restaurants.name: Lek Yai Traditional Tom Yum Noodles • Sam Yan
restaurants.address:

1440 Banthat Thong Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Visited Lek Yai on a Saturday evening and waited around 15 minutes before being seated. Luckily, a table opened up right on the footpath outside. It was an ideal spot to eat and take in the energy of Banthat Thong Road. The atmosphere was loud and bustling, with dense crowds shuffling past, tuk-tuks, bikes and cars on the street. Thankfully, it was the kind of vibe we wanted.

We ordered the signature pork tom yum noodles, along with fried pork wontons and iced lime soda. Everything arrived fast, steaming hot, and delicious. The soup was tangy, rich, and balanced, with enough spice to give it a kick without overpowering the flavour (I ordered the 'not spicy' option just to be safe). This is the best tom yum noodles I’ve ever had. Maybe there’s better out there, but I haven’t found it yet.

Prices are reasonable at around ฿65 per bowl, and service stays quick despite the constant crowd. There’s indoor seating for those who prefer air conditioning, but the outdoor tables are where the real Bangkok experience happens. Highly recommend this place.

My Instagram: @BenCanTravel
My Youtube: @BenCanTravel
sample_reviews_th.author: Ben Cantrell

sample_reviews_th.text:
⚠️ Honest Review: Tasty Noodles but Poor Hygiene at Lek Yai Traditional Tom Yum Noodles

We visited Lek Yai Traditional Tom Yum Noodles after reading about its bold flavors and budget-friendly dishes — but sadly, the overall experience didn’t live up to expectations.

✅ I had the Spicy Red Sauce Noodles with Pork (70฿) — rich, tangy, and satisfying with tender pork. Definitely the highlight of the meal.
✅ We also ordered a Pad Kra Pao Moo Sap (89฿), but it wasn’t to my taste — too sweet and way too spicy. I prefer a more balanced, savory style.
✅ Two glasses of iced Thai milk tea helped cool things down — creamy, fragrant, and refreshing.

🚫 All orders must be placed through the Grab app, even for dine-in, which might be inconvenient for some.

🚫 The biggest issue was the hygiene. The place felt very run-down, and I saw cockroaches crawling on the wall and flies all over the dining area. It made the experience quite uncomfortable and really overshadowed the food.

⭐️⭐️⭐️ 3 stars — only because of the noodle dish and prices. I wouldn’t return unless there’s a serious improvement in cleanliness.
sample_reviews_th.author: WanderWithWit

sample_reviews_th.text:
Tried Lek Yai Traditional Tom Yum Noodles • Sam Yan (เล็กใหญ่ ก๋วยเตี๋ยวต้มยำโบราณ • สามย่าน) and it was truly satisfying. The tom yum broth is the highlight — rich, aromatic, and perfectly balanced in sourness and spice. Each sip packs strong, authentic flavors that really stand out.

The shop attracts many locals, which is always a good sign when it comes to Thai noodles. The atmosphere is simple and lively, with quick and friendly service.

If you’re around Sam Yan and craving a great bowl of traditional tom yum noodles, this place is absolutely worth stopping for! 😋🔥
sample_reviews_th.author: Crumpled Nomad

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tried Lek Yai Traditional Tom Yum Noodles at Sam Yan and it definitely lives up to the hype. I ordered the original spicy pork tom yum soup with egg noodles, fried dumplings with minced meat, and a plate of pad krapow.

The tom yum soup was the highlight—rich, bold, and well-balanced between spicy, sour, and slightly sweet. The flavors hit immediately but didn’t feel overwhelming, and the egg noodles held up well in the broth. It’s the kind of bowl that keeps you going back for another spoon.

The fried dumplings were a solid side—crispy on the outside with juicy minced meat inside. Simple but done right. The pad krapow was also good, packed with flavor and a nice level of spice that complements the rest of the meal.

One thing to note: portions are quite big. It looks manageable at first, but it adds up quickly, especially if you’re ordering multiple dishes.

The place is busy and lively, which usually says a lot. Service is fast and efficient despite the crowd.

Overall, everything I tried was good. If you like strong, punchy flavors and don’t mind a bit of heat, this place is worth coming to—just come hungry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ryan Edward (RyanEdwardFitness)

sample_reviews_en.text:
After playing football at Thep Hatsadin Stadium, it was already past 10 PM 🥵⚽

The team's next mission wasn't tactical analysis, but finding something to eat!

Luckily, we found Lek Yai Ancient Tom Yum Noodle Soup • Samyan, Banthat Thong 🍜

And let me tell you, it didn't disappoint...

The tom yum broth was spicy, flavorful, and perfectly seasoned – no need to add anything. The bouncy pork was delicious, and the toppings were plentiful. The first bite instantly relieved all the tiredness from running after the ball.

How delicious was it?

So delicious that we ordered some soup to take home 😆

The next day, we added instant noodles ourselves, and it became another satisfying meal, just as good as eating at the restaurant.

Sometimes, the joy of football players at this age isn't scoring the winning goal, but finding a delicious restaurant after the game! 🤣🍜⚽

sample_reviews_en.author: Marketing PTSC

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sam Yan is not just another stop on Banthat Thong Road—it’s a place that really delivers.

I tried the fried minced pork with garlic, served with rice and a fried egg, along with a small bowl of broth. The dish was very fragrant, packed with garlic flavor but nicely balanced, not overpowering. Simple, but very satisfying.

A highlight was the spicy crispy noodles with minced pork. Crispy noodles topped with a generous amount of juicy minced pork and a fresh, aromatic sauce—full of flavor and definitely worth trying. Also served with a small bowl of broth on the side.

The place is clearly popular—often crowded, with quick turnover and plenty of delivery activity. Ordering is easy via QR code with a bilingual menu (Thai and English).

Great food, great value for money, and a lively atmosphere. Highly recommended if you’re exploring the Banthat Thong food scene.
sample_reviews_en.author: Farangondiet

sample_reviews_en.text:
Leh Yai Traditional Tom Yum stood out for the pork meatballs — they were done really well and definitely the highlight of the meal. The soup itself was a bit too sweet and sour for my Western tastebuds. Overall, the food is light and not oily, which I appreciated, but the flavours just didn’t quite hit for me.

Service was friendly but a bit forgetful — I didn’t even get the Coke Zero I ordered, which was a little annoying. Next time, I’d probably just share a couple of dishes and keep walking down the street, as there are plenty of other food spots nearby. I wouldn’t come back personally, but if you’re after something more traditional and local, it might be worth checking out.

restaurants.address:

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate it with tears streaming down my face! It was spicy enough, but incredibly satisfying! The crisp pickled cabbage paired perfectly with the tender fish, and the generous amount of fragrant garlic was irresistible. A spoonful of hot soup was simply divine. I couldn't stop eating the rice. This restaurant doesn't offer single-serving portions of pickled cabbage fish, but the staff kindly assisted me in ordering a custom-made meal. They also provided complimentary hot roselle and tangerine peel tea, its slightly sour flavor perfect for warming the stomach before the main course. However, some of the staff were foreigners and didn't speak Thai, Chinese, or English very well, which was a bit confusing for first-time customers. Thankfully, a Mandarin-speaking server quickly came to assist. A dining experience worth revisiting!
sample_reviews_en.author: 林奕廷

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm not really a seafood or fish person. I only eat fish that is DEEP FRIED.  Tai Er signature dish 酸菜鱼 really me change my mindset.  This dish looks more like soup, it is spicy, sour and steamy hot. You need to eat it with rice or noodles, by itself the taste will be too strong. The sliced fish is fresh and soft, like melted in your mouth. Other dish like stir-fried pork with bell peppers is also a good dish to order. It is a very fun restaurant and full of energy. Some of the staffs at Rama9 branch can speak Mandarin. Tai Er is a worth recommending restaurant. You won't regret it. I still can't imagine that I like FISH SOUP.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes good, and the decor has a unique ambiance. The staff are friendly and can speak Chinese, but they seem to lack service experience and are a bit unpolished. One surprising thing is that they don’t accept Prompt Pay, only manual bank transfers, which feels a bit outdated, considering how rare this payment method is nowadays. Overall, the experience was decent, though the price felt slightly high but still within an acceptable range. Anyway, I think it’s worth a try if you’re interested in authentic Chinese flavors.👍

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tai Er is a Chinese restaurant famous for its signature Suancai & Fish — fish with pickled mustard greens. The Suancai & Fish is definitely the must-try dish here, and honestly, it tastes really good. For me, I prefer it without extra chili because it’s already pretty spicy on its own.

As for the other dishes, they were just average in my opinion.

Personally, I’d recommend ordering the large Suancai & Fish and pairing it with a bowl of rice. Simple, satisfying, and definitely the best way to enjoy the meal.

sample_reviews_en.text: Tried the steamed fish with plum, stir-fried string beans, and mapo tofu. Everything was really tasty. The flavors were strong and authentic, with a nice level of seasoning that made each dish stand out. The fish was fresh and cooked perfectly, with the plum adding a light sour note that balanced it out. The string beans were crunchy and well-seasoned, and the mapo tofu was spicy and flavorful without being overwhelming. Overall, it’s a great place for Chinese food with bold flavors that really hit the spot.

sample_reviews_en.text:
A really nice, solid breakfast spot, even if the 4.9 rating had me a bit skeptical at first!

The Setup: Caught a table straight away for breakfast in the lovely weather. Ordered 1 mango smoothie, 1 breakfast sandwich, and 1 fruit bowl. Total spent was 320 Baht (~£7).

What stood out:

✅ The Service: The staff here are lovely and very welcoming. Great service all around, and our order came out quite quickly.

🔥 The Experience: A beautiful location with good food quality overall. The fruit in the bowl was perfectly ripe and splendid, and the breakfast sandwich hit the spot. It might not completely blow you away for a simple breakfast, but other meals might differ and it is a really nice place.

🙌 The Portion/Value: 8.4/10 - Good portions and very fair prices for a lovely, comfortable setting.

The Verdict: Highly recommend if you are looking for a reliable, relaxing breakfast and great hospitality in the area.

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a great dinner at The Island and can highly recommend it. I had the Panang Curry and my girlfriend ordered the red curry with duck served in a pineapple – it looked absolutely amazing and tasted just as good. The portions were very large and definitely worth the money.

You can choose your preferred spice level, which is a great option. I ordered medium and could probably have handled it a bit spicier, but it’s definitely better than being too hot.

The restaurant itself is quite spacious, very clean, and the service was excellent. Shine took care of us and she was incredibly friendly, funny, and very attentive. The food arrived quickly and everything felt very welcoming.

For us it was great value and we would definitely come back again. Highly recommended if you’re in the area!

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a wonderful dining experience at Island in Bangkok. The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Every dish we ordered was delicious, and the quality of the ingredients really stood out.

A special thanks to our waiter, Zaw, who was exceptionally friendly, attentive, and professional. His warm hospitality and great recommendations made our visit even more enjoyable.

The atmosphere was relaxed and inviting, making it a perfect place to enjoy a meal. If you’re looking for great food, excellent service, and a welcoming ambiance in Bangkok, we can definitely recommend Island. We would happily come back!

sample_reviews_en.text:
This small Japanese restaurant is located inside Siam Paragon, in the cinema zone. It's another branch of Sushi Seki, but only serves freshly prepared Japanese food; it doesn't offer shabu-shabu like the main branch downstairs. However, it's less crowded, making it ideal for those who don't want to wait for a table or prefer a quieter environment.

I visited for dinner on a Sunday in mid-January. I ordered several dishes, including the BlueFin block set, tuna sashimi platter, foie gras sushi, crab roe, and salad. The freshly prepared dishes arrived relatively quickly. The staff were attentive, frequently checking on customers, clearing plates, and generally asking if we were comfortable.

Overall, it's a Japanese restaurant with a decent selection of dishes and premium ingredients, but this comes at a higher price. Also, the prices listed on the menu do not include 7% VAT and a 10% service charge.

restaurants.name: Here Duan (Banthat Thong)
restaurants.address:

1982,1984 Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sensational Seafood and Bangkok’s Gold Standard Crab Fried Rice

For anyone seeking an authentic yet elevated taste of Bangkok’s street-style seafood, Here Hai is an absolute essential stop. Famed for its generous portions and Michelin Bib Gourmand recognition, this iconic eatery truly lives up to all the immense hype surrounding it.
The undeniable star of the show is their legendary Crab Fried Rice. Packed with massive, sweet chunks of fresh lump crab meat, every bite offers a smoky wok hei aroma and incredible depth of flavor. Beyond the fried rice, the Stir-fried Mantis Shrimp with Garlic and Chili and the Giant River Prawns are spectacular—brimming with rich prawn head fat and cooked to juicy perfection. Pairing these with their signature tangy green seafood dipping sauce takes the flavors to a whole new level.
The venue itself has a clean, unpretentious, homey vibe spread across a simple shopfront. Because of its massive popularity, queues can be long and wait times significant, but the efficient service and lightning-fast food execution once seated make every minute worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hoa Nguyen

sample_reviews_en.text:
THE 5 STAR RATING IS A SCAM
They have a high rating just cos diners get a free drink for giving a 5 star review on google.

The food is alright, but definitely not worth the price, hype or 5-star worthy. Wouldn’t bother coming here or ever, honestly.
- Basil rice - Meat was overcooked, dry and cold with a pre cooked egg that was cold too.   (Note that you can’t request for it to be less spicy. There’s “instructions” on the table that tell you to “pick out the chill”.)
- Pork Neck - You can tell the meat was sitting on the side for a while cos it was cold. It was crispy, but it just isn’t great that it came cold. What a waste.
- Tom Yum Soup - Alright. Not the best. But probably the only thing that came hot.
- Crab Fried Rice - For it’s price, you’d expect it to be generous with crab and well cooked. But it wasn’t. The crab meat was dry.

Maybe it was the end of the day, but the service staff were pretty rude when we were there.

So if you’ve got to the end of the review. Just skip this place. You’re better off spending your time and money elsewhere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Victoria Lim

sample_reviews_en.text:
Some months back, I was craving some thai food...so while scrolling in grab...I found this place..and ordered some delivery food. So, Creamy Omelet with stir fried pepper and garlic on rice (shrimp), and Savory Grilled Chicken was ordered as I was craving this sort of food. And well...it satisfied by craving...highly recommend this food.
The review and rating of the food: -
1) Creamy Omelet with stir fried pepper and garlic on rice (shrimp) (10/10)- if you love butter shrimp, then this food is our heaven...packed with shrimp...doused in butter...the egg is so creamy and smooth..obviously due to the butter...rich in flavor...perfect with the rice and use the green sauce for cutting down the richness of the dish and to add a burst of spice and twang to the dish...highly recommend it.
2) Savory Grilled Chicken (9/10) - the chicken was juicy and tender...falling of the bone...it had great flavor....would be better if the skin was more crispier...but its a personal preference...otherwise great dish...must eat it with the condiments.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shams Yaard Khan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited Here Duan in Bangkok and had a very good experience overall. The salmon was fresh, perfectly cooked, and full of flavor — you can immediately taste the quality of the ingredients.

We also tried two different omelettes: one with crab and one with beef. The crab omelette was generous, packed with sweet, fresh crab meat and cooked beautifully. The omelette with beef was rich and satisfying, filled with tender, well-seasoned pieces of beef. Both dishes were simple but executed with great attention to detail.

The restaurant itself is casual and unpretentious, clearly focused on food quality rather than design. It can get busy and you may need to wait, but it’s worth it. Prices are higher than typical street food, yet justified by the quality and portion sizes.

A very solid spot in Bangkok if you appreciate fresh seafood and well-prepared comfort dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michał Pszczoła

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very disappointing experience. We waited over an hour just to get our turn because tickets are issued one by one. We were with our family and young children, so the long wait was especially inconvenient.

The food took quite a while to arrive, and unfortunately, some dishes were already cold when they were served. The seafood stir-fried noodles were cold, the egg and shrimp fried rice was just okay, and the tom yum hot pot was terrible—very powdery and extremely spicy.

The air conditioning was also uncomfortably cold, with strong drafts blowing directly at us, and there was no way to adjust it. Definitely not family-friendly, especially for young children.

We also ordered Chang and Singha beer, which came in small bottles, and soda, which was nothing special.

Overall, the experience was not worth the wait or the money. I wouldn’t come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gia Linhh

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went there as a group of three and the total bill came to around THB 3,000 for about four dishes.

Unfortunately, the service was disappointing. Everything had to be ordered by scanning a QR code, and even when we simply asked a staff member for an empty glass, we were told to order it through the system. Despite this, the restaurant still charges a 10% service charge, which I found quite unreasonable considering the level of service provided.

The food itself was very standard and nothing particularly memorable. After adding VAT and the service charge, the overall experience felt quite overpriced for what we received.

Unfortunately, I don’t think it was worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: BT T

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is so packed. We arrived roughly 15’ prior to the last order so we secured ourselves a table in less than 5 minutes of wait time.

I’m not familiar with Thai cuisine, so I can’t say if these are authentic or not. The rice with fried egg was great, soft, pillowy, and pretty moist. The soup/hotpot is pretty bland and sour, you are able to add fish sauce to enhance the taste if needed. Fried pork is wonderful, crispy, not too salty and overall very satisfying especially when paired with the sour soup, which cuts through the fattiness.

Price is reasonable, with drinks totaling roughly 800 THB. Please do note that the bill must be >1000 THB for Visa/Master.
sample_reviews_en.author: Trung Vương (Chun)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Malaysian here, fortunate enough to arrive at 9.15pm and walk straight in without queueing which probably earned one solid star in the review. Music was upbeat 🔥

The food was a solid 3.8 stars, but hardly life-changing. Crab omelette: mid. Pork neck: tough. Stir-fried instant noodles with pork: surprisingly good for what was essentially elevated Maggi goreng. Washed it all down with a couple of refreshing Singha beers. Food was served quite fast, the chilli slaps.

It’s one of those places your friends rave about, and after eating there, you start questioning whether you are living on different planes. Can is can, but should you waste [however many hours] queuing??
sample_reviews_en.author: Char

restaurants.name: เฮงหอยทอด - เอกมัย
restaurants.address:

128 3 Ekkamai 14 Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here today (April 23, 1969). The braised pork rice was delicious; what's unique about this place is that they add boiled peanuts, which enhances the richness. My boyfriend had the fried oysters and said they were tasty and crispy, and the dipping sauce was flavorful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr.Arnon Wong

sample_reviews_en.text: The other restaurants were always crowded and expensive. We stumbled upon this one by chance. The food was incredibly delicious. The Vietnamese people ate wonderfully. A great experience. Especially the fried oysters, padthai, and braised pork knuckle. The prices were reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Như Ý Phan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, including the fried oysters, oyster omelet, and pork leg rice with boiled peanuts.
The fried oysters were crispy and not greasy / the oyster omelet was soft and not fishy / the pork leg rice was delicious and worth the price. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Maynie Pitarangsi

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here, and it was delicious! The Pad Thai was perfect as is, and the fried mussels were incredibly crispy. The flavors were rich and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: จันทร์เพ็ญ ทองเสริม

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there because the oyster pancakes looked delicious... but I saw Tom Yum Pad Thai on the menu and ordered it out of curiosity, and I actually liked this even more!
sample_reviews_en.author: 넉빠지니

sample_reviews_en.text: Randomly found this spot while in the area. A small vintage vibe. Food was delicious and service was attentive. Only one thing the food takes quite awhile to come out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gina Rattanaboontham

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my first time here, and my first time trying braised pork leg with beans. The pork leg was delicious and tender. I recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siravich Junthong

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the atmosphere was great. The Pad Thai and Tom Yum Goong had a rich flavor, and the seafood was very fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: ariyawad chokgasem

restaurants.name: Red Panda Yakiniku (Phaya Thai)
restaurants.address:

55, 26-27 Phaya Thai Rd, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: This is a buffet restaurant, and this branch has two price options: 699฿++ and 1,299฿++.
sample_reviews_th.author: S K (DoubleNN)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Before booking, I clearly confirmed with the restaurant that Grab Dine Out could be used on the 13th, and was assured that it could be used if the service was received before 5:30 PM. Therefore, I decided to book and use the service according to the stated conditions.

However, upon arrival at the branch, the staff informed me that the offer could not be used because it was a public holiday. While I understand this might be a restaurant policy, what was unacceptable was that the staff acted as if they had already informed customers that it was not valid, even though I had repeatedly asked and confirmed that it was indeed valid.

The staff also stated that it couldn't be used at other branches either, even though I have previously used the offer at the Pinklao branch without any problems or complicated conditions. I even used the offer at the Pinklao branch today without any issues.

I am a regular customer of Red Panda, both at this branch and the Pinklao branch, so I am quite disappointed with the miscommunication and the staff's way of communicating with customers. I will definitely not be returning to this branch again. I'm very upset and disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sün-Sün A. Prawatvatchara

sample_reviews_en.text:
Red Panda Yakiniku Buffet costs 699 baht per person. For two people, including VAT and service charge, the total was approximately 1,736 baht. We went based on a Google review that gave it a 4.8-star rating (?).

Personally, I felt it wasn't worth the price, especially the meat. The meat was quite bland and tough (mostly frozen). For a few more baht, ordering à la carte with better quality meat would be more worthwhile, and you wouldn't have to endure such a painful meal and worry about being charged extra.

The restaurant also has sashimi; only the salmon was passable. The river prawns were small and mushy.

Another thing that needs improvement is the service. The staff didn't explain the different types of dipping sauces available, including the seafood sauce. You wouldn't notice them unless you looked closely.

Overall, for me, the price is too high compared to the quality. I'm put off by it and won't dare eat at a buffet again for a long time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffy Jeffy

sample_reviews_en.text:
An AMAZING experience in Bangkok. 🔥
We absolutely loved everything. The concept of having the grill in the center of the table and being able to cook the meat to your liking makes dinner fun, different, and very special. The quality of the meats surprised us immensely: tender, flavorful, and with a huge variety. The seafood, fish, and side dishes were also fresh and truly delicious.

The buffet format is incredibly well thought out because for a very reasonable price, you can try so many high-quality dishes, something that's not so easy to find these days. The atmosphere has great energy, and the whole experience is enjoyable from beginning to end.

Without a doubt, one of our favorite places in Bangkok and a must-visit for those who enjoy good meat, Asian barbecue, and authentic culinary experiences. We would go back a thousand times. 👏🔥🥩🦐
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Gurau

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food wasn't terrible; some things were really good.
But this time, the beef tongue was tough, the eel was tough and had scales.
Other cuts of beef were okay, the pork was delicious.

I'm giving 5 stars because of the service. The staff were excellent, everyone was great. They took turns clearing empty plates, and the food was served very quickly even though the restaurant was full at 6 pm.

**Especially the male staff member with glasses who served and handled the payment. He was very polite and provided excellent service. He served cutlery immediately after I ordered rice without me even asking.**
He also served salt and pepper and immediately advised me to eat it with meat without dipping sauce.
Overall, the service was excellent throughout the restaurant. I was very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patiroj Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: I was disappointed. The shrimp wasn't fresh, the texture was mushy, and the meat was strangely dry. It was grilled briefly, but it became dry and not juicy and tender like other places. It wasn't tasty at all. Also, I wouldn't recommend ordering the mixed meat set because it contains a lot of tough meat. The salmon sashimi was cut into pieces that weren't separated, just stuck together in a clump, which was very confusing. The only good thing is that the plating is beautiful and perfect for photos. But the food itself was terrible; I even had diarrhea afterwards. One visit is enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dek Chob Kin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The meat was so tough! At first, I thought it was just the tongue, but the wagyu was also incredibly tough. My jaw ached from chewing. It lacked the flavor of beef and tasted like the all-you-can-eat 299 baht restaurants. 😭

I heard good reviews, but I'm so disappointed. I didn't enjoy eating it at all because my jaw was so tired from chewing.

The sashimi was okay though; I did find a few pieces of sashimi that were a bit mushy.

The ice cream and daifuku were delicious, but I'm sad the meat wasn't good at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaravee S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten here many times and really like it, but on my last visit, I'd like to suggest that your staff receive hygiene training for the following reasons:

1. A staff member with very long hair was flipping her hair around and it hit me 2-3 times while I was eating.

2. One staff member was using a cloth to swat flies while nearby tables still had food and were eating.

Please provide more hygiene training for your staff, as the prices are high, but the cleanliness and hygiene were like a roadside stall.
sample_reviews_en.author: piyaporn prapahan

restaurants.name: โค-ร-ต KORATA (Siam Square)
restaurants.address:

Siam Square Soi 3, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Came here with my parents for dinner and we love all the menu we ordered. The portions are perfect and the staffs are amazingly sweet. Best part of today’s dinning is the แจ่วโซดา drink! Highly recommended
sample_reviews_th.author: Apinya Chamchoi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Korata is a hidden gem that beautifully blends authentic flavors with a touch of modern elegance. From the moment you step in, the ambience feels welcoming—calm yet vibrant, perfect for both casual dining and special occasions.

The menu is thoughtfully curated, offering dishes that are not only delicious but also presented with care. Each bite feels balanced and satisfying, with fresh ingredients shining through. The seafood selections are particularly memorable, cooked to perfection and paired with broths and sauces that elevate the experience.

Service is attentive without being intrusive, adding to the overall sense of comfort. The staff’s warmth and professionalism make the dining journey feel guided and effortless.

Korata isn’t just a place to eat—it’s a place to savor, to pause, and to enjoy food as a meaningful experience. Highly recommended for anyone seeking quality dining with ambience that lingers long after the meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: kiweejace

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was deceived by the raving reviews, so I’m updating this to help others avoid the same experience. While the service was good, the staff repeatedly asked if I had reviewed the restaurant, as they were offering a free dish fried salmon head, which turned out to be overly oily and starchy.

I specifically searched for “authentic Thai food” and ended up here, only to realize it’s more of a Chinese-Thai fusion, which wasn’t what I was looking for. I ordered individual dishes with rice separately, and to my surprise, the portions were quite small, especially considering the high price range. Even the rice was served in a small plate, not a full bowl.

After spending 300-400 baht per person, I walked out feeling unsatisfied, knowing I could have gotten better quality food elsewhere. Unless you're just looking for an air-conditioned place to eat, I wouldn’t recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: A C

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don’t usually leave reviews for every restaurant, but this rating honestly feels a bit overrated.

We were walking around Siam Square looking for something to eat, saw this place, and decided to give it a try. The Thai-style decor is nice, and the service was not bad.

The food was okiee, but nothing particularly impressive. The grilled pork jowl was average, and the tom yum noodles lacked depth and flavor.

I was genuinely surprised by the 4.9 rating on Google. I assume part of it comes from the restaurant encouraging customers to leave a 5-star review in exchange for a free dish. Personally, I don’t feel comfortable giving a high rating just for free food.

Overall, it’s fine, not bad, but definitely not something I would rate 5 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jessy

sample_reviews_en.text: We were asked to vacate our table only 50 minutes after sitting down to order. We had finished our meal and the table had been cleared for about 10 minutes when the staff politely gestured for us to leave, even though the restaurant was not busy at the time. What made it even more surprising was that while we were standing by the entrance waiting for our taxi, we were gestured to move along once again. I have no complaints about the food, but being pressured to leave twice in under an hour when there were plenty of open seats is hard to justify. Very disappointing experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Li Tyrone

sample_reviews_en.text: A disappointing dinner after the end of a shopping day. Kept things simple and  ordered the shrimp Pad Thai, morning glory and clams with chili. Hardly any noodles in the pad Thai and after finally finding them they were very thin gluey noodles clumped together  they saturated in too much sauce with way too much fried pork skin all over it. The clams were not fresh, smelt fishy and were overcooked or reheated from frozen , stringy, and basically not worth eating. Such a shame! Waitress also a bit clueless. Nice decor inside. Again, such a shame as reviews looked good at 4.9!
sample_reviews_en.author: Gillian Bertram

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don’t be fooled with the high ratings! They ask customers to rate before even trying the food so you can get free appetizer. I told them i’ll try it first. The food was okay but the tom yum soup we thought it was big for 2000bhat but it was just a small serving size good for 1 person.

Overall, I saw a lot of tourists try this shop because of the high rating but I see it as a tourist trap! Nothing special with the place

Plus the bathroom is in the 4th floor! Waited so long for my turn just to learn it was a staff inside probable making tiktok videos!
sample_reviews_en.author: fille cainglet

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was a mixed bag; some dishes were good while others were not. The portion sizes were quite small. Interestingly, we were asked to give a five-star review in exchange for a free dish (my friend did that, not me! 😂).

The clam dish was disappointing because it wasn't fresh, and some of the clams were closed. We were offered another dish instead: chicken with cashew nuts. It was very sweet and had only three pieces of chicken!

Overall, I wasn't particularly impressed. It's not terrible, but it didn't wow me either.
sample_reviews_en.author: PP K.

restaurants.name: Suda - Thai & Vegetarian Restaurant
restaurants.address:

Unit 14, Number, 360 Samsen 4 Alley, Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was good, especially the Khao Soy. However, the chicken satay didn't look anything like the picture on the menu. For a place with such high prices, I expected a more generous portion.

The skewers were very thin, and some had very little meat on them. They were also very dry. I mentioned this to the waiter during the meal, but no solution was offered, and I wasn't given any extra skewers.

It's a shame, because the quality was decent, but the portion size didn't seem justified by the price (at least for this particular dish).
sample_reviews_en.author: Mel & B

sample_reviews_en.text: A charming spot in Bangkok. We took the recommendations of the waiter who served us and we weren't disappointed. Everything was delicious and flavorful. I should also mention that they speak English and that if you have allergies, you can let the staff know and they'll gladly inform you about the dishes and save you from any unpleasant surprises. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Ángel Valle

sample_reviews_en.text: Great experience 10/10 at Suda Restaurant in Bangkok. We had Tom Yum Kai, green curry, fried shrimps, and a passionfruit smoothie - everything was fresh, flavorful, and really well prepared. The soup was especially good, and the smoothies were very refreshing. Definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Bangkok ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Lipa

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant was truly a gem! The Pad Thai was absolutely fantastic, bursting with flavor and perfectly balanced. The fried shrimp was exceptional, crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside. The ambiance was warm and welcoming, and the staff were incredibly friendly. Overall, it’s definitely a must-visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: vince Nanocchio

sample_reviews_en.text: I really enjoyed my meal at Suda - Thai & Vegetarian Restaurant. The portions felt generous for the price, and the service was smooth without being over the top. The khao soi stood out for me, and the mango smoothie was a great finish. I’d happily come back and try more from the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pete Lauer

sample_reviews_en.text: My girlfriend and I got the chicken khao soi. It was the first khao soi we have eaten that only featured dry noodle and not any other variant. HOT DAMN it was good. Best Khao Soi i’ve ever had, the crunch, the chicken, the flavour all top tier. Service was great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jack Marshall

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely 10/10 experience in Thailand the most delicious food I've had in a long time. Highly recommend! Truly divine food all around, every dish hit all marks, go here!!! This place deserves more customers!! I will be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Amanda Leeb

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was amazing!!! The service was fantastic. Our waiter was so sweet and the food came out so fast. The mango smoothie was amazing. They can also make anything vegetarian. We will definitely be coming back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Vivian Pettigrew

restaurants.name: The Family
restaurants.address:

1 6 Prachathipatai Rd, Khwaeng Ban Phan Thom, Khet Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The food is absolutely delicious and reasonably priced. The service is thoughtful and attentive, staff really care about customers’ experience. The dining environment is very cozy and pleasant. I highly recommend this place! Dishes are served really quickly. If the full score is 5, I’d give it 100! Thank you for such an amazing dining experience!
ขอบคุณทุกคนค่ะ
sample_reviews_th.author: _ xuan

sample_reviews_th.text: Really cool atmosphere overviewing the canal. The massaman curry was intense, rich, spicy and unforgettable. Expect tourists. I highly recommend going at night. ผมจะกลับมา!
sample_reviews_th.author: Víctor

sample_reviews_en.text:
Holy moly!!
I just went there for dinner and it has been the BEST THAI FOOD that I ever had!
It’s VERY busy but it’s so worth it.
This is how you experience a real Thai food experience.
The people who served and took orders were so kind and helpful.
The food is AMAZING!! Beware of the spicy level. I’m Mexican and I’m used to eat very spicy food but this dishes are way too spicy (delicious though). So if you don’t like-eat spicy food just order non spicy.
The Thai Tea and Coconut water are fantastic!!!
We ordered mango for dessert and my husband was really surprised that it was super sweet and fresh.
Please leave at least 10% for tip because the people running this business deserve it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Gio

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food, excellent service, great vibes. Came here for dinner with my partner and we enjoyed a table outside. The atmosphere was awesome - happy, groovy music playing and games & bug spray on each table. The server was super attentive, checked on us while we ate - not often something you seen at a small, local, packed restaurant.

We ordered a papaya salad to share, then ordered our own curries. I got the panang curry and my partner got the green curry plus a Chang and a soda water. Everything with low spice which still had a very good kick to it. 390 baht for everything.
sample_reviews_en.author: Briana Le

sample_reviews_en.text: The Family Restaurant offers a welcoming atmosphere with friendly staff and attentive waiters. The portions are generous and the food is delicious. They have both indoor and outdoor seating options, and the canel side is a great choice if you’re looking for something local. If you’re in the neighborhood and looking for a great place to eat, The Family Restaurant is the perfect match. I had a wonderful dining experience here and I highly recommend it. Thanks to the owner and staff for making it such a pleasant experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kris Kyaw

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely perfect and cozy restaurant and atmosphere. Food delicious, workers cute and friendly - speaking English. Prices nice too (every dish around 70-100 Baht, coke 20, beer 90-100). Great to try something local in case you are tired of markets and “standing”. We were there at 8PM and it was quite full so have a plan B also. The “river” next to it did not smell at all (in case you are scared). We paid in cash, not sure if they accept cards.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dan Tz

sample_reviews_en.text:
Going here was the food HIGHLIGHT of my friend and I's time in Bangkok.

The service is kind. The atmosphere is beautiful. The food is so flavorful and light and you have to stop yourself from licking your plate clean. The food is incredibly affordable, you are robbing yourself if you don't come here.

Recommendations from my friend and I:
1. Coconut Soup (Tom Kha) - (do yourself a favour and order this to be BLESSED)
2. Massaman Curry
sample_reviews_en.author: Charlize Mae

sample_reviews_en.text:
Such a great little spot with really authentic Thai food. The menu is small, but the food we had was amazing!

The prices were really good too, especially for how nice the whole experience was. We sat outside by the river —really chilled, lovely atmosphere, and just felt like a proper local place.

Definitely one of our favourite meals in Bangkok. Would 100% recommend if you want something tasty, relaxed, and genuinely authentic!
sample_reviews_en.author: Georgia Andrews

restaurants.name: Pad Thai Kratong Thong by ama
restaurants.address:

270 272 Maharat Rd, Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited Pad Thai Kratong Thong by Ama just before going to Wat Pho, and I absolutely don’t regret my choice!

The food was incredible. The schrimp pad thai was flavorful and perfectly seasoned, and their mango sticky rice was simply delicious. Everything tasted fresh and carefully prepared.

The service was also excellent. The man who welcomed us was extremely kind - he even showed me how to properly eat pad thai, which I really appreciated.

The only small downside was the wait. We arrived around 12:30 PM and had to wait about 20 minutes. But honestly, it was definitely worth it.

Once seated, the service was quick and efficient, and despite the restaurant being busy, we never felt rushed to leave, which made the experience even more enjoyable.

I’m truly not disappointed and would have loved to go back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Emilie Lm

sample_reviews_en.text: A popular restaurant that always has a line. While waiting under the scorching sun, they kindly handed out silver bowls filled with ice to people in line, which we could press against our arms and neck to cool down. For those of us not used to Bangkok’s heat, this was a very welcome gesture of hospitality. We ordered passion fruit juice and iced tea for drinks, and Tom Yum Kun and mango sticky rice for our meal. It was my first time trying blue rice, so I was a bit hesitant at first, but it paired well with the mango and was very delicious. The Tom Yum Kun also had an authentic taste, and we were very satisfied. Most of the customers in the restaurant seemed to be tourists, but despite that, the prices were quite reasonable. This is one of the places I would love to visit again when I come back to Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: HiDe86

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had an absolutely OUT OF THIS WORLD dinner here! We tried the Pad Thai, the Tomyum soup, and the fried pork—everything was spectacular.
The Pad Thai was truly excellent, and the Tomyum soup... words can’t describe it! It was so flavorful, a must-try for anyone visiting.
But what really made our night was the service. The staff is incredibly kind, especially the gentleman at the entrance who was offering ice to keep everyone cool while waiting and giving great recommendations. When our food arrived, he even showed us how to prepare the "perfect bite" to fully enjoy the flavors. Such a special and professional touch!
A little tip: We waited for almost an hour to get a table, but let me tell you—it was 100% worth the wait. If you are in the area, don't miss this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Arianna

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really nice restaurant for after visiting Wat Pho or Grand Palace. Even though you have to wait to get a table as it’s quite busy, it’s worth waiting.

The guy at the reception is walking around and explaining the tourists how to correctly eat the meals- but in a respectful manner (e.g. break rice cracker and eat with Pad Thai). They were very easy-going and not complicated even when I ordered the wrong drink by accident.

The Pad Thai with Shrimps was delicious and felt authentic (saying it as a European tourist). For the Mango Sticky Rice I had already better ones.

If you‘re looking for a great place to eat - nothing too fancy but authentic and tasty, this is the place to go.
sample_reviews_en.author: Liron Kaufman

sample_reviews_en.text:
Rated highly for a reason! Your perfect rest and refuel location after a day at Wat Arun, The Grand Palace, and/or Wat Pho. Although this place stays very busy, the wait to get a table didn't seem to be longer than 10-15 minutes for everyone, they get people in and out without it even feeling rushed somehow!

The shrimp pad thai was delicous, but the star of the show was the green curry. It was perfectly sour/creamy. The best curry I had in Thailand while we were here! The mango sticky rice was just okay to me. I really appreciated the bottles of water and bowls of ice they provide immediately to help you cool down.

There is a bathroom in the restaurant that is kept clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emma Waziri

sample_reviews_en.text:
As a Thai person, I found the food quite bland. My friend ordered the green curry chicken, but the chicken was very dry and made her really thirsty. The Pad Thai noodles weren’t the traditional kind, and the seasoning didn’t quite hit the mark. I also ordered the tom yum with shrimp ( requested spicy), hoping for a rich, spicy, and sour broth but
it was surprisingly bland, even though I specifically asked for it to be spicy.

That said, the portions of meat and shrimp were generous and fresh, and the pricing was reasonable. Maybe the flavors are adjusted for foreigners, I’m not sure. If the flavors were improved to be more authentic and bold, it could be a great spot 🙏🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: Yanisa M

sample_reviews_en.text: What an amazing little place. Popped in for some Pad Thai, Tom Yum Soup, Omelette and Blue Rice. The food was out of this world. We  had our order taken while we sat and waited for a table and within 5 minutes we were seated and our food had arrived. The staff showed me the best ways of tasting the dishes together and even gave us bowls and bags of ice to cool down in the heat. I can't express how awesome this place is. The prices were incredibly cheap too. If I'm lucky enough to return to Bangkok, I will come back to this place. Thanks to all the staff. You set the highest standard in Bangkok. Good luck for the future. Neil & Becky.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neil Collins

sample_reviews_en.text:
loved everything i ordered here, my family also very enjoyed the food and i took some for takeaway too! their mango sticky rice is a must to order. sadly they dont accept takeaway otherwise i would’ve bring them with me too 🥭

coconut water is definitely my go-to-drink absolutely! 🥥

can’t describe my feeling when i visited here, it’s wonderful! i love the way they keep smile and respectful while serving the customers especially a guy with the hair tied, he is very good and friendly

ps: the last picture u will see 2 bowls of ice, this to tap in our skin to make our body feel more refreshed after the hot weather out there

❤️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Emily Farida

restaurants.name: BK SALON
restaurants.address:

11 31 Sathu Pradit Rd, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
BK.Salon is a delicious restaurant offering fine dining Thai and Eastern-style cuisine. Chef Ton-Thitit Tassanakajorn (LeDu) provided food consultation, and Chef Jen, former Sous Chef of LeDu, is the Head Chef.

❤️ Spicy Prawn and Cha Kram Leaf Salad: A perfectly balanced flavor.
❤️ Stir-fried Cabbage with Fish Sauce: Crispy, delicious, and flavorful.
❤️ Stir-fried Cowslip Flowers with Runny Egg: A generous portion of egg and perfectly blended cowslip flowers.
❤️ Tom Yum Goong (Spicy Shrimp Soup): Rich and flavorful broth, easy to drink.
❤️ Stir-fried Tofu with Chili and Salt: Large chunks of tofu stir-fried with Eastern-style chili and salt – a truly delightful dish.

❤️❤️ Desserts:
Whole Coconut Ice Cream: Sweet and creamy coconut ice cream made with coconut milk and coconut water, served with shredded coconut and peanuts.

Longan Jelly: Sweet and crunchy, delicious.

🙏🙏 Don't miss the coffee – it's amazing!
The restaurant atmosphere is fantastic, perfect for relaxing.
There are so many more dishes on the menu that I'll definitely come back to try again. 🙏🙏🙏

#Eatanywhere
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachit Chairat

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant exceeded my expectations! They have a huge selection of food, and almost every dish we ordered was delicious. The flavors were perfectly balanced, the ingredients were fresh, and the atmosphere was great – comfortable seating, beautiful photo opportunities, and the staff were lovely and provided excellent service. Another thing I loved was the ample parking; no need to circle around looking for a spot. It's perfect for groups or families. I'll definitely be back to try more dishes! 🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: T P

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I was very impressed. The food tasted great, with a wide variety of dishes to choose from. Each dish was well-prepared and the ingredients were fresh. The restaurant's atmosphere is beautiful and comfortable, suitable for both families and groups of friends. The staff provided excellent and attentive service. Importantly, there is ample and convenient parking. Overall, the food, atmosphere, and service were all perfect. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aun Pat

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant charges a service charge, but we paid it without hesitation. The staff were lovely and provided excellent service. The food was delicious and worth the price. The restaurant is beautiful, but the dining area inside is quite small, so it can be noisy when there are many customers (on the day we visited, there were mostly Chinese customers and several children). Nevertheless, we will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Namprao Siriwat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thai restaurant, have to walk through the lot to the white structure to enter the restaurant.
Speedy efficient service. The crab rice with condiments tasted very bland to me personally. The banana dessert was simply and tasty. The tom kha-esque soup was unique and also tasted nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neel Joshi

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and flavorful, the atmosphere is beautiful, there's ample parking, and the staff provides excellent service. The menu is diverse, and the desserts are amazing – I highly recommend trying the Kumbhamas caramel ice cream.
sample_reviews_en.author: matura th

sample_reviews_en.text: The desserts are expensive, and bottled water costs 60 baht without being told it's that price. They poured it for me as if it were free. The bill came to 180 baht. If they're going to charge for water, they should have informed me.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanida Koo-amornpattana

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent, the staff were polite, and the food was served very quickly. The food was delicious and flavorful. My favorite was the braised pork; it was fragrant with spices and had a rich, savory taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thunyaluck Sritasan

restaurants.name: Eat Am Are Union Mall
restaurants.address:

01, 02, 04 54 ศูนย์การค้ายูเนียนมอลล์ ห้อง1P Lat Phrao 1, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Price / value is always good, especially for first time visitors of Thailand, who hesitate with asian food. You get a full fill dish for just around 10 bucks.
I suggested the salad with chicken as side dish.
This time I went full in and ordered the Austrian beef, loin medium rare and I was really surprised, how good it was prepared.
฿430 ($13 / €11.50)
To avoid a waiting line, prevent 11:30 - 13:00
sample_reviews_th.author: Markus_BKK

sample_reviews_en.text: I wanted to try this place due to the large amounts of people I’ve seen eating here every time I walk by. It’s always packed and I mean both dining areas are usually always full. So today, my wife, a friend (Will), and I decided to try it. The atmosphere is quite similar to a diner experience, family oriented, quick, without to much bling. Let me just say if you are going here for the crème de le crème experience, its not for you. However Will and I thought the burger and combo dinner were very good value for the money and tasted ok. Surprisingly, everybody expected more from the prime rib my wife ordered. It was the most expensive item and it didn’t deliver in our view. We all felt the lower priced items were better and met expectations, being delicious enough to say they were good value. So if you want get some beef without spending too much then this is a good place. If you are expecting more than that there are other options available for you in Bangkok that cater to a more upscale market.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kevin Sund

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a great place to go. Good steak with great prices. Waiting time isn't bad at all, it is quite quick. Had a lovely dinner at EAT Am ARe Union Mall with my date and was genuinely impressed! The atmosphere was cozy and perfect for a casual date night—not too loud, with a relaxed vibe that made the whole evening feel comfortable and enjoyable.
The service was excellent—staff were attentive, friendly, and made sure we had everything we needed without being intrusive. We both had steak and it was delicious—tender, flavorful, and cooked just right. The menu has a great variety of options, not just steak, so there’s definitely something for everyone. And the best part? Everything is reasonably priced for the quality you get. Highly recommend this spot if you’re looking for good food, a nice atmosphere, and great value. Will definitely come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Phattharapol Traithanasombat

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered steak for my husband and me, asked for medium well, but both came out medium rare and we honestly couldn’t eat them. We told the waitress and asked if they could cook them a little longer, but unfortunately they refused. I’ve eaten steak at many restaurants from 1-star to 5-star places, and normally if the steak isn’t cooked to the requested temperature, they fix it right away. I don’t mind however they do it, just wanted the blood cooked through so we could actually enjoy the meal. Sadly both steaks ended up going straight into the trash because we couldn’t swallow them.

Other food was actually great, and the restaurant looked nice which is why we were excited to finally try it after seeing it so many times. Just really disappointed with how the steak issue was handled.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amittada Baker

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stumbled upon this steakhouse by chance and were encouraged to try it after seeing how busy it was. The prices are very affordable, and the service was exceptional. Although the staff didn't speak English, they were incredibly proactive and used translation software to ensure we were well taken care of.

Regarding the food, we ordered the Double Pork Steak, but unfortunately, it was a bit underwhelming. The meat lacked juiciness and the flavor was quite ordinary—perhaps beef would have been a better choice. Additionally, the fries were quite hard, as if they had been fried directly from the freezer. While the hospitality was 5-star, the meal itself was a bit unremarkable
sample_reviews_en.author: rustam thomas

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good value for money, but be prepared for a wait.

Visited this branch at Union Mall. I ordered the Spicy Grilled Chicken & Pork Loin combo with Sliced Potatoes, plus an Apple Salad on the side.

The chicken was well-seasoned with a nice kick, and the pork loin was decent, though a bit lean. The sliced potatoes are always a highlight—crispy and savory. The apple salad was a good palate cleanser, fresh and not too sweet.

Portions are generous for the price. The only downside is the long queue during peak hours and the crowded seating. It’s a solid, reliable choice if you’re looking for an affordable steak meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark J.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food here was pretty good, with great steaks at affordable prices.

But the service was ridiculous. So we wanted to order 2 sets, and told them to replace chicken with a certain pork steak as we both wanted something different. They said no we could not.

In the end we ordered 2 other sets, when the plates arrived, we just swapped 1 piece of meat from the one to another and the result was the same that what we asked initially. Why the strict rules and being so inflexible? Really bad service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fan

sample_reviews_en.text:
First time in Bangkok and absolutely loved this restaurant. The staff is super efficient and welcoming, the food was super tasty, the steaks were juicy and perfectly made, the chicken was perfect. Clean, quick, great prices, very good quality for the money. It seemed a very popular place, as it was almost full the whole time we were there. I loved especially the politeness of the staff.
The restaurant is on the first floor F1, it took us a while to get there but it was totally worth it!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Cristina Lujerdean

restaurants.name: Tanbo Chicken Rice
restaurants.address:

301 Yaowarat Rd, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Food was served quickly, tasted fresh, and was fairly priced."

sample_reviews_th.text:
ข้าวมันหอมนุ่มไก่เนื้อแน่น This is a classic serving of Hainanese chicken rice, a beloved dish across many Southeast Asian countries, particularly Thailand, Singapore, and Malaysia. Here's a quick review:

Visual Presentation:

The dish looks clean and appetizing, served on a beautifully patterned blue-and-white porcelain plate that enhances the overall presentation.

The poached chicken is neatly sliced, and its sheen suggests it’s tender and moist—key to good Hainanese chicken.

The rice is well-cooked and evenly colored, indicating it was prepared with chicken fat and broth, as tradition demands.

The cucumber slices offer a fresh, crisp contrast in texture.

The clear broth in the background looks warm and inviting, garnished with green onions.

What Could Enhance It:

A small dish of the traditional dipping sauces (garlic-chili, ginger, and soy) would complete the experience.

Garnishing the chicken with a bit of fresh cilantro or green onion might give it a visual and aromatic lift.

Overall, this is a beautifully executed version of Hainanese chicken rice that looks both comforting and refined.
sample_reviews_th.author: Call me OAK

sample_reviews_th.text: I stopped by with my mom. I love the rice and juicy chicken. We ordered regular portion ฿65. The portion was enough for a woman. The only downside would be the sauce is a bit salty side. The other than that, everything was good.
sample_reviews_th.author: neehong2

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best chicken rice that we've ever had!!

Randomly stumbled upon this restaurant while walking down Yaowarat Road, and decided to tried out their chicken rice. Wanted to order the mix chicken (steamed and fried) with rice, but the fried was sold out for the day. So ended up ordering the boiled chicken rice.

It was a pleasant surprise. The rice was very aromatic while the chicken was very tender. The chili sauce complements the whole dish extremely well. We thoroughly enjoyed the food and would definitely recommend this restaurant to everyone.

We had the Longan Juice as well, it was refreshing and not too sweet! A great way to end a fulfilling dinner!
sample_reviews_en.author: Natasha Liman

sample_reviews_en.text: Great chicken rice in the middle of the busiest, bustling Chinatown street in Bangkok. We sat at one of the sidewalk tables, and people swarmed around us as we ate. Walk in and join the queue for a table anyway, you will not be sorry. We tried both the crispy fried and poached (boiled) chicken, both of which came with a little bowl of delicious broth. However, the standout was the boiled chicken, which was astoundingly moist and tender. Pro-tip, order yourself a large portion of the boiled chicken in addition to the “Singapore chicken rice” set. The chicken rice portions are small and you’re going to want even more poached chicken. 😅
sample_reviews_en.author: Marianne M

sample_reviews_en.text:
**Tanbo Chicken Rice (Yaowarat, Bangkok) - Short Review**

Tucked right in the bustling heart of Yaowarat Chinatown, this unpretentious spot serves up authentic Thai-style Hainanese chicken rice (khao man gai) that's tender, juicy, and perfectly balanced. The fragrant oily rice, silky poached chicken, and punchy chili-ginger sauce hit all the right notes—simple comfort food done right. Super affordable at around 50-70 THB per plate, with generous portions and quick service amid the neon chaos. A solid, no-frills gem for street food lovers.
sample_reviews_en.author: KPEx Official

sample_reviews_en.text:
It’s a Chicken rice in Singaporean style but sauces are in Thai style. We ordered mixed of Chicken rice (Boiled Chicken and Fried Chicken). I’m quite like Chicken as it’s really yummy and super soft that goes well with sauces. Also we ordered chicken’s liver that is tender. But I don’t like friend chicken that I expected chicken’s skin a bit more crispy. It’s also served with a complementary soup.

Price was starting from THB 60 for simple one which is friendly and affordable price based from the prime location of China town
sample_reviews_en.author: Miki T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tried this place for my first meal in Bangkok and was pleasantly surprised. The queue was quite long, which is always a good sign, and it definitely lived up to expectations.

The chicken rice was very well done — chicken was tender and juicy, rice was fragrant, and overall flavours were on point. Even noticed Jensen Huang’s photo inside, so looks like this place has some recognition too.

Coming from Singapore, where chicken rice is everywhere, I would say this is really good and worth trying if you’re in Bangkok. 👍🍗🍚
sample_reviews_en.author: Raymond Lim

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tanbo Chicken Rice in Yaowarat is a great spot for a simple but very satisfying meal. The fried chicken was amazing, crispy, flavorful, and cooked perfectly. It paired really well with the rice, making the whole dish very enjoyable.
Everything tasted fresh and well prepared, and the portions were satisfying for the price. The place has a casual and local feel, which adds to the overall experience. Overall, it is a solid chicken rice spot and I would definitely recommend giving it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Justin Roberts

restaurants.name: Dough Bros. Pizza & Doughnuts (Interchange 21 - Asok)
restaurants.address:

Interchange 21 Room 104 G. Floor 399 Sukhumvit Rd. Khlong Toei Neua, Wattana, Bangkok, 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
congratulations on your advertising campaign, the influencers who probably didn't pay their meal or maybe got paid did a fantastic job to promote and attract their audience.  Unfortunately reality is far from those beautiful posts.
Staff is very kind but lack of training, no help or information regarding menu,  not everyone is familiar with taters, garlic dough balls or lollipops...
Pictures on social media look so different from what is being offered ( fried chicken)
Pizza are not bad but nothing out of ordinary, the barbecue chicken topping doesn't look or taste like chicken. The sourdough was pretty flat.
Donuts not bad as well, but don't worth the hypes and the price at 130bahts each.
Combo for 2 menu is at the same price of items selected individually, and you can't select a half'n'half pizza, so no points.
Pricing: why do you add taxes, and which kind of taxes. Is that vat? service charge?
Advise: cross the street and enjoy a wider selection of Pizza for a cheaper price, and explore terminal 21 for a cheaper and wider selection of desserts.
sample_reviews_en.author: Moo wan

sample_reviews_en.text: The female cashier was very unpleasant. The food wasn't ready at the same time; some items sat on the tray without being served until the smoothie I ordered had completely melted. When I complained, she made a displeased face. Also, the refillable cups at the bar should have been given after paying, not waiting until with the food. I've eaten at many fast food places like Shake Shack and Five Guys, and they always give refillable cups beforehand – never like this! The atmosphere was nice, I liked the outdoor seating, but no staff came to clear our table. Many tables around ours were empty, but new customers couldn't sit there because no one was clearing them. They really need to change the entire staff! Overall, the food was average and quite expensive. The pizza was very mediocre; edible, but nothing special. However, the fried chicken and garlic sauce were delicious. I would only order the fried chicken and garlic sauce again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Esther T

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dough Bros in Bangkok absolutely delivers! Their sourdough crust is hands-down the star of the show—perfectly crispy on the outside, light and chewy on the inside, with a delicious natural flavor.
I ordered the Pepperoni, and it was outstanding. The pepperoni slices were packed with flavor, nicely crisp around the edges, and layered over rich tomato sauce and perfectly melted cheese. Don't forget to dip your crusts in their signature sauces—the garlic & herb dip takes every bite to another level!
The team is super friendly, service is fast, and the overall vibe is fantastic. If you’re looking for top-tier sourdough pizza in Bangkok, Dough Bros is the spot to go. 10/10 recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Renaldo Wiles

sample_reviews_en.text:
Be careful with their self service kiosk, it always causes issues. I wasn't going to write this but it has happened both times I went there. We ordered from the kiosks and the orders doesn't go through. We have to go to the cashier to actually confirm and get our food. The first time it took us an hour to get our food.  The second time it was 30+ minutes and that was because we didn't trust the system and checked with the cashier.

As much as I like the food there. I don't think I'll be coming back until they fix this. Their food is really good, too bad their system sucks and provides a poor dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaung Set Lin

sample_reviews_en.text:
My first time trying Dough Bros. Pizza & Doughnuts (Interchange 21 - Asok).
+ Conveniently located near BTS Asok station or MRT Sukhumvit station.
+ Clean and organized atmosphere.
+ Two ways to order:
+ Counter
+ Self-service kiosk
+ Homemade Italian pizzas (made to order) served with Garlic & Herb Dip.
+ The Classic: 300 THB
+ The Pepperoni: 370 THB
+ Refillable drinks: 60 THB
+ Sides:
+ Taters: 130 THB
+ Bro's Fried Chicken: 210 THB
+ Garlic Dough Ball: 130 THB
+ Doughnuts (Triple): 360 THB
+ Nutella
+ Biscoff
+ White chocolate pistachio
sample_reviews_en.author: Tro Asian

sample_reviews_en.text: The pizza is delicious, and the strawberry jam donut is also tasty. The mango jam donut is good too. If you're coming alone, I recommend ordering a pizza slice. The staff explained well that they don't pre-make a whole pizza and then slice it, but instead prepare pizza slices beforehand without baking them. Then, they add the toppings and bake it when someone orders. The shop has a handwashing area for customers who want to eat with their hands, and free water is also available.
sample_reviews_en.author: N N (Pom)

sample_reviews_en.text: The pizza is delicious. Not exactly Italian, but delicious! The kids will definitely love it. The only downside is the loud music, very loud for two o'clock in the afternoon. But we asked for it to be quieter. They turned it down a bit, but it was still loud. The cafe has a sink for washing hands, which is very nice! 5 stars. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Irina

sample_reviews_en.text: First rule of opening a pizza shop is to learn how to make good pizza.  Ordered pepperoni and mozzarella and both looked and tasted mediocre at best.  The sauce was dark red and so was the cheese and neither tasted good.  The crust was crispy and not chewy the way it's supposed to be.  I only ate the pizza so not to waste 350 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Migs Michaelsen

restaurants.name: Panda Thai Food & Vegetarian
restaurants.address:

196 Samsen 2 Alley, Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hands down one of the best meals we’ve had in Thailand so far!

The Setup: Came here for dinner as 2 of us in the evening. Ordered 2 fresh smoothies, chicken pineapple rice, garlic grilled chicken, and a mango sticky rice to share. Total spent was around 580 Baht (~£13).

What stood out:

✅ The atmosphere & Service: Incredibly welcoming and friendly. They even gave us a little discount slip for when we return, which is an unreal touch. We will absolutely be coming back!

🔥 The Experience: The watermelon and pineapple smoothies were absolutely incredible and so fresh. For the mains, the chicken pineapple rice and garlic grilled chicken had insane quality and flavour—true homemade, fresh dishes. Even the mango sticky rice was stunning with piping hot rice and super fresh mango.

🙌 The Portion/Value: Crazy value for the money. You get massive quality and authentic, hearty flavours for an amazing price.

The Verdict: Highly recommend if you are looking for a bit of incredible comfort food and fresh local dishes in the area!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kai Sweet

sample_reviews_en.text:
Panda Thai in Bangkok is an absolute gem! The food here is nothing short of amazing authentic flavors, fresh ingredients, and beautifully presented dishes. Their smoothies are equally delightful, bursting with flavor and a refreshing complement to the meal.

We first ate here upon arriving in Bangkok for our trip and loved it so much that we made it a point to return before our flight home. The consistency in quality and taste is truly impressive, and the experience was just as fantastic the second time around.

What makes Panda Thai even more remarkable is the value for money. For the quality and portions, it’s an absolute steal. If you’re in Bangkok, don’t miss out on this fantastic spot! Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pikhaar

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited for the overwhelmingly high score on Google but were somehow disappointed by some dishes. Somtam, Lemon Pork Mince and Pineapple Rice are nice, but the Cold Mama Noodles and Basil Pork Rice with Egg are not as good. They are either too salty or tasting like soy sauce. The Green Curry and Pumpkin Soup could've been more condensed or creamy. Sticky rice was of good quality but the mango aside was not. The coconut smoothie is the worst amongst what we had tonight as none of us could even finish it.

It's true that people have various tastes and preferences, but if you are curious about the seemingly amazing score, check the one star reviews.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zhicong Xu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Panda Thai Food & Vegetarian is a must-visit for anyone craving authentic Thai flavors with a vegetarian twist. Their pineapple fried rice is absolutely the best — perfectly balanced with sweet, savory, and aromatic notes, and served in a fresh pineapple for that extra flair. The mango sticky rice is equally outstanding, with ripe, juicy mango and creamy coconut sticky rice that melts in your mouth.

The restaurant is clean and welcoming, with friendly staff who make the dining experience even better. Whether you’re vegetarian or not, Panda Thai Food & Vegetarian delivers dishes full of flavor that leave you wanting more.
sample_reviews_en.author: sanjana v

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had an incredible dinner at Panda Thai! We tried the Massaman Curry and the Pad Krapow Moo, and they were both absolutely delicious.
I have to say, the Massaman Curry was OUT OF THIS WORLD (SPAZIALE!)—definitely the best we’ve had so far. The flavors were so rich and perfectly balanced.
The staff were incredibly kind and welcoming, and the service was impeccable. If you are looking for honest prices and authentic Thai flavors, this is the place to go. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Arianna

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice smiling staff who will help you choose the food. The food is great and tasty, the portions are just right. They just didn't let us order the "Thai Spicy" spiciness of the dish. So we had to ask for chili 😁 The food was so delicious that I didn't even have time to take a picture of it. The restaurant is recommended 10/10 by Pandas

PS: We tried again the next day. They already allowed us the “Thai Spicy” level of spiciness. The food was perfect again 😎
sample_reviews_en.author: Radim Glovacký

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a great dinner here, both vegetarian dishes, Pad Thai Phuket and Massaman Curry with rice. I just wish the portions were bigger, as it was very tasty.

The staff is friendly and makes sure you have everything you need.

The atmosphere is informal and relaxed. They have their hostel upstairs.

They price is a bit on the higher side compared to other eateries in the area, but it is still a good value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Federico Ruzich

sample_reviews_en.text: We arrived at Bangkok around 9pm and the restaurant was close to our hotel. It was our friend’s birthday so I asked the staff if they could light up and serve the surprise cake we had and they agreed! They even gave us a Birthday Ice Cream for free and Played the Happy Birthday on the screen! The staff were all very friendly and highly recommend this place ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Jennie Gabon

sample_reviews_en.author: Julius Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: so many to choose from menu which is a delightful experience, although i confess i spent 15-20 minutes! the dishes and dimsum are delicious, also chinese style desserts, and soups i like
sample_reviews_en.author: dr ken chao

sample_reviews_en.text: At Central Rama9, very good Hong Kong style Chinese food,  my regular dinner restuarant, go often. Food is delicious, great service
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiawei Xu

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch of the Chinese restaurant is located in a shopping mall. It’s clean, and the food tastes great with consistent quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: vichayut sawet

sample_reviews_en.text: Mushroom Tom Yum is really tasty. The service and atmosphere is great. Really enjoyed all the dishes we ordered. Highly recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: L Shen

sample_reviews_en.text: Wonderful Chinese food, but definitely order more than we can eat! The dim sum options are a must try! …
sample_reviews_en.author: Akira Simizu

sample_reviews_en.text: Imo, Huasenghong Restaurant in Rama 9 is authentic and delicious Chinese cuisine. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Yustinus Albert

restaurants.name: Yuk-Do Siam Scape
restaurants.address:

SIAMSCAPE, 215 ชั้น 3, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
**Yuk-Do ยุกโด - A Lively Korean BBQ Experience**

Yuk-Do ยุกโด is the perfect spot for Korean BBQ enthusiasts. The restaurant offers a wide selection of meats and side dishes, all at an affordable price, making it an excellent choice for a fun and satisfying meal without breaking the bank.

The service is attentive and efficient, with staff members readily available to assist with grilling and to ensure diners have everything they need. Their attentiveness enhances the overall dining experience, especially for those new to Korean BBQ.

The atmosphere at Yuk-Do ยุกโด is lively and bustling, creating a vibrant and energetic environment. It’s an ideal place for group dining, where friends and family can enjoy cooking and eating together, making it a memorable and enjoyable outing. If you’re looking for a fun, affordable, and delicious Korean BBQ experience, Yuk-Do ยุกโด is the place to go.
sample_reviews_th.author: T C

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came here with my friends (4 people in total). One of my friends recommended this place after seeing positive reviews on Facebook.

The food quality was really good. There was a wide variety of side dishes, and they were all tasty as well. I especially enjoyed the kimchi and the oden. They also offer instant noodles, which the staff cook fresh for you and serve at your table.

The pork was fresh and not chewy at all. The scissors could cut through the meat very easily. I was also impressed by the grill system—I’m not sure how they do it, but there was almost no smoke, which made the dining experience much more comfortable. Ice cream is also included in the buffet package.

You can ask the staff for a hair cover and an apron if needed, which is a thoughtful touch.

The service was good. The restaurant is quite spacious, with plenty of tables available. I arrived at around 11:00 AM and didn’t have to wait for a table.

The prices are very reasonable considering the quality of the food and the overall experience. I think it’s a great place for Korean BBQ lovers and definitely worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yanisa Mongkolnarin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located on the 3rd floor of Siam Scape in Bangkok, it offers a delightful Korean BBQ experience. Priced at 399THB per person (approximately 427 THB net), the buffet includes a variety of pork cuts such as pork neck, pork belly, and marinated options in Kanjang and Gochujang sauces. The dining time is limited to 90 minutes. ￼

In addition to the grilled meats, the buffet features a selection of side dishes, including kimchi, fresh vegetables, and Korean-style fried items like fried chicken and dumplings.
