There’s also a ramen station where staff prepare noodles to order, and a soft-serve ice cream machine for dessert. Beverages like soda are included, though water is sold separately.

Overall, Yuk-do offers a high-quality, affordable Korean BBQ experience in the heart of Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emma Philippe

sample_reviews_en.text:
In a town where many folks chase the best dining deals with a passion , Yuk Do (YD) must be near number one for value for money.

Besides a good array of pork cuts for BQQing, patrons can also enjoy a salad section, kimchi selection, deep fried chicken and other goodies, fried rice, curry, and more. The meat was very good quality, fresh, tender, and juicy.

YD genuinely has something for everybody and if you leave hungry, you must be the pickiest eater going.

And for a nice final touch, customers can also eat a complimentary snow freeze ice cream. For about 500 baht per person, YD offers tremendous value. Highly recommended for everyone but especially if you have hungry teens to feed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Meng Yee

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here based on reviews, without high expectations because I was going to donate blood and stopped by for a meal first. I ordered the lunch set, the grilled pork set, and also got to eat from the buffet line. I have to say, it was incredibly worth it.
For 199 baht, I got to eat high-quality Korean food with authentic Korean flavors. The kimchi soup was very thick, like a stew that had been reheated for several days. There were various types of kimchi, and freshly made appetizers.
It was so delicious! I'm so glad I came based on the reviews. For this price, in addition to the buffet line, it also includes unlimited refills of drinks and a scoop of ice cream per person.
sample_reviews_en.author: KM78_T

sample_reviews_en.text: The Korean BBQ buffet restaurant on the 3rd floor of Siam Scape. Have a plenty of pork/meat selection, but you have to walk to the butcher counter to order the meat yourself. Besides, there are sooo many selection of other food on the buffet line such as Korean Instant noodle that they will cook for you, fried chicken, Kimmari, Fermented vegies and Kimchi, fresh vegetables and soft drinks. The price is very reasonable - 499 only. If you like and share their social media accounts, you can get a discount and pay only 399/person. The soft serve ice cream after paying the bill is sooo good!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayanan Kumhom

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant has amazing food and great service, but please train your staff in Thai. Every time I've been, the staff have spoken very fast and their Thai isn't clear. Many times, we ordered one thing and they understood something else.

We've been there many times, and it wasn't just our table that had problems with the staff's language.

Please, train your staff to speak slowly and clearly. I've brought 2-3 groups of friends, and every time, we had to explain things to them because no one understood us. Even I didn't understand them on my first visit! Haha.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saterat Ping

sample_reviews_en.text: i got in there and was the only none korean, at first it was a bit confusing but you can choose between 5 pork meat which you have to cut with a scissor and put it on the electric grill on your table. rest you get from the buffet yourself and put it on the grill as well. they also have fried chicken and fries. drinks are free and after paying you get a free ice cream from the machine right outside. if you want to pay 100 baht less per person you have to show them the LINE app for whatever reason. staff is very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: K.

restaurants.name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh CentralwOrld
restaurants.address:

ห้อง A301-302 Atrium Zone ชั้น 3 Ratchadamri Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I’ve already lost counting how many time I visited this restaurant. Satisfied every single time I need some hot concentrated broth soup. It’s amazing how tender their pork ribs is, super easy to shred. Fish is not as impressive but is ok, no stinky fishy but not that sweet nor that tender texture.

Please don’t miss their rice porridge + deep fried dough (ปาท่องโก๋). Top of the class, I guarantee!
sample_reviews_th.author: Kanna ksxks

sample_reviews_en.text:
Yum yum yum yumsssss!!!!!! Was feeling a bit lethargic today and a warm, hearty bowl of BKT was just what I needed!! It’s soooo amazingly peppery, LOVE IT SO MUCH OK 😋😋😋.

Song Fa BKT is just so different here as compared to the one in Singapore. The ambience, cleanliness, vibe, service, and variety of dishes is just 💯x better here 🙌!

You can have your BKT with porridge and meesua, instead of just rice. There’s chrysanthemum tea made with real flowers served in a cutie ceramic mini tea pot with authentic Chinese cups, poured and refillable by the friendly staff here.

When it’s a rainy day out, and you have your peppery warm soup served with generous servings of pork, coupled with hot congee and loads of groundnuts….. THE SIMPLE JOYS OF LIFE 🥲☺️🥹🥲.

The experience and food here was just amazing. Can see myself coming here and here again in a heartbeat. LOVE THIS 🥰😍💕🤩🤩🌟🌟
sample_reviews_en.author: Coffee & Matcha Lover

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited Song Fa Bak Kut Teh at CentralWorld, and it was a delightful experience. Known for bringing the iconic flavors of Singapore to Bangkok, this restaurant lived up to its reputation.

The bak kut teh (pork rib soup) was perfectly executed — the broth was flavorful, peppery, and aromatic, striking the right balance between spice and comfort. The pork ribs were tender and fell off the bone effortlessly. The accompanying side dishes, such as braised eggs, preserved vegetables, and fried dough sticks (youtiao), added wonderful variety to the meal.

Although the prices are slightly on the higher side for Bangkok, the quality and authenticity make it worth it. Whether you’re a fan of bak kut teh or trying it for the first time, Song Fa at CentralWorld is a great spot to savor this famous dish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wisanu Tuntawiroon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Song Fa Thailand at Central World, 3rd floor (near the Central side), is a must-visit spot for food lovers! The restaurant offers a cozy and inviting atmosphere, perfect for a casual meal or a quick break from shopping.

The menu features a variety of flavorful dishes that are both satisfying and reasonably priced, making it great value for the quality you get. The service is friendly and efficient, adding to the overall enjoyable dining experience.

Whether you’re a fan of classic comfort food or just looking for a place to relax and enjoy a delicious meal, Song Fa is a fantastic choice. Conveniently located in one of Bangkok's most iconic shopping destinations, it’s a perfect stop to refuel and treat yourself. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Central World
sample_reviews_en.author: Nammon

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a very disappointing experience at Song Fa Bak Kut Teh in Bangkok. I waited almost 40 minutes for my Bak Kut Teh, while customers who arrived later than me had already finished their meals. Even worse, the dessert was served before my main dish, and when I finally finished eating, I had to wait another 15 minutes just to get the dessert.
When paying, I used Alipay and the payment went through, but the staff insisted it wasn’t received. I had to wait nearly 20 more minutes while they checked with the bank. The whole experience was extremely unprofessional and a complete waste of my time. I lost an entire hour because of this place. Definitely not recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: YUXUAN ZHANG

sample_reviews_en.text:
December 2025: I am a Level 8 contributor (>450 reviews) on Google and regularly review eateries and experiences both in Asia and Melbourne.  I came here for late lunch. I ordered the braised big intestines, salted vegetables and a bowl of pig's liver and tender loin soup.

The braised big intestine is outstanding in both taste and texture.  Very bouncy to the bite and no wierd taste. The salted vegetables has a nice tanginess. The soup was peppery, but the portion of liver and tenderloin is very small. I don't think it's worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Justin Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Recently traveled to Singapore, and when I saw Song Fa in Centralworld Bangkok, I knew I had to try to compare.

It was a pleasant eating experience that reminded me of Song Fa in Singapore. Of course, the fragrant and peppery soup is also unlimited, drink to your heart's content. The pork ribs were cooked until it's tender and falls off the bone.

We only tried the ngo hiang and the braised beancurd for our side dishes, and both were great as well.

Don't forget to order the youtiao or fried dough!
sample_reviews_en.author: Brian Tamase

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a comforting and satisfying meal at Song Fa Bak Kut Teh! The pork ribs were tender and flavorful, and the peppery soup was warm and perfectly balanced — they even refilled it promptly. The side dishes, especially the braised pork and vegetables, complemented the meal really well.

Service was quick and friendly, and the overall experience was cozy and relaxing. A great place for a hearty meal, especially if you love Singapore-style bak kut teh.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jariyaporn N

restaurants.name: OKASAN | Modern Izakaya & Bar
restaurants.address:

94, 1-2 Lang Suan Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Cool vibe with decent food! My son absolutely loved the salmon croquette. All of the other dishes were well seasoned as well. The grilled cheese with pesto dip was a bit too salty though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bình Phan

sample_reviews_en.text: Japanese restaurant with very cool, modern, and captivating atmosphere. Love the red themed, style and decoration. Creative and interesting menu. Unfortunately, did not try their signature cocktails. But the Japanese food was great with a bit of twist, and the service is quite accommodating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prakit

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best food experiences we had outside the local Thai food restaurants. The most welcoming and warmest staff, super cool vibe and music and crazy good food! The “Gyu Steak Fat Fried Rice” was so good we have to ordered again! - highly recommend this place
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicolai Kahr

restaurants.name: Wizard Brewery and Restaurant
restaurants.address:

397, 42 หมู่ที่ 10 S Pattaya Rd, ตําบล หนองปรือ, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a very interesting bar restaurant.  Both the food and the ambience of the place are something totally different from what one is used to encounter in Pattaya. They have mostly Western food with a Thai Twist on some of the plates. Part of the restaurant is also a really good brewery that offers a lot of interesting beer varieties. At some point in the evening they also have live music. This is definitely not the cheapest restaurant you can find but it is very clean and definitely worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nikolaos Examiliotis

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent variety of house brews. Varying live music styles. Seriously air-conditioned. silent TVs with English Premiere League games. Monday specials with some beers  3 for 2.
After 8pm bands a bit loud for table conversation (90dBa+). Beer towers at every table. 5 serving sizes available. Typical 17% surcharge for aircon places without smokers.
A comfortable cellar-like atmosphere with quality craft beers at typical craftbeer prices. Seems to be surviving the 2026 tourism downturn.
sample_reviews_en.author: tom ciccateri

sample_reviews_en.text: Wizard Pattaya is a fantastic place to relax and enjoy a great drink. The atmosphere is excellent—cozy, inviting, and perfect for a night out with friends or a casual evening. Their beer selection is impressive, with delicious flavors that cater to different tastes. The prices are reasonable, making it a great value for the quality you get. If you're in Pattaya and looking for a spot with good vibes, tasty beer, and fair prices, Wizard Pattaya is definitely worth a visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Oom

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice place when you are tired of Chang and Singha and are looking for Craft Beer. Good beer and good food! A really nice place that I highly recommend to visit if you like beers,  other than lager. The only thing we missed was a beer tasting plate! We bought the smallest beers (30 cl) but it would have been nice yo buy a plate with four or five different beers (15 cl of each) for us beer geeks 😉.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jennie Carlsén

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wizard Brewery & Restaurant is a bit tricky to find, but that doesn’t stop it from being crowded, thanks to its great beer and live music. The atmosphere is lively, making it a good spot for a night out.

While most food items were just average for me, the truffle mushroom pizza was a standout and definitely worth trying. The live music adds to the overall vibe, making it a fun place to visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jayakrishnan Nair

sample_reviews_en.text: Wizard Brewery in Pattaya is a real craft beer gem. The atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming, and the team clearly puts passion into everything they do. Their Double Dry Hops IPA is outstanding – easily one of the best beers I’ve had in Thailand. Service is friendly, the vibe is authentic, and it’s the perfect spot to enjoy high-quality brews. Highly recommended for anyone who loves great beer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marc Partiti

sample_reviews_en.text: With a beautiful Harry Potter inspired decoration this place brings you to a different atmosphere in Pattaya. The central location is very convenient for tourists. Polite and attentive staff, always paying attention to what you may want. They make they own beer and there are many options in the menu, I liked the strawberry flavor and butter beer. I watched a great band playing on Saturday.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mari M

sample_reviews_en.text: The beer here is pretty good – nice craft selection that’s flavorful. But the music is a major downside: it’s blasted way too loud, making conversations impossible, and it’s mostly unknown tracks with a lot of sad songs that bring the vibe down. The food was mid at best – nothing memorable. This place has potential, but they need to fix the volume, playlist, and menu. 3 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emil K

restaurants.name: Shabubomb พระราม 5
restaurants.address:

168/2 Moo.2 Unit 4 , Nakhon-Inn road Bangsri Mueng Bangkrui, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
My last visit was on October 14th, 2025, around 7 PM.
1. They didn't inform me beforehand that the beef shank and beef shoulder were sold out. I only found out after sitting down and scanning the menu.
2. The char siu pork that I checked in with was sour and spoiled.
3. The remaining ribeye steak was sliced ​​with bone still attached to almost every piece. This was very bad. Shouldn't they check before slicing?
4. After eating for half an hour, they informed me that the ribeye steak was sold out and they couldn't slice it in time. I had to wait 20-30 minutes, even though it was only 8 PM.
5. The pork belly was hard, like they used two layers. It wasn't tasty at all.
In summary, I went there to eat even though there wasn't much food available. I've been there regularly for 10+ times, but I feel like it's getting worse with each visit, both in terms of food quality and staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: BLACK CAT

sample_reviews_en.text:
Shabubomb, Rama 5 branch.
The service was very impressive, starting from the parking lot where staff directed us to a parking space. Upon entering the restaurant, the staff greeted us politely. The food was served quickly, and the soup and dipping sauces were delicious. The sliced ​​meat was beautifully presented, tender, and fresh. The food was clean, tasty, and the service was excellent. There's plenty of parking and it's easy to get there. The prices are reasonable and offer good value. If you take a photo and post it on Facebook, you'll get a free delicious dessert called "Crème brûlée," a French-style dessert. Ordering food is done via mobile phone by scanning a QR code and selecting the desired items and quantities. Very convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanisa K

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shabu restaurant is located in Namchok Thavee Market.

The all-inclusive price is 276 baht.
However, ordering the boat noodle set is an additional 39 baht.
Additional items like Khanom Krok (Thai coconut pancakes), grilled meatballs, and premium beef are available.

Don't accidentally order the cheese, which is an extra 29 baht.

There's a wide variety of food available.

-----
The food is average, good value for the price, and varied.
The soup is salty, and the dipping sauces are too strong.

-----
There's plenty of parking.
It's crowded before 8 PM, and less crowded late at night.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปิยะพันธ์ วงมา

sample_reviews_en.text: Shabu Bomb Rama 5 has great prices, is clean, and serves fresh ingredients. You can choose from 3 soup bases, and adding an extra base like we did is only 29 baht! Such a good deal! The mala soup is good, the black broth is excellent and rich, and the clear broth is fragrant. They also have amazing dipping sauces, including mala and sukiyaki sauces. They have appetizers too, and their ice cream is delicious in every flavor (but I forgot to take a picture of the sauces!). I've been there twice already. Personally, I think it's great and worth it. ☺️☺️☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Snistp.

sample_reviews_en.text: I walked in, sat down, and asked a female employee if there was a restroom. She didn't answer, just had a blank expression, and walked away. That was confusing. The meat was okay for the price, but there weren't many appetizers. The ice cream was delicious. The mala soup wasn't very flavorful. The space is cramped; you can barely get up to get the dipping sauces and water.
sample_reviews_en.author: bom1993

sample_reviews_en.text: I personally really liked the taste of the food and it was worth the price. The food came out quickly and the staff constantly refilled both drinks and food. However, the front area was too hot, as if the air conditioning wasn't reaching all areas. I really hope they improve this; it would make the seating area much more pleasant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lovely Jackie

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely worth the price! You get beef, pork, and shrimp, and there's a variety of dipping sauces. I personally love the restaurant's sauces.
I hope they keep this price going for a long time!
I didn't take pictures of the table full because I was so hungry. As soon as it arrived, I started putting everything in the pot! 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: มณฑล ศรีอิ่ม

sample_reviews_en.text:
I just ate there last week, so I wanted to write a review to encourage the restaurant.

The food is delicious, and you can mix and match the dipping sauces to your liking, making it even better.
The food quality has improved significantly compared to before. The orange slushy is still as delicious as ever.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phuwameth Prasertjitsan

restaurants.name: Chowpati Bangkok - Indian Street Food
restaurants.address:

12/499 G Floor, 15 Sukhumvit Residences, Soi Sukhumvit 13, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a wonderful experience at Chowpati. The atmosphere is vibrant, clean, and very welcoming, making it a perfect place to enjoy a meal with family or friends. The restaurant has a great vibe that makes you feel comfortable from the moment you walk in.

The food was absolutely delicious, with authentic Indian flavors and fresh ingredients. Every dish we ordered was well-prepared and full of taste. The service was also excellent—the staff were friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was perfect throughout our visit.

Overall, Chowpati offers a fantastic combination of great food, excellent service, and a lovely atmosphere. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for authentic Indian cuisine, and I will definitely be visiting again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ra Kha

sample_reviews_en.text: This place offers an impressively wide-ranging menu, which can feel a bit daunting for first-timers at an authentic Indian restaurant. I ended up scanning Google reviews to narrow down my choices, and I’m glad I did. The team from the servers to the manager was incredibly attentive, even checking in to see if I wanted the spice level adjusted, which I really appreciated. The entire staff was warm and welcoming, making the experience feel relaxed and enjoyable. The dishes were richly flavored yet light, never heavy or overpowering. If you go, don’t miss the chicken leg set—the spices are aromatic, deeply flavorful, and perfectly balanced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sohom Raha

sample_reviews_en.text: Omg this place is a gem! We came here a few times during our Bangkok stay. True authentic northern Indian food - loved the lamb dish, chilli paneer, veg Manchurians, butter chicken, naan. I’ve recommended this place to friends too. Lovely, friendly staff. You won’t regret it and so reasonable priced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Deepa Graham

sample_reviews_en.text: If you want to try Indian food, I definitely recommend it. The service is fantastic, the staff are very helpful and make you feel comfortable. The food is delicious. They use a lot of cilantro, so be careful, I always ask them to remove it 😅
sample_reviews_en.author: Ümit Eren Yıldız

sample_reviews_en.text: Must be the location because a combo and a soft drink is over 400 (after vat and service charge). Crazy. Dal was too salty for my liking. Clean space and service was fine, though overall not worth the money like other places.
sample_reviews_en.author: nanasp

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely rubbish. Do not waste your time. Food is pathetic and stale. I came here for dinner with my family but regretted. There are manu other good restaurants like Amritsar and chotiwala who are miles ahead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay Singh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really good food! Great atmosphere, air conditioned and clean... they serve all Cuisines including north, South Indian as well as indo-chinese all freshly made. The portions are huge.
Would definitely return.
sample_reviews_en.author: payal patel

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're an Indian chaat lover, please come to this place. I am a pani puri addict and I loved the paani Puri here because of the Indian taste retained. I liked the bhel and the vada pav also.
Enjoyyyyy!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mallika Jajoo

restaurants.name: Palate Bangkok
restaurants.address:

1481 ถ. เจริญกรุง Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered a wok cooked mushroom appetizer, for dinner I ordered the spiciest deep fried chicken plate, Krystal and I split the mushrooms (pretty sure I ate most of them), she ordered a chicken Panang curry.
Everything came hot and well prepared.  The mushrooms well cooked with a lot of garlic!  Surprising for Thailand!
We loved the food, service was fine, we ate around 5:30 PM and we were just 2 of the 4 people in the entire restaurant!  But there are 6 levels, including a rooftop dining and bar area!  Took photos of all levels even though we didn’t eat on the rooftop.  I did this because the current photos online for the rooftop dining, I believe, are a little misleading.
Overall, the food is better here than the place looks and the staff is on top of everything here.
Great experience!  Would make reservations for the roof top if you are considering eating up there as all sides of the roof, as far as the view is concerned, are NOT equal!
You’ll understand when you see the photos and the videos!
Bon Apetite!
sample_reviews_en.author: Steven Nichols

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a cute bar/restaurant. Nice little rooftop dining area on the top floor about 5 flights of stairs up. Not the most incredible views but it gives you that industrial rooftop vibe.
We had great smoothies and our appetizer was delicious. Unfortunately, our main dishes were disappointing. I ordered the red curry with chicken. It had a weird assortment of vegetables that I had never seen in a curry before and only had four pieces of chicken. My husband ordered a black pepper chicken which was supposed to be in a black pepper sauce but unfortunately was just sauteed chicken and vegetables with some black pepper sprinkled over. There was no sauce and the portions are very small for the price. So if you want to come here I would just come here and get a few appetizers and drinks and maybe save your dinner for another place. Hate to say that because the staff there was very friendly. Unfortunately the food just wasn't that great.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Markham

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
AMAZING SERVICE and DELICIOUS FOOD

An absolute must-visit at this district! The food was outstanding, the service was exceptional, and the overall standard was incredibly high.

One detail that really impressed us: every time we ordered a beer (they even serve it in large „Maß“), the staff would replace the empty glass with a freshly ice-cold one quickly. It’s a small touch, but it shows their attention to detail. 👍🏻🍺

The staff were genuinely friendly and attentive throughout the evening. The rooftop setting creates a fantastic atmosphere, and the restrooms were spotless.

Highly recommended if you’re looking for amazing food, outstanding service, and a great rooftop dining experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexander Wodarz

sample_reviews_en.text:
Welcoming staff. The food is well worth the five floors of stairs to the rooftop.

Amazing tastes as you expect in Thailand. Tangy, sweet, sour, chili and umami.

So many fabulous dishes. Very well created. I've lived in Thailand on and off for about 7 years, and this is definitely up there in some of the best food.

Friendly service and decent drinks. In the evening they have a life singer and different floors for different experiences. Even a pool table on the penultimate floor.

The rain fell at around 11:30 p.m. so it was fantastic just to see the sights of the city in the rain, and you can see quite far.
sample_reviews_en.author: BH (Bryan)

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a wonderful meal here in Bangkok. The food felt truly authentic, fresh, and full of flavor. We ordered the lamb kebab, hummus with tahini, and grape leaves filled with rice — everything was delicious and prepared with care.
The lamb kebab was rich, well-seasoned, and very satisfying. The hummus was smooth and creamy, with great tahini flavor, and the stuffed grape leaves tasted homemade and authentic. You can really feel the quality and tradition in the food.
A great place for anyone looking for real Middle Eastern flavors in Bangkok. Highly recommended — we’ll definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Itay Gal

sample_reviews_en.text: 1st time to be here which followed the review from others. The location is good you can take the train to Taksin then walk only 2 minutes. But parking is limited you need to park somewhere nearby with paid service. The rooftop is nice can see the city view and enjoy the windy if lucky. Or else, you can sit indoor from 1st floor to 5st floor, if you prefer the live band the 5st floor will be good choice. Foods are good you can pick the recommended dishes from the menu list with reasonable price. The drink is and option for beers or you can go with liquor but no wine list.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattric Thanjk

sample_reviews_en.text: Was close to our airbnb, and did not disappoint. The food was great. Everyone in our group was happy. In fact, we liked it so much we went back that night to hang out on the rooftop. (Warning, it is a LOT of stairs but totally worth the climb!) They had live music and there are pool tables on 2 of the floors in the way up. (Who had the job of carrying them up those stairs lol). My favorite was their chicken wings! They were so good. Wish I would have gone back for them one more time. Hopefully I'll go back to Bangkok someday! My drink was also very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cory Hammerstone

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located just meters away from Central Bangrak, this 6 storey restaurant cum hostel offers varied seating options, out of those I found the rooftop open air seating the best, which accompanied by soft rock music from the 90s, warm lights and cool breeze made it a perfect ambience to enjoy tasty food. A large vegeterian menu available which is great! Service is prompt and pricing is value for money. I would recommend this place.

Only drawback being no lift, therefore to access the rooftop, you need to climb up quite a few narrow stairs.
sample_reviews_en.author: TheUltimateReview Level8Guide

restaurants.name: Il Bolognese
restaurants.address:

139/3 ถนนสาทรใต้ ซอย 7 Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
An outstanding Italian dining experience in Bangkok. Everything was simply perfect from start to finish. The service was impeccable, with the staff being attentive to every detail—even replacing the cutlery between courses, which reflects the level of care and professionalism. The restaurant was spotless, creating a truly comfortable atmosphere.

The lamb was absolutely incredible, perfectly cooked and full of flavor. The beef fillet was so tender it literally melted in my mouth. And the pizza? Easily better than many I’ve had in Italy, with an excellent crust and high-quality ingredients.

If you’re looking for real, authentic Italian cuisine in Bangkok, this is the place to go. Highly recommended—I can’t wait to come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Edoardo Emilio Bianchi

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was one of the best Italian meals I've had in Bangkok. The restaurant has a beautiful garden setting with a cozy, authentic atmosphere that makes you forget you're in the middle of the city.

The food was fresh, full of flavor, and clearly made with quality ingredients. The homemade food was cooked perfectly, the pizza had a light, crispy crust, and every dish was beautifully presented. The service was friendly, attentive, and made us feel genuinely welcome without being over the top.

If you're looking for authentic Italian food in Bangkok, this place is definitely worth visiting. Great food, relaxing ambiance, and an experience I'd happily repeat. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ali Albuloushi

sample_reviews_en.text:
such a cozy hidden gem. The ambience is super warm and inviting, perfect for a relaxed meal. The staff are friendly, attentive, and quick with service, making the experience even better.

Their specialty is pizza, loaded with generous toppings and authentic Italian flavors. Every dish we tried was delicious, and the wine selection is also great.

They offer both indoor and outdoor seating, plus convenient parking. Overall, it’s a perfect spot for good food, great vibes, and a comfortable dining experience✨💖
sample_reviews_en.author: Inggrid Yohana

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Italian restaurant has a great atmosphere and the service is excellent, more professional than casual. The food tastes great, and you can tell they use high-quality ingredients.

I would suggest adding some helpful recommendations, such as what to pair with the bread served initially, or what the appetizers are. This would enhance the experience for customers who might be trying this type of cuisine for the first time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sivaporn Pattana-anunsook

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant was nice in terms of atmosphere, but the food was not up to the price paid. The crab cappellini dish cost 1080 THB and was unseasoned, not creamy, and too spicy. The grilled meat cost 1200 THB and the portion was small for the price paid, even if it was good. The ossobuco was good... but the addition of taxes was exorbitant and excessive, I wouldn't recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ivan bubbi

sample_reviews_en.text: It was very crowded, and there was limited parking in front of the restaurant. I didn't really like the broth in this dish, but it wasn't bad. I liked the lasagna. Everything else was okay, edible. The prices aren't cheap considering it's not a five-star hotel, but the service was good, attentive, and lovely. The tiramisu was better than expected.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tui Dusadee

sample_reviews_en.text: We visited Broni Restaurant on the evening of 10 July to celebrate my daughter’s birthday. We had booked in advance and came as a family, including my daughter, her husband, their two young children (an 8-month-old baby and a 3½-year-old), …
sample_reviews_en.author: Farshad Shishehchian

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is nice and the food is delicious.

However, it's crowded and you'll have to wait if you don't have a reservation.

The portions are very small, especially the pasta.

The prices are considered high.
sample_reviews_en.author: مُلْهِم

restaurants.name: Zhang La Mian
restaurants.address:

13 Soi Chulalongkorn 5, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were a bit hesitant to try this despite the raving reviews because we were looking for local food and La Mian gave the impression that this place sold Chinese noodles. The signature beef noodles here are more of a Thai Chinese fusion, resembling the Thai beef soup, with a spicy paste mixed into the soup. The herbal version tastes very similar to the signature version without the spicy paste.

We are very impressed with the beef soup noodles. The beef was tender and flavourful, having soaked up the flavours from being stewed over a sufficiently long time. The broth was very tasty, while not stealing the limelight from the beef. Even though I'm a fan of the Thai rice noodles, I actually prefer the HK egg noodles here, which are springy and catches the broth better in my opinion.

Price is extremely reasonable and when we went on a Saturday, seats were readily available at dinner time. Place is clean enough at this price point.

Staff is attentive, and when they saw that we were struggling with the heat, they gave us another bowl of broth to dilute the spice.

Loved this place, would definitely be back whenever I'm in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yixia

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Chinese herbal meat soup was delicious! Despite described as a herbal soup on the menu, it didn't have a strong herbal smell. Instead, it offered a clear broth with the perfect balance of saltiness and sweetness. The large portion was filled with plenty of tender braised beef, and the beef intestines were tender with no unpleasant smell.

Additionally, the stir-fried braised pork with oyster sauce on rice was a delightful surprise. The braised pork was tender and flavorful, while the overall taste of the dish remained pleasantly mild.

One minor observation was that the soup wasn't as hot as it should be. An improvement in this aspect would undoubtedly enhance the overall eating experience and make it even more enjoyable.

Reasonable price and definitely worth a visit! Recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pariwat Plienpoo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Beef! Braised, Stewed!

Choose your noodles, the size of your order (I gots me da big boiling wok ^^) and just bring your appetite. Located in one of the sois of Chula area (think it was soi 5), lined along the food row - you can’t miss this restaurant’s mammoth sized wok stewing the shreds of the beef tenders.

I ordered yellow noodles (in thai: bamee) and an extra bowl of rice. I wanted to rate five stars but the broth was fairly salty, i asked for hot water to dilute the soup. I enjoyed sitting outdoors…people watching at the same time ^^ recommend to try if you’re in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: OceanSevens

sample_reviews_en.text: Chinese inspired noodles soup restaurant. This restaurant specializes in Chinese herbal braised pork and beef soup. You can order in noodles bowl, with rice or in the hot pot style. We tried the noodles soup style. The beef broth was aromatic, but it kinda leaning towards sweater side, so if you don't like sweet taste in your savory food, you might need to spice up your soup. The restaurant is a semi open air and air con, yet for some reason or another, there's lots of fly flying around and very annoying. The price for each dishes was great, at a little above 100thb
sample_reviews_en.author: Katethip Varanyuwatana

sample_reviews_en.text:
For the first time in my two years of living in Asia, I left the food untouched and walked out of the establishment. It was very bad.
They don't use salt here, instead of a dish you get boiled meat in greasy water and tasteless noodles. Maybe if they added salt, or soy sauce, or fish sauce, it would be good, but I don't know how you can eat it in its current form. The staff refused to give me anything salty, contemptuously saying that "we don't use such things in our restaurant and there is none of this in the kitchen"
sample_reviews_en.author: TatyanKA G

sample_reviews_en.text:
Zhang La mian offers stew pork and beef in Chinese style. The restaurant is Near to the Stadium One, at Chula Soi 5.

Walking from BTS National Stadium is possible, if you can go thru the bangkok heat during day time.

The place offers noodle with beef/pork and you can pick 5 levels of spicyness. They also do kapow (basil) with eithe shred pork and beed stews as well.

The portion are quite small and the tast seems to be a bit bland for us. But overall, an interesting experience with the concept and decor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donny Boonyamanop

sample_reviews_en.text:
Beef noodle specialty. However, I didn't find "lamian" noodles as I imagined, it was a completely different type of noodle.
Ambience is cool, on a quiet alley of bustling Banthat thong center of nightlife.
Tastewise, I got the herbs aroma but too salty also. Too bad I can not enjoy the broth. Beef chops are generous actually, and tender enough.
Price is reasonable.
Servicewise, if the business owner can fix the male staff's manner and attitude as good as the female one, it would be better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rbw dinata

sample_reviews_en.text:
Incredible noodles. I ordered the Zhang La Mian with pork which was a good size and packed with meat. The broth is incredibly clean, rich, with a mala numbing heat. It has a gorgeous sheen of fat on the top.
The noodles are firm and toothsome. You feel the numbing heat on your tongue. The pork is incredibly tender having been poached in broth for hours. Level 3 heat just right for me, my tongue was tingling nicely. Like all good meals I found I didn’t want it to end.
sample_reviews_en.author: Simon Heath

restaurants.name: Kokinaemsae Samyan
restaurants.address:

280 Soi Chulalongkorn 11, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Such a delicacy Korean BBQ with the best service so far. Employee are very nice + combined with the chill vibe, this is nothing but an absolutely perfect dinner after such a tiring day. They have many quality ingredients you could imagine, such as A PORK JOWLL (this is GOAT). Also all you can eat "the Banchan" (Korean side dishes) would blow your mind , they are absolute iconic and tasty. If you have come across by any chance without giving it a shot, try once and you'll have one of the most invaluable experiences about BBQ buffet in your life.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cherry CHZ

sample_reviews_en.text: It was the best Korean BBQ we tried ever. All-you-can-eat formula and the meat cuts were amazing: thick, well-marbled beef and pork, not the usual thin buffet slices. Short rib and samgyeopsal were standouts. Banchan selection is solid and they refill fast. Staff changed the grill regularly so nothing burned or stuck. We paid  around 800THB in total for two people, 90 min limit, and were absolutely full and satisfied. Unlimited water as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Romina Tocci

sample_reviews_en.text:
It is a Korean grill buffet restaurant that is not expensive.The creamed corn was delicious.

The service staff is very good,Quickly changed the grill tray and put away the dishes before we even called.

During the day it was quite crowded and there was quite a lot of smoke from grilling.

The amount of food per 1 unit provided was quite a lot.  It is recommended to gradually order one unit at a time so as not to be too full.
sample_reviews_en.author: mangdanoi zzz

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything I ate that day...was nice.... even the free watermelon and chrysanthemum tea. The place is a walk distance from Samyan Mitr Town Mall...on Rama 4 Road. The service is very good. Hey...if you like sweet corn...it is coming all you can eat. The meat is a bit smaller than other restaurant but I do not see as an disadvantage. It is nice that they are easy to cook.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daton Chris

sample_reviews_en.text: Affordable prices with good quality and a wide selection of meat. There were some side dishes which were also decent. For vegetables they have lectures and sesame leaves. The servers were attentive. They used charcoal for the grill and often changed the grill grate for you without needing to ask. There were 2 black cats in front of the entrance 🐈‍⬛🐈‍⬛
sample_reviews_en.author: Jin Karl

sample_reviews_en.text: Good crowd and environment, good service, price is relatively cheap. However, the quality of the food is not good. Meats are plain and chewy, not really fresh, "hot dishes" are not hot, the fried chicken and other things all cold. I just think you can find better quality elsewhere with some extra money.
sample_reviews_en.author: T Y

sample_reviews_en.text: The place is truly happening. Food is fresh and well marinated. Service is impeccable. They will change our grill tray very regularly, making the food clean and tasty, without any charred food. The ambience is great. Will recommend this place, and will come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Samuel Tay

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was absolutely delicious! The staff provided excellent and attentive service, changing the grill grates very frequently. The prices were reasonable and affordable. The restaurant had a nice atmosphere, was clean and air-conditioned.
sample_reviews_en.author: WANNISA

restaurants.name: Shree Khodiyar Kathiyawadi Dhaba pure vegetarian Indian restaurant Bangkok
restaurants.address:

120 29 Soi Ratchaprarop 3, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Reecent experience was not good.
The food was too oily. Tandoori rotis were like papadum. When complain to owner, he just ask you to order Chapati.
Daal and paneer butter masala were not good in taste. Somehow we finished our meal. Left hungry.

Don't go for A la carte here. Just go for set Thali.

Overall value for money and decent food.

We ordered Thali and 4 extra rotis. Which was more than enough for 2 people. Total bill was 495 THB.

Thali consist of 2 sabji, daal, rice and 2 rotis and sides. Salad and sides were good and was good. Check pics.

Green chutney was bit bitter in taste

They have separate Gujarati menu too. Jain food available.

Restaurant could be busy some time and you might have to wait longer.

Our food arrived within 15 min.

Overall I think this could be best option for vegetarian in that area.

Things which were not good:
Server are not attentive. Or may be they are overloaded.
There was fly near our table. Cleanliness could be improved.
3% extra on credit card payment is stupidity.
Nowhere in Thailand I was asked for 3% extra charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ank Eth

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ A truly wonderful experience – authentic Indian and vegetarian! 🇮🇳❤️

I went to Shree Khodiyar Kathiyawadi Dhaba with my family, and we were absolutely thrilled. Anyone who loves Indian food and appreciates a variety of spices, aromas, and sauces will love this place.

We tried several vegetarian dishes and were truly amazed by the flavors. You can tell that the food is prepared with lots of spices and love. For me, it wasn't just a meal, but a real culinary adventure in Bangkok.

The mango lassi, in particular, was one of the best I've ever had. 😍 My wife and children loved it too.

The prices are very fair and truly reasonable for the quality. The food was delicious, authentic, and we enjoyed it so much that we left with a very positive feeling.

Thank you so much for the wonderful food! 🙏❤️
We definitely give it 5 stars – we'll be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: nixon giggs

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very poor service and food. It’s worse than poor. You can see a lot of people only because they make you wait. It’s a personal experience of us. We went as a family with kids and still they made us wait 45 mins just to service roti curry and pulao.
Every time we asked the answer was they will serve in 10 mins and nothing. We were about to walk out and then they got salad. Even after that they made us wait 15 more mins. Finally we cancelled rotis and walked out paying for the what we ate.
There’s no one to manage that’s why they act however they want. We were highly disappointed.
Even after this review if you plan to visit, please leave your comment here if it’s wrong.
Edit part: 1. The waiter did not inform about the delay.
2. No we came by walk as our stay is nearby, I can share the details if you want. Don’t just make up things.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narendra Pandit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Not sure how this place manages a 4.8 rating, but our experience was a genuine disappointment. We walked in impressed by the spread - 12 pickle set box and chutneys neatly laid out on every table - but that's where the positives ended. The food was served cold, including rotlas and fafdas, which really only work when hot. The pickles smelled stale, with a strong whiff of heavily used or greased oil.

We picked this place over other nearby options specifically because of the high rating and review count, but honestly, wouldn't never go back.

The stretch near Indira Complex is packed with Indian restaurants, and if you're vegetarian looking for safe, reliable options in an otherwise tough city for vegetarian and Indian food - I'd look beyond this one.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sriram Srinivasan

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you are looking for Indian food in Bangkok , then this road is an answer as you  have the North , South , west India food available here . This particular Gujarati restaurent is just amazing with its quick service,  tasty food . The food spread was  just too good & Presented very well . The service levels was Quick & I liked the food taste & staff attitude .

Apart from the main course , they also served me a good salad with sweet dish , what else do you want 😋

Go for it if you are looking for some delicious Indian food .
sample_reviews_en.author: Chandra Shekar

sample_reviews_en.text: We had dinner here with a large Indian tour group and the experience was excellent. The food was authentic Kathiyawadi and completely vegetarian, with great taste and good variety. The flavors really reminded us of home. The staff was very friendly and specially rosan was very helpful and the service was quick even for a big group. The restaurant was clean and the atmosphere was comfortable. If you are in Bangkok and craving authentic Indian Kathiyawadi food, this place is definitely worth visiting. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jatin Jadwani

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Incredible Kathiyawadi Taste in Bangkok!
Visited this Gujarati Dhaba with my family for lunch after a strong recommendation, and it was absolutely "mstt" (excellent)! Finding such authentic Kathiyawadi flavors so far from home was a wonderful surprise.
Every dish was perfectly spiced and tasted just like a traditional home-cooked meal. If you are in Bangkok and craving genuine Indian food, this is the best place to visit with family. High quality, great hospitality, and 100% authentic. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rishi Bharakhada

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is a good option for people who want Indian food and Bangkok. The hotel is located opposite to Indira market area and there are a lot of India options in the same lane also for people staying in bio Sky hotel or the hotels nearby. This is a good option, even if you come late at night, there is a vast variety of menu and you and you also get other compliments as pickle the Indian assortments. Overall, this is a good option in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pallavi Chandak

restaurants.name: Central Pinklao
restaurants.address:

7 222 Borommaratchachonnani Rd, Arun Amarin, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a fairly large mall with many shops, brands, kiosks, and most importantly, a huge variety of restaurants. You definitely won't be disappointed if you come here to eat.
The parking is terrible, the navigation is difficult to understand with unclear signs, and the lighting is dim. First-time visitors are always confused, struggling to navigate the wrong lanes.
Even inside the mall, the signage is poor. I'm not sure if it's missing or damaged. Finding a restroom is very difficult.
I'm deducting points because, in my personal opinion, the branch's professionalism in management is lacking, especially since it was recently renovated. The air conditioning in some areas is unbearably hot and stuffy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tully Tul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The renovation has completely transformed this mall. It feels much more modern, with nearly twice as many restaurants as before and a great mix of dining options. The shopping experience has also improved significantly, with a better selection of stores and an overall more enjoyable atmosphere.

The only real downside is the parking. It can be very difficult to find a space, and the family parking spots are often occupied by people without children or by drivers who simply don’t want to look for a regular parking space. Better enforcement of these designated spots would make the experience even better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nawat K

sample_reviews_en.text: There's a wide variety of food and goods available, including BTS (Skytrain) events, food shows, cooking demonstrations, dessert shops, and OTOP (One Tambon One Product) food. Everything you need is here! There's a movie theater, restaurants (savory and sweet), shopping, and it's conveniently located with many bus lines passing by. If you're driving, I recommend coming during mall opening hours as there's plenty of parking. Around lunchtime, it gets crowded, and you might have to search for a parking spot for a while. Today, I brought my family here for lunch, dessert, and a movie – all in one place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sudarat Hatanee

sample_reviews_en.text: There are a lot of restaurants now, and there are regular food fairs. On weekends, people tend to come into the mall early, right after it opens. If you're only going to be there for a short time, I recommend parking on the G floor, where you can park for up to 90 minutes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittikorn .W

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's an old department store in this area...
When I was a kid, I was so amazed because the store was HUGE!
I used to visit here often. Lots of childhood memories here, hehe.
Update 1/4/68: The store is under renovation.
Update 19/169: The store renovation is complete.
sample_reviews_en.author: ChubbyArin

sample_reviews_en.text: Large shopping center with a wide selection of shops and restaurants, including Dairy Queen, Saint Etoile, KFC, and Tops. ATMs and massage machines are available. Multi-level parking. My favorite mall in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tony Anthony

sample_reviews_en.text:
The downstairs area has many restaurants, all with delicious-looking food and a wide variety of choices.
Parking is easy on weekdays, but a bit difficult on weekends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nirun Jiensnong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good. Free parking. Plenty of parking spaces.
Lots of household goods and food.
A nice, relaxing stroll; half a day would fly by.
sample_reviews_en.author: Atiwat Rattanawannee

restaurants.name: Heng Chun Seng
restaurants.address:

133 Sunthonkosa Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Morning Glory is basically water spinach~Wang Chun Sheng Beef (Mixed Vegetables) Hot Pot

Overall, "generous portions, delicious taste, and affordable prices" are probably the reasons for Wang Chun Sheng's popularity; for those who don't eat beef, there's also pork available. The medicinal broth has a pleasantly sweet taste, and the chrysanthemum tea is highly recommended.

The nearest MRT station to Wang Chun Sheng is the Queen Sirikit National Convention Centre, but if you have a more leisurely pace, you can also consider Khlong Toei Market as a stop before or after Wang Chun Sheng.

#ElijayAlwaysCome #ElijayAlwaysEat #ElijayAlwaysPlay #Thailand #Bangkok
sample_reviews_en.author: Eli Li

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve been hearing about this place for years and finally made it here to try their beef noodle soup (without noodles) — and it definitely lived up to the hype. The broth was rich and flavorful, and the beef was tender and well-cooked. They also have a hot pot option if you’re coming with a group.

There’s usually a long queue, but it moves quite quickly, so the wait wasn’t too bad. What I really liked is that the owner personally takes care of the shop, which makes the whole experience feel more authentic and well-managed.

Parking can be a bit tricky, as you’ll need to find street parking or park in nearby alleys
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornrawin R

sample_reviews_en.text: This noodle shop is very crowded, so you might have to wait in line for a bit. The vendor is quick, and there's seating at the back of the shop, but many people buy takeout, so if you come at lunchtime or in the evening, you might have to wait a long time for your food. There's no street parking, except maybe on Sundays when you can buy your food, but you can't leave your car there for extended periods.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bee love cats

sample_reviews_en.text: It lives up to the hype 👍... One of the legendary beef noodle shops with incredibly delicious noodles 🍜... I ordered the hot pot set 🍲🫕. The broth was fragrant and flavorful, with your choice of toppings: tender beef, tendon, tripe, tendon meatballs. Everything was delicious and had a wonderful beef aroma... Beef lovers shouldn't miss it 🤤
sample_reviews_en.author: Pitak Y.

sample_reviews_en.text: Tender, melt-in-your-mouth beef, complete set of offal, clean, diverse, fresh, perfect for beef lovers. Pork is also cooked in a separate pot. Public transportation is the best way to get there. It's a very old, established restaurant. If you're in the area, you absolutely must try it. Authentic recipe, highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Capt. Saksarun Nakkaraj

sample_reviews_en.text: This classic restaurant serves delicious beef noodle soup. I'm deducting one star because they only accept cash, and I only had 100 baht with me today (I wanted to eat hot pot but didn't have enough money 🤣). Anyone who's finished running at Benjakitti Park can easily take a motorbike taxi here for a satisfying meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: jom na thalang

sample_reviews_en.text: Legendary braised beef at my favorite restaurant near Khlong Toei Port... Every time I go, it's still as delicious as ever, the familiar taste. The only downside is the long wait... This time I ordered the hot pot with everything in it... It's great with boiled noodles or thin rice noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vava Jirakorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The mixed pork noodle soup is delicious and inexpensive. They give a decent amount of meat pieces, and the broth tastes good and is enjoyable to drink.
I ordered the beef noodle soup to take home, but the portion was a bit small, and the taste wasn't as good as the pork one.
sample_reviews_en.author: Deffy Tee

restaurants.name: Maojaad
restaurants.address:

บ้านเลขที่ 6 (เลขเก่า 285/47) หมู่บ้านประชานิเวศน์3ส่วน3 Soi Ngamwongwarn 23 Alley, Lane 11, เมือง Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste was great, the meat wasn't tough, and there was no gamey smell. You can choose the doneness of the meat.
The rice was soft, delicious, and very hot!
The dipping sauce was flavorful and well-balanced, and the pickled radish was crispy and delicious.

Today I ordered the 519 baht set, which included:
- The pesto was delicious, with a beautiful green color. The meat was grilled to the correct doneness as ordered (the table next to me had flowers in their pesto, but mine didn't).
- The stewed black beef was very tender, with a slight aroma that wasn't too strong. The fried shallots were just right, and adding chili enhanced the flavor even more.
- The grilled beef back was also good and not tough (personally, I found it a little salty, but others might not find it salty).
- The grilled potatoes were delicious (currently, if you spend 250 baht, you get free grilled potatoes).

The restaurant atmosphere was nice and comfortable.
I didn't use the restroom.
Parking is available on the street.
It's not too difficult to find a spot, but be careful not to park in front of anyone's house.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichawat Chakrabandhu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Our journey doesn't take long after we ordered the food. We started with fermented daikon, jaew sauce and crispy chewy tallow (this one we got it for free). Then followed by sous vide ox tongue. The pesto sauce is really nice. Papaya salad is really good. I don't usually like som tum with crab. But this one is just so good.

Our 3rd dish is parallelly delicious. Pasta with top side wagyu & chili. Imagine umami Japanese-Thai flavor immersed in spaghetti with a meat that tender & soft but still chewable. A nice fusion.

Last dish to come out is the tallow rice with the crispy chewy fried tallow & omelette. Again, this has a unami taste that we love. It came with wasabi & lime to wash the heavy flavor.

All in all, the winner is the sous vide ox tongue. But the others also very nice. I want to try the other dishes next time, esp. the pesto pasta & steak. We'll be back soon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chisa Rin

sample_reviews_en.text:
A real hidden gem beef restaurant! it is such a great value and has many interesting fusion menus.

We found this restaurant via Robinhood and decided to dine in. There is a small street where you can park nearby. There are approximately 4 tables available and it is advised to call for an appointment.

The menu here heavily focuses on the Thai fusion single dishes and having beef as a main character. The quality of the beef is great and cooks very well. The seasoning is also flavorful, and if it Thai dish it can be spicy.

Each dish costs approximately 150-300 Thb. There is no extra charge. You also can ask for other promotions available. For instance, I get free beef fat grilled as a complimentary as we spend over 200 Baht.

The service is great and the food come fast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuchnalin Leerasantana

sample_reviews_en.text:
A tiny  restaurant that’s a must-visit for beef lovers. The 4-hour sous vide beef tongue has a perfect texture and is cooked to perfection. The fried rice with beef fat is another standout dish, especially when paired with the Tom Zab spicy soup, which helps round out the meal smoothly.

A complimentary hors d’oeuvre is offered when dining in, adding a nice touch to the experience. Drinks are thoughtfully served in Yeti glasses to ensure the ice stays cold throughout the meal.

All the homemade sauces and dips complement the dishes beautifully.

Parking is available along the roadside in front of the café. With only a few tables, it’s highly recommended to call ahead for a reservation to secure your spot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aimamorn Suvichakorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had an amazing dining experience at Maojaad! The food was absolutely delicious—perfectly cooked and full of rich flavors. The stir-fried spaghetti with beef and mushrooms was well-seasoned with a nice balance of spice, and the pesto spaghetti with steak was a delightful combination of freshness and tenderness.

The service was excellent, with friendly and attentive staff ensuring a great experience. The atmosphere was also warm and inviting, making it a perfect place for a relaxed meal.

Highly recommend this spot for anyone looking for quality food and great vibes! Will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Channipa Wiriyangkoon

sample_reviews_en.text: Having encountered a recommendation on Google Maps, I was motivated to visit this establishment. Convenient parking is available both in front of and opposite the restaurant. The staff is exceptionally cordial, and the cuisine is of high quality. The beef's texture is particularly remarkable, surpassing my expectations. The pricing is commensurate with the offerings. For those in the vicinity with an appetite for beef, a visit to this restaurant is strongly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Benjamin Brasier

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a truly hidden gem, a homemade-style restaurant that's not located on a main road. The food is incredibly delicious and impressive. The spaghetti sauces are excellent, both the rosé and pesto. I didn't get a chance to try anything else because I was already full, but I'll definitely come back. The must-try item is the mashed potatoes; they're incredibly creamy! (I didn't get a chance to photograph them before they were all gone!)
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasunan A

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wagyu combo is a must.. with every kind of beef, med-rare mince size for easy eating. And wagyu grilled with butter.

A complimentary hors d'oeuvre is offered when dining in, adding a nice touch to the experience. Drinks are thoughtfully served in Yeti glasses to ensure the ice stays cold throughout the meal. All the homemade sauces and dips complement the dishes beautifully.
🤤🍺🐮🥩
sample_reviews_en.author: Imgreenjourney

restaurants.name: Kritsada Steak House
restaurants.address:

295 Pracha Uthit Rd, Thung Khru, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a fairly large Italian restaurant with a style that's hard to categorize (but not overly luxurious). The menu has a wide variety of choices. Steak prices start at a reasonable amount, and the meat is grilled quite well (though not particularly fragrant). It's not tough and is served very attractively. Considering the price, it's excellent value. Each dish is quite large and comes with generous side dishes. The Caesar salad is well-made and delicious. The sautéed clams with butter and garlic were a little mild in flavor, but there were plenty of clams. Other dishes we tried were delicious.

In summary: The taste, quantity, and price are all excellent value. The service is standard and the staff is attentive. There's convenient parking in front of the restaurant.

For those in the area, we recommend trying it at least once. The prices are great value, enough to eat there frequently. If you live further away, it's up to your convenience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Go Go Cat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is beautiful and large, but it's best to make a reservation because it can get very crowded.

The food doesn't come out very quickly, so if you have a dish in mind, it's best to order it in advance. Because of the high volume of customers, it takes some time.

It's an air-conditioned restaurant, very cool. They have a wide variety of dishes with options for both children and adults. The flavors are easy to eat, the ingredients are fresh and of good quality.

There's plenty of parking. They also have large tables for families to sit and enjoy their meal together.

Update: The back cafe area now has desserts, a spacious area, and displays a collection of dinosaur figurines. It's clean and airy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalisa Techawatcharapaikul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Update, I just ate here again after 6 years ago, the restaurant is a very well balanced mix between presentation and taste of the dishes. The food arrives quickly. The variety of dishes is overwhelming the name steakhouse doesn't do it justice.

This restaurant just reopened yesterday from across the street. It's a large western style steak restaurant but the serve fish as well. The food is delicious and they have enough staff serving you. But the kitchen seems to have a lack of personnel. A senior member of staff told us before hand that during lunch guests had to wait too long for food. Same with. Hope they can fix this soon and its just teething problems.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joey Baloni

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant offers a variety of steaks and other Western dishes with a rich, delicious Thai flavor. The spicy salads are perfectly seasoned. The grilled pork chop with Jaew sauce is a thick, tender piece weighing 475 grams and priced at 439 baht. The meat is soft, not dry, and delicious, and the Jaew sauce is authentically spicy and flavorful. The ribeye steak is 479 baht and the meat is not tough. The Wagyu beef soup is rich and delicious, with tender, small pieces of Wagyu beef.

The restaurant is large, consisting of two buildings with luxurious decor and beautiful plating. Prices are reasonable. There is ample parking on-site.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponchagarj Ngamukos

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but it was incredibly slow to arrive. I'm not sure how their order system works. I ordered a steak and waited an hour, but the staff said there was no order. How is that possible? Why didn't they inform me so I could reorder? I asked several staff members to follow up, but no one came to tell me that there was no order. They just let me wait until I gave up. And the other steaks that arrived were cold. They were already prepared, but why weren't they served immediately? Why let them get cold? Everything else was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: S S.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, even very delicious, but there were some issues with the service. I arrived at 12:30, ordered, and received everything I ordered, although it took some time, which was acceptable. However, the Austrian Ribeye didn't arrive until 1:30 PM. I followed up with the staff, and they kept saying "yes, yes, we'll check." Finally, the staff said the order was out of the question and I needed to order again. I couldn't wait any longer as I had other appointments.
sample_reviews_en.author: 2 Layers

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant offers a wide variety of dishes, which is good. The taste is okay, almost every dish is edible. The food and the venue are decent to good. There are two sections, a front and a back. The back section has a second floor, like a mezzanine, which seems to have different operating hours, but I forgot to ask the staff. The staff are friendly and there's convenient parking. However, a drawback is that the restaurant doesn't accept credit cards.
sample_reviews_en.author: AKW W

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste was excellent. All the steaks were delicious and beautifully presented.

The restaurant has a well-organized order management system; food didn't take long to arrive.
There's ample and convenient parking.
The staff were friendly, smiling, and always ready to serve.
I dined with my family in the evening; the atmosphere was nice, but personally, I thought the lighting inside the restaurant was a little dim.
Overall, I was very impressed, 10/10!
sample_reviews_en.author: GOODIE GOODIESSS

restaurants.name: วัวกิว ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือเนื้อพ่นไฟ - Wuagyu (สาขา Central Rama 9)
restaurants.address:

ศูนย์การค้าเซ็นทรัล พลาซาแกรนด์ พระราม 9 ชั้น B ห้องเลฃที่ B41 9 Rama IX Rd, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10320, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
So worth it! They give you a lot. For only 299 baht, you get good quality meat. The place was packed. I was very impressed. We used to know the boat noodle shop here from many years ago. It wasn't as good, but it was cheap. This shop is so much better. I came with my parents, and they both loved it. My only complaint is that the menu descriptions are in tiny print, which older people can't read. My dad ordered the regular version, which included braised beef. He didn't order it because he couldn't see the descriptions. So he scooped some out and shared it with us, and then scooped some out for my mom because she doesn't know how to eat it either, haha.
I recommend ordering it less spicy. It came with a few chilies on top, and you'll probably have to scoop some out to get about 80% of it off before it's spicy enough for us to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Melon Sprout

sample_reviews_en.text:
Not your typical “Boat Noodle”.  This bowl is packed with beef.  So full with beef that there is hardly enough room for the noodles and soup.  They have many choices for beef cuts and quality.  The Wagu beef is tender and flavorful.  The bowl is served with herbs and bean sprouts. There is a small charge for the addition of the standard green vegetables.

This is a superior boat noodle for a reasonable price.  The service is good.  The only thing that lets down this restaurant down is that seating is exposed to the mall people traffic.  It is a bit noisy and not very comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Bruneel

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Picanha looked amazing on the menu, but when it was served, it seemed like the meat hadn't been fried because the fat was pure white. It had a slightly gamey smell, so I had to cut off the fat to be able to eat the meat.
I messaged them on Facebook, but they didn't reply. This was my first time eating there, and I don't know if it's some kind of recipe they use.
The only thing that was delicious was the fried rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: KORNIsMyName L.

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The soup is nice
- The foods served here tasted average (not bad but not wow)
- Food portion is pretty big
- Stewed beef is very lean and tender
- Sliced beef is overcooked and it's kinda dry
- Krapao beef dish is a bit too sweet and overcooked too
- The foods are mildly spicy
- Only a few seats available as this branch is very small (too crowded)
- There is usually a wait here
sample_reviews_en.author: Duangkamol L.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Beef is delicious. I had the boat noodles 4 times before I tried Pad Krapao. The beef is good the marble wagyu is a great experience.  This is in the mall.  There is no atmosphere.  My Thai girlfriend doesn't eat beef.  She says the pork boat noodles is expensive but delicious.  149 is not that expensive to me.
You walk into mall basement directly from MRT station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Harold Manary

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best!!! I ordered Australian Chopped Beef + Wagyu stir-fried basil which is recommended menu. It is superb!!! Also, another good thing to add is fried egg (sunny side up). You can select the spicy level by your own. You may think it’s a bit expensive for this price but I think it’s worth the money.

I will come back to try hot pot soup next time for sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: fns

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered Wagyu Marble Slices. The picture on the menu showed beautiful marbling. However, what I received was exactly as pictured (the last picture shows a comparison with pork neck 🤣). I contacted the page and received the response shown in the picture. It was such a disappointing experience that I'm no longer a customer, and I had to write this review.
sample_reviews_en.author: wanwi praii (กรอบมันเค็ม)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very nice place for good premium beef with boat noodles.

Be aware that the boat noodles has tripe and liver in it as well. So if you would like to exclude, please inform the staff.

The beef is succulent and it was cooked nicely, ensuring it is still tender.

The pandan drink is really good. If you are at Central Rama 9, do visit this shop!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yong Quan Foo

restaurants.name: The Smokin' Pug
restaurants.address:

105 Lang Suan Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Have you ever found one of those places that just felt like you fit in?

I actually found this place by accident earlier in the day during a walk and decided to check it out for dinner. I was lucky enough to meet the owner and one of the managers.

I have slowly been writing a book about grief and travel as I explore the world and truly spend a lot of time in Bangkok, which is like a second home to me, but the leadership at the Smokin Pug felt like best friends long lost.

On top of that, they have a very good beer selection and I can honestly say the food was a surprise. It’s unusual to find barbecue no less American style barbecue anywhere in Asia and this place is great. Additionally, the portions were quite surprising. I had the three sliders and the chicken could’ve been on four buns. lol

Anyway, I love the atmosphere and the ownership is fantastic as well as the staff and I know for sure this will be a frequent place for me to visit. I highly recommend checking it out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Derrik Dyka

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re looking for an authentic American-style beer bar, I highly recommend this place! The name caught my eye right away since it’s named after a pug. Every time we call to reserve a table, the owner answers personally and speaks English with us. Their signature dish is the pork ribs, which we have to order every time—the meat is super tender and falls right off the bone, with a rich, flavorful sauce that’s just perfect. The bartenders here are really friendly, too.

Today, we picked a spot by the street, ordered some cold American beer, which paired so well with the pork ribs. Most of the customers are foreigners, with fewer Thai patrons, so the vibe is pretty laid-back and perfect for hanging out with friends after work. The only downside is they don’t have their own parking—you’ll need to park at the mall across the street. Overall, though, this place has become one of our regular spots!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sandy

sample_reviews_en.text: My foreign friend who's living in the area recommended this place coz I loved BBQ ribs. It was good but compared to my favorite one on Nana (also smokehouse)ribs and cornbread were better overthere. The ribs was tasty but quite dry out not as juicy as my favorite places. The beef brisket was too fatty. The big cornbread, I preferred smaller size that crispy outside and soft inside from my favorite place. The Best was smoky shirmp quesadillas and the service was Stella. But it was No service charge add to the bill at the end after I paid I have to asked if there's any tip box and finally found it. They're deserved tip. If I living nearby I may have up my favorite place on Nana. But eventually my residential area is near Prompong. P.S. It's hard to find comfortable chairs here, there's some but not many available. Overall foods good and portions big for Asian.
sample_reviews_en.author: LS SPK

sample_reviews_en.text:
We tried a lot of things here! The Smoked Chicken Wings had a great texture, and the blue cheese dip wasn't too pungent. The Pulled Pork Flautas were also good, especially paired with the sour cream and salsa.

For mains, we had a half rack of Baby Back Ribs and the Beef Brisket. These were a bit so-so for me. The ribs were tender and well-seasoned, but the smoke flavor was a bit too strong for my taste. The brisket was tender and juicy, but not all that exciting.

However, the sausages were the absolute highlight of our night! At only 95 baht, they are probably the best sausages I’ve ever had—tender, juicy, with a crispy casing, and grilled for the precise amount of time. Every table has three base sauces which are great for pairing (especially the ginger one), and the cornbread was baked with a great crust on the outside. Overall, a very solid meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: S.K. Seataphong

sample_reviews_en.text:
My American friend took me to this restaurant because he wanted me to try authentic American food 🇺🇸. He said he'd seen a lot of reviews and the food looked delicious, so he wanted to bring me along.

Personally, I don't usually eat steak or this style of food, so I'm not particularly into it, but after trying it, I thought it was edible and the taste was okay. Importantly, I got to try something I don't usually eat.

Another thing I liked was their craft beer 🍺. It tasted great, was enjoyable, and paired perfectly with the food.

Overall, it was a fun meal because, in addition to trying American-style food, I got to have my friend recommend dishes and experience something new. Anyone who likes steak and craft beer will probably like this restaurant ❤️.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kan Kandanat

sample_reviews_en.text: Every restaurant disappoints sometimes. Except this one somehow. It's one of about three places that I know that delivers an exceptionally enjoyable meal every time. Huge portions of perfectly prepared food, check.  Big, strong, delicious cocktails, check. Wide assortment of good wines available by the glass, check. Professional staff that provide top notch service, check.  And then there's the ribs. I'm from St Louis, MO, where we take great great pride in our ribs, yet nothing there compares to the Pug's. The other, maybe surprising, must try here is the side house salad with mixed greens, sunflower sprouts, and their homemade minty lime dressing. Anytime someone asks me for a recommendation in Bangkok,  this one is at the top of the list.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christopher [Chris] Kennedy

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really nice BBQ spot with a cozy, urban minimalist vibe. The interior design is minimalistic and welcoming, and the photos of the super cute pugs are a great touch!
The staff were friendly, helpful, and genuinely pleasant to interact with, which made the experience even better.

The food portions were very generous and overall delicious. We started with the chicken wings, which were perfectly cooked and full of flavor, and the nachos, which were also very good. For the main, we both ordered the pulled pork sandwich—it tasted good, though it was a bit on the dry side, which made it slightly hard to finish. That said, we probably over-ordered, so that may have played a role.

Overall, I’d definitely come back if I’m in Bangkok again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angelo Noviello

sample_reviews_en.text: I first went to the Smokin Pug the second week it was open, at its original Surawong location. I couldn’t believe how good the food was! Over a decade later and it still is the best in Thailand! A group of nine of us went to dinner there this week. The staff is so friendly and the private room they have for groups is amazing. The Pug has a great drink menu, I highly recommend the Dark & Stormy! Everybody loved their food. The only complaint was the portions are so big it’s hard to finish it all! The brisket quesadillas are probably our group’s favorite appetizer. The ribs are juicy and practically fall off the bone. I had a brisket sandwich and loved it. I always look forward to our visits to the Smokin Pug.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jim Morrison

restaurants.name: Sushina Fortune Town
restaurants.address:

