ชั้น1, หน้าโรงแรม​ AVANI​ ตรงข้ามธนาคารกรุงศรี, ศูนย์การค้าฟอร์จูนทาวน์, 5 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This meal was amazing! I ordered the teriyaki salmon set, which came with hot steamed rice, miso soup, and tamago salad topped with shrimp roe. The teriyaki salmon was perfectly grilled, fragrant, and sweet, with a tender texture and no fishy taste. The sauce was just right, and it paired perfectly with the rice.

I also ordered a mixed sashimi platter. It was a generous serving of salmon, tuna, grilled mackerel, squid, and chopped scallops. Everything was incredibly fresh, with firm, sweet, and juicy flesh. The orange fish roe and shiso leaves added a nice contrast in flavors. The presentation was so beautiful I had to take pictures before eating!

The staff provided excellent service; they were friendly, smiling, and attentive throughout the meal. The atmosphere was warm and comfortable.

Overall, it was great value for money – the taste, freshness, and service were all perfect. Highly recommend! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: EVENING

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was beautifully presented and tasted delicious. The plum soda was refreshing. The prices weren't too expensive, especially with special set meals in the afternoon. The service was quick. I saw the sign inviting people in on the second floor and decided to come down to eat. I wasn't disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Menee Kajorn

sample_reviews_en.text: It's right next to the Avani restaurant, just outside Rama 9, a really great location. I arrived at 11:45 am on a weekday and it was already packed. The prices are very reasonable, about half the price of Ippudo in the Central shopping mall downstairs, and the taste is about the same.
sample_reviews_en.author: LamYin Jyu

sample_reviews_en.text: The chef's cooking is perfectly balanced; the soup isn't too salty. I've eaten here many times, and even ordered delivery, which was just as delicious as eating at the restaurant. Highly recommend! It's excellent!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jany Jaan

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! This is my go-to lunch spot. The ingredients are fresh, and the sashimi is excellent. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Siriwan Sritunghom

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere, excellent service, and delicious food. I've been here many times already. 🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: อรณิชา แก้วทอง

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been here many times. The food is good value for money; the prices are reasonable and the taste is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภวิษย์พร เจิมเฉลิม

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, the prices are affordable, and there are great promotions.
Sushi buy one get one free.
sample_reviews_en.author: TIDA JITTHIANGTHAE

restaurants.name: Jumbo Seafood Iconsiam
restaurants.address:

299 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Today we went to a buffet for ฿1,999, but it was a buy 4 get 3 free deal, so it came out to ฿1,500 per person. We chose premium items, including four crabs. This doesn't include the unlimited dim sum and other items. It was great value for money. The staff were friendly and cheerful. We will definitely come back again! 💯💯💯💯💯💯💯🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 …
sample_reviews_th.author: Chotevivat Kornasdawuth

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted very good, and the ingredients were fresh. The atmosphere was like a typical restaurant, but the staff didn't prioritize their tasks properly. The restaurant seemed very chaotic even though there weren't many customers. We had to call someone three times to order everything before they even finished taking our food. They took one item and then walked away, like they had short attention spans (the manager too 😅). The receptionist said they had the menu item we were looking for, but when we got to our table, they said it was sold out and then walked away. The manager came back to take our order, and then suddenly they had it! It was all very confusing. Everyone seemed extremely busy, but I don't know what they were busy with. The dim sum was on the menu, but when we ordered it, they said they didn't sell it there. The service was terrible, absolutely awful. They really need to improve because for a 10% + 7% service charge, the service should be much better.
sample_reviews_en.author: nattwan ps

sample_reviews_en.text:
A famous restaurant from Singapore.
Plenty of seating inside.
The air conditioning wasn't very cool.

Set meals are available.
Cheaper than ordering à la carte.

Fried fish skin: This dish is excellent!
Crispy, soft, and coated with egg yolk.
A must-try!

Baked pork ribs: Very tender and boneless.

Fried rice: Fragrant with wok-fried aroma, typical Chinese style.

Braised tofu: Good flavor.

Fried tofu skin and shrimp dumplings: Good dim sum.
Good value for money.

For the crab, you can choose between
black pepper sauce or chili sauce.
I chose chili sauce; it wasn't spicy, more of a sweet and sour taste. The crab meat wasn't very fresh or firm.
Probably used dead crabs. At this price point, this isn't expected.

They offer a crab cracking service, which is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khongwut Aries

sample_reviews_en.text:
The crab wasn't fresh, so we returned it and asked for fresh, live crab. The chili crab and beef with black pepper were too sweet.

The Filipino waiters provided much better service than the Thai waitresses, who tend to group together near the restaurant entrance while most customers sit further away by the riverfront window.

Regarding the THB 1,999++ set menu, be aware that the 10% service charge is not calculated on THB 1,999 but on the full price of THB 2,820. (This is written at the bottom of the menu, but in very small print, as shown in the menu image.)

I expected the food and services of a reputable restaurant like Jumbo to be better than this.
Considering the restaurant's reputation and prices, the food and service should have been better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patchara Netsuwan

sample_reviews_en.text: I was impressed from the moment I arrived. The restaurant is spacious, clean, and comfortable, perfect for special occasions with family and friends. The service was excellent; attentive and friendly, offering great menu recommendations. Overall, the food was delicious, the ingredients were fresh, and it was served quickly. My favorite dish was the XO Radish Cake, which was fragrant with the perfect amount of XO sauce, rich, and incredibly tasty – I wanted to order more! Additionally, the lunch set was excellent value, including a small portion of Peking duck. I got to try several dishes at a reasonable price. I will definitely be back to this restaurant. ⭐️
sample_reviews_en.author: Marumanju

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came because of the 399++ promotion.
The food was incomplete; the pork dumplings didn't arrive, and when we asked, there was no answer. The ginger soup with glutinous rice balls was also sold out. The waiters were probably overwhelmed with the large number of customers taking advantage of the promotion. We asked for refills of our water and waited so long we almost wanted to pour it ourselves. The waiter was nice, but I felt sorry for them because they were busy serving many tables, so I only deducted one star. The portions are small, but you can order the same items repeatedly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sureeporn Tawankanjana

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to eat today and was very unimpressed. It's a buffet, but they ran out of items, and they didn't tell us. We sat at a table and ordered, then they said everything was sold out. They only compensated us with two baskets of pork ribs and two plates of Emperor Pork (two pieces per plate). The first round of food came quickly, but it wasn't complete. When we ordered a second round, it didn't come for almost half an hour. We had to keep asking for it. They only served stir-fried vegetables. We paid almost 500 baht per person and ate nothing but stir-fried vegetables.
sample_reviews_en.author: pattanan Taweehirussuwan

sample_reviews_en.text:
No wonder this place has so many bad reviews. I regret coming here. I arrived around 2 pm on a Thursday and was told the buffet was no longer available, but I saw other Thai customers being offered the buffet menu.

The service was extremely slow and inattentive. I had to ask twice where my food was. They also don’t accept credit cards for bills under 1,000 baht.

The food quality was average, and the portions were small. The XO radish cakes came with no XO sauce at all. Overall, it was a terrible experience. I won’t be coming back, and I wouldn’t recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachel Chen

restaurants.name: SUSHI SEKI (The Mall Bangkapi)
restaurants.address:


sample_reviews_en.text: Seki at The Mall Bangkapi is a fantastic dining spot offering a delightful Japanese culinary experience. The ambiance is modern and cozy, making it perfect for casual meals or special gatherings. Their dishes are always fresh, beautifully presented, and full of authentic flavor. The staff are friendly, attentive, and provide excellent service, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The menu features a great variety, from sushi and sashimi to hot dishes and desserts, all at reasonable prices. It’s a hidden gem in the mall that never disappoints. Highly recommended for anyone who loves high-quality Japanese food in a comfortable setting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lau David

sample_reviews_en.text: Sushi Seiki offers an authentic Japanese dining experience with a focus on sushi. The ambiance is elegant, creating a serene atmosphere. The sushi selection is diverse, featuring fresh and high-quality ingredients. The chefs showcase their skill with precision in crafting each roll. Service is attentive, enhancing the overall dining experience. While prices might be on the higher side, the quality justifies the cost. Sushi Seiki is a go-to choice for those seeking a refined taste of Japanese cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akanith Chowtivicha

sample_reviews_en.text: Feel like got trapped by the poster ads. Once arrived there’s a staff come to explain promotions at the table. We asked for the promotions that put in front of restaurant, then the staff introduced many promotions. We chose this 8 platter premium sashimi staff said discount from 2,xxx to 1,390 but I realized that on the menu wrote 1,390 not 2,xxx so wonder what full prices she claimed verbally is true. The fish is ok quality but gave big and thick pieces. I won’t go back again
sample_reviews_en.author: Montra Sutthinaraphan

sample_reviews_en.text:
SEKI Japanese restaurant offers an authentic dining experience with a menu that highlights both freshness and flavor.

A must-try is their Buri Kama Shioyaki, perfectly grilled to bring out the rich, buttery taste of the yellowtail collar. Pair it with the refreshing avocado salad, which balances creamy textures with vibrant flavors.

Whether you’re a fan of traditional Japanese dishes or looking to explore, SEKI is a fantastic choice for a delightful meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kulissara Tunyong

sample_reviews_en.text: Sushi Seki at The Mall Bangkapi offers a superb dining experience with its expertly crafted sushi and sashimi. The Toro nigiri melts in your mouth, and the Seki roll is a delightful blend of crab, avocado, and truffle oil. The service is attentive, the ambiance sophisticated yet relaxed, making it perfect for any occasion.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanyatheera S

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good and authentic Japanese food. Selections on the menu seem limitless. Quality is likely one the best you can find in shopping malls. Sushi size is fairly big; one piece would require 2+ bites for most people. Staff is knowledgeable and friendly. Will definitely visit again. Do check out the special menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pol C.

sample_reviews_en.text: Quality fresh ingredients for each sushi and sashimi set even donburi set are great. The taste is very similar with real authentic Japanese style. The best value compared price and ingredients. There many store and this is our first time here , we do get good experiences and you can try it too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joe Yang

sample_reviews_en.text:
1.The salmon on top with Kanimiso was really good
2.The kanimiso ( not the one from the salmon) taste a bit too sweat
3.The salad was incredible
4.The soup that was serve when we entre the restaurant was amazing
5. The waiters is really polite
6. An interior design is really nice

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent. They grilled the food for us throughout our stay, and everything was prepared and handled very cleanly. The food was delicious, and the dipping sauces complemented the dishes perfectly. The restaurant's interior was beautifully decorated, comfortable, cool, and not stuffy. I give it 100/10!
sample_reviews_en.author: Xiao Chill

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent; you can choose to have them grill it for you or grill it yourself. The food quality was good, with plenty of side dishes that you can refill. A suggestion to the brand manager: please open a branch at Mega Bangna! 🥹
sample_reviews_en.author: looknam pornchanok

sample_reviews_en.text: Honestly didn’t expect this place to hit this hard… but wow. From the very first bite, everything was insanely good. The meats were perfectly grilled for us.! juicy, smoky, and cooked just right without having to lift a finger. And can we …
sample_reviews_en.author: Anan T.

sample_reviews_en.text: Xita Ama (西塔老太太) offers a great overall experience, particularly because of its excellent value and the impressive variety of meats available on the menu. While the selection is strong, the beef brisket was a notable disappointment due to …
sample_reviews_en.author: Ben C

sample_reviews_en.text: First time trying Chinese grill but was not disappointed. The food is more like Korean than Japanese yakiniku. They offer set meals for 2-3 people at a good price. We tried the pork set which came with 4 different parts of pork and a pot …
sample_reviews_en.author: pongpratch puapatanakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The meat is tender and melts in your mouth, delicious with a variety of dipping sauces. There's plenty of free vegetables. The restaurant is clean, the service is good, and the meat is of excellent quality. Worth every penny.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phattharawadee San.

sample_reviews_en.text: It felt like eating Korean food in Shanghai. For me, it wasn't quite authentic Korean style. It's probably more like Korean food for Chinese people, which you should try, but I thought it was just average.
sample_reviews_en.author: rachathorn rungchinasak

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the good Chinese bbq restaurant i have eaten and definitely one of my top choice for bbq in Bangkok! Love the attentive service from the team! Definitely coming back for more!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Low

restaurants.name: Tam 20 Ratchada – Suthisan
restaurants.address:

90 Sutthisan Winitchai Rd, Samsen Nok, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tum 20 is a great place if you're looking for tasty som tam at a good price. They offer a variety of papaya salads, all fresh and flavorful. The classic som tam Thai is really well-balanced, with just the right mix of sweet, sour, and spicy. For something a bit different, the som tam pu pla ra with salted crab and fermented fish is also worth a try if you enjoy bolder flavors.

Aside from the papaya salads, you can also get grilled chicken, pork neck, and sticky rice to round out your meal. The portions are generous, and the prices are very affordable, making it a great option if you’re on a budget.

The staff is friendly, and they can adjust the spice level to suit your taste. The restaurant has a casual and relaxed vibe, perfect for a quick bite or a meal with friends. Overall, Tum 20 is a solid choice for good, affordable Thai food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narin Wattanasiri

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went here for lunch on the recommendation of a local friend (who owns a restaurant). He likes to bring his friends to the place for beer (which he says is cheaper than 7-11) and live music.

As a regular patron, he ordered the dishes for us, the large fish cooked with a coating of salt, the sizzling beef slices, steamed egg topped with seafood, and fried chicken. All the dishes were good and cheap from our foreign perspective.

Yes, the dishes did take time to be served but we didn't mind as our group enjoyed conversations pre meal. The staff were friendly and attentive (though mostly speaks Thai so bust out the translation app).

Plenty of parking and popular with locals (didn't see other tourists that time).

Best to arrive by taxi or private vehicle as it is far away from the MRT.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kingfisher

sample_reviews_en.text:
Large open air dining space (80+ tables) with nice live music (Thai & English).

The Tum Kanom Jin Palaa was fresh and tasty.  The grilled chicken,  on the other hand, was dry and cool. It seemed like food left over from the prior day. Also, we had to ask twice for the sticky rice,  which wasn't brought together with the chicken.

We ordered Jim Jum, but 70 minutes later,  when we hadn't received it,  we canceled the order and left since we'd eaten all the other food.

When we paid the bill, it took a full 15 minutes to get change.

The prices are low; the atmosphere is okay; the food is hit and miss, and the service we got was substandard.

The place was 70-80% full,  so they must do better most of the time,  but I won't be going back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bill Horgan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been waiting for my order for hours and still haven't received it. I ordered seafood fried rice. The picture in the menu showed chili fish sauce, but it wasn't included when it was served. When I asked for it again, I waited another 50 minutes or so, and still didn't get it. In the end, I had to eat it as is. Is it really that hard to make chili fish sauce? And what kind of fried rice doesn't come with chili fish sauce?
I ordered another dish, but it was missing sticky rice. I waited another 40 minutes or so, and still didn't get it. Am I supposed to just eat plain papaya salad?
Overall, it's terrible. If it were incredibly delicious, I'd forgive them, but what I ate was just average.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanadol Saiduang

sample_reviews_en.text:
A message to potential diners: Please consider listening to customer feedback.
I ordered 6 dishes and waited a full hour, only to be served water and ice. By the time I finished my drinks, the ice had melted and I still hadn't received any food (not even plain rice). When I inquired, the staff said they were short-staffed today. If you're not ready or if it's going to be very slow, you should inform customers before ordering so they can decide whether to wait or not. Instead, I wasted over an hour waiting, and the staff were getting criticized by almost every table. I'm passing this feedback to the management or owner. It was a terrible experience. This will be my last time here.
sample_reviews_en.author: JamesZ Astro

sample_reviews_en.text: I arrived at 11:30 AM today and waited for my food for an excessively long time. Two other tables had already finished eating. The system and management today were terrible. I repeat, I arrived at 11:30 AM and waited for my food for an excessively long time. Two other tables had already finished eating. The system and management today were terrible. I emphasize again, we were the first two tables. I received three dishes around 12:15 PM. I waited almost an hour for my food, it's ridiculous. Meanwhile, about four or five other tables received their complete orders and were almost full by the time they finished eating. First and last time here.
sample_reviews_en.author: รัชชวิช กิตติกุลธาริน

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was slow, the taste was mediocre, and the staff seemed confused, serving dishes one at a time. We finished our food, but the larb (spicy minced meat salad) still hadn't arrived. When we canceled the order, they said it was ready, claiming the delay was due to delivery orders. What does the customer have to do with it? If that's the case, they might as well just close the front of the restaurant and only open for business, wasting people's time. It created a very unpleasant dining experience for the customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Worawat Pongteeraporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The menu is diverse, the food tastes good, especially the crispy papaya salad. Prices are cheap to mid-range. There's both air-conditioned and outdoor seating. There's a spacious parking lot.

I ordered papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce, and papaya salad with fresh shrimp; the base flavors were exactly the same. I recommend the jellyfish salad. The grilled chicken is also delicious, as is the mushroom curry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puwit K

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely love Puponfai’s Seafood 😋 The customer service was great too. I ordered through their official Instagram account and they delivered straight to my hotel.

These three dishes were our favourites:
• Crab Meat Fried Rice with Extra Crab: Every bite was fragrant, flavourful and satisfying.

• Steamed Crab Legs & Claws: Fresh, cleanly peeled and served in generous chunks. It paired amazingly well with their seafood sauce!

• Prawn with Glass Noodle: The generous amount of black pepper gave it a slightly spicy kick but it was incredibly tasty.

Highly recommend Puponfai if you’re craving fresh and delicious seafood!

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food at Puponfai Zaponfai was absolutely delicious—fresh, flavourful and definitely worth trying while in Bangkok. We really enjoyed our meal here.

However, the restaurant does not accept card payments and there is no Wi-Fi available. Make sure to bring enough cash with you, especially if you do not have mobile data. Other than that, the food was excellent!
sample_reviews_en.author: Stefani Nguyen

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered seafood delivery to our hotel. The ordering process was smooth and easy, and the delivery arrived on time. Overall, the experience was amazing and enjoyable. Of course, the food was fresh and delicious! Special thanks to the admin and delivery rider for their excellent service!

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually use Grad Foods delivery to my hotel when I'm in Bangkok. This was my first time having dinner at the Chulalongkorn branch. You need to order using a QR code inside. Although there aren't many shops, it wasn't too cramped, and the …

sample_reviews_en.text: Was looking for an authentic seafood joint that wasn’t too overpriced and this might be it. Fried pork neck was easily the star of the meal, seafood was fresh and everything was tasty without any misses! Thai tea slushy was really nice too
sample_reviews_en.author: Sam T

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing seafood 🦀 spot, just little outside of Bangkok cbd. Always fresh and tasty. It’s not very long queue on weekdays but might get tricky during weekend. You can also get them on line so order from home as well. Siting is limited.

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken wings taste delicious. Mantis shrimp is well‑seasoned. Especially the curry crab goes perfectly with rice. Besides, the restaurant has a nice environment and thoughtful service. It is highly recommended.

sample_reviews_en.text: Dining in does not come with water.. You will need to purchase bottle water or so. Food was ok, not impressive though. Stir-fried cabbage was the best of all, but it’s 190 for a little portion

restaurants.name: Doo Rae
restaurants.address:

212 15 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Doo Rae is our regular stop whenever we’re in Korean Town, and after years of trying other places around here, nothing has pulled us away from it.

Honestly, the side dishes are half the reason I come. It’s a proper spread, not the token two or three plates you get elsewhere, and every single one is worth eating — I’ll happily fill up on those before the meat even hits the grill. They refill without you having to flag anyone down, which is one of those small things that tells you how well a place is run.

The grilled meat holds its own too. Marinated properly, cooked right, and the staff look after the grill for you so nothing gets overdone. They swap the plate out as it chars, so the last bite tastes as good as the first.

Service overall is genuinely excellent. Warm, attentive, never rushed even when the room is full. You end up staying longer than you planned, in a good way.

Easy 5 stars. If you’re in Korean Town and can’t decide, come here — and don’t sleep on the banchan
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuwarin Tattiam

sample_reviews_en.text: Side Dishes (Banchan): A spectacular display of side dishes including kimchi, vegetable salad, potato salad, pickled tomatoes/vegetables, soy sauce onions, stir-fried beans, and fresh vegetables like sesame leaves and lettuce. A truly …
sample_reviews_en.author: Kawinruj Jaratteerawat

sample_reviews_en.text: This is our family's go-to Korean restaurant. Our usual order is ginseng chicken soup, along with other soups. Everything is delicious, especially the kimchi they provide – it's incredibly tasty and makes eating there a lot of fun.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaiporn M

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been to this BBQ place many times. I'm really impressed with both the taste and the service. It's also super convenient to get to since it's right near BTS Asok.

Authentic Korean food with genuine Korean flavors.

sample_reviews_en.text: Great Service and great ambiance, can recommend this place to everyone who wants to experience a real Korean bbq.

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice Experience having hot Bowls & Plates served at the tables - yummy flavors - definitely recommended

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great Street Food Experience at Myth I Bangkok
I visited Myth I Bangkok Street Food and I really enjoyed it! The food was delicious and full of flavor. The ingredients were fresh, and the dishes were served hot.
The staff were friendly and helpful. They spoke good English and helped me choose some traditional Thai dishes. The service was also fast, which I liked a lot.
The place is clean and has a nice atmosphere. It's perfect for tourists who want to try real Thai street food in a comfortable setting.
I highly recommend this place if you are in Bangkok. I will definitely come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Emanuele Dessì

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's not far from Khaosan night market. The staff are so friendly with smile on their faces.
We ordered their spinach with rice, green curry and garlic nan, all food tastes great and delicious, also it's not over spicy!🌶🌶🌶
It's economic with good portion of food, also various choices, plus there are vegetarian options! We love our dinner there! There's also a toilet available for the customers.
Definitely highly recommended🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
sample_reviews_en.author: Tara Wang

sample_reviews_en.text: Brilliant little street food place with consistently good food. Despite being in Bangkok and wanting to try different places we came here for 4 meals in a row because the food was so good and the service was friendly . Also we loved the little street atmosphere. The chefs & waiting staff in this joint are brilliant and gave us some of our best meals in Thailand. Can't recommend it enough if you want to be assured of good food 🤤
sample_reviews_en.author: Sue D

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant had a quiet location and friendly staff, which made for a pleasant atmosphere dor that specific area.

Unfortunately, the food didn’t quite deliver. The Pad Thai leaned too much on the sweet side but was still decent—I'd rate it 3.5 out of 5. The mango shake, however, was disappointing: mostly ice and barely any mango flavor, just 1 star for that. Overall, an average experience with room for improvement.

sample_reviews_en.text:
After I walked by here earlier in the day I knew it would be the go to place for dinner, and I was not wrong.

A cool spot with lots of seating and stellar Massman Curry and Panang Curry with tofu

The service wa great. I believe it was about 100-120baht for the curries and 30baht for a bowl of rice.

Its right in the mix so lots if things going on all around. A great spot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Team Sauce Travels

sample_reviews_en.text: Got their papaya salad,  red curry and pad thai. Asked for no fish sauce and eggs, which they were very happy to customise. The salad was too spicy for me, but the overall flavour profile in this resturant was brilliant. The pad thai just felt so light and immediately dissolved in my mouth. Their outdoor seating on a cool evening just felt right. Would 100% be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Harika Komandoor Ranganathan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I would call it regular/average. Went there because of good ranking - but there are plenty of better places. Food was ok - justas for any other regular thai place.
Service was way before average - they forgot some of the dished we ordered. Empty plates stayed on the table all the time, we had to ask twice to tKe those out. Very average place

sample_reviews_en.text: A good restaurant - a combination between Thai and Indian kitchen. The food was tasty and well seasoned. The papaya salad was little bit to spicy to our taste. The stir fry vegetables with cashews were amazing. The panang curry with shrimps was also great. The chicken curry was also nice. Overall a great experience.

sample_reviews_th.text:
Cookkimao (กุ๊กขี้เมา) on Banthat Thong is an absolute must-visit spot that lives up to the hype! 🔥
If you're building the ultimate food crawl itinerary in Bangkok, this needs to …
sample_reviews_th.author: Cho Shinnakerdchoke

sample_reviews_en.text:
Not the most delicious Thai food I’ve had. I’m sure if the owner chef is actually there to cook all the dishes himself, it would’ve been perfect.

Their signature minced beef krapao was quite delicious but I couldn’t taste any crusty charred beef taste like how the recipe intended.

Lava eggs with shrimps looks scrumptious but the flavor was clearly on the bland side, did the cooks forgot the seasoning? Delicious grilled shrimps though.

Last dish is fried calamari with chili and salt. One of my most beloved Thai dishes. Calamari freshly fried to perfection, just the right amount of chewiness. Chili, fried garlic and salt add incredible amount of strong flavor but wow, it was crazy spicy!

But you know when you eat Thai seafood dishes, you will always get the famous spicy lime seafood sauce which is even spicier!
Absolutely sublime combination, I definitely suffered quite a lot but it was worth it.

Overall, I had mixed feelings about this place. Still pretty good Thai food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cafe S

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is both a drinking place and a restaurant. Saw the Google reviews ratings and decided to drop by to try the food though we don’t drink.

Unassuming shop front as we missed the entrance  the first time. We ordered some beef dishes like the stewed beef stir fried with basil and a beef soup that’s similar to tom yam soup. I particularly liked the stir fried beef stew with basil. Fragrant and spicy at the same time, with a very soft texture to the beef. It had been well stewed prior to stir frying it. Both dishes used fresh ingredients as we could taste the herbs and spices in the soup. Be warned as their stir fried beef can be spicy for foreigners.

Very lively ambience inside the restaurant with friendly servers as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Crumpled Nomad

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a restaurant where you can enjoy spicy Thai food. The place was filled with full of young Thai local and I was lucky enough to grab the last available seat.

Orders are made through a QR code, but there were no English translations or photos. By pointing at the menu pictures, the waiter helped me find and add the dishes through my phone. Since the restaurant was quite busy, I felt a bit guilty for making the waiter stop for about 5 minutes.

The food that was pretty good, and surprisingly, the deep-fried tofu, which I didn't expect much was the most enjoyable. Most of the dishes were quite spicy. If you’re not good with spicy food, I recommend asking for the dishes to be prepared less spicy in advance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donggeon Kang

sample_reviews_en.text: DO NOT RECOMMENDED! The food was acceptable. For the service, it was absolutely horrendous even though the restaurant was not full house and there were a lot of staff. The air conditioner was too windy and request to turn down a bit or change the seat, we called the waiter twice and they said okay but then nothing else changed. We request change seat before our food was arrived, but they also refused to do it. I could not finish a drink and I request for a takeaway cup (providing that this restaurant also do takeaway service and they said they didn’t have a plastic cup) it was ridiculous and I certainly believed that the reviews here were kind of a scam.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jinger Wong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The crispy pork with shiitake mushroom sauce was delicious. It went very well with plain rice. It was mildly salty and perfectly crispy.
The traditional glass noodle salad had a very generous portion and tasted good, but the squid was a bit chewy. The shrimp were large and cooked medium.
The preserved plum soup had just the right amount of sourness and plenty of pork.
The staff provided good service and the prices were reasonable.
The portions are large, so don't order impulsively! 😂
sample_reviews_en.author: M Sitt

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything we ate was delicious, but my favorite was the stir-fried squid with salted egg yolk – it had a unique flavor with a hint of sweetness. Next best was the crispy pork stir-fried with mushroom sauce; it looked unlike anything I've ever tasted. I don't usually eat beef, but the person I was with said the beef stir-fried with Jango sauce was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: ตามล่าอาหารอร่อย ราคากันเอง

sample_reviews_en.text: 🍽️🩷The Thai food here is very delicious, and they also show football matches. There's alcohol available too. Anyone looking to watch a football match at night while enjoying some food and drinks should definitely come here. A recommended dish is the sun-dried pork neck, which is extremely tasty. The prices are quite high, but the service is excellent.

444 ถนน พญาไท อาคารมาบุญครองเซ็นเตอร์ ชั้น 2, โซน C, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went for lunch around 1:30 pm, just the two of us, and surprisingly there was only one other person eating at the buffet at that time. The place was very clean and the staff were really attentive and friendly.

The only small issue was that they didn’t speak much English, which felt a bit odd considering it’s inside a shopping mall that gets a lot of tourists. Also, it was a little confusing at first to understand how the drinks work. Some drinks are included in the buffet and others aren’t, and the prices are written on the fridge doors. In our case, the beers didn’t have prices, so we assumed they were included, but they weren’t. Not a big deal in the end, just something to be aware of.

We chose the highest buffet option, which includes Wagyu and Australian beef, and honestly everything was delicious. Both the food on the conveyor belt and the items we ordered fresh were very good quality. The only downside was that some fried items took a bit longer to arrive when ordered.

Overall, the price is reasonable, although a bit high for Bangkok, but the quality makes up for it. Very good experience and we’d definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emilio Ferrari

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's cost 276, but also u have to pay for vegi many 78.

U have to wait 2 hours in the line, but they have handy application for this, so u can go shopping.

Stuff doesn't know English at all, so we wasted our time for understanding rulse of this place 🙄 But otherwise the service is fast and everyone is doing well. We waited for our order for a maximum of 5 minutes.

some rules for those who are in such a restaurant for the first time:

1. You pay per per person
2. You have two hours for the meal
3. You can reorder several times
4. To call the waiter (who will help you mark the food) raise the red flag
5. They top up the soup broth themselves, but you can call the waiter if this doesn't happen.
6. Calculate how much you can eat!  for each left bowl of food you pay extra 100 THB
sample_reviews_en.author: Misha Il'ves

sample_reviews_en.text: Suki Teenoi at MBK Center is a great spot for anyone looking to enjoy affordable and delicious Thai-style hotpot in Bangkok. The restaurant has a lively and modern atmosphere, making it a fun place to dine with friends or family after shopping at MBK. The buffet selection was impressive, with a wide variety of fresh meats, seafood, vegetables, noodles, and sauces to choose from. Everything was well stocked and flavorful, and the soup bases were rich and satisfying. The self service setup was organized well, making the dining experience smooth and enjoyable. The staff were friendly and efficient despite the busy crowd, and the overall value for money was excellent. If you enjoy hotpot or buffet dining, Suki Teenoi is definitely worth visiting while exploring MBK Center.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vachintha Piyadasa

sample_reviews_en.text:
we all know this restaurants fully packed. Now I'll tell the facts based on my personal experience.

Staffs: only 1 or 2 staffs can speak english. MBK center is also tourist attraction. They should hire some staffs who can communicate in Eng to get better customer experince.

Place: there are lots of tables. They also have robotos to assist cus. Pretty quick to get your order.

Food: Hot pot soup has lots of MSG. 😭
(I got headache and got some symptoms of MSG after eat that)

Personal recommendation: I wont recommend to eat with chess. It does not make taste better. You just have to carry that chesse stan cuz it always immerse in the hot pot soup:")
sample_reviews_en.author: J “𓆝 𓆟”

sample_reviews_en.text:
Suki Teenoi is one of those classic hotpot buffet spots locals keep coming back to—it’s the go-to place when you’re craving hotpot late at night. This branch is especially convenient since it’s located in a shopping mall and stays open until 3 AM, even after the rest of the mall has closed.

The food is just what you’d expect—nothing fancy or special, but definitely satisfying for the price. For under 300 baht, you get a variety of ingredients and a full pot to enjoy. They also offer different soup bases to choose from, so you can customize your hotpot to your taste. Perfect for when you want a no-fuss, late-night hotpot fix with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chen E.

sample_reviews_en.text: Food are very decent for the price. The buffet includes different meat options (beef, pork, chicken), vegetables, rice and noodles. There is an unlimited drinks refill option as well and there are different types of sodas and slushies to choose from. You have 2 hours to enjoy the food and it is very suitable if you are eating with a group of friends. If you plan to come for dinner, make sure you come and get a ticket around 6 or 7pm because it will take at least 45mins to 90mins to wait.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angus Stew Pitt

sample_reviews_en.text: We came here almost daily when visiting Bangkok. So affordable! The wait isn’t too bad. Take a number inside with staff and wait outside to be called. Food was super yummy! Recommend chicken and beef. Squid was good too. You get charged for drinks already and you can fill them up as much as youd like self service from the back. Also have self service fried foods which were so yummy too! Highly recommend trying at least once! All you can eat on a budget! Staff are super kind too!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bella

sample_reviews_en.text: You can choose it if you want to try suki buffet with reasonable price as it only costs ~285 Bahts per person. Can choose a variety of vegetables & meat like chicken, pork, beef, prawns, clams, octopus and dori fish. It also provides appetisers like french fries & chicken nuggets and 4-5 kinds of cold drinks. The only thing you need to know before you go there is that you might need to wait 1-2 hours of queues there as it’s crowded everyday, both weekends & weekdays.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lillian Zun

restaurants.name: THE COFFEE CLUB -Samyan Mitrtown
restaurants.address:

Fl. G, Samyan Mitrtown Parking Lot, 952 Phaya Thai Rd, Wangmai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The only good thing about this place is the shady and chill atmosphere because it’s inside a massive mall. The sun outside is prohibitive to any human activity. That’s where the good ends.

Croissant was stale. Beans tasteless. Avocado expired and bland. Poached eggs, of course overcooked. Coffee does not even deserve to be referred to as coffee…  service gave the impression of disengagement. This is a long shot, but my impression was they fear their boss and do whatever when he/ she is not around. They were kind and pleasant in the interaction with us.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marko Radosavljevic

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is another restaurant I frequent.
The 690 baht buffet is great value.
The service at this branch is good. There are quite a few people working in the restaurant, but they have tables available for diners.
If you come often, paying via Wallet is worthwhile.
sample_reviews_en.author: NIPON AROONRUANGSIRILERT

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the opportunity to visit The Coffee Club and was impressed by both the atmosphere and the service, especially a staff member named Prae who provided outstanding service. From the moment I entered, I was greeted with a friendly smile, …
sample_reviews_en.author: k

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff member, Nong Naey, is very friendly and speaks sweetly. She recommended this place, saying it opens early at 7 am so you can enjoy delicious food. ❤️😍🥰😘 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Tielek T

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ve sent email about my complaint and even DM-ed their IG account but to no response (they only “seen” my message. So here I am. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Windy Hapsari

sample_reviews_en.text:
The drinks were excellent, and I used a friend's points to get them for free.
It was a comfortable place to chat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paweena P.

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent service from P’Noey and delicious drinks! Also good spot for studying and chilling 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Praew Chen

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were lovely, the atmosphere was great, perfect for reading and relaxing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nisa N.

restaurants.name: SUSHIRO THAILAND centralwOrld
restaurants.address:

No.4, 4/1, 4/2, 4/4 Central World, Room no.B725 7th Floor, Ratchadamri Rd, Pathumwan, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
G’day, Bernie here.
In Australia we’re basically raised on sushi trains. It’s a staple back home but let me tell ya, Sushiro at Central World is playing in a different league. The Sashimi😋 I grabbed the salmon sashimi plates. At 100 THB (that’s roughly $4 AUD), the value is mental. You’re getting fresh cuts that actually have that fatty melt-in-your-mouth quality. Back in Brissy, you’d be paying triple for this quality at a standard train, so I bought 2 😍
​The Vibe is efficient mate, high tech, and clean. You’ve got the tablet ordering (very intuitive) and the specialised express belt that shoots your food right to your seat. It’s full "Japan-mode" in the heart of Bangkok. 10/10
sample_reviews_en.author: Bernie

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited Sushiro at CentralWorld and had a very satisfying experience. The sushi was fresh, well-prepared, and beautifully presented. The salmon was rich and buttery, and the ikura was generous, fresh, and bursting with flavor. The sashimi platter was also impressive fresh seafood with good variety and quality for the price.

I really like the tablet ordering system it’s easy, fast, and convenient, and the food arrives quickly. The restaurant was quite busy, but the staff managed everything efficiently, and the overall service was smooth.

Great value for money, consistent quality, and a fun dining experience. Definitely a good choice for sushi lovers in the city.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gardenian

sample_reviews_en.text: Sushiro Thailand offers a consistently excellent dining experience with high-quality sushi and a variety of fresh options. The food is flavorful and well-presented, with standout dishes like the salmon sashimi and seasonal specialty rolls. Service is attentive and efficient, with staff quickly clearing plates and keeping orders accurate. The atmosphere is casual yet comfortable, making it easy to enjoy a relaxed meal whether you come for lunch or dinner. Overall, it’s a great choice for anyone looking for reliable and tasty sushi at a reasonable price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Omer Mamon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Quality remains one of the best. Love the options they constantly refill on the conveyor belt, good for my parents who prefer the traditional way of eating sushi. Instead of having to order from ipad! They have a good 40 baht refillable drink bar. But if you wanna be healthy, you can just go for hot green tea! A lot of sushis are at 40 baht. Love the mini rice option for the nigiri sushi 😂

The staffs are quite helpful. we accidentally spilled water, they came very quickly to help us clean the table 🫶🏽

Awesome experience at Sushiro!
sample_reviews_en.author: Eileen Neo (Sgsohotleh)

sample_reviews_en.text:
A really great value Japanese sushi chain located on the 6th floor at Central World.

You have the choice of ordering from the table app of just taking dishes as they pass your table on the conveyor belt. We ordered our sushi and delivery was super quick!

Food was very tasty as was the presentation. Varied menu with plenty of choice.

The staff were super friendly and helpful, we went around midday and were able to walk straight in but it can get busy in the evenings.

Highly recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: Russell Hancock

sample_reviews_en.text:
Five stars for Sushiro Thailand at CentralWorld. As a tourist, I initially had trouble reserving a table because I couldn't install the app. However, several staff members took the time to help me and find a solution. The service was exceptionally good and memorable.

The sushi was phenomenal for the price. A great selection, delicious, and in my opinion, excellent value for money. I would definitely visit again on my next trip to Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Minh Cao

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don’t know if we were on a bad day or it’s always like that, but the sushi weren’t good at all. I heard from friends that visited different restaurants of sushiro that the sushi there was awesome but I don’t know why we had different experience unfortunately.
The fish felt not good and when you eat and raw fish you expect something fresh and with good look and it wasn’t the case.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yair Meged

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sushiro the famous Japajese sushi conveyor belt, its branch here is on Lv. 7 of CTW.

Super long queue and jammed pack every hour esepcially on weekends. Queue management are quite good though. There's a lounge for customers to wait there too.

Consitent quality, fresh, fair price and good services. Live up to its expecations all around.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donny Boonyamanop

restaurants.name: Luka Cafe
restaurants.address:

64 3 Pan Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: For a bangkok cafe this is priced at the top. But its clientel is almost solely tourists. The staff are fantastic,  the service is what would expect from a luxury resort.  The food is a creative spin on popular American cafe food. I had the fish tacos, they had a mango slaw which worked well.  I would sell one of my children for the burrata.  The staff are incredible, the service was incredible. I would like to see what else the chef can do,  avocado toast is a waste of his or her talents, what they did with the burrata was exceptional. Let the chef design a menu item each week. The staff better be getting the service charge. Thankyou for trying so hard to accomodate my partners allergies.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicholas Peter Kewin

sample_reviews_en.text: We visited for a late breakfast. The exterior gave off a really nice vibe. Both the terrace and the interior were lovely. All the staff were warm and welcoming, and we enjoyed our meal in a comfortable space. We ordered a cheese sandwich, which was quite large, so it was just right for two people to share. They also accept card payments, which is helpful for those of us who prefer cashless payments.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hiroyuki Matsubara

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of the best restaurant in this area and the food is always so fresh and delicious. Every single food from the menu were excellent. I really enjoyed the cuppchino iced which is my favorite and I found out here. The staffs are very friendly and helpful. We definitely come here again. Must try for everyone
sample_reviews_en.author: Mali Restaurant

sample_reviews_en.text: We had breakfast here and I have to say; best shakshuka I've ever had. Service was great, drinks we're great and the food was the best. Relaxed atmosphere with a good look. It was a busy cafe so we we're lucky we could just walk in for a spot. The food looked so good I even forgot to take a picture of it 😊.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angela Witte

sample_reviews_en.text: Personally, I really like salmon, but the person I went with prefers avocado. It's a contrasting combination, but it works well together. The restaurant is fairly busy, with lots of foreigners. They have a lot of cool stuff. I guess I really enjoyed the atmosphere because of the person I went with.💖🙂‍↕️
sample_reviews_en.author: sama muay

sample_reviews_en.text:
Awesome environment to relax in a hot Sunday morning.
The coffee is good, food portion is valued for money and S'more cookies is sinfully tasty (and you can get to do some charity because 25thb from your cookie is …
sample_reviews_en.author: G Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: The interior is spacious, and the terrace seating is surrounded by lush greenery, making it a great place to relax. I also really liked the drinks; they had a unique flavor that I'd never experienced before. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Luv Light

sample_reviews_en.text: Food and drinks are very tasty. The staff here is very concerned by customers experience. They are pretending that meats are halal but just words won't be enough to convince real muslim clients.
sample_reviews_en.author: Taron Eric

restaurants.name: Madam Saranair Thai Food restaurant
restaurants.address:

139/1 Soi Sukhumvit 21 (Asoke Soi 1 sub-district, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had the best Thai food I have ever tasted here. The sea bass, salmon and crispy papaya salad were absolutely phenomenal. Everything was full of flavor and clearly made with so much care and passion.

The staff was incredibly friendly and went out of their way to make my daughter’s birthday extra special, which meant so much to our family. Alon, the owner, was especially kind and welcoming, and you can really tell how much time, effort, and heart goes into the food and the whole experience.

It is also conveniently located next to Big Mamas Pizzeria, which is owned by the same person, and you can order from both menus there. Such a wonderful place — highly recommended! We have tried several Thai restaurants in Bangkok but nothing compares to Madame Saranair. It is hands down the best Thai food in Thailand!
sample_reviews_en.author: Venus Olaes

sample_reviews_en.text:
What a little gem! We first discovered Madame Saranair Thai Food three years ago and stumbled upon it again this week. What a lovely surprise to find Alon, the owner, still there—and even more amazing that he remembered us!

Alon genuinely cares about every guest and looks after his staff as well. His team is warm and attentive. The food is incredible: authentic, fresh, local, spicy, and full of wonderful flavours and textures, with a few surprises along the way. We especially loved the little amuse-bouche drink to start.

Delicious, thoughtful Thai food at a very reasonable price. We’re so happy we found it again! 🌶️🥭🇹🇭

**if you are lucky you will be greeted by another important well looked after staff member who greets you at the entrance. Very sweet 🐈‍⬛❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna DW

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem near Sukhumvit!

Madam Saranair is an amazing find! Tucked away in a quiet neighborhood just a stone’s throw from the hustle and bustle of Bangkok, this restaurant offers a truly authentic Thai dining experience. The dishes are flavorful and perfectly prepared—the vegetables are exquisite, the fried rice and pad Thai are spot-on, and the mango sticky rice is simply outstanding!

The service is warm and attentive, and the European owner is incredibly friendly. He takes the time to check in on every table, making sure everyone is having a great experience, and even helps translate when communication with the staff is tricky. A must-visit spot for delicious food and a welcoming atmosphere! Thank you again for a fantastic experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Aurélie Victoria Simon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Madam Saranair completely
blew me away. This isn't your average commercialized Thai food—it feels like the recipes were
brought straight from remote, traditional villages. You literally cannot find some of these unique
menu items anywhere else. The Green curry had a profound depth of flavor, and their signature
Love Chicken was absolute perfection. Beyond the incredible food, the service is exceptionally
warm, and the vibe is unmatched. The restaurant doubles as an art gallery, and finding out the
owner is the artist behind all the breathtaking artwork on the walls made the evening feel so
special. Easily one of the greatest Thai meals of my life. Pro tip: Book ahead to avoid the heavy
queues at the door!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ad Matt

sample_reviews_en.text:
Finding true, authentic Thai food in the city can
be tough, but Madam Saranair is hands down the absolute best Thai restaurant in Bangkok. We
brought the whole family, and thank goodness we reserved a table because the queue outside
was massive! The inside has an amazing, friendly atmosphere that feels like a gorgeous art
gallery—we were amazed to learn the owner created all the stunning artwork on the walls
himself. The food tasted exactly like my grandmother used to make; these are deep, traditional
flavors you simply cannot find in standard tourist spots. The Massaman curry was incredibly rich
and tender, and the Pomelo salad was so fresh and perfectly balanced. A must-visit for families!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kyaw Khant Thaw

sample_reviews_en.text:
Foodie review: The food is incredibly delicious. I know it looks like a humble café, but trust me, everything was just on point.

Recommend:
Pork neck: the sauce is incredible, it’s the classic thai, lime fish sauce palm sugar BUT they added tamarind and chili!!! I can’t believe how perfect it is
Sticky rice: yes I know this is very basic, staple, but day-to-day great job with it. Perfectly steamed, not sticky on the hands, nutty flavor. Just so good with the pork.

Everything had fresh ingredients, and bold flavor. Like wow, I want to shake hands with the owner and chef of this restaurant. Just so grateful restaurants like this still exist

Will I come back here again? Absolutely yes
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
What a gem a fantastic restaurant manger checks guests are happy at his restaurant
Staff are good very nice ambience here
Now let’s talk about the food
The chicken massaman  curry looked and tastes so good and the Roti was crispy but soft on the inside both cooked to extremely high standard
The Noodles with sea food was amazing and the trick with the chopsticks took it to another levels very cool
Go see for yourself  😎
This place is easily in my top 5 for restaurants in Bangkok
All the food taste great good flavour cooked so well
Cocktails were good also dived straight in and forgot to take picture
I will be back before leaving Bangkok 😎
Also thank you the free shots  a great welcome
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Robinson

sample_reviews_en.text:
My friends and I had been dying to try
this place because every time we pass by, there’s a legendary queue of people waiting outside.
Let me tell you—it is worth every single second of the wait! Madam Saranair serves up the
premier Thai culinary experience in Bangkok. We ordered the famous Pad Thai, which was
insanely tasty and perfectly smoky, along with a classic, fiery Papaya salad that was so crunchy
and refreshing. The atmosphere is electric and incredibly friendly, surrounded by beautiful
custom art. It honestly feels like dining inside a private art exhibition. If you want the real deal,
gather your friends and get here immediately!
sample_reviews_en.author: Aye Min

restaurants.name: Roast @EmQuartier
restaurants.address:

693 ชั้น1, ตึกเฮลิกส์ เอ, Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Friends visiting Thailand,

Don't miss Roast!

It's incredibly delicious and Thai! It's always packed, so you can stroll around the area while you wait.

Highly recommend:
#Tiramisu (They have some alcohol; if you don't drink alcohol, choose something else).
#Sourdough Bread (It's really delicious with butter when it's hot).
#Pizza (I personally love Hawaiian pizza; my family ordered the Margherita, which was also very good). Drinks were great because I've been drinking a lot of bubble tea in Thailand, which is really sweet and bad for your health. Seeing the hot latte was so refreshing and enjoyable! They also had latte art, although the artistry wasn't perfect. Sitting by the window with the trailing green plants was so relaxing. Because it's so popular, everyone talks quite loudly. The staff speaks good English and explains the products in detail.

The lemons are wrapped up, which is very thoughtful; they're not exposed and won't spray everywhere. Taiwanese restaurants should do this too, otherwise the lemons always spray everywhere when squeezed.
sample_reviews_en.author: 花花很愛吃很愛吃花花

sample_reviews_en.text:
Roast is the spot if you are looking for upgraded western cuisine with personal touch. I took the gnocchi dish and it was delicious. The gnocchis were literally melting in my mouth. The fried pan chicken didn’t feel too greasy and it was a good portion. The sauce was creamy without being heavy. The chefs are really doing a good job. And the staff is very attentive.
The main dish looks small but it is very filling. Also ordered a green jus and it was really refreshing. Paid 541 bahts which is reasonable considering the location and quality of food. You also get homemade butter with warm bread as a snack.

Only inconvenient was that I was sitting outside in the alley because they didn’t have space inside and it felt uncomfortable sometimes as random people would be too curious at checking my plate while I was eating. But it was Sunday and peak time so if you want some privacy, better to come early.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sophia Sivakumaran

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited Roast for brunch and was impressed from the moment I arrived. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, perfect for solo diners, business meetings, or gatherings with family and friends. The staff are friendly, smiling, and provide detailed menu recommendations.

The food is of high quality, made with fresh ingredients, and has an easy-to-eat, Western cafe style flavor. The plating is beautiful, and the brunch menu is exceptionally well-executed. The coffee is fragrant and smooth, pairing perfectly with the pastries.

The prices are slightly higher than typical cafes, but considering the quality of the food, atmosphere, and service, it's worth it. If you're walking around EmQuartier and looking for a comfortable place for a special meal or brunch on a weekend, this is definitely a place I'd return to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Smith

sample_reviews_en.text:
Arrived on a weekend around lunch hour. It was busy but we left our number and got a call for our table. Wait was estimated 40mins and to be expected.

Highly recommend sugar snap pea salad. It’s very fresh, well prepped and tasty. Steak frites was just ok. It’s good for what it is — the herb butter was delicious, cooked well but the cut was average. We ordered with wine and it was decent for the price.

Roast is one of my to go places. Their food is consistently good across different branches, and even over the years . Service is always good and attentive. I’m always impressed how they are able to keep the quality and service above average over the years.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cfutly

sample_reviews_en.text:
I enjoy dining at Roast EmQuartier. The restaurant offers several signature dishes that are genuinely delicious, especially its all-day brunch selections, pasta, and desserts. The atmosphere is warm, stylish, and comfortable, making it a great place for both casual meals and catching up with friends. The drinks and coffee are also quite good and pair well with the food.

My only minor criticism is that the prices are on the higher side. However, considering the quality of the food, the pleasant ambiance, and the location in EmQuartier, the overall experience is still very enjoyable.
sample_reviews_en.author: veeraphong jiraphanphong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Roast EmQuartier is one of the best brunch spots in Bangkok and far better than expected. Located in EmQuartier, this popular Bangkok café serves delicious brunch dishes, high-quality coffee, and a vibrant atmosphere.

Huge thanks to Meow, May, Noi, and Bombam for their outstanding customer service and warm hospitality, they truly made the experience memorable.

Highly recommended if you’re searching for the best cafes in Sukhumvit Bangkok with great food, coffee, and vibes.
sample_reviews_en.author: BRUCE ALEO

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices are a bit on the higher side, but the food was quite satisfying. (Two people ordered three dishes and it came out to about 1,300 baht.) We went around lunchtime and were seated right away after a brief wait. It felt packed with people, but it wasn't too noisy, so it was a great place to have brunch while chatting. Above all, I was pleased with the food. This was my second visit, and I think I will be coming back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vicky

sample_reviews_en.text: It opens at 10am, so if you go early you won't have to wait. It's a very popular cafe, and sometimes you can wait for almost an hour during lunchtime. I'm happy that they serve breakfast anytime. I often order the yogurt bowls, pancakes, and pasta, and they're all delicious and popular with kids too. I also recommend their signature frozen espresso latte. The service is polite, and I've never had a bad experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: M Insight

restaurants.name: Lazy Daisy Brunch and Bar
restaurants.address:

Sammitr, 51 Soi Sukhumvit 16, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This cafe is on the lobby floor of Gardina Asok Hotel, and honestly… even the bathroom was super clean.✨

Since it’s Christmas season, the whole place was decorated with a Friends theme: the official Central Perk sign, Monica’s apartment door frame, and photos from the Christmas episodes. I loved it. So much.

Everything was just… pretty. Everywhere you look, pretty.

The tables and chairs looked genuinely comfortable. They also have brunch menus available from 6 AM to 5 PM.

The deep blue coffee cup set with the Christmas decorations in the background?
So cute. Very much my taste. ☕💙

I ordered the avocado & poached egg toast, and the real highlight was the sweet-and-salty balsamic glaze — that was the kick.

•	Cappuccino: 110 THB
•	Avocado & poached egg sourdough toast: 260 THB
•	Service charge: 10%
•	VAT: 7%
💰 Total: 407 THB

Honestly, I wish I’d come earlier.
Such a good cafe. Really glad I stopped by. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: yesran

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went here this morning based on reviews and proximity.  Arrived around 11am and a good amount of patrons so good sign.  I got seat promptly and asked to use phone for their qr menu.  This is where they fail.

I waited ten minutes and no one approached me to ask for my order.  It merely looks like I’m on my phone when ready to order.  There were three servers whom all looked unrushed.

After waiting, I got up and ordered at the counter.  No apologies from staff.

Then I see two other parties who get treated the same, both tried to wave down servers with no luck.  One table looked highly irritated.

I had the eggs Benedict, presentation was great - taste average.  It’s also located in the ground floor of a hotel so nothing special other than a typical modern appearance.  Many young professional Thais eating so I gather popular amongst those living in nearby condos.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kevin Huen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lazy daisy a delightful restaurant.

I was craving an English style breakfast, had a look around, and came across this place and what a little gem.

Went for the full English, and it really hit the spot. A well-balanced portion with quality ingredients, and the omelette was cooked exactly how I asked. They also offer fried or poached options. Paired it with a fresh orange juice and then a cheeky cappuccino to round things off and sort the caffeine craving.

The restaurant itself is spacious and full of natural light, giving it a really nice, easy going morning vibe. The staff were attentive, friendly, and accommodating throughout. I also liked the deco it was funny and a little comical.

WiFi is available too, which is always handy as a tourist.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boeing driver

sample_reviews_en.text: Restaurant was cute, everything else was ok. Unfortunately my salmon was undercooked and they offered to make me another one but kind of ruined my appetite, you can see in the photo me and my friend hardly touched it, still charged for it, c’est la vie🤷‍♂️ what made me mad though was they thought they could convince me it was “medium rare” when it was undercooked and bland. Chocolate milkshake was good though. Service was also lacking. Theres one girl that was nice but the rest of the time, i was fighting to get my get more food or drinks. Shouldn’t be that difficult to get someone’s attention, especially in an empty restaurant. Would not recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ari

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came here as a small group for breakfast after running from the park.
Review is overrated, food is bland even recommend by the staff.

Menu I ordered was chili mushroom caramelized onions sourdough - the sourdough is very thin, and hard - mushroom is dry (maybe because it's fried and even the caramelized onions itself also dry and not compatible with the that fried mushroom. Was regret ordering this.
Staff seems to rush even the restaurant is not even half full.
Only advantage is the place is well decorated and locate inside soi which make it quiet and easy to park.
But wouldn't come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cs Fin

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were guests at the Gardina Asoke Hotel and have eaten here multiple times. The service is very good and I don’t understand the criticism. In every restaurant you have to make a nice gesture with the staff in Thailand. I like that a lot because I can choose the menu without pressure.
The food ist very delicious! We had several different dishes and everything was great. I would recommend the flatbread and the waffle with chicken. We liked the atmosphere and chill ambience.
You get a nice discount if you’re a guest of the hotel. We appreciate that!
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrea Meyer

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is part of the Gardina Asoke Hotel in one of Bangkoks most touristy districts. Obviously it‘s not as cheap as local restaurants in a side street. However, considering how good the food and the atmosphere is, the prices are really good. We ate breakfast and lunch a few times, it was very good at all times. Food is rather western with clear Thai influence. The best was the Beef Cheek Ragu in my opinion. I never ate beef in my life that was this tender.
The staff is very friendly and always a few feet away. We liked it very much!
sample_reviews_en.author: Max Werner Krüger

sample_reviews_en.text:
The price is reasonable. We had 3 dishes, 2 drinks and 1 water. It was less than 1500 b.

But, I expect the place to be chill and calm, turned out it was quite busy and noisy. It was Sunday lunch, and there was a DJ on top of the music that was already loud. Maybe it's just not our type of vibes 🫠

The food was ok. We shared grilled cheese. My hubby's Shakshuka was good, but the bacon in my eggs benedict were terribly sticky rather than crunchy 😐

All in all, it was an ok meal, not that good to return again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Beau Palida

restaurants.name: แซ่บนิรันดร์ - ZAABNIRAN One Bangkok
restaurants.address:

B1 Fl, One Bangkok Entrance 3, 41 Witthayu Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the Classic Tom Yum Noodles for 175 baht including VAT, and the dish was excellent. The balance of flavors was spot on: the chili provided just the right amount of heat, the acidity was bright and refreshing, and the overall seasoning was rich and beautifully balanced.

I’m generally not a big fan of pork and usually try to avoid it, but in this case the flavors of the dish completely overshadowed the meat. The only exception was the fatty pieces of pork belly, which weren’t to my taste and I left aside.

Overall, a delicious, bold and deeply satisfying bowl of Tom Yum noodles, with very good value for the quality and location. Definitely a dish I’d happily order again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eat the world

sample_reviews_en.text: True to its name, it's incredibly spicy, living up to my craving for spicy food. They have "Ba Mee Poh" (a type of noodle dish) which is deliciously spicy with three types of chilies: Karen chili, Jinda chili, and bird's eye chili, paired with mantis shrimp and crispy pork rinds. It's good that they have shrimp wrapped in sugarcane to help balance the spiciness. Unfortunately, they missed out on the bouncy pork jelly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Simarak ก้อย

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten here many times because the food is really delicious.
But today the service was slow and they got the order wrong. However, I want to commend the staff for handling the situation on the spot and managing customer satisfaction very well. They quickly apologized, explained why the service was slow, and even gave me a free plate of dumplings, which was very thoughtful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pijarin Sukkul

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my second time at this restaurant. The atmosphere is great, the decor is beautiful, and the staff are very polite. The food is beautifully presented and looks exactly like the menu pictures. You can specify the spiciness level of each dish. The food arrived quickly, and no extra seasoning was needed; the flavors were delicious and well-balanced. I really liked it! ❤️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Napaporn Jongudomsil

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, every dish tasted great. The staff provided excellent service, were polite, and gave great menu recommendations. I was impressed with both the food and the service. The pork belly with rice was incredibly tender and melted in my mouth – absolutely amazing! The crispy fried egg was refreshing and invigorating. The Thai tea and lemon tea were refreshing.
sample_reviews_en.author: SUPAPAK CHOKUDOM

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! Like, really, really delicious. The dry rice noodles are the best! The offal has no smell at all, it's very well prepared. The flavor is rich and intense. The dim sum is also delicious, the fried vegetable spring rolls are excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Z M

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum noodle soup here is just the right flavor. The rice dishes are also good. The pork is tender and easy to eat, and the soft-boiled egg is perfectly cooked. Overall, it should appeal to most people. The staff are also friendly, …
sample_reviews_en.author: LaGun

sample_reviews_en.text: We went to eat at the mall to escape the heat after walking through the lizard park and ended up at this restaurant. I understand it's a type of food that has its clientele, but Spaniards aren't (or at least we aren't). Everything was …
sample_reviews_en.author: Myriam Costa Garcia

restaurants.name: WHITE DRAGON cafe & bistro
restaurants.address:

202, 204 Yaowarat Rd, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very unpleasant experience.

I came to this place, had a normal meal, and my bill was around 450 baht. Nobody told me in advance that card payments are only accepted from 1000 baht. When I asked to pay by card, their terminal was not working, and instead of helping calmly, the male waiter started speaking to me in a disrespectful and mocking way.

I never refused to pay, but I was put in a very uncomfortable situation in front of other guests, and the staff even started discussing the situation out loud. It felt extremely humiliating and very unprofessional.

In the end, another guest had to pay for me because the staff did not want to help and did not even try to find a solution. They simply made me feel terrible and completely ruined my mood.

After this kind of treatment, I would definitely not come back. I would also think twice before recommending this place to anyone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Victoria

sample_reviews_en.text:
The White Dragon Café & Bistro is a true hidden gem in Bangkok. The moment you step inside, you're struck by the stylish, modern ambiance, which simultaneously creates a relaxed and cozy atmosphere – perfect for escaping the hustle and bustle of the city for a while.

The menu offers a delightful blend of international and Thai dishes, all freshly prepared and perfectly balanced in flavor. The beautifully presented dishes and the high quality of the ingredients are particularly noteworthy. The selection of drinks, especially the coffee specialties, is also outstanding.

The service is friendly and attentive, making you feel instantly at ease. Overall, a fantastic café and bistro, ideal for a relaxed breakfast, lunch, or a cozy evening. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Leon Oelzner

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the ideal place for a breakfast to set you up for the day. The hilarious thing is that an almost identical shop has opened next door — I think it could even be a marketing ploy to get you to choose White Dragon. And even it is, I made the right choice.

The coffee was great quality and they know what they’re talking about — there was the option for a medium or medium dark roast. That shows true coffeemanship.

Onto the food.

The granola was pretty good. I’d have quite liked a bit more yoghurt but it was a solid 4/5. The apples were crunchy, yoghurt nice and cultured and there was a nut butter drizzled on top.

The perfect antidote to a night time of fried rice guzzling.

Choose White Dragon for a brief reprieve from Thai delights.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benjy

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing Gluten free options, they understand celiac and I ate with confidence here.
Good coffee, and the best gf pancakes I have every had as I often still react to gf batter mixes, but I had no issue with their fluffy light pancakes.
They can also replace bread with a very good gf bread for other dishes.
This is a must visit for celiacs in Bangkok, as well as anyone seeking a really solid brunch option with a calm ambience before exploring the buzz of Chinatown.
Ordering is via a qr code from your table where you can select gf in the options and write celiac/gf allergy in the notes.
The staff are also happy to talk to you about any of the dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kris

sample_reviews_en.text:
🌾 Gluten-free safety:
There are several gluten-free options available, Pancakes and bread

🌱 Vegetarian options:
There are several vegetarian and some but less vegan options.

👩‍🍳 Staff knowledge:
The staff is really kind! The place very quiet. The staff know what the gluten is and which products are gluten free!

🍽 What I ordered:
Fresh fruit pancake (169+60 B)
Everything is really home made and with love

💰 Price-quality ratio:
It’s ok. I think portions were very small, although not the Pancakes. I also believe that i eat too much!

🔁 Would I go back?
Yes! I do appreciate that they clearly label their gluten-free options.
sample_reviews_en.author: Antonella Bertocco

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amongst the hustle and bustle of China Town is this calm, clean and good value coffee shop/eatery. They have a great selection of cakes, pastries and multiple home baked cookies together with full meals that have a focus on the healthier side of food (think avocado, scrambled eggs and you'll get the idea).

There's an entire second floor which it seems most people aren't aware of unless they visit the bathroom (also upstairs) so don't think it's full by judging the ground floor occupancy.

Food and drinks were reasonably priced and definitely made a pleasant and welcome break from outside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr Ant

sample_reviews_en.text: We stumbled upon the white dragon a year ago on our vacation. We tried the avocado toast and some coffee drinks. We have been dreaming of this avocado toast for a year now. To say we were so excited to be back to eat here again was an understatement and it did not disappoint. Once again, the food was exceptional! We brought guests this time who also were blown away by the flavors! The French toast is also on another level.  It is some of the best avocado toast that will leave you wanting to come back over and over. The staff is also exceptional and so friendly. This is truly a hidden gem.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nathan Hawk

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything we’ve ordered at White Dragon Cafe and Bistro has been excellent. The 70% chocolate drink, which I specifically requested with no added sugar, was rich and satisfying—definitely better without the sweetness. The salmon avocado toast was flavorful and well-prepared, while the yogurt with fresh fruits offered a delightful, light contrast. For dessert, we enjoyed a creamy cheesecake crème brûlée paired with smooth vanilla ice cream. Throughout our visit, the staff and servers were exceptionally friendly and attentive, contributing to a wonderful dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Jaypee Gonzales

restaurants.name: Jasmin's Café
restaurants.address:

WVPP+V3R, 137 หมู่ที่ 9 Central Pattaya Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
