Based on reviews of others, I decided to try Thai cuisine and arrived at Jasmin's cafe. Order didn't arrive for 40 minutes. On speaking to the waitress, I was told that they just started making it. No prior information was given that there will be substantial delays due to under staffing. Had to give up in the end as I had a movie at SF Cinemas nearby.

While waiting tried coconut icecream with mango. In months of October to February mangoes are not sweet. Maybe it tastes better in other months but for me the taste was average.

Traveler Tip: Good atmosphere here but come when you have one to two hours to spare for dinner. Food looked interesting, wish I could have tried more items.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vikky

sample_reviews_en.text:
An excellent little cafe just a stones throw away from Beach Road, well worth a visit.
It's got lovely Rustic charm, be warned, it gets very popular, both times I had to sit outside under a fan as the air conned interior was so busy. The girls were very attentive, the food was absolutely amazing, I visit Thailand a lot, I love Thai food, and this was some of the best dishes I've had, bear in mind, I'm a tourist, not Gordon Ramsey, so others experiences may differ slightly. The food was served piping hot and even though it was a busy lunchtime service we didn't feel like we were being rushed out the door for the table. Will definitely call in again in November.
sample_reviews_en.author: Terry L

sample_reviews_en.text:
I like this small bistro cafe, which is really a restaurant. I've eaten here on several occasions.
The food is excellent, the menu not too large, thank goodness, which indicates care of the dishes they offer, and it shows in the presentation and eating.
Seating is limited, and it gets very busy, so I suggest arriving early and being prepared to wait for a table.
It will be worth it.
The food is prepped to order, so again this can take some time especially during their busier times.
When you visit Pattaya, I recommend you eat here at least once.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul White

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited Jasmin Cafe here in Thailand and had a wonderful dining experience. We ordered Pad Kra Pao, Tom Yum, Pad Thai, and Thai tea, and everything was well-cooked and full of flavor. The taste was excellent—truly authentic Thai cuisine.
We were warmly assisted by Miss Nora, who helped us choose the best delicacies to order and made us feel very welcome. The hospitality made us feel right at home. Overall, we were very satisfied with both the food and the service, and we’re definitely looking forward to coming back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Angelo Cortez

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a great meal at Jasmin’s Café Pattaya. The food was excellent and the value is hard to beat. It’s a laid-back spot with a nice ambience, perfect for a casual lunch or dinner.

The staff were friendly and welcoming and the menu has a good mix of Thai and Western options. Everything we ordered came out quickly and tasted great.

Must have: The kee mao. Packed with flavour and cooked just right.

Definitely a solid go-to if you’re in the area and want good food without the fuss.
sample_reviews_en.author: Parker Hertz

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a nice lunch with colleagues at this place. Someone must have done some research prior as this place was packed for a Monday lunch.

Food was great, their level of spice for non Thai people is manageable, but if u prefer the other extreme, their Thai spicy was not very noticeable.

Basil pork with fried egg and the curry stew in coconut was da bomb. My colleagues Tom Yum noodle (at normal spice level) was extremely smooth and tasty.

Will return with my wife next time!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicol Loh

sample_reviews_en.text: I went here for the first time for breakfast and it was great. Easy to get to via the bus. The food is a little on the high side but the quality of food was good and the place is very nice with air conditioning. It's a nicer place if you are tired of mall food courts. They have a large variety of food options and I would like to Come back and try the other options. I went with a friend and for the both of us the cost was under 1,000p tbh for big breakfast plus drinks .
sample_reviews_en.author: ill-freaky-na-na

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered tom ka gai and eggplant pork along with coconut pudding and singha. Despite the aromatics and presentation the soup just tasted like salty coconut milk. The eggplant was flavorful but neither dish had any spice whatsoever. Specify spicy if you’re farang apparently. The beer could have been colder. It was my first time with the mango coconut pudding with passion fruit and it was sublime. I also had an iced mocha which made the entire visit worthwhile.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stanley Judd

restaurants.name: Sushi Seki (Central Eastville)
restaurants.address:

2nd floor, Central Eastville, Pradit Manutham Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Rating:  ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
My rating will be based on taste within the similar price range,

Recommended Menu:
Shabu Black Soup
มันปูย่าง
sample_reviews_th.author: The Black

sample_reviews_en.text: the food is delicious, service is good but fighting a few problems:  the AC is loud and not powerful enough especially if neighboring table order grill on the table. everybody starts coughing because of the smoke filling the surrounding area. we had to move because of that from our favorite table which is the most peaceful and not in direct AC airstream. even the restaurant opens 11 or 11:30 the deliveries coming until 1 pm and its disturbing. music even piano classics is way too loud. so if there are no changes - we observed this now multible times - we will be back which is a pity. part of the menu is reasonable priced but offering upscale unami etc. the mood is absolutely not matching the concept. prefer Seki to Maguro normally but not here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hans-Joerg Tangermann

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant itself is alright. But the service and price is crap. I ordered a dish and it took them an hour to make it. Furthermore, it also took them 40 minutes to make a simple salmon roll. I would not recommend this restaurant to people who people who rage easily. The worst restaurant I ever dine at.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rex Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: 🍣✨ The food was incredibly fresh and delicious, every bite was full of flavor. The staff were very polite, attentive, and provided excellent service throughout. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for authentic Japanese dining with a warm and welcoming atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Keaw Proudrawee

sample_reviews_en.text: Fresh, high-quality fish that really stands out. The service was attentive and welcoming. The restaurant is spotless, with a clean and comfortable atmosphere. Definitely a great spot for a quality Japanese dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bie

sample_reviews_en.text: Uni and Chutoro was not available so we did the order the overload menu,big size. The packaging on food was ok however can be improved. Menu was on a pricey side. Soup is refillable.Overall, Food was nice and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pree C.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was magnificent and splendid. Soup was bussing and my rolls were excellent. The atmosphere is amazing, I felt as if I were in Japan once again. Thank you for the amazing experience.

Much love,
Ja Stones
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex Baker

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing sushi and very fresh fish. The presentation is beautiful and the flavors are incredible. Great service and a very comfortable atmosphere. Definitely one of the best sushi places in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adrian Schneider

restaurants.name: KBBQ Sukhumvit
restaurants.address:

เรสซิเดนเซส ชั้น 2 ถ. 12/497 อาคาร 15 สุขุมวิท Soi Sukhumvit 13, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A frank review of mine: KBBQ is the best Korean BBQ restaurant for me in terms of food quality, staff, and atmosphere. The buffet offers a wide variety of dishes such as Bibimbap, Japchae, Tteokbokki, Gimbap, Ramyun, and more. The meat quality is excellent — we always order the pork set. They serve aged pork, which is my favorite.

There are also self-service ice cream and coffee machines available. The staff are very attentive and always quick to change the grill for you. Overall, we are very satisfied with KBBQ and highly recommend everyone to come and try their food.

It’s conveniently located between Sukhumvit Soi 13 and 15, making it easy to visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: artitaya intaratoot

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fantastic Korean BBQ at KBQQ Asok!
KBQQ in Asok is an absolute gem for Korean BBQ lovers. The variety of dishes anre impressive from juicy marinated beef to flavorful pork belly and fresh seafood, everything was delicious and well-prepared. The banchan were plentiful and constantly refilled. What really stood out was the amazing service, the staff were incredibly helpful, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed. For the quality and amount of food you get, the price is very reasonable. Great atmosphere, great food, and even better service. I’ll definitely be back for another feast!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kealyn Brown

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited this Korean BBQ restaurant with friends, and overall it was a good experience. The price is reasonable, and the atmosphere is friendly—perfect for a chill dinner. There’s a huge variety of food to choose from, although some items were unavailable during our visit, probably because we went quite late.

The service was okay, and the ventilator worked to some extent, though the smoke smell still lingered a bit. The entrance was a little complicated to figure out, but the location itself is good and convenient. A nice place to enjoy Korean BBQ with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suphatcha Sriwongruk

sample_reviews_en.text:
We chose the 499 THB Gold Buffet and left absolutely stuffed! There was a great variety of food and everything was regularly replenished.

What impressed us most was the service. The grill plate was replaced very regularly without us even having to ask, which kept everything clean and made grilling much more enjoyable. The staff also refilled the sauces directly at the table, which was very convenient.

The value for money was excellent. Great food, attentive service, and plenty of choice. Definitely recommended if you enjoy Korean BBQ!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwang

sample_reviews_en.text: This was our first time trying Korean BBQ and we were blown away by how interesting it is! We chose the beef option and the meat was delicious! They also serve amazing shrimp. All the side dishes were delicious, I especially liked the cucumber salad. But overall the choice of food is huge for every taste. The staff is very attentive, they always keep an eye on the table. At the end you can have dessert and we just fell in love with this little vanilla fish. Highly recommend visiting this restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna

sample_reviews_en.text:
The korean food offer here is beyond expectation. The aged pork meat is tender, juicy and very delicious!!. All side dishes are freshly prepared and great taste. There are vearity of side dishes to choose from ranging from kimchi soup to fried oba leaves.

The service is excellent. The grills are change regularly. The atmosphere is great with good ventilation.

We will definetely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peb S

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best Korean BBQ spots on Sukhumvit! The meat is fresh, tender, and full of flavor, and every side dish is delicious and authentic. The service is fast and friendly — the staff really know how to make you feel welcome. Clean atmosphere, great ventilation, and amazing value for the quality you get. I will definitely come back again
sample_reviews_en.author: Viraa Prajapati

sample_reviews_en.text: This place was horrible, there’s a reason no one was in there. There’s barely any difference between bronze and silver buffet except for the price and some prawns. Things weren’t restocked, we had to ask several times for things. The meat was fine. The toilets smelt absolutely disgusting. Go anywhere else
sample_reviews_en.author: mark R

restaurants.name: THE SIXTH 6th
restaurants.address:

6 Maharat Rd, Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍽🍲 MUST VISIT Delicious, Tourist-friendly Thai Food

This cozy Thai restaurant may be small, with fewer than eight tables inside, so be prepared for a queue. However, it's absolutely worth the wait! The flavors are perfectly suited for tourists, with a balanced taste that isn’t too sour.  The service also quick and friendly. And the price? So worth it!

Highly recommend their Green Curry—the meat is incredibly tender, and the curry itself is rich, aromatic, and full of flavor. It’s easily one of the best I’ve had! The Pad Thai is also exceptional, with a wonderfully chewy texture that makes every bite enjoyable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Evie L

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food and service were 10 out of 10. I'm celiac and used a translator so the waitresses could help me choose a good dish; they were very attentive. They even offered me a gluten-free option. The staff was very friendly, and the atmosphere was clean and welcoming.
Our meal came to 500 THB (two main courses + water + juice), which was about 13,000 CLP for us. The presentation was also lovely!
The only thing I would mention is the bathroom, which you have to go through the kitchen to use 🤭. It was very clean, though ✨
sample_reviews_en.author: danae polidori

sample_reviews_en.text:
Before I even think about where to eat in Bangkok, The Sixth is always on my list. I’ve been coming here since 2019, and it has become more than just a favorite restaurant—it feels like coming home.

The food has been consistently excellent through the years—authentic, fresh, and full of flavor—and it’s one of the few places that never disappoints. It’s rare to find a restaurant that not only serves amazing food but also makes you feel genuinely cared for.

Thank you to Apel and Mot and all the friendly staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Elli Soriano

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is seriously delicious! 🇹🇭

The food is very authentic, with layered seasonings.

You can tell that every dish was made with care.

Thai cuisine, in particular, is all about the perfect blend of aroma, spiciness, and flavor. After eating, you'll want to say,

"This place is great, I'd definitely come back."

It's not just tourists who eat here; even those who have tried it leave positive reviews.

If you happen to be nearby, add this place to your wishlist! 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Tony Lan

sample_reviews_en.text:
First restaurant in Thailand, recommended by the Lonely Planet guide as usual. Not disappointed. A short wait, it was 3 pm. I can easily imagine it being longer at other times. We tried the Thai dishes, which were all excellent. Green curry, Pad Thai, tom yum soup... in short. The waitresses were very kind, and the prices were very reasonable. A small place, but well worth the detour, near the fabulous Wat Pho!
A gem!!!
Thank you so much
Maxime and family
❤️❤️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Maxime Gignoux

sample_reviews_en.text: Very small place but the food is very good! We had Tom yum with shrimps, although I think it was done very well, it is a personal taste that I didn’t go crazy with it, but we had to try this traditional dish. It was not spicy. Instead green curry was really good with a touch of spicy but really enjoyable! Spring rolls are very good. Service was good, had to wait 20-30 mins.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lucía

sample_reviews_en.text: A very pleasant surprise near Wat Pho. The restaurant is clean, comfortable and has a lovely atmosphere. The staff are warm, friendly and attentive, which made us feel very welcome as soon as we walked in. A great place to sit down, cool off and enjoy a relaxing break after sightseeing. Really happy we found this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: 完美的睡眠

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant only has 5 tables, but it was bustling with customers! The mango sticky rice is so delicious that every table seemed to be ordering it! We also ordered a papaya salad and soup, and they were served quickly, which was very satisfying. The mango smoothie is also highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: yukiki

restaurants.name: KIWAMI Tonkatsu Koseki Premium
restaurants.address:

3rd Floor, Gaysorn Tower building, 127, Ratchadamri Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is definitely my number one tonkatsu restaurant in Thailand! I've eaten here 5-6 times and have been impressed every time. Everyone I've brought or recommended to has loved it.

- The pork is of very high quality, fried to a perfect crispness and tenderness. The shrimp is large, fresh, and firm, and the oysters are delicious too.
- The rice is amazing, perfectly cooked with a glossy sheen that shows it's high-quality.
- The soup is incredibly tasty, with plenty of ingredients and vegetables. I personally love adding rice to the soup for a refreshing taste, and it's refillable.
- The pickled vegetables are delicious and refillable.
- There are two dipping sauces: a sweet tonkatsu sauce and a slightly sour one. I like mixing them together. The sesame dressing is also delicious and helps me eat a lot of cabbage.

The staff provides excellent service. They are lovely, polite, and constantly ask if we need anything refilled, to the point where we feel a little embarrassed. The 10% service charge is well worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: MELEFA

sample_reviews_en.text:
The miso soup was good, containing pork, konjac, shiitake mushrooms, shimeji mushrooms, carrots, daikon radish, and lotus root. It had an umami flavor and wasn't too salty.

The pickled vegetables had a mild salty taste with a cool, pungent aroma, like some kind of spice.

The shrimp was good, plump, and perfectly fried with a thin, crumbly batter.

The pork was chewy and fun to eat. The top was crispy, but the bottom wasn't as crispy and was slightly soggy.
I preferred the chuno dipping sauce (the salty one), but I mixed them together for a variety of flavors. The portion I ordered was only 100g.

The shredded cabbage was thinly sliced, and the sesame dressing was rich, with a salty-sweet flavor.

The hot tea had a fragrant, slightly burnt aroma.

The service was excellent. Anything I asked for was brought within two minutes. As soon as my chopsticks fell, a staff member brought me a new pair without me even asking.
sample_reviews_en.author: TaTeeMan

sample_reviews_en.text:
An Absolute Masterpiece of Tonkatsu!
I had an incredible dining experience at Kiwami Tonkatsu Koseki Premium. Everything we ordered was top-notch. The scallops were incredibly sweet and fresh, and the croquettes had such a smooth, delicate texture. We also tried the Kurobuta, which was excellent.
However, the real star of the show was definitely the Imo Buta (pork raised on Japanese sweet potatoes). From the very first bite, it was mind-blowing—it literally felt like it was melting in my mouth! The flavors were perfectly balanced, and every dish felt thoughtfully prepared.
The atmosphere is cozy and comfortable, not at all cramped. Plus, the service was outstanding—the staff were very attentive. I noticed they have a very reasonably priced Lunch Menu running from now until next month. I’ll definitely be back soon!
sample_reviews_en.author: kero kat

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time trying a restaurant I'd wanted to visit for a while. I ordered the 100g pork loin set. It was almost perfect, the only downside being the dressing on the shredded cabbage was too sweet. I wish there were options with a more tangy dressing, like Japanese soy sauce, to balance the richness of the fried food.
Everything else was great: the fried pork, the soft rice, and both dipping sauces.

The service was excellent, typical Japanese style. The staff were helpful, efficient, and easy to call for service. The atmosphere was quiet and peaceful. I went on a Saturday at 5:30 PM, and it wasn't very crowded, only two tables occupied, but after 6 PM, it got packed.
The price is a bit high, as there's a service charge and VAT added on top of that. I paid almost 500 baht in total.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jidapa Samphunjaroen

sample_reviews_en.text:
(Update July 4, 2026) The food was late (12 minutes wasn't considered late), and I wanted to take it home because I wouldn't have time to eat it. They charged 20 baht for the takeaway container. When they served the cabbage, they dipped their hands into the bowl of raw cabbage before serving it to the customer. / That's it. It's gotten disastrously bad. Is this really a Japanese restaurant? The quality has dropped terribly in the last few years. I used to eat here and loved it. + I can confirm that they charge 20 baht for takeaway. They charge for everything. It's up to the customer's discretion. That's all.
_____________

The atmosphere is good, like eating in Japan (not at all).
sample_reviews_en.author: Knot K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tonkatsu Imobuta (Pork raised on purple sweet potatoes)

Today I ordered the premium neck and premium tenderloin sets.
The meat was incredibly tender. Usually, at other restaurants, the tenderloin is tougher than the sirloin which has more fat, but at KIWAMI, even though the tenderloin has less fat, it's still very tender. I loved it.

The Japanese rice was soft, fragrant, and delicious.

The miso soup was fragrant and sweet, made with bone broth and various vegetables including lotus root, mushrooms, carrots, and konjac.
Usually, miso soup at other restaurants is salty, but this one was so delicious I had to try another bowl.
sample_reviews_en.author: Huala Lullaby

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the Imobuta pork neck set, which was on sale for followers of the restaurant's social media. It was crowded because of the promotion, so there was a bit of a wait for the food. But while waiting, I enjoyed the pickled vegetables immensely – they were chilled, fragrant, and refreshing. The fried pork was served hot, tender, and juicy. The shredded cabbage was quite thin, making it very enjoyable to snack on while waiting. I loved the demi-glace sauce, which was beef stewed with yuzu dressing; it was fragrant and refreshing. The miso soup also had plenty of ingredients. It was a very satisfying and comforting meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teah PM

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the 120g Imobuta pork tenderloin tonkatsu. The meat was incredibly tender and delicious. The Japanese rice was soft, and the shredded cabbage with sesame dressing was excellent. They even provided a bowl of sesame seeds to grind yourself, which added a lovely aroma. The wasabi dipping sauce wasn't too strong or overpowering; the flavor was just right. The Hojichauri hot tea was 40 baht with unlimited refills. I finished with yuzu sherbet ice cream, which was perfect for cutting through the richness. It had crunchy orange peel pieces in it. In short, everything on the menu was delicious! 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: SUKANYA TALABTHONG

restaurants.name: JUMBO Seafood
restaurants.address:

Siam Paragon, 991/1 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've seen this restaurant open for a while but never had the chance to try it. I took the opportunity to eat here during Chinese New Year with my mother.

We wanted to try the dim sum; they had a promotion for 50% off if you ordered 5 baskets or more. The restaurant was very crowded, with many tables wearing red shirts to celebrate Chinese New Year.

The atmosphere was nice and lively, not gloomy at all.

We ordered the dim sum we usually order to compare taste and quality: shrimp dumplings, ha gao, crispy shrimp rice rolls, taro fritters, fried tofu skin, braised crab buns, giant xiao long bao, stir-fried vegetables with shrimp paste and dried shrimp, and salted egg yolk coated fried shrimp.

Everything we ordered was delicious; we liked everything except the braised crab buns – the filling was sweet and we weren't sure what it was.

The price came out to 1000 baht per person, including service charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bla bla

sample_reviews_en.text: Dining at Jumbo was a memorable experience from start to finish. Every dish was prepared exceptionally well, but the seafood was particularly impressive. The chilli crab had a thick, savoury sauce that was incredibly addictive, especially when enjoyed with the mantou. The black pepper crab offered a contrasting flavour profile, with a fragrant and robust taste that made each bite satisfying. The cereal prawns added a pleasant crunch and a hint of sweetness, while the sambal kangkong provided a spicy kick that complemented the richer dishes perfectly. The combination of flavours and quality ingredients made the meal both enjoyable and satisfying, making it easy to understand why Jumbo is such a popular dining destination.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yulianti

sample_reviews_en.text: The food at Jumbo was absolutely fantastic. The chilli crab was definitely the standout dish—the sauce was rich and flavourful, with just the right level of spice, and paired perfectly with the crispy fried mantou. The crab was fresh, succulent, and packed with meat, while the black pepper crab delivered a bold and aromatic peppery flavour that I really enjoyed. I also tried the cereal prawns, which were delightfully crispy, buttery, and slightly sweet. Even the sambal kangkong was bursting with flavour. Overall, the meal felt like a true Singaporean seafood feast and completely lived up to its reputation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re not a fan of the strong, herbal flavors that are common in traditional Thai cuisine, this restaurant is a great choice.
The cereal prawns, fried rice, and crab were absolutely delicious. Everything was fresh and full of flavor.
The location is also wonderful—you can enjoy your meal while overlooking the beautiful Chao Phraya River, which makes the dining experience even more enjoyable.
The staff were friendly, attentive, and always ready to help. I highly recommend this place if you’re looking for great food with a relaxing riverside atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: RIMA BGR

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’m a delivery rider and this was honestly one of the worst pickup experiences I’ve had.

I waited nearly an hour for an order. What’s worse is the complete lack of professionalism from the staff. No updates, no sense of urgency, and not even a simple apology.

If you’re running a “high-end” restaurant, at least have the basics of time management and respect for people who are part of your service chain. Riders are not invisible. We’re the reason your food actually reaches customers.

This kind of service is unacceptable. Fix your operations.
sample_reviews_en.author: SOONTORN CHAIYAPAN (SHUN)

sample_reviews_en.text: The food at Jumbo was honestly amazing. The chilli crab was the highlight for me—the sauce was super flavourful, not too spicy, and went so well with the fried mantou. The crab itself was fresh and meaty, and the black pepper version had this really bold, peppery kick that I loved. I also had the cereal prawns, which were crispy and buttery with just the right amount of sweetness. Even the veggies, like the sambal kangkong, were packed with flavour. Overall, it felt like a proper Singaporean seafood feast—definitely worth the hype.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gabriel

sample_reviews_en.text: This Chinese restaurant, originally from Singapore and famous for its crab dishes, has a branch located on the G floor of Siam Paragon. There's ample seating. Today, I had the lunch buffet, priced at 1,100 baht net per person. The buffet offers a selection of dishes according to the promotion, with unlimited ordering for a comfortable two-hour time limit. There's also a premium dish of your choice (from three options). The food tasted good, using quality ingredients, and was worth the price. The service was also good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Coke Somchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Worst food experience in Bangkok.  Bangkok 'JUMBO' ruined the reputation for Singapore. We had seafood 'chilli crab banquet' for two person with two coconuts juice and blended drinks the bill came to THB $3,992.06. Very disappointed. Out of the whole restaurant only two tables. We should have observed the fish tank. Mostly emptied.
Not sure why other reviews are so good, make us think it must be the changing of the new chef.  Nevermine, we hoped the owner will read this and organise a new chef.
Cheers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex Foo

restaurants.name: Myeong Ga
restaurants.address:

21216 สุขุมวิทพลาซ่า ซอย Suk Chai Alley, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
All the food was delicious, the meat was excellent. We ordered so much I didn't have time to take pictures of everything. Most importantly, the staff were wonderful. The vegetables were clean and fresh.
We had Wan serving us; she was lovely, spoke well, and was very polite. She refilled our drinks without us even having to ask. Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: 16t pj

sample_reviews_en.text:
Another great Korean bbq spot in Korea town.
The food was amazing, but the meat is definitely the highlight — absolutely incredible 😋 So flavorful, tender, and perfectly cooked.
The kimchi jjigae was also delicious — rich, comforting, and full of flavor.
Highly recommend if you’re in Koreatown in Bangkok !
sample_reviews_en.author: Katya Namkaew

sample_reviews_en.text: When I think of Korean food, this is the restaurant that always comes to mind. I've been eating here for a very long time. The food is delicious, the atmosphere is great, and the side dishes are plentiful! The staff are lovely and provide excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yanisa Pinmee

sample_reviews_en.text: This is incredibly delicious Korean food; we have to eat here every time we come back from abroad. My girlfriend loves it too. For authentic Korean food, it has to be Myung-Ga. Everything on the menu is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittiphong Kaewchay

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a Korean restaurant that truly makes you feel happy after eating there. The food is incredibly delicious; you don't even need to fly to Korea! The owner is lovely and very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: สิริสรา วสะวานนท์

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the service is excellent, and the atmosphere is great. I've eaten here many times with friends and family, and the service has always been great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chinnawarin

sample_reviews_en.text: My family and I dine here regularly, and we absolutely love it. The food is always delicious, and we truly appreciate the freshness and high quality of the ingredients.
sample_reviews_en.author: น้ําทิพย์ คําขวาง

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food was extremely delicious! The restaurant provides various side dishes as well~
The service was splendid too! If you order K-BBQ they will help you cook it 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Isabella Chan

restaurants.name: Exotics Pattaya - Cannabis Café & Social Club
restaurants.address:

S Pattaya Rd, Pattaya City, Amphoe Bang Lamung, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Ultimate Chill Spot in Pattaya! 🌴✨**

If you’re looking for the *perfect* place to unwind in Pattaya, look no further! This shop is an absolute gem—super cozy, laid-back, and designed for maximum comfort. From the plush seating to the relaxed ambiance, it’s the ideal spot to kick back, breathe deep, and let the stress melt away.

The staff here are legends—super friendly, approachable, and always down to chat or recommend their favorite strains. They make you feel right at home, whether you’re a newbie or a seasoned connoisseur. And oh, the **weed**? *Chef’s kiss* 🔥—top-shelf quality, fresh, and packed with flavor. Their menu is a dream, offering everything from mellow indica vibes to euphoric sativa highs.

Honestly, this place isn’t just a dispensary—it’s a vibe. Between the welcoming energy, killer product, and unbeatable chill factor, it’s hands-down **the best spot in Pattaya** for a 420-friendly escape. 10/10, no contest. Do yourself a favor and drop in—you’ll never want to leave! 🌟🍃
sample_reviews_en.author: Tomasz Jakubczyk

sample_reviews_en.text:
Exotics Cannabis Cafe is an amazing place to visit if you are looking for a unique and memorable experience. The cafe offers a wide variety of high-quality cannabis products, including flowers, edibles, and concentrates, all of which are sure to satisfy even the most discerning of cannabis enthusiasts.

The atmosphere at Exotics Cannabis Cafe is inviting and welcoming, with friendly and knowledgeable staff ready to help guide you through your cannabis experience. Whether you are a seasoned smoker or new to cannabis, the staff is always happy to answer any questions and offer recommendations to help you find the perfect product.

In addition to their exceptional selection of cannabis products, Exotics Cannabis Cafe also offers a comfortable and stylish space to enjoy them in. The cozy interior design is both chic and modern, making it the perfect place to relax and socialize with friends while enjoying your favorite cannabis products.

Overall, Exotics Cannabis Cafe is an excellent choi ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: บ่าวอีสานพา ROCK IN SWEDEN

sample_reviews_en.text: Exotics Pattaya is a cannabis café with a super cool vibe and an excellent location. If your looking for a spot to smoke some Ganja, here you go! The music is always on point, creating a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere ( even got to watch a football match). The café feels welcoming and comfortable from the moment you walk in (the owner is chill). Customer service is amazing, with staff who truly care about your experience, the waitresses always greet guests with a warm smile and positive energy. My go-to drink here is the Mocha Latte, which is always delicious and perfectly made!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nigel Bradley

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my favorite cannabis shop in Pattaya. I just chilled there daily for a month and enjoyed my sessions indoors with the air con. Owner and staff are super welcoming. They have around 18 strains of flower available at all times and had the flower rotating regularly. Their edibles are on point also. I even saw one dude come and order 20 brownies to take with him because he liked them so much. They have 2 levels so if you come in a group they can accommodate you. I'm definitely going back when I'm in Pattaya, which will be soon haha.
sample_reviews_en.author: Somchai Camilo

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Best Cannabis Dispensary In Pattaya!

This place is so cool, words cannot describe it. Wonderful, friendly and welcoming staff that have the freshest and most high quality bud that will leave you speechless, the variety of strains are amazing. A calm and relaxing ground floor with good vibes and an awesome chilled gaming room upstairs equipped with a PlayStation!

I’m telling you right now, this is the place to be if you want to relax, enjoy a smoke and socialise. Absolutely fantastic. 10/10
sample_reviews_en.author: Zachary Ellis Brown

sample_reviews_en.text: Ventured into the hidden gem of Exotics while exploring Pattaya and stumbled upon their intriguing High Society blend - a delightful concoction that danced on my taste buds with a mix of coffee and chestnut flavors. The unique aroma added an extra layer of excitement to the experience. This charming spot at Pattaya Beach Street is a must-visit for those seeking a distinctive and memorable start to their day. Thank you, Exotics, for the exotic journey!" 🌴🇹🇭❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Sudershan K

sample_reviews_en.text: If you haven’t pulled up to Exotics Pattaya yet, you’re seriously missing out. Vibes? Immaculate. Products? Top tier. Staff? Chill and super friendly. Whether you’re after some fire strains, cool merch, or just a good time — Exotics got you covered. Definitely my go-to spot whenever I’m in Pattaya. 10/10 recommend! 😎🤩💚 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Chitchanok Noopiban

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stopped by this place because of the bright lighting in the store front. Checked out the menu in the front and liked the price options. Went inside and found a great staff with a comfortable laid back environment in addition to good price options.
Will definitely be one of the places I pick up my Bud from going forward.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aerial Penn

restaurants.name: FOWLMOUTH Mahatun Ploenchit
restaurants.address:

872 Phloen Chit Rd, Lumphini, Khet Patumwan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Excellent place for lunch next to Ploen Chit BTS station.

I was impressed with the friendliness and attentiveness of the staff. Food is excellent. Price is steep. I will definitely go back.

I ordered the medium chicken “burger” with curly fries and iced tea. The spiciness was perfect for me. “Burger” and fries cost 270฿, iced tea cost 100฿ plus service fee and tax the total cost was 407฿

The “burger” was excellent—just as I expected. The curly fries were standard, which is good and hard to find in Thailand. The sweet tea was also excellent; not too sweet like most other places.

I recommend this place if you’d like to try the famous Nashville Hot Chicken.
sample_reviews_th.author: Noom

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fowlmouth in Bangkok is a must-visit for anyone who loves fried chicken, especially if you're a fan of chicken tenders. Their tenders are perfectly crispy on the outside while staying juicy and tender on the inside, making them a standout item on the menu. The batter is seasoned just right—crispy without being overly heavy—and pairs wonderfully with their house-made dipping sauces.

But the fried chicken doesn't stop there. Fowlmouth has an impressive variety of fried chicken dishes, each one more delicious than the last. Whether you're into classic Southern-style fried chicken or something with a little more kick, like their spicy variations, there's something for everyone. The crispy exterior combined with juicy meat makes it hard to stop at just one piece. The portions are generous, and the flavors are bold, making this place a go-to for fried chicken lovers in Bangkok.

The atmosphere is casual and comfortable, perfect for a laid-back meal with friends or family. Service is friendly, and the prices are reasonable for the quality of the food. If you're in the area and craving some seriously good fried chicken, Fowlmouth is definitely worth checking out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angeliki Katsifaraki

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wasn't exceptional but wasn't bad either.
For the premium price you pay per dish, I thought it would be exceptional but wasn't.

Had the regular chicken burger and chicken waffles.
Both chicken items were nicely cooked and had good flavour, (we didn't go too spicy, but regretted going mild, as the chicken could’ve been spicier) and it lacked a bit in the sauce department. Would’ve been better with extra sauce on both dishes.

Waffles needed a fresh salsa (a fresh element) to cut through the heaviness of this dish, but the waffles were light and fluffy like your typical Belgium waffle.

Shop space is very small, very few tables to dine at, so expect to wait outside or ask for a take-away during busy periods. Inside ambience suited the menu, fun and vibrant.

Service was friendly and efficient.

Would I be back to try other items? Probably not. Wasn't so blown away that I want to come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Free Spirit

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is hands down my favorite fried chicken in Bangkok.

I was recommended to this place by a friend of mine a few years ago, and ever since I have eaten here on a rather monthly basis.

Everything is seasoned perfectly, and all the textures are on point. The fried chicken remains extremely crispy despite the wet coleslaw on top of it.

My go to, or rather the only thing I let myself order, is the fried hot chicken burger with tater tots or curly fries, a small side of pimento mac n’ cheese, and an arnold palmer which is free refill (lemonade+tea).

This restaurant can be pricey, but as a treat from time to time, it is absolutely worth the price for the high quality you get.
sample_reviews_en.author: Luke Kriengparinyakij

sample_reviews_en.text: So glad Fowlmouth opened up on soi 11. Located in a brand new complex, behind Cali mex, they seriously have the BEST chicken sandwich. The crispiest chicken with pickles, slaw and Mississippi sauce sandwiched between two brioche buns. The curly fries are the best and I love that they have ranch dressing too! You can choose your level of hotness but it can get seriously spicy so be careful! This location also serves beer and spiked Arnold palmers! The Nashville chicken set is always a good idea and don’t skimp on the fried pickles!!! So good!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Megan Leon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Full English menu and American style atmosphere and music. A great place for a westerner looking for place that feels a bit like home. The prices are a bit high but normal for this area of town.

I had the spicy chicken burger (mild) and my partner had the fried chicken wings. We came in around 6pm and it wasn’t too busy. Our food came quick and the flavour met expectations.

The wings were not too spicy, so if that’s what you want make sure you ask!

I would certainly come here again for the chicken.
sample_reviews_en.author: Seph

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pleasant atmosphere that fits into the whole context of the establishment. The Arnold Palmer drink is excellent, which we ordered on the recommendation of the reviews, and we did not make a mistake. A refreshing drink that the friendly staff will refill for you free of charge. 🍹
You can choose how spicy you want your food. If you really don't like spicy buttermilk, it's for you, my husband's mouth was very hot when he had the mild one, and he likes it spicy. We recommend the establishment. 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Barbora Nováčková

sample_reviews_en.text: The place is tiny but comfy, has adequate tables, and no parking space in front of it. Therefore, walking is easier since it takes only 2 minutes away from BTS Phloen Chit. The service is fast and pretty good; the staff is very nice; and the food is delicious. I ordered waffles with hot chicken; the waffles were bland, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, and the chicken was thick and crispy as well. You can choose how spicy the food is; it ranges from basic to dead spicy.
sample_reviews_en.author: 王家英

restaurants.name: Nai Ek Roll Noodle
restaurants.address:

442 ซอย 9, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Dining Experience @ Nai Ek Roll Noodle.
.
The Koay Chup / Rolled Rice Noodles With Pig Offals (THB ฿70) features a base of wide flat thin rice noodles rolled into tubes, in an aromatic soup / broth. The chewy silky rolled rice noodles carry grainy sweet flavour, picking up the punchy savoury peppery spice flavour of the thin and cloudy soup / broth.
.
Garnished with a medley of cleaned pig offals, including crunchy sio bak / roast pork belly with meaty savoury salty flavour, tender minced pork meat balls with meaty savoury salty flavour, chewy pig stomach with meaty savoury flavour, and crisp parsley with vegetal bitter sweet flavour.
.
The Khao Kha Moo / Braised Pork Leg Rice (THB ฿70) has a base of fluffy moist white rice with grainy sweet flavour, heaped with a large portion of tender fall-off-the-bone braised pork leg meat with robust meaty salty savoury herbal flavour, and crisp preserved mustard greens with vegetal sour salty sweet flavour. A liberal dressing of gravy completes this punchy dish.
sample_reviews_th.author: Ivan Teh

sample_reviews_th.text: 2026-09-02 Ordered a small bowl of kway teow and chrysanthemum tea, only ฿90. I originally wanted to order braised fish, but they were sold out 😄 Every time I come here there's a huge queue, but today there was no queue, so I went in immediately to eat 🤣
sample_reviews_th.author: Kuanyun Chen

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited Nai Ek Roll Noodle during lunch, and although the restaurant was busy, the service was surprisingly quick. I ordered the signature Roll Noodle Soup with crispy pork and minced pork, and it definitely lived up to the hype.
The broth was light yet packed with flavor, with a wonderful aroma of white pepper and a naturally sweet taste from the pork bones. The rolled rice noodles were soft and chewy, while the crispy pork was the highlight—perfectly crunchy on the outside, tender and juicy on the inside.
The restaurant has a classic local Chinatown vibe with simple stainless-steel tables and an open kitchen where you can watch the staff prepare each bowl. It's lively, authentic, and gives you a real Bangkok street food experience.
Prices are very reasonable (around 70–100 THB for a bowl), especially considering the quality and generous portions.
If you're visiting Yaowarat, Nai Ek Roll Noodle is definitely worth a stop. Great food, fast service, and an authentic local atmosphere. I'd happily come back to try more dishes from the menu.
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tracy

sample_reviews_en.text:
G'day, Bernie here. If you're chasing the real, bustling energy of Bangkok's Chinatown, Nai Ek Roll Noodle on the Yaowarat strip is an absolute Top 10 must-do in the city.
​This place is steeped in the history of Chinese immigration to Thailand, and they've been crushing it since 1960, mang. It is proper old-school. No air-con here—just the heat of the street, classic stainless steel tables, and lines of people snaking out the door waiting for their fix. The experience itself is exactly what you want from Chinatown.
​I went straight for their signature Roll Noodle soup (Kuay Jab). It's a massive hit of protein loaded with their famous crispy pork belly, tender meats, and that legendary, fiery peppery broth. Pure happiness in a bowl.
​I grabbed a small bowl for 70 Baht, but you know I had to double down with an extra side plate of that elite crispy pork for 100 Baht. Washed it all down with an ice-cold chrysanthemum tea for 20 Baht.
​Massive flavor, unbeatable street-side energy, and an easy win.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bernie

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been coming to this venerable grande dame for a couple of decades and it's been going from strength to strength. Today, it's a tightly run ship with an army of service staff scurrying around taking and fulfilling orders. This place is normally full at peak meal times but service is quick, table turnover happens at a healthy clip and wait times aren't too bad.
The menu is tourist friendly with photos and English wording.
My standard order each time is a small bowl of the roll noodles with a side order of the crispy pork belly. The roll noodles come chock-a-block full of ingredients, all of it complemented by a tasty broth that has a slightly sweet finish to it. I'd caution against adding more pepper to this as there's already plenty and anymore would destroy the balance of the broth. The crispy pork is as advertised, crunchy to the bite and even tastier if you dab it in the sweet black sauce provided. I'll be back as long as I can still travel !
sample_reviews_en.author: D Yew

sample_reviews_en.text:
December 2025: I am a Level 8 contributor (>450 reviews) on Google and regularly review eateries and experiences both in Asia and Melbourne.  I decided to check out this eatery because of its Michelin status. The rolled noodles are similar to the Kway Chap in Singapore.  I ordered a medium portion with pig's entrails (100 Baht). The roast pork was super crispy.  The pig's entrails were well cleaned with no odd smell. However, I  felt that the broth is too peppery. Even the peppery version in Singapore does not have a strong peppery taste. I ordered a small version of vegetables,  mistaking it as pickled mustard. They were bland. I wouldn't recommend it. The chilli sauce has strong overtones of Tabasco sauce.

My dissatisfaction is the atmosphere and hygiene.  It's located next to a busy walkway and the jar containing the chilli sauce is not covered.

It's probably not an eatery which I would be rushing to return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Justin Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: Nai Ek Roll Noodles is Yaowarat boiled down to one dependable bowl. By 1989 it was already running from Soi Yaowarat 9, turning out guay jub with the same hard-working rhythm: queues moving, orders firing, bowls arriving hot and identical. The broth is the signature - clear, pork-led, driven by white pepper so the aroma hits before the spoon does. Rolled rice noodles come thicker and longer than usual, built for chew, holding the soup inside each fold. Then the pork line-up completes the grammar: minced and sliced pork for softness, offal kept clean and focused, and crisp moo krob dropped in for crackle against the pepper warmth. Around it, the menu is Thai-Chinese comfort in side dishes: glossy rib chunks in soy-oyster gravy, and khaa moo palo, trotters braised soy-dark with star anise and cinnamon until skin turns to gel, lifted by preserved greens.
sample_reviews_en.author: Loo Yeo

sample_reviews_en.text:
8/6/26 - 4.5 stars

A Michelin recommended small eatery in Chinatown. Place gets pretty crowded, but, it bustles with good vibes. Service is fairly quick, but, as expected with a cheap eat, don't expect super comfy seating or indoor air con.

Pork rump
Flavour: S+, 8.5/10. It's tasty and juicy with just enough fat. Good all rounder
Texture: S, 8/10. Tender and juicy.
Value: S, 8/10. 100 baht for the plate with rice.

Crispy pork
Flavour: SS, 9/10.
Texture: SS+, 9.5/10. Almost perfect. The meat could have a bit juicier.
Value: A, 7/10. 200 baht for that plate

Roll noodles soup
Soup: SS+, 9.5/10. Peppery and a bit spiced with the good umami. Could have been slightly deeper in flavour but otherwise excellent.
Pork: SS, 9/10
Noodles: SS, 9/10. Bouncy and chewy. Signature dish for a reason
Value: S, 8/10. 100 baht. Best dish for sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ronnyeatsout

restaurants.name: Sarnies Bangkok
restaurants.address:

101, 103 Charoen Krung 44 Alley, Khwaeng Bang Rak, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I found this restaurant on Google and decided to try it. It wasn't worth the price at all. I spent 900 baht and got matcha for 160 baht a cup, coffee for 150 baht a cup, and bottled water for almost 100 baht! Food was 380 baht, but the quality was questionable. What was even more confusing was the almost 100 baht VAT and service charge, and the service was practically nonexistent. The male staff member was dark-skinned, had curly hair, acne, and wore glasses; his service was terrible. He didn't smile and was extremely cold. It wasn't worth the almost 100 baht service charge. I can guarantee I'll only go once. There was no parking either. Inside, there was a group of teenagers talking loudly and annoyingly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tangmo Watermelon

sample_reviews_en.text:
This industrial-style coffee and brunch spot is located in Bangkok's old city. The building is said to be over 150 years old, giving it a very vintage feel. The weathered walls blend seamlessly with the modern industrial style, creating a unique and stylish retro vibe that's quite photogenic.

The Tom Yum chicken sandwich 🥪 looked nice, but it was a bit too salty. I told the staff, but they didn't respond.

In contrast, the "dirty" coffee, another coffee whose name I can't remember, and the brownie cake were pretty good.

There's a 10% service charge on the bill. The total for two people was around 970 baht, which isn't exactly good value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amy大姐姐

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is made with high-quality ingredients, and everything tastes fresh. The atmosphere is really nice and welcoming. The prices are a bit on the higher side, but the quality definitely justifies them.

We did have an issue with our coffee—the macadamia milk seemed spoiled. We mentioned it to the staff, and the waitress immediately made us new coffees with different milk and removed the original ones from our bill. That was a very professional and friendly way to handle the situation. Excellent customer service, and I would definitely recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: M

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had wanted to visit this place because it's such a well-known brunch spot. Unfortunately, the latte was extremely disappointing. The milk foam was full of large bubbles, which is something you would normally expect from a beginner. Is the person making the coffee inexperienced?

When a café charges premium prices, I expect the quality to match. This is something that really needs improvement. The latte itself wasn't to my taste either, but I'm genuinely curious how it would have tasted if the milk had been steamed properly.
sample_reviews_en.author: jeong-ryol gwak

sample_reviews_en.text:
People are right — the prices are outrageously and unjustifiably high. The food was absolutely tasteless. I ordered the shakshuka: a huge amount of sour tomato sauce with two eggs on top, all covered in chickpeas fried to death until they crumbled like ash on my teeth. A horribly spoiled product. I should have thrown all the chickpeas off my plate — this breakfast treat was a total disappointment.

You can make a decent, healthy plate, but the price is way out of line. It’s just ridiculous.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nesme

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered sandwich. No plating-just my sandwich on a plate which looks so dry and unappealing. I didn’t like it. I paired with orange coffee. I didn’t like it either. I thought i ordered wrong. I ordered a cookie, too hard. They didn’t even warm it. It was bad. I ordered latte coz i haven’t had any good food yet, latte also bad. I paid hilariously expensive amount for 4 items and nothing was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nikki

sample_reviews_en.text:
A must-try breakfast spot when you’re in Bangkok. Their breakfast plate is really good simple, comforting, and full of flavor. Their coffee is also surprisingly good and pairs perfectly with the food.
The overall experience is great, making it a perfect place to start your day in Bangkok. Definitely worth stopping by if you’re looking for a good breakfast spot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adya Filly Pramesti

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is worth trying for brunch enthusiasts, mainly for the ambiance and photos. The food is genuinely bad, the coffee is awful, and it's quite expensive – over 100 RMB per person for bread and eggs for two people. It's mostly frequented by foreigners; those who prefer white food might want to try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wang Lu

restaurants.name: Mo-Mo-Paradise One Bangkok
restaurants.address:

ชั้น 5 Rama IV Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to Mo-Mo-Paradise in One Bangkok. The restaurant was very clean and had a calm atmosphere, like a Japanese sukiyaki or shabu-shabu restaurant. The ceiling design and wooden partitions gave it a luxurious feel, making it a space where you could enjoy a leisurely meal.

They had both beef and pork, thinly sliced ​​and easy to eat, and of just the right quality for shabu-shabu and sukiyaki. The vegetables were fresh, and there was a decent variety of ingredients, including meatballs and mushrooms. You can also choose from two types of soup, allowing you to enjoy a change of flavor.

However, we had to wait quite a while. I felt like we were skipped in line, which was a little disappointing. Also, the staff's service wasn't bad, but it wasn't particularly attentive.

The food and the atmosphere of the restaurant are good, so I think the satisfaction level would be higher if it were during a less crowded time.
sample_reviews_en.author: チャッキー

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the third time I've called this restaurant and no one has ever answered. I wanted to ask if there's a long queue so I can come when I'm ready, because I've been here before and couldn't get a table. I was confused, so when I arrived, I showed the staff the phone number I'd called from. It was, and my number showed as a missed call. I wanted to give only one star, but the service was excellent and the food was great. They didn't answer and didn't even try to call back. I told them about it, but I don't know if they can improve on that.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warmwell hostel

sample_reviews_en.text:
Momo is my standard SOP place to go for a lunch each trip.    This is a new branch, waited for 49 queues😅 still must eat since most restaurant in this mall are full.    Waited almost 3 hours.   Things are as usual, meat good eggs fresh.

Service was not good, not because they are busy.   They don’t remember what you ask for.   Got to ask 2 times before they serve.   Waited deserts for so long, and turned out with melted ice cream.    The milky mochi is so hard like rubber.    😂😓 will visit other branches
sample_reviews_en.author: Tham Willie

sample_reviews_en.text: The One BKK branch is on the 5th floor and is a regular store, not a Gold level. If you can't find it, ask for directions to the Harborland zone. The interior is new and clean, and the staff are all friendly and smiling. The manager is well-organized. Staff even got in trouble for forgetting to close the meat display case. The meat is beautifully arranged and of good quality; you can choose whether or not to have fat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narin P. Rattanaroj

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time trying this branch, but it might be the best Momo branch I've ever eaten at. The special Wagyu and other meats were beautifully presented, living up to the restaurant's quality standards. The restaurant replenishes vegetables quickly, and the staff are fast and friendly. The tables and chairs are large with comfortable cushions, and each table has partitions, providing a good sense of privacy.
sample_reviews_en.author: นายป๋อย

sample_reviews_en.text: I was truly impressed by the excellent service at this restaurant, especially from our waitress, Bee. She was attentive, friendly, and made sure everything was perfect throughout our meal. It's rare to find such high-quality service in an all-you-can-eat setting, where things can often feel rushed. Bee’s professionalism and genuine care really stood out and made the whole experience memorable. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dion Rynaldo Pardede

sample_reviews_en.text: I think this is the best Mo-mo Paradise branch that I've tried so far! The staff are very attentive and friendly, especially Mali and 2 other guys. I forgot their name but one was very young, maybe fresh grad? Other little older. I usually eat at Terminal 21 brach but the staff there are not as friendly as here. The food taste fresher too and nicer somehow haha. Recommended for japanese shabu in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: J R

sample_reviews_en.text: If you’re looking for a satisfying shabushabu buffet experience in Bangkok, you’ll be pleased with the consistently nice service and attentive staff found at many of the city’s popular spots. The restaurants are generally clean and welcoming, with staff quick to assist and ensure your table is well taken care of, making the meal feel relaxed and enjoyable whether you visit solo or with a group.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuuki Snow


180/1 Surawong Rd, Si Phraya, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Extremely disappointing Stay here. Had to change rooms twice, once because the smell in one room was horrible and the 2nd time is when I had a flood in my room at 5am.  They then proceeded to move me to a room on a lower floor even though I had paid for an executive floor room.. no correspondence from management after I emailed them twice. This is probably the worst experience I have had in a bangkok hotel. No way is it a 5 star level. The pool area is very cramped and the drink prices are ridiculous. Tried ordering local beer but instead was forced to order Corona at $15usd a bottle, they also include a service charge which is deceiving. The breakfast is not a 5 star hotel breakfast.  Some food which is supposed to hot was cold at best.
I would avoid this hotel at all costs as there are many hotels In the area that are of better value and standard.
Disgraceful.
No compensation or offer of making it up to me.
I will make sure I post this review on every platform as it important people are not ripped off.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrick

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped over in Bangkok, a city I know well, on a layover to Europe for a couple days to break up the flight. I hadn't stayed at the Amara before this trip, but I certainly will be returning in the future. I arrived late, weary from the very early flight out of Brisbane via Singapore and tired from not sleeping for many hours. Tanya, who checked me in, recognised this and made sure I was well taken care of and comfortable while checking in and throughout my time at Amara. It's this kind of service that really made my stay memorable and special and a great commendation to Tanya and all her colleagues for making sure I enjoyed myself while there. If you're considering staying at the Amara in Bangkok, don't hesitate! The rooms are comfortable, the rooftop pool at sunset is magic and the food from the restaurant is excellent. This was a thoroughly enjoyable stay, and I have stayed in so many hotels at this point, it does take something extra for me to be able to think and write this!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mason Womack

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a fantastic stay at Amara Bangkok. The hotel is perfectly located, making it easy to explore the city while still offering a calm and comfortable retreat. The room was modern, clean, and well-designed, with all the amenities needed for a relaxing stay.

The highlight was definitely the food, cocktails, and the rooftop infinity pool, offering stunning views of the Bangkok skyline—perfect for unwinding after a long day. However, the sitting area is fairly small and can get a bit cramped after lunch. The lounge was also fairly small but did not meet my expectations.

The service from the staff was excellent throughout, always professional, friendly, and attentive. We had the opportunity to join the staff for the 15th anniversary celebration of the establishment and it was a lovely experience to mingle with the staff and the management.

Overall, a great balance of comfort, convenience, and value for money. I would highly recommend Amara Bangkok to anyone visiting the city.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shane Emilie

sample_reviews_en.text: I was staying at the hotel for a week. Some minor places for improvement, but overall the experience was nice. The view from the pool and gym is great, the design of the building and rooms are modern and nice. Reggae from concierge team is super attentive and friendly, he's always ready to provide assistance. I would say every hotel needs someone like him to elevate your staying experience. The location is quite good too, a few minutes walk to silom food market, a street of massage shops opposite to hotel VOCO. And it's a 10 minutes grab ride to places like Sanyan MITRTOWN mall and Chulalongkhon food street. Would consider to stay again if the chance occurred. however the room service could be better because toothbrushes and towels were not refilled (the lady is super friendly tho). i also learn that there are complimentary sessions such as yoga and bouquet making workshop (i'm not sure), it's certainly a good add on that elevates your experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lumiere Loussier

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a wonderful stay at the Amara Hotel. Everything was excellent: the room was spacious and comfortable, the breakfast offered a fantastic selection, the rooftop pool was amazing, and every member of the hotel staff we met was kind, welcoming, and professional.

Unfortunately, our experience was spoiled right at the end by one employee at the Starbucks Café (I believe his name was Beth/Bess). I simply wanted to buy a bottle of water, but he refused to come over because he had already closed his register. What disappointed me most was not the refusal itself, but his attitude. He didn’t even look at me, didn’t apologize, and showed absolutely no willingness to help or explain politely.

It’s a shame that such poor customer service from one person contrasted so strongly with the outstanding service provided by everyone else at the hotel.

Apart from this unfortunate incident, we had an excellent stay and would gladly recommend the Amara Hotel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karine Pélissié

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stayed at this hotel for 4 days and overall had a very good experience. The hotel itself is beautiful, very clean, and clearly well maintained. The service was excellent — the staff were extremely attentive, friendly, and professional. Honestly, the service was one of the highlights of our stay.

The pool area is lovely and offers a beautiful view, which makes it a great place to relax. However, the pool opening hours are quite short, and during the main sunny hours it’s not always possible to fully enjoy it, which was a bit disappointing.

The breakfast was okay but not particularly impressive compared to the overall level of the hotel.

Overall, we would rate the hotel 4 out of 5. The cleanliness and outstanding service really stand out, but extending the pool hours and improving the breakfast would make the experience even better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maria Shman

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a great stay. I liked the lounge bar and our room with a big bathroom and a stunning view. The bed was comfy too.
However there was one situation that should be improved especially if it is a five star hotel. Upon my arrival at around 9 am I got checked in but had to wait until 3 pm to access my room. I was asked to fill in a form writing my email address and phone number. When I asked a receptionist Yoe if she could message me when the room is ready she looked at me surprised, shook her head and said check-in is at 3pm which I found quite unpleasant. Later at around 1:30 I approached the desk and was told by a different person that my room was ready. I really wish this had been handled easier.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Bochenek

sample_reviews_en.text:
Giving this 3 stars because this hotel isn’t the 5-star experience it’s advertised as, it’s more of a 3.5 star. It’s a little above average but not the most aesthetic hotel. The room felt a bit dated and the service was just okay. All the towels had holes in them and really worn down.If you’re looking for a true luxury stay, I’d recommend doing more research on other options in the area! Esp for the price we paid.

For context, I’m comparing it to the Valia Hotel, which I stayed at right before this. By comparison, it felt like a standard Marriott or Hilton — nothing wrong with that, it’s just not luxurious. But I will say…The view from the room easily earns five stars!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Marc Corpus

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and the portions are good value for money. It's perfect for families or groups of friends. There's a wide variety of Thai food on the menu, which isn't overly spicy but has a well-balanced flavor.
This branch is located on the 4th floor of Siam Square One, very convenient to get to by BTS.
The seating is comfortable, with plenty of tables and not crowded.
I recommend calling to reserve a table in advance.

Located on 4th floor Siam Sq 1, next to KFC

Rstn looks good, modern, have cosy inside seating. Service is good
