The pad thai was quite blend in seasoning tho the ingredients was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Ee Ting Wong

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was okay and easy to eat. The rice was delicious, and the service was fast. However, the quantity and freshness of the ingredients compared to the price weren't worth it. I ordered crab curry for almost 300 baht, but the crab wasn't very fresh; it was probably frozen.
sample_reviews_en.author: ᅳmmantaa

sample_reviews_en.text: Brilliant Resto-bar in multiple locations across Bangkok. We hit up the one in Siam Square 1 Mall. Firstly, the staff is very friendly and properly trained. The furniture is very thoughtfully laid out and conceptualised, with small nesting …
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumeet Bhobe

sample_reviews_en.text: I have been in Bangkok over 20 years and I can honestly say this is the best food I have ever had combined with amazing service. The menu is exceptional and my favourite dish is the signature penne with salmon. They don’t hold back on the …
sample_reviews_en.author: Andy T. Laird

sample_reviews_en.text: Picked this place from Google’s recommendations while looking for a good local pad thai near my hotel. The restaurant is easy to find, located on the 4th floor of Siam Square One. It offers a good selection of Thai dishes, including rice …
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael K

sample_reviews_en.text: This isn’t really my go-to spot when I’m in Siam but it’s the place I often bring foreign friends or friends who aren’t very familiar with Thai food. If you want standard Thai dishes in a clean setting right in the city center this is a …
sample_reviews_en.author: Chen E.

sample_reviews_en.text: Had a great lunch here. I love the food, tastes good with good presentation. So many options to choose from, it mainly serves local delicacies. Price is also okay. Nice ambience too, very comfy here. Staffs were also very friendly and …
sample_reviews_en.author: Reyner Gunawan

restaurants.name: Onkijung Thailand (온기정) - Central World
restaurants.address:

ชั้น 6 ห้อง B631, ข้างร้านหนังสือ Central World, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Let me introduce you to authentic Korean food at Onkijung. This is another restaurant I can revisit often because they have a wide variety of set meals to choose from.
This time, I ordered the Couple Set Premium & [another set, 1,480 THB]. I enjoyed every dish in the set; it was incredibly filling and worth the price. If you want an authentic Korean experience, this is the place to go.
-BBQ: Fragrant grilled pork served on a hot grill – no need to grill it yourself! Enjoy it with plenty of authentic Korean side dishes.
-BIBIMBAP: Another must-order dish, Korean mixed rice served in a hot stone pot. Packed with ingredients and flavorful in every bite.
-Marinated salmon and shrimp: Juicy and marinated, with a spicy kick.
-Kimchi soup: Hot and flavorful, with tofu and tender pork.
-Cheesy corn: Super delicious!
Onkijung, 6th floor, CentralWorld (next to Kinokuniya bookstore).
Open daily 11:00 AM - 10:00 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: mountain

sample_reviews_en.text:
Celebrate Korean Thanksgiving with a super-value Chuseok promotion! 🎉 Enjoy the ultimate in authentic Korean cuisine at Onkijung. They're now offering a massive 20% discount on all sets!

🐷🍱Pork Galbi Dosirak Set (312 baht) - 20% off from the regular price of 390 baht.
Grilled marinated pork belly rice bowl with shrimp, egg, and grilled pork, served with kimchi soup and side dishes. Guaranteed to be a hit.

🐟🍱Soy Sauce & Spicy Sauce Marinated Salmon Dosirak Set (320 baht) - 20% off from the regular price of 400 baht.
Marinated salmon rice bowl set with seaweed and kimchi soup. Mix and match your favorite styles.

Pay less, but be full! This great deal is a must-visit!

Location: 📍Onkijung, both branches:
CentralWorld, 6th floor (next to Kinokuniya Bookstore)
Central Pinklao, G floor
sample_reviews_en.author: Fooddiarytoday

sample_reviews_en.text:
🌟 Overall: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

🍽️ What I Tried:
🍖 K-BQQ JEONCHAN - for 2 people

😋 Taste: Everything was flavorful and balanced, the salad and side dishes helped to balance the sauce marinated proteins

💖 Vibes & Service: Staff were friendly, the restaurant itself had a cozy vintage ambiance with cute decor like an antique tv 📺

💰1090 baht; The price was pretty reasonable if split between two people. Compared to the quantity and quality of the food.

🏆 Final Verdict: I’d take my friends and family back here again, tbh this is my 3rd time back already haha

✨ Must-Try? ✅ Yes!
sample_reviews_en.author: MUNSOO

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really like this restaurant. They have a variety of delicious set menus to choose from, and each set includes everything you need. This time I ordered the New Couple Set for 980 baht, which includes the Pork Galbi Dosirak Set (Pork Belly BBQ Grill Plate) + Korean Chicken Gangjeong (Size S) + Corn Cheese + 2 free drinks.

The ingredients are high quality. The pork is carefully selected, with a firm texture and just the right amount of marbling. The sauce is delicious and rich.
sample_reviews_en.author: EATADAY

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten at this restaurant twice now. The food comes out quickly, it's not too crowded so you don't have to wait long, and the taste is delicious, authentic Korean food 👍🏻
The service is good.

The kimchi is exactly my style, slightly sour, and the kimchi soup is amazing 😋

And the various pickled items use fresh and clean ingredients; you can tell they're fresh just by eating them. The pickling sauces are also perfectly balanced 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Emma_Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted okay. The pork was a little chewy, but not too much. The battered fried shrimp had tiny shrimp; what looked big was the batter. The rice portion was adequate, but those who like a lot of rice might find it insufficient. The two biggest problems were the warm air conditioning and the very low sofa seating, which made eating extremely difficult and ruined the dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: ChaaimFT

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste wasn't to my liking; the pork wasn't hot and the sauce wasn't to my taste, but that might be a matter of personal preference. The portion size wasn't worth the price. This set, including water and 7% VAT plus 10% service charge, cost over 300 baht. It felt like a bargain. However, the atmosphere was nice and the staff provided good service. They accept credit cards for payment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Princess Mia

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to try the couple set that is honestly enough for 2-3 people. The set includes a good variety of dishes that are sure to please those who’s looking for easy and comforting Korean foods. The quality of the ingredients justifies the price, although not comparable to actual KBBQ specialty restaurants. The bibimbab and the marinated salmon in soy sauce were really enjoyable though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hangry Joobert

restaurants.name: Nara Thai Cuisine Terminal 21 Asoke
restaurants.address:

Rm. 3054-55, Fl.3 Terminal 21, 88 Soi Sukhumvit 19, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I really appreciated the services. At first i saw that there was hair in the curry so I told the staff. After that they offered to bring me new set of food and plus “ขนมครก” as a complimentary snack. The key is not the blame them but to appreciate their actions.
sample_reviews_th.author: Pakaporn Kongmee

sample_reviews_th.text: Honestly, for a decent chain Restaurant, I’m quite disappointed with the quality of food at Nara Thai Cuisine. The fried fish was substandard and everything was so expensive. They even charge ฿45 just for a small bottle of mineral water …
sample_reviews_th.author: Eric Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited Nara Thai Cuisine at Terminal 21 during a trip to Bangkok with my wife.

We ordered several dishes, including the Pu Pad Pong Curry, which was quite good. Even though we ordered enough food to feel full, the dishes were surprisingly easy to keep eating. The vegetables were cleanly cut and fresh, and the sauces had just the right level of intensity that kept us going until the last bite.

In terms of value, it may not be the best compared to small local restaurants outside the mall. If you’re purely comparing taste, you might find similar dishes for a lower price elsewhere. That said, the overall cleanliness and presentation of the food might be part of what you’re paying for.

The atmosphere was neat and comfortable, which fits well with a restaurant inside a mall. However, the service from the staff was a bit disappointing and could have been more attentive.

Overall, a solid place for clean and well-prepared Thai food while visiting Terminal 21.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dave

sample_reviews_en.text:
No reservation is needed for Khao Chae (rice in jasmine-infused water); you can just walk in and the wait isn't long.

There are so many ingredients! It's enough to fill you up completely, no need for another meal. The flavor is quite strong, with a clear balance of salty and sweet.

The rice isn't too hard. As you eat, the water becomes slightly cloudy, and it has a very strong jasmine aroma. The addition of fresh jasmine flowers makes it even more fragrant.

Drinks aren't included in the set; they have to be ordered separately.

I wish the staff could explain the contents of the set a little better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Penny Tayscat

sample_reviews_en.text:
It is located on the 3rd floor of Center 21 shopping mall and features an open kitchen. We ordered four dishes: Green Curry Crab Fried Rice, Som Tum, Grilled Sirloin Sticky Rice Set, and Pad Thai.

The Green Curry was particularly delicious, and the food is presented beautifully and neatly.

I was slightly taken aback when a staff member spilled some cola on the table while pouring it; instead of wiping it up, they simply placed the can on top of the spilled cola and left.

The total bill came to about 1,300 baht, and I am satisfied.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bananafish Kim

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited this place and had a wonderful experience. We ordered the clear tomyam with seafood, omelette with minced pork, minced pork with basil, and a vegetable dish. Everything was delicious and flavourful (we requested little spicy. The balance was just right. The Thai milk tea was also excellent, rich but not overly sweet.

Ambience was warm and pleasant, making it a comfortable place to enjoy a meal. Overall, great food, great flavours, and a cosy atmosphere. Would definitely come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jyn

sample_reviews_en.text:
On a recent trip to Thailand, my spouse and I visited Nara for dinner. We’re both big fans of satay and theirs was delicious.

Neither of us had had pineapple fried rice so we felt like we needed to try it. That ended up being one of our favorites. We were so glad we tried it.

I can’t remember the name of the local dish or the beef dish that we tried. The beef dish was exceptionally good. It’s photographed in the middle picture.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kristen Lezza

sample_reviews_en.text: I come here with several friends. The atmosphere here is cozzy and relaxed. We ordered several signature food, which is astonishing. I really like the superb service provided by the manager, Mr A. He is so friendly and good at recommending good food. The store is also convenient to reach, just out of the BTS station(Asok) and go up directly to the 3rd floor. Will definitely come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: 王淳瑩Chunying Wang

restaurants.name: TenTen ชาบู 4 สี หมีออนเซน
restaurants.address:

388 5th Floor, Siam Square One, Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The beef was incredibly delicious! At 399++ baht, the beef alone was so good I didn't want anything else. It was flavorful, tender, and not tough at all. I believe even elderly people (with normal teeth) could eat it.

The staff attending to our table were very friendly (all the men and women had lovely smiles), served quickly, and diligently cleared plates. The only downside was that they were foreigners, so communication was a little difficult. When choosing the soup, they seemed to forget to mention that one option already had fish soup, so we ended up choosing the other option – a bit of a mix-up!

I tried the uni soup. It wasn't much different from the tonkatsu soup. The uni was crunchy and salty, which was delicious, but I think ordering another soup would have been more worthwhile (uni costs 50 baht per person).

The takoyaki was delicious, not hard, and small – perfect for saving stomach space. The gyoza was also tasty and not greasy. Overall, the fried items were well-fried, typical of what you'd expect, but they weren't hot.

The rice tea was quite bland, so I drank it instead of water because there was no plain water available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nale Elna

sample_reviews_en.text: Seeing the service staff made me want to write a free review! If I were the business owner, I'd be so happy to have such cheerful and hardworking employees. It was quite busy that day, but not a single person was rude; everyone was smiling and trying their best to fulfill orders. I especially commend one slightly overweight woman who calmly managed and followed up on orders for every table without ruining the atmosphere. She's incredibly skilled; I really admire her work. The food was fresh and delicious, although the seaweed wasn't very crispy that day, haha. The Japanese dishes seemed a bit slow to come out because I saw a lot of staff following up; I don't know what the chef was doing, maybe he was too relaxed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Afterained Official

sample_reviews_en.text:
The salmon was good.
The salmon salad and spicy salmon larb were deliciously sour.
The shabu-shabu had a mild flavor, not very rich, but edible. I didn't make a reservation, but they had a bear-shaped soup base, which was really good.
The sushi and seaweed wraps were okay, a bit salty.
Overall, it was good value for money.
I sat under a portable air conditioner fan, so it wasn't hot.
Those sitting by the window had a beautiful view, but it was really hot.
The staff provided good service.
The only downside was that some of the food wasn't included, but they did bring it later, though not quickly; it took a while.
sample_reviews_en.author: W. L.

sample_reviews_en.text: I didn't read the reviews before eating, but I was very impressed! The food was served quickly, the salmon was fresh and thick-cut every time, the french fries, konjac noodles, and meat were all delicious. The mala soup and the clear broth were amazing, and the dipping sauces were great. The quality was excellent, definitely worth it! The restaurant might be a little hot, but overall it was worth it. On a Thursday at 7:30 PM, I waited in line for about 15 minutes. Great! I'll definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: papoy

sample_reviews_en.text: From Monday to Friday, during lunchtime, they have a set lunch promotion, perfect for those who want a light shabu-shabu meal. You can choose your soup base. The staff provides excellent service. For those who like spicy mala soup, I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nipapat Ruangkae

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were friendly and the food was decent, but it was very hot inside. I was sweating while sitting there. The ice cream freezer smelled a bit rotten; someone must have been storing their personal items there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeajeah Y.

sample_reviews_en.text: We don't eat beef, but the pork was excellent, especially the pork belly. We ate the 699 baht set and got a lot of salmon, which was great value. All the salmon dishes were delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: ศุภวรรณ รัศมีเพ็ญ

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious! The salmon pieces were big, fresh, and sweet. All the soups were tasty too. The staff were friendly and provided excellent service. Definitely coming back!
sample_reviews_en.author: MissMeow

restaurants.name: Hops Brewhouse
restaurants.address:

219 Beach Rd, ตำบล หนองปรือ Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Currently, there are 3 car parking spaces on the side, 2 spaces in front of the shop, and no motorcycle parking.
It's very crowded. Instead of opening the back area, they try to direct customers to the upstairs, which is terrible. The bill includes a 10% service charge, but nothing was perfect. I understand the 7% VAT, but the service wasn't exceptional, just average. They even forgot the sauce for my mixed fried food. If someone doesn't know, they won't know. They should prioritize perfection before asking for it. There's a service charge, but they couldn't handle it. It was very crowded, and there weren't enough restrooms. There was no information or recommendations either.
They tried to direct customers to the upstairs area because it's a beer shop.
If an accident happens going up the stairs, will they take responsibility? It's very confusing. There's only music and food, nothing particularly impressive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lotus firstNolo

sample_reviews_en.text:
The beer is good and high-quality, and everything on the menu is delicious. I highly recommend the huge pizza and the German pork knuckle is a must-try (especially with their amazing seafood dipping sauce – I order it every time!). The restaurant is usually quite crowded because it's always packed. The atmosphere is more mature, with more foreigners than Thais. It's suitable for children as it's a smoke-free zone inside.

Parking is limited. I recommend parking at the Royal Mall and walking back a short distance (parking is probably around 30 baht per hour) for a safer and more worry-free experience. 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: เพ็ญรัตน์ ไชยทิยพ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hops Brewhouse in Pattaya is highly recommended for a business lunch or dinner. I went there with clients, and we were all thrilled. According to locals, it's one of the best restaurants in Pattaya – and I can certainly confirm that.

The menu offers a great selection of German and Austrian classics, as well as excellent Thai dishes. The quality of the food is consistently very high; everything is fresh and tastes fantastic.

The beer deserves special mention – a true taste sensation! Add to that the quick and extremely friendly service, which perfectly rounds off the visit.

We'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Wagner

sample_reviews_en.text: Since I first discovered this place about 20 years ago, the quality has remained consistently excellent. It's still as great as ever. The beer is delicious, fragrant, and sweet, and the prices aren't as high as many trendy craft beers. The food is great; the pizza has a thin crust that's not greasy, and the German pork knuckle is served ready to eat. The highlight is the Parma ham, beautifully colored, freshly sliced ​​from the leg, not dark or old, and pairs perfectly with both beer and wine. This is a place I have to visit every time I'm in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: rongritt punumphol

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's delicious, especially the yum spicy seafood,
and the seafood salad and pizza. It's become my regular spot. Parking is a bit difficult, or you can park at Believe It or Not, but there's a parking fee. Don't take leftovers home; they charge 20 baht for the takeout container. The staff are friendly, but there's a 10% service charge. They play old, retro international music, which is nice. Overall, it's good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supassra D

sample_reviews_en.text:
A great place you'll want to come back to.

The beer is delicious—it's clear they craft it with care and taste. The atmosphere is lively: the music adds to the atmosphere without hindering conversation.
The staff is friendly and engaging. Everything flows smoothly and without any waiting.

A great option when you want to relax and enjoy the place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Марина Дубро

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food! Extremely friendly and a live band seems to start at 8pm. I really enjoyed the house brewed lager! Probably going to be a hotspot for me so future visits will be logged! The ceiling is covered in flags but I don’t recognize the 1 I photographed
sample_reviews_en.author: Chazz Zumbro

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm only giving 2 stars because EVERY TIME I come the orchestra doesn't play and they tell me EVERY TIME "not tonight... tomorrow." They treat customers like idiots. So I've decided never to come back with my friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jipi

76th Floor, The Standard, Bangkok Mahanakhon, 114 Naradhiwas Rajanagarindra Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Gaudy decor, extremely overpriced food and small portion sizes."

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was inconsistent, I had the char siu pork which was delicious, my wife had the chicken, the leg part was not well cooked as it didn’t come away from the bone.
My wife feed back was too much spice in the food not true Mexican more a bit of Asian fusion.
The potatoes were nice and earthy again a little under cooked and my feeling was a bit soggy on the outside, I feel they should have been more crispy.

The main issue was the service, it just didn’t match the exceptions for the price you pay. The team were inconsistent, one of the members of staff didn’t have knowledge of the menu, and were very clumsy in laying out the table and clearing away.
The restaurant was very quiet and if it wasn’t for the music the place would have felt very flat.
Being in the business I would be surprised if this place survives.
I guess we were paying for a view and not for wow food.
Drinks were ok, not wow.
I say the team has a lot to bring this up to what it could be.
We also noticed some tables had been reset but they were dirty still on our way out of the restaurant.
Will not be going back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Gareth Jones

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ojo let’s go!

What an inspired choice to celebrate my recent birthday at the much celebrated and Michelin awarded Ojo.

The fun begins with the elevator ride up to the 75th floor, which reminded us of the Empire State experience. Stepping out of the lift the magnificent 360 degree view of Bangkok hits you first, then the stunning interiors of the restaurant. Modern, quirky, refined, and classy are the adjectives that spring to mind.

Then onto the food. The four of us enjoyed the 2 course lunch deal ordering two lamb dishes, ceviche, grilled fish, pork ribs, and a mushroom quesadilla. This was Mexican food, but not as you would expect, the Ojo dishes are modern, clean, beautifully cooked, and presented.

Having enjoyed lamb Barbacoa at the famous South Philly Barbacoa last year, the Mojo version was better in our opinion. Intense flavor and super tender - it was our favorite.

We also loved the attentive service, great music, and relaxed atmosphere - it is a great combination and I’m already looking forward to a return visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Meng Yee

sample_reviews_en.text:
WHAT A LUNCH!
We decided on a last-minute lunch at Ojo and arrived around 13h30, where we were greeted with a very warm welcome by the GM right in front of the elevator. From that moment on, we were transported into the spirit of Ojo.
The food was both interesting and delicious, very tasty, beautifully presented, and perfectly balanced. I highly recommend the guacamole with eggs, ants, and crickets: A MUST TRY!
We ordered many dishes, all perfectly executed, from the calamari ceviche and tomato Caesar salad to the mushroom and truffle tortilla, as well as the pork ribs and duck. Even the desserts were excellent.
The service was spotless, attentive and efficient. Khun Dao took great care of our table. Special thanks to Warisara, the GM, who was exceptionally caring; her recommendations and knowledge of the menu were impressive.
A great wine selection complements the experience, and last but not least, the spectacular view over Bangkok truly completes it.
Thanks to the team for this wonderful lunch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Olivier Limousin

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited in December 2025 for dinner. Unfortunately, we were not allowed to access the sky bar before dinner to enjoy the sunset. The hostess informed us that in-house guests were required to dine indoors first and could only visit the sky bar after dinner, which concluded around 9:00 pm. This felt like an unusual arrangement for in house restaurants guests.

That said, the food was good though less options and the wine selection was good.
Hostess at reception should’ve more welcoming guests.
The service staff were pleasant and attentive. For a fine-dining experience, the table seating could be more comfortable.
Spent almost THB 20,000 for two persons. With a bottle of red.

We will be returning next week on 12–13 January under my name, Joanna. We hope to be able to enjoy the sunset at the sky bar this time and that in-house diners might be granted a bit more flexibility. We look forward to visiting again.

Thanks
Epicurean from Malaysia
sample_reviews_en.author: Joanna Bing

sample_reviews_en.text:
Jaw dropping views from the highest eatery in Thailand, world-quality Mexican & Thai cuisine, and Bangkok's most elite rooftop luxury at Mahanakhon Skywalk!

One of Bagkok's newest Michelin-Guide additions, the Ojo experience exemplifies the utmost upper echelon of Asia's finest restaurant offerings.

Celebrity chef Francisco "Paco" Ruano is known for his famed Alcalde Restaurant in Guadalajara, ranked among the top 50 restaurants *in the world*.

Do yourself a favor and book Ojo for a superb evening of fine dining and penthouse-class experience.

All seating offers stunning views through floor-to-ceiling penthouse glass; and your dinner receipt grants access to the Mahanakhon Skywalk! After dinner, go upstairs and have a drink while taking in the best bird's eye 360° view in Bangkok. Oh and there's a glass floor area for photo ops 📸

(Pictured: Prawn Carpaccio, Whole Fish Pescado)
sample_reviews_en.author: Markus Osterlund

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had such a beautiful and great experience at Ojo Bangkok. We were served initially at the bar by the kindest bartender. Him anx the rest of the bartenders were very attentive and made our Cocktails so quickly. We were then moved to our table for the dinner reservation and it was such a stunning place. We sat next to the windows, the best vantage point ever!

The food was phenomenal! We’ve been eating around all over Bangkok, fancy and non fancy and we can 100% say that the food here has been the best so far. We were blown away particularly by the corn (esquites) and the service we received by Jayle was exceptional. She went above and beyond to make sure all our needs were met and kept checking in and looked after us our entire booking. Jayle was an important addition to our experience and we highly recommend coming go this place because of Jayle! Thanks so much Jayle!
sample_reviews_en.author: Aisha & Adel

sample_reviews_en.text:
Who would’ve thought we’d be having amazing Mexican food in Thailand?! Ojo Bangkok completely exceeded expectations, and Jackie made our experience unforgettable.

Jackie was incredibly welcoming and helpful—walking us through the menu, explaining the dishes with genuine enthusiasm, and making thoughtful recommendations that were spot-on. Truly cared about making sure we had the best experience possible.

What made it even more special was that this was our first night in Thailand and the kickoff to my friend’s birthday trip. Jackie helped turn the night into a full celebration and set the tone for the rest of the trip. From the food to the service to the overall vibe, it was a night we’ll always remember.

Amazing food, great energy, and outstanding service—thank you, Jackie, for making our first night in Thailand one to remember. Highly recommend Ojo Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert S

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried the lunch set, all dishes are very disappointed. The squid is salty. The lamb smell quite strong, ( lamb at Rossini Sheraton asoke, and for season is much better, no smell at all ) Especially the fish, smelly and the skin is quite sticky, I had only one bite and left the dish. I even gave the feedback, they don’t even care, the waitress only apologized ( Alati at Siam Kempinski even investigated) but the chef didn’t come. Normally, when the customer has this kind of feedback, the chef will come to talk. I have tried many Michelin star and guide but here is very disappointed. The food is not good at all. But the view is good. It gonna be my first and last to visit this restaurant. I do not recommend to come here if you expect to have a good food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lady Kathryn

restaurants.address:

1081 Sukhumvit Rd, แขวง วัฒนา Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: In the 1950s, a small corner stall selling egg noodles under another name began the story that would become Bamee Kon Sae Lee. The family recipe travelled through generations and along Sukhumvit to this Thong Lo shophouse by the BTS, where the focus is still one all-in bowl: บะหมี่เกี๊ยวทรงเครื่อง. Springy, house-made egg noodles form a tight, bouncy base, catching the gravy from properly flavourful roast duck laid across the top. Around it, prawn-and-pork wontons stay soft and mild, crispy pork belly brings good fat but only a light crackle, crab slips in more for texture than taste, and Chinese sausage adds a familiar, slightly plasticky accent. It eats as a strong reference bowl rather than a flawless one.
sample_reviews_th.author: Loo Yeo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Review: Bamee Kon Sae Lee Thong Lo

Bamee Kon Sae Lee Thong Lo is a popular noodle shop in the Thong Lo area known for its classic Thai-Chinese style egg noodles. The restaurant is simple and casual, but it attracts both locals and food lovers looking for authentic flavors.

The highlight of the menu is the bamee (egg noodles), which have a firm and springy texture. The noodles are served with well-seasoned roasted pork (moo daeng), crispy pork belly, and sometimes wontons. The broth is light but flavorful, balancing sweetness and savory notes typical of traditional Bangkok noodle shops.

One thing that stands out is the quality of the roasted pork. It is tender, slightly smoky, and pairs perfectly with the chewy noodles. The portion size is satisfying, and you can add condiments like chili flakes, vinegar, and fish sauce to customize the taste.

The restaurant has a local street-food atmosphere—not fancy, but lively and authentic. It is a great place for a quick lunch or late-night comfort food when you are in the Thong Lo neighborhood.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirun Boonpasuk

sample_reviews_en.text:
I actually found this place completely by accident while looking for good noodle spots around Bangkok. As someone who loves noodles, I was constantly searching for local recommendations, and this restaurant happened to be just a short walk from my hotel and incredibly close to Thong Lor BTS Station, making it super convenient to visit.

I came in with absolutely no expectations… and ended up having one of my favorite noodle meals of the trip.

The noodles were fantastic. The texture was spot on, the flavors were well balanced, and everything just came together perfectly. It was one of those meals where nothing felt overdone or lacking.

The funniest part was that I only intended to order one bowl. But halfway through my meal, I somehow found myself ordering a second one without even thinking about it. That’s probably the best compliment I can give!

If you’re a noodle lover like me, this place is definitely worth checking out. Great food, convenient location, and a meal that left me wishing I had room for even more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julius Alexander

sample_reviews_en.text:
We passed by this noodle shop several times during our stay in Bangkok, and no matter whether it was morning or late at night, there was always a queue outside. The display of crispy pork belly alone was enough to tempt us, so we decided to make it our final food stop before leaving the city — and it did not disappoint.

You can build your own bowl and choose exactly what you want. We went for the dry noodles with pork belly, duck, and crab meat, and everything was incredibly flavorful, tender, and perfectly cooked. But the true highlight? The egg noodles. They are unbelievably fresh, springy, and full of flavor — honestly the kind of noodles you could happily eat any time of day. If you go, do yourself a favor and order extra egg noodles!

With amazing meats, great variety, and truly outstanding noodles, this place is absolutely worth the queue. We’d go back in a heartbeat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jana Chris

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shrimp wontons were quite delicious—the skin was thin and nicely done. However, the noodles and soup were fairly average. The crab claws were on the smaller side, and it seemed like they may have been lightly treated (possibly with boric acid) to preserve texture, which unfortunately reduced the natural sweetness of the crab meat.

KH Guide & Rating :-

Accessibility : 4.5/5
Easily spotted along the main road and within walking distance from Thong Lo station, though parking can be challenging.

Cleanliness : 3.5/5

Ambience :
A compact setup across the ground and first floor, with limited seating. Air-conditioned, but space is quite tight.

Food Quality : 3.5/5
Overall average.

Pricing : 3/5
Slightly on the higher side for what’s offered.

Attentiveness : 5/5

Would Visit Again :
Occasionally, mainly for late-night dining as it stays open until midnight.
sample_reviews_en.author: HC_KH%

sample_reviews_en.text:
December 2025: I am a Level 8 contributor (>450 reviews) on Google and regularly review eateries and experiences both in Asia and Melbourne. I saw this eatery on Instagram and decided to check it out.

I ordered the signature noodle dish for 120 Baht. The outstanding items are the crispy pork, roast duck, Chinese sausage and the mushrooms.  The char siew is very bland, unlike the Hong Kong/Singapore version.  The pork and prawn wontans are acceptable,  but I would have liked to bite into pieces of prawns. It is accessible by walking along the bridge, past exit 3, then descending to street level.

Overall, it is acceptable and you can consider visiting if you are in that area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Justin Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The noodles and soup are clean and well-made, and the crispy pork is tasty without being overly fatty.

However, the service is the biggest downside. The staff consistently have an attitude, and even simple questions about the menu are often met with irritation rather than helpfulness. The older owners at the cashier also tend to come across as cold and angry. On one occasion, I only had a large bill and no smaller cash, and the staff seemed annoyed about it and said something under their breath. 🥲🥲

I visited many times because it was close to my home and convenient for breakfast. While the food is decent and reliable, I think the place is a bit overrated.

restaurants.address:

sample_reviews_th.text:
I've driven past this place on the bus before and always seen it crowded. I finally got a chance to try it. The bus stop is very close to the restaurant, but they also have parking available at the back, which is convenient for those who bring their own cars. Alternatively, you can park on the street in front of the restaurant.

Upon arrival, you need to get a queue number (don't forget!), as the restaurant calls out numbers. Rice with curry starts at 40฿ (one type of curry). The restaurant provides a bag of vegetables and shrimp paste chili sauce when you order. You can scan to pay.
Then, you can find a table to eat at. Drinks are served and paid for immediately.

Regarding the taste (personally), I felt it wasn't as spicy as some of the Southern Thai food I've had before. It seems adapted to be more palatable for people from central Thailand. If you're passing by, give it a try! ☺️
sample_reviews_th.author: Pood

sample_reviews_th.text: This restaurant has a wide variety of delicious Southern Thai food. Even the famous restaurants around here can't compare. You need to come early for the grilled pork; 10:00 AM is too late. They give generous portions of rice and curry; two dishes for 50฿. Highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_th.author: Srisit Powtongsook

sample_reviews_th.text: A place for quick and authentic Thai southern styled Nasi Padang meal. Self service, no longer has free flow veggies. ฿50 for 2-menu rice dish.
sample_reviews_th.author: Krittaya

sample_reviews_en.text:
I learned about this restaurant from a certain Thai TV channel. When I had the chance, I came to try it. It was around noon, and the place was packed. People were ordering so haphazardly, I wondered if they were even using a queue system.

As for the food, it was just average. You could get similar food near your house. I was just surprised by what that channel said about it, but the taste was nothing special. You don't need to travel this far for this kind of food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suchon

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes good and is quite cheap; it is truly a working man's meal. Not too spicy. The sweet pork goes well with Khua kling, which is salty and spicy. Stir-fried spicy catfish is full of spices.

But there are tons of people there and the way they order, you have to get the queue from the machine first, then wait for they calling your number IN THAI only. They you order and pay, but no credit card.

The parking is plentiful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanan Suwannabhach

sample_reviews_en.text:
2nd visit- Arrived a few mins before the main lunch crowd arrived. Had the belachan pork stinky beans, Bai liang and stir fried clams. All tasty!

Apparently the owner Khun Pha was a challenger vs Chef Ian Kittichai on Iron Chef Thailand and won! That probably explains the crowds😁

1st visit- Arrived at 10am and plenty of customers, delivery riders but the queue is quite fast. Tasty food at fair value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Crypto Calories

sample_reviews_en.text: 🎉 This is a truly honest rice and curry shop with a huge variety of dishes to choose from. The prices are affordable, and the portions are very generous – you'll be full! If you want vegetables and shrimp paste chili dip, you can ask for them when you order. It's so popular they have a queue system, but the wait isn't too long. I highly recommend this shop! 🙏🎉
sample_reviews_en.author: IDENTITY CONFIDENCE

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Recommend to come here early before 10:30 as it will be very crowded and most of the foods will be running out by then
- Traditional grilled crispy pork is very flavourful and the skin is very crispy

- The food comes in a small portion (and so the price)
- Washroom available
