sample_reviews_en.author: A “Ammbever_” M

sample_reviews_en.text: I know Pastel for few years already,  is one of my favorite places all over Bangkok, and i always make sure that i am spending at least one night there whenever i am visiting Bangkok. However, last time i have observed a bad turn. I used to …
sample_reviews_en.author: Gheorghe LANGA

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely loved this place! ✨ The food was 10/10, the cocktails were 10/10, and the atmosphere was absolutely beautiful. We came for an evening with a dance performance, and the girls danced incredibly beautifully — such a stunning show! …
sample_reviews_en.author: Maria Novikova

sample_reviews_en.text: I had such a wonderful experience at Pastel! The staff were incredibly attentive, friendly, and welcoming. Everyone made sure we were well taken care of, and the service was amazing from beginning to end. I’ll definitely be coming back!
sample_reviews_en.author: jamie geddes

restaurants.name: Tonkatsu AOKI @ Ekkamai Corner
restaurants.address:

Ekkamai Corner 1319 Sukhumvit Rd, พระโขนงเหนือ Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve been going back and forth between Tonkatsu Aoki and Tonkatsu Wako, and I want to share a fair and honest comparison.

At Tonkatsu Aoki, I ordered their signature Kata Set, which was excellent—especially when paired with a bit of pink salt (though the pepper salt had an unpleasant, fishy smell). The rice was soft with a nice fragrance, perfectly cooked. I also ordered a Japanese curry on the side for THB 100, and I’d highly recommend it if you’re a fan of Japanese-style curry—it paired wonderfully with the rice and tonkatsu.

That said, Tonkatsu Wako’s soup really stood out for me. It tasted homemade and comforting—the kind of flavor that stays with you. I still miss it even now.

When it comes to service, Aoki has the edge—it felt more attentive and refined—but that’s not to say Wako’s service was bad. It’s just that Aoki felt a touch more polished. On the other hand, Aoki is noticeably a bit more expensive, so that’s something to keep in mind.

In conclusion, I’d like to return to Tonkatsu Wako soon to try their signature dish again for a fair comparison. But for now, both are excellent in their own ways. Thumbs up to Tonkatsu Aoki—they definitely deserve 5 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arigo Siu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came here based on all the good reviews but now we’re not sure how genuine the good reviews are! We have had alot of katsu all over the world and this was by far the worse. Not sure if it’s just the quality of meat in Thailand as this was the first time we had katsu here, but the pork was tough, had a strong bad porky taste and one out of the two different cuts we ordered was inedible fat. Forgot to take a picture of the fat as we were just so annoyed and frustrated after we complained twice during our meal and showed staff how half of our one cut of meat was inedible and nobody spoke any English to respond. I even used google translate and they just stared at us blankly and didn’t offer anything except to tell us that some of the meat comes fatty. We literally had piled up all the fat that we cut out and it was the size of one full cutlet.

Staff should be able to speak at least SOME English in a high tourist area to at least understand simple things. They didn’t even understand anything we asked or any concerns we had. There was zero customer service.

On top of all that, prices were high.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kym Lim

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a restaurant I would recommend to anyone in Bangkok who wants to eat authentic Japanese tonkatsu.
What I particularly liked was that, instead of just eating it with sauce, you can enjoy the taste of the pork itself with salt. This is a style of eating that is characteristic of Tonkatsu Aoki, and I think it makes you appreciate the sweetness of the fat and the umami of the meat more. It's also nice that you can enjoy it by changing the way you eat it, with sauce and salt.
The balance between the batter and the pork is also good, and you get the satisfaction of eating at a tonkatsu specialty restaurant in Japan. While other tonkatsu restaurants also offer refills of cabbage, I felt that Aoki's distinguishing feature is how to make the pork itself taste delicious.
There are many Japanese restaurants in Bangkok, but if you're going out for tonkatsu, this is one you should consider.
I would recommend it not only to Japanese people, but also to anyone who wants to try authentic Japanese-style tonkatsu. I would like to visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ren

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 1000/10

* 🐷 The curry was incredibly fragrant, and the pork was served slightly pink.
* 🐟🦐 The fish and shrimp were delicious, especially the Kinmedai fish – sweet, tender, fresh, and perfectly fried.
* 🥣 The miso soup was incredibly fragrant and delicious; I've never found a restaurant that makes it this good.
* 🧂 There were three types of salt to choose from (white, pink, and black), adding depth to the flavor. Trying them together created different taste experiences.
* 🏮 The restaurant was clean, the atmosphere was great, and it was a very pleasant place to sit.
* 💰 Approximately 1,200 baht for two people, which is excellent value considering the quality of the food.
* 🙂 The staff service was okay, but their expressions were a little too neutral.

In summary: If you're a tonkatsu lover, this is a restaurant you absolutely must try at least once. For me, it's a 1000/10 – the best tonkatsu I've ever had. The ingredients, the frying quality, and the miso soup were all impressive. Worth every penny! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Ming Nithiworanan

sample_reviews_en.text:
A good attempt, but just slightly off.

Ambience : comfortable booth and bar seating. Bright and clean.

Food : Very good try to deliver the Japanese Pork Tonkatsu dish. However,
- I ordered pork loin, some pieces were quite fatty (relative to my personal preference).
- Not evenly fried, two pieces were still a bit pink, another two pieces a bit dry.
- The miso soup was oily, as they added fatty pork pieces to the recipe.
- The Tonkatsu sauce was a bit sour and slightly thin/runny (relative to my personal preference).

Price : The dish was THB630, but after tax and 10% service charge, the bill came to THB741. They did give 200g pork loin and was a pretty filling dish, but I could not help to think for THB741 there could be many alternatives. As I have a relatively smaller appetite, hence in this case, I am leaning a bit low on the price-performance.

Service : Normally good.

Will I return ? Probably not, a good place but nothing too memorable, likely looking for other new experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lewis Lau

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is Tonkatsu Aoki.

Enjoy the taste of Japan's famous Tonkatsu Aoki in Bangkok! Located in Ekkamai Corner, a commercial facility directly connected to BTS Ekkamai Station, it's easily accessible even on rainy days. The signature pork loin cutlet has a crispy coating on the outside and is surprisingly juicy and tender on the inside, with the sweetness of the fat spreading throughout your mouth with every bite. We recommend starting by savoring the meat's original flavor directly with one of the several types of carefully selected rock salt. Furthermore, the exquisite rice cooked in a pot, which is perfectly glossy, and the hearty pork miso soup packed with flavor are so delicious you won't be able to stop eating. The restaurant is clean and inviting, making it a highly satisfying place to enjoy authentic Japanese flavors whether you're dining alone or with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: パパちゃん

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered the 300g Kata Set for sharing (two). The pork katsu itself was quite good — crispy on the outside and tender inside. However, there are a few areas for improvement.

The cabbage was not fresh and didn’t taste as good as in other katsu restaurants. For a 300g meat portion, the rice serving was too little — it would be better not to be stingy with the rice portion.

Service-wise, the staff could be more attentive. It would be nice if they asked customers whether they’d like a cabbage refill, said thank you when customers leave, and welcomed guests with a smile instead of looking tired or uninterested. Small touches like these make a big difference.

Overall, the pork was enjoyable, but the service and side quality could definitely improve.
sample_reviews_en.author: John M

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here for dinner — the food took a bit of time to arrive, but it was worth the wait. We sat on the second floor and the atmosphere was really nice.

When the food came, I was impressed by the creativity of the dishes.
The tonkatsu with juiciness level 7 totally hit the spot! It was perfectly delicious even without salt, but when I tried a bit with black salt, it tasted even better.

The other tonkatsu (juiciness level 5) was also good. The tonkatsu sauce was rich and flavorful.
The sesame dressing had a unique and tasty flavor, and the “Uma” salad dressing was tangy and delicious too.

The only thing I didn’t like much was that the soup felt a bit too oily.
sample_reviews_en.author: Summer Nova

restaurants.name: Baan Somtum Sathorn
restaurants.address:

9, 1 Thanon Si Wiang, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited with an adult who rarely eats meat because they are sensitive to the smell, a middle schooler who still has a resistance to Thai flavors, and a college student who loves fish sauce.

Although the fried sea bass was highly recommended in the reviews, we ordered the dishes we preferred over fish first.

We ordered grilled pork neck and the new menu item, fried pork neck, and the grilled pork neck was the winner! It was tender, perfectly seasoned, and savory, so we ordered another one.

The shrimp fried rice was spicy and salty with the fish sauce on top, so it was gone in no time. It was my first time trying Som Tum, so I ordered the most basic Thai Som Tum; it was crunchy and the crushed peanuts inside were delicious.

The grilled chicken wings were also savory and tasty, pairing perfectly with beer.

The staff served our drinks kindly, the restrooms were clean, and the restaurant was cool and tidy.
sample_reviews_en.author: 뿌뿌릴리

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ingredients are incredibly fresh; you can taste it instantly even when they're pan-fried or deep-fried. The ambiance is also great, suitable for large groups.

However, I have a few points to make for your consideration. First, their signature sea bass is completely unseasoned, relying entirely on the provided sauce. Frankly, if you don't appreciate Thai seasonings and sauces, you'll only taste the raw, often bland, flavor of the food. This is not ideal for those who prefer stronger flavors. The pork neck is slightly sweet, not the caramelized flavor you might expect, and still lacks saltiness. The fried rice is excellent, no complaints.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gavin Wong

sample_reviews_en.text: Baan Somtum Sathorn, located 300 meters from Surasak-Sathorn Intersection on Si Wiang Road connecting Surasak Road and Pramuan Road in Silom-Sathorn area, was  one of the Michelin Awarded Baan Somtum restaurants which served quality northeastern Thai dishes. It amazingly could maintain and serve its dishes in the very same quantity, hygiene and tastes as those in other sister branches. All of its dishes had the completely perfect tastes of northeastern Thai foods: sour, sweet, bland and salty. Its highly recommended dishes were Spicy Rib-Eye Beef Salad and Luang Prabang Somtum.
sample_reviews_en.author: Itt Pamarapa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Choosing this restaurant was absolutely the right decision.
The service was excellent, and above all, every dish we ordered was delicious.
The som tam was fantastic, of course, but the yam woon sen, apple salad, Isaan sausage, and khao moo yang were all incredibly tasty!
We were a group of three, and the price was very reasonable; we were extremely satisfied.
There were also many women who seemed to be office workers from nearby companies.
We will definitely come again next time. Thank you for the delicious meal! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: shigeo yamamoto

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really like this somtum place. It's clean, the food tastes great, and the prices are good. I come here often—it's become one of my go‑to spots. Highly recommended.

I like this restaurant very much because it is clean and tastes good. The price is okay, but I don't think anything. I recommend this restaurant.

おしおしにおのソムタム屋さんですししししさしささしさししさしさしさしさしにさしにしてさしにさん.

I really like this 青木瓜沙拉店，the store is very clean, the taste is good, and the price is also reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: December19

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing food and even more amazing service! I accidentally left my bag here after dinner and didn’t realize it until the next morning. When I called, the staff had safely kept it for me.

Thank you so much for your honesty and kindness!

I’ve been here several times, and the food is always excellent with authentic Esaan flavors.

Highly recommend Baan Somtum for both the delicious food and outstanding service.

I’ll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: CK

sample_reviews_en.text:
Always my favorite restaurant. Wide selection of food with local flavors. The taste is consistent every time I go.

I always recommend this place to my foreign colleagues so that they could try something new other than just green or red curry, fried rice, tom yam and other typical-to-foreigner Thai food.

Credit card is accepted.
Could be pretty busy in evening on weekday.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oil Chou

sample_reviews_en.text:
📍Sathorn

🍽 The flavors are bold and the menu is diverse. Even when ordered non-spicy, the taste is still amazing. I especially liked the beef salad (fragrant with herbs). It's busy and there's parking available. However, some dishes take too long to prepare, such as the fried rice, and the wait for the bill was very long. Improving these aspects would make it perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: m.

restaurants.name: Kangpa Sriyan Restaurant
restaurants.address:

954 2 Thanon Nakhon Chaisi Rd, Thanon Nakhon Chai Si, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious! The food tastes like authentic central Thai cuisine, reminiscent of the riverside restaurants I used to frequent as a child.
Wild Boar Curry: The curry paste was flavorful. Some restaurants I've tried make it milder, more like a broth-like curry, but this one was more of a main dish. Delicious in its own way.
Choo Chee Snakehead Fish Belly: Highly recommended! The snakehead fish belly was fresh and odorless. The choo chee sauce was mild; those who prefer strong flavors might not like it, but personally, I think a good choo chee should have all the flavors present, like this restaurant's.
Fried Catfish Skin: This dish was a bit of a skepticism...because it reminded me of my childhood when my relatives used to make fried catfish for me. As a child, I loved the fried catfish skin...it might not be to everyone's taste.
Stir-fried Catfish with Ginger and Chili: Delicious! They used more catfish meat than many other restaurants.
Coconut Ice Cream: You have to save room for the ice cream! Their mixed coconut ice cream uses sago instead of cendol.
They also have durian ice cream, but I didn't try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: LS P

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. The name "Gaeng Pa" (Jungle Curry) doesn't just mean jungle curry, but it's a Bangkok-style food place.
2. This is a restaurant where I conquered the spiciness challenge.
The spiciness doesn't come from chilies, but from the curry paste. They have a variety of jungle curry dishes,
that gradually increase in spiciness.
3. The crab rolls are full of crab meat, not just chunks of crab. It's worth it.
4. The scrambled eggs with shrimp and curry powder, eaten wrapped in lettuce,
I haven't had anything like this in a long time.
5. The food comes out very quickly. Ordering is fast, and they constantly refill the dishes.
6. The prices are around 100+ baht per dish, not too high, not too low.
7. The restaurant is clean, but avoid sitting by the window during the day – it's hot!
8. They offer takeout and have lots of food stalls in front of the shop.
9. Parking is difficult. You might have to park at Ekason Sriyan and walk back.
10. Worth trying at least once.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ton Sunsern

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time trying this place. I saw over 2,000 reviews with a 4.4 rating, and at first I was indifferent. But after trying it, it lived up to the reviews!
So delicious, I give it a thumbs up!
🌿The "Three Smells" stir-fry is the best, I'll definitely order it again. The flavor is perfectly balanced.
💕The stir-fried Gnetum leaves with egg is also a must-try.
⭐️The garlic prawns and the stir-fried prawns with coconut shoots are equally delicious. The portions are large, and the prawns are very fresh.
🌿The jungle curry was also good, just the right amount of spiciness, not too spicy.
The only thing I wouldn't order again is the shrimp paste dip; it wasn't rich enough and was too sweet.
🚗Parking is available along the roadside, but it's a bit difficult to find a spot.
💸As for the price, it's excellent value. The whole meal cost less than 1000 baht! 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Fuiily

sample_reviews_en.text:
An old, family-run restaurant, well worth a visit. The restaurant has a simple, traditional style. The food is delicious, well-balanced, and not overly spicy. The prices are very reasonable and the portions are generous – be careful when ordering!

The spicy fish curry is a must-try, living up to the restaurant's name. It's not too spicy, easy to drink, and incredibly fragrant with herbs.

The fish cakes are wonderfully chewy.

The stir-fried squid is a must-try; the squid is incredibly tender and fragrant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pat

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old restaurant I've been eating at since I started my first job, almost twenty years ago. The prices aren't exorbitant, and the portions are reasonable compared to the newer restaurants opening these days. We ordered three dishes, enough for two people, and had leftovers to take home. The food has a moderate flavor, not too strong, making it easy to eat continuously. There's an air-conditioned room on the second floor. I deducted points because there were several large flies the day I visited.
sample_reviews_en.author: LT

sample_reviews_en.text:
Recommended dishes... Hmm, I have to say everything is delicious!
-Spicy Stir-fried Snails (prepared meticulously, no sand in the snails) -Jungle Curry with Beef -Spicy Stir-fried Beef with Coconut Shoots (very flavorful) -Fish Cakes (chewy and rich in flavor)

Don't get full yet! Save room for the Durian Ice Cream with Sticky Rice.
Coconut Ice Cream with Sticky Rice
Also very delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: SSaeng

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves very spicy food and has over a hundred menu items. Their signature dish is jungle curry, and you can choose your spice level; even the mild version will make you sweat. The flavor is excellent. The crispy catfish with chili and ginger was also good, but the catfish was too tough, making it difficult for elderly people to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: S M

sample_reviews_en.text: Gaeng Pa Si Yaan is the name of the restaurant. They offer a variety of dishes from different regions of Thailand. Importantly, the prices are affordable and the portions are generous. The taste is excellent; I highly recommend it. If you're looking for a restaurant, come here!
sample_reviews_en.author: พักร้อน ออนทริป

restaurants.name: Somsak Pu-ob
restaurants.address:

234 Lat Ya Rd, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
It wasn't what I expected?!?!
It was tasty, but not amazing. Not mind-blowing. Just okay. 💔

I arrived at 7:30 PM and only the glass noodle casserole was left. No big deal, I'm a shrimp lover anyway, so I ordered it!!
3 shrimp for 350฿. That's pretty expensive (and you have to peel them yourself!).
Adding extra glass noodles costs an additional 20฿, but the quantity is almost the same. You can't even tell it's been added.
The shrimp was fresh, but the noodles weren't soft and chewy at all. The seafood dipping sauce was a disappointment for me. Not spicy, lacking the aroma of garlic, lime, and coriander root. 😢 It tasted like it was made for tourists. It lacked the zesty flavor of typical seafood restaurants.

Service: Good. They greeted us, asked if we needed anything, and recommended dishes at the front of the restaurant. There are also staff on the second floor to take care of you, so you don't have to worry about being neglected.
Location: Air-conditioned, roadside, 2 floors.
Parking: None. You have to find parking on Lad Ya Road.
sample_reviews_th.author: Night Sjjr

sample_reviews_th.text:
Street-food legend for claypot crab or prawn with glass noodles. The noodles absorb rich crab sweetness, and locals queue for this dish.
💰 Typical price: ~฿600 for a claypot crab + noodles (based on local reviews).
📌 Best for: seafood lovers, especially crab with glass noodles
sample_reviews_th.author: Anant Prakash

sample_reviews_en.text:
Arguably one of the best baked prawn and crab vermicelli (Goong Ob Woon Sen) dishes you’ll find in Bangkok—or perhaps all of Thailand. Served piping hot in a rustic metal pot, the dish features giant tiger prawns that are incredibly fresh and succulent, layered atop perfectly cooked glass noodles that have soaked up the rich, savory broth beneath.

What truly sets this dish apart is the signature sauce—a deeply aromatic blend of soy, sesame oil, white pepper, garlic, and herbs that infuses the noodles with complexity and umami-laden richness. Each bite delivers a balance of seafood sweetness, herbal fragrance, and wok-fired depth.

The experience doesn’t stop there—steamed blood clams and green mussels are also available and well worth trying for those craving variety in their seafood spread.

Though presentation is humble, the flavor is anything but.
Highly recommended for seafood lovers seeking bold, authentic flavors done exceptionally well.
sample_reviews_en.author: TP TP

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was the first restaurant I told my partner we HAD to go in Thailand, but I was so worried that it would be overhyped as it was recommended by six separate people. I am SO happy this place lived up to the hype 🥲

We got there at 4 PM on a weekday and literally got welcomed and sat right away. Was worried about a long line but managed to avoid it!

The crab is really fresh and is really the first crab I’ve had that I can remember that doesn’t become fishy when the temperature cools down. The tiger prawns are insanely plump. The vermicelli doesn’t become a clump or soggy with the sauce. The sauce at the bottom of the pot though, really is the star and brought everything together. The sound of the sizzling plate when it is served will be in my dream for the rest of my life.

The only thing to remember/ note is that it’s a bit more expensive and cash only- we burned through a big chunk of our cash for the day (absolutely no regrets)!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lou Lou

sample_reviews_en.text:
Heard i
O
of this name many years  ago but no opportunities to try the food.  Also there also comment  that the have  closed and move from Charoen Rat Rd to Lat Ya Rd. ( NOT TRUE)
Some said that they have open a branch ( need to verify with the owner :) )

Yesterday we make it happen. I use  Grab and was set to CHAROEN RAT RD, when we arrived , 1st persons  I sae was the same person featured  in some of FB Post.

We quickly sit down on chair and tanke setup along the shop corridor.

The staff came and greeted us and informed  us waiting time is 1 hour. We ordered Glass Noodles  with crab, glass noodles  with crab roe and glass noodles  with prawn.

The food was serve after  55 minutes.

The glass noodle was cooekd ro perfection with lots of spring onions and peppercorn.

Even though the crab size is on the smaller size but it is fresh  and full of roe.

Definitely will be back again
sample_reviews_en.author: Simon Yong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Incredibly scrumptious and mouthwatering claypot crab vermicelli, this has to be hands down the best ob woonsen I've had. The roe crab was extraordinarily fresh and sweet, with the roe imparting its rich and savory umami flavor to the dish. The vermicelli itself has absorbed all the essence and sweetness of the crustacean and tastes even more delicious than the already amazing crabs. The mussels were kind of ordinary but you can't complain with the price. Ambience is that of a small unassuming eatery and is rather cramped.

Reservations are a must and you will need to reserve your crabs at the same time, we did regret not ordering the large roe crab earlier so we ended up only with the regular sized crabs. Prices are reasonable for the quality and this is one eatery i will definitely be returning to when I'm next heading to Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julius Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The grass noodles with the seafood and their special sauce, excellent. Eating the grass noodles is already worth the effort of travelling there

I am not a seafood person, but my wife is, so I am very happy just to have the grass noodles l, the most tasty grass noodles that I ever had.

My wife commented that crab is nice and tasty. I have to take her word on it.

Suggestions for new visitors....
Take the L portion, why? That is because you will get the big Thai  crab instead of my wife just having the small one. The big crab is more expansive, for sure, bit if u are a crab love, worth every cent of it. I only see the live crabs after we finished and the showed us the difference. Or u can check on the size of the crab before u order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Esmond Kwa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Baked Crab with Vermicelli (The Star Dish)
• Vermicelli noodles are chewy and not soggy.
• The aroma of pepper and spices is fragrant from the moment it's served.
• The sauce is well-absorbed into the noodles, not just poured on top.
• The crab is fresh and sweet (but…a little difficult to crack open 😅).

Baked Shrimp with Vermicelli
• Large, fresh, and bouncy shrimp.
• Many say it's "tastier than the crab" because it's easier to eat.

Seafood Dipping Sauce
• Simple in appearance, but with a strong, tangy and spicy flavor.
• When eaten together, it elevates the taste to another level.

Many reviews even say it's "the best vermicelli noodles this restaurant makes."
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Smith

restaurants.name: Ibrahim Restaurant
restaurants.address:

8/9 Shukmvit Sol 3/1, Nana Nua - Witthayu Bridge, Kwang Khlongtoey Nua, Watthana, Bangkok, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honestly, really impressed with Ibrahim Restaurant! ❤️

We were craving proper Pakistani desi food in Bangkok and this place did not disappoint. We ordered Chicken Karhai, Paneer Pasanda, Cheese Samosas and Chai, everything was absolutely on point. The taste was authentic, the food was fresh, and the portion sizes were really good too.

And the chai was next level! 🔥☕ Proper Pakistani chai, exactly what we were looking for.

It’s not easy to find this kind of authentic desi taste outside Pakistan, so I’m really happy we found this place. Great food, great quantity and a very satisfying overall experience.

Definitely recommended if you’re in Bangkok and missing Pakistani food. Will definitely come back! ❤️🇵🇰
sample_reviews_en.author: Shahzaib Khan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the fish biryani and waited 1.5 hours for it through Grab. When it finally arrived, I was shocked to find deep-fried frozen fish instead of what was shown in the picture.

I called the restaurant, but the person I spoke to was very defensive and didn’t even apologize. I asked why they advertise a good-quality fish in the picture but serve cheap, frozen, deep-fried fish, but he never answered my question.

If the actual food had been shown in the Grab listing, I would never have ordered it. This was a complete waste of my money and a very disappointing experience. See the picture of Grab and what they sent
sample_reviews_en.author: Lutf Bakhshi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing food here! Very authentic.
The only thing is, they give you a water bottle when you take a seat. Most would assume it's complimentary since you didn't ask for it but they charge around 20  bhat a bottle (if I remember correctly). Not a big thing, just a heads up.
Good service, friendly staff. The food does take a while to come out tho.

We got rice, salad (very refreshing!), Hakeem (great) and potato naan (very filling, couldn't be finished by one person). Loved the food!
sample_reviews_en.author: Hadi_:P

sample_reviews_en.text: Had a wonderful experience at this restaurant! The food was delicious, fresh, and beautifully presented. The service was friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere was warm and welcoming. Everything was well prepared, and the overall experience was excellent. Definitely a place I’d recommend to anyone looking for great food and good service. I’ll be happy to visit again!
sample_reviews_en.author: ijaz ahmad

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely delicious Pakistani food. We came here twice during our stay in Bangkok and couldn't fault either occasion. Server was super friendly and welcoming and wait time was surprisingly decent even though it was quite busy! Had to get our tips in for the outstanding service we've received. 5 stars -would highly recommend if you're looking for a good Pakistani dinner!
sample_reviews_en.author: Hannah Abdulhamid

sample_reviews_en.text: What an incredible experience every dish we ordered was gobsmacking with fresh ingredients beautifully balanced flavors and excellent presentation the staff were friendly attentive and genuinely welcoming the atmosphere added to the experience and made the whole evening even more enjoyable definitely one of those places you want to come back to again and again
sample_reviews_en.author: ARFANE ARFANEKHNE

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I am in Thailand and I have been in Thailand for 2 days but I did not find anything good in 2 days but I did not find anything good in the meal so I went to google map and found Ibrahim restaurant. Today I had dinner here, Al Hamidullah's zeeka of Pakistani cuisine. Everyone come here, eat the food and enjoy 🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Weight lee fight 1414

sample_reviews_en.text: I being Pakistani can actually tell you that the taste here is very authentic, especially their nihari,shinwari karhai & biryani is amazing and then the service here is even more zabardast. If one is looking for perfect Pakistani taste Ibrahim restaurant is a must try, plates khali hojaengi lekin dil nhi bharega.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fakhar Imam

restaurants.name: Olive Kitchen - Khaosan
restaurants.address:

28/10, Chana Songkhram, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited many restaurants during our stay in Bangkok, but Olive Kitchen - Khaosan was by far our favorite. The menu offers an amazing variety of international dishes, and everything we tried was absolutely delicious.

The pizzas were outstanding, with fresh ingredients and perfect crusts. The fish and chips were among the best we’ve ever had—crispy, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. The soups were rich and comforting, and the desserts were simply fantastic.

What impressed us most was the consistency of the food quality. Every dish arrived beautifully presented and exceeded our expectations. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made us feel genuinely welcome throughout our visit.

If you’re looking for great international cuisine in Bangkok, this place is a must-visit. Excellent food, wonderful service, and a warm atmosphere. We enjoyed it so much that we came back more than once during our trip. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Volkan Taştan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited for a late lunch. We tried salmon with yellow curry and stir fried chicken with spaghetti and red curry sauce. We ended the lunch with mango panna cotta. The restaurant has a great variety of dishes - from traditional dishes and breakfast on sourdough bread to pasta and pizza. All is home made (including the pasta and sourdough pizzas) and fresh. The team are so friendly and welcoming - happy to help you with your choices. You can also have a look at their own bakery on the second floor and see how they make their sourdough products. We had a great time and are very grateful we found this place - definitely one to add to your stop when visiting Bangkok.
Thank you so much to the team for looking after us ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna X Krivon

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a wonderful restaurant where you can enjoy a variety of international cuisines in Bangkok. The truffle mushroom soup and Caesar salad were especially outstanding. The other appetizers were also very delicious, and I particularly loved the mozzarella, basil, and tomato salad.

For those who are sensitive to palm oil, I believe this is one of the best restaurants to visit in Bangkok. The service was just as impressive as the food quality. All of the staff were exceptionally attentive, caring, and friendly. They truly make you feel valued as a guest. I was extremely satisfied with both the food and the service, and I would highly recommend this restaurant without hesitation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zoi Deniz Yılmaz

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 — Outstanding Food & Excellent Service

We visited Olive Kitchen – Khaosan and were genuinely blown away. The food was absolutely outstanding — every dish looked incredible and tasted even better. You can tell a lot of care goes into the presentation as well as the flavours.

The service was equally excellent. Staff were friendly, attentive, and made the whole experience feel relaxed and enjoyable. Everything came out fresh, hot, and perfectly prepared.

If you’re around Khaosan and want top-quality food with great service, Olive Kitchen is definitely worth a visit. Highly recommended! 🙌🍽️
sample_reviews_en.author: Jenson Weston

sample_reviews_en.text:
Bangkok’s backpacker area isn’t exactly where you’d expect to find a high-end wood-fired pizza and craft beer spot, but if you feel like a bit of a splurge, you could do a lot worse than Olive.
The pizzas here are among the best in town. Napoli-style with a thick crust, properly baked, and topped with high-quality ingredients. There’s a mix of classic Italian options as well as some Thai-influenced toppings.
They also have a good selection of Thai craft beers, including a very good Weizen. There are plenty of cheaper places to eat nearby, but this one is definitely worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: André Mohr

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lovely restaurant with a great selection of wine in Khaosan.
The food was excellent and very tasty 😋
The staff were lovely and friendly 🤩
We went there for our dinner and also for our breakfast 😊 I love the homemade salami, ham, sausage and bread 🥖💕

Only tiny problem was the seats (chairs) were to hard to sit in for long time which I believe it would be fabulous if the restaurant have chair cushions to afford the customers:) , and some of the tables are quite low, make it a bit difficult to sit and enjoy the food but for the drinks are fine 🙂
sample_reviews_en.author: Ladybug_zaa Lifetravel

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food here is excellent! I’ve been coming almost every day since I arrived in Bangkok.

The pizza is fantastic, and they even have their own bakery on the first floor. You can choose to have your sandwich made with baguette, sourdough, or ciabatta. I also tried the salmon pasta and the corn soup—everything was a 10/10.

​Upstairs, there’s a comfortable air-conditioned room, while the ground floor is equipped with fans. I highly recommend this place. The service is perfect!
sample_reviews_en.author: Zorka Erdeljan Zobenica

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was our first time having dinner at this restaurant, and we were very impressed.
The food was delicious, every dish we ordered was well-seasoned. The ingredients were fresh and of high quality. There was also a wide variety of menu options to choose from.

We will definitely be coming back.

The staff provided good service and were attentive throughout our meal.

The only downside is that there is no parking available in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: JomJi

restaurants.name: Prime Burger Sukhumvit
restaurants.address:

497 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a good experience at Prime Burger’s Sukhumvit location last night. While I agree with some reviewers that it is a bit pricey, and also think it’s not the best burger I’ve ever had, it was definitely a good burger and the whole meal was great from start to finish.

I ordered the Bangkok Burger with two patties, which includes cheese, pickles jalapeños, and chili mayo. I also ordered cheesy fries and an Asahi draft beer. First, the burger was juicy, well-seasoned, and definitely big enough to be reasonably filling. All the ingredients tasted great, and I didn’t notice a “pork” flavor as some reviewers have mentioned.

The low point of the meal for me were the cheesy fries, although the fries are cooked and seasoned quite well. The cheese tasted nice, but for some reason a lot of it had sunk to the bottom of the fry tray without coating the fries. Besides that, the taste was really good.

Overall, I had a nice experience and thought the food was really good, especially in terms of burgers in Thailand. It’s one of the better ones I’ve had, and kind of reminds me of the restaurant Smashburger from the US.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christopher Gorrie

sample_reviews_en.text:
Prime Burger Sukhumvit is a popular halal burger restaurant known for its tasty and high-quality burgers. It is a great place for burger lovers in the Sukhumvit area.

Their burgers are full of flavor, juicy, and tender, made with fresh ingredients and soft buns. Both beef and chicken options are available, and the patties are cooked nicely with rich taste in every bite.

One unique feature is that the burgers have creative names inspired by different cities, which makes the menu fun and interesting. It adds a special identity to the restaurant.

They also serve crispy fries, sides, and drinks, making it a complete meal option. Portion sizes are good and satisfying.

The food is usually served fresh and hot, with neat presentation. The restaurant has a casual and comfortable setup, suitable for friends and families.

The service is good, and staff are polite, friendly, and efficient. Orders are prepared smoothly and on time.

Overall, Prime Burger in Sukhumvit is a must-visit halal burger spot. Highly recommended for its juicy burgers, unique menu concept, and good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dewan Asif

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a dang good lookin burger that tastes just ok.
All the hype and stellar comments brought me here in addition to the mouth dripping menu photos are to swoon over.
I'm a smash burger connoisseur who had high hopes for this place.

The entire place is a 10. I loved the fast service and friendly workers, 10/10.
The music is booming, which is fine. It made little difference to me as I was there to eat a dang good burger. Or so I thought.

The burger looks like a 10 sitting in front of your face. After my bite, the first thought that came to me was ''this beef tastes like ground pork sausage..."

For some reason, the seasoning they use gives the burger a 'pork sausage' flavor, (odd).
I'm aware it's not pork that I'm eating. It is beef, I just prefer the natural flavor of the beef to come through and lightly salted.

The burger isn't a 10, maybe it's an 8 or maybe a 7.8 out of 10. Just my opinion. And yes, I definitely reccomend this restaurant to anyone who is after a smash burger but for myself, I wouldn't return.

I also ordered the fish burger, it is tasty 7.9/10💪
sample_reviews_en.author: Working out for Jesus (WOFJ)

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you are looking for a world-class burger in Thailand, Prime Burger is the place to go. Honestly, this wasn't just the best burger I’ve had in the country, it was easily the best meal of my entire trip.
I ordered the Paris and it was incredible. The combination of the smashed Australian beef patty, cheese, and Dijon mustard creates a flavor profile that is hard to beat. The ingredients are clearly high quality and everything is cooked to perfection. We also tried the San Francisco as a lettuce wrap, which is a great option if you want something lighter but still packed with flavor from the caramelized onions and vegan chili mayo.
The sides were just as impressive as the mains. Both the curly fries and the mixed fries came out hot, seasoned well, and stayed perfectly crunchy throughout the meal. The atmosphere is laid back and the service is quick. Whether you are a local or just passing through, do yourself a favor and eat here. You won't regret it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Farouk Hamood

sample_reviews_en.text:
Other than the ordinary whitebread bun, unlike the best burger in Thailand: Heaven Burger, Chiang Rai which gives you a choice of 6 different  buns (my preference is charcoal)--this is the 2nd best burger in Thailand, still excellent you can tell the meat is ground fresh daily and the sauces are OK, but naming burgers after cities is pretty nondescript  but I guess it gives you a general flavor point although what about the Tokoyo, Istanbul,  Manchester and Bangkok?

This place has potential to be #1 someday with some tweaks, such as lose the metal trays--restaurants did this in Saint Louis, too but it's too much vibe like eating in a jail, 555 maybe better just paper on a bamboo tray or banana leaf for local vibe
sample_reviews_en.author: Rocky Palmer

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tried Prime Burger again and this time went with the Stockholm Double Patty, paired with their potato waffle fries. The burger hits the right notes. Juicy beef patties, good melt on the cheese, and a soft bun that holds everything together without falling apart. You can tell the quality of the meat straight away.

Using Australian halal beef really makes a difference in both texture and flavour.

The waffle fries were crisp and well-seasoned, not greasy, and worked well as a side rather than just filler. Overall, a solid, well-executed burger that keeps things simple and focused on taste rather than gimmicks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Omer

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐ 5 Stars – Fantastic Burgers & Great Vibes!

I recently visited Primeburger on Sukhumvit, and it was an excellent experience from start to finish. The burgers were incredibly juicy, full of flavor, and cooked to absolute perfection. The ingredients taste fresh, the buns are soft, and the portions are just right.

The staff is friendly and attentive, and the service is fast. The atmosphere is clean, relaxed, and perfect for a quick meal or a casual hangout.

If you’re craving a high-quality burger in Bangkok, Primeburger is definitely one of the best choices in the Sukhumvit area. Highly recommended! 🍔✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Marco

sample_reviews_en.text:
Prime’s New York burger is a mighty fine thing indeed. Like most dishes I like, it’s the basics done super well - patty, American cheese, pickle, onions, mayo, and ketchup - the ingredients sing and they taste bloody good together too.

My companion’s Dubai burger was equally good - succulent crispy chicken, slaw, cheese, and crispy onions - the sweet potato fries are another standout.

Only miss was the prime fries (kind of poutine inspired I think) which was a bit OTT for me. But otherwise, Prime deserves its reputation as a Bangkok burger institution with branches across the city.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Meng Yee

restaurants.name: Hungry Nerd
restaurants.address:

89/70 Phaya Thai Rd, Thanon Phetchaburi, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Unfortunately it was disappointing.
I ordered the grilled vegetable quinoa salad for 200 baht.
The entire salad basically consisted only of lettuce leaves. It’s called a quinoa salad, but there was only about a tablespoon of quinoa in it.
When I asked if I could get some extra quinoa, they simply said no. I then said that I was of course willing to pay for the additional quinoa, but even that was refused.
Really outrageous.
All in all, I paid 200 baht for what was basically a quarter of a head of lettuce. Thanks for nothing.
I wouldn’t recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adonay Kahle

sample_reviews_en.text:
I walked from MBK to the restaurant 😂 I've driven past it before and always seen a lot of people eating there. I arrived at the restaurant around 7 PM and didn't have to wait long in line.

-Pork Loin Steak: The pork was tender and the bread was very crispy.
-Fish and Chips: Two pieces of fish with tartar sauce.
-Garlic Fried Rice
Both dishes were served in generous portions. Very filling and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: SAKONWAN Su

sample_reviews_en.text: I happened to walk past the restaurant and it looked appealing, so I ordered the large size chicken breast salad with sesame and yuzu dressing. The chicken pieces were thick and tender, and it came with bacon and roasted sweet potato, which was sweet, soft, and had a crispy skin. The food arrived quite quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: N N (Pom)

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was average in taste, and the price was reasonable, neither too cheap nor too expensive. The staff provided good service, and the atmosphere in the restaurant was nice and clean. The only downside was that the air conditioning was a bit too warm when I visited.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cha Min

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a combo plate with beef steak. The beef tasted completely different from what you'd find in Japan. It was bland and not juicy. I think pork or chicken would be a better choice. The staff and the atmosphere of the restaurant were nice, though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tamaki Igarashi

sample_reviews_en.text: This affordable restaurant is located next to BTS RATCHATHEWI, specializing in volcanic rock grill steaks and pasta. The signboard is huge; these days, if you don't have Lineman and Grab thumbs-up signs outside, you can't call yourself a …
sample_reviews_en.author: wei choco

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place! I really liked the service: the waiters cleared dishes quickly and kept a close eye on the tables. The food was delicious; the wait for my first order was only about 15 minutes, and the next one arrived in just 8 minutes. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Alena Maslova

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a conveniently located restaurant near the BTS Skytrain, serving Italian and Western steaks and pasta. The food is delicious, the prices are reasonable, and there's a wide variety of dishes to choose from – easy on the wallet!
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนัท จิรบุลเกียรติ

restaurants.name: B. Elbasha Asok Branch (Halal Lebanese & Turkish Restaurant)
restaurants.address:

25, 4 Soi Sukhumvit 16, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khet Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: i’ve eaten Middle Eastern and Mediterranean food all over the world and I’ve been searching for some really good kebabs and options here in Bangkok. I’ve tried several restaurants but this by far has been the best. I’ve ordered them from them five times now I’ve tried five different things and yeah, I wish they had like garlic, pita bread or garlic naan or some other options but overall everything has been exceptionally well in flavor portion size even the way they do to go. Takeout has been really amazing and I will definitely be ordering from them again and stopping to visit the restaurant when I’m in a Asoke area. I highly recommend the chicken kebabs. They are like white and breast meat. Chicken very well cooked very well. Flavored the rice is a great flavoring to it. I also recommend the green spicy sauce in the garlic dip. I’m not really big in the spicy stuff, but it just has just this great amazing flavor and it’s not too spicy and it really adds a lot of flavor to the dish. I hope this helps you. It’s a it’s a great place. A great find.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason Denison

sample_reviews_en.text:
Elbasha is a famous Lebanese restaurant known for its delicious and authentic Middle Eastern cuisine. It is a great place for people who enjoy rich flavors and fresh ingredients.

The restaurant serves a wide variety of dishes including mixed grills, kebabs, shawarma, hummus, pita bread, rice dishes, salads, falafel, and mezze plates. The food is freshly prepared and full of flavor.

Their grilled meats are juicy and tender, while items like hummus, garlic sauce, and fresh bread add a great balance to the meal. Portion sizes are generous and suitable for sharing with family or friends.

The menu offers both meat and vegetarian options, so there is something for everyone. Desserts and refreshing drinks are also available.

The restaurant has a warm and welcoming atmosphere with comfortable seating. Staff are generally polite, friendly, and service is smooth.

Overall, Elbasha is a highly recommended place for Lebanese food lovers. Great taste, variety, and authentic cuisine make it worth visiting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dewan Asif

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the most unique dining experiences I've had in Bangkok! The moment you walk in, it genuinely feels like you've been transported to Turkey. The décor, music, and atmosphere are beautiful, making it feel much more than just a restaurant.

What made the experience even more special was being able to dress up in traditional outfits with matching accessories for photos. It was such a fun touch and made the visit so memorable.

The food was delicious too. We loved the cold mezza with fresh pita, the mixed grill, shawarma, Turkish coffee, and the Nutella dessert. Everything tasted fresh and authentic, and the staff were welcoming throughout our visit.

Definitely a place I'd recommend for a unique date night, girls' day out, or if you're looking to experience something different in Bangkok.

Found this place while creating content for @bangkok_baddie, and it's one I'll happily recommend to anyone visiting the city. ✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Natasha Chawla

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went with 4 friends.
Very satisfied.
We ordered the Authentic Hummus, they act as a really good accompaniment to the carbs.
There were two remarkable salads we ordered. First,The Feta Cheese with Tomato. And Greek salad. Both were absolutely mouth-watering.
We also got their chicken potato tajine. Which is a really soup with a really refreshing taste.
We recommend ordering the mix shawarma platter if theres two or more people. You get to try on different meats and sauces.
If you want to try on their Pides. I highly recommend their ground beef schwarma with cheese pide. The cheesy and beefy flavour just goes together in harmony.
As for the carbs, try their whole wheat pita. They go really well with all the soup and especially the hummus.

And also their atmosphere is amazing. Especially the second floor. Music is really giving that middle easten vibes which is perfect for a place like this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phirasut

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a wonderful dining experience at Elbasha Asok with my husband and my son. Everything exceeded our expectations. The food was absolutely delicious, fresh, and full of authentic flavours.

What made our visit truly special was the outstanding hospitality and professionalism of the staff. A heartfelt thank you to Qasim and Reham, who are originally from Makkah. They welcomed us with genuine warmth, kindness, and exceptional care, making us feel completely at home.

Their outstanding service, together with the excellent food, made this one of our favourite restaurants in Bangkok. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for delicious halal food and outstanding hospitality. We will definitely be back. Thank you for making our visit so memorable! 🌹

Regards,
Dr Olfat Sambas
sample_reviews_en.author: Olfat Sambas

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fantastic authentic food and top-tier service!
If you are looking for authentic Halal Lebanese and Turkish cuisine in Bangkok, B. Elbasha in Asok is a must-visit.
The first thing that strikes you is the incredible staff. They are exceptionally welcoming, attentive, and make you feel right at home from the moment you walk in. It’s rare to find such a warm and professional team.
As for the food - be prepared! The portions are very generous, so come hungry or bring friends to share. Everything we tried was fresh, flavorful, and seasoned to perfection. Whether you’re craving a classic kebab or traditional mezze, the quality here is outstanding.
Highly recommended for anyone in the Asok area looking for a great atmosphere and a satisfying meal. I’ll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Artem Nikolaev

sample_reviews_en.text:
Unfortunately, this was a huge disappointment. The food was truly awful in both taste and quality. I've eaten Turkish and other Middle Eastern cuisine in Turkey and Egypt, so I'm quite familiar with it. Even in Germany, I've had much better meals in far simpler Turkish restaurants.

I find the numerous excellent reviews particularly misleading. The restaurant has a sign on every table explicitly offering two free desserts in exchange for a 5-star rating and a positive review. That, at least to me, explains why there are so many very positive reviews.

I strongly advise against being solely swayed by high ratings. For us, the food was completely underwhelming, and we wouldn't be returning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mya Velu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tried Elbasha and it was a really nice surprise 🤍

The mango lassi here is quite unique. It’s slightly salty but very well balanced and refreshing. Not the typical sweet version, but I actually liked this twist a lot.

The margarita pizza is also interesting. The dough is different from Italian-style pizza, but in a good way… soft, slightly chewy, and flavorful. What I loved is you can even use the crust to dip into the tajine instead of naan, which makes the whole experience more fun and versatile.

Atmosphere is cozy and relaxed, and the staff are friendly and attentive.

Overall, a great spot if you want something a bit different from the usual Middle Eastern places 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Ushma Ratnabala

652 เหนือ, 654 ถ. บางบอน 5 Bang Bon Nuea, Bang Bon, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This Japanese restaurant near my house is delicious and reasonably priced. It's not very big, but it has a cozy atmosphere. The staff are attentive and provide good service. Parking is available on the street in front of the restaurant. It's a really great Japanese restaurant on Bang Bon 5 Road. The fish is fresh, and there's a wide variety of delicious rolls to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Boss (Boss)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was just driving by and looking for a restaurant on Google Maps.
The result was a 4.9 rating, and I was shocked by the 1900 reviews.
I couldn't resist, so I stopped to try it.
Today I ordered three dishes, as shown in the picture.
I think everything was excellent; this is definitely a restaurant I'll add to my list of must-try places.
sample_reviews_en.author: พี่พาเที่ยว TakeATripTH

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and there's a wide variety of dishes to choose from. I usually order through Line Man regularly.
Today I wanted to dine in, but it turns out the prices at the restaurant are the same as ordering through delivery 😭 So sad. I shouldn't have driven all the way here. Ordering through delivery is the same price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oui P.

sample_reviews_en.text: I called to inquire about my order from an employee who had been preparing it for an hour. They cut me off completely. If you're not ready to provide online service, don't do it at all. The employee was terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: K P

sample_reviews_en.text: Why did I only just find out there's a sushi restaurant with premium ingredients here!!!! It's the best! Salmon lovers and Japanese food enthusiasts can't miss this. Fresh, delicious, and great value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nut Pichawee

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is good, and the ingredients are good. The silverfish salad is delicious and affordable at 145 baht. Almost everything is delicious except for the scallop salad which is too battered.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pasta BB

sample_reviews_en.text: Let's have a meal at our favorite restaurant. The food is delicious, the prices are reasonable, and the staff provides excellent service. I highly recommend this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: nutkamol yarmsuk

sample_reviews_en.text: The sashimi was very fresh, the prices were reasonable, there was a wide variety of dishes on the menu, and the staff provided excellent service. I was very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siwaporn T.

restaurants.name: ทวีโชคหมูกะทะ สาขา18รัชดา
restaurants.address:

424 Ratchadaphisek 36 Yaek 19-11 Chan Kasem, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
never been a fan of bbq or hotpot but i have officially been converted into a mookata fan 🙌🏼

this restaurant, although being on the side if a main road, is spotless and super clean. we were attracted by the vibe and it wasnt busy when we ate there twice so we really enjoyed the atmosphere and the meal.

i cant be sure if its expensive by local standards but we found the quality of the meat and portion good value for money.
we ordered the set to share and  walked away very satisfied both times.
their dipping sauces are also 💯💯💯
i personally like pairing my meat with their Nam Jim Talay seafood dip.

staff were also super attentive to us and often checked on and replaced our stove and charcoal during the meals, and tried their best to communicate with us despite not speaking any english.

their large variety of post-mookata ice creams were also. a huge bonus for me 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: nat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a minimalist cafe style decor with soft colors and beautiful lighting. It's clean, has plenty of seating, and the tables aren't cramped, making for a comfortable dining experience. There's also parking available.

The food is top-notch, as expected from Taveechok, with both set menus and à la carte options. They use high-quality ingredients and offer a complete selection of pork, chicken, beef, and seafood. In addition, they have side dishes like papaya salad, various salads, and fried items. For those who prefer hot pot, they also have a dipping sauce option. It's a one-stop shop for everything you need.

Overall, it's a delicious and value-for-money BBQ restaurant with a great atmosphere, perfect for a relaxing meal with friends or family, or even a company party.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marisa

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a really delicious Thai BBQ restaurant. Everything is great. I highly recommend it.
First, there's ample parking. You can park right next to the restaurant, no need to worry about finding a parking spot.
Next, the taste of the food and ingredients:
Everything is fresh, clean, and the taste is excellent.
The food comes out very quickly. We waited less than 2 minutes for everything to be served. The staff are lovely, polite, and well-mannered.
There's live music too, around 7 PM. I'm not sure if there's music at other times.

I peeked into the kitchen where they're preparing the ingredients, and the staff were wearing hairnets for protection.

I really recommend it. The pictures might not be the best because I took them for myself, but it's that good, I just had to share.
sample_reviews_en.author: mookrawee yutthakan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is clean, beautifully decorated, and brightly lit, making it great for taking photos.
We ate there on a Sunday evening; the restaurant was quite empty, so we could choose our seats freely. After a while, a musician started playing live music.

Ordering food is easy via mobile phone scanning, and there's a wide selection of food and drinks. The food didn't take too long to arrive.

One thing that could be improved is the BBQ grill; it wasn't very hot, the pork cooked very slowly, and it wasn't crispy enough.
Other dishes were okay; the papaya salad was flavorful.
However, the extra beef we ordered was quite tough.

There's parking available next to the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charlie Vongphantuseth

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, both the BBQ pork and the papaya salad. The papaya salad with thin noodles was perfectly made. The staff were friendly and the service was fast. They offered a welcome drink of refreshing watermelon smoothie, perfect for summer. They took great care of their customers. I was very impressed and will definitely go back again! 🥹🐷
sample_reviews_en.author: Pannipa Sutcharit

sample_reviews_en.text: Let the picture speak for itself. For 120 baht, I've eaten a lot of beef tongue, but never this good. I've eaten here many times before, and the food quality has always been okay for the price. This time, I wasn't impressed at all. When asked if it was normal, I said it was normal.
sample_reviews_en.author: ART (ตี๋)

sample_reviews_en.text: They have different set menus small medium big, it's perfect for couples they even have love music playing. The seating area is outside so it can be a little hot but they do provide fans to your table. The food was very delicious and not too expensive i recommend this place
sample_reviews_en.author: That Boi

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! The papaya salad was incredibly flavorful and spicy. The atmosphere was nice, minimalist, and they even had live music. The staff provided great service. I've been here many times already; the food is truly delicious and perfectly suits my taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patsorn Srisopa

restaurants.name: Aonchorn Thai restaurant ออนชอน ราชดำเนิน
restaurants.address:

21 Prachathipatai Rd, Wat Bowon Niwet, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is absolutely delicious and inexpensive. The value for money is definitely a 10/10, especially since the portions are quite generous.

I've tried Pad Thai everywhere here in Thailand, and I have to say it's really good here.

The food is freshly prepared on-site, and the staff is incredibly friendly and attentive.

The ambiance is standard for Thailand, which might take some getting used to for a European, but it's perfectly acceptable.

The panda-themed tablecloths are definitely a plus.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jenny Bürkel

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for authentic local flavor, Aonchorn Thai Restaurant is a absolute must-visit. Hands down, they serve one of the best Pad Thais in town!

The food here is simply incredible, it genuinely tastes like a delicious, comforting homemade meal cooked with care.

During our stay in Bangkok, we ended up coming back more than once because we fell so in love with the menu. Plus, the prices are incredibly affordable for the quality you get.
Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Alejandro Gavancho

sample_reviews_en.text: A cozy little Thai restaurant with a very welcoming atmosphere. The owner works incredibly hard and was so kind and attentive during our visit. The food was good, portions were satisfying, and the prices were extremely fair. You can really tell she puts a lot of care into the restaurant. A lovely little spot that I’d happily visit again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Cam Larocque

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is likely to suit most Korean palates!

It is 2 to 3 times cheaper than the expensive, strong-flavored food found deep inside Khaosan, and it tastes great. If you are staying near Khaosan, it is the place where you can eat deliciously without breaking the bank. I have been going there for three days in a row right now lol.
sample_reviews_en.author: 홍태태

sample_reviews_en.text: Really good local restaurant. Ordered quite a lot, some starters to share (the wakame salad & salmon with rice) and a plate for each one (we were nine), drinks and coffee. Very good price (222 BHATS per person) and the staff was very nice. We tried the green curry and the thicker noodes pad thai, everything was amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Belén Dorado

sample_reviews_en.text: Food so good I came all the way across town to eat here many times. Probably the best pad Thai and papaya salad I have ever eaten. (And I’ve had a lot). Also wonderful customer service. Not fancy but definitely fabulous. (No Ac but lots of fans ). Highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: John McClain

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely loved our experience at Aon-chorn! The best papaya salad, chili curry, and pad Thai dishes! We will definitely be back. You can’t go wrong with Aon-chorn (other than no AC but plenty of fans).
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Courtney

sample_reviews_en.text: Authentic, excellent advice and service. You feel right at home here! We had a fantastic Pad Kra Pao, papaya salad, and Pad Thai! We would definitely come back if it were closer from Germany!
sample_reviews_en.author: Siggi

restaurants.name: The Deck by Arun Residence
restaurants.address:

36-38 Pratu Nokyung Alley, Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I intended to have a foreign friend make a reservation by phone, but there was a communication breakdown with the person who answered the call, so I took the reservation myself. The reservation staff member spoke in a drawn-out, annoyed tone. I asked if they could please speak to customers more politely, to which the staff member replied that they were speaking politely and weren't being emotional. I asked for clarification, and they responded in a harsh, abrupt tone. When I repeated the question, they simply said "Yes." I then said again, "Please use polite language when speaking to customers," to which they responded, "Yes, ma'am/sir."

If staff members don't want to talk to customers or lack service mind, they should be assigned to other roles. This way, they won't have to deal with people and will avoid frustration and anger like this.
Okay, the restaurant is beautiful, the view is beautiful, but if this is the first impression, I won't go. I will also warn those around me about my experience, and if they do go, they should be prepared for this kind of behavior. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: tao panthipa

sample_reviews_en.text: Wat Arun, located beside the Chao Phraya River, boasts beautiful evening views. The restaurant is situated directly opposite the riverbank, allowing diners to enjoy the stunning sunset while gazing at the water. Occasionally, you'll see yachts slowly passing by, creating a tranquil atmosphere. The restaurant has three floors, with both a terrace and indoor dining area. The indoor seating is air-conditioned, while the terrace, on the top floor, is less hot in the evening. Ordering was left to my friends; I simply focused on eating. While waiting for our food, we went to the terrace, where the view was even more beautiful. However, it got a bit warm before sunset, so after taking photos and enjoying the scenery, we returned indoors. The food was excellent, and dessert was a must for finishing the meal. I recommend making a reservation if you have a large group to secure a good table and enjoy the sunset view of Wat Arun across the river.
sample_reviews_en.author: 陳米兒

sample_reviews_en.text:
From Wat Arun to lunch. At this point, there's only one place for lunch. Yes, that restaurant with a panoramic view of Wat Arun.
The Deck
We arrived an hour early, but they were still kind enough to seat us. There weren't many customers yet, and they had reserved a window seat for us.
The Deck is a place with a panoramic view of Wat Arun.
It's a four-story restaurant with various seating arrangements, but the cuisine is basically Thai-Italian.
The prices are high, but it's understandable if you consider it part of the Wat Arun visit fee.
Anyway, a toast with Chang beer!
The portions were larger than the menu photos suggested, and we were full quickly. Japanese tourists kept arriving one after another with their guides. It seems to be a popular lunch spot for tours. I wonder what they're serving.
When we stepped outside, the heat returned.
sample_reviews_en.author: james won

sample_reviews_en.text: We tried to book a table to watch the Royal Barge Procession on Friday, November 6th, 2026. We inquired on August 9th, and the restaurant said reservations would open in early October. Today is September 5th, so we tried contacting them again to see if reservations were open. To our surprise, the restaurant informed us that all reservations are full. That's it. We were very disappointed. When we called to ask about available seats besides those listed on LINE, they seemed uninterested in arranging anything. They just said "only the seats circled" were available and hung up. 😢
sample_reviews_en.author: Keyoon Ngamsomsuke

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to check out this restaurant by myself because I wanted to have dinner there with my family.

I confirmed that the open-air seating is perfectly fine during the evening at this time of year!

I enjoyed the wine and pizza.

The pizza was delicious and the size was generous – I was very satisfied.

The chilled white wine was also delicious.

On my way out, I made a reservation for a future visit with my family.

Thank you for the smooth service.

Next time, I'll come with my family, so please let me try some dishes other than pizza!
sample_reviews_en.author: Masayuki Ito

sample_reviews_en.text: Sitting back with a cup of coffee, a slice of cake, and some ice cream while soaking in the view of Wat Arun at The Deck by Arun Residence was such an incredible experience. Looking out over the Chao Phraya River, watching the shuttle boats cross back and forth with the grand spire of Wat Arun and the main hall of Wat Kalayanamitr in the background, it honestly felt like stepping back in time. You really get a sense of how vibrant and majestic this place must have been back in the day. It was just such a peaceful, beautiful moment.
sample_reviews_en.author: MaE Khetmongkol

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Romantic Dinner with a View
It was a truly romantic evening, enjoying dinner while watching the sunset from the rooftop of The Deck by Arun Residence. From up there, you get a stunning view of the Chao Phraya River as the city transitions from day to night.

The best time to arrive is just before sunset, so you can take in both the golden hour and the breathtaking night view that follows. As the lights begin to glow across the river, you’ll see the iconic Wat Arun beautifully illuminated—such a perfect and unforgettable scene.
sample_reviews_en.author: MP JOURNEY

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant offers a dining experience with a view of At Arun.

We made a reservation for 6:00 PM and ate at a table by the river.

The sunset was incredibly beautiful, and all the dishes were absolutely delicious!

Even though I don't like spicy food or cilantro, I thoroughly enjoyed it!

I think the seasoning is perfectly suited to Japanese palates!

I would love to go back when I travel to Thailand again!
sample_reviews_en.author: ひな

restaurants.name: BABYCCINO
restaurants.address:

53 Ekkamai 12 Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was disappointed with my experience at BABYCCINO Café in Bangkok.

The bread served was clearly not fresh. I politely informed the staff about the issue, expecting an apology or a replacement, but unfortunately no action was taken. The bread was not replaced, and my concern was initially ignored.

What made the experience more frustrating was the response from the manager, Bens, who did not make any effort to resolve the issue or ensure customer satisfaction.

That said, I would like to thank the General Manager, Ms. Nung, for stepping in to rectify the situation. She handled the matter professionally by removing the charges for the affected items from our bill, which I truly appreciated. Her prompt action helped recover what had otherwise been a disappointing experience.

I hope the café improves its quality control to ensure fresh food is consistently served and provides better training for its frontline management on handling customer concerns. Customer service should be proactive from the beginning, not only after escalation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ahmad Almoosawi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The place has a modern and stylish interior, creating a cozy yet vibrant atmosphere. It was quite busy when I visited, which speaks to its popularity, but the service remained smooth and efficient.

I ordered an egg mushroom sandwich, avocado toast with egg, and a grilled cheese sandwich, and all three dishes were absolutely delicious. The ingredients were fresh, the flavors were well-balanced, and each bite was satisfying. The avocado toast was beautifully presented, the egg mushroom sandwich had a rich, savory taste, and the grilled cheese was perfectly crispy and gooey.

Despite the crowd, the staff was friendly and attentive, making sure everything was served promptly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohamed AlAli

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place, is amazing us everytime we visit, the service, the food, the atmosphere and the view of the greenery and fish pond, and the great specialty coffee. The flat white and latte were so great. Came here multiple time during my short visit to bangkok and all visits were great. The cafe is having multiple truffle dishes, we tried the truffle brioche eggs sandwich, truffle ravioli, and truffle eggs Benedict and all were so great. Highly recommended.

There is a spa (messages) in the next building and a nails and lashes spa in the smae building (So Happening)
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohamed Alali

sample_reviews_en.text:
A lovely brunch spot in Ekkamai. I ordered the matcha strawberry and it was really good, nicely sweet with a strong matcha flavor and quite rich and creamy. If you like matcha drinks that still taste like real matcha and not overly milky, you will probably enjoy this one.

I also had the tuna melt and it was very good and satisfying, perfect for a relaxed brunch.
Just a heads up that this place gets quite busy, especially on weekends. It is better to come early or be prepared to wait a little.

Overall, definitely worth visiting for the food and cozy vibe.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ammi Ratanataya

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best Western brunch/lunch restaurants I've had in Bangkok. I've been there a few times, and the quality is consistently good! The menu is extensive, and I always have a hard time picking what I want. My favorites have been the pancakes, french toast, and eggs benedict.

The restaurant is beautiful, with tables close to each other. It seems to be full all the time, including weekdays, but the wait has been acceptable (at least for 2 to 3 people).

Overall ⭐️ : 4/5 (Would visit again!)
Value💰: 4/5
Food 🍲 : 5/5
Service🙎🏻‍♂️: 3/5
Atmosphere 💫: 3/5
sample_reviews_en.author: Judith Kan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere and the place was amazing for a quiet brunch and enjoying the outside pond.

My order was Thai hot tea, madam truffle Benedict and acai biscoff crunch bowl

Thai tea was with milk (its my first time trying it and I didn’t like it)

Truffle Benedict they made the eggs exactly how I wanted but it was tasteless and cold the bun and on top truffle tasted so good

Acai bowl: the biscoff and acai mix was actually good along with banana and strawberry (sweet lovers will definitely like it)

Su was so friendly and helped choose my orders
sample_reviews_en.author: Rodi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a great time enjoying tasty foods and drinks with chill and relax atmosphere.
All dishes we ordered (Avocado sourdough toast, salmon pasta, sourdough sandwich,truffle fries and pancakes) were delicious and I enjoyed all of those.
Can order via scanning the WR code they provide to each table. We made the reservation in advanced. Staffs were friendly and service was prompt and great.
Can be said that prices are quite worth for the quality, taste, venue and vibe.
I will visit again for sure when I visit again to Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Win Ma Ma (Emma)

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is quaint, quiet, and beautiful. Very clean, with a lovely atmosphere. While the servers seemed to be friendly, they were ignorant of some tables including ours. To be fair we only speak English, but the first server was new and easily confused. We waited a long time for our order, and it was difficult to get someone's attention if we needed something. The food was Pinterest-worthy, but bland and some dishes came out cold. Overall, the 3 stars felt generous for our experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: erika olson

restaurants.name: The Square
restaurants.address:

NOVOTEL BANGKOK, 392 44 Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Took the premium package and though we made reservation onsite, it didn't seem like it mattered as the staff can't seem to find the reservation when we went back at the appointed hour. Nevertheless, they managed to find us a table for our party of four.

The crab siew mai was depleted but it got replenished within the next 15 minutes. The premium items were ordered by placing the pegs into the designated trays at the kitchen counters. Pro-tip: 1 peg is usually for a one pax order. So if you have 4 pax, then 4 pegs for the same thing unless the group wants to share?

Staff did their best to bring us water, the ordered food and also cleared the empty plates from the table. Thank you.

River prawns were of a good sized but tasted unseasoned. There's salt and pepper on table, or there's seafood sauce from the crispy pork counter. The crispy pork was good. Live noodles station was doing boat noodles during our visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: purple taste

sample_reviews_en.text:
Didn’t have a pleasant experience on 10 March 2024 because of 2 unprofessional lady staff members despite having seen them work at the restaurant for a long time now.

Fortunately this morning, 12 March 2024, I met a young and pleasant trainee (Off) who, despite having a multitude of duties, maintains a sunny smile and is extremely courteous while going about attending to the guests.

Seriously, if I were a member of the  hotel management team, I would immediately give Off a permanent position before another hotel snatches this hardworking gem away.

One of the lady wait staff who was rude to me the other day tried her best to redeem herself this morning and I see the sincerity in her actions. I forgive her.

To me, it is not the word that comes out of the mouths of people in suits because most of the time, they don’t mean it.

It is the little actions and the non-verbal cues that exude sincerity.
sample_reviews_en.author: PTHC PTHC

sample_reviews_en.text: We have eaten this buffet a number of times. They have a new thing where they give you one course of crab.  There are 3 choices.
