My wife choice number 3 and it was not great with only a bit of crab.  I chose number one which was a whole crab.  It just never came I waiting for 45 minutes.  After about 25, I started to lose my patience.  I never found out why, but the manager gave me a free meal.  The river prawn was absolutely amazing and maybe the biggest and best I have ever had.  It could of been a 5 star evening except for the crab and even though it said Roast Beef on the website, they did not have it. I really appreciate the Managers and the servers method of handling this.  It was not their fault.  I am not sure what was happening in the kitchen.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chas S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had dinner at The Square in Bangkok with my relatives and really enjoyed it. It’s a big buffet with lots of Chinese food, dim sum, and seafood, so there’s plenty to choose from.

The dim sum was a standout — everything was fresh, soft, and full of flavor, especially their signature items. You could tell it wasn’t just typical buffet dim sum; it actually tasted well made.

The seafood was great, especially the prawns and lobster. The prawns were juicy and sweet, and the lobster was tender and flavorful. I liked it so much I went back for multiple rounds, which pretty much says it all.

Overall, it’s a solid spot if you’re in the mood to eat well and eat a lot, especially if you love dim sum and seafood. Definitely worth checking out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex Valenzuela

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The Sunday dinner buffet is on promotion for just 699 baht net.
- The main dishes are dim sum, offering a wide variety of steamed, stir-fried, and fried options, including roast pork and crispy pork. The highlights are the Peking duck and grilled river prawns, along with an abundance of prawn dishes, making this a great deal for prawn lovers.
- The food is delicious, of good quality, and served hot, with the dim sum being particularly well-prepared.
- There’s a wide variety of dishes beyond dim sum, including a salad bar, spicy salads, soups, fruits, and desserts.
- The service is excellent, with Ms. Ploy, Mr. New, and Ms. Pukky providing a warm welcome, offering menu recommendations, and taking care of guests attentively.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chulee Kobwitthayawong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently enjoyed the river prawn buffet at Novotel Siam, and it was an amazing experience! The selection of fresh river prawns and other seafood dishes was impressive, and everything was cooked perfectly. The atmosphere was lively yet comfortable, making it a great spot for both family and friends.

I would especially like to compliment K.May, one of the staff members. She was incredibly attentive, friendly, and made sure we had everything we needed throughout the meal. Her excellent service truly made our dining experience even more special.

Highly recommended — I’ll definitely come back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanapol Wisutwarin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service and food there are amazing.no cap.🥰🤩😝🤪💯✨️✨️✨️✨️

-Services
I would like to compliment 4 waiters, pookky, new, pukky and kan for their amazing services💯💫👌. They had ensure that my water is always been filled and make sure that the plates that i do not need are taken away. 😊🙏

-food
The food there are top notch💕, yum😋. The prawn are hugeeee, it looks like a lobster.(not joking😆).
The deserts, is wow. So many optionsss, they look so good and its nice. They even have a chocolate fountain. ✨️✨️✨️⛲️⛲️🍫🍫

Byeeee😜🤪😝
sample_reviews_en.author: jes

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall very good!
The food is overall delicious, there are many options to choose from ranging from Thai, Italian, and Japanese.
Desserts are alright, I enjoyed them but I’ve had better.
Some of the foods were too salty such as the parma ham on the melon, capers, and smoked salmon.
For 999+ Baht it’s a bit of a shame that the only drink included is water. You’d have to pay 140 to get refillable soft drinks, which is not at all worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alissa Stehlin

restaurants.name: Shree Khodiyar Kathiyawadi Dhaba Pure Vegetarian Indian restaurant Pattaya
restaurants.address:

17, 10 Pattaya Sai 2 Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Craving the taste of home while in Pattaya? Shree Khodiya Kathiyawadi Restaurant is where authentic Gujarati and Indian flavors come alive. From the moment you walk in, the cozy, welcoming atmosphere makes you feel right at home. Every dish bursts with rich Kathiyawadi spices and the kind of freshness that reminds you of traditional home cooking.

The menu is packed with variety — generous portions, delicious options for every palate, and dishes that truly capture the spirit of Gujarat. The staff go above and beyond to make your visit special, offering helpful recommendations with warm smiles.

Clean, comfortable, and perfect for families or groups, this restaurant is a must-visit for anyone who loves genuine Gujarati and Indian cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amit Shah

sample_reviews_en.text: Shree Khodiya Kathiyawadi Restaurant in Pattaya is a true gem for anyone craving authentic Gujarati, Indian flavors. This place deserves five stars for its homely atmosphere and mouthwatering dishes. The food is rich in taste, freshly prepared, and full of authentic Kathiyawadi spices that bring the flavors of Gujarat right to your table. Portion sizes are generous, and the variety on the menu ensures there’s something for everyone. The staff are polite, attentive, and always happy to guide you with recommendations. The restaurant is clean, comfortable, and welcoming, making it perfect for families and groups. A must visit for delicious Gujarati, Indian dining.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mayalcito Bhalala

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5

Shree Khodiyar Kathiyawadi Dhaba in Pattaya is truly the best Gujarati hotel for anyone craving the real taste of India. The food is absolutely delicious with authentic Kathiyawadi flavours that remind you of home. Every dish is fresh, perfectly spiced, and full of traditional Gujarati taste.

A special thanks to Mr. Sumer Singh for the excellent hospitality. He is very polite, helpful, and makes sure every guest has a wonderful dining experience.

The staff service is quick, the atmosphere is clean and family-friendly, and overall it feels like a perfect Indian dining spot in Pattaya.

Highly recommended for all Gujaratis and Indian food lovers!
sample_reviews_en.author: Patel Jainish

sample_reviews_en.text:
Original Gujarati taste, loads of vegetarian options. As a Gujarati person from kathiyawad, I really enjoyed the food here.
If you order food here, you get a mix salad plate with 12-15 different types of salads like mung beans, onions etc. for free. They also have a lot of free pickles to choose from.
The photo here is of 'special curd with muthiya' sabji. It was really amazing and I would definitely recommend that.
We were positively surprised with the authenticity of Gujarati food here. The service is quick and crisp. Must try!!
sample_reviews_en.author: kartik adhia

sample_reviews_en.text: If you’re a Gujarati looking for authentic Indian taste in Pattaya, Shree Khodiyar Kathiyawadi Dhaba is the perfect place! The food is pure vegetarian, freshly prepared, and full of real Kathiyawadi flavors. Every dish reminds you of home — simple, spicy, and delicious. The staff is friendly and the service is quick. Truly the best food in Pattaya for Gujarati people. Highly recommended for anyone craving traditional Indian food abroad!
sample_reviews_en.author: bhalani shani

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food with perfect flavors and presentation! The highlight of our visit was the exceptional service by Sumer Singh — polite, attentive, and very professional. He made our experience truly special. Highly recommend this place for great taste and top-notch hospitality. Will definitely visit again. Thank you,
sample_reviews_en.author: M D

sample_reviews_en.text: We had delicious Dal Khichdi and Paneer paratha, with this they serve 7 types of pickle, lots of salad and sprout. It made our day in Pattaya as we were looking for best indian food option. Staff is very helpful. Khichdi tasted so authentic with pure ghee, their pickle was homemade. Reasonable rates.
sample_reviews_en.author: Padmashree M.

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was fantastic.ghar ki yaad diladi. We all enjoyed it.. even staff were polite and helpful.. specially Sonu yadav very polite and helpful good service by him.thanks alot ..we all grp have decided to eat every day till we are there in Pattaya in same restaurant. Both lunch and dinner.
sample_reviews_en.author: amar deora

restaurants.name: All Meals Sawasdee
restaurants.address:

8 Tha Tian Aly, Khwaeng Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Khet Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: All Meals Sawasdee at Bangkok is a very small restaurant near the Wat Pho temple. You will find a lot of locals and westerners here and the place is super crowded always. We had to wait for 20 minutes who’re we got our seats. The restaurant can seat around 25  to 30 people max. The food was too good and we enjoyed every meal we ordered. I loved the sea food Thai fried rice (names are different in Thai language, however I would recommend you try them). The portion quantity is perfect and it is not less or more. Food was served quick and the staff are super fast. They are too busy to even give you an eye contact which is understandable as the crowd as large. I will recommend you to try this place out if you are in this area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vijay Verghis

sample_reviews_en.text: If I could give this 10 out of 5 stars I would. They were able to accommodate my gluten free garlic free diet, with no problem. Was able to order a traditional Thai fare I had been craving. Ordered the pad Thai, grilled vegetables, tom kha, and chicken basil dishes, to split with two people, and the like soda without sugar. Even without gluten everything tasted amazing. So grateful to find this little gem. This is the first gluten free review and we were unsure if anyone in the area could accommodate. Thanks so much to the staff for their attentiveness and delicious food! We were too busy stuffing our faces to get photos of our dishes. If you have any issue with spice get all dishes mild, they tent to run hot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lisa K

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here twice, and will definitely come back here again if I ever come back to Thailand.

I have tried several menu and every meals i tried is never failed, they taste really good. My favorite is mango sticky rice, shrimp cake, tom yum, and shrimp curry.

Shrimp cake in here is actually so unique, because it taste savory but they combined it with sweet dipping sauce, which surprisingly taste good.

The owner and the staffs are also very friendly. They even rembember my family when i came back here 4 months later.

The ambience is also good because it usually play uplifting music.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nabilla Nur Selina

sample_reviews_en.text: Such a charming little spot right outside our beautiful hotel overlooking the Grand Palace. The gentleman who worked there was so kind and even recommended a few local places to check out nearby. The food was absolutely amazing! It was our first time trying Pad Thai in Thailand, and we were a bit nervous because we wanted to make sure we picked the right place. Thankfully, this spot did not disappoint, the Pad Thai was perfect. I got a Thai tea, and my husband tried a mango juice, and we also ordered freshly made gyoza. You have to try this place. It’s absolutely bomb!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chinkie Abad

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very good local Thai restaurant near Wat Pho.
The food is simple but very authentic.

I ordered Thai fried rice with shrimp — well seasoned, not too oily, topped with crispy fried shallots which added great texture. The fried chicken was crispy outside and juicy inside, freshly made.

The fresh coconut was very refreshing in Bangkok heat, and the smoothie was smooth and natural.

Prices are reasonable for this tourist area, and the quality is better than many restaurants nearby.
Good stop after visiting Wat Pho.

Would definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fengyan Du

sample_reviews_en.text: Really good stuff here. Food is DELICIOUS like, no joke. Service is quick. Hospitality is like TOP PRIORITY here, it's lovely. You can ask for spicy or less spicy food. Drinks are equally good. Menu has huge variety. Atmosphere has that Café aesthetic to it and it's pretty comfortable. The only thing is that there's low amount of seats and tables. Close to the Temples and Palace too, so it's a plus to be here
sample_reviews_en.author: TJ

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything tastes so good in Bangkok and All Meals Sawasdee is one of those restaurants with some delicious options. We tried their Morning Glory, Fried Rice with Vegetable and also Noodles. We had Hot Mocha and enjoyed their amazing Stick Rice with Mango. All in all we paid around 500 and were happily full. The owners are very kind and friendly and the music was really good. We had a really good time there!
sample_reviews_en.author: Onur

sample_reviews_en.text: This traditional mom-and-pop Thai restaurant is a hidden gem! The food was fantastic, especially the chicken cashew, which was perfectly seasoned and flavorful. The stir-fried basil was an excellent choice, as always—full of authentic Thai flavors. To top it off, the watermelon shake was simply amazing—refreshing and delicious! If you’re looking for a cozy spot with great food, this place is a must-visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: LENK

restaurants.name: Tonchin Ramen - Siam Paragon
restaurants.address:

ชั้น G Siam Paragon, 991 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The miso ramen cost 270฿, but it only had one thin slice of pork. It's not worth the price at all. Previously, when I've had it, they'd give me two slices if the pork was this thin. I'm very disappointed.
sample_reviews_th.author: Amnichey

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to Tonchin in Bangkok, Thailand. This time I ordered the seafood tsukemen (dipping noodles). What impressed me most compared to Japanese tsukemen restaurants was the generous amount of dipping sauce. In Japan, you often run out of sauce halfway through and can't fully dip the noodles at the end, but here there was plenty to enjoy until the very end, which I was very satisfied with. The dipping sauce, which had a strong seafood flavor, was a little on the lighter side for tsukemen, but it was well-balanced and delicious. It was rich enough that I could drink it all without adding any extra broth. I think even those who love Japanese tsukemen will be satisfied with this dish.
sample_reviews_en.author: tk tk

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's great to be able to eat Japanese-style ramen in Bangkok. The location is also convenient. It's not on the first floor, but on the lower G floor. Since it's not a food court, it's not too crowded. Even though it was just after noon on a holiday, we were seated right away with a group of five.

The soup was a little on the thin side, but the flavor itself was delicious. The noodles were curly, but they were a bit disappointing. It was a shame they had the feel of instant noodles you'd get in school lunches.

The staff support was also good. However, the second-floor seating area was unfortunately hot.

I think it's a good place to go with children.
sample_reviews_en.author: I Y

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ramen shop is located near the mall entrance, a great location.
It has seating on two floors.
The ground floor has a counter bar and small tables.
The upper floor has about 7-8 tables.
For lunch, I recommend sitting downstairs because
the upper floor is hot.

The ramen noodles these days look pretty much the same at every shop.
They're usually made firm like instant noodles and then boiled.
The result is curly, instant noodle-like noodles, not fresh noodles.
This detracts from the taste, especially considering the price.

The broth is rich and flavorful.

The pork is not mushy but tender.

The service is very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khongwut Aries

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ramen is delicious: rich broth, balanced ingredients, and a generous portion. Arguably the most delicious I've ever had.

There aren't many vegetarian options; almost everything is pork-based. But there's still plenty to choose from.
They have Japanese and local beer, including draft.

The place itself is small, inside a shopping center, but secluded. It's two floors.

The staff is very considerate. They brought us European cutlery when they saw we weren't quite comfortable using chopsticks (but we eventually got the hang of it).
sample_reviews_en.author: Arina Mudrenova

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited Tonchin Ramen today and had a generally good experience. The food was solid, and the meal altogether—as seen in the photo—cost around 1,000 Baht, which is quite reasonable for the quality and portion size. The broth was rich, the noodles had a great chew, and the overall vibe was very satisfying. It is definitely a place worth checking out if you are craving a proper bowl of Tokyo-style ramen.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongsarit Rodruangdej

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best ramen places I’ve tried. The Kaguni Black Garlic Ramen, a special menu available only at the Siam Paragon branch, is definitely worth trying. The braised pork is tender and flavorful, while the black garlic gives the broth a rich and unique taste. Everything comes together really well. If you love ramen, this is one bowl I’d definitely recommend trying at least once.
sample_reviews_en.author: KNKR

sample_reviews_en.text: The ramen restaurant looked inviting from the outside. Personally, I love intensely spiced food, so the flavors here really appealed to me. The meat melted in my mouth. The portion was very generous, enough to fill my stomach. The soup overall was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adam Prymaka

restaurants.name: Shabu King Rama9
restaurants.address:

29, Rama IX Soi 37, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really like the soup, sauces, and ingredients here. Everything feels more customized and higher quality compared to many other shabu places, and the prices are very reasonable too. I’ve visited many times because overall the food is consistently good.

The only thing I’d like to suggest improving is the service regarding orders. Almost every time I visit, there are missing items that were not served, even though they still appear on the bill. Sometimes I also need to repeatedly call the staff to confirm my order before receiving everything. The staff are always polite and nice, which is why I keep coming back, but when you’re really hungry, it can get a little frustrating to deal with.

Overall, still one of my favorite places and I’ll definitely continue visiting!
sample_reviews_en.author: Montira J

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I visited the Rama 9 branch and had the 799 net buffet. The food was delicious, the meat was of very high quality, and the ingredients were fresh. I ordered strip loin steak and salmon sashimi repeatedly. The sushi was also delicious, and the tempura shrimp was good – plump shrimp with a thin, crispy batter that wasn't oily. The legendary black soup was flavorful, not overly salty, and retained its original taste even after simmering for a long time. The clear soup was also tasty and easy to drink. The vanilla toast was amazing, and the Hokkaido fresh milk ice cream was fragrant and creamy. The matcha green tea was very strong. There was a good variety of dishes, and I enjoyed eating so much that I didn't even take pictures. There was ample parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kla Klanarong

sample_reviews_en.text: I was disappointed with the overall service experience. The staff and manager did not demonstrate the level of friendliness, attentiveness, or customer care that I would expect.During my visit with my wife, we had different dining preferences, and the proposed solution was for us to sit at separate tables. I believe there were more customer-friendly ways to handle the situation. When I offered a suggestion, it was not seriously considered, and the manager did not make an effort to assist in finding a reasonable solution.The issue itself was straightforward and could have been resolved easily. Unfortunately, the lack of service mindset turned a simple situation into an unpleasant experience. As a result, I am unlikely to visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: nitithorn

sample_reviews_en.text: For 799 baht, the salmon was a complete disaster. It didn't match the pictures at all. I saw other reviews that looked good, and I tried to think positively, maybe the first order was a smaller portion, so I ordered a second plate, but it was the same size and quality. That's it. Where's the standard? The shabu-shabu was okay, and there were four dipping sauces, but (personally), only the ponzu was good. I was extremely disappointed with the food quality. Look at the picture; the salmon sashimi pieces are practically the size of chopsticks – I've never seen anything like it at this price before! 🥲🥲🥲
sample_reviews_en.author: Sathita Asamor

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish tasted amazing. The black soup is a must-try. The appetizers stole the show, like the Thai-style salmon salad – incredibly delicious! The salmon rolls were also excellent. But what really made me want to go back was the dessert! I can't remember the name, but it was a caramel toast topped with both chocolate and vanilla ice cream (I'm still drooling while typing this!). The staff were very attentive and provided great service. The atmosphere both inside and outside the restaurant was fantastic, just like being in Japan. And importantly, the prices were very reasonable!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirimuay J

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious.
The service was disappointing. Some dishes were incomplete, and some arrived late; we had to keep asking for them.

The atmosphere was very disappointing. Around 5 pm, the sun shone directly into the restaurant, and the restaurant arranged the tables facing the full sun. The Japanese-style curtains were ineffective in blocking the sun. The staff tried to use a sign, but it was too short and ineffective.
The air conditioning wasn't strong enough; it couldn't overcome the heat from the grill. After eating for a while, it became extremely hot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyanuch Lertvilaisak

sample_reviews_en.text: I had booked a room, but when I arrived, they said they had given the room to someone else because the person with a similar name had booked it. I've never heard of anything like this happening with a reservation before. I'm completely unacceptable. The staff just kept apologizing, but what good is that? I had foreigners, elderly people, and people with mobility issues in my group. I was so angry and humiliated. I used to eat there often, but I won't go back again. We came all the way from Rama IV, which made it even more infuriating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Banpod P

sample_reviews_en.text:
High price, but delicious, especially the meat.
The food is clean, the vegetables are thoroughly washed (impressive).
The meats, including beef, pork, and pork belly, are sliced ​​to the perfect size.
The soup is clear, delicious, and well-balanced.
The sesame dipping sauce is tasty.
The staff provides excellent service and is neatly dressed in head coverings.
The restaurant is relatively new and clean.
Plenty of parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manapan Kunjara

restaurants.name: The Gardens of Dinsor Palace
restaurants.address:

1217/2 ซอย ชุมพล Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Garden of Dinsor Palace, Bangkok

Tucked away in the heart of Bangkok, The Garden of Dinsor Palace is a charming and elegant spot that offers a peaceful escape from the city's hustle. Housed in a beautifully restored European-style mansion that once belonged to royalty, this place is more than just a restaurant — it’s an experience.

The ambiance is serene and romantic, with lush green gardens, swan-filled ponds, and cozy seating both indoors and outdoors. Whether you're enjoying a quiet brunch or a candlelit dinner, the setting is perfect for a relaxing meal.

The menu offers a variety of Thai and international dishes with a modern twist. I tried the truffle pasta and the grilled salmon — both were flavorful and beautifully presented. The desserts and coffee were equally impressive.

It’s also a great spot for photos, with its elegant architecture and garden views. Service is attentive, and the atmosphere is peaceful, making it ideal for dates, gatherings, or even solo unwinding.
sample_reviews_en.author: Md. Rehan Alam

sample_reviews_en.text:
An absolutely beautiful location set back from the main road in lush gardens.
Fountains ⛲️ everywhere you look and even a pond.
The menu talks about the history of the gardens as a palace and if the various special trees.
The menu is varied and offers plenty of choice.
R chose a pasta dish that was ambitious but slightly spoilt by the inclusion of too many ingredients.
My prawns were only just warm enough but tasted fine, as did the fries. Unusually for Thailand all our food came out at the same time, which was a bonus.
This would be a great place for a large family or friends gathering as it is vast and there are lots of attentive waiting staff. Id definitely recommend giving it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amanda Dickson

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was married here and couldn't have asked for a better place.  The garden was lovely.  It was adorned with a beautiful fountain,  swan lake, white peacock and white rabbits. The wedding decorations were just an added touch.

There are several rooms at this venue because it once was a palace for a princess. On the upper level my husband and I  had private rooms for our bridal party and to change our clothes for our multiple ceremonies. Each room has its own climate control too.

We had an international buffet and it was delicious.  The open bar kept the drinks flowing for all of our guests to enjoy! We highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: MsKel

sample_reviews_en.text: We had an amazing experience with the venue, catering, sequence runner, and decoration team. Everything was very well organized and professionally handled from start to finish. The team took great care of every detail throughout the event. The venue was clean and well prepared, the food was delicious and beautifully presented, and the decoration matched our theme perfectly. Special thanks to the sequence runner for taking care of the timeline and ensuring everything ran smoothly. Our guests were very happy, and we received many compliments. Highly recommended for a stress-free and memorable event!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thura Tun

sample_reviews_en.text: A cute little eatery with brunch and lunch options. This is a restaurant with a lovely garden setting with a small pond with a bridge and swans. There are also rabbits which staff will be happy to provide fresh lettuce for children to feed the rabbits with. There is also a small enclosure where you can see pigeons, rabbits and peacocks congregate so I would recommend asking for a table to be close to this. There is outdoor seating also and a small play area with a slide for younger children.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ka Ping Man

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was alright but the ambience was great. We were seated outside at noon worrying if it was going to be too hot for our group since we had kids with us. Turned out it was not hot at all. The trees did their great jobs giving us shades and everything. We got to see some white and black swans and a couple of peacocks. And it was Christmas Day we went they had a all those props on table and Santa for pictures and he gave out the goodies to the kids too. Wonderful experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sherry Papa

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited here with my regional team from England to celebrate, and overall it was a good experience. 🦚🥂The gardens offer a peaceful and relaxed atmosphere that’s perfect for a team gathering, and the natural setting really made our celebration memorable. One highlight was the big white peacock inside—he was incredibly charming and elegant, adding a unique touch to the ambiance. While the venue isn’t overly fancy, it provides a great backdrop for quality time together. 🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaithawat Dongcharoaen

sample_reviews_en.text: Lovely place. Location is good too. Just about 300m walk from Ekkamai station, next to Fullerton hotel. The restaurant has a big park kind of area and there are many squirrels that are on the tree for guests to see. There is also a big swan reared by the restaurant and some albino peacocks also. Food is very good too. Tried their crab meat pasta & it was very very good. Staffs’ service are very efficient & helpful too. Will definitely be back again in future
sample_reviews_en.author: Joey Choo

restaurants.name: Tamnanthai Restaurant Nana-Ploenchit
restaurants.address:

18 Sukhumvit 4 Alley, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
This restaurant offers truly authentic Thai food that is absolutely delicious. The flavor is fantastic, and the ingredients are superb—everything is prepared incredibly fresh and clean!!

​A real highlight is that they use freshly pounded curry pastes (เครื่องแกงตำใหม่), which makes the taste exceptionally rich and authentic.
​The restaurant itself is very clean, and the staff is attentive and caring. They also offer a great selection of beers.
​And, whatever you do, don't forget to try the cocktails! They are excellent.
sample_reviews_th.author: Nirada SNN

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very overrated and extremely disappointing.

The total bill came up to THB 3,655, which is far too expensive for the quality and portions served. Overall, the food was mediocre, bland, and lacking authentic Thai character.

The Tom Yum Goong was the biggest let-down. A proper tom yum should be sweet, sour, spicy, and aromatic, but this version had no punch, no heat, and no depth — completely flat.

The crab meat with curry powder was equally underwhelming. The sauce was milky and dull, with no umami or fragrance, making it feel very one-dimensional despite the premium price.

Even the three-flavour fish lacked umami and balance. It tasted muted and forgettable, missing the bold sweet-sour-savoury contrast the dish is known for. Thai fish cake was bland and oily

The vegetable dish portion was shockingly small for the price, more like a garnish than a proper sharing dish.

The only item worth mentioning was the shrimp cake — nicely fried with a springy (QQ) bite. Unfortunately, one decent dish cannot justify the overall experience.

Verdict:
For this price point, there is far better Thai food on the street with stronger flavours and better value.
First and last visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hew Helen

sample_reviews_en.text:
A real hidden gem in the Nana area. Restaurant is a bit hidden, have to go through a parking lot and an alley to get there. The area is clean and well maintained. The restaurant has some potted plants outside to give it that extra cosy feeling. This trend continues inside as well. Inside is clean and nicely decorated. The staff is very friendly as well. We were even offered umbrella’s when we left because it was pouring 🙂. Thanks Au!

They offer some Thai craft beers on top of the other beers and soda usually available. The food is mostly Thai and definitely a big upgrade from the street food widely offered in the area. We even came back for dinner after we had a lunch here.

If you’re looking for a more refined dining experience offering Thai food in the area, this is the place you’re looking for. A true hidden gem!
sample_reviews_en.author: Noah De Lauw

sample_reviews_en.text:
This spot was recommended with great confidence by the doorman at our hotel. We were staying at the JW close by and it took less than 10 mins to walk to the restaurant. Thanks to the good folks here, was able to find the place easily as it’s sort of tucked away from the main street down a short lane way.

We were not impressed by the food however, especially given the price point. Flavours were fine, herbaceous and colourful, but just a bit off. Particularly odd was the green curry which was unusually watery. We also got the morning glory veg and a half serving of the deep fried sea bass - again not bad but just not good either considering how accessible and easy it is to find amazing food in Thailand. I’m sure folks would be able to find better options close by.
sample_reviews_en.author: Helen

sample_reviews_en.text:
I found a Thai restaurant with truly authentic flavors 👍👍👍 I want to say that I had a very delicious Gaeng Liang (Thai vegetable soup), and the shrimp was very fresh and sweet 🍤🍤 The Yam Woon Sen (Thai glass noodle salad) was very well made, the noodles were chewy and soft, and the flavor was perfect – not too sweet and not too sour 👌👌👌 And I had dessert, and I have to say it was so delicious I forgot to take a picture 🤣🤣🤣 I highly recommend this restaurant, Tam Nan Thai. The restaurant is very clean, the staff are super friendly, and there are plenty of tables, making it great for groups. It's conveniently located near Nana BTS station, just a short walk 🚶‍♀️🚶‍♀️🚶‍♀️ to the restaurant. 👌👌👌👌👌

They have a very diverse Thai menu, and I'm sure I'll be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tukta Punsala

sample_reviews_en.text: So glad we came here during our trip!! The food is the best Thai food we had here, so good and so authentic!! We had shrimp cake, tom yum mixed seafood, crispy pork vegetable stir fry, papaya salad, shrimp curry and basil pork rice. That was a lot of food but they were all so delicious, we loved the shrimp cake (so crispy and juicy and umami), the crispy pork vege ( the pork is really really good) and tom yum soup (so tangy and refreshing). Also their coconut ice cream is house made, it’s the best coconut ice cream I had in Bangkok, it has coconut meat bits inside. And the mango sticky rice is also amazing, the mango is really sweet, and sticky rice is a little salty and really creamy. Loved Tamnanthai!! We’ll definitely be back❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Candice Cao

sample_reviews_en.text:
We are visiting from the U.S.. This is our 3rd dining in this place and we are coming back over and over again!

They have English menu. Owner Auau is the sweetest lady and the staffs are all very friendly.

Great location as it’s only mins of walk from Nana station. Nice ambiance and cleanness in the restaurant as well as the restrooms.
Then to the food; we ordered shrimp cake, stir fry greens, crispy pork belly, and fried fish with lemon grass, mango and cashew sauce glazed on top.
You can taste real shrimp in the shrimp cake. The cashew sauce is scrumptious and the fish is cleaned well and fresh. Crispy pork belly is my husband’s favorite, the crispy skin with pork fat go amazingly well, and it does not taste too oily.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pan Phoebe

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tamnanthai Restaurant in the Nana–Ploenchit area is a great place to enjoy authentic Thai cuisine. The food is full of traditional flavors, well-cooked, and nicely presented. Every dish tastes fresh and perfectly seasoned, especially the curries and classic Thai dishes.

The restaurant has a warm, comfortable ambiance, making it ideal for both casual meals and relaxed dinners. The staff is friendly, polite, and quick to serve, which makes the overall experience even better.

If you’re in the Nana–Ploenchit area and craving real Thai food, Tamnanthai Restaurant is definitely worth a visit. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael

restaurants.name: Sutunthip Vegan
restaurants.address:

36 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Khwaeng Bang Lamphu Lang, Khet Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a delicious and flavorful vegetarian restaurant with everything you could want. You can order almost anything on the menu. The char siu pork buns are delicious.
You absolutely must order the vegetarian crab claws; they are amazing.
The Hong Kong style stir-fried noodles, stir-fried water spinach noodles, vegetable fried rice, and crispy fried water spinach are all excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Meme Chanel

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and the atmosphere is nice, but there's only parking for two cars. More parking options are needed. Several times I've arrived and couldn't find a parking spot, so I had to eat at another restaurant. Inside the alley, every house has a "no parking" sign or a "private parking" sign.

If this could be improved, it would be great. Thank you very much.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chakraphong HATHAISUTTHI

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves Vegetarian Thai food. It has been a great pleasure to eat at every visit I have made to the restaurant. It is a simple cozy restaurant. The staff are very friendly and helpful they always greet and talk to you with a smile. The food wait time is low and has never been disappointing as "YOU ALWAYS GET WHAT YOU GO FOR."
sample_reviews_en.author: Pranay Sodhani

sample_reviews_en.text: This vegetarian restaurant offers a wide variety of delicious dishes. The food is tasty, the restaurant is clean, the staff are polite and provide excellent service, and the food arrives quickly. The air conditioning is very cool inside. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: นัทฐ์ชนันดา พิพัฒทยานัน

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish at this vegan restaurant was surprisingly delicious. Everyone in my family loved it. We'll definitely go again. The prices are very reasonable; you can order a full table of dishes and it still won't be as expensive as in the mall.
sample_reviews_en.author: I want to watch 789

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food. Would love to come here again and again. Authorities Thai food but VEGETARIAN. YES EVETHING HERE IS 100% vegetarian And Super delicious too. I do not enjoy coconut flavour so I thought I may not enjoy Thai food. But this …
sample_reviews_en.author: Meena Jain

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing Thai vegan restaurant! The food is absolutely delicious, with wonderful flavors and great presentation. Even if you’re not vegan, it’s definitely worth trying. Everything we ordered was tasty and satisfying. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sam Danesh

sample_reviews_en.text: I‘ve been to some vegan places before but this is probably one of the best I’ve ever been - had the vegan fish and the satay „chicken“ and it was absolutely delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jakob Ortner

restaurants.name: Boon Tong Kee (บุญตงกี่) ซีคอนสแควร์ ศรีนครินทร์
restaurants.address:

55 Srinagarindra Rd, Nong Bon, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Nice restaurant with a clean atmosphere and friendly staff. Service was quick and efficient, and the food arrived promptly.

The ข้าวมันไก่ (Hainanese chicken rice) was delicious and full of flavor. Everything we ordered was well prepared and satisfying. Prices are in the mid-to-upper range, but not overly expensive considering the quality and restaurant setting.

The restaurant wasn't very busy when we visited, which made for a relaxed dining experience.

Overall, a great place for chicken rice and other Singaporean-style dishes. I'd happily come back again.

ข้าวมันไก่อร่อยมาก! 👍
sample_reviews_th.author: Meng Thao

sample_reviews_en.text:
I booked the Boontongkee Buffet Package for 599 THB.

The food came out fairly quickly, made fresh to order. The fried items weren't greasy. The soup and Hainanese chicken rice were the same as ordering à la carte. It was very good value. However, some menu items didn't have portion size information, so it was unclear whether I would get a small or large serving.

The service was quite good, although some staff seemed a little confused.

The atmosphere was nice, but I suggest considering separating the dining area for families with children to another side of the restaurant, as we encountered a family with children who weren't properly supervised and kept running into our table.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sooksira G

sample_reviews_en.text:
The good Spot for Classic Singapore Chicken Rice!

We enjoyed a delicious chicken rice meal at Boon Tong Kee Seacon Square. The star of this meal, of course, was the boiled chicken. It was incredibly tender and flavorful, with perfectly cooked rice that captured the essence of chicken fat.

We also ordered few great selection of side dishes to complement the chicken rice.

Overall, this restaurant is a reliable choice for a satisfying and authentic Singapore chicken rice experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr Bob Wongti

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken is by far the juiciest. I'm a big fan of kao man Kai but I prefer juicy meat than the dry chewy ones that some people enjoy. Plus this place is cleaaaan. The rice is not mildly oily and the sauce is not too spicy. However! There are only 2 servers here so everything is slow and not so professional. Price is a bit higher than street food chicken rice but with the juiciness and cleanliness, I'll take it.  Also since it's in a mall it's an open space so it's loud.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jo K

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is consistently good every time I eat here...the chicken is so tender...served with pickled vegetables...if you ask for more, it's only 20 baht...unlimited dipping sauce too!...I also ordered Hokkien fried noodles...the aroma was amazing...they currently have a promotion on crispy pork...it's incredibly delicious...I have to go try it again...they have many branches.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanarat Khamsukh

sample_reviews_en.text:
The chicken is thick, tender, and not greasy, and the dipping sauce is even better. The stir-fried green beans aren't oily like typical Chinese food. The best dish is the garlic liver, perfectly cooked.

This is Singaporean Chinese food that's not greasy at all, and surprisingly feels healthy, especially when paired with refreshing calamansi plum juice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pavalin Limthongchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered a chicken platter for one person with one serving of rice. My food arrived in less than 5 minutes.

I'm a light eater, so this was just the right amount to fill me up. If you have a bigger appetite, you might need to order a larger size.

The chicken was delicious, and the vegetables were sweet and crispy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pong6uod

sample_reviews_en.text: Soft and juicy boiled chicken with a tasty sauce (mixed ginger & chilly) eat with Hainanese style rice.  XS size is good portion for hungry 1 person. Also the Stir Fried Morning Glory here is unique by mixture of Morning Glory with Chinese chilly (Sichuan Chilly, I guess), garlic.  Must try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gunn Polparsi

restaurants.name: Mook Restaurant
restaurants.address:

64 ซอย วัดสังเวช, Wat Sam Phraya, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: This place is a gem, unmissable if you step in Bangkok. ผัดกะเพราหมู (phat kaphrao moo) was the best one I had in Thailand (having tried dozens) being juicy, fragrant, comforting, as well as the ผัดซีอิ๊ว (pad see ew) which is perfectly balanced sweet/savory, rich in veggies, and not dry or pale. The staff is friendly, truly making your day better, and there is great communication and accomodation as to spice tolerance. The variety of dishes they offer is impressive, making it ideal for any taste and diet. Service is attentive, and ambience is lovely. It’s situated in a calm corner of the Old Town, and feels timeless and serene, it feels like dining with a family even though mine is on the other side of the world 🥹
sample_reviews_th.author: Eleonora Sofia Bianco

sample_reviews_th.text:
Best restaurant in Bangkok.

Best Pad Thai with shrimps.

The service very friendly! By a local family.

We came here 3 times on a 4 day stay in Bangkok! If it opened at night would have also come.

Great pad thai, shrimps with sweet sauce and great cashew chicken.

ขอบคุณค่ะ
sample_reviews_th.author: Camila

sample_reviews_th.text:
If you want local food and vibes, this is the place!
The staff was amazing and the food is just incredible!
I ate there almost everyday and this is the first place I'll visit when I comeback!

ขอบคุณค่ะ Pii 🙏🏻
sample_reviews_th.author: Ana Padilla

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is just a great restaurant that I will miss. It's a pity that I found it on the penultimate day of my stay in the city... Here you will get perfectly cooked (the way they cook for Asians) food, it will be spicy, full of taste. It was difficult for me to go to restaurants in Bangkok, because they saw my European appearance and did not give spicy food. In this restaurant, the staff does not make a big difference between Thais and foreigners, they are friendly with everyone, they cook beautifully, give large portions. This is not a stylish cafe in a tourist area, but if you want to try what Thais themselves eat, go to this restaurant.
Tom yum was divine, pad thai was very beautiful and tasty (but I am not a big fan of this dish and do not understand how to do it correctly), papaya salad was very refreshing.
Perhaps, this was my most positive emotion regarding Bangkok food 💕
sample_reviews_en.author: TatyanKA G

sample_reviews_en.text: I don’t think I could ever write a review to make this place justice. The food is so delicious that after trying it one day for breakfast I went back again for lunch and then again for dinner, and I returned every single day of my stay in Bangkok. The service is so friendly, the owner is so sweet and taught me some thai words after having just landed in Thailand a few hours prior, and the whole family is always friendly and attentive. I had the beef pad see ew, shrimp tom yam, som tum thai (papaya salad), chicken pad thai, a minced pork dish with rice and egg, mango shake, banana shake over the course of the few days I went there and everything was a solid 10/10. The price is so good and the feel of the place is super local. This family deserves everything good coming their way. Khop Khun Kâ! Aroy mâ mâ mâ mâ mâ!
sample_reviews_en.author: Elodie Ouellette

sample_reviews_en.text: not to mention that it’s super yummy, it is seasoned to perfection. not too salty and not too sweet or spicy. quantity and quality, they have both. And very friendly and kind. So I can say that they are perfect overall in terms of quantity and quality of food and hospitality 😁 plus price is super cheap 😁 usually when it’s cheap, portion or taste is not great. But this restaurant is an exception 😊👍 just one more thing for your information, I went there alone and I paid 250 baht. Because I personally eat a lot in general and ordered 4 dishes and one coke zero(20 baht). So it’s still super cheap considering everything. 😇
sample_reviews_en.author: Donggeun Choi

sample_reviews_en.text:
It starts at the door, where you have to take off your shoes as you are greeted in a warm way.

You move to a table and look at the menu, the hostess will tell you if they don't have something - in our case, they did not have any chicken so we had to choose between pork, seafood or vegetarian.

We ordered green curry(pork) with rice, coconut soup(vegetarian) and pad thai(shrimp) - this was so good that we ordered rice with cashew and pork to go.

This is a respectable, family run business and i hope that everyone tries this place out even if it is just once.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shane Terry

sample_reviews_en.text:
I can see why this place has so many 5 star reviews. Im absolutely in love with this place. The family running this little food spot is so kind and loving. The food was incredible, to come inside you must take your shoes off and youre greeted by a kind family ready to serve delicious food. The daughters help their mother and father here.
This place has taught me more about Love than anywhere else I've eaten.
Highly recommend getting the crispy fried pork with the egg and the tom yum soup!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanner Fleming

restaurants.name: Zanotti IL Ristorante Italiano
restaurants.address:

โคโลเน็ด คอนโดมิเนียม, 21 Sala Daeng Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I had my special celebration at Zinotti and it was simply wonderful. My friends and I were celebrating a special occasion and the team at Zinotti took great care of us and made our evening memorable.The food was delicious, with each dish perfectly cooked and presented beautifully. The atmosphere was cozy and comfortable, and we were lucky enough to secure a corner table. It was not too busy that evening, which meant we were able to enjoy our meal and conversations without any disturbance. The restaurant has a modern Italian setting with ambient lighting and a stylish interior, which added to the experience. Overall, Zinotti Italian Restaurant is a good Italian spot for anyone looking for delicious Italian cuisine in a comfortable setting. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone who wants to enjoy great food, attentive service.
sample_reviews_en.author: HL

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was missing this wonderful place from 19 years! But after a so long time they give me the same emotions. A Sanctuary of Italian Cooking where taste remain the same who make me feeling the same taste and flavours of two decades ago. Agnolotti del Plin was an unforgettable dumpling from Piedmont seasoned with a gorgeous truffled roast meat sauce where is not possibile do not clean the plate with the very good homemade complimentary italian bread. Tiramisù a great classic very well executed. With a crispy extrafresh complimentary sweet deepfried pasta and a complimentary sweet wine (Moscato d'Asti).
Very nice and large wine list for all pockets, including a good selection by the glass.
sample_reviews_en.author: claudio pistocchi

sample_reviews_en.text: The tables were arranged too close together. It would be better if there was more space between them. I didn't want to hear what the people at the next table were saying while we were eating. The staff kept coming around to check on us, but we counted three times that plates slammed together loudly. I don't know if other tables received this kind of service, but both I and the people at my table felt it was too frequent and unprofessional for someone in this field. And we would have appreciated an apology from the staff, but they seemed indifferent. Considering the price, we felt the food quality wasn't worth it. There are other restaurants with better value and atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: G. Chai

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Pizza and Pasta are absolute favorites here. The other main dishes aren't as good (steak, fish are like 3 stars) so the quality balances out. They also have the best free appetizers (fried onion) and bread.

Expect a heavy price tag of around THB 750+ per person.

Recommend to get the cheaper still Singha bottle water otherwise the waiters will rip you off with their default mineral water which is a couple hundred baht per bottle. Honestly could have been more transparent about it, should inform all guests. We incurred around THB 1-2K in plain water when it was supposed to be much cheaper.

Parking is underneath the restaurant on the saladaeng soi.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kris Supavatanakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent Italian restaurant, still maintaining the same high standards of food and service many years later.
All of the food is good whatever you choose you won't be disappointed. The level of service is exceptional, I have not dined here for the last 5 years yet the waiting staff still remember us well in great detail. There is a large wine list and the 2 bottles of prosecco we had were both perfect you will be delighted from the moment you arrive until you leave. The price is quite high but worth it. Only one negative point I noticed after leaving I was charged for 5 beers although we only had 4 but given the overall cost this was insignificant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nathan Wallbridge

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wow!! still excellent after so many years.

10/5 it's that good for me!
Food quality: 10/10
Taste: 12/10
Environment: 10/10
Service:10/10
Parking: underground parking.

The ambient of restaurant is very good, dimly lit, great tasting Italian food, the dishes are very well presented.

Premium service, water refilled continuously, plates exchanged often, well staffed.

Great wine and alcohol selections for you meal.

It is definitely a great place for a birthday or dinner party.

Fully loaded table for 8 people cost about $220 ($28/person).

Highly recommended. A bit of a walk if you are coming from the MRT.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Smith

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍽️ My Italian Lunch Set

My lunch set today was simple yet absolutely satisfying.

I started with a fresh salad — light, crisp, and refreshing. It was the perfect way to begin the meal.

For the main course, I had lasagna. Rich, flavorful, and perfectly baked with layers of pasta, savory meat sauce, and creamy cheese melting together beautifully. Every bite was warm and comforting — true Italian style.

To finish, I enjoyed vanilla ice cream and Kiwi ice cream.refreshing and balanced ending to the meal.

A perfect lunch set that made my day extra special. 🇮🇹✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Nantikan Intasit

sample_reviews_en.text:
From beginning with complimentary of bread basket and fried onion is already a good starting. And doesn’t take long to wait for pizza to come out

The dish that shouldn’t be missed is the half truffle and parma ham pizza.

As you see in the vdo, chef will come to slice truffle at your table until in cover half of the pizza.

Tirasumi is taste even better with sweet wine got as a complimentary from Zanotti

Service is great, parking also available so definite coming back again
sample_reviews_en.author: Namfon P

restaurants.name: The Seafood Cafe & Restaurant
restaurants.address:

51/1 Phadung Dao Rd, Khwaeng Samphanthawong, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The giant river prawns were outstanding! These things were half of the width of the table. Fresh, buttery, sweet, some of the best prawns I've had to date. Highly recommend! Our total bill came to around 2,800฿ total for the five dishes.
sample_reviews_th.author: D T

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Seafood Cafe & Restaurant offers an impressive selection of seafood at very affordable prices. Conveniently located in the heart of Chinatown, just off the main Night Market strip, it turned out to be a perfect alternative when the market itself became overwhelming. The Night Market was absolute mayhem—crowded to the point that finding a table where you could eat comfortably without being bumped into felt impossible.

We decided to have dinner here instead, and I’m so glad we did. We ordered the stir-fried grouper, grilled squid, and stir-fried water mimosa. Every dish was a delight—well seasoned, beautifully cooked, and full of flavor. Each bite felt thoughtfully prepared and satisfying.
A quick heads-up for future diners: the grilled squid comes with its eggs intact, which have a slightly slimy texture that may not be for everyone. The stir-fried water mimosa can also be quite spicy, but the staff is happy to adjust the heat level—mild, slightly spicy, or not spicy at all—upon request.

After dinner, we stepped back into the lively chaos of Chinatown Night Market for dessert and even treated ourselves to a foot massage. It was the perfect ending to a lovely night.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andre Jr Tache

sample_reviews_en.text:
Premium eat all you can buffet for 2 hrs., booked on HungryHub. Group of 4.
The premium item was crab. Small sized. Not fresh. Overcooked or undercooked.
Not worth the extra bahts. Better to go with the standard buffet.
Besides other items on Hungry Hub website not available on menu. And some premium items on menu not available any longer.

Service was quick except about 40 mins in our third order was not communicated to the kitchen. So after a lengthy pause and after two reminders, our 3rd and 4th orders arrived simultaneously.

The star of the show was the perfectly grilled sweet river prawns. Close second - plump fresh oysters ( probably Nakhom Si Thammarat).

No matter which, the stir fries all were sweet- so were the the dips. We had to hang on to the extra chillies from the garlic and birds eye chilli scallops, for heat.

The seafood clear soup was a worthy palate cleanser; the tom yum was the sweet, creamy version, not hot and sour.

Overall, recommend the standard buffet or order à la carte.
sample_reviews_en.author: Review Mutt

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came here because there were quite a lot of marketing this decided to give it a try.

Atmosphere was great just that it felt a bit hot and couldn’t really feel the aircon.

Fried Prawn Cakes were great and great portion size. Calms were garlic forward and fresh. The Steam Sea Bass in Spicy Garlic and Lime Soup was amazing and fresh but really spicy so just be cautious about it if you can’t handle spice. The Tom Yum Nam Sai was also amazing just for the base itself but also be cautious because it’s on the spicy end too.Enjoyed their 1for1 cocktail selections since the spice was a big kick to us.

The really disappointing dish which is actually one of their promoted dishes was the Fried Prawn coated with almond with their truffle sauce. Fell flat, didn’t have much taste and not crispy nor hot. Truffle sauce was alright.

Overall, great atmosphere, great food and service was good too. Would recommend those that are going to eat here to try their Thai dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarah

sample_reviews_en.text:
After looking for the best-rated spots in Bangkok’s Chinatown, we decided on this restaurant, and it certainly lived up to the hype. We ordered the Deep Fried Sea Bass with Three-Flavor Sauce, which was perfectly cooked and a generous portion for two. The Tom Yum Seafood was incredibly authentic—rich, aromatic, and packed with fresh shrimp and mushrooms, served piping hot on a small stove. Another standout was the Oyster Egg, which offered a delightful contrast in texture thanks to the fresh, crunchy bean sprouts underneath.

The service was excellent. Although there was a bit of a language barrier, the staff were incredibly friendly, prompt, and attentive to all our requests. We were also treated to a complimentary mocktail that was absolutely sensational—refreshing and high-quality.

Overall, this is a must-visit in Chinatown. The food is fresh, flavorful, and very reasonably priced. We will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: rustam thomas

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dining at The Seafood Cafe and Restaurant this evening has been very enjoyable.  We ordered the set menu for 3 where you pick a dish from each section and every dish we tried was absolutely delicious.  The grilled lobster in garlic butter was a showstopper.  It was huge and the meat was chunky and tender.  It’s a classic dish and was
perfectly prepared.  The crab fried rice was so good with chunks of crab meat on top.  We also ordered the crab with pepper sauce which was perfectly prepared as well as the jumbo prawn coated in almonds.  My paradise punch mocktail was very cutely presented and came with a mini goblet of grapes.  Our dessert was mango with sticky rice which was highly  recommended by our waitress.  She was so right and was happy we ordered it.  We’re so glad we had our dinner here, the food was amazing, you won’t be disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Connie Ho

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste at this restaurant is truly exceptional, with each dish brimming with unique aromas and layers of flavor, especially the seafood dishes, which are incredibly fresh, melting in your mouth and leaving a lasting impression. The ambiance of the restaurant is equally elegant, featuring a minimalist and sophisticated decor with soft lighting that creates a comfortable dining atmosphere. The prices are very affordable, offering great value for money, far exceeding expectations. The waitstaff are professional, warm, and attentive, always mindful of the customers' needs, making you feel right at home. The portions are generous, so there's no need to worry about leaving hungry. Whether it's a family gathering or a casual meet-up with friends, this place is an excellent choice. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: 鬻熊

sample_reviews_en.text: We went to the restaurant because of the number of 5 star reviews, but when we arrived we noticed the “leave a review and get a free drink sign.” This is usually when I start regretting going to a restaurant because the reviews are not organic and are “fished” for. That said, the restaurant has a nice atmosphere, the employees are friendly, and the food is good… not amazing. There wasn’t a dish that made us want to come back. The pad Thai was good, but it’s hard to mess up pad thai. Fortunately we opted for a la carte because we order several dishes for 2 people and it was more than enough and we had leftovers to take home. And it cost 1/2 the price of the cheapest AYCE option. Besides the pad thai, the best item we ordered was the Strawberry and Banana smoothie… it was a 5/5.
sample_reviews_en.author: Timothy Stewart

restaurants.name: Medium Rare Steak & Wine
restaurants.address:

12, 1 Pradiphat Rd, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Around 11:30 AM today, I drove my Yaris to the restaurant. A staff member came outside to direct traffic and asked if I had a reservation. I replied that I hadn’t booked in advance. The staff member responded, somewhat dismissively, that there might be no available tables and told me to wait outside since the restaurant opened at 12:00 PM.

At 12:00 PM, my friend arrived, and we entered the restaurant together. We finished our meal around 1:30 PM. During our entire visit, no other customers came in, which made me wonder why the staff had said there might be no tables available for walk-ins.

I couldn’t help but feel that perhaps the staff judged me because I drove a Yaris and assumed I might not be able to afford dining there. Even if that wasn’t the staff member’s intention, I hope they can improve how they communicate with customers in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tossaporn Choowuttichao

sample_reviews_en.text: Very limited menu. Very expensive corkage for wine (1000 baht), considering many other restaurants charge half or none at all, especially considering how much competition there is.  Service was very attentive and good. The only memorable dish was the fried rice with beef and the sweet potato fries--both delicious!  Salads were very underwhelming, and in fact disappointing. The black Angus beef was cooked well, but too tough and quite overpriced for what you get.  While Ari is still trendy, it is perhaps better to venture into the city and try the myriad more options for better steak and more reasonable wine corkage as well as a more appealing ambiance which this restaurant unfortunately lacks.  Sorry.
sample_reviews_en.author: N B

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you come to this restaurant, the Okan beef is a must. Personally, I think it’s a great wagyu with well-balanced marbling—not overly fatty. The Rangers Valley beef is also of good standard.

The carpaccio is tasty. The grilled vegetables and mashed potatoes are delicious, while the cauliflower is just okay. Finishing with the spicy pasta is a good choice.

The food prices are high but justified by the quality. However, the corkage charges of 1,000 THB per bottle is extremely expensive. I hope the restaurant will reconsider this, as some guests may want to bring their own wine that isn’t available on the list to enjoy with good-quality beef.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amm Hongskrai

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited this restaurant with high expectations, especially after ordering one of their most expensive Wagyu cuts, as recommended by the Chef. However, the experience was deeply disappointing. The meat was excessively tough, akin to chewing rubber, falling far short of the standard one would expect at this price point. Furthermore, it's disconcerting to note that the restaurant engages in a practice of offering free meals in exchange for five-star reviews. This unethical approach not only misleads potential customers but also undermines the credibility of their reviews, casting a shadow over the establishment's reputation.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Enea Dall'Aglio

sample_reviews_en.text: I had an amazing dining experience at Medium Rare Restaurant! The steaks were incredibly flavorful and tender even though I ordered mine well-done, it still came out juicy and perfectly cooked. You can order your steak at any cook level, and they get it right every time. I also loved their rockets walnut salad, fresh, crisp, and packed with great flavors. The fried sweet potatoes were perfectly seasoned and addictive, and the chips were crisp and delicious.  Overall, the food exceeded my expectations in every way. If you’re a steak lover or just looking for a great meal, I highly recommend Medium Rare Restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thidarat Christoff

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great steaks! But the soups are astonishing as well. I recommend truffle soup and/or onion soup. A very rich in taste and mouth-watering aroma. Their Australian wagyu beef fried rice is also a very good personal dish which goes really well with the fish and chilly sauce.

The 1kg 270-day australian beef tomahawk is the hi-light. Perfectly grilled, crispy on the outside, wet and juicy on the inside. The mashed potato is very tasty.

A very enjoyable lunch. Delicious and affordable steakhouse.
sample_reviews_en.author: apiwatbob

sample_reviews_en.text:
An unforgettable dining experience awaits at this steakhouse in the vibrant Pradiphat-Ari area!

Delight in their dry-aged Black Angus and Wagyu beef, alongside tantalizing options for pork, lamb,fish and lobster enthusiasts.

Despite a wide array of menu choices, the beef tartare stood out as a true delicacy. With parking conveniently located in front of the shop and exceptional service, indulge in exquisite flavors without any hassle! Highly recommended for a memorable dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasinon Rungwechwat

sample_reviews_en.text:
It used to be great… my last visit was a disaster. The ribeye was full of ligaments and impossible to chew. The server said I was "unlucky" to get the bad piece. I ended up paying $80 for a worthless piece of meat. I didn't finish the plate; I could only eat about half before giving up.

For over 2000 baht a piece, they told the customer it was just bad luck… It's my fault, I had bad luck.

The service was great. They cooked the steak to perfection, and I appreciated the spices they used.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirisilp Kongsilp (Tai)

restaurants.name: ก้นหม้อ Kon More
restaurants.address:

114 Inthrawat Rd, Bang Ramat, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: If you’re heading to Taling Chan, you’re likely looking for that perfect mix of "Old Bangkok" charm and authentic, punchy flavors. Kon More (คนหม้อ) is a standout for anyone who loves traditional Thai comfort food served with a bit of soul. …
sample_reviews_th.author: Hl Tan

sample_reviews_th.text: If you're looking for an authentic Thai dining experience in a setting that feels both traditional and thoughtfully designed, ก้นหม้อ (Kon More) is a fantastic choice. Located on Inthrawat Road, it’s a great escape from the more …
sample_reviews_th.author: Hedge Jey

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! Thai food made to perfection! Will definitely come back for more soon. The smell of each ingredient is pushed to the right spot. Worth the wait (for the opening). The high ceiling room with Nordic decor(?) and luxurious bar gave chill vibes. Only one complaint; the playlist is not so good XD please no more bossa Karma Police.
sample_reviews_en.author: katika akksilp

sample_reviews_en.text: recently visited this new restaurant during its soft opening and had an amazing experience. The thai cuisine here is absolutely astonishing! The standout dish for me was the sun-dried beef tongue—it was surprisingly good. I can’t recommend …
sample_reviews_en.author: Tatar Patsakorn

sample_reviews_en.text: A new restaurant near my home. The food is delicious. There are many menus. The taste is so spicy. I recommend the delicious chili paste and the fried chicken with fish sauce are very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongsatorn K

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. This is my second visit. The wait wasn't long; they served us in order of arrival. The service was good, and the staff were very friendly and smiling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ni Das

sample_reviews_en.text: Great ambience with good vibes. Wide selection of Thai foods. Their shrimp omelette is superb and  also their curries. Interesting twists on dessert. Must try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanapon

sample_reviews_en.text: Tasty and authentic thai food with many lists of drinks. A home- made chill paste is exotic with fresh Side 🥗 vegetables. Staff is very nice and caring. …
sample_reviews_en.author: kedyanee Tochanakarn

restaurants.name: Somtam Nua
restaurants.address:

392, 12-14 Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a popular Isaan restaurant in Siam. We visited with our family around 2 PM on a Saturday.

The restaurant was clean, and while it was full on our first visit, we were able to get a table relatively easily this time. There were many young Thai customers, giving the impression that it's a popular local spot.

This time, we ordered two types of Som Tum, Gai Yang (grilled chicken), Larb (spicy malt salad), sticky rice, and a lychee smoothie. All the dishes had a rich, authentic flavor with plenty of spices, and were delicious. The spiciness can be adjusted, so even those who don't like spicy food can enjoy it.

The menu has English and pictures, making it easy for foreigners to order, which is a plus. The food was served quickly, and with plenty of staff, the service was smooth even when the restaurant was crowded.

The prices are relatively reasonable, with Som Tum starting from under 100 baht. Considering its location in Siam, I felt it offered great value for money.

This restaurant is recommended for anyone who wants to enjoy authentic Thai Isaan cuisine in a casual setting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ren

sample_reviews_en.text:
We swung by on a weekday evening around 5 PM+, and it was the perfect timing - no massive crowds, just a super relaxed vibe to enjoy our dinner.

We ordered 3 dishes and was pleasantly surprised that they had a promo where you get a free dish if you spend over 500 THB! We feasted on their famous fried chicken, sea bass tom yum goong, mango salad, and a glass noodle salad.

The Famous Fried Chicken really lived up to the hype. Easily some of the most delicious fried chicken we've ever had. The Sea Bass Tom Yum Goong is incredibly traditional, rich, and packed with flavor. A total hit.
The mango salad & Glass Noodle Salad are authentic and perfectly balanced.

The staff here were super polite and the service was top-notch throughout our meal. To top it all off, the total bill came out to just 709 THB. For the quality and generous portions we got, that is an absolute steal.

We loved every single bite of our dinner here. Somtam Nua is officially on our "must-return" list for our next trip to Thailand! 🇹🇭✈️
sample_reviews_en.author: Lloyd Phua

sample_reviews_en.text:
3 stars for the atmosphere because I wasn't impressed by their chairs 😂
They only have stools here and who wants to sit down eating without proper back support.

The service was quite fast and decent. We were here on a relatively busy period. While we didn't have to wait, almost every table was occupied.

The food was great.
The highlight for me was their deep fried sea bass.
That should be on their best sellers page!
Wasn't too impressed with the papaya salad tbh. Was kinda meh?
Their signature noodle dish with the pork floss was quite good.

I think I ordered the coconut smoothie? But what I got was coconut with like partly frozen coconut water?
Was still alright.
Their red ruby dessert with coconut jelly thingy was pretty good. Not sure why they served in a cup. Made it a bit hard to eat. Could have easily been served in a bowl.

Was over 1k for everything we ordered I think. Didn't get a pic of the papaya salad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Honest Asn Travel Reviewer

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came across Somtam while shopping around Siam Square area. It looks pretty decent from the outside with a menu that’s Thai enough for us to try out.
So we ordered the 3 must have items from their menu which is the fried chicken, grilled pork neck & fried noodle with pork floss. We added on a deep fried corn fritters.
Overall food was edible but not impressive. The fried chicken was ok but somehow we found the ones by the roadside much better. Chicken was fresh though but the flour wasn’t that flavorful.
The grilled pork neck was ok but the spicy sauce was great ! Didn’t like their pork floss noodles which was wet and tasted odd.
The place was als not full and there were a continuous flow of customers coming in.
So we can see that the place is popular even with locals. Service was prompt but inside was quite warm also.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have been craving for Thai Esan food for sometimes. And I found this place while I was waiting for feast partner.

All food I ordered was great in the sense of original tastes. Spicy, umami, tart, sweet. Food portions were very generous with their price, considering the restaurant location.

Foreigners may find that food has acquired tasted but I am Thai and I can say this is what Thai like.

Unfortunately services were not good as I expected. Staffs couldn’t understand as I believe some of staffs are not Thai. Some orders didn’t come, fortunately those were rice and water. No need to wait.

Dessert was good. It was my favorite one.

Atmosphere was so so. But not a big deal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanathip Moolvong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Somtum Nua is a simple, no-frills restaurant that delivers exactly what it promises—great somtam. They offer a wide variety of papaya salads, and the one I had with crab was perfectly balanced, not overly sweet like some other places. The grilled pork neck was another standout—tender, flavorful, and nicely charred.

It’s a great spot for a quick and satisfying meal, and I was glad to have stumbled upon it for my dinner in Bangkok. The service is excellent, with staff who are friendly and welcoming, always serving with a smile.

If you're looking for authentic Thai flavors in a relaxed, efficient setting, Somtum Nua is definitely worth visiting. I’ll be back for more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Edmund JP

sample_reviews_en.text:
Somtam is a great spot for classic Thai flavors right in the middle of Siam.

I went for tender, crunchy chicken wings and som tam with Thai sausages and crispy pork rings. A really satisfying combo, packed with layered flavors that work perfectly together.
Service was a little slow, likely because the place was quite full, so lunch breaks might feel a bit tight. That said, it’s definitely worth the wait. There’s a nice selection of classic local dishes, the place is clean, and the staff are helpful and friendly.

Located in Siam Square Soi 5 (Siam Square One), right by BTS Siam (Green Sukhumvit Line) and next to Siam Paragon—easy to reach and recommended to visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Farangondiet

sample_reviews_en.text:
We arrived bkk 🇹🇭 on 6th Wednesday, it was still closed for renovation. Haven't seen the old somtum nua. Only witness the newly renovated shop.
I have heard so much about their legendary som tum, only tasted it today only to find out it is really as good as reputation. Som tum taste was overlapping, can't really tell the number of sauces used. 😋😋
Their mama noodle with pork cutlet is really good, but for those who don't like sour shouldn't try this. Definitely a must try on the  🐽 pork cutlet it's sooo good.
Service is fast and crew is friendly.
Keep up the fantastic work 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻😘😘😘
Note: no reservation allow. For big group suggest to arrive early to take number.
sample_reviews_en.author: Geena Ng

restaurants.name: Ruen Petch Suki
restaurants.address:

1907, 1903, 1905, 1909 New Petchaburi Rd, Bangkapi, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I've never seen a sukiyaki restaurant that charges for chili, garlic, and lime. Chili is 21฿, lime is 10฿. The food prices are also high.
Some items are even more expensive than MK. The staff are also difficult to get the attention of; they stand facing the other way and aren't Thai, making communication very difficult.
sample_reviews_th.author: Tupana Sp

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old-school sukiyaki restaurant that I've been eating at since I was a kid. I'm so happy it's still around today. Even though the atmosphere has changed, the taste of the food remains the same.

The use of tender marinated pork and the egg that forms a ribbon when swirled in the broth is a unique characteristic of traditional sukiyaki that brings back memories of the old days, when parents took their children out to restaurants on weekends.

Besides pork, we also like to order squid, pork liver, meatballs, and dumplings to add to the fun of eating sukiyaki.

If we're in a hurry, a dry sukiyaki dish is also a good option.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panshewa P.

sample_reviews_en.text: Normally, whenever I go to Ruen Phet Suki, I always order the large pot of their traditional suki. But today, I stopped by for a quick lunch and ordered some single-dish meals. Turns out, they were just as delicious and impressive! The jade noodle soup with roasted duck was fantastic; the duck meat was tender and in large pieces, the skin was fragrant, and the rich sauce was a perfect match. The stir-fried fish maw was also wonderfully fragrant, with plenty of ingredients and a well-balanced flavor. Everything was served quickly, making it perfect for a quick lunch in the Phetchaburi New Road area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Napat Kanokpornwasin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food selection was more diverse than I expected. There are still many dishes I want to try.

I understand the restaurant has been open for a long time and is well-known, but there are also new customers like us.
I followed Google Maps and it told me to turn into a street that was no longer closed, so I quickly called the restaurant. The person who answered the phone was incredibly harsh. It almost ruined my appetite. They answered as if they were too lazy to explain anything.
I was quite disappointed.
It would be great if they could improve this aspect.
sample_reviews_en.author: whanjeab jubu

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is okay, but not the same as before. It's different from what I ate as a child. The crab fried rice doesn't have the same aroma, and the rice is a bit soggy. The sukiyaki broth is bland, and the dipping sauce lacks the fragrant fermented tofu flavor and doesn't have white sesame seeds.
