Overall, it's acceptable if you don't compare it to the taste I used to have.
I came back to eat here again in 2026, and the sukiyaki tasted good again, with its rich flavor. The crab fried rice was also fragrant with a wok aroma.
sample_reviews_en.author: Koson Mungkornsilanon

sample_reviews_en.text:
The roast duck has a unique flavor, and the dipping sauce is an old-fashioned recipe that's hard to find elsewhere. It's delicious, but the price is a bit high, though still within an acceptable range.
However, the staff and service could be better. They weren't smiling, their tone was harsh, and they spoke without politeness. You had to ask for the dipping sauce and the spoons. Personally, I wouldn't go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anong S

sample_reviews_en.text: It's rare to find authentic sukiyaki with its original dipping sauce these days. A must-try is the beef or pork mixed with spices and raw egg. The fish balls, fish cakes, and fish dumplings are just okay. Besides sukiyaki, many other dishes are delicious. Some that I recommend are the drunken chicken, the Ruen Phet chicken drumsticks, and the stir-fried dried fish maw.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanasit K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
(The food is as delicious as ever.)
I would like to suggest that the head of reception staff be open to improving this aspect. Most of our customers come with elderly family members who find it inconvenient to go upstairs. If a table is being cleaned, it would be safer to inform the customer to wait a moment rather than having elderly customers walk upstairs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bee Aimpun

restaurants.name: A RAMEN ราเมงข้อสอบ (เดอะสตรีทรัชดา)
restaurants.address:

B Floor, The Street Ratchada, 139 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Khwaeng Din Daeng, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This famous ramen restaurant from Japan focuses on solo diners (even more so than individual dishes), making it very suitable. The atmosphere is very much in line with the Japanese style, but you can still bring people to sit with you, and then fold down the partitions. Everything is done according to the Japanese system – emphasizing eating and then leaving; they don't want to talk to anyone. They play Japanese youth music, similar to an Izakaya. The air conditioning is a bit warm. This branch utilizes its space very efficiently; it's one of the few restaurants that has managed to stay open even without a prime location.

The service is standard for this restaurant.

Food: The portions are appropriate, and the ingredients are good. It stands out from typical Japanese ramen restaurants because of the many customized options, similar to Thai noodle shops but with a much better system, making expansion easy.
- Original recipe: Delicious and well-balanced, everything is customizable according to your choices, such as not being greasy, very soft noodles, etc.
sample_reviews_en.author: WoonWoW

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thai-style ramen, don't compare it to Japanese ramen!!

Price per head: 101 - 250 THB
Signature dish: "Exam-style" ramen

"A Ramen," a Thai ramen restaurant, has faced heavy criticism for using the Japanese "exam-style" ramen as inspiration. I'm okay with that, because they copy everything anyway. Overall, their ramen is delicious...

**My highlight:** The "Original Recipe Ramen" is the bone broth ramen, which I chose with a medium-rich broth, normal spiciness, and two types of aromatic garlic. The key is the garlic, which gives the broth a slightly zesty kick. The noodles are not too chewy, making them easy to eat. The fatty char siu pork is soft and juicy.

Overall, it's very customizable. It's ramen suitable for all ages, but requires a certain level of understanding to appreciate it. Anyone who likes noodles should try it.

Find a branch near you, give it a try, don't expect too much, and you won't be disappointed.

#Pakorn'sFoodReviews
sample_reviews_en.author: Aut Pakorn

sample_reviews_en.text: I really love the gimmick of ordering food here. The shop provides a paper that looks just like a real exam. You can choose everything from the softness of the noodles and the richness of the soup to the spice level, making every bowl truly personalized to your taste. They provide large portions, the atmosphere is good, and the shop is very suitable for introverts you can sit and eat alone chillly. The private booths offer a sense of comfort that is hard to find elsewhere. Plus, the service is efficient and fast, ensuring you get your steaming bowl of ramen right when you need it. It’s definitely a must-visit for solo diners
sample_reviews_en.author: Anonymous

sample_reviews_en.text:
At first, I saw a lot of people waiting outside the shop.
(I was too soft-hearted)
But I was hungry, so I decided to wait.

In the end, the wait wasn't long, 15-20 minutes, which was acceptable.

The ramen only has one broth option.
But you can choose the noodle texture (chewy, soft, firm) and the level of spiciness or garlic.

The first sip reminded me of some ramen noodle soup brand 😆

But the noodles were really good. I ate the original style, no need to tick any boxes on the order form.

I also ordered the seasoned wood ear mushrooms, which were fragrant with sesame oil and went well with the ramen.
sample_reviews_en.author: teddy som

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted good and met expectations, but this time, the service was unfriendly. The food took a long time to arrive and wasn't served in the correct order. When I inquired about my order, I received a rather rude response and tone from the staff. I would like this issue to be addressed. Although this isn't a restaurant that prioritizes service, the prices aren't cheap, and I wasn't asking for free food. Therefore, I expected better service.

(The food is good, but the staff should be more aware of their word and mindset.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Nathaphong U.

sample_reviews_en.text: There was a long queue because there were few seats. The atmosphere was unusual for Thai people. They had cubicles where you sat and ordered food by tapping on a paper slip. There was an opening to insert the order, and staff served the food through the opening. There was no interaction with customers. The soup wasn't as flavorful as it should have been. The pork was sliced ​​thickly, giving it a good chew. The gyoza was delicious. The fried chicken was bland. Overall, it wasn't bad. I'll try again when I have time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suki Ma

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Japanese-style ramen shop where you take exams!

Choose your preferred ramen flavor based on your taste, and you'll know you've passed when you get there! Hahaha!

I recommend the original broth.

I chose a 7-degree spicy and 4-degree garlic flavor, which was a bit strange but still very spicy 😂

Anyway, the original flavor is the best choice. Prepare your questions and submit! 😎
sample_reviews_en.author: 朱爱吃

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was pleasantly surprised: one can customize the ramen, the seating is nice, and there’s a private water tap. I would definitely come back here.
Update: Have come back often. Still my favorite, but they’ve removed the free drinking water faucets and the gyoza have gotten noticeably smaller.
The macha/strawberry ice cream was free, I didn't eat more than a bite. Wasn't good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cecil M

restaurants.name: Davin Cafe
restaurants.address:

108 Khlong Lam Chiak Rd, Nawamin, Bueng Kum, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for a cafe not too far from the city center, near the expressway, with convenient access, plenty of parking, and great service, then Davin Cafe is the place to be. They don't just offer soft drinks, but also alcoholic beverages for those who want to chill out at night.

The food is delicious, from simple dishes like stir-fried pork with basil and a fried egg to familiar Italian dishes like carbonara. They also have a wide variety of coffees to choose from, including many matcha options. The cafe even mentioned they'll be opening a matcha bar soon! 👍🏻

The service is fast; food arrives at your table almost immediately after ordering. The staff are friendly and chatty, especially if you sit at the bar where you can charge your laptop and work comfortably all day. The music is relaxing and easy to sing along to.

The prices are on the higher side, reflecting the ambiance and service, but still within a reasonable range, comparable to restaurants in shopping malls.
sample_reviews_en.author: A “Ammbever_” M

sample_reviews_en.text: This wasn't my first time at this restaurant. The food is delicious, especially the beef nachos, which use very fresh and high-quality ingredients. All the dishes were tasty. The restaurant's decor is beautiful and inviting, suitable for dining at any time. However, the service was a bit slow. The staff didn't seem to communicate much. My mother ordered a cake and waited half an hour at the display case, but it still hadn't been served. When she asked, the staff said they were checking and that they were out of stock, then they said they would check again before finally confirming that they had some, even though there were three cakes on display. Today, it was raining and water was dripping on customers' clothes. We informed the staff about the leak, and they said we had to wait for a technician to fix it. When asked why they didn't inform us before we left, they said they only just found out. This back-and-forth caused confusion for the customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nitit Thongprasert

sample_reviews_en.text:
Davin Cafe is a standout specialty coffee spot in Bangkok, known for its Roman-inspired design, unique stylish decor, and an atmosphere that feels almost like stepping into an art gallery. The warm and inviting space makes it a great place to visit any time of day. From 8 AM to 5 PM, it’s perfect for enjoying quality coffee in a calm setting; after 5 PM, it transforms into a lively venue with music, ideal for family dinners or relaxed evenings until midnight.

The latte is excellent made by a barista who has won a national championship, which truly elevates the experience. The chocolate cake was also very fresh and delicious. With its spacious seating, attentive service, cool air conditioning, spotless restrooms, ample parking, and live music on Sundays, Davin Cafe is definitely a must visit spot in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cafe Hunter

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place exceeded my expectations! I was impressed from the moment I walked in. The atmosphere is amazing, and the owner is lovely and handsome too!
The decor is beautiful, the seating is inviting, the lighting is just right, and it has a warm yet fun vibe. Perfect for hanging out with friends or a date with your significant other 🫶
The highlight of the restaurant is the live music and concerts; the atmosphere is fantastic.
If you're looking for a place to chill, eat, listen to music, and spend quality time with your special someone or group of friends, I highly recommend this place. 10/10, worth every minute, and I'll definitely want to come back again! 🎶🍻✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Jame Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Personally, I don't get to travel very often,
but this place is great, really great. It's perfect for anyone who enjoys music, good food, and a fun place to chat without having to shout.
It's suitable for all ages, especially teenagers, and also great for families. The price is good, very reasonable for the quality. Food 10/10, atmosphere 10/10, service 9/10 (it might be a little slow at times, but I don't want to lower the rating for service because it was actually good, the staff were friendly, and the restrooms were clean.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Ronakorn Pakanitischon

sample_reviews_en.text: This large and beautiful shop is perfect for photography enthusiasts. They offer a wide variety of desserts and savory dishes. The seating is comfortable. Their chocolate drinks are all delicious, and the service is excellent. It's a shame we missed the live music; we left early. The security guards were also very kind, even holding umbrellas for us. My grandfather forgot his phone, and someone found it and returned it to him. If you're in the area near the expressway, we'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Art Suwarnatemiya

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been there many times, but what impressed me the most was during Halloween the year before last. I kept the photos for a long time and only recently had the chance to review it.

I took my mom out for a trip to see a beautiful cafe, and we ended up here. Besides the beautiful decor, they also have seasonal cakes, and even my mom commented that the cake decorations weren't just pretty and cute, they were delicious too.

It's another cafe I can visit repeatedly.
sample_reviews_en.author: BTO

sample_reviews_en.text:
Some places have great food, some have amazing drinks, and others excel in desserts. Davin Cafe has it all—and it is excellent.

Every item on the plate is thoughtfully seasoned, right down to the carrot on the side. My personal favorite? The matcha with coconut water—absolutely refreshing! 😋

Do not let the high-society atmosphere or the Rolls-Royces in the parking lot intimidate you. Treat yourself to something special—you deserve it.
sample_reviews_en.author: OT

restaurants.name: Kalyana Restaurant
restaurants.address:

110, 112 Ratchaprarop Rd, Khwaeng Makkasan, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
THE FOOD TRAVELLER REVIEW

Landed in BKK during transit and decided to drop by city area for some meals. This was the first restaurant that I passed by. The atmosphere is nice and tidy. Staff are friendly and greet with smiles. Definitely a good start.

Ordered a chicken dish, fried morning glory and a sweet snack with a tea. Dishes come in a good portion. The tea came first and I would say it tasted great. Creamy and sweet.

The next up was chicken dish and fried morning glory. Typical oyster sauce based fried vege, which I enjoyed a lot. The chicken dish was a bit of let down. The chicken tasted a bit funny, probably frozen.

Sweet snack was good, but I was just too full by the time to really enjoy it.

Overall, great hospitality and a spotless setting go a long way. While the chicken dish missed the mark, the stellar tea, reliable greens, and lovely service make this a decent, stress-free spot for travelers passing through.
sample_reviews_en.author: ZN H (Food Traveller)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place has become our go to Burmese restaurant in town. We've been here three times now. The first time was in April and it was honestly amazing. We totally fell in love with the Shwe Yin Aye. It was so good we kept thinking about it all the time. But the second time, we were a bit let down. The Shwe Yin Aye didn’t taste the same. The bowl was smaller and the flavor just wasn’t there. It felt kinda bland and didn’t taste like real Burmese Shwe Yin Aye.

On the bright side, we still love the biriyani here. We definitely recommend the regular biriyani over the clay pot one. It just tastes better to us. Also, we absolutely loved the pork red curry and tea leaf salad.

The staff are really nice and friendly. Thanks for remembering us.
P.S. Sorry, we understand how restaurant service works, but being asked how everything is multiple times made us feel a little uncomfortable. Just something to keep in mind.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hsu

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there with two vegetarian food buddies and we all loved what we had. My fav item (non-veg) is the chicken biryani. The rice was so good, and the chicken was well-marinated and cooked in a different way from Indian Biryani. However, since the menu contains food from different parts of Myanmar with various types of Biryani, you can ask the staff for recommendations.

For vegetarians, there are many choices of salad, deep-fried items, noodles, and curry as well. All were delicious. The staff were very supportive. The musical show was beautiful. The price was great compared to the amount and quality of food that we got.

The only mild downside would be the MRT construction right in front of the restaurant, which will take a few years more. You can reach the restaurant by the Airport Link train or by walking from the BTS near Central World for about 15 min.

We will definitely go back here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dao Yerburgh

sample_reviews_en.text:
First time eating burmeese food, and I rarely like all the meals that I order, but we ordered a couple of different things to try and they all tasted amazing! 😋 We had noodles with sweet soya sauce, fish specialty and I ordered also mouton curry with potatoes but they gave me the mouton gravy, nevertheless it tasted great! I also had lime and mint juice which was very refreshing. The only thing that didn’t tickle my fancy was the pink milk cake drink. Everything else is worth a try and I would be happily back for more if I am in Bangkok again.

Recommend 👌🏽
sample_reviews_en.author: Antoniya Dimitrova

sample_reviews_en.text:
As my husband and I haven’t been back home for more than five years, and we both are really craving for our traditional Cuisine. After dinning in Kalyana, all of the dishes brought us back home. We both really enjoyed a lot. The taste is very authentic, and I really recommend this place if you are looking for different cuisine from different ethnic groups from Myanmar. As we both were starving & the food was very delicious as well, we didn’t have a chance to take photo of each and every dish we ate. 😁
Even bought takeaways for our colleagues.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poe POE

sample_reviews_en.text: Definitely the place to go to discover Burmese cuisine!!! Reasonable prices and great quality! The staff were very attentive to details and could speak more than average English. We took 2 sets (the first two sets at 275b), a tea leaf salad and a falooda dessert (even tho the sets included a dessert too). The portions were generous and honestly that was enough to feed 4 people. In total there was about 20 items and ALL of them were delicious and presented unique flavors. I can't recommend this place enough, definitely a try again soon ❤️❤️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: DominiQC Asean

sample_reviews_en.text: Chanced upon this Burmese restaurant and was pleasantly surprised. The ambience was great with live music. All the staff were very welcoming and polite, and some could speak basic English. Tried the staff-recommended dishes, the Chicken Nasi Briyani was fantastic, and the tea leaf salad was unique and refreshing. The tea was a bit too milky for my liking, but overall, a lovely dining experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: CA

sample_reviews_en.text: Here, we had the authentic Burmese/ Myanmar food and dishes. I have been missing Myanmar food as I am living abroad and so I decided to eat Myanmar cuisine when I visited to Bangkok. The food is great and tasty, the staff are nice. Only the mote lat saung ( Myanmar traditional drink) is not the same taste in Myanmar. But, the overall experience was great at kalyana and so I gave 4 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nora

restaurants.name: Polo Fried Chicken (Soi Polo)
restaurants.address:

137/1-3 Sanam Khli Alley, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Spicy and tangy salads, crispy chicken, great service plus well priced."

sample_reviews_en.text:
Is it delicious? It’s not that it’s bad, but it’s just too famous.

Since it is a place that countless people have already visited...

I finally visited on my fourth trip to Bangkok.

Since our accommodation (Kimpton Malai) was nearby and my child likes chicken,

we went somewhere between lunch and dinner.

We traveled by tuk-tuk. Travel and dining tailored for the child.

We ordered a whole chicken, Som Tum, and steamed rice? That’s how we started our meal.

If expectations are high, is disappointment likely?

The tables weren't completely full, but two elderly gentlemen were having chicken and beer, while a man dining alone at the next table was having half a chicken and hot soup. I remember there were about two tables of Koreans as well.

I kept looking around like a meerkat.

I found out that Yoona had visited, and since they only accept cash, I realized the owner's pockets must be bulging with cash.

They bring ice without you even having to ask. If you are staying in accommodation within walking distance, it might be worth visiting at least once, but don't forget that there are endless alternatives to Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: ALL ODD (ODDALL)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm a Japanese man. I visited for lunch at the end of June. The restaurant was air-conditioned and very cool. There weren't many customers when we entered, but the restaurant filled up with customers while we were eating, so you might have to wait depending on the timing.
I ordered a green papaya salad and a whole fried chicken.
The green papaya salad was a little spicy, which was great for me since I like spicy food, but I think people who don't like spicy food should avoid it.
The whole chicken is quite large, so I think it would be difficult to finish unless you're with at least two people. If you're alone, it's better to order a half. As for the taste, the skin was crispy, the meat was tender, and the flavor was well-infused. It was the most delicious fried chicken I've ever had. It comes with sauce, but I thought it tasted better without any sauce.
With this taste, they could compete in Japan! I really hope they open a store in Japan!
sample_reviews_en.author: tamaking58

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re craving fried chicken, this is definitely the place to go! We came here for lunch on a random Tuesday, and surprisingly it wasn’t too difficult to find a seat. Here’s what we ordered:

Polo Fried Chicken (½ portion) –  4/5 🍗 Tender and crispy, topped with fried onion and garlic that made it extra crunchy and flavorful. Half a portion was more than enough for two people.

Papaya Salad –  3/5 🥗 Fresh and tangy, though not my favorite. The small shrimp topping added a nice umami kick.

Pork Sausage –  4/5 🌭 Tasty and well-seasoned, but reminded me of the ones in Bali (Uritan). Honestly, it didn’t pair perfectly with chicken as the main star.

Grass Jelly with Brown Sugar –  3/5 A standard dessert, lightly sweet and refreshing — a nice way to end the meal.

If I return to Bangkok, I’ll definitely be looking forward to another good lunch at Polo Fried Chicken. Simple, satisfying, cheap, worth the visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Coriandermixxx

sample_reviews_en.text:
Okay hear me out. I must agree with reviews that said the chicken was original, and that there might be much better ones outside. But the pairing with som dum (papaya salad) was the key here.

We ordered half chicken, papaya salad, and the pork neck. In short, the pork neck was okay and maybe not really worth to order many. The chicken we got was normal, not too dry but crispy. I must say, the fried onion makes the chicken more enjoyable, but it's just fried chicken.

The key here, as the person who never eat papaya, you must order it alongside the chicken. The papaya salad with the sauce taste uniquely sour but very subtle and refreshing, kind of slight lemon sour thing. Pair the papaya with chicken in one spoon to make the experience totally complete.

I recommend just going to the stall with aircon. Makes a difference.
sample_reviews_en.author: Darien T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Legendary restaurant in Bangkok that has earned fame for its exceptional fried chicken, but not the best chicken choice among locals. Other dishes delivered a better experience than its famed chicken, which seems more roasted than fried.

Drop by before 8pm since most of the chicken quota runs out early.

Exceptionally touristy with more than 70% of the entire restaurant filled with expats. Family friendly and open to groups, but there will always be a waiting line of around 15-20 minutes wait. The table turnaround is quite fast.

Located near Lumpini Park and Polo, this restaurant has operated over half a century, spanning three generations of the same family.

There is private parking nearby but the spaces are limited to 6-8 cars at most. Walkable from Suanlum park and One Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kris Supavatanakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're a chicken fan, you absolutely must check this place out! The food is super-local and extremely popular among Bangkok residents. The high volume of delivery orders ensures their chicken is always fresh, and the preparation process is completely transparent once you find the shop.

​The highlight is the signature garlic-laden fried chicken—make sure to pair it with beer! Adding a side of papaya salad and grilled pork neck makes for a satisfying meal.

​They do have a separate, air-conditioned seating space located a few shops down from the original stall. But if you're all about experiencing the full local experience, you'll want to sit at the original space.

​Important Note: Be prepared, as this is a cash-only shop; they do not accept credit cards or PromptPay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Flo Y.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered from Polo Chicken in Bangkok through Grab during a trip with my wife. Since it was delivery, it’s hard to comment on the actual atmosphere, but the packaging and overall food quality gave a good impression of their service.

We tried the fried chicken, which is their signature dish. The texture might feel a bit dry for people who prefer very juicy chicken, but personally I didn’t mind it at all. In fact, the texture worked well with the sauce and flavors.

The crispy chicken topped with garlic flakes was really tasty, and everything was nicely fried. Paired with a cold beer, it made for a very enjoyable and relaxing moment during our time in Bangkok.

Overall, a satisfying and good-value meal. I’d definitely order it again
sample_reviews_en.author: Dave

sample_reviews_en.text: Was downtown near the restaurant shopping so I decided to try it out and wow is it trip worth it… Absolutely delicious!  Just off main road, quieter side street, local restaurant..just came at lunch, relatively busy but I got a seat and did not have to wait. Staff knows English, sat down to a nice table. Restaurant has a nice atmosphere and is clean lots of options to order decided I would get a whole chicken so I could take a portion home also ordered a sticky rice and papaya salad with an ice cold beer. The perfect lunch. I grabbed an extra order of sticky rice for Takeaway with the 3/4 of chicken that I was not able to finish at the restaurant ,,,will definitely be adding this as a favorite restaurant,,price very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dan Brown

restaurants.name: Tang Jai Yoo Restaurant
restaurants.address:

85 Thanon Yaowaphanit, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tang Jai Yoo was one of the highlights of our trip to Bangkok. The restaurant was clean, the service was impressively fast, with dishes arriving so quickly it felt like the kitchen was already one step ahead. The suckling pig was exceptional, with perfectly crispy skin and tender, flavorful meat. The stir-fried kale was fresh and well seasoned, providing a great balance to the richer dishes. The crab fried rice was packed with generous pieces of crab and had excellent wok flavor. Every dish was served hot and tasted freshly prepared.

The atmosphere has a true Bangkok Chinatown feel with a distinctly Thai twist. It was interesting to see dishes like tom yum on the menu, something I don’t usually expect at a Chinese restaurant, but it reflects Bangkok’s unique food culture.

I’d definitely recommend making a reservation, as the restaurant gets very busy. Deserves 5 stars but i’d give it a 4 out of 5 because they don’t warn you that it’s cash only before you order, and I’d happily return on my next visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mon Yu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located along a very busy street in Chinatown, this Chinese restaurant is clearly popular — the place was packed with people and had a lively atmosphere throughout the meal.
The food overall was decent and enjoyable. Their signature dish is the whole roasted suckling pig, which many tables seemed to order. The skin was crispy and flavorful, though personally, I didn’t really like the chewy rice paper used to wrap the suckling pig skin. I found it a bit too thick and it affected the texture combination slightly.
The staff here were very attentive and responsive despite the crowd, which made the dining experience more pleasant.
We also ordered the hotpot fish soup. The yam was soft, smooth, and nicely cooked, but the fish itself was slightly disappointing as it didn’t taste very fresh — the texture was not firm or flaky as expected.
Overall, it was still a nice dining experience with good atmosphere and service, especially if you want to try their famous roasted suckling pig.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tan Adrian

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the true originals of Yaowarat, Tang Jai Yoo is a must-visit if you're craving classic, full-flavored Chinese cuisine in the heart of Bangkok’s Chinatown. The restaurant boasts an impressively extensive menu—from fresh fish and seafood to fried specialties and beyond, such as the crispy roast pork.

Dishes arrived quickly after ordering, each one served in generous portions that make sharing a joy. What really stands out are the flavors: bold, robust, and deeply satisfying. Everything on the table complements each other beautifully, creating a harmonious and hearty dining experience.

The staff are exceptionally friendly and attentive—quick to take orders, serve drinks, and keep your glass full without being asked. It’s clear they take pride in their service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisana Varanyuwatana

sample_reviews_en.text:
The stir-fried oysters with egg are usually one of the best at this restaurant, but this time they were extremely salty. The oysters were fresh, but the saltiness overpowered all other flavors.

The crab fried rice was as delicious as ever. Their chili fish sauce is a highlight, but because limes are expensive, they've reduced the sourness a bit, although you can ask for more.

The grouper head soup with taro was flavorful; the taro wasn't very strong, the soup wasn't overly sweet, but more like a slightly salty, umami-heavy dried squid soup.

Personally, I think the restaurant shouldn't charge a flat rate of 60 baht per person for drinks, as some people might be surprised by the high bill.
sample_reviews_en.author: Norah S

sample_reviews_en.text:
The owner, an auntie, and all the staff provided excellent service. They were attentive, helpful, and very polite. It was a great first impression!
The food was delicious too. This was our first time eating here, but we will definitely be back.

This was our first visit, and we were so impressed! The owner and all the staff were so welcoming, attentive, and genuinely kind. They made us feel well taken care of and gave us great recommendations. Every dish was delicious.
We had an amazing experience and will definitely be back. Highly recommend! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
sample_reviews_en.author: Roses_

sample_reviews_en.text: A friend recommended this place, and we had to try their signature suckling pig - absolutely a must if you're here. The skin was perfectly crispy, and we got to choose how the meat would be prepared. They suggested grilling, which takes about 20 minutes. Since we had time, we went with their recommendation. No regrets - it was incredibly tasty, especially with their house-made chilli. When the dish arrived, I honestly thought we wouldn't be able to finish it. It was huge and came out last. But wow we cleared the entire plate. That's how good it was.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patricia Lim

sample_reviews_en.text: Old school Chinese restaurant that transport me back to 1980s in SG. Felt nostalgic as my childhood was in that era. Came before 1700hrs and we are the 2nd customer group in the restaurant. Food was authentic Teochew style and it suits my tastebud. There is one uncle who speaks good Mandarin and gives good recommendations on the dishes to order. The only cons in this restaurant is the place smells of sewage which might be due to heavy rain on that day and they only accept cash. The young boss can speak English very well if you need help.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adrick Loh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Old school teochew restaurant in the heart of Chinatown, we have been visiting this restaurant for years whenever we visited Bangkok.

They definitely don’t stinge with ingredients, oyster omelette was filled with so much plump juicy oysters. Sharks fin soup as well.
Service is prompt, food arrives quick and fresh from the wok.

Flavour wise- we thought it had declined through the years. It is on the tamer side of things and needs more oomph.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sue Ann Lee

restaurants.name: Sunrise Tacos at Silom
restaurants.address:

114/19-20 Silom Corner of Soi 4 and Silom Rd Suriyawong Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great Mexican food. Reminds me of Houston Texas. Fish tacos and Nachos Cheese Supreme where the best and don't forget the Molcajete salsa!

Next Day Update and it's NOT good, very BAD!

Both me and my wife have had serious Gastrointestinal problems last night all night following our 2pm lunch at this place and it's continuing this morning. When something like what we are going through happens, it's usually one person, but this time we both have the same symptoms and cause. Lunch at this place. Food handling is the obvious question or intentional poisoning, which? To avoid what we are going through, AVOID this place like the plague!

I really wonder if anyone else has experienced this after eating at this place, if so then we know it's intentional poisoning of the customers by some physco.
sample_reviews_en.author: Working Together

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went here with my buddies this time (though I’ve swung by a few times with my wife before). I went for the chicken quesadilla, while the guys tried the beef quesadilla, tacos, and even some pizza. Everything hit the spot, especially with that avocado salsa they serve on the side—real tasty stuff.

They’ve got a beer promo during certain hours, so if that’s your thing, check it out to save a few bucks. The location’s bang on—just a quick 2-minute stroll from BTS Sala Daeng, super easy to get to. Prices are a bit on the higher side, but nothing too outrageous.

The waitress was super friendly and made sure we were well taken care of.

All in all, we had a great lunch. Good eats, chill atmosphere, and a spot I’d definitely head back to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dima Trionix

sample_reviews_en.text:
This has been my 3rd time coming here and it's some of the nicest, freshest food in the area.

Because I'm gluten and dairy intolerant it can make it quite difficult to know where to eat.

When I seen that they had options for vegans, I had to come. Although I'm not vegan it allowed me to have a burrito bowl full of veggies, rice and beans, topped with chipotle chicken and vegan cheese.

I have a big appetite but for the average person eating a burrito bowl you could easily save half and have it for dinner or a midnight snack.

The restaurant itself is bright and open, nice and cool with good aircon. And the staff are so friendly and attentive.

3rd time here and I'll likely be back tomorrow. I can't get enough.

Highly recommend! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Lloyd Frew

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the best experience at Sunrise Tacos Silom celebrating my birthday! Not only was the Mexican food absolutely delicious — from the sizzling fajitas to the creamy guacamole — but the atmosphere was warm and welcoming.
⁣
The staff went above and beyond by surprising me with a birthday complimentary treat. It honestly made my day extra special. 💕🎂
⁣
If you’re looking for authentic flavors, great vibes, and a team that makes you feel truly celebrated, this is the place! Highly recommend for birthdays or any special night out. 🌶️🌟
⁣
Thank you again to the amazing team! Can’t wait to come back! 🙌
sample_reviews_en.author: Min Hein

sample_reviews_en.text:
As a digital nomad and fan of Mexican food, I’ve went to a few dozens of Mexican restaurants in multiple countries... and I gotta say, the food here is one of the best of them all!

It’s full of flavor and uses my favorites ingredients! Me and my wife, so far, tried the fish tacos, horchata, carnitas chimichanga (picture attached), and a couple enchilladas; everything was delicious!!

The service is another great aspect, there is a lady that speaks perfect english and it is very friendly and polite.

On our second time there they even gave us free chips (picture attached)!
sample_reviews_en.author: Cayo Medeiros

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good location along Silom and entrance to Soi 4 where you can find the famous German restaurant and some gay bars (^^)
Very bright interior with Mexican feeling and friendly English speaking staff. Real Mexican foods and beer made me happy until I checked the bill.
Corona beer 195 baht is hotel price
Beef taco 🌮 95 baht is too small
Grilled chicken Brito 270 baht is huge but chicken too small
Delicious casual foods but overpriced, more expensive than those in Tokyo, and that’s probably the reason why I was the only customer at 8pm
sample_reviews_en.author: Inzaikun Chiba

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great spot, part of a successful chain of
Mexican restaurants across BKK.

Parents got the veggie enchiladas and the veggie quesadilla, both were excellent and flavorful. The sauces are critical here - don’t forget to ask for the hot red one as well as the avocado verde one!

Manager was Filipina lady, very kind and gave great service. I got the birria beef quesadilla with consome (335 baht) and it was on point. Worth it at the price point (m be mindful of 10% service charge) and will be back for sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anish Thakkar (Doc Thakkar)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don't go here if you're wearing clean clothes and you smell good. After two minutes in there you will stink like you have been frying chips for an hour. The extraction system is terrible. The air quality inside is bad and stinks of frying and cooking burgers. They have a poor selection of drinks available.

Basically if you're wearing shorts and flip-flops and a wife beater and you fancy a quick taco, it's probably a good place
sample_reviews_en.author: Kenneth White

restaurants.name: Rongsi Pochana Langsuan
restaurants.address:

ห้องเลขที่ B107เลขที่ 87 Soi Langsuan, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Exceptional service with amazingly prepared dish. The plating and taste passes with flying stars????? Middle spoon in every plate so it's great for a meal with colleagues, work place or even accomodating foreign visitors รับแขกบ้านแชกเมือง. The price is in an acceptable range. I was so lucky there because I went there and almost all the table were reserved. Luckily they managed to have us sit at one of the table before the reserved part arrived. The inside is well decorated and that the seating is comfortable. The air conditioning is too cold in some of the area.
sample_reviews_th.author: 李再龙

sample_reviews_en.text:
Been here many times, but this is actually my first time leaving a review. The fact that I keep coming back probably says enough by itself. Rongsi at Kimpton Maa Lai is easily a 5 star experience for me.
The food has always been consistently excellent, with great Thai flavors, quality ingredients, and beautiful presentation. But what really makes Rongsi stand out is that it’s not just about the food. The service is always warm, attentive, and professional without feeling overly formal, and the atmosphere is comfortable and stylish whether you’re coming for a casual meal or bringing guests.
Over the years, I’ve brought quite a few different people here, and everyone has enjoyed it. That consistency is probably the biggest compliment I can give. It’s easy for a restaurant to impress you once, but much harder to maintain the same quality visit after visit.
I honestly can’t remember ever leaving disappointed. Great food, great service, great atmosphere, and a place I’m always comfortable recommending to others.
Definitely one of those restaurants I’ll continue coming back to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bangkok Travels

sample_reviews_en.text:
Background:
It offers a culinary journey with a blend of Chinese and Thai flavours. Known for its bustling atmosphere, it is advisable to make a reservation to secure a table during peak meal times.

Ambience:
The ambience was great, creating a lively and energetic atmosphere. The restaurant's popularity is evident as it tends to be packed during dinner. It is recommended to make a reservation in advance.

Service:
The service was good, although it was hard to get the attention of staff members during peak service. The food is served relatively fast, though.

Food/Drinks:
The food may not be extraordinary, but it satisfies the palate. A standout dish of the night was the fried egg with preserved vegetables, showcasing a delightful combination of flavours. The fried fish is worth trying, but it was on the dry side.

Overall:
It's important to note that Rongsi Pochana leans toward the pricier side. If you're looking for a satisfactory Chinese Thai meal and don't mind the higher price point, Rongsi Pochana is a worthy choice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Gan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Rongsi Pochana, serves food that brings back old school Thai Chinese flavors. Using traditional Thai ingredients and cooking methods that brings back dishes that not only tastes great but brings back memories.

Sour veg with pork stomach was amazing! Not too sour like Thai soups, but super robust and hearty.
Crab meat with curry was even better than the restaurant starting with 'S' who invented the dish!
Stir fried squid with chili paste was very tasty and had a unique peppercorn taste.
Salmon salad had a good spice kick and balanced tangy sauce.
Oyster omelette was so so but still good, oysters were kinda dry.
Crab meat fried rice was also good, but there are better ones outside.
Grilled river shrimp was fresh and well grilled to keep the flesh succulent.

Reservations are highly recommended as it can get really packed during meal times.

Restaurant atmosphere was lively.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cedric Choo

sample_reviews_en.text:
4 stars – A Bangkok favorite for our family

Rongsi Pochana has become our go-to seafood spot whenever we’re in Bangkok. The grilled river prawns are consistently excellent — sweet, smoky, and full of roe. The steamed fish with chili-lime-garlic sauce is a must-order; the broth is punchy and perfectly balanced. Grilled squid was fresh and simply done, and the stir-fried morning glory and greens rounded out the meal nicely. The blood cockles, unfortunately, were a bit of a letdown this visit.

Beyond the food, the space itself has real character — industrial warehouse styling with great lighting and design touches that make it feel special without being pretentious. Portions are generous and clearly built for sharing, which makes it ideal for family visits.

Still a place we’ll keep coming back to when in town — just skipping the cockles next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Solidly Dubaian

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Thai-Chinese restaurant offers a wide variety of dishes 🍜. Most customers typically order dishes to enjoy with steamed rice or boiled rice (though they also have single-plate meals 🍛). The food is of high quality and delicious 😋, featuring many tempting menu items such as stewed minced pork with preserved plums, fried tofu with chili salt, stir-fried minced pork with pickled greens, and crab meat stuffed in steamed rice cake dumplings 🦀.

*The dessert options are somewhat limited 🍰.

For dining, they have both indoor 🏠 and outdoor seating areas 🌳, with the outdoor zone being pet-friendly 🐾.

The restaurant tends to get quite busy, so I recommend making a reservation in advance 📞.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tote Varisorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very disappointing experience at Rongsi. The service was unacceptable.

We were told that the space between the two tables was too small, and the customers seated around us were even asked whether they were comfortable with us sitting there. This made us feel extremely unwelcome.

What was particularly unpleasant was the clear impression that the other customers were being treated as more important than us, possibly because they were familiar with the owner. Regardless of the reason, customers should be treated equally and with respect.

Unfortunately, the attitude and handling of the situation completely ruined the experience.

Conclusion: a restaurant I would absolutely avoid.
sample_reviews_en.author: Samuel Helliere

sample_reviews_en.text:
A wonderful surprise.

The ambience is great, relaxed, lively, and inviting, and the service is genuinely kind, making the whole experience feel easy and welcoming.

The Lime Iced Tea is outstanding. The flavour is insane in the best way, you can genuinely taste how the lime has infused into the black tea, not just added on top. Fresh, deep, and incredibly refreshing.

The food was astonishingly surprising: well-executed, full of flavour, great crunch, and, notably, very generous portions without sacrificing quality.

A place that balances atmosphere, hospitality, and bold food extremely well. Definitely worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hakan

restaurants.name: Indian Express
restaurants.address:

70 55-56 Phetchaburi 31 Alley, Makkasan, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Indian express is a fantastic restaurant in the heart of city.. staff is so kind..food is tooo good.. .. I need to say we had a soulful dinner…No words to describe the food… we loved it.. cashier Adarsh is very  decent person welcomes all the guests with whole heartedly. Super smile guy..
sample_reviews_en.author: Aditya Varun

sample_reviews_en.text: Outstanding hospitality! From check-in to check-out, everything was smooth and well organized. The staff were professional, courteous, and always ready to help. A perfect place to stay.
sample_reviews_en.author: mandar patil

sample_reviews_en.text: Thank you for giving my partner and me such a wonderful first experience with Indian cuisine. The food was absolutely delicious, and the staff were so kind and welcoming. There are still many dishes we would love to try, so we look forward to visiting again next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: APBZ

restaurants.name: Sizzler Central Ladprao
restaurants.address:

Phahonyothin Rd, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Review of Sizzler Special Salad Bar Buffet

It's no surprise that after changing to the "Special" package, the place is noticeably crowded. It includes almost everything except steak. Normally 199 THB (no drinks), but for an extra 50 THB you get everything – practically everything you need, no need to order anything extra.

Unlimited cheese toast, pancakes, bread, papaya salad, fruit juice, slushies, green tea, coffee, pasta, spaghetti, salsa guacamole – that alone makes it worth it.

Personally, I love the baby carrots and pesto sauce; they go well with almost any noodle dish. I even tried them with konjac noodles tossed in sesame oil. The salad bar selection has expanded slightly from the regular package, mostly added carbohydrates. Those on a healthier diet might find it less worthwhile, but considering the unlimited drinks, it's still good value, even if you only eat the salad.

However, this new package is a double-edged sword. I noticed many tables only eating the salad bar without ordering steak. Steak sales might decrease somewhat.

If you haven't tried it yet, I highly recommend it. The pesto sauce, in particular, was amazing!

Cost: 249.-
sample_reviews_en.author: Oak Sonthitiwitoon

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The restaurant has been renovated with a new design.
However, the decor remains the same, with darker tones. Personally, I prefer this color scheme to the bright green branches.
- The food menu has expanded with more premium options for health-conscious individuals, including avocado, Greek yogurt, baby carrots, baby corn, butter-grilled vegetables, truffle soup, spaghetti where you can choose your own pasta and sauce, spicy papaya salad, bread, pancakes, smoothies, and fresh coffee.
- The service is excellent; the staff are diligent in replenishing supplies, and the customer service staff are lovely and friendly.
- The price has been adjusted to 249 baht, but with a wider variety of food options, it's a good deal.
- The restrooms are nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chai Chana

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to Sizzler Central Ladprao after a long time. This time it was extremely crowded, but the salad bar has improved a lot 🥗✨. There are many more options now, including yogurt, ice cream, and 5-6 types of soup. I was very impressed with the soup; it tasted great 🍲.

I ordered spaghetti carbonara. The first serving was quite bland, like it hadn't been seasoned properly, but when I informed the staff, they quickly replaced it with a new one. Their problem-solving service was excellent, even though the restaurant was quite busy 👍.

Overall, I was impressed. The food variety was great, and the service was excellent, even with so many people. 💯
sample_reviews_en.author: Julien Moonberry

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant was quite disappointing. The steak was serve very cold and not tasty at all. I ordered an expensive cut of meat, but the quality was very poor and not worth the price.
The salad bar was messy, with food scraps scattered everywhere and no one takes care of it.
The ice cream bowls were empty and were not refilled. When I asked about it, a staff even responded rudely.
There were also 2–3 staffs standing at the entrance, but none of them greeted customers with a friendly smile.
I felt like they could genuinely providing better service because the price I paid.
sample_reviews_en.author: This is Me

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes like the recipes have been adjusted and the serving sizes reduced. It seems like it's pre-made and then microwaved before being served when orders come in, rather than being cooked fresh. The service seems like they've reduced the number of staff during opening hours. There aren't enough staff to provide adequate service, and one person is handling multiple tasks, leading to occasional mistakes such as forgetting to give the bill after taking an order and serving the wrong items.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charith Chaichao

sample_reviews_en.text:
Newly renovated, it features a buffet and salad bar. What sets it apart from regular Sizzlers is that it includes soft drinks (no plain water, you have to order it separately), shaved ice iced tea, buttered toast, papaya salad, yogurt ice cream, and fresh coffee.
The lunch buffet salad bar costs 249 baht.
Plenty of tables, although the space isn't huge. Booking a table doesn't take long...
sample_reviews_en.author: JOHNAI OPENPORN

sample_reviews_en.text: The salad bar had a large selection, and the atmosphere was nice. However, the food took quite a while to arrive, and the steak was cold and rather dry. The service was unhelpful; they weren't very helpful and didn't answer questions well, seemingly reluctant to sell. Perhaps it was because we came close to closing time, although there was still an hour before closing.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนวรรษน์ เหง้าดา

sample_reviews_en.text: The cashier, Nong Nuan, asked and explained all the promotions very thoroughly. The service was excellent, the food didn't take long to arrive, which was impressive. The salad bar had a wide variety of items. The service was great from the moment we walked in. We will definitely come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: นรบดี นาราครี

restaurants.name: Samsen Center
restaurants.address:

Baan panthom Samsen 2 Alley, Khwaeng Ban Phan Thom, Khet Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I usually stay in Banglamphu area while in Bangkok - and this is my favourite place here!

Very cozy, good food & excellent service! Will always come back.

ขอบคุณ !

Best regards,
Solo female traveller from Finland
sample_reviews_th.author: Anna Ahola

sample_reviews_en.text:
It’s a cute place with lots of hammocks, hanging chairs and lanterns. Especially cute in the evening- it’s like a terrace, covered but you have plenty of space and practically it’s an outdoor place.

Their menu is really quite broad and contain some European, Chinese and Thai fusion food, also options for beef, duck and seafood etc. you can get a proper steak there! They have a good vegan selection. The food came very quickly, it was very pretty and tasty.

The big bonus is that you can pay with a credit card - no surcharge.

The negative is that for some reason there are so-so many mosquitoes! They seem to hide behind the furniture and even during the day there are just loads of mosquitoes- I literally had 12 bites just after 30 minutes. The mosquito situation made it very difficult for me to enjoy my stay unfortunately, but other than that, it’s a lovely set up and cool place to hang out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Juliet for OnlyOnwards

sample_reviews_en.text:
First the good: food is of great quality especially considering the prices that are cheap. The restaurant is very spacious and has a beach vibe which is what they propose..

Now, the not so good: I ordered the chicken with that white broth which is made using lemongrass. The issue I had was with the amount of lemongrass: was really everywhere and I was pretty much half of the time separating it from the rest of the food….

About the cleanliness of the space: it can improve a lot, and also the organization. The impression that I had was of a bunch of random stuff scattered everywhere: if you use the bathroom you will be walking by many personal items , maybe because the owners also live there ? Aside from this, I saw some trash on the floor like an empty water bottle.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bruno Storchi Bergmann

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere here is great. Outdoors, swing chairs, full couches, those Thai triangle cushions, all sorts of seating arrangements, and general relaxed energy is why my wife wanted to check this place out. All the food was delicious and now I’m very uncomfortable. I have a wheat allergy and the staff were able to accommodate for my needs. They were able to make wheat free/gluten free versions of pad Thai, grilled beef, and som tum (green papaya salad); my wife had coconut and butter fried rice, chicken wings, and my kid had spaghetti bolognese. Everything was delicious and my wife who usually just leaves food or gets to go boxes finished all of her food. Just overall amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kyuta Tomaru

sample_reviews_en.text: Good and pleasant discovery. The restaurant is very spacious, atypical with a good atmosphere of the beaches of southern Thailand. We came for a very simple breakfast which in the end was generous and delicious and which corresponds to an international clientele. so suddenly we came back for dinner to taste the whole Tilapia (fish) with perfect cooking and a sublime presentation. From the aperitif to the coffee the service staff we were very professional and attentive to our needs despite the world. I have to go back to Bangkok I already know where we will eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: jenifer Whu

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a chicken panang curry, veg dumplings, steamed rice and a pineapple smoothie. Food was good in general, would not say outstanding. Nonetheless, I would like to highlight the attentive staff. I ordered a smoothie and as I got a juice instead without raising any former complaints, they brought me a smoothie for free. They kept passing by to ensure I did not have any needs. Not sure how this place is later in the day but in the late afternoon / early evening, is a nice, quiet, place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nandus

sample_reviews_en.text: We arrived here for breakfast and had one of the best experience during our holiday. They serve the breakfast with the hot coffee which you can choose your favourite type (Espresso, Americano, Cappuccino, latte) and orange juice. They even have Thai breakfast too which serve with free Thai iced Tea. The prices are reasonable than the others in this area. What I like the most is the atmosphere of the place with relaxing morning music.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ann Warin

sample_reviews_en.text: Chill place with comfy seating and friendly staff. Great cocktails with a good happy hour deal (2 for 3, cocktails 150-180). Food was nicely presented and tasted great (pad Thai not spicy at all, which was appreciated!). Enjoyed an evening here on our first night in Bangkok and would happily return. It’s all outdoors so there’s no AC, but staff brought a fan over to our table as soon as we sat down so it was very comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachel Horrocks-Birss

restaurants.name: C. Elbasha Silom Branch (Halal Lebanese & Turkish Restaurant)
restaurants.address:

Corner of, 1323 ถ. เจริญกรุง Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered shawerma, falafel and pide the pide was good but the shawerma was nothing alike shawerma, it was orange and had strange taste, not shawerma taste at all. So i hope they will change the name in the menu. The frites was cold when they came. The falafel was dry and was dissapointing. And the price was so expencive. The stars is just for the kind stuff that works here, otherwise terrible experience and they give free dessert for good reviews, deffinetly somthing to have in mind while reading the reviews here
sample_reviews_en.author: FaresTop

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, with plenty of cheese 🧀. The pizza crust was soft and fragrant, and the baked cheesy pasta was rich and flavorful. The restaurant had a beautiful and unique Middle Eastern style. The staff provided good service. Overall, I was impressed. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Suchaya Vi

sample_reviews_en.text: Lebanese and Turkish cuisine are served together. The food is very delicious. The cheese pide, chicken Adana kebab, and falafel wrap were among my favorites. It's also in a very busy location. The staff are friendly and attentive. The …
sample_reviews_en.author: Dumi

sample_reviews_en.text:
A wonderful place I stumbled upon while wandering the streets of Bangkok at night!

The Lebanese food was excellent.
The welcome was perfect and the service was quick!
I highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: BenTM

sample_reviews_en.text: Superb food. Portion size is amazing and filling. Enjoyed the lunch with our family. Everyone has something to order
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohamed

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and authentic Lebanese food! Friendly staff, great service, and generous portions. Highly recommended..
sample_reviews_en.author: Laiba Tazeb

sample_reviews_en.text: Very bad service, food portion is very small and pricey i payed 175 baht for 1 ayran this is crazy!!
sample_reviews_en.author: alper mengü

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chicken shawarma platter was too good
Tasty food away from Pakistan
Love from Pakistan
sample_reviews_en.author: sardarmubashir khan

restaurants.name: Casa Pascal Restaurant
restaurants.address:

485 Pattaya Thanon Second, Pattaya City, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⸻

We went there with mixed expectations – and left with mixed feelings.

The welcome was anything but warm. Instead of a friendly "Welcome," we received a look that seemed to say, "Please, no more guests today." The service seemed overwhelmed and inattentive. It's a shame, because the initial impression is often crucial in determining whether you feel comfortable or not.

On the positive side, the food deserves a mention. The egg station was a fantastic idea – freshly prepared, cooked exactly to order, and expertly executed. The option to have various types of meat freshly grilled was also a real highlight. The taste was impeccable – solid to excellent.

The ambiance, however, unfortunately mirrored the initial atmosphere: rather cold and somewhat uninviting. It simply lacked that certain something that conveys coziness or charm. You sit there, eat well – but a genuine sense of well-being never materializes.

In conclusion: The food is good, but gastronomy is about more than just well-grilled meat. Service and atmosphere are just as important – and there's definitely room for improvement here. Therefore, I unfortunately cannot recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: marcus kares

sample_reviews_en.text:
For many years now, whenever I'm in Pattaya, I've come to Casa Pascal for the brunch buffet. I love this restaurant, its sophisticated yet relaxed atmosphere, the ambiance, and the friendly, professional service. And, of course, the abundant and wonderful buffet. I won't list everything delicious they offer. But there's a great deal, a great variety, all professionally prepared and presented. Simply delicious. And all this at a price that is exceptionally reasonable for such a high-end restaurant and such quality. Compared to the breakfast offerings of typical English and German tourist traps (lots of sausage, even more sausage, and every coffee and roll costs extra), Casa is a real bargain. Dear Schnyder family, please preserve this quality and this place of hospitality for many years to come. I felt this should be mentioned here, given some of the incomprehensible criticism I've received recently.

Lucien Huber
sample_reviews_en.author: L H

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to the breakfast buffet with my Thai wife, who has lived in Germany for 20 years.

She was thrilled with both the selection of Thai food and the variety of European dishes.

I'm not usually a big fan of Thai cuisine, but I was delighted!

Finally, a place where you can have breakfast just like at home.

And it tastes just as good!

Fresh, crusty bread, cold cuts, cheese, butter—everything was top-notch.

A huge selection, even for those with a sweet tooth.

It's also great that they offer not only juices but also soft drinks, milk—basically everything you could want.

The service is excellent, exactly as it should be.

The price-performance ratio is perfectly fine. It couldn't be better.

We came back the very next day because it was so good, and that certainly won't be the last time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Willi Ziegler

sample_reviews_en.text:
Casa Pascal is what we would describe as a true hidden gem. We received a friendly welcome with a touch of humor, which immediately created a relaxed atmosphere. After ordering our food, we were also offered some amuse-bouches, which we really appreciated.

The dishes were not only beautifully presented but also delicious and prepared with fresh ingredients. The price-quality ratio is definitely excellent. The restaurant is spacious, making it comfortable for larger groups. Reservations are strongly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: natasha dalle

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's an absolutely outstanding restaurant. The service is very attentive and incredibly friendly.

The tables are generously spaced, which I appreciate. The owner personally greets each guest. Everything is perfectly organized. I had three courses, including the Zurich-style schnitzel. Everything was superb. The name on the reserved table was a very personal touch. Unfortunately, the music was quite grating—sappy love songs. That's not really acceptable anymore.
sample_reviews_en.author: Uwe Kohlwes

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellence in all aspects. Maybe a little bit slow but we were very well taken care of being served intermediate courses „amuse bouches“ on the house - thank you 🤩 and we are not in a hurry when going out for a special meal. Spectacular clean restrooms with all ammenities could wish for. Among my favorite places to go to     It speaks for itself that the restaurant is there with exactly the same owner since approx 30 years. Bravo and thank you. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Beat Christ

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant stands out with its lovely ambiance; everything is tastefully decorated, unlike many cheap places with plastic furniture and no style. I felt very comfortable. I had breakfast, and the selection was huge, with various breads, soups, and hot and cold Thai dishes. I didn't miss a thing. I was there for over two hours and tried many things. It's definitely worth treating yourself to.
sample_reviews_en.author: franjocolonia

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fantastic upscale Thai and western food while not being pretentious. Staff are knowledgeable, fun, and good natured.

I came with friends during wan Lai not realizing this was an upscale place and the staff made us feel very welcome while we dried off.

Whoever is managing this place must be doing a good job because everyone seemed happy and filled with joy. I highly recommend Casa Pascal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cody Stratman

restaurants.name: 123 ICHI NI SAN Sathorn Soi 1
restaurants.address:

27/1-2 Soi Si Bamphen, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Probably the worst Japanese meal I have ever had. Came here because of the 4.9 rating but the food didn't justify it at all.
- The sha shu ramen was the worst. My husband and I shared it but we could barely finish the bowl. The broth was so bland that even adding more soy sauce couldn't save it. The pork had an off aroma to it and the noodles were way too overcooked.
- The Okonomiyaki (or Japanese Pizza as the restaurant calls it) was weird. The batter was as chewy as the octopus fillings.
- The ebi tempura was 80% batter and 20% frozen shrimp.
I have had much better meals than this at lower prices. No idea why it has so many good reviews.
While the waitresses did an ok job, we couldn't help but feel neglected compared to the other tables with Western customers, who got asked multiple times if everything was okay. The staff might have sensed our dissatisfaction, which is probably why they never asked for our feedback. 🤔
Also, there's no parking provided so you'll have to park at the Ibis Hotel next door for 50baht/hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bình Phan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my go-to restaurant; I eat here very often. The food is delicious, the prices are good, the salmon is excellent, and the menu is diverse.

However, I'm confused by the way the staff serves water. The first time I ordered two bottles, they didn't open them one at a time and pour them all out. Instead, they opened both bottles simultaneously and only poured about a third of each. The second time, I ordered only one bottle, but the same staff member unexpectedly opened and poured water from a second bottle (which I didn't order) even though the first bottle wasn't empty. Luckily, the manager saw and politely asked if I wanted to return the bottle.

P.S. They have a points system. If you visit, ask the staff before paying. They won't tell you unless you see it yourself. And remember to submit your receipt after each meal to collect points.

Parking is available at the ibis hotel (50 baht per hour). You can use your parking ticket for a 50 baht discount at the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: W. MN

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really don’t understand how did this restaurant have 4.9 stars on google review.
Feel like those who were eating here either was backpacking tourists or people who don’t know what’s good food is.
The ramen was soggy, meat quality and soup were bad; the okonomiyaki was like rock on the edge, and soggy inside. The tempura was frozen shrimp with too much buttered. The chawan mushi was full of low quality fillings inside. The grilled beef was chewy, meat was not tasty.
Price wasn’t cheap.
Basically there was no dishes I had that was good enough to save them. By far the worst japanese restaurant ever.
The server was rude as well, she keeps speaking Thai even though we are not, and she seems judging us as well.
She threw the bill and the qr code on the table to just let me pay it. Meanwhile she’s non stop boot licking the white couple on the other table, asking how they feel etc.
This google review is so misleading.
sample_reviews_en.author: Minh Ha

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice Japanese style restaurant.Very cozy,minimal style but yet surprisingly awesome.They have a cute corner of two tables for small group (like for 2 to 4people) to sit with legs up,which I find it very nice and creative.Great food.The place welcome us with a very crispy and yummy seaweed.Food is really fresh,especially the spicy salmon,tastes amazing.Grilled octopus is a must order here.The crab roll is so good, very big roll.All the food here comes in quite a big serving compared to other places.Also very yummy.Japanese pizza is quite unique,tastes amazing,heard its a special recipe of the place.Very nice service mind and friendly staff. Always smile and keep refilling the drinks. This place  turned out to be my  favourite place now.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sareena S

sample_reviews_en.text: We were here on our last evening. It was truly excellent! The best quality sushi we've ever had. Very Japanese and original! The atmosphere is also very pleasant. Just be aware, the portion sizes are very, very large! We're from Europe and aren't used to such large portions (see photo). Because of this, we ordered way too much. But we were able to have it packed up without any problems and even exchanged some rolls for takeaway while we were eating. It was incredibly delicious and of extremely high quality. For us, the price was also extremely reasonable for this quality. We are very satisfied and if we are ever in Bangkok again, we will definitely come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lilith Kampfert

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just had a meal at this Japanese restaurant near to
My Hotel in Bangkok Sathorn area ,on arrival there was no one
To greet and at first the waitress seemed a bit brusque but
They were busy and she seemed a little stressed,
Ordered the food which was Salmon & eel on rice and miso soup
With Large prawn Tempura , the Salmon seemed a little undercooked but was very fresh and dish not very hot but this didn’t spoil it , the Shrimp tempura was probably the best I’ve ever tasted & miso soup v good also
Had two small Asahi

beers .
Enjoyed the meal very much !
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Johnson

sample_reviews_en.text:
Where to start! Four days spent in Bangkok and every day was finished here (lived nearby), and loved that fact! This place with the staff and good food made me fall in love in Japanese Cuisine.
We tried ramen & miso soups, fried fish set, grilled set, sushi rolls, gyozas, rice with vegetables and chicken, fried salmon pancakes, wagyu sushi, beef sticks, salmon deep fried balls and literally everything was beyond delicious! So grateful to find this place and so happy for everyone who is going to try their dishes. Absolutely in LOVE!
sample_reviews_en.author: maka berbichashvili

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely incredible experience. I've eaten here two times now in a row, and the sushi is amazing as well as every other dish that I've tried. The sushi chef does not skimp on the cuts of sushi and sashimi, and you get plenty of protein for your order. Which is a nice change compared to some sushi restaurants that will give you slivers of fish. The miso soup is packed with seaweed and green onion and has great flavor. I'm very satisfied with the food and the service is exceptional here. Definitely recommend this establishment!
sample_reviews_en.author: Eric Wingfield

Photo 2 dans l'avis rédigé par Simon

restaurants.name: Vegan Pranakhon- Khaosan Road วีแกนพระนคร- ถนนข้าวสาร

sample_reviews_en.text:
We celebrated our wedding anniversary with an unforgettable dining experience at Vegan Pranakhon, thanks to our wonderful hostess, Intha.

The vegan dumpling salad, tempura-fried coconut meat with a delicious sauce, and grilled satay were absolutely delicious. The Panang Curry was good, but the rest was simply out of this world!
Don’t miss the Vegan Pork Belly with Garlic Confit. And the Pad Thai will take this well-known dish to the next level.

Of course, the drinks and desserts will stay in your memory as well.

A special thanks to Vegan Mahanakhon as well for the complimentary Mango Sticky Rice.
We greatly appreciate your  customer-focused service at both restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Early Retirement Abroad

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant features a contemporary and elegant ambiance, complemented by a team of courteous, welcoming, and attentive staff. The service was professional, prompt, and consistently attentive throughout our visit, with the staff providing thoughtful and well-informed recommendations from the menu. The menu offers a diverse selection of dishes, catering to a wide range of preferences. We sampled several menu items, the majority of which were served promptly and were of excellent quality. Overall, the dining experience was highly enjoyable, and I would not hesitate to return in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nour Atrib

sample_reviews_en.text: I found a small place near Khosan Road with 6 tables, but upstairs it has a double dining room, both very cozy and well-decorated. The staff was very friendly, the food was excellent—I loved it! The background music was very soft, and the only downside was the slightly worn wooden floor. The unisex bathrooms were very clean and unique. The prices are a bit higher than what you usually find in Thailand, but totally justified by the quality, the presentation, the decor, and the very attentive service, which was never intrusive. It was perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michel Messaoudene

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is one of the best restaurants I’ve ever eaten at. Every bite of food was incredible. The attention to detail, flavor combinations, depth of spices is simply divine. I am eagerly running to eat there again and explore the menu further.

Highlights:

Coconut meat appetizer
Pad Thai
Vegan pork belly
Tofu skin skewer

Do not skip this restaurant if you’re in BK.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ashley Molson

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was excellent; we ordered three dishes to share, and they were very generous. The best was the satay meat with pita bread and a delicious peanut sauce. Ben served us; he was very friendly and attentive, and he understood everything we asked for perfectly! I would definitely go back! Everything was delicious, thank you Intha and Ben!
sample_reviews_en.author: Renata Saibene

sample_reviews_en.text: We found this place on Google and it was one of the best choices. The place itself is very cozy and nice decorated. We were warmly welcomed by the friendly staff. The menu is very original and completely vegan. Food was delicious. So if you are looking for a vegan restaurant in the center of Bangkok, this is the place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Marlies Collantes

sample_reviews_en.text:
How do I start…
This is literally one of the best vegan restaurants I’ve ever been to.
The food is absolutely amazing. Came twice and tried different dishes. All of them exceeded my expectations. Even my non vegan friend was impressed by the food.
This restaurant is a MUST if you’re visiting Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karime Cortés Bracamonte

sample_reviews_en.text:
Finding this place was a surprise. After so much noise on Khaosan Avenue, entering a quiet environment with excellent music was already surprising.
But the menu is even better.
The explosion of flavors with each bite is wonderful.
I ate the jackfruit dish. Delicious!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Suzi Camey

restaurants.name: Ae&ek Steak Vilaiwan Resort, Sukhumvit 81, Pattaya
restaurants.address:

225 ตําบล, 5 ซอย สุขุมวิท 81 Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is by far my favorite restaurant in Pattaya. They have delicious food and great atmosphere (they recently did some renovations which is for the better). The portions are big and they taste great too. My favorites are the baked spinach, pepper pork chops and the T-bone.

There isn’t a lot of parking area and the place can be busy during lunch and dinners so I would plan my visits before or after peak hours. You can order take-outs which is amazing if you wanna eat somewhere else.

The place is next to a big pond and you can enjoy feeding the fish if you want just buy the fish food for 10 ThB. This is good activity for kids while waiting for your table/food.

There are 2 ways to get to the restaurant but I would always use the way by Sukhumvit Road as the other one can get flooded specially when it rains.

Wrap up: if you are looking for great food and great atmosphere visit Ae&Ek restaurant. You wont be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Davis Apas (Personal)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very cosy place with good background music. Nice scenery with a view at water and green. Small but relaxing interior with good, comfortable Seats.
The mocktails are beautiful served and very tastfull. Especially the Pasion Fruit Juice.
They serve European inspired food such as sirloin and T-bone steak, pork rib, lasagne, pasta en salade's.
I eat the duck a l'orange witch was very good coocked but the use raspberry instead of oranges to make the souce...... to bad bud delicious at the same time. My spouse ordered the T-bone steak and ask it medium rare. And indeed here they know how to prepare there meat! Very good!!!
Also one of the few restaurants where the staff take away your empty plates when Finnish eating. Not a common action in Thailand  555
Only 1 point for me to upgrade, the drinks come from another bar and have to buy separately....... to bad. This can be arranged intern isn't it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jos Breesch

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ae&ek Steak, located on Sukhumvit Boulevard, is the ultimate local restaurant where you can enjoy high-quality Western cuisine at affordable prices. 🍽️

Taste and Value: The biggest appeal is being able to enjoy thick, juicy steaks at reasonable prices ranging from 200 to 400 baht. Not only the steaks, but also the spaghetti and salads on the menu suit Korean palates well, and the generous portions ensure high satisfaction. 🍝

Atmosphere and Accessibility: Thanks to the clean and spacious interior, it is pleasant for families and large groups. It is so famous among locals that it is always bustling with energy, and the friendly service from the staff made for a very pleasant dining experience. ✅

As a place that boasts the perfect trifecta of 'price, taste, and service,' I highly recommend visiting this place without hesitation if you are craving steak during your trip to Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steel

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited a steak cafe and had a positive overall experience. We ordered striploin and T-bone; both steaks come with salad and fries, making it convenient and filling.

The striploin was quite fatty, with some sinew—an acquired taste. The T-bone, however, was much more enjoyable: juicy, tasty, and well-cooked—it's definitely recommended.

We also tried the mussels with cheese—they were delicious, aromatic, and flavorful. The wine and orange smoothie were also a pleasant surprise and complemented the dinner perfectly.
