The cafe itself is pleasant: there's a main dining room and a cozy terrace with tables. Sitting outside is especially beautiful—there's a lotus pond nearby, creating a calm and relaxing atmosphere.

It's important to keep the opening hours in mind: the cafe is open until 9:00 PM, but orders are accepted until 8:00 PM. Overall, it's a good place for a quiet dinner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Almira

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came to the restaurant in person, there were clearly empty tables available, and we were ready to order immediately.
However, we were refused entry because those tables were “reserved for online bookings.”

This creates a very frustrating situation where guests who are already present are turned away, while empty tables are kept waiting for people who may or may not arrive later.

It feels like walk-in customers are treated as less important than online reservations.
This policy shows a lack of common sense and customer-focused service.

Very disappointing experience.
Will not return and do not recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ruslan L

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I had a fantastic experience at Ae and Ek! The food was absolutely amazing—every dish we tried was prepared to perfection and full of flavor.
What made the visit even better was the service. The staff are really amazing; they were incredibly welcoming and made us feel right at home from the moment we walked in. It’s rare to find a spot where both the quality of the meal and the hospitality are this consistently high.
I can't recommend this place enough if you're looking for a great meal and a friendly atmosphere. I’ll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came here today to have lunch as it’s our last day in Pattaya before we go back to Malaysia to visit my parents.

The food is good, inexpensive and value for money for its size. I noticed that they’ve renovated and it looks more spacious and estatically pleasing.

There is a big pond next to the restaurant that has arowana fishes. In case, you don’t want to eat in the air conditioned part of the restaurant, you could opt to eat outside in the shaded patio.

The bill came up to 500 baht for 1 adult, a teenager and a 2yo infant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adrian Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Relaxing chill atmosphere over looking a small man made lake.
Affiliated with the branch on the lake.
Attentive staff

Pork chop w/Peppercorn sauce: tender, juicy , fatty and satisfying. The pork chop was much thicker than the other branch.

Curry Shrimp omelette over rice
Peppery curry with a slight hint of spiciness goes great with the runny omelette. Delicious

Plenty of car and bike parking.

If this review was helpful, please give it a 👍

Happy Eats

Mix berry smoothie was refreshing
sample_reviews_en.author: SoloJoe

restaurants.name: MAYs Pattaya
restaurants.address:

หมู่ที่ 12 315/73 Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The Thai food here is absolutely amazing but unfortunately it is very over priced. Ka Prao Gai (chicken) with rice and water cost me ฿480. Normally Ka Prao Gai costs ฿200 including everything.
sample_reviews_th.author: Steven Santoro

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a very enjoyable lunch here. The restaurant has a cozy atmosphere with lots of beautiful orchids and indoor plants, making the space feel warm, relaxing, and inviting.
The staff were friendly and attentive, and one thing I really appreciated was how accommodating they were with food preferences. There are plenty of vegetarian and vegan options, and they are happy to adjust dishes according to your requests. The menu offers a wide variety of choices, and everything we ordered was absolutely delicious.
Parking can be a bit challenging, especially during busy hours, but it's worth the effort once you're inside.
Just one small suggestion for improvement: while there are still customers dining, it would be better not to clean tables using a strongly scented disinfectant spray. The smell was quite intense (similar to hospital-grade disinfectant) and briefly affected the dining experience. Perhaps waiting until guests leave or using a milder cleaning product would be more comfortable for everyone.
Overall, a lovely restaurant with great food, excellent service, and a beautiful setting. I would definitely come back and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ana

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very good food. Extremely slow, was in there for hours, but overall pleasant experience.

The best Thai food I have eaten in Pattaya by far. Extremely good.

*** (2024 review)***
———————————————————————

Previously gave 5*. But had to edit review now.

Second time lately I have been to Mays and not sure what has happened with the chef maybe or like most restaurants got too comfortable earning to care so much about the food anymore.

Food came warm at best today.

First time ordered Tom kha gai was bland and chicken had zero flavour.

Came again today and massaman was luke warm and lacking flavour. Ingredients still quality but I feel like the good chef maybe gone?

All in all - used to be better hence the positive first review and pictures I left but that was more than a year ago.
sample_reviews_en.author: Louis Green

sample_reviews_en.text:
Third time eating here.
Small, high-quality restaurant.
Good atmosphere for a romantic dinner.

Placed my order.
Have to repeat "Jack Daniel's" four times before a 7Up arrives.
Have to get up to give them the bottle.

The shrimp salad appetizer, before, the sweet and savory balance was perfect with a very slight hint of port. Now, the port flavor is missing, and the sweet and savory balance is off.
Eating a sweet appetizer bothered me, even though it tasted very good.

Same for the main course. Excellent, but still too sweet, even though it's the main course.

I come here for dinner, not three sweet desserts.
The taste is there and very high quality, but this emphasis on sweetness really bothered me.

1400 baht, 2 whiskeys, appetizers, main course
sample_reviews_en.author: J. C.

sample_reviews_en.text:
At first, I thought this restaurant looked like it was geared towards foreigners, and it is. You can bring foreigners here to eat, but the flavors are rich and authentically Thai. They just reduced the spiciness a little, but you can order it spicier if you want.

Every dish that was served was delicious.
I loved the battered and fried crab.

The beef curry was delicious; they probably used fresh coconut milk, which was rich and flavorful.

The chicken satay was also very tender.

The beef massaman curry was rich and creamy.
The Japanese customers were very impressed with the pomelo salad.
The chicken wrapped in pandan leaves was also good.
I forgot to take pictures of many dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: SSS BKK

sample_reviews_en.text: I can only agree with everyone else, it's the best in Pattaya for upscale Thai cuisine. I've been going there regularly since it opened. Unfortunately, lately there have been too many large Chinese groups, and their behavior and noise completely ruin the atmosphere. But since that will surely sort itself out soon, I'm naturally sticking with my 5 stars. Whether you're there with a farang (foreigner) or a Thai companion, it's always a culinary experience! No more Chinese tourists – the old flair is back. And now I have to say, the service is even better than ever! 10 stars...
sample_reviews_en.author: Mat Thai

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were looking for a small restaurant away from the tourist crowds. We stumbled upon Mays Pattaya and, drawn by its charming entrance, decided to give it a try – and it was absolutely the right decision.

The atmosphere inside was lovely, the staff were incredibly friendly, and the food was truly delicious.

Since we only wanted a light meal, we shared the curry trio.

Anyone looking for good Thai food will definitely find it here.

Update: We went back to Mays Pattaya a second time, and everything was perfect again.

Thank you to the wonderful team at Mays Pattaya ♡
sample_reviews_en.author: Rene P.

sample_reviews_en.text: An exceptionally unassuming restaurant. Despite using navigation, we couldn't find it because of the plants in the entrance area. The restaurant is invitingly designed and offers a pleasant atmosphere. We received excellent service and advice from start to finish. When we asked, they offered recommendations that perfectly matched the description. The food was very tasty and beautifully presented. The value for money is exceptionally good!
sample_reviews_en.author: R W

restaurants.name: Nava Pad Thai
restaurants.address:

QG62+HFJ, Banphanthom Alley, Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the most grounded dining experience I had in Bangkok. A small shop with the food being cooked right outside the main door, some of the tables are repurposed sweing machines!! The staff are very courteous (not something I can say for quite a few places in Thailand from my PoV), the service is rather quick and the pricing is very affordable. Beer too is available. The egg in the pad thai just steals the show, it was the most perfectly cooked egg I have eaten in my life. Pork in red curry paste was another item I ate and it was decent. I suspect they dumbed down some of the flavour levels to suit a foreign pallet but they have plenty of condiments on every table to add your own personal zing to the food. A hidden gem that I suspect won't be hidden for long. A definite must visit eatry.
sample_reviews_en.author: rajath 2137

sample_reviews_en.text:
April 2026: Back in Bangkok after 6 years, we returned to this restaurant with great pleasure!! Still as inexpensive and, above all, excellent!

In the end, we went back at least once a day.

- Pad Thai (chicken, shrimp, or squid)
- Pad See You (pork and chicken, really delicious 😋)
- Radna (with its thick broth/sauce)
- Stir Fried Basil (pork, quite spicy)
- Morning Glory with Crispy Pork Belly
The dishes are served quickly, even when it's very busy. Incredible value for money.
One of our favorites in Thailand.

February 2020: A very enjoyable restaurant! Very friendly and smiling staff, and excellent food!
We ate Pad Thai and rice dishes. The portions were generous.
I highly recommend it.
Just a few minutes from Khao San Road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manu

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best pad Thai I’ve tried across Thailand.
I accidentally stumbled upon this restaurant on my first day and I was so glad I did.
The pad Thai has all the flavours perfectly balanced without anything overpowering the other.
The pad see ew was also very delicious with an amazing depth of savouriness.
The stir fried morning glory with crispy pork was also incredible but it is quite spicy so be warned if you cannot handle spice.
It was a very cosy and homely atmosphere which was how I knew the food was going to be incredible but it exceeded all expectations I had.
The prices are also insanely cheap for the standard of quality so definitely try it if you’re in the area! And even if you’re not, I’d recommend travelling for it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Zoe Lieu

sample_reviews_en.text:
It is rare that I do not enjoy food, but my pad thai was one of them. I came here because it had excellent revews.

The service was excellent, placr clean, provided good internet - but the food not so. My pork pad thai was incredibly greasy, too sweet and no other flavour. The pork tasted wierd and I ended up not eating it.  I am not sure what oil they used but it gave everything a bad taste - and I never ever had a bad padthai in my life. Morning glory was nice ( though very greacy too). I forgot to ask for not spicy ( it was VeRY hot) - but that was my fault.
sample_reviews_en.author: Barbara Guttman

sample_reviews_en.text:
As the name suggests, this restaurant serves delicious Pad Thai. Other Thai dishes are also inexpensive and generous in portion size. Singha 80 baht, Chang, and Leo beers are available for 70 baht. It's a great place for beer lovers. The air-conditioned interior is clean, and the friendly couple who run the place provide excellent service and cooking, making it a truly precious and comfortable restaurant.

I just wish they stayed open a little later.
sample_reviews_en.author: toshio okamura (oka3)

sample_reviews_en.text:
It is a small eatery located in an alley next to the canal.

I ordered a plate of Pad Krapao topped with a fried egg.

The minced meat is infused with a strong basil aroma, and the seasoning is quite strong.

The edges of the egg are fried to a crisp, which pairs well with the rice.

They served a generous portion of rice, so one plate was enough to fill me up.

It is quiet as it is located slightly off the beaten path for tourists.
sample_reviews_en.author: 잘난코

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious pad Thai in Bangkok! Visited for lunch and sat on the only vacant table in their indoor restaurant, which has about five to six tables. Ordered two of the vegetable pad thai, which was both fantastic. Great portions, wonderful balance of flavours made with fresh ingredients, and all the necessary accommpaniments available on the table. Fantastic value, lovely service, and a great all round experience. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Callaghan

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's delicious!

However, it's not good enough to go out of your way to eat there.

It tasted good because I just walked over since my accommodation was nearby; it's not special enough to warrant taking a Grab taxi just to eat it.

Make sure to try the crispy pork version of the Morning Glory. The meat is super tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Young

restaurants.name: André
restaurants.address:

11/1 Charoen Krung 42 Alley, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tried out this place nearby Saphan Taksin BTS. It’s sort of “hidden” in the soi, so need to keep an eye when coming by walking. The place itself is not big & have plenty of table, but it can feel a bit tight. Reservation is highly recommended as they only open for dinner service.
For the food tried out:
• escargot which is cooked in a cream sauce with mushrooms and served with sliced baguettes. Overall it tasted ok but the baguette was a bit soggy.
• scallops with ratatouille, it was cooked a bit too well done for me since it’s a bit dry.
• ribeye with potatoes, the beef is done nicely and still tender & juicy. It has an intense seasoning so it’s a bit too salty for me to eat as is, but it was balanced out by the cream sauce. It is also served with baked garlic knob.
Service was quick and the staff is attentive which is a plus point. Also price wise for a french restaurant, it is quite affordable. And the portion is easily shareable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maharani

sample_reviews_en.text:
You get exactly what you pay for at André, and that’s a steal for the quality. I can’t complain about the food—it’s not the absolute best I’ve ever had, but calling it “meh” or “mid” would be blasphemy.
Tucked away in a small alley in Bangrak district, this French restaurant offers delicious cheese, steak, and cold cuts at VERY affordable prices. This is a family-run kind of place with laid-back vibe. There is no air conditioning, and there is no frickin Door. A stray cat might march in and eye your plate, so leave your high heels and premium satin dresses at home. This is the kind of place where you can share stories with friends and let out a high-decibel laugh without turning heads. The food is cooked beautifully just as the photos suggest. Escargots is available here but I wouldn't call this a French restaurant. The fans are a big problem because it melt ice quickly and ruin your drink!

Would visit again and again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Derrick Ma

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is very good. There is no air conditioning because there is no door, and it is suitable to visit between November and January when the weather is good. I tried lamb, sirloin, and tenderloin, and the lamb and tenderloin were soft and good. The sirloin was a bit tough. The house wine is good to drink, and the other wines are reasonably priced. It is good for small gatherings, but reservations are essential. It is within walking distance of Central, so if you are having a light meal, you can park in Central.

The staff always keep an eye on customers and immediately bring them items such as forks and knives if they fall down.

If you sit with your back to the street, please be careful as the floor surfaces of the street and the store are not level, so the chair may tip over or wobble.

There is phone number for booking.
sample_reviews_en.author: HYERAN HONG

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s too bad we found this restaurant near the end of our stay in Bangkok. It is a gem! Their steaks are outstanding, and the prices are fantastic. I had the tenderloin, medium rare. It was cooked perfectly. My wife had a ribeye that came to her sliced up. She ordered it medium. It was also cooked perfectly. It was accompanied by some homefry type potatoes, and a bulb of garlic, which had been roasted in the oven. We each had a glass of the house red wine, which was quite nice. The charcuterie board a few tables away from us was heaping! Desserts looked great, although we did not have one that night. The restaurant is open-aired, located down a quiet street. It was packed! Make sure you have a reservation before going, or you may be disappointed. I highly recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffrey Babbitt

sample_reviews_en.text:
For my birthday I wanted steak, and decided upon André, as the feedback on Google was exceptionally strong.
Needless to say, I was not disappointed in the least.

At 8pm, all but 2 tables were occupied. A testament to it's popularity.

Between my partner and I we had the garlic prawns and melon Parma ham for starters (both excellent, with the prawns phenomenal)

For our mains we had the tenderloin and ribeye.
Again, without wanting to sound redundant, each steak was expertly prepared.

Even though we we both completely satisfied, I figured it wouldn't be a birthday without one final indulgence, so selected the Profiteroles for dessert.

Final bill came to under 2000 baht (we had water) which is stupendous value for the quality of the meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lex H

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely delicious experience at Andres in Bangkok! From the moment we arrived, the attentive staff made us feel welcomed and well taken care of. We indulged in the ribeye, which was cooked to perfection and incredibly flavorful. The scallops were a standout, beautifully seared and paired perfectly with the other dishes. The burrata was creamy and fresh, while the Camembert was rich and delightful. We also enjoyed a lovely wine selection that complemented our meal beautifully. Highly recommend Andres for anyone looking for a fantastic dining experience!

*Edit review * I’ve been back a handful of times since my first review and can honestly say the quality has been the exact same every time. One of my favourite restaurants in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Bourne

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had dinner here with my lady friend and wanted to express my appreciation for the excellent experience.

I started with the buttered shrimp and a glass of house white while waiting for my company to arrive. We then enjoyed the cold cuts and cheese plate, Fin de Clair oysters, and the tenderloin paired with a bottle of well chilled Viogner. Every dish was served in a generous portion and tasted amazing!

The waitresses were professional, friendly, and attentive. Even though the restaurant was quite busy and a bit less cozy because of the crowd, the service and food quality were absolutely top-notch.

I would definitely come back if I’m ever in the area again. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mamacita Wei

sample_reviews_en.text:
I passed by this restaurant many times. Already when they were at their old location. I tried a few times to grab a table but it is mostly booked out. Just once I had a glass of wine and enjoyed the beautiful atmosphere. Then tonight I finally got a table. And it was worth the wait. Beautiful place, great food and fantastic atmosphere. Prices are more than reasonable.

I had the tenderloin with potatoes. The steak was cooked to perfection and the wine was nice. Very attentive service as well. The place has an open front and the alley is great for people watching. Will come back to try the moules et frites.

Make sure to book a table in advance!
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

restaurants.name: Central Northville
restaurants.address:

68/100, 68, 919 หมู่ที่ 8 Rattanathibet Rd, Bang Krasaw, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate at The Stone...the service was terrible...I ordered the dishes I wanted, but they told me to wait half an hour. They only forced me to order what they had ready to sell...The restaurant was full, but there was no queuing system...I was made to stand and wait without any queue numbers or records of who was waiting or what number I was in the queue...I recommend you avoid The Stone.
sample_reviews_en.author: เอมิกาญ

sample_reviews_en.text:
🌿 Atmosphere: The new look is beautiful, shady, with airy, tree-lined areas; not crowded.
🍽️ Food: Lots of restaurants and cafes. Tops Food Hall is large and has a complete selection.
🐶 Pet-Friendly: You can bring your dogs and cats to walk around in the PetVille zone.
🚆 Transportation: Conveniently located near the MRT Nonthaburi 1 Intersection station.
sample_reviews_en.author: V Vara

sample_reviews_en.text: Formerly Central Rattanathibet, it's now Central Northville. It's been renovated, becoming more modern and larger with beautiful interior design. It incorporates nature into the mall, creating a refreshing and relaxing atmosphere. There are also more shops and restaurants than before.
sample_reviews_en.author: jeab srimart

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a new mall. It's very well architectured and maintained. It's so good. There's a tops food hall for very affordable food options. There are lot of food variety ready to eat in tops food hall. And also there are many stores here for you to shop and explore.
sample_reviews_en.author: Drift King

sample_reviews_en.text: There should be some umbrellas for the security guards at the parking lot ticket booth, or maybe they don't need anyone standing there at all since it's an automated ticket machine anyway. It's very hot, I feel sorry for the security guards.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rose Pimpattra

sample_reviews_en.text: The newly renovated mall is very pleasant to walk around. It's filled with shops and restaurants, but still has plenty of common areas, including a playground and seating areas, for visitors.
sample_reviews_en.author: K P

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice place, so many restaurants. Why don't you open Uniqlo and Muji or Zara would be a big boost for the mall
sample_reviews_en.author: Stefano Gallo

sample_reviews_en.text: The parking management is terrible. How many malls have they done this at already? It's baffling!
sample_reviews_en.author: Khunnadech Mabuppha

restaurants.name: Eat Am Are 253 Asok Building
restaurants.address:

253 ชั้น G, Asok Alley, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is edible and delicious if you're hungry.
The service is mostly provided by foreigners. I wish they would practice their Thai more. Also, I believe the restaurant is already using a lot of technology, but there are still instances of orders not arriving and needing to be followed up. I think that shouldn't happen. It's the easiest thing to maintain. Find a solution. Hire people to track orders, or use an app for staff to help track the progress of each step: taking orders, cooking, completion, waiting to be served. And also provide a time estimate for each step, specifying how many minutes it should take. Keep up the good work! I'm looking forward to seeing Eat Am Are's improvements.
sample_reviews_en.author: Samana Nitcharat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came here with some colleagues for lunch and I was so impressed by what we got.

I got the combo of fish & chips and spicy chicken, and both were so good! Fish was nicely breaded, but still had a decent amount of actual fish in there. Chicken was moist and tender, and went very well with the chilli sauce that came with it (for those curious, this was more of a sweet chilli).

Portions were also really generous, and definitely worth the price that I paid!

Drinks wise, the iced chocolate I got was nice and chocolatey! A much welcome relief from the hot weather today :)

Would definitely love to come here again some day :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Unazaki

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten at this branch many times because it's near my regular barbershop. I feel the portion sizes are smaller than other branches I've tried. The taste is okay, standard. You can order the papaya salad less spicy, and the chicken isn't tough.

The staff are quick and easy to call.
This branch is a bit cramped, with tables very close together. I think it's because it's in the city center and they have to use the space efficiently. Parking is difficult. I recommend taking the MRT; get off at Phetchaburi station and walk back for no more than 5 minutes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jidapa Samphunjaroen

sample_reviews_en.text:
The steak was a good size, meeting the standard. Everything was delicious, excellent ✨ because some branches give really small portions. The restaurant interior was clean and the atmosphere was nice, giving a real dinner feel.
The service was good, but the staff's Thai wasn't very clear yet. There was a bit of confusion when repeating the order, but they'll probably get better with time 👍 Keep up the good work!
sample_reviews_en.author: Phimagine

sample_reviews_en.text: The price is reasonable, and the taste matches the price. It was almost perfect, but the only downside was that when I ordered a salad as a side dish (without the fried items), they put way too much creamy dressing on it. I recommend ordering the dressing separately.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fridus Zypherd

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch is truly different from the others. The shop is beautiful, the atmosphere is great, and the staff are incredibly attentive. It feels very premium. (Personally, I sat inside and thought it was a little dark.) Overall, it's fantastic!
sample_reviews_en.author: Naphaskamon Opasi

sample_reviews_en.text: The meat quality is decent, the taste is good, the price is reasonable, there are many options, and ordering via QR code eliminates the problem of trying to communicate with staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vorramaz Thammapinan

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork chop was absolutely delicious, and the fish and chips were perfectly crispy and flavorful. Most importantly, the staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Joe PT

restaurants.name: HITORI SHABU สาขา Marché Thonglor
restaurants.address:

2nd Fl Marché Thonglor 148 Thong Lo, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
***Poor Service***
・Ordered “Sparkling Water” but got Singha Soda Water (didn’t get any information from staff)
・There were many hall staff, but most didn't seem interested in checking customers. I constantly had to get their attention. (to get tea refilled, to add more order, etc.)
・I requested the staff to clear my table after the main course. It took 20 minutes for them to clear the table before I received dessert. Even the nabe is getting dried by heating for 20 minutes, no staff take intention.
・Unfortunately, after bringing these issues to the restaurant's attention, neither the restaurant manager nor the area manager was willing to address my feedback.

Food is good, but the poor service makes it not worth the high prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamon S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had shabu-shabu hot pot today, ordered a set  meal featuring grade 5 A Wagyu beef.

The beef tasted incredibly tender and premium. The service was thoughtful and polite. What impressed me most was the stunning interior design, which creates a serene and peaceful zen-like atmosphere. Everything about the dining experience was superb.

The perfect finishing touch was Hokkaido ice cream. It was classic vanilla flavour drizzled with salty caramel syrup. The whole meal felt extremely pleasant. The taste gradually grew richer as I ate. I dipped the beef in peanut sauce for a richer savoury taste, then wrapped up the feast with the refreshing ice cream. It was an absolutely wonderful culinary journey.
sample_reviews_en.author: Estelle Wong

sample_reviews_en.text:
A cozy, refined shabu restaurant that truly feels like dining in Japan. Calm atmosphere, clean design, and very well-organized perfect for enjoying quality food without feeling rushed.

Hitori Shabu Marche offers a wide variety of premium beef cuts. I ordered the Wagyu A5 set, and it was very satisfying. The quality of the meat really stood out fresh, well-marbled, and served with care. This Thonglor branch especially gives an authentic Japanese dining experience.

Taste: ⭐⭐⭐
The Wagyu A5 was rich and tender, melting nicely in the shabu broth. Simple flavors, but done right.

Worth the price: Yes
For the quality of beef and the overall experience, the price feels reasonable and justified.
sample_reviews_en.author: DAO J.

sample_reviews_en.text:
It is a place where you can enjoy Authentic Japanese Sukiyaki and Shabu Shabu.
Overall, it is neat and the quality of the food is excellent.
However, one thing that is very regrettable is the service.
When I finished eating the meat and was making porridge,
The clerk asked me if I ate it all.
The clerk started organizing the table by putting the tissue in the bowl I was eating.
I was very embarrassed;;;;
(I double checked Opening time, It was at 21:15)
I was eating and didn't know he would organize my table.
It was such a bummer.
I will visit here again,
If it's the same price as other places, it's determined by the quality of service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Lee (Food brand manager)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hitori Shabu is one my most revisited chains in all of Bangkok. Particularly the one in Marche Thonglor.

The high quality beef options with different cuts is quite unbelievable for the value and taste. I am rarely impressed by a chain, however having been to Japan more than 4 times, I can honestly say this plays beats a lot of Shabu shabu restaurants in Japan.

I would highly suggest to anyone who would like to try not only japanese wagyu, but also have a true Japanese culture trip without leaving Bangkok.

I've been been here more than 10 times and now onto the next 10+ times.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ali

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had such a fantastic dining experience, all thanks to our server, Tunyong. From the moment we sat down, she was incredibly helpful, serving us with a genuine smile that made us feel instantly welcome. She did a wonderful job explaining the menu and walking us through the current promotions, ensuring we got the best value. She was so helpful in showing me how to cook the sukiyaki. That level of attentive service is rare and truly appreciated.
Because of Tunyong's exceptional hospitality and dedication, we will definitely be coming back again soon. Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: Layla Lwin

sample_reviews_en.text: Well designed Japanese restaurant with a unique concept of "hotpot for one". Staff is attentive and will check in at the right times. Food was average to me - aside from the Akita A5 wagyu, the rest of the beef menu didn't have much taste, and the bland soups we ordered (Hitori and Kombu flavors) didn't help. Kurobuta pork slices were good though. Generous with the vegetable set's portion. Would still recommend a visit as the set is a rather complete Japanese dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Xian You Lim

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came at 9pm and too short of time to enjoy the meal as I’ve haven’t started to eat, they asked u for last order.
After the food is boiled, the Hitori soup are sweet, the seaweed soup are still bland. A5 Zabuton are still the best compare to A5 Jyou Rousu.
Allow urself more time so can get to try other meats. Perfectly clean and hygiene pots to enjoy with friends together.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poppy Flower

restaurants.name: ครัวเมืองเว้ ลาว ญวน เซ็นทรัลปิ่นเกล้า
restaurants.address:

ศูนย์การค้าเซ็นทรัลปิ่นเกล้า เลขที่ 7/222 ชั้น 5 Borommaratchachonnani Rd, Khwaeng Arun Amarin, Khet Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a truly authentic Vietnamese restaurant. They give you as much vegetables as you ask for; whatever vegetables you want, they'll provide them. This Vietnamese restaurant is incredibly generous with their vegetables – I have to commend them for that. The vegetables they provide are also high-quality. I love eating vegetables, so if I don't eat here, I'd go to Sizzler.
I'm impressed that they always give me exactly what I want in terms of vegetables. I hope they maintain this level of generosity.

This is unlike other Vietnamese restaurants that are very stingy with their vegetables. I used to like the taste of their food, but now I don't go back to those places anymore.

The taste of the food here is average. Personally, I think the flavors aren't strong; they're on the milder side – not overly sweet, spicy, or sour. But I'm most impressed with the generous amount of vegetables, which is why I keep driving here. There's also a long line of people waiting.
sample_reviews_en.author: S P

sample_reviews_en.text:
Vietnamese food lovers can't miss this! 🇻🇳📍Hue Kitchen – Central Pinklao

Today I tried the "Vietnamese Dumplings / Vietnamese Rice Noodle Soup." Let me tell you, the aroma was amazing from the moment it arrived! The hot soup had a distinct shiitake mushroom scent, perfectly balanced with pepper – incredibly refreshing. It was packed with ingredients like pork ribs, Vietnamese sausage, and crispy fried shallots, adding a delightful touch. For those who like it spicier, add a little chili vinegar for an even more amazing flavor.

Another must-try is the "Steamed Rice Rolls." The dough is chewy and soft, the filling is generous – a truly enjoyable combination.

Finally, I finished with a "Coconut Coffee," fragrant, creamy, smooth, and refreshing – the perfect ending to the meal. ☕🥥

Overall, it's a Vietnamese restaurant with well-balanced, easy-to-eat flavors, yet with a unique character. If you're in the Pinklao area, I highly recommend stopping by!
sample_reviews_en.author: SURASAK SOONTHONWONG

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited around 10:20 AM and ordered the minced pork salad (larb moo), but was disappointed with both the quality and service. The larb was completely unseasoned and bland, as if a cooking step had been skipped. It felt like the staff might not have paid attention to detail in preparing the food.

Furthermore, the server brought the food without checking it before serving. Checking the food quality before serving would have prevented this kind of problem.

I informed the staff about the taste, and they took the dish to taste it at the counter, laughed a little, and then another staff member said they would make a new one for me.

I hope the restaurant will take this feedback into consideration and improve both its food preparation standards and pre-serving quality checks to provide a better customer experience next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: พิธีกรงานแต่ง By Mc.pumpui

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of the most interesting Vietnamese restaurants around. The food looks great, tastes good, and offers a wide variety of menu options suitable for people of all ages. However, if you are expecting a complex range of flavors, this place might not quite hit the mark; many of the dishes taste fairly similar. On the bright side, the overall prices are quite affordable, which is great for a mall restaurant. My only minor complaint is that their queue management could definitely use some improvement. If you are looking for a vietnamese tasted restarant in the neighborhood, this is the one to try.
sample_reviews_en.author: pornpong chiewcharat

sample_reviews_en.text: Located on the 5th floor near the cinema, the restaurant is beautifully decorated and the staff are incredibly attentive. The authentic Vietnamese food is delicious; every dish was excellent. The vegetables were very well-washed and unlimited refills were available. Overall, the place was spotlessly clean. The bill for this meal (food + drinks) was almost 800 baht, but it was enough for three people. We were very impressed and will definitely come back again. (P.S. I wish there was a sink in the restaurant for convenience while eating, as the restroom is quite a distance away.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitichote Pao

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Nem Nuong set is great value for money.
Vegetables and rice paper are refillable.
The staff are very attentive.
Food comes out quickly, no long wait.

Recommended: Vietnamese Pizza. The crust is crispy and delicious, not soggy or cold.
The toppings are flavorful, delicious even without dipping sauce.

The Banh Cuon (Vietnamese steamed rice rolls) are a bit salty.

Prices on the menu include 7% VAT.
No service charge.

One minor complaint: the tiled floor in the restaurant is a bit slippery.
You need to walk carefully; it might be difficult for elderly people.
sample_reviews_en.author: MyBlooD MJ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted good, although service was a little slow today as it was quite busy.

The menu was very diverse; I wanted to order everything, but I wasn't very hungry. I liked that the vegetables and dipping sauces were refillable, and the vegetables were fresh.

The prices were reasonable for the quality of the food. There was no service charge on the bill, and the staff were excellent. Some restaurants don't provide good service even though they add a service charge. Please maintain this standard so I can be a long-term customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Being Journal

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was served very slowly. I ordered two single dishes. I saw the staff carry three bowls of noodle soup past me, but I still hadn't received my fried rice. I waited over 20 minutes for my fried rice. At first, I wouldn't have complained, but tables that came after us had already received almost all of their food.
The noodle soup was a little too salty, but the Hue-style fried rice was delicious.
I've eaten at another branch before and was very impressed, so I wanted to suggest you consider trying this one.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gintini

restaurants.name: Sizzler The Mall Bangkapi
restaurants.address:

3522 Lat Phrao Rd, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Lately, I've noticed that the pork and chicken pieces are getting smaller, the prices have gone up, and the promotions have decreased. Some items on the salad bar don't look fresh and aren't refilled regularly; you have to stand and wait, like for things like the mushroom soup. Conversely, buffet restaurants with well-stocked salad bars always have fresh and plentiful food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siri Sae

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and flavorful, with a wide variety of menu options. After the renovation, the restaurant looks more modern, but the space is quite cramped; you might have to squeeze past people when moving around because it's quite busy. However, the food didn't take long to arrive, and the service was well-managed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nanat Ariyawatthanapak

sample_reviews_en.text:
Best sizzler that I have been to. Nice salad bar. They even had guacamole!
They also have a variety of drinks and additional pasta options that I haven’t seen at other locations.
sample_reviews_en.author: T K

sample_reviews_en.text: I just found out this branch is a Sizzler Special. The food is plentiful, refills are fast, and the staff provides good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaijaew Aroi

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was okay, but it was inconvenient because the shop was undergoing renovations.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karl P.

restaurants.name: Broccoli Revolution Sukhumvit 49
restaurants.address:

899 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We really don't know what all the good reviews for this place are about.
The Good: Great space and ambience.
The Bad:
1. Waiter messed up our order so we had to wait about double the time for the food. They do not write down the order so pretty easy to see how it can get messed up.
2. All the food including the drinks came at different times individually, not following any particular order.
3. The signature quinoa burger was absolutely bland and tasteless, literally just a blob of tasteless patty, the pictures show it coming with chunky chips, this was not the case for our order. The green curry had about four tiny pieces of tofu, see the pic to see how small they are compared to a spoon, 2 tiny florets of cauliflower, 3 tiny florets of broccoli (given the name of this place we found this the most ironic), and about 3 ridged cut pieces of carrot. There were no real other spices, kafir leaves or chunks of galangal etc., present in the curry which explained it's bland flavor. If you are a plant based restaurant and serve your tofu and vegetables so sparingly in bland coconut milk, it shows exactly where your heart is.
sample_reviews_en.author: X A

sample_reviews_en.text:
Broccoli Revolution on Sukhumvit 49 is a great stop when you want something fresh and nourishing. I went for the Super Seedy Açaí Bowl—refreshing, well balanced, and packed with texture from all the seeds. Light but satisfying, and perfect as a healthy pick-me-up.

The space is clean, bright, and comfortable, making it an easy place to sit and recharge for a bit, enjpy your Kindle or do some work. A solid option if you’re around the area and craving something fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: Farangondiet

sample_reviews_en.text:
Broccoli Revolution (located on corner of Sukhumvit 49). Walkable form Both BTS Phromgphong and Thonglor.

Spacious restaurant/cafe with 2 storeys (used to be an art gallery on 2nd floor, but now defunct). Many plant based menu and delicious gluten free drinks to be select from. Nicely decor, good attentive server.

Great space to hang out with your friends and family here. Very conscious Eco-Friendly + greenery indeed. Highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donny Boonyamanop

sample_reviews_en.text:
Full-time traveler review.

We found this place totally by accident! Since we frequent plant-based restaurants, we can confirm the menu is more than adequate.

We split the veggie burger & veggie quesadillas. Both dishes were amazing. The ingredients were fresh and portioned well.

Definitely enjoyed the whole experience and this will be put on our travel map for future visits.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sean Dubra

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a wonderful experience at this plant-based restaurant. The food was beautifully presented and full of flavor — every dish tasted fresh and thoughtfully prepared. The service was equally impressive; our waiter was warm, attentive, and truly made us feel welcome. A perfect place for anyone looking to enjoy delicious plant-based cuisine. Definitely coming back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Alka Mittal

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely amazing! Also for not vegans/veggies 😍 I’ve just ordered konjac noodles (Shirataki noodles) and they’re amazing! My husband had the cauliflower noodles and we just love both dishes!
But please serve with salt and pepper, then it’s even better 🙏🏼 best dish I’ve eaten in Bangkok so far ❤️❤️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Cassy Kiss

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had our second meal here.  The vegan
menu for both food items and drinks is very creative with truly healthy options.  Seem a good amount of research was put into designing delicious healthy options.  Service is good.  Price is also very adequate. One of our favorite Plant base restaurant in BKk.
sample_reviews_en.author: perusset pierre

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tofu scramble was delicious. Pro: Good portion size and attractive presentation exactly like menu photo. Friendly, prompt service.
Con: the carrot bacon was... Meh (very chewy and not delicious flavor)... but I still give 5 stars and will return to try some other offerings.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Ross

restaurants.name: SSamthing Together สาขา Central RAMA2
restaurants.address:

ชั้น 1 โซน Tree chamber 160 Rama II Rd, Samae Dam, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place uses quality ingredients. Pork jowl was the highlight of the night. The right amount of sesame oil and salt made the taste amazing without losing the natural flavor.

I also ordered the iberico pork to test it out. Given the premium quality of the Iberico pork, when jt is being grilled and not done to perfection, it would not make much difference whether the meat is iberico or not. Sure, iberico is softer when they were just off the grill. If you cannot finish all the pieces while they are hot, they will turn hard on you.

I like the service here. The person who grilled meat for me seems to know what she was doing (except overcooking the iberico pork by a bit).

The kimchi soup was a little too sweet for me, but the pork meats were well done and cooked well. The fat was literally melting in my mouth.

The only comment for improvement is the cleanliness of the restaurant. At my seat, the placemat was oily and not properly cleaned. On the floor, there were still tissue balls from the previous table.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamolkarn Srimongkol

sample_reviews_en.text:
💢Update💢

I recently dined there on a Friday evening. The restaurant was moderately busy. We sat at a large table inside and tried to call the staff several times, but no one paid attention (it might have been a blind spot or there weren't enough staff). Finally, I had to walk to the counter twice to get their attention, plus I had to keep asking for condiments and vegetables until I gave up. What was most unacceptable was that the male staff member saw us calling him but avoided eye contact and went to serve the tables outside instead.🙄

I felt the 10% service charge was too expensive for this kind of service.

I've usually had a great experience here, but this time was truly disappointing. The whole table was upset.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nirun S

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time eating here, but I encountered one staff member who had a very stoic expression. I could hear what they said or asked, but they just responded in a neutral tone, which left a negative impression. However, the other staff members were okay.

I waited a while for my food, but the table next to me, who arrived and ordered later, received their food at the same time. The staff even grilled the food for them first, which confused me. I asked if they were going to grill it for me (it was my first time).

Normally, at other Korean restaurants like this, the food is served and the staff grills it almost immediately. It seemed like there weren't many staff members here either.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prayat Sabuy

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's back to being as delicious as ever! I went when it first opened and it was amazing. But when it got super crowded, the wait was long and the grillers were dry and not tasty, so I went to other restaurants for a while. But this time my daughter wanted to eat here, so we came back.

They have the same promotion as when they first opened, so we ordered a set meal and had the staff grill it for us. It was just as good as when they first opened. Both the beef and pork were perfectly cooked, the side dishes were plentiful, and the tteokbokki was fantastic. My daughter almost finished it all by herself. We'll definitely go back again. This time, 5 stars!
sample_reviews_en.author: Muay Arandyarak

sample_reviews_en.text:
Korean BBQ is an a la carte Korean BBQ restaurant with premium ingredients and great taste. They have many menu options, including pork, beef, ribeye, and mixed seafood sets. I've walked past it many times but never had the chance to try it.
This time I came on a Monday at lunchtime. It wasn't crowded, and the staff provided excellent service. They even grilled the meat for us, making it a very relaxing and comfortable place to eat. 🥰 The kimchi, salad, and side dishes were plentiful and plentiful. I loved it! 10 stars!
The restaurant has several branches. Today I visited the Rama 2 branch on the G floor. I will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattcha Channel

sample_reviews_en.text: My regular Korean barbecue restaurant. The good thing is that someone will come and grill for you in front of the stove. I ordered the signature set, which was just right for 3-4 people, and I ordered a few extras, like the steamed egg with cheese (very delicious), and the truffle risotto rice. The side dishes served were also good, and you can ask for more. The vegetables were fresh and the kimchi was delicious, which went perfectly with the beef and pork. The dipping sauce was also delicious, with many choices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lastshot Z

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came around 11 AM when the restaurant wasn’t full, but there seemed to be quite few staff members, so it took a while before we could place our order.

The cashier was very helpful though and did a great job recommending promotions for customers, which helped us save quite a lot.

The cheese steamed egg was just as delicious as always. I really wish they would add a leaner pork option with less fat — if they had that, I’d probably be able to eat even more!
sample_reviews_en.author: 刘美卿

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a nice atmosphere.
The service is good. You can choose to grill the food yourself or have the staff grill it for you, which is convenient.
The taste is okay. There are many side dishes and vegetables available, which can be refilled as much as you like.
Overall, the food, taste, and service are all good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wu Nupe

restaurants.name: 泰辣 Thaispicy Hotpot ฉงชิ่งหม้อไฟ
restaurants.address:

12/3-8 Surasak Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and has a Chongqing feel, but cleaner than when I ate hot pot in China, and there's no cigarette smell. The price is good, there's parking behind the restaurant, and the staff are polite and attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayanin Lumyong

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, there was a wide variety of dipping sauces, the prices were affordable, and the wait time wasn't long. I really liked it. The only downside is that there's not much parking space.
sample_reviews_en.author: Varalee S.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my second time eating here. The food is delicious and the atmosphere is just like being in China. I love it so much! I'll definitely be back for a third time. ♥️♥️♥️
sample_reviews_en.author: sirirat ngamsuwat

sample_reviews_en.text: Yes, it's very delicious. If you want authentic mala Chinese food like you're in China, you should eat here. Highly recommended, it's delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: chinnaluk Enala

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the prices were reasonable, the food was served very quickly, and the atmosphere in the restaurant was great.
sample_reviews_en.author: อุไลภรณ์ ถ้ำทอง

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and appetizing, and the prices are very reasonable. This is my second time eating here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanjana Sritontip

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, authentic Chinese mala, the price is good, and the staff provides good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anucha Jaimao

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent, and there was parking available. The mala skewers were great! Fantastic!
sample_reviews_en.author: woraelle L

restaurants.name: Chua Kim Lee - Din Daeng Goose
restaurants.address:

1783/17-18 ปาก Lat Phrao Rd, Samsen Nok, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time trying Chua Kim Lee's braised goose restaurant in Tha Din Daeng, and I was pleasantly surprised. The braised goose had tender meat and perfectly cooked skin. The highlight was the dipping sauce, which complemented the goose exceptionally well, making it even more delicious. I enjoyed it so much I finished the whole plate.

My favorite dish was the foie gras stir-fried with black pepper. The sauce was fragrant and rich, the liver was tender and bouncy, and there was no gamey taste at all. It was excellent with rice.

The bitter melon soup was also well-prepared; the broth was sweet and savory, and the bitter melon wasn't as bitter as I expected. It was very easy to drink.

The crab cakes were delicious too. They were generous with the crab meat, crispy on the outside and still juicy on the inside. You could tell they used high-quality ingredients.

Overall, every dish was flavorful. If I'm in the area again, I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nathorn S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really like the roast duck and roast pork. The duck has crispy skin, and the roast pork is tender and not too fatty (you can choose the texture). Personally, I felt indifferent about the texture. The noodles are soft. Overall, it's delicious. There's a wide variety of herbal drinks to choose from.
The price is mid-range.
It's a good place to eat with family. If you're looking for roast duck, roast pork, and crispy pork, this is another restaurant I recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: G G

sample_reviews_en.text: The braised goose was good. The clear soup had a flavorful broth and the pork bones were tender and easily separated from the meat. The crab spring rolls were just okay. The clay pot roasted goose leg with noodles was chewy; the goose leg wasn't tender and the bone was difficult to separate from the meat. Parking is available in the PK Mansion parking lot, accessible via the entrance on Soi 35/2. Parking is free for 2 hours.
sample_reviews_en.author: N N (Pom)

sample_reviews_en.text: As a Chinese person who loves all kinds of goose and duck meat, I found the food at this restaurant utterly unappealing. There was absolutely nothing that appealed to me. A small portion of goose meat, a small portion of roast duck, a platter of goose feet, blood, and offal, and a pickled vegetable dish cost me 705 yuan. The problem is, none of it was tasty, and the portions were small. I won't be coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hung Chang

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has been delicious for a long time. We've been regulars here since our kids were little, and now they're almost 40. The taste is consistently great. Every time we come, we order a lot. This is just the two of us, grandma and grandpa, and look at all the food we ordered: roasted goose, braised duck, and stir-fried cabbage with fish sauce. Every dish is superb!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitisak Skulkroo

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don't know if I'm imagining it, but it doesn't taste as good as before. I'm not sure if the restaurant changed the recipe or what, but it's not as great as it was before COVID.
I ate there in late April, at 6:30 PM. The owners were filming content at the time.
sample_reviews_en.author: yoshida04

sample_reviews_en.text:
Come try our new menu, "Four Flavors," where you get to try all our signature dishes!
Choose 6 out of 4: Braised Goose, Char Siu Pork & Crispy Pork, Roasted Duck, Pork Leg, or Boiled Chicken.

Absolutely amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chonlaros Rattanataros

sample_reviews_en.text:
The appetizer doesn't look fanciful but tastes good!! 👍🏻
The Crispy Roast Duck and Braised Goose is really good!! It is not oily and not gammy!! 😍
Would like to come back to try the soup in my next visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dessert_Grl

restaurants.name: Man Ho
restaurants.address:

JW Marriott Hotel 4 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Man Ho Chinese Restaurant at JW Marriott Bangkok is a great spot if you're craving authentic Cantonese food in Bangkok. As the hotel’s signature Chinese restaurant, it has a solid reputation for serving traditional dishes in a really nice setting.

The food was delicious. The Peking Duck was definitely a standout—crispy skin, tender meat, and beautifully done. Everything we tried was fresh, full of flavor, and nicely presented.

The restaurant also has comfortable private dining rooms, which makes it a good choice for family meals, business lunches, or special occasions. The Chinese décor feels elegant and welcoming without being too formal.

What stood out most was the service. The staff were attentive, professional, and genuinely friendly, which made the whole experience even better.

If you're looking for authentic Cantonese cuisine in Bangkok, Man Ho at JW Marriott Bangkok is a great choice. Good food, a lovely atmosphere, and excellent service make it a place I’d happily recommend and visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Henry Harrison

sample_reviews_en.text: Man Ho at the JW Marriott Bangkok delivers an exceptional Cantonese dining experience where traditional flavors meet refined presentation. The Dim Sum selection is a standout, particularly the vibrant crispy rice flour rolls and perfectly crafted classics, while the main courses showcase incredible technique through dishes like the silky steamed snow fish in soy sauce, succulent BBQ pork and roasted duck, and the nourishing clear fresh fish maw soup. From the earthy homemade tofu with mushrooms to the perfectly seasoned sauna tiger prawns and noodles, every dish reflects a high standard of quality. This culinary excellence is further elevated by the hospitality, as the service provided by Khun Gung was truly outstanding—her attentive and warm demeanor made the meal feel both seamless and special
sample_reviews_en.author: Natt D.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had lunch at Man Ho Chinese Restaurant at JW Marriott Bangkok and chose their All-You-Can-Eat Dim Sum Buffet.

Reservations are highly recommended—ideally 2–3 days in advance—especially for weekends, as this spot is in high demand. The ambiance is elegant and refined, perfect for a relaxing lunch gathering.

The buffet offers an impressive selection of dim sum and Chinese dishes. While many items are truly unlimited, some premium selections are limited to one choice per person, which is clearly noted on the menu.

The quality of the food was excellent overall—from the classic siu mai and har gow to the delicious steamed prawn rolls and crispy taro dumplings. Everything was freshly prepared and served piping hot.

It was a satisfying experience with great variety and attentive service.
sample_reviews_en.author: ARTYOS

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a truly wonderful lunch experience at this restaurant. The manager is exceptionally professional and highly service-minded, ensuring that every guest feels welcome and well looked after. Her team reflects her leadership, with staff members—especially Khun Gung—demonstrating outstanding customer orientation and a warm, attentive approach. The staff are clearly well-trained, making the service smooth, efficient, and genuinely hospitable. On top of the impeccable service, the food was exceptional—flavourful, beautifully presented, and prepared with great attention to detail. This is a place where both the quality of the cuisine and the excellence of service shine equally bright. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mink Eats

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very good Cantonese restaurant in Bangkok—probably the best for me in the city. The highlight was the duck. Even though we didn’t order the full Peking duck because it was too large, we had the roasted duck with thin pancakes and it was excellent. Compared with the three-star Michelin restaurant in Taipei, Le Palais, this suited my taste better.

Other dishes were above average. The only flaw was the crab xiao long bao. The skin tip was thick and chewy, and on top sat an over-steamed uni that didn’t make much sense—perhaps put inside the dumpling is better? The filling felt overcooked, and the broth had too much ginger to taste the umami.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chia SD

sample_reviews_en.text:
My family and friends had dinner here and it was a fantastic experience.

The service we received was brilliant and worthy of a restaurant hosted inside Marriott. The decor and uniforms was very ‘Chinese’.

We ordered many different dishes and they all came out looking sumptuous and tasted just as delicious as they looked.

Everything was priced fairly for a restaurant of this calibre, although comparatively, was rather expensive for restaurants in Bangkok. It was around an average of 1200 baht per person but we ate a lot.

I think it was worth it and would definitely return the next time I’m back in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Don L

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kik koong beer was exceptionally courteous, attentive, and made us feel genuinely valued throughout our visit.

The food was outstanding—every dish was beautifully presented and rich in flavor. You can really tell that great care goes into both the quality of ingredients and the preparation. Whether it was the appetizers, main course, or desserts, everything exceeded expectations.
What stood out the most was the warm hospitality. The team went above specially kik koong beer served us so warmly  to ensure we had a pleasant dining experience, making it feel more personal than just a regular restaurant
sample_reviews_en.author: Aamina Virani

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited Man Ho at the JW Marriott for my birthday, and it was an incredible experience from start to finish. The dim sum is truly amazing—the shrimp, in particular, was so fresh and high-quality. However, the absolute star of the show was the sweet and sour fried pork; it was easily the best I’ve ever had.
To top it off, the staff made my birthday feel so special. They brought out a cake with a stunning dry ice presentation that looked magical. A huge thank you to the team for making our family meal such a memorable one. Highly recommended for any special occasion!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasin Manasathit

restaurants.name: Public House Bangkok, a Member of Design Hotels
restaurants.address:

249 Sukhumvit 31, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I absolutely loved this hotel. It’s a small, boutique hotel that is beautiful and so stylish. Clearly a lot of thought has gone into the design and fit out. It’s in a nice location with some fantastic restaurants within walking distance. Ask the reception staff for their recommendations, you won’t be disappointed. Our room was lovely, super clean with a massive, comfy bed. Breakfast options were via a menu, so no boring buffet. I ordered something different each morning and it was all very good. In the evening we would have cocktails in the bar area, again, beautifully designed and styled. I loved all the treats that was delivered to our room each evening, and upon checkout you get a farewell cookie. Staff were professional and very helpful. My favourite spot was the rooftop pool, it is a beautiful space and a wonderful haven from the madness that is Bangkok. Public House is a wonderful place to stay, highly recommended. Try nearby Sri Trat Restaurant & Bar. Food is delicious. Also good is The Local.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jo Wallace

sample_reviews_en.text:
Where do I begin?

From the moment we stepped into the hotel, everything felt just right. The room was perfectly sized, impeccably clean, and incredibly comfortable. Perhaps it’s the holiday mood, but these were easily the best five nights of sleep we’ve had in a long time.

Breakfast quickly became something we looked forward to each morning. The spread is generous, and every dish surprised us in the best way. Consistently delicious and never once disappointing.

What truly made this stay special, though, was the people. The staff are genuinely warm, attentive, and always ready to help. A special thank you to Zaza and Chicha, who were so kind and patient in assisting us throughout our stay. It made everything feel that much more seamless and personal.

The location is another highlight. Perfectly situated near great shopping malls, food spots, and bars, making it easy to explore and enjoy the area.

A beautiful stay, from start to finish. We’ll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Janet Poh

sample_reviews_en.text:
The hotel has a pleasant lobby, a convenient location, and I enjoyed the mocktail program, which was thoughtfully done. At checkout, the staff also offered snacks and a cookie, which was a nice and appreciated gesture.

However, during my stay I noticed a strong, persistent musty odor in the room that did not improve with ventilation. There were no visible signs, but the smell caused physical discomfort for me, including throat irritation and skin sensitivity.

I completed my stay, but the odor significantly impacted my comfort. I did not report the issue to staff during the stay, as I was focused on managing how I was feeling at the time.

This review reflects my personal experience. Other guests may not be affected, but those who are sensitive to odors or air quality may want to take this into consideration.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marci Scott

sample_reviews_en.text:
I didn’t attend Public House as a guest, but rather as a visitor to check out their coworking space. Very beautiful design and plenty of nooks to set up shop and work!

Cafe is a bit pricey, and got pricier since the last time I came. Kinda strange - yes it’s a nice hotel lobby and all, but also, we’re in Thailand.

Anyways, still great service from the ladies operating here, and private meeting rooms are usually readily available. I throughly enjoyed my cocoa nibs protein shake (extra pb) the first time. The second time, I asked for extra pb just like the first, and was told that it would incur an additional charge. As if the 250 thb + 7% + 10% service charge for the shake isn’t enough 😂

Will come back, but extremely sparingly due to the high cost and mid-service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anish Thakkar (Doc Thakkar)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a difficult review to write because there’s so much to like about this hotel. The design of the rooms and communal areas is truly beautiful, and the staff are among the most welcoming you’ll find anywhere in Asia.

However, there are two major drawbacks. The pool and gym are extremely small, the pool feels more like a large bath than a place to swim, and the gym is similarly cramped. For a property of this standard, both are disappointing.

The other major issue is the lack of communal space at weekends. On both Saturday and Sunday, large portions of the open-plan lobby were reserved for private functions, around 70% on Saturday and almost 95% on Sunday. It’s frustrating to struggle to find somewhere to sit in your own hotel.
sample_reviews_en.author: James Irving

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a excellent and very enjoyable family stay at Public House while we vacationed in Bangkok. The team really went above and beyond to accommodate us, as we changed dates and rooms. From the front desk to the night porter they were always ready to help. The food was also very tasty and love their offer of free drinks for guests at a certain time of day. I also used the coworking space which they allowed to have a meeting past late hours even though it was closing time.

Great overall stay, I would highly recommend it!

Special thank you to: Mam, Chanya, Mint, Hearth and Kik.

Only drawback would be the very heavy chairs at restaurant area but the team always ran to help and pick them up. Thanks Public House team 🙌🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasri Dedigama

sample_reviews_en.text: Truly an excelent hotel, the staff is impeccably qualified, they are extremely kind and hospitable, at the reception they greet you with some chips and some drinks while you check in. The rooms are exquisite, the bed is super comfortable, there is no noise from outside and the decoration is beautiful and clean. They also have an excellent restaurant in the lobby, we only had breakfast, but I’m sure that everything else is just as great. The location is also amazing, not too far from the metro station, and from many amazing and delicious restaurants, coffee shops and other stores if you choose to walk around the area. Truly deserves all of the stars in the world. Don’t miss out on this opportunity.
sample_reviews_en.author: Elisa Gallo De la Paz

sample_reviews_en.text: Public House in Bangkok is pretty awesome on soi 31. It’s in a location that you can walk right to the Sukhumvit. The staff are all super friendly and the lobby has a great atmosphere with a live music. The food that I ordered to my room was fantastic, I strongly recommend the chocolate brownie along with the Pad Ka Prow. However, the breakfast could be quite a bit better. It is only fair to mention that I arrived to breakfast about 15 minutes before they were closing, but still it was a little bit dissatisfying. Overall, I strongly recommend to anyone who’s staying in this area, the pool isn’t perfect size with a nice little weight room and great roof access.
sample_reviews_en.author: Darwin Davis

restaurants.name: MASA - Otaru Masazushi
restaurants.address:

ICONSIAM ฝั่ง SIAM TAKASHIMAYA ชั้น4 โซน Rosedining 299 Charoen Nakhon 5 Alley, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: 🇯🇵 MASA – OTARU MASAZUSHI is a Hokkaido-style omakase restaurant from Otaru City, Hokkaido, with a history spanning over 87 years. The restaurant meticulously selects the freshest, highest-quality ingredients from the Hokkaido sea, delivering them directly to its Bangkok branch four times a week. This ensures everyone can experience the exquisite taste of premium ingredients, just like dining in Hokkaido. Each dish is presented with meticulous care by expert chefs. The restaurant's unique feature is its "EZO MAE" (Hokkaido-style) omakase, where the chef uses only the freshest, most seasonal premium ingredients, preserved without any artificial flavoring or processing. 💯❣️ Every bite is sure to impress! ✨🤩💫
sample_reviews_en.author: cameragirl bkk

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Best premium omakase experience in Bangkok…
At Masa - Otaru Masazushi, every detail is thoughtfully crafted — from the freshest seafood imported directly from Japan to the precision of each dish served right in front of you.
What made this experience stand out even more?
The wine pairing 🍷 — something not commonly seen in omakase, yet executed so beautifully here. Each glass elevated the flavors in a way I didn’t expect.
From creamy uni dishes to delicate sashimi, everything tasted incredibly fresh, refined, and perfectly balanced.
And the chefs? Warm, attentive, and truly passionate about what they do 🤍
This isn’t just dinner — it’s an experience worth booking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamales T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was absolutely delicious, and the quality of the ingredients was excellent. The sushi was amazing, and the sashimi was incredibly fresh with a naturally sweet flavor. Everything tasted so good that it was impossible to say which dish was better—each one was outstanding. This was my first omakase experience, and it was truly memorable.

Reservations are highly recommended to make sure you get a seat, as the restaurant fills up quickly. There are only about 10 seats available. The atmosphere is lovely, and the restaurant is located on the 4th floor in the Takashimaya mall area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gavin Montfleur

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was taken there by a client.
This time, the head chef was there, so I sat at the counter and enjoyed watching him prepare the food.

I enjoyed not only the fresh ingredients but also the aged items. The course, starting with pureed soup, followed by appetizers and then nigiri sushi, was superb, and I had a wonderful time pairing it with sake.

The herring nigiri had a distinct Otaru feel, and the tuna was simply amazing.

The eel roll, the finishing touch, was packed with Nara pickles, and the crispy skin was delicious.

It was a truly wonderful time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akira's log

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a more traditional sushi omakase serving fresh flown seafood from Hokkaido. The Masa omakase was amazingly prepared and delicious. The  service was also impeccable. We paired it with recommended sake that matched really well with the dishes.

I took out one star because I feel for this price in Bangkok, I am expecting a more luxurious experience both in the sushi ingredients, presentation, and also the decor / atmosphere.

Still I would come back here again if I am craving for really top notch sushi quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wukong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food quality not proportionate to price.  We were treating a friend for dinner as she travelled from Sendai to Tokyo to meet us.

With much anticipation, we ordered a dinner set (Yen 24000 per person).  Not only the toro sashimi is frozen, the waitress came and told us one of the food items is not available.  We chose that particular set due to the fact that it will serve grilled crab leg.  Now now the restaurant told us it was not available.  Overall the dinner was very disappointing and won’t go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wai Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited today for lunch and had such a lovely experience. The staff were incredibly kind and attentive, and the chef(owner) was so warm and welcoming. You can really feel the care and passion behind every dish.

The ingredients tasted amazingly fresh, and every bite felt thoughtfully prepared and the homemade cheesecake was absolutely delicious soft, rich and has comforting scent of honey.

Truly appreciated , felt like I was enjoying a special lunch made with heart. Highly recommend!! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: thanyalak pongchelermporn

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the omakase restaurants I'll definitely revisit 🍣✨ Originating from Tokyo, this omakase restaurant brings the essence of authentic sushi to Bangkok. With every nigiri, I could taste the dedication to quality and craftsmanship that has earned Otaru Masazushi its reputation in Japan. From the finest seasonal ingredients to the simple and authentic presentation, if you're a sushi lover or simply looking for an unforgettable meal, 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: girleatsbkk Tiktok Instagram

restaurants.name: Bejo Korean BBQ ราชพฤกษ์
restaurants.address:

Bejo, 475 Phran Nok Phutthamonthon Sai 4 Rd, Bang Phrom, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
👍 Highlights

1. Flavors that appeal to Thai tastes:

* The marinated pork/beef is a "Korean-Thai fusion," easy to eat and not bland.
* The dipping sauce is slightly spicier (not as bland as authentic Korean sauces).

2. Generous side dishes (banchan):

* Kimchi, vegetables, and snacks are refillable.
* Many people say the kimchi is quite delicious.

3. Korean fried chicken:

* Another popular item.
* Crispy with a flavorful sauce (listed on the recommended menu).

4. Affordable prices:

* Suitable for 2-3 people on a budget.
* Ideal for those who "eat casually and aren't looking for premium quality."

⸻

👀 Points to note:

* Not a premium chain like those in Sukhumvit. (e.g., Wagyu beef)
* Not a fancy restaurant → More of a chill dining experience than a serious date
* Not many online reviews yet (but good ratings)

⸻

🎯 Suitable for:

* People who want to eat Korean BBQ at an affordable price
* People who like to eat with friends / family
* People who want "Korean flavors that suit Thai palates"
sample_reviews_en.author: tam tt

sample_reviews_en.text:
This a la carte Korean BBQ restaurant is open from lunchtime until evening. It's a typical Korean tent-style restaurant, but offers both air-conditioned indoor seating and outdoor seating, so you don't have to worry about the heat. The menu has a good selection of dishes, including BBQ items that the staff will grill at your table, and other Korean dishes like ramen, japchae, and kimchi soup. The kimchi here is delicious – perfectly sour, and the vegetables are very fresh and clean. Another must-try is the Korean-style garlic fried chicken. Everything is delicious. The food and drinks are reasonably priced (prices listed exclude VAT and a 10% service charge). The staff provides excellent service.

🥘 Korean BBQ
🚘 Ample parking available
sample_reviews_en.author: Attawut ミンヂー Wijinthanasarn

sample_reviews_en.text:
📍: Bejo Korean BBQ

A Korean BBQ restaurant in a red tent setting.
They offer pork, beef 🥩, and seafood 🦑, using high-quality ingredients and marinated to perfection – absolutely delicious! Side dishes are free refills 🥗.
There's a wide variety of menu options including BBQ 🔥, soup, kimchi, ramen 🍜, bibimbap, and the must-try fried chicken 🍗.
Crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, with a rich sauce – incredibly addictive!
It's definitely worth the price 💰.
The staff are attentive, constantly refilling side dishes and changing the grill pan ☺️.
The restaurant is located on Phran Nok Road and has plenty of parking 🚗, making it very convenient.
It can get crowded in the evenings, so allow extra time ⏰.

#1stEyeView
sample_reviews_en.author: Tananun Na sai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten at quite a few Korean restaurants.
I often see places with high review scores, likely due to positive reviews.

But this restaurant is different. Both the taste and the service are excellent.
The restaurant is clean, the air conditioning is cool, the plating is beautiful, and the portions are just right.
The prices are good, the food is delicious, and the staff are attentive.

Anyone passing by should stop in. I recommend it. You can grill the chicken yourself or have the restaurant grill it for you.
The fried chicken is crispy and the sauce is delicious. I'll definitely visit again.
There's also plenty of parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tinnapop แอบกิน แอบเที่ยว

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious. The fried chicken was great – crispy on the outside, tender and juicy on the inside, not dry, and a good size. The brown sauce was sweet and tasty. It was even better than Bonchon, comparable to Chungmang.

The grilled pork was a bit chewy and tough in some pieces, but overall the flavor was good. The side vegetables were fresh and crispy, I loved them.

The kimbap was also delicious and up to standard.

One thing we joked about was that the roof was a red tent, and the sun's reflection was so dizzying while we ate there. I have photographic evidence! 5555
sample_reviews_en.author: Jitpisut Sirirat (GoingGift)

sample_reviews_en.text: On days when you crave a light pork belly meal but don't want to go into the city, I recommend this place. They have all the main dishes on the menu, and I think the food will suit Thai tastes. The price and portion size are good. You can grill the pork yourself or have the restaurant grill it for you. Side dishes and vegetables are refillable. The staff are attentive and provide good service. The atmosphere is relaxed, and there's plenty of parking.
