I'll definitely come back again when I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr.Nobody

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten at many Korean restaurants in shopping malls and city centers, but this one is the best. Almost every dish is delicious, and the prices are much cheaper. They have both air-conditioned indoor seating and an outdoor area.

The brown chicken was too salty, but the sweet and spicy one was delicious. The kimchi soup was tasty, the japchae was good, and the spicy grilled pork neck was excellent. The side dishes were also tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panachai Korsawatworakun

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Korean restaurant, Red Tent, offers delicious food. Every dish ordered, from the black bean sauce noodles to the kimchi pork stir-fry, was fantastic.
You can ask for extra side dishes, and the kimchi is incredibly tasty. The grilled pork, served with vegetables and a fantastic dipping sauce, is definitely worth a visit. We'll be back for more!
sample_reviews_en.author: panda tong

restaurants.name: กะทิบ้านอาหารไทยและขนม
restaurants.address:

14 Borommaratchachonnani Rd, ฉิมพลี Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
My sister recommended this restaurant, saying she'd been there before. We arrived, a group of six, and loved the atmosphere. The trees provided shade, and the glass-enclosed room was beautiful. We came on a Monday in April, around 11:35 AM. We went into the glass-enclosed room, but it was hot; the room couldn't cope with the outside heat. I noticed this might be because one of the air conditioners wasn't on (there are three, but only two were running). I asked the staff to turn on both, otherwise, the room would be too big and wouldn't be cool. I also noticed several fans similar to portable air conditioners placed around the room, indicating the room wasn't getting very cool. However, they brought a portable air conditioner to our table, which helped a lot. The food was delicious. I didn't take any pictures because I was too hungry. The service from the staff was adequate.

P.S. Adding two more air conditioners would be much better, especially during the hot season.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirintorn Mungkornkarn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Thai food was delicious and suited my taste, but the price was a bit high. Overall, it was good. The restaurant doesn't have beef on the menu; my friend is Muslim and can't eat pork, so we ordered chicken, fish, and shrimp instead.

We also had a banquet at the restaurant. Personally, I thought the venue was nice and the staff seemed attentive, but some things could be improved. For example, the way food was served over the long tables – they should have placed food where it was available for guests, instead of just leaving it wherever it was placed. This resulted in some guests not having their food. This could be improved.

There's also a large playground, plenty of convenient parking, and clean restrooms.

I would definitely visit again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanvi K

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited this restaurant a couple of times several years ago when it first opened. This time, I went on a weekday evening; it was quiet and peaceful, not crowded at all. I also bought some Thai desserts from the display case to take home, which were delicious. As for the savory dishes, the chili paste was tasty, but the stir-fried fish with acacia leaves wasn't very tender; it was a bit tough. I really wanted to order a larger fish, but there were only two of us, and I was worried it would be too much. Maybe it's just that particular fish dish.

The service was excellent; the staff were attentive from the parking lot to the restaurant area.

The Thai dessert stall outside near the parking lot only accepts bank transfers; no other payment methods are accepted.
sample_reviews_en.author: KM KM

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered four dishes. I loved the yellow curry; the first bite was amazing, so fragrant with spices. The stir-fried pork with shrimp paste was also delicious, with a nice, fragrant shrimp paste flavor. However, the coconut omelet wasn't quite to my liking. I'll definitely go back again because there are many more dishes I want to try. Oh, and the herbal drink was very sweet; it should be less sweet.

<> After several months, I went back to eat again, this time bringing others along. It turned out that the dishes I ordered before didn't taste the same. They just felt saltier, except for the salads which were delicious, and the herbal drink was less sweet now. I wish the restaurant could maintain a consistent taste so I could proudly recommend it to others.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alias Tiiz

sample_reviews_en.text:
Looking for a venue with a great atmosphere and delicious Thai food for your event? Look no further! 🌿✨
"Kathibaan Thai Food and Desserts" offers a variety of function rooms to suit every occasion, from company parties and birthday celebrations to intimate family gatherings.

Rooms are available in various sizes and styles:
​🏛️ Function rooms in various styles: Phana / Payak / Tara / Bangkok / Phra Nakhon / Thonburi
​💙 Beautiful room zones: Silver Room / White Room
​🌿 Popular zone: Glass House Building, bright and airy with natural light, perfect for photos!
​Besides the beautiful venue, the Thai food and desserts here are amazing. The flavors are rich and authentic. For your next special occasion, you definitely need to bring your family or team here! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanyatit S

sample_reviews_en.text:
A perfect Thai dining experience amidst nature.

"Kathibaan Thai Food and Desserts" offers a warm and relaxing atmosphere. Surrounded by nature, with a waterfall and koi fish, the ambiance is refreshingly cool.

The Thai dishes here are meticulously prepared, using high-quality ingredients such as plump, fresh, and sweet prawns, perfectly crispy fried fish, and flavorful, well-balanced Thai tastes. The side dishes and fresh vegetables are clean and presented beautifully. Both the food presentation and service are impressive. It's truly ideal for a relaxing getaway or a special occasion.
sample_reviews_en.author: 许鹏 Thithit Atchattabhan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Thai restaurant features beautiful floral arrangements and a wide variety of dishes. For those who don't eat spicy food, customization is available. The flavors aren't too strong, which should appeal to Taiwanese palates.

It's a great place for gatherings with friends or family. There aren't many foreign tourists, but I love the atmosphere. After your meal, you can stroll through the garden – a truly stunning restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: YH Chang

sample_reviews_en.text: I never get tired of visiting this place, no matter how many times I come. The atmosphere is great, the prices are good, and the food is delicious. There's a wide variety of Thai and Northeastern Thai food to choose from. The restaurant is divided into zones: a beautifully decorated air-conditioned area and a grassy area where you can stroll around and admire the beautiful koi fish – perfect for taking photos!
sample_reviews_en.author: PEMIKA WONGSANUPA

restaurants.name: B-STORY
restaurants.address:

89/70 Phaya Thai Rd, Thanon Phetchaburi, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This cafe, located right by Ratchathewi Station, boasts beautiful wall art!
It was next to my hotel, so I just stopped by to take some photos.

Apparently, the exterior art changes with the seasons.

Halloween (pumpkins and skeletons), Christmas (a snowy landscape and Santa), Valentine's Day (a wall of pink roses), etc. The entire exterior of the shop is completely transformed each season, becoming a work of art.

Each time, local Thais and tourists line up to take pictures.

It has a solid, Gothic church-like atmosphere, surrounded by plants and antique furniture.

It gets very lively at night.

There's also a lot of Japanese signage, giving it a bit of a Japanese feel.
sample_reviews_en.author: komasan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Terrible experience. The staff attitude here was unacceptable and honestly ruined the whole visit. We were treated in a way that felt cold, judgmental, and completely unwelcoming — including staff giving us side-eye while we were there.

After reading other reviews, it seems like poor customer service is not just a one-time issue. Calling it “horrible” almost feels too soft. A place can look nice in photos, but if the staff make customers feel uncomfortable, that matters more.

Unless you only care about taking cute pictures and don’t mind being treated badly, I would seriously avoid this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supakiat Manusirivithaya

sample_reviews_en.text: It's been a very long time since I've been to this cafe, probably over 5 years. But it still feels as beautiful and impressive as before. This time, I came in the evening, and the decorative lights were even more stunning. There weren't many people, so it was perfect for taking photos. The staff were very friendly and lovely, inviting me in and explaining that there are two floors so I could take as many pictures as I wanted. The carrot cake and brownie were delicious too. If you're having dinner in this area and don't know where to go for dessert, this cafe is a great option.
sample_reviews_en.author: Praewpan Jansam

sample_reviews_en.text: Coffee was nice; I got a dairy-free hot latte, then a dairy-free iced mocha. Unfortunately, they cannot do the cute 3D bears with dairy-free milk. But they were able to do the coffee art on the hot latte with the bear face. It’s a pleasant environment with lots of flowers and lights and bears and cute things, without being too kitschy. Airy, light environment. The servers were also very accommodating, quick, and good at their jobs. I only spoke English, and they were very helpful and able to help me with everything in English.
sample_reviews_en.author: GC

sample_reviews_en.text: It is nice decoration and design cafe but like the others say, the price in the menu is bit expensive and it is not include VAT, so when you pay the bill it's feels like overpriced. As well they do not allow laptop using and no provide wifi for the laptop, this is so disappointimg and they should inform the customer during the order, instead they stick the small notice with tiny words with the don'ts. Read the notice from the picture before you want to stay here.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Y

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a pretty decoration, most of the plants are artificial.
I was in a place where the chair isn't padded (I prefer padded chairs because I'm very thin and it hurts). The waitress directed me to the table so I didn't have the chance to choose where I wanted to sit. Apart from that, the service was good, the food was ok, a little too oily, and the coffee was good. I need to go back another time to evaluate it again. Great place for photos.
sample_reviews_en.author: Evellyn Vasconcelos

sample_reviews_en.text:
The cafe is very cute and photogenic. It feels like you were in Alice in Wonderland once you stepped inside.

The staff were friendly and the vibe were chill with soft music background. The foods were great, we were satisfied with our food (fish and chips, passion fruit soda and Caesar salad) but considering the location, the prices are slightly higher.

Overall, it is a lovely cafe and worth to visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nurin Farah Athirah Binti Redzuan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really loved the design and decor of this restaurant — the atmosphere was beautiful and had a great vibe.

The service was a little weak though. It took quite a while for someone to take our order, but it might have been because the Café was crowded.

I ordered the Pad Thai, and it was AMAZING!!! Honestly, maybe the best Pad Thai I’ve had in Thailand.
The fried rice was good too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anahid Danesh

restaurants.name: Pantaree
restaurants.address:

9 Soi Sukhumvit 8, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located in the first left handed side when coming from Sukhumvit road. You wouldn’t expect a restaurant there. It is a small Thai food restaurant with good food. We ordered the century egg salad, morning glory, spicy papaya salad and the deep fried fish. The low performer were the salad and the morning glory, lack of spiciness and flavor. The century egg salad was good and the star was the fried fish. Not overdone and they put the fishbone out before frying like Nara. So that was really good. For drinking we had a cucumber lemon smoothie wich was also good. That was my second visit after years. And all for a price for 700 Baht!
sample_reviews_en.author: Armin Mandel

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my favorite restaurant just off Sukhumvit Soi 11. It is tucked away at the back of an alley. Just look for Buddy's bar & grill. It's in the alley behind this bar!
Open air seating, so no air con! I have been ordering their stir- fried basil with pork (Pad Kra Pao) & an order of their fried chicken wings 😋👍🏼 If you order a beer 🍺 here, just know that it is a tall 20oz bottle. It comes with a glass filled with ice, too. I don't use the ice.
The food is very tasty, and the portions are about 1 cup in size. The pricing is actually cheaper than the street food just outside! So you can try multiple dishes during the same visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Barge

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious Thai food with nice service! We wanted to eat where the locals eat. Their menu is full of pictures and English. They have refreshing fresh fruit slushies! We ordered watermelon and mango. Food was delicious and hit the spot! Prices were great. We ordered fried snapper, pad thai, papaya salad, morning glory, shrimp with garlic, and pineapple fried rice. Everything tasted so good! The fish was perfectly crispy and even better with the papaya salad sauce. Nothing was too spicy when I asked for less spicy. They will pack leftovers for you if you ask for take-away. I will have to come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Katheline Tran

sample_reviews_en.text: Great local place that has enough English on the menus and by the staff to make it easy for Western tourists. Tons of pictures on the menu and wall to make ordering easy for anyone. Great food! Tried the pad Thai, papaya salad (heads up: it's spicy), stuffed omelet pork, and stirred fried chicken with cashews. Everything we tried works for the picky palate. For example: good quality chicken and shelled shrimp (on the pad Thai). Add to all of that: down right cheap prices - especially compared to Western options in the neighborhood.
sample_reviews_en.author: JT Genter

sample_reviews_en.text:
Super tasty Thai food at reasonably prices!! We ordered Fried Snapper with Chili Sauce and were blown away by the crispy texture and the sour and spicy taste! Such a nice and appetising dish for hot weather!

The coconut chicken soup is the best one I’ve ever tasted. It’s made of fresh coconut juice, instead of coconut milk - it’s light and has natural sweetness!

This place is a hidden gem in Sukhumvit area where you can taste authentic home cooking Thai food at good value!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lotus

sample_reviews_en.text:
A fine Spot. It hast become our "Go to food place" for starting the day. The Smoothies are great as the food. I recommend the omlette maybe with a Plate of Fried Shrimps and the Pad Thai of corse. The service is super friendly and everything is Made fresh. But you can pretty much eat anything here.
Nice is, that its a little hidden and therefore calm here. Perfect to prepare for the busy streets right around the corner.

Go there. U will not regret this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Florian Kreft

sample_reviews_en.text:
Here’s a polished version of your review for Google:

I had an amazing experience at Pantaree! The chicken, which often has a weird smell at some places, was absolutely fresh and delicious here. The curries are absolutely fantastic – full of flavor and spice! Highly recommend this hidden gem in Nana for anyone craving authentic Thai food. The quality, quantity, and taste all come together perfectly. Don’t miss out on this place! ❣️🇹🇭❤️🇮🇳
sample_reviews_en.author: Rajat Srivastav

sample_reviews_en.text:
Revisited yesterday-
Must try pantaree’s Fried Som tam!!

Original post:
I tried green curry with chicken and pu pad pong curry (crab meat). It was delicious!
oh and must try their orange juice. It’s super fresh and tasty. Went there around 7:30pm, som tam (papaya salad) was all sold out for the day. Even though the sign says they open 10a - 9p, i saw groups of people sent away around 8p since most of the foods were already sold out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jenna Seo

restaurants.name: isung (아이성)
restaurants.address:

203 Sukhumvit 21 Rd, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Awesome place. I recently went to Seoul. Nowadays you think you can eat everything everywhere. And when you live in Bangkok you especially think that you get great Korean food. And you do. But then there is always this one dish that doesn’t make it across the border. That one dish that you can only eat there.

So in Seoul I had my first Jjampong and I loved it. Chinese-Korean spicy soup with seafood and pork (also available in variations). And then I found Isung when I came back. Probably the only Jjampong dedicated place in Bangkok.

The only thing I would have wished for is that the staff had told us before that one portion is enough for four people. So we definitely over ordered. But I will be back soon and bring more people to try more dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text:
The jangban jjajang was only slightly better than a typical frozen jajangmyeon, with just a bit more seafood. It had no glossy richness and came out watery, almost like a diluted sauce version.

The seafood jjamppong was good. It had a nice smoky wok flavor and a properly spicy, hearty taste.

The sweet and sour pork was far too greasy because they used too much fatty meat. The sauce was bland as well, neither tangy not sweet enough. After three pieces, I honestly couldn’t eat any more.

I was secretly hoping the fried dumplings would be handmade, but they were just frozen products.

The noodles overall were really disappointing too. I am not sure if they use frozen noodles, but they had no real texture and were badly overcooked.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hohohoho

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited Aisung in Pattaya and I was so satisfied that I visited Aisung in Bangkok this time.
As expected, the food was really good.
7- and 8-year-old kids visited together and ordered 2 gan-jjajang, sweet and sour pork medium size, 2 plates of fried dumplings, and yangjangpi.
It was so good to order how good the yangjangpi was.
Every food I ordered was so delicious.
The staff were also so kind and especially a young Korean female employee (I don't know if she is the boss) was so kind.
And my daughter said she is so pretty. Everything was the perfect meal.
Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: 지영

sample_reviews_en.text:
Surprisingly addictive Korean comfort food near Srinakharinwirot University
What started as a convenient dinner option close to home has now become a regular craving. The Jajangmyeon, Jjamppong, and Tangsuyuk set is my usual go-to — delicious, satisfying, and generously portioned (you definitely won’t leave hungry).

The restaurant is clean, service is fast and efficient, and yes — they actually have parking, which feels like a luxury in Bangkok. Great value, great taste, and great excuse to skip cooking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Louie

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the authentic Korean style Chinese restaurant near Pechaburi mrt station! Someone who can enjoy the spicy noodles with full of seafood would definitely love this place. Jjambong and Jjajang noodles are their signature with variations. I like Tangsuyuk too! super crispy and delicious. as Korean i'm very proud of this kind of restaurant being near my area!!
sample_reviews_en.author: binibini99

sample_reviews_en.text: We are visiting Bangkok for the first time and craved some jjajang-myun and jjompong noodles and of course tang-seu-yuk sweet and sour pork. All the dishes were excellent and simply better than the same dishes in the greater Seattle area. The next time we visit Bangkok, we are seriously considering getting a room in this neighborhood for easy access to Isung :)
sample_reviews_en.author: socrates63 (socrates63)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is beautiful and nice. The food are fresh and in big portion. We ordered set A and our favorite is Samsoen JJampong (the red seafood soup) its soup is rich, mildly spicy, and with great Smokey aroma. 🥰 Also the texture of the noodles is chewy in a good way. 🍜
Our least favorites are gyuza and Tangsuyuk the sauce is way to sweet for our taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Than T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place was recommended to us by a Korean local who has been living in Bangkok for decades, claiming it's the best 짜장면 she's had anywhere.

It certainly did not disappoint. Portions are generous and the taste was amazing.

The 탕수육 was just ok but the seafood jjajangmyun and jjampong were 👌👌
sample_reviews_en.author: Huascar Kim

restaurants.name: ซ่อนเจริญนคร : Son Charoennakhon Restaurant
restaurants.address:

545 Charoen Nakhon 5/1 Alley, Khwaeng Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I love the vibe.
Good location, convenient travel, next to iconsiam.

The food is delicious and veryyyy unique, suitable for couples and also sweet family.

For me I recommend ต้มพร้าว, which is signature dishes. You must try it.

Best in the town💖
sample_reviews_th.author: Nattanit Ph

sample_reviews_th.text: Very cozy and delicious Thai restaurant! Highly recommend 'Coconut Prawn Soup' or ต้มพร้าว
sample_reviews_th.author: p prite

sample_reviews_en.text: Don't listen to that blogger's recommendation on a certain social media platform! I was ripped off! First of all, the food was mediocre! The pork ribs were incredibly dry with very little meat. The coconut shrimp soup was good, but they charge a 10% service charge, yet there was absolutely no service. They only provide one napkin, and you have to take off your shoes at the entrance. And to make matters worse, they don't even set out the shoes; it's a mess. We're forced to walk on the dirty floor outside to find our shoes. The restaurant itself is clean, so shouldn't they at least provide a shoe rack or something if they charge a service charge? And what about the service? They charge extra for two bottles of water on the table? If we don't drink them, isn't basic service like greeting guests and offering two glasses of water the bare minimum? If the food were absolutely amazing, I could tolerate all this, but this was just average. It's completely overpriced and has extremely low value for money. I hate that male social media influencer; he ruined my evening with his unethical recommendation... Anyway, trust me, Chinese people, avoid this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: 张若菡

sample_reviews_en.text:
We found this place next to Icon Siam mall through Google reviews and decided to try it because of its high rating.

The restaurant is located in a residential area, inside someone’s home! When we arrived, we were confused, but the house owner kindly assured us that the restaurant is on the second floor. We took off our shoes, walked through the living room, and went upstairs to the dining area.

The ladies at the ‘restaurant’ recommended the prawn coconut soup, which is actually a clear tom yum prawn soup. At first, we didn’t expect much, but once we tried it, we were amazed by the fresh, delicious flavors. The prawns were large and sweet too. They also suggested the fried fish, which turned out to be excellent too.

Overall, it was such an interesting and unforgettable dining experience. Some reviews mentioned that the menu is limited, but I feel it’s more than enough when the food is this good. In fact, a smaller menu likely helps keep everything fresh and of high quality.

Just a note: they prefer cash. They also accept QR code payments, though only with selected banks. We’re from Singapore, and I was pleasantly surprised it worked!
sample_reviews_en.author: F Tn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Son Charoen Nakhon is a Thai restaurant quietly tucked away inside a private home, located near ICONSIAM.

The concept is quite unique—you actually walk through the owner’s house before reaching the dining area on the second floor.

Once inside, the atmosphere feels immediately warm and intimate. You can sense the owner’s intention to create a space where guests feel as if they’re enjoying a home-cooked meal in a cozy, personal setting.

The menu mainly features Thai and Southern Thai dishes. The flavors are well-balanced, mellow, and thoughtfully executed. Some dishes were quite unfamiliar, but surprisingly delightful once tasted—definitely memorable.

During this visit, I ordered a variety of dishes, as shown in the photos.

To end the meal on a sweet note, the owner kindly offered a complimentary ice cream bar before we left—a small but thoughtful touch that made the experience even more special.

Overall, it’s a hidden gem worth visiting if you’re looking for something unique and homey in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kritsada

sample_reviews_en.text: As usual, I followed the good reviews, and I didn't. Firstly, the service. The waitress kept playing with her phone. When I asked for extra napkins, I literally got three, then after asking again, three more 😅 It's nothing extraordinary. The coconut fish soup was delicious, the squid was rubbery, the shrimp were just shrimp, okay but nothing special. The honey-baked ribs were delicious, except that 90% of them were bone. I would have understood ribs like that at a street bar, but not at a restaurant with high-end prices. There was no one else in the restaurant except me. When I arrived the day before, I wasn't allowed in because it was supposedly closed. It's a strange, hidden place; I expected much better culinary experiences. I don't recommend it; there are many better places; the fish soup alone isn't worth the effort.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marcin

sample_reviews_en.text: This mysterious restaurant is tucked away in a side street off Charoen Krung 51/1. Entering feels more like trespassing into someone's home than a restaurant. Upstairs, there are no more than six tables, and none of the customers are Thai – foreigners are really good at finding hidden gems! We ordered fried fish with tamarind sauce, fish soup with coconut milk, and stir-fried prawns with chili and salt, plus a bottle of white wine. The menu is limited, but the ingredients are high-quality, fresh, and delicious – perfect for both Thais and foreigners. There are only a few staff members because it's a home-cooked restaurant, but they are polite and helpful. They have a wide selection of red and white wines – enough to get you tipsy! You won't be disappointed if you follow this recommendation.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปาลิลน์อินฟูล

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the opportunity to dine at "Son." The name is unusual, but the entrance is even more unusual. The restaurant is located on the second floor of a house, while the ground floor is the owner's residence. There's only a sign on the front of the house with a phone number. You have to call the owner to let him in. It was a very unique and interesting experience.

Upon reaching the second floor, the atmosphere was beyond expectations. The decorations were beautiful, lovely, and stylish.
I tried the Charoen Nakhon chicken salad, stir-fried pork with shrimp paste, and mackerel in fish curry. The fried sea bass with fish sauce.

The food was beautifully presented on the plates. I personally loved the stir-fried pork with shrimp paste and the mackerel in fish curry. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: CK Vistra

restaurants.name: Bawarchi Indian Restaurant: Grand President Hotel
restaurants.address:

16 Sukhumvit 11 Aly, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I finally decided to take the plunge and try this place after walking by it a 1000 times.
I dined inside which was air cooled and the furnishings & decor were of a high level, so first impressions were very good.
Menu is OK but not as varied as what we are used to in the UK (yes, we are spoiled for good Indian food there).
Prices are on the high side both for BKK and comparatively speaking (again with UK).
The small taster was welcome and very nice. The main event chicken Jalfreizi: the  Jalfreizi sauce was excellent, however the cheap quality chicken really let it down. In my opinion it was cheap chicken leg or thigh meat and not breast as I would expect. It was chewy, had gristle and even a small bone that made me think I’d broken a tooth! Fortunately I hadn’t.
When I shared my feedback with one of the waitresses she seemed indifferent.
Would I try it again?? I would probably give them a second chance and try a lamb dish and hope for the best. The live Indian music was very good by the way.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pablo Zorro

sample_reviews_en.text: Great Asian Cuisine and typically North Indian & pakistani food. Despite all boom n rocks around, this restaurant has flavor of its own, staff is so polite and simple that even if you ask for a glass of warm water, then cold water, then again warm water or maybe slices of unlimited lemon. The three different chutneys pineapple, Emily and green. All are exceptional and are being served free to the customers. Just to touch the taste buds. This restaurant was located just opposite to our hotel where we were staying and that's why I have clicked one pic from the window of my hotel. One night at around 2:30 a.m. We wanted a ginger milk, chai tea or typical Indian tea, the chef obliges just without even a single sign on his face and prepared the deed then and there for us.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumeet Gill

sample_reviews_en.text:
Indian Restaurant Bawarchi.  Went for breakfast. Had vegetables Omlette and aloo paratha. They do not provide any toast with omlette. Usually all restaurants do. Either bread slices or toast butter. So I ordered an aloo paratha.

Taste of both was okay. Very oily and super spicy. If u can't take the spice then this is not the place for you. So food I will give 3 on 5.

It is located on Soi 11 which is probably the most happening area.
Location 5 on 5. They play good music. Hindi bollywood songs. Open all day.  Good atmosphere overall. I spent 400 baht. Which is 1000 indian rs for an omlette and paratha. So for indian food this is on the higher side. Cheaper options are available also.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr. Ajwani's Dental Center

sample_reviews_en.text:
Waiting staff were a bit pushy and rushed me. While eating they all stood looking while people eating which made me feel like I was constantly watched and couldn’t relax. They gave me a card to do a review on line before I had finished eating or got the bill.
When I paid the bill they weren’t to friendly either.
The food quality was ok and I had butter chicken that the sauce wasn’t a rich sauce, more watered down. Garlic nan bread was dry and lacked garlic flavour. The serve portions were a good size.  Atmosphere was ok and I think if you knew the manager, staff they would treat you better. Has potential but needs to have a more relaxed inclusive atmosphere for me to go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason Grant

sample_reviews_en.text:
Little Indian trip.
To me as a western eating Asian food is always strongly influenced by the atmosphere in the Restaurant.
From the very first moment I have entered Bawarchi I was catched by it's Indian vibe in the Restaurant.
Decor, painting,  yes Bollywood music videos on 2x screens, service people, all gave me an authentic Indian vibe.
Food was good.
Although to me could be a little bit more spicy but I was asked before and asked for little spicy.
I had delicious salt Lassi, 2x garlic naan and soft lamb.
Only downsize was the price with 900 bhat (1xChang included) but hey what a cheap Indian trip compared by real travelling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fade_2 Grey

sample_reviews_en.text:
Discovering Bawarchi Indian Restaurant was like uncovering a hidden treasure in Bangkok, renowned for its authentic Indian cuisine.
The Dal Degchi is a delight for those who prefer simple and mild flavors.
My family was particularly fond of the Kashmiri Dum Aloo; it was a novel experience to see a whole, uncut potato submerged and flawlessly cooked in a delectable masala.
The Biryani and Egg Curry are also must-try dishes. Their culinary offerings made our nine-day stay in Bangkok feel very homely.
I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone craving Indian food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prashanth Giridharan

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant had a modern and beautiful interior, making it suitable for hosting events. Yesterday, I went there for dinner with a friend. The music was contemporary and trendy. When we arrived, there weren't many occupied tables; we were the only customers at that time. However, the staff mentioned that more people typically come later in the evening, around 21:00. The food was average and not too spicy, catering to the taste of foreign customers since it's located on a street popular with tourists. The service was fast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Monica’s Taste

sample_reviews_en.text: Incredible food, service, atmosphere. One for eh fanciest Indian restaurants I’ve ever been to. The worker who tended to us was ina suit! A great experience form too to bottom. The food was fantastic. The tikka massala chicken was so different and the naaan was perfect. 10/10 would recommend coming here. They have an inside area as well. The more luxury experience comes at a higher price tag. Was definitely more expensive than other Indians spots. But it was worth it!Across from sugar club!
sample_reviews_en.author: Brandon Leuangpaseuth

restaurants.name: Premium Congee by khun Noi
restaurants.address:

Pattaya 3rd Rd, Pattaya City, Amphoe Bang Lamung, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came with a friend as soon as it opened this morning. The shop is spacious with plenty of seating, and importantly, it has air conditioning. Looking around, it was mostly locals; I didn't see any tourists. The variety of dishes is dazzling. Although it's a congee shop, they have rice, rice porridge, and all sorts of other types of congee. Main dishes are inexpensive, and drinks are also reasonably priced. While the taste is indeed delicious, as some people say, it's definitely above average. By the way, they accept credit cards :) Fried dough sticks are 20 yuan, but the sauce is 15 yuan, so keep that in mind!

The shrimp fried rice, which I didn't photograph, was also a generous portion. I recommend giving it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Feliz-JK Wang

sample_reviews_en.text: It was okay but I definitely have had much more flavorful porridge. They forgot my drink but apologized after I had to tell them to remove it from by bill as I had never recieved it. While eating I watched tables that came in after me recieve their drinks very disappointing. At least offer something to go an apology only goes so far I was actually thirsty. Also I ended up leaving early as they had someone start coming in with a ladder measuring about to do construction while I'm eating no thanks that should be done outside of dining hours. Overall I would not go back or recommend this place there are much better options.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lisa

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes delicious and there's a wide variety of dishes to choose from. The congee is perfectly cooked and the offal isn't gamey. The dim sum is tasty. The wait for food is understandable given the high volume of customers and delivery drivers (like those on Line Man), but the food arrived gradually. The fried dough sticks are crispy, not rancid, and not oily. The custard is smooth, not too sweet, and has a nice aroma. However, the glasses should have the brand logo on them.
sample_reviews_en.author: nopparit hemniti

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is incredibly hot, even with the air conditioning. The food I ordered was incomplete; they made mistakes and had to correct it twice. It looked bad and I felt like I was being taken advantage of.
The steamed dumplings were just okay, and the congee portion was small for the price. The best thing about this restaurant is the fried dough sticks (patongko).
sample_reviews_en.author: imonba aa

sample_reviews_en.text:
I initially saw that it had a lot of stars, so I decided to try it, but it wasn't as amazing as I expected. The dim sum wasn't as delicious as I thought I would be. Even simple dishes like the shrimp dumplings were just okay. The congee/rice porridge had a lot of rice but very few toppings, not worth the price.

Ps. The staff provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Orawan Sri

sample_reviews_en.text: The congee was delicious, and the staff provided excellent service. I left my bag at the restaurant but couldn't go back to get it because of traffic, so I called a Grab taxi to pick it up. The staff securely packed my bag in a paper bag and stapled it shut. Very impressed!
sample_reviews_en.author: thanika ponnak

sample_reviews_en.text: This congee shop is considered local, but not *that* local, as it's frequented by tourists from all over the world—Westerners, Chinese, Koreans, etc. If you're looking for a light breakfast and feel that seafood is too heavy, this place is …
sample_reviews_en.author: Shimi K.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but the only downside was that the bamboo basket used for the desserts had cockroaches in it—it was disgusting! I hope the vendor will pay more attention to hygiene.
sample_reviews_en.author: SB Yeap

restaurants.name: Napha | Central Park
restaurants.address:

G Floor, Central Park, 946 Rama IV Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It is my first time visiting this shopping mall. Passing by this restaurant, my sons like the dishes from the menu, so that, we eat our dinner here

I ordered Claypot Crabmeat with Glass Noodle, Pork Chop Steak with Satay Sauce, Pad Krapao Minced Beef, Stir-fried Cabbage with Signature Sauce and Fried Marinated Chicken Wings

To comment the dishes that I ordered, I conclude that they are delicious.

The Pork Chop Steak can feel charcoal scent inside the mouth, the Claypot crabmeat with glass noodle is gorgeous, the spices in the pot is splendid.

We can feel the cook cooks the pad krapao minced beef with high fire fried beef slightly burnt scent. My 2 sons love it.

The stir-fried cabbage is a bit salty but it is fried with cooking smell. Of course, my 2 little kids love the fried chicken wings

The food in the restaurant is recommended but beware that the dishes are a bit small in volume
sample_reviews_en.author: Alan Lai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very pretty little restaurant on the ground floor of the new Central Park mall. Service was really lovely and attentive. The food was all good and well prepared but unfortunately,
not fully to our liking. Given the price, we had to knock off 1 star.

My partner and I both agreed the Stir Fried Crab Curry was the best dish. Very savoury and flavourful with a good amount of turmeric.

Stir Fried Soft Shell Crab was really well done but the roasted garlic made it bitter which was polarising. I enjoyed the bitterness, my partner did not. It would’ve made a difference if the dish was spicy but sadly it was not.

The Giant River Prawn was probably one of the priciest on the menu but the tamarind sauce way too sweet.

We paid 3890 baht incl. taxes for 2 people without alcohol.
sample_reviews_en.author: Freddie Kh

sample_reviews_en.text: I walked into this restaurant because of its bright and clean design style. Especially the crystal table in the middle—it must be quite difficult to maintain, but it’s spotless. When I opened the menu, I suddenly noticed one of the chefs, Chef Chuem, who I’ve heard is also one of the restaurant’s partners. I’ve seen her personal social media platform recommending delicious food 👍. The food here is tasty, the seats are comfortable, and the staff is friendly. It’s a great restaurant—I’ll definitely come back next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peggy Lau

sample_reviews_en.text: Napha Restaurant is more than just a place to eat; it's a true culinary experience. From the moment you step inside, you're enveloped in a warm and inviting atmosphere. The decor is a perfect blend of modern elegance and rustic charm, with soft lighting and natural wood accents that create an intimate and cozy setting. It's the kind of place where you feel comfortable whether you're on a romantic date or having a lively dinner with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: tanisorn jitpongtum

sample_reviews_en.text:
During our visit to Dusit Central Park, we had our lunch at this restaurant, which features a menu crafted by multiple chefs, making it quite intriguing.

We tried several dishes; while they were enjoyable, there is certainly potential for further refinement to elevate the overall experience.

The service was commendable, with attentive staff ensuring our needs were well taken care of throughout our visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutharin Phusitphoykai

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent and the food were delicious. The palo pork belly was extremely tender and my only gripe was that it's a little too fatty for me. The papaya salad was a little unconventional due to the manner which the papaya was cut but it was fresh and yummy. The green curry chicken was good too but it's just a little on the sweeter side for me. Overall it's worth a revisit soon :)
sample_reviews_en.author: kenneth ong

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re looking for Thai cuisine created by a variety of renowned Thai chefs, this is the perfect place. You’ll find everything from simple, comforting dishes to highly creative plates. The flavors remain authentically Thai, without being toned down to suit tourists’ tastes.

Today, I tried the braised beef khao soi — the curry broth was rich and intense, and the beef was incredibly tender.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nat Nampu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing Thai food that I would happily return to and recommend. Every dish we ordered was a hit, and we ended up finishing everything because it was all so delicious.

My only disappointment was that they had already run out of their plant-based options earlier in the day, so we weren’t able to try those. Aside from that, the food and overall experience were excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nelly

restaurants.name: Make Me Mango Asiatique
restaurants.address:

2194 ถ. เจริญกรุง Wat Phraya Krai, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A nice place well air conditioned place.
The Golden Time Smoothie is tasty and nice decorated.You can rent a power bank. A huge selection of drinks , food.

One table and seats were dirty. It took 10 minutes for preparing the smoothie.
Three person are working and the shop was almost empty. The cashier was friendly but the waitress bringing the smoothie not.
I wonder, if I haven’t chosen ToGo, why do we have so much unnecessary plastic trash, that can be improved!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bernd

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're visiting Asiatique Riverfront, Make Me Mango is an absolute must-visit. They serve one of the best mango sticky rice I've had in Bangkok, with perfectly ripe, sweet mangoes, fragrant sticky rice, and rich coconut sauce. Everything tasted incredibly fresh and the prices were very reasonable for the quality. The ambiance is beautiful and makes for a perfect spot to relax after exploring Asiatique. Highly recommended for anyone who loves mango desserts!
sample_reviews_en.author: Atul Singh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stopped in for desert after eating at Peppers Seafood

Wife tried the Black Mango with is mango coffee and I had peachy mango tea

Both were great.

We ordered the mango sticky rice fusion

It’s a great twist on sticky rice.  If you are close save room for desert and stop by.

They have food bowls also and hear they are good but did not see until we had already had dinner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Terrell Nixon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mango Cafe in Bangkok's Asiatique. The shop is clean and has a cute atmosphere, which really lifts your spirits. The food is delicious too.

However, the slow service and the unfriendly attitude of the male staff were disappointing. I understand that the staff are probably exhausted because it's a popular place, but it's a shame considering how delicious the food is.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sam Senai

sample_reviews_en.text:
A female staff member wearing glasses was unfriendly, didn't even greet the customer, and yelled at them. Foreigners, absolutely do not go there.

A woman staff member wearing glasses is so rude.

She doesn't even say hello to the customer and shouts.

She needs to be trained in the service industry.

Most Thai people are kind, but why do you like that?
sample_reviews_en.author: Lovely Popo

sample_reviews_en.text: This place sells beautifully presented mango sticky rice. I only tried one item, but the other menu items all looked good as well. It opens at 3 PM, so I went in after wandering around the mall; the opening hours were a bit inconvenient, but it was nice to be able to enjoy a visually appealing and delicious dessert.
sample_reviews_en.author: HS kim

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great location in Asiatique, right on the main road with plenty of parking.

The shop is beautifully decorated and very pleasing to the eye.

The smoothies are delicious! We ordered a passion fruit and mango smoothie.

And the staff are lovely and provide excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kiig Patricia

sample_reviews_en.text:
Clean and well decorated, but we waited 40 minutes for Mango Sticky Rice when it wasn't even busy. And it was so-so, we've eaten much better.
Good for the Instagram crowd I guess, but if you want to enjoy your food, try somewhere else.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jonathan Taylor

restaurants.name: Somboon Seafood
restaurants.address:

169 7-12 Surawong Rd, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Last visited many years ago but came today. Service standard has improved tremendously. Many and every staff were friendly and helpful.

Food was great. We ordered fried morning glory with garlic and fried noodles with mushroom and crab meat. Both were very delicious. We ordered a small portion of Shark Fin Soup which came in a Middle size portion suited for 3 servings. For the signature Crab dish, I chose the Black Peppered Crab (1 large crab 1kg) which my mum commended it was one of the best crab she had compared to several good restaurants in Singapore and Hong Kong). Personally I don’t like the Curry Crab which this restaurant chain is famous for as I find the curry carries too much oil especially when the dish cools. I had these over some visits and it’s not to my liking but would rather go for Black Peppered Crab.

For desserts we had Mango Sticky Rice which was of high quality and very tasty; and Thai Snakeskin Fruit (Sala) which is my personal favorite.
Well done, once again, Somboon!
(Restaurant atmosphere is great with the exception of some loud speaking Chinese patrons which somehow is a regular experience at Somboon).
sample_reviews_en.author: J S

sample_reviews_en.text:
A legendary spot that truly lives up to its reputation! You can see the Michelin Guide recommendations displayed proudly at the entrance (from 2018-2025), and the food definitely justifies it.
​The Food:
Everything we ordered was delicious. The highlight was of course their signature Fried Curry Crab, which was creamy, rich, and full of flavor. We also enjoyed the Deep Fried Fish with Herbs, Roasted Glass Noodles in Clay Pot, and the Stir-fried Morning Glory. Everything tasted fresh and authentic.
​Service & Parking:
The staff were friendly and helpful. However, a warning for tourists driving here: Parking can be difficult. Although there are signs indicating where to park, they are in Thai and hard to navigate if you don't speak the language. We drove around looking for the official spot but couldn't find it, so we ended up parking in a nearby alley along with other cars.
​Despite the parking confusion, it’s a must-visit for seafood lovers in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Banuaji P

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had high expectations for Somboon Seafood because of its reputation, but unfortunately, our dining experience was very disappointing. The food quality did not meet the standard we expected, especially considering the price.

The seafood did not taste fresh. The prawns had a mushy texture instead of being firm and springy, which made them seem less fresh. The squid was overcooked and rubbery, while the grilled fish was undercooked in some parts. Even the famous fried curry crab lacked the rich flavour we were expecting.

A few hours after the meal, I developed symptoms consistent with mild food poisoning, which made the experience even more disappointing. While I can’t be certain what caused it, the timing was concerning.

Overall, the meal was not worth the THB 3,938 we spent. I hope the restaurant pays more attention to food quality, freshness, and food safety to ensure a better experience for future customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maya Ng

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant outlet is Michelin selected and was the first lunch of our trip as it was very close to our hotel. I had my favourite yellow curry stir fried crab again and the rendition here was superb, possibly the best I had in Thailand so far and it goes so well with rice that I probably mopped up more sauce, gravy and rice than I should have. There were many tourists from China and Korea at this rather busy restaurant branch.

The scallops with asparagus were okay but both the curry crab and salt and pepper prawns were very delicious. The fried fish was quite tasty as well but I can’t remember the exact flavour we ordered. On hindsight, we should have ordered the crab meat version of the curry so I did not have to peel the crab and I’m sure it would be just as good. This was a very enjoyable meal and I will on the search to see if there are better versions of yellow curry crab elsewhere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julius Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: Very popular seafood restaurant. But food was  disappointing. They failed to deliver the standard I expected from other reviews. Service was ok maybe bcos it's full house and staffs were preoccupied... All food were not piping hot. The tomyam though the broth was decent but the prawns were not fresh. Soft and mushy. The grouper too was not fresh.... mushy meat. The somtam, papaya salad was crunchy but again the top condiments like the dried prawns was not crunchy. However it did pack a punch in terms of scoville figures. The crab and mince pork wrapped in soy skin and deep fried was nice if it had come out piping hot. But in this case it was warmish.  Hopefully the other dishes fare better the one we had. In all, tastes wise is acceptable but the value and quality needed improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Honzie Khong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was disappointed with the signature dish- crab curry, without shell. I got a medium portion (1500+ baht, $50). There were some lumps of crab, but I expected more for the price. It was tasty, but not hot at all spice-wise, and crab seemed a bit cold, like it was shelled earlier, refrigerated, then heated up with sauce. The portion looked big, most most of it was sauce. Rice was extra, but should have been included in the price.
Crab has a subtle flavor, and the curry sauce overpowered it so much it didn't really taste like crab- it certainly had the consistency of crab. I would suggest they ask guests how spicy they want it, and serve dishes that compliment the taste of crab better.
Don't think I'll return, given the above stated. Not sure why this is Michelin rated (not starred)
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeff Levy

sample_reviews_en.text:
Somboon Seafood was one of the best dining experiences we had in Bangkok.

After visiting the beautiful Akara Sky Hanuman, we walked just a few minutes to this restaurant for dinner, and it was absolutely worth it.

The food was outstanding, fresh, and full of flavor. Of course, we had to try their famous Fried Crab with Curry Powder, and now we completely understand why it's their signature dish. It was rich, delicious, and unlike anything we've tasted before. We highly recommend everyone to order it.

The restaurant was lively, the service was efficient, and the overall experience was excellent. If you're looking for authentic Thai seafood in Bangkok, Somboon Seafood is definitely a place you shouldn't miss.

We will certainly come back on our next visit to Bangko
sample_reviews_en.author: Mehdi Khani

sample_reviews_en.text:
First time trying Somboon Seafood, and it definitely lived up to the hype! The food was delicious, and the service was excellent from start to finish.

There were so many dishes to choose from, but the Fried Crab Curry was the clear standout. It was rich, flavorful, and absolutely worth ordering. My only minor comment is that I would have loved a bit more crab meat, as it seemed to have more egg than crab. Still, it was very tasty.

The Mango Sticky Rice was also fantastic and a perfect way to end the meal.

Overall, we had a great dining experience and would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting Bangkok. We’ll definitely be back on our next trip!

Tip: Consider making a reservation, especially during peak dining hours.

(Surawong branch)
sample_reviews_en.author: Roque Vicente Castillo

restaurants.name: Le Du Kaan
restaurants.address:

56th Floor The Empire, 1 S Sathon Rd, Yan Nawa, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The กล้วยบวชชี was my favorite! We visited on a rainy day, so we missed out on the atmosphere, but the food and service were both excellent. Overall, it was a great experience! Would definitely come back!
sample_reviews_th.author: Tanya

sample_reviews_th.text:
Le Du Kaan
ฤดูกาล
The food was amazing — and yes, once again I ate way too much 😅🍽️ …
sample_reviews_th.author: maxitzu gmail

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere was 10/10, the service was outstanding, and overall the experience was fantastic. The rooftop itself is beautiful, and the staff was friendly and attentive throughout the evening.

However, I was very concerned about the allergy information provided on the menu. Several dishes were labeled as gluten-free when they actually contained gluten, and many of the servers seemed unsure about which ingredients contained gluten and which did not.

In my case, I have a gluten intolerance, so it was an inconvenience. But for someone with a severe allergy or celiac disease, inaccurate information like this could have serious consequences.

The menu is misleading in its current form and should be updated to provide accurate allergen information. Staff training on food allergies would also be highly beneficial.

Despite this concern, the ambiance, views, and service were truly exceptional. I hope management addresses this issue, as it would make an already excellent experience much safer and more enjoyable for all guests.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maria Andrea Avendaño Ospina

sample_reviews_en.text:
While Le Du Kaan has been highly praised by many, I personally found the flavor profiles to be a bit too aggressive for my palate.

We visited for the set lunch and sampled a variety of dishes, including the Salad Pla Kem, Phal Pla, Namm Kor Moo, Nuer Yang Kati, and the La Roselle. While the technique is evident, I found that the natural essence of the primary ingredients (whether the proteins or the vegetables) was often overshadowed by an intensity of salt, spice, and citrus. I would have preferred a more balanced approach that allowed the quality of the produce to shine.

​That being said, the venue itself is stunning and provides a sophisticated backdrop for business meetings, dates, or weekend gatherings. The staff are exceptionally professional and welcoming. The rooftop bar offers one of the most spectacular sunset views in Bangkok, making it an ideal destination for evening drinks even if the culinary style is a matter of personal preference.
sample_reviews_en.author: Flo Y.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The venue is absolutely stunning, with breathtaking views and an incredible atmosphere.

The staff were very kind, attentive, and helpful throughout the evening. Special mention to Boom, who took care of me all night with such warmth and professionalism. Since I was dining alone, she kindly helped me take photos, which really made my experience so much better. She also recommended the “Coconut” dessert, which was absolutely excellent — definitely one of the highlights of my evening! She truly saved my night.

Unfortunately, I was very disappointed with the food. I ordered the mushroom soup and the vegetable fried rice, and both were honestly not good at all. I couldn’t even finish my meal.

Without the outstanding service — especially thanks to Boom — my rating would have been much lower. Her kindness, thoughtful recommendations, and exceptional customer care truly made up for what was otherwise a disappointing dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Monthira Khambang-Barrera

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely loved the food and atmosphere at Le Du Kaan. We had a gorgeous booth-side table overlooking the Bangkok skyline after sunset, right beside the DJ who was playing incredible music all evening and creating such a fun, elevated vibe throughout dinner.

Every single dish was beautifully presented and 10/10. You can really feel the creativity and care behind the menu, each dish had its own unique touch that elevated it beyond traditional Thai food while still honoring the flavors beautifully.

The crispy pork is an absolute must if you visit. The crab dish was also incredible. Everything we tried was delicious!

If you’re looking for an elevated Thai dining experience with amazing ambiance, music, views, and food, I highly recommend Le Du Kaan. Such a memorable experience and I can’t wait to return!

Thank you to the manager Terry Arsaipa, Caramelo, and the staff who really made the experience unforgettable! 💖🔥
sample_reviews_en.author: Sofia Wakabayashi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely blown away by this dining experience. Every dish felt thoughtfully crafted, balancing bold flavors with a refined presentation that makes you pause before even taking the first bite. The textures, the colors, the aroma—everything just works together effortlessly.

From the vibrant, fresh salad to the rich, perfectly seasoned mains, each plate tells its own story. Even the simplest elements, like the sauces and sides, are elevated to something memorable. You can really tell the kitchen pays attention to detail.

The atmosphere adds another layer—relaxed yet stylish, with a view that makes the whole experience feel a bit more special. It’s the kind of place where time slows down, and you genuinely enjoy every moment at the table.

If you’re looking for a spot that delivers both quality and vibe, this place absolutely deserves a visit. Definitely coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: chnakan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was really delicious. The staff were extremely nice and attentive. The restaurant looks stunning and the views are spectacular..

I did find it really stressful trying to make sure I ordered enough food and drinks to reach the min spend pp. The price of menu items went from really reasonable to really expensive and little in between. Unfortunately the expensive things didn’t appeal to me as I like to eat Thai in Thailand but the expensive things were wagu steak or lobster items. Also i don’t really drink alcohol so I was a bit panicky with that.

The atmosphere was good but the endless photo shoots of insta girls and their boyfriends/photographers was a bit annoying especially as they all had special camera lights shining all the time.

You go through a cool corridor before the lifts. Make sure to take pics then because you don’t go back out that way.
sample_reviews_en.author: TinaK

restaurants.name: Sra Bua by Kiin Kiin
restaurants.address:

991/9, Siam Kempinski Hotel, Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
An absolutely unforgettable dining experience—Sra Bua by Kiin Kiin truly lives up to its Michelin-star reputation. From the moment we stepped in, we were welcomed with impeccable service and a series of beautifully crafted welcome dishes that set the stage for an extraordinary meal.

The tasting menu was nothing short of spectacular, blending traditional Thai flavors with modern techniques in a way that was both innovative and delicious. Every course was thoughtfully presented, each dish a work of art that tasted just as incredible as it looked. The deserts were delicious as well as fun since it was a “scavenger hunt”

Beyond the food, the ambiance was incredibly romantic—perfect for a special evening. The attention to detail in both the service and presentation made the experience feel luxurious and intimate. Definitely worth every penny, and a must-visit for anyone looking for a top-tier dining experience in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bobby Cao

sample_reviews_en.text:
The entire experience from being greeted by the team,  to taking us to the longe where we sampled beautiful small bites and the incredible food and service were exquisite.

The food was wonderfully presented and had rich, complex, bold and delightful flavors. Everyone in our party was thoroughly impressed. We also were so excited by the playful desserts. That also helped make the evening fun!

The service provided by the team was impeccable and ran like a beautifully choreographed ballet.

Our main sever, Air, was helpful, kind, engaging and funny adding to the warm and receptive atmosphere of the restaurant. The next time we’re in Bangkok, we shall definitely visit again. I encourage all travelers to Bangkok to have dinner at Sra Bua. It’s well worth it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sanjay Marwaha

sample_reviews_en.text:
Some hits and misses.
Food:
- Loved two items - their ceviche with Phuket pineapple sprinkled with fruity ice & the wagyu beef sous vide with rice had a southern Thai touch which tasted similar to rendang was perfectly tender and was the best part of the meal
- liked their rendition of phad Thai, served with translucent noodles and sliced up fresh water prawn though it was a tad too sweet
- Tom yam soup was way too salty which was a waste as I could taste the umami soaked up from the  seafood
- Had a few surprise dishes but the food was too much (some may argue this is better than too little)

Service was extremely attentive and the restaurant while busy still offered a sense of privacy in a spacious classy environment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dylan S

sample_reviews_en.text:
The newly renovated Lotus Pond by Chef Noom Veerawat.
Fine dining, surprising Thai cuisine emphasizing seasonal, local Thai ingredients. The food tasted amazing. Chef Noom personally oversaw the meal. Before the course began, there was an exhibition educating guests about the ingredients used, making the meal even more interesting. They also have vegan options. We came to celebrate our wedding anniversary. We were very impressed. Khun Tonmai, Khun Som, Khun Apichai, and Khun Honey provided warm service and detailed knowledge about the ingredients. Thank you so much for the delicious food and the always warm service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suparluk Chanpreechakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant's rebranding is fantastic! It's truly new. The chef is incredibly talented in selecting ingredients and creating new culinary styles using authentic Thai ingredients. The flavors are bold and delicious. Every dish is thoughtfully crafted. There's absolutely nothing to criticize about this new beginning for Sra Bua. I was impressed from the moment I entered. All the staff have always been so welcoming, just like on my first visit and even after the rebranding. Lin and Apichai took excellent care of our table of three, making the meal incredibly enjoyable. And thank you to all the staff as well!
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฏฐณิชา พิจิตบรรจง

sample_reviews_en.text: This was an amazing culinary experience. The food presentation will blow you away as it is literally a work of artistry. The menu is limited prix fixe but the food is great as we enjoyed virtually every dish served. Staff service is also excellent but waned near closing as our dinner lasted nearly 2 1/2 hours and we started at 8:00 pm. Decor is also impressive. Wine menu by the glass is very limited but quality. We paid about $450 USD including drinks and it was worth it as it would have cost much more in the U.S. If you want a five star culinary experience then you won’t go wrong here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christopher Barton

sample_reviews_en.text:
A wonderful Thai fine-dining experience. Every dish was beautifully presented, with thoughtful combinations of traditional Thai flavors and modern techniques. The flavors were refined yet still felt authentically Thai, and each course had its own unique character.

The service was attentive and professional without being overwhelming, and the overall atmosphere made the evening feel special. A great place for anyone who appreciates Thai cuisine with a creative, elevated touch. Definitely an experience worth trying.
sample_reviews_en.author: Punyanuch Jomsubjaroen

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had an absolutely fantastic fine dining experience! The food was exceptional, but what truly made the evening special was the incredible service from the team.
A huge thank you to Worawut, Honey, Ta, and Air. They were not only professional and attentive to every detail but also wonderfully talkative and engaging, which made us feel so welcome throughout the entire meal. It is rare to find such a perfect balance of top-tier service and genuine warmth.
I will definitely be back. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mak Angela

restaurants.name: Tossakan Thai Curry House (Khaosan)
restaurants.address:

225 Ram Buttri Aly, Talat Yot, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been in Thailand for a few days, and aside from being the most expensive restaurant I've eaten at, it's the one I liked the least. It's just an ordinary restaurant, and the service was very basic. Honestly, and I'm sorry to say this, but I wouldn't recommend it, nor would I go back. Although the photos make it look good, the food doesn't live up to the taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Merche

sample_reviews_en.text: The vibe at Tossakan Thai Curry House (Khaosan) was a fun mix of live jazz and a lively upstairs view, which made the whole visit feel memorable. I especially enjoyed the massaman curry, which lived up to the praise I’d seen before coming. It’s the kind of spot that feels relaxed but still has enough energy to keep things interesting.
sample_reviews_en.author: lovel lalty

sample_reviews_en.text: Good, inexpensive, and they accept credit and debit cards. They have air conditioning at midday, which is rare in Bangkok. On hot days, it's very important. The service is very personalized. They have a Thai iced "butterfly" tea that they serve in a natural fiber basket; it doesn't leak a drop, and they give it to you for free.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jenifer Nahir Neves Jauregui

sample_reviews_en.text: The Massaman curry was good. I recommend it; although the taste is different, it's delicious. I think it's a good place to try Thai food. I didn't like the steamed eggs, but that might be a matter of taste. I also tried the green curry, but that didn't suit my taste either.
sample_reviews_en.author: ece

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is small and has a small terrace. It's air-conditioned.
It serves Thai food and is usually busy, which is a good sign. The food and drinks are very good, the place is clearly clean, and the service is excellent.
It's very reasonably priced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ayar Pardo

sample_reviews_en.text: In Bangkok, there's a restaurant known as "Mr. Massaman Curry" that serves delicious, mild curry made with plenty of coconut milk. A Massaman curry costs 160 baht. You can choose your toppings. Adding a soft-boiled egg makes it even milder.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manuel Velazqez

sample_reviews_en.text: Air conditioning at midday. Credit cards accepted. Delicious food, generous portions, and a good balance of spice. Reasonable prices. Every dish is good, and the butterfly drink is tasty and comes in a complimentary, handcrafted container.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jenifer Neves

sample_reviews_en.text: They repeatedly asked if they could clear the dishes before we finished eating and blatantly pressured us to leave quickly, which made me feel uncomfortable, so I hurriedly left. It ruined the atmosphere of my last meal in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: 이상곤

restaurants.name: EKKA Indian Grill and Bar
restaurants.address:

56 Surawong Rd, Si Phraya, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's easy to see why it's so highly rated. The food, the staff service, and the atmosphere are all perfect. The taste is luxurious and the portions are generous. Even the chips and spices are carefully selected, resulting in a refined flavor. The great value lunch menu comes with rice for 180 baht. You can add samosas for an additional 80 baht, or pani puri for an additional 30 baht. They kindly taught me how to eat pani puri. Thank you. I'd definitely like to eat there again.
I've visited again.
The lamb curry was absolutely delicious. The tandoori chicken and naan were also very tasty. I'd definitely like to eat there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: M M

sample_reviews_en.text: We had lunch at this Indian restaurant and were absolutely delighted. The ingredients were fresh, the Thai curry was especially delicious, and the naan bread was simply fantastic. A big thank you to Mohan for the wonderful and attentive service. We felt very comfortable and will definitely come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Irena Fromme

sample_reviews_en.text: What an absolute gem of a restaurant this was! We stumbled across this place on route to Pat Pong markets . Table of ten mixture of adults and kids. The food was absolutely delicious, the restaurant was immaculately clean and staff so lovely, would highly recommend this restaurant 👌🌟
sample_reviews_en.author: Darren Speirs

sample_reviews_en.text:
A wonderful authentic Indian restaurant serving the traditional dishes and beautifully presented.
This is the second time we’ve been here & tried different items from the menu each time and have not been disappointed by the flavours.
The staff are welcoming and efficient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mandy

sample_reviews_en.text: The best!!!! The food was delicious, and the condiments went unexpectedly great with the meal (especially with the biryani). The ice cream was absolutely divine as well. Service staff were polite, respectful, and attentive. Overall worth every baht spent!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bakewithlove L.

sample_reviews_en.text: Very different than other Indian restaurants that I have seen overall in any place outside India, europe or UK. Also value for money. The ambience is surprisingly not the the typical India Maharaja Theme that I have seen all over  India.
sample_reviews_en.author: parag sheth

sample_reviews_en.text: I was most impressed with the AVOCADO PAPDI CHAAT 🥑. The yogurt was so refreshing, and the spiced yogurt, avocado, and chutneys were a perfect combination. Other basic dishes were just okay compared to other Indian restaurants. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanaporn K.

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s a best Indian food in Bangkok . There are some restaurants in Bangkok but this one is best . Foods are very delicious and portion sizes are also good . Recommend everyone who wants to eat the beat Indian food at Bangkok .
sample_reviews_en.author: neela ara
