restaurants.name: Shining Taste 盛香亭 พะโล้หมาล่าหม้อไฟ
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 20 Sala Daeng Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today, we chose the 398 Baht buffet at this restaurant. After ordering our soup and a meat plate and beginning our meal, a staff member informed us that the Australian grass-fed brisket was out of stock. This should have been communicated to us before we placed our order.

When we raised our concern, another staff member assured us that we could select a different type of meat. We agreed and ordered a five-meat plate. However, after waiting 15 minutes, the order still hadn’t arrived. We reminded them, and after another five minutes, they only brought out two meat plates instead of five. When we followed up again, they simply told us to wait longer.

The entire experience was frustrating and disappointing. The lack of communication, slow service, and failure to fulfill our order properly made for an unpleasant dining experience. I believe other customers should be aware of this.
sample_reviews_en.author: A Nge Lay

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is good compare with price. But one downside is the restaurant’s policy, which does not allow friends who come together to sit next to each other if they choose different buffet price options. The reason is that they are afraid people might share food, which honestly sounds a bit ridiculous.

If that’s the concern, I’d suggest separating dining zones or tables based on price instead. But asking customers to leave empty seats between each other doesn’t really make sense.

When we asked, “What if we just pretend we don’t know each other can we sit close together with our friends then?” the staff said yes.
That’s quite amusing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adrenalin Rsy

sample_reviews_en.text:
Flies and cockroaches were flying around while I was eating.
I saw a cockroach and called a staff member. The staff member caught the cockroach, I'm not sure if they squashed it or not, but it looked like they did. This shouldn't have happened, and I didn't receive any compensation, apology, or genuine action. I feel like I wasted my money. Please improve this.
sample_reviews_en.author: xrsx xoun

sample_reviews_en.text:
The only bad thing is - lack of English speakers. Not all labels are translated to English. You have to place orders with QR scan by yourself but all the instructions were written in Thailand. Staffs speak little or no English at all.
On the bright side - food is quite nice, cheap and options are good too.
Will visit again next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Han Myo Htet

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, authentic Mala chili flavor with a tingling, spicy kick.
The main soups I recommend are:
* Mala Braised Soup
* The restaurant's signature Mala Braised Soup
* Mala Braised Green Chili Soup
There's a huge variety of options on the conveyor belt, but the highlight, aside from the soup, is the beef.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leo Crackerjack

sample_reviews_en.text: Shining Taste impressed me especially its rich tomato soup. The variety of braised and slow-cooked items was a highlight, adding extra depth and making each bite more enjoyable. Overall, it’s a great spot for anyone looking for a flavorful and slightly unique shabu experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Soul Tamashii

sample_reviews_en.text: Great value for money! The portions are generous and the prices are very reasonable. The service was super fast and the staff was friendly. I also love the DIY sauce station—you can customize your own dipping sauce. A solid choice for a quick and satisfying meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zhixuan Li

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is incredibly tasty and fresh, especially liked the bone soup👍 The staff are polite. I wish there was hot tea and the staff didn't always respond after pressing the button. These are minor minuses so I will definitely come back here again! …
sample_reviews_en.author: Lidiya Orlovskaya

restaurants.name: Baan India- Indian Cuisine
restaurants.address:

281/2 Prasan Alley, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stumbled upon this hidden gem of an Indian restaurant near the Marriott in Bangkok, and it was an absolute delight! Despite arriving late, the owner warmly welcomed us and gave us excellent recommendations. The highlight was the Chicken Korma - the best I’ve ever had! The meat was incredibly juicy, fresh, and flavorful, and every dish is prepared fresh to order.

The naan, especially the chili cheese naan, was fantastic. This place also serves alcohol, which is worth noting since many Indian spots don’t. The owner and staff were exceptionally friendly, making us feel so welcome.

While the interior isn’t fancy, the food and hospitality more than make up for it. This restaurant is off to a great start, and I can’t recommend it enough. Delicious, fresh, and such a wonderful experience. We’ll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Blaue Katze

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely fantastic 👌 for someone who cooks BIR very well, I can safely say this is next level and way beyond any British capabilities.  These guys are Indian and certainly know how to cook a curry, very friendly and like a  good conversation. This is in my top 5 lifetime curries.

I like super hot..this was not, but the flavour was 🔥🔥 the lamb (mutton) so soft, unbelievable.

The chicken madras and chicken tawa also impeccable.

I could not fault this dinner, and highly recommend it.

Happy hour 5pm-7pm so get your orders in..

Well done guys and keep it up….see you next year 👌🙏🇹🇭🇮🇳🥘
sample_reviews_en.author: The Reilly’s

sample_reviews_en.text: My wife and I ate dinner at Baan India on May 1, 2026. We found it as were walking along Surawongse. We were hungry but we didnt have great expecatations. However, we were pleasantly surprised with the attentive service from the owner himself. The food was excellent and was served hot and fresh. All the items were presented well and were freshly prepared. We ordered vegetarian Indian food - Alu Parantha, Chapati, Dal and Alu Palak. I would highly reccommend this place for anyone looking for tasty wholesome Indian food in the Sathorn, Silom and Surawongse area! Well done “Baan India”!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ananth Ramachandran

sample_reviews_en.text:
🇮🇳 The food was delicious, with rich flavors that suited Thai palates 😋. The staff were very attentive and provided excellent service; I was impressed from the moment I entered the restaurant.

My favorite dish was the Masala Chicken – delicious, fragrant with spices, and perfectly seasoned.

The Butter Chicken was slightly sweet but also tasty. I recommend mixing them together for a great flavor combination.

Overall, I was very impressed. Delicious food and great service. If you like Indian food, you should definitely visit! 👍🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: chanokcom kansids

sample_reviews_en.text: I am a lover of Indian food, and living in Chiang Mai I've actually struggled to find really good Indian food. I've been living there for a year and don't think I've been satisfied since I had some in Kuala Lumpur. Baan India finally scratched that itch though. I got my standard Palak Paneer, and the chili cheese garlic naan. It was all delicious, I would highly recommended. Also my server Ganesh was a gentleman. Top recommendation if you're I'm bangkok and craving good Indian food. Aroy mak mak 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Jack Alias

sample_reviews_en.text: We had lunch  at Baan India, and it was a wonderful experience. The food was fresh, flavorful, and tasted authentic. We especially enjoyed the Butter Naan, and Biryani & dal makhani. The staff were courteous, attentive, and made us feel welcome throughout the meal. The restaurant was clean, comfortable, and had a pleasant atmosphere. Overall, it was one of the best Indian dining experiences we had in Bangkok. Highly recommended for anyone looking for delicious Indian food!
sample_reviews_en.author: Aseem Narang

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went early September for diner (walk-in). Found this small Indian place last minute via maps.

Extensive vegetarian options. We had kaju and butter paneer curry with latcha paratha. It was our first time having the kaju curry, but it was definitely the highlight. All was delicous!

The friendly owner is from north India and is focused on serving the food as fresh as possible.

Overall, if you're looking for changing things up from Thai food, this one is a good option :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Yannick V.E

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great and tasty food - especially the Kadai Paneer was rich and flavorful with great texture of the masala. I really liked that both Naan and especially the Roti were soft and not dry.

Very attentive and welcoming staff.

The only minor inconvenience is the atmosphere - it’s a pretty rundown place… would be great if they’d make it prettier and invest into more quality furniture and equipment to match the aesthetics with their food quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Niklas Brenner

restaurants.name: The Old Siam Plaza
restaurants.address:

The Old Siam Plaza, 12 Tri Phet Rd, Wang Burapha Phirom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The renovation looks great! I've been walking around here since my student days. I love the old, classic feel. The renovation has maintained that classic charm. The food court on the 3rd floor is gorgeous. Other restaurants are also beautifully decorated and the food looks delicious. There's a huge selection of fashionable clothes. However, I'm deducting 2 stars because I was disappointed. I ate at the food court for 180 baht and then bought more food, totaling over 300 baht, but I needed a receipt to get my parking ticket stamped. Not all food stalls offer receipts, right? Could you please improve this? Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Selene Serena Musika

sample_reviews_en.text:
This security guard was really unacceptable. He parked his car in the basement of The Old Siam, looked at our car, shook his head, and said, "It's not parked straight." Yes, it wasn't parked straight because we hadn't finished parking yet. Is this acceptable behavior? We are regular customers here and we are very dissatisfied. Please train this employee.
I will post a picture to identify him.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุกัญญา ใจเย็น

sample_reviews_en.text: Their food is great, specifically at the food court or called as 'Bam Rung Mueng Market' at the 3rd floor is great. The stores are quite great, although some parts have long lines. The Big C is also filled with food and drinks with ready to eat foods, while there is a Starbucks and a Dairy Queen as well. Thank You!
sample_reviews_en.author: Achira

sample_reviews_en.text: Located on the 3rd floor of Bamrung Muang Market, this restaurant offers a comfortable, clean, delicious, and affordable dining experience.

sample_reviews_en.text: The old shopping mall in the old town – no matter how many times I go, I'm always confused about finding transportation or the shops.

sample_reviews_en.text: It's an old department store, but there's not much to see. I came in to sit in the food court and then browse the booths downstairs.

sample_reviews_en.text: Let's eat on the 3rd floor of Bamrung Muang Market. It's clean, comfortable, air-conditioned, and the food is very affordable.

restaurants.address:

sample_reviews_en.text:
The burgers are very good, although they aren't cheap.
They tend to overcook them, so it's best to order them rare.
You can order them single, double, or triple. I recommend the double. (265 baht in 2024, 275 in 2026).
The place is very nice.
They have tables outside and also inside with air conditioning.
It's a shame how noisy the place is: outside because it's across from Tree Town and it's like being at a fair, and inside because it's usually full of noisy Brits. It's hard to say where the noise is more bothersome.
sample_reviews_en.author: Antonio Socías Carrillo

sample_reviews_en.text:
The burger and fries are delicious.
Customer service is excellent and food prepared and delivered quickly.

On my first visit,  I noticed very heavy pepper seasoning on the burger.

My second visit, I noticed very heavy pepper seasoning on the burger.

To me it is way too much pepper.

If I come back, I will ask for light seasoning,  it was a bit too much pepper for me.

Overall decent burgers here in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warrant Salty

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had very good burger experience here. It really was Aussie beef, you could taste it. Had the Stockholm burger with waffle fries. Bef patties were juicy, big and nicely seasoned. Sauce was good, pickles good, everything was delicious. It was served very quickly and nice staff.
Best burger in Thailand so far and i have been here quite a few times.
Thanks
sample_reviews_en.author: Diana Klaar

sample_reviews_en.text: Visited many times, Always ordered the burger set which included a double burger and french fries.  Fries can be changed to mixed fries or waffled fries.  Quantity is large always make me very full.  Quality always good!  That's why it's one of my canteen in Pattaya!! Staff quick & efficient!!  Love this restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: K W

patty looks very overcooked and rough

looks too browned and dry

sample_reviews_en.text:
Prime Burger has several locations in Bangkok, but this one is in front of Pattaya Tree Town.
This time I had the New York double. It was delicious, but I personally prefer the Stockholm or San Francisco ones, which come with lettuce.
The curly fries were clearly too oily. I wish they were crispier.
sample_reviews_en.author: KA

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely excellent! Fresh, high-quality ingredients, generous and delicious portions. The packaging is elegant, understated, and very classy. I can't comment on the atmosphere since I ordered takeout, but if the service is as good as the food (and I have no doubt it is), then it's flawless.
sample_reviews_en.author: LABARRERE PIERRE

sample_reviews_en.text: I went midday to Prime. Heard it’s got the best burgers in Pattaya. The reviews were right. Burger was done perfectly, the fries were really crisp and soft. Great service, air conditioned and although I’ve been eating Thai food mostly this is a great go to for western food.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is halal and delicious, the place is clean and tidy, and the staff are very respectful and welcoming. The portions are good per person, and the price is excellent for the quality and type of food. The food was very clean and well-balanced, and you can request the appropriate temperature. My family and I have eaten there four times so far, and we will go back again. We tried more than one type of fried rice with shrimp, meat, and tom yum. We also tried their soup and Pad Thai noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: Enjoy_foodstore Budoor Alraimi

sample_reviews_en.text: Our first time dining here today. Very attractive and clean place with extremely kind & friendly staff. Menu is quite extensive. We enjoyed all dishes - the only comment being that we could have used more spice. I think they were being conservative for foreigners. Easily fixed next time around. Very clear that they use high quality ingredients. It will be a regular dining place for us from now on.

A must-try for families with kids!

Highly recommended for parents who want a good meal!

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were welcoming and the service was good, unfortunately the food was the most average food we have eaten so far in our 6 weeks in Bangkok. The crab in yellow curry was bland and lacking in any depth and the rest of the food was …

sample_reviews_en.text: It's not a magnificent temple compared to some I've been to but definitely worth a visit. I was there quite early and witnessed a large public gathering attending an assembly of monks chanting in the main hall. In another part of the Temple one monk was delivering Buddhist teachings to a group of people. Many people come here to "make merit" with offerings and gold leaf rubbed onto Buddha statues.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miles

sample_reviews_en.text: Please, please do NOT miss this staggeringly beautiful Temple literally dripping with gold decor! It’s one of a kind! I promise you will not forget the extraordinary experience of seeing this wonderful small Temple for the first time. Unfortunately a special person I had got to know but I never met was interred here, so you may want to send a prayer to her 3 daughters. Rest in Peace V.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ian Hawkes

sample_reviews_en.text: Very peaceful temple and very close to the center—you can even walk there. It’s not crowded with tourists, so you can take your time to enjoy the surroundings and explore the structures. Just be mindful, as funerals are sometimes held here, so keeping noise levels down is respectful. The caretaker was also very kind and encouraged us to roam around and enjoy the place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jessie Jessie

sample_reviews_en.text: Wat Nong Oo is very relaxing temple area in Middle Pattaya. 50 or 100 metres from the busy and noisy street, time stops and continues to walk, but slower. There you see local monks meditating and novises cleaning, there are few visitors, families. Wat Nong Oo is a good place to visit, it's a leap to a bit different world from Pattaya's worldly streets.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hannu Toivanen

sample_reviews_en.text: A place to make offerings of merit and receive blessings. Guide arranged for the blessing and offerings of merit. Bring change for your offering. Many opportunities to purchase flowers, candles (floating and regular candles), incense, and pre-made packages of clothing and food items, speak to the Ajarn next to the prone Buddha.
sample_reviews_en.author: Elsonian

sample_reviews_en.text: A nice temple to pay a visit to. The temple itself might not be that impressive but there are a lot of Buddha images and different golden statues here to look at. Good place to go if you are a first time temple visitor and surely the kids will enjoy this place too. You can easily spend 15-20 minutes here as a tourist
sample_reviews_en.author: Kasper Hammer-Hansen

sample_reviews_en.text: The place is simply magical! The temple grounds feature almost everything I've heard about from religious stories and myths. There's a black Razu holding the moon, Buddhas of all the days of the week, a reclining three-headed elephant representing the present, past, and future, a multifaceted Buddha, and more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Алёна См

sample_reviews_en.text: Very peaceful temple,with loads of unusual statues,some made from nuts and bolts .There were only a few people there on a Friday afternoon .Free parking is available in the temple grounds .There are also toilets. Senders selling delicious ice cream and, of course, the obligatory lottery ticket sellers.
sample_reviews_en.author: WhyMe

restaurants.name: Thipsamai Padthai Pratoopee
restaurants.address:

313, 315 Maha Chai Rd, Samran Rat, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Not worth to wait hour long for such overpriced food but not really tasty."

sample_reviews_en.text: We got a table after about ten minutes of waiting. It seemed like most of the customers were tourists; we even saw a Thai couple with their Japanese friends. The servers spoke many languages, making ordering easy. We ordered Padthai Siam Chicken, Padthai Wrapped with Eggs, chicken spring rolls, and Thai milk coconut juice. The server said the Padthai with Eggs was very sweet, but the Thai people next to us recommended it 😂 so we ordered it to try. My friend and I both thought it was okay. You can add lemon and crushed peanuts to balance the sweetness, and if you like it spicy, you can add chili powder to reduce the sweetness. Both options were delicious, but the taste wasn't drastically different from street vendors. However, at least the ingredients were fresher, the hygiene was better, and there were air-conditioned tables inside. The portions were quite small, not very filling. The sweetness of the Thai milk couldn't be adjusted, but it wasn't too sweet. It's worth trying if you happen to be passing by, but no need to make a special trip just to eat here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lana

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time trying the best Pad Thai in their origin place and I can tell it was amazing experience. We came for dinner and there was a queue line, but they're moving fast. around 10 mins we got the table, from the entrance the greeter, and the staffs warmly welcomed us, suggesting the most famous items, etc. Not so long the food served, the portion was kinda small, but the taste was amazing. It was the best Pad Thai I've ever tasted, mixture of sweet and savory taste and a hint of shrimp in it. We were thinking to order more but we were on a tight budget during our trip, so badly :(. And, the Orange Juice was amazing as well, I like they keep the big pulp inside. It was so unfortunate that I didn't remember their names and their food items, but I'd really like to come back to Thailand to try their foods again someday.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pungkas Kristo

sample_reviews_en.text:
There’s a lot of hype and controversy about this place, especially among Thai people, since Pad Thai normally shouldn’t be this pricey. The basic one here is around 150 THB, while a regular Pad Thai is usually 50–60 THB. And of course, everyone has their own favorite style of Pad Thai.

However, I was happy with the taste and experience there. The noodles fried with shrimp oil give it a unique flavor, and you can adjust the seasoning with different sauces as you like. For the experience, the highlight is the restaurant itself, it feels like stepping into a museum of Pad Thai history. It’s clean, interesting, and tells a great story. For that, I give them credit: they really preserve and celebrate traditional Pad Thai in town.

I understand why they deserve recognition and awards for both the food and the experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chen E.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thipsamai completely changed my perspective on Pad Thai. I didn’t think I would ever love this dish so much until visiting this place. It truly elevates the traditional Pad Thai experience and showcases Thai food at its best.

Prices are fair considering it’s recommended in the Michelin Guide. We waited around 15 minutes for a table, but it was absolutely worth it. Our waiter was extremely efficient, funny, and very attentive.

The only thing that could be improved is the timing of the dishes. As a group of four, our meals arrived at different times, which isn’t ideal, especially from a Western dining perspective.

That aside, I’ll definitely come back on my next trip to Bangkok for another dose of their incredible Pad Thai.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexander Cillan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Without exaggeration, one of the best restaurants in Bangkok. And among the top 80 establishments in the entire country. The service is top-notch. We were lucky—we got a table right away without even waiting in line, since we came for lunch, not during peak hours. The prices are very reasonable overall, and for a restaurant of this caliber, they’re actually quite cheap. They greeted us right on the street, escorted us inside to a table, explained the differences between the dishes and gave us an overview of the food along with recommendations, and it was spot on.
The food is incredibly delicious and traditional. They also serve their own homemade drinks—a variety of juices. This is a place you’ll really want to visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Valeria Ya

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had an awesome lunch at Thipsamai Padthai Pratu Phi! I ordered the Pad Thai with shrimp, while my wife went for the Pad Thai with marinated chicken. Both were absolutely delicious. The Thai tea was hands down the best I’ve ever had, and the spring rolls were also fantastic.

The Pad Thai had a slightly sweet taste, which made it even more flavorful. Not sure if it was from added sugar or just the perfect balance of ingredients, but it worked beautifully.

The service was exceptional! The staff greeted and saluted us every time they finished explaining the menu or served a dish. The price was reasonable, and the place felt spacious and not crowded.

Highly recommend this spot for a delicious and satisfying Thai meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rizqan Izari

sample_reviews_en.text: Very touristy place and experience to enjoy Pad Thai. I Had the simple Version with Shrimps together with crab dumplings and Fried chives Rolls. All in all a Wörtheile experience to taste the different Aromas in Thai Cuisine. You start neutral and after bites you add on chilli w vinegar, grounded Peanuts, i dont Like to add sugar. You Mix in sprouts, nibble on the  scallion and the bitter banana sprout. Service IS Well developed to perfection  to improve the process. People Line Up  Here AS Well AS they do at the neighbour Stall from Fei Jay for the crab Omelette. Different Story. Go Here  if you want the Story. Thanks to Noi and her Mebtrice for perfect service and conversation.
sample_reviews_en.author: FD249

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited Thipsamai Pad Thai (Tropi) in Bangkok, one of the city’s oldest and most famous Pad Thai restaurants. As expected, there was a line on arrival, but it moved quickly. Before entering, a staff member hands you the menu and even fills out your order in advance, which keeps everything smooth and organized.

The interior is charming and feels very traditional. The Pad Thai is excellent—many say it’s the best in Bangkok. Even if it isn’t the absolute best, it’s certainly a very good one and worth trying.

What truly stands out is the service. The staff are exceptionally kind and attentive, making the whole experience even more enjoyable.

Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Davide De Luca

restaurants.name: FuFu Taiwanese Shabu Ari
restaurants.address:

ที่อยู่ 133 Alley, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went three times during the Spring Festival! "Fu Fu" is our family's go-to restaurant for the New Year; even the storefront is festive.

We went to this restaurant three times in one week: New Year's Eve, the second day of the Lunar New Year, and the fifth day. Yes, that's how many times we went!

We had a hot pot dinner on New Year's Eve, came back like we were visiting our parents' home on the second day, and had our first hot pot of the year again on the fifth day. The staff all recognize us now.

Why are we so addicted? Fresh ingredients, a wide selection, and incredibly generous desserts—all the ice cream is from top brands, and you can scoop as much as you want. Beef, pork, and seafood are all you can eat; it's comfortable for one person, and lively for the whole family. The Taiwanese hot pot broth is refreshing and not greasy even after eating a lot.

The opening hours remained the same during the Spring Festival, and the atmosphere was as warm as ever. For us, this place is no longer just a hot pot restaurant; it's the first restaurant we think of when we don't know what to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: J Z

sample_reviews_en.text: Disheveled experience was different from the others that I had previously experienced. I was shocked that I had to pay up front before I even enjoyed my meal! Then they sell packages by levels each level gives you more time allotment to enjoy the buffet so the more you pay the more time you get to play! For what I paid the food offerings were very basic I didn't see any upscale proteins available on the menu but if you paid the $1,299 Thai baht, did you see everything they have to offer. The service was very average at best I had to keep flagging someone down to get soup refilled and get another beer and that's what brought my meal to a quick end! The only bright spot was the beer was really cold and if you buy the top tier packages beer is included in the buffet. I would rather have better service at a better price point!
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Duncan Sr

sample_reviews_en.text: Premium Taiwanese buffet shabu @ good location with parking space. Clean and good variety of ingredients. Premium seafood and sliced wagyu beef is available at 988THB net. You can choose 2 soups out of 6 types. Quality of food and service are only at acceptable level. Price is too expensive. Especially if your party larger than 2 people, it simply doesn't worth it.

sample_reviews_en.text: I came because I wanted to eat Häagen-Dazs ice cream. But after trying the shabu-shabu, it was amazing! The ingredients were high-quality, varied, delicious, fresh, and clean. The service was good, and the price was reasonable. I'll definitely come back again.

The kombu broth is fragrant and delicious.
There are many broth options to choose from. One pot, each person gets their own portion; make it yourself, eat it yourself, it's so relaxing.
--
The dipping sauce is delicious. You have to add the spicy miso; it's fragrant with yuzu and has just the right amount of spiciness -- it's great for cutting through the richness.
--
There are always great promotions.
Whenever I want shabu-shabu, I never miss this restaurant! 🎉

sample_reviews_th.text:
Keng Ji Herbal Tea

คั้นกี่น้ำเต้าทอง (พ.ศ. 2444)
Cute gourd bottle
Refreshing and delicious
Bought it for digestion and anti-inflammation
Not bitter at all
The seller is very thoughtful, even indicating whether it's sweet or bitter
Highly recommend! 👍
sample_reviews_th.author: HsuanJuHuang黃小飄

sample_reviews_en.text: Kan Kee is the shop’s name on sign. This 1 cavern shop run business since B.E.2444(A.D.1901)which medical treatment and medicine are limited and obsolete. People in China town and vicinity help themselves to get rid of internal heat or apthous ulcer and recovery back to normal health by drinking herb water from this shop.Blister inside mouth and nose is so tormented. The small cups of herb water are place untidy in front of a huge pot. The clients take small cups of herb water themselves or handed by his friends nearby or the shop’s worker, it has been like culture of service for a long time, some clients who know the price will place the money on the cup seated. Foreigners tourists know this shop , I met many of them come to visit this shop and try them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Payong Chatwiroon

sample_reviews_en.text: Kan Kee Nam Tao Thong (Nam Tao Thong, a legendary 124-year-old bitter herbal tea shop, open since 1901). This was my first time here. They have a huge menu, not just bitter herbal tea. I ordered a hot bitter herbal tea to try. Oh my god, I couldn't handle it! It was so incredibly bitter, the bitterness lingered on my tongue. It brought back childhood memories. I didn't want to get sick back then! Every sip was torture 😂 But there were so many people buying it. The owner said that drinking it hot helps to expel phlegm. So, for another drink, I ordered a tamarind slushy to cleanse my palate. 55555 It was delicious! I loved it. It was sour and sweet, but not overly sweet. Very refreshing. I'll definitely come back for the tamarind slushy next time! 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: จมูกพาไป

sample_reviews_en.text: New location :))) I have been drinking the herb drink from this shop since I was very young little. This year they have moved to the new location the drink still flavorful with a lot of product development. Now they have ice   Slurpee to offer and also have ice cream and candy :))) it’s one of the place where you can come and enjoy herbal drink :)) this is the place :)))) enjoy 😉 it’s one of china town of iconic place to visit :))
sample_reviews_en.author: naphak phiphatweerawat

sample_reviews_en.text: Living legend of Chinese herbal drink. Established in 1901, Nam tao thong (golden squash) has served customers variety of traditional Chinese herbal beverage. Despite 2 World Wars and many econimic crises, this legendary beverage shop stands strong to offer the best product to thw market. Nowadays it embraces the 21st century world with tradition and it makes Nam tao thong unique. Recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nadharatch Ounlert

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chrysanthemum Tea Shop
The menu offers options in glasses, bottles, and as shaved ice.

Personally, I regret they don't have iced chrysanthemum tea, only hot. It's 20 baht per glass. The taste is good, but in this hot weather, it's not exactly refreshing.

Bottled versions are priced at 30 baht and 60 baht.

The shop only accepts cash payments (no scan-to-pay).
sample_reviews_en.author: Supawut Saengrassamee

sample_reviews_en.text: Highly recommend this herbal drink shop since 1901, they have different flavours for different benefits i tried all the flavours there was 1 i really liked (Light green one) which gave instant relief for my chesty cough & phlegm but two of the other flavours is very very bitter and hard to drink 😅 buy 10 free 1 keep in your fridge 👍👍👍 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Jimmy Ho

sample_reviews_en.text:
The gotu kola juice is absolutely delicious! It's slightly sweet, just the way I like it.

The less sweet, slightly bitter version is easier to drink and has many health benefits.

The bottle is beautiful. It's expensive, but the quality and legendary status are worth the price.

The bottling area inside the shop is very clean and tidy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Norah S

restaurants.name: Go-Ang Kaomunkai Pratunam
restaurants.address:

962 Phetchaburi Rd, Makkasan, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
[Exquisite Khao Man Gai. 50B per serving!!!]
★5

This was the best Khao Man Gai I've ever had!

And it was so cheap at 50B per serving I almost cried.

I couldn't help but order seconds.

The meat was plump and juicy. The rice was delicious on its own. It was even better with the sauce provided. I could eat this Khao Man Gai every day.

The staff were all very kind, making for a great experience.

The restaurant has plenty of seating, and I was seated without waiting. It only took a few minutes from ordering to being served. The quick service was a big plus.

Incidentally, I entered without knowing it was the pink Khao Man Gai restaurant that's a regular in the Michelin Bib Gourmand.

Finding out later was a satisfying confirmation.

This is a restaurant I definitely want to visit again when I come to Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nyo Suke

sample_reviews_en.text:
The new place, not too far away is much comfortable as it’s with aircon.

Tried a chicken rice spot in Bangkok and it was a solid experience. The rice uses jasmine rice cooked in chicken broth, giving it that rich, fragrant flavor—very similar to Hainanese chicken rice you’d find in Malaysia or Singapore.

The chicken itself was smooth and tender, easily one of the better versions I’ve had in Bangkok. One key difference, though, is that they serve fried chicken instead of the usual roasted or poached style common in Malaysia and Singapore.

Overall, definitely worth checking out if you’re in Bangkok. That said, I’ve personally had even better versions in Malaysia, Singapore, and Indonesia—but this one still stands out locally.
sample_reviews_en.author: EdT

sample_reviews_en.text: This old and established Hainanese chicken rice shop in the Pratunam area has been a fixture for a long time. They offer a variety of options, including regular Hainanese chicken rice, minced chicken rice, offal rice, roasted pork, and several soup bases such as bone broth, bitter melon broth, and duck broth. The minced chicken is firm and flavorful, the rice is soft, and the dipping sauce is rich and delicious – you can ask for unlimited refills! They also generously provide sweet soy sauce on the table. It's a must-visit for anyone passing by when they're hungry. You're guaranteed a delicious and authentic Hainanese chicken rice experience. Come on in!
sample_reviews_en.author: Naphat Supaparkorn

sample_reviews_en.text: I just experienced the service. When we arrived with young children, the manager seemed unhappy and made us sit outside instead of inside where there was a fan. The chicken feet soup was delicious, the drinks were good, but the chicken rice was really not like Hainanese chicken rice; it was very dry, and the sauce was different and not tasty. The service was poor, only the staff were quick to greet and dismiss customers. I had young children and asked the manager to plug in a small fan for the children, but they refused, even though there were outlets and it didn't affect the business.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kieu Linh Dang

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were lucky that our wait was short. Original location, we wanted to go to the Branch 2 but our Taxi dropped us off here.

The service was EXCELLENT taking ino consideration that this is a not a fine dining area. Food was good.

Really loved the Hainanese Rice and Chilli sauce. However IMHO, the chicken wasn't good enough. But I can understand why most would rate this 5 stars.

To be fair, the chicken was better than most places. It's just not 5 stars great for me...

LOVED the Bitter Gourd soup and the normal soup that's provided. Credit must be given for those.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adrian Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Over the course of a few days, I tried several famous chicken rice restaurants in Singapore and compared them.

This place is definitely a close competitor. The chili sauce here was delicious and added a nice kick. If I had to choose just one, though, I would give the win to Singapore. The rice here was especially juicy and flavorful.

That said, this restaurant was clean and had a much larger menu with plenty of options. They also serve Taiwanese douhua, which was delicious. Overall, a very good place to try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jikhrde nkg

sample_reviews_en.text:
I finally made it to the "Pink Khao Man Gai" I'd been wanting to try!!

I can't believe I could eat Khao Man Gai of this quality for only 50 baht...! The chicken, the rice, the sauce—everything was delicious, and I was impressed from the very first bite.

And best of all, it was so delicious that the feeling lingered long after I finished eating! 🥹✨

Cheap, delicious, and completely satisfying!! This is a place you absolutely must try if you're in Bangkok! 🇹🇭 I'll definitely go again!
sample_reviews_en.author: 林春花

sample_reviews_en.text: A classic spot in Pratunam with a very authentic, old-school atmosphere. The Hainanese chicken rice was simple but tasty, with tender chicken and flavorful rice. We also tried the braised pork and omelet, which were enjoyable and good for sharing. Prices are very reasonable, especially for such a well-known Michelin Bib Gourmand place. The restaurant can feel crowded and quite basic, but that is part of its local charm. Definitely worth trying when visiting Pratunam.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mudofir Hadi

restaurants.name: Kenshin Izakaya Asok
restaurants.address:

155 Asok Montri Rd, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
First visit with friends gathering group.
It was full of customers on Saturday evening, but we made a reservation in advance and could get a table on the 3rd floor.

This is a place where you can order both meals and drinks.
The menu is varied, delicious and reasonably priced. (Some menus were just okay :)
The interior and atmosphere is like a Japanese local pub. So, it was okay we could talk and laugh comfortably.

The most impressive thing was the service of staffs.  We were so impressed with the service and gave even more tips to staffs.

If you are looking for a Japanese pub with a relaxed & local atmosphere in Asok, I highly recommend this place na krup.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amphawa Choi Family

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stumbled upon this cozy two/three-storey izakaya in Bangkok—great spot to unwind. They offer beers in sizes from S to XL with some interesting flavors!

Not a fan of the Sakura beer, but the passionfruit one was enjoyable. The standout was the Tokyo Snow Popcorn beer—surprisingly smooth, with a strong popcorn aroma but not sweet at all. Easy to drink and highly recommended (thanks to the staff’s suggestion~).

Kani Miso Yaki was delicious, especially paired with rice and seaweed.

From what I saw, the sashimi looked fresh, and they also serve udon with quail egg.

Overall, a nice chill spot that’s worth checking out if you’re nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amelie Kam

sample_reviews_en.text: Kenshin Izakaya Asok, located 1.5 km. from Asok BTS Station or Sukhumvit MRT Station on Asok Road near Asok 1 Lane, was a typical casual Japanese restaurant - Izakaya . It was one of the very first Izakaya  restaurants in Sukhumvit area where many Japanese experts lived. It served truly authentic casual Japanese dishes which got along well with beers, sake and other alcoholic drinks. Its dining area  was like sitting in one of Izakaka restaurants in Japan. Its draft beers were so good and refreshing. Its restroom was set on its 2nd floor where there was an additional dining area opened when its 1st floor seating area was crowded.
sample_reviews_en.author: Itt Pamarapa

sample_reviews_en.text:
The place had good vibes and a nice interior — it’s great for setting the mood.
However, compared to other izakayas nearby, the service wasn’t very good. It felt like the staff hadn’t received proper service training.
Some of the plates were chipped, which was disappointing. In Japanese cuisine, tableware is an important part of the experience, so serving food on broken dishes felt careless.
The food was just okay, nothing special.
I ordered a large highball, but it didn’t taste like Suntory whisky at all. It would be much better if they added the proper amount of whisky.
sample_reviews_en.author: Food & Travel lover

sample_reviews_en.text:
It could have been a 5-star given the good food and vibe, and midway through my meal I was asked to change seat to make way for a larger group. Not a big deal, but it certainly wasn’t pleasant to have to shift your things and yourself.

The flavoured beers had a sweeter note to them, and the back to 90s was not too bad a choice. It was both light and refreshing. The Kyoto graph cocktail on the other hand tasted just like carbonated drink, without a tinge of alcohol.

Despite being indoor, I had mosquitoes flying around and it was irritating to have to deal with them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ma tt

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of my favorite izakayas in Bangkok! The atmosphere is lively. The food was fresh, delicious, and reasonably priced, with plenty of options to choose from. The sashimi was fresh, the grilled skewers were perfectly cooked, and the drinks paired really well with the meal.

The staff were friendly and attentive, making the whole dining experience enjoyable. Whether you're coming for dinner with friends or just looking for a great place to unwind after work, Kenshin Izakaya Asok is definitely worth a visit. Will be back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Brian 555

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were lovely and quite friendly, but they often missed writing down the entire order. It's the best place for a company party because it's all-you-can-eat. The restaurant has two floors with comfortable seating and good restrooms with bidets. However, the oysters that day weren't great, so I had to use the restroom for a bit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Javachip

sample_reviews_en.text: Very disappointing experience. 👎👎 The waitress took our order incorrectly and brought out the wrong dish. When we pointed out the mistake, she responded with a rude attitude and didn’t own up to her mistake. We’ve dined at other Kenshin branches and have never experienced smth like this. Definitely won’t be coming back for sure …
sample_reviews_en.author: Goku Saiyan

restaurants.name: Je Ju Noodle
restaurants.address:

1313 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
This place is well known for their fishball and yen ta four. What makes it special is that the vegetable is very fresh, the fishball has really soft texture, the soup is delicious, and the noodles are just right. I ordered mine with lum yai juice (น้ำลำไย) which wasn't too sweet but had the right amount of sweetness. They also offer other manus as well as ice cream, which has various toppings.

This place only accepts cash. Cash ONLY. Can not pay with QR code or promptpay. Good thing I had some 100baht bills in my wallet.

The restaurants around this area all have limited parking. You have to park along the side of the road (free), or go to park at the Sena mall on the opposite side (not free).
sample_reviews_th.author: MIMI EKSA

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was walking by this store that was packed with locals eating noodles and ice cream. It was hot out so I was looking at the coconut ice cream. The boss lady recommend the coconut ice cream with egg and toppings, sticky rice and creamed corn. I also added the roasted peanuts. I was skeptical about the creamed corn but the salty and sweetness turned out to work well with the ice cream. The egg inside was also a nice surprise. The frozen yolk pieces added additional different texture and tasted great.

The people around me look like they really enjoyed their noodles so I got a bowl of noodles too. I ordered the Tom yum with egg noodles. Noodles were cooked well and there were plenty of toppings inside of this bowl including fish ball, fish cake, fried wonton wrapper, tofu, dumpling and a fried rice ball. The Tom yum was not very spicy but still very satisfying.

Both items ended up costing (60 + 70) 130baht though a person wrote it up in front of me so I am not sure which is which. For this price, this meal was a big win.

Coconut ice cream with raw egg: 9.5/10
Egg noodle with Tom yum soup: 7.5/10
sample_reviews_en.author: Yu-Ting

sample_reviews_en.text:
If I could give 10 stars, I would! I always stay at the Ibis around the corner and sat down at this restaurant some years ago by coincidence because I saw that they had ice cream, it was a very hot day and it was around the corner from the hotel. You can choose different toppings but the home made ice cream itself is already amazing.
Over time I’ve also tried other dishes and have eaten their amazing noodles. Spicy, rich broth, noodles at your choice and tasteful fish balls, everything is perfect.
The idea that I have to miss the noodles and ice cream for the coming year makes me already sad. When I’m in town, I come here at least once a day and every time it’s such a joy to sit and eat here.
The food is amazing, the staff are so incredibly friendly and the service is impeccable.
Really really really worth a visit when you’re in Bangkok and I can’t wait to come back
sample_reviews_en.author: Marie-Christine Rynja

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Noodle Shop Worth Coming Back For

This isn't just a noodle shop; it's a full experience! I've been back multiple times, not just for the great food, but for the free tea that they offer. It’s a small detail that really makes a difference.

The noodles here are a cut above the rest. And for a truly amazing dessert, you have to try their coconut milk ice cream! Make it extraordinary by adding the optional yolk for an extra 10 THB—it’s a game-changer.

A few tips before you go:

Bring cash: They don't accept cards or any scan-to-pay services, so be sure to hit the ATM first.

Parking is a challenge: You'll need to be lucky to find a spot right in front. Be prepared to park on the street and walk, but be careful of the red and white striped curbs, which mean no parking.

Overall, it's a fantastic spot for a delicious meal with a little something extra.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kunlasead Sritanyarat (Nic)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an almost 30-year-old restaurant; I've been eating here since it was 25 baht a bowl back in high school. I wish they'd add crispy squid to their Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup). The taste isn't amazing, but it's easy to eat and the flavors are okay. They have a variety of meatballs. The regular size is 65 baht, but the one in the picture is the special, which is 75 baht – a bit expensive. The ice cream is delicious, but it melts very quickly. The owner, Auntie Ju, is friendly. The restaurant only accepts cash, no transfers. The place feels a bit cramped with low ceilings and crowded tables, but it's well-lit and has plenty of fans. The dry noodle soup is delicious.
I ate alone for over 200 baht. If the cone had been locked, I would have gotten a 1000 baht bowl of noodles!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chon Vekin

sample_reviews_en.text: Je Ju's Noodle Shop serves clear broth noodles with fish balls and plenty of toppings. They also have a delicious, long-standing Yen Ta Fo (pink noodle soup) recipe that has been around for decades. Je Ju herself serves the customers, providing excellent service, including helping with parking and greeting them with a warm smile. The shop also offers coconut milk and lod chong (Thai dessert) ice cream, as well as egg ice cream. All the ice cream is delicious – authentic Thai flavors, especially the coconut milk. The shop is located on Charoen Nakhon Road. If you're in the area, be sure to try Je Ju's noodles! It's another hidden gem in Charoen Nakhon. There's parking behind the shop; the parking fee can be used as a discount towards your noodle bill.
sample_reviews_en.author: Streetfood Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The street food here have been doing for many years.

Food: The noodles really nice and simple Chinese style. Fresh ingredients and suitable with the price paying. The most incredible menu is dessert. The ice-cream really unique tastes with fresh eggs and local topping. I was enjoying the ice-cream so much with fresh ingredients and topping. I was enjoying the big caps and standard caps with corn soups on top. That is really nice and made me big smile indeed.

Service: The local service Thais style with big smiles all the time. After I was called foe bills and she realized that how many cups I was eating she laughed. 😃

Location: on the main street and find your parking space in advance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwanchai Quinzy Yokto

sample_reviews_en.text:
Parking is difficult; you have to park in front of the shop, causing traffic jams.
This has been going on for a while.

The noodles and ice cream are delicious.
The prices have gone up, which is understandable.

You have to be a bit of a customer to enjoy the food in the style of an old-school restaurant.

Recommendation:
The service needs improvement. The older staff members need to be more aware and not let themselves become rude to customers.

Tables that aren't meant for people to sit at should be removed.
They shouldn't just set up tables on the sidewalk and tell people not to sit there. The staff themselves even move tables to sit outside the shop, obstructing traffic.
sample_reviews_en.author: A J

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือวิศวะ
restaurants.address:

Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Food quality was really good. Very well prepared by the kitchen. Unfortunately, service staff didn't seem motivated enough. The first 2 dishes were served fast enough, but some how, had to wait half an hour for subsequent dishes to be served. The restaurant wasn't fully packed. While having the desserts, the finished dishes were all still on the table, no attempt to clear the table were made, until towards the finishing of our dessert, did one ONE staff noticed and quickly cleared the table. Would have been a 5 stars dining experience if the service staff were more attentive, and suspect there was a misunderstanding in the order, which made unnecessary waiting in between dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: eric tham

sample_reviews_en.text: SooSiam is a place to go for traditional Thai food. There are a lot varieties of food to choose from. The price is very reasonable. The place is very clean and a lot of seats to sit down and eat. But there is no place  is perfect. I found the place is lacked of trash cans and paper towels to wipe your hands. The paper towel that provided was so flimsy and it's not even enough to your hands with. Other than those two things, the place was awesome. Bring your own paper towel or knap kin of you want to keep yourself clean. If you ever out and about in the area, don't forget to stop and check it out. I hope like it and good luck.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steven Marshall

sample_reviews_en.text:
From the 10 Baht boat ride to Icon Siam, it was amazing. A cool breeze blowing through the boat took some of the 34°Celcius heat away.
1st step inside this incredible mall takes your breath away. Shops are shops, no matter where you go. But how many shops have canals, fountains, life size elephants and other awesome attractions. The massive range of shops is interlaced with vendors selling drinks, hot and cold, food of all kinds, ice creams etc. There really is something for everyone here, even if you just visit without buying anything.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brian Smith

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! I always eat at this restaurant in Suk Siam, I always go to Icon Siam because when I think of something easy to eat, tasty, and affordable, it has to be this place. I used to like it because the taste was good without needing any extra seasoning, but lately the morning glory has been very old, cut down to the roots, and the strands are mushy. The staff are also abrupt. I wanted to leave this comment because I want to go back and eat there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayathorn Ngampraphaphorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the high end version Thai Food market located in Icon Siam.
You can find most of the popular thai food and delicacies in this place from shakes, smoothies, fruits, pad thai, seafoods, exotic food and a whole lot more.
Prices are higher compared to non mall based street food markets though.
After the great gastronomic experience, burn the calories by shopping in the numerous high end stores or outlets in this Icon Siam mall.
A must see when in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warly Ybanez

sample_reviews_en.text: Went to eat at the Future Park branch. There were 2 of us. We each ordered a bowl of noodles and wanted to try the omelet, so we ordered it. But we were already full from the noodles and couldn't handle the omelet, so we told the staff to wrap it up to take home. The staff sighed and said, "Hey, this isn't a buffet! You have to pay to eat this." They had very bad manners and the taste was a bit sour this time. I'm done with this place. I'm really fed up.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jem Pate

sample_reviews_en.text: This is like a culinary heaven for street food enthusiasts. There are countless stalls serving different menus ranging from veggies to crocodile meat. The food is good but the place was so packed and crowded it became so hard to navigate through and empty seats are rare and almost none available. Halal food was also very rare so you can overspent your time here if you only looking for halal food. Overall great atmosphere, good food, clean toilets.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tamado Sitohang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Vibrant, beautiful,gives you the feel of real Thailand. You can get the feel of a floating market with great food here. Loved the Thai products they were selling. It is located in the ground floor of the IconSiam.
Pro tip: Look for the white dragon elevator and go upstairs, the view from there is breathtaking.
Also look for spots where you can sit and take pictures in the boats designed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Indrani Mukherji

restaurants.name: Rosewood Bangkok
restaurants.address:

1041/38 Phloen Chit Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
All around an superb hotel for a family of 4 staying for vacation. We were here for 3 nights with young kids (6 yr & 6 mth old) and they provided full amenities for the little ones but also left enough care for the parents. We found the service to be wonderful and personal without being intrusive, little details like remembering our room number during breakfast was a nice touch. Through Amex FHR we were upgraded to a larger room on a higher floor - and we were able to fully take advantage of the dining outlets for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Notably, breakfast was brilliantly executed - a combination of smaller buffet + a la carte items proved to be a winning formula and you feel a full sense of pride from their culinary team. We dined at the Chinese restaurant as well and found the food to be of very high quality.

Though not a 'family-oriented' hotel (i.e. no kids club, and the style of hotel is clearly for more discerning adults) - we really enjoyed the hotel pool and health club (where they offered complimentary activities such as yoga and muay thai, which we signed up a a family and was a ton of fun).

I hope I will be able to find time to visit this Rosewood property again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eugene Chang

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A Standout Stay in the Heart of Bangkok Rosewood Bangkok — Highly Recommended

From the moment you arrive, Rosewood Bangkok makes an impression. The location is excellent — centrally situated and easy to get around the city from, whether you’re heading to shopping, dining, or cultural landmarks.

Breakfast was a genuine highlight. The spread is generous and well-executed, with enough variety to satisfy both Asian and Western palates. It’s the kind of morning meal that sets a positive tone for the rest of the day.

Service throughout the stay was warm and attentive without being intrusive — the staff strike a nice balance that you don’t always find, even at this level of hotel.

If there’s one area for improvement, it would be the poolside seating. The number of loungers feels a bit limited, especially during busier hours, and it can be tricky to secure a spot. A minor inconvenience in an otherwise seamless experience.

Overall, Rosewood Bangkok delivers on its promise of luxury. The combination of prime location, excellent breakfast, and genuinely good service makes it easy to recommend without hesitation. Would absolutely return.
sample_reviews_en.author: C Victor

sample_reviews_en.text:
Average start, impeccable finish. In a city where 5 star hotels can be $100 or less a night, charging 4-5 times that should really stand out, and Rosewood Bangkok does.

Early check-in and room upgrade through American Express FHR was not honoured as the hotel was allegedly full, however the level of service is excellent. From the lobby staff learning your name, to the pool ladies instantly bringing chilled water and watermelon shots when you sit on a lounger, you will be treated very well here. The breakfast was truly world-class: and the staff encourage you to have multiple courses! Definitely book a treatment at the relaxing spa on the 6th floor.

Small cons: traffic nearby is crazy. The Phloen Chit x Wireless junction means anyone coming from the airport will be stuck up to 30 mins just waiting to turn right onto the road where the hotel is. This also results in some traffic noise, unless you’re on a high floor. Secondly, neither the pool nor shallow “hot tub” style area is heated? That is *very* strange given much cheaper hotels have this Bangkok.

The pros are far stronger, and I’d happily return! 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Arun A

sample_reviews_en.text: I enjoyed a teapot in the lobby bar.  Initially the hotel’s private skywalk entrance was a positive welcome, and a thoughtful ease of access, only to be amplified by its uplifting and thought provoking artwork exhibition which appeared to me of juxtaposed pattern and colour upon contemporary orientalist pop-art themes expressing narratives of music, textile, and the divine femininity !  The lobby lounge bar was a cooler theme, which offers a choice of semi-privatized or open seating via a quad of curved sculptural dividers.  The proportions of the furniture in the actual desk area are superbly elegant. I would like one for a sophisticated home !  A contrast of white art against deep rich timber wall cladding are a touch of the design ingenuity.  The tea itself seemed to multiply and last long, which is a sign of very good tea! Ultimately and most importantly, the staff made the experience most warm and friendly and connected.   Hopefully I’ll have a chance to stay for longer next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrick MacPherson

sample_reviews_en.text:
Our stay at Rosewood Bangkok was nothing short of exceptional. From the moment we arrived, the level of service, courtesy, and attention to detail was truly world-class.

The rooms are stunning—beautifully designed, immaculate, and incredibly comfortable, with every detail thoughtfully considered. Housekeeping was flawless, and the little touches throughout the room made the stay feel both luxurious and personal.

The staff deserves special recognition. Every interaction was warm, professional, and genuinely attentive without ever feeling intrusive. You can feel that hospitality here is not just a standard, but a culture.

The restaurants were outstanding—excellent food quality, presentation, and service across the board. Every meal felt like a fine-dining experience.

Rosewood Bangkok sets the benchmark for luxury hospitality. An unforgettable experience, and without question a hotel we would gladly return to. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: k Escribano

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stayed at Rosewood Bangkok for four nights and had a great experience overall. The hotel sent a pre arrival check in survey, which made the arrival process smooth and saved time.

We booked through FHR, received a good deal, and were pleasantly upgraded to a higher room category. Since our checkout was at 6 a.m., the team kindly arranged a packed breakfast with sandwiches, pastries, fruits, and juices of our choice, which was a thoughtful touch.

The rooms were modern and simple, with neutral tones throughout. We stayed on the 24th floor and had a great view.

Breakfast at the hotel was phenomenal. There were dedicated counters for breads and salads, and most dishes were served à la carte. The selection was extensive, including a wide variety of options and an excellent range of Thai dishes.

A comfortable, well run hotel with attentive service and highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiten Jetwani

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently stayed at the Rosewood Bangkok.They allowed me to check in early at 10am although the usual check in time was 3pm.Not only that but they also upgraded my room for free.

I was greeted by staff by the moment i stepped into hotel grounds.All the staff were really friendly and eager to help.Having the link bridge to the BTS station was also a plus point

They also allowed me to have a late check out at 2pm as my flight to depart was delayed.

The only thing that I could complain about is probably the breakfast which had a wide variety in the ala carte menu but not so much in the buffet section.The eggs benedicts that I had was abit underwhelming in taste.Lastly the pool wasnt that impressive but i dont swim so all good there.

Will definitely come back next time .Thanks to all the staff at Rosewood Bangkok it was wonderful staying with you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ben Yeong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hands down the best hotel I have ever stayed at in Bangkok, and one of the best hotel experiences I’ve ever had internationally.  Heard amazing things about Rosewood and decided to venture away from my usual Marriott stays to check it out. Was so glad I did. From start to finish the service was absolutely incredible. Perfect example, on one night I came back to the room after being out all day and saw a tea set with a handwritten note. They noticed that I’d been out all day and took the initiative to have a warm beverage waiting for me when I came back that evening.

All the food here was incredible. Ended up dining here twice for dinner in addition to breakfast each morning as the food was so good. Highly recommend and will definitely be staying here anytime I’m back in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Schreiber

restaurants.name: Charmgang
restaurants.address:

14 ซ. เจริญกรุง 35 Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stop reading and book a table immediately!

This is the best meal I have eaten in Thailand. This place is an awesome blend of delicious food in a relaxed setting.

The vibe is great, the restaurant had a real buzz about it and the staff were all smiling, and that is always a huge positive!

Too many places are doing bad versions of "elevated thai food" and falling short. Charmgang on the other hand does it perfectly. Exceptional flavor throughout, everything was bright and well balanced, I loved everything we ordered. Great use of spice and smoke.

We started with duck wafers which were crispy and super tasty. Scallop topped cupcakes were fun and delicious and the fish bite wrapped in betel leaf was a slap in the face with huge flavors.

We moved on to the pork jowl salad which tasted like the best glazed ham! And we had the smoked fish curry which was inspired. So so tasty.

I can't reccomend this place highly enough. Ive had some really dissapoiting Michelin starred tasting menus in Bangkok on this trip, and charmgang was such a refreshing change. Exceptional!!!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Danny Walker

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent service and recommendation from staff.

Visited this Michelin restaurant for dinner and our taste buds approved unanimously on both flavours and the vibes of the restaurant.

Hidden in a very tiny little back end road housed Charmgang, I heard they have a sister restaurant opening up soon.

But we love our culinary journey there, everything was so fresh and spiced to perfection, the duck wafer was fantastic appetizer to start and the grill steak skewers were so tasty,l with the condiments provided.

Drinks were fantastic with some local cocktails to pick from.

Pork jowl salad with grilled and tender pork slices and fresh crunch of salad greens

Curry was on point with giant tiger prawns and fragrant red curry gravy and goes well with multiple servings of rice so you can tell it was great.

Rounded up with a coconut dessert that make us a very happy customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lorelai D

sample_reviews_en.text:
Charmgang is one of the best meals we've had in Bangkok. Every dish felt considered without being fussy, and the flavors were bold in exactly the right ways. The scallops on coconut cupcakes were a standout starter, a clever, unexpected pairing that set the tone for the rest of the meal. The pork jowl and sour mango salad brought a great balance of richness and acidity, while the smoked duck wafers were craveable and full of depth.

The panang curry with braised beef cheek was the highlight of the night. Rich, deeply spiced, and the beef cheek was melt-in-your-mouth tender. It's the kind of dish that makes you understand why this place has such a strong reputation.

We'd go back in a heartbeat and would recommend Charmgang to anyone looking for a memorable meal in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zachary Henry-Litchliter

sample_reviews_en.text:
Charmgang BKK never disappoints. 🇹🇭🔥

Been coming back for the past 3 years, and the food has remained consistently amazing. The newly renovated space feels fresh and polished, though I have to admit, I still miss the character and charm of the old garage-style setting.

The real star, as always, is the food. The pork jowl with betel leaf & mango and beef cheek curry are absolute standouts; bold, deeply flavourful and beautifully balanced. Other dishes are delectable too.
Charmgang really understands how to layer spices and seasonings without overwhelming the palate.

Three years on and still a must-go whenever I’m in Bangkok. Absolutely deserving of its Michelin recognition.

And yes, service by staff was absolutely delightful too.

Come hungry. Leave happy. Kudos.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hendra Su

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had dinner at the Charmgang pop up which is located in a fantastic old building. It really added to the atmosphere even though it is a temporary location.
Fantastic service from all the staff. Great knowledge of the food and wine menus.
We started with the Duck wafers and the Betel leaf wrapped fish box of the day. Both had incredible flavour and texture. We moved onto the Duck confit with seasonal fruits. This is probably one of the most outstanding duck dishes on the planet! The kingfish with pennywort was next, but a little too spicy for me, although my friends enjoyed it.
Overall, Charmgang is an absolute must-visit. I am looking forward to visiting when the move into their new premises  —in the meantime, don't miss it where ever it is!
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrew Oldfield

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tucked away in a small alley off Charoenkrung 35, Charmgang is best reached by taxi or ride-hailing—it’s definitely more convenient than trying to find parking yourself. The restaurant occupies a three-unit shophouse, and you’ll recognize it instantly as a lively dining spot.

The place is usually buzzing with people, so making a reservation in advance is highly recommended.

The menu offers a wide variety of Thai dishes, reimagined with a modern twist that reflects the restaurant’s unique culinary concept.

On this visit, I tried several dishes (as shown in the photos), pairing them with both white and red wine—both complemented the food beautifully.

If you ever get the chance, this is definitely a place worth trying at least once.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kritsada

sample_reviews_en.text: Cosy, casual contemporary Thai eatery off a side alley in Bangkok’s old Chinatown area. The food, served out of an open kitchen, is justifiably good and a refreshing modern take on traditional Thai and Thai street food. The open kitchen takes center stage, with ingredients spread out enticingly for all to admire and inspire curiosity, which the staff gladly indulge. The not over-long menu (always a good sign) packs bold, punchy flavours. The kingfish fillet in yellow curry went down well, as did the pork jowl salad, the beef cheek curry, the crab omelette and the stir-fried veg (not as boring as it sounds). Desserts also didn’t fail to please - we liked the pumpkin “pancake” with syrupy pumpkin slivers. Warm, attentive service.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Closet Tenor

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall it's a good experience, and the restaurant is worth a visit. It's the right balance for food-lovers without having to go to a fine dining. Menu is not extensive, but well curated, and portions are good.
Wagyu curry (many reviews mention it) is certainly the best dish we had there: complex, very tender, a little salty but expected. Crab omelette is fluffy, good, but could use more garnish, flavors and presentation. The rest of the dishes present well.
Could have easily give it a 5 stars rating except a few things: Drinks are way overpriced as you were in a high-end resort bar or club. Service was good overall, but it feels like they want to rush you out as fast as possible.
This said, we're happy with it.
sample_reviews_en.author: F

restaurants.name: Yong Seng Lee
restaurants.address:

1 Phraeng Nara Rd, San Chao Pho Sua, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant serves traditional Hainanese-style sukiyaki with thin noodles, topped with a fried egg. The sukiyaki dipping sauce is delicious, and the pork is tender, although I personally found it a little too salty.

The Tai Tia meatballs are a recommended dish; they're a pork and shrimp mixture. The texture is hard to describe, but it depends on personal preference.

The traditional basil pork is made with the same pork used in the sukiyaki, so it was a bit too salty. The basil flavor might be too traditional for my liking; I prefer modern versions.

The restaurant has a nice retro atmosphere. The staff are helpful in recommending dishes and provide excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirisorn Popradit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Traditional Hainanese Sukiyaki
"Yong Seng Lee Restaurant will be open for the last time tomorrow, the 13th, before closing for renovations for 3 months.
This is a family recipe from Hainanese Chinese families that has been open for over 90 years. This restaurant uses thin rice noodles in its sukiyaki. We ordered the "Go Mai" sukiyaki, with everything – chicken, pork, shrimp – topped with a fried egg. It's a dry version for 120 baht. We also ordered the soup version with pork for 60 baht. For snacks, we had deep-fried pork and shrimp meatballs for 60 baht. Open from 09:00-15:30, closed on Sundays."
sample_reviews_en.author: Vit

sample_reviews_en.text: This area is a castle town surrounding the royal palace and is a treasure trove of delicious, long-established restaurants. This restaurant is one of them. I'm not entirely sure what the noodle dish category "Ski" is, but it's a stir-fried noodle dish with egg. Actually, what was particularly delicious was the meatballs on the side menu. You can see the royal palace buildings across the street, which adds to the atmosphere. The staff are also business-minded and attentive, so it's easy for non-locals to use as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: 天羽庸子

sample_reviews_en.text: This old restaurant behind the Ministry of Defence serves delicious traditional sukiyaki, especially the thin noodles tossed with runny egg yolk. You can choose between pork, chicken, or beef. For appetizers, the fried meatballs are recommended. They also have rice dishes like basil chicken rice. With the younger generation taking over, the menu has been creatively redesigned, and the service, including drinks, is now fully integrated. It's a one-stop shop for everything you need. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Inthira Vittayasomboon

sample_reviews_en.text: We had the glass noodles in soup, which is a common dish, but the restaurant’s own recipe made it really good. The staff were very attentive. It was nice that they asked if we had been there before, introduced the menu, and gave us recommendations. That’s something you don’t often experience in restaurants in Thailand. The menu also has English translations along with pictures of the dish, and the staff can speak English.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ruchirada Chunlawon

sample_reviews_en.text: Both the dry and soup-based sukiyaki were delicious. The taste was unlike any other I've ever had. The watermelon smoothie was delicious, sweet, refreshing, and perfect for cooling down. The owner was attentive, provided excellent service, and was very polite. I will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gunchaned Patthiponlakon

sample_reviews_en.text: Truly delicious meal and well worth its good reviews. Came here for breakfast/brunch and got the glass noodles with pork. The sauce and flavors were truly impeccable - it wasn’t too heavy but also filled me up. I also got the mango smoothie with was very fresh and delicious as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna Gleason

sample_reviews_en.text:
I highly recommend this place for noodles lovers. The food is absolutely delicious, I tried the Go Mai stir fried homemade suki chicken. It was amazing. The staff is also very friendly and making sure everything is going well
Thank you to the team !
sample_reviews_en.author: Anaïs Millet

restaurants.name: King Seafood​
restaurants.address:

94 หมู่ที่ 10 Beach Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The set, which includes the four dishes pictured, rice, and water, cost just under 5,000 yen. We were able to choose one dish from group A, one from group B, and two from group C.
The portion was more than enough for two people. We had choices like crab, shrimp, and fish. Everything we chose was delicious. However, the scallop salad was incredibly spicy (from the chili peppers). When I ate the chili pepper, it felt like my throat was on fire and I even had tears in my eyes. If you can't handle spicy food, it's best not to order it. The sunset atmosphere is very nice.
I had paid in advance at Clock, but I was billed again. I explained the situation and ended up paying only for the drinks, but this is a common occurrence in Thailand. Be careful when paying.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mrたぬ吉

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were given a table right by the water, which we found particularly pleasant. Unfortunately, a large group was seated just behind us shortly afterward, which somewhat disrupted the tranquility. Fortunately, the service remained extremely friendly and genuinely welcoming throughout the evening, which made up for a lot.

We ordered à la carte, thinking there would be a buffet, but that turned out not to be the case. The food was simple but very tasty: delicious lobster, tiger prawns, and shrimp cakes, which we enjoyed every bite of.

The prices are higher than you're usually used to in Thailand, but that's partly due to the beautiful view, which, of course, comes at a premium.
sample_reviews_en.author: natasha dalle

sample_reviews_en.text: I booked a buffet through Hungry Hub for 830 baht per person, and it was terrible. The restaurant seemed to only sell à la carte dishes, like they didn't want to sell buffets at all. I ordered Tom Yum Goong (spicy shrimp soup), and it came in a tiny bowl, like a dessert cup. The highlight was the salmon; I ordered it twice, and they quickly told me the kitchen was closed. But they gave me two servings of the stir-fried clams I ordered. It felt like they only wanted me to eat the cheap stuff. It was like I was begging for food. If they didn't want to sell buffets, why even offer reservations? I was very disappointed. I strongly advise against going there.
sample_reviews_en.author: วัลภา บุญนํา

sample_reviews_en.text: The waitress who helped us take our order seemed a bit impatient. We ordered 500g of curry crab, and she told us that we could switch to a different type of crab, mud carb, which would be tastier and the price would be the same. I was worried that the bill might be different from what she said, since the curry crab was quite a large plate. Luckily, the price was exactly as she said. All the dishes were delicious, and the whole family enjoyed them. The staff were very friendly and helped us take photos from many angles! The scenery was beautiful, the atmosphere was great, and there was live music. We'll definitely come back next time we're in Pattaya!
sample_reviews_en.author: Grace Chen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fresh seafood but lacks culinary finesse

Our highlight were 4 lobsters and river prawns , amongst green curry (chicken) and crab fried rice.

There is quality and freshness as we chose Seafood from tanks and wild . However the sauces culinary skills did not elevate the quality seafood- very average Thermidor sauce or cheese etc. Crab fried rice and green curry were very average too.

I would recommend to go for fresh seafood on the grill with their Thai seafood sauce to enjoy purely the goodness from the sea without the expectation from the kitchen.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarah Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
King Seafood Restaurant – Pattaya Walking Street

King Seafood, located on Walking Street, is truly excellent! Both the food and the atmosphere were fantastic. The seafood, in particular, was very fresh and delicious.
