Playing songs specifically for Turkish cuisine was also a very nice gesture — the staff was extremely attentive and friendly. I definitely recommend it for anyone looking for both entertainment and good food. Everyone visiting Pattaya should definitely stop by.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kenan Güven

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is located on Walking Street, right by the sea. The atmosphere is good, sit and enjoy the cool breeze. The lobsters are very well prepared. There are many sizes to choose from, with different prices. There are also fresh ones. You can choose to make many menus. I recommend the baked cheese menu, it's very satisfying. The fried fish is also delicious. The service is good. If something is wrong, they apologize and go and change it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benjaporn P.

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant was empty, so we were able to go right away. We ordered a half-size bowl of Pu Pad Pong curry, crab fried rice, water spinach, fried squid, and a beer, totaling about 12,000 yen. The portions were generous, so we were very full. My husband said he was very satisfied. The service was also good.
sample_reviews_en.author: 眞鍋悦子

restaurants.name: Victoria By Cocotte Central World
restaurants.address:

Central World, 1/F Atrium Zone, Ratchadamri Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered the delicatessen which is good by your own mixture, ingredients are fresh and the truffle sauce is a nice mix, 8/10.

The cocktail mixture here is good too, not too strong, and not too light, just nice. 8/10.

The tjruffle tagalini is excellent, a 9.5 out of 10 for this one. The pasta is al dente, while the sauce let's you know what you are tasting. With the smokiness of the truffle, it doesn't covers over the scent of thyme while the cream melting in your mouth. Perfectly flavored. Will be nice if a small side dish is included. Let the chef think on this one.

The crab and mango salad, terrible.
The crab isnt very fresh, its dry, easily mistaken for chicken.
A salad should be light, yet the mango sourness clash badly with the avocado,
Which,should give a light fluffier twist to the freshness of the salad. Instead, it makes it a heavy sourness clash of everything that makes the salad nothing short of a total turn off. 1/10

Good thing is that they allow the salad to be taken off the menu, which means that you will be only paying for the food that is acceptable.

Good service, nothing much to say on this aspect.
sample_reviews_en.author: 覺醒的變化

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered pancake w/banana. Pancake is fluffy, good texture with complement from the maple syrup n butter (wish there is more butter, just me). The cameralized banana is awesome, adding some crunchiness to the banana which is already sweet.

Victoria breakfast is a heavy pack of carbo, 😅. Lovely Bacon and sausages with harsh brown, sunny side top and 2 pieces of toast n saluted mushrooms and fresh tangy tomatoes. Sinful but filling. Loved the sausage, bacon isnt overcooked. Harsh brown is a bit oily. But this is good food before a heavy workout session. 😁

Coffee is good, americano is rich. Loved the strong coffee aroma.

Was the first customer morning. Enjoying the peace n santuary of dining.

Will b back for sure to try their meals next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Louis Low

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is delicious and has many halal options 👍 We tried several dishes and the experience was excellent:

- Shakshuka: very tasty with a rich, flavorful sauce 🌟
- Burrata & Garden Tomatoes: fresh and delicious
- Cheesy Mushroom Melt: the best dish of the meal 🔥
- Crème Brûlée: an amazing dessert, highly recommended 👌

A great experience, definitely worth repeating.

- Delicious restaurant with plenty of halal options 👍
We tried several dishes and everything was excellent:
- Shakshuka: very tasty with a rich, flavorful sauce 🌟
- Burrata & Garden Tomatoes: fresh and delicious
- Cheesy Mushroom Melt: the best dish of the meal 🔥
- Crème Brûlée: amazing dessert, highly recommended 👌
Great experience, will definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khalid alshami

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a really great experience dining here. The food was absolutely delicious and exceeded my expectations. Service was impressively quick without compromising quality, which is always a plus.

The staff were incredibly friendly, attentive, and efficient throughout the entire visit. I especially appreciated how accommodating they were with a small change I requested to my dish, they handled it with no hesitation and a very positive attitude.

Considering it’s Western food in Thailand, the prices are very reasonable and definitely reflect the quality you receive. The atmosphere is also lovely, making it a comfortable and enjoyable place to dine.

Overall, a great spot that I would happily recommend and return to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nathalya Musa

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a wonderful time at Victoria Café in CentralWorld. It was the perfect spot to rest and recharge during shopping. Every dish I ordered was beautifully plated with elegance, and the flavors were just as impressive, though I might have ordered a bit too much for one person ! :))

They also have a great selection of cocktails and desserts, which made the experience even more enjoyable. The service was excellent: attentive and caring without being overwhelming.

Overall, Victoria has become my new favorite place to eat and take a break from shopping. Highly recommend! 😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna Palmer

sample_reviews_en.text: Got a try on this place from internet recommendation. After a try, gotta say this restaurant did not disappoint me at all!. Impressed by location's design and decoration style. Even more impressed on the food taste. We ordered salad, pasta, burger, cold pressed juice, and iced cappuchino. Not gonna lie to you. All dishes and drinks were really delicious. All staffs were very nice and professional. Always active and responsive. The food price range is starting from 300 THB which is fair considering quality, experience, and service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanaporn Yamjinda

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a delightful experience at this restaurant thanks to the excellent service and delicious food. Our server recommended the banana pancakes, and they were absolutely fantastic! The pancakes were fluffy and packed with banana flavor. Moreover, I want to compliment the manager for running such a well-managed establishment. The staff was attentive and friendly, and the atmosphere was welcoming. I'll definitely be returning here for more of those amazing pancakes and overall great dining experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Roben Panday

sample_reviews_en.text:
Experience sophisticated French cuisine 🇫🇷 at Victoria by Cocotte ✨
Located in the heart of #Bangkok 🇹🇭, specifically in CentralWorld Mall.

@victoriabycocotte
The atmosphere is elegant, allowing you to savor every moment 👌. The French dishes are perfectly balanced in flavor, and every bite is bursting with quality and a taste that lifts your spirits 😋.

They offer halal options, which was one of the reasons we chose this restaurant ✨. The service is excellent, and they pay attention to detail 🙌🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: Halima Al Abdul Salam

restaurants.name: May Kaidee Tanao Vegetarian & Vegan Restaurant
restaurants.address:

54/1 Soi Samsen 5, Wat Sam Phraya, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
During my visit to Bangkok this time, I not only stumbled upon this amazing vegan restaurant but also made some incredible new friends from May Kaidee.

The food options here are so diverse, and I'm sure you'll find everything they serve here delicious. And when it comes to prices, for a restaurant of their caliber, it's pretty budget-friendly.

The new friends I mentioned earlier are the friendly and fun staff of this restaurant. I've gotten to know some of them quite well, to the point where it feels more like visiting a friend's house than a restaurant.

I must admit, I've been hitting up this place almost every other day during my six-month stay in Bangkok. It's definitely secured a spot on my list of favorite vegan restaurants in Bangkok.

Wishing continued success and good health to everyone at May Kaidee... You guys are awesome!
sample_reviews_en.author: Budi Nusyirwan (Bukrie)

sample_reviews_en.text: What a fun experience! I booked the afternoon class and practically had a private class (there was one other student at the beginning but she was only learning to make the basic pastes and left after that). I learned how to make so many dishes and they were all delicious! Since it was a private class, I could customize it to my tastes - vegan dishes and no onions because I don’t like them. I also got to choose which curry I wanted to make. Jenny was a fabulous instructor and told me how to modify the dishes when I’m home if I can’t find specific ingredients. I definitely recommend this class to anyone wanting to learn to make real Thai food. You won’t be disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Emily Shoup

sample_reviews_en.text:
We have been in Bangkok for almost a week, and May Kaidee's is the BEST food we have had so far!

Everything was incredibly flavorful, fresh, and wonderfully VEGAN. It can be surprisingly difficult to eat completely vegan in Bangkok because so many sauces, broths, and seasonings contain hidden animal products. Finding this absolute gem was a fabulous surprise.

The welcome was just as wonderful as the food—kind, warm, and accepting of me, bare feet and all!

If you are vegan, vegetarian, or simply love amazing food, don't miss this experience.

Love and ((HUGS)),
Laura Foster, Founder of Souls Healing Humanity
sample_reviews_en.author: Laura Foster

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing, unassuming vegetarian restaurant -  tables outside in the front but covered space too.  First night in Bangkok and staying close by.  This is recommended in the Rough Guide Thailand. Off the main road along with other food outlets / market stalls.
All food fresh cooked to order, no MSG.
Who needs meat! Nice beer too. We had: fresh spring rolls (not deep fried), deep fried crispy seaweed with peanut sauce (amazing), stir fried veg with cashew nuts, one red Thai curry, one green Thai curry, plain noodles (we were hungry) and two large beers.  Paid Baht 855.  Might return tomorrow!
sample_reviews_en.author: Barbara Claridge

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a lovely experience and learned how to cook so many beautiful dishes! It only felt a little rushed at the end as Jenny had to also serve restaurant customers whilst running the workshop.

It also felt a little odd in a vegan place to see fish in the smallest tank possible (for that size fish, see the photo below) right next to a loud blender, poor things didn't know what to do with themselves each time it was being used. Please take a better care of them!

Otherwise we enjoyed the whole process and will definitely be making the dishes at home, so it was really worth it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dovile Dixon

sample_reviews_en.text:
We got a recommendation for this place on our first day and went here after the first time for 4 consecutive days. Here you can find delicious vegetarian and vegan local thai food.

You can choose from Thai dishes from different regions, the food is a bit more costly (around 100-120 Baht on average) than on the street but it is much better than what you can find from the street vendors, and the portions are bigger. Every dish is made with fresh ingredients and delicious spices so you can't compare it with the street food.

Our recommendations: Pad Thai, Pad See U
sample_reviews_en.author: johannes leopold

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there last night and I can guarantee I wasn't disappointed. Vegetarian food isn't really my thing, though. Among other things, I tried an absolutely incredible signature salad. The vegetables were cooked in crispy tempura with flavorful and creamy fried tofu pieces, and a Thai herb sauce that was both tangy and slightly sweet. The harmonious and balanced flavors, the variety of ingredients and textures, and the warm welcome from the chef, Porn, will leave me with an unforgettable memory... and a strong desire to return, most definitely.
sample_reviews_en.author: La Parenthèse au vert

sample_reviews_en.text: Just a few steps away from our hostel is this gem of a vegetarian restaurant. The owners are really sweet and welcoming. The food is just on another level! We had the Pad Thai and the green curry and as an appetizer the deep fried springrolls. All the dishes were excellent! The portions were big and the prices were good for the portion size. We will definitely come back to taste some of the other dishes like the Masaman Curry. I would really recommended this to anyone especially vegetarians.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex Scholz

restaurants.name: Yang Hin
restaurants.address:

1095 Rama IV Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Personally, I didn't feel it was any different from other Korean BBQ restaurants. The taste was average. Some dishes weren't impressive, like the steamed egg custard. It's a simple, uncomplicated dish, but it wasn't as delicious as I expected.

The service was good, the food was served quickly, and the bouncy pork soup was delicious (ซุปหมูเด้ง).

But the one thing that I think makes it an edge over other places is that there's no time limit for customers. Customers can sit and relax and chat for as long as they like.
sample_reviews_th.author: N U N W O R

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is walking distance from Samyan Mitrtown. Good ambience but has limited number of seats. The waitresses might not understand English but the manager does. Most importantly menu is in English.
No comment on the service as we still prefer to grill on our own for bbq.

Ordered the pork seat, favorite meat is the pork neck. The meat is wonderfully juicy and tender. Practically no dipping sauce require, salt and pepper is tasty enough.

Pricing wise is reasonable, meat set starts from THB388 (3 types of meat). Additional THB49/person for refill bar (vegetables, condiments and dipping sauce).

Good place to Satisfy crave for K-bbq using black stones 😉.
sample_reviews_en.author: N (Princess)

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a great experience at this Korean restaurant. The meat is of very high quality and the vegetables are always fresh. What's impressive is that the prices are very low, making it an excellent value for money. The service is good and the seating is comfortable. Cooking on the hot stones is not only a fun experience but also makes the food taste delicious. The only downside is that they don't accept card payments. I highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Veronika S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ok I was asked to join at this restaurant.  The place was not so nice to relax and eat. It is more like eat and go.

The price is high to my standard if charge this price I expect better quality meet and the better cutting. Although the free salad bar is nice especially the sesame wakame. Also the fried ramyun was tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: BKK snap & bite

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant sits in the main street approximately 5 mins away from Chulalongkorn University. Not only the foods are great but also the staff. They are nice and friendly, they will approach to your table just to cook it for you on stones which is very unique way of cooking. Should try once
sample_reviews_en.author: T. Sir

sample_reviews_en.text: We were 4 people and chose gold. You have 2 h time but the grill is a bit slow and also tight for 4 people. Free water is given; the only drink you get for free in the package. The meat has not the best quality, also some is frozen. Gold package also doesn’t include any dessert.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patricia Schasburger

sample_reviews_en.text: In my point of view, this place is suitable for those having no expectations. The meat is soso. The grilling stone is full of black particles and it is not possible to do anything with it. Service is quick and attentive. Not a place I would return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ning N

sample_reviews_en.text: Food is amazing with many side dishes. The pork is soft and juicy. The food and salad are fresh with good quality of ingredients while the price is affordable. Excellent customer service. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Valentianas Kan

restaurants.name: Spicy Kuck Riverside by Amdaeng Typhoon
restaurants.address:

160 162 Charan Sanitwong 86/1 Alley, Bang O, Bang Phlat, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We celebrated a birthday with family here. The food was incredibly delicious! We ordered shrimp in fish sauce, Luang Prabang papaya salad (the best I've ever had, the fermented fish sauce was so fragrant – the staff said they make it themselves!), salted egg papaya salad, crab and fermented fish sauce papaya salad, snakehead fish larb, beef stew, Ranjuwan curry, squid in black ink sauce, shrimp fried rice (so delicious, the shrimp were huge!), stir-fried clams with betel leaves, stir-fried mixed vegetables with shrimp, fried chicken wings, fried fish with fish sauce served with mango salad, and sour fish curry. The atmosphere was great, the staff were very attentive, and there was live music – great and relaxing. We loved everything! Thank you so much everyone, and see you next time! 🙏❤😀
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Rongyen

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is part of the same chain as Eik Lerk Rim Nam. It used to be located at the old Sheep Village, a familiar spot with ample parking for dozens of cars. The riverside atmosphere is great, with both air-conditioned and open-air seating. The menu focuses on beef, fish, seafood, and chicken, with no pork. The food is diverse, flavorful, and well-balanced. Prices are similar to Eik Lerk, ranging from 200-500 baht per dish. The staff provides good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tang Raksat

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time here, and I was so happy with the atmosphere. Sitting at a table by the river was amazing; the breeze was perfect! The food was fresh and delicious in every dish 😋. The grilled beef with star anise was incredibly delicious! The staff provided excellent service, very attentive to customers. I will definitely come again. The papaya salad was also incredibly flavorful and delicious. Highly recommended! 🫶🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: ICUTMYHAIRCUZUDONTCAREMYHEART T_T

sample_reviews_en.text: This riverside restaurant has a nice, comfortable atmosphere and a view of the Parliament building. There are both riverside and air-conditioned seating areas. The papaya salad is delicious, but the other dishes we ordered were just average. The prices are a bit high overall. There's live music. If you want to chat with friends and prefer a quieter atmosphere, I recommend sitting inside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kandy M

sample_reviews_en.text:
Staff is not ok. They not provide a good service to customer. Event we ask for a spoon until we done all the menu spoon still not come. Smell quite bad in the air con place. The food quite salty for every menu.
The location is quite good and variety of choice. The menu with all picture is nice.
Still a room for improvement for the staff and reduce a bit of salty will be better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Uachit Petchkong

sample_reviews_en.text: For those looking for a riverside restaurant, I recommend this place. Friendly staff with impeccable service. The fried garlic crab is definitely a must-try. I'm not giving the food five stars because, despite asking for plain dishes, we received two very sweet ones. There's live music in the evenings, with two bands performing every night. Definitely worth a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naziya T Vinci

sample_reviews_en.text: Stopped by for lunch and was impressed. The Thai dishes were exceptionally flavorful and well-executed. On top of the great food, the restaurant offers a beautiful riverside view—I imagine the vibe would be even more amazing for dinner. The menu is also massive, with a huge variety of options to choose from. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Prakit

sample_reviews_en.text: I took my family there earlier this month. The service was excellent, very impressive. The staff were lovely and friendly. The restaurant atmosphere was great, and they have a separate halal zone. We ordered many dishes and everything was delicious. My parents were very impressed. We will definitely go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: กานต์ หมานจีด

restaurants.name: Bangwa Pork Leg Restaurant
restaurants.address:

3, 13 Phetkasem Sai Kao Rd, Bang Wa, Phasi Charoen, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: On August 1st, between approximately 2:00 PM and 2:10 PM, I went to eat at the restaurant. A man in a black shirt, of a heavy build, told me to order. I ordered a plate of pork knuckle and bamboo shoots. However, when it was delivered, it was bitter melon soup. I informed him, but he showed a displeased expression and tone of voice, saying he heard me order bitter melon, which I am certain I ordered bamboo shoots. But I wanted to eat rice, so I accepted it to avoid further problems. I may have ordered incorrectly, but he should have spoken in a more pleasant tone. I would also like to see the security camera footage of the table next to me, who were eating at the same time as me. If the soup was wrong or if I wanted to change it, a man in an orange shirt would willingly come and change it for me. I don't know who the man in the black shirt is; he might be a relative of the owner, but with his presence, I probably won't eat there again. This incident doesn't involve any other staff members; everyone provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: montree mongkon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Bangwa Pork Leg Restaurant is a great choice for anyone craving traditional Thai pork leg rice. The highlight of the meal is the pork leg itself, which is exceptionally tender and flavorful. The meat is slow-cooked until soft, allowing it to absorb the rich and aromatic seasoning while remaining juicy and satisfying.

Another standout item is the braised egg. It is well seasoned, with a delicious savory flavor that complements the pork perfectly. In fact, it was so good that I ended up ordering extra eggs to enjoy with the meal. The combination of tender pork, fragrant rice, and flavorful braised eggs creates a simple yet highly satisfying dining experience.

The restaurant focuses on doing a classic dish well, and it succeeds. With its comforting flavors, generous portions, and consistently delicious food, Bangwa Pork Leg Restaurant is a place worth visiting whenever you are in the mood for authentic Thai comfort food.
sample_reviews_en.author: SS DD

sample_reviews_en.text: There were 7-8 empty tables, but customers weren't allowed to sit down. They were made to take a queue number (and wait for people inside to leave before their number is called, which takes a very long time). They said there weren't enough staff, even though there were many staff members (more than 5). I'm a regular customer and have never encountered this kind of management. Instead of letting customers sit down and fill the tables (even if it's slow), they were being too accommodating. It would be more understandable if later arrivals saw that all the tables were full and had to take queue numbers. The workflow would be much better. It's disappointing that so many tables are empty but you have to wait in line.
sample_reviews_en.author: AKI

sample_reviews_en.text: It's always delicious. I've been eating here since before I was a father, and now my kids are grown, I always bring them along. I always order the 280 baht pork knuckle, a bowl of bitter melon soup, and four eggs, asking for extra broth. You'll definitely be full! / However, paying might be a bit slow. Be patient after you've finished eating. I recommend eating at the front restaurant, the one by the road. I tried eating inside once and it felt strange, and the food wasn't as good as the front restaurant. It's confusing. There's more parking inside; outside only has parking for motorcycles, but you might be able to park cars in the gas station nearby, I'm not sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: พี่หน่อย1983

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was terrible. When I asked for water, they acted annoyed and made faces at me. (Is it my fault I asked for water?)
This was the first time in my life I've yelled at a waiter in a restaurant. It felt good to show bad behavior towards others, and when others retaliated, they couldn't handle it. I've been eating here since I was a kid because I live in the area, but I won't be going back again. I feel sorry for the owner; they built such a good business, only to have their employees treat them so badly. No matter how delicious the food is, this kind of service is unacceptable.
#Eating here felt like being a beggar. It felt like I was begging for food.
sample_reviews_en.author: PP

sample_reviews_en.text:
Bang Wa Braised Pork Leg has two locations:
The first is right by Phetkasem Road in Bang Khae (no parking available).
A little further down, there's a small alley.
Go in and there's parking, convenient.
On weekdays, you can dine comfortably / or eat quickly and leave.
On weekends, it's busy and you have to queue and wait to be called outside. Staff clear orders table by table.
Some of the service staff seemed tired and irritable.
The owner, Auntie Tuan, repeated the order loudly. The restaurant seemed chaotic.
The braised pork leg has an authentic taste, perfectly salty, not sweet.
I've been eating at this restaurant for almost 30 years.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leorita Olion

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I took my girlfriend to eat there (3 of us in total). It's been almost 20 years since we moved far away. Honestly, it wasn't good at all (the old cook is probably no longer there). The pork was mushy, and the intestines were so soft they fell apart. The dipping sauce wasn't good; the flavor was terrible. It's nowhere near as good as the fresh market sauce near my house. (Actually, the intestines should be firm and bouncy, not mushy.) I definitely won't be going back. It's a legend. The only downside is the parking in the alley. Oh, and one more thing, the staff weren't welcoming and didn't pay much attention to customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suwat Wongsawanporn

sample_reviews_en.text: The braised pork leg rice at Bang Wa restaurant was served in the afternoon, and there wasn't much left. It's a shame they didn't have jasmine rice, which would have been a perfect match. This restaurant uses the same type of rice as for curry rice; the braised pork leg itself tasted good and wasn't greasy. The highlight is probably the pickled mustard greens in the braised pork broth, which were delicious, and the chili vinegar sauce with chopped garlic added to the braised pork leg – it was incredibly tasty. You should definitely try it at least once.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suesie Q

restaurants.name: Ohkajhu Siam Square One
restaurants.address:

Unit #SS 3009, 388 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Started as a humble vegetable farm by a group of high school friends, Ohkajhu is one of the newer salad restaurants in Thailand. First only selling organic vegetables in Chiang Mai, the three founders gradually expanded to create a restaurant and salad menu to highlight their quality ingredients to bring organic vegetables "from farm to table". This quickly gained popularity though work of mouth and social media and before-long, Ohkajhu has expanded into Bangkok and beyond.

The key difference of Ohkajhu from other salad restaurants is their absolutely ginormous servings, each menu are served in a gigantic bowl or plate with lots of different salads to eat. The salads really are organic, tasting of the vegetables itself without any chemical aftertaste or scent. Each menu are carefully crafted to complement each ingredients for a enjoyable meal. Although some dishes were a bit dry in my view, my overall taste and experience at Ohkajhu was not a bad one. I also enjoyed their selection of drinks and smoothies, which were well crafted and decorated in (again) giant glasses.

There is usually a bit of a que at Ohkajhu, but its not too long of a wait.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisana Varanyuwatana

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a great experience dining at Ohkajhu Siam Square One! I absolutely loved their mushroom salad with garlic dressing so flavorful and fresh. The atmosphere in the restaurant is really nice and welcoming.

One thing that stood out to me is the generous portion sizes just one order can easily feed 2–3 people, which makes it a great spot for sharing dishes with friends or family. The staff were also friendly and attentive, which added to the overall pleasant experience.

The only downside is that the space inside the restaurant is a bit tight, especially during busy hours. But aside from that, everything else was spot on. Definitely worth a visit if you're in the area and craving something fresh and satisfying!
sample_reviews_en.author: Maverick John Silva

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was excellent!! After long wait, it all was worth it.

I still would add this place on my 🌟 list for next time.

Best Vegan option!!

- Food was an excellent portion for sharing and good value as well. I was sharing 3 plates (salad, grilled chicken mashed potatoes side dish, veggie wrapped) with my mum and ended up with 1 dessert and 2 healthy juices (foma!)
- The service was also nice and fast!
- The atmosphere was cozy and comfortable vibes perfect for family and friends 🧡 even date!
- Siam Square One usually have long wait, so I would recommend walking a little bit to more significant location in the alleyway with 3 stories nearby.

I will definitely come back again since my mum enjoyed it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bly temnatee

sample_reviews_en.text: The queue is long with the internet booking system and it normally takes many hours at the rush hour. This is my second visit and the food quality is unchanged. Conveniently located in Siam Square One at The BTS station, the restaurant offers quality salad and international menu. There is no beef in the menu and you would be likely to share table if you come alone. All dishes are fresh, tasty, and healthy with a side dish of salad.  I highly recommend snapper fillet, salmon fillet, and Angle-Hair spaghetti. The service is polite and efficient with the winning ratio of wait staff to patrons. The decor is contemporary and clean with the right temperature.
sample_reviews_en.author: Praphat Sirivongrangsan

sample_reviews_en.text: Ohkajhu Siam Square One is not the best branch of this famous salad restro chain. The atmosphere is chaotic. I can smell something burning while dining and keep asking the staff multiple times to reassure that everything is fine. The answer is yes, but the burnt smell goes on for at least 10 mins which is very unpleasant. The staff don't pay attention to me at all. I have to walk to the cashier to order my food because no one notices me and care to take my order. The same goes for paying bills. I have to fight myself to get out of the restaurant. The only good thing is the food which lives up to the restro standard. Recommend going to other branches.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayanan Kumhom

sample_reviews_en.text: I was truly shocked by the salad here. The taste was fine, but the portions tho. When I ordered it I thought it was gonna be a small plate since it was only 85 Baht (and the place is in Siam). Surprisingly, the plate was gigantic that I think I can share with another person without other dishes, and we’ll be full! The staffs were also really nice and kind, she asked me to register for a membership so I could get a discount, then I got free salad and smoothie since it’s my birthday. The food we had basically was the portion of 5 or 6 people, but we paid on total less than 1000 Baht. I’m impressed
sample_reviews_en.author: Boonraksa Sopak

sample_reviews_en.text:
Always popular and busy; went there at 6pm and it was quite crowded already with dining guests.
The staff are all very polite and helpful, even though they are quite busy.
The waitress didn't speak any English, but was very courteous and repeated our order to confirm accuracy.
The food is amazing.  The vegetables are fresh and crispy, plates are large and portions are huge.
I had the pork chop with apple sauce, and it came with a large portion of delicious greens also.
I always leave with a full stomach and I feel good because I get a healthy portion of veggies every time!
sample_reviews_en.author: Travel Coffee Andy

sample_reviews_en.text:
good food, long queue, therefore slow service and food serving. Better go in between meal to avoid crowd. Food quality is good but was better. Dish and food portion is big, do not underestimate and order too much.

Update 7 May 23, service became bad to worse, there are 2 queue lists, one on the front, after call, order food in advance, another queue list kick in with another 30 min waiting. After seated, wait another 20 min, not even drink served. Farst disk came after 40 min seated. In general, if you do not have much free wait for idle chat, DO NOT WASTE your time here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyapun Kaokitvirach

restaurants.name: Boat Noodles - Toy Kuay Teow Ruea
restaurants.address:

Ratchawithi 18 Alley, Thung Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Boat noodles are one of those classic Bangkok experiences — and this place does them properly.
You can tell that social media has discovered it.
It’s busy. Very busy.
Lots of young locals, some tourists, tables constantly turning over.
But here’s the important part:
The food absolutely lives up to the hype.
The concept is simple: Tiny noodle bowls for 15 THB each.
Yes. Fifteen.
That’s not a typo.
You basically order multiple small bowls instead of one big one. We were four people and ordered a mix of eight different bowls to try as many variations as possible. It was more than enough — and the total bill didn’t even reach 200 THB.
For Bangkok, that’s almost absurdly cheap.
Flavor-wise: – rich broth
– perfectly cooked noodles
– tender meat
– great seasoning balance
– small portions but big taste
It’s fast, authentic, slightly chaotic in the best possible way — exactly what boat noodles should be.
If you’re expecting quiet fine dining, this isn’t it.
If you want real Bangkok street food energy and ridiculously good value for money, this is your place.
Honestly, it almost feels wrong to give it too much publicity — it should stay a bit of a secret.
But it’s absolutely worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert Haehnel

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went in and picked a table to my liking. The staff then handed over their menu and listed down my orders. Really thought of the combo of the ingredients through before coming to this place. 😂 So far, I'm quite satisfied with my choices. ✨️I ordered the ff.:
- Flat Noodles (Sen-Yai) / Egg Noodles (Ba-Mee) + pork + lil bit spicy + Tom Yum soup
- Rice Noodles (Sen-Mee) + beef + med. spicy + Dried noodles (Hang)
- Small Noodles (Sen-Lek) + pork + lil bit spicy + Boat noodle soup (Nam-tok; broth w/ cow's or pig's blood)
[this has the best broth for me]
- 2 × Khanom Tuay
[I really love this local dessert❣️ Taste a bit like PH's sapin-sapin; the salted coconut cream pairs really well with the sweet glutinous base 🤍]

I also added a few crispy pork skin pieces (already on the table, along with fried wonton chips, khanom tuay, and bottled water; not free of charge btw) to my noodles, which added texture and flavor 💖

After eating, I called the server over for the payment, and I was immediately given my total. I then proceeded to the cashier (by the entrance), paid for my meal, and gave my thanks and compliments before leaving. 🙏 Such a fun experience ✨️
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicole Nuñez

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love how efficient and cute this place is. Tables are ready with condiments, drinks and cutlery. Soups arrive in minutes after ordering.
The soups are tiny and delicious, a perfect size so you can adjust your lunch exacly according to your hunger. For me it was a late breakfast and I was full after 4 bowls and a coconut custard (sooooo yummy!!). All the soup bases are delicious in different ways but my favorite was Tom Yum which was very peanutty crunchy and had a topping of fresh sprouts!
The meat comes in a variation of cooking styles: meatball, fried, rosted.. not vegetarian friendly.
It’s widely popular among locals for lunch. It was practically empty at 11 when I arrived and by 11.45 it was superbusy and bustling of life, I seemed to be the only tourist and getting service in English was no problem.
Highly recommended when visiting Bangkok! It’s easy - comfy - delicious - and cheap!! 15 bhat for a portion.
(The only thing I cringed at was when I ordered a black coffee and received an insanely sweet bottle of something cold slightly coffee-like… I guess I should have expected that! 😂 The tai tea was delicious.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Hanna Maria

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is one of the best iterations of Thai style boat noodles you can find in Bangkok. Most people will go to the usual restaurants around victory monument which is ok but they don't know what they are missing out on.

Though it is quite a walking distance from the BTS or the main road it is 100% worth the sweat.

Although the portion sizes are small and you will need about four or five bowls to fill the tummy the flavour itself makes it worth it. An intense blast of flavour hits you with each and every mouthful full of porky or beefy goodness. It's so simple but addictive.

There is no need to add additional condiments. What you can do to amplify the experience is add some of that pork crackling and fried dumpling skin and let it soak up the  soup.

My personal favourite is the dry style noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: Crypto Calories

sample_reviews_en.text:
Toi Boat Noodles, Wat Makok

This is an old boat noodle shop that has been a fixture in the Wat Makok area for over 40 years. Its charm lies in its traditional flavor: a rich, fragrant broth infused with spices and herbs, perfectly seasoned. The noodles are chewy, and the toppings are generous. It's even more delicious when eaten hot.

This is another shop that reflects the authentic taste of traditional boat noodles passed down through generations. If you're passing by Wat Makok, we recommend you try it.

Toi Boat Noodles, Wat Makok
Soi Ratchawithi 18

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve been coming to this restaurant for over 15 years. It serves some of the best boat noodles around the Victory Monument area at a very reasonable price. I usually have 4–6 bowls per meal, as the portions are quite small. You can choose between pork or beef, nam tok or tom yum, with soup or without, and different types of noodles (ask for non-spicy if you can’t tolerate spicy food).

There are also side dishes you can order, such as deep-fried pork skin (which goes very well with the noodles), satay (very tender), and grilled pork balls.

For drinks, soft drinks and sugarcane juice (highly recommended) are available.

To end the meal, their dessert is steamed coconut milk custard—just perfect, not too sweet.

FYI, this restaurant accepts cash only.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukawan R.

sample_reviews_en.text:
A true hidden gem for authentic boat noodles, tucked right along the canal away from the heavily commercialized, touristy "Boat Noodle Alley."

The broth here is next-level — super thick, rich, and packed with deep herbal and savory flavor. You can choose three broth styles (boat noodle soup, tom yum soup, or clear soup), pork or beef and different noodle types.

Since the bowls are traditionally small and only cost around 15 THB each, it’s easy to order several and try all three broths in one sitting. Don’t skip the crispy pork rinds and fried wonton crisps on the table — they add the perfect crunch.

Simple open-air setup by the canal behind Wat Makok. Fast service, cash only, and very local vibe. Must-Try!
sample_reviews_en.author: SoniThai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kop khun khrap 🗣️

We came from Germany and had HIGH expectations as we got blown away !

15 Baht for a small bowl of delicious noodles in the best broth we have ever tasted.
Located in a very welcoming, inviting looking place, where your food gets prepared on a traditional boat and the whole story began.

The King of the Table felt like Po from Kung Fu Panda after finishing his tenth bowl of that deliciousness.

Remember what Master Oogwey said :

“Yesterday was history, tomorrow is a mistery, but today is a Gift.
That’s why it’s called present.”

Our holy Gift on that day were those bowls of noodles !

Liebe Grüße an Bernd Zehner 😘
sample_reviews_en.author: Oscar

restaurants.name: Cholos Mexican Charoen Krung
restaurants.address:

672, 65 Soi Charoen Krung 28, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were in the area for exhibition and wanted non-Thai/Chinese option

- seating: restaurant is on 2nd floor. There is an outside and inside area. Enough space we didnt have to wait

- Food: not exactly cheap but Mexican food generally trends towards expensive side. Portion though is generous for all the foods. The grilled cheese sandwich weny perfectly with the birria option (the dipping sauce. I dont see birria option often and it wad amazing), fish tarco was good with the salsa. The chip was plentiful and we liked the trio of sauces it come with. We had churros to go. Tasted pretty good when we had it at home.

- Service: quick, friendly, no complaint

Good spot id like to revisit next time I am in the area!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tee Chayakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cholos is located on the second floor of a building right at the entrance of the soi, so it's a little easy to miss—we almost walked past it! But it's definitely worth finding.

The tacos and quesadillas were absolutely delicious, and the guacamole was the highlight for me. It was incredibly fresh, flavorful, and paired perfectly with everything we ordered.

The staff were friendly and welcoming, making the whole dining experience even better. Parking can be a bit tricky, but there are places to park along the soi if you don't mind a short walk.

Overall, a fantastic spot for authentic Mexican food. I'll definitely be coming back!
sample_reviews_en.author: s t

sample_reviews_en.text:
Shop says it opens at 11:00am. Arrived at 12:30. There were still trash bags out in the dining area, AC was running quite hot, and loud construction going on outside, which was a bit unpleasant. We'll give them the benefit of the doubt because we arrived on a random Thursday afternoon. I think this place is geared more towards night/dinner get-togethers more than a lunch spot.

However, the food was DELICIOUS. Portions were HUGE for the location and price. Staff is very friendly and quickly cleared out the trash bags after our food was served. Oh...and free dessert upon writing a Google review, so we got churros to go. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Emmy Paranee Laovongpanich

sample_reviews_en.text: The facility is acceptable and the taste experience is good. However, I feel that the price level is somewhat high in relation to the portion size, even taking into account that some ingredients can be more expensive. It is important to remember that tacos and burritos are generally affordable street food in many parts of the world. Therefore, I consider the price of these dishes here in Bangkok to be high. In addition, the price of a small bottle of Singha, 160 baht, is remarkable and approaching European price levels. However, the service was excellent and there is nothing negative to complain about in that regard.
sample_reviews_en.author: Android Boy

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was attentive and fast, I’m a big fan of their decor and think it really adds to the atmosphere. Lots of fun decorations and colours representing Mexico.

The food is very yummy and came in hot :)!! Their quesadillas were very generous w the portion and sizing (4 very thick ones). As for Birria tacos you get two!

Although there is no parking available, there might be spots alongside the walls of the restaurant but are generally quite tight to park. They have a beautiful balcony / patio area as well

( if you’re looking to come here, they are on the 2nd floor! )
sample_reviews_en.author: hanza fg

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place does not disappoint. The food is impressive. This place is definitely a good place after just having just ordered 3 simple dishes from the menu and all 3 are excellent.

Therev are a staff here and it's possible that the kitchen is using rocket engine as the the food comes very quickly.

It's unclear if the restaurant has parking space for cars or not. Finding parking space on the street in the evenings should be relatively easy.

There are not just good but excellent  vegetarian selections here. From nachos, baby corn, taco, burrito, to the lovely dessert.
sample_reviews_en.author: Plus Lab

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a really nice Mexican restaurant! We ordered the Birria Tacos and a chicken quesadilla, and both were delicious. The meat in the tacos was very tender and flavorful, especially with the dipping sauce. The chicken quesadilla was also generously portioned and perfectly grilled. The food came out quickly, the prices were reasonable, and the atmosphere was relaxed and comfortable. The staff were friendly and welcoming as well. Definitely a great place for Mexican food in the Charoen Krung area. I would happily come back again! ！
sample_reviews_en.author: Carlson G

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent food and very nice staff. For its size and location, its a real gem for Mexican food. Cholos is located above the ground floor so you will need to navigate stairs. There is inside seating and a smaller outside seating area on the balcony that can accommodate a few groups of four nicely. We almost don't want to leave a much deserved 5-stars so we can keep it to ourselves! It would be wonderful, and delicious, to see them grow though. Prices are reasonable for the quality and flavors you get.
sample_reviews_en.author: Celeste Thompson

restaurants.name: Starbucks The Street Ratchada
restaurants.address:

The Street, 139 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice cafe, with big indoor seating room.. Although there are no outdoor seating.. Always packed with students & teenagers.. Very relaxing.. Service is good, drinks & foods are good too.. Can spend all day inside studying, reading books  & playing my phone.. Ambience is nice with enough sunlight to cheer me up.. 😁.. Will be a good place to hang out with friends or family.. It's inside a mall named The Street. At Ratchadaphisek Road.. The mall have many restaurants & fast food chains too, & will be a good place to have lunch or dinner after hang out in this starbucks cafe.. 👍. The nearest MRT station is Thailand Cultural Centre MRT station, it's about 6 minutes walk from this mall.. Quite convenient i think,. Have been coming here a few times, will be back again in the future.. 😀
sample_reviews_en.author: Haiman

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great. This is a branch I frequent because it's open 24 hours, which is convenient, especially since it's near the MRT Cultural Center Station, Exit 4. For food, there's a food court downstairs in the mall and many other restaurants. Plus, there's an air-conditioned connecting walkway to Big-C next door. The staff provides good service, answering questions and offering assistance. The taste of the drinks and food meets Starbucks standards.
sample_reviews_en.author: That guy

sample_reviews_en.text: I just came out of a reading session and the service was excellent. I felt comfortable and happy with the service. The staff were truly attentive. There was a child making noise and running around, but the staff handled the problem very well. They inquired and talked to both the customers in the store and the child's family without showing any emotion. I was very impressed. The air conditioning was always cool. Thank you for your attentive service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Janet Samcea

sample_reviews_en.text: Waste of time and money. I wanted to work on my laptop for a while in this Starbucks, but after 20 minutes I had to leave. It’s so cold inside that it’s impossible to stay there for long. It’s 35°C outside and probably around 15°C inside. I’ll probably be sick tomorrow. If you plan to sit there for a while, bring a jacket and a hat if you want to survive the cold. I understand that people like air conditioning, but this is really excessive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kinga Sedkiewicz

sample_reviews_en.text: Open 24hrs and always has a good crowd. The dinning area is quite big and it is always fully occupied or almost fully occupied. There are 2 meeting rooms with capacity of  10 to 12 persons are free to use as long as each person purchase around 150 Bahts  of drinks and food. First come first serve basis but reservation is allowed. Meeting room is equipped with LCD TV. This branch has free wifi and some seats provide power outlet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kesmond Kwek

sample_reviews_en.text: Another bad experience at this Starbucks. The service wasn't good  and there was nowhere to sit — every table was taken by people camping out with their laptops for hours. I had to retreat to the mall side, which was noisy and hotter. I ordered an iced coffee; after 20 minutes, they showed up with a hot Americano instead and it took another 10 minutes to fix their mistake. The cookie was tiny, dry, and  flavorless. Disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Deal Stiller

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch of Starbucks offers a great location where you can comfortably sit for an extended period in a serene atmosphere. While the store may be a bit crowded, it remains quiet, making it an ideal spot to linger. Additionally, there's a meeting room available. The staff provides excellent service and is quite helpful. A friendly reminder for visitors: bring a sweater, as it tends to be very cold inside.
sample_reviews_en.author: NNchan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The problem is that ..it is so busy...and people stay for long there..and as always ...u r gonna find laptops ...papers bags all over the place...while ppl go out do their things...and come back after an hour ...they just keep the place busy and their spots reserved...
Could be better...
Another fact....they must deal with huge number of mosquitoes in the place..it is really annoying
sample_reviews_en.author: lucas Ark

restaurants.name: Kouchan Ramen
restaurants.address:

15, ห้องเลขที่ 9, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I had quite high expectation for this place as i saw the review from a facebook group and read in google reviews before trying today. I believe they have a Nagahama style which after i been trying ramen from different parts of Japan i found the best for me in Beppu with Nagahama style. The atmostphere, condiments, the hardness level of ramen and customized your own toppings are on point. However i found the  soup is not extraordinary after being starving all morning and had this bowl at 1.30pm. I ordered the special ramen barikata, added Takana to have it just like Beppu experience, a little bit of garlic. Plus the very small 5 pieces of gyoza 🥲. I usually do the google review which restaurant offer additional noodle if you do, i actually could have more noodle but didnt feel like to. Maybe its just my mouth or i was to hype to try but i will give it another try next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kasamaporn Yurkyen

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm not a fan of Hagata style ramen and I didn't expect much but I'm still disappointed. Despite the strong smell of bone broth it lacks flavors.
I ordered a Menma bamboo shoot and Ajituke Tamako egg as topping to make the bowl look fuller yet nothing much added to the flavors.

Now what I like is that the noodles are cooked perfectly for a regular softness. Gyoza is tasty and the wrappers are good chewy although portions could be bigger. Also the service is spectacular, very attentive staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ryo Nattapach

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's great to be able to enjoy the flavors of Fukuoka in Bangkok.
And it's “Kochan Ramen”from the “ikkosya”group!
It's only been open for four days, so perhaps they're still improving their operations?
Consistent Japanese flavor and quality!
Tonkotsu ramen that you never get tired of!
They also offer toppings like pickled ginger“benisyoga”and fresh garlic, as well as fried rice and bite-sized dumplings.
The price is about the same as in Japan.
that's amazing!!
sample_reviews_en.author: izaya -yahn

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place for Hakata ramen. Try the signature Tonkatsu Ramen with Gyoza. Ramen you can choose how you like the texture, soft, normal or hard. For me normal was just fine still have the texture to chew but not too soft. Broth was creamy but still light not too salty just like other place. Gyoza was OK the filling was nice not too smoochy like the yuzu chilli paste make it great taste with a fragrance. If you wrote review, you will get free noodle.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrick Ngamsiripol

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered Hakata Mazesoba for 230 baht. The portion was small and not filling. 230 is normal for Phrom Phong but the portion does not match the price. In Tokyo I had the same dish at multiple places for a similar price but 3 times more food.

Adding 2 eggs cost another 40 baht, and with service charge and VAT the total came to over 300 baht, which felt very poor value. The taste was good and if portion size is improved I would return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khai Nguyen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Feels like walking into a typical Japanese ramen restaurant. Fill out the order sheet and wait for your ramen.

Ordered Signature Tonkotsu Ramen with regular hardness noodles and extra cha shu. Tonkatsu soup is rich and not overly salty. Regular hardness noodles is hard just right. Cha shu is a good size and not too thin. Satisfied with my ramen and will definitely return to try other choices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jan L.

sample_reviews_en.text: the pork bone soup is very salty.  when we order extra noodles. the noodles come in already made form.  So when It is time to put into the soup, the noodles are all lumped up. The extra noodles should be given after customer have ask for the extra noodles to be added to the remaining soup broth given. slices of pork given is also in abit of raw  state.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cjjoo Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ramen here is honestly some of the best ramen you can find at this price point, which by the way is very affordable.

The staff are very friendly.

It’s super simple to order, every person fills in their own little menu card of what they want, and then give to the waitress.

I’d highly recommend the spicy shoyu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Curtis Bull

restaurants.name: Tom Yum Kung
restaurants.address:

9 Khaosan Rd, Talat Yot, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: An excellent restaurant in a rare location! It is right in the center of things, in the middle of the main street near all the pubs and the public atmosphere. Although the place seemed full when we entered, everything was at the highest level, the food was simply delicious, the service was fast, courteous and inviting, and the place itself was clean and tidy. The prices were very fair and it was really fun to sit there. This is definitely a place we will return to!
sample_reviews_en.author: ofir faingold

sample_reviews_en.text: Disappointing service. We ordered two mango sticky rice, but only one was brought, so we had to ask for the second. After we finished, staff asked us more than three times within two minutes if we wanted anything else, even though the restaurant was empty and quiet. I repeatedly said I hadn’t asked for the bill yet, but they brought it anyway. We felt unnecessarily rushed to leave. The mango sticky rice was just so-so, and overall the experience was disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fernando Torcato

sample_reviews_en.text:
Unfortunately, we had a very unpleasant experience. Both my boyfriend and I had diarrhea after eating at the restaurant, which makes us concerned that something we ate may not have been handled properly.

I also specifically asked for my curry to be without any spice, but it was served spicy. I wasn’t able to finish the dish because of this.

Overall, I’m very disappointed with the experience, especially considering that we both became unwell afterward.
sample_reviews_en.author: jessica karoline campos

sample_reviews_en.text: This is where I first had Tom Yum Kung in September 2011. I had a Vodka Martini as an aperitif and then the Tom Yum Kung. It tasted like Korean spicy fish stew. I unknowingly chewed and ate all the lemongrass, and the staff gave me a thumbs up. My first Tom Yum Kung. Thanks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boheum Kang

sample_reviews_en.text: Great service good music it’s not too loud to talk but not too quiet. Great views of the road to people watch. Cocktails aren’t weak either
sample_reviews_en.author: Bela Rein

sample_reviews_en.text: We had dinner at this restaurant on Khao San Road. The food and service were excellent, and we spent about €17 for two.
sample_reviews_en.author: Susanna Piantoni

sample_reviews_en.text:
Above all, the staff's hospitality is wonderful.
The restaurant has a relaxed and open atmosphere.
Delicious Thai food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dragon M.

sample_reviews_en.text:
High-end Thai food for tourists
The prices are very reasonable
The atmosphere is very pleasant and the staff is great
sample_reviews_en.author: Usher

restaurants.name: ข้าวต้มหลบมุม สูตรอาม่า
restaurants.address:

135/6-7 Thanon Phet Phra Ram, Bang Kapi, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a very comfortable rice porridge restaurant with an atmosphere more like a dinner restaurant. The lighting and music give it that vibe 😁 The food is delicious and reasonably priced. I especially loved the stir-fried bean sprouts, tofu, and minced pork. The wok aroma was amazing, and the taste was even better than it looked. The tofu was chewy on the outside and soft on the inside, with a perfectly balanced flavor that wasn't too strong. Highly recommend this restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mitthida C

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice porridge restaurant, formerly located on the second floor of the hotel, has moved to the opposite side, to a hotel owned by the same owner. The atmosphere is luxurious, unlike the typical rice porridge restaurants I usually …
sample_reviews_en.author: เลิฟบู

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the staff were friendly and provided good service, the restaurant had a nice atmosphere, was clean and smelled good. However, I felt the menu was a bit limited. The panna cotta dessert was delicious and rich.
sample_reviews_en.author: sp coco

sample_reviews_en.text: A hidden gem for local late-night porridge in Bangkok. The food quality and atmosphere are top-notch. I recommend the stir-fried kale with salted fish, crispy pork, and stir-fried preserved radish with egg.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mick Voottinun Pathompakawant

sample_reviews_en.text: Stir-fried shiitake mushrooms with chili and salt, spicy stewed pork ribs – all delicious and flavorful; I order them almost every time I eat here. The fried fish salad is also excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Png Pha

sample_reviews_en.text:
Arrived at the restaurant but couldn't find it, contrary to expectations. It's located inside a hotel.
It's traditional rice porridge, but elevated to a new level. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuttapong Pongpetchdit

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely amazing! I'm so surprised! Everything was delicious, the prices were great, and it's in a hotel?! I didn't even have time to take pictures! 😅 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Bhadanan Pavarakijpaisala

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the atmosphere is great. The staff are very polite and provide excellent service. It was just as good as the first visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rujiphas Pakornmaneekul

restaurants.name: Jai Jinendra jain & pure vegetarian & vegan indian restaurant
restaurants.address:

329 หมู่ที่ 10 Pattaya City, อำเภอ, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Taste of India in Pattaya 🇹🇭🇮🇳
Our time in Pattaya felt incomplete without our dinners at Jai Jinendra Restaurant. This place truly serves some of the most amazing vegetarian food we’ve had while traveling. Every single dish was full of flavor and authenticity—each bite genuinely felt like home in India. 😋
From the variety on the menu to the consistent quality, everything was just perfect. It’s rare to find such delicious pure veg food abroad that matches Indian taste so beautifully.
A special mention to Mr. Sumit, the owner, whose warm hospitality and attention to detail made our experience even more memorable. His passion truly reflects in the food and service.
If you’re in Pattaya and craving authentic Indian vegetarian cuisine, this place is an absolute must-visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rashmi Shah

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had an amazing experience at this vegetarian restaurant in Pattaya! The food was absolutely delicious, fresh, and full of flavor. It was so nice to find such good vegetarian options here.

Sumit Jain (Owner) was extremely helpful, kind, and made us feel very welcome. Really appreciated the hospitality and service. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for great vegetarian food in Pattaya!
sample_reviews_en.author: Navveen Bokadia

sample_reviews_en.text: So many restaurants have a high rating, but this one truly deserves it! I had a dish with tri-colored paneer in an amazing sauce. I have been to many Indian restaurants in the U.S. and in Europe and this was the best Indian meal I've ever had! Everyone at the establishment was very friendly too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julie DeWalt

sample_reviews_en.text:
5 Stars! A True Gem in Pattaya – Jai Jinendra Delivered Pure Bliss! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
Just had the most incredible dinner at Jai Jinendra Restaurant, and it’s hands down one of the best spots in Pattaya! From the moment we walked in, the warm …
sample_reviews_en.author: YATISH SHAH

sample_reviews_en.text: "Wow, just wow! 🌟 The food here is absolutely phenomenal - every bite is a flavor explosion! Ambience is great, service is super attentive, and the prices are totally worth it. Had an amazing experience, will definitely be back 😋"
sample_reviews_en.author: Rushin Shah

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is just delicious and the owner is also very friendly. He would just go out of his way to make you have best food experience in the restaurant. Must recommended for Indian travellers in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neeraj Malik

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really amazing authentic indian food at affordable price.

Sumit bhaiya who is the owner of the restaurant very helpful and cool person. Do visit here if you’re in Pattaya. 😇😇
sample_reviews_en.author: Sahil Porwal

sample_reviews_en.text: Very tasty Indian food, very clean inside, this is the first time I've come across a high-quality restaurant, although it's small, but they cook with soul here ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Ranny Khaisman

restaurants.name: Chu Grill Shabu (Banthat Thong)
restaurants.address:

971, 973 Banthat Thong Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Firstly I’m not sure how this place has the ratings it does, something seems slightly fishy. Anyways, I opted for the platinum deal which includes everything, hot pot, sushi etc. In order to access the additional platinum dishes you need a QR code. 20 minutes into our meal and I still hadn’t received it, I had to go and ask one of the staff for it. Once I finally ordered, they slowly staggered my 6 dishes being served for the duration of 100 minutes that you get to eat so that I didn’t have as much. AND by when my time was up, some of my dishes STILL hadn’t arrived. And I ordered so little.i just got the bill and left. Also, the sushi was so bad. If you’re used to low quality rice and fish then ok but for me personally it was hard to swallow. Just go for the hotpot instead
sample_reviews_en.author: Megan Withers

sample_reviews_en.text:
They have both BBQ and hot pot options, whichever you prefer. There's a wide selection of food, including meat and seafood, as well as premium sushi and sashimi.
Prices vary.
The service is very fast. The food has many different flavors.
The mala is delicious. There's a wide variety of drinks to choose from.
For dessert, they have shaved ice and buttered corn.
The price is worth it.
Update 3.2026: Still very good. Fast service. The owners take care of everything themselves. Free membership, you can accumulate points. It's great value for money in Banthat Thong.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanathep Sam

sample_reviews_en.text: Give a good review and get a free salmon 🍣. But I don't eat salmon, so my review is honest, haha. Waiters are really nice. You can see the optional vegetables in the picture. The price is 358 all you can eat. It includes three types of beef and the pork ,fish balls or shrimp . The beef is very ordinary quality, with tough tendons and hard to chew. The paint on the grill pan is peeling. I suggest the restaurant replace the pan with a new one. But the price is very cheap, so it's still a good choice if you want a good deal.
sample_reviews_en.author: HE “HH” YAN

sample_reviews_en.text:
Restrooms are upstairs, self serve meats are mostly pork-based, everything else is ordered through QR code on table. There's a two hour time limit

Water and sodas are aelf-served. Sushi, sashimi, rolls, pork, and much more options to choose. It's not bad, but it's not exceptional or anything. Great to fill the stomach if you're a big back, foodies will likely value their time elsewhere.

Soup base for the hotpot and the sticky rice cake dessert thingy are actually pretty good.

Receipt on last page (total of 3 ppl)
sample_reviews_en.author: LG7

sample_reviews_en.text:
Me and my friend gone for the platinum buffet set. Unlimited ordering within a time frame. Reasonable price, do see my pictures for the price i paid.

Honestly, I dont really understand why there are so many full stars reviews here.

Ordinary Japanese food and shabux2.
I had tried higher quality sashimi and sushi in other joint before.

For the price I paid, I shouldnt complain. 👍🇹🇭😁
sample_reviews_en.author: Y jl

sample_reviews_en.text:
Place was crowded but nice, great options for hotpot and grill, though we forgot about the grill options.. (bummer).

Ordering beef was very convenient, no need to wait for server forever and just using your phone. Service was very quick, we were all so satisfied! Broth flavor was amazing and the tomyum was the best of all... ice cream was a nice touch too. 10/10 would recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rosita Lesmana

sample_reviews_en.text: Had an amazing sushi experience at Chu Grill Shabu on Banthat Thong. The sashimi was incredibly fresh and served with real attention to detail—just like in the photos. Presentation was beautiful, and every bite was high quality. Great spot for sushi lovers in Bangkok. Friendly staff and chill atmosphere make it even better. Will definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zohar Hamer

sample_reviews_en.text: The most valuable buffet restaurant in this area with choices of yakiniku, shabu, and Japanese food, snacks. All-you-can-eat with variety of set prices which is including beverages and desserts. The atmosphere is cozy. There's a plenty of seats available on the 2nd floor also. The owners and staff are really eager to serve with heart.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suchol Keeratisuntorn

restaurants.name: The Sportsman Pub & Restaurant
restaurants.address:

482 Pattaya 13 Alley, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Read a few of the reviews on Google and was really hungry after a night of drinking. I walked up and saw two people sitting outside. it was too hot for me to sit outside so I walked in and surprisingly the place was empty. I motioned for a table for 1 and was told I could sit anywhere. it was my choice since the place was empty. I made a jovial comment "not sure if that is a good thing or not". The hostess smiled and said don't worry.

it was morning so I orders the Sportsman special which came with eggs (any style), hash browns, toast, sausage, bacon, mushrooms, coffee and baked beans. I also ordered a bottle of water and a pineapple smoothie.

Order came out in a reasonable time. Food was fresh and very tasty. Staff was very friendly and accommodating. When I finished eating, I asked if I could take a picture of the staff. They giggled and agreed. They were very beautiful!!!

Breakfast was great so I will be back for a lunch or dinner while I am here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rod C

sample_reviews_en.text: I've tried most of the food options at The Sportsman over the years and have always found the food to be great quality and value for money. Except last Friday it wasn't... it was EXCEPTIONAL! My favourite has long been lamb shank and a pint of Guinness (The waitresses don't even offer me a menu any more😁). Always beautifully cooked, fall off the bone tender meat, and served piping hot. Tonight's lamb portion was HUGE! I had to ask if they had changed their meat supplier. Answer: No, but the cuts of meat offered have increased in size. One would expect if a supplier charges a vendor more, then the vendor might increase its prices to the customer. Not at The Sportsman. If you're in Pattaya, go visit and try for yourself. You won't be disappointed👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Adrian Bennett

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of our favourite places in Pattaya even if we are not into football :)
Very good service, waitresses always smile and know the menu perfectly. On the menu you can find a large selection of hot dishes, appetizers, drinks, salads, and desserts. My favorite dishes are traditional British pie and lasagna, as well as cherry pie.
Every day the restaurant holds promotions, which you can find on their website or among the photos here. There is a buffet here 3 times a week, I especially liked it with Italian food, but I advise you to come either 10-15 minutes before the start, or an hour after the start. On Fridays, the second cocktail is free, which is great for a buffet.

The restaurant also offers delivery.
sample_reviews_en.author: Raisi

sample_reviews_en.text: On Friday evenings there is always an all-you-can-eat Italian buffet from 6 p.m. for 299 THB. Yes, anyone who has lived in Thailand for a long time appreciates it. There are various pizzas that are brought out later, so they are always fresh and still warm if you arrive on time and early enough, and plenty of salads and dressings from a good brand. Pasta with Bolognese, pork and chicken is available. However, you shouldn't come for the buffet after 8 p.m. because they usually stop refilling the pizza because hardly anyone is eating anymore. For the money, I can highly recommend it. However, you can't compare it to an Italian restaurant - that's quite obvious - it's not possible for that price!
sample_reviews_en.author: Turtle

sample_reviews_en.text:
Based on overwhelmingly good reviews I tried the Lamb Roast here. The yorkshire pudding was nice and soft, the roast potatoes were crispy and browned near perfect, the vegetables not overdone but timed well with a solid crunch, and the stuffing was fantastically savory, all topped with a hearty gravy.

The lamb itself however was a huge disappointment; it was tough, and lacked any flavor. Especially taking a bite of it after a mouthful of the savory stuffing - the meat was just terribly bland.

I don't recommend this dish.

+1: Staff are all really friendly and hospitable; very good English too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christopher M

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice cozy spot to have a meal and a wide variety of beverages. I had the roast pork and it was okay, not as good as I’m used to but I can understand if it’s not purchased often there are shortcuts necessary to keep it on the menu.  I’ll return to try another dish another day. Popular spot for white foreigners with the comfort foods on the menu, sports on display, laid back music and indoor or outdoor dining.  There looked to be a father and son playing a little friendly game of pool and the staff provides excellent service.  Sorry, I forgot to take a photo of my meal before I ate it up.
sample_reviews_en.author: Be Kind

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to see the start of the Ashes test cricket series and try out a breakfast. I ordered the bacon, eggs and bubble & squeak. I added a sausage, tomato, black pudding and fried bread plus tea (with one free refill) and orange juice. Total cost was 370 Baht.
The food was top notch, especially the bacon and sausage. It filled me up for most of the rest of the day and I thought it was very good value for money.
The staff were welcoming, polite and very efficient and looked super smart in their uniforms.
I will certainly be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Hampson

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Sportsman bar completely blew our minds. The food was amazing and the portions were massive! There are plenty of classic British, Mexican, and Thai dishes to pick from. There also are British selections of drinks such as cider which is great.

The owner seems like a great person, he held a quiz night the night we went. It was fun to join in and listen too whilst eating. The staff were also very professional and helpful with their services.

Highly recommended as a pub to visit to have a chat or or a nice meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yawarakai O.

restaurants.name: Washoku Aji
restaurants.address:

78/2 Soi Sukhumvit 63, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Big C Ekkamai has two restaurants. The one on the 1st floor serves single-dish meals. This review is for the restaurant on the 3rd floor, which sells practically every kind of Japanese food imaginable: salads, sushi, sashimi, fried pork, tempura, soba, ramen, udon, oden, sukiyaki, nabe, grilled skewers, and eel.

They also have seasonal ingredients, including very fresh tuna, served whole and sliced ​​as shown in the opening picture. However, my friend and I don't eat raw food, so we didn't try any of their sushi or sashimi.

I've been eating at this restaurant for at least ten years. In the past, I would have given them full marks for the food, but they've removed and improved several items, such as: (1) They used to have kushikatsu (deep-fried skewers with dipping sauce), but now they don't; (2) They used to have a variety of oden, but now they only offer small portions.

P.S. There are descriptions in the pictures.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prassy Srikittichai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fresh sashimi and friendly service in a cozy setting.
Good quality ingredients and relaxing vibes overall.
Just a few small details that could make the experience even better.

A really good Japanese restaurant with great food quality and service.
The atmosphere inside is also nice — though if you happen to sit near a noisy table, it can get a bit less enjoyable.

The sashimi was impressively thick, fresh, and delicious.
Really good quality fish!

One small downside: there are no sugar-free drinks, and soft drinks like Coke or Pepsi are served by the glass instead of from a can or bottle. That means they lose all their fizz and just taste sweet, which can be disappointing if you enjoy fizzy drinks.

Free drinking water and ginger tea are available, and you can ask for refills.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mindy N. Carysme

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located near Big C Ekkamai, and you can park at Big C.

The restaurant has private rooms, and it's quite large. They offer a wide selection of food. Drinkers will love it, too, as they also offer a buffet.

The staff are very friendly.

The restaurant is located near Big C Ekkamai, and you can conveniently park right at Big C. 🚗
It's quite spacious, with several private rooms available and a wide variety of dishes to choose from. 🍽️

If you're into drinks, you'll love this place — they even offer a buffet option for those who enjoy a chill night out. 🍷✨

Plus, the staff here are super friendly and provide such lovely service. 🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: Nichakorn Chaikumharn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Polite staff,good service, staff take a good care of customer.

The prices on the menu are exclude VAT and service charge.

Menu
Bijin tomato:Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside. Good to eat with other foods to cut the richness.
German fried potatoes: Fried potatoes with bacon and sausage, slightly salty and goid taste.
Kani cream croquette:The smell of crab was distinct but it didn't go well with the tomato sauce served on the side of the dish.
Okonimi yaki:The proportions are to add a lot of pickled ginger and cabbage, which makes the dough not stick well.
salmon sashimi:good taste
Otoro sushu:The otoro fish meat is large and fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: mangdanoi zzz

sample_reviews_en.text:
❤️Washoku Aji claimed to sell best price Maguro in Bangkok. The maguro are actually amazing, good quality good price. For Akami price around 400 we get 5 thick pcs and same to Chutoro. Service is good, kitchen is quick, and drink is super cool🍺😮‍💨😋.

🍗It is amazing that the restaurant manage to have so much dish on their menu. How many chef they got? Even the place is full, we didn’t wait that long for the food.

⛴Everyone should go for Maguro Sashimi

❤️My Menu
Akami Sashimi
Chutoro Sashimi
Fish Tempura
Grilled Garlic
Sushi
etc.

💰Price
Besy Value Maguro, other dish are average on price.

🚘Parking
Can park at Big C Ekkamai
sample_reviews_en.author: Yossanon Ponnsmith

sample_reviews_en.text: Awestruck that this bustling washoku on the top floor of Big C is commanding such fanfare. The tables were already brimming at 6 pm, but we managed to get counter seats. The menu pricing looks friendly, but when you add everything up, you could be splurging a hundred bucks for 2 people. The fried octopus with ponzu, lotus and sour pork, gyoza with garlic, and the maguro experience (6-piece nigiri) are all delectable. The highball needs an overhaul as it was below par. Also, note that the restaurant needs some major renovation as the wear and tear is seeping through. Solid 3.85 stars, rounded to 4.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akaravej

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an authentic Japanese style restaurant where you can enjoy very tasty tuna and salmon sashimi and sushi at reasonable prices.

In addition to sashimi and sushi, there are so many other popular Japanese dishes. All the dishes are very tasty and taste exactly the same as they do in Japan.

The staff is very polite and friendly, and the restaurant is always kept clean.

I think it is very rare to find a restaurant in Bangkok where you can eat good Japanese food at such a reasonable price.
