I recommend it with confidence.
sample_reviews_en.author: Munetsugu Kaneko

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my favorite Japanese restaurant. The menu is huge, with an impressive variety of dishes, so there’s always something new to try.

The fish is consistently very fresh and high quality, which really makes a difference. Everything I’ve ordered here has been well executed, and the overall experience is always great.

The restaurant is on the 3rd floor of Big C Ekkamai, so it’s very convenient, you can just park at the supermarket. Definitely one of the Japanese places I keep coming back to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Passa Tanneau

restaurants.name: Gyukatsu Kyoto Katsugyu - Siam Center
restaurants.address:

2 Fl, 979 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
#SatisfyingMeal at Gyukatsu Kyoto Katsugyu
Gyukatsu Kyoto Katsugyu
Siam Center Branch, 2nd Floor.

The other day, while looking for a restaurant at Siam Center, I passed by this place and
realized that I'd eaten here before, but hadn't posted about it. So I checked my Instagram... Hmm,
that's right! I went there on October 23rd, 2024. So long ago!
I still haven't posted about how delicious this restaurant is.

What I remember liking about it... is:
The meat is excellent, and ***they have a fun feature:
You can grill the meat on your own small personal grill if you want it more cooked than it's already been done at the restaurant. There are various cuts of meat to choose from in sets, but personally, I don't think there's much difference between the different cuts. When we came as a couple and ordered different cuts to share,
it wasn't that different for me personally, because of how the restaurant prepares the meat.
The ingredients are of good quality, worth the price, and everything is incredibly tender.

#牛カツ京都勝牛
#GyukatsuKyotoKatsugyu
#Siamcenter
#DeliciousRecommendation
sample_reviews_en.author: Somaromhmai สมอารมณ์หมาย ณ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff at this restaurant were excellent, far exceeding the average. I wanted to write this review to commend them, hoping the company might see it and appreciate their service.
My husband and our 2-year-old daughter went today.
- We intended to order two sets (normally we count our child as one person out of consideration for the restaurant), but the staff suggested we order just one set and add shrimp as an add-on. They even brought rice for our daughter, saying the rice in the father's set was already refillable.
- They helped adjust our daughter's skirt because it seemed a bit revealing.
- When our daughter fell asleep at the table and her father had to hold her with one hand, the staff helped him clear the table and even asked if we wanted to take the leftovers home since he hadn't finished eating yet.

The food was delicious and up to standard, but the service was beyond expectations (far exceeding the standard), making us even more impressed. We really want to go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Experience Gyukatsu!
• The fun is in the grilling: The highlight is the personal stone grill where you can sear your breaded and fried beef (medium rare) on the hot stone, choosing your preferred doneness. The aroma of the meat sizzling over the heat is incredibly enticing.
• Variety of sauces and side dishes: As you can see from the menu, there are 6 ways to enjoy the meat, which helps prevent it from becoming overwhelming even with a large portion:
1. Wasabi Soy Sauce: A classic flavor that brings out the sweetness of the meat.
2. Japanese Salt and Pepper (Sansho Salt): For those who prefer a cleaner taste of the meat.
3. Worcester Sauce: A rich and traditional flavor.
4. Rich Curry: Adds a more Japanese twist to the taste.
5. Kyoto-Style Egg: Dip the meat in the runny egg for an extra touch of smoothness.
6. Ponzu with Grated Radish: Provides a refreshing contrast and cuts through the richness perfectly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benz Sport

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant serves superb Japanese deep fried beef!!
The crust is crispy and the beef is still pretty nice and pink! Not to mention the meat is really juicy and fresh. They lock the flavour of the meat nicely. Thumbs up for that.

If you like a more well-done beef texture, they even provide a small "stove" for you on your to further grill your meat to your preference! Which we do, and by grilling it a bit more, it add in to the flavour. Taste awesome!

The set meal also comes with 4 different type of sauces. Personally, I'm in love with their curry sauce. Goes super well with the beef and the rice.

The staff is really attentive, and will come to refill our cabbage since it's free flow. Same goes to the miso soup, you may request for a refill too!

They do have other side dishes like deep fried salmon fillet too. You will like that.

Strongly recommend this restaurant if you are a beef lover!
sample_reviews_en.author: Juztin Png

sample_reviews_en.text:
I never gave 1 star to any restaurant but this time i admit that the restaurant management has such big problems. Please accept my feedback.
- Staff who welcome us in front of the shop lack of knowledge to explain the menu’s details. They don’t even know the original country of beef. I have to wait for the answer.
- when i walk inside i can smell smoke very strong around the restaurant . How come this happened in newly opened restaurant.
- my gyukatsu was cut with uncommon size compared with my friend’s dish (we ordered the same thing but they cut like unprofessional. Some pieces were too thin. Some were too thick) i put my high hope on Japanese food quality.
- i strongly smell cooking oil on my dish and it looks like the oil’s temperature wasn’t high enough for frying. To be honest, other gyukatsu shops have better results

Disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pratthana Wongsiri (Pooh)

sample_reviews_en.text:
TLDR: Don’t dine here if you want the best Gyukatsu experience. Nothing is the same as the OG branches in Japan.

The food was edible at best. The only thing that’s the same from Japan is the restaurant name. The sauces (especially the signature sauce) and soups are not the same. The selection of meats are cut too thick and the staffs rush the customers to leave the table by keeping the pans exactly right after. Also, the pan (different from original) is shared per table not per the order. The service was adequate. The staff’s recommendation is also pretty useless and sounds unenthusiastic. They also “push” you very hard to add their LINE@ to get unlimited soup and rice refills is just baffling, the originals are complimentary as it should have been.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benjamin N.

sample_reviews_en.text: When we arrived, there were only 4 tables occupied including us; it wasn't crowded at all. However, everything took a very long time. We asked for extra dipping sauce twice from 2 different staff members, and only got it when we were almost finished eating. We had to ask for the bill twice, waiting a very long time because no one was looking at us. The first time, a staff member nodded, but we waited a long time and they didn't come to collect the money. So we called another staff member to collect the money, and that person told us to go pay at the counter ourselves. I felt very disappointed with the service. I really regret having to pay the 10% service charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tsuda Ram

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food and excellent service. The staff were very attentive, constantly asking if we wanted refills. We ordered the A5 Wagyu set, which came with a promotion including a bottle of sake and champagne. The atmosphere was great, not too crowded. The Wagyu was delicious, but eating too much can be cloying, so the sake helps cut through the richness. There was a wide variety of dipping sauces available. Rice, vegetables, and sauces were unlimited refills. However, there aren't many branches; this one requires a walk from Siam Paragon or CentralWorld, but it's not too far and good for digestion.
sample_reviews_en.author: essengent

restaurants.name: Shoko Omakase
restaurants.address:

248 Phahonyothin Rd, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Reading the Google reviews left me with mixed feelings but we still decided to try it anyhow.
It was an great experience as Chef Mos was humble and humorous. This was an experience that didn’t get in Nobu, KL few years back.
I’ve only had omakase once in the past (Nobu) but I think this was much better than that if you compare the ingredients, experience and price.

We booked platinum course 2499thb but do note it excludes drinks and 10%+7% service charge and tax.
It had 17 courses includes chawan mushi, assorted sashimi(s), engawa tempura, assorted nigiri(s), Hokkaido scallop & unagi hand rolls, wagyu sushi, kani miso, soup, and desserts.

The desserts were mediocre and the uni wasn’t as fresh as compared to the one I had in Osaka’s market & donki sushi store in Malaysia… looking at other reviews it seemed that the dishes are more or less the same so it seems like a set meal instead of omakase using freshest ingredients. Therefore the 4 stars. Would like to note that the flavours of the engawa tempura, Hokkaido scallop hand roll & wagyu sushi were really good!

🗓04/05/2023
sample_reviews_en.author: Felixia Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The overall experience was amazing! The Omakase offerings were interesting. Ingredients felt fresh, food presentation met my expectation. Chef seemed well-trained and knowledgeable about the food. He also asked for feedback at the end of the Omakase session.

Only two things I would ask to improve on is the details for each of the Omakase course levels (couldn't tell what the difference were while I was making the reservation) and the reservation process (Seems a bit complicated still: I called then was asked to add line, and had to type in a lot of details, and transfered deposit).

Would still come back to this restaurant for another visit, but some other Omakase restaurants have simpler process. 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Patt Nitikarn

sample_reviews_en.text: Shoko Omakase continues to impress on my second visit🥰The meticulous craftsmanship, premium ingredients, and elegant presentation make it an unforgettable dining experience. Every bite, from the melt-in-your-mouth toro to the rich uni, was exceptional. The welcoming drink was a refreshing touch, and the personalized glasses added a special charm. The hand sushi service elevated the experience, making it feel intimate and exclusive. A heartfelt thank you for the complimentary belated birthday dessert—such a thoughtful gesture! I truly appreciate the warm hospitality and attention to detail. I’ll definitely be back for another round of this exquisite omakase experience🫶🏻💕
sample_reviews_en.author: Juvie Jay

sample_reviews_en.text:
Summary: The food is good, but the service is really average.
The fish and meat paired with sushi are all rich in fat and have a great taste, but unfortunately, they are brushed with too much soy sauce, resulting in each taste being very similar.
But I was pleasantly surprised to have a combination of scallops, fish roe, and seaweed, which surprised me very much.
The combination of 1499BH is not reasonable, there is no appetizer, and the service is basically not felt.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miya MA

sample_reviews_en.text:
An entry level Omakase restaurant. We had a platinum course that consisted of 17 menus which was pretty affordable for such course. The raw materials were fresh but nothing fancy nor eye opening.

I personally think that sushi would be better if they were slightly bigger both the rice and the fish. Other than is was pretty okay. I left this place with half filled stomach though. A strong 3.5/5.0 for this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: apiwatbob

sample_reviews_en.text: Came to try Gold course (1,899++), they claimed to be 17 courses but in reality I think it’s like 12 or less as some items shouldn’t count as a course. Ingredients are not premium, they are fresh and taste decent still though. Chef did not provide insightful information, which is the real charm of omakase. Overall no impressive dish. Price is mid-range, affordable, but I wouldn’t return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ernst J

sample_reviews_en.text:
Not so impressed by the quality of the ingredients - lack of freshness.
Satisfaction Score: 4/7

The restaurant offers an affordable Omakase course. The chef is friendly, however, forgets to present what he’s making for us. Overall experience is okay. The restaurant is quite spacious and parking lots are available. There are private room provided for groups too.
sample_reviews_en.author: HUNGRY MHOOTOON

sample_reviews_en.text: Good experience indeed, fresh ingredients. Upon booking (online) staff tried to upsell with another course which i felt like too much. We came early so needed to wait just a bit. Chef is professional, can go into details of each course. Silver course is composed with 14 course which quite ok for me (1499++). 2/14 course were quite simple, but the rest is fine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawinee Santichalanan

restaurants.name: Ms.Jigger
restaurants.address:

Kimpton Maa-Lai Bangkok, 78 Soi Ton Son, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Beautiful atmosphere and excellent service. A special mention to Oxygen, who was absolutely lovely and took such great care of us. 🤍

Today, we tried their Afternoon Tea Set and also ordered tea and decaf coffee to enjoy alongside it. The tea was wonderfully fragrant, and the coffee was surprisingly good—even without the caffeine, it was still such a treat! ☕️

The pastries in the set tasted nice and were beautifully presented, just as you would expect from a proper Afternoon Tea.

Overall, a lovely place to spend a relaxing afternoon with good tea, coffee, and a beautiful atmosphere. ✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Nobody butfood

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited because I wanted to have a leisurely lunch.
I used the unlimited antipasto plan and tried three kinds, all of which were delicious, especially the focaccia. The staff were also very attentive.
Towards the end of my visit, many people came for high tea, and both the terrace and indoors were bustling with a pleasant atmosphere. I was pressed for time afterward, so I only stayed for about two hours, but I wished I could have stayed longer.
sample_reviews_en.author: 漆原絵美

sample_reviews_en.text:
Throughly enjoyed the meal! Especially as they were friendly and open, and the nice lady serving us, Folk, really knew their stuff. I appreciated how they helped us navigate the menu, patiently addressed any questions, and even joked around with my aunt, who was a bit grouchy that day, and had her laughing and cheered. They also helped us customise a few dishes that we asked for.

It’s quite a bit of a walk in, so do consider taking a car!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jamie Wong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food/desserts taste good, perfect for those who like sweet flavors. The service staff were excellent; Khun Fai explained the menu details well. They provided good privacy but still checked on us periodically.
The atmosphere was nice, suitable for chatting with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vi S

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is amazing! Food is delicious, and every aspect of the Italian cuisine is well taken care of. The music and the ambiance are on spot.
Maii and Boss were great with their kind, gentle and friendly service. Will keep coming!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Maria y Lucas Naranjo Erbes

sample_reviews_en.text: Khun Mai, the Assistant Manager, is doing a great job. She really pays attention to what we need and tries to notice if there’s anything we’re missing. I really like the way things are managed here. It’s been a great experience! Omotenashi
sample_reviews_en.author: pathara kradumporn

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was absolutely delicious, and K’Mai was such a wonderful host! She was incredibly warm, attentive, and welcoming, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable. Everything was perfect, and we had such a lovely time! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattawan Tanasongsrem

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time at this restaurant because I'm a fan of Chef Danedo. The food was incredibly delicious, and the service was excellent and attentive to detail, especially from Mai and Oxygen. I really want to come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fiona Weng

restaurants.name: Kruabansuan Pattaya
restaurants.address:

Thep Prasit 5/1 Alley, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This lovely garden restaurant Kruabansuan Pattaya is located in Thepprasit road soi 5. It’s a quiet area not far from the busy Thepprasit main street next to Kheha condo complex. If you are looking for a cosy place with nice fresh food and beverages and reasonable prices you are very welcome here. 🙏😊🙏
The staff is very friendly and the service is very fast! That’s why i come with friends from my badminton club and other friends often to Kruabansuan Pattaya to enjoy our time and have dinner in the beautiful and lovely garden restaurant! Everybody who was once here will come back for sure! 😊
It’s a romantic place for two as well as a wonderful place for events like birthdays or similar highlights! I realised that many thai people but also many Farangs with their Thai wifes or friends like this inviting place. Their comments are all positive! Especially because of the great staff and the variety of food anf last but not least because of the good prices in such a beautiful environment! 🙏😊🙏
My recommendation: Have a visit to this lovely place and the friendly staff! You will get what you are looking for! You will not regret! 🙏😊🙏Not forget the ice cream before you leave! 😊😊😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Joachim Krepf

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really wanted to like this place after driving past every day. The staff were friendly but unfortunately the Thai food was horrible, firstly the fried rice was sweet we had to order another portion without sugar!
The lady highly recommended the chicken cashew nuts, which sadly turned out to be the worse I've ever tried. None of the usual ingredients were used they seem to have made up their own recipe for this classic and it was horrible. Sorry. Please employ a professional Thai chef and stop using auntie
sample_reviews_en.author: Drew B

sample_reviews_en.text:
The place is nice, clean and shady inside, and it's pleasant to be there. It was a busy day, and the food took a while to arrive.
The shrimp fried rice was well-cooked and tasty, but the shrimp themselves weren't very tasty.
The chicken with cashews had a lot of practically raw, pungent onions, which ruined the experience. The papaya salad was good, but we asked for it to be mild. It was still quite spicy, which was fine for me, but those who don't like spicy food will be completely uncomfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karolina Zvereva

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍽️ The food is absolutely delicious 😍😍😍. Every dish is perfectly balanced and delicious. The flavors aren't too strong, making it easy to eat and perfect for families. The food comes out quickly, with no long waits. Plus, the prices are incredibly affordable.
🛻 Parking is convenient, available both in front of the restaurant and in the lot across the street.
👧🏻 The staff are friendly and prompt.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwankaww Kwankwan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a great little outdoor dining spot with a garden-feeling setting. It's just a little ways off of a busy street. Somehow, to be ao close to that more major street, it was largely very quiet and comfortable.
This IS a Thai restaurant, and there were only a very few dishes on the menu that were labeled in English!
I do, however, highly recommend this place! I will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Micheal Millsaps

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! The flavors were perfectly balanced and every dish was tasty. The food came out quickly; we didn't have to wait long. There's a small play area for children, making it suitable for groups of all sizes. Parking is convenient, both in front of the restaurant and in the lot across the street. The staff provided excellent and prompt service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nirana Pitiopaspong

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant guarantees delicious food. The service is excellent and the food tastes great. Recommended dishes include the crispy pork stir-fried with chili and salt. The papaya salad is also delicious. And the spicy pork rib soup is absolutely amazing. If you come to Pattaya, I highly recommend this restaurant. 😋😋 …
sample_reviews_en.author: วิณณ์พาไป : กิน เที่ยว มูเตลู

sample_reviews_en.text: Located in a quieter part of Pattaya, this place was a hidden gem. My Husband and I ordered shrimp fried rice, stir fried vegetables and crispy pork belly and we must say every dish was delicious and full of flavour. Portion sizes were decent and service was friendly. Food came out so quickly as well. A must visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Gloria Tran

restaurants.name: Medici Playhouse Italian Restaurant & Bar Bangkok
restaurants.address:

55, 55/555 โรงแรมมิวส์ กรุงเทพฯ 555 Lang Suan Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
❤️ Romantic Dinner Restaurants
Perfect for a date night in the heart of Bangkok.

Looking for a place to take your special someone for dinner? We recommend trying Medici Playhouse Italian Restaurant & Bar Bangkok, a beautifully decorated Italian restaurant located inside Hotel Muse Bangkok Langsuan, Autrograph Collection.

It's like stepping back into Renaissance Florence 🇮🇹✨. The atmosphere is luxurious and classic, with dim lighting, creating a romantic and private ambiance. Live music is especially enjoyable in the evenings. (Every Wednesday–Saturday from 7:00 PM) Make your dinner even more colorful and romantic ❤️

Today, I enjoyed the ❤️ Romantic Dinner Package at Medici Playhouse. It's a 5-course dinner specially curated for couples, perfect for anniversaries, birthdays, special occasions, or even a date night without waiting for a special event! 🥂
sample_reviews_en.author: Nijjawan Iamsa-ard

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu and pictures gives impression that the place is luxury and great but the food is terrible!! OMG nothing was worth the money. Even simple chicken was chewy and low quality - I took 1 bite from the chicken and I didn't eat it and still paid 850 bth. We ordered more food but it was less than average. OVERPRICED. You can find any street food better than this. But I didn't give 1 star because of the service which was good and the girl helped me to surprise my girlfriend with an urgent request for birthday. But the food and the price totally not worth it. Also if you will pay me I will not eat that food. Sorry I really expected to a better culinary experience. 3600 for a couple.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mor

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was very impressed with Medici restaurant. From the moment I stepped in, I felt the luxurious, warm, and romantic atmosphere. The restaurant is beautifully decorated in every corner, and the Italian food was delicious.
What impressed me most was the service from the staff. Everyone was smiling, friendly, and attentive to customers, especially Ning, Joy, Bam, and Mandiff, who took care of us warmly throughout the meal. They provided professional menu recommendations and service, making us feel very welcome.
Thank you for the wonderful experience. It's definitely a restaurant I want to return to, and I will definitely recommend Medici to my friends and family. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: wanisa chaiburee

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was my birthday dinner here, and the whole experience was truly elegant and beautiful. ✨

First, the atmosphere was absolutely stunning. The restaurant is beautifully designed, with such an elegant artistic touch, and it’s definitely a great place for photos. 📸

Next, the food—everything we ordered was absolutely delicious. Each dish was beautifully presented and tasted amazing.

Lastly, the service. A huge thank you to all the staff for making my birthday dinner even more special. Especially Ning, Gan, and Mamdeep—you guys were amazing and made the evening so memorable.

Thank you so much for making my birthday dinner such a wonderful experience. 🤍✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Suraya Ha

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had an absolutely wonderful evening at Medici Playhouse. The atmosphere was beautifully decorated with a gothic yet cozy vibe, and the live music really elevated the whole experience.

The food and cocktails were decent, but what stood out the most was the service. The staff were warm, attentive, and easy to talk to. Special thanks to Khun Gan, Khun Ning, Khun Mandeep, and Khun Joy for taking such great care of us!

Definitely worth a visit. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Phanatcha Thedthong

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant was beautiful with a wonderful atmosphere. The food was delicious and beautifully presented. The staff were excellent—warm, attentive, and friendly. Special praise goes to Ning and Joy; their service made me feel incredibly welcome. The music was also lovely, enhancing the entire dining experience with a pleasant and happy feeling. Overall, a fantastic experience! I'm truly satisfied! I'll definitely come back again! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Nooni Bn

sample_reviews_en.text: The stylish and relaxed atmosphere was wonderful. The food and wine were delicious, and although I only intended to have a light meal, I ended up ordering another dish. I highly recommend it for a wonderful time. The staff member who served us had a lovely smile, and Bam Ning Mandeep Petch truly soothed me in this foreign land. Thank you for the delicious meal! I recommend it. Next time, I'd like to try the meat dishes too…
sample_reviews_en.author: Ishiguro

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had such a wonderful evening at Medici Playhouse Italian Restaurant & Bar. The Italian food was delicious, the atmosphere was beautiful and the cocktails were absolutely amazing.

What really made the night special was the service. A big thank you to Joy, who took care of me throughout the entire evening. She was incredibly attentive, friendly, and genuinely caring, making sure everything was perfect from beginning to end.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phothirat Oakkharaphon

restaurants.name: Old German Beerhouse on 11
restaurants.address:

11, GF Eleven hotel, Sukhumvit 11 Aly, Kloengtoei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Enjoyed every second of our visit to Old German Beer House 11. The place has a wonderful old-school charm that’s becoming increasingly rare these days. Instead of focusing on fancy décor or gimmicks, they have stayed true to what really matters—serving delicious food and creating a warm, welcoming atmosphere.

The menu offers an excellent variety of dishes, and everything we ordered was fresh, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. Every bite reflected the care and consistency that comes from years of experience. The portions were generous, and the quality of the ingredients was evident.

Whether you’re stopping by for a casual meal with friends or simply looking for authentic comfort food, this is definitely a place worth visiting. Great food, prompt service, reasonable prices, and a nostalgic ambiance make it an easy recommendation. Looking forward to coming back and trying more from their extensive menu!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anant Naik

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Old German Beerhouse is like a little piece of Germany right in the heart of Bangkok. A cozy atmosphere, decent beer, and a menu with many German classics.

The food is good, the portions are generous, and if you suddenly crave something hearty after spending a while in Thailand, this is the place to go. Of course, nobody comes to Bangkok to eat only German food – but sometimes you just need it. 😄

The service is friendly, and the atmosphere is pleasant and relaxed. A great spot for a cold beer and German food amidst the hustle and bustle of Bangkok.

And let's be honest: as much as I love Thai cuisine, at some point, my inner German takes over. And it doesn't want a spring roll. It wants schnitzel and beer. 🍺
sample_reviews_en.author: Timm Brenzel

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited a German restaurant on Sukhumvit Soi 11. The first thing that surprised me was how delicious the beer was. The ice-cold Weizen had a creamy head, making me feel happy even in the middle of the day. The sausages were juicy and tasty, but what made an even bigger impact were the sauerkraut and mashed potatoes served as a side dish. They were much larger than I expected and had a presence worthy of being the main course. This is a must-visit for beer lovers! 🍺🇩🇪
sample_reviews_en.author: SH A

sample_reviews_en.text: A nice place with a typical German atmosphere. Very friendly service. The food is a matter of taste; with my pork schnitzel and mushroom sauce, the fries were by far the best part. Maybe I should have ordered some kind of sausage; you can't really go wrong with those. So I'd go back for a beer. Probably not for a meal. Logically speaking, it's not exactly smart to go to a German restaurant in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andreas Trummer

sample_reviews_en.text: Stopped for a quick lunch.  They had the F1 race on so we took the girls.  Good german beer selection.  We had schnitzel, schpetzel, bratwurst and a pretzel.  Schnitzel and brat were great.  Pretzel was a little small, but fine.  Schpetzel was dry.   Its open air, but plenty of fans so no biggie for us.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sean Fisk (Mr Fisk Teaches)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've rarely eaten so well. In some ways, I think it's even better than in Germany itself. I'm from Munich, and here you pay half the price for a meal that's actually better than in Munich.

I'm completely convinced; every German should try it.

Typical German classics are playing in the background.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benno H

sample_reviews_en.text: After months of traveling in Asia, I always love coming back to Bangkok just to eat some German food. I've been here countless times and never once been disappointed—quite the opposite, in fact. The quality is consistently high. Keep up the good work, both in the kitchen and the service! 5/5 stars
sample_reviews_en.author: Stefan Engeli

sample_reviews_en.text: The schnitzel was perfect. The breading and meat were excellent. The cucumber salad was okay. The server was quick and attentive. Unfortunately, she didn't know whether the house wine was a white Chardonnay, a Grigio, or something else. It still tasted good, though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Franz Xaver

restaurants.name: Waree Thara Seafood วารีธารา ซีฟู้ด
restaurants.address:

1280, 1282 Banthat Thong Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely delicious! Every single dish was amazing. The ingredients were fresh; the prawns were huge, fresh, and crispy; the squid wasn't chewy at all; the fried mackerel was perfectly crispy and edible whole; the stir-fried squid with salted egg was incredibly flavorful; and the fried pork neck was the best!!!🤤🤤🤤🥇🥇 Even the papaya salad and fried chicken were delicious. Don't miss the crab omelet either. In short, everything was truly delicious.🩷🩷🩷 I'm saying it a million times over!
sample_reviews_en.author: Hi kitty

sample_reviews_en.text: I came to this restaurant based on reviews. The service was good. The must-try dish is the fried mackerel, which is truly delicious. The food has a moderate flavor, nothing outstanding. We ordered many dishes and couldn't finish them all, so we were allowed to take the leftovers home. They accept credit cards, but there's a surcharge. I recommend paying with cash or via bank transfer app.
sample_reviews_en.author: Papangkorn Pavakanun

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has two floors. The first floor is small, and most of the customers are locals. The owner speaks fluent English and a little Mandarin.

It's really delicious 😋😍😍, I highly recommend the salted egg yolk squid rings 👍👍👍💕 Everything is delicious!

The owner is very warm and sincere, and he paid attention to whether we thought the food was good or not.

Highly recommended!!
sample_reviews_en.author: 钟逸杰

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate there a month ago and only just got around to reviewing it. I don't know why I'm praising it so much, but I can personally confirm that the quality is superb. Both the pomfret and the fried mackerel (which you can eat whole) are amazing – I've never had anything like it anywhere else in Thailand before. I can honestly say it was incredibly delicious. I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: เบ๊น อาปาเช่

sample_reviews_en.text: We came to this restaurant based on reviews. The food looked great, the ratings were good, and the prices weren't too high, so we decided to try it. It was exactly as advertised! The food was delicious, the restaurant was quiet and peaceful, and the prices were reasonable. I highly recommend trying it. I didn't get a chance to take pictures of the food because it was so good!
sample_reviews_en.author: CNXPrime ‘

sample_reviews_en.text: The set meal is incredibly good value at 999 baht. It includes Tom Yum soup, squid, a large steamed fish with soy sauce, and a whole fried mackerel that you can eat straight from the pot. Before you know it, the plate is empty! You absolutely have to order the mackerel dish.
sample_reviews_en.author: small a

sample_reviews_en.text: Had an amazing meal here tonight. Took the squid in black ink sauce, crab fried rice and morning glory. Such a simple meal yet so full of flavour and the staff were so friendly. Highly recommend this place and best of all the food was so affordable
sample_reviews_en.author: Panida Keophaithool

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious, I'd order it again and again! The squid in black ink sauce was amazing. Two people ate it and needed extra rice! Very impressed. The price was also okay, reasonable. We ordered three dishes and a pot of rice for less than 1000 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: ไม่อยากไปมอ ไม่อยากไปมอ

restaurants.name: Gorilla Grill โยธินบูรณะ
restaurants.address:

1080 ถ. ประชาราษฎร์สาย1 Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered through Foodpanda, and the restaurant canceled my order, refusing to accept it. I'm not sure if that's even possible. They refused the customer, giving the excuse that they had too many orders. Since they don't want to sell to me, I don't want to buy from them either. I've blocked that restaurant permanently. Even if it's nearby, I won't go there again. Refusing a customer's order is unacceptable. Even if it was an online order and they didn't meet in person, they might think canceling it is okay, but they forgot that this was a frequent customer, a customer who lives nearby. They might think turning away a customer once is harmless, but it has long-term consequences. And don't forget, customers spread the word about your restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐสุดา อนันตมงคลกุล

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordering the "Four Friends" chicken breast platter was good value; you got a lot of meat, and it was well-fried and grilled – delicious! The minced pork basil stir-fry was a large portion but the taste was just okay. There was free tom yum chicken soup available, which was decent and had plenty of juicy chicken. The strawberry shaved ice was a bit too sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthaphong Phaewbuntra

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually order through Line Man, and the food is delicious. Today I had the chance to stop by the restaurant. I love the mashed potatoes and the herb-grilled Dolly fish steak, while my child orders the pork steak – those are our regular orders.
sample_reviews_en.author: จิตรานนท์ นนทเบญจวรรณ

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has the best steak in the Bang Pho area. The steaks are huge and it's been a staple in this neighborhood for a long time. I recommend everyone try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirimukda Srikaew

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the prices are reasonable. I've been eating here since I was a student, and now that I'm working, it's still as delicious as ever.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawanrat Jinakulwipat

sample_reviews_en.text: The steak was tender, the sauce was delicious and rich, the mashed potatoes were good, and the salad was fresh. Overall, it was okay and worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: namzom c

sample_reviews_en.text: The instant noodles were super spicy, and the stir-fried basil chicken in a large bowl was delicious and very filling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pikkatar Rodcharoen

sample_reviews_en.text: Great! Delicious food, nice atmosphere. A restaurant I used to eat at when I was a kid; full of memories…
sample_reviews_en.author: Wattaneenan Changkeb

restaurants.name: Miss India Restaurant
restaurants.address:

69 71 Chulalongkorn 3 Alley, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Having spent over ten years reviewing all kinds of places, I've learned that a great meal isn't just about the food. It's also about the entire experience, including the final bill. My recent visit to Miss India in Pathum Wan was a good example of this.

First, let's talk about the food. I tried the "Happy Special Deal," and it was truly delicious. The flavors were spot on, making it a real treat. The staff were very friendly and welcoming, which is a big plus that makes a meal more enjoyable.

However, a couple of things stood out that potential diners should know. The naan bread that came with the meal was quite small and thin, so I ordered another one for 100 baht, which felt a bit pricey. The biggest surprise came when the bill arrived. While the food itself wasn't the most expensive I've had, the menu prices don't include VAT (Value Added Tax). This is added at the end, making the final price a little higher than you might expect.

Overall, if you're looking for tasty Indian food with friendly service, Miss India delivers. Just be ready for the final price to be a bit more than you thought because of the extra costs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vivian Lal

sample_reviews_en.text:
My experience at Miss India restaurant was extremely disappointing. The food was completely below the standard of authentic Indian cuisine. For instance, the chicken lollipop was nothing like it should be—it felt more like a basic pakora rather than the proper preparation and taste you expect from this dish.

The overall quality of the food was simply pathetic and did not justify the name or expectations of an Indian restaurant.

On top of that, the service made things worse. The person taking the order seemed uninterested, just nodding without explaining anything or helping with recommendations. There was no proper interaction or effort to assist, which reflects very poorly on the service standards.

Overall, this was a 100% negative experience. Poor food and equally poor service—I would not recommend this place to anyone looking for genuine Indian cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manik Dhar

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a wonderful dining experience at Miss India Restaurant in #Bangkok ✨

We absolutely loved the Chicken Kadai – rich, aromatic, and perfectly spiced. The Fish Curry ( medium spicy ) was equally impressive, fresh and flavorful with a well-balanced gravy.
Tried Aloo Palak for the first time here and it was surprisingly delicious – simple, comforting, and full of flavor.
Authentic Indian taste, great quality food, and a pleasant ambience. Definitely a place we’ll keep coming back to. Highly recommended for anyone craving real Indian food in Bangkok!
Special thanks to Mr Pardeep for the warm hospitality and attentive service that made our dining experience even more enjoyable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anishta Takoor

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went for dinner and found everything to be amazing! The decor was lovely and there was aircon. Loved the bollywood music videos in the background. The service was friendly and prompt. Most importantly - the food was really good! Be mindful some of the items are quite warm with spice, but had so much flavour! They offered us a free taste of an appetiser too which was delicious, and we got some free sesame dessert things which were really nice. Highly recommend this restaurant, and I would happily come back.

As an FYI, that night (Thursday) there were cute street markets a few streets over near the 711. Not sure what nights they run but they were well worth the walk.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rebecca Wilkinson

sample_reviews_en.text:
.	“A spice lover’s paradise! Authentic flavors, perfect ambiance, and impeccable service. This is the go-to spot for true Indian cuisine!
From the fragrant biryanis to the creamy curries, every dish is a masterpiece. Highly recommended for anyone craving a taste of India.
The tandoori was flavorful, A delightful experience from start to finish.Hands down the best Indian food in town. The attention to detail and authenticity is unmatched. A must-visit for foodies.

Great food paired with amazing service! The friendly and helpful staff made our dining experience even better.”
sample_reviews_en.author: rakesh shah

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had such a pleasant dining experience here! The staff were friendly, attentive, and sweet, making me feel very welcome from the moment I stepped in.

The food was flavorful and rich with authentic Indian taste every bite felt hearty and satisfying. To finish, I indulged in a traditional Indian dessert, which was the perfect sweet ending to the meal.

⭐ Must-try recommendation: Don’t miss out on the Panipuri! It’s fun, refreshing, and absolutely delicious.

Overall, a delightful spot if you’re craving genuine Indian flavors paired with warm hospitality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nichkan Peem

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was very impressed! Every dish at this restaurant was delicious and perfectly suited to my taste. The atmosphere was also great, ideal for a special meal with family or friends.

I loved the presentation of the food, especially the pani puri served in a cute little shot glass – so easy to eat! The naan bread was also excellent, fragrant and perfectly soft. Everything was just perfect.

If you're looking for a restaurant with flavorful food and beautiful decor, you absolutely must not miss this place. I definitely want to go back and try other dishes!
sample_reviews_en.author: Somogyi Ildikó

sample_reviews_en.text: I didn't like my dish; there was an ingredient that gave it an unpleasant flavor, and the vegetables were oily. I asked to exchange it for another dish, and they brought me something else, but not the dish I wanted (I wanted the vegetable yogurt). I get the impression that in Thailand, people deliberately misunderstand or only give me what suits them. At least they made a gesture and only charged me for the second dish, but I had to insist. For me, it's obvious that when a dish is inedible, you should be able to exchange it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Laurence B

restaurants.name: El Santo Mexican Restaurant & Bar
restaurants.address:

ข้างใน โนโวเทล ลิฟวิ่ง กรุงเทพฯ ลีแกซี, 12/14, 29 Sukhumvit 29 Alley, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honestly, one of the best dining experiences I’ve had in Bangkok!

I’ve been in Thailand for more than 20 days and have visited so many different restaurants, but El Santo really stood out to me. The Mexican-style atmosphere is beautiful, the food was really good, and the drinks were amazing.

But what I appreciated the most was the service and hospitality from Mike and Pawan. They were so friendly, helpful, and welcoming throughout my visit. Their service made me feel really comfortable and taken care of.

After trying so many restaurants during my trip, I can honestly say I haven’t experienced this kind of service anywhere else. It wasn’t just good service — they genuinely made my evening special.

Thank you, El Santo, for the amazing food, drinks, and especially the wonderful service. Mike and Pawan, thank you for making my Bangkok experience even better!

Definitely a place I would come back to and recommend to anyone visiting Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jose

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing Dinner at El Santo 🌮🍹

We had such a great dinner at El Santo today! When we arrived, I was honestly surprised to see that the indoor area was completely full. We saw the live music and really wanted to sit inside, but unfortunately there were no tables available.

We started outside for the first round, and later moved indoors. That’s when we had an even more amazing experience with the food, atmosphere, and especially the service.

A special mention to Mike, who gave me one of the best services I’ve ever experienced in Bangkok. He was friendly, attentive, and made our dinner feel really special.

I’ll definitely be coming back—not only for the amazing food, but also for Mike! ❤️🌮🍸
sample_reviews_en.author: Jhon Jonny

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing food and excellent customer service! Everything was delicious and beautifully prepared. The atmosphere was great, the staff friendly, and the food very tasty. A lovely place with high-quality food and service. The staff was very welcoming and attentive. Delicious food in a great location, highly recommended! A wonderful experience from start to finish. The perfect place to enjoy a relaxing and pleasant meal. The service was quick, friendly, and professional. I truly enjoyed the food and would gladly return. Especially, Bawan, thank you so much for your excellent service!
sample_reviews_en.author: Marko

sample_reviews_en.text:
Novotel guests get a 10% discount. I stayed at a lot of Accor hotels on this trip... If I had known this, I should have signed up for a paid membership.

The tacos are only 10cm in diameter lol. I was shocked... The taste is just average.

I think the price is on the expensive side.

I was shocked because the tacos were so small... haha. The atmosphere is nice, and they keep refilling the nachos, which really makes you want to drink ^,^

It feels like I want to dance and have fun, but I'm just tapping my feet internally.

Oh, and the staff were very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: 션방가

sample_reviews_en.text: We ate here out of convenience due to staying at the Novotel, we usually only eat local food whilst overseas. We were so shocked by the standard of food, hands down the best Mexican I have eaten outside of Mexico!! Everything exceeded my expectations, seriously such great flavours in each bite! Highly recommend eating here food was 10/10! Compliments to the chefs! Pawan was an excellent server and even gave us some complimentary corn for our baby! 🇲🇽
sample_reviews_en.author: Kylie Hall

sample_reviews_en.text: We needed a break from Thai food and El Santo was conveniently located at our hotel, so we gave it a try. Really glad we did — the food was great, and our waiter, Pawan, went out of his way to make sure we were well looked after, especially our two small (and not always easy) children, keeping them happy and entertained throughout the meal. Really friendly service and a very enjoyable dinner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom Motoyoshi Kalland

sample_reviews_en.text: The quality of the Mexican food was terrible and overpriced. The chips were old and stale. The salsa was not Mexican. I think it was Indian sauce. The cheapest bottle of water was 180 THB. The bill included a 10 percent service charge for terrible quality food. The food was not fresh or delicious and probably the worst Mexican food I ever tasted.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ginew

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had the taco tasting and everything was so delicious and fresh, no time to take pictures 😄
The atmosphere is amazing too: beautiful decor, great ambiance, and live music that made the whole evening feel extra special.
Special thanks to the band for making our night even better!
Definitely a place we’ll be coming back to 🌮✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Yulia Mazanova

restaurants.name: Oyster Mania
restaurants.address:

3/17-18 Soi Sukhumvit 31 Sukhumvit Road, Klongtoey, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was good, but the service definitely needs improvement. I came with my husband, and we expected our main courses to be served at the same time. Unfortunately, my dish and his dish arrived at different times, which made the dining experience less enjoyable. For a restaurant of this standard, the timing and coordination of the service should be better managed.

More importantly, there was a serious issue regarding the ingredients. We specifically do not eat pork. My husband ordered the oyster asparagus and mushroom risotto, and there was nothing on the menu indicating that the dish contained pork. However, when it was served, we discovered that pork was actually included as an ingredient.

This is extremely important. If a dish contains pork, it should be clearly stated on the menu, especially as many guests may avoid pork for dietary, religious, or personal reasons. Customers should not have to discover this only after the food has been served. I strongly recommend that the restaurant review its menu descriptions and ensure that the staff clearly inform guests of ingredients that may not be obvious from the name or description of the dish.
sample_reviews_en.author: yaowarote klinboon

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a Japanese restaurant we found online and decided to make a reservation for. The Japanese owner personally greeted us and took care of our table. The restaurant is very small with only a few seats.

It's located near Phrom Phong, so parking is quite difficult as you have to go down a side street.

Upon arrival, all the staff were very welcoming. Their menu is quite substantial, and we tried the creamy omelet rice. They mentioned that reservations are required in advance and they only serve one portion. The prices are quite high, but the food was incredibly delicious. They use high-quality ingredients.

Every dish was delicious; we ate everything and felt it was well worth the price. We were very impressed and satisfied. The oysters were fresh, and every dish was so good we couldn't stop eating – we were willing to gain weight!

If you plan to go, I recommend making reservations in advance for both seating and the creamy omelet rice. It's absolutely amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dainty biscuit

sample_reviews_en.text:
The sea urchin pasta was incredibly smooth, and the sauce was to my liking. However, the sea urchin itself was tiny and had a slight odor, perhaps because this restaurant specializes in oysters.

As for the oysters, they were a must-order. They lived up to the restaurant's reputation. This was my first experience with Japanese oysters, and I was very impressed. They were sweet, firm, and intensely flavorful. Compared to Fin de Claire, the taste and aroma were distinctly different.

The staff were all friendly and seemed attentive, but they seemed confused by our order, resulting in two or three incorrect dishes. They kept correcting the same item despite repeated explanations. It seems the staff were overly helpful, assuming that for a group of four, the food came out incorrectly, which I felt was unacceptable.

Overall, I was impressed, but my friend and I (two of us who ate) experienced stomach upset, so I have to deduct points for that.
sample_reviews_en.author: Janitsata T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
February 2026
I'd previously visited for lunch, but this time I finally made it for the evening meal.
Everything I ordered was delicious, and I ended up drinking way too much.
The staff seemed well-trained, and their service was excellent. I had a very pleasant meal.
This is a must-visit for oyster lovers.

December 2024
I hadn't had a chance to visit in a while, and I should have gone sooner.
This time I had lunch. I had the omelet rice with two fried oysters on top, and it was delicious. The rice was clam pilaf, and the sauce was a luxurious tongue stew.
You can order raw oysters individually, so there's no need to worry if you're going alone.
This suggests the evening meal will be great too.
sample_reviews_en.author: KA

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, prepared by a Japanese chef. The fluffy omelet was absolutely amazing – the flavor was perfect, creamy, and incredibly soft. The oysters were fresh and clean. The buffet menu was also good; while not extensive, the dishes were delicious, making it ideal for small groups or couples to try a variety of items. They have a wide selection of wines and sake. Parking is limited, so arrive early or inform the restaurant in advance. Overall, it was a great experience, and I would definitely go back. The chef was lovely, playful, and very friendly and talkative. The staff were also wonderful and provided excellent service. I plan to return for sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fttlouie

sample_reviews_en.text:
I loved it so much! It's perfect for oyster lovers. They have everything from fresh oysters to main dishes that feature oysters as the main ingredient. But ultimately, you have to try the truly fresh oysters. You don't need to add much; just a sprinkle of lemon juice and you can taste the natural sweetness of the oysters. They have every type and country imaginable, from Japan and France, etc.
The wine pairings are also carefully selected to pair perfectly with the oysters. And last but not least, the owner is incredibly welcoming, like a close friend you've known for ten years. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: S. Piw

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited Oyster Mania on Sukhumvit Soi 31 in Bangkok.

The appeal of this restaurant is the opportunity to compare various types of fresh oysters directly imported from Japan. This time, the oysters from Oita Prefecture's Oirijima Island were particularly delicious. They were rich, creamy, and full of flavor.

They also have oysters from other regions, such as Hokkaido, allowing you to enjoy the differences in taste. Besides oysters, the bagna cauda was also delicious, and the presentation was enjoyable.

This restaurant is highly recommended for oyster lovers. I would like to visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: SH A

sample_reviews_en.text:
Oyster Mania Bangkok is a fantastic place for anyone who loves oysters. The oysters were absolutely awesome, fresh, tasty and of excellent quality. You can really tell they care about the ingredients and the overall food quality.

The rest of the food was also very good, making it more than just an oyster spot. Everything we tried was well prepared and enjoyable. The staff were nice, friendly, and made the experience even better.

If you love oysters, this is definitely a place to visit in Bangkok. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Travel Ralph

sample_reviews_en.text: Thai Style restaurant comply with international dishes.The foods are good enough for party.I do suggest grilled chicken.

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was tasty and dishes was of generous portions. A bit pricey, but service was great so well worth it!

restaurants.address:

ตึกยุพินอพาร์ทเม้น 362/2-3 ระหว่าง 14 Phetchaburi 12, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It seems like none of the staff at this restaurant are Thai. I ordered plain soda with ice and asked for a lime wedge, and they served the lime slices on a separate plate with salt. I also ordered cooked beef larb without offal and double-checked to be sure, because I'm Thai and I could tell they weren't Thai, so I emphasized to avoid mistakes. They served a plate full of offal. When I asked about it, they said the staff member who took my order had already left, even though I saw them standing there. Then, when it came time to pay, I didn't eat the larb at all; I just looked at it and it was all tripe and offal. They charged me anyway. When I asked again, I said they should have apologized instead of lying and then just walking away, taking the larb off the bill and coming back. I didn't want a free meal because I didn't even eat it! So I told them to just take it and pay the full price, but I wanted an apology. That staff member just stood there for a while and said, "If you order larb, it has to include offal." Does that mean they don't understand Thai? I said I didn't want offal, but I saw them writing it down when they took my order! What were they writing down?
sample_reviews_en.author: Pronrudee Falcon

sample_reviews_en.text:
As a tourist, this isn’t exactly my “favorite spot,” but it’s definitely still a place with good food worth trying.

I saw some recent reviews saying the quality has dropped, so I was a bit hesitant before coming. After trying it myself, I still think the food is pretty good overall—definitely enjoyable. I guess taste really depends on personal preference.

I always feel that something as simple as an omelette is actually quite hard to make impressive, but their prawn omelette really stood out. It was genuinely delicious!!! The tom yum was also not too spicy—very mild and approachable, even for someone like me who can’t handle much spice ♡

For atmosphere, I’d give 4 stars. The only downside is a strange smell in the restaurant—maybe it’s bamboo shoots or something similar—but at times it does come across a bit like a urine-like odor, which was a little off-putting.

Overall, still a good dining experience because the food is solid.
sample_reviews_en.author: cheah cheah

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything was just okay, even among the countless choices in Thailand, this place left me a little disappointed.
I'm not used to eating Thai chicken, so it had a strong chicken smell 😭😭. It was very pungent. The toyu (chicken soup) wasn't flavorful. It wasn't bad, but it wasn't great either. The chicken at Pratunam Market is very, very strong, so if I had eaten there before, it was a bit disappointing here 🥹
The best dish was probably the pork jowl. It had a smoky aroma and was tender. The space looked like a hospital 🤨
Overall, it was okay as a quick meal, but I'd probably never choose to go there again 🙂‍↔️
sample_reviews_en.author: Khánh Linh Nguyễn

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place used to be amazing. I came here often with friends over the years, ever since university. I even took many new friends here, and everyone loved it.
But on my last visit, it seemed like the quality had dropped. The flavors weren't as intense, the papaya salad wasn't as spicy as before, and the Pad Thai was too sour. The fried duck beaks, however, were still delicious. I'd like to suggest that you try to maintain the quality you used to have, as I plan to return many more times.

I'm giving it 5 stars because it used to be so good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Quan Issara

sample_reviews_en.text:
Savior during the nights of our stay on the hotel nearby. The food tasted delicious, the dessert is quite sweet and savoury.

Touch screen menu (aka you dont have to speak or understand Thai language, just point what you want on the menu and the waiter/waitress understand you completely.

The price also affordable, the aircon works as it should so you can bring babies comfortably.
sample_reviews_en.author: Durrski

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food: fried somtam, seafood pad thai, grilled pork neck and sticky rice
=> cook super fast, within few minutes, all dishes tastw amazing, cannot complain anything, definately rcm
Price: reasonable, 100-600 baht, average 100-200/pax
Service: staff are nice, english not bad

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went late in the evening so the restaurant was quite empty. The food was delicious, the seafood was fresh. If you can't handle spicy food, remember to note that because some of the salads are quite spicy 🤤
The dishes I ate: pork jowl, pad thai, tom yum, squid salad, mango sticky rice ✌️
sample_reviews_en.author: Tú Nguyễn Khuê

sample_reviews_en.text: Horrible experience! The crab meat was mushy, the salmon looked dark and discolored, and the shrimp smelled rotten. None of the seafood was fresh at all. The quality is way worse than years before, while the prices are higher. Definitely not recommended 👎
sample_reviews_en.author: Zhao Wenlei

restaurants.name: CHARM Bistro and Restaurant
restaurants.address:

73 Sukhumvit 50 Aly, Prakanong, Klongteoi, Bangkok 10260, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "A good selection of Thai and Western Food well prepared and sensibly priced."

sample_reviews_en.text:
Finding great local food is one of the best parts of exploring a neighborhood. Located a mere five-minute stroll from my stay at Cross Vibe Bangkok Sukhumvit, Charm Bistro & Restaurant is a wonderful find. Nestled right next to a serene little canal, it features a lovely outdoor alfresco terrace next to a quiet river that provides a beautifully relaxed and casual backdrop for an easy dining experience.

The comforting, everyday Thai dishes are handled with impressive execution. The Chicken Soup with Coconut Milk & Galangal flawlessly balances rich creaminess with sharp, aromatic brightness. Equally superb is the Pad Thai, featuring perfectly textured noodles and remarkably plump prawns. For those who appreciate authentic vigor, the Pad Kra Pao Moo delivers a beautifully sharp, fiery kick of minced pork and holy basil. To finish, the Authentic Thai Milk Tea is exceptionally well-brewed creamy, deeply aromatic, and refreshing.

For an authentic, peaceful taste of Bangkok right by the water, this casual neighborhood spot earns my highest recommendation.

at.lifestyle
sample_reviews_en.author: Alvino Tuason

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice restaurant on Soi 50, food is tasty and well seasoned.
We had Som Tam, Duck Laab, Calamari all well made, fresh ingredients.
Pricing is very reasonable.
Location is good not too far from the BTS.

Updated review
I've been coming to Charm for a couple of years and always been very happy with the food, service and pricing.
Unfortunately things are not what the used to be!

The restaurant wasn't particularly busy but took quite a while to get the servers attention, more interested in talking amongst themselves.

The pricing on the menu remains largely the same but the portion size has shrunk quite dramatically, I believe this is referred to as shrinkflation
Just had some snacks but certainly not as good as on my previous visits.

Furthermore the are now adding 7% vat in addition to the 5% service charge, this wasn't the case previously.

When I put everything together I'm not sure if I can recommend Charm anymore,
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Solo

sample_reviews_en.text:
When I ordered the menu, I calculated that it would cost me a total of 1,332 baht (using a calculator app), but the female employee would add 110 baht, plus VAT or something like that, for a total of 1,601 baht.

I have a family with me and the conversation with the employee wasn't smooth because I'm a foreigner, so I just paid as I was charged, but now that I think about it, I'm disgusted and left a comment. Other food is delicious and the atmosphere isn't bad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kyuhyup Cho

sample_reviews_en.text: A hidden gem in Sukhumvit 50! The vibe here is incredibly cozy and welcoming, with both comfortable indoor seating and a lovely outdoor area. It’s the perfect spot to unwind with friends, enjoy a delicious meal, or have a few drinks in the evening. The owner and staff are super friendly and attentive. Highly recommend if you're looking for a chill spot in the area!
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyawan Jaidee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Perhaps because it was an awkward time, just before 4 PM, there was only one other customer. It looks like it will get crowded in the evening.

The steak was delicious. The sauce was spicy, probably because it's Thai food. I ordered mineral water, but maybe beer would have been better.

I was charged an extra fee, either tax or a seating charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: 旅蟻

sample_reviews_en.text:
You’ll always feel welcome when you visit this place. They have the very best service minded people. The food is great, the atmosphere is nice. We’ve been here almost every other week. You won’t regret it!!

PS. We’ve got a complimentary bottle of champagne. How generous the owner is!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Araya M

sample_reviews_en.text:
A typical Thai restaurant where the food is excellent. The "Spanish-style" prawns are delicious, and don't miss the soups and the "Spicy" rice dishes.

The staff is very friendly and helpful, and the prices are great! Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Matias Bo Girling

sample_reviews_en.text: 10/10 from me. This place is a real wee  gem - great food, very reasonable prices, lovely relaxed atmosphere and excellent friendly, professional service. You really have to try it - I know you will return 😀
sample_reviews_en.author: Brian Powrie

restaurants.address:

55 55 Phaya Thai Rd, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Unfortunately, we had a very bad experience at this restaurant. At first, they told us we would have to wait an hour for a table for two. However, we saw an empty table and pointed it out, after which we were allowed to sit down.

It took quite a while before they took our order, and unfortunately, the staff spoke very poor English, so communication was quite difficult. It also took a long time for the food to arrive.

The food itself was mediocre. Normally, it’s important to me to give restaurants a good review for their efforts, and I am being completely honest here. We never received part of our order, and no one came to check on us. This felt very inattentive and quite unprofessional.

It also seemed that we were treated less favorably as Western customers, which I find very disappointing. I hope that others will have a better experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zulaykha

sample_reviews_en.text:
While dining at Somaek Korean Bar, I noticed three mice running along the edge near the air conditioner, which made me feel quite uncomfortable. I’m sharing this photo as information for others who are interested in visiting this place, and I hope the restaurant will improve its cleanliness.

Regarding the service, I felt that it could be more attentive. When we placed our order, some items were forgotten. Even after several dishes had been served, we still hadn’t received plates and cutlery, which were given to a table that arrived later instead. There were three staff members and only 4–5 occupied tables, but we had to wave and call out several times before receiving assistance. I hope the service can be improved as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: หนอน ชาเขียว

sample_reviews_en.text:
Total disappointment. I just wanted to quench my thirst with a cold Asahi beer and some crispy salted wings.
But first I had to wait about 10 minutes just for a waitress to come over. Then, when I finally ordered, I specifically asked for the beer to be brought immediately so I wouldn’t have to wait for the food and could start enjoying it right away. Instead, they not only did not bring the beer before the food — they brought it about 15 minutes after food.
In total, it took around 45 minutes before my first sip.
And, in the best Thai traditions, the garlic wings turned out not salty but sweet. I didn’t even finish them.
My Thai girlfriend ordered a seafood soup and barely touched it as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Иван Иванов

sample_reviews_en.text:
Service was disappointing – we waited a long time for our food and even got the wrong order. That really took away from the experience.

The place itself has a cool vibe and they play Korean music, which makes the atmosphere more fun. The setting was okay – there are both indoor and outdoor seats, and plenty of options to choose from. They’ve got a good selection of drinks like beer and soju, and lots of food choices.

It’s a bit loud inside, so you’ll need to speak up, but that’s expected at a bar. Food was decent overall – some dishes were nice, others just average. Would’ve rated it higher if the service had been better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chen E.

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to try fried chicken and cold noodles. The waiter told me that I needed to wait 20 minutes for fried chicken. After the first order, he came to tell me that the cold noodles were out about 6 or 7 minutes later. Then I changed to stone pot bibimbap and was told that I needed to wait 20 minutes. I waited for about 15 minutes and was told that the fried chicken was out. If I wanted to eat it, I would have to wait 2 hours. If there were no dishes at the beginning, why didn't you tell me in advance? I have been wasting my time here.
sample_reviews_en.author: XI XI Li

sample_reviews_en.text:
Told when arriving that there was half an hour wait from ordering for food. Ordered drinks, fried chicken, and 2 noodles. After over an hour only the drinks had arrived, and when I asked the man in charge said that it was our fault for ordering noodles because they take longer. After 1hr25 from ordering, our noodles arrived. Our chicken never did, but was still on the bill, along with some drinks we never ordered.

Food that did arrive was excellent, but I can't give the experience more than one star.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dave Rodger

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here after work around 10pm & really enjoyed the vibe of this restaurant.

It is located right under Phaya Thai BTS and the outlook (like a tent) somehow demonstrates the food bar in Korean dramas.

The foods are good, with reasonable price. Jajangmyeon is recommended.

You can also play with the live music performance by singing along or requesting your favourite songs to be performed by the singer.

It will be a great spot for Fridays or weekends hanging out with buddies.
sample_reviews_en.author: Triet Le

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cozy Korean Bar with Excellent Food.
Delicious dishes, friendly service, and a pleasantly small menu – proof that “less is more.” Every item we tried was well-prepared and authentically flavored. Highly recommend the Tteokbokki with cheese and the fried chicken – both are absolute standouts! Both the indoor seating and the outdoor tables are inviting. The bar is located on a quiet side street with very little traffic – perfect for a relaxed evening.
sample_reviews_en.author: KT

sample_reviews_en.text: This Irish Pub feels cozy right after walking through the door.  A warm ambient welcomes you no matter if you are hungry or thirsty, or both. The Drinks menu is extensive and the food selection has both classic Western Pub Grub and Thai dishes. There are specials every day. Sports is shown on numerous screens. Upstairs on first floor you can play Pool. There is also an outside sitting area where smoking is allowed. A small stage features Live Music sometimes. The staff is friendly. Nice place. Not dirt cheap, but manageable.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a good chill spot to tuck into some nice comfort food away from the normal vibes of this area. Pizza surprisingly good. Wings, Ceaser, Pies all solid. Did try the chicken skewer sadly was very dry but seemed an unfortunate mishap. Just would say for this style should use thighs or be sure if breast that they are prepped, stored, and cooked so the meat doesnt get completely dried out.

I’m from Indonesia and I love oldies songs and for first time in my life the only one can play the song I request in this place by one man band ! He’s was awesome!!! I would love to come back again for sure. And the food here was yum , the atmosphere wasss sooo fun !!! Thanks for make my day..
sample_reviews_en.author: weirdbutwonderful_

sample_reviews_en.text: Would recommend to come hear any time of the day. In the morning, there is a make your own English breakfast where there is a wide range of sides you can combine into your English breakfast. Staff are nice all day and in the evening, something I would recommend would be the chicken nachos.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sean Burke

sample_reviews_en.text: Great Irish bar just around the corner from soi cowboy. Nice atmosphere and good choice of food and drinks. The pad ga pow I order was very good. I was told the larb moo is great as well. Service was great. Ploy served us with helpful tips and a great smile.

sample_reviews_en.text: My first time here, after over 20 years in Bangkok, and wow, superb! First of all the separation of a smoking area outdoors is brilliant so those inside in the AC do not get bothered by smokers. The lady who served us was A1, so attentive, …
sample_reviews_en.author: David Smith

sample_reviews_en.text: Good Irish bar in busy Sukhumvit area. We enjoyed the happy hours and the foods also good. The service was great, professional. Live music, on the day we went was "ok", could be better. But all in all, it is a good place to hang out 👌 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Jarupan Nagel

sample_reviews_en.text: Tasty meal. Fish and chips. Adequate but not 5-star service. Comfortable seating (I sat inside). Comfortable temperature. Beer happy hour started at 15:00 (Saturday). Would go again but pricey for what you get.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jim Hodge

restaurants.name: Bar.Yard
restaurants.address:

ชั้นที่ 40, Kimpton Maa-Lai Bangkok, 78 Soi Ton Son, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best rooftop bars with a great view in the heart of Bangkok, in the Langsuan area, is located on the 40th floor of the Kimpton Maa-Lai Bangkok hotel. This outdoor rooftop bar boasts a spacious area with plenty of seating in various zones. The decor is vibrant and colorful in a tropical style, creating a relaxed, fun, and informal atmosphere. It also offers stunning panoramic views of Bangkok.

Each night has a different theme. Last Sunday, the theme was Jammin n’ Jerk’ Jamaican Nights, featuring Jamaican-inspired dishes that were easy to eat, offering both refreshing and rich flavors such as Chayote Mango Salad with smoked chicken (320 baht), Chicken Lollipop (270 baht), Escovith Snapper with Bammy (370 baht), Curried Shrimp Stew (390 baht), and Maduros Pancake (390 baht).
The drink selection is also extensive, including cocktails and mocktails like Monkey Tail (440 baht), Pink Lady Slushy (460 baht), and Betty in the Yard (380 baht).
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarat Traipiyavong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Big appreciation to the amazing team at Bar.Yard, Kimpton Maa-Lai Bangkok, for making a solo night feel anything but lonely. The atmosphere, service, and attention to detail were truly exceptional.

A special thank you to Trio, the amazing manager, for being so warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. And to Nanno and Dream the wonderful hostess’s, for making me feel comfortable and looked after from the moment I arrived.

Sometimes, all you need is a great view, good vibes, and people who know how to make you feel welcome. Thank you for such a memorable night. 💫

I’ll definitely be coming back — even for another night out on my own. 🥂✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Natcha Sim

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was terrible. We took a vacant table because no one approached us at the entrance. After being seated, a few minutes later, a woman in a green dress approached us, asking us to leave and saying it was already taken. Despite the empty tables, the woman showed us the only table, which had dirty plates left from the previous guests. After 15 minutes, a waiter graciously came to take our order.

Aside from the beautiful views, there's nothing else waiting for you there.
And you can admire such a panoramic view of Bangkok from many other places with better service, and it wouldn't spoil your evening.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julia Mrugała

sample_reviews_en.text:
I absolutely hated that they advertise a happy hour that doesn't actually exist. They charge you for every single drink. I expected to spend one amount, but I ended up spending exactly double because they charge you for every single drink. When you finish one, they offer you a second, and since it's supposed to be happy hour, you say yes, but in the end, they charge you for all four drinks and explain that the happy hour price is the price they charge for each drink... It's a shame because the place is very nice.
We spent 1930 baht on a sparkling water and two drinks, which ended up being four 🤦👎
sample_reviews_en.author: Lucas Pereira Thiem

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a really good time at Bar.Yard! The atmosphere was great and the rooftop view was amazing, especially at night. The food and drinks were good, and the staff were friendly and attentive. Overall, it was a really nice experience and I'd definitely come back again.

I was very impressed with Bar.Yard. The atmosphere was great and the rooftop view was amazing, especially at night. The food and drinks were delicious, and the staff were friendly and attentive. Overall, it was a great experience, and I would definitely like to come back again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: wineu

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re in Bangkok you have to check out Bar.Yard!! 🌿🍸

The atmosphere is amazing beautiful rooftop vibes great music delicious food and creative cocktails. The staff name dream are incredibly friendly and attentive making the whole experience even better. It’s the perfect place to relax with friends, celebrate a special occasion or enjoy a fun night out. Everything from the service to the ambiance was top notch. I absolutely loved it and can’t wait to come back. Highly recommend it definitely one of the best rooftop🤩💞
sample_reviews_en.author: Min Seok

sample_reviews_en.text:
It has been two months since my visit, but I am writing this belatedly.

My friend and I had lunch in the afternoon and were sightseeing at Lumpini Park when we stopped by without a reservation just for coffee and beer. The woman who appeared to be the manager was incredibly kind, and all the staff were friendly as well.

We arrived a bit early to enjoy both the sunset and the night view. I plan to visit again in two months.
sample_reviews_en.author: YJ P

sample_reviews_en.text: Bar.Yard is a great rooftop spot in Bangkok. I had a whiskey sour that was really well made and the rooftop views are easily one of the highlights, especially at night. The whole place has a relaxed atmosphere and is a nice spot to hang out for a few drinks. I also really liked the dedicated smoking room — a small detail, but definitely appreciated. Great drinks, amazing views and an easy place to spend an evening.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cowabunga PIZZA bkk - Justin

restaurants.name: Cape House Hotel
restaurants.address:

43 Phloen Chit Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I booked this place because of the good reviews, but I think it would have been better to pay a little more and get a hotel right in front of the station. This isn't a 5-star hotel.

People say the staff are friendly, but the reception staff, in particular, looked awkward when smiling and treated me formally; it seemed like most of the reviews praising the friendliness were from Westerners.

I asked for a late check-out and extended it by an hour, but they called me at 12 PM on the day itself to tell me to check out.

Do the staff not manage guest information among themselves? I was baffled.
