The amenities aren't great, so it's better to bring your own shampoo and conditioner. There was also a strange smell in the room.

They gave me a corner room on a lower floor with no view, and I was already angry about being assigned the end room, but since I was only staying for two days, I just stayed put and didn't say anything.

If you are booking expecting a 'hotel,' I recommend going somewhere else.
sample_reviews_en.author: su hyun lee

sample_reviews_en.text: This mid size service apartment is nicely located in a quiet street just off the main tourist belt where many of the shopping malls are located. Food and shopping are easily available within a short walk. The facility here is quite old but generally well maintained. Service is very good especially front desk and concierge. Breakfast is excellent, and serve quality food. We stayed for 5 days and still enjoy the breakfast. Could perhaps provide more variety of tea at breakfast. There is a lounge for guests on the 15th floor from 9am to 1000 pm daily. Great place to have some finger food and a tea or coffee. The studio room we stayed is spacious and has a washing machine too. Linen and towels are of good quality and condition. Our only complaint is that the room sound proofing isn't good as we can hear clearly people walking by and chatting. Also the bathroom sink is far too low. Apart from that, we have a good stay here and not forgetting we received a complimentary teddy bear!
sample_reviews_en.author: Vince SS

sample_reviews_en.text:
Definitely worth its 5* rating!

We had a blast staying at Cape House Bangkok. From the high levels of service, to the beautiful room and the extra little touches- Cape House Bangkok exceeded our expectations.

Staff were incredibly kind and attentive and our room was just beautiful.
The pool on the 16th floor was really nice along with its hot tub too - recommend a visit up there if you’re staying.

If I had to say anything they could improve on I would say general attention to detail when it comes to cleanliness.

But this certainly didn’t impact the experience. The hotel is situated in a great part of Bangkok making so much easily accessible - even by walking!

A huge thank you to everyone at Cape House Bangkok for making our stay so special. It truly made our experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chloe Hall

sample_reviews_en.text: Lovely place to stay in Bangkok, the service was exceptional and all staff were very friendly. The room was nice and clean although the cleaners kept coming round at around 4pm and we were back in the room by then after most of the day spent exploring so we didn’t get our room cleaned for the 3 nights we stayed. The pool and other facilities were all spotless and modern and the location of the hotel was decent as it was in the heart of the city with good transport links (BTS station nearby) and had two 7-Elevens opposite for snacks and extra water. We checked out on our last day in Bangkok and went to the market for the day and when we came back the staff allowed us to use the showers by the pool to freshen up and we used the lounge to relax before getting our train.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ryan English

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cape House may not be brand new, but the location is unbeatable — super convenient for getting around! The price is great for what you get, especially with breakfast included.

There’s a convenience store right across the street and HarborLand nearby for kids to burn off energy.

The lounge on the 15th floor is a hidden gem — quiet, peaceful, and perfect for working without needing to step into a café.

The large rooms are amazing — so spacious and comfortable. The smaller rooms are quite compact though, so I’d definitely recommend booking a bigger one. The price is still better than many others in the same area.

Staff are absolutely lovely — warm and welcoming, it truly felt like staying at home. 🧡
sample_reviews_en.author: Miss Daisy Sweet

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently stayed at Cape House Hotel and had an absolutely amazing experience. From the moment I checked in, the staff were welcoming, attentive, and professional. The room was spacious, clean, and beautifully decorated, with all the modern amenities you could need. The bed was extremely comfortable, and I had a great night's sleep.

The hotel's location is perfect – it's close to all the main attractions, but still in a quiet area, making it a peaceful retreat after a day of exploring.

Breakfast had a fantastic selection, with fresh and delicious options to suit every taste. The staff went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect, and I really appreciated their attention to detail.
sample_reviews_en.author: Danalice Chin

sample_reviews_en.text:
· Great location, and the breakfast was genuinely satisfying—nothing to complain about, solid hotel standard. The room was clean, well-maintained, and carried a charming, slightly classic vibe. The gym was well-equipped, and the rooftop pool was excellent—truly a highlight. The staff were kind and consistently helpful. Overall, one of the best hotel experiences I’ve had.

· If we had to mention one detail, the air conditioning in the lobby was a bit too strong for our preference—but it was certainly not a major issue. It’s honestly hard to find any negatives. Of course, a slightly lower daily rate would always be welcome, but even so, the price for our three-night stay felt more than reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Szymon Szyperski

sample_reviews_en.text: Great location, great and friendly staff. We had a one bedroom apartment with a washer (no drying function), and a kitchenette. The bed was very hard. We asked for a mattress topper so we didn't have to feel the springs. A big issue was the water temperature in the shower. The controls got extremely hot and we both burned ourselves. It also keeps fluctuating, so the temp does not stay. The AC functions but it's rather loud. Breakfast was very subpar compared with most hotels in that price class. It is dated  while pictures look interesting, the actual experience is disappointing. Overall we would not stay here again. Not sure how this is ranked a 5 Star hotel. It felt like 3+ at best.
sample_reviews_en.author: Johannes Stosch

restaurants.name: Baan Khanitha Thai Cuisine Sukhumvit 23
restaurants.address:

14 Soi Sukhumvit 23, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Used this restaurant for dinner on the first day of our company trip to Bangkok.
- We were about 30 minutes late for our reservation, but we were warmly welcomed, which we appreciate.
- The food is truly delicious no matter what you order. There are no misses.
- The Tom Yum Goong and Green Curry are especially outstanding.
- The Tom Yum Goong was so delicious that we ordered seconds.
- The staff were all friendly, making for a pleasant dining experience.
- For 3 men and 2 women, we ate and drank to our hearts' content for approximately 8,000 THB.
- While the price might seem a little high, the satisfaction is well worth it.
- The perfect restaurant for those days when you want to treat yourself to a luxurious meal during your Bangkok trip.
- When I was stationed in Bangkok, this was a go-to restaurant for business travelers from Japan.
- A highly recommended restaurant that I can confidently suggest, whether it's your first time in Bangkok or for business entertaining.
sample_reviews_en.author: T

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overpriced for a regular food. 200 thb for a small Thai beer? 240 for a bite size som tam? I also asked for drinking water (30 thb) and the waiter brought a bottle that really seemed like tap water, but I was charged an expensive mineral water. The bottle was not even sealed. I bet it had tap water in it. Dirty trick.

It was not a pleasant experience overall for me. I’m definitely not coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Francisco

sample_reviews_en.text: While we were eating, a large cockroach was crawling on the wall. We called the waiter, who grabbed a rag and removed it. I asked him if this was normal in Thailand, and he said yes. And that was it. We could only pretend we hadn't seen anything and continue eating; there was nothing else we could do. This is quite unacceptable for a relatively expensive restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Willis Zhang

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu at Baan Khanitha Thai Cuisine Sukhumvit 23 felt almost overwhelming at first, in a good way, because there were so many Thai dishes to choose from. I ended up really enjoying the meal overall, especially the depth of flavor in what we ordered. It’s the kind of place that makes it easy to want to come back and try more from the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Virgilio Kramer

sample_reviews_en.text: Not that great. Portion small. Serving staff can't help much with  order taking.  Attached photo is an example of the tom yom goong they served. This is considered  big size for 5 people!  There is not much ingredients and spices (diluted).  They don't provide condiments typical of Thai cuisine. Free flow brown rice. Ambience is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: P

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is lovely, the old house is beautifully decorated in a traditional Thai style. The Thai food is authentic and has a mild flavor, suitable for foreigners. Parking is limited. The staff are polite and attentive. You can enjoy Khao Chae (rice in chilled broth) until the end of May.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyada Tack

sample_reviews_en.text:
Poor attitude when it came to service. Staff was barely bothered. Food was good, but service and attitude made the experience poor.

One shouldn’t expect Michelin quality food or service at this place for this price - but this was below what many other places in Bkk offer for same price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shehryar Waseem

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant's communication was lacking, as the staff failed to inform us of the private room's minimum spend requirement, resulting in an unexpected 2,000 THB charge. Although the food was good, the establishment would benefit from improved management and staff training.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanitha Bosco

restaurants.name: Bake n' Brew
restaurants.address:

หมู่ที่ 9 373/13 Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best breakfast spots in Pattaya

Bake n’ Brew continues to live up to its great reputation. The breakfast was excellent — generous portions, fresh ingredients, and everything cooked with care.

The classic breakfast plate was spot on: crispy bacon, flavorful sausage, nicely done hash browns, and perfectly cooked eggs. The ham and grilled tomato were a great addition, and the buttered toast was warm and soft.

The Eggs Benedict was outstanding as well. The poached eggs were beautifully done, the spinach was creamy and well-seasoned, and the hollandaise sauce had great flavor without being too heavy. It looked amazing and tasted even better.

Service was friendly and fast, and the atmosphere is cozy — exactly the kind of place where you want to start your morning. Prices are fair for the quality, and the menu has plenty of good options.

Highly recommended if you want a consistently great breakfast in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Petri Kettunen

sample_reviews_en.text:
I am not visiting this place for the first time. Previously, everything had always been delicious and the experience was excellent. However, today an absolutely unacceptable situation occurred.

Considering that the venue has an open bakery area and a semi-open kitchen, a customer entered with a dog. Afterwards, they sat at a table, and the dog jumped onto the sofa and then directly onto the table. The owner continued to keep the dog on the table, which I believe is completely inappropriate in any establishment where food is served.

I asked the staff to address the situation because, first of all, it is not hygienic. However, the staff chose not to do anything. Apparently, for them it is considered normal that a table where guests eat can have a dog standing on it with dirty paws.

I find this unacceptable and extremely disappointing, especially in a place that serves food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sayari Nane

sample_reviews_en.text: Located in Soi Chalaem Phrakiat 23(it is the soi that connect Soi Buakhao with Xzyte square)...it's about in the middle of the soi.....the atmosphere is good.....the food very good....the service is very good(even though the shop was full the food came fast)....1st time i saw 11.00 am a shop to be full (and the indoor area and the outdoor)....that means good service and good prices.....and the prices are good and the portions good......we wait a little so a table be free.....
sample_reviews_en.author: Triantafyllos Sosos

sample_reviews_en.text: Had the set 2 breakfast, which included 2 poached eggs, sausage, bacon, tomato, mushrooms, beans,black pudding, two slices of toast, coffee and orange juice, all for 190 baht,  very good value and tasty. The only thing I didn’t like was that the butter and jam at the bread buffet was uncovered and there were a couple of flies hovering around it, could do with being covered like the bread is.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ross T

sample_reviews_en.text:
Yesterday was my girlfriend’s birthday. We planned to have a light bite and then continue with our day, but after eating here I became severely ill. I experienced intense stomach pain and vomiting for hours and was unable to leave the house.

Please check the products you use more frequently and pay greater attention to kitchen hygiene...
sample_reviews_en.author: Burak

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent atmosphere and great selection of quality offerings. Fresh and delicious. Ordered healthy salad with grilled chicken ( chicken was dry but worked out fine with salad dressing- delicious otherwise. Finished off with yogurt fruit smoothie and a cake. All very good. My first food critique 🤗
sample_reviews_en.author: Kosta Soldatos

sample_reviews_en.text: A small but comfortable bakery, cafe and coffee shop. Situated down a small alley between soi Buakhao and 3rd Road. It's popular for breakfast and offer an unique 'bread buffet' where there is a selection of different breads of which you can eat as much as you like.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ian

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu is very extensive, with beautiful pictures, and it has everything you could wish for... The food is excellent and the service very friendly... I was absolutely pleasantly surprised... I can highly recommend it... I was here for breakfast...
sample_reviews_en.author: Stefan “Traveller66” Liebler

restaurants.name: ร้านอาหารจีน ฮั่วเซ่งฮง เดอะมอลล์บางกะปิ Huasenghong
restaurants.address:

ห้องเลขที่ 337 ชั้น 3, เลขที่ 3522 Lat Phrao Rd, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted okay, nothing special. However, on the day we ate there, we ordered one serving of Peking duck. When it was served, my sister and I picked up the package as usual, but the duck skin felt soft and chewy, not crispy like it usually is. We tried to think positively, assuming it was just that one piece, and continued eating, but everyone at our table agreed it wasn't crispy. The crispy white noodles in the middle also seemed like they had been sitting out for a while; they weren't crispy and fluffy, but rather chewy and doughy. We called a staff member over to inquire about the lack of crispness in the duck skin, but the staff member just said they would ask the chef and then disappeared without a trace.
Regarding the staff, there was only our table and one other table on our side of the table, but there were no staff members standing by to serve us. We had to walk over to a staff member to order anything, even though the restaurant wasn't packed that day; there were only a few tables occupied.
Finally, we asked the staff again when we were about to pay, and the manager came over to apologize and gave us a 10% discount on the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: LailA.

sample_reviews_en.text:
When you crave Chinese food, this is the restaurant that comes to mind! 🇨🇳

The menu is diverse, perfect for family meals. Each dish comes in three sizes: small, medium, and large. Since I was dining alone, the smallest size was just right. 🍜

The new restaurant is quite large, with plenty of seating and two entrances. It's great for large families as there are large tables available. 🍴

The taro dessert here is incredibly delicious. Don't forget to order it as your dessert! 🍠

The staff provides good service, and the food comes out quickly. The taste is consistently delicious. The restaurant also accepts credit cards.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arinta

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was mediocre, and the food was served slowly. The shark fin soup, in my opinion, felt like I was eating gravy. The appetizers, as the name suggests, should have come first, but they were incredibly slow and arrived last. Furthermore, they didn't look like the picture in the menu; the duck dish looked huge and at the price of over 500 baht, it seemed like good value, but I was personally disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: radhnarong ju

sample_reviews_en.text: Hua Seng Hong is a lovely restaurant located on the upper floor of The Mall shopping center. The food is incredibly delicious 😋 and I highly recommend it. The service is excellent and the atmosphere is great. The prices are also perfectly reasonable for the quality of the food. The restaurant isn't crowded because my wife thinks it's very expensive for Thailand, and that Thais tend to prefer Japanese food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joe's Weltreise

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves delicious food, but it's not very popular because people think it's expensive. However, the prices aren't as high as you might think. They offer set menus with various promotions, and the prices are quite reasonable. The food tastes good and is of standard quality. The atmosphere is comfortable, and the restaurant is clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aittipat V.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious and the service was good, but I can't remember what kind of soup I ordered. It wasn't really to my liking; it seemed to have taro in it, which wasn't good at all. 😅

The price was reasonable for the portion size and location. The food portions were huge!
sample_reviews_en.author: ลู ก แ ม ว สี่ ตัว

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted great, absolutely delicious, especially the salt-fried river prawns – fantastic!

Importantly, the staff at this branch were lovely, providing excellent service and possessing impeccable manners.
sample_reviews_en.author: สมศักดิ์ ตั้งจุตินันท์

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious but the service was very slow. We sat from 6:30 PM to 8:30 PM and still hadn't received all our dishes. Even simple dishes came out last. The staff didn't seem to check on customers much.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fah Saranporn

restaurants.name: The Brew House Sukhumvit 8
restaurants.address:

4 18 Soi Sukhumvit 8, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is one of those casual bars that you just feel right at home I’ve been to this place many many times and I do events in around Bangkok so I decided to do an event here we were on the second floor and of course the manager who took care of us was amazing Toni!!

A whole bunch of us showed up tonight and we had amazing food bits and appetizers passed around we had great drinks are happy hour drinks were awesome of course the majority of the people they love their beer here and of course the cocktails were also very good !

They have a live band on Fridays and Saturdays so I think because this Friday the band was really good I’ve seen her play here before !

If you’re in the Nana area I would highly recommend to stop by the brewhouse and have a cold chill brew their pizza is good anything on their menu is pretty good !!

😊

Follow Fauzia for more awesome  adventures in Bangkok and beyond you can follow us here as well as our Instagram YouTube Facebook and of course TikTok!
💞💞💞💞
sample_reviews_en.author: Follow Fauzia

sample_reviews_en.text:
This review is for their breakfast only.  The lunch and dinner menus look fantastic and I want to come back and try several of their dishes in the future.  I hope to revisit this review in the future.

The standard breakfast comes with 2 eggs, grilled potato cubes, bacon and a light salad.  I purchased the sausage as an additional charge.  The eggs were overcooked as was the bacon.  The potatoes had no seasoning and were saved by me using some Tabasco.  The sausage was burnt and was some kind of hot link.  The salad was good.  But what I find strange was there was no toast included.  I couldn’t even find an option to purchase a side order on the menu.

I did enjoy the coffee and I purchased an additional croissant that was also pretty good.  There are many other breakfast options on the menu that looked quite good but I cannot recommend the standard bacon eggs.  I paid more than 700 baht for the breakfast with the additions of the sausage, croissant, and two lattes.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Bruneel

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Brew House on Sukhumvit 8 is one of my go-to spots near Nana — a fantastic bar and restaurant with a great atmosphere and unbeatable value. Whether I come for a leisurely breakfast or a late-night session, this place consistently delivers on all fronts.

The selection of craft beers and drinks is excellent, and the food is surprisingly good for a bar setting. The pizza is tasty, the alfredo pasta is well-made, and I love the pancakes with fresh fruit for breakfast. The live music adds such a wonderful vibe to the evenings — the band is talented and entertaining. The staff are warm, friendly and professional throughout.

Open from 7am to 2am, The Brew House is perfect for any occasion — morning coffee, a business lunch, happy hour, or a full evening out. Great ambience, great prices, and great people. A true neighborhood staple. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexander Ericsson

sample_reviews_en.text:
An awesome brekky in the Big Mango a.k.a. Bangkok, at the stylish Brew House, on the dynamic Soi 8, in downtown Khlong Toei .

My magnificent ensemble meal of ; fluffy pancakes, crispy bacon, perfectly prepped scrambled eggs, tasty fried potatoes, delicious maple syrup and last but not least, a lovely hot cafe latte, equaled a great start to my day.

Positioned, close the entrance to Soi 8, I was afforded some curious people watching opportunities to check out, in between indulging in the perfectly prepared food and beverages.

I chose to sit in a comfortable area, towards the rear of this classy restaurant and savored warm plus attentive hospitality, throughout my most enjoyable dining experience.

Highly recommended and I will be back.  @CoffeeChillTV
sample_reviews_en.author: Coffee Chill TV

sample_reviews_en.text:
December 14-15, 2025
1. I was happy that the staff remembered me.
2. The food was still good.
3. It was even better that they didn't charge a separate service charge or VAT.
4. It feels like there are fewer and fewer smoking seats...
5. Next time, I'll definitely visit during dinner time to enjoy the live music.

The food... is on the pricey side and a bit salty. Even I, who eats a little salty, found it a bit salty. But it was delicious, lol.
The service was very satisfactory. The servers always smiled and were friendly.
This is my number one choice for returning to Bangkok!

I ended up returning. I visited twice a day. I always had breakfast here. It's not cheap, but we're tourists, right? The clean and neat interior makes it worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Totem Wolf

sample_reviews_en.text:
A great bar with an excellent range of beers. On Soi 8 a short walk from Nana BTS.

Enjoyed a small Le Chouffe Blonde circa 240 for an 8% imported Belgian beer, in perfect condition

Live music every day from around 8pm .

Happy hour runs till 7pm and all the craft and imported beers are at 299THB, plus all the standard beers are served.

This place has been a great addition to the area. My only criticism is the drinks prices are all over the board.

299 baht for a pint of La Chouffe Blonde in happy hour, as opposed to 240 for a Beer Lao pint after 7pm. The former is value but maybe not sensible at 8%, the latter is too much.

A pal found his post happy hour Absolute vodka, more expensive than comparable venues on Soi 11.
sample_reviews_en.author: D J

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve been coming here quite a few times for regular meetups, and it’s always a solid choice. A great spot to relax, grab some drinks, and chat with friends. The atmosphere strikes a nice balance between chill and lively.

The bar has a good selection of draft and craft beers, and the prices are reasonable for the area — around 220–350 for beers, 260–350 for cocktails, and spirits starting from 220.

It’s also a fun place to meet new people. The second floor tends to have a younger, more energetic crowd, while the ground floor is more laid-back with an older mix. Overall, a friendly and comfortable hangout that works for just about any mood.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shayan Naveed

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had an amazing dining experience at The Brew House! The pancake and coffee were a perfect combination to start the day—fluffy, flavorful pancakes paired with a rich, aromatic cup of coffee that hit all the right notes. Later, I tried the pork fried rice, and it was just as incredible! The flavors were perfectly balanced, with tender pork and just the right seasoning. The cozy ambiance and friendly staff made it even better. Highly recommend stopping by for great food and a warm atmosphere!

Thanks to ANN so accommodating and helpful 😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Christy Natsingo

restaurants.name: T & K Seafood
restaurants.address:

49, 51 Phadung Dao Rd, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Tried out this super crowded place in Chinatown. The place is always packed during dinner time, but luckily today managed to get a spot. Tried out the stir fried prawn with chili paste, fried bass with garlic, & egg fried. Overall the taste is good. Also got the fresh OJ (which is a must) and chrysanthemum tea. Service is also very quick here. Overall costs 830฿.
sample_reviews_th.author: Maharani

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you are down to a road side eating experience then go for this!
T&K is one of the highly recommended seafood places in yaowarat road, BKK. And boy oh boy! I did not expect the settings! We were literally seated in that cramped corner people passing by and cars/tuktuk honking. THIS IS NOT FOR THE WEAK!
But let's talk about food, shall we?

The price is still affordable except for lobster, I still think that lobsters (not only TK but all stalls there) are bit overpriced.

Some might say seafood experience in Yaowarat is overhyped. I tell you that I have a very distinctive palate. And believe me that T&K's tom yum is the best by far.
It has rich coconut milk. The only comment I have is too much aromatics like big pieces of lemongrass and galangal in it which i dont mind the taste but a bit of a nuance when scooping for the gravy/sauce/soup.

River prawns is a must! Ask lots of dipping sauce!
A som tam (papaya salad) on the side will balance everything off. But be careful with peanut allergy! Tell them not to put it if you have one.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ester Camacho

sample_reviews_en.text: T & K Seafood is a popular and affordable seafood restaurant in Chinatown, Bangkok. I went there with my wife and we had a great time enjoying the fresh and delicious dishes. The restaurant is located on the busy Yaowarat Road, and you can see the staff grilling the seafood on the street. The service was fast and efficient, and the staff were friendly and helpful. The portions were generous and the prices were reasonable. The seafood was cooked perfectly and seasoned well. The sauces were spicy and flavorful, and complemented the seafood nicely. The restaurant also serves beer and soft drinks to quench your thirst. We paid about 600 baht per person, which was very cheap for the quality and quantity of food we had. T & K Seafood is a must-try restaurant for seafood lovers who want to experience the authentic taste of Chinatown.
sample_reviews_en.author: Trung Trần

sample_reviews_en.text: The food selection at this restaurant is impressive, offering a wide variety of dishes that cater to different tastes. However, the downside is the overwhelming crowd, especially during peak hours. While there’s an option to ascend from the 2nd to the 3rd floor for additional seating, the narrow staircase can be quite challenging to navigate, particularly for taller individuals or those with larger frames. Despite the bustling atmosphere, service is swift, and our order, which included shark fin soup and fresh raw prawns, arrived promptly. However, potential visitors should be aware that accessing Chinatown after 6 PM can be a daunting task due to heavy traffic and an influx of diners. Overall, while the food is delightful, the logistics may require some patience and planning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kenneth Khoo

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been to Chinatown a few times already so I was very happy to finally try the famous T&K Seafood restaurant. I thought it was great, easily matching my expectations. I arrived just while it was opening, after 5:30 so I had my choice where to sit down. I totally recommend you come here early because after 20 minutes it was already full and a queue was forming. The food tasted great. The serving sizes were good according to the price. Beer wasn't expensive. The staff were really good. And the Chinatown atmosphere was amazing. I ordered their smallest lobster which was 1500 baht(pretty sure that's normal price).  It was great and suitable for two people. I got two crabs which were 600 baht each. My bill was expensive but it was worth it. It was a great experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffy Jeff Jeff

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐ T&K Seafood, Bangkok – A Must-Visit! ⭐ A very good classmate from Darjeeling who lives in Bangkok suggested to visit this place. Thank you Yasmin we loved this place in Chinatown. As always Chinatown is usually cheaper in everything from food to clothes and the best food we had in Thailand.

T&K Seafood offers some of the best seafood in Bangkok. The prawns and crab are incredibly fresh with delicious, flavorful gravy, and the tom yum soup is truly top-notch. The squid is perfectly cooked and absolutely yummy. All goes with chilled beer Singha.

The night vibe is vibrant and lively, packed with tourists — which shows how popular it is. It can be difficult to get a table, but the food and energy make it completely worth the wait. Loved the entire experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dragon Heart SHERPA

sample_reviews_en.text:
Instantly recognizable by the staff wearing bright green t-shirts, this iconic open-air establishment is a staple of Yaowarat Road. It delivers a quintessential Bangkok street dining experience with rows of metal tables set up directly on the frantic, neon-lit sidewalk.
Signature Flavors: Reviewers highly recommend their massive charcoal-grilled river prawns, whole steamed sea bass or snapper in spicy garlic-lime soup, and rich Tom Yum Goong.
The Atmosphere: It is chaotic, high-energy, and completely casual. Expect to dine amidst the buzz of passing traffic and bustling crowds.
Seating Options: While the outdoor tables offer the best street-side energy, they also have indoor, air-conditioned dining floors upstairs if you prefer to escape the heat.
sample_reviews_en.author: LUXME Bangkok VIP Airport Concierge

sample_reviews_en.text:
3*

This was just ok for me. Did I order the wrong things?

Seafood stir fried with basil - the seafood was all overcooked. The shrimp and squid were a little tough to chew. More importantly, this dish had a weird medicinal taste... I'm not sure what it was, the Thai seafood basil dishes in the US never have this taste. It was also rather sweet. I did not taste or smell the basil at all. Not for me.

Crab fried rice - I like there was a small vs large portion size. It was fine but not outstanding.

I think I should've ordered the grilled shrimp that everyone orders. Also, I looked around and some tables had the whole fish simmering on a metal stand. That looked delicious. You should order that instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joanne L

restaurants.name: Alibaba Tandoori & Curry
restaurants.address:

1, 13-14 Central Pattaya Rd, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Well I dont know where to start about this place because it is so wonderful.  I discovered this place on my last trip to Pattaya. On my currant trip I have eaten here twice, so far :), and it is fantastic. The food is super delicious! The service is always great. The décor is so beautiful. But the FOOD!!
If you want to eat the best Indian food around go here.
When you go you will most probably see the manager Manju overseeing the operation. Manju has been managing this restaurant for 20 years and this restaurant has been there 41 years! I can see why and you will too  if you go. If you are not sure about what to get or need clarification on what the food is or how it is cooked just ask Manju he will be happy to explain it to you and make sure that you will get something that you will love.
I dont rave about many restaurants but this place deserves it.
BTW, I love the butter chicken and chicken tandori. And if you dont get some garlic nan then too bad for you!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rick Stone

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited Alibaba Tandoori Curry in Pattaya, and it was an absolutely delightful experience!

We started with refreshing Mango Mocktail and Fresh Lime Mint with Ice — both were perfectly chilled and super refreshing.

For appetizers and mains, we tried Hara Bhara Kebab, Hakka Noodles, and Paneer Chilly — each dish was packed with authentic flavors and beautifully presented.

To end the meal on a sweet note, we enjoyed Rasmalai and Fruit Ice Cream, both of which were delicious.

The restaurant has a unique Ali Baba and 40 Thieves theme, which adds a fun and vibrant touch to the dining atmosphere.

They offer a wide range of vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes, making it a must-visit for anyone craving great Indian food in Pattaya.

Highly recommend this place for families, couples, or anyone looking for a memorable dining experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ammy Mishra

sample_reviews_en.text: 5 Star Indian restaurant. One of if not the best I've been to before. Everything was enjoyable and awesome about this wonderful place. Everyone made us feel welcome and the service was first class. We ordered the massive mixed meat platter for 3/4 between two of us plus a selection of 4 different curry sauces. With rice and garlic naan bread. I had 4 Heineken's. The meat was amazing it just melted in your mouth it came with prawns , chicken, lamb and cottage cheese. All the flavours were wonderful. If you enjoy a good curry then try this amazing place you will not be disappointed. The cost was around 1800b give 1900b you can do it cheaper by ordering just a curry with meat but we wanted the works. I would definitely recommend going here. This gem will be on my list every time I visit Pattaya now. Thanks for a wonderful afternoon. 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Kippax

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were invited for dinner today by my wifes Thai friend and her husband from Kolkatta. They picked us up from our home and brought us to this restaurant.

Apparently, this is the first Indian restaurant in Pattaya which opened in 1982. That’s an amazing 43 years.

Our host ordered the tandoori chicken, butter chicken, pani puri, raita (which consists of yoghurt mixed with raw vegetables and seasoned with cumin, coriander and mint), cheese naan, plain naan, two mango laasi and 2 cokes.

The food was awesome. I’ll probably bring my parents here for north indian cuisine the next time they visit us in Pattaya since it’s nearer and less than 3km from our home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adrian Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ali BaBa

Service:
- Not overly welcoming or friendly
- Rating: 2/5

Atmosphere:
- Comfy seats & i love the decor
- Nice background music playing
- Rating: 4/5

My Order:
- 1 x Chicken Kadal (Highly Recommended)
- Medium Spice & off the bone
- Great taste, spicy, perfectly cooked
- Price: 290 THB
- Rating: 5/5

- 1 x Jeera Aloo
- Good flavour and cooked perfectly
- Price: 180 THB
- Rating: 4/5

- 2 x Plain Naan
- Light & Fluffy
- Price: 60 THB per naan
- Rating: 4/5

- 1 x bottle of Leo
- Served Ice Cold
- Price: 95 THB
- Rating: 4/5

2 x Complimentary poppadom were provided with mango chutney, mint sauce, raita, carrots & cucumber.

Overall Rating: 4/5
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Hilton

sample_reviews_en.text: Really cool authentic Indian food experience. The inside of the restaurant upstairs creates a nice date or formal dinner setting with cool a/c. I ordered the chicken teka, garlic naan and rice jeera. The waitor suggested I order a curry sauce as well and I picked medium spicy. Taste of everything was incredible, clean and fresh. Price was fair for a ton of food and a cocktail. If I had one piece of constructive criticism it would be if you want people to branch out and try different menu items, pictures of the food on the menu can help a lot. I understand that can cheapen the look of the menu but it can be done tastefully.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike Margiotta

sample_reviews_en.text: Really cool atmosphere; amazing decor; and the staff is dressed in traditional clothing, too. My butter chicken and garlic naan were both excellent. I also like that they have Coke in a bottle instead of a can; it tastes so much better that way! The service is excellent; and they also accept credit cards, including contactless tap and pay digital wallet payments via phone (i.e., NFC mobile payments), without any annoying surcharges. That alone will keep me coming back! They also have a clean on-site washroom with sink and soap to wash hands. I will be back again for sure next time I am in the mood for Indian food!
sample_reviews_en.author: David M.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Indian Delight in Pattaya! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We had an amazing dining experience at AliBaba Tandoori in Pattaya, near beach Road. The flavors were truly authentic, and the food was freshly prepared with just the right balance of spices. From the rich and creamy butter chicken to the perfectly baked kadak naan, every dish was a delight.

The ambiance was warm and inviting, making it a perfect place to enjoy a meal. The staff was incredibly hospitable, ensuring we had a great experience.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for delicious Indian food in Pattaya. Will definitely visit again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jas S

restaurants.name: Baan Wang Lang Riverside
restaurants.address:

ริมแม่น้ำกรุงเทพ 342 Trok Watrakhang Alley, Siriraj, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
What a great find!  The location is great, our room was perfect, and the staff was super friendly and helpful!

We split our Bangkok trip into two hotels on different sides of the city.
We chose Baan Wang Lang Riverside for its convenience.  The Prannok pier is only about a 2 minute walk away for the Chao Phraya River Boat, which you can get a hop-on hop-off pass to easily explore many of the attractions along the river.  Keep in mind, this boat only runs till like 630pm(?), but, it’s also great that you take a Grab to “Wanglang Apartment” and they drop you off right at the entrance to the market that you can easily walk thru to the hotel.  2 mins

The hotel itself is right on the riverfront, so the rooftop, the restaurants, and some of the rooms have the best views!  (We chose a smaller room facing the side, and we still had river views from our small balcony).

As soon as you come out of the hotel, you are in the middle of Wang Lang Market (popular with tourists on weekends, mostly locals on weekdays)… with plenty of shops to keep you busy for a while.  Lots of great cheap eats here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex Contreras

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing location - very near the city center and all the main attractions of Bangkok (one 5 minute boat ride away), but still located in the middle of an authentic marketplace with delicious local cuisine (which is very very cheap at the same time). There's also a hospital some 6 minutes away while walking.
Reasonable price - you get a stylish air-conditioned room with two free bottles of drinking water a day.
Satisfying breakfast - great variety which includes fresh fruits. Also some days there is the option of having made-to-order eggs and/or bacon. It starts at 6:30 and ends at 10:30, so you can enjoy it if you're an early bird or if you're a late-sleeper.
Overall I highly recommend this place, the staff makes you feel welcomed and the atmosphere of the hotel helps you rest after the exhausting exploration of all the Bangkok's wonders.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anežka

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great hotel with stunning views over the river.

It’s one of the best hotels for a remarkable rate in a great neighborhood located just inside a street market with great food. Be prepared that your cab might not be able to reach the hotel directly but staff is very attentive and helpful with that.
Room are well air conditioned and include water for free. You might hear kids walking by your door as they’re not fully soundproof but not an issue.

If you’re only looking to get a beer and have seen many great rooftop views before, just sit in the restaurant by the water on ground floor. Beer will be half price of what you’d pay at the rooftop bar.

Breakfast is available at 300 baht and simple yet perfect for what you receive.
Thanks again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Luke Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
We are staying in the bungalow at river level, great views of the river.

Large room, big comfortable bed, big kitchen, all one room with big glass windows facing the river, a big smart TV
big outside area with fan and a soak tub. A bit of noise from the bar next-door but didn't stop us from sleeping ( we're in our 50's).

Heaps of space for our stuff, a washing machine, microwave good air-conditioning, spacious strong shower, big breakfast bar to eat the street food off (which there is plenty to choose from, only metres from the hotel)

Ferry dock just 100m up river, so super easy & cheap to get to all areas near the river, China town, Iconsiam, temples or interchange to the BTS sky train system.
sample_reviews_en.author: MaKy

sample_reviews_en.text:
The hotel is highly recommended. It offers the best conditions for all activities.
Even if the journey by public transport from BKK airport is a little more complicated, the location of the hotel offers optimal conditions for excursions in all directions.
The market directly in front of the hotel is a real highlight and impresses with its friendly and absolutely fair atmosphere. There are also great cafés and a delicious bakery.
All the restaurants, bars and cafés in the hotel are also highly recommended. The taste and prices are absolutely top.
The evening view over the Chao Phraya River to Wat Arun is unique. We were perfectly happy and certainly not for the last time in this wonderful hotel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sprudelwasser Deluxe

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a great stay! The location is perfect — right in the heart of old Bangkok, surrounded by locals and just a few tourists, which I really loved. The rooms are comfortable, the restaurant is excellent, and the staff were absolutely amazing, so kind and helpful throughout our stay.

What really touched us was the little souvenir the hotel made especially for us at the end — such a thoughtful gesture that we truly appreciated. Their dedication and genuine kindness really make the difference. We were completely won over and truly recommend this place!
Also, you have an amazing view in the river and it does make the difference. Go and enjoy your stay here.
Tom & Alex
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom B-S

sample_reviews_en.text: Baan Wang Lang really does have it all: great location (right next to a fun bustling market and a short walk to ferries/boats), comfortable rooms, and outstanding staff who go out of their way to make sure the stay is going well. Big thanks to Nan, Oum, and Taew for making our stay great! And to the gentleman who drove us in the golf cart to our car - forget his name unfortunately, but he helped make sure we paid the right rate for the lot. Note: the roads in the market are too narrow for cars, so parking or taxi drop offs are a short distance from the guest house, but they will quickly send a cart to transport guests and bags if you need.
sample_reviews_en.author: Josh Lewis

sample_reviews_en.text: The hotel is located in the middle of a local market. Not a fancy setup but very convenient to get everything you need. Hotel staff are super helpful and friendly and the river view from the room is awesome. You can tell they’re doing everything they can to make your stay a great experience. Make sure you get the river view room although it’s a more expensive than the standard rooms. Facilities are a bit old and the sofa in our room has stains on it. But considering the views and the service I don’t have much to complain about. And oh, try the restaurant at the hotel! We ordered 3 or 4 dishes and every single one of them tastes great!
sample_reviews_en.author: SupermanGo

restaurants.name: BAOBAO BANGKOK
restaurants.address:

Central World 4 Room A601, 6th floor 4/1-4 ซ. วิภาวดี 2 แยก 4-4 Patumwan Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the shrimp rice noodle rolls for takeaway and was told the waiting time would be around 30 minutes. I was happy to wait, but when I returned after 30 minutes, I found out that my order hadn’t even been started yet. There was no apology or update regarding the delay.

I also sent a message through Messenger to raise my concern, as I was informed that the manager wasn’t there that day, but I never received any response.

The food was just so-so and definitely didn’t make up for the poor service.

Another issue was that several staff members couldn’t communicate in Thai at all. I found this quite surprising, considering the restaurant is located in Thailand. It made communication unnecessarily difficult for local customers.

Overall, the service, communication, and customer experience need significant improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: P S

sample_reviews_en.text: BAOBAO Chinese Dimsum at CentralWorld. I had high expectations, but it was quite disappointing. The sweet and sour pork had a strong smell that I couldn't tell if it was meat or oil the moment I took a bite, and the pineapple had the same smell, so I couldn't eat it and returned it. The staff said it was fine, but I told them I wanted to taste it and confirm for myself. I wasn't charged. The xiao long bao were average. The crab meat noodle dish, which I was looking forward to the most, was very bland, and it also had a peculiar smell that bothered me, so I left after eating only half of it. It's a highly-rated restaurant, so I had high expectations, but I questioned the quality of the food this time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gaotaka

sample_reviews_en.text:
Standout items were surprisingly the duck - beautifully fresh, tender meat. (Although wrappers were a bit too doughy but tasted alright). Would defo come back for this alone.

Xiao long bao also very nicely done, the broth hearty and delicious!

Deep fried shrimp and leek cake - stellar! Thin, crispy and extra light batter packed with shrimp.

However, Crab roe noodle - a major letdown.  So plain tasting, and noodle also had no bite to it. Find it surprising that this is their best selling item.

We also tried the scallion noodle - way better than the crab roe but nothing to write about or crave.

Overall given the prices (reasonable), a decent Chinese resto.
sample_reviews_en.author: N Anita Amreen

sample_reviews_en.text:
My favorite dish was the stir-fried green beans. The price was reasonable, and the flavor was excellent.

As for the restaurant’s signature dishes, I wasn’t particularly impressed. The crab noodles contained very little crab meat—there was barely any left by the time I finished. The noodles themselves were good, but the overall flavor wasn’t memorable enough to make me want to order them again.

The xiao long bao was decent for the price, although I found the wrapper a bit too thick for my taste.

The restaurant has a pleasant atmosphere, and the service was fine. Interestingly, it seemed that none of the staff were Thai.
sample_reviews_en.author: mini kimtae

sample_reviews_en.text: Honestly rlly good food. Some things were sold out even tho we came at 1pm Monday but ig this place is just popular so come early. We still managed to get a lot of popular items like the XLB and duck though and crispy shrimp roll. The crab roe was also good. For two ppl we ordered 3 dishes and was hungry enough to order more. Service was bad though. No one ever came over. Just go up to the front to pay. But ordering was difficult
sample_reviews_en.author: Kathy Zhang

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pork xiaolongbao and scrambled eggs with chives were delicious.
The fish in the sauerkraut fish dish was packaged sole, which didn't taste good.
The roast duck was really disappointing; it felt like a semi-finished product that had been reprocessed and re-fried.
The crab roe wasn't fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: qingqing niu

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is on the 6th floor, in front of Central, near Bar B Q Plaza.
The dim sum is delicious, the Peking duck is delicious, but the crab noodles weren't amazing.
What I liked was the mango sago pudding; it was delicious, not too sweet, and refreshing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Niinuii H.

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here based on reviews from TikTok. I had high expectations for the crab noodles because so many people praised them, but I was even more impressed by the shrimp rice noodle rolls. The flavor was rich and delicious, I ate it so …
sample_reviews_en.author: Thiti Cho

restaurants.name: Mae Sri Ruen Outlet Mall
restaurants.address:

87 Sukhumvit Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm usually a frequent customer and the food is delicious, but this time I had to write a review because I was extremely disappointed with the restaurant's handling of the situation.
I found a cockroach on my plate, which is a very serious matter. When I informed the staff, there wasn't even an apology, no explanation, and no attempt to resolve the situation. The staff simply took the plate and then put it back in the kitchen, even though I had just reported finding a cockroach. I was truly shocked by this, as it reflects a very poor approach to problem-solving.

I understand that such things can happen unintentionally, but the important thing is how to handle it when it happens. This time, the restaurant didn't show any concern whatsoever. The reason I'm writing this review is because the restaurant doesn't provide a way to contact them to report problems.
I previously contacted their Facebook page to report the issue, but was told that the page only handles the Bangkok branch and not the Pattaya branch, so I couldn't forward the matter to the responsible party.
(The restaurant's contact method is via Line: toeyy2285)
sample_reviews_en.author: Naiyana Pornputtharat

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant you absolutely shouldn't miss if you're visiting Jomtien Pattaya. It's a great option with good value for money. If you're tired of food court food, come to Mae Sri Ruen! I guarantee you'll love it. They serve authentic Thai food with excellent flavors, and they also have Thai desserts like Khanom Krok (rice flour pancakes) which you must try, as well as Khanom Ba Bin (coconut pancake) and crispy Khanom Bueang (Thai crepes). I loved them and they were delicious! 🌸🌸🌸🌸🌸
sample_reviews_en.author: Neng Noi

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place to try a variety of authentic Thai food for an affordable price. I really enjoyed the pork satay, green chicken curry and drunken noodles with gravy. The Thai tea was awesome – not too sweet but well balanced especially to quench the spicy food. They also have a small dessert booth with Thai sweet crackers and chewy mochi cakes that were not too sweet and very enjoyable with Thai Tea.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thai Bui

sample_reviews_en.text: If I have business in Pattaya, I will come here regularly. Every menu item is delicious. They have everything: food, drinks, fresh coffee, and delicious fresh coconut milk ice cream. The pork satay is very tender. The coconut pancakes and the crispy pancakes are very delicious. You must try them. The seats are comfortable. The staff are very good. Parking is convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: คุยกันไป สไตล์พี่นุ

sample_reviews_en.text:
A safe family restaurant.
The food and service are average.
Considering the price, it's not cheap either.
Its awkward position is what makes it a family restaurant.
It's better to go to a cheap and delicious place even if it's a bit rundown,
or to a nice place with a nice atmosphere.
It's a waste of time and money, especially for short-term travelers.
sample_reviews_en.author: 井之頭一郎

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very good food in a nice restaurant ambience with great service.
I was passing this place 100s of time never thinking about going in to have some great Thai food. I have chosen the noodles in thick gravy with seafood and a really fantastic pineapple & passion fruit smoothie. Both was outstanding.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thomas Gessendorfer

sample_reviews_en.text: Very delicious spicy noodle. This place is very popular for thai and feriegner customer s.  Recommend dish is chicken spicy noodle. Service is also great, fast and polite. Only drawback is price. It is a bit pricey.  I understand they give us a quality food. But at this price, it is a bit pricy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pratya P

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a great place to grab excellent Thai food and drinks at a reasonable price. Very clean. Staff are friendly. Very quick service. Near the outlet mall and Tesco so there is plenty of parking. Enjoy a meal and go to the night markets a short walk away on Friday and Saturday nights.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cambo Ford

restaurants.name: Siah Duck Noodle
restaurants.address:

2856 Rama IV Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered extra water and waited for a while. I saw 2-3 employees just standing around doing nothing. I called them again, and they told me to wait a bit longer. I said it was taking a long time. The employee said there was only one person making the water. I pointed out that 2-3 people were just standing around doing nothing. The employee said it wasn't their job.
That's it. I'm wasting time arguing with employees who can't think straight.
The service is terrible. They're incompetent and don't know how to manage their staff. There's only one person making the water, and if they're busy, the other employees just stand around doing nothing. When customers ask for service, they say it's not their job. The customer feedback contradicts this, and the owner probably doesn't know anything about it either.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Peter

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came here by suggestion from a best friend, not gonna lie food is bussing and good, the broth is fresh made and not powder bag chemicals, duck liver was actually liver and aroma was high in my expectations. Conveniently has a bus stop so i could go home easily and not fit in the rusty tube of a bts train. Normal Fan room is free of charge while AC Room is +10 baht. Super cheap and affordable while being a desire for local people alike.
10/10 i would come back 🤤🍽️😋

Note: bring cash since only 300 baht or more is acceptable for scan/QR
sample_reviews_en.author: Davion So

sample_reviews_en.text:
Arrived around 7 PM (the restaurant is open from evening until late).
It's a short walk from Rom Pho Mansion. Parking is available on the street in front of the restaurant. It's a large restaurant with plenty of seating. They mainly serve duck noodles and also have dim sum. I tried the noodle, soup, and offal versions. The broth is clear and light, easy to eat, not too spicy. The duck meat is good, and the offal is delicious. I wouldn't recommend the dim sum. Prices are 60+ baht (Mar 26).
sample_reviews_en.author: Tang Raksat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The soup has a light, delicious flavor, not too strong.
The intestines are crunchy and tasty, with pieces that are just the right size for chewing; the texture isn't tough, but it's not the mushy type either (this depends on personal preference).
Air-conditioned seating is available (additional charge, but reasonable).
The prices are clearly displayed.
It's a popular restaurant, but the service is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anan Tantisirisaeranee

sample_reviews_en.text:
✅ Braised Duck (per plate) - 220 Baht
Tender meat, not mushy. Tastes similar to the one used in ancestral offerings. Delicious.
✅ Duck Intestines + Blood - 120 Baht
Chewy intestines, delicious and soft blood. Hot. Be careful, it's really hot!
✅ Duck Noodle Soup - 65 Baht
✅ Duck Blood - 25 Baht
✅ Plain Rice - 10 Baht
✅ Singha Bottled Water (glass bottle) - 10 Baht
✅ Ice - 2 Baht per glass
sample_reviews_en.author: alice prince

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, lives up to its name and long-standing reputation.
Open only in the evenings, 6 PM - 11 PM.
Street parking available.

The duck meat is tender and not chewy.
The soup is flavorful, not too salty, and has a fragrant fried garlic aroma.

There are both fan-cooled and air-conditioned seating options (10 baht per person).
sample_reviews_en.author: Billy Than

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered takeout and specifically requested no garnish, but they didn't give me any vegetables at all.
The stir-fried kale with oyster sauce was more expensive than the noodles, but the portion was very small. This will be my only visit. And definitely don't order the dim sum; the ones from 7-Eleven are tastier.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wongsatorn Kitkasetkun

sample_reviews_en.text: A small bowl of duck noodles costs 60 baht. You can choose the noodles and two kinds of duck toppings. Overall, it's okay, but the duck meat is never as tender as chicken! The shop also sells shumai, desserts, and other side dishes. For an extra 10 baht, you can sit in an air-conditioned room.
sample_reviews_en.author: Huang Ming Liu

restaurants.name: Doi Soi 12
restaurants.address:

5/1-3 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I ordered an iced mocha coconut coffee and a coconut raisin cookie for 130฿. It was delicious and the shop was clean. I'd seen it in Chiang Mai and other places before, but this was my first time going in. It's better than Cafe Amazon 😊 I'll go again when I'm tired! …
sample_reviews_th.author: SJ

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ An absolute gem in Bangkok!
Doi Soi 12 Cafe is hands down one of the best dining experiences I’ve had in Bangkok. The food is absolutely amazing—fresh, full of flavor, beautifully presented, and clearly made with care. Every dish tastes like it was cooked with passion, and the quality is outstanding, especially for the price. You truly get excellent value for money here.
The atmosphere is fabulous—cozy, welcoming, and perfectly balanced between relaxed and stylish. It’s the kind of place where you instantly feel comfortable and want to stay longer, whether you’re there for breakfast, lunch, or a casual meal.
What really elevates the experience, though, is the staff. They are incredibly friendly, attentive, and genuinely kind. You feel warmly welcomed from the moment you walk in, and their service makes the whole experience even more enjoyable.
If you’re in Bangkok and looking for great food, fair prices, a wonderful environment, and amazing service, Doi Soi 12 Cafe is an absolute must-visit. I’ll definitely be coming back—and recommending it to everyone I know! 🌟🍽️
sample_reviews_en.author: Laz Janier

sample_reviews_en.text: A comfort place, almost peaceful in an otherwise bustling area. Soi 12 is a relatively calmer street among others and this place adds to the calm I believe. Good variety of breakfast options (pancakes, waffles, toasts etc.), mostly sweet though and very little savory. Nicely spaced out tables, suited for single guests, a pair or a group of 5-6 as well. Staff greeted and served me with a smile a music was appropriate - not too loud or intruding. They have a small counter which display coffee and fragrances (body mists) for sale and no additional charges for paying by card, which is rare in Thailand. Overall, enjoyed my coffee and pancake there, which was served to please. I would recommend this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: TheUltimateReview Level8Guide

sample_reviews_en.text:
Such a delightful find in Bangkok! The French toast here is the star, beautifully cooked with soft, fluffy bread and just the right amount of sweetness. The mango sticky rice was another highlight: the mango was incredibly fresh and sweet, and the sticky rice had great texture. Paired with their fragrant, well-balanced coffee, it all made for a perfect brunch stop.

The café has a cosy vibe, friendly staff, and a menu that really shows care in every detail. Whether you’re craving a light dessert, a good cup of coffee, or something comforting, this place delivers.

A definite must-visit when you’re in Bangkok!
If you enjoyed this review, please like and support and check out the photos I uploaded!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sean T

sample_reviews_en.text: I stumbled upon this lovely cafe while passing by. I initially thought it only offered coffee and pastries, but it turned out to have a wide variety of food options. The prices were very reasonable, the food was delicious, and the atmosphere was comfortable. Great value for money! 🥰 They accept QR code orders. The cafe isn't large, but there are plenty of seats. The Padthai was delicious; I recommend ordering a plate. The omelet with crab and basil was recommended on TripAdvisor. The basil and egg were very flavorful, but the crab meat was rather bland. However, I was very satisfied with the price. 😋 Opening hours: 7:00 AM - 10:30 PM (last order 9:45 PM)
sample_reviews_en.author: Paupau T

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited this place because I hadn't ordered breakfast at the hotel and was looking for a nearby spot. The food was clean and tasty, but the service was poor. Our order was delayed, possibly due to a mix-up, but they didn't offer a single word of apology. Considering the location and the overall atmosphere, the price is on the expensive side. However, since they open early, I suspect there isn't a suitable alternative in this area for travelers needing breakfast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eric West

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and a pleasant surprise! It was my first time trying Hainanese chicken rice, and I thought it would be bland, but it was surprisingly fragrant and well-seasoned. The mango sticky rice was also a perfect complement. A hidden gem restaurant! 💕 The indoor air conditioning was quite cold, and people were smoking outside, leaving us nowhere to go, which was a slight disappointment.
sample_reviews_en.author: jane yijiang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came in around 2:30 pm on a weekday for lunch. Around half the tables were empty. But they still gave me a low table and eating from it was uncomfortable for my back. The staff kept placing “reserved” cards on all tables that were getting vacant, so I didn’t feel welcome to ask them for a regular table.

The food (pad thai chicken) itself was pretty good, and this could easily have been 5 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Abhay M

restaurants.name: Hongmin
restaurants.address:

8/1-5 อาคารพาสิโอ พาร์ค Kanchanaphisek Rd, Sala Thammasop, Thawi Watthana, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Disappointing. The food was much worse this time.

The Peking duck was okay, but much better before.
The steamed black pomfret with plum sauce had no plum flavor at all, and the fish wasn't fresh.
The stir-fried cabbage with crispy pork was the worst dish; the pork was extremely tough.
The stir-fried noodles with ham were mushy.
The shrimp cakes were the best thing about the meal, but the size didn't match the description, and the price was high.
The shrimp dumplings and taro fritters were standard.

Most of the staff were okay, but some were too intrusive with customers' privacy. I've already reported this to management.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paiboon S

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a favorite restaurant of my kids. The Peking duck is reasonably priced. Every time we come, I never get a nice photo with my nieces and nephews because I'm so hungry my hands are shaking and they sleep for a long time, but it's delicious! The Peking duck here is reasonably priced and the taste suits everyone in my family. There's no fishy smell, and the crab meat is fresh with large chunks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Watsan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted great, and the portions were quite large, offering good value for money. The atmosphere inside the restaurant was nice, and the staff were polite, helpful, and provided excellent service. They even offered a special menu for birthdays.
I was very impressed.
I will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: OBCHOEII

sample_reviews_en.text: The Peking duck, I suspect, was cooked in old oil. It was incredibly oily and smelled rancid. The first bite was tolerable, so I gave it a second chance, but that was it. I didn't dare wrap it up to take home, and I wouldn't dare give it to anyone else to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: The A

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was tasteless, bland, like health food. I ordered stir-fried scallops with XO sauce and found the scallops still had ice crystals! I think the high rating is because the reviews included freebies and the staff pressured people to give 5 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: SC Chan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. The fried fish and squid were perfectly cooked, and the noodles were dry and tasty. The service was excellent from everyone, especially Fahsai, who is always lovely and attentive every time I visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarunya Limaksorn

sample_reviews_en.text: This Chinese restaurant is located in The Paseo, Kanchanaphisek Road. The decor is beautifully Chinese-themed, the food is delicious, and they offer set menus.
sample_reviews_en.author: CK Vistra

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was terrible; almost every dish needs improvement.
The service was average; even the staff taking orders could provide better service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eng Eng

restaurants.name: ครัวกลิ่นกะทะ สาขาลาดพร้าว (krua klinkata)
restaurants.address:

Sutthisan Winitchai Rd, วังทองหลาง, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
So delicious! It's amazing! Highly recommended. 220฿ per dish.
The price is a bit high, but understandable considering the location and the quality of the ingredients. However, I couldn't eat here every day; it's a little too expensive.
sample_reviews_th.author: Suchinda Charoenyuth

sample_reviews_en.text:
✔️ The egg fried rice was delicious, with a nice wok aroma and tender texture. You can choose the level of doneness.
The basil fried rice was surprisingly disappointing; the basil sauce was too sweet and lacked the fragrant basil flavor.
The fried eggplant was well-seasoned, but it was mostly just batter – hardly any eggplant flesh. It was crispy and delicious when fresh, but became chewy after a while.
The stir-fried cabbage with fish sauce was well-made, fragrant, and went well with rice.
It might be a style of Chinese cuisine that prioritizes the wok aroma, but the taste wasn't to my liking.
❌ The restaurant is air-conditioned with a partitioned kitchen, but the kitchen isn't completely closed off, so the smell of food permeates the air, making you smell good afterwards.
✔️ The ordering system uses a scan-to-order QR code with pictures of each menu item, which is convenient. The food didn't take long to arrive, and there's no need to reserve a table. There's seating for about 20 people.
❌ The price is too high compared to the quality, although the portions are generous enough for one person to be full.
✔️ There's parking for about 5 cars in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natch NW

sample_reviews_en.text:
My son suggested this place, saying it looked delicious.
- Egg Fried Rice with Fried Fish and Black Bean Sauce: The fried rice was ice cold, the fried fish was hard, and the sauce was bland.
- Orange Sauce Fried Chicken: The batter was tasteless, and the orange sauce looked like a watery dipping sauce – there wasn't much of it, and it didn't really taste like orange.
- Minced Pork with Green Beans: This dish was okay; the mala chili flavor was strong enough to burn my tongue.
- Crispy Pork with Chili and Salt: The pork skin wasn't crispy, but the meat was tender. The pieces were thick and substantial. The chili and salt seasoning only had chili, no garlic, and the flavor wasn't strong. Overall, it was quite greasy.
** Many dishes had a strong mala chili smell that left a numbing sensation in the mouth. The portions weren't small or large. The flavor was neither distinctly Chinese nor Thai.
Service: Friendly
Price: Reasonable
Summary: Recommended for those who want to try something new ☺️☺️☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Mie Ming

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is quite expensive compared to the quality. I ordered the garlic pork, priced at 120 baht, because I wanted to know why it was so expensive and how it differed from typical street food. In short, the rice was too hard; it's more suitable for stir-frying than for eating with a rice dish. I also ordered the crispy pork basil rice, which was worth the price. As for the service, they offer an app for ordering, but when I walked into the restaurant, they just shouted to customers to scan and order. When they served the food, they didn't inform customers what each dish was; customers had to figure it out themselves. The servers didn't communicate well with customers at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: รีวิวไปเรื่อย

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great air conditioning on a red hot day in Bangkok. Pleasantly surprised with the flavour taste of the beef with Mama noodles. very good quality steak/beef.
Really tasty. Deep fried egg eggplant something new very tasty crispy batter with flavouring of Worcestershire sauce. really enjoyed it. Only problem I had lost in translation seems that you cannot pay cash have to pay using. QR code thankfully the girl that served me paid my bill and I gave her the correct amount in cash. Well worth a trip not far from Suttisan mrt. Luckily, for me, I’m staying just round the corner. I’m checking the Grab app now see if I can get a delivery.👌🏻😊😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Craig Adams

sample_reviews_en.text:
BBQ Beef Fried Rice: Aromatic, delicious, and tender beef.
Perfectly complements the fried rice!! 🥩🍚

After my first visit,
I went a second time and am reducing the rating. The restaurant states that it closes at 10 PM.
(This refers to the time informed to customers or posted outside the restaurant.)
However, upon arriving at 9:30 PM, they said they were already closed.
It seemed like the staff were cleaning up the restaurant in another half hour or whatever, but that's your management.

The actual closing time should be clearly stated.
sample_reviews_en.author: Butcher Kung

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, the food was average but acceptable. The BBQ fried rice was tasty. The grilled beef was decent (with a slight gamey smell, but okay). For the dry sukiyaki, I recommend pairing it with the fermented tofu dipping sauce instead of the standard sukiyaki sauce. The Tom Yum instant noodles were too sour. The fish stir-fried with black bean sauce was okay (but I couldn't really taste the black beans). The fried eggplant with sauce was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Worawut Tantipisnu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious! Great food, no disappointment. I really liked it.

The restaurant has parking in front, and there's also a 7-Eleven parking lot across the street.

The fried rice had a wonderful wok aroma, fluffy and delicious.
The grilled beef fried rice had tender, not chewy, beef that was easy to eat.
The stir-fried green beans were slightly spicy, just right, and crunchy.

For me, this restaurant is delicious. I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthaphon Khnti

restaurants.name: Shoutaian Tokyo Shabu Shabu
restaurants.address:

34-3 Room 104 Vivre Langsuan Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I visited Shoutaian Tokyo Shabu Shabu (โชไทอัน โตเกียว ชาบู ชาบู) located inside VIVRE in Bangkok. The restaurant was clean and had a calm, Japanese-inspired interior, allowing me to enjoy a truly Japanese atmosphere while in Thailand. …
sample_reviews_th.author: piku.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious. Some of the meat had a dark color, but it was acceptable.

The service staff needs some manners training. Their attitude was lacking, almost rejecting customers even though it was the last round of orders and there was only one table left. It was as if we had to beg and call ahead, otherwise they wouldn't accept us.
I want to say that there aren't just other restaurants in Bangkok. In this economy, there should be a better mindset and service mind.

Normally, when I eat at a buffet, I order gradually and only order what I can finish. The staff should observe the behavior of each table. But here, they used the same approach on every table, speaking harshly that they were no longer taking orders. It's frustrating. The manners were like those of a cheap buffet. It's confusing. The staff member who spoke was polite, but abrupt. In short, I was not impressed.

>> I would like to suggest to the management and owner that the restaurant improve because the food is delicious, but without good service and communication, I think more than half of customers might not return again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jakrisa Na Phatthalung

sample_reviews_en.text:
at 1500 baht beef buffet. There were supposed to be 4 types of beef to choose from, but one had already run out. Out of 5 ice cream flavors, only 2 were left. Out of 3 soda flavors, only 1 remained. None of this was mentioned at the time of booking or before we arrived — we only found out after being seated.

The beef itself was solid, living up to A5 standards. The salmon was nothing special.

Another issue was the restaurant's lack of flexibility. Id booked the 6:00 PM slot but showed up 13 minutes late because of traffic and rain — that my fault I know. Still, the restaurant insisted on cutting things off strictly at the 7:30 PM end time based on my original slot, rather than the time I actually sat down. That might make sense if every slot was fully booked, but the place was far from full — there were plenty of empty tables.

little flexibility on adjusting time would've been nice — especially when customers are already  asked to accept the menu being sold out before they've even ordered.
sample_reviews_en.author: nakarin charoenloasiri

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is located in the Weave Building on Soi Langsuan. A friend happened to take me here for Wagyu Shabu-Shabu, and I was very impressed. The Wagyu beef and broth tasted even better than some restaurants in Japan. We chose the 1,699 baht course, which included Saga beef, Wagyu beef, salmon sushi, salmon sashimi, hamburgers, and many other items. The service was excellent; the staff were very attentive to detail. They even asked my friend, a regular customer, if she liked her usual order. They really remembered what my friend ordered, which is something I appreciated. This kind of service is something some restaurants lack, which is why this place has so many regular customers. Parking is also easy; you can park in the building's underground parking. This review is because of my positive experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kitsorn Sakunnuthongkham

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a wonderful atmosphere. The decor is beautiful, a luxurious Japanese style that still feels warm and inviting, perfect for dining with family, friends, or a special someone.

The meat quality is excellent; the marbling is beautiful, and the meat is tender and melts in your mouth. The broth and ingredients complement each other perfectly, making it a more premium shabu-shabu experience than typical restaurants.

Overall, I was very impressed with the atmosphere and food quality. The price might be higher than average, but it's worth it for the quality. Recommended for those who appreciate high-quality beef shabu-shabu or are looking for a restaurant with a great atmosphere for a special occasion. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Prasittisak Wongkerd

sample_reviews_en.text: Hands down one of the best Japanese shabu places in town. You can tell they “know their beef” - they have superb beef cuts / A5 wagyu that were reasonably priced; vegetables and everything else was fresh. Good sake menu, selection wasn’t too wide but just enough for a great meal. Overall great service and friendly staff. A small detail I also love are their mini cow chopstick holder figurines…so cute I was tempted to take one home!  The atmosphere is cozy, but not too small. Perfect for a business dinner with clients or friends. They also can set up a private room that seats up to 12 people. Building has ample parking and also has valet which is a plus.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jessy Dangboonrueng

sample_reviews_en.text: After a long  search for Shabu restaurant. I came across to this name " Shoutaian",  I'm so excited to try. Shoutaian has the A++ quality Wagyu that taste buttery, tender, and healthy. Parking just under the building makes it so convenient. We were greeted and assisted with the menu. Everything in this restaurant is so elegant and clean ( I still can't get over the little gold cows they used for chopstick  holder). I had a white bone broth soup base with my Wague and it was to die for no need to add anything. Great location, clean, great service and elegant setting. Worth the money for sure with all their dedicated work. Will be returning soon.
sample_reviews_en.author: N Hark.

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were at Shoutaian Tokyo Shabu Shabu. #goodfoods #shabushabu Couldn’t ask for more of the A5 Beef: they likely to melt down in the mouth with little chew.
They serve as a set and a la carte where you may choose between suki yaki and shabu soup. One set includes the side dishes and dessert which make them well-portioned.
🥩Our menu contains
- SAGA WAGYU A5 SHIMOFURI
- SAGA WAGYU A5 AKIMI
🎋The restaurant decorated with light tone make you feel so elegant. They offer bar tables and small groups table. Pot by pot
👔Their staffs are knowledgeable and helpful
💸Price are high but valuable for the quality

HIGHLY RECOMMEND FOR SHABU SEEKERS 🍲
