sample_reviews_en.author: Rossarin Vannaroekngam (Ross)

restaurants.name: เตี๋ยวบางกอก ซีคอนสแควร์ศรีนครินทร์
restaurants.address:

ซีคอนสแควร์ Srinagarindra Rd, Nong Bon, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Let me tell you what happened!!! I usually eat here all the time, and the other staff are usually nice. But suddenly, I encountered a secret employee – a receptionist who also takes orders. She had a face and demeanor like she didn't want to serve us, and her tone was like she was annoyed that we asked about the menu. When we handed her the menu, she took it, snatched it away, and then went to yell at the cashier, using very harsh words (I don't know if she was trying to offend us). I don't know how that employee tolerated her behavior. As a customer, I felt so sorry for that employee and the owner for hiring someone like this. How can any customer come back here? The owner should reconsider hiring this kind of employee. I don't know how many times she's done this, but she's the worst employee I've ever encountered. She should reflect on whether this is really the right job for her. I think she's not suitable for a service job anymore. Her name starts with the letter "N". Everyone, please be careful!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tina Sarina

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. We ate there on July 30th, 2026. At first, we waited for a while, then a staff member named LOM brought the menu and told us we could order noodles. It was our first time there, so we looked at the menu for a bit, checking the ingredients. Suddenly, she yelled at us, saying "You can order noodles now!" I don't know if we were allowed to look at the menu for a long time, but if she was in a hurry, she could have just told us we wanted to order. Instead, she yelled at us. It was very unacceptable. 👎🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: นางสาวรพีพร ชำนาญ

sample_reviews_en.text: The boat noodles are delicious. For those who like to try many different dishes, ordering a small bowl for 19 baht is quite fun. I'm deducting 1 star because I'd like to see the noodles improved. They come in chunks, are cloudy, and not clear, making them look unappetizing. However, all the food is delicious. The tom yum noodles are also tasty. The staff are lovely and give very good advice. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: cocochi hair design

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious and enjoyable, only 19 baht per bowl. It's a great snack, don't overthink it. Considering it's in a mall and covers staff wages, the portion size is appropriate for the price. The taste is pretty good. The small bowls allow you to try different kinds. If you prioritize large portions, I recommend going to another restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirilug T.keerati

sample_reviews_en.text: This boat noodle restaurant serves delicious noodles at affordable prices, starting from 19 baht. They have a huge menu with about 30 million options – so many that you'll be spoiled for choice! The staff will help you decide. They have boat noodles, tom yum noodles, various rice dishes, and tons of snacks.
sample_reviews_en.author: PLOY BOHHOT

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my second time eating here, but at a different branch, and the taste was just as delicious. The boat noodle soup is truly flavorful and doesn't need any extra seasoning. There's a wide variety of food to choose from, and the prices are reasonable. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Krit Tosakul

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! Starting at 19 baht, the waterfall-style noodle soup doesn't need any extra seasoning. I also tried the Yen Ta Fo (pink noodle soup) and it exceeded my expectations; the thick noodles were excellent. I'll definitely be back after my first visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: หลง หลงหลง

sample_reviews_en.text: The broth is rich and flavorful, delicious without needing any extra seasoning. I recommend the premium wagyu beef; the meat is so tender it melts in your mouth. It's fantastic paired with crispy pork cracklings.
sample_reviews_en.author: Little Eva Family

restaurants.name: Bourbon Street Restaurant & Oyster Bar, Boutique Hotel
restaurants.address:

Ekkamai Rd, Khlong Tan Nuea, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an amazing restaurant and a lovely respite in the middle of Bangkok. I’ve never had a meal here that I didn’t like. The owner, Doug, is extremely hospitable and this is his 39th year of running this restaurant here in Bangkok. I just can’t say enough about the wonderful food and the way this place kinda reminds me of being back home in the US. Although I’ve never lived in Louisiana, I really do appreciate the time and effort put into the decor to make this place feel homey. Kind of feels like “Cheers” in the middle of Bangkok… at least to me. Don’t even get me started on the amazing food and value that they provide when they have their buffets. I have recommended this restaurant to many people, and everyone has loved it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Serg Palanov

sample_reviews_en.text: Great clean place! In good shape and quiet. We had a good night's sleep here. The room we had 407 had a large king-size bed and a full size couch. We slept here comfortably with 2 adults and an 8 year old child. The bathroom is also nice and clean, and the room is quite large with a small balcony, safe, fridge, and desk/TV. Highly recommend dye to it being in such a clean good condition. We needed to be nearby in the morning - it is near the public transportation and the food at Bourbon St is good! The rooms are up the alley from the restaurant - we went there to check in. Ask for 2 key cards & note that they do not have shampoo/conditioner but do have other toiletries. Highly recommend for the price and quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Third Phone

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stayed one night. Tried to extend my stay with the lady checking me in. She ignored my request. Upon being shown to my room,  I repeated my request. She demanded 1000baht -;in the hallway! Then she got rude when I informed her I wouldnt be giving her any money (never mind 1,000 baht) without a receipt. Good thing I didn't, as I found out later there were no rooms available and I'm pretty sure that if I had handed over the money, that would have been the last I saw of it! In the interest of fair play,  I sent the owner an email outlining the occurrence and heard nothing back. So now I'll post publicly. First and last time.
Good food, nice room,  shitty table service (about average for Thailand) and sketchy staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stewart Brown

sample_reviews_en.text:
My husband and I had lunch here and everything was wonderful! The interior design and seating were lovely and inviting. The place was clean and very comfortable.

The staff and service were excellent. They thoughtfully waited for us to finish our appetizers before serving our entrées. We also appreciated the wet towels they provided for wiping our hands since we ordered chicken wings and ribs- such a nice touch!

The food was perfectly cooked and have generous portions. We had the garlic parmesan chicken wings, ribs, and lamb chops! All absolutely immaculate!! Nothing was dry or cold; everything was just right. And the fries, the fries were really good!!

We’re already looking forward to our next meal here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anne

sample_reviews_en.text:
We choose this hotel based on the location closer to the airport. The rooms were cleans and spacious. Staff was not that friendly, we arrived earlier and wanted to leave our luggage (possibility mentioned on Booking). The bar tender made us clear in an unfriendly way that we arrived too early and we could not check-in yet, which was also not our intention. After friendly asking, he reluctantly accepted to leave our luggage behind the desk.
In the end, the hotel was still quite far from the airport train line so we would recommend to look for a hotel more in the center but close to the train line.
This hotel is located in a popular business quarter so a lot of options to drink and eat on walking distance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julie Van de Vondel

sample_reviews_en.text:
Room is clean and big. Bottled water is provided everyday. Only downside was that my safe deposit box was left locked and open by the previous guest , hotel staff was not able to restlet it.

Restaurant

Extensive menu. The restaurant was too dark to read the menu, we had to use the torchlight from our phone to read it.

Ordered prawn bisque and was pleasantly surprised. It tasted so good. We also order the blooming onion, Hawaiian pizza and buffalo wings. All tasted great except for the wings which was not very well marinated. Overall, nice food and very reasonably priced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bernard Sim

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stayed here for 2 nights and couldn’t have had a better experience. The room was nice, super clean, and all the staff were lovely. I enjoyed a pint of Guinness in the bar downstairs and on my last morning had a nice bacon and egg breakfast for 120 Baht including coffee. The location was exactly where I needed and I’d definitely stay here again. Thanks Bourbon Street, for great accommodation!

If this review is helpful, please give it a ❤️ or 🙏 so others can more easily find it. Thanks for reading!
sample_reviews_en.author: Matthew Pearson

sample_reviews_en.text: Close to BTS station. Modest rooms but good value. Rooms are not sound proof so you can hear the doors opening and shutting. Basic amenities included so it's hassle-free. Room was clean. Great service: one night it rained and the guard even helped me to get my ride into the parking lot. Even held his umbrella for me. The rooms are upstairs and the restaurant on the ground floor. I liked the restaurant, it's a diner style establishment. Old school style. Great for a simple stay. I recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Claralee Fung

restaurants.name: ซ้งเตี๋ยวหมูต้มยำมะนาว Zongtiew Tom Yum Noodles
restaurants.address:

912 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Noodles : The most delicious pork noodles! The restaurant is well known with Tom Yum noodles that using fresh limes which is the best Kuay-Tiew Tom Yum so far in this area of Bangkok. But you’re also can’t miss ‘the clear soup noodles’. It’s very light and great to begin your first meal with. My favorite noodle is Sen-Lek (small noodles). Plus, I like the fact that they give more pork than other local restaurants so it’s very cheap to me.

Side Dish : Pork balls are amazing especially the pepper one, I love it grilled!

Drinks : The Chrysanthemum tea cleanse the tongue palate and left it sweet and refreshing. Ready to fight the hot humid weather here.

I’d rate this at my most favorite pork noodles! It’s hard to find the restaurant that can make good pork even most of Thai people eat pork though. Love it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bebee Thitayada

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff were extremely rude. I’m a foreigner and could only use Google Translate to order food. When I tried to explain, they seemed annoyed and unwilling to help. When I paid, they didn’t even look at me, and when handing me the food, they didn’t say a single thank you.

I’m truly disappointed by their disrespectful attitude toward foreign customers. This was my first and also my last time here. I really hope the restaurant will train their staff to be more polite and respectful, especially toward international guests.
sample_reviews_en.author: quyên nguyễn

sample_reviews_en.text:
This review isn't just about the chrysanthemum tea, but the drink itself tasted really good; the lime flavor was very prominent, which was great. The portion size was okay.
*However, for me, the dry tom yum noodles were a bit bland, and I personally prefer the chicken dipping sauce for the fried dumplings, but they were delicious even without it. If the restaurant prepared the dishes with a stronger flavor beforehand, I think it would be perfect. I will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: MAIL Risa

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum noodles have a delicious and well-balanced flavor, with the perfect sourness of an authentic Tom Yum recipe. But the highlight is the pork in the noodles; it's incredibly tasty, not smelly, tender, and flavorful – a perfect combination. I also recommend the deep-fried pork wontons, which are delicious, especially when eaten with the plum sauce. The restaurant's decor and atmosphere are clean and simple. Plus, the prices are very reasonable!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanatinat Sokongsod

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is clean, with trash cans available on each table.
The prices are standard for this era.
The Tom Yum soup is incredibly flavorful, sour enough to make you sweat.
The staff are cheerful and friendly, fitting the weather.
And if you leave a review on Google, you'll get a free chrysanthemum tea.
sample_reviews_en.author: Somaromhmai สมอารมณ์หมาย ณ

sample_reviews_en.text: Affordable prices, parking available in the alley behind the shop. The food looks exactly as pictured, no deception. The fried dumplings have plump fillings, the grilled meatballs have a delicious dipping sauce, the Tom Yum soup has a moderate flavor, and the marinated pork is tasty. Great value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sureeporn Tawankanjan

sample_reviews_en.text: I eat here often. The noodles are delicious and flavorful. I especially like the dry tom yum noodles. The restaurant uses fresh lime, giving you lime wedges in the bowl, and they give you a generous amount of pork and meatballs. The restaurant and utensils are clean. I'll definitely come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daruna Thasanagosol

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Tom Yum soup was delicious! I ordered both the dry and the soup versions. Personally, I preferred the dry one; the flavors were well-absorbed into the noodles and meat.

The restaurant is spacious and comfortable, and there's parking available at the back. I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakjira

restaurants.name: Hungry Monkey
restaurants.address:

4 ซอย เทียนทะเล 22 แยก 16 Tha Kham, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a hidden gem in Soi Bang Khun Thian 22. The food is delicious, the atmosphere is great, and there's a small zoo and a playground for children to play with. You can even see black macaques. It's not very crowded, so it's probably not well-known. I'd recommend going to this place. The atmosphere is great, and most importantly, you can take adults there to worship and pay homage to both Hindu and Chinese deities. It's all in one place. Take the adults to pay respects and the kids to play with toys, see animals, color, and enjoy delicious food.

I'd like to recommend two things about this place. If these two things are achieved, the number of visitors should increase significantly.

1. The black macaque zone. I'd like staff to closely supervise it and make it a highlight for children to feed the monkeys.

2. If the shop opened a food market zone, selecting the best restaurants and placing them in the cafe area, that would be a great way to attract customers. A weekend market would be a great option.
sample_reviews_en.author: kittipat vimunsuttikul

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the pleasure of trying this dish today, and I was beyond impressed! The spaghetti was perfectly cooked, with a tender, chewy texture that absorbed all the rich flavors. The beef was tender and melted in my mouth, perfectly paired with fresh, crispy vegetables like baby corn, carrots, and fresh peppercorns that added a delightful spicy kick. The aroma of the spices blended beautifully, making every bite feel thoughtfully crafted. This dish is an absolute must-try for anyone looking for an unforgettable dining experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sanchai Songdamrongtas

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is very spacious.
Parking is available outside the restaurant.

Inside, it's divided into different areas,
such as the restaurant, activity area,
a shrine, and an animal enclosure.

There's a children's play area with many play equipment,
including children's tractors,
though most of them are in poor condition.

The food is well-prepared and the flavors are excellent.
The prices seem high, but the portions are commensurate with the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khongwut Aries

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is wonderful and warm. The food is delicious. There are so many activities and good prices. They have a wide variety of food. I'll definitely take my son again. He loves it. The mini zoo is great, you can get up close and personal with the little ones, and there are so many places to play.
For those who are into spiritual practices, this is a must-visit. It's absolutely amazing! You'll get everything you need in one place.
sample_reviews_en.author: sasipapar peanpiriya

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden cafe in the Bang Khun Thian area. It's a cafe with a beautiful and spacious corner for making wishes. This is my second visit.
Food: 3 skewers of steak for 100 baht - amazing!
Service: The staff are cheerful and smiling, and the owner is lovely.
Lots of activities for children, with cute pets to see and an organic vegetable garden.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ice Akina

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, and the price was reasonable considering how good it was ☺️. The service was good, the atmosphere was cool and relaxing, and there was a pet-friendly area. The only downside was that the cats were chasing and biting us, so we had to leave quickly 😅.
sample_reviews_en.author: oommri maci

sample_reviews_en.text: There's a prominent sign out front stating that if you're just coming in and not buying anything, or just browsing and playing on the playground, you should go to the park in front. However, we didn't take a picture of the sign because we …
sample_reviews_en.author: น้องข้าวหอม เมลดา

sample_reviews_en.text: A paradise for kids! The playground is under the trees, shady and not too hot. We went in the afternoon during winter, and it was perfect. There are outdoor play equipment for the kids to burn off energy. Parents can order food and watch …
sample_reviews_en.author: Krissanee Boonudom

restaurants.address:

QF5W+HR, 80-84 Khaosan Rd, Talat Yot, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
SCAM 🚫🚫🚫🚫🚫
Be careful if you come to this place. Speak clearly, double-check everything you order as many times as possible, double-check your payment amount, and carefully check your change.

They switched my friend's bill, tampered with the security cameras, and the staff was very rude and confrontational. (They refuse to take responsibility for their mistake.)

They switched my friend's bill, tampered with the security cameras, and the staff was very rude and confrontational. (They refuse to take responsibility for their mistake.)

sample_reviews_en.author: Jose Antonio

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited December 31, 2024. Bangkok, Thailand.
It was so exciting that we ended up staying here for quite some time. This is a recommended bar to celebrate your last day in Bangkok.
We ended up clubbing until 4 AM on New Year's Eve and waking up to the first morning of the new year without sleep.
We then picked up our suitcases at Phaya Thai.
The first ARL train departed from Phaya Thai at 5:15 AM.
Arrived at Suvarnabhumi Airport at 6:00 AM.
Check-in counters opened at 6:20 AM.
Cleared security at 6:30 AM.
Breakfast in the lounge.
Boarding began at 8:45 AM.
If you take a direct flight, you'll arrive in Japan in the evening, making it in time for that silly errand you always have to run to your parents' house for New Year's. lol
sample_reviews_en.author: Shinta JP

sample_reviews_en.text: I was at this place twice, and always pay a lot for drinks and have fun but the last time I came and met the waiter, I handed over 1000 bath bill to give me my change and he came back and tell me that you only given me 100 bath bill, which was very inappropriate, really I was very upset and confronted him too but in the ended up go but I was very disappointed, even I don’t wanted to put review but I could help it to help others and the management should know too so there won’t be more victims, I have a picture of this waiter too, if the management reply I have no issues to post it here or send it to them
sample_reviews_en.author: Haroon M

sample_reviews_en.text:
* It’s worth watching the music decibel and soliciting battle between this place and the one across the street... but I came in because the ladyboys here dance better.

* They gave me the correct change even when I paid in large denominations, and they were incredibly friendly. I don't think the beer prices are expensive considering the passionate vibe.

* There were many customers who went around to other places and then came back. It’s one of the top five hot spots on Khao San Road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Liz

sample_reviews_en.text: A waitress changed my 1000 bill and then when I saw the cameras, the waitress handed me a 500 bill. The girl walked a bit and suddenly appeared at the counter handing over a bill that was not the same.  The recording was not complete. and then they gave me a 100 bill to leave the place.  and then another 20 bill when they saw that I didn't accept the bribe they gave me.  They were very aggressive and hot-headed, never go if you want to enjoy Khao San without problems.
sample_reviews_en.author: Diony Riquelme Larenas

sample_reviews_en.text:
BEWARE! THEY'RE TRYING TO SCAM YOU!

Be very careful! My friend and I ordered two cocktails (190 baht each). My friend paid with a 1,000 baht note, and the bartender tried to switch it for a 100 baht note, saying it wasn't enough. My friend and I told him we had given him a 1,000 baht note and asked him to give us the change. In the end, his scam didn't work because we were both sober, but many people go there already drunk, so who knows...
sample_reviews_en.author: FREE RIDER 92

sample_reviews_en.text: Beware: They run a scam where they hand you a beer with a cloth. They soak the beer in cooking oil so it is very hard to hold without dropping. Once it breaks, they don’t refund you and tell you to pay for another drink. They tried to do this to me, but I just left after - never going back either. I was coming regularly and spending lots of money also with tips. The jokes on them though, they lost a respectful and polite repeat customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: mauro creato

sample_reviews_en.text:
The bouncer at the front of the shop had a terrible and rude attitude towards Thai tourists and people from his own country. He yelled, cursed, and shone a flashlight in my eyes, which was very confusing. This happened on September 2nd, 2024.
This is the first time I've encountered such a bad customer in Khao San Road. 👎👎👎👎👎👎👎👎 Very disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fahrsiri Suasong

restaurants.name: Iam Pochana
restaurants.address:

215 2-3 Yi Sip Song Karakadakhom 1 Rd, Pom Prap, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing Food, Terrible Service, and Disappointing Atmosphere

I had heard so much hype about 'Iam Pochana' and their legendary Chinese cuisine, especially their hot pot style.

Let me tell you, the food was absolutely incredible! I've had my fair share of hot pots before, but Iam Pochana took it to a whole new level. The meats were thinly sliced by hand, giving them a unique and perfect imperfection. We ended up ordering three big sets, and I would easily give them a 5-star rating for the food alone.

Unfortunately, the same couldn't be said for the service. The servers were incredibly rude and seemed to have no concept of customer service. It felt like they were just there to handle the food, without any care for the customers' experience.

And the atmosphere was a real setback. We were seated on the street, and to make matters worse, cars were zooming by just inches away from our table. It was quite frustrating and made it difficult to fully enjoy our meal.

While the food lived up to its reputation, the service and atmosphere were major disappointments.
sample_reviews_en.author: Some1loveu

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing dipping sauce. Not a whole lot of variety in terms of protein for the bbq. Squid and prawn were literally the only seafood left on the menu (for both bbq and a la carte), which was a bit of a shame as we were really looking forward to lots of their seafood menu. So you may want to call them up in advance to ask for availability if there's anything you specifically want to try out.  You get a very local half Thai-Chinese vibe from this restaurant. I highly recommend you get a table outside as it gets fairly warm inside. The atmosphere was very pleasant until I saw a rat running across the street in front of the shop 😅 Please also note that while this shop accept QR transfer, this option is only available up until midnight. Overall the food is nice, some item on the menu is a little pricey but still taste pretty nice. Would recommend if you happen to be stumbling through this area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Udomkarn Boonyaprasert

sample_reviews_en.text:
A bit overrated thanks to many food vloggers over the years who have hyped up this place a bit too much... It feels more authentic than the hustle and bustle of the very touristy Yaowarat (Bangkok's Chinatown) and it's open late in the evening (until 3am according to Google Maps). Many locals sit there and enjoy their meals with friends.
Although there are choices for solo guests, I wouldn't recommend it if you are by yourself because hot pots are suited for a larger group of individuals to share/eat.

I ordered chicken Garlic with rice which tasted decent and almost too bland for my tastebuds, so nothing extraordinary (3 stars), and a large Chang beer because I needed it badly.
The service was excellent (5 stars) and the staff were attentive and friendly. I would recommend this place but I wouldn't recommend it alone. Go with your friends and definitely go once.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mary C

sample_reviews_en.text:
Definitely an epic meal if you are very very hungry. For the hot pan, we ordered:
- Beef Set + 2 Bacon Dishes + 2 liver dishes.
For the hot pot, we ordered: Beef set + beef stomach dish + heart dish+ shank dish + beef balls dish.
Together with cockles, crispy pork mee mimosa, garlic fried pork & liver, and some rice.

That was a lot for two. The bill came out at 1830. Worth every baht. This place has been historic in the area. And the food items have very high standards. A must if you are in Chinatown area.

Extra points for.
1. Sauces & dips are delicious.
2. Old school calculating techniques by the uncle.

Loads of respect. 🙏🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: N. A.

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been there twice, but this is my first review. The first time I had the beef hot pot noodles, which were delicious, so I planned to go back again. The second time I tried the grilled beef with dipping sauce – it was still amazing! But everyone has their own taste, I think it was delicious and I finished it all, haha. It's a shame to waste food. The prices are touristy, I guess. This is a review from a person from Northern Thailand visiting the area. Scroll through the pictures to help you decide. Just try it, don't overthink it! #Everyone'sTasteIsDifferent
sample_reviews_en.author: Phimwilai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Local restaurant with tables in the street. Ordered the beef hot pot all-out set and it was delicious. Lots of options for additions. The all-out set had a variety of different beef parts, and we ended up adding some vegetables, vermicelli noodles, and a little more meat. Plenty of other dishes on the menu that I’d like to go back to try someday.

Staff didn’t speak much English but everyone was friendly and helpful. The menu was easy to order from with English and pictures that you can point to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lee Calabrese

sample_reviews_en.text:
A dishonest restaurant that cheats you on prices.
I calculated the price before paying, but it was clearly higher than expected. When I asked the staff, they later said, as if to make up for it, that only the stir-fried vegetables were more expensive because they were seafood, but the other dishes wouldn't have changed in price even if they were seafood, so it's obviously strange.
In addition, despite ordering a Chang beer, they deliberately served me a more expensive Singha beer.
sample_reviews_en.author: 木村

sample_reviews_en.text: You must understand that this is an old street food restaurant in Bangkok's Chinatown. Even though the outside doesn't look clean according to standards, they offer good-quality Thai-Chinese food. If you don't know what to order, you can choose between hot pan BBQ pork or braised beef hot pot. You can order additional menu items from the menu. I recommend sitting outside, as it has better air circulation than inside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neeraj Kim

restaurants.address:

2354, 9 Lat Phrao Rd, Phlabphla, วังทองหลาง, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff didn't wipe the table. Even when we told them it was dirty, they still didn't come to wipe it, and they made disgusted faces. We had to wipe it ourselves, and the table was covered in sticky sauce. Terrible service. If you're going to be like this, you shouldn't be a staff member.
sample_reviews_en.author: JET

sample_reviews_en.text: The main branch is good. The seating area is spacious, and there are four automated ordering kiosks. On the day I visited, three of the EDC payment machines weren't working, so I had to pay at the counter. The food didn't take too long to arrive, especially in the early morning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nanthiya S.

sample_reviews_en.text: Train new staff immediately! The staff at this branch are very rude to customers. I experienced being treated with disapproving looks, so I read reviews and it turns out they treat customers with disrespectful behavior. Improve your staff immediately!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Muthita Buaubon

sample_reviews_en.text: The service staff is excellent. This is a branch I've been a customer of for a very long time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Augustine M

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was good, and although there were many people, it was quiet and peaceful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ter1 Milk1

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch is open 24 hours a day. It's consistently busy throughout the day. 🥤🍟🍔 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuttapong S.

restaurants.name: Hemingways (Jomtien) Restaurant & Bar
restaurants.address:

414, 21 Thappraya Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Hemingways is a well run and professional English style pub with good food,good service and a decent range of drinks and snacks. Not too much open for decent meal around Jomtien so came here for dinner. Sat down in the outdoor area. Plenty of good screens for watching international sports. Outside was showing pro golf and formula 1. We ordered a Pepperoni Pizza and a Fish and Chips. Unfortunately due to covid restrictions no alcohic drinks available. All good. Sprite and water is fine. Menu is impressive. Basically its a tablet with a full digital menu. Very easy to use, not to mention, modern and sophisticated. Food arrived quite quickly and was hot and delicious. Overall a great dining experience, good honest food at fair prices and service to match. No complaints whatsoever. Will definitely return when next in Jomtien.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrew L.

sample_reviews_en.text: Went here for breakfast on the first morning of a trip to Jomtien and ended up going every single morning simply because I don't think you can do better in Jomtien. Delicious full English breakfast and also the smaller version, perfectly cooked and presented and wonderful service, friendly and professional. There is a great atmosphere here and I did notice many return customers. The newspapers available to peruse were much appreciated, too. I did not go in the evening because I was a bit worried that I would end up going every evening as I heard those meals are also delicious and the place looked packed every night! Many thanks Hemingways and I really look forward to returning!
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Baker

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went this morning to Hemingways.

Good atmosphère, cool air , music not to loud .

Staff very quick and can speak better english than me .

I was through the menu on the tablett. Nice picture and food correspond to the picture . Happy to get it . Not always easy .

I tried this time thai food . Very large portion with a good coffee at the end .

Aparently they have some quiznight on monday . Interesting to test myself next week .

Hemingways must be really cool on a football night. They have a huge space .  I estimate 180 people can rush in .   Plenty of tv for ambiance.

Really Happy to found that place .

Price wise the not expensive and so many draft beer .
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Brett

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hemingways quickly became my 'go to' place while in Jomtien. With an almost typical quality British pub vibe, the welcome from Management & Staff is both warm and friendly. There is a clean spacious layout for table dining, a game of pool, watching sport on TV (at a nice volume) or plenty of room to 'prop' or be seated at a stool as preferred by an old 'bar fly' like me.   The food is nothing short of delicious with a good selection of Thai and Western cuisine.  Everything is well priced and they also offer regular specials of the day that are even better value.
All in all, a thoroughly enjoyable well run establishment. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: MJ

sample_reviews_en.text: Great pub style sports bar/restaraunt. Service was great as was the food. Loved the various screens dotted around  showing all kinds of sport. Even ice hockey. Will definitely return for the Sunday roast. Might catch the grand prix there too! 4/6/23 revisited to try out eheshbday lunch. Now I'm fussy about my roast dinners as I make a pretty seocualoneofmg own. I was very pleasantly surprised. I the chicnek8was cooked how I like it, crispy skin, it was very tasty overall, the Yorkshire pud definitely beat mine hands down. Will be revisiting for sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mandy Revelle

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went for dinner at Hemingways Jomtien tonight. Very beautiful inviting interior and decor with comfortable seating. Super friendly staff throughout from entry to ordering. Had the Wagyu, Cheese/bacon burger. Outstanding! I'd go as far as saying the best burger I've had in Pattaya. Nice cold Heineken to go with it.
Was served by Noy and Lek who were just fabulous.

It has a comfortable and warm welcome friendly atmosphere in here and I look forward to my next visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Darren Whitehead

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went there for  birthday (dinner)
They put up free birthday decorations for us .
My friend organized for a suprise birthday cake and the staff presented it   and also sung happy birthday.We loved it.
The staff were friendly and the service was great.
Good selection for beer lovers.
We ordered roast dinner but the meat was thin more suitable for sandwich than roast dinner.
The meatballs was not the best either.
All in all,we enjoyed our moment there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ms.Sylviah Radcliffe

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my favorite place in town for breakfast, lunch or dinner. The staff is very nice and the place is spotless! You can choose from steak, to chops and breakfast choices. To many food items to mention. I choose cod fish and chips and I was very satisfied. You should make this place 1 of your favorites too! There's something for everyone, so bring your crew.  There are many big screens to watch sports if that's what your looking for too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thomas Bradley

restaurants.name: Sui Heng Chicken Rice
restaurants.address:

1739 ถ. เจริญกรุง Yan Nawa, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A long-established Khao Man Gai restaurant. A reliable taste from a historic establishment. I tried the three-meat platter (boiled chicken, fried chicken, and offal), and each was delicious. Needless to say, the chicken itself was excellent, but the boiled chicken (Hainanese chicken) was moist and refined, the fried chicken was crispy on the outside and juicy and tender on the inside, and the offal consisted of a rich, creamy liver and chewy gizzards – three distinct flavors and textures to enjoy.

Soup is included for free, but I ordered the lime soup, which costs extra. This was also delicious! A rich chicken broth with refreshing lime acidity, and generous chunks of chicken from drumsticks to wings. Definitely worth ordering.

They open at 6:30 AM and are very accommodating to tourists, so it's definitely worth a visit. Please rest assured that this is definitely not a rip-off restaurant 😁
(However, the last two items on the menu on the wall are both listed as "tom yam soup," but the second one is actually lime soup. Just for your information.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Bunta OZAKI

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have eaten here a few times over the years and can confidently recommend the place.

The food: for me is 4/5 stars. The chicken while flavorful sometimes has too much gristle or parts that aren’t edible. The rice is slightly flavored, the broth they serve is the star of the show in terms of flavor.

The staff: every person I’ve encountered here has been super friendly. The younger guy who butchers the chicken is always very friendly, cute and has a smile on his face. A very welcoming individual. 5/5 stars

The atmosphere: small shop with maybe 8-10 tables, fans always blowing and a lot of pictures from over the years on the wall. Good chill ambiance. 5/5 stars

Price: it’s $60THB for the small fried chicken with rice and broth. That’s comparable to other similar places. Cash only. If you’re in the area craving this then I would recommend.

I have not tried the boiled chicken but that seems to be the more popular dish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel O

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was excellent! Just ask for anything, and the owner is very welcoming. I came alone, and they chatted with me, so I wasn't lonely.
It was crowded during lunchtime, so I ended up sitting with another lady who seemed to be from the area. She said she'd been eating there since she was a child, and that the restaurant has been around for a long time and is delicious.

I came based on reviews, and the Hainanese chicken rice lived up to its reputation. The pickled lemon chicken was also delicious – a nice balance of sweet and sour. When I ordered, the owner let me taste it first and said they would adjust it if I didn't like the flavor; that was great!

The dipping sauce was tasty, and they gave me a huge portion of rice. I couldn't finish it all! 🥹 I ordered it without the skin, so I got lean chicken.

In the end, I couldn't finish the pickled lemon chicken and had to take the leftovers home. 😂
sample_reviews_en.author: Anoossara J

sample_reviews_en.text:
Walking along the historic Charoen Krung Road, came across a variety of Thai-Chinese shops which many offering delicious food. For today lunch, I decided to go for a local chicken rice shop, popular among locals but relatively undiscovered by tourists.

The chicken was served in generous portions, and the fragrant rice was so good that I ended up having two bowls. The dipping sauce served on the side, taste perfectly by adding ginger and chili makes it a true Thai-style experience. Don’t miss the sour plum and lime soup, which complements the meal with its refreshing, tangy flavor. Tips, drink it with the small soup bowl and you will find the wonder!

The friendly owner and fast service were definite highlights. This was one of the best khao man gai dishes I’ve had in Thailand!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lin Wooi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Felt that for chicken rice, probably better to eat during the day rather than night. The white chicken rice is actually good. Light fragrant rice with steamed white chicken, meat is tender and a good chewy texture. Disappointed with the fried chicken though as it was cold, and probably is night time and hence they are just selling the remaining fried chicken from the day, and will be nice if they actually re-fried it once before serving. Also didn't like the sweet chilli that goes with it, as it was super normal. Over here, there is no typical Hainanese chicken rice red/orange chilli but they have brown looking one, which was ok. One thing I do like also is the soup, very nice chicken stock-soup.

Will recommend but maybe just for for the steamed chicken with rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: JA A

sample_reviews_en.text:
This a local chicken rice shop which seems to cater mostly to locals. So we went in off peak around 3+ in the afternoon when it was quiet to try out the chicken rice. I ordered the fried chicken & steamed chicken combo rice. The rice as expected was fragrant and well cooked. The fried chicken had nice crispy texture on the outside but smooth meat on the inside. Prefer this to the steamed chicken which was ok but didn’t stand out. Average price is about 70 baht per portion and portion is average. The shop is not very big and I’m sure will be packed during lunch time peak hours.
Come here to experience local chicken rice in a traditional local Thai food place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is clean. Number of table is not so many (i saw a lot of delivery order comes and goes). I ordered boiled chicken (breast) with oily rice and boiled chicken in marinade lime soup.
The boiled chicken breast is tender and not dry (like this most). The source and oily rice are average. I personally think that having chicken with rice without source is better. Lemon soup is also average. I considered this meal in the medium to cheap rate. There is no parking lot available. You need to park at the temple named "Suthiwararam Temple".
sample_reviews_en.author: Nonth T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Hainanese chicken rice was delicious. The chicken was tender and juicy, not dry at all, even though I ordered the breast meat. I wasn't quite a fan of the rice itself, but it wasn't overly oily. The dipping sauce was flavorful and paired perfectly with the chicken. It had chopped chili and ginger, which was great. The hot soup had a hint of pickled lime, making it well-balanced and easy to drink. Overall, it was delicious.

You can ask for refills of the soup anytime.

You can park in the alley and walk to the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: วริยา มารศรี

restaurants.name: Peppery Thai Bistro (Siam Paragon)
restaurants.address:

G Floor, Siam Paragon Mall, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice and recommended Thai restaurant you could try when visit Siam Paragon shopping mall. We walked around Ground floor at Siam Paragon to look for Thai resto and decided to came here and tried their food. Had a bit of people on the line already during dinner time, after a bit of wait then we managed to get seat inside. We ordered Stir-fried Crispy Bass (fillet), Mixed Seafood in Clear Tomyum Soup, and Crispy Spring Rolls.
Stir fried crispy bass fillet was good, crispy outside and tender inside, not dry, perfectly fried, sauce is good, it’s a nice dish. Seafood tomyum was really nice, a lot of ingredients inside and seafood were fresh, got sliced fish, squid, prawn, mushrooms, etc. It was right amount of spicy and sourness, so enjoyable. And the Crispy spring roll was so good, perfectly fried, crispy skin outside and nice vegetables combination filling inside like glass noodle, carrot and wood ear mushrooms.
Overall dishes we ordered was so delicious and tasty, good quality. We finished all of it. Loved the food here. Service was okay, the place not so big though but atmosphere is okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: DP

sample_reviews_en.text: Highly recommend if you are looking for a bite to eat whilst shopping in Siam Paragon. Peppery Thai Bistro is located in the Food Hall. Open restaurant with its own seating area, although tables are limited. I had a late lunch at 16:00 and managed to get the last available table before a line started to form. This was on a Saturday afternoon. Service is very good. Staff are friendly and pleasant. I had the extra large grilled river prawns (two in a portion) and the classic papaya salad. Really good. If you order the grilled prawns then preparation time is around fifteen to twenty minutes. I was happy to wait. Really good. I couldn't fault it. Even glancing around at other diners and the menu, everything looked nice. I was a solo diner or I would have ordered more. If you are with others, order a variety of dishes and share. Portions are generous. Would recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Taylor Deni

sample_reviews_en.text:
Having the aesthetic is definitely not enough for a restaurant. While the establishment is nicely done up and the menu is enticing, the food simply did not meet the cut.

1. Stirred fried cabbage was watery and bland.
2. Tom Yum gong could pass off as lime water. It lacked both flavours and fragrant.
3. Oyster omelette was poorly done, with thick layer of tasteless goey starch. The bean spout still had the raw stench. The only consolation was the oysters, which were plump and fresh.

Three simple dishes and they reflected poor culinary skills and a lack of heart to provide a welcoming experience for patrons. With such poor outlook, the dishes could not bring about any anticipation when they were served.

The chef might need to go for re-training to ensure that quality of food is up to standard.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ma tt

sample_reviews_en.text: Wow, we thought the price was a little bit on the high side but it was completely worth it after we tasted the food! we  came here craving for its large river shrimp and crab, we only ordered 3 items including Clear Tom Yang soup.  The large river shrimps were perfectly grilled and delicious to start with, and the curry crab we ordered was stunning!! the crab was fat, sweet, so perfectly cooked that the shelf so easy to peel off from the meat.  we are from the Philippines and always have crabs but this is one of THE BEST crabs we've ever had! Unanimous decision!! with this crab, I dont care about the price or service anymore, a super 5 stars!! Galing! (sorry too late to take photos)
sample_reviews_en.author: Eric Wang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food, had a wonderful experience at Peppery Thai Bistro, Siam Paragon. We tried the Vegetables Spring Rolls, yummy Chicken Satay, Garlic Fried Softshell Crabs, delicious Tom Yum Goong, Pineapple Fried Rice, Spicy Salmon Salad (Raw), Black Pepper Jumbo River Prawns.
Loved everything. The crispy spring rolls were perfectly made. Loved the Spicy Salmon Salad - flavorful and refreshing. The Jumbo River Prawns were another favorite as well. For drinks we had the Butterfly Pea with baby coconut and the Blueberry Smoothie.
Very hospitable and friendly service. Highly recommend everyone in Bangkok or visiting Bangkok to try this eatery. Thank you Peppery Thai Bistro ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Samm M.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don't go. It has become a tourist trap. We dined at 7:30pm 23Mar 2026. We ordered 4 dishes, Tum Yum Kung soup, deep fried Tofu and the expensive crab fried rice and the chili fried crab meat. The cheap dishes were acceptable but the expensive fried rice was tasteless (totally a failed fried rice), the crab meat was much little than the menu photo (see the attached photo I took vs the menu photo), yet the taste was watery and bland. How dare they sell it and charge it high. Not much service provided, not even given a cup of water.

DONT GO. DONT GO. OR YOU WILL REGRET FOR SURE LIKE MANY OF US!!
sample_reviews_en.author: B3

sample_reviews_en.text:
Though this place is pricy, but boy do they ever make up for it through quality and taste of their food 👍🏻

Just happened to came across this, so we decided to give it a go, does not disappoint one bit.

Service was friendly and patient as we go through their extensive menu.

They serve excellent local authentic cuisine and the freshness of the ingredients really shows, especially the oyster omelet 👌🏻 simply top notch.

Portions too are massive here, so be ready 💪🏻

Will definitely hit this place again once we return to BKK.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Isaac

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu is a testament to the rich tapestry of Thai cuisine, presenting a spectrum of culinary delights that cater to every palate. I ordered classic Tom Yum Goong, Steamed squids with chilli and lime sauce, stir-fried morning glory, omellete, and spicy chicken basil. Each dish is great of balance and authenticity.  Always come to get the queue number 1st as this restaurant might be busy depending on time and day. Overall, it is highly recommended to check out this restaurant if you are in Siam Paragon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tina Liow

restaurants.name: COAL Bistro
restaurants.address:

38 Ratchaphruek Rd, Chim Phli, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Nice food, nice service, nice ambiance
Plenty of parking
Yeah, you can bring your own wine and if your bill exist ฿2000, they don’t charge you the corkage
Recommended for steak lover
sample_reviews_th.author: Navin Khanijow

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was served extremely slowly. The first bite was room temperature.
I saw the kitchen had finished preparing it a long time ago. I rang the bell to call someone to serve it, but no one brought it to the table. The person who rang it had to do so 4-5 times before it was finally brought. The spaghetti with chili and bacon was very cold. The steak took so long to be served that the salmon was already no longer hot.
And despite the heat, there were only 2-3 tables of customers at that time.
The air conditioning wasn't working either, which added to my frustration.

I chose this restaurant to celebrate my birthday and this was very disappointing. The price is too high for this level of service. It's not worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Most D

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I visited Coal Bistro to try their steak and I’m so happy to have discovered another favorite spot in Bangkok. Everything we ordered was absolutely delicious the avocado salad fries pasta and steak. Each dish had well balanced flavors and a truly divine taste. When it comes to the price it’s totally worth it considering the taste and quality. The staff were welcoming attentive and polite. The atmosphere was cozy and perfect for a relaxed dinner. If you’re looking for a fine European restaurant for a great steak I highly recommend Coal Bistro ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Irene

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is known for its meat dishes, but I really loved the salmon. It was so delicious! @coal.bkk The salmon was juicy, the skin was perfectly crispy, and it paired great with the sauce. The steak dish, a tenderloin, was well-prepared and of standard quality – not tough or difficult to chew. The mashed potatoes with truffle were delicious. They currently have a promotion: buy 2 dishes, get 1 free, so I chose the Caesar salad. When I saw it, I thought it had burrata cheese on top, but it was actually a pouch egg! My favorite! ☺️💖
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicharin Jianjinda (Cartoon)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This meal at COAL Bistro 🥩 was delicious, starting with the two-tone welcome bread that matched the restaurant's theme, followed by a creamy foam soup and a crunchy avocado almond salad.
As for the main course, I have to give a thumbs up to the charcoal-grilled steak with its unique aroma, juicy and perfectly cooked, served with their signature sauce. Or you can switch to the large, sweet and tender piece of snow fish on mashed potatoes, equally delicious. I'm adding this restaurant to my list of favorites for special occasions 🖤
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaettareeya Khunkaew

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious! The meat was tender and melted in my mouth. The salmon salad was delicious and refreshing with the citrus.

All the staff were very helpful and provided excellent service. They were cheerful, smiling, and had great service minds.

The staff member who specifically took care of us, Lay, was exceptionally good. He recommended dishes and even helped take photos for us.
The staff member named Nut was also very attentive; I saw him bring a cushion for the elderly woman at the next table. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: kamolchanok reansuwong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The day I went to the restaurant was quite hot and there were flies.
The Spaghetti Carbonara had onions and cream in it, but lacked cheese flavor (the menu name should be changed to Alfredo or Cream Sauce).
The Seared Jumbo Scallops were average in taste; the bacon sprinkled on top didn't quite fit in.
The Premium Angus Ribeye was very fatty and had tendons.
The Pork Chop Bowl had slightly burnt garlic, giving it a slightly bitter smell.
Overall, the price of the food far exceeded the quality and taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kantapol Sirawitoon

sample_reviews_en.text: Compared to other places in the area, it might be okay, but if you eat in the city often and compare it, it might not be. I was indifferent after trying it; a little disappointed that it wasn't better. My initial thought was, "Really?" 😅 They don't have house wine, only small bottles for 400 baht. The taste was just average, and I'm just confused why they don't offer house wine. There are plenty of good, inexpensive wines out there. They'd still make a profit per glass! 😭
sample_reviews_en.author: A T

restaurants.name: KABOCHA SUSHI @HOMEPRO BANGNA KM1 (ชั้น 1)
restaurants.address:

โฮมโปร สาขาบางนา, กม.1 224 Debaratna Rd, Bang Na Tai, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
One of my favorite japanese  resturant
Good start with. Welcome miso soup, wakame and fried fish. I got offer after I apply member with spicy salad. My main dish ข้าวหน้าปลาดิบ Donburi
Staff : friendly and good service
Food : Good
Atmosphere : cozy and comfortable
sample_reviews_th.author: Nittreeya Wongsa

sample_reviews_en.text: Our family likes to stop here. It's convenient and has a wide variety of menu options. My husband loves their salmon sashimi; the quality is excellent. We like their salads, and this time we ordered the soft-shell crab salad for the first time. We loved it – the soft-shell crab was crispy and delicious. Our daughter ordered a new kids' menu item, which she enjoyed so much she even ordered some to take home. We'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mama New TJ

sample_reviews_en.text: The sushi restaurant in HomePro has excellent service. I've tried to eat here many times but never managed to because I was too busy shopping. Today I finally got to try it. Shin Sushi uses very fresh ingredients. If you want authentic, high-quality sushi, this is the place. The prices vary, and the staff are very attentive. The location is very convenient for customers shopping at HomePro, with plenty of parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Atiwat Sinrachatanant

sample_reviews_en.text: This Japanese restaurant is located on the ground floor of HomePro Rama 9. The sushi is very fresh and uses high-quality ingredients. The price reflects the quality. I highly recommend trying it; I personally loved it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brûlée

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere. The sashimi was amazing, and the portions in each dish were huge! This was my first time here, and I was so impressed. P.S. I was so hungry I forgot to take pictures of the food!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nawanit Silthornvisudhi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Love the udon noodles with melt in your mouth stewed pork belly and broth! Huge bowl; good for sharing.
The claypot rice was yummilicious too!
Appreciate the free edamame apps ❤️
Service prompt and courteous.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jacq K

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu is diverse and interesting, with many options to choose from; whatever you're craving, they have it. The food is fresh, clean, and delicious. This is another restaurant that I'm impressed with.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ohlala Oom

sample_reviews_en.text: The salmon was excellent. The staff provided outstanding service and gave lots of recommendations on promotions and discounts. It was delicious and of truly high quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bencharat Chotisirisathaporn

restaurants.name: Suki Teenoi Liap Thangduan 2
restaurants.address:

6, 12 Pradit Manuthum 19, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a recently opened Thai BBQ buffet restaurant located near the expressway. It offers a wide variety of menu items, including pork, beef, seafood, a salad bar, and an extensive dipping sauce station with many options. The sauces are moderately flavored. Seafood quality is mixed—some items are fresh, while others are not. The pork and beef are decent.

However, the grills provided are not very hot, even when set to the highest level, especially when compared to other BBQ places. The brass grills tend to have black residue, and even when replaced, the new ones may have similar issues—so diners are advised to use discretion.

Overall, the restaurant is spacious with plenty of seating and a large parking area. If you visit after noon, it tends to get crowded, and you may need to queue.
sample_reviews_en.author: S K

sample_reviews_en.text: The food selection wasn't very diverse, but it was okay for the price. I couldn't finish everything (I ordered a lot, but I'm sure I'd finish it all!). They told me my time was up, even though there was no queue because it was late. Couldn't they let customers enjoy their meal for at least 10 minutes? Couldn't they be a little more flexible? It was really disappointing. I would have been willing to pay for extra time if I wanted to continue eating, but to be rushed out like that... they were even staring at me before my time was up! Okay, I won't eat anymore. (If there's a long queue, I always leave on time, never over.) I probably won't go to this branch again. I've been to another place that let me stay longer (if there wasn't a queue). It's a shame, my bingsu was really delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: ดีไม่ดีริวิวจริง

sample_reviews_en.text: I frequent this branch. I love their dipping sauces, and everything is clean. I especially love their truffle mushroom soup with rice crackers – a perfect combination, so smooth and delicious. It might get a bit cloying if you eat too much, though. Another new menu item I love is the pineapple chili salt bingsu; it's incredibly tasty! I'm not sure how long this item will be available, but overall, the ingredients are fresh and delicious. Previously, there was a lot of squid roe, but now there's not much, so I choose other dishes instead. One more thing: the female staff. I see them often standing around the ingredient display, chatting or just staring at customers with unwelcoming expressions. I hope they improve their service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poiizsi _

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I had the opportunity to use their services and was very impressed with the service from the team.

I would like to commend the manager, head cashier, and counter staff, especially for their management and problem-solving skills. Everyone listened attentively, communicated politely and courteously, and resolved the issue systematically and professionally.

What impressed me most was not just the outcome of the problem resolution, but also their attitude towards service and customer care, which reflects the team's excellent management standards.

I commend and encourage the entire team and hope they maintain this high standard of service going forward. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: Nath Ch.

sample_reviews_en.text:
There's a huge variety of food. Meat lovers shouldn't miss it! Pork, seafood, river prawns, peeled glass shrimp, cheese, salad bar, snacks, fried food, crackers, plus truffle soup, fruit, instant noodles, and eggs.

The price is 299 baht, not including unlimited refills of drinks (39 baht), including Coke Zero. Desserts are included.

There was a queue of 30 people when I went, but it moved very quickly. I got my food in less than an hour. Don't expect it to be like yakiniku, but it's excellent value for the price.

There are many dipping sauces to choose from. The BBQ sauce tastes similar to the one at Green Crocodile restaurant.

The parking lot is huge!
sample_reviews_en.author: a.aloniix saniiz

sample_reviews_en.text:
Teenoi BBQ
- Ribeye: Second toughest cut, takes a long time to chew.
- Karubi: Normal, not tough, but not exactly tender either. Easiest to eat.
- Horse Steak: Toughest of all, impossible to chew, takes a long time, even gets stuck in your teeth. Tough like rubber.
- Chuck: Not tender, takes a long time to chew, edible.
- Shank: Not tender, tough and crunchy. Edible because the portion is small.

Overall, if you're coming for the meat, it's quite tough. The Australian beef is much worse than Teenoi Suki's, which is very tender.

The appetizers are good and delicious. The vegetable bar and other items are good and tasty.

But the meat is really not good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Worrachot Bumrung

sample_reviews_en.text: TEENOI BBQ buffet, averaging 362 baht per person, with a 2-hour dining time, offers warm and attentive service, a wide variety of dishes, including salads. The beef is of excellent quality, the shrimp is very fresh, and the octopus is tender. The meats are kept in a refrigerated display case, ensuring hygiene and freshness. Overall, I was very satisfied. The only downside is that the seating is a bit cramped. The restaurant has clean and tidy restrooms. This is probably the most cost-effective BBQ buffet in Bangkok and is highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Speedplus

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice, spacious and comfortable mookata experience. It’s a bit far away but worth the visit if you’re nearby. There’s always a line up so come during non peak times.
Good meat selection. The buffet area does offer some good selection as well. Kids really liked the fries and chicken nuggets. The truffle mushroom soup was good as well.
One thing I wish they had was soy sauce or something that is salty. The sauce they provided was on the sweet side but we prefer a savoury sauce.
They also only take cash so be prepared for that.
sample_reviews_en.author: Co

restaurants.name: Herbs & spices indian restaurant
restaurants.address:

37 chakkraphong road chansonkram Khwaeng Chana Songkhram, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Listen up! If you like Indian food, this is the best choice you will be lucky enough to experience in Bangkok and one of the best in the world! This is not remotely fusion food, and it's not experimental. Instead these are the dishes you've come to love cooked with extra passion and served as a style of comfort food. These are all the recognizable dishes but made with their unique interpretation in the classic Indian tradition. Everything I have tried is magnificent. This is a place I return to again and again for the absolute excellence in quality, freshness and passion for the art of cooking. There are other choices for Indian food, but really there's only one solid choice and this is it! Look no further, here's a delightful meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: ROCK STARKEY

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Indian restaurant had great reviews so I wanted to give it a chance myself. And it turned out to be ok. The people working here are all very nice. And prices are totally fine as well. But the food I tried was a bit bland. I had a chicken vindaloo and asked for it to be spicy. And spicy it was. But besides that it was lacking depth. I was missing the sourness of the vinegar at completely. So it was a bit boring. The chicken comes on bones which I don’t like a lot in a curry. But that’s fine.

The place is also ok. Not super cosy. So I guess it’s fine for a quick lunch or dinner but not really more. If you have time you should try Indian restaurants in Silom or Sukhumvit instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is good, lots of options though when we came they were out of all South Indian items such as dosa which was unfortunate. They only give small amounts of pickle upon request. Otherwise it compares to the other Indian restaurants around though they do offer 5% off the bill for a google review!!! If you are Bangkok for a while I would steer you to go to “Tikka N talk” as well  for more of the Indian condiments like pickle, jaggery jelly and the mint cilantro sauce that should come with any dish. I understand not wanting it to be wasted but it should be offered or mentioned on the menu at least
sample_reviews_en.author: Devin Reaves

sample_reviews_en.text: WORST INDIAN EVER. So disgusting I actually told my husband Im scared to keep eating so we left. Ordered two curries both came with bone and barely any meat, so I showed them, they laughed took it back and gave us weird soggy meat back. Asked for my drink 3 times and they all stood talking and giggling when I asked where my drink was… instead of lemonade…. Squeezed lemon into a warm glass of water and handed it to me. No ice, no fizz , nothing like the picture. Honestly a health hazard.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natalie Costello

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stopped in for lunch and had really delicious food. We tried the lahori paneer and aloo paratha. Both were good. Only down side was the yogurt was not set yet, so the paratha was without dahi. The plus side is you know they make their dahi in house.

Lahori paneer gravy was new to us and the garlic naan went super well with it. Aloo paratha was classic homestyle dough with a side of achar and some chili sauce. Would recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anirudh Aggarwal

sample_reviews_en.text:
AUTHENTIC & CLASSIC INDIAN RESTAURANT AT HEART OF BANGKOK.

After 2 days of Thai Food, finally we Indians found this place and make it an best choice that we taken.

Really classic Indian taste and much cheaper while comparing local Thai Food.

If you miss Indian Food or want satisfactory food we will strongly recommend this place.

While finishing don't miss masala chai. That's the cherry on cake ! Must try
sample_reviews_en.author: Aakash Raj

sample_reviews_en.text: Wow wow wow 👌 Awsome beautiful gorgeous Indian restaurant 😍 in Kaosan Road ...The team here are all sooo warm,welcoming and amazing 👏 🤩 🙌 The food is super delicious 😋 fulfilled my craving for home cooked Indian food 😋 Thank you all soooo much for an amazing mouth watering satisfying experience 😋...Enjoyed every bite...God bless you all and May He open many doors to your success 🙌 🙏 ✅️
sample_reviews_en.author: Mollaine Anthony

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time trying Indian food, and I really enjoyed it. The butter chicken was delicious with a nice, balanced flavor and spices that weren’t too strong. The chicken was tender, and the cheese naan was soft, chewy, and very tasty. I’m still getting used to pani puri, but overall it was a great experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mint Nsr

restaurants.name: Original Pad Kra Pao 1993
restaurants.address:

231 Soi Charoen Rat 4, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
ผัดกระเพราเนื้อ is 90 baht but it's totally worth it. Very different from what you get at most shops. Ingredients are top quality and it has a very distinct flavour. They have standardised chilli levels so you can order the exact amount of spicy you want. The eggs are huge and delicious, you can order them sunny side up, crispy or over-easy.

They also serve tea which is excellent. No food colouring and you can order it without sugar.

If you like this dish, you should come here.
sample_reviews_th.author: Sam

sample_reviews_th.text: It was a pleasant surprise, I did see a lot of Farang and Chinese customers when I went in. But turned out to be very good. Tried level 2 and I think it’s perfect. For 99฿ with egg I think it’s reasonable for this quality.
sample_reviews_th.author: Tom H Praisan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here with my friend. When we ordered, the staff asked what spice level I wanted. I was confused because I hadn't seen the spice level options yet, so I just said, "Spicy." Then the staff pointed to the different spice levels. After that, I asked my friend what spice level they wanted, and they said "no spicy." Since we were sharing the food, I changed my order to the lowest spice level.

What really disappointed me was the staff's attitude. As soon as I changed my mind, the staff made a mocking expression. I don't fully understand Thai, but I understand a little. They said something to another staff member and were talking about my spice level. It’s like they mock “Why said spicy but chose the lowest level”. Even if I couldn't understand every word, I could understand their facial expressions and some words.

No wonder some reviews mention that the staff are rude. Now I understand why. Please improve your service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nochu

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came to Thailand on a whim without a plan and tried Pad Kra Pao for my first meal.

I heard Icon Siam is famous, so I decided to have lunch and visited a place nearby known for its "Pad" series. It seems like a great choice for my first attempt at Pad Kra Pao. However, if you order "Medium Spicy," it might be a bit spicier than expected for our taste buds, so a lower level might not be a bad option. Just keep in mind that I have a low tolerance for spicy food.

The food in Thailand is delicious. It's only my second day, but I've been wandering around and have eaten Pad Kra Pao four times already. The Pad series is really good. I think I'll try something else for dinner tonight.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ivan Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best Pad Kra Pao I have ever had in Bangkok!!
The taste is so much amazing providing authentic Thai flavors with combination of basil leaves, chili and Pad Kra Pao sauce.
There are a variety of choices such as pork, chicken, prawns, seafoods and so forth. You can also choose spicy level in the menu as your preference.
The price is really affordable for a person’s serving size.
The staff are friendly and service is very fast.
The location is just 3 minutes walk from BTS Wong Wai Yai.
I will come again and again very frequently whenever in Bangkok.
A must try and recommended place to visit and enjoy!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kyaw Min Lwin

sample_reviews_en.text: The place was often advertised as the best Pad krapao in BKK. The menu has around 30 variations of the dish, with different meats or even with basil fried rice. Our choice was for the classic ground beef. Unfortunately there were some very chewy and hard bits. Nevertheless the taste was very good, but actually comparable to a lot of street vendors or other restaurants. Maybe that's the peak of the flavor for this dish? You can choose your spice level from 0 to 5, I went for 5 and enjoyed it. The prices are okay- 80baht per portion and 40 for drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maciek Jankowski

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm Japanese.
I was wandering around looking for a hotel to stay at when I came across a reggae bar and decided to have a beer.
They said they didn't have any cold beer, so I reluctantly ordered gapao rice.
I was surprised, it was delicious!
It was the best gapao rice I've ever had.

Excuse me for the rudeness.

Food delivery was constantly coming to pick up orders.

It was spicy but had a nice sweetness to it. It was the best!
I'll definitely go again next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: tao jp

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing is not the word !!! Travelled from Khao sab Rd till this Outlet just to eat and was worth it...
Original taste..good quality..and Be carefully when u order the spicy level..ur sure to cry..
Ordered chicken pad krapao and Tom yum soup...both dishes were the best I had in a while !!!
Shop is small , in an alley...peak days u have to wait..luckily we didn't have to ...
But superb food ..10/10 recommended !
sample_reviews_en.author: Neelofer Shaikh

restaurants.name: Manee Thai Food
restaurants.address:

16 Tha Tian Aly, Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
As a frequent visitor to Bangkok over the last 2 decades I try to avoid tourist spots.  Nonetheless, I found myself “in the area” where the tourists flock to see Wat Arun by night and stumbled across this simple hole in wall Thai restaurant.

I should have turned around when I saw there was zero Thais inside - all tourists! 😝🤣

Still, got a seat and sat down.  Ordered a simple meal of “Khao Pad Kung” and a mango smoothie.

The fried rice tasted authentic enough but had too much julienned onions and carrots for my liking.. and huge wedges of tomato instead of finely chopped/diced tomatoes that most Thais prefer.  Guess these are mods to cater to their foreign clientele.  The prawns were properly seasoned and fresh.

Mango smoothie was OK if not great.

All in all a decent enough meal, if not something you’d write home about. 😊

The elderly lady managing the front of house was friendly and systematic.  A pleasant person.

(View of Wat Arun was from a lane running parallel).
sample_reviews_en.author: Whisky Dev

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem near Bangkok's temples
We stumbled upon this restaurant almost by chance during a Google search while exploring the temple areas in Bangkok. At first glance, it seems like a simple, unassuming spot, probably not a place I’d have entered without checking the reviews also because it’s hidden in an alley. However, it was bustling with locals, and there was only one table available, which immediately caught our attention.
The food was fantastic. Authentic Thai cuisine, expertly prepared, and packed with incredible flavors. The seasoning was spot on, making every dish a delight.
The staff were attentive and friendly, adding to the positive experience. If you’ve spent your morning visiting the temples, this is the perfect spot to recharge and enjoy a delicious meal. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gonçalo Moreira

sample_reviews_en.text: THERE IS NOT MANY PLACES LIKE THIS LEFT  IN BANGKOK! This place is family owned and the dishes  taste like the traditional Thailand we all invision visiting. I invite you to change the fancy touristic instagram places and travel in time  and experience this place as probably is going to be your first and maybe last time, because these family places get absorbed by the marketed influencer spots ..which usually does not go hand by hand with quality. Me, an influencer myself, I recommend practicing inmersive tourism and support the locals. Give it a try. My faves- papaya salad, shrimp pad thai, garlic pork.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mira

sample_reviews_en.text: Authentic Thai food with very reasonable price in a touristy area! Small restaurant but have enough space for 5-6 tables. The place looks nice and clean. No AC but it’s ok when the weather is not too hot. Pad thai was quite tasty (No need to add anything else). Som Tam Pla Ra was great ! can tell by its color. Stir fried noodles (Pad Kee Mao) and fried pork bun were ok. Will come and try more dishes next time. Also, they have a special discount for students from Chetawan Massage school 👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Inthebigmango

sample_reviews_en.text:
We found this small and lovely Thai restaurant near Wat Pho and absolutely loved it. The food was incredibly tasty and felt very authentic.
My wife had the Pad Thai and I had the Pad Krapow – both dishes were excellent, full of flavor, and freshly prepared. On top of that, the prices were very affordable for the quality you get.
A true hidden gem! We would definitely come back every time we are in the area. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jakob Bock

sample_reviews_en.text: Food is really really good. We were a little suprised, since this restaurant was the only one empty. But i looked at the previous reviews and we went anyway. The food needs time till it comes, but is worth the wait! Really amazing fried rice. My girlfriend had stir fried veggies which was very tasty as well. We definitely recommend this little restaurant. Even though it seems a little bit small and shady, the food is amazing!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Manuel Strupp

sample_reviews_en.text: We enjoyed the food very much! Cashew chicken (not pictured), basil pork (added a fried egg), and stir fried rice noodles with soy noodles and pork. Regardless, it was busy when we arrived and luckily we grabbed one of the last tables of the night. The lady seating was extremely kind and spoke some English, which was more than expected and helpful. Despite being in a touristy area this felt like a local's spot.
sample_reviews_en.author: T Fitti

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely amazing food! 🌶️🍜
Manee Thai Food offers a truly authentic Thai experience from start to finish. The dishes are with flavor, perfectly balanced, and made with fresh ingredients—you can really taste the care in every detail. Portions are generous, and the spice level is spot on.

Without a doubt, one of the best Thai restaurants around. I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend it! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: Joao Carlos Correia

restaurants.name: CQK Hotpot Huai Khwang
restaurants.address:

16 2 Thiam Ruam Mit Rd, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, and there's parking available. The restaurant is divided into different rooms with varying ambiances, allowing for a change of scenery regularly. 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: พิชญพร

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. The pork bone soup is excellent, the chicken feet are spicy, and the chrysanthemum leaves smell as fragrant as chrysanthemum tea.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thipthanya Piyadissakul

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was so good it felt like I was in Chongqing, but without the long journey. The ingredients were fresh and the soup was excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ta 'Van

sample_reviews_en.text: It was really delicious! The soup was tasty, the vegetables were fresh, the atmosphere was nice, and the staff were lovely. 💖💖
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirinda Manprasart

sample_reviews_en.text: I eat here very often. The food is delicious and the quality is good. There's parking available and no need to wait in line.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pisessud Hiranpradith

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! Great taste, excellent ingredients. Plenty of parking, clean restrooms, and the staff are attentive and lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mono Lawhavinit

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! The staff provides excellent service. I eat at this branch regularly. The ingredients are fresh and clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattamol Kongton

sample_reviews_en.text: No matter how many times I order, it's always delicious. I love CQK fruit tea; it's the best tea I've ever had.
sample_reviews_en.author: sirapassorn sirisanti

restaurants.name: Duklong Cafe and Eat
restaurants.address:

71/4-5 Soi Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand
