sample_reviews_en.text: We came across this place by chance and when we saw the location and the food on the plates we said we had to sit there. The atmosphere is great, the food is perfect and the owner is a legend, he told us interesting stories, gave us a few tips for further and a couple of complimentary desserts. I wish I could give 10 stars… The waiters and everyone else are great, I can't praise this place more
sample_reviews_en.author: dzodi hajroler

sample_reviews_en.text: Had an amazing brunch here, pancakes were surprisingly so good I ordered it twice. This cafe kept its old Bangkok feel and aesthetic. The perfect cafe on a lazy afternoon. Their lunch menu is no slouch as well. I ordered their Tomyum (sour spicy shrimp soup) paired with plain rice is on point! 👌 also their servers know how to speak english. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark

sample_reviews_en.text: My friend and I ate the pad see ew and an ice late and iced espresso which were all delicious. Best pad see ew I’ve had in Thailand. Service was amazing and location was beautiful, right on the river and easy to find. We also got given a free homemade coconut ice cream which was absolutely delicious. 10/10 thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jessica Micallef

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is amazing!! I had fried rice which was delicious and a super refreshing pineapple smoothie! Definitely visit if you’re in the area or in Bangkok! Amazing staff they’re so kind, friendly and attentive. Thank you for an amazing meal! Also sitting next to the river makes it very special ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Darcy Appleby

sample_reviews_en.text: We ate 3 of 4 dinners in Bangkok here, because the setting by the canal,  servers and food are all great. We shared a green curry at each meal, because it is so good and had something different with it each time and they were all great, in terms of taste, quantity and price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom Clark

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here twice. The first time I had the stir fried noodles with chicken, really good. Service is fast and nice. The second time I got the Bagel and met with the owner. Great guy!! Very friendly, def recommend for the food service and atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Genesis Fernandez

sample_reviews_en.text: We had a fantastic meal! We had it last night, and tonight too. Friendly staff, fast service. Beautiful spot by the water. The restaurant is close to our hotel, so we'll definitely eat there again! And thanks for the ice cream.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arlette Deben

sample_reviews_en.text: A very pleasant place with good coffee and a pleasant atmosphere. The service is polite and fast, and the food is fresh and delicious. Perfect for a leisurely breakfast or a meeting with friends. I will definitely be back 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrey Pelykh

restaurants.name: Roadhouse Barbecue
restaurants.address:

942/1-4 Rama IV Rd, Suriyawong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I went here during Songkran. The atmosphere of the place and the staff were really great. They charge 50 baht for small bottles of water(kind of shocking or is that normal for a pub?) My Philly Cheese Steak Sandwich was not what I expected. They should really rethink how they do it because it's not working. The fish and chips were also not what I expected because the piece of fish was so small( look at the picture), it tasted good though. With the beef brisket, the meat was good but the sauce was too sweet for me. I wish it said on the menu that they use a sweet sauce. The buffalo wings were very good but, I thought, salty but maybe some people might like that(make sure you get the blue cheese dip and celery)(FYI, I did finish them all anyways). The quesadillas were great and so were the beef nachos. My bill for three people was over three thousand baht and that was with only one glass of beer. Maybe, because my visit was during Songkran they didn't have their regular cook. I say that because I'm looking at the pictures from the other reviews and they look better or I just had some bad luck.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffy Jeff Jeff

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you want American-style BBQ, this place hits the spot.

We got the BBQ Platter for Two, and yes, it was a lot of food. We had to take home some leftovers, which were still good the next day.

The star of the show was the cornbread. They have such good cornbread! A bit sweet and crumbly with a nice butter-corn flavor.

The pulled pork was also really good - nice and juicy.

Other hits were the ribs and Carolina style coleslaw. The Caesar salad was also good. Everything else was good, but fairly standard.

For the wings we chose the spiciest option - Suicide flavor. They were legit spicy, almost as hot as a decent som dtam.

Atmosphere was good. The whole vibe of the place is Wild West Saloon, which works well.

The service was fine, but we normally go  there for lunch when it's not busy. I can't speak to how service is during busy times.

Overall it's good comfort food that I revisit every few months.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sa La

sample_reviews_en.text:
Whoever thought this place should deserve anything, but a one star has never had good ribs or a good burger. It is absolutely pathetic that anybody who eats this food would give it anything other than one star

I actually feel sorry for you that you’ve never tasted really good ribs and a really good burger...this burger taste like it came out of a freezer and a market that should’ve expired years ago. It taste worse than McDonald’s burger. I cannot eat it. It taste so bad $15 for....

The ribs are so bad. I don’t even know how to describe it. There’s no meat on them. There’s no good barbecue sauce. It is absolutely just pathetic. The only redeeming thing is the fries are somewhat decent.

If you want a really good burger and really good ribs stay away from this place. They have no clue what it is.

Oh my goodness... Suck... Wasted money

🤮🤢
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason Denison

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food was mostly bland, service/location/atmosphere are great. We would not return for food.

Food: Cornbread is nice and buttery. Mashed potatoes lack flavor. Creamed spinach was watery and so so in flavor. We wouldn’t order again. We ordered the buffalo wings medium with traditional Original Franks sauce and they were good. The brisket was tender and barbecue sauce was okay, a bit sweet. The filet mignon was cooked to medium perfectly but lacked flavor. The Mexican pizza was okay. We also had the garden salad with thousand dressing which was good and the Ceasar salad (comes with bacon bits) but we preferred the house salad. The Ceasar dressing did not taste the best.

Service: excellent from start to finish. The staff are kind and professional.

Atmosphere: Very casual, comfortable environment with seating for big groups.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brittany M

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went with some friends last night after the Loy Krathong festival in Lumpini Park and ended up here to have a few beers and some good ole American 🇺🇸 bbq 🍖!!

Ordered the full rack ribs and onions and they were HUMUNGOUS - the portions were like eating in the oversized state of Texas!!!

The food was good and the service quite slow!!!
My one friend has the Philly cheesesteak sandwich and the other one had wings!! Reminded me of Flintstones 😂!!

Overall it’s a good place to come and revisit the North American taste 👅 buddy!!

How to find us: Make sure you follow us, Follow Fauzia around Bangkok and beyond. 💋💋 on our website too!
You can find Follow Fauzia on IG, FB and of course our YT channel has over 700 videos all vlogs on food reviews plus YT shorts are plenty. 💚💚🩷💚💚💚🩷🩷🩷🩷🩷💚💚💚
sample_reviews_en.author: Follow Fauzia

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great, yummy tacos at really cheap price. I had beef tacos on Tuesday at 150 THB for dinner. :)
The place looks small on outside which I would normally walk past but never drop by. Somehow the inside is HUGE, with high ceiling and good ventilation. Plenty of menus to choose from.
Attentive and friendly staffs. Clean table.
I have been to too many western pubs in Thailand with oily, dirty tables. This place is neat and surprisingly clean.

Highly would recommend for tourists and passer-bys.

The only downside which I rate 4-star on atmosphere is that there is absolutely no parking lot. A common theme for this area, also, if you sit outside it’s really polluted. Make sure you have indoor seats.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tamruja D.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great american barbecue place to hang out with your friends and loved ones.

The place is 4 mins walk away from  MRT Samyan Station (Exit No. 1). The restautrant opens from 11am til 10pm daily.

The three storey building will takes you back to Texas, with its nice decor and vibrancy. The background music, the pool table, the cowboy hats decor are all amazing and nicely decorated.

Food is also awesome here. They have many wide selections of alcohols and food (and also savoury sweets). The menu is both in english and thai language.

They have special menu on each day too, right from mon-sun. Be sure to check it out.

Attentive servers and reasonable price. They accept both cash and cards.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donny Boonyamanop

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff is very polite and professional. I ordered the Friday special. Full rack of Ribs, 6 wings, choice of potato, coleslaw and cornbread. Was under 700B. Being that this isn't the USA, they don't have st Louis style ribs.  Felt more like pork loin ribs. Which leads to lots of small bones in the meat due to the location near the spine. Tasted like smoked ribs. Only wished they had more sauces. They have a thai-chili pepper sauce there, mix that with their standard bbq sauce and you get an amazing spicy bbq sauce. Use 3 to 1 ratio. The wings I got were amazing.  Didn't try the brisket. The decor is tacky, lots of late 1800's themed western stuff. Didn't care for it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tobbs v

restaurants.name: ร้านเออแซ่บ แจ่วฮ้อน สุขุมวิท
restaurants.address:

27, 1 On Nut 21 Alley, Khwaeng Suan Luang, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Jaew Hon (spicy dipping sauce) here is excellent. They offer different levels of spiciness for the broth; for those who don't like it too spicy, I recommend ordering the medium level. The restaurant offers two types of dipping sauces: a very spicy Jaew Hon sauce and a milder version for children, as well as a medium-spicy Sukiyaki sauce. The menu is quite diverse.

I first tried Jaew Hon in Khon Kaen, and while I've searched for similar places in Bangkok, this restaurant's is comparable. Importantly, offering spiciness options makes it enjoyable for those who don't like spicy food.

The prices are moderate and reasonable considering the quality and quantity. The restaurant doesn't play annoying music, the staff are attentive and provide good recommendations. Parking is available in front of the restaurant for free.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaweekai Chok

sample_reviews_en.text:
The soup wasn't spicy at all but it was thick.
The dipping sauce was sweet. Everything was overly sweet.
As someone who doesn't like sweet food, we didn't like it.
The spicy salad dressing was too sweet and not spicy enough.
The meat was okay, the ingredients were okay.
The grilled items were expensive and not very hot when served.
The prices are a bit high.
The staff provided excellent service.
There was plenty of parking in front of the restaurant (only for cars, I saw).

Overall, it was just average. I'll probably only go once.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fuji Chongcharoen

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was good and served quickly. The staff and owner were incredibly attentive. The portions of meat, vegetables, and other ingredients were very generous. The papaya salad wasn't small; it was a huge, full-sized serving. The dipping sauces were delicious, both the peanut and the spicy chili sauce. What impressed me most was the glasses. Restaurants usually don't invest in insulated glasses, but these were spotless and kept drinks cold for a long time without needing refills. Excellent! 10/10/10
sample_reviews_en.author: Blacx mirror

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten at the Sutthisan branch before, but it didn't have air conditioning. This time, I drove all the way to On Nut because it was comfortably air-conditioned.
The papaya salad needs a lot of improvement. It was the worst. They should just make regular papaya salad. Also, I ordered medium spicy, but it seemed like it was very spicy.
Papaya salad should be made with shredded papaya that's pounded until soft, not cut into chunks like French fries, just mixed in. It's too hard.
sample_reviews_en.author: veeraphon sahastharachai

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered through Grab using the "Thai Help Thai" program, but the restaurant canceled the order without any explanation. I usually order from them regularly and pay normally. If they weren't going to accept orders through "Thai Help Thai" in the first place, they shouldn't have participated in the program. It's a waste of time and frustrating. The food is delicious, but I'm done with them. I will definitely not be ordering from them again.
sample_reviews_en.author: jaejaewife

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually order dry sukiyaki through Grab, but today I tried eating at the restaurant. The service was good, and the atmosphere was okay. The hot pot meat was delicious; the soup was good, the meat was good, the vegetables were good. I barely touched the dipping sauce – it was perfect even without it! 🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: Coldy SPW

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything was amazing: the soup, the dipping sauce, the meat – everything was delicious and spicy. They make their own ice and keep the cups cold; they pay attention to every detail.
The fried pork was good, and the Thai papaya salad was also good.
Parking is available within the complex.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thunya K.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and incredibly spicy! The staff provides excellent service. If you love spicy Jaew Hon (Thai hot pot) but don't want to feel the heat, this is the place to go :) They also have a promotion on sparkling chrysanthemum tea 🍻🍺 and a new toast dessert menu item!
sample_reviews_en.author: Palasornthongchai Chairueangwan

restaurants.name: The Reise
restaurants.address:

333 Pracha Chuen Rd, Tambon Bang Khen, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is nice, but there was something strange about the place. We didn't intend to have a meal; my husband just wanted afternoon coffee. The prices were typical for a place decorated for scenic photos. However, the service inside was odd. It felt like the manager or owner (I'm not sure which) was following us whenever we entered or left. We ordered food and wanted to go outside to take pictures. Even after we ordered, when we were about to leave to wait for Bolt to take us back to the condo, they seemed to follow us outside, arranging flowers and plants, something they didn't do inside. They were following us, but it wasn't out of lust or anything, more like they were worried we might steal something. We don't look like we have much money, but we paid; we weren't asking for free food, and neither was my husband. It felt like judging people based on their appearance was unfair. We checked reviews before coming to this place, and we know what you're selling, but judging customers based on their attire like that is really bad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patcha Chotichaikul

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant recently just have their soft opening, so we walk across the street from my place to this restaurant. Have to say, this really has some of the best set up for the northern part of Bangkok hands-down. With multiple outdoor seating in the garden, fire place, restaurant has the cozy Southern Italian vibe going on, which is fantastic for family and friends gathering. We ordered one 12 ince pizza with Italian sausage and four cheese topping. The produce of the topping is fresh and good quality. However, the chef need to work on his product tastes. Since the pizza overall was a bit bland (and this is coming from someone whom eat relatively bland food). I hope the restaurant will work on their food more since there's so much potential for this restaurant. A return is a must for my family and I hope I could give them a tasty review for their food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Katethip Varanyuwatana

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is located on suburb :Nonthaburi district.   Easy to find as there is  big signage in front  of the soi .    Feeling like visiting cozy southern Italian house … good for families as there are garden .  Multiple outdoor seating in the garden is nice for for the evening.   Italian menu . We ordered grill salmon and lamps which were  delicious.  Could not order pizza  as it needed to wait for 45 mins . Thank you waitress let us know first.  In side restaurant is nice simple decoration  with high ceiling.  There are also private rooms available.     The food price is a bit high; however comparing to the nice service, quality of food and nice decoration, it is alright.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanokenath Suthasiri

sample_reviews_en.text:
Upon arrival, I was stunned. It was as if I left Bangkok and I just got to Tuscany. Basically out of the world.

The food itself, was served super fast (other than the Roasted Chicken we were going to order, they said it’ll take 30 mins). We had a Smoked Salmon Pizza, it was great. We also ordered fries and calamari.

Overall, I’d really recommend this place.

One tiny side note, somehow there are ants climbing over the table, not much, isn’t a big problem, just kind of distracting (we are sitting by the window maybe that’s why). Also, there’s a sign that says no pets.
sample_reviews_en.author: James Lai

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. The Reise Salad - the balsamic vinegar used on this dish could be much better.
2. Vongole - no taste of white wine, and no taste of clams. Printed menu says "Italian clams, Italian basil"... we know that's not true. It's perfectly ok to use fresh locally produced ingredients. Printed menu also says lemon is used (not sure why) on this dish, but there's no hint of any lemon at all.
3.  Margherita pizza ... is mediocre.

Nice courtyard for al fresco dinning, spacious comfy hall for indoor dinning. Quality of food has a lot of room for improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Keith Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really loved the vibe here — felt like a sunny day somewhere in Italy. Super cozy and nicely decorated, perfect for a chill lunch or early dinner.

We had the pizza, bolognese pasta, and duck confit — everything was delicious, but the duck was a real standout. So tender and flavorful. Ended the meal with their lemon sorbet, which was super refreshing and light — perfect for the heat!

Service was friendly and the whole place just has a relaxed, feel-good energy. Definitely coming back. 🌿🍋
sample_reviews_en.author: Fire x Journey

sample_reviews_en.text:
We received very good service. Every staffs were so welcomed.
For the food, it depended on each persons preferences. For me, I love the vongole pasta. The taste was nice while the pesto one was a bit sweet than it should be for me. The pizza was good if u eat them immediately. The most strange thing for me was, I ordered steak but the restaurant didn’t have the steak knife!!! This is a bit ridiculous.

The overall atmosphere was nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: S K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Found this lovely little Italian restaurant not far from home. It has a cozy, homey feel, and the food was good. We ordered the Reise Salad, Truffle Pasta, and Kurobura Porkchop.

The prices are a little on the higher side, but overall, the food was tasty and we had a nice experience. I didn’t get a chance to take photos of the restaurant, but it’s definitely worth trying if you’re in the area!
sample_reviews_en.author: Fa Huijuan

restaurants.name: June Pang
restaurants.address:

1529 1531 Banthat Thong Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: ร้านจูนปัง (June Pang) —* 🍞🤤It is a famous bakery and fresh milk shop in the Golden Line area. The outstanding menu is Toast Shogu Pang, which is baked with fragrant butter, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. Served with ice …
sample_reviews_th.author: Api K.

sample_reviews_th.text: service can be slow but it’s a popular and busy place so .. understandable. unassuming interior but food is delicious and cute, even converted non sweet loving parents. ice cream is perfect. couldn’t get enough สังขยาใบเตย
sample_reviews_th.author: m

sample_reviews_en.text:
If I have the chance to be in this area, after finishing my meal, I always end up at Pang Jun. Sometimes there's a queue, sometimes I can get in right away, depending on the time and the number of people. The shop has two floors of air-conditioned seating.

The highlight is that the shop makes its own bread; it's thick, soft, and fragrant. Their custard is also excellent. They constantly introduce new menu items to try, but my go-to order is the toast topped with custard and ice cream – crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, and with fragrant custard. Their steamed bread is also incredibly soft and melts in your mouth, and it pairs perfectly with the custard.

They have a wide selection of drinks, both milk-based and non-milk-based. If you're just coming for dessert, they also offer free drinking water.

Parking is available in a nearby parking lot for a fee, and it's a short walk to the shop. Overall, it's a dessert shop I'd revisit, especially if you love soft bread and delicious custard.
sample_reviews_en.author: SuperAuis Nantawan N.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This shop makes excellent desserts ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I tried the Thick Toast with Vanilla Ice Cream. The bread was crispy on the outside and buttery, while still soft on the inside. It paired perfectly with the vanilla ice cream; the warmth of the toast combined with the coolness of the ice cream prevented it from being overly sweet.

I also had the Strawberry Smoothie with Cheese Foam. The strawberry smoothie was refreshing, sweet and tangy, topped with a rich and creamy cheese foam that added a hint of saltiness. The overall balance was excellent. The crumble topping added texture, making this drink even more enjoyable.

Overall, both the drinks and desserts are thoughtfully made, visually appealing, and delicious. It's a great place to relax or enjoy a sweet treat in the afternoon. 👍🍓🍞🍨
sample_reviews_en.author: Donpat Rochanirom

sample_reviews_en.text: I was surprised that it didn’t take long time to get table, only 10 minutes so I recommended to come here to get ticket before 18.45 hrs. While you’re waiting, you can watch how they made the bread which made me enjoyable to see every bread they cooked with standardized of caramel butter to caramelize. Also I like the free drinking water especially the pendant water that smell good. Price for the signature one is 139.- which variety of toppings and choices. Hokkaido Ice cream on top feel like a homemade one and not sweet. Overall it’s good to try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miki T.

sample_reviews_en.text: The toast is as delicious as ever! I always order it whenever I come. The caramel, bread, and ice cream go together perfectly – a favorite of mine. Today I had the chance to try the fried sandwich, but personally, it wasn't really my style; it was a bit too rich, but it depends on personal preference. The Dubai chocolate uses delicious ingredients. Regardless, it's still Junpang's go-to place for their toast whenever I'm in the Banthat Thong area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichayapak Sereesawad

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a really delicious custard bun shop! The custard is fragrant with pandan leaves, and the toast is also tasty. Personally, I prefer the steamed buns with custard, but I like the pandan custard over the Thai tea custard. The drinks are average in taste. The first time I came, I had to wait in line for an hour. Later, I reserved a table beforehand to avoid waiting as long. The prices are student-friendly, so it's affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khongkhwan 45

sample_reviews_en.text: My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed the desserts at June Pang. The iconic toasted bread topped with ice cream and nuts, paired with a glass of iced fresh milk, is undoubtedly one of the best desserts in Bangkok. It’s best to visit during the day, as the lines can get long in the evening. After a satisfying meal, this spot should definitely be your next stop for dessert. Plus, it’s very affordable. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Harvey C

restaurants.name: Chef Man (Eastin Grand Hotel Sathorn)
restaurants.address:

33 1 S Sathon Rd, Yan Nawa, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Brought the family to dine here. We upgraded to a table for 12 people. It was a bit crowded, but cozy. (The set meal was also upgraded to accommodate 12 people, increasing the price from 15,000 to 18,000 baht.)
- I liked many things, including the snow fish, the Peking duck that was carved right at the table, the abalone which was excellent, the fried rice, etc.
- Personally, I liked it. Compared to Shangri-La Thariya, it's in a similar price range, but Chef Man seems better.

Amex Platinum members can claim cashback through the card. Reservations are highly recommended, especially during holidays. I dined here on New Year's Eve (31/12/2024) and used Eastin members, but didn't get a discount.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kim Dr.Choakchai Eaimrittikrai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chef Man Restaurant focuses on Chinese and fusion cuisine, offering beautifully presented dishes with an enjoyable taste experience. Reservations are highly recommended.
Recommendations include the crispy pork, black glutinous rice spring rolls (pretty visually appealing), and the delicious snow buns with tender, slightly sweet pork filling. It's best to call and reserve a table before visiting.
Personally, it's very suitable for families and gatherings, especially during holidays when it gets very busy.
sample_reviews_en.author: are down

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's expensive, but the quality justifies the price.

Top-notch cuisine, featuring Chinese, Szechuan, and Hong Kong dishes. Attentive and welcoming staff. The clientele is predominantly Chinese, which in itself guarantees authenticity.

There are two set menus – lunch and dinner. Note: if you want the Peking duck, you must reserve the day before. In any case, reservations are essential as it's packed in the evenings!

I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone seeking authentic, traditional Chinese cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arth K.

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, my aunt invited me to try dim sum at this restaurant, which is quite famous. They have a great selection of dishes, including seafood rice noodle rolls, tofu spring rolls, fried tofu, XO sauce radish cake, shrimp har gow, fried bean curd, shrimp siu mai, lava buns, and more. Prices are around 100 baht and up per dish. Parking at the hotel is limited, so you might have to circle around to find a spot. Taking the BTS would be more convenient. Anyway, let's enjoy a delicious meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: Art C

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had lunch on Mother's Day.
The food was average in taste; some dishes were good, but the Peking duck was unimpressive. The meat wasn't crispy or fragrant at all. The only good thing was the pancakes wrapped around the duck. The duck meat could also be used to make a strange-tasting miang (Thai wrap), more like dried fish and watermelon. The best dish that day was the coconut ice cream. Overall, I think the restaurant is very different from what I've experienced over the years.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bump Woratans

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. I highly recommend the crispy Peking duck; you have to order it in advance because it takes 4 hours to roast. The chef even serves it to you. Almost everything is delicious. The soup is rich and flavorful, and the egg custard is tasty. The restrooms are very clean and beautiful. There are many foreigners. The hotel parking lot is quite small; you can get a parking ticket for 4 hours. The restaurant is closed in the afternoon and opens at 6 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rasamee T.

sample_reviews_en.text: The dim sum was delicious and of good quality, but the other dishes were not good. The fried tofu smelled bad, and some of the fried items were undercooked. But what I disliked the most was the staff. They were frowning, speaking in a harsh, emphatic tone, especially the female staff. If there were a service rating of 0 stars, I would give it 0 stars. The chef/owner should train their reception and serving staff to treat customers more politely.
sample_reviews_en.author: bsb

sample_reviews_en.text: The famous Chef man at Eastin Hotel and I can tell you that the flavor and the quality of is awesome I like everything. The chef stick to the authentic style. It’s a bit boring compared to those fusion Chinese elsewhere but hey I like it. I think it’s honest and not pretentious. The flavor and the execution is spot on. Overall it was a great meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Woody Sim

restaurants.name: Aunglo by Yangrak
restaurants.address:

174/4-6 Decho Rd, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
quality modern thai food without breaking the bank - definitely put this on your itinerary!

i think they are better known for their open flame grill and thai street food - jap izakaya fushion skewers? i definitely preferred the chicken skewers (esp the boneless chicken wing with yuzu kosho) over their signature moo peng actually.

don't skip the other dishes too.

the shrimp on coconut pancake appetiser was TO DIE FOR. mochi-textured dense pancake with strong gula melaka and kaya fragrance. odd combination with shrimp but it worked so well!

the kailan cooked with prawn paste (har cheong sauce) was super yummy too! why has no one thought of using prawn paste instead of oyster sauce to dress vegetables all this time?

the pork ribs was on almost every table, so we got one to try too. it was fork tender and really yummy but leans on the salty side, so pair it with the pickled lettuce to cut thru the salt.

pomelo and shrimp salad was alright, but the least impressive of the dishes we tried.

P.S. i counted  6 aircon units for a relatlively small dining space. be warned it was very cold and draughty which marred my experience ever so slightly
sample_reviews_en.author: Nic

sample_reviews_en.text: Interesting and unique Thai izakaya small plates concept. We went for lunch and ordered a good variety of dishes. Pork belly and chicken thigh skewers with Pattani salt were standard izakaya fare (nothing special), moo ping on rice with a raw egg was a nice fusion play on the Japanese don (7/10), coconut pancake with shrimp and curry sauce was innovative and had a classy presentation (7/10), grilled chicken with cashew sauce (5/10 average), grilled boneless wings with sichuan spices (4/10 dry), Thai barbecue pork ribs served with a vinaigrette dressed salad (5/10 not impressive), charred clams with fermented soy bean (10/10 delicious and stood out), spicy squid toast (8/10 beautifully executed and tasty), Chinese kale (5/10 average nothing special), aor-suan crab (7/10 interesting hors d'oeuvre style thin pastry shell stuffed with Thai veges and crab), banana snack with chumphon chocolate for dessert (6/10 interesting textures, but felt it was a little too dry and sticky). We tried some of their interesting drafts and sodas. Overall unique, pricey and some dishes would benefit from a twist of flavours to make them stand out more.
sample_reviews_en.author: M4l2K T4N

sample_reviews_en.text:
Aunglo by Yangrak is a very solid dining experience in Bangkok, focused on Thai grilled cuisine with a modern twist. The flavors are bold, well-balanced, and clearly intentional — you can taste the skill behind the seasoning and cooking techniques. Dishes are served hot, aromatic, and full of character, which really sets this place apart.

The quality of ingredients is clearly noticeable, especially in the grilled dishes, and the menu feels cohesive and well thought out rather than random. Portions are satisfying, and the overall concept is consistent and refined.

A big plus is the individual QR codes at each table, which make ordering fast, intuitive, and very convenient without having to wait for staff.

The service is friendly, professional, and efficient without being intrusive, and the atmosphere is relaxed yet polished — ideal for enjoying the food at a comfortable pace.

Not every dish was exceptional, which is why I’m giving 4 stars instead of 5, but overall this is a place I would happily return to and confidently recommend to anyone looking for well-executed Thai grill cuisine with depth and authenticity.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michał Pszczoła

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop name is so small on the shopfront, it is hard to notice. But it is the only decor shopfront along that stretch so it is hard to miss. I did not like the first floor and the landing towards the upper floor because it smelt so strong of the drainage smell, it dampen my mood and appetite even before I reach the restaurant floor.

Luckily the smell disappeared as soon as we reached the dining floor. The open kitchen helps me to forget the unpleasant smell. Good exhaust because the dining area did not smell heavy on grilling smell even though the kitchen was busy with a lot of grilling. You can see a lot of recommendation in the reviews. Generally all the food we serve are fantastic.

The portions are really small but we like it because we dont eat a lot and we love variety. Just nice for us. If you are going in for a hearty meal, you are in the wrong place. This place serves high quality delicious meals. Pricing is on a high side but ok to eat to try out a place. Hurt your pocket if you go too often.

Staff service is excellent. Order via qr code.

The toilet should deserve more attention.  Dirty.
sample_reviews_en.author: EveC

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located along Silom Road, this charming restaurant stands out with its stylish décor and cozy atmosphere. There aren’t many tables, so I highly recommend making a reservation in advance. Around 7 p.m., the place gets very busy, and many walk-in customers end up waiting in line.

The grilled dishes are the highlight here — the smoky aroma from the charcoal, the freshness of the ingredients, and the chef’s seasoning make every dish rich and perfectly balanced. The restaurant beautifully elevates traditional Thai cuisine with creative twists, offering several innovative dishes that are both familiar and exciting. I especially recommend trying their signature items every plate is truly delicious.

Service-wise, the staff seemed a bit overwhelmed, probably because there were too many guests and not enough staff, but overall, they were attentive.

For parking, you can park at the Pullman G Hotel and have your ticket validated at the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornkana Suthiphongkanasai

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came to try out Aunglo after watching some influencers videos, but were unfortunately quite disappointed with the experience, especially since it was marketed as michelin.

The flavours seem to cater more to the western diners or izakaya style, if you compare to the average sweet, sour and spicy flavours of general Thai cuisine. We were surprised with the vegetable and meat dishes, which had really strong smokey flavours, but wished there were stronger thai flavours that went with it. It felt more burnt than wok-hei.

Some dishes had duplicated components, like the barbequed meat with the cabbages, and the staff was kind enough to let us know that in advance. However, it took us a while to understand until the dish never came, and we realized that they were waiting for us to make a decision.

The food was good, but it did not wow us, probably because we have a heavier palate. It might work better for western or japanese diners.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jonathan Ong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Trendy Thai innovative street food and a well ventilated, lighted and casual atmosphere.

Dress Code: Causal (men - shorts) but maybe not slippers for a cool place.

Location: upon entering level 1, there is a staff to assist and the dining is on the second floor. There are both stairs and lift.

Portion:  BIG. The menu picture is deceiving.

- I suggest skewers be shared as 1 skewer comes with 2 huge chicken meats. Good to share 1 skewer for 2 pax.
- Rice is huge. If 2 pax, 1 rice dish is enough.
- The ribs is huge. Easily good for 3-4 pax.

Taste: it’s like 50% of food is spicy. Great spice but too hot for me. End up didn’t try the Tom Yang Fried Rice as the spice level is high.

Overall it’s good but maybe better if the server can suggest the portion to order as first timer may not know the portion size.

Drinks: beer on tap. Go for the IPA. The rest are interesting.

Overall, I over ordered and my bill is $2800 for 2pax.
sample_reviews_en.author: Isaac Ho

sample_reviews_en.text:
Simply extraordinary, every dish I tried fully deserved the star.

I had:
•	Grilled Brioche with Curry Hummus
•	Chicken with Pattani Salt
•	Grilled Chicken with Panang Rice Bowl
•	Khanom Krok Brûlé

The food was astonishing, visually stunning, full of flavour, and perfectly balanced. Some dishes are deceptively simple but reveal surprising complexity in taste and texture.

The owner is surprisingly young and incredibly kind, and the service is equally warm and attentive. The kitchen feels like a clean, well-run family, which really shows in the quality of the food.

On top of that, the price is very reasonable, I paid 494 baht for everything (including a Coke), which is exceptionally fair for the quality.

Aunglo is a rare spot where taste, care, and presentation all come together beautifully, truly memorable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hakan

restaurants.name: Stock.Room
restaurants.address:

Kimpton Maa-Lai Bangkok, Soi Ton Son, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The breakfast selection and atmosphere were great, but above all, I had a truly pleasant morning thanks to the excellent service provided by staff member Shera. Shera’s warm and kind demeanor was very impressive; I was deeply moved by the meticulous attention and sophisticated service she provided despite my special personal requests. I definitely want to enjoy the breakfast at this hotel again next time. Thank you, Shera!
sample_reviews_en.author: 이선아

sample_reviews_en.text: Tin, Jaojane, Jah, and Kevin, the staff members who served me during that time, provided excellent service. They were very attentive to customers. The food was good, but not particularly surprising. The water dispenser required a long press on the screen to dispense water, and there were no signs explaining how to use it. Overall, it was a good experience. 😄💖
sample_reviews_en.author: มณฑิญา แทบทาม

sample_reviews_en.text: Went there mid-week for their land and sea buffet with the family.  Great quality of the layout.  Perhaps not the most diverse in Bangkok but fully adequate.  We enjoyed the meal very much and the staff were extremely courteous and efficient.  We will definitely return for more dinners at this restaurant in the days ahead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naushad Hussain

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent buffet, the meat is exceptional. The same goes for the seafood and sushi/sashimi. Everything is fresh, beautifully presented, and you also have table service in addition to the buffet. Their ordering system is very efficient, and the restaurant is located in a very nice hotel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mattéo E

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of the impressive seafood and meat buffet restaurants in Bangkok. It offers a wide variety of dishes, including freshly prepared items that you can choose from a menu. The staff are hardworking, friendly, and provide excellent service. The view and decor are superb.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panisara Satravut

sample_reviews_en.text: Dined at this buffet restaurant, and it truly delivered a premium dining experience. The selection was extensive, featuring high-quality seafood, expertly prepared sushi, premium meats, and an impressive variety of dishes. Every item was fresh and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: wai yan oo

sample_reviews_en.text: I came for dinner tonight. Compared to other places, the food options might be fewer, but everything was delicious. The steaks were perfectly grilled, and the staff were all excellent. Thank you, Khun Tin, for the high-quality service at our table.
sample_reviews_en.author: ponggkun

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the reasons that I come back to Kimpton MAA-LAI. The food, deco and vibe are fabulous. You won’t want to miss it even had a crazy night. Special thanks to Ko, Pan and Depa, your thoughtful service bright my every morning during the stay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amy Chen

restaurants.name: แชโบล Korean BBQ Buffet
restaurants.address:

63 Nakhon In Rd, Tambon Talat Kwan, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The portions were small, the fried items were battered and not hot, and the food didn't taste that good. The kimchi soup was watery and bland, and the cheesy corn was a huge portion – one dish is enough to fill you up. Compared to the price of 399฿, I wouldn't recommend it. There are many better-priced restaurants in the mall. The only things that were really good were the ice cream and the steamed egg custard.
sample_reviews_th.author: ศุภลักษณ์ ลาภเจริญ

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a Korean-style buffet restaurant. This was our first time here. The BBQ is self-service; the staff grills the meat for you and serves it to your table. Other non-grilled items can be self-served.

The price is around 3xx baht per person, which is great value. There's no time limit, and you get to enjoy fresh, crispy vegetables and kimchi with the grilled pork. The pork was perfectly grilled – not too dry and not burnt. The cuts of pork were lean, making it very enjoyable to eat. The seaweed-wrapped marinated shrimp was especially good. I was very impressed.

The restaurant is very generous with the cheese on the dishes.

The atmosphere inside is authentically Korean, from the tables and chairs to the TV showing Korean artists while you eat. Anyone who likes Korean culture will love this place. There's even a corner with chairs where you can take photos with standees of Korean artists. It's amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: ANNE KUMIKO

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a self-service BBQ buffet where you don't have to grill the food yourself; the restaurant does the grilling. There's a wide selection of side dishes, and two ice cream freezers: one for scooping (perfect for those with strong arms!) and one for ice cream bars. The overall atmosphere is nice, perfect for taking cute and trendy photos. It's a small community with this restaurant, a rice porridge shop, and a dessert shop all in the same area.
Inside the restaurant, there are BTS (Bangkok Skytrain) standees... wait!
You can take photos with the seven members of BTS. They play their music and other Korean groups' music. If you don't like restaurants with loud music or Korean music, you might not enjoy it as much.
Finally, the staff provides good service, constantly asking if you need anything extra.
There are 5-6 clean restrooms located outside the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: My Mail

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is super cute and has a really Korean style. You don't have to grill it yourself; one serving is huge! Be careful when ordering, you'll regret not being able to finish it all. They have marinated shrimp and marinated jellyfish, which are amazing. There's also chewy tteokbokki and unlimited vegetables. The grilled meat is perfectly cooked and delicious. For dessert, there's unlimited ice cream – a must-try for those with a sweet tooth! The corn cheese is also incredibly delicious. Highly recommend this place for K-pop fans; it's super fun and totally worth it! 🥳🥳
sample_reviews_en.author: jarupon thutakit

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff were very friendly and provided excellent service. The food was delicious, the service was great, and they even grilled the food for us. It was a very relaxed atmosphere, and they had ice cream and drinks, including a delicious guava with plum syrup.
The air conditioning was a bit too cold, so I recommend bringing a long-sleeved shirt so you can sit for a long time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Banjerd Noumpan

sample_reviews_en.text: This Korean BBQ restaurant has great food. The cheesy steamed egg is delicious, and the cheesy corn is the best I've ever had. They have a variety of tasty appetizers. It's a shame they open a bit late in the evening. The atmosphere is nice, they play Korean music constantly, and there's ample parking. The staff are polite and provide good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakkarddd

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, with grilling service available. The food came out quickly, and there was a wide variety to choose from. The atmosphere was great. The marinated shrimp was amazing, the steamed egg custard was excellent, and the kimchi was tasty and not too sour. It's perfect for hanging out with friends, and there's plenty of parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nannapat Patjan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. There's no time limit, and it's all-inclusive for 399 baht, no extra charges. They have marinated shrimp, a variety of ice cream, and you don't have to grill it yourself – the restaurant does it for you. Great value for the price. The staff are friendly and provide good service; the younger staff members are lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: CCYC Y

restaurants.name: Zawgyi Bar & Bistro (Bangkok)
restaurants.address:

44/1 44/2 Soi Phetchaburi 17, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a gem for anyone looking to experience authentic Burmese flavors in Bangkok.

I stopped in for the Burmese milk tea (my fave) the morning before my flight. I had a small mixup, but the owner was incredibly kind and accommodating. He runs the place with a level of warmth and generosity that really defines the experience here.

I also noticed Burmese being spoken in the restaurant, which really added to the sense that this is an authentic and well-loved local spot. I didn’t get to stay for the evening live music, but the setup looked lively and fun - definitely something I’d come back for next time I’m in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Regina Lin

sample_reviews_en.text:
I could say that their mohinga is definitely delicious more than other Myanmar restaurants.  Have live band and can enjoy the music. Food was ok.

The service is ok but I feel not welcoming much.  For Myanmar, we like to drink hot tea after we drink Myanmar tea. They have free hot tea cup but you have to ask many times for refill. The staffs will not see you and not take care you at all. I asked them if they have tea pot or not. We will pay for that cause we don’t want to request many times. But just got ‘No’ .

Anyways it was a great time here. The shop will be perfect if they can improve some points .
sample_reviews_en.author: Aye Aye Thu

sample_reviews_en.text: The highlight was the food. Comparing with price, quality and even quantity with other Myanmar restaurant I have been to, it certainly stays at the top. The portions were huge also, wasn't really expecting that size at a socalled 'bar'. Service was great. Place is a bit small and interior feels like a bit cramped though. But for a chill night with great food, "recommended".
sample_reviews_en.author: Cruise

sample_reviews_en.text: This bar has a great atmosphere to it, it's a cozy little spot. Every night I was there they had live music which was fantastic. I only had one of their appetizers, the egg omelette but from the little I did have the bar food is top notch. I would highly suggest stopping by for a drink.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bryson

sample_reviews_en.text: If you are craving for Burmese food in Bangkok, this is one of the restaurants you must visit. They also serve Burmese style Indian food. Variety of options on the menu. Owner and staffs are very friendly. Great vibe in the evening with live music.
sample_reviews_en.author: M Maung

sample_reviews_en.text:
Been here twice.

First time was a weekend night, when it has a live band and the full menu.

Second time was a Monday lunchtime when it is a more traditional Burmese buffet.

Both delicious. Very friendly service. Authentic place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay R

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recommend kaw yay noodles.
I come back as that’s really good .
But I also ordered pan tay . That was not good like add noodle in chicken curry. The taste of pan tay is not like that. Not same taste and noodle.
Staff are friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Min Thu Mon

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is really bad now, it used to be good
I ordered fried rice with seafood and added seafood extra, it cost 259baht, and it was only enough for one serving of fish.
Taste is really not good.
They didn't fix the taste either
sample_reviews_en.author: YE Yint

restaurants.name: KHAO SOI CHIANG MAI KRU AOR
restaurants.address:

315/12 Pattaya 3rd Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
2025/3/1: SO delicious. We are a family of Thai and Taiwanese people that live in Thailand for 40 years and we LOVED it. Still thinking about this place so much

Non-tourist-adjusted homemade authentic Khao Soi flavors. I am so glad I found this store and brought my family here. We had 5 adults and ate 7-8 bowls!

Service is so warm, kind and sweet feels just like home. I loved the lady so much I gave her a hug because I was so happy. I wanted to come back the next day to eat again.

ขอบคุณมากๆนะคะ🙏🏻
sample_reviews_th.author: YiChien Tsai

sample_reviews_en.text:
A simple, home-style restaurant, but very clean and thoughtfully prepared. The flavors are authentically Northern Thai, using quality ingredients. The owner is kind, and the service is warm, like eating at a relative's house 😊
All the Khao Soi dishes are delicious: Chicken Khao Soi, Pork Rib Khao Soi, and Nam Ngiao — the noodles are soft, the broth is rich and fragrant, and the side dishes (pickled vegetables, shallots, lime) are all there.

⏰ Things to know before you come:
• The restaurant opens at 11:00 AM, but items sell out very quickly.
• If you come at 1:00 PM, “some menu items” may be sold out.
👉 If you plan to eat here, it's recommended to come around early noon to be sure.

In summary: If you like authentic, unadulterated Northern Thai flavors, this restaurant should be on your list.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dinsor2B

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thank you for bringing CM to Pattaya🙏🙏🙏

Khao Soi made just like Chiang Mai(CM):
Curry was perfect . Very mild spicy, coconut milk and subtle herbs. Served w/tender fall off the bone chicken drumstick, crispy and wet noodles and side of fresh shallots , fermented vegetable and lime. Closes your eyes and enjoy CM again.

Miang: dried shrimp , pork, peanuts and cilantro,  rolled up in a rice noodle served with a sweet(honey like) and sour(fish sauce) fried shallots dipping sauce. Popping flavors and textures: sweet, sour, crunchy , citrus ……Amaziiiiiiiiiiiig !!!!!!

Chao Kwai: refreshing herb jelly in a sweet herb soup piled high with ice. Reminds me of the Chinese grass jelly drink . A perfect ending to the meal .
sample_reviews_en.author: SoloJoe

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is our first meal of today after getting back home to Pattaya yesterday afternoon. This nice cosy hotel “restaurant” has the best northern Thai cuisine in Pattaya.

I wanted to have my favourite khao kapik but unfortunately the cook/lady boss told us that they don’t make it anymore cos it’s a lot of work and not many people order it.

So I had the khao soi kai (chicken khao soi - 80 baht) instead which is equally awesome. The lady boss recognised us and our son since we ate here quite often in 2023.

Do patronise this hotel “restaurant” if you want some authentic northern thai cuisine, you will not regret coming here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Adrian Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: It's just a fantastic place to eat! I would consider one of the best Khao Soi I've ever tasted. Great chilled out place with superb food. There are only a few items on the menu, but they are all superb. It's very inexpensive for what you actually get. They have a self-serve water station for use. Also, if you want to grab a beer, the hotel next door will sell you a bottle, and it's no bother to take to the table with you whilst you eat. Over the last few weeks, I've been here four times now, and i will return before leaving Pattaya. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Daniel Broadbent

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Khao-soi(Thai Curry soup)noodles were slightly overcooked and the soup a bit lukewarm, with a mild spicy kick, likely catering to local tastes. Still, considering the price, it's reasonable and the flavor isn’t bad. It’s definitely better than the khao soi place around at Soi Bong-Koch.

Unless you’re specifically craving Khao-soi, it’s not a place you’d go out of your way for. Northern Thai food doesn’t seem to catch on in Pattaya, and restaurants offering it tend to open and close frequently. I hope this one manages to stick around.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cortana

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had been to this place three times before, but we weren't very lucky and it was closed. I had been waiting to try this khao soi for a month😅Today I finally got here.
Khao Soi is the most delicious in Pattaya for me. Ideal light spiciness, delicate broth, very tasty noodles and chicken leg.
The atmosphere is just like home, the people who run the restaurant are smiling. The young man who works there understands and speaks English. I think the other dishes are also very tasty, judging by how many plates people had on their tables
sample_reviews_en.author: Lina Bronz

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was staying at the Vogue Hotel and was looking for a nearby restaurant when I visited.
I had high expectations for KOO SOI's food, as there were so many reviews from Koreans.
The older owner, four tables, the homey atmosphere, the clean-looking food, and the presentation were all nice.
However, the food itself was nothing special, reminiscent of curry noodles with chicken legs and fried food.
The price was reasonable at 80 baht, and it didn't smell bad.
The taste wasn't particularly impressive.
sample_reviews_en.author: 김대현

restaurants.name: Baan Pueng Chom
restaurants.address:

38 Phahon Yothin 7, แขวง พญาไท Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Thai restaurant is decorated in a beautiful traditional Thai house style. The atmosphere is lovely, giving you the feeling of eating at home. There are both air-conditioned and outdoor seating areas. It gets quite busy, but the food comes out surprisingly fast. If you want an air-conditioned seat, I recommend calling ahead to reserve. There's also parking available.

The food is delicious! The portion sizes are just right – not too small, not too big. We went with 5 people and ordered 6 dishes; we were so full! It cost less than 200 baht per person. The price is great, and most importantly, everything was incredibly tasty! (I didn't take any pictures of the food because we were enjoying it so much!😭) My favorites were the stir-fried Gnetum leaves with eggs, the red wine chicken wings, the stir-fried Gnetum flowers with eggs, and the Pung Chom omelet. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tuesday

sample_reviews_en.text:
A lush garden atmosphere in the heart of Ari, giving you the feeling of having a meal at your grandmother's house.

"Homey, heartwarming culinary charm."

This restaurant is a perfect blend of an old wooden house and a verdant garden, creating a classic and warm atmosphere in every corner. The authentic Thai royal cuisine is delicious, especially the 'Bear's Fried Beef' which is incredibly tender and the 'Three Smells Stir-fry' with its uniquely fragrant herbs – truly irresistible. With its relaxed atmosphere and hot, freshly served food, it's ideal for a family meal or a gathering with friends for a peaceful chat in the heart of the city.

A legendary restaurant that you can visit again and again without getting bored. I'm impressed by both the taste and the rare vibe that's hard to find these days.
sample_reviews_en.author: woonsentan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was not bad, but unfortunately this was the worst service I’ve experienced in Bangkok.

We found a hair in our glass noodles and showed it to the waiter. Instead of apologizing, he simply gestured that he would change the dish, with a very arrogant expression, as if this happens all the time. There was no “sorry,” no basic courtesy, not even through gestures or facial expressions.

When we went to settle the bill, the attitude was the same. No apology, and they didn’t even waive the glass noodle from the bill after the inconvenience.

Mistakes can happen, but the way staff handle them makes all the difference. Sadly, the service here was extremely disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dorry Chung

sample_reviews_en.text:
First meal in Bangkok and we tried Baan Pueng Chom — and it was such a great start to the trip.

The food was really delicious and the prices were very reasonable. The place was quite crowded, which already says a lot about how popular it is.

One dish that really stood out was a soup that looked similar to Tom Yum (same reddish color), but the taste was on another level — super flavorful, slightly tangy, rich, and very comforting. Definitely one of the best soups I’ve had here.

Overall, the experience was great — good food, good value, and a lively atmosphere.

Highly recommend this place if you’re in Bangkok 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuyin treasure

sample_reviews_en.text: The best thing about the restaurant is the atmosphere. The food is mediocre, mostly on the salty side. Most of the staff are polite and lovely. However, the woman who seemed to be the manager provided unimpressive service. When we asked for a menu, she chose to recommend dishes instead of providing a menu book initially. Furthermore, her recommendations included phrases like "This dish has been reviewed by..." or "Many people have reviewed this dish." We chose to believe her recommendations and ordered some items, but the taste was mediocre, unlike what she had been encouraging us to order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panachai Pornlertwaranyu

sample_reviews_en.text: The food wasn't very flavorful, just average, especially the glass noodle salad with acacia leaves. I've had better fried beef elsewhere. The sour curry was very sweet. The stir-fried Gnetum leaves with egg was the best dish I ordered. The restaurant has parking, but it was full because it was a Saturday, so I had to pay to park at the building at the entrance of the alley. The service was okay, and the prices were affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: June Ppw

sample_reviews_en.text: It lived up to its reputation for being delicious, but I liked the spicy pork rib soup even more than the beef. Just looking at the color tells you it's really spicy! The overall taste was delicious and well-balanced, but the portion sizes are quite small. The atmosphere is nice, and there's parking available, but it's a good idea to call and reserve a table beforehand. 🤩
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanutcha Jensanoi

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has been open for a very long time, since my student days until now, when I have children and a family. The food has always been delicious. Lately, it's been very popular, so you have to call to reserve a table or wait a long time. The "Pad Sam Men" (stir-fried three pungent vegetables) is amazing; it's authentic, traditional Thai food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jasple J

restaurants.name: Lek Pork Soup & Rice
restaurants.address:

18 1 Pradiphat 20 Alley, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The guay jub soup noodles are not bad. The soup is a bit light, but you can add pepper to adjust the flavor to your taste! The place is clean, and the service is great. I love how they include all the pork ingredients in the guay jub dish, like tender pork and crispy pork.

The side dish, หอยจ๊อปู (crab meat dumplings), is the best! It’s open till late, making it a great late-night snack spot in the Pradipat area.
sample_reviews_th.author: Chen E.

sample_reviews_th.text:
Aroi makkk!

If you like the animal offal, this is your place. 💓
But If you not, you can have ก๋วยจั๊บ.
I LOVE It so much. The broth is flavorful and delicious. the noodle is also good too.

The price is reasonable.💰

Really Recommend.
sample_reviews_th.author: tongwariss

sample_reviews_en.text:
Real street vibe, there was car passing by and some creatures lol. But not that disturb. I ordered the boiled rice with pork’s sec which is surprisingly good. (This one for take home) I suggest to order for take home.

The blood soup I expected more than this. But it was ok. I guess they seasoning it for customers to season it the way they prefer. (I added more pepper) If you’re a fan of pork’s intestines, this is the place. Wide selection that you can customize and no smelly scent. The crab ball is so not worth !! For 100b you’ll get 5 tiny balls. Crispy pork was soso.

Service quite confusing. Require your effort and patience. But not a bad experience tho.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chutikhan Na Songkhla

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I was in the Saphan Kwai area, so I stopped by to try this place. Actually, I've been eating here for a long time; it used to be open all the time. Before, I used to see DJ Poom eat around here often. Now they've moved to a bigger location. They serve lunch, dinner, and breakfast. The food is delicious and satisfying. I ordered the pork blood soup; this time the offal had no unpleasant smell at all. For those who love offal, I highly recommend it. Their crispy pork is among the best in the country; the texture, the crispiness, everything is perfectly balanced. They use only the best ingredients. You should definitely stop by and try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Smith

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lek Kao Lao Blood Pork Soup Shop
A small shop specializing in delicious blood pork soup and pork stomach soup, located at the beginning of Pradipat Road.

Try the crispy pork and homemade Chinese sausage, served with rice and the shop's flavorful broth. Highly recommended!

Price per person: 80-200 baht. Excellent value for money.

The owner and staff are friendly, smiling, and polite.

Parking is available on the street opposite the shop on even days and on the shop's side on odd days, during 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM and 8:00 PM - 5:00 AM. Alternatively, you can park at J Park Green Pradipat Market for 20 baht per hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khitja Boonsri

sample_reviews_en.text: I didn't have high expectations, but it was actually quite tasty. The price was also reasonable. Some dishes might not be exactly like what I ate as a child in the provinces, but overall it was good. The place is clean and well-maintained. They've also implemented a QR code system to speed up the ordering process. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Taweewat Tangpirul

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant in the Pradipat area is a simple pork blood soup place, but every time I go, I always order the thin rice noodles with tender beef and tendon, and the braised beef soup is amazing. The beef slices are thick and tender, the …
sample_reviews_en.author: THITIMA SAWATSUK

sample_reviews_en.text: This legendary old-style pork blood soup (Kao Lao Lueat Mu) shop in Pradiphat is open 24 hours. It's consistently clean and delicious, just as always when you crave Kao Lao. The offal is clean, the broth is clear and traditional, the …
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasin Keatparitus

restaurants.name: The Wave
restaurants.address:

199, 1 Rat Burana Rd, Bang Pakok, Rat Burana, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time trying this restaurant. I heard the food was good and the atmosphere by the Chao Phraya River was nice. I ordered: 1. Mixed Seafood Hot Pot: Served in a hot pot, but there was no lighter to keep it warm. The food was lukewarm, not very hot.
2. Prawns with Tamarind Sauce: It seemed like they ran out of tamarind, but it looked and tasted like tomato sauce. This was a huge disappointment.
3. Stir-fried Water Spinach with Chili: It was wilted and chewy.
4. Fried Fish Cakes: The taste was average.
All the food was lukewarm, like it had been warmed up.
We forced ourselves to eat it, not wanting to spoil the atmosphere, but then I thought it would be better to review honestly. This is what we actually experienced.
I don't have pictures because I didn't intend to write a review, only the receipt.
When we arrived, there were already two other tables of customers. The atmosphere was quiet.
sample_reviews_en.author: apit Lertpringkop

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted decent, and the atmosphere was nice with dim lighting, but there were a lot of mosquitoes because it's near the waterfront. If you like riverside seating, it's best to call and reserve in advance. The service was good; the staff refilled water for everyone, every glass, every table. The food prices were mid-range to high. The taste of the food is considered improved because they use high-quality ingredients. For example, the Tom Kha Gai (chicken coconut soup) had young coconut, thick and fragrant coconut milk, and they used the tender tops of the kale, unlike other restaurants. However, the fried chicken was too hard. The stir-fried scallops were spicy, delicious, fragrant, and very tasty. The music wasn't too loud, which we liked. Mostly older people were there; our siblings said the atmosphere was good. Overall, it was okay. Including one beer, the total bill was 2000 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: PowderPangPang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited The Wave last night after last year, Food, Riverside View, Service still absolutely brilliant 👏. Always nice to be back. Highly recommend.

Still in the same place nact to the old Big C Ratburana which have now demolished,  looking for The Wave sign in entrance.

**Update from recent visit to The Wave Restaurant, still open as normal they using partitions to protect from the dust from the building demolitions during closing hours, Can dine at The Wave as normal 👍🍽🥂🍹😋**

Enjoyed an excellent dinner last night (Thursday 9th November). We found the portion sizes and quality of the food first class and highly recommended. Riverside View makes this restaurant excellent location. All in all very enjoyable. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supansa Davies

sample_reviews_en.text:
The riverside atmosphere is fantastic. The cool breeze makes it perfect for relaxing and chilling out, ideal for dinner.

We ordered the grilled pork neck salad, which was flavorful and the pork neck was tender, and the French fries were hot, crispy, and delicious. The Dunkel German dark beer was smooth and easy to drink, and it even had a cute design on the foam that made it perfect for photos! ✨

Delicious food, great atmosphere, and reasonable prices. We'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploykarin

sample_reviews_en.text: I go to a restaurant I frequent because it's near my house. I choose my favorite dishes, the staff provides excellent service and is very attentive to customers. The atmosphere by the Chao Phraya River is cool and relaxing. I usually go in the evening or at midnight when there's live music, a solo singer playing general songs. Sometimes it's good, sometimes it's off-key, depending on when they start playing, but overall it's okay. I recommend it. There's ample parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratchanida Gmail

sample_reviews_en.text:
We love The Wave! Extraordinary food and live music entertainment with riverside views of the Dinner cruise boats, make this a must do!
The spotless presentation and flawless service from the polite and friendly staff make this a memorable experience worth repeating frequently! It’s right on the river with easy parking, tasteful decor with masses of ambiance! Great for a first date and many more, also large parties are welcome. Don’t miss it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ian Hawkes

sample_reviews_en.text:
Another visit to The Wave just before retuning back to the UK. As always nice setting with riverside view. Delicious food, good value & excellent service.  See you next time at the end of year.

Excellent Venue, Great Authentic Thai Food and some International dishes including Sushi. Always taking care of by lovely staff. We always visit when in Bangkok.  Highly recommend.  Tell taxi driver behind Big C Ratburana.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alan Davies

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is pretty good, the service is good, and the location is nice. The riverside atmosphere on the Chao Phraya River is excellent. It's located next to the recently demolished Big C Rat Burana. The food prices aren't expensive. It's a great place to relax, have drinks, and listen to music on Friday and Saturday nights. Suitable for small groups, families, couples, and dates.
sample_reviews_en.author: AEM Asia Event Management

restaurants.name: Sirocco
restaurants.address:

64th Floor, State Tower Bangkok, 1055 Si Lom Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an absolute must-visit; the experience is incredible and becomes an integral part of your trip. It's well worth the price. The service is impeccable, the waiters are lovely, they looked after our daughter the entire time, and they are incredibly attentive to each customer, offering a genuine smile and a constant, yet unobtrusive, view of the dining room. They also took the time to take amazing photos to capture this unique moment. This is one of the best fine dining restaurants we've ever been to. We're from Lyon (the gastronomic capital) and are food lovers, so I highly recommend this place. The sommelier is French, and the mixologist makes excellent cocktails, even those not listed on the menu, like the incredible "Porn Star Martini." The chef subtly moves around the dining room, placing truffle shavings and discreetly ensuring everything is running smoothly. All the servers speak fluent English, which allowed us to know exactly what we were eating. The price was approximately 900 euros for three adults and one child. Everything was perfect. Thank you for everything.
Laura Stora
sample_reviews_en.author: Laura Stora

sample_reviews_en.text:
The venue is the perfect combination of the best views of the city, good food options and spending time together in a group.

The staff were professional and helpful. Our waiter Jake (Aum) made the night memorable with extra efforts, surprises in between the meals and making it a special experience for everyone.

There was live performances from a band and a singer which made the atmosphere personable and unique.

The meal presentations and variety were exceptional and has to be experienced. An unforgettable experience indeed!!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anri Goosen

sample_reviews_en.text: Great experience, next to the breathtaking setting on top of Bangkok, excellent food and service as you would expect from a first class destination. We went for a 5 course menu with wine pairing which turned out to be the perfect choice. We were impressed by the someillier’s detailed knowledge which for us meant an extra plus.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dirk Metzger

sample_reviews_en.text: The View is spectacular at night, the best in Bangkok, the staff , Jenny , AC and Reshan were incredible, always ensured our experience was the best we could receive. Lebua is definitely a wonderful place to experience, but it’s the staff that make the experience memorable. Thankyou so much for a wonderful evening
sample_reviews_en.author: Ivan

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was great, and the staff were very well trained and attentive. The live singer was excellent and made the evening even more enjoyable. The food was okay, but the breathtaking view is what really makes this place special. Overall, it’s a nice spot for a relaxing evening.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ester Joy

sample_reviews_en.text: Stunning location, like being in a film set. The service was truly exceptional, with perfect attention to detail. The views are just breathtaking, and you feel on top of the world. If you want that “special place”, this is perhaps unrivaled …
sample_reviews_en.author: Michela Zanata

sample_reviews_en.text: I was so impressed! This was incredible! We came to Lebu for our honeymoon ! Our server was Jake , who’s a veteran working here! Incredible, kind, funny and very good at explaining the entire experience for us! The meal itself was expensive …
sample_reviews_en.author: Diddy Hertez

sample_reviews_en.text: An otherworldly experience. Our server Jenny was so nice to explain every dish to us and took good note of which foods we were allergic to. The runners/bussers Boss and Kris were very thoughtful of our drinks and were constantly refilling. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Kariana

restaurants.name: Ardente Ristorante
restaurants.address:

65/2 Sukhaphiban 2, Khwaeng Prawet, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍝 Ardente Sukhaphiban 2

An exquisite Italian restaurant in the Sukhaphiban 2 area,
combining delicious flavors, meticulous preparation, and a warm, inviting atmosphere. 🇮🇹✨

Every dish is freshly prepared with high-quality ingredients — homemade fresh pasta,
tender and juicy steaks, thin and crispy pizzas with a fragrant wood-fired aroma,
served perfectly with fine wines. 🍷

The restaurant's atmosphere is warm, comfortable, yet elegantly sophisticated.
Suitable for special occasions, family dinners, or gatherings with close friends.
Excellent service with attention to detail. 💫

Another restaurant worth trying if you're in the Sukhaphiban 2 area.
Delicious, simple, yet full of good vibes. ❤️

#Eatanywhere #ArdenteSukhaphiban2 #ItalianDining #WineAndDine #GoodVibesOnly
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachit Chairat

sample_reviews_en.text:
I highly recommend this restaurant! The chef makes every dish incredibly delicious.

My go-to dishes are:
- Grilled Mushroom Salad
- Aldente Pizza
- Truffle Soup
- T-Bone Steak (dry-aged for 240 days here)
- Angel Hair Spaghetti with River Prawns
- Snowfish Steak
- Calamari

For dessert, I recommend the apple pie.
I suggest ordering 20 minutes in advance because it's baked fresh and served hot.

The ingredients are fresh, the prices are reasonable, and the staff provides excellent service.
The atmosphere is relaxed, the restaurant is clean, and elegant.

My mother also enjoys drinking wine here.
If you like this style of food, you absolutely must try it!

Remember to call and reserve a table beforehand, as it can get full on some evenings.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattamon s

sample_reviews_en.text: Today our family went to this restaurant by our friend recommended. So we have ordered a fews food including Spaghetti cream sauce and grilled salmon for my 4 years kids which doesn’t in the menu. When my kid enjoyed that menu half way through, we noticed a piece of scotch-brite in his spaghetti plate then we stop eating that spaghetti and told the waiter about it. After that he came back and mentioned that he already told Chef and they confirm that it’s not scotch-brite. We are so confident that it’s scotch-brite. I’m so annoyed that they make an argument that it’s something else not scotch-brite. Even worse, we ask for the bill and they still charged us on that menu. We don’t expected this bad service on this level of restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manus Tangtirawat

sample_reviews_en.text: This famous restaurant on the eastern ring road is so good, even I, living on Vibhavadi Road, drive all the way there to eat. Everything is delicious, especially the pasta. Their spaghetti dishes are so good, no exaggeration needed. The noodles are perfectly cooked and the sauces are amazing. They have a diverse menu. Two of us drank three bottles of wine – guaranteed! It was all thanks to the food and service. On the day we went, there was a singer with a grand piano and violin, creating a wonderful atmosphere that enhanced the dining experience. All my friends agreed that this is one of their favorite restaurants. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: KpN U

sample_reviews_en.text:
It is the best Italian restaurant around Bangna and Lad krabang neighborhood. The pasta is the most recommended for you to try and the appetizer bread bucket. The others is calamari which is good with beer or wine. Not forget to try on their signature dish - Spaghetti Ardente smoked salmon with tobiko. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ for this dish.

Yeah, the owner is the wine importer. So you can find lots of wine in their bottle shop too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gaan Puenpipat

sample_reviews_en.text:
It is a very elegant Italian restaurant with a refined atmosphere. Every dish is of a high standard and pairs well with wine. The truffle cream pasta was especially exquisite. The service is also top-notch.
Since it is close to the airport, it is an ideal spot for a meal before seeing off guests from abroad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gourmet Advisor

sample_reviews_en.text: This Italian restaurant serves authentic Italian cuisine with excellent service and a warm, cozy atmosphere. Every dish is delicious, especially the Australian Wagyu beef full buds. Plus, they don't charge a corkage fee for wine.
sample_reviews_en.author: chinabha Charunwikan

sample_reviews_en.text: A great find! Superb service and atmosphere. Especially when Pat and her husband are serenading. But the food!!! THE FOOD!!! SO GOOD. Still day dreaming or the ravioli and the truffle soup. Will drag my friends there soon!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Plush Patron

restaurants.name: Hello sit down by Ladda aunt
restaurants.address:

296 Maha Rat Rd, Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The most delicious tom yum goong I've ever had in my life.
It's packed with spices, which complement the creamy coconut perfectly. I was impressed from the first bite; the spiciness was kept to a minimum so it wasn't too spicy and I couldn't stop eating the soup. I squeezed some lime in halfway through to change the flavor. It was delicious.
The gapow rice and shrimp pad thai were also delicious.
The spring rolls were packed with vegetables and the honey added a nice accent, making them also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Toko

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the best Thai food spot I've ever been to in Thailand! I spent two weeks in different parts of the country, but nothing beats the local Pad Thai, Tom Yum, or Tom Kha. If I ever return to Bangkok, I'll definitely go back and try these delicacies. The bar is unassuming, modest but clean, the food is amazing, and the prices are very good. I recommend it 👌
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna Birna
