sample_reviews_en.text: A nice restaurant overall. The food is good — not the best I’ve had, but definitely enjoyable. The atmosphere is quite simple and nothing particularly special, yet comfortable enough for a relaxed meal. The service is good and attentive. Overall, a decent place if you’re looking for a solid dining option without high expectations.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dario Dubrovic

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good value for money. Friendly service (well, you find that almost everywhere in Thailand), but here it seemed a touch more so. The food is good quality, and you can relax for a while in pleasant temperatures.

Around the corner to the left, you can get coconut water for 30 baht. The clothing stalls are also of good quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Florian

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there after seeing a post saying Tom Yum was delicious, but I shouldn't recommend it so rashly. At the very least, Tom Yum is delicious enough to just suppress blood sugar spikes. As someone who likes sour and melted Tom Yum... well... people with a strong pancreas should try it. I couldn't eat it.
sample_reviews_en.author: 은송이

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a shame we can't give more stars.
The best Morning Glory I've ever had – crispy, crispy, and perfect. The pad thai was equally delicious. The service was quick and very friendly.
The restaurant has two rooms. We sat in the upstairs room, which was well-air-conditioned and quiet.
sample_reviews_en.author: K&P

sample_reviews_en.text: Super friendly, incredibly delicious food 😍 right opposite the entrance to Wat Pho. Better food than in the Thai restaurants. Came back to Hello Sit Down again in 2026 and it's still super friendly and delicious. The prices are too low for this level of food 🙏🙏🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Wek Ke

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent place to eat at a very fair price. The best meal I’ve had in Thailand thus far. Thai milk iced tea was phenomenal. Good location for seeing some main sites close by. Good service with an English speaking waitress. Would eat here again in a heart beat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dominic Urso

restaurants.name: LOFTER
restaurants.address:

Central Chidlom, 6 Fl, 1027 Phloen Chit Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330 Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We found this food court by accident and have eaten here twice already!
There’s a Thai stir fry place that makes the best Pad Thai  (unlike that nasty Pad Thai place in Paragon Siam call Thipsamai, this place was so bad I threw out the whole dish and spit out the shrimp after taking one bite)! The mantis prawn garlic stir fry or with basil was Devine! The stall next to him specialty is Crab fried rice and Crab omelette! That was wonderful also!
My wife loved the stall that makes broth with roasted pork with crunchy skin, the skin is still crunchy even when it’s in the soup!
The service staff are excellent and hard working and sincerely willing to work and help you! They bring you the food after you order so you don’t have to stand there and wait like an idiot and pick up your dishes when your done quickly!
We were so surprised the food was so good here because the food court at the ICONSIAM, Paragon Siam, Terminal 21, most of the food stall either was nasty or bad! Only one or two places was edible!

Pepper & Morris
USA
sample_reviews_en.author: Pepper Morris

sample_reviews_en.text:
Highly recommended! The first impression is super clean! I can see all staff constantly ensuring all the cooking and dining areas are sparkling clean!

Second impression is there’s plenty of cuisines to choose from. Basically everything you expect from Thailand and nearby Asian countries. I also noticed they keep the menu fairly easy to understand.

Third impression is how well trained and polite all the staff are. I’m pleasantly surprised. They are all very polite and understand English very well.

Last but not least, the taste of food. I had Tomyum soup and basil minced pork rice today. The tomyum soup is quite impressive. The seafood in there are fresh and very sufficiently in portions. The basil rice is not bad as well. For the prices of them, I’d say it’s very fair. The tomyum is 110 baht and pork rice is 70baht. General taste to me seems to be more inclined to meet foreigners’ tolerance, but who am I to say? There’s many local people here. So probably just me comparing them to different areas’ tastes in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The prices are on the slightly higher side compared to other food courts.

It is a food court where you receive an order card upon entry and pay later upon exiting.

Here, after ordering and receiving a receipt, you find a table, take a seat, and hand the receipt to the staff, who then pick up the food and bring it to you. Because of this, a 5% service charge is applied when paying.

Additionally, you can receive a 5% discount on the total amount if you pay with a Central The 1 credit card.

I have been having dinner here after work on weekdays for about two years now, and most of the food is quite delicious. There is a pasta stall at the far end directly in front of the entrance, and the pasta there is better than what you would find at most pasta restaurants outside.

Furthermore, the staff handing out order cards at the entrance, taking orders in the dining area, serving staff, and paying staff at the exit are all extremely friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Youngseok Hyun

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food court on the 6th floor of Central Chidlom has many tempting restaurants. The system is well-organized because when you enter the zone, staff give you a food card with a 1,000 baht limit. You use this card to pay for your food in the zone and then pay the final bill at the cashier before leaving. There are many restaurants, both savory and sweet. Most dishes are over 100 baht, but there are some dishes under 100 baht. For example, we tried two restaurants:
Ded Kaprao (a restaurant): The Crispy Basil with Century Egg + Fried Egg (120 baht). The portion was generous, and the taste was moderate, not too spicy. I liked the crispy fried egg.
Khao Mok Jingjai (a restaurant): The Chicken Leg Biryani (80 baht). The chicken leg was very tender, but combined with the amount of rice, it wasn't very filling for me. The soup was made with radish, sweet and fragrant. The biryani rice itself was average, but the dipping sauce was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thaya Aungtananukul

sample_reviews_en.text: Food Loft is still great after all theses years. It was the first to introduce the concept of stylish and modern “food court”. Though over time crowd do tired of it and move on to other new places, it still offers reliability delicious food in comfortable and relaxing atmosphere. The selections are always the same: Thai, Indian, Korean, Vietnamese, Middle East, Japanese, Italian, and one visiting food shop that on rotation. I enjoy the Middle East food and Vietnamese particularly. The fruit juice bar offers great selection of juices and mocktails. Watermelon juice is so refreshing. You can deposit shopping bags, order the food, if the food takes longer than few minutes to prepare, you will be given a ticket to be given to the waiters to bring the food to your table. If the food tray look heavy, walk to the dining area the waiter will ask to hold it for you and take you to the table. Less crowded most of the time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emwee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Was here many years back and back after pandemic. They used to serve high range selection of food and the concept was self-service.
Now, they provide a breeze dining-in where you just need to order your food via your card, pass the waiter/waitress the receipt and the next thing you know your food will be served on the table.
Indeed it is like a higher class food court but I would say price is reasonable for the services they rendered. The place is clean.
Ordered banana butter smoothies and it was yummy which make my tummy happy 😆. Also tried their crab omelette which is filled with crabmeat and good to take with their green chili sauce, beef noodle and dry tom yum flat noodle which was only average in taste. All these cost around TB700 since crabmeat omelette is at a premium.
By and large, this hidden food center in central is worth visiting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amummiz Leow

sample_reviews_en.text:
A food court in Central ChidLom. Good for tourists  like me to shop and eat the whole day. Always come here to shop at one go then claim VAT. The food here is good and so are the service provided. U just passed your food receipts to the staff and they will bring to your table. Unseen of this kinda service so far when I was in BKK.
Food-wise, the best is the fried Suki. It’s as good as the one in area near Chulalongkorn alleys. Better than my usual go to at Terminal 21. Next is the Yentafo. The soup is good and so is the pork cake. Duck noodles is not bad due to the soup being watery but the drumstick saved it.
Came back a year later. Food standards still maintained.
Came back again in Nov 2024. Fried suki standard is still Top 2 for me. I wonder how they maintain the standard as the cook has changed these few years.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adrick Loh

sample_reviews_en.text: A renovated (2 years I think) food court inside Central Chili’s Mall. You can easily get to it via BTS Chit Lom station.  Space feels nice and modern with all the known Thai F&B brand located inside. I had the Polo chicken set lunch with Sontam corn for 180 Baht and it’s as nice as the original. Also other brands are there as well. The selection is quite good. Also the service is elevated. Once you buy your food you can go to any open seating and a server will come to you to ask for your receipt and they will pick up the food from the stall and bring it to your table, very convenient. There’s also a full service bar if you want wine or alcoholic drinks with your meal. This is a good option for those wanting popular Thai street food at an elevated service and still friendly to the pockets.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joey C.

restaurants.name: ป.ประทีป ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือ คลองลำเจียก
restaurants.address:

6 2 Khlong Lamchiak 13 Alley, Nuan Chan, Bueng Kum, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
ป.ประทีป ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือ คลองลำเจียก is a hidden gem for boat noodle lovers 🍜⛵️. This casual spot serves up authentic Thai boat noodles that pack a punch of flavor, with a rich, aromatic broth and tender slices of beef or pork 🥩🐷. The portions might be small (as is tradition with boat noodles), but the prices are so affordable you’ll find yourself ordering bowl after bowl without breaking the bank 💸.

The vibe here is relaxed and unpretentious, like you’ve stepped into a local eatery where the focus is all about the food. The tables are often filled with regulars who know their boat noodles and aren’t shy about slurping up every last drop. The staff is friendly and efficient, making sure your bowls keep coming as fast as you can eat them 😊.

If you’re in the area and craving some seriously good noodles, ป.ประทีป ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือ is a must-visit. Just be prepared—you might need more than a couple of bowls to satisfy your appetite, but hey, that’s all part of the fun!
sample_reviews_th.author: PK PTD

sample_reviews_en.text:
P. Prateep's first branch is a bit hard to find parking.
You have to park on the side street next to the noodle shop or in front of the 7-Eleven.

Once inside, you sit at a table and write down your order. *If you don't want spicy food, you have to write that down.*
The prices are 20-30 baht, similar to my local area, but the taste is extremely spicy! It's so spicy you can barely taste anything else.
Even I, someone who usually eats spicy food, found it so spicy my face turned red and my nose ran.
I tried the braised liver, which was delicious and perfectly tender.
The noodle and glass noodle portions were huge!

Pork cracklings were 10 baht per pack, delicious and not rancid.
Pork rinds were 30 baht per bowl, a generous portion, crispy and delicious.
You can help yourself to vegetables at the front of the shop; they have basil, bean sprouts, and cilantro.

The staff provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: SAKONWAN Su

sample_reviews_en.text: I've tried other branches, but none are as good as the original P. Prateep Boat Noodles at Khlong Lam Chiak 13. Their crispy pork cracklings are amazing; I was so sad when I went late and they were sold out! The boat noodles have a rich, flavorful broth that hardly needs any seasoning. The chili is very spicy, so if you can't handle spicy food, be sure to specify "less spicy." They have both beef and pork, cooked in separate pots. Fresh vegetables are self-service and unlimited. There are plenty of tables, but it gets very crowded at lunchtime, sometimes requiring a long wait. Their coconut milk pudding is also delicious with a rich, creamy texture. There's limited parking; you have to park on the side of the road. This restaurant only accepts cash, so if you don't have cash, you can withdraw from the ATM at the 7-Eleven next door.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paew Waew

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating at this restaurant for so long I've lost count – probably over a hundred times! 😂 When I crave boat noodles, it's always my go-to place. The flavor is rich and spicy, just the way I like it. I always finish the whole bowl whenever I order. The toppings and noodles are great, and the taste is consistently good. Most importantly, I never get tired of it. Sometimes I just stop by without thinking much about it, just craving this kind of boat noodles. Overall, it's become my regular spot. If you like rich, flavorful boat noodles, give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: noo maree

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've had this place pinned for a while since watching it on The Spoon. After trying it, I felt indifferent; it wasn't really to my liking.

I ordered the beef noodle soup (special, 30 baht). The noodles were okay, but the broth wasn't very flavorful, and the beef was tough and difficult to eat. So I only ate one bowl.

The service was good and fast. They only accept cash. Parking is available along the roadside or at the 7-Eleven.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eco Com

sample_reviews_en.text: The original P. Prateep restaurant serves a uniquely delicious dish. The chili peppers are very spicy, perfect for those who like strong flavors. The broth is rich and flavorful; one bowl won't be enough. It gets very crowded during peak hours. The restaurant has recently been renovated and is now more spacious with convenient parking. Park in the right spot and you don't have to worry about getting your car towed.
sample_reviews_en.author: ISARA RUANGSANTI

sample_reviews_en.text: I drove from Nakhon Ratchasima, leaving around 6 AM, just to eat here. I arrived at the restaurant almost at 10 AM. The sign outside said they were closed until the 28th. I had prepared to arrive before noon because I was afraid it would be crowded. The restaurant should have announced this on their Facebook page. What are people from nearby going to do now? It's a wasted trip and time.
sample_reviews_en.author: SUKANYA

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the opportunity to eat at the original restaurant, expecting a more impressive taste than other branches, but I was disappointed to find the flavor quite bland and strangely sour. However, I must commend the spiciness of the chili peppers, which slightly improved the taste of every bowl of boat noodles. Overall, it was good, but a little disappointing. ⭐️⭐️🙇🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Justwondering

restaurants.name: Palanchai BBQ
restaurants.address:

136ถนน Chok Chai 4 Soi 54, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old-style Thai BBQ restaurant, not a buffet. The pork is pre-marinated and quite spicy from the black pepper and the marinade contains egg.

The marinade, when poured into the soup, boils and turns into egg.

Pork and beef are available in small, medium, and large sizes. The pork slices are good quality and lean.

Other dishes can be ordered separately. Recommended dishes besides the BBQ are Pad Thai and fried mussels.

The dipping sauce used to be tastier, but lately it tastes strange and less flavorful. Before, it was so rich you could eat it without adding any extra seasoning.

The spicy salads are just okay. The pork sausage in the salad isn't good; it's too starchy. They should use better quality pork sausage.

Parking is available along the side streets in the village, but it's not too difficult to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: S Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The thick slices of pork are marinated until tender but too salty. The seafood dipping sauce is also a bit salty, and the soup is salty too. My tongue felt numb after eating it all.

People are focusing more on health these days. I wish the restaurant would consider what to highlight as their main selling point, because everything is too salty right now. When grilling, the salt drips all over the pan.
The prices are a bit high. I ordered the largest mixed set, which included marinated pork, liver, chicken, fish, and squid, but the picture didn't match. There was very little vegetables – just one plate. It was enough for two people; we were so full we had to go to another restaurant afterwards.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ryna Ryna

sample_reviews_en.text:
This legendary restaurant has been my go-to since I was a kid, back when I used to sit on the stone benches in my house. I've been there every time they moved, until I moved house and didn't get to go as often. This time, the taste is just as delicious as ever. The brass stove with its strong charcoal fire is fantastic – the Pad Thai and fried oysters are all excellent. And to top it all off, they have the younger generation's traditional Thai crepes.

I highly recommend it. If you want to experience the deliciousness, sitting outside over the charcoal is amazing. And importantly, the price is very reasonable – a large set is 350 baht, enough to fill you up completely.
sample_reviews_en.author: NJ Story

sample_reviews_en.text:
I got recommendations here many times from Thai friends. I hear that one day one of the famous stars in Thailand visited this shop but I don't mind marketing.
The Mookata is similar to the BBQ PLAZA style. I smell black paper from pork. The basic source is like a seafood source. The vibe and everything were good and the price was reasonable price but I prefer my old favorite place for Mookata.
I recommend Hoitod, the fried mussel pancake, it was great crispy, and big mussel. The fried rice was good too. Ah, and they serve a bottle of beer with frozen glasses. GREAT
I’m so sorry to share what I was working on at the table
sample_reviews_en.author: nuhk 8AE

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant I've been eating at since before it became very popular. I went back yesterday, and the food tasted normal, especially the pork belly, which was delicious. However, the problem was with the young, pale-faced female staff member who was constantly playing on her phone. She didn't hear me when I called her. When I asked for the bill, she just looked at me, turned off the stove, and went back to playing on her phone, leaving me waiting for a very long time. I had to call her again until a male staff member finally heard me and picked up the iPad to process the payment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lugsamee Phothiwichit

sample_reviews_en.text: This air-conditioned BBQ restaurant serves set meals, not a buffet, but the taste is incredibly delicious. I've been eating here for decades, since it was a small shop until it became a large, air-conditioned building. The taste is still as delicious as ever, unique and unlike anything I've ever tasted, thanks to their special dipping sauce. If you've tried BBQ elsewhere and haven't been satisfied, try this place first. They also have a variety of other menu items and desserts.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanarat Prechawanich

sample_reviews_en.text:
🥩 Phlanchai Barbecue (#Chokchai4)
🔥 Legendary Thai BBQ for over 30 years! Tender, marinated meat in large, satisfying pieces.
🥓 Crispy, fragrant bacon, best enjoyed with their signature dipping sauce – pure bliss!
🍲 Sweet and aromatic broth, flavorful and unique dipping sauces.
🦪 Don't miss the fried oysters, Pad Thai, and finish with grilled bananas. Everything you need for a delicious meal in one place!

#PhlanchaiBarbecue #Barbecue #Bangkok #DeliciousFoodRecommendation
sample_reviews_en.author: O YUREEWAN

sample_reviews_en.text:
My friend said that no matter where you eat Mookata, fried oysters, or Pad Thai, it's never as delicious as here. Especially the Mookata dipping sauce and the thick, big pieces of pork that are so satisfying. It's so delicious you'll leave feeling full! 😋👏👍
If you're craving it or miss it, stop by!
Monday - Friday 4:00 PM - 10:00 PM
Saturday - Sunday 12:00 PM - 9:00 PM

Come and try it! For truly delicious food, it has to be Phlanchai Barbecue, only here! 👏
sample_reviews_en.author: Saosuy-dee Dee

restaurants.name: Tui Mu Kratha-Mu Chum Pho Nimit
restaurants.address:

4 Somdet Phra Chao Tak Sin Rd, Bukkhalo, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tui Moo Krata (Thai BBQ)
The dipping sauce is delicious, and the pork belly is amazing!
Not too fatty, crispy and delicious when grilled.
The shrimp are already peeled, and they're large, so you don't have to peel them yourself.
It's conveniently located near the BTS.
However, finding parking if you come by car can be difficult as you have to park on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: JM's Oill

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered the 450 baht set meal, which was more than enough for two people and very filling! With the set, you can tell the staff which meats you don't want; we didn't want chicken. It also includes one bottle of soda (or water). We ordered extra shrimp as well. I really like the shrimp here; it's large, firm, fresh, and clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชญาดา เชื้อจีน

sample_reviews_en.text: 🥩🥓🥢 This Mookata (Thai BBQ) restaurant is near the BTS station. The meat is tender, the dipping sauce is delicious, and the atmosphere is great with an open-air roof allowing you to enjoy the sky. The service is good, and it's very popular, so you might have to wait in line. It's my go-to restaurant that I visit every week ♥️
sample_reviews_en.author: POOPAE PIYANOOD

sample_reviews_en.text: The dipping sauce is incredibly delicious! The atmosphere is nice and breezy, but on some days when there's no breeze, it can get quite hot and stuffy. There's no dedicated parking lot, so you have to find parking along the roadside (which can be difficult). The service is pretty fast. I've been here many times already! 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: whytry amistar

sample_reviews_en.text:
A local restaurant that's not well-known to tourists. I found it on Google Maps. Both the hot pot and grilled dishes are delicious, and the dipping sauce is 10000/100 🤩
I'll definitely come back if I have the chance 😋
The restaurant also sells hair wraps, so my hair still smells great after eating kkkk 🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: Hà Nguyễn

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! I bought a combo set for around 549B, and it was enough for four people. The two bottles of water were huge, perfect for taking home and drinking later. The staff were lovely and attentive, even grilling the food for me. The restaurant is located on the main road and is easy to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: tram ngoc

sample_reviews_en.text: Tui Mu Kratha–Mu Chum Pho Nimit is the kind of spot that reminds you why Thai BBQ is basically a national pastime 🔥🐷😎 The moment you walk in, the air is thick with that glorious grilled pork aroma, smoke drifting in the air, and tables full …
sample_reviews_en.author: PK PTD

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually really enjoy eating there, so I arranged to meet up with my friends to have some. While we were finishing our ice cream and eating, a staff member came over and asked if we wanted them to take away the ice cream grill. We said yes …
sample_reviews_en.author: SIRINYA pathapata

restaurants.name: Sugam South Indian Restaurant மதுரை உணவகம்
restaurants.address:

Pattaya Sai Song Rd Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the South Indian thali, and man, it was insanely delicious, like, shake-you-to-your-core good.
That said, maybe it was just bad luck this time, but the rice was really mushy, which I'm not a fan of. The place was packed with Indian travelers, and as the only other Asian guy, I could see how some people might feel a bit out of place. It didn't bother me, though. The young staff weren't exactly friendly, but they were efficient and did their jobs well. Guess that's just the culture there.
Here's the part that makes me really hesitant to go back: while I was eating, this horrible sewage smell just filled the entire restaurant. Maybe they started cleaning the toilets, I don't know. It was so good and I wanted to finish it all, but I'm really sensitive to smells and just had to stop eating. I couldn't finish the meal.
But honestly, even now that I'm back home, I still think about how good that thali was. I really hope they sort their stuff out, because the food is amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: lotus sutra

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited a South Indian restaurant and had a wonderful dining experience. The moment I entered, the aroma of authentic spices and traditional flavors set the mood. The ambience was simple, clean, and gave a homely and welcoming feel.

The food was outstanding. The dosas were perfectly crispy, the idlis were soft and fluffy, and the sambar was rich, flavorful, and perfectly balanced. The chutneys tasted fresh and complemented every dish beautifully. I also tried their filter coffee, and it was authentic, strong, and a perfect finish to the meal.

The service was quick and the staff was polite, attentive, and friendly. The prices were reasonable, and the portion sizes were generous, giving great value for money.

Overall, this restaurant is a must-visit for anyone who loves real South Indian flavors. Delicious food, great hospitality, and a truly satisfying experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumit Padhiyar

sample_reviews_en.text: Located in Pattya down goen very rush area, not sure about parking would prefer take taxi/ by walk. Variety of foods, price seems little high! Favourite thaali just ordered fish! Guys you guys are charging reasonable every thing added penny all curries and those seems cold, fish tiny 2 pieces with zero taste😮😆🤔 I called the waiter and ask them to add little potato. Its very tiny small containers just filled up with fresh curries, to be honest I would not recommend this place to anyone! Don't waste your money. When I heard the name Mudurai was eager to visit upon visit understand its not authabtci just  a china made copy restaurant lol. Thank you and happy business
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay “Jay NY” Theja

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went here after seeing many positive reviews, but it was disappointing.
Ordered a South Indian thali and none of the items, including the rice, were warm - everything was cold.
Wada and buttermilk mentioned in the menu was not part of the thali we received.
Well, vathakulambu was nothing but tomato and onion curry. I am from Madurai and this is not taste of Madurai at all
Also noticed a dead rat, which was very unpleasant to see after eating.
Definitely one of our worst experiences. Won’t be visiting again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fa Ris

sample_reviews_en.text:
We really loved ur food but it your request that when u take group food orders ,Pls tell them maintenance some decency so that the another can have food peacefully , we thought fo coming back for next but after hearing their words and talks we thought of not coming so pls,I like has so many people are not going  it to come back it is request u guys pls work on it that help all of has, last but and least the food amazing I just loved it thank you, and also the waiter was so
So rude and respect to has
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunil Gowda

sample_reviews_en.text: “A wonderful Tamil restaurant offering truly authentic flavours from Tamil Nadu. The aroma, taste, and presentation of each dish reflect traditional cooking methods. The meals were fresh, the curries were well-balanced, and the parotta was perfectly layered. Service was quick and courteous, and the place maintained good cleanliness. Overall, an excellent spot for anyone craving genuine Tamil nadu Madurai style food.” Thaking you Sinu(Master) & Sonu
sample_reviews_en.author: ARUN MANI R

sample_reviews_en.text: At this cozy South Indian spot, the veg thali is a satisfying platter of multiple small curries, lentils, rice, roti/dosa and chutneys — flavorful spices but not overwhelmingly hot, perfect balance and good portion size. The non-veg thali pairs succulent chicken or  was good too.Service is friendly, portions generous, and the overall experience feels like a comforting, authentic meal that’s worth trying for both veg and non-veg lovers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hemkumar Venkatesh

sample_reviews_en.text: I am vegan. I tried thali here, the food is amazing. Perhaps this is only Indian restaurant which understands what vegan is, and has vegan options. But make sure to tell them Vegan just in case, they can substitute yogurt (buttermilk) with lemon juice and skip ghee part in thalis. Ofcourse, you can try Dosas most of which are vegan here. In future, they said they will have a separate vegan menu. I strongly recommend this place
sample_reviews_en.author: Chandra

restaurants.name: Blue Parrot Bangkok
restaurants.address:

21, 1 Soi Mek Sawat, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A nice place which is not easy to find (in the middle of nowhere), with a field for pétanque and a swimming pool.
Just a few customers at night when we have been to Blue Parrot for dinner.
Is it the reason why the service was poor as the young waiters seem to be boring ?
The food is good and expensive.
It is the typical type of restaurant for foreigners with the price indicated in the menu without taxes and services !
In Thailand, taxes are always included, and only a few restaurants (for foreigners) cheat their customers with prices without taxes. It is a shame.
The quantity of alcohol served is below the regular dose (for Ricard). I assume that they have an issue with the doser.
It is definitely a place where I will not go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bruno Godard

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an excellent place! The Blue Parrot is truly a hidden oasis in the heart of Sathorn.

Excellent food: The dishes are flavorful, fresh, and beautifully prepared. You can taste the quality in every bite. Their pizza is a real treat!
Top-notch cocktails: Their drinks menu is inventive, and the mixes are perfectly balanced. I highly recommend their signature cocktail.
A fantastic atmosphere: The ambiance is incredible, and the service is top-notch. Whether you're with friends for a party or with family, everyone will find something to enjoy.
The setting, with its swimming pool and pétanque court, adds a unique touch you won't find anywhere else, and they also offer other activities for children. I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: charlène ird

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely love this place. It’s perfect for the family to relax and the kids can play in the pool. The staff are extremely friendly, the food is high quality, music is excellent and the setting is awesome. You can forget you are in Bangkok for a few hours. The bill can add up quickly but I’ve never left there feeling dissatisfied and it’s worth every satang for the great service, food and atmosphere. Many thanks from my family to the management and team.

Edit: I would like to add how amazing these guys are. They accommodated us for a small birthday party after a big party. My daughter loved it. I’ve got so much love for the staff and management here. Thank you so much 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Edward Grant

sample_reviews_en.text: Olivia and Pierre and all of the staff were incredible hosts for our wedding party. We come here pretty often and always have a good time. It's such a good vibe. However, are wedding party was truly special because the staff was very proactive to specific situations. This made a big impact on our experience and I am truly thankful for all of there recommendations and could not ask for a better experience.  For private events like ours, it can be quite stressful but we didnt experience that. Even when we come here for casual hangout or working, its always a good vibe. Huge shout out to the staff. Sometimes they have live bands that play samba and its fire 🔥.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tyler Hundley

sample_reviews_en.text:
Such a fun find in Sathorn! The kids had a blast in the pool, towel service included. We went on a Thursday late afternoon and had the place to ourselves. Plenty of fun tropical drinks.

Bruschetta was GOOD!

Kids meal is a good size and chicken nuggets were great! Comes with main course, side and a water flavored with syrup.

Red Bell Pepper Pasta was AMAZING! Super flavorful and very good.

The Parrot Salad was so good. Lots of lettuce and the beetroot paired perfectly with the mango.

All in all this was one of our most enjoyable stops during this trip to Bangkok! We loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Meredith Nye

sample_reviews_en.text: One of our favorite places to go for our family (of four kids). We appreciate the wait staff who are very patient and friendly. The food is nice and the pool is lovely for our kids in the Bangkok heat. There is a shallow area for the younger kids. I understand that some customers may think it's too loud from kids but this is a rare gem where it's not a 'kids cafe' but still allows for kids to have fun while adults can enjoy a nice meal and atmosphere. So thanks for Blue Parrot's patience and hospitality to serve our specific season in life and making it really nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stephen Lou

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very lively and entertaining place with good music.We went sunday evening and the place was fully packed.This place is perfect for family as there is swimming pool in the middle of the place for kids to play and parents dine next by.Late evening is good for adults to jump in the pool too.
Food tastes really amazing.Like really unexpected.Serving is really big.I was shocked with how big the pork ribs was.Lots of variety of drinks especially cocktails and lot of mocktails too.My kids really enjoyed the place and would definitely come to the place again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sareena S

sample_reviews_en.text:
fb : Travel Cafe Eat Drink - Malaysia & Asia
Perfect for days when you want to be away from the bustling crowd in the city. Its a place to relax and hang out with friends and family.
The atmosphere is private and laid-back, highlighted by a central pool and surrounding trees that add freshness and shade for total relaxation.

The decor blends traditional Thai style with modern touches, creating a warm and unique feel.
The menu offers a diverse selection of both Thai and international dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ong C

restaurants.name: ตั๋นโบข้าวมันไก่เยาวราชและลูกเฮียเทพ (สาขานาคนิวาส)
restaurants.address:

149 Nak Niwat Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lately, I've been really into these two Hainanese chicken rice places:
🍚🐔 Tan Bo Hainanese Chicken Rice and Yosapol Hainanese Chicken Rice in Saraburi. I stop by whenever I pass a branch.

🚗 Today, I drove past the Ladprao area and decided to try it. I'm not sure if this branch is the newest.

🍚 Mixed Hainanese Chicken Rice, 95 baht.
It's not expensive at all, the portion is generous, and the taste is great.
🐔 I chose the breast meat for the boiled chicken; it was very tender and juicy, chopped into bite-sized pieces.
🍗 The fried chicken looks similar to the Hat Yai style fried chicken, with crispy fried shallots that enhance the flavor a lot.
🥣 The dipping sauces are the highlight. I like to mix the soy sauce dip with the chili oil – it's perfectly spicy. I also alternate with a really good sweet soy sauce (better than the regular sweet soy sauce).

🐖 Their roast pork and crispy pork rice look amazing too. I'll have to try them next time.

Location📍Ladprao 71, Nak Niwas
⏰ 09.00-21.00 hrs.
🚙 Parking available

🙏 Thank you all ♥️
for clicking "Follow"

YouTube 🎬 Paopao Studio
TikTok 🎙️ Paopao Studio
Wongnai 🍭 Paopao Studio

#StreetFood #EatBeforeBed #PaopaoStudio
sample_reviews_en.author: Paopao Studio

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't even want to give it one star. At first, I thought the chicken was delicious and I really liked it. But almost finished the plate, I found a piece of chicken with red blood, indicating it wasn't fully cooked. I called the waiter over. Initially, the waiter said it was probably undercooked and told me to tell the counter staff. So I went to pay and asked the waiter if it was okay that the chicken wasn't fully cooked. The female waiter replied that it was cooked, just red, even though she hadn't even come to check on it. I don't understand; it felt like she was deliberately trying to shirk responsibility. She didn't apologize at all, even though the previous waiter had already spoken to the staff. She knew but did nothing. I'm very disappointed. Even if the food was delicious, if the service is terrible and irresponsible, I won't eat there again. I'll tell others not to go because the staff is awful and irresponsible. They need to train and improve their customer service attitude and practices. Otherwise, they'll have problems. I regret forgetting to take a picture because I initially thought the staff would take responsibility.
sample_reviews_en.author: warangkana chuchat

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is located on Nakniwat Road before reaching the Shell gas station. You can park inside the shop. There's a small parking lot. The shop is air-conditioned and looks cleanly decorated. There are spacious seats and many tables. The menu has chicken rice, roast pork rice, and crispy pork rice. Prices start at 60 baht. The chicken rice is a bit dry, but the fried chicken is crispy. I personally don't like this type of rice, but my girlfriend loves it (food is a matter of taste). But the roast pork rice with gravy tastes like something I've eaten before but haven't had in a long time. It's a bit sweet and a bit salty. I personally think the taste is average, but the ingredients are very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffey

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'd never eaten here before, but I was in the area for a merit-making event, so my boss took me to try it. We ordered separate sets of roasted pork and crispy pork. The roasted pork was in large, thick, tender pieces – delicious and very satisfying. The crispy pork was cut into thick, crunchy pieces. The Hainanese chicken rice had soft and delicious rice, and the chicken was tender and thick, perfect with the dipping sauce. The chicken liver was fresh, not gamey, and without any blood.

In short, everything was delicious, so much so that I bought some to take home for my family. And I expect there will be more visits in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mooaorcafe

sample_reviews_en.text:
Singaporean Hainanese Chicken Rice, 90 baht. Great value!
Delicious, well-prepared. The chicken is a mix of thigh and hip meat, large pieces, firm and meaty. Just the right amount to fill you up. The liver is excellent! Everything is perfectly cooked, just right to eat. The soup is fragrant, and the chicken sauce isn't too oily or too salty, just right.

My partner ordered the mixed version with fried chicken. He said it was a bit oily and greasy. He said the boiled chicken version is better (according to him).

Roasted Pork and Crispy Pork Rice: Delicious, standard quality.
The crispy pork is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mickey Amollapa

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Hainanese chicken rice was delicious. The chicken was tender and not dry at all.
The chicken feet were also good and not boring to eat. The soup was served piping hot, which I really liked.
The chicken liver was also very tender, with all the blood removed.
The roasted pork was delicious, with a sweet and fragrant spiced flavor that wasn't just typical Thai roasted pork.
The crispy pork was plentiful and tasty.
There was always parking available, even on days when the tables were full.
The staff provided good service and were polite.
It's always as good as always.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sitthichai K

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant recently opened, so I decided to try it. There's convenient parking and the restaurant area is spacious.

They sell both Hainanese chicken rice and roast pork/crispy pork rice. This time I tried the Hainanese chicken rice. I'll try the roast pork rice next time because the chilies on the table looked very appetizing.

The rice was a beautiful brown color with nice grains. The chicken was tender, just right – not too soft. The dipping sauce was tasty, and they provided chopped chilies, ginger, and garlic.
sample_reviews_en.author: d apk

sample_reviews_en.text:
Review of Tan Bo Chicken Rice 🍚🐔
The chicken rice is delicious! Especially the chicken liver, it's soft, smooth, and not at all gamey. It goes perfectly with the fragrant rice 😋 Importantly, I recommend ordering the roasted pork as well, because the taste is excellent, fragrant, and just the right amount of sweetness. This is another restaurant that's definitely worth a visit ❤️

P.S. There's convenient parking and the seating is air-conditioned, making it cool and comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Milk Station

restaurants.name: Krua Pa & Ma Restaurant
restaurants.address:

222/1 Prachathipatai Rd, แขวง พระนคร, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tucked away from the busy streets, this charming, family-run restaurant truly lives up to its reputation as a hidden gem. From the moment you step inside, you’re welcomed with genuine warmth and hospitality that immediately makes you feel at home.
The food is exceptional—clearly prepared with care, passion, and a deep respect for quality ingredients. Every dish is thoughtfully crafted and full of flavor, reflecting both tradition and attention to detail.
What makes this place even more special is the incredibly friendly and attentive staff. Their kindness and authenticity create an atmosphere that is both relaxed and memorable.
In the truest sense of the word, this restaurant is a “hidden” treasure. It’s well worth seeking out, and once you’ve been, you’ll definitely want to come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Matthias Kuratli

sample_reviews_en.text: We had a lovely authentic Thai meal tonight with really friendly service from the owners, siting in an outdoor area surrounded by plants water features and soft music. The highlight though was the food. One of our favourite Thai dishes at home is a seafood salad in a hot and sour sauce, we found it here made with fresh salad ingredients and freshly cooked king prawns and squid in a great sauce. Far better than anything we get at home. We also shared a chicken and a beef stir fry dish both of which were delicious. If you are looking for a family run home cooked Thai restaurant when in Bangkok you should certainly give this a go.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andy Luce

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you are seeing this you are in luck! Just go!

This was a phenomenal find close by to the muy thai stadium. The penang curry was one of the most delicious thai dishes we have ever had. Creamy, spicy, salty, chicken cooked perfectly. We asked for more sauce which took a few min given its homemade right then. Also got a nice morning glory and green curry rocem Would love to have gone back and eaten several more times.

As the other reviews say, family run, great quality of dishes, nice atmosphere, excellent service and great pricing.

Will be dreaming of this place whenever we think of thai food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Allison B Campbell

sample_reviews_en.text:
YOU MUST come and eat here. Everything is just perfect!!! The ambience? Full of green and nice decorations. The service? fast and friendly…but the food?? Wow!!!
I was about to cry when I had the first bite to my shrimp panang curry. Honestly, its the best dish I have eaten in Thailand and also one of the best of my life!! Just so tasty, creamy, full of umami!
My bf got the Tom yum and was very happy with it it. The smothies were very refreshing and tasty too.
Make yourself a favour and come and eat here. It’s great for your belly, soul and wallet!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ameda A

sample_reviews_en.text:
2025 update . The Penang curry chicken is probably the best I’ve had in Thailand ! Pineapple chicken cashew nut fried rice also tasty.  Cold fresh coconuts too.

2023. Lovely Thai local homecooked meal in pretty setting In the lanes .  They have seating with fans under sheltered area to stay cool whilst sat outdoors. Felt very authentic, and prices reasonable.  We had the curry and would love to come back again. The fried green curry rice was delicious and great value at 60 baht. Large cold chang beer at 89 baht. Friendly owners.
sample_reviews_en.author: MNML journey

sample_reviews_en.text:
A few steps off the main canal road, tucked into a quiet alley — just follow the signs and you’ll find it. The place sits in a cute little garden where you can chill in the shade. The menu is quite extensive, and the photos of each dish make choosing easier.

Went for the Thai sukiyaki soup with shrimp and seafood. So flavorful, packed with shrimp, and the spicy sauce on the side hits just right. Added a Som Tam Thai and a watermelon smoothie — perfect combo.

Friendly staff, great service. Definitely worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Farangondiet

sample_reviews_en.text:
The place I aimed for was closed so we came here as a second option and I haven’t checked the menu previously as I usually do, being vegan I like to know what to expect. The menu was in pictures, hard to understand exactly what is what, but the waiter is glad to explain and give recommendations. I ordered a vegetable fried rice without the egg, he asked if i wanted tofu with it :)) always nice.
Food was good, nothing crazy, but not too fatty, good size portion and I really enjoyed the atmosphere!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tainá Oliveira

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went there for lunch and loved the cheap prices and tasty food so the next 3 meals we went there for take away 🤩 As we we’re staying at Centra by Centara Hotel was very convenient, it’s super close. We paid 50THB for a delicious chicken fried rice, with the extra homemade spicy sauce that we loved too (on the side)

Water melon 🍉 juice is one of the bests we had in Southeast Asia! And the staff is very kind.

200% recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Fabiana Saraiva

restaurants.name: Jackson
restaurants.address:

110 Soi Samran Rat, Khwaeng Samran Rat, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A fantastic steak restaurant.
The best steak in Bangkok city.
Jack, the owner, knows everyone around me... truly amazing.
This restaurant has been talked about for a long time for its grilled meat.
Five years since opening, and I only just got to visit, and I have to say to myself, "Why did I wait so long? 🤣"
It's seriously delicious... lives up to the hype.
Each plate of meat, each cut grilled to perfection... is incredibly juicy.
And the prices are very reasonable.
Nine of us came and ordered nine large plates of grilled meat / four servings of spaghetti / three chicken wings / one mixed sausage platter... after deducting the corkage fee of 1000 baht (6 bottles), we were left with a little over 7000 baht. Less than 800 baht per person, and we were all full.
Highly recommended.
But you need to make a reservation. It's a small restaurant, but the quality is top-notch.
Ten out of ten! 👍💪
sample_reviews_en.author: Neng Bunyaruch

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had an unforgettable experience at Jackson Steakhouse, truly the best steak I’ve ever had! Every bite was cooked to perfection, and you can really taste the care and quality that goes into the food.

What made it even more special was the owner, who is also the chef. He was so warm and welcoming, and took the time to share the story behind opening the restaurant, which made the whole experience feel personal and meaningful.

The craft Thai beer was also amazing and that’s coming from someone who doesn’t usually drink! Everything about this place, from the food to the atmosphere to the hospitality, was top-notch.

Such a kind, genuine place with incredible food. Easily one of the best dining experiences we’ve ever had in Bangkok or anywhere for that matter.
Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Allison Vega

sample_reviews_en.text:
Britpop meets beef steak was the pleasant surprise I got when I called into Jackson last week.

Located just around the corner from one of my fave bars, Tai Soon, Jackson was packed with diners - most enjoying steak and the great music (Manic Street Preachers, Pulp, Suede, and more) pumping on the stereo.

My pork chop was seasoned perfectly and the accompanying apple sauce hit the spot! While portions are not mega, the meal prices are very reasonable so big eaters may need to order more.

My big eating days are over and my fish was perfectly fine for me. I will return with more folks to try more dishes. Oh and shout out to the restaurant owners - they have great taste in music and film posters and it all adds up to providing a rock n roll steak dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Meng Yee

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Reel Taste of Home – Where Cinema Meets Steak”

Walking into this steakhouse feels like stepping onto a movie set — vintage film posters on the walls, warm spotlight lighting, and a cozy cinematic charm that instantly sets the mood. It’s a dream come true for movie lovers who also appreciate the comforting aroma of sizzling steak. In my own opinion as The X-files fan, the poster with the caption “I want to believe” means a lot to me.

The ambiance strikes the perfect balance between stylish and homey. But the real star of the show? The steak. Perfectly grilled, juicy, and full of flavor — it has that homemade touch that feels both comforting and indulgent. Each bite reminds you of a classic you can’t get enough of.
sample_reviews_en.author: B Wisoot (BumbleBee)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came here several times with friends and was happy every time I visited !!
Highly recommended for anyone who are craving for a good steak but don’t mind for a fancy atmosphere or five stars service.
This is a very friendly feeling restaurant, the owner are very kind, the waiters are nice, and the overall place is clean.
For the food, I think the meats selection is superb, there are various cuts of meat and the quality is also good, the crust on the steak is perfect !!! The gravy, the mash, coleslaw, and salad, everything is delicious (except the fries I think  there’s a strange smell like oil or margarine that’s quite off for me)

Please reserve table in advance
Ps. Don’t miss krapao beef here !!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bhaksook Charoonsak

sample_reviews_en.text: This place offers a casual and unpretentious atmosphere, specializing in steak and craft beer. The friendly staff and owner add to the welcoming vibe. The prime cut steak, generously portioned at around 350 grams, is reasonably priced at approximately 600 baht. They serve a beef Gapao rice dish for 95 baht. The craft beer selection includes a Weizen and Pilsner, both priced at a remarkable 89 baht per glass. The Weizen has a unique aroma, slightly different from European-made Weizens, which may vary in personal preference. Bringing your own wine with a corkage fee of 100 baht seems like a good way to enjoy the steak.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gourmet Advisor

sample_reviews_en.text:
Guess they were slammed when we visited, the first dish took 35 minutes.

We ordered two dishes, a pasta 'godfather' combo and a sirloin steak.

The pasta was salty in one part and the other lacked taste. The chicken schnitzel had a little smell.

The sirloin was cooked well, albeit a tad overly seasoned. The dips were interesting. The potato was an unremarkable mush, and so was the salad.

The beer was great though, at 90 baht too, though we had to ask twice before they poured a glass for us.

All in all, there was probably something good going on there, we probably caught them on an off-night.
sample_reviews_en.author: Than Raskul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fantastic hidden gem in an old town side of Bangkok! Located at pratu phee area in a small alley. The restaurant itself is small with limited tables so you may want to book if you go in a large group.

The food is incredible and affordable! I ate there twice and will definitely keep going back for different dishes. I’m so keen to try the beef steak soon

Chicken wings, fries, Caesar salad and spaghetti are all delicious!

Service can be a bit slow during dinner time but it’s worth the wait I can assure you

I notice a nearby parking place for 30 baht per hour too
sample_reviews_en.author: Jidapa Samphunjaroen

restaurants.name: ร้านอาหารเจ๊จุ๋ม สาขาลูก (Bang Kachao Restaurant)
restaurants.address:

111 หมู่ 4 33 Phetchahung Rd, Bang Kachao, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I LOVE THIS PLACE!!!!! I ordered Pad See Ew and it was the best I've ever had!! (Not too oily!!!) The atmosphere was so comfortable, relaxing and casual. The owner was the best part of the experience aside from the amazing food. Her English is so good and shes incredibly warm and friendly! It's just her working so it feels like you're at an Aunty's house being taken care of. The prices are soooo reasonable, it's really a great value! You have to stop here if you're in the area!! Even after my bike ride to the floating market, I came back a second time to order another Pad See Ew to go for dinner.
I'll be back for sure!
sample_reviews_en.author: Brooke Noriega

sample_reviews_en.text:
👍🏻
1) Operator single-handedly prepared and cooked the tasty meals
2) Simple menu, almost what Thai would have for meals
3) Met two Thais having lunch there, guess must be something that suits their taste bud
4) Friendly services (like how most Thais are)
5) The cuisine taste more like a meal that a grandmother or mother will cook when the children are back at home.  So TLDR, it is very home cook feel
6) Reasonable prices
7) the operator invited us to open the large fridge and find the drinks we want, like returning home and get a drink feel!
8) the operator could cook up the meals really fast
sample_reviews_en.author: Samuel Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: A lovely lunch spot for me after a long walk around the green lung. The owner/chef was friendly and welcoming, and took my order in very good English. It's situated in a pretty garden with lots of fans around for comfort. Of course the food is an important but, and in this case I had a tasty meal of beef noodle soup with a side of rice and egg for 65 baht, which seems like one of the best deals I've got in Bangkok. Would definitely recommend this to anyone biking around the Green Lung or visiting the nearby Ganesha temple.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gavin Thomas

sample_reviews_en.text: We were the first to arrive on a Thursday afternoon. The food was delicious and the atmosphere was so nice. A cool breeze and outdoor seating style. The place was very clean you could eat off the floor. We rode our bikes from the green lung, about a 6 minute bike ride. The food was the most delicious by far since we have been in Thailand. Would come again! Hospitality was great as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kevin G

sample_reviews_en.text: Best food we have had in Bangkok. We have eaten at Michelin star restaurants and this has been the best meal we had. Stuffed and buzzed for 220 Baht. We had the pleasure of experiencing Jum’s hospitality, she is an amazing chef and this place deserves to be put on the map. We will be back here in our travels returning to Bangkok. This is a true Thailand experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Connor Ramsay

sample_reviews_en.text:
Such a lovely gem of a place, totally worth together with a nice bike ride through the area. The food is amazing, basically made from scratch for you, the lady is real nice.

All options can be made vegetarian on request. I noticed the portions are on the small side so I ordered a double portion and it was just right. Prices are very decent for the quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bobby

sample_reviews_en.text: So happy to have found this place. Open-air, local vibe, Thai girls enjoying a day out, a few foreigners passing by. The chef cooks right in the middle, and her granddaughter runs the service in great English. Food is excellent, family-style but also delicate and well crafted. Easily one of the best spots to eat in Bangkok’s green lung 🌿❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Jordy Meow (Offbeat Japan)

sample_reviews_en.text: An extremely kind and welcoming host. She reopened the shop for us even though it had just closed. On top of that, she rode her scooter to the next stall and brought us back two ice-cold beers. I’ve honestly never experienced such amazing service. The Pad Thai was the best I’ve had so far in Thailand. I’ll definitely be coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maximilian Rothfuss

restaurants.name: Aunty’s Wok PhayaThai อาหารตามสั่ง
restaurants.address:

69/44 Phaya Thai Rd, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
As everyone's posts suggested, we went there hoping to eat delicious Tom Yum Goong.

We shared Tom Yum Goong, Thai fried rice, and fried noodles between the two of us. First, the noodles were brought out, and we were told to season them ourselves with a soy sauce base. One bite and it was delicious!! Next came the Tom Yum Goong, which had large shrimp in it. One bite and it was... oh, oh, delicious!! I was thrilled. Finally, the fried rice arrived and was mild and delicious. Everything was delicious and very satisfying. The three dishes cost 270 baht.

They only had canned soda or water for drinks, so we didn't order anything this time.

The taste didn't disappoint, thank you!

There really wasn't a sign for the restaurant, which made me a little uneasy, but thanks to someone who posted a picture of the exterior, we were able to find it. I'd be happy if this could help someone else, so I also took a picture of the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: ひめ

sample_reviews_en.text:
There is parking available.
No air conditioning.
There are many tables, but it's quite crowded, mostly with foreigners. However, the food is served quickly.
Good service. The staff (aunties/older women) are very kind.
The food tastes very good, rich and flavorful, "but not spicy at all." It might not suit Thai tastes. Asking them to add more spice will make it even better.
Every dish is made fresh. We ordered a fried egg, and they fried it fresh for us. The auntie even asked if we wanted the yolk cooked or not, which was very attentive.
The prices aren't cheap. Tom Yum Fried Rice with Shrimp (only three shrimp, one plate isn't enough to fill you up, you'll need to order something else to eat as well) is 110 baht. Stir-fried morning glory without meat is 90 baht. But it's still okay.

-There's no sign with the restaurant name in front. Walk in from the front entrance of the condo on the right side, almost to the end.-
sample_reviews_en.author: Koi Roi

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small restaurant run by a friendly and kind grandmother. There were a lot of foreigners (Chinese), about 80-90% of the customers on the day I went (4/5/69).
Food - The taste was perfectly balanced and delicious. They use good quality ingredients. The stir-fried morning glory was especially amazing; the sauce coated it well without being too salty, and the vegetables remained crispy.
Dishes I ate - Drunken Noodles with Wide Rice Noodles, Stir-fried Morning Glory with Chili (the restaurant doesn't make it spicy, so those who like spicy food might need to let them know).
sample_reviews_en.author: Denkamon Jamjaeng

sample_reviews_en.text:
By Taiwanese standards, the mild spice level is quite palatable and delicious; you could even have it a bit spicier. For the price, the taste is worthwhile. It feels like a long-established local restaurant, and the staff seem to be experienced and granny (sorry if any aunties are reading this). How bad could the food here possibly be?

Personally, if you're in the area, I think you should try this old-school restaurant. I had a great time, and the atmosphere is nostalgic. If you're between 40 and 60 years old, you'll definitely find it relatable.
sample_reviews_en.author: pika hsu

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's friendly and delicious..

The seasoning isn't too strong, and the prices are reasonable.

I want to come back here again♡

For this price, this friendliness, and the atmosphere are very good.

It's the perfect place for Koreans on their first trip who are hesitant about Thai food because it's too old-fashioned and they worry about hygiene or strong flavors. It's great for those who want to try an old-school Thai place but are a bit scared to go to a restaurant with such reasonable prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: dawoon jeong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pork is just like the Korean palate, and I also tried Tom Yum Kum, and it was quite a flavor that suited the Korean palate. And I didn't eat Pad Thai because I wanted to eat it when I went to Khao San, but I found a really good Khao San Pad Thai restaurant and held on. ㅎㅎㅎ
Morning Glory was very generous and delicious. It was really good.
It was so delicious that I thought about going back for dinner.
sample_reviews_en.author: -영

sample_reviews_en.text: First, the shop has no sign board. The shop number is 69/44. If you are looking for grandma taste, this shop definitely can fulfil you. The Tomyam is come with coconut milk style. Is very flavourful! The fried egg is just ordinary fried egg but very crispy and the oil is fresh oil. The pork taste so Thai style where I can’t get from other place. Highly recommend. Lastly the price is so so so affordable!
sample_reviews_en.author: wen xian soon

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is Bangkok food at its absolute best.

Run by an incredible crew of aunties who have been firing up their woks side-by-side for nearly twenty years, the place has an infectious energy and rhythm you simply can’t fake.
The food is pure, uncompromising, and packed with serious authentic flavors cooked exactly as they should be, with no shortcuts.
We loved the aunties.
A 100% recommendation!
sample_reviews_en.author: Karl Bontenackels

restaurants.name: Burger King - Bangchak South Pattaya Inbound (Drive thru)
restaurants.address:

Sukhumvit Rd, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my favorite place, but I won't order food from the touch screen.
Edit April 2026: Still won't order food from the touch screen.
sample_reviews_en.author: JBear Bear

sample_reviews_en.text: The place is clean, the service is excellent, and the organization and management within the store are very well-systematic.
sample_reviews_en.author: กฤษณะ ปานกุล

sample_reviews_en.text: Come by whenever you're hungry, it's very convenient. The staff are also very friendly and provide excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom Avenue

sample_reviews_en.text: Branch located at a gas station on Sukhumvit Road, near the South Pattaya intersection.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kriengsak Woraurai

restaurants.name: Kunshine Hotpot Buffet
restaurants.address:

233 Sukhumvit Rd, คลองเตยเหนือ Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Mala Shabu restaurant is located in the building next to Robinson's.
It's on the 2nd floor, and the staircase is a bit small.

It's an all-inclusive shabu buffet (soup base + dipping sauce bar).
There are several tiers to choose from.
Unlimited smoothies are an extra 59 baht, but the buffet actually includes free longan juice (you have to ask; the staff didn't mention it at first).

The ingredients are good, the vegetables are fresh and clean.
The pork comes in large slices, but be warned, everything is served in very large portions.
For example, one serving of pork has 10 pieces, more than any other place I've ever eaten at.

The mala broth is intensely flavorful, and the pork bone broth is savory.
The dipping sauce bar is well-stocked, and on the day I went, they had fried shrimp and fruit available.
There's also self-serve ice cream.
Plus, you can order snacks like fried mantou.

The staff provides good service, and the place is spacious.
It wasn't crowded or noisy.
You can order for 2 hours and eat for 2.5 hours, which is good value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichsaran Ves

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a great experience at Kunshine Hotpot Buffet in Asok! The meat was fresh, thinly sliced, and there was a really good variety to choose from. I especially liked being able to try different soup bases and dipping sauces. The portions were generous, and everything came out looking fresh and well prepared.

The restaurant itself is clean, comfortable, and nicely decorated. For an all-you-can-eat hotpot in Bangkok, I thought the quality and value were excellent. Definitely a good spot to come with friends or as a couple when you’re hungry. Would come back again! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: Ryan Wu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very disappointing experience.
We had to wait around 20 minutes just to receive the soup base after being seated. After placing our order, the meat and other food items took about 30 minutes to arrive—and that is not an exaggeration.
On top of the long wait times, the service was not what we expected. Staff seemed inattentive, and overall the dining experience was frustrating rather than enjoyable.
The food may be decent, but the extremely slow service and poor customer experience made this visit disappointing. Unfortunately, we would not return
sample_reviews_en.author: Nyan Lin Htet

sample_reviews_en.text: This post is for those who will not eat later. The service is extremely bad. After sitting for an hour, nothing came. When I told the staff, they ignored me and didn't even do anything. The food policy is the worst in the buffet. I have never seen such a bad restaurant that takes money. I sat for an hour and left. In my life, BUI students should boycott such a shabby restaurant. If you eat because you are hungry, you will have to come back without eating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paye Sone Tun

sample_reviews_en.text: there was many options for hotpot soup, I tried 3 -> they were okay, but the flavours do not stand out. They had quite a few great quality meats, and many options for sure. The taste was good, but the buffet is also a bit pricey. As for the service, the servers were very helpful, they even made good sauce to dip for us on request, but the orders came out very slow so we had to wait a bit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunny

sample_reviews_en.text:
Right next to Asok BTS and beside Terminal 21.
Great variety of fresh ingredients, from thinly sliced meats to crisp vegetables. The broths were flavorful and customizable, with spicy and mild options to suit everyone. Service was attentive, and the all-you-can-eat format made it fun and satisfying. Perfect spot for group dining — come hungry!
sample_reviews_en.author: Khaing Sabai Maung

sample_reviews_en.text:
Definitely not coming back again. Our order hasn’t come even after we finished dinner, it is strange that not too many people in restaurant, but everything comes very slow, even the dipping sauce we need to wait for half hour, not recommended at all.

The only positive thing is the taste, but the kitchen service is nightmare.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yo Alex

sample_reviews_en.text: We really enjoyed it! This was our first time having hotpot and it was a great first time! The service was fantastic and Jack helped us out a lot and explained everything well. The food itself is delicious; tasty soup, a lot of variety in vegetables and meat, and the meat is very tasty! The atmosphere was also great!
sample_reviews_en.author: Christina Boelens

restaurants.name: Tulum Skybar
restaurants.address:

559 Soi Sukhumvit 63, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited Tulum Skybar with high expectations, and at first, it really delivered on the atmosphere. The interior and decoration are beautiful — the space feels vibrant, stylish, and truly inviting. It’s the kind of place that makes you want to settle in, celebrate, and enjoy the evening. The cocktails were also well done — I had a margarita, and it was properly balanced and enjoyable.

Service was decent overall, though at times a bit too eager, as staff tried to clear plates while we were still eating. Not a major issue, but noticeable.

Unfortunately, the biggest disappointment was the food. Thankfully, we only ordered starters and didn’t proceed to mains. The nachos were completely bland, lacking any real flavor — even plain nacho chips have more taste. The salsa didn’t resemble a proper salsa at all, which was quite surprising. The beef tacos were overloaded with onions to the point that they were difficult to eat, and the chicken tacos were just odd overall — both in flavor and smell, which was off-putting.

In the end, it’s a place with a fantastic vibe and good drinks, but the food seriously needs improvement to match the setting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gabrielė Tepliakovaitė

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came after dinner with my partner and we really enjoyed the place. The vibe really hits us — it feels like a stylish tropical jungle hideaway floating above Bangkok. The iconic Mayan-inspired sculptures dominate the space, paired with lush greenery, thatched lanterns and warm ambient lighting. Together they create such a unique and relaxing atmosphere. It doesn’t feel like a typical rooftop bar at all.

At night the city lights look beautiful, and the energy is lively but still comfortable. DJs play a good mix of deep house, Latin and tropical beats that keep the place buzzing without being too loud or chaotic.

The cocktails are excellent, creative, well-balanced and perfect for a post-dinner session. We also shared some Mexican-inspired bites — the tacos and ceviche were fresh and full of flavour.

Staff were friendly, attentive and made the whole experience even better.

Great place for good drinks, a distinctive vibe and a relaxed-but-fun atmosphere after dinner.
sample_reviews_en.author: SoniThai

sample_reviews_en.text:
We waited at least 10 minutes before anyone came to ask if we wanted a drink, there were two tables that came in after us with there drinks already and had ordered food.I had to ask if we could get served and was told to wait a minute, finally we ordered. The food came out at separate times I had nearly finished my tiny steak then the rest of the food arrived. We had repeatedly asked for drinks, we were not waited on at all.
The security guard was more of a waiter.
He asked quite a few times if we were ok and if we needed anything.
We had dessert and then asked for the bill .
I was shocked at the prices of the food and drinks. Can’t fault the atmosphere and music but the service was unacceptable especially when you’re paying extortionate prices.
The venue itself is great but it didn’t feel as if we were high up in the sky as there wasn’t much of a view at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adam Nicholls

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited Tulum Skybar and had a great time overall! The ambience and decoration are fantastic, creating a vibrant and inviting atmosphere. The food was delicious, and the DJ playing that night was excellent—it's been a while since I’ve heard such great music. It made me want to dance, but unfortunately, there isn’t a dedicated dancing space, except for during the performance.

The seating arrangements, however, weren't ideal. The round small tables didn’t work well for dining as a couple or watching the performance comfortably. Additionally, there was an issue with the flow of the meal. I received my main course before the starter, which disrupted the dining experience a bit.

As for the performance, it was average that night, but I’m definitely looking forward to coming back to experience the full vibe again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zaza Meerveld

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tulum Skybar is a nice rooftop bar with a great atmosphere, good music, and beautiful views of Bangkok. It's a lovely place to relax with a drink and enjoy the evening.

The drinks are a bit expensive compared to other places in Bangkok, but that's fairly typical for a rooftop venue.

One thing to keep in mind is the seating. If it's raining, you'll be seated indoors, where there isn't much of a view. If the weather is good, you can sit outside, but many of the tables don't directly overlook the skyline, so you may need to stand up or walk to the edge to fully enjoy the view.

Overall, it's a pleasant rooftop experience with a great vibe, especially if you're there for the atmosphere rather than just the view.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mario Khoury

sample_reviews_en.text: A very beautiful restaurant with a pleasant atmosphere and music, but we have a lot of questions about the service. The service charge was already included in the bill, but when the waiter brought the bill, he persistently asked how we would like to leave a tip—in cash or by card—on top of the bill (which already included the service charge). Our bill was almost 4,000 baht, so my man paid in cash and asked for 200 baht in change, leaving the rest as a tip. A short while later, the waiter returned, holding out 40 baht and asking if he really needed the 200 baht. It was an incredibly strange atmosphere of begging and attempts to cheat us, and it left a bad impression.
sample_reviews_en.author: Анна Харлова

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited on a Sunday evening and took our Thai family. The food varied in portion size quite drastically from 3 small tacos to a huge Caesar salad. The service was really slow and the waiter was trying his best but it was clear he was assigned to too many tabled. The DJ and atmosphere was great but like the other reviews smoking was allowed around the food. The cocktails were nice around £9 each expected for a rooftop bar. The staff also didn't speak Thai which I guess aludes to this place is for tourists primarily. They had no menus in Thai either.

Overall it was worth it for the experience once but it isn't somewhere to return.
sample_reviews_en.author: G

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had an amazing time at Tulum during our first visit to Bangkok. We ordered the pizza, chicken breast and Mexican style spaghetti and every dish was absolutely delicious. The food was full of flavour and the drinks were incredible.

What made the experience even more special was the outstanding service. The manager Eran treated us like kings and queens from the moment we arrived. His hospitality and attention to detail made us feel truly welcome.

If you are visiting Bangkok for the first time I highly recommend Tulum. Come and experience it for yourself. You will not be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: beelleza

restaurants.name: Sanan Seafood Restaurant
restaurants.address:

101 Kamphaeng Phet Rd, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
#DroppedOffTheKidsAndGoingTo
"Sanan" Restaurant - This meal is a must-try for foodies! 😆🔥
This restaurant has a homey feel, but the cooking is anything but. Seriously, "every dish is amazing!"
It feels so much like having a meal with family.

🥩 Grilled Beef Salad: This is the dish I've been searching for! So hard to find, just like my favorite childhood dish. The grilling is perfect, the meat is tender, juicy, and not dry. Eating it with fresh onions is just right.

🐟 Steamed Snowfish with Soy Sauce: Large fish, firm and fresh meat. The sauce is absorbed into the fish (but this dish is a bit pricey 😆).

🍤 Stir-fried Seafood with Fresh Chili and Rice: Packed with ingredients, lots of shrimp and squid. Spicy and flavorful, you can't stop eating it with rice!

🥟 Crab Claw Rolls: Perfectly crispy, not oily, so enjoyable.

🥩 Fried Liver with Garlic: Soft and not gamey at all. Even those who don't usually eat liver should try this!

P.S. They have a low-sugar choux cream that's delicious. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Vachiraporn Yenchaisith (fonnie lapluie)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today, we arrived at the restaurant around 2:30 PM. There was one table waiting for food before us.
There was one person taking orders.
We were the second table, a group of three, and sat waiting to order.

A third table, consisting of 8-10 people, arrived later and was served first. The person who took their order went through the orders for each person, including food and drinks.

In the end, we went to another restaurant.

We've eaten here before; this wasn't our first time. Normally, they manage the order queue well and are attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: heyday business

sample_reviews_en.text: Was really looking forward to some seafood. Place is supposedly famous for good seafood. Options were plenty. Couldn’t decide between marinated crab, clams or yum trio. Clams weren’t available and I opted for something safe I thought I would love. But the yum trio was quite disappointing tbh. Didn’t look as stunning as the picture and the seasoning had an earthy undertone that I just couldn’t appreciate. Fish was perfectly cooked though
sample_reviews_en.author: Mee-Lin Dawson

sample_reviews_en.text: Have not visited Sanan for years and the restaurant was not busy on Friday evening and plenty of car park. A lot of the item on the menu still there and not significant changes. The big change was the price and taste. The food has gotten more bland than what we remember. The restaurant has gotten run down in interior. They use very dim lights to the point that initially we thought the restaurant was closed
sample_reviews_en.author: Sandee Tour

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old restaurant in this area, it's been open for a very long time. Overall, the food tastes good, but the prices are high. The atmosphere inside is nice, the restaurant isn't very spacious and the tables are quite close together. They also have delicious desserts. Recommended dishes include pork satay, dry rice porridge, and tom yum fish soup.
sample_reviews_en.author: wera

sample_reviews_en.text:
7 Jan 2026 - lunch at Sanan Seafood Restaurant before heading to the airport.

Oyster porridge
Fry egg with black fungus
Stir fry Cabbage
Snow fish with rice noodles
Glass noodles with prawns
Stir fry liver
Toddy palm in pandan juice
Iod chong in Coconut milk
Coconut ice cream with peanuts

Overall rating - 5 stars
sample_reviews_en.author: Adeline Ng

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good seafood focus restaurant tucked away behind Or To Kor market. Steamed fish, dried seafood porridge, and grilled river prawn were fresh and tasty. Price was high, but as expected for the fresh seafood.

Need to park in Or Tor Kor (paid parking) - there is a parking lot next to the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gunn Vanichbuncha

sample_reviews_en.text:
