I only ate two dishes: Chicken Stir-fried Noodles (forgot to take a picture) and Oyster Omelette (I liked it).
Personally, I think the ingredients were very good and fresh. The oysters were large, not fishy or bitter, suitable for those who like natural, relatively mild flavors.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sudtida Tangseraneekul

restaurants.name: After You (Siam Paragon)
restaurants.address:

991 Ground floor Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
No trip to Siam Paragon is complete without stopping by After You. It is incredibly popular for a reason, and their desserts completely live up to the hype. The toast is legendary—crispy and buttery on the outside, incredibly fluffy on the inside, and paired perfectly with vanilla ice cream and warm syrup. It is pure comfort food. The Strawberry & Mango Bingsu (shaved ice) are equally amazing. The ice is as fine as snow, creamy, and hiding a delicious surprise layer of cake/cream inside, all topped with a rich strawberry sauce. However, the wait times can be brutal. Because it's located inside a major shopping mall, you often have to grab a ticket and wait 30–45 minutes just to get a table.
Absolutely worth the calories and the wait if you love premium desserts!
sample_reviews_en.author: NGUYEN DOAN NGOC ANH

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten at several After You branches and the quality has always been excellent. The branch in Siam Paragon is no exception; the space is clean and the seating is quite comfortable.

This time I ordered Baby Milo Kakigori, Royal Thai Milk Tea, Hong Kong Milk Tea, and Pink Lemonade Americano. The bingsu was smooth, not too sweet, and delicious. I especially liked the Thai milk tea; it had a rich aroma, just the right amount of creaminess, exactly to my liking. The other drinks were also quite good.

The staff were enthusiastic and served quickly despite the large number of customers. I stopped here to relax while waiting for my flight to the airport, and it felt very relaxing. If I have the chance to return to Bangkok, I will definitely visit After You again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tan Tai Nguyen

sample_reviews_en.text: Favorite bingsu place! Ordered a strawberry shortcake bingsu, was pleasantly enjoying the bingsu to find a layer of strawberry shortcake underneath; a surprise I’ve been expecting after finding mango sticky rice under the mango sticky rice kakigori! Great snow soft shaved ice alongside the strawberry puree, and the cake was delicious too, a lovely sweet treat. Place is pretty great but seats weren’t the best to hang out for a while. Drinks available at the counter and ready desserts at the fridge. Staff are okay but most of it are done at the cashier, seating and waitlist are usually unorganized. Love the desserts though!
sample_reviews_en.author: jkus eats

sample_reviews_en.text:
After You is a must-visit if you love desserts. The Japanese shaved ice is incredibly light and refreshing—we tried the Strawberry Kakigori and the Mango Sticky Rice Kakigori, and both were absolutely delicious. The French Toast is also excellent, soft, rich, and definitely worth trying, no matter which flavour you choose.
The quality of the desserts is consistently outstanding, and the presentation is beautiful. One thing to note is that the café is cashless, so they only accept card payments.
Overall, it's one of the best dessert cafés I've visited in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ahmad Alhemeiri

sample_reviews_en.text: Tried their pandan coconut bun, and mochi kinako kakigori. The pandan coconut bun feels like pao dough. The filling was nice and generous. Sweetness just right, and the coconut milk makes the flavor more complex. The kakigori itself also nice. There's a mochi on top of the kakigori, and you can pour the brown sugar for a sweetness. Inside the kakigori, you will find red bean and some nuts, which is really nice. Place also nice, and they give you free drink when eating there. 9,8/10 for me.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kenny Kurniawan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Thai tea kakigori is worth the calories and wait for sure. It’s so sinfully delicious. The highlight for me. I tried a few other flavours and some other desserts but this one is the one that I keep ordering.

Had to wait for 20 mins before getting a table so do expect to queue. Expected of most but places in Siam Paragon. If you don’t like waiting, go to another outlet as there are many outlets in Bangkok. Worth it 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: CS

sample_reviews_en.text: Thai food tends to be quite sweet and spicy, so eating bingsu with cake at a shop can be a bit overwhelming and you can't eat much. However, I bought a few boxes of cake to take back to Vietnam as gifts, and when I ate them again, they were incredibly delicious. I craved them so much that the second time I went, I ate two boxes every day and never got tired of them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nguyệt Nguyễn

sample_reviews_en.text: Visited After You Dessert Café at Siam Paragon and had a great experience. The desserts were delicious and beautifully presented. The toast was soft and flavorful, while the shaved ice was refreshing and perfect for Bangkok’s weather. Staff were friendly and service was efficient even though the place was busy. A great spot to take a break while shopping.”
sample_reviews_en.author: jhon paul manalili

restaurants.name: บ้านนม รางน้ำ
restaurants.address:

101 Rang Nam Alley, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400

sample_reviews_th.text: The place is always full of people, but the wait isn't long. The food is delicious, and the hygiene is excellent. I feel at ease every time I eat here. It's near Santiภาพ Park, so after your run, you can come here for a milkshake to recharge. 🥰
sample_reviews_th.author: Warakul Naweepattana

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd call it a hidden gem. I've worked in this area for over ten years and passed by the shop many times, but never tried it. I finally did because I was having a group gathering nearby and needed dessert. I have to say, the custard is incredibly delicious! It's the real deal, not fake. My recommended menu item is the "Pang Na Na Thong" (a type of bread with coconut milk topping). It's amazing! Recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dave Chokchai

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is near my house but I've never eaten there before. Today I wanted a change of scenery, so I stopped by. The pandan custard was delicious! Made with real fresh milk, not too sweet. The atmosphere was nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongsuriya Sema

sample_reviews_en.text: "Baan Nom now sells fresh coffee! 😊 Today I tried an iced latte and it was delicious, not too sweet or too bitter, just perfect for sipping. I finished it all already! (The cup is a little small though 😁)"
sample_reviews_en.author: Pande Tassaneeya

sample_reviews_en.text: I had an incredibly delicious toast with sweetened condensed milk and can absolutely recommend it 😍 In general, the menu looks very promising; making a decision was very difficult.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarah Jahns

sample_reviews_en.text: This milk and bread shop is on Rangnam Road, opposite King Power. Their custard-filled bread is delicious, fragrant, and not too sweet. The service is good and the shop is clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: too tatsanai

sample_reviews_en.text: There are hot milk, cold milk, milk shakes, toast and custard on the menu. There are many menus. The taste is good and the price is not expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukhonta M.

sample_reviews_en.text: Hot milk with bread dipped in kaya jam is a delicious combination. The kaya jam isn't too sweet, perfect for those who prefer less sweetness.
sample_reviews_en.author: thm.r diia

restaurants.name: Namo Kitchen
restaurants.address:

128 ถนนดินสอ แขวงบวรนิเวศ บวรนิเวศ Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Safe Zone restaurant has been a favorite of mine since high school, and I still frequent it as an adult. Their food is authentic home-style, without MSG. The owner and staff are all very friendly and provide excellent service, always bringing back fond memories

SW105 รายงานตัว🤫
sample_reviews_th.author: A Dapawi

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my go-to restaurant. No matter how many times I eat here, the taste is always consistent.

There's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, the food is delicious, and the owner always provides excellent service. They're very friendly and welcoming.

The fried pork set meal (95 THB) is my favorite since childhood. The taste is still the same – the pork is crispy and delicious, the rice is good, and it comes with soup, a refreshing tangy salad, and fruit juice.

I recommend parking at the Bangkok City Hall parking lot (there's a parking fee), it's not far from where I used to be.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cherry Ja

sample_reviews_en.text: Tom yum was very good. It had a fairly light broth and I personally like it quite silkier but it had all the right flavours and was tasty. In terms of the filings, it had shrimp and mushrooms, and the shrimps tasted fresh and had the right texture. The portion size was not large. The staff were very friendly and welcoming. The toilet was not properly separated from the kitchen which felt a bit weird. Overall all it’s a good place to try authentic Tom Yum but personally I’d try to search for another place serving my favourite silky coconut-rich texture next time
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexey Subach

sample_reviews_en.text: I made a great discovery with this restaurant. The dishes are good and satisfying, without being overly fancy. The pad thai was perfect. For dessert, I had the waffle with ice cream. And there too, I received excellent service. The restaurant is peaceful. They have Wi-Fi. And frankly, if I were going to eat and then do some work on my computer, this is where I would go. The menu is in English, and the lady speaks English well. Perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ju L

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent Thai Food. We where here three times alltogether. Thai people go here for lunch or dinner as well. The food is very fresh and deliciously prepared. We had Thai red curry with spuces and chicken and also the famous Pad Thai with shrimps 🍤 After three times we can easily recommend this little and very friendly restaurant. A pitty we do not have Thai food with that quality back home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Martin Stromeyer

sample_reviews_en.text: Cosy restaurant close to the democracy monument. We tried the vegetarian spring rolls, chicken pad Thai and fried rice with chicken - all were really tasty with good portion size and inexpensive. The owners and their family are also very kind and the service is friendly. Super clean and the AC here is perfect for a hot day. Highly recommend
sample_reviews_en.author: Holly Harvey

sample_reviews_en.text: Homemade Thai food. We went three times for lunch or dinner because it was close to our hotel. There was a good selection, quality food, and just the right amount of food. Most importantly, it clearly indicated on the menu if it was spicy (handy for tourists like us who don't like chili!). Excellent service and value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vérane LE GOFF

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice restaurant with a chilled atmosphere. Very friendly staff and owner. It looks to be a family owned restaurant. It’s a small place but quite cosy. Tasty food. I personally went for vegetable springs rolls and the chicken fried rice with raisins and egg. It did hit the spot 😇👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Sufyan Al-Jeadah

restaurants.name: Samsen Villa - Phyathai
restaurants.address:

49/2 Set Siri Rd, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant serves authentic chilled beer. The portions aren't large, but the food tastes good. It's an indoor, air-conditioned space. They offer a variety of spirits and wines, with reasonably priced wines and bottled beer starting at 150 baht. They also have cakes and pastries. The staff provides good service.

Food prices are on the higher side, and there's a 10% service charge and 7% VAT.

P.S. It was quite busy when I went (7 PM), and I had to wait for my rice to cook. 😅
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawarisa Boonkoy

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was incredibly delicious! The crispy pork with fish sauce was tender, fragrant, and not greasy at all. Eating it made me think of my loved ones (I wish they could have enjoyed this delicious food too 😊). The staff provided excellent service, and the food came out quickly; we didn't have to wait long. The owner, an elderly lady, was very welcoming and chatted with customers throughout the meal. We'll definitely be back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Feony

sample_reviews_en.text:
Samsen Villa - Phyathai
Samsen Villa
November 8, 1968 Back to this restaurant again.
I wanted to eat crispy catfish salad so I came to this restaurant...they make it delicious.
Recommended dishes today I ordered...
Sun-dried squid, asked for seafood dipping sauce, so spicy!
Spicy snail curry, a real highlight!
Come here! Five stars, no deductions. Plenty of parking along the train tracks.
#TasteWithCher
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirawat Shinawatrawangso

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious with a wide variety of choices. The traditional Thai music was lovely, and the staff provided excellent service. The only minor issue was that when it started raining after we finished eating, there was no staff member to offer an umbrella or escort us to our car; they just stood there waiting to flag down a parking spot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyaphan Hovilailux

sample_reviews_en.text:
Some dishes are just okay, while others are incredibly delicious!
For example, the grilled beef, pork satay, and fried pork belly are a must-try. The good points are that there's a private room with air conditioning and parking available, although it's just a short walk past the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chatchanok Sirirattanawong

sample_reviews_en.text: The food of this restaurants are still good as like in my childhood. The price is increase more than before with service charge, which I am not so happy with the service at all. There are few parking close to the restaurant so you have to park close to the railway area nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: Umporn Athikom

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great restaurant, delicious food, and excellent service. Try any dish you like; everything is truly delicious.

Especially the spicy snail curry (though I didn't get a chance to take a picture!).
sample_reviews_en.author: Petch Kruapanich

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a family-run restaurant. The food is delicious and flavorful, with plenty of parking. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, perfect for families, couples, and gatherings.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumalee Ong

restaurants.name: TALES ME MORE
restaurants.address:

อยู่บริเวณสวนรถไฟ Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food, great atmosphere, and excellent service. Personally, I love the yellow curry, pineapple fried rice, spicy minced meat salad, salmon salad, and seafood steamed in young coconut. I like so many things I can't list them all! I go to this restaurant at least twice a month; I'm addicted! I highly recommend it. Some nights I stay until almost 10-11 PM – it's so relaxing! The prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kornrat Dharaphop

sample_reviews_en.text:
It is close to my office, it is the go to place for after your dinner and drink.

Food is good and some are above average. My favorite is the Kang Gung. Fried Shrimp Head. It is the perfect companion to your beer.

The Grilled Beef with Wasabi is also good. Pork Leg. German sausage. Esaan Sausage. Crispy Pork Belly with Salt and Chilli. They have live music too until 8PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: sagita suwandi

sample_reviews_en.text: Outstanding. They don’t speak much English but with a bit of google translate they will bend over backwards to help you. Their food is outstanding and the portions are very big. Highly recommend .. the view and the location alone are worth it but the extra care and attention have earned them all the stars. Thank you so much ..
sample_reviews_en.author: Michelle Bes

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a great atmosphere in the railway park. The food is delicious, with many options to choose from. There's also music playing. The prices might seem a bit high, but the portions are generous and worth the price. Alcohol is also available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leonardo Jackman

sample_reviews_en.text: If you are planning to have a walk in the park day, then you could stop over and have a meal with a lake view. The food wasn't as tasty as I hoped it would be, but guess for the price and view, it's fine to just grab a meal or have a drink perhaps
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Meng

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is located by the lake in the railway park. The atmosphere is great, the food tastes good, and you can enjoy a cold beer while admiring the view of the railway park. Good night to anyone who's in the area!
sample_reviews_en.author: Talk Around By ทนายต้อ -

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mocca Hot 🔥 The coffee tastes good and has a nice aroma.
Rainbow ice cream 🌈 tastes good.
The shop has a beautiful atmosphere, the air-conditioned room is cool, and the riverside atmosphere is great.
sample_reviews_en.author: ฝนฉัตร เมตตพันธุ์

sample_reviews_en.text: Ploynaree Tales Me More, a restaurant in the Chatuchak area, is located in Bangkok and has delicious food and a great atmosphere. 🍽️🍽️🍽️ #CountryBoyVisitsTheCity
sample_reviews_en.author: issarac

restaurants.name: Mo-Mo-Paradise Terminal 21 Rama 3
restaurants.address:

Floor 1, 356 Rama III Rd, Bang Khlo, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It is a famous shabu in BKK. So it is often crowded.

The quality was good as always. I ate pork only, and it never disappointed me.
Ice cream and daifuku all flavours were great too. But my favorite would be rice-something ice cream, and custard daifuku.

The service was so-so since they were too busy. So it's not like I expect they to be much better. So 4* does make sense.

Atmosphere, it's up to how many people were there. When there're so many people, the shop was too narrow to walk pass each other. Some family even let their kids walk around. In the buffet shop where there's time limit, we should expect that everyone would be in a hurry. So you shouldn't just let your kids walk around without taking care of them not to get in the way of other people
sample_reviews_en.author: Mae Hame

sample_reviews_en.text:
Since Momo Paradise first opened, many branches have sprung up here and there, making it easy to visit.

However, this Rama 3 branch at Terminal 21 is my favorite of all the locations👍

One thing I notice every time I visit is that, above all else, the staff here seem to be the friendliest.

They take orders immediately and are quite efficient at handling things.

Some days the tomatoes are incredibly sweet and delicious, while other days the green onions are tasty and the vegetables are fresh and well-selected, which is very satisfying. The meat is also of high quality. 🍅🥬🥕🥓

The lines aren't as long as at other branches, so you can save time waiting, and there is plenty of parking space within the shopping mall itself.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nikoniko Thai (니코니코 타이)

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is great restaurant for shabu buffet. The restaurant is decorated in Japanese style which give very good atmosphere for having shabu-shabu. Despite the large number of employees, the staff isn't very productive even though there is a lot of staff, sometimes they just group up and don’t focus on customer. Even though it's a buffet restaurant, the food is of fairly high quality. However, there are only two options are available for beef and pork, and only one for duck and pork. and one for duck and pork. Additionally, there are numerous options for drinks and vegetables that can be self-served. shabu lovers should definitely try this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chawit P.

sample_reviews_en.text: Best dinner in Thailand! We spotted this place full of local people and decided to try it, and what a great experience! Beam, our waitress, was super kind and explained us how the buffet works even demonstrating the process for us, which we were so grateful for. You get a heating system at the table and two soups where you can cook all your vegetables, meats, and noodles, at your own choice. Drinks and dessert included. Top-notch! Thanks again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Natalia BA

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious Shabu Shabu / Sukiyaki Japanese restaurant. Value for money buffet! Very delicious. There are 3 choices of soups that you can choose from. All the vegetables can be picked up by you, and meats can be ordered with the servers.  Excellent and attentive services. No queues at this branch!
sample_reviews_en.author: Maison Ray

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was great! The staff were lovely. The table next to us had a small child who was screaming constantly, causing several tables to look at us awkwardly. So we asked to move tables. The staff were so kind, finding us a new table …
sample_reviews_en.author: peach Peach

sample_reviews_en.text:
Service was great as always 🥰
I’m a Royal customer since I was 15 and now I’m turning 30 😂 Still enjoying the food and service from Mo-Mo Paradise 🥰
Keeping up good work !
sample_reviews_en.author: Griffin Wong

sample_reviews_en.text: The meat was excellent, the ice cream was delicious, and the rice milk was the best! The staff were very friendly and helpful, always smiling and speaking nicely.
sample_reviews_en.author: AM am

restaurants.name: Mo-Mo-Paradise Terminal 21
restaurants.address:

4th FL 88 Soi Sukhumvit 19, Khlong Toei Nuea, Thawi Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I feel like momo is not kind of shabu for everyone but it's definitely one of the best for me.

I don't live in Thailand but every year when I go back home I always go here to meet my friends and just have dinner together.

It's definitely our spot. I love the food and for me the meat is really good. The sauce and everything is perfect and it worth every baht you pay.

My boyfriend who's not Thai also had momo and he fell in love with it and now it's also his favorite shabu and we NEED to eat it every time we are back in Thailand❤️

Now I'm happy you can book table online so next time when I'm in Thailand I can just book it in front.

Really recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Plyfa I.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Di Maung made our entire dining experience truly enjoyable. He was warm, attentive, and always greeted us with a genuine smile. Throughout the meal, he took our orders carefully, ensured everything was taken care of, and made us feel very comfortable and welcome.

His cheerful attitude and excellent service really stood out and left a positive impression on us. Thank you, Di Maung, for your outstanding hospitality. With your dedication, professionalism, and positive energy, I’m confident you’ll go far and achieve even greater positions in the future.

Highly appreciated and highly recommended! 👏😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Louis Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I tried the premium waygu option +200b, to be honest while it's good I really can't tell the difference in taste to the normal option...so I would say it's not really worth the upgrade

Came back many times, though it's usually almost impossible to get a table after 5pm if you didn't reserve ahead of time. Best time to go is around 2-3 pm to get a table.

Excellent service and quality meats! Will definitely come again. The staff were very friendly and helpful.
sample_reviews_en.author: George Wei

sample_reviews_en.text: Finally we had the chance to have our diner at the very popular Mo Mo paradise. It's very often fully booked and we know now why: it is an ultimate experience of Shabu Shabu. We chose to pay 400 Baht extra for the Wagyu beef, hallelujah what a feast it was. The service here is much more personal and they treat you here as a VIP. everything we had was outstanding, from the sauces, vegetables, bouillon, meat, until the splendid Moshi and icecream. Top place
sample_reviews_en.author: marc van looy

sample_reviews_en.text: There is always a queqe in the evening so recommend to reserve table in advance. There is few more options of soups with the original (black) one is sukiyaki. Basic buffet with beef around THB 600.- per person including drinks and desserts. Its valuable price as meat is a good quality and vegetable is so fresh and hygienic. Drink is refill with options of soft drinks or tea. Don’t forget to spare your space for desserts as moji and ice cream is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miki T.

sample_reviews_en.text: Authentic Japanese Shabu buffet style. 560 baht not yet including vat and service charge. The beef are great. Theres a selection of meat ( beef, pork , duck and grinded chicken ). There are 4 soup and you can choose 2. Different soup goes with different sauce. Vegetable choices are great and fresh. A selection of beverages from coffee to soda and green tea.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanthida 'Mim' Saiphim

sample_reviews_en.text: the best shabu shabu place we had! definitely worth it! the meat are so tender and the cuts are premium very affordable compare to other countries. alot of side dishes and the salad are really good! thw dessert was so impressive all of the food served was really good. will come back again when we trave to thailand again
sample_reviews_en.author: Angel Lew Vasquez (rollerangel1994)

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is good as always. Matcha ice cream here is a must-try ! However, because of the busy time, it took a bit long to get what we ordered at the end of our meals. Some servers were not thai, so I can’t really understand what they said, but they were giving good service
sample_reviews_en.author: Pagamas R

restaurants.name: Jim's Burger & Beer Senanikom
restaurants.address:

94/84 พหลโยธิน 32 ระหว่าง Sana Nikhom 1 Soi 2, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Me and my girlfriend went here, she ordered a pork burger and I ordered the Mexican beef burger. After the food arrived we started to eat when I realized my burger had a strange taste, I knew after another bite that the beef had gone bad. I sent the burger back and asked the waitress to tell the kitchen staff to check the meat and then I ordered another burger. The waitress tried to tell me that the Mexican burger has a specific taste, I then told her that I knew it was bad meat. The next burger came and this time I smelled the beef, as soon as I smelled it I knew it was bad, but I tried and small piece to be sure. Sure enough it was even worse than the last time! Even after I told them to check the meat, they still served me rotten meat! Absolutely disgusting it made me gag. Avoid this place at all costs unless you want to end up in hospital with food poisoning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jacob Palmer

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for healthy food, maybe this isn't the place for you. But if you are looking for a great burger, chicken strips, fries, etc., then you can't do better anywhere else nearby. The portions were good, and the food was excellent. The bread and cheese in the burger tasted just like what you would get in America, and there were Jalapeños and great sauces to go with everything. The prices are not low but they are definitely fair given the great taste and the good portions. I will go here again anytime I am nearby, I loved it!

Only complaint would be the lack of seating and parking. Parking nearby is not very easy and the traffic is not great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alan Brothers

sample_reviews_en.text: Probably one the top 5 burgers that I've ever eaten anywhere in the world! A big range of different burgers with beef, pork, chicken or fish. Good quality meats and ingredients, cooked to perfection, and they have about 12 different craft beers on tap plus two fridges full of other nectar from around the world. The fried stuffed Jalapeno peppers aren't to be missed either. Jim's is as good as it gets, and you can also have your car washed and waxed at one of the best car washes in Bangkok, while you eat, where they change the micro-fibre cloths they use after every car. Attention to detail, in food and cars, is absolute here. Not to be missed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Colin F.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The day before New Year's, I went to Jim's Burger to eat at the restaurant, but this time I didn't order a burger (I usually order burgers via Grab delivery).
The menu items I ordered:
- Pork ribs
- Fried Jelapons
- Quesadilla (beef)
Personally, I liked the Beef Quesadilla. It was well-made and served with dipping sauce. The fried jelapons were a good appetizer to cut through the richness. If you're tired of French fries, I recommend trying them. My boyfriend said they went very well with beer.
It's a restaurant that I'm always impressed with the quality and service. The staff are attentive and friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeerapa Kanchanapongkul

sample_reviews_en.text: The burger that we got was pretty good although it was quite lackluster compared to the advertisements we saw both in-store and online, we thought that the portions were quite small (even though we got the large size) but the overall taste was fine. The waffle fries and onion rings that we got were very oily and we could distinctly taste burnt oil. The food itself wasn't horrible but the atmosphere in the store was quite suffocating as although the servers were friendly, the store itself had very bad ventilation which caused for a poor atmosphere for dining in.
sample_reviews_en.author: nattakarn sri

sample_reviews_en.text:
The burger is truly delicious. Order the small size and you'll get just the right amount of bite without trying. The grilled pork is fragrant. This restaurant makes their own bread, and I can confirm it's truly delicious! It's a great value!

Another dish is the ribs. They're tender and, most importantly, go great with flavored beer. They have a selection of both Thai and international beers. Give them a try.

The atmosphere is relaxed and the owner is friendly. 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimpan Kantacome

sample_reviews_en.text:
Finally went here for dinner after having it on my list for so long. One of the top 5 burgers I've had in Thailand. The fries are cooked to crispy perfection. The beer list is extensive and a bit confusing, I ended up with a beer I didn't like but that's my fault for not understanding the menu.

The music was a hilarious mix of acoustic 80s power ballads. Great place, great staff, great food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Justin Bowman

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a great time here and appreciated the staff's service, particularly one member who seemed to be very knowledgeable about the menu and introduced it to us with enthusiasm. I celebrated my birthday there and was pleasantly surprised with a complimentary gift from the staff.  I highly recommend this place, their fried chicken is delicious and the burgers and pasta are also great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hudaify

restaurants.name: Tidmunz Rama3
restaurants.address:

85 Thanon Yannawa, Bang Phong Phang, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time here. There were a lot of people and it was a very good business. There is a parking lot inside, about 10 cars. It is a bit difficult to get in and out, but there are staff who will direct you. You can park on the side of the road for several cars. The food service area is very crowded, like getting on a bus after school. It might need to be expanded to accommodate more customers. The dining area is also a bit crowded. The service is very good, 5 stars. Both Thai and foreign staff are serious and diligent. The food refilling system is fast and ready for every situation. This place does not hold back on the amount of food. Customers can eat their favorite food until their eyes are wide open, grilling it so fast they can barely keep up. The quality of the meat is worth more than the price. It is not surprising that this is one of the favorite restaurants of Rama 3 residents.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dawud

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food selection is huge, with fresh ingredients, ready-made meals, snacks, salads, cakes, fruit, and ice cream.
There's unlimited soup base that you can refill as much as you want. You can choose your cooking method: shabu-shabu, Korean BBQ, or butter grill. There's no time limit, which is great! We ate until we were completely full. There were 9 of us, and we sat for 2.5 hours and were already stuffed. We had to leave because it started getting crowded. If you go in the evening after work, it will be very crowded and you'll have to wait in line. I recommend going before 3 pm so you can eat comfortably and not have to dodge other people, because it gets very busy. The restaurant isn't very big, and it was quite hot and stuffy when it was raining.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nui Su

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a moo kata restaurant that offers grills for moo kata, shabu, and barbecue. Personally, on the day I went, I chose the moo kata. If you want other grills, it's just an additional 50 baht per grill. There's a wide variety of food to choose from, but the ribeye was a bit tough and very difficult to chew. The pork was also very large. There are many dipping sauces to choose from, such as seafood, sukiyaki, and barbecue. They also have fresh chilies, garlic, and lime. And what's essential for a moo kata restaurant is the wide selection of appetizers that are also delicious. Furthermore, the price is very cheap, only 276 baht, including drinks and 7% VAT.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thunya Kongkapetch

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a bit of a drive to get there, but once you arrive you'll be amazed!!!😱 The atmosphere is fantastic. You can see the mountains, lush greenery, and it's very relaxing and peaceful. Most importantly, the food is incredibly delicious. For example, the charcoal truffle croissant, the orange/lemon cake (or something similar) – it was so fragrant and delicious. The Hawaiian pizza, the huge salad, the bibimbap (Korean mixed rice) – everything was tasty, and the coffee cake was also great.
Overall, the food is delicious, clean, and flavorful. I give it 5 stars!
sample_reviews_en.author: Da Suksant

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop has a great atmosphere, open, airy, comfortable, and spacious, as it's an old indoor football field. The staff are lovely and the shop is organized. There are many sauces to choose from: pork, beef, various kinds: ribeye, sirloin, pie plate, bacon, fatty pork. There are also oysters, lots of snacks: French fries, crab rolls, Isaan sausages, ice cream, fruit, soft drinks. The price is 276 baht per person, add a stove for 50 baht, worth it, very good price, very impressive, first time coming.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sininat Thani

sample_reviews_en.text: I really want the restaurant to make this menu. This one I made myself. I used fish sauce mixed with yakiniku sauce. It's awesome. But the seafood, you have to accept the taste a bit. It's only spicy. It should taste sour and sweet. The restaurant is clean. The atmosphere is good. Everything about the dipping sauce. The restaurant is clean. The atmosphere is good. Everything about the dipping sauce might need to be adjusted a bit. The seafood can be sour and sweet or salty, sour and sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: เจติยา มหาโภควาณิช

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a fantastic all-you-can-eat BBQ buffet. The restaurant is clean, the service is good, and the quality is excellent value for money. They have a complete selection of food, including vegetables, pork, beef, and desserts like cakes, ice cream, and fruit. There's also a wide variety of drinks. Importantly, they use real butter! You can eat until you're full. After finishing and paying, I wanted to ask the owner if they could help keep the business going so we can come back often.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vinvin S

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is delicious, the meat is very delicious, and I like to eat fresh boiled squid with the shop's seafood sauce. It's very delicious. There are many drinks to choose from, worth the price. Some people sit for a long time because there is no time limit. And the overall atmosphere is a bit stuffy. But the ceiling is high and there is a strong fan, so it helps. But be warned, if you leave the shop and go home, you have to wash your hair. My hair smells so bad from grilling 😂
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukanya Panyayong

restaurants.name: Epia Asiatique
restaurants.address:

2194 ถ. เจริญกรุง Wat Phraya Krai, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Not recommended!

A restaurant that can't even show the most basic respect to its guests—I don't recommend coming here. (I paid and left without eating.)

Facts: I went to dine there around 8 PM on February 10th, 2026. I was led to an empty table on the second floor right next to the "service staff counter." When I was led to the table, there were no cutlery on it. (It was probably just a space where staff occasionally put things.)

If this was because the restaurant was full, it would be acceptable. But the fact is, there were many empty seats in the large second-floor dining area.

Having been to Thailand so many times, this is the first time I've experienced such incredibly low-class service in a relatively upscale restaurant.

The only protest I could offer was to order the food, not eat it, pay the bill, and leave.
sample_reviews_en.author: 楊泰一

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped in because I was a little hungry before seeing the show. I was attracted by the service of getting a full beer when I ordered one, but it turned out that it had to be a large beer. The same goes for fried rice; when you order one, you get another, and you can't mix types, so you get two of the same thing. I ordered a small, but when they brought out two, it was a bit too much. Well, I had some time before the show, so it was just right to enjoy my meal at my leisure. Thank you for the meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hiroshi “くまじろう”

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a tourist trap. Food isn't fresh, my kids didn't eat the pad thai while they ate pad thai for weeks non stop, as it smelt as tasted strange (not fresh sauce and ingredients).
My salad had a rotten taste and the beef salad had wayyy less beef than in the picture, and no salad, only onions.

They offered an exceptionnal 10% discount but added 10% service. They didnt make me pay my salad though, even themselves could smell it.

Service was nice and they were friendly, beside everything.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jonathan

sample_reviews_en.text:
we came around late lunch time, no crowd and not much options in the area, hence stumble into this restaurant.
food was good. fragrant pineapple fried rice and tomyum soup.
flavor is mildly catered to foreigners.
free plate of som tam provided upon review of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Evan

sample_reviews_en.text: At first I dont know this is a Thai restaurant. Luckily i look after the menu. We have amazing dinner here. Could you do something that make people know you're Thai restaurant? Me as tourist go to Bangkok to eat Thai food, not western or Indian food. Just a suggestion
sample_reviews_en.author: Ying-Noii

sample_reviews_en.text: Especially the beer, it's so sweet. I don't like this kind of spicy salad dressing at all. It's all the same, no matter how many salads I order, the dressing is always the same. It's just a basic dressing that's been modified to look unique.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nanawannnk Munky

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there yesterday, December 31st, 2025 (countdown day), and the service was terrible. I waited for my food for an hour. I called the staff to check on my order 3-4 times, but they all disappeared. No one came to tell me when my food …
sample_reviews_en.author: วรีพร ศรีน้อย

sample_reviews_en.text: The raw marinated shrimp wasn't very fresh, and the seasoning was just average. The freshly squeezed orange juice wasn't from fresh oranges either; you could taste that the oranges were a bit rotten.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sylvia Zhang

restaurants.name: CHAMAI BUTCHERY
restaurants.address:

229, 32 Suk Sawat Rd, Bang Pakok, Rat Burana, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're looking for an outstanding steak restaurant in Bangkok, Chamai Steak Restaurant is definitely worth a visit. This restaurant offers a remarkable dining experience, blending a cozy ambiance with exceptional service. The steaks are the highlight, of course, cooked to perfection and full of flavor. Whether you prefer your steak rare or well-done, Chamai's chefs cater to every preference with skill and attention to detail. The side dishes and beer selection complement the meal beautifully, enhancing the overall culinary experience. What sets Chamai apart is not just the quality of the food but also the warm, welcoming atmosphere, making it an ideal spot for both special occasions and casual dinners. A visit here is sure to leave you with delightful memories and a desire to return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Istvan Sahin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Disappointing Experience at Chamar Butchery

I visited Chamar Butchery a few days ago, and while the atmosphere was decent, the food fell far short of expectations.

We ordered the Caesar salad, beef tongue, picanha fried rice, and a steak (can’t recall the exact name). Unfortunately, none of the dishes stood out.
•	The beef tongue was too tough to chew, though the dipping sauce was flavorful.
•	The fried rice was basic and lacked any memorable taste.
•	The Caesar salad was ordinary, nothing to rave about.
•	The steak was just okay—decent but not impressive for a place specializing in meat.

Overall, it was an underwhelming experience. While the ambiance was fine, the food didn’t live up to the promise, and I don’t see myself returning anytime soon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tachinee Thinnakornvisan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here looking for craft beer, but there was none at all. They have only regular beers like Chang, Leo, and Asahi, which was disappointing. Now they do not offer any craft beer. They should remove the “Craft Beer” sign from the storefront.
I didn’t have high expectations for the food, but the beef fried rice was better than expected. I was expecting the usual tough Thai beef, but the Tajima Premium beef I tried was tender and tasty. It made me interested in trying other meat dishes as well.
For some reason, there was a 20% discount, which made it surprisingly cheap and satisfying.
In overall it was a good experience today, however, since there is no craft beer, I’m not sure whether I would come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gourmet Advisor

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is new and not quite ready yet, but the fresh meat tastes good, as expected from a former butcher. However, the preparation of ingredients needs improvement, the staff isn't fully trained, and they don't have craft beer yet. It seems we'll have to wait and see, or perhaps they'll just stay where they are. The meat is already good, and the food tastes decent. It's worth a visit.

However, the alcoholic beverages are a bit pricey for a restaurant located in Jas Food Plaza. They should look at their competitors a bit more, and then they'll understand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kitibordee Yindeear-rom

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a small restaurant specializing in meat dishes, and they do a pretty good job with the meat. The beef fried rice was delicious, and the grilled beef tongue was tender and not chewy. The soup was just okay, a bit light, and could be richer. The desserts were decent. The prices are reasonable.

As far as I remember, the prices were very reasonable considering the quality. I'd definitely visit again if I have the chance.

There is parking available in the complex.
sample_reviews_en.author: Twk

sample_reviews_en.text:
Friends brought me here.
We had the Thai Wagyu, Picanha and Tenderloin. Temperature of the steaks were spot on. The Tenderloin for me is the highlight. Cooked to perfection! And the fried rice is very good too! Highly recommend.
They do have in-house craft beers. The hazy ipa is 🔥.

Will definitely be coming back for more! Come and try it for yourselves!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sean Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: Despite a quite good food selection, but a bit wrong definition of "medium well done," the overall experience fails to justify the high prices. In the end, the premium price tag, plus a charge of 10% service fee overshadows my enjoyment derived from the meal, leaving me questioning the actual value of our dining experience
sample_reviews_en.author: Volker Kevin Capito

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered beef fried rice, steak, beef tongue and garlic bread. They are all tasty. But personally I think it is a bit too pricey considering the size of dishes and location.

There are parking lots. The staffs are nice, polite and helpful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanya

restaurants.name: Indian Summer Restaurant Pattaya
restaurants.address:

118, 4, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We recently visited *Indian Summer* in Pattaya, and we must say, it was an unforgettable experience. The taste of the spices and the level of service are simply impeccable. You can really tell that every dish is made with care and expertise. What's even better is that the prices are reasonable—offering great value for money without compromising on quality.

The variety of food available is fantastic, with a wide range of options that cater to all tastes. I’ve tried many Indian restaurants before, but nothing quite compares to this one. *Indian Summer* truly stands out as the best in Pattaya so far.

One of the unique features is that you can also hold private functions here. Whether you're celebrating an event or just looking for a night out, they offer a space that’s both comfortable and vibrant. Plus, they have a dancing show club in the restaurant, so you can enjoy amazing food and party all in one place.

What more could you ask for? Fantastic food, great service, and the option to turn your meal into a celebration. Highly recommend! 🌟
sample_reviews_en.author: PDW Australia

sample_reviews_en.text: Indian Summer Restaurant in Pattaya on Walking Street is a fantastic spot if you're craving authentic Indian food. The ambiance is inviting, and the restaurant is conveniently located right on Walking Street, making it an ideal stop after sightseeing or shopping.While the prices are a little higher compared to other local options, the quality of food and the warm, welcoming service make it absolutely worth it. The staff are attentive, and the tea is notably great, adding to the overall enjoyable experience. Whether you're a local Indian food lover or just want to indulge in familiar flavors abroad, Indian Summer offers an excellent culinary experience in Pattaya.Overall, a highly recommended place for good food, great tea, and a satisfying dining experience despite slightly premium prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Melhi Yabesh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Before describing the amazing setup and selection of the food, let’s talk about the structure.
First of all the place is modern, super clean, and classy (it had AC).
Love the set up (furniture and dishwear are nice).
Now for the food, a wide selection of indian delicacy. My personal favourite/recommendations are the shahi paneer (masala) and the butter chicken.
I feel like the prices are super affordable and are comparable to other indian restaurant in pattaya HOWEVER they are not as clean or as tasty as this one. So I think this one is worth the money.
The service is beyond professional and they were super kind as well.
Definitely THE destination for indian cuisine in pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohannad Nemeh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had an absolutely amazing experience at Indian Summer Kitchen in Pattaya! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

The food was outstanding—especially the Dal Makhni, which was rich, creamy, and full of authentic flavors, just like home. The Chicken Biryani was equally impressive, perfectly cooked with aromatic spices and tender chicken that made every bite memorable.

The ambiance is warm and inviting, and the staff is courteous and attentive, making the overall dining experience even better. If you’re craving authentic Indian food in Pattaya, this place is a must-visit. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mukesh Lalwani

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wellllll.....when you enter a restaurant it's basically to eat... I ordered a Dal soup and it was amazingly on the spot.... All tastes combined perfectly.
Although it was very difficult to choose something for only one person, I went for the chicken biryani for the main course. It arrived on time with a curd sauce and some green and red masala. Sorry for not thinking to take some photos before and after was too late. The price range is depend on your level of hunger and if the group is bigger, you can share
Overall, I enjoyed it very much.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunny Fine

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a wonderful experience at this Indian restaurant! The food was flavorful, fresh, and beautifully seasoned - every dish was delicious. The staff were incredibly friendly,  and made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. They checked on us throughout the meal and cleared the empty plates quickly.

Overall, great atmosphere, excellent service, and amazing food. Highly recommended! 🌶️🍛💛

Special thanks to Chndan the waiter, he very friendly and nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chen Sol

sample_reviews_en.text:
I HAVE BEEN TO MANY INDIAN 🇮🇳 RESTAURANTS IN PATTAYA OVER THE LAST 5 YEARS, AND I HAVE BEEN DISSAPOINTED ALMOST EVERY TIME BECAUSE I GO TO AN EXCELLENT INDIAN RESTAURANT IN ENGLAND 🇬🇧
THE INDIAN 🇮🇳 SUMMER ☀️ IS THE ONLY INDIAN RESTAURANT I WILL NOW GO TO IN PATTAYA :
EXCELLENT SERVICE
FANTASTIC SURROUNDINGS
DELICIOUS 😋 INDIAN 🇮🇳 FOOD 😍
AND AN AFFORDABLE PRICE .
INDIAN 🇮🇳 SUMMER PATTAYA
LOCATED AT THE BEGINNING OF WALKING STREET. 😋❤️❌️
sample_reviews_en.author: ALLAN BENNETT

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is well regarded to me as one of the best Indian restaurants in town! They took me in as a guest of honor and treated me to a five star experience! I think I need an intervention because I can’t get enough of the Butter chicken with nan bread. I also love the yogurt smoothie!!!

Just an American who is hungry and wanted good food and got a hell of a lot more than expected!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bojangles A7x

restaurants.name: Ranee's
restaurants.address:

The Circle Ratchapurk, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Stepping into Ranee’s Vilo felt like a scene from a classic Italian film—polished checkered floors, vintage decor, and an ambiance that transports you straight to a charming café in Rome.

🍕 Authentic Italian flavors on the table, from perfectly baked pizza with rich toppings to creamy, dreamy tiramisu that melts in your mouth. Every bite was a delightful journey through the heart of Italy!

“Chi ha pane non ha denti, chi ha denti non ha pane.” 🥖
(He who has bread has no teeth, he who has teeth has no bread.)
A little Italian wisdom, but here, you get both—delicious food and the perfect place to enjoy it.

If you love vintage charm and true Italian cuisine, this spot is an absolute must-visit! 🇮🇹✨

📍 Ranee’s Vilo, Bangkok
📍 The Circle Ratchaphruek
💵 Price Range: ฿฿-฿฿฿
🍽️ Highly Recommended: Pizza & Pasta! Honestly, every dish is worth trying! 😍
sample_reviews_th.author: RattoWanderlust

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Must-Visit for Italian Cuisine Lovers!

I had an amazing dining experience at Ranee’s The Circle Ratchaphruk. The restaurant boasts an elegant and clean atmosphere, with comfortable seating that made the meal even more enjoyable. The décor adds a cozy yet sophisticated touch, perfect for a relaxed meal.

The service was outstanding—friendly, attentive, and highly professional. The staff was proactive in recommending dishes and patiently answered all my questions about the menu, making the experience even more pleasant.

The food was nothing short of spectacular. Every dish was packed with flavor, presented beautifully, and served in generous portions. The standout dish for me was the *Truffle Hokkaido Scallop*, which was absolutely delicious and worth every baht. The pricing is very reasonable for the high-quality ingredients and exceptional taste.

I will definitely be coming back and highly recommend Ranee’s to anyone looking for great Italian food in Bangkok. Whether you’re dining with friends or looking for a special meal, this place is a fantastic choice!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanisorn Yongstar

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍕🍷 Ranee's Restaurant brings Italy to Ratchaphruek! Experience authentic homemade flavors in a classic atmosphere.

Enjoy Italian comfort food. 🍝✨ If you're looking for an Italian restaurant that feels warm and inviting, like having a meal with an Italian family, you have to come to this place! This branch is beautifully and stylishly decorated. The olive green color scheme contrasts with the black and white checkered floor, giving it a classic European vintage feel. Every corner is beautifully lit and the atmosphere is incredibly relaxing. Perfect for a date or a family meal.

🍅 Burrata & Roasted Tomato Salad
🥖 Homemade Toast Set
🍗 Nonna Chicken Steak
🍕 Brie Truffle Pizza
🍝 Frutti Di Mare
🍰 Cheesecake
🍹 Summer Smoothie
🫐 Blueberry Mojito

If you're looking for a delicious restaurant with a great vibe in the Ratchaphruek area, I highly recommend trying this one! Definitely impressive 💯

📍 Ranee’s Restaurant
🏛️ The Circle Ratchapruk
🕰️ Open Daily 11:00 - 22:00

#callmebacon #raneesrestaurant
#raneespizza #thecircleratchapruk #callmebacon
sample_reviews_en.author: CALLMEBACON

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ranee's has become one of my comfort zone restaurants. It's a homemade Italian restaurant with authentic flavors that make you feel like you're eating in Italy. Every time I come, whether with friends, my partner, or family, it's always impressive.

This time, the restaurant has some new menu items that you absolutely must try. My recommended dishes this time are:

‘Burrata & Roasted Tomato Salad’ – incredibly refreshing and subtly flavorful. Even if you don't usually like tomatoes, you should give this a try because they do it really well. The sweet and sour balance is perfect. It pairs even better with their signature pizza.

Another must-try is the ‘Italian Sausage Pasta’. The pasta is perfectly al dente, not mushy, and the rich, slightly spicy flavor, combined with the succulent Italian sausage, is simply delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Taetae Phonaumpai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Three of us arrived at Ranee’s around 11:30 on a Sunday. The restaurant is not yet crowded, luckily for us. We ordered calamari, a salad and two pizzas. We also brought a bottle of red wine. The serving staff seemed new but they knew what needs to be done by refill our wine glasses, water, etc. The food is exceptionally good, and ingredients, such as seafood and greens are very fresh. I would recommend this establishment if you are looking for high quality food and good service. By the time we left, past noon, the restaurant was pretty packed.

My friend and I met at Renee’s for lunch Tuesday afternoon around 12:30 pm.  They had a couple of big groups but our orders came out without much delays. As usual, the pizza is great!
sample_reviews_en.author: Emiko Kawashima

sample_reviews_en.text: The spaghetti was salty, not terrible, but not great either. I gave it one star because I intended to eat pizza, but they forgot to key in my pizza order until I had finished all the other food. I saw tables that came in after me get their pizzas before me and almost finished theirs. So I asked the staff how long my pizza would take, and they said it wasn't in the system – that was incredibly frustrating. They asked if I still wanted it and said they would make it right away. At that point, I was annoyed because I had waited until all the other food on my table was gone, so I just asked for the bill and went home. This was my first and last time at this restaurant. That's it.
sample_reviews_en.author: MYN 1990

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's easy to understand why so many people keep coming back. Besides their signature wood-fired pizza, their seafood menu is amazing, especially the fish and shellfish. The ingredients are fresh and perfectly seasoned, allowing the full flavor of the seafood to shine through. If you're a seafood lover, we recommend trying their drinks to pair with your meal, just like we did.

The atmosphere at The Circle Ratchapruk branch is warm and inviting. With two floors, it's perfect for hanging out with friends, family, or on a date.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kulin Kakaew

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time eating at this branch. I've been to the original branch in Khao San Road before, and the taste was still okay. Most of the food is average in taste. The restaurant is geared towards families, offering simple, easy-to-eat meals. But what I really loved was the lobster bisque risotto – it was amazing!
The Australian beef was just okay; I was a little disappointed, expecting it to be more impressive.

Overall, the atmosphere was good and the staff provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supisa Kisananone

restaurants.name: Yellow Lane
restaurants.address:

2, 92 Soi Phahon Yothin 5, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service is very bad. There are many waiters in the store. When they don't entertain guests, they talk and laugh. But when we need service, they seem to be invisible or avoid seeing, and I need to call them twice to come over.

When a huge dinner plate was served, the waiter did not give any signal or ask other waiters to help, but stood beside me and waited for me to take it to the table. Is it so difficult to say hello? This is very rude.

At the checkout, the clerk said that he would not accept cash, and there was no previous explanation. I think this should be stated in advance as a charging method. Finally, we said that we needed a receipt. A total of three clerks received our receipts before and after, but after waiting for ten minutes, someone came to tell us that it was only on the tablet.

When the waiter communicated with us throughout the whole process, he didn't explanation. He basically didn't say a few words, but nodded or shook his head more. We had an unpleasant dining experience.

This is a very cold and impolite service behavior. I'm disappointed that the restaurant's rating on Google Maps is high.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cici

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Yellow Lane Ari is easily one of Bangkok’s hidden gems. From the moment you walk in, you’re welcomed by a warm, vibrant atmosphere that perfectly blends modern design with a relaxed neighborhood vibe.

The food was absolutely outstanding—beautifully presented, fresh, creative, and packed with flavor. Every dish showcased high-quality ingredients and thoughtful attention to detail. The coffee was exceptional, and the menu offers a fantastic selection for breakfast, brunch, and lunch.

What truly sets Yellow Lane apart is the exceptional service. The staff are friendly, attentive, and genuinely passionate about creating a memorable dining experience. Whether you’re looking for a cozy café to work from, a brunch spot with friends, or simply a place to enjoy great food and coffee, Yellow Lane delivers on every level.

Highly recommended for anyone visiting Ari. Trendy yet welcoming, sustainable, community-focused, and consistently excellent. A must-visit destination in Bangkok for food lovers, digital nomads, and coffee enthusiasts alike. Looking forward to my next visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: kandan9

sample_reviews_en.text:
I personally came here many times since it was recently opened and it is kid and pet friendly.

The dish is quite a big portion and decorated very beautiful . The portion is big enough that can be shared, the taste is very good and can visit again and again.

The healthy snickers chocolate is very tasty with banana blended

Hot chocolate is very good too.

They renovated the new area recently, people seems to be coming in more and more than the timing when it recently opened in covid period .

The parking is becoming more and more difficult to find. Recommend to use public transportation when coming .

it is in walkable distance from BTS , if the weather is not too hot, it is quite chill
sample_reviews_en.author: Naszha Pimpawatin

sample_reviews_en.text: A love at first sight. Not only is this place an abundance of green and luscious garden, but best of all is truly pet friendly! My boy was allowed indoors and loved the outdoors as well. However service was a little “distant” and kitchen was not willing to cater to my request as I asked them to switch out some ingredients for me and boil the chicken breast for my fur baby instead of grilling it. I am a picky eater as health calls for it and my requests are taken seriously at some restaurants and not at others. Overall, I’m still pleased with this place. It’s perfect not just for dining, but for reunions or chilling out when you need a quick retreat from the city.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nok S

sample_reviews_en.text: As someone who regularly used to go to yellow lane years ago, this place has changed immensely. The restaurant itself is still pretty and the staff are lovely, but the food has downgraded. The drinks were good and the proportions were generous, but the carbonara we ordered was quite bland along side the garlic bread which was disappointing since back then it used to be very flavorful. Not to mention, this place doesn’t feel like a restaurant anymore. There are too many facilities around which ruins the whole atmosphere of the restaurant (dance classes on the top floor which causes loud noise).
sample_reviews_en.author: Ann

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very cool cafe with a working vibe during the day and a chill vibe in the evening. They offer a variety of food and drink options, from smoothies to coffee and beer, as well as snacks and main dishes. I usually come here and order a long black coffee—it tastes good. Their fries are also one of my favorites.

They have both indoor and outdoor seating. The outdoor area is lovely, with a garden and a very chill vibe. The indoor area feels a bit serious, but you can charge your laptop and focus on work.

One downside is that it’s very hard to find parking here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chen E.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wow, this place is something else! It feels like you’re being transported to a jungle cafe paradise retreat with the most gastronomically elevated foods.

We came here many mornings to have breakfast and work for a few hours during our stay at a nearby hotel.

As a long-time vegan, my only wish is that they had a designated plant-based protein option like tofu or tempeh besides mushrooms to swap into their dishes, but what they did have was delicious!

The vegan banana bread, juices and espresso drinks made with oat or soy milk were top notch. Mmmm!
sample_reviews_en.author: Colleen Howell

sample_reviews_en.text: An oasis to escape to within the city. I love the greenery and atmosphere of the venue with both indoor and outdoor seating available. This appears to be a popular spot for foreigners to unwind and enjoy international food and drink. It’s also easy to bring your laptop and work here. The coffee was good, a little on the lighter side for the roast with a fruity blend. The service here gives you the option to order via QR code and pay via the app which is convenient. Overall a great experience and recommend if you want something special for your day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Clinton Hatcher

restaurants.name: Thai Food at Samranrat
restaurants.address:

Maha Chai Rd, Khwaeng Samran Rat, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Try their "Suki Haeng" with pork(Dry suki), it is very good!
The Padthai and crab omelette were so so for a Thai person like me. But their "suki haeng สุกี้แห้งหมู) is just really gooood
sample_reviews_th.author: K Px

sample_reviews_en.text:
What an absolute hidden gem. At first glance, this place might not catch your eye as it’s a modest little food stall, easy to overlook if you’re just walking by. But trust me, the moment you take your first bite, you’ll know you’ve found something truly special. We ordered the crab omelette, the Pad Thai and the Tom Yum soup - and every single dish was out-of-this-world delicious. The crab omelette was divine, soft and fluffy on the inside, perfectly crispy on the outside and filled with the most flavorful, juicy crab. Honestly, I still think about it. It was one of those dishes that makes you stop mid-bite and just whisper, “Oh my God, this is so good.”

If you’re judging places by looks alone, you might walk past this one but please don’t. This is the kind of food that reminds you why street food is such a treasure. It’s authentic, made with love and absolutely unforgettable. Highly, highly recommend. I would come back in a heartbeat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kasia Prus

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is located right next to a Michelin-starred establishment with a long line of eager diners. However, don’t let that fool you—this place holds its own when it comes to flavor and value. We tried the crab omelette, Tom Yum, and fried rice, and each dish exceeded our expectations. The crab omelette was fluffy and packed with flavor, the Tom Yum had just the right balance of spice and tang, and the fried rice was well-seasoned and satisfying.

The best part? All of this came at a very reasonable price, making it a great alternative to its more famous neighbor. The portions were generous, and the quality of the food felt like a hidden gem find. I’d absolutely come here again, not just because it’s easy on the wallet but because the food is genuinely good. Whether you’re waiting in line next door or just looking for a solid meal, this place is definitely worth a visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: alma joyo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Location: outdor, beside the road. In front of 7-eleven and Tim Mansion hotel.
It was easy to find but the place is not like a restaurant. It was a street food vendor that has a few plastic chairs, the food being cooked outside by order, and they have only a few staffs. So, the food came a bit late for them to prepare.

The menu was quite various from pad thai, tomyum, and so on.
The pad thai was good, tangy, savory, slightly sweet, nutty and pretty much good. But the shrimps were a bit fishy.

Price wise it was okay. but for this price you csn definitely eat in an indoor restaurant.

Also, they have a fan to cool you down.

P.s not so spicy for foreigners.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akma Ikasari

sample_reviews_en.text: Pad Thai was excellent! couldn’t eat the Crab Omelette. The Crab and the Egg have zero spices. Crab not even salted & the aftertaste is too strong I was thinking it wasn’t fresh because fresh crab tastes milder. Big Disappointment in the Crab omelette I took two bites and couldn’t finish. The Ketchup that it comes with isn’t even Thai chili sauce its standart ketchup. Wish I had ordered Pad thai only. Also the Place could do a bit cleaner I know it’s cheap street food but good Lord.
sample_reviews_en.author: Luq He

sample_reviews_en.text: Avoid!! Cant taste the freshness of the crab in the omelette. The phad thai was alright but not fantastic. Service is non existence. Both the young waiter and young waitress pulled a long face. After my meal, i see mini spots of oil on the surface of my mobile phone. Imagine the oil from the cooking and smog from the cars that i have breathe in during my meal. You are better off somewhere else. Not sure how it achieve such high ratings on google.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stella H.

sample_reviews_en.text: This eatery, beside the famous Raan Jay Fai, is highligted as one of the nice eatery with crab omelette. In fact, the reviews in Google seems to be higher than Jay Fai. Knowing that Jay Fai has a longer waiting time, decided to try this instead. Loved its crab omelette and Tom yum kung 😋 however, this street side eatery has limited tables, so we did takeaway. Noticed many foreigners eating at this eatery.
sample_reviews_en.author: Reuben Cheng

sample_reviews_en.text: Authentic Thai street food flavors. Located near Jay Fai's restaurant!! Delicious and worth the price. I recommend all the crispy pork dishes; they also have fluffy omelets. Prices are comfortably around 400+ baht. It's located right at the Samran Rat intersection, easy to find. They now also sell delicious drinks next to the restaurant at very cheap prices, 25-30 baht per glass. You should try them!
sample_reviews_en.author: เชฟไอริน Cheevitcheeva

restaurants.name: Kub Kao' Kub Pla Central World
restaurants.address:

999/9 ชั้นที่ 3 ห้อง A303, floor 3, 999/9 Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If there’s one restaurant I never skip whenever I’m in Bangkok, it’s Kub Kao Kub Pla. I’ve found myself dining here two to three times in a single trip—and that alone says everything. The flavors are consistently rich, deeply authentic, and incredibly satisfying. It’s the kind of place you keep coming back to without hesitation.

My go-to order never changes: the Tom Yum Goong is an absolute staple—perfectly balanced with that signature tangy-spicy kick. The crab meat omelette is indulgent and generously filled, while the fried boiled eggs in tamarind sauce deliver a comforting sweet-savory contrast. And then there’s the Khao Kha Moo—tender, melt-in-your-mouth pork that’s cooked to perfection every single time.

Beyond the food, the service deserves just as much praise. The staff are attentive, warm, and genuinely knowledgeable. They offer practical menu suggestions and clearly know the dishes inside out, which elevates the whole dining experience.

Kub Kao Kub Pla isn’t just a restaurant—it’s a tradition every time I’m in Bangkok. And without fail, it keeps me coming back for more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Francis Frederick Lacap

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely the worst customer service I have ever experienced. We waited 50 minutes for a table for 2 people. My husband and I were the only ones dining, while our baby was asleep in a stroller. When it was finally our turn, the receptionist refused to let us in because she claimed we should have taken a ticket for 3 people. Instead of trying to help, she told us to go back and start over from the beginning after making us wait almost an hour.

Her attitude was incredibly rude and disrespectful. She even waved her hand at me as if to dismiss me and end the conversation. There was no professionalism, no empathy, and no attempt to solve the situation. She completely ruined our evening and turned what should have been a nice family meal into a terrible experience. Management seriously needs to train their front desk staff because no customer deserves to be treated this way. We will never return.
sample_reviews_en.author: taif alsaadi

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a wonderful dining experience at this restaurant during my trip to Thailand.

I arrived quite early, around 10am plus, and there was no queue at all, which made for a relaxed and easy start to the visit.

The food was outstanding. The Tom Yum Goong with sliced fish stood out in particular—it was rich, flavourful, and uniquely enhanced with coconut flesh, giving it a creamy and aromatic twist that I really enjoyed. The Pad Thai was also exceptional, easily one of the best I’ve had, perfectly balanced with great texture and taste. I also ordered fried pork with fried garlic, which was equally delicious, crispy, and packed with flavour.

The only minor downside is that the tables are placed quite close to each other, which makes the dining space feel a bit cramped at times. If the seating were more spaciously arranged, the overall dining experience would have been close to perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lloyd Phua

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I had a chance to bring my foreign friends to dine here.

* The Tom Yum Goong with young coconut was absolutely delicious. It tasted very refreshing and easy to enjoy, especially for foreigners since it wasn’t overly spicy. For Thai people though, a slightly stronger and spicier flavor would make it even better.
* For the stir-fried vegetables, I was a little disappointed with the stir-fried morning glory. It was a bit too salty and not very enjoyable.
* The stir-fried eggplant came in a huge portion. If you love eggplant, this dish is definitely worth ordering.
* My favorite dish was the pork with Maggi sauce. The pork was incredibly tender, juicy, and flavorful.

The restaurant was very crowded during the holiday, with lots of people waiting in line. If you come before noon, you’ll probably get a seat much faster. The staff also provided very good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachadaporn Kovitwanawong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a meal at Kub Kao Kub Pla and it was genuinely impressive as usual. I ordered the Tom Yum and fried chicken, and both dishes were absolutely delicious.
The Tom Yum had a perfect balance of flavors, it’s spicy, tangy, and fragrant, with just the right amount of richness. Every sip felt warm and comforting, full of depth without being too heavy. It really captured what I love about Thai comfort food: bold yet beautifully balanced.

The fried chicken was another highlight. Crispy on the outside, tender and juicy on the inside, it was seasoned just right so that every bite stayed flavorful but not greasy.

This restaurant offers simple joy of well-cooked Thai dishes done with a touch of elegance. The food, the ambiance, the service, everything was perfect. Another thing I need to point out is: the price won’t make you feel robbed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Annisa Shalsa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really bad service and behavior of the staff .

I ordered drink but waited for long time, I asked the waitress and suddenly staff name “ Ging” slam Menu down on the table with unhappy face and talk to me “ NO HAVE” plus strong body language withX sharpe on arms, I give her second time to talk in politely ways but still keep that behavior.

What kind of service like this? Did I force you to serve that drink to me? Just politely tell me that the drink was sold out, can I order different? Or you can speak Thai and translate it if you dont know English.

In overal I can not eat well under this situation even another staff did convince her to say “sorry” to me but I can not forgive. The reason I choose this restaurant because It’s kinda big one in this floor, I was expected to get the better service and food but reality is terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chan MD

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're a fan of Japanese and Asian cuisine, this restaurant is definitely worth a visit. 🍣🦐

It offers a distinctive selection of fresh seafood dishes and delicious Asian cuisine, all prepared with halal ingredients, making for a comfortable and enjoyable experience for everyone. The atmosphere is sophisticated, and the seating is elegant and comfortable, perfect for families or friends.

The prices are very reasonable considering the quality of the food and service, and the staff is courteous and efficient. The restaurant's location within the complex makes it easily accessible and close to most hotels, making it an ideal choice for visitors and tourists.

A truly wonderful experience by all accounts, and I recommend it to all seafood and Asian food lovers. You'll want to come back again and again!
sample_reviews_en.author: عمر الملحم

sample_reviews_en.text: I had seen this restaurant in Central World Mall to be consistently filled with customers on numerous occasions, but never tried it until my recent visit to Bangkok. Now I understand why it is usually crowded. Both the food and service are exceptional. I had the Tom Yum Goong (Cream Tom Yum Soup with Prawns), paired with a plate of white rice. For my beverage, I had a hot Honey with Lime Juice, which was nice. The Tom Yum Goong was perfectly made, the best Tom Yum Soup I have had to date on my international travels. Normal spice levels seem okay for this dish, but I have a very high spice threshold. Ask for less spicy if you have a low spice threshold. Worth the waiting time of about 20-30 minutes that is needed to prepare this dish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lavanesan Swaminathan

restaurants.name: MASALA ART- Indian Restaurant in Bangkok
restaurants.address:

Icon Siam Shopping Center, Shop no. 607 6th Floor, 299 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Mixed Experience: Excellent Chicken, but Steer Clear of the Lamb Chops
I recently dined at Masala Art in ICONSIAM, and the meal was a real mixed bag.
On the positive side, the tandoori chicken was the absolute star of the meal—excellently prepared and packed with flavor. The rogan josh was also quite nice and definitely worth ordering. As for the butter chicken, it was just normal; perfectly fine, but nothing that stands out from what you'd get at any standard Indian restaurant.
Unfortunately, the lamb chops completely derailed the experience. They were an absolute disaster. If I could give a negative rating for that specific dish alone, I would.
Overall, Masala Art is worth a visit if you stick to their strong suits like the tandoori chicken, but I highly recommend completely avoiding the lamb chops.

(Saved entirely by the tandoori chicken)
sample_reviews_en.author: Ali B

sample_reviews_en.text:
The hygiene here is simply unacceptable. While we were eating, a cockroach crawled onto our table. That alone should tell you everything. The food didn’t help either. The chaat papri came with yogurt that was warm, and the chicken in the chicken tikka masala was tough and dry, the kind of texture that makes you wonder how long it had been sitting around before it ended up in the sauce.

A restaurant like this has no place in a mall of ICONSIAM’s caliber. Surrounded by some genuinely good dining options, it sticks out for all the wrong reasons, and the gap in standards is hard to ignore.

Overall, I won’t be coming back, and I’d think twice before recommending it to anyone.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
sample_reviews_en.author: Eisha Kaushal

sample_reviews_en.text:
🌟 Oh, let me tell you about my absolutely AMAZING experience at Masala Art! 🌟

I can't even begin to express how much I LOVED their Butter Chicken 🍗. It was an explosion of flavors in my mouth - creamy, rich, and oh-so-delicious! 😋

But that's not all, folks! 🎉 The service was out-of-this-world phenomenal! 👏🌟 The staff in Thailand, hands down, set a new gold standard for hospitality. They were friendly, attentive, and made me feel like a VIP throughout my entire meal. 🙌✨

Masala Art, you've won my heart with your scrumptious Butter Chicken and top-notch service! 💖👑 I'm counting down the days until I can savor your culinary delights again. Keep up the fantastic work! 🌶️🍽️👌
sample_reviews_en.author: Baronet Kellman

sample_reviews_en.text:
