A must. Craving Indian food or not you must try it here. I am vegetarian and my sister isn’t! The variety of choices that we had!!! We ended up getting butter chicken, garlic naan, steamed rice! And for me I had Aloo dum Kshmiri (which was stuffed potatoes in a curry sauce soooo gooood) and butter naan; everything was 10/10! Fire. Total price was approximately 1400 thb.

Loved every bite couldn’t stop eating even when I was full.

Atmosphere was good! Therefore, shoutout to all the waiters, honestly they were incredible of how welcoming and helpful. Gentle thanks to both Marog and Sagar!! Cooks deserve acknowledgment. Respect.

Definitely coming back!
sample_reviews_en.author: sarah p. elisabeth

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a wonderful dining experience at Masala Art in Bangkok. The food was absolutely delicious — full of flavour, well-balanced, and clearly prepared with care and authenticity. Every dish we tried was fresh, comforting, and beautifully presented.

The atmosphere of the restaurant is elegant yet relaxed, making it a great place for both families and a pleasant sit-down meal. The staff were welcoming, attentive, and made sure we were comfortable throughout our visit.

If you’re looking for high-quality Indian cuisine in Bangkok, Masala Art is definitely worth a visit. We thoroughly enjoyed our meal and would happily return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sameer Ismail

sample_reviews_en.text:
Love - Paneer Makhani

It's not a fine dinning but the food is good. Paneer Makhani is delicious, but we find other dishes somewhat average. The portion sizes vary on every visit,

There is something about this place where you enjoy dinning here. The ambiance is beautiful. You can admire the mall while eating and talking.

People are all really nice. Mr. Sunil, Miss Ty Ty, and everyone are very kind.

Dear Manager, thank you again for everything. Your thoughtfulness is always appreciated.
God Bless
sample_reviews_en.author: Racha King

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of halal food restaurant at Iconsiam Mall. Masala Art is located on the 6th floor of Iconsiam Mall. Its location is not far from the elevator and the fountain.

The restaurant is spacious with a wide variety of menu options. You will receive a free appetizer, such as chips with sauce.

I ordered 1 biryani rice, 1 roti prata, and naan, which were enough for 2-4 people.

The prices are affordable, and the taste is good, not overly spiced, making it still suitable for non-Indian people like us.
sample_reviews_en.author: N.R.H

sample_reviews_en.text: We had a wonderful dining experience at Masala Art in Thailand Bangkok Sima Icon mall. The food was absolutely delicious, with rich flavors and excellent quality that truly captured the essence of authentic Indian cuisine. Every dish was beautifully prepared and full of taste. A special thank you to Mr. Sagar, our waiter, for his warm hospitality and attentive service — he made our meal even more memorable. Highly recommend for anyone looking to enjoy an exceptional Indian dining experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: baja subteam

restaurants.name: Jabpae Chonkae
restaurants.address:

101 Ratchaphruek Rd, Khwaeng Bang Ramat, Khet Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went for dinner and ordered the snakehead fish salad.
The food smelled bad and was inedible. I told the staff, but they didn't help.

I checked the bill and went to another restaurant for dinner.

The food in a restaurant must be clean. It's very important. I got diarrhea and it was not worth it.

I left the restaurant feeling very disappointed.
I reported it on Facebook and they just didn't apologize.

One time, and I won't go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sky Vpncool

sample_reviews_en.text: It used to be a fun place, but now it's completely changed and no longer a pleasant place to sit. The old way was a thousand times better. I'm not sure if it's a new owner, but they haven't kept the old style. My favorite place is gone. The food is also quite expensive compared to the old place. Not okay at all. It's a shame they don't know how to manage it. 😓😓
sample_reviews_en.author: ศิริรัตน์ วิบูลย์เวชวาณิชย์ (may)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered a steamed egg hot pot and waited 20-30 minutes, but when it arrived, the shrimp waste hadn't been completely removed. The cook isn't meticulous for a restaurant of this caliber. Not okay ☹️
#But thankfully, they made a new one right away after I told them 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Tiffy Gb

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a cozy atmosphere, the food is as delicious as ever, and the German Red Sun beer is so smooth and easy to drink, the glass is empty in no time. The music is great and the sound system is good. I highly recommend this place, you have to come!!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kavita Chaisorn

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a place for men who want to relax from work and stress. You'll feel happy here. I recommend bringing your Black Card; it's highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: 6 Tunwa

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere of the restaurant is great, the staff are attentive and very friendly, and all the food is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanya

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere was so much fun!
There were so many people listening to music and dancing, it was really enjoyable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charusporn Chongcharoen

sample_reviews_en.text: The German draft beer at Tawan Daeng is excellent; you can even create foam art with your own face on it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mod Kanyarat

restaurants.name: Yod Restaurant 2
restaurants.address:

971 Lasalle 75 Alley, Bang Na Tai, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
This is my favorite local Thai restaurant around my neighborhood when I crave for “rice porridge with a lot of side dish”  or “ร้านข้ามต้มกุ๊ย” in Thai. And of course, you can order steam rice here as well. I couldn’t count how many times I’ve been here already.

There are varieties of dish to choose from their menu and the taste is always great. The dish I always order are “spicy soup with chicken feet” and “stirred fried morning glory”. The spicy fresh crab salad is also good but could be a bit challenged for people who is not used to fishy smell.

The restaurant is clean for street food and service is very fast. There is always full of locals customers so you can really feel that it’s a popular place in this neighborhood.
sample_reviews_th.author: KN IWN

sample_reviews_en.text:
A classic Thai-Chinese boiled rice (khao tom) establishment offering a comforting, no-frills dining experience. The highlight lies in the wide selection of flavorful side dishes available to accompany the rice—ranging from stir-fried vegetables to savory meats and seafood, all designed for sharing.

Portion sizes are reasonable, and the pricing is refreshingly affordable, making it an excellent option for casual group dining or a satisfying late-night meal. The flavors are robust and deliver exactly what one would expect from a well-executed khao tom meal.

Ample parking is available behind the restaurant, adding to the overall convenience.
Highly recommended for those seeking a traditional and budget-friendly Thai-Chinese meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: TP TP

sample_reviews_en.text: You can see the restaurant like this everywhere in Thailand by marking on the key words “Khao-Tom” which means porridge in Thai. In here, there are many kinds of dishes such as Tom-yum soup and crab fried rice which are I loved. Anyway, in the restaurant there is a room to have a meal in the Air-conditioned room, but you need to pay 10THB extra per person. So, you can choose where you would prefer. But, for me sit outside is not bad. For those person who driving to there you can park the car behind the restaurant, get into the alley after it and you will see the sign. If you plan to drink beers, I suggest you not to drive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natsima Chuenthammanat

sample_reviews_en.text:
I frequent Yot Khao Tom Lasalle often. The food comes out very quickly, no long waits. It's perfect for late-night meals or when you want something quick and easy.
There's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, and the taste is delicious and well-balanced. It's great with hot rice porridge. The restaurant is clean and comfortable.
Another thing I like is that there's convenient parking, no need to circle around looking for a spot. Overall, it has everything: speed, deliciousness, and convenience. I give it 5 stars!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ferruccio Espada

sample_reviews_en.text: Thai-Chinese style restaurant, best enjoyed with steamed rice or rice porridge. They offer a wide variety of dishes. I really like their deep-fried dishes. It can get crowded with a long queue. There is an air-conditioned room available, with a 10 THB charge per person. Price is a bit high, but still reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pipo Travelgeek

sample_reviews_en.text:
After covid19 this restaurant also need time to recovery.

They serve original local thai food, various food, Tomyom Koong also one of the best.

Price reasonable,
Taste very good,
A lot car parking behind the restaurant.

Should try this shop one of best for this local foods.
sample_reviews_en.author: Niroot Manakitpinyo

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been eating at this restaurant for a very long time and come here often.
The restaurant has parking available at the back, with plenty of space.
There are tables both inside the air-conditioned room and outside. …
sample_reviews_en.author: DewSuth P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recommend Crispy Squid with Chili Paste.

+ Good test
+ Fast served
+ Price is acceptable
+ A lot of carpark

- Extra 10 baht/person for sit in air conditioning room
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuengruthai Mingkwansatit

restaurants.name: Sushiro (Emporium)
restaurants.address:

ศูนย์การค้า ดิ เอ็มโพเรียม ห้องเลขที่ 4P01 ชั้น 4 622 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve been to sushiro multiple times and I will never get board of it. The vibes are nice with sushi constantly scrolling by and when you see something you love, it feels like you hit the jackpot. If you’re not a fan of gambling, you can always order from the tablet. They also have many other menu items that aren’t sushi like ramen, chicken and desserts as well as an unlimited drink bar refill. Their menu is pretty big which means you won’t get bored of the food. The only problem is that there are a lot of people but that can be fixed easily by a reservation. The staff are also super kind and are easy to call over with the button on the tablet. Even though ordering sushi might take a little long, you can always grab the plates from the conveyer and the ordered ones have a fun way of reaching you which is through another conveyer. Finally, their system is really fast and intuitive. There are 5 colors of plates, each corresponding to a different price. At the end, the staff scans all the plates and you go pay which can be done with a staff member or at a self serve kiosk.

Overall, sushiro has some good food and you can visit multiple times without getting bored.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalunnop Charnond

sample_reviews_en.text:
Compared to the IconSiam branch, I give this Sushiro branch a perfect score! Even though everything else is practically the same, the taste and freshness of the food here are hands down much better. I wonder why there's such a difference!

If you want to avoid waiting in line, I recommend visiting between 2:00 PM and 6:00 PM. You can just walk right in without a reservation.

The food is truly delicious. The fish slices seemed a tiny bit thinner than before, but they were incredibly fresh, sweet, and didn't taste fishy at all!
sample_reviews_en.author: Veracious reviewer

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐

Overall, we were pleased with our visit. The sushi was varied and everyone should find something they like. A big plus is that tea is included in the price.
The downside is the rather long wait. Some sushi pieces also had to wait a while because they took a while to appear on the conveyor belt. On the other hand, we were quite late, so it's possible that the earlier the time, the wider the selection, and everything arrives faster.
Overall, the place is a positive experience, but it's worth keeping the wait time in mind.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julka Korzeniewska

sample_reviews_en.text:
✨🇯🇵 Sushiro, my number one conveyor belt sushi restaurant! They have a diverse menu, fresh fish, and their fried items are amazing. Great value for money! 😋💗 I love that they have special monthly menus, and the amazing dishes make me want to go back every month! 🐟🌈

💫 I recommend booking a table through the app beforehand. When you arrive, just give your booking number to the staff and wait. The wait time isn't too long now if you booked in advance.
sample_reviews_en.author: happynottiimeal

sample_reviews_en.text: The place is nice overall like other Sushiro restaurants, and it's one of the best conveyor belt sushi places in Bangkok, but I was placed in table 20 and it was right behind the very loud and obnoxious kitchen alarm for new orders. This destroyed my experience. I didn't ask to change because I wasn't going to stay long, and it's one of their available tables anyway. The experience near the kitchen is terrible in this branch...
sample_reviews_en.author: Richard William

sample_reviews_en.text: During peak hours, the queue is quite long. It's like, people in line at 220 or 221 are about to get in, but then people on the waiting list, like 201 or 179, show up and get in first. This happens most often at this branch. The food is fresh, but sometimes when you order, the food isn't chilled, like it's just taken from the conveyor belt. This branch has a lot of young children with their parents, so it can be quite chaotic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutcha “Natcha.niiw49” Wich

sample_reviews_en.text: The food serving area was noisy. The price did not include a 10% service charge (the service at Sushiro restaurants is the same everywhere – food is served via conveyor belt, and I didn't feel any special service). The price-performance ratio is not as good as Sushiro in Japan, and the price is the same as in Beijing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Coda

sample_reviews_en.text:
So glad I finally got to try this place. It’s always packed and the waiting line is so long.
The sushi, nigiri and rolls are super fresh. We ordered quite a bit of food to try and the bill was just over 670 baht ($20). It’s not fancy or high end but it’s great value for good food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hend Fakhroo

restaurants.name: Tiew Copper Craft
restaurants.address:

991 Siam Paragon, Floor 5 (Nextopia Zone, Rama I Rd, Pathumwan, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Unfortunately, this restaurant cannot compete in the high-end mall dining market. This was actually my first time trying Copper, a well-known name in the buffet scene.

I decided to try two of their signature items: the truffle mushroom soup with croissant and the boat noodles. To be honest, neither lived up to the hype.The flavors were disappointing, especially considering the restaurant’s reputation.

The croissant was shockingly small,so small that it honestly looked unappealing.

As for the boat noodles, the thin rice noodles were clumped together in a solid mass, which showed poor preparation and greatly affected the texture and overall eating experience.

Overall, the prices are unreasonably high when compared to the quality, taste, and overall standard of the food. I can confidently say that I won’t be returning, and this experience has also discouraged me from trying buffet dining...

While the location is bad, so loud and unmatch the music that you can hear two different kinds of it. Lmao
sample_reviews_en.author: mini kimtae

sample_reviews_en.text:
A newly opened noodle shop located in the new Nextopia zone at Siam Paragon. This restaurant is a spin-off from the well-known international buffet, Copper, and it brings one of their signature dishes—beef boat noodles—as the main highlight.

The beef boat noodles are very rich and flavorful. If you choose the clear soup version, it leans slightly sweet but still has a bold and well-balanced taste. Overall, the noodles are delicious and reasonably priced, making it a solid choice for a satisfying meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chopin

sample_reviews_en.text: Came here for early dinner and was greeted by friendly staff and was able to be seated quickly. I had the braised beef boat noodle and the meat was fall of the bone tender, the broth was flavorful without being spicy, and the noodles were al dente. The only downside is I wanted another bowl right after I finished. The fried chicken wings appetizer came out hot and crunchy but arrived after the noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rosalyn Komol

sample_reviews_en.text: Located on the upper level of the shopping mall, the place has a really nice atmosphere. The boat noodles were a bit on the salty side for me. The staff were friendly, but not particularly attentive—just a heads-up, they do charge a 10% service fee. Without that, the prices would be pretty reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yibo Zhang

sample_reviews_en.text: Incredible depth of flavor in the Boat Noodles! The broth is thick and authentic. I loved the variety of textures, from the silky noodles to the crunchy pork skins. The addition of the truffle soup and croissant makes for a unique, high-end lunch experience. Clean space and great presentation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthanit Pavasudh

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here many times. I like the boat noodles at this shop because the flavor is rich and well-seasoned, and the noodles are perfectly cooked, especially the thin noodles which are chewy. The steamed rice pudding has a rich Thai coconut flavor and is very delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Book Bucherer

sample_reviews_en.text:
Another great authentic Thai boat noodle in Siam Paragon.

The vibe is modern chill with a moderate level of service (could be better). The dishes are outstanding, the noodles are thick spicy umami.

I recommend my friends to come for a valuable noodle meal !

Cheers !!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tidbit Channel

sample_reviews_en.text: This boat noodle shop is truly famous and highly recommended. Great value for money with an incredibly rich and delicious flavor. Normally, you would only find this dish as part of a buffet menu, but now it’s finally available à la carte, which is amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: chayanun Phichitpricha

restaurants.name: Ping's Thai Teochew Seafood Restaurant
restaurants.address:

444 Phaya Thai Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best Chinese seafood meals I've had in a long time. Every dish was incredibly well-balanced and seasoned, not overly salty like many Chinese restaurants, you could actually taste the freshness and natural flavours of the ingredients.

The standout for me was the fried fish maw with prawns. The fish maw was perfectly fried, so it had a light crisp exterior while still being bouncy and chewy. It had also absorbed the sweetness and flavour of the prawns, making every bite so delicious 😋.

The shark fin soup was another highlight. The portion was very generous, and you could tell it had been simmered for hours. The broth was rich, fragrant, and full of depth without being heavy.
I also highly recommend the oyster omelette. It was crispy around the edges, fluffy in the middle, packed with oysters, and affordable!

Overall, every dish we ordered tastes amazing with quality ingredients. If you're looking for classic Chinese seafood done right, this place is definitely worth visiting. I'II definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Amanda So

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dined at Ping’s Thai Teochew Seafood Restaurant and had a really enjoyable experience.

The restaurant is run by Singaporeans, and you can tell the standards are there. Every dish we ordered was well executed and full of flavour.

Highlights for me were the Braised Fish Maw with Crabmeat in Claypot, Fried Oyster Omelette on Sizzling Hot Plate, Deep Fried Crab Meat Roll, and the Braised Goose Web & Noodle in Claypot. All were nicely done and very satisfying.

Ended the meal with the Chilled Coconut Jelly, which was refreshing and perfect in Bangkok’s heat.

Overall, a great meal and definitely worth a visit if you’re in the area 👍😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Raymond Lim

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very comforting meal here at Ping’s (as always)

Can’t go wrong with their shark’s fin soup and hearty Chinese style dishes. Loved their crab curry, which was tasty, and not too spicy; even the kids loved it! Prawn glass noodles was decent, but not the star dish

This outlet looked like it had seen better days, as when we reached at 5pm, the place seemed closed (lights not on, and no staff to be seen) Their service staff only appeared when we entered the restaurant and called out to see if anyone was in.

Do hope more people can come support/try their food, as it would be a pity if they close down
sample_reviews_en.author: The Wandering Foodie

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is excellent. The service is tip top.
We are not locals and Restaurant Manager was able to explain and recommend dishes to us without overselling. This says a lot about their customer service. We tried the sharks fin and fish maw. Both were excellent. Will recommend to anyone looking for authentic Thai Teochew cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Average Guy

sample_reviews_en.text: A very authentic Teochew cuisine restaurant. We had the large sharksfin claypot, braised goose web noddle claypot & deep fried crab meat roll. Fresh seafood well executed in Teochew style. Excellent service especially the manageress who speaks English. Comfortable air conditioned ambiance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Frank P

sample_reviews_en.text: Enjoyed the lunch so much we came back for dinner too! Ordered crab vermicelli claypot, fish maw & prawn, sharks fin with chicken stock soup. All the dishes were authentic Teochew dishes & fresh. The crab was as a standout. Finished the meal with a refreshing coconut jelly desert.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lena T

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered fish maw soup. This dish is outrageously delicious. The rich soup is multi- level and my mind was blown away.
Garlic prawns were very fresh and the dessert is so old school. Reminds me of my childhood days and my mother’s cooking.
sample_reviews_en.author: James NG

sample_reviews_en.text: ⭐️ Great first impression! The service is excellent, especially the waiter who was very attentive and friendly. My friends recommended this restaurant, and the food is absolutely delicious! 😋 Highly recommended! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Louis Thong

restaurants.name: Jones' Salad สาขา ลา วิลล่า อารีย์ (La Villa Ari)
restaurants.address:

Jones' Salad ชั้น 1 สาขาลาวิลล่าอารีย์, 358 Phahonyothin Rd, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted good in every dish. Almost all the staff at the bar were attentive and explained the drinks well. My only complaint was a staff member named "Nok," who stood at the front serving customers. She was constantly on her phone, looking down at the screen the entire time. Even when she came to take orders, she still held her phone. As soon as she placed the ice and water on the table, she immediately went back to leaning against a pillar and playing on her phone. She was so distracted that she spilled ice on a customer's table. Another customer at a table asked for a toothpick, and she only grabbed one, even though there were two of them. She didn't even see the customer when they waved because she was so engrossed in her phone. I recommend checking the security camera footage and monitoring this staff member's performance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dear V.

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. I ordered a chicken steak, but the chicken wasn't hot at all. However, the staff were lovely and reheated it for me.
2. The service was good, but the staff had to come too close to talk to me; they were too far away.
3. 😩😩😩 The restaurant was noisy. There were about 10 delivery riders waiting inside, and some were loud and disruptive, arguing with the staff (very unpleasant and impolite, I felt sorry for the staff) and talking loudly amongst themselves. They should have a separate waiting area for delivery riders compared to customers dining in to create a better atmosphere.
This was my first time eating at Pirate's & Restaurant, and it wasn't a very impressive experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nwr Tnrr

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff weren't very friendly; it felt like we were bothering them. I ordered watermelon juice, but it tasted more like papaya juice. We were a family with two children and had to ask for separate plates for the kids several times before we finally got them. The food was generally okay, not terrible, but I probably wouldn't come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Xayn10

sample_reviews_en.text: Finally it’s here!!! This is one of my fav salad places in BKK in terms of value for money. I went on the opening day and got 20% discount woot woot not sure until when. Their portions are great, very fulfilling. Place is a bit small so takeaway could be a better option. Overall im really happy and definitely going back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ernst J

sample_reviews_en.text:
Poor queue management.

When there were large tables, we let a few people get a table. This was a first-come, first-served situation.

When it was our turn, we didn't offer any more seats before letting two people skip the queue.

Next time, if I come and don't see the same team, I'll ask again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chimi Raikkonen

sample_reviews_en.text: The salad was delicious, the steak was good, and the soup was tasty. It was great overall, but unfortunately, the restaurant has limited seating. After our meal, we went for a walk nearby. There's the La Villa shopping center and a new building with a Cafe Amazon that looked nice to browse.
sample_reviews_en.author: karnwalai umklang

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate sushi upstairs and then walked around and found this place. Their drinks are tastier than the famous brands that cost 250++ baht per glass. This place sells them for just over 100 baht (190 baht) and they get your drink quickly. I'm hooked! I wish they would open a branch in Rayong.
sample_reviews_en.author: Makcita Gaytirapan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was incredibly delicious and the portions were huge! It was a little bit of a wait though, understandable given the crowd and online orders. Luckily, we arrived early, otherwise we wouldn't have gotten a table. But the food was amazing, everything was delicious! 5/9/68
sample_reviews_en.author: Note.nitipat

restaurants.name: Bardo Social Bistro and Bar
restaurants.address:

28, 12 Sathon Soi 10, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Came here for lunch and the experience was good. Nice relaxed ambiance as soon as I stepped inside the restaurant, followed by welcoming restaurant managers and the rest of the staff. Although I want to note on some unsettling moist / clothy smell permeating through the air. I had no idea what it was but if that weren't present then the overall atmosphere would've been very nice. On the food, we had the burata pasta, eggplant quinoa and the steak (I forgot all the formal names of the dishes unfortunately), and enjoyed them along with the coffees. Personal highlight was the burata, although the steak I find was bland and heavy on oil as well as the eggplant being just OK and also a little heavy on the oil. On the good note the portions of each dishes were filling. Otherwise, the lunch was topped off with something sweet which was the pancake with assorted berries and chocolate sauce - quite indulgent and enjoyable. Prices are not cheap. Overall, an OK experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ceylon Soul

sample_reviews_en.text: Went with my family for lunch on a public holiday and used the Chope coupon. Service was great from the highly responsive IG admin to the staff in the restaurant. Would call it a European food bistro, quite pricey, taste was not bad but it wasn't special either. Ribeye steak (ordered medium-rare and got medium) and Pork Chops were a bit tough, the sides were well done be it the potatoes that came with steak or the ratatouille. Cold cuts were huge portions with lots of other appetizers that were quite nice - cheeses were mostly on the mild side. 60THB to a 500ml glass bottle of Singha water was quite overpriced though. ONE parking spot in front of resto, you need to do road parking or find one of the parking lots that charges 50/hr nearby. No milk-alternatives for coffee, actually, restaurant doesn't seem to cater to allergies/intolerance, kind of hard for a group with lactose intolerant or vegan to locate a suitable dish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Monsicha Pongrujikorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
had a 3-courses meal for 2 people. huge portion (maybe for Thais) my tummy was fed up since appetizer

🥂 house sparkling - mild taste easy to sip

🥯 table bread was okay, not a freshly baked
🧈 garlic butter was appetizing 😋

🥙 beef tartare - 10/10 dominated by acidity but the meat itself is sweet, fries are superrr
🧀 fried brie - lower than expectations; the bread cover outside was too thick so finishing the whole plate is impossible

🐟 grilled seabass - toooo salty but ratatouille is okay
🥩 bavette black pepper steak - a lil bit chewy but overall this is my 2nd fav dish

🍫 tiramisu - creamy and rich, love it
🍮 panna cotta - passion fruit poured on top, too sharp & sour, prefer the berries

in-store service was great! 🌟
actually i booked the table in advance but didn’t get the reserved spot. there were another customers at that table already.
sample_reviews_en.author: jj

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was our second time dining here because we really enjoyed our first visit. The food was great, we ordered the chicken liver pate, spaghetti vongole, and lamb shank.

Unfortunately, we found an unidentified object I think it might be a cockroach. So we couldn’t finish our meal.

The staff simply told us it was the rainy season and that these things happen. We weren’t expecting a free meal, but a more thoughtful response, such as replacing the dish, or asked us if we are okay would have been appreciated.

It’s a shame because the food itself was excellent, but how the situation was handled left us disappointed. If you’re planning to dine here during “the rainy season”, just be aware that this was our experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pat Suphangkanan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went again twice this past week.  The restaurant remains one of the best all around neighborhood bistros in Sathorn.

The quality, quantity and presentation of the food always gets high marks.  Japan does a great job as a bartender, and the staff is always very attentive.   I love the weekend freeflow brunch does not disappoint and more people need to find out about the great value and quality of food and drinks !

And of course ... how could anyone forget the amazing Chicken Milanese !  Vadim and Arthur have put together a great place in the neighborhood to relax and have a good meal, with a European bistro flair.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jim Anthony

sample_reviews_en.text:
Bardo Social Bistro and Bar is my go-to place for casual Western food. The restaurant has a relaxed, social bistro vibe that works well for both easy dinners and catching up with friends. It’s a cozy Mediterranean-inspired bistro known for approachable comfort dishes and a solid drink selection.

The pasta is always cooked just right, and the flavors across the menu are consistently balanced. The fried chicken is crispy, light, and not oily. To finish the meal, the tiramisu is a perfect ending.

Reliable food, friendly service, and a comfortable atmosphere make this a place I keep coming back to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jan PS

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd love to write a fantastic review because I'm thrilled! The schnitzel and pasta were REALLY delicious. We booked them based on the reviews and weren't disappointed. The Burrata with pasta was also wonderful. The wine was good, high quality. I had a mocktail and asked if they could make it unsweetened (I can't have sugar), and the lovely waiters brought me some syrup on the side! Thank you for listening to me! It's a really nice place to sit and chat with friends and drink wine. The waiters are lovely, the music is good, honestly, everything is great! I'll remember this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Оксана Тусина

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a wonderful Mediterranean restaurant, especially for a weekend evening, though it also makes an excellent dinner spot on any night of the week. The cuisine leans mostly French, and the manager is French as well, but the menu also features some Italian and Spanish influences.

The prices are very reasonable considering the quality of the food and the location. They also offer attractive happy hour promotions, with bottles of wine available from 1,000 Baht plus service.

Every dish we tried was excellent, and we’ll definitely be coming back to explore more of the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

restaurants.name: PONTE Cafe by Chef Mine
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 1, 2 Krungthep Kritha 8 Alley, Lane 10, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Four of us tried everything on the signature menu and were not disappointed with any dish. To describe it in detail, which may be lacking because of the width of my descriptive ability:
The caesar salad was slightly but pleasurably off the beaten track in that the taste took the route off the usual toasted bread cubes and replaced by croissant bits interspersed with baby tomatoes, all improving the taste.
Next was a spicy sausage pizza which needed nothing more than a sprinkle of tabasco sauce to make it perfect.
Next came the German pork knuckle which came crispy on all sides already sliced off the bone for our convenience. Excellently creamy mashed potatoes in light gravy were added to make up for sauteed potatoes not available on the day. The whole crunchy knuckle disappeared in a flash.
Next was another signature dish, scallop fettucini in truffle sauce, magnifique.
Lastly was spaghetti pad mee Korat. This was a new one on us and did not disappoint in spite of its belying common name.
For dessert we had a tiramisu (giant portion), blueberry cheese pie and couple more items from the cake bar.
In all, a feast!
Must be repeated in the not too distant future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panit Nilubol

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love everything about this place. ❤️

Food: Delicious! I had a rice meal, a coffee, and a dessert. 💗

Staff/Service: Very friendly and accommodating. They served quickly and with a smile, and I see one of them talking to the customers and I think it’s great because he makes people feel comfortable. I didn’t get to talk that much because I was so hungry. 😆

Location: Perfect and easy to find. If you have a car, they have a parking area. If you travel by MRT (Yellow line), the closest station is Si Kritha. 🚆

Ambiance: Cozy, somewhat like being in Europe. The place was nicely decorated and it is so beautiful!

WiFi: Yes - they have WiFi. I see someone working with their laptop so I think it’s okay to work there (but order something). 💻

RECOMMENDED? 💯
You should definitely pay a visit and eat at this restaurant. ❤️

I would love to come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mika Ceferina Salvador

sample_reviews_en.text:
Is it expensive?! You have to try it for yourself. I can tell you it's worth the price. Delicious, with both Western and Thai flavors.
The restaurant is decorated in an English house style, with various flowers and many decorative collectibles, just like the extensive menu with both savory and sweet dishes. The plating, taste, and portion size are excellent value. It was so delicious I forgot to take pictures of the first few dishes! They have a variety of drinks including coffee and other beverages.
The staff provides excellent service and even offered to take photos for us without being asked. The chef came out to greet, thank, and chat with customers.
There's plenty of parking, shady trees and flowers, and a spacious area. The restaurant has many photo spots and relaxing seating areas.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prapas Ton

sample_reviews_en.text:
A beautiful and wonderful place, hidden from public view in a blind spot that you could walk by and never notice it.
So green and amazing place, full of trees and has a center court water feature. The front garden has many dining areas scattered around in the open air, and also a number of dining tables inside the main building in air conditioned room. You might have a chance to get greeted by the Chef himself.
The menu has plenty to choose from, Thai and Western cuisines ranging from starters to mains and beyond.
Presentation was excellent and so was preparation and very nicely spiced (as per personal liking).
Coffee was great too.
Highly recommended and very satisfying and enjoyable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Husain AlHusaini (Husain_Tula)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was good, with well-balanced flavors. I tried the Salmon Wellington; it was perfectly baked, the pastry was fragrant and delicious – the star of the show. The spinach cream was good, but the salmon was a little fishy, ​​so I needed lemon to balance it out. It seemed like the restaurant also provided sour cream, but I didn't notice or acknowledge their recommendation, so it was slightly diminished in flavor.

The atmosphere was like a European country. The prices were mid-range; if the service were more attentive, it wouldn't feel expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Varut

sample_reviews_en.text: Fresh breeze, good cake and food, nice staff and amazing garden for Coffee. You can also buy plants especially cactus plants. I basically fall in love with the place. All English menu and quick service. We chose to sit both inside and outside. Spent 5 hours to enjoy the atmosphere. Brilliant idea for a coffee shop. Clean setup and excellent place for a couple of hours to work. Greenery area is my favourite. Restroom inside as well as outside. Car parking is enough for as many spots as tables. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nanda Linn Aung

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is spacious with many trees, providing shade and a pleasant atmosphere.
However, the April weather was too hot to sit outside.

The staff and owner were very lovely and provided excellent service.

The food was delicious, especially the baked clams with butter. They used croissants instead of bread, which were crispy and delicious.
The truffle mushroom pizza was also delicious, with a thin and crispy crust.

There is parking available at the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sara A

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious!
The shop is very cute and the owner is very kind.
Today I ordered: Croissant gratin with clams and cheese,
Truffle mushroom pizza,
Carbonara pizza,
Roti with green curry pork,
and fruit salad with crispy fish.
It was the owner's birthday today, so they gave us a complimentary cake!
Sorry, I didn't have time to take pictures of the food; it was too delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: sutinee saipothong

restaurants.name: Tonkin Annam
restaurants.address:

69 Maharat Rd, แขวง พระบรมมหาราช, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The food we ordered was extremely good. I almost ordered seconds while I was there. The place was small but it wasn’t very busy so we didn’t have an issue sitting 5 of us.

The food came out quickly. Total for 5 people was ฿1,430 which translates to about 46 USD ~9/pp. I would definitely recommend  if you’re in the area. They did charge us for two waters even though we only got one but whatever.
sample_reviews_th.author: Samira Dasilva (Sam)

sample_reviews_en.text:
2023 visit was amazing! Egg coffee and banh canh was delicious!
2025 visit was terrible! Everything was costly and taste yuck! Banh canh barely had any noodle and it costs 180 baht. The egg coffee was served with just 3ounce. The pork roll was just fatty meat that looks like zombie flesh when bitten onto 🤢 only the egg roll fried was good but that was overpriced… I don’t know what happened. We finished and had to go find street food because it was barely filling…. Kitchen was slow, we had 4 people and each entree came out one at a time then the drinks finally came out after we finished eating. So we didn’t eat together and drink after we eaten!!!! D: the payment area was weird too! They had a screen and customer can only see the bill and not the face of the person giving the bill. It just seems a rude experience!

Will not come back 😔😔😔
sample_reviews_en.author: mars gemini

sample_reviews_en.text: This Vietnamese restaurant at Tha Tien serves rice paper wrappers for Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage). Normally, these wrappers need to be soaked in water beforehand, but here they're ready to eat as soon as you roll them up. I don't know what technique they use, but the wrapper softens instantly when you put it in your mouth. Many dishes have a similar flavor profile, emphasizing lots of vegetables. The shrimp wrapped in sugarcane and Nem Nuong are made fresh daily, and the pork and shrimp taste delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aphisit Techanitisawad

sample_reviews_en.text:
What used to be a small shop tucked away in a quiet alley has completely changed its atmosphere. Tongking Annam is a restaurant we admire for its concept, its story behind becoming this place, and its food.

The taste of the food is still the same even after many years. We only stopped by briefly to try the Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork skewers) with its crispy, slightly salty rice paper that we both love, and the Vietnamese crepe, a dish that my friend suddenly said we *had* to eat! 😆
sample_reviews_en.author: Panshewa P.

sample_reviews_en.text: I frequent this restaurant often. Many dishes are exquisite, thanks to meticulous preparation, such as the Hue-style pho and banh beo, considered exceptional in Vietnamese cuisine. The fried shrimp spring rolls also have a unique, woven wrapper that you won't find anywhere else. I recommend sitting upstairs; the atmosphere is more beautiful than downstairs. The owner, Khun Kai, is knowledgeable and very hospitable. The staircase is a bit narrow, but that's part of the building's charm.
sample_reviews_en.author: S.K. Seataphong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located right by the pier, down a side street with a view of Wat Arun. Inside, the atmosphere is quiet and relaxing, perfect for a casual chat.

This was my first time here with just one friend, so we only tried two dishes: Bun Cha and Banh Beo. They were good, but nothing exceptionally amazing. I wish the Bun Cha broth was bigger, as it's the heart of the dish. I'll try other dishes next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Blair

sample_reviews_en.text: Wow, after so many days in Bangkok, I unexpectedly discovered a Vietnamese restaurant right near my hotel, so I had to try the Hue-style beef noodle soup and grilled pork skewers. The familiar flavors earned me a 9 out of 10. The beef noodle soup wasn't as distinctly flavored as at home, but it was still delicious and fragrant. The grilled pork skewers were huge, and the dipping sauce was excellent! 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Trang Phạm

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall: Delicious

Local Vietnamese taste with good quality of ingredients. For me, I think it’s a bit high price compared to the portion.

The restaurant is quite small with the limited seats. I would recommend you to book in advance to make sure you will have seats. I really like the decoration. Feels like real local Vietnamese restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: fns

restaurants.name: Kuay Teow Kua Gai Aunty Pien
restaurants.address:

14 Fueang Nakhon Rd, Wat Ratchabophit, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
"Stir-fried Rice Noodles with Chicken"
If you're passing by this area, I highly recommend giving it a try!

The fragrant aroma of the wood-fired stove and the sizzling wok fills the air, making the whole dining experience even more enjoyable. The service is also excellent, and the auntie who runs the place is very kind and speaks so sweetly.

Recommendation: If you order the special version, you'll get a delicious combination of grilled pork, chicken, and crispy squid.

Price
Regular: 60 ฿
Extra: 70 ฿

----------------------------------------
A classic stir-fried rice noodle shop.
I highly recommend it to anyone passing by this area.
The fragrant aroma of the wood-fired stove and the sizzling wok makes the dining experience incredibly enjoyable.
The service is excellent, and the auntie speaks so sweetly.

Recommendation: If you order the special version, you'll get a delicious combination of grilled pork, chicken, and squid.
sample_reviews_th.author: Maru.y

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re looking for a nice stir-fry dish in Bangkok, you must try this place out! (If you don’t mind hygiene)

I went there for 4 times and only the 1st and 2nd did impress me. The flavours were phenomenal—springy and al dente noodles coated with a rich, umami flavour of seasoning with a nice breath of wok hay. The extra crunch from the pork lard enhanced the dish. Roast pork was also good but nothing much special. I highly recommend the rice noodles (sen lek) since it’s personally the best—springy, bouncy, fun to chew and coats well with that wok hay.

Everything seemed nice at first until I noticed the hygiene at this place. Flies gathering and even resting on the roast pork, water cups were really unhygienic with molds spotted, the place was really dirty with dirty, unorganized equipment and dark greened wall that seemed to be not taken care of that sits next to the food an equipment.

The food was good but the hygiene and quality was terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nachapol Sorndamrih (Taktai)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This stir-fried chicken and pork dish, cooked one batch at a time in a brass wok, is incredibly delicious. It's dry-fried, salty, and crispy with pork cracklings. The vermicelli noodles are especially good, dry-fried and fragrant, while the wide rice noodles are chewy and delicious with the roasted pork and stir-fried chicken. It was gone in no time!

You can get there by MRT, getting off at Sam Yot station. Personally, I took a boat to Ratchini Pier and walked for about 15 minutes.

After eating, you can stroll through the nearby Trok Mo morning market, which has tons of food.

I arrived at 8:30 AM and didn't have to wait long. The owner is very lovely. I recommend mixing the pork and chicken for the best flavor. I'll definitely go back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rung Sasinun

sample_reviews_en.text:
In A Nutshell:

-I discovered Aunty Piem's restaurant from my American buddy who lives in BKK.
-He learned about it from a YouTuber who covers food history in the city.
-This is how information spreads in real-time & I am glad I was able to come enjoy a hot bowl of dry noodles.
-I chose the chicken, nam man noi style (less oil).
-The niece & nephew (Pravit) were both working & Aunty Piem was close-by.
-I really enjoyed the meal & I was informed that everything is original & hasn't changed much in the 50 years of being in business.
-It was very nice to meet you Pravit, keep up your health & stay strong! 💪🏼

Overall, I appreciate authentic food like this amongst a local neighborhood close to the Grand Palace & a canal full of big fish.
sample_reviews_en.author: GlobeTrotter Lens

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! It's like traditional stir-fried chicken noodles, simple and classic, without the fancy additions of big prawns or onsen eggs. I prefer it this way. The shop has a simple, casual atmosphere. The owner and the person taking orders are friendly. The wait wasn't long. You can find parking on the street opposite Wat Suthat between 9:00 AM and 3:00 PM. Just avoid parking in the red and white zones. If you're lucky, there might be a parking spot available. It's a short walk along the canal. Most of the customers are foreigners.
sample_reviews_en.author: April Maysa

sample_reviews_en.text:
The stir-fried chicken noodles are delicious. It's not the crispy noodle type, but seasoned with a chili sauce similar to those found near the central hospital. The noodles have a wonderful wok aroma, and the ingredients like chicken, char siu pork, squid, and pork cracklings add a variety of flavors and textures.

The restaurant is located outdoors, so it might be hot, and there are quite a few birds. Overall, considering the taste and value for money, this place is great :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Panuwat Apiwattanachai

sample_reviews_en.text: The stir-fried chicken was delicious, and the marinated roast pork was incredibly flavorful – almost no need for extra seasoning. It was raining when I went, and everyone at the restaurant was so attentive. Auntie Pien was lovely and even gave the kids extra pork. A regular bowl was filling. Next time I'll order the mixed dish, it looks amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: anchalee chokampornsap

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of a few places that offer multiple type of noodles for frying. The thin rice noodle and yellow noodle are good alternatives from the standard broad/flat noodle. They also use Barbecue Pork (Red Pork) in their noodles other than chicken.

The Pork Crackling is outstanding. Among top of the city, if not Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Disciple789

restaurants.name: Giglio Trattoria Fiorentina
restaurants.address:

149 Sathon Soi 12 Alley, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The restaurant has a slightly homey Italian feel. The manager is quite friendly, and the waiters are attentive. The meat dishes are standard. The mussels in white wine sauce were good but a bit small. The fresh pasta was well-prepared, but the udon-style noodles weren't quite to my liking. The Peroni beer was excellent, the ham was good, and the vibrations were nice – quite warm and inviting.

Parking is available on the roadside. If it's full, there's a valet service with green vests in front of the restaurant. Personally, I parked in the parking lot for 50฿ per hour for peace of mind.
sample_reviews_th.author: 7ackie Srichompan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall, I was satisfied.

Food: 9/10 – Everything was delicious except for the final steak course.—>Update from 8 to 9 because the steak I had in the 2nd visit was excellent.
Service: 9/10 – Professional overall, although the wine refills could have been more attentive.
Atmosphere: 8/10 – Not flashy, but elegant, refined, and comfortably upscale.

Overall, the food was very good. I especially enjoyed the cold cuts and the pici pasta. I had high expectations for the steak, but it was disappointing. The dry-aged Wagyu was rather dry and lacked the rich aroma I was hoping for. Considering the price, it didn't live up to expectations.
The baked panna cotta wasn't particularly memorable to me, so next time I'd like to try the tiramisu instead.
There is an area upstairs that can be arranged into private dining rooms, making it a good choice for business dinners or group gatherings.
The service was excellent overall. However, they were unable to issue the receipt on the spot and told me they would send it by email. It wasn't sent promptly, and I had to call to follow up. I finally received it two days later. I hope they can handle this more efficiently in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gourmet Advisor

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tonight we had dinner at this extraordinary restaurant, and I want to share our experience. The food was excellent, the staff friendly and professional. I personally ordered a portion of Tuscan crostini with chicken livers, and I have to say they were truly delicious. For starters, I ordered pici with sausage ragù. The food was good, too, as was the pappardelle with wild boar that my wife ordered. For main course, we chose a fried lamb chop (just because the Thai cuisine had been too light in the past few days), and it was a true delight. It was incredibly light and delicious. The salsa verde was fresh and absolutely spot-on. I didn't order wine, but from what I gathered, the experience would be nothing but positive. This trattoria is a classic example of how to raise the bar for our cuisine around the world. I'll conclude by saying that I'm half Tuscan (from Maremma, to be precise), and rediscovering the flavors of home several kilometers away is a small, heartwarming treat. Well done, and congratulations to all the Italian-Thai staff.

P.S. Next time I'll be back for the tiramisu. I promise.
sample_reviews_en.author: Luca Gramiccia

sample_reviews_en.text:
We’ve dined here many times, and the one dish we never skip is the Pici al Ragù di Salsiccia. It’s packed with flavor, and the taste is remarkably consistent—always delicious. The octopus salad is incredibly fresh, light, and scrumptious. A fantastic dining experience every time.

On our most recent visit, we were celebrating my daughter’s birthday, and the restaurant kindly surprised her with a piece of cake and a candle. We truly appreciated this thoughtful and generous gesture, which made the occasion even more special. The attentive service and warm hospitality are just some of the reasons we keep coming back.

Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Annie Mose

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a quiet and relaxing atmosphere, making it a pleasant place to enjoy a meal. The staff were friendly, attentive, and provided excellent service throughout my visit.

As for the food, the flavors didn’t quite match my personal expectations. While the presentation was nice, I also felt that the portion sizes were a bit small for the price. Overall, it was a pleasant dining experience, and I hope to see even better value in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rosarin Katy Duchess of Bangsaen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Real Tuscan Italian cooking in Bangkok.
Small nice restaurant in Sathorn area.
Italian Chef & Owner.
Very good choice of tipical italian cold cuts and cured cheeses. Wonderfull Ribollita (florentine vegetable soup with Black cabbagge and bread).
Pici with wild boar meat sauce was rich and amazing.
Very nice wine selection at reasonable price.
A place to visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: claudio pistocchi

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is so cute! It was a surprise for both the person who made the reservation and the birthday person. We just wrote "Happy Birthday Jacky" in the request section when booking. After we finished eating and paid, they told us to wait because they had something for us, and then brought out the cake of the day with a message written on it. Loved it! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Khwanjai Boonhao

sample_reviews_en.text: Giglio was a pleasant surprise in Bangkok. I went with local friends who brought me there — six of us in total — and the food was excellent across the board, including the famed Fiorentina steak and a lovely Piemontese vitello tonnato. Great atmosphere, attentive service, and genuinely authentic Italian flavors. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Igor Mattio

restaurants.name: I love Thai Food
restaurants.address:

128 Chakrabongse Rd, Talat Yot, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
No Thailand vacation is complete without "I ❤️ ThaiFood." Whenever we're in Bangkok, we really look forward to it and have been coming back for almost 10 years. Now there are four of us; each of our children had their first Pad Thai here and became a fan instantly!

Dear "I ❤️ ThaiFood" team, you do a fantastic job every single day, working hard and always with a genuinely friendly smile, patience, honesty, and efficiency – many could learn a thing or two from you.

And we haven't even mentioned your truly outstanding cuisine, which has been excellent for years!!!! Keep up the great work!

Thank you so much for all the wonderful memories and the delicious treats you've served us. ... See you in a few days, our mouths are already watering! 😀
sample_reviews_en.author: Ka Tze

sample_reviews_en.text: Fantastic street-side dining with delicious Thai food! We visited I love Thai Food one evening for dinner, and it was really busy when we got there. They do have plenty of seating in their covered outdoor location on the roadside, but only one table for available due to their popularity. Great variety of dishes available, all of which are made fresh. Ordered two vegetable Khao Soi, which were really tasty. Fresh, flavourful, and delicious! Good portions, good value, and wonderful service. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Callaghan

sample_reviews_en.text: We came here after a disappointing experience at another restaurant, and it turned out to be a perfect choice. We received our drinks and food very quickly, and everything was delicious. The staff were extremely friendly, and the overall atmosphere was great. We will definitely come back and highly recommend this place if you want to eat well, affordably, and enjoy a pleasant atmosphere near Khao San Road.
sample_reviews_en.author: P K

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! I ordered the Thai stir-fried rice noodles with seafood and added an egg – it was so good!!! Of course, it was a little spicy; if you can't handle that, you should tell them. I love spicy hot pot, so the spiciness level was perfect for me! Highly recommended! Worth a try! And the price is very reasonable!
sample_reviews_en.author: 张钰欣

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was very cheap compared to other restaurants on the street (80 baht for vegetarian phad Thai). Phad Thai was pretty good and portion was alright. But wasn’t very traditional as there were vegetables like broccoli, cauliflower and baby corn in the phad Thai. Altogether I recommend due to cheap prices and good food
sample_reviews_en.author: Raihanna Faten

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food. The ambiance could be a little nicer, but it has its own charm and gives you the full Thai experience. The winner of the evening: Fried shrimp 🦐 - a must-try!

P.S.: The portions could be a tad bigger, but with such fair prices, you'll happily order another appetizer, for example.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lisa Knauer

sample_reviews_en.text: We loved this place so much we came two nights in a row. Both nights the food was amazing. The pad see ew is the best I’ve had, same with the pad thai and green curry soup with rice. Must try the curry it was so delicious. Such good chill vibes and not a long wait time despite being busy.
sample_reviews_en.author: edie mclean

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is fantastic!!! I used to come here when I lived in Bangkok and have since returned to eat here and it is just as good.
They are great at catering to vegetarians so just ask for no fish sauce! It is absolutely delicious and my personal favourite is the khao soi (vegetarian).
sample_reviews_en.author: Risha Raythatha

restaurants.name: Lebanese house. البيت اللبناني
restaurants.address:

399, ศูนย์การค้าพัทยา อเวนิว 9, Pattaya Sai Song Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
First time in my life to try Lebanese food!

Today is my second visit to this restaurant.  The lamb chop is tender & precisely cooked, neither under or overcooked. Taste not same as western restaurant but surprisely tasty!  3 lamb chops with fries just good enough for my stomach for lunch.  Chefs are good !!

My 3rd visit was on 8March 2026, still ordered  the lamb chop but shop served bigger size, make me very full while still delicious!

My 4th visit is today, 10 March 2026, tried the Lentil Soup & Kebab Lamb.  Soup first time tried, very special taste, its delicious. Lamb is not seasoned, first bite is tasteless, so I triedbthe rice, found that rice is seasoned, then I eat lamb & rice together, the outcome is excellent & delicious!

19 March 2026, tried the chicken wings which also my favourite, special taste not like western's nor Asian's but delicious!

22 March 2026, lamb again!
sample_reviews_en.author: K W

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located in the Avenue shopping centre glass fronted all around which can make it a bit of a fish bowl for people walking by.
The interior is really well done and the staff very friendly and efficient.
I had a lime and mint soda no added sugar which made it sharp and refreshing.
The humus and beef was good but did not come bread which I thought a bit odd so had to order two breads which were fresh and piping hot.
The chicken livers were nice and filling.
The salad could have been a lot better rather non descript.
A very nice touch at the end was the lemon scented wet wipe and cardomon tea which was delicious 😋.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Christou

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely fantastic! The food was bursting with flavor, beautifully presented, and served hot and fresh. The staff were warm, attentive, and made us feel truly welcome. The atmosphere was cozy yet elegant—perfect for both casual dining and special occasions. Highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a memorable meal! Mu second visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maria Moir

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually don’t write a reviews about any restaurant but man I have to give this beautiful restaurant the most delicious food I had in pattaya actually over all in Thailand I been in Thailand about 16 days this is the most relaxing place I been too food so delicious place so clean service so friendly thank you guys for this great experience
sample_reviews_en.author: Samer Rosha

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here for the enjoyment and excitement of trying Lebanese food. I just politely asked why the food didn't match the picture, but why did the owner get angry and speak rudely, even cursing in another language? The chicken liver was soaked in oil. This meal was very disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: chadcha punkasate

sample_reviews_en.text: I had an amazing experience at Lebanese House Restaurant! The food was absolutely delicious, especially the homemade hummus and vine leaves. The portions were generous, and the prices were very reasonable. It is a perfect spot for a relaxing meal. I will definitely be coming back
sample_reviews_en.author: Vision Logic

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was top-notch – the service, the atmosphere! The dishes were delicious and savory. We loved everything we ordered; we were thrilled with every dish! The owner was friendly and attentive. We'll definitely be back! We highly recommend this establishment!
sample_reviews_en.author: Malina Vladi

sample_reviews_en.text: poor quality food, i wonder how they got rated so high? Food that comes to to your table doesnt even resemble the photos on the menu. I make better humus then them at home. I told waitress the food doesnt look like the menu pictures, she …
sample_reviews_en.author: bernaz belibagli

restaurants.name: Jack Diamond
restaurants.address:

26 Krung Thonburi 2 Alley, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We went there on a Saturday night at peak dinner time (19:30-20:00). The restaurant was completely empty. Zero customers aside from us. Should’ve been a red flag, but reading the amazing reviews, we decided to still give it a try. Aside from taking our initial order and giving us the food, the waitress just got up and left us alone so we had to ask the man at the reception to ask for rice as the soup did not come with any. The “fresh” orange juice was powder juice with pulp floating in it, and although we didn’t drink any as it was gross, they still insisted on charging us. We didn’t bother arguing and just paid for everything as we ordered them, but we do have to say that the other reviews are unfortunately not good representation of the place. I added pictures of what we left (as you can see, we barely touched it), and the other soup we ordered (beef noodle soup) came spilled with hair in it. Again, nobody was there to help us, so we just paid and are somewhere else. Also, even though it’s a hotel, the credit card machines don’t have a tap function and do not take foreign cards. Bad food and lack of service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marie Kametani

sample_reviews_en.text:
Haven’t been to Thailand many times I am still impressed by the delicious food in this restaurant provides. It is my go to place during my day this winter.
The staff member there are very friendly and easy to communicate with in English. I do not want sugar and too much salt in my food and they always provided me with satisfaction.
Customers there are respectful and quiet. It’s a very nice place to relax even just over coffee or drink.
The only downside is its smell during the day. There is a very cute German Shepherd at the door. She doesn’t go into the restaurant, but somehow the restaurant smells animal. I’m very sensitive to smell so this bothers me a little, but I get used to it if I sit there for long.
sample_reviews_en.author: S Li

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently tried Jack Diamond (located on the 1st floor of W Station Hotel) and was very impressed. The restaurant is well-divided into zones, perfect for quiet work or a family outing with live music.

My recommended dishes:
• Beef Cheeseburger: The beef was incredibly juicy. I highly recommend adding bacon and egg – it's the best!
• Fried Sea Bass with Fish Sauce: Crispy on the outside, tender on the inside. The mango salad was deliciously spicy.
• Fried Pork Belly with Fish Sauce: So crispy and addictive!

🚗 Parking: Very convenient (in the alley next to The Rich Condo). Close to BTS Wongwian Yai, very easy to get to. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: มกรธวัช รัตนารักษ์

sample_reviews_en.text: Best burger I had in a while! They serve a mixture of Thai and Western food here. Offer chill places to sit, watch telly (sports), play games with friends and an outside terrace where one can smoke. Told my partner in crime that if they would come by the table and ask if everything is to our wishes I would give it an instant 5 ⭐ and seconds after they did! Always important 😄 Parking 🅿️ can be a bit of a problem but there are many small streets around and it's free..They have board games (Like Catan!)..10/10 revisiting 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Latte

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been hunting for a place like this for a while. The owner and waiter are both excellent and welcoming. The bartenders are amazing at mixing drinks. Coffee martini was fantastic.

There are several different items on the menu, including steak, Thai food, and Chinese food, I'm in love with the Grilled Beef Spicy Salads.

I suggest Jack Diamond if you're searching for a location to hang out that has a wonderful place, fantastic food, and great drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nat_shino

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the pleasure of dining at Jack Diamond. I must say, it was a delightful experience! From the moment we walked in, the warm and inviting atmosphere made us feel right at home.

The service was top-notch, with friendly and attentive staff who went above and beyond to ensure our needs were met. But the real star of the show was the Thai Isaan Steak dish 🤤

Rating: 5/5 stars

Price: $$

Will I return? Absolutely!
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexiwnl

sample_reviews_en.text: The Thai food here tastes like real Thai food, not overly spicy. The staff are friendly and the prices are good. They offer good recommendations. I recommend the stir-fried noodles with water spinach; the prawns are large, fresh, and have a nice bouncy texture, and the fish is fresh and crispy. They also have daily promotions. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mocha Coffee

sample_reviews_en.text: What a leisure time to be here!! I just finished working out at badminton court and craving for dinner. Then i stumbled upon this hidden restaurant nearby Wongwian yai station. The food is marvelous and the service is surprisingly fantastic. I would recommend this to be one of the best bistro in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nitiwat Onrat

restaurants.name: Somtamnua - Ekkamai Soi 6
restaurants.address:

Soi Sukhumvit 63, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Somtamnua just opened its new store with standalone format at Ekkamai Soi 6. If you are a big fan of Somatamnua or looking for Somtam/Isaan food with good vibe, I highly recommended to visit here!

My family and I have been big fans of Somtamnua for many years. We always visit their stores in Central Embassy and Central World, so this time, I got a chance to visit this new location with my friends.

At this store, its design and decoration are totally different from other stores. Well design with modern Isaan (Northeast) decoration. The lighting mood and tone are perfect for taking pictures of oursleves and  our foods as well.

There are also some exclusive menus to be served here. You should try it depending on your preferred selection, but most of them were amazing. Many local cocktalis and alcohols are also provided here. Let's enjoy your meal with their drinks!

Anyway, highly recommended to visit here. Great experience for this kind of new concept!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chawalit K

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ve been to this place 3 time in a week.

This is a Somtam restaurant with very cool and modern atmosphere. The decoration is like a very cool beach bar which is perfect for a date or even a party.

However, don't let the modern vibe tricks you, the food here is super authentic and provide a true test of e-san (north-eastern Thailand) food which is scrumptious and palatable. The drinks are worth noting as their cocktails  are mixed with the rare (but relatable) local booze and go well with the food.

The place is clean, the staff are nice, food is great. Trust you would enjoy iy like me and my friends do.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tarit C

sample_reviews_en.text: Somtam Nua's Ekkamai branch is located in the alley next to Big C. The atmosphere is pleasant, but there's a strange smell when you enter. There's plenty of seating, and the menu is quite diverse. The taste is average; the papaya salad is delicious, and the fried corn is good. The staff are friendly, but the manager's service is dismissive. Whether you eat in or take out, you're still a "customer." If they can't provide better service than the staff, they shouldn't charge a service charge for takeout. Unacceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narin P. Rattanaroj

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my second time eating at this branch. On my first visit, the restaurant gave me a discount coupon for my next visit. I asked the restaurant before ordering if the coupon was valid, but when it came time to pay, they said the coupon wasn't accepted and that I needed a physical gift card, which they didn't have at this branch. They never informed me of this beforehand, so I didn't get the discount this time. I feel this was a fake promotion and a deception of consumers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanakan Sriprom

sample_reviews_en.text: This is their first branch, a separate restaurant from the mall. It has its own parking lot. The restaurant is beautifully decorated in a Thai style, but the food prices here are higher than other branches. We weren't aware of this beforehand and were a little surprised that it was more expensive. However, the food quality is okay. We're deducting points for the service because the prices are a bit higher than elsewhere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patsaraporn Lipikanjanakul

sample_reviews_en.text: I recently had the opportunity to dine at the Ekkamai branch with friends. The music playing complemented the restaurant's atmosphere perfectly. All the food was delicious, especially the desserts that helped cool us down. The *grass jelly with fresh milk* was particularly amazing and perfect for this hot weather. I'll definitely go back again. The staff were also lovely and friendly. 😊👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploynapas Saktaranan

sample_reviews_en.text: Super satisfied with these Muay Thai shorts! The satin fabric is lightweight and smooth, no chafing during training. Elastic waist fits perfectly, wide leg design allows full range of motion for kicks and knees. Beautiful embroidery, well-stitched and great value for money. Highly recommend for Muay Thai & kickboxing training!
sample_reviews_en.author: P Lok Ho

sample_reviews_en.text:
All the papaya salad and spicy salads were quite salty. The food was average in taste.

The male staff member was unfriendly and showed displeasure and a sour expression when we informed him that the food served was incorrect. He didn't provide complete details and walked away without listening.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nokky Pichetchote

restaurants.name: Maderla
restaurants.address:

อาคาร G tower, Grand Floor B, ร้านมาเด้อหล่า by ภูไทไก่ย่าง 1971, Rama IX Rd, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Maderla is a good place for Issan food. You can find your favorites such as Som Tum and Grilled pork/chicken here.

I really enjoyed the grilled pork neck and Thai style papaya salad.

It can get busy at lunch time (12:00-1:00).

💰 It costs about 150฿ per person from my experience.

📍 A little difficult to find. It’s on the B1 floor in the corner near the Central Rama 9 entrance.
sample_reviews_th.author: Noom

sample_reviews_en.text:
North eastern Thai food, E SARN, you can try and enjoy. Taste quite authentic and they can adjust the level of spicy you can tolerate. Please be careful the spicy of food. English menu are available. Not much big space of seating but you can fit you and your group here for lunch or dinner. Located in the Basement next to Central Rama 9. Good taste !

Updated on November 2025
Taste are good as the same. Fresh ingredients and well cooked. Comfortable seating area. Enjoy !
sample_reviews_en.author: Supakij Khomvilai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Suddenly find this restaurant in the end of our shopping day.

It is located at the corner, floor B1, G Tower, nearby a connected way to Central Rama 9 mall.

The food is tasty, served fast even the restaurant is crowded. The price is reasonable.

The service staff is quick and friendly.

It can be a great place for a group of friends, colleagues gathering after work for dinner time, especially on Fridays, weekends.

The diced salmon salad is highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Triet Le

sample_reviews_en.text:
A northeastern thai food resraurant located in G tower near the connecting path from MRT station.

Fried fish cake was the best.

Papaya salad with fermented fish and crab was spicy while thai style was a bit too sweet.

Grilled chicken was too firm.

Pork rib spicy soup was very good.

Lots of rice including sticky rice and unpolished rice.

Good service from staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phanusorn Chancharoenchai

sample_reviews_en.text: Conveniently located near the subway, or you can drive and park at Central Rama 9 and walk from there. The food tastes good and the prices are reasonable. There's a huge menu to choose from. If you have foreign friends who want to try Northeastern Thai food, I think this is a great place. The seating is comfortable, and they also have beer and craft beers available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cooki3z Nyappy

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited the restaurant around 6:30 PM on a weekday. The food was delicious; Thai people shouldn't be disappointed. The papaya salad was nicely spicy and tasty, not too sweet – just right! The food didn't take too long to arrive. There was live music too, and the staff were lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pinyapatch I.

sample_reviews_en.text: Fantastic Lao-Isaan food in a bit of a hidden corner of the Central Rama 9. They offer a range of different Laos-style papaya salads, grilled meats and soups. Everything we tried was really good and freshly prepared. A real hidden gem and a Rama 9 favorite!
sample_reviews_en.author: Markus D

sample_reviews_en.text: A regular customer here.. Found this gem while strolling around the G-Tower and after I tried their food, it became my goto restaurant for thai food. Amazing food, ambience, affordable prices and friendly staffs. Definitely recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Freeze Francis

restaurants.name: Kam’s Roast (ICONSIAM)
restaurants.address:

205 Charoen Nakhon 5 Alley, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We had a really nice experience at Kam’s Roast ICONSIAM. The restaurant has a great atmosphere and is a very convenient place to stop for a meal while visiting ICONSIAM. The food was delicious, especially the roast meats, which were flavorful, tender and well prepared. The portions were generous and everything we ordered was served nicely. The staff were friendly and attentive, and the service was good throughout our visit. We also enjoyed the overall atmosphere of the restaurant, which was comfortable and welcoming. It was a great experience and we would definitely recommend Kam’s Roast to anyone visiting ICONSIAM and looking for a good place to eat. We would happily come back again to try more dishes from the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: JC

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kam’s Roast – ICONSIAM (6th Floor)
Ambience & Location: Located on the 6th floor of ICONSIAM right next to the impressive waterfall feature. The dining area is clean, modern, and offers a comfortable atmosphere after shopping.
Food Quality: Michelin-starred Hong Kong roast meats that live up to the hype.
Char Siu (BBQ Pork): Exceptionally tender and juicy with a perfectly caramelized glaze.
Roast Duck & Soy Sauce Chicken: Crispy skin, flavorful, and deeply seasoned meat.
Service & Price: Prices are on the higher side (~300–600 THB per dish), but well worth the quality and location. Fast and courteous service.
Highly recommended for roast meat lovers visiting ICONSIAM!
sample_reviews_en.author: Trần Mạnh Tiến

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the 1st time we tried Kam’s Roast in Iconsiam Bangkok. Overall the foods is decent, escpecially the roast pork & the braised duck wings.

However the char siew isn’t up to the expectation as i ordered toro char siew but they served me honey char siew. I double confirmed with the waiter is it the right food they served and the manager Ken came to us right away and offered us a plate of toro char siew as a complement.

Kudos to him for providing an excellent service and looking forward to have great dining experience there in future.

Keep it up.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eric Yeo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kam’s Roast is a must-visit for lovers of Cantonese-style roasted meats, and my recent visit did not disappoint. The restaurant, known for its Michelin acclaim, delivers high-quality flavors with well-executed dishes.

The char siu (barbecued pork) was the highlight of my meal—succulent, caramelized to perfection, and boasting a rich, smoky-sweet glaze. The noodles were nicely cooked, maintaining a springy texture while absorbing the light soy-based sauce. The bok choy on the side added a refreshing crunch, balancing the richness of the meat
sample_reviews_en.author: Saowanee Th.
