sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered the roast combo on rice with roast duck and crispy pork - this was so delicious. The skin was crispy and the meat was very tender. The accompanying sauces paired very well with the rich meat, and made for an explosion of flavour. The peanut sauce to go on the rice was also delicious.

We also ordered the toro char siu with salted egg. This was our favourite. Extremely tender, salty, sweet. Every single mouthful was to die for. Would definitely recommend.

Overall our experience was a 10/10. We will definitely be coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Orlando

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the pleasure of dining at Kam's Roast, and it exceeded my expectations! The roasted goose was succulent and flavorful, with a crispy skin that was absolute perfection. The service was attentive and friendly, and the atmosphere was cozy and inviting. The prices were reasonable, especially considering the high quality of the food. Overall, I highly recommend Kam's Roast to anyone looking for delicious Cantonese cuisine. Be prepared for a wait, but trust me, it's worth it!" 5/5 stars
sample_reviews_en.author: t h

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kam's Roast Goose 🦆🥢

📍 A Hong Kong-style restaurant, also a Bib Gourmand recommended spot

🦆 Roast Goose: The taste is excellent, with crispy skin and tender meat; the overall quality is very high.

🍲 Tofu: Also very good, worth ordering together.

🌿 Dining Environment: Located next to an indoor waterfall, the atmosphere is very unique.

👍 Both the food and the ambiance have their highlights; if you want to eat Hong Kong-style roast goose, this place is highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: 小威（LP）

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had the combo roast duck and char siu pork on rice at Kam's Roast in IconSiam, paired with chrysanthemum tea, and the meal was absolutely lovely.

I originally asked for the tea cold, but they served it hot by mistake. It turned out to be so nice that I didn't even bother correcting them, plus, they refilled it for free multiple times throughout the meal!

Delicious food and great overall value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jessica Faultless

restaurants.name: Nonna & Son Pattaya
restaurants.address:

218, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited this rooftop yesterday and my experience was mixed. We tried something form the Thai menu too but we ordered mostly from N&S.
The biggest problem in this place is the service. It’s just so chaotic and unorganized. We didn’t get everything that we ordered, they brought us the wrong wine twice, no help with it or whatsoever. One main course came 10 mins later. Terrible. The only nice person working there were Junie - very friendly and she save our evening.
Food wise I’m also not really sold on it. Crispy octopus was delicious as a concept but the baby octopus was extra tough, crispy soft shell crab was nice and spicy and was my personal favorite of the evening. For the main course the dishes came exactly the same - same sauce and same toppings. I can’t say they were bad - both ribs and lamb were tender and properly cooked but I believe everything is precooked, premade and just like in fast food chain. Well it was not bad, and we less or more enjoyed what we ate but that not what u wish to get in the restaurant.
The place has potential, and if they would work on the service it might be a nice spot in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Igor Jeczkowski

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered pasta, pizza and a cocktail and overall, I had a great experience. Food was delicious and high quality. Staff was very kind and helpful. But I have a few constructive comments as a suggestion:

- There is a part in balcony with wooden-like chairs. Height of these chairs is lower compared to table and it is hard to eat meal, higher chairs should be used.
- In balcony there are plants/flowers that covers the entire sea view. These plants can be removed and tables can be placed in sea side of balcony. That definitely increases the customer experience.
- Music was loud and disturbing like a club music. Maybe a calmer music with less noise would be more relaxing with great sea view.
- I had a hard time finding the location of restaurant in the building. Maybe you can add explanation like a top floor etc to google maps.
- I ordered an orange cocktail. It was kritt or krill or something. It came with a diffeeent glass and cocktail portion was less than it was shown in the menu. There needs to be consistency.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mustafa Arif Ersoy

sample_reviews_en.text: Nonna & Son is an Italian restaurant located in Pattaya. The sea view visible from the bar is stunning. This place is perfect for all occasions. The menu features a wide range of Italian dishes, crispy thin crust wood-fired pizzas, creamy pasta and delightful desserts. Came for a few drinks and ended up having to try out the parmesan truffle fries and crab cake burger. Cocktails will set you back 250-300 baht or more but are well worth the pours. The staff here is top-notch! Ultra friendly, professional, attentive and ready to assist. I recommend booking a table in advance at Nonna & Son to secure the best sunset views.
sample_reviews_en.author: chad svastisalee

sample_reviews_en.text: If you’re looking for a dining experience that combines mouthwatering dishes, a warm and welcoming atmosphere, and impeccable service, this restaurant is the place to be! Every bite is packed with flavor, the presentation is stunning, and the staff go above and beyond to make you feel at home. Whether you’re here for a casual meal or a special celebration, this spot guarantees a memorable experience that will keep you coming back for more.
sample_reviews_en.author: l lllobster

sample_reviews_en.text:
A stylish place with a breathtaking view of the bay, especially beautiful at sunset. We ordered only pizza, which was below average—we didn’t like it. As mentioned in other reviews, the service is strange: they brought the pizza but no plates. After we asked, they brought plates, but I had to get up and find forks and knives myself.
BTW, I think we will come back here, but not for dinner—just for a drink and to enjoy the sunset view.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maryna Y.

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a mess wIt's a mess when it comes professional service you don't know who your waitress is you just ask anyone who comes by. For this sort of restaurant that check in on the customer offer a drink when we get there this here is the typical service of a cheap Thai restaurant where just anybody will bring you food but you have to ask them very unacceptable in such a beautiful place
sample_reviews_en.author: Joe Pesso

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant's atmosphere was quite nice and the food was average but the service was terrible. I received absolutely no service at all and had to pour water by myself and the restaurant charged for it. I think a restaurant of this caliber should have better service…Compared to restaurants that charge a service fee, I think this place shouldn't even have one.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amchane TC

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came to dine with three other friends they forgot two dishes and only knew about it when we reminded them. I ordered Chicken Alfredo and when it came the Alfredo and pasta was super salty. The chicken was fine though

My friend’s other thai dish was also very salty as well.

Atmosphere is pretty nice service was ok but its a 2/5 since they forgot to dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arnanthithi Na Srito

restaurants.name: Koyama Seacon Square Srinakarin
restaurants.address:

55 Srinagarindra Rd, Nong Bon, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
My friends have invited me to this restaurant many times, so today I finally got to try it. It's a Japanese-style charcoal grill restaurant that uses farm-raised pork, Wagyu beef, and even Australian beef, all delivered directly from the farm. The slices are thick and satisfying, and the ingredients are of very high quality. They have large river prawns, a full seafood selection, and the highlight is the fresh, not frozen, Norwegian salmon sashimi. The ingredients are premium, but the prices are surprisingly affordable for other restaurants! They also have a sushi promotion starting at 19 baht (kids eat free) for unlimited sushi! No need to count pieces; everything is freshly made. They have maguro sushi, scallop sushi, engawa sushi, salmon sushi, and many other varieties to choose from! I also really like their dipping sauces.
They pair perfectly with the meat and grilled items – not too salty or greasy, just perfectly balanced. They also have six other dipping sauces to choose from. They have a wide variety of appetizers and side dishes. The service from the staff is lovely; everyone is very service-minded.🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: Pairin Pumsuwan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I wanted to give a negative rating but there's no option for that. The service was terrible.
1) The staff (pregnant woman) was grumpy and unhappy that customers chose their own table (in the open-air section).
2) The grilled items were served completely, but we had to wait for the grill. We had to keep asking for it.
3) Before entering, we asked if they had potato salad, and they said yes. But after ordering, we waited for half an hour. When it was served, there was no apology; the pregnant woman's face was still grumpy. When asked why it took so long, she said we were waiting for the potatoes to get cold. I don't know if the restaurant knows that it's a buffet with a time limit, not à la carte where there's a waiting time. If they had mentioned it when we asked if it was available, they should have said so, otherwise we wouldn't have eaten there.
4) We ordered pork dishes, and waited, repeatedly asking for it. The food served was wrong; it wasn't what we ordered.
That's it for this restaurant; it's not worth the 459 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: PA

sample_reviews_en.text:
Received "Thai Helps Thai" voucher.

Spent over 500 baht + 29 baht for extra sushi.
However, the restaurant informed me that they were out of river prawns and bouncy prawns.

I was planning on eating beef anyway, so it was acceptable.
The beef selection looked good; the first batch was delicious almost every type.
However, the brisket was a bit tough, and the quality of later batches seemed to decline.

The short ribs were the most tender and I ordered the most.
The pork neck had a lot of fat and was served in a generous portion, but I had to eat it.

The grill was small, and the fire burned out easily even though there was still charcoal. The weak fire made the meat tough and dry.

The ice cream was delicious.

The staff provided excellent service and took orders promptly.
The sushi took a long time to arrive; the first batch took 30 minutes.
The sushi wasn't very good; Shinkansen is better.
Wasted stomach space.

No sugar-free drinks; 0% sugar.

Overall, it was okay, but I probably wouldn't go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: minoru dokidoki

sample_reviews_en.text: I've seen this restaurant for a long time and finally decided to try it. I'm not sure if it's the same owner as the legendary Giant Yakiniku restaurant that used to have a branch in this Seacon Square location many years ago (a long time ago). The ingredients and dipping sauces felt similar, and it was pretty good. My only complaint is the "pork liver." It seemed like it was marinated, not fresh liver. Because of the marinade, the liver was still red and very difficult to tell when grilled. I had to omit the liver because I was afraid it wouldn't be cooked through and would burn if I waited too long. ***Most importantly, the service was excellent. The staff were great, serving quickly and completely. They constantly cleared plates, checked on us, and changed the grill rack. The speed and efficiency in 100 minutes, despite the restaurant being packed, was outstanding. The staff were fantastic.
sample_reviews_en.author: TKVariety

sample_reviews_en.text:
Koyama at Seacon Square Srinakarin is located on the top floor, in the food court, opposite Fuji restaurant.

They offer a good range of price options, with the initial sets being quite worthwhile. There's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, perfect for meat lovers. We opted for a set that included salmon sashimi, and the salmon was of excellent quality – tender, sweet, and not fishy. Salmon enthusiasts won't be disappointed.

The menu is good and diverse, but the ordering process isn't very convenient. You have to wait to order from a passing staff member, and some orders were delayed or missing. A scan-to-order system would be more efficient for both parties.

The restaurant's atmosphere is a bit dark. There's ample seating, and although it was busy when we visited, we didn't have to wait in line.

Credit card payments incur an additional charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Littlepaw

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I can't use the word "value for money" enough. Six types of dipping sauces, ingredients so fresh it's like they came straight from the farm daily. The sashimi is wonderfully firm and bouncy, and the sushi is served in perfect bite-sized portions. I'm not sure what makes it so delicious, but it's naturally soft, sweet, and delicious. Even the Japanese rice is amazing – try it with seafood, grilled mackerel, or wrapped in seaweed with grilled salmon – wow! The mayonnaise and kimchi are a must-try. If you're hesitant, go experience the value for money. No matter your preference, this restaurant has it all. Go! There's a 10% birthday discount; message the restaurant's Facebook page to claim your birthday discount and you can also use Thai Chuay Thai Plus.
P.S. We ate the 559 THB set and added salmon sashimi separately.
sample_reviews_en.author: Earn O

sample_reviews_en.text:
Koyama at Seacon Square Srinakarin is a great choice for anyone looking for affordable Japanese yakiniku. The buffet offers a wide selection of beef, pork, chicken, seafood, and side dishes at a reasonable price, making it good value for money.

The ingredients are fresh, and the charcoal grill adds a pleasant smoky flavour to the meat. The staff are friendly, attentive, and quick to refill orders even during busy hours.

The restaurant is clean, spacious, and comfortable for families or groups of friends. While the meat is not particularly juicy, it is still tasty and satisfying when grilled properly.

Overall, Koyama is an excellent option for a casual Japanese barbecue meal with generous choices, reliable service, and budget-friendly prices. I am not sure that might visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: SS DD

sample_reviews_en.text:
🔥 Incredibly good value buffet! Great meat, amazing marinated shrimp, but the dipping sauce could be better! 🔥

🥩 BBQ lovers must try! Premium beef, tender marinated pork, fresh seafood, and unlimited marinated shrimp! 🦐✨ Such great value at 459 THB!

😅 However, there might be a slight hiccup as the staff aren't Thai, so you might need to be patient when ordering.

🔥 Summary!
✅ Freshness and quality of ingredients: 10/10
✅ Marinated shrimp is a must-try: 9/10
❌ Dipping sauce could be spicier: 7/10
❌ Communication might be a little awkward.

📍 Who's tried it? Vote now!

sample_reviews_en.author: pokpong sangsuwan (POMMALOHA)

restaurants.name: Azuma Soba Restaurant
restaurants.address:

595/21 Soi Sukhumvit 33/1, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a safe bet for a meal. It's not cheap, but it's not outrageously expensive either, as you can choose up to 3 servings for free, so it's not too bad for those who eat a lot. However, I've been going there for years, and I always wonder why they don't offer a 1.5 serving option. For me, 1.5 servings of soba with a small portion of rice in the set meal is just right, but I always end up not being able to finish the 2 servings and leaving some behind, which makes me feel bad every time. Is it difficult to offer 1.5 or 2.5 servings from an operational standpoint? Next time, I think I'll try the sister restaurant on the second floor, which serves more affordable set meals.
sample_reviews_en.author: 世界を旅する覆面パトローラー

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried Asuma restaurant and I have to say it's delicious. The soba noodles are unlimited; you start with one portion and keep adding more until you reach three. As for the side dishes, we had the tempura shrimp, which was perfectly fried. Their highlight is the chewy, soft rice noodles that you can eat without getting bored, along with their special dipping sauce – it's incredibly smooth and moist, with a hint of spice. It's delicious! You should definitely try it. They have two branches, but this one is right next to the Phrom Phong BTS station. (Ravi rating: 1000)
sample_reviews_en.author: John Smith

sample_reviews_en.text:
A soba specialty restaurant run by a Japanese owner in Sukhumvit 33/1. The place was packed with Japanese customers, which already says a lot about its authenticity. We stumbled upon it after the restaurant we originally planned to visit was closed for the day, and it turned out to be a great surprise.

Every menu item comes as a set with a generous portion of soba noodles. The soba itself had a very unique flavor and texture that we really enjoyed. Highly recommended if you are looking for an authentic Japanese dining experience in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: pongpratch puapatanakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is one of the best fresh soba restaurants I've ever tried.
There's a wide variety of menu options, but I recommend ordering a set that includes soba. The staff will let you choose 1, 2, or 3 portions.
If you're unsure how much you can eat,
I recommend ordering one portion first, and then you can order more noodles when you finish it. Some of the dishes are quite unusual, but everything is delicious.
Including the complimentary fried soba noodles that the staff brings out, which are equally tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: M Thana

sample_reviews_en.text:
This soba restaurant is located near Phrom Phong station. It's practically synonymous with soba in Bangkok. The interior has an atmosphere very similar to a traditional Japanese soba restaurant, and the menu is extensive.

You can order up to three servings for the same price, which is great because you can choose according to your appetite. I could almost eat soba for lunch every day! The shrimp tempura is also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Staff Terry's Cafe

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm a huge noodle lover, and Azuma Noodles is always one of my go-to choices whenever I'm in the area. I especially love the texture of their noodles; it's chewy and just perfect! Whenever I go, I always think I'll only eat two portions, but I always end up with three because it's rare to get to eat such satisfyingly fresh soba noodles.
I'll definitely go back if I'm ever in the area again :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Beau Marceline

sample_reviews_en.text: I felt unwell, dizzy and fainted. The staff took very good care of me and offered to call an ambulance. I told them I needed to rest for a while and felt better. The restaurant gave me a can of Coke free of charge. I felt so grateful and thanked them profusely. I gave them a tip of over 100 baht because that's all the cash I had. I plan to eat at the restaurant often. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: HoneyMiaow

sample_reviews_en.text: Tucked away hiding in the corner, this noodle bar cant be missed...lunch queu can be a while but worth the wait, soba portions come in sizes 🍜 but go for the large with tempura 🍤, grilled duck 🦆 also a treat..cold noodles are great after slogging it out in the Bangkok heat 🔥add asahi dry and all is good 🍺...kampai!
sample_reviews_en.author: rony soerakoesoemah

restaurants.name: Savory Malatang小食记 (Terminal21)
restaurants.address:

88 Terminal21 5th Floor, Sukhumvit 19 Alley, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place doesn't accept the Pier 21 card, either that or they just want cash im not sure as I dont speak thai, but the person at the entrance was nice.

As for the food, I only ordered dumplings (95B- $3USD) and they were incredibly bland

One thing I did notice is that there was about 6 to 8 people behind me when I ordered and they all got their food before I did. They give you a buzzer, but its quite confusing how it works here if im being honest
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr. Zoidberg PhD.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food isn’t bad, but it’s relatively expensive. For double the price I can eat unlimited shabu elsewhere, and the shrimp there isn’t rubbery. What I don’t understand is why they boil the already cooked shrimp second time in the hot pot, (which they give separately on 30 baht tray..)until it turns rubbery, when they should only throw it in at the end after the soup is done. Congrats to the chef…ohh no actually, no! 🤦🏼‍♂️
sample_reviews_en.author: Balu

sample_reviews_en.text:
The mala soup is very very spicy as expected , very satisfying

Vegetables are 50baht / 100 g , pricey but acceptable. The meat quality is just ok given the price they charge

The used rancid oil to fry the bun , it’s a no no I can smell it after the first bite

Overall this place gives interesting flavors but I’m not coming back for the second time.
sample_reviews_en.author: May Sukumpeeranont

sample_reviews_en.text: There are a lot of toppings to choose from, but be careful not to get carried away or you might go over budget pretty easily. The mala soup is rich and pretty spicy, classic malatang style. The dipping sauce is sesame based and pretty nutty, and you can add more seasoning to make it spicier if you want. Service was good overall.
sample_reviews_en.author: John de j3k

sample_reviews_en.text: It's expensive and the taste is just average. In a place where meat and vegetables are priced the same, you still have to order meat separately. Who gave them the audacity? The only reason I'm giving it three stars is because they have a relatively complete selection of bean products.
sample_reviews_en.author: 张大虎（Abiu）

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but I wasn't impressed with the service from the cashier. They didn't inform customers about whether they wanted dipping sauce or how much it would cost. Not everyone knows that dipping sauce is an extra charge when they arrive.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐพร บัวสาย

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is clean, the atmosphere is nice, and they offer a wide variety of ingredients and menu items with clear descriptions. Unfortunately, some ingredients are sold in packs with excessively large quantities, making it difficult …
sample_reviews_en.author: hashigami niina

sample_reviews_en.text: I wanted to try Mala Dan, so I went to Savory Malatang (Terminal21). It was my first time and I was a bit flustered because I didn't understand the system, but I managed to eat it. You can get lots of vegetables, and the numbing sensation …
sample_reviews_en.author: PAPA - san

restaurants.name: OPPA SARANGHAE & SUSHI HAN อาหารเกาหลีและอาหารญี่ปุ่น
restaurants.address:

41 184 ถ.นวลจันทร์ Nuan Chan, Bueng Kum, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Updated Sept 2025: New location, now with a Japanese restaurant in the same place. Offering traditional Korean food in a modern setting with slightly higher prices. Limited free parking available in the avenue beside the restaurant. Still delicious as always, the atmosphere is airy and comfortable, but could be cooler. The slight price increase is reasonable, combining a Korean restaurant with a Japanese restaurant offering simple dishes. Limited parking in the alley. Best contemporary Korean food, an in-house style restaurant hidden in a local community shop. The low-salt concept made meals pleasant even though it's a bit pricey in this area. The food is generally very delicious, the restaurant intentionally reduces the spiciness to make it easier to eat. Many menu options. The prices are on the high side considering it's in a local area and hidden in a small community shop near the large Nuanchan market.
sample_reviews_en.author: sakul leksrisakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was in the area on errands and decided to stop by. The situation was that when I arrived, the owners were talking very loudly, and their children were screaming so loudly it gave me a headache. If they're going to be this casual, they should just close the shop and eat alone on days they have friends with them.

Answering the questions:
I visited on January 19th, 2025. There was a man sitting at a table at the front and a woman at a table near the counter. Children were running around in a playpen, screaming and talking loudly without any consideration for others. I apologize if I misunderstood, but the staff should have been able to manage the situation better. Ultimately, I couldn't tolerate sitting there any longer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pomphet Nopphakunwijai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Returned to the new, larger branch. The food selection is more diverse.

Service was average.
________________
The atmosphere is like a typical air-conditioned restaurant with a children's play area.

The taste is okay. Portions are reasonable, enough for two people.

Delivery sales are steady.

Service can be slow due to the limited number of staff, as many customers arrive at once.
sample_reviews_en.author: WoonWoW

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a comfortable restaurant with both Korean and Japanese menus. There are many delicious-looking dishes, and the food tastes great. It's a great place to dine with family. Parking is available in the alley next to the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panitnad L.

sample_reviews_en.text: I just tried it for the first time and it's delicious. They have a wide variety of food, including Korean and Japanese dishes. The side dishes are unlimited and look delicious, fresh and clean. I even bought some to take home.
sample_reviews_en.author: vraluck jiramira

sample_reviews_en.text: This Korean restaurant serves authentic, delicious food in generous portions at a reasonable price. It's a new location with upgraded children's playroom (don't forget to bring socks for your kids!). It's perfect for families.
sample_reviews_en.author: Beer Wongsuppapat

sample_reviews_en.text: This Korean-Japanese restaurant offers a diverse menu of both Korean and Japanese dishes in a great atmosphere, making you feel like you're dining in Korea. The restaurant is located in Soi Nuanchan 27.
sample_reviews_en.author: ChillOut

sample_reviews_en.text: The side dishes were delicious, especially the kimchi – it was amazing! The pork neck had minimal fat, and the pork belly with sesame dipping sauce was also excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wayu Witchutraiphob

restaurants.name: Heng Heng Hainanese Chicken Rice
restaurants.address:

642, 646 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Heng Heng Chicken Rice — a khao man gai (chicken rice) restaurant under Phrom Phong station in Bangkok that always has a long line.

I visited in the early evening before dinner time, so I got in without waiting. The chicken was wonderfully moist and delicious — I could immediately see why people queue for this. The rice is darker in color than most, a little different from the usual style, but it was very tasty. I even added an extra portion of chicken.


This khao man gai restaurant under Phrom Phong station in Bangkok always has a huge line. I visited in the early evening before dinner time, so I got in without waiting.

The chicken was incredibly moist and delicious, and it was really good. I understood why people queue. The rice was darker in color, a little different from others, but it was delicious. I even added an extra portion of chicken.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shota H

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited at 11am on a weekday. It used to be a street stall on the sidewalk, but it's now a proper restaurant. It used to open in the evening, but I'm glad that it's now open from the morning since becoming a proper restaurant. The interior is simple and unpretentious, like a typical Thai eatery; it doesn't have an exotic atmosphere, but it's comfortable. This time I ordered the classic "Khao Man Gai." The nam chim, which is made with authentic spices, had just the right amount of spiciness and was pretty tasty. The price is a little on the high side, and the portion is a little on the large side. The staff didn't smile much, but they were used to foreigners and handled things calmly. The restaurant is located right next to BTS Phrom Phong station, so the location is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: A

sample_reviews_en.text:
When I arrived, they were out of fried chicken, so I only ordered Hainanese chicken rice.

Didn't see the rice? I was in such a hurry that I forgot to take a picture 😂

The Hainanese chicken here was absolutely amazing; I ate it all. The chicken rice was decent, but the tender chicken with the accompanying sauce was so delicious I wanted more (so I ordered another plate 🤤).

And the soup reminded me of corn stew, which I haven't had much of lately.
Compared to pork bone soup, the chicken feet and bones made it much lighter and more refreshing.

Even though I had to use a translation app to ask, I still had to ask the staff for a refill 🥹

Next time I'm in Bangkok, I might make a special trip to relive and try the fried chicken I missed this time 🤤
sample_reviews_en.author: 旅行專用

sample_reviews_en.text: Both the salt-baked chicken and fried chicken were tender and delicious; the owner was very attentive, deboning everything. The broth made from the chicken bones was also very tasty. The Nth generation owner is a handsome guy, and I sincerely suggest adding more drink options (customers walking into a restaurant on a hot Bangkok day most want an iced drink first, even just iced plum juice, and drinks have the lowest cost and are the most profitable). With such a great location, directly opposite Emquatier, the rent must be very high. Putting more effort into the drinks wouldn't increase labor costs and would attract tourists. (You could refer to the approach of the most popular Rong Tai restaurant in the same area.)
sample_reviews_en.author: 日日

sample_reviews_en.text: I went at 11:20 AM and didn't have to wait in line; there were plenty of tables available. There were also many foreigners eating there, mostly Asians. I met the owner's daughter who served the customers herself. I ordered the mixed chicken rice, size M, for 75 baht. I found the chicken chewy, not as tender as it looked in the exaggerated videos on TikTok. The fried chicken was also a bit chewy and not crispy. The soup is a matter of personal preference; I prefer it with pepper, but this place didn't add pepper, instead using corn and chicken bones in the soup, unlike other places. Each person gets a different soup base; it's random. This is just my personal opinion, but I wouldn't order it again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Smiling Spoon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious Hainanese Chicken Rice at an affordable price!
The chicken was tender and juicy, the rice was fragrant, and the chili sauce was just perfect — truly one of the best Hainanese chicken rice I’ve had! Better than Singapore and Malaysia Hainanese Chicken Rice. The portion and price are very reasonable too. The staff were friendly and the service was fast.
Just a small suggestion — if the air-conditioning could be a bit cooler, it would make the dining experience even more comfortable, especially during hot days. Overall, highly recommended and will definitely come back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Cheng Jin Hooi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Arriving at 4:30pm, we were lucky to find an empty table without any queue. While Heng Heng might not be the pinnacle of Hainanese chicken rice, it certainly offers good value for money. The generous portions and the flavorful chicken soup make it a satisfying meal. However, the dining experience can be a bit chaotic due to the noisy environment.
If you're looking for a quick and affordable bite with a decent portion size, Heng Heng is worth considering. Just be prepared for a bit of noise and a less refined dining atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: HN Mak

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited on a Friday at 7:30 PM and was able to enter without waiting.

The fried version was sold out, so I ordered the steamed medium size (70B). The chicken was moist and delicious, and the accompanying soup had a mild flavor that was very nice.

I think this is a restaurant where you can enjoy authentic Khao Man Gai in a simple, easy-to-eat, and reasonably priced way. I'd like to try the fried version next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: 武田彩音

restaurants.name: Yào Restaurant
restaurants.address:

32nd Fl, Bangkok Marriott Hotel The Surawongse, 262 Surawong Rd, Si Phraya, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food not worth the price -
. Fried Chicken with Chilli & powder, nuts - the coating was soggy.  It should be crispy.
. Wok-fried flat noodle with Wagyu Beef - the beef was chewy and tough. The noodle was very soft, sticky and too sweet.
. Crispy pork - crispy skin and good meat texture.  Nice.
. Fujian Rice - very tasty. The best dish out of four we ordered.
. Fried green beans - we canceled it.

Service -
. Very pleasant staff,  but not attentive e.g. we have to chase them to refill tea pot with hot water
. Asked one male staff for our bill.  After 10 min. it has not come, so we had to ask another staff before we got the bill.

Atmosphere -
The big round table (at the window in front of us) with 7 women who were videoing themselves with us and other customers in their background.  I think it is inappropriate and disturbing other customers to enjoy their dinner.  They should also ask for permission if they would capture other customers into their videos.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emma M

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was hesitant to try this place because my past experiences with hotel food have been terrible. However, after expressing my dissatisfaction to the front desk, they challenged me to visit the restaurant upstairs—and I’m glad I did. The food here was excellent, with fresh options and great flavors throughout most of the meal.

There were only two dishes I didn’t enjoy. The Wagyu beef, which I ordered due to a mistaken translation, wasn’t what I expected. I requested something similar to a beef and broccoli or beef and pepper dish, but the Wagyu came in fatty chunks that weren’t really edible. The fried rice, while okay, was pretty dry, and I wouldn’t order it again.

Despite those two missteps, this restaurant has something for everyone. The service was amazing, the staff were humble and attentive, and the rooftop view made the experience even better. You really can’t go wrong here—you’ll find something to love.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jon J.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food and service are topnotch but a little pricey.
Shrimp Shumai with Caviar: These shrimp shumai are definitely a treat! The dumplings are nicely steamed, with a soft yellow wrapper, and the shrimp filling looks juicy. Topping them off with a bit of caviar adds a fancy touch, giving each bite a burst of rich, briny flavor. It's a nice mix of classic dim sum with a little something extra. Beijing Noodles with Roe and Bok Choy: The Beijing noodle dish looks super satisfying. The noodles seem perfectly cooked, with a generous amount of flavorful ground meat sauce. The roe on top adds a nice salty kick, while the bok choy brings in some freshness and crunch. It’s a great combo of hearty and refreshing, with a little bit of everything.

The view is fantastic. I think night time would be more beautiful. Overall highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sohthirsty

sample_reviews_en.text: Beautiful restaurant. Great atmosphere. Pecking Duck ois my favourite food here. I love the action to present Pecking Duck at the table. We can ordered 2 dishes different cook from the duck meat and also come with the duck soup. So order 1 pecking duck, we got delicious duck skin with pancakes, and two different dishes of meat duck and their signature duck soup. Great offer! This restaurant is my favourite Pecking Duck in Bangkok. The fresh noodles with minced pork and sauce is delicious. Chicken cashew nuts is top notch! Deep fried noodles which come with the dish is delicious. Eggplant dish is also my favourite. We are all very happy. Hot tea is reasonable price. Thank you very much for that.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pla Ontour

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a wonderful new dining experience at Yào Restaurant, located on the 32nd floor of Bangkok Marriott Hotel The Surawongse. We came as a family, and everything about the evening was truly impressive.

The ambiance was fantastic, offering a warm and elegant atmosphere. The service was exceptional — especially from K. Ton, who took great care of us from the moment we arrived. The food was served promptly, and every dish reflected the chef’s excellent skills, with outstanding flavors throughout.

Thank you for making our family’s special day so memorable and enjoyable. We will definitely be coming back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattanapong Poolpanchoo

sample_reviews_en.text:
If I could give this more than 5 stars I would. Firstly, the location and views are spectacular, even if you don't get a seat near a window. Secondly, the service is excellent. Finally, the food is incredible. We had heard about the peking duck but we didn't quite know how much this would provide. Turns out it was a lot! We were offered duck soup and a second dish made with the duck leftovers too. We also had fried tofu and cucumber salad for starters.

Total came to around 4000THB including drinks and service which we didn't think was bad at all. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jack

sample_reviews_en.text: I stayed at the Marriott Surawongse and decided to go to Yao restaurant on the 32nd floor. The atmosphere is fantastic, and the staff is extremely friendly. You should feel very well taken care of. I chose a very basic set menu because I drank wine with some snacks before dinner, so I wasn't hungry but I wanted to taste various kind of dishes. The portion sizes of all dishes are small but sufficient to enjoy. The plating is excellent. Especially the soup was delicious. This restaurant is highly recommended for any type of anniversary or important family gathering.
sample_reviews_en.author: Keith Chung

sample_reviews_en.text: What a nice surprise at this Yao Restaurant. My first here, overall was a pleasant meal both service and taste. The ambience was nice, where you can enjoy a river view from here. Menu design is great for either solo dining, couples or group diners. Foods taste really good, I personally enjoy crispy shrimp rice roll and crispy tofu with golden leeks in particular. Service wise was flawless from arriving until departure, special thanks to khun koi, patty,dream,jack and ness for taking care of me. Kudos to the team and will definitely comeback soon.
sample_reviews_en.author: At Pingnakorn

restaurants.name: Khunpa Shabu
restaurants.address:

56/8 Lat Phrao 18 Alley, Lane 2, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The soup was okay, the pork was good, and the beef was decent. There are four dipping sauces: ponzu, the restaurant's own sukiyaki sauce, regular sukiyaki sauce, and sesame sauce. If you mix them well, they're delicious.
---- When ordering, you have to write your order on a piece of paper. This might be convenient for those who aren't comfortable with QR codes, but be aware that when it's busy, you might have to wait a while.
---- When I ordered the jade noodles, I didn't expect them to be green instant noodles. So disappointing. For anyone who doesn't like green instant noodles, don't bother.
---- The pork was sliced ​​very thin; you dip it and eat it right away.
---- I was very impressed with the beef. It wasn't gamey at all. When I ate it, I was like, "Wow, this is it..."
---- The jellyfish was delicious. The only downside is there's no seafood dipping sauce.

Overall, it was tasty, but not mind-blowing. For those who don't want to wait three or four hours at a big-budget shabu-shabu restaurant, this is a good option. It's just as delicious and supports small businesses.
sample_reviews_en.author: A.C Thames

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was delicious! The taste was great, the dipping sauces were tasty, and the ingredients were high-quality with a wide variety to choose from. The staff provided excellent service, constantly refilling our water. They also accept the government's co-payment scheme. I went right when the restaurant opened, so I didn't make a reservation, but if you're planning to go in the evening, I recommend calling ahead to reserve.

P.S. It's a good idea to call and reserve during the government's co-payment scheme period. On November 11th, 2025, I spontaneously went with friends because we lived not far from the restaurant and it had just opened less than an hour ago. We went without a reservation and the restaurant was almost full! Luckily, there were still some tables available. Thank you to the owner for helping us find a table! 🥹🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Prapawee Preangprach

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. The meat is excellent, the vegetables are fresh and clean, the soup is tasty, and the dipping sauces are as delicious as ever. I've been a customer for a long time, and the quality remains consistently good. The only minor issue is that the meat takes quite a while to arrive. It comes in quick succession at times, but then there are long gaps between servings. I wish they would manage this aspect a little better. The restaurant also frequently offers promotions, making the prices very good. Parking is limited, so you have to hope there's a space available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Feletso

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went with my partner yesterday. The place was easy to find, with welcoming smiles and kind staff.

The food was fresh, and the portions were generous, with a good selection to choose from.

The team regularly checked on our drink refills while still giving us our privacy.

The place has a friendly, be-yourself atmosphere with very kind people.
It was super clean, and as foreigners, we had no stomach issues at all.

Thank you for the great service, we will definitely come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manal Ben

sample_reviews_en.text: Great value for the price of 369 baht, including drinks. They also give you a complimentary serving of grass jelly per person. The food is delicious and there's a diverse menu. The sliced ​​pork is tender, and they have cheese, vegetable noodles, and garlic fried rice served piping hot. I loved it! The ponzu dipping sauce was also tasty. There's a cute cat in front of the shop. I support restaurants that love animals! 🐱
sample_reviews_en.author: decem1996

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ingredients are high quality, the taste is great, and it's excellent value for money.

We came with 9 people. The owner was very kind, helped us with parking, and took great care of us. They were so lovely and kept serving us non-stop. The staff were also very attentive.

It lived up to the hype. We loved it and will definitely come again.
Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Itsaree965

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food: The shabu-shabu was delicious, the meat was good quality. I loved the sesame dipping sauce and the pork bone broth. I especially loved the dumplings and the pork belly.
Service: The service was excellent. They constantly refilled our water and checked on us regularly.
Atmosphere: It's a small restaurant, so it can be a bit noisy.
sample_reviews_en.author: J

sample_reviews_en.text: Auntie Shabu's serves high-quality, fresh, and beautifully sliced ​​meat. The dipping sauces are delicious, and the food isn't at all greasy. The staff are friendly and provide excellent service. Parking might be a little difficult to find, but overall, I was very impressed. It's definitely worth a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: ยูอิ โรมานอส

restaurants.name: Tora Sushi
restaurants.address:

ร้าน โทระ ซูชิ สาขาบางนา 159 Debaratna Rd, Bang Na Nuea, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've seen this restaurant for a long time and finally got to try it. We ate at the Bangna branch.
- The ingredients were excellent, fresh and clean.
- Very delicious. You must order the vegetable salad, it's very refreshing.
- Every piece of sashimi was good.
- The staff provided good service.

It's located on the main road and has parking, very convenient! 👏🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: petcharat kotchum

sample_reviews_en.text:
i normally visit Ratchpruek branch, but this time it was on the way to hospital and i felt i wanted to eat Japanese, then i remembered Tora has a new one here… so i went expecting same quality and didn’t disappoint.
Food is still fresh… service is great
one of staff even remember me and my name as she was a long apprentice at Ratchpruek before. Nice
sample_reviews_en.author: Bundit Anan

sample_reviews_en.text: The fish was incredibly fresh, the freshest I've ever had in Thailand. The ingredients were truly top-notch. They also served melon and green tea. The melon was sweet and juicy, absolutely delicious. The green tea pudding I ordered was equally good. The staff provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanakarn Thipnaytikul (Karn)

sample_reviews_en.text: If you are in the BangNa area, this is a must try. Big selection of sashimi and sushi. Make sure to order their sushi rolls. Milk pudding in Matcha, strawberry crumble were very good. Lots of seating and parking available - great for family lunch or dinner / big groups. MUST TRY!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chee Wai Wong

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't know how to say about my feeling of Tora Sushi. I think Tora Sushi is the best of Sushi. Sashimi and Sushi serve by premium grade. All items fresh and really delicious. I feel enjoyable with this meal the most. I recommended this restaurant. Don't miss and Must try.!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tatar

sample_reviews_en.text: Stand alone premium Japanese restaurant at Bang-Na. Good for family with kids, senior citizens or friends because of convenience to access, parking , private room & a few steps to restaurant. Variety of food with fusion sushi, lobster, A5 Beef , sometime Taraba crab.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumol

sample_reviews_en.text: Good sushi restaurant. Fresh ingredients they have. Rolls are well cooked. Seating area are comfortable and air conditioned. Private room are available. Taste good. Price are a bit more expensive but quality of ingredients are worth. Credit card accepted. Enjoy !
sample_reviews_en.author: Supakij Khomvilai

sample_reviews_en.text: First time here. The cream cheese salmon roll was fantastic. The shabu broth was quite nice but meat quality was average. Not sure if its only a covid special but we had free soup, beans, and dessert. That really rounded out the meal well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Toan Dang

restaurants.name: Palace Restaurant
restaurants.address:

G-Floor, Next to Sizzler, Royal Garden Plaza, 218 Beach Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I didn't try the food at the restaurant because the prices on the menu were expensive, and even Arab restaurants in general are outrageously priced with no justification other than exploiting tourists. They want to make five years' worth of money in one year.
sample_reviews_en.author: الأحساس

sample_reviews_en.text: The food and service at this restaurant was absolutely terrific. The food had plenty of flavor/seasoning which is important. Atmospere is delightful and clean. Staff are kind and attentive. The food was delicious and prices are great. I highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr G

sample_reviews_en.text: 340 baht kebab combo is great. Has hummus kebab arab bread and soda all included!! Great middle Eastern food in Pattaya. High quality and inside of Royal Garden Plaza. Try  tabouleh salad. Very fresh and tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thaigerr86

sample_reviews_en.text: Food absolutely stunning if like me the sound of Chicken Swharma, fresh oilive oil bread, fresh humus and homemade garlic sauce done to perfection for absolute brilliant price, I'm stunned want more 😆 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Damien Mcevoy

sample_reviews_en.text: The hummus was delicious and a pleasant surprise. The staff were very friendly; I tried several dishes for the first time, and they were all truly delicious. A wonderful experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: DDE PIC

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the half chicken, hummus, and knafeh for dessert everything was absolutely delicious! Highly recommended. The service was excellent as well!
sample_reviews_en.author: נועה שטרית

sample_reviews_en.text: They have delicious and affordable Turkish-style snacks like wraps, döner, lahmacun, pide, and pizza, available day and night. I recommend them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ayhan Vurankartal

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything was perfect and service was above our expectations.
The food is fresh and very cost effective.
We will absolutely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: דני ללזרי

restaurants.name: Indigo
restaurants.address:

6 Convent Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Best quality priced french bisto in town Superb selection of wines and cheese"

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have been working in Silom area for a number of years and I keep noticing that there is a nice French restaurant which is very near my office. It was situated in a small lane along Soi Convent.

Very nice and friendly team from Indigo, I feel very welcome.

Ordered a red wine, caesar salad and beef bourguignon. There is a complimentary bread as well. It was warm, moist and very soft. Really good start to my meal.

Caesar salad came very quickly. There is a nice portion of chicken breasts, lettuce, boiled egg, bacon, anchovies, and shaved parmesan. This is one of my tastiest caesar salad I have ever tasted in Bangkok!

My main dish of beef bourguignon came very quickly as soon as I finished my salad. I wasn't disappointed at all. It was very flavorful. The beef was extremely soft after soaking in the stew! It quickly falls apart as soon as I put it in my mouth. Really good and comforting bowl of deliciousness!

There are so many dish on the menu and they have lunch set menu as well. I knew very well from my first visit that it will never be the last. Many more to come!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Low

sample_reviews_en.text:
We dined at this restaurant for a 3 course lunch set menu for around 800-900 thb, I forgot the exact price (around $24-27/person)

Its not fine dining but I would say its upscale and a little mix or casual/upscale, but service is great!

For appetizers, we had the terrine and beef carpaccio. We highly recommend both of them, absolutely delicious!

For main course, my girlfriend had the duck breast with probably the best potatoes I've ever had. They were crispy on the outside yet soft and silky on the inside! I had the beef tartar, there was something "off" about the beef tartar so I don't recommend it. Portions were good though, so we're happy about that

For dessert, I had the vanilla bean ice cream sandwich and my girlfriend the lemon crepe. I liked my dessert and I recommend it

The major improvement here are the main courses, but aside from that, we are happy with everything else!

PS
If this review was helpful to you in any way, please "like/thumbs up" 👍🏻 so it may help other people as well, thank you in advance! :)
sample_reviews_en.author: John Jester Ching

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant garden is lovely, feeling cozy. But we sat inside to avoid the insects and mosquito. We could hear people walking upstairs, which was very noisy, ruining the romance the restaurant wants you to experience.

Food wise, the bread was very tough, so we asked them to change it. The second bread was better. The starters (souffle cheese and escargots) were very good.  When it came to the main course, we were very disappointed with the sea bass and duck breast 😩. Sea bass was frozen, so the texture was not as nice as it is fresh. The duck was overcooked. I wish they would improve their standards. This is a though time for the restaurant business during the COVID-19, food cannot be stocked, and very stricter regulations on selling alcohol, but this also gives them the opportunity to challenge themselves to prove that their service is never down. Good luck.
sample_reviews_en.author: Punyawee Intaraksa

sample_reviews_en.text: It wasn’t our first time here, and I was surprised how come I hadn’t left a review much earlier! We found this place a few years ago and keep coming back when we have the chance to. And after years of repeated visits, I can guarantee the quality never changes. The prices are really reasonable compared to the quality of the ingredients and the portion of the dishes. This restaurant always stays true to their authenticity and genuineness to their customers. The atmosphere is warm and homey, the dishes also reflect this notion very perfectly. Although the last time we went we witnessed the plate presentation was evolving to a more fine-dining style, the tastes still remain as comfort choice for French cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panisara Sittiwong

sample_reviews_en.text:
An incredible dining experience from start to finish. We started with the beef tartare and the seared tuna salad, both of which were incredibly fresh and well-balanced. For the mains, the duck breast was cooked to a perfect medium-pink and paired beautifully with the rich reduction, while the seared fish in the creamy sauce was delicate and flavorful.
The wine list is a standout—we really enjoyed the 2023 Viognier and the 2021 Muscadet. We finished the night with a crème brûlée that had the perfect 'crack' on the sugar crust. Great atmosphere for a date or a nice night out.The service is really great, more casual, Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pitikorn Promma

sample_reviews_en.text: Indigo is a fantastic French restaurant in Soi Convent, down a little alley – if you’re not looking for it, you could miss it.  It has been there for quite some time, I believe the bartender said 15 years. There is a full bar, an indoor, and outdoor seating area (the outdoor seating is quite cute  - worth a try if it isn’t too hot).  The menu is more “traditional,” but in a good way. I had the endive salad and then the scallops for my main course – both were excellent. My friends enjoyed their dishes as well, all in all an excellent meal. Service was attentive and very eager to please – I highly recommend Indigo.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiro

sample_reviews_en.text:
🦪After almost three years, returning to Indigo was like reuniting with an old friend who never loses their essence. Quality, character, and efficiency intact 👏🏽. The ritual dedicated to my friend's beef tartare was a spectacle in itself, while my exquisite tuna tartare… well, it didn't receive the same treatment 😅. Jealousy, damn jealousy!!! Meanwhile, the fresh oysters + prosecco were the perfect combination for a spectacular lunch.

🙏🏽 Thanks to the Indigo team for the prompt and attentive service that makes every visit unforgettable. Cheers 🥂
#Indigo #BangkokEats #FoodieLife #ProseccoAndOysters #restaurant
sample_reviews_en.author: JEvangelista

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had an absolutely amazing lunch at Indigo! Everything was perfect from start to finish. The food and service were both excellent, truly a classic French restaurant in every sense. The wine list was very impressive with so many great selections, and we found it to be excellent value for money.

We ordered the côte de boeuf to share – it was cooked perfectly, full of flavor, and such a great portion to enjoy together. The overall experience felt authentic, refined, and yet very welcoming. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a real French dining experience in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohammad Farran

restaurants.name: Rabeang Rimnum
restaurants.address:

458 ศรีเขื่อนขันธ์ ศรีเขื่อนขันธ์ - ซอย ศรีเขี่อนขันธ์ 2 Song Khanong, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tasty thai food with good service, affordable price and great view. Most menus were written in Thai, but some staff spoke English, so they explained about food and price.
I ordered Tom Yam with seafood. The taste was the good balance of sour and spicy. It came with tabletop pot, so it was also good that it won’t get cold until I finished it.
We went there on the lunch time, but it must be beautiful with the lighted up bridge in the evenings. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Reina Furukawa

sample_reviews_en.text:
After an hour of waiting for food, it still hasn't come. Even though it is after covid and the reopening of many restaurants, this should not have been an excuse for this kind of lateness on food.

Do not come for now if you want to experience this kind of service.

Wait until they have gotten all the chef back, who knows when but it's definitely not now.

You cannot miss the cute cat here!!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: PepsiBossman

sample_reviews_en.text:
A great spot if you’re looking for tasty Thai dishes. Genuinely impressed by the food, all the recommend menu are delicious and exceeded my expectations. I would easily give it 5 stars for both the food quality and the service. I’m deducting one star due to the atmosphere and tidiness, which could use some improvement to match the high standard of the food.

Would come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: kris soju

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located by the Chao Phraya River.
If you come in the evening, I recommend sitting on the outdoor balcony; the breeze is nice and cool.

There's a wide variety of food to choose from.
The taste is delicious, not too sweet.
My favorite is the spicy pork rib soup,
because it's made with stewed pork ribs, giving it a flavor similar to a super-spicy soup.
sample_reviews_en.author: SUNISA CHAUENG

sample_reviews_en.text: The Thai foods ( many dishes such as crab dip with rice cracker, fried shrimp cake, steamed savory curry seafood cake)are delicious but the Thai -Chinese foods are ok( Oyster omelet, fish maw soup), the vibe and the view are nice, the staff are friendly and helpful. however, you have to park beside the street, in front of the restaurant and the price is reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jarumart Panchim

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant on the way to Bang Krachao is located under the Bhumibol 1 Bridge, offering views of the Chao Phraya River. It's a charming old-house style restaurant with a great atmosphere, delicious food, and excellent service. You can enjoy your meal while admiring the river and the Bhumibol Bridge.
sample_reviews_en.author: sanansin yuangthab

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is good, the music is nice, it's perfect for bringing older people to eat, especially during sunset the view is stunning. Don't forget to pet the belly of the cat that sleeps and greets guests at the cashier counter! 😂 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Sorranut Kraitrakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great and the food is delicious. I brought my family here after Mother's Day and the food came out quickly. We were very impressed. Highly recommend it. I've been here many times already. 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: La Gon

restaurants.name: Spaghetti - Italian Food
restaurants.address:

The Storeys, B1 Floor, Room 2B101, 199 One Bangkok, Witthayu Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wandering around One Bangkok, I stumbled upon this Italian restaurant, the pizza oven and the inviting sign immediately caught my eye, so I had to give it a try!

They make fresh pizza right here, kneading the dough and baking it in the oven in front of the restaurant. And get this, the pasta is also made fresh daily! I secretly confirmed this detail with the staff

The restaurant also serves a small complimentary bread basket as an appetizer when you order

I just have to say, it was absolutely delicious! Buonissimo!  The pizza crust was crispy yet soft, super tasty, and not at all greasy. The spaghetti was perfectly al dente and chewy, totally hit the spot! Overall, the food flavors were incredibly satisfying, especially the seafood. What's more, I know this from the staff that the chef is Italian and most of their ingredients are imported directly from Italy. This truly gives you that authentic, homemade Italian taste

If you're a fan of Italian food, you absolutely can't miss this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chatchanok Boonsatchai

sample_reviews_en.text: A delicious Italian dinner with friendly and helpful, English speaking staff. My price point was based on a dinner with a starter, main and a couple glasses of wine. Overall the menu is very affordable and with a large variety of bright yummy dishes. I had the tomato bruschetta and the olive oil was so delicious and tomatoes fresh. There's balsamic and olive oil on the table for your complimentary bread and breadstick bag. Salt and pepper grinders for fresh grinds if you so desire, which are always nice when you're having bruschetta and Italian.  I opted for the lasagna for my main and it was creamy yummy delicious with fresh basil sprigs on the top which was a very nice touch. Everything was seasoned nicely so that you could adjust how you wanted with fresh grinds.   They have wine by the glass and a variety of drinks. Overall a great experience and I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joey B

sample_reviews_en.text:
Four cheese gnocchi was sub par. Even I made in my own just from YouTube version is still 10x better than what they served to us. Too much cream, not enough cheese. Stingy with the amount of cheese. This is a fair observation as a foodie. Mango shake was too much juice, it tasted artificial. Coconut shake had too much ice and it didn't really taste coconut. Even as street stall is still much better taste.

Their pizza burrata and ham was on the other hand very good. Compliment to the Pizza chef.

Overall, 2 star because of the pizza alone. Total bill of 1600 baht including service charge. I dontknow how they can charge this amount with such mediocrity.

Suffice to say, we're not coming back to this restaurant. With a lot of restaurants in Bangkok, fortunately we are spoilt with the endless other choices!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sita's Journey

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had an amazing experience at this restaurant in Bangkok. After spending a long time in Thailand, it was such a pleasure to enjoy delicious Italian food that really reminded us of the flavors we had been missing.

The food was absolutely fantastic, fresh, flavorful, and clearly prepared with great care. Every dish we tried was excellent.

What truly made the experience special was the service. The staff were incredibly attentive, friendly, and welcoming throughout the entire evening. They made us feel comfortable and well taken care of from the moment we arrived.

Without a doubt, this was the best restaurant we have eaten at during our time in Thailand. We highly recommend it to anyone visiting Bangkok who is looking for great Italian food and outstanding service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Elad Nehardea

sample_reviews_en.text:
At B1 floor, The Storey building, near escalators. One Bangkok had very huge parking lots.

This restaurant was easy to access, no waiting line. Not like the more famous Italian restaurant on the third floor.

Service was very nice. A lot of sfaffs ready to serve.

Price was reasonable and good value. Compare with another famous Italian restaurant, here is very good price.

Taste was standard in good Italian food. Pizza was baked in big oven but no wooden smell. Pork chop was good but not recommend. Next time I will try pastas.

Recommend for Italian food lovers. Chef was Italian. Relax atmosphere and no need to wait. Must try.
sample_reviews_en.author: P. Jit.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had some fantastic Italian food in Thailand 🍝🇮🇹 right there in One Bangkok, which is central. The seafood pizza was a great size to share and super delicious. They make their pizza fresh, perfect for 1-2 people. Plus, you can order by the slice if you want.

I also tried the tagliatelle with mushrooms and truffle, and it was delicious. The medium-rare Australian ribeye was just right for our meal.

I enjoyed it all with a glass of wine, and hanging out with my friends was a blast. It was my first time there, but we definitely plan to go back for more good food.

The staff was really friendly, and the service was fast
sample_reviews_en.author: Pataraporn C.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really liked this restaurant in The Storeys zone at One Bangkok. The head chef is Italian, and they use all ingredients imported from Italy — but the prices are very affordable.

I ordered the fried seafood, Australian ribeye steak, spaghetti carbonara, and truffle mushroom pizza. Everything tasted great, but the pizza and spaghetti are highly recommended dishes if you come here. They make their own pizza dough and pasta, which makes the flavor even better. The quality was really good, and it felt like such a great deal for the price.

If you’re visiting One Bangkok, I really recommend trying this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Melanie L

sample_reviews_en.text: I was craving pizza, so I looked for an Italian restaurant in One Bangkok and found this one. I decided to try it. I ordered a ham and mushroom pizza, which was delicious – the crust was soft and easy to eat. I also ordered french fries and chicken steak, but I forgot to take pictures. Both were incredibly delicious as well. It's a shame they were out of pork chops, I'll have to try that next time. I'll definitely be back for a second time because everything was so good. I was very impressed with the food this time. We ordered three dishes for two people, and the price wasn't as high as I thought.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piggybooboo ww

restaurants.name: After You Dessert Cafe
restaurants.address:

444 อาคาร MBk, Level 3, Zone A, Phaya Thai Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Shocking and aggressive customer service.
Visited this branch on July 15 around 7-8pm. The shop was only 2 customes and 2 ordering at the counter, so we put our bags down at a table first before walking over to the counter to order. Instead of politely explaining the policy, the staff member was incredibly hostile and aggressively told us "ออกไป" (get out).
Using such degrading language toward paying customers when the store is completely empty is unacceptable. I am deeply disappointed by this shocking lack of basic hospitality. Management needs to investigate this staff member immediately. Will not return.
sample_reviews_th.author: sabai fans

sample_reviews_en.text: Being located inside a secluded corner of MBK is definitely a perk - this was the least chaotic After You branch I’ve ever been to. There was no wait and I got seated immediately. The desserts were a nice addition after dinner at MBK, but unfortunately the different choice I made this time didn’t go quite well. I ordered a biscoff caramel ice cream or something, and a lavender-matcha drink because the other times I always went for their toast or shaved ice. The ice cream was okay if not for the strong cinnamon flavor (which I kinda dislike for it overthrowing everything else), but the drink was so, so bad. I didn’t understand the point of adding lavender at all because it made the whole thing smell and taste super weird. That was the cup of matcha that took me the longest in my life to finish I think. Always go with their signature dishes!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Quinn'z Land

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is After You Dessert Cafe at MBK Center.
Located on the second floor of MBK Center, it's conveniently located for a stop during sightseeing or shopping. My target was their famous "Mango Sticky Rice Shaved Ice." Hidden within the fluffy ice were chunks of mango and traditional Thai sticky rice, creating a perfectly balanced sweet and salty flavor that was truly impressive. The cafe is bright and clean, but as it's a popular spot, there might be a short line depending on the time of day. However, the turnover is quick, so it's not too much of a hassle. They offer regular and mini (Baby Size) sizes, and the mini is more than enough for one person. This is a must-visit classic dessert shop when you're in Bangkok. It's the perfect spot to soothe your tired body after a day of shopping!
sample_reviews_en.author: パパちゃん

sample_reviews_en.text:
This shop is famous for its visually appealing shaved ice.

I was one of those who were skeptical, thinking it would just be all about looks...until I actually tried it 😅
I ordered the mango sticky rice shaved ice, and it was twice as delicious as I expected; I was utterly amazed.
The shaved ice was incredibly fluffy, almost as smooth as soft serve ice cream, and I finished it in an instant, feeling embarrassed for hesitating about ordering the full size because I thought it might be too big 🤤
There are quite a few branches in Bangkok alone, but if you have a sweet tooth, I definitely recommend it.
Next time, I'd like to try their seasonal menu items.
sample_reviews_en.author: E M.

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch isn't very big, with about 20 tables, and is located near the elevator. The pastries and menu are the same as other branches. The staff provides good service. Parking is convenient in the MBK parking lot, and wheelchairs are accessible. You can order takeout from the front of the store or by phone. The restaurant isn't very large; each table is suitable for about 6 to 4 people. The pastries are delicious and updated seasonally. I like their signature drink, "Ting Ramnet." The staff here is very helpful. Open from 11 AM to 9:30 PM, last order...
sample_reviews_en.author: Denise Lin

sample_reviews_en.text: My favourite Shibuya Toast has been a top favourite since a decade ago when the chain opened. The bread is the secret. Toasted crispy on the outside and soft with lots of butter in the inside. The syrup is just light and savoury enough to enhance the taste. Their ice cream was perfectly in sync with the toast abd made the dessert perfect. A small mention too was the ice lemon Thai tea which is unique to Thailand as they use the that tea leaves which are very Fragrant.
sample_reviews_en.author: jeremy cho

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant in MBK Center is packed with students, tourists, and is very noisy; you have to shout to talk to each other. Waiting times for food are 3-5 minutes. The staff doesn't have time to recommend dishes; you have to read the signs yourself. There's no staff to manage the queue; you can just sit at whichever table is available. They don't even wipe the tables because the restaurant is so busy and the staff can't keep up.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yes No Ok

sample_reviews_en.text:
This branch gets quite crowded in the evenings, but the wait isn't too long.
You order your food in advance, so by the time you get a table, you can get drunk quickly, which is good.

The staff are okay, friendly and smiling, even though there are long queues and a lot of foreigners, making communication difficult.

The atmosphere is always lively, with many foreigners, making it a popular spot for people to check in.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anongsri Boon

restaurants.name: The Garden Dough
restaurants.address:

32 Phutthabucha 40 Alley, Bang Mot, Thung Khru, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: THIS IS NOT real Italian food! Just look at the photos! If you take a look at carbonara for example, is obvious that is NOT the real original Italian receipt. Pizza has its borders too much thin, and too much larger, and is NOT properly cooked; cooking time is too much short! If you want to say that the food is good then no problem, but please don’t say that the Italian cuisine is good!!! It’s just a pale imitation of the original!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rodolfo Berardini

sample_reviews_en.text: A small, family-owned restaurant in a nice, casual setting of a private house. All of the dishes I tried were nice but I particularly like the pasta al dente texture. Pity that they didn't make their homemade ice cream, perhaps due to slow business during COVID. Recommended for those coming around Prachauthit - Puttabucha area. The price is much reasonable too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Meena Kom

sample_reviews_en.text: I order the Margherita pizza with pineapple topping they charge for delivery fee 30 baht, the pizza is 230 baht, they come to my house with out forgot to bring a pizza so they go back to get a pizza for me but at the time we eat the pizza it’s was hard like a rock and it’s not delicious at all this pizza is not good for senior teeth.
sample_reviews_en.author: BD Life

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a big pizza with a thin base and a crispy rim. Definitely better than from any Pizza Chains, it can easily compete with some of the Italian Restaurants in Town.
Best is the location in a lush garden of a private property, hidden away from all traffic and hassle. Possible to sit outside as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Walter - ProTech Transfer - (Walter Brauns)

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating at this restaurant for almost 10 years. It's a small place with a homey atmosphere. The menu has expanded, but the pizza has a thin crust and the familiar taste. The spaghetti is delicious, and they use high-quality ingredients. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thatsanan Sakulthong

sample_reviews_en.text: Good pizza! Try the cheese balls and frozen yogurt/ice cream too! Situated in the garden of the owner's home. Lovely place. Will appeal to 'western'/modern decor tastes. Disappointing that when we ate there they had no chili. I mean, no chili?! Its Thailand!?
sample_reviews_en.author: Chané RD

sample_reviews_en.text:
We drove 1 hour to eat at the restaurant because the reviews were so good.  It was worth the travel time.  The pizza
was delicious  - light dough, not heavy.  The salad was wonderful .  We loved the comfortable atmosphere.  We'll be back
sample_reviews_en.author: David W. Engstrom

sample_reviews_en.text: The house is so beautiful. PIZZA specifically is so nice.  Pasta and other food was nice too. Also they care for kids with high chair, kids plate and crayons  for painting during waiting.
sample_reviews_en.author: YONG Chuangchan Borvornluck

restaurants.name: So Vegan - i'm Chinatown​ (2F)
restaurants.address:

F2 แอม ไชน่าทาวน์ ห้อง F2-14, 15 ถ. เจริญกรุง แขวงป้อมปราบศัตรูพ่าย, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited in the early evening on 19 July. This eatery is located in the I'm Chinatown mall, which is compact per Bangkok standards. But they still have four stories of stores, restaurants, salons, and a 7-11 downstairs.

But we went to visit So Vegan. They have a full menu, and the special plate offer is handwritten in Thái on a sign in front of the register. Food here is solid and this place alone is worth a trip to this mall. We paid 75 Baht each for a rice plate with 3 dishes, rice plate with 3 other dishes, and fried spring rolls. They were all really good.

We've eaten at a few vegetarian spots in this city, and this was a little more expensive than a food court eatery. But what they offered was also better quality. There were several fake meat options, and the two fake meats I had were good and spicy.

Prices are good for what you get, staff was friendly and patient (and cute), and the food was good. This mall is smaller, but it's fun and you should stop by when in Chinatown.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dan Pieloch

sample_reviews_en.text:
Its difficult to find vegetarian food in Bangkok but these guys made it very easy to find and it was very delicious!

We ate so much but still had a lot left on our plates. Serving sizes were very large, we felt bad for leaving some uneaten but still.

Only downside is location compared to the rest of Chinatown but that can't get helped.

Definitely recommend for vegetarians/vegans looking for something to eat in Bangkok 👌
sample_reviews_en.author: Mitchell Smith

sample_reviews_en.text: While on holiday, we were looking for a vegan restaurant near our hotel and came across this place. It's located on the second floor. They offer a wide variety of vegan and vegetarian dishes, both with and without substitutes, at very low prices. You can either order from the menu or create your own plate with several dishes. We really enjoyed our meal, and the service was friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sven

sample_reviews_en.text:
The greatest vegan food with amazing taste.

I deeply fall in love with the mushroom soup (its actual name is mushroom noodle soup but you can order the soup only.)

Additionally, don’t miss their lotus stem salad and the stir-fried spicy minced pork (vegan). They are both very catchy, and go so well with the rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Triet Le

sample_reviews_en.text:
No words needed look at the photos.
Also
Was such a disappointment.
After I asked to have something else they  brushed me off and can not speak one word in English!
The food was pre-made and they worked it in the microwave.
I will never go there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ronen Bach

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great all vegan/plant based stall in the food court of a shopping centre.
There’s ready to eat foot on display but also an excellent à la carte menu with lots of delicious options.
Very affordable, quick friendly service and absolutely fantastic food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gerry International

sample_reviews_en.text:
I showed the staff the list of foods that shouldn't be eaten, and they apologized, explaining that all the dishes contained the five pungent spices.

It's a real shame.

Vegan food lovers might still want to give it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: 傲哥

sample_reviews_en.text: Search through the Google recommendation and was introduced to this place in Chinatown.  Very surprised to see their menu with so many choices.  The price is very reasonable. Highly recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: Liverpool 13

restaurants.name: Tonkotsu Kazan
restaurants.address:

G Floor 2 Soi Sukhumvit 23, 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came for a solo lunch in the late afternoon and had a great experience. I ordered spicy ramen set with rice and karaage. I really appreciated the straightforward and fast service, staff is polite and I had no problem ordering in English. Menu is easy to navigate and atmosphere quite pleasant. I liked that it was clean, quiet (super sensory friendly), and server wasn’t intrusive which sometimes happens around BKK. You can pay by card which is another bonus.

The food wasn’t anything exceptional, but for the price in this location it was good. The ramen isn’t the same as what you get in Japan, but still tasty. I just didn’t like that the egg was a bit cold so I had to wait for it to warm up in the soup. There could be a bit more meat in the ramen. Other than that perfectly okay meal, I enjoyed it. I recommend this place for a quick lunch, but it’s not a culinary experience, so don’t expect fine dining level.
sample_reviews_en.author: T P
