sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the Oyakodon (chicken and egg rice bowl) for 159.43B (tax included), where the fluffy, runny egg is the star. You can't go wrong with Oyakodon; it's a classic.

The aroma of dashi and soy sauce wafted up the moment I opened the lid. The perfectly runny, soft-boiled egg was immediately appealing.

The egg had a light, airy texture and was coated in a delicious sweet and savory broth. It paired perfectly with the rice, creating a comforting taste with every bite.

The chicken was cut into large chunks, juicy and flavorful with every bite. The onions were cooked just right, their sweetness brought out beautifully, creating a well-balanced dish.

It wasn't flashy, but the gentle flavor of the broth stood out; it was a bowl I'd want to eat again and again.

There were other delicious-looking dishes, so I'll upload the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Syo Kei

sample_reviews_en.text:
Come try our piping hot ramen 🍜🔥 at Tonkotsu Kazan Ramen, located in the Jasmine Hotel on Sukhumvit Soi 23. The restaurant has a Japanese-style decor with a prominent red Mount Fuji in front, giving it a feel of a local Japanese ramen shop 🇯🇵

The Kazan Shoyu broth is rich and flavorful, a perfect blend of tonkotsu and soy sauce.

✅ The highlight is that it's served in a constantly boiling hot stone pot, allowing the noodles to slowly absorb the broth. The longer you eat, the richer the flavor becomes.

❌ The downside: the broth is extremely hot and can seriously burn your mouth 🤣

🐖 The pork is tender and in large slices, with plenty of vegetables. It's a satisfyingly filling ramen, perfect for when you crave something hot, reasonably priced, and substantial 🔥🍜
sample_reviews_en.author: SPÄÇĚ MØŇKĘY

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is another restaurant I frequent quite often.
My most frequently ordered dish is the Miso Volcano Ramen.
It's slightly salty and spicy.
The ramen noodles are different from other restaurants.
The texture of the noodles is a bit undercooked, slightly firm and thin, but actually cooked well.
It's served in a piping hot stone pot, so be careful not to burn yourself.
Another surprisingly delicious dish is the tempura shrimp.
sample_reviews_en.author: HIPSKULL Pomade

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the randomly selected dish, and it tasted delicious. The broth looked thick, but it wasn't actually thick at all; it was refreshing and easy to eat. The noodles were on the thin side. I chose the Destew broth, and the flavor was surprisingly well-balanced; I didn't need to add anything extra. What surprised me was the gyoza and the chicken karaage.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Smith

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff's attitude is just awful every single time. The food is delicious, so I'm writing this review with the hope that it will be worthwhile. If you want to experience the worst customer service in Bangkok, please give it a try lol. If there was a review with zero stars, I'd give it that rating.
sample_reviews_en.author: junichi ina

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there late at night,
and the young, skinny, small female employee had an extremely bad attitude, which made me very uncomfortable.
This woman is not suited for customer service. She should change jobs.
If you don't want to have an unpleasant experience, you should not go to this store.
sample_reviews_en.author: google Customer

sample_reviews_en.text:
The broth was fantastic, and the egg was cooked perfectly.

The noodles were okay, but not the Japanese-style raw noodle method.
The char siu pork was off; the flavor was wrong, and it was tough.

The decor and atmosphere were very Japanese.
sample_reviews_en.author: 到處走走 到處吃吃喝喝

restaurants.name: รฤก Raleuk Taste of memories
restaurants.address:

144, 1 Charoen Chai Alley, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
10/10 for the cozy, homely, yet stylish and glamorous decor!
This place specializes in beef dishes, and at this price point, they’re truly impressive—especially the sous vide beef tongue and rice pot, which are outstanding.
However, the other dishes could use significant improvement; they tasted more like simple home-cooked meals, similar to dorm-style cooking (เด็กหอ).
sample_reviews_th.author: Jaa J

sample_reviews_en.text:
PHENOMENAL 10/10

I’ve driven past this place for countless of times and finally had a chance to visit. Beautiful space! Very nice atmosphere, decoration, and lighting.

The beefs were amazing! Really really fresh and tender. Wonderful taste. The price was also incredible, I was amazed the whole time I was flipping through the menu. Really appreciation this pricing in the current Bangkok’s inflation.

All the food came out very quickly. It was surprising how fast they were, we really appreciated it.

We were told at the restaurant that the beef wellington had to be preordered a day ahead. I wish we were told or asked that when we called to make a reservation.

Portion was big and the taste was great. Wish they had more drinks and dessert options but the tiramisu we had was great and not too sweet!

Plenty of parkings. Such a big upside for this location.

Hope they stay open and keep this quality and price for a long time. It just became one of my favourite places in town!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nawacharee P

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cozy restaurant with an affordable price.

This place offer a great steak with reasonable price, I got an A5 steak with just around 1,xxx bath. The appitizers we had that day were also taste nice, Ceasar salad dressing was incredibly good, Brisket sandwiches was nicely smoked, Shrimp bisque was also have good intense bisque smell, 10-sec fried beef was surpricingly tender.
The main dishes we had was beef fat fried rice in a pot, the heated pot made the rice at the bottom crispy which I like. The A5 steak I mentioned before was a Thai-wagyu Picanya steak, I was skeptical about this one before it was served, but this steak was so goood and with this pricing I would defenitely come back fot more.

The downside of this place is you might need booking before coming as the place is quite small and the staffs still new so they still need some improvements.

Overall the food here was exceptional and worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattha Tanthasatian

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice atmosphere but very very disappointed with the food.
The food either bland or very salty
Ordered steak with chimichurri with fried egg and potato.. the egg was good,potatoes were good but the star of the dish was bad steak has no seasoning and quite chewy and its the first time I’ve encountered this type of chimichurri .. tome chimichurri should be finely chopped herbs with tangy refreshing taste but this version is diced bell peppers and some greens and taste more like quick pickled.
Next baked clam with garlic butter…. One word to describe that dish “Salty”
For fried rice with steak.. the rice was ok but the meat was under seasoned and chewy
Also ordered mash potatoes with truffle oil .. tasted bland and i could taste raw flour for some reason.. maybe its the restaurant recipe but its the first time ive had mashed potatoes that has the taste of raw flour
sample_reviews_en.author: Napol Phisanbut

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place made you feel like you're having dinner with friends in the retro house with their wooden furniture and l like the old wine bottles reused as flower vases decorated all around the house. They serve their carpaccio with thin sliced picanha, seasoned  with a hint of salt and pepper and oil. The spaghetti carbonara is served with a big piece of medium-rare grilled picanha sliced. The sauce is creamier after being mixed well with fresh egg yolk.
The meat inside the Beef Wellington is also tender and warm pie. We tried the sando, a sandwich with a chunk of juice steak meat served with flavorful gravy. I also love the grilled beef tongue that comes with 2 style dip sauces; the spicy herb one and egg yolk soy sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angelica

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a pleasant experience dining at Raluek: Taste of Memories. The restaurant offers a cozy, homely atmosphere that makes you feel like you’re enjoying a comforting meal at a friend’s house. It’s a charming space that invites you to slow down and savor each bite.

Food: The dishes were tasty and flavorful — clearly crafted with care and a sense of nostalgia. However, we did feel a bit thirsty afterward, which may be contain seasoning or MSG than expected. It didn’t take away too much from the overall enjoyment, but it’s worth noting for those sensitive to it.

Service: The staff were lovely attentive, kind, and welcoming.

A nice spot to enjoy comfort food in a relaxed setting. We’d be happy to return again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wimonwan Liwchavaroj (TuiTui)

sample_reviews_en.text: 5⭐️ This place truly lives up to its name — it’s all about flavors that stay with you. I had one of their signature dishes, and it was unforgettable. The seasoning was perfectly balanced, the presentation beautiful, and the flavors rich yet comforting. The salad surprised me the most — fresh, crisp, and so addictive that I ordered it twice without hesitation. The staff were warm and attentive, making me feel welcome from the moment I walked in. The ambiance has a nostalgic charm, with thoughtful décor that matches the restaurant’s theme. Dining here feels like a mix between visiting an old friend’s home and discovering a hidden culinary gem krub.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaithawat Dongcharoaen

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's no surprise this restaurant is so popular and has tons of reviews on TikTok.
The ambiance is great, perfect for a date, and the food is amazing. It's not just photogenic; it has a fancy feel but the prices aren't expensive.
1. 10-Second Fried Beef: Delicious, I loved it. The pieces at the end were tender and melted in your mouth. The slightly thicker pieces were a bit chewy.
2. Beef and Truffle Fried Rice: Delicious. Overall, everything was good, but the beef was fragrant and tasty, though a bit tough.
3. Assorted Sausages: Good.

I recommend calling to make a reservation beforehand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panupong Chanrun

restaurants.name: Tenjo Sushi & Yakiniku Premium Buffet
restaurants.address:

ชั้น 6 Central World, 4, 4/1-4/2 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Japanese-style yakiniku (grilled meat) buffet restaurant is located on the fifth floor of CentralWorld, before the entrance to the Central zone. The restaurant isn't very large, with a limited number of tables. The menu mainly consists of items for grilling and other Japanese dishes such as grilled meats, fresh shrimp, salmon sashimi, sushi, and various types of rollona. Customers choose from courses priced from a few hundred to a few thousand baht, with varying levels of variety.

I visited on a Sunday lunchtime in mid-January. The restaurant was relatively quiet, even at lunchtime, with plenty of empty tables. Ordering is done via a QR code system. Sauces, desserts (initial portions), and drinks are self-service.

Overall, it's a buffet restaurant with a reasonably diverse menu. Some items were sold out, but these weren't core dishes, so it was acceptable. Some ordered dishes took a considerable amount of time to prepare, but there were no missed orders. The rice portions in the sushi were excessive; be mindful of this when ordering.
sample_reviews_en.author: pakinai kasiwat

sample_reviews_en.text:
We have been returning customers here for years. The staff are good and provide nice service. We always order the Prime menu, which is a bit expensive, but are always disappointed for consecutive times. The quality of meat has gone down for so long.

I hope the quality is raised as it used to be before because we really notice the decline in quality of meat to the point that it is not chewable. Also, orders are not arriving in a timely manner, even appetizers come late after one hour.

Still love the people who work here and always treat us well and accommodate us. Maybe there is a need to increase the workforce as well because so many customers and there is high turnover.

There are so many competitions in Centralworld now that have caught up with good BBQ options like Xita Ama, Tajimaya, and You&I.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bernadette Buhat

sample_reviews_en.text:
We've been to several Tenjo around Bangkok. This is probably the first time we feel very disappointed. We selected the Ultima package for this visit. The food was very slow and I mean very slow. Slice beefs takes on average 10 to 20 mins to come out. We almost had to ask server to check on our order everytime before we get our food. Some of the server we made eye contacted with just walk away. The front person was very helpful, but other server not so much. I'll never come back to this location. The one in Siam Square one is much faster and better service.

For time limited buffet, I just can't help but feel a cheated with how slow everything is. Even the simple sliced beef order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tony S

sample_reviews_en.text:
July 7, 2025
I went on a hunt for this place. I went to Tenjo, Ari branch, but it was closed. I took the BTS to Siam, but it wasn't there.
I walked all the way to CentralWorld; the restaurant is on the 6th floor near the Central (ZEN) entrance.

The service standards were drastically different from when I ate at the Ari branch.

Here, they checked if I had received all my orders.
They continuously changed the grilling rack.
They constantly cleared plates and utensils.
They periodically checked the charcoal in the grill.

My first visit was about two years before COVID at another branch.

Today, I was incredibly full and got everything I ordered.
sample_reviews_en.author: DNA- TH

sample_reviews_en.text:
Second time at this location and unfortunately a little disappointed. Orders were often mistaken or unknowingly canceled, so at some point we had no clue of open orders. The yakiniku pot took 25 min to arrive but the time was extended on the bill so no deduction for that.
For the further rating, let's try a foto story.
The so called super marbled Wagyu was just an usual chewy beef as seen in the foto. The Toro had quite extended oxidation colouring on the surface and didn't feel fresh at all. To conclude everything, the last foto is the bill of the diarrhea medication needed for the following days.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chang !

sample_reviews_en.text:
Huge disappointment. The “wagyu” is definitely not wagyu — it’s tough, clearly glued-together meat that falls apart into small rectangular pieces. You can literally see the seams. The beef tongue was extremely chewy, and honestly nothing on the menu was impressive.

The foie gras was the only thing that was decent.

Service was just as bad. The waiters brought food out so slowly even though we were the only table dining the entire time we were there. No idea how this place has such high ratings. There are so many better options out there — save your money and go somewhere else.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yijin Zhao

sample_reviews_en.text:
We decided to come  to Tenjo Sushi today we like how it was looking on pictures outside of restaurant and price was reasonable.
But after they start bringing food in plastic plates it's doesn't look best,food wasn't bad but also not best.
No music at all only hear air extractors and other people's .
Also we smell like we been working outside next to BBQ 😂but this is normal for BBQ restaurants
Restaurant service was very quick and helpful can't complain that .
To be honest Zen buffet was much better and more tastier than Tenjo.
sample_reviews_en.author: Matus Makara

sample_reviews_en.text:
This buffet offers a huge variety of dishes, and everything is absolutely delicious! From sushi and sashimi to pork, beef, shrimp, and crab, the selection is impressive. The seafood and most of the meat options were top-notch.

The only downside was the beef, which was often too chewy and could use some improvement in quality. However, this small flaw doesn’t take away from the overall experience. If you’re looking for a buffet with fantastic variety and flavors, this place is totally recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Joagat

restaurants.name: Por. Pochaya
restaurants.address:

654 656 ถ. วิสุทธิกษัตริย์ Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A la carte eatery serving a menu inspired by both Chinese and Thai stir-fries. It feels like nothing has changed in this restaurant in the past forty or fifty years. You absolutely must order the Fried Pork Liver with Garlic. Restaurants don't skimp on the garlic when making their fries, so the fries are bursting with flavor. You can also choose from Minced Beef with Cumin Leaves, Snapper with Chili Sauce, Crab Omelette, or Tom Klong Seafood, just to name a few of the unique dishes available. This eatery is great for spice lovers who enjoy a robust flavor profile in their cooked meals.

The store is only open for a limited time, from 9:00 am to 13:30 pm. There are a lot of people there beginning around 11:00. You should probably make a reservation first. because there is a possibility that it is already full. A young coconut pudding with a subtle flavor is served as dessert. There is a small coffee shop inside the store, but the selection of beans is impressive. Inexpensiveness is reflected in the cost. You should definitely check out this store.

Guests can park at the nearby Tri Thotsathep Temple and walk the five minutes to the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kit Nit

sample_reviews_en.text:
When I got here, I was told the restaurant was full. However, I asked again about coming back later and the staff kindly added me to the reservation list and said I could wait 30 minutes. Make sure to go early or call ahead to reserve a spot!

I got a green thai tea with lime and waited for my table, placing my order while I waited. The wait went by quickly and then my food came out when I sat down.

The crispy fried shrimp with garlic was crunchy, savory, and creamy (without actual cream). Very garlicky and worth it.

The crab omelette was pillowy soft and filled with crab! This is a favorite and must try.

Stir fried clam with chili paste was so fragrant with lots of basil and had a lot of spicy oil.

The spicy seafood soup was the most flavorful dish I got there! Spicy, sour, savory, and sweet with seafood and mushrooms. The mushrooms in the soup was my favorite. Perfect with rice. It is spicy, but the spice fades quickly.

Overall, my total with two soft drinks was around 600 Thai Baht for two people, cash only.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dan Ma

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant deserve to be described by the song everything is awesome.

The food is delicious, everything is really good. The fried spare ribs with garlic are boneless which was perfect because I can eat it without having to touch it, We were lucky enough to have the last dish of stir-fried clams.(The next table also want it but it ran out :P ) We ordered the total of eight dishes, and 1 bow of rice, four servings of pudding, and three drinks. The price was very reasonable for everything we ordered. It come out just a bit more than 1000THB.
Unfortunately, there was no parking available, so we had to park at the hotel near by for which cose about 40 - 50 THB per hour. The restaurant is only open from 9:00 to 14:30. It's usually very busy during lunchtime, so it's recommended to make a reservation ahead of time. Luckily, we were able to get the non-reserved table available at around 11:30
sample_reviews_en.author: Sorravit Bunjongpean

sample_reviews_en.text:
Believe the hype. It’s incredible. Understated charm with friendly service and true depth of flavour.

It was quite busy when we got there which is usually the case apparently, and I could see why. A bustling mix of Asian tourists and locals. It’s a morning and lunch restaurant, 9-1pm and they don’t open on the weekends so be mindful and when you go. But it’s worth moving your schedule around for.

My wife and I ordered beef tongue with onions, it came with this delicious almost sweet sauce with carrots and peas. We also had liver and garlic, also fantastic and their crab omelette, which was good but left in the shadows compared to the other two dishes.

We’ve vowed to go back and try more food as soon as possible. Michelin definitely recommends this restaurant year after year for the right reasons. It’s awesome!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dom

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stumbled upon Por Pochaya completely by chance — had no idea it was a Michelin-listed spot! I managed to get a table right away, probably because it was close to closing time. The restaurant is only open for 4 hours a day, from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM.

Some dishes were already sold out, but the staff were super friendly and gave great recommendations.

The place has a cozy. Prices were reasonable and portions were just right.

I have to say — the garlic fried pork liver was the best I’ve ever had. So tender and flavorful, it just melted in the mouth. The spicy pork cartilage tom yum, crab omelet, and fried king mackerel were all amazing too.

There’s paid parking available at the hotel next door, which makes things really convenient.

Definitely a hidden gem worth visiting again!
sample_reviews_en.author: QUERIDA B

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came back because of the coffee I tried yesterday and Tried the food too. I didn't regret it!

I ordered beef with basil (little spicy which it was ) with rice and morning glory. All delicious and very quickly served.

When I noticed that people are coming from far with taxi and tuk tuk, tourists, locals, looking rich...I asked where are they going? All to this restaurant! Until I noticed the Michelin posters on the wall 😅

It's really a hidden gem looks very simple but wonderful experience.

The owner very friendly and efficient. And Nan's coffee inside the Restaurant is just a blessing.

This was my last meal in Bangkok and one of the best !! Totally recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Marina Marina

sample_reviews_en.text: Began our day at Por. Pochaya with a lovely 9 am meal. I can totally imagine how exciting the place would be when crowded. We were just 2, so couldn't eat much. Had their crab omelette and the garlic prawns. Both were lovely. Would have loved to go with a bigger group and have lots more. Best discovery of the meal was the charming Nan's coffee station inside the restaurant. Nan herself was there and she made a perfect pourover coffee for us. The thai milk tea here was the best we had in the trip. Nan told us how she mixed 5 tea leaves herself to get the flavour that she desires. Strongly recommend Por. Pochaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Salil Palkar

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tasty food, fresh ingredients
Each dish has been cooked fresh, dish by dish. But very quick though.

Atmosphere like home cooking and local, nothing fancy. But you can feel the community, the local life of people. An outstanding place around this area!
The restaurant has no parking lot. You can park at any place on the road, as long police don't lock up your car. Centra hotel, or nearby temple are available.
Reservation recommended, both for seat and pre-order your food.
Unbeatable is price of food in this quality!!!! 😃 No wonder for long year Michelin award. 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Ruangyos L.

restaurants.name: Burger King - The Street Ratchada
restaurants.address:

139 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: What's going on? They keep turning off the lights even though the restaurant is full of customers. The sign says "open 24 hours," but the air conditioning is on, yet it's like it's not. It's confusing. Did they get a power cut? People were sitting and eating, and suddenly the lights went out. It's like a street market with flashlights – they turn off the lights every time. The food portions are also getting smaller and smaller. The sun-dried chicken costs 99 baht and you only got 4 pieces. What direction are they going to take with this restaurant? From a loyal customer who eats here regularly, I'm quite disappointed with this branch. The restaurant's standards are strange.
sample_reviews_en.author: เกาะพีพียินดีต้อนรับ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The air conditioning at this branch isn't very effective; in fact, it's quite hot, even hotter than outside. Every day, students reserve tables and sit there for hours at night.
The ordering system is rather difficult to use, and the counter staff are constantly problematic. The payment scanner is always broken. The carbonated Coca-Cola is extremely strong and makes my stomach hurt. The French fries were soggy, like they hadn't been thawed before being thrown into the fryer. The core didn't seem fully cooked, and importantly, there were hard pieces in the fries—probably chicken bone fragments or some kind of sand—small specks on the tissue.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kohaku Umami

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was good and up to standard, but the staff lacked enthusiasm and attentiveness. Our order was incomplete; we thought it would arrive soon, but it didn't. We waited 20 minutes, then went to ask, and they said they forgot. We hadn't even opened the package of the burger that had already arrived, and we were still waiting for everything. It turned out the fish burger was actually chicken! This shouldn't happen with this brand. In the end, we had to exchange it because it wasn't correct. Seriously, manager, are you being too stubborn?!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanowit Lewchalermwong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was in a good mood and ordered food via Grab, and this is what I got? It's not even a small restaurant.

I ordered one piece of Tom Yum chicken and four pieces of Hat Yai fried chicken.
But what I got was four pieces of Tom Yum chicken and one piece of Hat Yai fried chicken. The order was incomplete; the sticky rice was missing, and the fried onions were chewier than those I've had at other branches. For that price, I could have eaten at another restaurant and wouldn't have been this disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: ขี้เกียจ ลงคลิป

sample_reviews_en.text: What's wrong with the staff at this branch? When I arrived, I gave them my order number. Once it was ready, they just placed it on the table without calling me. Other orders were ready, but I waited 30 minutes. I got up to check, and my order was still on the table, even though I arrived before everyone else. What's wrong with them?
sample_reviews_en.author: ปลายทาง ที่ว่างเปล่า

sample_reviews_en.text: Order at 03:00 in midnight and it takes 1,5 hours to make.. The burgers arrived not eatable, the paper en burger were completely soggy like they come out of the bathtub and the meat was rubber.. I mean how busy can it be at 03:00 after midnight? I will never order here again complete waste of 700 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: R M

sample_reviews_en.text:
So many workers so why so slow? There were only 2 people before me. 18 minutes waiting time.And I asked for cola zero but the bill says coke. The picture of the meal looks like a regular whopper but you get a small cheeseburger.
Better value and healthier at the nearby vietnamese or japanese places.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ronen

sample_reviews_en.text: The beef taste like dog food. Like corned beef. I threw my burger away after a bite or two.. the spicy chicken is actually powder, not authentically spicy dipped like you know it to be, , it’s like you’re eating dust and dirt:. Not worth it,  spend your money elsewhere!
sample_reviews_en.author: Aristide Lunardini

restaurants.name: Moom Muum Park
restaurants.address:

21 Soi Sukhumvit 19, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a really enjoyable experience at this restaurant, which offers a great variety of dishes in a very comfortable setting. The menu is quite expansive, featuring a solid mix of local flavors and international comfort food, making it an easy choice whether you’re dining solo or with a group.

The atmosphere is relaxed and well-suited for a casual lunch or a longer dinner, with a design that feels both spacious and welcoming.

Service was efficient and friendly throughout the meal, which really added to the overall positive experience.

It’s located in a very accessible part of the city, which is great if you’re planning to explore the surrounding area before or after eating.

The quality of the food is consistently good, and the pricing is very fair for the portion sizes and the level of service provided.

I’m already planning to return on my next visit to the area to try some of the other menu items I didn't get to this time. It’s definitely a solid, reliable spot that I would recommend to anyone looking for a stress-free, high-quality meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stuart L

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a modern industrial design with exposed ceilings and ductwork, accentuated by red lighting that adds a vibrant touch. The seating seems comfortable with a mix of booths and tables, catering to both small and larger groups. The lighting appears warm and subdued, creating a relaxed atmosphere.
The restaurant offers a good view of the cityscape, likely located in a high-rise building. This could make it an attractive spot for dining, especially around sunset or in the evening.
The restaurant offers promotions like a “Buy 1 Get 1 Free” deal on draught beer between 2 PM and 7 PM, which is a nice incentive for customers, especially those dining in the afternoon or early evening.
sample_reviews_en.author: soe koko

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had an amazing dinner at Moon Muum Park in Terminal 21! 🌆✨
🐟 The seafood hotpot served in a fish-shaped pan was so refreshing — tangy, spicy, and packed with squid, cabbage, and fresh herbs. Perfect balance of flavors!
🍤 The stir-fried prawns were another highlight — juicy, well-seasoned, and tossed with colorful peppers and onions. Every bite was full of wok-hei goodness.
Great food, cozy vibes, and definitely worth coming back for. 🙌
#moonmuumpark #Terminal21 #bangkokfood #bangkok
sample_reviews_en.author: Erin Quek

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is still one of my favorite places in BKK to take a date. Specially if it is a rainy day, you can then add in a movie an it is usually a great success.

The atmosphere is fantastic, good music, great view and a price that shows that you are not cheap Charlie, but will not break your bank.  Too bad that the food is lately so average, I think they have changed the chef and it is just “ok”.
sample_reviews_en.author: J Hern

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really like the crab fried rice here.. always comforting to finish the whole plate. It would be perfect if they can pair with Thai chilli (sour)..
Ordered their spicy minced catfish with mango salad and I think it is surprisingly good! Sauce is addictive as well.
This place would be good to chill as usually they are not very crowded.
The cocktail menu is a plus!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffrey Yeo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Moom-Muum Park offers a truly beautiful and serene environment. The highlight of our meal was the superb sea bass—flawlessly prepared. We were equally impressed by the farm-fresh vegetables and eggs, which had a remarkable natural sweetness. Highly recommended for a fresh and satisfying meal in a lovely setting.
#moommuumpark #Terminal21 #bangkokfood #bangkok
sample_reviews_en.author: qWww Q

sample_reviews_en.text: Seems to be a miscommunication with what we ordered. Which is understandable because of the language difference. Usually the person taking our order confirms the order with us to prevent errors. Not this time. Not a good birthday dinner. It seems management did try to fix but at that point it was too late and the restaurant was going to close soon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leonardo Moraes

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wide variety of menu but no unique identity or specialised cuisine. They were having a lobster promotion so we tried the Lobster Pad Thai which took very long to serve and the lobster didn't taste fresh. The pad Thai was passable too. The beef cubes were too tough and overcooked.

Great window views though and service was warm and friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daphne Yeo

restaurants.name: Heaven of weed
restaurants.address:

34 Room 11-12A Chaem Chan Alley Soi Sukhumvit 63, klongtun-nua Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I am a regular at this dispensary. It is very convenient for me as I live very close by. I would normally give this place a 5 star review but after my most recent visit, I was extremely disappointed. After spending 1000+THB there I came home and realized there wasn't any paper, which I purchased. So I returned to the store where the budtender was claiming she put it in there so I left to return home where I found no paper to be found again. So this time I bring the bag which she prepared and brought it back to the store. Again she said she definitely put it in there and accused me of dropping it. I told her I was either going to walk. out with a refund or a new paper... All this for an item only worth 70 baht. I've been coming here for over a 2 years and now I will not be returning here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Real Aviator

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing service! I had some issues with the automated payment system because I was using an international bank, but the staff was incredibly patient and helpful. They resolved everything manually in minutes and the delivery was super fast. Highly recommended for their great communication and efficiency
sample_reviews_en.author: AHV

sample_reviews_en.text: Outstanding selection and quality buds for a good price.  It sits on top of a live bar and restaurant.  Good vibe inside for sure.   Ask for Lee in the evenings.  Very friendly and will help walk you through the menu.   Very clean inside.  Highly recommend. 🙏🏽 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Bill Frost

sample_reviews_en.text: Before reaching the shop, you’ll pass a beautifully decorated place with a European-style vibe. Head up to the second floor and you’ll find the shop, where the staff are very helpful and knowledgeable. Definitely another must-visit spot in Ekkamai.💛 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Amonsiri

sample_reviews_en.text: This place has a really good vibe and the bartender know what he’s doing the staff super friendly and the price are very general I will recommend this place to other smokers out there .
sample_reviews_en.author: ANDREW N

sample_reviews_en.text: The best place to try weed in Bangkok! Shout out to my brother James take care of us! Try Phuket Weed , i recommend that one! Try the chicken wing! Bsst chicken wing you ever try! 🫶🫶🫶 …
sample_reviews_en.author: rahmat gunawan

sample_reviews_en.text: such a great place to hangout on sunday. hidden g of ekamai. this store located inside a restaurant so they have nice food provid for you!!!! recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: nuntapatana

sample_reviews_en.text: Best place that I’ve visited in Bangkok to havs a great time! This is my third time here. The place is sooo comfy
sample_reviews_en.author: Shafa Lubis

restaurants.name: The Gallops Restaurant
restaurants.address:

468 7 Pattaya Sai Song Soi 17 Pattaya City, Pattaya Chon Buri 20150

sample_reviews_en.text: What impressed me most was their Lamb Biryani, layered with fragrant spices, and the signature Butter Chicken, paired with freshly baked, irresistibly delicious Garlic Naan – a perfect sensory explosion. The average cost per person is around 300-600 baht, which is incredibly good value for such a convenient location. As one regular customer raved, "Not only is the food top-notch, but the staff's warm smiles make every meal feel like home." The restaurant is clean and tidy, with a modern, minimalist design that exudes a cozy, homey atmosphere – tranquil, welcoming, and sophisticated. Whether you're looking to start your day with an authentic Indian breakfast or seeking a comforting bite of rich curry late at night, this place offers a heartwarming adventure that transcends geographical boundaries and reaches the very core of your taste buds.
sample_reviews_en.author: 曼谷上门服务escort service 看主页

sample_reviews_en.text: Visiting Pattaya for the week so wanted to try some desi food. I rarely go out to eat Indian food so once in a while it brings back memories of being young. I ordered the special thali which includes two vegetable curries, butter milk, 4 rotis / chappatis, daal and rice. I also ordered the paper masala dosa and pani puri. The pani puri was good, no complaints at all puris were nice and crisp and chutneys were flavoured nicely 4/5 starts. The thali, portion was great size and tasted good. Nothing outstanding but I enjoyed it 3/5 stars. The paper dosa was a let down, it arrived flat to my table as you can see in the photos and it was soft to touch. The dosas if made fresh to order are served crispy which adds a nice texture. This I would give 2/5, and would not recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: aly nathu

sample_reviews_en.text:
"The Gallops Restaurant is a hidden gem! 🌟 The ambiance is cozy and inviting, with a warm atmosphere that's perfect for a  Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner with your beloved family or friends. The service is top-notch - friendly, attentive, and knowledgeable staff who make sure you're well taken care of.

The food is exceptional - each dish is expertly crafted and presented, with flavors that will leave you wanting more. I highly recommend trying their Fafda, Mix Veg and Paratha 😍- it's a game-changer! 🤩

Overall, The Gallops Restaurant is a must-visit for anyone looking for delicious food, great service, and a warm atmosphere. 5/5 stars! 👏
sample_reviews_en.author: DK Patel

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited this non-veg restaurant and had a great experience overall. The seating arrangement was one of the best I’ve seen—spacious, comfortable, and perfect for both small groups and families. The food was
flavorful and definitely worth the price. Everything we ordered was fresh, well-cooked, and satisfying. The service was also commendable—staff were attentive, polite, and quick to respond. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a good non-veg spot with a nice ambiance

The gallops restaurant pattaya thailand ❤️🇮🇳🇹🇭👌
sample_reviews_en.author: Neel RAJPUT

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is directly on the main road, next to vc hotel pattaya.It serves variety flavours south Indian, north Indian, Punjabi, Gujrati etc.alcohol also served here.It has friendly staff.Good part is this restaurant opens at 9am itself so there won't be any problem for breakfast.The main issue in this street is there are many Indian restaurants.in this region but everyone opens after 12pm but this restaurant opens at 9am which is a big advantage.please check my photos for interiors.
sample_reviews_en.author: s

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best Indian restaurant in town, this place has authentic Indian test, I highly recommend to everyone try here at least once while your trip. They have some special dishes like Handi Chicken, Handi Mutton, Handi Biriyani, Handi Panner, staff are very friendly and polite, very supportive with other activities too, they can help you to book Table in club & travel around Thailand 🇹🇭 as well. I love this place, very good vibe & my memorable experience with The Gallops-2 Restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nishray Khunt

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ve just tried their unlimited vegetarian buffet for 200 Baht only, and I was genuinely impressed. The food was delicious, with a good variety of dishes that were well-prepared and full of flavour. Everything tasted fresh and satisfying. The service was equally impressive — attentive, polite, and efficient throughout the meal. Overall, it was a very enjoyable dining experience, and I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for good vegetarian Indian food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vishal B

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the SPOT definitely been in Pattaya for seven days. I’ve had six different restaurants.
But I must tell you this so sooo far the best.
Such an extensive menu your meal doesn’t come,  just what you’ve ordered, so many side pickles chutneys are among you meal..
The guys working are very attentive.
The food you order comes out promptly.
Don’t judge this place of how it looks, taste the food it is definitely a be back spot for us all.
Put this on your to do list.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vic

restaurants.name: The Siam Tea Room
restaurants.address:

199 Sukhumvit Alley 22, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The ambiance was okay, but the prices were exorbitant, and the food was mediocre at best. I wouldn't recommend anything except the desserts; it wasn't even as good as the small restaurant downstairs from my hotel. We didn't finish much of the food (it was really bad), and there was an exorbitant service charge that wasn't disclosed… And who would have thought a bottle of water would cost nearly 200฿? That's absurd. My stomach felt uncomfortable after eating, and I'm currently on the toilet. I'm typing this from the toilet. I absolutely do not recommend going there…
sample_reviews_th.author: fanchan

sample_reviews_en.text:
You get interesting traditional thai food here with a little different twist of thai cuisine than in the typical restaurants allover the country. For instance the Larb Moo isnt a typical Issaan style one but still though tastes excellent. The Yum Woon Zen Tallee isnt the modern version you get everywhere and rather traditional so it doesnt come with tomato. Definitely interesting thai food even though it is on the pricier side but that is to be expected in hotel location like this. You can taste that the chef doesnt buy the cheap ingredients that most other restaurants use but aims for quality.

Their french pastry is only good but cannot compete even with common chains like Paul which was a bit disappointing. The ingredients are top notch though and the cakes and pastry is visually very pleasing. i think they had the best Rasberrries i have ever had in Asia topped on one of their tartes, really good and full of flavour.
I also liked their careful use of sugar, their pastries are not too sweet which is an issue in many bakeries these days.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jimbo Jackson

sample_reviews_en.text: We had a wonderful dinner. First course pomelo salad with soft shell crab, a perfect dish, very special, delicate flavor, main course we took pad kapho, I personally liked it but the dish was not very special, a Thai friend said it was very high quality, fish soup was very tasty, beef in red coconut sauce with pieces of palm hearts, the meat was tender, the sauce was very tasty and not too spicy, dessert we took brioche which was really good and banana pie with coconut and on top a ball of Thai tea ice cream which was excellent not too sweet, mixed and precise taste of banana and coconut, simply a delight. The service was great throughout the evening and we even received a discount without asking when the waitress found out that I was staying at the hotel itself, a simply perfect meal at a price that was not cheap but also not very high, about 750 baht per person
sample_reviews_en.author: Neta Harel

sample_reviews_en.text:
Much better than expected.
It tastes like high-end Thai cuisine.
Every dish was excellent.
The presentation was beautiful.
The spiciness can be adjusted.
The pork neck was outstanding, not dry at all, and the dipping sauce was delicious.
The tom yum soup was mild, but there weren't many ingredients, just a few shrimp and some small mushrooms.
The Thai fried noodles were authentic, with large shrimp.
The green curry chicken was rich and mild, not too spicy.
The fried shrimp cakes were average and could be skipped.
The ice cream was better than I expected, but the price was a bit high.
The cakes from the bakery next door were delicious; the pistachio and strawberry flavors were surprisingly well-integrated. You could try them at the Thai restaurant.
The ambiance was elegant, not crowded, and the service was good. Worth a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: CJ S

sample_reviews_en.text: i had my lunch here alone on a weekday. once stepped in i could feel their warm welcome. they've posh furnished indoor area but i chose the outdoor terrace. food on average was very good, especially the thai green curry! the chicken was chopped to bite size which made it easy for lady. the pork neck was also very well seasoned, and i especially love the very hot chili paste that came with! the oyster salad however, was very salty, that's not for me. staff was very friendly and occasionally checked with me how's the food and overall. they served good food and i do recommend here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Giami Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very disappointed with the bread and bakeries of this 5 star hotel.
I tried over a period of time all type of croissants they have (ie plain, chocolate, raspberry , almond, etc).
None of them are flaky as they should and very chewy and not tasty at all.
Also I tried all the loaf, toast bread, focaccia bread, etc...lack of taste and texture.
Looks like the base product is not of a good quality.
Only 1 praise I will give is the Chocolate cake (who ever makes it, well done !)
But for the bread and bakeries, so sorry below 5 star standards.
sample_reviews_en.author: the traveler

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good vibe with Thai food here. If you are tourist, this restaurant provides you with delicious Thai food and you can adjust spicy level by telling staff.

Beverage here also provides Thai style drinks e.g. old-fashion coffee, Bael fruit juice, Butterfly pea with lychee.

Dessert here is good except for Bualoy which  is quite salty in 1st try, then staff change for us. 2nd serve is super sweet. We think they have to revisit Bualoy recipe. We experience several delicious Bualoy places and expect more from Marriott.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wirat Paranpoonnagan (KaiKai)

sample_reviews_en.text: After a long day at the hotel or a day of shopping, returning to the hotel doesn't really make you want to search for good food again. Eating at the hotel is a great option. I always thought that only Cantonese people could make the best braised beef brisket, but after trying this restaurant's, I realized that Thailand also has its own delicious beef brisket. Of all the dishes we ordered, the one that impressed me the most was definitely the dessert! Anyone who tries it will absolutely love it.
sample_reviews_en.author: carson chiu

restaurants.name: Heng’s Kitchen
restaurants.address:

32 2 Soi Sukhumvit 13, Khwaeng Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Heng’s Kitchen in Bangkok is a delightful family-run restaurant that offers a warm and inviting dining experience. The atmosphere is relaxed, making it an ideal spot for both locals and visitors seeking authentic Thai cuisine.

The food is commendable, with dishes prepared using fresh ingredients that highlight traditional Thai flavors. Portion sizes are generous, ensuring diners receive good value for their money. Prices are reasonable, aligning well with the quality and quantity of the meals served.

The staff, particularly the waitress, are friendly and attentive, contributing to the overall pleasant experience.

Overall, Heng’s Kitchen stands out for its combination of delicious food, fair pricing, and exceptional service. It’s a must-visit for anyone looking to enjoy a hearty Thai meal in a comfortable setting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Travel Ralph

sample_reviews_en.text:
I could write a very long review about how delicious this family felt, food loving, restaurant…. the fresh seafood on site means your meals couldn’t be fresher, which is complimented extremely well by their use of spices, sauces, and aromatics.

Highly recommend anyone looking for local thai food with a focus on seafood!

i ordered the sea bass in sweet chili sauce which was unreal… fresh flaky, DELCIOUS sauce of spice and sweet, not oily at all! i combined the dish with an order of crab fried rice and while some might claim this an overly decadent move… the creamyness of the crab in the rice complimented the sweet spice of the flaky sea bass.

Don’t be deterred!!!! this place is 10/10
sample_reviews_en.author: Tyler Vyazmensky

sample_reviews_en.text:
The tanks of fresh seafood drew me in to this little corner restaurant. If you want an authentic Thai restaurant, I believe this is it. We had 1/2 kg of river prawns, pork collar, fried seabass, mushroom soup, kang kong/morning glory, stuffed omelette and 2 coconuts for a group of 4 adults. Man were we stuffed! The seafood is definitely fresh and value for money.

Had to wait a bit for the food to be served, don't know if that's the norm. We were there at 8+pm. Chose to seat outside which is all well and good except for the noisy vehicles passing by. Indoor seating is quieter if that's your preference.
sample_reviews_en.author: Esther Perh

sample_reviews_en.text: A hidden gem of a restaurant I stumbled upon on the roadside. It serves Northern Thai and Chinese cuisine. I tried several different dishes, each with its own unique flavor, all quite delicious. The chef's skills are superb, the ingredients are authentic and fresh, and the service is very friendly. Definitely worth returning to. I wouldn't recommend driving, as there doesn't seem to be parking nearby. It's best to pay in cash; credit cards or other electronic payment methods incur a 3% transaction fee. Opening hours are from 4:00 PM to 4:00 AM; it's closed during the day, so please keep that in mind.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrick Samuel

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stumbled upon this hidden place around Sukhimvit while looking for something less touristy and more authentic and we have found it just before given up!
The place is clean and simple with many tables available, fresh seafood and wide range of Thai food is available from stir fry to curries. The prices are so reasonable and considered cheap in this area.
All the dishes we ordered were very good and considered one of the best we had in this area.
The owner and staff are so friendly and polite.
Definitely recommended! 👍🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: Djeus Wong

sample_reviews_en.text: The food here is amazing. We were wondering the sois near our hotel and avoiding the large, noisy and commercial restaurants for dinner when we came across this modest place tuck away from a busy junction. The food is really good and we ordered way too much for 2 person. The fish was done well and was really fresh. The service was warm and friendly as we have come to expect from the Thais but this feel more personalised to me. The food bill was modest and it was the highlight of our first dinner in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: gevs

sample_reviews_en.text:
I wanted to eat Moo Kata, so I went to this restaurant near my hotel.

The portion was enough for one person, and the taste was satisfying. The other dishes looked delicious too.

Two large bottles of Chang beer, a Moo Kata set, and Mama soy sauce and a raw egg to finish, came to THB 674.

I'm not sure if it was because it was right after opening and they were quiet, or because the service took a while, but I was happy that the waitress stayed with me the whole time, cooking the food for me.
sample_reviews_en.author: Y M

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent thai food in a laid back environment. They have cold AC and the staff are very friendly and welcoming. Also they stay open late. I enjoyed the thai dishes. I don't recommend the sashimi as the texture was not as good as I prefer. But the grilled pork neck, sticky rice, and green curry fried rice are excellent. The menu has loads of options and they have a freezer with ice cream bars, as well as alcohol.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pasha M

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวตรอกโรงหมู สาขาเหม่งจ๋าย
restaurants.address:

540/2 Pracha Uthit Rd, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum noodle soup here is incredibly rich and flavorful, with a perfect balance of spicy, salty, sweet, and a wonderful aroma of real lime. The dumplings are plump and filled with delicious marinated pork. I especially like that the noodles aren't mushy; they have a nice crunchy texture. Another plus is easy parking, and it's conveniently located across from 1:2, perfect for grabbing a coffee to go with your meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phakwipha Kaewwisit

sample_reviews_en.text: The flat, chewy noodles are deliciously seasoned with plenty of toppings. Eating them with the plump dumplings is pure bliss. The fish balls are the best in the world, with no added flour! I hope this restaurant is still around in my next life so I can come back and eat here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lyn

sample_reviews_en.text:
I eat here almost every day because I'm addicted to the delicious, spicy, and amazing taste. 11 out of 10!
For appetizers, I recommend the plump fried dumplings; they're soft, fragrant, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธัญจิรา ธรรมสภาวกุล

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food, clean environment, and very convenient parking.
The Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) is delicious, the fish balls are made with real fish, and they are incredibly tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paemika Suewatanakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The spicy noodle soup with fresh chilies is delicious, served with plump fried dumplings and plenty of pork – very satisfying! The Tom Yum soup is also very spicy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manatsawan Sarak

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles are excellent, absolutely delicious, but the restaurant is a bit hot, the smell of fried food clings to you, and the ventilation isn't very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Klissapas “Beer” Kruthanawat

sample_reviews_en.text: Pork noodles and snacks are of good quality, portion sizes are reasonable, delicious, and the wait time is short. There is parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: ลูกหมี สามีซูยอง

sample_reviews_en.text: Great taste! No need to add any extra seasoning! ~ #Dry Tom Yum Noodle Soup (thin noodles) #Tom Yum Yentafo Noodle Soup (wide noodles)
sample_reviews_en.author: panutsaya ploysaree

restaurants.name: Easy Health
restaurants.address:

312 Pattaya 3rd Rd, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located just a short walk on 3rd road from the pattaya hospital. Parking for cars is available outside but can be hit and miss on how busy it is..
Inside, there are 8 or 9 tables that are all clean and well maintained with a cool ACd feel. There is also a seating area outside for those who like the warm air.
Menu has a fantastic selection of healthy, Asian and western food, most of the dishes can be prepared with a vegetarian alternative which is perfect for us as I am vegetarian but my girlfriend is not, this gives us both the freedom to enjoy what food we like!!
We have eaten here quite a few times and every meal we have chosen has been well presented, a good size and most importantly very tasty!!
Service has always been very polite, friendly with well spoken English.
Certainly our new favourite place to eat in Pattaya!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason Wymer

sample_reviews_en.text:
I dine in occasionally, sometime solo and sometimes with friends, and I order on Grab regularly. I will not be using their delivery app any longer, as Grab provides a superior option.

They do get five stars for consistency... Consistently good and consistent food, and consistently rude and inconsiderate service in the shop. It's a strange dichotomy, but I've never once had bad food or even an incorrect order, and I've also never once been treated in the typical, smiling, friendly Thai style when I walk in, either.

Will I continue coming? Personally, yes.

I made a decision long ago that I go to restaurants for the food... Not to make friends. Just something to be aware of. Expect great, healthy food, and rude service!
sample_reviews_en.author: Croc San Diego

sample_reviews_en.text:
I gave them a second chance literally six times- and each time they messed up in a new way.

They forget to include ingredients (like guacamole in the tacos), sometimes deliver undercooked chicken, other times it’s so overcooked that it’s impossible to chew. When I asked for no spices in the fish and vegetables, they still added spices. I asked them not to add oil- they added it anyway.

They claim they carefully calculate grams and calories, but how is that possible if they deliver dishes missing key ingredients? The quality does not justify the price.

Many people invest an enormous amount of effort into losing weight and maintaining their health, so I believe this kind of treatment toward customers is unacceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lina Bronz

sample_reviews_en.text:
My girlfriend and I recently visited eh! easy health and were pleasantly surprised by the quality of the food and drinks. I ordered the BBQ wrap, and my girlfriend had the Nordic wrap. Both wraps were not only delicious but also felt genuinely healthy, a rare combination.

We also had a Matcha Latte and a Cappuccino, both of which were well-prepared. Finding a good Matcha Latte and Cappuccino in Thailand can be challenging, but this place nailed it. The staff were friendly and helpful, adding to the overall positive experience.

If you’re looking for a place that offers tasty and healthy options with great service, eh! easy health is definitely worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Guyon Leen

sample_reviews_en.text: Right on one of the main roads, this little spot has a few vegan options, and most of these are substitutions with tofu. Alt milk is extra (sad face). There aren’t many vegan places in Pattaya, so a place that has fresh ingredients, lots of wrap combos and drinks is nice to stumble across. Nice place inside and staff were helpful and happy (and healthy). My only eyebrow raising moment was at the size of the mixed bowl of fruit and cereal that I ordered…a tad small, well compared to what you find at other spots. Served in a coffee cup sized bowl. Other than that it was fresh ;)
sample_reviews_en.author: Go Tiger

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating here for almost two years, initially ordering through Grab for about a year. I only dined in for the first time last month. My favorite is their energy drink; it's incredibly rich and flavorful, and even girls could use it as a meal replacement. I've tried about 50% of their food items, and I highly recommend dining in because Grab portions can be small, a problem I hadn't noticed until I ate in. However, I still highly recommend this place; all the food is delicious, as you can tell from their delivery orders. It's definitely worth a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: heyimcccui

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had requested for removal of carrots. It was done well. However what really disturbed me was the application of vinegar and lime which was never requested. No sushi or vegetable role ever goes well with such combination. I could not even bite down and decided to just pay and leave. This is by far the biggest disappointing situation.

Worse part is that whenever I ask for delivery. The amount and portion of the food is a lot lesser than the given amount for the same price at the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: William Sam

sample_reviews_en.text: I have tried this chain multiple times in Bangkok, ordering exactly the same items. The difference here is shocking. The juice was clearly diluted with water — it tasted weak, flat, and nothing like it should. The wrap was missing several of the advertised ingredients, making it feel cheap and poorly made. This feels like serious cost-cutting at the expense of quality. Completely unacceptable for a chain that claims consistent standards.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Ambrazhevich

restaurants.name: Toby's at Noble Play
restaurants.address:

Noble, 1035 Phloen Chit Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ambiance: 9/10 - Lots of space. Decor is minimal and nice.
Food Quality: 10/10 - Toby's breakfast dishes are hands down the best in Bangkok. Their eggs are amazing. Their coffee is amazing.
Service: 8/10 - Staff is attentive. Service is good.
Value - 8/10 - Still leaning on a pricey side but for the quality that you are getting, it's worth it.
Cleanliness: 9/10 - Clean

Overall Score: 44/50

Location - 8/10 - Phloen Chit station.
Menu Variety: 8/10 - Focused menu. And unfortunately, not many enticing pasta choices. But you have great choices for smoothies, protein shakes, etc.
Bathroom: 10/10 - Noble Play bathroom is very clean.
Noise: 9/10 - Few tables so your can have a great chat with your friend.
Space: 7/10 - Needs more seating since quite a folks are waiting outside.

Final score: 86/100

My favorite Toby's location. Great space. Great ambiance. Amazing food. Please try Roasted Pumpkin Scrambled Eggs. Please try Scrambled eggs, they are delicious. There's an extensive drink menu. And Noble Play is a great spot. Highly recommended spot for brunch in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: V D

sample_reviews_en.text:
The popular cafe / brunch spot continues to impress at its new location at Ploenchit - nicely located at the Noble condo complex, easily accessed from / via the BTS.

This is my first time trying out this new branch. Friends and I dropped in for a late lunch. The menus remain the same since I last visited (which actually has been a long while), and the quality is still as enjoyable. Service was quite welcoming and accommodating, although rushed and could use a little sense when collecting dishes and serving dishes to respect the patron's space.

The atmosphere was nice and sprawling.

All in all the food remains quality and reflects its premium pricing. Although the coffee seemed a little off - too much milk in my flat white. Would equally love to try out some other interesting modern dishes the next visits. Very delighted. Big smile :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Wunda Stone

sample_reviews_en.text:
My first visit to a Toby's, but definitely not the last. This place is great, pleasant atmosphere, nice and spacious, and power outlets by most seats if you need to work a bit.

Both drinks and foods are great. So far I tried Vanilla latte (with honey comb) and flat white, both were tasty and rich enough coffee flavour to my taste. With the coffee I had Smashed avocado and poached egg on sour dough bread, and after that a white chocolate brownie (also known as a "Blondie") with what I think was cranberries inside.

Everything was delicious, service was friendly, quick and efficient. So I can honestly recommend you visit Toby's if you are in the mood for a for nice cup of coffee, or you have a small appetite to satisfy. I'll be back there soon. Recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thomas Elers

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a wonderful brunch experience at Toby’s at Noble Play! The atmosphere was lively, stylish, and very family-friendly, making it the perfect weekend spot to relax and enjoy quality time.

The brunch selection was excellent, with delicious food, great variety, and beautifully presented dishes. Everything tasted fresh and flavorful, and the drinks were equally enjoyable. The staff were incredibly attentive, welcoming, and made sure we had a comfortable and enjoyable experience throughout.

What makes this place special is the combination of great food, amazing ambiance, and the fun environment for families and kids. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a unique and enjoyable brunch experience in Dubai. We’ll definitely be back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ahmad Almoosawi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice place within walking distance from Central Chidlom, Embassy and the Skytrain station.

I had the Bacon Rules, and my wife went for the Smashed Avocado and Salmon. The food was quite good, and the service as well. Given the pricing, that was kind of expected and par for the course.

However, I could have done without the loud chatter from the couole on our right, which was soon replaced with an Arab talking on his speaker phone, while an older person on the left felt the need to watch his videos without headphones...
Maybe it is me, but it seems that being considerate is not really common anymore these days. Then again, the staff or restaurant could choose to remind their clientele about simple manners.
sample_reviews_en.author: Martin Pott

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great cafe with good brunch options and great coffee. Came by twice as our hotel was close by. The Egg Mikado was really good with fresh salmon! Had their bacon as part of another meal but it’s a bit too crispy and dry for our liking. Otherwise everything was good, my family also enjoyed their meals. There are three coffee beans to choose from- Columbia, Ethiopia and Thailand. We tried the Thailand ones and it’s yums! Plenty of comfortable seats and not too crowded which is perfect. They have a big and friendly team too and they speak decent English which is great considering a lot of cafes around this price range don’t.
Wish we got a chance to return again to try the other options.
sample_reviews_en.author: Effie

sample_reviews_en.text:
It is quite a cozy and modern place. The atmosphere is excellent. The uniforms are white with a light olive green, which creates an energetic yet simple and spiritual vibe.

I come here to have coffee and change my mind. They also offer a very healthy juice, so I decided to try it. It's fresh and tasty, and I love it. I admire myself for making such a great decision.

They provide a lovely and comfortable space, and the ceiling is quite high, which gives you a sense of relaxation and no pressure to enjoy your time here.

The music is pleasant and not too loud, serving as a perfect background that enhances the experience. It's a very nice place to spend your breakfast time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Air Tree Water

sample_reviews_en.text:
Toby’s serves a fantastic brunch, and the food definitely lived up to the hype. We ordered the Baked Eggs, Breakfast Bruschetta, Smashed Avocado, Complicated Avocado, and Crispy French Toast—everything was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The coffee was great too, making it an all-around enjoyable meal.

The only downside was the wait for a table. We ended up waiting for a while before the staff suggested bringing in extra tables to accommodate us. It would’ve been a much better experience if that option had been offered from the beginning.

Overall, a great brunch spot with delicious food, and I’d definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: haya als

restaurants.name: Doodle Izakaya
restaurants.address:

8 Sukhumvit 47 Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a chill vibe and is super cute. The food is delicious, perfect for chatting and hanging out with friends. It's a Japanese-style restaurant with a Modern Izakaya menu.

- The food is well-prepared and easy to eat. The location is in the Sukhumvit area, and the food is beautifully presented, making it great for photos. It's a perfect place to invite friends.

- I personally loved the mentaiko spaghetti; it was incredibly flavorful. There's a wide selection of drinks.

- The staff provides excellent service and helpful recommendations. They even use lighting to enhance the photos. The service is top-notch! Reservations are highly recommended.

- Located on Sukhumvit Soi 47.
- Parking is available on the street on even/odd days, or you can park across the street at Rain Hill and get a 50 baht discount from the restaurant with your parking ticket.
sample_reviews_en.author: Smind Pokko

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited Doodle Izakaya recently, and while there were some okay elements, the overall experience ended up being a health hazard.

• Yakitori: The skewers were okay and cooked to a standard level.
• Mentaiko Spaghetti: This dish was excessively salty to the point where it was difficult to eat.
• Scallop: This was the biggest issue of the meal. The scallop was clearly not fresh.

As a direct result of eating the unfresh seafood here, I am now suffering from severe food poisoning and diarrhea. I strongly urge the management to immediately and strictly enforce your Quality Control, especially when it comes to seafood. Serving compromised ingredients is a serious health and safety issue.
This was an incredibly disappointing and painful experience.

I will definitely not be returning. :(
sample_reviews_en.author: english eng

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really liked the atmosphere at Doodle Izakaya. It has a cozy, lively feel and is a nice place to spend an evening with friends. The service was also smooth overall, and the staff were friendly and helpful.

The food, however, didn’t stand out as much for me. Shortly after ordering, the lotus chips arrived almost immediately and were already a little cold, so I had the feeling they might have been left from an earlier order. We still accepted them, but it wasn’t the best start.

On the positive side, the panna cotta promotion was a nice touch and definitely added some value to the experience.

Overall, I enjoyed the atmosphere and the service more than the food. Still, it’s a nice place to hang out, especially if you’re looking for a relaxed and lively izakaya-style evening.
sample_reviews_en.author: Meriç Murat Erdinç

sample_reviews_en.text:
Doodle (Salt, Sake, & Sketch) is a modern-style hangout spot with a bar that blends the izakaya vibe with its food and drinks.

They serve both meals and snacks, offering a fusion of Japanese, Thai, and European cuisine. The drink selection ranges from sake to wine, thanks to the bar seating.

The interior and exterior are decorated with unique artwork.

I was a guest at a senior's birthday party, so I don't remember all the menu items I ordered, but the beef dish in the picture and the tuna salad I had were delicious! 👍🏻

I'll definitely be back to support them in person someday.
sample_reviews_en.author: Earn Nigizer

sample_reviews_en.text:
🌟 3 things that made me love this restaurant so much I had to come back and share :)
- They have lights for taking photos! No matter how many lights are in the restaurant, the staff went out of their way to bring out lights with 2 or 3 levels (not sure which) specifically for taking pictures.
- The food is incredibly delicious. Every dish I ordered in the picture was amazing; there wasn't a single dish that deserved a thumbs up.
- The staff are so lovely and helpful. They explained the menu and constantly checked on our table.

I was very impressed 💖
sample_reviews_en.author: BUDDY BRAND RICH

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's quite rare for me to want to post a review but man Doodle Izakaya was phenomenal. Buzzy atmosphere (groups were flooding in as I finished up), amazing food and great attentive service.

The attention to detail for the food was next level, you can tell these are passionate chefs who care about quality. I've had a vast amount of karaage from a variety of places and this was the PINNACLE. I wouldn't be surprised if it was top 3 in the world.

I just want to highlight the kind server who saw I was taking videos gave me a camera stand. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kevin Kwan

sample_reviews_en.text: The modern BKK izakaya doodle (salt, sake, & sketch) serves dishes with exquisite presentation. The steak paired with yuzu kosho offered a nice sweetness, while the pesto pasta turned out to be a cold noodle dish, which wasn't quite to my taste. Surprisingly, the highlight of the night was the anchovy paste toast! Overall, the food was good but not particularly mind-blowing. Given the slightly high price tag, it’s worth a try once, though I probably wouldn't revisit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fat Fat Fish

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is really fun and quirky. We made an online reservation about an hour prior and ended up with a nice table in the back. We arrived at 7pm and the place was already busy, with a good vibe flowing.

The service was prompt and all of our food was delicious! Super smokey yakitori and the truffle toast was yummm.

We'll definitely recommend this to friends and visit again in future!
sample_reviews_en.author: Beth Westwood

restaurants.name: Baku Yakiniku Izakaya
restaurants.address:

555/56 moo10 nongprue, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
5 stars for the atmosphere AND THE ALCOHOL! I felt like I have been teleported to Japan!
With their 399baht free flow (2 hours) of shochu, beer (and Thai whiskey? ;p), this can't be any better! But yet.. we made it better by requesting a double shot of shochu in all our Ume sour!
It's embarrassing but we felt HIGH after our 2nd glasses... Eventually I had my 6th whole my wife had her 5th! This felt like the best night in Pattaya so far!
Of cse .. the food were great too! Not all, as I felt the yakiniku pork set that comprises of pork loin were pretty hard and not suitable for bbq.... The pork belly were good though! Assuming u are ok with belly, just go with that and you will be happy like a 🐦 .
The beef tongue, were thick, in a good way, and better in taste! Try it!
And how can we forget the charcoal grill that looks sooooooo pretty!
Staffs were nice and friendly, and I suspected the boss also said HI to us!
I seldom say this... But this is close to a 10 for me... 9.5/10!
Without a doubt, I will be here again! And again! And again!
💕
sample_reviews_en.author: Jialong Liu

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had high hopes for this place after reading so many positive reviews, and since it attracts many Japanese customers, I expected authentic and delicious food. Unfortunately, it turned out to be one of my most disappointing dining experiences.

1. Hygiene nightmare – Before I even placed an order, I saw cockroaches on my table four times. No matter how tasty the food might be, poor hygiene is unacceptable.

2. Communication issues – The staff spoke no English and couldn’t handle even the simplest orders. I showed pictures with menu numbers, yet my order still came out wrong.

3. Poor food quality – The fried chicken had a rancid, oily smell, clearly from old frying oil. I didn’t eat it and left it untouched.

Tip: After 5 PM, cars cannot enter this area, so you’ll have to walk to the izakaya.

I rarely leave negative reviews, but this was a letdown from start to finish. I cannot recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michelle

sample_reviews_en.text:
Go to Japan without leaving Thailand
Look for Baywalk
Cozy home atmosphere
All you can drink is particularly interesting for drinking buddies
Lots of options of Japanese food, and some Thai
Reasonable prices
Staff lacks English skills, so menu in English with pictures and numbers is really helpful
Other than that, service was nice and helpful
We had fries, miso soup, rice balls, gyoza, different noodle soups and cold tea noodle
Definitely coming back for all you can eat options
sample_reviews_en.author: Kirill Fomin

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited the sushi restaurant around midnight, arriving at 1 AM, and appreciated that they stay open until 2 AM. As always, I received a warm welcome from the staff. I ordered a variety of sushi rolls and eagerly anticipated the flavors. The ambiance was inviting, and the service was prompt and friendly. The sushi was fresh and beautifully presented, exceeding my expectations.
sample_reviews_en.author: Traveling

sample_reviews_en.text: Baku Yakiniku Izakaya is a delightful dining destination that brings a blend of Japanese yakiniku grilling tradition and izakaya-style ambiance to its customers. The restaurant offers an inviting and cozy atmosphere perfect for casual dining with friends or family. The interior is stylish yet comfortable, with modern touches that still retain an authentic Japanese charm.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexander Yudin

sample_reviews_en.text: Spent 1 hour waiting for meat, didn't receive full order, kimchi arrived already out of date rotten. Meat was very bad as well some pieces were blueish, grey, seems like kitchen change chef. I was coming 4 times a week and spending 10000 baht every week, but after today I can say food in 711 is better than here at this point
sample_reviews_en.author: Eiman Nekr

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my favourite izakaya in Pattaya. I live around 25km away, but when I want Japanese food I always come here.
The sashimi and yakiniku is great, the yukhoe is amazing, they have a 2 hour drinks package and the staff are always great. Special shout out to Khun Ning; she is very attentive and friendly
sample_reviews_en.author: Benn Rowe

sample_reviews_en.text: Honestly, I don't know why so many good reviews. Food is mediocre. Service is terrible. Noone speak English. I ordered main dish and rice on a site. In 15 minutes they brought rice and after another 20 minutes my main dish. If you want touse credit card -5% surcharge. My personal suggestion-stay away
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffrey Diamond

restaurants.name: Milin
restaurants.address:

205 Phichai Rd, Thanon Nakhon Chai Si, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is right by the road, easy to find. They've placed cones to reserve space on the road in front of the shop. The exterior looks nice, and the interior is clean. The restrooms are adequate. The staff are attentive and helpful, always ready to offer recommendations. However, the tables are a bit small, and the plates are quite heavy.

The food looks amazing, and the taste matches its appearance. I was most impressed with the minced pork with salted fish; it was delicious, crispy on the outside and still moist on the inside. The stir-fried three-smell dish was good, but would be even better with a little more spice. The traditional glass noodle salad was flavorful but too spicy. The fried bird's nest spring rolls with shrimp filling were also good; the shrimp was fresh and plump.

Overall, it's okay. The set menu prices are reasonable and good value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sompound

sample_reviews_en.text:
Milin is an incredible restaurant serving authentic Thai and Southern Thai dishes. Everything we had was packed with flavor—bold, spicy, yet perfectly balanced—and made with top-quality ingredients. Truly delicious across the board!

The space is spacious enough to accommodate large groups, with a lovely atmosphere. The staff are also wonderful, attentive, and genuinely eager to help.

The only drawback is the limited parking right in front of the restaurant, forcing most guests to park along the street. If possible, taking public transit is highly recommended.

Overall, I absolutely loved it and will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pranee Sutthasri

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hit up Milin last night and honestly? Not thrilled. As the last table of the night, and the service was pretty much rushing. I even got a little shoulder nudge just to serve water – real classy.
But here’s the kicker: their "best-selling" dish that the host was so proud of? The swimming beef in palm oil. Seriously, it was flooded. I'm talking a grease slick you wouldn't believe.
Honestly, if you haven't eaten for two days straight and need to mainline some fat, maybe this is your spot. Otherwise, save yourself the trouble. This trip to Milin was a definite miss for me.
