sample_reviews_en.author: Paniti Junhasavasdikul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food came out quickly, the taste was moderate, not too spicy, the ingredients were good, the portions were quite large, and the price was reasonable.
The restaurant's decor was pleasing to the eye.
Fried minced pork with salted fish: 8/10
Nong Jo's fried beef: 7/10 The texture of the beef was chewy enough, but the fish sauce flavor was a bit too mild, making it taste bland.
Ranjuan curry: 8/10 It would be much tastier if the curry was served hotter.
Fried Gnetum leaf salad: 6/10 Enjoyable with the dipping sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Walis

sample_reviews_en.text:
Recommended dishes include the deep-fried river prawns with salt, priced at just over 100 baht each, with fragrant prawn roe (5 prawns per plate, very firm meat).

My friend said the fried beef at Nong Jo was better than expected and the price was good too.

The coconut milk soup is a must-try; it tastes just like my grandmother's cooking.
The Tom Yum soup with Pangasius fish is spicy and delicious; I like that the fish is cut into chunks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saowalak Sainam

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere, playing retro music. The staff are polite and attentive. The food is delicious and flavorful. My favorite is the Tom Kha Pla Salid (coconut milk soup with crispy fish), the fish is crispy not soggy, and eating it with the broth is amazing. The Yum Tua Phu (winged bean salad) is tasty, the shrimp is very fresh, and the fried beef (Nong Jo's recipe) is cooked medium rare and very tender.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ravis V

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely amazing food....recommend to every farang and tourist to try!  Truly HIGH QUALITY THAI food. This is a destination restaurant!   Take taxi or grab just to come here!  Worthwhike!  Beats any mall restsurant, open air restaurant or strret food in quality and taste.  sorry no English, but menu has photos, and bring google translator.  Actually, ever dish is amazing, so doesnt matter what yiu order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Friedrich Matthies

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered fried beef, salted fried shrimp, shrimp spring rolls, glass noodle salad, and tom kha soup with snakehead fish. Everything was delicious, and the flavors weren't too strong. I liked the tom kha soup the most because the coconut milk was very thick. The fried shrimp was very fresh and had a bouncy texture. However, it would be even better if the restaurant used good quality jasmine rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattakorn Wuttichuay

restaurants.name: Ma Maison
restaurants.address:

4 Soi Somkid Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ma Maison lives up to its name as a fine-dining Thai restaurant in terms of taste, atmosphere, and service. The food is a blend of contemporary Thai cuisine, maintaining a harmonious and easy-to-eat flavor profile, using high-quality ingredients.

Taste:
Overall, almost every dish was excellent. The flavors were well-balanced, and the presentation was beautiful. But it wasn't just visually appealing; the food retained its Thai essence and was enjoyable throughout.

Atmosphere:
The restaurant's atmosphere is superb. Located in Park Nai Lert, it offers a quiet, peaceful, and classic luxurious feel with a high degree of privacy, ideal for special occasions or entertaining guests.

Service:
The staff provided excellent service; they were polite, attentive, and maintained the high standards expected of a restaurant of this caliber.

Price:
The prices are relatively high, and the portions are somewhat small, but the quality of the food, atmosphere, and overall experience justify the price.

Conclusion:
This is another premium Thai restaurant that maintains high standards in food, service, and a rare urban garden atmosphere. Perfect for special occasions.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apiwat Aksornsart

sample_reviews_en.text: What should have been a joyous celebration of Thai food and hospitality at its best turned out to be a disaster that I never want to repeat: First of all, Google Maps, the most stupid of all, took me twice around the worst construction nooks of the city, second, I might not have seen it but Ma Maison did not or failed to have clear street signs to turn into Soi Somkid from the main stretch, especially at night for people not used to Bangkok’s hellish traffic jams. It took me 3.5 hours to drive what should have been a 28 minutes run door to door (I clocked in my return trip). Needless to say, despite the quality of the foods, the amazing presentation, the impeccable service, this experience left a very bitter taste in my memory. My guests waited half of the night for my unforgivable arrival. This sucks!
sample_reviews_en.author: Meyung Robson

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The rice in chilled broth with all the toppings is a dish we eat every year.
- The noodle soup at Park Nai Lert is also very delicious; you can't find it anywhere else.
- The pomelo salad is very delicious, with toasted coconut and shredded chicken.
- The spicy curry with snails is rich and flavorful. This is a Thai restaurant that makes truly spicy food, not mild flavors like those adapted for foreigners, which I really appreciate. The food is very flavorful.
I like that they have private rooms available, both large and small.

I love the atmosphere with the large trees and the whole area being green and relaxing. I've eaten here many times, and today we visited the Park Nai Lert House Museum afterwards. It was great; my mother loved it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Norah S

sample_reviews_en.text:
I got caught in Bangkok's infamous evening traffic jam and ended up being two hours late for my reservation, but they served me without showing any displeasure.
The food was refined Thai cuisine, and when I visited, most of the customers seemed to be foreigners.
The location is decent, situated in a park (though the ditch at the entrance is a bit of a drawback).
The food itself is delicious, and they have a wide selection of drinks and desserts.
If you're tired of the heavy, intense Thai food and want to enjoy a meal in a more relaxed atmosphere, this is a restaurant I would recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: s watanabe

sample_reviews_en.text:
The location is lovely, but the staff were rude. My friend was already there with her one month old baby, and although she only wanted to order a coffee, I was greeted with “Are you here to eat?” without a hello or even a chance to settle in. We didn’t feel welcome and we got the impression that it was a problem that my friend didn’t want to eat, even though there are no vegetarian dishes on the menu, so there were no options for her! A lack of politeness, especially for an establishment of this kind.
The pad kap prao was very expensive and tasteless, and quite greasy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Caroline Poulain

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is beautifully located inside Nai Lert Heritage Park. It serves Thai food that seems slightly adapted for foreign tastes. Since it is close to several embassies, most of the guests were foreigners when we visited. The place is not very big, and we were seated near the bar, which slightly blocked our view of the garden. Even so, the service was good, and the food was comforting and mild. They close for a break in the afternoon, so we could not stay as long as we wanted, but overall it is a beautiful Michelin-rated spot for a special occasion.
sample_reviews_en.author: 엔트로피

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is beautiful and the atmosphere is nice, but the food seems unusual. There was artificial jasmine flavoring in the coconut milk curry, and the coconut milk was likely industrially produced. The ingredients chosen were not worth the price at all. Even the rice was not carefully cooked; one bowl had undercooked grains, while the other was mushy.
This is one of the few restaurants in my life where I could only eat a bite or two of each dish before having to put down my spoon and throw the food away.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jongrak Kitti

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was my first time here.  We were actually here for a business/work dinner.   The people that worked here were super nice and very attentive.  The food was made to order, so there was a little wait.
The dishes when they came out were
piping hot and fresh.   They accommodated food preferences and food allergies.  All the dishes we tried were amazing.  The food was authentic.  Many people didn't have space for dessert but I did.  Here are  a few that we had.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lynn Eglan

restaurants.name: Paper Butter and the Burger
restaurants.address:

51 Soi Phahon Yothin 5, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Paper Butter & the Burger is a hidden gem that I truly want to share. We found this small restaurant by chance, but it turned out to be one of our most memorable meals.

The biggest surprise was how delicious every dish was, and the prices were surprisingly reasonable considering the quality. We ordered several things, including burgers, fish & chips, macaroni, two types of fried chicken, and steak, and every dish was exceptionally well-prepared.

The star of the meal had to be the hamburger; the bun was incredibly soft, the meat juicy, and the flavor perfectly balanced – you can tell they put a lot of care into it; it wasn't your average burger. The macaroni exceeded expectations; it was rich, creamy, and so delicious that it's another must-try.

The fish & chips were perfectly crispy, and the fish was still moist. Both types of fried chicken were delicious in their own way, and the steak was surprisingly good for the price.

It's a small restaurant that you might easily overlook, but once you try it, you'll understand why you'll want to go back again. If you're looking for a delicious burger at a reasonable price, this place is definitely worth a visit. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: N T

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried Chili Mexican burger with extra patty. This is probably the best burger I have had in Bangkok. If you want to eat a homemade burger this is probably for you. The taste of the patty is different than an ordinary patty because they probably add some spice. It is juicy but not very fatty. It would be better if they remove onion rings or replace with caramelised onion. Also the bacon could be thinner and crunchy.

Edit: I have been to this restaurant a few times recently (March 2026) and noticed that the patty has some tough tendon pieces cannot be eaten. They should pay more attention to their patties.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hektor

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍔 Paper Butter & The Burger — Ari

A small, chill burger joint in the Ari area that surprisingly makes excellent burgers. The buns are fragrant with butter and perfectly soft, while the burger patties are flavorful and well-balanced. The price is reasonable.

The atmosphere is relaxed, perfect for hanging out with friends or just grabbing a burger without overthinking it.

Overall: 8.5/10 🍔
If you're in the Ari area and want a really good burger, I'd recommend giving this place a try. You'll realize that good food can sometimes be a little hard to find 😆 but I've tried it myself, and you can trust me! 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: BSK

sample_reviews_en.text:
You have to turn into a side street to find it;

It's a very simple hamburger, but the beef slices are thick and delicious! 👍

(That's what a hamburger should be! It's for filling your stomach, it doesn't need to be fancy; the beef slices should taste like beef, the ingredients should be fresh, the sauce should be well-balanced and not too overpowering; after one bite you want to eat the whole thing... That's what makes a good hamburger! 😬)

(Outside, the air conditioning was too open, so it wasn't very effective.)

(I wanted to give it 4.5 stars, but I didn't get a single star 🤔)
sample_reviews_en.author: siu wing wong

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant where we absolutely love the bread. It's fragrant and delicious. Normally, I don't really like the burger buns, but I ate every last bit of this one! The patty is juicy and not dry at all. We chose the Aloha menu, which comes with grilled pineapple to balance the flavors – and we loved it! The spicy fried chicken is genuinely hot and perfectly fried. They have a wide selection of appetizers. We'll definitely be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalalai J.

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered a little bit of everything from Paper Butter & the Burger and found it to have some good items but a bit inconsistent. The meats were consistently a bit on the dry side but some items made up for it with strong flavors and sauces. The fish & chips had great fish next to somewhat soggy fries. While most items ranged from decent to great, they all felt a bit underwhelming compared to the pictures on the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joseph Cammarata

sample_reviews_en.text: A small burger joint with decent, middle-of-the-road flavors that’s still worth a try. Meat patty is juicy and quite enjoyable, though the bun lacks that handmade touch — a bit of a pity, but acceptable for the price. The setting isn’t fancy, as it’s not a high-end restaurant, but it has a relaxed beach-side vibe. It’s also a comfortable spot to grab a casual meal alone.
sample_reviews_en.author: KIKO WANG

sample_reviews_en.text:
I personally would say this place is similar to a hidden gem.

Not too busy (Can get busy), but locations amazing, quiet, amazing lighting creating that calming ambience when you walk in.

They have a mini cocktail stall, along with a Japanese food stall, which makes it seem like a marketty* vibe.

Honestly good spot to have a relax and drink. Definitely will be back
sample_reviews_en.author: Jamie Cameron

restaurants.name: Devilish Smokin' BBQ Shed + Burgers (Sukhumvit 101/1)
restaurants.address:

29 ถนน สุขุมวิท 101/1 Bang Chak, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
This restaurant makes seriously amazing BBQ ribs. The sauce and the tenderness of the ribs are perfect. I wholeheartedly rate it as the No. 1 American BBQ in Bangkok – it lives up to its reputation.

We ordered the St. Louis pork ribs (559฿). The size was huge, enough for two people. The restaurant said the spared ribs are three times bigger! OMG! This was seriously delicious, I highly recommend it. And the menu item I absolutely recommend is the Nashville fried chicken. It's the best here!!!

These two dishes are exceptionally good. The fried chicken is incredibly crispy, the spicy sauce is perfect, and the chicken inside is still juicy – ​​just perfect!

If you like American-Aussie pub-style food, you have to come here. It's an Aussie pub, great for drinks and chilling out.
sample_reviews_th.author: Gracelicious (Kaegrace)

sample_reviews_en.text: Australian owned🇦🇺!! incredible food! i was desperately in need of something hearty, satisfying, and sweet to get a bit of home away from home #Texas haha! a beer with live music in the background and a cool night breeze? yea sign me up. I love the outdoor seating but even more so I am obsessed with these apple chimichangas! warm crispy shell packed with cinnamon and carmel alternating between that and the cold icecream yumm!!! could eat one of those everyday. the best spot for a late night 🍔🍷🍺
sample_reviews_en.author: Madison Keto

sample_reviews_en.text:
Udomsuk is the best BBQ restaurant in town, if not the best since Phra Khanong.

This place offers Australian-style BBQ, featuring beef, pork, and lamb.

Personally, the pork ribs were the best, and the lamb was also delicious. (The beef brisket was tender and tasty, but not wow-worthy.)

The plates are reasonably priced, making it a great place to enjoy a variety of BBQ meats at once.

The spicy sauce is also a nice touch.

Parking is available in the parking lot.
sample_reviews_en.author: CHANGHO KIM (JOKBARHARRY)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wanted some wings and happened upon this place looking for a birthday dinner location. Very nice menu selection, whatever you want… they’ll probably have!

BBQ ✔️
Tex Mex ✔️
Wings ✔️
Draft Beer ✔️
Gyros (Yiros) ✔️
Sandwiches ✔️
Pizza ✔️
Dessert ✔️
Burgers ✔️
Etc etc

The brisket is delicious, and we got lucky as they had it available. A few items and flavor choices were not available but since there was so many options, we just picked something else.
sample_reviews_en.author: R Bunupuradah

sample_reviews_en.text: Unreal meal at Devilish Smokin’ BBQ yesterday. After travelling for 3 months and eating a lot of local Asian cuisine (which is great) this was a welcome treat for us. The meats were all packed with flavour, the BBQ sauce may be the best I’ve tasted and I need that recipe for the beans. Would definitely recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ryan Harding

sample_reviews_en.text: I love everything here. Food is amazing. Portion is huge. Service is good. The food just took a little long time to serve, though the restaurant was not that crowed. Some side dishes were not available on that day, but it was fine. It was our first time here and the other options are also nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuanpan Tang

sample_reviews_en.text: Best place in town… or just out of town at any rate. We used to live in the area, and Devilish was a weekly or biweekly visit. Even now, we go out of our way to go back from time to time. Incredible menu, mouthwatering food, and the long-serving staff there always make you feel at home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Clark

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been there a few times. Every time it's a holiday, it's crowded, and they don't have any of the specialty dishes. They only have canned beer, no draft. The food takes a long time to arrive. Half an hour after ordering, they've only brought out soft drinks and beer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lei Yang

restaurants.name: Simply Southern อาหารใต้ครัวระนอง
restaurants.address:

61 มหาสวัสดิ์ 7 ถนน บางกรวย-จงถนอม Maha Sawat, Bang Kruai District, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Simply Southern อาหารใต้ครัวระนอง serves southern Thai dishes that are full of flavor without being overwhelmingly spicy. The food has a nice balance — rich curry aromas, bold seasoning, and fresh ingredients, but still easy to enjoy even if you don’t eat super hot food. The atmosphere feels casual and comfortable, making it a good spot for both quick meals and family dining. A great choice for anyone wanting authentic southern flavors in a more approachable style
sample_reviews_th.author: Wisanu Tuntawiroon

sample_reviews_en.text:
From the outside, it looks like a cute cafe ☕️🌿, but it's actually a Southern Thai restaurant with incredibly authentic flavors 😋.

The Southern Thai dishes are flavorful, spicy, and aromatic, and importantly, not sweet—just the way I like it. It truly tastes like real Southern Thai food 🌶️.

The restaurant is a good size, with a lovely, clean, and cozy atmosphere. It's perfect for families or friends, offering comfortable and uncrowded seating.

Another thing I loved was the friendly and attentive staff 💕. In short, this Southern Thai restaurant excels in both taste and atmosphere. Anyone who likes strong, non-sweet Southern Thai flavors will love it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattapra Jessadawuttiphan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Southern Thai restaurant and cafe focuses on a variety of Southern Thai dishes, offering both local and fusion options. The flavors are a blend of Southern Thai and Bangkok influences. I tried several dishes and particularly enjoyed the braised pork (Moo Hong) and the stir-fried mixed vegetables (Pad Sam Men). The staff were also very kind and gave me two jars of dried shrimp chili paste – thank you!
They also have drinks, including coffee and non-coffee options. I tried the passion fruit coffee, which was delicious and refreshing.
Parking is convenient, and the air-conditioned room is comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tang Raksat

sample_reviews_en.text: I found this restaurant on Google Maps. My initial craving was the tea leaf salad, but after ordering, everything was so delicious and flavorful that I had to order extra rice! It was so good I couldn't stop eating. I'll definitely be back. I recommend calling to reserve a table beforehand, as there aren't many tables. I didn't try the desserts this time, but I've got my eye on them! 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornparn Oimprom

sample_reviews_en.text:
First time here n will always be back here again for southern food...
Is not a big restaurant but they serve delicious southern food 😋
Small restaurant come with big taste 😋

Food tasted delicious 😋
Service is good n staff can also speak in  English...
Price is reasonable...

Never easy to find a nice n delicious southern restaurant around...
Will sure be back....
sample_reviews_en.author: Ricky Hwan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is great! Whenever I'm in this area with clients, I always come to this restaurant. The food is delicious, and the curry is flavorful!!!

And the cafe section is also great; everything on the menu is delicious, especially their signature lemon tea made with fresh lemons and fragrant, strong tea from the South. 🫶
sample_reviews_en.author: Phornthip P

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the service was good, but there was a bit of traffic before entering the soi (alley). The restaurant is a little small but has a cozy feel. Overall, it was good, but I think they should improve the cleanliness of the restroom and add a place to hang belongings. I'll definitely visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Moon Light

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here, after finding it on Google. But I'll probably be coming back regularly because it's a Southern Thai restaurant with bold yet well-balanced flavors. Everything I ordered was delicious and suited my taste. I recommend the sour curry; it's amazing! 👍 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Dow008

restaurants.name: The Fat Cow Yaowarat
restaurants.address:

36/12 Yi Sip Song Karakadakhom 1 Rd, Pom Prap, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were there on a Saturday afternoon. The store was empty with plenty of seats. We ordered the lunch set which let you choose any burger 🍔 + soft drink🥤 + fries🍟, and it was $290 Baht.

🍔: loved the beef patty. It was juicy and tender. The bacon was not crispy enough and the pickles were light.
🥤: a standard raspberry soda, refreshing on🧊! We ordered one set but they gave us both a glass of ice, which was awesome😎.
🍟: the fries were delicious, better than many burger places in Bkk.

Overall: Tasty food & Great service 👍🏻. While everything was freshly prepared, I’d prefer a more cheesy burger with more sauce, but it was just my own preference. Next time I’ll try a different kind and update my thoughts.

That said, I would recommend fat cow to anyone who’s craving for a burger in the Chinatown area🙌🏻.
sample_reviews_en.author: *o Kelly o*

sample_reviews_en.text:
So it was a late night, and we wanted to have something we were used to. This place popped up as local to where we were at the time, and the reviews seemed to highlight the fact the burgers were possibly the best around. Well, we had to test this place out!
Service was great - warm and friendly. I was sceptical of the burgers being good, but as we were seated I thought I should be a little open minded. I had the Fat Cow burger and the rest of the crew had other ones. My burger was to die for! I was totally blown away and have to agree with the other reviewers! The taste was so good, I decided to leave a 5 star review when I had a chance to. Please don't pass up a chance to visit this place, you will NOT REGRET it!
sample_reviews_en.author: I Singh

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Fat Cow offers a truly indulgent dining experience. I ordered the Fat Cow burger with fries and chicken wings and was blown away by the flavors and quality of the food.

The burger was perfectly cooked and topped with delicious toppings, while the fries were crispy and seasoned to perfection.

The chicken wings were also a highlight, with a crispy exterior and juicy, flavorful meat. The service was friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere was relaxed and inviting.

I would definitely recommend The Fat Cow to anyone looking for a satisfying and delicious meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vagabond Mick

sample_reviews_en.text:
The burger patty was cooked perfectly. The burger itself was rather bland. I ordered a cheeseburger. It had a small slice of cheese, two thin slices of tomato, one lettuce leaf, and some sautéed onions.

Because there was so little cheese, it was quite dry.

I ordered Big Mac sauce on the side, but it tasted very fishy to me, so I didn't eat it.

The service was friendly. They have several different types of draft beer. I was allowed to try some and ended up ordering the Fruit Berry Beer. It was something different.

I didn't regret it, but I won't be going back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Antje Hasi

sample_reviews_en.text:
First visit to The Fat Cow and it won’t be the last! We ordered the Philly Steak Sandwich and the Boss Burger, both served with fries.

Philly Steak Sandwich: Absolutely delicious! Juicy, flavorful, and hit the spot. Easy 8/10.
The Boss Burger. Good, but not quite boss-level. A respectable 7/10.
French Fries: Crispy and satisfying—solid 7.5/10.

Overall, a great first impression. The Philly Steak is definitely the star so far. Excited to come back and explore more of the menu. Great vibes, tasty food, and worth a visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tristan Barter

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the Boss burger, but it tasted like pork. I mentioned it to the waitress, but she said it was beef. After my girlfriend pointed out it wasn't beef since she doesn't like/eat it, I got a new burger.  But this one tasted a bit more like beef, but definitely not entirely. It was clearly mixed with, probably, pork. Such a shame. Apart from the meat, it wasn't bad. I don't understand all the positive reviews if this is the standard. It was extremely disappointing and expensive for what you get.
sample_reviews_en.author: Geen Gein

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Fat Cow is an absolute gem. If you’re looking for great food, quality beers, and a laid-back vibe, this is the place to be. Everything we tried was packed with flavor, the portions were solid, and the beers were cold and well chosen.

The atmosphere is relaxed and fun, perfect for hanging out with friends or grabbing a casual meal that actually delivers. Friendly service, good energy, and food that hits every time.

Highly recommend — we’ll definitely be back. 🍔🍺🔥
sample_reviews_en.author: moo baba77

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to Yaowarat to visit temples, strolled around, and looked for food until I was tired. I looked for a place to sit and have a drink in a relaxed atmosphere. They have many flavors of craft beer to try, and wine too. Plus, the air conditioning is nice and cool. Even though I was full, I couldn't resist ordering a burger, which was delicious. It was packed with ingredients, and just half a burger was enough to fill me up.
Open from noon until midnight. Long hours!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anyamanee “Ae” Limpipattanasopon

restaurants.name: E-motion Restaurant
restaurants.address:

223 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came in at 11:20 PM with only 10 minutes left until last order, having seen the Chang Beer 1+1 promotion.

The staff were super friendly, and although I only ordered one simple snack, it was delicious.

I asked for a recommendation, and they suggested the Caesar salad with chicken skewers, which made me wonder what it was all about, but the taste was fantastic.

They were so friendly that I even considered going back for lunch tomorrow to buy some.

They usually close at 12 AM, but they couldn't leave until 12:30 AM because of us, yet they offered to wait another 20 minutes.

I felt bad so I left right away, though.

I think it's worth a visit for anyone staying nearby.

I didn't realize it until I got back, but the 4.8-star rating says it all lol.

However, it isn't great value for money.

But compared to the 120 baht slice of pizza I just ate, it seems like a good deal lol.
sample_reviews_en.author: John KIM

sample_reviews_en.text: Visiting from America and looking for breakfast this morning and went in based upon atmosphere and curb appeal. Ordered the breakfast burger and avocado today meals. Also ordered “Thai iced teas.”  While waiting I noticed how clean and organized the restaurant is. The food arrived and it was all spot on. The burger was cooked to my specifications and delicious, hash browns crispy, and avocado toast had a perfect blend of sesame seeds and spice. Definitely a chill spot to hangout and people watch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anthony K

sample_reviews_en.text:
We got the lunch set for two (it includes 2 or 3 courses, for 350 or 450 baht). It was a great decision! Great value and delicious.

The tuna ceviche was delicious. The only downside was the sauce could have been half as much. The fish was fresh, and the tomatoes were peeled. 🔥

The shrimp and avocado bruschetta was especially delicious, and it was the only one we could have had. It was large and very filling.
They make their own pasta – delicious.

The staff is very attentive 🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: Алла Филатова

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came two days in a row. Delicious. And, the best lunch deal in town. 350b for two dishes and 450b for three full size dishes. Fresh romaine lettuce in the Caesar salad loaded with freshly grated cheese on top. Plenty of tuna chunks in the Ceviche. Creamy Tom Yum Goong with a western twist. The greenest “Green Salad” I have had. Bolognese with homemade pasta. Chocolate ganache that isn’t too sweet… but still sweet.

Excellent service. Waitresses with big smiles.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Yeung

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is very cosy and have a great atmosphere. The service is spectacular and very welcoming and professional. The food that is provided is very tasty and delicious . The restaurant food is Asian with a modern look . I really recommend this place if you want to try out some spectacular food .
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Michael

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food looks exactly like on the pictures online.
The products are fresh and of good quality.
The service was nice and not too insistent.
I gave it 4 stars for the atmosphere because the water was warm and in general it was hot in the room but it was acceptable.
Would definitely come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anthony Marozzi

sample_reviews_en.text: I liked the place; I had a green salad and poke bowl, both were delicious. I asked for corn on the poke bowl, but they don't offer that; we'd take the corn separately as a complimentary gift. At 11 PM, we were completely alone in the place, which was also a plus. 👌🏻 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Алена Кузнецова

sample_reviews_en.text: Very disappointed experience. To be honest  I have doubts about the reviews and the dishes showed here. The menu from breakfast is miles away from the posts amd very limited. That day no avocado... so many dishes were missing..Came for the …
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexandre Da Fonseca

restaurants.name: ท่านพ่อซาลาเปา @ La Villa Ari
restaurants.address:

อาคาร La Villa, 356 Phahonyothin Rd, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tann Por Sarapao is a famous stall/mini bun shop at Ari Villa. Just right next to BTS Ari Exit 4. Many delicious bun with variety of flavour.

The salted egg lava is very good here. Decent price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donny Boonyamanop

sample_reviews_en.text: For me, the taste was okay. The cream was a bit dry, but at least the buns weren't cold. The packaging was nice, but the buns were a bit small for the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: best perapat

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the deep fried egg custard bun. It was tasty, maybe not the best but good and warm for the moment! Nice 40 baht snack :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Aya Hosch

sample_reviews_en.text: Every time I'm in Ari, I always buy these to take home. Their steamed buns have a unique filling, and they're delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: ทิวากร ตันติพิสิทธิ์

sample_reviews_en.text: I really like the steamed buns here. They have different types of dough and a wide variety of fillings.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaminya

sample_reviews_en.text: The steamed buns are soft and delicious, the barbecued pork filling is excellent, you should try them.
sample_reviews_en.author: G G

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything on the menu is delicious and affordable. It's clean and the staff are very attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: supagarn tuntiwinyupongs

sample_reviews_en.text: It's small and pricy compared to it's size. The mushroom fried bao is sooooo yummy! 😍 Not bad
sample_reviews_en.author: Jia Yin Foo

restaurants.name: คอหมูพระราม 5
restaurants.address:

150 Ratchaphruek Rd, Bang Khun Kong, Bang Kruai District, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: In my humble opinion, this restaurant is the best at what they do. The pork collar was well seasoned and juicy. Add to that, an excellent selection of sides and the sauce is the game changer. I tried all the sauces and settled on the tamarind sauce and red eye chile paste with giant water bug sauce. In my opinion, these two are a perfect pairing. The pork stew and pork madras curry on rice were tender and delightful aromatic. A variety of flavors and simplicity never fails to impress. The staff were very helpful and polite. The restaurant was clean, and a great price for the amount of food you got.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mac Vichien

sample_reviews_en.text:
Super great value restaurant in terms of quantity, quantity and taste of food per their selling price. I would strongly recommend any one to come and try their food. Staff is great but i dont think they can speak English at all.

Minus 1 star bcus of no aircon and they didnt give us the recipe. So we cant check our order. However, i believe they get it right. All of our meal in my picture is around 700 thb.
sample_reviews_en.author: Veeravit Jayz kanjanathiemthao

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best grilled pork neck in BKK!
It’s Saturday around 11:30am. Parking was super easy and plenty of spots. Walked in, sat down, and ordered right away! Food came super quick. Their friendly server pointed out that for the dipping sauces, we need to get it over by the cart as there were more than 8 items to choose from. Everything was super :) We will repeat!
sample_reviews_en.author: Vuttikon Thaidecha

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best pork specialty restaurant.

They have not so many options in their menu, yet they nail it in every single dish they serve. Price is totally not an issue here.
Recommended dish: grilled pork shoulder and grilled pork ribs

Minus 1 star for not being air conditioned and smoke from grilling in storefront.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pirat KT

sample_reviews_en.text: The grilled pork neck is cooked to perfection, available in both the classic style and a toasted rice seasoning version. Both are packed with flavor. Complimentary dipping sauces and fresh vegetables are provided, allowing you to customize your meal to your liking. Absolutely delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mery C.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Decent pig’s jowl here. The jowl goes with white rice rather than sticky rice.

There are tones of sauces to choose from as well.

Other menus are also good.

Parking are available but no sun shades

The restaurant is an open space style but no hot air at all. Very good ventilation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeans

sample_reviews_en.text:
The grilled pork here is pretty delicious, and they also have free vegetables and dipping sauce.
But the minced pork and plum soup was just mediocre.
I think the price is also a bit high for the quantity.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sabrina Wu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food was nicely done. Pork lover heaven. The curry was super special- multidimensional flavours....like spices are playing orchestra to your senses.

Free flow Thai dips with local veggies.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pan Phatanapitoon

restaurants.name: Neon Boat Noodles
restaurants.address:

395, 7 Chaloem Phrakiat 17 Alley, ตำบล หนองปรือ, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The specialty is Kuai Tiao Nya, beef noodles. There are a lot of people, and the wait for a seat is about 15 minutes. We ordered the much-vaunted wagyu noodles for 260b, standard food for 75b, and moo crop for 140b. There's a choice of noodles (as in any food stall) and a choice of spiciness. Almost all the employees are Burmese. 'Restik' is aimed at tourists (farangs and Thais). The atmosphere is nice and clean. The place is small, table after table, the air conditioning can't cope, it's hot. The photos on the menu are beautiful. In real life, the portions are tiny, served in a large bowl, it feels like someone's making a joke. My wife said this wagyu is some kind of scam. The wagyu is Thai, three thin slices. No taste, no smell, nothing special. The beef soup isn't very good either, it's not rich, the meat is tough. The moo krop is essentially overcooked lard. Disappointing. The place is overpriced. There's nothing special about it. They also make padkaprao, and it's three pieces of pork, which is a real eye-opener. I wouldn't recommend it; there are better and cheaper places.
sample_reviews_en.author: Максим Титов

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is so delicious, I could come back again and again. The taste is great, flavorful, and rich. Adding lime juice makes it even better. The ingredients are high-quality and fresh; the pork slices, braised pork, liver, and beef are large pieces. The price seems high, but it's worth it.

I deducted one star because the restaurant uses a mobile scanning system for ordering, but when paying, there were additional items on the bill totaling 200 baht that I didn't order. You need to double-check before paying and inform the counter staff to remove them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Coatdays ร้านชุดกันหนาวให้เช่า ครบวงจร ราคาสบายกระเป๋า

sample_reviews_en.text: I asked the staff for a spoon and an extra fried egg, but even after finishing my meal, I still didn't get one. It was terrible; I ate noodles without a spoon and stir-fried basil without a fried egg. I told the staff I would order an extra fried egg myself, but she said she would. I asked for a spoon because I only had chopsticks, and I waited and waited. I decided to just eat, and still didn't receive a spoon or an extra egg!! It's like they only care about serving Chinese customers, not Thai people. Terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: 박하린

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is good, but be sure to double-check your order and bill. There can be confusion between special menu items and regular items.

(The food is delicious, but double-check your order and bill carefully. There can be issues with the difference between special and regular menu items.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Chonlada Natee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Waited in line for a while because it was a holiday season. Visited on 12/4/69.
Sat in the shop, enjoyed toast with custard and Thai tea, sipped drinks while waiting.

The noodles were incredibly delicious! Very impressed.
Will definitely visit again next time. ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Jinnapat H

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, the food was tasty, but not exceptionally delicious—like anything I've ever had. I wish the flavors were richer and spicier, but I understand that it might be because the taste is geared towards foreigners, so it wasn't too strong. The price was okay, not too expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภานุพันธ์ ภัทรพฤกษา

sample_reviews_en.text: I have to admit, I came with a negative attitude because of the hot weather. I kept thinking, "It's just noodles, how good could it be? Is it worth the wait? Should I just go back to Thongsmith in Bangkok for a more relaxed meal?" …
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaisit Suwankeeree

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food in Thailand is delicious, but halal options are limited.
As deaf individuals from Southeast Asia, we encountered obstacles in using services due to the lack of Thai sign language support, leading to frequent misunderstandings.
sample_reviews_en.author: ade wirawan

restaurants.name: Porwa Northern Thai Cuisine
restaurants.address:

69/34 Phaya Thai Rd, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic taste of Northern Thailand in Bangkok 🔥

We stopped by Porwa Northern Thai Cuisine for lunch and it was a fantastic choice for trying northern Thai food.

The food was delicious, beautifully presented, and the portions were generous. Here's what we ordered and loved:

- Chicken Khao Soi: Incredible. The coconut milk curry broth was super flavorful, with just the right amount of spice. The chicken thigh was incredibly tender, and the fried noodles on top gave it an amazing texture 🍜

- Prawn Pad Thai: A classic, but perfectly executed. The prawns were a good size, fresh, and had the perfect balance of sweet, sour, and salty.

- Spring Rolls: Very crispy on the outside, not heavy at all, and with a flavorful filling.

- Fried Banana Blossom with Squash: A total surprise, super crispy and perfect for snacking with the included sauces.

The place is welcoming, very clean, the staff were very friendly, and we found the prices quite reasonable for the quality they offer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jonathan Varela

sample_reviews_en.text:
While cleaning my room the other day, I stumbled upon a Uniqlo Lifewear magazine article from a few years ago that recommended this restaurant, so I added it to my food list.

My hotel for this trip happened to be near the restaurant, and since I had to stay in my hotel room for two nights, I decided to walk over and get dinner to take back to the hotel.

I tried three dishes on this trip: basil rice, Northern Thai sausage fried rice, and stir-fried seaweed.

They looked simple, but everything was incredibly delicious! Reasonably priced and great value.

If you're in Bangkok and happen to be staying nearby, you should definitely check it out! 👍

If you don't eat spicy food, remember to tell the owner you don't want it spicy.

P.S. The owner is very cute ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Joanna

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of my new favorite spots in Bangkok!
I visited specifically for the Khao Soi, but every dish we ordered was absolutely delicious and served in generous portions.
Tucked away in a quiet spot, this place feels like a lovely hidden gem that I almost want to keep as my own little secret.
I'll definitely be back!
-----
I've found another favorite spot in Bangkok!
I visited specifically for the Khao Soi, but every dish we ordered was truly delicious and the portions were very satisfying. Tucked away in a quiet location, this place feels like a wonderful hidden gem that I almost want to keep as my own secret.
I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: tadashi yamanaka

sample_reviews_en.text: A Thai restaurant located in the Phaya Thai area of ​​Bangkok. Situated within a 3-5 minute walk from Phaya Thai Station, which is served by the BTS (Skytrain) and ARL (Airport Rail Link), the restaurant specializes in Northern Thai cuisine. While it is famous for its Khao Soi, I ordered the classic Pad Thai and Pad Khao Pad Moo Sap, and they were quite delicious. The interior is tidy and well-maintained, and the owner and staff are very friendly. It is a place where you can enjoy a pleasant meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steven Hwang (아쭈s)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sticky fried rice x 2 - super sticky
Onion rings - melt in mouth gorgeous
Green curry with chicken - beautiful
Crispy pork with spicy sauce - awesome

What a great find this place was. The owners were consistently smiling and you can tell they really do know how to cook.

English is minimally spoken ( part of the charm )  but the menu is also translated.

2 beers , 1 water plus all above food mentioned 730 baht. Excellent value.

Lovely people - fantastic food.
sample_reviews_en.author: andrew lees

sample_reviews_en.text: We were here on the last day of our three-week trip to Indonesia and Thailand. A nice, simple, and clean place. Friendly service. The food was absolutely delicious, and yes, it's more expensive than street food, but it is a restaurant, and the value for money is excellent. Besides being so tasty, the portions were also generous. Really big. We were completely satisfied; it was a great way to end our trip.
sample_reviews_en.author: Melanie

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Khao Soi is subtly sweet and mildly spicy, with a gentle flavor.

To put it bluntly, it's the kind of soup you can "drink to the last drop."

The seasoning is perfectly suited to the Japanese palate, and it's a dish I highly recommend trying.

The restaurant fills up very quickly during lunchtime, so going earlier or later will allow you to enjoy your meal at a more leisurely pace.
sample_reviews_en.author: まぐろ

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is excellent. I ordered chicken khao soi, which has a delicious spicy kick that's perfect with the lime wedges they bring on the side. Then I ordered plantain blossom with breaded squash, which was also very tasty. The only thing is, if you don't like cilantro, like me, I wouldn't recommend the spring rolls because they're quite stuffed. However, the hot sauce is very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emilio Martínez Varela

restaurants.name: Salad Factory
restaurants.address:

ศูนย์การค้าเทอร์มินอล 21 ห้องเลขที่ LG021,LG022 ชั้น LG เลขที่ 88 Soi Sukhumvit 19, Khlong Toei Nuea, Thawi Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Healthy, Fresh, and Delicious! 🥗✨
If you’re looking for a great spot that is clean-eating, lean, and weight-loss friendly, Salad Factory at Terminal 21 is a total win!
Food & Quality: Everything was absolutely delicious! The greens were incredibly fresh, crisp, and vibrant. You can really feel that healthy boost with every bite—totally guilt-free. 💚
Service: Exceptional service! The staff here are well-trained, attentive, and genuinely helpful. They were fantastic at walking us through the active promotions and giving recommendations. 👏
Ambiance: Great overall vibe—relaxed and comfortable. My only tiny feedback would be the lighting: if it were just a touch brighter, it would be absolutely perfect (especially for food photos!).
Highly recommended for anyone who wants a wholesome, nutritious meal that doesn't sacrifice flavor. Will definitely be back! 🥑🔥
sample_reviews_en.author: Noppadon Akarapattananukul (I-Nop)

sample_reviews_en.text: There's a huge selection of menu items. The atmosphere inside the restaurant is great, and the seating is spacious, perfect for families with large tables available. Health-conscious people will love it, especially with the DIY salad bar …
sample_reviews_en.author: Pam Panotporn

sample_reviews_en.text: I was very impressed! It was very clean, and the plates were heated. The queue moved quickly, the food was good, hot, and the portions were appropriate for the price. Excellent!!! 😍😚🩵
sample_reviews_en.author: 0195 Chuenchom

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great. The restaurant is well-decorated. It's crowded but doesn't feel cramped. There's a wide variety of food, and everything on the menu looks delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kodchanan Bupasiri

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is good, delicious, and the portions are generous.
There's a wide variety of Thai, Western, and Japanese dishes.
The service is good, and the restaurant is clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanokwan W

sample_reviews_en.text: Love the food hear always for its taste, portion and price. No other salad resto beats the quality of material here. Thanks for serving us great healthy food. ❤️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Harissadee Saisawang

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was good, the food was great value for money with large portions, perfect for health-conscious individuals looking for affordable meals.
sample_reviews_en.author: sanupan pantitanonth

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing food

Waiting time for the ribs was about 20m definitely worth the wait.

They had way too many menus took us more than 5m to read them all
sample_reviews_en.author: Spam Underwear

restaurants.name: Rengaya
restaurants.address:

อาคารเพลินจิตเซ็นเตอร์ ชั้น B1 ห้องเลขที่ B 16 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Delicious. The pork set starts at 350฿. The staff are friendly and provide good service. Parking is available with a stamp. Prices include 7% VAT. Located on the ground floor of a building in Ploenchit. The restaurant is quite quiet and peaceful. It's a Korean BBQ style place. The kimchi is delicious, and they serve tea.
sample_reviews_th.author: gungun At

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's been a very long time since I ate here. I used to eat here when it was in Thaniya.
When it moved to Ploenchit, I went 2-3 times.
Today I was in the area, so I stopped by to try it again.

It's delicious. My favorite part of the restaurant is the marinade sauce for the meat. It's delicious.
The meat has a fairly strong sauce flavor (a bit salty).
This makes it not greasy at all when you eat it.

The Tan shio is delicious! Tender and not chewy at all.
(I'd say it's better than some expensive restaurants.)

The meat quality, in my opinion, is average, but it's very good value for money.
I tried the regular, Jo, and Tokujo cuts.
I think there's not much difference between them.

I really liked the salad. It was so delicious I wanted to ask for more.

Even though I haven't been to this restaurant for many years,
coming back to eat here again, I'm still impressed.
It's a restaurant that offers great value for money + the meat isn't greasy.
While I was eating, I saw people constantly coming into the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanawan Uramphorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The old world charm, but needs to improve to stay in the game.

Rengaya has been in yakiniku scene in bangkok for decades. It has now moved to ploenchit centre and i have the opportunity to try back the restaurant.

Food : i ordered jyo karubi and jyo rosu. It is 'okay' but you can get similar quality elsewhere. The only unique prob is their dipping sauce that is very delicious and difficult to replicate.

Service : when it comes to old establishments, service can be compromised. But yes, you would get the kind of 'homey' feeling services instead.

Atmosphere : nothing to shout about.

Verdict : if you have limited time in bangkok and want to try japanese yakiniku, the one at sukhumvit26 is much better at the same value. If you want to come here for old time sake or change of atmosphere. Why not ?
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamonkarn K

sample_reviews_en.text:
This grill restaurant is an old restaurant that is open for a long time on the 2nd floor of Thaniya Plaza.  Especially the lunch that has to queue up to get the card together in front of the store  The atmosphere in the shop is comfortable.  But the smell of smoke will stink all over the shop

Lunch will have a menu to order pork, beef and seafood.  In the dish will be served with kimchi, soup, vegetable salad, sesame oil and rice, sprinkled with plum powder  In the meat dish, there will be a sauce poured in the recipe of the shop, sweet (dip instead of sauce). There are pumpkins, garlic and scallop, and slice of lemon to eat with grilled meat, delicious, quite good. Delicious.

At the end, there are fruit and coffee tea services in the set as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gigs Boontharak

sample_reviews_en.text:
MUST TRY!! The best for me for Set Lunch Yakiniku.  My favorite place for lunch more than 20 years (since they’re located in Thaniya)

Now Rengaya is on B1 floor, Ploenchit center.
Plenty of parking slot and can get there by BTS (PloenChit station)

I recommend set lunch coz I think it’s valued price, the set serves with salad, soup, fruit and easy tea/coffee. And I love the quality of Beef 🥩.

I ever been there for Dinner and found the price is much higher but it’s worth for drink and chill out with friends and family.  KOBE beef is also good.

Highly recommended!!
(Actually I don’t want to review this good coz I don’t need to get a long queue 🤣)
sample_reviews_en.author: The traveller

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant has been a favorite of mine for years 🤍
Before, we used to come here for lunch because they had complete and value-for-money lunch sets. The food was easy to eat, but the quality was consistently good every time.
After they moved locations, I hadn't visited for a while. I recently got to eat here again, and it still feels the same. The atmosphere and the taste remain classic, especially the grilled meats, which are still fragrant, tender, and delicious as always.
Some restaurants are just places to eat,
but this one holds wonderful lunch memories for us 🫶🏻✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Nongnuch Choeysiri

sample_reviews_en.text: The food quality is good. The rice is soft and delicious, and the pork and beef are of good quality (according to those who ate it). However, some dishes can be salty, like the vegetable salad which is a little salty. But the other dishes are just right and not too salty. Buying a set meal is more worthwhile. A set meal includes one bowl of rice, one bowl of vegetable salad, miso soup, kimchi, meat (depending on which set you choose), and a drink (coffee, tea, etc.). There's also a small bowl of fruit, usually two pieces of watermelon, but sometimes it's something else.
sample_reviews_en.author: Doraphung Jun

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there for dinner on a weekday.

It's a Japanese yakiniku (grilled meat) restaurant.

It wasn't particularly crowded, and there were a moderate number of customers. I appreciated the wide selection of alcoholic beverages. The set yakiniku menus were a good deal.

The rice was also delicious. The staff were very attentive and helpful. I'm not sure if it was part of the set, but we also received dessert and after-dinner tea, which made it feel like a good deal. I was also happy to see chilled hand towels.
sample_reviews_en.author: やっぱり飛行機

restaurants.name: Thai Royal Kitchen ครัวหน้าวัง
restaurants.address:

12 Ratchabophit Rd, Wat Ratchabophit, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted on the sweet side. There were no tissues provided for customers. They couldn't scan to pay, but they should have put up a sign outside saying they only accept cash. That way, people would know better. I don't usually carry cash, but luckily I brought it today for other expenses.

Regarding the owner's response about the food taste, it depends on individual preferences; some people might like it. As for the tissue box on the table, there was none; I checked every table and there wasn't one. And when I asked to pay via scan, I clearly stated I wanted to scan, but the staff said they only accept cash. If the scanned payment machine was malfunctioning, the staff should have informed me.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornruedee W.

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I had the opportunity to pay respects at Wat Ratchabophit and stopped by Krua Na Wang restaurant for a meal. We just stopped at whichever restaurant we saw, but it exceeded our expectations – the food was delicious, the service was excellent, and it was very clean. The pork ribs were delicious, and the dumplings were incredibly flavorful and filling. You absolutely have to order them! The menu isn't extensive, but if you're looking for a quick meal when you're in a hurry, I highly recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ilada Chagthaisong

sample_reviews_en.text: That's how I left the plate of pork ribs. Everything was delicious. Highly recommended, but you have to be quick; for a Spaniard, you have to eat early or you'll find it closed or they might even run out of something. They're super friendly. They have fans, so it's not too hot. They separate the hot sauce so you can choose how spicy you like it.
sample_reviews_en.author: José García Pérez

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is very clean and the food is delicious. I ordered the baked chicken rice and baked chicken noodles to try. The flavors were well-balanced, the sauce had soaked into the chicken, and most importantly, the chicken was incredibly tender – practically melt-in-your-mouth. The prices are also reasonable. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: GreenLady N

sample_reviews_en.text: A super local restaurant that serves braised chicken and pork dishes. We tried their braised pork ribs and shrimp/pork dumplings, which were both very tasty. The pork ribs were a little bit sweet, pairing them with the dipping sauce would …
sample_reviews_en.author: *o Kelly o*

sample_reviews_en.text: I stumbled upon this restaurant by chance. The menu looked delicious, and the baked chicken noodles were amazing! The chicken was tender and the flavor was rich. Some of the Thai dishes require reservations in advance.
sample_reviews_en.author: krisada kongchong

sample_reviews_en.text: Unbelievably good tasting. It looks a little underwhelming when you first receive the plate but the taste is mind-blowing. Really well cooked and perfect flavour. I would recommend this place
sample_reviews_en.author: Tiffany Bartlett

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped by to pay respects at a temple in the area and came across Krua Na Wang restaurant. I ordered the baked pork ribs; the meat was tender and delicious. I recommend trying it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Beautifu Girl

restaurants.name: Namerou Sushi
restaurants.address:

8 150 ซอย เทียนทะเล 7 แยก 2 Samae Dam, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
On December 30, 2024, they served crispy and spicy fish skin as an appetizer (free of charge). It was very crispy. I've eaten here three times now. All the fish is very fresh and delicious. It's worth the price. It's not cheap, but I'm willing to pay for the top-notch quality. They have omakase, but you need to call to reserve. The restaurant doesn't have a parking lot, but you can park next to the restaurant or in available spaces in the Anil Town project.
The wasabi is authentic, grated from the plant, not powdered; you can see the strands. It's very fragrant and spicy, giving a great kick to the nose.
They have various seasonal specials or items available on that day.
sample_reviews_en.author: AM W/Mmrs

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem in the Rama II area… The chef has excellent cooking skills, everything he makes is delicious, and he’s very friendly and welcoming. They accept catering orders or offer customized omakase menus… Quality guaranteed.

You can bring your own alcohol; there’s no corkage fee.

The chef is so friendly, you’ll feel like family.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kitibordee Yindeear-rom

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a million out of a hundred! Fresh, good price, and delicious! I highly recommend it to anyone in the Tha Kham/Rama 2 area. It's cheap, fresh, clean, and the staff are friendly. Even the soup is delicious! I've been eating here since the restaurant was in its old location.
sample_reviews_en.author: Napatsakorn L

sample_reviews_en.text:
A relaxed, cozy, and family-friendly atmosphere... The service is top-notch... the sushi is prepared fresh right in front of you if you sit down in front of the chefs, who are fantastic.

If you love good, fresh fish, then this restaurant is for you... Enjoy!
sample_reviews_en.author: Stéphane Wilczewski

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu was diverse, but I didn't take pictures because I was too hungry and ate everything. You can get refills on the soup too. It was absolutely delicious! They could make many different dishes with a whole fish. 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirachaya Hongkaew

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and very tasty, especially for fish lovers – a must-try! There's also a wide variety of other dishes to choose from at various prices, all in an atmosphere like an izakaya in Japan.
sample_reviews_en.author: korn-ek thummarukkit

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and fresh, and the service is good. Parking is available, but the restaurant is located in a side street among townhouses, so finding a spot might be a little difficult.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ghinft N.

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a quarter of a Shima Aji fish, which could be used to make three dishes: sushi, sashimi, and the head simmered in soy sauce. The price was excellent, and the taste was amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Huang P.Pipat

restaurants.name: Amici Siam Paragon
restaurants.address:

G29, 991 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best Italian restaurants in BKK

Amici at Siam Paragon is an excellent Italian restaurant with delicious food, high-quality ingredients, and beautifully presented dishes. The menu offers a great variety, and everything we ordered was flavorful and well prepared. The staff were friendly and professional, making the dining experience even more enjoyable.

The service was provided by Mr. Barry.

The only downside is that the restaurant gets extremely crowded, especially during peak hours, which can make it feel a bit noisy and may result in a short wait for a table. Despite that, the overall experience was outstanding, and I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for great Italian food in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ahmad Almoosawi

sample_reviews_en.text:
I know that restaurants review is about food, service and atmosphere but a point to be highlighted: the place is very clean and hygiene wise, I saw them cleaning the table condiments  (salt, pepper and olive oil) bottles each one individually and I thank them for that!

They had reservation list and when we reached late bringing my kids they considered that and arranged the list accordingly.

They provided cutlery and plate for kids small, safe and colorful, the team were very friendly when my daughter was crying.

Food is great and there is variety of options, baby chair provided, wheelchair accessible for elderly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noura Alshamsi

sample_reviews_en.text:
I would like to file a complaint regarding the service behavior of an employee. The employee spoke and acted impolitely, resulting in an unprofessional and uncomfortable experience. I request that the company investigate this incident and take appropriate action, and inform me of the results of the investigation.

Experiencing poor service from an employee—rude, inattentive, or making me feel unprofessional—is very upsetting.

From a customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: angkank konluk

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is absolutely delicious! Every time I visit Bangkok, I have to go back more than once.
Their pasta with mixed sauce is amazing!
The Margherita + vegetable pizza is very tasty.
The truffle soup is delicious, even though I'm not a big fan of truffles, but it's incredibly tasty, although the cup is very small.
I tried their seafood spaghetti, and honestly, it was bad; I didn't like the taste.
The service is excellent! 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: نور العل

sample_reviews_en.text:
A truly excellent Italian restaurant serving incredibly delicious dishes. Based on our experience with the following dishes:

Hot Appetizers:
- Bruschetta with salad and pizza sauce. 8.5/10

Main Courses:
- Lobster Risotto (Grilled lobster with risotto rice) 8/10 🤙
- Smoked Salmon with white rice served with saffron sauce and lemon wedges. 10/10 💘
- Smoked Ribs with Vegetable Chops 7/10 🤙

A must-try for lovers of Italian food! 👌🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: باسم الثقفي

sample_reviews_en.text:
My visit was at 6 PM.
The restaurant was crowded, and you could smell the freshly baked goods from outside. The service was good and very fast. The truffle soup was delicious and served in a coffee cup. I didn't like the truffle pizza. The Margherita was good. I'd also give the truffle pasta a 6/10, and I asked for it to be fully cooked. It's worth a repeat visit and trying other dishes.

The prices are average.
sample_reviews_en.author: Al Hanouf

sample_reviews_en.text:
In the past, I frequented this restaurant as one of my preferred dining establishments. However, today’s meal was disappointing, to the extent that I was unable to consume the main course. The seafood pizza was particularly unpalatable, and I barely managed to finish the lobster soup.
Despite being the most expensive restaurant in Siam Paragon, I was surprised to encounter such subpar food quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: A. Aziz

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried it today and it was really good. I got the pasta with pink sauce, the Margherita pizza, and the Caesar salad. Their food was delicious. I also got the calamari, which was a little tough. Overall, I'd go back to the restaurant and its prices are good. All that food and two Cokes for 270? I think the price is reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: basmah alotibi

sample_reviews_th.text: A must visit place if you wanna add a premium taste to your usual boat noodle experience. Order the premium wagyu beef mix boat noodle which cost slightly over 500฿. Worth every penny as the beef is so tender and nice. Ordered the add-on crispy pork skin that melt in the soup. No regret.
sample_reviews_th.author: Dennis Toh

sample_reviews_th.text:
Thongsmith is delicious, no need to add any seasoning.

Use KTC points to redeem a ฿300 voucher when you dine

and spend ฿800 or more.
sample_reviews_th.author: ผู้รู้ ผู้ตื่น ผู้หลับต่อ

sample_reviews_en.text: I was told Thongsmith is the best noodle in Thailand. I think it was the most expensive Thai noodle I have tired so far. Well, the dinning area look nice but nothing extraordinary. It was only 4pm and almost all tables were occupied. Quite a wide selection of boat noodle, from combination of meat, to different grade of meats. Mostly Beef and Pork with just a few selection of chicken. Cheapest was 149 Baht to 529 baht with wagyu beef. You get to select the level of spiciness you like from 1, 2 and 3. I have selected 2, although I can eat quite spicy, wish I had selected 1 instead. The presentation was nice. The staffs were friendly and efficient. Looking at the crowd you can tell that this are the group that are willing to pay for good food. There is a 10% service charge. I think the noodle was nice but nothing give me a WOW. I think we pay for the quality of the food, the atmosphere and the services. I do enjoyed the meal but I will not visit frequently for sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kesmond Kwek

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food quality is great, which is why this has been one of my favorite places. However, today I had a very disappointing experience.
Despite arriving earlier, I was repeatedly skipped because I was dining alone. Groups of 2–3 people who came after me were seated first. I waited for more than 30 minutes while standing.
There were empty tables outside, and I asked three times if I could sit there since no one else wanted them. I made it clear that I didn’t mind sitting outside as long as I could get my food, but my request was refused. I was about to leave out of frustration when the lady at the front finally agreed to let me sit outside.
I understand that lunch time is a busy, peak period, but this kind of treatment toward a customer especially someone dining alone is very disappointing and not acceptable. I hope this feedback helps improve how customers are treated in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanya Sopradit

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have to admit for the longest time I thought this place is just overhyped. I’ve been here a few times before and thought it was really good but not spectacular.

Compared to the cheaper outdoor boat noodle restaurants I would always support small mom and pop businesses.

But tonight my wife wanted to go again. Instead of the usual regular (and cheaper) beef boat noodle I splurged this time for the Australian Wagyu sliced beef with tendons and brisket.

It was delicious. There was plenty of sliced beef but not enough tendons and brisket though.

The soup broth was really tasty and flavorful. The bowl came out to 329B. It’s not a big bowl but I wasn’t too hungry it hit the spot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wally’s Travels and Eats

sample_reviews_en.text:
Among all the branches, Thongsmith at Central Ladprao is the most disappointing in terms of location, atmosphere, and service quality. The staff appeared visibly displeased. While I understand that they may be tired, it is not appropriate for customers to be affected by this.

I requested condiments, but the staff walked past as though they had not heard me. I had to make the request three times before stating that I had already asked multiple times. Only then were the condiments brought to me, delivered with an unfriendly demeanor.

Given this experience, I would prefer to visit the Iconsiam branch instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: VOC

sample_reviews_en.text:
I thought for a long time I want to eat waterfall/boat noodles good beef Will set the price a bit higher, I agree. Until finally found this shop, yes.

The meat is fresh, rotting, very good. It gives a lot of meat. Big pieces. Super soft. Most importantly, the beef tongue is very cool.

I think it's not expensive because the boat noodles on the roadside don't have good beef like this.

Order the normal beef. That's all.

The fried dumplings were super delicious , the sauce was good.

Narrow/pork cartilage to pass through and fry well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chonpat Jaroenjit
