sample_reviews_en.text:
A Buffet with an Unlikely Combination
The concept of a shabu and pizza buffet is definitely an unusual one, but somehow, it works. While the food is good, the real star of the show here is the service, led by one particular senior staff member who seems to run the entire operation with incredible skill and enthusiasm.
When we arrived, she greeted us warmly and, sensing our confusion over the strange menu combination, immediately took charge. She guided us through the online QR code ordering process and made sure every single person in our large group was well taken care of, orchestrating her "minions" with a professional demeanor. Her enthusiasm for the job is truly impressive, and it made the entire dining experience smooth and enjoyable.
Her dedication to service is a rare find and a huge asset to the restaurant. It’s the kind of performance that deserves a big raise. This place is worth a visit for the excellent service alone, and the food is a fun bonus.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puvanai Dardarananda

sample_reviews_en.text: Honestly, I didn't have high expectations at first, but after trying the food, wow, it was delicious! Everything looked good and clean. The shop is a bit cramped, but it's not a big deal. The staff were attentive to customers, constantly serving and clearing plates from the table, which was great. They kept refilling the food at the self-service station. The pizza I ordered through the app came piping hot. I initially thought it would be pre-made and then we'd just serve ourselves, but it was made fresh on the spot. As for parking, you can park in the Samyan Market parking lot and bring your parking card to scan at the shop for a discount. The pictures might look plain because I ate in a hurry; I was hungry!
sample_reviews_en.author: ตะลอนตก By Karin Fishing

sample_reviews_en.text:
Narai Pizzeria x Khan Noi Khor Shabu, Samyan Branch, BLOCK28 Project

Shabu and pizza buffet for 1 hour and 45 minutes.

The staff provided excellent and polite service.
The current pizza serving method allows you to order by scanning a QR code, which I personally think is better than the previous self-service method because you can choose your pizza toppings.

The restaurant accepts payment via QR code scanning and credit cards (no card processing fees).
The restaurant does not accept cash payments.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supawut Saengrassamee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The menu offers a wide variety of dishes, including both Thai and international cuisine, as well as desserts.
The taste is considered okay; the pizza is very good, the crust isn't too thick.
The Hainanese chicken rice has very tender chicken, but it's a shame there's no sweet soy sauce.
I really liked the black broth in the shabu-shabu; it was delicious. However, the mala broth and the original broth weren't as impressive.
The staff provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jakkarpat S

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered shabu and they offered a free pizza. I wasnt expecting that pizza would be that delicious. Comparing the quality with price it deserves 5 star.

I didnt notice this is a cashless restaurant and at the end I didnt have even small cash to pay them. It was about 22.00 and they spend energy and time to change my 1000 Baht and yet they were very friendly and understanding.
sample_reviews_en.author: S. B.

sample_reviews_en.text: The pizza was incredibly delicious! 🤩 The sushi was also excellent, but I forgot to take a picture. 🥲 The fried food was constantly refilled and served hot. There was a huge variety of appetizers and dipping sauces, including ponzu! 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻 The desserts were also delicious. Pure bliss! 💕 …
sample_reviews_en.author: sky

sample_reviews_en.text: All you can it include hot pot and pizza. Food quality is good considering the price which is very affordable. Scan the barcode to order the food. There is enough variety of food to choose. Worth to try
sample_reviews_en.author: Hung cw

sample_reviews_en.text: The shabu is very cheap price. Plenty of choices for shabu like pork meats, fish, veggie and etc. The pizza also good soup as well. Free soft drinks included. 5 out of 5.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ronnakorn Ratananopdonsakul

restaurants.name: Krua Baan Suan By Madam Apple (ครัวบ้านสวน)
restaurants.address:

15 90 15/90 27 Vibhavadi Rangsit 16/27 Alley, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Of all the Tom Yum Kung I had in Thailand for two weeks, this was the most luxurious and deep-tasting!!!!🤤🤤 It was so delicious that I think I'll miss it when I go back to Korea. I definitely recommend ordering it!!!!❤️ The store is really cute and pretty!! Stay healthy, boss!! See you again🙏 ขอบคุณค่ะ
sample_reviews_th.author: 지나무

sample_reviews_en.text:
I want to recommend this restaurant to more Thais. It's a truly amazing Thai restaurant with incredibly flavorful dishes. Those who love spicy food will definitely love it! Today we ordered minced shrimp jungle curry, fermented pork rib sausage, stir-fried pork with betel leaves, and an omelet (we didn't intend to order the omelet, but the spiciness of the other dishes made us order it! And it went together so well!).

The jungle curry was seriously flavorful, not blandly spicy, but intensely spicy and well-balanced. The fermented pork rib sausage was deliciously sour and salty, perfectly complemented by the fried garlic. And the stir-fried pork with betel leaves was full of tender pork, with a perfect balance of salty, spicy, and sweet flavors.

The prices might be a bit high, but the quantity and quality are worth it. We'll definitely be back and want to invite our family to try it too. It's genuinely delicious! I heard it's popular among foreigners (who tend to prefer milder curries like massaman curry), so I wanted Thais to try it because it's seriously, seriously delicious! 😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanaporn Panupaisal

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best place to eat Thai food in Bangkok if you considered the warmth of the owner as an important aspect of the culinary experience.

I really loved their Tom Yam! Madam Apple (the owner) kept on saying it's spicy, but it was not spicy at all for me (a fellow South East Asian).

The place felt like home, where I could hear her son/daughter playing 90's music, and sit next to her watching a horror movie on Netflix.

Madam Apple can speak English really well. She would love to chit chat with you and recommend the dish for you if you are on your first time in Thailand.

She also has a small guesthouse in the back/upper part of the restaurant. Too bad I have booked another guesthouse. I would definitely stay in her guesthouse if I happened to visit Bangkok again. ❤
sample_reviews_en.author: Rima Putri

sample_reviews_en.text:
BEST THAI FOOD we had in Bangkok in our one week trip!!! We ate 3 times here!! Can't recommend more!!

This is exactly what we have been looking for in Bangkok in the last few days - home made tranditional & delicious Thai food ❤️ we were disappointed in many other places, but here, mama Apple's food met all our expectations - amazing!!

It is a bit pricy by Thai local price, but it's worth every penny I can guarantee (we have paid more in other places and only got just ok food).

And a huge plus is that Apple is such a friendly, nice and welcoming person (we are staying at her homestay as well). She loves cooking and makes customers happy!!

If I am in Bangkok next time, I'll for sure take a taxi here just to eat her food again ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: L S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Apple is the sweetest woman, who makes you feel right at home when you order. I have yet to try a dish of hers that I didn’t like.
My favorite was the Black Pepper Tiger Shrimp, but the Thai Chicken Green Curry was a close second. The menu is extensive, so there is something for everyone, even vegetarians and vegans.
The food is also extremely fresh, as I even had the pleasure of accompanying Apple to the market where she bought groceries for her meals. I also learned she offered cooking classes too!
I’m convinced if she were to ever put out a cookbook it’d be a best seller!
Try the fresh squeezed juices, my personal favorite was the sweet and tart guava!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kylah Quintal

sample_reviews_en.text: This hidden gem of a restaurant was discovered by chance and it was absolutely amazing! The food is flavorful and perfect for Thai tastes. The owner is lovely and does everything herself. I highly recommend the yellow curry with pickled bamboo shoots and sea bass, the stir-fried pork with dried chilies and betel leaves, and the fried tiger prawns with garlic – the prawns are huge and juicy! I had two servings of rice. P.S. This picture was taken after I'd already eaten half the food, I didn't get a chance to take a full photo. I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Supat Choosuk

sample_reviews_en.text:
We discovered Madam Apple’s place by chance, as it was close to the hotel where we were staying, and it turned out to be an exceptional experience. It’s truly a hidden gem, with such a cozy, warm, and homey atmosphere. Everything we ordered was delicious and tasted incredibly authentic. Every dish felt like home—like it was cooked by a Thai mum I never had.

Madam Apple herself is also very friendly and sweet, which made the experience even more special. If I have the chance to visit Bangkok again, I would definitely come back. 💯 recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karyn Feliana

sample_reviews_en.text:
It has been long time no vacation since I work in Singapore. This time I come Bangkok with my friend from Hong Kong.
I must say this restaurant is the best for combine Western and Thai style.
This family restaurant feel very cozy, and Madam Apple cooking is amazing and her son Kay also provide us very nicely service
Tom Yum spaghetti and Pad Thai are super tasty. The Tom Yum soup is the best I ever try.
And don’t miss their homemade durian ice cream with sticky rice, really special!
I will surely come back again next time in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: DONNOD

restaurants.address:

1018 8 Rama IV Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sundry is one of the most memorable bars I've ever visited. Every cocktail is unique, thoughtfully crafted, and absolutely delicious. You can really tell that a lot of creativity and care goes into every drink.

What truly sets this place apart, though, is the staff. Every team member is welcoming, attentive, and genuinely great at engaging with guests. Even when visiting alone, I never felt lonely they know exactly how to make you feel comfortable without being intrusive.

The service is warm, professional, and perfectly balanced not too much, not too little. By the end of the night, it genuinely feels like you're leaving home rather than just another bar.

If you're looking for exceptional cocktails and heartfelt hospitality, Sundry is a place you'll want to return to again and again.
sample_reviews_en.author: INTOUCH YIMTAE

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stumbled upon this hidden gem, just 10 minutes outside of Vertigo. Amazing bar with great selection of cocktails. The menu has everything! From the classics to more extravagant options.

I am a person who loves experimenting and this place definitely met my needs. I had a cocktail that can only be explained as unique - garlic, soy sauce, white pepper. But what a wonderful combination this was! Highly recommend for adventurous people.

The bartender was excellent, the DJ gave us great recommendations about neighbourhoods to visit and local bars. The music was on spot and the vibe was just great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ioana Dimova

sample_reviews_en.text:
A fantastic cocktail bar with stunning views of the park and the lively sky-street. We were the first guests of the evening - though officially open earlier, most people tend to arrive around 9:30 or 10 pm. This gave us the perfect chance to chat with the owner and bartenders, all of whom are genuinely warm and welcoming.

The drinks are superb, the music hits just right, and even someone like me - usually not a cocktail bar regular - might just find themselves coming back to Sundry again and again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text: I felt it wasn’t quite as good as expected. Most of the drinks that day had whipped cream, and it would have been helpful if the ingredients were listed clearly on the menu so customers could better understand what’s in each drink. Some of the cocktails also seemed like they were pre-mixed and simply poured into the glass, which made the preparation feel a bit too simple. In addition, several drinks listed on the menu were either unavailable or couldn’t be made at the time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Max Müller

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent cocktails and very courteous service. The menu is cool, varied and inviting. The bartender is professional and pleasant. However, the place is not maintained and is not clean. The smell in the place is not good and there is no soap in the bathrooms. The music is too loud and spoils the atmosphere. It doesn't make sense for a cocktail bar to play music that is suitable for clubs.
sample_reviews_en.author: יעקב גרמן

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sundry has such a fun vibe, the interior is beautifully designed, and every bartender here is super friendly and easy to talk to.

The music keeps the energy up all night, and the cocktail menu is wildly creative. Some combinations sound unusual at first, but they totally work. It’s one of those places where you can just relax, laugh, and end up staying way longer than you planned.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rotthanong Tienratthanaphaiboon

sample_reviews_en.text: Drawn in by the architecture, the restaurant's lighting and food are stunning, the cocktails are incredibly creative, and the DJ's music selections are perfect. If the team is to rebrand, please preserve this wonderful aspect. Average price per person: 2000+ RMB. Food: 5/5, Service: 5/5, Atmosphere: 5. Reservations are recommended.

sample_reviews_en.text: Love  my salad bar. Just gotta keep going back. I wish they had seafood chowder or clam chowder. But I can go for the cream of mushroom.  Still good for the baht. Nice choice of salads.  Mix and match if you will. Good with some lemon tea.

sample_reviews_en.text: We came on a Thursday evening; the traffic was good, it wasn't crowded, and the food was constantly refilled. We ordered a steak and paired it with the premium salad bar, creating our favorite dish – it was incredibly satisfying!

restaurants.address:


sample_reviews_en.text:
Yentafo Hongtae is one of the legendary yentafo noodle shops in the Sriyan area. Its highlight is the generous amount of toppings, including fish balls, fish cakes, crispy squid, blood jelly, and fish balls.
The yentafo broth has a sweet and sour flavor, a well-balanced traditional style that's easy to eat. Those who prefer a spicier taste can order a tom yum version for an extra kick. The portions are generous, and the price is affordable.

The atmosphere is a simple street food style. It can get quite crowded during lunchtime, so it's recommended to avoid peak hours. It's perfect for those looking for a noodle dish with generous toppings, a consistent taste, and a filling, satisfying meal in one bowl. 👍

Yentafo Hongtae, Sriyan

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️☆☆

I tried this place based on reviews. The highlight is the high-quality ingredients; the fish balls and crispy squid are large and have a bouncy texture, and the morning glory is fresh and crunchy. It looks clean and appetizing.

However, the broth in the Yen Ta Fo soup was quite bland for my taste. I had to add quite a bit of seasoning to make it palatable.

The fried intestines, a recommended dish, were also quite bland. The filling seemed to be minced pork mixed with pork fat and then fried. The texture was okay, but the flavor wasn't as outstanding as I expected.

One more thing to consider is that parking is quite difficult. If you're driving, you might need to allow some extra time to find a parking spot.

Overall, the ingredients are good, fresh, and the portions are generous. However, if the flavors were a little more intense, it would be even more impressive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratthawit Ek

sample_reviews_en.text: I had something to do in this area, so I used a map to find this place. It had a lot of reviews, and I wanted some yen ta fo (Thai noodle soup) to fill my stomach. When I got to the intersection, I almost missed it because there were different shops inside and outside selling at different times. I went to the shop in the alley before noon. It wasn't slow, or maybe I was lucky, I ordered and got it right away. I tried the yellow yen ta fo. The broth wasn't very hot, the yellow noodles weren't perfectly translucent and bouncy, but acceptable. The toppings were good, I especially liked the crispy squid which was soft and easy to chew. I liked the broth flavor, and the pork intestines were delicious. I ordered it to go. I'll definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: พอดี พีอีเอ

sample_reviews_en.text:

Service - 10/10
Price - 9/10

Recommendation - This Yentafour (fermented bean curd soup) noodle shop is known for its delicious pork intestine.
