Updates (February 24, 2023) (pics 5-12) - It's been quite some time since my previous visit. Quite satisfied as always.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thaweechot Tatiyapermpoon

sample_reviews_en.text: The unique feature of this restaurant is the "sai ngao," which is similar to a sausage and is used in noodle dishes. If ordered as a dish, it comes with a dipping sauce similar to chili sauce and chilies. We ordered the special Tom Yum Yen Ta Fo, and it was perfectly seasoned—no need to add anything. It also came with a generous amount of ingredients, making it incredibly filling. We even had to take some home! It's worth the drive, but parking can be difficult; you'll need to allow extra time to circle around and find a parking spot. There are signs indicating where parking is prohibited in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: manaros monklom

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Yentafo (Thai noodle soup) shop in the Sriyan area served a regular Tom Yum Yentafo. They gave a generous amount of toppings.

The soup wasn't very hot, but the seasoning was rich and flavorful, slightly sweet.

The "Luk Rok" (a type of noodle dish) was unusual; I'd never had it before. The filling seemed to be egg and minced pork, but I'm not sure. It was quite chewy and difficult to break apart.

The fried pork meatballs were delicious.

Overall, it was a good Tom Yum Yentafo that didn't need any extra seasoning.

There is parking available on the street opposite the shop's alley.
sample_reviews_en.author: Z Zilver

sample_reviews_en.text: Yentafo Hongtae Sriyan is an old, established restaurant located on Ruamjit Road near Ruamjit intersection. It's an open-air restaurant with a decent number of tables for dine-in. Their yentafo (noodle soup) is packed with toppings, and prices (as of February 23, 2024) start at 60 baht. Besides yentafo, they also serve pork noodles and tom yum pork noodles. The restaurant is very efficient, employing many staff members, resulting in fast service. Takeout orders are also prepared quickly. Their signature dishes are the fried taro and boiled pork intestines.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaiyakit Thanabriboon

sample_reviews_en.text:
This old-fashioned Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) shop has been open for over 50 years. The prices are reasonable: regular is 60 baht, and the special is 70 baht, with a generous portion. The Yen Ta Fo has a well-balanced flavor that hardly needs any seasoning.
A recommended must-try dish that everyone orders is the soft pork intestines. It's delicious with the shop's special dipping sauce. The intestines are firm and odorless, priced at 60 baht per plate.
The shop has two sections: the indoor section in the morning and the outdoor section in the afternoon.
sample_reviews_en.author: No Name

restaurants.name: Silom Serene, a Boutique Hotel
restaurants.address:

7 สาทร ซอย 3 Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best thing about this hotel is its location: everything is locally available without the need to go somewhere by transport. Beautiful and super friendly staff. We booked an executive room for 4000 bhat/night and really regret it because of the room condition: furniture has a smell as its made of a wood that’s been there for years, bathroom could be replaced to a new one as it was also very old. Our ceiling in the kitchen part started leaking but staff fixed it quickly. And the worst thing is that they didn’t have a proper ventilation, it was either not functioning or not  set up at all…. The air in the room was very stuffy and humid too and no AC can help with this. When it comes to breakfast, I can only advise to eat an omelette or toasts with jams, I didn’t like the rest of the food they offered. Its 4 star hotel and they serve an instant coffee instead of putting a coffee machine for breakfast time, veggies especially cucumbers had very big seeds on them and almost yellow colour, absolutely tasteless.

Only giving 3 stars for lovely people working in there and a good location, hotel is absolutely not recommended if you wanna choose an executive or de lux room at least
sample_reviews_en.author: Shaha

sample_reviews_en.text:
Where the sidewalk ends . . .

Silom Serene is steps from the main road but down a perilous side street with no good sidewalk.

It’s not fair to describe Serene as “faded glory” as it was never very glorious and there’s not a paint surface that isn’t scuffed or a carpet that doesn’t show wear.

The rooms are large, the beds comfortable and the aircon is effective and can be controlled. Security is fair (no card access on the elevator). Housekeeping was meticulous and respectful; laundry took unusually long 3 days) to return.

I didn’t like the breakfasts as I was looking for more western fare but I acknowledge that’s a minority view.

The swimming is little more than a splash pool but the fitness room was adequate.

Staff made up for deficiencies by good spoken English and cheery greetings. The hotel appears to attract elderly budget travelers.

On balance, I’d probably stay here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: David R

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a good hotel right in the heart of Bangkok. Location could not be better: within a few minutes You'll be at the BTS station, a little further and you're at the metro. It's also nice talking down Si Lom and of course, visit the nearby Night Market.

However, as you are right in the heart of Bangkok consider some noises from the streets: if you seek a complete quite Hotel, go somewhere else,... But if you're okay with city noises, this is the place to be. Breakfast is sufficient, could be a little better but it's enough to start a good day. Staff is extremely nice and helpful: they gladly help you find reliable taxi drivers to take you around.

I had very nice days in Bangkok - also thanks to the excellent location of this hotel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stefan Hosemann

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice hotel, the breakfast is in my top preferences and I have travelled a lot in many countries. The staff was very kind and we even got an upgraded room (it was low season), and the room was cleaned daily and was very clean (the housekeepers deserve praise!). I liked the toilet functions, the internet was ok and we slept well (despite the reknowned Thai stiff beds and the warm blankets, it is the same everywhere) so nothing to complain here. There is tea and coffee in the rooms and charging plugs next to the bed, but keep in mind that Thai hotels usually dom't have iron boards in room so prepare for that.
sample_reviews_en.author: DianaAngela C

sample_reviews_en.text: I was charged by the dirt of bed sheet, pillow and blanket cover and I think I washable so I told them I can clean by my hand with soap and I went to my room to wash all dirt perfectly. When they check all dirt is gone but they charge me about smelly room 500 THB which it is unfair do I have to wipe the room and use air refresher spray by myself? I have already gave tip to housekeeper and it is her duty to do it. But everything room and location is perfect. Therefore, I think I will not book this hotel again be cause there are many good hotel in Silom and Sathorn.
sample_reviews_en.author: Watcharaphong Singtana

sample_reviews_en.text: We booked the 1-bedroom suite and thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Friendly and helpful staff. The room was super clean, spacious, and we liked the separate shower and bath area. Tiles in the shower room get very slippery so do be extra careful. Our room was very quiet, which helped us have a good night’s sleep. Excellent location, close to a day food market / shopping alley, plenty of eating spots, bakery and bar, and walking distance to Sala Daeng BTS and Si Lom MRT. Steak at the on site restaurant was great for the price!
sample_reviews_en.author: Y Johan

sample_reviews_en.text: Very central (10min walk to train stations and bus stop right outside). Rooms are really big and comfortable. Great value for money and good selection of breakfast included. The service was above and beyond particular after checkout when they looked after our luggage before we flew out that night at midnight. Was also able to come back after a day of exploring and shower (with towels and toiletries provided) before heading to the airport for our flight. Would stay again
sample_reviews_en.author: Simone Boniface

sample_reviews_en.text: Since it was my fourth time in Bangkok I wanted to try a different neighbourhood for this visit. We had heard great things about Silom so wanted to give it a try. We found this nice hotel and it was a perfect choice! Clean rooms, nice location, good AC (very  needed in April). They also have a nice pool which we didn’t have time to use, but it’s a good to have for a quick break from the city chaos, especially with the heat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jessica Kurtz

restaurants.name: Steak Lao
restaurants.address:

ซอยอุดมสุข 16 Bang Na Nuea, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: My experience at Steak Lao was extremely disappointing. The iced lemon tea I ordered was cloyingly sweet, practically undrinkable, and I ended up just drinking water. The stir-fried eggs with leaves were even worse, so salty it tasted like pickled vegetables—completely unbalanced. I had to ask them to cancel and remake it. It was obvious they didn't remake it; they just took it back and processed it a bit. When they brought it back, it was even worse—not saltier, but still much uglier. There were quite a few customers, but the quality of the food clearly didn't match the popularity. Given this level of quality, it's absolutely not worth a special trip. Those who haven't been can skip this. Three dishes, a bowl of rice, and an overly sweet iced lemon tea cost 635 baht. For that price, you could get a much better meal elsewhere. Avoid this place! Avoid this place! Avoid this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jake Wang

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant in the Udom Suk area offers a diverse menu of various cuisines.

But I highly recommend trying their Jaew Hon (spicy dipping sauce) 👍🏻👍🏻
They have two broth options: Jaew Hon soup and black shabu-shabu soup.
There are three dipping sauces: Jaew (spicy dipping sauce), seafood, and sukiyaki.
The flavors are well-balanced and delicious.

Other dishes like their Laotian papaya salad and Laotian steak are also excellent 😋

The portions are just right, and the prices are reasonable.

Parking is available right in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: MuayLek

sample_reviews_en.text: This Thai restaurant in the Udom Suk area offers a wide variety of Thai and Northeastern Thai (Isaan) dishes. The flavors are bold, the ingredients are fresh, the atmosphere is comfortable, the service is friendly, and the prices are reasonable for the quality. It's another great value restaurant with delicious food. Recommended dishes include pork ribs, Jaew Hon (spicy dipping sauce), Lao-style stir-fried steak with chili, and sour fish curry with sea bass. We ate so much we didn't even have time to take pictures!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattana Pong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The lotus stem sour curry is amazing, the curry paste is rich and flavorful. The honey-glazed ribs are so tender the meat falls off the bone.
The stir-fried Gnetum leaves with egg are made with tender, non-tough leaves, giving them a wonderful wok aroma.
The garlic pork is delicious; I recommend telling them you don't want it dry for softer pork.
For drinks, I recommend the Thai tea, it's rich and flavorful.
It's a shame they no longer have the zongzi and bingsu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Iam Nrokan

sample_reviews_en.text: I have given it 5 stars as all in all I could not fault the food and service much if at all. The north style curry was super. The cheese spinach wontons were the best ever. We had loads of other stuff as you can see in the pictures, we went a bit over board and ended up taking a doggy bag home. We spent almost 1,000 which was less than I was expecting. And that included the lovely wife having crab meat at 320. Very good all round.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Smith

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The restaurant atmosphere is nice, and the staff provides good service.
- The food is delicious; the winged bean salad is especially tasty 😋
- The steak is quite tender and flavorful. The papaya salad is delicious; it would look better if it were served on a larger (vegetable) plate or dish rather than a bowl.
- The curry felt a bit too full, perhaps because I've never had it before 😅
- The side vegetables are fresh and clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: yammy takiko

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time here, I found it using Google Maps. I just realized they have a very diverse menu, but I specifically came to try the Jaew Hon (spicy dipping sauce). I'll save the other dishes for another time. I ordered the fresh sea bass fillet, which was very fresh and beautifully presented. The Jaew Hon soup was excellent. The staff provided good service and the prices were reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaweekai Chok

sample_reviews_en.text: If you’re looking for a place with a massive selection, Steak Lao delivers. The variety of menu items is huge, ranging from their signature steaks to local favorites. It’s a perfect spot for groups because even the pickiest eaters will find something they like. Best of all, it doesn’t break the bank. Highly recommend for a budget-friendly but delicious dinner!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ben C

restaurants.name: Prik-Yuak
restaurants.address:

108 Pradiphat Rd, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I went to Prik Yawk restaurant 🌶️🫑. The Southern Thai food was incredibly delicious 🥕🥕🥕. Everyone's raving about the best dish is the sticky rice with durian and coconut milk 🌟🌟. Oh my god, it was heavenly delicious 🪂🌚🌚. I want to say that the squid 🦑 was also very fresh (I loved it, hehe 🥰). The shrimp 🦐🍤 was good too, the stir-fried shrimp with chili paste was amazing 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻. The crab dip was superb!! 🦀🦀🦀 My eyes almost popped out, this review is over the top 💯💯💯. Everything was so delicious and melted in my mouth. Every dish we ordered was superb, 10/10, no deductions 🙌🏻🙌🏻🙌🏻. The only downside was the parking. We initially told them we were a group of 19 with 6 cars, but in the end, we could only park 2 cars inside the restaurant. The rest were told to park outside, which wasn't very impressive, especially since we had reserved a table in advance. The parking problem could be improved a bit, but I understand there are a lot of customers. However, a slight deduction for the parking issue would be appreciated.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanitha Sawettanan

sample_reviews_en.text:
We recently visited Prik-Yuak on Pradipat and were immediately charmed by the atmosphere. It has such a cozy, authentic feel, as if you’re dining in a well-preserved old house. The place is impeccably clean and makes for a really pleasant dining environment.
​A quick tip for those planning to visit: while they do have parking, the spaces are quite limited, so I highly recommend calling ahead to reserve both your table and a parking spot. Once we sat down, we found the food to be absolutely delicious. It’s worth noting that the menu doesn't feature any pictures, which can make choosing a bit tricky, but the portions are relatively small, which actually works in your favor—it gives you the chance to order and sample a wider variety of dishes in one sitting.
​The only thing to keep in mind is the pricing; it’s on the higher side when you consider the portion sizes. Because of this, while the quality is excellent, it’s definitely the kind of place I’d save for a special occasion rather than a regular weeknight meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pond

sample_reviews_en.text:
An excellent dining experience in Bangkok!
We dined here during our trip in March and the food was truly divine.
A Michelin-recommended restaurant serving authentic Thai cuisine, far from the touristy locales and perfect for those who want to discover authentic, traditional flavors.
The dishes are prepared with great care and sophistication, using quality ingredients and always maintaining the authentic identity of Thai cuisine. Intense, balanced flavors and preparations that are never banal.
Highly recommended for those visiting Bangkok who want to go beyond the typical tourist restaurants for an authentic, high-quality dining experience.
One of the meals we fondly remember from our trip to
Thailand!
sample_reviews_en.author: Stefano Simeone

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, beautiful clay tableware, and good service (though the staff don't smile much). However, the food is quite expensive considering the small portions and taste (the staff warned us beforehand that the dishes were small). Most of the dishes were average, leaning towards bland. Only the 'Fried Pork with Fish Sauce' was delicious. The 'Candied Banana' was excessively sweet and inedible. Parking is also limited. In summary, the restaurant is beautiful, but the price and taste don't quite justify the quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: M VIJ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was excellent at every point. The seating was good and well-organized.
However, if customers talk a lot or are loud, the sound echoes, but the restaurant helped move us to a different room.
The Southern Thai food has a flavor adapted for tourists.
My favorites were the yellow curry with koon, fried sand fish with fish sauce, spicy salted fish salad, and stir-fried Gnetum leaves with eggs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patha Thanomkul

sample_reviews_en.text: A lovely place that we booked out for a company event, and the owner herself was so kind to personally come down to oversee the dinner. She even hired a live band to play for us, which was one of the highlights of the evening. The food was delicious and served in generous portions, with a good variety of different local dishes. Would be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jonathan Chew

sample_reviews_en.text:
Expected much better, taste is mwah, menu is mwah, service is low (started at parking (fake police officer? trying to act rough, while the people he serves are customers… weird) and continued by waitresses (I ask in English, you ignore me… and dont even try…)

I guess people like to be “seen” here, but…

Is not worth the effort and/or time
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom Stravers

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm giving it 3 stars because I had high expectations. The atmosphere was nice, the staff were very attentive, and the ingredients seemed high-quality – everything appeared to be carefully selected. However, the food taste was quite …
sample_reviews_en.author: Donnapa Srijan

restaurants.name: วันวาน WanWaan.bkk
restaurants.address:

55, Phrang Phutorn, 55 Tanao soi, San Chao Pho Sua, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wanwan is a Thai restaurant that truly elevates simple dishes into something special ✨

✅The stir-fried pork with shrimp paste was outstanding aromatic, well-balanced, and unlike anything I’ve had before 🐷🔥

✅The squid stir-fried with yellow chili was amazing, perfectly spicy with fresh ingredients 🦑🌶️

✅The plum-boiled pork was also very well done, light and comforting 🍲

There’s no parking, so expect a short walk 🚶‍♂️
I found this place randomly on Google Maps because of the great reviews, and it absolutely lived up to the hype 👍

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️Highly recommended for anyone who loves authentic Thai food with a thoughtful twist
sample_reviews_en.author: Phantharee Nidngam (Yo)

sample_reviews_en.text: On our way to visit Wat Pho I stopped for lunch with my daughters at this small but lovely little restaurant in the old town, close to the temple. Although Bangkok has been considerably redeveloped in the last 30 years the area surrounding the restaurant hasn’t noticeably changed. We ordered four dishes with shared rice and drinks. The flavours were excellent as was the presentation and service. The bill for the three of us came to a surprisingly reasonable 1350 baht which was tremendous value for what we were served. I would definitely recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark S

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is a hidden gem. The food was delicious, the drinks (homemade pineapple soda & lemon honey soda) were beautifully balanced in flavour and our server was great. I was trying to explain my dietary restrictions and to make sure she understood, she brought her phone to the table to use a talk to text translate function. I would highly recommend them for a delicious meal with different flavours to what you find at the majority of restaurants that cater to tourists.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mandy Kalitsis

sample_reviews_en.text:
An absolute MUST TRY if you're in the area 🤩 Reminds me of an Italian taverna but featuring modern takes on Thai food on the menu. The Nam Tok is not to be missed, and their pork belly was incredible.

Their beer and wine selection is solid, but above all the service here was absolutely stellar. Super attentive, and very helpful

I also highly recommend just strolling around this nostalgic residential area, very close to the old town, as there are a lot of cute shops around.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anton

sample_reviews_en.text:
The place is run by a cordon blue graduate.
Chill and cozy atmosphere, with good air condition and absolutely amazing food.
We had the cabbage, stir fried shrimp and shrimp curry. Everything was meticulously prepared from very fresh produce.
The place is situated in a middle of a sleepy market and prices were a bit on the higher side. But still would recommend to try.
They also serve craft local beers, if you are into that try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Uri Torton

sample_reviews_en.text:
Quiet, local restaurant located right between the super busy Khaosan Road and the Grand Palace area. We had an amazing, home cooked meal at a very reasonable price (around €16,00 per person). The service was very attentive and kind.

Ps. The street it is located at might seem a bit too "local" and the restaurant itself might be empty, but don't let it scare you! Just come in and enjoy
sample_reviews_en.author: enrique

sample_reviews_en.text: We passed by on a chance as this is not exactly on a busy street and we are so happy we went in. The food was absolutely delicious. All the ingredients are sourced locally (from Thailand) and everything was great. The service was lovely as well. My boyfriend was also very pleased there was local beer on the menu we dis not see elsewhere :).
sample_reviews_en.author: Michaela Skácelová

sample_reviews_en.text: Super nice restaurant - very cool vibe in a quiet neighbourhood - perfect for a break between two temple visits. Staff is super welcoming - she served AND cooked for us! The grilled cauliflower is delicious and the crispy pork was excellent. Everything was natural, sourced relatively locally and made to order (don’t expect fast food!)
sample_reviews_en.author: Victor Epin

restaurants.name: Yoong Khao Hom
restaurants.address:

355 โครงการ แอมพาร์ค ห้องเลขที่ บี 101 ถนนเจริญเมือง, วังใหม่, ปทุมวัน, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
ยุ้งข้าวหอม 🌶️🍚✨

ยุ้งข้าวหอม is a modern Southern Thai spot that hits flavor without going hella spicy. I ordered the กะปิหมูผัด and it was perfectly salty, with fresh chili and onion mixed in so well—super comforting, very addictive.

The ปูม้าผัดพริก was another win. You can really taste how fresh the crab is, with a soft salty balance that doesn’t overpower the sweetness of the meat.

But the real highlight? ผัดใบเหลียงไข่. If you’re here, just order it. Very Southern Thai, done so right—simple, fragrant, and low-key the star of the meal.

Extra love to the staff for bringing me more rice when I already finished my plate but didn’t want to order another one because I was scared it’d be too much for the next dish. Thoughtful service, good vibes, great food. Would 100% come back 🤍🍽️

Follow for more
IG: a_bookies, bitelogth
sample_reviews_th.author: Amornrut Namasondhi

sample_reviews_th.text:
Very nice, delicious!! This restaurant deserved listed in bib gourmand from Michelin.

Great service, all staff are very friendly and helpful.

Normal level spicy for Kua Kling dish (คั่วกลิ้ง) is very spicy, should let them cook with less spicy.
sample_reviews_th.author: Sukhum Cheff Truengtrachitkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a relaxed atmosphere.
The service was excellent.

The stir-fried Gnetum leaves with egg were delicious; the leaves were tender and the egg was perfectly cooked, not dry. The stir-fried squid with chili and salt was also tasty, with just the right amount of flavor—perhaps not overly strong, as it was a chili and salt topping rather than stir-fried. The glass noodle salad was just okay. I'd like to try other dishes next time.

Overall, the food was delicious and I would definitely come back.

There's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, both single-serving meals and main courses.
There's parking available; you can get your parking ticket stamped with your receipt.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miaow Chong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came based on reviews because it's been awarded a Michelin star for 5 consecutive years.

The staff were attentive and provided good service.
The menu is extensive, and the prices are typical of Bangkok restaurants – 3 dishes for 900+ baht, plus VAT and service charge.

The flavors are strong and spicy; those who can't handle spicy food might need to choose their dishes carefully. The food came out quickly, and the quality is worth the price.
Personally, I can handle spicy food, but this was very hot and intense 🥵 – it depends on personal preference.

It wasn't crowded the day I went, so reservations weren't necessary.
sample_reviews_en.author: B BB

sample_reviews_en.text: I recently visited a one star Michelin Thai southern food restaurant and was left with mixed feelings. While the service was decent and the ambiance was pleasant, I found the food to be somewhat modified for a western palate. While it was certainly delicious, I couldn't help but feel like there was a lack of authenticity. On the plus side, the dishes were perfectly cooked, with a soft touch that made everything easy to eat. However, I would have liked to see more traditional Thai flavors and spices included in the dishes. Overall, while I enjoyed my meal, I was left wishing for a more authentic experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pasurachate Samorn

sample_reviews_en.text: Seeing other reviews, I have high expectations, and to be honest, I was a bit disappointed. The foods are generally ok. But that's about it, just ok. Nothing spectacular and extraordinary. The deep-fried pork belly is 85% fat. The coconut soup with bamboo shoots is bland. The chili paste with vegetables is not spicy at all and not that flavorful. The stir-fried pumpkin is the only dish that is decent. Moreover, the portion size is so small that you would need to order a few more dishes than you would have ordered in other restaurants. The service was fantastic with very attentive staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nithi Tangsirisap

sample_reviews_en.text:
The turmeric-fried sand fish was delicious! The fish was still firm despite being crispy. The Gnetum leaves tasted good. The Panang beef was tasty and tender. The Kua Kling (spicy minced pork) was also good.
The herbal drink wasn't sweet at all because the syrup was served separately, which is great for people who don't like sweet drinks.

The stir-fried mixed vegetables (with pungent herbs) tasted good but were a little too wet. It would have been perfect if it were a bit drier. I wish the curry was a little thicker.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chontisa Wetkunapaiboon

sample_reviews_en.text:
A great place to eat no matter if you’re with family, friends or as a couple. Food is delicious, restaurant is very calm, clean and spacious. We were very nicely greeted. Food is delicious, comes on single plates to share with others. We had a preset option for two, where we could choose from 3 blocks of dishes, 2 dishes of each and one beverage. The portions were sufficient!:)
We definitely recommend to pick coconut  dumplings as a dessert, it was delicious.

We paid in advance when making the reservation (990 baht)
sample_reviews_en.author: Linh Le

restaurants.name: Holey Mothership Bakery and Cafe
restaurants.address:

29 Pridi Banomyong 14 Alley, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came here during a weekday midday and it was rather empty. Shelves wise bread and pastry options were not as full. Love how the cafe is trying to emulate their name via the concept of the Hole-yness and spaceships. Water is not served so I'm not sure if it is complimentary

Price range is on the higher side and dishes are quite innovative and interesting!

🥗 Avo Fav was a green salad dish with many green herbs and a light citrusy dressing. In the middle is a multi grain sour dough bread topped with half an Avocado and a sunny side up runny egg. Would like it better if the egg was sous vide. A little dry though.
I rate: 3.5/5 🌟

🥪 My Hot Gai was a chewy bread like focaccia stuffed with chicken breast, sun dried tomatoes, cheese and pesto. The pesto really alleviates the taste profile, making it a hearty and comforting meal.
I rate: 4/5 🌟

Lemonade was refreshing and not too sour.  Cafe Latte was a good large volume too though slightly too milky to my preference.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yi Ling

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't know when this store started operating as a pet-friendly, but I never imagined having a meal with three dogs. If you're accompanied by three dogs, it's natural to eat at the table prepared outside. But I never imagined eating at a store with three puppies that had grown thickly fur. Even this store has an open kitchen, and all the employees working there wear hair caps. Is it okay for human hair to mix into food and for dog fur to mix in? Even this little one. L even built it inside the store. I had the worst experience of my life. If a rude customer entered with three dogs, the staff should have stopped the rude customer. Let's really grasp the concept. If the manager or owner sees this post, mark a pet-friendly store and only accept customers who enjoy dining with their dogs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Buddy Song

sample_reviews_en.text:
My first visit — and definitely my last.
The food is decent and the seating is comfortable. I live just three minutes away, so I was genuinely hoping this would become a convenient breakfast spot. I showered before coming.
Unfortunately, the ventilation is extremely poor. When my daughter and I left, our clothes and handbags smelled heavily of raw onions. The smell was so strong that when I got home, my partner immediately asked why we smelled like onions.
I had to shower again and wash my hair just to get rid of it, and I had to send my handbag for professional cleaning. That is simply unacceptable after a short breakfast visit.
No matter how decent the food is, leaving customers smelling like the kitchen is not okay. Very disappointing experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lita Sekarnphicha

sample_reviews_en.text:
Here is one of the best places for artisan breads. Lot of sandwiches menu. Good for breakfast.

Great ingredients come with the high price but it's really worth.
Coffees are average. if they've what so called specialty coffee, It would be great. But only scrumptious bread is enough for the hype.

Several outdoor seating. Inside several large tables. here and there tables around the place. Customer mostly come and go, not lounging for too long. Expecting families with kids, some behave, some not.

Staffs service well

Toilet located behind the large door in the back, outside and turn right.

Free wifi available

Parking space available in front. Be careful,  it's a rump over pavement to parking here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sawit Khosittham

sample_reviews_en.text:
I absolutely loved the food here. Living in Asia it’s hard to find good bread that meets the standard of a western palette, but this place delivers.

I gave the service a low rating because there were a few things that happened which I was not satisfied with.

1. The place was heavily staffed with many employees at the counter, but as we stood there I had to wave my hand multiple times to get their service at the front counter.

2. We ordered water for the table and it never arrived, so we later had to get a refund for the water which we had already purchased but never received.

Again, great food. Not great service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Betty Ford

sample_reviews_en.text: First time visit the Holey artisan. This particular shop is also the central kitchen for the other branches. Self order at the counter. The Burger (350.-) is tasty but no fries. Did not order panini as they seem a little pricy for a mostly vegetarian sandwich to cost 300-400 bath.  The pizza is square 350.-, more like a Foccacia Bread, good taste. It seem like they did not turn on the exhaust cooking stove fan, the food smell will stick to your cloth after left the place.  You can ask for free cold water otherwise they will try to sell you over price imported fancy mineral water.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pasit R

sample_reviews_en.text:
This bakery is really good for the sourdough bread. They also have some cakes and wines and other things. But I would say for me, the biggest hit from this place is really the sourdough bread - they make a good one. It's a little bit on the expensive side. But the quality is very good and I would highly recommend this place for the sourdough.

Give it a shot and see for yourself if it's for you. They also have some sort of membership program. But I don't really think it's  significant because I pretty much paid the full quoted price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wandering Free bird

sample_reviews_en.text:
I am really sad that the Super sticky cinnamon bun is no longer available.
When I'm really tired, I crave this bun so badly. It was so delicious with a cup of aromatic black coffee,
But now they have changed it to white batter and it looks so elegant.......,
The taste is delicious, but I still miss the brown sticky cinnamon rolls, which look gross and never look good.
They were not as sweet as they looked, and the cinnamon flavor was addictive.
Please come back again! I'll be waiting!
sample_reviews_en.author: kimiko oka

restaurants.name: Amorretto cafe&bistro
restaurants.address:

2909 Phatthanakan Rd, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had an amazing 10/10 meal here. We ordered a ton of food but they were so delicious I forgot to take photos.

The pizza is crunchy on the outside and soft on the inside. We ordered pesto pasta, and aglio olio pasta, and seafood risotto. Everything is aldente. The squid in the risotto is a bit chewy but it’s not a big deal. The salad was delicious, and ribeye was so soft and tender. Everything else we ordered was delicious. The pannacotta was also delicious! Not too sweet and creamy yet light!

The best place around this area for pasta, pizza, and steak!! Will definitely be back for more. :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Amy Sabpisal

sample_reviews_en.text: Amorretto Café & Bistro is such a cozy spot for delicious Italian food! The pasta was cooked perfectly with rich, authentic flavor, and the atmosphere is warm and welcoming. It’s a lovely place to come with friends and family to relax and enjoy great food together. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nurinta Diary’s

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! The taste was amazing. The room is a bit small, but it's cozy. I'd definitely come back. The staff are lovely and the service is great. The restaurant is clean. I even got a seat where I could watch the chefs prepare the food. I hope it stays open longer. 10/10/10
sample_reviews_en.author: B PaKaRa

sample_reviews_en.text: passion project of a retired businessman who wanted to bring great western food to the east side of town. large selection of western and Italian food, including pasta, gnocchi, pizza, salad, and steak. The lasagna was one of the better ones …
sample_reviews_en.author: Rick Stover

sample_reviews_en.text: As pizza lovers , i've tried it in many countries, especially in Italy. I was surprised to find that Thailand has some really good and authentic pizza places. Recently I found a café that made Pizza exactly the way I like it's perfectly …
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicky P.

sample_reviews_en.text: Tried this place after passing by often - really glad I did. Great value for the price. The classic carbonara was well-balanced and tasty, even with thick-cut bacon. The steak & wine promo (1 bottle red) was impressive good cut, nicely …
sample_reviews_en.author: Phathit Voravath

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted great, the pizza crust was delicious, and the portion sizes were good value for the price. The staff were polite and provided good service. This restaurant is perfect for hanging out with friends or family. I loved it! :)
sample_reviews_en.author: GABBie P.

sample_reviews_en.text: The pizza dough was excellent! Thin, crispy edges, not chewy. The overall taste was great. The pasta was delicious when eaten hot. If you're looking for an Italian restaurant, I highly recommend it. There's also parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Momaypiyada BS

restaurants.name: Puy Roti Lady
restaurants.address:

อาคาร Zuellig house, 1 Soi Si Lom 2, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I was thrilled to finally try the roti from the famous Puy, who's extremely active on social media. I can confirm that the roti are delicious, and I'd already tried them elsewhere, so her fame isn't just because she's pretty or floods social media, but also because her roti are amazing. I highly recommend you go and try them. She's very easy to find: take the MRT to Silom or the BTS to Salae Deng, then type "Puy Roti Lady" into Google Maps and you'll be there in less than two minutes on foot. Enjoy!
sample_reviews_en.author: Stefarang

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the most enterprising ladies on the streets of Bangkok. I absolutely love the way she rolls her dough — every piece is kneaded patiently and lovingly by her own hands. She’s truly an inspirational woman, always ready with a bright smile and never shy to pose for a photo with her fans. Her puy roti isn’t just food, it’s a little moment of joy made by someone who puts her heart into her craft.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phuntsho Norbu

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s cheap and good but a little too oily for me. I saw her around 2 years ago on social media crying about the rent or something else and she touched me a lot. She work hard to care about her family it’s not easy everyday to be on social media and work on the street like her she has my utmost respect 🫡 stay humble and strong mama. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Tasty chef

sample_reviews_en.text: Hands down the best banana roti in Bangkok. Puy makes them from homemade pandan flour daily and they fry up crisp and delicious. Banana and egg is the way to go and is recommended or whichever way you like is yummy...hot and fresh, top with choice of sauces. Puy is also extremely nice and always is happy to talk to her customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thailand Timmah

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have seen Puy Roti Lady on YT and I went to try this when I went to Lumphini Park. Wow, was it worth it. Although it is a simple dish, it's literally one of the best desserts I have ever had, and I am not exaggerating.
Stop by to try, I think you will find it a lot better than you are expecting.
sample_reviews_en.author: CLAY JR

sample_reviews_en.text: I love roti. I love eggs. I love bananas. I saw all the locals ordering this. There are other flavors but all these together topped with sweet milk and sugar were phenomenal. You can tell this lady knows what she’s doing. Her hands are fast and service is quick! Must  try when you’re in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Grace Shim

sample_reviews_en.text: Finally seen Puy the world famous Roti lady at work. Check her story on YouTube on how a young lady made it with her business. Deep respect for her. And her roti is delicious. And of course completely different of what we call a Roti back home 🙏 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrick van Wijland

sample_reviews_en.text: We have tried to come and taste these 3 years in a row , never there !!!!always on a holiday ,even though your opening hours said your would be .This has cost us time and money each time only to be disappointed your not there
sample_reviews_en.author: Carly Viney

restaurants.name: Nabezo Premium Siam Paragon
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 991ชั้นG จี20บี1 Rama I Rd, ปทุมวัน Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
An Absolute Masterclass in Shabu & Sukiyaki! If you are looking for top-tier wagyu and an immaculate dining experience in Bangkok, Nabezu at Siam Paragon is a must-visit.

From the moment we walked in, the service was nothing short of impeccable—attentive, warm, and seamlessly professional throughout the meal. The staff truly elevates the dining experience, ensuring everything is handled with care.

As for the food, the meat quality is simply outstanding. Every slice of beef was impeccably marbled, melting in your mouth with every single bite, and paired brilliantly with their flavorful broths and dipping sauces.

Whether you're taking a break from shopping or planning a dedicated culinary night out, Nabezu delivers on every front. I would highly recommend this place to anyone craving premium hot pot in Bangkok. Five stars all around! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
sample_reviews_en.author: Aaron Heng

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely not recommended. The crab was so bad I almost threw up. It didn't taste fresh, and everything was incredibly salty. It's a risk for kidney disease. Paying 8,000 baht was totally worth it; the food was worth less than 2,000 baht. The frozen crab at this restaurant made me want to vomit almost immediately; it was so greasy and lacked any sweetness. They exaggerate a lot. I recommend eating at restaurants that serve fresh, live crabs; absolutely avoid frozen crab – it's incredibly fishy. Frozen king crab is nothing compared to Thai crab, which tastes much better.
sample_reviews_en.author: อุเทน ภูริวุฒิโภคิน

sample_reviews_en.text: Two of us ordered the All You Can Eat Wagyu Buffet, which included both shabu-shabu and sukiyaki. We got to try Japanese F1 Beef, including Chuck Roll and Shoulder Clod, and the quality was excellent. The price included appetizers, hot/cold tea, and desserts. What we liked was that ordering plain rice came with flavorful minced beef as a side dish. Overall, we enjoyed it.
sample_reviews_en.author: N N (Pom)

sample_reviews_en.text: This shabu-shabu restaurant in the heart of the city also serves complimentary appetizers. The pork, fish, vegetables, and the minced shrimp meatballs are all incredibly delicious. My first time here was a great experience. The atmosphere is nice and not crowded, the prices are reasonable, and the quality and service are excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mhuay Gade

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! Great service. The food was excellent, high quality, the meat was top-notch. I used my KTC points to get a 50% discount, paying only half the price. Such great value! My first time eating here and I was very impressed. I will definitely come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Muchima Kaerattana

sample_reviews_en.text: The ingredients served were excellent. The meat was tender and in large pieces, and the crab legs were full of flavor (recommended to order the crab in advance as it takes time to prepare each plate). It's a shame there wasn't any seafood …
sample_reviews_en.author: Wittaya M

sample_reviews_en.text: This is perfect for those who like Momo restaurant but want a more premium experience in terms of meat, desserts, service, and dipping sauces. However, there's no coffee or soft drinks available. The price is quite high, but you get …
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakit Ussavaponganant

sample_reviews_en.text: The meat was excellent, the best I've ever had in Thailand, comparable to Japan. The staff were incredibly attentive, like princesses; I didn't even have to move. The atmosphere was great, private, and not crowded.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pepe thita

restaurants.name: Cute Pig Korean BBQ พัทยา
restaurants.address:

24, 58 โลตัสพัทยา หมู่ที่ 5 Sukhumvit Pattaya 53, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food was fresh, Staff was mostly friendly and alert,
It a good offer on food for 399thb
Unfortunately the Service from behind the scene (Galley) is not so good as the amounts of ordered Food does not match the pictures in the menu, you'll never know how much you get from someting you ordered except you order everything single wise. Otherwise you'll get the amount the galley staff sent, sometimes more sometimes less.

Recommendation to the Manager;
Create a Menu with pictures with exact the amount of food which will be served as 1 set.
For example... 3 Shrimps on the picture means if I order 3x I receive 9 shrimps.
sample_reviews_en.author: Heiko Schulze

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is another restaurant that I was very impressed with 💖
The food is delicious, every dish tastes great, the ingredients are fresh, and what I loved most is the wide variety of sauces to choose from, which makes eating never boring. Each sauce has its own unique flavor, adding to the fun of eating 🍽️✨

Another thing I really liked was the service from the staff 💯
The staff constantly came to change the grill pan, making sure not to let the pan get blackened or burnt, ensuring the food tasted great. They pay attention to even the smallest details, which is fantastic 🔥
sample_reviews_en.author: รีวิวไปเรื่อยถ้าอร่อย

sample_reviews_en.text: Not recommended. It is a cheap imitation of Korean-style food served indoors at the price of Mookata eaten outside on a hot day. I think I know why there are hardly any Koreans there. I wish Thai people would try authentic Korean barbecue. Please put in more effort.
sample_reviews_en.author: 제이제이

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food, great service, and plenty of parking. They have a wide variety of dishes at affordable prices. I highly recommend this branch! You'll definitely be impressed. 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Note Channel

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! The seating was comfortable with no time limit. The ice cream was amazing, and the staff provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pharnutchargorn Yukhoonthon

sample_reviews_en.text: We waited in line for almost an hour, but the food came out quickly, it was delicious, and the meat was very fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: thippawan mathon

sample_reviews_en.text: Korean BBQ place with a great atmosphere and lovely staff who constantly change the grill for you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zane

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was incredibly fresh and delicious.
The service was excellent and very impressive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phetto FF

restaurants.name: Bully's Bangkok
restaurants.address:

8 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice atmosphere, liked the ambiance, had an amazing sharing platter (see pics) which was delish, but it has drawbacks! First beer, I ordered a Singha. At the same time there was a Tiger beer mistakenly delivered to another nearby table, which was rejected by the occupant as it wa duplicate . It then arrived to me having traversed its journey via the bar from whence it came. Now, 1: I have no problem with Tiger beer. Actually I Iike It, and 2: I understand sometimes there are issues when drinks are duplicated or human error is a factor. But please don’t mug me off with someone else’s beer when I’ve seen what occurred and wasn’t even asked if I was ok with a swap of beers! Be honest!
The food was good and portion size was ample and reasonably priced for the Sukhumvit area, but at 175 Baht (Feb 2020 prices) a pint... well you judge for yourself.  The toilets when used were clean and acceptable, staff were friendly and accommodating so no issues there. Two of us however were bitten alive at lower leg level by mozzies / fleas so that wasn’t good. Hefty prices for a mediocre experience. Make your own decision on this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brendan Gorman

sample_reviews_en.text: I have seen and been told about this place for years. We are stuck in Bangkok a few extra days, so we decided to give it a try. David Bowie was playing over the speakers. This automatically scores points for the atmosphere. The interior is like most sports bars. Flat screens and a pool table with nicely stocked bar. Staff is pleasant. Large menu with Thai, Mexican, and pub grub. They also have breakfast all day. We ordered a Caesar salad and mushroom soup for starters. As you can see from our photos, they were very good. Dare I say, Bully's makes the best Caesar salad I have had outside my restaurant. My wife ordered Pat Kee Mao, which is a spicy Thai seafood pasta. I ordered salmon with potato and peas. The food came out in good time. Nothing rushed. I'm under doctors orders and would never think about ordering salmon unless I was eating sushi. Our food was wonderful. So happy we came in. I will be telling everyone I know about Bully's
sample_reviews_en.author: Modell Bleu

sample_reviews_en.text:
If I could give zero stars I would but I'll give 2 stars for atmosphere only.
Service is terrible! We waited over 25 minutes to receive our garlic bread which was cold and stale, our rib-eye steaks took even longer to be brought out and were also cold. The only thing on the plate that was warm was the pepper sauce! My partner ordered her steak well done and she received it rare. Presentation of the meal was the only positive experience. Sadly that does not make up for everything else.
We are currently sitting at the table and have been waiting for over 30 minutes for our desserts...  Oh it just got presented!! ONE desert when we ordered TWO. And my drink that I ordered never arrived!
So for 1 water, 1 Johnny red, 1 cold garlic bread and 2 cold steaks it still cost me 1975.90baht and that was AFTER a discount.
First time in, and it will most certainly be the last time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Atkinson

sample_reviews_en.text:
This the place for having a close to perfection Buffalo hot wings in Bangkok.
Clean, orderly, and  well-managed restaurant bar, a stone-throw from either Nana or Ploen Chit BTS stations. Plenty of beer choices on tap and in bottles and a perfectly stocked bar with almost all kind of spirits. The beer is cold and the "smoking" hot wings - as seen in the video- are perfectly done, served with the proper fixing of carrots, celery and blue cheese dip, no-less of what you get at a good place in Buffalo-NY. Perhaps this is one of very few - if not the only place that provide a wet-nap to clean one's hand after the tackling the wings. Add to that the  outstanding fast and professional service with the biggest smile, and you are in for a happy experience.
Highly recommended if you are in the area or you like buffalo wings.
sample_reviews_en.author: Richard Chichakli

sample_reviews_en.text:
Bully's is a great restaurant in the heart of Bangkok.  Friend and I had the pork ribs, one large order and one small order.  Both came with the usual coleslaw and a large portion of fries.  Ribs were lovely and tender, fall off the bone meat.  Lovely and very tasty BBQ sauce. Also ordered chicken satays which came with a very tasty peanut sauce, and some onion rings which we enjoyed very much.  Atmosphere is great with lovely and attentive  staff. Only downside is that it is on the expensive side and probably more tourists than locals eat here.  Can't afford to eat here every night.  Enjoyed two 1 litre glasses of local beer as well.  Will definitely return next trip!
Highely recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Vakhtang Japaridze

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing staff, great food and perfect place to chill! Annie helped to get the chef to make my Thai fried rice to spicy perfection as per my request, created an INCREDIBLE sauce (her own recipe) for fries and was great to have a chat with. Perfect place to chill if you're craving American, Tex-Mex or Thai classics food wise. Extensive drinks menu, pool table in the indoor seating area, clean bathrooms. Went there twice to get my fix of drinks and food in the span of 7 days. Says a lot as food in Thailand everywhere is fantastic. The relaxed vibe and kind staff made me revisit the night before I flew out. Highly reccomend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lavina Datwani

sample_reviews_en.text: Glad I stopped by for a bit to eat. The staff was very friendly with good English. There is a pool table in the back and there is both indoor (AC) and outdoor (smoking section) seating available. The staff was attentive and paid attention to what we wanted. The background music was very nice, not too loud but loud enough to be able to hear the lyrics. I did not see any room for car parking as it is right on Sukhumvit road, but it was only a 5 minute walk from Phloen Cit BTS station.  The beers were cold and the food was good. They do have a Thai food menu for those so inclined.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're near Nana Square and looking for a place with great food and a laid-back vibe, Bully’s Bangkok is a must-visit! The atmosphere is perfect—not too loud, just right for relaxing.

Tried their chicken wings and fried shrimp, and they were absolutely delicious! The staff was super quick and attentive, making the experience even better. Bonus points for the pool table.

Whether you're grabbing a bite or just unwinding with friends, this spot is highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sajan Ponnappa

restaurants.name: WESELL KOREA MART ( PATTAYA ) & BUNSIK JOAH 위셀코리아마트(본점)&분식좋아
restaurants.address:

8/112 Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Wesell Korea Mart & Bunsik Joah in Pattaya is a practical choice for Korean snacks and prepared meals. The kimbap rolls are a highlight, offering good value as they are both cheap and fresh with an authentic sesame oil flavor. The menu is extensive, providing a wide variety of options beyond the rolls. For dining, they offer both indoor and outdoor seating areas. Service is efficient and helpful, and there is plenty of parking available. It is worth noting that the toilet is located on the opposite side of the car park from the main building. Overall, it is a reliable spot for a quick and affordable meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay Roams Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the opportunity to try at Wesell Pattaya Bunsik Set, which is a combination of sundae, tteokbokki, and kimmari. The flavors were absolutely delicious, with each element complementing the other perfectly. The spicy kick of the tteokbokki, paired with the savory sundae and crispy kimmari, created a balanced and flavorful meal. The portion size was generous, making it a great value for the price. If you’re in Pattaya and looking for an authentic Korean street food experience, I highly recommend giving this set a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kim Driana

sample_reviews_en.text: I finally got to visit this store. Having lived in Korea for 23 years I found many of the Korean foods that I used to like. They had the sauce to make bulgogi and kalbi, but unfortunately they didn't have fresh or frozen Korean beef or pork.  Overall the best place to find Korean goods in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jim Davidson

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is great. If you love Korean food or you just need to buy some special Korean dishes or tools this is the place for you. Not only they have dried food, but also they have frozen and canned. Different kind of Korean products too, from shampoo to face masks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Janusz Daga

sample_reviews_en.text: Love to buy some Korean snacks here, it’s much better than the regular Thai snacks. Last visit we tried the Korean coin desert which is basically a pancake with some cheese. Pretty good and worth it. Staff are nice and helpful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dor Haim

sample_reviews_en.text: My favorite shop to buy Korean goods!! They mostly sell food and snacks but also have other Korean products such as utensils and accessories. The shop is well kept and has great Service! And the food is also delicious😋😋 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Imthe Bunnyboi

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place for Korean products, probably the biggest selection in Pattaya. Great staff and service. On the flip side, their homemade kimchi was disappointing and so was the ramen soup at the small restaurant inside.
sample_reviews_en.author: chinu nam

sample_reviews_en.text: Currently my favorite shop to purchase Korean goods. They mostly sell food and snacks but also have other Korean products such as utensils and accessories. The shop is well kept and has great Service!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yawarakai O.

restaurants.name: Nuatair Meeting Mall
restaurants.address:

594 Charan Sanitwong 94 Alley, Bang O, Bang Phlat, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a halal restaurant offering steak and beef dishes, conveniently located at Meeting Mall.
We love their fried chicken cashew nut salad and order this dish almost every month. It’s always cooked to perfection; the chicken is crispy, the salad is spicy and sweet and it’s topped with a perfectly runny egg. Highly recommend trying this item! Their Pad Kra Pao (Minced Beef Stir Fry) is also delicious! 🤌🏻
However, we didn’t enjoy their burgers. The Ronin Angus Burger was a regular plain burger and for 290 baht, it isn’t anything special. The Beef Burger with Fried Onion Ring, unfortunately, doesn’t come together taste wise. It has a perilla leaf which doesn’t taste good and the fried onion ring is too thick, lacks salt and spices, and ruins the bite, ultimately ruining the dining experience. The iced lemon tea is very refreshing and without it we couldn’t have finished our sad burgers. It would be great if the kitchen staff modifies and refines the burger recipes.
All that said, I’m still grateful for getting halal meals from this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tahmina Begum

sample_reviews_en.text: When you think of Bang Aor district, you know it's home to a large Muslim community. Today, we dined at a Muslim-owned restaurant, and we were impressed by its cleanliness and unique flavors. Located in the Meeting Mall, we indulged in their perfectly grilled steak, cooked to rare perfection. The tenderness and juiciness of the meat, along with its rich flavor, were outstanding. It's not crowded here, and parking is available. If you're craving delicious steak, this is a great option. Plus, you can earn points for your next meal with their loyalty program, where 10 Baht equals 1 point. I highly recommend giving it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: TEERUT PROMMART

sample_reviews_en.text: I was curious to try one of their mandi dishes as it was all I hear from one of my local friends who decided to go for Angus beef steak.  Mandi was nicely cooked with very tender meat that melts in the mouth.  I thought the served portion is smaller than the usual, but it was sufficient for me.  In general, normal dishes are adequately priced, however, the steak was somehow forcibly marketed to my friend who asked for my approval in an embarrassing way that I couldn't say no.  From what I was told, it was very tasty and perfectly cooked.
sample_reviews_en.author: Husain AlHusaini (Husain_Tula)

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were only interested in walk-in customers, not delivery riders. When a rider arrived and gave their order number, the staff told them to wait. We waited outside for 15 minutes. When we looked at the table, there was a bag of food left there. We went to check, and only then did the staff realize they needed to send our order. The food was ready, but they hadn't pressed "send" to update the status on the app. We just kept waiting. The staff were too busy opening and closing doors. "Hello, taking orders, service like royalty!"
sample_reviews_en.author: Paweena Permsakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went for a meal at 12:30 PM, and the restaurant was completely unprepared. They said they only had Thai food and smash burgers available, and even salad wasn't on the menu. They also mentioned there was only one person in the kitchen. It took until after noon to get all my food.
The steak also required waiting for the grill to preheat, and they only had two dishes available.
I ordered the minced beef stir-fry, but they didn't have that either.
Yet the restaurant opens at 10:00 AM.
I hope they improve.
sample_reviews_en.author: chanita dechma

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is cute, clean, and has an open kitchen. The staff are polite, friendly, and answer questions well. The food is delicious. The Mundi fried rice with braised beef is amazing; the beef is real and very fragrant. The basil beef stir-fry is a little too sweet. The Tom Yum soup is flavorful but not too spicy. The steak is tender, and the sauce is fragrant and delicious. The meatballs with ketchup are good. There's plenty of parking, which is convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Navakamon Shop

sample_reviews_en.text: "Nuea Tae by To Silly Fool, Bang O branch, is located in Meeting Mall, clearly visible from the front. There's plenty of parking inside, which is a collection of shops and restaurants. The restaurant has many tables and a small private dining room. Food prices start at 135 baht. Beef basil stir-fry, a 200g steak is approximately 369 baht, mashed potatoes are 69 baht. (Jan 25) The overall taste is sweet, in To's style, but delicious. Give it a try!"
sample_reviews_en.author: Tang Raksat

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! Large portions, amazing flavor. The beef in the curry was incredibly tender. I really wanted to try the braised beef mandi, but they were out of braised beef. Too bad! I'll definitely call ahead next time to make sure to check. The restaurant atmosphere is great, the aroma of beef filled the whole place. So satisfying!
sample_reviews_en.author: 1 9 9 X

restaurants.name: ทองเหลืองหมูกระทะ สาขา รัชดา ชอย3
restaurants.address:

Soi Ratchadaphisek 3, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Easy to get to, there's parking but it's a short walk. The atmosphere in the restaurant is great.
Both dipping sauces are delicious. The food is fresh, clean, and high quality.
The staff are very polite, always smiling, and provide excellent service, constantly refilling vegetables and water, which made me feel a little embarrassed!

The udon is good, a must-order. The coconut ice cream is also very delicious.
This has become one of my favorite restaurants! 💖
sample_reviews_en.author: pyn :

sample_reviews_en.text: The dipping sauce tastes delicious, but the staff are unhelpful and inattentive. You have to get the dipping sauce yourself when it runs out, and you have to keep calling them when the soup is finished. They barely even look at you, despite the service charge. I haven't been going there much lately because of the terrible service.
sample_reviews_en.author: BM

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐ Rating 4
📍 Ratchadaphisek Soi 3 (near MRT Phra Ram 9)
💰 Price: Approximately 400–600 THB
🕛 Open daily 12:00–23:00
Highlights include beautiful decor, a cafe-like atmosphere, use of brass pans, high-quality ingredients, homemade bacon, and free refills of cabbage.
The original dipping sauce is incredibly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naja LoveTravel&Cooking

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is good, but the price per set isn't cheap. The meat is okay though. There are drink promotions in the evening.

It's an air-conditioned BBQ restaurant, but there's no proper smoke management system. It's like eating surrounded by smoke from every table's grill that isn't properly ventilated.
sample_reviews_en.author: New

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food, great atmosphere, cool air-conditioned seating inside.
The bacon was incredibly delicious, because I usually don't like bacon. The staff had excellent service minds, very impressed. Will definitely go again. The only downside is that parking is in a separate area.
sample_reviews_en.author: New World

sample_reviews_en.text: I liked the vibes; it was chill, like having a BBQ at a friend's house. Everything was good. The staff were good, fast, and polite, although some of them spoke a bit confusingly, like they didn't understand me very well, haha.
sample_reviews_en.author: Janejne K

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the bacon was tasty, all the pork dishes were delicious, the desserts were excellent. The staff provided very good service. We ate in an air-conditioned room, so there was no smoke smell at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akkrauwd Nganvithee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I ate with six friends. We ordered two sets and were very full. The taste was good and the price was cheap, which we liked.
The only downside is there's no parking, so we had to park in the building in …
sample_reviews_en.author: Lalichat Charoennitiboonsiri

restaurants.name: Salvia
restaurants.address:

M Floor, Grand Hyatt Erawan Bangkok, 494 Ratchadamri Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Salvia Italian Restaurant is a standalone restaurant located on the M floor of the Grand Hyatt Erawan Hotel. The decor is casual yet luxurious.
It gets very crowded in the evenings,
but if you arrive after 2 PM, there are plenty of tables available and the service is excellent.
They serve premium cuisine,
popular with affluent young people who enjoy informal gatherings and parties.
The menu offers a complete range of Italian dishes, including steaks,
pizza, soups, and salads, all made with carefully selected, high-quality ingredients for a delicious and clean taste. The staff are welcoming, well-trained, and able to recommend dishes effectively.
I ordered a Medium Rare steak;
the meat was perfectly grilled, tender and not chewy. The Caesar salad had fresh vegetables and a well-balanced dressing. The truffle spaghetti had a lovely aroma and came with freshly baked bread served with olive oil and vinegar – a perfect combination.
The fruit platter was beautifully arranged and customers could choose their own fruit.
For foodies who have the opportunity to visit the Grand Hyatt Erawan Hotel,
don't forget to stop by!
sample_reviews_en.author: Atiwat Sinrachatanant

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good food, exceptional service
My husband and I were fortunate to celebrate our 40th Anniversary at Salvia. The food was good, the service was exceptional! Both Noi and Aof went out of their way to make us comfortable. Upon learning it was our anniversary, they even presented us with a hand-written card, along with a commemorative photo, and, a special dessert. Then, because they knew we were nervous about getting back to our hotel (my husband is in a wheelchair and Bangkok presents accessibility challenges), Noi personally escorted us back! She and Aof are assets to both Salvia, and the Hyatt universe.
sample_reviews_en.author: Randall Riese

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere at this restaurant is amazing! I went for my birthday and they gave me a cheesecake and even took a Polaroid photo for me. The staff were so lovely, especially Mint and Oui, who took such good care of me. I couldn't finish my Eggplant Parmigiana and asked to take it home in a box, and they gave me a brand new piece! Thank you so much, I was very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ling Lings

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was nice, not too crowded the day I went. There were plenty of photo opportunities. I had the set lunch, which allowed me to choose my dishes, and the price was reasonable. Overall, the food was delicious, but sometimes it was difficult to get the attention of the staff as they didn't always come to the corner tables.
sample_reviews_en.author: ᄋᄉᄋ

sample_reviews_en.text: We celebrated a birthday here and had a wonderful experience. The food was excellent, the ambiance was lovely, and the service was outstanding. Special thanks to Khun Mint, Khun Few, Khun Aof, and the entire team for being so welcoming and attentive. They also surprised us with a complimentary birthday cake
sample_reviews_en.author: nuttha patihan

sample_reviews_en.text: Decided to book this restaurant for anniversary date night and not disappointed at all. The food was good, high quality and didn’t expect the focaccia (complimentary) will be this good. All staffs are polite, friendly and always willing to help. It’s perfect for couples date dinner or special occasions.
sample_reviews_en.author: I love good food very much

sample_reviews_en.text: I had lunch at the restaurant today and ordered beef carpaccio, vongole pasta and squid ink pasta with Boston lobster. Beef carpaccio was very nice. The lobster was fresh and tasty. The vongole, however, was very salty. The waitress was …
sample_reviews_en.author: David Wong

sample_reviews_en.text: If you are searching for the perfect Tiramisu in Bangkok, look no further than Salvia at the Grand Hyatt Erawan. After struggling to find a good version of this dessert elsewhere, we came here specifically for it, and it was absolutely …
sample_reviews_en.author: Miriam Isaac

restaurants.name: PARK SATHORN RESTAURANT
restaurants.address:

24 Chuea Phloeng 2 Alley, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was nice, the food was mediocre, nothing amazing, and the service was terrible. The staff seemed unwilling to serve, and they served the wrong dish. They did correct it by changing the plate, but when I first asked, they acknowledged and said they would inform the staff, but never followed up to say anything about the correction. I was so confused and didn't know what to do next that I didn't dare eat it. I had to ask for an update on the food and what needed to be done. There were hardly any customers; only two tables were occupied. If it were busy, I understand, but there were practically no customers. The service was so bad that when I called for service repeatedly, they got annoyed and made faces. When I asked about the menu, they seemed reluctant to sell anything, acting clueless and confused. #This is an honest review. They should train their staff better, especially since I was paying for the service.
sample_reviews_en.author: admin ann

sample_reviews_en.text:
Beautiful place! I was in awe when I stepped in! The gardening and landscaping of this place is next level. The first time we came staff was very sweet and attentive. I have a severe nut allergy and the chef came out himself to make sure everything was right. The ambience is amazing and they also perform a cultural dance performance.

Our second visit we came when it was pouring rain, so outside seating was not available - worth to make note of if you want the full experience. Inside dining was fine for us as we just wanted the amazing food. Staff seemed a bit more irritated which is a shame, but they still were helpful with my allergens and prepared a safe (and amazingly tasty!) meal. So for that I am very thankful.

Amazingly beautiful place, come here if you have peanut/nut allergy but still want to eat Thai food!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattelatte

sample_reviews_en.text:
A beautiful place and definitely worth a visit!
It’s not the cheapest attraction by Thai standards, but I wouldn’t consider it expensive either, especially considering how beautiful and well-maintained the place is. The surroundings are peaceful, with beautiful scenery and plenty of photo opportunities.
It’s a great place to slow down, enjoy nature and escape the busy streets of Bangkok for a while. We really enjoyed the experience and would definitely recommend it! 🇹🇭❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: JC

sample_reviews_en.text:
A restaurant with tropical plants and shade from trees like banyan trees. It's cool thanks to the misting system.

This cafe and restaurant is filled with plants and serves solid Italian and Thai food, with a wide variety of drinks and cakes. It's a popular spot with private rooms, birds, and even traditional shows at certain times.

Even those who don't like air conditioning can enjoy a cool and relaxing time here.

The chicken breast and spinach was delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: TOTAL RICH

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere was amazing! I was impressed from the moment I stepped in. It felt like dining in a Greek-Roman style restaurant – beautiful, luxurious, and charming ✨
It's perfect for bringing your parents or family to dine together. The atmosphere is relaxed yet feels special. The food is delicious, and it's even more enjoyable to dine together as a family.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prinda Ruayfupant

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was great, the garden area was beautifully landscaped, and the staff were very attentive. There was a wide variety of food to choose from, and the Thai tea was delicious. The meeting room was spacious, beautifully decorated, and the staff provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarin .P

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is great, the flavors are well-adapted to Thai tastes and shouldn't be a problem for foreigners either. The atmosphere is fantastic, but the signage indicating which building is for the bakery and which is for the coffee is a bit confusing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chairat Jinanun

sample_reviews_en.text: It was late afternoon when we arrive and didnt manage to get our reservation. But we have been accommodated immediately and offer a good spot for us. They have both indoor and outdoor seating, we opt to stay outdoor as the weather is quite …
sample_reviews_en.author: Jan Vincent Cullano

sample_reviews_en.text:
We are so surprised and happy to be here at Nara Korean BBQ restaurant. All the dishes that we order are superb! "Delicious & Valued," and we love Murray Friut tea!! Once we enter the restaurant, the staffs are very friendly to welcome you and immediately serve cool water.

Definitely recommend this RESTAURANT to anyone who wants to eat Korean BBQ, AND YES!!! WE WILL BACK FOR SURE!
sample_reviews_en.author: Shilin Kanishthanaga

sample_reviews_en.text: Yesterday I had dinner in this restaurant. I feel like home because the service is best and the owner always gave me free foods so many .We ate the BBQ beef stallion and pork all the meats are fresh ,juicy and yummy and kimchi soup and bimbimbad is perfect taste .today I go back to my country next time if I visit to bkk I surely go again to this restaurant, 🥰🥰🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Crystal Zaw

sample_reviews_en.text: If you love authentic Korean BBQ this is worth a visit. Great friendly atmosphere but the staff and management are world class, everything refilled immediately no waiting no need to ask, the staff are fully focused on making the experience enjoyable and food was delicious. No frills just very authentic with perfect service and great food x
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Pirie

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice Korean food with reasonable prices. We ordered 4 dishes but got free many veggies sidedishes (and they refilled it often). Very nice and enthusiastic staffs. At the end they offered a steam eggin hot pot but we are too full so we couldn't finish it. They packed the food for take away.. Thank you, I will go back again for sure!
sample_reviews_en.author: varisa sawatdimongkol

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great food from typical Korean grill. Very attentive staff- they saw we were struggling with spacing our food on the grill so staff helped us without hesitation. They also refilled our kimchi and pickles every time we were running low on these.
Will be back! Although, kimchi soup wasn’t my favourite. Egg soufflé amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dominik Jurasz

sample_reviews_en.text:
Best bbq restaurant I ever tried. Many king of meat and side dishes. We went there two times in a week. Meat was tender and the girls helped us to cook it well.
Water is free and the owner gave us a free soup both of the time. Rice is also free so you can ask for it.
I love this place....it's really wonderful
sample_reviews_en.author: alessandra muraro

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ve been to many Korean bbqs and I must say this place is a gem 😍😍 my family and I were so thankful and happy to have found it, very nice staff, the owner is extremely nice 😊 and the beef 🥩 oh goodness it’s amazing! It melts in your mouth! And the sides are pretty great as well. Definitely coming back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Roxana Rodriguez

sample_reviews_en.text:
Enough parking spaces, easy to find.

One of the very few Korean restaurants in Thailand that are authentic, reasonably priced, and ethical.
The owner and staff are kind and attentive.

If you are Korean, you know this shop doesn't try to save cost on ingredients.
Highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yong Kim

very disappointed for a resturant in thailand ( even if it is just a salad ) i had 3 items ( i belive i opted out the free stuff as well such as the vegetable items ) instead of being generous they just gave the minimum QTTY
i asked for mixed salad , i still got the option of romain lettuce, 60 grams of rice and tuna u picked which is ok ..
