sample_reviews_en.text:
One of my go-to healthy food spots in Bangkok. Perfect for busy days when you want something fresh, filling and still healthy. The ingredients always taste fresh and the portions are actually satisfying. Love stopping here after errands or coffee runs around Thonglor.

The Marche Thonglor branch has such a nice vibe too and the staff are always friendly ✨

Also shared more on my Instagram @bangkok_baddie 🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: Natasha Chawla

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a very nice SaladStop in an even nicer shopping center. It has the same menu and consistent quality as the one in EMSPHERE. It’s tasty, well proportioned and served, and the service is solid. I would have come here more often if it was closer to me. As an added bonus, it’s right next to Rise Coffee for a great espresso and pastry after your healthy lunch!
sample_reviews_en.author: Felipe Latorre

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely loved this place!
Everything is super fresh, and the portions are big and filling. You can choose from ready-made options or build your own salad or wrap, which is really convenient.

The only downside — they forgot to add avocado to my wrap, which was a bit disappointing.
But overall, still highly recommend this spot for a healthy and tasty meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: Daria Khotuleva

sample_reviews_en.text: Good healthy food. I got a custom salad ordered. It takes a little time, but worth it. Not salty or sugary. The sauce is put on the side for you to decide how much you want. The upstairs was completely empty so I had it all to myself. They have USB ports there at each table so well setup for the nomad workers.
sample_reviews_en.author: ali safar

sample_reviews_en.text:
Newly opened in Marche. The fresh, hearty salads made with organic, pesticide-free vegetables are very satisfying. 🥗 There are also several charging points, making it a great place for work or meetings! 
Water is self-service and free, and it's also great that the price includes tax.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bua in Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visiting again after a long time.

Why has it changed so much?? I can't believe the taste is this bad.

The chicken breast was a total mess—dried and salty...

And what is this kimchi???

Overall, nothing is bad, but it's a shame that there is nothing tasty or special about it.
sample_reviews_en.author: S.H. Shin (Moon night of Silla)

sample_reviews_en.text: Super fresh, customizable, and delicious. Great ingredients, generous portions, and lots of topping options. A perfect healthy go-to that still feels satisfying. I also appreciate that they have the macros and calories on the menu! Perfect for those who are tracking calories.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miguel

restaurants.name: Shahrazad Restaurant
restaurants.address:

6, 8 Soi Sukhumvit 3/1, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried Egyptian food here for the first time and I was honestly so impressed. As a Thai, I didn’t know what to expect, but everything was so flavorful and comforting in its own way. The pickled vegetables were surprisingly addictive, and their sauces were super tasty and paired perfectly with the dishes. I was actually so hungry that I didn’t even get a chance to take photos of all the menus because we started eating right away.

There’s also a lovely Thai staff member who helped recommend dishes for us, which made the whole experience even better. She explained everything so kindly and made it easy for us to try something new. Overall, it felt warm and welcoming, and I’ll definitely be coming back to explore more of the menu! 🍖🫓
sample_reviews_en.author: Zorityx

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honestly, the experience was terrible on all fronts. First of all, the food had absolutely no flavor, whether it was the grilled meats, appetizers, or salad. I even had to squeeze lemon on the shish tawook and hummus just to make them edible. There was an extra item added to the bill that wasn't ordered, and the bill itself was a whole other story—just numbers without any details, and payment was cash only!

Even though the restaurant was practically empty, the staff were sitting at the tables with their backs to the guests!

And of course, the prices were exorbitant for the quality, service, and taste…
sample_reviews_en.author: Feras Alhassoun

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went and had the most amazing, juicy lamb sheesha for just 220 baht. It came with soft, fluffy bread, a fresh salad, green onions, and, of course, a delicious spicy tomato dip. I absolutely loved soaking the lamb into the dip—it took the flavour to another make goodlevel.
The seating was comfortable, and the staff were warm and welcoming. For one person, you can expect to spend around 450 baht, which is excellent value for money considering the quality and portion size.

I'll definitely be coming back whenever I'm in the busy Arab Street area Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sher MAZ

sample_reviews_en.text: During my visit to this restaurant, I was so upset. If my brother hadn't been with me, God knows what would have happened. There's an employee there who's incredibly annoying. Thankfully, nothing serious happened. He takes our order and says, "I'll make your dreams come true." He keeps saying, "I'll make your dreams come true." Who are you to make our dreams come true? We're paying money; we're not begging from you. Respect your customers and watch your words. This is the last time I'll visit this restaurant, and I don't recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jshs Bzbzhs

sample_reviews_en.text: Very bad experience. We ordered mixed grill half kilo and specified we only wanted beef lamb meat and kebabs, more than 70% of the platter was liver. When we tried to complain, the manager in the white shirt behaved very discourteously. The tomatoes in the salad were also rotten. The food was not at all up to par especially given the high price. Would not recommend at all. Nearby, a few meters ahead you can find al saddah Yemeni restaurant and pay for a better experience at a much more affordable price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shandana 11

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited the restaurant as many claimed it's among the earliest halal eatery of its kind in Bangkok, and has delicious food. Different with other similar eateries, there's no Indian menu, mostly Middle Eastern with some International selections like Spaghetti. Flavor wise it's okay, a bit strong gamey flavor on the meat based dishes, with dining space that's fully air conditioned and lots of staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bayu Amus

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food. Wide selection of all types of middle eastern dishes. I am usually apprehensive of a menu with too many cultural choices but this chef did a perfect job with everything we ordered. The lamb kebaabs and fatousch salad were the best ive ever had at a restaurant... and trust me i have high standards! Best pick of this entire area of mid east cuisine mixed into Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mia

sample_reviews_en.text:
Shahrzad Restaurant – Bangkok 🇹🇭

We tried the grilled food at Shahrzad Restaurant and it was a great experience! 👌🏼🥩 The food was halal, the restaurant was clean and tidy, and the staff were Muslim, which made us feel comfortable and at ease while eating.

Overall, it was a good experience, and I think the restaurant is worth trying for anyone looking for halal food in Bangkok. 🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: HA95

Been eating here since I was in ABAC. Time change .. so everything changes. The shop has larger space, better decoration, price dramatucally increased in controversial to the quantity & quality of the food served. If you don't want to waste money, I strongly advise you eat elsewhere. There's a lot of better options in the vicinity. But if you are looking for varities, and oddly served portion, then this is the place.
Ps. We also had the rice but too shock to take any photo before we start eating quickly and getting ourselves out of the place.

It's almost our young age regular place. At that time this restaurant was on a food cart.   As students we went for conjee and khao tom (rice soup). We are grown up and very good to see this place grown as well.

Very nice interior with some retro theme.

Very reasonable price for premium items.

If nearby, a must visit restaurant. Daybtime it's a hunger busting amazing restaurant and In the evening this place turns to be a nice pub with great food.

Interesting way they serve super chilled slushy beer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Faisal Anwar Patrick

sample_reviews_en.text: I used to live in this area for almost 10 years, and this place has always been one of my go-to spots because the food is delicious, reasonably priced, and close to home with plenty of variety. Today I had the chance to come back, and it was just as impressive as I remembered. The taste and prices are still as good as before — truly never disappointing. I highly recommend everyone to give it a try if you have the chance. Recommended dishes are shown in the photos.

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there because I like their fried rice. But they are good only at the first time. Only seafood are available and after I get it the seafood are mostly uncook, squid is uneadible. If you want to force sell me seafood at least make it cook.

This place is no fancy but a Students canteen.

Food is delicious and inexpensive.

This is certainly not a tourist attraction but is a quick lunch or dinner place if you are just so happen drop by this district.

Their egg noodles are incredibly springy, and the fishball on a stick is dipped into a sauce that is like a wonderful Thai version of BBQ sauce.

restaurants.address:

130 Witthayu Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Barely edible food and overpriced for the quality of the ingredients used."

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything here was good. I tried another michelin star restaurant named nahm and it was definitely not as good as here.

The dish I loved the most was actually the green curry, which was super flavorful and had a stronger herbal profile compared to traditional curries with a lot of coconut cream. I also appreciated the addition of a ton of vegetables in the dish. I’m not sure what it was named but it gave a lot of texture.

The prawns with the pad thai were cooked perfectly and were so tender. Same with the chicken curry massaman, which had a more Indian flavor curry profile but was still delightful. The chicken was extremely tender and the thick creamy sauce was lovely with rice. Every single dish here was excellent and words don’t do this place enough justice.

Atmosphere is great and the service is top notch. Essentially white glove service; they do everything from filling your water to splitting portions for the dishes you have on the table.

One of the rare places that I think actually deserves the Michelin star. The only slight con that I thought was that the drinks could’ve been slightly better, but they were still decent (pineapple freeze and thai tea). I will be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Johnathan Lin

sample_reviews_en.text:
A modern take on Thai cuisine with contemporary dishes inspired with Thai flavors.

The service, atmosphere, and presentation of each dish was exceptional. You can tell they are curating an experience here. We didn’t need a reservation at all for 3 on a Monday night.

The dish I remember the most wasn’t actually a dish at all, but their signature cocktail, served in a basket atop a pedestal, using local Thai rum and juices to make a delicious medley of tropical flavor with a nice kick. This stuck with me the most a week after my visit.

The rest of the dishes flavor wise ranged from very good to just ok. The desert was a bit confused, and I just wish there was more overt traditional Thai brought into the dishes. Dining on stuffed chicken, steak, and sashimi wasn’t really my idea of Thai food, but I get that this is meant to be influenced by local spices and flavors, not necessarily a replication of local dishes.

I think while I appreciate the experience, I wouldn’t really recommend this to others who are traveling from abroad. For a local’s date night out, I think it could be worth a try. If nothing else, for the cocktails :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Zachary Wood

sample_reviews_en.text:
Saneh Jaan is a fantastic choice if you’re looking for high-quality Thai cuisine. They offer both a set menu and an à la carte menu—if you’re dining with more than four people, I highly recommend going for the à la carte option, as it provides a great variety of dishes to share.

Some standout dishes include the yellow curry crab, grilled ribeye steak with Thai sauce, pomelo salad, beef Massaman curry, and Tom Kha Gai—all were absolutely delicious. For dessert, the mango sticky rice was the perfect way to end the meal.

Their wine list, while not extensive, offers a well-curated selection of both Old World and New World wines, ensuring you’ll find a good pairing for your meal.

Service was good, though I felt they could use a bit more staff to enhance the experience. The only downside was the lighting—initially, it was too bright for a fine-dining atmosphere, but thankfully, they dimmed it towards the end of the night. I’d suggest keeping it dimmed throughout dinner for a more intimate and elegant ambiance.

Overall, great food, good service, and excellent value for money. I’ll definitely be returning!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohammad Farran

sample_reviews_en.text:
Quite a contrast from the street vendors I had gotten to fond of and used to over the few weeks travelling here but decided to treat myself and what a good decision it was.

The service was polished and personable, I really appreciate the finer details in these grand establishments. For example, being the bigman and taking on the chillis and the host fetching me a drink to counteract, not at my request but grateful appreciated haha.

The food, I opted for the royal set dinner, which I believe is the most traditional set of dishes they offer.

A more refined and classic palette which I really enjoyed, equally the explanation of what I was eating is also a merit of great service.

The meal itself would've cost a lot more back in Europe and thus, worth every penny here in Bangkok if you want to treat yourself without going crazy expensive, I really recommend Saneh Jaan. A whole package with the staff the stars of the show.

Thanks again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jordan Blackwell

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had an amazing dinner a few months ago so I came a second time for lunch.

The good: food consistently amazing; service always good and friendly; reasonably priced compared to other Michelin laureates

The bad: no free water I think; ordered lemon tea today it come without any syrup or sugar in it—so sour I couldn’t finish it.

The could-improve: online booking extremely unfriendly to individual dining. If you choose “1 person”, availability rarely shows up. If choosing “2 persons” or more, wide open availability. Had to make a phone call to reserve—fairly easy and painless. I came today for lunch; sure enough, it was very empty.

*edit after 2 months from last time:
They DID listen to customer's feedback!! The website now provides much more availability for individual dining.
sample_reviews_en.author: J. Lin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant consists of one big square room, but leaves enough space to not be disturbed by other guests. The interior design is compelling and fits a place of relaxation and pleasure.

I enjoyed the set lunch, which, at 950 Baht + tax is a bargain. Every course was perfect, except maybe for the dessert (ice cream is supposed to be creamy?), which still tasted as great as everything else. My mocktail, too, was a very pleasant surprise.
Last but not least: The service was impeccable.

Not sure whether the Saneh Jaan meets the criteria of a Michelin star restaurant, since they do make less fuss than others. However, I am most happy with my experience and recommend it fully.
sample_reviews_en.author: Holger Krauße

sample_reviews_en.text:
A nice experience with one phenomenal dish. The sweet and sour crispy rice vermicelli with riverside prawn and the grilled kurobota pork is a must-try, it's incredible and justifies the price on its own. The general service and ambiance are also very good.

However, the other dishes were just okay, making the overall value a little difficult to reconcile when compared to other amazing Bangkok eateries. My only other note is on dress code consistency. Having rescheduled my own visit to comply, I was surprised to see it not enforced for another table. Maintaining this standard for everyone would ensure the sophisticated atmosphere is preserved fairly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yang Wei

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tried the “Earth” Samrub Thai Set as husband and i could not eat beef so we decided to go with the set without beef.

Loved how the seats are arranged such the couples are seated side by side comfortably on sofa seats.

The course meal feels like a journey through different flavours.

What i enjoyed: pork and prawn roulade, grilled river prawn, fillet w tamarind sauce, tiger prawn curry, coconut w taro pudding cup

What i did not enjoy: eggplant roll (too spicy), stir fried pork basil (too hard to chew)

The entire dinner took around 2-3hours, enjoyed my time w my husband in the lovely ambience. Great staff and service too!
sample_reviews_en.author: ST

restaurants.name: The Hansik Korean BBQ (Charn At The Avenue Chaengwattana 14)
restaurants.address:

104/42 หมู่ที่ 1 ชาน แอท ดิ อเวนิว แจ้งวัฒนะ A212 Chaengwattana 45 Alley, Thung Song Hong, Lak Si, Bangkok 10210, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has been around since it was part of The Avenue project. I finally got the chance to eat here, and I wish I had come sooner! I'll definitely be back because the food is fresh, clean, and delicious. The service is polite and excellent; it's great value for money. I especially like the wide variety of snacks, particularly the fried items, which remain crispy even after a while. They also have a variety of kimchi, and the staff constantly changes the grilling racks. For a buffet, I wish they would clarify the time limit more clearly. I assume they'll bring watermelon closer to the end of the time limit, but it's impossible to guess exactly when it will be finished. Overall, I was very impressed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thirada Thiraruethaiyasri

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're a fan of Korean cuisine like I am, then The Hansik Korean BBQ at Rama 5 in Nonthaburi is a definite must-visit. From the moment you step in, the warm ambiance and tantalizing aromas set the stage for a delightful culinary journey.

The highlight of my experience was, of course, the Korean BBQ grill right at our table, where we got to cook our favorite meats and veggies to perfection. The meats were fresh, marinated to perfection, and grilled to mouthwatering tenderness. The flavors were incredibly authentic, making me feel like I was transported to the streets of Seoul.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wisanu Tuntawiroon

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there after reading reviews, and I guess those who said it was delicious really wanted to eat Korean food😭

It was the first time I’ve ever left a restaurant after eating there in my year living in Bangkok.

There was a bug in the kimchi at the salad bar, so I told a staff member, but they just picked the bug out with tongs and that was it...

I saw it crawling around everywhere too😠

However, the service was good, and the eggs were the best haha.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ddidi

sample_reviews_en.text: The real Korean BBQ restaurant on Nakhon In road, Rama 5th, Nonthaburi, owned and run by Korean family. Their combination of marinades, seasonings, and sauces used in their meat, such as soy sauce, garlic, sesame oil, and gochujang (spicy red chili paste), creates a tantalizing and flavorful experience for the taste buds. The lowest price package is 359 baht which is good enough for us. Many choices of side dishes. Great customer service. Ample parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kiatkorn Panyavuddhiwongg

sample_reviews_en.text: I love the shrimp so much! They are huge and delicious!!! They grill everything for you, and the eggs served on the side are generous. Everything, from the drinks to the side bar, is top-notch. The watermelon after the meal was also very sweet. The Houttuynia cordata tea was nutty and nice. It would be even better if they offered cold noodles and soybean paste stew for dessert.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kevin KwangLo Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my 5th visit, and the service is consistently awful. The waiters seem untrained, stand silently in front of us without speaking, and make no effort to engage. It’s uncomfortable—like I have to prompt them to do their job. I don’t understand the “good service” reviews. The staff needs proper training to make customers feel welcome.
sample_reviews_en.author: Real Customer

sample_reviews_en.text: I came with my girlfriend on my big bike, I parked in the parking lot, there were only 2 other cars parking there already with a lot of empty spaces and one of the workers came and told me to park near the trash! With that treatment, I quickly searched for another place to eat. Wanted to spend at least 1000 to 2000 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Life Loving Adventurer

sample_reviews_en.text: Didn't get a chance to take photos. Came all the way from Nakhon In, Rama 5. Still excellent as always. The Jjamppong and kimchi soup are nowhere else as good. The side dishes are great, and the Hokkaido tea is superb. Ordered some Hokkaido tea to take home and quench my thirst. Will definitely be back! 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Boripat Limpanithanon

restaurants.name: Misaki cafe ริมคลองโอ่งอ่าง
restaurants.address:

ริมคลองโอ่งอ่าง 114 ถนน จักรวรรดิ Khwaeng Chakkrawat, จักรวรรดิ Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came here because of the high ratings on the map, but the service was uncomfortable and the food was nothing special.
The prices were reasonable, but the portions were small. The meat was dry, and the rice had an odd texture, as if it were very cheap or old. There was also a hair in the food.
When we asked for small plates to share, the staff was like "we don't have haha"
When we requested condiments, he simply glanced at us and never brought them. At the same time, condiments  were proactively placed on the tables of Western customers—even before they ordered. Cutlery was promptly and personally handed to Western customers lol.
All the other tables were Western guests. The staff frequently checked on them with comments like “Everything OK?”, while we were completely ignored. The difference in how customers were treated was hard not to notice.
Later, we saw Western customers tipping at the counter, which may explain the preferential treatment.
Given the high expectations from the reviews, this experience was especially disappointing and left a very unpleasant impression.
sample_reviews_en.author: AS

sample_reviews_en.text: Last night I randomly stopped by this place, but I wasn't disappointed at all! I ate beer and food, I didn't take any pictures, but the Tom Yum Mama noodles were amazing! The ingredients were top-notch, with plump shrimp and perfectly cooked squid. The squishy-selling kids were super cute, I was totally charmed! The owner was also lovely and the service was excellent. This is definitely one of my favorite restaurants. The breeze was so nice too. I'll definitely be back often! ❤️💖
sample_reviews_en.author: gubgib apinya

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lovely family run place on a canal - great place for an afternoon break. Cold beer!
We had the most delicious veg bao (lights and fluffiest!), pork rice, pad Thai, morning glory (delicious greens!). All delicious didn’t even snap a pic before it was gone.
Staff is friendly, son took our order and dad brought our food. Their friends bartend and cook - super chill and friendly!
Not fancy and the tables weren’t that clean but it felt very local and safe food wise to eat at.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shannon Knutson

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was incredible, the service was great, and everything was greatly priced.
Me and 2 friends had 3 dishes and 3 drinks, and everything came out perfectly.
I would definitely recommend this place for the food or just to grab a coffee and chitchat.
The place was incredibly clean as well, which just goes to show how great it is.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rami Almehdawi

sample_reviews_en.text: Came across this place after walking around all day and thought it looked like a cute spot. Right by the canal so super nice atmosphere!! The food was amazing and the staff were wonderful! Loved it so much, recommend to anyone considering!! Great prices as well!
sample_reviews_en.author: victoria lindstrom

sample_reviews_en.text: Best papaya salad ever and the other dishes were amazing as well. The family who runs it is super nice and helpful. Great atmosphere on the canal. If you want to eat spicy, just ask 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Isabella Sturla

sample_reviews_en.text: Really nice little place by the river. Excellent food, perfectly genuinely nice service. Kim and his family made our day! Great music also! We will definitely be back!!!  Loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Catalin Milon

sample_reviews_en.text: A lovely restaurant and cafe, the food is freshly prepared, and despite its proximity to Chinatown, you can sit peacefully by the water. A great oasis to relax for a few minutes.
sample_reviews_en.author: C. W.

restaurants.name: EBISU SHOTEN Phrom Phong
restaurants.address:

660 662 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fantastic find in Phrom Phong! We loved this place so much that we visited twice during our stay in Phrom Phong. The kushikatsu (deep-fried skewers) were absolutely delicious – crispy, light and full of flavor. Everything on the menu is reasonably priced (200–400 THB range), which makes it even more enjoyable.

The service was warm and efficient, and the atmosphere strikes the perfect balance between cozy and lively – great for a relaxed dinner or a casual night out. Highly recommend the set menus and the dipping sauces.

If you're in the area and want authentic, affordable Japanese izakaya-style food, don't miss Ebisu Shoten. We'll definitely be back next time we're in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nathan Vance

sample_reviews_en.text:
We arrived at the restaurant with high expectations and were quite disappointed, the dishes were mostly not tasty, a large part of the food remained on the plate
The prices were relatively high
The atmosphere there is what made it all, you enter the restaurant and feel like you are in Japan, all the comics and the special menu
To sum up, the experience at the restaurant was less good than I expected
sample_reviews_en.author: Ilay Encch

sample_reviews_en.text: Something changed. WiFi will not connect. I came for the beef tataki but it is unchewable. It was great a few months ago. Not anymore. I don't know what happened but it is very disappointing. I think its called tiger meat because even tigers will reject it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert Garland

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I got salmon sashimi, and the pieces were a bit soft, but the taste was still okay. Maybe it was because I got the ends of the slices, but other tables had nice, normal pieces. The other dishes were delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Varat Kautira

sample_reviews_en.text: I often eat here between midnight and 2 AM, but the staff frequently forgets my orders. Sometimes they don't even write down my order, and even after I follow up, I still don't get my food. The wait is quite long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamonwan

sample_reviews_en.text: An absolutely fantastic restaurant for sushi and authentic Japanese cuisine. The moment you step inside, you feel transported to Japan – the atmosphere, the ambiance, and the details are truly exquisite. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Patric Morueco Fernandez

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the atmosphere was amazing! We came during the day when it was hot and sunny, but once we went inside, the air was so refreshing! 💕✨🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Nanzy Khunu

sample_reviews_en.text: Great food, great people and would definitely come back. Came with picky eaters but the range on the menu is amazing and everyone leaving happy and full.
sample_reviews_en.author: Toni Dawson

restaurants.name: Royal India Phahurat
restaurants.address:

392/1 Chakkraphet Rd, Wang Burapha Phirom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
During our trip to Bangkok's China Town, we decided to visit the Royal India Restaurant to satisfy our craving for Indian cuisine in Thailand. Despite initial apprehensions due to its unassuming exterior, the positive Google Maps reviews spurred us to give it a chance. Our hopes wavered as we approached, but once we tasted the food, they were immediately reignited.

The dining experience at Royal India Restaurant turned out to be a delightful surprise. The moment we took our first bites, any doubts were dispelled. The flavors of the Indian dishes were simply exquisite, exceeding our expectations in every way. From aromatic curries to perfectly cooked rotis, every dish was a testament to their culinary prowess.

Though the restaurant's appearance might not be as inviting, the true gem lies within its kitchen. For any Indian missing the familiar tastes of home while in Thailand, this establishment comes highly recommended. The journey from uncertainty to culinary satisfaction was a memorable one, reminding us not to judge a book by its cover.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rithu Maria Jose

sample_reviews_en.text:
THE LEGACY of Indian Cuisine & Sweets

A legend is someone or something which survives the onslaught of time and yet commands the same respect and awe as when it started.

Royal India Indian Food Restaurant is the only place I know which deserves the title iof a legend as I have frequented this place, at the same location for almost half a century!

Food has always been good, and while traditional recipes are the norm, the new generation of proprietors have ensured that the cuisine is up to modern standards while mating the simplicity and sophistication which marks this place.

Every dish has been good, and if have to state something exceptional, then it is their dessert RASMALAI, which I have found to still be the undisputed champion, the best available in Thailand!

The restaurant may loom small, but it is cozy, and the ambience is charming and yet does not distract you away from concentrating on having a delicious, sumptuous meal!

Bon Appetite! ✍️
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukan Sethi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Royal India Restaurant is a long-established Indian restaurant in the Pahurat area, having been open for decades. The restaurant isn't overly luxuriously decorated, focusing instead on a traditional restaurant atmosphere. The menu offers a fairly comprehensive selection of North Indian dishes, including various curries, tandoori chicken, and naan. The highlight is the rich, authentic Indian flavors, with distinct spices, yet still easy to eat for those new to Indian cuisine.

The interior is relatively simple, and the restaurant is regularly frequented by Thais, tourists, and Indians alike. It's suitable for families or groups of friends, and children can enjoy the food if the less spicy options are chosen. Overall, the restaurant excels in taste and authenticity rather than modern decor or experience. It's perfect for those who want to try authentic Indian food in the traditional Pahurat setting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattana Pong

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place has a signage on the main road. The eatery itself is in the lane.

The raita (seasoned yoghurt) with cucumber & potatoes was well seasoned, it was nice by itself as well as with roti.

The Aloo Paratha was well made & seasoned. It was soft & nice on its own! The tandoori roti was also good.

The Dal Makhani was perfect with the roti.

The Vegetable Jalfrazi could have been seasoned better. The flavour was not right.

Ended the meal with masala chai, perfect after an Indian meal. The mithai / sweetmeats were also good. The chum chum was mildly sweet & the center's thickened cream balanced the flavour.

The rasmalai was white instead of the usual saffron infused yellow. The cream could have been a little thicker!

The waitress serving us was good. She knew the menu & was friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kiran Seth

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited Royal Indian in Pahurat, also known as Bangkok’s Little India, and ordered vegetable samosas along with masala chai. The restaurant’s interior was clean, and the waiter was attentive, which made the experience pleasant. Having last visited in 2018, I was really excited to return.

The samosas were well-cooked, though they lacked the bold masala flavors I was expecting. As for the chai, it could have used more ginger for a stronger, more authentic taste. Despite these minor tweaks, it was still a great experience to revisit after so many years.

Outside the restaurant, there were stalls selling Indian sweets, adding to the vibrant atmosphere of the area. Definitely worth a stop if you’re in the neighborhood and craving Indian food!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pam pam

sample_reviews_en.text:
Butter chicken was really good, as they put quite a lot of tomatoes in, giving off the sour note which was quite refreshing.
The roti and paratha were ok.. recommend the roti (only 15 thb, while the paratha was 55 thb for pretty much the same size and the taste were very similar)

Lamb korma was good, a bit too heavy/creamy/rich to my liking, but definitely enjoyable as the lamb was nicely cooked.. the only thing would be that there were some pieces of bones in the curry (small ones as well) which you should be a bit careful when you eat.
Rasmalai was really good, not too sweet, and refrigerated.. quite refreshing!
Masala tea was nice, too(no sugar was great).
Overall experience was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: K Px

sample_reviews_en.text:
We loved it here! The google map location is accurate. It was not difficult to find. There is not parking available so recommend to take public transport or park at the nearby building.

We ordered 4 items: Chicken Butter, Mutton Curry, Chicken Tikki and 2 servings of garlic nan. We really enjoyed the food! Eat until the plates are so clean! The food prices are not that cheap comparing to other shops nearby but I’d say they are reasonable prices. The chicken meat is tender, not dry at all.

The restaurant is rather small (4-5 tables) but nice a/c. So make sure you make a booking if going during peak time.
sample_reviews_en.author: KT Jung

sample_reviews_en.text:
Being in Little India, this chain restaurant would need to strive to have either better service or better taste(a tall order, given the location) to stand out from the others.

It has neither.

Expensive with a rather bland taste, this is clearly for one-time tourists as are many Indian restaurants in Thailand. The attitude of the management reflects this as they clearly cannot be bothered if you eat there or not. Rather, the hostess seems pestered when customers come into the restaurant. Save your time and money and go across the main road and get samosas from the street stall instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christopher M

restaurants.name: Nicky's on Buakhao
restaurants.address:

293, 43 Soi Buakhao, ตำบล หนองปรือ, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: First time in the new plaice, very welcoming, cool inside with outside seating and toilets, parking, sen the legend herself Debbie.  Had several meals over few days i was there, good menu, good prices, excellent specials.  Food was cooked fresh, had 99bht breakfast plus extra slice fried bread, sausage and bacon was lovely on negative,  found was fried slice, for some reason the fried bread on specials on small bread was never cooked enough, but when u ordered extra slice on big bread it was cooked to perfection, this happened twice, not to take anything away from the quality of food, the pork chops,  was fantastic,  fish and chips was good, and the omelette breakfast was extremely tasty. 100% would return
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Clubbe

sample_reviews_en.text:
Enjoyed the breakfast. Certainly the best one so far. The problem is usually the sausages. These were ok.

Still would like tinned tomatoes and butter fried mushrooms but other than that it's very good value at 99 baht including real Tetley's in a big cup. So overall excellent.  With better mushroom prep and tinned tomatoes it would be outstanding.

I will try the large breakfast next time. The other food being ordered looked marvellous also. Wife had Egg Benedict which was good but the hollandaise sauce was runny. Tasted great though as I had a bit to try it.

Now we've been in for the Mega Breakfast and it's big. Same quality so good.

Jelly had a Jacket Potato. Tuna.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nelly Byrd

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Sunday roast was very good. I ordered the roast beef small size that came with plenty of roast beef, roast potatoes, a small helping of mashed potatoes, some cabbage and broccoli, a Yorkshire pudding and some stuffing with gravy on the side. Personally I like brussel sprouts too.
Revisited recently for a non roast lunch of home made chicken pie, chips and peas. Unfortunately this was below average as the pastry appeared to be that of an off the shelf pie, the filling was unsatisfying and the chips were potato wedges.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nelson Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nicky's on Buakhao is a very good and reliable breakfast restaurant.  Pretty consistent meals day after day, mainly of the fried breakfast type.

Situated on a side street just off Soi Buakhao it's easy to find and offers inside and outside dining.  The inside area is kept nicely cool by AC.

Staff are quick and efficient, and there is limited parking right outside.  Very smart and clean toilets on site.

I had very good fried breakfasts here, but the eggs benedict I had one day was not so good.
sample_reviews_en.author: chiangmaicharlies

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nicky’s is great . Had the 99 baht breakky and a rice soup. Both were huge. Service was very fast location is down a side alley with a small parking area at the front. Seems very popular but honestly it’s the best hot coffee although probably filtered but hot unlike so many places plus a decent mug size.
99 baht for a full English you would need a big appetite for the mega size.
Has to be the best Thai English breakfast I’ve had
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Foulkes

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice cafe with a very British vibe when it comes to the food. Great all-day breakfasts here and they also do a Sunday Carvery if you're after a weekend roast dinner. Food is well-presented and comes out quickly and service is usually with a smile. It's a busy place with a loyal following - easy to see why when you go here yourself. A solid option. (PS Please get some Vegemite in for your Aussie guests to put on their toast)
sample_reviews_en.author: Lachlan Burnet

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate there 4 times last week. One time in the morning and three times in the evening. I wanted to go back Friday evening (for the fish and chips) but I was turned away at 8:25 ! I ate well 3 out of 4 times. On Thursday evening I chose spaghetti carbonara and frankly it was disgusting. The dish was swimming in oil. I wonder why so much fat is used to cook pasta. As for the staff, I much prefer the morning staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent service with smiles, great location and cheapest breakfast around. You can get a full English breakfast  for 99baht, and the bacon is good quality. I also had the chicken dinner in the evening, which was also great quality at 240 baht.
If I  lived here I would be on the 99baht full English everyday. My friend got the ribs and if was huge too.
I can't rate the rooms as I didn't stay in the guesthouse.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark

restaurants.name: Tim Mansion Bangkok Hotel
restaurants.address:

337 Maha Chai Rd, Samran Rat, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently had the pleasure of staying at the Tim Mansion Bangkok Hotel and I must say, it was one of the most enjoyable hotel experiences I've ever had. One of the standout features of this hotel is the rooftop. The view is absolutely breathtaking. The atmosphere up there was very relaxing and tranquil, with plenty of comfortable seats and shaded area to relax in. But what really set this hotel apart was the hospitality. From the moment I arrived, I was greeted with warm and friendly service. The owner and the staffs went above and beyond to ensure that my stay was as comfortable and enjoyable as possible. This hotel is nearby many temples as well. Few of them can be reached by walking distance. But few times I found some guests had difficulty to lock the room door when they wanted to go outside. Maybe they aren't familiar with it.
Overall, I would highly recommend the Tim Mansion Bangkok Hotel to anyone looking for a memorable stay. The rooftop and hospitality are truly exceptional and I can't wait to visit again in the future. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: R Tyas

sample_reviews_en.text:
I think this place would be great for anyone who is looking for affordable accommodation without having to stay in a hostel. The rooms come with a comfortable bed and a private toilet and shower room. Everything was clean, the building just seems to be on the older side. The lobby is nicely decorated and makes a perfect hangout spot.

There are quite a few restaurants and other food options nearby. Very convenient was the 7-11 right opposite the street. The next metro station (Sam Yot) and supermarket (BigC) are a 10-minute walk away. Attractions and sights like the Grand Palace and the Reclining Buddha are just a 10/15-minute drive away.

Tip: Get around the area by Grab as it can be way cheaper than a Tuktuk. If you do take a Tuktuk, make sure to negotiate the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cal’s Adventures

sample_reviews_en.text: Cozy, clean, and updated rooms and a really cool vibe throughout the whole place. The view of the Golden Mount from the room was stunning. It’s amazing value for the affordable price and I would definitely stay here again in Bangkok. We didn’t have that much time to explore the city so I can’t truly speak to its location, but the immediate surroundings of the hotel are awesome, with a fabulous restaurant right in front of the hotel for lunch or dinner (Ros Krung Esarn Thai Cafe) and two Michelin star places right next door. There’s definitely a lot of cool places to eat and walk around within a 10 minute radius which is really all you can ask for for a hotel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hannah Morrison

sample_reviews_en.text:
The only negative is the overwhelming smell of mothballs in the reception area. I was very scared it would also be in the rooms but thankfully that was not the case.
We had a family room with a view over the Golden Mount. Bed was hard but not so much so as to be unable to sleep. The room was clean. The shower floods if you attempt to shower one after the other. I would still stay again as I think it's a great location and it's clean and spacious.
Internet was patchy for us but I didn't have a lot of work to do thankfully.
Great places to eat around there and walkable to lots of things... will be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tania Pan

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a fantastic stay at Tim Mansion Hotel in Bangkok! The location is perfect – just a minute's walk to a 7-Eleven convenience store, and there's even a Michelin-starred restaurant nearby. The rooftop view of the Golden Mount is absolutely stunning and adds a special touch to the experience. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and truly a great value for money. The staff were exceptionally friendly and helpful, making our stay even better. Plus, the hotel has an elevator, which made it very convenient. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a cozy, well-located spot in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Srinidhi K

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stayed at this hotel for one night as a stop before heading to the south of Thailand, and we really enjoyed our stay. We were even upgraded, which was a lovely surprise. We arrived very early, around 9 a.m., and our room was already ready for us. After a 12-hour flight, this was incredibly appreciated and made a huge difference. The staff are so nice and friendly.
The hotel is in a great location, and the view from the terrace is absolutely amazing. We would definitely come back to this place on our next trip to Bangkok. Thank you !
sample_reviews_en.author: Martyna Wietecka

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really enjoyed my stay here in this hotel. I stay 4 days 3 nights here. I feel myself like at home and so cosy. The staffs here so friendly and welcoming. The location is the best! I love their lobby open space area.

The downside is at night is quite loud and if you're sensitive I don't think you will be able to sleep. But they provide ear plug if you need one.

The room itself very decent with the price I paid. Small room but very clean and have everything provided.

Will back at stay at this hotel again when I'm in bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Elene Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tim Mansion is such a great hotel and I would definitely rate it 10/10 because of the cozy location ( 7-Eleven is in front of the hotel ) and it’s not crowded as some people review beside that it’s so cozy and good to stay after a long day walk in the city 🫶🏻

Otherwise, I love how the room is so clean and comfortable as well within the affordable price 🥰 I have no worries anymore whenever I come to Bangkok.

Last but not least, don’t forget to buy the street food near by the hotel and cozy bar ( pub ) as well such good place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Raphy Joy

restaurants.name: Laab Ped Rama IV
restaurants.address:

4170 Rama IV Rd, Khwaeng Phra Khanong, พระโขนง Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Eating Moo Kra Ta (BBQ) with Korean Music 👯‍♀️Reasonable Price 🖤 Good food, Good Service👍✨️ Let's the pictures speak 😁
Price: 199- 250thb (11 Oct 2022)

Tips:
- Eat the beef with Ssamjang sauce (Korean one) !
- เล้งแซ่บ อร่อย Pork Bone Spicy Soup is great!
sample_reviews_th.author: Palm Chocolate Lively

sample_reviews_en.text: This has to be considered a hidden gem for me since I have been staying nearby and did not patronize this shop ever. The menu is extensive, whatever thai food that you could have think of, they are all in their menu. The food was absolutely delicious and comes in quite large portion so stay calm when you start browsing the menu like a recipe book. The only minus point is that despite it is an air conditioned restaurant with a closed door kitchen, you will get home with the cooking smell which is quite surprising,  given that I couldn't smell anything while dining inside the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daron Tay

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten at this restaurant twice now, and the food has never disappointed. It's delicious, the portions are generous, and it's worth the slightly high price.
This has become my go-to Northeastern Thai restaurant.
For me, when I want Northeastern Thai food, this is the only place to go.
The raw beef salad and papaya salad are amazing; the flavors are incredibly satisfying.
The only downside is that even with the air conditioning on, it's still a little warm inside. They use a large fan to help keep things cool. It would be much better otherwise.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanaskan Nankaen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Would not recommend.

The food was okay but the buffet was a scam it doesnt matter if you're alone or with a group you always get the same amount of food but you pay 349B per person. The menu is very misleading and the staff only said it costs 349B reapetedly.

If you're hellbent on eating here come in alone, order and then have the rest of the group come in and eat the "leftovers" for only a 100B per person
sample_reviews_en.author: karidagur

sample_reviews_en.text: It took so long. I asked the staff why it was taking so long; other people's orders were coming without a hitch, but mine hadn't arrived yet. The staff said the kitchen probably forgot to make it. Is this even possible? I'm confused. What kind of staff does the restaurant hire to manage this place? Why are they so negligent in managing the queue or forgetting to prepare food? All the staff are Burmese.
sample_reviews_en.author: Na Rit

sample_reviews_en.text:
-I ordered papaya salad with one chili, but they added chili without considering my request. It's like they added whatever chili they felt like!
-The restaurant smelled awful. I only went in for a short time, but my clothes smelled even worse than if I'd been sitting right in front of the stove.
-The food tasted good, but please adjust the spice level for my order because I can't eat spicy food.
sample_reviews_en.author: sililak saviya

sample_reviews_en.text: During my stay in Bangkok, I visited this restaurant almost every day. Thanks to them, I was able to taste many dishes of Thai cuisine. The taste was always delicious, the quantity is generous and the prices are reasonable. The staff was always very friendly, I already felt like at home. Thank you for everything, I hope I’ll be able to come back one day!
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel

sample_reviews_en.text: Great value for the price! The service is very nice and the place is very neat. We had a bbq buffet for 250 baht and it’s so worth it! Meat was good for the price and the variety of veggies and sauce in the open buffet is good too. Definitely recommend if you’re in the area. We also got tteokbokki and my Korean friend approved ☺️🫶
sample_reviews_en.author: Tina

restaurants.name: Mr. Steak @The Scene
restaurants.address:

1323 Lat Phrao 94 Alley, Phlabphla, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This steakhouse truly surprised me. I initially just randomly picked a place for dinner, but the steak quality was much better than I expected—tender, generous portions, and especially the 10oz series, which is definitely worth ordering. The price and quality are excellent value for Bangkok.

The pork chops are also highly recommended. The skin was perfectly seared, and the meat wasn't dry at all; no wonder it's a must-order signature dish for so many. The salad portions were also good; you could tell it wasn't just a hastily prepared side dish, and the overall combination was very satisfying.

I personally love the atmosphere of this old-school steakhouse. It's not just a trendy spot for taking photos; it's a place where you genuinely want to eat, chat, and socialize. The ambiance is comfortable, the service is excellent, and the food comes out at a reasonable pace.

If you're looking for a reasonably priced yet satisfying steakhouse in Bangkok, I think this is worth a try. I'd definitely bring my friends next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gary “Garyy” G

sample_reviews_en.text:
Reasonably priced. Good atmosphere.

I got all these for 349 baht.

A beef steak (5 oz, so around 150 grams?), a giant bowl of salad (I could not finish the salad and asked them to pack it for me), french fries and a bun. There are also refillable drinks, soups (corn soup and chicken soup), and fruits when you add 30 baht to your main dish. (Mine was 319 + 30 = 349). Prices on the menu were final prices, no added VAT/Service charge afterwards.

The food was okay. It’s not super good, but not bad at all.

The service was great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Knotto ._.

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time here, and I loved the atmosphere. They have a wide variety of steaks on the menu, and the food was delicious. They also have wine options to pair with your meal, and for a little extra, you can get an unlimited buffet of drinks, soup, fruit, and desserts. You can even finish your meal and still relax, work, listen to music, and have coffee. There's indoor and outdoor seating available. The staff were lovely and provided excellent service. I was very impressed and will definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: pothjanee Chaiudom

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love this place! It’s a great spot for delicious, budget-friendly Taiwanese-style steak.

I usually go for the medium rare 5 oz beef, which is always cooked just right. Plus, for just 30 Baht more, you get unlimited soup, fruits, drinks, French fries, and soft rolls—such a great deal!

On top of that, the owner is super friendly, making the dining experience even better. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kathy Cheng

sample_reviews_en.text: Mr. Steak offers a satisfying dining experience with well-cooked, tender steak served on a sizzling plate, accompanied by seasoned rice and fresh vegetables. The cream soup starter was rich and smooth, pairing well with the soft bread. The restaurant’s cozy atmosphere, with its modern decor, adds to the pleasant meal. Highly recommended for a casual yet delicious steak meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirivan Yotsutham

sample_reviews_en.text: My boyfriend said the beef rice bowl was delicious, but I thought the diced steak was just average. However, the service was excellent. All the staff were lovely; they should definitely include a service charge. The service was outstanding, we were very impressed. We'll definitely go back again. Next time I'll have to try some of their steak dishes. ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Aiewwy Penpaka

sample_reviews_en.text: The best steak house in town with the great service, great food at amazing prices, wide selections on the menu in such a fine place with an open soup/drinks and fruits bar at a very low price, however, the rice over the hot plate wasn’t so flavored and no salad available in the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amani Hsiao

sample_reviews_en.text:
The beef steak was well-cooked, the lamb steak was a little dry.
The fried rice that came with the set was delicious, the noodles were just okay.
When served, the staff will cut the meat to show you if it's cooked to your order.
The service was excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: SAMMY T (SAMMY)

restaurants.name: Sam Gyup Sal
restaurants.address:

410, 115-116 Ratchadaphisek 22 Alley, Samsen Nok, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time here with my boyfriend, and the service was excellent. My boyfriend had a seizure while waiting for our food and we hadn't eaten yet. I told the cashier that my boyfriend wasn't feeling well and needed to go to the hospital, and I offered to pay the surcharge for not eating. The staff were so kind, I almost cried 😭😭😭 Thank you for your understanding. They didn't charge us a surcharge and only charged us for one person's meal. I'm so touched.
sample_reviews_en.author: Su Su

sample_reviews_en.text: This Korean BBQ place allows you to grill the food yourself without having to do the grilling yourself. There's a wide selection of side dishes and fried items to choose from. The clam soup is delicious, but the grilling process is quite slow.
sample_reviews_en.author: LunaGlow

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the staff grilled it quickly, and the service was great. There were tons of side dishes, making it excellent value for money. There's parking available, and the staff were attentive. I'll definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Roongpairin Kaewkrajang

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, great value, wide variety of food options, no need to grill anything yourself, and the food arrived very quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supawadee Promsonthi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely delicious! 10/10
Lots of food, lots of side dishes to choose from.
Definitely coming back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: อมรรัตน์ บรรจงธุระการ

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and there was a generous portion. The staff provided excellent service. 👍👍👍👍👍 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Ngin Hom Lin

sample_reviews_en.text: Plenty of food, great staff, they grill the food for you, and most importantly, it's delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Poonna Promsonthi

sample_reviews_en.text: It was so delicious, and I didn't even have to grill it myself! I'll definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yaowalak Panpradit

restaurants.name: The Sitting Room
restaurants.address:

Soi Si Bamphen, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ambience is good! Like a place to gather for foreigners (95%). Crowded  always.

The high light is that foods and alcoholic drinks are not pricy and  there is a pool table to take turns playing among customers.

Last but not least, the restaurant hardly has any parking space available in front of the premises. Those with cars must park at the parking lot with fee which is quite far.

Note: the restaurant has informed me with the updated info [7 Oct. 2025) that currently, parking space is provided nearby Free of Charge to facilitate the customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Atchariya S.

sample_reviews_en.text: Just popped in for lunch, was only one there no staff out front, no problem. Waited patiently a few mins, a girl walked out kind of shocked someone was there although it was 1245 they opened at 12.. she gave me a bit of dirty look, said "what do you want". Felt like I insulted her ordering a beer. Never asked if I wanted food or a menu, I went elsewhere for lunch. You can hate your job. Don't have to hate the customers paying..
sample_reviews_en.author: S C

sample_reviews_en.text: Come here many times a week. Perfect place for hangout either alone or with friend. Foods are delicious, authentic, and reasonable price. Services people here are very friendly and won’t bother you too much. I know a few good service one, for example Pear. A pool table which I like the most. The place in middle of the city where you can relax and not much to think about.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amp Suebwongpat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Been going there last 2 years. Staff are fantastic, friendly, quick and good pool players ;)  highly recommended if you are in the area. The food is very good and offers a good choice, the pool is free and have live music, football on Tv ( or other sports) and now air-conditioning!

Thanks to the staff Poppy, Nan, ID, Duan, Por and Henry
sample_reviews_en.author: Lee Staniforth

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's probably the only bar that serves the most delicious proper food, Try Mus-sa-man soup and the pasta with meatball. The singers are always talented and sing very well every time I come.

The vibe is nice and chill, not hot. It's open air, but sometimes they turn on air con.

I am always here to hang out and chill with friends
.
sample_reviews_en.author: Praifa Huang

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is fantastic don’t miss the juicy grilled beef, comforting fried rice (both egg and chicken), or the refreshing raw shrimp salad. The coconut Thai soup is rich and aromatic, and the lime honey soda is the perfect pick-me-up.

The cozy vibe and warm, friendly staff make it a great place to relax and enjoy a good meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Masae

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, good vibes, chill spot, staff are really friendly.. especially staff name “pear” went above and beyond to make sure I found exactly what I was looking for, and her recommendations were spot on. She does her job so well and with such a positive vibe that it’s impossible not to remember her.
sample_reviews_en.author: cr

sample_reviews_en.text: If you live in the area and to lazy to go anywhere it’s a good place to grab a drink and play some pool. Prices for drinks are decent somewhat. I wouldn’t eat here just go to the next street stall. Stuff can be a bit slow when they are busy but friendly as anywhere :) I’d come again for a drink and a game of pool
sample_reviews_en.author: Tina

restaurants.name: พัฒน์เกาเหลาเนื้อ
restaurants.address:

ถ.จรัญ13 Bang Waek Rd, Phasi Charoen, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: My first experience eating here was terrible. I called in the morning and the staff spoke in a rude tone, which I initially let slide. I called to ask if they had any items out of stock. The restaurant said they only had Kobe beef, and that the beef shank needed to be pre-ordered. I ordered a mixed beef shank hot pot. Upon arrival, I mentioned that I had pre-ordered and emphasized that it included everything. The staff acknowledged this, but when the food arrived, it was incomplete, even though I had pre-ordered. No one informed me that any items were out of stock. The portions were ridiculously small; there was only one piece of offal and two meatballs for 240 baht. It was awful. When I inquired about this, the staff only offered apologies. I want to know why, when they said everything was included, the food was served incomplete. It was a terrible experience. Also, while I was talking to the staff, they kept walking away. I was very confused.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanadeth Cvn

sample_reviews_en.text: We went at 11 am, but the Kobe beef was sold out. Only beef shank and other cuts were left. So we ordered a large size beef shank noodle soup without offal. The broth was very piping hot and a bit salty. The beef shank was delicious. We also ordered grilled meatballs, which were smaller in size. Overall, everything was tasty. The restaurant was spacious and offered free tea and ice. It's a relatively expensive noodle shop. There was plenty of parking. The food didn't take long to arrive, and they had misting fans to keep the restaurant from getting too hot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Double Troubles

sample_reviews_en.text: Beef noodle soup with clear broth, tender beef, fresh beef, tendon meatballs, and offal. The clear broth is flavorful, refreshing, and easy to drink, with just the right amount of sweetness from the beef stock. It's not greasy or heavy. The Kobe beef is excellent, and the short ribs are tender and firm, not chewy. The tendon meatballs are fragrant with pepper. The price reflects the quality. If you want Kobe beef, you need to order a day in advance. Closed on the 1st and 16th of the month (lottery days).
sample_reviews_en.author: Thana Laopiyasakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came based on reviews. The soup tasted like pork blood soup, lacking any meaty flavor that would justify the restaurant's name. The tables were dusty; I understand it's near a road and construction area, but they should be wiped down more often.

In short, I ate lunch there and had diarrhea in the afternoon. :)

My bowl might have been the bad luck one.

But my friend's bowl was fine.

One try is enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanya N

sample_reviews_en.text: The beef noodle soup restaurant has about 10 tables and can accommodate a reasonable number of people. It opens early, and the Kobe beef sells out quickly, so you have to come early. The Kobe beef is delicious, but what I really liked was the broth; it's a clear broth that's incredibly tasty. The grilled meatballs are also good, and they're grilled fresh for every skewer.
sample_reviews_en.author: AMARIN PHOYEN

sample_reviews_en.text:
Meat lovers, this is for you! The best clear broth beef hot pot in Siam!
The soup is fragrant and has a unique flavor. The pork belly is the best, so tender it melts in your mouth. Be careful, it might sell out quickly! 555
The offal is clean, and the dried beef is also good.
The service is friendly.
Meat lovers absolutely cannot miss this restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pokchat Boonyaku

sample_reviews_en.text: It was worth the drive to get to this noodle shop. I ordered the special Kobe beef noodle soup (150 baht). The clear broth was flavorful and delicious, with a sweetness from the beef. The Kobe beef was tender, large pieces, and very tasty, with a wonderful aroma. The offal was clean and odorless, but the pieces were quite small.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jatuporn Jantharuthai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I arrived at 1 PM, and they were already sold out.
So I didn't get to try what they rave about.
But what amazed me was the broth. It's a flavor you can't find in beef noodle soup these days.
The broth is clear, fragrant, and sweet, reminding me of the old days when I first started eating beef noodle soup.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siripong Phankiriya

restaurants.name: Lily Fu's - Authentic Thai Restaurant
restaurants.address:

18 Soi Sukhumvit 11 Klong toei nua, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honestly, I was a bit disappointed. Choose for the dim sum buffet after seeing a positive vdo review on Instagram.

First of all, the choices on the menu are very limited.  Especially, vegetarian and vegan choices are very few.

I expect, more variety on the buffet menu for the price of THB 549 ++ per person.

The quality of the dim sums is, for me, below average. When I had a talk with the responsible staff of that moment (manager was not there) she informed me that their own chef makes the dim sum not every day and freezes it. And that's what I was afraid of, it tasted like frozen before. Some even cannot compete with the 7Eleven dim sums. The garlic rice was good by the way.
I said to the responsible lady that I now understood why the restaurant was empty. Not nice maybe to say that, but that's what I felt.

The service was acceptable. No worries about that.

The atmosphere of this place is nice by the way.

For me, so far, a one time visit. But seeing the reviews of others, they will have (returning) customers anyways.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leo Schuur

sample_reviews_en.text: My wife and I sat in a restaurant on 7.7.26. We were staying at a nearby hotel (NYSA) and were looking for a place with password-protected Wi-Fi so we could book a flight and hotel in Phuket - we found this restaurant. We sat outside - most of the tables were free, and there were no people inside at all. It was hot, but the seating was in comfortable armchairs. I charged my laptop in an electrical outlet next to the table. We ordered Pad Thai with large seafood (420 baht, expensive compared to Thailand - see photo). The portion was not large, too sweet, and with a single small crab. Not much. We also ordered coconut tiramisu (250 baht, expensive compared to Thailand) which was just fine, and a Ziraat Coke (90 baht, expensive for Thailand) and an inverted coffee (110 baht - expensive for Thailand). The service was just fine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ofer Doron

sample_reviews_en.text:
Barry was absolutely amazing! From the moment we sat down, he made us feel welcome and took great care of us throughout the entire evening. His cocktails were excellent, his recommendations were spot on, and his friendly personality made the experience even better.

Barry is professional, attentive, and genuinely enjoys what he does. He went above and beyond to make sure we had a great time, and his positive energy was contagious. If you’re in Bangkok and have the chance to be served by Barry, you’re in for a fantastic experience.

Thank you, Barry, for making our night so memorable. We will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Margie Cordova

sample_reviews_en.text:
A great find for Asian cuisine lovers!
A lively and meticulously maintained restaurant on Sukhumvit Soi 11, with a modern, retro design and bright colors, and a truly pleasant atmosphere both inside and outside.
The extensive menu offers a true journey through Asian flavors: traditional Thai dishes, excellent dim sum, fluffy bao, and fusion specialties prepared with fresh ingredients and beautifully presented. The Asian-inspired cocktails are also excellent.
The staff is friendly, cheerful, and attentive. Perfect for both a quick lunch and a casual, tasty dinner with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Giuseppe Martorana

sample_reviews_en.text: Beautiful restaurant with indoor and outdoor seating. The restaurant is in a pretty busy/touristy area of Bangkok so the prices are a bit steep. However, they have an all you can eat dim sum special on Sunday that is a good deal. We got to order 15 dishes for 549bht each (two of us). Plenty of vegan and vegetarian stuff, too. The Mrs. Fu cocktail was a standout. Also, the lava bun are both good and an experience! Don’t sleep on those.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marianna Carlucci

sample_reviews_en.text: We had such a great experience that we came back a second time during our trip! The food was absolutely delicious on both visits, and everything was fresh and full of flavor. The atmosphere is warm, fun, and welcoming, which made our evenings even more enjoyable. If we're back in Bangkok next year, we'll definitely come here again. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuki Ayoki

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chinese restaurant in Mercure Bangkok SUKHUMVIT 11
Food is more of fusion style, like Chinese American style. If you are looking for authentic Chinese food this may not be the place. The food was great, very delicious. Love the taro coated with sugar and scallions. Other dim sum dishes were great. Each dish has its own special sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Srunrat Pat

sample_reviews_en.text: We started at the bar and Barry personally took care of us, we tried many of his cocktail creations and they were amazing, in fact the best cocktails we have had in Bangkok.  The food was outstanding and service was attentive and warm.  We would definitely recommend Lili Fu’s for both cocktails and food!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicole Davis

restaurants.name: On the Table - Central World
restaurants.address:

999/9, level 6, ศูนย์การค้าเซ็นทรัลเวิลด์, Ratchadamri Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here as a hijabi , ordered the shakshuka (arabic dish that originally has no meat) which had no description on the menu but the picture had bacon on top, so i asked the waiter to remove the meat and she agreed. I received the shakshuka with no pork on top but full of pieces inside, I told the waiter, she said the sauce is full of pork anyway and that’s what I ordered?! And they insisted on keeping it on the receipt.
We waited for the waffles for 30 mins after we finished our food, and when it arrived it had canned peach on top!!
Overall, extremely bad. One star.
sample_reviews_en.author: s a

sample_reviews_en.text: Went there with my friends. We ordered 4 parfaits and 1 toast. The toast comes well after we have finished the parfaits and no cutlery were given to eat the toast as well. The waiting person there was not friendly at all. We tried to ask for tissue but they pretended they didn't see us. We have to get up and go to the counter to get the tissues and cutlery. Horrible service. Doesn't worth the 10% service charge we had to pay. Won't go there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thae Khaing Thet

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just my personal opinion.
The service was poor. We ordered food and the first thing we asked for (!!!) was coffee. After three reminders and after we'd already eaten everything (the food was delicious), the coffee finally arrived. I waited about an hour for my order. Our good mood helped, and they tried to make fun of it. On the way out, they gave us a cosmetic bag and a discounted ticket for our next visit. I don't even know if we'll be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Лина Муравьева

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes great, every dish is delicious.
Both Western and Thai food.
Finally, we finished with dessert.
The prices are reasonable, and the restaurant offers set menus that you can choose from according to your preference.
It's our family's regular restaurant.
We always stop by this restaurant whenever we're in the area.
The staff are all lovely.
They are attentive and pay attention to detail in their service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paka G.

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent food and service. Staff are very helpful, welcoming and polite. Dishes are seasoned nicely. Pizza was very crunchy and flavorful. The salmon with cream spinach was the best dish I've tried there.  Sauce is super flavorful and salmon is cooked very well. Dessert (chocolate mouse) was also super delicious. It was creamy and crunchy with the biscoff. Definately a must try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Damian Chang

sample_reviews_en.text: Yummy and cute presentation of foods. Strawberry avocado salad 🍓🥑🥗 is must ordered. Love pasta and pork chop here. The atmosphere is quite noisy ambience since its location is right in the middle of department store. Prices can be quite high for solo or couples, when weighing serving portions and prices. So I recommend to go with big group of people and be able to share dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Madames Pagy

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was super delicious. I would say almost every dish we tried was so nice. We find it so nice that we went back 3 times within 4 days! 6 of us. Everyone of us was so amazed by the taste of the food. The staffs was also friendly with excellent service. That will be my next top choice on my next visit to BKK. A Sure top MUST GO list. Super highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dawn Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: We went for a 3 persons combo set for lunch and it was amazing. Good tastes super good as per menus. Staffs are friendly always offering assistance. Although on the day that we visit the AC in central world feels like a notch down making it hot while we are eating, when compared to their usual (freezing) temperature in the mall.
sample_reviews_en.author: NK Parker

restaurants.name: Karaarom Hotel
restaurants.address:

8 Napha Sap Alley, Lane 2, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pleasant Stay with a Few Room Limitations

We stayed at Karaarom Hotel from 12 to 15 August 2025, booking two rooms for five people. While the rooms were clean and well-equipped with a convenient kitchenette, they were more suitable for couples and not ideal for three guests. We had to book an additional room to accommodate the fifth person comfortably.

The welcome touch of fresh fruits was appreciated, and the staff on the ground floor were exceptionally courteous and helpful throughout our stay. The reception on the second floor was also friendly and efficient.

One highlight was the thoughtful gesture of preparing breakfast packs for us when we had to leave early for a tour—this really showed their attention to guest needs. The hotel’s location is also a plus, just a short walk from the BTS, making it easy to get around.

Overall, a pleasant stay with great service, though room arrangements could be more flexible for groups.
sample_reviews_en.author: djd4uable

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a wonderful stay at Karaarom Hotel. The Thai-style breakfast was one of the highlights — plenty of delicious options, and the menu changed daily, which made every morning enjoyable. The room was spotless, modern, and very comfortable, creating a relaxing atmosphere after a day out in Bangkok. All the staff were incredibly polite and attentive, always greeting guests with warm smiles and genuine care.

The only minor challenges were that the hotel is a bit far from the nearest train station, and the walk can be tricky due to heavy traffic. Also, the walls are a little thin, so you might occasionally hear noise from neighboring rooms.

Overall, it’s a lovely and well-managed hotel with great service and food — perfect for those looking for comfort, kindness, and a true sense of Thai hospitality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hajime A

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had such a pleasant stay at Karaarom Hotel. The room was really comfortable — clean, well-designed, and surprisingly spacious for the area. What I loved most was the overall vibe of the hotel: it feels jazzy, vintage, and warm in a way that immediately makes you relax.

The lobby and common areas have this soft, nostalgic atmosphere, almost like stepping into a cozy jazz bar mixed with an old-school boutique hotel. Every corner feels thoughtfully curated. Staff were friendly and helpful, and the location is super convenient without being noisy.

Overall, it’s a charming place with character — perfect if you like a stay that feels a bit more soulful than the usual modern chain hotels. I’d happily come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cindy Angelica

sample_reviews_en.text:
Karaarom was probably my best stay in Bangkok and in Thailand in general!
The location is central and quiet, the hotel is beautifully decorated, the rooms are big and spacious (even the smaller one which we stayed in for a day).
The breakfast is okay - more western option could be nice.
The beds are big and soft and the shower is very nice. Everything we needed happened with the help of the staff which was absolutely fantastic, especially Naam which i’d like to give a personal shout out to - i wanted to make an order of something to the other side of the city and she really helped me to get it done without any complications. In general she’s very kind and helpful. I’d 100% come back and recommend others to stay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mia Goldstein

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stayed at this hotel in Bangkok for a week and had a wonderful experience. The staff were incredibly kind, helpful, and always ready to assist with anything we needed. The rooms were very clean, tidy, and comfortable. The whole hotel was well-maintained and had a warm, welcoming atmosphere.

It’s also very affordable, but still has everything you need for a great stay. The breakfast was absolutely delicious – a perfect way to start the day.

The only small downside we noticed was that the room didn’t have a full-length mirror, which would have been nice to have.

Highly recommended if you're looking for a budget-friendly yet high-quality place to stay in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Галина Голикова

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a wonderful stay for a week at Karaarom! The location is great, just a 5-10 minute
walk to the BTS Thong Lo station and near to a lot of good spas, cafes and restaurants. Our personal favorites were Brewing Path for coffee and Jay Nahm for delicious crab curry and prawns.

The rooms were so cozy, we slept well every night. The breakfast in the morning was also very delicious and filling! We also got to use their in house laundry and gym, which was very useful for a week’s stay.

The staff were all warm, kind and attentive. We would definitely recommend this hotel for all our family and friends going to Bangkok! Thank you Karaarom ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Mikee Castro

sample_reviews_en.text: A 10mins walk to and from Thong Lor BTS, with eateries and a convenience store along the way, this hotel exceeded my expectations. From the welcome drink/ snack to the friendly and helpful staff, everything was smooth and fuss free.  I loved the room and they paid attention to all the details one could want in a holiday stay. Check out the roof top pool and garden with self service snack bar for those who want to hang out in a cosy environment with friends.
