The breakfast was nice too, with daily options of local dishes, pastries, fruits and salad. Usually I stay in Airbnb but I'm happy that I booked this hotel.
sample_reviews_en.author: louos

sample_reviews_en.text: Cosy hotel, with good breakfast but unfortunately had a bad experience because when we arrived at check-in, they told us they were having a staff party, so the restaurant and bar would close at 3:00 PM, we planned to eat there with our small child, so that was not possible anymore. The party turned into an extremely noisy situation with blaring music and karaoke/bingo until in the night. During the night, drunk staff members were lying in the hallway, and several hotel guests complained. I find it very unprofessional to throw such a party when the hotel is full, without any communication in advance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gizem Meijman

restaurants.name: Jim's Burger & Beer
restaurants.address:

3095 ปาก Sukhumvit Rd, บางนา Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Overpriced for the quality of food, drink, and service."

sample_reviews_en.text:
Jim’s Burger is an absolute 5-star gem! I’ve tried most of the burgers on their menu so far, and every single one has been consistently delicious, juicy, and packed with flavor. To top it off, their craft beer selection is fantastic, with around 7 to 10 great options on tap and in bottles that pair perfectly with the food.
​The restaurant itself is cozy and intimate, with only about 10 tables, but the atmosphere is unbeatable. The decor featuring beer cans gives it a really cool vibe, and catching the live band on select nights makes the experience even better. Because it’s so popular, it’s usually packed with customers, but it is well worth it. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great craft beer, mouthwatering burgers, and an awesome Western pub atmosphere!
sample_reviews_en.author: Phoo

sample_reviews_en.text: Jim's Burger and Beer in Bangkok is an absolute gem! The staff here are incredibly friendly and welcoming, making you feel right at home from the moment you walk in. The food is simply fantastic — each burger is expertly crafted, and the smash burger is a standout that you must try. The fries are crispy, flavorful, and perfectly seasoned, complementing the burgers perfectly. What I really appreciated was the reasonable pricing, making it a great spot for a satisfying meal without breaking the bank. Conveniently located just off BTS on Sukhumvit Road, it's an easy and convenient destination for delicious comfort food. Highly recommended for anyone craving great burgers, cold beer, and a friendly atmosphere!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thawn Lowing

sample_reviews_en.text: It's authentic burger and beer club. I ordered the lunch set wagyu beef burger, that comes with 3 pieces of onion rings that are super crispy and a soft drink (I picked root beer). Went back again after 5 months. Still good as gold. After upsizing, the bill was 285 baht. Not cheap but true value for money. It's lunch time and I wasn't in the mood for a beer, but I would come back for the beers another day. There are 8 selections of drafts to try! For burgers, I never order delivery, always dine in, coz I hate my burger cold and soggy. I'm so glad I dined in and the wagyu burger was sexy, juicy and buttery. Yum! I want to come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lawrence Ng

sample_reviews_en.text: WOW!!! I am officially obsessed with everything about this place. The atmosphere is pure IPA bar vibes in the best way and still somehow warm, welcoming, and not crowded at lunch. The Samata sour beer had me going back for thirds. The jalapeño poppers were the perfect balance of spice and creamy cheese and had me doing a full happy dance at the table. I will absolutely be thinking about them for a while. The beef on the burgers made my mouth water in the first bite. Do not be surprised if you see me here again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kayla Whitney

sample_reviews_en.text:
Okay, here are some short, casual examples:

"Huge burger, juicy meat, melty cheese, crispy bacon. Super filling, worth the price. Highly recommend 👍🍔"

"Meat lovers must try this. Thick patty, plenty of cheese. So satisfying, keeps you full until evening 😋"

"Delicious beyond expectations. Flavorful meat, lots of cheese. Huge burger, enough to fill you up if you eat it alone 🤤🍔"

"This menu item is truly amazing. Two patties, two slices of cheese. Delicious without needing many words ❤️"
sample_reviews_en.author: Dachasu Khetkhum

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a late review, we enjoyed this place two days in a row. My partner enjoyed the burgers and I loved the nachos very much!
They had some new sodas too which were different to your usual soda flavour but super fun!

Service was great, super friendly and polite which we love.

Great food and great staff and great chef. We moved a bit further down the road ..otherwise they would see us come in everyday!
sample_reviews_en.author: Carly Wigs

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of a very good burger place to visit. The burger tastes amazing here (highly recommended for burger menu).

I also try their beef kra prao rice before, very good as well but not as good as burger.

Amazing beer quality, although I dont have photo of the beer. The texture was smooth the taste was on point. A plus for craft soda if you don’t drink alcohol.

The atmosphere is good for afterwork hangout
sample_reviews_en.author: Metha Tanchatchawan

sample_reviews_en.text: They have a wide variety of draft beers, the food is served at a reasonable price and tastes good, it's a small, cozy place with a friendly vibe. (I tried the beef burger > juicy, perfectly balanced salty-sweet flavor, fresh vegetables, pickled olives to cut through the richness / the sausage was fragrant, overall delicious.) Finding parking might require some skill.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aphirak T. (NoTT)

restaurants.name: Just Salt Steak
restaurants.address:

2nd floor, Plubpla, 123 Soi ramkmheang53, Khwaeng Phlabphla, Khet Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I had planned to dine at this restaurant around 6 PM. I called beforehand but no one answered, so I decided to walk in. It turned out the staff said there were no tables available. There were only two other customers in the restaurant, and almost all the tables were empty. However, the staff made me wait for about 10 minutes, then apologized and said all the tables were reserved, even though the people who had reserved were also 10 minutes late. I would like to suggest improving your handling of walk-in customers. Not reserving a table for unreserved customers, especially when there are plenty of empty tables, is essentially refusing them service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumintra Unjit

sample_reviews_en.text:
My family and I went to the restaurant and ordered food without expecting it to be disappointing, having read reviews and checked the prices, so we anticipated a satisfactory experience.

However, the grilled beef tongue, which seemed like it had been deep-fried, and the three steak dishes (sirloin, tenderloin, Angus) were far below our expectations. The truffle spaghetti had a very faint, almost imperceptible truffle aroma, and the pizza had virtually no truffle flavor at all.

Honestly, we don't think we'll be returning due to the quality of the food.

However, the service and atmosphere were good and appropriate.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ali Thongkamwong

sample_reviews_en.text: This Halal restaurant is great. I especially liked the fried rice with grilled beef tongue. The grilled beef was delicious, the tongue was tender, and the salt served with it was tasty. The truffle mushroom spaghetti was flavorful. There are many menu options to choose from. The pizza is good; you can order two different toppings. Meat lovers should definitely try this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pu Pu

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and didn't take long to arrive. The staff were very helpful and gave great recommendations based on my preferences and desired cuts of meat. I highly recommend this place for a date with your significant other; they're sure to be impressed. The beef tongue is a must-try!
sample_reviews_en.author: tanapoom kongsilp

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted really good!
The price was reasonable and the staff provided excellent service.
The only downside was that the beef tongue in the spaghetti was a little dry.
But everything else was great and delicious!!!
I loved the beef fried rice the most!
sample_reviews_en.author: ชาบูนะครับ

sample_reviews_en.text:
This hidden gem of a restaurant is on the second floor, accessible via a spiral staircase.
The pizza has a great crust.
The stir-fried beef tongue with basil is delicious, and the tongue is tender and not chewy.
They do not serve alcoholic beverages.
sample_reviews_en.author: NIPON AROONRUANGSIRILERT

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating there, and all the food was delicious. The restaurant is on the second floor, and the stairs are quite steep and spiral, so you have to go up and down carefully. It's not suitable for people with mobility issues.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanut Govitsittinun

sample_reviews_en.text: Entering from a narrow alley, you reach a spacious parking lot, but you're left wondering what the restaurant will be like. You walk through the back of a noodle shop, turn into a passageway, and emerge at a yakiniku (Japanese BBQ) …
sample_reviews_en.author: 7ackie Srichompan

restaurants.name: โค ลิมิเต็ด เซ็นทรัลเวิลด์ - CO LIMITED central wOrld
restaurants.address:

7th Floor Central World 999/9 Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: While wandering around CentralWorld I happened to come across this restaurant. Had a hankering for some Pad Siew and the youg lady said they had it. I ordered the dish, a Som Tam Thai salad and Iced Lemon tea. The food was served quickly, the pad siew was a seafood mix, the portions were well sized and the food tasted delicious. The cost for the entire meal was 735 Thb, about 23.00 US. Pricier than real Thai street food but worth the money. Since I knew what I wanted I didn't get a chance to look over the menu but it seemed quite large.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fredric Prager

sample_reviews_en.text: Located on the 7th floor of the shopping center. We ordered tom yum soup, it was very tasty. I liked the seafood soup less, the fish, squid and shrimp were good, but the soup didn't taste very good to me. The mango smoothie was great. Excellent service, polite staff. I recommend this place to try Thai cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lana

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices are expensive compared to other restaurants but the taste is worse. There’s nothing special, a little bland compared to same dishes we had at Lay lao and other cheaper restaurants. Also, their portions are little less. Overall not satisfied in terms of value and taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuel Games

sample_reviews_en.text: The ambiance was fun and colorful to look at and be in. I got their rice meal with a beef patty, and mixing it together with the sauces and other ingredients made it stand out. Their tom yum was spicy for me, but its flavors were pretty good. A good lunch for my family and me!
sample_reviews_en.author: bianca carandang

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant smells like seafood heaven! I was blown away from the fantastic river shrimp glass noodle. Highly recommend! We were just in time for happy hour and enjoyed the beer get one buy one free discount 😚😆
sample_reviews_en.author: Chloe Li

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere so very chic, and gives the Thai experience! Food is phenomenal, and worth the price. Definitely worth the Michelin recognition! Thank you to Bo for a fantastic service!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jazmine Lo

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food, lovely ambiance, and above all, outstanding hospitality. The staff were professional, quick, and very polite. Thank you Co Limited for a perfect dining experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anh Bùi

sample_reviews_en.text: Thai cuisine. The Woon Sen was excellent and in general all the dishes were on point though the pork was a bit spicy, good thing they had the sauce on the side.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daphne Yeo

restaurants.name: Bella Casa
restaurants.address:

9, 11 Thoet Damri Rd, Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Bella Casa has a warm and private atmosphere, perfect for business meetings, meeting friends, or family meals. The food is reasonably priced, the portions are good value, and the taste is a perfect 10/10. I was very impressed on my first visit. We tried the Khao Chae (rice in chilled broth) set, which took a little while to prepare (about 40 minutes) because the restaurant carves and makes it fresh to order. Before leaving, we bought some cakes to share with my siblings and friends, and they said it was delicious and not too sweet. I'll definitely be back next time. It's now become one of my regular restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Enjoy eating

sample_reviews_en.text:
Favorite dishes:
Grilled pork neck with spicy dipping sauce (a must-try!)
Strongly flavored honey lemon tea
Stir-fried morning glory (using only the tender shoots)
Stir-fried water spinach noodles
Carrot cake, quince cake

Other dishes are also delicious.

Parking is limited.
And please prepare cash; credit cards are not accepted.
sample_reviews_en.author: Huala Lullaby

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant offers a diverse menu. Reservations are recommended as it gets very crowded.

Parking is available in front of the restaurant, with a sign indicating it's for the restaurant.

The prices are reasonable. The restaurant is not hot, and the air conditioning is comfortably cool.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cm MSR

sample_reviews_en.text: Haven't eaten here in years, but it's just as delicious as ever ☺️☺️ I love the stir-fried rice noodles with water spinach and the boneless chicken wings the most. I came at an unusual time, 2:30 PM, parked easily, and even got to sit at a swing table!
sample_reviews_en.author: piya

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is beautiful with a warm atmosphere. The food is delicious; my favorites are the green curry with pork ribs, stir-fried morning glory, and boneless chicken wings. The coconut cake is soft with smooth cream. The prices are a little high.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuengwong Tuaycharoen

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was slow to arrive. We ordered everything at once but they forgot some items. The staff were grumpy, cold, and didn't seem to feel any guilt.
People who came later received their food first. The service didn't match the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Touch InTouch

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, and the seafood, including the crab, fish, and squid, is very fresh. The service is good, and there's a place where kids can feed the fish. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuch S.

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu offers a wide variety of Thai and Western dishes. The food is delicious, the service is good, there is parking available, and the prices are
sample_reviews_en.author: Note Lekhakul

restaurants.name: Leng Tew Moo
restaurants.address:

1402 Banthat Thong Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We recently dined at this restaurant and tried their famous Tom Yum instant noodle with a variety of ingredients. While the dish was fairly good, it wasn't my favorite as I prefer a more tangy and strong flavor. However, it's a delicious option for those who enjoy a milder, less spicy Tom Yum.

We also had the shrimp and vermicelli bowl, which was excellent. It was my first time trying it, and I was very satisfied. The restaurant can get quite busy, especially during dinner, so plan accordingly. If you're looking for a milder Tom Yum noodle soup, this place is worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naw Hsu Ei Thin Zar (kk)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited this restaurant and had their spicy pork spine soup (Leng Zaab) and seafood basil stir-fry, both of which were absolutely delicious. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, making the experience even more enjoyable.

We arrived during a rainstorm and were fortunate to find shelter there. Enjoying a hot bowl of soup while listening to the sound of the rain created a wonderfully cozy moment. The flavorful, steaming soup was the perfect comfort on a chilly, rainy day, making the meal even more memorable. I would definitely love to come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khun PB.Travel

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing combination of different cuisine that awakens your taste buds. The Leng picture alone makes me drool and realising it in reality is just heavenly. Being a Singaporean, sour and spicy food is just our love language. Love the springy noodles, tom yum mama and my 5yo boy is just crazy about the Japanese curry rice is the reason for patronising every day when we are in bkk.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jasmine Yeo

sample_reviews_en.text: I was searching for an alternative to satisfy my craving for Tom Yum instant noodles instead of going to the busy Jeh O. When I passed by this eatery, I decided to give it a try. The food tasted good, and the portion size was decent. Many patrons were ordering the pork spine bowl, so I plan to come back next time to try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sontos

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum and Pork Spine soup here are great. You don't need to queue long and can dine in AC peacefully. The young coconut pudding is so good that we ordered multiple for each person. The boiled pork and chicken is so soft. I will try the Japanese menu next time I visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khant St

sample_reviews_en.text: The food didn’t take long to arrive and looked exactly like the photos—very appetizing. Every dish we ordered tasted great. The staff were especially friendly, polite, and attentive, which made the experience even better. Prices were reasonable and worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Passaporn Na Songkhla

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you want to eat authentic Je O's style instant noodles at a fair price, I recommend this place.

They use good quality ingredients; the shrimp is fresh and plump, the mussels are very fresh, and the instant noodles taste great to Thai people.
sample_reviews_en.author: GowGow Vee

sample_reviews_en.text: The Lèng (pork spine spicy and sour soup) stole the show tonight. Its flavorful broth was simply divine, and the pork spine was tender to perfection. Paired with a bowl of fragrant Thai rice, it was a match made in heaven. I'm usually quite …
sample_reviews_en.author: Danzler Alan Smith

restaurants.name: Baan Suriyasai
restaurants.address:

174 Surawong Rd, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Heritage-style exterior with a renovated mix of old-and-new interior. Beautiful plating. Traditional palace-style Thai food. Taste may differ from modern Thai palates. Wonderful classy “ย้อนยุค” atmosphere and decor. Good experience.
sample_reviews_th.author: Sirawich S. (tonsonsirawich)

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a wonderful evening at this restaurant. The historic building is beautifully designed and creates a special, elegant atmosphere. The entire ambiance reflects a great attention to detail.

The food also impressed us: every dish was delicious and beautifully presented. The portions could be a bit larger, but the quality of the ingredients and the preparation were truly excellent. We especially recommend the crispy pancakes – a real highlight!

The only slight drawback is that parts of the restaurant were being renovated during our visit. As a result, we were seated in the Tea Room right next to the street, where the traffic noise was quite noticeable. This was a bit of a shame, but it should only be temporary.

Overall, this beautiful building is definitely worth a visit, and we would gladly return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jan

sample_reviews_en.text:
A fine Thai restaurant in the middle of Bangkok business district. With welcoming hospitality, finest cuisine and easy elegant atmosphere, Baan Suriyasai promises to unwind any guest visiting.

The restaurant is a renovated historical rocal residence. Even though it is located in the busiest area of Bangkok, the ambiance inside is so leisurely relaxing. It serves royal Thai cuisines. Every plates are cooked following the original royal recipe. The food were tasty. Besides, the vibe is flawless like dining in a lush garden.

Apart from the restaurant, there is a gorgeous bar upstairs opening in the evening. It is finely decorated with a classy style. So impressive! On the opposite of the restaurant located the elegant tea room. An afternoon tea set is served from 2.00-6.00 pm.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charukit Rattananaka

sample_reviews_en.text:
A truly unique and refined restaurant, light years ahead of anything Bangkok has to offer in terms of gastronomy.

Flavors to discover, authentic cuisine likely rooted in a very ancient culinary tradition.

A delight for my eyes, and especially for my taste buds... For a more than reasonable price, since a starter, main course, dessert, original cocktail, and mineral water came to 1509.5 THB, or €40 or CHF 36.

We're talking about a gourmet restaurant, a real one...

And for traditional dishes elsewhere in a proper restaurant, you'll be hard-pressed to pay €7 less.

It's truly a place to discover, a refined and comfortable setting, top-notch service, and culinary artists.

I very rarely write reviews, so this restaurant truly deserves it.

I will definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Frédéric Dumusois

sample_reviews_en.text: The services were absolutely exceptional, and the food was truly exquisite—perfect for hosting my international business guests. They were thoroughly impressed. The menu exudes sophistication, with a meticulous attention to detail that highlights the craftsmanship behind each dish. Every item is prepared using royal recipes. The Tom Yum Rover Prawn (a traditional style Tom Yum Goong) is a must-try, as are the Five-Spice Stew with medium-boiled eggs. I particularly enjoyed the desserts, including the Raspberry Jelly-filled Lychee in rose syrup, Coconut Milk Ice Cream, and Mahachanok Mango Ice Cream with an array of toppings. Adjacent to the restaurant is a stylish bar under the same ownership, offering an elegant and luxurious setting for a relaxing evening.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kulthirath Pakawachkrilers

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you are looking for the ultimate Thai dining experience that truly maintains the traditional and authentic flavors, I highly recommend this restaurant!

The taste of the food here is unparalleled and hard to match. It truly reflects the meticulous care taken in the cooking process. Every dish we ordered was deeply delicious and full of the unique character of classic Thai cuisine.

While the price point is high, it is absolutely commensurate with the quality of ingredients and the excellent service received. The staff were very attentive, polite, and provided superb care.

For anyone who desires to taste "truly authentic Thai food" coupled with outstanding service and an impressive atmosphere, this restaurant is the ultimate choice you should not miss!
sample_reviews_en.author: Paris Carlsson

sample_reviews_en.text:
We dined like royals at Baan Suriyasai, where we indulged in the warmth and charm of old world Thai-style hospitality within the compounds of an elegantly restored 1900-era heritage site. Known for presenting authentic Thai flavors adhering to the kitchen wisdom long practised in the Thai royal court, Baan Suriyasai is a beautiful and magnificent experience to enjoy.

Our meal comprised the exquisite and time-honoured Pomelo Salad with River Prawns, Sour Soup with Crispy Shrimp, and Crab Omelette, accompanied by Riceberry. The salty, sour and umami flavours danced on our tongues, enhanced with sweet watermelon and tangy lemongrass mocktails.

This was unforgettably one of our favourite dining venues of our time in Thailand. 👑👩🏻‍🤝‍👨🏼🍽️
sample_reviews_en.author: NinaBelle Travels

sample_reviews_en.text:
In a word: WOW. This restaurant delivered in every way. It was a meal shared between four friends, each ordered a different dish and we shared. All were absolutely worthy of the multi-year Michelin star. The standouts (among a table of standouts) were the rendang beef curry, the fried spring rolls, and the blue ruby ice desert. Cost per person for our group, 4, with alcoholic drinks, appetizers, mains, and 2 deserts: US $50/each. Totally worth it.

Service was helpful, kind and efficient. The space is gorgeous and makes you feel you’re someplace quite special (because you are). Only item that could be improved is dimming rhthe lights for a more relaxing ambiance. We will return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Globetrotting Gourmand

restaurants.name: Gyukatsu Permpalung Sukhumvit 39
restaurants.address:

47 5 Sukhumvit 39, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The beef was excellent in quality—very tender, juicy, and well-prepared. Considering the quality, the price was very reasonable. It’s a great option for families, especially for kids who truly love beef. Everyone enjoyed it, and we would definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cacharin Sanpakit

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a family favor! It’s always a treat coming here and if you are careful what you order it’s a bargain. I highly recommend this place if you are craving some delicious simple barbecue. And make sure to ask for the shaved cabbage on the side.
sample_reviews_en.author: joao siegel

sample_reviews_en.text: My recent visit to Gyukatsu Permpalung Sukhumvit 39 left me thoroughly satisfied. The gyukatsu itself was expertly prepared, with a beautiful crisp exterior and a juicy, tender interior. The beef's texture was exceptional, truly melting in …
sample_reviews_en.author: Ben C

sample_reviews_en.text: Not authentic at all. I’ve had gyukatsu multiple times when I visited in Japan, and this doesn’t even come close. The slices were wayyy too thin and the seasoning was overly salty. I also have no idea why kimchi was served as a side dish. …
sample_reviews_en.author: T

sample_reviews_en.text: An authentic Japanese taste with a carefully crafted Gyukatsu. I was really impressed in the tenderly sliced cutlets, the wonderfully attentive staff, and the clean yet simple interior of the restaurant. …
sample_reviews_en.author: J K

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Gyukatsu is great ! The price for the meat is good and the quality is ok !
The concept very nice and the food come quickly!
You make by yourself that you can choose the cooking size:) …
sample_reviews_en.author: dor gross

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! It really helped me miss the restaurant in Osaka. The meat was crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. The staff provided good service and the atmosphere was nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamolchanok Kongsiri

sample_reviews_en.text: One of my fav BBQ restaurants. If you like Gyuukatsu in Japan, you silly love it here. There are varieties of meat and they got pork too. Free parking available at nearby alley.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornchanok Ch.

restaurants.name: ลูกชิ้นรสเยี่ยม
restaurants.address:

7 66 Chok Chai 4 Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my favorite noodle shop, one I drive all the way from Rangsit to eat at regularly 😅 Everything is perfect, from the broth and meatballs to the noodles themselves. Especially the meatballs, they are incredibly delicious 😁 I have to give them a thumbs up because they are truly the best. The shop is clean, the service is good, and the tea is fragrant and free. Parking can be a bit difficult to find. In short, if you like beef meatballs, you absolutely MUST try this place!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: dear

sample_reviews_en.text: This small noodle shop occupies one room and has a cart in front serving as the kitchen. They offer a variety of noodle types, but no rice, so you'll need to bring your own if you want to eat your noodle soup with rice. The clear broth with thin rice noodles and meatballs (without sprouts) is served piping hot. The highlight is the fragrant and delicious tendon meatballs with tender tendons. The broth is flavorful with fried garlic, making the whole bowl a perfect combination.
sample_reviews_en.author: Torpong Chiamtawongse

sample_reviews_en.text: I drove past and it looked delicious, so I parked on the side of the road in front of the shop in that row of buildings. I bought some to take home and reheated it. It smelled amazing. My child said it was delicious. I don't eat meat myself, but judging from the smell and the way my child looked in the bowl, it must be really good. Parking is difficult at this shop; you really have to park on the side of the road in front of other people's shops.
sample_reviews_en.author: Muchkin

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a clear beef noodle soup. The broth is very light and refreshing, perfect for those who like a mild flavor. Those who prefer stronger flavors can easily add their own seasonings. The tendon meatballs here are delicious; I really liked them. My only dislike is the thin noodles; they clump together, both in the soup and dry versions.

The price is very reasonable: 50 baht for a regular serving and 60 baht for a special serving.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kewalee S.

sample_reviews_en.text: Although this is  one small noodle shop but do not make mistake and pass this without trying their meat ball noddle with or without soup. The noddle is very delicious with juicy meat ball ( made themselves not commercial made). Price is very good. Starting from 50 baht. However, there is not parking lot but you can park one next to side walk on street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nitiwat lertviwatkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a noodle shop serving clear broth beef noodles. The highlight is the meatballs. The fresh beef is marinated to be tender and not chewy. The flavor is just right, not too salty. Regular is 50 baht, special is 60 baht. I recommend getting the special for a satisfying meal.
Parking is available along the roadside near the shop, or in Soi 53.
sample_reviews_en.author: yimp yimpdow

sample_reviews_en.text:
This clear broth beef noodle soup, a style that's quite hard to find these days, is excellent thanks to the meatballs, which the shop makes in-house. They're firm, not gamey, and delicious.
I recommend ordering a bowl of rice vermicelli noodles with just boiled meatballs. Sipping the hot, clear broth is perfectly filling. 🍜
sample_reviews_en.author: Tae Poonlasak

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating this for 20 years, from childhood until my hair turned gray. It's still as delicious as ever. The person who packs it remembers the customers. They give you lots of sprouts in the chicken breast. Their chili powder is incredibly delicious, unlike any other.
sample_reviews_en.author: J T

restaurants.name: Sushi Sekiji
restaurants.address:

62/5-6, Si Lom Rd, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Reasonable priced, tasty, and high quality pork steak!"

sample_reviews_th.text:
Found this gem on Google Maps and it's truly a delightful discovery
In the heart of Silom, I decided to explore some sushi and try their à la carte options. The flavors were outstanding and satisfying, each dish crafted meticulously 🎉 The variety of à la carte items offered is pleasantly broad, allowing me to tailor my meal to my taste
The ambiance is calm and the staff's attentiveness is just right. All in all, great value and wonderful dining experience — I’ll definitely be back for an omakase night with friends!

ข้าวซูชิร้านนี้อร่อยมากกกกก จะกลับมาอีกค่ะ
sample_reviews_th.author: Serious food eater

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you love deep fired and Japanese delicate taste, here is your choice. The crust is thin and broken gently on bite. The most impressive is the simple asparagus and cream crab croquet.

2021:  After the COVID-19 attack, the restaurant is seemed to repositioning. The price is reducing from what we usually paid 2000 THB per head to approx. 700 THB per head.  No more delicate taste, no more excellent raw materials.  I thus reduced from 5 stars to 3 stars

2022 March: The restaurant started a new line, soba and udon.  Three visits during 3 first week, the soba was unstable. Served soba was different and never repeated during three visit. Though the soba quality is acceptable, but one cannot expect fragrance of soba in this hand-made soba. The most impressive could be inari sushi.
The service and staff is strongly recommend to improve.  There are always some mistake or missing our order, not only one time but every time we visit and could be more than 2-3 mistakes in a visit. Every visit, we found staffs loudly argued among them that totally ruin a good atmosphere for dining.  I reduced 3 stars to 2 stars and removed from my favorite place.  Let's see if the restaurant can improve.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jongrak Kitti

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve visited this restaurant every time I travel to Bangkok and have dined here somewhere between 10 and 20 times over the years. Every previous visit left me satisfied, which is why this experience was so disappointing.

We spent around THB 8,000 for two people, yet most of the dishes consisted of dried fish, pickled items, and cooked dishes rather than the fresh seafood I had come to expect. We ordered uni as an extra, but unfortunately it did not seem very fresh either.

Most importantly, almost every dish was excessively salty. I can honestly say there wasn’t a single dish that I truly enjoyed. The tempura was probably the best item of the meal, which says a lot.

The level of craftsmanship and attention to the dining experience that I remembered from the previous chef seems to be gone. To make matters worse, none of the staff asked about our dining experience afterward.

After so many consistently enjoyable visits, this was by far my most disappointing experience here. Unfortunately, the only way I can share that feedback is by posting this review.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wingho Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited this sushi spot based on a friend's recommendation, and it was my first time there. I ordered the omakase set, and the experience was truly delightful. Each piece of sushi was a masterpiece, with perfectly seasoned warm rice and fresh fish that melted in my mouth. The variety of the menu was impressive, allowing me to choose from an extensive selection of à la carte options to complement my meal.

The ambiance was serene, and the chefs’ skillful yet understated movements added to the calming atmosphere. The service was attentive without being intrusive, making me feel welcomed throughout my dining experience.

Being in the heart of Silom, it offers a wonderful setting for both a leisurely lunch and an intimate dinner. The sushi and omakase offerings are reasonably priced, which made the experience even more satisfying. I’m already looking forward to my next visit, perhaps to try more seasonal specialties and dive deeper into their extensive menu options! 🍣✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Namsom Sarocha

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently had the pleasure of visiting a sushi restaurant in Silom after hearing about it through a personal recommendation. It was my first time there, and I opted for the "Chef's Choice" omakase menu, which was truly delightful. Each piece of sushi was crafted with precision, the rice perfectly warm, enhancing the fresh flavors of the fish.

The ambiance was serene, and the staff's attentiveness made my dining experience even more enjoyable. What impressed me was the extensive à la carte menu, offering a wide range of choices to suit all moods and preferences 😊

Given the quality and variety, the price felt just right. I'm already looking forward to my next visit, eager to explore more seasonal sushi delights in this lovely spot. ✨
sample_reviews_en.author: P90 Meister

sample_reviews_en.text:
A friend recommended this place, so it was my second visit for their signature sushi omakase course. The flavors were truly satisfying, with warm and tender shari and fresh, well-cut fish that melted in my mouth. The staff, both waiters and chefs, were incredibly friendly and made the experience delightful.

I also appreciated the wide variety of à la carte options, which made it easy to add something new to try. The atmosphere is cozy with just the right touch of elegance, creating a pleasant dining experience in Silom. 😊

For anyone seeking exquisite sushi or an omakase experience, this spot offers excellent value and delightful service. I look forward to returning and exploring more of their seasonal offerings!
sample_reviews_en.author: robert barateo

sample_reviews_en.text:
I discovered this place through a friend's recommendation and decided to try the omakase menu. The sushi was absolutely delightful, with flavors that truly impressed me. Each piece was crafted with care, and the balance of flavors was exquisite. It was my first visit, and the ambience was warm and welcoming, complemented by the attentive service.

Located in Silom, the restaurant offers a wide selection of à la carte options, making it easy to personalize your dining experience. With great food and service, I’m eager to return and explore more of their sushi offerings. The overall value was excellent, and I look forward to sharing this experience with friends! 🍣✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Wipawan Sinlapasert

sample_reviews_en.text:
I discovered this fantastic restaurant while browsing Google Maps for a new place to try. Being my first visit, I opted for the à la carte menu and was extremely satisfied with the fresh, high-quality ingredients seasoned to perfection. The service was impeccable, and the ambiance was very comfortable.😊

The extensive selection of à la carte options was a pleasant surprise, allowing for a personalized dining experience. Located in Silom, this spot offers great value for money, and I highly recommend it if you're in the mood for sushi or an omakase treat. I'm already looking forward to returning and exploring more seasonal offerings with friends! 🍣
sample_reviews_en.author: R YW Chung

restaurants.name: เจนจิตร - ขนมไทย หวานเย็น ปัง นมสด
restaurants.address:

666 มิศาชล ซอย 5 Bang Phai, Bang Khae, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
#You won't be missing out if you don't try these:

- The sticky rice has a faint burnt smell.
- The custard toast is average, nothing special. The palm sugar ice cream isn't fragrant either.
- Theลอดช่อง (Thai dessert with coconut milk and pandan jelly) is better with coconut milk.
sample_reviews_th.author: mhee gmail

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my third time eating here. On previous visits, I was very satisfied. However, this time I ordered the "Khanom La" (a type of Thai dessert) with ice cream and the "Lod Chong" (a type of Thai dessert with pandan jelly and palm sugar sauce). I won't comment on the taste or price, as that's a matter of personal preference. But what I found unacceptable was that the Lod Chong was clumped together like whale vomit. They gave me a bubble tea straw that I couldn't use. When I asked the staff, she said, "That's how it's supposed to be."

Another issue was the water in the dispenser; the water flow was almost nonexistent. I initially thought it was empty, so I asked the staff to refill it. She checked and said the same thing again, "That's just how it's supposed to be."

Anyway, my previous visits were positive. Please train your staff to have better service mind. This time, it felt like I was begging for food, even though I paid full price. 🐱
sample_reviews_en.author: Krittin Honglumpong

sample_reviews_en.text: The Bua Loy (Thai dessert with glutinous rice balls in coconut milk) was terrible; the balls were ice cold, and the coconut milk and coconut were only lukewarm. I only ate a little and threw the rest away. I ordered the Lod Chong (Thai dessert with coconut milk and coconut milk in syrup), it looked good but tasted sour – I don't know if that's normal. The staff weren't good; they were more interested in their phones than trainees. This is the first time I've given a review, and this is from a real customer. Improvements are needed. The idea is good, but the staff preparing the food are awful. Even the Lod Chong was served with sticky sugar syrup that left a mess on my hands – they didn't even care. I think you can get better and cheaper food at a street market if this is the kind of service they provide.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gun n rose xxx

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The shaved ice dessert had thin coconut milk, causing it to separate into layers on the ice when eaten.
- The two-tone sweet potato with coconut milk topping had little sweet potato and a bitter/astringent taste (possibly specific to the dish I received).
- The steamed bread with custard in all three flavors was diluted (palm sugar, milk, pandan). Only the Thai tea was acceptable.
- The lod chong ice cream had a stiff texture, and the lod chong noodles were dry and hard.
- The shaved ice with palm sugar topping tasted better than the other menu items.
- The staff were attentive but took the wrong order, resulting in the customer having to pay for items not ordered.
- The restaurant has air conditioning, but there was a cigarette smell.
sample_reviews_en.author: PH ZH

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there based on reviews to celebrate Mother's Day with my mom. She only ate a little 😢. The cendol (Thai or Singaporean cendol) could have been more clearly identified; the noodles were like Singaporean cendol, hard and knotty, and the taste wasn't great. The bread was tiny and very bland, not worth the price. The pomegranate dessert was served in a very small, plain cup, also not worth the price. We ordered 5 items but only received 4 – we only realized this later. The atmosphere in the restaurant was completely undecorated, and the seating was cramped. We braved the rain to go there, and it was a disappointment 😔.
sample_reviews_en.author: TATPASORN KUNSUMARSO

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was incredibly dirty. I ordered grass jelly with milk, and when the employee served it, her fingers were completely dipped into the bowl when she placed it down. We ate it between two people and paid almost 200 baht. It's been 3-4 weeks since then, and I still regret spending the money.
These days, it's hard to find delicious food. I've been a victim of KOLs (Key Opinion Leaders) before, trying out many restaurants based on their reviews. This restaurant was no different; it was just another place that people were paid to review. I was so disappointed after trying it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittipat Kittiyano

sample_reviews_en.text:
Can't say it's worth the hype. The Thai dessert dishes aren't much better than the classic ones you can get from slightly bigger markets, but way pricier. The store is small and decorated to look retro but with minimum effort.

The service is mid at best. A good bit of the menu isn't even on the menu itself (they kinda just framed a photo of tiktok screenshot and that's one of the thing you can order).

Ordered hot white malt milk, got cold but they did switch it out for me. I don't really smell white malt so it could have been another wrong order but I wouldn't know.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Angry Stringinstrument

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered steamed buns with pandan custard dip and creamy milk dip. The custard tasted okay, but the milk dip tasted like artificial milk, not fresh milk.

For drinks, I ordered taro mochi with less-sweetened milk. The milk tasted good and was genuinely less sweet, but the taro paste was so sweet it made my throat hurt. Once mixed in, it was extremely sweet.

Overall, the taste was mediocre and the prices were overpriced. Toast was 50-55 baht per slice, and they even increased the price by 5 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: sirirat jiranapakul

restaurants.name: NIKU NIKU Japanese BBQ(Phra Khanong-Ekkamai Branch)
restaurants.address:

1056 Sukhumvit Rd, Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
-The total bill came to 4,500 baht (2 premium sets, 1 kimchi soup, 1 sashimi set, 1 rib pork, 2 beef dishes, and 3 bowls of steamed rice, water and 1 singha beer). However, I think around 3,500 baht would have been more than enough, since I also had to take leftover food home.
-The grilled meat and sashimi were very delicious, but the kimchi soup was really fishy. The meat in the soup was all fat, and even now I still feel uncomfortable and almost nauseous when I think about it.
If you order a set, it has to match the number of guests, with each set meant for two people. So if you go as four, you must order two sets at the same price.
I went with three adults and one 3-year-old child (the child also enjoyed eating wagyu beef and had about 150g).

-The restaurant was crowded, but there were too few staff members. They all looked very busy, yet still couldn’t serve customers quickly enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hải Anh Nguyễn

sample_reviews_en.text:
When I entered the restaurant, I asked a staff member if there was a table available for two. The staff didn’t answer my question but turned to chat with a colleague instead. So, I stood waiting at the entrance until another staff member came to speak with me, and then I asked again if there was a table for two. That’s when I finally got a table.

If you want to get the dishes shown on the cover/menu photos, you have to order at least two sets, which means you end up paying double. I don’t mind the price itself, but I do have an issue with the fact that when paying by credit card they charge an extra 3%, yet there was no sign or notice about this—I looked around carefully.

The staff also didn’t grill the vegetables that were left on the tray for me, so I’m not sure if they were reused or thrown away. The day I went, the place was quite crowded. The taste of the food was okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yujin ficrobert

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hands down one of the best Japanese BBQ buffets around Phra Khanong! The meat quality totally beats other stores at the same price range. There are plenty of selections: marbled beef short rib, pork belly, fresh shrimp and assorted sushi. The homemade dipping sauces match grilled meat perfectly.
Service is top-tier—staff check our table regularly to change grill paper and bring new plates right after we order. The environment is cozy with Japanese-style decor, air conditioning works well and there’s no heavy smoke inside.
Perfect spot for group dinners. Highly recommend to anyone craving authentic yakiniku in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Xuanshuo Yang

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant food is not bad. Truffle fried rice was actually good. Meat quantity is small but at the same time, it is not too expensive. It could be an OK restaurant but few disturbing things: out of the numerous staff only 1 people wanted to work and was nice with us. The rest of the staff stands still, not friendly. The dishes and silver are a bit dirty. The big negative point is: give a 5 stars recommendations on google so you have a free drink. So i gave 5 stars and had to edit my post after. That could explain why this restaurant is so well ranked on Google Maps, that’s not reflecting the truth.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tan NGUYEN

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a really great time here! The meat was so good and everything tasted really fresh. The best part was the staff—they helped grill everything for us and made sure each piece was cooked just right, which made the whole meal so much more enjoyable.

The service was friendly and attentive, and everyone made us feel really welcome. Definitely one of the better yakiniku experiences I’ve had. Will be coming back for sure!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ong Mia

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing food in an amazing environment, very close to the Sukhumvit centre. And great service. Highly recommendable from a dining experience perspective!

The only drawback is that they charge a 3% fee for card payments. When you get such an amount of a bill (because of the type of food, not that the place itself is crazily expensive), it’s not fare to pass the card scheme fees to the customer 🙃
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex Gene

sample_reviews_en.text: Craved for yakiniku and found this one randomly. Turn out it was a good choice. They served with the real charcoal grill. The food was authentic and delicious. They provided sets to order so you can try various kinds of meat in one go. Price was reasonable. Waitress were nice. They are kind enough to come out and lead us to the parking area. It was a good place for yakiniku and chill out.
sample_reviews_en.author: carmen ng

sample_reviews_en.text:
Best value yakinuku I've had in Bangkok. When I saw the prices I was expecting small portions but they're actually very generous. The quality of the meat is excellent for the price, and also the staff are really friendly.
The only negative - it felt a little bit disorganised, but I was there a few weeks ago and they hadn't been open long, so I'm sure they've fixed that by now.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adam

restaurants.name: Mama Pook noodles ก๋วยเตี๋ยวคอหมูย่าง 泰式正宗妈妈面馆 - Park Silom
restaurants.address:

2nd Floor, Park Silom, 1 Convent Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food - The menu offers a wide variety of dishes, including rice and noodles (dry/soup/no-soup), snacks, and drinks. Even those who don't want noodles can enjoy rice or snacks. The food is delicious, especially the plum soup.

Atmosphere - Located on the 3rd floor of Park Silom building, it's convenient and easy to find.

Service - I'm deducting points here because the staff member's tone of voice wasn't pleasant, and their communication with customers was rather impolite.

When customers wanted to pay via Thai Plus, the staff informed them upfront that splitting the bill wasn't possible. This led to customers having to remind the staff member that it worked last time before they finally asked if all customers had Thai Plus accounts before allowing payment.

Additionally, the food was served much slower than expected, and there was a queue system, forcing customers to personally inquire about their orders at the kitchen.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sireethorn Sutthiporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem noodle shop in Park Silom building! It's famous for its grilled pork neck noodles, with a taste like mom's home cooking. You can choose your noodle type: round egg noodles, flat egg noodles, or thin rice noodles. Topped with crispy pork cracklings, fried garlic, and their signature pickled chili (you can choose your spice level). Other dishes are also excellent. Prices start from tens of baht to a little over a hundred baht. Perfect for Silom office workers!

Dishes we tried:
🍜 Grilled Pork Neck Noodles
🌶 Tom Yum Soup (with various toppings)
🍚 Dry Rice Porridge (with various toppings)
🍲 Minced Pork with Plum Sauce
🥡 Spicy Thin Rice Noodle Salad with Pork Cracklings
🍠 Mixed Fried Sweet Potatoes
sample_reviews_en.author: nutsfoodjourney

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dishonest, cold food, AVOID!
This restaurant had fliers up at every table and an accompanying listing on their menus that advertised a given price for a dish/combo. However, when we received the bill, they charged us a much higher price than advertised. When confronted about this, the staff—including the manager—appeared to “not understand” the problem for quite some time. Eventually, they said that the lower amount was an “old” price, and they insisted on charging the higher than advertised price at checkout.  Some of the dishes also came out cold after a very long wait. HORRIBLE experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Iris “Iris” Pan

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is good, but not overly strong; it's more of a city-style, moderate flavor. They put a lot of fried shallots and garlic in it, which is good. Everything is dry and looks clean. The portion sizes aren't large. There's plenty of seating, but there are few staff members, so service can be hectic. If you come on a weekday during lunchtime, you might have to wait in line because there are many office workers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pearploy Stp.

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the recommended pork cheek noodles, and overall it was quite good. The mild spicy flavor was quite spicy but very fragrant. Adding some fried pork dumplings also made it quite flavorful. The only downside was that the lemon black tea was too acidic, and it didn't taste like freshly squeezed lemon juice, but that could just be a matter of personal taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: 戴瑞億

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is located inside a shopping center with a wide variety of restaurants and shops.

The dishes are very well described on the menu. The service was good.

The food quality is exceptional, and the pork dish was incredible.

I eat quite a lot, and the portion was very, very generous. I'll definitely be back before I get back from vacation!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bruno R.

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food, reasonably priced. Served very quickly and by a lovely server. We were sad when it was finished we enjoyed the food that much! We weren’t sure what to expect in an office building but it’s well worth getting off the street and enjoying a meal in the aircon for once.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julia Ruane

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eyeing this place for a while. I love the grilled pork noodles; they remind me of the old-fashioned sweet pork noodles I used to eat as a kid – wow! The flat noodles are chewy and springy. The broth is well-made. The Tom Yum is a bit too spicy, but overall it's okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wat

restaurants.name: Baan Baan Bang Kra Jao
restaurants.address:

Bang Krasop, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Baan Baan Bang Kracha Restaurant
A delicious restaurant with a fantastic atmosphere located in Bang Krachao, Soi Phetchahung 20. Open from 11:00 AM to 9:00 PM.
It's a restaurant that also offers accommodation. Enjoy the Chao Phraya River view with delicious food at reasonable prices (hundreds of baht per dish) and million-dollar views.
There's an outdoor area by the river or you can sit inside with air conditioning.
The food is delicious, both savory and sweet. The service is excellent, and the staff are lovely and talkative.
A family of otters can be seen swimming around and greeting you periodically.
There's a sign at the entrance; the soi (lane) is narrow, but there's plenty of parking inside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sinisha Bejrananda

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and there's a wide variety of savory dishes, baked goods, and desserts. I especially liked the stir-fried morning glory with shrimp paste and the homemade omelet – I'd never tried an omelet with dried chilies before! The German sausage was also good. Other dishes were decent too. The restaurant is right by the river. Coming around 5 pm is perfect; the weather isn't too hot, and you can take great photos by the river. The owner is very friendly, and it seems like they also have accommodation. If you're visiting Bang Krachao and have some free time, you should definitely check it out!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ntm L.

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Krua Baan Baan" (Home-Style Kitchen) gives you the feeling of eating at a relative's house, but with Michelin-level taste. The clear tom yum soup, stir-fried morning glory with shrimp paste, and basil omelet are all incredibly delicious and perfectly suited to Thai palates. The fried beef with fish sauce is tender and not chewy, and the seafood dipping sauce is fantastic.

Just to reiterate, for those who saw "Road Closed" on Google Maps, that's NOT true. You can still drive there normally. The restaurant is packed because the food is delicious, the view is great, and the weather is nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pariyanuch Korangkool

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant on the Bangkrachao island close to town. The location is alright, unfortunately the road to drive there quite limited.

Food: The ingredients is really fresh and really good. We order many menus without pork, however five or more dishes we order really good original tastes and amazing Thai food. Totally understand them on this business and really good one.

Service: Good and attentive staff by check satisfaction all the time while we were dinner.

Atmosphere: Good view of ChaoPraya river. The view over the local River and great to support all clients.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwanchai Quinzy Yokto

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The restaurant is located in Bang Krachao, the entrance might be a little hidden.
- There is parking for about 20-30 cars.
- There are about 5 bungalows available for staycation.
- The restaurant atmosphere is quite peaceful and located right by the water.
- Great vibe, popular with foreign tourists.
- The food is diverse, very well-prepared and delicious in every dish. ***
- Relaxing music is played while you eat.
- Craft beer and craft soda (house-made recipes) are available for purchase.
- If I'm in Bang Krachao again, I'll definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pae Pae

sample_reviews_en.text: Baan Baan Bang Krachao restaurant is a combination restaurant, cafe, and even a bar, offering a complete range of food and drinks. It's located right by the Chao Phraya River, facing the Samrong side, allowing diners to relax and enjoy the surrounding atmosphere while they eat. The staff are very attentive, regularly checking on the food and drinks to ensure they're to your liking. This place is suitable for groups of all sizes and has ample parking. (08/11/2024)
sample_reviews_en.author: P. Sergiu

sample_reviews_en.text: Good service, delicious food, and a nice, shady atmosphere by the Chao Phraya River. You get both the view and nature. Perfect for meeting friends and ordering the fried beef with fish sauce and the traditional spicy salad – both were delicious! I loved the shady trees by the river, the peaceful atmosphere, and the soft music. The owner is lovely and attentive, very friendly. I will definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: BERICH CHANNEL

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was so good I had to write a review! 🤩 The food was as delicious as the reviews said, it came out quickly, and the staff were incredibly attentive. We went without a reservation, and the restaurant tried their best to find us a table with a beautiful view, and even apologized for the table issue. Such great care and attention! I was very impressed and will definitely be back again. 🩷🩷
sample_reviews_en.author: Jannapat Sangson

restaurants.name: Kuaytiaw Khua Kai Suan Mali Chicken Noodle at Klang Hospital Junction
restaurants.address:

260 Soi Thewi Worayat, Wat Thep Sirin, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Tasty Food, It can take 40 minutes or more to get your food and don't expect much for service as it is street food with a 50฿(USD1.5$) price per dish.
sample_reviews_th.author: Flowers Blossom

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Kuay Teow at this place is simply delightful with its perfect crispiness. I highly recommend opting for the regular version without the runny egg, as it tends to lessen the noodles' crunchiness. To savor its original taste, the ideal condiments are the spicy chili flakes and the savory fish sauce. These complementary flavors enhance the dish without overpowering its authentic essence.

The street-side setting adds to the overall dining experience. With the bustling ambiance of the roadside, it's a clear sign that you're about to enjoy some truly good food.

However, it's worth noting that the wait times during peak hours can be a bit lengthy. Nonetheless, the scrumptious taste of the Kuay Teow compensates for this minor inconvenience.

In summary, if you're a fan of crispy Kuay Teow, this place is a must-visit. Opt for the regular version without the egg and pair it with the spicy chili flakes and fish sauce to enjoy a truly flavorful meal in the vibrant street-side atmosphere. Despite occasional wait times, the mouthwatering experience makes it all worthwhile. Give it a try, and you won't be disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ryan Edward (RyanEdwardFitness)

sample_reviews_en.text:
was very disappointed with my experience at this restaurant.
•     This
•	The queue management was terrible; regular customers were ignored while tour groups were prioritized.
•	Some staff skipped the order queue for customers who gave them tips.
•	The staff were rude, gossiped about customers, and showed no manners.
•	The restaurant was dirty, with a strong, unpleasant smell like cat waste.
•	There were rats running around, and even pests coming into contact with the ingredients, which raises serious food safety concerns.
•	When I tried to pay by QR code, the staff said they don’t accept it because they don’t pay taxes.
•	And one more important note: the Michelin Guide recognition actually belongs to the restaurant next door, not this one.
This kind of service, hygiene, and business practice is unacceptable, and I believe the authorities should inspect this place. So terrible!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanin CHAIPUVAPAT

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍜 Suan Mali Stir-Fried Chicken Noodles, Central Hospital Intersection Branch
This famous Suan Mali stir-fried chicken noodle shop is conveniently located for those visiting Central Hospital in the evening. It's a short walk from a nearby soi (alley).
I ordered the stir-fried chicken noodles.
The noodles are stir-fried until dry and crispy, with a wonderful wok aroma. They're delicious! They have both chicken and crispy squid, and the portions are generous.
The chicken soup is also great; the hot broth is very comforting.
⏰ I recommend allowing some extra time for your food, as the shop takes a while to prepare each dish due to the time required to stir-fry and deep-fry the noodles to achieve that crispy texture. However, I think the wait is worth it because the taste and crispness of the noodles are truly remarkable.
sample_reviews_en.author: MR NOOM

sample_reviews_en.text: Worst meal I had in Bangkok. Super greasy and bland as well, the only flavour came from the burned oil. My table mates said the dish was acceptable after adding chili sauce, but what's the point of that, when the basics are off. We were on a food tour and only had to wait about 20 minutes to be served, but our guide said there is sometimes a waiting line of about an hour. I don't want to imagine going through that, only to be served this crap. The next day we all had an upset belly because obviously hygiene is also severely lacking and there is only one squatting toilet with no running water (no hand washing). I have not had any bad meal anywhere else in Thailand, everything is so amazingly flavourful, except here. Think twice before you decide to come here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jan De Volder

sample_reviews_en.text: Renowned for its exquisite stir-fried rice noodles with chicken, this establishment offers three distinct variations to tantalize your palate: the classic stir-fry, an indulgent baked rendition enriched with eggs, and a delicate clear soup version. Each interpretation boasts its own unique depth of flavor, making it well worth the effort to experience all three. Be advised, however, that during peak hours, wait times can extend to approximately 30 minutes, a testament to the dish’s popularity. The dining arrangement adheres to a traditional Thai street food aesthetic—simple yet authentic. Note that only cash transactions are accepted. Despite these minor inconveniences, this spot remains an unequivocal recommendation for discerning food enthusiasts.
sample_reviews_en.author: TP TP

sample_reviews_en.text: The famous stir-fried flat rice noodle shop that gets Michenlin guide. This is one of the interesting Thai street food called "Kuai Tiao Khua Kai". The flat noodle is cooked in the fiery wok over the charcoal stove promising the flaming aroma. The noodle turns into crispy outside while soft texture inside. Chicken is tender as using Thigh part. Original recipe come with preserved squid which if you are not a fan then can request just chicken meat. There are few shops selling the same manu in the area but I trust this particular shop is the authentic one which is located in a small alley. Price is so affordable as costs only 50 baht. Atmospher? Well it is just real street food so nothing fancy to look at. Yet, it is delicious so recommend you to try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Apichart Dausiri

sample_reviews_en.text:
I asked if they had scan-to-pay, and at first they said no. I went to ask the woman preparing the food if they had scan-to-pay, but she didn't answer and turned to talk to two of her Burmese employees. I walked away because she wouldn't answer, and I was going to withdraw money. One of the Burmese employees said, "Where are you going? Come here."
Me: So, do you have scan-to-pay or not?
Burmese employee: Only for those who don't carry cash.
The atmosphere in the restaurant was terrible. It was dirty, with lots of flies swarming the condiment bottles, and a dead rat lying next to a table. I was baffled; this is a restaurant that shouldn't win any awards because it's so dirty. And there wasn't even drinking water.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tony Stark

restaurants.name: Red Rose
restaurants.address:

481 Yaowarat Rd, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came for dinner based on the glowing reviews, but it proved to be more of a Western-style tourist supper club than an authentic Chinese dining experience. The food arrived cold, as several others have noted> the kitchen is downstairs or some distance from the dining room. The scallop appetizer was overcooked and rubbery; I can only hope it doesn’t cause any aftereffects. I returned it, yet it still appeared on the bill.

Our waiter seemed genuinely overwhelmed, and the service lacked both attention to detail and proper training. The atmosphere caters largely to Western tastes, with loud American pop music,  certainly not jazz. It felt far more like a karaoke bar designed for buckets of beer than a restaurant proper. I can understand how some might enjoy the lively scene for cocktails, but if you don’t travel to Asia in search of an imitation American supper club, best to skip. The décor is lovely, but the music is garish and the experience distinctly overpriced for what it offers.
sample_reviews_en.author: V ROY

sample_reviews_en.text:
Took me over a week to get around to this one — there was a lot to unpack.

The starter was disgusting: a lukewarm prawn smothered in wasabi, dumped on a bed of watermelon (a “surprise” ingredient, probably leftover from the hotel breakfast) — topped off with a piece of old, cold, rubbery duck skin propped awkwardly against it. It honestly made me gag.

The main wasn’t much better. Basic food, not fresh, and stone cold. I sent it back, and it returned warm — but still not hot. Easily the worst Chinese food I’ve ever had: bland, lifeless, and utterly joyless.

Then, to top it all off, we discovered a piece of rotting chicken floating in the table vase. We could only assume it had been left there by previous diners as a warning to future ones: STAY AWAY.

For the price, this was nothing short of a scam. I wish I’d refused to pay — but it was our first night in Bangkok, and we were too tired from the flight to argue.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hollie Jade Hopkins

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a fantastic atmosphere, located in Chinatown, so everything inside and out is immersive! The live jazz band captivated us from the very first notes of their best songs...we didn't try the food, so I can't comment on it. We were just passing by, but since I love live music, we stayed for a drink and to listen to the band playing that evening, and we certainly didn't regret it. The menu is a bit pricey, but we figured it was worth it for these musicians! The waiter spotted us from the street and quickly found us a good seat, even though I smoke. The service was fast and top-notch! We truly enjoyed our time there, and everything around us contributed to that. We left absolutely satisfied, having had a wonderful experience, both with the place and especially with the music. The musicians are just super👌 🙂 ☺️ 💘 😍 💕 💌 💘
sample_reviews_en.author: Lessa Pinkredmi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Red Rose in Chinatown Bangkok is easily one of the most visually stunning bars in the area. The moment you step inside, you are immersed in a beautiful blend of vintage Shanghai glamour and modern chic. Rich red tones, elegant lanterns and intricate Asian-inspired patterns create a luxurious old-world charm while stylish contemporary touches make the space feel upscale and incredibly photogenic. Warm, soft lighting ties everything together, giving the bar a cozy yet refined atmosphere.

We enjoyed a few beers while taking in the ambiance and the night was made even better by two fantastic live bands performing on stage. Their music energized the whole room and added a lively, vibrant spirit to an already captivating setting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joseph K

sample_reviews_en.text:
Probably one of the best Chinese meals my partner and I have ever eaten. We had the duck meal with pancakes and stir fry and it was delicious. The crispy skin pancakes were unbelievable and the experience of the staff cutting the duck at our table was also really fun.

Drinks were also excellent, cocktails were really tasty and we enjoyed watching the bar staff mixing them, it also encouraged us to try a few more as we kept getting curious!

Staff were really friendly, helped us with the menu and drinks and spoke great English.

Restaurant itself is really cool and has a great vibe, also very clean.

During our visit their was also live music, which was really good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eric Keen

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stumbled upon the lovely Red Rose and decided to unwind there. The band that performed from 6:30 pm to 8:30 pm was absolutely incredible! The female lead vocalist's powerful voice and the male vocalist's harmonies were mesmerizing.

They were entertaining, high-quality, and had us thoroughly enjoying ourselves until we ordered two bottles of Prosecco.

Unfortunately, the night took a turn when the second band took over at 9 pm. The female vocalist's underwhelming performance was disappointing, and we struggled to make out what she was singing. In contrast, the food and service were excellent during the earlier band's performance. Overall, a mixed experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Melissa Lok

sample_reviews_en.text: Two of my favourite things packaged beautifully : Chinese food and jazz. The Chinese food here is amazing and is available a la carte or in set menus. Be sure to check out the monthly specials. The jazz starts around 7pm and goes on till late. The bar area at Red Rose is the only outdoor bar along this stretch of Chinatown and with air-con it's a great place to sit and chat or sit and chill. There is an extensive drinks list with spirits, wines and beers, although the latter is only Thai beers no craft or international brews. Highly recommended for a few hours and don't forget to ask for your favourite jazz song to be played.
sample_reviews_en.author: Philip Hall

sample_reviews_en.text: After 28 hours of travel we were exhausted and hungry so we ate ate the hotel restaurant. The service was quick. The food was hot and flavor forward. The amuse was house made tofu. Very delicious. We had veggie spring rolls, which were crispy and tasty. We also tried the Hok kien noodles. It had a lot of crispy vegetables and chicken. The drunken chicken was the star. They lit it in fire at the table. Very spicy 🔥. It had a lot of warming spices including cinnamon sticks and star anise. Watch out for the red pepper paste! All in all it was a good meal and far too much food for 2 people.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bonnie D

restaurants.name: Chill In Bangkok
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 32 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Khwaeng Khlong San, Khet Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was really good, inexpensive, service was great, kind of odd location, definitely off the beaten path
sample_reviews_en.author: Laura Dennis

sample_reviews_en.text: Small restaurant with a lovely owner. Food was awesome.  Chicken wings were great. I had red chicken curry with rice. Spicy and so good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rick Dennis

sample_reviews_en.text: Very new shop in this area! Great atmosphere, tasty food with easy to enjoy flavors, and lots of menu choices. Very affordable prices (Thai’s price) for food and drinks. Friendly and attentive staff. Open late perfect! if you’re looking for a place to go after Icon Siam closes😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitikarn Yansawang

restaurants.name: Choongman Chicken Union Mall
restaurants.address:

54 Lat Phrao 1, Chom Phon, Khet Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Chicken "looks" nice & crispy BUT not crispy at all.... asking the waitress, she said it's like this because of the sauce (which I did not believe because it could still be crispy in several brand).... ... ... #ไก่ชุ่มซ๊อสค่ะพี่

Taste is OK (actually the soy sauce flavor is nice, nicer than garlic)
sample_reviews_th.author: Jub Chutimar

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is very large with plenty of seating options. It's located near Sushiro.
It wasn't very crowded, so there was no wait.

I ordered the 111 baht set: boneless fried chicken with side dishes of kimchi (okay flavor) and pickled radish (sweet, a bit cloying). Refills are unlimited.

The bulgogi pork rice: the pork was delicious, but the rice and other ingredients were generally bland.

The onion rings are a must-try; this branch makes them exceptionally crispy and delicious, especially with the sweet sauce.

The staff tended to chat amongst themselves, so they didn't pay much attention when customers called them. You had to call loudly or several times.
sample_reviews_en.author: SAKONWAN Su

sample_reviews_en.text: The soy sauce tikkudak was easily a ten. For the non spicers, the sweet yangyeom chicken is a must to get the perfect balance of "not too hot and not too sweet". My favorite non chicken dish was the kimchi fried rice, the spice only hits once you've swallowed the warm and savory rice. A nice refreshment to top off your meal is their grape drink, simple but reliable. Although one of our dishes was forgotten, after we asked about it they apologized and managed to bring it in less than 4 minutes. Not only did we leave impressed with their positive and welcoming attitude, but also with satisfied bellies.
sample_reviews_en.author: Reika H

sample_reviews_en.text:
Choongman is best compared to Bonchon. Similar price points but I prefer Choongman’s wings. They are both breaded but the Gochujang (higher price point wings) are not only fried, but also grilled for extra flavor and crispness. It’s a nice touch.

The thin onion rings are amazing too. And the little pickled radishes are yummy as well. I wasn’t a fan of the homemade tea (free refills on that but it wasn’t my favorite).

It’s never crowded (good or bad?), but it is my destination place when I want Korean chicken.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike Tongwarin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Choongman Chicken locates at Union Mall Shopping Centre. Gotta tried the deep fried chicken here. It was tasty and not too oily. However, the kimchi fried rice is surprisingly good though. Tteokbokki is alright. Many young generous staff (with Korean looks and hairstyle) are willing to go beyond mile to assist every table, just give them a shout out.

Places can get busy from time to time. As they still keeping their K-Pop costume concept (for the servers) and Union Mall are known for Korean K-Pop lovers here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donny Boonyamanop

sample_reviews_en.text:
First off, it is located on the G floor of Union Mall. We ordered soft tofu stew, fried squid, and beer.

1. The soft tofu stew is delicious. Seriously, it’s just as good as in Korea.

2. The batter on the fried squid is wrong. It has a hard coating with a floury smell. It is crispy, but the taste...

Since we ordered it as a beer snack, it wasn't that great, and the squid inside was tough too....

The soft tofu stew is really delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: 이태원

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time trying this restaurant/brand.
Their Gochujang Bulgogi Bibimbap was delicious, worth the price, and the portion was generous – very filling and satisfying. The taste was great, and the price was reasonable. For me, this dish was incredibly filling! 😅
The staff were also lovely, providing excellent service and attentive to customers.
I will definitely come back for this dish and try other menu items. 😊😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Blink Boom

sample_reviews_en.text: Went here with high expectations and they met and even exceeded them. The food was great. I have had Choongman chicken abroad in the United States and this one tops that one, with their freshness of the chicken. It was a tad spicier than I remember but the flavor was great. We got the spicy garlic and it was great. Will definitely come back. Ground floor of union mall in the corner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Caleb W

first time eat here at this
restaurant at rama 9, price a bit high but value for money in
view of good meat quality and
nabe soup, while the taste is
good, be careful not to touch
the metal soup container as it is quite hot, the staff did remind you but in Thai language, the restaurant is not big, so always quite full but can still sit comfortably, recommend choose value set for first time
visit
sample_reviews_en.author: dr ken chao

sample_reviews_en.text:
Coming here after having been to the Emsphere branch some months ago, the quiet dining experience doesn't seem so quiet and peaceful as much because the shop is open-faced along the main foot traffic area and everyone is seated facing the busy kitchen area.

Otherwise, the place is clean and food is good as expected. Expect a 20-40 minute wait during dinner rush hour period.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bobin Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: Please beware that this restaurant does not have a fair queue system . I came much earlier but the waiter( in glasses ) let many people in first before me. At last i gave up and look for another restaurant. Waited too long even if there are only a few customers because the waiter keep letting big groups in first.
sample_reviews_en.author: nurul shahida

sample_reviews_en.text:
Spent 1600 for 240g of meat and vegetables, very tiny portion my and partner had 1 set each, only 120 g of meat each .
the set was already really  expensive 600 then there is Vat and Services charge 250 added on top
The meat is good quality but food is too over priced and portion is so so small.
sample_reviews_en.author: james long
