sample_reviews_en.text: It's the most impressive service I've ever got from Hitori. The waiter recommended the meat and soup very well! He even gave me example to try and help me cooking at the beginning. Then, suggested the seasoning to eat with meat. Definitely will return to this branch
sample_reviews_en.author: Apichaya Boonsomsuk

sample_reviews_en.text: Good beef, with very helpful staffs. If you are new for this kind of shabu, they will help you quickly without any awkward situation. You can come to have shabu alone or with family. The table is around the kitchen, so all the orders create live here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanwipha Prueksaritanond

sample_reviews_en.text:
A japanese style hotpot restaurant with several branches in malls.

The prices are relatively high compared to the portion size, but the taste is standard and the ingredients are good quality, fresh, and clean.

The staff provide very good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krittayot Chaowanapreecha

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate sukiyaki and it has raw egg in it. I think they do not use bacteria killed raw egg, I had serious diarrhea and vomiting after eating it. I am now admitted at Bangkok hospital and it cost me 30000 baht +++ I will never go there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: JJ Ling

restaurants.name: Izakaya Hotei at Sathorn12
restaurants.address:

120, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This izakaya (Japanese pub) is located on a corner just behind the Mahanakhon Ritz-Carlton. It's only been open for a few years, I think? It's clean and feels like a traditional Japanese izakaya. All the pork belly skewers were delicious.

Just as everyone's reviews said, the mugs were chilled, and I was so happy to drink ice-cold draft beer!!!

Until 9 PM, they have a happy hour where you can get two drinks of your choice for a certain price. The wide variety of plum wine is also fantastic.

There are many izakayas in Bangkok, but I like this one because it's stylish. The restrooms are clean too. They play Hotei's music, and the background music is nostalgic Showa and Heisei era songs.

It's fun to hum along, as I get the impression that only about a third of the customers are Japanese.

This is the place to go when you want beer and pork belly skewers!

Thank you for the delicious meal, be my baby!
sample_reviews_en.author: TOTAL RICH

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is great, the menu is extensive, and the food is delicious. The skewers are grilled to perfection, and the portions are generous, making it good value for money. I especially liked the bacon-wrapped water spinach; it was crispy and tasty, although the meat was a little chewy. The EBI salad was uniquely delicious with a great flavor.
The restrooms are also beautifully designed, well-organized, and clean.
I went in the evening, almost 10 pm, and the last order was around 10 pm.
We could only order once, and the outdoor seating wasn't hot, with a comfortable breeze.
The staff were lovely and attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teepui Kiatdilokrath

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent izakaya in Sathorn Soi 10. I’ve been here several times and somehow never got around to writing a review. The place has a cool, lively atmosphere without feeling pretentious, and it’s almost always packed—especially on weekends—so booking a table in advance is a good idea. The menu covers all the izakaya classics you could ask for. Nothing overly fancy, just consistently excellent food, great drinks, and quality across the board.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing experience at Izakaya Hotel Sathon 12! The atmosphere and vibes are incredible, it honestly feels like you’ve stepped into another country. The staff were really friendly, the drinks were nice and cold, and the food came out super quick. Loved the yakitori, yakisoba, and the grilled corn. Definitely a spot I’d come back to!
sample_reviews_en.author: James Popp

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely adore dining here! 🍽️ The food is consistently excellent, and the service is top-notch. The atmosphere is always so inviting. Just a heads-up, make sure to book a table in advance, especially on weekends or public holidays, as it can get fully booked! 🥂 #Dinner #Food #Vibes #Booking …
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattawat .P

sample_reviews_en.text: I can’t even express how much I love the Spaghetti Mentaiko here — it’s incredibly delicious! The other dishes are great as well, and every visit has been enjoyable. I absolutely love coming to this place and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a good dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: vasita hirunwarakul

sample_reviews_en.text: This place was so hyped up but I just found it ok. The cocktails were nice but the food, even the recommended ones, were avg. Sushi was nice but the skewers were meh, didn’t have a lot of taste. For the high cost and how hyped up it was i was disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vaughn Friesen

sample_reviews_en.text: Izakaya Hotei, tucked in the heart of Sathorn, offers a memorable dining experience with its cozy, rustic ambiance and exceptional Japanese cuisine. The atmosphere is a perfect blend of traditional and modern, with warm lighting and an open …
sample_reviews_en.author: Sam Bhandari

restaurants.name: Zia Pasta
restaurants.address:

4/15 Sukhumvit 65, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dinner at Zia Pasta, an Italian restaurant on Soi 65 in Phra Khanong.

We started at 4 PM. That's the rule for Italian restaurants.

My Thai friend recommended Zia Pasta to me, a Roman native.

Phra Khanong isn't my area of ​​expertise, so I didn't know about this restaurant and hadn't visited until now. Today, I swallowed my pride and went to apologize.

I was offered one dish after another, and I shouted, "Caprese!"

I opened a Spanish wine that was recommended as a promotion and toasted to today's encounter.

After rejecting every dish recommended by the waitress, who spoke fluent Japanese, I ordered carbonara. It was so delicious that I forgot to take a picture, so I finished with tiramisu.
sample_reviews_en.author: james won

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm from Taiwan, and I stayed at an Airbnb in the alley next door. This was definitely the most relaxing place I've ever been. On my first day after landing, I went to the hotel, had a meal and drinks, and met a lady there. Her fluent English and warm greetings made me feel incredibly welcome. I want to share this wonderful experience with my friends in Taiwan. You can chat with her, and in the morning you can enjoy her authentic Thai buffet at the alley entrance. I'm so grateful that everything was so wonderful.
sample_reviews_en.author: 李孝文

sample_reviews_en.text: When I arrived at the restaurant that evening, my first thought was to order a beer to quench my thirst. However, it turned out that it was a local election day in Thailand, so alcohol was banned for 24 hours. I had no choice but to drink a soft drink to tide me over. Luckily, the food was excellent – ​​the first salad was great! 👍 The lasagne was also great! 👍 The margarita pizza was also great! 👍 The owner's service was excellent! 👍 She was always smiling! 😃
sample_reviews_en.author: Wailam Ng

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very small restaurant but Excellent food, restaurant located inside Sukhumvit 65 which around 6min walk from Ekkamai station. Food was great, we ordered appetizers caprese, carbonara and lasagna
everything delicious and taste authentic. Plus their own homemade chili oil in the big jar is awesome. Service is great, the server speak good English and Japanese. Price is pretty high but the food is good quality. Definitely come back
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattareeya T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very small restaurant where you feel right at home.

The manager and the waitress are very attentive.

The dishes are generous and delicious.

The prices are very reasonable.
It might be best to make a reservation as there are only a few tables.
My friends, my wife, and I all left absolutely delighted with our meal, the price, and the service.

PS: The price paid does not include the bottle of excellent Chilean wine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lacome Jean

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent little Italian restaurant at SUKHUMVIT 65. I passed by this place so many times but didn't even noticed it was a restaurant but I found out through googling restaurants nearby.

Food is great and service staff is warm and very friendly. Pasta is awesome. Soup is delicious!!

Will definitely recommend this little restaurant to my friends. Will be back for more!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicole Ling

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited this place and I am not satisfied at all. The space was dark and somewhat smelly. We arrived about an hour before closing time, and it was obvious that we were served reheated food. It was the only meal I had that day, and I ended up spending four days in the hospital with food poisoning. Completely unacceptable, especially considering the prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Melina Van Allen

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was good, it’s close to BTS ekkamai station. Staffs purr wine and drinks so fast which make me feel uncomfortable like pushing us to drink quickly and order more , and show us that the bottle is empty. They don’t know the drink menu and recommend us the expensive bottle without knowing flavor or our preference.I think better to improve service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Skmsm0502

restaurants.name: OMG Thai Restaurant and Cooking School
restaurants.address:

WVJP+FWP, Chaloem Phrakiat 21 Alley, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was mediocre and nothing special. I had the Pad See Ew, which I wouldn’t crave or order again (from here). My friend’s chicken cashew nut was also average. However, another friend enjoyed his fried rice quite some. Some orders were forgotten, but we didn’t bother reordering.

When we first entered, the atmosphere was chill. However, as more guests arrived, the music was turned up very loudly, which made conversation difficult and quite annoying.
We did like the interior, which looked interesting.

The place seemed to attract an odd crowd. A man who seemed to be familiar with the staff behaved in a disrespectful way toward the cook, including physical contact. Watching this killed the atmosphere for us.

For me, this is not a place I would return to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dill

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited OMG Thai and had an absolutely amazing experience. The food was incredible, full of flavor and beautifully prepared, but what really made this place special was the atmosphere.
You can come just to enjoy a great meal, but the real highlight is the cooking class. The chef is wonderful, funny, and full of humor, making the whole experience fun, relaxed, and truly unforgettable.
We came with our kids and ended up spending the entire afternoon there, enjoying every moment, both the food and the experience.
Highly recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: נועה לוי

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped by here because I saw the cooking school sign. Apple had a wonderful smile and told me all about the classes and prices. I was interested in trying her food so I placed an order for squid. She asked me if I would like to cook it myself. Of course this was with her supervision. She was a great teacher and let me spice the dish up according to my tastes. I would highly recommend this restaurant if you are looking for good Thai food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Freetirement Randy & Lori

sample_reviews_en.text:
A cozy place run by one super woman who’s flying around taking orders, cooking, cleaning and setting the music. As extremely reasonable prices!!
As someone with vegetarian preferences in the country, the vegetable PadThai and Papaya salad were PERFECT!!
She made sure to ask each and every thing in writing so she doesn’t add anything I don’t wanna eat. Came back and double checked on the eggs as well!
10/10 would recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mursil Khan

sample_reviews_en.text: By far the best Thai food Ive had in all of Thailand. The owner and cook, Apple, is by far one of the best cooks I've seen. She is also very friendly and welcoming. I NEVER go back to a restaurant twice when traveling but I had to go back to apple 4 days in a row for her amazing red curry.  Her pad thai and cashew chicken is also exceptional. This is a must go in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Fernandez

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have been to OMG three times now for dinner and OMG perfect every time !
The third time was a cooking class apple explained all the different ingredients . I cooked the penang red curry also chicken with rice .

Apple is great fun and full of energy . Her cooking class is on a one to one basis which is the best .

I will be back for sure to learn more !
sample_reviews_en.author: Simon Knight

sample_reviews_en.text: Apple and her staff are amazing. They were very warm from the time we entered the place. The food was so tasty, flavourful and filling. She used fresh ingredients right in front of us. We ordered some authentic thai food like Tom Yum, Spicy Chicken Curry, Raw Papaya salad and some rice. Yum Nom Tow is a must visit for anyone looking for great thai food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neelava Maitra

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered chicken, seafood pad Thai and papaya salad, food was awesome and totally local style. Owner is friendly and this great woman do know how to cook the food that warms my stomach and heart too. Definitely will come back if I visit here again. She also taught me how to make this perfect gourmet papaya salad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lee Hsuan-Yi

restaurants.name: SEE FAH (สีฟ้า) – Ramathibodi Hospital
restaurants.address:

Rama VI Rd, Thung Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Writing
SEE FAH (สีฟ้า) at Ramathibodi Hospital is truly a hidden gem for anyone visiting with their loved ones. The food is consistently delicious, comforting, and …
sample_reviews_th.author: Surakit Kanokngam

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant located in the Ramathibodi hospital on second floor. They offer a variety of Thai food including drinks and desserts. The quality of the food is very good. This name See Fah , has been with Thais for a long time. There are many branches with the same quality .
sample_reviews_en.author: Khoong Yaowares

sample_reviews_en.text: We came to the hospital, and this restaurant had empty tables. We ordered several dishes, and they tasted delicious. The staff provided good service and recommendations, and the food came out quickly. It's a good place to wait while running errands or seeing a doctor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pisanu K.

sample_reviews_en.text: SEE FAH Restaurant has a lovely, cozy atmosphere with delicious food. The staff are attentive and take great care of their guests. They also thoughtfully arranged a table with wheelchair access, making it very comfortable. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Apple Tipparat

sample_reviews_en.text: Every time I come to the hospital, I always eat at Sifaa restaurant. I love it, especially their fresh spring rolls. When there are two of us, we always order two plates. Today I had braised fish with black bean sauce and rice mixed with …
sample_reviews_en.author: Chariya Panishkan

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was crowded but well-managed. I arrived at noon but got my food very quickly.
The food was delicious, up to the restaurant's standard. It was clean and good value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yayee 2548

sample_reviews_en.text: The fresh spring rolls are always the best. The minced pork noodles, without the chili paste, are as delicious as ever. The blanched kale is perfectly tender.
sample_reviews_en.author: Be Pui

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a restaurant located in the hospital. The food is delicious and the service is good. It's my go-to restaurant whenever I come to Ramathibodi Hospital.
sample_reviews_en.author: NAVA

restaurants.name: อาไบมาโคขุน at ศรีนครินทร์ 40
restaurants.address:

54 1 Soi Srinagarindra 40, Nong Bon, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Abaima Koh Khun" is an Islamic restaurant, displaying the "Halal" symbol on its sign. It's located on Supapong 3 Alley, off Srinakarin 40 Alley.

The restaurant is open-air with fans. There are many tables inside; the tables are wooden, antique-style, and vary in design. The interior is rather dimly lit, with warm orange incandescent bulbs resembling candlelight.

The restaurant serves beef and beef products such as beef noodles, beef curry fried rice, beef brain fried rice with garlic, and various beef soups. They also offer chicken dishes and fresh beef.

Desserts are available, including roti, and drinks such as goat milk, herbal drinks, and Pakistani tea.

Free self-service water is available.

Restrooms are available, and there is free parking both beside and behind the restaurant.

Note: The goat milk with honey was sweet and delicious, without any gamey smell, so I'm unsure if it was genuine goat milk. I ordered cheese roti and requested condensed milk, which the staff acknowledged, but only the cheese roti was served.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaiyakit Thanabriboon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Review: Abai Makokhun @ Srinakarin Soi 40

Beef lovers must try this! Today, we had the opportunity to visit Abai Makokhun in Srinakarin Soi 40. It's easy to get to, near Seacon Srinakarin, and there's plenty of parking.

Recommended dishes we tried this time:
✨ Beef Shank Soup – A hot, fragrant soup with perfectly tender beef shank. Absolutely delicious!
✨ Cheese Roti – Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, topped with melted cheese. A must-try!
✨ Spicy Beef Salad – This dish is flavorful and spicy, with tender beef pieces that pair perfectly with the dressing.

Restaurant Highlights: Besides the delicious food, the prices are very reasonable. If you want to enjoy high-quality beef at an affordable price, we highly recommend this place.

Summary: If you're a beef lover or want to try delicious beef dishes, you must visit Abai Makokhun at least once.

📍 Location: Srinakarin Soi 40 (near Seacon Srinakarin)

After you try it, don't forget to tell us which dish was your favorite! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Baitong Little Duck

sample_reviews_en.text:
This old-school steak restaurant, with decades of history, has been a fixture in Soi Suphapong for a long time. It's conveniently located opposite Seacon Srinakarin, easily accessible. There's a prayer room, clean restrooms, and the food comes out quickly with friendly, family-style service. There's nothing fancy or expensive to worry about. Single dishes are 50-60-70 baht depending on the choice, while hot pot is standard at 200+ baht. Food is cooked to order, so it's never cold or bland. Free water, tea, and coffee are available. Fried meat is also available for purchase to take home as a souvenir.
🖍️It seems the main issue with this restaurant's reviews is the delivery service, which varies depending on the time of day. Dine-in isn't a problem. Ordering is done in a traditional way, sometimes written on paper, sometimes verbally. The speed of service depends on the time and the number of customers at that moment.
sample_reviews_en.author: -Kapolo- Terio

sample_reviews_en.text: The wait for food was incredibly long. Those who arrived earlier got served later, and those who arrived later got served first – that's a real thing. I ordered noodle soup and plain rice, and they served the plain rice first, making me stare at it for 30 minutes. The noodle soup and noodles finally arrived. The person I was with ordered basil chicken and finished their meal before the noodle soup even arrived. If there had been chili sauce and fish sauce on the table, I suspect they would have been eating rice with fish sauce instead of noodle soup. The staff were also unwilling to serve. When I asked about the order, they made a displeased face. Also, I ordered blanched vegetables with dipping sauce, and after I finished eating and went to pay, the food had just come out of the kitchen. I saw the kitchen staff working non-stop, but it was delivery! People working in the restaurant just had to wait.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tushchakorn Rushchatrabuntchasuk

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered through Line Man, but didn't receive the order. I'm so confused. I paid for express delivery, but the restaurant lacked the maturity to resolve the problem. I called to ask what the issue was, but the owner just said, "You have to wait." Seriously?! I've been waiting for an hour already! Is that how you talk to a customer? And the staff... don't even get me started. They were completely flustered and couldn't solve anything. No wonder their business isn't thriving and they haven't improved their system. From someone who's owned a restaurant for over 10 years, this is a fail. No matter how delicious the food is, if their mindset and problem-solving skills are like this, it reflects poorly on the food they serve. Are they really choosing the best for their customers? It's a waste of time. I recommend going to another restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: เเจ็ค เว็บวเตอร์

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went for lunch before noon, so it wasn't very crowded. There was plenty of parking. Inside, they gave us a menu and a piece of paper to write our orders on. After a while, someone asked if we wanted plain rice, but actually, our order was served to the table behind us. The staff seemed confused. After a while, our order arrived. The food was flavorful and delicious.
I had the stir-fried beef with basil and a fried egg, stir-fried liver with basil, mixed hot pot soup, fried sun-dried beef, and crispy fried tongue with garlic.
The food was delicious, the beef was good quality, and the price was reasonable. However, the inside of the restaurant was very hot and stuffy. I didn't sit there long before I was sweating profusely. The fans didn't help at all. I kept wiping my face and neck with tissues.
sample_reviews_en.author: JR.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The meat is delicious.
Don't miss the sun-dried beef tongue, it's incredibly tasty.
However, it's a bit random whether it's oily or not. It's great with chili sauce, with rice, or as a snack.

The restaurant is extremely hot. If you come at lunchtime, bring your own fan so you don't have to share it with other people in the restaurant.

The restaurant is getting popular, so the wait is very long.
There weren't that many people, but the wait was incredibly long.
I thought it might be due to delivery, but there were no riders. It seems they have their own delivery team. People in the area said you can call to order, but I'm not sure.
Allow at least 30 minutes or more to get your food.
There's a decent amount of parking.
I recommend going in the winter and avoid the summer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pond Jarupon

sample_reviews_en.text:
🥩✨ Meat lovers, you MUST try Abai Makokhun!

This Halal restaurant offers a wide variety of meat dishes, including beef hot pot, beef basil stir-fry, beef tongue, and various other meat dishes, as well as roti and Pakistani tea. 🥘🥩

Personally, I love the tender meat, rich flavors, extensive menu options, and friendly prices. It's perfect for a casual meal or a date with family or friends. 🍽️

My recommended dishes are the large mixed beef hot pot + beef basil stir-fry + fried beef tongue with garlic, and to finish, cheesy roti with iced Pakistani tea. Absolutely delicious! 🤤
sample_reviews_en.author: Yasmin Puktun

restaurants.name: Ann Tha Din Daeng
restaurants.address:

167 Tha Din Daeng Rd, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went during a long holiday weekend around 12:30 PM. There were still tables available. The food didn't take too long to arrive. The ingredients were good, and the meat was firm.
The crab fried rice was a bit soggy.
The Tom Yum soup was too sour.
The garlic fried prawns were oily and salty, priced at 700 baht each (priced by weight).
The creamy crab omelet was excellent, with plenty of crab meat.
Overall, I felt the taste was a bit overrated. It was tasty but not amazing, but worth trying at least once.

Parking: Park in the Tha Din Daeng market, 20 baht parking fee.
The restaurant only accepts cash.
sample_reviews_en.author: bandp's map

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was okay, but the wait was incredibly long. Initially, everything was served normally.
But once a film crew arrived, the restaurant completely stopped preparing our orders. They didn't cook anything and didn't even inform us. We had to go and ask for it ourselves. When we finally inquired about our food, the staff said that because of the filming, there was no one to cook. Why didn't they just stop accepting customers then? Why make us waste our time waiting?

In short, I was disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apisara Pak

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'd been wanting to try this place for a while, and finally strolled over after visiting Siam Paragon. A single-serving Thai meal was so satisfying!

We ordered three dishes, and they were all delicious, though I might have preferred the shrimp cooked a little longer.

The staff were incredibly friendly. The restaurant has limited seating and is very popular. It closes at 8 pm, so be sure to arrive early!
sample_reviews_en.author: Maggie WJ

sample_reviews_en.text: The eggs in the fried rice were cooked to a wonderfully soft texture, making the whole dish taste amazing, the stir-fried clams were delicious and packed with flavor, the Tom Yum Goong was exceptionally rich and flavorful, the squid was so fresh that it tasted amazing all on its own without needing any sauce, and the crispy pork belly was wonderfully crunchy
sample_reviews_en.author: ccion cappu

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm a little disappointed. Before ordering the salted fried shrimp, I asked how much they were per shrimp today, and the restaurant said 750 baht each. But when it came time to pay, it was 950 baht per shrimp! I was so confused. I paid, feeling bewildered. I ordered three dishes and it came to over 2,000 baht. 😔
sample_reviews_en.author: Saifon Sirijaroonchai

sample_reviews_en.text: Went for lunch. The Tom Yum Goong (spicy shrimp soup) was good, with a moderately spicy flavor. The stir-fried water spinach with crispy pork was delicious, but there wasn't much water spinach; it was very tender. The soft-boiled egg with crab meat was also delicious. The stir-fried clams were tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ekkavee Nana

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered fried rice and tom yum goong (spicy shrimp soup). The food was fresh, but the restaurant only accepts cash, and the portions weren't worth the price. The crab fried rice was 300 baht, which was quite expensive, while the tom yum goong was 220 baht and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattha Sae-ue

sample_reviews_en.text: This seafood restaurant is located in Tha Din Daeng. Parking is limited along the roadside; you'll have to look around to find a spot. I like the stir-fried crab with yellow chili peppers and the deep-fried shrimp with salt. The dipping sauce is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: iShadow

restaurants.name: Krua Nai Soi
restaurants.address:

1432, 1428,1430, 1434 Soi Jaransanitwong 75, Bang Phlat, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Thai homey restaurant located in Soi Charansanitwong 75.

The menus taste good. Personally, I like green curry with fish balls and fried chicken with Thai herb.

The atmosphere is nice and clean. There is an outdoor area available to those who like a fresh air.

A must-to-try-dessert menu is banana in syrup with coconut milk or กล้วยไข่เชื่อม in Thai. Sooooo good! This is one of the best กล้วยไข่เชื่อม I have ever tasted. ❤️

Recommend to make a reservation on weekends and holidays due to the limited seats.
sample_reviews_th.author: Krittanai Vattanasaeneetum

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was doing merit-making in the Charansanitwong area and had the opportunity to try this restaurant.
It's a Thai restaurant, but the way there might be a little complicated.
It truly lives up to its name, "Kitchen in the Alley" (meaning "kitchen in the alley")! 55555
But there's plenty of parking.

The restaurant offers both indoor and outdoor seating.
The atmosphere is relaxed, and the tables and chairs are comfortable.
Suitable for dining with family or older relatives.

The menu is quite diverse.
The portions are quite large.

Dishes I ordered:
1. Grilled Pork Salad with Garlic - A Thai-style salad, the pork was tender and the flavor was good.
2. Crispy Catfish with Ginger and Chili - Delicious with hot steamed rice.
3. Fried Chicken with Pandan Leaves - Personally, I'm not a big fan of fried pandan leaves, but the fried chicken was well-cooked and not oily.
4. Tom Yum Seabass Soup - The flavor was moderate, not too spicy. It included straw mushrooms, which is rare these days.
5. Fried Banana - A dessert to finish the meal, served with honey.
sample_reviews_en.author: DeltaT

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in Soi Charan 75 (accessible from two directions: 1) from Charan Sanitwong Road, 2) along the Bang Bamru railway line). There is parking available across the street from the restaurant, with ample space for several cars.

The food is decent, with a mild, easy-to-eat flavor suitable for all ages (but those who prefer spicy food might want to skip this place).

The service is good, with polite staff and no problems with service. The portion sizes and prices are reasonable. The restaurant is suitable for families or bringing elderly family members, as the atmosphere is appropriate, and there is parking and a ramp for wheelchairs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pathitta D.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is located in an alley (true to its name).
The Thai food is delicious, with a unique flavor that sets it apart from other restaurants. I highly recommend dishes such as green curry served with roti, crab curry, braised pork ribs, salted beef fried rice, and noodles in gravy.
For dessert, they have delicious candied bananas that sell out quickly, and fried bananas which are also excellent.
I could praise it all day! The only downside is the relatively high price. It's best to save it for special occasions; I probably can't afford to eat there often.
There's plenty of parking compared to the seating capacity.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khemmachart Inkaew

sample_reviews_en.text: This hidden Thai restaurant in an alley serves delicious food. Based on what I've tried, my top recommendation is the Green Curry with Snakehead Fish – rich, flavorful, and incredibly tasty. Second is the Grilled Pork Salad with Garlic – perfectly balanced salad dressing. The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, good service, and the food comes out quickly; you won't have to wait long. (I was closed the first time I came; it seems they close on the 10th and 20th of every month, but Google Maps doesn't show that.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthwut Chewatappasarn

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my second visit.
I like many of the dishes at this restaurant.
The taste is delicious, the prices are reasonable, parking is convenient, and the restaurant isn't cramped.
I recommend trying the salmon salad, the fried fish dishes, the curry, and the banana desserts – both the fried and candied bananas are delicious – as well as the green curry with pork roti.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthira Sirisuntornratch

sample_reviews_en.text: This time, the food was just average in taste. My favorite was the fried rice with chili paste and seafood – it was delicious! Other dishes weren't quite as good. The prices were quite high for my liking. It gets quite crowded at lunchtime, especially on weekends, so I recommend making a reservation. There is parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lalita S.

sample_reviews_en.text: Lunch on weekends is quite busy, with most people having reservations. The food tastes good and the prices are reasonable. The fried crab with garlic seemed a bit small in portion, but it was crispy. Parking is available across the street from the restaurant, with a sufficient number of spaces, but it was almost full.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nyanko X

restaurants.name: Yummy Thai Food
restaurants.address:

112 ซอย สองพระ Si Phraya Rd, มหาพฤฒาราม Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very disappointing!

This restaurant is overpriced for foreign tourists, and the prices aren't clearly displayed. I ordered and communicated with the owner in Thai, but the final bill was still unexpectedly high. I was using Google Maps to find nearby restaurants without a specific destination in mind, and I guess the owner assumed I was looking for her place. When I passed her stall, she greeted me, saying "Found you!" It seems the owner is very confident that many tourists eat at her restaurant.

Later, I read the reviews, and it turns out the owner meticulously recorded many low-rated reviews to identify the customers and then responded to them. That's why I'm only writing this review a year later. Fellow Chinese tourists, please avoid this restaurant; it's a total rip-off!
sample_reviews_en.author: M

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best local Thai food! This is my favorite restaurant that I found on Google Maps during my first stay in Bangkok. Every dish was truly delicious and I was completely satisfied!
The rich green curry, crisp som tam, and fluffy crab fried rice were especially exquisite. The stir-fried morning glory and the sour and spicy yum woon sen also had authentic flavors that made it impossible to stop eating. The three of us finished it all in no time. The prices were reasonable, and it was the authentic taste I was looking for!
The staff were also very kind and attentive, accommodating our requests regarding spiciness and portion sizes.
It was a wonderful local experience. I definitely want to go back to this restaurant when I'm in Bangkok again.
Thank you for the delicious meal! 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: 青インコ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great dining experience for breakfast. This was the only restaurant I’ve been to that has a giant turtle as a pet!

Food was delicious, our minced pork omelette was 60 baht each and stir fried morning glory + crispy pork was 80 baht. After our Singha soda, meal was 220 and super enjoyable. Give this place a shot!

EDIT: Crazy that exactly a year later, I revisited this lovely spot and everything is as fresh and tasty as I remembered. Amazing place :)

EDIT 2: love to come back and check in on this family! Everyone is healthy and doing well. New menu. Food is still amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anish Thakkar (Doc Thakkar)

sample_reviews_en.text: I decided to try this restaurant because it was close to my hotel and had good reviews, and it turned out to be a really great restaurant, so I went twice during my stay in Bangkok! The pad thai, crab fried rice, and gapao rice were all delicious. I especially loved the mango smoothie and ordered it both times. The staff (an older man and a younger man) were very kind, which warmed my heart. I also liked the local atmosphere of the restaurant. It was a wonderful memory. I hope to visit again someday.
sample_reviews_en.author: Haru A

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited Yummy Thai Food, and it was an incredible experience! The crab fried rice, pad Thai, Tom Yum, spring rolls, and other dishes were so tasty, packed with flavor, and felt truly authentic. The prices are very reasonable too, which was a pleasant surprise! Friendly service and a cozy spot. I highly recommend Yummy Thai Food to anyone visiting Bangkok. Everyone should try this place. Malaysians - must try!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Levina Wayne

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good food over lunch at Yummy Thai.. situated on a quiet street off from the main street, they served us a good pad Thai and very good mango sticky rice.

Slightly more expensive than other locations, but good quality and quantity. We paid 150 baht for a medium sized plate, which is more than usual but we paid for proximity as it's 100m away from iSanook hostel.

Kind staff and quick service, made fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: OliveG

sample_reviews_en.text: I was in the neighborhood and walked pass this place once before so I decided to give it a try this time. I am glad I did! The foods I ordered definitely were local tastes and just the way I like them! The owner and his staff are friendly and accommodating. The price was also reasonable. Highly recommend if you are in the area!
sample_reviews_en.author: pramoch r

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place! I stayed at a hotel on this street the past week and ate meals here three times and stopped by several more times for their super cheap smoothies (only 40 baht)! Their meals all have multiple price listings for you to decide how much food you want which is very convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Todd Kronenberg

restaurants.name: The Marshal Social Cafe
restaurants.address:

2, 13 Soi Pradipat, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, suitable for business meetings and dinners.
There is both indoor and outdoor seating.
The prices are a bit high, but worth it considering the quality and quantity.
- Beef Wellington: Must be ordered 1 day in advance, 1600 THB.
The price is considered mid-range. The taste and texture are generally good. The meat is tender and easy to eat, but the meat flavor is mild.
- Rigatoni with Squid Pesto:
(Squid pasta with green pesto)
At first glance, I thought the sauce would be very sour, but it's actually creamy like a typical carbonara sauce, but delicious. It also has a slight taste of seafood dipping sauce mixed in, which greatly reduces the richness compared to other pasta dishes.
- Spaghetti Carbonara: Served with a raw egg yolk for added creaminess.
This was my favorite dish, but it can get a bit rich if you eat it continuously. You should find another dish to balance it out.
- Fried Salmon Belly with Chili and Salt:
Okay, the taste is generally good. The salmon is fried crispy and delicious, not too oily and not too dry.
The garlic and chili stir-fry is quite salty, best eaten with hot steamed rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: 15monDe

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a hidden cafe in the Ari area.
Originally a general's residence,
it has been renovated into a cafe.
The new decor is bright and beautiful.
The atmosphere is relaxed, with shady trees.
It feels like visiting an elderly relative's home.

The ground floor has general seating areas,
both indoors (air-conditioned) and
outdoors in the garden.
There is one clean and beautiful restroom.
Upstairs, there are two private rooms with en-suite bathrooms.

The drinks and food are delicious and flavorful.
This time, I didn't try the savory dishes.
I ordered drinks and desserts.
I was so full that I had to take a walk to digest, admiring the garden and
the Amazonian catfish
in the fish pond. There are also stingrays with beautiful and unique patterns.

There are cats lounging in the house
and running around in the garden.

I plan to visit again in the evening.
I often see signs advertising chrysanthemum tea.
☺️✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Nok Ninat

sample_reviews_en.text: We had the opportunity to hold our wedding at this restaurant and were very impressed with the atmosphere. The restaurant is beautiful and has a homey feel. Guests commented that the food was delicious, with generous portions – so much so that we couldn't finish it all! The staff provided excellent service, especially Ms. Sa and Ms. Kung, who greeted and welcomed guests from the moment they arrived. Their service was efficient, fast, and cheerful, making the reception exceptionally good. Guests praised the restaurant non-stop. We will definitely use their services again if we have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eye Hattaya

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Marshal Social Cafe has a really nice, relaxed Thai vibe that makes it easy to settle in and stay a while. The atmosphere feels casual but thoughtfully put together, with a local charm that stands out.

The food is genuinely good—well-flavoured, comforting, and served in a way that feels honest rather than overstyled. Drinks are solid too, and pair well with the overall menu and setting.

Overall, it’s a great spot if you’re looking for good food, good drinks, and a laid-back Thai-inspired atmosphere that feels welcoming and unpretentious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vidya Waghmare

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Old Marshes House has been beautifully redecorated into a cozy, homey restaurant that instantly makes you feel welcome. The charm of the old house is thoughtfully preserved, while the refreshed interiors add warmth, comfort, and an inviting atmosphere—perfect for a relaxed meal.

The space feels intimate and calm, ideal for spending quality time with friends or enjoying a quiet moment to yourself. Soft lighting, tasteful décor, and well-designed seating create a balance between rustic character and modern comfort.
sample_reviews_en.author: Koong 8142

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Thai restaurant has decent food and good service.

It's a Thai restaurant with a nice atmosphere, offering both indoor and outdoor seating. There's plenty of parking, and the staff provides excellent service. The menu focuses on Thai cuisine, with a moderate flavor profile. The prices are reasonable for the Ari area. Overall, it's a good place to bring foreign friends.

Taste: B+
Price: B
Atmosphere: A
Service: A
Cleanliness: A
sample_reviews_en.author: Wattanin Bannasarn

sample_reviews_en.text: A hidden gem in the Pradipat area serving delicious Thai food in a peaceful atmosphere. The restaurant is set in a charming vintage-style house with a lovely garden that makes the place feel very relaxing and cozy. The food was excellent, portions were generous, and everything was full of flavor. Perfect for bringing family, older relatives, or gathering with loved ones for a nice meal together.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amy N.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food didn't quite match the pictures, especially the shrimp.
In the picture, they looked big and fancy, but they weren't what they actually looked like. However, the food was still delicious.
It wasn't crowded at all; the restaurant was quiet. There were only two other tables occupied that day, and there was plenty of parking.
The restrooms were very clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: W P

restaurants.name: Nak La Mookata Imperial World Samrong
restaurants.address:

MH2W+4PC, Tambon Sam Rong Nua, Mueang Samut Prakan District, Samut Prakan 10270, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my absolute favorite Mookata (Thai BBQ) restaurant! It's air-conditioned, perfect for those who don't usually get their money's worth with buffets, haha. Just eat until you're full. No queues when you arrive. I have to commend all the dipping sauces – they're the best! The Jaew (spicy dipping sauce) is authentic, not fake, haha. The staff provides great service. You order via QR code, and the vegetables and dipping sauces are free. Today I ordered the medium set and a few extra items. It was great. I especially loved the Wagyu beef garlic fried rice – it was delicious! I highly recommend it. The fried rice is so fragrant, and the beef is tender and not chewy. It's amazing! I haven't tried the other side dishes yet, but I'll try them next time. In short, I loved it and will definitely go again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Joy Za

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is airy and not crowded. The staff provided excellent service. The pork belly and mala pork were delicious. The crying tiger was delicious, but the bitter liver was a fail. The garlic fried rice was fragrant and delicious, but it wasn't hot enough. The fried pork salad didn't pass because the pork belly was coated in flour and fried. It was greasy and then the sauce was thick. The batter that coated it absorbed the sauce, making it not crispy. If the fried pork wasn't coated in flour, it would have been better.

Overall, the food, the atmosphere, and the service were good. The prices were reasonable. The vegetables were fresh, the dipping sauce was good, and it was free.
sample_reviews_en.author: N. sukkaluk

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate there last Sunday, February 8th, 2026. Overall, the food was average, and the dipping sauces weren't anything special. But the thing that was most unpleasant was the female staff member clearing the tables. She was incredibly noisy, practically throwing the dishes, spoons, and forks onto the cart. I was startled several times, but she didn't apologize at all. This is in stark contrast to another brand where even a dropped spoon is met with immediate apologies from the staff. I understand that they might be tired or there are a lot of customers, but if you're going to work in customer service and behave like this, I suggest you stay home and calm down first.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supaporn Somchit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything is delicious. Come try it!
AEC employees might need to listen carefully.

**Further Update**
This was my second visit. The waiter served the wrong set.
I ordered the large 499 baht set, but the waiter served the small set.
Luckily, I've eaten here before so I know. I recommend double-checking your order.
Make sure it matches the picture you ordered. Check again when you get the bill.
The staff didn't patrol the entire restaurant; there was no one to wave to call them.
I had to walk over to them. I recommend having a button to call the staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Parichat Deeudom

sample_reviews_en.text: My regular restaurant. I like to go late at night when there aren't many people, so I can sit and chill. The food is delicious, the sauce is delicious, and the food is good. It's made to order. The branch doesn't yet participate in the buffet, but lately I've felt that the air conditioning isn't very cool sometimes, but most of the time it's very cool. The food comes out quickly. The fried rice with fried pork rinds is very delicious. I recommend you try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: อรกัญญา พัฒนสาร

sample_reviews_en.text: This mookata restaurant is one of my favorites, especially because it offers unlimited vegetables. There’s usually a long queue, and we waited around 20 minutes to be seated. While the meat portion might not be quite enough for two people, the unlimited vegetables make up for it and make the experience well worth it. I would definitely recommend this place and will gladly return again.
sample_reviews_en.author: GlobeStepsby Yune

sample_reviews_en.text: Many items were out of stock: chili peppers, garlic, glass noodles, pumpkin, and the meat was very tough. The staff were mostly foreigners, making communication almost impossible. The food was also served very slowly; it took ages to get each item after ordering. I've eaten here twice and been disappointed both times, even though other branches are much better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Youyou

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and clean. The pork isn't too fatty, but it's a bit dry. I really like the cheese toast here; it's delicious, sweet, salty, and creamy. This restaurant offers unlimited refills of vegetables, glass noodles, and dipping sauces with no extra charge. The "Nam Laa" (spicy dipping sauce) is excellent; adding lime makes it the best.
sample_reviews_en.author: SSC

restaurants.name: Aoringo Curry (Ratchaphruek)
restaurants.address:

QC8W+M28 บางระมาด Bang Ramat, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Menu Ordered:
- Crispy Pork Cutlet Curry Rice (280฿)
During my visit, there was a promotion where a set meal included a free salad and dessert.

The crispy pork cutlet was perfectly fried, a beautiful golden color, not greasy, and juicy – ​​not dry or tough. I loved it.

The curry sauce wasn't very thick, with a salty, sweet, and slightly sour taste from the green apple used to simmer the sauce.

The rice was beautifully cooked (you can ask for more or less rice).

There's no option to choose the spiciness level, but chilies are available to add.

The side dishes included pickled vegetables and pickled scallions.
Eating them together created a complete flavor profile, with a nice crunch and a good tangy contrast.

The restaurant is spacious and comfortable.
The staff provided good service, attentive and constantly refilling our water.

🚗 There is ample parking.
sample_reviews_th.author: MISSYS

sample_reviews_th.text:
The shop is clean.
The curry rice is delicious and the portions are generous.
I love the coffee jelly. (づ๑•ᴗ•๑)づ♡
sample_reviews_th.author: Natcha T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Aoringo, J Arena Ratchaphruek Branch

This homemade curry restaurant uses a secret blend of spices and apples, as the name suggests. The curry is simmered for a long time to achieve a unique flavor unlike any other in the city. The J Arena branch in the Ratchaphruek area makes it convenient for those who want to enjoy their curry without having to travel far into the city.

The main menu items are curry dishes, but they offer a wide variety of toppings, including fried pork, tenderloin, sirloin, hamburger, sausage, and squid. Sets include a drink and your choice of one dessert (coffee jelly or milk pudding).

Curry comes with two side dishes: pickled lotus root to balance the richness and enhance the flavor, and pickled scallions for a crunchy texture.

Spiced and Soy Sauce Braised Pork Curry Rice (360 THB): The curry rice is rich in flavor, but the sauce isn't too thick, making it easy to eat. The spice flavor is distinct, with a slight sweet and sour aftertaste. The braised pork topping is incredibly tender. It has a sweet and salty taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Origami

sample_reviews_en.text: The only original Thai Brand of Japanese Kare invented by a Japanese expat and transferred to a Thai-Japanese owner. The curry comes into a set of 300+ baht with salad and dessert which is quite expensive compared to the Japanese brand franchises. Being a Thai brand this shouldn't cost that much as they should promote to local Thai people not a Japanese expat. They claimed to be certified by the Japanese Association but that is when Thailand doesn't have any Kare restaurant. Go there just to try the brand sake otherwise there is nothing much there worth of money. There is plenty of parking available but the food is not. The services by staff are commendable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thusnai M

sample_reviews_en.text:
I used to only eat at the Thaniya building branch. Today I searched for curry rice restaurants online.
That's how I found out there's a branch in Ratchaphruek.

The atmosphere is the same as the Thaniya branch, and the food is just as delicious.
The price is a bit high, but that's understandable for this area.

The fried pork looked great; it wasn't oily, and the pork was still tender and not dry.
The side dishes were good. The food comes as a set with salad, rice, and dessert.
Rice refills are free.

There's free parking, and the restaurant is air-conditioned and comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tinnapop แอบกิน แอบเที่ยว

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Japanese curry restaurant serves delicious curry.

Compared to other Japanese curry brands, this one has a much more unique character, both in the flavor of the curry and the side dishes.
The curry itself is less spicier than many others, but it has a distinct fruity flavor. The pickled vegetables on the side are also a type you don't often see at other restaurants. Overall, for curry lovers, this is a restaurant worth trying at least once.
For this branch, you can park in the J Arena complex; there are plenty of parking spaces available and they are free.
sample_reviews_en.author: Koramit Jenjirawatn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Their curry is pretty creamy, smooth, and sweet. The amount of curry is a bit too small comparing to the rice which doesn't come that much either. Rice is pressed and spread so thin on the plate. Fortunately, rice is refillable. The deep fried toppings are great, perfectly cooked with fresh cooking oil. Apart from the topping, I think they need to revise with the amount of rice and curry.

Overall, an okay experience here.
sample_reviews_en.author: apiwatbob

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten at the Thaniya branch before. Today, I felt the flavor wasn't as intense. The fried pork and other fried items were still good, but I tried a new dish, the pork stir-fried with pineapple, and felt there was very little pork compared to the fried pork. A bit disappointing with that dish.

The restaurant is comfortable, and the staff provides good service. It wasn't crowded when I ate around 2 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: PJ z

restaurants.name: Gyofu Vegetarian Dumplings - เกี๊ยวฟู
restaurants.address:

212 Yaowarat Rd, Chakkrawat, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: New vegan restaurant in Chinatown specializing in dumplings, both steamed and fried. Also several different soups with noodles and dumplings. Went in today for the first time and tried most of their menu items - everything was really great, I’m definitely going back for more. Serving sizes are nice and prices are very moderate. They have a nice variety of iced coffees and teas all served with oat milk. There are a few tables upstairs on the second floor and some bar stools downstairs. Service is warm and welcoming. You scan a barcode at your table and place your order to be served at your table, then later come pay downstairs before you leave. Truly a gem, do not skip!
sample_reviews_en.author: Guy Braverman

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just stumbled across this place and anything I would say wouldn't be enough on how amazing this place  is-from the food, flavours to staff and ambience, just a perfect gem. They have the best Thai tea✨ (seriously) and make sure to order the coconut ice cream✨- my personal favorite, and I had both tom yum✨ (tangy-my favorite) and khao soi noodles(flavorful). And ofc the salad✨.
The owner- super nice and so was the staff, they are adorable.
They even had these miniatures to show the filling of the dumplings to make it easier to identify the ingredients and which Flavour to pick from.
Definitely visiting here again on my next visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Muskan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a vegetarian restaurant you’ll definitely want to visit! Every dish here is flavorful, well-seasoned, and honestly. It’ll make you forget all the bland vegetarian food you’ve ever tried before.

All the ingredients are clean, fresh, and high-quality. The prices are also very reasonable, starting from just 59 THB.

If you’re not sure what to order, the Khao Soi is a must-try. It’s rich, aromatic, and absolutely delicious. And don’t skip the ice cream. It’s light, refreshing, and the perfect sweet finish to your meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanakrit Chankhajorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just tried Gyofu Vegetarian Dumplings and I’m honestly obsessed. Everything was sooo good, but the standout was their fried Thai curry dumplings, which were insanely flavorful and crispy in the best way. Every dumpling we tried hit, no misses at all. Even the khao soi was really solid and comforting. The staff was also so lovely and made the experience even better.

If you’re in Chinatown and want vegetarian food that actually slaps, this place is a must.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anvi Mehta

sample_reviews_en.text:
Walked around Chinatown and stumbled upon this vegetarian / plant-based restaurant that serves dumplings. Anyone looking for a nice meal, this is the place to go for authentic vegetarian dumplings and other local dishes. I had the khao soi, a noodle curry-based soup from the north of Thailand, with shiitake mushroom dumplings, it was simply divine.

Very friendly staff, welcoming and very affordable prices. Highly recommend and will definitely go back!
sample_reviews_en.author: William

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely amazing – hands down the best dumplings we’ve ever had!

The menu has so many great options that it’s honestly hard to choose because everything sounds delicious. The prices are very reasonable, especially for the quality of food.

We didn’t have to wait long for our order, which was a nice surprise. Everything came out fresh, hot, and full of flavor.

If you’re in the area, this place is a must-visit – especially if you love dumplings!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jovana Stojanovic

sample_reviews_en.text:
🌱 If you’re vegan or vegetarian, you have to try this place!

🥟 Fresh handmade dumplings with lots of fillings to choose from. My favorites were the mushroom and mushroom with Thai red curry,so flavorful and delicious! 😍

🇨🇳🇹🇭 The flavors are a perfect mix of authentic Chinese and Thai cuisine.

💰 Great value for money, generous portions, and everything tasted fresh.

✨ Highly recommend! I’ll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kotchakorn Phensuk

sample_reviews_en.text: Really lovely find amidst the bustling Chinatown in Bangkok - Gyofu serves really tasty vegetarian dumplings, and in addition, the restaurant’s atmosphere is very peaceful and service staff are all very friendly and helpful. Highly recommended - even for non-vegetarians!  (Special mention of their flavorful Khao Soi, and oat milk-based Thai milk tea - both of which are really delicious too!)
sample_reviews_en.author: Kai

restaurants.name: Suda Restaurant
restaurants.address:

6 1 Sukhumvit 14 Alley, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Suda Restaurant is one of those classic local Thai restaurants that has stood the test of time. Tucked away in Sukhumvit Soi 14, just a short walk from Asok BTS and Terminal 21, it’s a great place if you’re looking for authentic Thai food at very reasonable prices.

The menu is extensive, and the prices are surprisingly affordable considering the location, although I found some of the portions to be a little small. The atmosphere is simple and casual, and the service is fast and efficient, even when the restaurant is busy.

The only downside is that the restaurant is not air-conditioned. Even in the evening, it can get quite hot while dining, so be prepared if you’re sensitive to the heat.

Overall, if you’re after a no-frills restaurant serving authentic Thai comfort food without paying tourist prices, Suda Restaurant is definitely worth a visit. A solid choice for both locals and visitors alike.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leonard Lim

sample_reviews_en.text: The smiling face of the elderly owner is soothing! This is a local Thai restaurant that's open until 11pm. It's closed on Sundays. Terminal 21 closes at 10pm, so if you're here before 10:30pm, when the last order is made, this is the place to go. It's easy to find, as it's located just off the main road and bustling with activity, just a short walk from BTS ASOK Station Exit 4. I arrived on a Monday night at 9pm, and about 80% of the seats were taken. It's an open space with no air conditioning, so it gets hot without a fan. The bottled beer is nicely chilled. If you're eating alone, you can order a small portion, and if you're with a group, the staff will advise you on whether to order a medium or large portion. The menu is easy to understand, with pictures and written in English. Most customers are Westerners, Chinese, and Japanese. Be warned, the tom yum soup is extremely spicy.
sample_reviews_en.author: mac noritetsu

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is Sudar Restaurant.

It's a long-established, casual eatery in Bangkok where you can easily enjoy authentic Thai cuisine. Popular with both tourists and locals, the restaurant has a lively yet relaxed atmosphere where you can enjoy your meal. The menu is extensive, and classic dishes such as Pad Thai and Green Curry are all flavorful and have just the right amount of spiciness, making them easy to eat. The prices are reasonable, and the portions are generous, so you'll feel it's great value for money. The staff are friendly, making it an easy place to visit even for first-timers. This is a recommended restaurant for anyone who wants to enjoy delicious Thai food easily in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: パパちゃん

sample_reviews_en.text:
My accommodation was in Asok, so I took a leisurely walk there, but I was sweating profusely ;;;

I ordered fried rice and Tod Man Goong. Wow, Tod Man Goong tastes so hot it really calls for a Coke.

I downed two bottles of Coke in the middle of the day. After ordering, the fried rice came out first, and the Tod Man Goong came out 2-3 minutes later. I went back a few times for dinner, and it was really crowded.

There were quite a few foreigners there, probably because the owner speaks English incredibly well.

Seeing them greet each other, they seem to be quite friendly with one another. It’s the perfect place to eat, get a foot massage in the alley, and then head over.
sample_reviews_en.author: Min

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is right next to the MRT station and is easy to find. Many Europeans and Americans love this place. I live in this area often, so it's on my wish list too. The downside is that there's no air conditioning, but there are big fans. It gets crowded during mealtimes, so the restaurant doesn't work very fast and you have to wait a while for a seat. Remember to avoid mealtimes. The upside is that the food is delicious and the portions aren't too big. It's a rare Thai stir-fry restaurant in the city center.
sample_reviews_en.author: 罌粟花

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolute gem of a restaurant right in the middle of Bangkok! I’m always looking for somewhere the locals eat - Suda didn’t disappoint! Looks like an old, local place that hasn’t changed in years, but great atmosphere, friendly service and incredible, tasty food at brilliant prices. The morning glory was something else and don’t miss out on the Mango Sticky Rice to finish!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nick Broom

sample_reviews_en.text: Suda is a restaurant that has been open for over 50 years. It's no easy feat to maintain its popularity in Bangkok's prime location with decent food. It lacks air conditioning, fancy decor, and even basic service, yet there's often a queue during mealtimes because of its authentic flavors and reasonable prices. The fried chicken wings are definitely a top choice.
sample_reviews_en.author: tony kuan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I imagine an old-fashioned restaurant from back in the day, resisting the "wokification" of the neighborhood.

I love the Khmer-style concrete Art Deco. The prices are higher than in Yahowarat, but that's to be expected. I stumbled upon it by chance. A guy stood me up.
The women are friendly. You should go and grab three big Leos! 😅😍
sample_reviews_en.author: robertozizi

restaurants.name: Auan's Noodle
restaurants.address:

421 Chok Chai 4 Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a Yen Ta Fo (pink noodle soup) shop that I often buy to take home. The shop is located a little past Soi Chokchai 4, Soi 49. Parking is difficult, so I usually buy it to eat at home. If you come after 8 PM, drive past Soi Chokchai 4, Soi 45, and you might find some parking space on the side of the road. It's not far to walk from there.

Alternatively, one person can buy while another drives into T. Ruamchok Soi, finds parking inside the soi, and then circles back to pick up the other person across from the shop.

I usually only order the Yen Ta Fo; it's delicious, the broth is rich, the morning glory is fresh and blanched, and it comes with fried shrimp.
The price is reasonable.
The shop has a casual, lively atmosphere.

I recommend buying the fried shrimp separately to snack on when ordering takeout. It's fun and inexpensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chompunake K

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a delicious Yentafo noodle shop in the Chokchai 4 area. The shop opens at 2 PM and closes at 11 PM. It's a large, airy, single-story building with plenty of tables. It's a popular spot with a steady stream of customers. They sell Yentafo and Kuay Jab, but their signature dish is the fried shrimp.
The shop's signature dishes are Yentafo and fried shrimp.
The menu items I tried were Yentafo Tom Yum soup and fried shrimp.
-Yentafo Tom Yum soup: The Tom Yum Yentafo broth is intensely flavorful. The fish balls are small and not fishy. The fish cake is soft and tasty. The morning glory is fresh and crispy.
-Fried shrimp: The shrimp is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, not oily.
If you're in Chokchai 4, be sure to stop by and try it. It's truly delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirichai Thananunthakit

sample_reviews_en.text:
This famous noodle shop in the Chokchai 4 area has been my family's favorite for a long time. The taste is comparable to the older shops in the city. I especially love their shrimp meatballs, and their yentafo (pink noodle soup) or tom yum yentafo is incredibly flavorful.

My favorite dish is the dry tom yum with thin noodles. It's best to eat it at the shop because the noodles don't stick together. Their yentafo and tom yum yentafo are also delicious. The owner might make it a little sweet, but you can ask them to adjust the seasoning.

They only accept cash, so please prepare your money. The owner will give change regardless of the amount. There's some parking available in front of the shop if you're driving.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phakwipha Kaewwisit

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's been a while since my last visit. This time, I feel the service has improved significantly and is much faster than before (previously, I had to wait a very long time, even when it wasn't peak time).

The highlight of this restaurant's Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) is the battered and fried shrimp, one per bowl. The shrimp aren't huge, but the highlight is the thick and incredibly crispy batter. If you want more, you can buy them for 40 baht per bag.

The restaurant sells Yen Ta Fo and Kuay Jab (Thai noodle soup). They only accept cash, no transfers. There's no parking (you have to park on the street). Remember to read the ordering rules posted on the wall before ordering! :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukwan At.

sample_reviews_en.text: This roadside stall in Soi Chokchai 4 opens in the evenings and sells Tom Yum Yentafo noodles and thick broth Kuay Jab. The prices are a bit high, starting at 60 baht, possibly because it's a late-night spot. The Yentafo itself is just okay, but the Tom Yum is delicious, especially with the crispy wontons. It has plenty of ingredients, including small fried shrimp (which you can order extra for 40 baht for a small bowl). They also sell smoothies; I ordered an orange smoothie but got orange-flavored saltwater instead. They only accept cash, no bank transfers. Parking is available on the roadside late at night.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffey

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is our go-to restaurant when we can't decide what to eat. They make really flavorful dishes, including their Yen Ta Fo (pink noodle soup), Tom Yum (spicy sour soup), and Kuay Jab (rice noodle soup with various toppings).

Parking can be a bit difficult, as you'll have to find a spot on the street depending on the day and time you visit.

The restaurant can get quite hot inside.

The staff are attentive and take orders promptly; you don't have to look for them.

In short, it's a restaurant worth trying, especially if you like Yen Ta Fo.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pensupa C.

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was pretty good considering the large number of customers. The Tom Yum and Yen Ta Fo soups were delicious and were their main selling points. They also have a hearty Braised Pork Noodle Soup (Khao Piak) to offer a change from regular noodles. However, I'm wondering if they even have Tom Yum Yen Ta Fo soup (without noodles) because I ordered Tom Yum but received regular Yen Ta Fo soup instead. I suggest updating the menu for the customers' information.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐฐากร

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered a special Tom Yum Yen Ta Fo noodle soup with extra toppings for 70 baht (I loved the aroma and flavor of the chili paste they added).
+ Fried shrimp for 40 baht (highly recommended, it's delicious!). I got 5 medium-sized shrimp, not too small or too big, with a very crispy batter.

Parking is available on the street in front of the shop or across the street, depending on the day.

The shop only accepts cash, no bank transfers.
sample_reviews_en.author: theSMOKKOK

restaurants.name: Eat Am Are Major Cineplex Ratchayothin
restaurants.address:

ซี ชั้น 2, 1839 ห้องเลขที่ 202,202เอ,201, Phahonyothin Rd, Lat Yao, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
My go-to spot when I watch movies here. It's on the second floor near the ticket counter. It gets crowded in the evenings, so you have to queue. Ordering is via QR code.

I like the Hawaiian grilled chicken + cheese sausage, with added mashed potatoes (15฿).
A pitcher of Coke is 90฿; you can get a takeaway cup if you don't finish it.
Payment is cash or via QR code.
sample_reviews_th.author: Mist _in_Blue

sample_reviews_en.text:
We originally planned to try a nearby hot pot place, but when we got there, we found out they were renovating and had stopped serving the rotating conveyor-belt hot pot. So we ended up at this very popular Western-style casual dining spot instead.
It was easy to find – on the 2nd floor of Ratchayothin Mall.
It was packed – we had to queue for a while. The service was great – the host who called our number knew we didn't speak Thai and made a point of letting us know when our table was ready. Even though the place was crowded, every waiter/waitress was still really attentive and careful.
We ordered a chicken chop with fish and chips, and a chicken chop with fried shrimp – plus two Cokes. The food was solid overall – the ingredients were fresh too. Definitely a good choice when you're hungry.
sample_reviews_en.author: HAOLIN LI

sample_reviews_en.text: The ordering system was messy. I came with a friend and we ordered two dishes. Only one arrived; the other took another 20 minutes and still hadn't come, so we had to follow up. Normally, when you order directly from a staff member, everything arrives at once. I don't know if the system is malfunctioning. In total, we waited 40 minutes for the second dish from the time it was listed on the bill. Plus, the black pepper pork steak didn't even have the black pepper sauce. But at that point, I didn't want to follow up anymore. Honestly, if it was going to be late, it should have arrived at the same time. The first dish was completely cold. I wouldn't complain if every table was slow, but other tables that ordered later got their food before the second dish that we were waiting for.
sample_reviews_en.author: M PP

sample_reviews_en.text:
Although I've seen it for a long time (and it's always crowded), this was my first time at Eat Am Are. Since I arrived early after the mall opened, I didn't have to wait in line. However, after sitting for a while, the staff started calling out numbers using the loudspeaker.

I tried the steak and spaghetti, and they were all pretty good. The meat portions were large and worth the price. The side salad used simple shredded cabbage, which I personally didn't like. The onion rings, another side dish, were beautifully fried but soft, not crispy, and had a thick batter. The spaghetti and baked spinach with cheese were delicious.

Considering the price and location, it's a very good value restaurant. 👍😋
sample_reviews_en.author: MybOy ThaiLand

sample_reviews_en.text: On January 16, 2025, I visited the restaurant and ordered a dish. While eating the bread, I discovered a cockroach in my food. I informed the staff, who apologized and prepared a new dish. However, I believe finding a cockroach in food is completely unacceptable, and the company should have taken more responsibility for the consumer. I was too unwell to continue eating. I contacted the branch manager and explained the situation. The manager stated that the company would contact me, and I emphasized that they should contact me by January 16, 2025. As of January 17, 2025, I have still not received any contact from the company. I contacted them again today, but still have not received a call back.
sample_reviews_en.author: p ppp

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The service staff were good, polite, and neatly dressed, wearing gloves and hairnets. They wiped down tables, chairs, and condiments after each customer finished paying the bill. - The food tasted good. I liked the Thai papaya salad, mashed potatoes, and the Dolly fish; the fish was tender and in a large piece, not fishy at all. The pork ribs were easy to eat and not chewy at all.
- The portions were very generous, making it good value for the price.
However, on my last order, I got sausage and salmon, and the fish pieces were surprisingly small. I personally don't really like cabbage salad, and sometimes they give too much of it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rainbow Chompoo

sample_reviews_en.text:
A delicious steak restaurant with good value for money and fast service.

Our recommended dishes are the pork chop and the garlic pork (sliced ​​into strips, giving it a feel similar to grilled pork neck). Side dishes include fried rice and papaya salad (Thai style, moderately spicy and delicious). Eating them together is very filling.

🥤 For soft drinks, if you're in a group, we recommend ordering a pitcher for 90 baht. It yields more than 6 glasses. Ice is 2 baht per glass. Individual soft drinks are 30 baht each.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanyatorn (LukTarn)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Eat Am Are is located on the 2nd floor of Major Ratchayothin. Right next to the cinema kiosk/counter.

The place offers Thai Style (inexpensive) steak and fries and so as other fusion food. The amount of food portion you get for what you paid for is unbelievable. Totally worth it.

The branch here just open in Feb 2022. All staff at this branch are very prompt and attentive to all customer needs.

Recommended dishes: Deep Fried Pork Knuckle, Tuna Salad, Sausages Steak

The place accept both cash and bank transfer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donny Boonyamanop

restaurants.name: บุรินทร์ เบอร์เกอร์ & สเต๊ก Burin Burger & Steak
restaurants.address:

317 Ban Mo, Wangburapapirom, Pranakorn, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I spent ages wandering around the places near Tha Tien. Since I was already tired of the local food and the smells, I decided to go back to something more Western. I found this restaurant because of its rating.

Despite being small and unassuming, I found it incredible, absolutely amazing. I ordered a burger and wow, what flavor! The ingredients were fresh and without that typical local seasoning. The beer was ice cold. Then I ordered a piece of beef cooked on a board, medium-rare, and as Brazilians would say: “Nossaaaaa!” Honestly, it's small for how great it is. 100% recommended. The service is incredible and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Juan Pablo Flores Vargas

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came to this cafe based on reviews, and we didn't regret it. The location is convenient, a little out of the center, so it's quiet and comfortable. The prices are reasonable: you can get a reasonably tasty steak with potatoes and salad for around 200 baht.

Unlike many Thai cafes, you can feed a child well here if you're with family. It's also comfortable for a couple. We live in Phuket and don't always crave Thai food—we usually choose something closer to European or Russian cuisine. This place definitely didn't disappoint.

We had spaghetti, a burger, and a pork chop—everything was delicious, fresh, and well-prepared. Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: Рустем Виноград

sample_reviews_en.text: Moderate experience at Burin Burger & Steak in Bangkok. The Kurpbuta pork cheese burger with a single patty was excellent, perfectly balanced in flavor. The salad with sesame sauce was fresh and complemented the meal well. I found the honey lemon juice to be super refreshing. However, the mushroom soup was disappointing—too watery and lacking flavor. The ambiance of the restaurant is inviting with good air-conditioning, but the seating space is limited, making it unsuitable for larger groups. Additionally, the location is a bit of a trek from Sampheng Market. Overall, it has its highlights but also some areas for improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Win Paragon

sample_reviews_en.text: The homemade-style triple beef burger, with three thick patties, costs 379 baht. The flavor and aroma are excellent, with a well-balanced salty and savory taste, and a hint of pepper. The meat is slightly juicy. Compared to well-known burger brands, it's quite filling and good value. Considering the style of the restaurant and the ingredients, the value is moderate to slightly expensive. The overflowing blended cocoa is rich and meets the standard of blended cocoa drinks found in the market.
sample_reviews_en.author: ล่องลอย ต้านสายลม

sample_reviews_en.text: Having been pulled off the main road based on the good reviews, I arrived here around 7:00 PM... I was in the mood for Western food, and when I asked if I should order pork or beef, the waitress recommended the beef burger... really... it was cooked medium rare with really big, tasty fries in fifteen minutes... had delicious non-alcoholic drinks... highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dusko Djukic

sample_reviews_en.text:
A vurguer and healthy food, near from the center, it's a small but very clean and nice place. They recommended what and how many food to take, and always with a smile, the mabager is super nice, also the chef.

Burguer, salmon and fries where very good cooked, flavour and quality. If you want to eat healthy and enjoy u should visit this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Iker D

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was so delicious! Worth the wait. The food came out very quickly. Excellent value for money. Highly recommend! They also accept the government's co-payment scheme right now.

The food is superb. I’ve been wanting to visit and try the food here for a long time and it is satisfying. The beef burger is definitely worth trying!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanita Ruamchat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food is good .
There's like two people in this tiny little shop.
It can't have a good atmosphere because the place is too small.
.
They can't speak English.
They charge 3% extra on any card you use , whether international or local cards.
The price is already expensive, but they still charge 3% extra for using a card payment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brandy Cambodia

restaurants.name: Naga Cafe
restaurants.address:

170 6-7 Thanon Suan Phlu, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I can’t praise this place enough. The Very comfortable and quirky atmosphere is enhanced by friendly polite staff who are totally on the ball.
Couple this excellent foundation with food that is of superb quality (I had the Thai red curry with pork and it was about the best I’ve ever had) and presented in a beautifully understated, yet personal way - and you’ve got a little glimpse of Naga Cafe.
Very very well done guys, your efforts in pleasing the customer have not gone unnoticed by me. Super. Highly recommended!
UPDATE:
