Have been back a few times now since reopening after the dreaded Covid lockdown and I'm pleased to report that nothing has changed. If you like Tom Yam style, I can highly recommend the Jungle Curry with Pork. It was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brendan Gorman

sample_reviews_en.text:
It’s a restaurant for the tourists, you’ll see there’s no locals.

A pomelo salad that could give you diabetes.
The chicken is as tough as stone — it’s amazing they can even messed up chicken.
And the “beef” on the beef fried rice is like rubber, like it was cooked by my 5-year-old brother.

I got a coffee and asked the staff if it was supposed to come with milk. He told me, “I don’t know,” and then asked what I wanted in it. So imagine a staff don’t even know about their own menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ede T

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just amazing place, amazing food, good price, best quality. Friendly staff, friendly owners... I am returning back and always great service, delicious food. If you ask me if is worthed ? Yes yes yes and again yes. We had a birthday girl, I have vooked in advance and they organised really tasty and beautiful cake
Thanks again Naga Cafe team for excelent service, for delicious food, for unforgettable experience and memories. KapKhunKrap
Keep it that way, you are doing amazing job.
sample_reviews_en.author: Drago Satosek

sample_reviews_en.text:
Naga Cafe is my favorite place in Bangkok- for the good food and the lovely host Sanit!

All dishes are very well prepared. The menu features typical Thai dishes as well as some international items.
Interior might be called kind of wild or unique - in any way it is not some streamlined design, but has a very personal touch.
Host Sanit is a wonderful person, always friendly, helpful and often full of laughter, trying his utmost to make veryone feel comfortable!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nik Braun

sample_reviews_en.text: Start of our 3rd week in Thailand and our second day in Bangkok and we stumbled across the Naga Thai Cuisine restaurant while looking for a nice place for dinner. What a find, simply delicious. The interior is very eclectic and fun. Wait staff friendly and food service was fast. We had five different dishes and all were incredible. The best Thai food we have had since being in Thailand. We are coming back tomorrow too 🥰. Aroi, aroi mak!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dan Brown

sample_reviews_en.text: Only in Bangkok for 3 nights and followed the great reviews to find this fantastic restaurant. I would say the papaya salad is the best thing I can remember eating for- well a long time. The food in general was utterly brilliant. Spice levels adjusted and for me- I like the heat- spot on. Service was great, good chat, great advice on food. Even with a bottle of wine the price was well below what I would have been very happy to pay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Glen Gribbon

sample_reviews_en.text: Discovered it by chance. Food was simply amazing the atmosphere as well. Very friendly people it felt like home away from home. We end up turning up there for dinner and what really strike me we were not the only one. We kept seeing the same people. I wish there were more of those restaurants in Thailand and further away. Not sure if we will visit Bangkok soon again but if we will definitely come looking for this place again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Valkanov Kostadin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Walked in here by chance last night as we are staying close by,  I honestly think it was one of the best Thai meals I’ve ever had… we were basic and went for a pad Thai and green Thai curry (vegetables and tofu) and coconut rice… it was SO tasty, the rice was perfect. Will definitely be back, maybe this evening!
Service was also great, and the restaurant itself is very interesting and eclectic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Georgie Harris

restaurants.name: The Vegetarian Cottage
restaurants.address:

41/19 Vibhavadi Rangsit 16/21 Alley, Khwaeng Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I asked for the server to recommend, and I ordered filet mignon with balsamic cream and I like how simple it is. The sauce compliments the mock meat, the sides of mushroom and mash potato goes well with the sauce as well. The Bale fruit tea was great. It gives a nice earthy feel to it Overall great experience.

Another occasion I ordered Cag au vin, which is slow cooked chicken in red wine, it taste great. I ordered a Ranee cocktail, taste great as well. It has a unique taste to it which is awesome.

I went there on a 3rd, 4th & 5thoccasion as well.

Overall, I will say the food replica is very close to the real meat. It's pretty amazing how they do it. I recommend going for the lobster soup which is nice. Not the full thing, as it felt too much for me. Other things on the menu are delicious as well, I recommend you to go for what you like.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phoenix

sample_reviews_en.text:
• This is an old, long-established vegetarian restaurant located in a side street off Vibhavadi Road. If you're coming from Ladprao, you can enter via Soi 26. There's plenty of parking in front of the restaurant.
• The interior is spacious and has a homey feel with plenty of seating. The female staff member taking orders is friendly and provides good service.
• The menu is extensive, but almost every dish contains plant-based meat substitutes. Those who follow a vegan, clean/raw food diet or prioritize fresh vegetables might not like it. The restaurant should consider adding more menu items to cater to this customer group.
• The food tastes good. If you prefer a vegetarian option without onions and garlic, you can inform the staff.
• The prices are relatively high compared to other vegetarian restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: BeboBeing

sample_reviews_en.text:
Extremely quiet area. A calming atmosphere with the fountain and plants in the garden.

The staff tried very hard. In my opinion, even too hard, because they were constantly watching you, which was a bit unsettling.

At lunchtime, there was only one other customer besides me.

The menu presented the owner's personal story of wanting to offer healthy, plant-based alternatives. However, the Masaman Curry had no vegetables other than three potato cubes and was full of vegan meat. That's not healthy either. I was disappointed.

The plastic tablecloth kept sticking to my legs (I was wearing shorts).

I think the idea of ​​a plant-based restaurant is great, but there are too many shortcomings.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emulator93

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the longest-running vegetarian and vegan restaurants.

Owned by the same owners as SPA Food, almost every menu item contains products from SPA Food, many of which are imitation vegetarian/vegan.

Portions aren't very large, priced from 100 baht up to 300 baht per dish.

Rice is unlimited refills, priced at 35 baht per person.

High chairs are available, and private areas for small parties are possible. The staff are lovely and provide good service.

I like the Father's Day and Mother's Day promotions; if you bring your father or mother, they eat for free (my three children brought their mother, so four of us paid 75%). I hope they have these promotions regularly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manutchai Banchongsirichareon

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old vegetarian restaurant in the neighborhood that predates the plant-based trend. Each dish is creatively crafted to look very similar to regular meat dishes, and the food tastes excellent. The tuna stir-fried with ginger and chili is particularly fragrant, and the fermented pork fried rice is also delicious. They also have a variety of ice cream flavors made with soy milk instead of cow's milk, which is tasty and not too sweet. The restaurant is housed in a converted former residence and has ample seating. It's decorated in a vintage style, has clean restrooms, and plenty of parking under the trees.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukid Panja

sample_reviews_en.text: Restaurant with an unusual and original setting, very cozy, making you feel right at home. The service is excellent—attentive and friendly. Everything is vegan, and there are also fridges where you can buy textured soy protein that mimics meat and fish. You can really tell that this place is genuinely committed to promoting vegan values. The portions are generous. There’s a wide variety on the menu, whether it's starters, main courses, desserts, or drinks. I didn’t expect to find such a peaceful restaurant in Bangkok. It’s very relaxing to have lunch or dinner there. There's lots of greenery. I’ll be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chloe Fabre

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere of the restaurant was very delightful, bringing the ancient Roman elements through decorations into the heart of Siam. I had to personally snap a few photos of the scenery and decorations myself. The restaurant had a very elegant and sophisticated feel to it, with well made tables and a comfortable environment. Each dish we ordered came well prepared and proved to be pleasantly satisfying and delicious. The staff were very attentive to an exemplary level and well mannered. The overall experience was unexpectedly unforgettable, leaving us with no choice, but to come back for a second visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ami San

sample_reviews_en.text:
My only criticism is the atmosphere. It was incredibly quiet and eerie. Eating there felt so oppressive. They should play some soft background music to drown out the sound of my chewing; I could even hear my own breathing! 55555

BUT!!!! The food was AMAZING! Absolutely amazing. They did an outstanding job transforming vegetarian food. Looking at the menu, I thought the prices were a bit high, but once I tasted it, I was completely sold! 🤤
sample_reviews_en.author: B KTC

restaurants.name: CANABANGKA FARM & DISPENSARY (Ramkhamhaeng 26/2)
restaurants.address:

51 Ramkhamhaeng 26/2 Alley, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Review for the Cannabis Farm Tour

I recently had the pleasure of visiting a cannabis farm, and it was an unforgettable experience! The tour was both educational and engaging, providing a fascinating insight into the cultivation process, sustainability practices, and the various uses of cannabis.

A special thank you to our guide, Anna, who made the tour truly exceptional. Her deep knowledge, enthusiasm, and friendly approach created a welcoming atmosphere, making the experience even more enjoyable. She answered all our questions with great detail and passion, ensuring we left with a much better understanding of the industry.

If you're curious about cannabis cultivation or simply looking for a unique experience, I highly recommend this tour. Thank you again, Anna, for an amazing and informative day!
sample_reviews_en.author: Галинка to go

sample_reviews_en.text:
Yet another good dispensary shop that offers a clean product, accessories, edibles, and free education (Thai and English languages).
Interior space is heavily utilized for sectioning of different processes, and extends to the upper floors (3 floors), ending up on the roof that is beautifully set up.
Product quality is very good and the promotional deals are something to consider. No hot coffee is available yet, but there is limited choice of soft drinks.
Note that if you become a member, you will get extra discounts.
sample_reviews_en.author: Husain AlHusaini (Husain_Tula)

sample_reviews_en.text: We went here because we love weed and the whole grow process. This tour is everything that I could imagine and more. Holding pounds of cannabis and smelling!! Our guide Ana went above and beyond as soon as we walked in the door!! She provided a great experience with her knowledge and love for her job!! The whole process is explained and shown. Can't miss for true weed lovers!! A little far out from downtown but use grab app. and no problem!! Also get a 1/2 gram per person sample.
sample_reviews_en.author: Roy Linderman

sample_reviews_en.text: proper cannabis farm and dispensary to visit! for 1.500baht/pax they made a tour to planting rooms, showed drying room, provided protection costumes and gave us complementary weed as well as tea and other cute souvenirs that we can enjoy on the rooftop or bring home. highly recommend to come there if you like nature and labs core. book on the website official for bangkokcannabisfarm a few days in advance
sample_reviews_en.author: vèsna kaya

sample_reviews_en.text: Don’t usually leave reviews on google but if you love weed this place is a must visit. Probably one of the best tours I’ve done in Thailand, very professional and all the staff are very helpful, wisa knew the answer to every question and explained everything so well. I would highly recommend if you’re on the edge of yes or no. Plus you get a freebie at the end!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jake Valli (Riixual)

sample_reviews_en.text: Really good experience! Anna, the one who guided us in the farm tour, was very pleasant and accommodating. Learned a lot about the industry and how it works in Thailand. It was worth it and very educational. Had some free tasting strains and they were amazing. Would highly recommend to cannabis enthusiasts and interested newbies alike for knowledge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Darrell Cheng

sample_reviews_en.text: Had a wonderful experience at Canabangka Farm Tour! The place is beautiful and inspiring, but what really made it special was Anna. She took such great care of us and shared her knowledge with so much passion. You can really feel her love for the land and the community. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Can (mikecan)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Super kind and friendly people at the store. I just find this shop and walk in and I didn't expect anything special but one of thier stuff Anna gave me special experiences.
Super kind people with knowledge.
I suggest this shop is the one of best in bkk
sample_reviews_en.author: 포우poe

restaurants.name: Desi Tadka Indian Multi Cuisine Restaurant
restaurants.address:

59/28 Moo 10,Near V.C Hotel,Opposite Cherry Hotel,2nd Road Pattaya Pattaya, Pattaya City, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This has to be One of the best Indian restaurant in Pattaya. The menu offered a wide variety of dishes, catering to both vegetarians and non-vegetarians. Everything we ordered was cooked to perfection and served promptly.

The ambiance was warm and inviting, and the staff were attentive and friendly, making sure we were well taken care of throughout the meal.

I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a genuine Indian culinary experience. I can’t wait to come back and try more dishes!”
sample_reviews_en.author: Nilesh Salunkhe

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very Much Recommended for INDIAN FOOD.
We were craving indian food a lot and randomly bumped into this place and then visited here 2 days consecutively for dinner.
Very tasty food at good prices.
MUST VISIT!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yashodhan Jadhavrao

sample_reviews_en.text: Good Food with Good Service. Enjoyed the food. The background music was good. Plates 🍽 and presentation was also good. SanJay bhai took our order. Thank you SanJay bhai and team Desi Tadka
sample_reviews_en.author: Syed Saad

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent Indian restaurant in Pattaya!
The portions are huge!!! (We recommend sharing one dish between two people).
The service is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna Rockye

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food is delicious  all chicken dishes is very good
Cleaness and staff behaviour is good  and owner is so humble and very much friendly
sample_reviews_en.author: rakesh kumar

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing food and very cheap in price ! Must try the chilli chicken and with that cheese garlic naan! 🤍 loved it. Best for Indian.
sample_reviews_en.author: aniket gupta

sample_reviews_en.text: Clean, delicious, large portions. I'm not sure how to eat it properly, but I ate everything. I ordered the thali for 250 baht.
One of the best Indian cafes in Pattaya. The food is delicious, the portions are huge. The inside is very clean and cozy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Uygun Tipanov

restaurants.name: Sunrest
restaurants.address:

1 Sala Daeng Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I had lunch here a couple of times since the restaurant is opposite my office. Their lunch menu is very nice and reasonably priced-offering mix and match selection from rice bowls to meat and fish. Dinner menu is different and a bit more expensive. Good for chilling out after work.
sample_reviews_en.author: Roskamol Vongchowanart

sample_reviews_en.text:
A secret spot… a nice little restaurant with a pretty good wine list!
Simple, modern, and trendy decor.
Exceptional food! The grilled chicken with garlic rice… it's absolutely delicious! A must-try! Not far from Lumpini Park!
sample_reviews_en.author: Heike Heckert

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious, the prices were good, and the service was excellent. If you're looking for a chill vibe, this is the place to go. The spicy salad was delicious, and the grilled meat and spaghetti were great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimpagon

sample_reviews_en.text: I've wanted to try this restaurant for a while since it's located near Sala Daeng. It's a cute place with a nice atmosphere. The staff are very friendly and provide excellent service. The food is absolutely delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: กมลวรรณ พุ่มพวง

sample_reviews_en.text: A very nice restaurant in a quiet part of the city.  The wagyu was great and the Shrimp Yuzu with chili salt was amazing.  I would definitely eat here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chuck

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a nice atmosphere and plays great music. The staff are friendly and provide good service. Most of the food is fusion style.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gubgib

sample_reviews_en.text: We dropped in for drinks after dinner.  Cute modernist white decor.  Innovative cocktails.  Good house wine.  Loved the Beatles music. ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike M

sample_reviews_en.text: I like this restaurant. Food is amazing, and I get to meet many Thai people there. Get to see a real Thai life.
sample_reviews_en.author: Becky

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good place for any meal you want. The price is considerable affordable compared to any fast food restaurants.
The Paseo provides spacious area of parking lot.
For student, this place is good for reading. The AC power sockets are provided for ten seat for laptops and cellphone.

This place is cozy and casual for any engagement.

Promotion
Line pay and Rabbit card give you good discount.

Please be reminded that the building is not connected to the main Paseo's building.
Please bring an umbrella in case a sign of raining.

sample_reviews_en.text:
As a nightshift manager at a fast-food joint of other brands in my younger years, offering to make fresh batch of fries and chicken wings at late hours Drive-Thru ain't a common feats anywhere, anyhow, anymore.

Congratulation to the young man that took my order, for you had just got on my A's List!

You won't be disappointed for the quality of the foods you get here, and as for service aforementioned... here is your 5 stars review. Keep it up-!
sample_reviews_en.author: Synopsis Snake

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nicely decorated shop. It looks big outside but rather small with not that many tables on the 1st floor, I supposed they focus on the drive thru. The foods are so slow even we are eat-in, most of the reviews for drive thru are complaining about speed so they are true!

I would like to rate this shop a 3.5 star not 4 though. A .5 star extra for the lady, manager, who was very helpful in chasing for our orders then.
sample_reviews_en.author: apiwatbob

sample_reviews_en.text:
McDonald's is what it is. Always drive thru and always have to wait for it
Not that I complain, I stop there from time to time when I go home late and I'm too lazy to find anything else to eat cause they have someone walk to deliver freshly made fries to your car, just a little wait.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khun Som

sample_reviews_en.text: Celebrate Chinese New Year with McDonald's Lucky Gold! Get a chance to win a 1-baht gold bar and prizes worth over 1 million baht! It's super easy: just buy any participating McDonald's fried chicken set (THB 150 or more), add the official …
sample_reviews_en.author: PING thefoodlover

sample_reviews_en.text:
The chocolate sundae had much less chocolate than other branches.
I asked the staff, who said it was a machine-based pump, but I usually eat at many branches. This time, the amount was unusually small.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phassawan Jethjarurach

sample_reviews_en.text: Was okay as every Mcdonald I suppose. Happy with their unlimited beverage refill. The French fries could have been a little bit more crispy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Axel Hoebeke

sample_reviews_en.text: Last time I came here, I wait very long for my order. About 5-8 minutes. Didn't know my order was so hard to make, just a burger and fries.
sample_reviews_en.author: KOKO

restaurants.name: Via Vai "il Cortile"
restaurants.address:

665 On Nut 17 Alley, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Via Vai is a true gem for Italian cuisine lovers. Run by an experienced Italian chef who has been sharing authentic Italian flavors in Thailand for many years, this restaurant offers a genuine taste of Italy in every bite.

I had the pleasure of trying several dishes, including their grilled seafood, Neapolitan-style spaghetti, and freshly made pizzas. Every dish was prepared with care and passion, using high-quality ingredients that highlighted the natural flavors beautifully. The pizza, in particular, stood out with its perfectly crisp crust and rich, flavorful toppings.

The ambiance is relaxed yet refined, ideal for a casual meal or a special night out. Service was professional and friendly, and the staff made sure we were well taken care of throughout the meal.

There is parking available at the restaurant, which is a great convenience. If you're looking for an authentic Italian dining experience in Bangkok, Via Vai is definitely a place worth returning to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornkana Suthiphongkanasai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ive had the pleasure of dining at Via Vai after years I didn’t come back and it truly exceeded expectations.
We started with a delicious burrata and Parma ham pizza – the dough was perfectly baked, the burrata creamy and fresh, and the Parma ham just melted in the mouth.

For the main course, I went for the surf and turf: a beautifully grilled Wagyu strip loin paired with a giant prawn, served alongside aglio e olio spaghetti.
The dish was not only generous in portion but also showed incredible attention to detail and balance in flavors.

What truly stood out was the quality of the ingredients – authentic Italian products used with care and respect.
The wine selection is also worth mentioning. We had a bottle of Primitivo di Manduria Riserva – smooth, full-bodied, and a perfect match for the meal, at a very fair price.

The service was warm, attentive, and professional throughout the evening. A fantastic experience from start to finish – highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniele Scardicchio

sample_reviews_en.text:
Highly recommended for those looking for good Italian food in the On Nut area. The prices are very reasonable and it is worth coming from the Sukhumvit area.

I recommend the traditional and basic pasta dishes such as Bolognese and Carbonara. I think they are some of the best in Bangkok. The pizza is named after the restaurant, VIAVAI or buffalo milk cheese pizza, which is delicious.

Beef and pork steaks are also on the menu to try.

There are many other dishes on the menu, so I am sure you will find what you want to eat.

They also have a large selection of wines, so if you let them know what you like, they will have something you will like.

The atmosphere of the restaurant is very friendly and informal. The chef will even come to your table and talk to you. The waiters are very friendly and will help you with your order and any requests you may have.

All in all, this is a very good Italian restaurant and well worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Munetsugu Kaneko

sample_reviews_en.text: Via Vai "il Cortile Italian restaurant, located on On Nut Street, offers a delightful dining experience. One of its notable features is the ample parking available, making it convenient for patrons to visit. The restaurant prides itself on serving authentic Italian cuisine, ensuring that guests can savor the genuine flavors of Italy. Additionally, the friendly and attentive service enhances the overall dining experience, creating a welcoming atmosphere for visitors. Despite providing high-quality dishes and excellent service, Via Vai "il Cortile maintains reasonable pricing, making it an attractive option for those seeking a satisfying meal without breaking the bank. Whether you're a local or just passing through, this restaurant is definitely worth a visit for a taste of Italy right in the heart of On Nut Street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Theng Seng Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
LOVE this place!  Ricardo ..the Godfather of Italian Restaurants in Bangkok!

Ricardo has relocated to this very quaint little area, and the ambiance feels like a little Italian restaurant and of course it reminds me of the time that when I was in Italy, especially in the evenings, these little houses that are full of Italian charm and love!

Everything here was delicious because when he makes some thing he does an incredible job to make sure that you feel right at home and your food is delicious!

I would highly recommend to go here and try the dishes and I’ve tried. Also, he may have changed up his menu a bit because he’s very creative so try whatever he suggests because you will never go wrong with that suggestion.!

Highly recommended- make sure you read our food and travel blog at Follow fauzia ❤️❤️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Follow Fauzia

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the best Italian restaurant in the area. I think their truffle ravioli is the best. The wagyu beef is excellent, and you can choose your preferred doneness. They have a chef's specialty this month, including angel hair and mentaiko shrimp, which was the most delicious. At first, there was a huge portion, and I thought I wouldn't be able to finish it all, but after the first bite, I was amazed. In the end, I finished it all. The white wine mussel was a little salty. The menu changes seasonally, and they have a wide selection of wines with excellent taste. Definitely worth a visit. The staff communicate well in English, and the restaurant welcomes many foreigners.
sample_reviews_en.author: bo kapp

sample_reviews_en.text:
Open relatively late when other options close around 10pm. The service was good and the pizza was decent - given that you don't come to Thailand and expect great pizza. Super thin crust but needed to be cooked slightly longer for a crispy crunch (see pics).

I would have given it 4-stars based on service & food but the price is $$$$ for what it is. Ordered 2 Coke lite (60B ea) and Diavola (340B). They add tax + 10% service charge for a total of 541B. Not opposed to paying a premium for amazing food but it was more on the "not bad but not great". If it was amazing pizza, this would have been a different rating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thep Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came here on Valentine day,
The service is very bad, we did not receive any starter until 20 minutes pass, we have ask for it 3 TIMES, while the table that came after us already got it.
The food is good but it came 15 min after each dish. The main was okay but the side mashed potatoes is COLD.

After complaining to the head of service the only thing we received are excuses, not even one sorry.
Super disappointed compared to the price we pay we expect HIGHER STANDARDS.

I personally came here quite a few times but this ganna be my last time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karnkawin Jatubhonpipat

restaurants.name: 1823 Tea Lounge by Ronnefeldt
restaurants.address:

999 Phloen Chit Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a lovely afternoon tea at 1823 Tea Lounge by Ronnefeldt. The ambiance is elegant yet cozy, perfect for a relaxing break in the city. The tea selection is impressive, with beautifully brewed premium blends, and the afternoon tea set was both visually stunning and delicious. The scones were warm and fluffy, and the pastries were well-balanced—not overly sweet. Service was attentive and refined, making the whole experience feel special. Definitely one of the best spots in Bangkok for afternoon tea.
sample_reviews_en.author: Methinee M

sample_reviews_en.text: Great value for money. The food is flavorful yet light, and the staff provide excellent service. The atmosphere is lovely and perfect for experiencing the everyday lifestyle of Bangkok locals. You can even see the Erawan Shrine nearby, which is a nice touch for those interested in spiritual or cultural spots. The music is not too loud, making it a comfortable place to sit and relax for hours. Whether you’re looking for a full meal or just something light, this place works perfectly for both.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamonchanok Wattanataree

sample_reviews_en.text: Past by few times and notice the enviroment is quite good, so i drop by to have brunch today. I got their set lunch, the food and ice cream is nice. Iced tea come with the set lunch is just normal. I added a pistachio scone and iced tea (gaysorn blend) afterwards. Scone is nice but i think pistachio didn't mix well with scone in my tongue 😂 I should got for the classic or cranberry instead. Staff are attentive and services are good. I spent more than 4hours there and it is quite relaxing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bih Jen Yap

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely loved my experience here! The food was fresh, delicious, and beautifully presented. Every dish we ordered was full of flavor, and the afternoon tea set was just as impressive. The ambience is elegant and relaxing, with a lovely view that makes the whole experience even better.

The staff were friendly, attentive, and made us feel very welcome. If you’re in Bangkok or planning a trip, I highly recommend stopping by. It’s definitely a place I’d visit again! 🤍🍽️✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Shaima Xxm

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried 3 dessert and coffee, it came to 1000 bth, very normal price, but the Opera cake was below average , cheesecake was mid, blueberry mousse cake was the best item by default, service was good. If i was rating only based on dessert its a 1.5 stars. The service made it 2.5. I am being nice give it 3. Plenty of better options meters away. The ambience is nice if you don't mind bunk desserts. To me its a pass.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ali Ameri

sample_reviews_en.text: Customer service was beyond what Ive experienced. Details of my food sensitivities were remembered accurately and changes were made in my tea set to accomodate them. Friendly warm and generous with smiles and greetings. Food was good but the ambience elevated the dining experience. My window seat was perfect - calm abd relaxing. Perfect for a quiet lunch and tea. Will definitely come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Serene Neo

sample_reviews_en.text: We visited 1823 Tea House for afternoon tea and had a wonderful experience. The selection of teas was impressive, and the pastries were both beautiful and flavorful. The service was warm and professional. We’ll definitely return on our next visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: SASIMA KITRUKSA

sample_reviews_en.text: We had an amazing afternoon tea experience at the authentic 1824 tea lounge. The variety of tea flavors was incredible. We tried the original, chocolate, and pistachio scones. The service was excellent, and the location was convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohamed Hamad

restaurants.name: ARGO GEORGIAN GREEK BAR & GRILL
restaurants.address:

4/26 Soi Sukhumvit 8, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Tried their handheld Qutab Spinach/Cheese, Chicken and Lamb Gyros and the Chicken Shwarma. The Qutab Spinach/Cheese was pretty good with plenty of melty cheese and spinach made just right with a good balance of both cheese and spinach flavors in each bite. The Tzatziki in the gyros was excellent but the meat was a little bland . The fries infused within the gyros didn't help the cause either. Maybe having the fries as a side rather than in the gyros would be better, thus the gyro was a little less pleasing. The Chicken Shwarma was excellent and generously portioned compared to the other handhelds. The Chicken was marinated to perfection and the fresh vegetables and sauce were just right to make the Shwarma juicy, flavorful and Yummy Delicious. 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Sujanani

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’m from Georgia, and the price for khinkhali is a joke. It’s 4 times more expensive than anywhere in Georgia, no matter how fancy the restaurant is. In Georgia, it costs around 2 GEL, while in Thailand it’s around 8.5 GEL.

Okay, forget about khinkhali — a standard 325ml can of Coca-Cola for 90 THB is just cringe. Outside, it costs 16 THB at 7-Eleven, and in restaurants it’s 5 times more expensive. Four cans of cola for two people = 360 THB, while outside it would cost only 64 THB.

Just because it has ice and you’re sitting there? A 5x price increase is so greedy when you’re a food restaurant and not a nightclub or bar where the main income comes from drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Georgia Win

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Eastern European food was absolutely delicious, and the service from the staff was outstanding. I was especially impressed by the male staff member and the female staff member with dyed hair. Their hospitality was exceptional.

Because it was raining, they were concerned about us and kindly walked us to our taxi while holding an umbrella for us. It was a very thoughtful gesture that we truly appreciated.

The cherry dumplings were even more delicious than the ones I had in Poland. I was extremely happy with both the food and the service. Thank you very much! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Choii

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was really tasty!
I will put 5 stars the moment you kindly change the description of borsch, which is a traditional Ukrainian dish. In your menu, you brand Georgian food as “Georgian”, not “South Caucasus food” or “Caucasian”. Plov is directly branded as Uzbek, not “Central Asian” or “Turkic”. It would be fair if you applied the same logic to the Ukrainian dish, recognised by UNESCO as Ukrainian, rather than “Slavic”, as it says now in the menu.
With all due respect to Georgia, its cuisine and people 💛
sample_reviews_en.author: Bohdan Ivashchenko

sample_reviews_en.text: It was very tasty! The food is so delicious that I felt like I was at home in Ukraine. When we were about to go home, it started to rain heavily and the employee of the establishment helped us call a taxi and took us under an umbrella, it was very nice and unexpected. Thank you again for the warmth, comfort and delicious dinner🥹❤️‍🩹
sample_reviews_en.author: Анастасия Шелихова

sample_reviews_en.text:
Let's share our impressions!
We're thrilled with the delicious Khinkali and Khachapuri...we'd eaten them in Phuket before (and weren't satisfied), but we're thrilled with this one! The staff is fast and friendly, and a special thank you to the Chef for his hard work and passion for the dishes! See you again, Argo💸
sample_reviews_en.author: Aleks

sample_reviews_en.text: We live in Phuket and there's nothing like this there, although there are plenty of Georgian options. We ordered khinkali, khachapuri, shashlik, and salad. Everything was delicious and the service was excellent. We'll recommend it to everyone and will definitely be back ourselves. Thanks to your team.
sample_reviews_en.author: Константин Клюков

sample_reviews_en.text:
They removed satsivi from the menu and added pilaf—very Georgian.
Overall, it's a good place, I can recommend it, but the dough isn't quite right.
The lamb leaves a lot to be desired, but compared to Thai food, it's certainly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Андрей МО

restaurants.name: Tarka House Indian Restaurant
restaurants.address:

325 Pattaya 13/4 Alley, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chang Wat Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best Indian food experiences in Pattaya. 🇮🇳🔥
Amazing flavors, fresh ingredients, large portions, and very friendly staff. Every dish was full of authentic taste and perfectly prepared.

The atmosphere is relaxed and comfortable, and the location near Classroom Hotel makes it super convenient after a long day in the city.

Highly recommended if you are visiting Pattaya and looking for really good Indian food. Definitely coming back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dariusz Szafarewicz

sample_reviews_en.text: I was recommended to Tarka house when I was asking for a good Indian restaurant while on the baht bus. I'm glad to of been told as I frequent the restaurant when I'm in Pattaya  4-5 times now and look forward to meeting the pleasant owner and staff and the food is delicious and plenty of it, I try different foods from the menu and all have been very, very good culminating in a pleasant experience. I look forward to my next visit soon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stephen Green

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pop is the owner and an amiable and helpful host. We ordered some appetizers and several entrees for my party of three.
Everything was carefully prepared and the spice level (we requested spicy) was spot on. Service is attentive, but not overbearing.
I can't recommend any one dish since I believe anything on the menu will be delicious.
Great food, good prices, good service...what more can you ask for?
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert Alongi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Takra House is a small, cozy, and homey spot that serves incredible Indian food. Everything we ordered was fresh, beautifully presented, and truly a "flavor celebration." They have a great variety of both vegetarian and meat options.
We had the Palak Paneer, Mix Veg, and Aloo Gobi with different types of Naan, and it was absolutely perfect. Highly recommended! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
sample_reviews_en.author: Tzvi Arden

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered a chicken butter curry but what I received was a chicken tikka masala. I think they made a mistake with my order

I called the shop to explain and the man apologised and was going to send another order out to me but I was hungry so I ate my chicken tikka masala which was very tasty
They offered me a 35% discount on my next order which was nice of them
sample_reviews_en.author: Leo Deevy

sample_reviews_en.text: Had 3 dinners here this stay in Thailand because it is a very good restaurant.  The two first times was excellent but the third time half of the lamb I got served was chewy, somewhat dry. I swallowed it instead of spitting it out because I was hungry. Was going to give a 5 but because of this I give 4.
sample_reviews_en.author: Erlend Ellingsen

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was ok but nothing that will make me rush back the next day
The food is Very very basic the one thing is I don't understand is do they know what a buriani actually looks like or taste like i don't think so the place is clean. The service was good, but I just didn't get the wow factor
sample_reviews_en.author: Yiannakis Yiacoumi

sample_reviews_en.text: Ate here for dinner on 6th November 2025.  The food was delicious - paneer makhani, fish biryani, garlic naan, one beer, one water and bhindi bhaji.  Total came to just under 800 Thai bart.  The service was good and the staff all very friendly.  Would thoroughly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kart Somasundaram

restaurants.name: Yiam Tai Authentic Southern Thai Restaurant
restaurants.address:

74/43 Pak Kret District, Nonthaburi 11120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd noticed this place when driving past recently and as lovers of Southern Thai recipes we decided to give it a try. You can park around behind the building and there is ample parking available. When entering, restaurant is nice and spacious with plenty of seating options. We chose a spot next the window. We ordered three dishes and a couple of soda drinks. Food arrived fairly promptly. Food was as expected, good flavors and tasted great. Add to that it was nice and spicy as expected. Our only disappointment was that the dishes were expensive and the serving portions were quite small given the price. We made a comparison with another southern Thai restaurant that we visit regularly close by. Normally we'd be happy to give 5 stars but we just felt that the prices didn't reflect the serving portions. Overall a nice place etc 4/5 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrew L.

sample_reviews_en.text: I've wanted to try this place for a long time, and it exceeded my expectations. The food is flavorful and spicy in every dish. The sour curry was amazing; I even wanted to take some of the broth home to add more seasonings! The seafood was fresh, and they offer free shrimp paste dip and fresh vegetables. The restaurant also sells souvenirs like shrimp paste and curry paste. If you like spicy Southern Thai food, I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ann Xanthippe

sample_reviews_en.text:
The flavors are intense and rich, especially the sour curry. The curry paste is pounded until you can still see the chilies – incredibly spicy, enough to make your eyes and nose water! A real treat for Southern Thai palates!!!
The food is served very quickly. There's plenty of parking, it's convenient and comfortable. The staff provides good service, and there's live music too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hameii

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! The sour curry was a little too spicy for our taste, but still tasty. The stir-fried squid with eggs was sweet and had plenty of eggs in every piece. I liked the stir-fried pork with shrimp paste and the stir-fried …
sample_reviews_en.author: Meaw Vatinee

sample_reviews_en.text: The stir-fried squid with basil was not too sweet and fresh. The braised pork knuckle with chayote leaves had a bit too strong a pork smell. Overall, the dishes I ordered weren't very impressive. I'll try some spicier dishes next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wittaya M

sample_reviews_en.text: All the food was delicious, with plenty of ingredients and a strong flavor. They gave us lots of vegetables. It was so delicious that I didn't take any pictures. I only took a picture of one dish: a large set of crab curry noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: paanpanisara Chu

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! You MUST order the sour curry; it's authentic Southern Thai sour curry. It was so good I ordered some to take home. The staff provided great service and the restaurant was clean. P.S. I didn't take any pictures.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jip J.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, typical of Southern Thai cuisine, with rich flavors.
The rice noodles came with all the toppings, but there wasn't enough variety of vegetables for Southern Thai food. …
sample_reviews_en.author: manilla phin

restaurants.name: Suananda
restaurants.address:

109 Pan Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
💚A hidden gem of an Indian vegetarian restaurant in the Silom area, not far from the Hindu temple. Perfect for a quick and healthy break during the busy city workday. The atmosphere is tranquil and peaceful, ideal for a break. They offer a wide variety of easy-to-eat Indian vegetarian dishes. The staff recommended their lunch set menu. Daily Menu, Complete Nutrition, Yummy!

💚SUANANDA AYURVEDA SET 255฿: deal of the day, 🥗Vegetable sabzi, 🥛 buttermilk, 🍚 rice & 🫓 roti

💚 SUANANDA
📍Pan Rd., Silom, not far from Wat Khaek (Hindu Temple)
🗺️ (13.7229568, 100.5239445)
💸 Cash, QR code payment
🚙🚐🏍️🚴🏻‍♀️ Parking available at the restaurant
🚊BTS Saint Louis, then walk approximately 600 meters

#kindaimod #กินได้หมด #SUANANDA #silom #healthyfood
sample_reviews_th.author: KINDAIMOD

sample_reviews_en.text: As I continue to search out new vegetarian spots in Bangkok, Suananda is on a small side street, and then down an alley covered in trees and plants. A large happy mural greets you at the entrance and the restaurant is a lovely garden area at the back. A family run bushes the menu is vegetarian and vegan and the set meals give you options of Thai or Indian inspired fusion sets. I tried a Thai spicy vegetable green curry set which also came with red chili tofu and fresh salad, rice and Paratha bread. The green curry was quite nice filled with vegetables and a moderately spicy level that left a pleasant flavor but didn't cause me to break into a sweat.  Service is quick and friendly but not rushed allowing you to enjoy your meal in the garden. A nice selection of hot and cold drinks and healthy teas add to the meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: John a

sample_reviews_en.text:
#Bangkok #Thailand #Suananda vegetarian garden Café

Cozy and quiet dining area with indoor and outdoor seating. The hosts were kind and welcoming. We mentioned that we are vegans and we received a vegan menu.
There’s also available a qrcode to scan to see the full menu. There were probably a few main menu items that could be made vegan, but we ordered from the vegan menu.

The food was amazing. I ordered the falafel for life set and my wife had the Punjabi Desi Dhaba set. We also got 2 immunity booster shots consisting of tumeric, lemon, honey and something else.

Details about meals
falafel for life
falafel & hummus, house pita bread, salad & soup

punjabi desi dhaba tofu & peas curry, mint paranthas, kachumber salad & raita
sample_reviews_en.author: jeff starke (iseektoknow)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The yoga class is located in a small house separated from Suananda Restaurant, offering a relaxing, serene, hidden green space in the city center, which makes the location very convenient. There is on-site parking, and the overall atmosphere feels calm and welcoming. I felt such positive energy from both the place and the teacher.

The class is suitable for beginners as well as those who already do light exercise regularly. I usually do running and Pilates, but this yoga class helps balance both mind and body in a different way. It brings me back to myself and reminds me to slow down and smile. After every class, I leave feeling peaceful, healthy, and happy.

They also offer discounted packages for multiple classes.
sample_reviews_en.author: P T

sample_reviews_en.text:
A quaint hidden gem in the hustle and bustle of Pan Road. The place feels homey - like visiting a relative you wish you have. The garden maybe small but lush enough. I had their dal lunch set and it came as a complete, all rounded meal with salad, cooked veggies, rice, flatbread, yoghurt drink and a sweet bite. Their food is exemplary that healthy food does not need to be bland - it can be flavourful, alive and full of depth.

At the time of my visit, there is a construction nearby. I treat it as a soundtrack of this season and feel fine with it. However if you are more noise sensitive, please check with the restaurant before you come :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Poonpha

sample_reviews_en.text: Thank you GOD for bringing me to join yoga at Suananda. I am proudly to say I am one of student yoga of Master Shiv. I have known him for a year and now taking my 2nd course. He is an optimistic instructor and has positive attitude in delivering good energy to his practitioners every class. He always shares how to be better in Asana. I love his smile and passion in teaching yoga. His Mantra is amazing. I can touch he teaches yoga with heart and soul. I would say Yoga for Life - Yoga for Healthy Lifestyle.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nida Petch

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best vegetarian vegan restaurant in Bangkok. Everything we ordered was outstanding, diverse, and creative.

The service is warm and welcoming. We were taken care of by the amazing Raj, who accompanied us throughout the entire meal and recommended dishes that matched our taste perfectly. The entire team is attentive, smiling, patient, and genuinely caring.

The restaurant is located in a quiet and pleasant area. The place is clean and spotless and is located in a charming garden.

Super recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lili Blum

sample_reviews_en.text: fell extremely in love with garden & the overall vibes it offered 🪴🌿🌱 didn’t actually feel like leaving the restaurant, very cosy & homely setting. Food was as great as the environment, no doubt! Staff can speak English and was very friendly. Truly a hidden gem in the middle of the city. If you’re looking for great vegan food while wanting to escape the city vibes temporarily then this is your place to visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukhmani Singh

restaurants.name: Pathé
restaurants.address:

1130/5 Vibhavadi Rangsit Rd, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A chill place to hang out with friends after work.
The food is delicious, they offer free peanut salad, and there's a beer promotion: buy 3 bottles and get a free plate of spicy minced meat salad. They have Singha beer, but no Chang. I didn't like that the staff kept refilling my beer too frequently, even when it was only slightly low, like they were rushing to make sales. There's no parking.
The restaurant is on a main road, accessible by MRT Phahonyothin station, exit 2, and a short walk away.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amii Wong

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is cramped, the food is mediocre, and there aren't enough servers to attend to the customers. The restroom was initially clean but overflowing with trash due to neglect. We initially reserved a large table, but our group was smaller than the reserved number, so they asked for our table back, which was fine. However, they later requested more chairs, forcing everyone at our table to sit very close together. Overall, we were quite unimpressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Caviar Augthayanike

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was absolutely awful. The salmon salad was so bad, it was like there was only a tiny bit of salmon, and it wasn't fresh at all. The Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) was terrible, the worst I've ever tasted.
This is ruining the restaurant's reputation. I even presented the issue to management. It's simple food, but it's like some random person cooked it. The restaurant isn't low-class, but the food is just awful.
If they don't improve...
sample_reviews_en.author: Ja Ja

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for a chill place to hang out, I highly recommend this place.
The atmosphere is perfect for having deep conversations with friends.
The service is excellent; I especially liked that they kept changing our beer glasses.
The Japanese beef salad was delicious, served with peanuts, and the best part was that they brought hot tea before we left. It was a wonderful experience! I'll definitely be back again. 🫶🏻✨
sample_reviews_en.author: patcharapa kummarat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every dish is delicious. Order anything without hesitation.
Larb, Yum, Ha Dong, Isaan Sausage, Japanese Beef Salad, and Shrimp in Fish Sauce are dishes I always order.

You can ask for unlimited refills of peanuts, which I really love.
As for the beer, every bottle is served chilled, and the glass is replaced immediately when it melts.

The prices are reasonable, making it a great place to relax and eat after work often.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wongnaret Khantuwan

sample_reviews_en.text: A really nice place with a unique and beautiful interior. The vibe is perfect for drinks and hanging out with friends. They have both Thai and Western food, with good prices and solid flavors. They often have beer promos too, and the chilled beer glasses are definitely a nice touch for anyone who enjoys a proper drink. The fried peanuts go really well with the beer too. Overall, really enjoyed the atmosphere here.
sample_reviews_en.author: John de j3k

sample_reviews_en.text: We went for a Monday evening party. People kept arriving, and there were times when all the tables were full. Initially, they played classical Western music, and later switched to Thai songs from the '90s. The food was delicious, especially the spicy salads. The staff were attentive and constantly changed our beer glasses. The smoothies were also tasty. I recommend making a reservation beforehand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phureephorn Suewattana

sample_reviews_en.text: Since you're charging a service fee, could you please improve the restrooms? The food was decent, but the staff kept refilling our beer even before we finished our meal. It felt like they were rushing us to get more beer, and we lacked privacy. Every time we tried to have a conversation, they'd refill our beer again. It was annoying.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lady Op

restaurants.name: Quack Quack/แควกแควก ข้าวมันเป็ด สาขา หน้าม.หอการค้า
restaurants.address:

126 ซ. วิภาวดีรังสิต2 แยก1 Ratchadaphisek, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🦆 Review of “Quack Quack Duck Rice”

This restaurant has a similar feel to typical Hainanese chicken rice, but this time it’s about putting real effort into their “duck” dish.
It’s not a big restaurant, but it’s always busy because the quality and taste “beyond its appearance.”

⸻

🍚 What I tried:
• Duck Rice (Regular)
• Soup
• Gravy

⸻

👅 Straightforward Taste

Duck – The meat is tender, not gamey, dry, or smelly. It feels like a restaurant that marinates well, with a distinct flavor.
Rice – Not greasy, fluffy, and fragrant (not the dry, flat kind).
Gravy – Fragrant with soy sauce, well-balanced, not the dry, salty type.
Dipping Sauce – Has a good amount of sourness to cut through the richness, but it’s not the star of the show.
Soup – Not just plain water + powder; it’s well-seasoned and has real “flavor.”
(Many restaurants fail at this point.) (But this isn't a disaster)

⸻

Things I liked:

✅ The duck wasn't gamey; I could eat it alone without having to avoid the skin.
✅ The portion size was appropriate, and the price wasn't too high.
✅ The rice was well-cooked, not so oily that it caused stomach pain.
✅ The soup helped balance the flavors; simple but not bland.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Smith

sample_reviews_en.text: The duck rice was seriously delicious. The rice was perfectly cooked, fragrant and soft; it was delicious even on its own. The duck meat was excellent, with no gamey smell, tender, and thick-cut. The dipping sauce was fantastic. The duck soup with pickled lime was amazing; the duck meat melted in your mouth, and the soup was clear, fragrant with pickled lime, and slightly sour – very refreshing. The desserts, coconut pudding and Thai tea pudding, were so delicious I couldn't choose just one – I had to eat two! I loved it 😉
sample_reviews_en.author: ไปนู่นไปนี่ฉันจะตีก้นเธอ Facebook page

sample_reviews_en.text: Experience a new way to eat duck biryani for the first time. The duck had no gamey smell, just as the owner recommended. The duck was tender, the skin was crispy, and the orange dipping sauce was spicy and the brown sauce was deliciously balanced. Everything tasted amazing together. I highly recommend everyone try the duck dishes here; they were incredible! 10/10. The owner's dog, Moo Wan, was adorable. The service was great, there was relaxing music, and the air conditioning was perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kritsana Pinsuwan

sample_reviews_en.text: A unique and previously unseen menu item: duck rice, cooked in a traditional pressure pot without using electricity or gas. The restaurant is clean and delicious, serving duck without any gamey smell and with tender meat. The cost per person is an affordable 100 baht for a satisfying meal. The restaurant boasts a pleasant atmosphere, is air-conditioned, and the staff provide excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: sososo saazz

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and perfectly portioned. The restaurant has a great atmosphere; the air conditioning is cool, and the music is soft, just like being in a cafe. There's also a cute, friendly dog ​​to play with. The owner is very kind, lovely, and friendly. The service is excellent, and the cleanliness is top-notch!
sample_reviews_en.author: nuey niracha

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! I've walked past this place many times and finally decided to try it, and it exceeded my expectations. The atmosphere is peaceful, the air conditioning is nice and cool, and the restaurant isn't small, making it easy to move around. There are plenty of tables for customers. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: aom am

sample_reviews_en.text: I was very impressed! I really liked the owner. There were probably fewer customers during school holidays, but the food was delicious. Unlimited refills of soup! The taste was great and the portions were generous. The owner was very polite and friendly, and the dog was adorable too! 5555+
sample_reviews_en.author: Chokaew Hemchayat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The duck noodles were delicious; the duck meat was tender and not chewy, and had no unpleasant smell. The pickled lemon soup was refreshing, the liver was soft, and the duck spring rolls were unique. The food was tasty and flavorful.
The staff were very welcoming.
sample_reviews_en.author: destiny ANN

restaurants.name: Heng Heng Korat BBQ Buffet
restaurants.address:

442/10 ถนน จันทร์ Thung Wat Don, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I usually order takeout, but this time I ate at the restaurant and loved it because the heat was amazing. The staff were incredibly attentive to the heat; they wouldn't let us eat if it wasn't strong enough.
The crispy fried shrimp dumplings were delicious, freshly made with big, whole shrimp.
The pork portion was also generous. We ordered the large set and it was enough for three people.
We parked a bit far away (40฿ per hour) and were worried about getting our wheels locked if we parked on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_th.author: Punnapatcharee Chotthanakuljira

sample_reviews_en.text:
Although it's called Korla hotpot, it didn't feel unfamiliar at all. The grill in the center is surrounded by hotpot platters, somewhat like a Korean copper plate hotpot, but the flavor is very "Korla".

Despite the language barrier, the staff were incredibly enthusiastic, gesturing and showing me different parts of the pig. Even with my limited Thai, we still managed to order everything.

The ingredients were undeniably fresh. The meat was not only marinated beforehand, but also mixed with a raw egg yolk to enhance its tenderness. Dipping it in the restaurant's homemade Thai sweet and sour sauce after grilling was incredibly appetizing.

This flavor is unlike anything you can find in bottled sweet and sour sauce; it's like Taiwanese garlic soy sauce. Every restaurant has a different flavor, and you won't find it in supermarkets.

Overall, it's a cheap, simple, and delicious hotpot restaurant. I'll definitely go back specifically for it next time ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Kian Kuo

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm from Korat (Nakhon Ratchasima), but I lived in America for almost 30 years. I came back to visit home with my children, but this time I didn't go back to Korat; I stayed in Bangkok, near Asiatique. I was very lucky to find Heng Heng Korat Barbecue Buffet. My children and husband were so happy and loved it. The taste was just like in Korat, and even better than many other Korat restaurants I've eaten at in the past.

The server, Tai, provided excellent service. I saw her working non-stop; I felt sorry for her because she looked so tired. She was always smiling and very lovely. My three daughters loved the food today even more than they would at fancy restaurants. Thank you to the owner for preserving the authentic taste of Korat Thai food. The flavors are just like they were 30 years ago when I lived in Thailand.

If I ever return to Thailand, I will definitely come back to eat here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sudarat K.

sample_reviews_en.text: This place offers a local atmosphere. The shrimp dumplings are delicious, so I recommend trying them (prepayment is required for the dumplings). They do not sell alcohol, but bringing your own is allowed. There is a convenience store nearby, so I recommend buying some in advance. You can order ice at the shop. Since there is no air conditioning and they light a fire outside, I highly recommend visiting after sunset. When I went at night, it wasn't as hot as I expected thanks to the fans. It had been a while since my last visit, and it seemed like the shop had expanded or that there were more seats available.
sample_reviews_en.author: ᄒᄒ

sample_reviews_en.text: Extremely expensive! The portions are very small. They give you the least amount of vegetables I've ever had at a Thai BBQ place. The pork is served in a marinade bowl; it looks like a lot, but there's very little. For 299 baht, 199 baht would be more reasonable for this quantity. The dipping sauce is extremely spicy; it's pre-seasoned with no separate chili or garlic. In short, I was full from the water. Everything is overpriced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Parn Mookkamas

sample_reviews_en.text: Heng Heng Korat BBQ is an a la carte Thai BBQ restaurant. They offer small, medium, and large sizes, priced around 300-500 baht. The open-plan environment has fans, but it's still hot. The pork is served in a bowl. A unique feature is the marinade in the bowl, which can be added to the soup, but I found it too salty. The ambiance is average, and the meat is okay, but the price is cheap.
sample_reviews_en.author: 小威（LP）

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wow... what's going on here?!?!
I think it's a recommendation from Taesarang, but there aren't any Koreans here.
Lots of locals. Hahaha
The soup is salty and spicy, and the noodles are refillable. Hahahaha
There's a bit of a wait involved, so I definitely recommend a table for two.

The opening time is listed as 3:30 PM, but it could be 4 PM. They prepared early because I waited.
sample_reviews_en.author: 빡재

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my all-time favorite Mookata (Thai BBQ) restaurant.
The marinated pork is incredibly delicious; drizzling it into the soup is amazing.
The vegetables are also perfectly cooked, tender and tasty.
The fried shrimp is delicious too.
The dipping sauce is the best I've ever had in any Mookata.
And the service is also excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phankon Sadi

restaurants.name: Tony's
restaurants.address:

424 ซอย ริม ถ. คนเดินคลองโอ่งอ่าง Wang Burapha Phirom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Outdoor corner fresh air (such as hot season on the canal is 'sort of' at best), but the food was underwhelming. Not bad, just not good. How so?

Rajma dal..

1. Dry kidney beans. Undercooked or old?

2. Cooked very quickly as if they took previously cooked beans and added a curry sauce - not steeped in spiced oil for even 15 minutes.

3. I didn't order any of the breads because based on the photos they don't use 'atta' flour (stoneground wholewheat)

But it is cheap (THB50), so what did I expect?

Will I come return? Maybe, but to try something else. An escape from Khao Sarn Road prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hermes

sample_reviews_en.text: Foods really nice and the street it's on it beautiful. The only thing of note is that there is no ac seating so if you overheat quickly this might not be the restaurant for you. There was a pretty long que for this restaurant probably about 8 groups of people in line at all time, although there was an event going on so this could have affected the wait time. The naan is cooked fresh and is nice. Butter chicken was nice but miledly spiced, it's less sweet when compared to the British ones I've had before. The aloo chat was nice and a bit more heavily spiced .
sample_reviews_en.author: Natalie O

sample_reviews_en.text: It was terrible, a huge disappointment. I'd wanted to try it for a long time. The chicken masala was tough chicken breast, and the sauce tasted like any other supermarket sauce you could make at home. The grilled fish curry was just small pieces of fish full of bones. The aloo paneer was very bland, and the naan was hard and not tasty at all. My favorite thing was the papad. The beer wasn't cold enough, and when I asked for ice, it was full of black bits floating in it. Other tables had tons of leftover food.
sample_reviews_en.author: phrae p

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've had Tony's on my list of places to get food from for some time. The curries (chana masala, mixed vegetables, daal fry) were much better than some of the ones that I've gotten elsewhere and at a much better prices. The only thing I didn't like from my order was the aloo paratha which wasn't as tasty as I had expected. Folks were super friendly; it's a shame that dining services are not allowed due to COVID. I definitely will come back here again!

(momos in pic are from Mama’s next door)
sample_reviews_en.author: Angela Arunarsirakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Highly remembered this Indian restaurant. i have visited several times trying different dishes. So far so good. Love all dishes.

If you fancy especially Vegetarian Indian food, then the place do a good variety you can select from, and they all VERY GOOD. They are tasty and cheap.

The place feels local, slightly hidden away from the main road but easy to spot. Chefs and staff are friendly. So far, this is my favorite Indian food in Bangkok. It’s not the finest one, but it’s just the best.
sample_reviews_en.author: Withit Kiatthanavanik

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is easy to eat, perfect for those new to Indian cuisine. The flavors aren't too strong or spicy. The prices are reasonable, and you can order several dishes as the portions aren't too large. To order, simply scan the menu at your table and press the order button. The food arrives quickly at your table. Bringing food or drinks from other restaurants is not allowed. The staff provides good service, and there's a handwashing station available. Very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bee love cats

sample_reviews_en.text:
Let me tell you, Value for money, Good Food, right by the canal! It was frickin perfect!! We were in Bangkok for 4 nights & we ate here twice!! It’s so good, I highly recommend Tony’s, I would eat here everyday tbh!!

The staff are the absolute best they make you feel so welcomed, the food is cooked fresh you can see them rolling and cooking the breads, the vibe is on point it’s right next to the canal they really look after you :)

We will be back x
sample_reviews_en.author: Kate

sample_reviews_en.text: Really lovely spot for a family style Indian, rich on the canal under fairy lights at night; Staff were lovely too! Food was great for the price! The Saag paneer and Dahl makhani were my personal faves! Definitely could add a little garnish here and there but overall lovely and you scan the menu to order and it’s all rapid even out of the teeniest kitchen! Also the famous neighborhood cat came and said hi to my friend (so cute)
sample_reviews_en.author: Faye Ocj

restaurants.name: FATT CHICKEN RICE
restaurants.address:

B1 FLOOR, One Bangkok, Rama IV Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have seen a rise in Lion City's chicken rise in Bangkok recently. Having heard of Fatt for a while and finally had a chance to try. Its a relatively small restaurant situated in ONE Bangkok in B1 level.

I wasn't disappointed.

Ordered:
Chicken rice set
Bak kut tea
Turnip cake with XO sauce

Chicken was plump, tender, juicy and very flavorful. Cooked to perfection to the way i like it. The rice was delicious, but definitely not the best I have tasted so far. The chili was a little bit of a let down in my personal opinion. I like my chili to be a little spicier but theirs tend to lean on the sweeter side.

Bak kut tea was a little too sweet. But it was full of ingredients. Price was very reasonable for the size.

Turnip cake with XO sauce was a delight. I was worried the XO sauce would be overpowering, but they cooked it to perfection with the right balance.

The service staffs were great!

Overall really love this restaurant and will definitely be back again with friends!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Low

sample_reviews_en.text:
Finally found the best Hainanese chicken rice in Bangkok — and it’s hidden in plain sight at One Bangkok.
Fatt Chicken Rice is a humble, cozy eatery with just a handful of seats, but what it lacks in size, it more than makes up for in flavor and soul. Despite the staff not speaking much English, the warmth of their service makes everything easy and welcoming.

The star of the show? Exceptionally tender, organic chicken with perfectly seasoned rice and a clear, aromatic broth that outshines many fine dining soups. The flavors are clean, authentic, and crafted with care—no shortcuts, no gimmicks.

Fatt is more than just another chicken rice shop—it’s a quiet statement of how simplicity, when done right, becomes unforgettable. Just a few blocks from home, and already a new go-to.
sample_reviews_en.author: GastroTravel

sample_reviews_en.text:
Specialized in Singaporean Hainanese Chicken Rice but also serving other dishes like Soy Chicken with Egg Noodle, Bak Kut Teh (a herbal pork rib soup), Braised Pork Belly, and more.

Hainanese Poached Chicken (M) is served with soup and several dipping sauces, including fragrant sesame oil and minced ginger. Meat is remarkably tender and flavorful, complemented by aromatic rice and traditional condiments. While the accompanying soup is subtle in flavor, the variety of accompanying sauces provides ample opportunity for customization. Nice clean environment with attentive staff and good service.

Fatt Chicken states they serve chickens raised in low density, without rapid growth, cared for well, and chickens are 100% antibiotic-free.
sample_reviews_en.author: Farangondiet

sample_reviews_en.text:
My second visit to this eatery. The dishes we had was consistent to our last visit. Delicious and pleasing to our plate. Good job!

As a Singaporean, I am really proud of the standards set by this eatery. Right from the rice, to the chicken, and even down to the humble looking winter melon soup that comes along with the chicken rice set were well balanced and wonderfully tasty. The Brinjal as well as the mala wanton dishes were great too. If I ever come to One Bangkok in the future, it is to eat at this restaurant again
sample_reviews_en.author: GL

sample_reviews_en.text: Located on B1 floor of One Bangkok, this restaurant is Chef Enoch's. It's not very big, but it's popular with office workers on weekdays. Prices are mid-range, and the food arrives quickly. The taste is good; the chicken is tender, and the dipping sauce is unique – unlike typical Thai sauces, it includes a salty dark soy sauce. The mala dumplings aren't too spicy, just the right flavor. The staff are friendly. If you're coming with a large group, it's recommended to make a reservation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fon Kawaii

sample_reviews_en.text: Tried Fatt Chicken Rice for the first time and it truly hit the spot. This is Chinese comfort food at its finest. The clay pot rice was rich and flavourful, with that perfect smoky touch at the bottom. The Hainanese chicken set? Tender, juicy, and served with fragrant rice that brought the whole dish together. Portions were generous and satisfying. But the real surprise? The soup that came with the meal. It was unexpectedly delicious and full of depth. A hidden gem worth discovering.
sample_reviews_en.author: OfficialG Tui

sample_reviews_en.text: The food here is very similar to Singapore. The portion of the food is generous and delicious. The staff is very friendly when taking orders and also if you need any help, they are willing to help. Would recommend to anyone who is into chicken rice and Singapore food ! Price wise is totally worth it !
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiewphui Poh

sample_reviews_en.text: Really good sauces to go with the chicken rice set. They give you 3 types of sauce and the rice is very tasty as well. It’s definitely expensive compared to the price on the street, but it’s worth trying. The staff is not very attentive, but fortunately you won’t need them much.
sample_reviews_en.author: Philip Haas

restaurants.name: FuKu FuKu
restaurants.address:

UBC2 591 ตึก Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited this cozy spot after a friend's recommendation. The yakitori was truly delightful - perfectly grilled with a savory balance of salt seasoning and succulent flavors. My favorite was the juicy tsukune. The staff were incredibly friendly, especially towards families with kids, adding a warm touch to the enjoyable atmosphere. While it did get a bit lively with a large group, the overall experience was fantastic.

The place has a bright and clean ambiance that makes you feel right at home. Located conveniently in Phrom Phong, it's easy to stop by for a relaxed evening out. The prices were reasonable, allowing me to indulge just a bit more. I'm already planning my next visit to try more items and bring friends along for the experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thomas S

sample_reviews_en.text: I discovered this place while searching for restaurants on Google Maps. This was my first time at this Phrom Phong location, and it far exceeded my expectations! The atmosphere was very comfortable and welcoming. The grilled chicken skewers were delicious, with just the right flavor and texture, and the balance of salt and sauce was particularly delightful. However, the chicken fallopian tube and ovary were a bit overcooked and lacked the juiciness. The staff were friendly and attentive, and their hospitality made me feel right at home. The prices were also reasonable, making it easy to try a wide variety of dishes. I'll definitely bring friends back next time to experience this special experience again. 😊 I highly recommend this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: pinhao wang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Our first dining experience in Sukhumvit branch. We were frequent visitors of their Silom branch that has been closed. In Sukhumvit they use electric grill and this really reflects in the end product taste and texture. skewers in Silom where caramelized to perfection - I'm not sure if they used binchotan charcoal from Japan (which is quite expensive) but they achieved so much more flavor and complexity while watching grill master playing with the fire was a visual pleasure as well. In Sukhumvit branch the skewers end up being half grilled half boiled and lacking the proper Maillard reaction.
We do not plan to come back - looking for other places in BKK that choose to be more authentic and invest in real charcoal grilling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oleg Fadin

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time at this restaurant, recommended by a friend. I was very impressed! 🎉 The yakitori here in the Phrom Phong area is incredibly tender, with slightly crispy skin, perfectly seasoned with just the right amount of salt, and the sweet sauce is deliciously balanced. I loved it so much I ordered another skewer!

The atmosphere is relaxing and comfortable. Whether you come alone or with friends, you can chat without feeling rushed. The staff are attentive and always smiling, which makes a great impression.

The prices are very reasonable, allowing you to enjoy a satisfying meal for hours. I'll definitely be back to try other dishes. 😊 Next time, I'll bring my friends!
sample_reviews_en.author: TSP236

sample_reviews_en.text:
I discovered this place through a friend's recommendation and was not disappointed. For my first visit, I was warmly welcomed by the staff, who were extremely polite and attentive. The cozy atmosphere made me feel relaxed and at home.

The dishes were excellent, with the fuku fuku salad and cold noodle being absolutely to die for. The combination of flavors was spot-on, and the food was served at just the right pace.

Located in Phrom Phong, this spot is perfect for enjoying delicious yakitori. The reasonable prices make it easy to indulge in a few more sticks without breaking the bank. I’m already planning my next visit, maybe with some friends to try more of their menu! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaewon Park

sample_reviews_en.text:
For years I’ve always had a good impression of this place, but when I was there on 1 June 2024, 6pm. There was a waitress that was sick. She was sneezing and coughing. She even wiped her snot on her hands. All without having a mask. She’d serve drinks and food without even sanitizing her hands that had snot on it. I wanted to leave immediately and cut short my meal but the management wasn’t even willing to send her home. They messed up my final bill in the end (I ended up paying more) but I really had to hightail out of there without finishing my meal.
People should have more knowledge on how to protect their customers. I doubt I’ll ever go back here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kayden Chew (KayC)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I learned about this restaurant from a friend's recommendation, and this is my third time here. I'm always impressed! The staff are polite and always smiling 🍻

The food tastes delicious; each yakitori skewer is grilled to perfection, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, with a perfect balance of salt and sauce. The atmosphere is warm, inviting, and very relaxing.

Most importantly, the price is very reasonable. I'll definitely ask for extra skewers next time! I plan to bring my friends here for a get-together next time. If you're looking for a delicious yakitori restaurant in the Phrom Phong area, don't forget to visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattawat Umnuayharn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything is very good(except the potato salad which is too smoky for me) the service is excellent the food is delicious as for the grilled chicken the skin is crispy and the meet is tender and juicy you can tell that it was cook to perfection not overcooked not undercooked it was just right I really recommend it. I had 3 different one i can’t remember the name but you can see 2of them in my picture. The nabe is different than what I had before not in a bad way it is also good as well
Overalls I really like it I would definitely go back if I have a chance

By the way most menu are chicken as the name of the restaurant suggests.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sorravit Bunjongpean

restaurants.name: Suki Masa
restaurants.address:

111, 1 Thong Lo 5 Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I ordered Shabu set at home.
Also Shrimp Tempura here is really nice.
ยำแซลมอน is one of my favorite dish ever.
Suki Masa is always have high standard. I am really appreiciated it.
sample_reviews_th.author: AS SAWA

sample_reviews_en.text:
A place that doesn’t hold back. Very attentive and kind staff who know their portion of the meal well and are not afraid to speak their mind and recommend you what they think is best. The place allows you to order from sushi masa, and I must say, the sushi are elegantly made with fresh ingredients without holding back in the portions.
