As for the suki itself, this place is for premium meat lovers down to spend. I was able to try the A4 beef set. The meat was excellent itself with fine marbling, but that was not all. Each set came with a sizable amount udon, a bowl of rice, and an absolutely massive bowl of vegetables as well as dessert of custard pudding.
As for the broth, had tried both dashi soup and tonkotsu soup but unfortunately not the miso tonkotsu. The tonkotsu had a deep, noticeable flavor of broth that seeped into the meat, making any seasoning whatsoever excessive. The dashi soup was light and great for those who seek to taste the raw flavor of high quality meat. If asked, I prefer the tonkotsu, but I recommend both.
A great place for premium beef, make sure to book beforehand!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yawp Yawperins

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is our go-to Japanese sukiyaki restaurant in Thonglor, the one we frequent the most. The reason? We absolutely love their udon noodles!

They serve cold udon with a set, and we recommend eating it quickly because the noodles will stick together if left for too long. The best way is to dip the noodles in the accompanying sauce. The sauce is quite concentrated, so taste it first and then adjust the amount to your liking.
We love the soft and chewy noodles; the quality and taste never change, no matter how many times we go.

The sukiyaki and shabu-shabu menus differ in the soup. The sukiyaki soup is uniquely sweet. We usually order the shabu-shabu set with clear soup, which includes vegetables, meat, and dessert. However, you can order additional items separately if needed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panshewa P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Japanese-style sukiyaki restaurant is effortlessly delicious! 🥢✨
The broth is incredibly flavorful, both the dried fish broth and the clear broth have an authentic Japanese aroma. The ingredients are super fresh, especially the beef and seafood, which you can tell are carefully selected. 🐟🍤
There are several dipping sauces to choose from, both Japanese and Thai sukiyaki sauces, but I personally love the Japanese one – it's mild yet rich in flavor. 😋

The staff provides excellent and attentive service. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, perfect for couples or families. 🍲
The price is on the premium side, but it's worth it for the quality and taste. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: nanniizca

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was amazing lunch, we are shabu lovers and it is one of the best we had in Bangkok and there is so many shabu restaurants  now at every corner of the Sukhumvit and we were very nicely surprised by quality and they give every thing you need with decent Wakyu , all kind of nice vege, Udong and rice until dessert. And they were giving also the condiments for Kao tom at the end, was very attentive thinking !!
It is not often that I make that good review, I definitely go there again soon this week already. And the staff were very well trained , nice and good service before you ask any thing !! 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Miwha Shin

sample_reviews_en.text: Suki Masa, a Japanese Suki Kansai style restaurant at Thonglor Soi 5.  I heard that this is a qualify restaurant especially for meatlover.  We order 2 beefs sets of shabu and 1 pork set of suki together with sushi and salmon salad.  Shabu soup is great and delicious till my niece making her own rice porridge 😆😆 by just putting boiled rice in the soup and streamed for a while.  She just can't let it go. Beef and pork are premium and fresh.  Price is quite high but it's just a gift for life.
sample_reviews_en.author: W Nana

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pros
The overall was good
Price for suki yaki
Wagyu A5 1500++  150g
Wagyu A4 1200++
Kurobuta pork 450++
Good taste good service

Cons. They were rushing customers to finish their meal. From sukiyaki server will cook it front of you as customers may ruin the taste. However, in my opinion, I want to take time to enjoy the flavor of wagyu but server was rush and cook the meat continuously,  like you dont have enough time to enjoy it

Anyways overall is 4 star from me
sample_reviews_en.author: Pob Wara

sample_reviews_en.text: A bit and service we got is not consistent. I went there often because my friends love their food and location. However, comparing the place with nabezo (because the price range is about the same, and menu structure is kinda similar) I’d say the atmosphere at nabezo is more private and service is much more better and consistent. One good thing is that it allow you to share your course with your friends so you dont have to order one course each person.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alice Danwiboon

restaurants.name: Smizzle Burger - Central Embassy
restaurants.address:

Phloen Chit Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re hunting for a proper smash burger in Bangkok, stop wasting your time hopping from one place to another and head straight to Smizzle Burger at Central Embassy.

The burgers are smashed exactly as they should be, with beautifully caramelized edges, a juicy, flavorful center, and a soft bun that holds everything together without getting soggy. The house sauce is the standout, tangy, balanced, and just enough to complement the beef without overpowering it.

This is unapologetic comfort food done right. No unnecessary gimmicks, just quality ingredients cooked with confidence. Pair it with the fries and you’ll leave wondering why you ever settled for mediocre burgers elsewhere.

An easy 5/5. One of Bangkok’s best smash burger spots, and absolutely worth the visit. Don’t expect too much from staff they’re mostly mute and wear a poker face. Don’t let that distract you from the burger.
sample_reviews_en.author: Solidly Dubaian

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered

1. Beef Oklahoma - nicely cooked. caramelized onion. Long sliced so it went all over my face. A little bit too boney for me (2 small pieces of bones inside the patty) nearly had to book a dentist. But hey, 2 small ones out of the whole patty, I considered myself lucky.🍀

2. Sweet potato fries - my gf’s personal favorite. The actual serving size didn’t do its justice. Comparing it to the advertising pic on the counter, I felt breached contractually and emotionally. Good sweet potato though.

3. Dark chocolate shake - super thick couldn’t suck it out when freshly served. Not too sweet.

The temperature at the seat in front of the shop was just right. You wouldn’t gonna be frozen to death like other seats in the same Open House area.

Great place. I believe all the downsides were just my food misfortunes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattapong Suntayopas

sample_reviews_en.text:
Smizzle Burger at Central Embassy is a must-visit for any burger lover. I went with friends, and we ordered four or five different burgers to share, and every single one was absolutely fantastic! The flavors were spot-on, with perfectly cooked patties, fresh toppings, and just the right balance of sauce and seasoning.

Yes, we had to wait a bit for our food, but it was well worth it—great things take time! Plus, the prices are very reasonable considering the quality. If you’re looking for a delicious smash burger experience in Bangkok, Smizzle Burger is the place to be. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohammad Farran

sample_reviews_en.text:
The burgers here are absolutely incredible, perfectly juicy, packed with flavor, and cooked to perfection in every bite. You can really taste the quality of the ingredients.

What makes the experience even better is that they’ve thoughtfully included great options for kids, making it an easy and enjoyable spot for families.

The location is also a big plus at Central Embassy, which is modern, clean, and has a great atmosphere. Whether you’re grabbing a quick bite or sitting down to enjoy a relaxed meal, this place ticks all the boxes. Highly recommended if you’re in the area!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sheikha Al Zaabi

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best place for burgers in Bangkok!!

I’d highly recommend uncle sam and crusty blondy with both pork and beef burgers — both are absolutely tasty but the buns will be too oily if you not requesting less oil buns.

Fries with cheese and crispy bacon also one of the must order menu

Staff here is 10/10 very friendly and care. I visited the place with pregnant friend and without saying anything cashier staff order kitchen team that burger beef must be cook well done since it is for pregnant women.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kuna Pun

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best burger spots we have tried recently in the city and it’s no surprise it was voted Best of 2025 by customers! The burger was incredibly juicy, with fresh, flavorful meat that really stood out. Every bite was satisfying and cooked just right.

We also tried the truffle fries, and they were excellent perfectly crispy with just the right amount of truffle flavor. The combination made for a great meal overall.

Definitely a place worth visiting for burger lover looking for quality and taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Abdulkarim ALZarouni

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is tastier than typical hamburgers. The meat is nicely crispy, the cheese is crunchy, and the bun seems ordinary—it doesn't have that distinctive buttery aroma like places that use brioche bread. However, the staff spoke in a harsh tone and seemed unenthusiastic about service, lacking training. The side dishes seem overpriced for their portion size. The sauces here are tastier than most, or even better than those at other hamburger restaurants. I'd visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: S.K. Seataphong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Worth the hype!

Probably one of the most delicious smash burgers in the area.

Enjoy all the burgers and fries, especially the curly fries it was delicious.

My favorite was P.B.B. And Crusty Blondy burger, hands down.

Service was okay due to this location's recent opening. The waiting time was a bit longer than usual and the cashier who took the order should provide some suggestions or recommendations about the menu.

Definitely will come back for more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Awaybutnotalone “Awaybutnotalone”

restaurants.name: The Verandah
restaurants.address:

48 Oriental Ave, Khwaeng Bang Rak, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Verandah overlooks the historic Chao Phraya river and the view while dining is simply stunning. There’s an option to eat indoors when it gets too hot during the day.

Their ala carte menu has a lot of choices and everything we ordered was delicious. We ate indoors during one hot day at lunch and we were quite pleased with the food. Servings were enough and prices were fair for a luxury hotel. Service was impeccable.

Their breakfast buffet was one of the best.

There is definitely something (and more) for everyone. It seemed pricey at first but when presented by the vast array of high quality food items, there is definitely value for money and the price seems more than reasonable. Again, service at the outdoor breakfast area was exceptional as well.

This truly is a place to experience and enjoy oneself. I have not enough good words for my experience here and can only recommend to try and have a few meals at the Verandah.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna M

sample_reviews_en.text:
The experience began with fresh coconut juice, made right in front of you, followed by a fruit corner overflowing with tropical fruits like dragon fruit, jackfruit, star fruit, and rose apple. The deli and salad corner offered cheese, ham, and even sushi rolls, and there was a live station where meatball noodles were prepared right before your eyes. I was amazed by the wide variety of offerings.

The shrimp congee was particularly exquisite; I had several servings. Eggs Benedict was also available as a separate order, a luxurious dish with a rich hollandaise sauce and caviar.

The riverside seating offered a view of the Chao Phraya River, making for a pleasant start to the day.

Both the variety and quality of the food were highly satisfying. While reservations aren't accepted, walk-ins are welcome, so I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone not staying at the Mandarin Oriental Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: みたらし だんご

sample_reviews_en.text:
No reason not leaving a 5-star review for the food, atmosphere, and the heart warming service.

I ordered pad see yiu gai (Thai chicken fried noodle) and dom kha gai (Thai coconut sour spicy soup) for myself. Tastes like home, feel so satisfied.

I reserved an outdoor seat but I didn’t feel hot at all (early September), enjoyed the best view of the Chao Phraya River, a mosquito coil is elegantly placed in a case under the dining table, you won’t notice it and effectively prevented insects come close to you, especially your delicious food. At around 7pm, the sky starts dimming, with the warmth breeze blowing to my face I almost fallen asleep, it’s too comfortable.🤣🤣🤣

I must mention the service, saying it “good” or “outstanding” is not enough. I’d say it’s heartwarming, gentle and very caring like I’m having dinner at home that’s the reason why I’m a MO fan.

Hope to visit there again☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Tracy Cheung

sample_reviews_en.text:
Perched on the riverfront of the Mandarin Oriental Hotel, Verandah restaurant offers a serene setting to watch the boats and admire views of the river, the Peninsula, and IconSiam. The ambiance perfectly embodies the Italian phrase “Il dolce far niente”—the sweetness of doing nothing.

Our meal was delightful, featuring dishes with genuine "wow" factor. We sampled the wonton noodle soup, cauliflower steak, blue crab & papaya, and Ravioli duck foie gras. Each dish was fresh, but the ravioli stole the show. The pasta was flavorful, and the duck foie gras inside was luxuriously rich and tender, melting seamlessly on the first bite.

I’m eager to return and explore more of the menu. Note that the restaurant appeared short-staffed, so we had to signal for service periodically. Nevertheless, it remained a wonderful fine-dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachel Barker

sample_reviews_en.text: After looking around a bit, we visited here on one of the Christmas days. The restaurant is located at the back of the hotel, Mandarin Oriental, facing the Chao Phraya River, where five different empty boats with lots of lights were driving back and forth, it was a bit too much of a good thing, probably to please the guests along the river. A full menu with both food, there were many great dishes, and drinks were available, and the order went quickly as there were a lot of staff present, who also followed up during the meal. The hotel was beautifully decorated, and radiated quality on the way in and later on the way out of the restaurant, and was a great sight. This is an exclusive restaurant, which of course has a price level accordingly.
sample_reviews_en.author: John F. Stieglitz

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there for lunch. It was a weekday lunchtime, but there were plenty of empty seats. It seems like you can get in without a reservation. It's child-friendly, and casual attire is fine.

Since it wasn't raining, I sat outside. It was a little hot, but the view was nice and the breeze was pleasant.

The cost is usually around 3000-5000 yen.

I had the Khao Soi, and the meat was tender and well-seasoned. Sparkling water was about 380 baht.

I recommend this place to anyone who wants to enjoy lunch in a slightly upscale atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: I Y

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Delightful Dining Experience by the River

Food: The food was fresh and delicious, with the highlight being the Crab Ravioli—an absolute must-try! loved the complimentary crispy prawn and their butter was out of the world!

Service: Service was prompt and efficient, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable dining experience.

Atmosphere: The riverside setting added to the charm, creating a relaxing and picturesque ambiance.

Overall, a great spot for a memorable meal with excellent food, good service, and a beautiful atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Monica’s Taste

sample_reviews_en.text:
POSITIVE: great location, relaxing atmosphere with awesome views. good variety of food. friendly stuff. as a guest of the restaurant, I had a boat ride to Iconsiam mall.
NEGATIVE: waiter has seen I barely touched the salad, and no reaction what was wrong with the salad. this is a top rated restaurant and they should have to pay attention to these details.
I had classic caesar salad, octopus, and latte. I loved octopus and latte, but caesar salad was awful, no taste dressing, and so dry bacon on the top.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marina Berger

restaurants.name: Suan Son Beef Noodles Halal
restaurants.address:

QM42+GMH, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time there. I arrived at 11:10 AM. The restaurant was relatively empty, with most tables empty, but there was a line of about 20 or 10 people in front of the stove. They ordered and waited for their orders, each taking their own food to their table. We waited for about an hour, and finally got there at 12:10 PM. Personally, I think it wasn't that crowded, but the food was slow.

Everything I ordered looked very appetizing. The meat was generously portioned, which was a good amount for 70 baht. However,

1. The soup was a bit salty, but it was delicious and I could slurp it down.
2. I had high hopes for the fillings because of the reviews, but today's experience was terrible. They looked good, but some pieces were bitter and some were not cleaned properly.
3. The rice was incredibly hard. I've never eaten rice this hard in my life.
4. The vegetables had a strong medicinal smell, like pesticide. They were inedible. If you can't choose, you should have handled or washed them better.
5. The dry noodles were overwhelmingly sweet.
6. The edge of the winnowing basket was the only thing that was delicious. There was no smell.
sample_reviews_en.author: Janitsata T.

sample_reviews_en.text: For braised beef noodle soup in the Bang Kapi area, I highly recommend this place. I've been a customer for a very long time, since the owner's father was still alive. Now it's been passed down to the next generation, and the taste hasn't changed at all. If you don't want to queue, don't go between 11 am and 12 pm because the line is very long. Go between 9 am and 10 am; the queue isn't as long, and they'll have all the parts available, like tripe, spleen, liver, etc. Some items will be sold out by the afternoon. This is another great place I highly recommend in the Bang Kapi area! 😋😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Yo Vios

sample_reviews_en.text:
Suan Son Beef Noodles, which are similar to Bang Sammakorn's, are siblings. The broth flavors are similar, but not exactly the same. The beef and offal are more succulent and chewy than Bang Sammakorn's, and there's a wider selection. You can order a combination here, but it's not all included; it depends on what Bang Sammakorn puts in it. You'll also have to wait in line.
If you're planning to come, I recommend arriving early, around 9:00-9:30 AM. There won't be a lot of people and the line isn't long. If you come at noon or in the afternoon, you might miss out.
sample_reviews_en.author: WG

sample_reviews_en.text:
Suan Son Beef Noodles is a beef noodle shop with a constant queue. Today, I joined the queue for about 15-20 minutes before ordering. The soup was incredibly fragrant. I ordered the stewed beef, pork belly, intestines, and tendons. Overall, it was excellent. It wasn't too tough, and the soup was fragrant.
Bang Suan Son Noodles offers a flat price of 70 baht for the entire course. The shop is located right at the Chang Roundabout, on the corner. It's easy to find, as the queue is noticeable. Parking can be a bit tricky, but you can find a spot.
sample_reviews_en.author: พิชัย แตงอ่อน

sample_reviews_en.text: The braised beef and tendon are all delicious and affordable. Anyone who loves braised beef shouldn't miss this place. It's always crowded with long queues every day. It's a small food cart with limited indoor seating. You have to queue to order, and if you want seconds, you have to go back and queue again. Having money isn't enough; you also need passion, plenty of time, and the right timing, as they sometimes run out of ingredients. The only potential issue might be that it doesn't meet the same hygiene standards as larger restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siwakorn Job

sample_reviews_en.text: This noodle shop is a hidden gem. It is very delicious, good volume, and reasonable price. It is one of the best in Bangkok for me. Before you come, you need to know that it is close randomly lol it is a long queue during lunch time. While you are on queue, you need to be ready what to order. When it is your turn, you tell the cook what type of noodle (small, big) and 3 ingredients (beef etc). If you cannot speak thai, you can point at the ingredients. 500B and 1,000B bills are not accepted. So, don’t forget to bring small changes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Takashi Iwata

sample_reviews_en.text:
For beef noodles these days, a plate costs 70 baht. This one is the best in the area. I've eaten here since it was 30 baht. Most people would be full after just one plate. If you're a bit greedy, two bowls will fill you up. It's worth adding fermented bean curd and peanuts to the dish for a richer flavor. Many of the dishes are even more delicious than the more famous ones. It's worth waiting in line to try.

I've seen several different chefs, but it's still delicious and a great value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ordinary Decent Criminal

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best beef noodles with very tasty stew beefs.
Good organized line up self service and self-serve.
The owner who making noodles benind the hot big  boiling soup pot  was calm and gentle. Near by old lady and the table by him could be his wife doing cashier station.
At this stage open on and off because not enough staffs at the moment. (4 Sept  24).
So, Please check with him  before you go.
His mb. Shown in one of my posted picture.
The atmosphere is open air...ground floor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Life is beautiful NZ

restaurants.name: Trattoria Delina
restaurants.address:

11, 14 ชุมชน Soi Ruamrudee Community, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Let me start of with what was really good :
The handmade mushroom and sausage pasta was excellent. The pasta was pretty cooked and homemade. The sausage came after the dish was delivered as a side but maybe it was because the staff thought I was vegetarian . Very nice all the same.
The slow cooked lamb shank was excellent. It was the speak of the day / week and was brilliant.

The soup on the other hand was supposed to be a minestrone but was very cauliflower and broccoli forward and tasted more like a simple amalgamation of boiler vegetable. Not unpleasant but not something to write home about.

The service is friendly and kind. The front entrance looks a bit sad and doesn’t quite do justice to the cosy interior.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pritish Kakodkar

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delina is simply a place where you feel like home.
Starting from the staff warm welcome and kindness all along the time spent there , the atmosphere , the expertise of the manager to illustrate their menu, suggest and explain how to match drinks with the mouthwashing foods, all is genuinely perfect.
I've been here several times, in different occasions, alone, with family, with coworkers and friends; everytime the thought sticked in my mind, is always they same: I must come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: urxi81

sample_reviews_en.text: An absolute standout for both seafood and meat lovers! We ordered the roasted whole fish and the steak tagliata, and both were executed to perfection. The fish was incredibly moist, served over a bed of tender potatoes and zucchini that soaked up all the herbs and juices. The steak was served perfectly rare, high-quality, and paired beautifully with the sharp parmesan shavings and fresh arugula. You can tell they use premium ingredients. A must-visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ornicha Seangket

sample_reviews_en.text: Great Italian restaurant in Soi Ruam Rudee, just a short walk from Ploenchit BTS Station. I visited twice — a very good value lunch set and a dinner with excellent Italian wine, cold cuts, a perfectly cooked tenderloin, and a delicious tiramisu. The food quality is high, prices are reasonable, and the service is friendly. Special thanks to the owner, Alessandro, a true wine expert who helped me choose a fantastic white wine. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrea Sciortino

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a cozy eatery that serves up delicious pasta and pizza that will make you feel right at home. The restaurant's warm and inviting atmosphere is perfect for a casual meal with friends or family.

The menu features a variety of pasta dishes, including the classic spaghetti carbonara and a flavorful clam vongole. The pasta is cooked al dente, and the sauces are rich and satisfying. For meat lovers, the steak is cooked to perfection.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumol

sample_reviews_en.text: Hidden homey Italian restaurant ( @trattoriadelinabkk ) that is located in Soi Ruamrudee, near BTS Phloen Chit. The atmosphere of the restaurant is very cozy 😍 There are large wall paintings that give Italian vibes 🍝 The food tastes authentic Italian with homemade style 🤩 This is the restaurant that you should not miss 🥳 A variety of seafood, including shrimp, shellfish, and squid. The taste is perfectly balanced 🇮🇹
sample_reviews_en.author: Rywyn Uttamayodhin (Trustmewithfoods)

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited for lunch and had a delightful experience!
The lunch menu, priced at a reasonable 290 baht per person, offered great value for money.
The food was delicious, especially the “tonnato”.
The cozy atmosphere truly captures the essence of a traditional Italian trattoria. Special mention to the manager Alessandro, who was exceptionally kind and added to the overall hospitality of the place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leonardo Vanni

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've had the pleasure of coming here several times, it's always a treat!
Amazing Italian dishes cooked how it should be, cozy environment.
The manager knows his way around wines and can suggest the perfect pairing with every dish. He's also always very welcoming and attentive to each and every guest.
Perfect place for a dinner with friends or a romantic night!
sample_reviews_en.author: Cristian Guerra

restaurants.name: JP French Restaurant
restaurants.address:

59, 1 ซ. สุขุมวิท 31 Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Classic French cuisines, skillfully executed, generous portion, homy setting, simply delicious. Proper escargot, not too salty but nice and clean, with special contraption to hold the shell. JP salad is humongous and super tasty, combination of fresh lettuce, balsamic dressing, poached egg, big tomatoes, foie gras toast, and cold cuts, really yum! Penne carbonara, perhaps not french, but it's really proper pasta, good for kids. Duck confit is nicely fried with crispy edges, the duck jus is really the star of the show, thick, complex and absolutely delicious. Beef wellington is the best one I had so far, good quality tenderloin, cooked to perfection, nicely seasoned mushroom filling and flaky pastry. High value for money and highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yosua Iskandar

sample_reviews_en.text:
### Review for JP French Restaurant

JP French Restaurant offers an exquisite experience of authentic French cuisine. This fine dining establishment is perfect for a leisurely meal, allowing you to savor every bite without feeling rushed. The escargot, served in shells, is a must-have and allows you to enjoy it in the traditional style.

I indulged in a full-course meal, and every dish was delicious and impeccably prepared. The food is fresh, with some ingredients imported from France, adding to the authenticity. The foie gras was particularly outstanding.

The servers are knowledgeable and well-trained, enhancing the overall dining experience. I can't recommend JP French Restaurant enough for anyone seeking a genuine taste of France.
sample_reviews_en.author: T C

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything about this place was lovely. I had such a great time! The owner is incredibly friendly and welcoming, which made the experience even more special.

I tried the beef tartare, it was flavorful, though a bit heavy on the mustard for my taste. That said, paired with the fresh veggies and bread, it still hit the spot.

But the real star? The crème brûlée. Absolutely unmissable, perfectly creamy with that golden caramelized top. A true standout.

Also loved the Kir—light, refreshing, and just right to start the evening.

Highly recommended if you’re in the mood for a cozy French escape in the city.
sample_reviews_en.author: Passa Tanneau

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent welcome from Jean-Pierre, the owner.
An extraordinary Australian ribeye steak, worthy of the best French beef. Better than a Parthenaise, and served with a Béarnaise sauce that was absolutely perfect in both taste and texture. Incredible!
Not forgetting the sautéed potatoes.
And for dessert, a very flavorful and light chocolate mousse. Without hesitation, come and enjoy the cuisine at this restaurant.
Bravo to the Chef and his team!
It was a wonderful experience.
Thank you, JP.
sample_reviews_en.author: jacques lollier

sample_reviews_en.text: What can I say except that this restaurant is a wonderful discovery recommended by a friend. Everything is delicious; the ribeye steak was excellent and perfectly cooked. The Béarnaise sauce is to die for—you won't often find anything like it in France or Belgium. JP is a very welcoming person and will gladly share his experiences of living in Thailand for the past 32 years. In short, don't bother looking for another French restaurant in Bangkok; this one is the best!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sher Man Official artist channel

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall a very enjoyable meal and would come again. Friendly service in a classic restaurant of may be 7-8 tables. The complimentary appetizer + baguette were good. Ingredients feel fresh and chef gives good portions for the prices. Duck confit and sauce very flavorful/ a little salty for me but great with the mash). Escargot sauce fragrant/ chef gives extra for the bread. (Disclaimer: honest reviews with limited knowledge of French cuisine though)
sample_reviews_en.author: Nalin c

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was good. Service was fantastic. Food was excellent. We truly enjoyed our dinner at JP French restaurant. Would definitely recommend this place for their Beef Wellington, Fried Frog Legs, Beef Tartare, Escargot and for dessert we had Creme Brulee, Ice Nougat washed down with their House wine. Cost THB 5530 for a family of 4. A Truly amazing French dinning experience tucked away in Bangkok. Great Job to the Owner, Chefs n Staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nelson Gabriel Edwards

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of our go to restaurant for my family. The food here is really great on both the freshness and the taste. The menus is not over-priced for the quality you get. Staffs were very attentive. There is no parking beside the restaurant however, you can park at the Young’s Place parking basement and get a free parking stamp.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kongpope Naranong

restaurants.name: 100 ล้านนัว อาหารไทย อีสาน (ทุ่งครุ)
restaurants.address:

620 9 Pracha Uthit 86 Alley, Khwaeng Thung Khru, Thung Khru, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: If you’re craving real Thai-Isan flavors, 100 ล้านนัว is the place! The spice level is just right, enough to give you that perfect kick. They use fresh, clean ingredients. The staffs are super friendly, and the food looks just as amazing as it tastes. If you love Thai-Isan food, this spot is a must-visit!
sample_reviews_th.author: Asil Munaf

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is near my house, one I've passed by many times but never tried. I read good reviews, so I decided to give it a try, and I wasn't disappointed. The food tasted great, the prices were reasonable, and the portions were just right. My favorite was probably the grilled pork neck; the meat was high quality. After finishing the first plate, I ordered another! The restaurant has both air-conditioned and outdoor seating areas, perfect for enjoying a meal outside in the cool evening air, especially if you're looking for a hot pot place. The only downside was the stir-fried fish with chili paste, which I ordered several times before it finally arrived. Everything else was great.

In total, we ordered 7 dishes, 2 servings of rice, and drinks for 5 people, and the bill came to only 840 baht!

Delivery is also available.

Payment Method: Credit cards are not accepted; bank transfers are accepted.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tai Sasitorn

sample_reviews_en.text: Today was my first time eating there. I was running errands in the area, so I decided to stop by. The food was decent, and the portions were worth the price. I went in the afternoon, so it wasn't very crowded. It seems like most people go in the evening. It was hot outside, but the restaurant had air conditioning and fans. Overall, the service was good, and the food came quickly. The taste was good, especially the grilled pork neck and the palm fruit in milk dessert.
sample_reviews_en.author: Baipai Nuttapun

sample_reviews_en.text:
Terrible service. We arrived long before, but two tables that arrived 10-20 minutes later got their food first. Awful.
Wasted a lot of time waiting.
I repeat, two tables that arrived later got their food first. Absolutely awful. Even though it was takeout, shouldn't those who arrived first have gotten their food first?
The first table waited over half an hour.
The fried larb portion was tiny.
I recommend finding a better place to eat at a roadside stall instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: OG HK

sample_reviews_en.text: There's ample parking. The food selection is diverse, the prices are mid-range, and the taste is delicious. It's a comfortable, air-conditioned place to relax. I recommend the papaya salad platter, fried chicken wings, and beef tendon soup. When I went around 12:30 PM, it wasn't very crowded, so I could relax and enjoy my meal. The food arrived quickly and the service was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: DAMRONG LERTNA

sample_reviews_en.text:
The papaya salad was delicious. The flavor was intense, and the fermented fish sauce lived up to the restaurant's name.
We ordered three types of papaya salad: fresh shrimp papaya salad, mixed vegetable papaya salad, and cockle papaya salad.
The prices were reasonable, and the staff were lovely and provided good service. There were four of us, and we finished every dish!
sample_reviews_en.author: nukai phuthai

sample_reviews_en.text:
A relaxed atmosphere, perfect for families and friends.
Spicy and flavorful Northeastern Thai food, with must-try dishes like papaya salad with fermented crab and fish sauce, grilled beef, and spicy pork rib soup.
Reasonable prices and generous portions.
Good service, fast food delivery. Located in front of the Thung Khru district office with convenient parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: รุ่งนภา คุ้มเณร

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tended to be predominantly sweet. The grilled intestines, which came later, were even sweeter. The seafood tom yum and beef tom yum were both very sweet. The stir-fried dishes were also sweet. But anyway, everyone's taste is different. I saw they had a lot of regular customers, so it must suit many people's palates. This was my first time there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sehee Num

restaurants.name: GALA BANGKOK
restaurants.address:

28 Soi Saman Chan, พระโขนง Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: “I used to be very impressed with this restaurant and even brought my family here on promotional days, but this time I was very disappointed. We had a reservation for 8 PM, but the food didn't start being served until almost 8:50 PM and came out one dish at a time, making us wait until almost 10 PM. There was no prior notification that the food would be delayed or that there would be a change to the menu, even though that menu was the main reason we chose that course. Furthermore, we found a hair in our food. The only solution was to replace the dish, but no manager came out to apologize or explain the situation in person. After we reported the problems, the restaurant only offered to let us come back again, which isn't the point for us, because what we lost was time and our satisfaction. I hope the restaurant will use this incident to improve its communication and service, because food quality alone isn't enough if the customer experience isn't taken care of.”
sample_reviews_en.author: France Srl

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited Gala in Bangkok, and it was a great discovery for me and my friends! The restaurant is conveniently located with ample parking, which is very convenient for guests arriving by car. The interior is stylish and modern, yet very cozy, creating a comfortable atmosphere for relaxation.

I especially enjoyed the Toothfish dish — it was tender and cooked to perfection. The restaurant does not have a cocktail menu, but the wine selection is available by the bottle, which is great for wine enthusiasts. The staff were excellent — attentive, polite, and friendly, helping with recommendations and making the experience pleasant.

Gala is a great place for a romantic date, birthday celebration with friends, or a casual meetup after university. I will definitely return and recommend it to anyone who appreciates quality cuisine and excellent service!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kate Bass

sample_reviews_en.text:
Purchased a 1-for-1 promotion.
I went to use it as advertised, but the restaurant opened late.
I gave the food 1 star because I paid 1,500 baht per person for a set advertised as 3,000 baht. I have considerable dining experience, but I've never encountered such appalling food service. The fish pieces were tiny, as if they were forced to be cut smaller due to the 1-for-1 promotion. Some items weren't even listed on the menu.

It should have been a "wow" dining experience, but the charcoal grill they brought out seemed like just a prop.

Looking at other reviews, the experience didn't match the money spent.

The foreign staff took drink orders but only served plain water. I ordered sparkling water but didn't get it, even after asking twice.

Limited parking.

Writing this review in case the owner reads it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pintula Vatjanapukka

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dining at Gala Bangkok was a truly memorable experience. The concept is unique and immersive, where each dish is carefully crafted with creativity and precision. Every course came as a surprise — beautifully presented with hidden touches of flavor that made the journey exciting from beginning to end.

The wine pairing was also excellent, complementing the dishes perfectly and enhancing the overall experience.

The ambiance is modern and artistic, and the service is attentive yet relaxed, which made the evening even more enjoyable.

For anyone who loves fine dining and wants to experience something different in Bangkok, Gala Bangkok is a wonderful choice.
sample_reviews_en.author: RattoWanderlust

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just tried the Himeshi Omakase course at Gala Bangkok — an experience built around the idea of grilled ingredients paired with premium Niigata rice. The rice is the true centerpiece here, cooked with fish bone broth and came out with beautiful texture. Combined with top-quality seafood and thoughtful execution, the course feels so comforting in an elegant way.

I went there in Jul/Aug ’25, and the actual start time turned out to be much later than our reservation. The course itself was longer than the one-hour time slot, so later rounds couldn’t begin until the previous round finished. Hopefully, this issue has been resolved by now.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hangry Joobert

sample_reviews_en.text: Certainly one of the best fine dining. The restaurant ambience is fabulous. Next the dishes concept is innovative and full of creativity, the presentation of the food never fail to impress me. I can feel dedication of chef and his team from their presentation of food and when I eat the food. I must say this is art. Chef Tee Too and his team are very professional in explaining the dishes and what inspired them to create the dishes. They also very friendly toward the clients. Always interact and building rapport with eaters. Would definitely come back again for their food again.
sample_reviews_en.author: YEANLOONG yong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Simply exceptional experience. Impeccable service from start to finish, attentive staff, and the perfect atmosphere for a special birthday dinner. The chefs are extraordinary: great quality, technique, and attention to detail.

We chose the Kamashin menu and it was an incredible experience, especially the moment when they bring the grilled meat directly to the table: truly spectacular and captivating.

The crab rice was truly memorable, probably one of the best dishes I've tried in Bangkok. A top-notch dinner, highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Abdel Rahman Khabbaz

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the most unimpressive Japanese restaurant I've ever eaten at.
The food tasted terrible, the fish wasn't fresh, and the charcoal used for grilling wasn't hot enough; it was like it was just there as a prop.
The only thing that was good was the truffle rice, which actually uses Japanese rice as the base ingredient.
The restaurant needs to find a clear direction for itself; it seems very confusing and like it doesn't understand its own identity.
It wasn't worth the price. You could find better food elsewhere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Petit Bird Thailand

restaurants.name: Soofu Hotpot
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 999 999/1-4 Rama IX Soi 41, Khwaeng Suan Luang, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's Friday!
Stopped by to try the new premium hotpot @Soofu.hotpot, a trending spot where you don't have to follow the crowd anymore. Here, they have personalized soup pots where you can choose your favorite soup from 6 options, with a choice of 2. This time, I chose the premium pork set for 621 baht. It was served complete, with carefully selected, high-quality pork that cooks in just 20 seconds – incredibly tender and delicious.
#recommend the delicious soy sauce dip #The pork was incredibly flavorful and the soup was perfectly seasoned. #Today I chose the collagen pork soup, which was deliciously bouncy with collagen. Another favorite was the tomato soup, simmered until tangy and fragrant – I finished it all! The set also included baked scallops with glass noodles, fried dough sticks, and for dessert, watermelon jelly – so refreshing! I definitely have to go back for another round.

#soofuhotpot
#hotpotpremium
#instafood #foodlover #yayeechannel #yayeereviews
#shabuinbangkok #hotpotinbangkok #theninepraram9 #bangkokthailand #delicious #yayeelifestyle #foodblogger #foodstagram #instafood
sample_reviews_en.author: pacharas Thanabordeesuphaseth

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, good quality, and reasonably priced. The restaurant is nicely decorated.
I ordered the pork set, which had about 6 layers of pork, sliced ​​not too thin. It takes a little time to cook, which is good for those who like a bit of chewiness. The vegetables and side dishes didn't seem like a lot, but as you keep eating, you'll feel full. I liked the fried dough sticks that came with the set; dipping them in their special chili sauce was another delicious way to enjoy it :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Narongded RKK

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was delicious! I personally loved it. Everything tasted great, the ingredients were fresh, and the price was good. However, the soup and dipping sauce were extremely salty. I'd love to come back again, but I'm worried about kidney damage if I eat it frequently. I wish they would adjust the saltiness; it was just too salty.
Regarding cleanliness, please be a little more careful. I found a hair in the restaurant, but the staff replaced the vegetables promptly. The service was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ann Wancha

sample_reviews_en.text:
Shabu shabu 🍲 I love eating shabu shabu so much 🍲🥬🥩
You have to come to this shabu shabu restaurant, @soofu.hotpot. It's premium shabu shabu.
The price is lovely and very worthwhile. The atmosphere in the restaurant is not crowded, giving a very private feel ✨ Importantly, anyone who comes on a birthday gets an amazing pork birthday cake 🐷 The staff are all very attentive and impressive 🤍

📍The restaurant is located on the 2nd floor of The Nine Center Rama 9.
sample_reviews_en.author: TC TC

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and reasonably priced. One set is filling, the ingredients are good, and the dipping sauce is very tasty.

However, I'm deducting points because on the day I ate there, someone was filming a review using portable studio-like lighting that was extremely harsh on my eyes and lasted for a very long time. I don't know if they had planned it with the restaurant, but if they did, they should have seated them at the table furthest inside.
sample_reviews_en.author: P S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mala soup paired with tomato soup is delicious!
So delicious I had to come back. The meat is tender, and the quality is well worth the price.
The set comes with vegetables, mala chili fried dough sticks with condensed milk – unusual but delicious! The scallops are also fresh.
I came on my birthday and got a huge plate of Koji Buta pork.
Most importantly, the staff provided excellent service – the best I've ever seen! I'd give them 100 stars! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Aui Petitz

sample_reviews_en.text: This individual hot pot restaurant is located on the 2nd floor of The Nine Rama 9 shopping mall. They offer a variety of soup bases, including two versions: a spicy beef oil mala soup and a vegetarian mala soup (less spicy). The menu offers both set meals and à la carte options. The food is delicious and the staff provides good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supanan Avasiriphongs

sample_reviews_en.text: This mala restaurant uses high-quality ingredients and is located on the 2nd floor of The Nine Rama 9. You can take the escalator in front of McDonald's. The meat is excellent, the mala broth is flavorful, and the clear broth is very refreshing. The set includes vegetables, side dishes (which are delicious!), and dessert.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rossukon V.

restaurants.name: You & I Premium Suki Buffet Central Festival Eastville
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 69, 69/1, โซน บาร์ แอนด์ บริสโทร, ชั้น 1, 69 Soi 2, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very large variety of food and soups even for the cheapest of sets. Extremely affordable for this type of buffet, especially with a salad bar, drinks and desserts already included in the price. Most items came extremely quickly and were delicious. (Some items may take longer, however, they do state it). Floors may be dirty at times but it’s not too bad - not much to complain about.

Overall, an always an amazing experience and would definitely recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Matt

sample_reviews_en.text:
3 times visiting for the basic buffet and all well managed and delicious.
Highly recommend for buffets. Variety of soups to choose. Simple basic also very nice. You can customize your own mix and match sauces to go with.
Reasonable price and won’t rob the bank to enjoy.
All my visits the staffs were very attentive and active in clearing used plates.
Clean utensils.
Variety of drinks to choose too. Including boba milk tea and sugar free.
Worthwhile.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sitthichai K

sample_reviews_en.text:
- It's been a long time since I last ate here. The last time was after the COVID lockdown. I felt like the broth was less rich and less salty (maybe I'm just imagining it).
- The abalone soup was delicious.
- The black soup wasn't too salty, easy to eat, and slightly sweet.
- I'm not sure if the staff at this branch were Thai, but they were quite good at communicating and answering questions.
sample_reviews_en.author: Elynnda N.

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff ignored customers. Empty tables were listed as unavailable, making it feel like we were begging for free food. Only the student staff were somewhat polite and able to communicate with customers. The staff in black uniforms were incapable of managing the queue and greeting customers at the entrance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wuttichai Panthung

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a shabu-shabu buffet restaurant with a wide variety of premium ingredients. It's a great value for the price, considering the quality. You can order via QR code, and there's a selection of delicious desserts available for you to enjoy as much as you like.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khanittha Homdang

sample_reviews_en.text: At this branch, the tables are a bit close together. The staff are attentive but can't keep up, especially during peak hours. The staff at all branches are excellent. The meat is good, the soup is good, the appetizers are just okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: NüI Siraluk

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good service. The staff recommended suitable dishes. The food was of good quality.
There's a wide variety of options: shabu-shabu, BBQ, sukiyaki, and more... Dogs are allowed to sit and eat outside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Parichat Kongurai

sample_reviews_en.text: It's been a while. This time I tried the grilled option, which I just found out they have. It's as delicious as ever, the ingredients are high quality, fresh, and clean. I wasn't disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ordinary Decent Criminal

restaurants.name: Baan Steak (Yothinburana Branch)
restaurants.address:

ร้านบ้านสเต็ก 1066 ถ. ประชาราษฎร์สาย1 Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my third visit. The food tastes good, including the rice dishes, burgers, and steaks. The atmosphere is nice, although the seating is a bit strange due to limited space. However… the service is terrible. They lack service mind and communication difficulties are one thing, but on my third visit, the staff were rude. When I opened the door, they said all the tables were full and told me to ask the restaurant next door. I then entered that restaurant, and the staff there also said, "All tables are full," in a curt and abrupt manner. What am I supposed to do? Go home? Or what? How do you manage a restaurant when it's full? (Note: The restaurant has two adjoining rooms.)

If anyone who has eaten here, or the owner, sees this review, please take it into consideration for improvement. But if you only care about selling food and not service, that's fine.
sample_reviews_en.author: pattarasuda_ferin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was a mix of delicious and mediocre, overall considered good. The steak was large and quite good value for the price.
Papaya salad with fermented fish sauce - the fermented fish sauce wasn't very flavorful.
Black pepper pork steak - a bit too sweet.
Grilled fish steak - very delicious, grilled until crispy and fragrant.
Takoyaki - very delicious.
However, the service was very poor. I pressed the call button 4-5 times, but no one came, even though the staff themselves said to press the button if you wanted to call someone. When I raised my hand to call them, they didn't pay much attention.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nam

sample_reviews_en.text: The female staff member was terrible. I found some kind of hair in my food, so I called for a staff member, but she made a displeased face. She just picked it up and left. I waited, and she didn't say anything, so I paid. She charged me normally, and when I asked about the food, she just said she would follow up. There's a complete lack of communication in the workplace. When I finally got my food, she just placed it down without any apology. It was a very unacceptable experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Athikarn Mulsana

sample_reviews_en.text:
- a waiter does not help to change the complained dish   service mind got me 2/5 point
chef is hurry so our frenchfries go overcooked ( dark brown color and hard texture )
- Fried onion rings, Mashed potato ( sticky hot salthy mild ) is very good and spicy big chicken ( same name of the shop ) is the most good taste with tabasho   shop named chille source ground pepper and black pepper in grind bottle
sample_reviews_en.author: hazardous toxic

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered spaghetti and found some kind of hair in the dish, so I called a waiter. The female waitress who came just looked at it and took it into the kitchen without explaining what she was going to do next. She didn't even say if she would replace the dish or not. She also made a displeased face and didn't even apologize.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nisa.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'd like to file a complaint.
The food tasted good overall.

However, the person taking the order was a foreigner, resulting in an incomplete order. I ordered my food without sauce, but they still added it.

I recommend having a Thai person take the orders instead.

And have the foreign staff serve the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: วศ.พิชญา ภู่ประสงค์

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good. I like the branch in front of Yothin School the most. It feels like I'm eating at a friend's house, lol. The food comes out quickly. The cheese pizza is...so delicious. I often come here for the teriyaki chicken. It's fragrant, tender, and juicy. I haven't had a chance to try it in my heart yet.
sample_reviews_en.author: สิริ พีร์

sample_reviews_en.text: Dine today March 10,2026 around  2:00 pm - The girl took our order appeared aggressive and unaccommodating, making us feel so uncomfortable . Took our order and even repeat our order very very quickly without pause . Please apprehend or even talk to her, By the way I/we are a loyal customer to your store.
sample_reviews_en.author: justin veloso

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือกรุงทอง สาขา สาทร
restaurants.address:

บ้านเลขที่ 6 Soi Naradhiwas Rajanagarindra 4, Khwaeng Yan Nawa, Khet Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodle and papaya salad dishes were incredibly delicious! I ordered four dishes and they were all amazing. And the prices were so cheap – where else can you find food like this in the Sathorn area? 10/10! The total bill was less than 300 baht, and the entire meal cost less than 300 baht!
sample_reviews_en.author: Fangnitaa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tasty affordable local spot specializes in Boat Noodle or the Namtok which is a blood noodle broth. Unlimited fried wanton paper.

Recommend:
- beef namtok (blood soup/boat noodle)
sample_reviews_en.author: N. A.

sample_reviews_en.text: the food is SO GOOD. found this near empire tower before to go to arabica. but the waiter only speak thai. but the food are very good and very cheap. Very recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: Daviga Teguh Wirasendjaja

sample_reviews_en.text: Various noodles to choose from and the soup of boat noodle is pretty thick. Tom yum noodle is relatively lighter. Free flow raw veggies and deep fried wonton sheet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Starcreek Chen

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is flavorful, the restaurant has two floors with air conditioning so it's not too hot, and there's a wide variety of dishes to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: ManinY

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! Just walk a little way down the alley and you'll find it. They have free dumplings and vegetables that you can help yourself to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jayjay B.

sample_reviews_en.text: Free crispy fried dumpling which taste awesome. Boat noodle itself is better than average. If you order non spicy the soup will be plain broth
sample_reviews_en.author: Nawapol Krudpun

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice noodles, you get free dumplings and unlimited vege with your noodle order. Very affordable pricing for what they serve. Would come again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sophia Chang

restaurants.name: เจริญรสชาบู บุฟเฟ่ต์ สาขาอนุสาวรีย์
restaurants.address:

The Seasons Mall (3rd Floor, 899 Phahonyothin Rd, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The buffet restaurant is located on the 3rd floor of Seasons Mall ⭐️🥩🌭
We ordered the 315 baht set which included drinks, ice cream, and glass shrimp. It was okay. The glass shrimp came in a plate of 20 pieces and arrived quickly. The fried items included red sausage, french fries, rice crackers, dumplings, and fish balls. There was also a good variety of fresh ingredients. I was a little confused because the reviews mentioned dim sum, but it seems they've removed it from the menu. Overall, it was good value for money. The taste was standard and delicious. The red sausage was especially tasty.
The restaurant wasn't crowded; mostly families were dining there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alise

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was quite bad. They ran out of green noodles, so I informed them and asked them to refill. They responded rudely. The soup in the pot was also empty, so I asked them to refill it. I didn't see how they refilled it because I was on my phone. When I looked up, the dipping sauce bowl had spilled. I was confused. They spilled it and then just didn't care? The dishes weren't very clean. (The food overall wasn't bad, though.) It depends on personal preference, but I just tolerated it. I couldn't complain because I chose the restaurant myself. Once is enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: อัญนิกา ผลาผล

sample_reviews_en.text: I was impressed by the female staff member in the black shirt sitting at the counter; she greeted me with a warm smile. The food tasted good. The restaurant overall felt clean, but a little old. The staff clearing plates were a bit confusing because they were pushing their cart in the way, but I didn't mind. However, the Australian beef I got had a lot of fat, which was a bit disappointing. The food variety was good. The total bill was around 280 baht, which was good value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณภัทร ปั่นทอง

sample_reviews_en.text: Charoenrot Restaurant, Anusawari branch, serves fresh food with delicious, authentic dipping sauces. My favorite is the sliced ​​pork belly; the texture is just right – not too thin, unlike the extremely thin slices I've had elsewhere. The glass shrimp is also tasty. Overall, it's a great place. The staff are well-dressed, clean, and provide excellent service. The manager is particularly good, recommending promotions and speaking in a friendly and polite manner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eye Diiz

sample_reviews_en.text: Out of all the shabu-shabu places I've tried, the glass shrimp buffet at Charoenrot is the most honest. They give you a huge, generous portion all at once, no need to order multiple times. They really don't hold back. And the ice cream is amazing too, with two freezers available. You can come anytime without a reservation, there are plenty of seats left. The quality is excellent.

The restaurant is HUGE! I love that there's no queue.
The food is served quickly, and there's a huge selection. You can help yourself to the vegetables, and there's also a fried food section.
Rice and green noodles are available.

There's a huge variety of ice cream, probably around 12 flavors. I love this! And they also have other desserts.

Overall, it's great value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanyarat Mitdee

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is spacious and comfortable, with a steady stream of customers. Prices are mid-range. The service from the staff is okay, but they don't seem very attentive. The vegetables weren't very fresh, appearing bruised. The beef was quite tough, but the pork was acceptable. There are many toppings available for the desserts.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fon Kawaii

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff was terrible and yelled at customers. During my two-hour meal, I overheard them speaking rudely to customers at several tables (the staff member was an older woman, thin, with long hair). The plates and cutlery were unclean, with stains on many pieces. My order was incomplete, and I was too lazy to follow up.
sample_reviews_en.author: สายป่าน

restaurants.name: Eggtisan by commonroom x ari
restaurants.address:

room 106, 33 Rajchakru Ave, Soi Phahon Yothin 5, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually have avocado toast for breakfast, and they had it here. However, the combination was simply disgusting in taste; the dill overpowered it, and the avocado was old and tasteless. The egg sandwich was also beautiful, but tasteless; my boyfriend didn't finish it. The place looks nice, and so does the breakfast, but it's edible. And the coffee is incredibly bitter. There are only three syrups: salted caramel, brown sugar, and regular. Furthermore, the syrup is served separately, thick, even though you have to whisk it into the milk for cold coffee and into the espresso for hot coffee!!! 🤬🤬🤬 Otherwise, it's hard to stir the syrup; it sinks to the bottom! It's bitter on top and cloying at the bottom! Then the cashier gave me my change incorrectly! I gave her 400 baht, but I needed 299 more! I stopped and then gave her 300. They don't have a restroom!!! Or go across the street to the market! The cafe pretends to be trendy, but in reality it's rubbish! Such a shame.
sample_reviews_en.author: annajlua

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cute little tiny place and done right in so many ways!!!

Ive been there in the afternoon so the space wasnt crowded at all, I can use my laptop here to casually work for a few hours, tho I can imagine how it’d look like in a busy morning.

Packed with several “egg” dishes in theie menu, I chose Tamago Sando or Egg Sandwiches and they’re just perfect! For the perfect soft boil eggs with perfectly seasoned egg salad (Jpanese style) and the perfect crispy yet chewy toasties. I also added a perfect combination side of Rocket salad (which is incredibly cheap at 60thb)

The sandwich may seems small at first look, but be warn! It’s packed with 4 eggs, so that keeps me a full tummy whole afternoon.

Ps. This place also offer some selection of coffee and other drinks, tho I had their Thai tea which is also great!

I’ll definitely coming back for their promising egg benedict! And that iced chocolate looks great as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kuang Kobkijcharoen

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited Eggtisan Ari during my short stay in Ari. This is a great place to have a great coffee and a delicious sandwich (I think sandwiches are one of their specialties) in this pleasantly decorated, quiet and relaxing place. The atmosphere is great, and the staff are very friendly and always have a smile.

The menu items are mostly western food/beverages/salads, but I have also seen couple of Thai specialties such as Khao soi (northern Thai coconut curry noodle soup) on the menu.

The salad and Tuna sandwich I had was delicious and quality was great. Also, the coffee (cappuccino) was great. I really enjoyed the food and the time I spent there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neil R

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food here is amazing! I ordered the tonkatsu sandwich and it was perfectly crispy on the outside, juicy inside, and packed with flavor. The bread is soft and fresh, and the sauce ties everything together so well. I also tried their passion fruit smoothie - super refreshing, not too sweet, and topped with mint leaves for a nice touch.

The café has a cozy, minimalist vibe and it’s just a short walk from Ari BTS station, making it really convenient to visit. Definitely one of the best spots around Ari for a quick but satisfying brunch or snack!
sample_reviews_en.author: Romen Samuel Wabina

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a wonderful experience at Eggtisan! We ordered the Breakfast Platter and their popular Egg Sandwich, and both were absolutely delicious. The scrambled eggs were creamy and soft, while the waffle was fluffy, tasty, and perfectly done.

The staff were also incredibly friendly and accommodating. Even though the café was almost full when we arrived, they still managed to arrange a table for us, which we really appreciated.

Overall, it was a great dining experience and we will definitely be coming back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ying Hui

sample_reviews_en.text: The food, service and atmosphere were all 5/5 stars but I’m giving my overall rating a 3/5 because the prices are just outrageous. The sandwiches are very very good but should not be that expensive for something as simple as tuna, egg and mayo… The coffee could’ve been better especially if it costs 125 baht.. Even for a small bottle of water they charge 40 baht!? It’s definitely an overpriced place and I’m sure you could make the same sandwich at home for a quarter of the price just a little less tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jordan Awin

sample_reviews_en.text:
3.8⭐️
We ordered Eggtisan for lunch.
Traffic must’ve been horrible because our order was so late. I got the Tuna and egg salad sandwich, with a salad, a caramel latte, and sourdough bread. The salad did not look appealing so I didn’t take a picture of it. And I just forgot to take a picture of the coffee. I thought the food was good. I would like to eat there and rate them again after eating inside the restaurant. The food was good so I would recommend giving Eggtisan a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: AL Franklin

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had All day breakfast set, coffee, egg tuna sando and strawberry smoothie!

I would say the food was fresh and tasty, best way to start the day! Strawberry smoothie was tasty with appropriate amount of viscosity, sweetness and texture 😋🍓
Staff members were very welcoming, kind, respectful and friendly. We exchanged a couple of laughs as well! Thanks for that.

Would highly recommend people to visit this place once if you come to Bangkok for the ultimate breakfast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ton

restaurants.name: Hinata Izakaya
restaurants.address:

44-26 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food here is absolutely delicious and very reasonably priced. The owner and staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming, and the tea is great too! Amazing value for money and definitely one of the best spots in the Asoke area. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Siriyaporn Dechsen

sample_reviews_en.text: I regularly go there to eat Japanese food. I especially like the fried chicken and udon noodles. For udon, I order the bukkake udon with beef added. It's really delicious and I highly recommend it!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Naoko

sample_reviews_en.text: All the food was delicious, there was a wide variety of menu options, the prices were reasonable, and the staff provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirajira Duangprateep

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was good and the food was delicious. The restaurant isn't very big, it has two floors, and the atmosphere is cozy.
sample_reviews_en.author: koonny

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and affordable. I highly recommend the salt-grilled chicken butts; they're boneless and very tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kim Karun

sample_reviews_en.text: Grilled pork rice tastes very good! And deep fried chicken organs is also very crispy and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: 大树大树是大树

restaurants.name: KC Guesthouse
restaurants.address:

64 Phra Sumen Rd, Chana Songkhram, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
2023 review:

The staff are still very friendly and nice but the stress of everyday definitely has a strong effect on their attention to details etc. Everyone is sweet regardless.

Airport shuttle, laundry etc can be arranged. There is no kitchen or drinking water refill facility. No common area, the cafe is usually busy.

Location is good if you're into staying out late or don't mind a bunch of drunk/ high kids yelling across the road (mad monkey hostel). Unbearable music as well. Awful, just awful.

Some of the guests cannot take care of the shared bathrooms and everything feels dirty. The staff works very hard but maybe getting more staff will help.

Review from July 2023

The staff are super friendly.
The floors & bathrooms were always clean. They were flexible with our needs aswell.

Amazing location

Thank you
sample_reviews_en.author: Lily

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a review for the restaurant. We stayed at a hostel across the street and came here every day, sometimes multiple times per day. We tried nearly half of the menu and everything was superb. The portions are generous and the prices are affordable. Everything is well-seasoned. Our favourite dish was the Khao Soi, but you really can’t go wrong with anything. They are also very accommodating to vegetarians and can make any dish veggie.

The owners are incredibly friendly and welcomed us with a smile every time we walked in. They also have impeccable taste in music, playing jazz, Beatles, and Bob Dylan. This is the type of place where you immediately feel at home. Can’t recommend this place more!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lucas Morissette

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hello all.
This place is really cool to stay.
We were their first  Mauritians customers 🇲🇺. At the reception they speak in English and try their best to communicate. Even though the elderly staff tried to! The rooms were smelling pleasant and fresh bedsheets. Washroom always cleaned as well.

More positive side, there’s 7/11 store infront, it’s near to Khao San Road and nearer to the water ferry to go to Wat Arun/Grand Palace and all the main stops.
And they have their own cosy restaurant where you’ll find authentic Thai food and some international food too.

Cool memory and pleasant stay there for one week! :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Koumaressen Palanee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The attached restaurant is very unassuming. I loved everything and was actually impressed which is rare for a snob like me. Good clean generous nourishing servings. A wonderful and comfortable  balance of flavours which is very rare.

One thing I particularly loved - there was no overwhelming amount of MSG in any dish. We could actually taste the food, spices and herbs! A masterful chef, incredibly lovely attentive staff, and flowers!

70-100 Baht a dish, average price 80 baht. The value is exceptional. A true diamond in the area.

KC guesthouse restaurant. Top notch!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr Jones

sample_reviews_en.text:
We absolutely loved our stay here!
We booked it for our first 2 nights in Bangkok before heading up to Chiang Mai and oh my goodness, this family are so amazing! They are so kind, will help you with anything and suggest places to go. We ate here too and the food is INSANE the royal Thai pineapple fried rice was amazing! They even gave us little lollipops each day and we also got free fresh fruit, they are so kind and so welcoming. You’ve made our first 2 days in Thailand amazing thank you 🙏💓
sample_reviews_en.author: Dani W

sample_reviews_en.text: KC Guesthouse Restaurant delivers perfection on every plate. Every dish we tried was flawless, bursting with flavor and expertly prepared. The service was impressively quick, ensuring we were well taken care of throughout our meal. With no complaints at all, it's clear that KC Guesthouse Restaurant sets a high standard for excellence in both food and service. If you're looking for a dining experience that exceeds expectations, look no further than KC Guesthouse Restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Isaac

sample_reviews_en.text: Writing this review after 1 week stay at KC guesthouse (still 1 week to go). Just a big thank you to all the amazing staff who are making our stay just perfect. The food is perfect, we love it so much that we don’t even feel the need to look around for a different restaurant! From the smoothies to the soups, everything is so tasty and so well presented! Portions are big and very well priced! Thank you guys for making our trip so special and memorable!
sample_reviews_en.author: Gianmarco Fochetti

sample_reviews_en.text: Location is very good, close to shops and popular streets. its easy to go anywhere with public transportation from guesthouse. There is also a restaurant downstairs which has tasty food and drinks. We stayed in standart room with shared bathroom, and it was also practical and comfortable. Totally recommended, clean and safe place to stay. We can definitely stay again when we come back to Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sevinç Durgut
