restaurants.address:

69/4 Phra Suli Alley, Wat Bowon Niwet, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
We came across this place last night and it is safe to say that this food was some of the best food we have ever had. The owner was very accommodating and not a single bad thing to say about the food, it was just delicious! Very reasonably priced food for the 3 of us!

อาหารอร่อยสุดยอดเลยค่ะ!
sample_reviews_th.author: Jessica Challender

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here specifically to try this place and was pleasantly surprised! 😊
The atmosphere is warm and friendly, like having a meal at a friend's house, but the food is seriously delicious and authentically Thai. The ingredients are fresh and high-quality.

The dishes I ordered had well-balanced flavors, not too sweet, and the aroma of the curry spices was very strong and clear. You can tell they pay attention to detail. It was a bit slow to get our food during peak hours, but it was worth the wait. The service was polite and attentive.

It's perfect for a family meal or for introducing authentic Thai food to foreign friends.
If you like rich, flavorful Thai food, I highly recommend trying it at least once. 🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: Kotchaporn Namonta

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recommend the fried beef; it's delicious and inexpensive. It's medium-rare picanha beef in a savory, salty sauce, served with a tangy ponzu-like dipping sauce. It's perfect with hot steamed rice.
Another recommended dish is the stir-fried Gnetum leaves with egg. They stir-fry it dry, with a salty flavor from the dried shrimp, but the sweet and sour pickled garlic balances it perfectly.

Other dishes were just okay; I've had better Southern Thai food elsewhere.

There's no parking. If you're lucky, you might find a spot on the street, or you can park at Wat Bowon and walk – it's less than a 5-minute walk.
sample_reviews_en.author: ร่มโพธิ์ หงศ์ลดารมภ์

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best meals of my life. Genuinely I think I’ll be talking about this for the rest of my life, I’m telling everyone who’s planning a trip to Bangkok they have to visit BaanTye ! Couldn’t recommend enough. I’ve been 2 times, first time I had the crispy fish with rice (so delicious), second time we had the whole crispy fish with garlic, egg fried rice and Chinese broccoli. Ask for the spicy seafood sauce to come with the fish (pictured green) - it was unbelievably good. I want to eat here every night.
sample_reviews_en.author: Isabel MacRae

sample_reviews_en.text: Our first order of business on Vday weekend. The reviews did not disappoint. Really good food. The Picanha fried beef was cooked and seasoned perfectly. It goes well with the Southern Thai Spicy Rice Salad with Crab Meat, which had plenty of crab meat, fat, and roe. We also ordered the Stir-fry shrimp with chaom and salted egg yolk. But the first two would’ve been enough, paired with a bottle (or two) of Thai beer. We’ll be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kathrina Dizon

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a very good dinner last night at BaanTye restaurant. Unfortunetally this restaurant ceases to exist. The restaurant caretakers informed us and we were only one of the last guests. It is petty because the food was excellent and the atmosfeer was lively and inviting. Let's remember this place as one of the jewels of what was there to be and let's not forget.

We enjoyed and hope of the rebirth of BaanTye restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Friso Albada

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wish there was a 10 star review for this place. They deserve it. Our party of  9 was treated with the freshest gourmet food in BKK ( all 10 plus dishes were delicious and just kept getting tastier ) . The food just kept coming ; so busy eating and enjoying we didn’t get pictures of all the food.Than to top it off with some of best homemade ice cream
Awe ,life doesn’t get any better! Try it you won’t be disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Cathy Cianci

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ate here 4 times during our stay in Bangkok and each time was amazing! I will miss this restaurant and its food.

Their crispy fish is amazing, on its own or served with fried rice. If you request seafood sauce it compliments the fish so well! We loved everything we ate here. The service was also great, the host is very welcoming and kind.

Would recommend this place to everyone visiting Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Emma Mulligan

restaurants.name: Sakkwa สัก-กะ-วา
restaurants.address:

4th floor 839, ร้านสักกะวา ชั้น, 4 ถ. เจริญกรุง Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Food: Superb, everything was very well thought out and flavors blended incredibly well together.

Service: Warm, friendly, Khun Nam made an already 10/10 dinner even better. Thailand hospitality to its finest.

Recommended dishes
- ผักโอซุ่น
- The icecream (sadly I forgot the name)

Everything we ordered was fantastic, just these two really stood out.
sample_reviews_th.author: taraa k

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sakkawa is truly a hidden gem in Bangkok. From the moment you step in, everything feels thoughtfully curated from the ambiance, plating, to the flavor journey.

The menu combines creativity with comfort, elevating Thai ingredients into fine-dining style dishes. Every plate is beautifully presented like art, but more importantly, the taste exceeds expectations. Some highlights for me:
•	Braised pork with rich dark sauce — melt-in-your-mouth, deeply flavorful.
•	Duck and beef dishes — cooked perfectly medium rare, paired with sauces that balance richness and acidity.
•	Crispy rolls with edible flowers — a delightful mix of texture and fragrance.
•	Desserts like baked sweet potato with brûléed top, coconut ice cream, and pumpkin soft serve — playful, nostalgic, and so satisfying.

What makes the experience even more special is watching the chef prepare dishes with passion in the open kitchen. Service is attentive but relaxed, making it easy to enjoy both food and conversation.

I’ll definitely come back again (and again). Highly recommended for anyone who loves food that tells a story and surprises you in every bite. 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Janejira Phurekanokrat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sakkwa really is a new rare gem where elevated Thai cooking feels both inviting and nostalgic.

When its fine dining predecessor Kavee closed its doors, it felt like years of hushed anticipation until Sakkwa finally made its debut! Sakkwa isn’t just Kavee reborn, it’s something more open and welcoming now serving only la carte fare (no more prix fixe) with portions that genuinely satisfy.

Old Kavee signatures made their triumphant return: the sticky rice-stuffed chicken wings are as beautifully comforting as I remembered, and the legendary 14-day dry-aged Khao Yai duck with its crispy skin and rich juicy flavors remain a standout!

I want to really emphasize that Sakkwa is not defined by its revival of old classics. You’ll find a medley of new signatures like the grilled kurobuta pork skewers paired with a bold wondrous fermented fish dip that blew me away.

From starters through dessert, every dish we ordered was a masterpiece that’s guaranteed not to leave any foodie disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Adiwid Devahastin Na Ayudhya

sample_reviews_en.text:
An amazing dining experience at Sakkwa.

I visited Sakkwa yesterday and absolutely loved it. The food was outstanding: fresh, flavorful, and beautifully balanced. We were served incredibly fresh fish, perfectly cooked beef, juicy prawns, pork, and a rich chicken curry paired with a spicy Thai salad, all executed with great precision.

One of the highlights was the dessert: pineapple ice cream with a subtle coffee flavor, unexpected and delicious.

The concept of playful yet precise Thai cuisine really comes through in every dish. You can feel the chef’s Michelin-level experience, but the atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming, making it easy to truly enjoy the food.

Highly recommend for anyone looking for modern Thai cuisine done with creativity and soul. Will definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kate Bass

sample_reviews_en.text:
An exceptional dining experience at SAKKWA from start to finish. The food was thoughtful, beautifully executed, and full of depth — every dish felt carefully curated with impressive balance and creativity. The atmosphere was elegant yet welcoming, making the entire evening feel relaxed and memorable.

A special thank you to Nam, our server, who truly elevated the experience. Warm, attentive, knowledgeable, and incredibly gracious throughout the meal, Nam made us feel genuinely cared for without ever being intrusive. His recommendations were spot on, and his attention to detail added such a personal touch to the evening.

Hospitality like this is rare and deserves recognition. Looking forward to returning again soon.
Congratulations to Chef Tae and SAKKWA !
sample_reviews_en.author: stephanie Lim

sample_reviews_en.text:
We originally planned to visit one of the so-called 'top-tier' buffets in Bangkok on the evening of Jan 17th, but changing plans to dine at Sakkwa with friends turned out to be one of the best decisions I've ever made.

We ordered the duck and the fish, and the execution was flawless—the cooking temperature was controlled to perfection. The duck was the absolute highlight of the night for me; the meat was incredibly tender, but the skin was perfectly crispy. It was truly amazing and definitely my No. 1 dish!

All the appetizers were delicious as well, and the sparkling wine recommended to us was outstanding. This was truly a fantastic dining experience. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kurt Zhou

sample_reviews_en.text: Great discovery in the most hip area of BKK. Loved everything on the menu. We tried almost every dish and even some twice. Great vegetarian options also. K Noon and K Nam were taking very well care of us. Chef Tae even stopped at our table for a chat. Overall a very positive experience with an extremely friendly team that is living attention to detail to the fullest. We highly recommend Sakkwa to everyone that loves food that burst with flavour! My absolute favourite was the Crispy chive  Dumplings and you must try the Stir-fried celtuce stems with mushroom ragu. Also don’t miss the Fried Shimeji mushroom;) Loved everything! Need to come back for more soon! Thank you ka!
sample_reviews_en.author: Angie L-S

sample_reviews_en.text:
While scrolling through reels one evening, I stumbled upon a glowing recommendation from a renowned Thai chef who described this spot as a true hidden gem. I booked our reservation instantly for our upcoming trip to Bangkok.
It ended up being our very first meal in the city, and it completely blew us away! The standout dish for me was the marinated raw tiger prawns served in fresh kaffir lime cups — unbelievably fresh, vibrant, and packed with deep umami flavor. Every bite felt special. Our server Nam was such a sweet heart and wonderfully hospitable.

I can’t recommend this restaurant highly enough. If you’re heading to Bangkok, make sure to add it to your list!
sample_reviews_en.author: ashleyashley t

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had visited a couple of times before I decided never to come back. There is a Thai lady there who speaks English extremely well; she is awesome and provides great customer service. She always charged the right price for the food—always 100% correct.
​Today, however, she wasn't there, and a young, tall man was running the place. When I wanted to pay, he quoted 20 THB more than he should have. It's not about the money, but the principle. He destroyed the great impression I had previously. Shame on him.
sample_reviews_en.author: Łukasz S.

sample_reviews_en.text: It's close to the hotel, but I kept putting it off because it was a hassle, so I finally ate there on the last day. I had the chicken fried rice and Som Tum, and both were delicious. Since the owner cooks everything by himself, the dishes are served one by one. If you order multiple items, it will probably take some time. If you're in the area, you should definitely come and try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: 댕댕

sample_reviews_en.text: We stay just across Auntie's restaurant. This is where we always eat our lunch and dinner during our two weeks of stay here! We love her cooking and the price is very affordable! My husband and I are very delighted by her generosity and kindness and of course, her delicious food! Thank you Auntie for our fabulous meals! We love you! 💋💋💋
sample_reviews_en.author: tupaz michael (Mhike Tupaz)

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place for local, great value food. The food was exceptional and there was a wide range of choice of traditional Thai food at a local price. The family who run it are friendly, kind and great with kids. I would definitely visit here again and recommend it to anyone else visiting. Portions are generous and it is a real hidden gem!
sample_reviews_en.author: TC

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was fooled by the reviews.

The pork had an unpleasant smell, and the food was just spicy and tasteless.

The prices also seem to have gone up by about 50% compared to the menu shown in the Google Maps photos.

This is the first time I have left more than half of my food uneaten at a local restaurant I've visited recently.
sample_reviews_en.author: 이현석

sample_reviews_en.text: A proper Bangkok street food experience! The hostess welcomed us with open arms, cooked some of the best food we’ve had here and let us chill and have a few beers to accompany our meal. Cooked right there and then in front of you with local workers coming for their lunch, the true Bangkok feel is tangible. A must visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: James

sample_reviews_en.text: A small local Thai restaurant located in front of NIST International School. The owner, Amourjuni, doubles as the chef and is friendly. Since it is a one-person restaurant, it takes some time after ordering, but I recommend it for its above-average taste. I especially recommend the spicy basil pork stir-fry deep rice.

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the pork with basil rice, but it was a little lacking in flavor. The woman who made it was a wonderful person. There weren't enough seats, so they made a seat for me next to the trash can across from me, but the smell from the trash can was so strong that I couldn't eat there.


27 โรงแรมนิกโก้ ชั้น 3 Thong Lo, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Not the fanciest dim sum restaurant but everything was solid - delicious and well executed. We couldn’t find fault with anything we ate. The food came quickly and the attention to detail with service (tea pouring for example) was exceptional. Very fair priced for what it is.

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place for tasty Chinese food with the group of family or friends. Their dim sum are very tasty and quite fast service.   The staff are quick on their feet and always looking over our table to ensure that everyone glass always full no matter the beverage.

sample_reviews_en.text: I never see that we comming at 8.45 we order full red duck and after 20 minutes restaurant say now we closing. We need take food for take away. 2400B for 2 pax . And 35 minutes sit. Oh i forget when staff put food for take away he do …
sample_reviews_en.author: KeV DCT (SPAW8)

sample_reviews_en.text: A clean and yummy chinese restaurant located in nikko hotel. Excellent peking duck with a good promotion on mon-thurs. when you order duck, you can also pick how they cook the meat so u’ll get two dishes (i recommend the minced duck …
sample_reviews_en.author: Arch W

sample_reviews_en.text: The food at this Chinese restaurant is a perfect blend of bold flavors, with just the right amount of spice for a Thai palate. The service is excellent, and the restaurant is remarkably clean and quiet, providing a relaxing dining …
sample_reviews_en.author: Siwa Ong

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing food, me and my friend were looking for a place late at night, 2am to be exact. We took a chance on this place and we didn’t regret it, amazing food, service and hospitality. God bless Ram and Solay. Godblessroyal kitchen.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Nwamadi

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice place to eat dinner. Good service and very tasty food. We loved the Peking Duck and the Crab Meat Sweetcorn soup was amazing. We will definitely come back with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Parada S

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best Pekking duck in town. We  tried this, using the promotion of 50% for the duck during Mon to Thurs. What we ordered a lot for 3.  But all was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Le Thi Huong Lien

restaurants.name: Jae Phon Lang Lerdsin
restaurants.address:

409, 11 ซอย Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
What is not like about street food in Thailand! 🇹🇭

I have seen this on so many street corners and I’ve never tried it before ! A friend of mine saw this place and he really wanted to go so we decided to try it out today together as an adventure!!

Small portions come with unlimited rice but those portions are not small they’re very deceiving they packing a lot of pork leg in there and wow it was so delicious especially with the raw garlic green chili and of course this green sort of veggie that you put on it and a ton of hot sauce !!

I devoured mine in a second it was so good and it was so filling !! I also did the braised duck 🦆 leg 🦵 with rice Takeaway I can’t wait to have that for dinner tonight!

I would highly recommend to go here it is behind the Lerdsin hospital 🏥 you can sit on the street and have it in their typical classic street food style so awesome of Bangkok!

Follow Fauzia for more amazing food reviews in Bangkok street food to Michelin star ⭐️ we do it all !!

You can follow us on all of our platform such as TikTok YouTube or video content of course and our Instagram stories and reels !! 🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Follow Fauzia

sample_reviews_en.text:
Je Phorn's Braised Pork Leg Restaurant, behind Lerdsin Hospital, is a famous braised pork leg restaurant in this area.
The braised pork leg is delicious, the meat is tender, and the broth isn't too sweet. The highlight of the restaurant is the kajak, which is very hard to find elsewhere. Today I tried the kajak, which is braised pork leg with tendons and skin, but the restaurant adds extra meat. It tasted really good, and you can refill your rice unlimitedly. The price is also good; all this for 90 baht for rice and braised pork leg.
Come early in the morning to avoid waiting, as the restaurant opens at 6 am and it's not crowded. Good food at an affordable price.
The restaurant is open every day...located behind Lerdsin Hospital, near Central Bangrak.
sample_reviews_en.author: ChubbyArin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Friendly Staffs That Took e Order, However, I'm Quite Disappointed w e Food.

Pork Leg Sauce - Too Sweet (Maybe Unique & Different From e Rest)
Rice - Not Fragrant That You Will Yearn For A 2nd or 3rd Plate (Not As Reported In Social Media For "Unlimited Rice Serving" Too Or Maybe For Locals Only
Duck - Tasteless
Sides - No Comment

Not Even As Good As What I Had Earlier Along Pratunum Street & Sabx2.

I Personally Feel Not Worth Travelling Over For Unless Staying Around e Corner.

Slightly Overrated Through Social Media!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: iamafoodtaster

sample_reviews_en.text: How could a middle-aged female employee talk like that? Whatever frustration she had, don't take it out on the customers. We don't know you; your job is to take orders, that's it. Don't meddle in other people's affairs so much. Acting like you're feeding a dog, you shouldn't be an employee. I'm showing respect to the restaurant here because the food was really delicious. The other employees were very nice; it was just that one old woman who didn't fit in.
sample_reviews_en.author: DD

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stunning, fatty, gelatinous goodness, not for the faint-hearted.

This is likely as local as it gets. A huge pot of pork cuts simmering away by the street beckons you. When that plate of pork comes, go straight for the fatty bits because it’s so flavourful and that texture is absolutely beautiful. There’s still a great bite to it without falling apart completely. Eat with the tangy chili dip to switch it up.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lavinia

sample_reviews_en.text:
One sentence : must try !
When you pass by, you can just tell that this place is something else. Massive portions with delicious pork legs. If you’re not used to eating pork legs, you might be a bit scared, but please, try it! You will find a new flavour!
Amazing service, and they try to look after foreign customers as well… so sweet! Thank you so much staffs and the lovely lady!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rani Kim

sample_reviews_en.text: Actually, the taste of jokbal rice bowl is similar no matter where you go, but personally, I think this place is better than that famous place. If you order a small at that place, it's just bones and chicken, but this place has a lot of meat and even gives you side dishes like garlic, peppers, and pickled cabbage. However, the rice(?) at both places is not that great.
sample_reviews_en.author: LEE

sample_reviews_en.text: The best place for khao kha moo in the area. We decided to go here than other more popular places in the area and we were not disappointed. Amazing hospitality, many different sizes of knuckle to choose from for varying prices. Rich and flavourful, melt in your mouth meat. Check out our channel for a full review of our experience: Hungry Two Travel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hungry Two Travel

restaurants.name: AKART Bistro & Bar
restaurants.address:

30 Yen Akat Rd, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to the cafe today and waited for a sandwich for almost an hour without being informed that they needed to wait for ingredients or that it would take this long. The sandwich looked really ugly and tasted bad; too much sauce, like they rushed to make it, and the bread wasn't toasted at all.

I ordered both a drink and a sandwich but had to wait almost an hour for the sandwich. I asked twice if it was ready, without any prior notification that they needed to wait for shrimp from the restaurant. When it finally arrived, it looked and tasted terrible. There was way too much sauce, it didn't look like the picture on the menu, and the bread wasn't toasted or anything.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neen Destination Beauty

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm so confused. I came to the restaurant wanting to order a T-bone steak, and I understand that they were out of T-bone. But they didn't have any other meats, no foie gras, no truffle pasta, no butterfly pea pasta, no oysters, no lamb, no shrimp fritters, and many other things. This is unacceptable. And the staff told me to come back, but I will never come back here again. It was a terrible experience. I can understand if three or four items were out of stock, but being out of everything in the restaurant is something I've never experienced before. I came to this restaurant specifically for the T-bone steak, but I'm extremely disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panita

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place used to be super crowded and people came for a photoshoots. Now the place is surprisingly quiet.

My latest experience there was not quite pleasant though the food are good.

1) there is a sign around the place to prohibited the customer to do many stuff with a fine. I found it mean for the restaurant owner to do such a post like that (see the photo I shared from the toilet mirror)

2) The staffs (3 of them) are looking like an active listener on the conversation I had with my friends there. It causes an awkward moment.

3) the menu is inserted into a flimsy sheets which make it supeyhard to read in the restaurant lighting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pisith Thanasaethsakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice and relaxing atmosphere situated in quiet area. There are many parking lots available.

There are 2 separated areas; Akart restaurant and Akart Day (which is café style).

We ordered many items at Akart day, which mostly served brunch, breakfast, drink, and dessert at this place. So if you want to enjoy simple food and dessert with cozy vibes, this place is for you.

However, we have tried sandwiches and other brunch menus which surely are tasty, but not that unique. Other menus are okay, but don’t see anything special or something worth coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: KOKO

sample_reviews_en.text:
- many dishes on the menu are not available, which seem to be a common complaints from other reviewers as well
- the food is expensive for the quality they serve: pizzas are 500-800 bht, and are terrible. For that same prize, you get excellent pizzas in Bangkok
- bread is frozen, comes toasted, and is hard and dry
- ordered the pan fried foie gras: big mistake, over cooked and dry, tasteless
- not worth reviewing other dishes

Business is tough, but it’s not an excuse to rip off customers. We were the only table on a Saturday for lunch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ariya Banomyong

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a relaxed atmosphere with spacious, comfortable tables and cool air conditioning. They have a good selection of wines. The food is flavorful, light and not overly spicy. The meat is excellent, especially the lamb shank. The fresh pasta is delicious, perfectly seasoned. The desserts are also great, though there might be a bit of a wait, as the Thai rice balls in coconut milk are made fresh in-house by the chef – soft, chewy, and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kengman ...

sample_reviews_en.text: Came here for breakfast. Quite a distance walk with no proper pavement so best to take a taxi. Ordered their English breakfast ( two suns) & the pancake. Its delicious & well presented. Mocha was good as well.  But in terms of sitting area,  I would recommend to avoid sitting at the area with the strong Aircon! Also,  they do not accept cash (cashless) but luckily because I am a tourist, they accepted it 😅 I guess not much tourists come here??
sample_reviews_en.author: May K

sample_reviews_en.text: Good pricey coffee with unimpressive service. We bought 2 coffee drinks that cost around 300 sth. THB. We asked for 2 free tiny glasses of non iced drinking water. The barista gave us one and refuse to give another glass to us and said that they actually sold a bottle of drinking water in our cafe... Oh.. such a bad service attitude. Even a small cafe, which their drink is 2 times less expensive than u offer a free drinking water to customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tongjai D.

restaurants.name: Panda King
restaurants.address:

80, 5 Chula 46, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Unexpected find! Escaped the heat for Aircon and was blown away by how much we loved the food. Phad mee Hong Kong was really amazing. The fried dumplings and xiao long bao are also a pleasant foodie find! We will be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: R T

sample_reviews_en.text: When I think of Chinese food, this is usually the first restaurant that comes to mind because the taste is delicious and it's a flavor I really like. I think Thai people would enjoy this kind of taste as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: panupong yomruang

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the portions are generous, and there's plenty of seating. It's within walking distance from Sam Yan MRT station. Don't miss the french fries!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanida Phutthiwachananon

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old restaurant; I ate here a long time ago. The tomato fries were delicious, with a sweet flavor. The garlic stir-fried beans were tasty, a bit salty. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Baitong

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been searching for so long and finally found it in Samyan. It's incredibly delicious, especially the eggplant fries; it's my absolute favorite!
sample_reviews_en.author: Krissada Kuan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. I'm impressed every time I eat here. The eggplant fries are crispy and so enjoyable to eat. I give it a perfect 10/10! 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: New

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the staff provided excellent service with friendly smiles, and the restaurant was spacious. It was great!
sample_reviews_en.author: POPPY

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the flavors were great, the ingredients were fresh, and the service was friendly. I was very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tapfa V

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวตำลึงนายอ้วน
restaurants.address:

61/2-3 Bang Khun Non Rd, Bang Khun Non, บางขุนนนท์ Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Not very pleasant seating however the noodle menu especially เส้นเล็กต้มยำแห้ง is by far one of the best in Bangkok. Parking is not easy to find, recommend avoiding peak hours.

Restaurant offers assorted rice menu and ready to buy takeaways.
sample_reviews_th.author: Aom McViboon

sample_reviews_th.text: Well-organized, good service, fast queue, incredibly cheap prices. Rice with curry starts at 30฿ per plate. Parking is available on the sidewalk.
sample_reviews_th.author: Sakura Midori

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, but...the owners are almost all grumpy and scold their staff.
The owner's daughter-in-law, who is quite pretty, has terrible manners.
I used to go there 2-3 times a month with relatives and friends, and I've recommended it to many people.
Now I'm done with them. All my relatives agreed it was terrible.
The incident was over just one bottle of water.

When it was time to pay, I said I returned one bottle of water. The waiter brought me eight bottles, and they replaced it with chrysanthemum tea. They called a staff member over to ask and confirm. When the staff member confirmed it, they scolded them, calling three other staff members to scold them in front of me. I told them to count the bottles if they didn't believe me, but they still insisted someone took it. I said, "Just charge me if you don't believe me." It was just one bottle of water, but they were still unhappy, shaking their head and making a sour face. I'm not sure if they were trying to show off or what. We were a group of 10 and the bill was 1,400 baht. They wouldn't even lose money on one bottle of water!

But now I'm done with them. I'm never going back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nanda Nonchayawit

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a noodle shop that serves incredibly flavorful Tom Yum soup. I've been eating here since my student days, and I still drop by occasionally. Honestly, it's one of the few places where I can eat noodles without adding any extra seasoning. The aroma of chili and peanuts is amazing, the sourness of lime is perfect, and the sweetness of the minced pork is delightful. The offal is incredibly fresh and not at all gamey. However, despite all the praise for the noodles, I have to say their curry rice dishes are even better than the noodles! And if you want noodles, you have to queue! Is it crowded? No! They're just slow!!! Haha! Just kidding! 555+ It's just that it's almost always crowded. I highly recommend the green curry with beef – it's insanely delicious. Anyone who's tried it will understand. The stir-fried eggplant with beef is incredibly sweet, and the tamarind chili paste is another must-try. It's extremely crowded during lunchtime, so I recommend setting up a tent and waiting! 555+
sample_reviews_en.author: hispeed design

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the portions are generous, making it good value for money. However, there's one issue: the staff were very unwilling to serve. Around the end of May, I went to buy rice and curry in a container in the evening with two friends. We spent about five minutes choosing our dishes and asked the staff how much each item cost, specifically how much for two dishes in a container, or how much for one dish. We asked about 3-4 menu items. One staff member made a face as if they didn't want to serve us. I'm not sure if they went to another staff member, but then they looked at us with a condescending gaze. It was a very unpleasant look. We quickly bought our food and left. I don't know if the staff member was tired or what. Overall, the food was delicious and worth the price, but the staff's judgmental attitude was a major drawback.
sample_reviews_en.author: อริศรา ไชยสุวรรณ

sample_reviews_en.text:
This noodle shop serves various curries, including a wide selection of dishes.

I only tried the noodles today, not the curry rice.
I ordered a small dry noodle dish with spicy dressing.
It was very well made, perfectly seasoned, and delicious without needing any extra additions.
The offal pieces were large and odorless.
I also ordered crispy wontons to go with it, which was a good combination. The wontons were perfectly crispy and not rancid.

The prices are standard.
There were a lot of customers, but the flow was good when I went; I didn't have to wait for a table, and the food didn't take long to arrive.
I'll try the curry rice next time.
Parking is available on the street in front of the shop; find a spot, or park a little further away and walk, as it's really busy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichsaran Ves

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum soup was incredibly delicious! It was perfectly balanced with just the right amount of sourness and sweetness – no need to add anything. The offal had no unpleasant smell at all, which was fantastic. The price was also very reasonable. The curry rice dishes were good too, but I forgot to take pictures. I ordered the stir-fried shrimp with stink beans and got a really big shrimp! There's usually a bit of a queue for the curry rice, but it's not too long. The prices are quite wide depending on what you order, but it's worth it because the portions are generous. The restaurant atmosphere is okay; it's clean and not hot because there are lots of fans. You have to find parking along the roadside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cygne E.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely delicious noodle soup! The broth is rich and flavorful — not too salty, not too oily. The noodles are perfectly chewy, and the pork and meatballs are really tasty. The fresh ivy gourd leaves (tumleung) add a nice balance to the flavor.

Prices are very reasonable, and one bowl is just enough to fill you up. The place is clean, the service is quick, and the owner is super friendly and welcoming.

Highly recommend trying the dry noodles with tumleung or the mixed pork soup! A must-try spot if you’re in the area! 🍜
sample_reviews_en.author: pare_cetamol

restaurants.name: Bangkok Banjom
restaurants.address:

Thailand, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon, Watthana, Bangkok, Soi Sukhumvit 63

sample_reviews_en.text:
Bangkok Banjom is the definition of a hidden gem in Bangkok. It’s literally hidden in some random building next to the Civic Hotel so it took a while to find the entrance.

My wife and I ordered a jjajangmyeon upsized and a plate of tang suyuk to share.

First thing to comment on is that the portions are HUGE. If you’re eating by yourself the upsize isn’t even necessary.

For me, the main thing that really sold the food was the quality of the noodles. They were chewy and bouncy with every bite, even when mixed thoroughly with the sauce.

Apart from this, the jjajang sauce was so generously filled with pork meat. It was very unlike other jjajangmyeons i have had whereby the sauce would be mainly potatoes with just a little bit of meat.

The tang su yuk was delicious as well - each slice was evenly battered with an amazing meat to batter ratio (it was mostly meat). The sauce was a good balance of sweet and tangy, and not to mention the generous portion size as well.

10/10 recommend to anyone going to Bangkok. If you didn’t like jjajangmyeon like myself, you will love the dish after eating here 🔥
sample_reviews_en.author: Tze Shiuan Kong

sample_reviews_en.text:
After all, this isn't Korea.

The Burmese chef managed to achieve a 98% similar taste, which is already fantastic.

It's delicious.

For this price, it's a great restaurant.

Some reviews complained it was too salty and the noodles weren't mixed properly. Otherwise, please ask the restaurant to use less salt.

The iSung restaurant I used to frequent has changed a bit. It's so great to have found this place that serves jajangmyeon and seafood noodles.

The staff were very friendly and helpful.

There's water, Wi-Fi, and air conditioning. The high ceilings make it very comfortable to sit in.

Unfortunately, they don't have half seafood noodles and half jajangmyeon. Next time, I want to try dumplings, sweet and sour pork, and mapo tofu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Huang Keiko

sample_reviews_en.text:
Not recommended to go at 3pm because the resto closed from 3:30-5pm. I went at 3:05pm and rushed myself badly. The waitress get off from worked punctually. I had my leftover food packed and left at 3:35pm. Am not sure because I walked in late or not but the cashier seems cold.

Shrimp fried rice has nice aroma from the wok but tasteless and the shrimp is the cheap frozen type. I asked waitress if the combo comes with janjanmian. I misunderstood that it would come with noodle but its not. Another dish is lemon creme shrimp sauce. They use a better quality of shrimp and bigger size. Taste sweet but delish. Better eat fresh cook coz they r batter deep fried. It becomes socky if u pack home. Overall i prefer other dishes i tried before.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rath S

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is run by a Korean. Design is simple and clean. Not many tables but it is full when we went for a Sunday lunch. Water and appetizers are at free flow as the same as other authentic Korean restaurants. The price listed on the menu is net price without surcharge.

The dishes are hot and delicious. The portion is very big. The ice cream cooler outside the restaurant is also interesting.

The Thai staff provided not so good services.  However the Korean is very nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: J Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the restaurant that makes the most delicious Jjajangmyeon in Bangkok. Other menu items, jjamppong and sweet and sour pork are also delicious. However, I think Jjajangmyeon is their signature dish. And my son and daughter also love Jjajangmyeon. The staff are very friendly, and the restaurant is hygienically well maintained. This is a restaurant recommended to Thai people in Bangkok.👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Junie S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing... i dont think you could find a better Korean-Chinese restaurant than this place even in Korea or elsewhere. Hands down the best chef & dishes. Will definitely come back to Bangkok for this restaurant. 👍👍👍

Recommended menu?

CHADOL JJAMPONG (Spicy Noddle soup with beef brisket)
JENGBAN JJA JANG MYEON (Stir-fry blackbean noodle)
TANG SU YUK (Sweet & Sour Pork)
sample_reviews_en.author: Joon Young Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: First visit, and what a great first impression. The Jja Jang myeon delivered perfectly chewy noodles with a rich, flavorful sauce. But the Jjam pong completely stole the spotlight. Its broth was deep, fragrant, and bursting with flavor—comforting, bold, and memorable. Definitely a dish I’ll be craving again. Tang Su Yuk was okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornchanok Phueadphokaew

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered black bean noodles with pork, but what I received was a seafood mix. I asked for the pork again, but the staff she told to the kitchen, "Just take out the seafood for me." What if someone else has a seafood allergy? Wouldn't they have to make a new dish for them? Thai staff this restaurant service so terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bunny Bun

restaurants.name: Fish Head Tang Chua Li
restaurants.address:

2216 Khao Lam Rd, Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has air conditioning.
The tables and dishes are clean.
There are many staff members providing attentive service.
The menu has pictures, although not for every item, but there are staff members who can recommend dishes.
The food arrived quickly and was hot, ready to eat.
The seafood ingredients were very fresh.
The taste of the food was quite bland or only salty.
Fried and stir-fried dishes had a rancid smell from old oil.
The atmosphere wasn't very friendly to first-time customers. My family and I ate there for the first time, and it will probably be our last.

Some staff members had unpleasant manners. Because we had a foreigner with us, we asked about the cleanliness of the ice.

***I understand that other Thai or foreign customers may not have had this problem or never reported it, but the foreigner we had wanted to know if they should consume the ice because they had a flight back to their country the next day and didn't want them to get sick on the plane. If the staff had informed us that the ice was supplied by an ice supplier, we could have avoided the ice and only drank water.***

The total bill was over 2000 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuthika Prior

sample_reviews_en.text:
The chicken fried rice portion is enough for 2-3 people, costing several hundred baht. Every baht I ate was filled with the taste of old, rancid oil.
The shrimp spring rolls (4 pieces for 150 baht) tasted and smelled awful; if a dog smelled them, it would run away for its life. Plus, the shrimp were the size of a Barbie doll's finger. The Tom Yum soup (450 baht) was so bad that the staff asked me three times if it was delicious. The first sip... My God! Even the water flowing through a nail salon's drain was more appetizing. And I even asked for it spicy! It was so strange. Normally, chicken with cashew nuts should be sweet and sour, but this place seemed afraid of iodine deficiency. And the garlic pork... excuse me, was that fried or steamed? It was completely unappetizing.
I'm so confused about how different the taste is from before.
The staff's attitude was like they'd forgotten all manners.
The owner seemed to be using the brain of a 4-year-old with special needs.
There was absolutely no "In charge" attitude. In total, spending over two thousand baht felt like throwing my hard-earned money down the toilet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Praewa Ekpornpisal

sample_reviews_en.text:
Last week, we took a trip to please our parents 🥰, and this restaurant was one of the places my dad requested.

Of course, we had to try the fish head hot pot, but since we don't like fish heads, we opted for the fish fillets instead. They have sea bass or grouper, and four soup bases to choose from: cabbage, taro, plum & ginger, and tom yum.

We chose the fried grouper with taro soup: the fish was good, and the soup was okay.

Sashimi (Hoo Sae): Another dish we saw many reviews for, so we decided to try it. We think the sesame seeds made it tastier. Be careful of bones though, as some might get stuck in your food.

Braised pork tendon: The tendons were soft and plentiful, and it came with shrimp and shiitake mushrooms. The sauce was a bit too strong.

Spicy pickled mustard greens salad: We didn't try it, but my mom said it was bland 😅

Overall, the taste of the food wasn't quite to our liking. The service was quite fast (there were only two tables occupied when we went), and they kept refilling our water.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kung S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Travelled around talat noi and happened to see this fish head restaurant.
Fish head steamboat - hearty soup, fresh fish. The one in the menu comes with tiny bones at the side. We are not good in deboning so we normally prefer to have seabass. Not sure if we can choose type of fish.
Deep fried prawn roll /hei zhor - good, compliment well with the sweet sauce.
Service - attentive servers, consistently walk around to keep lookout on customers' needs such as adding soup to the steamboat or changing bowl/plate (if needed).
sample_reviews_en.author: N (Princess)

sample_reviews_en.text: AUTHENTIC Chinese Teochew cooking, with TRADITIONAL dishes that hardly found in any modern restaurant kitchen ! we ordered some popular dishes, like the Teochew sashimi, the fish hotpot, and some traditional desserts. the ingredients all very fresh, the taste was so delicious and so original. pictures on the wall really tell the history of this small 'unspoken' restaurant. hope they survive this covid-19 crisis and pass on their culinary tradition to generations ahead !  eat there and support the local community !
sample_reviews_en.author: Ernest T

sample_reviews_en.text: An authentic traditional Chinese place that famous for their fish hotpot. This place offered other traditional dishes as well, but for me their fish hotpot is topnotch. Other dish I love is the Chinese sashimi that used white fish paired with sweet sauce and different vegetables condiments. Another highlight would be the taro rice that tasted great and come at a large portion. Overall, would recommend for a family gathering, as many dishes are meant for sharing. Parking is available behind the place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pasachai Tangsakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Quality food, quick service.

Love their fish soup with Tarot, the best. Fish were fried with perfect amount of meat, great fragrance, no fishy smell at all. Super delicious.

They sauteed the vegetable just nice, perfect fire, still cruchy and fresh.

Or-suan (oyster pancake) was cooked nicely, chewy base. Recommended!.

Raw fish was fine, for those who love this style. In general a bit too sweet.

The staffs were quite attentive and got parking lot provided.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suratchata Shu

sample_reviews_en.text: This Chaozhou Chinese restaurant, operating for over 80 years, has retained its authentic flavour by consistently using high-quality ingredients. I suggest trying the boiled fish head with taro, oysters stir-fried with egg, goat meat stir-fried with celery, stir-fried mixed Chinese fruits and nuts, Chinese-style raw fish, and other items from the menu. The portions are generous, so I recommend dining with a group to enjoy a variety of dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neeraj Kim

restaurants.name: Duck & Noodles House
restaurants.address:

945 Soi Wanit 2, Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dry duck noodle soup with only duck meat: The noodles are crispy, and the broth is fragrant, flavorful, and not too salty—perfect for sipping continuously. I also ordered duck meat and intestine soup; the duck meat was tender, and the intestines were well-cooked and not too chewy.

The owner is very welcoming, constantly asking and recommending what to order. It's an old, traditional-style restaurant with a relaxed, comfortable atmosphere.

There were almost 10 ducks displayed in front of the shop at 11 am, but when I went back at 2 pm, they were all gone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bunnarach Punnarach

sample_reviews_en.text: A woman who spoke Thai and a little English managed to understand my order and brought me some duck ramen, which was absolutely delicious. The duck meat was so tender. I was completely satisfied for 60 baht. Amazing! I found out later that there was also an air-conditioned area (5 baht charge)! She even opened Google Maps for me at the end. I left a review! Kop khun mak ka!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kumin

sample_reviews_en.text: The meat is tender yet chewy, with a unique texture. It is a bit on the salty side, so I think it would be nice to have some rice with it haha. There are both spicy mixed noodles and noodle soup options, and both are good. The meat, which tastes like boiled pork, feels like the perfect drinking snack that would make any Korean person crave soju.
sample_reviews_en.author: Allan

sample_reviews_en.text: The meal was beautiful, really good but however the potion was quite small i guess it worth the price that set. I wouldn’t might paying extra for a bigger potion to be fair. The service was really quick took about 6 mins for a really good meal. Overall should try out if you are in the area!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Felix

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a small, tiny shop that makes the dining experience feel authentic and local. The roast duck was tender and flavorful, while the noodles were perfectly cooked and satisfying. The flavours are top notch for braised duck and the place seems to be a hit with the locals as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Live and let live

sample_reviews_en.text:
The duck is delicious, tender, and not gamey or fishy.
The noodle soup is just okay, with a clear broth. Special: add offal for 100 baht.
The minced duck is 300 baht, topped with a strong-smelling sauce that doesn't really go well with the noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: D N

sample_reviews_en.text: The food here is actually really good, but it's a shame that a great experience was ruined by a rude waitress. Even though I clearly ordered what I wanted, she still got the order wrong and acted irritated towards me. Worse still, I …
sample_reviews_en.author: Anek Premium

sample_reviews_en.text:
The duck rice was good, the sauce was flavorful, and the duck had no gamey smell; it was tender.
The flat noodles were good, the soup was delicious and not too salty, I loved it. The portions were generous for the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Namfon

restaurants.name: 80/20 Eighty Twenty
restaurants.address:

1052, 1054 Charoen Krung 26 Alley, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
An unforgettable dining experience at 80/20.

On behalf of Khun Hai from YPO, I would like to express our deepest appreciation to the entire team for delivering one of the most exceptional dining experiences we’ve ever had.

Every dish was nothing short of a masterpiece—beautifully presented, incredibly creative, and bursting with unforgettable flavors. Each course showcased remarkable craftsmanship and passion, making the entire journey exciting from beginning to end.

What truly elevated the evening, however, was the outstanding hospitality. A heartfelt thank you to Jack, Keaw, Ice, and Pao, whose warmth, professionalism, attention to detail, and genuine care made us feel like honored guests throughout the night. Their seamless service, thoughtful recommendations, and sincere smiles transformed an amazing meal into a truly memorable experience.

80/20 is far more than a Michelin-starred restaurant—it is a destination where culinary artistry and world-class hospitality come together perfectly. Without a doubt, this is one of Bangkok’s finest dining experiences, and we cannot wait to return. Highly, highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Cat Sun

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was pleasantly surprised by how boldly spicy yet thoroughly enjoyable the cuisine was.

Overall, the food was delicious and excellent — definitely worth trying.

The Choux Farci Green Curry seabass was perfectly cooked, with a juicy texture and a flavourful curry. It would have been even better with a little more curry sauce. The Khao Kan Chin seasoned jasmine rice was the best I have ever had — I finished all the accompanying dishes just so I could enjoy more of the rice. The lychee sorbet and longan cake were beautifully prepared and left me wanting more.

The dishes that could be improved were the Ong Oyster, in which no actual oyster was present, and its four accompanying appetisers, which tasted too similar to one another and lacked creativity. The Caviar Kanom Krok was good, but its hidden heat was unexpectedly strong and burned my tongue. The Tofu Ice Cream was disappointing — the portion was far too small to serve as a satisfying palate refresher.
sample_reviews_en.author: S. LIM

sample_reviews_en.text:
I first heard about 80/20 from friends, who mentioned it as a Michelin-starred Thai restaurant. As a Thai person, I was curious about how Thai cuisine could be elevated to fine dining.

When the day of my reservation arrived, I was truly impressed by what I experienced. Every dish was meticulously crafted, and the creativity behind each plate was on par with Michelin-starred restaurants in other countries.

The most outstanding aspect was the flavor—even Thai dishes that I typically don’t enjoy, I ended up finishing every single one, including the desserts!

The staff were wonderful—attentive and always ready to assist. They carefully introduced each dish, sharing the story behind it, which made the dining experience even more meaningful and memorable.

Overall, it was absolutely worth the price and time spent here. The atmosphere with my friends was fantastic, with every table filled with laughter. Great wine, incredible food—it was a perfect night
sample_reviews_en.author: Kornrakrit KJ woo

sample_reviews_en.text: Already planning my next meal here. The food is so skilled, creative and really honours traditional Thai, Burmese and Laotian flavours in a surprising way. Every course activated the memories of tasting those flavours for the first time in some small local eatery or another, but combined with the incredible technique and artistry, it took me to a whole new place. I can still taste that Burmese broth every time I look at the picture. Service was perfectly executed and there was a good atmosphere emanating from the kitchen which is always a green flag. My only feedback would be that the Pun Khao Poon dish felt overpowered by the peanut sauce - the beef wasn’t able to shine and the whole dish needed something to lift it, but that is just my opinion. It was still delicious and did not detract from the overall experience at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Solomon Wilkinson

sample_reviews_en.text: A perfect evening. The food was delicious, interesting, and plated with style. The wine pairings were all enjoyable and provided interesting, even provocative, accompaniment to the dishes. I was especially impressed with the wait staff. As a solo diner, I am grateful for the brief interactions throughout such a creative meal. Regarding the ambiance, I enjoyed the open setting and design. Keeping half of a demolished wall to separate two parts of the dining floor was a flourish. The neighborhood immediately around the 80/20 is another plus; well worth exploring after a meal. I wandered through several narrow side sois taking pictures and enjoying the vibe for an hour afterwards. Bangkok is magic and 80/20 casts its own very special spell.
sample_reviews_en.author: Todd Bisson

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dined at 80/20 in Bangkok's Bang Rak—a one-Michelin-star standout! This contemporary gem reimagines Thai-Lao flavors with 80% local, ultra-fresh ingredients that burst with bold, vibrant tastes. Hokkaido scallops in aromatic Lhon sauce, spicy Plaa Goong blue prawns, succulent Papaya Fish Red Curry, and premium Holy Basil Beef deliver intense yet balanced perfection.

Sleek industrial loft vibe feels welcoming, with attentive service sharing each course's story. Tasting menu shines through innovation rooted in tradition—pandan rice and amuse-bouches are highlights. Highly desirable for special nights; book ahead! Freshness and finesse earn every star.
sample_reviews_en.author: William Lau

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Good: Service was attentive and excellent. The sommelier was also knowledgeable and skilled, lighting a candle to look for sediment in the bottle while pouring into the decanter.

The Not So Good: While the presentation was good, the flavours went well, and the use of local ingredients was interesting, many if not most of the dishes were spicy (bordering on very spicy). This should have been stated explicitly on the website or in correspondence during reservation and paying the deposit. One of our group was not able to take spicy food, and even those that did found the heat a little too much to take.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aldrin Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Service and presentation good.  However the lady who served us was not able to explain in English when asked about the foods; she seemed to memorise the  menu descriptions by heart.  Appetiser fish soup was too salty.  Main course grilled pork skewer was dry and tough.

Dress code was smart casual (no sport attires, shorts or slippers.) according to the restaurant reminder message.  Two young Chinese guys at the next table  were in shorts & collarless T-shirts; with one of them in slippers and running shorts.  Restaurant must maintained its decorum especially being a Michelin stared restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lau Ah Gong

restaurants.address:

โครงการ K space 99/3 ห้องเลขที่16 Sukhaphiban 2 Rd, ประเวศ Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This place instantly catches your eye with its stunning wall filled with hundreds of wine bottles from floor to ceiling. The warm lighting, wooden tables, and cozy seating create a relaxed and elegant atmosphere, perfect for a chill evening with friends or a romantic dinner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Katty Nako

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere and plays good music. The staff are very lovely and friendly. The prices are reasonable, and the food tastes delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: JIK SAW

sample_reviews_en.text: You pick your own bottle and the owners are so nice and helpful. Highly recommend if you're staying near the airport like I was. This place has good vibes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alayna Devivi

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and very pet-friendly. The staff even helped take photos for us. The service was excellent. We will definitely go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuu Ring Meesuk

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant near my house is reasonably priced, the food is delicious, and they always have promotions. It's also pet-friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: fonsarita Areekul

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is so cute!💖💖💖 We arrived late, and even though the shop was closed, they were still open. I'm really impressed!🥰🥰🥰👏🏻🥳 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Natphassorn Kaeota

sample_reviews_en.text: The food looked great and tasted amazing. Every dish was delicious. The atmosphere in the restaurant was also great. I loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Toey “LA HERMANA [ลา เออร์มานา]” Charisa

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop gives a warm feeling like coming to home. It's warm and the staff are lovely and provide good service. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Wilawan Khiwwilai

restaurants.name: Ali's Indian & Thai - MBK Center G Floor Zone D (Halal)
restaurants.address:

Zone D MBK Centre G Floor Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
While visiting Thailand, I didn't feel like being adventurous and trying unknown food. While in the mall, I was quite impressed with how many choices they had for dining. Although it was a hard choice, I settled on Indian cuisine. Ali's menu looked good being I was not seeking a restaurant that specialized in meat. Interestingly enough there is a Sizzler in this mall. I probably would have tried that just for nostalgia.

The staff was attentive and very kind. We ordered our food. It ended up being a lot more than I thought it would be. Probably could have ordered half of it. We didn't even get to eat at all. The food was tasty delicious and hot. Everything except for the hummus. It was a little bit sour. Perhaps people don't order it a lot and it was sitting in a refrigerator. Either way they took it away and didn't charge me. This is a pretty good option especially for a mall. Their food tastes like an any Indian restaurant I have gone to. The familiar flavors was satisfying for this traveler..
sample_reviews_en.author: Dread InNY

sample_reviews_en.text:
Finding halal food in Bangkok sometimes feels like searching for a needle in a haystack… but Ali’s is that needle, and it’s golden! I tried fried rice, naan, Pad Thai spring rolls, and samosas – all delicious, filling, and affordable. The naan was soft, the samosas perfectly crispy, and the spring rolls a fun surprise. In the middle of MBK’s shopping chaos, this place is a true lifesaver for halal seekers.
Even though it’s halal, I was still a bit suspicious about the meat (trust issues, you know 😂) … so I played it safe and went full vegetarian. Samosas, spring rolls, fried rice, naan ,pad thai – no regrets, I was stuffed and happy!
sample_reviews_en.author: Souad Yassine

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was delicious but slightly overpriced. However the issue arose when they made a mistake with our order leading to an extra dish arriving at our table. When we explained the mistake to them, they began blackmailing us, telling us that if we did not pay it, it would come out of the waitresses pay check. This was completely unfair and put us in a very uncomfortable position. The owner did not do anything to assist with the matter, refusing to speak with us. Would not recommend this restaurant at all!!
sample_reviews_en.author: josiah abdelmalak

sample_reviews_en.text: Had a wonderful experience at Ali’s Indian & Thai Restaurant in Bangkok. The restaurant serves an excellent combination of Indian, Thai, and Arabic cuisines, all prepared with authentic flavours and great attention to detail. Every dish was rich, well-balanced, and satisfying, with generous portions. The quality of food, friendly staff, and comfortable ambience made the visit truly enjoyable. A great choice in Bangkok for anyone craving flavourful and authentic multi-cuisine food. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ashish chamoli

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were 3 friends and had dinner last night at Ali’s Indian & Thai in MBK and wow 🔥

Malai tikka, butter naan, butter chicken, lamb karahi, all 10/10.
Even the Thai tea, Indian tea and cappuccino were spot on. Everything came out hot and fresh.

Big thanks to the girls working there! The one who took our order and the server were both super friendly and welcoming. Made us feel at home right away.

If you’re shopping at MBK and craving Indian/Thai, this is the place. 5 stars no doubt ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: Samaid Aslam

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overpriced and underwhelmed.
It looked clean and interesting.
The food arrived piecemeal.  My wife finished before my food arrived.  My wife's drink arrived just before we paid the bill despite plenty of staff and few customers and needed 3 requests .....
The food was very disappointing, we both left more than we ate.
Nearby choices were cheaper and probably offered better food.
Just go elsewhere, there's no reason to put up with this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bob B

sample_reviews_en.text:
Not for Indian food. I tried zordar thali and was very excited to try, my partner ordered non veg thali. Both were way below expectations, curries too tangy or burnt cumin in curry and rice. All curries had same taste which was very bad. Please make actual Indian food, what I ate was not Indian in any way.
Service and atmosphere was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: snehal kukale

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don’t come here!
While the service was nice, the food wasn’t good at all. The Indian food was plated right away while the steak came later and in addition to that cold and very chewy. Prices are okay. Chicken wasn’t chicken breast even though it was confirmed before ordering. There are plenty of better options.
sample_reviews_en.author: SJ

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted amazing, so flavorful and delicious. The restaurant has a great atmosphere, perfect for eating and chatting with friends. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Kulisara Chaiyakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! The staff were lovely and the service was excellent. I came because of Jaehyun, but to a different branch. 🥹💚 …
sample_reviews_en.author: nn napat

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the wait time was short, and the atmosphere was great. I especially loved the fresh shrimp papaya salad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Papada P.

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere in the restaurant was great. The food took a little while to arrive, but the staff provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: ajchara haitasee

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! The Korat stir-fried noodles exceeded my expectations. The staff were also very friendly and lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patcha Sennun

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the only branch that I think has the best taste in Bangkok. Good service, great taste, and good price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gnoldx TH

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! The fermented fish sauce was amazing, I loved it! The restaurant presented the dish cutely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patinya Kamalaporn

sample_reviews_en.text: I love Khun Phoon very much. I love you. Delicious food forever. (Referring to a type of noodle dish).
sample_reviews_en.author: f

restaurants.name: Daeng Racha Hoi Tod (Oyster omelette)
restaurants.address:

342 Sukon 1 Alley, Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I saw many reviews saying it was great. Since I like oyster omelet and my girlfriend likes fried oysters, we decided to try it. We ordered fried oysters, oyster omelet, and "Or Rua" (a type of Thai curry). The restaurant informed us that there would be a 40-minute wait. Okay, no problem. While waiting, we saw fresh spring rolls across the street, so we ordered some to try. The result? Not amazing. Not like the ones from a place I often frequent around Daokhanong. After the spring rolls were finished, the fried oysters, oyster omelet, and "Or Rua" were served. I tried the oyster omelet without the sauce. The oysters were fresh, but the taste, for me, wasn't as amazing as I expected. I tried the chili sauce, but the flavor wasn't that great either. My girlfriend said the fried oysters weren't any different from some other places she's eaten at. The "Or Rua" wasn't very crispy. Overall, the taste was just average, similar to other places I've tried. The oysters were fresh, which was okay. Some people might have a less refined palate, and that might be true depending on perspective. But in conclusion, the taste was okay, average, but not amazing like others experienced.
sample_reviews_en.author: panya tharathipphitak

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant I've wanted to try for a long time, but you have to be prepared because it's always crowded with long queues and things sell out quickly. This time, I came on a weekday around 9:30 AM and luckily there were still tables available. Since I had the chance to try it, I ordered everything on the menu, including all the specials. However, I still had to wait almost half an hour for my food because there were people ahead of me in the queue. Once I tasted it, I can honestly say it was "amazingly delicious!" The oysters were incredibly fresh and there were so many of them. It was definitely worth the trip! 😋😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Witoon Vorapoonsuki

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is one of the most iconic old-school restaurants in Thailand, and it’s still killing it! 🔥

The portions are generous, and the food quality is seriously top-notch.

I ordered the oyster omelet, and the oysters were incredibly fresh, sweet, and delicious. 🦪 The best part is that you can choose how crispy you want the omelet—from medium crispy to extra crispy.

I also tried the stir-fried flat noodles with chicken, and they were really good too.

Highly recommended!

⭐ Pro tip: Make sure to tell them exactly how crispy you like your oyster omelet. It makes all the difference! 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: jarusyut satirasilpin

sample_reviews_en.text: I've passed by this restaurant many times and it's always full. Today, someone just left and I got a seat. I tried the "Or Suan" and "Or Rua" dishes. I asked the seller what the difference was. "Or Suan" has a soft batter, while "Or Rua" has a crispy batter. The names sounded unusual, and I'd never tried them before, so I ordered them. The batter was crispy and slightly salty, topped with oysters, and served with chili sauce and a drizzle of vinegar and pickled chilies. It was delicious. At 100 baht per plate, I thought it wasn't expensive. I waited about 30 minutes for my food.
sample_reviews_en.author: jen Wit

sample_reviews_en.text: It should have been fried crispier. I understand there were a lot of people, but they shouldn't have rushed, because customers know they have to wait. Frying it for too short a time makes the shellfish and batter soggy and inedible. In short, what you see in the picture is just what I ate and then threw the rest away. What a waste of money. Also, when I've found a fried shellfish stall that pays attention to detail, they'll stir-fry the bean sprouts until they're soft and not have that raw, grassy smell.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lee Rover

sample_reviews_en.text: This old-school oyster omelet stall offers both crispy and soft versions, with a choice of oysters. It's located by the roadside, has no air conditioning, no parking, and accepts cash only. Everything is made fresh to order. The oysters are fresh and delicious, but it's recommended to come with a group because one plate is too much for one person and it's quite oily, which might make you feel nauseated.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nath.S

sample_reviews_en.text: This famous restaurant in the Talat Noi area was visited based on reviews. It's located by the roadside. It wasn't too crowded in the morning. The fried oysters were crispy and delicious. The oyster omelet had a soft batter; ordering the mixed oyster omelet would probably be best. The service was good and the wait wasn't long. The prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: nittaya lumjiektes

sample_reviews_en.text:
Daeng Raja Hoi Tod (Fried Oyster King): When talking about fried oyster shops, this shop is always mentioned. With its unique batter, generous portions of oysters, and reasonable price, it's no wonder people keep coming back.

The fried oysters are incredibly crispy, slightly oily, and you get oysters in every bite.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karn Santidhananon

restaurants.name: Ramen Tei (Surawong)
restaurants.address:

11/1 Si Lom 6, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Been visiting this place for more than 15 years. And their consistency is on point. Gyoza 🧡, Mapo tofu 🧡, Liver x Greens 🧡 and ramens are decent with a different style of noodles. Reasonably priced. Big portions. Still saddened me every time that the place removed the “braised belly pork” or หมูสามชั้นตุ๋น - that dish was phenomenal.
Other recommendations are Fried Rice, fried livers, tantanmen & etc. the sauce in the jar is very tasty. This place is those place where you really trust that your food will taste the same. Cheers!
sample_reviews_th.author: N. A.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I just visit this restaurant by some reviewer from twitter as it nears my office.

The food is quite good. Average price is around 230-320 per dish and come up with a large portion so I think if you come with friend, you can share it with your friend as they will provide a small bowl to divide some portion separately.

I select cold tea as I love tea but quite surprise that it’s refill 🥰 because it’s hard to find a refill tea from normal restaurant and their service is quite food since the staff view walk around to see if your drink nearly run out or not and they will refill it.

For the atmosphere, they have 2 options for sitting which are counter area and dining table. I select dining table as I come with my friend. If you come alone or prefer to see what are chief doing, select the counter area as it opens area.

Anyway, during the way that I walk to this restaurant is not that too good for girl if you come after 18.00 since it’s a bit dark and many store that have a guys open for massage 🫠
sample_reviews_en.author: pitty papha

sample_reviews_en.text:
An old-style restaurant with a simple, Japanese atmosphere.
Old but very clean.
Even the restrooms were spotless. I thought the restaurant had just opened (I went in the evening).

The food was excellent, thanks to PONCHANOK's quick wit in recommending dishes to customers.
She gave great recommendations and provided excellent service. Every dish was delicious.
- Shoyu ramen with pork bone broth; you can adjust the saltiness and soy sauce level.
- Stir-fried liver; you can adjust the fat level. Highly recommended; the liver was very tender.
- Cold ramen; refreshing, highly recommended, perfect for a summery day.
- Fruit salad with tofu pudding; very refreshing.

Good service, delicious food, clean restaurant. Parking is available behind the restaurant. I really liked this restaurant and highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fia Fia

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is one of the most highly regarded by Japanese expatriates.

In the clean, open kitchen, chefs skillfully prepare the food. Watching them makes you feel as if you're in Japan. The menu's resemblance to "casual Japanese Chinese food" also contributes to this nostalgic feeling.

When you're craving something other than authentic Thai cuisine or Thai-style Chinese food, be sure to try this restaurant. Please note that credit card payments are not accepted.
sample_reviews_en.author: 稲地秀介

sample_reviews_en.text:
Love this place as its atmosphere is like in Japan. There is an open kitchen in the middle so a customer can see the chef cooking.

Once I was inside, the staff served a wet towel and tea for free to wipe my hand first. I ordered pork bacon stir-fried with veggies, gyoza, mapo  tofu and stir-fried noodles. This restaurant is a Japanese fusion with Chinese. Food is very delicious, I can smell wok hay from all stir fired. Price is reasonable and very worthy to come.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chantasinee La-ongsri

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Guradake (or something similar to ramen) dish was delicious, but the Gantomen, which is just like plain noodles with gravy, was more of a niche flavor. It's worth trying, but the portions are medium, enough for two people, though slightly on the smaller side. I'd recommend trying it, but I wouldn't come back again. The staff weren't very service-minded, but they did smile and respond normally.

The atmosphere was nice and felt like being in Japan.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชาตรี คุรุภากรณ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff doesn't accept cards, but you only need to pay for the food. There is no separate service charge.

I ordered Chili Shrimp and Shoyu Ramen. The Chili Shrimp had too strong a spice flavor and aroma, while the Shoyu Ramen was a bit bland and watery.

My standards might be high because I have tried Japanese ramen specialty restaurants in other countries, but personally, I would not visit this place again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Xy rho

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fresh and delicious. There are many choices for soup as well as my favorite spicy one. You can also choose the level of noodles, soft, normal
and hard as well as for those who doesn’t like too salty or oily. I chose less salt, less oil which was still so good. We tried different kinds and all were perfectly cooked.  Staff is nice. The place is not so big buy clean and good for stopping for a hot ramen 🍜
sample_reviews_en.author: J J

restaurants.name: Sousaku The Circle Ratchapruek โซซาคุ เดอะเซอร์เคิล ราชพฤกษ์
restaurants.address:

39 Ratchaphruek Rd, Bang Ramat, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the few truly authentic Japanese-style shabu restaurants I’ve been a regular at for a long time. They serve high-quality ingredients, from premium meats to fresh vegetables. It’s also one of the rare shabu spots that offers tong ho (garland chrysanthemum), which I really love.

The shabu broth here is well balanced, with a gentle natural sweetness from shredded daikon.

The ponzu and sesame dipping sauces are also excellent, pairing perfectly with the meats.

In addition to the hot pot, they also have sushi and sashimi of good quality, though the prices are quite high.

The service is also excellent and worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krittayot Chaowanapreecha

sample_reviews_en.text: As a regular customer, I was very disappointed this time because the staff taking the order provided terrible service. They spoke in a condescending manner, simply because my wife asked about the type of pot that would be served with the set. Comments like, "There's only one type of pot," and "Have you ever eaten at this restaurant before?" were used without any polite ending. The tone was abrupt, and after taking the order, they slammed the order board and mouse down forcefully and shook their head as if displeased with the customers. In short, my wife and I left with feedback for the manager.
sample_reviews_en.author: IP

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sukiyaki/Shabu-shabu: Fresh pork, fresh vegetables, and crispy mushrooms. The dipping sauce is decent, and you can refill with fresh chili, garlic, green onions, and shredded daikon radish as much as you like.
Sushi is okay, but not impressive. Personally, I didn't like it.
Desserts: Only ice cream is available.
Members get special discounts on some menu items and coupons for free beer. For every 800 THB spent, you get one free bottle of ASAHI beer per bill/one time only.
The staff are polite and attentive.
The restaurant atmosphere is quite nice, bright, spacious, and not cramped.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pretty Sudanee

sample_reviews_en.text:
This shabu-shabu restaurant has a great atmosphere. The food is fresh and there's a wide variety to choose from, including pork, beef, and various vegetables. The quality of the ingredients is excellent considering the price. The broth is flavorful and not too salty, perfect for sipping continuously.

What impressed me most was the excellent service from the staff. They refilled the food quickly and cleared the plates constantly, making the dining experience comfortable and relaxed. The restaurant is clean and comfortable, suitable for dining with friends, family, or in a group.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wongbaworn Chavengvorakul

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited on a Sunday, so there was a long queue and many customers, but the wait wasn't too long. The restaurant looks very nice, with a Japanese style. The main ingredients looked good and were of good quality. The taste was good, and it seemed clean. There's a wide variety of menu options, but the appetizers served before the main dishes seemed to have been open for a while and were starting to lose their crispness. Also, the staff taking orders didn't seem very helpful or attentive; if you're not a regular customer, you might be confused about ordering.
sample_reviews_en.author: SD Chindapol

sample_reviews_en.text:
For those who enjoy Kansai-style Japanese sukiyaki, I highly recommend Sousaku. It's incredibly delicious! I ate at their The Circle Ratchaphruek branch.

This set, for two to three people, costs 1899 baht and includes two plates of the meat shown in the picture, plus a set of vegetables. It was absolutely delicious! The staff will stir-fry the ingredients in the pan and add the broth the first time. For subsequent servings, you can choose to add your own dark broth as desired.

I also ordered an unagi bamboo roll, which was also very tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Beer pen

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a Japanese restaurant that also serves shabu-shabu, but they don't sell sesame dipping sauce. They have a large menu. It gets crowded on weekend evenings, so it's best to call and make a reservation. They offer various grades and prices of beef, and the portions are generous with large pieces.
