The fish is fresh and the prices are reasonable.

Prices do not include 7% VAT and a 5% service charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponchagarj Ngamukos

sample_reviews_en.text: This is another Pet Friendly shop that I was very impressed with. The food is delicious, the staff are very helpful and provide excellent service. Importantly, they have a menu for dogs, and they even have a private room for pets. I highly recommend signing up for the Member Plus membership; it's totally worth it. I've added this to my list of places I'll be visiting often.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattranit Aschaprasertsuk

restaurants.name: แชมป์เย็นตาโฟเครื่องทอด สาขาเสรีไทย
restaurants.address:

93 Seri Thai 19 Alley, Khwaeng Khlong Kum, Bueng Kum, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited Champ Yentafo Fried Toppings, a newly opened branch on Seri Thai 19. They have a full set of toppings, including fried toppings! I loved it; lots of toppings. I personally prefer the dry version, it's unique.
If you mention you saw this video on this channel, they'll give you a free plate of buttered roti!
There's plenty of parking behind the shop, which is right on the main road.

Opening hours: 11:30 AM – 10:30 PM
Newly opened branch, Seri Thai 19

#PIKI
IG: princekishiro
Tiktok: @princekishiro
youtube: princekishiro
sample_reviews_en.author: Prince Kishiro (KIRA)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Champ Yentafo Fried Toppings, Seri Thai branch, is a popular restaurant known for its flavorful broth and generous toppings, especially the variety of fried toppings such as fried tofu, crispy squid, and fish balls. Their yentafo (noodle soup) has a sweet and savory broth,
with a vibrant pink color from the fermented soybean paste. Overall, the taste is a favorite of many. Besides yentafo, they also offer other dishes such as clear noodle soup and tom yum, and the friendly atmosphere makes for a comfortable dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyaporn Petch

sample_reviews_en.text: Located on Seri Thai Road, you can park behind the shop. Ordering is easy and the food is prepared quickly, no long wait. The taste is good, the broth is flavorful. You can even specify your preferred level of spiciness. The roti for dessert is also excellent. You can even order some to take home. The taste doesn't change when reheated. I eat here often because it's on my way home, but I wanted to leave a review for the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sakura Midori

sample_reviews_en.text:
I intended to eat roti and tea, but the seating was in the same place as the Yen Ta Fo restaurant, so I ordered fried dumplings and fried tofu to see if they were any good.

- In short, they weren't as good as I thought. The dumplings and tofu were served ice-cold. I didn't even think about microwaving or reheating them. They were completely inedible. They were rock hard. The first time, the last time, and that was it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Keera 888

sample_reviews_en.text:
You can order their champion Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) and eat it at Heng Tong Kee Hainanese Chicken Rice restaurant. The Yen Ta Fo is delicious, with great ingredients. I loved it! I ate a little while ago and then ordered another bag of the same thing to take home. So delicious!

The restaurant is located on Seri Thai Road, next to Gu Roti. There's plenty of parking at the back and shared restrooms.
sample_reviews_en.author: Airi Riki

sample_reviews_en.text: The Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) was delicious; the broth tasted great and didn't need any extra seasoning. The fried toppings were a bit oily though. I'm deducting a star for the drinks; the Thai iced tea was awful and left an orange stain on my hands, so I didn't dare drink it further. I've had this brand elsewhere that wasn't this bad. The roti was also undercooked; the dough was still hard and dry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jackkarin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Yen Ta Fo Tom Yum is rich and spicy. The freshly fried toppings are fragrant and crispy. Absolutely delicious!

The plum tea is generous with plums.

The roti is thick and soft, with just the right amount of flavor and the dough is perfectly soft.

There's a spacious, convenient, and well-lit parking lot behind the restaurant.
Accessible from both the alley before and next to the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: lovelychan Mercenaries

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff often give the wrong order. The taste is delicious as it is prepared. The crispy squid used to be hard to chew, but now it has improved. There is a boiled squid with fried shallots and it is delicious. There is parking in the back. Overall, it is considered good. It has improved a lot from when it first came, both the service and the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanarat Prechawanich

restaurants.name: Achyut Bhavan Bangkok
restaurants.address:

75 Suk Chai Alley, North, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
New name, new location, same great food. I was genuinely sad when Saravana Bhavan in Silom closed about a year ago. Their deep-fried idli and dosas were among my favorites. So I was delighted to discover they’ve reopened near Asok, in the former Italian restaurant.

Nothing has changed where it matters. The menu is just as extensive, the food just as delicious - only the location has improved. If you’re looking for authentic South Indian cuisine, this is the place to go.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text:
Such an outstanding south indian restaurant in Bangkok.👍👍

I will say it's one of the most well made , modern , super clean south indian restaurant I have ever seen in the world. 👍

Staff in kitchen 100% from South India.

Service staff excellent.

Taste of food and selection was mind-blowing. I went there every morning for my brunch. It opens at 10:00 am.

Let me end by saying it is among the best south indian restaurant in the world👏👏
sample_reviews_en.author: Hemant Didwania

sample_reviews_en.text: Heavenly food in bangkok. Best restaurant for Indians to enjoy indian food in a foreign country. So authentic and tasty. Loved it. We ate here for 6 times for 5 day bangkok trip. The menu is enormous they have lot pf options and we almost tried everything, everything is tasty. Only the falooda is ok ok and fruit salad is just milk and fruits not at all good. Apart from desserts i feel everything is to the point.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aishwarya Marathe

sample_reviews_en.text:
Service is great, waiters are busy during rush hour but just wave them down and they'll come to you.

The butter and garlic naan will fill you up. They are toasty at the bottom and soft and buttery at the top. Even though they aren't thick one naan filled me up.

I'm not a vegetarian but this Paneer butter Masala was too good, definitely would eat at this vegan restaurant again.
sample_reviews_en.author: FE Trotter

sample_reviews_en.text: Good restaurant in Bangkok for Dinner Indian Food especially South Indian. Good ambience, courteous staff, delicious food. Order does take some time but food is worth the wait. Tried the Ghee roast, Malabar paratha both were really amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anurag Bhaskar

sample_reviews_en.text: Achyut Bhawan is pure vegetarian restaurants for Indian food. The quality and taste are excellent, with a wide variety of North and South Indian dishes. The restaurant is clean, and the service is good. Prices are on the higher side, but …
sample_reviews_en.author: Dinesh Sharma

sample_reviews_en.text: Really good experience everytime we've visited. All the dishes we've ordered so far, be it dosas, vada or parotha, have been delicious. The service is prompt, food is fresh and the atmosphere is hospitable. Would highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kunal Kukreja

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best South Indian food in BKK. Value for money, food portion size. Slightly outside the main area, but only a 10-min walk, and a nice walk. Dosa and idly were the best. The music buffer could have been little lesser.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarah

restaurants.name: Have A Zeed - Icon Siam
restaurants.address:

Charoen Nakhon, Khlong Ton Sai, Klongsan, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Manam of Thailand,
Great price and menu!

Crab Meat Curry - 9/10
This is what I love about thai cuisine, very flavorful and experimental. I was having second thoughts on ordering this since I hate curry, but this one is soooo good. The curry paired with the crab meat brings a great texture. Flavor wise I wish it was a little more spicy. But overall this is great!

Rice - 10/10
Even their rice is something else, just wow. Lime + garlic + chili greaaaattt!!

Tom Yum Soup,
Great balance of sourness, spice, and saltiness. Such a good comfort food. Great paired with the rice and crab meat curry

Steak -7/10 (this is the food that made me rate the resto 4/5)
It's a ritual for us to order steak in restaurants though I don't think this is Zeed's specialty the dish was still passable. The meat wasn't tender tho and the taste does not stand out much

When visiting this resto the crab meat curry, rice, and tom yum soup is a must try!
sample_reviews_en.author: EatwithE

sample_reviews_en.text: I was very impressed from the moment I walked in. Have a ZEED Icon Siam is a newly opened Thai Northeastern restaurant. The food is delicious, especially their Som Tum Mahanakorn, which is a Thai papaya salad but uses thicker papaya strips and includes crispy, sweet shrimp – it was amazing! The sweet liver was perfectly cooked, the glass noodle larb was flavorful, and my favorite was the "Break-Off" chicken wings – freshly fried and incredibly delicious. The restaurant has a relaxed atmosphere. Most of the customers are foreigners, but the food is adapted well for Thai tastes. The staff are very attentive, especially the person standing at the front of the restaurant in the picture – they provided excellent service and recommendations. I was extremely impressed. All the staff speak English. I will definitely be back. I highly recommend this restaurant to everyone!
sample_reviews_en.author: OatChisanupong T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered 4 dishes. Curry crab - the curry was hot, but the crab on it is cold, like chiller cold. Chef didn’t stir hot the crab at all.

Morning glory was tasteless, noodle with beef was also serve cold and not flavorful enough.

Also ordered a Thai Milk tea. Nice touch that they freeze the milk tea and use as their ice cubes. But their milk tea is gateway to diabetes, I asked for extra normal ice to dilute the milk tea.

Only food that was good is the chicken wing, besides that, none of the food tasted good.

In BKK, is really hard to find a bad Thai restaurant, this is one of them.
sample_reviews_en.author: William Seow

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came to this place for lunch, and I didn’t expect anything special — but the Thai food turned out to be absolutely delicious. I tried Pad Kra Pao and a beef soup with lemongrass, and both were incredibly tasty.

I also ordered two cocktails: a lychee lavender soda and a butterfly pea soda. They were the freshest and most delicious drinks I’ve ever had — so refreshing, lightly sweet, and perfectly balanced.

But unfortunately this place is so popular that sometimes you need to wait in queue.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jenny

sample_reviews_en.text: Very happy I stopped here if all the restaurants on the 6th floor. This was an amazing pick. I got the chicken massaman curry and their ribs with a side of rice. Both meats were literally fall off the bone tender. I wished there was more of a barbecue sauce on the ribs for more flavor, but that’s okay. The curry was super flavorful and rich. I loved it. I just wished there was more broth. So good! Great customer service also. And the restaurant looked nice and clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christina Williams

sample_reviews_en.text: I had dinner here with my friend 2 nights ago and loved the food here. The highlight of our meal is the Thai river prawn cooked with glass noodles. The prawn was succulent and fresh and the glass noodle was a welcome change from rice. Thw second favourite dish was the crab curry. The curry wasn't what I was used to back home but the crab meat was served generously. It was a great meal indèed after we shopped in Icon Siam.
sample_reviews_en.author: gevs

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there with a midsize group of about eight people, and it was plenty of space for us. The food was great, and the staff were very kind and helpful. All the dishes were reasonably priced and good quality. My favorites were the pineapple fried rice and pad Thai. If you want to try a variety of Thai dishes at once, I highly recommend this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sun R

sample_reviews_en.text:
Compared to other branches, this one is really disappointing.

The tables are spaced ridiculously close together, and I was shocked by how salty the food was. It wasn't like this when I ate the same menu a few times at other branches.

Also, I know this is a restaurant known for small portions, but it seems like this branch gives even less... lol.
sample_reviews_en.author: H Choi

restaurants.name: MR. RIBEYE - สเต๊กอร่อย คุณภาพดี
restaurants.address:

99/14 รามอินทรา 14 แยก 11 Khwaeng Tha Raeng, Bang Khen, Bangkok 10220, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Hidden Gem in Ramintra: Quality Steak and Quality Conversation

I had the opportunity to dine at MR. RIBEYE, owned by the well-known younger brother of David Asavanond. The atmosphere is very cozy, but what made this meal most special was the conversation I had with him. Time flew by without me realizing it. The conversation enhanced the flavors of the food, making it even more enjoyable.

🥩 The Beef: Today I ordered the Australian Angus Ribeye. The flavor was rich, the marbling was beautiful, and the meat was incredibly tender with excellent juices (high value for money considering the quality). It was perfectly cooked. 📍 Location Note: My only observation is that the restaurant is quite a hidden spot. Although it's located by the road, the storefront blends in with the surroundings, so you'll need to look carefully. I recommend using a map and slowing down.

Summary: This restaurant is complete in both taste and spirit. Anyone passing by Soi Maiyalap should stop by!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chittakorn Khamthun

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm from California, and love steaks and wines. I tried a local steakhouse after my gf work on the weekend. The atmosphere was good, I guess the owner was in NY or family members went to NYU. Everything was good,  Truffle soup was perfect,  Salad was just ok, I saw Guinness beer and ordered (wow), Chile Cabernet Sauvignon selection was good. BUT NOT THE STEAK.  I expected very juicy and soft Ribeyes texture of meat, but very tough and sooooo chewy. I felt cheap stiff NY steak lol 5555.  Where was Ribeyes marbling even imported from Aussie?  Are you guys pre-cooked for grill marks and re-heated?  hmmm.  or Am I too much of a foodie and have luxury and expensive taste? 555 My gf said, a little pricey for local people here. If you are meat lover, go to .... Downtown BKK.
sample_reviews_en.author: Human R (Anonymous)

sample_reviews_en.text: A very cozy and friendly restaurant serving delicious food! Their pasta is always perfectly cooked, al dente. They have both Thai and Western dishes on the menu, and both are always done right. The service is always super friendly and welcoming. This small, warm restaurant, run by the owner, consistently delivers delicious food. The beef fried rice is amazing, and the spaghetti is always perfectly cooked. They constantly update their menu. In this area, this kind of restaurant is excellent – ​​not fancy, not crowded, but offering great food without having to go into the city. Highly recommended! Try their pasta salad, steak, beef fried rice, fermented pork sausage with bacon, and soft-serve ice cream.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patty Sukontasawadi

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish was delicious! We tried the Australian beef steak, cooked medium, and it was tender and tasty. The Thai beef steak was a bit tougher to chew (but we like a bit of chewing so it wasn't a problem for us). The owner gave great recommendations on the meat; if you prefer tender meat, they recommend Wagyu or Australian beef. The pesto spaghetti was excellent, fresh and delicious. You can see the dedication the restaurant puts into preparing the food, and the price is reasonable for the quality. 🙏🏼😋
sample_reviews_en.author: LALALACE

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, the atmosphere is great, and the service is excellent. It's perfect for relaxing with a group of friends or your partner. I often come alone, and they have a good variety of single-serving dishes.

Some dishes might be a bit fatty from the meat or rich in butter; those who like it will love it, but some might find it a little too rich. However, they have dishes to balance the richness.

The desserts rotate depending on the day, but everything I've tried has been delicious! (Haha)
sample_reviews_en.author: ชราภาพ Gamer

sample_reviews_en.text:
This small restaurant may be small, but the food is surprisingly delicious! My friend wanted spaghetti, so we searched online and found this place. We ordered two dishes:

The truffle spaghetti with shrimp and egg was incredibly delicious! So flavorful, but not at all greasy.

The pork chop was also very tasty. And surprisingly, even the boiled carrots were delicious!

The owner, David, was incredibly friendly and chatty.
sample_reviews_en.author: 梅娜亞 Nathaya Meksamanasak

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant had a great atmosphere and lighting. We received a very warm welcome and excellent service.
When the food arrived, it looked great. The truffle mushroom soup was very fragrant and delicious. The steak was incredibly delicious, tender, easy to chew, and not tough at all. I highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: PPEcoRace Nissan

sample_reviews_en.text: The quality doesn't quite match the price. The only thing that was delicious was the baked spinach with cheese. The steak, at 400 baht per plate, was incredibly tough, as you can see in the picture. I don't understand why most reviews give it 5 stars, but a steak for 400 baht should be good and not tough.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jj

restaurants.name: Angel Wonton Noodles, Branch 1
restaurants.address:

QHHX+MMC, Saha Kan Pramun Alley, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
📌Angel Wonton Noodles Branch 1📌
Location: Ladprao 80, Intersection 26

My mom found this place through a TikTok review.

She asked me to take her there 🤣🤣🤣

The menu is as follows - Menu names are under the pictures.

For me, the taste was good but not amazing.

Anyone passing by should stop by and support the owner.
That way she'll have the motivation to keep selling.

I asked her where her husband went, based on his TikTok review.

She said he passed away 8 months ago.

Prices start at 50 baht per bowl.
There were probably almost 20 bowls in total.
We ordered two of each, and the total was a little over 900 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Doungkamol Seumpaisarn

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop has two shops across from each other. The morning shop sells in a building, and the evening shop sells in a shed. It's almost at the end of the alley, so you really have to come here. Their noodles are thin like those in Hong Kong shops. The roast pork, Chinese sausage, and dumplings are good. The sauce is average. I accidentally ordered a drink, but overall I liked this bowl. The fish maw soup was too thick and didn't look very appetizing.
sample_reviews_en.author: S M

sample_reviews_en.text: It's incredibly delicious! The flavors are perfectly balanced, with a subtle, fragrant aroma, just like Hong Kong style. They use a generous amount of high-quality ingredients and put in plenty of toppings. The price is very reasonable, it's like eating noodles in Hong Kong! The noodles are perfectly cooked. I highly recommend it! Please support the auntie who runs this shop; she has a variety of dishes to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rintira Subprasong

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located in Soi Ladprao 80. Drive straight from the entrance of the soi, you'll see the first 7-Eleven, then go straight to the second 7-Eleven on the opposite side. It closes around 1 AM. The food is delicious and flavorful, the noodles are soft, the fish maw soup is tasty, and most importantly, everything is reasonably priced – great value for money. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: au rockdj

sample_reviews_en.text: Even with a change of cooks, the noodles still taste pretty good. I ordered noodle soup to go and got four plump pork dumplings, char siu pork, and Chinese sausage. The shark fin soup was a little too starchy. The aroma filled my car as I got it to go. It's an area with shared parking spaces among the restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sujitrkul Phangphongsai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every part of the Emperor's noodles is delicious: the noodles, Chinese sausage, soft-boiled egg, and roast pork are all fragrant and generous.
The fish maw is also delicious, but after finishing it, my face went numb for a while. It would be even better if they stopped adding MSG.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jin

sample_reviews_en.text: Updated in 2025, the taste remains consistent. Even ordering for home delivery now is still delicious. Delivery is fast, and the price hasn't increased. Ordering through Robinhood makes delivery cheaper. The vendor packs everything securely in a sealed box. It's microwaveable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Choco Mori

sample_reviews_en.text: A small humble shop with heavenly flavors—Ba Mee Hong Tae was packed with delicious toppings and perfectly chewy noodles, while the shark fin soup impressed with its rich, flavorful broth and generous ingredients; both dishes are must-tries if you’re in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasapol A.

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวโบราณ เฮียบ้วย (ซอยโปโล)
restaurants.address:

10 2 Sanam Khli Alley, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old noodle shop that you can tell has been around for a long time. The walls are covered with photos of celebrities, influencers, and newspaper clippings—some faded—but this only adds to the shop's charming, old-school appeal.

Every time I come, I order the dry tom yum noodles with everything in it. This shop delivers a truly satisfying dry tom yum experience. The toppings are generous, with chunks of pork, large meatballs, fragrant broth, and they even provide a half-slice of lime to add yourself. The flavor is rich and intense, like traditional noodles that have retained their character well.

If you like tom yum noodles with lots of toppings, this shop is perfect. However, the shop is quite local, with no air conditioning and limited tables. During busy periods, you might have to share a table, and if you come in the afternoon, many items may be sold out.

There's no parking for cars, so it's more suitable for those who are planning to eat and leave rather than those who want to linger and chill for a long time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jelly bear

sample_reviews_en.text: "Traditional noodle - Soi Polo Hue Baue" is one of the best street restaurants that I tried in Bangkok. A big selection of wide noodles, thin noodles, rice noodles, egg noodles — with a large choice of meatballs, fish balls and seafood. The secret is in the family recipe, a pink sauce added to the soup upon request. The combo for 100 THB (pictured below) is definitely the best! Most other noodles are 50 - 60 THB. Indoor seating with an open-air front of the shop. My favourite place for lunch, several times a week.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marko Lovrekovic

sample_reviews_en.text:
This noodle shop has a generous amount of toppings, and the various ingredients are tasty. The broth is fragrant, but the overall taste is a little too salty for my liking. It's a small shop located on the roadside in Soi Polo, probably seating about 20-30 people. If you go during mealtime, you'll have to wait a while, about half an hour. They also have other menu items besides noodles, like dry rice porridge and things like that.
I ordered a dry-fried Yen Ta Fo to take home, and that dish was also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: U-Maraj S.

sample_reviews_en.text: The tom yum noodle soup looked good with the ingredients, but the taste was disappointing. It seems they didn't use real lime (it must be expensive right now). The stir-fried noodles were also too salty; even though a previous customer complained, it was still too salty. The staff seems to lack attention to detail. It's a shame considering the restaurant's long-standing reputation.
sample_reviews_en.author: พีระ ชโลธร

sample_reviews_en.text:
Giving you a real local experience with the set up. the food is amazing! We love the broth so much it’s clear and testy. We ordered noodle and it is one of the best places in Thailand for us and we are local :)
Service is also very nice. Staff is friendly and helpful !!

No parking though so you should park at lumpini park and walk here
sample_reviews_en.author: Pat PZ

sample_reviews_en.text:
A must, local, truly street food you need try once or more. Taste is good but not that exceptional, if you don’t like sweetness or MSG, you’d better tell the staffs.

Many LINE man (food riders) visit during 11:00-12:00 and the shop needs to close. Quite a busy restaurant. Better come/order before 11:00. The owner is kind and polite.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patchima Chantaren

sample_reviews_en.text: Another favorite noodle shop. It is an old shop that has been open for a long time. There are only a few tables in the shop. If you come at noon, you might have to wait a while to get a table. The taste is good and the ingredients are full. I recommend ordering fried pork rinds to eat with it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattapong Manothai

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is one of my favorite restaurants for delicious minced pork noodles. They have a diverse menu including Tom Yum noodles, Yen Ta Fo noodles, wonton noodles, basil chicken rice, and steamed dumplings. The taste is excellent.
The only downside is that parking is a bit difficult to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: wan wong

restaurants.name: Samsen Kitchen@WAT TRI
restaurants.address:

192/4 Soi Wora Phong, Khwaeng Ban Phan Thom, Khet Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited here with Biw (Kultida) and we had a genuinely good meal, the kind where the food does most of the talking. There is air conditioning, which matters in Bangkok, and a small music stage in the background that adds some atmosphere without being intrusive. Biw rated the food 5 out of 5, which from a Thai person eating Thai food is about as reliable an endorsement as you can get. Service was a little slow and there was a noticeable wait between ordering and the food arriving, but the staff were visibly working to keep things moving and it did not sour the experience. Prices were reasonable for the quality on the plate. A place I would come back to, and one that holds up even when your dining companion has high standards for the cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrei Petrescu

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
One of the best restaurants in Bangkok! The restaurant is exceptionally clean, elegant, and has a warm, welcoming atmosphere. The staff are very friendly and provide excellent service. The food is incredibly delicious, fresh, and beautifully presented. Every dish was full of flavor, making the dining experience truly enjoyable. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for outstanding food and great hospitality in Bangkok. I will definitely visit again!
sample_reviews_en.author: dc hab

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered takeaway. The food and smoothie were great. It's just difficult for vegetarians! Fish doesn't seem to count as meat. That's why the "pad thai no meat" has shrimp in it! Otherwise, everything was good.

And reasonably priced.

The atmosphere is more like a street food stall, but the kitchen and everything else was very clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Caroline Lemaitre

sample_reviews_en.text:
I dont usually put 4 stars in restaurants but this one failed in a small detail, no spicy

I asked for no spicy since I can’t stand spicy food and the waitress told me o, but at first bite I felt all of the spicyness

Its a pity since the food looks amazing but I really cant stand ir
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniela Barazarte

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent restaurant.
We ordered stir-fried basil with pork and green curry fried rice with chicken.
The combination of fried rice and curry is quite unique but perfectly seasoned. It was truly excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Léa

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a wonderful meal at Samsen Food Restaurant.

The prices are reasonable for Bangkok, and the food is really good.
I loved my dish; the spices were perfectly balanced. I highly recommend this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tristan Degrange

sample_reviews_en.text: This was a very nice place to eat. The staff were super friendly and had an awesome conversation with them. The food was cooked very well and the price is very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: luke pelham

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very welcoming family, attentive and always smiling... The meal was excellent and plentiful, bursting with flavor.
Come without hesitation, you won't be disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Eric Pyck

restaurants.name: ZONGTER
restaurants.address:

111 ถ. เจริญกรุง Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
A small dimsum and coffee shop located in the chinatown market Charoenkrung 16 called ตลาดเล่งบ่วยเอี๊ยะ, which is easy to find.

Dimsum, drinks and desserts were great taste, quite affordable and reasonable price with enough portion for 1-2person.

Not too crowded.
sample_reviews_th.author: Sujinant Pessuwan (Madam Auzzie)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food here is very delicious! Everything was delicately prepared and served with a Thai-twist Chinese food. It is very easy to eat because each dish is small. Each dish starts from 35-75 baht, it is quite high price per dish because of small quantity, but I think overall is quite valuable because this restaurant gives nice vibes and clean environment. So if you are tired from walking around the area and want to enjoy simple Chinese food (I couldn’t say that this place serves Authentic Chinese food- it is rather thai-style chinese food for thai people), this place is for you.

However, service could be better. Seems like there is no proper staff who takes care of seating area and there are only 2-3 staffs - which are not enough to serve and arrange everything for customers properly. We have to find our own seat and come down to order ourselves. Even we want to order 2nd round of food but in the end we didn’t because of long queues and no proper management to the seating and ordering queue.
sample_reviews_en.author: KOKO

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a shop I've walked past so many times but never stopped by because I was always in a hurry to shop and move on.
I'm so glad I finally got to visit today!
The taro dish lives up to its reputation; it's fragrant, soft, creamy, and has a well-balanced flavor.
The three-ingredient dish, especially the radish-flavored dim sum, was delightfully soft and chewy. The salted egg dim sum was perfectly sized and the surprise was the incredibly delicious sauce – I almost wanted to drink it all!
The mini fried buns were adorable and fun to eat.
The tender pork belly, served with the seafood dipping sauce and fragrant preserved mustard greens, filled my mouth with flavor.
This is a shop I could definitely come back to often.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phak Waripunth

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in the old market, very easy to get to.
Take the MRT to Wat Mangkon station, exit at the old market exit, cross the road, walk a short distance and it's on your left.

There's a wide variety of dishes to choose from.
The price, location, and decor are all reasonable.
The three dishes I ordered today were delicious.
I liked the shrimp cakes the most out of the three.

The portion sizes aren't large; they come in small bowls.

The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, a pleasant place to sit, and there's also a mezzanine level.

When I went around 10:30 AM, there were hardly any people.
The food didn't take long to arrive.

For one person, including drinks, it cost less than 200 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนิดา ธีระภิญโญ

sample_reviews_en.text:
ZONGTER – Delicious Dim Sum & Relaxing Vibe
ZONGTER is a hidden gem for anyone craving authentic flavors in a calm, quiet setting.

The Food: They offer a wide variety of delicious dim sum. Whether you go for the savory ones or the sweet options, you won't be disappointed.

The Tea: I had the traditional brewed green tea, which was very decent and paired perfectly with the meal.

The Vibe: It’s a peaceful place where you can sit down and enjoy your food away from the crowds.

Perfect for any time: A great spot for both breakfast and lunch.

A must-visit if you're looking for high-quality dumplings and a moment of peace.
sample_reviews_en.author: Qbus Pil

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a fantastic spot for dim sum! If you're exploring Chinatown and feeling hungry, you should definitely visit this place. They serve a wide variety of delicious dim sum dishes, all freshly prepared and full of authentic flavor. The traditional Chinese ambiance adds to the charm, making it a delightful dining experience. Whether you're a fan of dumplings, buns, or other dim sum classics, this place won’t disappoint. A must-visit for anyone craving tasty dim sum in a cozy, cultural setting!
sample_reviews_en.author: SK Katair

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious! A tiny place tucked away in the market alley. Their food was good quality and has a great price.

The space is really small but their atmosphere didnt feel cramped or uncomfortable. It was a little hard for the staffs to tend to people upstair but it wasn’t too hard to try call them from above.

No parking of their own but there are a few paid parking lots not too far away.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nawacharee P

sample_reviews_en.text:
I liked the retro Hong Kong-style Chinese atmosphere – small lights, tables with sofas, a semi-cafe vibe.

The menu was diverse, and everything was delicious. The lava-filled fried buns were served hot, not too hot to burn your mouth, and perfectly sweet and delicious. Other dishes I can't remember the names of were also tasty, and the dipping sauce was fantastic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karn Santidhananon

restaurants.name: be4 SteakHouse
restaurants.address:

36/6 Soi Prasert-Manukitch 18, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We went in the morning. The New Orleans chicken smelled bad because it wasn't heated enough, but we had already finished eating. The staff apologized and offered to make a new one, but we declined because we had other things to do. In the end, they didn't give us a discount and charged the regular price. We understand that the restaurant offered a new dish and we declined, but when we got home, my sibling said the ribs also smelled bad but didn't tell the staff. We think maybe it was too early in the morning, we went before noon. We've eaten there many times before, and this is probably our last time there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Skuntala Thongmee

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is one of my favorite restaurant. Many delicious dishes. Good customer care staff, reasonable price

𝐑𝐞𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐝 𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐮: mashed potatoes, tuna salad,Bacon Rolls, watermelon smoothie

𝐌𝐞𝐧𝐮:
𝐇𝐞𝐫𝐛 𝐆𝐚𝐫𝐥𝐢𝐜 𝐏𝐨𝐫𝐤+𝐁𝐚𝐜𝐨𝐧 𝐑𝐨𝐥𝐥𝐬:The crispy bacon is delicious.
𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐡𝐞𝐝 𝐩𝐨𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐨𝐞𝐬+𝐣𝐚𝐩𝐚𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐞 𝐒𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐚𝐠𝐞𝐬: mashed potatoes with chunks to chew. As for the sausage, the texture is bouncy. Fragrant smell of smoky grill
𝐒𝐩𝐢𝐧𝐚𝐜𝐡 𝐜𝐡𝐞𝐞𝐬𝐞 𝐁𝐚𝐤𝐞: good taste
𝐓𝐮𝐧𝐚 𝐒𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝: Spicy salad dressing Fresh vegetables, thinly sliced ​​carrots give a very good texture.
𝐖𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐦𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐧 𝐒𝐦𝐨𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐞: Delicious, taste of watermelon like eating real watermelon.
sample_reviews_en.author: mangdanoi zzz

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is homey, comfortable, and not stuffy. The air conditioning is icy cold. I haven't been here in almost ten years. The menu has expanded significantly. Everything looks delicious. The staff is polite and the prices are reasonable.

Note: The air conditioning is incredibly cool. I like it a little. I personally don't like it half-cold.
sample_reviews_en.author: hello world

sample_reviews_en.text: The home-cooked food, especially the glass noodle salad, was delicious. The mashed potatoes were incredibly creamy and the gravy was fantastic. The tuna salad had a slightly spicy dressing that complemented the dish well. Overall, the food was delicious and worth the price. The atmosphere was warm and inviting.
sample_reviews_en.author: gates K

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent food menu with a variety of Thai and Western dishes, all reasonably priced. Their combination plates are very nice, with a mix of steak, pork, and fish options.

There is seating both indoors and outdoors, with limited parking on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: That Guy

sample_reviews_en.text: I have to say, having tried many restaurants around Bangkok, this one gets the number one spaghetti. It's perfectly cooked, not mushy, and the flavors are rich and infused into every dish, whether it's spaghetti, steak, or fried shrimp – I …
sample_reviews_en.author: วรัตน์ เรืองสิทธพงศ์

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is located in a side street and has been open for a very long time. The food is delicious and the prices are reasonable. You can park your car near the front of the restaurant. You are welcome to bring your own wine to enjoy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Art Art

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my family's regular restaurant. I come here often. The food is delicious, good quality, and clean. The steak is very delicious. The tuna salad has the best dipping sauce. Overall, every dish is delicious. I recommend you try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: BabySai

restaurants.name: Charmkrung
restaurants.address:

6th floor 839 ถ. เจริญกรุง Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Another packed day of shopping, eating sightseeing to Jim Thompsoms House, and finally a stop off at a very lovely localish spot.
Charmkrung is the bigger sister of Charmgang downstairs across the road.
From what I was told, they had better wines, better seating, better views, better vibes.
Sounded good, so we tuktuked our asses over there!
We walked in as it was  opening and it was empty at 6,  but full by 7.
Service was fast but relaxed, with a room mixing affluent locals and foreign like us seamlessly, without any awkwardness.
Food was way above average with great flavours and quality, and the chefs showed real skill. Direct, salty sweet and meant to be eaten quickly.
The Beef Martabak Wellington is one not to be missed, the duck was also fantastic... which was tough couse we had already rated one of the starters a solid 9.2/10 🤣
(Dry aged fish sitting on a betel leaf btw! Don't miss it either to be fair)
All washed down with a sparkling rosè and a sparkling water.
A chilled spot with no pretence.
Just good drinks and fab bowls in a district that feels local, lived in and quietly confident.
sample_reviews_en.author: Will Knight

sample_reviews_en.text:
Being a fan of Charmkrung and the other restaurants the group has in Bangkok, and a regular customer, we were not satisfied during our last visit. It felt like a clear downgrade from what we were used to.
The space was charming and packed, and the team was working like a machine — but in a robotic way, less engaging and less warm than before.
For me, food and beverage is what matters most, and that’s where the biggest drop happened. The overall standard has clearly dropped. The food felt bland, missing the layers of flavor and depth they used to create. Some dishes even tasted very similar to each other. It felt like steps had been cut in order to handle a higher volume of guests. Maybe being fully booked and successful has pushed the kitchen to become more tourist-friendly, less Thai flavor intensity and less sharp execution than on previous visits.

At 5,000 baht for two , and having been there several times , I found it very poor value for money, even outrageous.

It feels like we’ve lost one of our favorite Thai restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Taka Honda

sample_reviews_en.text:
My wife made a reservation here for our date night and the experience was incredible. The place is dimly lit with rustic chic decor which creates a great vibe and the diner profile is very international. We reserved counter seats which allowed us to watch all the action in the kitchen. It was really cool to see the team executing all the dishes like clockwork. The service was prompt, attentive, and friendly throughout the evening.

The food was amazing and there were several standout dishes. We started with the betel leaf with cured fish and the lemongrass and coconut salad with deep fried pomfret and grilled pork belly. The salad was really delicious and perfectly prepared. We also had the fish curry with galangal and fresh cumin leaves, which was excellent.

The cocktails were also a highlight of the night. The Saneha gin and tonic was very good and the Thai Espresso Martini was perfect because it was strong with just a hint of sweetness. This is a top tier dining experience and I look forward to going back for more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Honest Reviews Only

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was really good, the portions quite big and the dishes weren't overly spicy. One thing that surprised me was the THB 80 per person charge for FREE FLOW TAP WATER.

One thing I think they could improve is communication regarding reservations. I booked by phone and on the day of the reservation a staff called me to confirm it. About an hour later another staff called me again to reconfirm and mentioned that our table would only be available until 8:30 pm (my reservation was at 6:00 pm).

Since we weren't aware of the time limit, my friend called the restaurant to double-check. The staff told us that the 2.5 hour seating limit had been mentioned in a confirmation email. The thing is I made the reservation by phone, wasn't told about the time limit during the call and never received any confirmation email.

However, the staff were very polite when handling the situation, and everyone at the restaurant was friendly and attentive throughout the evening.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tana

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place was buzzing of expat crowd! And the food was so satisfying. We started with some cocktails. To start with, we ordered the tomato 🍅 and crab 🦀 salad which was so tangy and addicting. We also ordered the curries mussels which was super rich and paired extremely will the the heap of fried onions and toasty bread. For the mains, we ordered the eggplant 🍆 with minced pork 🐷and cod - somehow i thought the cod was unnecessary, the eggplant with the minced meet was so addictive - almost like a basil pork flavor but with eggplant. The cod was buttery soft but wasn’t the star of this dish. And finally we had the grilled catfish 🐠 - it was extremely flavourful and grilled to perfection. It came with a sweet sauce which paired so well together.
The team was extremely kind to share a bit of a creme brulee as a sweet ending!
Would definitely come back to try rest of the menu ✨🇹🇭
sample_reviews_en.author: Angshula Das

sample_reviews_en.text:
We booked a table in advance to welcome our crews from BC, but ended up had to wait at the bar even we showed up earlier than our booking time.

The service s nice overall, only some tried to clear a table while we are still eating and didnt have more order to come.

All dishes are good (esp the oyster very fresh and creamy in seafood sauce) tasty, nice fusion design.

But some as  the curry that came out too salty, even we mentioned our concern to  a staff, they insisted that it should be salty this way( That is our main complaint), another was dried beef that came out pretty hard but it s ok.

We ended up been served my coconut ice-cream which led us to think that is a way to apologize but not really as we noticed that the staff also served these to other tables.

Overall is good except some concerns that didnt get any solution till the end.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bowie Y.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Awesome night out with family
Thai fusion taken to next level covering all aspects of taste partners with friendly knowledgeable service in a comfortable vibrant atmosphere.
We ordered a mixture of bites mains and desert, all hit the spot with a surprise in every tasting as the flavours took as down a journey of Thai flavours done in a clever but simple way with the perfect bite never far away.
The betel leaf or the pork jowl on tofu both great mouth fulls , followed with a salad with pork sausage and pomfret chicken wings and pork terrain
Balanced exquisite tastes
Beef brisket suckling pork with rice and rotis absolutely amazing deep flavours with excellent texture balance
All three desserts hit the spot and continued the journey of fusion Thai flavours .
Incredibly well put together meal and we all enjoyed it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shannon Wong

sample_reviews_en.text: Finally we enjoyed a nice dinner at Charmkrung. Another great option in this neighbourhood. Can’t get wrong eating here! We enjoyed a seating at the bar counter watching the chefs preparing meals and the activities around the bar. Loved all dishes from starter to dessert. Each meal was packed with flavours and beautifully created. Loved to start with  stuffed tofu and beancurd relish topped with smoked pork Jowl. So good !!! Also the Beatle leaf topped with Trevally are super delicious. The grilled chicken wings are very good too. Make sure you get the Pavlova for dessert. It’s not your ordinary Pavlova. Must try! The staff is very good and friendly overall very good  energy and vibes in this place. Also nice decor! Have to come back to try more dishes! Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: Angie L-S

restaurants.name: Sumi Tei Yakiniku
restaurants.address:

Marche Thonglor Room, Marche Thonglor, 2nd Floor Building B 144, Number THL02LS205, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered the A5 Imperial set and realized that the meat tasted sweet after 2-3 pieces. Server mentioned that the A5 Wagyu was served on sweet soy marinade and we have to tell them not to serve this way. I asked if this is really the case and mentioned that I do not like seasoned sauces on A5 Wagyu. They said this is really the case and refused to change remaining meat to non-marinated.

After eating and getting the bill, manager came and apologized because they made mistake and should have put two sauces on the side or asked us if we wanted the sauces at all. Offered only a 10% discount for the meal which we took. The mistake ruined the A5 set experience, which was not cheap here to start off with. I will not go back since there are better options out there without server lying to us that A5 set is served with marinade on the meat. This is your mistake and you should have comped the entire A5 set as a jesture.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Cai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sumitei is easy to find and offers a refined, comfortable atmosphere with private rooms—perfect for business dinners or special occasions.

The wagyu is directly sourced from Japan and transported without freezing under strict temperature control, ensuring exceptional freshness and quality.

Since its founding, the restaurant has focused on bringing out the best flavors through precise charcoal grilling, allowing you to fully enjoy the natural taste of premium ingredients.

The signature set features A5-grade Japanese wagyu, including zabuton, sirloin, and karubi—an irresistible selection for meat lovers. Other highlights like squid ink curry, komutan soup, and Japanese strawberries with nama chocolate are also excellent.

If you’re looking for authentic, high-quality wagyu charcoal yakiniku in Bangkok, this is a must-visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploy Chanida

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my go-to Yakiniku spot in Bangkok. I used to go to Tokyo Yakiniku, but quality there has fallen recently, while Sumi Tei is completely reliable

Great selection of Japanese and local beef, vegetables for grill, with truly excellent sauces to pair them with. Namuru and Kimchi are excellent quality. The soups are fantastic as well.

They sell shiso shochu, which is one of my favorites to mix with sencha green tea for a clean lightly sweet flavor

Order the butterhead lettuce to wrap your grilled beef in. Delicious

Embarrassingly, I sometimes go here by myself and eat what should be a dinner for 2

On another note, it’s easy to eat a near-keto meal here, plus probiotics from the real kimchi
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris T

sample_reviews_en.text: I have to admit, the quality of the meat at this restaurant is amazing. They really give you a generous portion. However, the price is also very high. This time, I also tried the beef curry. The beef was stewed perfectly until tender, and the flavor of the beef in the curry was clear and not overpowered. It was delicious, but the portion was very small, with only 4 pieces of beef. Overall, I'm still impressed. The atmosphere is much better after they moved locations. I recommend calling to reserve a table in advance because there are limited seats, so it's often full. We called to reserve and got a private room, which was very private.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattari Wongwattanasan

sample_reviews_en.text:
1st attempt of this rstn for my recent BKK trip(4.3.23).
The A5 beef was super delicious as this is the 1st time I try to hv beef (all the while,don't dare to eat beef) for BBQ
We r shocking when we settled our bill for the night as it cost us Baht 25,842
.00😅
But we r happy w the warm caring services provided by the manager(Mr Max) n 2 sweet colleague (Ms Sirinda & Mr Dis). They helped us booking for grab n having a few calls to the driver to ensure we r getting to the right destination n ensure we r safe on our way.
Nevertheless, no regret of paying such a expensive meal w such a caring people around while travelling overseas
sample_reviews_en.author: Joanne Loh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sumitei Reserve is hands down the best Yakiniku omakase in Bangkok!

The restaurant serves amazing beef dishes that are all sourced from Japan (so you don’t need to fly all the way to Japan!) . The omakase style means you do not have to grill the meat by yourself and the chef also prepares many interesting styles of beef. (My favorite dish is the Chateaubriand). The price is also very reasonable, as you get to try different styles of Japanese beef that you probably can’t find elsewhere in Bangkok. I will definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamolwat Ratanachai

sample_reviews_en.text: Even in Bangkok's fiercely competitive Sukhumvit area for yakiniku (Japanese BBQ), Sumitei stands out for its unwavering commitment to quality. They offer both private rooms and counter seating. From the homemade kimchi and namul to the exquisite flavors of the meat, fat, and even the seafood, everything is superb. This time, I had the charcoal-grilled tenderloin, perfectly cooked to the highest degree, allowing me to savor the finest lean meat. I also recommend the squid ink curry and the raw chocolate and strawberry dessert.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tsuyoshi K

sample_reviews_en.text:
Booked here for a special dinner with my girlfriend.

The food is excellent. We ordered one of the buffet options and a few other meat dishes. The meat is very good quality.

As were the sides and vegetables.

The staff were great. Regularly changing the grill.

And the restaurant prepared a special dessert for us, which had yuzu, chocolate, and something else. Also great.

Finally it's a private atmosphere. We had a room to ourselves. Which could hold up to 8 people.

Would recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brian Lavery

restaurants.name: Otto Pizza Bangkok
restaurants.address:

4, 21 Soi Sukhumvit 8, Klongtoey Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Otto’s pizza is simply exceptional.  I had the Borbona Truffle Pizza.  The crust was excellent, with the right mixture of crunch and chewiness.  The ingredients were high quality and generous.  The truffle was a nice touch and did not overwhelm the pie.  There are only 3 tables, and there is no a/c, so it might be better to order to take out.  They were doing a lot of delivery business while I was there.  This is some of the best pizza I have had in Thailand.  I fully recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Keith Moore

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent pizza here. I was a bit hesitant due to the touristy location but to be honest, I haven't had better pizza in Thailand. The crust is often the secret to good pizza and this was perfect, not too soft, not too hard. Will definitely return when I'm in the area.
The drinks are a bit pricey but got a free Coke Zero with the pizza so cant really complain.
sample_reviews_en.author: eltel22

sample_reviews_en.text: OTTO Pizza on Soi 8 is one of the best pizza spots in Bangkok. The crust is perfectly crisp and chewy, the ingredients taste fresh, and the flavors are well balanced without being heavy. The atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming, and the staff are friendly and attentive. Definitely a place worth coming back to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Beach Life

sample_reviews_en.text: Roaming around bangkok, we just got to this little pizza place reading google reviews..while the pizza was decent, slightly charred. Our kid demanded water, this small shop charged us 60 baht for 600ml water bottle almost 10 times, what u get at 7 eleven..that's cheating
sample_reviews_en.author: Nitin Arora

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing wood fired pizza with airy and crispy crust that’s really hard to achieve. Coming from New York which is Mecca pizza capital of world, I’ve have numerous pizza slices in my lifetime and this place surely holds up to its own. They …
sample_reviews_en.author: abcdan

sample_reviews_en.text: The pizza was okay, nothing special, but edible. Unfortunately, the place itself is extremely small – in the evenings there's no air circulation at all and it feels very stuffy. It wasn't very comfortable to eat there. Next time, I would …
sample_reviews_en.author: Rein Sõõrd

sample_reviews_en.text: Tasty and big and in my opinion very authentic to how Italian style pizzas are (very UNlike American style pies). They ingredients are fresh and quite flavorful and I feel this is a little bit more authentic because they do not have any …
sample_reviews_en.author: DK Lo

sample_reviews_en.text: Otto Pizza on Sukhumvit 8 is a fantastic find — authentic wood-fired pizza in one of Bangkok's most lively bar areas, and I keep coming back for more. The brick oven is the real deal and you can taste the difference in every bite. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexander Ericsson

restaurants.name: OZAWA RAMEN ปตท.ราชพฤกษ์-สวนผัก
restaurants.address:

59/3 ห้อง 3 ปตท.เหรียญทอง Ratchaphruek Rd, ตลิ่งชัน Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍜 Osawa Ramen – Delicious and Great Value, No Need to Fly to Japan!
Mid-range prices but quality exceeds expectations. High-quality ingredients, chewy noodles, perfectly runny boiled eggs, and incredibly rich pork bone broth – not greasy at all! Plus, service is super fast!

🔥 Highly Recommended:
• Tonkotsu Ramen: Rich and flavorful broth.
• Spicy Ramen: A real wake-up call! Seriously spicy!
• Amazing: Fragrant garlic butter fried rice and thin-crusted, crispy-on-the-outside, soft-on-the-inside gyoza.
• You can add karaage, fried rice, or gyoza at reasonable prices – great value!

🧊 Cleanse your palate with a refreshing, unsweetened Mugicha (wheat tea).

🪑 Small, clean, comfortable seating, and authentic Japanese decor.
❤️ Osawa Ramen is amazing – words speak louder than words, just try it yourself!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarawut Chinpaisan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ramen is delicious, affordable, and has a flavor that suits Thai tastes. Prices start at less than 100 baht.
•Special Miso Ramen: Large bowl with big slices of pork, bamboo shoots, and a boiled egg. The soup is delicious, slightly sweet. 200 baht.
•Zaru Ramen: With pork on top. 125 baht.
•Gyoza: Decent, 3 pieces for 45 baht.
•Tantan: Strong flavor with a hint of sweetness. Contains peanuts and sesame seeds. This bowl was just okay, perhaps because I don't like the umami flavor.

Overall, delicious, affordable, and good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: attpocari

sample_reviews_en.text:
-Tan Tan Ramen: Rich flavor, intense sesame aroma, incredibly delicious. The noodles are soft and made to order.
-Eel rice bowl: Premium quality, especially paired with wasabi. It's a perfect match.

Overall, I give it 5 stars. It's even more delicious than the famous ones in the mall. The price is reasonable and great value.

P.S. I can't believe how far away these good ramen shops in PTT gas stations are. It's so convenient and saves me the time to fight for parking in the mall. I'll definitely stop by before heading home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lucky pook

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the Katsu Ramen.

I personally prefer noodles that are chewy and slightly springy, but the noodles I received felt more like cold vermicelli... maybe that's the restaurant's style.

The broth was average in taste, but I appreciate that it wasn't too salty.

The restaurant is located in a PTT gas station, so parking is convenient. 👍🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: Nitcha

sample_reviews_en.text:
This ramen shop is so delicious you'll want to slurp up every last drop of broth. Both the soup and the noodles are flavorful. It's served as a set with your choice of fried chicken or gyoza. Trust me, you'll be completely full and want several more bowls!

Note: The shop is located inside PTT Ratchaphruek-Suan Phak.
sample_reviews_en.author: Katai Pornvipa

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ramen was delicious, with a decent flavor. The staff were very helpful and informative.
The only downside was the poor ventilation. The restaurant smelled of food, and the food lingered on my hair, body, and clothes. After eating, it could be annoying if I had other things to do or if I had just washed my hair.
sample_reviews_en.author: ** PYMN **

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is great! We had the Osawa Ramen. We really enjoy visiting this place, and another highlight is the Karaage chicken. The meat is incredibly juicy, the pieces are large and satisfying, and it's served piping hot. I wish this branch offered larger Karaage sets; I love them so much!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kt Th

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is clean, the food tastes good, the prices are reasonable for the portion sizes, the staff are friendly and smiling, and most importantly, the air conditioning is perfect for this weather. Oh, and there are power outlets available for those who like to sit for a long time.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณรงค์ธรรม สุขเกษม

restaurants.name: Ruenthai Restaurant
restaurants.address:

485 Pattaya Sai Song Rd, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
At Christmas Eve, where could be better for us to enjoy a nice restaurant like here. The dancers are really cheerful and happy here.

Steam sea bass fish at ฿500. We need to order additional chili and lime to get the “kick” as foreigners (farang) prefer more light/bland food.
Green curry chicken ฿180, taste ok.
Grill squid at ฿280, ok.
Tomyam seafood ฿300, ok.
Chang beer big bottle at ฿150 each. Quite cheap here. Total bill for 4 pax is ฿1650, which is cheaper than last night normal coffee shop.

Overall, the service and the traditional dance are very good here. Must visit 👍🏼👏🏼
sample_reviews_th.author: Albert Khor

sample_reviews_en.text: Came here for dinner with a few friends. Was hoping to see a Thai dance show but as we went there on a Tuesday there were no shows until Friday/Saturday and Sunday. I suspect it'll be 7 nights a week once the Thai tourism numbers recover to somewhere near precovid. However place is nice, plenty of tables to accommodate in the region of 100 plus people, probably more. We sat outside under the stars. We ordered some green curry, Tom yum soup, spring rolls, lab moo, fish cake things, rice and a few beers. Food and service was ok but nothing to rave about. That said the place was nice under the stars. Overall it's a nice place but it's a little tourist orientated and that might affect the quality a little. Cost all in was a little over 1300 baht which was fair. 4/5 stars. It's nice place to have dinner with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrew L.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Large restaurant with indoor and outdoor seating, outside is open with lots of trees and plants also small water feature. Also has a stage where traditional Thai dance and music is performed, I ate very late so no entertainment for me to comment on.The watermelon smoothie was good and tasted of watermelon!!!
The chicken in kale I know it's only chicken but it was some of the most succulent moist tasty chicken I have had in a long time.The chicken in banana leaf gave it a distinct flavour not overly pleasant but the accompanying coleslaw/ sauerkraut was delicious and a nice palate cleanser.Not the cheapest of places but for the location design ambiance live show well worth a visit
PS did wake up the next day with several Mossie bites be warned.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Christou

sample_reviews_en.text:
I saw some really good review from Google, hence I decided to come and witness it myself in Nov 2024. I took the opportunity to go Ripley's Believe It or Not in Royal Garden Plaze which is located opposite of this restaurant. They have obviously large signboard at the junction of the road and you have to walk a little into the lane for the restaurant. This restaurant doesn't just give you very presentable dishes but they come with Thai traditional costume dancing. We ordered 1) deep fried flathead lobster 🦞 with garlic 2) tom yum kong 3) mango salad 4) grilled pork neck and of course thai milk tea!!
We enjoyed ourselves with fantastic food and dancing from the ladies.. couldn't ask for more from a restaurant 👏🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: MK Leong

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're looking for a relaxing, authentic Thai meal in Pattaya, this is the place for you. In a beautiful space surrounded by traditional architecture, you can enjoy authentic Thai cuisine, not Asian fusion. Even when you order a moderate level of spiciness, the rich flavor of herbs and spices remains, leaving a lasting impression. While you're dining, there are performances of Thai dance and live music, making for an elegant experience that feels like you've traveled back in time. The staff are friendly and speak English! This is a must-visit restaurant for any Pattaya visitor, where you can enjoy delicious food and a cultural experience all at once.
sample_reviews_en.author: アムロ礼

sample_reviews_en.text: Great experience, the food is amazing, didn’t knew but we witnessed a very nice dancing performance. We had seafood soup, tell them not spicy because in the menu it doesn t show the spicy sign but it actually was very spicy, so amazing soup but let them know that you do not want spicy just to be sure. We took a grea seabawa fish, pinapple rice with raisins and other stuff mixed. Then was the beef hot plate very cheap and tasty. Very nice staff, understood very well english. So 5 stars for this fine thai restaurant in Pattaya. Keep up the good work!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tiberiu Nicolae Stanescu

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were here with a big group of friends, half Thai, half foreigners and it was an amazing experience! I can recommend this place for a nice dining in this beautiful atmosphere in the evening. The food was very tasty and the service was always there. Not cheap but the quality was fresh and the dishes were authentic. It was really worth it! This is a must see and visit when you are in Pattaya in my opinion :)

And on top of all that good and tasty food - they have the Thai dance show in the evening - super amazing 😊🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Maik

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best places in town for an authentic Thai meal. This was recommended by our hotel person and we were not disappointed

The place has a very calming look and the food is prepared fresh. The taste of the food was extremely good. All ingredients were also very fresh

We ordered for prawns. Red Thai curry and jasmine rice. And all the three dishes were amazing. The REd Thai curry here is a must have.

The place serves beer also

The service was efficient and the staff was very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Su

restaurants.name: สมยงตำซั่ว สีลม
restaurants.address:

18 1 Convent Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, and the prices are standard for this area. The menu is diverse, the restaurant stays open late (no rush), there are plenty of tables, and there's a restroom, but it wasn't very clean; the faucet was broken, and I'm not sure if it's been repaired. When we walked in, my son slipped and hit his shoulder on the table because of water dripping from the air conditioner on the floor. The staff came to wipe it up but didn't ask if he was okay. The restaurant floor wasn't very clean; there were pieces of food like pork rinds on it. I was surprised to step on something large.

Inside the restaurant, there's an air-conditioned room, a fan zone, and an outdoor area to choose from. However, due to the high PM2.5 levels lately, we chose to sit in the air-conditioned room.

The food tasted good in every dish. We ordered non-spicy because we had children with us, and everything was non-spicy, which was great. The chef is very attentive.

The price listed is for 2 adults and 2 children.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krissana L

sample_reviews_en.text:
Before I decide to go to this restaurant, I checked its reviews on Google Maps. But, for my surprise, my experience and the food were far far away from the ratings.

I ordered a fried rice, a very popular dish in Bangkok. I know almost all local restaurants can do it well. But I was wrong. Here, it was the saddest and the most tasteless food I’ve had in the city. A food without thai soul. So disappointing.

To make it better, I even tried to ask the waiter to bring me some fish sauce, chilli and sugar - the special trio of sides every restaurant offers here in Bangkok - but unfortunately he just brought me some pepper in vinegar.

If you are thinking about having lunch or dinner here, please dont. There are a bunch of better local restaurants just one block away, near Silom Complex Shopping Mall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leo Longo

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came here specifically because the restaurant offers a vegetarian menu. I ordered the Pad Thai Tofu from that menu and was very surprised when it arrived topped with shrimp. When I pointed this out to the staff, they acted as if this was normal and suggested that I simply move the shrimp to the side.

Eventually, they did offer to remake the dish without shrimp and brought a new plate within about five minutes. However, while I was eating, the chef kept looking over at us, and it felt as though the staff were talking about us. This made the atmosphere extremely uncomfortable. Unfortunately, the Pad Thai also had a strange taste.

The restaurant may be fine for non-vegetarians, but based on this experience, I would not recommend it to vegetarians.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gritt Bröning

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the best somtum (papaya salad) restaurant in the Convent Lane area. Every dish is delicious and suits my taste perfectly. I could eat here again and again without getting bored. I'm drooling just thinking about it!

Especially the grilled pork neck and grilled chicken – they're amazing! So delicious it'll make your taste buds explode!

I recommend calling to reserve a table.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanida Tul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Four dishes for three people.
That works out to less than 200 baht per person! 😋
My favorite dish was the mushroom curry; it was delicious, flavorful, and perfectly balanced. 🍄
The grilled pork neck was equally delicious—tender, fragrant, and so enjoyable to eat. ❤️
Delicious, great value, and affordable. Anyone who likes Northeastern Thai food should definitely try it! 😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Todsapol Meeboonsamer

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was very delicious!

I liked the fried morning glory very much. The sauce was very very good. The Tom Sep was a bit different from what I’ve tried before but it was still very good.

The restaurant offers a lot of options. The prices feel very affordable for the quality of the food you get. I’m definitely coming back here to try other food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tony Kim

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I ordered Tom Yum soup and Som Tum (papaya salad) in a tray. It was my first time trying them and they were delicious. The Tom Yum soup was perfectly spicy with plenty of pork, and the Som Tum was a huge portion at a very reasonable price. I'll definitely be back for a second time!
sample_reviews_en.author: Vilailak Usaprom

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. The papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce was excellent, using the correct type of fermented fish sauce. The grilled pork neck salad used good quality pork. The grilled chicken was tender. The fried shrimp patties were not oily and were very tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: patty S.

restaurants.name: Hua Potchana
restaurants.address:

288, 79 Phuttha Bucha 38 Alley, Bang Mot, Thung Khru, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Premium service that will impress everyone.
The pandan-flavored rice porridge is delicious, served quickly, and tastes good—not mind-blowing, but definitely tasty.

The staff are incredibly attentive to customers. Excellent management.

When they see a car pulling into the restaurant, they rush to greet it. When they see customers entering, they rush to greet them as well. They are so attentive. When it rained and there was standing water, they even cleared the puddles (the ultimate in attentiveness and customer care!). The restaurant and restrooms are clean.

However, there's one thing I'd like to see improved: the consistency of the rice porridge portions. Some days it's the right amount, other days it's just broth. On another day, when I mentioned it was only broth, they just gave me rice. My hope of enjoying the broth was dashed. So I just stopped complaining and just ate whatever I got. That's the only thing I'd like them to improve. Other than that, everything is fantastic! Everyone at the restaurant is lovely—the owner, his son, and all the staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: a STORY Telling

sample_reviews_en.text:
Oyster omelet, fried grouper with garlic, preserved radish omelet, stir-fried coconut shoots with oyster sauce, rice porridge.
This was my first time trying this restaurant, and it was delicious! The price was reasonable, they have a large menu, the food came quickly, and they even gave me two chestnuts to eat. The staff were enthusiastic, there's parking available, and there are tables both with and without air conditioning. You can come and eat here. I haven't tried the fried intestines with garlic yet, I'll try it next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tarnthip Phothitantimongkol

sample_reviews_en.text: I highly recommend this restaurant. I've been eating here since it was near Major Suk Sawat, over 30 years ago. It was run by the father's generation, and now it's run by the son. All the food is delicious. I recommend the Betong chicken, braised bamboo shoots and Chinese flowers, braised sole fish, and crispy duck with basil – everything is tasty. The prices are also reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Molee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food arrived so quickly, it was like they knew what I was going to order 😂 I eat here very often. I love the stir-fried pork with preserved plums, the fried intestines, the stir-fried chives with tofu, and their rice porridge which is chewy with a faint pandan leaf aroma. Every time I come, it feels so warm and comforting.
The restaurant now has an air-conditioned room too!
sample_reviews_en.author: Punnapatcharee Chotthanakuljira

sample_reviews_en.text: If you like the style of Thai rice porridge (khao tom kui), I recommend this place. The food tastes good, the service is good, there are plenty of staff, and most importantly, the food comes out very quickly. There's parking behind the restaurant, it's a bit small, about 10 cars, but there's someone to direct and watch your car, so you can rest assured. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirichok Pairthong

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant serving made-to-order dishes that's very popular, but the service is relatively fast. The food tastes generally good, and there's a wide variety to choose from. The prices are affordable, and there's convenient parking. It's another restaurant I'd consider visiting again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: PK

sample_reviews_en.text: Air-conditioned rooms are now available. It's very cold, so prepare jackets and long pants for elderly guests. The food is delicious, and the beer is ice-cold. This is another popular restaurant in Phutthabucha. I recommend the braised duck, Betong chicken, bamboo shoot stew, and fried sea bass with fish sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: โจว พ่อเอวา

sample_reviews_en.text: I recommend ordering the Betong chicken dish // The bamboo shoot soup is a safe bet // Overall, the food isn't overly sweet and the prices are reasonable // The air-conditioned room is a bit cramped, so you'll be sitting close together // The transgender staff member is friendly and provides good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Busaba S

restaurants.name: Nonna Nella by Lenzi
restaurants.address:

83, ออล ซีซั่นส์ เพลส, 20 Witthayu Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overpriced for what it is.  Lacked genuine authentic flavour and any discernible Italian "heart".  Much better options in Bangkok.

Pizza was a winner (Diavola) but special of orecchiette tuna main was very disappointing.  Hot canned tuna with oil and a sprig of basil did not win our affection, expected at least some seared tuna loin.

Atmosphere was dreadful.  Spent the evening in the firing line of a table of aspiring Russian influencers snapping pictures of two blonde girlfriends with their SLR cameras.  Could the restaurant not ban this type of activity as there were many families just trying to enjoy a simple family dinner? It made it worse that our daughter was in direct firing line of the camera and no one even considered asking for our permission nor did the restaurant take any steps to stop said "Insta photo shoot"

We will eat elsewhere next time 👎
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert Cunningham

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was disappointed with the service during my visit.
One male staff member, who was wearing a black T-shirt and glasses, kept staring at us throughout the meal in a way that made us feel very uncomfortable. Instead of feeling welcomed, I felt like I was being watched the entire time. He also came across as unfriendly and unprofessional.
The pizza was fine, but the uncomfortable service made it difficult to enjoy the experience. I hope the management pays more attention to how customers are treated.
owner should consider customer service training for that staff member. it was terrible service manner.
sample_reviews_en.author: ym Jin

sample_reviews_en.text: Advertising this restaurant as Italian or Tuscan is an insult to our cuisine. The dishes, though beautifully presented, were of terrible quality. I had rigatoni alla 'Nella', and I think I stumbled upon the poorest quality pasta I've ever eaten; I doubt it was made in Italy. They served the salad with the leaves whole and a creamy sauce—I think it was avocado—which made it slimy and, in any case, had nothing Italian about it. A truly awful experience, and the prices were truly exorbitant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ollie I.

sample_reviews_en.text: Italian food restaurant operated by same owner of Lenzi Tuscan Kitchen. The difference is this restaurant has pizza oven and more variety of cold cut & cheeses. Foods are tasty and good looking. Only one complaint is about their menus focus more on pork and beef menus, while lack of fisheries and seafood menus. Restaurant located inside office building complex which is convenient to find parking space for dinner time but bit difficult during lunch time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattapong Manothai

sample_reviews_en.text: Came here for group lunch so we ordered a bunch of foods. Don’t remember exactly but pizza with 4 cheese, tagliatelle with seafoods, pizza with grilled veggies and sausage, risotto with sausage and truffle, lasagna, mozzarella. All have authentic Italian flavors despite the lasagna and tagliatelle are bit salty for me. Location is great, nice design, good service, a bit pricey but the taste is really authentic.
sample_reviews_en.author: S Tran

sample_reviews_en.text: After a week in Thailand, we were ready for some Italian food & found this place by chance. Hesitant to go in at first coz the place was empty, the food was surprisingly good. We ordered a sausage & mushroom pizza, ravioli, Bomba alla Nutella & tiramisu. All were delicious and service was spot on. Highly recommend this place if you're tired of eating Thai food in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jocelyn Beigel

sample_reviews_en.text: When I tell you it was the top 3 Lasagnas I ever had it’s no light feet to say that! I always hesitate to order Lasagna in an Italian restaurant because I’ve been disappointed more frequently than an Italian watching the Azzuris play but this one was simply out of this world! Compliments to the Chef this is the real deal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mario Milanovic

sample_reviews_en.text: Nonna Nella by Lenzi is one of our favorite restaurants.  Whenever we are in Bangkok, we would try to schedule in a meal here.  This time it was for Christmas Eve celebration.  We ordered Rigatoni Al Ragu and Parmigiana Di Melanzane.  The dishes were cooked perfectly.  We highly recommend making a reservation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sue Poonapirat

restaurants.name: ย่างบ้านเพื่อน ( Haus of GRILL )
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 25 ถนน ลาดพร้าว 64 แยก 4 ตะวันรุ่งซอย 5 วังทองหลาง Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was excellent, the meat was top-notch. Even Thai beef was this good. The service was good; it was crowded but the wait wasn't long. The food came out steadily. The atmosphere was nice, with plenty of fans so it wasn't hot. There was live music and draft beer. The grill was always hot. There's parking available. It's better to make a reservation; walk-ins might have to wait in line. The salmon salad was good, not too spicy, not too salty, not too sour, just perfect. The oysters were incredibly good, huge and delicious.
