sample_reviews_en.author: worapong lert

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is truly like having a meal at a friend's house, living up to its name. It's a really chill vibe. The food is fresh, clean, and the flavors are perfectly balanced. The Japanese food is a must-try; the beef melts in your mouth, it's incredibly fresh and delicious. The shabu-shabu broth isn't overly salty. My favorite part is the dipping sauce – it's so refreshing! The restaurant isn't hot at all inside; it's spacious, airy, and comfortable. I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angle Candy

sample_reviews_en.text: The meat was very tender. One set was just right for two people. The atmosphere was nice, and they serve alcohol, perfect for a long after-work chat. There's parking available. It gets very crowded between 7-8 PM, so I recommend coming after 9 PM to find parking and a table. // The staff were very attentive and helpful; they were observant and always ready to assist without being asked.
sample_reviews_en.author: toondisney

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time at this restaurant and I was so impressed! The staff (especially Natt) provided excellent service (I can't remember his real name, but it might have been him!). The food has a range of prices, from expensive to affordable. The taste was good, not bad at all. I loved it and will definitely come back again. The atmosphere was great too! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
sample_reviews_en.author: bangsaen Sale

sample_reviews_en.text: "The beef is tender, the marinated pork is delicious, and the dipping sauce is very rich. It smells amazing when grilled. The ingredients are fresh and refilled quickly. The atmosphere is chill, perfect for eating with friends. If you're looking for a delicious and value-for-money BBQ restaurant, I highly recommend it! 👍"
sample_reviews_en.author: Maploy

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is amazing! There's live music, and the songs are fantastic. I don't eat beef, but the pork is equally good. They have other dishes on the menu too. The prices are reasonable, and the quality is good for the price. The staff are lovely. The restaurant has a large parking lot, which is very convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Janejirne _Rod

sample_reviews_en.text:
Waited a long time for food. Finished a whole plate of grilled meat before the vegetables even arrived. Had to ask twice. Plenty of staff, but service was slow.

Parking available in front of the restaurant.
Good atmosphere, good quality meat, good taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: OUM Waranya

sample_reviews_en.text: First off, I have to commend the taste. It's genuinely delicious, I'm not exaggerating. The meat is top-grade, tender, flavorful, and absolutely amazing. But the price is incredibly reasonable considering the quality. I felt like I got my …
sample_reviews_en.author: Chonlada Noiwong

restaurants.name: Bua
restaurants.address:

5 1 Srinagarindra Rd, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and fresh, with reservations and takeout options available. The staff are polite and courteous, and the prices are reasonable for the quality. Parking is convenient, making it perfect for families or groups of friends to enjoy a delicious and flavorful hot pot meal that suits Thai tastes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supachoke Tadrungraung

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a large restaurant with a great atmosphere, located near Seacon Square. The food is delicious, offering both Thai and Northeastern Thai (Isaan) cuisine. The staff are attentive and caring. It's perfect for socializing with friends or bringing the family. It's one of my favorite restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pannathat Amaritthivanich (Mr.Donut)

sample_reviews_en.text: I've known this restaurant for a long time. Overall, the food is very good and clean. I especially like the sour fish curry and the winged bean salad. The only downside is that the prices have gotten a bit high lately.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr.Pichai

sample_reviews_en.text: Clean, clear flavors in their Thai food. It's not rough around the edges as you would get in many hole in the wall places. I recommend it. The spare ribs roasted in honey and curries are wonderful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Isaac Sutton

sample_reviews_en.text:
I enjoy having breakfast here, especially the rice with curry.
#Inexpensive, two toppings for 50 baht.
#Nice atmosphere, comfortable seating.
#Fragrant hot tea, 2 baht per cup.
#I like it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wan Balloon

sample_reviews_en.text:
authentic thai food in a relaxing thai ambience with beautiful design, served with a smile :)
the delicious thai flavours are a pleasure. highly recommend for a good time :)
sample_reviews_en.author: green mango

sample_reviews_en.text: It's been a while since I've been here, and they set up a separate table outside, so I had a comfortable meal. Fortunately, the weather was nice and cool, which was nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: write1004 Park

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was okay, but the Tom Yum soup wasn't quite up to par. There were way too many staff members, they surrounded us, making it difficult to eat. Haha.
sample_reviews_en.author: imachi ice

restaurants.name: Hunger Bar & Grill
restaurants.address:

PGFP+3XR, 4 Suan Phlu 1 Alley, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: A real hidden gem! I never would have expected it. Unassuming, because it's not directly on the main road > very delicious food and a truly beautiful interior design with cool music and really good sound. The service was very professional, very attentive, and very friendly. Thank you 🙏❣️
sample_reviews_en.author: Olaf Beck

sample_reviews_en.text: We choose Pat Thai. After traveling in Thailand for a long time we can say, the food wasn't tasty at all. Very basic, almost no taste. Other people in the restaurant where also complaining. We don't understand why the ratings here are so high.
sample_reviews_en.author: Töbi Summermatter

sample_reviews_en.text: The worst Pat Thai ever😫 It came without any herbs and sprouts on it - just noodles and prawns - and very different from the photo on the menu. I wondered if it had been forgotten, so I asked. The answer was "no veggie stock, sold out". …
sample_reviews_en.author: Rika Itabashi

sample_reviews_en.text: Stopped by for a late night snack. Excellent drinks (whiskey sour, margarita, virgin mojito), and delicious fish and chips and beef curry (penang?). Cosy place, cool decor, and very friendly owner. We'd love to go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ema Nai

sample_reviews_en.text: A very nice, quiet fusion restaurant, perfect for both a casual dinner and a post-dinner drink. We tried the California rolls, skewers, and burgers (HUGE and delicious). The staff were very kind and attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bestiaccia

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was really delicious. The sea bass with lemon sauce was particularly impressive. The atmosphere is comfortable and cozy.

The food comes out a bit slowly, so it is recommended to come with plenty of time.
sample_reviews_en.author: KH Oh

sample_reviews_en.text: Fantastic little spot around the corner from Small Jazz club. Highly recommend. Super kind staff, and really good food and drinks. We all loved this place and will go back! Thank you for hosting us.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrew Prochnow

sample_reviews_en.text: The food looks exactly like the pictures and tastes delicious. The drinks are reasonably priced and the atmosphere is friendly. The owner is also very lovely. I will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: aob jai

restaurants.name: Mapo Galbi
restaurants.address:

71 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I arrived at 7 PM, feeling relaxed. As soon as I finished eating, I looked around and the restaurant was packed! It's no wonder they're open late, until midnight! My absolute favorite highlight is the cheesy egg omelet around the pan. Whether you prefer it gooey or crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, it's all delicious. It's even better when you add the hot grilled pork, top it with the side dishes, and wrap it in sesame leaves.
They have a selection of meats including ribs, diaphragm, and sliced ​​beef, just like the ones Koreans eat in K-dramas. The service was also incredibly impressive. The staff constantly checked on us, peeled the shrimp for free, and changed the grill rack every 10 minutes.
sample_reviews_en.author: FIRST Jirapa

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been to this restaurant many times and I really like it. The service is great. Lately, they've had staff grilling the food for you. They change the pans quite often, but it's not sticky at all. I love the new pans! The heat is strong enough, and they'll refill it if you're not satisfied. I especially love the grilled pork belly with japchae. They offer both buffet and à la carte options. They now accept credit cards. The taste is worth the price. You should definitely try it! When you get your table, they'll give you cheese and salad, but you can buy extra if you want.

Most recently, they had grilled intestines. They clean them very thoroughly, which I love!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kulisala O.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came here at Tuesday Dec 3rd at 10:30pm.  Food was just awful. Everything has been sitting out for hours and all the food was cold and stale + the meat has no real flavor.

For example, the fried chicken and Tteokbokki was cold and felt like it been our for several hours. The vegetables such as mushrooms, pumpkin and onions looked like they been out for days shriveled up and rubbery. And the pickled veggies (bean spouts, cabbage, daikon) were also stale tasting and flavorless. Overall everything lacked freshness and taste.

How anyone could give this a good rating despite the 380 baht price tag is beyond me. It's not even worth 100 baht in my opinion.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rob C

sample_reviews_en.text: 299 Baht per person and open wild late, I think to like 3 AM. The pork cuts are varied, large, and fat, it's strictly pork and egg as protein selections and then there is everything else. Where this place shines is within their customer service. The staff, all of them, are humble, attentive, and checking on your grill to make sure that nothing is burning, it's cooking properly and conveniently, and that the vacuum above is properly draining exhaust. They serve an array of Korean specific spirits, alcohols, and drinks. The food just doesn't stop. It's a very satisfying way to spend your evening as a couple or with some friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: D R

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re craving Korean BBQ without breaking the bank, this spot is a solid choice. The price is really affordable compared to the quality—meats are fresh, portions generous, and everything comes out quickly. The staff are super attentive and friendly, making sure the grill stays hot and your table feels taken care of.

The only thing that didn’t wow me was the sauce—it’s pretty average and doesn’t add much to the overall flavor. But honestly, with the good cuts of meat and the price point, I didn’t mind too much. Perfect place if you want value-for-money Korean BBQ with great service, just don’t expect standout sauces.
sample_reviews_en.author: SURASAK “Bill” ABE

sample_reviews_en.text:
I didn't expect much because the reviews were low, but I left satisfied.

It was the most satisfying BBQ restaurant I've been to in Bangkok.

The Thai staff were incredibly friendly and grilled the meat for us.

The quality of the meat was also good. I go to BBQ buffets often in Korea, and even compared to them, this place is above average.

The meat quality is good and it tastes great.

The side dishes were substantial and good. The gochujang stew was tasty, and the gimbap was decent too.

100% willing to visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: 포아탄

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a great Korean restaurant, located close to W market and BTS Phra khanong. I went to try their Korean Buffet on Sunday and I was pleased with the service, quality of food and prices. They offer free refill of eggs and an assortment of Korean entrees including Dokboggi, Korean fried chicken (Bon Chon Style), Bulgogi, seaweed soup, Gimpap etc. I think for the price and location it is a must. However, it does get full on evenings so make sure to make a reservation or arrive early. Highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gabriel Flores

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent food at an affordable price. The meat here is thick and massive but the grill have no problem cooking it through amd very well seasoned. A typical Korean meat marinated can be sickly sweet but not at this place at all, the savoury of the meat still come through. Overall very enjoyable. First round of Korean omlette and chease is free but charged at the next order.

All you can eat only offer pork and choices are fairly limited. A bit far if you walkes from BTS station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suthichat D.

restaurants.name: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh Siam Paragon
restaurants.address:

Next to Kasikorn Bank Unit, Room Unit. FHGF050B, G floor, 991 Rama I Rd, Khet, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Was excited to know that my favourite Song Fa bak kut teh is in town. Look forward to dip into the giant pork ribs and hot soup but to my disappointment, the ribs was pretty small despite ordering the large size bowl and the colour of the meat is dark compared to Singapore. Lovers of this Song Fa, don't expect to see and eat the same standard as in Singapore! Surely won't be going back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were very friendly, cheerful, and attentive. The food was delicious and the restaurant was clean. I was very impressed with the service and taste of the food at the Paragon branch and will definitely visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donporn Likhitratanapisan

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious, the taste never changes. Always impressed. The fried dough sticks with pork rib soup are the best! 🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawarun Sornkham

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and met the restaurant's standards. The staff provided good and attentive service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patteera A.

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious Michelin Restaurant! Tried their Michelin dish and I have never tasted anything like that.
sample_reviews_en.author: JM San

sample_reviews_en.text: another comfort food i recommend in Siam paragon. The staffs are so nice! Love the service here
sample_reviews_en.author: Natcha Y

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes good, but the service is disorganized and orders are often missed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kenneth Wong

restaurants.name: Thai Dusit
restaurants.address:

674/2 Rama VI Rd, Thung Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Thai Dusit Braised Beef near Urupong Intersection – I’ve heard so much about this place for a long time, and today I finally got to try it. It truly lived up to the hype! I'd rate it as having the best braised beef offal I've ever had. It's fresh, clean, and odorless. The aroma of Chinese herbs and spices filled the air as soon as the bowl arrived – it was mouthwatering. The marinated beef was incredibly tender, which I loved. The braised offal was perfectly cooked; the liver and heart were delicious. Most importantly, this is the first time I've ever had braised beef offal soup where I found this amazing dish. The beef kidney was incredibly tasty, with a unique flavor. Sipping the hot, fragrant broth, picking up the tender marinated beef, fresh liver, heart, tripe, and braised tendons, dipping them in the fermented tofu sauce before putting them in my mouth – it was heavenly! Beef lovers who haven't tried this are missing out. It's like I've been missing out forever! 🤤🤤🤤🤤🤤❤️👍😂
sample_reviews_en.author: Nawachai Harnkla

sample_reviews_en.text:
The soup was a bit bland, maybe because I went early in the morning and it hadn't fully developed yet.
Maybe it's because I'm used to salty food.

The braised beef was excellent; it had a nice aroma of Chinese herbal stew that lingered in the mouth.
It melted in my mouth, so good! I loved it.

The tendons, slices, and edges were all well-prepared.

The price was incredibly cheap!

Parking is available in front of the shop.
I saw others parked there, so I parked too, but I'm not sure if the police will chase people away later in the morning or around noon.

It's an old shop, but it's clean and tidy.

The food came out quickly; no wait at all, even though the shop was full when I went.

P.S. These are my personal opinions, apologies in advance.

Cost:
Special Beef Soup (1 serving)
Rice (1 serving)
65 Baht!!!! Amazing price!
sample_reviews_en.author: Moo Por

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a long-established restaurant that serves stewed beef offal. Although it is called stewed offal, it is not made with miso like in Japan, but rather with a light, nam pla-flavored soup with plenty of ingredients. The basic way to eat it is to shovel it down with rice, and if you order "Khao Lao," you will get this set. You can choose your favorite ingredients for the offal, but if you order "Teugyan," you will get everything. They are open from early in the morning, so you can also have it for breakfast.
sample_reviews_en.author: THAI SANPO FUJII

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped by to eat braised beef noodle soup, but the taste has dropped a lot. I've been eating here since the father (Uncle Waen) ran it. Back then, the braised beef and all the offal were cut into big pieces. Now, with the son's generation, everything has shrunk; the pieces are very small. The broth isn't as rich as before; it's quite watery. I came here thinking about the old days, when Uncle Waen was cooking at the stove, with his wife standing beside him collecting payments...
sample_reviews_en.author: Sanphat Kijprueang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Best braised beef soup I have ever tasted!! The braised beef is so tender 10/10 Totally recommended

On a first glance, I feel the beef is not taste meaty that much. Also, the soup is not intense compared to others. I think it because they use not over-fatty part meat.

BUT later on.... it all just click in! Since the soup is not too greasy, it is light enough that you can eat it with the beef, which also enhance the meaty flavor that the beef is missing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peerapong Wongnawapreechachai

sample_reviews_en.text: Eat beef noodle soup with rice. The price has increased from 50 to 60, and the special portion from 60 to 70. However, the quantity is very small. It's not worth the price paid. Some items are out of stock, but they don't tell the customer. You have to order first to know they're out of stock. If any item is out of stock, they don't add it and don't add any other items. Order everything but no meatballs.
sample_reviews_en.author: ดุรงค์ฤทธิ์ แก้วกระจ่าง

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is one of the best braised beef restaurants I've ever been to. The broth has a medium salty flavor with a mild herbal aroma.

What the restaurant does exceptionally well is that all the offal is free of any gamey smell and each piece has its own distinct flavor. The braised beef is tender and fresh, and it pairs perfectly with the slightly sour fermented tofu dipping sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนานพ ทองถาวร (MochaHunter)

sample_reviews_en.text: This old, decades-old restaurant specializing in braised beef and tendon with Chinese herbs is located in a single shophouse unit by the entrance to the former Coliseum cinema. I ate here 20 years ago and had the opportunity to visit again today, and the taste is still as delicious as before. This time I ordered a bowl of soup and plain rice, and even ordered a second serving!
sample_reviews_en.author: พร้อมพูล ชอบเพื่อน

restaurants.name: Ounjai Riverside
restaurants.address:

9 บางกระสอบ Tambon Bang Nam Phueng, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located deep in an alley, a long walk from the parking lot. The restaurant is beautiful with a nice atmosphere and clean restrooms. However, the food took a long time to prepare and was expensive. The taste was too salty, sour, and not spicy – ​​not impressive. When checking out, the staff didn't inform us about the points accumulation system; we had to ask. The staff seemed confused and couldn't answer, requiring the manager to intervene. The manager's response was unprofessional. We mentioned a 10% birthday discount, but the bill didn't show it; we had to request a new bill. The only thing impressive was the view. Everything else was disappointing. The walkway to the parking lot is dark; it's beautiful during the day and well-decorated, but not very safe to walk to at night.

*The points accumulation system should have clearer details.
**Staff should inform customers about promotions every time they are served, as customers are unaware.
***The manager needs to find better ways to communicate with customers or receive customer service training.

Hopefully, this won't happen again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattakarn NTK

sample_reviews_en.text: With limited halal food around, we were pleasantly surprised to meet a southern Thai female staff (with a red short hair called Salita?) who seemed so happy to see us, spoke basic Bahasa Melayu and was super helpful in pointing out what was vegan, had only seafood and did not contain any other forms of meat or pork in the cooking. We were one of very few customers on a Thursday night, but all the staff graciously stayed till we walked out at their closing time at 10pm. Never chasing us out and only switching off the lights behind us. Understandably, some of the staff probably seemed a bit unsure how to serve us since we could only speak 1-2 Thai phrase. Salita walked us to the door and even advised us on the route to take that had the least dogs, or at least just one dog who might bark and chase a bit but wouldn’t bite us as long as we went pass quickly which we did on bicycles. It was such a pleasant dinner/supper and we are so thankful 🥹
sample_reviews_en.author: Social Greens

sample_reviews_en.text:
What impressed me most was the riverside atmosphere and the peaceful ambiance, as well as the attention to detail for customers. The walkways are designed to be wheelchair accessible, making it easy to bring elderly people along. The place is very clean, and there are plenty of tables. We sat by the river, and the cool breeze was so refreshing. The food is served in sets, and each dish is quite large. The ingredients are fresh and of good quality.
There is convenient parking. The entrance might seem a little dark and secluded.
The restrooms are clean.
The staff provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Punnapatcharee Chotthanakuljira

sample_reviews_en.text: Visited this place after a very favourable review on YouTube. It was a lie. When you first arrive & walk in the gardens & surroundings are pleasant. If you want a meal on the waterfront deck your views are obscured by random boats tied up. The staff were very attentive (I was the only person there) however they gave me my main before my entre which I had to ask for twice. The food was disgusting & overpriced. The beef was mainly gristle. The chicken tenders were small pieces of battered bones. There was no meat in either. I paid & walked out leaving behind 2 disgusting uneaten meals.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Pusko

sample_reviews_en.text:
Didn't try the food.
Wanted to enjoy a cup of (real) coffee by the river but got served instant coffee that was sold as hot cappuccino.
Cake was good, though.
Ordered a sugar free green tea as well and got served an instant green tea that was sweet.
On the menu the drinks look all great, but the disappointment set in when the drinks were served.
On the way out I saw an actual coffee grinder and a proper machine.
Don't know if the staff to operate had a day off, though.
Next time, tell your customers that (real) coffee is actually not served.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andy Sats

sample_reviews_en.text:
Followed my Thai friends to @ounjairiverside which is a riverside restaurant around 1 hour away from city center of Bangkok with amazing view and decor. The food were simply delicious. Enjoyed especially their deep fried seabass, stir fried crab meat with curry and deep fried pork with garlic.

Worth a visit if you have spare time and want to explore away from city center when you are in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Javier Lim

sample_reviews_en.text: Huuuge, right on the River! Beautiful location, fabulous food, and excellent service. Beautifully and extensively landscaped with tropical plants and spotlessly presented it offers great views of the river. It's a little expensive. Service by friendly attentive staff. The lavishly illustrated menu a joy to behold.  It's a long walk from car park, but worth the effort!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ian Hawkes

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a large, spacious restaurant. Parking might be limited if it's full, but we visited on a Sunday afternoon and found parking was easy.

The food arrived quickly and tasted good. The steamed sea bass with soy sauce and the seafood tom yum soup weren't too spicy, and the broth was delicious. However, the river prawns weren't very fresh on the day we visited.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arnon Rungsawang

restaurants.name: ChaaChaa Malatang (ชาชา หมาล่าทัง) - สะพานควาย
restaurants.address:

บ้านเลขที่ 2 Sutthisan Winitchai Rd, เเขวงสามเสนใน Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was very impressed with my first visit. I came around 6 PM, it was a little crowded, but the restaurant managed it well. The ingredients were good, fresh, and clean. There were so many options, especially the noodles – a huge variety! I loved that they had udon and ramen, which is rare at most mala restaurants. The food came out very quickly; I got my meal almost immediately. The atmosphere inside the restaurant was nice, the staff were lovely, and there was plenty of seating.

As for the taste 🍴
1. Pork Bone Soup: The flavor was rich and fragrant, delicious and savory without being too greasy. Highly recommended for those who don't like spicy food.

2. Mala Tang: I ordered the medium spicy version. It was flavorful but not overly spicy. Delicious! The flavor was rich and savory, and not too greasy. Highly recommended!

The highlight is the dipping sauce! The dipping sauce is included in the mala price, no need to buy extra. So satisfying!
sample_reviews_en.author: Aoei P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is easy to find; you can walk there comfortably after getting off the BTS, but the Thai sun can be quite hot.
The shop is cute, with two floors and a wide selection of dishes.
Takeaway is available for an additional 15 baht.
It's 49 baht per portion.
However, there's an additional charge for the soup and dipping sauce (for every order). Tofu is 10 baht per piece. You can refill the dipping sauce as much as you like. Personally, I felt it was a little too salty, but it was okay.
The staff provided good service and handled problems well. I felt very satisfied.
I will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jenjira Suwannachot

sample_reviews_en.text:
Personally, I like it.
The mala soup is delicious.
The bone broth is also delicious.
The ingredients look good, the vegetables are fresh, and the meat has a nice color.
There's a wide variety of dishes.
It's clean.
There are two floors of seating.
The downstairs area has a slight food smell because the kitchen is downstairs.

Food is served quickly.
They have a loyalty points program.
There's no parking lot.
You have to park on the street.

The price is a bit steep.
The soup base is expensive.
There's also a 7% VAT.
sample_reviews_en.author: Beau Watinee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The price is 49 Baht per 100 grams. They offer a many variety of ingredients, cook it freshly and hot served to your table. You have 3 ways to choose how to cook your selected ingredients: 1.Malatang (hot noodle-like mala soup with 3 spicy options less spicy / middle spicy / extreme spicy) 2. Stirred  fried mala and 3. Hot tonkatsu noodle soup (no spicy). I chose middle spicy Malatang noodle soup and my gf chose tonkatsu noodle soup.

The staff were nice and helpful. Looking forward to trying this again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Satianpong Eameiam

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mala hot pot, 49 baht per 100 grams. The shop is located on the roadside.
There are many soup bases to choose from. ✨️Mala soup✨️Pork bone soup
✨️Sukiyaki soup✨️Mentsuyu soup
🐷We chose the Mala soup, mildly spicy, and it was incredibly flavorful and rich.
Snacks include French fries sprinkled with Mala powder
, fried onions dipped in Mala mayo sauce
, red sausages dipped in Mala tamarind sauce
, and Gyoza dipped in Mala sauce
✨️The shop's decor is cute, bright orange.
sample_reviews_en.author: La Pluie

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tasty hotpot. First you choose which ingredients you’d like to have and you put them in a bowl. Then it’s weighed and you choose a flavour soup and a level of spice. I highly recommend getting sticky rice with your order as it helps offset the spice of the hotpot!

The food came quickly and was very tasty. The staff were friendly and very helpful. It was good value for money as well. I’d recommend to others for a quick(-ish) and easy dinner.
sample_reviews_en.author: George Brand

sample_reviews_en.text: 😗✨🇨🇳🍲My favorite Mala hotpot place right now. I love their CI (Corporate Identity); the cute cartoon character adds to the overall deliciousness. You pick the ingredients you want, the staff weighs them, charges you, and then brings the meal to your table. The restaurant has two floors, with the upper floor being spacious. There’s free ice that you can help yourself to. The pork bone broth is absolutely delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: tongwariss

sample_reviews_en.text: A very delicious Mala Tang shop. For Mala lovers, come and try it. Serve yourself. Weigh the actual amount. There are many soup bases and levels of spiciness. I recommend the pork bone soup and dry fried Mala. The shop is small. I recommend sitting upstairs. The air conditioning is cool and not noisy. Come and try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: n3wZzcl3al2

restaurants.name: Brunch Paradiso
restaurants.address:

69 Yen Akat Rd, Khwaeng Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
◡̈ Brunch Paradiso
The cafe has a cute, cozy, homey feel. The lighting is beautiful in every corner. It's genuinely pet-friendly, and the staff are cheerful and endearing. It's a great place to enjoy delicious food in cool air conditioning with your family.

The food was delicious and suited my taste perfectly. The drinks were equally delightful. This is definitely a cafe I'll be returning to again because of the wonderful atmosphere and relaxing atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pim lada

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stayed at this hotel for eight days, and breakfast was served in the Paradiso restaurant.

Guests can customize their breakfast by choosing from various combinations. Our server, Su, was incredibly friendly and attentive, making sure we had everything we needed.

The à la carte dishes were also very good, and the coffee is a must.

We highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: R. R.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a breakfast restaurant with a great atmosphere. We came late in the morning, and the menu was diverse and interesting. Today we ordered Salmon Benedict, Fish & Wedges, and Truffle Soups, all of which tasted delicious. The staff, especially Knight and Tum, provided excellent service. It was a very memorable meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanruethai Luedthahan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was excellent, well-prepared, and offered a wide variety of choices. The restaurant had a comfortable atmosphere and parking was available. The staff members Su and Natcha were lovely and provided great service. They had a special menu for June, which I'll try next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pploy Ttrifaud

sample_reviews_en.text:
Avoid. Overcharged me and Took 3 attempts to get coffee order correct on first day.  Coffee was ok if you tell them how to make it
Staff incompetent to the point charged me twice for sandwich even when shown bank statements to say they have already taken the money.  Unhelpful
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark H

sample_reviews_en.text:
This pet-friendly restaurant has a fantastic atmosphere.
If you're looking for a restaurant for lunch, breakfast, or brunch with good prices, I highly recommend this place.
The food is delicious, fresh, and the fusion dishes combine many different flavors in a great way.
sample_reviews_en.author: inicky ad

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was mediocre, leaning towards bland. The coffee wasn't good. The atmosphere was nice, there was parking available, and EV charging stations. The restrooms were in the hotel and very clean. Overall, it was okay, but not impressive. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Sutamas Luengvichacharoen

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and high-quality, the atmosphere is great, and the drinks are excellent, especially the Dirty Coffee. Plus, it's pet-friendly. Highly recommended! The staff (named Nice & Nat) provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Job Jumsai Na Ayudhya

restaurants.name: Shabu Square
restaurants.address:

ฟอร์ ยู พาร์ค 341 ซ. โครงการ เดอะมาสเตอร์ Bang Na Nuea, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A satisfying all-you-can-eat Shabu experience with a diverse pricing structure to suit different preferences. I opted for the Gold tier, which offered excellent value without compromising on quality. The beef and pork cuts were well-marbled and tender, while the salmon sashimi was fresh, clean-tasting, and featured commendable marbling—an unexpected highlight for a Shabu-focused venue.

One of the standout features is the ability to choose up to four soup bases, exceeding the standard two-pot setup typically seen at most shabu restaurants, and allowing for greater variety and customization at the table.

Desserts are also a pleasant surprise, with options including Häagen-Dazs ice cream (two flavors), panna cotta, honey toast, glass jelly (chow koey), and fruit salad, rounding off the meal with a sweet finish.

Ample parking is available directly in front of the restaurant, adding convenience to the overall experience.
Highly recommended for those seeking quality shabu in a relaxed and well-appointed setting.
sample_reviews_en.author: TP TP

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Wagyu Angus Chuck Roll was delicious.
- Some salmon sashimi dishes were good, others weren't very impressive.
- Wagyu sushi was delicious.
- For the fried items, we liked the sweet potato with cheese filling; the kids loved the cheese fries.
- The beef in the rice bowl was very dry.
- For dessert, the grape jelly and vanilla ice cream were delicious.
- Häagen-Dazs ice cream had one flavor per day; today it was strawberry cheesecake.
- Booking through Hungry Hub gave a net price, with no added VAT or service charge.
- The prices at the restaurant showed a promotion for senior citizens with a 30-50% discount depending on age.
- Food was served quickly, although some dishes were slow.
- The staff provided good service, constantly clearing plates, smiling, and speaking politely.
- When paying, the restaurant asked for license plate numbers for 4 hours of free parking.
- Food was ordered via QR code, and the staff refilled drinks (bottled water costs an extra 25 baht).
- Here are some screenshots of the menu.😆
sample_reviews_en.author: ps ppp

sample_reviews_en.text: Today we ate at the Platinum buffet, priced at 1,129 THB net, through Hungry Hub's 2-for-1 deal, making it 569 THB per person for 2 hours. It was more than worth it! We got to eat A5 Japanese Wagyu beef and other high-quality meats, river prawns, sea bass, and scallops – all fresh and delicious. There was also eel sushi, scallop sushi, salmon sashimi, Wagyu sushi, teppanyaki, dim sum, appetizers, and desserts including Häagen-Dazs ice cream and more. The restaurant was clean and the staff provided excellent service. The only thing that could be improved is the dipping sauces.
sample_reviews_en.author: karuna pusri

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was very unimpressed with the service.

Firstly, I needed a refill of my water, so I used the app to call a staff member several times, but no one came. I'm not sure why this option is available if it's not functional. I then tried to call a staff member to refill my water, but they barely paid any attention.

Secondly, I ordered a craffle and waited 30 minutes. I went to ask when it would be ready, and they said they weren't making craffles that day. Why didn't anyone inform me of this? Plus, I could have ordered it through the menu. I wasted a lot of time waiting.
sample_reviews_en.author: idontwannadothisanymore

sample_reviews_en.text: Almost perfect shabu hotpot buffet place. They  provide a variety of soups to choose from, all of which is pretty decent. I especially love the boat noodle soup, but it can get quite salty when reduced for a bit. Vegetables, meat balls, fish balls, crab cakes, you named it they probably have it. The meat quality here is mediocre for standard buffet, but the premium one is said to be of quality (especially the wagyu beef slice). There are multiple sauces to select from. One of the best thing is the Haagen Dazs ice cream.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Momentist

sample_reviews_en.text: I came all the way from home to try this place, based on a recommendation, and I wasn't disappointed! The soup was delicious, the dipping sauce was okay, but the meat was amazing! They also have sushi; I tried the eel sushi and it was just as good as famous sushi restaurants. Importantly, they have a huge menu. The minced beef basil rice was superb, I don't know how to describe it! The desserts are delicious, and they even have Häagen-Dazs ice cream. Most importantly, those over 65 get a 30% discount.
sample_reviews_en.author: jeng jeng

sample_reviews_en.text: I went a while ago and just got around to writing this review. Using the Hungry Hub promotion was incredibly worthwhile. I went in the afternoon and it wasn't crowded. The food was fresh, delicious, and came out quickly. The beef was tender and not chewy, the salmon was fresh, and the grilled beef sushi with truffle mushrooms was delicious. The croffle dessert was amazing, and the homemade vanilla ice cream was especially good – so fragrant and delicious, I had several scoops!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jithaporn S

sample_reviews_en.text: Was craving for lamb meat and finally found this place offering lamb slices so decided to visit. Loved the integrated QR menu for instant ordering. The waiter who took our order informed that the fishballs/meatballs came in single unit so recommended we order by number of pieces. The place is good for family visits since tables could accommodate up to 6 pax with two induction heaters. Cleanliness is standard and services are good. Great selections on soups and sauces.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rattirom Joy

restaurants.name: Bangkok Chim Chum
restaurants.address:

1321 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re in Bangkok, you have to try this local restaurant! This place is an absolute gem for authentic Thai hotpot lovers. From the moment we walked in, the warm and friendly staff made us feel at home, guiding us through the menu and explaining how to enjoy the various dishes like the locals.

The Thai specialties are sublime and the flavors were out of this world! The Tom Yum broth was rich and aromatic, perfectly infused with herbs like lemongrass and kaffir lime. The fresh selections of meat, seafood, and vegetables were top-notch, and everything tasted incredibly fresh and flavorful. The dipping sauce was the real game-changer – spicy, tangy, and just the right kick of Thai zest!

The place resembles an art gallery and the atmosphere was lively but cozy, making it perfect for both casual dining and a fun night out with friends. And the best part? The prices were super reasonable for the quality and portions you get.

Visited many times with friends and family, I can’t recommend this place enough – it’s a true taste of Bangkok! I’m already planning my next visit. Thank you for an unforgettable dining experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kalboz Kal

sample_reviews_en.text:
An Unforgettable Thai Culinary Experience!

As someone who works in the hospitality industry, I have high expectations when it comes to dining experiences. And I must say, this local Thai restaurant exceeded all of them! From the moment I stepped through the door, I was greeted with warm smiles and genuine hospitality that made me feel right at home.

One of the standout aspects of this place is the incredible value for money. I was pleasantly surprised by the generous portions and the attention to detail in every dish.

The menu offers a wide variety of options, catering to both meat lovers and vegetarians alike. Whether you're a fan of traditional Pad Thai or looking to explore new flavors with dishes like steamed fish or Green Papaya Salad, this restaurant has got you covered.

What truly sets this place apart is the overall experience. The staff is knowledgeable and passionate about the food they serve. They were more than happy to answer any questions I had and even recommended some off-menu specialties that added an extra layer of excitement to my dining experience.

Thank you P Pong for your hospitality!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jorge Gomez

sample_reviews_en.text:
We flew into Bangkok in the late evening and had pre-selected Bangkok Chim Chum for dinner primarily due to their late opening hours - they open till 11.30pm. We did not regret our choice! The delicious meal we enjoyed was much welcomed after a tiring flight and the extended commute from the airport to this quaint district in Bangkok.

At the owner's recommendation, we tried their chicken with cashew nuts, and Tom Yum Koong. We also ordered their Pad See Ew for carbs. As chilli lovers, it was apparent to us that the spiciness had been calibrated to tourists' taste buds, but the food was delicious nonetheless. Portions were generally smaller, and thus well-suited for sharing. Prices were certainly affordable; we spent ~600 Baht for two, including non-alcoholic drinks.

We also appreciated that the owner spoke fluent English (having worked in Singapore in the past). The staff were warm and the hospitality was excellent. They do not accept card payment so do ensure you have cash.

Would most definitely patronise Bangkok Chim Chim again if we ever have the chance!
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Loh

sample_reviews_en.text:
We've been coming to Bangkok Chim Chum regularly for over four years, and it's one of those restaurants we always recommend to friends and family when they visit Bangkok.

The owner is incredibly welcoming, speaks excellent English, and always makes time to chat with customers. It's the kind of place where you quickly feel like a regular.

The menu is extensive, and over the years we've tried many of the dishes. Our personal favourites are the lemon fish and the duck special, but we've always found the food to be consistently fresh, tasty and great value.

If you'd rather escape the Bangkok heat, there's also a comfortable air-conditioned dining room inside.

Bangkok has no shortage of places to eat, but it's restaurants like this—with genuinely warm service and consistently good food—that keep us coming back. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Geordie boy lost in Asia

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was our last day to dine in Bangkok and we just stroll around what is near our hotel. We were supposed to go to other side kf road when the owner called us to dine in his restaurant. I think he immediately noticed that we are not locals so he called to us in english.
We decided to check out the menu and glad we did.
We ordered pork fried rice, fried chicken with herbs, fried sea bass with mango salad and off course, mango sticky rice! We were asking the food attendant if our order is enough for us when the owner approached us and recommended som tum salad which is a local favorite. It's made with papaya, onions, carrors, cherry tomatoes and roasted nuts. It was so good and glad we tried it out!
We are so full from what we ordered! We'll gladly go back here when we go back to Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: rhyan tiangco

sample_reviews_en.text: Bangkok Chimchum was a fantastic dining experience! The food was really good, if not absolutely delicious, with plenty of flavorful options. What stood out the most was the warm and welcoming atmosphere, thanks to the incredibly kind and smiling owner, who was not only friendly but also super helpful in guiding us through the menu. The restaurant offers a great selection of dishes, many of which can be made vegan upon request, making it an excellent choice for plant-based eaters. The service was impressively fast, ensuring we didn’t have to wait long to enjoy our meal. Overall, a wonderful place with great food, a lovely owner, and a relaxing vibe—definitely worth a visit in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nathanjosias

sample_reviews_en.text:
We have been scouting around for dinner when we happened by this restaurant and were  greeted by the hands-on owner.

We had the Pad Thai, Spring Rolls and Green Curry with Rice and they were absolutely amazing.👌 These were probably for around THB400 but we ordered a bottle of white wine so we paid a little more.

Serving size is for two people (at least for us) and really good value for money.

Totally unrelated but seeing their kids help around the shop is just so nice. One particular kid swept the floor and cleared the nearby table and one can see that the parents are doing something right.

Thank you for the lovely experience! Best of luck to you and your business! 🍻
sample_reviews_en.author: Weng Bayhon

sample_reviews_en.text: We always make it a point to look for old-style clay pot hot pot whenever we’re in Thailand, and this one really not bad. We actually spotted the place from the advert outside the shop while we were on our way out, and decided to give it a try. The clay pot hot pot was exactly what we were craving.. hot, comforting, and full of that simple, homely flavour. We also ordered the cashew nuts chicken, and it was just simple but really satisfying. Nothing fancy like those in restaurants, just honest, good food. Definitely one of those random finds that turned out to be a great decision.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lye Guang Yang

restaurants.name: 炙り居酒屋 朔 Saku Asok
restaurants.address:

2 Jusmin city B1 floor, room B, 01 Soi Sukhumvit 23, Khlong ton nua, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
5/5🌟

Before going: Why is this place only 4.9? Is it really that good?

After going: Ahhhhh, it definitely deserves a 5-star review!

Super large portions! Great taste! Attentive service!

1️⃣ Who would have thought a stingray could be such a huge plate?! It's like they peeled off the bones of a whole stingray, haha!

2️⃣ The seared beef tongue is so tender it melts in your mouth!

3️⃣ So much salmon in the avocado salad! Much more than the salmon in the Lunar New Year's raw fish salad! 😏

4️⃣ The Nanban fried chicken is so delicious! The combination of egg yolk and mayonnaise is double the deliciousness—my favorite!

5️⃣ The broth in the black pork hot pot is so flavorful, the pork is very fresh, and the whole pot is so refreshing. I drank three bowls of soup!

Such a huge portion for only 1800 kiwis! Wow, what an amazing restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pi Pi

sample_reviews_en.text:
I also went there for lunch.
It's nice that they have sets where you can choose your side dishes. I chose oden and grilled yellowtail collar. The yellowtail collar wasn't grilled, it was clearly boiled in broth?? And it was way too salty (*_*;
The oden broth was nice, so it was a bit of a disappointment...
As for the cost performance... I guess it's a mixed bag?? I'll think about it after trying some of the other side dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaopraya Thai

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted delicious, but what upset me was seeing the chef use the same paper he'd used to wipe his hands to clean my bowl. When the food was served, I watched him swirl the paper around in my bowl a few times, which made me lose my appetite. Japanese food involves direct contact with the food, so hygiene is crucial. I hope the restaurant can improve this. The food was very fresh and tasted good.
sample_reviews_en.author: John

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited for lunch on two separate occasions. However, the first week, the lunch menu I wanted was sold out, so I went to the restaurant next door. The second week, the lunch menu itself was gone. The food seemed promising, but there are some issues with customer service training. I think they might lose customers if they don't train their staff in basic customer service etiquette.
sample_reviews_en.author: JIRO BKK

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had shabu-shabu for lunch 🍽️
The staff cooked everything for us, and even the rice porridge was delicious.

The fluffy dashi-rolled omelet is so comforting, you should definitely try it.

All the tables were in private or semi-private rooms, creating a comfortable space for conversation.

We'll definitely visit again!
sample_reviews_en.author: 水田和

sample_reviews_en.text: The food uses high-quality ingredients, many imported from Japan, and tastes great. The seating is private with sliding doors that can be closed. I tried the hot plate roasted chicken; they add broth to the hot plate at your table, and after you finish eating, they add ramen noodles. The staff provides good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: N N (Pom)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Higher quality than in Japan
An upscale izakaya (Japanese pub)
Every dish is delicious and goes perfectly with drinks
The service is kind and attentive, leaving a very positive impression
This is definitely a great place
Reservations are recommended on weekends
sample_reviews_en.author: GOLFandTRAVEL

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is all delicious, but the ventilation is terrible, and my clothes and bag end up smelling of oil. The air conditioning is also ineffective. If these issues could be improved, I would change them to positive points.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puramuk

restaurants.name: Bianca Italian Restaurant (Siam Paragon)
restaurants.address:

G Floor, Siam Paragon, 991 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is a banger! I've only tried their desserts, but every single one is top-notch—in fact, they're some of the best in Siam Paragon. Every time I order, it's a real win. The only place I think does it better is their sister restaurant in Emsphere, Holy Belly. But out of all the restaurants with multiple locations (which I won't name), this one is the best.
The staff are freaking awesome, too. Manager Oh and the team do an amazing job taking care of customers—no wonder this place has a 4.8 rating. Both variations of the tiramisu are bangers, the cheesecake is "OMG," and the tart was really nice. I don't even usually like panna cotta or chocolate mousse, but theirs are delicious.
Ninety percent of the time, if I make it to the mall by 11:10 AM, I stop by. The desserts have a tendency to take a bit longer to prepare than at a normal coffee shop, so if you're in a rush, it's better to skip it. But if you can wait about 15 to 20 minutes for certain items, you won't be disappointed. In fact, these guys should open a bakery nearby so I can come every day!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ali Ameri

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good food and great ambiance. The restaurant is located in the middle of all the restaurants on the G floor, but because of its elevated seating area (you have to climb a few stairs), it feels more comfortable and slightly more tucked away, making it a nice place to sit, dine and chat with friends. They also have seating available on the lower level if you prefer not to take the stairs.

Overall, the food was amazing! Here’s what we had:
(4 pax)

• Crab Avocado Salad – 6/10
• Cheese Amore pizza - 7/10 a little too salty for my taste
• Classic Tomato Burrata – 100/10 😍
• Aglio Olio Prawn – 4/10 as I don’t get any taste at all
• Bistecca Alla Griglia (Angus Tenderloin Beef) – 100/10  😍
• Lamb Rump Caponata – 100/10  😍😍
• Chocolate Mousse & Tiramisu – 5/10 it is not to my liking

The staff confirmed that the chicken, beef and lamb are HALAL, which was great to know.

We will definitely be back! And I really hope they keep the Lamb Rump Caponata on the menu forever and don’t leave it as just a special. That dish deserves permanent residency! 😂😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Aishah Adam

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The restaurant has a nice, private atmosphere with two floors.
There are many tables available, suitable for families or couples, with various table arrangements.
- The tableware is neatly prepared and ready to serve, and is clean.
- The restaurant is located on the G floor, opposite Burger King, in Siam Paragon.
- They offer a complete selection of savory dishes, desserts, and drinks, with a wide variety of menu options.
- Personally, I find the prices to be quite high compared to the taste of some of the dishes, although many are just average in flavor.
- The staff are lovely, cheerful, polite, and provide good menu recommendations.
- Payment methods include credit cards, cash, and bank transfers.
- They participate in promotions with UOB and Krungsri bank cards; it's recommended to ask the staff about them.
- There is ample parking space in the mall; you can get your parking ticket stamped for free.
- The restaurant has wheelchair accessibility.
sample_reviews_en.author: 가을Kam

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ve already left a review before, but I genuinely had to come back and write another one because this restaurant continues to be absolutely amazing! Every visit is such a wonderful experience — the food is always delicious, the atmosphere is lovely, and the service never disappoints. A special thank you to our server today, Man, who was incredibly kind, attentive, welcoming, and made our experience even better. His service was truly exceptional and deserves to be recognized. This has easily become one of my favorite restaurants, and I always look forward to coming back. Highly recommend! 🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: Tarkia Alhameli

sample_reviews_en.text: Extremely disappointing experience. I came all the way here from very far away because the restaurant says it closes at 10 PM. I arrived at 9:20 PM, yet I was told they were already closed, while I could clearly see customers still inside. If you stop accepting customers before 10 PM, your opening hours should clearly state the actual last seating/order time. I wasted a long trip coming here and was treated very poorly. Definitely not coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: oki sapri

sample_reviews_en.text: Their food is halal, delicious, and the flavors are great. The staff are quick, polite, and happy to help. They're very helpful and will even joke around if you ask them about something. It's definitely worth coming back for more than once.
sample_reviews_en.author: Seitah Alshammari

sample_reviews_en.text: We would like to highly recommend Yim. She was warm, friendly, and incredibly attentive throughout our meal. She explained the menu with patience, answered all of our questions with a smile, and made sure we had everything we needed. Her …
sample_reviews_en.author: nirit Bachar

sample_reviews_en.text: The cheese pizza was probably 520 baht, not sure. It was so delicious! I loved the pizza crust at this place. If you don't like salty food, this might not be for you because almost everything I ate was quite salty, probably due to the …
sample_reviews_en.author: Fineday

restaurants.name: Bistro Sathorn French Cuisine
restaurants.address:

241, 4 S Sathon Rd, Yannawa, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely wonderful experience and one of the most memorable dinners we had in Bangkok!
The food was excellent — the steak was perfectly cooked, the duck was delicious, and the escargots were fantastic. Everything felt authentic, carefully prepared and full of flavour.
But what made this place truly special was Francis, the owner. We didn’t realize beforehand that cards weren’t accepted, and unfortunately we didn’t have enough cash with us. Francis was incredibly kind and simply trusted us to come back the next day and pay. That kind of warmth, trust and hospitality is something you rarely encounter nowadays.
Of course, we came back the next day — not only to pay, but also with an even greater appreciation for this place and its owner.
Francis, thank you for the wonderful dinner and for being such a genuinely kind person. We will definitely remember this evening and would happily come back when we are in Bangkok again.
Highly recommended — both for the fantastic French food and the incredible hospitality!
sample_reviews_en.author: Крестина Ляшук

sample_reviews_en.text:
I understand it’s a French restaurant, so perhaps other dishes are better, but pls AVOID the 'Linguine with Scallops and Shrimp' as it was very disappointing.

For 350 THB, it was honestly one of the worst pasta I’ve tried. The pasta was bland and too dry, the shrimp didn’t taste fresh, and there was only one piece of scallop—which is not even a real scallop! I’d rather pay more for a dish made with better-quality ingredients.

I also noticed another review mentioning that this same dish tasted bad, so I think the owner should either remove it from the menu or improve the recipe and ingredients.

On the positive side, the foreign old guy(guess he is the owner) was attentive and friendly.

As for the atmosphere, it feels more like stepping into Grandpa’s cozy home than a stylish restaurant. The pinky walls and traditional style table give it an old-school feel. If you’re looking for a romantic or upscale atmosphere, I won't recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: YS W

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was basic at best.

I ordered a cordon bleu; it was swimming in butter and hard to finish.

The escargots weren't great either.

The crème brûlée was good.

The restaurant manager was slumped on his phone; the only thing he did was clear our plates.

Otherwise, he had the nerve to come over and tell me that the table I was sitting at smelled like cannabis and asked me several times if I had any drugs on me.

He started complaining loudly to his friend on the phone, saying he was convinced I'd lied to him, all while making disparaging remarks about my appearance.
Too bad for him; he didn't know I was French and understood everything he was saying.
Needless to say, I wouldn't recommend it to anyone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arthur

sample_reviews_en.text:
A wonderful hidden gem of a restaurant. Warm hospitality from the server and a friendly owner made the evening enjoyable throughout.

The food delivered was tasty, homey and unpretentious and at a price which was unbeatable in terms of value for money. We liked that the steak tartare was prepared in front of us as it gave a refreshing spin to the dining experience.

Will definitely be back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Edmond Lim

sample_reviews_en.text: A lovely cozy bistro that offers homemade French cuisine at affordable prices. The taste and the quality of the dishes is great, specialties of the day are at wide range as well. We've been coming here almost every week for years and have never been disappointed. Highly recommend the vol-au-vent, beuf bourgignon, duck fillet dishes and creme brulee /Pavlova among desserts.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yulduz Ashrabova

sample_reviews_en.text: One of my all-time favorite French restaurants! The food is absolutely marvelous thoughtfully crafted with local ingredients, delivering an authentic French taste. The prices are surprisingly reasonable for the quality, and the warm welcome from the owner makes every visit feel like coming home. Highly recommended for anyone craving a true French culinary experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kariss Chen

sample_reviews_en.text: Good food and atmosphere. I enjoyed the potato accompaniments with the mains the most. They were very flavorful. The duck breast and beef tartare were also delicious. I thought the stuffed duck neck and escargot were a bit lacking in flavor so I would not order those again (maybe personal taste). There is a large menu and reasonably priced, so lots of things to try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joseph Yeung

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing French restaurant with reasonable price! Very friendly staff and owner!

Ordered a few dishes with a bottle of white wine recommended by the owner and every dishes are perfect!

Escargots
Hokkaido scallops
French onion soup
Potato salad with duck breast
Salmon
Lamb chop with rosemary served with potatoes

Definitely coming back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Low

restaurants.name: Pranakorn Noodle Restaurant
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 2/2-6 Phahonyothin Rd, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
If you're in doubts you can always take a small bowl of noodles for only 16฿. It will be small but you can decide either you like it and want to have a big bowl or choose another "sample bowl". As for me I ate two small bowls for only 32฿ and got full.
I think for most travelers I can recommend Tom Yum version with wide noodles.
sample_reviews_th.author: A C

sample_reviews_th.text: Nice smalll noodle dish (Boat noodle 12 Baht per dish) with chicken fried side dish and Thai dessert.  Recommend to try Namtok (น้ำตก)
sample_reviews_th.author: Panithan P

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the first noodle shop in this alley and personally I prefer the other shop at the end better.
As one review also said, I feel like this noodle shop has gotten too commercial and touristic.
This brand has numerous shops that you can also find at the malls around Bangkok but more expensive (20baht instead of 16).
They will ask you to choose the type of noodle beside the dish that you want. The coconut custard is written 14baht, which stands for 2 small dishes. If you just point at the image on the menu they will bring out 3 of them and it will be 42baht. It’s lind of too sweet for me so I would recommend just 2 plates/person. We were in two and 3 sets were too much for us.
They shrimp balls do not have the shrimpy taste at all, and the sauce is like honey-based. Not an excellent choice but ok to try.
I saw Thai people order charsiu rice and they look good. Maybe i will try that next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ngân Thùy

sample_reviews_en.text:
I dined here on July 5th, 1969 at 1:58 PM.
It started with: When I entered the restaurant, there was a table but no place to sit because the dishes hadn't been cleared and were piled up on the table. I asked them to clear them, but they didn't. The staff just stood there looking confused. Once I was seated, I asked to order food, but they didn't respond. They walked past me once, then a second time they acknowledged me but said they forgot. I had to wait until I couldn't stand it anymore and went to the counter to ask when my order would be ready. Only then did they come to take my order. They served the wrong items, and when I asked about the bill, the staff just stood there looking confused.
My suggestion: Even with many customers, you should pay more attention and be more attentive if you don't want to go bankrupt.
sample_reviews_en.author: ยลลดา ไทยรัตน์

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Nice experience with small bowl noodle -
They had 6 types of noodle sauce & mix, with 5 choice of noodle. We chose to try small bowls 16baht (Nov 2022), all off the sauces.
Thicken soup tasted like normal soup. Tomyum noodle had sour taste. Dried noodle was tasty. Brewed bean had quite strong fermented smell, this option was quite strange.
Personally, we reckon you to try all. Each could have 3 small bowls at least. They had option of big bowl 65 B.
The waiters would ask the spicy level. They was friendly.
Nice experience. We had breakfast at 9am, weekday. Hence the store was not too crowded.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hang Nguyen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Famous Bangkok Noodle House

We walked past and immediately stopped as we saw hundreds of bowls on the side of the street with bowls piled up 4 tier being served to customers.

Inside we were greeted by a hoard of locals eating their favourite noodles with varying flavours and spiciness.  So we sat down and did the same, enjoying a mixture of noodle soups including the fried fish which was really tasty.

Recommendation
GO and enjoy some local life filling up on 1 or 2 or dozen of bowls of your fav noodle soups.

#LetsGuide #localguides #travelblogger #garystribe
sample_reviews_en.author: Gary Collins

sample_reviews_en.text:
We tried all “flavours” and got to love the Tom yum one the best! Noodles type can be choose and it’s a hit or miss depending on the noodle type u like, but personally I like the kway teow. Their fried wanton was delicious too! Careful about the delicious flakes because we just put a little bit and the entire noodle turned a lot spicier than we thought we could handle. Drinks wise it’s the typical drinks found around BKK!!

service is friendly and they knew some English, thankful for that! Their toilet is also very clean and overall it’s a nice environment!
sample_reviews_en.author: Faith

sample_reviews_en.text: The boat noodles were decent. Orders stopped around 7 PM. There were six flavors to choose from, and five types of noodles to choose from. I chose five flavors, each randomly paired with one type of noodle, and each small bowl cost 20. Coconut pandan-flavored desserts were 20 each, and Cokes were 20 each. Trust me, any shop that survives on this boat noodle street can't be too bad. There's no one so amazing that it's worth a special trip. Tourists shopping at King Power Duty Free can store their luggage and walk a few hundred meters to eat here.
sample_reviews_en.author: free suagr

restaurants.name: Berlin's Doner Kebab - Sukhumvit 22
restaurants.address:

28 Sukhumvit Alley 22, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I saw this restaurant on Grab and happened to walk past one night. The quality is amazing and great value. The mid size combo was definitely enough for one person.

The staff was also great, Jack and Num were very welcoming and patient explaining the food options and came to my table later to check if the food was of my standard.

Safe to say 5/5 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

I only regret not taking a photo of the Berlin Doner.... it looked too good, I couldnt wait to eat it haha.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeremy Sim

sample_reviews_en.text: Trash of a rare kind. Meat is old, bread is stale. Sauces tasteless, nothing even vaguely resembles what you get in Berlin. 4 months ago they seemed to apologize about offering this quality to another customer - well nothing changed since then! Nothing of a real Berlin Döner except maybe its packaging.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dolores Watson

sample_reviews_en.text: The original doner kebab is incredibly delicious! They give you a super generous portion of chicken, and the bread is amazing – everything goes together perfectly. The sausage is so tender and goes perfectly with the sauce. They also have …
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayanis Kaewlom

sample_reviews_en.text: Just ordered beef wrap with grab and almost puked of their beef quality. The doner had pieces of hard unedible piece of meat (or something else) that kept coming up. So i couldnt finish it and threw it into garbage. Avoid this place
sample_reviews_en.author: Chyngyz M.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted good. We ordered a beef kebab and it was enough for two people.
There was a staff member who kept checking on our order; if I remember correctly, his name was Golf. If you love kebabs, you have to try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamolchanok Poolpipat

sample_reviews_en.text: I just had the beef Döner delivered. While it was good in the past, whatever kind of low quality beef they put in there today was just disgusting! Just weird crunchy and wobbly bits everywhere in the meat. That sucked!
sample_reviews_en.author: Florian Fratzscher

sample_reviews_en.text:
cute little tucked away place to get a yummy late night snack !

Aashi is such a sweetheart ! recommended me some food and it truly didn’t disappoint…. kofte is so yummy…. much love xx gonna come back again 🙏🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: itskirstenjane

sample_reviews_en.text: Best doner kebab in Thailand so far 👍🏻 Top quality, halal, and super delicious. My kids loved it too, even though they're very picky about doner kebabs (used to the quality from Hamburg and Berlin)!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mariam Sayedi

restaurants.name: Yot Khao Tom
restaurants.address:

40/195 ซอย ลาซาล Sukhumvit 105 Alley, Bang Na Tai, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Great selection of dishes and well priced quick service."

sample_reviews_en.text:
I waited forever for the steamed egg custard. I was furious. I ordered 5 dishes; the first two came out quickly. A while later, the glass noodle casserole arrived, but the steamed egg custard still hadn't come. I figured it takes time, so I waited.

Then, the Tom Yum soup, which I ordered last, arrived, still without the steamed egg custard. I asked about it and said if it wasn't ready, I didn't want it anymore because I'd already finished my rice.

The staff disappeared and then came back saying it was almost ready. In the end, I waited another 10 minutes for the steamed egg custard. Was the kitchen just starting to make it? Steamed egg custard in a hot pot takes hours to make!

If it wasn't ready, I could have canceled the bill, I wouldn't mind. 🔥But I'm furious that the kitchen said it was almost ready, but then made me wait another 10 minutes. What kind of service is that? Terrible!🔥

I will never return. I didn't even get an apology. So frustrating! 🫩🫩
sample_reviews_en.author: Giffy Giffy

sample_reviews_en.text:
It took 40 minutes to prepare my order. I waited forever. All I got was rice, beer, and ice. I finished the beer and wondered what I was supposed to eat with the rice, as the food still hadn't arrived. Meanwhile, delivery orders were coming out like crazy. If you don't have the capacity to handle and serve food, you shouldn't be accepting delivery orders at all, or maybe just close the restaurant and only accept delivery.

In short, I canceled my entire order because when I asked, they hadn't even started preparing it yet. And importantly, I only ordered two dishes! What the heck?!

Anyone thinking of eating here should think twice. If the restaurant remains in this condition, then that's it.
sample_reviews_en.author: PSYSIGN P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Spicy Chicken with Cashew Nuts (120 THB): My favorite dish today. The fried chicken was crispy, and I loved the flavor. Delicious.

Spicy Sausage Salad with Fried Egg (100 THB): The salad was good, especially with the rice porridge.

Stir-fried Chives with Tofu (80 THB): Standard deliciousness.

Super Pork Rib Soup (120 THB): This dish was just okay. I wish it was spicier, and the ribs had too little meat, making them difficult to eat.

The food came out quickly. Overall, it was a satisfying meal.
……………………………………
🏡 Yot Khao Tom
📍 Lasalle
⏰ 4 PM - 1 AM
🅿️ Parking Available
sample_reviews_en.author: Pangeataround Pang

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was extremely unprofessional. It took almost 20 minutes to get my order. I had to go ask for water, but they didn't give me a glass. I waited another 10 minutes and had to go get a glass myself.
- The omelet looked like the picture.
- The spicy salad was served with more than half of the dressing spilled.
- Is the eggplant with minced pork and salted fish a different recipe from the Lasalle 75 branch? That branch doesn't add chili or basil, and the dish tastes great as the name suggests. It's very different from here.
sample_reviews_en.author: PAIR THITIPORN

sample_reviews_en.text: I found a steel wool scouring pad in my stir-fried morning glory. I didn't get a chance to take a picture before the staff grabbed it. I also found an insect in the fried pork ribs with garlic. The restaurant remained silent and offered no apology whatsoever. We asked for the owner, but they didn't come over. They just had a staff member reduce the price of the stir-fried morning glory. I want to say that an apology is very important in the event of a mistake.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bowvy Kanyavee

sample_reviews_en.text:
This rice porridge restaurant is not far from BITEC Bangna.

The food is delicious, the portions are large and worth the price.
The ingredients are good, and the food and rice porridge are served hot and quickly.

The side dishes taste just right when eaten with the rice porridge; eating them plain is a bit salty.

The staff are friendly and smiling.

Parking on the street in the nearby alley might be a little difficult as the alley is narrow.
sample_reviews_en.author: Isaya Kung

sample_reviews_en.text: I have been a customer since I lived in this area but now I am moving out the area for my work overseas. Whenever I come back to visit Thailand, I will spare at least one time to visit Yot Khao Tom Soi Lasalle. The food is so delicious. My favourite dishes are always stirred  fried Morning Glory, Herbal Fried Duck, Fish dishes and many more. You will never go wrong just ordering them 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuth Sumaleewichai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten here many times. On the day this review was written, there weren't many people.
However, there were no staff members coming out to greet customers.
Pressing the button to request the bill didn't work; I had to call a staff member anyway.
And then I waited a long time before one person finally showed up.
There were no fans outside either.
I hope they improve their service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanasub Subrueangnam

restaurants.name: Sakenomise 2nd Kushikatsu Japanese Restaurant
restaurants.address:

33, 13 Surawong Rd, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: What a meal!  Very fresh and delicious japanese food with many choices! You can have lunch set or a la carte but we chose to go for dinner instead. We ordered many things started from sashimi which is super fresh and well prepared, both japanese and thai fishes on the menu but recommended to call to ask them first because it's catch of the day and sometimes sold out quite fast. Sushi and roll are so good as well, when it comes to Japanese food, rice always matters and the chef cooked them well! There are also fried snacks you can have with craft beer. The restaurant is small but call to book the table first so you get the private room, staff is nice. If you like the authentic japanese food, this might be one of the good choices in Bangkok :)
sample_reviews_en.author: J J

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere before entering the restaurant is a bit hazy, requiring you to walk down to the basement of the Wall Street Tower.

Inside, the ambiance is like entering a traditional Japanese restaurant. The decor is simple but effectively creates an authentic feel.

The menu offers a full range of options, including set meals, grilled and fried dishes, beer, and more.
All the food was delicious. The soup alone was exceptional – rich, flavorful, and with a perfect smoky grilled fish aroma. The fried chicken was crispy and delicious. Lunch sets are available at a special discounted price on weekdays, and you can refill your rice and soup.

This is another great restaurant to add to your list!
sample_reviews_en.author: Geo

sample_reviews_en.text: Authentic Japanese Style for both food and atmosphere. Price was reasonable. Lunch time free of service-charge and vat for special set menu. All raw ingredients were fresh and serve in very big pieces. After parking in the wall street building lot, you can go down to the basement floor by elevator. An entrance to this restaurant were presented immediately after you walked out from that elevator but no sign and no clue for you about where is this restaurant until you asked from staff there. Totally like the taste of food and valuable price. Some of staff need to improve service mind. Recommend to make a reservation if you plan to come here in the weekend. Walk-in was okay for the weekdays.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donlawat Chitsing

sample_reviews_en.text: Izagaya style Japanese restaurant in Silom area. Really good taste like authentic Izagaya in Japan. Located in the Basement of Wall street building on Suriwangse road. They have Kushikatsu which is real Kushikatsu style from Japan. Sashimi are also good. Most of them from Thai ocean and you should try. Oden are also good. Drinks have happy hours for alcohol. Sake not so many choices, Beer are more varieties, Shoju are also available. They have others Japanese dishes which looked good. English menu and communication are OK. Cash, Credit card, QR payment are OK. Reservation are recommended especially more than one people are coming. Enjoy !
sample_reviews_en.author: Supakij Khomvilai

sample_reviews_en.text: The quality, the price and the variety of choices are amazing. They have many types of local fish sashimi and the yakitori were so enjoyable, especially the oyster. The atmosphere is a little daunting as the floor and the store front is a little dark and the building is quite old. The decoration is quite authentic but it is worn, one of the wooden plank was sticking at my legs where I was sitting. This restaurant is located on the B-floor of the wallstreet tower so there are plenty of parkings (free for 3 hours if stamped). Would come back again just for the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hattapark Dejakaisaya

sample_reviews_en.text:
I cannot travel to Japan right now but I can have some authentic Japanese experience at Sakenomise!
First time visitor here, I went for the special kaisen don lunch set, fried chicken, okonomiyaki, and matcha ice cream.
I found the side dishes in the popular kaisen don set a bit too much; pasta and salad were edible while the fried chicken were a tad oily tho I like the main kaisen don very much! High quality fish and so yummy! Will definitely come back!

- quick service
- good for groups but be sure to make a reservation
- parking available
- open on Sunday!
sample_reviews_en.author: DK

sample_reviews_en.text:
Taste 8/10
Atmosphere 6/10
Location 10/10
Staffs 7/10
Price 9/10

Went for a lunch here where they offer an extended amount of value lunch sets. We ordered a Kaizendon set which comes with green salad, kara-age, soup, and potato salad. Also got the kobore ikura gunkan for maximum satisfaction.

Taste was pretty good. Sashimi was fresh, but what i like the most was their shari(sushi rice) and soup. Lunch set pricing was very reasonable for the meal you get. However, they were a bit busy with all the take-out orders so the service was quite slow.
sample_reviews_en.author: Varut V

sample_reviews_en.text:
