Lunch set is hard to beat in both quality and value. They also used local catches instead of Japanese imported for sashimi and sushi. Huge respect for that (it also give a much more selection of fishes and seafood for you to choose from instead of usuals)

Noticed that the squid quality today isn't as good though. Not bad by any standard but a week ago it was amazing. The lack consistency is a minor flaw compared to the rest you get for the price but it's there and should be considered before you give the place a visit or recommend to a friend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suthichat D.

restaurants.name: อู้ฟู่巨富-หมูกระทะ สาขาสุขสวัสดิ์
restaurants.address:

96/3 Suk Sawat Rd, Khwaeng Bang Pakok, Khet Rat Burana, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a really great Korean BBQ restaurant! The seating is comfortable, the air conditioning is cool, so you can eat comfortably without having to endure the heat. Parking is also convenient.

This time, I ordered the "Rich and Fulfilling Set" in size M. It included pork, shrimp, squid, and various meatballs – a pretty complete selection. The ingredients were fresh, especially the pork, which was very tender.

If you like beef, I recommend ordering extra. We tried several cuts, including brisket, neck, shoulder, and picanha. The meat wasn't tough and had no gamey smell.

Another thing I really liked was the wide variety of dipping sauces. Personally, I liked the peanut sauce with mala spice the best. It had a savory flavor with just the right amount of spiciness, and paired perfectly with the grilled meat.

The appetizers were also delicious: spring rolls, bacon-fried corn, and spicy rice noodle salad with pork sausage. The latter was really tasty and great for cutting through the richness of the meat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marisa

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent! The marinated pork was very tender, and the dipping sauce for the BBQ was delicious – no need to add anything. The fried chicken wings were good, and the fried corn was tasty. But my favorite was the papaya salad with thin rice noodles. It was incredibly delicious, with a well-balanced flavor – not too salty or sour, and the fermented fish sauce wasn't fishy at all. I was very impressed and will definitely go back again. The staff were also lovely, providing great service and recommendations. 10/10, I hardly want to deduct anything! This restaurant made me, who used to be tired of BBQ, give it a try again, and I'll definitely be a regular customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: พิภัสสร เสรีชัยวณิช

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a BBQ pork restaurant with good quality ingredients. The seafood dipping sauce, seasoned with chili, garlic, and lime, is excellent. You can ask for extra sukiyaki sauce. The soup is good, not too bland and not too salty. The fried appetizers are freshly made, hot, and not greasy. The restaurant is air-conditioned, so you can enjoy your BBQ without getting hot. The service is good, and they offer a welcome drink. Shredded cabbage is unlimited refills.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narumon Intaraprom

sample_reviews_en.text: There's a wide selection of pork and beef dishes. I ordered the beef belly, which was delicious – fatty but not chewy. The mixed pork set was also complete, with three dipping sauces to choose from, all tasty. The Luang Prabang papaya salad was excellent, with a very flavorful sauce. Highly recommended! The prices are reasonable, neither cheap nor expensive. The air conditioning is cool, there's plenty of seating, and parking is available.
sample_reviews_en.author: ThAnut (PP)

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

This is an air-conditioned BBQ pork restaurant. The dipping sauces are delicious, and the lime shot is amazing. They also have fried sausages and my favorite papaya salad with thin noodles. Parking is convenient, but it might get crowded in the evenings. Most importantly, the staff are incredibly friendly and provide excellent service. I've eaten here with my family many times. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Preuksa Chom

sample_reviews_en.text: It's à la carte, not a buffet. It's been open for a while, but it's still busy. There aren't many other restaurants like this in the area. They offer free cabbage and a welcome drink, including a lemon slushy. The ingredients are fresh and the food tastes good. Overall, it's delicious, and the kids love it. However, the prices are a bit high; five chicken wings are over 100 baht!
sample_reviews_en.author: C Wana

sample_reviews_en.text: This BBQ pork restaurant offers a variety of set options. The dipping sauces are incredibly delicious, and the fried items are tasty. I highly recommend the crab stick mayonnaise spring rolls, especially when eaten with wasabi mayonnaise – they're amazing! Drinks are refillable, and they also have Thai desserts like grass jelly and taro sticky rice balls, as well as ice cream.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chankawee Suthipinittharm

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an air-conditioned Thai BBQ restaurant located in the Just Food Suk Sawat food court. The staff are friendly and provide good service. It's an à la carte menu, with comfortable seating and a smoke extractor at each table. They offer a refreshing welcome drink of a lime shot. There's a parking lot, electric vehicle charging stations, and separate restrooms.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zaa NoData

restaurants.name: ร้านโกวใหญ่
restaurants.address:

Lat Phrao Wang Hin 36 Alley, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a famous noodle shop in the Chokchai 4/Wang Hin area. I came on a holiday at 1 PM, but luckily there was no queue! 👍🏻 They've added a lot of new seating inside, which is great. The staff taking orders are very efficient, and they manage the queue and tables neatly. The little girl serving the noodles is super cute! 🤏🏻

If you don't know what to order, I recommend any Tom Yum soup – they're all delicious! 555555 The prices are great, and you don't need to add any extra seasoning; it's perfect as is. You can even ask for extra broth to sip alongside your noodles. 🍜
**If you plan to order a second bowl, I recommend ordering early because each bowl takes some time to prepare.**

Parking is on the street. 🚗 You need to check the odd/even day parking restrictions, but if you're unsure, there's a large sign inside the shop indicating which side to park on. If you park incorrectly, you can move your car immediately – that's what happened to me! 😂
sample_reviews_en.author: Chollada Ch.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Gow Yai is a top-rated restaurant in this area. Every time I eat here, I feel incredibly full. I've been eating here for years, and it took me ages to realize I'd never reviewed it before.
When you arrive, the owner will take your order; just let him know your location, and he'll arrange a table for you.
The noodles are excellent, the meatballs are varied, the broth is clear and refreshing, and they give you plenty of pork ribs. Come late, and you might miss out on the ribs!
Everything is delicious, from the Tom Yum to the Yen Ta Fo. Try the Tom Yum noodles and the dry Tom Yum noodles – they're my favorites.
There's also a popular pork dumpling stall in front of the restaurant that sells out very quickly. Check the parking rules carefully, especially on the days you park.
***On even days, park across from the restaurant. On odd days, park on the restaurant side. The police around here are very strict if you park incorrectly.
sample_reviews_en.author: PSPN

sample_reviews_en.text:
The noodles are delicious, the ingredients are good. The dry version is even better than the soup version. There are many noodle options to choose from; I especially like the flat noodles, which are hard to find elsewhere. The offal is tasty and not at all gamey.

The staff managing the queue and finding tables are quite good, but it can get slow and there might be a long wait during lunchtime.

Don't forget to try the dumplings from the grandpa in front of the shop; they're delicious! The grandpa is polite and lovely.

You can park right in front of the shop, but be sure to check the odd/even day parking restrictions to avoid getting your car towed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phakwipha Kaewwisit

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Tom Yum noodles are delicious, no need to add any seasoning. 50-60 baht per bowl.
The dry Tom Yum, in my opinion, is a bit too sweet.
The Pho Yum is just okay for me; the clear broth version is alright, according to my mom. The meatballs are good, the ingredients are good at this restaurant. But the wait is a bit long. On Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays, there's a Kinako ice cream shop nearby. Ask the shop for recommendations; the flavors are good, but they don't offer samples. Some flavors are subtle. The ice cream isn't fattening, but it's expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prasit C.

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum pork noodle soup was excellent. The fish balls were good, the fish cake was good, and the offal was clean and not gamey. The Tom Yum Yen Ta Fo soup was perfectly seasoned, no need to add anything; the color wasn't too pink. The dry Tom Yum noodles were perfectly cooked, though a little sweet and oily. There aren't many seats. I came in the late morning and the restaurant was still empty. I think it would be quite cramped when it's busy. The staff provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponlapat Nipattasaj

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't know why the food wasn't very good the day I went. The soup had a strange taste, and the Yen Ta Fo and Tom Yum were too sour and not well-balanced. Parking is street parking, and there aren't many spaces. Even though it wasn't very crowded when I went, I still had to park quite far away. You have to check the odd/even day parking restrictions and prohibited times. The service was good, and the restaurant atmosphere was okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ballondor HappyGoLucky

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles tasted delicious and were well-seasoned. Sitting outside, it was a bit hot from the sun, so I had to eat quickly as they weren't served very fast, probably because they make each bowl to order. The portion size and price were excellent. You might have to queue around lunchtime, but the wait isn't long. Parking is available along the roadside in front of the shop, but it might be a little difficult to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: U R

sample_reviews_en.text: I can tell you that anyone who tries it will become a regular customer. The flavor is rich and satisfying, no need to add any extra seasoning. It's the best Tom Yum pork noodle soup I've ever had. Every time I come, I order several bags to take home. Finding parking might be a bit difficult, but the shop will tell you which side to park on—in front of the shop or across the street. The price is great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thipsriwan Puttivorrakit

restaurants.name: BUTCHER
restaurants.address:

3641, 7 Charoen Tham Alley, Bang Khlo, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food here is good quality since the shop open 9-10 years ago til now.
Such a great place with the positive attitude of the owner.
I think this branch is the only one Butcher branch that survived during the past few years.
You can ask the waiter to grill for you and avoid the smell of yakiniku. Super!
Chilling place for friends to hang out .
Various kinds of beers for selection.
Garlic fried rice with tomahawk, wasabi and beer , try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ju Janya

sample_reviews_en.text: This time we eat pork menu, shrimp, oringi mushroom and slice cabbage. We do not try beef menu because one of our friend do not eat beef. Anyway, pork is pretty good enough and it smell good with butter. The shrimp is also good as well. Next time I will try beef menu and may give one more star ^^"
sample_reviews_en.author: Beer Piriyalertsak

sample_reviews_en.text: Disappointed with the meat, the beef and lamb were tender but really tasteless in terms of flavor, we ate it medium-rare. I actually remember eating plain grilled chicken breast with more taste that the premium beef served here :(. On the upside, the place and the personnel are really nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Flavia Soare

sample_reviews_en.text: Best little place for (reasonably priced) beef and beer in BK. You can also cook specialty meats like Wagyu. Yum. The one in Ari is also cool. Just note ... it’s hot and sweaty but that just makes the beer go down better!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tim Arrowsmith

sample_reviews_en.text: Bar and grill with quality and knowledgeable in beef. There are several other meat with brass pan and hotpot option. They also serve self-developed craft beer. Overall is a good experience with friendly services.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thee Theerapat

sample_reviews_en.text: the place opens til midnight and last order is some time around 11pm, which is one of the few places to go if you are trying to have a late dinner in BKK these days. i'll put my vote on their chickens though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Max Cher

sample_reviews_en.text: New experience of having steak. Wide selection of craft beers. The pan is a bit sticky but you can ask for changing. Not recommended for butter haters. Not cheap but still not too expensive. Good for groups.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittinan Chaimanee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Eating here more than 6 yrs (!) during trips to Bangkok and still 💕Butcher. A super-friendly team, fresh quality food choices & awesome beer selections.

A great spot for an evening patio meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stephen G

restaurants.name: Sexy Pizza Pizza Bar & Tapas
restaurants.address:

540 Phloen Chit Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We walked in without a reservation, and the staff were very kind and managed to get us a table.

The atmosphere was lovely, especially with the restaurant’s choice of music playlist. We really loved it!

We ordered a creamy Alfredo pasta and a rocket-leaves pizza. The pasta arrived first, but about 15 minutes later, we were told that they couldn’t make the pizza and that we had to change our order to another one. In total, it took around 35 minutes for us to find out that they couldn’t make the pizza, which unfortunately put a bit of a damper on the overall experience.

It’s worth trying once, but unfortunately, I don’t think we’ll be coming back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ella

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Absolutely loved Sexypizza!

The pizza was incredible—crispy, beautifully charred crust, generous toppings, rich tomato sauce, and perfectly melted cheese. The seafood pizza was packed with flavor, and the steak was cooked beautifully and incredibly juicy.

The restaurant itself has such a fun, stylish atmosphere with the bold red decor and lively open-kitchen vibe. Everything felt energetic and welcoming.

🍕 Great food
🥩 Excellent steak
🔥 Deliciously charred pizza
❤️ Cool atmosphere
👏 Definitely worth coming back!

**Sexypizza is a must-try if you love great pizza, quality food, and a fun dining experience. Highly recommend
sample_reviews_en.author: Lady Whisper

sample_reviews_en.text:
Way overpriced and poor service.
First things first, the pizzas are good, let's not take that away from this place.  BUT they are expensive.
The starters were pretty awful, particularly the 'chicken wings' which honestly had less chicken on them than a chicken's foot.  They were tasteless as well.
Now, service. There are many many people working in this place (probably why the cost is so high) and so why did my daughter's pizza have to arrive when I had almost finished mine? Plus they couldn't even get the order right in the first place.  Inexcusable when you are paying THB600+ for a pizza.
Underwhelming I'm afraid.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Gill

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered a Margherita pizza, travel fries, and Pepsi, which totaled 840.
They didn't give me a receipt, and when I asked, she said she couldn't, and that my total was 1500! I told her I didn't have cash! Then she said it was okay, give me 1100, and that I couldn't pay by card because it was a takeaway order! Shame on you! She ripped me off! If you want a tip, ask for it!

Be careful not to pay in cash before checking the receipt. The employee is a thief; she'll inflate the price and say the receipt isn't accurate and that only Visa payments are accepted. 🤢 Exploiting the crowd!
sample_reviews_en.author: hajer alqaseri

sample_reviews_en.text: I thank the restaurant staff for their service. We arrived an hour and a half early, and they arranged a table for us in a great, beautiful location. The staff's attention was truly outstanding. We ordered chicken pieces, which were delicious, and three types of pizza: fig, burrata, and truffle. However, the pizza lacked flavor; we needed to drizzle it with honey, Tabasco sauce, and balsamic vinegar to improve the taste. The truffle was acceptable, but I didn't like the other two.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suaad Faridi

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Had a really great experience at Sexy Pizza! 🍕 The food was delicious, the atmosphere was fun and lively, and the staff were friendly and attentive.

The pizza was fresh and tasty, and there was a nice selection of food and drinks. It’s a great place to come with friends, enjoy some good food, and have a relaxing evening.

Definitely recommend Sexy Pizza if you’re looking for a fun restaurant in Bangkok. I’ll definitely come back again! ❤️🍕
sample_reviews_en.author: Shwe lay

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a great experience at Sexy Pizza. The pizza was absolutely delicious, made with fresh ingredients and a perfectly baked crust. The overall food quality exceeded my expectations.
What impressed me the most was the staff. They were incredibly friendly, professional, attentive, and provided fast service, making the whole dining experience even more enjoyable.
I will definitely come back to try more items on my next visit to Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khaled Alneaimi

sample_reviews_en.text: We had such a lovely experience! We ordered the seafood pizza and shrimp spaghetti with butter, and both were absolutely delicious 😍🍝🍤 The food was full of flavor and we really enjoyed it. They also have a fun fire show, which made the whole experience even more special 🔥✨ We had a great time and really enjoyed the atmosphere. Definitely worth a visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Fatma Aleeli

restaurants.name: Omakase Don by Teppen Park Silom
restaurants.address:

ชั้น L เลขที่ 1 อาคารพาร์ค ห้อง L03-3 Si Lom Rd, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We came specifically to eat here because we work in the building, but when we stood in front of the restaurant looking for a seat, the staff ignored us and were busy talking on the phone. We tried to say "one seat, please," but they still didn't seem to notice, even though we were standing right in front of them. Even after we left, the female staff member still didn't pay attention. I hope the restaurant improves this. We were really looking forward to eating here but were extremely disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: privated kaox

sample_reviews_en.text:
📍#OmakaseDonbyTeppen
Omakase Don by Teppen, Park Silom branch, 2nd floor, BTS connection. The restaurant is a small counter bar selling rice bowls (Donburi). It operates in time slots and reservations are required. The ingredients are high-quality and fresh, the plating is beautiful, the food is delicious and flavorful, and the service is excellent 👍🏻👍🏻
#Happyboy💯
sample_reviews_en.author: Natee Korsanan

sample_reviews_en.text: The lunch set is good value and reasonably priced. You can sign up for membership to accumulate points. The food is fresh and delicious. The staff are friendly, polite, and attentive. The restaurant is located right at the entrance connecting from the BTS Saladaeng station. There aren't many seats, so you might have to wait in line if you come in a large group.
sample_reviews_en.author: วัชรพงษ์

sample_reviews_en.text: Being a small restaurant with bar seating, it might not be very private, but the staff were very helpful and gave great recommendations. The food tasted good and was presented in a high-end way – excellent! However, I felt the salmon slices were a bit thin. Everything else was great.
sample_reviews_en.author: GiNGER

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my first time at this branch (I previously tried the Dusit branch).
The staff provided good service, were attentive, smiling, and readily answered questions.
I just found out that this branch only charges VAT, but no service charge like the Dusit branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suksan Phanphut

sample_reviews_en.text: A donburi restaurant with an omakase style on the 2nd floor of Park Silom. Signature dish is the Temari Set (Ball shape), which comes with donburi (wide variety), temari Set (3 types to choose), and complimentary (dessert or ochazuke) …
sample_reviews_en.author: しろくま

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop isn't big; I mainly came for Don's photo. The food was okay overall, looking very tempting, but it wasn't as delicious as I expected. I'd only give it a 6 out of 10, but the matcha latte was excellent—highly recommended! 👍🏻 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Rainbow

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is of good quality and reasonably priced, especially the set lunch which is great value and just the right amount to fill you up. The staff are helpful and provide good recommendations. Overall, I'm impressed 😊 …
sample_reviews_en.author: KARNSINEE SOONTORNRATTANARAK

restaurants.name: Wraptor Ari
restaurants.address:

32/20 Soi Ari2, Phahonyothin Alley, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
**Ari offers classic Mexican cuisine, with a varied menu that should suit different tastes. It includes fairly substantial salads, tacos, and wraps, all prepared in a simple and approachable style. The portions are quite generous, allowing you to leave feeling satisfied.**

**The atmosphere is pleasant, and the place can be a good option for a quick meal, whether you eat in or take away. The salads are an interesting alternative for those who want a lighter meal, while the tacos and wraps are perfect for something more substantial. The cuisine remains fairly classic, without any real surprises, but overall it's decent and satisfying.**

**The main downside is the price, which I find a bit high considering the quality and simplicity of the dishes offered.** Even though the portions are decent, the bill can seem a bit steep, especially compared to other places offering similar cuisine.**

**A nice spot in Ari to enjoy tacos, wraps, or a hearty salad, but it would benefit from reviewing its prices to offer better value.**
sample_reviews_en.author: Luxury thai

sample_reviews_en.text:
The wrap was huge! I'm a big eater but couldn't finish it. I ordered the steak wrap and they gave a generous amount of meat. I felt the sauce was a bit too much and too salty. I took the leftovers home and ate them in the air fryer, and they tasted even better than when they were fresh!

What I liked most was the incredibly thin crust and generous filling.

I didn't get to try the Quesadilla though. 😂

The staff seemed reluctant to offer recommendations and less polite than they should have been.

Parking was extremely difficult to find. I initially planned to eat at the restaurant, but there was no parking available. I had to ask a staff member to bring the wrap to my car.
sample_reviews_en.author: PuAy PoLLy's Journey

sample_reviews_en.text: Great food and drinks! Loving all the food and drinks we ordered over the years. We visited Wraptor every time we’re in Bangkok and wished we have one closer where we live. Their all sorts of wraps are our all time favorite. We really liked the wild honey lime and dark chocolate and mint. The small restaurant is cozy with warm ambiance. Reasonable pricing and friendly staffs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anita Rosaleh

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes good, especially the tacos. The Mexican food is delicious and has a flavor that Thai people can enjoy. The portions are quite generous and worth the price. The Fajitas, taco salad, and other dishes are tasty with plenty of vegetables, but the meat was a bit tough. Also, finding parking here is difficult; it's best to walk.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suttiruk Salaluk

sample_reviews_en.text: It's been a long time since I've been here, but it's just as delicious as before. I was tired from the long journey, but biting into the I Love You Honey Wrap almost brought tears to my eyes – it was so incredibly delicious. The Wild Honey Lime was also fantastic. Thank you for staying open until 10 pm 💖
sample_reviews_en.author: Praiya U.

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely amazing! 10/10! Everything was delicious. We were a group of over 10 people and ordered a whole table full of food, and everything was truly delicious. Great value. The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, good prices, and the staff are lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bongkot Poonkue (Bua)

sample_reviews_en.text: It seemed like there wasn't any parking near the restaurant, so I took a Muvmi for convenience. I came for lunch; it wasn't too crowded. The restaurant is beautiful with a great atmosphere. They mainly sell Mexican food. It was a real taste …
sample_reviews_en.author: booyns

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, and the wait wasn't long. Everything on the menu was great. Parking might be a bit difficult, but that's okay. If you're coming in the evening, you might need to make a reservation because I think it will be crowded.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vee

restaurants.name: NaemNueng Khun-Or
restaurants.address:

431 ถ.โชคชัย 4 Chok Chai 4 Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I ordered a small portion of fresh garlic, and they charged me 30฿ for a tiny bowl. That's outrageously expensive!
I spent almost 2000 baht on food, but they're still nitpicking. They should have …
sample_reviews_th.author: chinarat Tansuwan

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're craving Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage) or other Vietnamese food, this is the place to go. I especially love their spicy papaya salad – it's incredibly delicious! The food is tasty, the prices are moderate, and the restaurant is clean. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kannika Kp

sample_reviews_en.text: Our family's favorite restaurant. The corn som tum is delicious and flavorful, the nem nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage) is packed with ingredients, the catfish larb is spicy and delicious, and the hot fried rice with nem nuong is amazing... A truly satisfying meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bilitis Somritsuk

sample_reviews_en.text:
Popular Vietnamese restaurant. Nam Nuang or DIY Pork Ball with rice paper wraps is delicious.

Prawn balls in sugar cane skewers is thickly crumbed. None of us like it.

Empty plates should have been cleared away from table. They have been left until last minute.
sample_reviews_en.author: Selvi SF

sample_reviews_en.text: Anyone in Chockchai 4 shouldn't miss this place. I've been a customer for many years, and the food is consistently delicious. They use high-quality ingredients in every dish. Their Somtum (Thai papaya salad) is excellent. Let's get here if you visit Chockchai 4!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pipit Normuang

sample_reviews_en.text: It is not a complaint but all menu that I had were good for people in Central region of Thailand, I assume. I expect more tastes of Vietnamese and complexity of each menu. For the price range.... I would mind paying this price for the food here, to be blunt.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daton Chris

sample_reviews_en.text: This is our family's regular restaurant. We order delivery for lunch and dine in for dinner. The food is delicious, the menu is diverse, the ingredients are high quality, and the staff are friendly, cheerful, and always ready to recommend new menu items.
sample_reviews_en.author: KanaPappy

sample_reviews_en.text: I really want to highly recommend my favorite Nham Neung restaurant! If you're looking for delicious Vietnamese food, especially exquisite Nham Neung that's hard to find, you absolutely must stop by this restaurant. The food here truly …
sample_reviews_en.author: Fourtwenty

restaurants.name: Khua Kling Pak Sod (Ratchakhru)
restaurants.address:

24 24/1 Soi Phahon Yothin 5, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The place is nice, classic and spacious. I like it. Toilet is clean, simple but nice. Staff are friendly. My favourite dish is deep fried pork belly with herb. Other dishes is good. The spicy southern soup, Gaeng Tai Pla (แกงไตปลา) , I didn't t enjoy it at all. It is a bit bland (not rich enough as it's typical taste) and too spicy. Just only spiciness comes out.
sample_reviews_th.author: Pla Ontour

sample_reviews_th.text:
Excellent choice and taste of traditional southern food. Really love it.
I saw many comments about high price.
Indeed not cheap like street food around Ari but it's a high style house with good service.
But it is not over price (1 normal dish ~ 200฿).
I recommend it and I will come here again & again ^_^
sample_reviews_th.author: Julien Jalon

sample_reviews_en.text:
I prefer visiting Kua Kling Pak Sod’s Ratchakru branch over the Thonglor branch because it has parking, though the parking space is still quite limited. As for the food, it’s a solid five-star rating. I always order the Gaeng Lueng, which has consistently great flavor. The Kai Palo is also delicious, especially with the pork belly. The Kua Kling might be a bit too spicy for Bangkok locals, but it is well-cooked and dry, which I appreciate. The Bai Liang Pad Kai is decent, though not particularly outstanding—perhaps using duck eggs would make it richer. I also ordered some crab and prawn dishes, and as always, the food here never disappoints.

However, during my latest visit on a Monday evening, there were only two or three occupied tables, yet a group of customers at the table behind me was speaking very loudly, which disrupted the dining experience. On top of that, I left feeling full—but also with a few mosquito bites to take home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sandy

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fish kidney curry was very good, the flavors were perfectly balanced, but I was surprised to find no mackerel, only fried fish. The fried sea bass with fish sauce was a good price at 199 baht, it was well-fried, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, but the fish sauce topping seemed quite light. The mango salad dressing was very mild. The stir-fried Gnetum leaves with egg were bland, almost tasteless, and lacked the wok aroma. The shrimp paste dip was delicious, using real dried shrimp, not imitation dried shrimp. The side vegetables were plentiful. The dessert was average in taste, the coconut milk wasn't very fragrant.
**The desserts and plain rice were quite expensive compared to their value.**
sample_reviews_en.author: pathom panatnok

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is Southern Province Thai food and the initial impression as the dishes were served was that the food looked identical to the menu 😁.

Taste is superb, with great quality ingredients. Variety of the menu was also very good.

Staff was polite and non obtrusive, service was fast (only 4 tables) with light music quietly murmuring through the ceiling speakers.

The facility is simple, light and very, very well kept, more of a fine dine than normal Thai restaurant, let's call it local fine dine.

Grounds, it has enough parking for around 8 - 10 cars, no landscape, no play area.

Summary: Taste 9, Quality 9, Staff 8, Service 8, Speed 9, Ambience 8.5, Decoration 8.5, Cleanliness 10, Price 7.5, Grounds 7.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panu Tatirat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tasty southern style. The restaurant design, from the outside, gives homey look. Bright yellow house is easily spotted. For those who drive, parking is available. However, taking public transportation is a better choice during peak hours as parking lots are limited. Advance booking is also suggested to reserve your seats to enjoy your meal.
Southern-style food is famous for its spiciness. Food from this restaurant may not be that much spicy for typical Thai people who eat spicy food as usual. Anyway, foreigners may find challenges to finish those spicy-but-delicious dishes. Variety of mild taste dishes are also available to put off the spiciness.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thawicha S.

sample_reviews_en.text: Southern style Thai restaurant with very quality produce. A lot of the dishes has the strong punchy flavor reminiscent of Southern Thai food in rural part of Thailand. Some dishes food portions is a bit small just for a sharing meal. Many of their crab dishes are very generous with the amount of crab meat. My personal favorite is the turmeric fried whole fish. The dish has a strong aromatic flavor of the turmeric. The fish was fried to perfection and eating it with garlic fried turmeric is an absolute perfect marriage.  Ensure to try that dish yourself if you are visiting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Katethip Varanyuwatana

sample_reviews_en.text: Authentic Thai food with a cozy ambience, set in a converted Thai home. The restaurant name (khua kling) is actually the name of a southern Thai dish which you can also order. The food tastes good and portion is not too big. Some dishes are quite spicy so do let the service staff know if you need to tone down the spiciness level. There aren't that many parking spaces in front of the restaurant. We didn't have the problem when we went because it wasn't crowded. Booking is highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Foodie's Diary

restaurants.name: Sushi Masa
restaurants.address:

65/3 อาคารแอทธินี เรสซิเด้นซ์ Witthayu Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This sushi (and sashimi) restaurant offers a wide selection of various types of brioche buns. Go ahead and order a set; it's more economical than buying individual pieces. Yes, it's expensive, but quality comes at a price.

The real star of this place, however, is the Matsusaka Wagyu beef from Mie Prefecture. Matsusaka is currently the most sought-after. In Japan, the Japanese love it and appreciate it the most. It's the most highly regarded and considered the most luxurious.

Take advantage of it. Order the half-plate of Matsusaka A5 and ask for it grilled. Sit at the counter to watch the chef at work. To caramelize the surface, he uses a small, portable gas torch. It's unexpected, but absolutely delicious. It's the best Wagyu I've had in Krun Thep.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arth K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
-1 Atmosphere: I can hear staff playing games.
-1 Atmosphere: I can directly see staff playing games.
-1 Price: It costs 329.56 for a mini bowl of rice with sashimi.

+1 Food: The food is okay.
+1 Service: The waitress is friendly enough.

-3+2 = -1 I would give zero or even minus one star if I could.

If you don't mind hearing and seeing the staff playing games without wearing headphones while you enjoy your food and paying more than 300 for just a dish without any beverage, you might want to try their food.

I personally don't like noise pollution. So I did not enjoy my food while constantly hearing and seeing the staff playing games on their devices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Clarice M. Starling

sample_reviews_en.text: The cheapest sashimi set meal at 450 baht includes premium scallops, which is quite generous. However, the Wagyu beef donburi I ordered this time at 440 baht had a small portion of meat and the quality was just average. But there was a lot of rice, so I wasn't worried about not being full, though it left me feeling a bit empty. I arrived at 1:20 PM on a weekend, so I was basically seated without waiting. Also, a 10% service charge and a 7% tax are added to the bill.
sample_reviews_en.author: 葉俊弘

sample_reviews_en.text:
Portions are generous and the food is tasty, but the service could be improved. One of the main staff who served us had good manners and was professional, but another staff member seemed less trained and did not respond clearly even to simple questions.

My last visit was about 7 years ago, and the atmosphere feels the same. Not too crowded and not too loud, which is nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leo H.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Restaurant’s location is very convenient to get here, nearby BTS Ploenchit station, and being in Central of Bangkok with very good quality of food and good price. Of cause the food is very tasty. (Specially recommend the Homemade ice cream!!!)
The restaurant atmosphere is so private.
If you are sushi lover, highly recommend this place!!! Yummy!!! 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutjyjung P

sample_reviews_en.text:
⛔⛔ Don't go near!!! ⛔⛔
I ate there yesterday, and since then I've had chills all over my body, diarrhea, general weakness in my body, can't get out of bed... food poisoning for sure, I'm on pills, I really hope it passes, anyway, it's dangerous don't go near!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Gal

sample_reviews_en.text: My favourite sashimi restaurant in Bangkok since many years. Yesterday I enjoyed fabulous unagi (warm eal in a delicious souce) as well as salmon and yellowfin tune. I recommend asking them to this slice the sashimi to get more taste. Their …
sample_reviews_en.author: kris wijnendaele

sample_reviews_en.text: Japanese food located behind Sheraton Ploenchit, for the food it’s really worth the price. You can mixed your own roll if you want to, spicy salmon and anything spicy recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natee Chan

restaurants.name: SaladStop Emsphere
restaurants.address:

552 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Perfect spot if you’re craving something healthy in the middle of Bangkok. They offer a good selection of salads, bowls, and burritos from the menu, but you can also build your own, choosing from many ingredients and different types of protein. It’s not just a vegan place, you can also add chicken or other proteins, which makes it great if you want something balanced but still filling.

The quality of the ingredients felt very fresh and well prepared. Everything tasted clean and light, which is sometimes exactly what you need after days of heavier food.

The place itself is nice and modern, located on the ground floor of EmSphere, and the service was quick and efficient.

Prices are a bit on the higher side for Bangkok, but considering the quality of the ingredients and the location, it feels justified. I’ll definitely come back whenever I feel like eating something healthy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexander Cillan

sample_reviews_en.text:
It wasn't tasty, the salmon was bitter, the dressing was unpleasant, the second option was very greasy and spicy, the place is extremely overpriced, the edamame tasted of something else, apparently stored in the wrong place with the vegetables.

The only thing I liked was the smoothie, it was delicious, but the rest was terrible. People who say this is a great place for vegetarians apparently haven't tried really good cafes with this kind of food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexandra Pogorelova

sample_reviews_en.text: Second bad experience at this branch in four weeks. Today, I was presented with the wrong order, made to wait while they tried to figure it out (partner’s food arrived correct), and then told I had to pay extra THB 15 to fix their mistake (what?!). I would then have to wait, so I took the wrong order. Four weeks ago I had the worst (and smallest) Açai bowl I have had in BKK in the past 4 years. Will not be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: DB

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food taste is ok (not over expectation). However service is not there. Staff does not have service minded at all. My bf makes an order but staff does not really listen or either smile.

Also they serve kombucha which is splash over the place without shaking the bottle. Pay money but getting no drink. Staff seems not minded and not given any help for cleaning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suksiri Anannurak

sample_reviews_en.text: Great healthy casual option with delicious salads that have all sorts of flavor profiles, including Western and Eastern tastes. I went twice, trying the Vietnamese and Korean salads (I forgot their specific names). They have their own small seating section, though you can go sit anywhere else in the food hall seating as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Felipe Latorre

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant took a very long time to prepare the food, the mushroom soup was cold, and the beef burger patty was also cold. In the tuna salad, the avocado was still very green, hard, and unripe! When asking for extra chili sauce, they wouldn't give any even though they had a whole bunch of bottles right there
sample_reviews_en.author: Việt Anh Phạm

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm a huge fan of this restaurant! I first ate here at the Marche branch, and this time I ate here at this location. The staff provided excellent service, the food was delicious, and they constantly introduce new drink and dessert menus.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kt A

sample_reviews_en.text: Our salads were delicious, and healthy too. Lots of great choices on the menu, in addition to salads, such as wraps or açaí. Prices were OK, and the dining area seats about a dozen in a food court setting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adam F.

restaurants.name: Kamikaze Seafood & Steak Restaurant
restaurants.address:

Pattaya Beach Road, Pattaya 7 Alley, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a solid choice for a non-sleazy restaurant along this strip. It can be suitable for families. We brought a large group here and ordered in advance. The restaurant was very accommodating. The menu has a mix of international items as well as popular Thai foods, and there is a free salad bar that was OK on the night we went. The staff was friendly, but a bit sparse at times for a large group.
There are over a hundred seats in this place, mostly at long tables with benches, but also many tables and chairs.
For some reason, we had trouble using some credit cards here, but it's unclear if it was on this side or the CC network side. Otherwise, I can definitely recommend this place for large group reservations.
sample_reviews_en.author: Justin Yoshida

sample_reviews_en.text: It has been a few years since I have been here. I always get the grilled seafood mix. It comes with conch, shrimp, squid and mussels. For the price (699) they should at least give you a crab or fish in addition to the other items. The flavor is pretty good. I was not able to get the unlimited salad bar because that didn't start until 5 pm. The service has always been good. The restaurant sits right on beach road so of course it is noisy. You are able to catch a glimpse of the beach from time to time through the traffic. They try to seat you in front of fans to at least keep you cool. I know I can find seafood just as good but a little cheaper but if you don't want to search, Kamikaze is a good place to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Freetirement Randy & Lori

sample_reviews_en.text:
i never visit Kamikaze before.........The comment i hear was very good...so i decided to check myself....and YES....The words were true.....The place is very good!!!Located in the corner of Beach Road and Soi 7....it's big....has only outdoor area....The food delicious and the service Excellent....First time i saw so BIG MENU CATALOGUE....the shop had EVERYTHING!!!Seafood,meat,burger,thai,pizza,pasta.Western food,breakfast,wine,coctails,beers,....etc
as i told you,the food was very good.....the service fast and great...the prices normal....in the back,there is a free salad bar(so you can have your salad)
for sure i recommend it...the shop do not have aircondition but big fans
sample_reviews_en.author: Triantafyllos Sosos

sample_reviews_en.text:
The location of this restaurant is great, close to the beach, and some of staff were friendly, which is a plus. However, the food was very disappointing.

We ordered the set for 1,990 baht, and honestly, the only good thing were the prawns and the fried fish. The mussels were cold and extremely dry, the beef was practically raw and impossible to cut, and the crab wasn't fresh at all. We ended up leaving half of the set, and we didn't want to take it home.

The Tom Yum soup lacked flavor, far from the authentic Thai taste, and the spicy seafood salad was so bad we only tried it once.

Overall, not a good dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gigi Pr

sample_reviews_en.text:
The menu is extremely long, which is appealing at first. However the quality of food is terrible. The pizza is terrible, it is not pizza dough, the sauce taste like ketchup, and the cheese is barely cooked. The beef burger, is anything but beef! Also, there was supposed to be a free salad bar. We knew about it from reviews, but we have not been informed, we had to ask about it. And when we saw it, we understood why… it was ridiculous! A few cucumbers and cherry tomatoes.
Anyway… to avoid.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sandy Zarka

sample_reviews_en.text: Very delicious restaurant on Beach road. Pretty cool interior with the TukTuk tables. Started with salman and tuna sashimi; it was fresh and very good, as well as the vegetable tempura; really nice with the sweet sauce that complimentd it. I had the Wagyu ribeye and passion fruit sparkling boba soda(delicious). It was very good at the price. Also on the table was a full fried fish and spicy glass noodles salad ( really really delicious, wish I knew the name) and a pad Thai.
sample_reviews_en.author: bryan mancuso

sample_reviews_en.text:
Decent service. Open concept, not in enclosed air-conditioned enclosure. Facing Pattaya Beach main road. Food not bad. The fried whole fish was nice at 8.5/10. The Tom Yum Soup at 8/10, had the milky version. The stirred fried vegetables was okay. The Coconut drink 👍🏼, water melon drink 👍🏼 The grilled lobster not too bad at 8/10.

Only found out about the free salad bar when we were done eating. Tried the white dragon fruit, it was nice 👍🏼😃

(December 5th, 2023)
sample_reviews_en.author: John Tango

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had dinner here with a nice beachfront view, which really sets the mood, especially in the evening. The seafood was fresh and well-prepared, and the menu has a good mix of seafood and steak options. Staff were friendly and attentive without being overbearing.

One downside is parking there’s no proper parking space, so that can be a bit inconvenient. Overall, a decent place for a relaxed dinner by the beach. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Crazy Traveller

restaurants.name: Lim Lao Ngow (Taling Chan) ลิ้มเหล่าโหงว (ตลิ่งชัน)
restaurants.address:

20, 1 Borommaratchachonnani Rd, Chimphli, Taling Chan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff member in the black shirt was terrible. The shrimp dumplings (Hakka style) were undercooked, the shrimp was hard, the dough stuck to the paper, and they fell apart when I picked them up. The pork siu mai smelled spoiled, like they'd been frozen for a long time, and they were oversteamed. When I pointed out they seemed undercooked, the staff member just took them away and said she would re-steam them. The total bill was almost 200 baht. Initially, they said all the 150 baht items were sold out, so I accepted the 175 baht ones. The service, the attitude, the demeanor – everything was awful. I was extremely disappointed. The only staff member who apologized was a junior female employee who handled the bill; she was polite despite being a junior. The supervisor, however, argued with the customer every step of the way. The restaurant wasn't busy, and she was just playing on her phone during her shift. If she's not comfortable in this job, she should reconsider her position. The restaurant and manager should have informed me of this incident so they can improve. I won't be using their services again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nathrada Rujiratchayangkoon

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is a must-try for its Yen Ta Fo noodles. The broth is rich and flavorful, the fish balls are crispy and not fishy. The restaurant is beautifully decorated and inviting, with a relaxing green space, a bright and airy atmosphere, and cool air conditioning. Cleanliness is excellent. During this COVID-19 period, the restaurant has implemented good management practices, including temperature checks, hand sanitizer, socially distanced seating, and partitions. Food and drinks are reasonably priced, and there is ample parking.

This restaurant has received both a Shell Shuan Chim award and a ranking from the Michelin Guide, guaranteeing its deliciousness.
sample_reviews_en.author: WW Holmes

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, I brought my family to try Lim Lao Ngow. We ordered several dishes including Lim Lao Ngow dry noodles, mala noodles, yen ta fo noodles, and fried spring rolls. Each dish exceeded our expectations in terms of taste. The noodles were chewy and soft, and the sauce was rich and flavorful. The fish balls, which are a highlight of the restaurant, were especially delicious – bouncy, fresh, and lived up to their reputation. The fried spring rolls were crispy and not oily, making them very enjoyable. Overall, this is another famous noodle restaurant that impressed us with its taste and was well worth trying.
sample_reviews_en.author: ekachai Nui

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice noodle, good atmosphere, but too expensive.

Their yellow noodle is good, chewy, well cooked, and not oily like other noodle shops. The fish ball taste nice, prawn ball is a bit too soft, chinese fish sausage is okay. Their tom yum is a bit too sweet with reasonable amount of minced pork. The portion for each bowl is too little considering a price of 65 bahts/bowl, you can finish the whole bowl in less than a minute.

Afterall, there are better noodle shops out there at a much cheaper price but you should come and try once since they received a Michelin award.
sample_reviews_en.author: apiwatbob

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a Michelin Bib Gourmand homemade fish balls with Chinese-style noodles. My visit was good even though the place felt a little bit cramped.

Mala Noodles was very good. In my opinion, it was better than the original noodles. Fish balls were springy and tasty. However, pork satay was so-so.

The bill was a bit pricey. However, if you love noodles and fish balls in general, it would worth the price.

Besides, you don't need to queue up like the China Town branch and parking was very convenient here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neeranat J.

sample_reviews_en.text: This noodle shop is overpriced, trying to create a luxurious atmosphere that doesn't quite match the food. The noodles themselves are just average in taste, and the portion size and presentation don't really justify the price of over a hundred baht per bowl. Judging solely by what's in the bowl, you could find similar noodles anywhere. Today, two of us spent almost 500 baht on three bowls of noodles – that's a bit excessive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bread and Butter

sample_reviews_en.text:
Is it delicious? Yes.
Is it expensive? Yes.

The definition is: Delicious, but expensive.

The "Ba Mee Po" noodles are delicious, my favorite.
The fried taro is also delicious.
The wait isn't long, they prepare it quickly.
But it might be full around lunchtime.

It's a good place to grab a bite, but one bowl is usually not enough; the portion is a bit small.
sample_reviews_en.author: S P

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went there at 20.26 the staff said already closed (claimed to close at 20.30)! Whereas, the sign says close at 21.00. They claimed that its an outdated sign? Does it really cost a lot to change the sign?? Do you guys really run outnof money to change the sign?

Also your staff should finish clarifying the reason, not just walk off!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattakrit Tongpoonsakdi

restaurants.name: Salad Factory Soi Ari
restaurants.address:

34, 1 Soi Ari 2, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Feels like a hit or miss kind of place. I ordered tofu pad prik klua (salt & chilli tofu) which ended up being delicious but my god it looked terrible. ‘Factory’ about says it right: It looked thrown on a plate without a second glance (and nothing like the picture), and 2/3 if the amount presented in the menu. I kindly asked if the dish was indeed finished and they took it back to the kitchen to ask. The second attempt wasn’t much better. But as I said, very tasty. The mushroom tom yum was also delicious, and came in a decent portion.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nik

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really loved this restaurant!! They have a large variety of dishes, and they all look good and seems to be tryingto go towardsthe healthier dide, but not exclusively, so you have options...but for my first visit I went with the one that said "Must try", that was the crispy chicken wrap, and it was very good. I also had a dessert the strawberry mouse and that was pretty satisfying too 😌

I'll be back, thanks 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: i Travel

sample_reviews_en.text: The food and location are good, but there are few staff members. The only downside is the arrogant behavior of the security guard when pulling up to park. He didn't even wave me in to a parking space when I drove in. When I finally parked close to the curt line in front of the restaurant, he started yelling and being aggressive! I think I'll stop eating here in the future!
sample_reviews_en.author: SOMSAK ADIREKLARPWONG

sample_reviews_en.text: This healthy restaurant doesn't just offer salads; they have a DIY salad bar where you can customize your own dressing, vegetables, and meats. For those who don't like vegetables, they have various types of steak, tofu, and delicious soups. For carbohydrates, they have rice and spaghetti. There's a huge menu – you'll be spoiled for choice!
sample_reviews_en.author: FoodLover

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is located in an alley with ample parking. There's a ramp for wheelchairs to easily enter. The restaurant is spacious, air-conditioned, clean, and offers a diverse and delicious menu. It's a comfortable place to chat, with a huge selection of savory and sweet dishes. It's a very interesting healthy food option.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joom Naya

sample_reviews_en.text: Love the roasted sesame seed salad! Food was tasty and healthy... Salmon steaks!  Service was good and the eating area, modern and clean. Loved the tropical theme around the building and internally. A good concept for a chain in the states.
sample_reviews_en.author: Elsonian

sample_reviews_en.text: The calamari was sliced ​​into such thin strips there was practically no meat, it was like eating a rubber band! LOL. But some dishes were delicious. However, the Fly restaurant is getting worse and worse. The chef's skills have declined, …
sample_reviews_en.author: มุกกี้ ขี้เเตก

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was served quickly and tasted standard; overall, it was okay. The staff provided good service. However, the table had a slight musty smell, like the tablecloths weren't clean. I informed the staff, and they resolved the issue.
sample_reviews_en.author: Billy Boonthong

restaurants.name: Olé
restaurants.address:

365 11 Soi Phaya Nak, Thanon Phetchaburi, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I decided to go because it was close to my hotel and there were quite a few reviews from Japanese people.

It looked a little intimidating to enter, but I mustered up the courage and went in.

There were about three groups of customers.

There were five tables, mostly seating four people.

The menu was in English and Thai.

I ordered gapao and mango sticky rice.

I was asked if I wanted rice with the gapao, but I felt like I'd be too full if I did, so I ordered it separately.

This gapao was spicier than I expected... (´；ω；`)
I used the mango sticky rice to soothe my palate while I ate it ♡
The sweetness of the coconut and the sweetness of the mango ♡
I was so happy.

The mango was cut into bite-sized pieces, making it very easy to eat, and it was incredibly sweet and delicious.

The coconut sauce was so generous it was overflowing from the plate.

After that, a pair of Japanese people came in, and about half the customers were Japanese.

There was a lot of Japanese being spoken, so it didn't really feel like I was abroad (lol).
sample_reviews_en.author: komasan

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered four dishes. The Tom Yum soup and Pad Thai were just so-so. The clams weren't fresh. The sauce tasted good at first, so it seemed delicious, but upon closer inspection, the fishy smell of the food overwhelmed the sauce. It was too late to spit it out because the fishy smell filled my mouth. Later, I told the staff to change it to curry beef, which was even worse. The beef was as tough as a men's leather shoe, impossible to chew. The curry was brightly colored, like water with added coloring, and had no curry flavor at all. The lotus leaf fried chicken tasted like frozen, zombie-like chicken. The service was indeed very good, but I hope the ingredients can be improved.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chuyu Huang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great food with cheap prices. My wife ordered pad thai, tasted great when you  use some kind of fish sauce condiment on top. It brought the sweet, sour, umami, and a bit spicy.

I ordered chicken basil and red curry chicken. The stir fried chicken basil is sweet, umami, and a little bit spicy. The red curry taste amazing, it has sweet, sour, creamy, and pretty spicy aftertaste. I love every bite of it.

Overall the foods are great and the price is pretty cheap.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nikko Tjandra

sample_reviews_en.text:
This small shop is run with care; the food is delicious, the staff are friendly, and the seating is comfortable. I highly recommend it.

This time I ordered Tom Yum Seafood Soup (small), Spicy Stir-fried Seafood, Brown Rice, and Thai Milk Tea. The portions were just right for a single man. The price might be a bit high for some, but considering the quality of the food and the overall atmosphere, it's a place I would definitely want to visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: FF

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, reasonably priced, and suits Chinese tastes. I've been several times, and it's always packed, whether it's lunch or dinner. A few times, when customers came in while we were eating, the staff said there were no seats available. I've even seen customers bring their clients. Although the ambiance isn't fancy, the food is good and the place looks clean. I highly recommend the mango juice—you absolutely must order it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike Zhu

sample_reviews_en.text:
So far, I've been coming here so often that the staff have come to remember my face every time I visit Bangkok. 
No matter how busy it is, I always wait about 10-15 minutes from ordering to being served. It's not cheap, but the food is consistently delicious, so I often end up here instead of venturing elsewhere. We eat around 8 dishes for two people at each meal, and the mango sticky rice is a staple after every meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: SHOTA

sample_reviews_en.text:
Besttttt halal thai food in Bangkok 🥹
Never skip this resto when visiting Bangkok. The most recommended foods are clear tomyum seafood, beef soup, ole chicken, stir fried beef basil, and its mango sticky rice! 🥰 the lemongrass juice is great too! kudos to their staffs who are very thoughtful, they will help & assist you kindly. They will provide you sajadah for praying on the 3rd floor.
sample_reviews_en.author: A Diva

sample_reviews_en.text:
They accept credit cards, the staff provided excellent service, and they even spoke English.

Orders are placed by writing them on a slip and pressing a button on your table.

The Pad Thai and Tom Yum Goong were delicious, and the prices were reasonable, making for a comfortable experience. It was so good that I went back two days in a row.
sample_reviews_en.author: d t

restaurants.name: Nuea Luan Luan Restaurant
restaurants.address:

7 2 Srinagarindra Rd, Bang Na Nuea, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The Ultimate Wagyu Sanctuary: A5 Perfection at Nurulunlun

I’ve discovered a true Yakiniku sanctuary at Nurulunlun (เนื้อล้วนล้วน), a modern and industrial-chic spot that is an absolute paradise for those seeking the peak of Japanese Wagyu A5. The experience centers on incredible marbling, with premium cuts like the Ichibo, Zabuton, and Misuji all boasting a staggering BMS 11-12 rating that provides a buttery texture that literally dissolves on the tongue. Every dish is served with signature flair on ornate golden bull platters, creating a multisensory experience that feels like pure theater.

To perfectly balance the rich flavors of the decadent Wagyu, I recommend pairing your meal with their fragrant garlic fried rice and refreshing sides like the seaweed salad and tangy kimchi. The service is truly impeccable, and the welcoming character of the staff ensures the entire experience is seamless and special.

For anyone looking for an authentic Yakiniku experience that prioritizes "only meat," this is the definitive spot to visit. Don't forget to look for that BMS 11-12 rating on the menu to guarantee the ultimate melt-in-your-mouth texture.
sample_reviews_th.author: Surapong Laosutthi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Top notch beef selection! Beer in a frosted mug! Simple but elegant, high quality beef but in a relaxed atmosphere! Staff were attentive right from the parking lot.

The space was very well kept, clean, landscaped and the feel was almost like walking into yakiniku shop in Japan.

My brother did most of the ordering and everything was great… I picked the beer (pitcher of Sapporo draft). Loved the small charcoal grill, easy to cook and the staff were very timely with cleaning it so the char didn’t build up.

They have a menu of ala carte items like tako yaki, sweet potato fries in case the kids needed something other than beef.

Plenty of parking, just be careful if you are turning from the other side of the road. The cars  and motorcycles are just cresting a bridge.

Will definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: R Bunupuradah

sample_reviews_en.text:
The meat was excellent and delicious. The large set I ordered was amazing!
The dry ice-grilled beef was spectacular!
The quality was great; I enjoyed it so much I ordered more.
The beef tongue was also excellent, 10/10/10!

And the best part was the draft beer – it was fantastic!
Fragrant, sweet, and smooth.
They kept replacing the beer glass with a chilled one, which I loved! I'll definitely be back!

The only minor issue was when I asked about getting less fat on the belly portion – I didn't want it too pale. The female staff member said it wasn't possible to choose, as it was all pre-cut in sets. I was a little confused by that, considering the price.

But thankfully, the meat wasn't excessively fatty; it was just right and delicious. I forgive them for that!
sample_reviews_en.author: MM JJ

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a butcher shop with high-quality meat at prices that reflect that quality. When ordering a large set, the shop even included an extra plate of meat, which was a pleasant surprise. It would be even better if the shop provided more vegetables or more than one bowl of miso soup, but overall, it's a good place. The food is delicious, the meat is tender, and the air-conditioned atmosphere is nice. The only downside is that when there are noisy customers, it can be difficult to have a conversation because the shop isn't very big. If you want to sit outside, you have to go after 5 pm. The staff are all very helpful. Overall, this is a good restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ming Hongdang

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an affordable yakiniku (grilled meat) restaurant offering both set menus and à la carte options. The meat is tender, juicy, and has good marbling, and they offer a wide variety of alcoholic beverages.

The restaurant offers private rooms, air-conditioned seating, and open-air seating in a comfortable atmosphere.

The staff provides excellent service, earning a perfect 10/10. They recommend menu items and promotions, offer complimentary plum wine to sample, and even provide lychee juice for the children.
sample_reviews_en.author: paphop plapiriyakit

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a meat-only restaurant with excellent quality meat at a price that's more than worth it. The atmosphere is nice and clean, and all the staff are lovely, friendly, and provide great service. We ordered a large meat set, and the restaurant gave us a complimentary plate of meat to try. They also had a birthday promotion with free meat, making it incredibly good value. We will definitely be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Swan Plon

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant was recommended by a friend, and I have to say I was impressed from the moment I walked in. The service was excellent, and the Thai beef set with premium Japanese Wagyu was fantastic. I loved the generous amount of marbling; it was delicious, though a little rich, but I still enjoyed it. The staff were all incredibly helpful and gave great recommendations. I will definitely be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gracelicious (Kaegrace)

sample_reviews_en.text: A steakhouse that's a must-try for meat lovers! 🥩 The atmosphere is fantastic, especially with the cool weather – sitting outside and enjoying grilled meat with beer is the ultimate experience 🍻 The service is excellent, and parking is very convenient – ​​no need to circle around looking for a spot. If you're looking for a chill place with delicious food and easy access, I highly recommend it! 10/10! 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Ronnarith Sugihara

restaurants.name: Funkytown (F*nkytown)
restaurants.address:

1, 39 Sukhumvit 37 Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Funkytown is an experience in various aspects. Firstly, it feels a bit like time travelling. With each flight of stairs climbed towards the 4th floor, you feel closer to the 1970s. Once you enter the space, you find yourself in a hip bar, perhaps in 1973 New York, with earthy tones and plush fabric upholstery. Period correct Funk is playing. But the other dimension is the second meaning of the word Funk. Don’t expect anything normal, this is an experimental cocktail lab and the giant jars containing mysterious concoctions on the bar shelves are akin to living lava lamps. Cocktails are rated by level of “funk”, which is practical for the less adventurous patrons. It can get quite extravagant, a Caesar salad or Green Curry cocktail might not be for the faint of heart. And the Final Funky boss would probably be the Duck Liver Pâté Old fashioned. We were moderately adventurous and chose the matcha fizz, the Long Island Thai Tea, the Thai Tea Tarik which is based on Malaysia’s favourite sweet tea drink. Overall a great experience. The barkeeper guided us through the process and gave perfect advice. We will come back to try the food one day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Felix Haller

sample_reviews_en.text:
Atmosphere: 7/10
Located in Bangkok’s Thonglor area, Funkytown hides behind a coffee shop entrance and sits on the 4th floor. The space fully leans into its name—funky, vibrant, and energetic. Music gets loud, especially with a live DJ on weekends, but it fits the concept. Backbar is decent. Plenty of seating with both bar seats and tables. Crowd is younger to mid-age.

Drinks: 7.5/10
Recommendation: Pisco Disco
Menu features a “funkiness scale” indicating how experimental each cocktail is. Selection is solid. Drinks lean into bold, unconventional flavor combinations—some work better than others. Coasters are good. Glassware above average. Garnish and presentation are well executed, including ice work.

Service: 9/10
Water served on arrival. Complimentary snacks and a welcome drink provided. Team is friendly, professional, and attentive. English skills are good. Prices are average for Bangkok. Reservations not needed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anton S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
It took a bit of time to find this place, which I actually enjoyed as it felt like solving a little puzzle 😅

When I finally stepped inside, it looked exactly like the photos from other reviews. It’s not a big space, but I really liked the atmosphere, cozy, intimate, and slightly private.

The service was lovely, and the staff were professional and attentive. I was introduced to the menu with a charming welcome plate written with my name, which was such a thoughtful touch and showed real care for customers.

I tried two cocktails, one was delicious, though the Green Curry one wasn’t quite to my taste. The shrimp roll was very good, the beef one was decent, and the fried chips were excellent. I’d love to see more light, healthy and bite-sized options added to the menu.

I would definitely visit Funkytown again. It’s such a nice place to drink, relax, and unwind.
sample_reviews_en.author: Winona Wang

sample_reviews_en.text:
DRINKS:
The drinks here are incredibly creative, unique, and unexpectedly delicious. The “Tomyum” is a must-try. It’s not savory, but has a subtle tom yum note that gently kicks in with every sip—in the best way. Perfectly mixed and beautifully balanced.

DINING / AMBIENCE:
This is my absolute favorite bar to bring non-Thai friends as an introduction to Thailand-inspired cocktails. The bar is tucked inside Sardines Coffee Shop on the 3rd floor. It’s spacious with plenty of seating, yet still feels cozy. There’s both indoor seating and a rooftop area overlooking EmQuartier mall, which adds to the experience.

SERVICE:
Service is exceptional. The staff speaks excellent English and knows the menu inside and out. You can ask for recommendations and they’ll tailor drinks to your preferences. Everyone is friendly, welcoming, and genuinely attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Asianeats Bangkok

sample_reviews_en.text:
This new is gonna be the next coolest hangout venue in Sukhumvit neighborhood. It's located right on the 4th floor of Sarnies Sukhumvit. The bar interior is giving retro-inspired vibes which is very insta-worthy!
I just love the great ambience, cool funky music curated by the DJ, generous portion of delicious food to pair with their unique cocktails. My recommendations would be Somtum Cocktail (a posh version of papaya salad that comes with sticky rice balls), Matcha cocktail, the smashed beef burgers, Thai Northern sausage corn dogs, truffle hams, sourdough with sun-dried tomatoes paste and the octopus dish. They also gave us a surprise cake for our friends' birthday celebration, which was really lovely!

We will definitely come back here again and this bar is highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Janchittra T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wow wow wow! This place is very special. From the vibes, to the service, to the cocktails and the food. Everything is first class!

The cocktails really are 'funky'. The 'kimchi' cocktail, the 'khao soi' cocktail (based on the Thai curry) and so many others. Totally unique and expertly put together. We could have sat trying out the cocktails all night. My personal favourites were the Kimchi and the Hawaiian Margarita.

The food is also incredible! Mostly small plates. We had a scallop crudo tart, pickle fries, a bone marrow canelle (wow!), meat skewers and an unbelievably good prawn toast.

Service was fantastic. The staff were super friendly and attentive. Great vibes and music. Highly recommend Funkytown. Just awesome!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Katie Horsfield

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stopped by this bar so I could work from home. The staff is really friendly, and the decor is really nice.

As for the cocktails, they aim for a funky vibe, and I have to say they deliver. They're very original, though, since I'm used to going to high-end cocktail bars where most cocktails are either very balanced or very strong, but you know whether you'll like them or not based on the ingredients and recommendations. At this bar, you really have to take a second look because you either love them or you hate them.

I'm not saying they're bad; it depends on personal taste. Just read the menu carefully before ordering.

Also, I'll say it again: the staff is very welcoming, and they speak English well! Thanks to them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marc DEBUY

sample_reviews_en.text:
Funkytown delivers on all fronts — and then some. The cocktails are absolutely outstanding, creative and well-crafted in a way that makes it hard to stop at just one. The food is equally impressive: delicious, satisfying, and clearly made with quality ingredients. And the service is attentive, warm, and genuinely hospitable from start to finish.

if you go during happy hour, some cocktails are just 250 baht, and the food menu is also 250 baht per item. For Bangkok, that's an incredible deal for this level of quality.

Funkytown is the kind of place that ticks every box. Whether you're stopping in for a quick drink or settling in for a full dinner, you won't be disappointed. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: P Tweedie

restaurants.name: Le Du
restaurants.address:

399/3 Silom 7 Alley, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
My postponed journey at Le Du (migraine) had been curteously accommodated.
I arrivednto a warm welcome.  I was happy to see the staff wearing silk pj's which matched my Komono aesthetic perfectly.
I had a veiw of the kitchen and plating area.
I was intoriducedntp the restaurant snd some of the ingredients used this 'season' (le du means season)
I chose the 6 course tastjng menu with wine pairing
The menu had some quirks that I wad not overly excited about and felt was a shock tactic rather than for flavour.  Never the less I braved the ant larvae.   If I had not had the wine pairing I might have chickened out.  Seeing their palid, larger than expected thoraxes and legs i only managed two.
I would have preferred they served the ant larvae an optional extra (if at all) and not inside the gravy.  Apologies however recalling the menu causing my tummy to flip a week later.

Overall the presentation was excellent as were the flavour profiles in most of the courses.

In particular the duck outstanding as was the pork ball in red curry paste and the amuse bouche with a green liquor to die for.

Ant larvae aside, overall an interesting and enjoyable experience which I would try again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kate Williams

sample_reviews_en.text:
Please do NOT believe the bad reviews, this meal was the best meal we’ve had in a couple of years and we’ve eaten at  Noma in Copenhagen, Osteria Francescana in Modena and St Peters in Sydney, to name a few. Yes it is super expensive but any restaurant that makes the 50 Best Restaurants in the World List is always gonna be top dollar.

From the first amuse bouche, I knew we were in for a treat. Every dish just got better with each course. If you’re a couple, treat yourself to the Signature River Prawn and the chef will cut it in half.. more than enough when you’re eating six courses and who would have thought of adding deep fried scrambled eggs as a garnish.

Further to the amazing food, the service is impeccable, relaxed but professional with a sprinkling of humour. The ambience is modern with great air conditioning and very stylish lighting with a cool playlist.

Honestly, the next time, we’re in Bangkok, we’ll be checking out the new menu and looking forward to eating here again.

Treat yourself and book a table!
sample_reviews_en.author: Martin BQ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Best meal of our lives. Seriously. Celebrated our 20 year anniversary at Le Du last night and it could not have been more perfect. We selected the 6 course with pairing wines and added on a river prawn. The food was absolutely delicious and worthy of the Michelin star. The staff were extremely friendly and clearly love their jobs. The highlights for me were the chicken spring roll (amouse bouche) and the meatball with ice-cream. Who would ever think to pair the 2? We advised when we were seated it was our 20 year wedding anniversary and they kindly served us a special dessert. The tea to take home was a nice unexpected touch.
They also let us select where we wanted to sit (8:30pm sitting; Thursday) and definitely did not rush us.
It was a wonderful experience and I’m so glad I didn’t listen to the negative Google reviews.
It is a lot of food and we have not eaten much today!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tracey Phillips

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came here for a date night and decided to try Chef Ton’s restaurant after following him from the TV show Restaurant War Thailand. And honestly, we were impressed by everything!

The service was excellent, the restaurant itself was beautiful, and the vibe was just perfect for a date night. ❤️

But most importantly, the food was absolutely amazing. Every dish was beautifully presented, and the flavors were so impressive. As a Thai person, I was genuinely amazed every time I tried a dish because I never imagined that the familiar Thai food we grew up eating could be elevated to such another level.

The flavors were more pronounced, the ingredients were thoughtfully highlighted, and each dish felt so creative and unique while still keeping the essence of Thai cuisine.

It was such a wonderful experience, and definitely a memorable date night for us. Highly recommended! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: sutida phubet

sample_reviews_en.text: Modern Thai cuisine. Le Du has been around for such a long time but somehow I’ve always missed it. This time, I was watching a Netflix programme on regional chefs and came across Le Du and Chef Ton and so we decided to visit. Loved the dishes we had that night. So innovative and different. I even tried the ant larvae and fried ants! And also the seasonal fish: Empurau. This fish was so expensive in Singapore and I’m so glad I’ve the opportunity to try it here in Le Du. Chef Ton was present that night and doing his rounds in the restaurant. Such a friendly guy and I’m honoured to have met him. Loved the desserts too; they looked quite simple but yet so delicious. Will definitely be back when they change the menu in about 3 months time. The price was quite reasonable for an ex Number 1 in the Top 50 Asian restaurants ranking.
sample_reviews_en.author: HC L

sample_reviews_en.text:
We celebrated our anniversary at Le Du, and it was an unforgettable experience from start to finish. Every dish was beautifully presented and full of incredible flavors that showcased Thai ingredients in such a creative and refined way. The tasting menu was perfectly paced, and each course felt like a special surprise.

The staff made our celebration even more memorable with their warm hospitality, attentive service, and thoughtful surprise of a cake with their greeting. The atmosphere was elegant yet comfortable, making it the perfect place for a romantic evening.

If you're looking for a truly exceptional fine dining experience in Bangkok for a special occasion, I couldn't recommend Le Du more. It was the perfect way to celebrate our anniversary, and we're already looking forward to returning. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: Dianne

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant was a good choice overall. The staff was excellent.
