The food was good, but we were aware it would be pricey—what we didn’t expect was just how expensive it would be, especially with wine pairings. It came out to almost 480 Swiss francs around 500 dollar for two, which for Thailand is not just expensive, but frankly crazy. That said, I’m not here to complain. The head staff member actually told us beforehand to review the menu since the prices were on the steep side, and we agreed. So, no complaints there—I just want to give my review. It’s a Michelin restaurant, haute cuisine, but honestly, the dishes weren’t always a hit. I wouldn’t choose this restaurant again. While it deserves a 5 for the service, soberly speaking, it’s not worth more than 3 points overall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Danilo Troia

sample_reviews_en.text:
It’s been 2 years and I still think about this place. I’ve eaten in hundreds of places and this place still lives in my memory to this day.

Chef Ton greets everyone at their table which was a nice touch. The service was impeccable. I ordered the tea course which was unbelievable, the waiter came over when they saw I didn’t finish the kombucha “you don’t like kombucha do you?”, which brought a laugh to us both.

With the 7 courses, I would say I’ve never tasted so many flavours on each dish before! I was constantly asking what am I tasting right now??!!

This is a must do experience if you’re in Bangkok!

One of, if not the best dining experience ever!
sample_reviews_en.author: T W

restaurants.name: nahm
restaurants.address:

โรงแรมโคโม เมโทรโพลิแทน กรุงเทพฯ 27 S Sathon Rd, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I believe this restaurant exhibited racist behavior. When we walked in, the first server told us they were full and asked us to come back half an hour later. When we arrived on time, they said there were still no seats and we had to wait in the hotel lobby for them to let us know… But I clearly saw several empty seats, so I spoke up. The server then very impatiently led us in—and I mean very impatiently! Afterwards, a white couple who had also left their walk-in information with us were warmly welcomed in. The staff even only gave us the drinks menu. We sat there for quite a while, and the white couple who had just sat down next to us had already asked about the set menu, but they still didn't give us a menu; we had to ask for one ourselves. Also, this restaurant doesn't offer à la carte service; there's a fixed menu. If you don't want to eat a lot, you should think carefully, as the selection is very limited. In conclusion, we are very dissatisfied and would not recommend this restaurant. It's hard to believe that such attitude and arrangements have anything to do with Michelin…
sample_reviews_en.author: Margo

sample_reviews_en.text: We were here for Valentine’s Day (today) 2026. The service was pleasant and I found the front of house team engaging and helpful. The food, however, was almost universally terrible. The worst low-lights were snails boiled to a hard, rubbery texture in a curry sauce that was strangely bland, mixed vegetables that seemed to have been steamed with no sauce or spice and completely lacked flavor, a fish that was so dry it felt like it sucked the moisture out of your mouth, and obviously reheated jasmine rice. The one positive note I can say is that the beef dish for the main course was well cooked and flavorful (too bad my husband is pescatarian so he missed it - instead he was served a single whole jumbo shrimp with no utensils appropriate to extract any meat from it). I was open with the waitstaff that we were very disappointed, and they did take off two of our cocktails from the bill (a negligible amount compared to the total price), but I truly wish I had the potential for a pleasant evening back instead, and I hope you avoid this thoroughly terrible restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benjamin Steelsmith

sample_reviews_en.text:
we had a really great time, enjoyed the dinner.
only issue was with the service and some dishes being too salty.

Service was not up to par with a Michelin star establishment. No set server for the table, different servers serving, and some don't explain the dishes while others do.

before we finished the amuse-bouche, plates for the next course were set which was odd. serving etiquette was a mix up of different things. servers kept re-filing the water whenever we had one sip so they could get money out of us. something i didn't see happen in fine dining places. our booking was close to closing time, and service felt rushed that they were hinting we leave early.

now to the food. i would mention the names but i have no idea what they were called.
most of the dishes were really great. they tasted really good, we enjoyed them quite a lot. but some of them were too salty for our taste. especially the tom yum soup and the beef dish.  the best dish was the curry and salad. the coconut themed dessert was really good as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Honest Review Guy

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had the heritage tasting menu and the wine pairing.
Both were excellent.

Thai food at the highest level, featuring elegant utilization of local thai produce and ingredients.
I had some dishes whose flavors were reminiscent of classic Thai dishes(but at the highest level) as well as ones that were one of a kind and that I hadn't tasted before.
Great meal and at a great price. Waiters were attentive as well.

All dishes were excellent but highlights were:
- turmeric crab curry
- herbal scallops with roselle blossoms
- minced prawn with peanut gravy on rice cracker
- both the coconut and rice desserts

One critique that I believe would help elevate the experience even more:
- Some of the courses came together, which created a situation where while eating one course, the other one got cold.
If the courses had a bit more space between them, it would elevate the experience even more to a level Nahm could definitely get another Michelin star.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gal Sagui

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dined at Nahm, located within COMO Metropolitan Bangkok and felt that it is worth a visit.

The space is sleek and swanky, though a little on the darker side indoors. If you can, go for the alfresco seating overlooking the pool. It is much more relaxed and has a nicer vibe overall.

The food was the real highlight. Every dish had a beautiful balance of flavours, refined but still very true to Thai roots. The beef was incredibly tender and easily my favourite of the night. Also highly recommend anything with blue crab, those dishes really stood out. The tom yum soup was excellent as well, rich and comforting without being too heavy.

For a Michelin-starred restaurant, it feels like great value for the quality you are getting. Service was warm and attentive, and all the staff spoke good English, which made the whole experience very seamless.

We managed to make a same day booking but there were quite a lot of seats available when we arrived.
sample_reviews_en.author: Abraham

sample_reviews_en.text:
We wanted to end our Thailand trip with a lovely and, above all, high-quality culinary evening. Well, in hindsight, we should have taken the recently posted negative reviews seriously: To sum it up, the food was partly inedible, so we could barely eat any of the main courses. Here's a more detailed explanation:

The aperitif and appetizers were very good. At that point, we thought we had chosen a very good restaurant, one that even had a Michelin star.

Then the disastrous culinary decline began: the soups were so salty that you couldn't eat more than two or three spoonfuls.

The curry was also oversalted. We opted for the stir-fried "angry beef," which was barely edible. The beef was disgusting and not cooked properly. Only the side rice was good.

Dessert was overly sweet.

Unfortunately, a completely disastrous and expensive evening. Any street food would have been far superior to this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: christina klapf

sample_reviews_en.text: I seem to have mixed reviews of this restaurant. Decor and atmosphere was terrific. Staff were outstanding and sommelier was quite impressive. Service of food seemed a bit rushed. Taste of food was unique….i understood they took us on a journey of Thai cuisines…. Wanting to include spices to test our palates. Some dishes were overwhelmingly spicy, so the follow-up dish seemed a bit bland. Presentation was ok, but instead of individual portions, we had to dishup and share ourselves. We were a patron of 3 so sometimes it was quite difficult to serve appropriate portions per person. I suppose it is the Asian way of eating , share and share alike. Dessert was a bit disappointing. There was a great Thai dance show between meals. That was entertaining. To say the least, do try this restaurant if you want to be adventurous. I was left sometimes sweaty and breathless. Price was a bit $$$$.😂
sample_reviews_en.author: K “Momo80” K

sample_reviews_en.text:
On arrival we were offered a seat indoors, having reserved outdoor. Since the evening was very comfortable we “insisted” and were shown a table by the pool. An excellent choice in the end.
Choosing the tasting menu seemed the best option here. Not something we generally do but the choices on the a la carte would be difficult to get a nice balanced meal, so leave it to the experts. Turned out to be a good choice.
Every course served was excellent and the courses followed a natural progression in taste. Went well, accompanied by our choice of white wine.
If I have any criticism, it would be that there was simply too much food, but that may just be us.
Service was, as you would hope, attentive and unobtrusive.
There are many excellent restaurants now in Bagkok, but this is one where I would return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Richard Dawes

restaurants.address:

39 Soi Sukhumvit 33, Dangudom, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I walked into this place without knowing anything about it, but it turned out to be much better than I expected. The noodles were thick and curly, and the rich pork-bone broth had a bold, flavorful taste.

The ladies' set was just the right portion, while a regular bowl of ramen was quite filling. I would definitely come back again.

I went in without knowing anything about it, but it was much better than I imagined. The noodles were thick and curly, and the broth was a rich, robust pork-bone base. The ladies' set was just the right amount.

A regular bowl of ramen was a substantial portion that filled me up completely. I would definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: tsutae kittikhumwong

sample_reviews_en.text: I came to Kaisugi via social media (tik tok). As it was early for dinner and monday I was the only guest. I ordered the spicy miso Ramen and two shushi rolls. I expected the rolls as apetizer but they arrived after the Ramen. The Ramen was …
sample_reviews_en.author: Armin Mandel

sample_reviews_en.text: I found this place through google map on “ramen” recommendations, and I was pleasantly surprised! The staff were all so friendly and welcoming. I tried their lunch set, which was incredibly good value at 399+. I got all the appetizers, …
sample_reviews_en.author: Mint Patara

sample_reviews_en.text: I think this is a place you come just to eat ramen. We tried the 2-hour 1,500 THB course, which includes all-you-can-drink plan. I understand that you can’t expect too much at this price point, but overall, we were not so satisfied. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Gourmet Advisor

sample_reviews_en.text: The Pork cutlet tonkotsu ramen was absolutely amazing — super rich, creamy, and packed with flavor. The tonkatsu was perfectly crispy with a thin, light coating, while the chashu was incredibly tender. The Tenmaki mentaiko was also …
sample_reviews_en.author: มนัสนันท์ เกาทัณฑ์

sample_reviews_en.text: Very cosy place for a lunch with friend. Service is a little too fast for me when each dish comes so fast, and they take away your dish when the other guest did not finish his yet… it puts you in a rush …
sample_reviews_en.author: Siline Ng

sample_reviews_en.text: I think I've eaten at every Jiro-style ramen shop in Bangkok, but this is the Jiro that I, who has been touring all the Jiro-style ramen shops in Tokyo, like the most. …
sample_reviews_en.author: 【Minoru Ito】伊藤稔

sample_reviews_en.text:
After searching for a well-reviewed ramen spot, Kaisugi Ramen truly did not disappoint.
The ramen was rich and flavourful without being overly salty, making it …
sample_reviews_en.author: Rinrada Rinrada

restaurants.name: Hemingways (Pattaya) Sportsbar Restaurant
restaurants.address:

503 Pattaya Sai Song Rd, ตำบล หนองปรือ, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food is ok but service terrible. I ate there a few weeks ago and Sunday Roast was good but I found some of the staff unfriendly and too businesslike. Went in again this evening for the Sunday roast again and was looking for TV with DP World Tour golf on. I asked the waitress who approached me if there was a TV with the golf and she said “no golf” and turned and walked off! There was probably 10 patrons and 20 spare TVs which they could have accommodated me on. No interest at all. Won’t be going back!
In reply to response
Absolutely had the right place. I walked in from the rear entrance on Soi 10 and walked right through the place. Most TVs had England vs Nepal cricket on.  I must admit I didn’t go out the front entrance because I wasn’t interested in sitting out there but there was no golf on the TVs inside.  The waitress approached me and I asked about golf on TVs and she responded “no golf”turned and walked off. It wasn’t the fact that there wasn’t any golf on inside. It was that she just turned and walked off on me without offering any assistance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Salvatore

sample_reviews_en.text:
I live locally and come here frequently (usually the fish & chips!) The food is good.

The service is even better. Popped in to try brekkie and the food was kinda bad. (Everyone has a bad day, even cooks LOL).

My waitress and the manager noticed my silent
"What the heck is this?" face, and came to my table. They looked at my plate, said something to the food runner that brought the plate. The manager said she would make it right if I gave her a chance. Of course I did, and the second plate was perfectly delicious like their food always is.

Everyone can have a bad day at the office like this cook did. But the best places instantly recognize and fix problems.

That's why I've been a customer going on three years. And it's why I will keep coming back.

10/10
sample_reviews_en.author: roy herron

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hi guys my husband and I have just returned to England from our 2 week honeymoon in Thailand!

We used Hemingways for drink and food very often and we just want to say how lovely the staff are and how clean and tidy the venue is!!

The staff were very friendly and accommodating and done absolutely all they could for us to make us feel welcome!!

We run a pub here in England and we even asked if I could have a picture behind the bar to send back to our family and friends.

The staff were more than happy to allow us.

The food and drinks were great and we would definitely be back!!!

Thanks again for a great time and reception!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Joe Kavanagh

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐ 1 Star
Hemingway’s Sports Bar used to be a great place, but this visit was extremely disappointing.

I ordered a simple BLT and a cup of tea with milk. Instead, I was given a coffee, and it then took around 45 minutes for my order to arrive.

What made it worse was watching people who arrived 20 minutes after me receive their food and drinks well before I did. There was no clear explanation and no sense of urgency from staff.

Service like this is simply not acceptable. A basic order should not take this long, especially when others are being served out of sequence.

Very poor experience. I will not be returning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr. Michael Harrison

sample_reviews_en.text:
Been Hemingways every day for the past week. Very impressive as to the quality and service delivered. The staff especially Annie and Smile is very accommodating and often come to check on your needs.
The food portions and generously large and great compliments to the chef as it tastes great too.
Above all I’d like to thank Mark the manager who is responsible for this awesome restaurant and the way he strives to make sure of a perfect experience.
Well done. You guys are a great credit to the way a restaurant should be run.
sample_reviews_en.author: Surinderpal Chagar

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sorry, that was the worst burger I've ever eaten. I'm a chef myself.

I was shocked.

A cold, dry bun. A way too big "slice" of onion just carelessly slapped on top. A huge lettuce leaf.

The cheese wasn't melted. You couldn't taste the Wagyu beef.

No burger sauce. You could only taste cheese and lettuce. This thing is an outrage.

When I pointed this out to the waiter, he just gave me a weary grin.

My buddy's meat was burnt black...😆
sample_reviews_en.author: mike mike

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good food at good prices. Especially with the daily specials (schnitzel, chicken parmesan, etc.).
The restaurant is spacious, nice, and air-conditioned.
The service is a bit slow, but they try to serve you as quickly as possible. There are TV screens everywhere for sports fans.
Free Wi-Fi. It loses a star because the noise from English-speaking customers shouting and laughing loudly is unbearable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Antonio Socías Carrillo

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered Fish and Chips from here on 7th feb via grab. Not had Fish & Chips for years but wanted to try. I have to say it was really good and a fair price. Chips were not bad. Fish was amazing and cooked well. Not oily and batter was crispy perfect. Only downside is i asked for Mushy Peas and got a bag or garden pea's :). For a takeaway Fish & Chips it''s 9/10 from me.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mj

restaurants.name: Manop Suki
restaurants.address:

PGP7+VC9 ซอยเจริญกรุง 27 Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
An exceptional sukiyaki experience with perfectly balanced elements—vegetables are tender yet not overcooked, the pork is delicately soft, and the dipping sauce boasts a distinctive and memorable flavor. Every component comes together harmoniously. The satay pork is equally delicious, making it easy to overuse the word “delicious” when describing this place. It is truly one of our favorite restaurants and stands out as one of the top sukiyaki spots, without a doubt.

(The last line is a separate, unrelated comment about the sukiyaki experience.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Review Tee Jing Jai รีวิวที่จริงใจ

sample_reviews_en.text: Dry sukiyaki with mixed meats (beef, pork, chicken, crispy squid) is 60 baht. A single item is 50 baht. It's well-fried and has a nice wok aroma. The mustard greens aren't very crispy, more on the soft side. It's hard to distinguish between the pork and beef; it seems like fresh pork, not the tender marinated kind. They don't provide sukiyaki dipping sauce initially; you add it yourself. The dipping sauce is a fermented tofu sauce, sour, not very spicy, and delicious. Tea is 2 baht per glass.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zuzu Taro

sample_reviews_en.text: Highly recommended for anyone who loves street food. The flavor is unique with a strong wok aroma that makes the suki incredibly fragrant. Generous portions for such an affordable price and the dipping sauce is refillable. Highly recommend pairing it with chili oil absolutely delicious. Lovely owner, very local vibes:)
sample_reviews_en.author: Similan Charoensillapwan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This sukiyaki restaurant serves delicious pork satay with a fermented tofu sauce. I already like this style of dipping sauce (it was a little too sour for me), but overall it was okay.
The pork satay was tender, and the pickled vegetables were amazing. Oh, and the music at the restaurant was really nice!
sample_reviews_en.author: Monkeyaey

sample_reviews_en.text: Worth the price. The sukiyaki was very fragrant, the aroma was amazing. BUT... the dipping sauce was extremely salty, not sour, spicy, or sweet at all, just overwhelmingly salty. The staff were welcoming, polite, and lovely. The pork satay was delicious and very tender. Parking was difficult to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภูวเมศฐ์ ภัทรพลกุลไพศาล

sample_reviews_en.text:
The sukiyaki was delicious, with a wonderful wok aroma. The pork was tender and the portion was very generous. The dipping sauce was incredibly tasty; it's a flavor I've never tasted anywhere else.
The pork satay was also delicious; the pork was very tender.
sample_reviews_en.author: mhymie

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love this sukiyaki place so much! It's amazing!
I love going there to eat.

The flavors, dipping sauces, vegetables, pork, chicken, and beef are all incredibly delicious.

There's a juice bar next door with a lovely old lady; her orange juice is delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: ZJ ZOMJEED

sample_reviews_en.text: For those who love sukiyaki with a delicious, spicy, sweet, and savory fermented tofu dipping sauce, this place offers both pork and chicken options. As for me, I prefer beef, so I ordered the dry sukiyaki with beef, and it was incredibly tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yodchai Kongthong

restaurants.name: Daddy G's Smoke & Brew
restaurants.address:

45 Natthawutthi Alley, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "The food is tasty and well-priced—especially the smoked meats and the salad."

sample_reviews_en.text: This Western restaurant on Rama 9 Road, which brews its own Yaksha beer, is spacious and has easy parking. The European-style smoked barbecue and steaks are consistently high quality, and the sausages, shredded pork, and beef tongue are also excellent. The beer is on sale for 108 baht, which is a great deal. Some dishes are on the lighter side, but the atmosphere is relaxed, the service is attentive, and the average cost per person is 300-1000 baht, making it suitable for gatherings with friends or casual business conversations.
sample_reviews_en.author: 曼谷外围Outcall Services

sample_reviews_en.text:
Disappointing BBQ, but Surprising Sides
I came here with high expectations, but unfortunately, the food didn’t quite live up to the hype.
• The BBQ: The brisket was dry and bland, and the ribs were unfortunately burned, not just barked.
• The Highlights: Surprisingly, the Spaghetti Carbonara and the salad were excellent. The duck breast was also quite good.
Overall, it was a mixed experience. While the non-BBQ items were great, the main event didn't meet my expectations for a BBQ joint.
sample_reviews_en.author: Seree N

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a great atmosphere. The food is quite diverse and tasty, and the prices are moderate. They have a huge selection of craft beers on tap, so craft beer lovers should definitely check it out. There's free parking available, and a hotel is connected to the restaurant, so if you're too tired to go home after a drink, you can stay there overnight. It's quite a one-stop shop. The staff provides good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: fye

sample_reviews_en.text: This Western-style restaurant, which also houses their own Yaksa brewery, focuses primarily on European cuisine, particularly smoked and grilled dishes. The restaurant is spacious and comfortable, with parking available across the street. Located beneath a hotel, it offers convenient amenities. The food is delicious, and they have a wide selection of beers on tap, making it perfect for a relaxed meal and a beer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirayu Limjinda

sample_reviews_en.text: The sausages are delicious, the gravy is generously portioned, the pork is good, the spicy carbonara is tasty, the beef tongue is excellent, and the beer is good. Sometimes they even have organic produce for sale to take home, like eggs, tomatoes, and lemons. And if you get too drunk to go home, you can comfortably stay at the hotel above the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: PKY PP

sample_reviews_en.text: 🥩 The portions are generous, so if you're coming with a group, we recommend the Big Daddy G Platter, which includes the restaurant's best cuts of meat served on a giant platter. 🐮 The highlights of the platter are the Beef Ribs and Brisket, which are smoked for 12-18 hours, resulting in incredible tenderness and aroma.
sample_reviews_en.author: ไป- กลับเมีย

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing steak, ribs and pasta. Service was lovely and the owner came out to check on us which is always a nice touch. Sauces and onion rings were not up to the standard of everything else, but this didn't matter. 100% recommend. Steak is expensive but worth it, everything else is very reasonably priced.
sample_reviews_en.author: P N D

sample_reviews_en.text:
The steak was delicious! The smoked ribs were so tender and melted in your mouth.
If you're coming with a group, I recommend ordering the large set so you can try a variety of dishes.
They have a wide selection of beers.
There's plenty of parking.
The service was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: MooPipe Jinnapat

restaurants.name: Azuma Soba Restaurant
restaurants.address:

11 Soi Phrom Phak, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This soba restaurant serves huge portions—seriously filling, no exaggeration. The prices are reasonable. One serving gets you a massive portion of soba, and you can get up to three refills—great value!
The soba noodles are excellent, perfectly chewy, and the broth is flavorful. The toppings are well-prepared and detailed, not just thrown in for show.

The fried items are delicious, not greasy, and pair well with the soba.
The appetizers, perfect for pairing with beer or highballs, are also very good. It's ideal for a chill after-work hangout.

The restaurant's atmosphere is authentically Japanese, unpretentious, and very comfortable, like eating at a local Japanese restaurant.
Overall, it's a restaurant that puts effort into its food, offers quality exceeding its price, and is suitable for both a serious meal or just a light drink.
sample_reviews_en.author: SPÄÇĚ MØŇKĘY

sample_reviews_en.text:
I arrived right when they opened.
When I tried to sit at the counter, a Thai staff member kindly told me in Japanese that it was cold there and suggested I sit elsewhere. They immediately brought me cold tea and soba snacks after I sat down, and then served me warm tea after my meal. It was a wonderful restaurant with excellent service.
The soba menu is extensive, and the soba is both inexpensive and delicious, making me want to return.
I accidentally entered 10 minutes before opening time, but a staff member told me to wait a little longer as they weren't open yet. While waiting on a bench by the entrance, I witnessed three strong-looking Thai women enter 5 minutes before opening and confidently take seats without any warning from the staff. It made me realize that women from any country are incredibly strong.
sample_reviews_en.author: ポメ吉

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was craving Japanese food, so I found this place through Google Maps. Since the weather was quite hot, I ordered the Zaru Soba set, which came with a small Unagi Don. The food itself wasn’t particularly special. The soba dipping sauce was too salty, and the rice didn’t have much seasoning, so the donburi lacked flavor.

Considering the prices aren’t cheap in Thailand, it would be nice if they paid a bit more attention to the garnishes as well. The Unagi Don was simply a piece of eel placed on top of the rice — no ginger, aonori, sesame, or any kind of decoration.

However, the restaurant had a nice, private atmosphere, and the staff were very friendly. If they could improve the taste and presentation of the dishes, it would be a great spot overall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Food & Travel lover

sample_reviews_en.text: I regularly use this place for lunch! The food is good, the prices aren't too high, and it's become a regular part of my lunch rotation. They've also introduced izakaya-style dishes, so I'm thinking I might come here in the evening too. There are also a few simple private rooms (I say simple because conversations are pretty much audible), so you don't really have to worry about the people around you. If I had to make a request to the restaurant, it would be to offer a 1.5 portion option for soba noodles. Personally, I don't think that's a very practical operation, but 2 portions is too much and I end up wasting food, and 1 portion isn't enough, so I always feel guilty about leaving food behind.
sample_reviews_en.author: 世界を旅する覆面パトローラー

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is truly a hidden gem serving authentic Japanese food with a cozy atmosphere and lovely staff. We got the Azuma Gozen set which was more than enough for 2. The noodles are nice and firm and paired with the dipping sauce makes for a light but filling meal. You can get up to 3 servings too in one order. The salmon and rice where simple but absolutely delicious made with high quality ingredients. The tempura were wonderful too, staying crispy even after a while. I would definitely recommend this place to any one who is looking for good Japanese food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Victoria

sample_reviews_en.text:
We come here quite often when before or after our Samitivej Sukhumvit appointment. Restaurant provides hearty affordable soba meal.

Food: we usually go for their main soba set. They allow us to choose how many portion of soba to serve (1-3). There is also multiple izakaya items, all pretty affordable

Atmostphere: nice, casual setup which a few private areas.

Service:  efficient and friendly. Food come out quickly

Others: many Japanese patrons bringing their younger childre  so that is a pretty high praise!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tee Chayakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The soba was soooooo delicious!! I was able to refill the noodles 3 times, but actually, 2 was enough for me. I was so full I wanted to order more to take home, but I couldn't. 🥹 They don't allow take-out, I guess because they're afraid of spoiling the taste. They seem to care a lot about the quality of the food. They gave us hot tea at the end too >< so comforting, I loved it so much!!! / The entrance to the shop is a bit confusing because it's in another building.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khongkhwan P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a great restaurant with a relaxed atmosphere and spacious tables for dining. The menu is extensive, but the soba noodles are undeniably delicious.

The prices are reasonable, comparable to or perhaps even cheaper than in Japan.

For soba lovers, this is a restaurant that will get you excited.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tana Bota

restaurants.name: Blue by Alain Ducasse
restaurants.address:

Unit L101, 1st Floor, ICONLUXE ICONSIAM Shopping Centre, Klongtonsai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'll break this down in more detail:

* When I arrived I asked the woman at reception to see a photo of the dishes. She left, never came back and another woman came back and produced an ipad with photos right next to me - so the first woman clearly did not understand.

* I placed an order with the second woman for three local limes, cut into thirds, to go with the sparkling water. She came back with slices of one lime. She said she asked for them but got push back from the kitchen so this went on four more times until I asked a manager, who produced the lime quickly.

* The pastry was fantastic - beautiful and delicious.

* The ambiance is fantastic - very beautiful. I love the blue carpet.

* The hot chocolate was OK, but not great.

* They took 10 minutes to bring the water so I almost got up to ask.

* The vegetarian sandwhich was twice as small as it looked in the photo and tasted bland - one of the worst sandwiches I've had.

* The staff did not bring the bill when I was done so I went looking for them after 10 minutes and I found three of them chatting with each other at the back.

In short, the service is 2 star and pastries are 5 star and the food seems to vary.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dane Rose

sample_reviews_en.text:
First of all, the view from the restaurant is outstanding, overlooking the river and creating a beautiful dining atmosphere.

I visited the restaurant the day before yesterday for dinner and opted for the 5-course meal. Every single dish they served, including the desserts, was enjoyable and thoughtfully prepared.

I would especially like to thank the server for explaining each dish so clearly and patiently answering all my questions. Kudos to Maitai (apologies if I’ve misspelled the name)! I also forgot the host’s name, but he was incredibly welcoming and engaging while introducing the drinks menu. Although I decided not to order any drinks because I was trying to limit my alcohol consumption 😅, I really appreciated his friendly approach.

Overall, I had a wonderful experience. The food, service, and atmosphere were all excellent. I will definitely come back, it was absolutely worth the money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tino martin

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had an awesome experience, worth every penny!

I showed up for dinner to Blue. The view of the river, the city and the boats going by was stunning. Couldn’t have asked for a better table.

The food was fresh, creative and delicious. The chefs literally cooked with it 😂

Every dish was something memorable, and the presentation made it even more unforgettable. I even got some light reading material in between courses (about the restaurant and Thailand)!

Adrien and the rest of the staff were superb! They were knowledgeable about every dish, friendly and funny. After my meal I was lucky enough to get the opportunity to meet the chefs and kitchen staff 🤩 Even snagged a pic!

Unforgettable dinner. Each dish was better than the last, the most friendly and knowledgeable staff, and an insane view! Couldn’t recommend enough 🔥
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Berezovski

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was a truly wonderful experience. The food was absolutely delicious overall, and the staff were incredibly knowledgeable, especially when explaining the ingredients and the stories behind each dish.

The sommelier also explained the wines very clearly, making the flavors easy to understand. I usually don’t drink wine, but after trying the pairings, I felt that they matched the food perfectly.

I visited during a seasonal special menu, and my favorite dish was the one featuring mushrooms. It was outstanding — even without any meat, the dish was executed beautifully and full of flavor.

I would love to come back again when the menu changes.

P.S. The bread and butter truly live up to their reputation — and special mention to the lady staff who quenelled the butter so beautifully. It was absolutely amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mia Eleanor

sample_reviews_en.text:
High-quality ingredients meet meticulous craftsmanship. This spot offers an accessible menu that doesn't compromise on detail. The savory dishes are outstanding, the pastries are a must-try, and the beverages are perfectly matched. It's rare to find a place that feels this premium yet remains so welcoming for a regular visit. A must-visit for anyone who appreciates finesse in everyday life.

Hidden details many overlook: Extremely high-quality ingredients, delicious food, tasty pastries, and perfectly balanced drinks. It's a style of restaurant you can frequent often; the flavors are accessible, yet the attention to detail is exceptional.
This is another restaurant you should definitely add to your list.
sample_reviews_en.author: Review Tee Jing Jai รีวิวที่จริงใจ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Blue by Alain Ducasse, a Michelin 1-star restaurant, is a beautiful restaurant by the Chao Phraya River, located in Icon Siam. The service was excellent, friendly, and very nice.
The meal started with a welcome drink, followed by several other dishes.
The food was delicious and suited my taste. The green Rainbow dish was surprisingly tasty, especially since it contained no meat. The lobster was perfectly cooked, moist and crispy.
Finally, the chocolate was incredibly delicious.
I brought my sister for a birthday dinner today, and she received a surprise dish.
We also got to take photos inside the kitchen with the sous chef and team.
The wine selection was good and varied.
#BluebyAlainDucasse
sample_reviews_en.author: สุชีรา หงษ์สกุล

sample_reviews_en.text:
Blue by Alain Ducasse offers an exceptional fine dining experience with outstanding food, drinks, and service. The dishes were beautifully presented and perfectly balanced in flavor. The highlight was the French duck, cooked to perfection tender, juicy, and full of rich flavor, truly memorable.

The cocktails were delicious, creative, and well-balanced, while the wine selection was excellently curated, with thoughtful pairings that complemented the cuisine perfectly.

The service was impeccable. The staff were professional, attentive, and knowledgeable, making the entire experience smooth and enjoyable from start to finish. Highly recommended, and I would definitely return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mello

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went to Blue by Alain Ducasse during Songkran.

Honestly, really impressed.

The restaurant felt calm and elegant even though it was a busy holiday outside. Service was smooth, formal and very polished.

Food wise, my two favourites were the Rainbow Courgette Galette and the Monkfish.
The galette was super balanced (cheesy but still fresh, not heavy at all). The monkfish was cooked perfectly, really nice texture, and the sauce had a lot of depth.

Overall just a really solid experience. Nothing felt forced, everything flowed well.

Definitely one of the best meals I’ve had in Bangkok, would go back for sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: nipol kakmuttarad

restaurants.name: Hom Dee Noodles
restaurants.address:

460 Mittraphan Rd, Pom Prap, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited Hom Dee Noodles based on the excellent recommendations and high ratings. I ordered the egg noodles with vegetables, which were absolutely delicious - truly excellent quality and flavor.

The restaurant has an extensive and impressive menu. However, I should note for those with dietary restrictions that pork is incorporated into most dishes, including items like chicken curry and shrimp wontons (in the broth or as an ingredient). As someone who doesn’t eat pork, this limited my options significantly.

I completely understand that pork is a staple in Thai cuisine and the restaurant is naturally catering to local preferences, which makes perfect sense. The egg noodles I had were genuinely wonderful, but unfortunately the lack of pork-free alternatives means I likely won’t be returning.

That said, if pork isn’t a concern for you, I’m sure you’d have a fantastic experience with their full menu!​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
sample_reviews_en.author: K Ash

sample_reviews_en.text:
A great local noodle shop that’s definitely worth a visit. The egg noodles have a nice chewy texture, and the broth is light but full of flavor. The wontons are freshly made with a generous filling, and the roasted pork is tender and well-seasoned.

The highlight for me was the crispy pork—perfectly crispy on the outside while still juicy inside. It added a great crunch and paired really well with the noodles.

Service is fast, prices are very reasonable, and the restaurant has a simple, authentic local atmosphere. If you’re in the area and craving a comforting bowl of Thai-style wonton noodles, this is an excellent choice. I’ll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Unplanned traveller L.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This noodle shop in the area serves delicious wonton noodles with roasted pork and crispy pork.
The noodles are coated in oil and taste great. The roasted pork is fragrant, the crispy pork is good, and the fried shrimp wontons are tasty and not greasy.
Order at the old shop, pay, get a queue number, then sit at the new shop.
Parking is available at the Mor Mee building for 40 baht per hour, or on the street, but it's very difficult to find a spot.
Tips: There's a Kanom Krok (Thai coconut pancake) stall behind the shop. Walk through the back to order there first, then pick it up after you finish your noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayavat Chareonraj

sample_reviews_en.text: Order your food directly at the kitchen area, then walk a short distance to the seating area. There's no air conditioning, but it's not too hot. Drinks are self-service. The noodles are delicious; the texture is chewy and soft, tossed with garlic oil. The shrimp dumplings are large and plump. The crispy pork belly is thick-cut with a good mix of meat and fat, not just lean fat, and the skin is crunchy. The char siu pork is tender and juicy, not chewy. It's excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutta P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just a place I wondered across and decided to give it a try. Looks catered to the locals more so than tourist.

The Wan Tan Mee with Crispy Pork Belly was really good if you’re looking for a quick bite and local taste. They have a lot of other food options but just decided to get what they are known for since I have eaten somewhere else already and they only just opened when I got there. Portion size was great.

Stop by to try if you’re in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarah

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lovely little place with incredible food. This is authentic, affordable food and exactly what I was hoping to find in Bangkok. I would definitely go back.

The order desk is 2 houses away from the restaurant which was al Little confusing (although mentions with pictures in the restaurant), but a friendly local showed us around. Nice experience. Do go!
sample_reviews_en.author: Boris Van Severen

sample_reviews_en.text: Simple place but really good. The egg noodles are very thin and have a great texture — not too soft, not too firm, just right. BBQ pork is nicely caramelized and tasty, and the roast pork has crispy skin with juicy meat. Service is friendly and fast. If you’re in Bangkok, worth stopping by. I’d come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sonny Tanoto

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop front may look small, but there's a separate air-conditioned seating area.
The ordering, seating, and food delivery process is efficient.
The food is delicious, including the stir-fried noodles, regular noodles, and roast pork.
If you're driving, there's nearby parking at the Mor Mee parking garage.
sample_reviews_en.author: S D

restaurants.name: Chao Wang Duck Noodle
restaurants.address:

PJPQ+9MQ, Phatthanakan Rd, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Braised Duck with Chinese Herbs, Royal Court Style, is a two-shopfront establishment located on Phatthanakan Road, under the Phatthanakan-Srinakarin overpass, Suan Luang Subdistrict, Suan Luang District, Bangkok 10240.
The reason I went there was because I had it for free during lunchtime at a luxury car showroom nearby. I ate it twice and it was so delicious that I had to find an opportunity to try it at the restaurant itself.
I ordered the small rice noodle soup with braised duck. The broth was very rich but not too salty. The duck was braised perfectly, tender and easy to remove the bones. The price is 60 baht, and the portion is just right.
They also have stewed duck in soy sauce. Next time, I'll try the stewed duck noodle soup.
The restaurant opens at 8:00 AM and closes at 2:00 PM, but on the day I went, they were already sold out and closing time was only 1:30 PM.
Parking is available in the alley next to the restaurant, Phatthanakan Soi 49. You can park wherever there's a space in the alley.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaroonphan Lim

sample_reviews_en.text:
This long-established noodle shop has been open for a long time on Pattanakarn Road.
It's located at the foot of the bridge before crossing the bridge towards Vibharam Hospital. Keep left, avoid the bridge, and turn into Soi Pattanakarn 47. Go to the back and find parking between Sois 47 and 49.
The shop has a back entrance and you can call to order and pick up your order behind the shop.

Noodle prices start at 60 baht.
Duck tongue and intestines are 100-120 baht per plate.
The shop offers delicious chrysanthemum tea, roselle tea, and tea (on the table).

Food is served quickly and is ready for takeout.

📍 Cash only; no bank transfers or credit cards accepted.
📍 Parking is limited; don't bring multiple cars. If you're alone, you might find parking in the alley behind the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ruttiya V.

sample_reviews_en.text: It's so delicious! I've been eating here since I was a kid, for over ten years. The braised duck noodle soup with plain rice is the best. The service is great. It's always crowded. There's parking behind the restaurant, but it can be difficult to find a spot because so many people park there to eat. You have to rely on luck to find a parking space! 555 The last time I went, I brought my dog ​​to wait in the car, and they said I could bring him in. They were so kind! But I put him in a stroller and kept him under my care to respect other customers. Also, the food sells out very quickly. I recommend not coming after noon, or calling the restaurant beforehand to check what's still available. I always do this to avoid disappointment or a wasted trip.
sample_reviews_en.author: M Maydel

sample_reviews_en.text: This noodle shop serves delicious braised duck and stewed duck noodles. The broth is fragrant and flavorful, and their stir-fried chili paste is also tasty. The duck meat is thick, tender, and plentiful – one bowl is enough to fill you up. The duck blood cubes are also generously sized. This is a shop I've been eating at since I was a child. You can park behind the shop, but you might need to try your luck.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarun ch คุณพ่อ2i

sample_reviews_en.text: The duck dish is delicious and the price is reasonable; a regular bowl of noodles is 60 baht and includes duck offal, which I order every time I go. The offal is bouncy and not chewy. The only downside is the lack of parking; you have to park in the alley behind the shop, but that's understandable since it's an old commercial building. Also, the shop only accepts cash and doesn't accept QR codes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthanan songsri

sample_reviews_en.text:
The braised duck was perfectly tender, a bit too sweet. The stir-fried chilies were fragrant and delicious, just like the ones I ate as a child.

It was difficult to find parking. I arrived at 12:30 and drove around. As the afternoon approached, people started to start leaving. If you arrive at 1:00 PM, parking might be easier. The restaurant closes at 2:00 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: d apk

sample_reviews_en.text:
The broth is rich and fragrant with braised duck spices. The braised duck is cut into large pieces with no gamey smell. The duck blood is soft and smooth in the last bite — prices start at 60 baht 🍜🦆

This shop only accepts cash.

Parking is available behind the shop.

**Oh, I forgot to mention, their chili paste is amazing! I recommend not adding too much.**
sample_reviews_en.author: วริยา มารศรี

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious braised and stewed duck noodles with a fragrant, well-balanced broth. The chili paste adds a great aroma and flavor. The duck meat is thick, tender, and generously portioned, making one bowl filling enough. The blood cubes are large and satisfying. Parking is available behind the restaurant, but finding a spot can be challenging
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunny_

restaurants.name: 511 Cafe & Bistro
restaurants.address:

เลขที่511 Rong Mueang Rd, Rong Mueang, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere of the restaurant is very pleasant – the place is nice, calm, and comfortable to sit in. The service is also faultless: friendly, smiling, and helpful.
Unfortunately, the food leaves quite a lot to be desired. The papaya salad was weak, and the other dishes were really average, lacking flavor and anything memorable. The kitchen definitely needs to work on improving these dishes, because with such a nice venue you would expect something much better.
Overall: great ambiance and service, but culinarily just mediocre for now.
sample_reviews_en.author: Erwin Kowalski

sample_reviews_en.text: I passed by this place a few times over a few days since I was staying nearby, and the lady (owner?) always greeted me, so on my last evening I decided to come by for dinner since they have quite a few vegetarian options. The food is great, but above all everyone from the staff is really sweet. I sat with my back to the wall and was able to look out the entrance, watching the evening sky change colors behind the train station. Will surely think back to this when I remember my time in Bangkok. 🥰 Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: july the month

sample_reviews_en.text: The place is very easy to find. The food was great and tasty. Their tom yum soup is a must try, it’s full of flavour and it was not too spicy (which is perfect for me). Plus points for the staff, they were very accommodating, and the man who I think might be the owner was extremely friendly and communicated very well with the customers. I will definitely come back and eat here again when I’m in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: shieloves

sample_reviews_en.text: We chose this restaurant near our hotel because the reviews were excellent. We don't share that opinion; the manager constantly yelled at the waiter. The portions are small, and the dish pictured on the menu, which contained 8 shrimp, only had 4. They should at least indicate that the photos are not representative of the actual dish! Tourist trap: avoid at all costs!
sample_reviews_en.author: Françoise Jousset

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, and they have beer ready. It's a great place to sit, chill, and chat. The atmosphere is fantastic because you can see Hua Lamphong train station right away. If you're looking for a chill place to eat, sip on cold beer, and enjoy good international music, this is it. The owner is super lovely and the service is excellent!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pinyapat Mongkonpattanasak

sample_reviews_en.text: We had the set A breakfast, it wasn’t mentioned on the menu but it also included fruit! What a win! The food/coffee are good, it’s a nice atmosphere and the man serving us was friendly. Only downside is that it can be quite noisy since it’s next to the main road near the train station. But I suppose that comes with the convenience
sample_reviews_en.author: Ian Hitchman

sample_reviews_en.text: I was staying at a hotel near Hualamphong and looked for something to eat nearby. I found a small but very cozy place with delicious food. I was surprised because I was just looking for something quick to eat, so I ordered chicken with basil, a salad, and a beer to wash it down. Everything was excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Diana Chacon Condori

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there yesterday 🙂 The shop is beautiful and has a great mood. It was okay overall, but I wasn't okay with the service. The staff spoke nicely and in a pleasant tone, but their facial expressions didn't match their mood or tone of voice.
sample_reviews_en.author: MTD official

restaurants.name: Alola Pizza & Pasta
restaurants.address:

39 535 39/535 Lad Prao Wanghin Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍕Pizza Day's deliciousness will rival 😍 us, my dear!

Homemade pizza & spaghetti, baked in-house with fresh pasta and generous amounts of sauce.

Travel until the cat scratches you! Aloha Pizza Bistro & Bar - a date spot!

Amazing deals ✅ that couples shouldn't miss!

🍷 2 drinks for 290 THB - drink and become immortal!

🍕 Customize your own half-and-half pizza! I chose a Margarita & Truffle Cream with rich, creamy sauce.
We bake everything in front of you, so you can see the entire process.

🍕 We have a variety of pizza toppings and set menus.
🍝 Freshly baked spaghetti in various styles.

🚚 Delivery service available.

#Alohapizza #pizzahonemade #homemadepizza #spaghetti #pizza #spagetti #ladpraowwanghin
#traveluntilthecatscratchesyou #happyvalentinesday
#TeeMueyTheCatScratchesYou
sample_reviews_en.author: Cat Travel

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍕This is my second time eating here, and I'm finally writing a review!
The first time I came was because my husband wanted to eat fresh pizza.
Personally, I don't love pizza at all, because I don't usually like it. But after eating at this place, OMG, it was so delicious! I ate 2-3 slices already!

And today was my husband's birthday, so I brought him. The restaurant was so sweet; they even played a birthday song for my husband!

P.S. Before coming, I asked the restaurant to write "Happy Birthday" for my husband, and they did it for me, which was so sweet!

Overall, I'm very impressed and have come back twice. Whether you like pizza or not, I highly recommend trying it. It's delicious! The crust is thin and crispy, just the way I like it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rindara Watchanarungrot

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The atmosphere is great, a relaxed bar-style setting. The prices are very reasonable, not too expensive.
- You can order two different toppings for half the price of each. The margarita and truffle pizzas were delicious and not too rich.
- The clam soup wasn't overly salty or buttery. Squeezing lemon added a nice touch of sourness that balanced the creamy richness of the soup.
- The pappardelle pork ragout had a sauce that wasn't too watery and had a good flavor.
- The pork ball had a delicious sauce and the pork itself was very tasty.
- The burrata salad had excellent cheese and a good portion size. Everything together was perfectly balanced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Radjhagrit Thongwat

sample_reviews_en.text: This Italian pizza restaurant also serves pasta and red wine. The pizza crust is neither too thick nor too thin, with a slightly chewy texture depending on personal preference. The pink sauce pasta is decent, and the Alfredo is okay, but I personally prefer stronger flavors, so I liked the pink sauce more. The staff's recommendations were helpful. There's no parking lot; you have to park on the sidewalk. Overall, the taste is quite good, very authentic Italian. If you like that style, you might want to give it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: NP S

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of those restaurants that unexpectedly became my favorites from the first time I visited. It's a medium-sized shop, occupying a single storefront on Ladprao Wanghin Road.

The food is delicious, fragrant, beautifully presented, and the portions are just right.

The pizza is thin and crispy, and I'd love to try every topping if I get the chance.

I highly recommend it. The atmosphere is very relaxing, especially in the evening or at night. They also have wine and other drinks to enjoy with your pizza.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratta P

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best Italian meals I’ve had. The fresh handmade pasta was perfectly cooked with an incredible texture, and every sauce was rich, flavorful, and well balanced. The pizza was equally impressive—the dough was outstanding: light, airy, crisp on the outside, and beautifully chewy inside. Friendly, attentive service and a warm, inviting atmosphere made the experience even better. Highly recommended, and I’ll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: JaN SaBaLahey

sample_reviews_en.text: This place has a really warm and inviting atmosphere. The staff were great at helping us choose what to order.  The Caesar salad wasn't that special but the Vongole pasta was one of the best i had. The tagliatelle was cooked al dente, and the sauce was amazing with the clam and wine flavors. It was a perfectly emulsified sauce, not oily at all. Really recommend if you are looking for a good pasta place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeerameth “Gene” Klomsing

sample_reviews_en.text: The pizza is delicious! The crust is soft and chewy. They also have a wide variety of spaghetti noodles to choose from, including fresh pasta. There's so much variety! I've been eating at this restaurant since they only had one menu item, and now they've expanded so much. Highly recommend! The recommended truffle pizza, or their signature pizza, is still one of my top favorites. 🩷
sample_reviews_en.author: naparn saranchot

restaurants.name: Metro Square SiamParagon
restaurants.address:

991 Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited Metro Square BKK Gourmet Destination and was thoroughly impressed by the experience. The food was exceptionally good, with a wide variety of options that cater to all tastes. The highlight of our meal was undoubtedly the crab noodles and prawn fried rice, both of which were cooked to perfection and bursting with flavor.

The ambiance of Metro Square is modern and inviting, making it an ideal spot for both casual dining and special occasions. The staff were attentive and friendly, ensuring that we had everything we needed throughout our meal. The presentation of the dishes was also noteworthy, adding an extra touch of sophistication to the overall dining experience.

In addition to the fantastic food, the location is convenient and easy to find, making it a great choice for anyone looking to enjoy a delicious meal in Bangkok. Whether you're a local or a visitor, I highly recommend Metro Square BKK Gourmet Destination. Be sure to try the crab noodles and prawn fried rice – they are must-try dishes that will leave you wanting more!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ashutosh Jawale

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant offers a clean, open-concept layout that feels spacious and welcoming. The seating is comfortable, and the overall vibe makes it a pleasant spot to enjoy a meal. The menu is impressively large, with plenty of options to suit different tastes.

One of the best parts? If you arrive early and use the right dining app—like Eatigo—you can score a significant discount. I visited in the morning and received 50% off my meal, which made the experience even more worthwhile.

The food was delicious. I had noodles and sticky rice with crispy pork, and everything was well-prepared and flavorful. It’s clear they take pride in their cooking. Customer service was solid too—friendly and attentive without being overbearing.

Overall, it’s a great place for a relaxed meal with excellent value, especially if you plan ahead and take advantage of the app-based discounts.
sample_reviews_en.author: Meng Thao

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently dined at Metro Square Siam Paragon located inside Siam Paragon, and it was a really enjoyable experience overall.

We ordered the roasted pork with sticky rice, tom yum soup, pad krapao, and wagyu steak with aglio olio pasta — and every dish was tasty and well-prepared. The flavours were balanced, comforting, and satisfying, with a nice mix of Thai classics and Western options.

The restaurant had a great vibe, making it a pleasant place to relax and enjoy a meal. Service was also good — staff were attentive and welcoming throughout.

A solid spot for good food, good atmosphere, and reliable service in Siam Paragon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nagawa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don't bother to come if you care about how the food tastes. Food Court is selling more tasty food than here. Save the money. Crab ngo hiang, you can get better tasting ones at the food cart. Coconut chicken soup food court sells better and cheaper. Kang Kong normally has nothing much to shout about. Shrimp vermicelli, a total failure, don't waste your money. Spring rolls taste better with the sauce.

Overall, if you are not in a hurry to look for a fast fix, the food court is much better than here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Derek Chen

sample_reviews_en.text: Being a tourist from Australia we were always hesitant on where to eat. We came across Metro Square and it ticked all the boxes. As we walked in we were greeted with a friendly smile and welcome.  We tried the "must have when in Thailand " and that was Pad Thai. The food looked amazing, it was fresh and delicious. Even our drinks were very good, and the prices were very reasonable. I  can honestly say this restaurant was amazing and strongly recommended it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brendan Berry

sample_reviews_en.text: Metro Square SiamParagon, located on the ground floor of the Siam Paragon shopping mall in Bangkok, offers a diverse culinary experience that has garnered positive feedback from patrons. The establishment functions as a food court, bringing together prominent chefs to create a variety of dishes across Thai, Chinese, and fusion cuisines, all prepared with premium-quality ingredients. The pad Thai and Tom yum soup is soooo good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gisele Hwang

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was truly outstanding. Fresh ingredients, balanced seasoning, and expert cooking… every bite made me say “this is it!” You can really feel the chef’s touch in every dish.

The staff were incredibly attentive, friendly, and professional. Not too much, not too little — just the right amount of care. The atmosphere is both elegant and cozy, making it a place where you can relax and fully enjoy your meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Erhan Cakirgoz

sample_reviews_en.text: Wanna try Thai food ? Here ‘s the place to come. They have varieties of Thai food for your selection.  Taste are good, spicy as it should be.  Noodle, rice , esarn food and other Thai dish they have. Ingredients are fresh. Price is a little bit high compare to street food but quality is better. Credit card are ok. English menu are available and staffs can communicate English well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supakij Khomvilai

restaurants.name: Haveli Indian Restaurant Pattaya Beach Road - Best Indian Food Restaurant in Pattaya
restaurants.address:

ยามาโต้ 219/1 Soi Pattaya 13/1, ตำบล หนองปรือ Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
as in comparison to other restaurants? Haveli Indian Restaurant is doing wonderful. They have fresh food, fresh ingredients, good accompaniments and a wide variety of menu to choose items from with a decent price tag on it as per the place and location they are serving.

The outlet is just on the road at the left hand side while you'll be going to Walking Street via South Pattaya Road. Staff welcomes warmly and gives the menu.

We ordered chicken biryani, dal makhni and butter naan. Chicken biryani we requested for tikka one and tikka was good but the rice was normal fried not that like original biryani but dal makhni was flavourful and good.

They have onions, chutney and salad + achar... Water is also available if you don't want to buy bottled water they have jugs for you.

Overall a good experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nikhil Dhawan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Avoid going to this place if you’re looking for a peaceful or quiet dining experience. There was a toddler—possibly belonging to the owner or manager—running around the restaurant as if it were a playground, shouting loudly and playing chase with the staff.

I even informed the waiter that I had a bad headache, but nothing changed, which was quite disappointing.

The staff also seemed distracted most of the time—busy making reels and eating (perhaps mouth freshener), rather than focusing on guests.

Overall, the experience was very poor and far from relaxing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Himanshu Shankhdhar

sample_reviews_en.text: We were just walking on the street and we found this place and we found it pretty  amazing. The have ample options in both veg as well as non veg food. We had paneer butter masala and tava roti and it was so good and price worthy. We also have fried rice which was totally Indian and spicy as per our taste. The highlight was buttermilk, it was so yummy and so good in taste which reminded me of home. Overall a must visit place for Indian food. They have ample seating place and the staff is courteous as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pinaz Pirani

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I found another Indian restaurant, but this one served both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food. I ordered Palak Paneer, plain roti, mix veg raita, Aloo Paratha, and tea at the end. It was a nice place to have lunch.

Food was delicious.
Service was fast — I got my order within 5–8 minutes.
Good seating arrangements.
Nice staff.
Beach-side location.
Bar and alcohol options available.

If you like more travel content plz follow me on IG Hrtourer and YouTube
Thanks 🥰❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: GoobalYatri

sample_reviews_en.text: Ms. Bhelle is the true definition of Kindness, their kind of service was amazing. Rooms are spacious and comfortable. Their authentic Indian foods are delicious and that’s what encouraged us to stay. I highly recommended this place and restaurant. Thank you also for the whole staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Richmonn Orellana

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the chili chicken and the chicken wasn't breaded. I'm not use to that. Spices were less. I've had better...

Mushroom malasa didn't look at all like the picture. Taste was a little off as well.

Won't be coming back. The staff was super friendly and food came out fast.
sample_reviews_en.author: PKS Xingo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Haveli restaurant is located at Pattaya beach.i found skilled cheff, specially tea maker that attracted me to come again and again.service staff are polite and I hope they will maintain it same in future.
I have best wishes for all staff
Dr.mehmood Joseph from Pakistan
sample_reviews_en.author: Mehmood Joseph

sample_reviews_en.text: They serve me food that was already cooked before and most likely reheated it. This resulted me food poisoning. They con you by talking sweet and bring you in knowing tourist will never come back again. Small chicken pieces when ordered tandoori. Not worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Riz

restaurants.name: Chim Chum Suthiporn
restaurants.address:

QH66+Q3P รัชดา Soi 3, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ate there as a couple and had just the right amount of food.
The food wasn't expensive; splitting the bill, it came out to 270 baht per person.

The hot pot set was 100 baht and you could choose two types of meat (enoki mushrooms weren't included in the vegetable set). We chose a small plate of pork belly and a small plate of beef. The rest was seafood.
The soup was well-seasoned and delicious, with an authentic Northeastern Thai flavor, fragrant with basil and slightly sweet.

The papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce had the perfect balance of salty and sour. The portion wasn't very big.

The marinated grilled pork neck was tender and slightly sweet, served with a tangy and salty dipping sauce.

The duck larb had a delicious, authentic local flavor.

My partner said the grilled intestines were a little chewy today.

The restaurant has a large parking lot, 20 baht per hour.
The atmosphere wasn't hot the day we went. It would probably be hot in the summer because there aren't any fans.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwanjaii Tareerujakom

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food with very kind of staff! They made us feel very welcomed. Our server selected all the yummy dishes for us and continued to check on us and our hot pot throughout our meal. We would have been absolutely lost without his help!

All the flavours were superb! An absolutely authentic Thai experience. If you do not like or tolerate spicy, be cautious with the hot spicy sauces they give you as side dishes. They were delicious but OMG they were hot!  Nothing a few beers doesn't fix though.

We spent 535 THB for a hot pot with chicken, lamb, beef, veggie, and noodle sides, as well as a chicken dish, white rice, side of stir fried noodles, 2 beers, and water bottle. A great price for a delicious and very filling meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natalie Juarez

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here after seeing an online recommendation. There are three branches along this short route, so there's plenty of seating and no waiting.

I ordered a clay pot hot pot and added different kinds of meat. The broth was sweet, and it tasted even better with the vegetables and meat. The flame wasn't strong, so it took a while for it to boil. The food was tasty and inexpensive.

However, there were always ants in the food. The complimentary vegetables initially had many ants on them, which the staff replaced. But towards the end, I found many ants in the broth, even though it was cooked. I don't know which dish had the ants, but I couldn't find them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sara Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were recommended this place by a very friendly TukTuk driver, and he was absolutely right,this is truly a local spot! Most of the customers were Thai people and students, which shows how affordable and authentic the food is 👍🏻

The uncle working there was super adorable and even spoke a few Chinese words like “vegetables,” “water,” and “add soup.” So cute and friendly! 😁

The food was delicious, the prices were fair, and the atmosphere was simple but cozy.
We’ll definitely come back the next time we’re in Bangkok, and we’ll recommend this place to our friends too.
Highly recommended! 👍🏻
Wishing the shop great business and continue success! ✨👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Shu Pei

sample_reviews_en.text:
I didn't try Jim Jum which is their signature dish. I go there first time for other Isan food. Croweded. No aircon. Plenty but expensive parking (around 30 Baht/hour). The sauce is sweet which Isan food should not sweet. Grilled beef with fat  also too sweet. Raw beef (Soi Ju) not nice. Cannot taste the sweetness of the raw beef. Slow service and have to follow up a few time. Wrong order and some dishes do not come. I like stir fry rice noodle. Too far and difficult to go without a car, around 1km from the main Ratchada road.
For me, it's not worth to travel that far. And Ratchada road at night also difficult to find taxi which turn on meter.
sample_reviews_en.author: Little Bunny

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been here several times. My partner was very impressed last time, but this time...
- The grilled pork neck... don't even call it pork neck, it's pure pork fat. I could barely eat any of it (this was terrible).
- The papaya salad with 3 chilies... I ordered it last time and it was delicious (I usually order with 2 chilies). This time it was bland. The taste was different, probably made by a different person.
- My favorite, and still love, is the fried pork intestines. I order it every time.

Good service, food came quickly.

P.S. I'll give it another chance. If it's still not good, then I'll stop. 5555
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimphitcha Ch

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re looking for a true local Thai hot pot spot, I highly recommend Jim Jum Sutthiporn. This place is busy almost every day, and after trying it, I totally understand why.

Their jim jum is delicious, with a rich and flavorful soup, fresh ingredients, and generous portions. They also have a wide variety of dishes to choose from, including Isaan food and local Thai favorites.

The best part is the price — very affordable and great value for money. Good food, local atmosphere, and friendly prices. Definitely worth a visit!

Must order - jimjum and grilled fish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Savor and savage

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has parking available right next to it. The parking fee is 20 baht per hour.

I went on a Sunday evening and there were plenty of empty seats, so I didn't have to wait in line. The seating is on two sides: one side next to the parking lot and the other side with tent-like seating under a roof.

The menu has a fairly large selection of dishes. All the food arrived very quickly after ordering.

The portion sizes aren't very large. The papaya salad was very tasty, but the fried and grilled items were just okay; some were a bit chewy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charlie Vongphantuseth

restaurants.name: ร้านอาหารครัวใบบัว
restaurants.address:

13, 37 Industrial Ring Rd, Tambon Bang Phueng, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Your handling of the menu is zero. I understand your recipes, but you explicitly stated the menu item as containing a specific type of meat without adding any further description that you included shrimp.

There are many cooking methods and recipes, depending on the restaurant. I understand that. But your assertion that it's our responsibility to specify a shrimp allergy because "crab curry" (or "crab dip") is seafood, implying that it must include shrimp, and that all restaurants around here do it that way, is completely unacceptable. Please understand the meaning of the menu item, its description, and the diner's perspective before making your own claims and apologizing. The negative impression is already caused.

At other restaurants, if a menu item includes shrimp or describes it as containing shrimp, we always make a note of it. Your "crab curry" implies that it only contains crab.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nisa

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted acceptable, but slightly below expectations.

The service was quite disappointing. Despite the restaurant not being busy and having many empty tables, after about two hours of dining, the staff started checking on our table frequently, making the atmosphere less comfortable.

If the restaurant has time limits for dining or a minimum order amount, it would be helpful to clearly state this on a sign. This would allow customers to manage their time more effectively.
sample_reviews_en.author: sirasith pongpreukngam

sample_reviews_en.text: On July 2nd, 2026, I took my car to DNA shop for a wrap job. While waiting, I ordered lunch. It exceeded my expectations. The food was flavorful, not too spicy, making it easy to eat a lot. My favorite was the creamy Tom Yum soup; the taste was excellent. The ingredients were good, and the seafood was reasonably fresh. The atmosphere was peaceful and comfortable; there was no noise or crowds. The bakery next door had a lot of pastries, but I was too full from lunch to try any.
sample_reviews_en.author: จําปาหอม หอมจําปา

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and the prices are great. Parking is convenient, the restaurant is air-conditioned, and the staff provides good service.

The crispy shrimp and fruit salad served with melon was incredibly delicious, living up to the restaurant's reputation for melon.

Another unexpected highlight was the pizza. While not perfectly crispy, it was still very good overall. Cheese lovers would definitely enjoy it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Papon Birdy

sample_reviews_en.text: Updated in 2026. The food is average in taste, but the prices are good. The seafood is fresh and large. I recommend the seafood curry in banana leaves, stir-fried stink beans, and crab spring rolls (though there isn't a lot of crab, as expected for the price). It's one of my family's regular restaurants. They accept Thai Help Thai Plus vouchers (separate scans available). Parking is a bit limited.
sample_reviews_en.author: Keaw Koong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food, reasonable prices, excellent service.
Forgot to take pictures of the food. What I ate:
1. Prawns with tamarind sauce
2. Crab fried rice
3. Crab curry
4. Northern Thai larb
5. Stir-fried kale with shrimp balls
6. Stir-fried noodles with water spinach
7. Pizza
9/10 for everything!
Too bad I didn't take pictures.
sample_reviews_en.author: Radatorn Suebwong

sample_reviews_en.text: I have a few criticisms, but only regarding the taste of the food. Everything else was fine. I ordered three dishes: 1. Crispy oyster omelet, but the flavor was bland. 2. What seemed to be a spicy seafood stir-fry, only spicy, the coconut shoots were hard. 3. Pork with lotus leaves, the pork pieces were large but very tough.
sample_reviews_en.author: sittisak charoenpak

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything we ordered was delicious, except for the crispy fried chicken which was very hard and dry. The prices were very reasonable. The staff provided excellent service. The fish dishes were very fresh. Parking was convenient and it was easy to get to. They also have fresh coffee. Overall, a great experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pareeyawee Rungrattanachai

restaurants.name: As You Wish Restaurant - Best Crispy Pork!
restaurants.address:

96 Prasert-Manukit Rd, Ram Inthra, Khan Na Yao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
“As You Wish”…More like “As We Don’t Care”

Service: Terrible. The staff completely ignored us most of the time. We had to keep calling them over, and when they did show up, they were unfriendly and acted like they didn’t want to be there. Even worse, they stood around gossiping about customers loud enough for people to hear. Very unprofessional.

Rules & Charges: This place is unbelievably stingy. Want to take food home? They charge 30 baht per item, even if it’s just a tiny sauce. Who does that? On top of that, you can’t even pay with a credit card unless your bill is over 3,000 baht. Completely unreasonable.

The whole experience felt cheap, unfriendly, and frustrating. There are plenty of restaurants in town that treat customers with respect and don’t make you jump through hoops just to eat. Food was mediocre, this one is not worth your time or money.
sample_reviews_en.author: M

sample_reviews_en.text:
Atmosphere: The restaurant is beautiful and has a great atmosphere, perfect for a relaxing meal.

Service: The staff provided excellent service and were very attentive to customers. This was the most impressive part.

Food: Fresh, clean ingredients, and the flavors were good. I recommend the crab rolls, which were incredibly delicious.

Comfort: The air conditioning was cool and comfortable. The seating was well-arranged and comfortable, not stuffy.

*Today, I visited and they offered free fish crackers as an appetizer. During the karaoke session, they also gave me a large box of fish crackers as a reward.

Conclusion: This is a restaurant I will definitely return to. If you're looking for a restaurant with a nice atmosphere, comfortable seating, and attentive staff, I highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khun PoP

sample_reviews_en.text:
Most of the food was delicious, especially the fresh, crispy roast pork. However, the wait was incredibly long. The staff said 15 minutes, but it actually took an hour. I ordered spaghetti, and the first dish was rich and flavorful. The second dish had a very runny sauce.

The staff took my order and spoke four times, seemingly unable to hear me. They were using earphones to communicate in the restaurant, but they didn't pay attention to my order. I tried to order more, but they didn't seem to care. They took a long time to call me.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bee Lamais

sample_reviews_en.text:
Yes! Another 1st glass restaurant experience in Bangkok again. I have kind of followed this YouTube star owner occasionally and kept this in my list.

Today had a good opportunity and Crispy Suckling pig with other side orders well met the expectations. The environment is super nice. Additional high light was the owner making new YouTube video at next table.
