So food 5/5, service even better and environment/atmosphere very good.  This place is around 30 mins drive for Bangkok city center.

I need to visit again for tomahawk.
sample_reviews_en.author: Seppo Ihalainen

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time trying this restaurant, and I was impressed with the atmosphere and decor; it's beautiful and very upscale. The price is excellent considering the taste. Everything I ordered was delicious, even the garlic in the fish. It was worth the price. However, since it was a holiday, service was a bit slow, and the food took a while to come out. But overall, I didn't mind. All the food was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: A Glass Premium “A Glass Premium” Lumlukka

sample_reviews_en.text: We have fun with the big room enjoy the food everything are good but only the admin on line official she couldn’t recommend as good as we want also don’t get the right order food set I have to be reorder again 6,500 not 4,500 that we book up. And no more the beef A5 that we want is out of order. Ok next time. Will be back again the girl serve us in the room she is very good but we still love this place
sample_reviews_en.author: Diamond Head Plants International

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came here with the extended family which included some kids.   The staff were super friendly and didn't mind the wild monkeys I brought.   We forgot to order the suckling pig/crispy pork but everything else we ordered was wonderful.   Kids also enjoyed it.
Great atmosphere and a place I will be sure to return to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kilian Ford

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is owned by a famous Thai food YouTuber, well known for its flame grilled suckling pig  (reservation is strongly recommended). Other dishes were tasty. We went on the weekend and there was a live band too.  Service could be much faster (don't come here when you are hungry). Parking is available.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Foodie's Diary

restaurants.name: Izakaya Hanako
restaurants.address:

Soi Sukhumvit 19, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We just went for before dinner, beer and small dishes. Food was okay and good. We had some sashimi that they didn’t serve with ginger pickle and I asked to bring some, at the end of the bill, they charged it , it was not in the menu so everything else was in English but only that one in Thai… most of the Japanese restaurants give this ginger … we spent over 2,000 baht during an hour for two of us and it would be normal to serve this to customer and if they charge , the should ask first to the customer. I mentioned to the manager and she didn’t react properly. She just didn’t say anything. Very small thing ruined general photo !!
Especially now there are so many Japanese restaurants in the area !
sample_reviews_en.author: Miwha Shin

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for an authentic and super laid-back Japanese izakaya experience in the heart of Asoke, you HAVE to check out Izakaya Hanako! This place is a true hidden gem, perfect for winding down and catching up with friends.

From the moment you step in, you get those cozy, relaxed izakaya vibes. It's the kind of place where you can truly chill. And the food? They have a fantastic selection of Japanese dishes, from classic favorites to delicious small bites that are perfect for sharing (or not sharing, we won't judge 😉).

Parking at Robinson is the most convenient way, try to buy something above 300 baht , get parking stamp, then you will pay ~40 baht if you stay until midnight.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumol

sample_reviews_en.text:
Always my favourite Japanese restaurant whenever I am in Bangkok! Great fresh sashimi and equally yummy cooked food! The staff are nice and approachable. Authentic Japanese food and hospitality.

Update: Had the seasonal special this round - the tuna cheek. It is really good as the texture is more like beef than fish. Good pairing with the sweet white onion and ponzu sauce.

Update (25/1/25):
As usual, the food is amazing. The horse mackerel sashimi was really fresh and delicious, after which the bones bits were battered and deep fried to perfection - a great snack to end the meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: LynC

sample_reviews_en.text: I am about ready to take the first bite.   Wow incredible flavor.   I live in this neighborhood. I’ve eaten most of the Izakaya.   This is to amazing.  I like the unique variety on the menu many specials from Japan many types of liquor and special sake.      All of the low reviews are very old.   Prices are good. This is a go to place for quality and flavor in the neighborhood.   You can spend a lot of money here or come for a 200 Bhat meal …. The food’s great you’re gonna spend a lot of money all the pickles, vegetables all homemade.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cat Avatar

sample_reviews_en.text:
Enjoy a relaxing drink in a relaxing izakaya.
The grilled yellowtail collar is plump and fatty, cooked to perfection.
The deep-fried river shrimp is fragrant and crispy, so delicious you won't be able to stop eating it.
The kakiage soba noodles to finish the meal are flavored with plenty of yuzu, with a great aroma and a refreshing aftertaste.
It pairs perfectly with a green tea highball, and the overall satisfaction level is high.
Each dish is carefully prepared, making this a restaurant you'll want to drop by again and again.
sample_reviews_en.author: ken ishikawa

sample_reviews_en.text: Top notch Japanese restaurant located near Sukhumvit Soi 19. Everything breaths traditionally high standard quality throughout every little detail. The dishes are a masterclass of art, from the chopsticks to the plates where the tremendous food is served, the waitresses are beautiful dressed. The service here is outstanding. The food it selves was Delicious with a big capital D. The pictures we took speaks for itself. Every Japanese foodie must have visited this Nirvana of haut cuisine
sample_reviews_en.author: marc van looy

sample_reviews_en.text: Izakaya Hanako offered an average dining experience for me. The food was good, but not particularly outstanding. Unfortunately, there was a mix-up with my order, as I had requested a meat-free option, but the soup I received contained pork. On a positive note, the sushi was delicious. The service, on the other hand, was a highlight. The staff was incredibly friendly and professional throughout my visit. Overall, it was an okay dining experience, but not one of my most memorable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daria Gurschi

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a long-established Japanese-style izakaya that I've been visiting since before COVID-19. Not only the menu but most of the staff speak Japanese, so it's easy to feel at ease even if it's your first time. I came alone this time, and it was my first visit since COVID-19, to try the ozōni. The menu and prices have changed a little, but I think you can relax and enjoy a safe and secure experience. By the way, this time I had three dishes and three Singha Ls for 1,101 THB.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ichi sek

restaurants.name: Indian Kebab and Curries
restaurants.address:

No. 19, Alley, Subdistrict, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went there in the hopes of getting some nice food after a long hot day. They had one of the worst hospitality ever and did not treat us well. We ordered Aloo Paratha and they did not serve us curd and gave us just 2 small spoons of pickle and expected 2 people to eat two portions of aloo paratha. When we asked them to give us extra pickle they refused to give us. We said we would pay extra and gave another small tea bag sized pickle for 25thb. He straight off told that he won’t give us more..
Please don’t go there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brinda K

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good service, naan bread and taste in the dish are good - but fish in the curry dish very hard and boring - the other dish with chicken did not contain much chicken
We mentioned it twice but the waiter did not take the initiative to compensate - charges 3.5% extra for card payment

some restaurants don't charge extra when you use a credit card - you have a 3.5% surcharge on top of the bill - whether it's the bank or you who charge extra doesn't matter to me
sample_reviews_en.author: Ole Pedersen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food is delicious, service is friendly, music is great, you can pay by card!

We ate here 3 times in two days, you really can't go wrong with Tikka masala and garlic naan.

I will come back!

There's really not much GREAT FOOD within walking distance, lots of good places around, not many great, this place is great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yahir Garay

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent Indian food (we had two curries + rice)!! Mango lassi was also good, although lukewarm. We did NOT like the service: When we paid for our meal the waiter did not speak a single word to us, not even "Thank you" or "Goodbye". No smile either.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gerold Nb

sample_reviews_en.text: I eat here every time I’m in Bangkok. Food is always spectacular and rich in flavors! Honestly some of the best food I’ve ever had! Staff is very friendly and helpful. The atmosphere and music are enjoyable. I highly recommend eating here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jamie Chaszar

sample_reviews_en.text: Great food, friendly staff, and a clean, comfortable atmosphere. The cool temperature made the dining experience even better. Highly recommend this spot for a relaxing and satisfying meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rei Gaming PH (Rei Oli)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent restaurant! We thoroughly enjoyed our meal! And the staff is very friendly.
If you want to enjoy delicious Indian food during your trip to Thailand, this is the place to go!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mya Giton

sample_reviews_en.text:
They serve some lovely dishes here - and their behavior is something dat one would love too. The ambience is cool n you can enjoy your food n liquor
A must visit - cheers!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Debjitt Royy

restaurants.name: Kung Phao On Nut
restaurants.address:

Sukhumvit 77 Rd, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: We ordered 5 dishes: grilled prawns, crab fried rice, grilled cockles, steamed squid with lime, and fried sea bass with fish sauce. The total was 1,610฿. Everything was delicious, the dipping sauce was amazing, and most importantly, the staff provided excellent service. Kudos to them!
sample_reviews_th.author: Mayly Natrapa

sample_reviews_en.text:
We celebrated my wife's birthday and my son's completion of exams at this long-standing restaurant in On Nut. The food was consistently delicious, fresh, and clean. Thank you to the owner for the birthday ice cream! 🙏🙏🥰

It's heartbreaking to learn that the restaurant will be closing today (May 31, 2026). For over 30 years, On Nut Grilled Prawns has been more than just a restaurant for me; it's a place filled with memories, happiness, and smiles for my family.

Thank you to the owner and all the staff for always taking such warm care of their customers. Delicious food can be found elsewhere, but this kind of sincerity and connection is rare.

Even though today is the last day for the restaurant, the good memories will remain in my heart forever. I wish the owner and the entire team good health, happiness, and success in all their future endeavors.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for every meal and every wonderful memory. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachawis Kanjanarojpokin

sample_reviews_en.text: It's been a while since I ate here, and the food was terrible. It didn't look anything like the pictures, and it was awful – soggy and mushy. The picture showed big shrimp, but the shrimp was minced, like shrimp waste. Even the shrimp in instant noodles is better. It was the worst. The staff even argued that they'd changed the picture. Please change the picture on the menu next time so I won't order it. The price was also high, 190 baht for a dish like this – stir-fried noodles with shrimp waste and scraps.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eve O'yiff

sample_reviews_en.text: Been here before. Thai seafood specialists. Wide selection. Excellent attentive service. Ordered oysters which on their own were completely bland, disappointing, different from my in-shell experience, although eaten Thai style with supplied add-ons, were fine. Other dishes so-so. Inside A/C. Clean spacious even cavernous, devoid of atmosphere. Has outside seating. Child friendly. Bill 2 adults and child incl 2 Leo's b1, 615.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Graham

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered four dishes but only received two. It seems the restaurant's recipes aren't consistent.
The worst part was the sweet clams; they were all rotten and mushy, yet they still sold them to my child. They didn't even remove them from the bill. It's a waste of money and very disappointing.
The shrimp was 980 baht for 10 pieces per kilo. It's a bit expensive.
If I could return them without paying, I'd give more stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiramet Lapsiriwatkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
As the name Kung Pao suggests, the shrimp were fresh, plump, and absolutely delicious.

The crab and squid were also very tasty.

Everything we ate was delicious.

The soft-shell crab tempura was also superb!!

The service from the owner and staff was excellent. ✨
It's located in On Nut, a little outside of central Bangkok, but it's a place you should definitely visit! 🙌
sample_reviews_en.author: traveler28

sample_reviews_en.text:
Seven years ago, I reviewed it saying:
"The food was delicious. So delicious I didn't have time to take pictures :) I only managed to photograph the desserts."

Now I'd like to add:
"The service has deteriorated significantly compared to how I used to eat here. The standards have dropped. Quite disappointing."
sample_reviews_en.author: Wallobh Tum

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious. The service was excellent and very attentive. The food was fresh; the grilled prawns were amazing, the steamed squid with lime was perfectly cooked, and most importantly, the seafood dipping sauce was incredibly flavorful and spicy. The food came out quickly, which was great.
sample_reviews_en.author: SAMORN SEELUEANG

restaurants.name: News Steaks & Grill
restaurants.address:

306, Plaza, 89 Chateau Dale, Pattaya City, Pattaya Chon buri, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Have eaten here many times over the last 10 years and love it but this year I booked Christmas day and new  years eve Set menu.
to be fair I knew it was a set menu but only 1 starter choice 1 steak choice and 1 desert choice no vegetarian option nothing wrong with the food but the shouldn't there be at least 1 option eg I dont eat smoked salmon but that was the only option so I got no starter. to be fair the food was still lovely and the staff were as always brilliant and they took a lot of grief from on a lot of unhappy customers on both nights I will be back but not on set menu nights
sample_reviews_en.author: Derek Yeates

sample_reviews_en.text:
First and last visit. I had high hopes for this place, and we were not only disappointed, but I ended up with food poisoning. The Australian ribeye was garbage; tough, grisly, and just didn’t taste right. The nachos had spaghetti sauce and a butt-ton of funky cheese on them. The staff seemed friendly and attentive, but it was way too expensive for the quality or lack thereof.

This was the only food I ate that day, so either food handling wasn’t correct or someone had it on for me. I hate to think so, but my wife ate pasta and didn’t get sick.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Peerson

sample_reviews_en.text: I went with a group and ordered many items. We tried chateaubriand, filet mignon, garlic shrimp appetizer and many sides. The food was expensive and mediocre. Frozen drinks from the bar weren’t very good. I lost my appetite when I looked under the table for a toy my son dropped and found a cockroach graveyard right under the table. If you eat here you best keep your eyes above the table or you will get nautious. I have them 2 stars because the service was excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: R P

sample_reviews_en.text: Good looking steakhouse, dimly lit though. Menu quite good, lots of choices to fulfill most cravings. We had one salad as a starter and chateaubriand for two. Salad was ok, quite expensive for what it was actually. Main was average, meat was rather on a hard side as for tenderloin. sauces and potatoes were good though. All in all, nothing to write home about, on average side only.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bartosz Brozek

sample_reviews_en.text: My wife and I were out for another perfect steak dinner, accompanied by a good red wine. My wife finished her meal a little early, and while I was still eating, her plates were being cleared away. This completely ruined the lovely atmosphere of the dinner. I hadn't expected such rude, food-market-style service there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Didi

sample_reviews_en.text:
News Steaks & Grill is really a steak lover's (which I am not) paradise, however, the other offerings, including the Thai selection, are very good.

The atmosphere is relaxed, the service attentive, and the overall experience is very close to fine dining.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Mc Elhinney

sample_reviews_en.text: We've been here many times and have never been disappointed. The dishes that I'd like to recommend are Black Pepper Steak, Toast Skagen and Gambas Ajillo. This restaurant is ideal for dinner with family and loved ones. The staff is attentive and nimble.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nat Pakawanit

sample_reviews_en.text: I was craving for some good handmade meat balls european style, and there you go I found it. After searching online for a while I got hold of this restaurant that serve european style meatballs in gravy sauce. The restaurant is located very …
sample_reviews_en.author: Nidhi Jha

restaurants.name: Maguro One Bangkok
restaurants.address:

1877 โครงการ One Bangkok ห้องเลขที่ 1324,OP1302 ชั้นที่ 3 Rama IV Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overpriced, bad atmosphere and horrible service. Foods were eatable but staffs were undertrained badly. Sequenced of foods served surprisingly stupid. Beef teppanyaki came first the followed by tempura and salad then sushi and end by sashimi !?! I had been to hundreds of Japanese restaurants and it was the first.

Services were so poor that make street foods looked good. When foods came, they just kept piling foods up. They just put them on any space. When table was full, they just hold it in front of your face!

Four people for almost 6,000!!! You can get shushiro for half price with better service and atmosphere. AVOID!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Joe C L

sample_reviews_en.text:
The table had a musty smell, and there were flies around, which made the dining experience unpleasant.

The service was very slow and inconsistent. Several ingredients were out of stock, but we were not informed before placing our order. We ordered the Spicy Roll and Vegetable Tempura, but the food was quite disappointing and did not meet our expectations. Overall, we were not impressed with the quality of the meal.

The staff were friendly, smiled, and spoke politely. However, the service was extremely slow, and it took a long time for them to answer our questions or assist us.
sample_reviews_en.author: gift chaeng

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent Japanese restaurant! 🇯🇵 Everything was truly delicious, fresh, beautifully presented, and bursting with flavor. The sashimi was superb, the dishes were meticulously prepared, and the drinks were also very good. A wonderful discovery in One Bangkok. We thoroughly enjoyed our meal from beginning to end. 😋

I highly recommend it! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
sample_reviews_en.author: li ren

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service staff was excellent. Manager Jane handled the problem very well. She followed up on a missing order immediately.
I will definitely use their service again. ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Surachai Phusodsi

sample_reviews_en.text: Food quality is good but service is quite disappointed. 1. Slow especially cashier 2. Table too small not comfortable at all if you come more than 5 paxs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanyanakorn Saorumnee

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent today at the One Bangkok branch. The staff were lovely and provided great service. The food was delicious, as always.
sample_reviews_en.author: Salanya Lockett

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were friendly, lovely, and always provided good advice and care for customers. The food was delicious, as expected from Maguro ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Tat Bonn

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff seemed sluggish and unwilling to provide service. They didn't take the order completely. This branch is a complete failure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Annann

restaurants.name: J's Restaurant Thatien
restaurants.address:

294 Maharat Rd, Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
My dad and I stopped in after visiting Wat Pho. We were lucky as there were seats inside. Some reviews mention a second floor but I couldn't see the stairs or entrance for that. Anyway, the restaurant itself is small but if you want to just order takeaway drinks, you can!

We both ordered Chicken Pad Thai. It was so delicious 😋🤤! The best I've had. I also ordered a Ice Thai Tea and he a Passion fruit smoothie. Bothe drinks were amazing but don't order the Thai Tea if you don't like a sweet taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Monica Botha

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a fantastic experience at J’s Restaurant! The food was absolutely delicious—every dish was bursting with flavor and clearly made with care. From appetizers to dessert, everything exceeded my expectations.
What really stood out was the service. The staff were very accommodating, friendly, and attentive without being overbearing specially to yong .They made sure we felt welcome and comfortable throughout the entire meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lennin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thai Tea - Fragrant tea with creamy, smooth milk, perfectly balanced sweetness.
Stir-fried Morning Glory - Tastes like eating with family. The sauce is rich and fragrant with fermented soybean paste.
Tom Kha Gai (Chicken Coconut Soup) - The highlight of the meal. It has an authentic Thai sourness, but with a creamy, smooth texture. The chicken isn't dry, and the dish is visually appealing.
sample_reviews_en.author: เขมชาติ คุณธรรมวรกุล

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for a restaurant in Bangkok with a great atmosphere, excellent service, and delicious food, here are some top recommendations: "J's Restaurant Thatien"

If you're looking for a restaurant in Bangkok with a great atmosphere, excellent service, delicious food, and convenient location, here are some recommended restaurants: "J's Restaurant Thatien"
sample_reviews_en.author: i-gi auntZ

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! The Tom Kha Gai (chicken coconut soup) was perfectly sour and refreshing. The fried chicken wings were crispy and a little salty. The garlic chicken was also amazing, the chicken was so tender. The Thai tea was delicious and rich. And the view was great too!
sample_reviews_en.author: Baitoeyyy

sample_reviews_en.text: I brought my tourists to have some fresh drinks, I like everything lemonade and fruit juice...so yummy. Not much seats downstairs, but it is with air cond. Located at the opposite site of Wat Pho, riverside. Recommend  for refreshing place👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Notes de Na

sample_reviews_en.text: We went despite the very positive reviews. The result was quite different from what we expected, far from good Thai cuisine as we know it. There's no point in going anywhere else. Instead, go to the market 20 meters to the left.
sample_reviews_en.author: B. C.

sample_reviews_en.text:
March 2025
Two of us ate for 480 baht. The food was decent, and the coffee was very good. The service was quick and friendly. They have a dining room upstairs and, most importantly, air conditioning!
sample_reviews_en.author: Xsk SS

restaurants.name: LELE by le mai anh
restaurants.address:

571 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
kindly staff, very nice taste and price
I tried boat noodle, included fried onions and coriander are good flavors as ASIAN food.

LELE by le mai anh also offers a range of accessories, including bags, shoes, and jewelry, that are designed to complement the brand's clothing collections. The accessories are made using high-quality materials and expert craftsmanship, ensuring that each piece is both stylish and durable.

In addition to its fashion offerings, LELE by le mai anh also hosts a range of events, from fashion shows to pop-up shops and exhibitions. These events provide a platform for emerging designers and creatives to showcase their work and connect with the fashion community.
sample_reviews_en.author: N I

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was okay. We went during a less busy time. We ordered spring rolls, but the staff left them frying until they were burnt. We waited a very long time. When we followed up on our order, they claimed they forgot, even though we were the only customers left in the restaurant. ☺️ We were about to go to work, and the restaurant offered to make a new batch in 3 minutes, so we cancelled the order. It was disappointing, a waste of time, and we didn't even get to eat the spring rolls. The staff at the counter handled the situation well and apologized. However, next time, if staff are going to be so inattentive in the kitchen, it would be better to change their job position.
sample_reviews_en.author: Idaho

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is perfect for a healthy meal for busy people. It serves grandmother's traditional Vietnamese recipes in a format ideal for city dwellers, as many dishes are ready-to-eat, like pre-wrapped Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork skewers). They also offer plant-based options. There's seating available, and a refrigerator where you can browse and buy other items like in a convenience store. As is typical of Vietnamese food, vegetables are emphasized, and these are pesticide-free because they use organic produce. The dipping sauces are low in sugar, and the drinks are also low in sugar. It's perfect for health-conscious individuals.
sample_reviews_en.author: เอไปเจอนี่มา

sample_reviews_en.text:
Finally, a fine Vietnamese café to enjoy pho on Sukhumvit.
“LeLe by Le Mai On” is a newly opened Vietnamese restaurant in the Phrom Phong area in the RSU building off Sukhumvit on Soi 31.
I had the pounded prawn on sugarcane, grandma’s ready-to-eat rolls with marinated charcoal-grill pork meatballs and of course the beef pho.
They all came with fresh herbs, mint and basil.
I’ve been here twice in a week and will keep this on my favorites list.
This is an update, December 2022!
They unfortunately don't serve Banh Mi.
sample_reviews_en.author: Claw Dagon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great little vietnamese place in the bustling Bangkok centre. Located on the ground floor of what looks like an office building, I suspect its usual patrons are office workers. I went during the weekend and it was quiet but accommodating.

Ordered the banh cuon and meet free fried rice with pandan tea. The banh cuon had a really good fill to wrapper ratio. Taste wise it was quite good.

The fried rice was a touch on the spicy side for me but that's more me than the dish.

Worth the visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hieu Huynh

sample_reviews_en.text: “Best Overall” - The best Vietnamese i had. I decided to write my first review after visiting and ordering a few deliveries and, I have to say i enjoyed every bite of the meals from LELE. My favorite menu are Pho’, Steamed soft rice wrap, all on Skewers (They just added Plant-base marinated balls). Considering the food quality, the price is reasonable. It is ideal for those who want to grab a quick yet tasty and healthy meal. Love the place and will continue to visit. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: tata boonnamsiri

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice and clean Vietnamese restaurant where locates around 10 minutes walk from my hotel in upper Khaosan area. Well cold air conditions. Kind and charming staffs. Every  dishes, authentic and absolutely tasty. I love a fresh spring roll with shrimps just 95 baht! Please be careful spicy salad. It was too spicy for me. Perhaps I should have ordered an normal salad on the menu next page. And also, icey cold lemon tea was so tasty and refreshing. Lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mi K

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Vietnamese restaurant on the first floor of the RSU building.

It's not a typical restaurant (it's hard to explain, but it's an open space along the building's corridor).

The seating capacity is small.

A bowl of pho starts at 155 baht. While it's not fair to compare, it's definitely expensive compared to prices in Vietnam...

The taste is good.

They only accept cashless payments, so be careful about payment methods.
sample_reviews_en.author: TAKAN

restaurants.name: Such A Small World
restaurants.address:

951 ชั้น 3 ถ. เจริญกรุง Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a fantastic multi-use space/ cafe with a variety of free spaces to sit, 'pod' areas to rent and chill out, each with a different vibe/ decor and screens for movies, gaming, and tables where you could play boardgames. Some were open with sofas, other offered a touch of privacy by being closed off with (still semi-teansparent) curtains. There is a vinyl record library that appears extensive to say the least - likely a must-visit place if you are a record lover! They serve coffee, as well as other drinks (alcoholic and non-alcoholic) and cake etc. when I was there a live DJ was playing and there were families with kids quietly watching movies, and people just relaxing. Great vibe, although you won't be able to relax if hearing other people's music bothers you (you may need noise canceling headphones!). Situated on the 3rd floor of the building, it is just a few minutes from the riverside and 5 minutes from the Sheraton Hotel nearby. Ice and hot coffee cost about 150-170 THB. Staff were very friendly and service was fast and efficient too. An awesome experience that I really enjoyed, and hope to visit again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Oliver Bayley

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to the cafe today. The atmosphere was nice, the cafe is big and has many photo opportunities. However... after ordering food and drinks and sitting for a while, a staff member told us to move tables because someone was going to play games there. Before we could even get up, a new group arrived and sat down right away. I was so confused, where's the manners? The staff member who told us (or rather, asked us to move) didn't offer any suggestions or find a new table. We had to carry our glasses and plates to find a new empty table ourselves. And we didn't know where we could sit or if there was a fee to sit somewhere. In short, we didn't know if the movies, games, or music that were mentioned in the reviews were free or if there was an extra charge; there was no sign saying anything. From the moment we entered the cafe, no staff member informed us of anything. It was a very disappointing experience. The cafe is huge with lots of seating, but where exactly are the designated seating areas? Please let us know.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Golee

sample_reviews_en.text: We went in because the reviews said it was a beautifully decorated cafe. The food and drinks were quite expensive, understandable since it's in a tourist area, but the service was terrible. Communication was extremely poor. When we went in to buy food, the service was excellent. After we sat down for a while, one staff member came and informed us that a customer wanted to play games and asked our group to move to another area, as we hadn't rented any games. After we moved, a second staff member came and said that the table was reserved, and there was no sign indicating that it was reserved. We saw new customers queuing to buy food and drinks. Basically, they were trying to get our group to leave. We had already finished eating, which we understand, but they could have told us politely, perhaps asking if we could share the space with the new customers. The staff asked us to move several times using language that made us feel unwell. The cafe could have explained or managed the situation more politely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siriwan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Was really excited to check this place out as a deejay and musician myself. Unfortunately, the girl at the front counter appears to have an attitude problem and was unbelievably rude to me for no reason. She got noticeably passive aggressive and agitated after I gently tried to confirm something she had said in broken English, which I wasn’t certain I heard correctly, and started aggressively handling some some plastic board they have on the front counter and being really short with me.

On top of that, that space itself felt clinical and more like a library/store that caters to teenagers than a quality listening gallery and far more commercial than expected (they were almost exclusively playing Sabrina Carpenter and Olivia Dean, which is fine but … says a lot). Unfortunately, I will not return.

Please do better, and remember that your staff set the standard and reputation for any space.

If you don’t want to deal with people, go work in a kitchen or something. It’s not that deep lol.
sample_reviews_en.author: Deb Lombard

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wow wow wow, absolutely loved this place!!! Love the concept of picking whatever vinyls you desire and then having your own vinyl player to listen to them. There was something so relaxing and comforting to this place, we went as a group and after discussed how much we would love to have something like this at home in Ireland.

If Vinyls aren't your thing, they also have a selection of screens where you can watch movies and play games, with my two friends deciding to play Mario kart against each other while the test of us listened to the vinyls we picked.

We didn't get food, however this is also a option and a nice touch, and the whole place was very clean considering food is an option.

If you're looking for a relaxing afternoon or evening in Bangkok, pr looking for a different night out with friends or even a date option, I couldn't recommend this spot more!!!

I don't know how this concept isn't more common around the whole, I would love something like this where I live!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Adam Wright

sample_reviews_en.text: It is the cool place in this area!. you can do anything that you want in this building , drink coffee? , watch movie? , play ps or board games with friends? or explore the new jam with vinyl? this place will bring you find the vibe BUT it just opened for a month so the service from barista still confused. the lacking of order (i ordered and wait it for 45 mins and my order was kicked out to the last) , the managing of queuing or the handling of multi-tasks and especially the taste of drinks and food is not in the level that i can say delicious however if you want to joy n hangout the activities i recommended but if you want to have some drink or food (dont forget to bring snicker for help your life from waiting order like hour).
sample_reviews_en.author: kittgumbs

sample_reviews_en.text: This cafe was the best Cafe in Bangkok, It’s a new concept cafe / hang out space where you can listen to vinyls, play video or board games  or watch a movie or simply just chilled.  We had the fried chicken and Larb mimosa which were yummy.  The organic wine was great too! The team were friendly and passionate and we had a great time chilling before heading to dinner in the trendy area of Chinatown.  Don’t miss out - give this place a try! environment here was Chill 😏 the DJ play the song was 60an until now series, about the food was and drink was amazing. Must come for here Check in and try to feel what am I meaning.
sample_reviews_en.author: NWD

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're a vinyl-head, I wouldn't recommend getting your hopes up. The records weren't really properly stored. I'm not sure why the shelves are labeled alphabetically when the records on said shelves aren't organized at all. The records were also full of dust. They seemed like they weren't cleaned in ages. The player is also super basic and old. Sound quality wasn't ideal at all. But food and drinks were great. Staffs were polite. If you're looking for a light, low-expectation afternoon, I'd say it's worth it, but if you're looking to come and appreciate vinyl music, I'd suggest rethinking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Almond Boy

restaurants.name: Babyccino Mahanakhon
restaurants.address:

Mahanakhon Cube, 96 Naradhiwas Rajanagarindra Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s the worst experience i had between all the places i visited in Bangkok, the service is the worse and the food just ok, i ordered hot coffee and the brought me iced and i didn’t say anything, i ordered 2 ice cream for my kids and it took the 30 minutes to bring it and the said we have many orders, 2 group of people came after me and the ordered ice cream and the gave to them within 5 minutes, i asked to speak to the manager more than 5 times but she never came even though i saw her but she did come, i recommend to not come to this place at all since it was the worse.
sample_reviews_en.author: ahmed alshaer

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall, a lovely visit, but unfortunately with a bit of disappointment. We really wanted to go to Babyccino to have their delicious pancake again. Sadly, it wasn't offered to us this time, as the staff responsible for it apparently wasn't there.

That was a real shame, because we'd been looking forward to having that exact pancake again on our next trip to Bangkok for the past two years. 😔

The other dishes we tried, however, were delicious, and the service was generally fine. Maybe we'll have better luck with the pancake next time – we'd be delighted! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Marco Bonin

sample_reviews_en.text:
This spacious, charming, and modern restaurant is located in the skywalk building. You can enjoy the skywalk experience before dining. I found a wide variety of food and drinks available. In my opinion, the food and drinks were quite delicious. The service was also quick, attentive, and polite. The prices are a bit high, but acceptable. The atmosphere is pleasant and not too noisy. The street view isn't boring either.

It was a great experience, and I will definitely return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hang Dinh

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a number of dishes: rice with salmon. I asked for non-spicy - we got spicy! We ordered a Margherita pizza - we got a pizza with salmon. And at the height of her impudence, she charged us for the pizza and started arguing with us. She put us in such an embarrassing situation that I have never encountered before. Embarrassing. I have never rated a restaurant at such a low level. I do not recommend going anywhere near it!
sample_reviews_en.author: זיו שושן

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don't come here! We arrived at 9:00 PM, and they kept urging us to order quickly. When we asked them to come, they were incredibly slow. Most importantly, they didn't have what we ordered, and the food was completely bland. Why even bother charging customers?

They were quick to pay, though, after serving the food, and it wasn't cheap!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yu Li

sample_reviews_en.text: A deserted place. We ordered two dishes. The waitress made a mistake with both of them. We asked for one thing. She brought something else. We tried to eat a bite of the second thing. They made a mistake and finally charged us for it. Not recommended at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Raz Shushan

sample_reviews_en.text: The truffle and mushroom pizza was exquisite!! And the price-quality ratio is very good. The only thing is that the size seems a little small to me. Even so, I would be satisfied. Very friendly service. Pleasant music.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adriana Montiel

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very disappointed in the service, they ignored us 3 times by starting to take the order, and then ask us to wait again.
They use one menu for many different restaurants, which looks great. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Dennis van Heezik

restaurants.name: Nai Huad Fish Ball
restaurants.address:

594, 8 Soi Phaya Nak, Thanon Phetchaburi, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Mr. Huat's fish balls, 12 baht each..." How much could that cost?

I ordered delivery before the shop closed at 3 pm to eat while watching the World Cup final. In short, #delicious!

I don't know how I missed this place for so long. Maybe it's because I'm a regular customer of Lao Ngow, Lao Sa, Je Hiang, and a couple of other famous places.

This time, an older friend recommended it, so I finally got to try it. The thin noodles are perfectly chewy and bouncy, seasoned lightly with flavorful preserved mustard greens.

The star is the fish ball. Jumbo-sized, bouncy, maybe not as bouncy as some of the Lao Ngow brands because it's a bit softer and smoother, and not too salty.
#Fish cake and #fried fish balls have the same texture; every bite is crunchy and delicious.

At this price, I'm happy to pay.

I'll definitely order again soon. I'm thinking of making a fish ball salad myself.
sample_reviews_en.author: topinito S

sample_reviews_en.text:
This humble eatery serves one of the finest local-style fish ball noodles I’ve had the pleasure of enjoying. The fish balls, made from real fish, are distinctly original—firm, flavorful, though I did find them to be just a touch on the salty side.

A standout accompaniment is the crispy fish skin—light, golden, and a delightful contrast to the noodles. I highly recommend pairing the dry noodles with a bowl of comforting seaweed soup, which balances the flavors beautifully. On this visit, I ordered a special dry noodle dish, a regular portion served in soup, and a side of fish skin. The total came to a very reasonable 240 THB. An authentic and satisfying experience, rooted in tradition. Must try!
sample_reviews_en.author: BKK snap & bite

sample_reviews_en.text:
This cozy little restaurant in a quiet Ratchathewi neighborhood is extremely popular and usually full as soon as it opens. They serve one of the best flat rice noodle soups around. The noodles are super smooth, very slippery, and have a nice crunchy bite. The clear soup is simple yet well balanced, making it light and comforting. Each bowl comes with fish balls, fried fish balls, and fish cake, giving it a nice mix of textures and flavors.

The place is very clean and hygienic, with the dining area thoughtfully separated from the kitchen. Prices are very reasonable, making it a favorite spot among locals for a quick, satisfying, and affordable meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hau Keong Yoong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop advertises opening time as 9:30 AM.
However, on-site customers arriving at 9:30 AM had to wait approximately 10-15 minutes.
This was because the shop was preparing 40-50 bags of food for both online and pre-ordered customers.
It felt like being cheated.
But I understand that the shop was trying its best to prepare the food as quickly as possible.

The noodles were very good.
The taste of the meatballs was also very good.
Delicious and worth the price.

From a finger…typing on the keyboard.

Have eaten this every time I come back to Bangkok. The menu on the wall is Thai but it does not deter my order. Use Google Translate and point to the menu on the wall or follow with the photos in the reviews here!
Spicy fishball noodle dry 70
Fried fish skin 35
Luo Han Guo (monk fruit) bottled drink 30
Fresh handmade fishballs with lots of good oyster sauce and it makes a good hearty breakfast!
Oh the granny speaks Teochew if it helps abit..
sample_reviews_en.author: Chang Rong Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This shop is known for its fish balls, which have a unique texture: soft, bouncy, and not fishy.
The pork dumplings are firm but not too firm.
The flavors are not overpowering.
The soup is bland.
This shop is always crowded. If you don't want to wait long, come early, or you might have to wait a while.
There are quite a few orders.
The shop is in two adjacent rooms, with no air conditioning.
This shop only accepts cash.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kinjonboum

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a popular and famous restaurant in the area. If you go, be prepared to wait a bit for your food as they have a lot of orders. The fish balls are huge, bouncy, and full of fish – absolutely delicious! The broth is excellent and flavorful, and the chili paste is fantastic. When we went, they said the food would take half an hour to prepare, and we did, but it actually only took about 10 minutes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pand

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best fish ball noodle i have! The fish balls, the noodles are amazing. Portion is good too. Highly recommend. Not much seating area. The seating area and cooking place is 2 separate place. The menu has no english translation for tourist but manage to order correctly still. Hope to come back soon.
sample_reviews_en.author: ng6.6

restaurants.name: Baan Ying Plant-Based - Thai Vegan All Day Dining & Wine Bar
restaurants.address:

Dusit Suites Hotel Ratchadamri Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely loved this place 🌱✨
One of the best plant-based cafés we’ve visited in Bangkok. The ambience is calm, aesthetic, and super fresh with a beautiful tropical vibe. The food was flavorful, fresh, and didn’t feel heavy or overly processed like many vegan places do.

The mock meat dishes were surprisingly good, the ingredients tasted clean, and everything was beautifully presented. A special mention to Noy, who was incredibly hospitable, warm, and kind throughout our visit — she truly made the experience even more memorable with her lovely service and welcoming nature 💚

Perfect place for a healthy yet satisfying meal in Bangkok. Would definitely love to come back again ✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Neha

sample_reviews_en.text: A really great place to enjoy vegan food in Bangkok. It was the first time I ate plant-based meat substitutes in Thailand. The dishes were all delicious there was nothing to complain about, the service was very very attentive and very friendly. The lemon ice tea was special - very fruity and delicious. I would give 4.5 stars - half a star deduction because I just lacked the last bit of food - the special something in the spice. I would still come back! Great restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Manuel Bischoff

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is amazing and the staff is very welcoming! It is authentic thai and 100% vegan. As a vegetarian foodie it's hard to find great authentic vegetarian food without the risk of there being some fish sauce, shrimp paste, oyster sauce or similar when I'm at a food market/court. So just being able to order whatever without having to worry was a fantastic expierience. And I can't stress enough how incredible food the food was!!!! 10/10 will come back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Robin Wyler

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just treated myself to an amazing Thai vegetarian spread and every single dish hit the spot.
Green Curry: Rich, comforting, and perfectly spiced.
Spicy Papaya Salad with vegan  minced protein stirred fried with holy basil : the Salad Crisp, tangy, and packin' heat, pairs well with  the protein. Incredibly savory, textured, and fragrant.
Sticky Rice: Super cute presentation wrapped in a banana leaf!
Ended the meal on a sweet note with a refreshing
sample_reviews_en.author: Yeh Judy

sample_reviews_en.text: Today we had dinner at this very nice vegan restaurant. There is a large menu so it was actually quite diffucult to choose. We tried several dishes and they were all really delicious and tasty. My Thai husband confirmed that this is very high quality Thai food. The staff is also incredibly friendly and the ambiance is very relaxed. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lenore Sturm

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was our first visit to a Thai restaurant, and we really liked the ambience of the place. We ordered Pad Thai (the only Thai dish we were familiar with at the time) along with a flat rice noodle dish, plus a Coke and a tea.

Overall, it was a pleasant experience. The menu has a long list of Thai dishes, you’d love to come back and try more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bala Kowsalya

sample_reviews_en.text: Cute garden tucked away from the bustle of the big road, twinkly lights in the trees. Two friendly resident kitties grace the front door. Food was great - they have a large menu with a mix of traditional Thai dishes and other fare. It was hard to choose.  The owner/manager is very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: genevieve shapiro

sample_reviews_en.text: Best Vegan Thai food in Thailand! You must try all the fresh food at Baan Ying! They have a huge menu of plant based cuisine. The food is fresh and full of flavor. Portion sizes are very good. Prices fit the quality. Good energy. Nice clean inside. Good vibes only here
sample_reviews_en.author: Peace “Earthling” Art

restaurants.name: อีชา อาหารเกาหลี สาขาภาษีเจริญ (E-CHA Korean Bar & Restaurant)
restaurants.address:

618, 7 Phet Kasem Rd, Bang Wa, Phasi Charoen, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I usually live in this area but never ate here before. Today, a friend drove me in unintentionally and said they wanted to try this place, so I did. Turns out, it was SO delicious! The taste is perfect for Thai palates. The price is reasonable considering the portion size, quality of ingredients, and location near the MRT with parking. It's very affordable and worth every penny. A small fried chicken dish starts at only 79฿. Everything was delicious, even the pickled radish was tasty (I usually don't eat it, but I enjoyed it here). The portions are generous, so you finish everything in no time. Definitely worth trying! Amazing!!
sample_reviews_th.author: Yuri Kitti

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a delightful dining experience at this restaurant with my friends. The staff was incredibly friendly and attentive, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere throughout our meal. We indulged in Fried Chicken, Pork Galbi, and Korean Instant Noodles, and each dish was simply great, satisfying our taste buds. The restaurant's cleanliness and ample parking space, along with its convenient location near the BTS station, added to the overall ease and comfort. The pricing was very reasonable, offering excellent value for such delicious food. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a great meal in a wonderful setting. Making it a must-visit spot!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakorn Supakiat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is average in taste, nothing outstanding. The good thing is the price is cheap and the portion size is reasonable (though maybe a little small).

*The pork belly wasn't tough or dry, the taste was decent for the price, but the pieces were a bit small.
*The kimchi didn't seem very fresh, it smelled rancid.
*The udon was okay, ordered as a soup to cut through the richness.
*Vegetables are unlimited.

- Taste 3/5
- Speed ​​of service 4/5
- Freshness 3/5
- Portion size 4/5

Parking is available. If you park at SEACON, you can walk through the MRT station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bruh

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️The restaurant atmosphere is lovely 👍🏻
⭐️The food is delicious
- Korean tender pork set (the pork is incredibly tender, so satisfying!)🤤 The side dishes are also tasty.
- Kim Mari Tteokbokki is delicious.
- E-Cha fried chicken set with spicy gochujang sauce. Very spicy but very delicious (those who like spicy food will love it 👍🏻). The chicken is very tender.
- Korean marinated salmon. The sauce is well-absorbed into the salmon. The seafood dipping sauce is also delicious.
⭐️The staff are friendly and provide good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: BBaitoey

sample_reviews_en.text: I walked past E-Cha without intending to stop, but ended up trying it and was really impressed! The atmosphere is comfortable and friendly, a great place to relax and eat. The food tastes delicious, is easy to eat, and the portions are just right. The side dishes are also provided, making this meal feel very worthwhile. It was a chance discovery, but it exceeded my expectations. If I have the chance, I'd love to come back again. Anyone who visits the Sene Market area and doesn't try this place is missing out!! 🫠💟
sample_reviews_en.author: Muthita

sample_reviews_en.text:
The meat tasted good, and the grilled meat was convenient. The vegetables were acceptable, not bad but not very fresh. The kimchi was tasty, but the pickled radish wasn't very good. The kimchi soup was decent, and the tteokbokki was just okay.

The call button for staff was convenient, showing good organization and service.

The atmosphere was nice, with air conditioning so it wasn't hot. Music played softly throughout, making it comfortable to sit, eat, and chat without feeling cramped.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peeraset Bu

sample_reviews_en.text: This Korean restaurant is great from the taste and price of the food to the owner (Oppa, Kawaii, Saranghaeyo so much 🥰🤣). The charcoal-grilled pork belly is a must, the best! The broth is amazing. The crispy chicken is crunchy, the cheesy tteokbokki has real cheese, so stretchy! The marinated salmon and shrimp are so flavorful. I've bookmarked it as a favorite. See you again soon!
sample_reviews_en.author: Manz

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and the prices are affordable.
The staff are lovely and provide good service.
The food might be a little slow to come out because there are a lot of customers.
The kimchi soup is flavorful, the grilled pork is tasty, and the fried chicken is good (but the pieces are small).
sample_reviews_en.author: Fah Fah

restaurants.name: The Pizza Company
restaurants.address:

ห้อง1 เลขที 49 15-18 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fool me once shame on you..... This place sucks!

I went in one day and the waiter took 15 to 20 minutes to get a beer. Now you might think the restaurant was busy..... No. There were 3 people (2 adults & 1 child) sitting to my left. That was it! Maybe he got us mixed up.... No. We look totally different. Maybe he was to busy messing about on his phone and having jokes with his colleagues..... No. He wasn't. The dude was just a useless waiter. The pizza was a thin as paper.

Fool me twice shame on me.....This place is still just as bad

Yes I returned yesterday and once again the pizza was bad. Thin pizza's. The manager confirmed that they are not fresh. I wanted a small deep pan and surprise, surprise they didn't have any left, but they did have the bigger size..... Which I didn't want. I only returned as I didn't want what else was on offer. There won't be a third time as I am going home today so I will buy food at the airport.
sample_reviews_en.author: L

sample_reviews_en.text:
this branch restaurant at nana square but it is easy to find this branch restaurant in most popular shopping mall, i like this restaurant as it is value for money, the pizza is always tasty and crispy but not salty or oily, they have items other than pizza in the menu too, eg spaghetti, also yummy, the only pity seems they no longer coffee, in the past i often ordered americano or other coffee in addition to fruit drinks such as orange juice or melon juice, however, the service still very good, not much waiting time from order to food cooked and ready to eat, the environment is cozy as the arranged tables are not close to each other, in fact ample space between each table, here is what i think, if they have the pay per song old style music box which customers can choose songs while enjoying pizza, so much better

If you like the above review, please give me a
Like ♡, thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: dr ken chao

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a disgrace, I have never seen such a pizza anywhere, I wanted to order a small pizza with cheese, the waitress said that there are only medium and large. I ordered medium, she brought a small one and indeed it was even smaller than small and whispers of cheese in the middle and immediately asked why the pizza is small and so little cheese, I ordered medium, she said that this is medium, then I asked for a Coke and then she brought me a draft Coke 🤔 I thought that Coke was included, and in the end she charged 55 baht ($1.77) for the Coke and 369 ($11.87) for the pizza, the total was 424 baht ($13.64). I was very unhappy, I was simply forced to eat what they brought because I don’t eat meat and I was very hungry. Choke on it, devils.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shakhzod Yakubov

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered the premium pizza dipper this time and the pizza itself is actually pretty decent, though it could do with more cheese around the edges. Last time I tried the regular dipper and it was almost inedible as it was over cooked. Of the dipping sauces the cheese one is the only one that's good, I don't know why they picked a Korean spicy sauce, a BBQ sauce and a sour cream sauce...those do not go good with the pizza at all. Listen Pizza Company the proper dipping sauces for a pizza like this would be marinara sauce, a garlic sauce, or a ranch sauce!
sample_reviews_en.author: George Wei

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered a half classic and half spicy seafood. Can't go too wrong with the classic, but the seafood, the squid was, well, not as fresh crisp/springy as I would like, probably just passable and the shrimp, kinda soft and mushy. Unsure if it's just this branch, but I wont wanna try again.
Halfway through the pizza, saw a b1f1 promo but with what I was served, don't think I want another pizza and it seems staff won't actively promote to tourists either.
A notable incident when the waiter dropped a glass onto the floor while clearing a table.
sample_reviews_en.author: Badtz

sample_reviews_en.text: Wonderful pizza! I am on holiday here from China where I currently live. I haven't been back home to the USA in several years, and this pizza took me back home. Wonderful, wonderful pizza. I do have a couple of complaints though, which is why it is 4 stars. They did not give me napkins with my large pizza and bread sticks, and they got one of my toppings wrong. I ordered garlic, butter chicken, but I got plain roasted chicken. It was good, but not what I ordered. Overall though, excellent pizza and I highly recommend!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Asian Adventures

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service here is problematic because the staff can barely understand English which is ridiculous in a high tourist area.

The pan pizzas reasonably tasty, however there's a noticeable reduction in topping.

The new New York style pizza is poor quality, soggy base hardly any cheese and hardly any topping.

The food comes out temperature hot which is good but it could have a lot of improvement
sample_reviews_en.author: Jake Ramos

sample_reviews_en.text: All the three dishes we tried were awesome. The pizza was simply mind blowing. We ordered a thin crust one. The highlight was the Thai tea which was so creamy and intensely flavourful. The presentation was also very nice. The weight time was not much even though the place was quite crowded. The waiter helped us with the menu. Nice experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shahla Siddiqui

restaurants.name: Cheng Sim Ee Saphan Lueang Rama 4
restaurants.address:

480/2 Rama IV Rd, Maha Phruttharam, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I recently visited Cheng Sim Ee (เช็งซิมอี๊), Saphan Lueang, and it was an absolutely delightful experience. This charming spot on Rama 4 Road specializes in traditional Thai-Chinese desserts, and their offerings truly stand out.

I tried their signature sweet soup, which was beautifully presented in a vibrant yellow bowl. The dessert had a perfect balance of sweetness and herbal flavors. With ingredients like lotus root, gingko nuts, and goji berries, it offered a wonderful combination of textures and a healthy, refreshing touch. It was both comforting and satisfying—a treat suitable for any time of the day.

While I didn’t get a chance to try their savory dishes, I noticed that they also serve a popular pepper pork soup, which many diners seemed to enjoy. I’ll definitely keep that in mind for my next visit!

The service was exceptional—the staff was welcoming, attentive, and ensured everything was served promptly, even during busy hours. The lively yet cozy atmosphere added to the overall experience, making it a perfect spot to unwind.

Cheng Sim Ee is a true gem for dessert lovers and foodies exploring Bangkok.
sample_reviews_th.author: Darren Sim

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop is truly exceptional for its desserts. Personally, I love the crispy water chestnut and coconut milk dessert the most. If you don't like it too sweet, you can tell the shop to omit the syrup. You'll get the savory, creamy taste of the coconut milk combined with a touch of sweetness from the crispy water chestnuts and coconut milk that are already soaked in syrup. Besides desserts, the shop also has many tempting savory dishes, such as noodle soup.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vimlet Kir

sample_reviews_en.text: Didn't know that i had to order outside. Went straight into the shop and started browsing the menu. The staff inside were not the friendliest as none of them approached me to guide me. Pointed out the item from the menu to the staff and she reluctantly took my order and brought it to me. Would have been a pleasant experience if not for the staff. The jackfruit was hard and not sweet. The variety at Jae Wan was so much better. Jae Wan over this anytime!
sample_reviews_en.author: NonoP

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and clean, and the atmosphere is nice. However, I ordered mixed vegetable stew twice, and it didn't match the picture. Normally, mixed vegetable stew should have many different vegetables and ingredients. The menu picture showed a variety of items, but what I received only contained vegetables and pork. Nevertheless, the taste was delicious, so I ordered another bowl. I wish they would include more ingredients like in the picture.
sample_reviews_en.author: Luna Shadow

sample_reviews_en.text: We stopped by Cheng Sim Ee, Saphan Lueang for some ice cold dessert. This shop sells a variety of colourful desserts and the fun part is that you get to mix and match or customize what you want for your dessert… sooo cool! The weather was hot and humid so having a bowl of shaved ice was perfect. We ordered a bowl of Brown Sugar Shaved Ice and it tasted so delicious and really refreshing. Yummy!
sample_reviews_en.author: Alice Woo

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, I eat here often. The night shift staff are also lovely. But I wish there was a standardized pricing system. I order the same thing every time, but the price is never the same. Sometimes I accept it, but sometimes it feels unfair. It's not a big deal, just the pricing issue. It's the same menu, the same price every time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alisa Kokerd

sample_reviews_en.text: The Saphan Lueang branch has indoor seating with air conditioning. They also sell food like Khao La, Kuay Jab, and crispy pork. Today I had the dessert, and it tasted the same as always, with customizable sweetness levels – maintaining the high standard across all branches. However, parking might be difficult at this branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: K K.

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here many times, and I've tried other branches too... but this branch has the best quality ingredients. The ginkgo nuts aren't hard, and the longan juice never has a burnt smell. It seems the staff at this branch pays attention to preparing the ingredients. Highly recommended! 👍🏻💗
sample_reviews_en.author: Lalada Waratechapong

restaurants.name: Sortrel's Cottage
restaurants.address:

500/1 Rama III Rd, Bang Khlo, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant Sortrel here we used to visit here long time ago. However we decided to drop here again because we so hungry and need quick bite before back home.

Food: Good ingredients for local menu and really tasty. The food plate really comfortable to share with it. We order as per pictures down there. We can't finish it. We have to asking pack back home for some reason.

Service: Outstanding and make different from the staff, I can't remember her name but she wearing glasses whiles Service us on the table with attentive information.

Location: Good access from the main road directly.

Looking forward to visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwanchai Quinzy Yokto

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've had parties here three or four times now. The banquet hall is quite large…
You can choose the buffet option, priced around 600 baht per person, which includes a wide variety of food and drinks…
The karaoke room is comfortable and spacious.
The food is delicious; everyone who's been here has praised it.
The restaurant closes quite late, giving you plenty of time…
The service from the staff is good. There's also live music outside in the outdoor area.
…
Overall, I really like this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthajak San

sample_reviews_en.text:
A casual and relaxed restaurant atmosphere.
There are both indoor and outdoor seating areas.

Seafood Salad (Yum Ruam Mit Talay) 5/5: Very delicious. The noodles are soft and chewy, and the dressing is very flavorful.

Tom Yum Goong (Spicy Shrimp Soup) 4.5/5: Delicious, the broth is rich and flavorful.

Cheese Sticks with Spinach 6/5: Absolutely delicious, highly recommend trying it!

Other dishes are great with free refills of alcoholic beverages.
sample_reviews_en.author: Err OR

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, with both outdoor and private rooms available for events. The food tastes good and doesn't take long to arrive. They offer free crackers, fried peanuts, and french fries that you can fry yourself. There's live music; the day I went (Sunday, January 19th, 2025) the music was excellent and both bands played and sang very well. However, the first band on Friday, January 10th, 2025 wasn't as good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mantana Y

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant offers delicious food, good service, reasonable prices, and live music in the evenings. There's ample parking and both indoor and outdoor dining areas, perfect for relaxing.

The portions are generous. Overall, it's okay. However, the restrooms weren't very clean, and there were a lot of mosquitoes and insects.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploiieas As

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the atmosphere is relaxing, there is a waiter, free beans/french fries are served, but you have to fry them yourself. There are colors to play with on the dining table (tablecloth is covered with paper).
sample_reviews_en.author: สเต็กคุณหนู

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is nice and the food is decent. There are private rooms available for reservation, perfect for gatherings. They also have a self-service buffet with unlimited French fries, peanuts, crackers, and chicken legs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teerawoot Sutthumvilai

sample_reviews_en.text: The karaoke system is still considered not very good, especially the sound quality and the fact that too much text obscures the screen when selecting songs, making it difficult for the person singing to see the video.
sample_reviews_en.author: TJ

restaurants.name: Guru Kripa-Pure Vegetarian Indian Restaurant
restaurants.address:

115 11, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Guru Kripa Pure Veg Restaurant in Pattaya is a hidden gem! I stumbled upon this place and was blown away by the flavors and hospitality. The moment I walked in, I felt like I was in for a treat. The aroma of spices and fresh herbs filled the air, and the warm decor made me feel cozy.

The menu was a love letter to vegetarians, with creative dishes that showcased the chef's skills. I tried the vegetable biryani and palak paneer, and oh boy, they were divine! The portions were generous, and the prices were a steal.

What truly made my experience special was the service. The staff were attentive, knowledgeable, and passionate about the food they served. They made great recommendations and ensured I had a wonderful time.

If you're a vegetarian or just looking for a delicious meal in Pattaya, Guru Kripa is a must-visit. Get ready for a culinary adventure that will leave you craving for more!
sample_reviews_en.author: Neeraj Tomar

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Excellent Vegetarian Food in Pattaya!

Had an amazing dining experience at Guru Kripa Pattaya. The food was absolutely delicious, fresh, and full of authentic Indian flavors. Every dish was prepared perfectly, and the taste reminded me of home.

The restaurant offers a great variety of North Indian and South Indian vegetarian dishes, with excellent service and a warm atmosphere. The staff was courteous, attentive, and made us feel very welcome.

If you’re looking for the best vegetarian Indian restaurant in Pattaya, I highly recommend Guru Kripa. Whether you’re a tourist or a local, this place is a must-visit for authentic Indian food, reasonable prices, and outstanding hospitality.

Will definitely visit again on my next trip to Pattaya!

Highly recommended for pure vegetarian food lovers in Pattaya. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
sample_reviews_en.author: Harleen Singh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Guru Kripa in Pattaya delivers genuinely good food with flavors that feel well thought out and satisfying. The quality of ingredients is solid, and most dishes are well-balanced and enjoyable.
Taste-wise, I’d rate the food a strong 4 out of 5 — comforting and consistent.
The owner truly stands out, bringing warmth, care, and passion to the place (5/5).

When the owner is present, the staff is attentive and service feels smooth and professional.
You can sense better discipline and focus during those times.

However, in the owner’s absence, service quality drops noticeably and feels careless. This inconsistency affects the overall dining experience despite the good food. With more consistent service, Guru Kripa could easily become a top choice for quality and taste.

Raghav Sharma
sample_reviews_en.author: Fox Eyes India

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely loved this place! It’s so hard to find authentic Indian pure vegetarian food in Thailand, but this restaurant truly exceeded expectations. Every dish was fresh, flavorful, and reminded me of home. The spices were perfectly balanced, and you can really taste the authenticity in every bite.

What made the experience even better was their amazing milk tea (masala chai). It’s very rare to find proper Indian-style milk tea here, but they got it just right – strong, perfectly sweet, and full of flavor. It honestly felt like having chai back in India.

Great food, great taste, and a comforting experience overall. Highly recommended for anyone craving real Indian vegetarian food and authentic chai in Thailand! 🇮🇳☕✨
sample_reviews_en.author: raksha bhandari

sample_reviews_en.text:
Guru Kripa Restaurant Pattaya is an absolute gem for vegetarians. I tried their hara bhara kebab, pav bhaji, and chilli paneer, and everything was perfectly made with authentic Delhi-style flavors and the right spice levels. The hara bhara kebab was especially amazing crispy, flavorful, and unforgettable.

The owners, a wonderful husband-and-wife team, personally manage the restaurant and are extremely sweet and welcoming. They treat every guest like family, which makes the dining experience even more memorable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karnika Chandana

sample_reviews_en.text:
Newly opened restaurant Guru kripa
Really nice Indian food and the staff is courteous and super friendly.

Ordered the good old panner tikka masala with a preference for spice. The food was amazing.
Prices are a little  good 👍 but comparable to their veg counterpart next door. But the taste and service do justify the prices to an extent.

Overall good experience dining here.

Thanks to the staff, guru karpa resturant
Amezing
Food: 5/5  |  Service: 5/5  |  Atmosphere
sample_reviews_en.author: Jagdev Singh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Best North Indian vegitarian food in Pattaya.
Staff is very good, soft spoken, caring and helpful.
Service with a smile and dedication.
But I didn't like tea there as
there may be some limitations with the owner.
We are habitual of making tea using fresh milk, but they only have bottled milk.
Owner lady is also very good, caring for her customers.
She puts every effort to make best food available in the city.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious! There's a wide variety of savory and sweet dishes, so you can get everything you need in one place. The food comes quickly, no long wait 👍 The prices aren't too high. If you spend 300 baht and check in, you get a free drink!
sample_reviews_en.author: จันจิรา แซ่อ้อ

sample_reviews_en.text: The fried food was delicious! I intended to have dessert, but the savory dishes here looked so tempting that I ordered a big set. The Tom Yum instant noodle hot pot was amazing, super spicy! A hidden gem in the Phra Pradaeng area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Katyb Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here many times, probably more than 10 times. They have a wide variety of dishes on the menu. The food tastes good and the prices are reasonable. You can park your motorcycle right in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Faris

sample_reviews_en.text: The service at the restaurant was excellent, the food tasted delicious, and the atmosphere inside was comfortable. The quality remained the same even when ordering for home delivery. I was very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: kae Vimonrat

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent service. The restaurant is clean, and the staff are very friendly and cheerful. Parking is convenient. The food is delicious and suits my taste, served quickly and efficiently. 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanabun Rattanasopapibun

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and of good quality. It was crowded, but the service was fast. Parking was good (across the street). The staff were very friendly and provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawarate Loonla

sample_reviews_en.text: When you come to this restaurant, you have to try the cotton candy bingsu and the BBQ chicken steak. The chicken is tender and delicious, and the food tastes great.
sample_reviews_en.author: fadeelah loesrabiab

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, the service is excellent, the staff are lovely and not rude or aggressive. The food is delicious, flavorful, and the portions are generous.

restaurants.name: Beef Express เลียบด่วนรามอินทรา
restaurants.address:
