Soi Yothin Phatthana 7, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10230, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Beef was reasonably priced, but the pasta felt a bit overpriced."

sample_reviews_en.text:
🇹🇭 Beef Express

🍴 Meats & Grills

🎗️ Beef Express is a steak restaurant known for its great value. Hidden away in a side street off Yothin Phatthana Road near the Ramintra Expressway, it's a must-visit for meat lovers and those who enjoy beef dishes. The interior isn't very large, but the fragrant aroma of meat wafts to your nose as soon as you walk in.

📃 SHARING SET

Sweet Potato Fries
Sweet potato fried served with truffle mayo & ketchup

Beef Tallow Fried Rice
Signature wagyu tallow fried rice topped with Australian 120-day grain-fed striploin

Angus Truffle Alfredo
Pasta truffle alfredo topped with Australian 120-day grain-fed striploin

Wagyu D-Rump MB 2/3 (200 g.)

Australian Grass-Fed Tenderloin (200 g.)

New Zealand Grass-Fed Ribeye
New Zealand grass-fed ribeye (250 g.)

Honey Garlic Pork Chop
Grilled honey garlic marinated kurobuta pork chop served with side of Caesar salad, BBQ ketchup & yakiniku sauce

Truffle cream mushroom soup with toasted buttered garlic bread

Lemon Creme Brulee

Molten Choc Lava Cake

📍 Visit: April 2026

🚗 Parking: Available in front of the shop

🕦 Operating Time: 11:30-14:30, 16:30-21:00

💰 Price: 799-1,790 THB

🧥 Dress Code: Casual
sample_reviews_en.author: ตามล่า Fine Dining

sample_reviews_en.text:
We recently engaged Beef Express for their outdoor catering with a Chef’s Table concept, and the entire experience exceeded expectations. From start to finish, the team was highly professional, attentive, and ensured that every detail was well taken care of.

The food presentation was remarkable — elegant, precise, and visually appealing, creating a dining atmosphere that felt elevated and memorable. Each dish was carefully prepared with high-quality ingredients, and the flavors were exceptional. Guests were genuinely impressed, not only by the taste but also by the thoughtful presentation and smooth service.

Another highlight is the value — considering the quality of food, service, and setup, the pricing is very reasonable. It is clear that Beef Express takes pride in delivering excellence while remaining accessible for different types of events.

I would highly recommend Beef Express to anyone seeking professional catering services, whether for private gatherings, corporate events, or special occasions. Their combination of outstanding food, attentive service, and refined presentation makes them a standout choice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasin Manasathit

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been eating here since their first branch until their last. At first, I felt sorry for them, but now I understand why.

This is my last time here. I wish them continued success in their business.
—
The food is good and the atmosphere is okay, but I'd like them to improve the service speed for each dish. The last main course took a very long time to arrive. We were a group of four, and three people had finished their meals before the fourth person received their order, even though we all ordered at the same time.

This is the second time this has happened. I hope the restaurant improves this, and it will be much better.

The previous staff managed things better in the areas I mentioned earlier.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vasinee Russamee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere was terrible, there were lots of flies, and the food on the menu was completely different from what it actually tasted. It didn't look appetizing, the portions were small, and the meat was tough and chewy.
But the worst part was when I told the staff about the salad, saying the vegetables were very bitter and inedible (I had to spit them out), and asked if they could substitute with other vegetables (which were my favorites and I usually eat them). The staff member went off to talk to someone else and disappeared without even coming back to say anything. I've never encountered such terrible service at a restaurant before.
sample_reviews_en.author: D. Vittaz

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited this steak restaurant recently — The meat quality was just okay, and the Alfredo sauce was a bit light. Beef was reasonably priced, but the pasta felt a bit overpriced. Overall, it was enjoyable, though it didn’t quite live up to the social media hype.

The main dishes should have come together. My husband’s two beef dishes arrived and were finished before my pasta even made it to the table. I mentioned it to the waitress, and it seemed like the order was missed. We had to wait a bit longer for it to be served.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nerunya Rattana

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very nice place , first time and loved the setting

The food ordering very fast and nice service

We ordered soup pumpkin , light and very small portion not like standard in other restaurants

The signature dishes are very nice 👍👍👍

The beef burger small suitable for kids (price adults )
But when eating it is very nice , the patty is big and delicious👍👍👍

Recommend to order few things as all food very tasty and nice . Recommended to go sign friends
sample_reviews_en.author: Yas Mokdad

sample_reviews_en.text: Good taste with a bit on the pricy side. Location is easily accessible, not far from the main road. Services not considered bad, but questionable. We place ordered for 5 dishes, got reconfirm from the waiter, but got only 3 dishes. 4th one after recalling once, so we decided not to recall again for the 5th. At the billing process, all 5 dishes were on the bill, so not sure where it could go wrong with the missing dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiratip Nuamtanong

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered 4 dishes for 2 people.
Striploin wagyu MB4/5 (medium)
Grilled Toungue with Yakiniku sauce
Truffle soup
Cold cuts salad (Balsamic)

The best dish was beef toungue! Very tender and tasty. No need to dip withany  sauce. Steak was cooked to-the-level. Soup was ok. They gave generous amount of cold cuts ( would gave been better if it was sliced a bit thinner).

restaurants.address:

165, 1 Sukhumvit Rd, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
6 of us stopped in for lunch. It was my girlfriends and my first time eating here. The food was delicious. My girlfriend had shrimp pad that and she said it was delicious! I had lobster soup, which was incredible, and Pad Krakow moo. They were both incredible dishes!!!

14/5/2026 Had lunch with my 92 year old father before he returns to America on Saturday. We had another wonderful meal. He had spaghetti with tomato sauce with chicken. I went Western and had an incredible burger. The burger was quite big and flavorful! I forgot to take a picture of his dish.
3/2/26 My girlfriend and I stopped on after taking a friend to the Bangkok Hospital Pattaya. As usual the food was delicious and the service was incredible. I do wish other restaurants would be as quick as Gecko. It is like the kitchen can read your mind. The servers drop off the order and you blink and the food is arriving at your table. Also, the prices and the flavors are incredible!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeff Holcomb

sample_reviews_en.text:
The building is surrounded by trees spreading their branches, creating a comfortable, resort-like atmosphere. The menu is similar to a family restaurant. While primarily Thai cuisine, they also offer spaghetti and other dishes. Recently, they've added kuay tiao (Thai noodle soup), which is a nice touch. Compared to before, the number of main dishes has decreased, and the dessert menu has disappeared, although they still offer cakes and ice cream.

The menu has changed again, now offering a selection more like a family restaurant. The prices haven't increased, but there are more Western-style dishes, and a breakfast menu available all day has been added.

They are apparently planning to move the store to the opposite side of the premises soon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Masato Ueno

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lovely place, but the service is non-existent.
​The cafe itself looks very nice, and it has a great atmosphere. I ordered a cacao, which was good, but that’s where the positive experience ended.
​After I finished my drink, nobody ever came back to my table. There were about 5 waiters walking past me back and forth, but they completely ignored me. I spent ages trying to catch someone's eye, but they just wouldn't notice. What if I was hungry and wanted to order a full meal? They missed out on a bigger bill just because they didn't care.
​In much cheaper places, the staff is way more attentive. Good rating should mean good service, but here you literally have to fight for the staff's attention. Where is the customer focus? Disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: M

sample_reviews_en.text:
A cozy cafe with large windows facing the main street.
I used it to work on my computer. It's cool and clean.
The linoleum feel of the floor is a bit of a shame.

The table seats make it quite easy to work on your computer.
There are sofa seats available too.
The terrace also looks nice, but it was too hot so I refrained from going there.

Fruit smoothie 130B. It was a little pricey, but it had whipped cream and was delicious, like dessert.
I forgot to check out the rest of the menu, so I'll come again later.
sample_reviews_en.author: ys

sample_reviews_en.text:
Found on a local guide google review. Glad that we came for breakie. ⭐️Western + Thai⭐️menu. Good range. Flavour is GOOD. Price very fair. Heard it’s pet-friendly 😍

❤️Perfect for big group 👍
🥹SUPER HELPFUL staff👍 we asked them for some recommendations & location confirmations

❤️mural arts & plenty of good photo spots around the cafe
❤️NO WAIT 🤭

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was absolutely top-notch – very attentive and friendly! The breakfast itself was also delicious, although there was one small drawback: the sausages were unfortunately still cold inside.

If the kitchen makes sure everything is served hot next time, it will be a truly excellent place. I'll gladly return because of the great service and lovely atmosphere!

sample_reviews_en.text:
The tom yum wasn't bad at all; the shrimp was really tender, but the squid was like a shoe sole. It would also be great if all the roots were removed from the pot; it's not very convenient to eat and pick at the roots.
The Margherita pizza was just tomatoes; there was no salami. I didn't like the dough, although the kid found it delicious.
The iced coffee was good.

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, the food is delicious, the restaurant is beautifully decorated with plenty of photo opportunities – everything you need in one place. They have drinks, bakery items, and meals. The restaurant is located right by the road with convenient parking. The prices are higher than average (prices do not include service charge).

restaurants.address:

604/3 Phetchaburi Rd, Khwaeng Thanon Phetchaburi, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I saw many good reviews online and decided to give this place a try. It’s located in Phenix, which is still a fairly new mall and relatively quiet at the moment.

The sashimi was reasonably fresh, but overall it didn’t really impress me and was a little disappointing. To be fair, this is more of a buffet and wagyu-focused restaurant rather than a dedicated Japanese sashimi restaurant, so expectations may differ.

The salmon sashimi was not sliced very well, as some pieces were “opening” at the ends, which affected the presentation and texture slightly. The sushi rice also felt under-seasoned.

Perhaps I should have focused more on their wagyu dishes instead, as that may be what they are better known for. Overall, not a bad experience, but probably not the place I would return to specifically for sashimi.
sample_reviews_en.author: James Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very, very good experience. Small cosy shop with good hot grill and strong air vacuum.
Just note that it's not charcoal fire.

Staff is very friendly and enthusiastic while explaining the menu items to us.

Had the platinum buffet. Superb quality A4 wagyu, no complains.
Wagyu comes in thin slices. I personally would  prefer thicker slices but they were great nonetheless.
Beef tartare(Yukke) is very, very nice.
Sashimi is fresh and nice.
Draft Chang beer, tasty!

They are running a promo until the end of July; 4 diners for the price of 3.
I highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tim Ho

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the pleasure of dining at Wagyu Kurabu Premium Yakiniku, and the quality of their Hitachiwagyu beef is truly outstanding. The meat literally melts in your mouth, with the perfect balance of marbling and flavor. I really appreciated seeing their official Certificate of Authenticity and designation as an official seller of Hitachiwagyu Beef — it gave me full confidence in the quality. The staff were attentive and knowledgeable, explaining the different cuts and cooking methods. Definitely one of the best Wagyu experiences I’ve had outside Japan...
sample_reviews_en.author: Uzir Erawan

sample_reviews_en.text: I had an incredible dining experience here! The Wagyu beef was phenomenal—melt-in-your-mouth tender and beautifully marbled. What truly set this place apart, though, was the staff. They were incredibly attentive, patient, and detail-oriented. They took the time to explain the different cuts of meat and carefully guided us on the perfect grilling times. Cooking at the table was so much fun, and the cozy atmosphere made it even better. With such stellar service and top-notch food, this restaurant deserves more than five stars. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Zoey Wang

sample_reviews_en.text: This Japanese Wagyu buffet is a paradise for meat lovers, offering top-quality cuts that are beautifully marbled and melt in your mouth. The sushi and other dishes are equally impressive, showcasing fresh ingredients and authentic flavors. Service is exceptional, with attentive staff ensuring a seamless dining experience. If you’re looking for a luxurious Japanese feast, this place is a must-visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Samuel August

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wagyu Kurabu was a wonderful experience.
The staff was super attentive and very helpful! The dishes came out very fast.
It was nice and quiet when I went.
I can imagine it's a more intimate setting when packed with people.

The food was super delicious from the yakiniku to sushi and sashimi. Definitely worth the visit if you are a meat and sushi lover!
Thank you very much for the dinner 😊🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom Liang

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Exceptional Service and Quality
We had an incredible dining experience at Waygu Karabu Premium Yakiniku in Bangkok. The service was outstanding—attentive, friendly, and efficient. Our favorite was the lean wagyu, which was absolutely delicious. It was prepared quickly and of the highest quality. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a premium yakiniku experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lily Senevongsa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Without a doubt, the best meal I have ever had.
The food was so fresh and delicious.
This place deserves to be packed out as it's in a relatively quiet area.
The location is Phoenix Big C, ground floor on the right.
The menu is extensive and it's best to ask the friendly staff for help. Their English is very good.

I'll be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: james7999

restaurants.name: Bloom Dining
restaurants.address:

70 Rama IX Soi 41, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
If you're around the Sports Authority of Thailand (SAT/กกท), this long-running fusion spot is a must-visit. It offers great reviews, ample parking, and a cozy, air-conditioned atmosphere—perfectly decorated with beautiful Christmas trees this season.
Must-Try Dishes:
Spaghetti A.O.P: Perfectly al dente pasta with a bold garlic and chili kick. It comes with crispy bacon and slightly fatty pork belly (which adds great flavor even if you prefer to trim the fat).
Bloom Sandwich: A standout choice! The soft, chewy Salted Pretzel bread makes for a unique "carb" base, stuffed with fresh greens, ham, and creamy cheese.
Iced Orange Americano: Highly refreshing with a distinct, aromatic coffee scent.
sample_reviews_th.author: Aey Angel

sample_reviews_en.text:
So my friend and I after our business meeting came here to have lunch she wanted to show me this place because they have really good flavored ice cream although after eating the lunch I had no room for the ice cream!

We ordered the steak and eggs dish , it was very good except it was quite small portion there was hardly any beef and in the photo it looks like you’re gonna get a half a cow 🐄 😂

We also ordered the beef Krapao which I had ordered spicy and that was really good the fried so fluffy and crispy it’s extremely fun to eat!

If you’re in the area the ambience is great you wanna sit and have a nice meal I didn’t get a chance to try the pretzels because it was quite sold out and I was so full I couldn’t even look at any more food !

I would highly recommend this place here in the area remember to Follow Fauzia and all of her social media channels such as Facebook Instagram TikTok and YouTube for our daily video content !
Thank you so much for reading our review  💕
sample_reviews_en.author: Follow Fauzia

sample_reviews_en.text:
​[Hidden Gem Alert 🚨] Don't leave Bloom Dining without trying THIS!
​We all know Bloom Dining for their iconic pretzels, but did you know they have a "Secret Weapon" that only comes out on weekends? 🤫
​I finally got my hands on their Signature Egg Tarts, and honestly? The hype is real. They use premium eggs from No Brand Egg, which gives the custard this incredibly vibrant golden hue and a rich, "real egg" flavor that’s hard to find elsewhere. It’s silky, it’s creamy, and it’s not too sweet.
​But the real MVP is the CRUST. 🥧 It’s shatteringly crisp! Get this: I even kept one in the fridge overnight, and it was still crunchy the next morning. No soggy bottoms here!
​📅 Note: They only bake these on Saturdays & Sundays.
📍 Where: Bloom Dining
​If you’re a fan of Portuguese-style tarts or just love a good crunch, put this on your weekend checklist! ✨
​#BloomDining #EggTart #NoBrandEgg #WeekendSpecial #FoodieReview #BangkokEats
sample_reviews_en.author: Thaifoodies Co

sample_reviews_en.text:
My first visit was okay, the service was alright.

My second visit was terrible. I came because I liked the location and the view; it's a pretty cafe. The first question the staff asked was, "Did you come by motorcycle?!"
My feeling was, "Can't I come by motorcycle? Do I have to fly here?"
The staff were extremely discriminatory. Does it mean you have to be rich and spend a lot to get good service?
I was paying for my food, not asking for free meals. This is the first time I've ever encountered such prejudice.

I tried to order food several times, but the staff ignored me and went to take orders from people who came after me, then stood there on their phones.
I pressed the order button again, but they still ignored me, so I walked out.
I glanced back and saw them taking orders from foreigners who came after me! I was so confused. There were several staff members at the counter.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sa Sareepah

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a nice and vibrant place. The service is nice. Good atmosphere and the food is original and of good quality.
Minor points:
It can be quite noisy with a combination of people talking, music and noises from the (open) kitchen.
Today we asked for some extra parmezan cheese for our pasta, but although there was a bit on the pasta already. They seem to not be wanting to give us some extra cheese. We are very used to asking this in many restaurants throughout the city and never refused. It is common and oke for us to pay for extra cheese.
A restaurant like this should not have any issues (the guest can pay for it) to be more flexible and guest friendly to accommodate such a small gesture. Really disappointing. Thats why I can only give 4 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: MABKK

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stumbled upon this trendy café, drawn in by its charming exterior adorned with Instagram-worthy spots. The café's main attractions are its pretzels and coffee, prompting me to order the almond pretzel and Nutella peanut coffee. Disappointingly, the pretzel was a tad dry and didn't live up to my expectations. Inside, the café offers a handful of pet-friendly tables, and there's outdoor seating available as well. Parking is a breeze with around 10 spots to choose from. On the bright side, the staff were warm and attentive throughout my visit.

Additionally, they offer brunch, lunch, and dinner options, which I plan to explore in the future. It's worth noting that the café is conveniently located near a shopping mall, adding to its appeal.
sample_reviews_en.author: S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Bloom Dining is famous for its breakfast menu, especially the Pretzel, which is a best-seller 🥨🍳. The staff are friendly, provide clear menu information, and the atmosphere is clean and well-kept. It can get quite busy in the morning.

Parking is available, but cars are often parked in tandem. The staff will always ask for your license plate number so they can move cars when needed. I recommend visiting around 9 AM, when it’s not too crowded and you can easily choose your seat.

The food tastes great, but it takes a bit of time to be served, so it’s best to allow for some waiting. Overall, a lovely spot for those who enjoy a warm breakfast atmosphere with attention to detail 🌿.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pinkpurin. Tips

sample_reviews_en.text:
pretzel, good food.

Hard to find a good pretzel in Bangkok, this place could be the winner. Their pretzel was tasty, especially the almond pretzel, it paired well with Americano.

Didn't expect to have a cafe with good food but it did! The fried rice with pesto sauce (Emerald wagyu fried rice) was delicious.

Unfortunately, the cafe recently opened in the area and many people wanted to try or take pictures. Most of the time they ran out of pretzels which is very unfortunate for a cafe that sells pretzels.

Service was great, the employee was friendly and active.

Free parking is available around the restaurant but might be difficult to get parking during lunch time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Awaybutnotalone “Awaybutnotalone”

restaurants.address:

Gaysorn Amarin ชั้น 3 496 Phloen Chit Rd, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Went there 3 times in a row, good vibe, great music, the service is phenomenal friendly, shout out to everyone but Khun Jo (คุณโจ้) was keeping coming checking on us, cheers bro!

There’re many bars in Bangkok these days
But these kind of services and vibes are hard to find, keep going! FatBoy!
sample_reviews_th.author: Fleur Merphy

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been eyeing Fatboy for a while and I finally has the chance to at their newly opened Amarin branch.

I really like their decorations and overall atmosphere. Its decorated in a Japanese-themed/Japanese classic cartoons toys decor. Staffs were very friendly and welcoming and spoke good English. The menu offers a diverse selection of foods, some with an interesting twist on the classics.

The foods comes in a relatively small portions in my view, compared to the prices charged, the flavours were nice for most, but the menu I enjoyed most (and recommend) would have to be the Edamame Hummus. Served with a side of crispy nori chips, the hummus was smooth and well seasoned with a touch of wasabi for an extra subtle kick. The other sushi/rolls were made with fresh ingredients, but again I felt like it was on the smaller side compared to its price tag.

Will visit again in the future and recommend for all looking for a cool place to hangout.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisana Varanyuwatana

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food was good, but the service was quite disappointing. The floor manager was not flexible in making arrangements — we were seated indoors and found it too noisy, so we requested to move outdoors. Despite the restaurant not being crowded, they could not accommodate the change.

Later, when we decided to just have drinks outdoors, the staff allowed us to do so but insisted we couldn’t order food since the area was “closed.” While I understand policy restrictions, there was clearly no crowd and the rigidity made the experience uncomfortable.

The entire night felt awkward as we couldn’t enjoy our meal or conversation peacefully. Overall, good food but poor service and inflexible management — would not recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: L K

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pre-booked and purchased set from Hungry hub at 1999baht for food set for 2 pax. We were promptly ushered to our table seatings with window viewing of the busy city centre just before it turned dark.
Food included: waygu beef tartare, gyoza, rice rolls, crispy mushroom curry,pork katsu, uni pasta. They were generally well executed but probably only the waygu beef tartare and pork katsu were more memorable in taste.
We were very full by end of the meal and atmosphere were relaxed and the Izakaya was not so busy so quite chill during our dinner there.
Probably will recommend if wish to come have a good meal to boom on Hungry Hub for the value set else walk in pricing of the menu is steep.
sample_reviews_en.author: Katherine Chong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve heard about this place for ages—everyone says the food’s amazing, but a bit pricey, lol. So of course, I had to try it for myself. And honestly? They weren’t wrong. Everything we had was delicious (as you can see from the pic, the three of us didn’t stop eating 🤣). My personal MVP goes to the dry udon and the spaghetti with uni. But yeah, the portions don’t exactly match the price tag.

What really stands out here is the lively atmosphere and great music. I didn’t get a chance to try the drinks this time though, since it was the end of Buddhist Lent, and they weren’t selling alcohol. So I sipped on some green tea at the izakaya instead!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bow K. Techataveekijkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, the ingredients were fresh, and every dish we ordered was impressive 😋 Especially the non-alcoholic mocktails – we tried all 3 and they were all delicious and refreshing 🍹✨

The staff were lovely, friendly, and welcoming. The atmosphere was fun.

The only minor issue was that the lighting was a bit dim, with a red tone, making it difficult to see the food clearly. Sometimes it was hard to tell what we were eating 😂 A little more lighting around the tables would be great.

Overall, the food and service were excellent. We will definitely go back again ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: MydestinyMikel

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food overall were really good. We tried many dishes and none of them were bad. The service was also very friendly. There were staff hopping to every table offering sake tap to your mouth which I thought was quite funny.

The only complaint I got for the place was for the DJ and his music. It was quite a mess. At first it started out ok but then he keep switching between the Thai 90's + 00's and old school songs like Abba and Maroon 5 with happy birthday thrown in to the set for a couple of times. His mixing skill was also a bit questionable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Theerapat Yimsirikul

sample_reviews_en.text: I loved overall experience. The drinks are very good ! Most of the food is tasty. I had a cocktail called “Fans Only” and it was delicious. We ordered 4 dishes and I felt like the roasted duck breast was not worth what we paid for. The music became extremely loud around 7:30-8:00 pm and we had to move outside due to the loud sound. The waitress was rushing us to order but other waitresses and waiters were chilled and helpful. I will definitely go again but would be great if they adjust the sound system coz it was extremely loud.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ei Phyu Sin Aung

restaurants.name: Miyabi Kappo
restaurants.address:

9 11 Thong Lo 25 Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Miyabi is a long-established restaurant in the Thonglor area that speaks of high-end Japanese cuisine. It's often used to entertain Japanese expatriates, and the adjacent karaoke set menu is now a standard staple. While the recent weak yen makes it a bit pricey, the restaurant continues to attract many high-class Thai customers, and the parking lot is lined with luxury cars! The food, made with exceptional ingredients, is undeniably delicious. Perhaps there's no Japanese person with the title of Prime Minister? I wondered why. The reason is that the sauces and dipping sauces seemed almost pre-made. If they had paid a little more attention to detail, I think the restaurant would have received a higher rating.
sample_reviews_en.author: 世界を旅する覆面パトローラー

sample_reviews_en.text: I thought I bought a plane ticket to Bangkok, but somehow I ended up in Japan. At least that’s how it felt. Prepare to spend some time looking through the menu because it’s massive. The food is fantastic though. Don’t forget to bring swimming trunks because they also have a pool. Also, make sure to wait after the credits because you will be rewarded with fresh fruit, hot green tea, and a hot towel to melt yourself too before you head back outside to melt further in Bangkok’s weather. Another tip, if you write a Google review, like I’m doing now, you’ll receive a 20% off discount on your bill.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Hoang

sample_reviews_en.text:
We took a taxi in the rain. Bangkok is extremely congested.
When we arrived, an attendant came over and asked,
Are you going to Karaoke Miyabi today?
We were welcomed into a private room, and the hospitality of the many staff members made it a comfortable atmosphere. The Japanese-mansion-style restaurant has many private rooms, and with views of the counter on the first floor and the pool in the courtyard, it has a very relaxing atmosphere.
There is also a sushi counter and a teppanyaki counter, and the atmosphere is great. All the food is delicious, making it a good place for entertaining.
sample_reviews_en.author: james won

sample_reviews_en.text: High class Japanese sushi restaurant with the best quality sashimi I have had in Thailand. Authentic styling and ambiance. Extensive menu with every type of fish I can think of, and a few things I never thought I'd see. The service was beyond amazing and attentive. I felt welcomed and cared for from the moment I came in the parking lot. There are different dining options and they'll customize your experience however you want, from private rooms to omakase. There's something here for everyone and lots of space for all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stefan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I wanted to try some Japanese food in Bangkok, so I visited Kappo Miyabi. All of the toppings on the premium sushi were in excellent condition, and the taste was firm and comparable to what I'd get in Japan. 

The conger eel tempura was also impressive, with a light batter and a fluffy texture that made it delicious down to the bone. 

The restaurant has a calming atmosphere, making it a great place to relax and enjoy a meal. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for quality Japanese food in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Toshiyuki Tanaka

sample_reviews_en.text:
Miyabi Kappo is one of those places where you walk in and immediately feel like you’ve discovered a hidden gem in Bangkok.

Sitting at the counter watching the chef prepare everything felt so intimate and special — like dinner and a show, but elegant. Every dish looked like art and somehow tasted even better. The sashimi was melt-in-your-mouth and everything tasted insanely fresh and high quality.

The whole experience felt calm, refined, and not touristy at all. Definitely a “core memory” type of dinner.
sample_reviews_en.author: autumnasagirl

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food here is so good. I’ve been here 3 times, and every time I’ve had an excellent experience.
The sashimi is fresh, with generous slices. The yakisoba has the perfect texture and taste. The sushi rolls are delicious. The staff are very attentive.
It is a restaurant that values quality.
The price is the same as other sushi restaurants in Thonglor, but in my opinion the service, quality of food, and beautiful venue are better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rhys Griffiths

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really nice Japanese restaurant in Bangkok.

The whole experience felt very authentic, and the food was honestly delicious. You can tell they take care with the ingredients and the preparation. The place itself is cozy and has a great atmosphere, and the staff were super friendly and attentive the entire time.

Five stars for the service, five stars for the place, and five stars for the food. I’d definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: cesar augusto herrera llinas

restaurants.name: Lucky Panda - American Chinese Eats (Sathorn)
restaurants.address:

50/1, 2nd Floor, 8 Soi Phiphat, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Feeling lazy so I decided to get delivery

I ordered the
Chili 🌶️ beef 🥩 - wow!! Love this (wish it was a bigger portion) I had ordered the small one

Chow Mein - I ordered the large portion and I’m happy I did I wish there was a it of spice on it

Singapore Noodles 🍜- these were good Singapore noodles but I’ve had better they were not the real Singapore noodle flavor that I’m used to with American Chinese food they were good though but not that dryness that Singapore noodles usually have!

General Tao’s chicken 🍗- I really enjoyed this I like the batter it was lightly battered not too heavy and like the sauce with it as well and the bit of broccoli thrown in there was quite nice they were well done it was crunchy not soggy broccoli which was nice!

😊
I would highly recommend to order from Lucky panda if you’re having a hangover day or just even a nice lunch with friends but the person I would find her bit too small

Follow fauzia for more tips and tricks of food, lifestyle and travel 🧳 in Bangkok and beyond because Follow was here on Facebook Instagram and YouTube !!
🥳🥳🌶️🌶️🌶️🥳🥳🥳
sample_reviews_en.author: Follow Fauzia

sample_reviews_en.text:
Was craving American Chinese food so decided to give this place a try based on the excellent reviews. We order 3 different dishes from here.

Will never order from here again. This place is expensive and the portion sizes are small. The pictures make the cartons look like they are filled to the top with food but in reality the cartons are only 75% full. What makes it worse is that the bottom is has veggies so the actual portion you get is very small.

On top of the small portions, the chicken wasn't even crispy - it was soggy and some pieces were just plain fried dough with no chicken.

For how much they charge, the portion sizes should be more generous.

Perhaps it was a one-off bad experience but given the high prices and small portion sizes, I'm not inclined to give it a 2nd chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jimmy

sample_reviews_en.text:
Having a craving for American Chinese food. Saw this restaurant near my office and decided to try after reading mostly positive reviews.

The service is great. Staffs are very nice.

Nice little shop. Love the color and simple design. Makes me feel comfortable.

Ordered chow mein set with crab Rangoon and stir fried broccoli with beef.

Chow mein was really so so. The noodle texture was great. But was under season. Pretty much bland.

Stir fried broccoli with beef was the star here. Beef was done perfectly and broccoli was delicious. Really love this dish.

Crab Rangoon was slightly too sweet but taste quite good.

Overall a nice dish. Huge portions and value for money.

Will be back to try the fried rice next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Low

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered thru Grab, Broccoli Chicken, Large orange Chicken and Chow Mein Vegetable. I gave 3 stars for service because it was at least packed properly.

I was expecting food that are at least flavorful because they call it a Chinese Restaurant, you know how an Orange Chicken taste like and how the chicken should be if you love Chinese food  but their Orange Chicken is simply fried Chicken nuggets with sweet & sour sauce and slices of oranges. The Chow Mein is so bland and a bit dry and the Broccoli chicken is also bland. The price might look affordable but I consider it pricey because of the taste. I hope they can improve it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yoda Travels

sample_reviews_en.text:
LP at One BKK closed. Unfortunately, I don’t think they learned any lessons.

I made the trip here only to find it nearly impossible to order a fresh ice tea with my set menu.

With the lack of communication came a certain overall attitude that was reflected in the entire experience.

The food, service and quality all seem to be an afterthought-rather than the reason they are there.

I suggest it’s time to rethink the business model and focus on the customer experience and quality.

This review is more for the owners than customers. Believe it or not, this is my attempt to help the Panda be lucky and successful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gerry Noterman

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went on a weekend at lunchtime and were the only dine in guests.
We ordered a combo meal — General Tao’s Chicken and Szechuan BBQ Pork with fried rice plus a couple of sodas — all for under 340 THB, which was great value. The food was sweet, spicy, and packed with the comforting flavors you expect from non-authentic American Chinese fare.
Restaurant was on the 2nd floor and very clean and tidy.
No greeting on arrival, no menu offered, and no goodbye or thank you when we left which was disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karen Graham

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to lucky panda this afternoon, it was very quiet. The sets look really good value for money, however I didn't want rice so I ordered General Tao's Chicken and also mixed vegetable. I really like it when restaurants offer a mixed vegetable dish as it's a good way to get more veggies in. The food was really good. Together when a water it was around 329 BAHT, but you can get a regular set for less than 200 baht.

The really nailed the western style Chinese chicken dish.

Recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexander Roan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great tasting food and great value! Having the noodle with chili oil is soooo good! Restaurant is pretty empty in the evening so a great spot to enjoy food alone after a tiring day.  The meal portion is so large you’d be full for a long time. Ladies, bring your friend or you won’t finish it.

Add: Unfortunately, staff can’t communicate well in Thai, thus didn’t collect membership point despite the fact that I have mentioned it several times. All I got was dry laughter and “next time?”.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phassaphoo Apissirirat

restaurants.name: Uptojug Kitchen & Cafe - ครัวแล้วแต่จั๊ก
restaurants.address:

23 Prasert-Manukit Rd, Sena Nikhom, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, clean, and the atmosphere is great. The ingredients are high quality, and the prices are reasonable for the quality. Every dish we ordered today was delicious. The crab curry noodles were excellent – ​​the curry paste was perfect, the sauce was smooth, and the accompanying vegetables were clean. The crab fried rice was delicious, dry, and flavorful. The fried rice with dried fish was also tasty, with generous portions of fish. The minced pork with plum sauce was very flavorful, refreshing, and not too sour. The papaya salad with rice noodles was also delicious. The portion sizes were just right, and the dishes were beautifully presented. Overall, I really liked it. The atmosphere is nice, clean, and modern – a great place to host guests at home; you won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peeraphan Wichityarn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The room is beautiful and comfortable, and can accommodate a large group.
Recommended dishes:
Chicken chive sticks (I loved them! Not greasy, and the dipping sauce was good)
Crispy pork neck
Green curry with bird's eye chili and beef shank (The beef was tender, and it was delicious with rice noodles)
Stir-fried crab with bird's eye chili and minced pork (Not spicy)
Fried rice with dried fish (Fragrant and delicious, a squeeze of lime makes it even better)
Fried bananas were not oily and were delicious.
For coffee, I recommend Kiss Me.

I didn't get a chance to take pictures; the food was gone so quickly! Haha. The pictures match the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: supavadee samakkit

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant was recommended by a friend as being delicious. I used GPS to drive there, and I recommend slowing down a bit when you get to the front of the restaurant because you'll see the entrance right ahead. The atmosphere is nice and shady, and it's located by the road with convenient parking. We ordered several dishes, and everything was delicious and to our liking.
The staff were very attentive. We stayed and ate with our friends until the restaurant closed. Overall, we were very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ble Athi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every dish was delicious. Today I ordered rice noodles with crab curry, crab fried rice, minced pork and plum soup, spaghetti with fried fish, and spicy papaya salad.

The ingredients were of very high quality and the food was prepared with great care.

What impressed me most were the rice noodles with crab curry, crab fried rice, and minced pork and plum soup; they were so refreshing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirinan Wichityarn

sample_reviews_en.text: We went for lunch and we were the only table in the whole restaurant. It's like a typical cafe. The lunch food was terrible and expensive. The only good thing was the staff were very nice. Everything else was bad, and they even gave us fried bananas that were stuck to the bone – thankfully they let us return them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr. Sukunya Harinasuta

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped by for lunch. The restaurant is air-conditioned, looks neat, and has plenty of parking. There's also an EV charging station nearby. The staff were attentive, the menu looked interesting, and the food tasted good, but the prices were a little high.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dumrong tri

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere in the restaurant is comfortable, the air conditioning is nice and cool, and the menu offers a wide variety of dishes, each meticulously prepared. I personally found the spaghetti with salted fish to be delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natjanan Wichityan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious. The Khao Soi with beef is my absolute favorite. The ingredients, even the side dishes, are top-notch.

They've opened a new glass-walled zone. It's so beautiful in the evenings when the lights are on! 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: TOPZCRET

restaurants.name: V Street Emsphere
restaurants.address:

Emsphere, Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
This is one of my impressible vegan restaurants I’ve ever met. The food is so delicious with good ingredients. The staffs are so kindness. I ordered V Street Tomyum Noodle (I asked for not putting the noodles but just only vegetables), Dry Sukhothai Noodle, and Fried Pork With Garlic and Pepper. They gave me the little bowl of soup, too 🥹🙏🏻

I met a female staff who can communicate with Thai people and foreigners. She explains clearly about anything that I would like to know, she told me a lot of details though 🤣🤣 that was super cool!!! Because I clearly understood and it’s good for allergic people to know the ingredients of food.

The restaurant have its own area to sit. But don’t worry if you come at the traffic time, there are a lot of seats and tables from the mall at this floor 😉💜

#VStreet #Emsphere
#Bangkok #Thailand
#LSulita #แอลสุลิตา
sample_reviews_th.author: L Sulita

sample_reviews_en.text:
I first visited this restaurant when Emsphere originally opened and was a bit disappointed with the food choices, as they were quite limited.
A year later, a lot has changed in their menu. There are far more choices, with the restaurant offering single and combined dishes (with rice). The staff are friendly and have a good knowledge of their food. As the dishes are made onsite, they are able to accommodate, allergy needs.
There is plenty of seating onsite as the site is located in the food court. Price wise it is more expensive than common street food, but the taste is on par.
My friend ate faux pork and I ate tofu w/ veg and rice. We both enjoyed our dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tessa Spiers

sample_reviews_en.text:
The street food, period. You really need to know what to order here.

We ate at V Street several times, and some dishes were definitely better than others.

The Pad Thai was consistently good, and the Lord of the Dumplings as well.
The Vientiane Noodle Soup was also good every time.

The Green Curry was perfect a couple of days ago, but today it was very spicy, so my daughter couldn't eat it.

V Street also has desserts (ice cream and brownies), which was a pleasant surprise.

You can definitely have a very good meal here. If you’re not sure what to order, just ask the friendly staff for recommendations — they’ll be happy to help.
sample_reviews_en.author: Early Retirement Abroad

sample_reviews_en.text:
More on my vegan travel blog: I Travel For Vegan Food 🌱

Vstreet is the more casual sister brand to the famous Vistro, and the food here is top-tier. It was honestly so good that it was one of the few places I actually went back to for a second meal during my trip.

You have to try their vegan 'egg' omelette served with fried rice. I tried it with both the Tom Yum and Drunken fried rice, and the omelette stole the show both times: Perfectly crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. The Lion's Mane Prik Paow and the boat noodles are the two of my other favourites
sample_reviews_en.author: I Travel For Vegan Food

sample_reviews_en.text: What can I say? I strolled the food court and stumbled across V street after a quick glance at happy cow. I was met with smiles and warm welcomes. The hostess suggested was incredibly helpful and also suggested the truffle mushroom dumplings. These were to die for. I also got the pad Thai with noodles and the fried pork with garlic and pepper. Everything was delicious and filling. I cannot wait to come back here. If you are vegan and come to Thailand do yourself the favor and grab a bite at V street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Lopes

sample_reviews_en.text: I have traveled worldwide in search of the most tastiest vegan cuisines out there. This place knocked me off my feet once I went into my first bite! The flavors and spices touched my palette in an instant! I was savoring each bite like it was my last 😋 the entire experience was a delightful one. Cashier very helpful and friendly. Place easy to find. The decor eye catching especially the plantain chandelier ☺️ LOVED IT ALL! definitely next time in BKK I will always visit. Gracias 🙏🏽
sample_reviews_en.author: Dagyana Romero

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delighted to find an all vegan place close to our hotel. I had the pad thai and edamame dumplings. Both were fabulous. The dumplings a little on the spicy side. The lady serving was so kind and happy to make suggestions of you ask her. Will definitely come back during our 3 day stay.

Update: in fact we definitely came back another time whilst we were here and it was consistently excellent. Having spend 10 days in Thailand this was easily the best vegan pad Thai we ate.
sample_reviews_en.author: Priya G

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely blown away by V Street in Bangkok! hands down the best fully vegan spot. I LOVED their dumplings!! I’ve never had dumplings this good before. And OMG the butter masala pasta is soo delicious and flavourful, it’s an absolute MUST TRY! The mixed mushroom truffle was equally incredible, rich and earthy in all the right ways. I wish I could try their entire menu because every single thing I ordered was so tasty and spot-on. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Saba Khurrum

restaurants.name: Sushi Kōge
restaurants.address:

อาคารวานิช วิลเลจ เลขที่ 304/2 อาคารซี ชั้น B ยูนิต B02 Phahonyothin Rd, สามเสนใน Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400

sample_reviews_th.text:
🇯🇵Following reviews from food bloggers, I went to Sushi Koge for their Omakase Sushi. Their lunch course starts at only ฿1,900++, which is a great price. However, since I went in the evening, I opted for the premium course instead.

It lived up to its name with premium ingredients. The fish was fresh and the flavors were excellent. The selection changes daily. I loved many pieces this time, especially the scallop topped with fish liver – it was truly amazing. Their sesame tofu was also delicious, and the ankimo (moss) was expertly prepared.

This is another Omakase sushi restaurant that impressed me and I'd love to return to. Highly recommend it for Omakase lovers! Don't forget to screenshot this post and send it to the restaurant when booking via LINE: @sushikoge. The restaurant has a ฿500 voucher for you! 😍

P.S. The restaurant is located on the B floor of Vanit Village building. Convenient parking is available.

฿4,000++ Premium Course

📍@sushi.koge - Ari
#orn_bellyjourney #orn_omakase #orn_japanese #orn_sushikoge #omakase #sushi
sample_reviews_th.author: Orn Bellyjourney

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’m usually not a big fan of omakase. The pace can feel slow with each bite served one by one and I’m not really into raw fish as it can sometimes have a strong fishy taste. But this place was recommended by my older sister, and it turned out to be truly worth it 🤩

🧑‍🍳 The chef was very kind and attentive, taking the time to explain each dish in detail, especially since I had quite a few questions. You can tell everything is prepared with care, and they’re flexible too. If you prefer less rice or have certain preferences, you can easily let them know.

🍣 The omakase course overall was very enjoyable. The fish was fresh, clean-tasting, and not fishy at all. If you’re not a big fan of certain ingredients, the chef is happy to adjust (my uncle isn’t a big fan of fish, and they accommodated him well).

✨ The restaurant is quite small, serving around 10 guests per seating, which creates a cozy and intimate atmosphere. It’s perfect for a small group or family gathering.

Overall, it’s worth the price, great vibe, nice atmosphere, and very delicious. Definitely worth the calories! 😊💖
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasinee Thongperm

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is definitely one of the best omakase experiences of the season! I tried the Premium Kappou Omakase at Sushi Koge and was impressed from the first bite to the end of the course.

The restaurant is located on the B floor of Vanit Village. It's quite private, with a calm atmosphere and beautiful, clean, and comfortable decor. It was very relaxing to dine there.

The ingredients are truly premium, incredibly fresh, and of the highest quality in every piece. It felt like I was dining in Japan. The chef explained each dish in detail, and I especially loved how he described which part of the fish each piece came from, making the dining experience more enjoyable and immersive.

Each piece was a good size, truly filling. The entire course was incredibly satisfying, both in terms of taste and the overall experience. For those who regularly enjoy omakase, I personally think this restaurant is in my top rank of favorite omakase places.

You don't need to fly all the way to Japan to experience this level of quality; you can find it right here. Highly recommended! 💯🍣
sample_reviews_en.author: Dainty biscuit

sample_reviews_en.text:
🌟I was absolutely thrilled with the omakase course at this restaurant! Sushi Koge is an Edo-style omakase restaurant hidden away in the Vanit Village project in the Ari area. The restaurant's atmosphere is decorated with a Japanese feel that's slightly glamorous.
.
📣The omakase course here has 4 main courses as follows:
✨Koge 17 course: 2,800++
✨Nigiri 20 course: 3,500++
✨Premium 21 course: 4,000++
✨Special 22 course: 6,000++
.
🍣The course we tried today was the Premium 21 Course (4,000++). It truly lives up to its name; the ingredients are imported seasonal from Japan, making every piece incredibly fresh and delicious.
.
There are 4 seating times to choose from: 12:00 PM, 1:45 PM, 6:00 PM, and 7:45 PM. It's recommended to call and make a reservation beforehand!
sample_reviews_en.author: kinjubkinjib

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍣✨ Discover a hidden gem in Ari with an Edomae-style omakase that seamlessly blends glamour with tradition.

This isn't just any ordinary omakase restaurant; it's like being transported to Japan the moment you step into Vanit Village. The restaurant's Zen-style ambiance is elegant and sophisticated, offering a warm and exclusive atmosphere—perfect for a special meal.

This is the first omakase in Thailand to use Kuro Shari, or black sushi rice, imported from Ibaraki. This helps to bring out the delicious flavor of the fish even more. 🖤🍣

📍 Sushi Koge | Vanit Village Aree
💰 Kappou Premium 4,000++ / 18 Course
🍤 Tuesday - Sunday
🕰️ 12:00 | 13:45 | 18:00 | 19:45

#callmebacon #SushiKoge
#OmakaseBKK #OmakaseReview #CallMeBacon
sample_reviews_en.author: CALLMEBACON

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really good omakase experience! The fish is fresh and prepared with master-level precision. Every bite was an experience. There was a decent variety of served courses and even the things that weren’t exactly our cup of tea were done well and interesting enough to try.

The setting is small and cozy; the sushi chefs are very nice and make you feel super welcome. They didn’t speak much English but made an effort to explain the dishes served by pulling up a picturebook with different types of fish. Adorable.

We had a 17-course menu and next time, we’d gladly do a bigger one!
sample_reviews_en.author: Przemek Stolarski

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ll be very honest, I paid for the most expensive option there is which is 4000 baht menu. In terms of pricing, I did not think it was better than the 3000 baht option. Lack of creativity, a repeat of the same ingredient occurred 2 times. Which is the abalone, abalone steamed egg, abalone with rice.  We had a an extra steamed egg? Abalone and scallop? Was not filling at the end. Would like to also note the soup was full of sand. Like my mouth was full of sand as seen in the photo. In all the price is not worth it if u select 4000 baht , I’d just go for the cheapest one.
sample_reviews_en.author: YU HUI HE

sample_reviews_en.text:
An Edomae-style omakase restaurant in the Ari area. This premium omakase restaurant offers authentic Edomae-style cuisine, using fresh, seasonal ingredients imported from Japan. Expert chefs pay attention to every detail, all within a sophisticated and private ambiance. Every dish is meticulously crafted, accompanied by high-end service at a very reasonable price. We booked through the Hungry Hub app.
The restaurant is located on the B Floor, Vanit Village, near BTS Ari Exit 2.
🚘: Parking is available in the building.
🚝: BTS Ari, Exit 2.

sample_reviews_en.text: We got disappointed especially about two dishes.  The shrimps on rice is really like the shrimps been from the Flintstone as it's so hard and really Rocky.  And same from the baby squid, the squid is another thing which could be from the Ice Age, as it's so hard, think the cook could not save the squid until it's been swimming in hot oil for few rounds until it's like ROCKs too.  The lobster is the only dish that I think it's fresh, though not really fantastic, at least it's fresh n cooked with normal standard.  Those who don't mind about the standard of food, may go, otherwise, pls don't waste time there unless you were Fred or Barney.

sample_reviews_en.text: Lobster City's peeled shrimp rice bowl 😋 on Banthat Thong 🦞 TikTok fans, you HAVE to try this peeled shrimp rice bowl on Banthat Thong! For other dishes like Tom Yam Goong and stir fried scallops with garlic we don’t like the tastes, they are a bit mild and sweet. However, prices are reasonable🙂
sample_reviews_en.author: Pine P

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here. The restaurant is clean, the staff are lovely and provide good service. The food is delicious and the prices are reasonable. I'll definitely come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gummi J

sample_reviews_en.text: At the shop, we currently accept donations through the "Thai Help Thai" program. If you come by car, we recommend parking at the '100th Anniversary Park'.

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is nice, and the food is reasonably priced, ranging from 140 baht per dish to 300+ baht for larger portions – good value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: พนิตา ก่อศิริโชค

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, flavorful, and suits my taste. The ingredients are fresh. The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, is clean, and comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pohnnapha Phumkhokrak

sample_reviews_en.text: I've wanted to try this for a long time, and finally got to. The peeled shrimp rice lived up to the hype. The price was reasonable. Excellent!

restaurants.name: TAIBAN (ใต้บ้าน)
restaurants.address:

476/5 Rama IV Rd, Rong Mueang, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: A hidden eatery and cafe near Hua Lamphong MRT station (exit 3), when out from the station, turn sharp right and enter the small soi (you would not notice that there is a small alley on your right hand-side), then walk around 1 minute until you see a grey hip-looking building on your right-hand side. The eatery is located inside Tamni hostel. They serve varieties of casual dishes like northern curry rice vermicelli noodle with pork blood aka ขนมจีนน้ำเงี้ยว, Beef Kraprao, crispy pork Krapao.. The food tasted good. However if you want to try their coffee, make sure you visit on the weekend since their specialty coffee is served on the weekend (their teen barista   is taking an on-line class on weekdays and may not be at the cafe).
sample_reviews_th.author: Pia Suwannalert

sample_reviews_en.text:
Taiban Cafe is a cozy spot with a warm, welcoming atmosphere. The name “Taiban” translates to “underground of the house” in Thai, giving the place a unique vibe. There’s a hostel upstairs, so you’ll often find a mix of locals and international travelers.

The cafe offers a variety of coffee beans to choose from. I tried their iced latte with the house blend, which was decent for the 90 THB price point. I also ordered the full breakfast set, which was made with high-quality, nutritious ingredients, but I found the 220 THB price to be a bit on the higher side.

One interesting feature of the cafe is that it hosts painting and handmade jewelry-making activities. However, these are held in the yard outside, so it can get quite hot.

To get to Taiban Cafe, take the MRT to Hua Lumphong station. Use Exit 3 and, as soon as you’re outside, you’ll see a set of stairs on your right. Go down those stairs, follow the small road for about three minutes, and you’ll find the cafe on your right.
sample_reviews_en.author: Intera Phongsawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Taiban Café is a charming, art-infused sanctuary tucked just a short walk from MRT Hua Lamphong Exit 3, in the Pathum Wan district at 476/5 Rama IV Road . This cozy café masterfully blends homey comfort with creative flair: think warm lighting, greenery, and a rustic loft aesthetic that instantly puts you at ease  .

While the café serves a well-rounded menu, ranging from homemade Thai-inspired brunch dishes like stir‑fried basil to baked goods and strong, flavorful drip coffee, its standout appeal lies in hands‑on art: you can grab a canvas (≈200–400 THB depending on size) and paint to your heart’s content. All tools, easels, brushes, paint, are provided at no extra cost.

Reviews consistently praise the warm atmosphere and attentive service.

If you're seeking a creative escape in the city, whether to relax solo, date, or hang with friends, Taiban Café delivers with style and soul. Just note: on weekends it fills up quickly, so arriving early is wise.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andre

sample_reviews_en.text:
TAIBAN (TAIBANBKK): Coffee, Co-working & Canvas Painting
TAIBAN is more than just a typical cafe; it’s a cozy, vibrant creative space hidden near Hua Lamphong. With its lush greenery and laid-back backyard vibes, it feels less like a commercial coffee shop and more like chilling at a creative friend's house.
The Highlight: The ultimate draw here is their canvas painting activity. They provide all the art supplies (canvases, paints, brushes), allowing you to sip on a latte while unleashing your inner artist. It’s the perfect spot for a therapeutic solo day, a hangout with friends, or a cute date.
Food & Drinks: They serve a solid selection of coffees, refreshing non-caffeine drinks, and simple, delicious single-dish meals—all at very reasonable prices.
Getting There: Super accessible. Just take the MRT to Hua Lamphong Station (Exit 3), and it's just a short walk into the alley.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirun Boonpasuk

sample_reviews_en.text:
What I liked most was the atmosphere both inside and outside the restaurant. I loved the decor, the music was great, and the staff were very helpful and gave good recommendations. There are plenty of outdoor tables, and it's easy to get to, right near the MRT station.

The day I went, it rained heavily, and the restaurant kindly gave me an umbrella to use for free, without requiring me to return it. Otherwise, I would have had to wait a long time to leave.

However, I have a suggestion regarding the staff. On the day I went, there were no signs or markers to identify who the staff were, and they were dressed like customers. This made it difficult to distinguish between staff and customers when asking for information. It seemed like many other people also had difficulty finding the staff. I think there should be clearer signs or markers to identify them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Helena Zelenia

sample_reviews_en.text:
The drinks were decent, although I didn’t get a chance to try the food.

The atmosphere is pleasant and green, though it was quite crowded. The location is convenient if you’re taking the MRT, but if you’re driving, the parking is quite a walk away.

Unfortunately, the biggest issue was the communication and attitude of the front-counter staff. I ordered one thing, but received something different. When I pointed this out and asked them to correct it, the staff member’s facial expression very clearly showed her frustration. In the end, the “corrected” order was handled rather carelessly and wasn’t remade as the staff who took my order had promised.

In particular, the tan skin female staff member with long, wavy hair may want to reconsider whether that kind of facial expression and attitude is welcoming customers—or telling them to leave.
sample_reviews_en.author: Full time cat mom

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stumbled upon this place by chance while searching for a unique experience, and I had a more satisfying time than I expected.

The staff were incredibly friendly, and the painting space was spacious and pleasant, allowing me to focus solely on my artwork in a comfortable atmosphere. Even though I visited alone, I didn't feel awkward at all and finished my painting without even realizing how much time had passed.

I also liked that the smallest canvas starts at just 300 baht, making it easy to try out without feeling pressured.

Even if you aren't good at drawing, you don't need to worry. If you watch a quick video on YouTube of a picture you want to draw or a drawing tutorial before visiting, it will make the experience much easier.

A tip for Korean visitors! Korean QR code payments cannot be used, so please make sure to bring cash.
sample_reviews_en.author: hae tak park

sample_reviews_en.text: I recently visited a cozy café located right under my house, and it quickly became one of my favorite spots to relax. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, with soft lighting and comfortable seating that makes it perfect for both working and unwinding. The aroma of freshly brewed coffee fills the space, creating a calming and pleasant environment. The drinks are well crafted, especially the iced latte, which has a smooth and rich flavor without being too strong. The desserts are also delicious, with just the right level of sweetness. What I love most is the convenience of having such a great café so close by. The staff are friendly and attentive, always greeting customers with a smile. Overall, this café offers a wonderful experience in terms of both taste and ambiance, and it is definitely a place worth visiting again and again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chotiwit Naulchey

restaurants.address:

56 1 Thong Lo 5 Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the worst dining experiences I’ve had.

After being seated, no one came to take our order for over 15 minutes. When a staff member finally arrived, we asked for the drinks menu, but our request was ignored. We had to ask again another 15 minutes later before receiving it.

When ordering, we asked whether one of the dishes could be prepared without meat. The staff member told us to “wait a moment” and then disappeared. We followed up after another 15 minutes, and she again said, “Just a moment,” but never returned.

The service was extremely slow, unprofessional, and inattentive throughout our visit. Considering the high prices, the level of service was completely unacceptable. I would not recommend this restaurant unless they significantly improve their customer service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chandler

sample_reviews_en.text: I thought it was an Ok Sushi place, given I do have japanese food a lot in Japan and HongKong, not overwhelmed with the 4.4 points review,  It wasn't bad but wasn't amazing wither, I would deduct 1 star off the food quality, and 1 star off the service.  Served by 2 confused email waiter, slow and unresponsive,  the sushi came after 5 minutes of order but the Ice Green tea came after 10 minutes.... and the 2nd Maki waited 15 minutes- Came during Sunday Lunch time Not busy situation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Edward K

sample_reviews_en.text:
Andaman Thonglor is a kind of restaurant hidden in Soi 5 or Thonglor street. They offer various kinds of foods. But the day I & my family went there was to enjoy a cheese fondue. We ordered mainly beef which is very tender and after boiled in hot melted cheese it becomes so delicious.
Price is medium to high.
They are also famous on Japanese cuisine like Shabu Shabu
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaroonphan Lim

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of those restaurants in BKK that you don't see many tourists. Been there twice recently. There is always local family and friends gatherings. There is a sense of homeliness in this place.

Food is fantastic and surprisingly reasonably priced too.

We ordered mixture of western and sushi. My guests love the food and enjoyed the ambience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jovey Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Must say that the good thing about this place is that apart from Andaman itself, you can also order food from Sushi Masa and Suki Masa.

Each person can enjoy food from different cuisine from western, sushi, to sukiyaki! The price is reasonable, approx 700-1000 thb per person.

The atmosphere is good. The vallet parking is available.

sample_reviews_en.text: If you wish you have the fondue, sit on the otherside of the teataurant that have hotplate. You still can order from the japanese restaurant. Basically both the restaurant share the same menu and can cross order/ deliver. Good food, on the pricier side though. The service is great and there are ramps for wheelchair

A fusion restaurant with varieties of western and asian foods.
Sushi is good.
Very low on parking spots.
This place is mostly crowded so the service is quite slow and sometimes not covered all area.
Ps. Do check popular hour before coming for a better service and good chance on a parking spots.

sample_reviews_en.text: My favourite restaurant in Bangkok! The food is amazing, and the staff is the friendliest you can find in Thailand. You can order food from 3 different cuisines, and one is better than the other one. We always be back every time we visit Bangkok. 💯 Recommended

restaurants.name: Mee Dee Pochana 米弟酒楼
restaurants.address:

47 Chulalongkorn 3 Alley, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Highly recommend this shop for tasty fair priced chinese/thai meal."

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ate here last year and thought it was pretty good. Because there was a huge queue of mainland Chinese people lining up to eat at the Mama's Noodles across the street, I chose this place again this year. The second floor has air conditioning; I don't understand those people who queue up in this sweltering heat to eat hot Mama's Noodles outdoors. I can only admire them.

I wasn't very hungry, so I ordered a mixed Mama's Noodles, a shrimp and vermicelli casserole, and a crab omelet. Last year, I thought the Mama's Noodles were amazing, but this year they weren't as good. The Tom Yum soup base was still very flavorful, but the Mama's Noodles weren't cooked long enough and were quite hard, and the ingredients weren't as good as last year. The vermicelli casserole was good, and the crab omelet was okay. Overall, this time it was just average; not worth making a special trip for.
sample_reviews_en.author: lena lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
I want to review this restaurant. Thai people, please come eat here!
When I sat down, there were only Chinese people.
But the taste was okay, everything was delicious!
The ingredients were good too, and the prices weren't too high.
It was nice and cool sitting in the air-conditioned room on the second floor.
However, we did have to ask for our food a few times.
The Tom Yum soup came very quickly, followed by the stir-fried vegetables, and then we had to ask for the salted egg squid twice. It was so delicious, and I wanted extra rice, but we had to ask for it twice too. But I guess it's because there were so many people, I understand. 🥹😋😍

I will definitely come back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ingfah chirarat

sample_reviews_en.text:
As a long-time Samyan resident the transformation of nearby Banthatthong Road, and side roads, from old shophouses to Bangkok’s latest street food Mecca, has been incredible.

Sitting outside Mee Dee at 7pm on Sunday surrounded by many locals and tourists was an eye-opener. The beautifully renovated Mee Dee restaurant deserves its reputation as a “go-to” Khao Tom eatery and the food we enjoyed - braised chicken, stir-fried kale, and roast pork, and their signature crispy, salt and pepper tofu was excellent. A bit pricier than our beloved Dee Mee in Ban Mo but Mee Dee offers a spectacular people-watching experience that is worth the extra baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Meng Yee

sample_reviews_en.text: What a fun night and an awesome place to have dinner.  Stir Fried salted egg and squid, OMG one taste and I thought to myself that is why Bangkok has some of the best food in the world!!! Red chili oil looks spicey but it wasn’t . The texture of the salt egg gave the dish a smooth rich texture I couldn’t describe except I know it’s from that broken down salt egg that dissolved into the sauce. And it wasn’t spicey at all.   The squid was cooked perfectly.  The garlic Shrimp was so flavorful, the shrimp was a bit overcooked, though.  The clear seafood tom Yom soup was spicy and very delicious!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Shinji Inaba

sample_reviews_en.text: I just wandered into this restaurant by chance, and it turned out to be surprisingly delicious. I highly recommend this place to Thai people; there were way too many Chinese tourists. I took this picture after I'd finished eating – I ate too fast and didn't get a chance to photograph the food when it arrived, I was so hungry! 5555 Everything was great: the food, the atmosphere, the staff were lovely and provided excellent service. They accommodated all my requests. The price was reasonable and acceptable. I'll definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prapassorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Review for Mee Dee, Bangkok
​Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐
​If you want to experience the heart and soul of the night market, this is the spot! Located right at the main intersection, the atmosphere is full of life, happy conversations, and that classic market buzz.
​The food definitely lived up to the vibe. My wife had the tofu soup and I went with the crispy pork; both meals were well cooked, flavorful, and served in  decent portions.
Highly recommend for great food and a quintessential Bangkok experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Haycock

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is really excellent. I would like to call it the best dining place I have visited during my trip to Thailand! All the dishes are freshly prepared upon order and they are all very delicious. The overall atmosphere of the restaurant is also very nice. There are a continuous stream of people dining there. If you are afraid of the heat, you can go to the second floor. The second floor has air conditioning, which can make the entire dining experience cooler.
sample_reviews_en.author: L Z

sample_reviews_en.text:
Incredible sit down street food. Great service. Everything arrived quickly. The quality and consistency was very high. Excellent prices. Really clean. Best tom yum soup I've ever had. Essential if you only have time for one meal in the area.
What I ordered: fried tofu with salt and pepper, Tom yum without coconut milk with seafood, kra prao prawns, stir fried morning glory. Chrysanthemum tea and Singha beer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay M

sample_reviews_en.text:
Terrible experience. Didn't get what we ordered at first (although clearly referring the menu for clarity), then only got one of the dishes... Once we finally got our meals, my Tikka Masala was ONLY bones, no chicken at all.
I tried signalling it to the chef, who nonchalantly didn't want to hear a word of it, he only said that that's the way Tikka is. I don't mind a couple of bones, but not only a bowl of bones. I ordered a "chicken" Masala after all...

sample_reviews_en.text: Hands down the best Indian food in Pattaya. The service is excellent and they take special care to cook food the way we want if necessary. The staff are polite and welcoming. I would recommend this place to anyone who wants to have the best Indian food in Pattaya.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is very good and served on time. We did not miss Indian food because it was very close to the place we stayed . When I visited I had Chinese who were enjoying the food along with us. It was a pleasant experience visiting the hotel. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Jyothi Ml

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're looking for a great Indian restaurant in south pattaya area, this is an excellent option. The restaurant is quite spacious and offers both Thali and Ala Carte options. The staff is attentive, and the restaurant is very clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shankar Meganatha

sample_reviews_en.text: I am English, this was as good as the Indian restaurants in England,  if not better. I love Lamb Buhna, they gave a mutton Dish ,that was so Delicious not too hot 🔥 or not too spicy, just brilliant.  Thank you .Boz

sample_reviews_en.text: Mutton biriyani is delicious. Very tasty and Low price .  Quantity also high.  I visited with my wife Bharatia restaurant.  My wife also very hapy with staff service and staff are very friendly nature.
