sample_reviews_en.text: Raagi mudde was really yummy one of the best restaurant in Thailand for Indians who love raagi mudde lacated near golden sea hotel pattaya ..very satisfied with their hospitality and yummy food
sample_reviews_en.author: Dhanu Kumar

sample_reviews_en.text: Good place to have Indian food...truely enjoyed while in another country...this place serves good authentic Indian dishes. I think ppl going to Thailand should try this restaurant .
sample_reviews_en.author: Neelaveni Ragu R

restaurants.name: Beastie
restaurants.address:

149 Rimtangrodfai-sai Paet-Riu Rd, Bang Kapi, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Beastie Bangkok exceeded my expectations! The atmosphere is cozy yet elegant, and the service is top-notch. Every dish we tried was cooked to perfection and packed with flavor.

I highly recommend starting with the Carpaccio or the Grilled Sendai Cut Tongue for a flavorful appetizer. For mains, the AUS Wagyu Picanha was incredibly tender and juicy, while the Grilled Wagyu Short-Ribs with Chinatown Rice Pot was a standout with its rich, smoky flavor. Don’t miss the Pommes Dauphine (มันฝรั่ง) on the side – a perfect complement to the meats.

For dessert, the Chocolate Lava was decadent and perfectly balanced. A must-visit for meat lovers and food enthusiasts. I’ll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_th.author: Boon Thanatsedh

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was a restaurant I discovered by chance.
The atmosphere is fantastic, with well-proportioned decor. There aren't too few tables, and it's not cramped at all; you can sit comfortably without feeling pressured.

The staff are cheerful and helpful, offering excellent recommendations for both food and wine.

The grilled sendai cut tongue was amazing. The beef tongue was incredibly tender, sweet, and flavorful, served with pickles that complemented it perfectly without overpowering the taste of the tongue.

The carpaccio, thinly sliced ​​raw beef, was served with rocket salad and various pickles, a great way to cut through the richness.

The dry-aged striploin was served on a hot plate. It remained incredibly tender even as it started to cook – 100/10!

The apple crumble, served with vanilla ice cream, exceeded my expectations. I didn't think it would be this delicious. Many restaurants have very sweet apple crumbles, but here the apples had a distinct tartness that perfectly balanced the sweetness of the vanilla ice cream.

Overall, I was very impressed and will definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kulrada Kiatkulthorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stumbled across this restaurant on someone’s Instagram post of their top 3 favorite restaurants in Bangkok…
This has immediately catapulted to my Top 2 restaurants in BKK… the Vibe/Ambience is incredible (just wish I brought a date)… salad was sooo amazing to get my taste buds ready for an eclectic mouth watering experience!!! Have to mention the Squares Potatoes that were crisp on outide and soo tender in the middle (I used them to soak up the butter/dripping from my steak)… OK the Steak!! I ordered the dry-aged 200oz Tenderloin… I think the best ‘Char’ I’ve ever had!! I ordered the ‘inside’ Medium Rare+
It was the perfect pink and juicy!! Perfect Size for 1!! I saved room for the Apple Crumble ala Mode… perfect ending to an out of the body experience!! Too bad I was solo on this visit…otherwise my dates neck would have been an after dinner target!!  This Place is a 10/10!! And the attention/service was Ritz-Carlton like!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Don Russ

sample_reviews_en.text:
We enjoyed a truly wonderful dinner here. The food is fantastic👌🏻Beef steak is a must-try, cooked to perfection and full of flavor. However, it was our server, Lora, who made our experience truly memorable.

Her service was top-class. To help us decide, she presented an iPad with photos and took the time to introduce every dish. She gave us brilliant advice on selecting our beef and the best sauces to pair with it, enhancing every bite.

The entire meal, from the bread to the dessert, was seamless thanks to her attentiveness. And speaking of dessert, the chocolate lava cake was a stunning surprise and the best I've had in Thailand.

This restaurant delivers incredible value for such high-quality food and outstanding, personalized service. We will definitely be returning and highly recommend you ask for Lora to make your visit extra special🤫
sample_reviews_en.author: TT Tam

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honestly, I don’t understand the hype. The ambiance is really nice and cosy, and the restaurant itself has a great atmosphere.

But the steak was overpriced for what we got — dry-aged, but unfortunately quite dry and not tender at all.

I’ve seen a lot of reviews saying the steak here is amazing, but honestly, I have to disagree. Maybe we just have very different standards when it comes to steak, because I’ve had much better steaks in Bangkok for the same price.

At the same price elsewhere, you can get proper Wagyu beef that is significantly more tender and enjoyable.

For me, the ambiance is a 9/10, but the steak definitely wasn’t worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lou

sample_reviews_en.text: I just had the chance to dine here today. It's a shame I didn't get to meet the chef, but I can honestly say I was impressed with everything. The food was superb; you can tell they pay attention to every detail. The manager or staff member (I'm not sure which) was incredibly polite and provided excellent service. They even offered a complimentary cake for my visit – it was so heartwarming! Today I ordered beef tongue, dry-aged beef, lamb, and some kind of corn starter + starter bread, and finished with cheesecake. We ate so much, we were practically bursting! 😂 Every dish was delicious, 10/10, no complaints at all. I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom

sample_reviews_en.text: Beastie is a paradise for meat lovers! Every dish is expertly designed by an Iron Chef, showcasing high-quality ingredients and incredible flavors. From the first bite to the last, you can taste the dedication to perfection.The ambience is just as remarkable—beautiful, intimate, and private, making it an ideal spot for a special occassion. If you’re looking for a standout dish, I highly recommend the Grilled Sendai Tongue and Grilled Tenderloin—both are unbelievably soft, juicy, and packed with flavors.This place is a must-visit for anyone who appreciates top-tier steak and an exceptional dining experience. Can’t wait to return!
sample_reviews_en.author: Joy T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
good steakhouse, exceptional service and attention, very well cooked dishes but it didn't blow my mind. If you like a very technically amazing steak and potatoes this is the place. If you're looking for innovation this might not be it.

Chocolate lava cake for desert was a highlight. House made and very rich. Ox tongue was super tender.

The space is a little small but well decorated, though it feels set in a temporary building? The building itself isn't impressive, but the decor and design makes up for it.

It's also a bit hard to find from the parking lot! The entrance could use more signage.
sample_reviews_en.author: Salisa Jatuweerapong

restaurants.name: Bar-B-Q Plaza
restaurants.address:

ชั้น 3 3522 Lat Phrao Rd, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
For those who love Korean BBQ but prefer to eat in an air-conditioned environment, this brand is definitely a must-consider! 🐷

This brand offers good value, high-quality ingredients, excellent service, and their highlight is their legendary BBQ sauce. It has a unique flavor, a subtle nutty aroma, and is seasoned with fresh chili, garlic, and lime. It's incredibly delicious drizzled over rice. The smoke extraction system is efficient, preventing lingering smoke. Combined with the unlimited shredded cabbage, this is truly a fantastic meal! ⭐️⭐️⭐️

They frequently have promotions; those who come during their value set periods can save up to 50%! The queuing system is efficient, ensuring short wait times. Leftovers can be taken home, and the restaurant packs everything exceptionally well – chili, garlic, lime, dipping sauce, and soup base are all included (a pleasant surprise I encountered this the first time!). The branches are clean, there are plenty of staff, and service is fast. They accept credit cards.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arinta

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the chance to eat here in late March. They had a great buffet promotion, with a 50% discount for senior citizens. The restaurant has moved to the upper floor, on the same floor as the cinema, I think it's the 3rd floor. The food came out quickly, and the staff provided good service, but the grill wasn't very hot, so the pork took a long time to cook. Luckily, we mainly ate seafood, so we just boiled some. If we had waited to grill, it would have taken much longer. Oh, and at this branch, if you come for the buffet, don't be impulsive and order too much unless you're a big eater. And definitely, don't order the squid! I'm warning you! Hahaha. Don't believe me? Try it yourself. I'll tell you, it's a disaster, especially the cuttlefish.
sample_reviews_en.author: แบงค์ ตัวกลม

sample_reviews_en.text: I really like this branch. Normally, if I want to eat Barbeque, especially during buffet hours, I won't go to the crowded branches. But the The Mall Bangkapi branch manages everything so well, from the queues to the food service. Orders come very quickly. The food is also high quality. Some branches, when you go for the buffet, the meat is often broken or falls apart when you pick it up, but here everything is perfect. Another thing I like is the cashier – I can't remember her name, but I always see her. She's very polite and always gives great advice on the points system and payment methods. All these things combine to make me always come back to this branch whenever I want Barbeque, even when it's busy.
sample_reviews_en.author: fhabulous x

sample_reviews_en.text:
I forgot to take pictures!

The restaurant is now on the same floor as the movie theater.

I had the birthday set today.
I was very impressed ♥️

They currently have a buffet promotion, but they also accept à la carte orders. The staff were very attentive and always smiling. They were very helpful and lovely.

Regarding the refillable drinks, you have to inform the staff.
I felt a little hesitant because I drink a lot.
I wish there was a staff member dedicated to managing the drink refills.

But overall, it was great! Keep up the good work, this branch! ✨✨✨✨✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Sinita milk

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is generally standard. There was a promotion for 999 baht when I visited, which was great value – better than buying coupons on the app. You could choose 14 items. Ordering individually would cost over 2000 baht. This branch is not hot when you sit inside, and the staff provides quick service. I recommend the crispy pork salad; it's delicious. You can pay with a credit card without any extra charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Guitar.

sample_reviews_en.text: I went for the buffet. The food was okay, but the male staff weren't very pleasant.🥹 When I asked for a refill of my water, no staff member looked at me. They didn't hear me when I called them. When I finally called them again, they made a grumpy face and refilled it half-heartedly. When I asked for another refill, the same staff member still had a sour expression. It ruined my meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: fah muangmanee

sample_reviews_en.text: The buffet was good, service was fast, but the only issue was the garlic fried rice. No matter how many times I ordered it, it never arrived, and I was too lazy to keep asking. Then it finally came just as I was about to pay the bill, so I had to cancel the order. That was the only problem; everything else arrived quickly and completely. It's a minor issue, so it's not a big deal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bee Corse

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating at this branch after The Mall Bangkapi closed for renovations. The restaurant is much nicer than before, cleaner, and the service is excellent – ​​a perfect 10 out of 10! The service was outstanding at this branch, including the manager who was lovely and provided great service. They took good care of all the customers. I was very impressed!
sample_reviews_en.author: watchara watchara

restaurants.name: PengYou Cuisine & Specialty Bar @Ekamai
restaurants.address:

ห้องเลขที่ 105, 7/1 Soi Sukhumvit 63, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I can't say for sure, but this place is simply fabulous! Every dish is a treat for the taste buds! You can't beat the value either—only 690++฿ for two people! It's a fantastic deal!
sample_reviews_th.author: Melody Sri.

sample_reviews_en.text:
From the moment the dishes were presented, it was clear that great attention had been given to both aesthetics and detail. Each plate was not only beautifully curated but also served with an impressive sense of grandeur, elevating the entire dining experience.

The flavors were equally remarkable—refined, well-balanced, and thoughtfully executed. In particular, the steamed rice rolls with shrimp stood out as a personal favorite. The texture was delicate and silky, complemented perfectly by the freshness and sweetness of the shrimp.

Overall, PengYou offers a harmonious blend of contemporary presentation and authentic flavors, making it a truly memorable and refined dining destination. Highly recommended for those seeking an elevated Chinese culinary experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suparak Toomkosita

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food was decent, the main course and soup that you can only order one of has a pretty small portion size, and it all came out very slowly. Took approximately 1.5 hours for my party of 7’s main course to be delivered. Not to mention the dimsum that only came out after the 1.5 hour mark. Although the staff was apologetic, it doesn’t account for the fact that the food took way too long to come out, and it wasn’t even that good, definitely not worth the wait time.

Atmosphere was decent, but the entire vibe was thrown off due to the very slow service.

the picture shows my order of shrimp wontons(?), it was the last to come and had 3 pieces of wontons. the bowl was also barely larger than a fist.
sample_reviews_en.author: sydney

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ingredients are good and food is prepared with heart. The signature Shu Mai with black roe on top is nice. The signature abalone har gao is not as good as expected. The black har gao skin is a bit too soft and watery. The roasted pork dice is a bit too tough. However, the presentation of each dish is wonderful.

We were the only table in the restaurant. However, service standards are not there. Staff is inactive to offer help to customers. For example, refilling the hot tea. Every time need to call out to request for tea refill. I would prefer leaving the tea pot on my table and I pour the tea myself.

With this process settings, the service provided is way below expectations.
sample_reviews_en.author: J Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had lunch there today and food overall was very good yet most of the dishes on the menu are stirfried in oil with the exception of a few dishes.  I wanted non oily food and ordered the steamed tofu which was very good. I asked the lady server for steam vegetable but she answered we only served stirfied. How difficult is it for a Chinese restaurant to steam vegetable ? So easy but answer was no !!!

Also most Chinese restaurants have many  vegetarian options but PengYou does not.  The restaurant is good, nice but if you need healthy options, oil free options, vegetarian or vegan options best go to other Chinese restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: perusset pierre

sample_reviews_en.text:
Photo-worthy Chinese food with solid flavors, but better for drinks.

The roast platter and fried silver fish were the highlights, and the fried prune dessert was quite good. I’ve visited this branch and their main one, and I prefer the ambience at the main branch.

However, there’s some inconsistency in the food—like varying levels of crispiness—between visits. While the dishes are tasty, they’re not life-changing.

I wouldn’t come here just for the food, but it’s worth a visit for the drinks and the overall atmosphere. A good spot if you’re looking for a visually appealing experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Arisa Chuklin

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere, good service, and the food comes out quickly. Almost everything on the menu is delicious. I recommend the crispy pork belly – the skin is crispy, not hard, and not greasy. The char siu pork is thickly sliced, tender, easy to eat, and has a sweet honey flavor. The steamed sea bass with lemon is delicious and not too spicy. The fried items are excellent; not greasy, perfectly fried, crispy, and fragrant – you can eat them continuously without changing your mind. I highly recommend the pumpkin lava bun – it's incredibly good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pai Young Channel

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really enjoyed our dinner at PengYou. We went for the Peking duck and it was excellent, crispy skin, tender meat, and nicely presented. Everything tasted fresh and well prepared.

The menu had so many tempting options that we ended up ordering way too much, but honestly no complaints. The add-on dishes were all solid and full of flavour.

The space feels nice without being overly formal, and service was friendly and smooth throughout the meal.

Would happily come back (just maybe with a bit more self-control next time).
sample_reviews_en.author: Theo den Brinker

restaurants.name: Signature 15
restaurants.address:

No.49/26, Soi Petchburi 15, Phetchaburi Rd, Subdistrict, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had the pleasure of dining at this hidden gem recently 6 of us, and it was an experience we won't soon forget. Came back 5 times to be exact The shrimp fried rice was perfectly cooked, with plump, juicy shrimp and a wonderful blend of flavors that left us craving more. The pad thai was equally impressive, with just the right balance of sweet, savory, and tangy notes that danced on our taste buds.

What truly elevated our dining experience, however, was the exceptional service. The waiters were not only attentive but also incredibly enthusiastic, making us feel like valued guests from the moment we walked in. Their attentiveness ensured that our glasses were always full and our needs were promptly attended to, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere that made us feel right at home.

Overall, dining here was a delightful experience, thanks to the delicious food and the outstanding service. We left feeling incredibly happy and satisfied, alread looking forward to our next visit. Oh yeah aircon and wifi was a big bonus.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jacob Low

sample_reviews_en.text:
Last year, I had a meal here and it was delicious—especially the sticky rice, which was perfectly soft and fragrant.

However, this year when I came back, the coconut sauce had a slightly sour, musty smell—like it had been kept in a fridge that wasn’t cold enough. This wasn’t the first time I noticed this.

In my opinion, the ingredients should be checked more carefully. Also, when I visited, some of the AC units weren’t working—not a big problem since it wasn’t crowded, but there was a bit of an unpleasant smell in the air.

That said, I’ll still come back and try again when I visit Bangkok, because I’ve had the sticky rice here twice before and it was incredibly good—soft, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. The other dishes were also tasty.

One or two bad experiences can still be tolerated, especially since the service is always excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: kristiyanti Liephing

sample_reviews_en.text:
While on my stroll through the night market in the neighborhood, decided yo try this cozy looking restaurant.

I ordered the pea pods with shrimp 🍤. I also tried to order a Thai iced tea but the waitress informed they were all out of it. Ok ….

Then asked where the restrooms were located and she said it was out of order. I know in US/Canada, if a restaurant bathroom is out of order, you’re not allowed to operate for health reasons. Not sure what and if Thailand has the same health regulations. Thus my low score on atmosphere.
Nonetheless….

The shrimp 🍤 and pea pods 🫛 arrived in about average time, based on the number of customers. The dish was very tasty.. peapods cooked to perfection and the shrimp were coated in a nice savory sauce. Great meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay Falcone

sample_reviews_en.text:
A fantastic Burmese restaurant
Stands out for its impeccable cleanliness and new (April 2026) and lightning-fast service. Owner and services are Burmese and kitchen chef also. They serve a Burmese food and Thai foods.
The food is delicious, and several dishes look and taste exactly like the authentic originals from Myanmar as a some menu.
It is incredible value for money considering the quality and portion sizes. 🥗🍛🍜
Upstairs in the restaurant is a hotel but not quite.
Great food good taste , good services , nice staff and value for money , Recommend!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kham

sample_reviews_en.text: 6 Ladies had a massage and was looking for food.. by chance, we found this restaurant in Google and decided to give it a try.. we were there quite late, about 11.30 pm, and surprisingly, the food we ordered is super yummy.. the fish is juicy and we can taste the freshness.. Best pork neck I ever tasted with little fats with it and etc.. here's some photos to share what we ordered.. the only disappointing dish is the salted egg squid.. can't find or taste any salted egg.. but still highly recommended to all to enjoy the food there..
sample_reviews_en.author: Yu Ling Ong

sample_reviews_en.text: A nice little restaurant tucked away within some alley in Phetchaburi. They offer both Thai and Myanmar cuisine but we opted for Thai for familiarity. Ordered fried fish with dipping sauce, tom yum goong with prawns and stir fried morning glory were absolutely delicious. The fish was crispy while the flesh remains tender to the bite. The dipping sauce added savouriness to the dish. Tom yum soup was really good as it was well balanced. Worth a try if you are in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Henry Cheng

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food was mediocre. Service was terrible. My group had 11 people and they brought out 4 cup of water and 4 plates and that was it until we asked for more (the food was already out by the way). They do mandatory 10% service charge for big group. Asked to speak to the manager (maybe not even real manager), she kept saying it was peak hours, I looked around and there was only 4 other tables.
Very disappointed. Will not recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kieu La

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the worst meal during my stay in Bangkok here. The coconut water I ordered was warmer than the curry. I asked for mild, but the dish came extremely spicy and was impossible to finish.

The server was friendly but clearly inexperienced. When she wiped the table, she pushed excess water onto the floor and left a big puddle. Unfortunately, no one came back to clean it up.

Overall, a very disappointing experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Victor Menendez

restaurants.name: Alice Cafe
restaurants.address:

1st floor Wat ratchaborphit 125 Fuang Nakhon road Issara by d hostel Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
7 months ago, my next visit was terrible. The staff were talking loudly in the kitchen, complaining about the wrong whipped cream (adding cow's milk), and everything they said was overheard by the customers. My carbonara order was served to the wrong table and was awful. There were hardly any pastries left in the display case, only the chiffon cakes, which aren't popular. This visit was terrible. I even tried to buy zongzi (Chinese rice dumplings) but they were sold out of sourdough bread. Oh my god, they have absolutely no preparation for opening a shop. This is what happens when you become popular.

I only bought the roll cake, chiffon lava cake, and some other desserts like glutinous rice balls and cane sugar jelly. The desserts were well-made and rich in flavor, but quite expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prapaporn K

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the pleasure of visiting Alice Cafe, just a few steps away from the hotel (Feung Nakorn Balcony) I staying. The ambiance is cozy and inviting, making it a perfect spot to relax. I tried their best-selling Pandan cake, and it was absolutely delicious! Made with fresh Pandan leaves and coconut flesh, it has a wonderfully aromatic flavor. The chocolate cake paired with its crispy chocolate powder topping adds a perfect touch. The drinks here are also fantastic, complementing the cakes perfectly. As a bonus, they offer a wide selection of bottled snacks like the garlic and pepper cornflakes that’s a unique mix of sweet and savory, which I really enjoyed. If you're in the area, this cafe is definitely worth a visit for both the delicious cakes and drinks, plus the great overall vibe!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sha

sample_reviews_en.text:
Listen, this is incredibly delicious. You have to try this at least once in your lifetime.
The pandan roll costs 110 baht, which is quite expensive, but it's also incredibly delicious. If it were cheaper, I'd definitely buy it more often. But at this price, I might only eat it occasionally.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patt Pattara

sample_reviews_en.text:
All our meals in Bangkok were a pleasure except for this one.

We left our plates practically untouched because it was inedible!

Furthermore, the service and welcome were appalling; the waitress came looking for us in the street to demand money even though we had already paid!
sample_reviews_en.author: SAVOYEN MARYLINE

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was amazing. We all had great food and served hot. Are drinks were great and there was a wide selection. The staff is friendly kind and professional. It is child friendly. Plenty of seating inside with air conditioning. There is one table outside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alicia Brant

sample_reviews_en.text: Alice Café feels like one of those places you don’t plan to find, but end up remembering. Right in front of a temple, the energy is calm, almost intentional, like the space was designed to slow you down. The layout is simple but aesthetic, …
sample_reviews_en.author: GID

sample_reviews_en.text: A very clean and pleasant café with an extensive menu. We had coffee and muesli. Delicious! The restrooms in the attached hotel are very clean. The air conditioning is a bit too cold, so it's advisable to bring a scarf and a light jacket.
sample_reviews_en.author: Petra Stolz

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I took the BTS to Sam Yot station, crossed the road, and walked along Khlong Lod canal until I found Phueng Nakhon Road – it was great!
So delicious...😋
Peach tea
Cocoa
Amazing drinks..💞
Delicious desserts..
sample_reviews_en.author: wilai s

restaurants.name: ส้มตำซาดิสบางแสน สาขาพัทยา
restaurants.address:

WV4F+3FW, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hey there! This like a Northeastern Thai restaurant is just amazing! It's very spacious and beautifully decorated, with plenty of seating. The food is not only delicious, but also made with fresh ingredients, which makes it very clean. Moreover, the service is excellent and the staff is super friendly. However, we've noticed that the restaurant doesn't seem to attract many customers. We really recommend that you give it a try at least once. You won't regret it!

Hey there! If you're not really into oysters, don't worry, I still highly recommend giving the oyster salad with fermented fish sauce a try. Trust me, it's so delicious that you won't be able to resist it! Another dish that I think you might enjoy is the fried pork neck, especially when you dip it in the oyster sauce leftover from the first dish. Bon appétit!

We hope you'll want to come back for more of our delicious food! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Prae Phomlumpuck

sample_reviews_en.text:
We arrived around lunchtime. The restaurant was packed, but we didn't have to wait long. The air-conditioned section has about ten tables. The outside area wasn't too hot either, with a clear roof and plenty of fans. You can order food through the app or by telling the staff.

Many dishes were delicious, the portions were generous, and they arrived relatively quickly. The prices were moderate. For eight people, we ordered over ten dishes plus a blended coconut drink, and it cost less than 3,000 baht.

I recommend the mushroom curry, the crispy pork belly with shrimp paste dip (so good we'd order it again!), the papaya salad platter, the bamboo shoot soup, the salted fried chicken, the grilled beef – every papaya salad was delicious.

There's convenient and spacious parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sf224

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate off the promotional menu which was great value and delicious food. The restaurant is semi open by which I mean it's a large opensided she'd similar to many similar establishments. Hard wooden seating and wooden tables, It's new so everything is clean it's a place to eat but not really linger. One small complaint is that it's not really forigener friendly in that the menus and signage is all in Thai script so unless you can read and write Thai you need Google Translate.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ian

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop is actually branch of a quite popular som tam shop at Bang Saen beach. The food is reasonably priced. Visited this shop a number of times and have not encounter different pricing as mentioned by other reviewers. You can request less spicy or less sourish or sweetness of the food. The som tam or larb dishes can be very spicy for foreigners, inform the staff about your preference. Parking along Thepprasit road and turn left into parking lot beside the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: SW Ng

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing local Thai food for super cheap! They've got multiple sets whcih visiters can pick all for 2000 THB which usually consists of at least 5 different dishes.

Service was very professional and incredibly quick. We waited no longer that 10 minutes for the majority of the food to start arriving.

Theres also plentiful parking spaces and many different seating arrangements to fit all preferences.

Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yawarakai O.

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there last Sunday. Overall, the food was good. The shrimp was fresh, the oysters were excellent, the marinated crab with roe was okay, and the fried and grilled fish weren't fishy. Overall, it was good. (I arrived before the restaurant opened so I didn't have to wait in line, but I finished eating before noon and saw people waiting in line.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Nichapa Soiyangsuk

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a huge and open-space restaurant that offers a wide range of thai dishes.
Food is exquisite and well presented, ingredients are fresh and clean, and prices are reasonable, considering quality and quantity.
The waiters are always available to help you, always smiling, and they are fast.
I absolutely suggest you give this place a go.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lorenzo Siwadol Sias

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices are reasonable. The food is fast and delicious. The chefs are excellent! The dishes are delicious, and the ingredients are fresh. We get our fish here. It's had an excellent reputation for many years. There's an air-conditioned dining room. The presentation is interesting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Алёна См

photos.alt: Clodors Photos
Clodors Photos
Clodors Photos

restaurants.name: Caffè Olives
restaurants.address:

4, 2 Napha Sap Alley, Lane 2, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a wonderful eggs Benedict, ham and focaccia 360 THB, and a latte 110THB in this charming little cafe. The food was exceptional, I’d have preferred the eggs a little hotter but everything else was so good, I couldn’t mark it down.

Both the cafe and the adjoining restaurant already had several customers before 9AM on a Saturday morning so they are clearly doing something right.

I walked from Thong Lor BTS. That was the least pleasant part. Sukhumvit 36 has no pavement on either side. I had to press myself up against the condo construction site a couple of times as traffic came by. Despite this I’d still return here.

The total bill with 10% service and 7% VAT came to a curious 553.19.  Scan payment via my Thai bank so not bothered with coming up with small change.
sample_reviews_en.author: D J

sample_reviews_en.text:
What a surprise find deep in the street across from Soi Tong Lor road and sits next to the Italian restaurant called L’Oliva. That’s for another review.

This bakery is one of those places you end up staying longer than you planned. They have a nice selection of baked goods, and the ice cream options are just as tempting. Everything looks fresh and thoughtfully made.

The space itself is calm and welcoming, with beautiful decor that makes it easy to relax. Whether you sit inside or outside, it’s a comfortable spot to slow down, enjoy a treat, and catch up with friends. I’ve been back more than once, and it’s quickly become one of my favorite places to unwind.

I would recommend the pistachio ice cream with strawberry crostata. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Prat Prathnadi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food here for the caffe side and the main restaurant are super different. Personally I am a fan of the caffe side more. I’ve been here twice and still love their bread so much! Tried the focaccia, sourdough, puccia sandwiches. Salad is generous portions.

The atmosphere makes you feel like you’re in Europe. Gelato is delicious with 6 flavors. Coffee and juice selections are great. I’ve really liked everything on the menu so far.

Service is quite good although when they’re busy you might have to try to flag them down a bit. There is parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: J Ch

sample_reviews_en.text:
Definitely a memorable experience 💖. For a moment, we were transported straight to Italy.

The shakshuka was outstanding, and the focaccia bread? Get an extra serving—you'll thank me later 😊.

Absolutely amazing spot 👏👏👏

It was a truly memorable experience 💖. For a moment, it felt like we were transported to Italy. The shakshuka was delicious, and the focaccia bread was amazing (order an extra, you won't regret it 😊).

Absolutely fantastic place 👏👏👏
sample_reviews_en.author: Ted weitz

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went here to have my last breakfast before leaving Bangkok and what better than a quiet little breakfast at a nice quaint restaurant.

The French toast brûlée was truly a treat fit for an emperor but I would probably go for something lighter unless you wanna spoil yourself. The ice cream with its simple appearance was truly deceiving as each bite was packed with a complexity of flavour which I took the time to thoroughly savour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sathiya Konasagaran

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice little place with good food and atmosphere! A little on pricey side but hey, that’s Thong Lor. Also, the staff was extremely good at this place. A nice escape from thinking about the horrible, despicable President back in the USA! Because T-Rump & Musk ended USAID, according to “The Lancet”, a 100 year-old respected Medical journal in the U.K., 13 million more people will be dead by 2030!
sample_reviews_en.author: Griffin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Caffè Olives is a hidden gem in Bangkok, a cozy Italian café with fresh ingredients, simple plates done right, good coffee, and proper Italian sandwiches and pizza by the slice.

With natural light, Italian cocktails, kind staff, it’s  the kind of place you settle into and end up staying a little longer than planned!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nina Lalina

sample_reviews_en.text: Lne of the best breakfast and brunch cafes in the city. A variety of food, drinks, and snacks. Connected to the cafe is Olivia which is an excellent restaurant at any time of day. The croissant sandwiches are fantastic. And plenty of parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: That Guy

restaurants.name: Luk Heng
restaurants.address:

10-14 Soi Yotse, Wat Thep Sirin, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my number one favorite Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) shop right now. It's delicious without needing any extra seasoning. The meatballs are good, the braised pork is good, the squid pieces are large, and they give you a generous amount of morning glory – great value at 70 baht a bowl. I also tried the shrimp wonton soup, and it was excellent as well. The broth was clear and refreshing.
The owner and staff provide good service. You can drive and park at the shop. If the parking lot is full, just roll down your window and ask the staff.
The owner will help you find parking nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichaya Choochuenchaimongkol

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stopped by for Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) for breakfast. This shop makes it slightly spicy (those who usually eat spicy food might not notice).
The fish topping was delicious. The shrimp dumplings had whole shrimp inside, mixed with minced pork.
The fried dumplings also had some kind of stir-fried pork inside.
Overall, all the toppings were excellent. I highly recommend it to anyone visiting this area.
sample_reviews_en.author: DK

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! I went to the hospital six years ago, in 2019. Especially the braised pork belly. I recommend the Tom Yum Yen Ta Fo and the crispy fish skin. It's very convenient to order through Grab. The shop also sells bottled Luo Han Guo and Chrysanthemum tea. The noodles taste great, I recommend trying them, they're delicious! I ate at the shop today and it was just as delicious as always.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ler鍾樂

sample_reviews_en.text: A fish noodle that has a full set of fish dishes, fish noodle, fish ball, fish dumplings, good taste, no fishy smell. Ordered dry noodle come with pork “Moo Ba Teng”. For anyone who likes soup, recommend shrimp dumplings with large pieces of meat mixed with minced pork. In Yentafo, it is fully equipped as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poonnapop Nutkumhang

sample_reviews_en.text:
The braised pork is fragrant and not too salty, it goes well with the noodles. The fish balls are firm and bouncy, the fish dumplings are good, and the fish noodle soup is decent. The sauce has a good balance of sour and spicy.

The price is 60 baht per bowl, 80 baht for the fish noodle soup.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suwit Phechrung

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered cold yentafo noodles (Thai noodle soup with thin rice noodles). The noodles were perfectly cooked, not mushy.

All the toppings were good, fresh, and delicious.

Including the meatballs, dumplings, fish cakes, and fried taro-filled dumplings.

Price: 60 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teerapat Ungsriwong

sample_reviews_en.text: I stumbled upon this place while checking out google map for another place to go. Being an ardent fan of yentaofo (red sauce) noodle, I couldn’t resist coming here and it’s such a great fine. The food is super fresh especially the fish ball …
sample_reviews_en.author: Penny Woo

sample_reviews_en.text: At 8 a.m., we tried the Lak Heng Yen Ta Fo Ba Teng. It wasn't very crowded, but orders were starting to come in. We had to wait a while for the vendor to take our order. We ordered the special Ba Teng Tom Yum Noodles (70 baht). A good …
sample_reviews_en.author: Opas Samsen

restaurants.name: Boon Tong Kee Paradise Park
restaurants.address:

ชั้นที่1 Paradise Park, เลขที่61 Srinagarindra Rd, Nong Bon, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This morning, I had breakfast with my girlfriend, but the experience was quite bad.

After ordering, we waited about 20 minutes for my girlfriend's food to arrive, but my duck dish hadn't come yet. My girlfriend had to eat her own food first because she was worried it would get cold. We asked the staff several times, and it seemed the restaurant had forgotten my duck order.

In the end, we waited about 1 hour and 10 minutes from the time we ordered. My girlfriend finished her meal and had to go to work, so we had to take the duck home instead of eating it together at the restaurant.

After paying, the restaurant gave us a takeaway box, but upon checking inside, there was only noodles, no duck, even though we had already paid. We had to go back and ask again and waited another 10 minutes to get the duck.

The staff apologized, which I appreciate, but overall, the wait was extremely long, an order was forgotten, and the food wasn't particularly delicious. It was a very disappointing experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Granados

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered the signature chicken, and it was delicious!

The other dishes were mostly average, nothing to complain about.

However, there's a reason we only gave it three stars: the problem was the oil used for the fried taro strips—it tasted rancid!

There were five strips on a plate, and we ate two. We initially tried to finish them to avoid wasting food, but we felt really uncomfortable afterwards. So, we asked the waiter to take the remaining three-fifths away, ask for the bill, and told them about the rancid oil smell.

The waiter quietly apologized and went to get the bill.

From start to finish, all we got was an apology; nothing else!

We didn't want to argue, so we paid the full amount and left! Wen Dong Ji isn't some roadside stall; it's a fairly large chain restaurant! This kind of service is really unacceptable!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jen Shr

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm a vegetarian, but I love Boon Tong Kee. I always order my usual: fried tofu with spinach. It's delicious every time I eat at any branch.

May I offer a suggestion? I ordered chrysanthemum tea and just found out there's a promotion. I recommend mentioning the promotion to customers when they order. Also, for members, please indicate how many points they have and whether they want to use them as a discount during payment, as customers only find out their points after scanning to pay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akira Kit

sample_reviews_en.text: The deliciousness lies in the soy sauce drizzled over the chicken. It gives the feeling of eating tender chicken with a sauce that tastes like soy sauce soup. It's incredibly delicious when eaten with pickled vegetables.
sample_reviews_en.author: COACH GIFT

sample_reviews_en.text: Our family love every dishes we order, they are all super deliciuos! Scrumptious I would say. Fresh ingredients are used, freshly cooked by experienced chef. We visit this restaurant everytime we cone to Paradise Park!
sample_reviews_en.author: Real Channel

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, but the staff was incompetent.
They didn't pay attention to who arrived first.
They didn't even come to take orders when we waved. The staff training is terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tasanapong Skawattananont

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten at several branches, and this one didn't disappoint. Good service, and the taste is consistently delicious...🙂👍
sample_reviews_en.author: monster dvp channel

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a chicken rice restaurant I frequent because the chicken is tender and juicy, and the dipping sauce is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: NOUM CHONGJA

restaurants.name: Zap Station
restaurants.address:

1372 Sutthisan Winitchai Rd, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hard for me to recommend to foreigners/tourists. I love spicy food; I order it globally. Mexican food (in Mexico) is never spicy enough for me, I’ve won spicy food challenges in (western) restaurants, and vindaloo curry is my go-to. But this curry was inedible from spiciness for me. I picked the meat out of it and choked it down with the rice I ordered, but the rest got wasted…first time I’ve ever not finished a meal due to heat. I didn’t even come close…

It’s marked as a 2/3 spicy on their menu and I can’t help but suspect one of the hot pepper stickers fell off, because if there’s anything above this, I can’t believe even Thais could eat it. It looks and tastes like murder!! Never had spicier food in Thailand and I’ve been here three times. Honestly, I’m impressed. And in pain!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rick Logan

sample_reviews_en.text: There is nothing much i can say about it, as i have never been there to dine.. all i know is it is a reataurant along sutthisan winichai road that opens in the late afternoon til midnight, it is a romantic i think as there are no bright lights, only candles in the table, and there are live singer while you are eating  near. It is i think 3 or 4 blocks away from the mrt sutthisan station, take exit 3 and walk through along sutthisan road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Norma Doromal

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an awesome restaurant/bar. They have live music every day of the week. They have a ton of ultra friendly servers, and the food is delicious. I like the stir-fried morning glory, even though it's really spicy. The shrimp with asparagus was delicious, especially the sauce. And the asparagus was cooked just the right amount. They have a few beers I'd never heard of, which is rare in a Thai bar. I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joseph Dewey

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and traditional.  Draft beer in stock.  Delicious Tom Yam seafood soup.  All is well.  The work of the staff is very disgusting.  Ashtray waited 15 minutes.  The waitress for a long time could not understand the order in Thai language.  My local friend make  order and she did not understand it.  Maybe from Burma.  Change the staff and there will be more guests. Only for this 4 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fedori Grigori

sample_reviews_en.text: More a place to go to listen to good Thai live music, drink towers of beer, and party in an open space. Large menu with lots of Thai classics. The stir fried thai basil pork was great, and the tables are well spaced out, so a comfortable place to eat. We did not order much so can’t judge the overall quality of the food, but I would be happy to go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adam Aitken

sample_reviews_en.text: Great chilling place. Food is excellent. Seafood is fresh from the Zap Station own fishing team. Cocktails are done just right (hint: whisky sour is right on). Service is perfect though some waitresses will shy away from talking to foreigners (but no worries a big smile can fix it). Very reasonable prices. An all round enjoyable experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Olivier Dombey

sample_reviews_en.text: I loved the place. Some waitresses are very kind and beauty 😍. I wish a wider menu with more Western food but overall it is an amazing place to spend the evening while listening some live music (Thai) and watching football. Well done guys!
sample_reviews_en.author: Infinite 8

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious Tom Yum Sea Bass! Comes in that giant bowl with fire in the center. Generous portions of fish, a bit much on the squid content. About $10 US dollars.  Fun atmosphere, good music (in Thai). Slightly upscale. Outdoors.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrew Flowers

restaurants.name: Khao Soi Lam Duan
restaurants.address:

ร้านข้าวซอยลำดวนฟ้าฮ่ามเชียงใหม่ สาขา ประดิพัทธ์ เลขที่193/3 Pradiphat Rd, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This popular restaurant, originating in Chiang Mai, offers authentic Khao Soi in Bangkok. Its appeal lies in its rich yet not overpowering curry soup, with a perfect balance of coconut creaminess and spice aromas. The contrasting textures of the fried and boiled noodles are delightful, and the chicken on top is tender and easy to eat. The accompanying pickled mustard greens, onions, and lime allow you to change the flavor as you eat, keeping you engaged until the very last bite. Located on Pradipat Road, it's easily accessible, making it highly recommended for anyone wanting to try Northern Thai cuisine in Bangkok. Even first-time Khao Soi eaters will likely find the flavor appealing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yusuke

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had Khao Soi Chicken. The soup was slightly spicy, just the way I like it, and it was delicious.

This restaurant serves Khao Soi from a famous Chiang Mai restaurant at an affordable price in Bangkok. The Saphan Khwai branch opened about two years ago, and compared to the branch one BTS station away and other Khao Soi restaurants in Bangkok, the prices were reasonable and the taste was authentic.

The Sai Oua, a Northern Thai dish, was also delicious.

Next time, I'd like to try other dishes like Khanom Jeen Nam Ngiao and Gaeng Hung Lay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hashimoto N (Hasse)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Khao Soi had a rich, intense curry paste flavor. Personally, I needed to add a little more sweetness. I ate it with friends, and each of us had different opinions about whether it needed more sweetness, more salt, or just the right amount of sweetness.

The Hang Le curry was incredibly delicious! Full of spices, very flavorful, and the pork was so tender it melted in my mouth.

The prices were reasonable, and the portion size was perfect for one person.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dragonia T

sample_reviews_en.text:
Following the sign for Miss Cherlyn Guide🥧, the Khao Soi was quite tasty. The curry was average, slightly bland, but still seasoned well. The chicken was tender and tender, but not outstanding. 6/10 points.
The Nam Prik Ong wasn't as tasty. The chili paste was too broken, which made the tomatoes very mushy. The Laab Kua was tasty and delicious. The price might be a bit high.
This review is based on the taste of a Northerner.😅
sample_reviews_en.author: Mali weather

sample_reviews_en.text:
To put it simply, "excellent food!"

The taste is hard to beat, it tastes like Mom's cooking. The portions are generous and the prices are more than reasonable!

The staff is nice and friendly and always ready to help.

I definitely recommend the pork Khao Soi, and be sure to try the sausage too!

The ambiance isn't amazing, but it does the job.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nik Blomquist

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious Khao Soi, along with a variety of other northern Thai dishes, I also ordered a plate of Sai Ua (Northern Thai Sausage). It was delicious and packed with spices. I wasn't disappointed at all. If you're craving authentic northern Thai food, I recommend this restaurant. The prices are reasonable too.
sample_reviews_en.author: adisak kammungkun

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was really not good. I've eaten many Khao soi in Thailand but this had quite a weird taste, not authentic at all. Additionally I had a bad stomach few hours after eating here while eating every other meal at home the same day. Don't want to blame them but I wouldn't be surprised...
sample_reviews_en.author: Hannes

sample_reviews_en.text: The Sai Ua sausage smells bad. I've eaten it twice and thought it was just a mistake the first time. I ate it again and it smelled just as bad. If it's not good, it's best to throw it away. If you're feeling sorry for the ingredients, you shouldn't make a lot of it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lalabelz

restaurants.name: Flame Pattaya
restaurants.address:

312, 54 Soi Lengkee, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Recommended to come here, ordered a tenderloin rare, it came out medium to well done.

As my partner and daughter food had already arrived, I was not prepared to wait for them to fire another order, so sent the order back.

The manager/owner (Farrang) not his fault, he was very apologetic, polite etc, but for me when you get an order wrong I rather send it back than sit and wait for my guests to eat and then eat alone.

I was not going to leave a review, how ever I also ordered the Garlic prawns, which never arrived, so I thought I’d wait for the cheque and see how they react, as I assumed, they were on the cheque. When I said to the staff I didn’t receive this item, she agreed and said I’ll take it off of the bill, she was so confident I didn’t receive the item, so I asked, “why didn’t you remove it from the bill then?” She looked very nervous.

I think the above speaks for itself, very very bad experience. Staff are not up for the job. Won’t be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: James

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great find!! My wife and I visited the Chinese restaurant next door one evening and on our way out looked at the menu outside of Flame.
We decided this would eat here the following evening.
We weren’t Disappointed the Staff were great the food was Fantastic we both had steaks that were cooked perfectly and full of flavour.
It was so good we decided to return with our family the following week.
Five of us dined on this evening and again every dish was fantastic.
During our months stay our go to restaurant for quality food especially Steak is Cafe Des Mis rated as a top restaurant in the Pattaya area.
Flames Steaks is a more casual restaurant but the quality of the food is just as good we will definitely be returning to Flame
sample_reviews_en.author: SHAUN Marshall

sample_reviews_en.text:
A friend brought me here, saying he’s always had great meals. I can honestly say, I can’t think of ever having a better steak that the strip loin served to me. It was so incredibly tender with minimal seasoning; I could taste how naturally delicious it was.

The sides were also amazing. And the service…we didn’t think there was any delay, but the owner insisted on buying us a round of drinks because of a backup in the kitchen.

We are already planning on another meal there. This place is a must-visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andy Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best steakhouse in Pattaya hands down.
Service on point and served with a smile.

A must have on anyone’s to do list when in Pattaya.

I had the Australian strip loin 250 grams with a side of fries and sauce.

Many sides to choose from and all looked delicious.

My friend had Wagyu burger and it was hit in every bite.

We will be back many times during our holiday.
Highly recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: BOOMERANG_247

sample_reviews_en.text: I walked in to this restaurant with low expectations. So many nice looking places in Pattaya have nice photos of meat but don't know how to cook them properly. But hot damn, this place is amazing! The brisket, the lamb, the ribeye. All perfectly cooked and delicious. The only complaint I have is that the AC setting is too strong which cooled down my food. But I'll definitely be going back here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve D

sample_reviews_en.text: Had a great meal everyone at our table really the variety. From amazing steaks to authentic Thai dishes. The new addition of chicken is superb. Delicious and tasty with service that comes from a well run restaurant. Definitely be back again
sample_reviews_en.author: John Centofanti

sample_reviews_en.text:
Soy Lengkee has many steak houses, but this one is top-notch in every aspect.
I had the 250g ribeye medium-rare, and the aging and cooking were perfect.
The accompanying vegetables and side dishes were also delicious. …
sample_reviews_en.author: KA

sample_reviews_en.text: My friend and I have just had the Sunday roast and ut was fantastic. Every component of the meal was top notch and certainly the best roast I've had in pattaya over the 20 years I've been visiting. Definitely recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: david kemp

restaurants.name: Portanova Pizza & Cucina
restaurants.address:

340, 27 Chaloem Phra Kiat Rd, Pattaya City, Amphoe Bang Lamung, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant looks nice, the staff is friendly.

The pizza is good, napolitan style, the tiramisu and the panna cotta are good also.

The prices are a little too high compared to other italian restaurants, the sales tax is not included in the price so you have to add 7% to the prices shown on the menu.

At the end, we were asked if we wanted a limoncello.
Sometimes, some restaurants offer a limoncello to their customers at the end of the meal.
We thought it was offered as she did not ask if we wanted another alcohol, just mentionning limoncello like it was offered as i get in some italian restaurants i go to, well, it was charged to the bill, like 200 bahts the shot.

So you know, if you go there and they ask if you want a limoncello, it's not complimentary.

The owner doesn't appreciate constructive comments, answers with a rude attitude.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dominique

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you want to taste the essence of Napoli culture 9000 km away from Italy, Portanova Pizza & Cucina is what you are looking for. The best points for me:

1. A very welcoming and open space makes you feel the Italian vibes

2. Like in REAL pizzerias in Napoli, the oven is always the first visible thing when you walk in, to enhance the main character of this place, the pizzaiolo and his magical instrument.

3.The added value of Antonio and his crew product is without any doubt the quality of the dough. An excellent example of the now famous contemporary Napolentan pizza.

This pizzeria should be an example for many of Italians who try to run Italian restaurant-related businesses abroad.
With study and dedication it's possible to offer an excellent product at the correct price.

A big applause to Antonio and the team. RECOMMENDED!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ciro Cirillo

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pasta and pizza, and I must say the food quality was outstanding. Both the pasta and the pizza were incredibly delicious, and the staff were friendly, courteous, and attentive throughout our meal.

However, one downside was the temperature inside the restaurant. Even though we were seated directly under the air conditioner, it still felt quite warm and slightly uncomfortable. I believe this may be due to the pizza oven being too close to the dining area, which seems to raise the overall room temperature.

It’s a pity because everything else about the experience was excellent. We would truly love to return, but the heat was a bit of a deterrent. I hope the owner will consider addressing this issue, as it would greatly improve the comfort of the dining environment and make repeat visits much more enjoyable.
sample_reviews_en.author: wai leung kwan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Portanova Pizza & Cucina is a slice of heaven in Pattaya! The moment you take a bite, you know you’re tasting something exceptional. The crust is perfection — airy inside with a gentle chew and a golden outer bite that’s simply divine. You can tell the dough has been expertly crafted, likely cold-fermented, giving it that deep, flavorful character that only true artisans can achieve.

The cheese pizza is nothing short of sublime. The balance of rich cheese, flavorful sauce, and masterfully baked dough creates harmony in every bite. This isn’t just pizza — it’s culinary craftsmanship at its finest. If you’re in Pattaya, visiting PORTANOVA Pizza is an absolute must. It’s the real deal, 10 stars out of 10!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeramia Valentine

sample_reviews_en.text:
The modern interior and helpful staff made a good impression, but the food didn’t quite live up to my expectations. The pizza was good, the tiramisu was okay.

The prices felt a bit high, especially at 320 baht for an Aperol Spritz and 270 baht for tiramisu. The bill included a surprise 7% VAT surcharge that wasn’t listed on the menu. When I pointed it out, the staff quickly fixed it and apologised. Credit card payments incur an additional 3% fee.

It’s an alright spot for an Italian meal, but just be mindful of the pricing and potential hidden charges.

Edit: after the disrespectful reply from the owner below, I feel obliged to update my score from 4 stars to 1 star.
sample_reviews_en.author: Martijn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Italian restaurant managed by Italians on the 3rd road.

All the dishes are Italian.
No fusion, no half-American fake dishes or stange fancy stuff.

The menu is very simple and the selection is well done:
Classic appetizers
Pasta (al dente. As It should be!)
Pizza Napoletana "moderna" (absolutely delicious and super light. Like a cloud!)
Salads
Dessert Panna cotta and tiramisù (both awesome)
Nice selection of Italian wine and Birra Nastro Azzurro Peroni.
Many drinks available as well.

The atmosphere is nice and with nice details.

Reasonable price for high quality food.

In my opinion the best pizza napoletana in Pattaya at the moment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Riccardo Demartini

sample_reviews_en.text:
Best pizza in Pattaya.
After trying several pizzerias around Pattaya, I can confidently say this is the best pizza in town. The dough is light, perfectly risen, and baked to perfection in a wood-fired oven. You can truly taste the freshness and quality of the ingredients in every bite.

I ordered a Margherita and a Quattro formaggi – both were incredible, with authentic flavors just like in Italy. But what makes Portanova even more special is the excellent service. The staff is friendly, attentive, and welcoming – they make you feel right at home.

The atmosphere is cozy and well-kept, and the value for money is great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Luca Proverbio

sample_reviews_en.text: I love Thai food but I had a craving for pizza and this place hit the spot! The taste is very authentic Italian, I have never tasted pizza like this outside of Italy. I sometimes find pizza a bit heavy but the dough used here is light, airy and delicious. They have a great pizza oven and the owner is Italian and takes great pride in the food. The ambience and service were great, I sat in the bar area and Bas and Tisha spoke great English and made me feel very welcome. I came alone but I'll definitely return with friends next time I'm craving pizza as I think this would be a great place for a group meal
sample_reviews_en.author: Paddy Cooke

restaurants.name: Daniel Thaiger Burger Hub & STAX Burger
restaurants.address:

419, 1 Phetchaburi 47 Alley, Lane 3-4, Bang Kapi, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Following the reviews, I took an hour grab ride to get here. Not sure if it was a bad day or what but I didn't experience anything like the other reviews. I ended up ill whilst at the restaurant in the bathroom and the burger didn't agree with me. It was the Mr Steve with cheese. Over salted fries was a stark difference to zero flavoured burger.  The staff were behind closed doors in the kitchen so I doubt they even noticed i wasn't enjoying it and was ill. Was really looking forward to it but ultimately it was the biggest waste of money I had spent in Bangkok on travel and the burger itself.

The staff weren't overly welcoming or kind. I asked for recommendations and the waitress was fairly dismissive. Again, a stark difference of energy and passion in comparison to the amount of self driven marketing material they have within the restaurant. I asked what cheese they used and they said cheddar. I am British and I have even visited the Cheddar Gorge region and had it right out of the cave so no, this isn't cheddar in my opinion (see picture) I asked if it was melted down and she said no we don't do that.

Not a great experience I'm afraid.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sabrina Natasha

sample_reviews_en.text:
Daniel Thaiger Burger is a burger joint that has long been famous as a food truck. Today, I'm happy to have had the opportunity to try it at their physical store.
Daniel Thaiger Burger is renowned for its perfectly balanced flavors and the high-quality ingredients it uses.
What sets Daniel Thaiger Burger apart from other burger joints is the meticulous attention to detail in every step of making their burgers, from selecting high-quality beef and soft, fragrant brioche buns to their special sauces that perfectly complement the various ingredients.
Today, I tried their best-selling menu items:

★Cowboy Burger: Juicy meat, flavorful sauce that pairs well.
★Mr. Steve Burger: Milder flavor but equally delicious, with crisp lettuce.

In addition to burgers, the store offers many other menu items such as French fries, onion rings, and various drinks. The atmosphere of the store is friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pinit Phunvichardkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
True to its reputation as one of the first burger joints to originate from a food truck, this is what packaging ideal for eating on the go should be like.
Normally, street food burgers are placed on a tray and skewered, which is inconvenient and hard to hold with unclean hands. But this shop's packaging is excellent; you can eat it conveniently on the go without worrying about spills or mess.
Parking is limited if you come to eat at the shop, so ordering delivery is better.
The taste is delicious, and the pork patty is slightly crispy.
Give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: My Love

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered the buy 1 get 1 free special on Grab, but they didn't send the free burgers which meant some people in the office didn't get lunch. The burger tasted a bit dry and cold. I heard a lot about them, but they seem overrated.

*Edit: Apologies, Lineman, not Grab. And we did contact them - directly and through the Lineman app, but they just said there's nothing they can do 🤷🏻‍♂️ Terrible service and false advertising. And now trying to avoid responsibility as well in the reply to this review (please see screenshot).
sample_reviews_en.author: Johan Pieterse

sample_reviews_en.text: Been eating DT burgers for over 10 years, can't believe I've never left a review yet. I remember the old days when they used to serve out of 'Game Over Lounge' back in 2013-2015. Nowadays they are at different locations so it's hard to keep up. Today I went to their Grab delivery kitchen/location nearby Bangkok Hospital. The atmosphere was nothing special as it's just a ghost kitchen, but I don't care about that. The burgers are always tasty and consistent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dean Sonetirot

sample_reviews_en.text:
I finally got to eat at the restaurant after ordering through Lineman several times.
This burger is so delicious, I could use the word "delicious" excessively. The beef patty is juicy and retains the texture of the beef, the brioche bun is both crispy and soft, and the house sauce is perfectly balanced without overpowering the beef flavor. In short, it's fantastic! It tastes twice as good when eaten at the restaurant as it does when ordered for delivery. 🙂
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanakan Wongleelaseth

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered delivery from Stax Burger through Foodpanda, and it was an exceptional experience! The burger arrived hot and perfectly packed, showing great attention to detail. The bread was soft and fresh, complementing the deliciously juicy and flavorful meat. Everything was well-balanced, and the quality was outstanding. On top of that, it offered excellent value for money. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a great burger experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohammad Farran

sample_reviews_en.text: I don’t know if it was a bad day in the kitchen but the burger we got, the most recommended “Mr Steve burger” was completely tasteless. The meat itself didn’t have any flavor, the bun seemed stale, and we couldn’t tell there was even bacon in it. I’m not one to write negative reviews but this burger was so bad that I think Burger King would have been a better option. Other than the food, the server was incredibly nice!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jenna Donato

restaurants.name: Korean Spoon
restaurants.address:

201 ห้องเลขที่ 201-202, อาคารโครงการเดอะคริสตัลเอกมัย-รามอินทราอาคารอีชั้นที่ 2, Pradit Manutham Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Located on the second floor of Crystal Design Center, K 3 building, this upscale restaurant offers a traditional Korean cuisine prepared by a certified Koran Chef. The dining space is well appointed and comfortable, with Korean-style decorations.  The place is famous for its Korean BBQ that has its meat marinated with some fruits in a traditional Korean jar. For some reason, the staff would show you how your choice of BBQ is marinated and kept in a jar. You can either grill it yourself or ask the chef to grill if for you. There are also several other recommended dishes listed in the menu. I tried Ong-gi galbi and Dolsot bibimbap and they tasted so good. Haemul-sundubu-jjigae is also great seafood based soup - must try. The side dishes (complimentary dishes) are awesome and better than I expected. All in all, the restaurant offers great selection of different variety of dishes. Fresh ingredients of fine quality, especially the meat and vegetables. Food are cooked with attention to detail and with splendid food presentation. Service is average. One downside I've found so far is the poor air ventilation and air-conditioning system in the restaurant though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Simplysiri

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Korean BBQ restaurant serves authentic Korean food. I frequent it often because I'm impressed by the taste and quality of the food. They grill it for you and then bring it to your table, so you don't have to worry about smelling bad. You can always refill side dishes.
1. Korean beef bibimbap: Lots of toppings and vegetables, so delicious.
2. Seafood soybean paste soup: Very delicious and flavorful.
3. Grilled food: Let the staff grill for you, just wait to eat.
- Tender beef marinated in sauce: tender and delicious.
- Pork ribs marinated in skewers and sauce: Everyone loves this dish. The pork is very tender and flavorful, and the sauce is well-seasoned.
- Pork neck marinated in sauce: very tender.
- Pork neck marinated in gochujang: tender pork with a good sauce.
- Korean bacon marinated in gochujang: This dish was also delicious, but it was served when I was full, so I had to take it home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mummy Sombatsiri

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time trying this branch; I usually eat at the Fashion Island branch.
- The service gets a perfect 10. The staff were very attentive, caring, and gave excellent recommendations. They even offered a free small cup of sweet drink after the meal, which the Fashion Island branch doesn't provide.
- The food was delicious as always, no disappointment. The menu seems to be more extensive than the Fashion Island branch. They have tteokbokki, which is very delicious. However, the kimchi soup wasn't as good as at the Fashion Island branch, which is a shame.
- They have lunch sets at reasonable prices, just the right portion size, good value, perfect for those who want to try a variety of dishes. If you're coming alone, the lunch set is enough to fill you up.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aon Onanong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great authentic Korean food! Very Clean and hygienic, comfortable booths, perfect for up to 4pax. Efficient service.

Lots (and lots) of Korean sides arrive moments after you order your mains. Be careful not to fill up on these savory delights.

You can cook your selections at your table or they can prepare perfectly in the kitchen. I opted for the latter as I was feeling a bit lazy. They brought each course out to the table before heading back into the kitchen to cook it just right! Every dish was really yummy!

The bill arrived and was in line with expectations. Vat was thankfully included in the prices, but 10% service charge was added. All in all, well worth it!

This place was a great find... I'll be back soon!
sample_reviews_en.author: David Touring

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best Korean food I've had in Bangkok. The chef has been trained and certified directly from Korea, and they have a certificate to show for that in the first page of the menu. Everything is just so full of flavour. The bibimbab, while served in a hot stone bowl, does not dry out and retains the moisture and flavour. The BBQ set coomprises a variety of cuts marinated differently, and surprisingly, they really do taste different - I find this rare at most yakiniku joints. The BQQ is served with about 9 side dishes all of which are refillable.
10/10 would eat here again, even though it's a bit pricey. But it's totally worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: S. Chaunchaiyakul

sample_reviews_en.text: I went here today at lunch with family , many crown customers and many queue for waiting , some customers canceled because can’t wait so waste their time , my luck that I booked before , arrived 11:30 but our 1st order came 12:30 I don’t know why took the food so long , not impress , not good not bad service but not good for solving immediate problems for us. I think you should prepare your restaurant and your manpower to handle many customers who come to your place ASAP. Sincerely I used to have my own restaurant too I understand all of the process but today I can’t take it sorry for my opinion
sample_reviews_en.author: Kirapat Siripong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Horrible Korean food, no flavor!
I am a Korean male in his 50’s. Traveled to over 40 countries and this was the worst Korean food so far.
I ordered kimchi pancake and kimchi soup and marinated Kalbi and spicy marinated pork and it was all bad ! It makes it worse when you tell them it has no flavor and the man/owner comes and argues and wants to take me outside to beat me up after threatening to hit me in the restaurant while I was sitting at my table!
The restaurant itself is beautiful and tastefully decorated recently and they spent a lot of money and the staff were amazing and great service!
sample_reviews_en.author: John Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: Korean restaurant by a Korean chef. The shop is on the 2nd floor of Crystal Park. The shop has both beef and pork. You can ask the staff to grill it for you. Very convenient. The taste is very good. The sauce is good. There are many side dishes. There is also salad. The vegetables are very fresh and crispy. Delicious. You can ask for more. In addition to the grilled menu, there are other Korean dishes. Kimchi soup is very tasty. It is sour. Korean mixed rice is delicious. Squid stir-fried in Korean sauce is also delicious. I really like this shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mai Dateyou

restaurants.name: Sunny Offside
restaurants.address:

1944, 1946 Sukhumvit Rd, Bang Chak, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today, I want to share a truly satisfying and delicious meal!

First up is the Original Smash Burger. The bun is beautifully glossy, lightly sprinkled with white sesame seeds, and incredibly soft and fluffy. The juicy, flavorful meat is bursting with a distinct grilled aroma, and the sauce is perfectly balanced – not too sweet or too salty. It's served with golden, crispy-on-the-outside, soft-on-the-inside French fries; a perfect combination!

Next, there are crispy Buffalo wings with a tangy and spicy sauce – just the right balance of flavors. They're served with a blue cheese dip that cuts through the spiciness, and carrot and celery sticks for added freshness, preventing the dish from being too rich.

Finally, there's a refreshing cold drink from their extensive selection, perfect for cutting through the richness of the fried food. This meal was both delicious and invigorating!
(The staff recommended the drinks, which were spot-on!)
Overall, it was the perfect meal for a relaxing day, a great way to treat yourself. The taste, presentation, and atmosphere were all fantastic. I definitely want to go back again! 🍔🍗🍺
sample_reviews_en.author: Monruk Prayoontongkam

sample_reviews_en.text: Place was the best rated restaurant next to out hotel. We had been traveling all day and weee excited to get some great food. Our first time in Bangkok. Restaurant design was cool but waiter was inattentive. He took my order and walked away never got my girls order we had to call him back. He brought us a dish we didn’t order but thank god he did because the food was gross. We ordered the smothered fries dish and wings.Wings seemed like frozen then heated premade and fries and cheese sauce tasted horrible. I ordered the Ribeye medium and it came out rare in center, also seemed like cooked from frozen. Just had an off vibe in there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Matt Mcdougall

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff here are excellent and attentive. However the alcohol prices are far from reasonable. I was charged almost 300B/£7/$9.50 for a bottle of Kirin.

If you want a can of Sierra Nevada you’ll pay almost 400B/£9.30/$12.50 including taxes and service which they add on to already silly prices.

You’ll be hard pressed to find more expensive places to drink in Thong Lor, Siam or Silom. Honestly quite baffling.

They had no Singh draft and the place is always empty. For a reason. Food prices are reasonable but I think you need to do better to drive thirsty customers not hungry ones.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dan Mason

sample_reviews_en.text: The food and service were excellent. We had the pad kra pao, fish and chips, spring rolls, chili and lime nuts (surprisingly unique and good). There is also a vegetarian menu. The seats are comfortable and the place was not crowded, they show Premier League matches. Nothing to complain about except Tottenham's performance 😂😂
sample_reviews_en.author: Dalia G

sample_reviews_en.text: I didn't expect much, but the burger was surprisingly delicious! I was really surprised. I just saw reviews saying the "Haodong" (a type of spicy pork dish) was good, so I'll have to try it next time. The atmosphere is perfect for hanging out with friends to watch football. Overall, it was a memorable experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kook Pi

sample_reviews_en.text: The burger is to the point: simple, cooked well, and tasty! The fries are your usual frozen fries, could be better. Atmosphere is nice and cozy, unfortunately there are too many TVs for a family with kids 🫣 But they have great non alcoholic local craft sodas, which are 👌🏽
sample_reviews_en.author: Alora

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is clean and has a nice atmosphere. There were no customers when I visited. I would recommend it; it's perfect for hanging out with friends. They have draft beer, a TV showing live football matches, decent food, and mid-range prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: pornpimon thitaweera

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ve had lunch here twice. The smash burger and fries are very good made to order always hot. Owner very nice and tries to make the customer feel welcome.  Several craft beer selections and many bottle beer selections imported and domestic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tai
