308, ปาก Udom Suk 26 Alley, Bang Na Nuea, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The river prawns, salmon, and oysters were excellent. The fried dishes were very crispy. Other dishes were also delicious, especially the kimchi soup. At 649 baht, it's great value, and there's no time limit. Pay, done, and eat until you're full. Definitely coming back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mileymiw

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and there's a wide variety to choose from. I eat here very often.
Even though it's already August 2026, I still keep coming back. They've added new menu items, but the food quality hasn't decreased at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: panfah s wattanasri

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. The restaurant was spacious and comfortable, and the staff provided great service. They changed the grill for us whenever it got burnt, which was really nice. I’ll definitely come back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kornkanok Boonchai

sample_reviews_en.text: There's a wide variety of food. If you come with at least two people, there's no time limit. Personally, I don't really like Korean-style BBQ; I prefer Japanese-style BBQ.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaweekai Chok

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is really good. One of the best in bkk. Everything is fresh and all the soup are really good. Must try. And thanks for the good meal. meat factory
sample_reviews_en.author: Paing Soe Kyaw

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here more than ten times. The taste is absolutely excellent. It's like being in Korea; the taste is authentic and signature!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: NO EY

sample_reviews_en.text: Great customer service with the delicious dishes. Meat is fresh and well marinated. Kimchi is one of my favorites.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yu Zin Zin

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my 5th time eating here, and I'm still as impressed as ever. The food is absolutely delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutty SweetyPink

restaurants.name: LOONG MALA HOTPOT DONKI MALL THONGLOR
restaurants.address:

Donki Mall Thong Lor Floor 4, 107 Soi Sukhumvit 63, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I chose the most expensive buffet package hoping for a wider variety of dishes, but the actual experience was quite disappointing. The menu wasn't as extensive as expected, and the number of dishes to choose from was limited compared to the price. In particular, the crab wasn't fresh, significantly reducing the quality of the dish.

After the first order, subsequent orders involved very long waits, even though the restaurant has a time limit for dining. This disrupted the dining experience and created considerable stress as the time continued to tick. Some dishes we ordered weren't brought, and there was no notification from the staff, forcing us to ask repeatedly.

The staff were initially enthusiastic and friendly, but their support decreased significantly after we ordered more dishes; we felt less cared for than before. Considering the cost, I felt the experience wasn't worth it and I probably won't return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nhismee

sample_reviews_en.text: The food order was incomplete, and we had to keep asking the staff about the mussels. When they finally arrived, they smelled bad and were inedible. We also ordered quail eggs but didn't get them. We waited so long we thought we hadn't received our food before asking for the bill. Please check the quality of your food. I've eaten at the Don Quijote branch before and it was delicious. This time at the RCA branch was very disappointing. My mother asked for a soup ladle twice and didn't get it. When we went to pay the bill and told the staff and the cashier about the incomplete order and the smelly mussels, the staff member just said "We're sorry," and the cashier refused to acknowledge or report the issue.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kunjira Jitmontee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a beautiful Chinese-inspired décor, which creates a nice and authentic atmosphere. However, the experience was affected by several issues.

The staff do not speak English, and the bill is not available in English either, which made communication quite difficult. Unfortunately, this also led to a mistake in the billing.

The food presentation is visually appealing, but the taste is not particularly outstanding. For a restaurant of this size, a major downside is that they do not accept Apple Pay, which is quite inconvenient.

Overall, the ambiance is nice, but the service and payment limitations significantly impact the overall experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Louis Nguyen

sample_reviews_en.text: The mala soup tastes just like the authentic Chinese version. The mala broth is wonderfully spicy and numbing. The pork bone broth is also delicious and flavorful. The ingredients are fresh, and the staff are attentive, clearing plates and refilling water – very lovely. It's also conveniently located with plenty of parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: H I have H a p p y

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was varied but not exceptionally delicious considering the buffet price. However, the ambiance was luxurious, making it suitable for entertaining clients. I think business people would want their partners to feel the opulence and sophistication of this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: QP

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant boasts a beautiful decor and pleasant atmosphere, with a fragrant broth. The brown sugar glutinous rice cakes and freshly killed bullfrog are particularly impressive. However, the duck intestines and tripe are tough to chew, …
sample_reviews_en.author: 曼谷外围Escort Bangkok 看主页

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is weaker and the price has gone up after the renovation 💧
The old tomato hot pot tasted better, so please bring it back
And the pork belly... was it really pork belly? It had a strange texture I'd never seen before.
sample_reviews_en.author: アル・シャマク

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant was almost empty. The soup was delicious. There's no buffet, it's à la carte. I ordered a large dish, but there was very little meat and the vegetables were in small pieces.
sample_reviews_en.author: N W.

restaurants.address:

226, 2 Beach Rd, ตำบล หนองปรือ, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very nice expreience with family, delicious foods with superb service at Spicy twist, all the staff are so throughful, friendly and patient, all of us leave with a satisfied and joyful vibe.

Besides, the fried drumsticks are nice, the next day we re-order it again~yummy yummy~😋
sample_reviews_en.author: giraffegracet

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff here are really kind and make you feel like a guest in their home, the restaurant is beautiful, the food is so delicious, and they’re great at tailoring dishes to your preferences, I visited several times while in Pattaya and will definitely stop by again when in town.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brad

sample_reviews_en.text: I have tried few of the dishes at this restaurant and all were in big portion and very delicious quality. Staff are very kind and friendly. Very good customer service. I highly recommend the restaurant. The price is very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: manooch tmi

sample_reviews_en.text: This Indian restaurant in Central Pattaya is a must-try! 🍛 We've tried a few places, but this one truly made us feel like we were back in India. The atmosphere and location are both fantastic, and there's no VAT or service charge!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rakesh Reddy

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a very strong food halal restaurant. We felt like it had been 5 days. I felt like I was sitting in a good restaurant in Pakistan and was saying that the entire staff was in Urdu, so it was easy to order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Syed Nain

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant had been renovated, and the owner was very welcoming. When we left, he even had his employee buy a chocolate for my daughter as a gift.
sample_reviews_en.author: qing li

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great authentic taste, really excellent and fast service.
Always nice to find a good Indian restaurant while travelling.
Thoroughly recommend!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Safety Dance

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s a really good India good the curry lamb are amazing and delicious and the place are Clean comfortable good restaurant to visit it
sample_reviews_en.author: 俞俞丞

restaurants.name: Pae Heng
restaurants.address:

5/7 บางยอ Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A must-try on Wongnai! Delicious food at a reasonable price. I saw a review of this restaurant on YouTube today, so I decided to give it a try. I wasn't disappointed.

The restaurant is on the side of the road. There's no parking. You can usually find parking on the side of the road in front of the restaurant or at the gas station across the street.

The food is delicious. The portions are generous and the prices are reasonable. See the photos. I took some photos, but not others. Please forgive me, haha.

The atmosphere is normal. It's like a roadside single-dish restaurant. There were always people coming and going when I was there, but it didn't feel crowded at all. It was very chill.

I recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: santi noikamon

sample_reviews_en.text: For all you westerners, if you ever happen to venture out here, this is probably the best duck you’ll ever have! All they do is duck, in lots of different preparations, and it’s absolutely brilliant! Very down to earth open place with a tin roof, so be prepared to be almost as hot as the food ;). It’s worth it. Warm welcoming vibe & service, although probably not a word of English. It doesn’t matter; pointing works just fine. Prices very low, as you would expect in a place that rarely sees any foreigners. Highly recommended. There are also beautiful temples and nature walks in the area. Definitely tedious to reach from the city, but between Grab and the ferry boat crossings it’s absolutely doable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert Pytela

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is located by the roadside, so parking is a bit difficult. I saw ducks hanging and several cars parked, so I decided to stop by. I wasn't disappointed. The braised duck slices were thick, with a light, fragrant braised sauce, and had a chewy, not tough, texture. The roasted duck was juicy and not too dry. The duck was well-prepared and had no gamey smell. If you like to gnaw on duck necks, they're 20 baht per piece, or 3 pieces for 50 baht, with plenty of meat. They also have noodles, green noodles, and crispy pork. If you're passing by, you should definitely stop. Even if you're not, it's worth the visit. The prices are reasonable, and the staff are all very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: ตามรมณ์

sample_reviews_en.text: This duck roast and braised duck shop is located before entering Bang Nam Phueng market. I ordered dry noodles with roast duck; the noodles weren't soggy but not firm either, slightly soft. The roast duck meat was firm, and the sauce wasn't overly sweet. I also ordered rice with roast duck and crispy pork; the sauce was slightly salty, not sweet. Personally, I didn't like the rice because it wasn't fluffy. The duck soup had a good broth. The portions are large, the prices are good, and the food comes out quickly. Overall, it's good. The owner and the aunties provide excellent service. The shop has plenty of seating, and you can park on the street in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuch S

sample_reviews_en.text:
We started our trip with duck rice at "Pa Heng" restaurant. I highly recommend trying it. The duck is reasonably priced, tastes great, and is very enjoyable. The roasted duck has a unique aroma, and the braised duck is flavorful. They have a delicious dipping sauce – a soy bean paste mixed with seafood – it's insanely tasty!

Follow us on:
FB Page► Laksi Review: Amazing reviews from a woman in her 40s
IG► @laksireview
TIKTOK► @laksireview
YOUTUBE► Laksi Review: Amazing reviews from a woman in her 40s
sample_reviews_en.author: หลักสี่ รีวิว

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pae Heng is a famous duck noodle and duck rice restaurant in the Phra Pradaeng area. It has two branches; this is the second one. It's not as crowded as the first, but the quality is just as good.

I've eaten here many times. The taste is excellent, the duck is cooked perfectly – not dry, with a slight chewiness that's pleasantly firm (though it might be a bit chewy for the elderly). The sauce has a traditional flavor, slightly sweet and salty. The drinks are rather light in flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kasan Chanto

sample_reviews_en.text: This duck noodle shop serves two types of duck: braised duck and roasted duck. The portions are very generous, and the flavor is on the sweeter side – perfect for those who like sweet flavors. It's very affordable, and the shop is clean. If you live near Phetchahung Road, Soi 17, it closes exactly at 2 PM. Don't go after 2 PM! Parking is available on the street; you'll need to find a spot yourself. The street isn't as crowded as it used to be.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ninapranee TV

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and affordable, generous portions. I love the crispy glass noodles, the jade noodles are also tasty, the roast duck rice is delicious, and the crispy pork is excellent. Prices are inexpensive, 50-60 baht. Parking is available in front of the shop. Food is prepared quickly, and there are plenty of staff, so you don't have to wait long. The shop is located right by the road, perfect for those going to Bang Nam Phueng Market.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiranan Boonraksa

restaurants.name: คำรัก Kamrak ร้านอาหารและคาเฟ่ริมน้ำ
restaurants.address:

225, 1 Phet Kasem Rd, Bang Wa, Phasi Charoen, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my second visit to this small riverside restaurant.
It wasn't busy today, but the wait was extremely long. We ordered before other tables, but our food arrived at the same time.

This resulted in our food being cold and bland. The rice was also cold. We ordered six dishes and waited for everything to be served. Some dishes were ready before ours, and by the time they were served, they were already tasteless. This needs improvement. We ordered shrimp fried rice with chili, chicken basil stir-fry, pork with garlic rice, mushroom salad, fried tofu, and fried chicken. The rice was cold, the fried egg was bland, and the stir-fried shrimp was starting to get cold – it was inedible. The soup wasn't hot either. I'm not sure if they were understaffed, but they waited for all the dishes to be cooked before bringing them all out at once. A table that arrived after us received their food at the same time.

This needs improvement. The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, is close to home, and I intended it to be my regular spot, but today was a little disappointing. The taste wasn't the same as before.
sample_reviews_en.author: ดี ดี

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant in the Phetkasem area offers food, drinks, and desserts at reasonable prices. The atmosphere is nice; it's not crowded on weekdays, but I'm not sure if it's busy on weekends. There's parking available, and both indoor and outdoor seating is provided.

Today, I ate inside the air-conditioned room because I needed a quiet space to work. It was nice and quiet on a weekday. I ordered about three or four dishes: spaghetti with minced shrimp, crab fried rice, some kind of tom yum soup (I can't remember the name), fried tofu, and a less-sweet Thai tea.

The food tasted good; everything was delicious. The Thai tea was also just right.
Inside, they sell OTOP (One Tambon One Product) clothing, bags, and other items (I didn't take pictures).

The parking area is spacious and can accommodate many cars.
The outdoor area is next to the river, offering a nice and cool atmosphere. If you don't know where to eat, you can try this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yurawadee Pinanchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall good food and great atmosphere, but service workflow needs improvement.
The food here is a bit of a mixed bag—some dishes were delicious, while others fell short on flavor or didn't quite hit the mark. The Basil Stir-fry (Pad Kaprow) was tasty, and the blended drinks were good, but other stir-fried dishes lacked depth and flavor. Overall, the food is decent, though not mind-blowing. Food decoration is so nice.
The biggest issue is the service speed and organization. Dishes took a very long time to come out, and the serving order was chaotic—main dishes arrived before the steamed rice, and drinks weren't served first as they usually are in standard restaurants. They definitely seem to struggle with kitchen organization and order sequencing.
On the bright side, parking is a bit limited but wasn't a problem for us. The location right by the water is excellent, offering a great, relaxing atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Surat Jewpojaroen

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is another restaurant that I was very impressed with. The food is delicious and flavorful, and what I especially liked was the excellent service from all the staff. They were very attentive and friendly.

The atmosphere is also great. The restaurant is located right by the canal, with both air-conditioned indoor seating and an outdoor area by the canal. Anyone who likes to relax and enjoy the breeze will love it. 🌿✨

The menu has a wide variety of choices, whether you want rice dishes or individual side dishes. Overall, the food is well-prepared, delicious, and very enjoyable.

In short, I was impressed with the food, the atmosphere, and the service. It's a restaurant I would definitely return to if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Iyada Th

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a cozy, homey restaurant located by the Phasi Charoen canal. It's quiet and peaceful, with parking for about 10 cars. There are both outdoor and air-conditioned seating areas. The outdoor seating has about ten tables. It's not suitable for customers who want to have loud parties because the atmosphere is very quiet; you can hear anyone talking loudly.
The food takes a little while to arrive; we ordered 3 dishes and waited about half an hour, but it was acceptable since we weren't in a hurry. The food was delicious and the portions were generous. The staff were friendly and polite. Overall, it was a good place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pitchy W

sample_reviews_en.text:
April 22, 2023

Kam Rak Cafe is a canal-side cafe on Phetkasem Road.
The atmosphere is nice and shady, with both indoor and outdoor seating.

The menu mainly consists of single-dish meals, along with snacks, drinks, and desserts.

Food is served quickly, and the staff are lovely and provide good service.

Recommended dish:
Crispy Pork Stir-fried with Chili and Salt, served with Creamy Egg Rice (119 THB)

Conveniently located near BTS Bang Wa station.

Opening hours: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM. Closed every Monday.
sample_reviews_en.author: manuddear

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted pretty good. The vibe of the restaurant was nice and cozy, with an outdoor area. It seemed like they didn't just sell food; they also had clothes, woven bags, and handmade items for sale. They serve both savory and sweet dishes. I went during a long weekend, so the food took a while to arrive, and several cakes were sold out. Parking is limited, but the pin on the map isn't quite right; drive a little further and look for the restaurant sign at the entrance of a narrow alley.
sample_reviews_en.author: WA AN

sample_reviews_en.text: The receptionist was very lovely. The food was reasonably priced, but VAT wasn't included. The coffee, which the shop said was Vietnamese, was delicious. The plum juice was also tasty. There was a wide variety of food to choose from. Seating was in an air-conditioned room. There were clothes and other items for sale inside. I really liked the view by the canal, but today I wanted to sit on the sofa. The service was excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tipcha Tip

restaurants.name: แซ่บไฮน์ พัทยาใต้ Zaab High South Pattaya
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 111/73 S Pattaya Rd, ตำบลหนองปรือ Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice middle sized thai restaurant with calm atmosphere, staff was friendly and attentive and the service was quick. it is said that cuisine is specifically of Isaan region. I went at 11 am for a late breakfast and got a mixed mushroom soup, rice,  an omelette, a bottle of water and an americano for a total of 253b. The soup was great filled to the brim with assortment of mushrooms and some greens.

The place is very clean with the nice interior with some hanging decorated lamps above every table and a cute graffiti on the wall with symbolic references to the titular region.

The place seems to be especially great for companies of 4 people because they have a variety of dishes that are meant to be shared, like large stew pots or a hot pot on a live fire, they give everyone at the table a small bowl to put food in from the pot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aleksandr Mikhailov

sample_reviews_en.text:
What an amazing find. We had some errands to run in the area so we searched on-line and found this place. The reviews sounded good so decided to give it a try. We are so glad we did. Simply put, just some amazingly tasty esarn food. With spice levels to suit any taste. Fast, efficient and super friendly service/staff.

A reasonably priced menu with a variety of dishes from the North East of Thailand. Our only regret was not being super hungry as we would've loved to try more.

Thank you for an awesome late lunch. We'll be back to taste the rest of the menu, plus some desserts, as we failed to order sweets this visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeremiah Abrogar

sample_reviews_en.text: vibe and decor inside totally rocked. super clean and staff was awesome. I thought the food would be watered down due to the tourists but thank goodness this is not the case. hands down the best fried rice i have eaten in a LONG TIME! the flavor, you can taste the high heat from the wok, I mean flavor town was there. I love the fish sauce wings, I love that they didnt bread the thing like in the US. they use the natural skin to get the great crispness and that sweet tangy fish sauce on top...wow. Tom som was freaking awesome, sweet, tangy, sour, and packs sum heat.
sample_reviews_en.author: w k

sample_reviews_en.text: I randomly chose this restaurant because I saw a picture of fried food in a wicker basket. The plating was so stylish and perfect for photos. The sun-dried pork and Northeastern Thai sausage were excellent, especially when eaten with the spicy dipping sauce. The Thai papaya salad was standard for central Thai tastes, easy to eat and clean. If you're looking for a place to have a long, comfortable meal and chat in a cool, air-conditioned environment, I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vipob39

sample_reviews_en.text: We were with my friend at this cafe yesterday and got poisoned. My symptoms started after 15 minutes we left this cafe: nausea, diarrhea, vomiting, strong fever, muscle pain. I asked if meat and fish are fresh, she said yes (of course). I don’t know what they put on these tom yams. Need to take pills for the last days of my vacation. I am shocked. We went there only because of good reviews, but now i suppose they are purchased because there is no bad reviews almost
sample_reviews_en.author: misha Finogin

sample_reviews_en.text:
All of the food, service, atmosphere and cleanliness is great at this restaurant.

Isan style food done perfectly with fresh ingredients and good quality meats and fish

Portion sizes are medium, price is minimal, and I can’t stress enough what an amazing restaurant this place is.

Great to take a Thai girl on a date, any Thai woman will not be disappointed.

I highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Doctor Kutchapeckeroff

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's Issan and Thai restaurant. We got Combo set at 599BT. Many dishes were coming and each of them were really goos, specially salmon one was really good. The amount was good enough for 2 persons. It was a bit too much.
The I had 30 percent of chilli and was really spicy and hot. Better not to order 100 percent of spicy, you cannot finish if you are not Thai people....
sample_reviews_en.author: The MY World

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very delicious food, presented eye-pleasingly. Less spicy by demand. Very polite and swift service, clearing empty plates immediately.
I landed at the table next to the loudspeaker and had to eat against noisy, scratchy, nervous music (note that I did not ask for remedy). The room has a bit of a canteen, they sell some nice handicraft, supposedly from Isarn.
sample_reviews_en.author: hn

restaurants.name: Origami Restaurant Sukhumvit 24 Borderless Cuisine
restaurants.address:

L Floor, Staybridge Suites Bangkok Sukhumvit, 89/8 89/9 Sukhumvit 24 Alley, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Origami Restaurant – Sukhumvit 24 🌸✨

If you're looking for a restaurant in the Phrom Phong area that's both delicious, has a great atmosphere, and is a nice place to sit, Origami is a very interesting option.

They offer Borderless Cuisine, blending flavors from various cultures to create exciting and unique new dishes.

Whether you're having a family dinner or a romantic date, it's perfect. The restaurant's warm and relaxing atmosphere, along with a wide selection of drinks including coffee, cocktails, mocktails, and wine, makes for a great choice.

Another highlight is their selection of high-quality ingredients. Every dish is prepared with care, from the smallest details to the final touches, resulting in visually appealing and delicious meals.

In addition to dine-in, Origami also offers catering and private party services for birthdays, graduations, farewell parties, baby showers, or New Year's parties, creating a delicious and stylish atmosphere.

📍 Located in Sukhumvit Soi 24, it's easily accessible. Anyone who visits is guaranteed to leave with a memorable experience.

---

#Eatanywhere
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachit Chairat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a chance to visit twice this week. Excellent atmosphere and Japanese music. Food presentation was also great although flavour-wise, some worked really well and others were so-so.

Living up to its name, beautiful origami papers were available with folding instructions. The really friendly staff were eager to demonstrate how to fold cute paper rabbits, foxes or cats.

Would recommend the salmon miso, salmon cream spaghetti and chicken karaage. For desserts, both the brownies and green tea cheesecake were delicious.

Avoid the rice dishes though. They were a little too heavy on rice with not enough meat/fish/prawn --- not great value compared to the high price tag.

There was a special deal on offer where you get a free drink if you give them 5 stars. Might have considered it if they cared about honest opinions from customers rather than buying a perfect score, so subtract 1 star...
sample_reviews_en.author: Tiger Yotsawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went on February 15th, 2026 for the Valentine's Day special ❤️❤️❤️. Each person got 5 dishes, costing almost 4,000 baht. At first, I thought we wouldn't be full, but we were extremely full. The staff provided excellent service, always smiling and attentive. They served the food appropriately and didn't rush us. The restaurant atmosphere was great; there was only one other table occupied when we went, making it quite private. The food tasted good, and the restaurant was beautifully decorated. Parking is available in the building, and you need to scan your parking ticket at the restaurant. The restrooms in the building were quite clean. We went without a reservation, but overall, we were very impressed. My favorite dish was the steak; it wasn't tough at all. The mocktails and cake were a little too sweet.
I'll definitely come back again if I have the chance. 🌹🌹
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploiieas As

sample_reviews_en.text: 🍽️✨ If you're looking for a restaurant that offers something new and out of the ordinary, you must try Origami Restaurant Sukhumvit 24 – Borderless Cuisine, a fine dining restaurant that takes inspiration from various ethnic cuisines and combines them with modern cooking techniques to create dishes that are both beautiful and delicious like no other. 🌏 The menu is designed to be borderless, not limited to Japan, Thailand, or Europe, but combines premium ingredients from around the world. 🥂 Whether it's fresh seafood, premium meats, or meticulously prepared organic vegetables, every bite is an impressive taste experience. The restaurant's atmosphere is elegant and modern, perfect for a special dinner or a meal with a story. ✨
sample_reviews_en.author: JOYANTHIYA

sample_reviews_en.text: Cute and relaxing Japanese fusion cafe, origami themed. Creative and international fusion menu, beautifully presented, while some food is slightly on the salty side, most of the dishes we tried were delicious: spicy tuna puri, quesidilla mentaiko, teriyaki butterfish and lentils, Wagyu Beef Roll, tofu salad, Kaizen Don, Yuzu Josei (mocktail), soy cappuccino (lactasoy, sweet). Has a nifty electronic menu that you can order and free origami instructions and paper in case you want to play. My one critique would be as a high-end cafe, I would expect oat or almond barrista milk to be available to complement the extensive drinks menu that should be a strong point.
sample_reviews_en.author: Monsicha Pongrujikorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Never try a coffee here.

First the coffee came and it was too strong to drink. We asked to take it away and we paid for it. It’s just undrinkable.

The staff admitted they had put too much shot and offered another cup. The second cup served and the tongue was burnt only in one sip. It’s extremely hot.

The staff should be trained how to make a coffee basically. We love the place unfortunately the coffee had ruined our morning.

Not including the staff do not know the name of this restaurant and she spent sometimes figuring it out with her colleagues. We need it to order Starbucks in to save our morning!
sample_reviews_en.author: patcha bundit

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the best place for Japanese food in BKK.  It is easy to access and arranged so that the seating is very comfortable for westerners.

I am staying in the hotel for a long term and eat the breakfast daily.

What is most special is how attentive and considerate the staff is.  And it is consistent across ALL employees.

They keep this restaurant spotless and refreshed.

All staff are so helpful and kind.  I would specifically mention Kat, Get, Fern, Noi, Noi Na, Dow, and many others whom names I cannot recall.

Highest recommendation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jonathan Fife

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stayed at Staybridge Suites Bangkok Sukhumvit and I gave it a try for this restaurant since I saw those reviews were good.
I ordered three dishes as below.
Quesadilla Shrimp with spicy Mentiko Sauce THB 300
Udon Khao Soi with Chashu THB 350
Wagyu Beef and Tuna Donburi THB 500
Everything was good except that the Wagyu beef was too gluteny to chew.
Nice place with smiling waiters, I'm very satisfied with it.
What's even better is that you can get 15% off by showing your room card, so I highly recommend guests come and dine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Chang (托里尼)

restaurants.name: Home Ground BKK
restaurants.address:

114/3 Soi Vibhavadi Rangsit 17, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food, both savory and sweet, tasted delicious.
Every dish had a unique flavor; it wasn't the typical mass-produced taste you find everywhere.

The dishes that everyone agreed were delicious were:
- Prawn & Ponzu
- Truffle and Scallop
- All the protein dishes were excellent: Salmon, Cod, Scallops, Wagyu. Everyone was happy.

Our favorite dessert was:
- Yuzu Khao Kaeb
The apple tart was quite sweet though.

The chef mentioned that the menu is seasonal, changing depending on the available ingredients.

The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, but the entrance might be a bit deep and narrow, and parking is limited because it's the chef's own home (true to the name "Home Ground").

As for the service, the staff were excellent – ​​perfectly attentive (they even came to check on us as soon as we parked).

The chef was also very kind, coming out to take care of us and explaining the ingredients used in each dish, which are grown around the restaurant. Haha!
He has a lot of passion for cooking; I was very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chutipa Prapruetchob

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was incredibly delicious 😋 I'll definitely be back.
I got to chat with the chef; he's a Thai chef who's worked abroad for many years. He's amazing!

Recommended dishes: Honestly, everything was delicious, but my favorites were:
✨Savory dishes:
-Duck confit: The baked rice was amazing with lots of ingredients. The duck skin was crispy and the meat was incredibly juicy.
-Tou: I can't remember the name, but the one-bite bread was so delicious! One piece wasn't enough! I wanted more. The bread wasn't oily and was incredibly crispy.
-I loved all the other dishes too. They were all delicious, no exaggeration.

✨Desserts: All of them were delicious! Highly recommend:
-Yuzu mhoo yong: Amazing! I've never tasted this flavor anywhere else. It's unusual but perfectly balanced. I'll definitely order this again!

-The flavors were spot-on. The atmosphere was great, and they have a good selection of beers.
-Ample parking.

P.S. They also have board games at the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mega Poong •-•

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to Home Ground BKK on a very last-minute booking with my partner and it turned into one of those meals that just really stays with you. The atmosphere was calm and welcoming and the food was the real standout. The crab and brioche starter worked so well, really fresh crab with yuzu and aioli, and the crisp bread just pulled it all together. It was a really well thought-out dish. The chef coming over to take our order and explain how he confits the duck was a really nice touch, and both the duck and the wagyu hanger steak with chimichurri and red wine sauce were full of flavour and cooked perfectly. The pink power cocktail was sweet, delicious and beautifully presented, and the panna cotta was the perfect way to finish. Such a nice evening and we'd definitely go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Katherine Knight

sample_reviews_en.text:
Almost everything was delicious (except for the fried mantou with mayo sauce). It was creamy but not greasy, and the flavors were well-balanced. The balsamic salad was very refreshing. The cold-pressed juice and soda were perfectly sweet and sour.

The restaurant is beautiful, clean, and spacious with high ceilings.
The staff provided excellent service, attentive but not intrusive.
The menu is only in English, so you have to carefully read the ingredients.
However, the presentation is beautiful and easy to understand.
The menu isn't very diverse, focusing on Western cuisine.
The desserts weren't good; they were excessively sweet.

The restrooms were very clean. Parking is limited.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eiffel

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a very surprising restaurant. I didn't think there would be a restaurant in this alley. The restaurant is beautifully decorated and is in a house. There is quite a bit of parking. The road to get in is quite narrow, but the food is delicious. The dishes are menus that you won't find anywhere else. It's like a combination of dishes that you can understand. The taste is delicious. Some dishes are unusual, but surprisingly delicious. The size of each dish is quite small for one person. The price is considered almost high, but not too expensive when compared to the quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suttiruk Salaluk

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't usually review restaurants, but I made sure to write one because I was so impressed. The restaurant is beautiful and private, the food was delicious, and the staff provided excellent service. The price was reasonable considering the quality and service. I went on my birthday, and the owner and chef gave me complimentary gifts, which was incredibly thoughtful. I've received similar gifts from other restaurants before, but this one was exceptionally thoughtful and memorable. I was so happy!
sample_reviews_en.author: k kie

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is beautiful, well-decorated, and clean. It's located somewhat hidden, and parking is limited.

The staff are lovely and provide excellent, attentive service.
The food is delicious and great value for money.

The fried mantou (steamed buns) were amazing, I really liked them.
The spaghetti was a little bland.
The steak was decent, but not amazing.

The desserts were good; the tea ice cream was delicious, and the milk ice cream was also tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chotiwat Hardware

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a home-style Western restaurant, and almost everything is delicious. There's only one thing we didn't like, but others might. Everything else was great, the food came out quickly, and the staff were all lovely.
Parking is quite limited, but since we were the first ones there, we were able to park right in front. The prices are reasonable; for four people, ordering nine dishes cost around 4000 baht, which isn't bad at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tevika Chaengsuk

restaurants.name: R & B Karaoke
restaurants.address:

1124 2 ซอย นราธิวาสฯ 9 Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
For those who want to sing, I highly recommend this R&B branch. It's suitable for all generations. I've used their services many times and this branch is my favorite.
And for those who enjoy food and drinks, the food is delicious and the drinks are excellent, just as good as the music.
There's a wide variety of menu items, and the staff are very friendly and helpful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chutatip Keasama

sample_reviews_en.text: The karaoke machine is good, with a touchscreen, making it easy to find songs. The food is okay, but the prices are expensive. For a small room, there's an extra charge of 100 baht for more than 5 people.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charin

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the sound system was great, there were plenty of rooms to choose from, and the price was reasonable. I was very impressed and will definitely come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wenika Chobngam

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was great. The rooms were clean, the music was varied, and the staff were very friendly and helpful. The food and drinks were delicious and reasonably priced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornnapa Kabkangplu

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was great, the staff were friendly and smiling, and they were very helpful with the sound system. The props we used for decorating were a lot of fun!
sample_reviews_en.author: run

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent, the room had a great atmosphere, and the food was delicious. It was a fun trip with friends and great value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: HATTAYA KITSAMUT

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my second visit, and I'm absolutely hooked! The staff provides excellent service and is very attentive. The food is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: ครีม ชลิ

sample_reviews_en.text: Rooms of various sizes, clean and new, plenty of parking, diverse music selection with good sound, and delicious food.
sample_reviews_en.author: rattapanit srisawat

restaurants.name: CAFE LA PLAGE
restaurants.address:

Room w :11, 137, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We ate here for brunch and dinner on the same day. We had pizza and brown sugar coffee and a late and the food was very delicious and I enjoyed the pizza and the coffee. The customer service was excellent and the staff were very friendly. The cafe looks over the beach in Pattaya which is great and you can even sit and chill and have a drink and just watch the ocean. There is also some colourful things setup on the second floor where you can take some Instagram photos or just cool photos. In the evening this place comes alive and it was very busy and there were people on the dance floor or people just having a drink and relaxing on the first floor. We sat on the second floor and had Thai food for dinner. We were a little disappointed with the Thai food that’s why it lost a star but the rice we ordered with our dishes was very nice. Overall these place does have a great selection on the menu and worth a visit. I did do a quick review and walk through on my YouTube channel “The Travelling Social Worker” so check it out if you are interested.
sample_reviews_en.author: GREGORY EGAN

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very pleasant restaurant offering tasty food and a great location. The second floor is a rooftop terrace with panoramic views of the beach and the sea from all sides, which creates a particularly enjoyable atmosphere, especially in the evening.
The only drawback is its position on a busy beachfront street, with heavy traffic, many people, and lots of tourists, making it rather noisy. However, if you are in a relaxed mood, this is easy to overlook.
The food is flavorful and offers a good variety, including both local and Western dishes, most of which are slightly adapted to international tastes. The service is good, the atmosphere is enjoyable, and the restaurant is clean and well maintained.
The place is mainly oriented toward mass tourism, but it still delivers a pleasant dining experience. It is especially enjoyable to spend an evening here during the holiday season, when the weather is warm and inviting, while Europe is still locked in a cold and gloomy winter.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andy Cara Vaggio

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have visited this restaurant and bar about 15 times on visits to Pattaya.  Generally good Thai (I am told) and foreign food.  Nice views of Beach Road, staff friendly enough.

Tonight we visited and ordered a Singha tower for four people.  Two of the three drinking independently said it didn't taste right.  We then compared it to a bottle of Singha and it was different in both colour, taste and gas.

Staff not interested, just said it was fresh.  Maybe it was, but not Singha.  Left 2.5L in the tower and no tip.  We were gone and never to return.

Never had a problem with Chang or Singha draft there before.  Their loss, plenty of other bars are available!
sample_reviews_en.author: John

sample_reviews_en.text:
The location and everything is great. I sat with a drink for a few hours and was pressured to order more. One woman staff rudely told me “Are you not gonna order anything more? You’ve been sitting for a long time”.

The place was empty and no one was waiting for the table. I could understand if people were waiting or had she been a little more nice about it.

EDIT: I told the staff before that “I’ll order more soon. Please wait a bit” because I was waiting for a friend. That’s when she complained to me. If you have a time-limit policy. please tell the customer beforehand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayata S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent location at the T-junction of beach road and Central road and overlooking the beach. Seating is available in both, downstairs and upstairs in the second floor and in the roof open area.
Serve is quick and presentation is excellent. The place is very clean, tidy, well maintained.
Friendly and welcoming staff as step in.
Food and drinks menu comes in a large (A3) size book that illustrates a large variety of different cuisines, Thai and European.
I only came for a fresh smoothie which I enjoyed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Husain AlHusaini (Husain_Tula)

sample_reviews_en.text: Good place to get a beer and something to eat. They have a great variety.. from Asian to western cuisine. The taste is alright. I enjoyed the breeze hitting straight from the beach on the hot day I had been suffering from. It’s definitely a very crowded area with a lot of hustle, but well that’s the unique experience one’s waiting to experience when in the Land of Smiles. Overall, quite decent and good 👍 worthy of the “PATTAYA” sign, which is right facing this place, and if someone is enchanted by it. 😀
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarah Sharma

sample_reviews_en.text:
The sauce for steamed fish I ordered has been the sweetest I ever tried. For sure it's a sign to reconsider the amount if sugar here...The (lemon/ lime) sauce taste also had some unusual notes (grape fruit like), not sure what it was exactly.
The four cheese pasta my friend ordered were just very average or even below average.
The staff look sad as if they are overworked and/ or not paid enough. The place itself looks very bright from outside, sadly seems not managed properly...
sample_reviews_en.author: Maxim Avdonin

sample_reviews_en.text: What can I say this restaurant has a party of its own from the main party that is which is Pattaya as a whole.. They have their own DJ, very colourful curated atmosphere. The waitresses are very attentive plus one of them really speaks English well which is very commendable. The food is great and they are very accommodating that at that we came in late for a munch.. Thanks a lot for the experience
sample_reviews_en.author: Tinj Eusuya-Deal (Tinjee)

restaurants.name: Mo-Mo-Paradise (ICONSIAM)
restaurants.address:

6th FL 299 Charoen Nakhon 5 Alley, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I had a great service by Khun ออว. It was our first time hot pot and it was wonderful. He explained everything in good english and created his favourite sauce for us. This is personalization of service
sample_reviews_th.author: Raphael Lehmann

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍲 Shabu-shabu heals everything… especially dark broth sukiyaki 😋
On tiring days, just sitting down to eat at Mo-Mo-Paradise is like instant healing.
The dark broth sukiyaki pot is fragrant and rich in flavor.
Dipping thin slices of meat in until just cooked, then eating it with a raw egg is amazing 🥩🥚
Sipping the hot soup with fresh vegetables is so enjoyable you'll forget the day's fatigue.
Sometimes happiness is simple.
Just a good shabu-shabu meal, then plan your next trip ✨

sample_reviews_en.author: ไปอีกแระ paiekrae

sample_reviews_en.text:
I highly recommend Mo-Mo-Paradise at ICONSIAM, especially if you're a fan of shabu and quality beef. I really enjoyed my meal here and felt it offered great value for the price. Everything was well-balanced, from the broth and sauces to the meat and side dishes, and all the flavors worked really well together.

When I visited, there was no waiting time at all, so we were seated immediately. It made the whole dining experience even more relaxing and enjoyable.

The staff were friendly, attentive, and eager to help. Most of them appeared to be from neighboring countries, which wasn't an issue at all they provided excellent service throughout the meal.

One of the highlights for me was the plum ice cream. It was refreshing and the perfect way to end the meal.

The price is very reasonable considering the quality of the beef and the overall experience. I left feeling that it was well worth the money, and I'd definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bebe Kunasinpongsa

sample_reviews_en.text: On September 7th, 2025, around 5 PM, I visited this branch for the first time. I went alone and there was a table available right away. The restaurant seemed more spacious than the branches I usually go to, and it wasn't crowded. The vegetable bar was easy to access and not noisy. The staff had excellent service minds, smiling and providing information throughout. They cleared plates and served food without being asked or having to wait long, as if someone was managing the queue. The table I got was for two, and the tables to my left and right were also occupied by women dining alone. I felt this branch was the most solo diners I've encountered at this branch, which I rarely experience at my usual branches. Overall, I was very impressed with this branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutsara Deepankeaw

sample_reviews_en.text:
Momo paradise branch at Icon Siam, though the place got many rave reviews for its shabu style soup, beef/pork quality. However, as another Google reviewer did mentioned, the service was appaling.

They absolute have no clue of what they are doing. Although, there are one female staff (non-Thai) is willing to help but language barrier also is a issue here in term of communication.

Many grumpy servers that use their head nodding as a gesture to customers instead of yes/no answer via verbal. Very rude actually.

Food itself is ok. Not many pork and beef to pick from.  But the black soup is always good. Sauce is ok too.

Price is 599 Baht per adult (exclusive of VAT and Service Charge 10percent)
sample_reviews_en.author: Donny Boonyamanop

sample_reviews_en.text: It is a shabu-shabu buffet franchise restaurant. There are always a lot of customers. Beef and vegetables are fresh. It is a comfortable table to sit on. The food was delicious. This is one of the best buffet restaurants. I felt that the prices were not expensive compared to the food. I always eat and leave with a full stomach. I feel good. And there is dessert. The mochi is delicious, and the ice cream is especially refreshing and sweet. The restaurant hygiene is also excellent. However, you need to come a little early because people are waiting in line from about 5 p.m. Only then can you eat it.👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Junie S

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a high-quality buffet. There are plenty of staff, providing attentive service with minimal waiting times. I appreciate that they keep empty dishes readily available without needing to ask. There's ample space to order and refill items. They offer both hot and cold drinks. The beef, pork, and duck are excellent. The vegetables are fresh and clean. The mochi is chewy, and the ice cream scoops are just the right size, allowing for plenty of choices. I tried almost every flavor and liked the charcoal one the best.
sample_reviews_en.author: Inthira Atama

sample_reviews_en.text:
Taste and quality are good as standard, but we will not eat at this branch anymore!!!

We feel every time like we come here for begging for free meal. Reception staff doesn't care any queue in front, just let everyone stand and begging for queuing. Wording is not good, terrible service mind.

Waitress doesn't care customer inside, very hard to call them for order.

I would recommend to go to Yuzu Suki nearby if you come to Icon Siam and want to have shabu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kunkrerk kwanjangwat

restaurants.name: Trok khrut cafe :ตรอกครุฑ คาเฟ่
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 58 Trok San Chao Pho Suea, Khwaeng San Chao Pho Sua, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Edited to add my husband and I ate here again Friday night, and just as well enjoyed our food, the FAB rosella cocktails and the crepe with blueberries and ice cream.

My husband and I ate here late Tuesday night, as the place is next door to the Siri Poshhotel we are staying in. It was empty save for us so we had full staff to wait on us ha. They spoken broken English but were lovely regardless. Beautiful and cute interior design, very bougie, and an extensive, mid-priced menu. I just had the salted edamame which was a decent  serving, and the tasty, heaping sundae glass of coconut ice cream with mango atop. My husband LOVED the chicken and egg dish he had. He raved on the spicy flavour- he said the plate was one of the top 5 spiciest dishes he had in his life- but also said it was so flavourful.

A waitress even took our photo of us unasked; very nice of her. Highly recommend for their service, patience and good food.

Only negative here really is it’s cash-only which doesn’t make sense in 2023!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jennifer Smith

sample_reviews_en.text:
Exceptional presentation, excellent food, and wonderful staff.

We stopped at Trol Khrut Cafe for breakfast, getting a mix of their coffees and a Thai tea, all of which were exquisitely presented and a delicious way to kick off our day.

For breakfast, we got a mix of the breakie, eggs, and salmon, and again, the presentation and quality were equivalent to what we had the day before at a Michelin Star restaurant and quite delicious.

The staff are wonderful making Trok Khrut Cafe, in my opinion, well worth a visit if you're in the area!

As a secondary note, we enjoyed it so much that we went back for another round the following morning and got more salmon, coffee, tea, and eggs. Cheers for the fantastic food, ambiance, and sublime service!
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Luisi

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is beautiful and has a great atmosphere. It has two floors, offering plenty of photo opportunities. They have a diverse menu, including cafe items, drinks, and desserts. I tried the bacon carbonara, but personally, I found the flavor a little bland. It would be perfect if it were a bit richer! The staff provided excellent service. If you're looking for a chill place to hang out or a spot with beautiful photos, I highly recommend it. I'll definitely go back to try more menu items if I have the chance. 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: titaporn wen

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a fantastic atmosphere and beautiful, unique decor. There are many seating options, and the lighting is perfect for photos from almost every angle. The food and drinks are delicious and offer great value for money. The ingredients are fresh and the dishes are well-prepared. The staff are lovely, friendly, and attentive. Overall, I was impressed with the atmosphere, the food, and the service. It was a truly enjoyable time at the restaurant, and I would definitely return.
sample_reviews_en.author: G

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is super greasy, we came to this place based on Google recommendations, liked the food in the reviews, but the reality is far from expectations
The food takes a super long time to come out, a lot of things are out of stock, I don't recommend this place, it's not worth starting the day with
We didn't eat what we ordered, but we paid for it
sample_reviews_en.author: Alina Yolovich

sample_reviews_en.text: The pasta sauce was very thin, the noodles were all broken, the bread for the Eggs Benedict was completely soggy and still cold, and the waiters didn't clear empty plates but just played on their phones. Overall, it was a disaster. Fellow countrymen, please don't come here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Weixin Jiang

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere, as well as the quality of the food and beverages, is exceptional. The service provided is also excellent. Additionally, the pricing is reasonable, making it a worthwhile experience. I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kathy B.

sample_reviews_en.text: Really nice place with quality ingredients and menu all was really good except the waiter that didn’t let me sit in the table outside in their smoking table and smoke a cigarette with my coffee and said that I need to replace the glass in a …
sample_reviews_en.author: nadav Ozery

restaurants.name: The Local Canteen
restaurants.address:

158 Soi Naradhiwas Rajanagarindra 3, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This tiny narrow restaurant was a saviour for us when we just arrived to Bangkok. The atmosphere is totally like in an European hipster restaurant, the waiters are nice always attentive and they speak a good English. The food and drinks they are offering are very nice and high quality. Our coconut water came in a bottle and was ice cold. The blended coconut shake was not overly sweet like at other places. Food was also really nice. We ordered two set menus the one with the smoked duck and one with the slowly cooked chicken massaman curry. I was amazed by the quality of the vegetables it wasn’t overcooked it was crunchy and fresh yet still warm and cooked. Very nice seasoning. I would say this restaurant is a European Image result for haute cuisine style restaurant only that the food is Thai and for a reasonable price. Absolutely go for it if you want to taste something special.
For your information it is not possible to pay with card, but there is an ATM about one minute walk from the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Traveling Tiger

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is one of the highly rated Thai food that is nearby to my apartment. We were told that their restaurant in the original location closed down during the COVID period. They relocated 100m down the road and now go by Lon Lon by The Local Canteen.

The food here is really authentic and good.  Our favorite dishes include Fried seabass with sweet fish sauce, Green curry with beef, and Fried pork belly.

We also ordered Spicy duck soup, and egg with minced pork. The former takes getting used to while the latter is nothing out of the ordinary.
On the whole, this is a good dining experience as the environment is nice, food is excellent and service is also pretty good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stephen Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This narrow, long and small Thai restaurant is a jewel in Sathon.

Near to the Chong Nosi BTS station and opposite to Holiday Inn Express, it is located in Soi Phiphat 2 street.

It is cozy, clean and romantic. Various Thai authentic dishes are available. I have been dined more than three times. Their Green curry, Tom Yum soup, Stir-fried Pork with Lime leaves, and many other dishes are delicious and recommendable.

Take away and free delivary within 5km is available. Also offer free 2 hour parking at Trinity Complex and WIFI.

The kitchen hours are 11:30 -14:30 , 17:30 - 21:45. And don't go there on Sunday.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zeyar Tint Wai

sample_reviews_en.text: The Local Canteen experience was fantastic! A group of friends met for dinner and we selected the restaurant more for its central location. But what we experienced was well beyond expectations. The Thai-style dishes were authentic and prepared with high quality. Presentation of the food was excellent. The instagrammers in the group had to do a photo shoot before we could eat. The dishes were delicious and the steamed sea bass one of the tastiest and most tender we have had. If you’re in Silom area and want Thai food with high quality at reasonable prices, this is the place.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Stech

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place to eat! As Bangkok newbies, we weren’t sure where to grab lunch, but the reviews steered us to The Local. The food was great, and we managed to fill out the self-serve menu selection sheet without too many errors. The base level spice was awesome for me, but I eat a lot of extra hot wings back home so ask them to tone it down even more if you can’t handle heat. Lots of great local award winning craft beers which was a bonus! Cash only though - be sure to bring dough!
sample_reviews_en.author: Howie Outerbridge

sample_reviews_en.text: Tucked away in a very narrow facade is the local canteen, it is a modern take on classic Thai dishes. Offering a variety of dishes including salads, curries, stir fry noodles and rice. Lunch and dinner sets offer great value. The local canteen also serves great selection of local Thai and other Asia craft beers as well as a thought out dessert selection. It's great Thai food meets modern cafe ambience, not to be missed if in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benjamin Zhan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cozy ambiance & nice decoration with a great music.  I ordered lunch set, deep fried King mackerel with salt served with Thai Spicy mushroom Soup.  It’s very tasty and generous portion.   The stir fried cabbage (side order) wit h fish sauce is also nice.

I came at 14.00 when the restaurant is nearly closed but the staffs are very welcome.  I’m impressed with a nice & attentive service.  Will definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: sareeraya vorasaph

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very good experience ! We came at lunch time and the lunch menu was really great with good price and good food. Curry and the soup is beyond expectation.
Staffs are supportive, we asked the curry to be less spicy and the staffs even provide the small dishes of curry for us to taste if the curry is too spicy for us.
It's and wonderful experience ! Will come again when visiting Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Viola Lin

restaurants.name: Ant Cave
restaurants.address:

อาคารพาเรด 1511, 1877, 1513 Rama IV Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Bad service ever! The quality of the food was also very disappointing. Several items listed on the menu — like sliced tongue, seafood soup, and fried octopus — were not available when we visited and the staff didn’t inform us at all.

It was also very difficult to get the staff’s attention. We had to wait a long time before anyone came to the table, and the staff did not seem welcoming or attentive.

Overall, the experience was frustrating and far below expectations!

I hope the restaurant improves both its service and menu management so other customers don’t have the same experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ati M

sample_reviews_en.text:
- 599++ Many items were out of stock, and there were many restrictions.
- Most of the beef was very tough, and the staff didn't know why. We just ordered it to try.
- The dipping sauce was ordinary and too sweet.
- The staff couldn't understand what we were saying because they were foreigners, and they had an unwilling attitude and spoke very abruptly.
- You can't return items if they don't match the order (ordered beef with sauce, but received it without; couldn't ask for extra sauce).
- The best thing was the Coke Zero.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sandee Meequamsuk

sample_reviews_en.text: The food portions are generous and the quality is quite good. However, the restaurant has only recently switched to an all-you-can-eat format, so the staff do not seem fully familiar with the workflow yet, which led to a few minor mistakes. In addition, the text on the menu with pictures is too small to read clearly. I hope the ordering process can be adjusted in the future to make it more convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aikidol Pan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Meat is tough and staff are woefully undertrained. They had to ask around five staff before someone finally answered what sort of meat was in the set.

The 300, 700 and 2000 baht meat were all the same in terms of how hard they are to chew - I'm not sure how you can mess up grilling and cutting that much.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patriya P

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was quite delicious. The beef was good, the beef tongue was excellent, and the pork was also tasty. Overall, the food was very good.

However, they have conditions for ordering. Some dishes can only be ordered one per person. There are quite a few conditions, but overall, the food was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nupompom Kwangiezz

sample_reviews_en.text:
Korean restaurant interior with Chinese music.
Clean and pleasant atmosphere, but the menu knowledge and soulless service are lacking. The food was mediocre. I'm not sure I'd return.
QR code ordering seems like a good option.
Having to ask for a menu every time is inconvenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daewhan Kim

sample_reviews_en.text:
We tried their set menu and it’s totally worth it .
I love how they grilled  meats in front of us and put aside . You don’t need to grill by yourself. Plus their fried seafood jeon is so good n not oily at all. You will get with discount price if you have membership 🙌 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Kie Kie

sample_reviews_en.text: The meat was good and delicious, and the mashed pumpkin was amazing. The staff were lovely and provided great service. They even grilled the meat for us! The price was reasonable, and the side vegetables were unlimited. I was very impressed and highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bangearn เจอนี่

restaurants.name: XII Bistro & Bar
restaurants.address:

142, 41 Sathon Soi 12 Alley, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place has been on my wish list for a while and I was so glad I finally got to go.

Mediterranean food is my favorite and I’m always on a hunt to find the best ones in Bangkok and I was not disappointed.

The decor, the ambience vibe of this place is also amazing and coming here for a celebrations would be a great choice. they offer Mediterranean cuisine which covers Italian Greek Middle Eastern and Spanish.

I love the salad. It was really fresh. They offer great selections but the one I try was refreshing and tasty full of great toppings.

We also order Caponata, which is a dish that I always order anywhere I go and here it was done perfectly. The dips were just OK I didn’t find it was standing out or anything. It was basic so I wish they had offer a little bit more, but it came with a lot of bread like pita and also crispy flatbread.

The paella here was one of the best I’ve tried. We had to send it back for them to get a bit crispier, but once that’s done, it was perfect.

We had a little dessert to finish off tonight, and the sorbet was tart and perfect to balance off the richness of the meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amanda

sample_reviews_en.text:
How I was waiting for your reopening after the renovation, and how I sad now!

The Caesar salad from XII was the most delicious in the world — I truly begged you not to remove it from the menu. The Greek salad and the green olives were absolutely amazing as well.

I miss it so much. There is no place in Bangkok that has a Caesar salad as delicious as the one you had with chicken thighs.

Please bring the Caesar salad back to the menu. If you do, I will come to your restaurant every week for a minimum year — it would make me the happiest person. I absolutely adored that salad.

UPD
Dear Craig and the wonderful team,

This truly feels like one of the best New Year’s gifts I’ve ever received.
I honestly can’t put into words how much I love your Caesar salad — it makes me unbelievably happy.

I’ve already ordered for tomorrow 😊
Thank you so much for making this decision and for caring so deeply about your guests.
I’m beyond happy and grateful.

Wishing you all a very Happy New Year!
Thank you for being amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vikki Eliseeva

sample_reviews_en.text:
The dishes here are packed with strong flavors, this is sincerely one of the best restaurants in Sathorn. Inspired by an italian/greek/mediteranean background, the chef shows dynamic culinary knowledge on the dishes we ordered. The manager also knows the best wine pairing and there is a wide selection available. Everyone here was warm and friendly.

The slow cook signature is the best, worth the twenty mins wait. The mash potatoes is beautifully decorated and pristine, how can one make it look loke a piece of art? The meat was good and juicy and goes well with the sauce.

The rissoto is a "must-have", its very thick in taste and the seasoning is spot-on.

The beef tartar appetizer is very good, although the french tartar in Sathorn Soi 10 remains the champion. The portion is rather small so its best eaten with a date and not a group of hungry buddies.

Great outdoor seating, lovely interior design.

It is on the pricier end. We ended up with around THB 2,500 per person since we also opened a bottle of wine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kris Supavatanakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Price Value Champion on Wednesdays

Location:
Great location in Soi Sathorn 12. Next to a lot of nice bars and restaurants. Parking can be bothersome.
The restaurant is above Kai New Zealand restaurant on the 2nd floor.

Food:
Great food. From seafood to pizza. Good ingredients.

Recommendation:
Wednesdays is Bistro Wednesday with Free Flow of the dishes you see on my pictures. For 790THB++

Reservation:
Restaurant is big. So I guess no reservation mandatory.

Service:
Attentive. Speaking English and Thai.

Overall good experience, nice atmosphere and music. Food was delicious and even without free flow it is worth a visit.

We will come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Schell

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s a new Mediterranean/European style gastropub place that offers tapas and entrees from Lebanon, Spain, Greece. Same owner as Kai (next door). Very good food and ambiance. Though it just opened, the service was impeccable. I recommend the 5 different dips & the Greek style pizza. Good place to go with a couple of friends. Everything was good but the drinks are on the expensive side, I just wish they also offer lower price range drinks.  3 of us had a few dishes to share, 1 bottle of wine, 2 beer, it was around 1700/person.  IG@TJ_Storytelling
sample_reviews_en.author: TJ Stories

sample_reviews_en.text: Very cozy and nice restaurant. Great setting. You can easily spend a whole Saturday and drink wine, watch people and eat snacks. They also have a table on the balcony. It’s the same owner and building as the New Zealand steakhouse / restaurant. So you can order from both restaurant. We will try that next time. This time we focused on the upstairs one. The tapas were very tasty. My main - the steak with cafe de Paris sauce - was ok. I had better. Pasta was also good. Not great. A bit over cooked. But all in all very nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is SO GOOD. We ordered the Moroccan spiced chicken thigh (Crispy skin, nicely charred and super juicy), mushroom risotto (rice grain was not overcooked, strong cheese flavour with good consistency), fritto misto (fried to perfection with tasty seasoned crust paired with a really delicious sour garlicky sauce) and 2 sangrias. Everything was really exceptional, the service was excellent and the vibes (+ music) were all on point. Highly recommend to come if you are in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bervyn Goh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Definitely will visit again with friends and family.

Food
Very fresh ingredients
And good choice of beers
Average portion for sharing with friends of 3-4

*recommendation: #1 the scallop !!!  Must try !
#2 the fried calamari, mussels and white fish basket! Definitely are  the beer / cocktails best friends !
As for the brunch menu: the omelette with salmon is just average

Ambience
Good for family and friends
Friendly staff

Price
Slightly higher than average but worth it
sample_reviews_en.author: Floy cheung

restaurants.name: Ton ton - Coffee, Eggs & Baked Goods
restaurants.address:

215 Thanon Tanao, Wat Bowon Niwet, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "An overpriced place Heads-up, they charge 7% tax on top of the menu prices"

sample_reviews_en.text:
Unfortunately, my visit to this cafe left a very unpleasant impression. I came here with a kind attitude and expected the usual respectful treatment of guests, but instead I was met with ridicule and jokes.

It's especially unpleasant when staff treat customers this way. Respect should be mutual, no matter who you're talking to.

I was also repeatedly assured that there was no tea, only to later discover that there was. To me, this feels like deception and only adds to the disappointment.

It's a shame that a place that could have left a pleasant impression showed such disrespect for its guests. Therefore, I'm removing one star and cannot recommend this cafe to others.
I do not recommend this place 🚫⛔️
sample_reviews_en.author: Айсулу Баймужанка

sample_reviews_en.text:
We loved the place. It's a small all-day breakfast spot in the heart of Bangkok. The whole community is lovely and well-reserved, giving off a vibe of the 60s and 70s. We were seated by the window, so it was really nice to watch people and cars pass by.

The service was fantastic. The food was delicious, and our order came very quickly.

If you want to explore the area, this place would be great to visit.

The food was delicious.
The staff were lovely and served quickly.
The food came out very fast, which was great!
The vibe was great, relaxing and peaceful.

There's no parking lot, but you can park at the temple next door and walk over; it's not far.
sample_reviews_en.author: Malinee Ron

sample_reviews_en.text: This brunch restaurant in the old town has a cute and pretty decor. Parking is available along the street. We went for breakfast and found parking wasn't too difficult; we were able to park in the temple grounds. The food was delicious. I ordered the avocado toast, which I loved (though the bread was a little difficult to slice). The picture includes bacon because I ordered it extra. My husband ordered another dish and said it was good, but the waffles weren't very crispy; they were soft. I prefer them crispy and chewy. The food arrived quickly and the staff provided good service. The hot chocolate was delicious. The prices are on the higher side.
sample_reviews_en.author: K C

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food, service, and atmosphere are all absolutely fantastic!

I'm driving two hours to go again this weekend~~ :)

My son especially loved the chicken waffle dish, and my husband really enjoyed the scrambled eggs because they had so much cheese in them. I absolutely loved the coconut yogurt, too~ The coffee was great, too!! Come to think of it, everything was delicious~~ hehe. However, I wish you would add salt and cook the pasta for just a little less time. The sauce was delicious, but the pasta was bland and overcooked, making it mushy, which detracted from the overall taste. I'm going on Saturday, so please keep that in mind~^^♡
sample_reviews_en.author: 샛별명주Bona Korean

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Big Breakfast was delicious! I got to try everything I wanted.
I especially loved the avocado; it was perfectly fresh, not overripe, and paired wonderfully with the Caesar sauce.
The scrambled eggs were excellent! The seasoning was just right – not bland, not too sweet, not too buttery, perfectly salty, and the texture was ideal – not overcooked. Absolutely perfect!

I'm so glad I got to eat here; it was incredibly delicious.

🚗 You can park in the public parking lot on Soi Sake for 30 baht per hour, then walk 300 meters to the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jimmy Kitichaiwat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very good selections of Western brunch items here, including eggs, avocado toasts, waffle and pancakes.

1 star deduction because the food is a little under seasoned. For example avocado on the avocado toast didn’t have any seasoning and could benefit from some garlic powder/salt/pepper and maybe a sprinkling of sunflower seeds. Hash brown was good but also lacked salt.

We really liked the roasted tomatoes and scrambled eggs though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nessa Nguyen

sample_reviews_en.text:
We loved Ton Ton Cafe right across the street from our stay. As Americans, it was a great safe spot to grab some solid Western food in Bangkok.
The food was fresh, tasty, and clean. Perfect when you want something familiar. The staff was so friendly and the place felt safe, spotless, and welcoming overall.
Highly recommend it for breakfast, lunch, or a quick bite. Great service!
sample_reviews_en.author: Raleigh Willoughby

sample_reviews_en.text:
[Bangkok Breakfast Gathering] This was my second time visiting this coffee shop/breakfast restaurant. I noticed they had a really delicious oatmeal porridge on the menu. The other breakfast items and hot lattes were also pretty good, but the oatmeal porridge is definitely my top recommendation.

Prices are mid-to-high range. Service is good, and motorcycle parking is convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hok Zheng Pingfu

restaurants.name: Baan Dalaa by Angkana
restaurants.address:

ชั้น 1 และ 2 2 Kasem San 3 Alley, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Experience the vibrant soul of authentic Southern Thai cuisine at Baan Dalaa by Angkana 🍽️ Located in a 120-year-old house 🏠, where bold flavors, heritage recipes, delicious desserts, and warm hospitality come together in every dish 🌶️✨. From aromatic curries enriched with freshly ground spices to fiery stir-fries and coastal-inspired specialties, each plate is crafted with passion and authenticity 😍, reflecting the rich culinary traditions of the south. Whether you're seeking comforting classics or standout signature creations, Baan Dalaa invites you to savor a truly unforgettable dining experience rooted in culture, craft, and the heart of Southern Thai cooking‼️

.
From coastal-style seafood to every dish crafted with intention and sincerity 😍, Baan Dalaa conveys the flavors and culture of Southern Thai cuisine spanning centuries. Whether you're looking for familiar classics or unforgettable signature dishes, Baan Dalaa invites you to savor a truly refined, warm, and memorable dining experience‼️
sample_reviews_en.author: Rywyn Uttamayodhin (Trustmewithfoods)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’m writing this so no one makes the same mistake and wastes their money. We could only book a table by purchasing a pre paid option. 3 x of Option 1, 2 x of Option 2 and 2 drinks.

The photos of the food look amazing, but when it came time to order in the package it is really limited compared to what’s on the menu itself. For example: there’s HEAPS you can’t pick. So instead we asked to order ala carte instead. I tried to order the Crab Curry: unavailable, along with literally every item on that menu.

I revert back to choosing from our package: sea bass curry: unavailable, along with my next pick.

So instead short: Out of the first 5 things I tried to order NOTHING was available. The Assistant Manager who was on at the time went to the kitchen and never came back. So we forfeited the 1350 baht and left also.

The photos look great but we never got to try anything. The reviews seem great but re reading them I feel like they are paid reviews that people jumped on chatgtp to write.
sample_reviews_en.author: lani williams

sample_reviews_en.text:
Baan Dalaa by Angkana is a true hidden gem in Bangkok.
The restaurant is located inside a beautifully restored 120-year-old colonial-style house surrounded by lush greenery and flowers — a peaceful retreat in the heart of the city.

Chef Annie, who comes from Koh Phangan, brings her Southern Thai roots into every dish. The flavors are bold, aromatic, and deeply comforting — full of authentic spice and warmth.
I especially love how the restaurant balances traditional recipes with a modern touch. Every dish feels like a story told with love.

The atmosphere is bright, cozy, and elegant at the same time. It’s a place that makes you feel at home while discovering something new. Definitely one of my favorite Southern Thai restaurants in Bangkok.

📍 Baan Dalaa by Angkana, Kasem San 3, near BTS National Stadium
sample_reviews_en.author: RattoWanderlust

sample_reviews_en.text: Fantastic restaurant, which is really worth a visit if you visit Bangkok - my family and I were here 3 times the week we were here as we loved the place. The restaurant itself is really nice and has a cozy atmosphere, and the staff were nice.
