The food was absolutely fantastic and exciting, and we felt we had a wild taste experience every time we were there while also being full. It was really beautifully presented, and just super delicious. In addition, delicious and exciting drinks. There is a super good correlation between price and quality. The price for a dish that fills you up is about 8-15 dollars - far too cheap in our opinion. We need about 70 dollars for 3 people, so 23 per person with food, sharing dessert and drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: therese dalegaard

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had an absolutely fantastic anniversary dinner here. The setting itself is breathtaking. A beautifully preserved 120-year-old colonial building that adds so much charm and character to the experience. The team did an amazing job by arranging a lovely anniversary setup for us and even providing a private room, which made the evening feel incredibly special.

The food was delicious, with wonderfully generous portions, and every dish was full of flavor. What truly stood out was the warm and hospitable service. The staff made us feel so welcomed from the moment we arrived. It was a memorable experience from start to finish, and we can’t recommend it enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: Janie Martin

sample_reviews_en.text:
DINING: Baan Daala is truly a hidden gem in the city. Set in a beautiful old house that has been transformed into a Thai restaurant, the space is filled with well-maintained antique interiors. It’s spacious and suitable for all kinds of groups, including private dining. The atmosphere feels cozy and peaceful, surrounded by trees. Service is exceptional.

FOOD: The food specializes in Southern Thai cuisine, making each dish unique and full of character. The flavors are authentic and traditional, using high-quality local ingredients. Everything is incredibly flavorful, and every dish in the photos is a must-try.

Parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Asianeats Bangkok

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is beautiful. It's housed in an old house, spacious and grand with separate rooms, decorated with lovely ginger lilies. There are many photo opportunities.
Today we ordered three dishes: spring rolls with oyster mushrooms and ginger lily dipping sauce / rice noodles with crab curry from Koh Phangan / train station fried rice. The portions weren't small; two people were completely full... Everything was delicious! Highly recommend it. The staff are all lovely, smiling, and have excellent service minds.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nantida Unchan

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my second visit. The food is delicious and the ingredients are high quality. The curry might be a small portion, but it's perfect for two people. I highly recommend trying their kaffir lime dessert; it's amazing! The atmosphere in the restaurant is nice, and the staff are very attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wi. S

restaurants.name: Aunt Lek restaurant Samsen 4
restaurants.address:

376 ซอยสามเสน 4 Sam Sen Rd, Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a hidden gem between a lot of restaurants and bars. A family street food, with 3-4 tables. We have visited this place after i have read the reviews before. We ordered 3 food (pad thai, pad see ew, kanom pak kard ), and all of them was perfect, better then you get in restaurant in Thailand. An old woman and a young guy cooking constantly, you can see how your food made. A lot of local arrives minute to minute to take away their pre ordered dinner. All of the food were cheap so absolutely worth it. You must have to give a try! I think they are cooking with love. It is a very small place first we have visited the restaurant next to this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gergely Tamás

sample_reviews_en.text: This place was great! Reminds me of what I saw of Jay Fai on the Netflix street food show before she moved into a building. Aunt Lek is a hard working food slangin grandma! She even gave me a very friendly smile when I thanked her in Thai after our meal ☺️ The food was fast, fresh and delicious. The crispy pork is craveable! Quick service and low locals prices. The neighbourhood around it is also super cute and lively! We heard live music from the street and saw many other places to get food/drinks. Grabbed beers from the store across the street to drink with dinner.
sample_reviews_en.author: El Styles

sample_reviews_en.text: In the UK people have £20k kitchens which they use to heat up ready made meals from Tesco and Asda. This is just a simple street food stall with 3-4 tables serving delicious home made authentic thai meals for between 50-100 baht. You might wait a little longer for food, this is because the locals order their take away food from here. That tells you all you need to know about this special place. I recommend the turnip cakes in oyster sauce - a unique dish I've never seen anywhere else in Thailand. This whole area is full of great places to eat - read my other reviews.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pg1988

sample_reviews_en.text: The flavour of authentic Thai foods that is like my grandmother at home makes it.The food has a fragrant aroma from stir-frying in a wok.The best I recommend you to try Stir-fried kale with crispy pork and rice,maybe for foreigner Pad Thai is tasty though,I was bring my Chinese friend she really liked Pad Kha Pao with rice. It's a cosy family business. I recommend adding tables for customers, but with limited space, I hope everyone can wait. When you try to eat here, it's worth waiting for Authentic incredible Thai foods.
sample_reviews_en.author: SARANPHON S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wow, just amazing.
I love to search authentic local places.
I went here, as I read the Google reviews.
As soon as we arrived, all tables were already blocked.
So they got as a additional table.
Soo friendly.
I ordered the Pad Kee-Mao with Crispy Pork.
It was by far 5he best Thai Food I had in a 2 week holiday all over this country.
The price was really cheap and soooo good.
The staff was friendly and amazing.
They were sorting their garbage everything is fresh and clean.
I can recommend this place to everyone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Philipp Thilo

sample_reviews_en.text: Worst experience in Thailand. They discriminate foreigners, cook for locals first. We waited 30 mins and the next table(Thai locals) who came after us already ate and left so I asked, realised they haven’t even started cooking for us. I lost it and said “but we came before them”. and only then he said he would start cooking now for us. I said “no I don’t want it anymore”. Then he said “ok then leave” then I quickly left because if I stay I feel I might cry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emily Wang

sample_reviews_en.text: Wow wow wow. We went next door on our first night and just witnessed the amount of people rocking up on scooters for a takeaway at this place. The tables are simple, a couple across the road and one they setup for us under their cover in the rain. It is exceptional, no other words. Cheap at twice the price...if you like spicy, have the crispy pork pad keemao and enjoy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pete Wootton

sample_reviews_en.text: We're Americans who are huge fans of Thai cuisine. This place is a food stall with a little old lady over a wok. We ordered the Pork Glass Noodle Soup, Pad Kee Mao, and Pad Kra Pao. The Pad Kee Mao was the best my husband and I have ever had - I will dream about this dish. Locals also drove up constantly on mopeds grabbing to go orders, which was a bonus for us.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hope Gardner

restaurants.name: ฟอร์เดียร์ Fordear Chinese Bistro 福蝶
restaurants.address:

110, Rama VI Soi 30, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We come here quite often with our friends, and the food is always delicious! 😋

Today, we came with 6 people and ordered 9 dishes. Honestly, everything we ordered was really tasty. The owner is also very kind and friendly.

They also recommended a new dish that they are planning to add to the menu — crispy fried eggplant with sweet and sour sauce. It was so good and definitely worth trying!

The restaurant is open every day except Sunday.

Highly recommended! If you’re looking for a good Chinese restaurant around Soi Ari Samphan, you should definitely give this place a try! 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Dhanikcha Boonwattanopas

sample_reviews_en.text: Passing by this area and craving Chinese food, I searched on Google Maps and found Fordear (a Sichuan-style Chinese restaurant). The atmosphere was great, with modern decor. We ordered four dishes in total: Sichuan-style dry-fried green beans, Mapo Tofu, noodles with scallion oil, and spicy potato strips. I have to say, every dish was delicious! They had a spicy, numbing, and rich flavor. If you're in the Ari area, I highly recommend this restaurant! 👍🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Nanthikarn Julwanna

sample_reviews_en.text:
A casual Chinese restaurant in Ari Soi.

Today I ordered classic Chinese dishes: Sichuan Tofu with Rice and Stir-fried Tomatoes with Egg.

The Sichuan Tofu with Rice has a slightly spicy flavor because of the Sichuan peppercorns (hua jiao). If you don't like spicy food, you can tell the restaurant beforehand. (Personally, I like spicy food, so the Sichuan peppercorns made it perfect for me 👍🏻)
sample_reviews_en.author: Pearl

sample_reviews_en.text:
My best Sichuan green beans ever! 👍🏻🌶️

We finally found our new favorite Chinese restaurant. The Sichuan green beans were incredibly flavorful, and the crispy Sichuan chili chicken was just as delicious. Everything was fresh, well-seasoned, and full of authentic flavors.

We’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend ka🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
sample_reviews_en.author: Chutikarn Boonya

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. The fried rice was fragrant and perfectly cooked. The food might be a little salty, but it reminded me of China. I ate here at lunchtime; it wasn't very crowded and the music was chill. It would be great to try eating here in the evening. I'll definitely come back again. 🫨
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayut Klangkanasub

sample_reviews_en.text: Really love this Chinese bistro! Right now in the middle of the night I’m craving for their 土豆絲 🤤 what’s the best part they have natural wine to drink along all these yummy Sichuan shanghainese food! One of my absolute favourite place for chinese food in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Somehow in Bangkok

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious! This restaurant is great. Today I ordered less spicy dishes and everything was delicious.
Recommended dishes:
-Noodles with scallion oil
-Stir-fried potatoes and green beans
-Beef stir-fried with cumin (less spicy)
-Pork stir-fried with bell peppers
sample_reviews_en.author: Tabtim Naja

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant worth the 5 star rating!
The best Chinese food I tried in BKK through the whole year.
All the ingredient and taste are super authentic, most of the food is even better than restaurant in China.
I'm a Chinese and I highly recommend the restaurant
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrick Yu

restaurants.name: Shinkanzen Sushi สยามสแควร์
restaurants.address:

Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently discovered a fantastic sushi spot near Siam Square that's definitely worth checking out. The menu is extensive, the prices are incredibly reasonable, and the quality of the food is top-notch. The ingredients are always fresh, and the sushi is prepared to perfection. Each bite of the salmon roe sushi was a burst of flavor, with the fresh roe popping in your mouth and the sushi rice being perfectly cooked. I also enjoyed the various maki rolls, each one packed with delicious fillings.

The staff is friendly and attentive, and the service is quick. I tried ordering through their app, but the English interface wasn't fully developed, which made it a bit inconvenient. However, this didn't significantly impact my dining experience.

The ambiance of the restaurant is a bit dark, and a little more lighting would make it feel more cozy and inviting.

Overall, this is a great sushi place with affordable prices that you should definitely try when visiting Siam Square. If you're a sushi lover, you won't want to miss this spot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sơn Phạm

sample_reviews_en.text:
Highly recommended for anyone in Bangkok who wants to eat omakase sushi with very good taste and service. Even as a Japanese, I think the sushi is excellent and comparable to what I eat in Japan.

I also think it is great that you can eat omakase at an unbeatable price of 1,500 baht per person in Bangkok.

There are two chefs at the counter, each serving three or four sets of sushi to each customer. The workmanship is both deft and attentive, and you can tell that the sushi chefs are well trained. Their explanations of the sushi are concise and easy to understand, and their craftsmanship comes across well.

The waitstaff is also friendly and attentive, and the service is excellent.

Overall, I think this is the best sushi restaurant in Bangkok. It is worth coming here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Munetsugu Kaneko

sample_reviews_en.text:
Shinkanzen Sushi at Siam Square is a popular Japanese restaurant known for its affordable prices and good quality. The sushi starts at just 11 THB per piece, making it a great choice for students and young people. The restaurant is located near BTS Siam Station, Exit 6, and has two floors with a clean and cozy atmosphere.

Some recommended dishes include Spicy Salmon Salad, Grilled Salmon Tempura Sushi, and Karubi Beef Rice Bowl with Egg Yolk. The salmon is fresh, the beef is tender, and the flavors are well-balanced.

The restaurant also offers delivery service, ensuring that food arrives well-packaged and fresh. Overall, Shinkanzen Sushi is a great option for delicious sushi at an affordable price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nammon

sample_reviews_en.text:
“Epic meal for such a price!”
The sushi prices start from $0.34 and could get as (in)expensive as $2.16 a piece which is Foie Gras. I have never tried Foie Gras before in life but unfortunately, they ran out of it the day we went. Boooo!

We ordered quite a lot of food including appetisers with drinks and dessert. At the end of the meal we’re so packed and the bill came in just 200THB a person. I was surprised!!!! Oh! What also surprised me was, they got 2 types of soy sauce for you to choose from, the salty and the less salty one. Never really seen that elsewhere

So..
Good food with great price so Shinkanzen Sushi‘s totally become one of my favourite go to for sushi in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Way Beyond Padthai

sample_reviews_en.text: Yesterday I try to give go to this restaurant as last time delivery took 2 hours. So I select and pay priority and end up with driver cancelling order for « accident » but showing up with order and trying to get payment for himself. I called and tried to pay restaurant directly. I told them driver threaten me and follo me. They end up helping the driver that try to rob the payment and did not do anything. The order was there I had to let it go, driver try to take order from my hands. Restaurant did not propose anything. After 2. Hours we went to buy dinner at 7/11. Shame on the management of this place and customer service. Will never order again
sample_reviews_en.author: BEW Bangkok Electronic Week

sample_reviews_en.text:
A good experience, but clearly not the best sushi I've ever had.

I must commend the impeccable service; the dishes flowed smoothly, and unlike some restaurants, they didn't bring everything to the table at once.

One thing I found particularly odd was the portion sizes, always an odd number, which isn't conducive to sharing. Tempura shrimp are served in portions of three, while gyoza and rolls are served with five pieces—odd.

Also, the ingredients aren't listed on the sushi; some contained surimi, which I didn't appreciate at all.

A good place nonetheless for inexpensive sushi.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thibaud Desroches

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've tried 3,000 Omakase course for 20-22 sushi pieces. Great ingredient like otoro, wagyu, and many fish sushi. By the way, the chef put too much sauce or seasonings in almost everything which I could not taste the real taste of premium ingredients. Otoro is good but too much shoyu sauce. Wagyu beef is so good but the same, too much sauce. If you try 1,500 course, you will get Shutoro instead of Otoro. By the way, great service and nice staff.

IG: @gingunther
sample_reviews_en.author: Gin Gunther

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered takeout, so I can't rate the atmosphere.  But as for the taste - a big thumbs up from me.  Delicious salmon, not a thin slice.  I definitely recommend the salmon sushi.  As for the rest of the sushi, it’s usually delicious.  What I didn't like was the 3 shrimp dish.  I expected something more, but these were literally three shrimp.  with heads, not cleaned.  Better take sushi.  The prices are good.  I would order more and recommend  to you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alyona

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวหมูต้มยำตำลึงนายเอก
restaurants.address:

QCJX+W7V, Liap Thang Rotfai Taling Chan Rd, Chim Phli, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the chance to try Nai Ek's Leng Saap (spicy pork rib soup) again after several years, despite it being close to home. Returning home, I must say the taste is still excellent, even with the name change. The broth is distinctly spicy, with a perfect balance of sour, spicy, and salty flavors. It's refreshing and soothing, not overly spicy or sour. The aroma of lime and chili is prominent, making the taste well-rounded and enjoyable to eat continuously.

The pork ribs are quite large, with meat clinging well to the bone – not dry or tough. The meat easily separates from the bone, making it very enjoyable to eat. Eating it hot allows the broth's flavor to permeate the meat perfectly. Anyone who likes spicy Thai food will definitely love this dish.

Another thing I appreciated was the generous portion size. The price is very reasonable, making it perfect for sharing with friends or family. Some might even order hot rice to go with it, which pairs very well, balancing the spiciness and ensuring a satisfying meal.

Overall, it's a must-try.
sample_reviews_en.author: pakpong pongatichat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The menu offers a wide variety of dishes, not just noodles. They have rice dishes, stir-fried basil chicken, pad Thai, and even desserts. Today I had beef basil chicken, which was very flavorful and delicious. I also had spicy offal soup, which was predominantly sour, almost like it had artificial lime flavor, lacking the aroma of fresh lime. However, the addition of bird's eye chilies made it incredibly spicy. Overall, it was good.
The food was prepared quickly, with minimal waiting time. The seating area is spacious.
The parking lot can accommodate probably 10+ cars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Harmony

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of the best noodle shops in the Taling Chan area, specializing in pork noodle soup with morning glory. They also have pork satay and grilled meatballs as appetizers. But my personal favorite is the chilled banana in syrup. Seriously, you'll regret not trying it! But you have to arrive early because it's a must-order item. If you prefer air conditioning, you can go to the shop next door; this place has natural breezes!
sample_reviews_en.author: Montri Anan

sample_reviews_en.text: We went to the restaurant on Songkran holiday around 2 PM. It was packed. Turning left onto the main road, the traffic was backed up all along the sidewalk, making it difficult to find parking. Most cars were parked there because everyone was coming to eat at this restaurant. The restaurant was clean, but the wind was blowing, making it very hot. The food was delicious; we had the fresh seafood Yen Ta Fo noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sakura Midori

sample_reviews_en.text: This traditional Tom Yum noodle shop serves a flavorful dish, a little too sweet, and the portion is a bit small 😂 But overall, it's delicious. The offal is clean and not at all gamey. The shop is located next to the train tracks, so parking is difficult, and it's a bit hard to find. Could it be considered a hidden gem? 🤔 They have a diverse menu, and the pork satay looks amazing. I'll have to try it sometime! 🤩
sample_reviews_en.author: Yam Asamapohn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is like eating noodles in a garden. I like that there are windows all along the side, so you can sit and watch the street view.
The Tom Yum noodles are delicious; the broth is amazing, fragrant with lime, and the pork offal is tender and not gamey.
There is parking available along the street, which is convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Malee

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's delicious. The original taste is only available at this branch. However, when I went today, it seemed like they had changed the name of the restaurant, and the taste was a bit less intense.
It wasn't as spicy as before, but it's still tastier than all the other branches I've eaten at.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nap Nak.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Leng (pork bone soup) is excellent!
The noodle bowl is quite small, but it has plenty of toppings.
Parking is available along the roadside.
If you buy it to take away and add all the seasonings, it tastes pretty much the same as eating at the restaurant.

Scanning to pay is available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fon S

restaurants.name: อากุ้ย ผัดไทหอยทอด
restaurants.address:

103 Soi Rong Muang 1, Rong Mueang, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Easily one of the best Pad Thai dishes I’ve had. I’m a big fan. There’s no air conditioning, but it’s easy to overlook given the quality of the food. The place is tucked away in a small alley between two garages, which adds to its charm.

The flavors are well balanced and really highlight the chef’s skill. The drinks are refreshing without being too sweet, and the staff are friendly and welcoming.

If you enjoy authentic local food, it’s definitely worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lucas P

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food and the place are a disaster. The positive reviews are because you get a free drink after leaving a positive review. This isn't fair.

There are no vegetarian options on the menu; we asked for a curry dish with vegetables, sauce, and rice. We got just cabbage in sauce and rice. The staff didn't speak a word of English, and communication was very difficult.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piotr Siewierski

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's delicious, surprisingly hygienic for the atmosphere, and cheap.
I wanted to give it 5 stars, but they were running a sneaky campaign where they'd give you a free juice if you left a review, so I'm giving it 4 stars.
Anyway, I'd recommend it to Japanese people too.
sample_reviews_en.author: 忖度なしKID

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered Pad Thai with fresh shrimp and less noodles, and it was delicious. I also ordered fried shrimp dumplings to eat with it. The food at this restaurant is inexpensive and tastes good, but it's hot because there's no air conditioning.
sample_reviews_en.author: anutsara wong

sample_reviews_en.text: Great service! The food was delicious and worth the price. They even have free gachapon (capsule toys)! LOL. I loved it! It was really, really delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: G

sample_reviews_en.text: I spent 12 days in Thailand and this is the best Pad Thai you can imagine, everything was clean and the staff were super friendly
sample_reviews_en.author: David Egi Onteniente

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing food I got the noodles and pork and for just 80 baht it was the best food I’ve had so far in Bangkok
sample_reviews_en.author: Kleber Guerra

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, a diverse menu, and has received many word-of-mouth recommendations.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gift

restaurants.name: ร้านโชคดี โกตา
restaurants.address:

146, 38 Samsen 8/1, Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today, I tried the traditional Hainanese chicken rice at Chokdee, or Ko Ta. It's Hainanese-style chicken rice (60 baht). It's home-style boiled chicken, not the fluffy, soft, chewy chicken you'd find with a little effort. The rice is loose and the grains are small. What's unique is the dipping sauce. Ko Ta offers three types of dipping sauces. The first is a chicken sauce, which I can't quite describe. It's like a seafood sauce base, seasoned with a hint of sourness, saltiness, and spiciness. The second is a simple soybean paste, with minced chili and ginger added to the sauce. The third is a dipping sauce for stewed goat, which I didn't try. I ordered the steamed minced pork and salted fish (20 baht). The pork was tender, with a subtle salty fish flavor and the aroma of fried garlic. It's delicious on its own, and even with the chicken rice sauce.

There are other dishes I'd like to try at this restaurant, such as the stir-fried fish maw and the Chinese sausage salad. I'll definitely be back.

The restaurant is located in a small alley before the Bang Khun Phrom intersection, opposite Wat Intharawihan. Parking is available in the alley, depending on your luck.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paraj Ratanajaipan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lucky Kota – Authentic Hainanese Chicken Rice 🍚🐔
The chicken rice here is authentically Hainanese style. The rice isn't oily or greasy; you can easily eat a second serving.
The chicken is tender and chewy, with crispy golden skin and no fat 👍
The dipping sauce is tangy, salty, and slightly sweet, with ginger and fresh chili, preventing the whole dish from being too greasy.
My must-try item is the steamed minced pork, only 20 baht per piece 😍
It's not too fatty, not too salty, and has a well-balanced flavor – more than worth the price.
Another favorite is the braised bamboo shoots with Chinese herbs 🥣
The soup is clear, not too peppery, and has a well-rounded flavor that's very refreshing.
Overall, everything complements each other well; no single dish overpowers the others.
They enhance the flavors, making this meal incredibly satisfying ✨
If you like this style of Hainanese chicken rice, I highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: JTOTHEJOM

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an authentic Hainanese chicken rice restaurant. The taste is excellent; the rice is fragrant and not too oily, the chicken is tender and chewy with crispy skin, just like free-range chicken with a golden yellow skin. The dipping sauce is fresh, with fresh ginger and chili mixed with a mild fermented soybean paste, perfectly balanced with sourness and saltiness. It was so delicious I ordered a second plate! The steamed minced pork was also delicious, with a well-rounded flavor and fragrant marinade. It was even better when eaten with the rice. As for the soup, I ordered the bamboo shoot and pork rib stew with Chinese herbs. The flavor was well-balanced, fragrant, sweet with Chinese herbs, and mildly spicy with pepper. It was very refreshing to drink. Overall, the food was delicious and worth the price. There are many other dishes worth trying, so I'll definitely review them again next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanapot Saengponsit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hainanese Chicken Rice, a Hainanese Chinese dish, was delicious in every way!!
The Hainanese chicken rice (as many comments have mentioned) is unlike the mainstream version with soft rice and tender chicken. Here, the rice is fluffy, not oily, the chicken is firm, and the dipping sauce is clear, tangy, with chili, (ginger?), and garlic – no soybean paste. I personally liked it; it was refreshing.
The steamed minced pork with salted fish was tender, not too fatty, and mildly salty.
The stir-fried spinach with oyster sauce, Hainanese glass noodles, bamboo shoot stew with Chinese herbs, and fish stewed with plums were all delicious. The stir-fries were fragrant with soy sauce and wok flavor, not oily, and the stews/broths were clear and easy to drink.
The restaurant itself isn't specially decorated and isn't air-conditioned, but it's airy and comfortable. I highly recommend trying it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Paranee Jansawake

sample_reviews_en.text:
Legendary Hainanese Chicken Rice. Come try it before the uncle stops making it.

The chicken rice is dry but still chewy, with yellow chicken skin and a subtle flavor that reminds me of my grandmother's childhood. The chicken is as good as the rumors say.

The pork bone and bamboo pith soup🐷 is a traditional Chinese herbal stew, easy to eat and slurp down.

The fried minced pork with garlic (not on the menu) is a popular order. Personally, I'm indifferent. It's a good protein supplement for the chicken.

This is a restaurant I could eat at every day, provided the distance and parking aren't a problem.

Parking can be difficult due to the alleyway, so you'll have to park on the side of the road or in a temple and walk out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karn Santidhananon

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a very old restaurant, and most of the staff, both cooks and servers, are elderly and very friendly. If you can speak Hainanese Chinese, you can chat with the elderly owners.

As for the food we tried:
• The pork meatballs were incredibly delicious! I was amazed at how good they were. They paired perfectly with the seafood dipping sauce.
• The braised pork ribs had a dark broth, which is unusual. The herbal flavor wasn't overpowering, and there was just a hint of pepper. It was delicious.

They were out of chicken when we visited, so we'll have to try it next time.

Please bring cash; they don't accept transfers.

The restaurant is closed on Wednesdays, and now it's also closed on Thursdays.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yanin Pittayasathornthun

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went on March 1st. The map showed the restaurant was temporarily closed, but it was actually open. I went at 8 am and didn't have to wait in line.

I ordered minced chicken and spinach. The chicken tasted as pictured, but it wasn't quite to my liking as it was boiled chicken. The dipping sauce was well-balanced and delicious. The soup that came with the minced chicken was fragrant with herbs, but unfortunately, it wasn't warmed up at all; it was cold upon arrival.

I highly recommend the spinach. It was stir-fried very well and paired perfectly with the chicken.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mixz

sample_reviews_en.text: I've wanted to eat at this restaurant for a long time, and it didn't disappoint! The chicken was incredibly tender, the chicken skin was perfect, the rice was delicious, and the dipping sauce was in the traditional style. The pork meatballs were amazing. They also have à la carte dishes, so I tried the stir-fried spinach with oyster sauce, and it was delicious. I'll definitely go back to try other à la carte items next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: พงค์ บางนา

restaurants.name: Ban Ya Kaad
restaurants.address:

5, 10 Soi Pradipat, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Nice spot for good homemade Thai food. The price isn’t exactly cheap, but the place is cozy and homey. I especially love their grilled fish and Gaeng Ranjuan (แกงรัญจวน), a rare and authentic Thai dish that’s hard to find elsewhere. It is a flavorful Thai curry with a deep umami taste, originally created as a way to repurpose leftover grilled meat by simmering it with shrimp paste, lemongrass, and aromatic herbs.

I really enjoyed the food—just wish the portions were a bit bigger for the price. Other than that, the flavors, location, and hospitality were all perfect!
sample_reviews_th.author: Chen E.

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very nice restaurant, also suitable for family celebrations.

There's no traditional menu; instead, each dish is pictured on its own menu. Despite this, the selection is very extensive and consists exclusively of Thai cuisine.

The staff is very friendly and helpful. I ordered fish and simply mentioned, without complaining, that the accompanying sauce was a bit spicy for my taste. They immediately brought me a milder version, even though I hadn't mentioned it.

The restaurant is somewhat secluded on a side street, but well worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: M. Vutuc

sample_reviews_en.text: This classic-style house in Soi Pradipat 10 has parking for about 5 cars. The food is good, and the standout dishes are excellent. The waitress taking the orders is the MVP of the restaurant – incredibly efficient, almost like she's serving the entire place alone. The menu is presented using dozens of Polaroid photos, over 30 in total. Today, we came with five people and ordered many dishes. The portions aren't very large, and the prices are standard for Ari Soi – high, but worth the money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Non Siamnaliga

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is excellent, with unique homemade dishes that give you the feeling of authentic Thai home-cooked meals. Every dish is delicious. I recommend the appetizers like the fried tofu and the tea leaf salad; they're consistently delicious. The braised eggs are also uniquely tasty. The Ran Juan curry is rich and flavorful, and the clear tom yum soup with lotus stems is fantastic. The cooking is consistently excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanlapa Roobsoong

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, it was great. The food, atmosphere, and service were all excellent. Not every dish was mind-blowingly delicious, but overall, it was impressive. The restaurant has parking for about 6-7 cars. There are six tables, and they mentioned a private room for 15 people with no room charge. I'll definitely come back again. Oh, and the prices aren't cheap; they're mid-range for the Ari area.
sample_reviews_en.author: jeffrey wang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Thai food that's hard to find elsewhere, delicious, meticulously prepared, and the drinks are tasty.
The staff are lovely and the service is excellent. The menu is presented as cards, making it more fun to choose what you want to eat. The restaurant is beautiful with a great atmosphere. I loved it very much!
sample_reviews_en.author: YANEE INTARATIP

sample_reviews_en.text: I was impressed with the food, service, and the cozy atmosphere. Every dish tasted amazing. The staff were very attentive, helpful, and friendly. The interior was decorated in a warm style, like eating at a friend's house. I highly recommend this restaurant and will definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bond 2B

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of the best Thai restaurants I've ever been to. It's housed in an old-style house, and parking is limited. There aren't many tables, but the service is excellent, especially from Khun Mew, who takes great care of the customers. The prices are reasonable. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: N T

restaurants.name: Cream
restaurants.address:

603 Charoen Nakhon 9 Alley, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Who on earth said this restaurant was good?! I saw a few posts on Taobao saying it was good and it was near Siam Paragon, so I came here. I ordered 3 dishes for 500 baht. The curry crab was soft-shell crab coated in egg wash!!! Is soft-shell crab shit?! It was terribly mushy and disgusting. The gills weren't even removed, and the crab meat was pink and not fresh. Seriously, I wanted to enjoy a proper crab meal, and you give me this soft crab?! The curry tasted like medicine!!! It was awful!!! The beef and basil rice wasn't even as good as the basil at 7-Eleven. The water spinach was oily and greasy. No wonder there was no one in the restaurant during peak hours 😡😡 Avoid this place!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Xiaoxuan Zhang

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was staying near ICONSIAM and visited for dinner. It wasn't crowded, but there were a few other customers.

I ordered the gapao rice. It was delicious.

The shrimp dish I ordered after seeing the picture was also delicious, with a flavor that suited Japanese tastes.

I ordered a soup that I thought might be like green curry, but it wasn't. However, it had just the right amount of spiciness and a delicious, authentic Thai flavor. It had lots of lemongrass in it.

I enjoyed a relaxing dinner. Credit card payment was accepted.
sample_reviews_en.author: ramune

sample_reviews_en.text:
cream was old local restaurant on this area. they offered verious kind of food from thai to western.
the price was decent (very cheap compare to others restaurent around the same area).
the place was decorated in the old fashion but it looked lovely and cozy to visit.
the food was nice. I ordered ordinally thai food i usually enjoy. I found that some of them got adjusted to appeal foreigner but the taste was still good though

recommend for foriegner and local
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanin Rungwanichsukanon

sample_reviews_en.text:
You can see why this place gets 4.5 stars on Google. Because it is harsh to give it 4* and kind to give it 5*. It is somewhere in the middle.

The food was good, but the dishes were definitely slightly different to what I was used to in Thailand. Especially the chicken and cashew nut.

The service was excellent and the staff were kind. The restaurant is calm.

The value for money was again excellent.

Worth a visit. Worth the money. Won’t disappoint.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Neville

sample_reviews_en.text: I went on a Sunday afternoon and it was empty which was nice. The interior has Western décor and the menu has English as well as Thai. The food was good and was served in a timely manner. The price was a bit more expensive than a local restaurant but not as much as you would pay in a mall for a similar restaurant. It would be 5 stars if it was a bit cheaper or if the portion sizes were larger than average. I'd be happy to return and eat here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Simon Berrie

sample_reviews_en.text: This isn't a restaurant worth going out of your way to visit. The pineapple shrimp fried rice and tom yum goong aren't bad, but the phu pad pong curry is salty, but more than anything, it's overly burnt, overpowering the overall flavor of the curry. I spoke to the owner, but whether it can be improved will be up to the next visitor. (They said it was tasteless, and that the crab was burnt, not fried... haha)
sample_reviews_en.author: 이연섭

sample_reviews_en.text: Located on the way to Iconsiam, near the entrance to the ferry terminal crossing the river, and near the surrounding luxury hotels. For those weary of Iconsiam's exorbitant prices and the crowds of tourists, this is a great option. The prices are reasonable, and the menu offers a variety of delicious dishes. I visited twice during my two-day stay at the Peninsula, and was satisfied both times.
sample_reviews_en.author: 김재홍

sample_reviews_en.text: Really enjoyed my time here. Every dish we tried was delicious, the service was quick, and the staff were warm and accommodating. The place felt clean and well maintained, which I appreciated. My friends are vegetarians, and the staff were super helpful in guiding them to great vegetarian options they loved their food too. Overall, a great experience and a place I’d happily visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shivam Bhosale

restaurants.name: Coals Steakhouse and Bar
restaurants.address:

199, 3 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I walked in and they had a lovely duet singing tonight, the  staff was very welcoming and it was very comfortable and relaxing. I ordered the large flat iron steak 500g. I think it was roughly ฿1600 and it was fantastic. I was only able to eat half and took the rest home
sample_reviews_th.author: daniel powell

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had high expectations for Coals Steakhouse & Bar, and while I have to admit the food was genuinely good, the overall experience was terrible.

The restaurant brought in a live band that was unbelievably loud. It wasn’t just “lively”—it was painfully loud. I couldn’t even hear my own thoughts, let alone have a conversation with the waiter. We had to almost shout at each other just to communicate.

I paid around 3,500 THB, and instead of enjoying a nice steak dinner, I found myself rushing through my meal just so I could escape the noise. The place is relatively small, which only made it worse. The music was so loud that I could literally feel my chair vibrating, and even my head was vibrating from the volume.

If you’re looking for a relaxing steakhouse where you can enjoy good food and conversation, this isn’t it when the band is playing. The management really needs to reconsider the volume, especially given the size of the restaurant.

The food deserves praise, but the atmosphere completely ruined the evening for me.

If you arrive and see the live band setting up, my advice is simple: run away.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tim Charoenphon

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

From the moment we walked into Coal Steakhouse and Bar, we were welcomed and served right away. The service was excellent from start to finish. The staff were incredibly attentive and always checked in on us with a smile, making sure everything was perfect.

The food was absolutely fantastic. My friend ordered a steak and said it was the best steak he’s had in Bangkok. I had the pasta, and honestly it tasted like something straight out of Italy. Another friend ordered the chicken with mashed potatoes and absolutely loved it as well.

The live music created such a great atmosphere and really elevated the whole dining experience. We’ve been traveling around Thailand for about 20 days now, and we were all saying this is easily one of the best restaurants we’ve visited during our trip.

Huge compliments to the kitchen, the musicians, and especially the servers who made the night so enjoyable. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ben Zimmerman

sample_reviews_en.text:
Found this recommendation on Google and it was one of the best decisions to go. As I walked into the restaurant, I was greeted with warm hospitality from the waitresses. They recommended every good dishes and drinks in English. They’d serve us with a smile. The taste of the beef and pork ribs were suited to our tastes that it made my partner want to go back there again. Although it’s bit more pricey, the atmosphere and excellent food and services amount to it.

FYI, I really some bad reviews and thought it was funny that some people don’t see it’s a bar with live music from 7:30-10:30?PM everyday, 10% and 7% VAT are charged in every restaurants (it was even stated at the very bottom of the menu in fine prints), and water is usually charged in restaurants. Don’t make a restaurant look bad because you can’t read or refuse to spend a lot of money knowing it’s an expensive restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: SHII MIIN

sample_reviews_en.text:
Coals Steakhouse and Bar, you guys made our dinner absolutely memorable.

It was a last minute decision and they're able to cater to all 7 of us. Warmly greeted by the front of house, told us to wait as they prepared the table and then ushered us in. Front of house was even willing to go along with my special requests as it was a surprise birthday dinner.

The food we ordered was prepared perfectly to our request. Everything was seasoned perfectly. Doneness we chose for the meats, the order we wanted the food to come out from the kitchen, simply exceptional.

The live music provided great entertainment throughout our dining and we even send in some song requests and they sang it perfectly.

To the front of house and to all you CHEFS who made my brothers' dinner a great one, I thank you all. 🙏❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Fahmy Sudhar

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a great experience dinning in Coals steakhouse located in the heart of Bangkok at Sukhumvit road.
The vibe of the restaurant was like original western steakhouses with a live band played classical music. The staff were very welcoming and polite with good language. The restaurant decor and cleanliness was good too.
I ordered Tenderloin and the quality of the meat and design of the plate was wonderful. Meat cooked exactly to the point. For the sides, which are included, you have 3 choices on the menu.
Price was not cheap or too expensive comparing to the restaurants around. Of course a bit pricy for this type of fine dining restaurant but it’s worth trying it. Be aware of 10% service VAT which would be added to the total receipt.
Highly Recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amir O.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I only review restaurants I either utterly love or utterly feel disappointed. This one is unfortunately the latter.  So please be warned.

We order a salad and a mushroom risotto which tasted okay, nothing special.

However, the most disappointing dish was the steak. We ordered medium rare 400g NY strip and the first time we got a very overcooked one (I would call it congratulations coz it was way beyond well done).

They re-fired it and the second one came rare, ice-cold you could still hear the cow moos. We had to sent it back again and all the we got was an apology from a waitress saying “sorry for the inconvenience”.

This place cannot be named a steakhouse. Definitely we won’t come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jarit Sidhu

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was quite disappointed with the service today. The staff repeatedly came to clear our plates, even though there was still a considerable amount of food left. The restaurant wasn’t busy either, so there was really no need to rush us.

Being repeatedly asked to clear our plates while we were still eating made us feel uncomfortable and pressured, and unfortunately, it took away from what could have been an enjoyable dining experience.

I understand that clearing tables is part of good service, but I believe staff should wait until customers have finished eating before clearing their plates. I hope the restaurant can take this feedback into consideration and improve the service in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Niracha Yoovichit

restaurants.name: Phra Nakhon Bar & Gallery
restaurants.address:

58/2 Ratchadamnoen Klang Rd, Wat Bowon Niwet, Khet Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Phra Nakhon Bar is an old favorite that still maintains its great vibe. The atmosphere is warm, friendly, and perfect for a chill hangout with friends. The highlight is the rooftop with views of Wat Phra Kaew (Temple of the Emerald Buddha), and it's popular with foreign tourists. However, on our last visit, we chose to sit on the first floor, which was air-conditioned and comfortably cool.

I've been coming to this bar for a long time, and I still feel good every time I return. I'm not a heavy drinker; I mostly enjoy cocktails, wine, or beer with friends. But actually, I'm more of a fan of the food! The portions are large, the prices are reasonable, and it's perfect for sharing.

It's a bar with great food, a great vibe, and the same charm it always has.
sample_reviews_en.author: ongart sutas

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a lovely time. Cool local bar/restaurant. Kind staff. The rooftop access is quite breezy. The food is incredible. Prices are reasonable. The stairs access to the rooftop is a bit steep, though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fokwa Babila

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is amazing! Great vibe, chill vibe, good music.
Affordable prices, and all the food is delicious.
They have a full range of drinks, including craft beer and cocktails. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyarat Suksamran

sample_reviews_en.text: This used to be my favorite place during university... I came today because my best friend brought her husband from America to relive old times. Everything is still the same.
sample_reviews_en.author: aey kit

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was amazing! I'm not sure if it was the owner or not, but they were so kind and chatted with me the whole time. Truly impressive in every way! 🥹🥹 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Orawan Mahanam

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was great! The staff were very attentive, and the food was excellent. I highly recommend the hot, delicious french fries!
sample_reviews_en.author: Juthatip Srinaphu

sample_reviews_en.text: Our last day and it was a pleasure to find this place. The terrace is very comfortable. The service was excellent. Come and visit! ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Borja Casamayor Garcia

sample_reviews_en.text: It was great! The staff were very attentive, polite, and even gave me a small gift. I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suttida Phomngam

restaurants.name: Yee Chinese Noodles หยี บะหมี่เกี๊ยว
restaurants.address:

30, 7 Soi Phetchaburi 15, Thanon Phetchaburi, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited Yee Chinese Noodle and had a mixed experience. While the restaurant offers a clean and welcoming atmosphere, with a friendly staff that made me feel at home right away, the food didn't quite meet my expectations. I ordered the noodles and crab meat fried rice, hoping for a delicious meal, but found them to be somewhat lacking.

The noodles were served cold, which may have been intentional to prevent them from sticking together. However, this made them less enjoyable. The texture and flavor of the noodles didn't stand out, and they seemed to lack the vibrant taste I was hoping for. The crab meat fried rice was also quite ordinary, lacking any distinctive flavors that would set it apart from typical fried rice dishes. While it was cooked well, it just didn't offer anything special.

Despite the food not being as great as I had hoped, the chef and staff were attentive and friendly, which was a nice aspect of the visit. Their hospitality was a positive point, making the dining experience pleasant. Overall, while Yee Chinese Noodle has potential, the food needs some improvement to match the excellent service and cleanliness of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hee Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very hot restaurant. Try getting a seat near a large fan. Sparrows come in for visits too, though they flutter away quickly if you so much as look at them.

Food was great for the price, there was no queue near lunch time (we had brunch).

If you have not been here before, get their bestsellers indicated on their large pink menus, and a plate of wanton for sharing.

Food was served quickly as well.

This was a surprise fine considering the long queue at another noodle place before reaching here. Kudos to my travel companion on this find.

This bowl of noodles (for 80 baht) was not heavy handed with the flavours and is a welcomed change for the start of the day. It does not mean that the noodles and its accompanying ingredients are not flavourful. Not only that, the food was quite enjoyable too. (Yes, there is a wee bit of crab in there!)

On the menu, the items without egg noodles indicated does not come with noodles!

If you are staying near Asia Hotel Bangkok (even if you aren't), make a trip here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Clev W.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Yee Chinese Noodles was not even on my radar. It popped up while I was hunting for a decent bowl of Thai Wanton Noodles. I want to break my usual routine at Soi 19, which I have been visiting for years whenever I am in the Land of Smiles.

I am glad I clicked.

The noodles were springy and eggy — exactly how I like them. The balance with the sauces was spot on. Not too heavy, nothing fighting for attention. The Char Siew was solid, but not the charred type that you would find in Singapore. Better-flavoured than I expected, though that is not always the case even at well-regarded spots.

The wantons, though. That is where Yee earns it —prawns and pork, cooked properly and well flavoured. No shortcuts. You can taste the difference.

Here is the thing, the bowl is slightly bigger than Soi 19’s, and cheaper. After finishing the first, I ordered another. That doesn’t happen often.

Yee Chinese Noodles is my favourite now. Soi 19 had a good run.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
sample_reviews_en.author: Calvin Chua

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Yee noodles here were a pleasant surprise simple, comforting, and quietly satisfying. In fact, I ended up eating here for four consecutive days, which already says everything.

The noodles had a nice springy texture, not overcooked, and coated lightly in seasoning that didn’t overwhelm the natural flavours. What stood out was the balance: tender slices of char siu, juicy dumplings, and fresh greens all coming together in one bowl. The crispy bits and chopped scallions added that extra layer of fragrance and texture, making each bite more interesting.

The broth on the side was light yet flavourful, perfect to sip between bites without feeling heavy. And pairing it with a fresh coconut? That’s honestly the perfect Bangkok combo refreshing, hydrating, and just elevates the whole experience.

It’s not a flashy dish, but it delivers where it matters comfort, balance, and satisfaction. Clearly addictive… because four days in a row is not a coincidence.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr Jessenzzth

sample_reviews_en.text:
Will definitely eat here again. Noodles are absolutely perfect - springy with just the right amount of bounce and chew that marks truly well-made noodles.

The char siew (barbecued pork) is a standout, impossibly tender and clearly prepared with care. We tried dishes #3, #7, and #10, and all were great. The dumplings deserve special mention - each bite explodes with flavor.

Don't miss their fried pork wontons (#7)! These crispy delights come with an incredible sweet plum sauce that's worth the visit alone. The sauce strikes that perfect balance of sweet and tangy that makes you want to drizzle it on everything.

If you're craving Chinese noodles and dumplings, Yee Chinese Noodles delivers on all fronts. The attention to detail in their food preparation and the quality of ingredients make this place a must-visit for noodle enthusiasts.
sample_reviews_en.author: wrinklefreebrain

sample_reviews_en.text: This is such a hidden gem. The food is delicious and quickly served. If you are taking a Grab, better off ordering motorbike so they drop you off right in front. Cars will drop you off on main road to avoid the traffic in the narrow road. I came back to this spot twice within a 24 hour time period. Ordered the crab/shrimp wonton egg noodles and bbq pork/crab/shrimp wonton. They serve the dish with soup on the side so you can decide if you want to pour it in.  I preferred the noodles dry and added some dry spices provided on the table. Can't recommend this spot enough. I'm not sure if they take credit cards, best to have cash. It's not expensive at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ming Lim

sample_reviews_en.text: They open start 7.30 am - 2.00 pm after that 5.30 pm - 9.00pm. This is a local wonton noodle with a delicious taste, the place is very clean and the service is good, their best seller is pork wonton roasted pork Crab noodle. We ordered Soup and dry and i would prefer the Soup but the dry version also delicious. Beside that i would recommended their fried pork wonton as well, this wonton is really crunchy, must order the fried pork wonton. Their service also super friendly and nice. Price also very friendly. Overall i can Said : Cheap-cheap, good-good, many-many 👍😁
sample_reviews_en.author: Joni Lie

sample_reviews_en.text:
Exceeded my expectations.
Clean interior, well ventilated
Staff were prompt, polite and had the attentiveness of quality F&B service standards.
I ordered 2 of the best seller wonton noodles and a fried pork wanton.
Noodles were springy and fragrant mixed into a light onion oil drizzle, plump wanton, pork slices fresh and firm, generous with vegetables which I totally love.

Will highly recommend trying. Prices are highly affordable for this quality and dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Babu Huat

restaurants.name: Rosaroi PhraNakhon รสอร่อย พระนคร
restaurants.address:

10/3-4 ถ. เจริญกรุง Wang Burapha Phirom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Avoid at all costs - this place made both me and my partner soooo sick with food poisoning. As soon as I got my dish, it had a horrible smell and the chicken was undercooked. I picked out the chicken and ate the noodles anyway, which was a poor decision. I came in excited as the reviews were high, but now I’ve been sick for days. Even when we paid, the woman was making dumplings and handled our check with raw meat… Overall, very unsanitary, nonexistent service (not to mention, we were the only two in there), and not worth the food at alllllll.

Wish I could rate negative stars!!!! I’ve been in Asia for 3.5 months and this is the first place to make me sick. Please avoid for your own sake!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bea D.

sample_reviews_en.text:
very affordable food options and most of them are delicious too!

ordered morning glory (amazing), thai basil rice (also amazing) and tom yum soup. the tom yum soup fell short of our expectations as it was pretty milky

all the food that's supposed to be spicy weren't that spicy at all

other than that, organisation was not good as they sent wrong orders to our table and the table next to ours a couple of times...

but in general, food was mostly good, great ambience and good price 👍

note: cash only!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jing Min Ong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love it here. The food tastes good and the tables are clean. The price is very affordable and appropriate for the amount of food we get. They are very accommodating with your food allergies.
They have indoor and outdoor. Indoor is air conditioned, and air purifier is turned on all day. They are quite friendly when you talk to them. Otherwise, they will leave you alone for your privacy. Overall, I think it's a great place to have good food and escape from the humidity LOL ^_^
sample_reviews_en.author: Darling_ja

sample_reviews_en.text:
Photos don't show serving as we started eating before I took photos. But this is a humble yet very worthy place to go if you want a simple meal that doesn't burn your pockets and near your other plans.

It's home cooked taste, so expect it to be a bit salty. I was surprised by the price I paid.

I can’t really take spicy food, but papaya salad is very nice, sourish but slightly on the spicier side. the rest is fine.

We got glass noodle and kua and 3 drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jane Tmw

sample_reviews_en.text: I was compelled to return to this review to give this restaurant it's true rating ⭐ The food is fantastic, and I mean that with every letter of the word! Behind those kitchen doors is real talent 👩‍🍳 if you find yourself in the local area come here, eat up and be happy 😁 The price is great, the food delish and the vibe is chill. I cannot recommend this establishment enough! From my heart "Thank you for feeding me so well" 💖 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Hayden

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food is really nice and affordable. For less than €5 we had food and drinks for 2 persons.
Downside: they don't give you much service. We came in and we saw that there was no table available. They didn't speak to us for 5 minutes until we asked ourselves. They also don't smile or say you goodbye.

Don't go there if you can't handle the lack of service. Just amazing food for a good price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachel

sample_reviews_en.text: AVOID. I have no idea how this place can have such great reviews (maybe they are paid). I usually don't write the reviews but my boyfriend got food poisoning after eating the crispy pork here. I was fine because I took the vegetarian option but in general, the food was tasteless, didn't look appealing either. It's cheap, but you can find way better options in the low budget in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julia Lejman

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste wasn't anything particularly special, but for Thai food, it wasn't overly salty and just right. It felt like a home-style meal in Korea. The air conditioning was cool, and I liked the atmosphere. It was nice that it opened early, and for an air-conditioned restaurant, the prices seemed reasonable. We ordered three dishes for 200 baht. The portions seemed generous.
sample_reviews_en.author: ming char

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวขาหมู ABAC
restaurants.address:

47 ซอย รามคำแหง 24 แยก 34-1 Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This old-established noodle shop, located in the ABAC Hua Mak alley, offers simple, homey ambiance, but the service is impressive and friendly.

I ordered the dry pork leg noodles (with skin/meat, just meat, or trotters). The noodles were good, the pork was tender and soft, and there was a generous amount of gravy. Lime was served in the bowl. If you like spicy food, add some roasted chili peppers for a fragrant and delicious flavor.

The regular portion might be a little small for some; ordering the special portion would be better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miiw

sample_reviews_en.text: This famous pork leg noodle shop is located near ABAC Ramkhamhaeng. Students in the area know it well for its delicious noodles. We ordered pork leg noodle soup, tom yum pork leg noodle soup, and tom yum soup without noodles. The flavors were moderate, making it enjoyable to eat. Those who prefer a stronger flavor can add a little fish sauce and chili. The noodles were perfectly cooked, chewy and delicious. The owner is lovely and friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paphassarin W.

sample_reviews_en.text: The legendary pork leg noodle soup that ABAC students craved – I returned to eat it after 25 years. The owner is still as kind, talkative, and attentive as ever. The pork leg noodle soup is still as delicious as before. My only regret is not getting to eat the skin because the shop was about to close – I was the last customer of the day. I consider myself lucky to have gotten to eat it.
sample_reviews_en.author: PIYAMAS SATRAPHAN

sample_reviews_en.text: Local food with famous history than 35 years. Good price and care. A lot of excellent food shop nearby. So we can park here and take other as well. Type of this food shop is quite hard to find in Bangkok. Generally, You should come here before noon because it has a lot of people line up. The food shop here is not open in evening. Another thing is herbal juice here is good as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay KJ

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my go-to restaurant when I was a student 20 years ago. It was incredibly delicious, and even now I still occasionally go there because I don't live in the area anymore.
The taste is still the same – delicious, rich, and the noodles are great.
They have many menu items, but whenever you come, you absolutely have to try the pork leg noodle soup. It's the best!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jack_Somphob

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was delicious!
I ordered dry rice noodles with pork leg. The noodles were soft, and the pork leg had just the right flavor. It went very well with the crispy fish skin.
There's parking in front of the shop, and the owner provides excellent service.
The pandan jelly drink was also delicious. I'll definitely go back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: duangporn w.

sample_reviews_en.text: I like this type of noodle. I ordered the pork leg noodle soup with just the meat, and the pork leg yentafo with just the meat and meatballs. It was delicious. The regular bowl isn't very big, so if you want to be full, I recommend ordering the special. There's a little parking space in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Taksaorn Sirikantaramas

sample_reviews_en.text:
The braised pork noodle soup had firm, chewy noodles. Squeezing lime juice enhanced the flavor, and the braised pork with its tender meat and skin was incredibly satisfying.

On a hot day, I ordered pandan jelly drink. It was a lovely price at 10 baht per bottle and not too sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manipa T.

restaurants.name: Tom's Cafe
restaurants.address:

34/28 Soi Si Bamphen, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Budget friendly place with good quality food and cold beer reasonably priced."

sample_reviews_en.text:
Being the last night of this trip, I told myself I needed to get out and explore a little more before flying home. Stumbled upon Tom’s Cafe, a nicely decorated local restaurant just right beside my hotel, the ibis.

What caught my attention? It was still alive and open at 11pm plus while most places were already winding down for the night. Perfect for late night wanderers like me.

Ordered an iced coffee and a chicken fried rice. Simple supper but honestly quite satisfying. Coffee was refreshing, fried rice was good with decent portion, and the whole place had a relaxed local vibe instead of feeling overly touristy.

What made the experience better was the staff. Friendly, smiling all the time, and genuinely welcoming even at that hour. Sometimes it’s these random unplanned supper spots that end up becoming one of the more memorable moments of a trip.
sample_reviews_en.author: Crumpled Nomad

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's really delicious. They say they make all the food themselves.

Spring Rolls - Incredibly delicious. I have to eat them every day. It's the #1 menu item.

Som Tum - Unlike other places, there are no dried shrimp. Regardless of that, there is a subtle scent—cilantro? Or mint? I'm not sure, but there is some invisible aroma.

Delicious.

Meat Rice - Pad Khao Moo Sap? Not salty. Delicious.

Green Curry - Super creamy and full of ingredients. Delicious.

Fried Rice - Ordered the vegetable version. Less salty and tasty. It pairs well with the other dishes.

I'm going back tomorrow for a fruit smoothie.

If you're nearby, stop by and give it a try. It was hot because there is no air conditioning, so I got takeout. If it were just cooler, I think I could eat there.

Food is about 100-150 baht per item.

Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jun

sample_reviews_en.text:
We absolutely loved Tom’s Cafe! We came for a long holiday and ended up eating here most days, it truly became our home away from home. The food is delicious and affordable, the cafe is always clean, and the staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming. There’s just something comfortable and familiar about this place that kept us coming back again and again.

By the end of our trip, Tom’s Cafe felt like part of our daily routine. If you’re looking for great food, reasonable prices, and genuinely warm service, we highly recommend it. We’ll definitely miss this little gem when we leave!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dominique Upshaw

sample_reviews_en.text:
From breakfast to dinner, the authentic and fresh cuisine is impeccable. The flavors are vibrant and the service is pleasant. Friendly and welcoming! A must-try, a go-to spot if you're in the area!

From breakfast to dinner, the authentic and fresh cuisine is flawless. The flavors are vibrant and the service is delightful. Friendly and welcoming! A must-try, a go-to spot if you're in the area!

Thank you 🙏🏽
sample_reviews_en.author: Gilles Azar

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was looking for a place to have dinner at midnight.
I found this cafe nearby; everything else was closed.
I didn't regret it; it was delicious.
I had a mango smoothie; it's a really thick mango puree without any thinners like milk or ice.
Also, the rice with shrimp is not Noi.
Nice, quiet atmosphere and interior.
sample_reviews_en.author: Виктория Савинова

sample_reviews_en.text:
A lovely little restaurant near the Goethe Institute in Bangkok.

The visit was pleasant, the food was good, and the owners, mother and son, were incredibly friendly. They also have rooms for rent above the restaurant, but I can't comment on those.

I would recommend it, as I found it very cozy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Horst Christian

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stumbled upon this place by chance and have already been back several times.

So far, it's been the best food I've had here, and at really reasonable prices. The meal in the pictures cost less than €10 without drinks. And it was incredibly delicious! I'll definitely be back. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: p schulz

sample_reviews_en.text: Really a great spot, some of the best tasting food we had during our stay in bangkok, prices are good and atmosphere is warm and welcoming. Definitely better than the place next door on the corner, which looks good but is no match for Tom’s cafe. Would highly recommend !
sample_reviews_en.author: Scott Evans

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือแม่พลอย (Mae Ploy Boat Noodles)
restaurants.address:

92/1 Charu Mueang Rd, Rong Mueang, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stopped by because it was close to my hotel.
I ordered pork noodles, tom yum noodles, and tom yum bibim noodles.
Everything was delicious, especially the tom yum noodles👍 (I recommend the glass noodles for the thickness of the noodles).

It does have a bit of cilantro in it, but even those who don't like cilantro can enjoy it!

The owner explained the menu in English, so it was easy to order. :)
The prices are reasonable, and I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: 김예린

sample_reviews_en.text:
The soup was herby and spicy - on the stronger side for me.
The store front was filled with trophies - their other business, so you might missed it thinking that you found the wrong place.
Just walk in and you will find 2 tiny tables amongst the stock pule of trophies and medals.
So it was a squeeze to fit 4 person in that tiny space.
After this meal, we found there were so many other stalls for boat noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anisah 思思

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hands down the best boat noodles in Bkk.
A must try is the tom yum boat noodles it’s been 2 months ago I had them for the first time and we have been back 4 times ( in the 2 x 3 days we visited bkk)
The tum yum boat noodles literally brought me to tears. full joy and pleasure in a bowl for  €1,25 see you next time guys !
sample_reviews_en.author: Justin

sample_reviews_en.text: I was running errands in the area, so I stopped by for a meal. I was impressed by the rich flavor of the broth, just like Ayutthaya boat noodles, and the tender pork was excellent. The service was good, fast and efficient. The price was reasonable. I liked it and will definitely go back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Vicky Latthiprasart

sample_reviews_en.text:
Vietnamese below.

Delicious food and affordable price, no waiting, should come. But the drink should be less sugar because it's a bit too sweet.

The food is delicious, seasoned just right, and the service is fast. But the drink should be less sweet. The price is excellent! ^^
sample_reviews_en.author: Huỳnh Mai Hương

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food, very hospitable owner

I just edited my review when I came back to this restaurant for the second time with my wife and sister. I have updated more pictures.

My whole family praised the delicious food, rich flavor, will come back many times.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lê Phong

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered food from the restaurant at 1:00 PM, but after 10-15 minutes, I still hadn't received my food. There were no other customers in the restaurant, so I went to ask. The staff replied that they forgot. Is that even right?
sample_reviews_en.author: Chakrits Kumfoy

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a local eatery, so the prices are very reasonable, only 50 baht. There are almost no tourists here.
The owner didn't speak much English, but we were able to order easily.
The food was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nguyễn Lê Bảo Vy (Yumi)

restaurants.name: Paksika
restaurants.address:

627 Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Wonderful food, nice place, friendly staff, reasonably priced"

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pak Sita is a very affordable and really good place to eat. The food is great, and the atmosphere is very cozy.

By cozy, I mean that when you’re outside in the heat and walk inside, it feels comfortable. It’s not freezing with strong air conditioning like many places, so it feels relaxed and pleasant.

When we arrived, the restaurant was almost empty. I think they had just opened for the day. But even with no one there, I got a good feeling about the place, and it turned out I was right. After a little while, a few more people started coming in, which confirmed that it’s actually a popular spot.

The restaurant is right on the main street, but you do have to pay attention when walking because it’s easy to miss with so many small shops around it.

The food was really good. The papaya salad was excellent, and everything we tried was very satisfying.

They also serve beer, and they chill the glass before serving it, which made it even better. That small detail made the experience feel extra nice.

Overall, I highly recommend this place if you want to eat good Thai food at a very reasonable price. It’s simple, comfortable, and the food is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miriam Isaac

sample_reviews_en.text:
I debated going to Cream right next door but decided to visit here instead.

There was only one other group besides us. It was around 2:30 PM.

No air conditioning, no fans.

Tom Yum Goong, Chicken with Cashews, Steamed Rice.

We almost finished our beer, but the chicken wings we ordered for the child still hadn't arrived.

The child was starving... The chicken wings were the size of an adult's little finger.

The size was small, and there was hardly any meat to eat.

The service was just curt.

As for the taste, the Tom Yum Goong was very sweet, as if it contained a lot of coconut.

The chicken tasted like spicy stir-fried pork; it was perfect to eat with rice, but there was too much onion and very little chicken meat with cashews.

I have visited Thailand many times, but this taste did not feel authentic at all.

It felt like a modified flavor made for foreigners! That's about it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay

sample_reviews_en.text:
We chose this restaurant late one evening based on the many positive reviews – and we can absolutely confirm them. All the dishes we ordered were very tasty, and the portions were comparatively generous for Thai food.

One minor point for improvement would be the timing of the service: Our appetizer unfortunately arrived after the main course, and the main courses weren't served at the same time. However, this only slightly marred the overall positive impression.

The restaurant itself is very stylishly decorated, and everything appears clean and well-maintained. Overall, we can definitely recommend it without hesitation, even for European guests.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benutzernamejk

sample_reviews_en.text:
The last restaurant I stopped by before heading back to Korea...

They serve Korean food too...??

I immediately ordered kimchi fried rice, Shin Ramyun, and grilled pork jowl.

The kimchi fried rice didn't taste exactly like the kimchi fried rice I was expecting; it had that kind of dessert-like flavor you'd get at a Korean BBQ restaurant at the end of a meal, so I kept reaching for more haha.

Overall, everything was pretty good~~

I think I'll go there often next time I visit the Peninsula.
sample_reviews_en.author: WSKIM

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice restaurant with a pleasant atmosphere, catering mainly to tourists - primarily Chinese and European. The menu features a range of Thai classics, though at times the flavors can feel slightly toned down to suit international palates. If you ask them not to hold back on chilies and fish sauce, the dishes become much more authentic.

I tried several items, including the Panang curry, and everything was fresh and tasty. While not exceptional, the overall quality was consistently good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited for lunch and ordered Tom Yum Goong Chicken, Pork Gapao Rice, and Stir-fried Morning Glory.

The seasoning was generally good, and the stir-fried morning glory was particularly delicious with its crisp texture. However, I personally felt the Tom Yum Goong Chicken lacked a bit of flavor, and the Gapao was just average.

While I was generally satisfied for a lunch visit, it didn't leave me particularly impressed, so I'm giving it 3 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Satoshi Watanabe

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had pork pad thai. It was amazing.

I was feeling a bit skeptical about Thai food at Suk Siam, so I decided to try this place for dinner.

The noodles were chewy and the presentation was beautiful. The restaurant had a nice, comfortable atmosphere.

This is my first time in Thailand, but this place is likely to become one of my best memories.

Since I'm staying for multiple nights, I want to come here every night.
sample_reviews_en.author: 田中カナタ

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was nice overall but it was a long wait despite us being the only people there and we were served meat spring rolls instead of vegetable ones which is always disappointing as a vegetarian. Server was extremely apologetic which was appreciated but we weren’t served a replacement and we did have to ask for them to be removed from the bill despite not eating them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarah Priestley Keogh
