sample_reviews_en.text: Incredibly good coffee from an espresso machine. Delicious breakfast. The menu is quite small and concise, but what they offer is really good and high-quality. You can look into the bakery through a glass partition, which I think is a nice touch. It's small, but clean. The prices are a bit higher for Thailand, but for such delicious, fancy, Instagrammable, and rather Western-style food, it's worth treating yourself.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julia Mithin

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner is very nice, and the food is delicious! The cheese and bacon ratio is just right! The egg isn't overcooked. Sometimes too much bacon makes it too salty, but this one isn't. The Thai milk tea is good, but a little too sweet; it seems to be made with condensed milk? Hong Kong people should definitely try this! Recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: SM W

sample_reviews_en.text: the actual cafe had no air conditioning so they made me sit in the weed dispensary next door and as someone who doesn’t like that it was very unfortunate, also i asked for a hot matcha and i was given it cold and also tasted terrible, i don’t recommend
sample_reviews_en.author: Sabrina

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food was absolutely amazing and delicious. Good quality ingredients done masterfully. Coffee is also amazing.

The staff here were so kind and the owner is very friendly as well.

10/10 recommend this place for a breakfast/brunch done beautifully.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chester Everingham

sample_reviews_en.text: During my stay, breakfast wasn't included at the hotel, so I used this place. The bread was delicious, and it was a rare treat to be able to drink proper, tasty black coffee ✨ (because all the coffee in Thailand is sweet). The atmosphere …
sample_reviews_en.author: Kakeru Nishida

sample_reviews_en.text: A lovely and, above all, delicious café for breakfast. You can tell the coffee is prepared with love! The owner regularly participates in barista competitions and truly understands his craft. The food was also very good. The prices are a …
sample_reviews_en.author: Till Schreiber

sample_reviews_en.text: Incredibly slow service. It took ages for them to bring our coffees and when they did, they were barely warm. The toast was soggy and the berries were very sour. Not good at all. Definitely would not recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ashley Ho

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stayed for three days in Bangkok and ate breakfast here everyday!
The Food was really lovely and the coffee… just PERFECT!

We really enjoyed it. If we're ever in Bangkok again, we'll definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maurice Weise

restaurants.name: Delicious Democracy Noodle & Burmese Cuisine
restaurants.address:

Sap Rd, Khwaeng Si Phraya, Khet Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I just had a late lunch/early dinner at Delicious Democracy Noodle & Burmese Cuisine, and wow, the food was sooo good.

I ordered the minced pork with basil paired with their Burmese iced tea, and both were absolutely satisfying. The flavors were rich, comforting, and felt very authentic.

What made the experience even more special is that the chef, Mama Ae, cooks right in front of you. It was amazing to watch, there’s something about seeing your food freshly prepared that makes it taste even better.

They offer a great variety of Burmese dishes, so there’s definitely more to explore on the menu next time.

The restaurant was quite quiet when we visited, probably because it was around 5 PM, which actually made the whole dining experience more relaxed and enjoyable.

Overall, great food, great experience, I’d definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angel Sison

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles were delicious, and the broth tasted incredibly sweet and flavorful, made with vegetables. The owner and his son were very friendly. The fried dumplings weren't greasy or overly flavorful; you could taste the fresh, sweet taste of the vegetables. It's truly an exceptional restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: 趙崇明

sample_reviews_en.text: This place serves delicious noodles with real history tied to Chula and many students’ lives. They also serve Burmese cuisine for adventurous eaters looking for unique experiences. In this big city, it’s nice to support a locally owned shop with real history and real food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sorawisit Totharong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing food & wonderful people!
I had a great time at Delicious Democracy Noodle restaurant.
Support this local traditional restaurant with authentic food (and don’t waste your time at malls)
Thank you so much for this delicious lunch!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mélissa

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. It was a Tom Yum noodle soup unlike any I've ever tasted before, but the ingredients combined made it incredibly tasty. The price wasn't too high either.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khawpad Gallagher

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was simple and delicious. The auntie was very friendly and welcoming! I usually don’t write reviews but you guys should try! Thai, Burmese and more foods are available!
sample_reviews_en.author: Htay Aung

sample_reviews_en.text: Good and delicious food at Delicious Democracy. The noodles are very tasty and the ingredients are fresh. Friendly service and nice atmosphere. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: May Phyu Khin Khin

sample_reviews_en.text: The moment we entered the small cozy restaurant, I was greeted by something that can only be described as a teaser for the food we were about to be served. …

restaurants.name: Chef Nour Lebanese Restaurant
restaurants.address:

51 Soi Charoen Krung 67, Yan Nawa, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Perfect Solo Lunch! Incredible Portions, Authentic Taste, and Warm Hospitality
If you are looking for an amazing, authentic Lebanese lunch, this place is an absolute gem. I stopped by for a solo midday meal and sat in their lovely semi-open space under the trees—it has a wonderful, breezy atmosphere that is perfect for dining alone.
The generosity here is unmatched. As soon as I sat down, they brought out a spread of complimentary condiments and crackers, plus a refreshing orange juice shot that was the perfect midday pick-me-up.
For the main course, the portions are huge! The chicken dish comes with four large, flavorful slices that left me completely satisfied. Just when I thought I was done, they surprised me with a free cup of rice pudding for dessert.
Even though I was dining alone, the service made me feel right at home. The host was incredibly friendly, and the owner even came out to say hi and check on my meal.
Price Range: 220 – 500 THB
For the massive portions, authentic taste, and top-tier hospitality, it is incredibly affordable and worth every Baht. Highly, highly recommended if you want to treat yourself to a fantastic lunch!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ali Sabri

sample_reviews_en.text:
Although it is a bit of a walk from Saphan Taksin Station (about 13 minutes on foot), this restaurant is definitely worth the trip. I had some time to spare before checking into my hotel and wanted to wander through Bangkok's alleyways, so I stumbled upon this hidden gem while looking for a restaurant nearby.

Thanks to the friendly owner and the quiet, relaxed atmosphere, I was able to experience a charm of Bangkok distinct from the tourist spots.

Recommended Menu: Oven-roasted chicken breast (very moist & flavorful with spices)

It’s a little bit of a walk from Saphan Taksin Station (about 13 minutes on foot), but definitely worth it. I had some time to spare before checking into my hotel and wanted to wander through the small streets of Bangkok. While looking for somewhere to eat, I happened to come across this hidden gem.

The owner was very friendly, and the quiet, relaxed atmosphere gave me a chance to experience a different side of Bangkok, away from the usual tourist spots.

Recommendation: Oven-roasted chicken breast
sample_reviews_en.author: 허인우

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chef Noor Lebanese Restaurant in Bangkok delivers an outstanding dining experience, marked by both generous hospitality and excellent food.

The meal began with a selection of complimentary items, including fresh orange juice, pickles, and crispy bread served with a flavorful garlic dip—an inviting and thoughtful touch that set the tone for the evening.

The dishes themselves were exceptional. The hummus was smooth and rich, while the tabbouleh was fresh, vibrant, and perfectly balanced. The mixed grill kebab was a highlight, featuring a variety of well-seasoned, tender meats cooked to perfection. The pita was warm and soft, ideal for pairing with the dips and grilled items. The spinach and cheese pide added a comforting, savory element, with a nicely baked crust and a satisfying filling.

Overall, the combination of high-quality ingredients, authentic flavors, and warm service made for a memorable experience. Chef Noor is a standout choice for Lebanese cuisine in Bangkok and is certainly worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Darren Marshall

sample_reviews_en.text:
We booked an accommodation in the area and I found on Maps Chef Nour's restaurant.
I went there with my 6 years old daughter to have lunch in the day of our arrival in BKK.
I had the pleasure to meet the owner, Mr Nour and, during our brief conversation, I found out he had worked many years at Intercontinental. And trust me, what we had in our plates was definitely worthy of a top-notch restaurant.
We also got on-the-house spiced flavorful starter crackers, my daughter received as well a desert.
The generosity and the natural hospitality are things that make a restaurant customer willing to come back.
My mind was made about where to have lunch or dinner during our stay in Bangkok.
Unfortunately, we had to change our accommodation and move to Klong Toei district. Otherwise, Chef Nour's place would have been THE spot for us, as we are big fans of Lebanese cuisine.
To Chef Nour and his staff: Keep up the good work and I am sure you'll need a bigger space soon. ;)
sample_reviews_en.author: Costin Pavel

sample_reviews_en.text:
We are the first time and was more impressed than I expected. The atmosphere was comfortable, clean, and not crowded. The owner provided great service, spoke politely, recommended the menu well, and was friendly and kindly .

The food came out quite quickly and tasted delicious The ingredients were fresh, and it felt like a lot of care was put into the quality. Every dish we ordered was finished completely. The prices were very reasonable for the quality, making it well worth it.

This is definitely one of those restaurants I’d love to come back to, and I’d also recommend it to my friends. If you’re looking for a place with delicious food, a nice atmosphere, and impressive service, this restaurant is a great choice. Supper  💕🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Napat Napat

sample_reviews_en.text:
I must say thank you to the owner for such great service, my compliments to the chef for the delicious food, and extend my gratitude to the server for his work.

Me and my girlfriend found this place randomly on Google Maps, and decided to go and try it out. That was one of the best decisions in a while!

We ordered a whole array of food, and I must say that every single dish was delicious. The owner gave us complimentary drinks and deserts, and we felt truly welcomed and thankful for his hospitality.

If you ever are in this area, or don’t know where to eat, please do yourself a favor and dine at this fine establishment. We will come back for sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oliver Tandstad

sample_reviews_en.text: An authentic Lebanese restaurant managed by Mr. Nour. The management of the complex is very meticulous and sensitive. A variety of Arabic dishes, Arabic desserts, and Arabic coffee and tea are served. There is parking space in front of the restaurant. The restrooms are clean and adequate. The prices of the food are moderate. And it costs about 400 baht per person with drinks and desserts, etc. The last order is taken at 11 o'clock, but the restaurant is open until 12 o'clock. There is an outdoor table in front of the restaurant for smoking. Thanks to Mr. Nour for the wonderful hospitality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hamidreza Tatar

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is excellent, very fresh and served piping hot. You can tell that the ingredients are fresh and that everything is carefully prepared. It is a small restaurant, so it can get busy, but it is definitely worth the wait.

The owner and chef, Nour, is a lovely gentleman, very friendly and hospitable.

We had the tabbouleh and hummus with freshly baked pita bread to start. For the main, we went for the mixed grill, as well as the cheese and spinach sfeeha, which is a bit like a Turkish pide.

Definitely recommend going there if you fancy freshly made Arabic food and Lebanese mezze.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mo El-Haj

restaurants.name: Bloom86 Steak & Pasta
restaurants.address:

86 Punna Withi 21 Alley, Bang Chak, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was craving steak, so I randomly searched on the map and found this restaurant.
The food was incredibly delicious and high-quality. The price was very reasonable. I ordered three dishes plus two servings of homemade ice cream.

Service: The woman (not sure if she's the owner) and the chef were incredibly friendly and helpful! They provided excellent service, offered food recommendations, were extremely polite, and both spoke fluent English (I've been to similar restaurants in the area but rarely encountered staff who spoke English so well).

Ambiance: It's a small, beautifully decorated restaurant. It wasn't crowded on a Monday, perfect for a relaxing chat. If you're in the area, you should definitely try it! Or if you live far away, it's worth the gas money. Go try it! ❤️

Open hours: The restaurant is closed every Tuesday, but during holidays like Songkran, Christmas, and New Year, it's open every day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kunkawi KKW

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here randomly but left feeling completely satisfied. The signature steak was amazing; the refreshing sauce perfectly balanced the richness of the meat. The chef grilled the medium rare flawlessly.

The creamy mushroom soup was just right, not too thick. I loved that it had a generous amount of mushrooms – perfect for mushroom soup lovers!

The Vongole pasta was also excellent; the noodles were perfectly cooked, there were plenty of clams, and the sauce was rich and flavorful with a strong seafood aroma. Absolutely delicious!

It's a small restaurant with no more than 12 seats, so I recommend calling ahead to make a reservation.
The owners were incredibly friendly. I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Koy VIRANYA

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! 👍🏽😋 The seafood soup with fish belly was so smooth, and the mussels and squid were tender and silky. The salad looked ordinary, but the addition of passion fruit juice and honey enhanced the sweetness, making it even better! 👍🏽 I especially love the shrimp pasta with its rich shrimp sauce and very fresh shrimp (the shrimp heads even had roe, so fragrant!). I couldn't help but nod in approval after every bite! 🤭😋 I didn't expect to find such high-quality food in this area. Thank you to the chef for letting me enjoy such delicious and satisfying dishes! 🙏🏻 You can tell that every dish is made with care! 👍🏽 Remember to make a reservation before you come!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tung tung

sample_reviews_en.text:
I randomly picked this restaurant on the map; it had great reviews, so I decided to give it a try.

As others have said, the food was absolutely delicious! 😋 The owner listened attentively to our requests and explained the preparation methods for each dish in great detail. Most importantly, both owners were incredibly friendly and easy to chat with (their English is excellent)!!! They introduced me to many Thai restaurants and tourist attractions. The overall environment was very comfortable, and it was wonderful to have my first restaurant experience in Thailand here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lori Lin

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish was delicious. We ordered 7 dishes, not including dessert. The taste was premium, the ingredients were fresh and high-quality, and the portions were excellent value for money. The fish was a whole piece, and you could choose the amount of meat you wanted by the gram. The salads and dressings were freshly made. Every bite was delicious. I recommend making a reservation beforehand because the restaurant only has 14-15 seats, including a long bar for groups of 6-7 people and smaller tables for 2-4 people.
sample_reviews_en.author: May Sanguanchati

sample_reviews_en.text:
I randomly picked a restaurant because it was close to where I was running errands.
But everything exceeded my expectations! Everything was delicious, from the complimentary bread and salad to the main course and dessert.
I especially loved the bread, salad, and steak.

The owner (I think) was lovely, and the atmosphere was chill with a great vibe. Highly recommend!

P.S. I didn't get a chance to photograph the steak because I ate it so quickly! 😅
sample_reviews_en.author: K Buff

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant boasts a warm, open kitchen atmosphere and a meticulously crafted fine dining menu, staffed by only two people – a chef and server. While the wine selection is limited, it perfectly complements the restaurant's style. A recommended dish is the steak, where you can choose your own cut; the cooking method suggests it pairs better with white wine than red. The vongole pasta is also exceptionally flavorful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phornphat Sutthithammakul

sample_reviews_en.text: This bistro is a such a lovely hidden gem. The food is absolutely delicious, I would highly recommend the grilled barramundi as it was well cooked and really tasty. Small touches such as the rosemary bread with olive oil & balsamic vinegar make a huge difference. The staff are also very friendly & welcoming. I’m glad I made a diversion to this restaurant on my way to the airport. Well worth the trip!
sample_reviews_en.author: Roina Daniel

restaurants.name: Nakamura Ramen 東京武蔵野 中村拉麺
restaurants.address:

26 22 Sukhumvit 69 Alley, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This ramen shop is even better than those in Japan.
The staff are incredibly diligent and well-trained; the contrast between their professionalism and the shop's atmosphere is striking when you enter from the side street.
The Suntory Kakubin Highball is excellent; compared to other places at the same price, the whiskey itself is properly chilled.
The noodles, soup, and toppings are all carefully prepared, but even the freshness and cutting of the green onions are perfect.
Some places overseas just roughly chop them and throw them in, but this place is different.
The soup is also delicate and deep, unlike many ramen shops in Bangkok where the soup tends to be too rich.
I think it deserves to be more popular, but it's always empty when I go.
The fried chicken is also freshly fried, and the soy sauce and oil noodles are delicious.
Next time, I want to try the tonkotsu and chicken paitan ramen.
sample_reviews_en.author: K

sample_reviews_en.text:
His ramen from this story became the taste in our memories”

Driving to Japan, today you can choose the nation from Kunitachi City, Musashino City, western Tokyo through Mr. Nakamura's ramen bowl. The shop aims to bring the simple taste of authentic Japan for Thai people to experience.
The soup that is simmered until fragrant and soft, the chashu pork that melts in the mouth, all of this is not trying hard but makes you feel “sincerity” and “nostalgia”, including everyone having such memories before.
Mr. Nakamura said, “This is the taste that I grew up with and I want Thai people to know it,” and immediately understood why he wanted to share it with us.
“Tonkotsu”ramen is the menu I chose today. The taste is very good. You will have a good experience from this ramen shop with the care of the chef and staff. I want you to come and try it. 😊🍜
sample_reviews_en.author: Ked Naruemas

sample_reviews_en.text:
I wonder how many times I've been here...maybe around 30 times.

The staff changes, but a few of them know what I'm ordering without me even having to say it. I do tell them, though.

I only ever order the oil noodles, so I don't know what the best dish is. They seem to change the char siu sometimes, but it's always fantastic. After eating half, a quick swirl of apple cider vinegar, and I can't stop eating. I even stop touching my phone.

There are several places that use vinegar, but their sweet apple cider vinegar is Nobel Prize-worthy.

Today, when I went for lunch, there was a young Hong Kong man. I've seen him before. He's just gotten a little plumper. He must be a regular customer. If anyone's been coming here more often than me, it must be him.
sample_reviews_en.author: N Kazzy

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was really delicious. I tried the tonkotsu ramen, and the soup had a carefully crafted flavor. Before I knew it, I had almost finished drinking it all because it was so tasty. The noodle texture, chashu, menma, egg, and greens—all of them gave me the impression of being prepared with great care, without the slightest shortcut. I’d definitely like to try the shoyu ramen next time.

Update on January 12th, 2026
Second visit. After being impressed by the tonkotsu ramen last time, this time I tried the shoyu ramen. The chicken-based broth had good depth and was enjoyable. The first sip reminded me of the chicken extract smell of Brand’s essence. Personally, I still prefer the tonkotsu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gourmet Advisor

sample_reviews_en.text: I flew all the way from Chiang Mai just to eat at this restaurant. A friend recommended it, saying it tastes just like the original Japanese recipe. Today, we ordered the Tonkotsu bisque, their best-selling item, along with chicken karaage and takoyaki. The fried chicken was delicious and very tender. In short, everything was delicious, just as my friend recommended. I especially loved the soup; I usually don't like it too oily at other places. I'll definitely come back to try other dishes next time. The staff were very lovely too. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Paew Hwaew

sample_reviews_en.text:
They serve not only ramen, but also braised pork rice bowls.

This ramen shop in Phra Khanong offers authentic Japanese flavors.

This time, I had ramen, gyoza, and a braised pork rice bowl.

The ramen had a rich, flavorful broth, and the toppings—char siu pork, seasoned egg, bamboo shoots, green vegetables, and seaweed—were carefully prepared, creating a good balance with the noodles.

The bowl was filled with plenty of tenderly braised pork, and the sauce paired perfectly with the rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: ken ishikawa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Drawn in by the word "Tokyo"
The interior didn't look like a typical ramen shop, and it was my first visit.
I had a sudden craving for ramen, so I went out with my family...

Salt ramen (me), Tonkotsu ramen (my wife)
The char siu was different from what I expected
Maybe it was slow-cooked? It was delicious, the best I've had in a while
We ran out of rice halfway through though (lol)

Given the location, it's been a while since I've been here, but this street is full of karaoke places lol
sample_reviews_en.author: まーくんม้าอคุ่ง YUN

sample_reviews_en.text: Outstanding Tonkatsu ramen with three kinds of chashu. Soup was  rich, full of umami, but not overpowering, a perfect complement to the toppings. All three Chashu had different flavors and textures which added to the bowl. Wanton was very good as well and veggies were very fresh. The owner used to have a shop on Phrakhanong 14 which I really like and I was very happy to see that he has a new shop with even more varieties of soup to enjoy. I'll be back. Check it out!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tommie Duncan

restaurants.name: Grillicious Japanese BBQ
restaurants.address:

46 36, ตำบล หนองปรือ, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Little bit over priced but tasty place not many options of appetiser"

sample_reviews_th.text:
The shop had buffet and A la carte
Beef is good we always order Karubi beef
Always here for buffet 990+soft drink buffet 59 ฿
I would say best beef bbq buffet in Pattaya
Been here every 2-3 times a month
If you’re visiting at 4-5:30 pm is kinda hot inside the shop,best to come about 6 Pm
service is ok sometimes very good
Sometimes very slow
sample_reviews_th.author: Kelly Nk

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came here for a meal a few nights ago, let me be clear, the food is very, very good.
However, I felt let down by their service and policies.

The menu is relatively straight forwards, you can either order from the pork menu or you can opt for the beef menu which then also includes the pork menu.
However, be warned, everyone at the table has to order the same menu.
If someone opts for the beef menu, everyone is charged for the beef menu.

The same is true for the drink options, we had someone under age with us and only drinking water or soft drinks however, they made us pay the alcohol price for her as we were drinking alcoholic beverages, some of which were unavailable.

You get 1 hour and 45 minutes at the table, and again, be warned, any leftover uneaten food you may have ordered is charged for on top of the buffet price.

All this just did not make for a pleasant dining experience.
We felt untrusted and unwelcome before we had even looked at the menu, this made the atmosphere throughout the meal rather sour.

Whilst, as I have already stated, the food was of the highest standard, I did not feel that the price was justified, especially with their aggressive dining policies.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adam Zuberi

sample_reviews_en.text: The pricing is undeniably on the higher end, and to their credit, the quality of the meat is excellent—well-selected, fresh, and prepared with care. However, the overall dining experience was somewhat diminished by the service. The staff behavior felt unusual and slightly intrusive; there was a constant sense of being watched, with servers lingering nearby and circling our table throughout the meal. Additionally, remarks about potential penalties for unfinished food came across as uncomfortable and out of place in a restaurant of this caliber. While the food meets expectations for the price point, the service does not quite align with the refined and relaxed atmosphere one would anticipate from a premium Japanese yakiniku establishment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brando Chen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered 3 beef buffet meals, cost is 990 baht for food and 59 baht for soft drinks per person.

First off not all beef on the menu is available, at this price very disappointing.

The staff are not very attentive, also the service is very slow on the refill, I think they take into account you have a 1.45 hour time limit to eat and don't want you to get very much food.

The price to cook your own food is ridiculous.

3989 baht for 3 people is outrageous, especially because the food is average at best, the 5 star reviews on this place are baffling.

I will never go back to this place and can't in good conscience, recommend it to anyone.
sample_reviews_en.author: tony estes

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a fantastic family lunch at Grillicious Japanese BBQ in Pattaya. Choosing the buffet was brilliant; the meat quality was incredibly fresh and flavorful.

The service was also excellent—friendly, attentive, and fast, making for a relaxed, enjoyable meal. Our 3-year old toddler got a nice chair, and suitable tableware was provided.

Considering the top-tier food and superb experience, the price was very fair. With the added bonus of easy parking, Grillicious is a total win for the best Japanese BBQ in Pattaya!

Thanks for a wonderful meal and an unforgettable experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ernst Súni Magnussen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Grillicious is a very high end Japanese BBQ restaurant and so the buffet prices are quite high too. Though, the high prices does kinda justify the very good quality of meat they offer in the buffet (wagyu).

The wagyu was definitely legit. It was very tender and beefy in taste. The cuts in each dish was inconsistent though. We preferred the thinner slices for the bbq for best texture.

The staff were quite professional. There were some language barriers but they managed fine and served quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yawarakai O.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honestly, this is one of the best BBQs I have had in Thailand. Nice atmosphere, food and decent price.

I loved all the pork dishes we ordered. There were 2 kinds of sauces. One is the traditional Japanese Sauce and the other one was the signature restaurant sauce which tasted very much like Aka’s sauce.

The food arrived quickly and the staffs were very quick in serving.

I would totally drive from BKK to Pattaya to eat here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Monica’s Taste

sample_reviews_en.text:
AMAZING!!! A beautiful restaurant with the most delicious food! We chose the beef buffet and found it very worth the price! The quality of the food was outstanding with very fresh meat! The sides were just as delicious! Highlights were the Korean salad, Kim Chi, spicy seaweed salad and garlic fried rice.
Their cocktails were delicious too. Overall, it was a wonderful meal and I can’t wait to eat here again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Amanda Willey

restaurants.name: 420 Happy Bar Thailand (คาเฟ่กัญชา)
restaurants.address:

1359 Lasalle Rd, Bang Na Tai, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
English Version:
420 Happy Bar is a true passion project, showcasing what a cannabis shop should be—authentic, welcoming, and uncommercialized. With live music on weekends, a cozy vibe, and a great selection of strains, it’s a perfect spot to relax and enjoy the culture in its purest form.

Thai Version (ภาษาไทย):
420 Happy Bar is a project born from a genuine passion for cannabis culture, reflecting simplicity and a friendly, uncommercial approach. With live music on weekends and a warm atmosphere, it's the perfect place to relax and immerse yourself in the authentic cannabis culture.
sample_reviews_th.author: michelle curisma

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited 420 Happy Bar, and it was amazing! The warm atmosphere and beautiful decor truly reflect a love for cannabis culture. Live music on weekends adds to the relaxed vibe, making it a perfect spot to unwind.

It’s easy to see why this is considered one of the best cannabis places in Thailand. The menu has great drinks and tasty food, and the cannabis selection is fantastic and fragrant. The owner and staff are incredibly friendly, making everyone feel at home. Whether you enjoy cannabis or just want to hang out, 420 Happy Bar is a must-visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jha Oh

sample_reviews_en.text: Very convenient and great staff. Was able to chill smoke and relax while walking around the area. Awesome place to land if you want to smoke up and kick back. Quiet cheap and friendly
sample_reviews_en.author: Travell Weatherspoon

sample_reviews_en.text: There are tons of great deals and affordable things for you to try, no need to look anywhere else. Come to 420 Happy Bar, we have it all! Friendly staff and delicious food 😍
sample_reviews_en.author: นันท์นิชา แก้วคําลา

sample_reviews_en.text: Wow! They definitely have cannabis here. Whether it's food or drinks, whether you're into green or yellow, they have it all. It's a really good shop with great prices too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ytfamily Family

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, and the spicy flavor is very authentic. I highly recommend it; you definitely won't be disappointed. Even the regular soup is surprisingly tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bin Bin

sample_reviews_en.text: The aroma is irresistible! The price is great, they have everything, the products are really good, the place is nice, and the service is excellent. Come try High!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirapa Boochatham

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my favorite dispensary in my district, I always choose to come to this one because I love the vibe and the prices are very affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tara M

restaurants.name: Witch’s Tavern
restaurants.address:

20 Village 20-23, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: On June 15th, 2026, a waiter dropped my orange iPhone 17 Pro Max (I wasn't using a case) on the table with the menu on top, leaving a very noticeable scratch. After ordering, I tried to pick up the menu, but the waiter dragged it away, taking my phone with them. They didn't take any responsibility and even came back later, telling me to put my phone on the sofa instead of the table. I couldn't make a fuss because it was a farewell party for a friend before they moved back to their country, and I didn't want to ruin the atmosphere. We came to this restaurant because it's usually our regular spot, even if the food wasn't amazing, it was for the sake of creating a lasting memory. I want that waiter or the restaurant to take responsibility.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krichmon Hongthong

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of my absolute favorite bars!
I come here often and love that each floor has its own atmosphere, so it never feels repetitive.
Love the pool table — there are always great players there who keep you playing all night.
The staff are always friendly and welcoming, and the owner is genuinely lovely! You can really feel the good energy of the place.
Great vibes with great customers every time and always a good night here.
Highly recommend!
Keep it up 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Picolo

sample_reviews_en.text: The best bar in Thailand ! The boss makes you feel at home and is an amazing and warm person 🙏 The staff is doing more then a great job, they are kind and always serve everyone at the highest level possible 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 Accommodation is great, Pool table at first floor, live music at top floor, so many different vibes in 1 place!! Food is great and the music is lovely. Thank you so much Witch’s family for all our great moments❤️ see you soon 🍀 The Belgian guy
sample_reviews_en.author: ghilain gil

sample_reviews_en.text: A cozy bar with live music and a stylish interior. They serve draft Guinness, which is a pleasant experience in itself. But what really stuck in my mind was the unusual painting: Viktor Tsoi sitting against a backdrop of prefabricated apartment buildings. And it's amid portraits of Jimi Hendrix, John Lennon, and other rock legends. This was quite a surprise for Bangkok. However, when I asked who was depicted in the painting, the staff couldn't answer.
sample_reviews_en.author: G T

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant and bar has an amazing vibe, but unfortunately, the food was very disappointing.

The ribs were very dry and not tender at all. They tasted dull and lacked flavor. The food also took around one hour to arrive, which was disappointing.

However, the drinks were excellent. The wine and cocktails were amazing, and the house wine was especially great.

I would recommend this place for drinks only, but I would pass on the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angiejk

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is a scam.  They put a happy hour where you buy 1 and get another free.  But they change the prices for drinks during happy hour.  So  you end up paying almost the same as regular prices.  And they also add 17% vat and service charges.  We ended up paying 800 baht for a pint of Guinness  and a shot of Jameson!!!!! The same bill as a full dinner in other places
sample_reviews_en.author: Yasir Al-Kadhem

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had fish (nattered sea bass) and chips. It was nice enough but not special. Beers on patio 2 for 1. Not a pint but in a draught mug. Very helpful and friendly servers.

They add on 10% service charge which I object to. If you want to add more as standard, add it to the price!!!
Then another 7% charges for VAT.
So THB 790 (£18.64) bill became THB 930 (£21.94).
sample_reviews_en.author: Sandy Werner

sample_reviews_en.text: Had a great experience at Witch’s Oyster Tavern. The atmosphere is stylish and welcoming, the service was excellent, and everything felt very well done. It’s the kind of place that has a lot of character and leaves a strong impression. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a quality spot in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cale Gibson

restaurants.name: Muslim Kitchen Lamsalee (Halal)
restaurants.address:

428 Krungthep Kreetha Rd, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a traditional Muslim restaurant. The delicious menu includes chicken/beef/goat biryani. The biryani is excellent. They also have a Middle Eastern salad, beef soup, and spicy oxtail stew that's tender and delicious. Free ice is available. It's a great roadside restaurant (literally roadside). Park your car on the bridge over the Lam Sali canal and walk down the (quite steep) stairs to street level. The restaurant is located right at the U-turn under the bridge, next to the canal. The atmosphere isn't particularly pleasant, but the food is delicious and flavorful. Anyone passing through this area should stop by and try it.
Muslim Kitchen (Old Shop) Under the Bridge
Open from 6:00 AM - 3:00 PM (Closed every Sunday)
sample_reviews_en.author: Roch

sample_reviews_en.text: We've eaten at this restaurant many times, but there's no parking because it's located under a bridge. This time, we ordered takeout. We ordered chicken biryani and oxtail soup. The chicken biryani was delicious as always; the rice was perfectly soft, not dry or crumbly like some other places. The chicken leg was flavorful and firm, and the dipping sauce was tasty, not too sweet. The oxtail soup had tender and delicious oxtail, a generous portion enough for two people, and a spicy, flavorful broth. It was very tasty. Importantly, the prices are reasonable: chicken biryani is 50 baht per set, and oxtail soup is 120 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ya T

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located under the bridge, so you might have to search a bit for it, especially if you've never been here before 😅😅😅
- I don't usually eat Muslim food, but I was very impressed.
The restaurant is clean, not cluttered, and looks cool and comfortable. Water is provided.
- There are many types of food. The rice mixed with shrimp paste is delicious.
The chicken biryani is very tender, and the rice is fragrant and flavorful.
- There is also a variety of à la carte dishes.
If you come in the late morning, some menu items might be sold out.
*I'll go back again next time to try other dishes 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: yammy takiko

sample_reviews_en.text: This roadside restaurant (literally right by the road) requires parking on the bridge over the canal and walking down (quite steep) stairs to street level. The restaurant is located right at the U-turn under the bridge. Their signature dishes are chicken/beef/goat biryani, but today I ordered chicken and oxtail soup – flavorful and tender. Free ice is available. The restaurant is located just past the bridge, right by the canal. The atmosphere isn't particularly pleasant, but the food is delicious and flavorful. If you work in the area, stop by for a meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanchalerm Srirattana

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old, established restaurant. I recommend the oxtail soup; it's very tasty. It pairs well with the tender, succulent rice. The rice grains are beautifully separated. The only downside is parking; you have to park on the bridge and walk down under it to make a U-turn. It's next to the Saep Saep canal, so there's a faint canal smell. Anyone specifically looking for this restaurant should come here.
sample_reviews_en.author: เลิฟบู

sample_reviews_en.text: The soup cost 110 baht, and the portion was surprisingly small. I asked for a bowl, but they wouldn't give it to me. The condiments, like chili and fried onions, weren't served separately or included. The taste was standard, the kind you'd find at any typical Muslim biryani soup shop, but the quantity and price felt disproportionate.
sample_reviews_en.author: WG

sample_reviews_en.text: The beef biryani was incredibly delicious! The rice was perfectly cooked, the beef was tender and not chewy at all, and the dipping sauce was great. The oxtail stew and beef stew were also amazing. I really want to go back again. It was so good! However, it's hot inside and there's no parking; you have to park on the bridge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rata

sample_reviews_en.text: I recently dined at a lovely restaurant that boasts a welcoming atmosphere and attentive staff. The employees were not only friendly but genuinely nice, making us feel right at home. They were eager to assist with menu suggestions and ensured our dining experience was enjoyable from start to finish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Reviewer

restaurants.name: L'Auberge
restaurants.address:

216, 94 Moo 10, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
December 26, 2025: Excellent! Truly excellent! Worthy of a Michelin star.

First of all, the decor: The dining room is neither too big nor too small, intimate, perfectly decorated, warm, and tasteful (not always the case in Pattaya). The waiters' uniforms are friendly, and the professionalism of the servers is impeccable—always smiling, attentive, and discreet. The menu is magnificent, full of specialties, with a variety of prices. I chose the oysters—and by the way, it's worth noting the impressive feat of serving French oysters in Thailand, 10,000 km away—(Marennes and Gillardeau) on ice, with lemons, vinegar, and bread rolls. Perfect. My friend had the set menu (800 THB) and was also very satisfied with the salad, Serrano ham, and burger/fries. The chocolate mousse/crumble was magnificent for dessert. We'll be back very soon for the raclette, couscous, and flank steak. In short, everything looks tempting. The French owner is, of course, very welcoming. It's a long-established and reputable Pattaya establishment, and it deserves all its success and more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Gauthier

sample_reviews_en.text:
When talking about an authentic French bistro, l’Auberge is propably the closest place that comes to it while being in the heart of Pattaya.
I’m so glad my wife and I decided to try it out.
As a Belgian I’m a huge fan of French cuisine and being able to get that in Thailand is amazing. We came in late without reservation, yet staff were very helpful and accomodating. There is a Sunday arrangement but we decided to eat a la carte. The food was great, I especially liked the beef tartare, fresh and sharp as it is supposed to be, with the added sauces on the side to flavour to ones liking. Although we were more than full, I had the cheese buffet as dessert anyway and didn’t regret it at all.
Definitely a good experience and a place we will return to.
Congrats to staff and owner for creating this place, you put the work in it and it shows.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yves Decan

sample_reviews_en.text:
We returned several times to ensure the quality remained consistently high. 20/20. It's perfect. The inventive and varied menus, excellent value for money, impeccable quality, an incredible selection, a feast in both quantity and quality. We chose the all-you-can-eat charcuterie/cheese/raclette buffet (there's even unlimited truffle cheese!! Incredible, considering we weren't in our beautiful French countryside but at Auberge, the best French restaurant in Chonburi, Thailand).
The service was impeccable, from the owner and his discreet and efficient team. Here, you don't have to ask the waiter for more bread; it arrives on its own at the table because every detail is taken care of. In short, go! It's so good, so delicious, that we could come every day...
sample_reviews_en.author: renate lise

sample_reviews_en.text:
Always a satisfying experience!
We've been to L'Auberge before but didn't write a review. On this visit we tried their famous Sunday Cheese buffet for the first time and left very satisfied, happy, and stuffed 😊.
The buffet includes at least 20 kinds of premium cheese, mostly from France.
There are also 3 kinds of Raclette cheese to melt at your table on the provided raclette oven. Besides cheese, there are several kinds of cold cuts (Charcuterie) and even smoked Salmon.
Boiled potatoes and Bread are provided at your table and constantly replenished by the attentive staff.

At 999B per person, and no time limit, this is an excellent value.  Note: drinks are not included.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Travelers

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went for the Sunday cheese and charcuterie special and it did not disappoint.
Nice selection of cheeses and meats also include a salad and baked potatoes with raclette set.  At the end complementary rum raising ice cream was the perfect touch.

Staff made constantly sure I had everything I needed. Very friendly and helpful as is the chef/ owner.
The setting is cozy and comfortable with linen tabletops.
Now I need to go back and taste his cooking which I will do with excitement.

Credit cards accepted is also a nice touch.
sample_reviews_en.author: W DV

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went today with a friend, we each got our own 3-course-meal and a cold cut and cheese platter to share. The food was super good, very authentic. Everything from the breads, all the way to dessert were superb and reasonably priced. The service was also very good, nice atmosphere. I look forward to go back again.

Ps.There’s a parking space in the back of the complex, the entrance is in the middle, right through the complex as you can see on the map.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thamonwan danaisawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
L'Auberge is in the hidden gems of Pattaya category.
A cosy restaurant on Pattaya 3rd road that serves excellent french food, prepared by a French chef that takes pride in his cooking.

Tonight we've had the steak with 'Café de Paris' Sauce. The entrecôte was coked perfectly and tender, but the star of the dish was the sauce - amazing!

This was my 4th or 5th visit to L'Auberge and certainly not the last one.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrick Stoessel

sample_reviews_en.text: I highly recommend this restaurant for its delicious food and exceptional service. The chef clearly takes great pride in his craft, as evidenced by the high quality of the dishes. During my visit, the chef even personally came to check on us, which was a nice touch. The staff were also very attentive and made sure that our dining experience was enjoyable. Overall, the food is well worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thai Sun

restaurants.name: Salathip
restaurants.address:

Level 1 Shangri-La Bangkok 89 Wat Suan Phlu Alley, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Salathip (ศาลาทิพย์)

Located within the Shangri-La Hotel in Bangkok, this restaurant sits beside the …
sample_reviews_th.author: Alicebubu_travel

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited Salatip Restaurant at the Shangri-La Bangkok to celebrate our anniversary with authentic Thai food, even though we weren’t staying at the hotel. The food was fresh and very tasty, with excellent Thai flavors throughout the meal.
The staff were very present, attentive, and genuinely friendly. Mok from the restaurant reception was wonderful — she kindly helped us make the reservation. As a nice surprise, the restaurant gave us complimentary wine, which made our special occasion even better. We really appreciated the thoughtful gesture.
Unfortunately, we didn’t take any photos of the dishes. The hotel itself is getting a bit old but still maintains a classy Thai style with excellent staff and management.
We will definitely come back and highly recommend Salatip for both hotel guests and visitors looking for great Thai cuisine and warm service.
sample_reviews_en.author: M Molly

sample_reviews_en.text:
Liked:
1) The view from the terrace. We caught the sunset and admired the river and boats.
2) Dessert: "Pandan Noodles with Cane Sugar"

Disliked:
1) We were greeted by an unfriendly receptionist.
2) The girl who took our order wore a very strong perfume and was rude to us from the moment we ordered until we paid.
3) The espresso cup was stained with coffee.
4) They didn't open the bottled beer in front of us; it was brought to us already opened, and they didn't ask if we wanted it poured into a glass.
sample_reviews_en.author: Diana Karmazina

sample_reviews_en.text: The food here was amazing. We couldn't put our cutlery down. We had their ribeye namtok, which was very tender and tab tim mieng fish. The portions were very generous. Their staff was super friendly and took great care of us. Especially, K.Nan who reccomended great dishes for us. The dishes are really unique and show the chef's personal flare.  You can even tell from the sauces that seem handmade and compliment the diahes very well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Navat Churnun

sample_reviews_en.text:
No wonder the restaurant is mostly empty!

Honestly, I was pretty shocked by how bad the food was. Everything was bland, the portions were tiny, and our main course took forever to arrive. At this price point, you’d at least expect decent local food—but that wasn’t the case at all. We spent about USD 50 per person, and it absolutely wasn’t worth it. Do yourself a favor and go somewhere else.
sample_reviews_en.author: danny

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely wonderful dining experience! The food was incredibly fresh and delicious, and every dish was beautifully presented with great attention to detail. The staff were exceptionally friendly, attentive, and professional, making us feel truly welcome throughout our visit.
Employee names include chef Yanavit,
Krobporn, Pennant, Thanaporn, Fern, Worden.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sudarat Roongwara

sample_reviews_en.text: You absolutely must dine at an outdoor table.💗 It is truly beautiful at night, with the gentle sound of waves and the burning incense outside, which really calmed my mind. The food was neat and clean, and it was wonderful chatting about this and that with my loved one. The atmosphere is truly amazing ✨
sample_reviews_en.author: GgoMo꼬모커플

sample_reviews_en.text: Dining was a real highlight of our stay at the Shangri-La Bangkok. The Salathip restaurant offers not only delicious and refined Thai cuisine, but also a stunning riverside setting and impeccable service, making the experience truly memorable
sample_reviews_en.author: leon campeas

restaurants.name: Diyalo Griha
restaurants.address:

86/5 Ratchaprarop Rd, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I have been in a Thai restaurant in Vietnam. I really loved Tom Yum. My very first dream is traveling to Thailand and enjoy their food. That why I really rigorous about Tom Yum's taste. But when I came here Diyalo Griha, I was surprised. Tom yum was much more better than the one I had enjoyed in Vietnam. It was awesome. Spicy and sour food is my fav. Tom yum has both. And Diyalo Griha gave me a balance taste one. I will definitely come back if there's any chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Henry Ha

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place was a surprising find. But I kind of feel fortunate to have found it.

This place serves authentic Indian and Nepalese cuisine.

Me along with friends ordered chicken curry, egg curry and dal tadka along with lassi and naan. I was blown away by the taste of the food. It was as if we were having the food in any resturant in India itself.

Strongly recommended and I certainly would visit again as and when I'm in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeevan Sharma

sample_reviews_en.text: This Nepali restaurant serves delicious Indian -Nepali cuisine  in an affordable price. I would recommend to take Nepali Thali which is sufficient for any individual. I felt starter items are a bit expensive. This restaurant serves Halal food. This small restaurant is located in a convenient place near Indra market of Pratunam. The owner Mr. Thapa is truly a gentleman and very friendly. Hope to have  dinner/lunch next time also.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr. Ziauddin Ahmed

sample_reviews_en.text: Unfortunately I had frustrating experience here at Diyalo Griha. Dining alone, I was looking forward to a good Indian meal, buoyed by a good atmosphere in this cosy restaurant, but ended up waiting over an hour - even for the starters - only for a mixed experience food-wise. I ordered the chicken achari, and while it tasted amazing, the  chicken had lots of bones in. Wish I could have rated higher, but frustrating overall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Elliot Shah

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Nepali Thali and Momo!

This restaurant is a walking distance by Makkasan Airport link. Here serves Indian as Nepali recipe. You can also buy frozen Momo back home as well.

I have ordered Vegetarian Thali and Momo with sauce. The Thali takes around 15 minutes to prepare yet it is pretty tasty. The momo is also very yummy.

The price is regular Indian price like 250-350/persons.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuchnalin Leerasantana

sample_reviews_en.text: I’m basing my review on a recent Grab order.  I’m very disappointed because the portions were tiny.  Their curries are tasty, but the portions are simply too small.  One container was only half full (see photo)!  Two of us spent 990 baht for a dinner we finished in about 10 minutes — and we are still hungry.  Also, the garlic nan is flavorless. No wonder they give it away.  Never again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert McPherson

sample_reviews_en.text:
A great restaurant with a wide array of delicious Nepali cuisines. We have been to this place a few times in the last couple of months already and have never been disappointed. Though the serving time may be slightly long, what appeals us is the fact that the order is cooked fresh and served hot.
The chicken steamed momo is my personal favourite and I recommend it strongly :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Dibyadarshan Acharya

sample_reviews_en.text: Traditional Nepali cuisine and best one in Bangkok. After ordering on grab, we decided to dine in this time. Food is freshly made and staff provided great service. Momo, thali and duck choila were our favourite. For some reason tandoori did not hit the spot. I would also encourage clean uniforms for staff as something the restaurant can improve.
sample_reviews_en.author: B Basnyat

restaurants.name: M&M Asiatique The Riverfront Indian-Thai Halal Restaurant
restaurants.address:

2194 ถ. เจริญกรุง Wat Phraya Krai, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
M&M Asiatique Riverfront Restaurant is a true gem in Bangkok, offering a delightful dining experience. The restaurant's ambience is exceptional, with a modern yet cozy vibe that makes it perfect for a relaxing meal. Situated near the riverfront, the setting is serene and adds to the overall charm.

The food here is simply outstanding! We ordered Chana Masala, steamed rice, and Tandoori Roti, and each dish was incredibly delicious. The Chana Masala was perfectly spiced, rich in flavor, and paired excellently with the soft and fresh Tandoori Roti. The portion sizes were generous, and the quality of food was top-notch.

What sets this place apart is the reasonable pricing and good quantity, which is a refreshing change compared to other Indian restaurants in Bangkok. It offers authentic Indian flavors without burning a hole in your pocket.

The service was prompt, and the staff were friendly and attentive, ensuring a pleasant experience throughout. If you’re craving authentic and tasty Indian food in Bangkok, M&M Asiatique Riverfront Restaurant is a must-visit. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Two.travel.techies

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is delicious, I highly recommend it, and the price is reasonable.

This is my second time eating there.
Shrimp Biryani 10/10 (Delicious)
Chicken Biryani 10/10 (Delicious)
White Basmati Rice 8/10 (Was bland, needed more salt)
Chicken Tikka Masala 10/10 (Delicious)
Chicken Curry 8/10
Butter Chicken 7/10 (Has a hint of sugar)
Spiced Potatoes (Salt and Pepper) 10/10 (Delicious)
Yogurt Mix with Cucumber, Onion, and Tomato 10/10 (Delicious)
They have delicious Cheese Naan 10/10
Butter Naan and Plain Naan (Regular) 6/10
sample_reviews_en.author: Ibrahim Alajmi

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a wonderful dining experience at the Indian restaurant in Asiatique The Riverfront. The food was exceptional, the service top-notch, and the ambiance delightful. An added convenience was the mobile charging spot conveniently located near our table. It's a great place to enjoy delicious cuisine while staying connected.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rithu Maria Jose

sample_reviews_en.text: From the fragrant, succulent, juicy, perfectly charred Fish tikka, to the juicy and mouthful of rich brothy steamed chicken momos, to the absolutely amazing staff with the kindest of characters and super hospitable. What an absolutely …
sample_reviews_en.author: Laylà Isaacs

sample_reviews_en.text: An excellent Indian restaurant! The service was quick and efficient, and the staff were very friendly and helpful. The food was delicious and of great quality. We ordered chicken and vegetable samosas, chicken biryani, curry, chicken …
sample_reviews_en.author: Abdullah Dawwari

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was fantastic, the atmosphere is wonderful the music is soothing and the place is very clean. Staff here are very nice and friendly, the food is beyond expression especially the butter chicken that is a must!!! …
sample_reviews_en.author: Pow Wongtanakarn

sample_reviews_en.text: Superb Indian restaurant. Service was prompt and the food was generous portions and very tasty. Prices were reasonable in relation to quantity and taste. I unfortunately ate before i could take pictures of the other dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Farahnaaz Allie

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent Indian cuisine! The food was absolutely delicious — the Palak Paneer was rich and flavorful, and the Masala Chai was simply outstanding. Highly recommended for anyone who loves authentic Indian food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Любовь Ершова

restaurants.name: ครัวนมหก ร่วมฤดี Kuanomhok Restaurants
restaurants.address:

48/1 Soi Ruamrudee Community, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Must try Thai restaurant in the area. Low key and their foods are superb. Located in the small alley which has 7/11 in front which is across the church. They got every single Thai food representative like Pad Thai, TomYum,etc. Prices are very very reasonable. The restaurant is quite small but worth a try when you are around the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Win Thaw Ko

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the prices are very reasonable. I’m only in Bangkok for a few days, so I wanted to try as many different dishes as possible. I couldn’t finish everything, but I really enjoyed every dish I tried. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Paulius

sample_reviews_en.text: We stumbled in by chance and were more than satisfied! A cute little restaurant at the end of an alley, the food is prepared with love, looks fantastic, and tastes really good! And as we discovered when paying the bill, it's also affordable!
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex ander

sample_reviews_en.text: A hidden gem! 💎This cute little Thai restaurant is tucked away in a small alley, so you might miss it if you don't look closely. But it is totally worth the search! The seasoning here is spot on. You absolutely must try the Tom Yum and the …
sample_reviews_en.author: Phúc Trương

sample_reviews_en.text: Located within a 10-minute walk from the Conrad Hotel. I tried the restaurant and used Grab for meals throughout my trip. Since it's close, Grab orders are delivered hot. All the food is delicious, and the prices are very reasonable!
sample_reviews_en.author: 고지영

sample_reviews_en.text: Authentic Thai Cuisine :) Delicious, quick and friendly service, great portions. You can pay the bill by card, however extra 3% will be applied. Our dinner of 2 main dishes, 2 sides and 2 beers ended in 864B. Amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lesia Dyvanchuk

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolute hidden gem. Down a little ally way behind a 7Eleven. Service was great and food was amazing. When were there rather early, 5pm and were the only once in there. Food arrived quickly and was very tasty
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris

sample_reviews_en.text: There is short alley next to the 7 11.  This place is about 25 meters into the alley.  Prices start at 80 thb. Very clean . You can sit outside and enjoy one of the most delicious meals you will ever have
sample_reviews_en.author: Zach Mathews

restaurants.name: ไก่ลู่ลม ร้านอาหารอีสาน
restaurants.address:

87 1, Tambon Bang Khanun, Bang Kruai District, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
📌 This Northeastern Thai restaurant is hidden away, deep down an alley. The atmosphere is natural, with bamboo decorations. Elderly people and those with mobility issues should be careful on the walkway.
🍽 Papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce: Spicy, with a strong sourness, but the fermented fish sauce wasn't very fragrant or flavorful. There wasn't much papaya.
🐷 Pork larb: The best dish we ordered.
🐷 Grilled pork neck: Very bland, lacking any fragrant marinade. It wasn't served hot.
🍗 Original fried chicken: You can choose the part. Wait 15 minutes. The taste didn't live up to the wait. It smelled of rancid frying oil and was greasy. The chicken wasn't cooked through inside. When I informed the staff, they quickly took it back to fry it thoroughly. They should improve the taste and frying method.
🍄 Sweet potato leaf curry with fresh shrimp: Good flavor, but a bit fishy. The sweet potato leaves were a bit tough.
🍚 Sticky rice: Soft and delicious.
🥤 Lemongrass and pandan drink: Fragrant, sweet, and delicious.
♦️ The staff provided good and fast service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lara Linh

sample_reviews_en.text:
3.5/5

This is a modern Northeastern Thai restaurant with a great design and atmosphere. It's located in a garden and is open-air, so it might not be very comfortable in hot weather. The food taste is generally average, not particularly outstanding.

Dishes I tried:
• Som Tum (Papaya Salad) – The taste was predominantly sweet.
• Koi Suk (Spicy Minced Meat Salad) – The flavor was strong and good.
• Hao Dong Beef (Spicy Beef Salad) – The beef was sliced ​​too thick, making it tough, and the doneness wasn't sufficient. This dish was a failure.

Service > The female staff member who was key in taking orders had a strange way of speaking, especially some phrases that seemed untrained for this type of restaurant. This needs improvement.

Seats > Limited seating. It's recommended to call and reserve a table.

Summary: The restaurant is suitable for a chill hangout, but if you expect amazing flavors that will make you want to return, this might not be for you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sariya J

sample_reviews_en.text: I wanted to give 0 stars but couldn't. I've eaten at the restaurant 2-3 times, the food is delicious and the service is good. But I've ordered delivery 2-3 times. The first time, the restaurant was closed but I accepted the order. The rider arrived at the restaurant, called to say it was closed, and I waited in vain. The second time, the rider brought the food, the order slip was correct, but the food delivered was wrong. I had to contact the staff again. The staff called to ask for my address, saying they would deliver it themselves, and I gave them the address, but they still delivered to the wrong place, even though the restaurant is only 1.9 kilometers from my house. We talked for almost 2 hours and I still didn't get my food. The food isn't cheap; I pay because it's delicious, but I've had enough of this happening. I've given them two chances, but there won't be a next time. It's terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: AINTHIRA SONSUKONG

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered fried chicken, Thai papaya salad, and lotus stem salad with crab and fermented fish sauce. >>> The Thai papaya salad was just salty; it didn't taste like Thai papaya salad at all.
The lotus stem salad was extremely salty. It was so salty, like it was just fermented fish sauce mixed with salt. It was inedible. I asked them to remake it, even suggesting they add some sweetness. After they remade it, the taste was still the same; the saltiness was only slightly reduced. Still inedible. The fried chicken, however, was delicious. It also came with crispy noodles.

P.S. I personally prefer very salty and sour food. Imagine how salty this must have been for someone who doesn't like very salty food. It's a shame the restaurant is beautiful and has a nice atmosphere, but the food quality needs significant improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Whip sodaza

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is well-decorated and clean, with convenient parking.
However, the access road is under construction, making it narrow and inconvenient.

The food taste is average, nothing outstanding.
The staff are polite, but the ordering system is confusing; orders are often incomplete, items are served to the wrong table, and food preparation is slow.

Personal rating: 6.5/10
(Remarks: *Personal opinion* scale
*** Below 7 means I wouldn't return.
7️⃣ Okay taste, would be acceptable if someone invited me.
8️⃣ Delicious, would go again occasionally.
9️⃣ Very delicious, would highly recommend.
🔟🏆 Extremely delicious, would go again frequently, would be a regular restaurant.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Phattaraphon “Boom” H.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant has a beautiful bamboo design concept, a great atmosphere, and parking. It might be a little hot during the day as it's an open-air setting, but they provide fans 😊 It would probably be nice and cool in the evening.

-Spicy Pork Rib Soup: Very sour and spicy, highly recommended.
-Thai Papaya Salad with Crispy Pork Rinds: Generous amount of ingredients, crispy pork rinds.
-Spicy Vermicelli Salad with Crispy Catfish: Flavorful with crispy catfish.
-Signature Fried Chicken: Crispy chicken, I really liked the lemongrass it came with, highly recommended.
-Sweetened Liver: Juicy and tender, not dry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Caloriesvoyage

sample_reviews_en.text: The deep-fried beef with fat was incredibly delicious! I ordered two plates. It was so good, I'm still craving it. Talking about it makes me hungry! 555555🤣 The other dishes were okay too. The papaya salad with thin noodles was edible, but the fermented fish sauce wasn't as flavorful as I'd like. 8/10. I'm deducting points because the food took forever to arrive. Too long. The restaurant has parking, but there's road construction, so you can't drive in the opposite direction. Try looking for it. If you see the temple, turn left onto the dirt road; don't go straight into the temple. 👍🏼👍🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: Varissara Nattapattana

sample_reviews_en.text:
- This is a hidden gem of an Isaan (Northeastern Thai) restaurant located down an alley. Parking is available right at the restaurant. There are both air-conditioned and outdoor seating areas.
- The spicy pork dipping sauce was okay. The fried pork neck was good, but the dipping sauce was the highlight. The vermicelli salad (we ordered it without fermented fish sauce) was quite sour. The fried pork waterfall salad was tasty.
- The staff provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eve Amolrat

restaurants.name: Kaolao Nang Loeng Pork Brain Shop
restaurants.address:

5 22 Chakkraphatdi Phong Rd, Wat Sommanat, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Taste - 10/10
Service - 10/10
Price - 9/10
Ambiance - 8/10
Parking - 2/10

Recommendation - Delicious pig's brain soup with no gamey smell.

Recommendations - Delicious pig's brain soup with pig's offals.

Must try - Pig's brain soup with everything (assorted kinds of offals).

Pros - Very delicious taste, hot soup, no gamey offal smell, delicious radish cake. Reasonable price. Good, quick, and friendly service.

Cons - No parking. There's still some parking available for motorcycles.

Don’t be surprised - No parking nearby. Only motorcycles can be parked.

Update (June 16, 2022) (Picture 18) - Bought some to take home and added delicious straw mushrooms.

Update (March 14, 2026) (Picture 19) - Enjoying the delicious, peppery soup.

Update (March 14, 2026) (Picture 19) - Peppery soup.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thaweechot Tatiyapermpoon

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a pork innards soup restaurant, and as the name suggests, it contains "pigs' brains (samoan moo)." There are many different types of innards, so it's very filling. The contents can be changed according to your request, but it's a good idea to order the whole thing for now.
Before eating, put chopped chili peppers on a small plate and dilute it with a little vinegar. The correct way to eat this restaurant is to dip the ingredients in small amounts into it. It's even better if you order moo yang (roasted pork) or kung chian (Chinese sausage) as side orders.
The soup is generally quite spicy, so you may need to ask for it to be adjusted. However, the flavor itself is extremely light, so a little spiciness would be better.
sample_reviews_en.author: THAI SANPO FUJII

sample_reviews_en.text:
My dad brought me here. At first, I was hesitant and didn't dare try it, but I was impressed by the cleanliness of the restaurant. The floor and tables were spotless, unlike some older restaurants. They must take very good care of it.
Once I gave it a try, I knew I'd be back.
The soup wasn't fishy at all; it was flavorful and not too strong. And when eaten with their dipping sauce, I finished the whole bowl in a minute. The dipping sauce is the MVP; its sourness cuts through the richness perfectly.
The owner, an elderly lady, was lovely and not grumpy. She was patient even when we ordered incorrectly. In short, it's nothing like typical old-school restaurants. It's fantastic!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pamai S

sample_reviews_en.text:
• I've passed by often but was afraid I wouldn't know how to eat there. Today was my first time : )
• The owner was very helpful and the service was excellent.

• If you don't eat offal, you can choose from pork, meatballs, and tofu.
• They have all kinds of offal. I tried the brain for the first time; the texture was very soft and easy to eat, depending on personal preference.
• The soup was good, not too strong or salty, just right.
• The portion of the noodle soup was very generous; one bowl is enough for two people.
• The grilled pork tasted great.
• Free tea and ice are provided.
sample_reviews_en.author: ducky kung

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd heard about this place for a long time and only tried their pork brain soup, but I'd given it a try since I was in the area. And I wasn't disappointed! It was delicious, creamy and gel-like. The broth was also great, with lots of bone and a nice aroma. I'll definitely be back in the area next time. Anyone passing by this area should try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tee Niwut

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very good food. Broth was fantastic. Very flavourful.

The owner was very patient and polite. She is a bespectacled old lady that speaks good English. She would patiently explain the dish to you.

The ingredients such as pork brain, liver etc was not my thing. Didn't quite enjoy the dish.

But highly recommend everyone to visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: James Ong

sample_reviews_en.text: This old restaurant has maintained its charm remarkably well. The broth is flavorful, the offal is good and not smelly, and the radish meatballs are delicious and hard to find elsewhere. They also give you a generous portion of pig brain, perfect for those looking for high-protein food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Greatest

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant looks old but is clean. The owner and staff are very friendly. The pork brain soup tastes delicious; the broth uses a lot of pepper. If it's too spicy, they'll add some pepper-free broth for you. For parking, drive past the restaurant and look along the roadside.
sample_reviews_en.author: poonsak sgricegroup

restaurants.name: Madcow burger x Under Over Ari
restaurants.address:

In A-ONE Ari, Soi Ari 1, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Friendly staff, good quality food, good service and very reasonably priced."

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don’t know anything about Madcow Burger, but I definitely cannot recommend Under Over, which we tried tonight for the first time.  Thais just cannot make a decent pizza.  They seem to think that any Italian dish that’s made with bread should be all about the bread.  Every slice of pizza contained 3 bites that were topped with ingredients.  The rest of the slice was nothing but the massive, doughy crust edge — way too much bread.  The focaccia was terrible — just a thick piece of bread with minimal toppings.  We got 2 different kinds, took maybe 3 bites of each, and threw out the rest.  The best thing was the hash browns.  Don’t bother with this place.

If you want good pizza, order from Chef Bing's.  I tried it last night for the first time and thought it was excellent.  The chef lived in New York for 30 years and really knows how to make pizza.  They are generous with ingredients and don't leave a bare ring of fat dough around the edge like Under Over does.  Chef Bing's is the best!
sample_reviews_en.author: Carlos Santiago

sample_reviews_en.text:
Madcow Burger has a few locations around Bangkok, and the Ari branch is a great spot if you’re craving a quality burger. The restaurant itself is quite small, creating a cosy, laid-back atmosphere.

We ordered the Smash Burger, Madcow Burger, and Cheeseburger, all served on their signature charcoal buns. The buns were light, soft, and complemented the juicy, flavour-packed burgers perfectly.

While enjoying our burgers with a cold beer, we noticed a constant flow of delivery orders, many of them including freshly baked bread and sourdough. It’s clear that their bakery is just as popular as their burgers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Afibosaf Stories

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good burgers at Ari.
Located in a small restaurant area near to the BTS Ari. Wide variety of dishes, additional toppings and sides.
Some sitting available inside, but it is very limited so probably you would be forced to sit outside.
Service is nice, but assuming I ordered a burger I was expecting gloves or at least a wet wipe as burgers are usually eaten with bare hands.
The burger itself was good, fresh, juicy and the patty wasn’t overcooked. I didn’t really understand the chips in the side as they tasted like basic store potato chips…
The fries were good, but nothing extraordinary.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ivan Dragomiretskiy

sample_reviews_en.text: The burger was made very well; the meat was juicy and paired perfectly with the melted cheese. The restaurant also has other interesting menu items, such as pizza, sandwiches, and freshly baked bread made daily. If you're looking for a good burger place in Bangkok, I think this is one to consider. I highly recommend this restaurant. The downside is that the restaurant doesn't have much space, and you have to park on the street. If you drive, you'll have to take your chances with the traffic police.
sample_reviews_en.author: TUUL

sample_reviews_en.text: Really good burger spot. I had the smash burger with the homemade sauce, my girlfriend had the cheeseburger, and we shared the tomato focaccia. I especially liked how the edges of the smash patty were thin and crispy, and the homemade sauce really made the whole burger. Both burgers were juicy and full of flavor, and the focaccia was fresh, savory, and well worth ordering. Generous portions, friendly staff, and fair prices for the quality. Fantastic overall. We’d definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason Camillo

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the signature MadCow normal size. Totally worth it! Perfect portion. I was surprised by the thickness of grilled beef burger.
Not too salty comparing average burgers in Thailand.
Atmosphere is a bit too small but you can sit outside in the common area.
Well done guys! Definitely will visit again.
Oh, no parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Belle Luxsika

sample_reviews_en.text: Their best selling menu, Smash burger was delicious with a good portion, but since I arrived 5.15pm which around dinner time, I had to wait for almost 20mins for the burger bc they had a lot of orders from grab/lineman. The bread from under over is always superb. I ordered them from Grab from time to time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirithon Kaewsuphan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Simple seating indoors w/ AC or outdoors in sort of a food court area. Burgers are deluxe with great fixings on top. As stated by others the bun is arguably more distinctive than the burger.
Apparently they are also a bakery of many fine breads. Thus explains the magnificent bun.
Good quality burgers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Neri

restaurants.name: Fu Fu Taiwanese Shabu
restaurants.address:

3243/1 Rama IV Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fufu Shabu at G Tower has an incredible vibe. I was first drawn in by the view of people enjoying hotpot through the floor-to-ceiling windows. Sitting by the window yesterday (Table 13), looking at the bustling street and Fortune Town across the road, gives you a real 'city life' feel 🌆

I aporeciate the pro and nice service. The lady in the grey shirt (ponytail) greeted with smiley and welcoming, and the red-shirt staff serving my table is also attentive, and helped prep dipping sauce and everything I needed 😊

Charge is the package price what you saw and picked, e.g. 688b my case (middle tier).

However, as a long-time fan, the food variety feels like it has bit fallen behind. The layout may make the food selection trickily less 'abundant' than the old Ari branch, and I couldn't even find my favorite duck blood. Scan menu looks short. Meat quality is just ok. Just a friendly reminder that similiar service ike King Kong Shabu are now offering a stronger experience. It’s a bittersweet visit: I love the nostalgic Taiwanese songs and the service, but the food needs to catch up 🥺
sample_reviews_en.author: Avery Zhuang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good value for money: 488 net (no dessert), 688 net (including dessert). The pork is delicious, the beef is good, and the meatballs are of good quality. There's a wide variety of food, including various offal. They have duck and sesame chicken which are very tasty. The fluffy dipping sauce goes perfectly with the dark broth. Water, soft drinks, and various teas are available.

Dessert Menu:
Häagen-Dazs ice cream: Macadamia, Strawberry, Green Tea, Pistachio, Chocolate
Movenpick ice cream: Mint Chocolate, Green Tea with Chocolate
Magnum Original, Green Tea
Homemade pancakes, shaved ice, panna cotta, mousse

The staff are lovely and provide good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tatchaya

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lately, the mala soup has become less flavorful.
