But today, I went to the restaurant, got up to make pancakes and scoop ice cream, and when I came back, the staff had already cleared the hot pot. There was nothing left!
I even went to the restroom, and they'd taken the bowls! I was so confused. What's the rush? Customers haven't even finished eating yet!
This is impolite. They should wait for customers to return to the table and ask if they can clear the plates.

While I was finishing my meal and digesting, the staff kept walking around the tables.
Please improve this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saraya Tk.

sample_reviews_en.text:
After 2 decades and it’s still standing, tons of vegetable choices, good quality meat, lots of car park

Warning: don’t recommend others coming on weekdays afternoon, vegetables aren’t quite fresh but they replace them before dinner service
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanayos Tantivejsak

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was unclear and the promotions were complicated. If a promotion had payment method restrictions, these details should have been clearly stated before the customer decided to use the service, not discovered later at the payment …
sample_reviews_en.author: Weeraya wong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The buffet offers a wide variety of fresh and clean food.
The desserts are varied and absolutely delicious!
The staff are very lovely, helpful, and provide excellent service. They are very friendly and there is parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: ใบชา ใบไม้

sample_reviews_en.text: It's incredibly delicious. Everything is fresh, and the staff are very friendly; they showed us everything, explained everything, and recommended delicious dishes. It's a shame you can't pay in cash.
sample_reviews_en.author: Кармелл Торетти

sample_reviews_en.text: It's always up to standard. No matter how many times I come, I always like it just as much. The food is neatly presented and the staff provides excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: nattawut sappayakasadtarin

restaurants.name: Firepork - Central Festival 5th Floor
restaurants.address:

99 Pattaya Sai Song Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is definitely a paradise for Korean BBQ lovers, specializing in authentic Korean open-fire charcoal grilling. The pork here is of exceptional quality, from the perfectly marbled pork belly to the tender and juicy pork chops, all releasing an irresistible aroma under the charcoal fire. What I found most enticing was the tangy and spicy Bibim Guksu and the rich and flavorful kimchi soup, paired with unlimited servings of delicate side dishes—a perfect way to cleanse the palate and whet the appetite. The average cost per person is around 500-1000 Thai Baht, and the drink selection is also extensive, making it exceptionally good value for a high-end shopping mall restaurant. The servers are very attentive and will professionally grill the meat for you, controlling the heat precisely. The restaurant boasts a modern, stylish, spacious, and comfortable environment. A powerful ventilation system ensures a smoke-free dining experience, creating a lively and energetic atmosphere—perfect for a relaxing day after shopping, gathering with family and friends to enjoy a high-quality and blissful Korean feast amidst the sizzling sounds of grilled meat.
sample_reviews_en.author: 曼谷芭提雅.高端外围&伴游 Home service

sample_reviews_en.text: Located upstairs in Central Department Store, the staff will help you grill the meat and vegetables. I chose Set Meal C, which included 3 cans of drinks. For an extra $79 per person, you can enjoy all-you-can-eat vegetables and side dishes. The pork was of good quality and can be wrapped in lettuce.
sample_reviews_en.author: 張雁玲

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! I ordered set B (999 baht) because I was very hungry. The staff grilled and sliced ​​the pork for me, which was amazing. The portion was so generous I had to take some home. The side dishes were also delicious, especially the kimchi and cucumber.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pachakorn Huajai

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! They even offer a pork grilling service. It looked so appetizing, smelled amazing, and looked beautiful. The staff were polite and friendly. You absolutely have to come and eat here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Vesaloveplasui

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent service. The staff were polite, patient, and spoke respectfully. The food was delicious and suited my taste. It was convenient, and they even grilled the food for me.
sample_reviews_en.author: Love Fah

sample_reviews_en.text: This Korean restaurant offers good prices and delicious food. The pork is grilled by the staff, and the kimchi soup is incredibly tasty. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Napat Charoenrach

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is fresh and delicious. The staff provides excellent service, attentive and friendly, especially Fiew, who is very cute. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Patiparn T.

sample_reviews_en.text: The worst Korean restaurant I've ever been to. 1,100 baht for two strips of pork belly, with nothing but chicken legs. It's the worst.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piong Hap

restaurants.name: Sirimahannop
restaurants.address:

72 ถ. เจริญกรุง Wat Phraya Krai, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited this restaurant without a reservation and were told it was fully booked. However, when we checked online shortly afterward, there were still plenty of booking slots available. This left us confused and disappointed.

We can’t help but wonder whether the refusal was based on how we were dressed. There is no stated dress code for the restaurant, and we were not wearing anything inappropriate. We are currently on holiday in a tropical destination, and our attire reflected that — neat, clean, and suitable for the climate. It’s unreasonable to expect guests to wear suits or overly formal clothing in such weather.

It was disappointing to feel judged rather than welcomed. Hospitality should be about making guests feel comfortable and valued. Perhaps the staff could benefit from being more open-minded and understanding of different cultures and holiday styles of dress.

Unfortunately, this experience left us feeling unwelcome
sample_reviews_en.author: Mimzillaz

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice place to have dinner if you are in Asiatique The Riverfront. You can either dine inside or outdoors on the open-air dining deck, soaking up the timeless beauty of Bangkok. The venue is a permanently docked three-masted sailing vessel that sits on the Chao Phraya River. I walked in without a reservation on Christmas Day. I would suggest making a reservation if you can. I had half dozen of the Signature Fine De Claire (France) oysters and a glass of sparkling wine which was lovely. The menu primarily focusses on seafood, taking diners on a gastronomic voyage between Thailand and Scandinavia. Asiatique The Riverfront can get very busy. This is a nice option if you are looking for something quieter with a view.
sample_reviews_en.author: Taylor Deni

sample_reviews_en.text:
Unfortunately, we were misled by the lovely ambiance of this restaurant. The food was a huge disappointment. The braised ox cheeks were tough and barely edible – more like shoe leather. The fish and chips consisted almost entirely of breaded batter; the fish was practically nonexistent.

It was particularly frustrating that our group's dishes were served at very different times, making it nearly impossible to eat together. The price is absolutely unjustified for the quality offered – far too expensive overall.

Our conclusion: a beautiful setting, but the food and service fall far short of expectations.

We definitely went there twice. The first and last time!
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Kloster

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was impressed from the moment I stepped onto the boat! The atmosphere along the Chao Phraya River at sunset was amazing. The view was breathtaking, and the boat itself was decorated in a classic and luxurious style, perfect for celebrating special occasions. The cocktails had interesting stories and a perfect blend of Thai and European flavors.
I must especially commend the service from the team, including Dream, May, Bam, Kom, and Gak. They were all incredibly attentive, cheerful, and provided detailed recommendations on the food and drinks. They even helped find beautiful spots for photos throughout the meal, making this evening truly perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: ZenIngXCephiros

sample_reviews_en.text:
It’s my favourite restaurant in Asiatique all the time. My hand was dirty after I ate the king prawns. Mr. Bombay noticed that and took a bowl of water for me to clean my hands. I would like to give Mr. Bombay a compliment for his excellent service and he is professional in cocktails knowledge. Everyone is cheerful and friendly there. As for the new menu, I prefer the old menu with fusion of Thai and European dishes more. Because I can easily find Thai food anywhere in BKK. However, I come here always because of the friendly staffs and excellent services here.
Hope to come and meet them again soon!!
Cheers,
Harry Poon
sample_reviews_en.author: Harry Poon

sample_reviews_en.text:
a boat themed restaurant is a cool concept but of no use when your staff are rude, arrogant and blatantly racist. we asked the hostess if they had availability (they clearly did) and she looked at our family and immediately refused - allowing in the very next group who were white. i’ve been frequenting bangkok for 10 years and this is the first time i’ve had to deal with such a disappointing incident.
if you’re indian, don’t waste your time on racist restaurants, come to crystal grill house (next door) instead - far prettier, classier with happy, obliging staff!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ariya Chauhan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was excellent, the food was delicious, and there was a surprise on my way out. A staff member called out to me as I was leaving, saying there was a birthday cake for me. I asked them to put it in a box for me. (I was so surprised they knew! It turned out they knew because I booked via email. 😁)
Thank you for the wonderful experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: นพรัตน์ วโรรส

sample_reviews_en.text: Truly an amazing experience. The atmosphere, the view and the staff’s service were all incredible. The food wasn’t amazing for the price, it was rather standard for a 1,000+ baht meal. But the experience as a whole more than makes up for that. Perfect for a birthday, anniversary or celebration.
sample_reviews_en.author: lol noob

restaurants.name: Kinlenn Eatery & Play Ari
restaurants.address:

330 Phahonyothin Rd, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: It’s a great location for office workers, and they offer free parking. As for the food, it’s just okay overall. However, the ใบเหลียงผัดไข่ (Stir-fried Malindjo Leaves with Egg) is quite greasy. The vibes are decent, and they have live music.
sample_reviews_th.author: Saranya WRA

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently had a private event at this restaurant.
The admin system was very efficient. When you contact them, they direct you to book through their LINE account.
They have private rooms of various sizes to choose from.
Once you've selected a room, they'll ask you to transfer a deposit, which will be deducted from the total food cost.
The booking system was very easy and clear.
On the day I arrived, the staff were attentive, refilling water and taking orders – very efficient.
The food was delicious.
The prices were quite reasonable.

If you're looking for a venue for a private event, party, or New Year's celebration, this place is worth considering.
It's practically right outside the BTS Skytrain station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponpan Jindawattanawong

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a fusion restaurant with parking available behind the building. The food portions are generous, served quickly, and the staff provides good service.
- The spicy vermicelli salad with mackerel and fermented fish sauce was flavorful and tasty.
- The Tom Yum seafood hot pot was spicy, but a bit salty, and lacked broth. We had to ask for more broth to balance the saltiness.
- The battered and fried calamari came with two sauces. It was very crispy and delicious.
- The fried rice was a snack, with a slightly sour and sweet flavor.

Overall, the service was good, the food portions were generous and served quickly, it was delicious, and the convenient parking behind the restaurant was great.
sample_reviews_en.author: attpocari

sample_reviews_en.text:
-The restaurant atmosphere is nice, suitable for casual gatherings with friends, but not ideal for large parties.
-The food is okay, portions are neither too small nor too large.
-There was no beer tower, despite being told beforehand that they would have one.
-Drinks were placed outside the dining area; I'm unsure about the quantity charged.
-There was only one staff member serving 25 people.
-The food is expensive, reflecting the location.
-They accept credit cards, but not Amex, even though the Amex directory website states that this restaurant accepts Amex cards.
-There are only two restrooms.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nawat P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good Live Music

This place has potential to be better.

Food is good. Place is nice and looks clean. Enjoyable food with live music. Although everyone is attentive if you need them, I would appreciate it if they didn't dip their finger into the plate touching the food while delivering. There could be more ways to give the food by not touching what's inside it. The person literally dipped the thumb in to Khraphao. Sorry to see that.

Live music is good but it gets a little loud if you want to sit and have a chat with your friends. Beautiful voice though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Racha King

sample_reviews_en.text:
Brilliant modern Thai eatery, with a variety of dishes on the menu to please everyone. (They also have a few Western dishes, but I didn't try any of it.) I had green curry with chicken and rice noodles, a "savoury plate" with isaan sausages, grilled pork with "djao" and baked garlic, and a portion of poached Chinese spinach with smashed egg and garlic. Everything was really delicious, and presentation was nice too. Staff was friendly and helpful and the atmosphere was quite nice, modern, but still cozy.

Overall, a great place I will visit again !
sample_reviews_en.author: Thomas Elers

sample_reviews_en.text:
I passed this restaurant several time, and finally pulled the trigger to try it for lunch. It is a nice setting with a small stage for live music.

I basically only ordered two appetizers and rice, but from these small samples, it is promising.

The crispy pork with salt and pepper was nice. The esaan sausage was good too. It is probably an over reaction as it is hard to mess up these two dishes, but hey, I have had worse. It's enough for me to come back and try it again. It is not a cheap place though. A bit more expensive than normal.
sample_reviews_en.author: sagita suwandi

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm not used to the taste of the food. Overall, it wasn't bad, but the flavors were either too bland or too salty. The tom yum goong (spicy shrimp soup) was extremely salty. I tried the tom kha gai (chicken coconut soup) for the first time, and the chili paste helped balance the saltiness of the fried chicken. The plating was cute and appetizing. The staff were lovely and the service was okay. The live music was a bit too loud. The restaurant atmosphere was nice and inviting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Evenin

restaurants.name: Ramen Tei Premium (Soi 49 branch)
restaurants.address:

46 46/14 Sukhumvit 49, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited "Raamen-tei Premium" on Sukhumvit Soi 49.
I went for lunch early, but there was no waiting time because the restaurant is spacious and has plenty of seating.
Although I didn't order it this time, the daily special looked delicious and substantial.
The menu has a wide variety of dishes, the food is served quickly, and it has a casual atmosphere, like a Japanese Ohsho-style Chinese restaurant, making it easy to visit even with children.

I visited "Raamen-tei Premium" on Sukhumvit Soi 49.
I went for lunch early, but there was no waiting time because the restaurant is spacious and has plenty of seating.
Although I didn't order it this time, the daily special looked delicious and substantial.
The menu has a wide variety of dishes, the food is served quickly, and it has a casual atmosphere, like a Japanese Ohsho-style Chinese restaurant, making it easy to visit even with children. <What we ordered this time>
◉ Shrimp in Chili Sauce 400B
◉ Appetizer Char Siu (roast pork) 230B
◉ Twice-Cooked Pork (Hoi Ko Lo) 280B
◉ Dumplings (6 pieces) 150B
◉ Mixed Fried Rice 290B
◉ Salted Fried Noodles 250B

TOTAL 1,600B
sample_reviews_en.author: Rei

sample_reviews_en.text:
Here's a list of reasons why I've personally visited this restaurant over 50 times:

• The open kitchen gives it a clean feel.

• Food is served quickly (predictable).

• My elementary school-aged child loves it.

• They have many unique menu items not found in other ramen shops, such as kimchi ramen and tom yum ramen.

• The flavors suit Japanese palates.

• There are plenty of seats, so there's no waiting time.

• They have a wide variety of dishes other than noodles and rice that pair well with beer.

• The location is convenient, making it easy to combine with other errands.

• The staff are very attentive and refill our tea frequently.

In short, it hits all the right notes for a restaurant.

The restaurant's design is also great, with tatami seating and high chairs available, making it child-friendly.


[Frequently ordered dishes 📝]
Garlic fried rice, kimchi ramen,
Cantonese noodles, dumplings, spicy miso ramen,
stir-fried liver and chives with miso, stir-fried liver and chives,
stir-fried bean sprouts, Chinese rice bowl, etc.

The shark fin ramen, which I occasionally order, is also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: SHIGEKI SATO

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here alone on Sunday nights for the second week in a row.

It was after 8 PM, and while it wasn't full, there were still quite a few customers.

It feels like a downtown restaurant, and they have almost all the menu items you'd expect at a typical Japanese Chinese restaurant. lol

I ordered the stir-fried beef with green peppers (250 baht), fried rice (230 baht), and last week the mapo eggplant ramen.

Everything was delicious!
However, the mapo eggplant was different from what I expected, with a strong sansho pepper flavor. It wasn't quite the typical Chinese restaurant flavor.

By the way, I also like that they offer free tea.

I'll definitely come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: moko Kiri

sample_reviews_en.text:
My wife and I went there for dinner.

★Location & Atmosphere
Located on Sukhumvit Soi 49.
The restaurant has both table and counter seating.
When I went, it was quite crowded, and even groups of 3-4 people were seated at the counter.

★Price
Bean sprout ramen: 270 THB
Garlic fried rice: 270 THB
Dumplings 🥟: 150 THB
Beef with green peppers: Price forgotten

★Food
The bean sprout ramen was incredibly delicious.
It tasted even better than when I ate it at their Thaniya Street branch.
The other dishes were just normally delicious.
We ordered 4 dishes for two people, and it was quite a lot of food, almost to the point of being a little too full.
sample_reviews_en.author: たそまる

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chinese, Japanese mixed food dishes. We have been here many times and they have a decent menu selection of both cultures.

Ramen, gyoza, stir-fried vegetables, meat balls, sweet and sour, spicy...most people should be able to find something they like.

Service is generally fast, seating is very nice and ranges from table/stool to traditional Japanese "on floor mats". The 3rd floor is very cool, as there are "holes " in the floor to accommodate your feet, while sitting at the traditional "mini tables".

The food quality is good across the range and my personal favorites are the Tatanmen Ramen, Mapo Tofu and the meat balls (pork).
sample_reviews_en.author: Martin Pott

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, fragrant, and the portions are generous. However, today during lunchtime, the restaurant was undergoing air conditioning cleaning (or repair... I'm not sure)... making it very hot and stuffy inside. I would appreciate it if you could inform customers at the front of the restaurant or put up a sign saying that the air conditioning is being cleaned, and that it will be completed within a certain timeframe, or that you are happy to have your air conditioning cleaned if it's convenient for you. This would allow customers who are not informed beforehand to make an informed decision about using the service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Green Malay

sample_reviews_en.text:
Moyashi Ramen 270THB
Ramen-tei Premium @ Prompon
For lunch, this is a Japanese purveyor of Chinese-style food. There were many different menus to choose from, and I was torn between sanmar-men and store-only curry mazemen, but I decided on moyashi ramen. The stir-fried vegetables on top of the bowl are crunchy and uniform in size, and the meat is well-prepared, giving it a Chinese feel. The soup is a clear soup base with a refreshing soy sauce flavor. The noodles are yellow and springy and remind me of the old days. Finally, I added vinegar and finished eating. It was delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: W JIN

sample_reviews_en.text: 🥢✨ Ramen Tei Premium, Soi 49 branch, is a premium Chinese restaurant that selects high-quality ingredients and prepares dishes by experienced chefs. The menu focuses on Cantonese and Shanghai-style cuisine, offering authentic flavors adapted to Thai palates. 🍲 Signature dishes include stir-fried mushrooms with egg and shrimp with mayonnaise. 🥟 The ingredients are fresh and clean, and the flavors aren't overly strong, making it perfect for family meals or business dinners. 🍽️ The staff are polite and attentive, ensuring a delicious, comfortable, and premium dining experience. 💯
sample_reviews_en.author: JOYANTHIYA

restaurants.name: เฉลิมชัยข้าวแกงบุฟเฟ่ต์ 50 บาท
restaurants.address:

ถนน แยกราชดำริ, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The 55 baht buffet has now moved to the Hawker Center. For those arriving by motorcycle, there's free parking available nearby, but space is limited. It's recommended to come during off-peak hours. Regarding the food, I ate there before they moved, and back then it was quite salty. Now, the taste has improved significantly; it's a well-balanced blend of salty, spicy, and sweet flavors. However, the dining area itself isn't the restaurant's fault (it's an external factor), but it's very hot and stuffy, and doesn't seem very clean. If you're particular about cleanliness, you might not like it.😸
sample_reviews_en.author: Tiwly

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent value for money. It's surprisingly delicious. The atmosphere is unique, near a park fence, and sometimes there's a whiff of sewer air. But excuse me, it's a BUFFET for 50 baht. The chef and his mother are very nice and friendly. The menu is varied. There are both mild and spicy dishes.
I don't understand the negative reviews. You paid a pittance, you saw where you were going, but you still expected restaurant service and haute cuisine? Seriously?
sample_reviews_en.author: Polina

sample_reviews_en.text: Highly recommended! All-you-can-eat Thai street food! Affordable and delicious! Prices started at 45 baht, then increased to 50 baht, and now (August 2026) to 55 baht, still great value! It's moved back to its original location (near Exit 5 of the park) and now has a roof for rain protection. Highly recommended! PS: Each dish is slowly cooked and served. It's best to visit around 7:30-8:00 AM for the best selection.
sample_reviews_en.author: crosser

sample_reviews_en.text:
50 Baht All-You-Can-Eat Rice and Curry Buffet, Suan Lum, Gate 5, opposite Chulalongkorn Hospital.

Many dishes to choose from, not just scraps or bones. Generous portions of meat!

Pork, chicken, fish, clams, stir-fried vegetables, soups, and more. Delicious flavors, perfectly cooked rice. Unlimited refills. Only 50 Baht for a filling meal.

Cash only. Friendly owner. Open from 6 AM to 3 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: Praphon Wongsakpakdee

sample_reviews_en.text: I found a baby cockroach in my food. I returned it, but the restaurant wouldn't give me a refund, only saying sorry. It was so disgusting, and the taste was terrible. I'm confused why some reviews say it's good. Don't believe everything you read. Even before finding the cockroach, the food tasted awful. Finding the cockroach ruined it completely. I almost threw up.
sample_reviews_en.author: volumeseed

sample_reviews_en.text: This local street restaurant offers delicious food at a very affordable price. It is like an all you can eat concept for only 50 THB, including refills of your plate. We especially enjoyed the pumpkin chicken curry, which was flavorful and well prepared. Overall, it is a great place to grab a quick meal before heading to Lumphini Park.
sample_reviews_en.author: Najuraas

sample_reviews_en.text: I was worried about how much there would be to eat at a 50 baht buffet, but there were plenty of meat options and all the side dishes were delicious. The owner was constantly cooking and restocking, so the turnover rate was fast. I was so happy I had three bites. The owner is a truly talented cook.
sample_reviews_en.author: 월그린

sample_reviews_en.text: Affordable and delicious food still exists in Bangkok! There's a 55 baht buffet rice and curry place with tons of dishes, including curries served in bowls. You can eat until you're full and then go back for more – it's really great! It's located in the Suan Lum food court.
sample_reviews_en.author: รู้จักดอกไลแล็คไหม?

restaurants.name: Rangoon Tea House Bangkok
restaurants.address:

6 Soi Sangchai, Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ragoon Café (Bangkok) is Burmese food done differently — and that’s exactly why it feels like a real hidden gem. The location is spot-on: calm enough to settle in, but still right where the city has energy. It doesn’t feel touristy or staged; more like you stumbled upon a place locals would quietly recommend.
What really makes it work is the service: warm, attentive, and genuinely helpful without being performative. Do yourself a favor and ask them to walk you through the specialties — it’s the kind of menu where a short explanation changes everything, because the flavors aren’t “standard Thai/Asian,” they’re distinct and memorable.

Don’t miss the tea leaf salad (Laphet Thoke) — layered, fresh, crunchy, with that slightly bitter, deeply aromatic edge that keeps you going back for another bite. If they offer it with soft-shell crab, take it. And pair it with the aged Negroni: smooth, rounded, beautifully balanced — not just a cocktail, but part of the experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tominffm

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve been a regular at Rangoon Tea House Bangkok since they first opened, and I’ve always loved coming here for Burmese food. The place itself is still great, nice atmosphere, good service, and everything looks well done.

Lately tho, I feel like the taste of the food has changed a bit. It’s not bad at all, just a lil different. The flavors feel more toned down and less bold than before and not quite what I’d expect from traditional Burmese food. It feels a little more adjusted to international tastes now.

If you are new to Burmese cuisine, you’ll probably enjoy it a lot because it’s very approachable. But as someone who’s been coming here for years, I do miss the stronger, more authentic flavors from earlier days.

With that said, it’s still a very solid place and I’ll definitely keep coming back. I just hope to see the food lean back toward its original Burmese taste in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Elio Merval

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining here, and I wish I could give it more than 5 stars! The entire experience was simply amazing. The food was not only fantastic but also unique, offering a delightful fusion of flavors that left my taste buds dancing. ch dish was a masterpiece, both in presentation and taste.

The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere that made the dining experience even more enjoyable. They went above and beyond to ensure we had an unforgettable meal, offering great recommendations and attentive service throughout our visit.

The restaurant itself has a great vibe and ambiance, making it the perfect spot for a relaxed yet exciting dining experience. If you're looking for something different and delightful, this place is a must-visit. I can't wait to return and try more of their delicious offerings!

Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kay

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tried out this Burmese restaurant which is located just steps away from BTS ThongLo (exit 4). The place is cosy with vintage & eclectic interior and perfect for eating and hanging out. They have plenty of seating area indoor & outdoor, but make a reservation just in case especially for dinner time.
For the food, tried:
Arloo Samosa: nice samosa wrapper texture, mild spiced potato filling
Kachin Calamari: love this lightly battered calamari with intense seasoning & goes well with the dipping
Pratha with Chicken Curry: crispy & flakey roti served with mild spiced curry
Garlic noodles with braised chicken: very light garlic taste and the chicken is slightly on the dry side
For drink, got the Ceylon Milk Tea. All i can say is that this drink is divine!!!
Definitely will come back to try the other dishes & desserts.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maharani

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'd never tried Burmese food before, and it was tastier than I expected. I understand it's a fusion of Burmese cuisine.

Grilled beef tongue, dipped in the restaurant's homemade kachin spice powder – fragrant, delicious, and unique.

Fish curry: The broth was thick, similar to a stew but with a subtle curry flavor. The broth was very mild.

Shrimp paste fried rice: Lighter in flavor than Thai-style shrimp paste fried rice, easy to eat continuously.

Burmese sausage: Similar to Northern Thai sausage but milder in flavor. Served with mashed potatoes and chili oil. This dish was delicious.

Grilled pork: Topped with crushed peanuts and served with a sweet cream salad sauce.

The restaurant is housed in an old house with beautiful architecture and excellent decor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwan Kajornchaiyakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honestly one of the best Burmese restaurants in Bangkok. The concept, interior, and overall atmosphere are SO good ! easily my favorite out of all the Burmese restaurants I’ve tried here. It actually feels like they put so much thought into the whole experience, not just the food.
The sesame latte is so good
The food is great, but the atmosphere is what really makes this place stand out. Very cozy, nostalgic, and effortlessly cool. If you’re looking for Burmese food but also want a restaurant that actually has a vibe, this is the one. And you can smoke outside too. I can see the restaurant vision and not only I’ve always come several times here but also at the Iconsiam branch and tried modern Burmese cuisine which are so niche!
sample_reviews_en.author: may kyi

sample_reviews_en.text: I wouldn’t go here if I want authentic Burmese cuisine but they serve delicious food with a twist of flavor to the original and the ingredients are really fresh. A dish like “Grilled eggplant salad” is something you must try. And “Steamed seabass Kachin style” is our favorite. The service is great, the staffs are very helpful and attentive. A lot of people say that they are expensive (I wouldn’t deny it) but you would definitely get what you pay for. The atmosphere is great too. They have outdoor seating which I find quite nice (but you decide when you arrive because you are in Thailand - the weather could be humid and hot). Overall we really enjoyed our dinner here and we will come back again for sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ei Phyu Sin Aung

sample_reviews_en.text: We first dined at Rangoon Tea House in Yangon years ago, back when the city was thriving and full of promise and before strife and civil war tore at the fabric of the country. That unforgettable meal set a high bar, and I’m happy to report that the Bangkok outpost lives up to the legacy. We had dinner here with friends visiting from the US, and every dish was a knockout, thoughtfully prepared, beautifully presented, and packed with flavor. The service was warm and attentive, and the space itself strikes the perfect balance of stylish yet inviting, and lively but never too loud. Rangoon Tea House is an instant favorite, and we’ll be back soon. Kudos to the entire team for a fantastic experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Wykoff

restaurants.name: VILLA Veg & Vegan Indian Restaurant
restaurants.address:

147 Thanon Tanao, Wat Bowon Niwet, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had one of the worst dining experiences at Villa restaurant in Bangkok. We booked a table through the Eatigo app and arrived 15 minutes early. After informing the manager about our reservation, everything seemed fine—until we mentioned that we got a flat 50% discount through the app.

That’s when things went south. The manager suddenly got furious and said the booking couldn’t be honored because the owner wasn’t answering his call. It felt like an excuse to avoid giving the discount. We had traveled 8 km just to dine here, only to be turned away in such an unprofessional and rude manner.

Despite the poor treatment, we decided to dine without the offer—but the service was extremely slow and inattentive, and the food was below average at best.

If you’re traveling in Bangkok, I would strongly advise avoiding places like this where the staff refuses to honor valid reservations and discounts. The entire experience felt like a scam, and it left a very bad impression.
sample_reviews_en.author: Taha Muaaz

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were looking for a great vegan-friendly Indian restaurant and are so happy we found this place!

The service was incredibly warm and welcoming, and every dish we ordered was delicious. My husband loved the BBQ Sizzler so much he barely looked up from his plate!

The sweetest moment was my daughter. She usually only eats naan or rice at Indian restaurants, but this time she was dipping her naan into my Paneer Masala and even eating from my husband’s plate. Before we left, she gave the owner a big thumbs up and said, “Really good Indian food. I loved it. Thank you.” I’ve honestly never seen her do that before.

It was the first meal since arriving in Bangkok that our whole family truly loved. We’ll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: crystal haacker

sample_reviews_en.text: A classic bill scam. Check your receipt carefully – they add all sorts of strange items (as absurd as the separate chicken for the pad Thai – the menu only lists the price for the pad Thai). I'd say ask for every detail (what's included and what's not), but I'll say steer clear. There are plenty of honest restaurants in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michaił Banancew

sample_reviews_en.text: Best place for Indian / best place for Indian food in Bangkok, it is an experience in itself. Addition to the food, the kindness, service and a sense of home is so evident and heavy in the atmosphere. Makes you want to stay in Bangkok and visit them again. A special shout put to Sunil ji - thank you for a wonderful experience
sample_reviews_en.author: Prakhar Tripathi

sample_reviews_en.text: We had a vegan Pad Thai, which was delicious. The paneer butter masala was just slightly spicy and absolutely tasty. The only slight drawback was that the food didn't arrive at the same time, and we had to watch each other eat for about half the meal. The service was very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Armin Rud

sample_reviews_en.text: I would definitely recommend this restaurant to all the people visiting Bangkok, you cannot afford to miss the gem. I tried their BBQ sizzler, Mexican quesadilla, pizza and pink sauce pasta every dish is special value to money and is so flavorful ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Priyanka “Priyaankeraa” Gupta

sample_reviews_en.text: My husband and I had such a wonderful experience from the moment we walked in , the staff were welcoming and the owner was incredible. We couldn’t believe it when we came across a 24hr vegan restaurant with vegetarian options. The food was …
sample_reviews_en.author: Darian Richter

sample_reviews_en.text: We're from Spain, we were looking for a place to have dinner and ended up here. 10/10. The food was delicious, the service was excellent, and they were incredibly friendly and attentive. I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alicia Manzano

restaurants.name: Siamhouse Cafe and Restaurant
restaurants.address:

90 Soi Silom 20, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting from Taiwan! I walked 2 kilometers from my guesthouse to this little restaurant recommended online. It's located in a bustling market street, and thankfully the sign is very clear, so it's easy to find – just turn into the street at the intersection and it's not far. It opens at 9 AM, and I arrived around 9:50 AM. The best part was having a seat all to myself before any other customers arrived. Since I hadn't tried Dong Ying Gong yet, I ordered it along with pineapple seafood fried rice, both of which were delicious! The Thai milk tea was also fantastic. There was alcohol-based hand sanitizer on the tables, and the spoons, forks, and tissues were all wrapped in plastic bags – very hygienic! After a happy meal, I headed to IconSiam to check out the famous floating market inside the department store.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lightman Cheng

sample_reviews_en.text:
I revisited Siam House Cafe after 6 years again on January 2025.

Still a really great place to eat out in Bangkok. I tried many dishes and each one was delicious! Can only highly recommend this place!

5 star friendliness, checked out many different main dishes all delicious.

I was here several times. Really great variety of delicious dishes.

They also can cook not spicy European style. You should check out by yourself. Large Portion are really large. Good tastes meets very good prices. Air-conditioned and outside places are available. Whatever you like.

SPECIALTIES:

You can also buy good coffee here.

WESTERN STYLE WC, clean!

CLOSED every SUNDAY!

Heute am letzten Tag in Thailand nach 30 Tagen nochmal 5 verschiedene Gerichte ausprobiert.

Wirklich einfach unheimlich Lecker!!!

Mein bester Tip zum Essen in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Time Traveller

sample_reviews_en.text:
For where it is, it's a delightful little restaurant.

Marriage stages are like having a very long dinner at this restaurant, it doesn't looked much from the outside .... excitingly started with that spicy young papaya salad and Pad Thai Prawns accompanied by the fizzing froth of LEO BEER TH (honeymoon stage), less exciting fried prawns, gets boring with the green curry chicken (about 15-20 years), it spicily picks up again with that spicy stir-fry Squid (maturity after 25 years perhaps) and the big prize is at the end - super sweet Thai Mango with Glutinous rice and salted cream Coconut ;-) All up for 755 B or A$30 - Marriage will cost a lot more than that .... your life :-) a great life sentence without parole ...... you'll get less for murder. Cheers to those who've made it passed 25 years or more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffrie Trika

sample_reviews_en.text:
My husband and I found this place thanks to TripAdvisor and Google maps and unfortunately we only tried it, on our last night in Bangkok. We have spent so much money eating in nice places that promise amazing Thai dishes but this little restaurant was by far the best! We walked in and it was completely packed with people and one local got up from his table to let us seat and have our dinner. Where else do you find that?!
Please go! So cheap and stunning food! Leave a large tip as they won't put it on your bill and will be much appreciated. The owner is super lovely and the girls working there are lovely as well. Wish we would have found this place earlier!
sample_reviews_en.author: Otilia Carter

sample_reviews_en.text:
English spoken.

A small, clean restaurant.

When I visited, there were many locals and Indians (because there's a Hindu temple nearby).

I ordered Massaman curry and green curry, and they were both delicious! Both were huge portions and great value for money. The service was friendly and wonderful, and I was impressed to see Kirei Kirei (a popular Japanese hand soap) in the restroom – it was my first time seeing it in Thailand!

They had draft beer during happy hour, so we each had two beers, totaling around 500 baht.

If it were closer, I would definitely become a regular; in fact, next time I want to stay near this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: マナティー

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely love this place! They have the best chicken cashew nuts in town — rich, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. If you’re vegetarian, no worries — you can ask for tofu instead of chicken, and it’s just as delicious! Actually, the whole menu is super flexible: you can swap out meat, chicken, or seafood for tofu or other veggie options.

The drink menu is great too — don’t miss the fresh coconuts! Staff here are friendly, speak good English, and really understand what tourists need. They get what “not spicy” means and can adjust the heat level just right for your taste.

Highly recommend visiting if you’re in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Daria Berdiuzhenko

sample_reviews_en.text: Read the reviews and felt it would be worth a visit, since my wife is Thai. Place is small & very dated. Menus old & dirty. The prawns looked good & were fresh, but tasted like dirty socks, due to not being cleaned well. I ordered lime juice, which was mostly watered down over ice, very little lime flavor. Gaeng Kai Wan was great, nicely seasoned. Spring rolls were small, very small, store bought, not home made like they would normally be at an authentic Thai restaurant. Would not recommend this a place to try. If anything, it's a place to avoid. I just hope we aren't sick tomorrow, when we'll be traveling to Malaysia.
sample_reviews_en.author: An'ton

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the Massaman curry.

The restaurant was relatively clean, but when I visited, I noticed a slightly unusual smell.

The Massaman curry contained large pieces of chicken and was more filling than it looked. It's quite substantial, so it's a good choice for those who want a hearty meal.

Note that rice is ordered separately, so I recommend ordering rice along with the curry.

The taste was decent, but not particularly impressive.

It's a good place to stop by if you're in the area, but I don't think it's worth making a special trip for.
sample_reviews_en.author: みよ

restaurants.name: Myeongryun Jinsa Galbi (Central Pinklao)
restaurants.address:

5th Floor, Pinklao Shopping Center, Central Plaza, 7/222 Borommaratchachonnani Rd, Arun Amarin, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The picture shows the lunch set, which was great value for money. The price was good, with unlimited self-bar access and ramen, all for under 230 baht. The taste was average. The japchae and fried chicken might have been a little cold.
- I've been to their buffet before they opened a branch at Central Pinklao (I ate at the Seacon Bangkae branch). Back then, I thought the marinated pork and chicken were quite delicious. I haven't tried the buffet at this branch yet.
- Personally, I think this branch has a better separation of the drink and self-bar zones than the Bangkae branch. At that branch, the counters were all crammed together. This branch has clearly separated zones and more space to walk around.
- There seem to be more foreign staff than Thai staff.
- I wish the staff would inform customers that utensils and tissues are in the table drawers. I saw several tables asking where the spoons, chopsticks, and tissues were. There's no sign on the table. First-time customers probably wouldn't know. (When I ate at the Bangkae branch the first time, I didn't know either, but the staff told me.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Elynnda N.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Newly opened restaurant. Comfortable and spacious seating.
Good food with 3 price options:
399 / 499 / 699
Birthday promotion: Members eat free on the 399 baht price list.
Seniors get a 100 baht discount on the 399 baht price list only. Don't misunderstand!

Today, we went with a group of over 10 people, including my grandparents. There was a miscommunication; the seniors were happy about the discount and ordered the 499++ buffet to support the new restaurant. It turned out they didn't get any discount at all! 😆😆😆
By the time we realized, it was too late.

The shrimp wasn't fresh, and they were out of shellfish.
The instant noodles were delicious.
The mixed rice was also good.
The pork and chicken were good.
The drinks were good.
Other items were okay.
The exhaust hood was excellent.
Good service, but the music was too loud.
It's starting to get crowded. It's best to go on a weekday. I recommend the 399 baht option only.
sample_reviews_en.author: manilla phin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The new branch is located on the 5th floor, near the entrance to the new cinema.

They offer several types of pork.
There are many side dishes, and you can mix your own dipping sauces.
They have a variety of appetizers, but the fried items aren't very good; they're oily and seem to have been sitting out for a long time, making them soggy and chewy.

The staff seemed confused and didn't explain the promotions or the price tiers.
The quantity also seemed insufficient for the initial opening period.
This resulted in inadequate customer service; they didn't explain what items were available for first-time diners, where chopsticks and spoons were located, or what requests could be made.

Most importantly, they didn't inform us about the time limit for dining.
We had to ask several times about the closing time.
sample_reviews_en.author: MyBlooD MJ

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came on a weekday lunchtime and they had a promotion for 199+ baht.
You get soup + side bar + drink and can eat for 2 hours.
The food tasted okay. They had a ramen pot which looked unique and cooked well. Adding oden and kimchi made it even better.
The side bar had 3 flavors of fried chicken, which was alright.
There was also some kind of chicken stew, which was okay.
They had salad and kimchi fried rice, which were average.
For dessert, they had shaved ice.
Personally, I think it's worth the price.
I went during Chinese New Year and they had a lucky red envelope lottery where I got a 399 baht buffet with a buy-one-get-one-free deal. That was great! I'll definitely go back again.
P.S. Some of the staff weren't very attentive, but some were good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wirongtong Charoenpong

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant looks nice, but the food is just average, tolerable, but the service charge is a bit much. They promote it as a self-service bar, but it's actually grilled food. The tables have built-in hot plates underneath, which are slightly raised, so you could easily trip and fall. Also, they use charcoal, so there's a risk of fire. They provide bottled water on the tables to extinguish the fire, but I didn't see any fire extinguishers or other safety measures. Please exercise caution.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supakit Siwpirom

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great Korean atmosphere and a wide variety of food, especially at the side dish station. They offer several types of meat for grilling, all of good quality. There are many dipping sauces to choose from, and the pickled radish is delicious. The prices are reasonable, and the exhaust fan is very efficient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattajak L

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork is delicious, there are lots of side dishes, the vegetables are very fresh, including kimchi and crispy papaya kimchi. They also have oden, bingsu, and japchae. The price is good, starting at 400++ baht. Great value for the buffet!
sample_reviews_en.author: earn orapun

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located on the 5th floor of Central Pinklao, next to the cinema. On weekdays (Mon-Fri), it's not too crowded. During lunchtime, they have a lunch set without BBQ, which includes one serving of soup and allows you to eat …
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponsupree Ota

restaurants.name: อีเขียว ลาซาล
restaurants.address:

640 Sukhumvit 105 Alley, Bang Na Tai, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came here unintentionally, but left with a 100/10!!!!
Everything was surprisingly delicious. Honestly, I already have a favorite restaurant near Lasalle, so I had high expectations for this one, and I wasn't disappointed at all. The spicy pork rib soup, the "Tam Ee Khiao Siew Thang Soi" (signature dish), the fried chicken, and the sun-dried beef are all must-try dishes. Importantly, the restaurant is air-conditioned, so you don't get hot or wet in the rain, and there's parking in the alley next door, just a short walk away.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wipa Jirachoosakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
I highly recommend the grilled pork waterfall salad, it's delicious!
The Luang Prabang papaya salad and Thai papaya salad are tasty, and they provide lime wedges to squeeze for extra flavor.
The sun-dried pork is delicious and not chewy.
The tamarind, chili, salt and soda drink is uniquely delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Santika Wattanapisit

sample_reviews_en.text: A small shop but full of delicious food. Everything is delicious, especially the fried sticky rice with sun-dried pork. Absolutely delicious! 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Lek Wanna

sample_reviews_en.text: E-Kiew Lasalle serves delicious food with rich flavors, but the prices are a bit high. The air-conditioned room is nice and cool.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aely Wong

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. I loved the "Pork Heaven" (a type of Thai pork dish). I ordered it for takeout and it was well-packaged.
sample_reviews_en.author: S W

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, flavorful, and the portions are large, but it's not cheap. However, the taste is fantastic!
sample_reviews_en.author: TYRB

sample_reviews_en.text: Papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce, minced pork salad, and grilled beef tongue were all delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: koolgada

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, with authentic Northeastern Thai flavors, and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khajorndet Jarudethkajorn

restaurants.name: Mug jee
restaurants.address:

1st Floor, INN A DAY, Maharaj - Tha Tien, Khwaeng Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Khet Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I randomly found this restaurant near Museum Siam, and the prices were quite reasonable. Everything I ordered yesterday was delicious, especially the คอหมูฉ่าน้ำปลา; so good! 👍

I think this is a new restaurant because I could still smell the paint, which wasn’t great, but I really enjoyed the food. 😋
sample_reviews_th.author: MAYTAWEE K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
My recent visit to this restaurant started promisingly with outdoor seating on a pleasant evening, but quickly turned sour when a large cockroach landed directly on our food shortly after it arrived. While the staff did replace the affected dish, their response lacked genuine apology or concern—there was no offer to replace the other plates on the table, which we understandably lost appetite for, nor any compensatory gesture like a discount.

This incident raises serious questions about hygiene standards, especially in an outdoor setting where such issues should be anticipated and mitigated. It's a shame, as the food itself seemed decent, but the overall handling left us feeling undervalued as customers. I have a photo of the cockroach on our dish but chose not to post it, as it's quite graphic and unnecessary to convey the gravity of the situation.

I do not recommend dining at this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dylan M

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited 18 months ago, but they have refurbished and changed since. The lady that run (owns?) seems to be the same. They have 6 craft beers, a lager and a cider on tap. We tried several pints if Philip Glitter Bomb, which was very nice. Staff are very friendly and the owner gave us free deep fried tofu. Oh and probably one of the best views of Wat Arun, whilst sat at a cool bar drinking good beer. I've not eaten here so not rated food, but looking at others food and the tofu we were given, I'd think it would be good.
Update : we've just been given some roast pork, in a soy sauce (I think) with chilli which is delicious. So have updated food to 5*

So, so friendly.

If you are in this part of BK, pop in - I don't think you'll be disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Fairbank

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is superb, so as the atmosphere. They are having a promotion so if you buy a big beer you will get a skew of pork skillet for free. The rooftop bar is still under construction, but the owner was kind enough to show us the rooftop bar, which has the great view of Wat Arun. The construction should be done within the next few months and is also a hotel which has 9 rooms. Overall,  we have a great experience there, we dine in late around 8pm but the owner was kind enough to let us stay there till we finished our dinner. It's sure a hidden gem.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chia Brennan

sample_reviews_en.text: I think this is one of the nicest restaurant experiences I have had in Bangkok and I have lived here off and on for 20 years. The food was fantastic and because it was mostly based upon North Eastern Thai dishes , it was fun to experience new tastes.  You can dine and drink all while looking right at one of the most beautiful temples in Bangkok, Wat Arun. And if you go after sunset, Wat Arun is all lit up.   Good food, lovely atmosphere, excellent bar choices, and an amazing view. Mug Jee has everything a restaurant needs to make it special.
sample_reviews_en.author: chrave1956

sample_reviews_en.text:
I think the food, vibe, and people are great.

Sadly I was asked to move my seat because a group of people visit this restaurant later. I am positive that the restaurant has other seats enough for the newly visited people.

I ordered a main dish, two grilled food, and a beer, I think this qualified me staying for a normal time slot. However I staying less than an hour and then I was asked to move to a seat with poor view. I am not sure about the policy of this place.  I am sure that was a bit unpleasant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom Big

sample_reviews_en.text: This Bar could have one of the best view in Bangkok.  We went there just after midday.  There was a continuous arrival of visitors outside,  trying to capture the Temple, across the river.  We were enticed by happy hour offer of Beer.  Buy three half pint, get one free.  There is no such thing as free!  The three half pints costs the equivalent of almost £20!  I wonder how much more would it cost if enjoyed after happy hour.  Toilet was immaculate.  You’ll obviously pay a premium for view!
sample_reviews_en.author: Gio

sample_reviews_en.text: Newly refurbished classic restaurant.  We came when it had been opened 2 days.  Soft opening. Food was amazing.  Service was very attentive.  Owners were happy to have us.  Running drink specials now to get new customers.   Som Tum Thai was fresh tangy and spicy.  Moo Tok Kirk was fresh and delightfully spicy.  Ordered the. Beef Fat Fried Sticky Rice with Beef without spice for my partner.  Tasty beef.  Savory sticky rice.  Definitely returning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Martin Mayne

restaurants.name: AMRA Thai Cuisine
restaurants.address:

53 Soi Somdet Chao Phraya 17, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I had high expectations because it was right in front of my accommodation and had good reviews, but I am disappointed overall. First of all, since it is near the hotel, it seems like they are rip-offs targeting foreigners, considering the atmosphere and quality of the food. I understand that the prices might seem a bit high, but they only accept cash (even though QR payment is available) and charge an additional 7% tax plus a 10% service charge. So, even though I ordered takeout, the 7% charge was added. It is ridiculous that they seem to be trying to rip off tourists. This is the first time I’ve encountered a place in Bangkok that charges a separate 7% VAT on top of the price, even though I’ve been to many local spots in Bangkok. It’s not a place with high-end service or atmosphere—it’s just a small, genuine local shop (different from the photos), so a 10% service charge is also a bit funny. The taste is just so-so. The broth tastes decent, but the main ingredients are very lacking. You also have to order rice separately. I hope no one else gets scammed. There are many better restaurants in Aiko Siam. Please, don't get ripped off.
sample_reviews_en.author: asthasia

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hello Guys,
Thai Food Restaurant for anyone looking for truly authentic Thai cuisine in Bangkok. The restaurant named AMRA offers rich, traditional Thai flavours prepared with fresh herbs and quality ingredients, making the dishes both healthy and delicious. Staff ensure to purchase seafood daily for fresh and authentic taste. The environment is clean, hygienic, and comfortable, giving diners peace of mind while enjoying their meal. Prices are very reasonable for the portion sizes and quality provided, and the location is convenient and easy to access, it is close to ICON Siam. What makes the experience even more special is the warm hospitality and attentive service from the staff, waiters, and waitresses, who ensure every guest feels welcomed and well taken care of. It is definitely a great place to enjoy genuine Thai taste with excellent service and value.

I visited two times during 3 months, satisfactory rate is always TOP.

I highly recommend you all to visit to AMRA and taste whenever you visit to Bangkok or stay at Bangkok. Taste and service will be non-regrettable.
sample_reviews_en.author: NiNi Thaung

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything we ordered was fantastic. The tom yum was extraordinary and exactly to our liking; the glass noodle salad brought a wonderfully spicy heat to the table; the noodles we ordered were unforgettable, especially the pad see ew. The tempura and drinks were satisfying too. We would definitely recommend this restaurant to our family and friends, and we would consider coming back here in the foreseeable future. Plus, the service was great and the waiters were nice too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Myla Anderson

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love enjoying local food!
I ordered the expensive Poo Pad Pong curry + Tom Yum Kung + fried rice at a local restaurant, and was shocked when it came to almost 50,000 won 😂😂 But the menu was really delicious, and it was close to my Chao Phraya accommodation, so I highly recommend it!
The staff were friendly, and the food was all delicious.
Even my group, who were trying Tom Yum Kung and Poo Pad Pong curry for the first time, loved it.
sample_reviews_en.author: 황지현

sample_reviews_en.text: We are love the Tom Yum gong here, Got two types of Tom yum. Creamy seafood and clear Tom yum seafood. Very nice taste, smells good perfect with sour and spicy,  Fish nice, all seafood very fresh. We Oder grill green  Prawn it’s good two. Service good, fast , friendly, and prices very reasonable. We will come again for next Bangkok trips.🙏🙏😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Cheung Jiaxin

sample_reviews_en.text: This was the most authentic Thai cuisine I have tried. It’s down the block from my hotel the Quarters which doesn’t offer much in terms of authentic local cuisine. This place is, great friendly staff who try and give extra and the food was delicious. I had a Thai Basil with rice. And also the cost was much less than what the hotel charges.
sample_reviews_en.author: Philip Jean

sample_reviews_en.text: No, this place completely changed my understanding of Thai food, Tom Yum Goong! Now I know exactly why you have to go here. Three people, four dishes, and beer included for less than 50,000 won, but it feels like it's worth more than 200,000 won at Sook Siam. It's so delicious. If you're staying at The Quarter, make sure to try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: 산들하은

sample_reviews_en.text: We only ate here on our last evening. It's a shame, because the restaurant is truly wonderful. The food was good, the service exceptionally friendly, and the atmosphere very pleasant. A quiet restaurant with tables on both the ground and upper floors. The price was also reasonable. We would definitely come back! 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Brigitte Sch.

restaurants.name: Zaab High Pattaya Sai 3
restaurants.address:

406 43, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was my first time here, thanks to an invitation from friends. We came as a big group and ordered quite a variety of dishes. Overall, the food was delicious, but the real star of the meal was the Tom Klong with soft bone pork ribs—an absolute must-try at this stage of life! The rest of the dishes were good, though not particularly mind-blowing for me.

The seating area was spacious, open, and comfortable. The restrooms are located at the side of the restaurant near the parking area. If you're looking for the place, it's right across from Muang Pattaya Hospital on Sai 3 Road—just follow the Google Maps location.

P.S. Everything was great except for the service organization. It would be better if staff were assigned to specific zones. One person took our order, another informed us the food was being prepared, and yet another came to check if we had received everything—it felt a bit chaotic. Maybe it was because we had a large table, so apologies if that was the case!

P.P.S. The Bael fruit juice was incredibly fragrant and delicious. If you come here and don’t order it, you’re seriously missing out!
sample_reviews_en.author: Γαλνανατ Πυχομχιτ

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered several dishes. The taste was okay, average, not authentically Northeastern Thai, more like Central Thai cuisine. However, the Northeastern Thai larb was extremely salty. I tried to eat it with the vegetables and sticky rice, but it was still too salty. I had to ask the staff to fix it. In the end, they just changed the plate, but the food was the same. It was like they squeezed lime to make it more sour, but it was still just as salty. It was really bad. If the food tastes wrong, they should consider how to fix it. Customers are paying to eat, and if they don't want to fix it, or can't fix it, there should be a better way. In short, I didn't eat the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kunchornvisit Tinchoddacha

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered Northeastern Thai sausage, duck larb, Luang Prabang papaya salad, grilled pork neck, two drinks, and two plates of rice. After waiting a while, only the two drinks, two plates of rice (which was cold), and the Northeastern Thai sausage arrived. That was it for 32 minutes; nothing else came. Meanwhile, a table that arrived later (table 3) had already received their three main dishes. Seeing that nothing else was coming, I asked to cancel the remaining order and just take the rice home. When it came time to pay, they brought the bill with the price of all the dishes! So I asked them to recalculate the bill to only include the items that had been served.
sample_reviews_en.author: kotchapat na bangchang

sample_reviews_en.text: This wasn't a planned trip...we went there randomly! It exceeded our expectations. The restaurant is beautiful, very crowded, and the menu is extensive – it was hard to choose! My son ordered a salmon salad without fermented fish sauce, while I had a spicy noodle salad with fermented fish sauce. It was delicious; the fermented fish sauce was flavorful and not smelly at all. The grilled pork neck was also excellent; my son had a second serving. They also served fried Northeastern Thai sausage in a cute little basket. If I'm in Pattaya again, I'll definitely stop by again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Patcha_toey

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff is very welcoming and always smiling – it's always a pleasure when traveling!
Hygiene is top-notch: everything is spotless, which is very reassuring. The customizable chili level option (0%, 30%, 50%, or 100%) is super convenient – ​​ideal for all tastes, whether you're a beginner or a fiery spice lover.

And your favorite dishes:
The Tom Yum is very tasty.
The Larb Moo is well-executed.
It's a great place in Pattaya: authentic, balanced flavors, with lemongrass, galangal, and other ingredients that make all the difference.
I recommend it 100%.
sample_reviews_en.author: Galaxy Note

sample_reviews_en.text: The service at this restaurant is terrible. I waited for almost 40 minutes and they still hadn't served me water. I had to keep asking for it. When I arrived, the table was empty, but tables that arrived later got their food first. I understand that preparation is slow, but getting food before other tables was unacceptable. They even gave the excuse that their food was easier to make. This is completely unacceptable. I'm extremely disappointed with the service. One visit is never coming back!!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: sureepohn ngeksoongnuen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thw food was amazing and my Isaan partner said that the food here was incredibly authentic and nostalgic tothe isaan cuisine.

The spice levels qre definitely up there so make sure to notify the staff how spicy you'd like your meals.

The menu size is vast and has a lirtle bit of everything to suit all diners. Unique plates like Som Tum Strawberry is served here too.

Staff were very welcoming, informative, helpful, and attentive 👍👍👍

We will being our friends here next visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yawarakai O.

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere. The staff are well-dressed, clean, and ready to serve. The interior is very nice, clean, spacious, and doesn't feel cramped at all. The papaya salad with thin noodles was delicious and flavorful. It wasn't crowded during lunchtime, so the food didn't take long to arrive. The food was very tasty. It was perfect for a client dinner; the clients were very impressed. I give it a perfect 10/10.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thongchai C.

restaurants.name: La Mía
restaurants.address:

19 Phetchaburi 47 Alley, Lane 8, บางกะปิ Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm giving it 2 out of 5 stars, and I'll explain why. The highlight was the lemon dessert, which was truly fabulous. But, unfortunately, for everything else, you can tell in a second that there isn't a single Portuguese person in that kitchen. The flavor of the dishes is close, "almost" there, but it always misses the mark. It's like a low-resolution image: it lacks detail, soul, the seasoning that only those who grew up with these pots and pans know.
When I asked, they confirmed what I already suspected: the owner is Thai, he really likes our cuisine and has visited Portugal a few times. I greatly appreciate the initiative and the affection for our country, but let's be honest for a moment: nothing replaces the authenticity of a cuisine we grew up with and that runs in our DNA.
The "gap" is simply too big. If we forget for a moment that it's said to be Portuguese food, the dishes are even good and well-executed, but it's not what you expect. For those who know the true flavor of our land, the historical know-how is missing. A commendable attempt, but one that remains very superficial in relation to our true tradition.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joana Da Graça

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Spaghetti Vongole*: Perfectly cooked pasta, chewy texture, fragrant sauce, slightly salty and spicy, large and plump clams, delicious.
- Cataplana de Marisco: Tomato seafood soup, clear broth, fragrant with seafood, fresh fish, shrimp, and clams, no fishy smell, served with Sourdough* bread, chewy texture, crispy crust, delicious.
- Creme Brulee*: Creamy, smooth and soft, just the right amount of sweetness.

A cute little restaurant with only 3 tables.

The owner is lovely and friendly.
---‐-------------
Revisited (5/6/26)
- Peixe* (Grilled Peixe fish with garlic, dried chili, olive oil, and lemon): Pan-seared fish, fragrant, firm and tender flesh, light and slightly tangy sauce.
- Clams sautéed in white wine: Plump and juicy clams.
- Sourdough*: Soft texture, chewy crust, slightly tangy, delicious. Dipping it in the white wine sauce with the clams was a perfect combination.
- Spaghetti with grilled shrimp: Perfectly cooked pasta, chewy texture. Concentrated tomato sauce
- Lemon Posset*: Very creamy but not cloying, slightly sweet, with a refreshing tartness that provides a great finish.
sample_reviews_en.author: HummingbirdS

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, premium quality home-cooking style food.
"La Mía is the epitome of 'small but mighty.' This Portuguese-Mediterranean restaurant in the Research Center area has a very cozy atmosphere.
Recommended dishes:
🥗 Grilled Chicken Salad with Portuguese Chili Sauce: The chicken is tender and juicy, the sauce is delicious, and it pairs perfectly with the crisp romaine lettuce.
🍝 Fish & Lemon Pasta: The fresh pasta is the best! The refreshing lemon sauce goes very well with the seasonal fish.
🍤 Gambas ao alho: Garlic and dried chili shrimp. The shrimp is fresh and bouncy, with a strong aroma of olive oil and garlic.
This restaurant is health-conscious (no MSG), and the food tastes truly natural. If you like handmade pasta, you shouldn't miss it!"
🚗 Parking: You can park on the street in the alley in front of the restaurant.
📌 Recommendation: The restaurant has limited seating, so it's best to call and reserve in advance."
#eatwithksm
sample_reviews_en.author: kasama ch

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were absolutely delighted by this restaurant! The food is simply delicious, cooked to perfection, and prepared with incredible care and attention. The dishes tasted almost identical to authentic Portuguese cuisine, a wonderful surprise for the palate!In fact, the food looked and smelled so amazing that we didn't even have time to take any photos. We immediately dived right into the experience without capturing the moment. Such a shame!
The atmosphere is calm and incredibly peaceful, making it the perfect spot to enjoy a relaxing evening.
A special mention goes to the staff, who were absolutely delightful, welcoming, and attentive. We cannot wait to come back! We are eagerly waiting for an update on your upcoming relocation. See you soon!
sample_reviews_en.author: Denise

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a small restaurant with a homey, friend-like atmosphere. However, they're moving soon to Ruamrudee, and the prices will increase then. Right now, the prices are excellent – ​​very affordable, with good portion sizes. It's great value for money, and everything is delicious. The braised pork cheek is incredibly tender, the grilled cheese with crackers and nuts is tasty, the Portuguese rice porridge is a large bowl and flavorful (adding a squeeze of lime makes it even better), the clams are clean and sand-free, the chicken piri piri is delicious, the mashed potatoes are smooth and creamy, the fruit tea is very fragrant, and the lemon dessert is refreshing. The staff are also incredibly lovely. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Poko Lasalle

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was delicious! The prices were reasonable, and the quality was excellent – ​​definitely worth the money. You won't regret coming here; it's as good as Michelin-starred restaurants.
The flavors were rich, and the fresh pasta was amazing. The chicken pilifolia was superb – tender and delicious on its own, but the creamy sauce made it even better. A must-try! The clams had a wonderful white wine aroma, and the prawns were large, flavorful, and had a lovely garlicky taste. Highly recommended!

The owner was lovely, friendly, and fun to talk to. They put so much care into the restaurant. ❤️ I really admire them and will definitely be back to try other dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: N. Jinny

sample_reviews_en.text: La Mia is an absolute hidden gem! This Portuguese private kitchen offers a truly intimate dining experience that feels more like being invited to a friend's home than a restaurant. Every dish is crafted with care, from the perfectly salted bacalhau to the melt-in-your-mouth piri piri chicken. The flavors are authentic, bold, and comforting. The host/chef personally explains each course, which adds a lovely personal touch. Highly recommend booking in advance – this place is a must-visit for anyone who loves Portuguese cuisine or simply appreciates great home-style cooking!
sample_reviews_en.author: JingJing_Foodie

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fantastic restaurant that will be moving to the Ploenchit area soon. So if you read this after they are gone: no worries. Just a new location.

The owner has been living in Munich for 20 years and fell in love with Mediterranean food and European wines. She has a great selection of German wines. Maybe the best I‘ve seen in Bangkok. The food is heavily influenced by Portuguese food. No wonder: Lagos is her favorite European town.

The owner is very lovely and can help you big time with your food cravings if you have a hard time deciding.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

restaurants.name: YeonJung
restaurants.address:

212 sukhumvit plaza, Suk Chai Alley, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited here when I was craving Jjamppong while traveling in Bangkok. I ordered Bul Jjamppong, and it wasn't the spicy flavor of capsaicin, but the spicy flavor of Thai chili peppers, which was spicy and went well with soju. People who can't eat spicy food might have a hard time. Judging from the pork in it, it seems like they stir-fried the meat to create the broth and smoky flavor, but it was a bit weak when I tasted it, which was disappointing. The broth wasn't very sweet, so people who don't like sweet things might like it. And all the employees were friendly and the interior of the restaurant was clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: 신종호 (Luis)

sample_reviews_en.text:
It’s honestly not an exaggeration to say it tastes even better than most Korean-Chinese restaurants in Korea! The portions were incredibly generous, the service was attentive, and I also appreciated that there was no separate service charge or VAT. Absolutely recommend!!!

Honestly, it was tastier than most Chinese restaurants in Korea! The portions were really generous, and the staff were friendly, so I was very satisfied. Plus, it was great that there was no separate service charge or VAT. I highly recommend it!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: A

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ganjjajang is really delicious.
The samseon jjambbong was also delicious, but I found it a bit too bland.
They gave me a free tangsuyuk, which was delicious.
I went before they opened and had a great meal.
The Myanmar staff spoke Korean fluently, were very cheerful, and were very friendly, so I had a wonderful and delicious meal.
It's on the first floor, so it's easy to find, and the bathrooms are very clean.
Highly recommended if you're craving Korean food while traveling in Bangkok!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: sj kim

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was sooooooo good lol
It was way better than the Chinese food I had in Korea
The manager spoke Korean well, so even when the food was bad, they handled it smoothly
Oh, it was so delicious that I'm thinking about going back for dinner today, which is my last day in Bangkok...
I wrote that before I went, and the fried chicken was so delicious! I highly recommend the Japchae Bap!!!!!!!!!!!
The spicy Jjamppong was so spicy. If you can handle medium spice, don't try it lol
sample_reviews_en.author: 김보정

sample_reviews_en.text: The homemade fresh noodles are truly different. If you're a noodle lover or a fan of Korean food, you have to come to this restaurant. The sauce isn't too sweet or too salty; it might be a little bland, but adding 2-3 spoons of chili makes it perfectly spicy and delicious. The owner/sauceman also provides excellent service, which is impressive. The restaurant is small but beautiful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kulisara N.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is seriously fucking delicious lol.

I drink alone here every time I come to Bangkok, and it’s insanely tasty. If you’re craving something spicy, don’t buy Shin Ramyun from a convenience store; come here and have a bowl of Samseon Jjamppong. The owner is super friendly, and the guy working there speaks Korean really well. Seriously, highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: 아기공룡둘리

sample_reviews_en.text:
We moved our accommodation from Ekkamai to Asok and went to Yeonjeong for our first meal.

We ordered Spicy Jjamppong and Szechuan Sweet and Sour Pork.

Wow, the Spicy Jjamppong really sets things on fire. On top of that, the Szechuan Sweet and Sour Pork was intense.

For the first time in about 20 days, I’m leaving having worked up a good sweat with food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Min

sample_reviews_en.text:
Jellyfish Salad - Chewy and Sour
Cucumber Salad - Sweet and Sour
Crab Meat Soup - A little more crab meat would have been nice~^^
Yurin-gi - The sauce is delicious. The vegetables and chicken are fresh~^^
Dolpan Jjajang - Lots of seafood, highly recommended!!

Everything was delicious!!
Highly recommended~~~~
sample_reviews_en.author: 박주영

restaurants.name: ต้มเลือดหมูศาลเจ้าพ่อเสือ
restaurants.address:

331 333 Nawa 2 Alley, San Chao Pho Sua, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Extraordinary noodle soup! The best I've ever had! The place is very local, no tourists come often. I first came here after training Muay Thai in the morning and decided to give it a go. I was blown away by its flavour. Then, I started to come here almost every day for noodle soup and pork belly with pork blood cubes. All that combined with the taste of the broth gives the perfect soup!

The owners did not speak English but we understood so simply, after the second day, we just a look at each other they knew what I was getting. Lovely people! I will definitely be back many more times the next time I visit Thailand.

The soup was about $60 bhat and includes free ice tea

The place is not far away from Khao San Rd, it is about 8-10 min walk on the other. One must cross Ratchadamnoen Klang Rd towards the Old Town.
sample_reviews_en.author: Carlos Luque

sample_reviews_en.text: The broth is flavorful and clear. It's not exactly fragrant, but the taste is good. The blood cubes are large and plentiful, with no fishy smell; it's clean.
