I ordered the three-pork version, which included large pieces of crispy pork, sliced ​​pork, and minced pork – a truly satisfying meal. The price is excellent; pork blood soup with rice is 55 baht. Free water and tea are included. It's a real hidden gem. There's seating on the sidewalk and inside the shop. If you sit inside, there are plenty of fans, so it's not too hot and it's airy. The staff are lovely. You can order through an online app, but it's better to call the shop and have a delivery rider pick it up (as recommended by the owner).
sample_reviews_en.author: Atcha “Alice” Y.

sample_reviews_en.text:
My Thai friend took me here.
It's a famous local restaurant specializing in pork soup.
It was bustling with customers even in the morning!
Among the various menu items, I chose the soup with pork offal and solidified pig's blood.
I was a little hesitant about the pig's blood, but while I wouldn't say it was delicious, it wasn't particularly strong-tasting and I was able to eat it.
I eat pork offal regularly in Japan, so that was fine, but the pork liver was fresh and very tasty 😋
You put the soup and meat into the rice and eat it like soup rice.
It's quite a large portion for breakfast, but it's light and easy to eat, so I recommend it!! 👍
And it's only 50 baht, so it's incredibly cheap!
sample_reviews_en.author: sega1

sample_reviews_en.text:
This delicious pork blood soup shop is a short walk from the Chao Pho Suea Shrine. Just turn into the alley and you'll find it.
- For those who don't like offal, they have a "three-ingredient" option: sliced ​​pork, minced pork, and crispy pork, both very tasty. I highly recommend tasting it before adding any seasoning; it's already delicious as is.
- Free self-service water, both plain water and tea.
- Parking is a bit difficult. I recommend visiting the shrine first and then walking to the shop.
- The shop adapts to the weather, but not many cars pass by, so there's not much dust.
sample_reviews_en.author: Powakon Theerakarn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pork Blood Soup at the Shrine of the Tiger God...
Today I ordered crispy pork rice and pork blood soup.
The taste was good, the broth was flavorful, the blood pieces were large and plentiful, no fishy smell, clean. The crispy pork, pork slices, minced pork, and offal were all good, very satisfying. The price was good. Free water and tea are available.
There are seats on the sidewalk and inside the shop. If you sit inside, there are plenty of fans, so it's not too hot. It's airy. The staff are lovely. There are tons of online orders through the app!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: ChubbyArin

sample_reviews_en.text:
We happened to encounter this small shop around the alley after trying the famous K. Panich sticky rice shop.

It was worth it. We ordered the dried pork noodles. The pork ball was authentic, unlike those from frozen supermarkets. The soup was flavourful, can taste the pork broth.

The owner also provide free ice tea for their customers.

The only bad thing was it was a little dirty with pigeons coming to nibble around the waste area where they discard the remains of food.

Can give it a try if you don’t mind the not so hygienic street food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michelle M

sample_reviews_en.text:
It definitely looks like one of those restaurants for locals; I haven't seen anyone from out of town here.
The food is excellent. I tried some dry noodles with pork, and they give you a separate broth and as much iced tea as you want. It's wonderful! Just be careful about whether or not you ask for blood in your soup; they serve it like some kind of tofu, or just leave it out if you don't like it.
The price is very low, around 50 or 60 baht, and the service is incredibly fast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adrian Evangelio Molina

sample_reviews_en.text: Unfortunately, I've had to come here a few times, as this food court is located under the hospital. The prices are reasonable, and it's always packed. The variety is also great; they have several Thai and Chinese food stalls, an Aai café, and some pastries. As usual, they don't have beer, only water and soda, iced coffee, etc.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adrian Evangelio Molina

restaurants.name: Ramruay Pochana Rama 3
restaurants.address:

Naradhiwas Rajanagarindra 26 Alley, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Chinese restaurant serves authentic, moderately flavored food made with fresh ingredients and traditional recipes. The roasted suckling pig is incredibly delicious, with crispy skin and tender meat. It's served as a set with crispy duck, which is also very enjoyable. Other dishes like steamed fish, fish maw, and jellyfish are also decent and tasty.

For families with children, the crab fried rice and large, delicious shrimp dumplings are particularly popular.

If you're planning a trip during a festival or public holiday, such as Chinese New Year, it's recommended to call ahead to reserve a table and arrive around 11:30 AM to secure parking, as parking spaces are limited.
sample_reviews_en.author: T F S B 56

sample_reviews_en.text:
Come try the amazing value Chinese set menu for 1,999 baht at Ruayruay Pochana, Rama 3. It's a huge portion, enough for 5-6 people!

🥢 2 appetizers
🦀 Braised fish maw with crab meat
🦆 Peking duck (signature dish)
🐚 6 Australian abalone with 6 shrimp meatballs
🦐 Stir-fried shrimp with mixed vegetables
🐟 Large sea bass
🍚 Fried rice with abalone slices
🥮 Salted egg yolk lava bun

It includes appetizers, main courses, and dessert. That's less than 400 baht per person for a full Chinese restaurant experience. Great value for a family or group of friends.

There are 2 branches:
📍Ruayruay Pochana, Rama 3
📍Ruayruay Pochana, Udom Suk
#RuayruayPochana #ChineseRestaurant #OdetteReview
sample_reviews_en.author: โอเด็ตรีวิว

sample_reviews_en.text:
My mother likes roast duck and suckling pig, so we chose this restaurant after seeing reviews in a video.

The roast duck had a rancid smell and was quite tough, though still chewable.

The Hong Kong-style suckling pig was tough, hard, and had a rancid oil smell.
I asked the staff if it was fried before serving, and they said yes.
It was only roasted to about 70-80% doneness since morning.

The staff member took away the old dish and served a new one. It was better – chewable and less tough – but still not delicious.

I understand it's supposed to be freshly roasted and served hot, but I was quite disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: อัญณิการ์ สิทธิ์มโนมัย

sample_reviews_en.text:
-The restaurant is located on Rama 3 Road, near the animal hospital.
-Parking is available but limited. It might be easier on weekdays, but during weekends or Chinese New Year, parking is quite crowded and you might have to park in the side streets.
-The food is delicious, in a Chinese banquet style, but not up to restaurant standards.
-The prices are reasonable, and the menu is diverse.
-The quality is commensurate with the price.
-The staff are attentive, but due to the large number of customers, they might not be able to attend to everyone individually. However, the staff are dedicated to their work.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aommi W.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Rumruay Pochana Rama 3 is a Chinese restaurant located next to Lotus Rama 3, opposite The Up Rama 3. You can access it via Narathiwat Soi 26.

Recommended Dishes:

•	Crispy Roasted Suckling Pig – A signature dish known for its crispy skin and tender meat.
•	Salted Egg Lava Bun – A soft steamed bun filled with rich salted egg yolk custard.
•	Seafood Rad Na (Gravy Noodles) – Stir-fried flat noodles in a thick, flavorful seafood gravy.

The restaurant also offers a special 8-dish set menu, starting at 1,700 THB.

For more details and promotions, visit their Facebook page: Rumruay Pochana Facebook.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ganesh Laxmi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Riches Restaurant 🥢🔥 Legendary Chinese Food, Delicious and Flavorful! Lots of Promotions, Incredibly Good Value!
Peking Duck & Roast Duck: Crispy skin, not greasy, wrap it in a pancake and drizzle with rich sauce, incredibly delicious!
Roasted Suckling Pig: Incredibly crispy skin, authentic original recipe.
Braised Fish Maw with Crab Meat: Rich and flavorful, with chunks of crab meat.
Australian Abalone & Sea Bass: Fresh, tender, and melt-in-your-mouth, not at all fishy.
Lava Buns: Overflowing filling, perfectly sweet and creamy, the perfect way to end the meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: Poppydoo

sample_reviews_en.text: Had dinner there with suckling pig,pipa duck etc. I think we order the set dinner and some add on. I can find much better suckling pig and duck in Bangkok. The presentation of the pig in a metal tray is a minus point. The prawn roll is really yummy and the fried mixed veggies were  the only dishes I like. I'm not sure how the pork was prepared but it's not crispy at all it's hard. The crab fried rice is bland and unlike what I had in other restaurant u don't really see the crab meat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Coffey Bean

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Ramruay Pochana" restaurant, Rama 3 branch, is located at the corner of Narathiwat Ratchanakarin Road and Ratchadaphisek Road, accessible from both directions.

The restaurant is air-conditioned, has plenty of tables, private rooms, and restrooms. The overall appearance isn't particularly luxurious, resembling a back entrance, but the food is delicious, reasonably priced, served quickly, and consistently. It's a popular spot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaiyakit Thanabriboon

restaurants.name: Prime Burger Thong Lo
restaurants.address:

411 1 Thong Lo, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The burger was delicious, I ordered a double and it was just the right amount to fill me up. The sauce was flavorful and rich, and the bun was amazing. The French fries and curly fries were also very tasty, crispy and with plenty of meat inside. The milkshake was also delicious. Personally, I was indifferent to the buffalo chicken bites. The blue cheese and ranch sauce was tasty, but the chicken was fried in oil, not crispy, and it was boneless. The flavor wasn't as strong and spicy as I'm used to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanasit K.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is very yummy the beef is smells good the survice is very good because we can tell them and they do it and the atmosphere is very good not too dark and not to bright colorful and the temperature is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalermpong Dilakanont

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, I love Prime Burger, and I think they make the best veggie burgers, but this particular place, despite being located in the best area of ​​Bangkok, still falls far short in terms of service. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Алекс Вронский

sample_reviews_en.text: I randomly picked a burger joint nearby that was still open late at night, and it was absolutely delicious! I ordered the Phuket Double and it completely blew me away. Amazing! Highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: 難相處藝術家

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were cheerful, welcoming, and very polite. I was very impressed and will definitely come back again. Thank you for your care and attention.
sample_reviews_en.author: นัทธวัฒน์ สิงห์จันทร์

sample_reviews_en.text:
The branch has a bad smell coming from the restrooms.
The staff is unprofessional; they bring in frozen meat uncovered and without gloves.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ayoub Alharbi

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered burgers to our hotel via Grab. Despite the 20km distance, they were incredibly delicious and fresh. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Tinka Volk

sample_reviews_en.text: Great burgers and fried food, have weekday deals, easy to order to take away or eat in. Always hits the spot 👌 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Tim Swainson

restaurants.name: NIKU NIKU Japanese BBQ (Sathorn Branch）
restaurants.address:

95 Soi Praphinit, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a great dining experience at Niku Niku Japanese BBQ (Sathorn branch). The restaurant has a beautiful Japanese-inspired interior with a cozy yet modern atmosphere — very clean and comfortable, perfect for both casual meals and special occasions.

The quality of the meat was excellent, fresh and well-marbled, grilled perfectly with great aroma. Side dishes and sauces complemented the BBQ very well. Service was friendly, attentive, and quick without being intrusive. Staff were helpful and made the experience smooth and enjoyable.

Overall, great value for money with good food, nice ambiance, and professional service. Definitely worth coming back again. Highly recommended! 👍🔥🥩
sample_reviews_en.author: Achiraya Phupongskorn

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a newly opened restaurant and it truly exceeded my expectations. The food looks absolutely delicious, and they offer different cuts of A5 beef for you to try. Each part has its own unique flavor and texture, which makes the experience even more enjoyable. It was such a great dining experience, and I would definitely recommend it to anyone who loves premium beef.
sample_reviews_en.author: Klass DMaster

sample_reviews_en.text: Besides the exceptional food, the staff’s service and the restaurant’s atmosphere are also remarkable. It reminds me of the time I was having grilled meat in Shinjuku 😍
sample_reviews_en.author: JOEJO CHAN

sample_reviews_en.text: Great food, location near BTS Chongnonsi.. staff are very helpful … meat cuts are very high quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sepehr Massoumi Alamouti

sample_reviews_en.text: Since there's a barbecue restaurant in front of our house, we go there every other day.
sample_reviews_en.author: a r

restaurants.name: New Bukhara's Indian Restaurant
restaurants.address:

Sukhumvit 7 Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
My Indian landlords kindly brought me here for lunch to renew our rental contract. They described it as their favourite —and the most authentic— Indian restaurant in town, so expectations were high.

For context, I’ve eaten countless Indian meals over the years, many of them forgettable. The benchmark, however, has always been an exceptional curry I had in Oxford in 1999. (Yes, Ive seen a few summers)

Today’s meal didn’t just meet expectations—it surpassed them. While that Oxford curry remains a distant memory, this was without question the finest Indian meal I’ve had in decades, and quite possibly ever. I left genuinely elated.

I’m absolutely delighted to have discovered this place, and will, no doubt, return often.
sample_reviews_en.author: pierre

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very disappointing experience at Burkha Restaurant. We ordered egg biryani, but what was served was more like plain pulav rice with a few pieces of egg, not biryani at all. There was no curry or raita provided, which is usually expected with biryani.

On top of that, they charged an extra 10% service charge, which was not clearly mentioned or informed in advance. Transparency in billing is important, and this was quite misleading.

Overall, the food quality and value for money were not satisfactory. Would not recommend this place based on my experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunilkumar

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an Indian restaurant located directly on Sukhumvit close to the Nana BTS station that serves a wide range of both vegetarian and non vegetarian dishes. I had a vegetarian tandoori dish along with aloo gobi and a cucumber raita. All the items were fresh and tasty. The service staff was professional and courteous and spoke English. The portion sizes were generous, the prices reasonable and the food was served promptly. The restaurant had a comfortable and casual ambiance. I highly recommend this restaurant to those that enjoy Indian cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Kapshuk

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered Daal Bukhara which was ok but Reshmi Kebab was terrible. We didn't even eat it. Reshmi Kebab is suppose to be marinated and soft but fully cooked. Thats why its called Reshmi kebab. What they brought was a hard pieces of chicken which were not cooked from inside. When we asked about it they said we don't know what reshmi kebab is. And at billing when I gave my feedback they told us not to order this dish again. We make it only this way. I hope they improve their food and attitude.
sample_reviews_en.author: Waqas Lashari

sample_reviews_en.text:
Update 26 Nov 2025
I always live visiting this place, they have duch great food. My latest pics shows my attempt to finish my dinner, I gave it my best....soooooo good.

I am so satisfied from this meal, that I don't want to do a review, lol.  I just want to go home and crash.
I am going to make myself though because it was so delicious.
Incredible food and the service was awesome.
If you see this place try it, you won't regret it.
sample_reviews_en.author: J. Smith

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice service, exotic food. this is the first time i have try Indian food. It was delicious. Everyone should try, this restaurant is reccomend for the beginner. You can ask about food with the service person. And price is reasonable. worth to try. After that, love it or not depends on your style. I would give 4 star for the only some spice that I dont like it. But others element of restaurant are really good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Parichat Sawatteerakul

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was good 👍.  Calm place in the busy Sukumvith area.  It is pricey as we spent 500 bhat each for the basic Indian food. I really liked the hot Indian spiced tea. There was no kulfi that I was looking forward to having unfortunately. There are so many Indian restaurants in the area, so this was a discovery.  A place to go to if u are willing to pay a little bit more than other eateries.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vajira CERTAIN

sample_reviews_en.text: Admittedly, I only went in because it was raining (I thought I would prefer Thai food while in Thailand). The indian food here  is awesome, spicy if you ask for it, and in a very full-flavoured way. Goes down great with a Singha! Lots of vegan/vegetarian options. The samosas were great, the Dal was mindblowing, and all in all this was the best Indian meal I have ever had.
sample_reviews_en.author: Morten Schmidt

restaurants.name: สมยงตำซั่ว สุขุมวิท-อโศก
restaurants.address:

44/4 Sukhumvit 21 Rd, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very disappointing experience. We felt openly discriminated against as foreigners.
No greeting or acknowledgment when we walked in; we were completely ignored. We asked for ice for our drinks and were told there was none available. Yet shortly after, the Thai table next to us received a full bucket of ice.
We ordered four simple dishes. The first dish arrived after about 15 minutes, the second another 10–15 minutes later. As soon as those two dishes were served, I noticed the Thai customers beside us (who had arrived after us) were already receiving all their food plus the bucket of ice they requested.
At that point it became crystal clear we were being treated differently because we are foreigners. I immediately cancelled the two remaining dishes, paid for what we had received, and left.
If you’re not Thai, do not waste your time or money here. Strong recommendation to avoid this restaurant.

Big love, Balake and Allegar
sample_reviews_en.author: H.R. ASP

sample_reviews_en.text:
Somyong Tum Sua, tucked away in a small alley off Sukhumvit 21, is a lively spot known for proper Northeastern Thai food. I went for one of my favorite combos - grilled chicken and som tam. And this place really delivered.

The chicken was nicely grilled—juicy inside with a bit of smoky char—while the som tam came in a huge portion, packed with that punchy balance of lime, fish sauce, and chili that makes Isaan food so addictive.

Casual, energetic atmosphere with plenty of locals dropping in, which says a lot. A great place to stop by if you’re around Asok and craving something spicy, fresh, and full of flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Farangondiet

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered soup and specifically requested that I didn't want it spicy. This request was accepted with a friendly nod.

The bill was supposed to be paid before the food even arrived. My soup came with two chilies and was therefore inedible for me. When we asked for a satisfactory solution, we were offered a new soup. However, the wait was too long for us, and we couldn't get a refund. Overall, I wouldn't recommend this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Gandalf Olaf

sample_reviews_en.text: We knew the food already from home delivery and wanted to check the restaurant by itself. Delicious with a capital D was the outcome. The somtam, spicy papaya salad, huge portion was sublime. The sun-dried pork tremendous, so where the Tom Yum chicken and the vegetables in Soya sauce. That together with sticky rice and idem dito noodles made it a grandiose diner. We paid only 435 Baht inclusive 2 drinks. Highly recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: marc van looy

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shrimp in the spicy salad weren't fresh; they tasted very fishy. The vein on the back of the shrimp wasn't removed either. I ordered pork larb but there were glass noodles in it, which was a bit confusing.
However, the girl who took my order was very nice, smiling sweetly and speaking politely. I was a little disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: นภาดารา สกุลพงศ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
Caution⚠️ The reviews might be bias due to the store offer free 1 plate if you give the review with 5 stars!

Overall experience was good. The service was excellent.  But the papaya salad should have had this much carrot, evean more than a papaya. The food was a bit slow.
sample_reviews_en.author: P Pongvirat

sample_reviews_en.text: Dined at a restaurant specializing in Esan cuisine. Clean atmosphere, although certain dishes veered towards excessive sweetness. However, Somtum and Tum Luang Phra Bang stole the show with their exquisite flavors. Prices were reasonable, making it a solid dining choice.
sample_reviews_en.author: siraprapha laongthong

sample_reviews_en.text: A northeastern Thai food restaurant located in the Asoke area. It feels like a spot for locals, which is rare in this tourist-heavy district. The taste is okay, though I expected more based on the reviews. However, the service was excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pipo Travelgeek

restaurants.name: Kuppa
restaurants.address:

39 Soi Sukhumvit 16, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good homemade yoghurt with granola, french press coffee (original blend) and great fresh mint tea- so hard to find at Bangkok. This all for 5 star.
But for other food - it's made with no idea, just huge pieces of ugly cuted vegetables- look like a prison food. Not luxury at all. And doesn't have any taste or any side sauce besides ketchup. Didn't even wanted to try espresso based coffee after saw which coffee machine they use - same one you can try on the street by sidewalk. Was surprised that they care about coffee bean quality but wont use La marzocco or at least Victoria Arduino one. Why should kill all coffee taste by cheap coffee machine? Waitress also trained for 2-3 star. Asked to cook food without onion due allergy- but food comes with lots of onion in there. And this place asked for extras service charge- with no service for it. Be careful.
Cheap drinking water from the sink putted into branded bottles- overpriced. I'm ready to pay for good water but this is not respectful. Cheap bread- like from 7/11 shop. Don't think I would be back or suggest this place for friends. Who come here- just doesn't care about good quality meals. Can come and can eat, but without any joy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natalia “Natalia” Smirnova

sample_reviews_en.text:
Disappointing experience. Honestly, this was probably the worst coffee I’ve ever had in Bangkok. And surprisingly, also one of the most expensive, costing more than what I would expect to pay in a five-star hotel lobby. Looking at their pricing it feels like a place that pulls down tourists.

The place has a great location, plenty of space, and could easily be one of the nicest dining spots on Soi 16. Unfortunately, the experience was the complete opposite.

The coffee quality was terrible, scratchy when drinking, and used a diluted crap coffee instead of a proper espresso shot. And the atmosphere wasn’t much better. Staff were cleaning cutlery in the dining area, creating an incredibly loud and disruptive noise. Even with earplugs in, it was difficult to tolerate.

For me, this felt more like a tourist trap than a quality dining or coffee destination. With the space and potential this place has, it’s a real shame.

I definitely wouldn’t come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tamas Magda

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fresh and nicely mixed juices and tasty smoothies. We had the melted cheese with toasted bread to dip in and some spinach on site with onion jam which tasted great. Snow fish with pea puree superbly presented and very tasty. Salmon dish also fantastic in presentation and great taste. The pizza was on thin bread and very well loaded and extremely yummy. After that french pressed coffee which with caramel cheesecake which was actually enough in size for 3 people.
The staff was very attentive and friendly. The downturn is a bit the ambience. Maybe the light conditions, a bit too dark, and the low roof above the bar are creating this feeling.
Nevertheless it is a great place to enjoy high quality cuisine for lunch or dinner and great breakfast selections. They seem to have also a large variety of cocktails as well. Will try on our next visit since it's definitely a place to go and get spoiled by great tastes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Konstantinos Karakolidis

sample_reviews_en.text: Pretty disappointed lunch with the team. I was here before and food are greats. But not for this time. Found out that all dishes were strangely designed. For example the salmon steak were served with soba and some side like cucumber Ah-jad which pretty messy mixed. Not well rounded together. Spaghetti were too soft and not tasty anymore. Moreover the food took ages to be served even thought we pre-order in advances. The striploins we order medium rare but got burnt. All desserts are too big tiramisu texture also not good. Only French fries that can eat. Americano is OK. I think k the restaurants need to big revamp with all food menus and taste. May not be is visiting this anymore until it’s got fixed. We went there with 20++ pax but most of us not enjoying to food. This is just to share sincere reviews for improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fttlouie

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kuppa is a place that looks much less inviting from the outside than from inside. Once inside it's quite a lovely place. I only went there because a friend wanted to give it a try.
From one visit you can't tell much. We had a late breakfast with 2 coffee a home made yogurt and a French toast at a piece tag of slightly over 800 B (!!!) That was for sure the most expensive breakfast I ever had in Thailand. With this said it's quite unlikely that I sample more dishes there although they have a quiet interesting menu.
If money doesn't matter for you, you might love this place. What we had was at least delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: ThailandLifestyle Odin

sample_reviews_en.text: Kuppa Coffee is one of those Bangkok cafés that never go out of style. The vibe is easygoing and welcoming — perfect for a morning coffee or a casual meeting. Their espresso is smooth and consistent, and the flat white is one of the better ones in Sukhumvit. The food hits the spot too, especially the breakfast plates and desserts. It’s not flashy or trendy, just reliably good — a cozy, familiar spot that always feels right.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ken

sample_reviews_en.text:
We always enjoy this hidden oasis. What's terrific about this restaurant is that there is ample parking in an honest to goodness parking lot.

The restaurant itself is quite spacious and offers a wide variety of culinary delights from allday breakfast menu, to Italian to Thai.

The staff is always courteous and the music is a mix of American standards and jazz, creating a wonderfully relaxed atmosphere
sample_reviews_en.author: B T

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Italian restaurant has a relaxed atmosphere. Although it's a little pricey, the interior is quiet and spacious, making it perfect for both business meetings and private use. You can bring your own bottle of wine for 500 THB, so it's a great way to pair your favorite wine with the food. 
For lunch, we recommend coffee and cake. The cakes are large, so one would be enough for two people.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yoshinori N

restaurants.name: Jasmine Coffee & Restaurant
restaurants.address:

64, 30 ม.9 Pattaya 3rd Rd, หนองปรือ, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the small breakfast for 110B. I chose tea as part of the set drink.
It wasn't very filling, but it was just right for me as breakfast.
It was a standard dish and nothing particularly outstanding.
No complimentary water was provided.

You're greeted by Astro Boy at the entrance, and Super Mario and friendly staff when you enter the restaurant. On the day we were greeted by chickens at the entrance as well.

This is a cafe restaurant with a casual atmosphere. The interior is clean and comfortable, with wood-grain floors and a calming décor.
It's popular with both locals and foreigners, and is often busy.

There are two table seats and counter seats on the terrace, and two sofa seats, four table seats, and counter seats inside, so you can relax and unwind.

In addition to coffee and sweets, the menu is extensive, making it a great choice for breakfast or lunch. I'll upload the menu soon.

The WIFI (5G) had upload speeds of 78Mbps and download speeds of 49Mbps.
sample_reviews_en.author: Syo Kei

sample_reviews_en.text: Great cafe and restaurant, especially, for breakfast with very nice and clean environment and very friendly staff! This is the place in central Pattaya to have a full breakfast for those people who much prefer the nutritious and high energy egg-based breakfast over having yet another seafood even for breakfast in the numerous yet common not so good quality and not so clean street-type tiny cafes and restaurants in southeast Asia! I will come back for sure to Jasmine Coffee & Restaurant every morning during my stay in Pattaya city to have a full nutritious egg-type breakfast.
sample_reviews_en.author: PT

sample_reviews_en.text: The service is great.  Prices are inexpensive,   great atmosphere.  Only reason for 4 on food is waitress got my order wrong and my omelette had too many things I didnot ask for.  I believe they dont change the ingredients according to customer wishes but it was still delicious.update,  I will keep coming here as long as they are open..  still love the place.....❤
sample_reviews_en.author: Clarence Lankford

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food always good but sometimes I had bad service
I sit at the table and eat my food staff take off her shoes and wear only socks and walk around the shop and service with her socks sometimes she service fast and not look at the food or customers
And she speak Thai with foreign so how I can understand?
sample_reviews_en.author: baby

sample_reviews_en.text: Cleanliness and atmosphere in the restaurant are excellent (10/10). The food tastes great; my boyfriend prefers Western style food, while I enjoy the shrimp paste dip with mackerel and the rice mixed with shrimp paste. They have a wide variety of dishes. I eat here regularly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rodsarin Wilkerson

sample_reviews_en.text: What a great little restaurant this is, the food both Thai and farang is absolutely amazing. The Staff are excellent and friendly, plus the restaurant is spotless. Love going here and will be back on my next visit to Pattaya 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Booth

sample_reviews_en.text: Clean, comfortable, modern restaurant with wide variety of Western and Thai foods. We had the minced pork with basil, rice, and fries cheese balls. We also had an iced latte and Tai tea. Everything was fresh and well seasoned.
sample_reviews_en.author: Scott Sones

sample_reviews_en.text: The Choices are very good for breakfast and lunch time with Western and Thai food will venture back again, the only thing they need to change is the sweet bread or I would have given a 5 everything else was perfect
sample_reviews_en.author: Alfio Gangemi

restaurants.name: Khamis Zain halal restaurant (คามิส เซน ฮาลาล เรสเตอรองท์)
restaurants.address:

60 มัสยิดตออะติ้ลละห์ 6 ซอย หนองปรือ Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
After being in Thailand for the past two months, one of the best restaurants we had was at Khamis Zain.
The best two dishes were Three flavor fried fish and Tomyam soup... Have not been able to find anything comparable even in Bangkok.

Also the service was spot on. The server heard us asking for tissue and quickly went ahead and got additional pack for ease.

They also have a very clean and beautiful toilet and wudu making facility, although they could separate the wash basin so others can also use.

Also it's right next to the masjid so very convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Muneeb Bin Yousuf

sample_reviews_en.text:
Beautiful place, a house converted into a restaurant. Gives that home vibes when dining out. I’m so glad I choose to try this place, the food was amazing, authentic Thai taste as you’ll expect. Atmosphere was superb! Interior designers can go crazy with how beautiful this place is.
Lastly service was top notch, they interacted with me seeing that I came alone. Gives a nice description of what this house/home entails!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anuar Deah

sample_reviews_en.text: Mashallah amazing decor in the restaurant, delicious Halal food, and friendly genuine interaction with the owner. Perfect it is right next to the Masjid as well. We had fried seabass with tamarind sauce (highly recommend!), beef pad krapao, crab fried rice and Tom yum. Also the most beautiful bathroom I’ve ever seen in a restaurant in Thailand. Alhumdoulilah we found this place and will definitely come back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Serena Sharpe

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent restaurant interior design with ambient atmosphere.

Modest and humble family owned restaurant at the South Pattaya. Food is so tasty. Home cook style. So many choices of local delicacies to choose from.

Price is way cheaper compared to more renowned restaurant.

This is a gem in Pattaya popular to the food enthusiasts. Plenty of parking space.
sample_reviews_en.author: Isma KL

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was very delicious! The sea bass fish with tamarind sauce was excellent! We also ordered mango salad and morning glory vegetables, and the restaurant was able to modify them without shrimp and oyster sauce. We are not Muslim, but Seventh-day Adventists. Thank you for accommodating and cooking according to our requests..
we are satisfied 🙏💙❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Sophia Siahaan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is excellent and tasty. Athentic Malay and Thai style. I tried seafood curry, beef garlic, stir fried kangkung, pattaya chicken, and omellet, all superb. The portion just right for lunch. The resto is inside the mosque area, you may want to order and pray while waiting the order to come.

Recommended for halal food in Pattaya area
sample_reviews_en.author: Riza Ch

sample_reviews_en.text:
“Absolutely delicious! The flavors were rich and authentic — especially the Tom Yam and grilled seafood. Clean, halal-certified, and served with warm hospitality. A must-try for anyone visiting Pattaya!” must try the seafood all taste real thai food and dont forget tp order their own grown grape soda

Sedak sungguh tak belawok
sample_reviews_en.author: Che Faeiz

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stumbled upon this place as we were looking somewhere to pray.
The look of the restaurant, the kindness of the owners and even more amazing the food. We had our first Thai food experience in Pattaya here and we were happy to find somewhere halal. We loved everything about it and were happy to find it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Em

restaurants.address:

672, 8 Si Phraya Rd, Khwaeng Bang Rak, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tom Yum Goong
The seasoning is tailored to foreign tastes, so it's not spicy.

I thought their green curry was good, but the pineapple fried rice (not the green curry) was surprisingly delicious. My recommendation is the pineapple fried rice.

↓Previous post
It's delicious. My favorite Thai restaurant around the Sheraton. Their green curry is mild and not spicy, so those looking for a spicy green curry might find it lacking. Besides beer, they also have wine and other alcoholic beverages, making it a good place for a leisurely meal. Even two middle-aged men could enjoy a stylish meal here. They also have Tom Yum.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nao T

sample_reviews_en.text:
We greatly enjoyed our meal at Bona. We were hungry, and started with shrimp cakes and fried vegetable spring rolls.

Then I had chicken and noodle, while she had the full sea bass meal!

We finished with a mango and mango ice cream dessert.

I had Chang beer, which I always do in Thailand. She had a piña colacda and a pineapple juice.

We were very happy with our entire meal, served by friendly helpful staff.  It cost 1449 baht.  Good value
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael O'Malley

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had lunch and dinner at this place the same day. The food was great and an English menu with photos was provided that it was easy to understand what to order. I really liked the minced pork dish and garlic fried rice. The price was super reasonable and we were all surprised as we ordered a lot of food and beer.

The only downside was that it took a bit of time to get the food we ordered, but it was understandable as the restaurant was full.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Woosouk Choi

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner of this place is definitely a racist or an Asian hater. Ur order will come only after those Caucasians/white people r served.  It took 47 minutes to get my order ready whilst the white lady sitting right next to me got hers only in less than 10 minutes. It definitely irks and is humiliating to eat here if u r an Asian.  NOT recommended for Asian and non-white people to visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Pih

sample_reviews_en.text: Last night in Thailand and Bangkok and we found this hidden gem. Food was really tasty and the ones who wanted spice got it. We had morning glory, deep fried morning glory, spicy pork salad, laab moo, pork neck, som tum and a lot more and none of them disappointed. We were seven people ordered a lot of different dishes and they got all of the dishes spot on.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pathrick Broholm

sample_reviews_en.text:
The visit left a pleasant impression. The cafe is small, with one floor. There are many paintings hanging on the walls. The staff was very friendly and hospitable.
I ordered noodles, and they were good but not amazing. They were prepared quickly. Wi-Fi was also available in the cafe, which was very convenient.
Prices at the cafe were average for Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nadya Levina

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place was a really good surprise after a long warm walk in Talat Noi  - the place is very well decorated, they serve well prepared thai food and some western starters.
The only downside was the dessert (the sign says mango icecream, and it happened to be vanilla icecream along with fresh mango) but overall a very pleasant experience, great service.
sample_reviews_en.author: TheFitnessTheory

sample_reviews_en.text:
Unexpectedly delicious! Needed to grab a quick lunch break on the way to a tour, glad we stopped here

The crab fried sauce was our favorite, the sauce on the side of fish sauce, garlic, chilis was amazing! Morning glory was a solid vegetable side to eat

The restaurant is nicely AC'd, friendly service and with tasty food!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kev N

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here seeing the good reviews. But the food is just bad. Dosa tasted stale and the sambar had a weird flavour. Idli was hard and didn’t feel authentic. Plus the ambience and the overall experience is not worth the prices they charge. There are better Indian restaurants nearby with a better ambiance and food, for lower prices. Try Malabar restaurant instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanmay Vij

sample_reviews_en.text: A uniquely excellent 👌 eatery..  the owners are nearby taking care of the kitchen. The owners eat their own food. And have given me recommendations...  I have been with vegetarian friend and we are all weekly visitors.   I live 25 minutes away and it is worth the drive over... And he does an excellent take away service
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeremiah Keenan

sample_reviews_en.text: Great food, fantastic service, but the owner and about 5 other guys were sitting there talking to each other very loudly, they were actually yelling! I left there with a headache and will never go back. They had total disregard for us as customers, if you are looking to have a quiet meal keep walking past this place
sample_reviews_en.author: Perry Hobden

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is great !! The staff is also really friendly. They know what they’re doing and what they’re talking about. You can tell, making customers happy is their main priority. Food is pretty good, Biryani is awesome also the Chatpati Pani Puri, and for their prices it’s 100% worth it !!! Highly recommend !!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rahul Mhatre

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great food, great location. If only they had more friendly customer service... I felt like I needed to apologize to the waitresses for no reason so many times as we got rather cold and unwelcoming service at the table.
But the curries were amazingly good. 5 stars out of 5 for the chefs!
sample_reviews_en.author: T K

sample_reviews_en.text:
It is a wonderful restaurant with good Indian dishes. Their taste is authentic and they serve  hot and clean.
The staff is also very friendly. The restaurant is very close to pattaya beach. The rates are also economical. Overall a very good experience. The restaurant is recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr. Zainab Asim

sample_reviews_en.text: A must visit place if you have a craving for authentic Indian cuisine. The restaurant has a plethora of varieties ranging from Maharasthrian to Chinese as well as North Indian food. The hygiene of the restaurant is also pretty good and the staff is pretty polite and friendly too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nitin Pandey

sample_reviews_en.text: I had 230THB Chicken Biryani(Basmati rice was sweet, fragrant, aromatic, chicken was tender) & 30THB Masala Tea(Strong tea flavor, kept me awake all night). Food was good, but nothing really oustanding. Staff were nice&friendly. Price was abit steep for the biryani.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaxw Ang

restaurants.address:

24 Sukhumvit 53 Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
My husband and I with a couple from USA had dinner at Bo LAN on 9th Jal26. First, we start with cocktails and coconut drinks. The coconut served with spoon that suggest to eat coconut meat but it was so hard and water sour. It should be for cooking not serve at fine dining restaurants. Then staff took us to the kitchen to meet a chef. Chef served a bite of rice with salt and pepper call ( พริก กับเกลือ)  our dinner start with small bite of little things for example, curry with fish wrap the banana leave (ห่อหมกปลา) , Thai noodle mango over with coconut milk(ขนมจีนซาวน้ำขนมจีนชาวน้ำ) etc.Spicy curry, glass noodle with sto. I am being Thai person. One through it come in mind “ foreigner try to cook Thai food and  Failed .  I am so embarrassing to bring my husband and friends there. We spend over 30,000 Thb for 4 of us hoping every bite are memorable.

A Sucker born every day(just onetime)
Kasinee.
sample_reviews_th.author: Kasinee Karnsomport

sample_reviews_en.text: Arrive hungry for this feast. The Thai restaurant featured on Chef's table was an amazing and imaginative $US200pp 12-course tasting menu set in a dark interior. It was such a huge meal we had to leave half of it behind, which was heartbreaking. The chef trained abroad, married an American, and returned to resurrect ancient recipes of traditional cuisine using organic local products sustainably. The meal begins with a visit to the incredibly clean kitchen for a spoonful of rice types with roasted coconut and palm sugar.  The 6 amuse-bouche openers were really beautiful and unusual. The mains came all together and were spicy, intense flavors. Standouts were a crispy fish curry and a seafood coconut curry where the shrimp was unusually tender and meaty. A palate cleanser 1/2 teaspoon of peanut ice cream was so intensely flavored we wouldn't have wanted more than that tiny morsel. They take you to a separate lounge for dessert, trying to upsell you with liqueurs. The desserts were a smoke-infused popcorn granola followed by a beautiful array of postage-stamp-size molded jelly fruits and intense chocolate cubes, accompanied by a tea with lavender, bergamot, chrysanthemum and honey.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom Elwood

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very good meal for over 14,000 baht (7,000 baht per person...).

From start to finish, it was a true gastronomic experience: we were seated with a cocktail, then we went into the kitchen to enjoy a very pleasant little amuse-bouche. Going into the kitchen gave us a VIP feeling, even though everyone else was invited in.

Then we sat down to eat. The appetizers were lovely, and the main courses were served all at once. Not being very familiar with Thai cuisine, I couldn't distinguish the herbs, but I could tell they were delicious. The dessert was nice because there were several options, and the smoky flavor of the peanuts was a pleasant touch.

The staff was very attentive, and the chef came to chat with us... it was a pleasant experience, a bit pricey in my opinion, but very enjoyable nonetheless.

We left with a small gift (for cooking at home).

I changed my review the next morning:

During the night, we both had stomach cramps and had to go to the bathroom... Looking back, the meal was therefore very expensive for what it was.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jonathan

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited this restaurant all the way from Korea with high expectations for the most traditional Thai flavors.
The course and flavors truly reflected the philosophy of the head chef and the team that we had seen on Netflix.

Indeed, this was a place where we could experience authentic Thai flavors unlike anything we had tasted before.
Beyond the food itself, the service was equally outstanding and treated guests with genuine care and professionalism.

We would especially like to express our gratitude to our server, Miss Nut.
She guided us through the formal atmosphere and the progression of the courses—something that could have felt unfamiliar—with great detail, sincerity, and warmth, offering thoughtful explanations and insights into each dish.

Thanks to her, our family was able to enjoy a truly wonderful and unforgettable experience together.

We fell in love with your cooking, Chef.
Thank you, Miss Nut.
sample_reviews_en.author: ToneGray tonegrayproject

sample_reviews_en.text:
Given the high quality of restaurants in bangkok and the high price point, I would not recommend dining at bo.lan. You have so many other great options!!

We were really looking forward to bo.lan but something about dining here made me feel gaslit. Neither the food, service or atmosphere felt particularly elevated despite the glowing write ups and netflix documentary. Has it always been this way? Or did they make changes since they re-opened since covid?

The food was fine but a bit gimmicky like being told to spritz pandan water into your mouth or having someone infuse smoke in your dessert.

Service was fine, nothing special.

Atmosphere was just lacking. No buzz or vibe. You walk through the gift shop to enter the restaurant and are first seated in a very mediocre bar area. And I hope it was an unusual occurrence, but the toilets were not clean the night we were there either.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeevika Makani

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were crashing at Madi Padi next door when we accidentally wandered into this absolute gem of a spot. From the second you hit the street and cruise down that endless driveway, (pictured) it's got that "wow, I'm underdressed" vibe dialed up to eleven.

I skipped the photos because the table beside us was treating their meal like a paparazzi stakeout—flashbulbs popping like they were documenting a crime scene. No thanks; I stuck to my mission: devouring everything in sight.

The menu swung from old favorites to proteins twisted into shapes that made me question my life choices. Look, this isn't your go-to for a awkward first date unless you enjoy explaining caviar to someone who's still impressed by ramen.

But if your wallet's feeling flush, do yourself a favor and book a table—your taste buds will thank you, even if your bank account sends a passive-aggressive text.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ekym

sample_reviews_en.text: Bo.lan is an absolute masterpiece of fine dining that offers a truly unforgettable journey through authentic Thai cuisine! Set within a stunning, timber-clad environment that perfectly balances traditional charm with minimalist elegance, the atmosphere is as captivating as the food itself. The menu is an incredible showcase of elevated, meticulously crafted dishes that burst with complex, uncompromisingly bold traditional flavours, showcasing a profound respect for local ingredients. What makes the experience even more remarkable is their inspiring commitment to sustainability and a zero-waste philosophy, adding a meaningful layer to every phenomenal bite. With warm, impeccable service and an incredible attention to detail from start to finish, a meal here is not just a dinner but a spectacular culinary adventure that is an absolute must for anyone visiting Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna Alam

sample_reviews_en.text:
To summ it up, nice place, good food , but   definitely not the standard you are expecting. From the entrance that takes you through some kind of gift shop … and the staff that  seems to be poorly trained. A few things disappointed me 1. The 5 last courses came all together, not what you expected from a tasting menu. Once i was done with the first or second one the rest got cold.
Also, The restaurant was almost empty and the staff was
Was gathered all together in the corner most of the time, staring at people dining and giggling, altogether the staff was very loud, seems a few were in training and it was well noticed. That being said, the food was good, special, and interesting. Cocktails were amazing, and all together i had a pleasant  meal. Just not-the standard of one star restaurant and does not live up to expectations and to the price tag.
sample_reviews_en.author: Elch

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located right by the road with parking available inside. The staff provided excellent service, always smiling and welcoming. The food came out quickly, with no long wait. The soup I ordered was delicious and rich, I loved it so much I barely needed any extra dipping sauce. One thing that surprised me the most was the pumpkin; it was incredibly delicious, sweet, soft, and melted in my mouth. After the meal, they even gave us complimentary mochi ice cream in strawberry flavor, which was delicious. Overall, this restaurant is great, and the price is reasonable considering the quality. I'll definitely be back next time! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Prapapan L.

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating here since it was a hidden gem within a Thai-style restaurant. Now it's no longer a secret because of the deliciousness, premium quality, amazing soup, fantastic dipping sauces, and consistently excellent service from day …
sample_reviews_en.author: Eong Pk

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. The meat was high quality, and the soup was flavorful and well-balanced, not too strong. The staff provided good service, and there was convenient parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thawin Riewbumroong

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and of good quality, and the atmosphere is great. I like that they have small individual hot pots, which is convenient if you come with a large group.
sample_reviews_en.author: SASUNE ซาซูน

sample_reviews_en.text: The shabu-shabu is delicious! The staff are very attentive and polite, and they give excellent food recommendations. Whenever I'm in Pattaya, I always eat here! 🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Panida Jongkolwaranont

sample_reviews_en.text: I love this shabu-shabu restaurant the most. The meat is excellent, the soup is great, and the side dishes are fantastic. I highly recommend it! 10/10/10.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nan CeeD

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent! The food was delicious. It's perfect for solo diners or families. I'll definitely come back again if I have the chance! 🙆🏻‍♀️🩷

sample_reviews_en.text:
The meat is delicious and of good quality. Parking is available at the Thai-style restaurant.
The staff are attentive and provide excellent service. 😘 …

restaurants.address:

25 Chana Songkhram Alley, Chana Songkhram, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
During my 4-month trip to Thailand/Vietnam..
Khaosan, Pattaya, Hua Hin, Chiang Mai, Da Nang, Hoi An, Hanoi, etc. Korean restaurants are the most tasteless and expensive. Kalguksu noodles are Thai egg noodles..
The broth was somewhat edible. I didn't eat the noodles.
Tuna kimbap costs 150 baht, but it doesn't taste good even when dipped in tteokbokki broth. The contents are too weak. The rice is a mess.
No matter how many Korean restaurants there are in Khaosan, they are not competitive,
but they are incomparable to Korean restaurants in Chiang Mai and Pattaya.
The price is more expensive and the taste is also very bad.
The side dishes are really...the kimchi tastes like rotten kimchi. I spit it out.
sample_reviews_en.author: hyemi lee

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere, I especially love sitting on the floor, it's such a nice vibe! The food prices are moderate and acceptable considering how delicious the food is. At first, I thought the food tasted like typical tasty dishes, but after trying the Jjamppong... wow, it was the best! The seafood aroma was amazing, and the flavor was perfect. Please don't let the quality drop like this! 🥹 I'll definitely be back. The staff are friendly, polite, and provide good service. They often give complimentary items. The side dishes are delicious, especially the bean sprouts.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chon Lamad

sample_reviews_en.text: Maybe it's because I don't eat Korean food very often, but if I had to compare it, it's similar to eating Nem Nuong – pork, vegetables, side dishes, and dipping sauce, eaten with ramen or something like that. The restaurant has both floor seating and tables. It's not very big, but there are more tables outside, suitable for groups. The service was good. The restaurant also gave us a complimentary steamed egg (or maybe it was a steamed egg custard, I'm not sure if that's the Korean name, sorry!). It was delicious and easy to eat, and the price wasn't expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: อารยา เจนการ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Jjamppong: Absolutely not recommended... 1 point

Kimchi Stew... 3 points. It tastes like a foreign version of Korean food you'd find abroad...

Gimbap... 3 points. There is too much rice compared to the filling, and it's sticky, so you get full after eating just a few pieces.

Side Dishes... 4 points. The accompanying side dishes are actually the best part...

As expected, you should go to eat Korean food overseas with zero expectations...
sample_reviews_en.author: DH H

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here many times, and it's still as delicious as ever. The highlight is the grilled pork belly – crispy pork belly served with lettuce, garlic, gochujang, kimchi, and unlimited refills of side dishes and fresh vegetables. You can ask for more anytime. I also like the kimbap, fried chicken, and tteokbokki. The service is great, and they even give you free fried tteok and steamed egg.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanin Nithi (Imm)

sample_reviews_en.text: This Korean restaurant has a homey, casual feel, like visiting a relative's house. The staff are incredibly friendly, and they offer a generous amount of side dishes (free). The flavors are just right and easy to eat. The portions are large, so sharing is recommended. I highly recommend trying their Jajangmyeon and fried chicken – they're delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr. Kornravit Inthachai

sample_reviews_en.text: Recommended for those craving Korean food. Lots of young locals frequent this place. The bean sprout salad is incredibly delicious. The owner and staff are friendly and willing to provide a variety of dishes. However, there's no ssamjang (ssamjang is so good I can't even think of it).
sample_reviews_en.author: 송지호

sample_reviews_en.text:
Somewhat unassuming, but a fantastic place nonetheless.

The food and service were excellent. Very friendly people. They always have a variety of small, dressed salads available, from cucumber to kimchi, to accompany your usual order. The value for money is unbeatable.

Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert Biedermann

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is very chill, like being at a seaside hangout. The food is delicious.
It's a made-to-order BBQ pork set, where you can choose what you want to eat. The large mixed pork set comes with a generous portion of good quality ingredients. The dipping sauces include both those with and without fermented fish sauce, and they're not too spicy.
The passion fruit ice cream has a mild flavor and is good for cleansing the palate. The Mahachai ice cream wasn't quite to my liking.

The service is good and the restrooms are clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dolly Vipulakom

sample_reviews_en.text:
The dipping sauce is sweet, just sweet, not sour, not spicy, and doesn't go well with the meat at all.
The chicken pops are tasty, but the portion is small and not worth the price.
The snacks are not worth the price at all. The large pork set isn't enough for two people. A bottle of water is 20 baht, and it's Quafina brand, omg.
sample_reviews_en.author: OnceUpon Atime

sample_reviews_en.text: I've never had such a terrible BBQ place. They treat their customers with such disrespect. The prices are exorbitant, but the ingredients are far below the quality expected. They use low-grade ingredients. What kind of BBQ only has chicken? They should change the name to "Chicken BBQ."
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirilak Buakaew

sample_reviews_en.text: Come experience a Thai-style BBQ where everything takes about 20 minutes to prepare. Requesting a new pan takes another 20 minutes, and ordering more pork takes another 20 minutes. The portions are so small, it's like eating until you're stuffed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Pan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food and dipping sauces were terrible, way too sweet, and the prices were exorbitant for the quality. The portions were small, the marinated pork was overly salty, and they even added a 7% service charge/tax on top of the food price. I …
sample_reviews_en.author: Chontichs Daengna

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere, the food is delicious, the marinated pork is amazing, the dipping sauces are great, and they play relaxing music. Eating here during the rainy season is so enjoyable! 😍🩷
sample_reviews_en.author: Nontiya Thiraprawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered a large set at a BBQ restaurant, got more chicken than pork. Ugh.
The charcoal wasn't strong enough, asked for more, but they didn't, instead they moved the pan?
sample_reviews_en.author: Ritidet Every

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was great. The food, the fried items – I have to say the shrimp heads were amazing! And the surprise was they had German draft beer, Red Sun brand! Fantastic!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chutsarun Klumkum

restaurants.address:

1297 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Wow, this was literally the worst Indian food I’ve ever had in my life and the overall worst restaurant I’ve visited in all of Thailand. Watery curries with the completely wrong ingredients used. You may as well just shut the place down until you find someone who actually knows how to cook — i certainly think you should not in good conscience charge money for something that so clearly is unfit to be served to begin with. I could have done ten times better cooking myself. This comically terrible food was paired with bad service — no music either to distract us from the horror. It was expensive and took forever too! We spent almost 1000 baht for three people. I am in shock.
sample_reviews_en.author: Evan S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Indian food from Indian chef is so delicious like travel to India! This restaurant isn’t easy to find but isn’t hard to reach. Start from BTS Sapan Taksin exit 1 and walk to ferry across Chaophaya river, take the boat, then walk until you see the main road, turn left around 500 meters from pier. Finally, you will found it!

It’s a small restaurant with 6-8 tables but clean and worth to come. Owner is nice and gave me a good suggestions. All Indian food is delicious and easy to try. Price is quite cheap when compare with other Indian restaurant in Thailand. But there is no parking. If parking is your first choice, please order delivery.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pearploy Stp.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and the flavors are easy to understand. My favorite is the butter chicken. The flavor is smooth and the chicken is tender. It's delicious with the egg biryani, or even with the cheese naan. It's amazing!

The restaurant has tables to sit and eat. The staff are friendly and helpful. When I first went, I didn't know Indian food, so they recommended different dishes. On my second, third, and fourth visits, I only ordered this set because it was the best.

The restaurant now accepts the "Half-Half" program. It's easily accessible, located on Charoen Nakorn Road.
sample_reviews_en.author: J N

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is our go-to Indian restaurant in Bangkok. All the food is delicious and flavorful, leaning towards South Indian cuisine. They do a great job with the naan; I highly recommend the cheese naan with the cheese curry – it's incredibly delicious! There's no parking at the restaurant, but you'll have to find parking elsewhere. It's a small restaurant but the quality is exceptional. Highly recommended! They also offer delivery. 🥘😋

(Note: The repeated "🥘😋" appears to be spam/illegible text and has been omitted from the translation.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanyapath Wandee

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my second time for indian food (but this is still the first restaurant). I still in love with pani puri here. Prawn masala is very tasty and go well so much together with nan (I’d prefer garlic). This time I tried thali (set) I don’t know the name of each soups but I can enjoy all of them especially spinach one. If someone hesitate to try indian food, please go and try, it doesn’t have to be this restaurant, you might find something new.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puvadol Canthasaksiri

sample_reviews_en.text: Use only your hands or clean the utensils yourself.  I suspect contamination from the unclean utensils the last time I and my wife both have indigestion. But good tasting Indian food, Reasonable price.  Tried a few dishes, chicken tikka was very tender and flavorful without being over powering by spices.   Spinach Paneer was right on the spot.  Lemon rice came out looking unlike what I had in Goa, but was good never the less.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom Praisan

sample_reviews_en.text: I live very close to this restaurant, there are 3 great Indian restaurants near by, but this tends to be my go to when I'm craving Indian food. The reason is the price and quality. Plenty to chose from on the menu and good portion sizes. Can't believe I've not reviewed before, maybe because I often take away. Anyway if you're looking for a very good Indian meal at reasonable prices, I can't recommend enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: Geordie boy lost in Asia

sample_reviews_en.text:
I walked into the restaurant and it smelled awful. I'd like to see it cleaned up a bit. The food was very bland, lacking any spice. It didn't feel like I was eating Indian food at all. I ordered the fish tandori, which was made with dory fish and the fish was mushy.
The only good thing was the Indian tea, which was standard. The garlic naan had a nice buttery aroma. Please improve. I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanda Rodpon

restaurants.name: Al-saddah Yemeni restaurant
restaurants.address:

Soi Sukhumvit 3, Khwaeng Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5

First time ever trying Yemeni food and Al-Saddah absolutely impressed me. I came in late night/early morning around 5 AM and they were open and ready, which was perfect.

I ordered the lamb muqalqal breakfast and the shakshuka dish with the fresh Yemeni bread, and everything was delicious. The lamb was tender and flavorful, and the eggs paired with the warm bread hit perfectly for breakfast. The portions were great and the flavors were something new to me in the best way.

The vibe was relaxed, the service was quick, and for my first Yemeni experience, this place set the bar really high. Definitely recommend stopping by if you’re curious about Yemeni food or want a solid early-morning meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: William Price

sample_reviews_en.text:
Of the many restaurants I've tried on my three visits, Al-Saddah Restaurant stands out. The goat meat is delicious and the price is excellent.

We tried a portion of Haneeth lamb, a portion of Mandi lamb, and a cucumber and yogurt salad, and all were delicious.

The Yemeni staff's hospitality left a lasting positive impression. May God bless them and grant them success. The food and the atmosphere were very comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: First Last

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, and I honestly wasn't expecting it to be so good. I tried the mandi meat, and there are also seating areas upstairs for families. I was also impressed by the staff's friendly and polite manners, especially the Yemeni staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: MOHAMMED

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best Yemeni restaurants in Bangkok, Thailand, located on Arab Street. One of the best and most distinguished staff members is Haroun, and the service is fast and excellent, God willing. The staff is respectful, and I am very grateful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Farida Alhabsi

sample_reviews_en.text: Dinner was mandi lamb, recommended and advised by the restaurant staff, and I thank them for that. Masha'Allah, it was a delicious and tasty dinner. After dinner, they offered me tea as a treat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Salman

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried their lunch and it was excellent, especially the snack and shrimp salad, which were very delicious. The service was good and the staff were very attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Xamaada Cabdulaahi

sample_reviews_en.text: A beautiful restaurant, and I highly recommend the Haneeth (sweet porridge), which is excellent. The service is also excellent, and the restaurant is clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yousef Alsharif

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best restaurants in Bangkok. The food is clean and well-presented, and the service is excellent. I thank Mr. Haroon for his hospitality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nawaf Hey

restaurants.name: Bangkok Trading Post Bistro & Bar
restaurants.address:

59/1 Sukhumvit 39, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This café is gorgeous. The design is just on point, there’s a little fish pond, a beautifully styled terrace, and the whole place has serious aesthetic vibes. Inside, it’s nicely renovated and feels super chic.

The service was great, and yeah it’s a bit pricey, but it’s one of those fancy spots where you kind of expect that.
I had a Thai tea that was really good, actually.

What’s surprising is how empty it always is. I’ve been there a few times, and every time it’s either just me or one other table.
It’s kind of strange considering how stunning the place is, it totally deserves more people.

Definitely worth a visit if you’re into stylish cafés with a calm, quiet vibe.
sample_reviews_en.author: daniel alon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Two years ago, this was our favorite place for Sunday brunch. We loved coming here with the whole family.
However, the service has deteriorated significantly since then. I’ve encountered rude behavior on several occasions, and my order has been forgotten more than once.
Today, when I came to the café with small children, I waited for the menu for 20 minutes. Then I waited another hour for my order, which was forgotten. And there were no other customers in the café. The quality of the food has also declined over the years.
We are very disappointed; it was an extremely unpleasant experience. It’s a shame that our memories of this place will now be negative.
sample_reviews_en.author: A Kerkor

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a wonderful dining experience at Bangkok Trading Post.

The food was absolutely delicious — every dish was flavorful, beautifully presented, and made with high-quality ingredients. You can really taste the care and attention in every bite.

The atmosphere was lovely and relaxing, making it a perfect place for any occasion, whether with friends, family, or a special celebration.

A special thank you to Luktarn, Pim, Mei, Going, Ploy, and Fon for the outstanding service. They were attentive, friendly, and made us feel truly welcomed throughout the meal.

Highly recommended! I will definitely come back again. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: yant cafe

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dog 🐕 Friendly ✨✨
We love taking our dog here as they are very welcoming and the dogs are allowed on the grassed area with no problems.
It is a lovely green space in the city which is rare to be able to enjoy with your dog.  The beautiful big trees provide shelter from the sun and it feels so relaxing to be looking at greenery.
The atmosphere is enhanced by great music playing around the outside sitting area.
We have only every gone for breakfast but I think it would make a great place for lunch.

Thank you 🙏 so much for welcoming our dogs into your business we really appreciate it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Debbie Armstrong

sample_reviews_en.text: We were there for breakfast. Coconut Pancake was quite sweet with pre syrup. 4 persons didn't finish this dishes.  Farmers' Egg were very bland but nice Soft Toast. Tuna Tataki's Salad.. umm  no.. It's quite bland. No impression of food. All Coffee were 100+ Baht. Good deal but Quality come with price. Nothing wrong but nothing impressive. We expect 5 position star hotel come with 5+ F&B especially in downtown Bangkok. Great location, Great atmosphere but wish a bit selected Chef, Food quality and more drink dimension served.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nijaya I

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came to eat at the restaurant and ordered a pizza to share with friends. It was delicious and the tray was huge! We were so full. We came around 5 pm and they had a happy hour buy 1 get 1, which was great value. I highly recommend it!
P.S. The staff were very lovely, friendly and provided excellent service. Thank you to Khun Luktan, Khun King, and Khun Mei for the great service and excellent menu recommendations.
P.S.S. I forgot to mention that the chef served and presented the pizza himself, by Chef Pol.
sample_reviews_en.author: Go with Pimpilai

sample_reviews_en.text:
3.5 stars. Popular brunch spot serving a wide selection of Western food. Overall OK across the board though nothing particularly good.

We shared a bunch of things – details below:
- Mexican sharing plate – nice variety but tastes very average…
- Lemon pancake – nice lemon touch but texture could be improved
- French toast – ok
- Egg soufflé – ok
- Pizza – ok
- Chocolate lava cake - ok

Nice ambiance though and the rooftop bar has a signature glass floor which is pretty cool to check out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anchisa Pongmanavuth

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff here are so lovely. They greet you and really make you feel welcome.  It’s dog friendly too with good seating area outside and fans help with the heat.
Each time I come back the staff remember me and make you feel so special.  The pumpkin soup is the best I have had anywhere in Bangkok and the Calamari is also lovely and fresh.
This will be my little neighborhood place to take visitors because I know the service is first class.
sample_reviews_en.author: DM R

restaurants.name: Est.33
restaurants.address:

1420/1 Pradit Manutham Rd, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited Est.33 on Pradit Manutham Rd. on a weekend around 7pm and was surprised to find we were the only diners in the whole restaurant when we arrived, though a live band had already started performing. Compared to my past visits, it currently feels less crowded than it used to be—back then it was packed with customers. The food quality was fairly standard, with nothing particularly exceptional, and overall I found the pricing on the pricey side for the quality offered. On the positive side, service was attentive and the staff were responsive throughout our visit, and I hope the restaurant can keep sustaining in the long run as it’ll be interesting to see how things progress with the current turnout.
sample_reviews_en.author: Theng Seng Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: Offering four CBs on tap, including occasional Weizen alongside regular options like Snowy, Lager, and Kopper, all boasting a 4.5% alcohol level. Despite the seemingly high-end atmosphere, prices are reasonable, except for the Weizen which is slightly higher. Prices range from THB 190 for 0.3 liters, THB 260 for 0.5 liters, to THB 1,500 for a 3-liter pitcher. The venue features comfortable and spacious indoor and outdoor seating, with tables overlooking an outdoor fountain and indoor brewing tanks. Additionally, there's a winery onsite! Enjoy live music in the open air, with many young couples adding to the vibrant atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tak D

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was absolutely delicious, with every dish cooked to perfection and bursting with flavor. The cocktails were top-notch—beautifully crafted and packed with flavor, making them the perfect accompaniment to the meal.

The live band added a great vibe to the evening, with fantastic music that made the atmosphere lively and enjoyable.

And I have to mention the service—our waitress was not only attentive and professional but also stunningly beautiful, adding a special charm to the whole experience.

Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for great food, drinks, and an amazing ambiance!
sample_reviews_en.author: Max Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but the air inside the restaurant was extremely hot, which ruined the atmosphere. I went at 7 PM, and the air conditioning wasn't working. They tried using fans, but that didn't help much. A restaurant of this caliber shouldn't be making such a mistake regarding the indoor air conditioning. Surprisingly, the air conditioning in the restroom was even cooler than inside the restaurant! 😂
sample_reviews_en.author: Aurkarn Mongkonrat

sample_reviews_en.text: It's been many years since I last visited. The food is as delicious as ever, but the restaurant was quite hot inside, and I felt the bill was more expensive this time. I hadn't noticed it was that pricey before. I brought my father here for his birthday. There weren't any special birthday promotions or gifts like other restaurants. The staff provided good service, and parking was convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: fhabulous x

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is beautiful and comfortable, they have delicious beers, and the band plays great music. Overall, everything is great. The only downside is that the menu is a bit limited, mostly Western food, but most people come here mainly to drink beer. It's a suitable place for socializing or having a meal with family. It's located at CDC.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brûlée

sample_reviews_en.text: Good beer, delicious food, good service, big German pork knuckle, worth the price, crispy and meaty. However, I would like to see more side dishes, such as mashed potatoes and pickles. The wasabi seafood salad is also good. Overall, it's good. I'll go hang out with friends again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Passzarkorn Beta

sample_reviews_en.text: I used to eat here often when it first opened. This time I came back and the atmosphere is still similar, but the food has changed a bit. The beer seems to have deteriorated slightly in taste. There's live music on Sunday evenings (one band). The staff provides good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: JomJi

restaurants.name: GENKI SUSHI
restaurants.address:

CentralWorld, floor5, 999/9 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This bright yellow restaurant stands out, located on the 5th floor, near the glass elevator, in the Urbance Balance zone. It's the first place that comes to mind when I want sushi in CTW.

The restaurant has both outdoor and indoor seating, with both tables and individual seats. The atmosphere is nice and quiet, with no queues. You order via QR code and wait for a train to deliver your food to your table.

If you come between 11:00 AM and 2:30 PM, they have Lunch Sets priced from 179-269 baht, which are considered good value.

The a la carte menu is diverse, ranging from appetizers, sushi, sashimi, and desserts. Everything is freshly made, delicious, and worth the price. Prices range from 29-39 baht. Prices do not include a 10% service charge. They also have promotions with credit cards.

Today, I had the 269 baht Lunch Set, which included a rice bowl with very fresh and sweet shrimp, steamed egg custard, soup, and fried salmon skin (the dipping sauce was delicious).

I also ordered Engawa, pork wrapped in scallions, pork wrapped in enoki mushrooms, and cheesecake for dessert. Everything was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: J'adore

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, especially the 29 baht menu items – they were surprisingly good value and tasted amazing! I usually eat at Sushiro every week because there's a branch near my house, but today I was in the city and tried a new restaurant. In conclusion, I like this one more than Sushiro, but it's far from home so I probably won't go often.🥹

The Ame Sababo and US Gunkan beef are the best – incredibly good value.
The shellfish and squid with wasabi were seriously spicy – ​​wasabi lovers have to try them!🤣 Even the sweet egg with mentaiko was unexpectedly delicious.
