I ate 23 dishes + fried chicken wings, totaling 887.70 baht (plus 10% service charge). It was enough for two people. In summary, it was great value, delicious, and I loved it! 5 stars! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

Ps. For salmon and tuna dishes, Sushiro still has softer and tastier meat, but for other menu items, Genki is better.
sample_reviews_en.author: thanaporn sukjitnitayakarn

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best sushi spots in CentralWorld 🍣
No long queue like many other popular places, which is a big plus. You might need to wait a bit for the food, but that’s because the chef makes each piece fresh to order and sends it to you by a little train — such a fun and unique experience! 🚆
The sushi tastes great, fresh and high quality. The quality and price are comparable to well-known sushi restaurants.
Overall, a very enjoyable experience. Definitely worth trying if you’re in CTW.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tenz Photoz

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've walked past this place many times and wondered why there were so few people.
I saw a promotion and decided to try it. I think it's still far inferior to nearby restaurants. The sushi rice was hard, which I've never encountered before. It was dry and grainy, but not to the point of being tough. The sushi meat didn't match the picture at all; I even took a screenshot to compare. The other sushi items were average, nothing outstanding.
sample_reviews_en.author: SaturNight

sample_reviews_en.text: Forget all other conveyor belt sushi restaurants. This place is incredibly clean, pleasing to the eye and ear. The staff are very polite, calm, lovely, and courteous. The food is absolutely delicious. The salmon is amazing, the spicy dishes are intensely flavorful, the wasabi and pickled ginger are tasty, and the tomatoes in the salad are incredibly fresh. Everything is excellent. The scallops are fantastic. I will definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: min리

sample_reviews_en.text:
Genki Sushi is located on the 5th Level of Central World. Right near to the main escalator.

Large space and the conveyor belt (Shinkanzen Train Stlye) is a cool gimmick for delivering sushi to the customer's table.

Friendly service. Every pieces of sushi is freshly made by the chef himself. Super fair price compared with the quality given.

High recommend for sushi lovers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donny Boonyamanop

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an off-the-beaten-path sushi restaurant; it's quite private.
I've been there once before, and today I felt like going back because I don't like waiting. The fish was incredibly fresh and sweet, contrary to my expectations that the fish would be dry given the limited number of customers. Every dish was top-quality. It was really good! I'll definitely be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: kEnEmEyE

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located on the 5th floor of CentralWorld, the restaurant is clean and has a diverse menu.
Orders are processed by scanning a QR code.
Once you order, a train will deliver the food to your table.

There are tables for children, plenty of seating, and it's not crowded.
Kids will probably love it.

The atmosphere is cute.
Suitable for a family meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนิดา ธีระภิญโญ

restaurants.name: Orchid Café
restaurants.address:

250 Sukhumvit Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The location is super convenience, just next to Asok BTS and has a bridge to connect in between.

I'm having the lunch buffet in weekday, the regular price is 1,500 BAHT, I reserved via Eatigo and get a 30% discount.

The salad bar has many choices, above average. The seafood provided oyster, shrimp and mussel. The 🦪 is tiny size but very fresh, not very salty one. The 🦐 is extremely good, firm texture and very fresh.

The Japanese corner provide sashimi, sushi and tempura. The choices are limited but the quality is very good.

The hot plates are general, choices are also limited.

The best food is the roasted beef, very tender and juicy, I tasted 2 rounds unfortunately my stomach cannot afford more.

The foods are very good but the service is also renowned. All waiters/waitresses always keep smiling and I really enjoy to have meal in such comfortable atmosphere.

I will recommend this restaurant for the diner who are looking for quality food and services.
sample_reviews_en.author: Matthew Ngai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Funnow needs to reflect on its practices! I also booked through Funnow. The hotel is positioned as a business-oriented hotel. Hygiene, service, and taste were all fine, but its price point and target clientele seem primarily business travelers. For tourists relaxing in Bangkok, there are many other restaurants to choose from in Bangkok, even with Funnow's discounts (around 1300 baht per person including tax and service charge). Therefore, during peak hours, the restaurant wasn't very crowded. However, the restaurant's decor, atmosphere, dining environment, hygiene, service, and food quality were all very good. It's just that the food's value for money wasn't as high in comparison.

Booking restaurants directly through HungryHub in Bangkok is definitely far superior to Funnow.

When making a reservation, it's advisable to request a window seat in advance, as the natural light is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eric Perng

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went for the weekday dinner buffet. The food wasn't that extensive, so I recommend going on Saturday or Sunday. But for the price, it was a great deal. The ingredients were excellent, the seafood was fresh, and the sashimi was amazing. They didn't hold back on the food, and they kept refilling it. Everything was delicious. I was very impressed with the Indian food. The service was excellent, but the desserts were too sweet. I'd like to see some improvements. The ice cream was delicious.

New Year was very helpful. I mentioned in the booking app that I was coming for my anniversary, and they gave me a surprise cake. The cake was incredibly delicious! I loved it! They also offered a hot tea to finish the meal.

I'll definitely go back, but I'm deducting one star because the desserts were too sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanidapha Rattanachatchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I saw this buffet recommended by FunNow on Instagram, and since ordering through FunNow offered a discount, I booked a weekend seafood buffet for four people!

Upon arrival, the king crab legs were cut into tiny pieces (pitifully small), the grilled river prawns were skinny and small, the prawns were similarly small and the meat was loose, and the baked crayfish was limited to half a crayfish per person (the taste was incredibly mediocre). The only decent thing was the chilled white shrimp!

Drinks were limited to one cup of tea or coffee per person, and the variety of other food items was also limited!

At checkout, a service charge was added at the "original price," bringing the average cost per person to 1500 baht. It didn't seem worth the trip!
sample_reviews_en.author: 王筱玲

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a wonderful experience! The staff provided excellent service—they were friendly, attentive, and made me feel very welcome throughout my visit. The food was absolutely delicious, with great flavor and presentation. Everything exceeded my expectations, and I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for both outstanding service and amazing food.

It was a wonderful birthday dinner! The atmosphere was perfect for celebrating, the staff were incredibly kind and attentive, and the food was absolutely delicious. Everything came together to make the evening feel truly special and memorable. I couldn’t have asked for a better birthday experience.

Thank you .
sample_reviews_en.author: นายพงศกร อดุลพิทยาภรณ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
My first all 5 star review ☺️
I loved it here, the food is SUPER fresh and tastes so good with so many options!
You have Asian, Western, Thai etc. with meat and seafood options for days!
The lamb chop of your choice, fresh off the grill was the highlight and let’s not forget the mango sticky rice. The fruit was so sweet I wish I had more space.
Honestly, this would 100% be my last meal.
Thank you for the amazing experience!
Last note: My pictures do not do it justice, I was so busy eating, I went to take the videos really late 😅
sample_reviews_en.author: Jee Moon

sample_reviews_en.text: We had a chef for table for 2. All the staff are very friendly and provided a great services.  attentive. When I called to book they offer me a nice spot by the window. The course was included with appetizer, soup, pasta, main and dessert. All are served in a good size that ugly won't feel over intake. The Hotel is located near the Asoke bts station and Sukhumvit Mrt station. there is a connecting bridge from the sky train walk. The buffet will be on Thursday to Sunday but monday to wednesday is a la carte or chef to the table.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pharuewisa P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
✨ International Buffet at a Luxurious Hotel ✨

The buffet came with a wide selection—from seafood to Thai classics. The oysters were fresh and delicious, truly the highlight 🦪. Tiger prawns were flavorful and the noodle dishes quite good. Some of the Thai food tasted a bit too sweet for my liking, and the cold shrimp wasn’t very fresh.

Service was quick, attentive, and professional, which made the dining experience pleasant overall. A buffet worth visiting for the oysters, prawns, and warm service. 🌟
sample_reviews_en.author: SURASAK “Bill” ABE

restaurants.name: MK restaurant (SiPH)
restaurants.address:

2 Wat Sutthawat, Siriraj, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A great place to eat in a hospital. One of the best things about it is the price. Even though it is more expensive than the food court (which I found lacking in atmosphere), MK is very reasonably priced considering the quality of the food and the pleasant dining environment.

The airflow was excellent, and the seating was well spaced, so it never felt overcrowded (you do not want other patients coughing near your food, right?).

I had the dry green noodles with roasted duck and the shrimp shumai.

The food was tasty, the service was good, and the overall atmosphere made for a comfortable dining experience while visiting the hospital.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukawan R.

sample_reviews_en.text:
MK restaurant in Siriraj Piyamaharaj Hospital is located on the 2nd floor in the food court area (this area also donates all profits to the hospital).
Inside, there are plenty of tables, both for 1-2 people and for groups. The service staff is excellent. Even at 5 PM, they still provided full service.

The food came out quickly, and the taste is up to MK's standard. I tried the new menu item, the dry sukiyaki set for 199 baht. They let you stir-fry it at your table (but honestly, I recommend having them stir-fry it for you so there won't be so much smoke). It's actually delicious, and one serving is enough for one person.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tang Raksat

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered food and mentioned I have a seafood allergy.
I ordered BBQ pork noodles.

However, they brought me BBQ pork noodles that were already boiled and served with shrimp dumplings. I don't know if there was a mistake in my order or what.

A little while later, they brought another bowl, saying it was a separate bowl of noodles,
not including the shrimp.

I was confused because I'm allergic to shrimp, so why bring the first bowl in the first place?

In the end, I had to take allergy medication and monitor my symptoms.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชยุตพล สุขแก้ว (Artnerd)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and meets high standards. The place is clean, and the staff provides good service. While waiting outside, someone brought me a menu so I could order beforehand, as the staff were preparing a table inside for me.

This branch is easily accessible for wheelchair users.

Many tables have touch-screen ordering systems; you can simply press to order. Some tables don't have screens and require ordering from a staff member.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tote Varisorn

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was standard. Today, the crispy pork was delicious; the skin was crispy and not too fatty. However, the sago pudding with longan and coconut milk sundae was disappointing. The sago seemed like it had been left out for a very long time; it was lumpy, rough, very soggy, and a little too sweet. The hot crispy rice crackers were okay, but the portion looked small (the picture doesn't show the exact amount).
sample_reviews_en.author: yelly leknamongkol

sample_reviews_en.text: Two staffs were using their bare hands to hold the mop and were mopping the floor. When the food arrived, they picked up the food from the robot and served it to the table without cleaning their hands first. The food was dumpling soup and duck sauce (spilt on the staffs' fingers). I think that picking up the bowls of food like this is very unprofessional. The other staffs were working normally.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffrey Klom

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered one duck, but they only gave me one packet of sauce and no dipping sauce.
Even the dipping sauce wasn't provided. And this was handled by a store manager!
They should check the items for customers before serving them.
Any mistakes should be corrected and improved immediately.
Other branches aren't so stingy with their ingredients.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mon Mongkol

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a meeting on my iPad and forgot my headphones. I needed to keep the speaker volume low so as not to disturb others, so I asked for a table far away from the crowd, on the opposite side of the street.
But the staff said they didn't have the service available.
Okay, I'll eat at another restaurant then.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thara Sitaphong

restaurants.name: โอซากะ26
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 32 Lat Phrao 26 Alley, Khwaeng Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Centrally located in Soi Ladprao 26, with parking for over 10 cars. There's indoor and outdoor seating, beautifully decorated. The food looks great and is perfect for photos 😂 and tastes delicious.
BUT!!!! The prices are surprisingly affordable, so cheap I'm amazed!
I wonder if the owner is trying to profit from this?
Just kidding! Don't raise the prices yet 😁 I've lived in this area for so long but only just discovered this place. I'll definitely be back often. I'm very impressed. Thank you for being such a gem in this neighborhood!
sample_reviews_en.author: Charinda Changpheak

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Japanese restaurant in the Lat Phrao area with a great atmosphere, spacious and comfortable seating, and convenient parking. The menu offers a wide variety of dishes and reasonable prices.

Many dishes are delicious, and the draft beer is generously served. Drinkers will love it! The ice cream is also delicious, making it a great way to end a meal.

The only complaint is that the food is served a bit slowly, but overall, it's okay. Perfect for a relaxing meal with friends or family. 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Panggg S.

sample_reviews_en.text: This Japanese restaurant has a relaxed and friendly atmosphere, perfect for a casual meal with friends or family. The food is delicious and reasonably priced, allowing you to order a variety of dishes without feeling overpriced. The yakitori and karaage are particularly tasty and enjoyable. What I especially loved was their green tea; it has a beautiful green color, a lovely aroma, and a perfectly balanced, rich flavor that's refreshing and pairs well with all the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boomfio

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered a steak. The menu picture showed a steak with side vegetables.

What was actually served was stir-fried vegetables topped with the steak. It was like eating stir-fried vegetables with meat.

When ordering, the waiter asked how I wanted my steak cooked. I asked politely, and replied Medium.

It came out well done. I think the chef probably didn't know how to properly cook it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aom AoM

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today, I ate with nine old Triam Udom Suksa friends. Everyone loved the food, the price, the quality of the ingredients, and the atmosphere, which made me feel like I was in Japan eating at a local restaurant.
The waitresses were lovely and took great care of me.
My friends said they'd bring their families back to eat here again. 😋😋
sample_reviews_en.author: pornsak Leaderplus

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food and great atmosphere. There's both indoor and outdoor seating. I personally sat inside and ordered hot udon noodles and some satisfyingly firm sushi rolls – pure bliss! And you absolutely can't miss the "Japanese pizza" – it's incredibly delicious! Plus, it's conveniently located near Lat Phrao MRT station. 📍
sample_reviews_en.author: kukkik thitirat

sample_reviews_en.text: Very annoying, this place doesn't have a normal schedule. Sometimes it is open, sometimes it is closed, you never know. Staff doesn't speak English, so you have to explain with the translator. Food is okay prices are cheap. But I was enraged today when twice I went there and the place was just closed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasha Romanova

sample_reviews_en.text:
The green tea was too sweet and didn't taste like green tea at all. I'd recommend ordering water instead.

The hot pot was okay, but the pork was very tough.

The curry rice: the curry itself was okay, but the rice was hard and bland. It would be better if it were served warm and fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shared drive

restaurants.name: 粤港澳大湾区会所酒家 HengShun Restaurant
restaurants.address:

34/5 Thiam Ruam Mit Rd, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Chinese food here is diverse.
The steamed abalone with garlic is absolutely delicious, better than anywhere I've ever had it.
The char siu pork and crispy pork are very tasty.
The roast goose was a bit too salty.
The jellyfish salad was flavorful.
The Buddha Jumps Over the Wall dish had good ingredients, but overall lacked aroma.
The Hong Kong-style fried noodles were tasty.
The char siu pork buns were well-fried.
Hot tea is reasonably priced and they keep it warm while you dine.

Parking is available in front of the restaurant, but there aren't many spaces. Most of the customers are Chinese.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nora Tap

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is flavorful and delicious. The roast goose is good with crispy skin, but the crispy pork skin wasn't as crispy as it could be, like it was reheated in a microwave, making it chewy.

The mala chicken stir-fry, jellyfish salad, and steamed scallops with garlic were all tasty. Overall, the food was delicious.

The portions are quite large. There's free parking in front of the restaurant, so you don't have to park on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: S Chan

sample_reviews_en.text: After work today, I was incredibly hungry, so I stopped by a clean Chinese restaurant with excellent service. They even recommended promotions with a smile, which I really appreciated. After finishing my meal, I felt I made the right choice. The food was delicious, especially the roast duck, which was exceptionally good. If you're in the area, be sure to try this Chinese restaurant! I was very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aileen Wongpudee

sample_reviews_en.text: The mapo tofu tasted just like the one I had in Sichuan. The Hong Kong-style roast duck was also delicious, though a little too salty. It would have been even better if it were less salty. The xiao long bao (I didn't take a picture of the xiao long bao, only the dumplings) wasn't quite as good as the ones I've had at other great restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: hoegarden345

sample_reviews_en.text: I eat here regularly. They have a promotion going on right now, which is great value and the food is delicious. Their stir-fried vegetables are amazing; don't forget to order them whenever you come! Another dish I order regularly is the crab with spring onions; the crab is incredibly fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patchrawan Pajaree

sample_reviews_en.text:
The roast goose was terrible. It wasn't fresh, it was old. The skin was crispy, but the meat was tough, tasteless, and lacked spice and aroma.

The Hainanese chicken was tough but fresh and sweet, acceptable. The dipping sauce was a good match.
sample_reviews_en.author: Uncle Pooh

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious. I recommend the Hong Kong-style roast duck with crispy skin and juicy meat, and the stir-fried water spinach.
The restaurant's hot tea is kept warm on a stove at all times. The staff provides good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: juniper c

sample_reviews_en.text: 🇨🇳 They have a huge menu and I've been wanting to try this place for a while, but the taste wasn't very impressive. Only the xiao long bao and the goose were okay. The rest were mediocre, greasy, and bland.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bread Bkk

restaurants.name: Simple. Natural Kitchen
restaurants.address:

31 Soi Sawatdi, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
While I can only review the one dish I tried, I'm very impressed. Authentic sourdough bread, high-end coffee, a rustic but stylish interior, and a fantastic ambience (read as Music Tasteful and Not Too Loud, room temp neither stifling nor oppressively cold) all lend themselves to a pleasant experience.

The menu item I had was perfect for an American. We've heard of corned beef hash? This was literally corn hash (see pic). Well-conceived, well executed, albeit a bit digestively hard for a breakfast item. Nevertheless, it was done beautifully. The bell pepper sauce added a delightful punch of flavor once the corn had started to get a tad monotonous.

If I'd but one complaint (re: I'm guessing the owner), it was this. I arrived quite a bit earlier than opening time. I asked if I could have a coffee. Nothing doin'. I asked if I could have some water. No. That second one really bothered me. I walked to 7-Eleven and got a bottle and helped myself to an outdoor table while waiting for them to open. All's well that ends well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Carter Butler

sample_reviews_en.text:
100 points! This was my favorite meal of the entire Bangkok trip.

We ordered three dishes and a drink for two people.

Granny’s Pork Stew (served with creamy mashed potato and quinoa)
The pork was plentiful and very tender, and the potatoes were incredibly creamy.
The base flavor was tomato, with some stewed carrots.

It was a very healthy meal.
Oak’s Spaghetti with Chili and Bacon
This dish seemed to be a limited-time offer, available on a separate menu.
Delicious spaghetti! 🤣 It had garlic slices, which was great.
Tropical Açaí Bowl
I didn't really like the watermelon on top of the acai bowl; it was a bit too cold.

But overall, the portion was large, and the milkshake underneath was full of berry and banana flavor, so I still really liked it.
Ginger Bell
Even though I don't like ginger, I could handle it.

The staff were all friendly and welcoming.
There were plenty of seats, and the prices were reasonable. I would definitely go back! 💖
sample_reviews_en.author: Natalieee

sample_reviews_en.text:
I didn't get a picture of the shakshuka, and the breakfast menu is in the picture.
There aren't many reviews, but it's delicious. The baked beans made with canned chickpeas are also really good.
It looks like they made them themselves, and they're delicious.
The staff is friendly, the atmosphere is nice, and the price is reasonable.
And best of all, the portions are generous.
It's incredibly filling for brunch.
I ate until I was full.
When you're tired of Thai spices and want to soothe your stomach, and you feel like you can't have authentic Korean food, this is a great option for a familiar Western dish.
To all Koreans🇰🇷
I recommend it👍🏻❤🇹🇭
sample_reviews_en.author: Lena Y

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food, coffee and juices. Nice little hangout tucked away but it's rather overpriced. I ordered the Simple English breakfast which was delicious and I loved their take on the traditional baked beans with chickpeas BUT 1 sausage cut in half pretending to be 2 sausages seemed a bit naughty! Staff were wonderfully attentive and we had a nice rapport but I don't think I'd return in a hurry. Coffee ok but the only alternative milk they seemed to have was soy. Atmosphere was lacking somewhat and while I LOVE both the Bee gees and Stevie Wonder, the same two tracks of theirs were playing on repeat the whole time I was there 😆
sample_reviews_en.author: Nadya A

sample_reviews_en.text:
Landed at 5am, picked up the car and drove straight across the city to one of my favourite breakfast spots. Arrived right on the dot at 8am—just as they opened the doors! They serve fresh, healthy food and the coffee is strong and solid 💪🏽 . It’s now my husband’s favourite too 🍳 🥗

We had spinach & poached eggs benedict- it was sooo good! Normally I would go for Full English Breakfast but it’s kinda heavy and high in calories (so good though!)

P.s. It’s also pet friendly! People bring their dogs to join the breakfast!
sample_reviews_en.author: Caffè Doppio

sample_reviews_en.text:
Simple. Natural Kitchen is a fantastic place with very delicious food and a welcoming atmosphere. The service was friendly and attentive, making the whole visit smooth and enjoyable.

The stew was absolutely outstanding — full of flavor, perfectly cooked, and clearly prepared with care. One of the best dishes I’ve had in a while.

Great food, great service, and a relaxed vibe. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Max

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my go-to breakfast spot in Bangkok for the past four years.
The bacon frittata, shakshuka, and cold-pressed juice are truly delicious.
It's a quiet, relaxing place where you can unwind.
The waiter who serves you maintains a comfortable distance, providing just the right amount of service.
I also like the cheerful and positive atmosphere created by the kitchen staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: N S

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing breakfast spot! I've visited multiple times and always look forward to coming back. They offer a really unique menu with creative options you won’t easily find anywhere else in Bangkok. If you’re looking for something different and refreshing, this place is definitely worth a visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wr3nD

restaurants.name: Purple Laurel
restaurants.address:

Raynue zone, 4th Floor, 502 Gaysorn Amarin, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We chose this restaurant for family Mid-Autumn Festival place, and it was an absolutely amazing and unforgettable experience. I can say with confidence that this is the best and most beautiful Jiangnan-style restaurant I have found in Bangkok to date.

Its location on the 4th floor of the bustling Gaysorn Amarin plaza is very convenient, situated above the visually stunning LV concept store. The restaurant itself is a work of art, with exquisitely beautiful details in every corner.

But the food was the true highlight. Each dish was a perfect blend of nostalgia and surprise, somehow reminding me of the freshest, most authentic flavours I ate in my childhood, while still feeling new and exciting. It's rare to find a place that can capture that feeling so perfectly. And the food portion I can say very generous.

This was more than just a dinner; it was a journey. We will undoubtedly be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ke Yang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing Dining Experience!

Just visited Purple Laurel and had an absolutely wonderful experience!

From the moment we walked in, the staff was incredibly welcoming and attentive. The ambiance was cozy and stylish, making it a perfect spot for both casual dinners and special occasions.

The food was beyond delicious! Every dish we tried was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The portions were generous, and the ingredients tasted high-quality.

What really stood out was the excellent service. Our server was knowledgeable, friendly, and made great recommendations. They checked on us regularly without being intrusive, which made the dining experience even more enjoyable.

I highly recommend this chinese restaurant to anyone looking for a memorable meal.
Whether you're a local or just visiting Bangkok

this place is a must-try.
sample_reviews_en.author: di zhao

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a Chinese restaurant I had wanted to try for a long time, but unfortunately the experience was disappointing in several ways.

First, for a dinner meal there was no dim sum menu available. The staff told us to go to another branch at CentralWorld if we wanted dim sum, which was quite confusing and disappointing. When coming to a Chinese restaurant, dim sum is something I was really looking forward to.

Second, the food took a very long time to arrive. The staff explained that their system was down, which caused many mistakes — some dishes were not ordered properly and some were never served. What was more frustrating was that no one informed us about the missing dishes until we asked.

That said, the food itself was tasty, and the prices are high but the quality of the food is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nishaaa Isn.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a wonderful dining experience at Purple Laurel. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere felt elegant and refined—perfect for both business meetings and special family occasions.
The food was truly impressive. Every dish was beautifully presented and full of authentic flavor. What stood out even more was the attention to detail in the service. The waitress took the time to carefully explain each menu item, which made the experience feel thoughtful and personalized.
Overall, the combination of excellent food, a sophisticated ambiance, and top-notch service makes this a fine dining restaurant I would highly recommend. Definitely a great choice if you’re looking to impress clients or enjoy a memorable meal with loved
sample_reviews_en.author: prow vechasit

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the tasting menu and the food itself is Michelin-star worthy — the product and execution are seriously impressive.

The service is warm and genuine, but this is also where they are still just short of a star. Effort alone does not earn Michelin recognition. That final step needs tighter training and sharper consistency in the small details — from plate placement to menu explanation.

Trying makes you very good. Mastery earns the star. They are close.

Portions are generous (almost too generous) — we enjoyed it but could not finish everything. You will leave very full, even on the tasting menu.

Still, I will come back again and again and again. They are that good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Seow

sample_reviews_en.text:
A brand-new Chinese restaurant in town, specializing in authentic Shanghainese cuisine. The first thing that stuns you is the breathtaking décor—rich in cultural details and beautifully designed. The service is top-notch, from the moment you step in until the end of your meal.

The food? Absolutely outstanding. Every dish is freshly made to order—nothing frozen, and you can taste the difference. The Peking duck here is next level, hands down better than anywhere else in town. The red pork barbecue and fish in soup are must-tries—so incredibly good.

Make sure to book and order in advance, as they don’t keep much spare stock. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukhum Cheff Truengtrachitkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
I believe a star is coming soon 👍
This new Chinese Restaurant is a true gem in downtown Bangkok.
The staffs are well-trained and the level of service is at a fine-dining level of excellence.
The duck liver cherry is a must ordered appetizer, as well as the pork ribs, and the hot and sour soup.
The highlight today is the Peking Duck (2600 baht). The skin is thick but crunchy. The meat is soft and juicy. The sauce is unique with aromatics. This is the best duck so far in Bangkok food scene, thumbs up 👍
Overall, originality is 5 star, cooking techniques 4.5, flavors 4.5, service 5 stars !
I will be back !
sample_reviews_en.author: Tidbit Channel

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tried several dishes including Sliced Wagyu Beef with chilli, Boiled Squid with bean curd and celtuce in golden broth, Mixed Mushroom roll with rice paper, Deep-fried pork jowl with homemade chili vinegar sauce, and

the Crispy Pigeon — which was the absolute highlight and honestly the best in town. The skin was perfectly crispy, while the meat remained tender and juicy with no gamey smell at all.

Overall, the food quality and execution were excellent, showcasing refined flavors and premium ingredients. The only downside for me was the atmosphere — it felt slightly too warm inside during my visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: OakMealStory

restaurants.name: ทวีโชคหมูกะทะ สาขา22 พัทยา Taweechok Mookata Pattaya
restaurants.address:

WWM4+XXQ, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the 399 baht set, but the portion was very small. The set actually included cabbage, water spinach, and rice noodles. The thing is, I only eat water spinach, so I specifically requested only water spinach. In the end, they only gave me water spinach. They didn't even give me the rice noodles, and they didn't replace the cabbage I didn't want with water spinach – they just didn't give me any at all. I only got a handful of water spinach. The food also took a very long time to cook, even though there weren't many people. I ate here the first time when they first opened, and the service was bad then. I came back hoping it would be better, but it was the same. Okay, no more third time here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthamon Yangtrakul

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate here when the restaurant first opened, and the food tasted much better,, and the service was excellent. Today was a very disappointing experience, and I won't be going back. They couldn't even answer my questions about the menu, and the quality of the food felt different from my first visit. We ordered the wrong vegetable set, and when we asked for it, they said they couldn't change it, even though the price was the same. We also asked for extra dipping sauce, and they told us to get it ourselves. I just feel like this isn't a buffet restaurant; the service should be better. (A message to the owner: the restaurant's app system is good, but customer service could be improved.)
sample_reviews_en.author: สุทธิพงษ์ ศรีเจริญ

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices on the menu are on the higher side, but I must say the ingredients are truly high quality. We loved all the pork dishes; they were so tender and delicious. The dipping sauces were also tasty, especially with added chili, lime, and garlic. However, the main issue I'd like to see improved is the staff. On our first visit, no one greeted us, and we waited at our table for a very long time without anyone coming to explain how to order or what to do. We had to go and ask ourselves, which was quite disappointing. I hope the restaurant will address this point. 💗
sample_reviews_en.author: Mila K.

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant looks clean and tidy, plays pleasant international music, and the food looks hygienic. There are three types of dipping sauces to choose from, but there's an extra charge for seafood or other sauces.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suratchada C

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is great. I like that there's live music.
The service is good. I've eaten at the Bang Saen branch before. This time I ate at the Pattaya branch. The BBQ pork is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: varunya nongrukprasert

sample_reviews_en.text: I went when it was extremely hot, but they even blocked the sun with a parasol – such thoughtfulness! 👍 The meat was delicious, and all the staff were friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: jin01

sample_reviews_en.text: The baked scallops with cheese were delicious, and the scallop dipping sauce was good. Apart from that, everything else was pretty standard.
sample_reviews_en.author: Deathz Kittie

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is beautiful, clean, the service is good, the food is delicious and high quality. I was very impressed with my first visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฏฐพิชา ชูชัยวัฒนศักดิ์

restaurants.name: Sara-Jane's
restaurants.address:

55, 21 Naradhiwas Rajanagarindra Rd, Khwaeng Yan Nawa, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was good/ok to our taste but the bad rating is because they over charged (or did not explicitly state outright) us for the panaang curry when they asked if we wanted beef, chicken or (?). By default it's with chicken, but by mentioning it without mentioning an added charge we thought it'd be a free swap. Turns out not. What should have been 160 baht turned into 250 baht (an extra 90 baht). The beef was also hard to chew, not tender at all. The salted crab stew was also on the salty side, although yes they had a respectable amount of crab. There is also a sneaky 10% service charge mentioned in the corner of a random page not shown on these menu page pictures. Many other bad mentions as the review here, slow service (the food took forever to come out, versus what other bangkok places can do), whether it be the drinks or all the dishes, and the ambience was very empty whether inside our out at 8pm. I would not recommend, there are plenty of better eateries around in Bangkok. Their saving grace for me was they accepted credit card here, but honestly the food was not worth the price here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michelle W

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sarah Jane's – to those unfamiliar with it, you might think it serves Western food, but it's actually a Western restaurant that sells Larb (Thai spicy minced meat salad). They have many delicious dishes. Their boat noodles are sold by the bowl during lunchtime, but only in hot pot sets for dinner (I only just found out this, so I missed out on that today because I came for dinner! haha). They also have a Moo Kata (Thai BBQ) set, but you have to eat it in the outdoor area. It was quite hot today, so I preferred to sit inside with the air conditioning. The grilled pork was delicious and had a wonderful smoky aroma. The Som Tum (Thai papaya salad) with crab was also tasty, with a nice, balanced spiciness. I finished with fried bananas and ice cream.

The restaurant is located in the heart of Sathorn, before the Empire State Building, with convenient parking. The staff provided good service. Next time, I'd like to try the Moo Kata.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warinmas K

sample_reviews_en.text:
Super Cute Romantical Situation - We’ve walked by this place a few times and it looked like a restaurant in a parking lot, however one evening we walked by and the lights were on in the outdoor restaurant and It looked really cute so we decided to check it out.

We ordered-

Dinner:
Panang Curry
Chicken Larb
Isaan Sausage
Fried Morning Glory
Seafood Salad

Dessert: Mango Sticky Rice

Drink: Coconut Water

Food came out hot, fresh and delicious w just the right amount of spice.

Definitely would visit again.
Good food, good service, nice ambiance, and a dope playlist while we enjoyed our meal. We sat in the outdoor restaurant so there were a few mosquito’s in the evening, but they provided mosquito spray at the table so we were able to deal.  Mosquito’s or nah, we’ll definitely be back.

For more travel tips and reviews, be sure to check out: @adventureswhileblack on FB, IG, and YT.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adventures While Black

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sara-Jane’s absolutely did NOT disappoint.  Based on one reviewer’s multitude of visits and dishes sampled, I figured this would be the best bet and thanks to him, I had one of the best meals of my week in Bangkok.

I had the papaya salad and the fried sea bass with herbs with rice and a beer and the total was 710baht ~$20.  Not super cheap, but worth the enormous portion and exquisite balance of flavors and an excellent, crispy entire sea bass.  In hindsight, for one person, I should have not gotten the papaya salad, as the herbs was a salad on its own and a lovely accompaniment to the fish and rice.

I was a little hesitant about sitting outside, but it was quite beautiful dining under the banyan trees and there are many fans they will move around to get the perfect breeze.  Otherwise, there is an indoor space with a/c which I didn’t realize at first.
sample_reviews_en.author: Elijah Davis

sample_reviews_en.text:
Both the noodle shop and the Sara restaurant allow dine-in at the same location.
This time, after having eaten at the noodle shop before, I asked the staff if I could sit in the air-conditioned section of the shop.
-The noodles use good, fresh ingredients.
-The Khao Soi (Northern Thai noodle soup) seemed to have shrimp paste in it. Was it tasty? It was okay.
-The papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce had a clean, refreshing taste.
-The Pad Thai was very disappointing. It was soggy and wet, unappetizing and not tasty at all. It was totally not worth the price.

Overall, the prices are quite high. The ingredients must be good, but the taste is just average.
sample_reviews_en.author: C Muthita

sample_reviews_en.text:
A place made for tourists.

The fruit juices that came had more ice that fruit. The coconut smoothie just tasted of milk. The person who made them used a spoon to taste them, then used the same spoon to scoop the juice out the blender.

The food was nothing great. Green curry was watery. Prawns were not fresh. Tom yum tasted instant. Only thing alright were the fried vegetables, and they were just fried vegetables.

Its understable that this place is almost empty at lunch time. Marriott, please stop recommending people this restaurant when any other one in the vicinity will probably be better since this is Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ivan Teo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited on friday night at 9pm.
Ample of seats,resturant was half occupied.
Ordered papaya with dried shrimp somtum, stir fried noodle with shrimp, and grilled chicken 150B portion.
Somtum was decent, nice sauce, appetising. Stir fried noodle were decent, chewy noodles and came with 4-5 shrimp.
Grilled chicken was very disappointing, especially since its one of their signature. It was served at room temperature. Meat was dry and hard, and I'm not sure if it was because it's the chicken breast part. There's not much flavour on its own. I need to dip into chilli sauce for flavour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Z H

sample_reviews_en.text:
A huge thank you to Sarah Jane’s restaurant in Bangkok ❤️

We had an absolutely wonderful time. The owner is incredibly kind, attentive, and warm, which made the experience even more special. The staff is remarkably professional: welcoming, smiling, and very attentive.

The dishes were delicious, perfectly prepared, and full of flavor.

And a very special thank you for accepting my husband's rather unusual request: to take the tablecloth home as a souvenir of our visit 😄 A lovely gesture that will remain a beautiful memory of our time there.

We highly recommend this restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Say “Sjay” Jay

restaurants.name: Baan Sapaitai
restaurants.address:

89 Soi Phahonyothin 3, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: In my personal opinion, the ingredients are pretty good, but the taste is just average. Not bad, but not amazing. It didn't leave me speechless like I expected. The "pretend shrimp" was delicious, and the fern salad was okay. Everything else was just average. I'll come back to try other dishes. The restaurant atmosphere is nice, airy, and comfortable. Parking is free for 2 hours if you get your parking ticket stamped, otherwise it's 50 baht per hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bhorn

sample_reviews_en.text: Very large menu, hip and clean space with a pretty good vibe. There is only one dish with tofu, but I’m not sure if it actually had tofu in it but it did have young coconut, set in a curry that was so spicy most of us couldn’t eat much of it. The chicken and taro fritters were amazing. We ordered a desert but never got it.  Food comes quickly but the check does not.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gaya B

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered Pad Thai for 300++ baht, and it didn't even come with any side vegetables.
The fried rice with dried fish innards was 200++ baht; it only had the chili paste, no fish innards ingredients at all. Not worth the price. Terrible experience. The taste was mediocre. One time is enough. A waste of money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rungtawan Riankohpor

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! My boyfriend really liked the coconut milk soup with Melientha suavis and fresh shrimp. I usually don't like it, but this restaurant's version was so good I ate several spoonfuls. The spicy salad was also delicious, and the desserts were amazing. Please maintain the quality!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratravee Viphakorn

sample_reviews_en.text: The shrimp was tasteless, the glass noodles were cloyingly salty, and the broad beans had a crunchy, sour taste. One of the servers was rude, cold, and completely unresponsive. The 10% service charge plus 7% tax made the total price too high. I felt uncomfortable with the service charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: li xu

sample_reviews_en.text:
I loved the food here and the ambiance is nice but the service is surprisingly cold. Had it been very busy I would have understood the brash attitude but it was quite empty when I dined here.

But, I recommend the food and drinks here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Varsam Kurnia

sample_reviews_en.text: We just arrived today, August 13 at around 7:45 PM, and were told they don’t accept cards, which was not mentioned anywhere beforehand. Since we didn’t have enough cash, they refused to serve us. Very disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naoufal MB

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a unique menu, and the food tastes delicious, with a Southern Thai flavor. The fried pork patties were tasty, but the chocolate cake was extremely sweet. It looked cute, but the taste was awful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Luijee Lee

restaurants.name: Ahmad Rosdee & Krua Thai
restaurants.address:

27 Rama IX Rd, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered through the LINE MAN app and paid via QR code at 1:18 PM. The app didn't show a rider accepting the order, and it displayed a "delayed" message. At 2:43 PM, I called the restaurant, and they said the order had been ready for a long time. Their tone was very aggressive. They asked if a rider had accepted the order and also said there weren't many LINE MAN riders in the area. A short while later, a rider accepted the order. I called the rider, and they said the order had just arrived and was extremely delayed. I wouldn't mind if they waited for the food to be ready and then forgot to confirm the order, but instead, they're telling the customer to check it themselves.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jigkobangkok

sample_reviews_en.text: I thought only the mango sticky rice was amazing, but everything else is delicious too! The curry noodles are rich and the meat is tender, but I highly recommend the salted beef fried rice – it's fragrant and the beef is soft. All the beef dishes have tender beef. Parking is convenient behind the restaurant. The prices are moderate, but the food is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: ลอยชาย เเชลเเนล

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken biryani with soup is delicious. I've been eating here since it was just a roadside stall, not as spacious, clean, air-conditioned, and organized as it is now. The taste is still exactly the same. The staff provides good service. I'll definitely go back if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Minky Somtong

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant was busy, but the service was fast. The biryani rice portion was generous and the rice was soft. The beef soup with onions and tomatoes was undercooked/not tender enough, and had a very sour taste. The mataba (stuffed flatbread) had a thick filling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuna Zarena

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and great value for money, using top-grade ingredients. The place is great, with comfortable air conditioning and convenient parking. My favorite dishes that I order regularly are mango sticky rice and Malaysian-style noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิมล น้อยจาด

sample_reviews_en.text: Went today but had a bad experience stopping by. We ordered the same food (3 of us) - all 3 were single dishes. But the first 2 got our food, and the third waited almost half an hour and still hadn't arrived. So I called a Burmese-looking …
sample_reviews_en.author: ประวิทย์ ศักดิ์นิรันดร

sample_reviews_en.text: A loyal customer for 20 years whenever I'm in Bangkok. The food is consistently excellent and reasonably priced. The chicken biryani and oxtail soup (caution - spicy!!🌶️) are absolute must-haves—as delicious now as they were decades ago. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Zaiful Zarim

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been a customer of this restaurant for a long time. I usually eat in, but today I happened to be passing by and stopped to buy chicken biryani and goat biryani to take home. I just asked if they offered soup to take home, and the …
sample_reviews_en.author: PP. V

restaurants.name: Beef Ball Noodles
restaurants.address:

Phetchaburi 47 Alley, Lane 9, Bang Kapi, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was decent, but the service — especially the order management — was very poor. I waited over 20 minutes for my second order, yet at least five tables that arrived later were served before me.

When I got tired of waiting and decided to pay instead, the staff who took my order even asked if I had received it, even though they had been standing there the whole time. I told them to cancel it, and they just informed the kitchen without showing any concern. The owner didn’t seem to care either, just acknowledged the cancellation.

It was quite frustrating, especially since I had been sitting there waiting for a long time. It made me wonder if the restaurant doesn’t treat solo customers well, as I wasn’t even able to place a second order properly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Trophy Lin

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered dry noodle soup… Look at this! So much liquid!
(If they're going to claim it's water from the bean sprouts… honestly, after selling for so long, they should know better – they should pack it separately for customers. Packing it separately would only cost a little extra for the plastic bag, which is reasonable considering the cost of the food.)

I paid over 800 baht today. We're not new customers; we've been eating here since they first opened. But this is too bad.

(Oh, and when I ordered, the owner was also rude and seemed unwilling to answer questions.) This needs improvement. I'm buying, not asking for free food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ray T

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is located in an alley between the buildings of Bangkok Hospital. It was almost closing time, so only rice noodles were left. While waiting for my food, I walked around and browsed the many snacks displayed in front of the shop. The rice noodles were perfectly cooked, and the pork meatballs were delicious and tender. I also asked for soup, and the broth wasn't sweet. I appreciated the cleanliness of the shop; since I arrived near closing time, I saw the staff clearing the tables and cleaning all the utensils, including the condiment trays, chopstick boxes, and spoons. My food arrived quickly and was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: N. W.

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped by a noodle shop near Bangkok Hospital Research Center and ordered a dry rice vermicelli noodle soup with mixed meatballs, fresh beef, and braised beef. I also ordered a bowl of boiled meatballs. The flavor is light and refreshing, like Chinese broth, not very strong. If you want a stronger flavor, you'll need to add more seasoning, but if you like light broth, you can finish the whole bowl. Overall, it's okay. If you want to try bouncy Chinese-style meatballs, this is a good option.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siva Chaivichitmalakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hygienic, just like the name suggests. The place is clean and the clear soup noodles taste light and fresh. I especially like the finely ground chili powder, similar to the style used in Japanese cuisine.

Today I ordered fresh beef noodles, one dry and one with soup. The beef was tender and cooked just right. The meatballs were okay—not particularly amazing, but still good.

Overall, it’s a pass. Motorbikes can park in front of the shop. Not sure about car parking. 🚶‍♂️🍜
sample_reviews_en.author: Fhon Fufu

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant I've been eating at for a long time and still visit regularly. Their clear broth noodle soup with meatballs is delicious, the meatballs are excellent, and the grilled meatballs are fantastic. They also sell snacks in the shop. The prices are a little higher than typical noodle shops, but it's worth it. The restaurant has a decent number of tables. It's a bit hot inside as there's no air conditioning, but the tables and utensils are clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Go Go Cat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food is clean.
Service might be a bit slow and not always in order, as is typical for this type of restaurant. The staff are average, but the owner's family provides excellent service.
Parking may be limited; it's best to ask the parking attendant.

The highlight of the beef noodle soup is the clear broth.
Regular: 60 baht, Special: 75 baht
Grilled beef skewers (5 skewers): 70 baht
Meatballs (50 pieces): 150 baht
Available for dine-in or takeaway.
sample_reviews_en.author: TONGTA S

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place serves clear noodle soup with both pork and beef. The broth is clear and flavorful, and the stewed beef is fresh, fragrant, and has a good meaty texture.
The grilled meatballs with dipping sauce are delicious, but the flavor of both the pork and beef meatballs could be improved. The restaurant has a local, rustic atmosphere and is located in an alley next to Bangkok Hospital, opposite the plaza area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ae Hellojaae Natechanok

restaurants.name: Malabar Restaurant Pattaya
restaurants.address:

27, South Pattaya, 50-51 S Pattaya Rd, Pattaya City, Amphoe Bang Lamung, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Our family visited Thailand  for the very first time. We are living in California for 20 + years . We explored Bangkok & Pattaya. Our travel itinerary was arranged by Chris Travels. Special thanks for Prince from Chris travels & Malabar restaurant for making our travel journey very special and spectacular. Prince was very responsive to all our queries, response time was always immediate. We also had 2 lunch at their Malabar restaurant. They do serve delicious authentic Kerala food .
We really enjoyed the authentic food and hospitality from owner Babychan, who has lived here for the last 25 years
Thank you Prince  & Babychan from Chris Travels and Malabar  Restaurant Pattaya , you truly made our vacation memorable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saju Joseph

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a great experience at Malabar Restaurant Pattaya. The prices are a little on the higher side, but the food is absolutely delicious and worth trying. If you're looking for authentic Kerala traditional food in Pattaya, this is a great place to visit. They offer a good variety of food and beverages, including beer. The atmosphere is pleasant, and the quality of the food is excellent. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone craving genuine Kerala flavors. My only concern is that the prices are quite high, but overall it was a very enjoyable dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sabeesh Abraham

sample_reviews_en.text: We had 3 night stays in Pattaya. Everything served here was superb quality food. There is no artificial flavours. This food hits the right spot for the malayalis from central part of Kerala. Authentic homely taste of Cochin Kottayam style appam, kappa, idiyappam, fish, authentic ernakulam style sambar, thoran everything. The owner as well as the staff are really attendive and welcoming. Our tour program was atranged by them Chris tours. If we ever go back again, it will be our first choice for trips and food. Thank you for the lovely time.
sample_reviews_en.author: sreeradh kl

sample_reviews_en.text: Wonderful food !!! after a long time during my stay, i had a chance to have a good South indian meal & onion pakoda !!! Quality & ambience is awesome !!! The staffs, especially the two gentleman here who greet the customers & the way they show the hospitality is awesome !!! You can customise the spiciness here.....They ask you before starting with the food preparation !! Be sure to inform them (MEDIUM / HIGH SPICY) !!! FIRST HOTEL (outside INDIA) WHO GIVE THEIR CUSTOMERS "FREE WATER" & water bottles are an optional in this hotel !!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Purushothaman R

sample_reviews_en.text:
Vegetable dishes - OKAY

Indian rice - GOOD

Beef fry with coconut - AVOID
Too Hard & tough,
Need Dentist visit 🤕😊

Service by Nepali didi - EXCELLENT

Ambience - NICE

Prices - ACCEPTABLE

I'm a Bangkok resident,
In pattaya often,
May visit again to give another try with other dishes

Parking available at Wat (temple nearby)
20 baht/hr
sample_reviews_en.author: Bkk Seller

sample_reviews_en.text: Omg for a Keralite having Thai cuisine is very difficult ..May be for a day maximum…And if you are in Pattaya i think best restaurant to have Kerala dishes..Amazingly yummy and i felt taste was better than what you eat in Kerala …Tried beef ,chicken ,egg ,puttu ,porotta ,payar and all ..So delicious ,AUTHENTIC
sample_reviews_en.author: Dipin J

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the pleasure of dining at your restaurant recently and tried the Beef Kerala Style. It was exceptionally well-prepared, with authentic flavors and perfect seasoning. My sincere compliments to the chef and the entire team for maintaining such high standards of quality and taste..
sample_reviews_en.author: ajmal azeez

sample_reviews_en.text:
First I ordered tandoori chicken. They served it all burnt. I thought mistakes happen hence scarped the burnt portions and ate.
Next ordered egg appam, I was burnt too hence I asked the boy who served me to …
sample_reviews_en.author: Raja Chidhambaram

restaurants.name: Pipula! Bangkok
restaurants.address:

50/2 N Sathon Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the Spaghetti Bacon Aglio Olio, which was described as having crispy bacon, garlic, chili, basil oil, parmesan cheese, and parsley. I don’t mind paying the price — what concerns me is the quality of what I received.

Honestly, if I had seen the actual presentation of this dish beforehand, I would have reconsidered my order. The portion and appearance look very simple for the price charged, and the taste was quite ordinary — nothing that stood out or felt worth the premium.

I’d like to kindly suggest that the restaurant and chef pay closer attention to the quality and details of the dish so that it truly matches the price customers are paying.
sample_reviews_en.author: Parada Chansree

sample_reviews_en.text:
The prices don't match the portion sizes and taste at all. The portions are small, and the taste is mediocre, not exactly delicious.
Caesar salad (450 baht): just over ten leaves of lettuce and some bacon scraps. The dressing lacked aroma.
Mushroom spaghetti (690 baht): no truffle flavor at all.
Tough pork ribs (690 baht):
Total bill for this meal: 2,200 baht. A huge waste of money.
I tried this place because I wanted to try a new restaurant in the area, but I wouldn't recommend it. There are many other restaurants in the Sathorn area that are tastier and more reasonably priced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tippawan Larppichet

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were the only ones in the room, and even then it took them more than 20 minutes to serve basic breakfasts.
They assured us that the juices were natural, but when confronted with the evidence that they weren't, they replied that the package said it was 100% natural…
sample_reviews_en.author: Jose Rodrigues

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was tasty, up to standard, nothing amazing, but the price was very high compared to the portion size. The food service was quite slow despite there only being two tables of customers. The servers were attentive but seemed confused. I probably wouldn't return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalida Nakornchai

sample_reviews_en.text: this whole place felt like sitting on a drama set. it doesnt even have a proper reception. totally not worth the price. ordered oysters but they told me they were sold out after serving the first dish. I was so disappointed and all the food …
sample_reviews_en.author: SUPISARA K.

sample_reviews_en.text: It was quite expensive, and the food wasn't tasty, nothing was hot, and it took a very, very long time to prepare. The first time, the salmon and asparagus were undercooked, but they made a new batch for me right away, which I appreciate.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rattanagone Ngampairojpibul

sample_reviews_en.text: A lovely cafe in the heart of Sathorn. The place is beautiful, the atmosphere is great, and the staff provides excellent service 👏. There's parking available. The food is decent, but perhaps a little overpriced; the portions aren't very …
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanaporn K.

sample_reviews_en.text: Went there in a hot Friday afternoon for some all day breakfast... We tried their eggs Ben, salmon guac, egg truffle... Which did not dissapoint... Overall a good experience👌
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Poh Tiu

restaurants.name: Mana Mana まな まな (มานะ มานะ)
restaurants.address:

ซอย สุขุมวิท 75/1 Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Mana Mana (มานะ มานะ) is a fantastic little Izakaya-style gem that delivers great food in a cozy, welcoming atmosphere. The absolute highlight of the meal was the Black Chin Tilapia tempura, which was perfectly fried, light, and incredibly tasty. We also tried the Thai sashimi, which was surprisingly good, fresh, and well-prepared. If you are looking for a small, casual spot with solid food and a relaxed vibe to unwind, this place is definitely worth a visit.
sample_reviews_th.author: Ben C

sample_reviews_en.text: A hidden gem in On Nut. The food is delicious, high-quality, and affordably priced. It has an Izakaya vibe, perfect for after-work gatherings. Many Japanese customers frequent the place. The staff, especially Nok, has excellent service and a genuine care for customers. There might be some mosquitoes at night due to the surrounding trees. It's a great place for a relaxed after-work party. Highly recommended! ✌🏻🐠
sample_reviews_en.author: Phornpreeya T

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is great 🥃 The owner is super kind, and the umeshu is absolutely delicious – so enjoyable to drink!

My friends loved it. It's easy to get to and there's plenty of parking 🚗
All the food on the menu is delicious, with a huge variety to choose from. No waiting time, comfortable seating, and clean restrooms.

From Aeyom and Boss 😆
sample_reviews_en.author: Kulnida Tuesakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes great, with authentic Japanese flavors. The sushi is very fresh. We ordered grilled mackerel, grilled scallops with butter and soy sauce, clam soup, salmon sashimi, and engawa sushi. The ingredients were very fresh and delicious. Parking is convenient right at On Nut Market, accessible from both Sukhumvit 75/1 and On Nut Soi 1.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaiwalit Phien

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere and beautiful decor, reminiscent of an izakaya. It's worth a try. The prices and food taste are well-matched. There's plenty of parking, although you might have to circle around a bit to find it. The focus is on appetizers; the main dishes aren't particularly outstanding, but there's a ton of snacks!
sample_reviews_en.author: Warid Petprasit

sample_reviews_en.text: All the food was delicious, especially the chicken dishes and the soups. The staff provided good service, and the atmosphere was cozy. It was quite crowded and noisy when I went, but still manageable to have a conversation. I'll definitely come back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: neon minatozaki

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is perfect for chilling and having drinks with friends.
The food is delicious, and they have many daily specials that aren't on the menu.
The staff are lovely and friendly.
They're very attentive to customers. I'll definitely be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: นิศารัตน์ คิดเข่ม

sample_reviews_en.text: The reason I deducted two stars from the food is that the oden is too salty; even for Japanese oden, it is too salty. The grilled shishamo had a very strong fishy and oily smell. The atmosphere was really nice, and the ginkgo nuts were delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: kc

sample_reviews_th.text: I recently visited ฉ่ำ Charm Bar & Bistro and was quite disappointed with the experience. The ambiance was far from what I expected. Instead of a warm and cozy atmosphere, the bar was filled with a large group of waiter's friends who were …
sample_reviews_th.author: Anakin Sky Driver

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Huge selection of beers, every glass is top quality.
- Excellent service from the staff.
- The minced beef with basil is delicious if it's fried a little drier like before (personal preference).

The pork ribs are juicy and highly recommended. They're truly juicy! 🤩
sample_reviews_en.author: Santiparp Kothan

sample_reviews_en.text: Cozy style pub&resturant. Good for meeting/Hangout. Very good price compaired to other resturant of the same categories around the area. easy to travel, just 700 metres from bts. This place is a must. As a local drinker, I Highly Recommened this place to you!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Falan Jaiklangduk

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s a small craft beer bar that had a lively crowd. There are 14 kinds of tap beers, and you can taste them before choosing. Most are Thai craft beers, and a glass (350 ml) costs around 170–180 baht. The atmosphere was comfortable and pleasant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gourmet Advisor

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my favorite bar ever. I love drink and foods here and also really chilling. The owner super nice and warm take care plus responsibility with any problems and take all the actions. The best !! You got me ♥️
sample_reviews_en.author: Snow Pixiez

sample_reviews_en.text: Multitap bar with nice food and locar beers. Good selection of beers and ciders o tap. You can taste the beer before buying. Fod is good, the fried rice with beef tongue was excelent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Szymon Golen (Zwiedzamy i zjadamy)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Restaurant and craft beer.
Today I picked number 1, Deschutes Fresh Squeeze.
Delicious, unique, can't remember the name of the beer, haha!
Good beer, lovely price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thawat Srimahachota

sample_reviews_en.text: This bar is so cute, the food is really good and the price is cheaper than we expected. If travel to Thailand, we hope can have another oppurtunity to come back
sample_reviews_en.author: Nguyễn Thanh Trúc

restaurants.name: FRIEND’S COFFEE & LOUNGE
restaurants.address:

26 Thanon Klan Tan, Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I got this apple mousse cake for 230 baht. For the appearance and the taste, I think 230 baht is worth it. There’s also no extra tax 7% or 10% service charge when eating at the cafe.

The staff is polite. My only complain would be that the cafe decoration inside is too….lackluster? The seats feel a bit cheap…or maybe it’s the light design inside? I’m not sure, but I think I might just get a takeaway the next time I visit this place.

The apple mousse cake is nice, not too sweet! The chocolate(?) coating outside is very thin in a good way, showing good technique. The mousse inside feels like it contain a bit too much gelatin, but it’s understandable since it’s needed for the cake structure. The layers and crumbles inside taste good, and the frozen cranberries on the plate complement the dish well! However, I think there’s too much mousse cream inside compared to advertised photo, I think there should be more layers inside to balance flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Esther Leelaswatanakun

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were very impressed with the cakes at Friend's Coffee & Lounge. They were seriously delicious, not at all cloying, and we didn't feel guilty about eating them (because we shared one between two people, haha!). However, we did feel a little guilty about our wallets, as they start at 220 baht per slice. We couldn't afford to order more! Our hearts loved them, but our wallets were empty.
The hot chocolate was also excellent, with a rich, creamy texture and a unique nutty and oat flavor.
Note: The shop is quite small. There's one table for two and six bar stools. The bar stools are more suitable for petite, minimalists. As for us... sitting alone felt like we used four of them! 😆 If you're coming in a large group, you might need to check the seating schedule carefully.
sample_reviews_en.author: PPANGG

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really nice little café tucked away in Talat Noi, feels like a bit of a hidden spot you’d only find by walking around. The atmosphere is calm and minimal, with soft music in the background, which makes it easy to just sit and relax for a while.

The cakes are definitely the highlight, they look almost like small artworks and taste just as good. The coffee pairs really well with the desserts, everything feels carefully made and not rushed.

Staff are friendly and welcoming, and you can tell they put effort into making the whole experience feel personal.

Overall, a great spot if you’re in Chinatown and want something a bit more relaxed and aesthetic. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Sercan Çelik

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible. I was confused. I just ordered a yuzu coffee, but the staff didn't know what I was talking about and called someone else. Turns out, they couldn't make it. They were chatting on the phone, trying to add milk to an Americano even though I asked for less sugar. They had to call another person to make it, and this time it was even worse. They added way too much syrup, making it sweeter than before. A coffee for 130 baht, comparable to Starbucks. How dare they sell coffee like this to customers?
sample_reviews_en.author: Dee Dai

sample_reviews_en.text:
AIf you’re in the neighborhood, Friends Coffee and Lounge is an absolute must-visit. The staff are super friendly and make you feel right at home the moment you walk in.
​As for the treats? The creative cakes are a lot of fun—perfect for anyone who likes unique sweets. Every "tasty little morsel" I tried was spot on.
​The best part? You really can’t go wrong for about 200b. It’s fantastic value for the quality and the atmosphere you get. Definitely worth a pop-in if you're in the area!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rephvew De'eze

sample_reviews_en.text: Cakes that tastes as good as they look. Thoughtful in presentation and subtle in taste, Friend's has every right to claim that theirs are the first and only architectural cakes in the country. Coffee pairs well (we had the mocha and dirty). The interiors are clean and monochromatic, allowing us to focus on the stars: Friend's cakes. Service is top notch. Will definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jasper Cubes (nrdist)

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered two desserts. One was soft and very tasty, but the other was only half-defrosted, so its texture was completely ruined - it was firm and had chunks of ice in it. We even had to take it outside ourselves so it could melt a little in the sun near the road. Do not recommend this place if you want to dine in, but for the takeaway that’s a great place
sample_reviews_en.author: Annete

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I tried the MINI HEART.
Although the outside is a sweet pastel pink, inside is a combination of chocolate flavors with various textures.
You get the smooth taste of milk chocolate, chewy almond brownie, crunchy dark chocolate, and smooth chocolate mousse.
Alternating with the tart cranberries,
it's refreshing and delicious :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Amvs Tpk

restaurants.name: Come Pah
restaurants.address:

500 28 ซ อยู่เจริญ ดินแดง Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has an atmosphere that cherishes the home cooking of the northern region, and the first thing that impressed me was that it wasn't too touristy. The sweetness of the coconut and the use of herbs are subdued, and the spices are well-defined, so the more you eat, the more depth you feel. It's not flashy, but each dish feels like it retains the local food culture, and it's great to encounter flavors like this while traveling. I think it's perfect for people who are interested in northern Thai cuisine but don't like it too heavy, and it's great to be able to get a glimpse of the local atmosphere while in Bangkok. I would recommend this place to anyone who wants to deepen their travels through food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yusuke

sample_reviews_en.text: This small restaurant, from the outside, doesn't seem to have such a great vibe. The decor, music, and atmosphere are warm and inviting. The Northern Thai food is delicious and reasonably priced. However, the dishes containing makhaen (a type of spice) were a little too mild in flavor, perhaps because I ordered it less spicy. The dry-fried chicken khao soi was unique and surprisingly tasty. I especially loved the sweet vegetable curry with grilled fish; it was fragrant, refreshing, and delicious. I will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanlaya Wittayawerachai

sample_reviews_en.text: The Northern Thai food here is excellent, with authentic Northern Thai flavors, but with a modern twist. Every dish I tried was delicious, especially the duck hoong lao curry, khao soi (Northern Thai noodle soup), and jin som mok kai (fermented pork with egg). The atmosphere is warm and inviting, and the owner is very friendly, making you feel like you're eating at a friend's house. The prices are reasonable. If you want to try delicious Northern Thai food, I highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: นาย กาแฟ

sample_reviews_en.text:
**The menu has very limited options. If you don't like spicy food, you'll barely be able to eat anything at this restaurant. Compared to the price and portion size, it feels like it's not worth it.
*The service needs serious improvement. Customers take the order form to the front counter, but the staff only takes the form and tells the customer to put the menu back on a table inside the restaurant… If you want any service, you have to go to the front counter yourself to ask.**
sample_reviews_en.author: Linda Yeh

sample_reviews_en.text: I can’t even mention how many times I have been to this place. The whole area is so homely, its tucked away that I couldn’t even tell it was a restaurant at first because it straight up just looks like a home. The staff was really chill and she speaks english so no worries when I was ordering it. I highly recommend the kha phrao kao clearly but the other items on the menu is also worth a try. If you want to get delicious northen thai food, this is definitely the place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jojo

sample_reviews_en.text: I was staying at a hotel nearby, and since I heard they served Khao Soi, I decided to check it out. I ordered the chicken Khao Soi, but the soup was unbelievably lukewarm and cold, and perhaps because of that, the noodles had no chewiness. The taste wasn't bad, so it was a shame. I couldn't forget the Khao Soi I'd eaten at several places in Chiang Mai, so I jumped at the chance, but it was a bit of a disappointment.
sample_reviews_en.author: VWX

sample_reviews_en.text: I was looking for clear broth rice noodles, and every review on social media pointed me to this place. However, the flavor was a bit bland (it improved slightly after adding some dipping sauce). It was different from what I've had at the Thailand Travel Fair. But the northern Thai sausage was delicious. I haven't tried the other dishes yet. It's a small shop, but cozy inside. The staff are friendly and lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittithad Ekmongkolwiwat

sample_reviews_en.text: Expensive, too salty, not enough Sichuan peppercorns, very little added. The seller was grumpy and didn't say thank you. Water is expensive, 20 baht per bottle compared to the usual 10 baht. Rice (plain or sticky) is 15 baht, very small portions, not worth the price. The shop is not nicely decorated, and the prices are higher than a mall. The chili paste had a lot of pork fat. I had diarrhea the next morning.
sample_reviews_en.author: New Life New Normal

restaurants.name: Saladburi
restaurants.address:

670 52 Soi Trakun Suk, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If this cafe weren't located in a back alley far from the metro, but somewhere on Asoka, the prices would be three times higher, and there would never be a free table.

This is a rare format for Thailand, an inexpensive European cafe. The dishes are simple, tasty, and healthy in the best sense of the word. That is, not vegan, gluten-free, low-fat, overpriced sweetener-based options, but vegetable salads, creamy soups, and sandwiches. I like the sandwich builder idea: you can choose a protein filling (from tofu to pork) and sauce (there's a huge selection). It's a shame they only use white bread; I wish they had whole-grain options.
The smoothies and muffins are also delicious. New baked goods are constantly being added—brownies, oatmeal cookies, chiffon cakes. It's never boring.

And what's even more amazing is that they have some of the best coffee in Bangkok. If you love light roast coffee and a smooth flavor, be sure to try their cappuccino. For 60 baht, it's a real treat.

The cafe is tiny, primarily offering delivery, and the interior is lovingly designed.
The owners are super nice and speak English.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mila Azhnikova (БА ГД)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really want to give 5 stars, but I can't because the service. Staffs are swift but they haven't been trained to assist customers. As I order, the staff didn't told me that there is free water. I saw a couple with plastic bottle on the table. I try to reduce plastic use but I need water to take my medicine, so I ordered one. It was later in when one customer came to his table with free water in his hand that I knew about it. It's well-hidden after the coffee machine. You can't see it from where you order, eat and pay.
I suggest the restaurant to do more for the environment by suggesting an option for no-plastic bottle water.

They have one parking space for a car, not except credit card.
The food is excellent, fresh. the price is very friendly. Their coffee selection is up level but modest price. Cosy atmosphere, warm-hearted decorated, Love it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Felice S

sample_reviews_en.text:
