My appetite was piqued, so I ordered extra fried pork belly.
(The corn somtam is similar to Chiang Mai's Neng Muob Ong,
but somehow...I enjoyed it even more because the meat was so good.)

I had a full-on meat party all by myself from morning. As you enter the alley, there's a sign in Korean that says "Yam Lot Sap!"
sample_reviews_en.author: 박정은

sample_reviews_en.text:
For Yumsorn Saap restaurant, the food was incredibly delicious and impressive. It truly deserves a perfect score in the food category. The glass noodle salad was perfectly spicy, flavorful, and well-balanced. The fried and grilled dishes were also excellent. The garlic fried pork was perfectly seasoned, and the herb-fried dish was crispy and fragrant with lemongrass.

The service was good, with polite staff. As for the atmosphere, because the restaurant is quite small and compact, it can be lively and a little noisy during peak hours. However, if you're looking for delicious, high-quality food at an affordable price, it's definitely worth it and highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charinrat.N

sample_reviews_en.text:
A friend who has lived in Thailand for many years recommended this place to me, and ever since then, I always come back whenever I visit Bangkok.

It’s a local restaurant hidden in a small alley near Icon Siam and within walking distance. The family-style service is very friendly and welcoming, giving a truly local atmosphere.

I came back this time with my family, and everyone enjoyed the food. The flavors might be a little saltier and spicier than usual, but overall it was delicious and definitely worth trying. I’ll definitely be back on my next trips to Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nancy Nga

sample_reviews_en.text: Hidden into Charoennakorn soi 9, a family aircon restaurant with simple & clear menu (not a dozen of pages to read), serving high quality & small quantity Thai food portions at low price, perfect for keeping you fit & healthy. You sit next to the family watching TV and you are served in less than 5 minutes ! Surprisingly it’s kind of secret Korean hub 😂 because of hot pot as far as I read. My second lunch there, yummy, restful and familial place as to escape from buzzing Icon Siam nearby at best ratio quality/price. To become my canteen for sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ren’an

sample_reviews_en.text:
I absolutely love this restaurant! I've been eating here since my student days fifteen years ago; it's my go-to place. I had the chance to come back again and the food was amazing – every dish was delicious. The prices are good, the service is great, everyone is lovely, and the restaurant is clean.

I love every dish in the picture! I want to go back and eat there every day! Spicy instant noodle salad, sweet liver, spicy soup, papaya salad, grilled pork neck, lemongrass chicken, fried intestines, fried duck beaks...

💓💓💓💓💓💓
sample_reviews_en.author: Bigbeer'r

sample_reviews_en.text:
MUST TRY RESTAURANT. Get the lemon grass fried chicken. The fried lemon grass is a dish of its own. Never had it before and the fried lemon grass is amazing. Plus the sweet sour sauce is like McDonald’s but has a deeper flavor.

I also got the soup, pork neck, and papaya salad. All excellent choices.

The restaurant is located towards the end of the road. Even though the road narrows down to like a two person alley, keep going and you’ll see the place on your left. Well worth the trip!
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex

restaurants.name: มรกตสยาม หวานเย็นสูตรโบราณ สาขาสะพานพระราม5
restaurants.address:

31 7 Nakhon In Rd, Bang Phai, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
This is another great place for shaved ice! You can choose 5 toppings for ฿50.

The coconut milk is fragrant and not too sweet, and the toppings are good. Only the ginkgo nuts weren't quite as good.

The staff were nice.
sample_reviews_th.author: Being Journal

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd like you to reconsider the price. I eat here often and enjoy the taste, cleanliness, and many other features of this restaurant. However, I'm still confused about the pricing of the coconut milk and palm fruit. The last time I ordered just two items, the staff charged me 85 baht. Previous times, I've ordered five items and also charged me 85 baht. I understand that these two items are more expensive than the others, but the two and five items were exactly the same quantity: 5 coconuts and 4 palm fruit. Even though the glass is less than half full, if you order just the coconut milk and palm fruit, 85 baht is fine, but it shouldn't be the same quantity as ordering five items. It's a bit strange. Thank you for your kind words.
sample_reviews_en.author: Claire C

sample_reviews_en.text: This dessert shop in Nonthaburi has a huge variety of toppings to choose from. For 40 baht, you get 5 toppings. They offer various syrups including fresh coconut milk, palm sugar syrup, longan syrup, and a wonderfully fragrant fresh coconut milk infused with candle smoke. The longan syrup is perfectly sweet. They serve it with plenty of ice for a refreshing treat. They also have coconut ice cream, and you can add egg yolk or salted egg for a rich and delicious flavor. It's great value for money. The shop has seating and you can park on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jintawanee Somritbuppha (Jinta)

sample_reviews_en.text: 🍧 Cold desserts 🍨 Fresh coconut milk ice cream, hard-boiled eggs, salted eggs, with a variety of toppings to choose from, including fruits, palm fruit, cantaloupe, melon, jackfruit, and a variety of toppings to choose from, fresh coconut milk, soy milk is also available. 🚘 Early Sunday evening, it's easy to find parking on the side of the road. 🌝 There are rooftop seats to enjoy the breeze and the view (Rama 5 Road)
sample_reviews_en.author: Narumon V

sample_reviews_en.text: They only do Grab orders. I ordered and waited for a very long time, until finally I didn't want to eat and asked to cancel the order. The staff member was very rude. I'd never eaten there before and went to order at the counter. The staff member gestured with one hand for me to stop talking while I was ordering, without making eye contact, and just handed me a QR code and said, "Scan to order."
sample_reviews_en.author: apinyaiie

sample_reviews_en.text: The ingredients are of good quality, the ginkgo nuts are okay, the service is good, and the price is moderate, not expensive. It's a small shop but has plenty of seating, including a mezzanine level. It's a suitable option for a Thai dessert to finish off dinner. You can ask for more ice as it may evaporate quickly in the hot weather. Parking is available on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ben The Pathfinder

sample_reviews_en.text: The desserts are delicious and varied, with a choice of both the type of dessert and the syrup. However, I have a slight complaint about adding toppings. For example, if I added a scoop of ice cream, the shop served it separately, which didn't justify the price. Also, the staff's way of speaking wasn't very pleasant to understand, possibly because they were foreigners.
sample_reviews_en.author: numshouse ratchada

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. I stood waiting for ages, almost 20 minutes, and they didn't ask me anything. They asked if I wanted to eat here or take it home. I kept saying "eat here, eat here," and then told them to wait at their table and scan their order at the table. Why didn't they tell me this when I walked in? Why make me stand here and waste my time?
sample_reviews_en.author: chomphon '

restaurants.name: Blanc Eatery & Cafe
restaurants.address:

9, Socialpack Lifestyle Venue 9/1 1 ซอย ศรีนครินทร์ 5 Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I searched for a workspace near my house and decided to try this cafe for the first time. It's easy to get to. If you don't have a car, you can take the yellow MRT line and get off at Sri Kreetha station (Srinakarin Soi 5 side). Walk about 150 meters into the soi (not recommended if it's dark). If you're driving, you can park in the cafe's parking area.

The front area of ​​the cafe is decorated in white/gold/orange tones, giving it a sophisticated look. The staff at the counter are lovely and provide good service. For first-time visitors, they'll explain the terms and conditions of the working space (ordering via QR code with a minimum total order of 250 baht, available until closing time at 7 PM).

The indoor working space offers various seating options, is quiet and peaceful, has power outlets everywhere, a photocopier, and restrooms.

The food is beautifully presented and looks appetizing. The taste is average, but enjoyable. The prices might be a bit high. If you're looking for a workspace around Srinakarin-Bang Kapi area, I would recommend this place.
Note: There is also a ramp for wheelchair users.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanokorn Paopongpaiboon

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, I walked into the shop at 5:45 PM. The female employee scowled and said that the shop was already closed. So I replied, "Okay." I happened to see a sign in front of the shop that said '19.00'. Before I could finish my sentence, the employee immediately spoke up in a harsh voice, 'It's already closed.' Don't forget to correct the closing time on the sign in front of the shop and on Google. Most importantly, don't forget to correct the employee's behavior. Who would know that it's already closed when the white sign in front of the shop says 19.00, including on Google? I've been there many times, but let me tell you, this time was terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kawinthip Thojersin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The quality of the ingredients and mix with the skill of the chef. Make every dish delicious Pasta that seemed bland and greasy It's really delicious. The taste is just right. No wonder the restaurant was full of people even though the prices were quite high.
Pretty good, almost everything is delicious.
Premium set. Recommended beef brisket.
Don't miss out, the aromatic grilled meat with oily inserts is very heavy.

Crab is good
Oysters can be

good almost everything
except the pro who said except Seacon branch

Thanks to staff members for providing us a great delicious food to eat thanks to the manager too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jatin Gulati

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice place with pretty nice food. The seafood black noodles was really good. Sadly the chocolate fondue was out, but we tried the berry ice cream which was also nice. The decorations are pretty beautiful and nice, and staff is friendly. The price is also quite reasonable compared to lots of places with comparable taste. Overall, nice place and deserves a 5.
sample_reviews_en.author: zxtremedemon

sample_reviews_en.text: A nice place to work, eat, or simply relax. They have a cafe/restaurant at the front and the co-working space at the back. Plenty of rooms and seat types depending on your occasion. Both their coffee and food tastes great. Atmosphere is great. Ergonomic seats for working or private area to focus. Parking is available for around 10 cars on premise.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apiwat Narkhan

sample_reviews_en.text: I've wanted to try this place for a while. The exterior and interior are both soooo beautiful, refreshing with flowers but not oo much. The vibe is nice and calm, music not too loud, not too crowded even during lunch time. Staffs were friendly and supporting. And the food, I love them all. Especially the grilled cow's tongue on rice, splendid.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kevalin Saksiamkul AThR, STFC

sample_reviews_en.text: A posh cafe, restaurant, and coworking space featuring air-conditioning, time limited WiFi, power, toilet, and plenty of tables. A flat white or latte costs THB107 inclusive of tax and service charge. The air is very cool, and is welcome on a hot day. They take cash, and conditionally accept credit card for bills over THB500.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brad Smith

sample_reviews_en.text:
A cozy café with a relaxed atmosphere, offering a decent selection of food and a variety of drinks. It’s a halal spot by Company B.

Good quality ingredients at reasonable prices. The space is bright and airy with a clean white tone, and there’s also a co-working area inside.

Service is very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krittayot Chaowanapreecha

restaurants.name: Eat Me Bangkok
restaurants.address:

234 Samsen 2 Alley, Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
We were looking for peace and quiet and a lovely place, where we weren't pressured to buy anything.

Everything was perfect, no complaints.

ขอบคุณ
sample_reviews_th.author: Dylan Soares

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited this restaurant in February 2026. Because we arrived in the early evening, there were plenty of seats available.

We ordered chicken satay as a starter, followed by sweet and sour chicken and chicken cashew nut, both served with rice. The food arrived quickly, and the service was friendly. However, the sauce for the chicken cashew nut was far too runny and greasy; it had no consistency at all. It was the worst chicken cashew nut we've had on all our trips to Thailand. When we pointed out the excessively greasy consistency to the server, she simply smiled.

The sweet and sour chicken, on the other hand, was okay, but nothing special.

We wouldn't be returning to this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rainer

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had pad kha praw & duck green curry respectively. Both dishes were excellent. Though the name was a negative, we chose Eat Me because it was nearly empty when we walked past and the smiling woman standing in front was not pushy at all. She & her co-workers proved to be friendly & attentive. And whoever is doing the cooking is talented.
It added to our experience that the operators' friends, with small children in tow, dropped by a few times. It was nice to see these women and their restaurant are part of a happy community.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gordon Mitchell

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the steak breakfast. The eggs were ok good. The toast was pretty good. The steak was ok good. It was edible. I wasn’t expecting five star dining tender. The butter was completely frozen. I wasn’t able to spread butter on my toast. The orange juice was pretty good. The coffee was ok at best. 400 baht for this. I probably wouldn’t come back again. The puppy was awesome. 3/5 stars
Don’t expect much from this place. It is decent. I went when it was quiet in the morning.
sample_reviews_en.author: RYAN

sample_reviews_en.text: The very young and eager waitresses unfortunately couldn't compensate for the kitchen's shortcomings. Despite the requested spiciness, the papaya salad was rather average, and the grilled pork with rice had clearly never seen a grill. A shame, because the quality of the meat was quite poor. The satay skewers were decently prepared, but the accompanying sauce was utterly bland.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rainer Bierl

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything is perfect in this little restaurant. The staff is very attentive and incredibly kind. As for the food, you're guaranteed to enjoy it. We had the Stir Fry Yellow Curry and Stir Fry Ginger, and it was absolutely delicious. You should also try the Egg Fried Rice. Yum!
sample_reviews_en.author: Normand Despins

sample_reviews_en.text: Good food and a nice little spot. Great place to get away from the chaos of Khao San road. There is a cute little outdoor dinning spot and they are open pretty late. Came here twice with my boyfriend during our trip for some late night curry and beer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eliza Verwoert

sample_reviews_en.text: A nice little restaurant in a quiet side street. The staff is quick and friendly. The menu includes breakfast, set meals, many Thai dishes, and a few Western options. There are also plenty of vegetarian dishes. Our Black Pepper Shrimp (with …
sample_reviews_en.author: Andreas

restaurants.name: Brother Kum’s
restaurants.address:

85 หมู่ 4 Ratchaphruek Rd, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Brother Kum’s โรตีสายไหมเฮียก่ำ
Brother Kum’s is a well-known stop for roti sai mai that lives up to its reputation. The roti sheets are thin, soft, and freshly made, with a light fragrance that doesn’t feel greasy. The sai mai (cotton candy threads) are fluffy, mildly sweet, and well-balanced, making it easy to eat without feeling overly sugary.

What stands out is the consistency — each roll is neatly prepared with a good ratio of roti to sai mai. The ingredients feel fresh, and the taste is clean and straightforward, just how classic roti sai mai should be.
sample_reviews_th.author: Wisanu Tuntawiroon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cotton candy roti is available in mini (30 baht), small (60 baht), and large (120 baht) sizes.

The small size is also quite generous, with three bags of roti dough. They offer a variety of dough flavors including plain white, pandan, pumpkin, carrot, etc.

We found the dough to be soft, fresh, and the filling delicious. My friends and family also agreed it was tasty.

They also sell other snacks such as mooncakes and crispy pork jerky.

They also have freshly made appetizers like fresh spring rolls, salad rolls, and fried spring rolls.

There is seating available if you want to eat in. They also sell tea and coffee.

For parking, we parked just past the shop and walked over.

The staff were friendly and smiling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oaddybeing B

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a famous roti sai mai (cotton candy roti) shop in Nonthaburi, where you don't have to go all the way to Ayutthaya to enjoy delicious roti. The shop makes the dough fresh constantly because there's a constant stream of customers. A regular set costs 60 baht and comes with several dough flavors; the white and pandan flavors are the best. They also have cotton candy in various flavors, with the white and green ones being the most delicious. The shop also sells other snacks. Currently, they accept the government's co-payment scheme.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lookmoo Pajonsak

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm giving it 5 stars! This is the best cotton candy roti I've ever had. Ayutthaya can't even compare. The pandan flavor is distinctly pandan-flavored, and the purple sweet potato flavor is clearly purple sweet potato – not made with artificial food coloring. The herbal drinks are not too sweet; the chrysanthemum tea tastes like something from a pharmacy, and the bael fruit juice is fragrant. The fresh spring rolls are also excellent – ​​large, filling, and topped with crab meat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lemon Tea

sample_reviews_en.text: This famous shop in Nonthaburi, known for its cotton candy, has been featured on numerous TV programs and events. They offer a variety of roti (flatbread) flavors such as pandan, carrot, taro, pumpkin, etc., with thick, flatbread-like layers. The cotton candy is soft and light to the touch, not clumpy, and not overly sweet like other places. They also offer many other products. The shop is located on Ratchaphruek Road, on the side heading towards Pak Kret.
sample_reviews_en.author: Napadol Kasiwat

sample_reviews_en.text:
I hadn't even ordered cotton candy yet when the owner told me to try the zongzi (Chinese rice dumpling) first. When I ignored him, he just brought it to me. He makes selling things as a hobby. The cotton candy was 60 baht and had three servings of dough. I could use the government's co-payment scheme, so I ended up paying 23 baht. Plus, they have a points system: buy 10, get 1 free.
Awesome!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattraporn Trisirisuk

sample_reviews_en.text: This roti sai mai (cotton candy roti) shop makes its own thin, soft, fragrant dough. I really like the wrapper here. Their other snacks are also delicious. You can eat in the shop or take it away, whichever is more convenient, but there aren't many tables. They serve hot tea, which is very fragrant. I forgot to take a picture of their signature roti sai mai! 😅
sample_reviews_en.author: aura pk

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything is great, but every time I go to pick up flour, the staff doesn't seem interested in ringing me up. I practically glued to the cash register while waiting, but as soon as another customer comes in, they rush to ring them up, forcing me to move away. It's so confusing. Aren't people picking up flour customers too? This has happened many times.
sample_reviews_en.author: อรปรียา สถิตย์พงษ์วัฒนะ

restaurants.name: The Marca Turkish Restaurant
restaurants.address:

36, 3 Pan Rd, สีลม Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We’ve been to many Turkish restaurants over the years, and unfortunately, this one falls on the lower end of the spectrum.

The lentil soup was watery and it lacked salt, while the shish kebab felt like it was baked in the oven rather than grilled — dry and lacking that smoked char. The pide was overwhelmingly oniony, and overall, the dishes we ordered were quite bland in both taste and presentation.

Additionally, I couldn’t help but notice that all of the 25 five-star reviews were left in the past two days, which raises some concerns about their authenticity.

That said, I genuinely hope the restaurant improves, as there aren’t many Turkish options in this area. Wishing you the best!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nurdaulet Niaz

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were absolutely thrilled! 😍 The restaurant had a fantastic selection of food, and everything was incredibly delicious, authentically Turkish, and served piping hot. The location was lovely, and most importantly, everything was spotlessly clean and tidy, which is something we personally value a lot.

The food arrived super fast, and the staff was incredibly friendly. We even got to chat with the owner, who has been living in Thailand for about a year and a half and opened this Turkish restaurant. 🙂

You can tell that they put their heart and soul into their work. We would definitely come back and highly recommend it to everyone! 🇹🇷✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Sibel Hüseyin

sample_reviews_en.text:
We really had a wonderful experience here! The food was not only delicious but also beautifully presented. You can tell immediately that the cooking is done with care and passion.

The atmosphere in the restaurant is warm and cozy, making you feel welcome right away. What makes this place truly special is the staff: super friendly, attentive, and professional. They do everything they can to ensure you have a fantastic evening.

All in all, everything just fits together perfectly: high-level quality, service, and ambiance. Highly recommended; we will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Volkan Tasci

sample_reviews_en.text:
We chose this place based solely on reviews and were very disappointed. The beef was rubbery, with lots of chunks of fat instead of meat. The ayran wasn't ayran at all. It wasn't sour or salty. It just tasted like cream.
The experience was further ruined by the guys who were either the owners' guests or the owners themselves. They would go out to smoke cannabis and sit down to dine in the dreadful stench.
No respect for those sitting and eating.

On the plus side, the Thai waitress was sweet and polite. Unfortunately, that's all.
sample_reviews_en.author: melena asanova

sample_reviews_en.text: We had a really great experience at The Marca Turkish Restaurant. The food was fresh, full of flavor, and beautifully presented. You can really taste the quality in every dish. The atmosphere was warm, stylish, and welcoming, which made the whole experience even better. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made us feel comfortable from the moment we arrived. If you’re looking for delicious Turkish food and excellent service, this place is definitely worth visiting
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaan B

sample_reviews_en.text: I came with my girlfriend. The chicken casserole, Iskender kebab, seasonal salad, balloon-shaped flatbread, and ayran (yogurt drink) were fantastic. I've been living in Asia for 5 years, and this was the best Turkish restaurant I've experienced. The service and cleanliness were also excellent. Thank you for the complimentary tea and the polite, friendly service. They opened the shop 10 months ago, congratulations and best wishes to the chef! 👏
sample_reviews_en.author: Serter Gezdiren

sample_reviews_en.text:
First of all, we would like to thank the owner, Mr. Oğuz, very much; he was really very attentive.
The food was excellent, and the variety and colorfulness of the menu was pleasing; I really felt like I was eating a meal. The complimentary tea beforehand was a very nice touch.
The establishment is very clean and tidy. 🇹🇷
sample_reviews_en.author: Muhammet Bilen

sample_reviews_en.text:
A fantastic Turkish restaurant in Bangkok!

I ordered an İskender and it was absolutely delicious – incredibly tasty and very authentic. The price was perfect, and the portion was more than generous.

Anyone looking for really good Turkish food in Bangkok should definitely stop by. Highly recommended! 👍🇹🇷
sample_reviews_en.author: Onur

restaurants.name: One cc. Cafe & Craft beer
restaurants.address:

121 21 หมู่5 ถนน ราชพฤกษ์ Maha Sawat, Bang Kruai District, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food: 🍳🥓 They offer both Thai and international cuisine. The delicious Thai food is perfect for lunch, or you can enjoy it with the restaurant's craft beer. The international menu focuses on spaghetti 🍝, steaks 🥩, and their must-try burgers 🍔, which are incredibly delicious.

Beverage: 🍺 They have a huge selection of craft beers, and you can even sample them to see which one suits your taste. The staff are incredibly helpful and knowledgeable about craft beers.

Service: ⭐️ I'd give the service a 10 out of 100! The staff in charge of the craft beer section gave excellent recommendations for each beer flavor. 🍺 Highly impressed with their service.

Atmosphere: 🍃 For those bringing young children, the restaurant has an open area for kids to run around, and the staff do a great job looking after them. The atmosphere is shady and relaxing with lots of trees. Even during lunchtime in January, you can enjoy your meal outdoors in the pleasant weather.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teerapath Puangkaew

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my absolute favorite craft beer bar. The food is amazing too; every dish is delicious. I highly recommend the traditional glass noodle salad, the German sausage, and the surprisingly delicious stir-fried cabbage with fish sauce! The atmosphere is great, and they have live music on weekends. Everyone is lovely – the staff, the singers, the owner, even the customers. It feels more like a home filled with wonderful people, not a restaurant at all.

Every time I go, it feels like I'm eating at a friend's or sibling's house – so warm and welcoming.

If you like a chill atmosphere, great music, comfortable weather, premium drinks that you can sample before ordering, and incredibly delicious food – especially during the winter when it's so cool you'll forget you're in Bangkok – then this is the place to go!
sample_reviews_en.author: Joy Loy

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food service was extremely slow that day. I ordered a simple pork basil rice dish, and it took the staff 30 minutes to realize they were out of rice. The total waiting time from ordering was almost an hour. When I inquired, the staff said there was only one chef that day. Their response and facial expression showed a poor mindset. They should have informed customers beforehand that there would be a long wait.

I ordered water and waited almost an hour, and it still hadn't been served. I also ordered shrimp nachos, but they were out of shrimp. Please reconsider your approach. The reason for the delay is unlikely to be a single chef, but rather a lack of preparedness in service.

The atmosphere was nice, but I wouldn't go back and wouldn't recommend it to anyone. Extremely unimpressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Screen Y.

sample_reviews_en.text: "This is the place to go for craft beer!" I'm not a big coffee or sugary drink person, but I enjoy going to cafes for the atmosphere. This place is perfect for me because it's a cafe that also serves craft beer, making it a great place to relax. The atmosphere is shady and feels like camping, with lots of trees, perfect for sitting for hours. They have both savory and sweet food, and most importantly, they have a fantastic selection of craft beers, both Thai and international! You can even chat with the friendly staff member, "Fatty," for a while. I came in the afternoon and enjoyed it until evening. I'll try going in the evening next time. I loved it! 😁👍🥳🤩
sample_reviews_en.author: Pratya Chamnongsin

sample_reviews_en.text:
🌿🐶 A lush and pet-friendly cafe!

This is another cafe that I was very impressed with. The atmosphere is quiet and peaceful, perfect for relaxing, working, or reading. It's especially chill during the daytime.

Importantly, it's pet-friendly, so you can bring your furry friends, making the atmosphere even warmer and more welcoming.

The owner is lovely, friendly, and takes great care of customers, making you feel comfortable from the moment you step in.

If you're looking for a cafe where you can sit for a long time, whether alone, with friends, or with your dog or cat, I highly recommend this one! 🐾☕🌿
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanpen Leangchaipanich

sample_reviews_en.text: I found this cafe near Central WestVille on Google Maps with good reviews and saved it for later before finally getting to visit. The atmosphere is very relaxed with lots of trees and shade. I loved the green lawn; it was fun for my toddler (just over a year old) to play on. They have a good selection of craft beers and bottled beers. The food was delicious. We went on a Saturday evening and there was live music. The cafe is located a bit deep in an alley. The owner and staff were very friendly and provided excellent service. Overall, it was great; I give it 5 stars!
sample_reviews_en.author: satha soontornchai

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a simple basil pork with rice and a glass of water. After 30 minutes, the restaurant informed me that they had run out of rice and offered to substitute spaghetti instead. I agreed, but after nearly another 30 minutes, I still hadn't received my order, and the water hadn’t been served either. The restaurant then explained that they only had one chef on duty today and a lot of customers, but the staff member who informed me appeared visibly annoyed with me. I had come intending to relax but ended up frustrated with the long wait and the service attitude.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tucky San

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is great, very homie, and the service is good.
They have craft beer and live music.

You can sample the craft beer before ordering. I personally liked the "Salak Sod" (easy to drink, tastes like Heartbeat candy) and the mango passion fruit.

I loved the pizza! It's Indian-style crust, very soft, and has plenty of cheese. Another favorite dish was the deep-fried pork belly with fish sauce; the sautéed mushrooms in sauce were excellent.

There's also a garden area, and it looks like they allow camping there. Plus, there are adorable cats! 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornpimon Chiewpimonporn

restaurants.name: Dojoe Steak Expert สาขา บางกรวย
restaurants.address:

45 13 Bang Kruai District, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited for lunch on a Saturday; it wasn't crowded. The restaurant sells steaks, spaghetti, soups, as well as Thai and Japanese food, but I specifically came for steak.

I initially planned to have Wagyu beef, but unfortunately, they were sold out. So I had the Tomahawk steak instead. There are two sizes to choose from, priced around 400+ baht, but it was a huge piece. The meat was delicious; not so much that you'd need to chew at all. However, I've had Tomahawk steaks at other restaurants that cost over 3,500 baht, so this one was exceptionally good. The price was much lower for this quality of meat – excellent!

The soup was very thick, more like a sauce. It would have been even better if it were a little less thick. I loved the garlic bread; they make it exceptionally well. The mashed potatoes were smooth, but the flavor wasn't quite to my liking. Overall, it was good.

There's plenty of parking. The menu is quite diverse, offering Western, Thai, and Japanese set meals like fish. I'll definitely try the ribeye next time!
sample_reviews_en.author: Usanisa P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I decided to stop by because I often drive past this area. The sign makes it sound like they only sell steaks, but they actually have a wide variety of food, including steaks, spaghetti, som tum (papaya salad), and Japanese-style set meals. At first, I didn't plan on ordering anything other than steak because I was afraid it wouldn't be good, but everything I ordered was delicious. The som tum with crab and fermented fish sauce was amazing – better than most Isaan restaurants; the fermented fish sauce wasn't smelly and had a wonderful flavor. The spaghetti carbonara was delicious and had plenty of shrimp roe. The pork steak was good quality and a decent portion for the price. The teriyaki chicken set was tasty with crispy skin. In short, everything was great. The food is reasonably priced, the restaurant is clean, and the staff are very friendly.

🥩 Steaks, Som Tum, Set Meals
🏢 Bang Kruai Plaza
🚘 Free parking in Bang Kruai Plaza
sample_reviews_en.author: Attawut ミンヂー Wijinthanasarn

sample_reviews_en.text: This steakhouse was a chance find; I was craving steak. The tables were a little higher than the chairs. The truffle soup had a slight truffle aroma. The garlic bread was delicious. On the day I went, there wasn't a wide selection of steaks available; most were sold out. I ordered a Tomahawk ribeye, medium rare, but it came out quite rare. It was grilled well, but this cut had some tough bits of tendon. The owner explained that there weren't many options available that day. I'll have to try again next time. I think the steak is quite good value for money, as a Tomahawk ribeye at other restaurants usually costs over 1000 baht. The side dishes were a bit sparse for a steak. Overall, it was good value. Parking is available right in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panisara

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten at this restaurant many times.
Most of the food is okay and good value for money.
The taste is decent, both the Japanese food and the steak.
Maybe not amazing, but it's okay. It's also close to home.

However, today was the first time I ordered yakisoba.
But what I got was spaghetti noodles stir-fried in yakisoba sauce.
That's not right.
I ordered yakisoba expecting soba noodles.
Instead, I got spaghetti noodles, and they were bland, almost tasteless.
There was also very little pork and vegetables.

This dish was terrible.
If the yakisoba menu uses spaghetti noodles,
it should be stated on the menu so customers know and don't order it.

**I ordered through Line Man, but couldn't find the review button, so I'm reviewing it here instead.**
sample_reviews_en.author: Atiwat Aneksittisin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is flavorful and perfect for those who like strong flavors.

The service was okay; the food didn't take long to arrive. Today, there was only one server, and she kept bumping into glasses and bottles while carrying the food trays. I wish there was at least one more person; she seemed tired.

The atmosphere was generally good, but I think the tables, trays, and floor could be a little cleaner to make it more pleasant to look at.

Overall, I will definitely return. The food is delicious and worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anongsri Boon

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu offers a diverse range of dishes at reasonable prices, including steaks, Thai food, and single-serving meals. The restaurant has air conditioning, but it's not very cool. The staff don't smile much and seem generally expressionless while serving. The atmosphere is dim. I'd like to see better customer service training and an improved ambiance; then it would be a great restaurant. There's plenty of parking in the complex, and you can shop at Max Value after your meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanasak Vanichavit

sample_reviews_en.text:
First time here and everything was delicious.
The staff were very attentive to detail.
The staff here are very welcoming.
The restaurant is clean and inviting.
All the food was delicious.
My first time here and I was very impressed. I will definitely come again. 🥰🥰🥰 There is plenty of parking, which is convenient. There is a massage shop next door where you can also get your hair done.
Located on Therd Phra Kiat Road.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภัทร์สินี มิ้ลค์ พิพัฒน์สําโรง (มิ้ลค์ Milkเจ้าของกิจการ)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious. My beef wagyu steak set was well-cooked. It tasted well with smell of butter.
The mushroom soup is creamy and yummy for only THB 50.
The atmosphere was nice. Everything was in good quality comparing to the price.
The blonde hair girl staff was super rude. I asked for a receipt and she stared at me unpleasantly the whole time.
sample_reviews_en.author: ** PYMN **

restaurants.name: Nameless Thai Local Restaurant
restaurants.address:

210 / 7 Soi Buakhao, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This local Thai cuisine place, which literally doesn’t have a name, is a hidden gem. It’s mostly frequented by locals and is run exclusively by women. The cozy establishment has just five to six tables and an open kitchen.

The most adorable food place I’ve ever been to in Thailand! Based on reviews, I ordered Khao Man Gai, which is essentially boiled boneless chicken served over rice with a clear soup and a dark, spicy soup. To be honest, it didn’t look appetizing, but it turned out to be surprisingly delicious. The clear soup had a mild, distinct flavor similar to miso soup. The chicken was fresh, tender, and smooth, and the well-cooked rice complemented the dish perfectly. The colored soup was a bit spicy and had a unique flavor. Overall, for just 60 baht, it was more than worth it.

The restaurant lacks air conditioning and shared seating, which may not be ideal for everyone, but the food compensates for all of those shortcomings. And considering the price point, we can’t even complain.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siripuram Sai Bharadwaj

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's truly disappointing.
The two young female staff members were the worst.
The girl who came to take my order left without even looking me or responding. I wasn't sure if she understood, but she came anyway. I tried the Chicken Ramen, but I felt sick and couldn't tell if it was good or bad.
The soup, however, was lukewarm.
When it was time to pay, the other girl didn't even look me in the eye, and as if she was in a bad mood, she handed me my change between her fingers and threw it at me.
I was annoyed, but I endured it and left.
I took photos of the two girls, but
due to portrait rights, I won't post them.
I've been to Pattaya dozens of times, but this is the first time I've been treated like this.
Everyone, please be careful if you go here. The other staff members have really nice smiles and are very pleasant.
I hope the owner reads this review and makes amends.
sample_reviews_en.author: 荒井実（みのさん）

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm aware of the double whammy of rising prices and a weak yen, so I'm just as satisfied with the price as before.

I ordered pad thai this time, which is unusual for me, but the taste was worse than before. Considering the price and location, I think it might be good for a late-night meal.

This is my second visit, and as others have pointed out, the staff's attitude is really rude. I understand they're busy, but they should be a little nicer and not so rude.

And stop changing your attitude when I speak Thai!

The first disappointment!
sample_reviews_en.author: Shigeki Namatame

sample_reviews_en.text:

sample_reviews_en.author: iidapan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I would say that even if you visited not only Pattaya but all of Thailand, there is no place as cheap, with generous portions, and delicious as this one.

No explanation is needed. It is simply the best restaurant.

The shop is small and hot, but it overcomes all of that.

If you are looking for a cultured and dignified dining experience, do not go here, as you will always have to share a table with a stranger. Since it is crowded, sharing a table is a must.
sample_reviews_en.author: 반제이

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited this place many many times during the years.
Don't expect luxury.
Don't expect to be very very clean.
But it is busy - very busy.
The food is always good and delicious.
The prices - well, you can have a decent meal for 50-60 baht. (Little bit over a British pound).
Highly recommended and Yes, I will visit it again.
Works till very late and it is located at a very convenient place in central Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: K London

sample_reviews_en.text: Exceptional real true Thai food at a very good price. Menu is also very good so many options.  I tried to multitude of different dishes over a 14 day time period two times a day. Everything was exceptional. I gave a five star on atmosphere because it’s real Thailand. You know you’re living that real Thai experience with the hustle, bustle and noise. I loved it and I highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thomas

sample_reviews_en.text:
I read reviews that said the service from the staff was bad, but when I was looking for a straw, a male staff member told me where to find one. He was quick and efficient, which I really liked.
It's often crowded even outside of meal times, so you'll likely have to share a table.
I ordered menu item 31. I ordered it with a mild spiciness, but it was still too spicy for me.
sample_reviews_en.author: trangden trangden

restaurants.name: Sasaya Silom
restaurants.address:

8/4 Soi Naradhiwas Rajanagarindra 1, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited this place in Silom with my partner as we were looking for a cozy spot to enjoy some Japanese cuisine. The creative dishes based on traditional Japanese flavors were delicious, with a thoughtful combination of ingredients that left us wanting more. Each dish was a delightful surprise😊

The ambiance was perfect for a relaxing dinner, with a comfortable and inviting atmosphere. The staff were attentive and provided excellent service, enhancing our dining experience. We appreciated the extensive menu, offering a wide range of options to suit any mood or occasion.

For the quality and creativity of the dishes, the prices were quite reasonable. We left feeling very satisfied and are already planning our next visit. I’m eager to try the seasonal creations they will offer! Silom is a great area to enjoy such delightful Japanese cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Purin

sample_reviews_en.text:
We decided to visit a spot in the Silom area for a relaxed meal, looking for something delightful. The creative Japanese dishes stood out with their gentle flavors and well-thought-out ingredient combinations. The variety in the menu was impressive, inspired by traditional "washoku," which made the dining experience even more enjoyable. 😊

The atmosphere was cozy, making it a perfect place for a family gathering. The staff was attentive, ensuring that we felt right at home throughout our meal. The pleasant ambiance and quality service really added to the enjoyment.

Considering the flavorful dishes and the inviting setting, the prices felt justified. We left feeling very satisfied and are eager to return, especially to try more of the seasonal creations next time!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarocha Phakhasetthakarn

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of my favorite Japanese restaurants in Bangkok. The food is always good quality, not a typical izakaya menu, and presented very well.

The interior is very nicely done, rustic and private table style, which is a nice change to usual izakaya layouts.
The service is a hit and miss, sometimes they can be friendly and other times a bit dismissive.

They also seriously need to change their payment processor. Ive been here at least 7-8 times, and 3 times the card processor did not work, and they looked at me like its my card thats the problem.

To the Management: can you seriously replace that payment processor, this is the only restaurant that it has an issue this frequently.

Bring cash in case they dont bother changing the machine, to be safe.

Cheers
sample_reviews_en.author: T O (Diomedes)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stopped by this cozy spot in silom for some Japanese cuisine with my family, and it was a delightful experience. The creative Japanese dishes were not only delicious but also beautifully presented. Each dish offered unique flavors and thoughtful ingredient combinations that made every bite enjoyable 😊.

The menu offers a wide variety of options, which is perfect for satisfying different cravings on any given day. The atmosphere was incredibly welcoming, and the service was attentive, making us feel right at home.

I am very pleased with the overall value, considering the exceptional quality of the food and ambiance. I’m looking forward to returning soon, perhaps to try their seasonal creations and enjoy another relaxing meal in the heart of silom!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yipunh Srisurang

sample_reviews_en.text:
While exploring silom after a work meeting with some colleagues, we decided to stop by a spot known for its creative Japanese cuisine. Each dish offered a delightful combination of flavors and was thoughtfully presented, making every bite enjoyable.

The ambiance was incredibly soothing and perfect for unwinding after a long day. The staff’s attentive service added to the overall pleasure of our dining experience. Plus, the menu was impressively diverse, giving us plenty of options to suit our moods 😊

For the quality and creativity of the dishes, the pricing felt just right. It’s a place I’d recommend to anyone seeking a relaxed meal in the silom area. I'm already looking forward to going back to try their seasonal creations!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pun Thanapoom

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited a Japanese cuisine spot in Silom with friends and had a fantastic experience. The creative twist on traditional Japanese dishes not only delighted my palate but also offered something new with each bite. The generous portions and delicious flavors made the meal truly memorable.

The atmosphere was cozy and inviting, with attentive service enhancing the overall experience. The wide variety of menu options means there's always something new to try, making it perfect for both regular visits and special occasions.

For those seeking a satisfying meal in a relaxed setting, this place offers great value for the quality. I’m certainly looking forward to returning soon to explore more of their seasonal creations! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Chutima Posomboon

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited a cozy spot for dinner with my friends in the lively Silom area. We were in the mood for some Japanese cuisine, and this place was a gem! The menu was abundant with creative dishes that combined traditional Japanese flavors with an innovative twist. Each plate was a delightful surprise, with thoughtful seasoning and perfectly matched ingredients.

The atmosphere was very calming and welcoming, just what we needed for a relaxing evening. The staff’s attentive service added to the overall pleasant experience.

The value for the quality and variety of dishes felt spot on. I’m eager to return and explore more of their seasonal creations with friends. Can't wait for my next visit! 😊✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Niramol Tiensripojamarn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visiting the Silom area, I wanted to enjoy some Japanese cuisine with friends, so we stopped by this place. The creative Japanese dishes here were not only delicious but also beautifully presented, with well-thought-out combinations of ingredients and subtle flavors.

The atmosphere was very relaxing, making it easy to unwind and enjoy the meal. The staff were attentive and friendly, adding to the overall pleasant experience.

With such a wide variety of menu options, there's something for everyone, which is a delightful surprise. The quality and experience offered here certainly justify the price! I am looking forward to trying more of their seasonal creations the next time I visit Silom 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanadol Vibulchan

restaurants.name: qraft. (Ari soi1)
restaurants.address:

5, 7 Soi Ari 1, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you are a fan of intense flavors, this place is a must-visit. The quality of their ingredients is exceptional, especially their matcha and coffee selections.

Eaten menu:
- Koicha Cream Strawberry Tosuto (5/5): The combination of rich cream and fresh strawberries is good.
- Pastel Matcha (5/5): Incredibly delicious and very concentrated. Must try.
- Pastel Coffee (4.5/5): The coffee is very bold and aromatic.
- Waffuru (4.5/5): The matcha filling inside is super intense and high-quality.
- Affogato Cheezu Tosuto (4.5/5)
- Parfait (4.5/5): It’s a bit pricey, but very refreshing. You can taste the natural sweetness from the fresh fruits.

Overall, everything here is top-notch. Even though some items are on the expensive side, the premium quality and rich flavors make it worth every baht."
sample_reviews_en.author: Tashin Jiracharoenvongsa

sample_reviews_en.text: I placed my order, and the staff checked the availability and confirmed there was enough to serve me. I paid and waited for over 20 minutes. A staff member then informed me that the item was out of stock and offered to change my order or issue a refund. Finally, when I inquired at the counter, I learned that the item wasn't out of stock, but had been served to the wrong table. The customers who were served incorrectly had already finished their meal and left the restaurant. The restaurant knew about the mistake but didn't inform me, claiming they were out of stock. Their problem-solving and management need improvement. This wasted my time and caused a negative experience for the customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutthakit Achavakulthep

sample_reviews_en.text:
Some seriously good matcha here, as the sister of peace oriental matcha it really lives up to expectations.

I ordered their matcha latte and the matcha icecream dessert set. The matcha latte was made so quickly using a blender - just milk and matcha powder and blend, but yet it tasted so rich and creamy with the perfect amount of airiness. I guess all the focus on using hot water at the perfect temperature to whisk the matcha with some perfect technique really isn’t required so long as you got good matcha. The icecream is also equally great, so was the little matcha sponge cake. I’m not sure what exactly it is but the crème brûlée like layer on top was delicious as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kenny Yap

sample_reviews_en.text: The air conditioner has been broken for almost a year now, and they haven't fixed or improved anything. I urge the owner to be more responsible towards their customers, instead of just focusing on making money. I've given them countless chances because I'm impressed with their pastries and matcha, but the air conditioner being broken for months, almost a year, is simply irresponsible. I've lost all interest; I don't even want to buy my favorite menu item anymore because I don't want to spend money supporting them. If you're not ready to provide good service, you might as well close the shop. Regular customers are just wasting their time and energy.
sample_reviews_en.author: thitirat fa-amnuayphol

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop offers matcha, croissants, and other parfaits. They have large croissants in various flavors, or you can have them with ice cream. We tried the Matcha Extremist, a black croissant with matcha ice cream and black sticky rice. The croissant was crispy and fragrant, the ice cream was rich and creamy, and it paired well with the black sticky rice. Overall, the desserts were good and delicious, but the prices were quite high. The shop is nicely decorated; I liked the style. There's seating on the second floor, but no parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Taksaorn Sirikantaramas

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm not usually a matcha fan, but I ordered the clear matcha - medium firing - and it was delicious. It was easy to drink.

The shop is beautiful. I loved the peaceful atmosphere, especially on the second floor. However, the lighting was a bit dim because I went when it was raining and getting dark. There were no lights at the tables, so I couldn't see anything to read. I had to sit by the window. The shop was quiet and peaceful; I enjoyed sipping tea and reading a book. It was very relaxing. I loved it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miaow Chong

sample_reviews_en.text:
This famous matcha shop, located in the Ari area, has been around since before matcha became incredibly popular.
The drinks are as good as everyone says, and the prices aren't too high. However, the pastries are a bit overpriced considering their taste. The atmosphere in the shop is cramped but bright, with two floors. The downstairs area has a slight musty smell, but the upstairs is quiet and peaceful. The restroom is clean. There is no parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chom K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a beautifully designed Japanese-style cafe in Ari Soi 1. The decor, using black and wood tones, creates a warm and simple atmosphere. They offer a wide variety of drinks including coffee, non-coffee options, matcha, and their signature croissants – and importantly, everything on the menu is delicious!

For those who love croissants and matcha, this is a must-try cafe in the Ari area. You won't be disappointed! 😍😍
sample_reviews_en.author: kongpop yodphaeng

restaurants.name: Sallim Restaurant (Halal)
restaurants.address:

10500, Bang Rak, Bangkok, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sallim Restaurant is located near Thai Grand Postal Bangrak Building/TCDC and is not far from Si Phaya Pier Boat Station. You need to take the boat from Saphan Taksin BTS.

A very good homey feeling restaurant. They do have Indian, Pakistan and Thai food there.

Prices are quite cheap compared to other restaurant. There is no air condition though.

Nan bread are pretty good too. Meats (beef) are tender and their curry sauce are very delicate and creamy.

Minus one star for the hygiene part. We found one small hair inside the garlic Nan bread.

Payment can be either via cash or money transfer through app.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donny Boonyamanop

sample_reviews_en.text:
I order a takeaway. Mutton masala, chicken masala and 2 of nans.

The food are really delicious with good portion and reasonable price (quite cheap). The nan bread is quite big for me, so i would recommend to order just 1 piece of nan for those who usually eat small portion.

As for mutton masala, the mutton meats are really tender and easy to eat. I really love the smell of spice and flavour in this dish.

Chicken masala also easy to eat, i can smell all the spice in every bite.

Overall, i recommend for a try if you are in the area. The food here is worth every penny. 😋 💞
sample_reviews_en.author: Tales ForTell

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of my absolute favorite spots for authentic, delicious Halal food!

I have visited Sallim Restaurant many times, and it never disappoints. The curries are rich, flavorful, and perfectly spiced, paired with fresh, warm nan that is cooked to perfection. Portion sizes are generous, the quality is consistently great, and the prices are very affordable compared to many other places. If you are looking for authentic, comforting Halal cuisine that won’t break the bank, this hidden gem is definitely a must-try. Highly recommend! 🍛🫓✨
sample_reviews_en.author: nlek nlek

sample_reviews_en.text:
sallim is Muslim restaurant which located near Bangrak Post office by walk 2 mins.

Recommend order Milk Tea which is the super delicious and it's tasted different from Thai Tea.

Chicken Biryani is total different I had ever eat before. Rice and herb cover the chicken. If you are not the fan of Indian herb you should order other dish. I saw there have Thai street food for Muslim you could try.

For Roti just 15 THB, but you must pay by cash separate from the restaurant..
sample_reviews_en.author: Kitiporn Sudchai

sample_reviews_en.text: No words to express how good the taste, service, reasonableness of price, cleanliness, and availability of different halal foods options. I would recommend to try if you are nearby. It's worth choosing this shop even if you are not nearby because of available Thai food and roti as well. In addition, Lassi (yogurt) was so refreshing. You also have Indian sweets, masala tea available. Enjoy and have good healthy and tasty food while in Bangkok. Sawadeecap.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thein Han

sample_reviews_en.text: Unexpected scroll in google map brought me to this quite legendary place that exists since 1987! Tried the milk tea which was so good reminded me to tea stall behind my university in India. Also, the biryani is delicious! I felt like eating it from the famous  biryani in Lucknow. The service is also good, I could pack the left over samosas too. Will come back for sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dinny Wardhani

sample_reviews_en.text:
I found this place on Google based on reviews, and it turned out to be surprisingly delicious.
I tried the chicken masala curry; it had a fragrant blend of spices and a spicy kick, perfect with the naan bread. The chicken samosas were also delicious, with a generous filling. The pani puri was good too. But the highlight is the iced milk tea – a must-try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Leqi Z

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pakistani food style.
Yellow rice
Keema masala
Butter naan
Kabab (fried style)
Vegetable masala
And Lassi
All of these 355 THB !!!
Very delicious and cheap. The restaurant open for long time and it's worth it for try.

The restaurant located near Pier so you can take River ride from this and also surrounded by many interesting spots.
sample_reviews_en.author: supree Yarnkup

restaurants.name: ราดหน้าคนแซ่จัง (ลาดพร้าว 101)
restaurants.address:

674 แยก 20 Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old-school Rad Na (Thai noodle dish). I've been eating it since I was a kid.
Back in the day, it used to be a food cart selling in the evenings across the street.

The taste hasn't changed at all. The pork is tender and they give you a generous portion.
Lots of pork, noodles, and vegetables.
Really a lot for 60 baht.

Delicious. The pickled chili is fresh and tasty. Try the pickled chili as a side dish.

I recommend coming during lunchtime; it gets crowded and you'll have to wait.

Taste 🌟🌟🌟
Quality 🌟🌟🌟🌟
Service 🌟🌟🌟
Cleanliness 🌟🌟🌟
Convenience 🌟🌟🌟
Price 🌟🌟🌟

*☺️☺️*This is a personal opinion based on my preferences, tastes, experiences, biases, and quirks. I paid for the meal myself, so I'm giving an honest review and critique based on what I ate and experienced on the day I visited. I want to see criticism as a way to improve, rather than getting angry, hating, or cursing me. I ask for forgiveness here. For any restaurants, I'll briefly mention that there's something wrong that the restaurant should fix, but I won't elaborate to damage their reputation.☺️😊**
sample_reviews_en.author: วันจันทร์ ที่ผ่านมา

sample_reviews_en.text:
The noodles are generous and delicious. You don't even need to add any seasoning. It's even better if you add it.
The kale here is excellent. It's crispy, shiny, and delicious without a strong green smell.
They give you lots of large kale stalks.
The fried rice is fragrant with the wok, the sticky rice with mango is well-made, and the chrysanthemum tea is a bit sweet. Most importantly, the price is reasonable. Every time I go there, I feel "full" every time I leave. Unlike some restaurants,
the only downside is the lack of parking. The restaurant is on the roadside, but you can park on the side.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hinamoli

sample_reviews_en.text: I came to this restaurant because I saw it on TikTok, but I was very disappointed with the service. One older staff member was unfriendly and spoke harshly, making the dining experience unpleasant. The food wasn't bad, but there are many other restaurants with better food and service. This will probably be my first and last time eating here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maythawee Karaket

sample_reviews_en.text:
🚗 Parking/Transportation — Street parking available.
🍽️ Food — Delicious and generous portions.
👤 Service — Average.
🏠 Atmosphere — Cool and comfortable, plenty of seating, but also crowded.
💰 Price — Excellent value.
💬 Note: Rated compared to other restaurants in the same price range (based on memory from last year).
sample_reviews_en.author: Mee Pandaz

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is decent and the price is affordable.
The problem is that the shop extends out onto the public sidewalk, claiming it as its own all day, overflowing onto the street. Furthermore, the shop's operations are causing damage and deterioration to the sidewalk and drainage system.
sample_reviews_en.author: mnc

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was mediocre. The YouTube video said it was a dry-fried rice dish, and that the restaurant would fry it plate by plate...but what I experienced was them pre-cooking it in a pot and just scooping it out to customers. The female owner wasn't very rude...One time is enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: pharada k

sample_reviews_en.text:
Rad Na (noodles in gravy) and Pad See Ew (stir-fried noodles with soy sauce) are delicious.
The highlight is the fragrant, spicy aroma of black pepper, which enhances the flavor.
However, they may not be suitable for young children who do not eat spicy food.
sample_reviews_en.author: sompas

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! This was my first time buying and trying it. The price is reasonable. I saw a lot of people eating at the restaurant. I recommend trying it. It's delicious without needing any extra seasoning. 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Farida Chariya

restaurants.name: 61 Bistro
restaurants.address:

32 ซอย พัฒนาการ 61 Khwaeng Prawet, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: What an amazing experience! 😍 The service was incredibly friendly and welcoming – the staff made us feel right at home from the moment we walked in. The garlic chicken was perfectly seasoned – bursting with flavor in every bite! And those ribs? Absolutely juicy, tender, and downright delicious. 🤤 And don’t get me started on the burger made with premium Australian beef – it was a total game-changer! The patty was incredibly juicy, perfectly grilled, and packed with rich, bold flavor that just melts in your mouth. Topped just right, it was hands down one of the best burgers I’ve ever had! 🍔🔥 Unfortunately, I didn’t manage to take a photo of the burger because it was so delicious that it disappeared in a flash – I just couldn’t resist and devoured it all! Everything was prepared and served super quickly, without sacrificing quality. I wholeheartedly recommend this place – you won’t be disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: D

sample_reviews_en.text: Really enjoyed this find tonight near our Airbnb. With a picky child it isn’t always easy but the pizza was made to his exact liking, and the rose crispy bacon fusilli was the perfect taste and size for my 7 year old daughter. After the fun gastrique appetizer, The braised beef lasagna came out extremely hot and delicious. The chicken lollipops were tender with the perfect amount of spice. Dad’s yum picanha steak was perfectly cooked at medium rare and mom’s fish & chips was light, fresh, and served with the best tartar sauce I’ve had in Thailand thus far!  Oh! And the coconut crème bruiee is a definite must-try! If we are back in the area again 61 Bistro will certainly be on our places to repeat!
sample_reviews_en.author: Patra Nakornthap

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was craving banger and mash for a while and this place helped me a lot! The sausage is really tasty.

The rest of the food also very nice. The pesto-shrimp pasta is beyond expectation, the taste is good and they used fresh good size shrimps. Yum picanha is recommended, good portion of the beef with bright yum sauce.

Recommended coming minimum 2-4 people and order to share dishes.

The service is nice, ambiance is cozy, british pub inspired.

There are a lot of drinks (coffee/cocktail/beer) to explore. And if you dont like Western food they also offer Thai one-dish meal like Padkrapao too.
sample_reviews_en.author: An Th.

sample_reviews_en.text:
At 61Bistro, the flavors come alive,
A cozy haven where sweet memories thrive.
From golden onion rings and fries that crunch,
To savory dishes perfect for dinner or lunch.
The garlic bread whispers a fragrant delight,
While rich spaghetti warms the tonight.
Juicy sausages and ribs cooked so fine,
A perfect place for families to dine.
With smiles all around, for the young and the old,
A culinary story beautifully told.
Delicious plates that everyone will love,
A dining experience we highly approve.
sample_reviews_en.author: GG Parnichkarn

sample_reviews_en.text: This is probably one of the hidden gem around the area. Food tastes surprisingly delicious both Thai and western. It is cozy vibe with 90s music era. Pasta with ka phrao seafood is yummy and so spicy. Fish and chips has really nice tartar sauce though fish size is a bit small. Stir-fried chicken with salty chili sauce is nicely cooked and come along with scrambled egg & streamed rice. Pizza has it own style. Worth visiting whether for good food or just chilling with various choices of drink.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apichart Dausiri

sample_reviews_en.text:
✨ Hidden gem spotted in Pattanakarn 61! ✨

I’ve been down this soi so many times and can’t believe I missed it before. The food and service are truly exceptional. I tried the pork steak — perfectly crisp on the outside, tender inside. 🥩👌

What really surprised me was their music playlist — I fell in love with it instantly. It made the whole dining experience even better. 🎶💛

This spot has now officially become my shortcut to a new favorite place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Witsanee Veerawattananon

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem spot with good vibe and atmosphere.
A chill place you can work or study at.
Reasonable prices for great food and wide range of drinks.
Good and humble service.

Fish & chips I had was rather bland-seasoned but you're meant to dip it in tartare sauce. It perfectly compliments the dish.
I found this place by chance and I must return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ekawat T.

sample_reviews_en.text: Back for a second review after visiting this bistro so many times. This time I tried the 519 baht package from Hungry Hub, which comes with a choice of 4 dishes — really great value for the price. The shrimp salad is definitely a must-try. Overall, another satisfying visit and I’ll probably be back again soon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaung Pyi Soe

restaurants.name: NICO NICO - Gaysorn Amarin
restaurants.address:

ตึก Gaysorn Amarin (ชั้น2 496 502 Phloen Chit Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Second visit to Nico Nico, and it sadly confirmed what I felt the first time: disappointment with the food.

Everything else is done right. The atmosphere is excellent, the service is warm and attentive, the owner clearly has good ideas, and the location is even better than I remembered. On paper, this place should work.

I ordered the chicken pot pie. It looked fantastic, exactly the kind of dish you want to like. Unfortunately, it was bland and completely forgettable. No depth, no seasoning, no payoff. How something can look that good and taste that flat is honestly baffling.

I also tried the orange coffee. My wife warned me I was being unnecessarily adventurous, and she was right to doubt it. Surprisingly, the coffee was actually very good and ended up being the highlight.

This place has the right concept, the right energy, and the right setting. But the execution from the kitchen just does not match the ambition. Either the food is being played too safe, or the chef has extremely timid taste buds.

With so many truly creative dining options in Bangkok, this one sadly does not come close to the mark.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Seow

sample_reviews_en.text:
For others trying to find it, it's on 1st floor (one level above ground level) close to the entrance of BTS skywalk. If you come by motorbike, there are very unclear signs, so I ended up parking in the staff area until I left and realized there is even more parking if you keep going around the back of the building.
Once I parked and foumd the place, I realized they are quite limited in breakfast choices in their menu. It's all egg based bruschetta and mostly savory lunch options. I was feeling like having some pancakes and waffles and sweet croissants and muffins, but there was none of that. Instead I had the avocado toast with eggs. It was very good and I appreciate that they didn't use precooked eggs, but freshly boiled ones. The latte was also well balanced. For that they get four stars, which is quite generous.
sample_reviews_en.author: ali safar

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nico Nico has quietly become my go-to coffee stop in the city. I drop in almost every other day, and their cappuccino is consistently the best I’ve had here. Smooth, balanced, and perfectly frothed, the kind of cup you actually slow down for.

The café itself has a calm, relaxed feel. Plenty of light, comfortable seating, and a peaceful vibe that makes it easy to take a short break from the day without any rush.

I also tried the miso caramel pudding, which turned out to be a great surprise. Lovely flavour, silky texture, and just the right amount of sweetness.

Overall, a really pleasant place for both coffee lovers and anyone who just wants a quiet moment with something good on the table.
sample_reviews_en.author: Omer

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Perfect Morning Retreat ☕🍞🎶

I had such a delightful breakfast here! Every bite was flavorful and satisfying—definitely worth every baht. The salted bread was a standout: perfectly crisp on the outside, soft inside, and packed with savory goodness. The coffee? Bold, aromatic, and just the right kick to start the day.

What I loved most was the relaxed atmosphere. I could sit for hours without feeling rushed, soaking in the cozy vibes and enjoying the lovely music playing in the background. It’s the kind of place that makes you want to linger a little longer.

Highly recommended for anyone seeking a delicious, peaceful start to their day.
sample_reviews_en.author: mocha aoroae

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently had brunch at NICO NICO and overall, it was a great experience. The food was absolutely delicious — every dish we ordered was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Their coffee was just as impressive: rich, smooth, and clearly made with care. The cozy, stylish atmosphere also makes it a perfect spot for a casual date.

The only downside was the service. Unfortunately, the staff didn’t seem very friendly, which took away from the otherwise warm vibe of the place.

Still, if you’re looking for amazing food and great coffee in a cute setting, NICO NICO is definitely worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanawat Pengdith

sample_reviews_en.text:
Randomly walked in for a coffee fix and unexpectedly discovered Cocorn COF and now I’m hooked!

I ended up returning the very next day just for this unique drink. It’s a blend of coconut purée, corn juice, oat milk, and an espresso shot.

What I love most is the way the flavors unfold the roasted sweet corn aroma fills your mouth with the first sip, followed by the deep espresso notes that linger at the back of your throat.

The beautiful layering of flavors makes this one of the most memorable and delicious coffee experiences I’ve had.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shin O

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nico Nico is a restaurant offering a variety of dishes, including healthy food, clean food, and Japanese cuisine.

The restaurant is located inside Gaysorn Amarin, easy to find – just walk along the skywalk, enter the mall, and you'll see it right away.

The food is delicious. Today, I ordered cold noodles, a hamburger rice bowl, and a salmon quinoa dish. All of them were tasty, and you can't go wrong with any of them.

If you're around here and unsure of what to eat, this restaurant is a pretty good option.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thananun Ua-arak

sample_reviews_en.text: A great place for breakfast or for casual all-day dining. They serve Japanese-inspired modern food with good quality. Had a great prawn avocado toast and a very tasty sweet corn soup with cheese bits in it. They also know their coffee game - working with their in-house specialty coffee shop offering four different roasts (tip: Myanmar Med-Lite Roast) expertly brewed on their La Marzocco machine. Their outdoor seating area is beautiful and invites to linger longer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Markus D

restaurants.name: Yeast Rustic Pizza
restaurants.address:

31 Soi Ramkhamhaeng 24, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, although the steak was a bit pricey. We had pasta and pizza, which were both great. Our seafood pasta, with fresh New Zealand mussels and prawns, was fantastic. The escargots were also good. The restaurant is small, with only four tables, but it wasn't very busy. We had a reservation, and there was only one other table occupied since we'd booked before us.

The atmosphere was very homey, like a small, family-run business. We waited a while for our food, but not too long considering we were the first table. Another table waited considerably longer. If you're hungry, I recommend allowing extra time, as it's a small, family-run business with only one chef preparing orders in sequence. Reservations are highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutthacha P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a rustic atmosphere, as the name suggests. It's not very big, with about 4-5 tables, so it's recommended to call and make a reservation beforehand.

The pizza has a delicious crispy crust and the pesto sauce is just right.
The Caesar salad isn't too creamy, just right, with a nice tangy finish to balance the richness.
The fish dish had a surprisingly generous portion of fish, but it was enough for me. Overall, this dish was enjoyable and I could eat it repeatedly.
The mushroom and chestnut soup was thick and not greasy, and tasted great with the bread drizzled with olive oil.

The prices are on the higher side. I'd recommend trying it at least once.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fiilm Filmm

sample_reviews_en.text:
Small rustic Italian with family run operation. Cool interior with lots of props and tasteful decoration.  Parking at shop front.

Food : a super ready made pizza dough  with heartless / not fresh salmon & Parma  pizza. We don’t like its cold heart pizza.

Truffle soup is very creamy, thick with corn / cheese ingredient. Totally opposite feeling of healthy soup we expected. It felt like a potatoes soup.

Avocado prawn salad: 🥗 what could go wrong. Salad from super market with half slice avocado and 4 fried shrimps. Dressing is standard mayonnaise.

Wish the pizza chef work with smile and happy attitude. Perhaps it’s his moody’s day today. 🤔

#MadamBananaDoubtofReturn
sample_reviews_en.author: Nijaya I

sample_reviews_en.text:
Here are my personal comments:
The restaurant is beautifully decorated in a European-style, small house setting. However, the kitchen is inside the restaurant, so the food smells permeate the air. The ventilation system isn't very effective.
It's a small restaurant with limited seating. Initially, I asked to sit at another table, but the restaurant said it was reserved. I didn't mind, but when the reserved customers arrived, they asked where they wanted to sit, which confused me a little.

Overall, the food tasted okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sungsit Na Takuatoong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Yeast Rustic Pizza 🍕🌿

A small pizza and Italian restaurant with a great atmosphere.
The shop is full of cute details, giving a warm and cozy feeling.

The dish I tried was the *Bacon Pesto Pasta*.
The basil aroma was fresh, the pesto was rich and just right, and the slightly salty bacon balanced the flavors perfectly.
It's a simple dish, but very well-made, not greasy, and very enjoyable.

Perfect for a chill brunch, a light date, or even a solo visit.
Definitely a place I want to come back to again 🤍

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
sample_reviews_en.author: Polli Kissa

sample_reviews_en.text: This small restaurant makes the best pizza I've ever had. The chef carefully selects the ingredients, and many other dishes are delicious, such as the cold cuts (excellent value for money), truffle mushroom soup, and Caesar salad. The prices are mid-range, offering great value for the quality (around 500+ baht per person). I've brought friends and family here, and everyone loves it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Go Go Cat

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Italian restaurant is a little far from the Japanese residential area, but it's close to my workplace and I often go there for lunch.
They serve delicious pasta and pizza.
Menu prices include tax.
I've tried the Arrabbiata, Genovese, and Bolognese pasta,
and have been very satisfied with every one. The restaurant has a quiet atmosphere, making it easy to talk.
sample_reviews_en.author: SHIGEKI SATO

sample_reviews_en.text: This small Italian restaurant serves homemade food with only a few tables, but the decor is beautiful, with cute décor, creating a warm and friendly atmosphere. Food takes about 20-30 minutes to arrive, but it's delicious, made with high-quality ingredients, and the portions are generous. The prices are on the higher side, but it's definitely worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siwakorn Job

restaurants.name: Rak Kimchi (รัก ️กิมจิ) Korean Restaurant
restaurants.address:

429 Happy Land Sai 1 Rd, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Someone recommended this place, so I decided to try it.
I liked it!
It's a family-run business, and the recipes are like home cooking. I met both the grandmother and the Korean owner, which assured me the taste was authentic. There's a wide variety of side dishes, and you can refill them as much as you want, perfect for someone like me who loves vegetables and side dishes.
The prices are reasonable, and the portions are generous – in fact, I felt it was quite cheap.
The staff were all very helpful. Everything I ordered was delicious (I haven't tried everything on the menu yet, but the dishes I've tried so far have been to my liking). Especially the Jajangmyeon (black bean noodles), this is the first restaurant that makes it so perfectly to my taste.
The fried chicken was also delicious.
The stir-fried pork with sauce was also tasty.
The Korean BBQ set and Kimbap were both good.
If you're in the area or can easily get there, I highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Siri-on Umarin

sample_reviews_en.text: 🫶🏻✨This is my second time at this restaurant; it's one I always crave whenever I'm in Bangkok.
