I love Korean food, and initially, I searched everywhere for Korean restaurants on Google Maps, which led me to this place. I always make a point of taking a taxi here to eat. The Korean food here is incredibly delicious and authentic. Whether it's the grilled meat, ramen, or soup, everything is wonderfully prepared with meticulous attention to detail. The owner seems to be Korean; he speaks fluent English and Thai, is very polite, and provides excellent service. Dining here is a true pleasure. They always offer a slice of watermelon after each meal, which is a delightful surprise. This time, they even gave me a complimentary Korean biscuit. And when I asked for takeout, they thoughtfully packed it up for me and provided complimentary side dishes. Five stars! I recommend everyone who reads this review to try it; you won't be disappointed!🤩🤩🥳🥳🥰🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Xiomya

sample_reviews_en.text:
I didn't intend to write a review, so I didn't take any pictures, but I was so impressed I had to write this.
1. The food came out very quickly.
2. The portion size, price, quality, and taste were excellent. Compared to other Korean restaurants I've tried, I especially loved the kimchi – it was cheap and good. The only thing was the vegetables could be more varied (they even packed up the leftovers for me to take home).
3. The service was excellent. It seemed like the owner was the one who took good care of us and was attentive throughout the meal. The staff were also very nice.
4. The restaurant was clean, the smell wasn't overwhelming, it wasn't too hot or too cold, and there was nice music playing.
Parking is available in front of and next to the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apinya Punchai

sample_reviews_en.text: I took a picture during my meal because it was so delicious that I wanted to write a review. It was my first time here, and I was very satisfied. The price was reasonable, and the portions were huge, so I took the leftovers to go and ate them again that night. Oh, and the Korean owner is incredibly kind. These days, I often see Korean restaurants where people don't even greet customers or show any basic manners, but the owner here is very kind. He told me to try a lot of food because it was a lot, and encouraged me to order more. The only thing I regret is that they don't have alcohol. I'd love to go for a drink, but that's a shame. Anyway, I had a great meal. I'll order delivery often. I hope your business prospers.
sample_reviews_en.author: 경상도왕발

sample_reviews_en.text:
After traveling to Koh Chang, Rayong, and Trat in Thailand, I visited Rak Kimchi, a Korean restaurant in Bangkok.

Since I love Thai food so much and was satisfied with my trip, eating Korean food felt like just a formality. But to my surprise, it was a moment that erased all memories of the expensive Thai food I had eaten in the past.

The soft tofu stew, beef short ribs, spicy pork neck, kimchi stew, and side dishes all tasted more authentically Korean than food in Korea. The kind owner's son was overflowing with kindness and manners! It was so delicious that I definitely want to come back at least once more before heading back to Korea the day after tomorrow.

I enjoyed the meal very much.

Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: 신희수

sample_reviews_en.text:
I travel to Thailand every summer.

This year, after passing through Rayong and visiting Koh Chang, I had dinner at Lak Kimchi, a Korean restaurant in Bang Kiphi. I stopped by to verify this because several people said that dining there allows you to deeply experience the taste of Korea in Thailand.

Although I usually make it a rule to eat local food while traveling, the meal at Lak Kimchi made me realize just how moving it is to eat Korean food in Thailand, and allowed me to feel the immense comfort and inspiration that Korean cuisine provides.

I sincerely recommend that those reading this experience the same moving emotions I did here.
sample_reviews_en.author: 한정혜

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Korean restaurant, run by Koreans, has a spacious and airy atmosphere with a peaceful setting. We visited during lunchtime on a weekday. The owner's mother was very friendly and welcoming, and the service was excellent.

The taste was perfect for our palate.
The vegetables were fresh and clean.
The stir-fried pork in sauce was flavorful and rich, with a variety of side dishes (banchan) – 6-7 different kinds.

The braised pork ribs were tender and fall-off-the-bone, and the potato soup was sweet.

They also provide complimentary fruit and dessert after the main meal.

We frequent this restaurant often.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanyarat Sutprasert

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is near my house, a 2-minute walk away. I pass by it every day but never stopped in. When I finally tried it, the atmosphere inside was spacious and airy. On my first visit, the owner recommended about 5 or 6 dishes for the four of us (parents and two children). The portions were generous; we couldn't finish everything and had to take some home. The owner is kind, lovely, and friendly. On my first visit, I even got a free serving of steamed egg custard.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pan T

restaurants.name: Saphan Kwai Authentic Basil Restaurant Original Thai Food
restaurants.address:

327 Saliratthawiphak Rd, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is absolutely amazing! The food is incredibly delicious, bursting with authentic Thai flavors that leave you craving more. The price-performance ratio is completely fair, offering excellent value for such high-quality dishes.

The place is also spotlessly clean, which adds to the overall comfort of dining here. On top of that, the owner is extremely kind and friendly, making you feel genuinely welcome from the moment you walk in.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for an authentic Thai food experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Manuel Keller

sample_reviews_en.text:
I usually buy from them regularly because the taste is decent. But the last time I went, I specifically planned to eat there. When I got to the shop, most of the tables were full, but I tried to walk in anyway. However, the owner completely ignored me. I asked if there were any empty tables, and he just replied, "No," and that was it. He didn't even look at me. He just kept cooking.

Thank you very much. I won't be coming back again with that kind of service. I'm disappointed, as I used to think this shop was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pat S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is good, just abit too salty. Very crowded during lunch time. There is only 1 person cooking and serving so the service is abit tight. I also have the vibes that the owner is not willing to serve me as he directed other groups of locals who came later than me. Only after  a local invited me to be seated before him then I get a seat.

Good food but poor service so won’t be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boon Sun Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Real basil, delicious taste It's very easy to eat. Order beef basil. The texture is not sticky. Water is included. The damage is 79 baht.

It is a beautiful place to go.
There is a lot of love in the world.
There are many things that happen in the future, and there are many things that happen in the future.
There is a lottery in the shop and there is a lottery in 79.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattaya Jamjumrad

sample_reviews_en.text: A small restaurant close to BTS Saphan Khwai with amazing food. I got a Pad Kra Pao with beef, 2 eggs on top and a drink for 99 THB. The food is cooked freshly right outside and tastes very good. You can also tell him the spice level you like. I will definitely come back here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kim

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was really good and a good portion 👍 I had rice with chicken and an egg, I asked for spicy. It was really spicy but not too spicy for me. Has fans inside and Sufficient seating. I will likely eat here again and try some other food. Bro is nice and chill 😎
sample_reviews_en.author: FadedShadedJaded

sample_reviews_en.text:
What a nice discovery this place was. We ended up going there three times during our week stay in the area. Super affordable  holy basil pork/beef or chicken Pad Krapao prepared fresh plate by plate from the very friendly owner.

6* in Ari district.
sample_reviews_en.author: L G

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food is ok. But the boss asked me if I want an egg on my basil pork rice and he charged me an extra 10 baht (total 69 baht), despite the stated price of 59 baht. I didn’t want to spoil my mood by arguing with him.
A very dishonest man. Yucks!
sample_reviews_en.author: Niwa T

restaurants.name: Indian Rasoi Restaurant Pattaya . حلال
restaurants.address:

358/5 Phra Tamnak, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We've been dining here for years. We love the hospitality, the friendliness, the huge selection of dishes, and the reasonable prices. The food is delicious and filling. The portions are large. You can also get takeout. Thank you for the excellent service. The restaurant underwent a minor renovation in December 2024, making it even cozier and offering more seating. They still provide a complimentary vegetable plate and flatbread while you wait for your order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ольга Большакова

sample_reviews_en.text: So happy we found this place last week :) The curries were rich with flavour, rice was fresh and the naan served hot and straight from the oven. The Thali is fantastic value and very tasty. The owner is a very kind and friendly man. Awesome service and meals arrived quickly. Everything tasted fresh and delicious. Have been looking for an Indian Restaurant in Pattaya with great food at a reasonable price and this is it! Will be back again for sure!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarah McTackett

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered one Chicken Biriyani and 2 Veg thaali. Veg thaali doesn’t have thaali, just rice, dal, one mix veggie and curd salad. Rotis and papad also available. But it’s not thaali. Rice was not fully cooked. Biriyani was quite ok, had enough chicken pieces and Raita. However over quality with price doesn’t seem a good combination. Not recommended if you are looking for an Indian meal. Also if you are a light eater it could be a fine option.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cybermon K S

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious Indian food here. So far I have always been eating the vegetarian dishes because they are so perfect but I will also try something else another time. The cooks in the kitchen surely knows what they are doing. They advertise that it is "Simple home cooking" and it might be correct to call it like that, but nevertheless is it very delicious food in all it's simplicity.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tubia

sample_reviews_en.text:
It’s a very good Indian restaurant. I've been going there for years 3 to 4 times a month and it's still just as good. It is not luxurious, but the food is excellent and the prices modest. My favorite dish is Chicken Tikka Massala. But the menu is very varied. The Tandouri Fish is also delicious. You can take away what we haven't eaten.
An address to remember.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andre Brunner

sample_reviews_en.text: I really wanted to try delicious Indian cuisine, we chose according to the reviews on the map and were not mistaken!  We really liked the food here))) Vegetarian thali is very tasty, chicken masala is even tastier))) There are Russian dishes on the menu and we noticed several Russian families.  And that means a really good place.  The staff is friendly)))
sample_reviews_en.author: Yulia Rodicheva

sample_reviews_en.text: I had it delivered, it came very hot, the nan was wrapped in foil. The chicken masala was a lot of white meat, only one piece had bone. The curry was thick and a little spicy. I got 2 orders of butter Nan and I'm glad I did because it was a lot of curry. There was a tray of onions ,cucumbers  tomatoes. Very very good, I will order there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: frederick b

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered from grab and they gave my hot tea in a plastic bag. This is pathetic and totally unacceptable. Why put hot tea in the menu if you can't even spend some money to buy some cups for take away. Really disappointed as we pay a lot of money to these restaurants and they fail to provide even basic packaging and service.
sample_reviews_en.author: esmee gautam

restaurants.name: Anmole Indian Restaurant Pratunam Bangkok
restaurants.address:

122/13 Ratchaprarop Rd, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had an excellent dining experience. The food quality was outstanding, with authentic Indian flavors and perfectly prepared dishes. The staff were humble, friendly, and attentive, making us feel very welcome throughout our visit.

The quality and taste of the food were truly impressive. If you’re in Bangkok and craving delicious Indian cuisine, this place is definitely worth a visit. Highly recommended! 😊🍽️🇮🇳
sample_reviews_en.author: Subo

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant made one of the kindest actions I've experienced. I was leaving to Cambodia one hour before trying to have dinner around the place and I had just a little cash left. They invited me to enter knowing that I only had 60 bats and they gave me so much food for that ridiculous price. Good deserved review for them!!! Thank you very much
sample_reviews_en.author: Marcos Martín

sample_reviews_en.text: I received a terrible delivery yesterday. Since you don't have a phone number for feedback, I'll write here. My order was all in a bag, since the box wasn't wrapped, but open. Naturally, I can't eat something like that. My evening was ruined. I threw everything out and ordered from another place. Before that, everything was always fine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Валерий М

sample_reviews_en.text: For those who have trouble finding similar food in Indonesia, you can come to this place. The taste here is delicious. For Indonesian tongues, the taste is similar, more spiced. Especially the chicken tandoori, it's really the best. Also order chicken biryani. I didn't expect to find this place in an alley, the food is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: syko Wirawan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ambience is okay like basic restaurants.
In Indira Market near Indira Square.
Food: mix reactions like
Dal Tadka was very good
Chicken Biryani was very good
Mutton Rogan Josh - uncooked , even after re cooking was still uncooked .
Service was good and staff was friendly and try to serve all as per requirements of customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nitin Srivastav

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s best indian restaurant, you’ll get best tea here if you are proper india tea lover I m traveling since 30 days finally I found a place where I can have my type ginger tea , staff is very good helpful, taste is amazing now I m having all my meals here after having international meals from past one months
sample_reviews_en.author: Udit Nagar

sample_reviews_en.text:
It’s run by Nepali people offering Indian food. Food quality and quantity is good. Have Variety of items in both veg and non-veg. Veg and Non-Veg thali is available for reasonable rates.It’s in walkable  distance from Platinum Fashion mall.

I will strongly recommend this hotel for Indian food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brahma Evuri

sample_reviews_en.text:
We absolutely love the food here! Never been there in person, but we order it every other week. Everything we have tried is delicious! And the portion sizes are excellent too.

They have a lot of vegetarian options, but the meat is also delicious, so it should make everyone happy. :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Katherine Schopf

restaurants.name: Khun Pa Rat Na
restaurants.address:

1014 ตรงข้าม On Nut 23 Alley, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Auntie's Rad Na Yod Pak (changed name from the old shop) in On Nut, opposite Wat Yang, is the real deal. I've eaten here many times and it's never disappointing 🙌
The gravy is rich and perfectly balanced, not too greasy. The pork is incredibly tender and delicious. The kale is crispy and soft without being bitter. The noodles have a distinct wok aroma. You can tell from the first bite that the cook has excellent technique and extensive experience 🔥
It's a simple shop but the quality exceeds the price. Anyone passing through the On Nut area must stop by and try it at least once. You'll understand why the locals love this place 💚🥢
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasin Daha

sample_reviews_en.text:
Khun Pa Rad Na On Nut - This restaurant serves incredibly complete Rad Na and Pad See Ew (Thai noodle dishes). Their highlight is the perfect amount of fermented soybean paste – not too much, not too little – resulting in an incredibly well-balanced flavor. The noodles are crispy and stay crisp for a long time without being oily. The kale is not bitter, and the vegetables are very fresh and crunchy. The Pad See Ew is incredibly flavorful and well-rounded. I'll definitely be back.

Note: Parking is quite difficult; you'll have to park on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thiganesh

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been checking out reviews for a while and finally got to try it. The gravy noodles were amazing! The flavor was rich and intense. I usually like strong flavors, but I didn't need to add any extra seasoning. The pork was perfectly tender, and the vegetables were soft, crisp, and delicious – served in small, long stalks. I really liked it; it's the perfect gravy noodles/stir-fried noodles with soy sauce. The wok-fried aroma was incredible, and the portion was generous – great value! 👍🏻🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Narumol Laisuwan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered a regular bowl of stir-fried noodles with pork, 50 baht.
The portion size is good for the price; the sauce fills the bowl.
The highlight is the incredibly tender marinated pork. The taste is great 😋
Plenty of fresh vegetables, nice and crunchy.
The sauce is light with a slight sweetness; no need to add extra sugar.
The noodles are soft and separate, not sticking together, but lack a bit of the wok-fried aroma.
Overall, it's a standard stir-fried noodle shop 👍
7.5 out of 10
sample_reviews_en.author: Opas Samsen

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was delicious, but the crispy noodles with soy sauce were basically stir-fried with pork and vegetables in soy sauce and then poured over the crispy noodles.
The vegetables were very tender, and the pork was soft and delicious.
There was a bit too much dark soy sauce, but it could be adjusted by seasoning (maybe it's just a matter of personal taste).
The large, crispy noodles with gravy were great; personally, I liked the gravy a lot, but the regular noodles were even better.
sample_reviews_en.author: L B

sample_reviews_en.text:
The rice noodle dish with gravy was delicious; the pork was tender and the portion was generous. However, I personally found the stir-fried noodles with soy sauce a bit too sweet. Those who like sweet flavors would probably enjoy it. Even on a rainy day, people kept coming in to order.

P.S. The downside for drivers is that parking is very difficult; you have to find parking on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suttimon Narongchaisarid

sample_reviews_en.text: The stir-fried wide rice noodles with soy sauce are the best. Delicious, with that wonderful wok aroma. The sauce is good, they don't skimp on the kale, and the taste is excellent, befitting an old established shop. The atmosphere is nothing special; you sit at tables on the sidewalk while enjoying your food and inhaling car fumes. There's no parking, so you'll have to find your own parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: กินเที่ยวเฟี้ยวเงาะ

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here because I wanted to try their recommended stir-fried noodles with thick sauce. It was lunchtime, and all the tables inside were occupied, and they were also preparing a lot of takeout orders, so I knew it was a popular place. The stir-fried noodles with thick sauce have a sweet sauce that suits Japanese tastes and is easy to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: 八鶴かぼす

restaurants.name: Malar Thai-Indian Cuisine
restaurants.address:

360/15 Samsen 4 Alley, Khwaeng Ban Phan Thom, Khet Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We tried the Rajma Dal, basmati rice and a side of chapati tawa. The food was good, except for the fact there was zero salt. I said to the young waiter that it would be excellent if the chef just added salt. He explained that the chef (his sister) doesn’t add salt as it is the preference of their European customers. It seemed like a lame excuse to me, so I suggested he tell his sister that a little salt would help elevate the flavor of the spices.

I said we’ll come back tomorrow to try the masala chai, veggie samosas and aloo paratha for breakfast, to which the waiter replied, “Ok sir. And I will be sure have my sister add salt.”

The next day, we arrive in the afternoon and the waiter says they are out of the veggie samosas, so we leave.

We go back two days later and the waiter tells us they still have no vegetarian samosas, so now I’m stuck writing this review.

I’m just happy I found an Indian restaurant nearby that isn’t afraid to season properly (and also has excellent vegetarian samosas).

To recap, this restaurant serves bland food made to “European” tastes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bob

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an absolutely fabulous restaurant I only stumbled across, as I was staying around the corner. I quickly Googled it and the reviews were great, so I decided to 'give it a go'... one of my best restaurant decisions ever!

The food and service were excellent, as were the almost unbelievable prices (when compared with the UK)!

They even 'knocked up' a Chicken Tikka Jalfrezi (as it wasn't on the menu) and... it was absolutely fantastic - so much so, that I had it at least half-a-dozen times over the remaining 10 days of my trip!!!

I'll definitely be back (t)here next time I'm in BKK/Thailand!

BTW, other great dishes: Aloo & Chana Chat (Spicy), Chicken Tikka, Onion Bhajis (Spicy)
sample_reviews_en.author: Anthony Rowe

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re in Bangkok and craving something real Indian food, you have to try Malar Thai-Indian Cuisine. Honestly, this place lives up to the hype—it might just be the best food in the city.

The flavors are incredible.

The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and the staff are is super friendly, which makes the whole experience even better. It’s the kind of place where you go once and immediately start planning your next visit.

Highly recommend this spot to anyone who loves flavorful food—Malar is an absolute gem in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Xymbio

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing Indian restaurant! I asked for my dish not spicy at all (because spicy food doesn’t agree with me), and they were incredibly kind and attentive to my request. They made me a Butter Paneer that was honestly one of the best I’ve ever had- rich, creamy, and perfectly balanced in flavor. It was absolutely delicious.
The food was excellent, the atmosphere was lovely, and everyone here is super friendly and welcoming. I’m very happy with my experience and highly recommend this place! 🍛✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Ella Assraf

sample_reviews_en.text: You can't judge a book by its cover, and that is certainly the case with Malar Restaurant. We had the most delicious food and can't recommend highly enough the Palak chicken and the chicken Kadai. We also had breads and a vegetable dish they were all so good.  Our server Adi was excellent,  speaking good English so was able to explain the ingredients in   each dish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alison Golt

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went on a hunch. Turned out to be the best decision. Super delicious food. Freshly made when you order it. Meaning that you can also tell them how you would like it to be made (e.g. spicy or not). While eating we ordered some more. That's how good it was.
If you're looking for delicious, affordable Indian food, this place is a must visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gigi L

sample_reviews_en.text: The best food as said, with an affordable price and best service.The food is freshly made and deliciousness is beyond the imagination giving a taste of home.So many vegetarian options available and also non veg. I really appreciate it. I would like to recommend  to all of them who are looking for homely tastes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aditya Btr

sample_reviews_en.text: I truly love Indian restaurants in Bangkok - unfortunately this isn’t one of them. Prices are way too high, portions very tiny, food not warm anymore and tasted as they forgot the spices. The owner’s kids were running around, screaming and made me feel really uncomfortable. I would not recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nadine Theis

restaurants.name: CROW Craft & Cuisine
restaurants.address:

86 Inthrawat Rd, Khwaeng Bang Ramat, Khet Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food, good prices, and parking available.
The duck breast with tamarind and citrus sauce was amazing. I wasn't impressed at first, but as I kept eating, it became surprisingly delicious. The skin was slightly crispy, and it paired perfectly with the sweet and sour vegetable salad.
sample_reviews_en.author: sarer bebty

sample_reviews_en.text: Honestly, the food tastes great, but don't expect much from the ambiance. This is my honest comment. When you come here, focus on the taste. Think of it this way: if this restaurant were prettier or located in the city, the price wouldn't be the same.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aim Hans

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, especially the signature fusion dishes. The menu was more diverse than expected and the prices were reasonable. The staff provided good service, and the food arrived quickly. The restaurant had a nice atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanavit Pitaksith

sample_reviews_en.text: The foods are very delicious. We highly  recommend green curry with grilled pork, pork chop, picanha Australia and seabass curry roll. Staff are very friendly. We could combine this with car wash service at the next door.
sample_reviews_en.author: Porntip Jarusiritrangkul

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! My favorites were the Australian picanha (tender meat at a reasonable price), the clear tom yum soup (the shrimp were fresh, firm, and very large!), and the stir-fried chayote was also tasty. 😍 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Ank Sev

sample_reviews_en.text: All the food was delicious and very well-prepared. I especially loved the crab roe bread and the shrimp in fish sauce. The restaurant has ample parking and the food came out quickly, no waiting required.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nunnapath Teeratecha

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was beautifully presented, delicious, and reasonably priced. The atmosphere was private and relaxing. We finished with a refreshing and delicious orange-flavored dessert.
sample_reviews_en.author: suradej chuephanich

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here. For dinner, I ordered roti with green curry beef, beef salad, crispy noodle salad, shrimp and bacon fried rice, and baked chicken steak. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornchai O

restaurants.name: BAD POUTINE
restaurants.address:

1338B Song Wat Rd, Chakkrawat, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don't let the name fool you—there is absolutely nothing "bad" about this poutine!
Review:
If you're craving ultimate comfort food, you need to track down Bad Poutine. I just had a serving, and it completely blew me away.
The Fries: They use proper thick-cut, skin-on fries that actually hold up to the toppings without turning into complete mush.
The Toppings: They absolutely load it up. The pulled meat is incredibly tender and soaked in a rich, savory gravy that coats every single bite perfectly. The fresh green onions scattered on top cut through the richness just right.
The Cheese: The real star of the show. They use proper, massive mozzarella cheese. If you want proof, just look at the ridiculous cheese pull I got in my second photo!
The street-food vibe—eating it right off the custom branded paper on a blue milk crate—just adds to the experience. Highly recommend checking them out if you want a seriously decadent meal. You won't regret it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyate King

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried to use the QR code placed in front of me before paying, but it didn't work. They saw that I was relieved, yet they still made the food. Without prior notice, they kept asking me questions in a sarcastic Thai tone, claiming they only had cash and credit cards. They held up my companions, who went to withdraw money, treating them like criminals. They were extremely rude. (+ Added via comment) Didn't you say you were the owner, not an employee, back then? You and your employee teamed up to mock me and kept forcing me to pay with cash. Even when I said I was going to get money, they treated me like a thief, and when I told them it was rude, they laughed at me. It's seriously ridiculous. It also pissed me off that the quotation marks clearly indicate the comment was sent by an AI. (+ Why did you delete the reply?) I mean, at least the food should have tasted good... This really makes me more angry... Downvote
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiho Park

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing! As a Canadian I immediately knew I had to buy this. It’s a really tiny place but the poutine is so tasty, it could’ve had a bit more gravy but otherwise was perfect.

The resto owner was really nice and friendly, he’s there by himself cooking everything, so there was a long wait and no seating in the resto but he brought chairs outside for the dozen or so ppl outside waiting and even asked the neighbour guy to borrow a stool so people could sit and wait.

Downside is there’s no aircon so we had to sit outside and it was FREAKING HOT! Worth the heat and the wait though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vaughn Friesen

sample_reviews_en.text: Their pastrami poutine was the perfect meal after hours of walking the streets of Song Wat. Chips were piping hot, pastrami was soft and tender, gravy was peppery and seasoned well, and the cheese curds were stretchy and gooey and enveloped everything to create THE bite. If you want to have it for dine-in (which I highly recommend) and if your knees are up for it, they have camping chairs and tables set up at the alley right next to it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sel

sample_reviews_en.text: Yummy poutine. We had the butter chicken Putin and we had the deep fried pickles which were delicious It's a window order style restaurant with little seats in an alleyway beside and you can sit and watch all the people walking by. The staff were attentive the food was delicious the gravy on the poutine was so delicious I'll be back for another Poutine and try one of their other ones maybe even the pulled pork next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joey B

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent, magnificent, glorious!
This poutine was incredibly delicious, even better than in Canada! I've never been to Canada, though. Especially the pull-pork, so fragrant with herbs. Authentic Canadian food is very hard to find, but you can eat it here! The staff were lovely; I met the owner that day, who was very nice. Overall, this is now one of my favorite restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: mofox

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious. The gravy still had a nice meaty aroma and wasn't too salty. The potatoes weren't pre-made, and the meat was of good quality.
There's seating in front of the shop, with camping-style chairs. The atmosphere wasn't very inviting, and it felt a bit dirty.
The staff provided good service and were very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Red Rose

sample_reviews_en.text: As a Quebecer, I can affirm this is good poutine despite the funny place name. If you want to experience it closer to a real Quebec poutine, buy extra cheese. P.S. If you tried it out when they just opened and didn't like it, I can affirm they've definitely improved a lot and it's now really good, you should try again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vincent Choquette

restaurants.name: เจิดจรัส 90's Bar & Restaurant
restaurants.address:

Pattaya Tai 5 Aly, ตำบลหนองปรือ Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Live Music, Lakeside Vibes, Friendly Staff, and Unbeatable Prices!

I stumbled upon a little slice of paradise today. A cozy lakeside restaurant with live music playing inside — the kind that soothes your soul and makes you forget about time. The gentle strum of a guitar, a voice that pulls you in, and a vibe that just feels right.

The staff? Absolutely amazing. Warm smiles, quick service, and genuine hospitality that makes you feel like a regular from the moment you walk in. It’s rare to find such natural friendliness and attention to detail.

Now let’s talk prices — because this deal is just too good not to share: Before 9 PM, you get 5 beers for only 100 baht! That’s right, 5 beers for 100 baht. Try finding that anywhere else!

Imagine sipping a cold beer while the sun sets over the lake, a soft breeze brushing past, music in the background, and nothing but good vibes all around. Whether you’re here to chill, chat, or just enjoy the atmosphere, this place delivers on all fronts.

If you’re in Thailand or planning to visit, add this gem to your list. Great drinks, beautiful setting, lovely people — what more could you ask for?
sample_reviews_en.author: Bekir KARACI

sample_reviews_en.text:
The minced pork basil rice took ages to prepare. I waited an hour and 20 minutes. I called 4-5 times, starting with the first 30 minutes, and then every 10-15 minutes until the second person came back to ask again. It still wasn't ready. The other guy who followed up was very nice and tried to follow up with me.
The girl who refilled the beer had a very nonsensical response. She said the food was cooked in order, saying that if you order later, it will be a bit slower, but we ordered everything at the same time. She also said that difficult dishes would be slower. If fried food comes quickly, is basil really that difficult to make?
PS.
+1 for the guy.
I want to compliment the guy for his good service, politeness, patience, and constant follow-up. The guy told me he had been waiting for a long time, and he called me several times.
The food I received: the fried chicken wings and salmon salad were delicious and okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: pichy test

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious cuisine meets a wonderful atmosphere with convenient access. Offering affordable prices, this venue is ideal for fans of 90s music, featuring a variety of live bands on rotation. Guests can enjoy dining and drinks while singing and dancing to familiar classics that bring back memories of their youth. The facility includes clean restrooms and is situated near numerous tourist landmarks. With friendly service and a nostalgic playlist, it is a must-visit destination for vintage music enthusiasts ... 🎶🎸🙉🍝🍻💃🎶
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanderer Wherever

sample_reviews_en.text: Yesterday, I called to reserve a table to watch the Red Devils football match. I told the staff that I wanted a table close to the screen to watch the match. When I arrived, the staff said that the restaurant doesn't have football available. So why didn't they tell me when I called to reserve the table that the restaurant doesn't have football available? I wasted my time and felt very disappointed. However, I want to commend the staff and the restaurant manager for being responsible and for taking responsibility.
sample_reviews_en.author: อนน นรินทรางกูล

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great place with a very cool 90s vibe.
The atmosphere is lively but still comfortable, perfect for drinks or a relaxed night out.
Food is tasty and well presented, and the beer prices are very good.
Staff are friendly, fast, and attentive, even when the place gets busy.
Nice music selection and a welcoming crowd.
Definitely one of the better bars in Pattaya for good food, drinks, and overall ambience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jack “Mee” Hoff

sample_reviews_en.text: We traveled a long distance and reserved a table in advance, but they didn't tell us the time the table would be released. We called again, but no one answered. They only called back when it was almost time to release the table. They wouldn't even let us wait a little, even though it wasn't the customer's fault. The admin was rude and unprofessional. Very disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marisa Homjan

sample_reviews_en.text: The tables were packed so close together, it was almost like people were fighting. I asked the staff if it was really that crowded, and they said it was normal. I couldn't even move my chair; if I tried to move, the people behind me would stare. For a restaurant this size, I recommend at least having enough space to move around to use the restroom.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุภาภรณ์ ก้องสมุทร

sample_reviews_en.text:
The first time I came here, I intended to check out the marketing. So, that day, I ordered 10 dishes and 20 glasses of Chang draft beer. There was a promotion before 9 PM, which included an additional large tower.
I was so drunk I was on the verge of falling over. Everything was perfect. I had to come to enjoy the 90s music.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rodsarin Wilkerson

restaurants.name: This is Basil
restaurants.address:

250 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Klongtonsai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: This is a basil stir fry ผัดกระเพรา restaurant that is also a burger place. I had the stir fried beef basil dish with egg on top. It was actually a very tasty dish and one of the most tasty basil dishes I have tried in Thailand!
sample_reviews_th.author: Yai Buranakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had been wanting to visit this place since it opened and even though I lived in the same area I never made it. Now, after leaving Bangkok and only visiting as a tourist months later I finally came here and I'm sorry I didn't come before. This is the best pad krapaw I had in my nine years of living in Thailand. And I had the most classic version, the menu has a lot of krapaw varieties. The egg, what brings the dish together, was perfectly runny as well
And to wash it down, they have some really cool drinks to choose from, I had a mojito cider, loved it!
A must visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Triin Udris

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited on a Thursday at 6pm. It was nearly full but I was able to get a seat.
I ordered the minced pork gapao.
It didn't suit me.
There was not much gapao and the taste and black appearance were not good.
I didn't even think to take a photo.

It has good reviews and the restaurant is named after gapao, so I went there with high expectations, but it was disappointing.
I don't understand why it has such high reviews.
I thought other specialty restaurants were tastier.

Maybe it's just me, but I wouldn't recommend this restaurant to Japanese people.
sample_reviews_en.author: aki

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a lovely, cozy atmosphere, perfect for enjoying a cold drink. All the staff were wonderful. I ordered the minced beef basil stir-fry with duck egg, and the flavor was very unique – hard to find elsewhere – because it uses a lot of herbs and spices like black pepper and kaffir lime leaves. However, I'm deducting one star because I felt there was a bit too much basil, making it difficult to pick out the meat. Overall, though, it was a good dish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jearanai S.

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located opposite Icon Siam. Their fried duck eggs are delicious and creamy, the basil stir-fry is fragrant, and the minced pork is tender. You can choose your desired level of spiciness. Overall, the food is tasty; the basil stir-fry has a slightly salty and sweet flavor, which pairs perfectly with the chili fish sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ariya Limpaiboon

sample_reviews_en.text: Lovely food, lovely staff, lovely atmosphere. Ifyou can kind of handle heat, I recommend going for the 0 no spice option, as the mild had a kick, but it was still delicious. We had the rice with chicken, rice with duck and a burger. The food was very reasonably priced, the beer was a bit of a luxury, I would definitely recommend
sample_reviews_en.author: Katy

sample_reviews_en.text: The stir-fried basil chicken was incredibly delicious and flavorful. It came with a fried egg and Japanese rice, which complemented the dish perfectly. The chopped kaffir lime leaves added a wonderful touch. I ordered level 1 spiciness, which was just right.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mandy Mandy

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious. Be sure to add the egg and chicken. The chicken is served as something like fried chicken skin. Alcohol is on the expensive side, so I recommend ordering sparkling wine. There are various spiciness levels, but even level 1 …
sample_reviews_en.author: 루아루아

restaurants.name: Chor Chang Yok Krok
restaurants.address:

คชช 82/1 Soi Bang Na-Trat 23, Bang Na Nuea, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Went once for dinner, there was a variety of thai options. Wife got her papaya salad (ส้มตำ), pork larb and bamboo salad. Kids enjoyed the fried chicken wings, fried pork and the fried shrimp cakes (ทอดมันกุ้ง). Atmosphere was laid back, live music since it was Friday, not sure if they do that daily.

The food was good and that’s what we want sometimes, no need to go crazy with comfort food. We will definitely be back for good food, and try some other dishes.
sample_reviews_th.author: R Bunupuradah

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been there several times, and usually the food is average, but the last time I went, the taste had changed and it wasn't the same as before. The prices have increased significantly. More importantly, it shows a lack of honesty in their business practices. They're running a Thai restaurant but charge 20 baht per bowl for seafood dipping sauce, 10 baht for the spicy dipping sauce, and 10 baht for fresh vegetables. I've never encountered a restaurant like this before. I urge you to think carefully before going there. I've spent several hundred baht on my meal and still experienced this. (They didn't inform me about the charges for the dipping sauces and vegetables, but I ended up paying almost a hundred baht for them.)
sample_reviews_en.author: J P

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, fresh, and clean. They have everything, including rare dishes like ant eggs and free-range chicken. The flavors are amazing and spicy. The atmosphere is great; you can sit and enjoy a refreshing drink in a cool breeze, very relaxing. There's live music. The staff are friendly and the service is excellent. Importantly, there's parking both in front and next to the restaurant, in a dedicated area, which is very convenient. I go often, about 4-5 times already because it's close to my condo. Every time I go, I'm impressed with both the food and the service. And most importantly, the prices are very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kungnang Polio

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food arrived quickly, no long wait.
The papaya salad was delicious and spicy; I ordered the mixed papaya salad.
The Tom Yum soup with beef tendon had very large pieces of tendon. It's a shame the Tom Yum soup wasn't hot; it would have been even more delicious if it had been. The tendon itself seemed to lack the soup's flavor.

I've been here many times before. The staff are good at recommending dishes.
They are friendly and smiling.

There is ample parking and the restrooms are okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rainbow Nails

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant offers a diverse menu with many dishes, but I recommend the papaya salad and other Northeastern Thai dishes, as well as the "dancing shrimp" (gung ten). The staff are friendly and provide good service. There's live music, and an air-conditioned room for those who prefer not to sit outside. There's ample parking, and it's easily accessible. The food is reasonably priced and affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr.Dhachakorn Thitiluck

sample_reviews_en.text: This is another type of restaurant that has a considerable number of regular customers because the food is quite good, the prices are reasonable, the ingredients are of good quality, and there's music to listen to. There's seating available both on the ground floor and on the rooftop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Weera Sinsmutra

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the atmosphere is friendly. However, if you go in the evening, you should reserve a table beforehand, as it might fill up quickly from evening until nightfall.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชัชวาล แสวงกิจ

sample_reviews_en.text: The food seemed tastier than on my previous visit. I recommend the grilled meat menu. Parking is available, but they do not accept credit cards. The atmosphere is not to my preference.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pipo Travelgeek

restaurants.name: ‏Sahara Restaurant
restaurants.address:

373 31 Pattaya Sai 2 Soi 18, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Okra dish very delicious +
Lime fresh +
A few people smoking at the front door -
A little loud music in the restaurant -
A little too much fat with the lamb -
Rice and meat not proportionate -
Salad could be a bit larger potion -
Tea so dark -
Food seem not very fresh -
Noisy neighborhood, not family friendly in my view -
Needed more space and freedom in reviewing and choosing the meal in the menu -
sample_reviews_en.author: Reza Ebrahimi

sample_reviews_en.text: When I arrived in Pattaya, I was surprised that there wasn't an Iraqi restaurant, because Iraqis are masters of cooking and have impeccable taste, a legacy they inherited from Sumer and Akkad. But when I found Sahara Restaurant, the delicious flavors of our people were brought back to my mind. May your hands be blessed, Abu Hussein, and may you be granted abundance.
sample_reviews_en.author: الدكتور ظفار عبد الواحد خشان

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a diverse menu, excellent service, and the food is clean. Honestly, I dined there twice—once with chicken kabsa and once with lamb maqluba—even though I'm usually hesitant to eat meat. But honestly, it was excellent and clean. May God bless the owner, and hopefully, we'll meet again if God grants us life…
sample_reviews_en.author: بندر الحربي

sample_reviews_en.text: Cleanliness 10/10, Food 100/10, Service 100/10. If there were more than five stars, I'd give it to this one. The owner is incredibly polite and well-mannered. It's definitely worth a visit. Don't forget to take a picture as a souvenir. Sahara is something else! 🇰🇼❤️❤️ …
sample_reviews_en.author: عبدالهادي العازمي

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered a meat maqluba and a second dish of okra with rice and bread underneath. Honestly, the amount of meat was generous and the taste was perfect. I also ordered mint yogurt, which was the most delicious I've ever had, and the price was affordable for everyone.
sample_reviews_en.author: عمار الساعي

sample_reviews_en.text: I had my dinner tonight at Sahara Restaurant. I was warmly greeted by the owner. The Kebab tastes amazing and authentic. The lamb portion in the okra was very generous that I couldn't finish eating. This is one of the best restaurants I tried and highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mostafa IBRAHIM

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent restaurant! The food is delicious, the service is impeccable, and the staff is very welcoming and friendly. The atmosphere is pleasant, and everything was perfect. I highly recommend this place. Go without hesitation; you won't be disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mmz Ghita

sample_reviews_en.text: Masha'Allah, Tabarak Allah (God has willed it, blessed be God). The location is excellent, the prices are reasonable and competitive, the quality is high, the quantity is plentiful, and the service is very kind and pleasant. ♥️ Thank you, Abu Hussein.
sample_reviews_en.author: M M

restaurants.name: Chef Pom Kitchen
restaurants.address:

209, 5 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Samre, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Updated Feb 2026: Remain the best! Traditional Cantonese cuisine that evolves with modern ingredients and flavors results in excellent Chinese tables. No dish is wrong, neither in taste nor ingredients. The portion sizes of all meals are appropriate for customers, but the taste and value are exceptional! The set meals are designed for ten people, and customers can order as much as they like, making the prices very reasonable. Considering the quality of the ingredients and taste, it's among the best in Thailand. The restaurant employs a large number of waiters who provide flawless service without charging excessive extra fees, so they deserve separate rewards. The atmosphere of the restaurant, a simple shophouse without any embellishments, is something I'd like the owner to consider improving to better reflect the traditional food that has been adapted to suit modern tastes. Parking is available on the street or in a nearby parking lot.
sample_reviews_en.author: sakul leksrisakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
This traditional Chinese restaurant in the Charoen Nakhon area boasts an upscale, old-school style. The sight of the sauces and woks guarantees its long-standing tradition. It's now managed by Chef Pom, the Iron Chef of Chinese cuisine.

Dim sum is currently half-price – an incredible bargain! For this price, you get to taste Iron Chef-level food. The soy sauce and Chinese wine flavors are amazing, and the fillings are generous. I brought my mother here, and she praised it non-stop. Recommended dishes include the fried rice noodle rolls, scallop dumplings, shrimp dumplings, pork dumplings, xiao long bao, and more. For main courses, I ordered the stir-fried noodles with scallions and crab meat – it was fantastic! The Chinese soy sauce dressing was incredibly flavorful. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasin Keatparitus

sample_reviews_en.text: We made a reservation for Mother's Day lunch. The restaurant asked us to order via LINE beforehand because it would be busy. However, when we actually arrived, the food still took an extremely long time to arrive. It was so long that we had to cancel some dishes later because we couldn't wait any longer. The management was terrible, and the food wasn't tasty. The dim sum had thick dough, and most of it wasn't even hot. The dough was all stuck together, so I don't understand why it took so long. Even the Yangzhou fried rice wasn't impressive. The restaurant atmosphere was old and dirty, especially the tables, which were sticky from the moment we arrived as if they hadn't been wiped. The utensils were stained. Overall, I was unimpressed with everything.
sample_reviews_en.author: NPS N.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chef Pom's Chinese restaurant is located on Charoen Krung Road. Drive a little further and you'll find parking; then walk back. The restaurant doesn't have many tables.

The food is delicious. Chef Pom's pork ribs are deboned and coated in a tasty sauce. The stir-fried green beans with minced pork are perfectly spicy. The stir-fried black grouper with wide rice noodles is also delicious. For dessert, we had fried Chinese dates, similar to a chocolate crepe but with Chinese dates inside; it had a lovely aroma.

The staff provided good and fast service. They refilled our water constantly and cleared our plates very quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: T Jaroen

sample_reviews_en.text: We went during a 50% off dim sum promotion. Considering the size of the dumplings, they were quite small, and the shrimp dumplings had thick wrappers. The taste was standard. At the regular price, I personally thought it was expensive. But what really ruined the atmosphere was the chef constantly yelling from the kitchen, saying they were out of stock and couldn't order anymore, and that they didn't have enough shrimp. Not to mention scolding his staff. P.S. The rice noodle rolls had thick wrappers. I understand that it's the style of each restaurant, but I've seen reviews on YouTube saying they use a thin wrapper recipe.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ming Mongkol (Ming)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there on Saturday and encountered undercooked steamed pork ribs. I ate it thinking it would be tender because of the sauce coating. At first, I didn't notice, but by the third piece, I had to spit it out because it felt bad. It turned out to be raw.
I ordered every type of rice noodle roll on the menu, thinking it would be good based on their reputation. Let me tell you, the noodles were very thick, which shouldn't be the case. I was very disappointed. One meal is enough, even though I booked a week in advance.
I don't know if it's because of the 50% discount, but the quality is 50% as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pol Lertratanachai

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is on my bucket list because of a well-renowned chef, Chef Pom, a Thailand Iron Chef who specialises in Chinese cuisine.

I came with my family and ordered a promotion set of 8 plates four months ago. I would say that the quality is beyond my expectations. The menu set was well-designed and had creative ideas. All dishes are flavourful, and each dish complements the others. We all had a delightful time.

Definitely recommend. I will come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: P N

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited Chef Pom's restaurant, the Iron Chef of Chinese cuisine 👨‍🍳
It lived up to its reputation for deliciousness. I was particularly impressed with the fried dishes (Haam Shui Keo).
They were perfectly fried, crispy, and not greasy 😍
Other dishes were also delicious, and the hot/cold drinks are refillable, which is great 😊
The restaurant has parking. Drive about 20-50 meters past the restaurant and turn left. It's convenient :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Span nana

restaurants.name: Tha Arun
restaurants.address:

392/61 พระบรมมหาราชวัง Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: My favourite place for Thai food. The tom yum here is always a 10/10 for me — perfectly balanced, fragrant, and full of flavour. I was also so happy to find เมี่ยงบัว (miang bua) on the menu, a traditional Thai appetiser wrapped in lotus leaves that you rarely see these days. It’s fresh, aromatic, and absolutely delicious. Everything feels authentic, the food is consistently great, and it’s a place I always come back to.
sample_reviews_th.author: Sarah R

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were looking for a place for lunch and were wandering around and came across Rongros which I had read about. However, their menu was limited and I pointed out the menu for Tha Arun, to my husband. Tha Arun was next door to Rongros.

We chose to eat at Tha Arun because there was a grater choice for us.  From the moment we walked in, the staff were super friendly and helpful.  We chose to sit outside the terrace with a view of Wat Arun across the river.

We ordered a shrimp mango salad which was delicious.

We ordered a crab curry with rice which was amazing.  For dessert we ordered the mango sticky rice and it was my first time trying this dessert and it was yummy.

We stayed sitting at the terrace for a good few hours and the staff did  not seem to mind.

Amazing staff and delicious food great combination.  Our bill came to around £30 or so. Definitely would recommend this place and to reserve for sunset because I assume it would be amazing to see the temple at sunset.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hammimi

sample_reviews_en.text:
May 2025, Weekday Visit

Recommended Dishes: None

Advantages:
✔️Advance booking via Facebook (FB: Tha Arun) with seat selection (reservations recommended one month in advance). Bookings can be made for lunch/dinner at sunset/dinner with night view.
✔️Front row facing the Chao Phraya River, offering the best view of Wat Arun.

✔️Restaurant available.
✔️Accepts credit cards/cash payments.

Disadvantages:
✖️Food wasn't particularly amazing, but the price was high and portions were small.
✖️Outdoor seating is hot and subject to many mosquitoes.

✖️Outdoor seating requires navigating steps, inconvenient for those with mobility issues.

Reservations are recommended, especially for indoor seating, which is comfortable and cool. If you want to take photos, you can go outside during your meal. The restaurant's only advantage is its front-row river view and convenient view of Wat Arun.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naomi

sample_reviews_en.text: I didn't get to eat because no one paid attention to our table, but I wanted to write a review to let the restaurant know. We arrived at 8:30 PM. There were only two servers taking orders, and there were 5 tables of customers. We waited for a very long time. We tried to get the server's attention, but no one paid any attention. We called repeatedly, but the server seemed confused with the orders, making mistakes and serving incorrectly. We waited for almost 10 minutes, and no one cared, so we left. If you don't have enough servers, please hire more. Don't let people wait like that. Or, if there are too many customers, limit the number of tables you can serve at any one time to ensure faster and more efficient service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ztar* Yumyum

sample_reviews_en.text:
I wanted to eat at a restaurant with a view of Wat Arun, so a local friend made a reservation for me.
Since many other people have posted photos of the food, I'll just post a photo of Wat Arun.
We were seated on the riverside terrace, so the view was simply amazing. Eating while watching Wat Arun change colors in the light is exceptional.
We ordered Tom Kha Gai, Tod Mangoong, Gai Satay, and beef steak, and all were delicious. The prices were quite high, but considering the great location, we were very satisfied.
I recommend making a reservation in advance 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Noah S

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my second time here. The food tastes okay, and the cocktails are good, but the servers tend to clear things away too quickly. They even took my cocktail glass before I'd finished it! Next time, I suggest asking first. 🥹 The service is good, but I was a little disappointed that they cleared everything away, including the food. I wanted to try the Tom Kha Gai soup because it's delicious, but when I looked again, it was gone! Oh well...
sample_reviews_en.author: Narumon Luanlert

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place gets a lot right. The food was excellent and the cocktails were just as good - proper quality on both.

The setting is a big part of the appeal. It’s in a great location and the restaurant itself looks fantastic, with a really nice atmosphere.

Service was also spot on. The staff were friendly and attentive throughout, which made the whole experience feel relaxed and welcoming.

Definitely somewhere we’d happily return to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maria Gyemant

sample_reviews_en.text:
A modern Thai restaurant by the Chao Phraya River.
- Uses high-quality ingredients; the crab meat and large prawns are delicious and satisfying.
- Beautifully decorated restaurant with many photo opportunities.
- Great atmosphere; the view of Wat Arun by the river at night is stunning.
- Parking is available in front of the restaurant; parking is also available across the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: JANG Pogus

restaurants.name: Kaloang Home Kitchen
restaurants.address:

2 Si Ayutthaya Rd, Wachira Phayaban, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
An absolutely wonderful riverside restaurant in Bangkok! Set in a charming old wooden Thai house by the water, this place has quickly become one of my favourites in the city. Their food is truly exceptional — the best I have tasted in Bangkok so far. The salads alone are worth the trip: fresh, beautifully balanced, and full of flavour. There must be a chef who truly knows how to create delicious, memorable food.

Their fish dishes are, of course, the highlights: perfectly prepared and full of character. And considering the quality, the value for money is outstanding — excellent food at very reasonable prices.

They also offer hotel rooms in the same beautiful old wooden house, and I’ve had the privilege of staying here for five nights. I haven’t had a single reason to look for any other restaurants during my stay — the food here is simply that good.

The location is a little out of the way, but absolutely worth the journey — and there’s even a pier for boats just a 10-minute walk away. If you’re looking for authentic, high-quality food in a peaceful riverside setting, don’t miss this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Harri Taskinen

sample_reviews_en.text: Located directly on the river, the room is quiet and adequate for a few days in Bangkok. The beds are hard but large enough (single bed), the in-room refrigerator is good, and there's air conditioning and a ceiling fan. The shower is okay, and shampoo and shower gel are provided. Instead of a TV, we would have appreciated a bedside table and better electrical outlets. Overall, though, it's a pleasant room, a welcome contrast to the city. You can reach the city center in about 15 minutes by boat, taxi, or tuk-tuk. Note that payment is in cash upon arrival, and the room is rather noisy.
sample_reviews_en.author: sinem cessan

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious. The sour curry was authentically Thai, like my mom's – spicy and flavorful. It was served in a hot pot, enough for two people to finish the whole pot. The mackerel chili paste was tasty; the shrimp paste wasn't too salty, sweet, or sour, just perfectly balanced. The eggplant salad was fragrant with the aroma of roasted eggplant, and the dressing was delicious. In short, everything was delicious. I was so hungry I forgot to take pictures! Plus, the view by the river made me eat everything before I knew it, so I didn't even get a chance to take photos.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rawisara Jajah

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was average. The stir-fried vegetables weren't great, but the sour curry was delicious, the green curry was okay, and the steamed lime dish was good with a well-balanced flavor.

The restaurant has a simple, wooden, homey decor and is located by the Chao Phraya River, offering views of the Rama VIII Bridge, although a pontoon obstructs the view. It's nice and breezy in the evening. The service from the staff was adequate.
sample_reviews_en.author: apichart yamprasert

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old, traditional restaurant with delicious, authentic flavors.
If you like traditional tastes, I highly recommend it.
If I'm in this area, this is my number one choice, both in taste and price.
However, if you prefer modern flavors, I suggest you stay far away.
Because you definitely won't like it.

My favorite dish, which I always order two of, is the spicy eggplant salad.
It's incredibly well-made!
sample_reviews_en.author: KIT T.

sample_reviews_en.text: We had a wonderful stay; the room was comfortable and clean. The neighborhood is quiet and close to a boat station, making it easy to get to the city center quickly and at a very reasonable price! The staff were very welcoming and attentive, and the breakfast was good. We would gladly return!
sample_reviews_en.author: Maëlle Fereroles

sample_reviews_en.text: A very good experience to start our trip. A very warm welcome, attentive and helpful staff, especially a young woman who spoke excellent English and was always smiling and friendly. Having the boat nearby was very convenient for getting around.
sample_reviews_en.author: myriam sempé

sample_reviews_en.text: Bangkok's Wachira Phayaban district has a small-town feel with few tourists. Kaloang Home is a guesthouse run by the Thai restaurant Kaloang Kitchen, located on the banks of the Chao Phraya River with a view of the Rama VIII Bridge. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Hans-Joachim Schnäkel

restaurants.name: Pad Thai Mae Thong Bai
restaurants.address:

Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is very popular on social media, so I came with high expectations. I waited around 10 minutes in line, and once I finally tried the food, I have to say it was very good and definitely worth eating.

Unfortunately, the service significantly lowered the overall experience. Apart from the lady at the entrance who was managing the queue, most of the staff appeared cold and unwelcoming, with little to no smile — especially the cashier. The attitude felt tense and unfriendly, which was quite disappointing.

This felt very un-Thai. If you’ve dined at other restaurants in Thailand, the contrast in hospitality is noticeable. Considering the price, I believe customers should receive not only good food but also friendly and respectful service.

We traveled from overseas genuinely excited to enjoy local cuisine, but the cold reception made the experience less enjoyable. I hope the owner takes this feedback seriously, as the food has great potential, but the service needs improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julie F

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic and Flavorful Pad Thai at Mae Thong Bai, Siam Square

Pad Thai Mae Thong Bai at Siam Square truly lives up to its Michelin Guide recognition. Their pad Thai is incredibly flavorful, with fresh, juicy prawns and perfectly stir-fried noodles that hit all the right notes — sweet, savory, and just a hint of smokiness. Pair it with their sour vegetable minced pork soup, and you’ve got a beautiful balance of rich and tangy flavors.

The eatery itself is small and cozy, with a casual setup that gives off an authentic Bangkok street-food vibe. During lunch hours, it’s buzzing with both locals and tourists, though you’ll likely spot more tourists eager to try this well-known spot.

While the food and ambiance are top-notch, be prepared to pay a premium. Prices here are nearly double what you’d usually pay for a similar meal elsewhere in Bangkok. Still, for the quality and taste, it’s a worthwhile splurge if you’re in the area and craving a solid pad Thai experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ekim Mike

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited this restaurant after seeing a YouTuber’s recommendation. There are many food options to choose from. This time, I tried the crab fried rice. It had a generous amount of crab meat, and the eggs were cooked very smoothly and tenderly. The flavor was quite mild, perfect for those who prefer less strong tastes. I believe it would be even better if paired with some tomato sauce. The portion size was large, and I was already quite full after eating it alone, so I couldn’t try anything else. I feel a bit regretful for not trying the Pad Thai, which I’m sure would be even more satisfying. The restaurant is conveniently located near Siam Square, making it easy to go shopping or get a massage afterward. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: 金正一

sample_reviews_en.text:
The crab rice was good, but the cashier's attitude was poor.

Although it was just a simple checkout, the cashier ignored me and didn't speak. I don't know what I did to offend him, so I'm deducting points 🤷‍♀️. More than half of the customers in the restaurant are Chinese. Based on this overall assessment, I wouldn't recommend making a special trip there.

Crab Rice ✨ $310 The crab meat was plump and clean, stir-fried with garlic, oyster sauce, and soy sauce. The seasoning was heavy on salt and had a good wok hei (wok aroma).

It was alright, but not something I'd crave. The white rice was dry and hard, not tasty, and felt like it had been sitting out for a long time, or was rice from the bottom of the pot.

2026.02
sample_reviews_en.author: R. H.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently tried Pad Thai at Mae Thong Bai and it was absolutely delicious. The flavors felt very authentic, just like traditional Thai cuisine. It had a nice balance of sweetness, tanginess, and a slightly spicy kick that made it even more enjoyable. The dish was rich in flavor and well-seasoned, making every bite satisfying.
The restaurant itself is small with simple decor, but it’s clean and the service is quick and efficient. I highly recommend trying the Pad Thai here—the flavor is excellent, and the prawns are especially fresh and juicy. If you’re looking for a true taste of Thai-style Pad Thai, this place is definitely worth trying!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thái Thái

sample_reviews_en.text:
Small restaurant with cold aircon

Stir fried spicy crab meat rice is fantastic 👍👍👍
Stir fried rice noodles with crispy pork belly abit disappointed as the crispy pork belly not crispy anymore after stir fried
Longan Juice is good 👍👍
Deep fried crab ball is delicious, eat tgt with the sauce will have another different taste 👍👍

Service maybe can improve abit, if first time here was thought to queue nobody approach to you, until we saw another group to ask some question then we just aware but actually you just get the number from the waitress and wait they calling your number. But luckily is quite fast so do not need to wait long time..
sample_reviews_en.author: Catharine Ong

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place feels very much like a tourist-oriented restaurant — I’d say about 95% of the diners were overseas visitors. We went on a Friday at around 6:00 PM and were lucky to be seated immediately with no line.

The spicy crab fried rice was delicious and definitely the highlight. However, I strongly recommend skipping the mango sticky rice. It was honestly the worst sticky rice I’ve had in Thailand — hard, dry, and lacking the soft, chewy texture you’d normally expect.

Overall, it felt like a one-time visit for me. The service wasn’t particularly warm and at times even came across as a bit indifferent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alice Chang

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love Thai food and visiting Bangkok is a yearly affair for me and my partner. We have never tried this place before but decided to give it a go after seeing some review on RED.

Here’s my thought, crab meat rice was good, Tom yum too! But the other two dishes was a big no no. Firstly the ‘fresh’ river prawn tasted flakely and with no seasoning, which is a hi he disappointed. And the seafood vermicelli was just so-so.

This really gave the place a huge mark down in my pov. So if you do visit there, do try the crab meat with rice and egg or Tom yum. Other than that don’t waste your stomach space.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kelias Quek
