restaurants.name: Above Riva
restaurants.address:

392, 25-28 Maha Rat Rd, Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food wasn’t bad, but the service — especially from a staff member who appeared to be a manager — was the worst I’ve ever experienced.
I ordered a dinner set with four dishes, but even after 50 minutes, one item still hadn’t arrived. I asked the staff twice, but received no response.
They seemed completely uninterested in our table and focused only on a large group nearby.

Eventually, I had to go to the counter myself and speak directly to the manager. Without even a basic apology, she rudely asked if I wanted to cancel the item or take it to go.
I was simply asking her to check on a missing dish — after waiting an hour — and was shocked by her attitude. Isn’t it basic courtesy to first apologize and give the customer a proper explanation?

In the end, I was so disappointed that I canceled the rest of my order and took the one dish I had waited an hour for as takeout.
I had imagined a pleasant dinner while enjoying the night view, but instead I wasted my money and had one of the worst dining experiences ever.
sample_reviews_en.author: 최정효

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was a restaurant with a wonderful atmosphere. The view from the rooftop terrace was amazing, and at night the illuminated temples and cityscape looked beautiful. The location is truly superb, and I think it's a special place where you can enjoy food and drinks while taking in the Bangkok night view. It's a great place for a date or sightseeing.

The interior was a calm and sophisticated space, and the staff service was attentive. It was wonderful to relax and enjoy the view while sipping drinks.

The food was beautifully presented, and the plating was stylish. However, to be honest, the taste wasn't quite as good as I had hoped; compared to the atmosphere and location, it was a little on the ordinary side.

Nevertheless, the view and atmosphere are truly wonderful, so I would recommend it to anyone who wants to relax and enjoy the Bangkok night view. It's a great place to go for drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: チャッキー

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Surprise Worth Every Penny — Almost

We were craving mango sticky rice after dinner and wandered up to Above Riva, our hotel's rooftop restaurant, on a whim. The hotel arranged a lovely spot for us with a beautiful view, and we had barely settled in when a boat on the river below suddenly launched fireworks. Completely unexpected, utterly magical.
We ordered two portions of mango sticky rice and a glass of wine. The bill came to two and a half times what we'd paid for dinner. 😄 No regrets — the setting alone was worth it. The mango sticky rice, however, was a little disappointing despite its beautiful presentation. A rare miss.

Breakfast, on the other hand, was outstanding every single day. Fresh, generous, and with that incredible view as the backdrop — absolutely worth every penny.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cheryl Lasse

sample_reviews_en.text: All I can say is the view is great. Arrived at five and was told all the seats facing the river were reserved. There is NO ONE else in the ENTIRE restaurant. Okay, that’s weird but the seat is in the back until minutes later it begins to rain. They then seat us by the door, the worst seat in the house. It’s now 5:30 and NO ONE else has arrived. They claim that the river seats are still reserved. At 5:35 we left without eating. Not giving a place with this kind of service. Oh, and when we left NO ONE - not a SINGLE person - had come in. Nearly 40 minutes and they decided to lose a full meal sale. What a bunch of clowns. The river is FULL of restaurants like this. Give this one a miss.
sample_reviews_en.author: B

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant and the view, including of Wat Arun, are very beautiful. The food, however, was a disaster. We ordered a medium steak. After 10 minutes, a server came to ask if a thinner steak would be okay. - Okay. - After another 10 minutes, the server asked if it would be okay if the steak was well-done, as it was very thin. - Okay. - We wanted to eat something eventually. After 20 minutes, a fried roulade finally arrived. Because it was so thin, it was curled from frying and tough as shoe leather. The bill also listed roulade, not steak. And the food there is really expensive for Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Britta Kaletsch

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really enjoyed my evening at Above Eleven. The rooftop atmosphere is stylish and lively, with a beautiful view of Bangkok’s skyline, especially at sunset. The cocktails are creative and the fusion food is quite unique, which made the experience special.
That said, I feel the prices are quite expensive for what you get. The location and ambience are wonderful, but the value for money is not the best and could be more fair. Still, if you’re looking for a nice place for a date or a night out with friends, it’s definitely worth visiting at least once.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khun Aye Han Kyu

sample_reviews_en.text: This place has a very beautiful view of the river. Very impressive. Unfortunately, the food was not up to par. The pork chop and chicken entrees were average. My Angel Hair with scallops was not good. The pasta was very dry but I liked the taste of parmigiana cheese. The cost was close to 700 Baht, and it only had TWO medium size scallops. They were cooked very dry, tasted terrible. It was highly overpriced. I was terribly disappointed. Don't expect much from the wine purchase. You only get a 3 oz glass of wine. Do not recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: P Pang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great place to have dinner! The location is in the roof top of a hotel. You will be mesmerized by the beautiful views of he river itself and the beautiful wat in across the river. You can see the beautiful Wat Arun and a big buddha statue of Wat Pak Nam.  In the evening, the view is very beautiful. The light from the  Wat Arun and sometimes the cruise looks stunning.
The food is great, taste so good and the portion is big. Although it is a bit pricey, it is definitively worth it. The staff are so friendly and helpful.
sample_reviews_en.author: ketut cakra

restaurants.name: Vidhi Jib
restaurants.address:

10250 Chaloem Phrakiat Ratchakan Thi 9 Soi 6 Yaek 1, Nong Bon, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Was there for a birthday celebration. The food was excellent the atmosphere was excellent.

The deal breaker was service recovery. We ordered a Picanha steak in which the server was trying to suggest as a recommended menu. When the food was served there was also a Pana cotta that was served together. We thought it was a set or something. We started eating the steak and other part of our meals. The Pana cotta was sitting on our table for at least 15 min. As soon as we started eating the Pana cotta the server came directly to our table saying that we did not order that Pana cotta and it was delivered wrongly. The problem was it sat on our table for 15 minutes at least. They could had correct the mistake during any of those minutes but they chose to do so when we started eating which seemed too convenience. I had no problem paying for what I eat but I felt like that should had been dealt with better by the server. This left a grave sour taste for me on this establishment especially for my Birthday and I vow not to come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanut Pimhataivoot

sample_reviews_en.text:
OMG, this is a real hidden gem! It's tucked away deep between Chaloem Phra Kiat and Bang Na.
✨The food is delicious, especially the steak – OMG! It's perfectly grilled medium, and the truffle sauce with egg yolk is amazing. 180 grams for 500 baht – I finished the whole plate!
Next, the roti with truffle sauce is so good I could eat the whole plate myself. They give you a generous amount of sauce. 270 baht.
Then there's the spaghetti with creamy shrimp sauce and the fried shrimp with chili. They're both delicious, but I liked the other two more. You have to try them! They also have a wide selection of mocktails, cocktails, and wines.
💫The atmosphere is relaxed, with indoor and outdoor seating. It's best to make a reservation beforehand. If you're celebrating your anniversary here and have a reservation, they'll give you free flowers and a Polaroid photo! I'm definitely going back! 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: piyathida prechanont

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Romantic atmosphere, small restaurant, delicious food."

It's a really hidden gem, deep inside the alley 😅 My friend said the instant noodle salad was delicious, so I had to come. Okay! I ordered 3 plates of instant noodle salad 😅 The salmon salad went well with the cocktails, but my favorite was the picanha steak. The meat was tender and paired perfectly with wine. This time I tried various dishes, and everything was delicious, from pizza and spaghetti to appetizers. It was so enjoyable. I love this restaurant 🤭

📍Soi Chalerm Phrakiat Ratchakarn 9, Soi 6
(Accessible from several directions)
🚗 Parking available
sample_reviews_en.author: Apaporn (Joya)

sample_reviews_en.text: This hidden gem is just keep driving straight. Remember my directions: keep driving, don't stop. At the end of the street, turn left and you'll find it. 😅 I didn't give the food 5 stars because I was too busy eating and drinking beer, haha. They have a signature beer that you have to try yourself. I can't remember the name... (I was drunk) 😅 Also, the restroom... the mirrors are so cool! One stop to pee and you'll remember it forever. 😅😅😅 Okay, I think I'll get yelled at by the restaurant, haha. But I liked it, it was awesome! 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: sa-bong Pandokmai

sample_reviews_en.text: Wowwwww! I don't even know what to start admiring. From the cozy, homey atmosphere to the incredibly polite and lovely staff who treated me like family and gave me amazing wine recommendations (I don't usually drink, but I couldn't resist today! 🤣🥂), everything was delicious. I especially loved the sous vide grilled beef tongue and the truffle roti pizza. I'll definitely be back! So happy! 💗✨ Thank you for putting so much effort into opening such a place. I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: paliwan jaja

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located a bit deep inside the area, but there's ample parking. Driving is more convenient. If you don't have a car, take the BTS Yellow Line and then a short Grab ride.

The restaurant has a beautiful vibe, is private and not noisy. The food is delicious. It's suitable for a date, but I've also been there with a group of friends and had a great time. They even offer a Polaroid photo service, which is very cute.
sample_reviews_en.author: PP JK

sample_reviews_en.text: A true hidden gem in the Prawet–Bangna area! The restaurant has a charming atmosphere with both air-conditioned seating and a cozy outdoor garden. The food was delicious, the prices reasonable, and the staff incredibly friendly. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a great dining spot in this neighborhood.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chin Surasirin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is great, the restaurant is beautiful, the food is delicious, the price is good, and the service is excellent, lovely, and warm. At first, I was confused and couldn't find the restaurant; it's a real hidden gem. There were a few mosquitoes, though.
But overall, it was great!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanida Paenoy

restaurants.name: Koto Furui
restaurants.address:

ใกล้คอนโด ยูดีไลท์, Kotofurui โคโตะฟุรุอิ, 264 ถนน Soi Sukhumvit 77, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Still good but not as good as it used to be. Mr Lee sold it to a new management. New staff. Same prices, basically same taste, but most things are a bit smaller portions, e.g. the tonkatsu is thinner sliced according to my wife, the tofu portion is smaller, the hamburg steak is more carrots and onions. Very much the same vibe though. Nobody seems to speak Japanese, unfortunately, so I have to butcher my Japanese orders into Thai-Japanese, or they do so for me, causing lots of confusion. I used to enjoy a good chat in nihongo with Mr Lee. Miss the old days. It is still good value and tasty. But I notice we are the only customer tonight at 7pm, should be busy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike Amy

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a chill atmosphere. Seeing all the manga on the wall made me feel so nostalgic! I loved it. I just looked at the pictures even though it was in Japanese, lol. The food came out quite quickly. I was impressed with the gyoza; it was delicious when eaten hot. The hamburger was decent and worth the price, as the restaurant generally has good prices. The okonomiyaki wasn't very good though; it was mostly batter with no vegetables. It was okay when hot, but I didn't want to eat it once it cooled down. Would I come back again? I'd probably order from here because I like the theme and I want to try the fish dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: T P

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried the On Nut branch of Koto Restaurant. Compared to the Phra Khanong branch, this location is more spacious and comfortable.
My favorite mixed salad had the same quality and portion size as at the Phra Khanong branch, so I was satisfied. However, I ordered the grilled horse mackerel set meal today, and the fish was dried out and tough, making it far from enjoyable. Next time, I’ll try a different dish.
Compared to the Phra Khanong branch, this location had a more satisfying selection of side dishes that come with the set meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gourmet Advisor

sample_reviews_en.text:
However, I was a little disappointed that the Japanese-speaking chef who had been there before wasn't there. 

I ordered the liver and leek set meal for myself and tuna roll for my son, but the tuna roll not only came with wasabi but also had wasabi in the roll itself, so my son couldn't eat it. 

It would have been a hassle to order it again, so in the end my son couldn't eat the tuna roll, which was disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bua in Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has very reasonable prices and delicious food, especially the miso-braised mackerel – a must-try! It's so tasty you'll get it down to the bone. I've made this my go-to restaurant. If you're driving, you can park at Big C. The staff are all lovely, always smiling and providing great service. I also love that they have a lot of comic books. The atmosphere is cute, like being at a friend's house.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suwapat Puangkaew

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of the best Japanese restaurants I've ever been to. Everything is incredibly delicious. The sweet egg omelet here is so good it'll make you cry. I've been searching for this flavor for over 10 years and finally found it here 😭😭😭😭😭 It's delicious from the bottom of my heart. The sashimi, everything is amazing. You have to eat here at least once in your life.
sample_reviews_en.author: akiko nakamura

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm a regular here; the food is delicious, nutritionally balanced, and reasonably priced.

The entire wall is covered in comics—I absolutely love it! The overall decor and atmosphere are quiet and warm.

It's excellent value for money! Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mavis li

sample_reviews_en.text: Eaten here many times, always fresh, fast service and incredible value. I get the salmon roll with a side of tuna and my gf gets a salmon box set. Big glass of iced green tea only 20 baht. Everything I’ve eaten here is excellent. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: john dohrmann

restaurants.name: Have A Zeed - Siam Discovery
restaurants.address:

989 ชั้น 3 ห้องเลขที่ 307/2, Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
This restaurant is adorable, the service is great, the food is reasonably priced and tastes delicious. ❤️

Today I went shopping at MBK and then continued to Siam Discovery. It was quite hot and I was tired from walking. I wasn't sure what to eat, so I walked past this restaurant and saw the menu had Som Tum (papaya salad) and curry fried rice, so I decided to try it. The atmosphere is very cute, cozy and clean. There were many staff members who seemed attentive to customers.

Since I was alone, I chose a seat in a corner, but the air conditioning wasn't reaching me well, and I felt very hot. I asked a female staff member if I could move to a seat under the air conditioner because it was quite hot. She immediately arranged it for me, without hesitation and with great willingness to help. I was very impressed by this. 😊

The food is reasonably priced, tastes good, and is easy to eat. Most importantly, the service is excellent.
This is a restaurant I feel deserves support and would recommend to others. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: ANDY CJ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stopped by Have a Zeed while visiting Siam Discovery and overall it was a good experience. The restaurant has a modern and cozy atmosphere, with a clean and nicely designed interior that makes it comfortable to sit down and have a proper meal.

We ordered the Massaman curry and a picanha with rice. Both dishes were very tasty and well prepared. The Massaman curry had a rich, slightly sweet flavor with tender chicken and potatoes, while the picanha was nicely cooked and paired well with the garlic and chili fried rice.

The portions were good and the prices felt quite reasonable for a restaurant inside a shopping mall in this area of Bangkok.

That said, while everything was enjoyable, we’ve had slightly better versions of these dishes elsewhere, so I’d rate it 4 out of 5. Still a solid option if you’re looking for Thai food while shopping around Siam.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexander Cillan

sample_reviews_en.text: Have a Zeed really delivered on flavor with this spread. The Massaman curry was the standout, offering a rich and velvety sauce that soaked into the rice perfectly. It had that deep, nutty warmth you expect from a great curry without being too heavy. The Pad Thai was equally impressive, featuring well-textured noodles and a balanced tang that didn't feel oily. Even the butterfly pea and passion fruit drink was more than just a visual gimmick; it was incredibly refreshing and cut through the spice of the meal nicely. It is easily one of the most consistent spots for a quality Thai dinner, and both plates were finished in no time
sample_reviews_en.author: Farouk Hamood

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered a few dishes and everything was really satisfying.
The pineapple fried rice came with plump shrimp and squid—simple, flavorful, and well done. The stir-fried morning glory was also tasty and cooked just right.

Loved the Thai iced tea presentation. It comes with sticks of iced Thai tea, which is such a smart idea because it doesn’t get watered down. The sweetness level was just nice.

The real star of the meal was the fried pork knuckle. Super crispy, crunchy, and savory, especially when dipped in the sauce. Definitely one of those dishes you can’t stop eating after the first bite.
sample_reviews_en.author: leotrails

sample_reviews_en.text: Taiwanese visitors to Siam Discovery 3F can enjoy drinks and eat at this restaurant. Compared to other department store restaurants, it's quite delicious and not too expensive. Remember to order mildly spicy or order just one chili pepper. The curry crab and Northern Thai sausage stuffed with chicken leg are very tasty. The Tom Yum Kung shrimp soup comes in a large bowl with lots of shrimp. I ate it too fast to take a picture. Overall, the taste is good but a bit salty. If you want to eat Thai food but don't want to break the bank, you can consider this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Feng-Yi Chang

sample_reviews_en.text:
My girlfriend and I came down from the gym and wanted some good food. This place has a great atmosphere, easy place to relax and talk and they had suprisingly good chairs.

I ordered panang chicken with rice. It was impeccable. The fried chicken skin was also very well made. If I could speak the mother of the chef, I would tell her that she has a lot to be proud of.

As I did not find any negative thing about resturant, it is only fair to give 5 stars
sample_reviews_en.author: Max

sample_reviews_en.text:
Highly recommend this place! I've tried so many Thai restaurants in department stores this time, and this one is definitely the best value for money! 😋

The corn salad was so refreshing! The volcano rib soup was also delicious, and the meat was so tender! The fried rice was also very fragrant! The dining environment was bright and clean 🥢✌🏻 I really loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Maggieee

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited this Thai restaurant for three time during my trip in bkk. The staffs are super friendly and the vibes and environment are great. The Thai tea is a must-drink, smelling so good and tasty. The price is quite reasonable ( not to compare with street food). All the dishes we ordered are wonderful. Would definitely revisit next time I visit bkk.
sample_reviews_en.author: Will Wu

restaurants.name: บะหมี่หัวโต
restaurants.address:

436 37 Thanon Nakhon Chaisi Rd, Thanon Nakhon Chai Si, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good ingredients include the dumplings and crispy pork.
The char siu (roasted pork) uses pork loin, resulting in a somewhat firm texture.
The noodles are unique, being thick, round strands, but because they are so thick, they can sometimes be hard or not very hot.
The fried garlic is likely the restaurant's own recipe, fried until crispy and burnt (personally, I didn't like it).
Overall, the taste is good and the aroma is pleasant.
sample_reviews_en.author: charnwit mena

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old, established restaurant that I've been eating at since the days of the Sriyan cinema. The noodles are freshly made, with a perfect chewy texture. They're delicious with crispy pork or roasted pork.

Another delicious item is the rice noodle rolls, which are generously filled with ingredients.
sample_reviews_en.author: บทเพลงปีศาจ

sample_reviews_en.text: This legendary noodle dish was first eaten 18 years ago. Honestly, I didn't like it because the fried garlic was black and bitter. My husband's family just kept buying it for me... but it stopped selling later, so I grew to like it. For me, the dumplings are delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Professor

sample_reviews_en.text:
There were so many online orders! There was a wait, but not too long.
✅️ Ordered dumplings and crispy pork, they were delicious.
✅️ The fried spring rolls weren't eaten immediately after purchase; after about 3 hours they weren't very crispy and became a bit hard.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nalinee Cheryklinput

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old restaurant that has been open for many years, since my great-grandparents' generation. The food is just as delicious as ever, even though I haven't eaten here in a long time. They have more menu items now than when I used to …
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitichote Pao

sample_reviews_en.text: If I don't eat at the restaurant, I always buy their raw noodles to cook at home. The noodles are thick, chewy, and delicious. The crispy pork is also excellent. The restaurant is located down an alley, past the Sriyan fresh market.
sample_reviews_en.author: Timmy ItchyFeet

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles at this restaurant are very unique; they're homemade. They're thick and have a slightly muted color. Today I ordered the mixed platter, which was a huge bowl and I almost couldn't finish it.
sample_reviews_en.author: JiRa W.

sample_reviews_en.text: They have to arrive first before they'll do anything. That's terrible. Just sell in-store, don't bother selling on the app. Customers are waiting to eat, they're not just ordering for fun. It's awful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Popman ป๊อปแมน

restaurants.name: Bang Bua Restaurant
restaurants.address:

13 Phahonyothin Rd, Anusawari, Bang Khen, Bangkok 10220, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Delicious food, great set menu, price for 10 people 2500-3000฿. Come try the good food here. Anyone who studies at Kasetsart University must have been here.
sample_reviews_th.author: Srisit Powtongsook

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old restaurant with a Thai-Chinese fusion style. The food is moderately flavored, and most of the customers are older. I've been eating here since I was a child; my family used to bring me here often, so I feel a connection to it. Even though the taste isn't outstanding and there aren't any exciting dishes to try because the restaurant has been around for so long, I still have several dishes that I really love.

**My absolute favorite is the "Crispy Roast Duck."** The duck is incredibly delicious – crispy skin, tender meat, and a sweet dipping sauce. It brings back nostalgic childhood memories. It has a home-style Chinese flavor in Thailand; not too strong, but truly amazing.

I'd say almost everything on the menu suits my taste. I've recently tried the "Spicy Stir-fried Fish Curry" and the "Green Curry with Salted Egg Yolk and Snakehead Fish."

The prices aren't high; in fact, they seem cheap.

I bet almost everyone has tried this restaurant at least once...
sample_reviews_en.author: Aut Pakorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a restaurant I've been eating at since I was a child. Today, I had the chance to visit Bang Bua again. My biggest complaint is that the grilled shrimp weren't fresh. They weren't fresh at all. They probably had been picked quite a while ago. They're usually fresher because there's a fresh produce area on the right, but that's no longer the case.

The tom yum goong was pretty bad. The shrimp and tomato were just salty.

I thought the shrimp cakes were really good. I liked them so much that I ordered four of them today.

The service was good. The food was reasonably priced, but a bit on the expensive side for a garden restaurant. However, this is a long-established restaurant, and people in the Saphan Mai, Bang Khen, and Kaset areas know it well. Thank you very much.
sample_reviews_en.author: AUNG S

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant has been around for a very long time; it's old but not run-down. The parking lot is very spacious, the restrooms are clean, the air conditioning is a little weak, and there are tons of tables.

The service is good, attentive, they refill water constantly and are polite.

The food is delicious and varied. The stir-fried catfish with ginger and chili is excellent, the winged bean salad is flavorful, the baked crab meat with glass noodles is tasty and aromatic, and the steamed snakehead fish with dipping sauce is also good – the fish is firm and the sauce is delicious.

Overall, it's great. You get a traditional atmosphere, delicious food, good service, although the prices are a bit high.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sompound

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a long-established restaurant, probably over 30 years old, located on the main road near a BTS Green Line station. It has a very large parking lot and several function rooms of various sizes to suit different groups. Food is served quickly, and the menu is diverse. The prices are reasonable, and there are plenty of staff to provide good service. The restaurant's decor is old-fashioned, not modern, which younger generations might not like because it's not very photogenic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thananan Tansophontanasak

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has ample parking.
The restaurant looks quite old but is clean.
The staff are reasonably attentive but don't smile much; overall, it's okay. There are large and small tables to choose from.
We deducted a star because the food didn't quite suit our taste.
Some dishes were bland, while others lacked balanced flavors.
This made us feel it wasn't worth the price.
Finally, we felt the menu lacked variety.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mook ToTravel

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is well-located and has been a beloved spot for over 35 years. While its exterior reflects a charming old-style design, the food offers a creative twist on traditional Thai cuisine, especially dishes inspired by the Bangkhen district.

There’s plenty of parking available, and the restaurant also offers private dining rooms for a more intimate experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr. Kent NYC

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted great, authentic traditional Thai cuisine that brought back childhood memories. The staff were friendly, smiling, and greeted us with a welcome message and offered parking inside the restaurant. I was impressed and will definitely return. The prices are reasonable, and the food isn't greasy, making it suitable for health-conscious individuals.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tamruja D.

restaurants.name: Chisana Nami
restaurants.address:

494 Phloen Chit Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chisana Nami: A Delightful Dining Experience

Chisana Nami isn’t just a restaurant—it’s a culinary performance that turns every meal into a joyful spectacle. The chef brings incredible energy to the open kitchen, captivating diners with rich, theatrical presentations that blend flair and precision.
Watching flames dance over sizzling woks or ingredients artfully arranged tableside made our evening feel like front-row seats to a live show, keeping smiles on our faces from start to finish.
The food quality shines through in every bite, with ultra-fresh ingredients that burst with flavor. Highlights included perfectly seared seafood that melted in your mouth and vibrant salads packed with crisp, seasonal greens—clearly sourced with care and handled expertly.
The atmosphere adds to the charm, offering a cozy, comfortable space with soft lighting and intimate seating that invites lingering chats. Service was a standout too; the friendly staff anticipated our needs with warm smiles and thoughtful recommendations, making us feel truly welcomed.
Overall, Chisana Nami delivers on every front—I’ll be back soon for more of that chef’s magic!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kiukiu Tam

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had lunch at Chisana Nami on a Sunday.

Staff was very welcoming and brought us to our table really quick despite us not having a reservation. Once seated the staff gave very good explanation on what’s the current promotion and we ended up ordering

1) Wagyu A5 set
2) Pork Set
3) Ala carte salmon
4) Ala Carte Chicken

Each set comes with Soup (we ordered Miso soup), Drink (Hot/Cold Green tea), fried rice and dessert (either fruits or ice cream).

Chef Satra was really engaging and take the effort to have small conversation with the adults while keeping the children entertained.

The food was cooked to our liking.

Restaurant is really modern, clean and nicely decorated.

Will definitely dine in Chisana when we are back in Bangkok next time!
sample_reviews_en.author: jenny su

sample_reviews_en.text: A surprisingly modest teppanyaki restaurant in the Erawan hotel. Food was only average; I'd say the same for the skills of the 2 chefs I could see during our dinner. While there was nothing wrong with the meal, it was certainly the least impressive teppanyaki experience I've had in 40 years and 3 continents. The service was friendly, prompt and enthusiastic. The food, a bit bland. The atmosphere, surprisingly sterile, with for example, no view other than the tiled hallway leading to an escalator and public toilets. We paid less than 5,000 baht for 2 people (including 7% VAT & 10% service charge) -- a modest price for this type of restaurant, but I didn't feel like we got good value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bill Horgan

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing food and unforgettable experience! We had a wonderful dinner at this restaurant. The place itself is perfect—not too small, but not overwhelmingly large either. It has a great, cozy atmosphere.The service here is absolutely top-notch. Our server Pii was extremely attentive, polite, and made sure we had everything we needed throughout the night.The highlight of the evening was definitely the chef Plai! He is incredibly talented, funny, and brought so much positive energy to our table. His cooking is spectacular, and his teppanyaki show was absolutely brilliant and entertaining.Highly recommend this place for great food and fantastic vibes!
sample_reviews_en.author: Арина Сол

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ingredients are impressively fresh, especially the shrimp and salmon, which are grilled to perfection—juicy, tender, and beautifully aromatic from the hot iron plate. The vegetables remain crisp and flavorful, complementing the seafood perfectly.

What truly made the experience special was the excellent service. Khun Gigi provided outstanding care, paying attention to every detail with a warm and friendly smile. Meanwhile, Chef Lhee was very approachable, engaging, and cooked everything absolutely delicious. Their hospitality made the dining experience even more memorable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tgtgtjingp

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had such a wonderful experience at this teppanyaki restaurant in Erawan, Bangkok.

Chef Cherry was absolutely amazing. She cooked with so much care, focus, and passion — you could truly feel how dedicated she is to her craft. Watching her work was part of the experience itself.

Every dish was perfectly cooked, beautifully presented, and incredibly delicious. The flavors were well-balanced and high quality.

Cherry’s energy and effort made the entire meal even more special. Thank you for such a memorable dining experience. We will definitely come back!

Highly recommended 🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: Emi Y

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently had an absolutely fantastic teppanyaki experience that exceeded all expectations. I went with the scallops paired with A5 Wagyu beef, and it was pure indulgence from start to finish.
The food itself was outstanding. The scallops were perfectly seared — tender, juicy, with a beautiful golden crust

The highlight was undoubtedly the chef — incredibly engaging, skilled.
If you’re looking for a memorable dining experience that combines top-tier ingredients, skillful cooking, and great entertainment, this teppanyaki spot is a definite must-try.
sample_reviews_en.author: tam wing yin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Teppanyaki is more than just a meal—it’s an experience. Sitting by the grill, you get to watch the chef cook everything right in front of you with skill and flair.

The food was excellent. The garlic fried rice was rich and flavorful, the prawns were juicy with a nice char, and the scallops were soft and buttery. The highlight was the beef—perfectly cooked, tender, and full of smoky flavor.

Overall, it was a fun and satisfying dining experience with great food and an entertaining atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: soh madeline

restaurants.name: ส้มตำออนซอนเด | Somtum On Sunday
restaurants.address:

1 3/1-4 Phaya Thai Rd, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm giving 1 star for the service. The staff were unwelcoming, and the order was incomplete. When I asked for a refund for the missing items, they refused, which was very confusing. However, the food was delicious and the atmosphere was nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanyaporn Dungdee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fermented fish is flavorful, the clay pot roasted chicken is tender, and the dipping sauce is amazing.
The stir-fried minced meat salad is incredibly delicious, a must-try!
Absolutely delicious!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanatchaya Yoopanied

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and satisfying. The grilled chicken was juicy, and the grilled pork neck had just the right amount of fat. The staff provided good service, and the restaurant was clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuttarika Somsuk

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the flavors suit my taste, with clear spice levels specified. The prices are mid-range to slightly high, as expected for the location. I expect to go there often.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pantip Paigapate

sample_reviews_en.text: The papaya salad was spicy and flavorful, and the other dishes were also delicious. The fried chicken wings were crispy and perfect. I'll definitely come back. Easy to get to.
sample_reviews_en.author: PhaPare Sasina

sample_reviews_en.text: The air conditioning was cool, the music was nice and fun, and the food was delicious. The papaya salad was great, and I especially liked the mushroom curry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanokporn Boonsom

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service staff were very good.
The food looked delicious.
The taste of the food was average; if you prefer it spicier, I recommend informing the staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: naruemol wongsom

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! The fish roe soup was amazing. I've never had anything like it anywhere else before.
sample_reviews_en.author: P. Mansawatapaiboon

restaurants.name: ฉงชิ่งเกาเก้า
restaurants.address:

167/17-20 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Chinese hot pot with the good experience atmosphere as if you were not in Thailand.
Staff were friendly, foods were good.
I think the price range is the same with Hai Di Lao or CQK, many people claim that this one the overall taste is better but I couldn’t tell the difference, I meant here is also nice.
What I like about this one is green chilli sauce paste, it’s like น้ำพริกหนุ่ม (nam prik noom) with crunchy pickles.
Membership fee is 99 THB but cannot use right away, discount will be available for your next visit.

Worth to try for me
sample_reviews_th.author: Bhaksook Charoonsak

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chongqing 99, a Chinese hot pot restaurant near Ratchada-Huai Khwang, offers authentic Chongqing-style hot pot that tastes just like the real thing!

The restaurant serves only premium quality ingredients. The broth is fragrant with spices, rich in flavor, and perfectly spicy – ​​absolutely delicious!

They currently have a Lunch Set for 99 Baht, a mixed set with 9 different items in one plate.
It includes: fresh duck intestines (9 seconds), shredded tripe, pork kidney, minced shrimp with fish roe, crispy tripe, and more!
In addition, the set also includes extra items like premium pork belly, potato noodles, fish balls, sunflower sprouts, and golden fried mantou.
It's a great deal, reduced from the usual 1980 Baht to only 1280 Baht, available only from 11:30 AM to 5:00 PM.

The restaurant's atmosphere is fantastic, with a Chongqing style. Walking in feels like you're dining in China – very luxurious. There's also a self-serve dipping sauce bar.
Feeling hungry already, huh? Come on over! The restaurant is located on Ratchadaphisek Road, near MRT Huai Khwang. It's easy to get to and there's parking available. They're open from 11 am to 6 am. I highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Noom Say D

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every time I pass by, I'm drawn in by the grand and imposing storefront. Upon entering, the rich aroma of the broth fills the entire shop, a truly enticing smoky fragrance!

The broth has that authentic Chongqing hot pot flavor; the aroma of Sichuan peppercorns and chili peppers hits you right in the head. It's spicy enough, but not at all pungent—just like a hot pot restaurant back home! Add some sliced ​​beef and tender beef, dip them in the sesame oil sauce, and one bite is bursting with juicy goodness—it's like stepping back in time!

The duck blood and handmade meatballs are also amazing. The meatballs burst with juice when you bite into them, and the duck blood is cooked until soft and flavorful, with absolutely no fishy taste.

There's also a self-service condiment station, with an open kitchen and Chinese-style latticework, all clean and tidy. You can mix and match sesame oil, minced garlic, cilantro, and scallions—you can make any dipping sauce you want. I especially love their pickled radish!

You can also use Wukong Groupon—it's so economical!!
sample_reviews_en.author: xepear

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ordering system is a scan-to-order system. The set menus have no details at all. The staff said we would get what was pictured, but seriously, who's supposed to tell what's included?
The set meal contained about 15 items, and we couldn't eat a third of it, so we informed the staff. They said we couldn't cancel the order (we hadn't even touched the food yet). Oh well, it was delicious anyway. My dog ​​ate it all.
The second confusing thing was that they served dessert and fruit as soon as we sat down, even though we hadn't received our food yet. By the time we finished our meal, the dessert and fruit were no longer cold!
Overall, the taste was good, but the serving order was confusing, and I think the menu should specify what's included to avoid such a huge surprise.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amicale B

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chongqing Gao Gao Chinese Hotpot in Huai Khwang is a great spot if you’re craving a real Chinese-style hotpot experience. 🇨🇳🌶️

Of course, the highlight is the soup base — rich, flavorful, and full of that authentic taste that really makes you feel like you’re having hotpot in China!

There’s also a good variety of ingredients to choose from, plus free-flow fruits, ice cream, and some desserts at no extra charge, which makes the whole experience even more worth it.

The atmosphere is lively and fun, especially in the evening, and on some days they even have live performances while you’re dining. A great place to come with friends or family, enjoy good food, and spend a fun evening together.

Definitely one of the Chinese hotpot spots worth trying around Huai Khwang! 🥢✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Donlacha P

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is delicious; I've eaten here many times. When you arrive, the staff will bring you dessert and fruit after you've finished your meal, and you can ask for more if you want. For the soup, I recommend the mala soup if you can handle spicy food because it's truly delicious, but the smell tends to linger on your clothes, so you'll need to wash them immediately. There's a huge variety of food to choose from, and the condiment section is extensive. The staff provides excellent service, constantly refilling the soup and clearing plates. The food quality is commensurate with the price, which is quite high.
sample_reviews_en.author: Juuq X

sample_reviews_en.text:
Verdict: A solid, authentic Chongqing-style hot pot experience near MRT Huai Khwang. The place is huge, neon-lit, and always busy. The spicy mala broth is rich and numbing, and ingredients are fresh (great beef, tripe, duck blood, even bullfrog). Non-spicy tomato and mushroom broths also available.

Downsides: Can be pricey (800–1000+ THB/person), sometimes long queues, and the broth can taste slightly bitter.

Bottom line: Worth it if you want real Sichuan heat and high-quality ingredients – just bring friends and be ready to wait.
sample_reviews_en.author: JingJing_Foodie

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is near my house, I've driven past it many times since they were renovating. At first, I hesitated to go in because I was worried it might be expensive. But it turned out to be very lively inside, lots of people, and the food was incredibly delicious! The soup was amazing, everything was great, I was very impressed.

We ordered a set meal during a promotion, it cost a little over 1000 baht. There were three of us, three small women, and it was just the right size.

I'll definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Any Anyavee (อัญวีณ์)

sample_reviews_th.text:
If you want to have a strong snowflake, you can have a snowflake and a snowflake. With a slightly less expensive bedroom, a slightly more expensive dressing gown Thanks for watching, it's a nice place to stay, and it's a nice place to stay The rest of the town is a place where you can find a suitcase in the woods.
I came here based on the reviews, so I had fairly high expectations. Unfortunately, the overall experience didn’t quite live up to them.  The presentation of the dishes was decent, but the flavors were rather average and didn’t stand out as much as I had hoped. Considering the pricing, it felt a bit on the expensive side for what was offered, and the value didn’t quite match the cost.

The dining environment could also be improved — the air conditioning wasn’t very effective during my visit, which made it slightly uncomfortable.  That said, service was fine, and this might just come down to personal preference.
