sample_reviews_th.author: redcherry redcherry

sample_reviews_en.text: When my colleague in the office wanted to eat fish stew with pickled mustard greens, we found a review of a restaurant near our workplace and decided to go. We arrived at 6:30 PM and it felt like we had the whole place to ourselves. Our order included, of course, the fish stew with pickled mustard greens, Sichuan chili chicken, stir-fried green beans, and beef dumplings. Seeing the portions and trying a few, we ordered 3-4 more dishes. Overall, it was delicious, especially the Sichuan chili chicken and the spiced beef stir-fry. But it's even better with rice – one bite should have the meat, chili, spices, and rice all in one! 🫠🫠🫠🤤🤤 The fish stew was flavorful with a light mala chili seed aroma; not as strong or oily as some of the famous chain restaurants. This area is a cluster of Chinese restaurants near Silom, so parking is extremely limited.
sample_reviews_en.author: kookykiss kook

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited Sichuan Restaurant at Silom - a little walk from BTS.  We took the Hungry Hub lunch set for two - with 3 dishes. Overall, it was a very enjoyable experience.

The service was good throughout our visit. Although there were no other customers at the time, the staff remained attentive and welcoming, which made for a relaxed and pleasant dining experience.

The food was definitely the highlight. The dishes tasted authentic and were full of flavor, giving a genuine Sichuan dining experience. Everything we tried was well prepared, fresh, and enjoyable. It's not always easy to find authentic Sichuan cuisine, so this was a pleasant surprise.

Overall, we had a great time and a good value for money. If you're looking for authentic Sichuan food in the area, this restaurant is certainly worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Parag Jain

sample_reviews_en.text: Good food, but really bad customer service. The family started laughing at me when I came in, and that made me move seats after I was already seated. The family also wanted me to pay, before they even started cooking my food, and I looked at them like they were crazy. They unfortunately put meat in one of my dishes, and didn't give me any napkins or check on me after dropping my food off. I usually love family restaurants, but this one made me feel so unwelcome. I paid for all of the food, even the dish that they put meat in (I'm vegetarian). If you like meat, speak Chinese, and just need people to drop off random food at your table and leave, then this is probably a good restaurant for you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Coco Amor

sample_reviews_en.text: It was a Sunday lunch, and I was craving braised fish with pickled mustard greens, so I followed a recommendation from a social media video. There were three Chinese restaurants in the alley; this was the only one without customers and had empty parking. The staff were dressed casually in t-shirts and shorts. Upon entering, I was greeted by the aroma of a Chinese restaurant. I ordered the braised sea bass with pickled mustard greens. The taste was okay, but not what I expected (this depends on personal preference). The portion of fish was quite large, but almost every piece had bones. I'm not sure if it's a Sichuan style of slicing the fish, but it was another unique dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kannitha P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fish stew with pickled mustard greens was delicious. This time I ordered it less spicy, so it wasn't as flavorful as I'd hoped. Next time I'll try the regular spicy version. My parents liked it the most out of all the fish stews with pickled mustard greens we've tried.
The dumplings were also good. The fried chicken felt a bit dry and the flavor was average; I didn't personally like it that much.
But another thing that surprisingly was delicious was the stir-fried spinach. It was incredibly fragrant. I just ordered it because I wanted to eat vegetables, but it turned out to be surprisingly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Monsisha S.

sample_reviews_en.text: The Sichuan-style braised sea bass with pickled mustard greens was delicious, with a mild, pleasant sourness. But what exceeded expectations was the Sichuan-style stir-fried chicken with dried chilies. The chicken pieces were small, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, with a slight mala spiciness – absolutely delicious. Everything else was good too, but the steamed egg custard didn't match the picture. The menu showed a thick, caramel-like custard, but when I ordered it, it was a flat, microwave-heated version.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mayurin Laorujisawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here with my mom for late night dinner, it’s not that crowded here. The food was so delicious. We ordered fried string beans, chicken sauce sichuan, and fish fried pickle cabbage boil sichuan.

The food came out so fast, we just wait about couple minutes. Only for the fish soup that takes a bit longer. The portion is kind of bigger, I would recommend to order the food to share with person you come with.

The staffs and owner here are really nice. Also if you don’t want your food to be spicy you can tell them too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Be Kind

restaurants.name: Tang Meng
restaurants.address:

887 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today, I stopped by Tang Meng, an old-time restaurant in the Sukhumvit/Thonglor area. I've been hearing about it for a while, so I decided to give it a try.
The atmosphere is homey, like a classic old-fashioned diner. It's not fancy, but it's clean and comfortable, just like a local favorite.

I ordered the Yen Ta Fo noodles and the Hainanese Chicken Rice. Overall, the taste was good. The food arrived quickly, the flavors weren't too strong, and it was easy to eat. The meatballs were delicious and the ingredients were generous. The Hainanese Chicken Rice wasn't dry, and the sauce was good.

The price wasn't too high, and the location was a good value.

If you enjoy old-fashioned, fast food, and familiar flavors, this restaurant is a great choice.
However, if you're a cafe lover or a photography enthusiast, you might be indifferent, as the restaurant isn't focused on atmosphere.

Conclusion:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ / 5
Easy, filling, and perfect for breakfast or lunch. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: tam tt

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was so happy to stumble upon this gem shop I passed by! The double-portion chicken and grilled pork rice was delicious! A small drink was only 10 baht! The whole shop has a lot of history, but it doesn't feel uncomfortable at all. It's clearly a popular restaurant among locals. The noodle soup looked delicious too. I plan to try it next time. They close at 3 pm, so I recommend arriving early if you want to eat good food.

I went back a second time to try the noodle soup. I used photos from Google reviews to order, and I was very satisfied. This old shop, popular with locals, definitely has its charm; everything I ordered was delicious. I chose longan juice for my drink—icy, sweet, and with several pieces of fruit—it was so refreshing! The 10 baht was well worth it. The warm smiles of the owner when I paid made me happy both physically and emotionally.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sinderland

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible, awful, awful! I usually order takeout because the noodles are delicious. Today I ate at the restaurant and ordered two glasses of ice water—one for plain water and one for Pepsi. The man who brought them was very nice. After he poured the water, a short, elderly woman snatched the glass away, saying she was too lazy to wash it, and started yelling and making a huge fuss. It ruined my meal. I was planning to order takeout again, but I'm done with this place. I'm so disappointed. It was a terrible experience. That old lady was awful. I'm never eating there again. It lives up to its reputation as a legendary, old-fashioned, yelling, rude, and disrespectful place. Don't go there; it'll ruin your mood and atmosphere. I'm never going back to this restaurant again. The taste of the food doesn't help at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: NanNoh Rattanasiriporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you come to this restaurant, try the Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup).

The Yen Ta Fo sauce is a perfect balance of sweet, sour, and salty, with a hint of fermented tofu aroma. A well-made version isn't cloying, and it's packed with toppings like fish balls, fish cakes, pork blood, squid, and fried tofu. You get a variety of textures in every bite.

Adding a little chili, vinegar, or chili paste will make it even spicier and more delicious 🌶️

If you don't eat much, tell the staff because they give generous portions.

They also have Hainanese chicken rice and other rice dishes at reasonable prices.
The owner is lovely, but there's no parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: วริยา มารศรี

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tasty old school vibes 🎉 Stumbled upon this charming old-school eatery while staying nearby, and it turned out to be a great find! I was there for brunch and ordered their chicken rice, crispy pork, and longan juice—each dish was delicious in its own way. The chicken rice was fragrant, the pork was a little dry for my liking, but the longan juice was a refreshing touch.

The place was bustling with calls and orders, which tells you how popular they are with the locals. It has that no-frills, traditional vibe that makes the food feel even more authentic. If you’re in the area, I’d definitely recommend giving it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Evasaurus

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been wanting to try this place for a while.
The moment I walked in, it was packed and I had to share a table 😂
I don't know if it was quiet or noisy (the restaurant staff lol).
It's a warm, nostalgic place with a Thai vibe.

This time I ordered the Khao Man Gai, which comes with steamed chicken and crispy pork.
Even the regular portion is huge!! And it's delicious!! ✨The crispy pork is especially good, isn't it?!

The other dishes that looked delicious were the bami and yen ta pho, as well as the gapow and other rice dishes with toppings. 🤤 This might be the perfect place for a quick and delicious Thai meal. 🤭
sample_reviews_en.author: mayuko imanishi

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a bit stuffy because there's no air conditioning (there's a fan), but the food is so delicious it's totally worth it.

The menu is similar to a roast meat shop (crispy pork, Hainanese chicken, braised pork belly) and you can mix and match. The pork doesn't have a gamey smell, and the chili sauce is delicious (super spicy). You can buy an iced drink at 7-Eleven beforehand (highly recommend adding sugar). The red seafood soup has a fish sauce flavor that some people like and some don't.
sample_reviews_en.author: 菇阿

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a long-established Khao Man Gai and Bami (egg noodle) restaurant near the entrance to Soi 49 on Sukhumvit Road.
I had the Bami with everything on top. It was a clear soup and was very delicious.
I wanted to try the Khao Man Gai as well, but I was full from the Bami, so I'll try that next time I visit. I'm very intrigued as this restaurant boils their own chicken.

Two grandmothers and an older woman cook and run the restaurant, and it has a very peaceful atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hashimoto N (Hasse)

restaurants.name: Suppachai Salapao
restaurants.address:

136 12 ปาก, Soi Pradipat, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don't know about their in-store service, but my experience ordering steamed buns and a snack box from this shop has shown me that their management and delivery service are terrible.

I ordered the snacks on May 18th, 2026, and requested delivery on May 21st, 2026, at 8:00 AM. The snacks arrived at 8:53 AM, which was too late for use (I had factored in enough time to use them by 8:30 AM). Furthermore, the shop didn't notify me of the delay from 8:00 AM onwards. When I asked them to track down the driver, the process was extremely slow. They seemed to acknowledge the problem but just told me to wait. I understand that Bangkok's morning traffic is bad, but there's a concept of "allowing extra time." I've ordered snacks from many other shops, and none of them have ever arrived exactly on time or late; they always arrived early. The snacks I received were also cold. Honestly, I'm very disappointed and won't be ordering from them again.
sample_reviews_en.author: ARM

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered 150 snack boxes via Line Official Account.
The admin's coordination was excellent. I accidentally ordered from the wrong branch, but the admin promptly coordinated and resolved the issue upon discovery. Very impressed with the service!

The snack box set included mini buns, two dumplings, and a small bottle of orange juice. The price was great, and the taste was delicious. I ordered the minced pork and egg, black bean, and cream fillings. I usually prefer the minced pork filling, but this shop's sweet filling was amazing! Truly delicious. The dough was soft and fragrant, and the dumplings were still delicious even when cold.

Very impressed! ^^
sample_reviews_en.author: PORNTHIP KIMSAGUL

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is located by the roadside and there doesn't seem to be parking. Today, I stopped by to buy takeout and parked right in front of the shop. After ordering and paying, my order arrived quickly.

I ordered steamed buns and zongzi (rice dumplings) to try. The steamed buns weren't very big, but they were delicious, fragrant, and perfectly balanced in both the dough and filling.
The zongzi had all the necessary ingredients and was good value at 65 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charlie Vongphantuseth

sample_reviews_en.text: I bought these steamed buns to eat in the car while traveling. I was very surprised; the buns were taken straight from the steamer, but they were very cold and soggy. I've been to another branch before and the buns were spoiled. I wish the shop would check the food before handing it to customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pizcy

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I ordered through Grab from the Victory Monument branch. Overall good, but regarding the chili sauce, they only gave one packet, but for an extra 2 baht, I asked if I could change the garlic to chili sauce. Next time I'll order 10 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Note Maneerojchay

sample_reviews_en.text: The steamed buns were smooth and soft, not at all tough in the mouth, I loved them. The dumplings had thin wrappers and were delicious. Our set included 4 dumplings, 1 steamed bun, and orange juice, which we'd already finished.🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: Vashiraporn Promla

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're in the Pradipat area, you have to stop by and buy some black bean paste buns to take home. The black bean paste filling is amazing, ultra-smooth and melts in your mouth (22 baht each).
sample_reviews_en.author: Leqi Z

sample_reviews_en.text: I've ordered from them before and it was delicious! The dough was soft and fluffy and the filling was tasty. Today I came to check out their physical store and the staff were very helpful.
sample_reviews_en.author: น้ําผึ้ง เบคคุ

restaurants.name: ร้านต้นโอ๊ก Tonoak-Restaurant
restaurants.address:

432/5 2nd floor, Parking lot side) Pathumwan บันไดทางขึ้นร้านอยู่ข้าง Tew's Barber, Pathumwan, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I found this restaurant because a friend took me there. After that, I often stopped by when I went to Siam. The prices are reasonable, not too expensive. This time I came back, it was very crowded, which I was happy about. I think I saw the restaurant trending on Twitter before. Even though it was crowded, the wait wasn't too long. The menu has more options than before. They accept bank transfers, and if you pay cash, you get a 5% discount on the food only.

Update 09/26: It's been a while, and the restaurant has changed a lot. It's now downstairs, you don't have to go up the side stairs anymore.
sample_reviews_en.author: Seonmul

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. I didn't expect to find such good value food for under 100 baht around Siam. The restaurant was very clean and comfortable inside, the service was good, and the food was clean. I will definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: KufaOA Music

sample_reviews_en.text:
Variety menu . Reasonable price . Good location.
Proper seating for talking or chatting…

Good atmosphere….

Definitely come back and recommend friends in the future for sure…
sample_reviews_en.author: Phoenix dew

sample_reviews_en.text: Great atmosphere, delicious food, comfortable and relaxing seating, excellent prices, and a diverse menu. Love it! 🫶🏻🤩
sample_reviews_en.author: Manao

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. I like Singha rice, sticky rice with spicy dipping sauce, and stir-fried grilled pork neck.
sample_reviews_en.author: FaH K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes good, it's clean, and the staff are attentive.
I recommend the clear soup; it's delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: _R-TID

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the restaurant has a great atmosphere, it's clean, and it's fantastic!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarisa Soontaros

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a relaxed atmosphere, a soothing mood and tone, and delicious food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nestiza

restaurants.name: A5 Legacy Beef Grill & Chill
restaurants.address:

บ้านเลขที่ 13 Ratchaphruek Rd, Bang Chueak Nang, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "A bit overpriced but overall it’s really nice place and good food"

sample_reviews_en.text:
The meat was good, but I wasn't blown away. Maybe it's because I had high expectations, considering the price and the fact that it doesn't include VAT and service charge. I think the price is a bit high.

The staff were attentive, but a bit indifferent; we had to call them over.

There were three types of dipping sauces, all tasty, and they provided fresh lime to add, which I really liked.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarintip Likasitwong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The meat was reasonably priced.
There was almost no service because there were only two people working. We had to shout to get their attention because they wouldn't even look up.
The music in the restaurant was quite loud. The people eating in the restaurant at that time seemed to be 40+ years old.
We had to shout to talk to each other.
The grill was high up, so you had to stand to grill.
sample_reviews_en.author: Salila Arthakovida

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and of good quality, with a standard taste. It's not amazing, but I appreciate that they clearly state the amount of meat in each dish served, allowing us to gauge whether we can finish it all. It doesn't feel like they're trying to trick us into buying something.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rawiwan O.k

sample_reviews_en.text: The steakhouse has a fairly wide selection of cuts of meat. Personally, I prefer meat that's not too greasy, and they have several types of Thai beef that I really like. It's excellent. There's also live music, so you can enjoy your steak and sip on beer in a relaxed atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: B.THANAKORN CH

sample_reviews_en.text: I recommend this place for anyone who wants to eat good quality Japanese beef. It's not just Japanese beef; the Thai beef is just as good. The atmosphere is nice and spacious, and the staff are helpful with recommendations. It's so delicious you'll want to come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaibodee S.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is it! The kind of beef I've been looking for. I've bookmarked this as my go-to restaurant. What I love most is the Thai beef; it's rare to find such delicious Thai beef, but this place is perfect! It's incredibly tasty and great value for the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: จิตรา นามวงศ์

sample_reviews_en.text: This homey-style yakiniku (grilled meat) restaurant features trees along the fence, high ceilings, and wooden decor, creating a relaxing atmosphere. However, parking is limited. Overall, the food is delicious and the atmosphere is impressive.
sample_reviews_en.author: h ightt

sample_reviews_en.text: The meat was terrible. I paid a lot of money, but the pork wasn't fresh, and they gave me poorly cut cuts of beef. They claimed the quality was "standard," but this was a very disappointing experience. I usually never give a 1-star review, …
sample_reviews_en.author: Phubate Thitikittanon

restaurants.name: Kaithong Original at Central Eastville
restaurants.address:

69,69/1-2 Central Festival Eastville Pradit Manutham Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm usually a regular customer at this restaurant because I love their pork liver dish, but this time I was truly disappointed.

Before sitting down, I asked the staff if they still had pork liver, and they confirmed it was. So I sat down and ordered immediately. However, I was later informed that "a customer had reserved it by phone," and therefore it wasn't available because they hadn't had time to process the reservation.

I understand the restaurant might have a reservation system, but since the staff confirmed with the customer in person, that reservation should have gone to the customer already there, not someone who called later.

The disappointment wasn't just about not getting the dish, but the way the restaurant handled the situation, making me feel like the customer in person was insignificant. An apology alone isn't enough to erase this feeling.

I hope the restaurant will reconsider its reservation system and communication with customers. People who genuinely wanted to eat and inquired politely deserve more clarity and respect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Say my name

sample_reviews_en.text:
✨ Kaithong Original, a Michelin-starred restaurant 💯 This is the ultimate destination for those seeking premium Thai cuisine and an unforgettable experience.

🌟 Must-try dishes:

1. Ba Chang Chao Sua - Premium rice dumplings in Kaithong's unique style, with large, melt-in-your-mouth pieces of pork belly.

2. Stir-fried Squid with Salted Egg Yolk - Fresh, large, succulent squid stir-fried with a rich and creamy salted egg yolk sauce, a perfect balance of sweet and savory.

3. The Dessert by Kaithong Original - Chef's Ice Thai Tea Shaved Ice - A signature dessert! Finely shaved Thai tea ice with generous toppings of tapioca pearls, jelly, almonds, and fresh cream. Refreshingly sweet and delicious.

✨ Restaurant Decor - Luxurious and sophisticated. The choice of colors and materials creates a special feeling from the moment you step inside.

✨ Service - Lovely staff, attentive and caring in every detail, from menu recommendations to food service.

📍 We recommend you try it yourself to experience this exceptional service!
sample_reviews_en.author: BOX RANGSIT (ร้านบ๊อกซ์รังสิต : รังสิต คลอง 1)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kai Thong Cafe: Clean and comfortable seating.
Thai tea: Delicious, fragrant, and not too sweet.
Takes a bit of a wait as it melts slowly.

The Thai tea is delicious, with condensed milk, almonds, and tapioca pearls served separately in individual cups.
Add your own toppings!

The whipped cream is also delicious and smooth.

Taste 🌟🌟🌟🌟
Quality 🌟🌟🌟
Service 🌟🌟🌟🌟
Cleanliness 🌟🌟🌟🌟
Convenience 🌟🌟🌟🌟

*☺️☺️*This is a personal opinion based on my preferences, tastes, experiences, biases, and quirks. I paid for it myself, so I'm giving an honest review and critique based on what I ate and experienced on the day I visited. I want to see feedback used for improvement, rather than anger, hatred, or curses. I apologize in advance for any offense caused.☺️😊**
sample_reviews_en.author: วันจันทร์ ที่ผ่านมา

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kai Thong Original at Central EastVille has a beautiful ambiance. The tables are elegantly set, and a welcome card in an envelope adds a nice touch. The service is excellent and attentive. While the menu is a bit pricey, I personally felt it was worth the money. All the dishes are made with fresh, odorless ingredients, and the flavors are well-balanced – not too strong. The meat is cooked perfectly, and the portions are large; the prawns are huge! I especially loved the braised pork belly (Khao Yok), served with steamed buns – fragrant, delicious, and wonderfully soft.

I didn't get to try their famous liver dish on my visit because it was sold out, but it looked delicious on the menu, even though the price was very high.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kasan Chanto

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Thai restaurant is located inside Central Eastville, a large shopping center in Bangkok, Thailand. It appears to have been featured in the Michelin Guide from 2019 to 2025, as a Michelin plate was displayed outside.

We went as a group of about 10 and ordered drinks and food, but the service was disappointing. It took a considerable amount of time for our drinks to arrive, and even though we ordered two identical dishes, one was served much later than the other.

While the drinks and food were all refined and delicious, the excessively long service times lowered our overall rating. It wasn't like there were a lot of other customers either…
sample_reviews_en.author: Hilo Cassi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes good and meets standards.
But I was confused by the service. It's not that the staff are bad, but it seems like the system is flawed. The owner is to blame for this. As soon as we sat down, we had to crane our necks and look around to order, but no one came. We had to shout to get their attention. We ordered three dishes, and the first and third dishes arrived 15 minutes apart. Even a typical rice porridge restaurant does better than this. Finally, there's the same 10% service charge that customers are forced to pay.
sample_reviews_en.author: เอี๊ยง TL Terry

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kai Thong Original 🍴
A Thai restaurant serving flavorful dishes in a luxurious and comfortable atmosphere.
The food is of high quality in every dish, especially the "Stir-fried Liver with Black Pepper," which is intensely flavorful.
The "Stir-fried Hong Kong Kale with Oyster Sauce" is perfectly cooked, crispy and fragrant.
And the "Panang Beef" is richly flavorful with a strong curry paste.

The prices may be slightly high, but it's worth it for the excellent quality and service.
Perfect for special occasions or family meals.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apsorn ploy

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere of the restaurant is good, clean and tidy. The food tastes average, not too sweet or salty. The ingredients are very good, making me think of the taste of food in old Chinese homes. Especially the "Brandy Drunken Chicken" menu, eating it makes me think of Chinese New Year, sitting in a circle eating together, and the chicken that is plentiful from boiling is used to cook other types of food to get another taste. Eating it with "Stir-fried Glass Noodles with Mixed Seafood" is just right. 😆🤤
sample_reviews_en.author: wisit pongtunkul

restaurants.name: เสี่ยวเฉินกู้ซื่อ หม้อไฟฉงชิ่ง สาขาบางนา 小城故事重庆火锅邦那店
restaurants.address:

ร้านอยู่ติดริม ถนน สุขุมวิท70/3 3606/2 ถนนสุขุมวิท แขวงบางนาใต้ เขตบางนา, Bangna, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
1/08/2026 Lunch, Chinese-style buffet, 2 hours.
Several price options available. Prices include water but not soup.

+49 THB for refillable soft drinks and ice cream.

Personally, I like the mala soup and bone broth 👍🏻👍🏻
Today I chose the lowest price option, 299 THB.
🥩The beef is sliced ​​ribeye.
🐷There's no sliced ​​pork, just various marinated tender pork cuts.
There are a few appetizers and fried items.
The dipping sauces are self-serve; they have a secret recipe you can try.

The atmosphere is great. There were a lot of Chinese people eating there; it felt like I was in China, with lots of loud conversations! 55555

There's parking available, so no need to worry. Or you can take the BTS to Bang Na station and walk about 500 meters.

Overall, it's okay. The food quality is appropriate for the price.
The staff are friendly and lovely 😍

P.S. Don't forget to bring cash! Paying with cash gets you a 5% discount.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bandit M.

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, it's a great place to eat. The food is delicious, especially the mala soup base. The pork ribs are also very flavorful. The restaurant is open late, so you don't have to wait in line even if you come at night. The staff are lovely and welcoming. The buffet has several price options.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปริยากร วงศพุฒ

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here because of the good reviews, but taste is subjective.
Paying with cash (using a banknote) gets you a 5% discount.
There's no discount for bank transfers.
They probably don't want too much money going into their account.
sample_reviews_en.author: RoadNomad

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's been changed to a buffet, so there's a wider variety of food. The quality is good, and it's worth the price.
The food is delicious and of good quality.
I ordered the mala with medium spiciness, and it was already quite spicy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Korkarn Techatiraphan

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is very authentic Chongqing! If you order the large pot, the mala chunks are huge. There's a wide variety of dipping sauces, including my favorite pickled radish. The prices aren't too high.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bowii Pornsuree

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is clean and the atmosphere is nice, but a little hot. The soup is delicious, especially the pickled cabbage soup. The dipping sauce, as recommended, is also tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bongbong Park

sample_reviews_en.text: Stopped by for a meal. The mala beef stew was flavorful and well-seasoned. Good and fast service. Would definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: ยศธกร จันทรประสพ

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken and mala soup + the quality of the meat and the price are excellent. It's so delicious, I eat here every week.
sample_reviews_en.author: เบญจพร ปรงกลาง

restaurants.name: Pad Thai Baitong
restaurants.address:

130, 95 Charan Sanitwong 45 Alley, Arun Amarin, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant offers a wide variety of dishes, from Pad Thai to Pad Krapow (Thai basil stir-fry), and many more. The prices are quite high, but the portions are generous – enough to fill you up. I tried three dishes:

- Pad Thai with Glass Noodles and Pork Slices (85 THB): This dish wasn't spicy and came with crispy pork cracklings and pork slices stir-fried separately with the glass noodles.
- Pad Thai with Chantaburi Noodles (55 THB): This was spicier than the glass noodle version and also came with crispy pork cracklings. It was just plain noodles, no meat.
- Pad Thai with Chantaburi Noodles and Fresh Shrimp (150 THB): Similar in taste to the Chantaburi version but with two shrimp of a suitable size.

Overall, the flavors were rich and intense. It came with raw bean sprouts and banana blossom as side dishes. Overall, it was quite oily and greasy; it took a while to finish the dish.

The restaurant is air-conditioned, but after sitting and eating for a while, it felt a little warm. Overall, I was indifferent to it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sudawan C.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has set hours, but you won't be disappointed. The stir-fried beef with rice is delicious, and the Pad Thai is also tasty. The restaurant has opening and closing times, including breaks. Walk-in customers might experience a longer wait due to orders placed through Grab, but it's best to call ahead to reserve a table.
(Meaning, call to order before coming to the restaurant.) But if that's not convenient, you can order through Grab or LINE Man. It's very busy, and one dish is very filling. Parking is probably available at Wat Bang Bamru. The restaurant is located behind Wat Bang Bamru, in a row of shophouses. It has air conditioning, and because it's so busy, you need to be patient and wait. Ideally, you should call and order in advance because there are many orders. There are many menu options to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisakan Watchakapong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just hearing the words "banana leaf" makes me want to eat Pad Thai right away! And the shrimp are huge! You have to try it, it's excellent! 😋
2/4/68 Ordered 2 servings of crispy pork basil stir-fry in banana leaves. Oh my god! 😋 It was so delicious I completely forgot about the previous ones I'd tasted. ✅ This place is on the right-hand side before the Nai Rong School, in a row of shophouses. I'm ordering again. The price is affordable. You have to try it! I'll tell you more about today's order later. 3/4/68 Ordered again. Open at 11:00 AM. Waiting in the morning for delicious food. They have a variety of made-to-order dishes. I'd like to subscribe to their catering service too. Today, the hair salon on Borom Soi 2 ordered 3 more servings of basil stir-fry rice. 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: ภัทร์สินี มิ้ลค์ พิพัฒน์สําโรง (มิ้ลค์ Milkเจ้าของกิจการ)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pad Thai Bai Tong (Pad Thai Wrapped in Banana Leaves)

Today, I had the opportunity to visit Wat Bang Bamru. While waiting, I got hungry. I remembered there was an old, well-established Pad Thai shop in the area behind the temple, so I invited my friends to eat there. I personally love their Pad Thai because it's delicious and has a unique aroma. Besides Pad Thai, they also have other dishes like stir-fried basil with large prawns, stir-fried basil with chicken, and stir-fried basil with minced pork. They use pork lard for frying and add crispy pork cracklings, which are incredibly delicious. If you're in the area for business, I highly recommend trying it.

Shop Name: Pad Thai Bai Tong
Opening Hours: 11:00 AM - 2:00 PM and 5:00 PM - 9:00 PM
sample_reviews_en.author: Panjapon Khamsajja

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is on the sweet side, edible.
The service is... not friendly, no smiles.
The queuing system is terrible! If you don't have friends (from other food delivery services or tables) ordering the same thing, don't expect to get anything. They cook in large batches, not in order of queue. Because of the long wait, I just sat there watching what everyone was doing. I didn't just think about it, I saw it with my own eyes!
I was first in line at 5 pm and only got my food after ordering one item at 6 pm!!!!!!!!!! The guy who bought takeout was second in line, the restaurant forgot his order!
After eating and getting in the car, I smelled awful! Tears were streaming down my face.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patcharaporn Phetdaeng

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered basil chicken with a fried egg and pad Thai, totaling almost 600 baht. When I opened the package, I found the fried egg was missing. I called the restaurant, and they refunded 12 baht for the fried egg, but I have to say, their attitude towards customers was terrible. They were argumentative and only focused on winning the argument. The refund seemed like they just wanted to end the problem. Honestly, I don't have a problem with the 12 baht for the fried egg; if they had just apologized, I wouldn't have made a big deal out of it. I've ordered from their app regularly, but I'm definitely not ordering from them again.
sample_reviews_en.author: นางมารร้าย เสียสติ

sample_reviews_en.text: The Pad Thai was incredibly delicious! ⭐️⭐️⭐️ The noodles were perfectly chewy and the flavor was perfectly balanced. I personally like it a little sour, so adding some lime made it even better. They were very generous with the toppings – tofu, dried shrimp, and the special addition of crispy pork cracklings – making the Pad Thai absolutely perfect. I was especially impressed with the river prawn Pad Thai; the prawns were huge and very fresh. The restaurant also has other à la carte dishes. I highly recommend trying the Pad Thai! 💕 You might be able to find parking along the temple wall or park inside the temple grounds.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicharee Roeksasut

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant I used to frequent, about once every two weeks for many years. But in the last two months, the food quality has deteriorated significantly, and the service has worsened. The person who used to take orders is no longer there, and the food isn't always what I ordered. When I asked to change my order, they seemed reluctant. To reiterate, this happened on both of my most recent visits – two items were wrong the first time, and another was wrong the second time. (I drove specifically to eat there, but due to the declining quality and service, I think I'll stop going.)
sample_reviews_en.author: burut jenpravit

restaurants.name: ARROZ - Bangkok - Spanish Restaurant - Paella - Tapas
restaurants.address:

112 Sukhumvit 53 Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Not my favorite place. Because I love Thai foods. But Arroz is a hidden gem in Bangkok, offering a taste of authentic Spanish cuisine in a warm and elegant setting. Specializing in traditional Spanish dishes like paella, tapas, and an array of seafood, each plate is crafted with attention to detail and rich, vibrant flavors. The restaurant’s rustic decor complements the Mediterranean ambiance, creating an inviting space for a cozy dinner or special occasion. The staff is knowledgeable and provides excellent service, enhancing the overall dining experience. Arroz is a must-visit for anyone craving a genuine Spanish feast in the heart of Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanchaya kuram

sample_reviews_en.text:
AVOID !

If you’re looking for a Spanish restaurant go away.
This is litteraly a business.
Really overpriced. Awful service. We was 3 persons and the third person wait more than 20mins for is meal after we receive our meal. So she was looking at us eating for 20mins and she lost appetite (it was not Paella or Rice, just meat).

This is just a business idea restaurant, don’t try to found the “Spanish owner” to feel like in Spain, because you will be disappointed.

Never more.

(And for the community manager or owner, don’t reply BS like we would love to see you come back and do better, because it will not be the case.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Pedro Ferreira

sample_reviews_en.text:
I just had the most incredible dining experience at this Spanish restaurant in Bangkok! The atmosphere is absolutely charming while food was quite authentic- reminiscent of what I enjoyed in Spain.
The standout dish was definitely the gambas al ajillo (red hot shrimp in the pot). The seafood paella was worth the 30-minute wait, loaded with fresh prawns, mussels, and clams. The meal ended perfectly with a slice of classic basque cheesecake which was quite well-balanced.
Service was attentive and kind. We'll definitely return for the black paella next time! ¡Muy delicioso!​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
sample_reviews_en.author: DK

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was very impressed with the service. All the staff were lovely and gave excellent food recommendations. They had incredible service minds. Even though there was some flooding, they provided exceptional assistance, helping me get back to my car without getting my feet wet from the rain! Haha.
The food was delicious and easier to eat than I expected. The Spanish paella was dry, fragrant, and very tasty. The lamb was tender and didn't have any strong, gamey smell. Everything was perfect.
If I have the chance, I will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anuchat Panomchokpisal

sample_reviews_en.text: At first, i am very surprise that we are the only table in the restaurant during the dinner time. The service was great but the rest is not as expect. The food is not that good compared to the price which is very expensive, especially the octopus. The outdoor area has plenty mosquitoes so we have to move inside. The restaurant is a bit wear and tear. Therefore, if you want to find a decent spanish place, this might not be a great choice. However, if you are looking for a place that give you a privacy, this might be the alternatives.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jenvit Chayavoraprapa

sample_reviews_en.text: I can honestly say that if you're looking for a Spanish restaurant with authentic Spanish flavors and atmosphere, this is it!! The service was excellent and very helpful. Even though we arrived at 3 pm and it seemed like the restaurant was closing, the staff quickly turned on the air conditioning and immediately helped recommend dishes, even though the menu had Spanish names. We got exactly what we wanted. The appetizer bread was excellent, and the dipping sauce was refreshing! I will definitely go back again!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: J. K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
For a Spanish restaurant outside of Spain, it’s really good. It’s a place I could even go to for dinner if I were in Spain.

We ordered a paella, croquettes, and patatas bravas. The alioli is one of the best I’ve ever tried, although I asked for something else to add to the paella and they didn’t know which sauce I was referring to.

Overall, the food and service were excellent, but I found the prices too inflated. The place was practically empty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alberto García Mandarina

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing restaurant! Me and my family came here to Celebrate my sisters birthday🎂 and it was the best ever!!! The food was very good and delicious , and since it was a celebration , they gave us a complimentary pudding!!🍮 I Personally really recommend this restaurant to forgeiners that are looking for an authentic Spanish restaurant in Bangkok , their desserts were amazing🍨The waiters were very passionate about their job . Amazing !
sample_reviews_en.author: Milton

restaurants.name: Jao Long Fish Ball Noodle
restaurants.address:

1456 ถ. เจริญกรุง Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating here for a long time. The food is delicious. They used to have amazing Hong Kong-style kale noodles, but lately Hong Kong kale has become expensive, so they use regular kale instead. I've chatted with the owner, and he's very welcoming. His son is also friendly. However, the foreign staff, both male and female, need improvement. They've worked here for many years, but they always have the same expression – unwelcoming, like they haven't received their paycheck. The service is really poor. Just seeing their faces makes me lose my appetite. The staff seem unhappy. When I go to order food, it feels like I'm adding to their workload, making them tired and uncomfortable. I feel bad, so I just walk across to eat at the restaurant opposite. They haven't improved in years; they've only raised the prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: จักรกฤษ เจริญพร

sample_reviews_en.text:
I walked past and the aroma was so tempting, so I went in and ordered boiled chicken rice and fried chicken. I sat down at a table and waited for the food to arrive. It looked delicious and the portions were very generous.
They served the food with dipping sauce for the boiled chicken, but after waiting a while and still not receiving the dipping sauce for the fried chicken, I asked the staff. The staff member went back, presumably to get some, but came back empty-handed and said they were out of sauce. I was surprised and asked why they didn't tell me before I ordered. They apologized and offered if I wanted to change my order to duck or something else. I was very hungry, so I just let it go.

The boiled chicken rice was delicious, but the fried chicken without sauce was so bad I barely touched it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wah Suchada

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was planning to go to Jok Prince across the street, but since there was a wait, I came to this place I had marked as a favorite.

Many other people seemed to be eating noodles, but I tried the Chicken Pad Thai and Lemongrass Juice.

It was my first time trying Lemongrass Juice, and it was so delicious that I fell in love with it. It had a subtle pandan flavor. The Pad Thai was tasty too.

The menu is incredibly diverse; if I had to compare it, it's like Kimbap Cheonguk?

It seems like every dish is above average.

I went back for dinner and had the Pork Basil Rice Bowl again lol.

On my next visit, I'll try the noodles…
sample_reviews_en.author: emma park

sample_reviews_en.text:
Highly recommended for a quick and affordable meal!

Behind the somewhat awkward translation of the restaurant's name lies a typical street food stall, or as we'd say, a "snack bar" style establishment. Don't expect fancy, extravagant cuisine here, but rather solid and tasty dishes at very fair prices. And that's exactly what you get.

The crispy pork was extremely delicious, and the duck and Pad Thai were also quite good, even if you can certainly find both elsewhere at a different level of flavor.

Overall, a good experience if you come with the right, realistic expectations, hence my solid 4 stars!
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex

sample_reviews_en.text:
📷 Location: The restaurant is located on the main road, not too difficult to find.

📷 Atmosphere: Casual, down-to-earth style.

📷 Service: Average.

📷 Food:
Large portions, very filling.
The soy sauce rice is delicious, with meat, sausage, and egg.
The Tom Yum noodle soup is also decent, though not particularly outstanding.

📷 Price: Prices are comparable to other restaurants in the area.

⚖️ Overall Review:
I visited this restaurant by chance for dinner. From what I've researched, it's quite famous and delicious; even with a sensitive stomach, I was fine.

⭐️ Rating: 8/10.
sample_reviews_en.author: Glucose

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been eating here since high school. The squid meatballs are so delicious and chewy. Back then, my friends and I would buy them and share them at school. It was even better when we secretly ate them in the classroom 🤣
(But the smell would get us caught by the teachers!)
I think among all the Yen Ta Fo noodle shops in the area, this is my favorite because of the bouncy meatballs and the fragrant Yen Ta Fo broth.
They actually have rice dishes on the menu too.
I think the price is very reasonable considering the portion size, and it's not hot inside the shop either.
sample_reviews_en.author: Punnapatcharee Chotthanakuljira

sample_reviews_en.text: Chao Long Fish Ball Shop offers a menu featuring pork blood soup, noodles, yen ta fo (pink noodle soup), kuay chap (rice noodle soup with fish balls), rice porridge, Hainanese chicken rice, roast pork rice, crispy pork rice, and delicious, bouncy, soft fish balls with a flavorful, perfectly balanced sweet broth. Regular size is 60 baht, special is 70 baht. Cash payment gets a 5 baht discount. It's neither cheap nor expensive, great value for money. I give this shop 5 stars for taste! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasin Saitanmanee

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the famous shops on Charoen Krung Road in Bangkok, this fish ball shop is said to have been visited by Hong Kong star Chow Yun-fat. I ordered fish ball noodles and chicken rice. The fish ball noodle soup was clear but flavorful, and the fish dumplings and fish balls were indeed delicious. The chicken rice was just average. Also, the picture of Sun Yat-sen hanging on the wall is really XD
sample_reviews_en.author: ken lee

restaurants.name: ฉัน - CHUNN / Central Plaza Ladprao
restaurants.address:

เซ็นทรัล ลาดพร้าว เลขที่ 1693 Phahonyothin Rd, จตุจักร Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I eat at this restaurant regularly. The quality is great. The beef rice bowl is only 250฿, but you get a lot of beef, and the beef is of good quality, not tough. It's great value for money and delicious! ❤️❤️
sample_reviews_th.author: Natcha Prachayakul

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate at the Central Ladprao branch and the service was terrible. The staff were completely rude and lacked manners. I don't know what criteria they use to train their staff; they need further training. The staff inside were talking and laughing loudly, talking over customers' heads, and using vulgar and offensive language. They shouldn't be operating in a mall, especially since there's a service charge. Terrible service and manners. This was my first and only visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yo Charoenwai

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a small restaurant with only a few seats, located in the basement of Central Ladprao.
The beef quality is excellent – we tried several dishes and every one of them was rich in flavor. 🥩✨
The beef curry was absolutely melt-in-your-mouth delicious, and the marinated egg was also amazing.
Don’t miss the “jaew bong” dip – so flavorful and intense! 🌶️

Highly recommended for beef lovers!
sample_reviews_en.author: Patnaree Punobpamatpong

sample_reviews_en.text: I rarely eat out, but when I'm in Bangkok for business, this time I went to the branch in Central Ladprao, a mall I haven't been to in 10 years since graduating from university. I saw that the restaurant I used to eat at in Mega Bangna had opened there, so I decided to try it. It was just as delicious. The price might be a little high, but it was worth it for the taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Plukky Rocker

sample_reviews_en.text: The food quality has dropped considerably compared to before. The pork was quite tough. However, the overall taste was still to my liking. This branch is quite small, and what I really dislike is the design; it's really difficult to get in and out. The floor is already cramped from floor to ceiling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tully Tul

sample_reviews_en.text:
This small restaurant is located in the basement of Central Ladprao.
I intended to try the beef soup, but it was a bit too sweet for my liking. As for the beef rice bowl, my son said it was decent but didn't really like the fried shallots. The staff were attentive and the service was okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Grace

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves grilled beef and pork. Located on the G floor of Central Ladprao. The food is delicious but on the high side, and the quality is good. They use Japanese rice, which is fragrant and tasty. It would be even better if they included soup or vegetables.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kasem Ratana

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I went out to dinner with my family. A male employee came to take our order. I ordered food. I wanted the male employee to tell me what I had ordered. The male employee ignored me. He gave me a dirty look. He frowned at me. Why was he …
sample_reviews_en.author: Mateo

restaurants.name: Uzbekistan Lazzati
restaurants.address:

Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I remember this day like it was yesterday!

While celebrating my birthday, my bf and I decided to stop in here and try the food as I have never had Uzbekistani food and the ladies here were such darlings.  They really took care of us I felt like I was sitting in at a kitchen table with my family.

We got the food and it was so tasty and the bread was out of this world, all homemade by these wonderful  ladies.

Once we finished the delicious food we stopped to have a conversation with them, finding out their life story and how they ended up here in pattaya, it was quite interesting to listen to.

Once we finished and paid out billl the ladies packed up some breakfast treats for us to take back to our hotel to have Uzbekistani breakfast with our morning coffee.  WOW .. such a sweet gesture, we graciously accepted and went on our merry way!  I will always remember that gesture!  Thank you so much dn I would highly recommend to come to this place for the heart warming food and delicious bites.

Follow fauzia for more late night food travel and experiences from 📍Bangkok and beyond make sure to follow us here as well as 👉🏽👉🏽⭐️⭐️Facebook, Instagram and of course YouTube! 📍⭐️⭐️⭐️👈🏽👈🏽
sample_reviews_en.author: Follow Fauzia

sample_reviews_en.text:
**"As a consulting chef, I deeply appreciate the importance of authenticity and the added value it brings to the overall dining experience. This Uzbekistani restaurant is a true gem! The setting is absolutely enchanting, with beautiful carpets and pictures creating an authentic atmosphere. The food is equally impressive. The meat skewers are generously portioned, juicy, and incredibly flavorful, perfectly seasoned. We were particularly delighted by the amazing meat-stuffed pastries, freshly baked in their brick oven – a true tandoori experience. To top it off, the salads were a refreshing accompaniment.
What truly sets this place apart is the authentic experience. You'll find it frequented by locals, including many Russians and Uzbeks themselves – a sure sign of quality. And the prices? Remarkably fair for such delicious and authentic cuisine. Highly recommended!"**
sample_reviews_en.author: ofer aviv

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good food, but needs attention to detail
​We visited the Uzbekistan restaurant in Pattaya and the food was truly delicious with generous portions. The interior of the restaurant looked very neat and well-kept. However, our experience in the outdoor seating area (where we sat because of smoking) could have been better.
​The tables had plastic covers but clearly needed dusting. Basic essentials like salt, pepper, and napkins were missing from the table. Also, despite all of us ordering meat dishes, we were only given forks and had to ask for knives. While the food is great, these small details make the difference between a 4-star and a 5-star experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sissy V

sample_reviews_en.text: The experience fell far short of my expectations. The Kazan kebab lacked the anticipated cold yogurt cucumber soup, and its taste resembled goulash without the vegetables and with only a few slices of potatoes. The texture was chewy instead of fried, and I left meat on the plate due to the absence of complementary elements. Similarly, my partner received a meager amount of rice for a 250 baht dish, and the taste resembled what one might find at a Russian night market, which is not a compliment. 30 baht for bottle filter water..
sample_reviews_en.author: Dimitri Brezhnev

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here at about 1:30 PM on Thursday and I had a great and filling meal. I had a big appetite, so I ordered 4 skewers of their lamb kebab and let me tell you, I could only go through 2 skewers before I gave up. Very generous with the portions and also high quality meat. The kabob was tender, juicy, and well seasoned and had all the accompaniments like grilled veggies, onions, etc. Being so early, I was the only person there but they still made a great effort to accommodate me. 10/10 would definitely come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ali

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent atmosphere, if you eat outside they put some russian type music i like it a lot, the food is the best ive eaten in pattaya im more of a europe type cuisine , i tasted my first borsch which was excellent and a rice and beef dish which i forgot the name but not the good taste. Its located on a calm location and you have cats just on the left, prices are ok for the quality of the food if you want prices like kiss food restaurant its not for you, but the portions are much bigger so its worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: powerlink provider

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s pretty uncommon to find a Uzbeki restaurant in Thailand, but having tried it before in UK I had to have it again. So we ordered Uzbek salad a mixture of tomatoes onions cucumber in olive oil with lemon and salt. We tried the Uzbek plov which was beef and rice cooked together with carrots and cumin seeds and the lamb shish kebabs. The food was amazing, no complaints and great portion sizes. Would definitely return here and would recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: aly nathu

sample_reviews_en.text: Zero customer service, they don’t even say hi and thanks, pictures on menu is match with what you will get, I paid 250 b for a small plate ( baby food sized) with few pieces of small meats, the worst part I paid 300b and takes few minutes to give my change ( it was only 2 more people there) not busy and they gave me back all coins so I could leave for tips smart A..
sample_reviews_en.author: D D

restaurants.name: Crown Kitchen
restaurants.address:

328 Krung Kasem Rd, Bang Khun Phrom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It has a nostalgic, old-fashioned atmosphere. The elderly couple who run the place provide excellent service. As for the food, it's fantastic, a 10/10/10 for everything we ordered. We were amazed!
⭐️ The crispy fried sea bass with herbs was delicious and packed with flavor.
⭐️ The shrimp in fish sauce was authentic; it was truly marinated, not just raw shrimp.
⭐️ The oyster omelet was delicious; even after it cooled down, the batter remained crispy.
⭐️ The dry noodles with shrimp looked bland, but were amazing with the seafood dipping sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aim PT

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to a funeral at the temple and stopped for a meal before heading back. I searched on Google Maps and found this restaurant right next to the temple. The atmosphere was a bit old-fashioned, but the food was delicious and reasonably priced. I ordered the crispy catfish salad; it used real fish meat with no added flour, and it tasted great. The pineapple fried rice was delicious, and the braised tofu in red sauce was also tasty. I didn't get a chance to take pictures because I was too busy eating!
sample_reviews_en.author: Warang Wong

sample_reviews_en.text: I love this restaurant! It's going to be one of my favorites. The food was delicious and came very quickly. It was so delicious I wanted to go up to the chef and tell him how amazing it was! The staff were welcoming, kind, and always smiling. The atmosphere was nice and peaceful, which I really liked. P.S. I didn't get a chance to take pictures of the food, but it looked so delicious and appetizing! The price was reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ming K

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old, established restaurant in Bangkok with a very extensive menu. It's recommended to go with a group so you can try many different dishes. The food tastes excellent; the braised duck with pickled lemons is delicious, and the stir-fried mixed vegetables are perfectly cooked and fragrant. The staff are older but provide excellent service and recommendations; the atmosphere is very warm and welcoming.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boat K.

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a cookshop style, with an atmosphere that feels like stepping back in time to eat in the old days. It's warm and inviting. The shrimp spring rolls are similar to glass shrimp. I recommend ordering the American fried rice and the Hong Kong-style beef (beef in a red sauce, similar to stir-fried with tomato sauce but fragrant and sweet, not greasy).
sample_reviews_en.author: Jinsei

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ten years have passed, and this restaurant remains unchanged. The food is delicious, the atmosphere is old-fashioned. If you're looking for a restaurant with great food, a wide variety of menu options, reasonable prices, and a traditional setting, you must try this place.

P.S. You can park at Wat Makut Kasattri next to the restaurant and walk over easily.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nirun Choo

sample_reviews_en.text: I went without any expectations. Judging from the pictures, it looked like ordinary food, but the taste was familiar and delicious. It's the kind of food you could eat repeatedly; it's comforting. The staff were lovely, polite, and always smiling. It's an old restaurant, but clean. If I'm in the area again, I'll definitely stop by.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nok Ja

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant maintains its classic charm in both taste and atmosphere. If you're in the area and it's mealtime, just stop by without hesitation. The portions aren't large, so you can order several dishes. The food comes out quickly, and the service is friendly, like eating at a relative's house.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sobthana Anprasert

restaurants.name: Ruen Urai
restaurants.address:

118 Surawong Rd, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to Ruen Urai.
Located on the grounds of the Rose Hotel, one block off the main road, it can be a little hard to find if you're visiting for the first time, but that doesn't stop it from becoming a truly hidden gem.

This time, I ordered Massaman curry (with lamb), the recommended appetizer, and an iced coffee. The appetizer salad was refreshing and delicious with a strong cilantro flavor, and the deep-fried crab was fragrant and very satisfying.

The Massaman curry looks spicy, but in fact it's hardly spicy at all, with a sweet, sauce-like flavor that is easy for Japanese people to enjoy (rice is included).

The restaurant has a calm atmosphere and pleasant music, making it a relaxing place to eat.

However, the pool right in front of the restaurant allows you to see the guests swimming, which may be a bit of a challenge.

Overall, I was very satisfied with both the atmosphere and the food, and I recommend this restaurant for those looking for a quiet meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Y W

sample_reviews_en.text:
✨ A wonderful discovery in Bangkok 🇹🇭
Tonight, we discovered a true gem: Ruen Urai. ❤️
From the moment we arrived, we were charmed by the setting: a beautiful traditional Thai house, surrounded by greenery, with an elegant, warm, and serene atmosphere. 🌿🏡✨
And to make the experience even more interesting, we didn't choose any of the dishes! 😍
I asked the chef to choose the appetizers and main courses for us, specifying that we wanted one without chili and the second VERY LITTLE (meaning very mild, lol).

… 😳😳🤣🤣
And what an excellent decision! 👏
The chef introduced us to wonderful combinations of Thai flavors, with refined, delicate, and incredibly delicious dishes. A true culinary discovery! 🤩 The service was also exceptional: attentive, friendly, and caring throughout the meal.

We're so glad we discovered this place. ❤️ A beautiful setting, top-notch service, and exceptional cuisine… a truly wonderful Thai experience. 🇹🇭✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Oslo Oslo

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service here is exceptional, and the atmosphere is warm and inviting, making it a perfect spot for tourists or overseas colleagues. The food leans toward a modern, elevated take on Thai cuisine. While I personally favor traditional recipes that have been handed down through generations, this place offers a refreshing twist on classic flavors.

The Krathong Thong appetizer was flavourful, and the coconut ice cream was the highlight, creamy, perfectly smooth, and a delightful way to end the meal. Pork Jowl slices were perfect - melts in your mouth. Overall, it’s a great spot to enjoy Thai food with a contemporary flair, especially if you’re looking to impress visitors with a memorable dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Celine

sample_reviews_en.text:
202609
Revisit
Shrimp and Grapefruit Salad
→Sweet and sour, delicious; a flavor that Japanese people wouldn't think of, but it suits my taste.
Total 1350 THB/person

Thai fusion cuisine!

Good ingredients and a stylish space!

Recommended for those who have stayed for several days, are tired of eating Thai food, and want to try some delicious Thai food that's a little different!

• Deep-fried crab and minced meat

• Deep-fried soft-shell crab

• Gai Yang (grilled chicken)

All dishes are carefully prepared!

It's difficult to find using Google Maps, so it might be better to set the destination to Rose Hotel first, and then to Ruen Wrai.
sample_reviews_en.author: izaya -yahn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Table of 7, could walk in on a Saturday evening but had to sit outside in the garden. Well lit enough to have a nice meal, however there are cats and mosquitoes around. The staff are attentive and will offer mosquito repellent and light an incense under the table if requested.

Food was great; elevated homestyle cooking with standouts being the deep fried watercress, and the crispy cups. Food all came within 10-15 mins.

Server was attentive and tried to make it a good dining experience for us. On the slower side at times, but done so with care.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joysha

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely stunning place! The ambiance is a perfect 10/10 – peaceful, idyllic, and surrounded by a beautiful garden with a pool. The gentle sound of the water adds to the relaxing atmosphere.

The food is simply outstanding – incredibly fresh, beautifully seasoned, and full of refined, extraordinary flavors. Every dish was a highlight.

The service was flawless: extremely friendly, attentive, and professional. A truly perfect experience from start to finish. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Susi von Däniken

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ve been coming to this restaurant for many years. It has deteriorated dramatically. No surprise it wax almost empty. The food overpriced, They seem to want to try something complex and different for each food item often simple is better. The service non attentive bordering on arrogant. For one  of the mains, the most expensive, we were brought the wrong dish. One entree was not what we expected. A real disappointment. I won’t be going back
sample_reviews_en.author: George Inoz

sample_reviews_en.text: The price is unjustifiable here, not even by the setting, given that we were seated at a small table right by the restaurant's entrance. A measly bottle of beer cost 140 baht, and of course, it's nowhere mentioned on the small drinks menu (at least nowhere legibly; I imagine it must be written on the back in off-white font on a light white background) that the 10% service charge and VAT are not included in the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phoenant

restaurants.name: ราดหน้ายอดผักนายเหลา-ต้นตำรับนางลิ้นจี่ (Nailao Ladna Yodpak)
restaurants.address:

99/4 Nang Linchi Rd, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've spent several weeks in Bangkok and travel all over the USA and world (see my reviews). So please understand the significance of what I am about to tell you: This is the best Pad See Ew I've ever eaten.

In Bangkok. 🏙
In Thailand. 🇹🇭
In the world. 🌎

They do cook it with pork but will happily omit the meat if you are vegetarian👍🙏

This Pad See Ew had the most delicate wide flat noodles I've ever eaten, and the general flavor is smokey from the coal. When adding the pepper vinegar to the mix, introducing a necessary acid, you are in for a world class treat! The proprietors and operators are some of the most friendly Thai I have encountered thus far. They were elated when I smiled ear to ear as I ate this food - high pride is here! 60 Baht per dish... I ordered 2 back to back! Do not let the distant location scare you away - it's good. Real good. Damn good! 🔥 The real deal 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Ormand Deen

sample_reviews_en.text: Noodle with gravy sauce- radna or stir fried noodle with egg - pad see eew are only two choices to have here.  There are small options to choose from like small noodle - sennmee/ large flat noodle- kuay tiew / egg noodle -bamee and even no noodle at all - Kaolao.  Only pork here no chic or meat as choices but it is all great.  Possibly one of the best place to have pad see eew in bangkok.  It is oily and unhealthy and possibly cost you about 750cal, but it worth the sweat you have to burn after finishing it.  Smell the burnt of that pan, lightly sweet and salty tgt with tender meat are the key to a great pad-see eew.  Service is good street style.  No deco no air cond, but that is not why you are here.  i normally order mine double eggs (recently tried triple and quad, double is about right).  The radna is clearly not as good as pad see eew though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tui Dusadee

sample_reviews_en.text:
We prefer to find places where locals eats.  So for the best local Pad See Ew, come here!
They only serve 2 types of noodles, Pad See Ew and Lard Nar.
We ordered the traditional Pad See We with Flat rice noodles and the Lard Nar with thin rice noodles. But being the piggies that we are, we also got Pad See Ew Sen Mee Paem Kai Jeow. Which is a fluffy fried egg omelette on top of Pad See Ew with thin rice noodles.
3 noodles and 1 bottle of water set us back 180 baht!
The restaurant is away from the center but it is worth the trek if you are a big Pad See Ew fan like us.
My fav was the traditional Pad See Ew.  The pork was marinated already and super tasty.  Noodles were fried with enough "wok air" that was just delicious.
Place is small and pretty busy with take outs as well.
But they have menu in English too so it's easy to order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Katrina Z

sample_reviews_en.text: Fried Noodles with pork in gravy sauce  and Stir - Fried rice noodles with soy sauce and pork must try. Nailao is the most popular 2 menus in this area. The original both noodles come from China which are very popular in Thailand. All restaurants as 5 stars restaurants must has as Fried Noodles with pork in gravy sauce. My parents really like and love to have both two kinds of noodles at Nailao shop. We like smell smoked from noodles fried as real fried noodles. It is not easy to find yummy fried noodles in the city. Don't miss it. You will love to have it again and again. My family have been eating for long time since till now and move on even the price is higher just 10 baht so, we can accept coz a lot of pork.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patchanipa Sridaeng

sample_reviews_en.text: I used to buy their stir-fried noodles regularly to take home. I liked their stir-fried noodles; it was easy to eat... One day, I called to order, and the owner, an elderly lady, completely lost it. She lectured me on how to order, telling me not to order like that, just to say this and that, and that her phone wasn't working well. I patiently ordered, staying quiet until the end... Then I went to pick up my food, and she apologized, saying her phone wasn't working properly. I accepted the apology and didn't say anything... But after that, when I wanted to order again, I hesitated and decided to skip it, because if that happened again, I'd probably get upset and wouldn't want a confrontation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Antonio Oattono

sample_reviews_en.text:
Please check your order properly because the restaurant said customer always check their order by themself because they are all busy !!!!!!!. So today they forgot to give me a noodle for Lad Na ( I got only the soup). Maybe it’s my fault that I didn’t check before left the restaurant but at the end I have to pay for Grab to take the noodle by myself . That’s what the restaurant said and recommended me .

So please customers!!!!!! it’s your responsibility !!!! If one day you found something suspicious or miss something from your order from this restaurant, it’s your fault and you have to pay by yourself for the ride to pickup or change it.
sample_reviews_en.author: nipa Sri

sample_reviews_en.text: Arrived @ 11am, before the lunch crowd. Mostly takeaways at this time from what I observed, managed to get a table immediately. 1st time eating pad see ew - it didn't disappoint. Super tasty, albeit slightly sweet as per other reviews. Got the flat noodle and thin noodle version for pad see ew, with additional fried omelette. Also got a rad na with yellow noodles recommended by the friendly staff. Will taste the pad see ew separately without mixing the omelette on next trip for a more accurate taste of the wok hei. Recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bernard

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, very fragrant from the wok. Pad see ew or Rad na are both great, but Pad see ew is even better. The noodles are just the right size and fragrant. You can park on the side of the road. You have to get a stamp at 7-Eleven, or if you buy a minimum of 200 baht, you can park for free for an hour. I can't remember if you don't buy anything or you have to pay for parking. This shop accepts cash payments.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narawara Boonset

restaurants.address:

Maha NakhonKhwaeng 2Khet 44, Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dear, Value  Manager for Nigiya Sukhumvit
Any way please have alook on your cooking timing , period of service ,, once you charge them 10% service charge, You must deliver the best of service.
Positive : food taste was great, environment really good.
Negative : Food take time supers long ,

We was asking team to take out 2 dishes from the check coz of take super long time for ( Sashimi )

We would love to see your improvement for the next.

Thank you
sample_reviews_en.author: NUTTAPUT PHIWLUANG

sample_reviews_en.text: Interior is like a plastic cherry blossom garden with a view of the kitchen, very typical japanese style of seating, Asahi draft is nice and cold, its my second visit to the place, ordered cod fish roe, bbq squid, grilled rice wirh miso, garlic rice. Look the place is not fine dining but the service is quick and the food is fine, everything is a bit towards the extra salty side for me. Perfect for a quick bite and you can be on your way.
sample_reviews_en.author: J.S. Kullar (kullarclicks)

sample_reviews_en.text:
A chain izakaya from Tokyo with a number of branches in Bangkok. Normally, I visit the one in Thonglor, but I just happened to be in Asoke so I dropped by this one. It is just as good.

My favourite dish is the grilled/roasted/baked (not sure which) pumpkin with butter. I haven't been able to find one this good anywhere else in Bangkok. The place is famous for its variety of "nabe" (Japanese hotpot) which is also worth a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tap Yeophantong

sample_reviews_en.text: What a disappointment when it comes to service! Our sashimi took over an hour to be ready, and a simple sushi roll took about 1.5 hours. Way too slow when it comes to food prep. Completely ruined the whole dining experience! We were sitting upstairs and the waiters weren't always there too. Such slow service on a Saturday night is quite unacceptable, no matter how good the food tastes.
sample_reviews_en.author: ShuEe Wee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent Izakaya restaurant. Service very friendly, but they mixed up our orders quite a bit (1item missing, 1 swapped for a different dish, another drink completely missing) hence not 5stars.
The frozen beer glass, the quality sashimi and sushi, and the nice atmosphere are all great.
Expect 10% service charge added, but prices are still fair. I can recommend the place
sample_reviews_en.author: István Nagy

sample_reviews_en.text: By coincidence we found this Japanese restaurant and had a fantastic diner. As Salmon Sashimi and Sushi lovers we ordered it and it was fabulous, through all details, soya sauce, wasabi, ginger you feel and taste that the staff wants to give you an unique treat. The tempura was absolutely world class. Friendly and efficient service
sample_reviews_en.author: marc van looy

sample_reviews_en.text: A pretty authentic Japanese ambience restaurant on the first floor, it's crowded with Japanese. The food is of good quality and the service is warm and friendly. The BBQ buffet on the third floor is value for money even with the time limit. You can request for smaller portion so as not to waste food. Repeat order if you like it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julian Wong

sample_reviews_en.text: Nagiya @ asoke is worse than Nihonmachi and more expensive. Salmon rolls are thin. Best things are Asahi and Belly pork grill and tacoWasabi. Happyhour for Asahi start 4pm-6pm. Second floor has a bbq buffet. The sauce is not bad. All staff very nice and polite. There are 3 or 4 izakaya in this area, I reccommended this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jo Jo

restaurants.name: Himalayan Coffee
restaurants.address:

Samsen 4 Alley, Ban Phan Thom, Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Had the most lovely experience at this cafe, firstly for a delicious breakfast with the traditional Nepalese iced tea with cardamom - soooo yum 10/10, pancakes which were so good. Then we came back for dinner because we wanted to try the traditional dinner! We had the vegetable thali and the dhido (stiff dough) with chicken which was so delicious, perfectly seasoned food and such unique flavours we hadn’t tried before!! We are from Australia and loved the dhido which was something we’d never heard of or tried before but it was delicious to soak up the curries. Please come and try this delicious traditional food we highly recommend ! Also such nice people work here and explained to me about the food and what it is in Nepal. 10/10
sample_reviews_en.author: Lulu H

sample_reviews_en.text:
Himalayan Coffee is an absolute gem. Whether you’re stopping by around 6 PM or rolling in closer to 10 at night, this place never misses. The food is consistently delicious, with incredible Nepalese and Indian dishes, plus solid Western options too—so there’s truly something for everyone.

But what really makes this place special is the owner. Mario / Prakash is a genuinely beautiful human being. Warm, welcoming, and full of heart—he takes real pride in what he serves and how he treats people. Tell him what you’re in the mood for and trust him… he will not steer you wrong.

Great food, great vibes, and even better people. Places like this are rare. Highly, highly recommended. 🙌☕️🍛
sample_reviews_en.author: Jigar Patel

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a wonderful experience at Himalayan Coffee Bangkok. The food was absolutely delicious, and the prices were very reasonable and affordable. Every dish we ordered was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully prepared.
The service was impressively quick, and the restaurant was very clean and well-maintained. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and attentive, which made our visit even more enjoyable.
We truly enjoyed our meal and highly recommend Himalayan Coffee Bangkok to anyone looking for tasty food, great service, and excellent value for money. We will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: binod pant

sample_reviews_en.text: I feel like I’m in the Himalayas maybe because their aircon is open every time 😅 I like the vibe and colours here I always comes here 3 times a day ,in morning I take a Himalayan black tea and then meera special king size macchiato and later at night for some chilled & cheap beer when I get bored I asked samir to play “om mane padme ho “ and singing bowl really nice
sample_reviews_en.author: Petrus Quin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The manager Mario was fantastic. Very friendly & polite. Would definitely recommend this warm & friendly place.
Had the chicken tikka & it was fantastic. 10/10.
Then had the mutton saag brand new to the menu. Melt in the mouth mutton 15/10.
Will 100% return when I visit Bangkok again.
Thank you for being a great host host Mario.
Richard from England.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachael Cook

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best places to enjoy delicious vegetarian food. The owners are incredibly humble, friendly, and helpful. They take the time to explain the menu and ensure you get the best dishes according to your taste. I truly loved the food and the warm hospitality. A must-visit for anyone looking for great vegetarian cuisine. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: Narendra Darbar

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is amazing!
The service is great and the food is even better.
They have as many veggie options as meat and all taste absolutely amazing.
