Sorry for the half eaten food on the picture but we could not wait eating.

They also have singing bowls and the atmosphere is just great.

It might not be Thai food but if you ask me this is way better!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thomas

sample_reviews_en.text: What an experience!!! A culinary and atmospheric pleasure. Mario is a new businessman in the area but establishing a unique niche. My espresso was superbly balanced. Eggs and Yak cheese delicious. Even let me try some Nepalese pepper 😋. Mario has big plans for yoga upstairs as well and I wish him all the best 👍🏻 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Graham Dunn

restaurants.name: SHEMROON IRANIAN,arabic,indian,turkish FOODرستوران ایرانی،هندی،عربی شمرون،حلال,halal food
restaurants.address:

11, Top of Hillary, 43 Sukhumvit 11 Alley, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came here two times, for thier Amazing Sultani kebab. Both times It was perfectly prepared. It comes with two side sauses, red and green, both are so nice. The other small plate with  fresh round cut of onions, fresh small greem chily peper, and pickled cucumber and carrot.
The main dish comes, as seen in the video, with a minest meat kaban, tall piece of Sultani beef, white and zofran rice. The dish is decorated with grilled baby tomato and hot green spicy peper and basil and fresh onions.

Overall amazing food and service. The four service stars only for cash only option.
sample_reviews_en.author: Abdulaziz Boker

sample_reviews_en.text:
SHEMROON X is a great place for anyone looking to enjoy a diverse selection of Middle Eastern and Asian flavors, with a menu featuring Iranian, Arabic, Indian, and Turkish cuisine.

The variety is impressive, making it a convenient choice when everyone in the group has different preferences. The dishes offer a nice mix of traditional flavors, and the overall experience is enjoyable.

A good option for families and groups who want plenty of choices under one roof. I would definitely recommend giving SHEMROON X a try if you enjoy Iranian, Arabic, Indian, or Turkish food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ahmad Almoosawi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Finally, I found an authentic Persian chelo kebab. I’m not sure if chelo kebab is the same everywhere in the world, but I always look for kebab that’s freshly made. You can really tell when it’s prepared with care and passion.

It was so satisfying that it made me sleepy afterward, which, for me, is a sign that I truly enjoyed the meal. I finished both skewers..the chicken and the beef (or mutton).

I’ll definitely be coming back. In my opinion, their kebab is far better than the ones I’ve had on Soi 5 or anywhere else in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: rania Tan Qui

sample_reviews_en.text:
The place is small and cozy. On the second floor, they have indoor and outdoor seating, on a small balcony. I came at 2 p.m., which was empty and nice.
Our requests were:
Meat kebab with rice, Mashallah. The two skewers were plentiful and large. The dish was sufficient for two people to enjoy. The meat was clean and there was no rancidity or exhalation. What came in the throat had a taste.
And naan with love, soft and juicy
And a green salad, fresh and clean
I will repeat the experience and I definitely recommend it
sample_reviews_en.author: rOrO wazgar

sample_reviews_en.text: Pretty decent considering the difficulty in getting some of the ingredients. Was very excited to see Iranian basil on the side. The grilled meats were ok, a little dry. The Koresh were fine, I don’t think they were made that day, but that’s still ok. Would recommend if you’re missing Iranian food after traveling for a prolonged period.
sample_reviews_en.author: Py Tries

sample_reviews_en.text: Resturant is ok atmosphere only problem i saw were 2 things one they dont not accept credit cards guess for restrictions  and 2nd the chicken kabob was salty. I dont like too much salt in the food no idea why they put so much salt in the food. Portions were adequate rice was OK  I prefer little more cooked overall is OK to try it .
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunny Zarbafi

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is absolutely delicious, the grilled items are more than wonderful, the portions are generous, and the price is reasonable. However, I feel the place needs to be bigger because it was incredibly crowded. I highly recommend it. Honestly, I went there by chance, but it turned out to be my favorite restaurant in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: haya almajed

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is very good, the food is delicious and the portions are good, but the rice was a little salty. The prices are reasonable, but the location is inconvenient because it's above a bar, and the floor shakes annoyingly from the music. Overall, the food is good, but the location and atmosphere need improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohammed Mohammed

restaurants.name: Thongsmith Siamese Boat Noodles
restaurants.address:

1031 Phloen Chit Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Located in the upscale Central Embassy mall, on the fifth floor amid all the other eating establishments. Thong Smith gives a hawker style/street food vibe. Numerous selections of beef, pork or chicken noodle soups with your choice of flat noodle, vermicelli or original Thai noodle. We ordered a refreshing lychee tea which has the right amount of sweetness, to go with our Pad Thai, Chicken Noodle soup and Beef Noodle soup . Pad Thai is always one of our choice dish wherever we go that it’s offered. So I’m glad the Pad Thai did not disappoint since we’re in Thailand and this place should be offering authentic Thai meals. If you don’t have the chance to do the street food tour, this is a good place to try for Thai cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marie O

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great looking shop and fantastic food. The portions are great and broth is hearty. I love boat noodles and this place is certain an upgrade.

The service however sadly lacked even fundamentals. I was a solo diner waiting for a table. I made eye contact with 2 servers and they just looked away, as if thry didn't want the business. Even one of the staff who ended her shift and was walking out called out to her colleagues that there's someone waiting.

Nobody bothered. Until maybe a few mins later when I was awkwardly standing there.
sample_reviews_en.author: EatSleepPlay

sample_reviews_en.text:
tried the Australian Wagyu Boat Noodle and it was SUPER rich & tasty! 😋 the wagyu meat is tender and perfectly soaked in the broth. we ordered the braised beef & tendon rice bowl too and it was pretty decent. i’d recommend going for their noodles as it’s their signature.

thai milk tea is very refreshing too! but it might be too sweet for people who are not so much into sugary drinks.

serving time is rather fast, combined with quality service. highly recommend this one to noodle lovers out there 🍜
sample_reviews_en.author: Gina Fitria Adita

sample_reviews_en.text: Really enjoyed the meats in this boat noodle-the ox tongue, sliced beef, shank, and tendon were all so soft and tender they just fell apart. The beef ball was nothing special, though. I got a level 3 spicy, which wasn't very spicy at all, but the broth was seriously salty. That's why I had to knock off a star. Wondering is it the chili paste make it very salty because my friend having the noodle without spiciness one is not salty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pan Lian Thai

sample_reviews_en.text: I love coming to Tong Smith for the beef noodle soup. There was a short wait, but it moved along smoothly and I was soon seated. The service was excellent, and the Aussie Wagyu beef in my Thai noodle soup was absolutely fantastic. Every bite reminded me why I keep coming back. I genuinely look forward to my return every time I’m in Bangkok, and I only wish there was an outlet in Phuket.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rohan Watt

sample_reviews_en.text: This place was so good we revisited the establishment on our last evening to get a fix of their dried pork noodles and bouncy egg noodles.  The trick is to add a portion of noodles to your order as it’s the star once you infused it with the rich sauce and condiments. The fried banana dessert was also excellent and staff were very attentive and the service very good. Such good value!
sample_reviews_en.author: Winston Khoo

sample_reviews_en.text: Thong Smith is available at majority of the Bangkok malls. Decided to visit its branch in the Central Embassy since we were in this neighborhood. The soup does not disappoint, intense and flavorful whether it's beef or pork based boat noodle soup. Cracklings appetizer is a must, to add some crispy crunch to your meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alan and Deirdre Forever

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant was full during weekday lunchtimes, but there wasn't a long line, and we were seated in about 5 minutes.

This restaurant offers rich soup, meat, and chewy noodles.

The prices are a little on the high side, though.
sample_reviews_en.author: とのか夫婦

restaurants.name: Vanida Duck Noodle Ratchaprarop 4
restaurants.address:

447/47 4 ซอย Makkasan, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered the duck drumstick noodles with rice stick noodles. Really good! It seems like a family business. Owner granny is very cute! She said Aroimakmak! Indeed. Love the noodles and soup especially. The price is 80 baht per bowl of drumstick noodles, less price for other ranges, pretty reasonable. We also see duck blood on menu! People who are up for exotic food can try! People who like spicy can also add a bit of their chilli powder! It is also available on Grab and other food delivery platforms! Owner can speak mandarin and english. She asked how we find her place and we told her about google reviews. Apparently, she is not satisfied with the current number of stars. Can see that she really put in efforts in preparation of the food! Worth the trip! Will come visit again! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Qiu Ju Yeo

sample_reviews_en.text:
After an early morning flight into Bangkok, we were pretty hungry and found this little hidden gem behind our hotel — Vanida Duck Noodles. We ordered the duck thigh noodles soup with some duck blood added. The broth was really flavorful, and the duck was tender and tasty. It’s definitely a satisfying bowl of noodles.

The service was quick and friendly, which made the experience even better. The place has a chill, laid-back vibe — there were two cats in the store, they seem very comfortable hanging around customers, and we saw more cats on the rooftop. It was a little uncomfortable as I am not a fan of cats but the delicious noodles compensated for it.

Overall, a great spot for authentic duck noodles. I’d definitely recommend it and would come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sylvia M

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tucked away in the rustic neighborhood, against the modern landscape that is Siam, you will find flavourful and fragrant duck noodle soup that seemingly revitalises the soul. Their braised/stewed pork rice is a hit in my books too.

Found this stall a few years back while aimlessly browsing Google Maps for ideas for lunch and tried my luck with this family business. Since then, I have been finding the time to dine here on each of my Bangkok trips.

I recommend fueling up at their stall before going on a shopping spree at Platinum Mall.

The business is family run and they are attentive and friendly, managing to converse in a mixture of English and Mandarin, and Teochew for the ah ma.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benjamin Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a small plate of dry noodles with mixed duck and duck offal. I really liked the duck intestines; they were delicious and crispy. All the duck offal was very well prepared, with no unpleasant smell. The blood pudding was soft and melted in your mouth, and the broth was fragrant. The noodles were chewy and soft. The shop is a bit cramped though. The owner, an elderly woman over 80, is kind and still very energetic. She likes to chat, but her children or grandchildren are always arguing loudly, typical of Thai people of Chinese descent, haha. My boyfriend ate braised pork leg (with added egg) and said it was delicious as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: อรทัย อนุรักษ์วัฒนะ

sample_reviews_en.text: We came for lunch and there was still food available. No need to worry about the heat, there were fans everywhere. The braised duck was tender, not chewy or dry. The duck intestines were clean and odorless. The owner, Grandma, was very lovely, and the staff were also very friendly and attentive to customers, always smiling. Grandma brought out the steamed buns piping hot. The pork filling was delicious and very fragrant, easy to eat, like bouncy, smooth pork. The taro filling was smooth, not overly sweet, with a mild, just-right flavor, and had lotus seeds in the center.
sample_reviews_en.author: Z.zonata

sample_reviews_en.text:
So in love with this place! Very local and owner can speak chinese & teochew. We came here 3 out of 5 days of our stay in BKK. Tried their soup & dry version and i personally preferred dry egg noodles while my husband preferred the soup with original pad thai noodles. We also tried their stewed pork rice which was good, but i still prefer their noodles.

We added on duck wings which was tender. Owner recommended chicken wings on the last day but sadly we had to return back already :( will definitely come back here to dine when i'm in BKK agaain!
sample_reviews_en.author: Isabelle Tay

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Duck Noodle is Great!!!! A hidden gem at a back alley. You can dine in the shop house. Owners are friendly, origin Teochew Chinese. Best additional toppings, chicken feet, chicken drum stick and wing, duck blood like tofu melts in your mouth and the soup broth was heavenly.I'm

If u can't make it to the stall, u can order it via Grab food platform. Search for Vanida Duck Noodle, make sure u select the correct name of the stall in app.

Atmosphere, it's a retro shop house unit. There are some friendly cats around owned by the shop owners.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mocca Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: Easily one of the best duck noodles I have ever eaten in my life. Ordered the duck drumstick noodles and the stewed pork rice with egg. The duck broth is rich and full of flavour. The duck meat is so soft that you can break it without chewing. The stewed pork rice is good as well. The pork just melts in the mouth. Seats are limited as it's in an alley. And it's quite hot so I advise bringing a neck fan or something. But overall, one of the best street stalls I ever tasted in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kenneth Lo

restaurants.name: ZaabEli
restaurants.address:

79, ศูนย์การค้า เซ็นทรัล พลาซา พระราม 3, ชั้น 6 Sathu Pradit Rd, ช่องนนทรี, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We ate Northeastern Thai food at Zaap E-Lee, Central Rama 3 branch. The dishes we ordered were: Fried Corn (sweet, crispy, delicious), Som Tum with thin noodles (delicious, but personally, I prefer the Luang Prabang style Som Tum), Crispy Pork Rinds (crispy, but some pieces were large and hard, making them difficult to eat), Salmon with Lotus Stem (delicious, rich flavor, tender and crunchy lotus stems), and Crying Tiger Beef (this time, the portion was large, chewy, and had a strong smell, which I didn't like). The total cost was approximately 1200 baht, including a 10% service charge. The staff provided good service, and the food didn't take long to arrive. The restaurant was clean, well-decorated, and had plenty of tables.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jib Bird Search For

sample_reviews_en.text: The wait for food was extremely long. It was difficult to get the staff's attention. They seemed to prioritize serving large tables, getting their food last. I ordered very spicy but received mildly spicy. When I informed the staff, they just added more chili. The pork cracklings were soggy and mushy. They didn't even inform me that some of my ordered items were unavailable. In the end, I had to go find another restaurant because I was still hungry and didn't want to wait any longer. At first, I thought we were being difficult, but the table next to us, who arrived after us, also cancelled their order because they couldn't wait any longer. Not recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rose Jones

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has both indoor and outdoor seating, with good seating arrangements that aren't crowded. The food is flavorful and delicious, but if you don't eat spicy food, you should inform the staff. Today, I ordered four dishes: salmon fried rice (this dish was very delicious), squid salad with just a little bit of fermented fish to make the dressing rich. It was spicy because I ordered it with normal spiciness, fried pork neck, and spicy pork cartilage soup with tamarind leaves. A drink I'd like you to try is the longan juice, which comes with both fresh and dried longan pulp. The price of the food includes a 10% service charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: SUNISA CHAUENG

sample_reviews_en.text:
This branch always makes delicious corn salad, better than other branches I've eaten at. It's slightly spicy but well-balanced.

The grilled udder (or "girl's breast") takes a while, about 20 minutes. It's grilled well, with a chewy texture. It feels like there might be some tendons, but there aren't. It's a little fatty, crunchy, and bouncy.

The longan juice is slightly sweet. The longan pieces are frozen; I actually wanted fresh longan.
sample_reviews_en.author: SSS BKK

sample_reviews_en.text:
Zaab Eli 🥗🌶️
A restaurant serving Isaan food with bold flavors and delicious, flavorful dishes.
The Pad Khanom Jeen (rice noodles) is especially delicious, with its aromatic fish sauce and perfect amount of herbs.
The Som Tam is equally delicious, spicy, and full of authentic Isaan flavors.

Those who love spicy food must come and try it for themselves! 🔥

#Eatanywhere #ZaabEli #IsaanSpicyToTheHeart
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachit Chairat

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a really delicious Isaan restaurant in a shopping mall. I really like the sweet vegetable curry with crispy fish here. It's extremely delicious... the Luang Prabang salad is very creamy, the fermented fish is fragrant and not at all smelly... the grilled chicken is juicy and fragrant with three friends... the pork covered in dust is something I personally don't like 😅
sample_reviews_en.author: Bad Bad'z

sample_reviews_en.text: Zaap E-Lee restaurant, Central Rama 3 branch, is located on the 6th floor, Plaza zone. The restaurant has plenty of seating and isn't crowded. I've eaten there many times and there's never been a queue. The food is delicious and spicy. The prices are on the higher side, but the quality is good. The staff provides good service, and the food doesn't take long to arrive.
sample_reviews_en.author: J Phinun

sample_reviews_en.text: Zaab Eli, located on the 6th floor of CentralPlaza Rama 3 in Bangkok, offers authentic Thai cuisine in a casual setting. The restaurant is known for its flavorful dishes that capture the essence of Thai gastronomy. While there is limited information available online, it has received positive feedback from patrons, with one reviewer on TripAdvisor rating it favorably.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanchaya kuram

restaurants.name: ครัวเมืองแพร่ Krua Mueang Phrae
restaurants.address:

217/1 Bang Chueak Nang Road, Bang Chueak Nang, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Taste: Authentically Northern Thai, spicy and flavorful, not sweet, with the fragrant aroma of herbs and makhaen (a traditional Northern Thai spice).

Recommended Dishes: Khanom Jeen Nam Yoi (Phrae signature dish), Larb Moo Kua (stir-fried minced pork salad), Gaeng Kae Pla Kang (spicy fish curry), Khao Soi Pad Haeng (dry-fried curry noodles), Gaeng Kua Hed Thob (spicy mushroom curry), and Northern Thai appetizers.

Atmosphere: Simple, clean restaurant, reminiscent of eating at a relative's house in the countryside.

Value for Money: Affordable prices, generous portions, street parking available in front of the restaurant (check parking hours).

Summary: If you're looking for truly authentic Northern Thai food in the Sai 2 area, this is the place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tawan Boonithee

sample_reviews_en.text: Lam Khue serves delicious food that appeals to both Bangkokians and people from Northern Thailand. I recommend trying their Gaeng Jin Som Pak Plang (sour pork curry with Malabar spinach), which is quite hard to find in Bangkok. The sour pork is cut into bite-sized pieces, making it easy to eat. Another must-try is their Bamboo Shoot Soup with Crab Paste. It's unique and unlike any Northeastern Thai bamboo shoot soup you've ever had. It uses crab paste instead of fish sauce, doesn't include roasted rice powder, and isn't overly sour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panut “Non” Jongkiatkajon

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered a Khantoke set for two people.
- The green chili dip was delicious.
- The Hang Le curry with tender pork was tasty.
- The red chili dip was authentic.
- The Sai Ua (Northern Thai sausage) wasn't too spicy.
- The crispy pork skin seemed like it had been stored for a while.

Overall, it was very good. For people from Northern Thailand who miss Northern Thai food, ordering the Khantoke set allows you to try many dishes. Highly recommended!

P.S. The galangal chili dip was incredibly delicious!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nook Jariya

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is excellent, perfect for city dwellers or people from Northern Thailand living in Bangkok who want to try Northern Thai cuisine. The service is great, and the staff are all lovely and from Phrae. The atmosphere is also very nice. Highly recommended! Come support the people of Phrae!

I suggest playing Northern Thai music and decorating with items that reflect Northern Thai culture to create a more authentic atmosphere and let outsiders know where the restaurant is located.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gipgip PongPang

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious. The sweet vegetable curry with grilled fish was very fragrant and flavorful. The dry-fried Khao Soi was also tasty. The galangal chili paste was excellent; it would be great if it were sold separately. The restaurant had a nice atmosphere, the staff were lovely, and provided good service and recommendations. There was ample parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: เกศรา เตชะวุฒิพันธุ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious. I recommend the Khao Soi with chicken, the stir-fried Khao Soi with Northern Thai sausage, the Nam Prik Num set (this dish is really delicious!), and the sesame seed fritters (the fritters are very fragrant).
As for the service, all the staff are very attentive. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
There is convenient parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: yui zhang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I ordered Khao Soi with beef shank, Nam Ngiao, and Larb Kua. Everything was delicious! It really satisfied my craving for Northern Thai food 🤗💗

The restaurant is beautiful, cute, and comfortable.

(I didn't have time to take pictures of the food because I was so hungry! I ate it so fast!)
sample_reviews_en.author: Pearl pp

sample_reviews_en.text: The Northern Thai food here is not too spicy, just the right amount of deliciousness. The atmosphere in the restaurant is pleasant, and there's parking available in front. It wasn't too crowded on New Year's Day. I recommend the Khao Soi and the Larb Kua (stir-fried minced meat salad). 👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Chonlatep Usaku

restaurants.name: Khao Tomm Rung Rod
restaurants.address:

532, 534 ถนน Sin Sap Alley, Khwaeng Bang Sue, Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food here is incredibly delicious! It's a traditional, long-established rice porridge restaurant. We ordered the fried fish salad; the dressing was amazing and perfectly balanced, and the fried fish was so crispy you could eat the whole thing. The stir-fried morning glory was delicious, with tender shoots. Even simple dishes like stir-fried preserved radish with eggs and stir-fried minced pork with preserved plums were incredibly tasty. Every dish was wonderfully fragrant with the wok aroma. The minced pork with preserved plums was amazing; the broth was clear, flavorful, and not overly sour. The minced pork was marinated with preserved plums, showing how much care they put into preparing it, and they gave a generous portion of it. Everything was delicious and worth the price!
Parking is limited; you have to park on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirada Pookkasorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
This rice porridge shop in the Bang Pho area is generally good and worth trying.

- Food comes out quickly; you won't have to wait long. However, this isn't guaranteed as it likely depends on the timing.
- The price is reasonable for the portion size.
- The taste is very good. I liked many dishes. Some things I expected weren't mind-blowingly amazing, but I finished them all. There are many menu items; I need to go back and try more.
- There is no parking. You can park in front of the shop after 8 PM, or in the next alley. There might be some parking available on the side of the road in front of closed shops, or you can try your luck finding a spot in front of the shop, but the shop doesn't recommend it and takes no responsibility for any parking issues.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lakky

sample_reviews_en.text: This old-fashioned rice porridge restaurant occupies three shophouses. Parking is available on the street in front of the shop. There's no air conditioning, only fans. We ordered rice porridge and steamed rice. Recommended dishes include stir-fried clams with fresh chili, stir-fried crab meat with curry powder, stir-fried salted fish with egg and minced pork, stir-fried morning glory with chili, crispy pork belly with chili and salt, and stir-fried catfish with chili paste. The food looked clean, tasted delicious, and was reasonably priced.
sample_reviews_en.author: พร้อมพูล ชอบเพื่อน

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old restaurant in the Bang Pho area that I've been eating at since I was a child. It has low review ratings, but it's always crowded, especially in the evenings and early nights, where you might have to wait a while for your food because there are relatively few staff members compared to the number of customers. The food is delicious and the prices are moderate. I eat here often.
sample_reviews_en.author: Draugr รูปหล่อ หมูกรอบหมด

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried ordering through Robin Hood. The clear tom yum soup with fish was really good. I also ordered stir-fried catfish with chili paste, which was just okay. The fish was very fresh and the price was alright.
But it's cheaper to eat at the restaurant. The minced pork with salted fish is also delicious, as is the spicy sausage salad.
I eat at the restaurant often because I like it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pach Lemon

sample_reviews_en.text: This old Bang Pho restaurant offers a variety of dishes, including rice porridge. The owner helps serve the food because it's always busy. Some dishes are delicious, while others are just average, such as the minced pork with preserved olives which wasn't very impressive. However, the stir-fried catfish with chili peppers was delicious, just as recommended on the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tang Raksat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted good, **but the price charged didn't match the menu, or any price adjustments should be clearly stated to the consumer. A clear price list and menu items should also be provided.**

***Customers should carefully check the price when paying.***

Or, please leave a review confirming whether the prices matched the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alek17

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is a SCAM FOR TOURISTS. The menu in English had no prices and in the end we had to pay several hundred more compared to a very nice similar restaurant right down the line. The lady there charged us what she wanted to and we also suspect the money she returned us is fake currency….. will find out soon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Meenal Thakur

restaurants.name: Baan Chiang Restaurant
restaurants.address:

14 Thanon Si Wiang, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's often said that you shouldn't return to places where you were happy decades ago, so as not to tarnish the memories. Ban Chiang proved us wrong after our return. After more than 20 years, we finally came back – and it felt like coming home. In a city as rapidly changing as Bangkok, Ban Chiang is a beautiful constant. The historic teakwood house still exudes the same incomparable, nostalgic tranquility that made it our favorite back then. While many restaurants today strive for flashy effects, Ban Chiang remains true to its roots. The atmosphere is authentic, elegant, and wonderfully unpretentious.

The quality of the cuisine has remained absolutely consistent over the past two decades – a true feat! Every dish we enjoyed tasted just as profound and finely balanced as we remembered. The harmony of spices here is simply masterful.

Anyone seeking the "real" Bangkok, away from glittering rooftop bars and modern malls, must visit Ban Chiang. It was a gem over 20 years ago and remains so today. An absolute must for any lover of authentic Thai cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Scherneck

sample_reviews_en.text: As Thai locals, we rarely eat at Thai restaurants, but we came to experience Baan Chiang Restaurant, and it truly exceeded our expectations. We were amazed by how tasty and authentic the food was. We were impressed by the starters, the main courses such as green curry and Massaman curry, and the selection of Chilean wines. Everything was perfectly balanced—the food, the Thai colonial atmosphere, and the warm hospitality provided by the lovely owner and staff. I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone who wants to experience authentic Thai cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Watt Hermann Ratanadechakorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
I would have liked to give 5 stars to this place for its charming interiors and well-priced menu. Most of the items we ordered were good but the pork neck wasn't marinated at all and didn't taste anything without the sauce. The pork and vegetable clear soup also lacked flavors.
Dry Boat Noodles were OK. The winner was the fried tofu with garlic.
Service was friendly and subtle, but would have been good with recommendations.
Still a good restaurant to try in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: R Ho

sample_reviews_en.text: I’m not sure but somethings changed, I really used to love coming here but , today was different, food was not as represented in the menu and was a let down, my spicy appetiser was great but my New Zealand lamb was not what I was expecting. I had a pineapple yoghurt which was very refreshing. Please do something about the food as this is way below what you are are capable of, I will return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter “PeteRock747” Bopape

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ve been coming here for the past 12 years whenever I’m in Bangkok, and the food has always been consistently delicious. Over the last five days, I had lunch or dinner here three times, and once again, everything we ate was absolutely perfect. The service is quick, the atmosphere is calm, and my wife and I especially enjoy dining in the covered courtyard under the fans.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jean-Christophe Moens

sample_reviews_en.text: Have been here a few times before, last year 2025... but this time it was completely wrong - got a steak - which was 5 pieces of meat with a lot of fat - which had not been a piece!! Also got coconut milk soup with chicken/ tom ka gai - it was like dishwashing liquid - very disappointed - will not come here again - despite good service and cozy colonial surroundings!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Schrader

sample_reviews_en.text: Lovely and charming local Thai restaurant. A wide selection of Thai dishes, great selection of vegetable dishes. We ordered the beef with white pepper and garlic and the chicken massaman curry, side orders of rice and 2 beers (one large and one small) and the bill came to under £28 for two. Great value and amazing food, I’d highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: LolaLondon

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the chance to try their single-dish meal: fried rice with shrimp paste and fried mackerel. The fried rice tasted good, and they even gave me extra shrimp paste. As for the fried mackerel, I personally prefer it crispier, so it wasn't to my liking. Overall, I'd say it's not bad at all, a decent place to grab a quick meal. Give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: ThE JuK MoNsTeR

restaurants.name: Little Brother Pizzaria ตี๋เล็ก - pattaya sai 2 (italian restaurant)
restaurants.address:

Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Update: I went five days in a row and had great food.  Particularly the Thai lady cook. Last night it was a completely different story.
A four cheese calzone had very little cheese.  I told the cook (A farang) that I loved the Gorgonzola.  I could not see any on his pizza.  I brought two friends with me telling them how good this place was and they were particularly disappointed.  My New Yorker friend said this is not a calzone with this small amount of cheese.

This may sound crazy, but this was one of the best four cheese pizzas I've ever had. It was made with the perfect amount of cheese and the perfect amount of doneness in a brick oven I watched them put a bunch of real Gorgonzola cheese on it. I've lived in Italy and eaten pizza everywhere in the world. I make my own pizza in my own oven at home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chas S

sample_reviews_en.text: Mind blowing Italian authenticity! Hands down best Pizza in Pattaya, very affordable, what a crust, amazing cheese and spices, I haven't had a pizza this good since I was in Napoli, Italy! Simon is the pizza wizard in this Little Brother Pizzeria. Unforgettable experience, I will. Be back for different flavors and update this post, so excited to have found my awesome Pizza place in my beloved Pattaya city, Thailand! I came back for the Bolognese Pizza, amazing topping, very original! Bravo once more!
sample_reviews_en.author: Hassan Farhood

sample_reviews_en.text: Literally the best Pizza I have ever eaten in thailand!!! I am from germany and we have great pizzeria's at home but this one can hold up with the best at home. If you are in pattaya and want to eat pizza or pasta, this is definitely the place to go. Ambiente and Service are, well.. Thailand, so no comparison with the restaurants at home BUT the quality and taste of the food are exemplary. ( I had the four seasons Pizza and my Girlfriend had the garlic and chilli Pasta)
sample_reviews_en.author: R. Johnson

sample_reviews_en.text:
I am truly sorry to give this review, but the pizza was horrible.

The pizza bottom tasted great, even smelled delicious. But... the toppings were all dry and chewy. The pepperoni, ham and even the olives were awful. They tasted like they were days old.

I do not understand why they were able to mess this up since they were selling enough pizzas to be able to use fresh ingredients. Which they obviously were not...

Oh yeah, the staff was super friendly...
sample_reviews_en.author: Ronald Joosten

sample_reviews_en.text: Very sad , I used to love this place. But the last two times my pizza was burnt . I don’t mind some bubbling or charred, but this was too much. Today I complained. Staff said it was ok, and I would have to tell them if I wanted it lightly cooked. The worst part was my friend’s soup. We found two tissues in it . They did offer to remake it . We wanted a credit , which they refused. Can’t go back there . Very sad. I have been there a lot , and loved it .
sample_reviews_en.author: Ari

sample_reviews_en.text: We keep coming here every time we head to Pattaya, the colds cut with beer is super good, Seafood soup is also good with a lot of seafood, Padthai is superb and also the Thai style Omelet with pork is one of the best. Truly recommended!! Reasonable price and very tasty. PS. We came the other day to have only Banana split icecream and Tiramisu, they are so authentic, the taste of your childhood in huge portions, love them all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ma-proad Srisukh

sample_reviews_en.text: Great location on 2nd road. Nice big restaurant and the pizza is baked in a custom brick oven. The pizza just comes in just one size and is thin crusted. Reasonably priced and toppings are plentiful. I enjoyed the pizza but the service needs attention. The ladies whom wait the tables seem very inexperienced and slow. The Italian owner is new and tells me he’s only been there over two weeks and is working on the service issue.
sample_reviews_en.author: WillyWorld

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is magnificent. The staff is great very accommodating. They show me the pizza before I walk out. The toppings are great on the on the pizza. There could be a little bit more pepperoni, but I’m not gonna complain about that. Still five stars to me. As well as they give you a oregano and two different sauces for the pizza which is unheard of here in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: william robinson

restaurants.name: Call moo คอลหมู (Isan & Seafood Restaurant )
restaurants.address:

1430 Banthat Thong Rd, Rong Mueang, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The grilled and fried pork neck lived up to the restaurant's name! The dipping sauce for the grilled pork neck was amazing. The pork was from the neck cut, with just the right amount of marbling. The fried pork neck was also crispy and the seasoned batter was delicious.

Other dishes were just average. The papaya salad with fermented fish sauce was a bit too salty, and the papaya strips were slightly bruised, making it less crispy and less fresh than it should have been. The sticky rice, however, was fragrant and soft.

I'd like to commend the staff; they were all lovely!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jenny Paphawarin

sample_reviews_en.text: The Khao Soi (spicy pork) restaurant on Banthad Thong Road is truly delicious in every way. The flavors are very intense, and the prices are reasonable. After eating there, I want to go back again! 🤍😋🌶️
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirivimon Mangwong

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! This was my first time eating here, and the flavors were intense, just the way I like them. The staff provided excellent service. I'll definitely come again!
sample_reviews_en.author: waraporn inpanya

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, all the ingredients were high quality and exactly as pictured. The marinated salmon and grilled pork neck with papaya salad were amazing! 🙏🏻🥹🤤 …
sample_reviews_en.author: สุนิตา บูชาพันธ์

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! I come here often. Whenever I'm on Banthat Thong Road, I always eat at this restaurant. The staff are very friendly and provide excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนดล แตงอ่อน

sample_reviews_en.text: I eat here very often. It's so delicious! If you're looking for something to eat after work, I highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: ภคพร บุญเตี้ย

sample_reviews_en.text: All the staff were so lovely and the service was great. The food was delicious and the flavors were just right!
sample_reviews_en.author: hey.anijjung

sample_reviews_en.text: The raw marinated shrimp was absolutely delicious! And the price was very reasonable too. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tae Lu

restaurants.name: Go Roti Chachuk (Roti & Tea)
restaurants.address:

677 Thanon Nakhon Chaisi Rd, Thanon Nakhon Chai Si, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered through Grab, the toasted bread with whipped cream, banana, and caramel, but the bananas I received were unripe!!! They were rough on the tongue. You could tell from the outside that they were raw, dry, and white. The shop has been selling these for a long time, so why would they still give me unripe bananas if they're not sure if they're ripe? They should at least replace them. Also, the smoothie was wrapped in six layers of thick scotch tape. When I unwrapped it, the smell was overwhelming, and the smell lingered in my nose after drinking it. It really diminished the enjoyment of other dishes. I wish they would check their packaging more carefully and change their packaging. The taste was good, but I want to see improvements in other areas.
sample_reviews_en.author: Crusties - boy

sample_reviews_en.text: The roti was delicious. As for the toast and iced milk, I wasn't particularly impressed, but it was edible and worth the price. I liked the cute teapot they served it in, and it smelled wonderful. They even helped pack up the leftovers for me to take home. I deducted one star for the atmosphere because it's next to the road, so it was a bit noisy, and there was a slight smell of sewage.
sample_reviews_en.author: JEW TH

sample_reviews_en.text:
Go Roti Review
Go Roti is a must-try for anyone who loves thin and crispy roti. The texture is absolutely perfect, and there are so many delicious flavors to choose from. Whether you're in the mood for something sweet or savory, there's sure to be a roti to satisfy your cravings. I highly recommend checking out Go Roti if you're looking for a quick and tasty snack or meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ben C

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the iced tea tastes great, and the service was good, although there were a few hiccups due to the staff taking orders not always communicating clearly. The atmosphere is nice though. I'll definitely go again; it's become my regular spot because the owner is lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suraphon

sample_reviews_en.text: They said they open at 9:30 AM, I arrived at 9:40 AM and the staff said they weren't open yet. They spoke rudely and made a displeased face. When I asked what time I could make a purchase, they said it would be a while. Terrible service. I've seen this happen several times.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanapon Muangman

sample_reviews_en.text: The tissue roti with whipped cream and shredded egg yolk is delicious. The dough is thin and crispy, not too sweet. The thick, soft roti with milk is also tasty as usual. Free tea is available. You can park on the street or at the 7-Eleven across the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayavat Chareonraj

sample_reviews_en.text: Really nice roti place here. Tried a few things and was really surprised. The coff-tea combo was almost an equal mix, and not overly sweet at all. The roti selection was massive, and was good as well. Nice place for a snack anytime even until closing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leslie Quah

sample_reviews_en.text: The toast wasn't hot at all when they brought it. They asked me to write down my order, but they didn't make everything. I waited a very long time. Normally, when I order a lot of milk, I get a lot, but this time I got very little. Terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชานมไข่มุก

restaurants.name: KRAZ Sathorn
restaurants.address:

34/1 Soi Sribumphen, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
French-style crepe with a savoury and sweet twist.

The place is cozy and well-decorated. The bright, tangerine orange really stands out and sets the image of the store apart from others around the area.

The menu is quite expensive. Most of the menus are 300+ baht with a large portion of crepe and stuffed. The crepe is crispy and tender at the same time. It doesn’t smell much aromatic but what excites me is how light and crunchy it is. The topping and stuffed compliments the crepe really well. They really understand which ingredients should go with their own crepe.

Will I come back to this? I think so. It is really worthy to experience once in your life.
sample_reviews_en.author: doubleJ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kraz is a crepe shop that makes you feel like you’ve slipped into Paris without getting on a plane. They offer both soft, thin crepes and crispy Brittany‑style crepes in a variety of flavors — from premium savory options to classic French breakfast‑style

They also serve fruit juices, cocktails, and mocktails, all of which pair beautifully with the crepes and add a light European freshness.

Parking is conveniently located right next to U Sathorn, and there’s an electric tuk‑tuk shuttle — super handy on hot days. Please call for pickup.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumol

sample_reviews_en.text: The Galette Crêpe Complète was fantastic, probably the best crêpe I’ve ever eaten. The fillings of this and the other crêpes are untraditional, but creative and interesting, and certainly worked very successfully in this case and I paired it with a traditional apple cider. We also ordered a Green Omelette which was excellent and paired well with the crêpe, and we tried a kombucha which was also very nice, nicely balanced between sweet and sour.  I would love to come back and try one of the sweet crepes sometime.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Hooper

sample_reviews_en.text: A fantastic brunch spot in Sathorn. Kraz is part of the iOde family, with the main restaurant just around the corner. While iOde focuses on dinner, Kraz is the perfect place for breakfast, brunch, or even a relaxed lunch. The menu features both sweet crêpes and, my personal favorite, savory buckwheat crêpes. The ingredients are top-notch, and the atmosphere strikes a great balance between lively, modern, and effortlessly chill.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text: The crepes were burnt and bitter; the food was mediocre. The sweet crepes weren't tasty, and the texture was like those from any other crepe shop. The parking is far away, and there are tuk-tuks waiting to pick you up. The drivers are indifferent, letting customers walk to their tuk-tuks in the wet like that, without even offering an umbrella. The only good thing was that the staff were polite.
sample_reviews_en.author: neoprostthailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a great experience here! There was a wide variety of crêpes to choose from. The crêpes tasted very authentic, just like the ones you'd find in France. The portions were generous and definitely worth the price.

The staff were also friendly and provided excellent service. Highly recommended if you're looking for authentic French crêpes!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanna S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Convenient parking with shuttle service, great food, and truly thoughtful service. I accidentally dropped some cash and the staff went out of their way to contact the driver and return it to me.

As someone who has worked in the restaurant industry in the US for many years, I really appreciate and admire this level of hospitality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nichakorn Reth

sample_reviews_en.text: A great breakfast spot in Bangkok with a modern twist, serving both sweet and savory French-style crepes. The staff are friendly and attentive, and the place has a nice vibe with good music. Don’t miss their buckwheat crepes – definitely a must-try! And hey, who says you can’t start the day with something sweet?
sample_reviews_en.author: Saranya WRA

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวต้มยำ ธิษณา
restaurants.address:

เลขที่171 Wachiratham Sathit 9 Alley, Bang Chak, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This small fish ball tom yum noodle shop is located in a shophouse, and the reviews seem unusually numerous.
It's in Soi Wachiratham, near a three-way intersection. Street parking is available at certain times and on certain sides of the road.
Ordering requires scanning a QR code. The shop has two air-conditioned zones.

The staff are foreigners, but communication is reasonably good.
I visited around 4 PM.
There weren't many customers, so the food came quickly.

The dry tom yum noodles were mildly spicy, and came with a delicious, hot sweet radish soup.
The tom yum flavor seemed somewhat pre-made; it was well-balanced and tasty, but felt like something was missing – it lacked depth and intrigue. :)
Delicious, but not enjoyable.
The noodles weren't cooked very well; they were still a bit hard.

The price is the standard 69 baht. My criticisms aren't that the food wasn't delicious.
I gave it 4 stars because of my expectations based on the number of reviews.
I'll try visiting during lunchtime next time, hoping it will be better.
sample_reviews_en.author: W. W.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thit Sana Tom Yum Noodle is a noodle shop that will appeal to those who like spicy flavors. Both the clear broth and tom yum noodles are well-made, especially the tom yum broth, which uses real lime juice, giving it a naturally sour and fragrant taste without being sweet or overly seasoned to mask the flavor of the ingredients.
The noodle toppings are of good quality, including the minced pork and fish balls. There are also several side dishes to choose from. Recommended dishes are the crispy pork rinds in tom yum soup and the crispy wontons in tom yum soup, which are enjoyable and pair well with the noodles.
The restaurant has seating both in the air-conditioned area and outside, accommodating a reasonable number of customers. If you come by car, you can park in the alley near the shop or at the nearby Lotus store and walk to the shop. Overall, it's another recommended restaurant for tom yum noodle lovers with a spicy flavor, good ingredients, and reasonable prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: SuperAuis Nantawan N.

sample_reviews_en.text: Extremely slow service. There was no queue at the shop, but even ordering took 20 minutes, causing other delivery riders ahead of us to wait. If you want to eat here, order delivery instead. The portions are very small; you'll need to add extra noodles to feel full. The noodle portion is about the same as a 14 baht boat noodle bowl. The price is quite high compared to the quantity. The taste is also very overrated. It's a good thing it's near my house; if I came from far away, I would be very disappointed. I came without high expectations and was still disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: phachara tharaphaisarnsuk

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles looked exactly like the picture. The spicy salad was delicious, and they provided a large lime wedge to squeeze extra. Even though I ordered the dry version, they gave me soup instead. The soup had a fragrant radish flavor. The restaurant is air-conditioned. It's delicious, and the staff are lovely, although they might be foreigners, I'm not sure. The restaurant uses a scan-to-order system.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pang Thanapanich

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop doesn't have parking; you have to park at Lotus and walk a short distance. It's right at the entrance of the soi (alley).
You can use ThaiChueyThaiPlus (a government social security payment system).
The prices are reasonable, and they use a scan-to-order system.
I deducted points for the pork crackling salad; the cracklings were very rancid. They should be stored properly to keep them fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirimas Duangla

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is small with no parking space in front. We parked in front of a roti shop and asked if we could park there. The staff member said it seemed to be only allowed on even or odd days, basically telling us to find out for ourselves. Then a male staff member confirmed that it was allowed on even days, so we parked there.

The Tom Yum soup tasted okay, but the boiled rice noodles were still hard.
sample_reviews_en.author: thida satitanuchit

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant serves cold, tasty spicy salad with a refreshing broth.

The dish wasn't as pictured.
I ordered extra noodles for +15 baht.
It felt like they didn't add any extra toppings to the salad, and the taste was bland 🥲 because I've had it before with the regular version and it was just right.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattasit Kumcharoen

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pork crackling salad needs improvement.
It should be more of a thicker sauce, without too much liquid, as the latter makes the cracklings soft and unappetizing, and they develop a rancid smell.
Everything else is okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bewitched OOM

restaurants.name: จั๊กหน่อย Juknoi
restaurants.address:

393/3 Pracha Rat Sai 2 Rd, Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
My favorite restaurant.
Delicious Northeastern Thai food with high-quality ingredients.
The restaurant is air-conditioned and comfortable.
My go-to dishes every time are Som Tum (papaya salad), duck larb (spicy minced duck salad), grilled beef, and beef stew.
Conveniently located near Bang Pho MRT station, or you can park in front of the restaurant if you're driving.
It's recommended to call and reserve a table before coming.
sample_reviews_en.author: BiGadam AZ

sample_reviews_en.text: I wanted so much to have a phad Thai Goong and walked everywhere looking for one without success. And tonight, I spied a fine dining restaurant two doors from my hostel m thought I try it. It turned out to be the best phad thai I have had for a long time! And the surprise is that the lady who owns that restaurant also owns this hostel as well!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ed Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Northeastern Thai food, spicy and flavorful. Air-conditioned dining area.
Opening hours: 10:30 AM - 8:00 PM
Location: MRT Bang Pho, Exit 2A

Spicy papaya salad, various fried dishes including fried chicken and crispy fried pork belly – not greasy, very delicious.

Good service and nice atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pitchanika Vaewchinda

sample_reviews_en.text:
Isaan food with a Bangkok twist.
Everything is on the sweet side.
The Luang Prabang-style papaya salad tasted like Thai papaya salad with flat noodles.
The service was quite poor.
The prices are overpriced.
The atmosphere is ordinary. Overall, I give it 1 star, plus another star because the dog is cute.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supalap Somsak

sample_reviews_en.text: My first time eating here was very disappointing. The management was poor, the food was very slow to arrive, and some items were missing. They didn't inform me in advance that some items were out of stock, letting me wait a long time before telling me. Not impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: idlennn

sample_reviews_en.text: The duck laab is my favorite. The papaya salad is delicious. The grilled pork neck is excellent. The spicy pork rib soup with tendons is also good. The crispy morning glory salad is also good. The price is a bit high, but everything is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthaphong Phaewbuntra

sample_reviews_en.text: Walking from Bang Pho Pier, I came across this restaurant and decided to try their signature dish, the som tam chak noi. It was incredibly delicious. I ordered it to eat with sun-dried pork and sticky rice. The restaurant also serves black …
sample_reviews_en.author: Nitikorn Poosri

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and clean. The only complaint is that the pork and bamboo shoots were seasoned differently, like they forgot to add any seasoning or fish sauce. It was very bland. If the flavors were complete, it would definitely be …
sample_reviews_en.author: nnnuke'nk asavanicothon

restaurants.name: Fantuan Thailand @101 True Digital Park West
restaurants.address:

G Floor บางจาก True Digital Park West 101 Sukhumvit Rd, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Other branches are good.
Actually, this branch is good too.
I'm deducting 1 star this time because of this one employee. I went in and asked what time they opened around 8:50 AM. She made a grumpy face and said they open at 9:00 AM.

Then I went back at 9:00 AM and was told I had to wait 10 minutes for my food. I asked, "Didn't you say you opened at 9:00 AM?" The female employee said, "We open at 9:00 AM, but the rice isn't cooked yet." Her tone and demeanor were terrible; she acted like she didn't want to sell anything.

Honestly, if you're too lazy to work, you should just stay home.

If her manners were better, I wouldn't mind waiting, no matter how long. My daughter likes this restaurant. Because of this, I'm giving it 1 star.

June 27, 2026, 9:00 AM
sample_reviews_en.author: Premo 5555

sample_reviews_en.text: I love the food but can’t eat there because they have a 300 baht minimum for credit cards. This means I have to buy food for two people if I want to eat. Sadly, I can’t eat here because of it. I would eat here every day if I could, it’s that good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Devin

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious at this price. I've eaten here many times when I can't decide what to eat. It's easy, convenient, and the taste is perfectly balanced. They give you a generous amount of filling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Inkanut J

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was good, the restaurant was clean, the rice balls tasted delicious, and it was convenient, quick, and easy to eat when you're in a hurry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patty Vitoontanapaiboon

sample_reviews_en.text: Consistently delicious, convenient, no long waits. When in doubt, just head here. I love the crispy items, they put in generous portions, perfect!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jubilee Joob

sample_reviews_en.text: The filling is delicious! I tried a new menu item and it was so good! The salmon pieces were big and satisfying.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jee Lim

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff provided excellent service; they were cheerful, friendly, and spoke politely. The food was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: suprangon senawong

sample_reviews_en.text: Exotic food flavors, delicious beef rice bowls with seating But unfortunately, there are no vegetarian options.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuo Vbbhnnn

restaurants.name: Brewave Playground
restaurants.address:

MGP7+QMC Montien Riverside Hotel, Bang Khlo, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
First visit.
Enter from the front of the hotel, go down the stairs on the left, and exit through the glass door at the end to arrive. You might be able to enter directly from outside as well?
This beer garden seems to focus on Thai craft beers; half (6 types) are Thai, and the other 6 are from the US and New Zealand? I think it varies from day to day 🍺♻️🍺
Drinking outside is great at this time of year, as long as it doesn't rain, so I recommend it 🇹🇭🍺
Although it's outdoors, there are no ashtrays, so smoking is impossible 🚭
1 pint: 250 - 350 THB
Half sizes available
sample_reviews_en.author: Yusuke Hara

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the staff were lovely, but the cashier was extremely slow. I had to go and ask them four times myself. // Several tables complained about slow bill processing. Some foreign customers even walked out while waiting for their bills. This urgently needs improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภูวนาถ แจ้งแจ่มญาณ

sample_reviews_en.text: Located inside the Montien Hotel, parking is available. The atmosphere is great, quiet and peaceful with live music. It's not crowded, perfect for relaxation. The dark beer from Silalom is very strong and has a hint of Shanghai pastry flavor. I'll try other beers next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Little Moment

sample_reviews_en.text:
Waiters don't speak English well. Forget about orders.
There are children serving, Do not recommend this place!
Waited 30 minutes after I was told they forgot my order, it was supposed to take 15 minutes. The food is not good here. Eat at Anna's place
sample_reviews_en.author: Sebastian Skaar

sample_reviews_en.text: One visit is enough. The service was terrible. The staff were unenthusiastic, I ordered one thing and got another, I don't know if they were drunk or confused or what. The chicken rice wasn't even hot. The taste, I'd give it a 3 out of 10. …
sample_reviews_en.author: gief zaza

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lots of beer types. Seating outdoor at a pier. There are 2 restaurants nearby which also play music. The music is competing with each other.
Beer price - craft beer and not so craft - around 200-350 thb /pint.
sample_reviews_en.author: PetoH H.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a craft beer bar with a wide selection of beers, along with food and snacks, and a beautiful riverside atmosphere. The ambiance is great, with a cool breeze and amazing views.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kuma Odd

sample_reviews_en.text: What a hidden gem!!! Great variety of international beers on tap, live music every day, very friendly staff, delicious food, located directly at Chao Phraya river. Loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Singer

restaurants.name: Sasi Bangkok
restaurants.address:

14 Soi Wat Krachang, Chim Phli, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sasi Restaurant, Taling Chan: A Delightful Mix for Every Craving!

Just discovered Sasi Restaurant in Taling Chan and it's a gem! This place beautifully blends the best of both worlds. We loved their authentic Thai food – rich in flavor and truly satisfying. But it doesn't stop there; their Italian pasta offerings were equally impressive, proving they can master more than one cuisine.

And for those who appreciate a good brew, their specialty coffee hit just the right spot. Make sure to save room for dessert: the Lod Chong ice cream is a unique and refreshing treat, and the strawberry cake was simply delightful. Whether you're craving local Thai, Italian, or just a sweet escape, Sasi has something delicious for everyone!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumol

sample_reviews_en.text:
For those who relish the spiciness of Thai cuisine, this restaurant offers an array of choices. Additionally, it caters to steak enthusiasts looking to pair their meal with fine wine or those craving spaghetti.

The desserts here are also exceptional. I tried the Strawberry Short Cake and it was delightful—the rich, creamy topping was the highlight, and the cake's texture was excellent.

If you need an afternoon pick-me-up after lunch, the café serves both medium and dark roast coffees for those who appreciate robust flavors.

The restaurant's decor is stunning and highly Instagrammable, as many beautiful photos on social media can attest.

Overall, this café is outstanding and comes highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bundit Srinon

sample_reviews_en.text: Brunch, lunch, and dinner – perfect for any occasion. The restaurant is beautifully decorated with a great atmosphere. The menu isn't extensive, but the quality is excellent and delicious. They offer both Thai and Western dishes, including tasty yellow curry, garlic fried shrimp, and traditional glass noodle salad. They also have various spaghetti dishes, desserts, coffee, matcha, and other beverages. Towards the end of the year, the restaurant is beautifully decorated with a large Christmas tree, making for great photo opportunities. Reservations are recommended on weekends as the restaurant closes at 9 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jarupan Viravatanadej

sample_reviews_en.text: This cafe/restaurant has incredibly delicious food, and the coffee and desserts are equally amazing. It's located on Borommaratchathani Road near Taling Chan. The place is spacious and very clean. During this time of year, there's a large Christmas tree perfect for photos. It's ideal for families and groups of friends. There's also plenty of parking. And most importantly, I highly recommend their yellow curry – it's absolutely delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiwdie Fu

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, with a great vibe. There’s plenty of space between tables, so it feels open and comfortable. The Thai food here is amazing—every dish tastes great! Portions are just right, so you can try a variety of dishes. It’s a great spot for a date, family meal, or even a small event. The staff are super friendly. I’ve visited twice and can’t wait to come back. Definitely one of my favorite places to eat!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pparnxoxo xoxo ninlaphan ninlaphan ninlaphan test

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ambience of the place is just nice from the building entry to the dining area. With live music, this place is very cozy and nice to dine in.
The food do not disappoint either, all the dishes are well prepared and taste good. The dirty coffee is also very nice, a surprise.
Definitely worth to visit again. Not to forget what a great service this place have, need to mention this, even when raining the waiter help to walk us.
sample_reviews_en.author: M *

sample_reviews_en.text: Beautiful space with both indoor and outdoor seating. It wasn’t crowded on a weekend morning, which made it even more enjoyable. The coffee was good, though the serving temperature could be improved — my flat white wasn’t hot enough. I also had the banoffee, and it was perfect. I noticed there’s a nice variety of food options as well. I’ll definitely come back to try their lunch or dinner next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pisit Ujjin

sample_reviews_en.text:
This charming restaurant/cafe is located in the Taling Chan area. The interior seating is airy and spacious with high ceilings, letting in plenty of warm sunlight. The menu offers both Thai (with a focus on Southern Thai cuisine) and Western dishes, all of which are delicious.

The staff provides excellent and attentive service, and the food is served quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittika P

restaurants.name: Pu Tie Shrimp Wonton Noodles
restaurants.address:

933/1-7 Rama I Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're coming from the BTS, go down one floor from BACC and you'll see the restaurant. It's sandwiched in the middle and doesn't have an English sign, so it's not easy to spot. The seating isn't formal; it's quite free-style. The menu is simple; you order and give it to the lady of the house and wait for your food. Because the menu is fixed, the food comes out quite quickly. The noodles and meat are a great combination, and the soup isn't too salty, which is excellent; however, the chopsticks are of very poor quality, so there's a strange chopstick taste... Don't overthink it; the bamboo chopsticks must have been made much more enjoyable. At that moment, I really envied people who insist on using eco-friendly chopsticks. Overall, it's cheap and delicious, but I recommend bringing your own chopsticks...
sample_reviews_en.author: Bart Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
An absolute essential for all gallery and art visitors in the Cultural Centre. Very friendly prices for a bowl of great noodles with red pork and thiccc wontons! Looking at around THB 50-80 depending on the toppings and the bowl size (standard or extra). Drinks are self-served at their fridge.

Been here atleast ten times, and this place remains the champion of food in this museum.

Expect a longer than usual wait time (until 2pm) on event days, when the neighborhood swells with hungry noodle eaters. As far as I can tell, you can't make reservations and they only do walk-ins. Friendly staff!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kris Supavatanakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Another cheap, but very good dining option, in the busy, often expensive Siam business and shopping district.

Wonton noodles are my ultimate comfort and Pu Tie Shrimp is a top spot for lunch or a morning or afternoon snack. Most bowls - with soup or no soup - are priced between 65 to 75 baht and they taste great. The broth is clean and hearty, the roast pork has a nice smokey taste, and the wontons are just right sized.

And bring in the BACC gallery building, the air conditioning is excellent offering nice respite from the heat or rain.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Meng Yee

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Chinese noodle shop located inside the art museum.

The wonton noodle soup is excellent; the shrimp wontons made with minced fish are superb, and the noodles are homemade thin noodles similar to somen.

The clear soup has a light flavor; add a little pepper at first, and then add green chili vinegar halfway through to change the flavor and enjoy it to the last bite.

The shop is closed on Mondays when the art museum is closed.
sample_reviews_en.author: YAMAHICO

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good place for a lunch - comfortable seating, friendly service, soup with noodle, shrimp wonton (dumpling) and red pork is quite tasty, not too spicy, hearty, the pork smells of smoke, and the extra large portion is large enough to feel full. Price is democratic for BKK - 70 bht. They also serve wontons without soup, which might also be a good choice. Recommended for a healthy peaceful lunch at the art center.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ksenia Kagan-Levinskaya

sample_reviews_en.text:
Artist House's homemade noodle is known for its authentic day by day freshly made egg noodle. Their bbq red pork is very tasty as well. Please do order the wonton shrimp as well. They are incredible. Prices are friendly. Lovely owner.

Seatings capacity is a bit too small though but no complained.
Water bottle cost 10 baht. Get your belly fulled within 100 baht guaranteed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donny Boonyamanop

sample_reviews_en.text:
IG: tamu_traveller

A hidden simple noodle and shrimp wantan in this building. Very worth to try, 55B.

Clear hot soup, noodle, big size shrimp wantan are nice combination.
Noodle texture is enough, not so tight nor soft.
Shrimp wantan is soft and fresh.
The interior is full wooden texture which feel like staying old house/street.
The owner also selling cups, souvenirs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tamu Traveller

sample_reviews_en.text:
The menu at this restaurant is very simple and straightforward, consisting only of noodles, dumplings, and barbecued pork. Everything is delicious: the noodles are thin, soft, and chewy; the dumplings are large; the barbecued pork is flavorful; and the broth is well-balanced.
There's also a red dipping sauce provided for the dumplings.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daris P.

restaurants.name: Stark Food
restaurants.address:

192 Soi Somdet Phra Chao Tak Sin 40, Dao Khanong, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Starkfood, a hidden gem near Big C Daokhanong.
Once you try it, you won't want it to be a secret anymore! 🍝✨

Eat fresh pasta → then play golf.
Spend 1,500 THB and get a VIP room for 2 hours of fun!
This meal isn't just about being full, it's also about having fun! 😆

👉 A hidden gem in Thonburi, but always packed!
Relaxed Italian vibes, but the menu is seriously impressive.
Located in the Daokhanong area, in a small alley.
Surprisingly… it has tons of reviews and is always busy!
So I had to try it myself.

The highlight of this restaurant is 🍝 fresh pasta, made in-house for every dish!
It's not just Italian style, but a fusion that perfectly blends tradition
with modern elements.

• Pesto Pasta 🌿
• Pesto Risotto
• Masaman Molle (This one is WOW!)
• Calamari
• Nam Fish

The first bite is Italian, the next bite…
Wow! A Thai flavor suddenly appears! 😍

There are also special promotions! Order 1,500 baht worth of food
👉 Get access to the VIP room + golf simulator
Play for a full 2 ​​hours!
Eat and play... Losing is okay, as long as I'm full! 😆⛳

If you want to try something new and unique,
this restaurant is worth every penny and every moment you walk in.
sample_reviews_en.author: นอน ว่างๆ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant occupies two adjoining shophouses, with the right-hand side open for customers. It's air-conditioned, but the atmosphere isn't particularly inviting. It seems the food plays a leading role in creating a positive customer experience, which they do well, especially the pasta dishes. The fresh noodles are delicious, and the red wine tomato sauce is excellent. The meat dishes, however, were just okay. The pork chop was a bit dry, and the meats used in the pasta dishes, like beef or Italian sausage, weren't to our liking. There isn't a clearly defined vegetarian menu, but we ordered the white wine mushroom risotto, which was tasty. If you want to try it, I recommend parking at Big C Daokhanong for convenience and walking into Soi Somdej Chao Phraya 40 for about 5 minutes. Or, you could try their second branch at Central Chidlom, which might be more enjoyable. Considering the prices are the same as this branch, it's reasonably priced.

Booking a table through Google Maps gets you complimentary truffle mushroom soup and garlic bread, which are delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: MrsMom Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted good. We ordered a large portion of ribs, but the side dishes like mashed potatoes and pickles were quite small. There were only 3 tables occupied when we visited.

We ordered 3 pasta dishes, but didn't receive all of them. The staff may have delivered them to other tables, as tables that arrived later had already received their spaghetti. When we inquired about the missing items, since everyone else at our table had almost finished their main courses, a risotto dish arrived, but it was for another table. Later, we were informed that the Italian sausage intended for this dish had run out, so we cancelled the order.
Some of the foreign staff couldn't communicate effectively. They delivered food but didn't know what it was. We ordered Chardonnay, and the staff insisted it was beer. We ordered lychee soda, and they brought soda instead. When we questioned it, they said it was out of stock.
More time should be allocated to training and educating the staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Varaporn Chaweekulrath

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pork ribs at this restaurant are so good, I have to say. They're incredibly tender, requiring almost no effort to cook. The sauce is perfectly balanced and flavorful. You can tell they put a lot of care into making them.

The truffle risotto is also well-made; the rice has a good texture, not mushy, and the truffle aroma is subtle. A slightly more intense flavor would have been even better.

The truffle soup is a highlight. The aroma fills the table as soon as you open the bowl. The taste is rich and creamy, and the bread is excellent – ​​tender and enjoyable to chew, not just for show.

The truffle fettuccine is also delicious. The pasta is perfectly al dente, the sauce clings smoothly, and the aroma is just right – not cloying at all.

In summary, many of the truffle dishes at this restaurant are of high standard. The pork ribs are outstanding. If you like fragrant, flavorful dishes that aren't overpowering, you should definitely try them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manow Manow

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time eating at Stark Food, and I loved many of the dishes!
The baked pork ribs and BBQ ribs were incredibly tender, the bones easily came off the bone, and the sauces were delicious.

The 'Kiss My Cheek' dish, with its 48-hour sous-vide beef cheek, was so tender it practically melted in my mouth – I especially loved it.

The baked salmon pasta with spicy salmon cream sauce was also delicious and perfectly rich. The hamburger fried rice was easy to eat and had a well-balanced flavor.

The restaurant has a relaxed atmosphere, the staff and owner provided excellent service, the food was served quickly, and the prices were reasonable for the quality. Overall, it was a great place to eat, and I'll definitely be back to try other dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: 1 9 9 X

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited a restaurant known for its steaks, and while the food itself wasn’t bad, the overall experience left me feeling a bit underwhelmed. The steak was cooked well, with good flavor and tenderness, though it didn’t stand out as anything extraordinary.

The real drawback, however, was the atmosphere. The dim lighting and narrow space made it feel more like a hidden bar tucked away in a secluded alley than a restaurant you’d want to sit down for a nice meal. It lacked the warmth and ambiance you might expect for a place that serves decent steaks. While the food was enjoyable, the setting didn’t complement the experience, and I left feeling that the environment fell short of its potential.
sample_reviews_en.author: Starry Solutions

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located at the entrance of Soi Ramkhamhaeng 142. The atmosphere is great, and the food is delicious. The mashed potatoes are incredibly creamy and melt in your mouth. We ordered the tender pork chop with a rich black pepper sauce, and also the beef fried rice with ribeye steak and a spicy dipping sauce that was perfectly balanced and delicious – it went wonderfully with the fried rice. We live in this soi, and now we have our regular restaurant. The owner, Khun Arm, mentioned that they will be opening a cafe in the future. We'll be waiting for that!
sample_reviews_en.author: M T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a real deal.

I came here by chance, because i was around the area. There are 2-3 parking lots in front of the store. But otherwise you have to park on the main road.

I ordered - beef fried rice and it was solid. The fried rice is really tasty and flavorful with bits of garlic, beef fat and beef meat.

The truffle soup was not bad as well.

This is a small shop with small shed-like vibe. Dont expect anything fancy. Its more homey/ bar-like place with solid food offerings at a very competitive price.

I would return if i am in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamonkarn K

restaurants.name: Miffy's Voyage Café Pattaya
restaurants.address:

888 หมู่ที่ 12 หนองปรือ Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited the Miffy Cafe in Pattaya for the first time in a year, and the ball pit had moved to the second floor, and the merchandise area had expanded!

I didn't see the second floor myself, but my son, who played there, said there was no slide, only the ball pit.

Since I visited on a weekday, there weren't many people, and I was able to browse the merchandise at my leisure. It seemed like the lineup of items, such as plates and keychains, had increased compared to before.

There were new items that weren't there last year, such as Thai pants and T-shirts and bags with what seemed to be original Thai designs. It also seems you can buy T-shirts from the Miffy Cafe in Bangkok here.

I didn't have much time this time, so I couldn't have tea inside, but I noticed that there weren't as many of the large Miffy dolls that used to be placed on the sofas.

It changes a little bit each time I visit, so I'm looking forward to my next visit!

2026.3
sample_reviews_en.author: Mo

sample_reviews_en.text:
​Located within the Pattaya Premium Outlet, this Miffy-themed café is the perfect spot to take a break from shopping. It offers ample and convenient parking, making it an easy addition to your Pattaya itinerary.

​The café is designed with a bright, airy "nautical" theme featuring Miffy and friends. It’s a great place to sit back and relax:
​Kid-Friendly: There is a ball pit inside the café, ensuring children have a fun place to play while adults enjoy their drinks.
​Merchandise: A dedicated section of the shop sells a variety of Miffy merchandise, including clothing, bags, and souvenirs.
​Adorable Seating: The booths are lined with large Miffy plushies and themed cushions, making every corner perfect for a photo.

​The menu is as delightful as the decor, and the prices are quite reasonable.
​Unlike many themed cafés where the focus is only on looks, the coffee here is delicious and very strong, catering to true caffeine lovers.
