sample_reviews_en.author: Chanaporn Yamjinda

sample_reviews_en.text: Miffy's Voyage Café Pattaya is a very cute café with beautiful decor, a boat and ocean theme, and Miffy everywhere. The food and drinks are all adorably presented, and the lighting is perfect for photos. It's ideal for those with a sweet tooth and who want to relax and take pictures. The café has two floors and is very spacious. The kids' area is on the second floor and has toys. They offer main courses, snacks, drinks, and desserts. I ordered the Homemade Choco Banana Pan (185 baht) and the Miffy Affogato (95 baht). Prices include VAT, no extra charges. There's Wi-Fi and charging stations, and the staff provides good service. The café is located inside Premium Outlet Pattaya and has parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ph031

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is very cute. The air conditioning is cool even though the shop is wide, tall, and made of glass. The noise might be a bit loud because there are a lot of children, which is understandable. The food and drink menu is decorated cutely. The beef with basil is fragrant and slightly spicy (if it were spicier, it would be good). The latte is delicious, the coffee is fragrant, and the tiramisu is excellent and the texture is smooth. The price might be high for people who aren't really into cafes, but we think this is the general price for a cafe in a tourist city. And with the shop decorated or the menu like this, it's a selling point.
sample_reviews_en.author: PJ Black

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recommend going on a weekday when it's less crowded. There's convenient parking.

The cafe is adorable, with a ball pit for kids. There are various seating areas, each table decorated with Miffy dolls (though some might be a bit dirty from handling). The lighting is beautiful and the air conditioning is cool, perfect for taking photos.

The menu has a wide variety of dishes at mid-range prices, similar to other cafes, but the food tastes delicious. The dishes are decorated with cute Miffy designs. The staff provides good service and is happy to answer any questions. The cafe also has a section selling Miffy-themed clothing and bags.
sample_reviews_en.author: M Label

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is super cute, but the drinks, coffee, and desserts are just average in taste and quite expensive. This might be because it's Miffy-themed, but it's forgivable because Miffy is so adorable. There are two floors, but the staff didn't go up to the second floor to serve customers, although you could take photos there. Inside, there are many photo opportunities, a small ball pit for kids, and a souvenir shop. Overall, it's lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaipetch JJ

sample_reviews_en.text: A lovely spot for children who love Miffy. It has a ball pit, large cuddly toys, a slide, and more. We had an ice cream and a cappuccino. The ice cream was cute and tasty, but the cappuccino was very bitter. A Miffy nightlight, about 50 cm tall, costs a whopping 125 Swiss francs. In short: nice and good for Thais with enough money and for tourists. The children played quietly and still seemed to be having a lot of fun.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kat Swiss

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every dish is decorated with Miffy characters. Kids love it! They're cute, tasty, and not too spicy. They eat a lot.
The colorful drinks are a bit sweet. The coffee is average.

Order at the counter and the staff will bring it to your table.

The atmosphere is decorated with Miffy and her friends.
The first floor has a ball pit and a slide.

They also sell clothes and accessories.

Parking is available at the outlet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex A.

restaurants.name: Hoong
restaurants.address:

Sathorn Corner, 46 Phiphat 2, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The service from the staff member named อีฟ(Eve) was very rude and unpleasant.
She spoke loudly with the kitchen staff about irrelevant matters while customers were present, which felt extremely unprofessional. …
sample_reviews_th.author: sacai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried their sous vide chicken and let me tell you, it was thick and tender, just as everyone said. The crispy chicken was also delicious. The rice was perfectly cooked, with each grain separate and not broken. The highlight of the sous vide chicken rice is the two types of dipping sauces that complement each other perfectly. I wish I could take the dark-colored sauce home with me; it tastes good with everything.

Today's menu (copied and everything was delicious):
- Sous vide chicken (thigh and breast)
- Chicken rice combo (mixed with sous vide and fried chicken)
- Fried chicken biryani
- Grilled pork neck noodles
- Sesame oil salad
- Fried chicken skin and cilantro salad (delicious!!!)

My partner and I agreed it was excellent!!! Free refills of vegetable soup. The service was great and very attentive. Even though it's a small restaurant, everyone is dedicated to their work. Very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gracelicious (Kaegrace)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I rarely go back to this restaurant, but I was very disappointed with the service.

The staff had unfriendly expressions the entire time. There was almost no greeting, no thank you, and no acknowledgment of service.

It's been a long time since I've encountered such poor service.

The staff were quite noisy inside the restaurant, making it impossible to enjoy my meal comfortably.

While this might be understandable for a roadside restaurant, it's very disappointing for a relatively expensive establishment.

Even when I asked for the bill, the staff continued talking amongst themselves, and despite me calling out to them several times, no one noticed.

I personally recommend going to a different branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: m m

sample_reviews_en.text:
My favorite dish is Khao Man Gai. I heard there was a unique way to eat it, so I went to check it out.

The place was a little hard to find, but I found it.

I ordered Khao Man Gai in the clean and tidy restaurant.

When the Khao Man Gai arrived, I poured a thick broth over it and enjoyed it. This is unusual.

The meat was plump and the rice was delicious. The broth was delicious, and the accompanying sauce was also tasty. It was more expensive than what you'd get at a food court, but it was a Khao Man Gai that I was glad I ate.
sample_reviews_en.author: 本田太郎

sample_reviews_en.text:
The location is a little hard to find, but the restaurant is cool and clean inside.
I was a little confused by the ordering customization options (breast or thigh meat, with or without skin, etc.).
I ordered a half-and-half Khao Man Gai with thigh meat and skin, and the fried chicken was fragrant and crispy, while the steamed chicken was juicy and tender with no unpleasant odor, and paired perfectly with the special broth.
The Khao Man Gai costs nearly 200 baht, but it was well worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: kyo i

sample_reviews_en.text:
The skinless chicken breast is absolutely delicious!!
They say it's cooked using a sous vide method, but how is it so moist and tender?!
I bought a sous vide cooker to try and recreate this chicken.
However, I just can't get it this moist...
I wonder what temperature and how many hours they cook it...
Normally, when I think of Thailand, I like street food stalls and restaurants, but this place is different!
I've visited several times just for this moist chicken.
I'll be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: ふき

sample_reviews_en.text: Two bowls of Khao Man Gai and two small bottles of Singha beer cost 597 baht. The chicken was incredibly tender, and you could enjoy different flavors with the two different sauces. For us, who usually only go to street stalls and local eateries, the taste and price were a little too refined. It might be good for people who are trying Thai food for the first time or aren't used to it. The restroom is located outside the restaurant, at the back of the parking lot.
sample_reviews_en.author: ぴろ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was very good.

However, the fact that they asked "How many people are there?" as soon as we entered the restaurant made me realize that they take it for granted that customers will be there.

I've been in the food and beverage industry for around 30 years.
I run my restaurant with the motto "customers won't come" in mind, but I strongly feel that I need to instill that same mindset in my employees more.
sample_reviews_en.author: hiroki y

sample_reviews_en.text: To celebrate my birthday, I wanted Spanish food, and I definitely made the right choice visiting this restaurant. The food was delicious, the wine selection extensive, the atmosphere pleasant, and the service top-notch. They even gave me dessert on the house. The prices were excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zaida Rivera

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious paella — perfectly crispy rice with authentic flavor. The restaurant is nicely decorated and has a quiet atmosphere. They offer two styles of paella: the traditional version and a creamier one. Next time, I’m trying both and I might order a whole pan for myself.
sample_reviews_en.author: Penny T

sample_reviews_en.text: Place is quite a bit of a walk from where we stay.  For a weekend I found the place a bit empty only two tables were occupied.  The Japanese seafood place on the other hand was quite packed.  Food was quite good, but overall price was a bit high.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bale Takhel

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a decent experience. The food wasn’t bad at all, though I wouldn’t say it was excellent. I tried the Paella, which was quite nice overall, but I went with the creamy version and kind of wished I had stuck with the original instead. …
sample_reviews_en.author: SY LC

sample_reviews_en.text: I recently had the pleasure of dining at the restaurant I've been wanting to visit for ages, and I can happily say it lived up to the hype! I went with a friend, and the entire experience was fantastic. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattanant N

sample_reviews_en.text: I recently visited the Spanish tapas bar that many people have been talking about, @esquinasg. The restaurant has received many awards, including being listed in the Michelin guide. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Hangry Joobert

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was alright. We went there on a rainy night and it was quiet. Food was super fast given that there were only few tables there. …
sample_reviews_en.author: P Tang

sample_reviews_en.text: Outstanding! Loved the arroz negro, the pork plate and the selection of wines. The two girls serving us at 1pm were very attentive.👍 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Jose Caban Fishing

restaurants.name: รสกรุง - Ros Krung Esarn Thai Cafe
restaurants.address:

337 Maha Chai Rd, Samran Rat, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
My major problem with writing this review is I don't have many pictures to show because almost every time my food was served I commenced eating it and didn't take a picture. 😁 their food is that GOOD!! They have a great menu with a lot of variety.
I ate at this restaurant for 3 weeks everyday. Once I found that my stomach would not be unhappy with me (Bangkok belly is real) and the food is a 10, it became a no brainer.
The staff is very kind and friendly and it's a great place to chill.
If you walk in and order the Crab rice or the beef cheeks with rice you will have discovered some of the tastiest dishes anywhere. I have eaten across the globe and this food is high on the tasty scale.
I will search my phone to try to find some pictures but pictures or not this can be a go-to place for you in Bangkok.  Enjoy your meal and tell the staff hello for me!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Always K

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Isaan fusion restaurant offers flavors unlike any other.

We ordered Luang Prabang-style papaya salad, Bangkok-style grilled chicken, and lotus stem salad with fresh shrimp.
Let me tell you, the flavors are intense, savory, and well-balanced. They're delicious on their own.

But when paired with two types of German Red Label whiskey,
the lighter version cuts through the richness, making it more enjoyable.
The fruitier, slightly tart version pairs perfectly with the papaya salad.

Overall, the food is already excellent,
but the combination really enhances it. No exaggeration!

If you're in the Phra Nakhon area, give it a try.
I think it's worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supichaya Bella

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came across this place by accident when a nearby pad Thai place was closed on Tuesday. So glad we did!
They advertise northeastern Thai flavors and maybe that's why everything was just a tiny bit different. And in a very good way.
My vegetarian pad Thai was outstanding. Chicken curry rice was also good, iced Thai milk tea also yum. Finished off with some coconut ice cream.
The service was very good - so friendly. I would love to come back here again whenever I'm in Bangkok.
Oh and the prices are reasonable too for how good the food is.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leslie's Travel Snacks

sample_reviews_en.text: I came down here for dinner and was pleasantly surprised! I wanted to stay close to my accommodations (Tim Mansion) and this was right downstairs! The pad kee mao was delicious (chewy noodles and packed with flavor) and I appreciate them asking how spicy I wanted it. Decor had a cool retro-pop art theme going on and good music was playing in the background. The staff were very kind and attentive; I was dining alone and they would occasionally check on me, even if our Thai/English was limited.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nadine

sample_reviews_en.text:
I rarely leave negative reviews but feel the need to let others know - We waited an hour for our food & the same dishes came out at completely different times? A can of coke took about 45 minutes to be brought over.

I’m not sure if they were understaffed. We did have a big group - but I think they could have advised if they could not have served us.

The food was okay but not great portion sizes. I would not recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: India Rich

sample_reviews_en.text:
“Spicy rice noodle salad” is absolutely the best—so delicious!! The portion is huge, I thought I wouldn’t be able to finish it by myself, but I just couldn’t stop eating.

The beef om stew is perfectly balanced, and sipping the hot broth is incredibly satisfying. The atmosphere is great too. Top it off with a refreshing fruit smoothie that really brightens your day (the mango-passion fruit one is a mystery-try!)
sample_reviews_en.author: Puttinee Chotikultanachai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic delicious food, the Tom kha kai flavours were beautifully balanced and the papaya salad had to heat it deserved (spiciness can be adjusted to your taste).
Service was attentive without being intrusive.
Food came quickly and there are drinks specials before 8pm.
Located just over the canal from the Golden Mount, perfect place to stop for a bite, a drink and a reprieve from the heat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hamish McDonald

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food of outstanding quality and fresh ingredients – highly recommended! The dishes were perfectly balanced in flavor and beautifully presented. The service also deserves special mention: the lovely Nway was exceptionally friendly, attentive, and professional, making the visit even more enjoyable. You immediately feel welcome and well taken care of. I will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: TttT 99

restaurants.name: Thai Wang
restaurants.address:

264 Thai Wang Rd, Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It has high ratings on Dianping and Google Maps. Compared to the boutique shops next door, this place is more down-to-earth; there's no air conditioning, only fans. If you're coming from Wat Pho and need to go to the pier to catch a boat, eat here!

[Tom Yum Kung + Noodles] My first Thai meal in Thailand, and I can only say it was delicious! You absolutely must add noodles, the smooth and slippery Thai rice noodles. A big spoonful of Tom Yum Kung soup base + a mouthful of rice noodles. I finished it all, completely clean! 😆
sample_reviews_en.author: Loop

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing food, very quiet because the mindless horde of tourists goes to the restaurant next door, Pad Thai Kratong Thong, and totally miss this gem of a place. I came here because of the stellar Google reviews this place has, and I stay away from overhyped and crowded places where tourists congregate. This place is 🔥🔥🔥 highly recommended. Do yourself a favour and don't be a zombie tourist. Try somewhere new that doesn't have a crowd. It might just be the best place you discovered.
sample_reviews_en.author: Herman Soh

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice! I really liked it! I ordered Tom Yum soup and noodles. It was a very refreshing Tom Yum soup with a perfectly balanced light creamy flavor, and not spicy at all. Superb! Customers here are all very satisfied, and I think it deserves an even higher rating! The only downside is that it's an open space, so it can get a bit hot. But it's so comforting to work up a sweat after eating a hot Tom Yum soup! 😌
sample_reviews_en.author: 张钰欣

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hole in the wall family restaurant. Has English menus. Affordable price and very homely - you can even see the grandmas cooking from the seating area in the restaurant.

Nice and shaded, in a shop so you don't have to eat next to the street, this is a great place for a quick bite and also just to cool off after exploring the area and winding down with a great plate of food
sample_reviews_en.author: EatSleepPlay

sample_reviews_en.text: Good food while having one of the lowest price around the area. The space is an open one without an air conditioner. You can also see how they cook food at the back portion of the restaurant. Over all, this gives you an idea that even though you are eating in a commercial area near Wat Pho, you can still have good food at the lowest price point possible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eugene Carlo

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent street Food. Tasty, cheap, lot of turist but waiting time for meal is short. Perfect place to eat, near the Palace, central situated next to the Pier. Sitting on the plastic cheirs, with little plastic table, Spirit of Bangkok pure. Perfect Sea Food and Chicken, much vegetables. Hot. Very cheap, complet meal for few Euro.
sample_reviews_en.author: m jo

sample_reviews_en.text: After my week-long stay in Bangkok, I haven't eaten at a better restaurant than this one. I ordered the Pad See Ew and even went back for a second helping because it was so delicious. The owner and his grandmother, who I assume was there, were very kind. I have nothing more to add except that you should definitely go and try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Antoine BRETON

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is great! Butterfly peas soda was very good. I also had pad thai twice here during my visit in Thailand. I must admit it was delicious. They're serving it in tasty fried cake bowl. Staff was very friendly and helpful (thanks for gift). Loved every second spent there. Most authentic thai food and people 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Tomasz M.

restaurants.name: Yokai Izakaya
restaurants.address:

Rama VI Soi 30, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A fantastic Izakaya in Ari with a vibrant atmosphere, perfect for hanging out with friends.

They have a great happy hour: Buy 1 Get 1 Free on beer before 8 pm and Buy 2 Get 1 Free after 8 pm. The menu also features Japanese fusion dishes paired with unique Thai sauces.

The food is solid, the prices are reasonable, and the overall vibe is spot on. Definitely worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chen E.

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was really good and the staff were really friendly and helpful they’re really polite as well. Even when I made a call to make an appointment, that one male staff explained how to park my car and how to get to the place clearly. The food and cocktails were chef kissss. I also loved the songs and the vibe. Definitely coming back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Maddie MADMAX

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food and excellent service. Parking is available in front of the restaurant or across the street. My favorite dishes include: Numa-go fried squid, grilled sweet egg with ponzu sauce, dry-aged duck breast, grilled beef tongue, grilled stingray, eggplant fries with spicy dipping sauce, and Chashu pork rice bowl.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kalavit

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is diverse, a bit fusion (Thai, Japanese, Indian).
The grilled dishes are amazing, especially the butter miso chicken skin – it's perfectly crispy and not too greasy. We ordered several dishes!

The staff are attentive and the service is good.
I'll definitely come back again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: PINK Penguin

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best izakayas in Ari. 🍻🇯🇵
All the food was delicious. I ordered everything from the recommendation page, and every dish tasted great.
The draft beer was reasonably priced.
The service was excellent, and the staff were very friendly.
A great place to hang out with friends after work.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apisara Pak

sample_reviews_en.text: Staff is not friendly , takes a lot of time to get served , we had to wait an eternity to get our food , the vibe and atmosphere isn't good at all , cannot split the bill and before leaving one of the staff was very rude by asking if I paid the bill with an angry face , not recommended at all
sample_reviews_en.author: Eric Chatelus

sample_reviews_en.text: Fresh and well-balanced Japanese meal. The sashimi was high quality and clean-tasting, the grilled skewers were juicy and nicely charred, and the fried corn was crispy and addictive. A great selection for sharing with drinks in a relaxed atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyapatra Gatebua

sample_reviews_en.text: We went with high expectations because of the high rating, but were disappointed.Small space,very noisy ( mostly young people),unimpressive fusion food, reasonable prices.But service was good. That was only redeeming feature
sample_reviews_en.author: lekha shankar

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวคั่วไก่ แฮปปี้แลนด์ 1999
restaurants.address:

67, 60 Thanon Happy Land Sai 2, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: It’s not bad. But it looks better than it tastes. I don’t like pad thai at all but this kuay tiew khua kai is one of my favourite thai dishes. I feel like other shops cook better. To me the kuay tiew khua kai (ก๋วยเตี๋ยวคั่วไก่) boxes they sell at Max Valu supermarket taste a lot better than this shop.
sample_reviews_th.author: Ko Ko (Gwrarrrr)

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious! I ate here over 10 years ago when I was a student. Back then, the shop was in the old Happy Land market.

I got to eat here again because I watched The Spoon. Congratulations! You totally deserve the two Golden Spoons! I'm so proud of the male contestants; they were all so talented! 🏆

Today I ordered:
1. Stir-fried Chicken with Seafood (65 baht). I usually don't like crispy squid, but this shop's crispy squid was amazing! Fresh, large pieces, and the shrimp and squid were also big. The noodles were chewy, soft, and crispy, with a wonderful aroma of the wok and charcoal. Even better with lots of sauce!
2. Regular Stir-fried Chicken (45 baht). My mom ate it and said it was delicious. The noodles were different from other shops – dry, fragrant, and tasty. The chicken wasn't fishy at all.

We finished everything! We'll definitely be back!

The shop is clean, and ice is free (self-service).
Parking is available along the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angsupa Phachala

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant has received two Golden Spoon awards from The Spoon, guaranteed for quality.

Today, I tried dining in, after usually only ordering delivery. The restaurant is located on the main road with no parking; you have to find your own parking. It's a small shop with about 5-6 tables.

I arrived right when the restaurant opened, so the food came quickly. The stir-fried chicken had a wonderful wok aroma and tasted just as good as the delivery order. What I liked most was that the meat was served in generous, bite-sized pieces.
The Thai tea, however, was a little too sweet for my liking.

Overall, it's okay. The menu offers a variety of choices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jelly bear

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. The stir-fried chicken noodles are crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, with a variety of options to choose from. The noodles are well-cooked and fragrant, and everything is made fresh to order. The herbal drinks are also tasty. You have to wait for your food, but it's worth the wait. The restaurant is quite small, occupying a single shop unit in a row of buildings.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wan J

sample_reviews_en.text: The stir-fried chicken was delicious and the price was good. However, the lod chong (Thai dessert with coconut milk and jelly noodles) that the shop advertised didn't seem to be from Wat Chedi. My apologies if I'm mistaken, but the ones I've had before weren't like this. The portion was also smaller than expected; one bowl was about 20% ice, 70% noodles, and 10% coconut milk.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aom Mitsangsuk

sample_reviews_en.text: The food comes out quickly, and it tastes great. It's even better when eaten hot, straight from the pan! The shop also serves drinks, toast, and lod chong Wat Chet (a Thai dessert). You have to try it yourself because everyone's taste is different, and what's delicious to us is not the same for everyone! 🤟🏼😎
sample_reviews_en.author: Ongart “nOOm” Roonchai

sample_reviews_en.text: The flavor is great, the noodles are crispy and unique. There's a unique taro noodle menu, and the aroma of the wok is amazing just from being served. The more you eat, the more delicious it becomes. However, it takes a bit too long to make. It should be made one dish at a time. It's worth the wait.
sample_reviews_en.author: Waranon “Safety” Boonchuiluer

sample_reviews_en.text: Today's menu is stir-fried chicken with added bacon. The noodles are served crispy fried, which might diminish the signature wok-fried aroma, but the ingredients are good, including the chicken, crispy squid, and bacon. Overall, the taste is average, appropriate for the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anon Jariyanorasade

restaurants.name: The Bibimbab ICONSIAM
restaurants.address:

iconsiam 299 ชั้นที่ 6 ห้อง R611 Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It is a very nice place but, it is a small place which means it has very limited place to eat during dinner hour. We are with 5 people in total so it was a bit difficult for the staff to find a spot for us, they told us to come back 30 minutes later so there might be some available place for us. We said that’s fine so we walked around till it was time to come back. Once we came back the worker said to us come with us we come and once I sat down they suddenly said that we had to leave for 2 other people. We were all shocked and we tried to reason with them that they told us we can come back 30 minutes later and that there will be a seat available for us.
We were all upset, then they gave us a peace of paper and told us we can wait again at some seat. We both got even more upset because why didn’t they gave us this sooner. So we just left and ate somewhere else.

I think the place would’ve been a great place to eat and enjoy but because of this weak service we couldn’t enjoy the food to leave a better review.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yeben Shin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The cashier staff member had a terrible attitude and needs improvement. I went with a friend but hadn't been able to enter the store yet, so we were standing and waiting. The staff member turned around and told us to wait outside the store, speaking very rudely. The first time, I couldn't hear what she said because she was wearing a mask and couldn't understand. Then she got irritated with the customers.
I asked if there were many people ahead of me in the queue, and she turned around and said, "You're the only one. Wait until they clear a table." Her tone was terrible. We stood outside the store, looking at the menu, but no one called us in. There weren't many customers, and people kept coming out to pay, but no one called us in. I was frustrated and decided not to eat there. In the end, we went to another store. Terrible, very terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patha TANA

sample_reviews_en.text:
we hit up Bibimbap at ICONSIAM, 6th floor, right across from the cinema. The place is super spacious and has this cool outdoor vibe even though it’s inside the mall—no roof, super breezy, just chill   and the round tables with the “floating” sofas? Total vibe. Like, it’s so Instagrammable, you gotta snap a pic.

We got the pork neck, and let me tell you—so soft, so juicy. Loved every bite. The ramyeon? Way bigger than I expected, totally worth it. We ordered a ton of food, and when the bill came, I was shook—it wasn’t expensive at all. Plus, the food was really good.

Oh, and the little Pepsi bottle flipped upside down in the glass Adorable. Honestly, if you’re looking for a chill spot to eat with fam or hang out with friends, this place is 100% worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Napasorn Maneerat

sample_reviews_en.text:
How can you run a business with a Korean face on your face and provide service like this? Why is the food taking so long to come out? My friend and I came and waited for over 40 minutes. Why were other foreigners served first and us late? I didn't complain about that, though. We ordered two dishes, and they really took this long to arrive. What kind of service spirit is this?? Please train your staff properly. Or at least have the owner come out and offer a single word of apology.

It’s not like there are that many people here. Are you kidding me? Seriously, think about the Korean people before you come. It completely ruined my mood. And on top of that, why are they charging a service fee?
sample_reviews_en.author: Hippo k Kang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located on the 6th floor of the well-known iconsiam shopping mall, this Korean restaurant left me quite impressed. Although I don’t often eat Korean food, I was genuinely satisfied with the flavors here.

The service was remarkably fast, perhaps because it wasn’t too crowded and every dish arrived piping hot. That alone made me feel like giving it a full 5 stars! The staff were also very polite and attentive. There was a small communication mixed up, but overall, their attitude was excellent.

In terms of price and portion sizes, everything was reasonable. I’d be happy to visit again when I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Happitel Apartment

sample_reviews_en.text: Yesterday, I went to Icon Siam for meet The Berger's chef and got a chance to tried the Korean restaurant "The Bibimbab" that make me remember when I went to Korea 10 years ago.Yookgarjang, Tteokgalbi Bibimbab, Yangnyeum Dakgangjeong  and Tteokbokki are good, and Tteokgalbi (like a meat ball) is very good that I absolutely recommend anyone who love beef.The last menu is Korean BBQ pork set, unfortunately they don't have the charcoal stove. The side dishes are delicious for all. For the Beverage, they have chic idea. I will absolutely return.
sample_reviews_en.author: อุลิต รัตนตั้งตระกูล

sample_reviews_en.text: I recently visited The Bibimbab, and it was a fantastic experience from beginning to end! The authentic flavors made me feel as if I was in Korea. The Jeontong Bibimbab and Jijambbong Ramyeon were incredibly tasty and seasoned to perfection, with generous portions. The ambiance was warm and inviting, and the staff were attentive and friendly, ensuring we had everything we needed. I highly recommend this restaurant for anyone looking to enjoy genuine Korean flavors. I’m excited to return and explore more of their menu!
sample_reviews_en.author: M D

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're craving Korean bibimbap at ICONSIAM, head to the 6th floor and you'll see The Bibimbap restaurant. They serve authentic Korean bibimbap, with individual BBQ grills and four side dishes that you can refill. The pricing is standard for a mall. I ordered the Chicken Dakgalbi Bibimbap for 250 baht (excluding VAT and service charge). Currently, they're offering free coffee with no strings attached. You can order anything you want, even take-away coffee – just ask the staff. Come try the freebie!
sample_reviews_en.author: Narongchai Tho

restaurants.name: Era-izaan Bangna
restaurants.address:

389 Debaratna Rd, Bang Na Nuea, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Looking for a place with draft beer in the Bangna area, I found this place and decided to try it. They have a good selection of beers, including easy-drinking, chill-out beers like the Red Tawan, which are great for a relaxed, casual vibe. The food, more like appetizers, has unique flavors that I haven't experienced before. I especially liked the grilled mackerel, which seemed to be marinated and had a nice savory taste. Other dishes were in the Isaan style, with a salty, savory, and umami flavor. The atmosphere is comfortable and chill. They have beer promotions and parking available. Overall, I'd give it a thumbs up and would come back. The prices are reasonable considering the 10% service charge. Some food items aren't too expensive, and there's a wide variety of choices on the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sureerat Phu

sample_reviews_en.text: It's an Isan fusion restaurant, but if you're looking for a place to drink and chat with friends, this is a good place. There's not much parking. We arrived at 7:00 PM. There was some parking in the back, but the staff will direct me to park in front of the building next door and then have to walk to restuarant instead. Meanwhile, another car arrive behind me only minute they allow to parked in the back (confusing). The food and dipping sauces are all too sweet. The bakmi soup that they say is delicious is just so-so. They focus on socializing, not the original Isan flavor. The price is not cheap, similar to a Japanese izakaya, but if you want to change your vibe, I recommend you try this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: UgZilla

sample_reviews_en.text: This Isaan restaurant has a Japanese-inspired atmosphere and serves authentic, spicy Isaan food. If you don't like spicy food, be sure to inform the staff. Recommended dishes include Yukke (grilled beef tongue) and grilled beef tongue. The menu offers a good variety of dishes, and the service is quick. Portions aren't too large. There's indoor and outdoor seating, a karaoke room, and a wide selection of drinks with great promotions (buy 3 get 1 free). ***If you're coming from Mega Bangna, avoid using the U-turn bridge as the restaurant is located right by the bridge.***
sample_reviews_en.author: Mousey Nump

sample_reviews_en.text: There are many unique Northeastern Thai dishes on the menu that we weren't familiar with, which is great variety. People who like Northeastern Thai food will probably enjoy it. There are several beer promotions available. The rosé beer tasted delicious, not too bitter, and slightly sweet, easy for women to drink. As for the food, the dishes we ordered were on the salty side, except for the Thai papaya salad and the spicy dipping sauce, which had a well-balanced flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mammy SRP

sample_reviews_en.text:
We got a chance to try Thai-Izakaza fusion restaurant in Bangna. The tables were almost full during the dinner time. It was a great place to hang out/drink with friends or colleagues after work. There was plenty of parking and it was free. The price was quite high though

What we like:
-Grilled beef tongue: perfectly grilled but the portion was a bit small
-Yum grilled pork neck: a bit too sweet but tasty
-Grilled Mackerel: perfectly grilled (our favorite)
sample_reviews_en.author: Austin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The menu is unique and cleverly designed to suit the restaurant. 🌟🌟🌟
I like that the prices aren't too high per dish, so you can order several things to try.
The restaurant is spacious, a bit noisy but you can still have a conversation.
The decor is nice and the food is delicious. I recommend the duck larb; it's unique and very crispy. I ate two plates! 🩷🩷🩷🩷
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratchanan Larpcharoenwongsa

sample_reviews_en.text: Era-izaan Bangna offers a really unique dining experience. The food has a creative twist with subtle Japanese vibes, making each dish feel interesting and well thought out. The service is excellent, staff are attentive and friendly throughout. The atmosphere is also great, especially with a live music band that adds a nice touch to the overall vibe.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phonlapat A

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a Northeastern Thai restaurant with a great concept and absolutely delicious food. The papaya salad is genuinely spicy, so if you can't handle spice, be sure to note that. The grilled pork neck salad is the star dish; the pork is tender, fragrant from the grilling, and perfectly balanced with a sweet, sour, and salty flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rainie

restaurants.name: สมุนตุ๋น สาขา La Villa Ari (ลา วิลล่า อารีย์)
restaurants.address:

LAV01LS203 ร้านสมุนตุ๋น ศูนย์การค้า ลา วิลล่า อารีย์ ชั้น 2 เลขที่ 356 Phahonyothin Rd, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Part of the same chain as Jones Salad, it hasn't been open for very long.
It's easy-to-eat food, but the prices are higher than typical noodle shops due to the brand and location.
I think the price, food quality, and service might not be quite commensurate compared to other brands in the noodle segment.

The side dishes are quite reasonably priced considering the noodles.

The restaurant has a steady stream of customers, but there might be a shortage of staff, resulting in slow service.

The dumplings are delicious, but the pink sausage didn't match the picture.
It's a shame there aren't any sweet or plum-flavored dipping sauces.

The water is served in small paper cups, which might be inconvenient. I also noticed the staff handling the rim of the cup every time they serve a paper cup to a table, perhaps because the cup is too small to hold comfortably.
If you order without ice, there's no straw. So, some adjustments might be needed. I sympathize with the staff; they're busy taking orders, clearing tables, wiping tables, serving food, and collecting payments. I offer my encouragement to everyone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naszha Pimpawatin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant, Samun Tun, is located on the second floor, LAV01LS203, La Villa Ari Shopping Center, 356 Phahonyothin Rd, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok.

The restaurant has a well-designed seating area, not crowded. They offer a variety of dishes including noodles, curry rice, and snacks.
We ordered the beef curry rice (69 THB) and the braised beef tendon curry rice (149 THB). Both dishes were tasty and included Chinese sausage (which I didn't particularly like). The Wagyu beef noodle soup with braised herbs (259 THB) was delicious but very expensive. The braised beef noodle soup with braised herbs (169 THB) was standardly tasty. Everything had a slightly Chinese flavor profile, which was a little disappointing. The mixed braised beef salad (139 THB) was a bit pricey and extremely spicy due to the generous amount of chili paste.

Parking is easy to find during the day. One hour of free parking after a meal or purchase is included; a small fee applies after that. Parking fees are the same in the evening and night, but it gets crowded and difficult to find a spot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaroonphan Lim

sample_reviews_en.text:
Support Uncle Jones's place! It's not a salad shop, but I didn't order the braised pork/beef dish as the name suggests.

I ordered dry rice porridge with sea bass. The sea bass piece was huge, and it came with Chinese sausage and pork cracklings. It didn't look as healthy as Uncle Jones's salad shop, but they included blanched Chinese cabbage, which is unusual for dry rice porridge.

The rice porridge broth was fragrant and delicious. The sea bass piece was large, and eating it with the crispy pork cracklings was great. The broth tasted good, and the seafood dipping sauce was very spicy. The fried dumplings had a typical bouncy pork filling.

The restaurant is comfortable, the staff are friendly, polite, and attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bunnarach Punnarach

sample_reviews_en.text:
The wide rice noodles were a disaster; they were mushy, separated into small pieces, and not strands at all.
The chicken pieces were of good quality, skinless, and didn't look appetizing, but they were tender and tasty.
The soup had its own unique flavor, with a Chinese herbal undertone.
The vegetables were wilted, mushy, and mixed in with the wide noodles.

My friend ordered the vermicelli noodles; there were a lot of noodles and very little chicken.

I think they need to improve their quality control and adjust the proportions to be more balanced.
Then it would be much better.

P.S. The echo in the restaurant was very loud. If you want a quiet dining experience, this isn't the place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natcha Song (Natcha.S)

sample_reviews_en.text: The braised pork with soft bone was tender and delicious. The thin noodles were chewy and soft. The soup was piping hot with a mild spiciness and a slight herbal/Chinese medicine aroma. It wasn't a heavy soy sauce or braised pork base, but it wasn't a clear, watery broth either; it was very tasty. It came with plenty of vegetables, including water spinach and baby bok choy. Crispy pork cracklings and fried garlic were sprinkled on top. The food came out quickly. The restaurant is spacious, clean, and the service is good. While the price is considerably higher than typical noodle shops, considering the quality, taste, and location, I think it's reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pat K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This noodle shop serves really delicious noodles. Both the braised chicken and beef are perfectly tender, and the broth is fragrant, well-balanced, and rich – you can really taste the intense flavor of the broth that's been simmered for so long.

I also tried the spicy pork salad and spicy meatball salad; they were both flavorful and delicious, and paired perfectly with the noodles.

The atmosphere and seating are quite comfortable, making it a pleasant and relaxing place to eat.

Overall, it's another restaurant with delicious food, especially the excellent broth. If you're in the area, it's definitely worth a try! 😊🍜✨
sample_reviews_en.author: มันม่วง Journey

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a relaxed atmosphere, the food comes out quickly, and the flavors are bold and well-seasoned, especially the papaya salad and appetizers, which are delicious and enjoyable. The ingredients are fresh and clean, and the dipping sauces are tasty and just the right amount of spicy.
The staff provides good service, they are friendly and attentive to customers. The prices are reasonable for the quality. Overall, I was impressed and will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Korakod Sailabath

sample_reviews_en.text:
They offer both rice and noodles. The menu includes chicken, braised pork, braised beef, and fish. The broth is fragrant with herbs, but the flavor is a little mild. The meat is tender and melts in your mouth, and the tendon is soft and smooth, but there's too much of it to be cloying. The portion size per bowl is just right.
✨ I recommend the braised beef.
💸 Noodle prices start at 139.-
sample_reviews_en.author: Mins Min

restaurants.name: Mr. Green Thai Food
restaurants.address:

PHJ8+G8J, Unnamed Road, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It was our first meal after arriving in Thailand, and Bangkok’s hyper-vibrant urban atmosphere had us a little mesmerized. We randomly walked into this small diner tucked off the city’s bustling streets. It’s one of those places where home-style cooking hits particularly differently. The Pad See Ew tasted like something parents would make on repeat and never mess up: the right amount of oil, the right seasoning, and ingredients that still felt fresh. The green curry chicken had the same comforting effect. The chicken was tender, and the soup was aromatic, neither too thick nor too watery. The fried rice with beef was a bit on the average side, but the portion of beef was quite generous. And all three dishes came to under seven dollars?! Truly ridiculous great value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leo Zhang

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is “typical noodle shop”, no frills. The food was pretty good but not outstanding. Large portions. The service (Mr. Green is apparently away for extended holiday) was pretty much “here’s your food”. By engaging the manager/server enough we finally got a little
smile. He speaks reasonable English but clearly doesn’t enjoy what he’s doing. Considered it beneath his pay grade and beneath his dignity. Openly talked about how he’s not used to serving meals for 50-100 baht. “I used to work in a fancy hotel where we served this kind of food for 350-500 baht.”

The biggest turn-off, however, was wading up the alleyway past the lineup of scantily dressed bar girls and “masseurs” vying for my attention even though I was walking hand in hand with my wife.
sample_reviews_en.author: Reginald Williams

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there because of the 4.9 star reviews. The tom yum with shrimp wasn't available so I ordered one with chicken. The soup broth itself was excellent and the mushroom was very tasty. The chicken however was extremely dry.

I also had a Pad Thai noodles with seafood. Luckily the lady asked if I want it spicy or not - I said no, knowing how spicy things can get here 😂 The seafood was nice but I didn't like the peanuts being mixed together with the noodles.  This might be the authentic way but I'm used to the 'UK way' where it's not mixed in or put on one side so I can remove it. I'd say the flavour was disappointing - a bit bland to be honest. I much preferred the Pad Thai we have in the UK, sorry!
sample_reviews_en.author: HappyBunny

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is somewhat secluded and unassuming, and consequently very small and simply furnished, but the owners are extremely friendly and the food is very good.

There's nothing to complain about regarding hygiene; the dishes were fresh and the meat was good and safe to eat.

I've tried quite a few restaurants in Bangkok, and this is definitely one of the best and, above all, most authentic. It's also very inexpensive; I paid about 90 baht for a meal and a drink. You can also take your food to go, and it's prepared very quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Magdi

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had the chicken pad Thai and the stir fried crispy pork with kale and oyster sauce.

The pad Thai was delicious and the largest serving of food I’ve received so far in Bangkok! (On day 3 of trip). The stir fried crispy pork dish was great as well, but could have used a little more flavor. The owner was very kind and welcoming. We would definitely come back again! The prices were great, especially for this area of Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: A G

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food, great value. Charlie was the host working when I went, a friendly and hysterical man.

I was about to put in an order for a second entree before my first order arrived, but he said to wait and see once I get my first meal. He was right, they have generous portions here and I couldn’t have eaten another bite. Honest man. And then he wrote out directions for me on his scratchpad on how to get to Robinsons.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tim Clancy

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good Thai food! I got the pad kra pao kai, and asked if they could make it spicy for me! They didn’t hold back on the chillies even tho I have the typical foreigner-look. The food was so cheap as well, I paid 80 baht for my dish and my drink. The owner was the sweetest guy, who told me about how they dry their own chillies. He also clapped for me because I handled the spice, so sweet! Please support this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Noor

sample_reviews_en.text: I spontaneously decided to come here last night, having discovered the restaurant by chance through Google Maps, and I can wholeheartedly recommend it. The staff are so warm and friendly; I immediately felt at ease, and the food was absolutely delicious. They offer a wide variety of Thai dishes, all very authentic and also available in vegetarian versions. I would definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jil

restaurants.name: Shakariki432" The Street Ratchada
restaurants.address:

ชั้น B ห้อง B06 ศูนย์การค้าเดอะสตรีท รัชดา 139 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Khwaeng Din Daeng, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Discovering new restaurants in the Ratchada area using Google Maps was a great experience. First, the food and drink menu was incredibly diverse, with so many choices it was hard to decide!

During the meal, I was impressed by the variety of flavors and the beautiful presentation. The atmosphere was very friendly, finding a seat was easy, and the staff were attentive, polite, and made me feel warm and welcome 😊

It's definitely a great value izakaya, considering the price and food quality. I'd love to come back with friends next time to try more dishes!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nenè Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: I found this restaurant through Google Maps and decided to visit with friends for the third time 🏮. The food and drink menu is so diverse it's hard to choose, but everything was delicious and perfectly balanced, especially the sashimi and the fried items which were perfectly crispy. The atmosphere in the restaurant is quiet and cozy. The staff are attentive and provide excellent service 😊. The prices are reasonable and good value. Next time, I'd like to bring my friends to enjoy another izakaya experience in the Ratchada area!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mos Molliya

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stumbled upon this place by chance while strolling around the Ratchada area. I loved the wide variety of food and drinks on the menu! Everything looked so tempting, although there are a few dishes I haven't tried yet.

The atmosphere is casual and perfect for chilling out. The staff were friendly and welcoming 😊

If you're looking for an izakaya with a relaxed atmosphere in Ratchada, this is a great option. It's definitely worth the price! I'll have to bring friends next time to try more dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปิยธิดา เครือคำ

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my second time visiting this restaurant while walking past it. This time, I was impressed with the variety of food and drinks on the menu – so many choices! 🍣

The atmosphere is really relaxing and comfortable, perfect for a long hangout with friends. The staff were attentive and the service was fast, giving it a genuine izakaya feel.

Having such a great restaurant in the Ratchada area is always a good idea. I'll definitely bring my friends along for another fun visit next time! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Rata K

sample_reviews_en.text:
I highly recommend this restaurant. We ate here on April 24th, 1969, at approximately 11:20 PM.

I didn't even have time to take pictures of the food before I couldn't stop after the first bite. It was so delicious!

The staff were incredibly attentive, constantly observing customer reactions and responding even before we spoke or called for them. Highly commendable!
sample_reviews_en.author: kolola

sample_reviews_en.text: A friend recommended this restaurant near Ratchada, and this is my third time visiting. The atmosphere is bright and very clean 😊 The food and drinks are truly worth the price. The dishes I've tried, whether fried or sashimi, were delicious …
sample_reviews_en.author: Mod Kantika

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my third visit to this restaurant, based on a friend's recommendation. My first visit was impressive with the diverse drink and food menu. The skewered meats had a wonderful charcoal aroma and were lightly crispy and not greasy – a …
sample_reviews_en.author: viewforyt

sample_reviews_en.text: I've walked past this restaurant many times, and finally had the chance to try it. This time I came with my family, so we ordered many dishes and shared them. I have to say, everything was delicious overall. The flavors were excellent! 👍 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Palmz Srisawat

restaurants.name: Kong Pai Lew
restaurants.address:

1/1 ม.9 ถ.พระราชวิริยาภรณ์ ต.บางพึ่ง อ.พระประแดง, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The crispy-skinned grilled chicken was delicious.
The fried lemongrass salad with shrimp had 5 large shrimp.
The papaya salad with grilled pork skewers had delicious crispy papaya strips.
The chicken coconut soup was rich and flavorful.

The food flavors were moderate, not too spicy, just right for those who don't like strong flavors.

Drinks included water and soft drinks.

The prices were reasonable.

The portion sizes were appropriate.

It's an air-conditioned restaurant with approximately 9 tables (4 seats per table). Reservations are recommended during meal times.

Parking is available in front of the restaurant (slanted parking for 4 cars, if parked straight), along the street, or in the temple across the street (parking restrictions apply in the evening; the restaurant has a sign at the entrance informing customers about this).
sample_reviews_en.author: rutjinee khiaoubol

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, cozy and family-friendly. The food isn't too spicy or sweet. The grilled chicken has crispy skin, and the fried catfish, fish cakes, sour curry, and chicken tom kha are all delicious. The papaya salad is tasty, but the larb and nam tok are just okay, lacking some flavor, perhaps because there wasn't enough MSG. The food isn't overly spicy but has good flavor overall, and the dishes are tasty. The service is good, and the food comes out quickly.
There's parking for 4 cars, or you can park in the temple across the street, which has plenty of parking spaces but only until 5:30 PM. The durian bua loy (rice balls in coconut milk) is delicious, just like regular durian sticky rice. The young coconut tofu pudding is also good and not too sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: C Wana

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every dish was delicious! I didn't even have time to take pictures. I highly recommend their signature crispy-skinned grilled chicken. The skin is perfectly crispy and dry, yet the meat is still juicy – ​​it's just right!

The vegetable soup tasted just like the one my grandmother used to make when I was a child. The peppery kick was just right, very flavorful and aromatic with every bite.

The staff were also lovely and friendly. Highly recommended! You won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: KAMTHORN UNSAB

sample_reviews_en.text: Wow, so surprisingly good, how is this gem hidden all the way here! We had 15 people and ordered almost everything, all the dishes was done right. Everyone’s favorite dish is the leaf with salad, they did it really well. Chicken and Fried Fish is so delicious, we also ordered lemon fish is good too. great service and even great shopping of ChiangMai handmade clothes and goods. Cant wait to go back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: YiChien Tsai

sample_reviews_en.text: Interesting menu with a few special dishes. Fresh ingredients but very unbalanced flavours. Somtam too sweet and not spicy (we even asked for very spicy and sent one back to the kitchen). Namtok crazy sour (and from fake lime use I think), and the same for the chicken dipping. The chicken was almost tasteless.
sample_reviews_en.author: We all need to eat

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old, long-established restaurant. Their crispy-skinned grilled chicken is delicious, and the skin is genuinely crispy. Other dishes are reasonably priced; we ordered a fried sea bass for 350 baht. There's parking in front of the restaurant for 4-5 cars. They also sell souvenirs inside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mania K.

sample_reviews_en.text: This old restaurant in the Rat Burana area serves a variety of authentic Thai dishes. Their signature dishes include Gaeng Liang (spicy vegetable soup), Yam Takrai (lemongrass salad), Tam Saeng Wa (spicy papaya salad), Steamed Sea Bass with …
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornpanom Chatwiriyakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was generally delicious and the restaurant atmosphere was nice, but I'm wondering why the recommended dish, lemongrass fried shrimp, was so expensive. 235 baht for only 5 shrimp! Where did the crispy-skinned grilled chicken wings go?
sample_reviews_en.author: Joe

restaurants.name: Yentafo Kruengsonge by A.Mallika BITEC Branch
restaurants.address:

BITEC Bang Na, Bang Na Tai, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This famous Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) looks great, the price is reasonable, and the taste is delicious.
You can tell that each ingredient in the Yen Ta Fo is of high quality; the meat is firm, not starchy, and in large pieces, and the water spinach is crispy. The soup, if you choose the non-spicy version, is sweet, while the spicy version has a sour taste from the vinegar, each with its own distinct flavor.
Overall, I really liked the taste. The seating area is spacious and the air conditioning is comfortably cool.
sample_reviews_en.author: Grang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Yentafo Krueng Song A. Mallikar
BITEC Bangna Branch
A legendary restaurant, I've eaten there since its MBK branch.
The taste feels like it's dropped by 10-20% compared to before.
The freshness of the food at this branch is acceptable.
Because there are fewer customers, the food isn't as fresh.
The prices have increased considerably compared to before.
And the portion sizes have decreased.
The service has also deteriorated; the staff lack enthusiasm for service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piya Jirapapongpan

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here because I was at an event at Bitec. I was impressed with the taste of the Yen Ta Fo with the most toppings. It was delicious, just the right amount of sour and spicy, so I didn't need to add any more seasoning. The kids' version was a bit sweet, and it came in a very large bowl, just the right amount of filling.
sample_reviews_en.author: มาเนกิ เนะโกะ

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant's decor is creative and evokes a nostalgic feeling. The food is delicious and very reasonably priced. The ordering and food pickup system is efficient, and the food arrives quickly. They also have seasonal menus. If you're interested in supporting Thai food, give it a try! They even sell set meals in bento boxes. 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: นั่นไง สล็อตป่วย

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes good and is up to standard. The dishes are large and come out quickly. They use good quality ingredients and are reasonably priced. There are promotions including drinks. There are lots of seats. The shop is spacious and the service is systematic. Good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasu klinkaew

sample_reviews_en.text: Tried the pad thai and fried rice with pork this afternoon, very yummy!!!! And the price is good !!! Very recommended you to have a try ~ and the polite girl from cashier provided us with excellent service, she is so friendly and helpful.
sample_reviews_en.author: A m

sample_reviews_en.text: Try Grandma's Noodles, a recipe from Nakhon Si Thammarat using vermicelli noodles in a pinkish-red broth made from fermented red rice mixed with ginger, Chinese rice wine, and sesame oil. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Bebe Supree

sample_reviews_en.text: Yen Ta Fo with a dry, spicy flavor. My favorite menu. Delicious as always. Good quality ingredients. Crispy fish skin is very delicious. The food doesn't take long to arrive.
sample_reviews_en.author: PattO San

restaurants.name: Tanommit Food Hall
restaurants.address:

4160 Rama IV Rd, Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Update, Wednesday, September 18, 2024 (2567) #StreetFood #Rama4Road #BangkokFood #Restaurants #Rama4Road #SoiBangkokUniversityKluayNamThai

There are some vacant spaces available for rent for shops.
There is stainless steel seating with staff always on hand to maintain cleanliness. There is ample and sufficient parking. A variety of shops are available, such as: Prasert's Food (made-to-order dishes), rice and curry shops, Panya Heng Heng Lao noodle shop (pictured) where you can add your own crispy wontons, Pran La Nuea shop, Lung Sak's Food (made-to-order dishes), Khao Pla Kae (which also sells fried chicken and grilled chicken, and a new menu item: fried fish salad with rice), Som Tum (papaya salad), Yam (spicy salad), and grilled chicken. There are also two beverage shops offering various smoothies, a congee shop, and a shop selling grilled meatballs, grilled pork, and sticky rice. The first shop opens at 6:00 AM.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattharicha Mainkul (Ying)

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came here for dinner at around 16:00 after spotting it on google maps. It wasn’t far from our hotel, an easy walk. There were a variety of different food shops and two drink stands (that I noticed!) and I was stuck by how clean everything was. Really, it was spotless! The tables, chairs, floors. Even the dish return area was organized and clean. The ceiling is very tall and the fans allowed for good airflow. While it was a very hot day, I was comfortable sitting down with my meal.

We ordered two of the chicken rice - one boiled and one with a mix of boiled and fried chicken - and they were so delicious. I also ordered a coconut smoothie and banana smoothie which were very refreshing! We also ordered a spicy meat and rice dish along with some beef noodles. The beef was so tender, it melted in my mouth. The prices were excellent, too.

I wish I’d come here earlier in my trip!
sample_reviews_en.author: Elle

sample_reviews_en.text:
I usually like to eat Pad Krapow (Thai basil stir-fry) at either Uncle Sak's or Prasert's. Both restaurants taste equally good and give generous portions; you get exactly what you order.

But today (January 1st, 1969), both were closed, so I ate at the restaurant in the picture instead. I'd never eaten there before. I ordered extra spicy Pad Krapow, but what I got was Pad Krapow that wasn't spicy at all, and it was even sweet. The taste was nowhere near as good as the other two restaurants. It cost 60 baht for the same portion as a 50 baht portion from the other two. The only advantage was that they included soup, since they also sell noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thana Kiki

sample_reviews_en.text: This food court has so much variety—you’ll find everything from made-to-order Thai dishes and noodles to curry rice, chicken rice, and even fresh smoothies. The prices are super affordable, which makes it a great spot for everyday meals. There’s plenty of seating, so you can sit down and enjoy your food comfortably. Plus, if you’re driving, you can park for free for 1 hour—just don’t forget to get your ticket stamped! The dining area is clean located right along Rama IV Road. Pretty good a quick lunch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Minky Somtong

sample_reviews_en.text: I often went there after yoga. It's only in Thai, but you can order using broken Thai, menu numbers, and translation. It's not crowded, the turnover is quick, and it's clean. It never upsets my stomach. My favorites were the Moo Grob stir-fry, Khao Mok Gai, and Tom Yum Goong. They had Thai food on display. The restaurants change from time to time.
sample_reviews_en.author: yumi

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time here, so I decided to try the Pad Thai.
The Pad Thai was delicious. It tasted like the Pad Thai I used to eat when I was a kid, not overly sweet like what you often find at other restaurants in Bangkok these days.
sample_reviews_en.author: Park Phantaweesap

sample_reviews_en.text: It was so clean and tidy that it felt like it was newly built. I went for lunch on a weekend, and while two or three stalls were closed, most were still open. The food I ordered was generally delicious, generous, and reasonably priced.
sample_reviews_en.author: JAYEONG CHOI

sample_reviews_en.text: A go-to spot for Thai food and drinks, perfect for Thais living nearby. Plenty of parking, decent taste and price — good for everyday meals. Just a heads-up: it can get pretty hot at lunchtime, so bringing a small fan is a smart move!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thrapat Wong

restaurants.name: Jaew Hon, Khon Kaen girl
restaurants.address:

ตรงข้ามโรงเรียนโยธินบูรณะใหม่ 1030 ถ. ประชาราษฎร์สาย1 Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm craving Jaew Hon (spicy dipping sauce) for lunch.
But it's so hot outside!
I recommend a hot Jaew Hon experience in an air-conditioned room
at Jaew Hon Sao Khon Kaen restaurant,
on Pracha Rat Sai 1 Road, near Wat Soi Thong.

The restaurant is easy to find, right by the roadside.
Be careful not to accidentally park in the red and white zones on the roadside.
I recommend driving past the restaurant,
until you see a 7-Eleven, then turn left.
There's parking available on the left.
Get your parking ticket stamped at the restaurant.
Free for the first hour, 20 baht for each subsequent hour.

The restaurant offers various price options.
You can choose between buffet or a la carte.

Today, I opted for the buffet for 288 baht.
This includes unlimited refills of drinks for 38 baht.
The total price per person was 326 baht.

The food came out quickly and exactly as ordered.
The quality of the pork and beef was good.
The Jaew Hon soup was incredibly delicious!

The staff provided good and fast service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natta

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here many times before, but on my last visit, I brought my 5-year-old child (105 cm tall) with me. The staff informed us that we had to pay half price for the child's meal. Honestly, we could have paid extra, but we checked the menu first to see if a child of that height could actually eat it. There's no height requirement displayed outside the restaurant; no guidelines specifying a minimum height for children to be charged half price. Most reputable hot pot or buffet restaurants that serve spicy food require a minimum height of 120 cm or taller. A child this young wouldn't even be able to handle the dipping sauces or spicy food, so why pay extra for something they can't even eat? Please consider adjusting your policy. This is feedback from a customer with young children.
sample_reviews_en.author: จันทิมา สุขเกตุ

sample_reviews_en.text: The Jaew Hon soup base was delicious, I loved it! The ingredients were fresh – pork, beef, seafood – for 288 baht, refillable drinks for 39 baht, including ice cream. I usually don't like soda, but at 39 baht I had to have some. Luckily, the restaurant used good quality soft drinks like real Fanta, grape soda, red soda, Sprite, and lemon tea. For this price, the buffet is incredibly good value. The pork and beef were fresh, the vegetables were fresh, and the shrimp were large (I forgot to take a picture!). The tripe was crunchy and high-quality. They offer both buffet and à la carte options, suitable for those who don't eat much.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornchanok Ae

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has been renovated with a new, brighter and cleaner atmosphere.
The food is delicious and worth the price. The ingredients are as fresh as ever. The sliced ​​pork is perfectly thin; I recommend the pork neck, especially if you wrap it in cheese and dip it in sesame sauce – it's amazing! The scallops are excellent, as are the beef brisket, pork belly, and beef meatballs. I recommend their famous Jaew soup, but the must-try is the black soup – it's flavorful and rivals other restaurants. I usually eat there about once a month.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jame ROaON

sample_reviews_en.text: I used to eat there regularly, but the spicy dipping sauce used to taste better. Last month, when I went, the taste didn't feel the same... Also, during promotions and discounts, they didn't give any discount when I ate at the restaurant (I found out after checking Facebook after I left). It feels like they're not being honest with customers... Every time I pay, they always charge me for refills on the bill. I usually only drink water, but this has been happening every time lately. I wouldn't even notice unless I checked the bill.
sample_reviews_en.author: CHANINTHORN K

sample_reviews_en.text:
-High-quality ingredients at a reasonable price.
-Good service from the staff and owner.
-A cozy, homey-style restaurant.
-The Kurobuta pork with its beautiful marbling is exceptionally delicious.
-Food takes a little while to prepare if the restaurant is full, but not excessively long.

Be aware that the portion size is larger than average. It's better to order one dish at a time.

Otherwise, everything is excellent. A perfect 10/10!

See the picture for an example of how large one dish is.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tak Chaowanachan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Beef Review:
Shank (top left) > Beautiful golden color after boiling, tender and chewy, a pleasure to eat. Shoulder Blade (top right) > Soft and melts in your mouth, the most delicious. Sirloin (bottom right) > Slightly firm meat, but with a fragrant, melt-in-your-mouth texture. Pork Belly > Soft and juicy, fun to chew, the fat is easy to chew. Coconut (bottom left) > Nicely chewy, can be eaten according to your preference.

The staff provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: นัทที อินทรังษี

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a small shabu-shabu restaurant, but the ingredients, such as pork, beef, and shrimp, are of good quality. The dark broth isn't too salty even after the allotted time is up. The spicy dipping sauce (jaew hon) has a mild flavor, perhaps because they need to cater to a diverse customer base. They offer Wall's ice cream for dessert. The dipping sauces are a little difficult to find due to limited space. Overall, it's good value for the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: พรพิพัฒน์ พ่วงแม่กลอง

restaurants.name: HIDE Dine & Wine
restaurants.address:

748/5 Phahonyothin Rd, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
For anyone looking for a glamorous anniversary, birthday, or celebration dinner, I highly recommend this restaurant. Everything is delicious and reasonably priced. The truffle soup is incredibly rich and flavorful. The squid dish (I can't remember the name) was amazing – so tasty! Their signature dish is the duck breast with a unique berry-flavored sauce; it was interesting but not bad at all.

The staff are incredibly lovely and provide exceptional service. They pay attention to detail and their gimmick is the wine glass painting.
We went for our wedding anniversary and birthday, and the staff noticed our painted wine glasses before filling them with water, so they brought a cake to celebrate with us! It was such a big surprise; we almost left! I've never experienced such a thoughtful touch at a restaurant before.

Before leaving, my husband and I took turns taking photos, and the staff even offered to take a picture of us together – so thoughtful!

I hope they maintain this high quality and service for years to come! 🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Un Omyim

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to dinner with my boyfriend for my birthday, and the atmosphere was terrible because it was incredibly noisy. They should have had a larger table set up; we had to shout to talk. The live music was almost unintelligible. The food was also very slow; we ordered four dishes, but only two arrived, and two were forgotten. It was awful. The food tasted okay, but it was overpriced, and some portions were very small for the price. The service was also poor; it seemed like the manager apologized to a table of foreigners for the noise, but didn't seem to notice the other tables. Staff were slow, and when I told one person about my food, they didn't follow up. I had to tell another person before they finally rushed to get it. In short, my first birthday celebration at this restaurant was the worst. I paid over 1,500 baht. Never again.
sample_reviews_en.author: m333

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went for drinks and dinner with 4 friends.
Drank 2 bottles of wine and ordered 7-8 dishes.
The price was a little over 1,200 baht per person, which was very worth it.

The food was delicious. Our favorite was:
The baked salmon with truffle rice was amazing and fragrant. Highly recommend! The atmosphere was great, with live music and good-tasting background music.
There were many beautiful photo spots with great lighting.

The staff were incredibly lovely. They were always chatting with us and even taking pictures for us. Simply fantastic!😆✨

If you're looking for a great hangout spot, I highly recommend it. It's genuinely amazing, no sponsored review. I paid for everything myself, no endorsements. If you don't believe me, go try it yourself!🤍👏🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Natasha Sangarun

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! I especially loved the fresh shrimp with a pesto-like sauce; it was so flavorful. The salmon was perfectly cooked, and the tangy sauce complemented it well. We made a reservation for my boyfriend's birthday, and they gave us a complimentary matcha pudding as a birthday gift – it was amazing! We also ordered chocolate and vanilla ice cream, and the flavors were spot-on. The desserts here are truly delicious. The restaurant is beautifully decorated, and the staff provided excellent service. The food arrived quickly, and they even provided a large bouquet of flowers for us to use as props for our photos – so thoughtful! 🩵🩵
sample_reviews_en.author: wed

sample_reviews_en.text: We think this restaurant has a great vibe. It's chill, and Gen Z and Gen Y would probably love it. The atmosphere is nice, perfect for dinner with friends, and there are plenty of beautiful photo opportunities. The food is generally okay, but the portions are small, about 1 serving for 2 people. In my opinion, the staff we encountered today weren't very good, both in their speech and service. If they improved their service mind, I think it would be much better. We ordered a lot of food today and liked several dishes, such as the crunchy ball, ebi crocrette, truffle toast, etc. // Returning in Dec 2025
sample_reviews_en.author: Wachiraporn Olarn

sample_reviews_en.text:
For anyone looking for a dinner spot or to celebrate a birthday, I highly recommend this restaurant. The service is excellent. It was raining heavily that day, and the staff even came to escort us from our car.

The food is delicious, and there are fun activities like painting wine glasses – very cute! If you don't drink alcohol or need to drive, you can order a mocktail and have the glass painted as well.

You can even leave a cake and flowers at the restaurant as a surprise. The atmosphere is great, and they have live music too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittipon Nguansakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
This bar has an amazing vibe with live music that sets the perfect mood. The food is absolutely delicious—every dish we ordered was exceptional. The staff provided excellent service, always attentive and checking in to see if we needed anything. The owner was also very friendly and welcoming.

The overall atmosphere made our anniversary dinner date with my wife a truly special evening. If you're looking for a place to enjoy great food, warm hospitality, and a cozy ambiance, this is the spot you shouldn’t miss!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ekapol Kunadirek

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and reasonably priced, and the atmosphere is great. Especially now that the restaurant is decorated in a Christmas theme, it's adorable! There's live music on Thursdays, Fridays, and Saturdays. We went on a Saturday, and it was a bit busy, but we were extremely impressed. The staff were incredibly friendly and provided excellent service. The owner was also very kind and welcoming. This is now one of my favorite restaurants! 🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: PLVS

restaurants.name: Baan Suan Op Uan Rak – Samrong
restaurants.address:

26/12 ม.15 Bang Ya Phraek, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in a side street with an incredibly pleasant atmosphere. Parking is available, and both air-conditioned and outdoor dining areas offer a natural breeze. The menu offers a wide variety of dishes, including Western and Thai dishes, single-dish meals, and even som tam (papaya salad). The interior is clean and white.

Food and drink prices are reasonable, and the service is excellent. There's no service charge, but the staff are attentive and helpful. No additional tax is added. Prices are listed on the menu. Credit cards are accepted for 800 baht and up.

When I visited, there were tables outside that could accommodate large groups of about 10 people. I went on a Friday night around 7 PM and there was live music playing inside (I'm not sure about the exact time).

If you're in the area and looking for a place with a good atmosphere, this is a must-try. Taste is a matter of personal preference, but I personally enjoyed the clear tom yum soup with seafood, the squid stir-fried with salted eggs, and the melon smoothie.
sample_reviews_en.author: P Panyaphirom

sample_reviews_en.text:
Come on over! The quality and taste are well worth the price!!!!
My photos aren't great or detailed because we ordered small portions in multiple rounds. Today, we opted for the entry-level buffet. There's a huge variety of soup bases to choose from, and the entry-level option even includes seafood! I tried bamboo clams for the first time and loved them. Everything was incredibly fresh, especially the vegetables. The dipping sauces were just right, and the corn salad was delicious – not too spicy, I think everyone would enjoy it. The biggest surprise was the amazing ice cream; it was so rich and flavorful. And the toast had a generous amount of Nutella!

The atmosphere in the restaurant was warm and inviting, not too hot and not crowded. It had a homey feel, perfect for a relaxing meal. I think it would be very romantic to eat here in the evening.
sample_reviews_en.author: ploy pim

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been here twice before and it was great. This time, I came with friends, seven of us in total, and the service was terrible. We kept ordering, and as soon as we finished eating, we'd place our orders again. But as more tables kept arriving, our food started taking 30-60 minutes to arrive. We asked for refills of our soup until it was all gone, but still didn't get any. I don't want to criticize the staff, but shouldn't the person in charge pay more attention? It's a holiday, so there should be a lot of customers, but with such inadequate service, I'm starting to not want to come back. I was going to be a regular customer, but I'm very disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakyn Thi

sample_reviews_en.text: I really like this quiet place. The shop is airy and well-ventilated. There's parking. The shop's decoration is cute.
