Shabu is available in both buffet and a la carte styles, as you like. You can order desserts separately. There are both water and desserts. We ordered the buffet for 379 baht, no additional charge. The food is quite fresh, clean, and delicious. The only complaint (really just a little) is that the electric stove is a bit loud. Everything else is fine. The quality is worth the price. The staff is very good, cute, and friendly. It's a good place to bring your family to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Parichamon Sangmuang

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is shady and has plenty of parking. The restaurant is located in an alley decorated in a garden house style. There is both an air-conditioned glass room and an outdoor area. It feels like you've traveled back in time to the countryside in comfort. The food is fresh. The young staff provide good service. The fried food is very delicious. The sauce is good. There are many choices of shabu soup. Fresh vegetables. Try it. The buffet food has 3 prices. You can choose. There is also a play area for children. If you have a chance, you will stop by to eat again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suttipong Prasertsopha

sample_reviews_en.text: This minimalist-style restaurant serves dishes that look delicious just by looking at them! And the taste doesn't disappoint; everything is incredibly tasty, both savory and sweet. The baked ribs are incredibly tender, and the sauce is perfectly balanced. There are so many other dishes I could go on and on! Outside the restaurant, there's an organic salad farm with incredibly fresh and delicious vegetables. The highlight here is the melon farm. Everything is perfectly balanced, and we believe the owner truly puts their heart into it. Everyone should come!
sample_reviews_en.author: Krittaphat Teerakultana

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been to their Ban Na branch before and was very impressed. When I had the chance to be in this area, I stumbled upon this branch by chance.
The restaurant is located a bit down an alley, but it's not difficult to find. Entering feels like a different world from the surrounding atmosphere; it's very warm and inviting, and the staff are attentive.
The food is delicious and uses high-quality ingredients, just like at the Ban Na branch.

If I have the chance, I'll come again during lunchtime, hoping to pick some vegetables to eat with my order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Variya Vongrianthong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I didn't know this branch was a buffet, otherwise I would have come a long time ago.
They currently have a promotion starting at 299 baht, which beats every other shabu-shabu restaurant!
The soup base is amazing, the dipping sauces are great, and the ingredients are top-grade.
The staff are very quick to serve, even with many customers, they didn't even have to sit down!
It was a very satisfying shabu-shabu experience. I'd rate it as number one in the Samut Prakan area. I hope this restaurant becomes more popular and stays open for a long time!
sample_reviews_en.author: spie Dreamer

restaurants.name: Summer Kiss Restaurant & Moon Bar
restaurants.address:

1, 3 Soi Srinagarindra 40, Nong Bon, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
We made a reservation for 20 people at The Moon bar.
The staff were very friendly and extremely helpful with the birthday surprise. Thanks to them, it became a wonderful night for all of us.
ขอบคุณ!
sample_reviews_th.author: Maika Noguchi

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been traveling in Thailand with my wife for a month now, we've been to at least 10 different hotels.
My wife and I feel at home here.
The entire staff here is simply amazing, one by one!
It's so much fun that we're finishing a month-long honeymoon trip here.
Really left with a sweet taste and a taste for more.
Highly recommend!!!!
When I return to Bangkok, God willing, it's only here.
Luxurious rooms, delicious food at the level of a chef's restaurant. (And I worked for years in the food and restaurant industry.)
In one word, a pleasure!!!!!
So nice, smiling and helpful.
The service here is above and beyond.
Their restaurant is where we eat every day and we took a room for a week.
There's also a very beautiful and enjoyable pool here.
If I could give them a score of 1000, I would, and with all my heart.
Thank you very much for a very pleasant and enjoyable stay!!!!
Hope to see you again soon❤️🙏🏼
Thank you so much for everything!!!🙏🏼
Dudu and Nicole.❤️🇮🇱❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: David Aberjil

sample_reviews_en.text: It's so delicious, I've eaten here twice already! The stir-fried noodles with kale are crispy all the way to the stem, sweet, and not bitter at all. They have a wonderful wok aroma, and the noodles are perfectly cooked. My boyfriend ordered the vegetarian option, which had penne cheese. Highly recommended! The price and quality are excellent. The service is great, and the chef is incredibly skilled. This is the best stir-fried noodles with vegetables I've ever had. We ordered the seafood stir-fried noodles, and they gave us plenty of shrimp, which were clean and delicious. The mocktails are also tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakjira Udomwongsub (Bella Hinata Tsubaki)

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the dining and bar area of ​​the mii hotel. Besides having breakfast, it's also a restaurant where non-hotel guests can come for a general meal and drinks. Today, I stayed at the mii hotel and had a welcome drink at the Moon Bar. Later in the evening, I had cocktails and mocktails, which were on a buy 2 get 1 free promotion. I ordered a Summer Kiss and a Margarita, and a Twilight mocktail. All the drinks tasted good and were reasonably priced. The bar staff provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: T.P

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered three dishes: crab soup, pork ribs, and beef steak.
The beef steak was terrible. It seemed like the meat was spoiled; it tasted sour and was so mushy it fell apart when I bit into it. I asked the staff to replace it once, but the second serving was the same. I didn't eat any more and called for the bill because I was afraid of getting a stomachache.
The other two dishes were delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: llcheezyll llcheezyll

sample_reviews_en.text: Each course of the meal shows the chef's meticulous attention to detail in preparing it for the customers. The presentation and ingredients are excellent, the flavors are well-balanced, and the staff are lovely and always happy to serve. I would definitely visit again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: จตุพร หวังเสต

sample_reviews_en.text: Truly amazing. Great value for money. Food is unbelievably good and best value I've seen in a long time. Do check out the SUMMER KISS restaurant. Hotel is clean, modern, great staff and a just a great, all round experience. Bring ya costume. Beautiful pool.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul G Barker

sample_reviews_en.text:
"A Journey from Garden to the Moonlight," priced at 990++ baht, is definitely worth the price. It's a change of pace and offers unique flavors.

We also ordered truffle soup and pineapple fried rice. It was just the right amount for two people.
sample_reviews_en.author: พศภณ วัฒนสมบัติ

restaurants.name: Vegan India- 100% Pure Vegetarian Indian Restaurant in Bangkok
restaurants.address:

925/6-8 Rama I Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Warning for vegans: this restaurant is NOT vegan, despite the name. Do not order anything with paneer and triple check your dishes do not contain any butter, ghee, milk, yogurt etc.
The staff hardly speak any English, only Hindi. When I asked a staff member if everything was vegan, they said yes, but then when I asked what the paneer was made out of, they couldn't answer and called someone else to help. I had the same issue with the second person until they called the manager.

Once our food came, one of the dishes tasted like there was dairy in it, so we asked a staff member to double check with the chef about the dish and she said she would, but then she never came back.

Otherwise, we found the food tasty, but the service awful.

It would be great if the restaurant could change their name because it's very misleading and confusing, especially if staff are telling customers everything on the menu is vegan.
sample_reviews_en.author: R

sample_reviews_en.text:
The positive reviews are mostly or entirely fake. Don’t go. Very overpriced, the worst meal we had in Thailand and probably the worst Indian food I’ve ever had.

To be fair the butter paneer was really good! Everything else was abysmal.

We each ordered the Thali combo. The roti was crunchy. The daal was a salty soup. Even the rice was somehow bad. It was supposed to include dessert. When we asked why it didn’t come they shrugged and said they don’t have any. Also didn’t have the pickles, chutneys or raita. A couple slices of tomato and red onion, both raw, were included instead.

The place is quiet and musty, (a spider literally fell onto my wife, TWICE), and after the 7% VAT charge we paid 737 baht for the dhalis, a coke, and a lassi. We figured it wasn’t worth having a confrontation about it so just decided to help others steer clear.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anonymous

sample_reviews_en.text: The aaloo methi was good, and the daal tadka with roti was excellent. However, the kachumber salad was disappointing because it had too much raw, strong-tasting onion. The service was good, but the staff suggested we sit near the windows, where we soon realized that only one air conditioner was on. It quickly became too hot, and by the time the air conditioner had cooled our part of the room, we had almost finished our meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rajendra Yadav

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dined here multiple times during our stay in Bangkok. Masala tea was watery but all other items we tried here were good. Onion uthapam should be highlighted. Sourness was upto the mark. Even restaurants in India miss this.

Also, There is a large Indian crowd, and it can get noisy because of that. We also saw a few foreigners enjoying the food here. Staff is very polite. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fa Ris

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was really delicious! It had a mild spiciness that made it flavorful without being too heavy. The fried dishes were also excellent — crispy, not greasy, and with no unpleasant smell at all. The staff were very kind and gave great recommendations, which was really helpful for someone like me who isn’t very familiar with Indian food. Highly recommended for Veganism!
sample_reviews_en.author: Supachai Pongvichaicharoen

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is good thali not recommended but the staff is not, the sardar guy. Rude in speaking if you ask simple question. The apply 10% service charge and 7% vat. When asked about it he was very rude. We went to so many Indian restaurant in Thailand this is the only one with extra charge. He didn’t even know the basic thing about his own restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sakshi Deshmukh

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing vegan Indian restaurant with so many options to choose from! Every dish we tried was fresh, flavorful, and full of authentic spices. The staff was incredibly kind and attentive, making us feel welcome from the moment we walked in. Whether you’re vegan or just looking for great Indian food, this place is definitely worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Olivia V

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I had a great experience here! The food was delicious, fresh, and 100% vegetarian and vegan, with plenty of tasty options. The atmosphere was clean and comfortable, and the staff were friendly and welcoming. If you're looking for authentic vegetarian or vegan Indian food, I highly recommend this place. I'll definitely come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: maya bhanwara

restaurants.name: LA PLANTE
restaurants.address:

AVORA31, 28 Sukhumvit 31, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had pretty high expectations coming here because the reviews are so great. The place is very nicely decorated, beautiful but a little more homier than most places around this area. I would say the food is generally pretty good but not outstanding. However, their service and dedication to detail in food presentation is lovely. Their pricing is also amazing.

Burrata with Parma ham:
Great! A classic dish that’s made well here. Although more ham could be added.

Pork chop:
Their pork chops are very interesting, it’s a blend of Thai and Western style of serving grilled pork. There are fried potatoes as well as other veggies that are not typically served in Thai cuisine but the pork and the sauce (I believe it’s jaew sauce) reminds me a bit of kor-mhoo-yang but the meat here is not oily and is more on the dry side.

Chicken pesto risotto:
The chicken pesto risotto is also pretty good here.  The chicken is tender and the risotto is nice but could use a bit more flavor.

Pancake with berries:
Delicious fluffy pancakes!
sample_reviews_en.author: Miss Food Lover

sample_reviews_en.text: I savored the highly acclaimed chicken risotto during my visit, and it exceeded my expectations for a dish often considered basic. My taste buds are already tingling in anticipation of trying their seafood risotto on my next visit. The clams angel hair, while slightly dry, offered an explosion of flavors that made each bite a delight. The restaurant's ambiance exudes a serene and Instagram-worthy charm, making it a perfect spot to relax and enjoy a meal. What truly sets this place apart is its pet-friendly policy, where dogs are welcomed in the air-conditioned comfort of the restaurant. Additionally, the adjacent café and outdoor seating options cater to those who prefer the natural ambiance, even though it can get a tad warm during the noon hours. The service was impeccable, with attentive and friendly servers, ensuring a memorable dining experience. I'm eagerly looking forward to my return visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: S

sample_reviews_en.text:
🌿 La Plante Bistro & Cafe | Sukhumvit 31

A cozy hidden gem tucked away in Sukhumvit 31,
La Plante Bistro & Cafe offers a calm, welcoming atmosphere—perfect for a relaxing brunch, casual dining, or a quiet coffee break.

Thoughtfully crafted dishes, quality ingredients, and well-balanced flavors
come together in a space that feels simple yet refined.

The food is well prepared with quality ingredients and balanced flavors.

We started with the mushroom soup, which was rich and very enjoyable.
The fresh salad came with a well-balanced and flavorful dressing.
The pasta portion was quite generous; a slightly smaller portion might make it even more perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nittreeya Wongsa

sample_reviews_en.text: Le Plante Bistro & Cafe, Bangkok: In an insane city packed with cafes, bars and restaurants, how do you find the good ones? Fortunately, we were just across at Public House and found this beautiful quaint French spot. Choose your ambiance - there is a bistro and a cafe flanking two sides - you almost think they’re two separate establishments. We chose the bistro, which was dripping with romanticism thanks to the booth seats. Brunch here is a classy affair. Banana pancakes were so well caramelised. Mushroom spinach omelette looks deceptively simple but packs a flavour powwow. #eatstylishtravelstylish
sample_reviews_en.author: Health Care

sample_reviews_en.text:
From the moment we walked in, we loved how incredibly cozy and welcoming the atmosphere felt. It is perfectly kid-friendly without sacrificing its charming vibe, making it an ideal spot for families.
​The highlight, however, was definitely the food. Every dish tasted exceptionally fresh, and you can really tell they prioritize high-quality, fresh ingredients. Everything was cooked to perfection.
​Excellent food, warm service, and a wonderful environment. We will absolutely be coming back! Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: paricha joule

sample_reviews_en.text: visited here for a bday with my fren yesterday and the service was so good! And the ricotta was delicious for me personally! But my fren say her chicken spicy pasta tasted a bit bland for her . But anyways i got a cake slice and requested the staff to write Happy Birthday for me on the plate and they did it for me and the pleasant surprise was when the staff started singing happy birthday for me too😹💕💕 it was so cute i love it so much!! Plus the atmosphere is cozy and great for photos!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tofu

sample_reviews_en.text: 1000 baht buffet for corkage fee. The wine price is good. The dishes are good but not a wow, it is very good looking at a very reasonable price. Music selection is great. The sop is very pretty. Love the Parma and fig salad, and the berry cheese cake. Though, the berries were dried on top from being too long in the chiller. The lamb was welldone when i ordered medium. The fish was dry, not juicy, again too well done.  The sauce in the fish dish was very good!
sample_reviews_en.author: nan doji

sample_reviews_en.text:
Found this lovely bistro for a late lunch. I was the only guest at that time so a bit hesitant first but I enjoyed the quiet and the food was outstandingly fresh & yummy. I‘ll definitely go back.

I especially loved the window nooks for seating and the general interior was just the prettiest, with so much attention to detail.

My main waitress was friendly but a bit short for real comfort, hence the deducted star. Other than that, great experience for lunch!
sample_reviews_en.author: Britt Schwaabe

restaurants.name: La Tavola
restaurants.address:

518/8 Renaissance Bangkok Ratchaprasong Hotel Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I am extremely disappointed and upset. Today, February 14th, I had pre-booked a Sharing Set course through Hungry Hub.
About 40 minutes before my reservation time, a staff member called to say that it was Valentine's Day and the chef would only be serving buffet.
I was shocked and asked, "What about my reservation?"
If I didn't want the buffet, she simply said that it was Valentine's Day and the chef could only serve that way, without any apology whatsoever. It was as if the fault was on the customer who had made the reservation…
She said she would consult with the manager and call back. I, who was planning to dine on Valentine's Day, didn't know what to do. I waited for a very long time, but no one called back. I had to find a new restaurant… There was no attempt to take care of the customer at all. As a Bonvoy member and loyalty member of Renaissance, I am very disappointed with the service here.

I contacted them again after having to find another restaurant. The manager said that the staff member had miscommunicated, and that I could actually still come to dine… but unfortunately, there was no communication with me until after my reservation time had passed.
sample_reviews_en.author: fxsx101

sample_reviews_en.text:
Escape the hustle and bustle of Ratchaprasong and immerse yourself in an Italian ambiance with Mediterranean Modern decor 🌊 reflecting the refreshing charm of the coast.

A highlight is the open kitchen, where you can watch the chefs meticulously prepare your dishes up close, making this meal even more special. And let me tell you, their Lunch Set 🤩 is incredibly good value!

Two sets to choose from:
✨ 2 courses for 390++ (Starter + Main or Main + Dessert) perfect for a light meal.
✨ 3 courses for 590++ (Starter + Main + Dessert) a complete and delicious feast.

Our Ordered Menu:
🥗 Starters
Eggplant Parmigiana (baked eggplant with cheese) / Italian Sausage Salad / Mushroom Soup (porcini mushroom soup with truffle)
🍕 Mains
Roasted Spring Chicken (Italian-style roasted chicken served with smooth mashed potatoes) / Freshly baked Pizza Diavola
🍮 Dessert
To perfectly end the meal, we had La Tavola's Signature Tiramisu – rich, perfectly sweet, and melts in your mouth.

📍 La Tavola, 3rd Floor, Renaissance Bangkok Ratchaprasong Hotel
🚆 BTS Chidlom, Exit 2
🗓️ Open daily
⏰ Lunch 12:00 – 15:00 / Dinner 18:00 – 20:30
sample_reviews_en.author: Fooddiarytoday

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a restaurant I would recommend if you want to enjoy a meal with a nice atmosphere at a hotel during your trip to Bangkok. I visited on Mother’s Day, and they even provided a complimentary drink, which made for a delightful dining experience 🤍

I expected the prices to be a bit high since it is a hotel restaurant, but booking through the Hungry Hub app made the rates quite reasonable. The portions were more generous than I anticipated, making it great for a group to visit and share a variety of dishes.

The menu was diverse, ranging from wood-fired pizza to pasta and steak, and overall, the food was truly delicious. I especially want to recommend the wood-fired pizza 🍕

The space is spacious, and the tables are spaced comfortably apart, making it a great place to chat while dining.

I recommend this place if you want to enjoy a delicious meal with a hotel restaurant vibe in Bangkok.

It was also perfect for setting the mood on special occasions like Mother’s Day or anniversaries. ✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Jihye Suh

sample_reviews_en.text:
An affordable Italian buffet with quality far exceeding the price. Every dish was delicious.

The pizza was fragrant, freshly baked, and generously topped with truffles – they're very particular about the truffles!

The desserts were delicious, served in bite-sized portions, perfect for enjoying continuously.

The salads were fresh and crisp.

The dining room was beautiful, and the staff provided excellent service.

Highlights you shouldn't miss:
Pizza & Pasta: Authentic Neapolitan pizza with a soft, chewy crust (the truffle topping is highly recommended!), followed by freshly made pasta, prepared to order by the chef.

The Carving: Crispy-skinned, juicy porchetta (herb-roasted pork belly) and tender prime rib, perfectly slow-roasted by the chef.

Risotto Pass-around: Truffle risotto served directly to your table by the chef, filling the entire dining room with its aroma.

Finally, authentic Italian desserts like tiramisu and cannoli.
In short, it's more than worth the price!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ananthana Rakphan

sample_reviews_en.text:
La Tavola was one of those meals where everything just felt right from start to finish.

The food is classic Italian done properly — simple ingredients, bold flavours and dishes that clearly come from a kitchen that cares about getting the basics right. The pizza came out bubbling straight from the oven, the ragu was rich and slow-cooked, and the tiramisu at the end was genuinely one of the best we’ve had — light, balanced and full of flavour.

But what really stood out was the team. The service was warm, attentive and incredibly thoughtful with our kids. At one point the staff even arranged a custom pasta for our toddler without us needing to ask twice, which made the whole meal so much easier as parents.

Great food is one thing, but when a restaurant combines that with genuinely kind hospitality, it makes the experience memorable.

La Tavola absolutely delivers on both.
sample_reviews_en.author: akshat arora

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food is amazing, we had tuna tartare, saffron rissoto (saffron were already mixed with rissoto), black cod, parma ham bruschetta. All were absolutely fantastic, delicious. What i can speak highly of them is, you will be satisfied because the portion is massive. Not gonna exaggerating anything, do order 1 by 1 instead of ordering all at once. You i promise you, you'll be stressed out, im telling you. Even desserts (pannacota) were small but it was huge and thick. Yeah good luck. Above all, service were very good. Imagine this. A waitress were talking, seeing my hands were looking for someone, he ran towards me, not 1 people did that but 3 different people did that.

Dream is the guy you might want to serve you. Yin were amazing and Diss were giving all out for us.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dewanto Wijono

sample_reviews_en.text:
La Tavola on the L3 of the Renaissance Bangkok Ratchaprasong Hotel specialises in authentic Italian coastal cuisine, fresh seafood, and homemade pastas.

Known for its sophisticated atmosphere, it has extensive wine options, and is led by Chef Waranyu “Nott” Pansakul. Chef’s specialties include fresh pasta, wood-fired pizzas, and signature Italian dishes with high-quality ingredients.

At a good price point for the venue, La Tavola is highly recommended. We especially love the truffle pizza 🍕.
sample_reviews_en.author: Soo Hin Yeoh

sample_reviews_en.text:
This hotel Italian restaurant is consistently good, with reliable food, atmosphere, and service. While not particularly unique, it's a solid, trustworthy choice.

Booking through Eatigo gives you 50% off all food, making it quite a bargain for a hotel Italian restaurant.

One minor disappointment, though I didn't check properly, was that they served Evian water, two large bottles costing 560 baht. Regular water would have been perfectly fine, so that was a bit of a waste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kay K

restaurants.name: InLove Bar & Restaurant
restaurants.address:

2, 1 Krung Kasem Rd, Wat Sam Phraya, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The live music, relaxing vibe, and view is what makes this place special. It’s our second day in Thailand (visiting from USA) — if you’re a visitor, I would recommend! ฿165 per person.

The atmosphere is absolutely fantastic, the view of the bridge and being by the water is magical. Reading through the 1 star reviews, it seems agreed upon to avoid the seafood.

My family and I had the Thai and Chinese fried noodles with chicken. It was alright, nothing to complain about. The Chinese noodles had a better flavor.
sample_reviews_th.author: Kyle Graham

sample_reviews_en.text: While the view is nice, the tables wobble, you can constantly hear the kitchen exhaust fan, and nobody there understands a word of English. The coconut with seafood was delicious, but the pad Thai was far too sweet, the fried rice was practically tasteless, and the shrimp salad came without dressing, instead being given an expired yogurt dressing. For that price, it was an absolute rip-off; any street food stall is five times better and five times cheaper. We even received the wrong order because the waiter didn't understand us. When we complained about receiving something we hadn't ordered and having to pay for it, he threatened to call the police. Paying 900 Bahr for fried rice, a salad with four fried shrimp, a coconut with seafood, and a pad Thai is outrageous considering how bad the food, service, and atmosphere were. Never again!!
sample_reviews_en.author: John Abdalla

sample_reviews_en.text: Food is ok regarding the taste, but I do like the ambiance at night. You can enjoy the life music, eating as well as seeing the view of the bridge. The Chaophraya dinner cruises also arrive until here for the turning point. For the food, I have tried Pad-Thai, Bua-loy as a dessert and lemon juice. It was ok good taste. Good place for a dinner between couple, friends or family. Rooftop view over the Chaophraya river. Located near the boat pier, taxi access during the evening until night time is recommended. For the way back, you can take either Tuk-Tuk or walk until the main road and take a taxi meter without problems. I brought my tourists friends there, so mostly see Thai local people enjoy their meal and spending time together.
sample_reviews_en.author: Notes de Na

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was fine but there was some mistake in taking my order. Moreover, I asked waitresses to take a photo group of my family. They aggressively denied my begging. The young girl with golden blond - short hair especially, said she ended her worktime and won’t be able to take a few photos for my family. Another old waitress said she was not able to take a photo. Then, other waitress come and take a photo for me at the time 21.22 o’clock. I would like the manager to take care of waitress’ attitude in giving services cause it costed not cheap! Please ask waitress who ended work around 21.10-21.30 on the date of 10 March. Thank you and I hope to see manager’s response.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yanathip Chanrueang

sample_reviews_en.text: I just went to a New Year's Eve countdown party with my family on the 31st. The food was okay, especially the Tom Kloong soup, which was very flavorful. Other dishes were alright, but I was extremely disappointed. Many items we ordered were said to be sold out. Even dishes that should have been available, like Som Tum (papaya salad), were unavailable from early evening onwards. Despite it being a busy night, they weren't prepared at all. So many dishes we ordered were unavailable. I was incredibly upset and disappointed with this restaurant. Overall, it was a terrible experience. Only the atmosphere was good; the food was severely lacking!!
sample_reviews_en.author: ปภาวรินทร์ รายทองคํา

sample_reviews_en.text: The In Love Bar & Restaurant in Bangkok is an excellent choice for those seeking to combine top-notch cuisine with breathtaking views. Situated directly on the Chao Phraya River, the restaurant offers spectacular views of the illuminated Rama VIII Bridge, especially at sunset. The atmosphere is romantic and relaxed, ideal for couples or cozy evenings with friends. The menu features classic Thai dishes such as Tom Yum and seafood specialties at reasonable prices. An unforgettable dining experience in a central location.
sample_reviews_en.author: arazados arazados

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place could be so much nicer if people smiled a bit more. The location is breath taking. Stunning view on Rama VIII bridge and a beautiful old mansion next door. We came on a Saturday afternoon and were the only ones. It was raining but we asked to leave the blinds up so we could enjoy the view. Apparently that is against house policy. But we still had a nice afternoon watching fisherman and the bridge from the side window.

Prices are quite high for drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, right by the Chao Phraya River, and you can see the Rama VIII Bridge in the photos. The service is good. The food menu isn't very diverse; we went at 8:30 PM and several items were sold out. The menu mainly consists of typical fish, squid, and shrimp. The prices are reasonable. It's conveniently located next to Thewet Pier, and you can see the pier from the seating area. I'm not sure if reservations are required during peak season.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cha_li Chokdee

restaurants.name: The Place Restaurant
restaurants.address:

316/142 Soi Buakhao, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant that serves primarily Israeli inspired cuisine along with some Thai dishes. They also have a large selection of vegetarian meals. I had the vegetarian couscous (only available on Tuesdays) and an order of hummus with tahini which came with a pita. I also had a carrot smoothie. All the items were fresh and delicious. The service staff was efficient and I received my food promptly. The portion sizes were generous and the cost reasonable. The restaurant has a casual and comfortable ambiance with both indoor and outdoor seating. I recommend this establishment to those that enjoy Israeli/Middle Eastern food served in a pleasant environment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Kapshuk

sample_reviews_en.text:
Disappointing restaurant.  Usually all Isreali restaurant are famous with Pita bread done at the restaurant and served with the food. Here you get toast or a loaf of bread COLD.
I didn't sea any Israeli working in the kitchen or even monitoring,  all Thai workers which makes the food taste not Middle Eastern to me. Portions are so small compared to the majority of the Israeli restaurants I have been to . Price is good compared to the little portions. Taste in ok but not Authentic amd not the best.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tommy Helmy

sample_reviews_en.text: this is an interesting cafe. reasonable prices and clean, i ordered the shashuksa and it came with a nice crusty half loaf of bread to dip it with. the taste was great but the eggs were over done thus the yolk was cooked thru as you can see from the video. for 220 baht it was a satisfying deal. the waitress was over worked thus i can understand why service is bit curt, but it did not bother me. life is too short to get all bent out of shape for small things like that, just relax and enjoy
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay Koh

sample_reviews_en.text: Worst vegetable couscous of my life. Totally tasteless with overcooked vegetables, some without any texture left. I swear there was not one spice in the plate, not even cumin, and the yellow colour came from I don't know what. The bill was 10% more than the menu price and they said the price had changed. I am not saying don't go but don't take the vegetable couscous, I think any middle eastern chef would be insulted by that dish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Richard Hebert

sample_reviews_en.text: We had a holiday meal at the local restaurant. We started with a selection of salads, challah and pickles. Then we ordered Asado which was excellent, lamb in the oven was excellent, and the stuffed vegetables were amazing. We received hot sides of rice with beans, rice with wonderful raisins, potatoes and sweet potatoes. For dessert we had Malbi. It was perfect. The service was excellent and the experience was very good
sample_reviews_en.author: סמדר לוי

sample_reviews_en.text: Been here a few times now.  From the dishes I've tried, falafals quite nice, humous just runny and not great, egg salad delicious, bread nice, soups ok, spaghetti ok.  Sadly the service must be one of the worst in Pattaya, mieserable, never smile, too serious to communicate and seem demotivated.  Doesn't help when the owner is hanging around shouting at everyone.  Do they know the word smile in this place ?
sample_reviews_en.author: Anthony Thai

sample_reviews_en.text: I woke up this morning hungry and looking for a place to eat in Pattaya. I went to a few places and everything felt unaesthetic and uninviting. In the end, I came here – and I was really happy. The food was excellent, fresh and delicious, the service was kind and professional, and there was a real feeling of home cooking. Finally, a place that does good for the stomach and heart. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: BENI ROSENBAUM

sample_reviews_en.text: If this review was based on the speed we got the food and the quality of the food it would easily have been a four star. Unfortunately our waitress was having a bad day and it showed. The inside of the restaurant is quite nice however when we were there it was quite messy. Given all the good marks that this restaurant has we just happen to go at a bad time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert Staub

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวคั่วไก่สวนมะลิ เจ๊ทิพย์
restaurants.address:

319 Yukol 2 Rd, Wat Thep Sirin, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Jae Tip's Stir-Fried Chicken Noodle shop is located at the entrance of Soi Yukol 2, Suan Mali. There is seating available both in front of and inside the shop. It's open from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM, closed on Sundays.

Noodle prices range from 60-80 baht. Besides stir-fried noodles with chicken, pork, and seafood, the noodle soup is also fragrant and delicious. They also offer snacks like spring rolls, fried pork dumplings, and fried tofu.

It's recommended to eat at the shop for a better experience than takeout. The stir-fried noodles have a nice wok aroma and use a bit more oil, but the noodles aren't crispy; they're more like just fried with egg. They used to be crispier. It's still acceptable. The noodle soup is still delicious, with a fragrant and sweet broth that doesn't need any extra seasoning.

Eating inside can be very hot because there aren't many fans. Adding more fans would be beneficial.

Taste: 3/5
Value for Money: 4/5
Parking: 2/5
Atmosphere: 2/5
sample_reviews_en.author: Yutiya H.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been eating this chicken fried noodles since I worked at Suan Mali. I quite like the flavor and the slightly charred aroma of this stir-fried chicken. For those who prefer a seafood stir-fried version, they also have that option.
But for me, just eating this chicken fried noodles with crispy squid is absolutely delicious. The surrounding area may have changed a bit, not as lively as it used to be when the Nakorn Luang Thai Bank was established, and this could be due to the current COVID situation.
Fried Noodles with Chicken is my favorite dish from this restaurant since I worked nearby and had lunch at least once a week. You can enjoy the aroma of food fried in a Chinese wok over a charcoal stove.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nithinart Limsiri

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'd love to rename this street "Fried Chicken Street"! If you want to eat fried chicken noodles at 6-7 different restaurants, you can walk less than 1 km and try them all.
This restaurant uses a charcoal stove to fry the noodles. The noodles cling to the egg, fried very dry, and have a wonderful wok aroma. The chicken is tender. This restaurant is different from others because it uses iceberg lettuce instead of romaine lettuce. Personally, I prefer iceberg lettuce because it stays crisp and doesn't wilt like romaine lettuce. The flavor is well-balanced. They also have chicken noodle soup and many other dishes.

#Foodie #FoodTour
sample_reviews_en.author: M Shayutpong Kiatpimolkul

sample_reviews_en.text: Normally, I order one dry bowl (stir-fried noodles) and one soup bowl (noodle soup) from the owner. The stir-fried noodles have a wonderful wok aroma; the noodles aren't super crispy, but they're chewy and soft. They use skinless chicken breast, which is tender and juicy, so I ended up ordering an extra bowl of soup. The broth is fragrant and sweet; I almost finished the whole bowl. Importantly, the squid is perfectly tender and crunchy. I recommend ordering the soup first, then the dry noodles, if you still have room. I deducted one star because finding parking and a table at lunchtime was difficult (I had to circle around).
sample_reviews_en.author: yingyos akmanachai

sample_reviews_en.text: After being disappointed by the pork blood soup at Suan Mali, and not wanting to go home on an empty stomach, I chose the stir-fried chicken shop closest to the parking lot. I ordered the mixed stir-fried noodles; the noodles were soft and fragrant with a charcoal aroma, and the mixed ingredients were crunchy. The portion wasn't suitable for big eaters. The iced Chinese tea was refreshing. The shop offers both dry and soup versions of the noodles, as well as fried snacks, using eco-friendly seasonings. They stir-fry each dish to order, but the wait wasn't long; the service was quick.
sample_reviews_en.author: AK95DuitBetter

sample_reviews_en.text:
Jae Tip's Jasmine Rice Noodles
This visit was a trip down memory lane.
The owner said it hasn't changed; it's incredibly delicious, on a whole other level... The flavor is amazing in every dimension. The noodles are fragrant, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. The chicken is tender, flavorful, and the squid is crunchy.
It's delicious with just the right amount of spiciness... unless you like it saltier, then you can add more. Impressive.
Besides the rice noodles, they also have chicken noodle soup. Ordering the soup without noodles to go with it is a perfect combination.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanajak Chettapornpet

sample_reviews_en.text:
The stir-fried chicken at Auntie Tip's in the Suan Mali area is second to none. I've been eating there for almost 20 years 👍 The cooking skills are truly exceptional.
The charm lies in the charcoal stove ♨️, which prevents the gas smell from mixing into the dish like at other shops.
Before, they only had stir-fried chicken, but now they've added pork 🐷 and seafood 🐙🦐 to choose from.
If you find the dry stir-fried chicken delicious, I recommend trying a bowl of the noodle soup version as well. Guaranteed you won't be disappointed...
The price and taste are well worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pataraphong Sanguansakdi

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is famous for its stir-fried chicken noodles, but personally, I prefer their noodle soup more 😁 because it's delicious. I like the clear broth; it's flavorful, fragrant, and they offer several noodle options like thin rice noodles or egg noodles. Another dish I love and would recommend trying is the chicken rice with a fried egg. Just add a little soy sauce, and it's incredibly delicious! 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Niccy nan

restaurants.name: Pungdet (Banthat Thong)
restaurants.address:

1604 Banthat Thong Rd, Rong Mueang, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
If you’re around Banthat Thong and craving something sweet, Pungdet (Banthat Thong) ปังเด็ด (บรรทัดทอง) is a great stop. Their toast is crispy on the outside, soft and fluffy inside, and perfectly paired with rich butter and sweet toppings. The aroma of freshly toasted bread alone is irresistible.

Simple menu but done really well – perfect for a late-night dessert or a quick sweet treat while exploring Banthat Thong’s food street. Cozy vibe and definitely worth trying!
sample_reviews_th.author: Lau Guan Zhen (Sean)

sample_reviews_en.text: The lava buns are very famous. We came here for a snack after lunch. There was no queue. We ordered Thai, pandan, and Hokkaido milk buns. We went to the air-conditioned seats next door and the food came quickly. The bread was very fragrant and the filling was inside. We all thought the taste was just average. It was a good place to try something new. If there are many people, you don't need to queue up.
sample_reviews_en.author: SI TING

sample_reviews_en.text:
🇹🇭 Bangkok, Thailand Recommendation ✨ Snack Buns

😋 Located near Chulalongkorn University

🤩 Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, with a variety of fillings to choose from

🥹 Choose your flavor first, then pay; made to order

🤤 The staff grills the buns over charcoal and adds more filling

💲 THB25 Pandan Flavor Buns
sample_reviews_en.author: Foodie_kikiu

sample_reviews_en.text: After ordering, there are indoor tables next door with air conditioning and hot water available. I came here because of a popular online influencer's recommendation, but the taste was just average, nothing particularly amazing, and I was disappointed. You don't really need to make a special trip here. 😏 …
sample_reviews_en.author: 陳嘉欣

sample_reviews_en.text: Order at the counter on the right and wait for your number to be called at the grill on the left. There seemed to be a lot of people waiting, but don't worry, the food came out very quickly. This time I ordered the "Pandan Pudding," which was a bit sinful but really delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tseng Kenie (雷姆踩點筆記)

sample_reviews_en.text: Picked a random item while walking by, and later realized it’s a fairly popular shop. Tried the Thai milk tea flavor, the sauce wasn’t too sweet, and the portion was generous. Finished it within 10 minutes and it tasted great. Would love to try other flavors next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fionaa_沁沁

sample_reviews_en.text: The toast was wonderfully fragrant, with a rich buttery aroma and a crispy texture. The ham and cheese combination was perfectly balanced, making it a standout item on the menu. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a simple yet satisfying treat. 😋🍞🧀 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Lim

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered pandan and Thai tea flavors, but the taste was so weak it was like they'd been diluted with water. It was so faint there was hardly any flavor at all. The bread was crispy and delicious, so it would probably be tasty if the cream were improved.
sample_reviews_en.author: jr somtam

restaurants.name: วราภรณ์ ซาลาเปา นางเลิ้ง
restaurants.address:

นางเลิ้ง 594 Nakhon Sawan Rd, Si Yaek Maha Nak, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Whether you want to dine in or order takeout, this is a great place!
Waraporn Steamed Buns, Nang Loeng Branch

We only recently discovered, despite driving past it constantly, that
this legendary steamed bun shop with numerous branches
in malls and PTT (with its headquarters)
is located right behind it!

This branch offers a wide variety of items,
including mantou, steamed buns, dumplings,
ha gao, tea, and hot and cold coffee.

Takeout orders are also quick.

The shop is comfortably decorated.
You can visit from morning till evening.
Open daily from 6:00 AM to 7:00 PM.

There are approximately 30 seats (4 tables).

Whether you want to dine in or order takeout,
you can park in Soi Phitsanulok 9
(connecting to Soi Nakhon Sawan 16)
in front of the Waraporn headquarters office.

If you come by motorcycle, you can park
in front of the shop and wait comfortably.

You can add their Line account to order in advance
and register for membership at the shop beforehand.

This branch is "five stars"!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bally Jirakorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the original branch. I really like coming to this branch. They have some menu items that other branches don't have, like iced coffee.
And I feel that the fried mantou with butter and condensed milk is much better at this branch than at other branches.
The atmosphere is comfortable, the staff are friendly, and it's not crowded. However, finding parking can be difficult.
📍 Location: It's located on the main road, with a sign in front of the shop, Soi Nakhon Sawan 16.
sample_reviews_en.author: Keng

sample_reviews_en.text: As a fast-food restaurant, it has an English menu, but not many, and communication with the staff is quite difficult. There's a sign saying they accept Alipay or WeChat, but the staff don't know how to use it and only accept cash. The service is polite and courteous, and the restaurant is clean. The food is average, but acceptable for fast food. However, could they perhaps be a little more tourist-friendly?
sample_reviews_en.author: tien

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been patient for too long, I've endured it continuously. I've informed the shop, but it's never worked. Customers' cars are parked blocking the street entrance every day. Please be considerate of people entering and exiting the street. We can't wait there either; other cars honk at us. We're bothering customers who use the shop's services to find a parking spot that doesn't block the entrance/exit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suthida Euavisalsin

sample_reviews_en.text: "I used to eat it regularly... almost 40 years ago. Back then, I had to call and reserve more than 10 boxes a day in advance to distribute/feed the poor in the community near Ranong Road [on my birthday every year]. I would pick them up the next day at the shop near Nang Loeng... with the owner. And it's still as delicious as ever at the PTT gas station on Sai Mai 56."
sample_reviews_en.author: Jatuporn Sereepunwong

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered from this shop and confirmed the order 2-3 days in advance. I arranged to pick it up at 6 AM via Grab. However, on the scheduled pickup day, I couldn't contact the shop. This wasted a lot of time and caused a delay in delivery. The shop needs to urgently improve its phone answering system!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jarvis

sample_reviews_en.text: I was running errands in the area and stopped by for breakfast. It opens early, which is good, but if you don't like sweet drinks, I recommend letting the staff know. All the staff were very helpful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paninee Srikesorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had bbq pork and Buk Gu Tae as side dishes. Food was underwhelming - the flavor is leaning toward sugary profile + small portion. Buk Gu Tae was bland.

Stick to their buns.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pasin Humbert

restaurants.name: Jae-Rose Moo-krata , Bang Son
restaurants.address:

95, 20 ถ. กรุงเทพ - นนทบุรี Wong Sawang, Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. We arrived at 9:40 PM and asked if we could sit and eat, and they said yes. So we decided to order food and sat until 10:30 PM. We understood and ate quickly, and were told to order more, which was fine. However, at 10:28 PM, they rushed us to leave, even though it wasn't our usual time. A little lateness would have been okay. Their attitude was rude from the moment we entered the restaurant, even before we'd finished eating. If you're going to work in customer service, you should have more manners. We eat here often, but this is the first time we've been this disappointed with this employee. This employee needs to be reprimanded or improved.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kate Kate

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes good. The sauce is delicious.

But I wish the staff would have been more clear about the promotions. This is disappointing.

The staff initially informed me that there was a promotion today, where orders totaling 800 baht were food only, not including drinks, and I got a free bottle of Pepsi. I initially ordered a large set for 500 baht, and after a while, I ordered a set for 300 baht. I asked the staff if I could get a Pepsi since I had already reached 800 baht. However, they told me no, as I hadn't ordered the full 800 baht the first time.

They didn't tell me that I had to order the full amount the first time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Quinn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted good, the dipping sauce was spicy, and the heat was intense.

However, the service from the staff was terrible. They had grumpy faces, like they were forced to work. They ignored my requests for additional food and wouldn't add any items to my order. Actually, I shouldn't have even bothered asking; it would have prevented them from increasing sales for a restaurant with such poor service.

They didn't even provide plates and didn't speak to the customers at all.
I recommend going to a restaurant with better service.
It ruined my meal and made me lose my appetite.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimsujee W.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is very spacious and well-ventilated.
I like that it's not crowded.
If you're looking for a BBQ pork restaurant for lunch, I highly recommend Ja Oo. Having BBQ pork for lunch is great 😊
Price: 300/500 baht per set

The restaurant is located under the expressway / next to the train tracks / with a BTS station above.
Parking: Free parking under the expressway.
Restroom: 3 baht coin-operated restroom under the expressway.
sample_reviews_en.author: นรินทร์ NARIN

sample_reviews_en.text: The 300 baht set meal is enough for two people. It's easy to get to in Bang Son and has plenty of parking. The dipping sauce is delicious. They also have other dishes you can order, so I tried the papaya salad. And OMG! 🫶🏻 10/10! It was so delicious, just like homemade. I loved it! Even the mild version was still a bit spicy, haha. But overall, it was great!
sample_reviews_en.author: MMAY20

sample_reviews_en.text: This BBQ pork restaurant exceeded my expectations! I'm giving it full marks because the dipping sauce is absolutely amazing! It's incredibly flavorful, with a perfect balance of sour, sweet, salty, and spicy. It tastes great with everything, but it's especially delicious with hot, grilled pork belly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mo Rith

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my number one favorite BBQ pork restaurant. The dipping sauce is the best – fragrant and fresh. The pork is high quality, the price is reasonable, and the staff are friendly and always smiling. Many of them have worked here for so long that I recognize their faces.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Annihilator

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! The dipping sauce is amazing. There's plenty of parking. The high ceiling and lots of fans keep it from getting too hot. I really like that you can refill the dipping sauce yourself. I ordered the large set, all pork belly; just let the staff know.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cm MSR

restaurants.name: Gyeongbokgung
restaurants.address:

เขตวั ฒนา, ตึกสุขุมวิท สวีท Soi Sukhumvit 13, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Great place for a massage and not overpriced like the rest of sukhunvit 11."

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my go-to place whenever I crave Korean food.
The side dishes change every time, but they're always delicious. This time, they had mustard kimchi, and it was amazing! The pajeon (green onion pancake), gamjatang (spicy gamja stew), and dongtaetang (spicy pollack stew) were delicious, as were the egg soup, naengmyeon (cold noodles), and ssambap (rice wrap). The bibimbap was also delicious, and the boiled pork was absolutely delicious. Since other people have already reviewed the sashimi, I'll skip it. Of course, the sashimi is the real deal. The owner and manager are really nice. They're like my aunts.
The bathroom is at the end of the hallway, and it's clean. Parking is available, and I think it was free for two hours. There are motorbike drivers right in front, so it's easy to get around. I think it was 20 baht to Nana Station.
I've always gone there and inhaled it, so the photos are a bit odd, but... highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: June

sample_reviews_en.text:
On the 20th day of our trip to Thailand,
my husband and I, both in our 70s, were craving Korean food
and searching for a place to eat,
when "Dagumbari" raw fish caught our eye.

I remember 20 years ago,
we had raw fish at a Japanese restaurant near Yasok Station,
and it was really bland.

But,
this time??
We ordered 1 kg (1,600 baht),
and it was delicious, filling, and served with side dishes, sujebi (handmade noodles), and spicy fish stew.
(We couldn't finish the spicy fish stew, so we wrapped it in plastic and took it home.
We quietly ate it at the hotel the next day.)

And the kindness of the owner, who is from Busan, and the hospitality of the local staff made our day
even more enjoyable.

We'll definitely go there next time we're in Bangkok! ~^^
sample_reviews_en.author: 천봉조

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place deserves even one star.
I suffered acute food poisoning after eating raw fish and was discharged after receiving two IV drips. Immediately after eating, I experienced vomiting, diarrhea, chills, abdominal pain, and cramps. Everyone I ate with also suffered the same symptoms and went to the hospital. I didn't eat any other food with it, and since it was dinner, I didn't eat anything else afterward.
They didn't even apologize, saying they hadn't experienced this in 10 years.
Some reviews say it's delicious, but be careful. If you get Thai food poisoning, you'll know what it's like to be on the verge of death. Never eat here. It's a real struggle. Suffering from COVID-19 is nothing.
sample_reviews_en.author: 이미자

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. Taste
The best Korean restaurant I found in Bangkok
A Korean restaurant in Bangkok that's even tastier than a Korean restaurant
A Korean restaurant so delicious it's laughable

2. Side Dishes
The side dishes include kimchi, mustard green kimchi, monkfish, raw fish, raw fish salad, steamed egg, kimchi pancake, and more. Every side dish is a slap in the face to the black and white chef.

The side dishes are so delicious that the dageumbari is overshadowed by the dageumbari.

Ordering the dageumbari includes porridge, side dishes, and spicy fish stew.

3. Atmosphere
We went at 7 p.m. on a Friday
and it was quiet, which allowed us to enjoy a quiet meal.

I can see why people rave about it.
sample_reviews_en.author: 김자유

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered and ate raw grouper yesterday and got acute food poisoning.

Symptoms appeared rapidly about an hour after eating.

I was in pain all night and was in so much pain until this morning that I am currently receiving an IV drip at the emergency hospital.

Everyone who ate with me is experiencing the same symptoms.

The restaurant's hygiene seems poor.

Please be careful.

There is no solution if you get sick in a foreign country.

I wasn't expecting much, but

They said they would treat me well if I came back next time,

Putting the money aside, they didn't even apologize properly.

After getting this sick, I never want to go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dh

sample_reviews_en.text:
I wanted to try Korean-style sashimi, so after doing some research, I visited this restaurant based on a recommendation from a Korean acquaintance.

I wanted to try Korean sashimi because it's made with live fish that are caught on the spot, resulting in firm flesh and a fresher taste.

However, it seems this restaurant doesn't serve live fish. I think they serve thawed frozen fish.

To be honest, the sashimi was terrible.

However, the hot pot and kimchi pancakes were delicious.

It might be a good place to eat dishes other than sashimi, but I wouldn't recommend the sashimi.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sweet Yakuza

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was the best restaurant I visited during my trip to Thailand.

I had a meal with my son's friend, whom I had wanted to meet, based on a recommendation from my son who lives in Thailand. We ordered the expensive yet delicious grouper sashimi for 1.5k baht, and it came with sesame porridge, pancakes, a generous portion of steamed egg, and even a soup at the end.

The four of us enjoyed a delicious meal.

The bill came to 3,300 baht, including two bottles of soju and two beers.
sample_reviews_en.author: 최현희

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant building is so scary. It's so empty and desolate... This restaurant would be a hit if they just moved its location. Don't go to the Koreatown restaurant, go to the Korean restaurant nearby~~~ It's cleaner and tastes better!!!! I only ate raw fish, but this was my first time ordering bossam, and it was delicious wrapped in seasoned oysters. Also, the raw fish packaging is really neat and well-made. Please don't change~~~
sample_reviews_en.author: JJ

restaurants.name: Rosa Maria’s Pizzeria & Ristorante
restaurants.address:

Market, 6 Murnggaow 4 Alley, Bang Kaeo, Bang Phli District, Samut Prakan 10540, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pizza crust and focaccia here are truly the highlight. They are delicious and of a very high standard. However, the other menu items are a bit ordinary in taste, and considering the relatively high price, it feels a little overpriced. I would recommend it for the bakery/dough items, but the other dishes could use more refinement to match the price tag for a truly perfect meal.

The pizza crust and focaccia are genuinely impressive—well-crafted and delicious. That said, the rest of the menu felt underwhelming and fell slightly short of the standard I expected for these prices. It felt a bit overpriced for the overall experience. I’d recommend it for the bakery/dough items, but the other dishes could use more refinement to match the price tag.
sample_reviews_en.author: P. K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was quite a coincidence. I was planning to eat noodles but ended up having pizza. The restaurant looked appealing, and they had a pizza oven, so I decided to try their Italian pizza. I ordered a 14-inch Italian pizza, which is only available in one size. Half of it was Hawaiian, and the other half was a special pizza (haha, I can't remember the name). We also had mushroom soup to tide us over, which was delicious.
There's parking inside, but it's hard to find, so we parked along the side of the road. The large pizza, cut into 8 slices, cost 480 baht, so the total came to 600-700 baht.
What can I do? I really wanted to eat it! Feel free to visit sometime.
sample_reviews_en.author: Art C

sample_reviews_en.text: If Rosa Maria has ten fans, I am one of them; if Rosa Maria has 1 fan, I am one of them; if Rosa Maria has no fans, I have been killed. Rosa Maria is my favorite Italian restaurant that rivals Italian restaurants all over the world, including Thailand's high-end restaurants, and they sell it at a cheap price (relatively, albeit being in the States has made me tone deaf to Thai prices). If anybody has any issues with this restaurant, I will personally find them and convince them in a civilized manner to take down their bad reviews. Rosa Maria is love, Rosa Maria is life.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pokin Wongprasobchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very yummy authentic Italian food. Yum yum in my tum. Nutella pizza and I violated Italy by dipping the crust in basalmic vinegar and olive oil and it tasted good still.... The bread was a good texture and chewy and the pasta was nicely spiced..... Don't have any pictures this time but it was pretty good. Went with family and was a good atmosphere! The staff were so friendly! Even gave some freebies... The vegetables are even farm to table!! No pesticides.. Hope you yes YOU will come here and enjoy this wonderful italian place 😋🔥

"Top ten eats" -my cousin
sample_reviews_en.author: Lunar-Opposite

sample_reviews_en.text: Great little pizza and pasta restaurant.  The service was very friendly and they took great care of us.  The restaurant is very bright and clean.  The burrata salad was very good, and we really enjoyed the balsamic dressing.  But the star of the meal was the great crust on the pizza which was light and crunchy with just the right amount of chew.  Some other restaurants have a very soggy crust, but not here!  So excited they will open a new branch next to Index at the Eastery on Bangna Trad!
sample_reviews_en.author: Milo Cho

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was quite disappointed with this restaurant. I had read many positive reviews beforehand, so I came in with high expectations for the food.
However, everything turned out to be quite average.
The pizza was just okay, and the lasagna was rather disappointing.
The only dishes I truly enjoyed were the grilled seafood (which is expected, as it’s simply grilled) and the tiramisu.
Considering the price, I believe there are better options elsewhere for pizza.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khaotok Pradchayawee

sample_reviews_en.text:
At first, I was surprised by the high prices, thinking the location didn't justify the cost.
But once the food arrived, the portions weren't small, and after tasting it, I understood. It was definitely worth the price. Everything was delicious – the salad, pizza, and seafood were all great. I loved it!
The ice cream was also interesting, with a Hazelnut flavor that's hard to find in Thailand, and a white Lemon flavor that was perfectly sour.
sample_reviews_en.author: b_chrys

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the best Italian restaurant I've ever been to. I've personally eaten at many great restaurants in the US and Australia, but none were as good as this one. Anyone who goes there will know the ingredients are top-notch, and the chef puts a lot of care and attention into the cooking. The pizzas are surprisingly huge, and the price is very reasonable. There's also parking available in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: A Google User

restaurants.name: นายหน่องข้าวต้มปลา สาขาพระรามสี่-สามย่าน
restaurants.address:

1347,1349 Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
My friend from Bangkok brought me here, saying it's a seafood restaurant frequented by locals.

Tom Yum Goong: It contains fish, shrimp, clams, and squid (I think). Since I only eat fish, she ordered the fish-only version for me 😂. The broth was salty, sour, and sweet—I loved it! The spiciness can be adjusted; mild is just right.
Fish Dumplings: This is my favorite! Very chewy and completely without any fishy taste; the meat is very fresh and sweet.
Stir-fried Sea Bass: The fish seemed to have been fried before being stir-fried, served with mushrooms and greens.
Stir-fried Greens: I couldn't quite identify the vegetables, but it was delicious… Every dish was really delicious. Remember to add some white rice! The restaurant provides each person with a small dish of seafood dipping sauce (green), which is extremely spicy, so please consume with caution.
sample_reviews_en.author: CL

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there during Songkran. It was very busy. There was only half a plate of grouper left, so I ordered it along with some other fish, both boiled and served with dipping sauce. Both were delicious. The fish head soup had firm, chewy meat from the cheeks, chin, and the gelatinous tissue. For the best experience, order the hot pot to enjoy the broth. The squid in black sauce was thick and bouncy, the salty black sauce providing a nice contrast.

The staff and kitchen weren't quite coordinated yet; the food took a while to arrive. Every table was full, and they couldn't keep up. It might have been because of Songkran. I'd bring my family back next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: อภิชัย เหล่าสกุลชัย

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fish is very fresh. The tom yum soup with grouper head and eggs is clear broth, ordered in a hot pot.
And the taro and fish head hot pot is a must-try, it's really delicious.
Another dish I order every time is the boiled fish dumplings with dipping sauce – incredibly tasty.
The seafood curry stir-fry... comes in large chunks, the flavor is delicious, and it's not greasy at all.
Parking is on the street, but be careful.
There's an air-conditioned room and an upstairs area as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: NITAYA SILPSRIKUL

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're craving a comforting bowl of Thai fish porridge, this place is worth a visit. There are plenty of fresh fish options to choose from, including grouper, Spanish mackerel, marbled goby, and sea bass, so you can pick your favorite. The fish is fresh, the porridge is light yet flavorful, and it's perfect for any meal. Don't forget to end your meal with the famous Wat Jet lod chong dessert—it's a refreshing and delicious finish
sample_reviews_en.author: Minky Somtong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious! The flavors are bold and satisfying, especially for those who like strong tastes. The fish was incredibly fresh, making every dish I ordered excellent and truly high-quality.
Overall, it's totally worth the price, considering the taste, ingredients, and freshness of the fish. This is a restaurant where you'll feel like you're getting great value and I'll definitely come back!!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ruby P

sample_reviews_en.text: The whole restaurant smelled strongly of durian. I was so confused; it's a rice porridge shop, but it smelled like durian. The female employee didn't apologize, was impolite, and didn't even repeat the order after me. When I complained about the strong durian smell, she still didn't apologize and didn't seem to know how to handle it. She just looked unwilling to help.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirinya Piyarat

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant serves fish porridge and various seafood dishes from Rayong.
Today I ordered grouper and sea bass fish porridge. The fish was fresh, the pieces were large, and the taste was good.
You can park in the parking lot in the alley past the restaurant and get your parking ticket stamped for 1 hour of free parking, or you can park on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayavat Chareonraj

sample_reviews_en.text: I was extremely unimpressed with the service. The food was served incorrectly. They tried to correct it the first time, but the same problem persisted. They gave us a second chance, but the same issue remained. It wasn't until the fourth attempt that we finally got our food. My first experience here was unforgettable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Food Mania

restaurants.name: เหลียงโก๋ โภชนา
restaurants.address:

168 พระราม 2 ซ. 48, Samae Dam, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Brought my family to this Chinese restaurant. All the food was delicious, with authentic Teochew flavors.
The sizzling oyster omelet was fantastic.
The oysters were large.
The braised fish maw in red sauce was rich and flavorful.
The drunken chicken was delicious, Chinese style.
The chicken noodles were tasty.
And the sesame oil jellyfish was delicious.
Enjoying it with hot chrysanthemum tea in the Chinese-style restaurant atmosphere was wonderful.
It brought back childhood memories.
The staff were friendly and cheerful, constantly refilling our water.
We'll definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนภัทร อรรฆยเวที

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located in an alley and has its own parking space. The service is warm and friendly, and the atmosphere is great. It serves authentic Chaozhou cuisine and is suitable for small and large families. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: 張韶庭

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and very easy to eat. I'm not usually into Chinese food, but this restaurant did a great job. It wasn't crowded at all, not chaotic, and the price was reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boonchu Weeraphiphat

sample_reviews_en.text: This hidden Chinese restaurant near my house is incredibly delicious. I highly recommend it. They have a wide variety of dishes, including individual servings.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratanon Prateepthong

sample_reviews_en.text: The service staff were excellent, attentive, and very polite. The food was reasonably priced, and they had set menus available, which was great value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paweenthorn Thienwiroj

sample_reviews_en.text: The sea cucumber is delicious, the restaurant is air-conditioned and comfortable, and the monk fruit drink isn't too sweet and has a nice aroma.
sample_reviews_en.author: นทีทิพย์ ดิเรกฤทธิกุล

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located in a side street, not far in. There's parking available. The food doesn't take long to arrive and tastes good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peeriya Mannontarat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious and flavorful, and the prices weren't as expensive as I thought.
It's a shame there wasn't much parking space.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirinya Amor

restaurants.name: Alby & Micky - Ristorante Italiano
restaurants.address:

111, 288 Soi Buakhao, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have been thinking of going here for some time now and finally got round to it. I was looking forward to it but was disappointed.

Starter chicken wings, off the Thai menu were nice enough.

We both had the ssne main ciurse of fresh pasta parcels, I found the pasta to be a bit thick and chewy and the meat filling bland, possibly under seasoned. The herb foccacia was just a pizza base with dried herbs sprinkled on. Fairly tasteless.

Staff were pleasant but not attentive, got the order wrong. My gf meal was not delivered and we had to order again.

I saw a few pizzas come out which looked very nice, one customer complimented the chef. I wish I had ordered pizza now.

Prices are reasonable and there is Thai food available.

Based on my first experience I will probably stick to my usual Italian restaurant.

A real shame, I was looking forward to going.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chrisp3008

sample_reviews_en.text: everything was ok, but unremarkable. just another decent pizza and pasta place, if in the neighborhood and hungry for standard italian fare, this place might satisfy. but if you are a tourist and looking for something special, this may not be the answer. I had the ham and mushroom pizza, now i’m not sure why but i noticed that brits really love canned mushrooms, even in breakfast. and i find them here on this pizza for some reason. Not gonna try to analyze why, i don’t have any cultural objections but my korean american palette finds that bit strange. to be honest i would give 3 stars for the pizza but i should really come back to try the pasta, my neighbors carbonara looked mighty good tbh. so i’ll give them the benefit of doubt that i ordered the wrong item for a fair review… that happens folks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay Koh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Alby & Micky, a beloved Italian restaurant in Pattaya, offers a taste of authentic Italian cuisine in a charming setting. With its warm ambiance, friendly staff, and delectable dishes, it's no wonder this restaurant has become a favorite among locals and tourists alike.
From classic pizzas and pastas to flavorful seafood specialties, the menu at Alby & Micky caters to a variety of tastes. The restaurant's commitment to using fresh, high-quality ingredients ensures that every dish is bursting with flavor. Whether you're craving a hearty meal or a light lunch, you're sure to find something to satisfy your appetite.
Beyond the food, Alby & Micky is also known for its extensive wine list and expertly crafted cocktails. The perfect place to unwind and enjoy a delicious meal with friends and family.
sample_reviews_en.author: José Jose

sample_reviews_en.text: The pasta here is simple awesome. The hand made pasta was what i had first and it did not disappoint. Hand made pasta with spicy sausage and tomato was rich and creamy. Pasta was cooked to perfection. The next day I went back to try the pizza. Thin crust, slightly charred to light brown colour, good sauce and so light. On the third time, i had prawn pasta and it was really good as well. Slightly heavy on the oil, but still very tasty. If you want a change of pace from Thai food, go and see for yourself.
sample_reviews_en.author: Biohazard

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was getting tired of the slack service and poor food in the Soi Buakhao area, so went searching for something better.

I was really surprised to find what I wanted actually on Soi Buakhao itself, towards the Pattaya South end.  It's 'Alby & Micky - Ristorante Italiano' and the restaurant was cool, quiet and spotlessly clean.  Staff were most helpful and friendly.

I opted for a simple pizza and it was excellent.  I would most certainly eat here again.

There is dining inside and outside.
sample_reviews_en.author: chiangmaicharlies

sample_reviews_en.text: Everyone has different tastes. Unfortunately, the pizza wasn't to my liking at all. The sauce was a bit too sweet for me, and the dough was too thick. Although there was a fair amount of topping, it was still far too dry. Incidentally, these cheap, stamped metal forks aren't suitable for eating pizza because they're very blunt and you can't easily pierce a folded slice. The fork bends immediately. Why does Coke Zero cost more than regular Coke? The pizza was very inexpensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Henning F. (Henning)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant appears to be cozy, and when we dined there, it was close to closing time; I guess, no one informed us, but the waitress began turning off the air conditioner and some of the lights while we were just beginning our meal, feeling rushed... I'm not particularly impressed.
We ordered two types of pasta, one of which was decent and the other not so much.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rimin R

sample_reviews_en.text:
Spicy pasta. This isn't Italian cuisine, it's Thai spicy spaghetti. How can I take the heat out of it? If I want it spicy, I can add black pepper, which is on the table. But you've made it spicy by default. How can I even taste the spaghetti? Do you even have a clue about Italian cuisine? How can you ruin ordinary spaghetti? How???
"Italian Restaurant" 🤦🏻🤦🏻🤦🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: anushavan28 минасян

restaurants.name: Gian's Italian Restaurant
restaurants.address:

306 Chateau Dale Plaza 89 Thap Phraya 12, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: There were three of us. I ordered a pizza, thinking that since it was an Italian restaurant, it would be freshly prepared. Instead, I received a frozen pizza from Makro, the kind you can find in the freezer section of any supermarket. The menu listed freshly squeezed drinks, so naturally I ordered a pineapple juice, but I got a standard 7-Eleven long-life carton of juice. I think it's a shame that such a nicely decorated restaurant offers such cheap drinks on its menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Martin Moser

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came on a relaxing Monday evening, not crowded.
A great place to sit for a long time, both the decor and the temperature.
The staff were polite and very helpful.
The food was delicious and reasonably priced.
Some of the dishes I intended to order were no longer available, but the staff offered good alternatives.
Parking is available next to the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakkad Kaew

sample_reviews_en.text:
Upscale restaurant in Jomtien. Great place if you have money to spurge.

Positives:
Tasty food
Good quality food
Attentive service
Nice decor and environment
Easy parking

Negatives:
Expect to pay above the average in Jomtien
Food was delivered a little bit slower than we would have desired, specially considering there were not many customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: J Hern

sample_reviews_en.text:
What a delightful surprise this restaurant was!
It was a real pleasure to spend such a wonderful time in an Italian atmosphere.
The staff were very attentive, offered great advice, and above all, the food was extraordinary.
From the main course to dessert, everything was perfect.
I highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: CHRISTOPHE LEHERON

sample_reviews_en.text: The best in Pattaya! The veal with tuna sauce is a must-try... and the porcini ravioli with truffles, +++... the pizza is also one of the best... top quality with top ingredients! The welcome, service, and wine selection are 5 stars!
sample_reviews_en.author: Enrico EE

sample_reviews_en.text: Beautiful place, super efficient and knowledgeable staff. Excellent food quality. Prices are a bit high for Thailand and for the quantity of food on the plates. Still, it's excellent, at least once if you're in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Irina C.

sample_reviews_en.text: Another great dinner here. A much needed place in Pattaya. Great food, excellent service, and a generous owner. For a high end dining experience, this restaurant should be on your short list.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brad

sample_reviews_en.text: Elegant italian place owned by Mr. Guido who's such a great person and gentlemen. Highly recommend for date night, business dinner and for great food and wines.
sample_reviews_en.author: Matteo Bkk

restaurants.name: Kumpoon - Central Rama 9
restaurants.address:

ศูนย์การค้าเซ็นทรัลพระราม 9 ชั้น B ห้องเลขที่ B05-B05C,B06-B06C, Rama IX Rd, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10320, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kum Poon is one of our favorite restaurants in Bangkok, and we find ourselves coming back again and again whenever we crave  Isarn (north-eastern) cuisine.

The food is consistently delicious and full of bold flavors. The som tam (papaya salad) is always fresh, spicy (we can tell them to adjust the level of spiciness) , and well balanced. The grilled chicken is tender, juicy, and pairs wonderfully with the crispy fried sticky rice, making it one of our favorite combinations. Every other dish we have tried has been equally flavorful and satisfying.

The restaurant is quite popular and can get busy during lunchtime. To enjoy a more relaxed dining experience, we usually visit just before or after the lunch rush.

Kum Poon is an decent choice for anyone looking to enjoy well-quality Isaan food in Bangkok. With its consistently delicious dishes and welcoming atmosphere, it is a restaurant we highly recommend and will continue to visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutharin Phusitphoykai
