sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered about 3 dishes: papaya salad, ant egg omelet, and grilled sticky rice. The food didn't take long to arrive, about 5-10 minutes. The papaya salad was quite good. The ant egg omelet was very oily. The grilled sticky rice was a disappointment; it was mixed with coconut milk and very bland. I personally didn't like it. The staff weren't very attentive to customers (in case customers called for help or needed anything). When paying, I went to the counter myself (the staff didn't even look at me). I paid by scanning a QR code. The staff were busy chatting on their phone, leaving me standing there waiting for my bill. No matter how urgent the phone call was, they should have finished processing my payment first. It shouldn't have taken more than 2 minutes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Winston B

sample_reviews_en.text: The papaya salad is super spicy and the portion is huge! They have a wide variety of dishes starting at 100 baht. It's great for groups so you can try many different things. My absolute favorite is the sun-dried pork with roasted chili peppers – it's incredibly delicious and satisfying! Highly recommended! Another secret menu item is the fried mushrooms 🍄‍🟫 – they look ordinary but are surprisingly tasty and addictive. Overall, 10/10.
sample_reviews_en.author: Napasorn Sirichart

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the atmosphere was great. The staff were very polite and provided excellent service. The food arrived quickly and in quick succession. You can choose the spiciness level of the dishes. The staff were attentive, constantly checking to make sure we had received all our food. It wasn't crowded on the weekend, so there was no need to wait in line. I was very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyanan V

sample_reviews_en.text:
A nice Isan restaurant with very warm and friendly service. The staff made us feel welcome, and the overall experience was enjoyable.
The highlights for us were definitely the corn salad and the spicy pork rib soup— both were flavorful and really stood out. A great spot if you’re craving tasty Isan food with a warm atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: I Max

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kumpoon Restaurant is a popular modern Isaan (Northeastern Thai) restaurant known for its spicy, flavorful, and authentic Isaan cuisine. They emphasize using high-quality, clean, and safe ingredients. Most of their branches are located in major shopping malls, making them easily accessible.

The taste is generally moderate.
sample_reviews_en.author: pornthep sen

sample_reviews_en.text: Decided to try this place for lunch. I wanted to order a chicken (half or whole - don't remember) but the waiter told me it would be too much and recommended the dish in the picture.... let's just say I wouldn't listen to their advice …
sample_reviews_en.author: L

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a somtum (papaya salad) restaurant in a mall that really delivers on its word. It's spicy and flavorful. My go-to dishes are grilled beef tongue, somtum with fermented fish sauce, and grilled Northeastern Thai sausage.
sample_reviews_en.author: paloy palaloy

restaurants.name: Earw Thai Nawamin60
restaurants.address:

Nawamin Rd, Nawamin, Bueng Kum, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The traditional sukiyaki has a rich, authentic flavor, and the soy sauce dipping sauce is fragrant and well-balanced. The ingredients are fresh. Other dishes are also well-prepared, such as Peking duck, pineapple fried rice, stir-fried noodles with water spinach, sesame oil jellyfish, and taro dessert – all delicious and suitable for the whole family.
The restaurant has a spacious and comfortable atmosphere, perfect for groups or families.
The staff provides polite and efficient service.

sample_reviews_en.author: นาย กาแฟ

sample_reviews_en.text: The Chinese food tastes pretty good. I was impressed on my first visit and had to come back. There's a wide variety of dishes to choose from. However, I have a complaint about the hot pot. It's only sold as a set; you can't order extra beef or pork. So I just ate one set and didn't want to order more. The dipping sauces were delicious, but the soup felt strange and unfamiliar to my taste. On my second visit, there were two flies buzzing around, which was slightly annoying while I ate. I hope they improve on this. The staff provided good service, which I'd like to commend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eiffel

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried this restaurant for the first time because I saw it was an à la carte buffet. They use tender marinated pork (similar to the tender marinated pork used in Rad Na). All the pork dishes use this tender pork.

This left me feeling rather underwhelmed (personally, I don't really like this type of marinated pork). As for the dipping sauces (all three of us agreed), they were bland, like a tofu-based sauce – not salty, not sweet, not sour 😅😅 I think this style might not be for me.

I'll try another branch with an à la carte menu next time to give it a try 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: pat siamtravel

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been eating here since their original location on Phetchaburi New Road, back when Ruen Phet Sukiyaki didn't exist yet.
What makes this place good and original is their traditional sukiyaki, pre-cooked with all the ingredients and eggs, and their Genghis Khan grilled meat, which used to be eaten during the winter because they used a charcoal grill.
Nowadays, they've added fried spring rolls and crab claws, and occasionally they order Peking duck. And the must-have savory dish for the end of the meal is their Rad Na (Thai noodle dish).
sample_reviews_en.author: ตะนาว 419

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a traditional sukiyaki restaurant with a good menu.
The food is delicious and has a unique style.
The sauce is rich and flavorful, not spicy.
The meat is generously portioned: large pork and squid.
The clay pot rice is well-balanced.
The cabbage with fish sauce and sweet sauce is delicious.
The jellyfish salad is rich and sweet.
The morning glory noodles are a bit dry and pale, but delicious.
The Chinese sashimi, Hue Sae, has a unique sweet sauce.
The prices are restaurant-level.
Parking is adequate.
sample_reviews_en.author: NATT SK

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a very comprehensive Chinese restaurant, offering dishes like roasted suckling pig, Peking duck, oyster omelet, and crab curry, but their specialties are traditional sukiyaki and Korean BBQ. The prices are quite reasonable, especially the 899 baht set menu which is great value and can feed up to four people. The staff provides decent service, but they aren't particularly helpful unless asked. Parking is convenient right in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Buntoon Ekbundit

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the opportunity to visit Nawamin and Wat Bang Toei. I happened to see a Chinese restaurant right in front of the alley at Wat Bang Toei.
The food is mostly Chinese. The shop is in a shophouse.
It's not very big, but the taste is average.
The ingredients are quite fresh.
The price is quite high.
There's parking in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: สราวุฒิ จินดาประเสริฐ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious Chinese food.
I love the oyster omelet and Hokkien noodles here.
They're delicious, flavorful, and packed with ingredients. I've never been disappointed with the taste, no matter how many times I've eaten here. These are the dishes I order every time I visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bhanuphong Meemaitree

restaurants.name: Took Lae Dee Laksi
restaurants.address:

100 Kamphaeng Phet 6 Rd, Talat Bang Khen, Lak Si, Bangkok 10210, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is one of my go-to late-night eateries. It's affordable and lives up to its name. When I'm hungry late at night and can't decide what to eat, this is one of my first choices. They have a wide variety of dishes, including Thai, Chinese, and Western food, as well as desserts, ice cream, tea, and coffee – everything you need in one place. The prices have increased somewhat compared to before, but they're still considered reasonable given the quality and portion sizes.

They have several signature dishes, but my frequent orders are the Braised Fish with Black Bean Sauce and the American Fried Rice.

Today I ordered the Braised Fish with Black Bean Sauce (106 baht). It was served piping hot, the portion was huge, the fish pieces were thick, and the taste was excellent. I also had a bottle of water (10 baht).

This branch has a spacious area with plenty of seating. The staff are friendly and the food comes out very quickly. If you're hungry late at night, you can definitely stop by here. It's open 24 hours! ^^
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukwan At.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Been eating here pretty often, while most menu are not exactly cheap in price, some dishes are quite delicious with reasonable price like Thai fried rice and stir-fry macaroni. These are always my favorite choices especially after work when I want to eat something quick and tasty.

Thai fried rice only the most delicious when you eat right away at the restaurant, it’s nice and hot also comforting. Stir fry macaroni has always been my childhood’s favorite dish as a Thai person growing up in Thailand. As long as the tomato sauce isn’t too sweet, it will be delicious.

Service is definitely good, chefs are kind, working hard while keeping the open kitchen clean.

I hope the price will remain like this for many more years to come but probably won’t happen.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cafe S

sample_reviews_en.text: Took Lae Dee translation "Good and cheap" which is a pretty accurate reflection of the restaurant. Great service on my visit, forgot to bring my reading glasses and menu print was quite small, staff member must have noticed me holding it away and squinting and promptly gave me a large format illustrated menu which was great. Good selection of Thai and western dishes plus some Japanese curries. Food was reasonable and inexpensive. I did however order a latte yen ( iced milk coffee) and afraid to say it was the worst I'd ever tried. Could hardly taste any coffee and quote sweet. Open 24 hours is very convenient with free parking up to 2 hours.
sample_reviews_en.author: Scott 70

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, with a wide variety of dishes to choose from. Some signature menu items are unique to this restaurant and are definitely worth trying. The restaurant is clean and maintains high international standards of hygiene.

The prices are on the higher side, but the quality of the food and overall dining experience make it worthwhile. Another great advantage is that the restaurant is open 24 hours, making it a convenient choice at any time of the day or night.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuranan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Be conscious what you order. Some items are really good, others less so (new on the menu: caesar salad, pizza). Some items are great value for the money (89 Baht breakfast for example).
One time it was busy and we had to sit at the counter and could observe the kitchen: meticulously clean, the wok is cleaned after each use, the stove is cleaned when there's no immediate order. Impressive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cecil M

sample_reviews_en.text: This comfort food restaurant is open 24 hours. The glass noodle salad was tasty, but the Pad Thai was a bit too sweet and soggy. The desserts were excellent, especially the fried bananas and fried apples 🥰 Overall, both savory and sweet dishes were good. It's a good place for a late-night meal with a wide variety of menu options.
sample_reviews_en.author: bandp's map

sample_reviews_en.text: Only restaurant in the entire world that won't let you change the way the egg is cooked. The English Breakfast says "fried egg" and we asked to change it to scrambled egg. The server who is also the manager! said no, cannot change.  Not even for extra money. Ridiculously bad service for no reason but to be unfriendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: chriskennedy100 Kennedy

sample_reviews_en.text: This is another place I can visit anytime. The flavors are well-balanced, easy to eat, and not too strong. The portions and prices are quite good value. Most importantly, the quality is excellent; it's consistent every time I go. The restaurant is open 24 hours, so I often eat there late at night. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Patt-Saa-ya

restaurants.name: Bangkok'78
restaurants.address:

68 Soi Langsuan, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We came every day for breakfast during our stay. My daughter left a review about the staff and our experience, but I wanted to jump in as well and say that it was fantastic every day - the service, the friendliness and attentiveness of the staff, the food. There was something for everyone from multiple regions of the world. There was not a single day that we struggled to find something to eat. We want to personally thank James and Mary for the spectacular service and taking care of us. We would highly recommend Sindhorn Midtown Vignette Collection’s Bangkok ‘78 to anyone!
sample_reviews_en.author: David Richards

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thank you very much, Chef Shim Youngdae, for the wonderful dishes at Anju and the delicious breakfast. I would also like to express my sincere appreciation for the special mango sticky rice that you thoughtfully prepared just for us.

Thank you for your excellent service, attention to detail, kindness, and friendliness. We truly appreciate the warmth and care shown by both you and your entire team.

Thank you very much for making our experience so memorable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Girasop M.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and flavorful, truly authentic Thai taste, not mildened like Western cuisine.

I recommend the pineapple fried rice – it's packed with ingredients – the soft-shell crab khao soi is also delicious, and the shrimp meatballs are made with real shrimp.

The dining room is large, I think it could even host functions like weddings or product launches. Overall, I love the restaurant; it's beautifully decorated in a Hua Lamphong style.
sample_reviews_en.author: Norah S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hotel service is excellent. I have stayed 5 days since 12th of February. I also want to recommend their breakfast. Food is delicious and rich full choices.

Most important, I would like to thanks Sai is very kind and easygoing. My sister is disabled on wheelchair, she will arrange big space for us.

And also James, he is also very kind and hard to work. Definitely, I will recommend this hotel to people who want to visit Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: 馮文凱

sample_reviews_en.text: The food here is absolutely five-star hotel quality, but at very reasonable prices! Besides local seasonal fruits, local snacks, and various Asian dishes, there are also exquisite Western dishes – a truly satisfying meal! The staff are also very friendly, especially James, who always notices our needs immediately and provides incredibly efficient service! I highly recommend this place to all travelers to Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: YP Lin

sample_reviews_en.text: I wanted a good steak and I got it! Filet perfectly cooked. We also had a yummy stewed pork with century egg , 5 spice and bean paste. The Garden Fizz (Prosecco, elderberry, cucumber, and lemon water) was so refreshing and an explosion of fresh flavors. Finished with Kao Doi and Bluefly teas. The service was 5 star. This great little spot is on the second floor of the Sindhorn Midtown Hotel.
sample_reviews_en.author: John C. Lipes

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ve been coming here for breakfast at least twice a week, and it’s consistently one of my favorite buffet breakfasts. The spread is generous with plenty of variety, but my personal highlights are the noodle soup station and the tofu mushroom miso soup—both are always delicious and comforting. Great selection, quality food, and a pleasant dining experience every visit. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Charlotte J

sample_reviews_en.text:
We have had breakfast every morning of our stay and the staff are extremely helpful and sweet. We want to thank pond, james, nune, tan, and apo for the incredible service every day!

The variety of food is incredible and everything is absolutely delicious. Each of the tram were very attentive, making sure we did not want for anything- it made the breakfast experience wonderful.
sample_reviews_en.author: M Jones

restaurants.name: Bonchon Paseo Kanchanapisek
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 8/15 ศูนย์การค้า เดอะ พาซิโอ พาร์ค ห้องเลขที่ S-004 ชั้น 1, Kanchanaphisek Rd, Sala Thammasop, Thawi Watthana, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I was running errands at the bank in Paseo and decided to try this restaurant. I ordered two dishes: Pork Basil Fried Rice (฿105) and T-bone Steak with Homemade Sausage (฿375). Prices exclude VAT, but there's no service charge 👍

The Pork Basil Fried Rice used soft and sticky riceberry, which was delicious. The basil stir-fry was rich and flavorful. It came with a large pile of salad, typical of O'Gaju restaurants. Compared to a street-side basil fried rice for ฿40, this ฿105 dish was excellent value.

The T-bone Steak, served with homemade sausage and mashed potatoes as a side dish, was a pork T-bone steak, similar in texture to a pork chop. It was topped with a rich larb sauce, freshly roasted rice, crunchy and fragrant. The homemade sausage was high-quality, tender, and bouncy, served with the same larb sauce – a perfect combination. The huge salad added great nutrients. The mashed potatoes were smooth and creamy, served with miso sauce. (Without gravy) Very delicious.
sample_reviews_th.author: ทนายปู ปรเมศวร์

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm giving it 3 stars because the food is usually edible and this branch is near my house, so I eat here quite often. My kids also like it. But honestly, this time I'm very disappointed.

I ordered through GrabFood, and the quality of the food didn't match the price I paid.
The chicken looked burnt, the color was so dark it was obvious. It shouldn't have been released from the kitchen to the customer at all.

The pickled radish cost 65 baht, but the quantity was barely enough; it felt like they reduced the amount but were still charging full price.

The side dishes that came with the chicken were also noticeably less than usual.

As a regular customer of this branch, I can honestly say this level of quality is very disappointing. Compared to other Bonchon branches I've eaten at, the quality and standards should be similar, not letting food that looks burnt and the quantity not justify the price reach customers like this.

I hope the restaurant will take food quality control before delivery and improve its food preparation standards to match the price. Customers who pay full price should receive quality food that meets the brand's standards.
sample_reviews_en.author: K W

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious as always.

Fresh veggies and ingredients served from organic farm straight to your dish. I love how they arrange everything so nicely and in a large quantity so that customers are amazed by how big and pretty it is once dish is served.

There are over 100 menus of salad, steak, spaghetti, juice, and dessert for you to choose. I love their sauces, they all taste amazing. I know that their ingredients are healthy, but have to admit that they put so many (salt and sugar) in the sauce and sides, just to make it taste good.

Price is quite high, but compared to the taste and portion, it’s quite suitable. Vegan menu and takeout also available.

Anyway, everything is so nice, and definitely will come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: KOKO

sample_reviews_en.text:
I think the service at this branch isn't very good, but since it's close to my house, I eat there regularly. The food takes a very long time to arrive, especially the chicken, the fried chicken. It takes ages. Maybe they focus more on delivery, because I always see the delivery drivers sleeping. So I think this branch has really poor service. The staff who come to pick up orders aren't very enthusiastic either.
But the main issue is the long wait for the food. But I still go there because it's close to home. I eat there regularly, and my kids like it. It's very different from the Seacon Bang Khae and The Mall Bang Khae branches, which have excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: nerv

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very cozy place to dine. Decorated in cottage styled with veggie, healthy, menus really go well together. This branch is very spacious and the staff are very helpful, friendly, and very polite...they bow everytime food is served. Kudos to the service training provided to them.

Foods taste great especially their onion soup. Their fancy smoothies and cold pressed juices are remarkable! The price tag for their food is reasonable considering the portion that each menu can be shared within the table of 2 or 3 persons.

Great foods, good atmosphere. Highly recommended. Moreover, they round down!! this is simply amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: apiwatbob

sample_reviews_en.text: The Songkran Set is 799 baht. We ate it as a couple and it was so much food! 😁 To feel comfortably full, it would probably be best for 3-4 people because the ramen noodles are refillable! 👍 The taste was amazing, rich, mildly spicy, and had a nice kick 🌶️😙 The cheese fondue 🧀👀🧡 was the best! Look at the pictures, it's worth it, I was so pleased! 😌 However, the price including VAT and service charge is 940 baht. If you're hungry and craving something delicious and filling, this is it! 👍😚
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploy Kitta

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm just a customer who ordered ramen with pork bone broth and asked for the vegetables to be separated. Is that so difficult? I'm confused. And the staff said the kitchen was very busy right now (but they couldn't separate the vegetables anyway). I'm not complaining about the long wait; if they knew it was busy, I could wait. I've never been rude before. I've been here twice now, and the male staff are very good, but the female staff are terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: กมลวรรณ ช้อยสามนาค

sample_reviews_en.text: Vegetable lovers shouldn't miss this! A salad packed with various fruits and vegetables for a healthy meal. High-quality ingredients, beautifully presented, and looks just like the food in Chiang Mai! (There was a long queue, but the staff managed it well. Delicious and healthy food is worth the wait, right?) Even I, who don't usually like vegetables, was drooling just looking at it... Go for it! What are you waiting for!
sample_reviews_en.author: J.NOPPAKUN

restaurants.name: Neo Suki
restaurants.address:

Room 301, Floor 3 Center One Shopping Plaza 1 Ratchawithi Rd, Khwaeng Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Today I tried Neo Suki at Center One branch and I was even more impressed than I expected 🥰🍲

My favorite highlight was the dipping sauces. There are so many to choose from, each with its own unique, rich, and delicious flavor. Whether you prefer spicy, sweet, or strong flavors, you can find something you like 😋✨ They pair perfectly with the sukiyaki.

The ingredients were fresh and clean, and the portions were just right. The homemade sukiyaki, in particular, was incredibly delicious – tender, bouncy, and flavorful. You could really tell they put a lot of effort into making it 🥢💯

Importantly, they currently have a buy one get one free promotion 🎉🎊 It's such a great deal! You get an extra set of homemade sukiyaki for a very affordable price. It's a fantastic promotion for sukiyaki lovers.

The restaurant atmosphere is clean and comfortable. The staff are friendly, smiling, and attentive 😊👍

If you're looking for a delicious sukiyaki restaurant near Center One, I highly recommend this one. The taste, quality, and value are all perfect ❤️🍲 I'll definitely be back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: อริศรา จงจิตต์

sample_reviews_en.text:
The chicken broth was delicious; I almost finished the whole pot.
Even though it said no MSG, I was still incredibly thirsty after eating, I don't know why.
We chose the pork set, which was okay.
There was a wide variety of dipping sauces to choose from, all free except for the XO.
I really liked the spicy Cantonese and Hainanese sauces; they were so delicious!
The stir-fried kale with oyster sauce was a little too sweet, but not bad.

The tea had a lovely aroma.

I wish they had a smoke extractor because so much smoke was getting in my head! 🤣🤣 It felt like being in a sauna.

The staff were polite and provided good service, but they didn't walk past the tables in the corners very often, making it difficult to get their attention.

They accept credit cards.
sample_reviews_en.author: King Bob M.

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken broth was mild, the Tom Yum soup was more flavorful but not too spicy. The budget set was light and easy on the stomach, but if you're very hungry, it might feel a bit small. The seafood dish was like minced seafood, soft and bouncy, very delicious. The Cantonese and Hainanese dipping sauces were very tasty, while the Taiwanese-style sauce and another one I forgot the name of were quite salty. The coconut ice cream for dessert was amazing, with lots of red bean topping, I loved it! The total was over 700 baht for 3 people, which I felt was a reasonable price. However, at this branch, we saw a small cockroach walking around. There is parking available, but you have to pay for it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanyaros SP

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited alone at 8:30pm on March 7, 2024, but the restaurant was empty and I was able to be seated right away.
I ordered a pork and vegetable set, bami yok, a large bottle of Heineken beer, and tom yum soup, which was free of charge.
When the food arrived, the pork was very fatty, so when it boiled, a lot of pork fat floated to the top of the soup, making it taste greasy, which was disappointing.
Also, there were no Thai beers available, only Heineken, and I felt that 155 THB was expensive.
I paid 700 THB after checking the box.
If you're looking for Thai Suki, I highly recommend other restaurants such as MK.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mikisan

sample_reviews_en.text: I only recently started eating here after the COVID restrictions were eased (but I've lived in this area for a long time). Back then, it wasn't crowded, and the service, taste, and price were all excellent. I've been eating here ever since. What I like is that they have many types of soup to choose from. Personally, I like the regular chicken soup; it's really good. The garlic fried rice is also good. The dipping sauces are great (they serve the standard Cantonese sauce, and I order extra shabu-shabu sauce, which are my two favorites), and they have many more options to choose from as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tonger Further

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant offers easy-to-choose set meals with many menu options. Starting with a light and affordable pork set, there are many other sets to choose from, including beef sets and shabu-shabu sets. There are about 6 types of soup bases to choose from, as well as a wide variety of dipping sauces. The ingredients are fresh, the staff is friendly, and the prices are reasonable.
It's one of my favorite places to eat sukiyaki right now.
sample_reviews_en.author: K K.

sample_reviews_en.text: Homey, old school Taiwanese style hot pot (but now also have other soup like shabu and mala). Try the specialty neo sauce (kinda like flavored soy sauce). It's subtle, but very good. Also, this place is like 20% cheaper than any similar Taiwanese hot pot in BKK (like MK or Canton). They also have delivery by Grab. Unfortunately the place is a bit cramp, so I don't recommend big party (beyond 6 or7 ppl)
sample_reviews_en.author: Savin Wangtal

sample_reviews_en.text:
The seafood platter is amazing! You MUST order it; you'll be hooked. Everything else is fresh and delicious too, except for the dim sum – no way!

My family said the dipping sauce bowls and some of the utensils spill very easily. They need to improve that.

Oh, and the dipping sauce has MSG in it; it's not like MK's.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ssy

restaurants.name: Bistro Bordello
restaurants.address:

670/414, Soi Khwan Phatthana, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fantastic restaurant with a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The owner and the entire team are genuinely kind and make you feel at home right away.
The food was outstanding. The Rossini foie gras burger was exceptional, perfectly cooked, juicy, and full of flavor, with a great bun and delicious toppings.
We also had the carbonara pasta, which was rich and very well prepared.
A special mention for the cocktail inspired by a White Russian, reinvented with peach instead of coffee cream, surprisingly good and very refreshing.
Overall, a wonderful dining experience. We truly enjoyed our time here and will definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex B.

sample_reviews_en.text: Dinner with a friend last night and we ordered Greek salad with chicken pesto, SIRLOIN 500g with French Fries. The owner is a cute foreigner, and the staff were very friendly, at the end the owner also gave us mango tiramisu for dessert. It’s very thoughtful . Although I prefer harder pasta, But the pasta were too soft and lost their chewiness last night. But the seasoning has a light minty scent ,very delicious. If next time I will remember to ask the waiter to cook the pasta for a shorter time.and want to try some pizza too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lingo Chiang

sample_reviews_en.text: This is more of a bar with food than a restaurant, and it's not air-conditioned, so it feels more like a sauna, but the food is good and the prices are fair. The quality of the cold cuts and cheeses is better than most other places, and we liked how they are served with full baguettes (although a proper bread knife would enhance the overall experience even more). The pizza was outstanding, with a savory crust that is baked perfectly crispy.  We would like to return to try more dishes, but will wait for cooler weather.
sample_reviews_en.author: chriskennedy100 Kennedy

sample_reviews_en.text: Great, friendly family atmosphere. We went there for a special couscous night, sided by a lovely bottle of chilled Chablis... perfect. The couscous was prepared to perfection (even the Thai chef came out of the kitchen to check if we enjoyed his cooking), relaxed and friendly service, all at a very affordable price (we paid just a little over 3,000 tb- for 3 including 3 Royal Couscous, 2 deserts, 1 mint soda, and 1 bottle of Chablis). A simple, no-fuss, friendly, and very yummy French restaurant. Go check it out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Olivier Dombey

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing French and English meals are served here at this location. If you’re looking for Western meals, visit this place. The co-owner explained the source of all of his foods to us. The meat is from Queensland, Australia. The cheese burger is outstanding. The rip eye was excellent. The pizza was of a high standard. The French bakery items were fresh. We can’t speak highly enough for this restaurant - and it was worth the 20 minute trip to this location. We will return to this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brenden Wood

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently tried Bistro Bordello, located at the beginning of Soi Talat Khwan Phatthana (Din Daeng).

At first, I was surprised that a restaurant like this would open in this area (usually there's only one restaurant for expats, Fatty's, on the main road).

The owner is a half-British, half-French person. The prices are quite high, but the food tastes authentic. (I ordered pasta and steak).

The owner was very friendly and even gave us a complimentary shot of bourbon at the end.
sample_reviews_en.author: Albert PJ

sample_reviews_en.text:
After seeing the good reviews and beautiful pictures on the menu, we had high hopes about the food. However, the food turned out to be a major disappointment; Caesar salad, Scandinavian pasta and on top of all baguette Parisian (220B). Hummus was alright. Staff/owner did their best but in a near-empty restaurant the service was rather awkward than friendly.

Could be a nice place to have a night out and enjoy burgers or pizza.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tuukka Oksala

sample_reviews_en.text: Thank you for taking my family for the Saturday evening reservation. Kids are brutally honest but you and most adults know that you and your wife cook from your heart! The kids got hungry later that evening. The first thing they ate was the pizza and french fries!  My little one would have picked all of the bacon off the pizza. She loved relaxing at the bar. I'm glad she warmed up. Thank you, kindly!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark O

restaurants.name: 6/3​ Halal Jim Chum
restaurants.address:

366/3 Krungthep Kreetha Rd, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The male staff member provided good service. I wish the description had been more detailed. I thought it was regular Milo, but the staff are Muslim, so I assumed the name was used for a drink, like "Milo tea." I was confused because I ordered Milo but got iced tea. The shop clearly stated it was tea, but some people in Bangkok don't know what Milo is and think it's Milo. It was a little disappointing. The staff probably added extra Milo powder, so it did taste somewhat like iced tea. The staff member was also quite loud. This is a restaurant, not a market! It would be better to inform customers in advance about the charge for ice and water before serving them. Please improve on this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sofhki

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a halal roadside restaurant with a nostalgic, relaxed atmosphere. Importantly, despite being by the road, it's not crowded because it's on a bypass road leading to Bangkok Kreetha Road.

They label the portion sizes using "Kindergarten," "Elementary," and "Secondary," likely to match the restaurant's name, P.6/3 (Class of 6/3). The prices are quite reasonable considering the portion sizes. We chose two broths: Tom Yum and Jim Jum. They offer both traditional dipping sauces and a spicy dipping sauce with separate chilies, roasted rice powder, and tamarind paste. I assume they use a very efficient method of preparing pre-made sauces to avoid wasting leftovers.
sample_reviews_en.author: ลูกมือ

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered mild and medium spicy basil chicken, clearly specifying the spice level. The (Myanmar) employee brought the food, but when I asked how spicy each one was, they said they didn't know, walked away, and called another person. They seemed confused. I asked the other person, and they were confused too. Finally, I had to ask at the counter, and they said the cook made both dishes mild, without checking the order. When I ate it, it definitely wasn't mild. I was confused, but I couldn't tolerate the lack of attention to detail. The price wasn't street food either; I could afford it, but they should pay more attention to customer orders.
sample_reviews_en.author: Imron.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent dining experience..

🤤 Food was extremely tasty.

🤩 Portion was big.

🥰 Owner was extremely friendly.

What we like about the restaurant 🥳

Restaurant closes late around 2am. You can easily order it if you can't come (grab or foodpanda)

Really recommend this place. Suitable for Malaysians too as owner and staffs speaks melayu language.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr. Ray

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant has really delicious food. I've been here many times.
The prices are affordable, it's always crowded, and the food arrives very quickly. You don't have to wait long at all. If you're hungry late at night, you can stop by and try this place. It closes at 2 AM. Late night owls should definitely try it! 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Natnicha’s

sample_reviews_en.text:
I saw a shrimp fried rice for 85 baht and was shocked. Seriously, 85 baht?! Look at the shrimp! The fried chicken cartilage was delicious.
But the food took forever to arrive. The spicy salad took ages; I finished eating the hot pot and the spicy salad only came out after that.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peerapath Ponghanpoj

sample_reviews_en.text: Parking is only available on the street because the shop is right next to the sidewalk. They have a variety of dishes at reasonable prices. The taste is average, but preparation is a bit slow. There is seating both inside the shop and on the sidewalk.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ketsarapan Sattayakun

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious. I've been here many times.
The prices are affordable, and the food doesn't take long to arrive. There's a wide variety of dishes on the menu. If you're hungry late at night, you can definitely try this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปิยพร สุขสวัสดิ์

restaurants.name: KubKao' KubPla Siam Paragon
restaurants.address:

สยามพารากอน ชั้น G, เลขที่ 991 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very disappointing and upsetting experience at Kub Kao Kub Pla Siam Paragon on 9 August.

While waiting for our table, my parents bought two cans of beer. We didn’t know outside drinks were not allowed, but once the LADY manager told us, my parents immediately stopped drinking and put them aside.

Instead of simply explaining the policy, the LADY manager aggressively took the cans, put them in a bag, tied it, and took them away without saying a word, with a aggressive emotion. My parents were extremely embarrassed in front of other customers.

When we asked if we could order beer from the restaurant instead, SHE told us “you guys need to pay first,” which was not true.

I am honestly very angry and disappointed, especially seeing my parents being treated this way while they were simply trying to enjoy their vacation. Rules are understandable, but there is absolutely no excuse for treating customers with this level of disrespect
sample_reviews_en.author: Thủy Trịnh

sample_reviews_en.text:
KubKao’ KubPla at Siam Paragon is a solid choice for Thai food, especially if you want a comfortable, convenient restaurant in the middle of the mall. The menu has a good variety of classic Thai dishes, and the food is generally tasty with nice presentation and decent-quality ingredients.

That said, I would describe the cooking itself as mid-tier rather than exceptional. The flavours are enjoyable and approachable, but some dishes lack the depth, complexity, and strong character you can find at really good local Thai restaurants. Nothing was particularly bad, but not many dishes stood out as truly memorable either.

Overall, it’s a good and reliable place for Thai food in Siam Paragon — comfortable atmosphere, plenty of choices, and consistent quality. Worth visiting when you’re in the area, but I’d come more for the convenience and overall experience than for outstanding Thai cooking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Min Min

sample_reviews_en.text:
KubKao' KubPla is very good for Thai food!

Went on a Wednesday evening in August. Waiting time around 30 minutes. Located by all the other food options.

Service: Friendly staff even when everything is so busy. Quick to take order and food arrives fast.

Food: The highlight. Really like their mango sticky rice. Everything we had was very delicious!

Atmosphere: Very loud because of all the people. Nothing the staff can do about the people outside the restauran, but didn't always at times keep people in the restaurant at check when they were being loud. Not the place for calm and/or intimate dinners. There is another outlet at the higher levels of Emquartier that is much quieter and the atmosphere is much nicer and you also get beautiful views. The food is the same quality, though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex Gustafsson

sample_reviews_en.text:
I feel this restaurant is overrated. The seafood Tom Yum only had shrimp and fish; at first, I thought the white stuff was squid, but it was actually coconut rice, and the soup was quite sour and unremarkable. The papaya salad wasn't flavorful. The raw shrimp and salted egg squid salads were okay, around a 7/10. The best dish for me was probably the crab fried rice. That day I had already eaten snacks around the food court and was quite full, so I only ordered these few dishes.

The prices were quite high, and we had to wait about an hour for a table. The staff ignored customers even though I called them three times and the female staff member saw me.

In short, there are many cheaper and tastier local restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: TN Ng

sample_reviews_en.text: Kub Kao Kub Pla at Siam Paragon is one of the most popular spots for premium Thai home-style cooking. The dishes feel familiar and comforting, but you can really taste the quality of the ingredients and preparation. The caramelized pork leg is an absolute must-try — incredibly tender, rich in flavor, and practically melts in your mouth. The stir-fried shrimp is another standout, fresh and perfectly bouncy with just the right texture. And of course, you can never go wrong with Thai papaya salad, which adds a bright, refreshing contrast to the meal and pairs beautifully with everything on the table. A great choice for anyone wanting elevated Thai comfort food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chubby Hands

sample_reviews_en.text: If you’re looking for the best Thai-restaurant in Bangkok, KubKao’ KubPla is your first-choice!! We dined at around 7:30pm Tuesday and we waited for about 50 minutes to get in. This is my first time trying their dishes and they were all impressive; not to mention the price is quite reasonable! We ordered Tom yum cream soup, coconut cream chicken soup, stir-fried water spinach, stir-fried basil pork, and pad thai. Every dish was delicious; however, they’re quite spicy for my family even though we ordered less spicy already 🌶️ I really love the taste of their dishes and can’t wait to visit again before I leave Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: hyso ch

sample_reviews_en.text: A very bad experience with this restaurant. Although the Central World branch is excellent, this one was truly awful. We arrived late; you should have been told the restaurant was closed like the others, but instead, you were welcomed inside. Then, the waitress was unhelpful and unprofessional. We can excuse her because of work, but having to pay the bill before eating is bizarre. And when you asked for sauce, she claimed it wasn't available. The food was cold, and the service was terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dubai 2020

sample_reviews_en.text:
To be honest it was really good, but probably because it was my first meal in Bkk. It was so crowded, not quite worth the queue and space given was quite small, but the food was 10/10.

Had crab curry, tom yum soup, creeper cowslip, crispy pork with garlic and mango salad. All yums, accompanied by fresh coconuts.

It was pretty strong in MSG though, was thirsty after. Compared to baan ying, which was my first love, definitely sharper in taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattj

restaurants.name: SSamthing Together สาขา The Nine Rama9
restaurants.address:

999/3 ชั้นที่ 1 Rama IX Rd, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're in Bangkok and love Korean BBQ, you must try SSamthing Together! Their grilled pork belly and Signature Together Set is absolutely delicious, I really love this set because it has a big variety and the portion is very generous for 2 people. The Iberico pork collar comes highly recommended, and for good reason—it's simply fantastic. The Korean noodles and steamed eggs with cheese are perfect complements to the meal. Don't miss out on trying the meat with kimchi; it's a flavor combination that you won't forget. Overall, an excellent dining experience! And not to forget, the service is top notch. The staff is very welcoming, friendly and they even grill the meat for you, how cool is that ? Perfect restaurant to have a great time with friends, date or family! I will definitely come back
sample_reviews_en.author: Jelte Blommaert

sample_reviews_en.text:
This establishment shares ownership with the Maguro Group and Hitori Shabu. Regrettably, I discovered that the food quality is rather poor in comparison to the high prices charged. While some menu items appear reasonably priced, the portions are exceedingly small. Furthermore, the grill is not charcoal-based but rather an electronic grill, which results in the absence of the distinctive charcoal flavor.

Be advised that a 10% service charge and a 7% VAT are added to the prices. Considering the quality of the dining experience, I found the overall cost to be excessively high based on my personal and my family  opinions.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tony Chote

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good place for Korean BBQ.

You can either cook it yourself or ask the server to do it for you. The meat ( i.e. beef) quality is good, for the price. (Not a top notch, but good enough.) Veggies are fresh and of good quality. Often have promotion sets differ from time to time.

Ramyon hot pot is also good (beware of super spicy paste that comes with it!)

Price is reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ronrapee Leelawong

sample_reviews_en.text: Generous portion and verity of side dishes according to Korean BBQ style. Overall value for money and taste good. Good for family meal. They provide full service to grill at the table. You just simply sit and eat. However they mentioned that today will be the last day for à la carte and tomorrow they will change to Buffer. Not sure if they will provide the same quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supakhun “Ken” Chantaravisutlert

sample_reviews_en.text: Good Korean restaurant. Meat was fresh and taste was great. They had variety of meat, beef and pork. Side dishes were available and served all the time. They had service to grill at tables. They did cook very well. The staffs were great with mind of service. I recommended to come as group because you could order variety of dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jetnapa Techawiparat

sample_reviews_en.text: I loved this restaurant! We went to try real Korean style bqq and we enjoyed so much the food there. The restaurant has a nice ambiance and the staff is kind, we tried pork, beed and fish and everything had an amazing taste. I world recommend anyone who is looking for a good korean bqq experience to try this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Laya

sample_reviews_en.text:
A delicious Korean yakiniku restaurant
The menu is extensive and the price range varies
The staff will grill it for you if you ask
The inside of the store is also beautiful
It was a good Korean restaurant
sample_reviews_en.author: T'sトラベル

sample_reviews_en.text: this place is clearly understaffed. due to a lack of staffs grilling quality is ok but not more
sample_reviews_en.author: Remo Bandi

restaurants.name: Malai Restaurant
restaurants.address:

54 Ngam Duphli Alley, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: 24-hour open... A must are purple boiled rice (ข้าวต้มอัญชัน), minced pork stir-fried with black olives (หมูสับหนำเลี๊ยบ) and Ruby in coconut milk dessert serving hot (ทับทิมกรอบร้อน)... Btw, moderate price (not cheap if comparing to other shop)
sample_reviews_th.author: Jub Chutimar

sample_reviews_en.text: Malai Restaurant in the Malaysia Hotel offers a variety of Thai dishes. The restaurant's interior is simply but elegantly decorated, perfect for dining with family or friends. Highlights include: Rice Porridge: Smooth and flavorful rice porridge, available with fish, shrimp, or pork options. Crispy Fried Sausage: Crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, with a perfect balance of sweet and salty flavors. Stir-fried Morning Glory: Spicy and flavorful stir-fried morning glory with a fragrant garlic aroma. Pickled Radish Stir-fried with Egg: Pickled radish stir-fried with egg and minced pork, a balanced sweet and savory dish. Fried Fish Salad: Crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, mixed with a flavorful dressing that is sour, salty, sweet, and spicy. Overall: Malai Restaurant is a great option for those seeking delicious Thai food in a relaxed atmosphere with good service, tasty food, and reasonable prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: OPPA XRAY

sample_reviews_en.text:
This rice porridge restaurant is known for being open 24 hours, making it a safe haven for many. Located in the Malaysia Hotel, it offers a range of dishes from typical rice porridge to international cuisine. I've only tried the rice porridge, and overall, the taste is good and meets standard expectations.

- Tom Yum Goong (spicy shrimp soup): This was very well made. It's rare to find a restaurant that includes straw mushrooms, which are quite expensive. It came with about 7-8 shrimp, suitable for two people.
- Yam Pla Salid (spicy fried fish salad): The fish was crispy, but the dressing was a little too sweet.
- Stir-fried Morning Glory: Standard taste.
- Rice: I have to commend them on the quality of their jasmine rice, which enhanced the overall flavor of the food.

💸 The prices aren't cheap, but not expensive either.
🚗 There's parking available at the hotel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marmalade Pear

sample_reviews_en.text: 24-hour restaurant located inside the Malaysia Hotel with free parking. This place has some of the best Teochew/Chaozhou kao-tom dishes in Bangkok (潮州粥/潮州打冷); most of their Thai customers come here for the kao-tom dishes. Teochew kao-tom is actually a Southern Chinese cuisine and it was brought over to Thailand by Thai-Chinese families. A famous food critic from Hong Kong once claimed that the most authentic Teochew food is from Thailand and not from China. I eat here once a week and it is one of my favorite reasonably priced restaurants. The kao-tom dishes are listed on a separate sheet from the main menu, the main menu is long with many international and regular Thai dishes. I have tried everything on the kao-tom menu and none were disappointing, I haven’t ordered anything from the main menu yet.
sample_reviews_en.author: David T

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fantastic Beef Steak, it's a 6 star steak! The clientele mid to late evening is "upper midle class young profesionals', many high profile government people, discrete highly successful business owners and executoved . The is a constant presence of the Arts and media croud and sometimes divas andfashionistas. Hotel clientele, are usually daytimers - they can be enigmatic and mysterious . On any given evening and time you will notice a  convoy of Bentley's, Tesla, Porches, Ferrari and other Italian iconic motor vehicles on a holding pattern for parking. Those are my random impressions and still dinning there going on 2 months
FYIpeople watching over a beer on the outdoor terrace is fun. I'm sure you will feel like you are in the right place, then just discover your own thoughts on it's alure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kevin Joseph Bourque (Skeeva)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is located near Lumpini Park, inside the Malaysia Hotel.

The building is a bit old-fashioned, but the interior is very clean.

This time, I ordered Khao Tom (rice porridge), which was blue because it contained butterfly peas.

It didn't have much flavor, but the blue appearance of the food was quite surprising.

All the dishes were delicious and the portions were quite generous.

Although everything looked spicy, except for the stir-fried morning glory, most of the dishes weren't spicy at all, which made me feel that this is also a part of authentic Thai cuisine.

In any case, these are definitely dishes that would taste better with beer in the evening.

The prices were quite reasonable; for two people ordering a fair amount, it came to 500 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: KAZUYA WAKASUGI

sample_reviews_en.text:
This rice porridge restaurant offers reasonably priced, mid-range food with delicious flavors.
The atmosphere might look a bit old, but it's clean and tidy.
The air conditioning is refreshingly cool, perfect for the Thai weather.

Definitely worth trying!
🤟 The rice porridge has a unique blue color from butterfly pea flower – excellent!
🤟 The spicy sausage salad is great; they even added dried fish upon request – everything was perfect.
🤟 The stir-fried clams with chili paste are also superb.
🤟 The minced pork with preserved plums might be more like minced pork stir-fried with soy sauce,
because there weren't many preserved plums, but it was still tasty.
🤟 The plum soup is rich, not too salty, and delicious.

See the last picture for confirmation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Theerawut “Notz”

sample_reviews_en.text:
The prices are fine but definitly not cheap, but the real problem is that the rest of the experience doesnt reflect that at all.

The food was mediocre, but palatable and it arrived relatvely quickly. Meanwhile, the staff was dead silent when serving and taking orders, but the moment they got back behind the counter, they were howling with laughter and jokes. Mind you, the restaurant was nearly empty when we arrived, yet it sounded like we were in the middle of the fish market. It definitly killed the atmosphere.

On top of that, out of the half a dozend servers present, we struggled to get the attention of even one despite the fact that there were no guests.

I would not recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Elara
