restaurants.address:

120 370-371 Ratchaprarop Rd, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited on Tuesday at around 12pm. When we arrived, the place was quite comfortable and we managed to settle down without any issues.

For our meal, we ordered the stir-fried dish with soya sauce, Thai stir-fried prawns and basil prawns. We also ordered a Thai milk tea and iced coffee to go with our meal.

Overall, the food was okay and we had a decent dining experience. The dishes were nicely prepared and the prawns were enjoyable. Both drinks were refreshing and went well with the food, especially on a hot day in Bangkok.

The portion sizes were reasonable and everything we ordered was good enough to share. The flavours were quite familiar and not too overpowering, which made the meal easy to enjoy. Service was also okay during our visit and we didn’t have to wait too long for our food to arrive. We spent about 800 baht for 3 dishes and 2 drinks, which felt quite reasonable for the overall experience.

Overall, I would say it was a pleasant dining experience. The food was decent, the environment was comfortable and we enjoyed our lunch.

I wouldn’t mind coming back again to try some of the other dishes on the menu. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Raihah Roslan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve been coming to this restaurant on every trip to Thailand since 2006. It used to be one of my favorite spots, but unfortunately the quality and service have gone downhill.
On my recent visit, I ordered a chicken breast and was served chicken legs instead. When I pointed out the mistake, the staff refused to replace it and claimed I had already eaten from the dish—something that definitely did not happen. The attitude and lack of responsibility were shocking, especially from a place I’ve supported for so many years.
Sadly, this will be my last visit. I can no longer recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: peter dunbar

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Delicious halal Thai & Arabic flavors!

Had a great meal at Maedah Restaurant perfect spot if you’re looking for a mix of Thai and Arabic halal food.

The fried quail mix rice was absolutely delicious  flavorful and well-seasoned. The fried fish was crispy on the outside and tender inside, cooked perfectly. Great variety on the menu with both Thai and Middle Eastern options.

Simple place, but the food really stands out. Friendly atmosphere and very satisfying overall.
Will definitely come back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Salim Mumtaz

sample_reviews_en.text: The halal restaurant was decent. We ordered Thai food, which was average, nothing special. However, the clear Tom Yum soup didn't appeal to me because the shrimp were way overcooked and had a strange smell (I work with shrimp), so I left it. Otherwise, everything was fine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Margaux Cappelleri

sample_reviews_en.text:
The cleanest halal food and excellent service from the restaurant owners and staff.
Everyone is helpful and cheerful. The food is clean and fresh, and every meal is prepared at the same time. I recommend the tabbouleh, charcoal-grilled chicken, and tandoor bread. 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Suhaila

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place never FAILS to deliver!
Food has always been so consistently good.
We see similar faces from the staffs n it kinda make u feel warm n comfy. While some say it’s a lil pricey but it’s worth every penny for the quality n portions of the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sue Syahira Goh Bte Abdullah

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is beautiful and the food is delicious, just like in Saudi Arabia. The reception and service are more than wonderful. It is located in the Pratunam Night Market area, but it differs in its cleanliness, air conditioning, and reception.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr.SULAIMAN

sample_reviews_en.text: First time at this Halal restaurant located in the famous Pratunam Night Market. Warm welcome, excellent food! They serve Thai, Chinese, Indian, and Arabic cuisine. They even have barbecue options! I ordered chicken with biryani rice, which …
sample_reviews_en.author: Sandrine TSAO

restaurants.name: Be My Guest
restaurants.address:

217 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Google maps shows here 2 restaurants. It's the same Be My Guest restaurant and บ้านริมน้ำ restaurant.
sample_reviews_th.author: CREOLE SCREAM

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here by motorbike and it's a little adventure in itself. The entrance to the super narrow alley where the restaurant is is very concealed since it can't be accessed directly from the main road. So if you are coming here by a motorbike (like me), you'll need to drive on a footpath for about 10 metres to be able to turn into the soi. This alley is super narrow and the surface is very uneven, go slow and be considerate. Lovely animist bodhi tree on the first bend. There's a little space to park youor bike along the front wall of the restaurant. Crossing the river on a ferry from Si-praya pier would be a lot easier but a lot less adventurous.

The food is lovely. Squid in salted egg sauce is one of the best I've had so far. Pineapple fried rice is served with prawns on top. I also recommend Tom kha gai with young coconut.

The service is not much but attentive enough. Great view but can be a bit stuffy since the seating space is flanked by buildings.

The riverside walk path leads to Jam Factory.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyabutr Lorgrailers

sample_reviews_en.text: I went out yesterday for the first time with my friends. Around 8pm, there were not much people. Such a nice place to meet up with friends. It has a good vibe, chill, open air table, quite quiet location, not to be distracted by anything (Icon Siam building which next to it, the construction part is mostly finished). It has a good view to see ferries and river transportation. Well known '90 Thai pop music were played there. As a local, I recommend Thai food here which taste good like local. We ordered 6 plates of food (Kang-som, Yum-Pakkashed, Whisky fried rib, fried squid with salted egg, fried broccoli with shrimp, fried sour pork and one rice bowl which cost us around a thoundsand. Red vine is 900 baht per bottle. Nice service, ask staffs for the solution of mosquito. I recommend to come for dinner and during Nov-Feb.
sample_reviews_en.author: napawan mew

sample_reviews_en.text:
They rip off tourists. They bring you bottled water you didn't order and put it on your bill even before you open it. They then add a 10% tax and add 15-20% to your bill. If you don't check the bill yourself and open it, you'll get ripped off right away. The atmosphere is nice, but there are too many mosquitoes...

(Answer) I revised the bill twice. The first time, I omitted the bottled water, and then I revised it again because the tax was higher than 10%. If you keep checking the bill like that and revising it, wouldn't everyone think you intended to overcharge them the first time?
sample_reviews_en.author: 최윤호

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice place to enjoy dinner by riverside.
Food: For thai maybe not that extreme but not that bad. Some menus are great, I love fried fish with spicy herbs.
Service: very good. Many staffs can speak English so it is convenient for foreigners.
Price: reasonable.
Transportation: There is a trick to hit there by taking shuttle boat of Hilton Millennium hotel from Saphan Taksin pier.
Update 22-05-2022 Hilton’s shuttle boat is out of service now.
Update 02-11-2023 Hilton’s shuttle boat is available now.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nakarin P.

sample_reviews_en.text: Interesting date place as you have to go down a dark alley to get there. Be my guest offers Thai food with a good water front view. If your there at night ask for mosquito repellent oil BUT I WAS STILL BIT ON MY FACE 😡. I a farang, thought the food was good a 7-8 but maybe a little pricey. My date, a Thai chef, said she could make better 🤣 she just thought it was too salty and not spicy enough. Service was great and they had an adorable stray cat there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vincent Pascoe

sample_reviews_en.text:
BAN RIM NAM
Is a great restaurant for chilling by the bank of the Chao Phraya River opposite the So Heng Tai Mansion. After entering via the old blue iron gate, you'll feel the openness like entering a warehouse beside the water. As such. the restaurant has arranged seating on the top and bottom floors to enjoy the panoramic view. The menu has a full set of dishes, ice cream, various beverages, which are perfect for chilling out or reading a book.
sample_reviews_en.author: Calvin Nguyen

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very tasty seafood restaurant, and its prices are cheap compared to the restaurants around it. It has a very beautiful view of the river. The only defect in it is its entrance. You will not be able to reach it through Google Maps, but rather through the Hilton Hotel next to it, and it has an almost dark private road.  I highly recommend visiting it.
I visited the restaurant again on Monday and unfortunately it was closed 😔
sample_reviews_en.author: talal alnimri

restaurants.name: Swensen's Central Rama 3
restaurants.address:

ชั้น 1 79/108 ศูนย์การค้าเซ็นทรัลพระราม3 ห้องที่223, ถนน สาธุประดิษฐ์ Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We looked at the menu for about 5 minutes. People started coming in, but the tables weren't full yet. We said, "Could we place an order?" (in a very normal tone of voice). The employee named Dasy (wearing glasses, thin) immediately replied, "Just a moment." Her tone was terrible, even awful.
What she should have said was, "Okay, just a moment." This was my first time eating at this branch, and I definitely won't be coming back. I usually eat at Terminal 21 Asok; it's crowded, but the service is so different.

Oh, I forgot to mention, when the ice cream was served, two cups were already melted, practically watery. I almost had a meltdown. I really couldn't take it anymore. I asked for the first cup to be changed. My boyfriend was too lazy to wait for the second cup and ate it. Here's a picture of the ice cream that was just served. When he poked at it, it was mostly water. It was like eating durian juice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thegb sbux

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to this branch with 6 friends.

The restaurant closes at 9:30 PM. I arrived around 9:20 PM and asked the staff at the front if we could still get a table.

The staff member said yes (but with a displeased expression).

I was also displeased because if they couldn't accept our order or didn't want to take it anymore, they could have just said so. But accepting customers and then making a displeased face like that, I have the right to review my experience.
Because I am a consumer and I paid for my meal.

I would like the restaurant to improve or have a meeting with the staff to discuss and clarify their customer service practices.

Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mac Nayumi

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered half an hour ago and still haven't received it. Then a famous person came 10 minutes later and got it. Then other customers got it first. Then a while later, a staff member came and asked what I had ordered. I had been waiting for so long and saw the staff talking, so I raised my hand to call them. I asked if this was ready yet. They said it was ready and asked again to be sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: 03 Napatrada Thongsongsom

sample_reviews_en.text: When we arrived at Swensen's, my friend said she was too full to eat anymore because she had just eaten sukiyaki. But once the ice cream was served, she ate it all up! She said it was delicious, the durian flavor was refreshing and went well with all the ice cream flavors, plus the sticky rice was amazing. I wish they had printable photos, my friend loves collecting them. Happy Birthday!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanna Rattanawanit

sample_reviews_en.text: I waited forever! There were very few customers and many staff members, but I waited almost 20 minutes and only got one scoop, which wasn't difficult at all—just scooping it into a cup. And it was already melted by the time it arrived. I'm confused about why it's taking so long. I'm disappointed every time I come to this branch. Please check it out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suttida Sombuntanon

sample_reviews_en.text: The number of staff should be increased. Compared to the Lotus branch across the street, the difference is significant. If there were enough staff, food would be served faster, customers would get their meals quicker, and leave faster. Customers wouldn't have to wait as long, and the staff wouldn't be as overwhelmed as they are now.
sample_reviews_en.author: P R

sample_reviews_en.text: Swensen's ice cream never disappoints. This location had this amazing promotion where you buy one, get one for 1 THB- SO worth it. This is a busy location, but there are a ton of indoor seatings. You can also sample flavors if you're indecisive like me.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tar T

sample_reviews_en.text: I was so tired of chewing, and the bingsu portion was tiny. They gave me so many trackers instead! It wasn't worth it at all. They could have told me beforehand if they were out of stock. I'm very disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: 01จิระเดช สุธาบูรณ์

restaurants.name: itto shokudo
restaurants.address:

101 12 Rang Nam Alley, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd give it zero stars if I could. The staff's rudeness was so appalling that, even though we'd already ordered our food, we got up and left. The air conditioning was blasting; we asked them to turn it down, but the waitress completely ignored us. We moved to a different table, as far away as possible, but we still felt a freezing draft on the back of our necks. We asked again, and without even answering, she turned around and started talking to someone at another table. A restaurant's quality isn't solely determined by the quality of its food. A little further down the street, there's another excellent restaurant that, in addition to its great food, knows how to treat its customers well. We won't be returning to this one.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lucy Stone23

sample_reviews_en.text: A little restaurant on Rang Nam. The front facade isn't too flashy so it's a blink and you miss. But we landed there since we were specifically looking for inexpensive Japanese food and followed Google map. And it was a very pleasant experience! The young lady managing the joint is very polite. You write down your dish number from the menu on a little note pad and they bring your food to your table-fresh, hot and very quick! Definitely try the enoki in light soy sauce. Their katsu curry is very tasty too!  Do try as many dishes as you can, they make them really good! And loved the pretty decor too. Will come back again. Definitely recommended! 👍🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: Moumita Dhar

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered ramen and fried chicken.
The ramen was great, I was able to finish the soup so the whole bowl was empty.
I wasn’t able to take a photo of the fried chicken because I ate it so quickly 😂 it was too good, too juicy and tender.
I also ordered the take out for my bf.
The Japanese fried noodles tasted so like in Japan. Not even to mention the fried pork chop… I miss the sauce so much and this place just fulfill my desire!!
As a Taiwanese, we eat a lot and love Japanese food very much.
Will 100% come back during my stay in bkk for 2.5 month!

Came back right next day to try the pork chop with curry rice, not disappointed at all!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ivy W

sample_reviews_en.text: I just ate at this restaurant and it was absolutely delicious! The atmosphere is lovely, the place is charming, and you immediately feel at ease. The lady who greeted us was incredibly kind; she gave us excellent recommendations, and thanks to her, we discovered some amazing dishes. We thoroughly enjoyed our meal. A wonderful experience that I highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lili Grmnl

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was a great little izakaya place. It really reminded me of a little mom-n-pop place my wife and I went to near Mt. Fuji. The selection is amazing and everything I had tasted great!

You can really tell how good a Japanese chef is by their tamagoyaki, and theirs was perfect for me. Tender, not too sweet, but melts in your mouth. Give them a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Scott Means

sample_reviews_en.text: I think this place is a bit overhyped from people dropping 5 star reviews to get a free key chain. We came here because of the good reviews and found the udon to be very bland with not much flavor or sophistication. Atmosphere was nice and the one staff member who served us was friendly enough but the food was a bit of a let down.
sample_reviews_en.author: Josiah Hunt

sample_reviews_en.text: We stumbled upon this place by chance. And it was amazing. We've been to Japan before, so the food tastes exactly like there. I almost cried from nostalgia. The food is served very quickly, and the interior is beautiful and atmospheric. We're so happy we had such a delicious meal in such a pleasant setting ♥️
sample_reviews_en.author: Nadia Rakhvalskaia

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and great value for money. The atmosphere was comfortable. My sister isn't a fan of raw fish, so they adapted the dish for her. /There were customers in the restaurant, so I tried not to include other people in the photos.
sample_reviews_en.author: lalita leto

restaurants.name: Wok wayy
restaurants.address:

17 78 Nawamin 111 Aly, Khwaeng Nawamin, Khet Bueng Kum, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is amazing! 💯 The atmosphere is super chill 🌿

The decor is beautiful, with cool neon lights and pretty hanging plants. It's perfect for photos 📸 Every corner is photogenic! The yellow sofa is so inviting.

The best part is they have activities to do, making it ideal for chilling with friends. The staff are also lovely and friendly 🥰

The prices are reasonable, not too expensive, great value for money. I recommend trying it, you might love it like I did 😆

P.S. Come in the evening for the best photos, the neon lights are so cool ✨
P.S.2. Come with your gang so you can order a lot and try everything 👯‍♀️
sample_reviews_en.author: Warut Boonpakdee

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to Wokwayy. Given its location, I recommend going by car or taxi. The restaurant is spacious and comfortable, filled with Pop Mart dolls and other items.
As it serves Chinese fusion cuisine,
I tried a variety of wonderful dishes.
Everything was sophisticated and delicious.
There are still many other dishes I want to try, so I'd like to go again.
The staff and owner were very kind.
Thank you very much.
sample_reviews_en.author: ふじー

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything we ordered was delicious, especially the crispy tacos and the Shanghai noodles stir-fried with XO fish sauce. The flavors were well-balanced and delicious. However, if you're planning to come here, you might want to bring a sweater because the air conditioning in the restaurant is quite cold.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apisak Phaigaroon

sample_reviews_en.text: Please go to the restaurant on a very empty stomach because the portions are incredibly large. One dish is more than enough to fill you up, so I missed out on trying other dishes. No worries though, there'll be next time! We'll go with a bigger group so we can try everything on the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Preeya Prasert

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was pretty good, the service was fast and efficient. They even had cute activities to play while waiting for the food. The chili paste fried rice with crispy pork was perfectly spicy and delicious. The tacos were also good, and the Korean ramen with fried chicken was tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanut Thiracharoensakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wok Wayy is a clean restaurant with a nice atmosphere.
The food is delicious and the service is good.
However, the restaurant could use some air purification. Upon entering, there's a slight smell of cooking. But overall, it's good. The restaurant is large with many tables.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tuchdao NellaLené

sample_reviews_en.text: I intended to review the food, but by the time I remembered to take pictures, I'd already eaten it all! It was delicious. So, I'll just share pictures of the atmosphere instead. It's a nice atmosphere with toys for the kids to play with.
sample_reviews_en.author: waritpol jiwasurat

sample_reviews_en.text: Everyone...for those who love noodle dishes but still can't decide which restaurant to go to, I recommend coming here. #wokwayy Delicious food, cool air conditioning, parking available, and free Wi-Fi for a long, enjoyable time!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sakorn Phiromthong

restaurants.name: Tham Na
restaurants.address:

133 Sam Sen Rd, Wat Sam Phraya, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Clean food, Good taste and Good for health too
(My feedback for Thamna in 6 year ago-Y2018)

Update in year 2024, Thamna change location to new building but still near the old one and change name of restaurant to "ร้านช้างกินผัก" in Thai (CHANG KIN PHNK)

The taste of foods still very very good.
But the nenu that i love it so much is Mango smoothy...

If you love vegan, this place very very good
#ชิมกับเชอร์
sample_reviews_th.author: Jirawat Shinawatrawangso

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don't mind the picture on Google Maps, the shop moved its location and does not look like the main photo in the profile. The place is now called Chang Kin Phuk (notice the elephant on the sign). Better to come by boat, motorbike, grab, or walk as there is ongoing major road construction. We came by boat to Phra Arthit pier and walked for less than 10 mins.

We love the mushroom larb tod dish so much we had to return for another go around! All of the Thai dishes that we tried were really good. Don’t expect your usual tourist dishes here, Chang Kin Phuk’s specialty are real local dishes and some Western dishes.

As some of the other reviewers say, this establishment is a level above most of what you see on that street (as quality, dish selection, and prices go).

We will definitely be back :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Alisa P

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is a delight if you are vegetarian and especially if you like mushrooms. They use a lot of Thai local vegetables. Small place, clean, not too crowded yet popular, fast service and reasonably priced for the quantity and quality. Try their fresh juices. Their brown rice is really good. I lived in the vicinity for a few months and happed to visit them quite often. They also have pastas, but I didn't try them. The local food is so delicious that never felt like trying anything else.
sample_reviews_en.author: prakriti naswa

sample_reviews_en.text: Recommended to us under a different name, but we eventually found it. This is an indoor, sit-down spot (compared to other vegetarian restaurants nearby which are mostly outdoors on stools). The food is fancier as well, this is definitely a much nicer restaurant than most of what we tried, with higher prices as well. Overall definitely worth it for an elevated version of Thai classics, and on some days the A/C is probably worth the premium on its own:)
sample_reviews_en.author: Bret Sikkink

sample_reviews_en.text: My sister and I found this restaurant and really enjoyed it. The food was well prepared and did not take longer than 10 minutes to reach our table. The food truly is organic. You can taste the freshness of the ingredients which were impeccable. Prices were reasonable and affordable compared to most restaurants. Highly recommend this establishment for vegetarians and vegans.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phoenix “Darriel” Ríszing

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely delicious! A must-visit for vegetarians.
"I had an amazing dining experience here. Every single dish was delicious and packed with flavor. You can really tell they use high-quality, fresh ingredients. Everything tasted so vibrant and well-prepared. I will definitely be coming back again! Highly recommended for anyone looking for top-notch vegetarian food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anuchit Sirirushneekorn

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best Delicious Vegan Food around that area. Menu is variety and healthy. We love all menu we ordered.Salad with soft tofu is great and tasty . Overall is above average . Price is reasonable. Parking lot is a little nit difficult. You have to park in samsen soi 5 and walk around 2 mins but it's ok. Highly recommend to all vegan lovers.
sample_reviews_en.author: TJ Jira

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very nice place, clean, staff is super friendly and the food is excellent.
They have a good selection of vegetarian and vegan options. The service is fast, I had to wait less than 10 minutes.
The ingredients are organic as far as possible. I definitely recommend the place and will come back as soon as I am back in the area😀
sample_reviews_en.author: Lucas Weiss

restaurants.name: Orihara Shoten
restaurants.address:

Park Lane 18 Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Highly recommended sake bar! The bar is located near BTS Ekkamai station. Here, you can order à la carte or opt for the sake buffet, priced at 1,100 baht net. The last order is at 8 pm, so it's better to arrive by 5 pm to have enough time to enjoy. They have four main categories of sake, and each category offers three items to choose from. If you choose the one called 'staff recommended,' it could be different each time, allowing you to try a variety of sake. While the food portions may not be extensive, they are delicious. Personally, I enjoy their noodles. The majority of customers are Japanese. Whether you're a sake enthusiast or have never tried it, this is the perfect place to experience a variety all at once.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gene

sample_reviews_en.text: Probably one of my favorite restaurants in Bangkok. A place that I frequent with a wide variety of Japanese liquor from sake to Plum liquor. They have a huge variety of skewers and Japanese food. The ambience and the staffs are great. It’s a great place where you can chill with friends and family. Their location is great. This place just gives a little something different from other Japanese places with skewers. I highly recommend in pairing your food with sake you either have a small, medium or large bottle depending on your preference. Prices might be on the higher side but it’s worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anak Kanokvichitra

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sake Sound Event was a lot of fun.  The place seems cool with tons of Sake!!  I mainly enjoyed the one from Yamagata.  We had a bottle of something else but I don't know where from, all good though!!
Staff is great with a mix of Japanese and gaining, so English is spoken without problem, and THEY'RE GOOD!  If you order a bottle you don't have to ask for a bucket of ice, they just figure you want it and bring it.
Great place, very cool.  They have a Yaki tori restaurant in back. I haven't tried it, but heard good thing from several friends!
sample_reviews_en.author: Suckadave

sample_reviews_en.text:
Oden and yakitori 😆 good combination for a chit-chat night. Too bad we do not drink, so didn't try any sake there 🙂 Anyway, food and service were nice. It was pretty crowded when I visited. The place was separated between sake bar in front and yakitori dedicated place at the back. Look real good.

This is a great bar for those who love sake. So many options.

The tables are not so comfortable 😂 if you don't get to sit by the counter. Other than that, it is a good place to hang out for a long talk 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: NITE Garngunn

sample_reviews_en.text: Nestled in the heart of Bangkok's Ekkamai district, this SAKE BAR is a hidden gem worth discovering. The intimate atmosphere makes it a perfect spot to unwind. The sake selection is impressive, offering both classic favorites and unique brews that thrilled my palate. It's clear they put thought into every detail, from the cozy lighting to the attentive service. Whether you're a sake enthusiast or just curious, this place is definitely worth a visit. Enjoy a taste of Japan right in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattarapol Hanpatchaiyakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Love this place for sake! You can enjoy the sake there or pick up a bottle to go. They have an extensive sale and umeshu selection and you can taste the different types of sake with their sake flight as well. Check out their special sake buffet menu until 8pm daily at only 990b. Tasty Japanese bar food like oden too.

You can also order yakitori from the yakitori restaurant, tori tama that is connected.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jacq

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great selection of reasonably priced sake.
The sakes are all stored in fridge which is critical to the condition and rarely adhered to in Bangkok.
They serve toriyaki from next store which is a famous franchise from Tokyo.
The skewers are made top notch quality and the price is also very reasonable.
Great ambience and vibe to hang out with friends and family.
sample_reviews_en.author: Terry Lau

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered 3 1.8L format sakes and 1 720ml format to be delivered to my hotel. While I am pleased with their response time in their deliver I am shocked by the age of the sakes they sent.

They were produced in May 2018 and Jan 2019, which means it’s 4 years old. Dreadful to keep and sell sakes that old.

Very disappointed!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Foo

restaurants.name: OXBO Bangkok
restaurants.address:

3rd floor, 123 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was a stand out restaurant and bar for us whilst in Bangkok. Boss on the bar was superb and created some wonderful cocktails you have to try them. All with a story.

The food was on another level. We had a bone marrow and a toastada starter and they were out of this world tasty. They came on wooden blocks with a story of what it was under them.

Then we had the buttery softest octopus  I've ever had along with river prawn and pork belly. Every dish outstanding in its own right,  full of flavours and cooked to perfection but together as a dinner for the 3 people it was unbelievably tasty all round.

You have to experience this restaurant along with an amazing view of the chopraya River thru the high glass windows as you eat,  or of the chefs at work in 6 the teppenyaki style cook side seating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noël

sample_reviews_en.text: The view is fantastic dining in the chefs area is off the charts.  Don't miss out on this fantastic restaurant with a very diverse menu and fantastic drink selection. The staff is super welcoming. If you're a Hilton honors member you get a great discount also. We went through so many appetizers we never made it to the main course. The chefs sit there and talk to you and explain all the stuff that they're making where they're from their backgrounds.  Definitely put this on your priority list when visiting Bangkok.  Don't miss the bone marrow and the duck on the appetizer menu. They were out of this world.  And one of the staff there, her name is Film. She was one of the kindest humans you will ever meet in a restaurant. Make sure and stop and say hi.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donnie Ozenne

sample_reviews_en.text: A great place for celebrating your loved ones, they will make it a day to remember forever. I booked a table for my husband’s birthday in advance, and even though we got there late, we didn’t lose our reservation. The food was delicious , we enjoyed every dish. I loved their complimentary cucumber drink, I wish it was on the menu, l would’ve ordered it again. The staff were lovely, and recommended amazing drinks. They even singed happy birthday for my husband when the cake came🥰. The view, the music, the interior design, all complement each other and made our night beautiful. I recommend this place 10000%.
sample_reviews_en.author: Catherine shaheen

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have eaten at many places like this that try to do too much, or crowd dishes with unnecessary pairings. This chef has intentionally balanced his dishes with focus on the quality of the main items.

We had the gnocchi, and waygu Short rib which was cooked to perfection with a slight charred crust. Both 5 ⭐, sticky banana pudding dessert 5 ⭐

The server was very patient with my Taiwanese girlfriend who likes to take her time photographing each item.

For a hotel restaurant I was blown away by the service quality, and attention to details.

****Hidden gem on the riverside***
sample_reviews_en.author: Scotty D

sample_reviews_en.text: My wife and I enjoyed celebrating her birthday with friends at OXBO Bangkok this weekend. The staff were wonderful and our hostesses Jeab and Bee provided excellent wine and menu suggestions for us to enjoy together. When they learned that it was her birthday they were kind enough to bring out a nice chocolate cake and the staff sang. It was a joyful evening with great food, wines, and service. I highly recommend this venue for celebrations or any dinner occasion that you want to impress and have a guaranteed good time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Moore

sample_reviews_en.text:
5 star for all, the establishment is immaculate. The staff are out of this world, even the ones that had nothing to do with our table. Been here 5 times in the past year and doesn’t compare to many fine dining restaurants in Australia, it’s better than most.
I have food allergies and they catered superbly.
We never miss out on our visit here whenever in Bangkok. No idea why there is not a line coming out of this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kon Nasopoulos

sample_reviews_en.text: A very nice restaurant with a direct view of the river. The food quality is okay. However, what is very bothersome and discourages lingering is the extremely low temperature. Some guests, especially the women in summer dresses, were even given blankets by the staff. This leaves a bad taste in my mouth and would be a reason for me not to visit the restaurant again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Henrik_ M

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent birthday dinner at Oxbo. Kudos to the team for the great service, especially Mr Best and Ms Kran! Thank you for arranging the honeymoon table decor and complimentary birthday cake! The food was also excellent, with yummy tomato and walnut bread for starters, and the steaks were well cooked: slightly crispy on the outside and tender and juicy inside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Louise Neo

restaurants.name: STONE Craft Cafe
restaurants.address:

60, 168 Soi Bongkot 6/4, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great vibes, food was delicious, it’s great to find a place that uses beef tallow for their cooking, the fried rice in beef tallow was amazing, I highly recommend the place and the steak was great. The staff are friendly and I will definitely come back. As a big steak eater from Australia I can suggest their steak can match us back home.

Give this place a try and you’ll be back for more. They have PlayStation 5, pool table, coffee, alcohol and a tattoo artist who does all the paintings in the cafe.
sample_reviews_en.author: Better Nutrition

sample_reviews_en.text: We came to this restaurant based on someone’s recommendation. The presentation was great, and everything was very tasty. However, there was one downside for us — a weed shop next door had a strong smell coming from it. Some people might actually enjoy it 😀, but for us it was a minus, so we probably wouldn’t come back because of this. We really enjoyed the food, but many menu items were not available, and they also didn’t have the craft beer I came for.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maryna Y.

sample_reviews_en.text: When I went in, I thought about leaving because it smelled like marijuana, but the atmosphere and interior were good, just like the reviews said. The food wasn't bad either. The tonkatsu curry was delicious, and the krapao moo sap was a little saltier than other places, but it wasn't so bad that I couldn't eat it.
sample_reviews_en.author: 내꿈은주총꾼

sample_reviews_en.text:
The curry was Japanese-style and overall delicious.

However, the steak had a meaty odor that I found disappointing.

Also, because the restaurant is right next to a marijuana shop, I could smell it indirectly, which was uncomfortable. Those with sensitive skin might want to keep this in mind.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mia B

sample_reviews_en.text: The food and ambiance were amazing!! The stoner breakfast was fantastic – the steak was top-notch, the jazz music, the leather sofas, and the comfortable air conditioning made it a delightful surprise to discover this hidden gem the moment you opened the door.
sample_reviews_en.author: 施又寧

sample_reviews_en.text: Food tastes amazing, service was extremely fast and the restaurant had a very jazzy vibe. Would have been even better had I came when they had live singers and not a random Tuesday. Huge recommendation to anyone looking to eat some steak
sample_reviews_en.author: Mel Ty

sample_reviews_en.text: There are so many beautiful, chic, and cool cafes here. It's very hot outside, so come in to relax and unwind with a refreshing iced espresso. The cafe is stylish and trendy, the service is great, and the artwork is stunning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chutinat Nganpaisansamrit

sample_reviews_en.text: We had our first meal of the day at 2 pm. They also have an all-day breakfast. The staff were friendly and lovely, and the air conditioning was very cool. They also had a promotion that included a complimentary cacao salad.
sample_reviews_en.author: tookata Pattaya

restaurants.name: Pad Lay - Thai Stir Fry & Seafoods (ผัดเล)
restaurants.address:

331 3 Soi Buakhao, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chang Wat Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
came to Pad Lay with no expectations & everything turned out so good! 🤩 The place is quite small but cozy. I tried:
- Tom Yum Red Ocean (฿520): flavorful spices, not too sour, big fresh prawns & seafood. We chose level 2 and it was already quite spicy
- Pad Lay's Fry Chicken & Cashew Nuts (฿160): tasty but nothing special
- Thai Grilled Pork Collar (฿140): super juicy, savory, and delicious. TOTALLY LOVE IT!
- Rad-Na Shrimps & Squids (฿220): big portion (enough for 2) with lots of veggies

Would love to come back & definitely recommend this place! ☺️👌🏼
sample_reviews_th.author: Yosepha Ayumi Mulyosusanto

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wow!!! If you’re looking for authentic Thai food that feels truly home made, this place is a gem. The cooking was absolutely excellent — full of rich, well-balanced flavours that tasted traditional and genuinely authentic. Every dish arrived in generous portions with really good quality ingredients, and you could tell everything was made with care and experience.
The amazing ladies in the kitchen clearly know what they’re doing. The food had that comforting home-cooked style that’s hard to find, while still being packed with flavour and beautifully presented. From the first bite to the last, everything was fresh, well seasoned, and incredibly satisfying.
What made the experience even better was the atmosphere created by the staff. Everyone had such a lovely, welcoming energy and made us feel comfortable from the moment we walked in. Warm service, authentic cooking, and fantastic flavours — definitely a restaurant worth coming back to.10/10
sample_reviews_en.author: Kane Dark

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great place. We visited Pad Lay in Pattaya as a group of four and had a wonderful experience. From the moment we arrived, the atmosphere felt warm and welcoming.

We ordered Pad Thai and Tom Yum, and both dishes were absolutely delicious. The Pad Thai was full of flavor, perfectly cooked, and nicely balanced — not too sweet, not too salty. The Tom Yum was rich, aromatic, and had just the right amount of spice. You could really taste how fresh the ingredients were.

The portions were generous, and everything was served quickly. The staff were friendly and attentive, which made the whole experience even better.

If you’re in Pattaya and looking for authentic Thai food, Pad Lay is definitely worth visiting. We would happily come back again.

The Thai curry with jasmine rice and the Thai tea were absolutely delicious, and the red curry was just perfect. If you’re an Indian traveler and prefer cooked food, I’d suggest skipping the steamed prawns and going for the curries instead – they’re truly mouthwatering.

Padlay is a must-visit in Pattaya for anyone who loves flavorful food in a beautiful setting. Highly recommended!

This restaurant is a true gem, especially if you love seafood. The prawns were incredibly fresh, perfectly cooked, and full of flavor. Every bite was juicy showing the quality of prawn and the chef’s expertise.

The prawn dish is an absolute must-try — rich in taste, beautifully presented, and worth every penny. The ambiance is pleasant, and the staff are friendly and attentive, which makes the dining experience even better.

If you’re a seafood lover or simply craving delicious prawns, this place should definitely be on your list. Highly recommended!

restaurants.name: Baan Kook Kai
restaurants.address:

32 ซอยจุฬา 3 Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
A solid 4-star review for Baan Kook Kai (บ้านกุ๊กไก่), highlighting its great street food vibe, famous Mama noodles, and crispy pork, while being a fantastic—and less stressful—alternative to other spots in the Banthat Thong area.
I stopped by Baan Kook Kai on Banthat Thong Road and had a really great experience. The bustling, open-air setup gives off that authentic Bangkok street-dining vibe that makes you feel like you're on a true vacation.The standout for me was the Mama Tom Yum. The broth is incredibly flavorful, rich, and packed with generous toppings. I also highly recommend ordering the Crispy Pork—it is perfectly crunchy on the outside while remaining melt-in-your-mouth tender inside. The portions are massive and reasonably priced, making it fantastic value for your money.The service was surprisingly fast and efficient despite the crowd, which is a huge plus. If you're craving some of the area's iconic late-night noodles but want to skip the massive queues at the more famous shops nearby, this is an excellent, delicious alternative. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_th.author: Edwin Goh

sample_reviews_th.text:
Visited Baan Kook Kai (บ้านกุ๊กไก่) and really enjoyed the food. The dishes were authentic, flavourful, and freshly prepared. The portions were good, and the prices were reasonable for the quality.

One area that could be improved is the service. The staff were efficient, but they didn’t come across as particularly friendly or welcoming. A warmer attitude would have made the overall dining experience even better.

That said, the excellent food makes this restaurant worth visiting, and I’d still recommend it to anyone looking for authentic Thai food in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_th.author: Lester Koh

sample_reviews_th.text:
Delicious food and authentic taste. The broth is rich and full of flavor, and the noodles have the perfect texture. Friendly service and reasonable prices. Highly recommended when you visit! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
(อร่อยมากครับ / ค่ะ! Delicious!)
sample_reviews_th.author: Nguyễn Thành Đông

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a popular Thai restaurant, known for its signature seafood noodle dish. I came here to try it out, but honestly, the taste was quite average. The dish costs around 350 baht and is basically a mix of seafood and pork. It's more of a hype than actual value.

The place is quite hot and noisy, and although I didn’t have to wait today, it seems like there can be a wait during busy hours. The restaurant doesn’t offer Wi-Fi and only accepts cash—no card or mobile payment options—which makes it a bit inconvenient.

While the staff were polite and the menu has a decent variety, the overall experience didn’t feel worth a special trip. It’s okay for a one-time visit if you're nearby, but I wouldn’t come back regularly.

Ratings:

Food: 3.5/5 (variety is good, but flavor is average)

Service: 3.5/5 (limited payment options, no Wi-Fi)

Environment: 3/5 (hot and noisy)

Overall: Around 3/5
sample_reviews_en.author: Lis Horning

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited on weekdays at dinner time, but it was very crowded. There were already 5-6 groups waiting ahead.
However, staffs were very nice and giving the accurate instructions so we waited only 5-10 mins.

The famous Tom Yam Kung Noodle was a must order!
7 out of 8 tables around us were ordering the same one, and I understood why. Soup was not too spicy, many herbs and some rimes were adding extra flavor. I can literally drink the entire soup.

Shrimps, meat balls, fried chicken, and so on. Raw eggs make it more creamy and less spicy.

[Garlic shrimp]
Tasted so good. Lemon grass  added good flavor.

Even though there were plenty of customers, staffs were well taking care of them. They also immediately clean tables after customers leave, which makes it smoother operation.
Will visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Toko

sample_reviews_en.text: Saturday night, fabulous street vibe, the atmosphere was excellent, restaurant was packed with an endless queue that kept moving. Staff fantastic people efficient rushed off their feet busy busy yet still friendly and personable. We were so lucky had to wait maybe 10 min after we sat down the line was all the way around the restaurant. The crispy pork was outstanding light fluffy soft tender meat with a firm tasty crispy crust, near perfection. The fish soup was delicious hot pepper and very fishy, no bones in the flesh big tick. The greens had spicy sweet sauce which was extremely moorish. All in this was an excellent experience both the restaurant, the staff and the general area. Buzzing and vibrant. If you can you definitely should.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joseph Mercurio

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is conveniently located and easy to get to. It's at a busy intersection, very crowded with tourists like us.

The other day, my family tried the Mama Noodles, but we were a bit disappointed. The noodles were just regular, the toppings were decent, but the price of around 750B was high compared to the quality of the food.
The fried rice was soft and soggy, not dry and plump like other fried rice dishes, whereas the quality at other local fried rice restaurants in Thailand is much higher.
The restaurant only accepts cash and doesn't accept bank transfers, which is inconvenient.
The experience was just to get a taste of the flavors, but I probably wouldn't eat there again because it wasn't anything particularly special.

The portions are HUGE, so one meal can easily be shared between 3–4 people, which makes the prices even more affordable and worth it.

Just a heads-up: "be prepared for a waiting list because this place is almost always busy. But trust me, it's worth the wait."

I literally bring every friend who visits me here because they have to try it at least once! 😆

restaurants.name: Hidden Bangkok Bistro จอดรถยนต์ปากซอยเทอดไท 26
restaurants.address:

872, 8 Soi Thoet Thai 26, Talat Phlu, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This café offers one of the best views of Wat Paknam Phasi Charoen and its iconic Giant Buddha. Located directly across the canal, it provides a clear and stunning view of the Buddha without needing to take a boat ride.

What I love most about this place is the atmosphere. You can sit by the canal, watch boats passing by, and enjoy a glimpse of everyday Thai life. The surrounding area is a real local community with schools, homes, and residents going about their daily routines, making it feel authentic and unique compared to more touristy spots.

The drinks are decent, and the service is good. However, the café is very popular, so it can get quite crowded and noisy, especially on weekends. You’ll find both Thai and international tourists visiting throughout the day.

I highly recommend coming on a weekday morning if you prefer a quieter experience. Sunset is also a beautiful time to visit, as the golden light over the canal and the Giant Buddha creates a breathtaking view.

Overall, this is an excellent spot for anyone looking to enjoy a beautiful canal-side view, take photos of the Giant Buddha, and experience a genuine local Thai atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: ladda sabaichit

sample_reviews_en.text:
This café and restaurant is a fantastic spot with a stunning view of the giant Buddha statue at Wat Paknam. The ground floor houses the café, the first floor is the main dining area, while the second floor offers both indoor seating and a balcony where you can enjoy drinks with an even better view.

The spring rolls were excellent, with a thin, crispy wrapper, and the fried chicken wings were perfectly crispy and delicious. Both are highly recommended.

The best seats are the ones facing the river, so it’s worth arriving before sunset to secure a table and enjoy the beautiful scenery. It’s a wonderful place to relax in air-conditioned comfort while taking in one of Bangkok’s most iconic views. Definitely worth a visit. Plus point is the view and not their foods or drinks.

We were fortunate to witness monks releasing fish into the river, which added to the peaceful atmosphere.

For car park, the entrance to this alley has a private parking space with minimal fee.
sample_reviews_en.author: HC_KH%

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited Hidden Bistro today. Finding the place was a bit challenging, as there wasn’t a clear sign along the way. The bistro has three floors—the first is a café, the second is a restaurant, and the third appears to be mainly for enjoying the view.
When we arrived, it was already quite crowded, which is understandable since many people come to experience the view. We initially planned to go to the second floor, but we were informed that it is a restaurant area and requires ordering food. After checking the menu, we found the prices a bit high for our preference, so we decided to stay on the first floor instead.
This is just my personal opinion, as everyone has different tastes and expectations. The coffee was great, and the staff were attentive and welcoming. Overall, for us, it felt a bit more hyped than expected, but it may still be worth visiting if you’re curious about the view.
sample_reviews_en.author: Beverlyn Yague

sample_reviews_en.text:
I loved this place, I visited for a quick lunch and came for the view. It’s VERY busy but staff were so friendly and welcoming!

I don’t agree with anyone being annoyed that they can’t go upstairs without paying for food, it’s a cafe/restaurant, not a free photo spot.

If they allowed this, it would be crammed and it helps keep actually eating in the restaurant a pleasant experience.

I ordered the chicken cashew nut with rice, which was really delicious, fresh and probably the best I’ve had in Bangkok, however the price is a bit steep, 400 baht for just a small dish (no drink) which is usually around 250 everywhere else, but I guess you pay that price for the view.

Overall, it’s a simple cafe with delicious food and lovely staff, and the view is incredible, would definitely visit again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kashima Doherty

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had an amazing time at Hidden Bangkok Bistro! 🍹✨

The drinks were refreshing and the staff were super friendly and welcoming 😊. Whether you're Thai or a foreign visitor, communication is smooth and easy, which makes the whole experience even better 🌏💬.

One thing I really loved is that they can help arrange boat trips to other places 🚤 and even offer private tours 🛶. Super convenient if you want to explore Bangkok from a different perspective!

And the highlight? The giant Buddha statue 🙏✨. It's absolutely stunning, peaceful, and truly a beautiful place to admire and pay respects.

Great food, great drinks, great people, and great vibes. Highly recommended if you're looking for a unique Bangkok experience! ❤️🇹🇭
sample_reviews_en.author: Nova Nova

sample_reviews_en.text: It was crowded, and on a rainy day, there were no seats available, so we had to sit outside. It was drizzling! This restaurant in Thailand isn't cheap; a drink cost 160 baht and was terrible! The mango sticky rice portion was pitifully small, yet it was expensive at 150 baht. Even with drinks, you couldn't go upstairs; you had to order food separately there, and the food was quite expensive. Even upstairs, there wasn't guaranteed a window seat! They even had someone guarding the stairwell, and the service was poor… Plus, this isn't the best spot to photograph the Wat Phra That Doi Suthep Buddha; power lines obstruct the view, making it impossible to get a full-body shot of the Buddha.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wins

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great experience

I had this on my list to do and I’m so glad I managed to visit before I departed Thailand

Atmosphere:

Two floors, one for cafe related purchases and the upper for food related. Both areas give access to the Buddha vibes but I personally feel like ordered food would give you better views upstairs

Food:

Create offering, menu isn’t too big but it’s also not too so small. I love that.

Scenery:

As you can guess, the vibes are special lol.

Overall,

Great place to sit and relax while getting some great photos. I would also recommend walking around the neighbourhood, it’s such an interesting area
sample_reviews_en.author: Andre

sample_reviews_en.text:
• A nice cafe and restaurant next to the canal with a beautiful view of the Big Buddha.

• With a 4.2-star rating, we did not expect much from the food, but it turned out to be better than expected. The menu choices are limited, but the taste is authentic and satisfying.

• Some dishes may seem expensive, such as the Fried Rice with Pork (Khao Pad Moo) at 300 THB, but the portion is large enough for 2–3 people.

• The atmosphere and canal-side view are the main highlights of this place.

• Visitors can park their cars at Wat Paknam Phasi Charoen and walk around 10 minutes through a small alley to reach the bistro.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongpit Pinsai

restaurants.name: NoodleBar (Spicy Crispy Pork Noodle)
restaurants.address:

1239 Phahonyothin Rd, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honestly, this didn't quite stand out when I first ate here but I'll have to admit it's grown on me over time. I've found myself coming here increasingly by default because it's the only noodle joint that remains open on a Sunday after 8pm when everything else around has closed after my evening foot massage ! More importantly, the service and food has been consistently good each time and with easy access directly below BTS Ari too.

First off, no English menu. Don't worry, if you can't "read" pictures, the helpful staff speak enough English to fulfill your every whim. I've tried several items on the menu but have been gravitating toward the intriguingly named 'Cooklick' the last couple of times.

Despite it's exotic name, the noodle dish is surprisingly simple and familiar in composition. The slender egg noodles are cooked al dente and served with the usual condiments of fried garlic, chopped nuts,  beansprouts, spring onions and a perfectly cooked onsen style egg. The centerpiece, however has to be the crispy crunchy fried pork belly. No need to put lipstick on this one, it's perfect ending to an evening after massage. A solid 4.5 stars!
sample_reviews_en.author: D Yew

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has two floors and primarily sells Tom Yum noodles with a variety of toppings. They also have rice dishes, but many were sold out on the day I visited.

You can customize your dish by ticking the boxes for ingredients you don't want or adding extras. It's very customizable!

Orders are processed via QR code, and you can call staff to pay using your phone. Liking their Facebook page gets you a 5 baht discount per person.

Overall, I loved the "crispy pork" because it was well-seasoned, crispy and fluffy without being too hard. The clear Tom Yum broth was rich and flavorful, the minced pork was good, the boiled pork was tender, the meatballs were okay, and the bouncy pork was tasty. Another favorite was the "crispy pork belly," which was deep-fried until perfectly crunchy. It was deliciously crispy – just the way I like it!

If you're in the Ari area, I highly recommend it. It's near Ari BTS station, on Soi 1 opposite La Villa.
sample_reviews_en.author: NiNG648

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Tom Yum noodle shop is located near BTS Ari station, right next to the escalator.

The shop is decorated in a striking blue color scheme. They offer noodle, rice, and other à la carte dishes. Their signature dish is crispy pork.

Today, I ordered flat noodle Tom Yum with pork, choosing the creamy version with fresh milk. The flavor was spicy and delicious. The flat noodles were excellent, and they gave a generous amount of minced pork. Every spoonful was delicious; I finished the whole bowl before I knew it!

Fried pork dumplings were 35 baht each. Crispy and tasty (though the serving dish was disproportionate to the portion, making it look less appealing).

The prices are on the higher side, but the food is so delicious, it's worth trying! 👍🏻👍🏻

- Ordering is done by scanning a QR code to view the menu.
- The shop has two floors with plenty of seating.
- Cash and QR code payments are accepted.
- Food prices do not include VAT.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanchana Sawangthanakit

sample_reviews_en.text:
A terrible dining experience. The staff didn't speak basic English. We had to scan a QR code to order, but if we didn't select the correct option, the prompts were in Thai. When we asked a staff member for help, they just gave a brief reply and walked away. Another staff member was clearing the table, and when I went over to ask her, she just pointed me in another direction and no one paid any attention. Eventually, an older staff member helped us place the order, which was really difficult.

The food wasn't particularly delicious but was extremely expensive. One plate of roast pork noodles + one plate of pork offal noodles + six slices of roast pork cost almost 280 baht. I won't go there again. It was expensive and there was no service, but the food was okay, so it was acceptable. This place is...unremarkable.
sample_reviews_en.author: CHOI KENG UN

sample_reviews_en.text:
It seems like the restaurant just opened. They have a modern ordering system where you can scan a QR code to view the menu and order at your table without needing to call a waiter. However, paying the bill was very slow; we had to wait for a waiter.

The price, in my opinion, is high compared to the portion size, but that's probably compensated for by the location and air conditioning, as the restaurant is right at the foot of the Ari BTS station.

The taste was just okay for me, but the dipping sauces were delicious. The one that's like a seafood dipping sauce but without lime was unique! 555
sample_reviews_en.author: Mai Jida

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stopped by here because the name caught my attention, and honestly the bowl looked too good to ignore. I ordered the spicy crispy pork noodles with minced pork and a soft boiled egg.

However, the portion felt a bit too small for me, especially considering the price. The taste was not bad, but overall it felt quite average and not particularly memorable. The crispy pork was genuinely crispy and well done, but it was not something I had never tasted before. Still, the staff were friendly and the atmosphere was casual and comfortable, making it a decent place for a quick meal around the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chen E.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was okay, tasty, but the service was slow. I've been a customer since their old location moved to this building. I have a complaint about the government's co-payment scheme. The restaurant doesn't accept all menu items, and only certain categories are included. Even though there's a sign, it's not clear enough to understand. It's a bit ambiguous, and when I asked the staff repeatedly, they just pointed to the sign without explaining clearly. It's my fault for not reading it clearly, but I won't be coming back because I feel they aren't sincere about the co-payment sign.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mikki

sample_reviews_en.text:
#CelebratingCrispyPorkForever Located on the 2nd floor of Ari BTS station, in the air-conditioned seating area. It gets quite crowded around lunchtime. The food is delicious, both the rice and noodle dishes. The crispy pork is tasty, not chewy, and very crispy. However, personally, I think the noodle portion is a bit small; one bowl isn't enough to fill you up.
🌟 Recommended: Dry Tom Yum Noodles with Crispy Pork
💸 Prices start at 69 THB.
🚗 No parking available, but it's conveniently located near the BTS.
