sample_reviews_en.text: I tried the Chicken Biryani at GMQ Food Halal and it was absolutely delicious! The rice was perfectly cooked, aromatic, and full of flavor. The chicken pieces were tender, juicy, and blended beautifully with the spices. Every bite had that …
sample_reviews_en.author: H ahmad Ali

sample_reviews_en.text: the burger was really good the french fries were really nice they're perfect crispy and soft, warm ready for eating. The cooker gave me a cake that he tried to make it for selling. I tried it, it was super delicious! thank you
sample_reviews_en.author: ORACHA SUKKASEM

restaurants.name: Khao Tom Pla Plaeng Nam - Congee
restaurants.address:

560 Yaowarat Rd, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
This is an old-style fish porridge shop in Yaowarat (Chinatown), open for a long time. Prices start at 150฿. The shop is simple, street food style. The broth is clear, fragrant, and made with fish bones, without any fishy smell.

Getting there: Take the MRT to Wat Mangkon station and walk into Soi Plaeng Nam. Parking is very difficult due to traffic. Walking or using public transportation is recommended.
sample_reviews_th.author: Gofu_Gif

sample_reviews_th.text: I've eaten at this restaurant many times. I usually order one dish for 100฿ per bowl, such as fish rice soup for 100฿ and oyster rice soup for 100฿. When I went to eat again, the restaurant was close to closing time. They had run out of …
sample_reviews_th.author: Siriporn Thongpaknum

sample_reviews_en.text:
This fish porridge stall is set up on the sidewalk with tables and chairs. There are several tables available, and they also offer noodles.

The mixed fish porridge costs 150 baht (June 30, 2025). It includes sea bass, oysters, shrimp, and squid, but doesn't include braised pork. You have to ask the stall owner if you want it. The fish is fresh, the sea bass skin is crispy. The shrimp aren't very big. The broth is clear and served piping hot. The fermented soybean dipping sauce is salty, but the pickled chili in vinegar complements it well.

Payment can be made via bank transfer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponchagarj Ngamukos

sample_reviews_en.text: This old-style fish porridge in Yaowarat starts at 150 baht. They use fresh sea bass and give a generous portion of fish, but the broth is quite bland and lacks aroma. The taste is geared towards those who don't like spicy food. Compared to the price, it's not considered good value, but it's reasonable considering the prices in the Yaowarat area. They set up tables on the sidewalk, by the roadside, with no air conditioning and no parking lot. You can park a little on the street. Taking a bus is highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: too chinnakorn

sample_reviews_en.text: The ingredients were incredibly fresh, with no fishy smell at all. The fish and seafood were perfectly cooked. The price was reasonable. The owner was lovely, a great salesperson, constantly calling out to customers with a smile. The staff were enthusiastic and quick to accommodate any requests. The flavors are suitable for those who prefer milder tastes, and you can add more seasoning if you like. I wish the condiments had lids for hygiene reasons, as we were eating at tables by the roadside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chusanang Trisateinpong

sample_reviews_en.text:
At first I was like: all right. Nice classy Khao Tom place. But he soup is ok. A bit blend. But I seasoned it myself a bit: some chilies, some vinegar, some pepper and fish sauce. And what can I say: it was delicious. Really tasty soup. Slightly more expensive than other places around. But still ok (150 Baht for a generous portion).

It‘s a classic street food place in the beginning of Yaowarat. Good first stop on your food tour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you can speak Teochew, you get special priority in the queue.
We, being descendants who can't speak it, order from the staff and are told to sit and wait at a table. But when we sit and wait, it's mostly elderly Teochew people ordering takeout. Those of us have to keep waiting, and when the staff taking orders finally arrive, they get called away to help with something else. It's a waste of time and frustrating.
sample_reviews_en.author: วรวิทย์ คุณกิตติรักษ์

sample_reviews_en.text: This famous fish porridge shop in Yaowarat has normal prices, not too expensive. I ordered the mixed porridge; the ingredients were fresh, using grouper fish, but the broth was quite bland and lacked aroma. They set up tables on the sidewalk, by the roadside, with no air conditioning and no parking. The shop said you could double-park, which seems to be the case, but it causes traffic congestion.
sample_reviews_en.author: phat Ounchalanon

restaurants.name: Crepe cafe' by เครปแป้งอร่อย
restaurants.address:

199/9 Ramkhamhaeng 112 Alley, Saphan Sung, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Regarding the food, the crepes were delicious and high-quality; I'd give them full marks. If I could give 10 stars, I would!

!!However, due to the staff, I'm deducting 3 stars!! As of March 29, 2026!!

The order was taken correctly, but then incorrectly. The first time was okay, no hard feelings, no change given.
But the second time (different day, different time) was also incorrect.
The excuse given was that they were still learning to make them. This excuse is unacceptable in a business-like food business.

Another small issue, but customer convenience is always paramount in a business.

A customer was waiting to use the restroom when the staff member opened the door, stood there fixing their hair, getting dressed, and playing on their phone. The customer waited outside, even though they knew someone was waiting. This highlights the need for attentiveness and customer convenience.

I want the owner to prioritize the well-being of their staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachata Pidkanphai

sample_reviews_en.text:
We've been eating here since the shop first opened at its old location until it moved to its new location across from the lake. It's our favorite crepe; the batter is thin, crispy, and delicious. We always order the shredded pork and chili paste filling.
Lately, we've only been eating here occasionally.
Today, we ordered the same thing.
The batter is thin and crispy, but this time the flavor of the batter was different. It was both sweet and salty.
Combined with the sweet and salty shredded pork, the sweet and salty chili paste, and the sweet mayonnaise, the taste was a mix of sweet and salty. It was delicious at first,
but after a while, it became too much – just too sweet and salty.

As for the staff, the service was exactly as the other reviews described, haha.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akira_明

sample_reviews_en.text: The crepes here are really delicious light, soft, and with no flour aftertaste at all, which shows the quality of the batter. Every bite tastes clean and well-balanced. There’s also a restaurant right next to it, making it a convenient stop if you’re in the area. There's a lake across the street where you can feed the fish 🐠🐟🐠🐟🐟
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrew V

sample_reviews_en.text: The crepe batter at this shop is absolutely delicious! Since I tried it here, I haven't eaten at any other crepe shop. I love the blueberry cheesecake jam; they make their own jam, not store-bought, it's amazing. The staff are also very friendly and lovely. I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: PapaiiR PP

sample_reviews_en.text: Both the savory and sweet crepes are delicious. The batter is truly amazing – thin and crispy (I've tried the Nutella & almond crepe and the spinach & cheese crepe). Parking is a bit difficult, and the shop is small with few tables, so it's more suitable for take-away.
sample_reviews_en.author: N K

sample_reviews_en.text:
The batter is delicious, perfectly crispy. The crepe itself is very well made, and the filling is just right.

However, there's a bit of a wait because they put a lot of effort into making it. Parking is available in front of the shop, and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ao Trafford

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small beverage shop in Sammakorn selling coffee, butter beer (a drink from Harry Potter), and pretty good crepes. The shop has small tables for 4-5 people, opposite the lake, next to a restaurant, and within a house compound.
Overall, it's a decent place to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eakachin Techapongkul

sample_reviews_en.text: The crepes are delicious! The batter is very crispy and the fillings are flavorful. The Taiwanese tea is fragrant. The staff provides good service. It's a small shop that's quite busy. There's indoor and outdoor seating. Parking is available on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuch S

restaurants.name: Swiss Corner Restaurant
restaurants.address:

163, Ramkhamhaeng 112 Alley, 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recommend this restaurant!
You can enjoy this without having to fly all the way to Switzerland 😊
Cheese fondue is a recommended dish that I've wanted to try for a long time. I had it in Switzerland during the winter and it was great 👍
This one was really good. The one I had in Switzerland had a stronger smell and flavor. This restaurant has adjusted it to suit Thai tastes perfectly.
We ordered the set menu for two people for 1,400 baht. It included fried pork, boiled vegetables, buttered potatoes, and bread. We were so full! This dish is also delicious with pickled cucumbers and chili daffodils. I'll definitely go back again 👍
#EatingAroundWithJom😆
sample_reviews_en.author: Jommy Wisakha

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nothing to complain about. The little appetizer was on the house and the waitress was helpful with explaining the menu. I was only going to buy some cheese and charcuterie (which they sell at pretty good prices) from here at first but then we decided to dine in as well. If you're not very financially comfortable, it does feel somewhat pricey though not to the extent of being unreasonable.

So, a good place to eat out at every once in a while especially when you have a craving for nice and hearty food. Many choices of drinks to go with it too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nopp

sample_reviews_en.text: Enjoy authentic Swiss flavors without flying to Switzerland. Even if you're dining alone, you can have a satisfying meal. The salad is crisp, fresh, clean, and perfectly dressed with a light dressing. The Cordon Bleu is heavenly, with perfectly crisp vegetables and a harmonious blend of cheese and ham. The ingredients are sourced fresh daily, ensuring the taste remains excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pasawut O.

sample_reviews_en.text: A Swiss restaurant run by authentic Swiss people (the owner is Swiss). The atmosphere is great, the space is quite large with plenty of tables. Personally, I found the food delicious and to my liking, but the portions are quite large, so I recommend ordering with a bit of patience. The prices are very reasonable. The desserts are also incredibly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarunna Supol

sample_reviews_en.text:
Some restaurants back home in Switzerland could learn a thing or two from this place.

The food was superbly cooked and presented.

A lovely location just outside the center of Bangkok, but close to the airport.

Chef Daniel personally greeted us at the entrance, and his staff is also very friendly.

Highly recommended! 🇨🇭🍽️🟰⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Bravo! 👏🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Martin Enz

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything was great, I'd love to come back! 👍 Excellent quality and very good value for money in Bangkok. 👏 Large selection and changing specials. Highly recommended! 🙏

Everything was great, I'd love to come back! 👍 Excellent quality and very good value for money in Bangkok. 👏 Large selection and changing specials. Highly recommended! 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Bruno Müller

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great, cozy Swiss restaurant with authentic flavor. We had the traditional cheese fondue and it was perfection. Service was wonderful and it felt like we escaped to a little Swiss chalet.
Highly recommend this to anyone looking for perfect fondue.
Also, the Swiss coffee, espresso was awesome.
sample_reviews_en.author: NARA NARA NARA

sample_reviews_en.text:
I always enjoy coming back to this Thai restaurant.

Since I've been living in rural Thailand for a while now, it's a nice change to eat schnitzel and fries.

The food is really good and the price is reasonable.

The owner and staff are always friendly.

Highly recommended! 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: Raul

restaurants.name: PrumPlum Stand
restaurants.address:

857 Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Smart casual is a good way to describe the drinking and dining experience at PrumPlum Stand (PPS) making it our fave kind of night out spot.

It was love at first sight because from the road, the elegant PPS shophouse stands alone from other buildings on the road. Enter the cool space and you could imagine Wong Kar-wai filming a scene in this small, but groovy spot.

The interiors ooze style, cool, intimacy, and romance. I also like places where you can eat and drink at the bar.

Drinks-wise, PPS has an impressive range of umeshu (plum wine) options but I stayed with the humble Highball. The food menu includes a good selection of Japanese snacks and classic dishes - and a spicy Burmese salad - that were all delicious. I wish the portions could have been slightly bigger but that’s a minor quibble.

PPS is also pretty affordable and it is a place I will definitely return to. Finally, the service was brilliant - friendly, warm, and courteous - like you were dining with good friends. What more could you ask for?
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Meng Yee

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a shop I stumbled upon while browsing Google Maps during my travels. I was able to taste various Japanese plum wines and dishes.

While listening to the friendly staff member's explanations, I ordered a sampler set featuring four different plum wines along with some food. The staff member was professional and kind as they explained the brewing process and detailed flavors of each wine.

When I mentioned which plum wine I liked best, they recommended a similar one, so I ordered that as well. The food I ate alongside the wine was also delicious.

Even though I visited on a Friday night, there were plenty of seats available, so I was able to sit down without waiting. I also liked the cozy atmosphere of the small shop.

I thought to myself that I want to come here every day on my next visit to Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: 김덕형 (BRAD)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The only bad thing about decision to dine at this restaurant was my unprepared stomach.
They offered variety of Umeshu Drinks and the service and knowledge of the product of the staff was superb.

I didn't get to try any just because of my stomach problem but I ordered non-alcoholic honey ginger Ume drink and it was super refreshing.

Appetizers are really paired well with the drink. Nham Khao Aracini has unique blend of refreshing citric taste together with a kick of spicyness. The magic comes when it paired together with sweet une sauce. Such a balanced blend of flavour. Potato Salad also wasn't pale in comparison. The crunch of the fried onion topping really enhance the flavour of this dish. Anyways, I'm definitely coming back again when my stomach is ready to drink alcohol 🫶
sample_reviews_en.author: Saw Thiri Kyaw

sample_reviews_en.text:
A new hidden gem for umeshu lovers krub. It’s a cozy little bar with a great selection of plum wines—from classic smooth ones to unique, fruity blends. I love how the staff are super knowledgeable and happy to recommend something based on your taste.

The vibe is warm, stylish, and intimate—perfect for winding down after a long day or starting off a relaxed night out. It’s not a big place, but that makes it feel even more special.

Prices are reasonable considering the quality and import of the drinks. If you’re into umeshu or want to explore something new in a chill setting, this place is absolutely worth a visit ja.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaithawat Dongcharoaen

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a fantastic place in every aspect—delicious food, attentive service, and great recommendations for different types of umeshu. Even if you’re new to drinking umeshu, you won’t feel lost with their helpful guidance. The staff is attentive, always keeping an eye out to clear empty plates and refill water without needing to be called—it’s like they know exactly what you need. The service is exceptional, and the food is amazing. I hope they continue to maintain these high standards. Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: NARINWAT KULLAWATTHARA

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! Everything we ordered was amazing. The liquor set we ordered allowed us to try several different drinks, which was great value. Perfect for sharing with friends. Highly recommended! The staff were lovely and provided excellent service 🫶. The only downside is that the restaurant is very small. You might feel cramped if you sit at the bar. If you're sensitive to crowds, this might not be for you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nakamol K

sample_reviews_en.text: It was a full house the last time we came to this restaurant. We get our entry during this second attempt. Great experience with umeshu liquor in Bangkok! Though there is no Japanese chef at the bar counter and in the kitchen, the service catered was wonderful. The food dishes served in the restaurant were comparable, if not, better than some of other Japanese restaurants operating in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: chu a H o c K s a n (Jase)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I just happened to find this treasure bistro.
The food is awesome. Whats more, if u are an umeshuholic u cant miss this place! They have plenty of umeshu!!! The host is hospitable and willing to share and introduce their product!! It is a Umesha paradise!! I really have a great time here and Prumplum stand made my day!!! Highly recommended! Please pay a visit here and u will not regret!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Chen

restaurants.name: The Dawin Hotel
restaurants.address:

35/1-2 Soi Sukhumvit4, Sukhumvit 4 Alley, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Dawin Hotel

Overall I am giving The Dawin Hotel an overall rating of ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ because it did not completely meet up to expectations as it was advertised.

Everything is smaller than in the photos and I recommend you skip the breakfast option as there is plenty of other places to eat close by that are cheaper 😉.

There is a rooftop pool but once again it’s smaller than depicted in the photos 😅.

Generally I found staff to be helpful. My room was clean with all usual facilities including aircon, fridge, hot shower, hair dryer and TV. Smoking and non-smoking rooms available. Sound-proofing rooms - one of the reason why I chose to stay here!! Free Wifi throughout the hotel - not 4K media nomad friendly but okay for emails and 720p social media down / upload.

If travelling with family be aware that the hotel is located in an adult area - there is a ladyboy bar opposite and the pavements become a red light walk way starting from around 8pm.

I hope you found this honest review helpful and enjoy your stay here. I certainly did and would consider this place again on my next visit to Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tao Chi Kai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Decent place, decently priced, rooms were fine and clean, rooftop pool was not too big but noone was using it, so you would usually have it to yourself which was nice.
Location is quite central in Sukhumvit which is good, and despite being in quite a "party street" we were not too disturbed by noise.

Service was OK in general, but we were not able to check in at 14.00 as the rooms were not ready for us, despite us having to inform our arrival time immediately or otherwise we would "have our rooms cancelled". We arrived very tired and needed to rest before dinner reservations in the evening, which we were not really able to as the rooms were not ready in time.
Also, we had requested for an extra bed, which was not accomodated - nor commented on at all during check-in.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Hueg

sample_reviews_en.text:
The room is clean and comfortable, with only a slight noise from the bed frame when turning around.

The staff is very friendly and nice👍. Added point on this.

The breakfast is decent. My family enjoys the meal at their nice café near the entrance. They provide breakfast as a set, allowing you to choose from a menu.

Location wise, morning and night are totally different. Look normal when walking in the morning, but it turns guy heaven when night time😅. Many foods, pubs, cafes, and entertainment at surroundings.

Easy access to 2x BTS station to take train from this location, around 10 to 15 minutes walking distance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alan LZL

sample_reviews_en.text: Booked a stay for my wife and her sister.  The wifi had terrible service and kept cutting in and out.   No amenities like toothbrush or slippers provided.  Worst part was they were locked out for more than an hour out of their room because of a faulty door.  Service people had no clue.   It took them a long time to get everything sorted.  No compensation and barely an apology.  Only after complaining to Agoda, was offered 2 measly breakfast coupons for ANOTHER stay.   There won't be another stay because I will NEVER again book this hotel.  There are much better options out there.
sample_reviews_en.author: D D

sample_reviews_en.text: I stayed at The Dawin for two weeks over the Christmas and New Year's holidays.   The staff were great and very attentive.   There were no issues communicating in English.    The room was very clean and the maid staff kept it in great condition through my stay.   My favorite part of the stay was the restaurant.   Great service and friendly staff.   They make awesome cappuccinos!  The location of the hotel is far enough from Nana Plaza that you can escape from the crowd in peace or walk 4 minutes and be right in the thick of the action. Will stay here again for sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike Wind

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Dawin is really close to the Hustling nightlife of Nana Plaza, despite being on a congested and somewhat dirty street the Dawin is the height or cleanliness, the interior is nicely deisgned, the food is fantastic, the staff are so excellent, caring & polite
The rooftop pool is nice.
All in all for the decent price you're paying for a stay here you get ALOT of value for your money, it feels like a Premium Hotel.
I would highly reccomend a stay here if you're looking for something central & comfortable
sample_reviews_en.author: David Brady

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an exceptionally clean hotel near about a quarter mile down Nana plaza.   You have to walk through all of that but you're rewarded by an exceptional hotel, with a great lobby and food choices.   Best of all, you're a 10 minute walk to Benjakitti Park, one of the most amazing urban parks in the world.    The Green Mile connection also starts at this particular entrance if u care to see Lumpini park.    Great place for those wishing to see the park or go for a run in the middle of Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Glenn Rapp

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently stayed at the Dawin hotel located in the heart of the red light district (not for the faint-hearted).

The transport links were excellent, with easy access to buses and trains, allowing for seamless travel around the city.

The staff were friendly and accommodating, and the amenities were good.

Overall, it was a good experience, and I recommend this hotel for anyone looking to stay in a central location with great connectivity.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sofie Muldowney

restaurants.name: Mydam Un
restaurants.address:

100/1 Sukhantharam Rd, Suan Chitlada, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This hidden gem of a Vietnamese-Thai restaurant in Sukhantharam Soi offers incredibly delicious and affordable food. They have a wide variety of freshly prepared Vietnamese and Thai dishes, beautifully presented with vibrant, fresh vegetables. Many dishes are unlike anything you've ever tried before.

Recommended dishes:
• Sesame Rice Cracker Pizza (Vietnamese Pizza) 🍕 (220 THB) Absolutely delicious, a popular choice, and the flavors blend perfectly.
• Fried Banana with Honey 🍌 (6 pieces, 100 THB) Incredibly tasty, hot, crispy on the outside, and soft on the inside.
• Lemongrass Chicken with Fried Sticky Rice 🐓 (180 THB) Fragrant with lemongrass.
• Mixed Seafood Soup 🍲 (390 THB) Very fragrant and flavorful.
• Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork skewers) The sauce is incredibly delicious.

The restaurant is very comfortable, with a great atmosphere, air-conditioned, and has very clean restrooms. The decor is beautiful, and the restaurant is spacious, making it perfect for families. The staff are attentive, and food is served quickly. There's ample parking (about 10 spaces) with parking attendants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Punnatorn Vechaputi

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the large set of Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork skewers) with 4 skewers of pork, but they gave me very little Vietnamese rice paper and vegetables. The amount given wasn't even enough for 2 skewers of pork. I had to ask for more vegetables and rice paper, and the restaurant charged me an extra 40 baht because I asked twice. The restaurant was being unreasonably petty. Nem Nuong is meant to be eaten with vegetables and rice paper. My usual restaurant is much more relaxed and doesn't make such small demands. I was planning to take my elders there because they have a diverse menu, but after this experience, I'd rather not. It would be awkward for them if they found out they had to pay extra for this reason.

However, the fried items were delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: warisara c

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every dish was delicious and suited my taste! The food didn't take long to arrive.
- Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage): The rice paper wrappers and vegetables were already arranged alternately, making it very convenient – ​​no need to struggle to separate the wrappers.
- Banh Xeo (Vietnamese savory crepe): Crispy and not too oily, with a generous filling.
- Pork wrapped in betel leaves: I highly recommend this dish! The betel leaves had a wonderful aroma and tasted amazing.
- Fried bananas: The outer batter was crispy and delicious. They were tasty even without added syrup. 6 pieces for 100 baht. You can also order them individually for 20 or 25 baht each.

There is parking available before the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasipim Suanmalee

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried a new Vietnamese restaurant with a diverse menu including Thai, Vietnamese, desserts, and drinks. The restaurant is cutely decorated, the air conditioning is nice and cool, and the atmosphere is great.

The surprising dish was the fried rice salad with fermented pork sausage. The fried rice was crispy and not oily at all, and the salad dressing was perfectly tangy and spicy. The rice paper rolls and nem nuong were delicious and up to standard. I liked that the rice paper wrappers and vegetables were pre-packaged, making it easy to eat.

The fried banana served with honey was amazing! Highly recommend ordering it. It was crispy, flavorful, not overly sweet, and not oily. 🫶
sample_reviews_en.author: ชนกนันท์ ศิริสุข

sample_reviews_en.text:
This old Vietnamese restaurant is located in Soi Ranong 1. Their Nem Nuong (grilled pork skewers) is delicious; I especially like that they provide the rice paper wrappers separately for the vegetables, so you don't have to soak them yourself. Their Banh Beo (Vietnamese rice cakes) and fresh shrimp spring rolls are also tasty.

However, the beef wrapped in betel leaves had a very strong bitterness. I'm not sure if it was grilled for too long or what, but the bitterness overpowered the flavor of the meat. Even after dipping it in the sauce, the bitterness remained.

For dessert, you absolutely must try the fried bananas – a real highlight!
sample_reviews_en.author: บทเพลงปีศาจ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food looks like a Vietnamese-Thai fusion, and the taste is very appealing to Thai people—they really enjoy it. I wonder how authentically Vietnamese people would feel about it.

I've actually tried grilled pork with rice noodles in Hanoi before, and I've even tried making it myself. I felt that the grilled pork with rice noodles here wasn't quite as good, but the flavor was delicious nonetheless. The atmosphere was nice, perfect for conversation. It wasn't very crowded at lunchtime.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattapon Srichan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food here is not what I had expected. If you're a fan of authentic Vietnamese cuisine, you may not be satisfied.

Our group of 5 had beef pho, hotpot, Vietnamese pizza, mixed salad, and fried spring rolls.

The beed pho was disappointing. The seafood and pork/chicken hotpots were  just ok. The pizza was a bit strange. The mixed salad was so-so. The fried spring rolls were the best of the bunch.

On the other hand, the different kinds of fruit drinks were the best. Very tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naruth BKK

sample_reviews_en.text: I first ate here when the restaurant was located on Soi Ranong 1 and loved it. This time, when I used Google Maps to get to the restaurant, I was a little confused whether it was the same Madame restaurant. The staff informed me that it is, and they moved to this location about a year ago. The new location is even better than before; it's cleaner and parking is much easier. The food is still as delicious as ever, with a good variety of dishes to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mattaneeya P.

restaurants.name: Wattana 3 Beef Noodles
restaurants.address:

1497 Phahonyothin Rd, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I was randomly strolling around looking for something to eat near Phaya Thai Hospital on Phahonyothin Road. I crossed the crosswalk opposite Big C and smelled something delicious. I followed the scent until I found the shop. It was clean, spacious, and airy. I ordered noodles with everything except offal – fresh beef, stewed beef, tendons, and meatballs. The first sip of the broth was amazing! Fragrant, delicious, and perfectly balanced. Everything was great, I especially liked the meatballs. There wasn't much vegetable, so I ordered a big bowl of blanched bean sprouts to go with it. The noodles were 80 baht, and the blanched bean sprouts were 20 baht. The owner was very polite.
sample_reviews_en.author: A V

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a long-established noodle shop specializing in beef and braised beef noodles.

The ingredients are fresh and clean. The braised beef is incredibly tender, and the beef shank is crunchy and delicious. The meatballs are firm and bouncy.

The broth is flavorful and aromatic with spices, featuring a touch of vinegar added from the stove. For those who don't like sour flavors, avoid adding more vinegar as it will become too sour and difficult to correct.

Overall, it's delicious. I give it a 9/10. If you're passing through Saphan Kwai, I highly recommend stopping by this shop. You won't be disappointed! 😋😋😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Panot Laocharoen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Finding the middle ground~
This beef noodle soup is perfectly balanced, requiring no additional seasoning. The broth is deliciously smooth, neither too strong nor too weak, perfectly balanced. The tendon is good, the tripe is excellent. The only minor drawback is that the braised beef might be a little tough.
Overall, excellent value, great taste, and perfectly balanced.
8/10 🙂‍↔️
sample_reviews_en.author: Pisit Siri

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles were delicious! The meat was fresh, tender, and not chewy. The soup had a good flavor (a bit salty), but adding a little vinegar and chili made it perfect. Free refills of tea were available. The owner was very attentive. The shop was spacious, comfortable, and not hot. 👏👏👏 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Phetch Pakuko

sample_reviews_en.text: The aroma wafted through the air as I walked by, so I stopped in. The mixed noodle soup wasn't a very big bowl, priced at 60 baht, and came with complimentary tea. Everything was good and the price was reasonable. It tasted pretty good too!
sample_reviews_en.author: A S

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a very old restaurant in this area. If you're in the Saphan Kwai area, don't forget to stop by and support them. For me, the soup doesn't need any seasoning at all; it's delicious as is. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: นางจงกล เอี่ยมวัฒนะ

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the beef noodle soup and beef soup I eat most often.
The broth is clear, fragrant, and the beef is tender and easy to eat.
The shop also has tea, and most importantly, it's very clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: jutatong boonsri (Momay)

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're in the Saphan Kwai area, I think this restaurant has the best taste. The soup is salty, the offal is well-prepared and not gamey, and the stewed meat is okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Los sentimientos

restaurants.name: Thai Pakistan Restaurant
restaurants.address:

184 Si Phraya Rd, Si Phraya, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I got very hyped up after reading all the positive reviews about the food and I was seriously craving some Mutton Paya with naan so I travelled quite a bit to try Pakistani food.

We went around 12 pm, and unfortunately, they didn’t have Mutton Paya (broke my heart 😭) that day so we ordered Mutton Degi Nihari and Chaana Masala with 3 naans. The food came within 15-20 mins. Our young server gave us glasses and plates but they weren’t clean. It felt like they were not ready for service for the day. Both the dishes were heavily spiced and didn’t have the unique taste that Pakistani dishes offer. My excitement waned after all of this.

We ordered milk tea which was delicious and cost just 20 baht! Our total bill came to 285 baht. While the food is very affordable, considering my travel time and excitement, it fell short of my expectations. Hence, a 3/5.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tahmina Begum

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thai Pakistan Restaurant is a great place for those who love a mix of Thai and Pakistani flavors. The restaurant has a clean and welcoming atmosphere, perfect for families and friends to enjoy a relaxing meal together.

The menu offers a nice variety of Thai dishes like Pad Thai, Thai Green Curry, and Tom Yum Soup, along with some local favorites. The flavors are rich, authentic, and perfectly balanced — spicy, tangy, and full of aroma. The food is always served fresh and well-presented.

The staff is friendly and attentive, and service is generally quick. Prices are reasonable for the quality and portion size, making it good value for money.

Overall, Thai Pakistan Restaurant is a wonderful spot for anyone craving authentic Thai food with a local twist. Highly recommended for both casual meals and family dinin
sample_reviews_en.author: Gopang Nishad

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thai-Pak Restaurant is a perfect spot for authentic Pakistani food in Bangkok. The menu is full of traditional flavors, not mixed with Thai taste. You get real Pakistani dishes like mutton pulao, kabab, paye, dal, naan, and paratha — all cooked in pure desi style.

The food tastes homemade, with balanced spices and rich aroma. Their chai is outstanding, just like back home. The place is clean, calm, and run by friendly staff who understand Pakistani hospitality. Prices are fair, and portions are generous.

If you miss true Pakistani taste in Bangkok, Thai-Pak is the right place to visit.

Recommended items: Mutton Pulao, Paye, Kabab, Paratha, and Chai.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zahir Kazmi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great Pakistani restaurant in the heart of bangkok Nice food, lovely atmosphere and behavior of the people at the restaurant all top class. We had different dishes in last few days.The food was very tasty and full of authentic flavor. Price is also better comparing other restaurants of the neighborhood.
Definitely worth it. visiting if you enjoy Pakistani cuisine!” 🌶️🍛👍
sample_reviews_en.author: TAIMOOR Sarwar Hussain

sample_reviews_en.text: Every time I come to Bangkok, I have to eat at this Pakistani restaurant! It's clean and hygienic, the meat is fresh, I especially love their chicken, and the prices are reasonable. The naan is also delicious! Even though there weren't many customers, the food was amazing! I highly recommend everyone to try it!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: b lang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honest people, food was good with decent quantity. I was going to order Nihari as listed in menu but the owner told me it would be too much for single person so I ordered half plate. The price was good and it felt fresh. Also came with salad and condiments. The tea was good too.

Highly recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: Yu B

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, Delicious, Delicious. Our first time trying Pakistani food and it was recommended to try the Chicken Karahi and Lobiya and these may now be our new favourite food. So good!
This restaurant was super welcoming and friendly and as mentioned above help us select dishes to try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gypsyduo

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious flavors and very well priced! You can get half of anything on the menu which is so convenient when you come solo. Halwa Puri is only offered on Sundays so I didn’t have a chance to try it. The owner is really nice, he gave me some halwa even though I didn’t order it
sample_reviews_en.author: Aydin Adnan

restaurants.name: Phra Nakhon
restaurants.address:

300, 2 ถ. เจริญกรุง Yan Nawa, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a very disappointing experience at Phra Nakhon at Capella in Bangkok. Overall, the service was extremely poor—honestly among the worst I’ve encountered. Drinks were not even served before the first course arrived, which is basic hospitality that should never be overlooked. As for the food, it was quite average. Considering it’s a Thai restaurant, I expected bold and authentic flavors, but everything felt toned down—barely spicy, clearly adjusted for Western palates, and lacking personality. Even the presentation of the dishes was underwhelming and uninspired. For a restaurant part of what that is supposedly ranked among the best Hotel in the world—assuming those rankings are truly earned and not influenced in questionable ways—this felt incredibly average and, ultimately, pointless. I would strongly suggest that the team take inspiration from places like Mandarin Oriental or Lilly’s at the Ritz Carlton, where presentation and attention to detail are on a completely different level. In the end, the best way to describe this experience is simply: unnecessary. Definitely not worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mario Fittipaldi

sample_reviews_en.text:
I live next door at four seasons residences and I eat here every second night.

Service and setting is absolutely impeccable.

The food…..

I do not like curry, never eat it ever, not in Thailand or anywhere.

So far I’ve had every curry on the menu and it’s divine…it’s “love” on a plate..I have zero idea who they make a curry taste so depth in flavour and clean but also light at the same time.

The “DUCK CURRY” OMGGGGG

I’ve lived over a year in Bangkok, I’m yet to have any type of meal taste as good as all the meals from this restaurant.

I don’t even like Thai flavours that much in my food, but they do this so well.

This is a restaurant where every dish is a work of art on presentation and flavours whilst sticking to the Thai DNA….and they do it so far better than ANYONE or ANY restaurant in Thailand…

This is your best Thai Fine Dining Restaurant in Thailand, not just Bangkok..WOW.

I’ve eaten here over 50 times, each dish gets better.

Thank you to all the staff who serve and look after me, greatly appreciated 🙏🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: David Zuegn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Definitely one of the best brunches in Bangkok! It may be difficult to get a reservation, but trust me—it is well worth the wait.

Unlimited lobster, incredibly sweet and meaty king crab, and generously sized pieces of foie gras that were rich and melt-in-your-mouth delicious. The sashimi was fresh across the board, and the dessert selection was amazing. I also have to mention the Thai tea—it was so good!

The staff were all incredibly lovely, friendly, and attentive. A special shout-out to Khun Earth, who took wonderful care of our table. He gave us great recommendations and was always so helpful, making the whole experience even more enjoyable. Thank you so much!

Honestly, there were still so many dishes I wanted to try, but my stomach simply couldn’t fit anything else. I left feeling completely and happily full!

A very special brunch experience and absolutely worth trying. Can’t wait to come back and eat all the dishes I missed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nitchawee C.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, especially the grilled pork neck. The restaurant is beautiful with a nice atmosphere. The staff were welcoming. However, I wish the outdoor area had plastic wrap on the plates, as insects and tree debris kept falling on the tables and dishes. There was no staff to check for this. Also, the napkins provided weren't enough for everyone. And because the air wasn't circulating well and there was no breeze, I informed the staff about the need for a fan, but they acknowledged it and didn't offer any assistance. I also wish there were more staff members to serve customers in the outdoor area; there were very few staff members, and it was difficult to get their attention when called, resulting in long waits. I will return again in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Im Cha

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the “Chivit Chiva Vegan Course” at Phra Nakhon and was truly impressed by every course. Each dish was beautifully presented and thoughtfully prepared, but the dessert was especially memorable—I absolutely loved the refreshing Thai fruit and ice combination.

Although I only eat vegan occasionally, this experience made the entire meal feel exciting, satisfying, and special. The restaurant also offers one of the best riverside views and service experiences in Bangkok.

A special thank you to “Mr. Big”, who took care of me this evening. He was genuinely kind, attentive, and highly professional, making sure every detail of my dinner was perfect.

A wonderful dining experience from beginning to end. **10/10—highly recommended!**
sample_reviews_en.author: Kulthirath Pakawachkrilers

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tonight I had dinner at Phra Nakhon restaurant in the Capella Bangkok hotel. The atmosphere was amazing. The restaurant serves contemporary Thai cuisine with well-balanced flavors – not too spicy, very easy to eat.

My recommended dish is the pomelo salad; it's delicious, refreshing, and made with high-quality ingredients.

Another thing I loved was the view by the Chao Phraya River; it's beautiful and peaceful. I recommend going during sunset for a very romantic view, perfect for a dinner or special occasion.

That day we were very lucky to see fireworks twice, from both the Capella and Four Seasons hotels. It was a truly memorable dinner! ✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Supawadee Sanwichai

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a wonderful dining experience at Phra Nakhon. Khun Earth provided exceptional service—he was energetic, attentive, and always seemed to anticipate what we might need before we even asked. His warm hospitality made our visit even more enjoyable.

The food was excellent overall. The Thai dishes were authentic and full of flavor, and the cakes and pastries were delicious as well. The traditional Thai desserts were enjoyable, though they didn’t stand out quite as much as the rest of the menu.

Overall, a great dining experience with outstanding service. We’d be happy to come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Varut Prateepvattanavit

sample_reviews_en.text: That Thai dinner was amazing! The place was super elegant but also really welcoming from the moment we got there. The menu had so many great options, and the staff gave awesome recommendations. Out of all the delicious dishes, the Crispy Pork with Chili and Salt and the Cassia Curry were seriously outstanding – you could tell the ingredients were top-notch and expertly made. Big thanks to Khun Tam for his excellent service!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanisara GG Ruangdej

restaurants.name: นักล่าหมูกระทะ สยามสแควร์วัน Nak La Mookata Siam Square One
restaurants.address:

4F, siam square one, Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, my friend and I went to eat at the Nak La Moo Kata (Thai BBQ) branch in Siam Square. We go there very often, about 4 times this month. The restaurant's rule is that you have to spend at least 279 baht, not including V-S (vegetarian/supplementary items). However, today, while we were eating, a staff member named Krattae brought us the bill before we even asked for it. The total was 266 baht (as shown in the first picture). Then she said, "Please make sure you spend at least 279 baht, not including V-S." We were shocked and looked at each other. We don't know what she meant by that, because she didn't inform us that we would be charged extra if we didn't meet the minimum bill. It felt like she was being condescending and afraid we wouldn't eat enough, even though we always exceed the minimum. We felt it was very impolite to act like that while we were eating. We were going to order something else because we knew we hadn't reached the minimum, but after that experience, we're not ordering anything else and we won't be going back there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aticha Khomapan

sample_reviews_en.text:
We love eating at [restaurant name]. Whenever we're in Siam, we definitely eat at their MBK or Siam Square branches. Usually, we never have any problems. But two days ago, when we went, the pork fat was burning and the silvery coating was dripping everywhere – it was a total shock for me and my friend. So we asked to change the grill. When we told the staff, they didn't seem very interested, but they did change it for us.

After that, the same thing happened again! This time, no one paid any attention to us no matter how much we called for them. My friend and I just gave up, wiped the grill repeatedly with tissues, and ate because we were so hungry. But it really ruined the experience. 😭😭😭 Finally, after searching on Google, we found other people who had written about this, and it was clear this was the restaurant in question. Why haven't they fixed this yet? 😓

Actually, after that, no matter what we asked the staff about, we were ignored. We're sure we didn't say anything rude, but... 😅
sample_reviews_en.author: Jinny Nrs

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually eat at the MBK branch, but today I was running errands in the area so I decided to try this branch. I waited a long time for a staff member at the counter; there was no one there. Ordering food took a long time. The pork grill ran out, but the vegetables were undercooked. The bamboo shrimp smelled bad. The large pork set I ordered was smaller than at other branches. The shrimp was mushy. The cleanliness of the restaurant might need improvement. Most of the staff were sitting around packing dipping sauces. After I finished eating, no one came to take my order. I waited for quite a while, and if I hadn't asked, no one would have come. I hope they improve a little. But this will probably be my only visit to this branch. (This is my honest opinion based on my actual experience; please no drama.)
sample_reviews_en.author: RUNGNAPA FAKPRAPAI

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came here because it had a high rating. I’ve been to a few mookata so I know what to expect.
I like that you can order on your own through their online menu system. I also like that there’s a robot that brings you the food. Kids get a kick out if that.
Most food items are relatively fresh but definitely high quality. The self serve station is a bit cluttered and needs more attention. It’ll go along way to clean the area more frequently.
There’s decent air ventilation but not great. Our clothes were smelly after the meal so be prepared for that.
Everything was just average and I’ll probably recommend this place to others or even return. On the bright side, my favourite dish was the caramel ice cream with roti. It was absolutely delicious that I ordered two of them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Co

sample_reviews_en.text:
Let me share my experience. My friend and I went intending to just have dessert, but the female staff member who led us to a table started recommending a lot of things. If I read the sign correctly, she was probably the cashier. We ended up paying a lot! We only wanted dessert, but we ended up eating papaya salad, spicy salad, and some fried snacks. They had new papaya salad menu items, the spicy salad was delicious, and the fried snacks were a must-try!
But most importantly, the air conditioning in this restaurant is extremely cold. This is the case in almost all branches, but this one is exceptionally cold. Think carefully before coming, and I recommend bringing a blanket. I'm writing this review because the staff member gave me a QR code to review. Hehe.🤣🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: Frty Tuiop

sample_reviews_en.text:
Another terrific value for money option for budget diners in Bangkok.

Mookata (BBQ & steamboat combination) is one of the most popular dining options in Thailand, especially during the cooler months, and is often very social and fun.

Nak La’s ordering is very easy - just order your proteins from a decent selection of meats and seafood - and go to the vege section and pick your greens (these are free). While mookata is old school dining, Nak La add a modern touch with robot servers. Their restaurants are clean, bright, and fairly well ventilated so you won’t come out smelling like BBQ afterwards.

Nak La is popular with Thais from all backgrounds and they have branches located across Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Meng Yee

sample_reviews_en.text: I was invited to come here for dinner because my friend knew I like to eat moo-ka-tha but I cannot eat much so buffet should not be an option. To my surprise, this shop offered set for 2, 3, 4 people with decent quality dishes and unlimited fresh vegtables, noodles, mushrooms and sauces. The services are nice and helpful too. We got full and paid only around 500 baht for 2 people when with similiar amount of food and quality, we should have expected to pay up to 800 or 1000 baht at other restaurants. Worth to try, even the food taste is not stand out but ok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Forelsket Sky

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, and the staff were lovely in showing us to our table. It was our first time, and the staff recommended a birthday set promotion. We ordered the 199 baht set, and they said we could help ourselves to the vegetables. Initially, I thought the 279 baht set included self-service vegetables, but you can order individual dishes to reach 279 baht. The dipping sauces weren't amazing, but okay. The desserts were delicious; I especially liked the roti. (We went during lunchtime today, and there was no queue.) All the staff were very nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: M Io

restaurants.name: Ninetails on Radio Cafe & Bar
restaurants.address:

89/17 Witthayu Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The restaurant is beautiful and the atmosphere is amazing! 🌃 We went at night. It's a bar & rooftop open from 7 PM to 1 AM. There are many beautiful photo spots, especially the popular glass roof, which gives a different vibe at night. The food is delicious – spicy salads, various fried dishes, etc. It's a great place to chill. There's live music too, mostly chill old songs. We went on a Saturday, so I recommend calling to reserve a table beforehand because there aren't many seats. But the atmosphere, food, everything is great overall! 😍🤍😋

P.S. After your meal, you can try your luck with a fortune stick to win discounts or freebies. For example, we won free ice all night when we spent 500฿ or more on food, which can be used on our next visit! ✨

P.S. If you're taking the BTS, get off at Phloen Chit station, exit 5. If you're driving, you can park at All Season Places. Just get your parking ticket stamped at the restaurant. 💖
sample_reviews_th.author: Tunchanok SK

sample_reviews_en.text:
We waited 1.5 hours for our food — and only 3 out of about 10-12 dishes we ordered actually made it to the table. At that point, it felt like a surprise game: guess which dish will show up next… or at all.

We had a reservation, but upon arrival, we were met with a less-than-welcoming scowl and told to “wait” — no greeting, no guidance. Apparently, we were already in the wrong just by walking in.

When we were finally led to our table (after standing awkwardly for a while), we were seated at the very back corner. Three cinema-style seats in a row… and a round table. Not sure how that setup was supposed to work — musical chairs, maybe?

The highlight of the night? Spending the least amount of time possible in the restaurant. We ate the three dishes we were granted, asked for the check, and left. Any longer and it might have turned into a full-blown bad night.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ruangkanchana Aiamrit

sample_reviews_en.text: It's an after-work bar in the heart of the city. The prices are quite suburban. It's not likely to be a bar on Witthayu Road like this. They sell a plate of food for over a hundred baht and have live music. During the day, it's a cafe. A cup of coffee costs 70 baht. Where does the shop make its profit? It's like the owner sells for fun. 😂😅 Cheap and good really exist. The food is delicious too. The food is appetizer style. The music is nice. There are also photos of Tops. The weather is good. The atmosphere is very good. The location is very good. Avoid the traffic and stop for a drink and socialize with friends. It's on the 4th floor behind the Rolex building.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rojjana Rungrattwatchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
A coffee shop during the day
and a secret bar at night
with Ninetails Radio

I had the opportunity to visit at night.
A friend had a chance to host a small birthday party at the restaurant, and the service was excellent and the atmosphere was warm.

The atmosphere is great.
During the day, it's a cafe on the third floor.
At night, it's a bar on the fourth and fifth floors, which are rooftops with beautiful photo spots.

The food is reasonably priced compared to other restaurants in the city, and the taste is good.

The restaurant accepts cash, QR code scanning, and credit cards.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supawut Saengrassamee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The attic bar (4th floor) is a bit of a walk, but the atmosphere is amazing once you get up there.
Lots of photo opportunities, but I want to review the food. It's inexpensive and delicious.

I loved the traditional glass noodle salad the most. It had the perfect flavor and lots of ingredients. I could easily finish the whole plate by myself. The other dishes were also finished as expected. There's a wide variety of food to choose from, mostly appetizers and single-serving dishes.

The drinks are reasonably priced (not expensive). The vibe is fantastic. Highly recommend coming!
sample_reviews_en.author: yub yib

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to try the bar on the 4th floor in the early evening. Normally there's live music, but there wasn't today. The bar is located in an alley next to the All Seasons building. The entrance to the alley is marked by a somtum (papaya salad) restaurant. Walk a little further in and you'll see a row of buildings on your left; you need to walk up to the top. The food menu isn't extensive, focusing on salads, but they were delicious and reasonably priced. The taste was great, and the atmosphere was good too. There was also a Singha beer promotion before 8:30 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: BYP

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ninetails on Radio – Radio, Pathum Wan, Bangkok
A European-style rooftop cafe and bar with a warm and friendly atmosphere, perfect for chilling with friends while enjoying a variety of drinks and live music that creates a special ambiance.

⏰ Opening Hours:
• Cafe: Daily 11:00 AM – 6:00 PM
• Bar: Daily 6:00 PM – 1:00 AM (Closed on Sundays)

#BangkokCafe #NinetailsOnRadio #RooftopCafe #BangkokBar #LiveMusic #GreatAtmosphere #EuropeanStyleCafe #CafeWithBeautifulPhotos #NewCafe #CafeInTheCityCenter
sample_reviews_en.author: Facebook / TikTok : Check In

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was average in taste, and the prices were typical for a cafe. The first floor is small and cramped, while the second floor is spacious. They were having a workshop the day we went, and it felt like there were a lot of vendors—more than buyers! There were stalls everywhere, making it impossible to take any photos. Even though we went in a large group and bought things, we couldn't take any pictures because of the stalls and customers in the way.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuparat Nn

restaurants.name: Mad Sugar Home Café
restaurants.address:

Charoenkrung 26, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love this restaurant!
I'm a pasta lover, and you can tell they put a lot of care into their pasta. You can see it in the quality of the noodles, the ingredients, and the balance of flavors.
I tried the Seafood Arrabiata, and it exceeded my expectations! The sauce was so delicious I almost licked the plate clean 😂 The texture was amazing; the shrimp were large and firm. Definitely worth the price. I highly recommend it!
Another dish I ordered was the Spaghetti Pesto Bacon. It had a generous amount of bacon, and some of it was large pieces. I think it's homemade. The flavor was well-balanced. I suspect the restaurant uses a traditional pesto grinding method, resulting in a rich, creamy sauce that I rarely find elsewhere. It felt very homey. I also loved the spaghetti noodles; they were chewy, soft, and delicious.
For dessert, I had the Orange Chocolate Cake, which was also delicious. It had a lovely beer aroma, and the flavors were perfectly balanced. The cake was moist and very enjoyable. In short, everything I ordered was delicious. The restaurant is cute, and the atmosphere is friendly. Highly recommend it! If you're in the area, you really have to try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Grumpy Face GG Map Reviewer

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fresh pasta has a delightful texture that makes you think, "Ah, so this is what fresh pasta tastes like." The flavor is moderately rich, not overly strong, leaving room for those who want to add salt and pepper.
But what really impressed me was the cakes! They are absolutely amazing. Some of the menu items are unique and you definitely won't find them anywhere else. The names might sound confusing, but they're worth trying, like the Som Tum cake and the Dark Beer Orange cake. Every single one is delicious, like cakes made by an artist. I was very impressed.
But don't expect Thai-style pasta flavors like overly spicy, salty, or sweet. That's definitely not the place.
On a tiring day, this place is a lifesaver. You can sit back, relax, and enjoy your meal.
I love that they have a booth where they make fresh pasta (you have to be there during the pasta-making session) and they have new brands of drinks to try.
Note: The bacon here is huge! It's like a bridge!
sample_reviews_en.author: August Songkiatthana

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, both savory and sweet. I ordered the smoked salmon and lemon pasta. The smoked salmon was delicious, not too salty. The pasta sauce was creamy and flavorful, with a refreshing lemon tang that prevented it from being too rich (though I usually like richer dishes). The egg was fresh and tasted great mixed in. The pasta itself was also tasty; all the components complemented each other perfectly.

For dessert, I had the orange chocolate cake with some kind of liqueur or beer. It was also incredibly delicious. The orange on top had a sweet and sour taste, served in a jelly, which perfectly complemented the mousse and chocolate cake. It was refreshing yet subtly complex (?). I couldn't stop eating it!

The atmosphere in the cafe was comfortable and relaxed. It wasn't as flashy as other cafes, but it felt like home. I want to try other menu items here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Noryor

sample_reviews_en.text:
We traveled to Bangkok just to eat at this restaurant. Parking is limited, but luckily, we found a spot. This shophouse-style restaurant has limited seating. We recommend going early in the morning before noon. Here's our menu: 🏡📍

🐖Bacon Carbonara - This is the signature dish of the restaurant. The bacon is large and the carbonara is delicious and not too greasy. It's a fun dish to eat.

🐟Smoked Salmon Lemon Chili - The salmon is perfectly smoked, fragrant, and slightly spicy. It doesn't really go well with the gnocchi, but it ends up being too greasy.

#tbackpackp

sample_reviews_en.author: TbackpackP (Ton)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is absolutely adorable! I loved all the decorations. The fresh pasta was delicious too.
The pesto gnocchi had a rich and flavorful sauce, and the large, chunky bacon pieces were a perfect match. Another dish I tried was the lemon cream fettuccine, which was refreshing and delicious. The cream had a light tartness that cut through the sweetness nicely.
But my absolute favorite was the Strawberry rhubarb pie. Every element was delicious. The almond pie base was so good you could eat it plain, the pie crust was sweet and tangy without being cloying, and the rose-flavored cream on top was fragrant and refreshing – a perfect combination. I want to go back often so I can try every single item on the menu!
sample_reviews_en.author: Punnisa Bannaros

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a small, local restaurant located in an alley with no parking; you have to park across the street at a company office. If you didn't come here based on reviews, it would be a hidden gem. Who would know such a place exists? The menu isn't extensive, but I ordered the cream cheese bacon spaghetti – it was rich and the bacon was incredibly fragrant. The other dish, spaghetti with dried chilies, was delicious. As for the cakes, the lemon tiramisu was slightly tangy, not too sweet, and very tasty with a dense texture. The macadamia cheesecake was equally amazing – dense, delicious, and perfectly sweet. I'll definitely go back to try other dishes. It's a shame they didn't have the papaya salad cake to try that day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rabby Kratai

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small homemade pasta shop in the Charoen Krung area. They offer four types of pasta: spaghetti, fettuccine, ravioli (if I remember correctly, the filling is spinach), and gnocchi.

They also have a variety of sauces to choose from. Since I wanted the Prawn Butter Lemon Chili (320 THB), I chose the spaghetti because it paired perfectly.

I've read reviews that the noodles were hard, but they weren't hard on the day I went. They were just right. The sauce was delicious, with a refreshing lemon flavor and a touch of chili to cut the richness. The shrimp weren't small either, and the heads were all juicy! 🤣

I ordered the Craft Cherry Cola (95 THB), a refreshing and fragrant drink.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eattention

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍓✨ Mad Sugar Home Café ✨🍝
A hidden gem in the Charoen Krung area that's not just cute, but the taste is truly authentic!

Freshly made pasta in every dish 🍝
Homemade desserts that are both beautiful and delicious 🍰
The atmosphere is like eating at a friend's house, but even better than expected.

A small shop but full of details, both in the food and the mood 🖤
A must-visit for café and comfort food lovers.

📍Charoen Krung Soi 26
(Reservations recommended as the shop has limited capacity)

#MadSugar #HomeCafe #BangkokCafe #CafeHopping #PastaLover #HiddenGem #BangkokCafe
sample_reviews_en.author: Tul Phomprasert

restaurants.name: Raylist Rooftop & Bar
restaurants.address:

โครงการ Vanilla Moon, 265 ถนน จันทร์ Wat Phraya Krai, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible experience at this restaurant. The waiter barely spoke English but acted like he understood everything—we told him what we wanted, and he brought something completely different. To pay, they said we could use a credit card, but at the end, they told us the machine wasn’t working, so we had to take a taxi back to the hotel to get cash. On top of that, their QR code payment required installing a specific app, registering, and everything—not practical at all. The waiter also stayed stuck to our table from the moment we sat down, putting a ton of pressure on us. Oh, and the food wasn’t good either. Definitely wouldn’t recommend it for the service or experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: drak vlad

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was great. The food tasted good, the music was nice, and the staff were lovely and very attentive. However, I'd like to point out that the prices on the menu didn't match the prices on the bill. The difference was hundreds of baht – a significant discrepancy. When I pointed it out, they said the restaurant had adjusted the prices by increasing the portion sizes. But they should have corrected the prices on the menu from the start. Doing this is upsetting. I'm not upset about the price itself, but I felt taken advantage of and it wasn't right.
sample_reviews_en.author: May Tantiapikul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Appetizers, drinks and main courses were amazing!! Prices are also super reasonable. Nice view and place is not too crowded if you get there at around 8:30 - 9pm :)
They also do live music which was super enjoyable :)
I recommend the cheese sticks, fried chicken with chili and garlic, the ceasar salad and the mac and cheese was the best I had!
Service was also really good even though we had to use google translate to communicate, they were so nice :)
Will be back next time 😄
sample_reviews_en.author: Mélanie Yee

sample_reviews_en.text: Very bad experience at the restaurant, the waiter is barely speaking english but acts like he understands everything (told him what we want to order, but he brought an other plate instead), we asked if we can pay by credit card they said yes so we ordered food, at the end they told us that the wireless contact is not working leading us to need to take a taxi to go get our credit card back from the hotel. The food was not good as well. Don’t recommand for the service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ayoub yessari

sample_reviews_en.text:
I thought this place was all about the view. And it kind of is: the view is amazing. You see all the skyscrapers along the river, in Silom and in Sathorn. Since this restaurant is on top of a mall in Chan road there are hardly any high rise buildings blocking your view.

But this place is more than just a great view. It has very good Thai food! Leaning towards Isaan but also covering other local Thai cuisines. Definitely going back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text:
The price is amazing, especially considering the quality – it's totally worth it! 🍸✨
I went during a promotion and the drinks were genuinely strong, no exaggeration. Just one glass and I was already feeling tipsy 😂
The rooftop atmosphere is chill and comfortable, perfect for chatting with friends or having a light drink after work.

If you're looking for a bar with great value for money, I highly recommend this place! 🍻🌃
sample_reviews_en.author: nn___

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. Near home
2. Convenient parking because it is in a shopping mall
3. The food I ordered last time was very delicious. This time I came to drink only because we had already eaten and the drinks were delicious
4. The staff provided good service, impressed me every time I came and they remember the customers well
5. The atmosphere inside and outside the shop is good, I like it very much
sample_reviews_en.author: maylada wangboonpati

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very modern, Asian, karaoke-style feel at this new rooftop bar / lounge / restaurant. Enjoyed the outdoor deck space.

Ordering a draft beer when solo was a challenge as everything served only in mega-party size.

Nice team on hand. Did not stay around to sample food. Menu looked good and others have chimed in.

Plenty of parking if you’re arriving by car.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stephen G

sample_reviews_en.text:
On The Table, Central Rama 2
A Japanese cafe with a Western fusion twist. Beautifully decorated.
Many menu options.
Everything looks delicious.
We chose:
🌼In The Summer Tea
125.-
🌼Japanese Seafood Gratin 280.-
Prices do not include a 10% service charge.
The prices are quite high.
The food didn't take too long to arrive.
The seafood rice bowl tasted delicious, Japanese style, topped with cheese.
The fruit tea was very large, with fruit on top, and very refreshing.
There were a fair number of customers, coming in steadily. The staff provided good service.
If you're passing by Central Rama 2, give it a try! 🌼🌼
sample_reviews_en.author: สราวุฒิ จินดาประเสริฐ

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is beautifully decorated and has a comfortable seating area. I really loved the thin-crust Margherita pizza. The truffle omelette was also delicious served hot. I can't remember the name of the other dish I ordered, but it was hot Japanese rice mixed with mushrooms, served with stir-fried vegetables and topped with chicken breast – it was very tasty! I'll definitely be back. ❤️👌
sample_reviews_en.author: Aom Kotaru

sample_reviews_en.text:
On The Table
is a restaurant that my children and wife really love.
And how could I possibly disagree? 😋😋

If you want a restaurant with a wide variety of dishes,
good service,
quick and efficient food,
no waiting in line, and
tastes just right…
(because every time we go, they always order the same dishes 😂😂)

my family often chooses this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Montree Tripetpisai

sample_reviews_en.text: Members get a 5% discount every time they dine at the restaurant, and there's a birthday promotion with a 15% discount plus a free dessert with no minimum purchase, which is great! The staff are friendly and polite, and the atmosphere is nice and perfect for taking photos. I loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: รัตติยา เรืองสา (ตะตาล)

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a comfortable and spacious seating area. It's mostly families dining there. The spaghetti is flavorful, and the creamy corn sauce is delicious. The truffle soup is fragrant and tasty, not too salty.
sample_reviews_en.author: K. Vijit.

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, I was very impressed with everything – the atmosphere, the food, and the service. It's perfect for those who enjoy Japanese fusion cuisine. If you're looking for a great restaurant, try On the Table!
sample_reviews_en.author: Supansa Meesongchan

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a lovely restaurant with beautiful decor, delicious food, and good service. The food is fusion style. I've eaten there several times. The prices are a bit expensive after adding VAT and service charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aimmie

sample_reviews_en.text: Services are very slow and the pizza was so bad. Other foods are not good at all. Very different from the other brunch. This one is at Central Rama 2. Over price for the terrible qualities of foods.
sample_reviews_en.author: Curvy Killer

restaurants.name: Cozy house restaurant by kwanruen
restaurants.address:

126 Sam Sen Rd, Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food was delicious, so we came back a second time.
The second time I wasn't so lucky. Both visits, I checked my order with the waitress and explained I have a severe nut allergy (I gave this information to them in both Thai and English, and was reassured again that all would be fine with our order). Unfortunately I started having quite a severe reaction, a few mouthfuls into my soup, and had to leave in a hurry to get safe and treated.
Could have been cross-contamination... could have been poor communication between service staff and kitchen. Won't ever really know.

In summary:
Good if you don't have dietary requirements.
Dangerous if you do.
Average value for money for the area.
Casual atmosphere. Mostly outdoor tables on the street.
Food was actually very tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Abbie Shipley

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place used to be good, with reasonably authentic Thai fare, evidenced by local custom.
But it must have new owners. There are now undisclosed service and VAT surcharges (as in, you find out when paying). Then there's subtle pressure to round up the bill, which I'd normally be happy to do without needing to be asked, or tip depending on the circumstance.
Another indication of change was the ignored request for spicy, though the meal was otherwise tasty enough.
PS: further to the reply below, I am basing my review on past experiences,  when none of the above occurred.
While there has always been a restaurant of sorts on the site, it's current iteration is in fairly recent years. Perhaps different management then, if not owners.
sample_reviews_en.author: paul spinks

sample_reviews_en.text:
This café is better than any restaurant. The food here is incredibly delicious, and the staff are extremely kind and responsive. I absolutely love this place and come here all the time.

I would especially like to highlight two staff members: Win, who works in the morning and during the day — he is a very courteous and attentive guy. And the girl who works in the evening — her name is Mook. She amazed me with her kindness! You don’t meet people like her every day — it’s truly a gift from above. She is incredible.

Thank you so much to the management for having such wonderful employees. It’s truly valuable to have people like them on your team. I am grateful to this place, and I will definitely come back again and again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Alana Baeva

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a lemon tea, mango smoothie, Tom yum fried rice with chicken, morning glory and garlic squid squid.
The mango smoothie was full of real mangoes and was really delicious. The squid was crispy and the morning glory quite tasty. They were both however a little bit too salty. Tom yum fried rice was not bad. I think we should have gone for steamed rice considering how rich the flavours were going to be. But overall we still liked the food and the mango smoothie was a 5 out of 5.
Would come back here for a mango smoothie on a hot afternoon.
It was also in a very breezy location in the evening as it caught the evening breeze. You won't need the fan here. Very comfortable at 8pm this evening.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maria Ngo

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried the Pad Thai here and overall it was tasty, though the noodles were a bit on the soggy side. The portion was generous, and I really appreciated the big prawns they were tender, soft, and cooked just right. The staff were warm and welcoming, creating a friendly atmosphere, and the food came out pretty quickly, which is always a plus. A decent plate of Pad Thai, especially if you’re hungry and craving a hearty serving.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marcon Danao

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great location and always busy which is a good sign.
We ordered a variety of Thai dishes which were all great. One had a bacon sandwich which came on lovely fresh bread.
It was one of the places we saw doing beer lao which we love so that was a positive.
The staff are a little slow and it did take a while to order, then one of the dishes was missed. But this is Thai time so had time to relax and enjoy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amie Langford

sample_reviews_en.text: Food is Ok but what really annoyed us about this place is they automatically add on a 10% service charge to the bill without you knowing.....firstly they missed a dish off our order..food didnt come out together and when we saw the added 10% my wife questioned it only to be bluntly told "you must pay".. last time we go here.. there are better places around the corner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Garry Walden

sample_reviews_en.text:
A gem of a find, we've visited a few restaurants locally and this one was the first that we thought hit the spot, the food was so good that we had to order extra.

Highly recommend the crispy fried pork with Thai basil as well as the sesame chicken.

If we would have found this on night one of our trip, it would have been an easy decision to eat there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ben Tucker

restaurants.name: Toro Fries, Icon Siam 6th Floor
restaurants.address:

ชั้น 6, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Definitely instagrammable. This is the kind people will want photos with.

They had many choices of sauces but after perusing them carefully, we ended up with the cheese and classic mayo.

However, if you’re excited and expect it to taste like real fries, this isn’t it. When it’s hot, you won’t really taste it but once it starts cooling a little, you will know it tastes fake. More so if one is accustomed to eating real fries and real potatoes. One can tell the difference right away.

The sauces also tasted like fake food, ultra processed ingredients most probably. I don’t usually dispose of food but this one, I couldn’t eat more. It tasted way too processed. After this experience, I prefer eating real fries now that I have tasted how terrible fake fries taste like.

Service was quick and attentive. The person was helpful in explaining how the system works. We decided not to have the sauces poured all over the fries as it would be too messy to eat, so she gave us separate dipping sauces, which we appreciated.

There were a few tables with seating around and we managed to get an empty table.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna M

sample_reviews_en.text:
Toro Fries is a popular fast-food chain that specializes in serving high-quality, crispy fries, and Icon Siam Mall is one of their many locations.

One of the things that stands out about Toro Fries is the variety of toppings available for their fries. Customers can choose from a range of options, including cheese, bacon, chili, and even truffle. This selection ensures that there's something for everyone, regardless of their taste preferences.

In terms of the quality of the food, Toro Fries is known for using fresh, high-quality ingredients to prepare their dishes. The fries are crispy and flavorful, and the toppings are generously portioned. The restaurant also offers a range of drinks, including sodas and iced teas, to complement your meal.

Overall, Toro Fries Bangkok Icon Siam Mall is an excellent option for anyone looking for a quick and satisfying meal. The restaurant's welcoming atmosphere, variety of toppings, and high-quality ingredients make it a must-try for anyone in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: A M

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, but incredibly messy to eat. If I have to buy it again next time, I'll order the sauces separately in cups because when you eat all three sauces at once, the flavors overpower each other.
