Today I ordered three flavors: Tom Yum Goong, Nori Wasabi, and Truffle Mayo.
🦐The Tom Yum Goong flavor tasted like chili sauce.
🍙Next, the Nori Wasabi flavor was bland; it tasted like plain mayonnaise with no wasabi smell at all.
🍄‍🟫Finally, the Truffle Mayo flavor was fragrant, creamy, and not too salty – the best!
I think the restaurant doesn't really need to put that much sauce on the fries. It makes them look heavy. Foreign customers who shared a table picked up their fries, and they broke, fell on the floor and chairs, and the sauce spilled everywhere. Plus, they didn't clean up the mess. The staff couldn't keep up with cleaning each table, and it became a random accident for the next customer to sit on the sauce stain.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suchanart Uransathian

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a terrible experience at this shop. I was told to wait for 50 minutes and given a machine that was supposed to play a sound when the food was ready. However, the machine never made a sound. When I returned to the shop after 50 minutes, they told me the food was ready, but the machine was not working properly. The food I received was cold, soft, and tasted bad. It was also easy to break. When I asked for a replacement, they refused. I don't understand why I had to take responsibility for the broken machine. Overall, the service and quality were poor. Additionally, the shop expects customers to wait for 50 minutes near or inside the shop, which I found to be inconvenient and frustrating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuna :3

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fries ofcourse it is Instagram worthy but not the taste. The taste is on the sweet side but a bit too much. The fries mainly tasted like flour and not potatoes and was over seasoned. The service was good and the price was pretty friendly. Overall it was ok but would not come back.

Extra Information:
- Parking is available in the mall but it is limited since it is a tourist spot.
- Would recommend taking the BTS (sky train) there since the traffic to get to Icon Siam is crazy.
- Great atmosphere since it is Icon Siam
- Kid friendly and easy wheelchair accessibility
sample_reviews_en.author: sarisa kittijaroenvech

sample_reviews_en.text: Beware, if u r a tourist & cant read thai they will not give you free drink which was clearly mentioned on the check out. While waiting for my order i saw some server asking thai person which drink flavour he would like to have & saw paying same amount which i paid. I used my google translate & read it was written buy one fries get a drink free. Upon asking he hesitated & gave me a drink . Saw the same happened even after me to the other tourist too. I would like to mention Either  dont make any deals for customer if u cant offer to every one. Do not discriminate .
sample_reviews_en.author: S K

sample_reviews_en.text:
My family went on a trip to Thailand after a long time. (January 31, 2023)
We have been to IconSiam in Bangkok.
There are many newly opened shops...
Among them, this French fries shop was unique.(6F) This fried potatoes are very long, and you can choose from a variety of seasoning powders!
Potatoes use Idaho potatoes, which are very famous in the USA!
So, there were a lot of people waiting to order! My kids ordered and ate well!
If you are visiting IconSiam in Bangkok, I recommend you to try it at least once.
sample_reviews_en.author: SYJ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food looks good and the portions are generous—one order can easily be shared by two people.

I tried several sauces, and most were a bit salty but still acceptable. The tom yum sauce, however, was extremely salty and tasted mostly of salt, possibly due to the seasoning sprinkled on top.

The wait was also quite long. Even with four staff members and two fryers available, I noticed that only one fryer seemed to be in use, so many customers had to wait a while for their food.

Overall, decent food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miin Q

restaurants.name: Kowloon Diner 九龍冰室 Cove Hill
restaurants.address:

Unit 104, Kowloon Diner, Cove Hill, 1888 ถ. เจริญกรุง Wat Phraya Krai, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant's prices are reasonable, falling into the mid-range.

The dining environment is comfortable, clean, and air-conditioned!

I'm reviewing Kowloon Diner again. As delicious as ever 😋.

The ingredients are excellent; the shrimp in the shrimp dumplings and rice noodle rolls are very fresh, incomparable to budget restaurants. This time, I had the siu mai, and it was still "delicious"! 🤩

The food selection isn't huge, but it's enough for my family's appetite. 😍

For Hong Kongers and Chinese living in Thailand, this is a taste of "Hong Kong," highly recommended. The only drawback is that the selection isn't extensive, but it's sufficient. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Fong Daniel

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious; we ate it all up. The staff were very attentive and provided excellent service. The prices were also very reasonable. This will definitely become one of my mom's favorite restaurants. In particular, the wonton noodle soup was the best – my mom couldn't stop praising it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chicky Jeab

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! Perfect for anyone who likes Cantonese food and a Hong Kong vibe. Highly recommend trying it. They even have hard-to-find dishes like braised three-egg vegetable stew. Come try it! 🥰🥰🥰 The atmosphere is great and the staff are lovely. 💖
sample_reviews_en.author: เบียวกวางตุ้ง Cantonesediary

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and the atmosphere is nice. It's located in Cove Hill with convenient parking.

🌟Recommended Dishes🌟
Wonton Noodles (Kids love it, the broth is fragrant with shrimp flavor)
Mala Tofu Stir-fry
Shrimp Rice Noodle Rolls
sample_reviews_en.author: P J

sample_reviews_en.text: We visited this restaurant due to its great reviews and it did not disappoint, me and my partner tried a variety of dishes and they were all delicious. Would highly recommend and we will be back when we return to Bangkok
sample_reviews_en.author: Bethany S

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is prepared quickly (if there aren't many customers). The creamy scrambled eggs with rice are flavorful, not bland or greasy. The stir-fried green beans with minced pork are also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakwan Chin

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. We ordered so much that we filled the whole table and finished everything. It was all so tasty, especially the wonton noodles, shrimp rice rolls, and shrimp dumplings.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanita Jirapat

sample_reviews_en.text: Lovely local kitchen with authentic Cantonese taste. Good range of Yam Cha and other Chinese dishes (including some pasta menu!?!). Good value for money. Will definitely return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benjarit Nimboonchaj

restaurants.name: Chez Mony
restaurants.address:

Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: A wonderful discovery in Pattaya! I highly recommend it. The food is varied and absolutely delicious, whether you're craving Thai or European cuisine. Everything is incredibly tasty, very affordable, and the portions are generous. The desserts are excellent too. The place is spotless, the waitresses are incredibly attentive, and the owner is very welcoming. I have four children, three of whom are 10, 11, and 12 years old, and everyone finds something they love. What really sets them apart for me is that everything is homemade, from the mashed potatoes and fries to even the cordon bleu! You and your children will be delighted. This restaurant is a sure thing in my book! The waitresses are very pleasant, even with my 8-month-old baby. I give it a 10/10, and you can go without hesitation; you're guaranteed a wonderful meal. Thank you, Mony! I'll be back again and again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Samira Allam

sample_reviews_en.text: We stopped in by chance and without a recommendation. The place turned out to be very interesting. Beautiful, interesting menu. Lots of tables inside and outside. Friendly waiters. We liked the medium-rare steak. You choose your own side dish: mashed potatoes, French fries, vegetables. Delicious. Excellent spaghetti with a sweet and savory sauce. The avocado and shrimp salad was fairly ordinary, but the dressing was good. We liked the wine in a pitcher. They give you a small bun with each dish. The portions are quite large. Fast service. I recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vadim Moskalchenko

sample_reviews_en.text:
update on 20sept '25

Totally refurbished, absolute transformation from the once simple but cozy place. It seems the former owner Mony is no longer working there. Anyway the place is pleasantly decorated, and the outdoor seating is equivalently nice. The menu has more variety than before, the prices have understandably risen, but in conformity with the similar local restaurants. A different feeling from the family atmosphere we used to know., but the Staff is somewhat Friendly and the service is fast.
sample_reviews_en.author: One Step at a Time

sample_reviews_en.text: Disappointing. The 2 stars are for my wife's Cordon Bleu. That was good. I had the Picana steak. It was so tough I could barely eat it. Took the remains home for the cat. The French Fries were soft and soggy. Not recommended. Pity. Places looks good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rudolf

sample_reviews_en.text:
A great discovery following a friend's recommendation. I chose the chicken fettuccine in a cream sauce, delicious!
The highlight: the tiramisu, fantastic!
There were four of us and we chose four different dishes.
This meal was unanimously approved.
sample_reviews_en.author: philippe bloch

sample_reviews_en.text: If you’re in Pattaya and craving a meal that makes you rethink your entire definition of "good food," Chez Mony is the spot. This place serves up amazing Thai and Western dishes with the kind of flavors that make you close your eyes and do …
sample_reviews_en.author: Jack “Mee” Hoff

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the carbonara and requested a side salad. Both delicious and exactly what I was craving. The environment is chill. It's not a fancy restaurant but that's not what I was looking for. This is worth a meal if you are in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ryan Frank

sample_reviews_en.text: A great place with a great menu execellent food! Parking available! Nice service! Interesting discussion amongst French Arabic about asking iif all the plates were hallal and continuing the discussion on how juicy are the lasyboys.
sample_reviews_en.author: HALO Jumper

restaurants.name: แดงกรอบสวนสน (หมูแดง-หมูกรอบ)
restaurants.address:

69, 81 ซอย รามคำแหง 60 Khwaeng Hua Mak, Khet Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
20251231: This is my third visit. Still delicious!

20251107: Back again! Everything's the same, but even more delicious. Definitely going to be back next time! 🤟🏼😎

I'm so happy to have found a roasted pork and crispy pork rice shop that's so good I have to shout! And importantly, it's not far from home. The roasted pork is sliced ​​thickly, just the right chewy texture. The crispy pork is crunchy, and the sauce is generously poured over the plate. It's so good! But I should mention they also sell noodles. The egg noodles are excellent, soft and chewy, the fish balls are delicious, and the broth is superb. I recommend you try it yourself, because everyone's taste is different. 🤟🏼😎
sample_reviews_en.author: Ongart “nOOm” Roonchai

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant specializes in roasted pork and crispy pork, and I really liked the crispy pork – the skin was incredibly puffy and crunchy. The meat was tender and easy to chew. The roasted pork sauce was a bit too thick and sticky; it needed to be heated up to be just right (I microwaved it to take home). They also have noodles, which I tried but wasn't that great. The restaurant recently moved about 10 steps from its original location. Finding parking on the side of the road is a bit difficult. The service is fast and the staff are friendly and cheerful.
sample_reviews_en.author: yimp yimpdow

sample_reviews_en.text:
Roast Pork and Crispy Pork Rice Shop on Soi Ramkhamhaeng 60
I go there every now and then. I personally like to order the Tom Yum noodles. The flavor is okay, but the crispy wontons are sometimes a bit too chewy and oily. The wonton soup doesn't have a lot of filling, it's more like dough. The roast pork and crispy pork rice with a sweet sauce is a nice touch. A little dark soy sauce is just right. The roast pork is lean, but the crispy pork is good and not tough.
The staff are friendly and the food comes out relatively quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaninun Kittipadimakun

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating here since they were in their old building. They've moved to a new location, and the place is clean and spacious. I ordered the roast pork rice with everything, plus an extra egg. They gave me a generous amount of sauce; those who like a lot of sauce will probably like it (personally, I found it a bit too sweet), so I had to balance it with some dark soy sauce. The crispy pork was nice and fluffy, but the roast pork was a little dry. I also ordered the Tom Yum soup with noodles; it was standard fare.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kun กุน

sample_reviews_en.text:
They moved to a bigger place just few meters away from the old place.
I used to come here almost every week. I like the fried pork and how fast they serve. Today, I tried their new place. Food is the same, delicious as before, but it took about 30mins to serve 😨 Also, they forgot to bring me soup 😰 Next time, I will order in advance and take away to eat at home… waited so long and broke my mood and no feeling of taking food photos…😭
sample_reviews_en.author: Takashi Iwata

sample_reviews_en.text: Very delicious. I come to eat here often. Even when I'm at home, I order it. I once ordered it and left it for an hour. The pork was still crispy. The pork didn't smell rancid. It was very crispy. It was delicious every time I ate it. The dumplings were good. The noodles were good. Everything was good. I highly recommend it. It's a restaurant I eat at very often. I wanted to ordain for it. It's really, really delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Knk Wnn

sample_reviews_en.text: This famous roasted pork and crispy pork rice shop in the Lam Sali area, which I saved from watching "Tiger Crying" a long time ago, finally got to try today. The shop is very clean and inviting, the staff provides good service, and the prices and portion sizes are very reasonable. The taste is excellent, with the thick, flavorful sauce that I like. Next time I'll try the noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: WP Adora

sample_reviews_en.text: Crispy pork lovers shouldn't miss this restaurant. It's very delicious, reasonably priced, has a wide variety of food items, and the service is quick and relatively clean. Another highlight is the sauce, the restaurant's own recipe. It's very satisfying. You can order through a rider and have it delivered to your home, as there's very little parking since it's in an alley.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุวภัทร ชํานาญวนกิจ

restaurants.name: Khaow Mai Pla Mun
restaurants.address:

185 ถนนศรีบำเพ็ญ Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food, reasonable prices, and a clean, air-conditioned dining area. I visit this restaurant daily because the food is simply delicious and the value for money is excellent.

Those who complain about small portions should perhaps consider that not everyone needs to serve huge portions. For me, everything here is perfect: quality, taste, cleanliness, and price. It's also particularly convenient that you can pay easily with your mobile phone using Thai QR codes.

Compared to many other inexpensive restaurants, this one is much more comfortable because of the air conditioning, so you don't get sweaty while eating. The restaurant also gives me a very hygienic impression.

I especially recommend the Tom Kha Gai – it's delicious. I've tried many different dishes and have never been disappointed. There's also a restroom available.

In conclusion: I highly recommend giving this restaurant a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael FKB

sample_reviews_en.text:
Two years ago, I was impressed with the food here. The taste, the presentation, the overall quality. The place was packed. This was no longer the case today. What has remained is the good price. Everything else seems to have gone down. The chicken with cashews - it was lackluster and I counted 3 cashews in it. The (isaan style) larb - the texture was not right (not enough ground toasted sticky rice) and none of the herbs (mint, basil, coriander) was used. Frankly, the food looked tired and boring.
The staff appeared bored as well.
Overall - quite disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alejandro Costa

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was staying at a nearby hotel, so I came here. This area has a lot of foreigners, so it seemed like about half the customers were foreigners and the other half were young Thais.
I ordered a vegetable salad, pork fried rice, and an iced coffee. The salad came with both sesame dressing and mayonnaise. The fried rice was delicious; the rice wasn't too soft, just the right consistency.
The iced coffee was probably instant, but it was cheap, so that's okay.
I noticed they had a lot of delivery orders.
I would recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Spanky Kun

sample_reviews_en.text: The waiter working there was very unfriendly. He didn't come to my table; he stayed far away from me. He didn't confirm my order. He was very rude when speaking to me. I had to get the menu myself. I was very dissatisfied. Anyway, thank you very much for the delicious food you had at the restaurant. It was very tasty. I will come back again. But please tell your waiter to be more friendly and not rude to me. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: M U

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant in the Sathorn area has air conditioning, a large menu, and the food doesn't take too long to arrive. I ordered dry sukiyaki to go. The dry sukiyaki was stir-fried until moist, not too dry. I ordered the mixed version, without chicken, and it included pork, squid, and shrimp. They also provided a separate sukiyaki dipping sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Koy Koya

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and exactly as pictured. I had already decided on my order at home, and I wasn't disappointed when I arrived. The atmosphere was great, the restaurant was clean, and the staff were very friendly and provided excellent service with a smile.
sample_reviews_en.author: mali son

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, cheap, no-frills local Thai food. Everything I’ve had here has been delicious, with a special shout-out to the cashew chicken. The folks working here are curt but friendly, and they’ll get you a delicious meal anytime you walk in …
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael McElligott

sample_reviews_en.text: I came to this restaurant after being told about it by a guy at the motorbike rental shop. I had fried rice with kom yam, som tam, a large bottle of Chang beer, and an iced coffee. The total was cheap at 230 baht, but they only accept cash. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Leo

restaurants.name: Flying Pork Rice with Deep Fried Pork
restaurants.address:

ตลาดนัด ปาก Khao Talo 2 Alley, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Small local restaurant, good price, good food. You can help yourself with free vegetables fresh or blanched and Thai style dipping sauces. They have not only deep fried pork but also chicken and fish. You can find other Thai dishes like basil chicken or seafood. I think foods especially deep fried pork or pork belly will be more delicious if you have it with cold beer. Unfortunately they don’t sell beer but they don’t mind if you bring your own beers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Napaporn Khumpor

sample_reviews_en.text:
11/15/2014
Parking: Streetside parking in front, suitable for motorcycles. Parking for several cars at the back.

Atmosphere: Open-air, well-ventilated, and 19 tables.

Food: Fried pork, lamb, fried chicken, Chinese sausage, pork belly. Vegetables, chili paste, and rice are available. Free refills. Water, soft drinks, tea, coffee, and desserts are also available.

Taste: Very good. The fish sauce with chili is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: DAnuWAT DAUNGKAEW

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm so confused. I bought some food, didn't finish it, and asked to take it home. I put the leftover vegetables with the main dish I was taking home. The employee said I couldn't include the vegetables; I had to buy them separately, 20 baht per bag + chili paste. What?! Does that mean the leftover vegetables are just thrown away, or are they washed and given to other customers?
sample_reviews_en.author: Jib Max

sample_reviews_en.text: Very delicious, worth the effort. Following the story from the show "This Table is Reserved", the pork menu is really delicious. The fried liver with garlic is extremely delicious. The owner is friendly. The girl who appeared on the show came to greet us. She is cuter than on TV. Most importantly, the price is very cheap. I am very full.
sample_reviews_en.author: sama

sample_reviews_en.text: Fresh vegetables and chili paste are free. If you're still hungry, you can get extra rice. The food is inexpensive, and there's no need to queue or get a queue number. Just order at your table from the menu placed on the table. Parking is available behind the restaurant; walk in through the back alley before reaching the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: kanchutha warakornamorndech

sample_reviews_en.text: The service at this restaurant was excellent. I ordered takeout but received the wrong order, yet the restaurant took responsibility and gave me a full refund. The staff were very attentive and polite. The food was delicious. I was very impressed with the service and the restaurant's responsibility.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suwanna Rakkam

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the best healthy lunch. They provide lots of green veggies, soup, and rice for free. No limits. I ordered crispy chicken only for 40 baht. The staff are very friendly. Clean, open-air environment. I will come back to eat here again. Cheap, clean, delicious, fresh vegetables. Excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panai Chirasai

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a fried pork rice shop that I can use the word "delicious" over and over again. Free vegetables, free chili paste, free soup, and you can get extra rice. The portions are generous and great value 😂 Do you have a chance to expand to …
sample_reviews_en.author: ploy nantawan

restaurants.name: Mango House N.8
restaurants.address:

8 Phahon Yothin 51 Alley, Khwaeng Anusawari, Khet Bang Khen, Bangkok 10220, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
“Cozy & hidden restaurant in Bang Khen – a must-try!”

Mango House N.8 is at Phahon Yothin 51 Alley, Anusawari, Bang Khen (Bangkok 10220)￼

The ambiance is warm and homey – the kind of place where you feel like you’re eating at a friend’s house rather than a formal restaurant.

“heart-made” vibe of the dishes.  ￼

The food is full of flavor, with a mix of British & international cuisine. I tried the crispy fried fish, beef fried rice and fresh lemonade – each was tasty and satisfying and fresh pasta too.  ￼

Great for a relaxed meal: it’s tucked away in the alley so it’s quieter than the main street, and there’s parking available.  ￼

🎯 If you’re around Bang Khen or looking for a lunch/dinner spot slightly away from the busy main drag, Mango House N.8 is a strong pick. The food quality and atmosphere make it more than just your average neighbourhood eatery. Just go with the mindset of enjoying a slower, more personal meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: vichest jirabovonvisut

sample_reviews_en.text: I found another favorite restaurant! It's near my house, adorable, and most importantly, incredibly delicious! The steak rice bowl is seriously amazing, the fish and chips are perfectly fried, and the spaghetti carbonara is fantastic. Even though I wasn't very hungry when I went, I finished every single dish! The restaurant is decorated cutely and feels like home. The owner is lovely, and the place is very peaceful. It's just a short walk down a side street and there's parking available. They've recently adjusted their opening hours: Friday, Saturday, and Sunday, 12 PM - 8 PM. I highly recommend it! Please don't let such a great restaurant close down! I'll be back soon!
sample_reviews_en.author: Prapai N. (Chim)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is easy to find. It's a short walk down the soi (alley), on the right-hand side. The entrance is through the second gate.
It's a small restaurant with parking for about 10 cars.
Normally, walk-ins are welcome, but currently, most customers make reservations, so we recommend calling ahead.

The food might take a little while to prepare, but it's worth the wait. The fried chicken breast is crispy and delicious. The beef steak fried rice is also very flavorful. It's worth the wait (because many customers arrived at the same time).
sample_reviews_en.author: PIGGY_ MOMMY

sample_reviews_en.text:
Both dishes at this restaurant were delicious and the portions were large.
- Spaghetti with Pork Meatball: The pasta was cooked al dente, the tomato sauce was rich and creamy, and the pork meatballs were fragrant with spices.
- Fish and Chips: The onion rings were thinly and crispy (the best, I loved it!), the fish portion was large and tender, and the sauce was just right.
It's a cute little restaurant, and the owner is very kind.
I will definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: HummingbirdS

sample_reviews_en.text:
All the food was delicious, just like in the pictures. At first, I wondered if two dishes would be enough, but my boyfriend and I were completely full! It was so delicious, wow, even better than the steak restaurants I've been to. The price was very reasonable, not too expensive at all.
The desserts were also delicious. We had homemade vanilla ice cream and coconut ice cream with mango sauce. In short, everything was delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Praewa Nawachat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, high quality, and the portions are huge! The vanilla ice cream is amazing. I was very impressed.
The serving sizes are generous; two of us ordered two dishes and almost couldn't finish them, but they were so delicious we ate everything on our plates! 😚
The staff provided good service, and the owner was very polite. There's parking available.
I'll definitely bring my family here next time.
🫶🏻❤️😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Vasithorn Usanakornkul

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, with both Thai and Western options. The ingredients are high quality, and each portion is huge, making it great value for money, especially if you're coming with a group. The owner is lovely and friendly. The restaurant has convenient parking. If you're going with a large group, I recommend calling ahead to make a reservation. I will definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oraphan Yoosuparp

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Every dish on the menu is delicious. The portions are generous, making it easy to share with multiple people.
- The restaurant has parking and is conveniently located. Alternatively, you can take the BTS to Racha 11 Station and walk down the alley.
- The restaurant has a great atmosphere, is clean, and pleasing to the eye.
- The owner provides excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukontee Pakahan

restaurants.name: ยู่ไถ่หมูโรงไม้ (Yu-tai)
restaurants.address:

54-56 Boripat Rd, Ban Bat, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything at this restaurant is delicious for us. The broth is clear and unique; if you order the noodle soup without noodles, the broth is sweeter and tastier than usual. But the absolute best thing is the crispy pork. It's the best I've ever had anywhere. It's not greasy, it's perfectly crispy, with just the right amount of fat and meat. I ate the whole bowl! 🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Sudawan Tipsakorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Small but delicious restaurant.
The staff is incredibly kind and the food is delicious.

We were staying near the famous Jay Fai, but this little restaurant is much better: good food at reasonable prices, and it definitely doesn't smell like the Michelin-starred one.

Really good, congratulations. The girl who served us was extremely kind.
Highly recommended!!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Federica Trinci

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sooooooo delicious! Absolutely delicious! Che Po noodles are the best. It's my safe haven whenever friends from out of town visit. It's truly delicious.

P.S. The staff at the restaurant are so kind. I don't eat vegetables, but they remember. If I forget to write "no vegetables," they'll make it without vegetables for me. 🤩✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Jariya Junyawanichakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very Taiwanese-style restaurant.
The owner was very helpful in answering tourists' questions.
The crispy pork was delicious.
However, you can tell the owner that you want the sauce to be separate from the pork, so it's not poured over the meat. This way, the crispiness of the pork will be more pronounced.
sample_reviews_en.author: 王大牛9955

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is located near Wat Saket (Phu Khao Thong). It's a vintage-style restaurant in an old building, selling single-dish meals such as roasted pork, crispy pork, and grilled chicken, served with both rice and noodles. The crispy pork is delicious, but the noodles are the winner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanatorn manaudomkul

sample_reviews_en.text: The charm of this old shop, formerly a sawmill, is something anyone who lived in the 70s or 80s will understand. The noodles, rice, and various meats are delicious. Importantly, the prices are unbelievably cheap; you'll be shocked when you figure out the total price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nunthaphan Jamornluck

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honestly i was blown away!
Goose and pork mix noodle soup is so good, you have to try it.
This street restaurant definitely has and authentic feel which i love and the staff as sweet and nice!
just demolished my meal in five minutes, it was honestly so good🤤
sample_reviews_en.author: eldarM

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a noodle dish with caramelized pork, it was excellent. I even made a mistake putting the broth in my noodles, and they made me a new batch. I highly recommend it; it's a great place to eat very well and cheaply.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maxime

restaurants.name: Passionrista Coffee & Brunch (Ladprao)
restaurants.address:

24 30 Lat Phrao 21 Alley, Lane 2, Khwaeng Chom Phon, Khet Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
ข้อความรีวิวภาษาอังกฤษ (ยาวประมาณ 80–85 คำ) สำหรับนำไปโพสต์ใน Google Maps:
"Stopped by this lovely spot and had an absolute treat! I ordered the clear matcha and a sesame bagel with cream cheese, and both were top-tier. The clear matcha was incredibly crisp, vibrant, and clean-tasting—super refreshing without any unwanted bitterness. The bagel was toasted to perfection with a delightful chew, packed with nuttiness from the seeds, and paired wonderfully with the smooth cream cheese. Such a cozy atmosphere and excellent quality overall. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a great matcha and snack break!"
sample_reviews_th.author: Thongchart

sample_reviews_en.text:
☁️🍵 Another cafe that impressed me a lot!

Matcha lovers must try this! The Yuzu Matcha is fragrant, refreshing, and has the perfect balance of sweet and sour. It's so refreshing! The brownie is deliciously rich and dense, yet the cream is soft and smooth. They go together perfectly! 🤍

The atmosphere is quiet, comfortable, and airy, perfect for working for long periods. Soft background music plays, making it pleasant and not distracting. The tables are comfortable, and the cafe is incredibly clean; they take great care of every corner.

Another thing that impressed me was the staff – they were so lovely 😊 The service was excellent, they were smiling, friendly, and constantly refilled my water without being asked. Their attention to detail made me feel warm and welcome, and I want to come back again.

I think this cafe has it all: drinks, desserts, atmosphere, and service. It's perfect for chilling, reading, working, or just relaxing on a peaceful day. 💚

⭐️ Taste: 10/10
🍵 Yuzu Matcha: Highly recommended
🍫 Brownie: A must-order
💻 Suitable for working: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
💛 Service: Extremely impressed
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐนรี สถิตธรรมจิตร

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of those hidden gems in a local Thai neighborhood that makes you feel at home the moment you walk in. It’s cozy, calm, and has a real lived-in warmth I don’t often find in Bangkok cafés.

Coffee is amazing! All local Thai beans including some special unique international blends. The food menu has breakfast and brunch style with tones of choices and good portions for super cheap prices.

There’s strong WiFi, plenty of sockets, and comfortable seating, so it’s perfect for working or just spending a lazy afternoon.

The garden terrace is my favorite, with nice touch of greenery and small fish pond. The staff are always friendly and can speak english providing me help with some local knowledge.

They also have a second floor with convenient workspace room, which I used for my meeting calls, including a printer and extension monitor for my laptop!

Shop is just a short 5-minute walk from the MRT, tucked in a quiet neighborhood so there’s no loud traffic piercing your ear drums!

Love this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicolas Fragassi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The wall by the parking lot has really cute paintings.
There's an outdoor area with a stone fountain and a beautifully designed Japanese garden, very minimalist.

The menu is diverse, and the coffee is decent.
Some seats have power outlets.

When I arrived, the staff didn't greet me or smile. When I left, they didn't say anything either, like I was invisible.
They didn't mention that there's seating upstairs as well.
But...
they greeted every foreign customer very warmly.
I've been to over 30 coffee shops around Ladprao, and I've never encountered one that treated me like this.
Most of the shops are very homey, and the people are incredibly lovely, from the owner to the baristas and staff. I was really surprised to experience this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Felice S

sample_reviews_en.text: At first, I was hesitant to ask about drinks not on the menu, but I discreetly asked the barista if I could take a picture of the piccolo, which wasn't on the menu, but the staff recommended it well and kindly let me take a photo before it was served, to use for my review page ♡♡ The shop offers a selection of beans: light, medium, and dark roasts. I'll definitely go back again when I have some free time. The coffee is delicious, and the staff kept refilling my water 🥰 When I went, there weren't many customers, so I was able to enjoy my coffee in a relaxed way. It was quiet and perfect for working. The croissant was also delicious 🥐
sample_reviews_en.author: DEAR V.

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here with a friend today! We were the first customers. It’s a lovely little coffee shop with a peaceful and gentle atmosphere. Soft warm music plays in the background while we sat and looked at the zen like garden. I had some green tea and carrot cake. I also tried a bite of my friend’s green tea brownie. All were excellent! During the month there are various art workshops upstairs, maybe you will find one that you like. Also, the place is within walking distance from MRT Lat Phrao. I recommend it very much, especially if you like a chilled place for a warm cup of coffee and conversation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kevin Sund

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just a 5-minute walk from MRT Ladprao, this café is a pleasant and homely place to work remotely.

I’d highly recommend their Spice Latte — a perfect blend of masala spices and smooth latte coffee. The aroma instantly brought me back to my travels in India — fragrant, comforting, and truly unique. They serve it with delightful cookies, adding a little warmth to the whole experience.

Whether you’re working on your laptop or simply taking a slow afternoon break, this café is the kind of place that makes time feel unhurried.
sample_reviews_en.author: Koong 8142

sample_reviews_en.text:
This has become my absolute fave coffee shop in Bangkok! The girls who work here are so sweet! It’s just round the corner from where I am studying and I pop in two or three times a day! The breakfasts are so yummy! I always have their double shot iced cappacino! It’s only 70 baby! WOW! Everywhere else is almost twice that price and half as nice.

Lovely chilled decor, and chilled background music- definitely worth a visit if you’re in lat phrao area
sample_reviews_en.author: Charlotte Houghton

restaurants.name: Monkey Suki รามคำแหง81
restaurants.address:

2 Ramkhamhaeng 81 Alley, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, flavorful, and reasonably priced. The service was excellent; the staff were lovely and attentive. The restaurant had a nice atmosphere, was clean, and comfortable. Overall, I was very impressed and will definitely return if I have the opportunity.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nurhafeesa Sulong

sample_reviews_en.text: Monkey Suki is a great value buffet with a wide variety of choices, delicious broth, and decent quality fresh meat and ingredients. It's perfect for a meal with friends or a date. Overall, it's worth it! 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: อานิส

sample_reviews_en.text: It's good and delicious. I highly recommend it. For those in Bangkok who are having trouble finding a good shabu-shabu restaurant, come here! It's fantastic!
sample_reviews_en.author: รา รา

sample_reviews_en.text: The "buy 4, pay for 3" promotion is incredibly good value! The meat and seafood here are very fresh. The staff at the restaurant provide excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: ุbus Ra

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything is delicious and fresh. I've been here many times. The dipping sauce is amazing. Everything is delicious. The staff provides excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: บัสรี โต๊ะแว๊ะ

sample_reviews_en.text: Good service, food served quickly, but the Australian beef today was very tough. It was tender at first, but became hard later. Overall, it was okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suraida Chewae

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, especially the oysters; I ordered them again and again. However, the air conditioning was a bit too cold. Overall, it was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Irfan Doloh

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and fresh. The custard buns are to my liking. There's a variety of snacks available, and parking is provided.
sample_reviews_en.author: Latete channel

restaurants.name: The Box of Fit Café & Bistro(Thai,Italian Restaurant And Bar) ร้านอาหารไทย นานาชาติ
restaurants.address:

1259 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant serves authentic Thai recipes passed down from grandmother, as well as international dishes.

A dish we highly recommend is the mushroom soup. It's incredibly flavorful and rich in ingredients.

For our main course, we had the salmon steak set with papaya salad. The papaya salad was delicious and not too spicy – ​​a combination that international diners would likely enjoy.

Our absolute favorite dish was the stir-fried rice with pork, chili, and salt. They stir-fry it with Chinese rice wine sauce, which was perfectly suited to our taste.

The menu is incredibly diverse, with hundreds of dishes! If you're in the Charoen Nakhon area, this is a great place to eat. The prices are also very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gracelicious (Kaegrace)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant accepts the Thai Help Thai Plus government subsidy program.

I ordered a half-pizza with a tuna and spinach topping. It looked delicious. I ordered at lunchtime, and the staff were just opening the shop when they turned on the air conditioning. Normally, this restaurant has a steady stream of foreigners and gets very busy in the evenings.
sample_reviews_en.author: PhraPin5.Market

sample_reviews_en.text:
All the food looks delicious and is reasonably priced. There's a wide variety to choose from, including desserts and coffee. The staff are lovely.
Overall, everything was great. I'd only ever walked past before, but today I finally had the chance to stop by. I'll definitely be back again! 🎊🎊
sample_reviews_en.author: Benya Dararung

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was delightful, and the staff were very attentive. The place has a calm and lovely vibe, making it an ideal spot to just sit back and enjoy a nice meal. You can confidently choose this place to grab a bite to eat and have a few drinks after a hectic day touring Bangkok ✨😍 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Hanife Köse

sample_reviews_en.text: We chose this restaurant because it's close to our hotel and very popular. The staff were very friendly. We ordered chicken noodles and mango rice and were very satisfied. They even offered us complimentary Italian soda.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaan KEFAL

sample_reviews_en.text: Great atmosphere, the staff were lovely and very attentive. The food was delicious, the drinks were excellent, and watching the football match was pure bliss.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amawasee Viriyanucroa

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner is incredibly welcoming, the menu doesn't look expensive, the food is amazing, and the restaurant is clean and tidy. 🌹 Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: 林枫

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a pleasant atmosphere, the staff provides good service, the food tastes delicious, and it's quite busy.
sample_reviews_en.author: ครูหวาน สายย่าววว

restaurants.name: Sai Sa-ard Noodle (Arun Amarin)
restaurants.address:

345/8 Arun Amarin Rd, Wat Arun, Bangkok Yai, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
📷 Location: The Noodle Boat restaurant is opposite Arun Temple, making it convenient and easy to get to.

📷 Space:
The restaurant has a spacious interior, not too many tables, and comfortable seating.

📷 Service:
Orders are taken in English, and food arrives in about 10 minutes.

📷 Drinks:
The Thai red milk tea I drank had a slightly unusual taste, like they added grass jelly; you can try it.

📷 Food:
Delicious, flavorful, spicy, and the portions are small; 2-3 bowls per person is enough.

According to the menu pictured, dishes number 1 and 3 are quite good; the soup dishes are tastier than the dry dishes.

📷 Price: Reasonable prices, around 40k-70k VND.

⚖️ Overall rating:
The noodle boat restaurant serves authentic dishes with good service.

The toilets are a bit small, and you'll need to queue when it's busy.

There's a sink in front of the shop, but be careful of the pigeons, as they often drop bombs on you.

⭐️ Rating: 8/10.

🛵 Parking: Cars can be parked inside the alley, next to the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Duck Fatty (Review)

sample_reviews_en.text: "I'd like a 10 baht soup, please. The bowl is about the size of a fist, but the noodles are soft, chewy, and delicious. The grilled meatballs are also nice and firm. Every noodle dish takes a long time to prepare. **There's no parking; it depends on your luck.** The staff are a bit grumpy and don't smile; they're probably exhausted from working and inhaling a lot of PM2.5 dust. The shop is open-air with no air conditioning. The old lady selling to foreigners in front of the noodle shop is very good at pushing her to buy things; a packet of dipping sauce is 20 baht. You have to be firm and refuse, otherwise it feels like you're being robbed."
sample_reviews_en.author: Zeiiz Aezz

sample_reviews_en.text:
🥢 Clear Soup Noodles with Meatballs
⭐️ This noodle shop serves pork/beef meatball noodles with a fragrant and delicious broth. It's good even without adding any seasoning. The meatballs have a nice chewy texture, and the thin noodles are soft and perfectly cooked, complementing the broth well. The downside is the long wait for food due to the crowds.
🅿️ Parking on the street is quite difficult to find.
📍 At the entrance of Soi Arun Amarin 11
sample_reviews_en.author: JT.

sample_reviews_en.text: I waited quite a long time for someone to take my order. I ordered drinks three times and still didn't get them. The service wasn't very good; they didn't come when called and seemed reluctant to take orders. From what I observed, the service was generally better for foreigners than for Thais. The food portions weren't worth the price, possibly because they cater to foreigners due to their location near Wat Arun. The food tasted average.
sample_reviews_en.author: C J

sample_reviews_en.text:
📍: Sai Sa-ard Clear Soup Noodles with Meatballs

A great-tasting noodle shop near Wat Arun. 🥢
The dry noodles are a must-try! The noodles are perfectly cooked, chewy and not mushy 🍜. The broth is delicious even without adding any extra seasoning.
They offer both pork and beef 🥩. Besides noodles, they also have grilled meatballs and grilled pork 🔥.
The shop is located near Wat Arun. Parking is available along the street.

#1stEyeView
sample_reviews_en.author: Tananun Na sai

sample_reviews_en.text: While the culinary quality was acceptable and delicious, I do not anticipate patronizing the establishment again. Should the proprietor wish to be apprised of the specific reasons underlying this decision, you may initiate direct communication via private message. I am prepared to furnish a comprehensive account, the consideration and subsequent action upon which shall remain entirely at your discretion.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oil PPP

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, but the person taking the orders...
seems confused.
If you sit outside, you'll have a long wait.
Those who arrive later and get a seat inside will have their order taken immediately.
Those outside will have to wait, thinking, "I'll come take your order when I'm in a better mood." It seems like this is just a habit.
The owner should train them better.
Terrible, not okay at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: วีรภัสส์ ภักดีจิราวัจน์

sample_reviews_en.text: The meatballs are delicious. The noodles come with fragrant fried garlic and a good broth. The pork slices are tender, and the peanuts are freshly roasted. However, they don't give a lot of broth. The service is very slow, but they collect payment very quickly. They have separate pots for pork and beef noodles, but there's only one person cooking the noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: จุ๋ม

restaurants.name: The Viking Lasalle (ร้านอาหารและดนตรีสด)
restaurants.address:

555 11 ถนน แบริ่ง - ลาซาล, ตัดใหม่ Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Great and reasonably priced food and drinks."

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very nice local venue. Live music. Food menu to accomp the drinks (or vice versa). Popular on weekdays too. Affordable pricing. Great for small groups.
OBS: Pool inside and retractable roof.

Due to location between 105 and 107 sometimes hailing taxi in the night might be difficult so better use an app to order one.
sample_reviews_en.author: Henry

sample_reviews_en.text:
A little difficult to find. Impressive venue with live Thai and farang music. Not busy on my visit but still good feeling.
Food was distinctly average but prices on food and alcohol 🍸 good.
Not many taxis after midnight and they are reluctant to go into central Bangkok or further west.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrew Hampton

sample_reviews_en.text: May be because it was week day but the attention was low. The food is okay but the ambience is fine. They have huge screens playing movies n sports. The service quick but not proactive, again, May be because it was a weekday. Should try one time though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kalesh Menon

sample_reviews_en.text: It was fun. They had drink promotions on both Chang and Leo beer. The live music was good. The restaurant is right on the main road. If you arrive early, you can park close by; if you arrive late, it's a bit of a walk. The food tasted good. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarawut Polsen (ไลน์ 2goratchaburi)

sample_reviews_en.text: There are so many delicious dishes here! The salmon sashimi is fresh, with large, satisfying slices. The seafood dipping sauce is a highlight. The crispy lemongrass-fried chicken is fragrant and comes in a generous portion. The spicy …
sample_reviews_en.author: info work

sample_reviews_en.text: Choice of only two beers, both very expensive. Heineken was 120 baht a bottle. If you want ice, add another 50 baht! Music too loud to have a conversation. Please clean your toilets too, they are disgustingly filthy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ian B

sample_reviews_en.text: I love this place, not exactly a pick my next girlfriend up kind of bar. But perfect for just chilling, drinking with mates and having fun listening to some great live local artists on stage until the early morning.
sample_reviews_en.author: StarLord Worldwide

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the service was great, the restaurant is large and can accommodate many people, the music was fun, and there were PR staff available. Highly recommend trying it! 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: กนกนุช ศรีเดช

restaurants.name: คลังเนื้อ Yakiniku Grill & Chill พรานนก
restaurants.address:

บางเชือกหนัก 59 Phran Nok Phutthamonthon Sai 4 Rd, Bang Chueak Nang, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Food and grill were really disappointing… could not get any good char on the meat, and meat quality seemed lower than what was advertised. Sides were OK, but beef rice was very strange. When we asked the kitchen if they could grill the rest of our 5 pieces of meat to try and get a better result, it took 20 minutes for food to come back and it had less char then when we cooked it and was ice cold. Like they had forgotten. Then we mentioned it, they said they would just heat it up, after the meat had already been ruined. Overall really disappointing, but staff were generally good and looked after well. If you drive here also, watch out for the rain as the car park very quickly turns into a swimming pool!
sample_reviews_en.author: Oscar Haynes

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the opportunity to try the meat at Klang Nua (Meat Warehouse) restaurant. The meat was truly good and delicious.
The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, perfect for enjoying Japanese food.
The parking lot is spacious and convenient.
I highly recommend it to meat lovers. You have to try it; you'll be hooked!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ramida Tangsrifarh

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is near my house, but this was my first time here. The ninja set is great value, the meat tastes really good. I recommend it. The other dishes are also very good. The staff are all lovely and provide excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mananya Panyadhira

sample_reviews_en.text: This meat shop truly lives up to its name. The quality of the meat is just like eating in Japan; it's excellent and delicious. The service is also outstanding. Everything is 10/10. I loved it! The desserts are also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: กณิกนันต์ เลียนษี

sample_reviews_en.text: Such a wonderful ... wonderful Japanese restaurant with perfect wagyu beef !!  Wholeheartly recommended for meat lover. Can be a bit pricey but better than trying to have the same thing in Japan, I think.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kraisorn Liansee

sample_reviews_en.text: The meat was delicious and the restaurant had a great atmosphere. If you love eating meat, I highly recommend this place because they use beef from Australia and Japan, and the flavor is amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alisa Angwitayatorn

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely amazing! The meat was so tender it melted in my mouth, the staff were so soft and cuddly, and the service was superb.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธีร์ธวัช สัตยกมลฉัตร

sample_reviews_en.text: The meat was delicious, the price was good, and the service was excellent. I'll definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nook Jariya

restaurants.name: PaDang Kitchen
restaurants.address:

423, 425 Phra Sumen Rd, Wat Bowon Niwet, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for a simple, convenient Thai restaurant where you can get your food served right away without waiting, I highly recommend this place. The food is delicious, with fragrant, mellow curry paste and a rich Thai flavor. Perfect for those who enjoy traditional Thai cuisine, this curry is full of flavor and fragrant Thai herbs. The ingredients are carefully selected and carefully selected. I recommend the pork rinds stir-fried with curry paste and salted egg, and the catfish stir-fried with chili and minced meat. It's incredibly delicious, with no fishy smell. The massaman curry is fragrant with spices and coconut milk. They probably use their own pressed coconut milk because it has a subtle, delicious aroma.
Finally, we had the sticky rice with mango and sticky rice with durian. The flavors were excellent, not too sweet, and the sticky rice was fragrant and soft. The mangoes were excellent, and the durian was even better (the durian was in large pieces). Absolutely delicious! 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanokpun Ekabut

sample_reviews_en.text:
Upon entering, I encountered a service system like a boss sitting at a table, with no queuing system. During peak hours, everyone crowds around the food serving area. You have to hope the staff making eye contact with you while serving the food, otherwise you'll have to wait indefinitely. People who arrive later and make eye contact first get served first.

I ordered rice with two curries: pork panang and two small pieces of fried pork, about 4 cm in diameter. The rice was decent. The panang curry sauce was rich but overly sweet, almost sickeningly so. The pork pieces tasted okay.

I went to pay the boss, and had to wait for the staff to check the price. I was shocked to hear the price: 86 baht for two dishes!

The taste wasn't terrible, but the price was outrageous. I've never paid so much for roadside curry rice before. Once is enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: City of Angel

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you find yourself walking to 711 for a snack then my advice is to skip the snack and go to PaDang Kitchen.
Why you may ask!? Well because the food here is without doubt that true authentic Thai taste and as such the dishes are on the spicy side but soooo tasty!
Sweet pork curry and mild fish coconut curry were brilliant and the owners son was very helpful so try his advice on which dishes might suit us.
We went for lunch and each day the family owners make over 40 different dishes that you can indulge in. Padang uses 10kg of Thai Chilis per day , these are the small one about an inch long that really pack a punch which explains the wonderful spiciness of all their dishes.
Pricing was very reasonable at around 80 bhat for a meal with drink.
Go before Mark Weins discovers it and makes it too busy
sample_reviews_en.author: Jo Ana

sample_reviews_en.text:
[Phra Nakhon].

📍Pa Daeng's Kitchen, Bang Lamphu.

Another favorite curry rice restaurant. It's located near the Wan Chat Bridge intersection. I recommend going early in the morning; they'll have all the curries available then.

I ordered three dishes: stir-fried chicken, stir-fried chicken with bamboo shoots, and fried pork. All three were delicious.

I liked the stir-fried chicken with bamboo shoots the best; it was nice and spicy. The fried pork was also good.

They have a wide variety of dishes to choose from, but if you go later, some might be sold out.
——————————-
🏡 Pa Daeng's Kitchen, Bang Lamphu
📍 Wan Chat Bridge Intersection, Phra Nakhon
⏰ 06:00-14:00
🅿️ Parking available along the roadside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pangeataround Pang

sample_reviews_en.text: Really delicious and good value local Thai street food with a small simple canteen setup.  Street food pricing, a handful of tables to sit and dine in. The pad Thai boran (my favourite pad Thai is from here!) is highly recommended, as are the crispy fried mussels 60 baht and the fried chives dumplings. In the mornings they also have a Thai version of nasi kampur or lemak , which you can pick and mix your meal with rice, noodles, curries , soups , choice of proteins.. it’s fab! Been coming here multiple visits and would come back again. Open til late afternoon / sometimes early evening
sample_reviews_en.author: MNML journey

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is an absolute gem! The sweet lady owner is incredibly welcoming, speaks good English, and greets you with a lovely smile—such a charming person. The service from everyone is outstanding, making you feel truly cared for.

You must try the bamboo chicken and the chicken soup; 👌👌😋😋they are both heavenly! The green curry is also very yummy. What's more, the value is unbeatable: you can select three or four different, high-quality dishes for the price you'd pay for just one meal elsewhere. Much love to the lovely people who serve better here😍😍❤️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuhu T

sample_reviews_en.text: This old-fashioned rice and curry restaurant has been open since 1969. It moved to its current location about 10 years ago, occupying a two-shop corner building with no air conditioning. They offer a variety of dishes: one topping for 45 baht, two toppings for 55 baht, and three toppings for 70 baht. We tried several dishes separately. The taste was acceptable. They also offer takeout and dine-in options.
sample_reviews_en.author: พร้อมพูล ชอบเพื่อน

sample_reviews_en.text: A Thai curry and rice restaurant with well-balanced, flavorful dishes—every plate is full of taste and spice. It’s quite popular, so if you see an empty seat, grab it quickly! The staff are attentive and friendly. Their chili fish sauce is made with bird’s eye chilies—spicy and delicious, a must-try. Prices are very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suthiluck Tangsutthimongkhon

restaurants.name: Salad Factory - Silom Complex
restaurants.address:

52 Soi Si Lom 2/1, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered takeout for dinner at the front counter, but the service from the front counter was extremely disappointing. Not only was they unhelpful, but they spoke in a way that suggested they didn't want to serve me. After I placed my order and asked to scan to pay, she told me to scan inside and order again with a staff member inside, even though she had already entered my order. Why ask me to order again unnecessarily? I don't understand the restaurant's system – do I need to order at both the outside and inside counters for takeout? I suggest putting up a sign stating that takeout orders and scanning payments should be made at the inside counter.

When I went to pick up my order, I encountered the same staff member who took my order. I showed her the order slip, but she didn't check or help me verify the order number at all.
She just told me to go pick up my food inside. This is the first time I've encountered such poor service from this restaurant's staff. In the past, other staff members have been helpful and provided excellent service. It was a very bad dinner experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wansika Simarat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ingredients are good, and the taste is mostly to my liking.
The staff are attentive and provide good service.

However, accuracy and completeness in service could be improved. After confirming our order before leaving the table, the staff member was very confused when entering the order information into the system next to our table, asking us to repeat the order at least twice. This also happened to the table next to us.
In addition, another table asked for toothpicks, and the staff member walked over to our table to deliver them, until the table next to us had to ask again.

The restaurant atmosphere is good and meets standard expectations. However, the benches along the wall are too low, making it a little difficult to sit and eat comfortably.
sample_reviews_en.author: d apk

sample_reviews_en.text:
Its slow.... wayyyyy tooooo slow. Its the second time i ordered take away same dish... Chicken caesar wrap. Very easy dish.

The first time i ordered it took me 30 mins wait. This time, I waited more than 30 mins. I assumed they learnt from past experience and make some improvements. But to my disappointment, not in the least bit.

My advice is, if they knew they are going to be this slow, they should at least inform customers first so we can have a choice whether to wait or to go elsewhere. No communication.

Not forgetting that this is silom area where a lot of people are on limited lunch break timing.

At least the food tastes good and ingredients used are fresh. But they need to improve how they run the kitchen.... quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Low

sample_reviews_en.text:
📌🥕🥬 This restaurant focuses on salads and spaghetti, with a wide variety of menu options including drinks and desserts.
🌯 The Tuna Wrap is delicious and a large portion.
🍽🥬🥕 The Salmon Steak comes with mashed potatoes, truffle sauce, and rocket salad. The fish is a large piece with good texture, and the salad is tasty.
🍝 The Drunken Fish Spaghetti doesn't taste like typical drunken spaghetti; it has a strong, rancid oil smell.
♦️ The service is good, fast, and attentive to customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lara Linh

sample_reviews_en.text: there is one employee who feels very bad, her character is like she doesn't want to work, her name is "tip" she served me like trash without a smile and I ordered something extra until I asked 3 times and she didn't bring it and finally her manager came to bring it and after that she felt she had done nothing wrong and acted like a boss and spoke loudly, a restaurant with delicious food will not be attractive if the service quality is bad like the woman named Tip
sample_reviews_en.author: Putu Brxxn

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stopped in for dinner tonight. I decided to try something new. The Grilled Chicken Breast Steak with Truffled Parmesan Cream Sauce with Spinach.

I didn't like it. There is nothing wrong with it but it didn't care for it. My girl was happy because she enjoyed it with her meal.

The staff were friendly and answered all of our questions. They had 7 customers when we sat down and at least 3 more sat down while we were eating.

Stop I'm and give them a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Somchai Camilo

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is located in the basement of Silom Complex, near the Tops entrance. It's spacious with plenty of seating, so there's no need to queue. They have a wide variety of menu options, the food arrives quickly, the portions are a good size (not too small), and the taste is excellent. I usually like their Caesar salad; this one uses a bit more black pepper, but it's still delicious. The staff provides good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Athit Upakan

sample_reviews_en.text: I wanted to order delivery, but the platform wasn't updated; the menu item I wanted wasn't available. I called the restaurant, and the staff helped contact the marketing department to update the menu, but ultimately, it wasn't possible because it takes months to update the app. However, I appreciate the staff's service mind and effort in helping customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nessa Assen

restaurants.name: Grandmother Restaurant
restaurants.address:

Thanon Phetchaburi, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been to Bangkok a few times, and this is by far the most delicious place I've ever eaten, and it's perfect for Korean palates👍

I went there because of the good reviews, but it wasn't open yet because it was daytime, so I wasn't sure if it would be open... but I'm so glad I did... It was seriously the best meal ever...👍👍👍

The location is a bit tricky, but if you look for the sign that says "CO CO WALK"? The round chair area? (Photo 4), it's just a short walk to the right of the entrance (Photo 3).

The Tom Yum Kung I had here was legendary—spicy, coconut, sour—everything was perfect. The combination of rice, meat, and corn tofu was truly legendary. The beer went down smoothly, and two women downed three bottles in no time. The Morning Glory was a bit bland, but it was still delicious.

The staff aren't super friendly, but I can't complain. They communicated well in English, and the meal was perfect. I'll definitely be back here next time I'm in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: nahyeon choi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chinese customers should avoid this restaurant:

1. Pork was being sold as beef; it was inedible and didn't seem very fresh.

2. The staff had sullen faces but were very enthusiastic towards Westerners.

3. There was no air conditioning; it was too hot.

I've been in Thailand for a few days, and this was the first time I'd seen meat that was so tough to chew. I was shocked! 😱 Then they brought me a dish I hadn't ordered. I tried to explain it to them using Google Translate, but the waiter either didn't understand or didn't want to talk to me. It seems like the staff here don't understand Thai and don't speak English. In the end, I had to find someone who seemed to be the owner to get the fish refunded.
sample_reviews_en.author: zhu qiuyi

sample_reviews_en.text: Every time I order takeout from a restaurant, they never bring it to the customer's table. I wait, thinking it's still being prepared, but instead they just leave it on an empty table. Why...? Then I ask the cashier, and they say it's still not ready. Hmm, but I've seen the bag for ages. Finally, they bring it to me, and just as I suspected, it's been ready for a while. I've already paid, so why make me wait? It's a huge waste of time. They really need to improve their service. This has happened several times now; takeout orders aren't brought to the correct table, but why not just place the food at the correct table?
sample_reviews_en.author: นิศารัตน์ พรมแสง

sample_reviews_en.text:
This looks like a family-owned restaurant in Coco-walk.

The restaurant decoration is plain, with not much design; it looks more like a street food restaurant.

It can be very crowded during peak hours.

The menu is vast with Thai food dishes. The cost is quite reasonable, and the flavour is excellent.

The staff is decent, but they appear a bit puzzled when we communicate in English.

The Jim Jum soup, papaya salad, and fried intestine are all fantastic choices here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sai

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered four dishes, and unfortunately, none of them were delicious.

The pork hot pot was cooked in a clay pot right in front of us, which was quite unique.
The grilled meat was also grilled by ourselves over charcoal.
The shrimp cakes had a peculiar texture, but lacked aroma or sweetness.
The blood clams...

The coconut we ordered that day was medium-sized, slightly acidic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alllama

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been to Thailand over 15 times, but I rarely return to the same restaurant.
I want to try as many delicious dishes as possible.
But this place was an exception...
I came here for dinner three days in a row, and each time I tried a different menu, and it was all delicious.
There's a reason I went three days in a row.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yury Mo

sample_reviews_en.text: A wide selection of food, especially non-fried dishes, which is much appreciated when you're tired of stir-fried food. I had half a grilled chicken and two sticky rice for 120 baht. The only downside was that the man told me there was water …
sample_reviews_en.author: dorian Bauwin

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, the flavors suited my taste. The papaya salad wasn't as flavorful as I'd hoped, but it was still good. The grilled pork intestines were the best – perfectly crispy, not bitter or smelly, absolutely fantastic. The sweet liver was …
sample_reviews_en.author: Wishala Saleedang

restaurants.name: 8855 Restaurant & Bar
restaurants.address:

4, 24-25 Soi Sukhumvit 8, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good choice if staying around Soi 8 for standard breakfast fare eggs bacon sausage etc. But coffee or tea is priced extra. Friendly service. Comfortable space. On little side alley, across from Lolita's.
UPDATED rating: the western breakfast is delicious and excellent quality so I have returned several times. Also very good friendly service. And it opens at 8AM.
NEW UPDATE: the all day breakfast menu has some new fancier selections, The Celley for B199 was delicious and very filling. Great friendly service as always.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gio Sailor

sample_reviews_en.text: We had my wife's birthday party here. The staff was very attentive the entire night and made sure we had everything we needed, from food to microphones for Karaoke and even offered to help put up decorations for us. The food was definitely a highlight. The area was spacious on the second floor and had a bartender available on that Flor which was very convenient. No cost to secure the venue which helped me stay within our budget. Highly recommend as a party venue!
sample_reviews_en.author: Randy Hudson

sample_reviews_en.text: The coldest beer you can find on Soi 8 during an EARTHQUAKE 🫨. 😬⛳🍻😅. They have a brand new menu with more choices.  They have an incredible Chicago deep dish pizza. I'm from New York And I have to bend the knee. I'm not comparing it to New York thin slice 🤓. But I order his deep dish all the time. Thai food's amazing. 8855 is a hidden gem. Also, I joined their golf club. It's called bangkok's best bunch. And I believe they have a pool league.
sample_reviews_en.author: Casey

sample_reviews_en.text: A reliable spot with genuinely kind staff who are always quick to respond. The service alone makes it an easy place to return to. The food is solid—good rather than exceptional—but consistently enjoyable. I tend to go for the sweet and sour chicken (including today), which is one of the safer bets on the menu. Overall, a dependable choice when you’re after something tasty without surprises.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marlies Gerritsen-Feenstra

sample_reviews_en.text: Impeccable service from start to finish. From the moment we walked through the door, we were warmly welcomed and fully accommodated until the moment we left. The staff was attentive, professional, and genuinely cared about our experience. Every detail was handled seamlessly, making us feel comfortable and valued throughout our visit. Truly outstanding hospitality—highly recommend 8855.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hakeem

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here mainly for the deep dish. I was craving chicago style pizza and the first 2 slices hit the spot the rest of the pizza was way too acidic (i think from the tomato paste) and sour. I was dissatisfied since it cost about 650 baht for the pizza
sample_reviews_en.author: Wesley

sample_reviews_en.text: Very friendly staff. It's tucked away in a tiny corner off of Soi 8 which gives it a cozy feeling. It's a great place to meet new people and has very comfortable outdoor seating. The food is good and a bit cheaper than other restaurants in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ricardo Orlando

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of my favourite places for a western style breakfast, service is friendly and efficient. It is tucked away from the hustle of Bangkok.

They also have a great selection of popular Thai dishes, that are tasty and reasonably priced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuklc Yuklc

restaurants.name: BanBabb Restaurant
restaurants.address:

307 Ban Baep Alley, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The reviews were so good, I went there, but honestly, I lived in Thailand for a year, and this was the worst Thai food I've ever had. The tom yum kung was seriously the worst I've ever had. The shrimp in the tom yum kung
I don't know how many days had passed, but it definitely didn't look fresh. The pad thai came out like rice cakes,
and the cabbage that came with the food was wilted and twisted.
Please, please be more careful with your ingredients. I'm afraid I'm going to get norovirus. Seriously.

นี่เป็นอาหารไทยที่แย่ที่ สุดที่ผมเคยกินเลยคับจรืงๆ

ขอทิ้งอันที่หมดอายุด้วยคับ
sample_reviews_th.author: 태감

sample_reviews_en.text:
On the day I arrived in Thailand 🇹🇭, I stayed at the nearby Oakwood Hotel, so I went to this restaurant, which was a three-minute walk from the hotel.
I ordered gapow rice and mixed vegetables. The food was cooked outside by the owner's wife? It wasn't overly spicy and tasted absolutely delicious. I think whatever I ordered would probably be delicious.
There was a man (husband?) inside the restaurant, but he was unfriendly and just sat at the table the whole time watching a DVD and on his phone.
It's a shame that I wouldn't give it more stars if the service was a little better.
There was also a slight odd smell, probably because there was a cat, which was a minus.
sample_reviews_en.author: M. O.

sample_reviews_en.text: Creamy Thai green curry, served in a stylish bowl that contrasts nicely against a vibrant red tabletop. Tender slices of chicken are submerged in a fragrant coconut milk-based sauce, beautifully garnished with bright red chili peppers, a delicate flower, and fresh basil leaves, adding a pop of color and hint of fresh herby aroma. Sliced bamboo shoots provide a crunchy texture, while the kaffir lime leaves peeking from beneath add a citrusy depth to the complex flavors. The presentation is inviting, suggesting a balance of spicy, sweet, and savory notes typical of authentic Thai cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Artur Kudłacz

sample_reviews_en.text: Such a charming little restaurant near our hotel, the Holiday Inn Express.  We arrived late evening and were looking for a nearby place for dinner and this quaint restaurant didn’t disappoint.  It’s local Thai and the menu is quite extensive, it’s not a big restaurant and I think it’s good to call and check if seats are available during busy meal periods.  Good was delicious and flavorful.  If you like small animals, this is a perfect venue as the owner keep a few cats to accompany diners.  Lovely place
sample_reviews_en.author: SY Lo

sample_reviews_en.text: Cool place with cats. For me it was so-so, but my girlfriend loved it. I think this is a very unique spot in Bangkok. It is cheaper than a regular restaurant but more expensive than street food. I've never been to a restaurant that is also an art café. Well, I have, but they blend into one here. The owner is clearly a very talented person who pours a lot of love into his craft, and I can safely say the same about the food. We took the fish, pork neck, rice, and some vegetables. All very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: C_T

sample_reviews_en.text: Exit 4 from BTS Saphan Taksin station and walked about 3 min and you'll find this restaurant. It's like a 🏠 and the owner is very friendly and kind and made us feel very welcome. There's cat 🐈 in the restaurant. The interior is very nice and cool. Food is very nice but spicy (ask for less spicy if you cannot take it) and better than any Michelin places we went. Price wise is also very affordable. Really a hidden gem.
sample_reviews_en.author: Asia Foodie

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the restaurants that has retained its classic charm for over 20 years, and still feels just as timeless today. The owners, a lovely couple, are incredibly friendly, making you feel as though you've stepped back in time. Everything is so vibrant and full of life, almost like reliving the past. I highly recommend visiting this restaurant if you ever get the chance to come to Bangkok. It’s a must-visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom Jaturavit Tinsulanonda

sample_reviews_en.text:
Baan Baep Restaurant
is a restaurant and a semi-music bar.
The decor is contemporary.

The food tastes okay.
The prices are typical for a restaurant with live music, but slightly higher than average for a regular restaurant (average starting price is around 80 THB per dish).

There are cats here, so it might not be suitable for those with cat allergies.

The restaurant accepts cash and QR code payments.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supawut Saengrassamee

restaurants.name: Kai Chef House
restaurants.address:

2922/67 ชั้น 2, 2922 New Phetchaburi Alley, Bang Kapi, Huai Khwang, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10310

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious!

This restaurant is located in the Charn Issara Building. There's parking available in the building. It might be a little confusing to find once you get there, but there are signs for the restaurant on every floor. The restaurant is decorated like a typical Thai street food stall, but the food is delicious in every dish and the prices are reasonable. I highly recommend it!

Recommended dishes:

- Fried Pork with Frog Brand Fish Sauce (220 THB): Large, tender, and not chewy pieces of pork. It has a very fragrant fish sauce aroma, with a sweet and sour taste. It goes perfectly with rice.

- Tom Sarawat (189 THB): A pickled cabbage soup with minced pork, seasoned to taste like Tom Yum. It's sour and spicy, and incredibly delicious. I've never had anything like it before. You can easily drink the whole bowl!

Taste A
Price A
Atmosphere B+
Service A
Cleanliness A

Atmosphere B+
Service A

sample_reviews_en.author: Wattanin Bannasarn

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here based on a review from a YouTube channel. It was lunchtime, and the restaurant is easy to find; it's on the second floor of the building, and there are signs guiding you. At lunchtime, the restaurant was full of office workers on their break, and the atmosphere was noisy. If you prefer a more relaxed dining experience and want to savor the flavors at your own pace, I recommend going before noon or in the afternoon. As for the food, there's a huge menu with everything looking delicious. Based on the review, I ordered the Pad Thai – two types: traditional Pad Thai and fresh shrimp Pad Thai. It didn't disappoint. The fresh shrimp were large and succulent, and the dried shrimp were also large and salty, perfectly complementing the sweet Pad Thai sauce. The Pad Thai wasn't spicy; you'll need to add more seasoning if you prefer it spicier. It had a wonderful wok-fried aroma. Overall, it was delicious and highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Happiness Happiness

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious! 😘

Well-balanced, harmonious, and authentic.

The quality, quantity, taste, and price are outstanding. I wish other restaurants would maintain this standard.

It's no wonder that food critics give it such high praise.

This is a restaurant where you can feel the sincerity and fairness of the food, exceeding the price you pay. Every dish I ordered was delicious. I've been twice, so I'm confident, and I'll probably go many more times.

It's a great place for a quick bite or a full meal. A satisfying meal costs around 150-200 baht per person. Remember, the basic focus is on single-serving, filling dishes.
