I recommend making a reservation and ordering your food in advance. Try to avoid peak lunchtime; going during that time will be more convenient, as it's a very busy restaurant.

Parking is available in the building; eating at the restaurant gets you free parking, but I'm not sure how many hours.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jack Worapan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I saw reviews of this restaurant in many places, and many people were talking about it, so I decided to try it.
The atmosphere was quite lively, with a constant flow of people. The menu offers a wide variety of choices, including Thai food and single-dish meals.

On the day I went, I tried:

* Green Curry
* Rice Noodle Rolls
* Pad Thai
* Shrimp Paste Fried Rice

Overall, I felt the flavors weren't quite as well-balanced as I'd hoped. Some dishes were rather average, and none of them were as amazing as many reviews suggested.
The shrimp paste fried rice and Pad Thai were okay, but the green curry wasn't as rich as I expected.

It might be a matter of personal taste, as I saw many other tables enjoying it immensely. 😅
But if I have the chance, I might go back and try other dishes to see if I find something more to my liking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nana Relax

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant I've been eating at for many years. Four years ago, it was delicious, but now the quality has declined with each visit. The chef's skills are inconsistent. The last time I went, I ordered seafood glass noodle salad, but they made it into minced pork salad instead. The staff changed it, but when it arrived, it had a very strong bottled lime juice smell. The restaurant didn't used to use bottled lime juice before. I'm confused why they wouldn't use fresh limes when limes aren't that expensive. Also, the shrimp was undercooked. I asked the staff if it was normal for the shrimp to be undercooked. The staff informed the counter, but the owner didn't take any action. I was very disappointed. Before, if anyone asked me what to eat, I would recommend this restaurant, but now I won't be going back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lewis By

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is incredibly delicious and reasonably priced. Chef Aunt Kai, the owner, is lovely and her cooking skills are consistently excellent. It's unbelievable that such a delicious restaurant is hidden away on the 2nd floor of the Charn Issara building – like a master chef hiding somewhere! I came today because I missed Chef Aunt Kai's cooking. I tried a new menu item, the bouncy pork ramen, and let me tell you, it was heavenly. The bouncy, tender pork belly practically melts in your mouth, and the rich flavor permeates the meat. It's so delicious I can't even describe it. Simply put, it's amazing! You have to try it yourself.
sample_reviews_en.author: punpote wongvongsri

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been a customer of this restaurant for many years. I don't come often, but I've been here many times. The food used to be delicious and I was never disappointed. But this last time was very disappointing. The taste of some dishes wasn't the same as before. When I informed Chef Kai, he said it was probably because there was a new chef.
- Pad Thai: Very disappointed with this dish. It wasn't tasty, bland, and lacked flavor.
- Stir-fried Three Smells (Pad Sam Men): The taste was average, nothing special. It didn't feel amazing like it used to be.
- Stir-fried Ginger and Chili (Pad Prik King): This dish was as good as always.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charistma W

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food looks simple and homey, but the taste of each dish is absolutely amazing!

Especially the Thai papaya salad. It includes tomatoes, so it's not overly sweet, with a unique sourness – a whole new dimension to eating Thai papaya salad that impressed me the most.

The Pad Thai is rich and flavorful. Just a squeeze of lime to cut the sweetness, mix the ingredients, and it's perfect!

It's a pity... the chef should have stir-fried the shrimp with the Pad Thai sauce instead of blanching them and topping them on the Pad Thai.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akara Kiattiajin

restaurants.name: RITA Japanese Eatery
restaurants.address:

610 5 ถนน Phahonyothin 32 Alley, Chan Kasem, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Japanese restaurant near my house is delicious, with a wide variety of dishes to choose from, both set meals and à la carte options. The prices aren't too high, and the staff are incredibly polite and provide excellent service.

Parking on the street in front of the restaurant might be a bit difficult, but you can try circling around or walking a little further.

P.S. Their fried items are cooked with minimal oil, which is fantastic! Highly, highly recommend it! ♡
sample_reviews_en.author: Manaschanok Buanark

sample_reviews_en.text:
Randomly found this place and it didn’t disappoint! Their tonkatsu is truly delicious. The Rosu Katsu set is only 249 baht and comes with a cup of green tea (hot or cold—your choice). Super satisfying! I’ll definitely be back to try other dishes. The waitress was incredibly polite too—I couldn’t help but smile/bow back at her.

One small improvement I’d love to see is better ventilation—because I definitely smelled like deeply fried tonkatsu when I left.🥹
sample_reviews_en.author: Kletdoaw Sincharoenkul

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my favorite curry restaurant. I love eating it with their homemade fukunaki (Japanese char siu), it's incredibly delicious! The soy sauce is also fragrant and tasty, everything is made in-house. The sashimi is also excellent. The food quality is top-notch. All the staff are very well-trained, lovely, and provide excellent, polite service. The prices are reasonable. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Apisara S.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a truly authentic Japanese restaurant! It's become one of my favorite regular spots. The food tastes amazing, the ingredients are incredibly fresh, and most importantly, the price is excellent value. The portions are generous – …
sample_reviews_en.author: woonsentan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pork cutlet curry rice was standard and tasty. The light beer was reasonably priced.

The staff were very polite.

The restaurant doesn't have parking; you have to park on the street.

Orders are placed via QR code.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanwit Phongamwong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff are extremely polite and the service is good.
The food tastes great.
There are beer promotions.

Parking is available on the street in front of the restaurant, but parking spaces are limited.
sample_reviews_en.author: chamachote chokboonmongkol

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere of the restaurant is like being in a restaurant in Japan. The food tastes very good. I like the soup. The price is good and not expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nat Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the prices were good, and the staff were so polite and provided excellent service that I felt a little embarrassed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adchara Srisawat

restaurants.name: โกกี้ นมสด ทุ่งครุ
restaurants.address:

Pracha Uthit 64 Alley, Khwaeng Thung Khru, Thung Khru, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The prices are quite expensive compared to the quantity and quality. The meat was very tough. The chicken basil stir-fry at 129฿ is extremely expensive. The desserts were bland and not flavorful. Despite the prices, the atmosphere was extremely hot while we ate. The staff were rude and served the food very slowly; they even lost our order without apologizing or taking any responsibility. We waited almost an hour and had to ask for our food four times before finally getting it. This made tables that arrived after us feel very uncomfortable. The staff didn't apologize at all; it was a terrible experience.
sample_reviews_th.author: Jennie Queen

sample_reviews_en.text: The cold fresh milk is unsweetened and creamy, but you can add sugar to your liking. The toast is just the right amount of sweetness. They have both sweet and savory dishes. Parking is convenient. The shop is spacious and open-air. Free drinking water is provided. The steamed bread with custard is delicious, but unfortunately, the toasted version was sold out the day I went. The cold fresh milk is also delicious and not too sweet. They also have mantou (steamed buns). The menu is extensive. The service is good and the wait time is short.
sample_reviews_en.author: too chinnakorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dessert shop at Pracha Uthit 64
Go about 200 meters into the soi (alley), the shop will be on the right-hand side. There's a large parking lot, and importantly, they have both savory and sweet dishes.
Recommended menu item 🍨
A must-try is the corn cream pudding.
It's very fragrant and delicious; you'll want to come back for more.

Check in and get a free ice cream!
I have to say, that's a lot of free ice cream! One scoop is enough. 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: กรวรรณ ไชยฤกษ์

sample_reviews_en.text: This halal restaurant in Soi Pracha Uthit 64 offers very affordable prices and a great atmosphere, perfect for enjoying desserts with family or friends. The service is excellent, with polite and attentive staff. The food is delicious and reasonably priced. There's convenient parking. If you're looking for a good halal restaurant in this area, I highly recommend trying this one. You'll definitely want to come back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Theeraphat Sukhampha

sample_reviews_en.text: I didn't have high expectations when I went because I was dragged along to try it. But once the food was served, I started to feel good about it. The food was delicious, and the plating was beautiful, just as pictured. There were both savory and sweet dishes. The beef basil stir-fry was delicious, the chocolate bread was delicious, and many other dishes were also delicious. I'll definitely go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: ร้านพิมพ์ดีดอทคอม ป้ายอิงค์เจท

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, very relaxing. The shop feels spacious. It would be even better if it were cooler. They also serve savory dishes, like beef from the Gyuburi area. For dessert, they have custard-filled bread, milk tea, fresh milk, and Ovaltine – perfect for those who want to chill and chat for a long time. There's plenty of parking space in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: PotDoi Story

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant has ample parking and a diverse menu of both savory and sweet dishes.
Personally, the desserts are delicious. The custard might not be very rich, but the texture is smooth and pleasant. The ice cream is fragrant. The restaurant is a large dome-shaped space with air conditioning, but it's not hot inside. There are plenty of parking spaces in front.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalisa Techawatcharapaikul

sample_reviews_en.text: It was probably an unlucky day; my first time there, I encountered a group of ill-mannered Zontes people. The restaurant had no management; they moved other people's cars and belongings without notice, blocking the entrance. Customer service was terrible. The food tasted good and was reasonably priced. The desserts were delicious, especially the corn dessert.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sobsin

restaurants.name: Pilot Brewery
restaurants.address:

58 17 Yothathikan Nonthaburi Khao Wat Daeng Rd, Sai Ma, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: There are places you expect to find a brewery, trendy urban corners, beachside towns, hipster hangouts. And then there are the places you don’t. Places so hidden in the rural maze of countryside roads that you question whether maps are still relevant. That’s where this unlikely gem thrives: a mini brewery so devoted to its craft, it planted roots where no one was looking. During our visit, the owner was in full swing as he broke down the layers of creating the perfect beer to some of the guests. Topics ranged from optimal serving temperatures and storage tips to the subtle effects of air conditioning on fermentation. It wasn’t just informative, it was infectious. You couldn’t help but admire the depth of his knowledge and the joy he takes in sharing it. The food menu is modest. We ordered beef that was so tender, the seasoning soaked through every fiber like it had lived there all its life. Then came the fried instant noodles. Simple, honest, yet very yummy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khun Lim

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place has truly delicious beer. If you haven't found your perfect beer yet, you should definitely try this place!
- They have a wide variety of beers, about 15 different kinds, at reasonable prices starting from 170+ baht.
- It pairs perfectly with the amazing Picanha steak – tender, juicy, fragrant, delicious, with a beautiful pinkish-red color, cooked to a consistent Medium Rare, and visually stunning. It's a highly recommended dish!
- The Caesar salad complements the steak perfectly, making it even more delicious.
- They also have marinated shrimp in fish sauce, with large and incredibly fresh shrimp – a must-try!
- Or you can opt for single-serving dishes like the beef or chicken basil fried rice, both delicious and flavorful.

Overall, I was very impressed. Everything was delicious, the prices were reasonable, making it perfect for a family dinner. It's easy to get to, the pin on the map is accurate, and there's ample parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuengruethai J (Christ.RJLAW)

sample_reviews_en.text: Great spot for craft beer lovers! Their own brewed hazy IPA and fruity beer were excellent, and they have a solid selection of imports as well. Don't miss out on the food though - the chili and salt pork belly was amazing, the picanha steak was delicious, and the beef krapraw was a real highlight. Highly recommended for both drinks and dining!
sample_reviews_en.author: Worapong Rojanusorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very cozy place with great beers.
The place is hidden near Wat Daeng, there is a small parking spot, it's perfect to chill out and try some very delicious beers.
The owner is very friendly and speak very good english.
There is also a variety of food in the menu and the taste is very good.
You can try a beer before ordering.
sample_reviews_en.author: Antonio Mele

sample_reviews_en.text:
Small family-run place. Open only on the evening of Friday to Sunday.
Plenty of parking lots.
Good craft beer (various kinds) and delicious burger.
Location is quite complicated, very far away from the main road. The best way to get here is to start from Saima Municipality Office.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattara Wongjaroen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just as important as the delicious beer is that the food is also incredibly tasty!
The shrimp in fish sauce is amazing; they use really big shrimp and the dipping sauce is delicious too.
Very impressed.
There's parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miss Ribbin

sample_reviews_en.text:
They make some 40 different types of beer and can suggest you which one to suit how uou feel on the day.
Burgers were yummy and the chips are great. I'm picky with my chips but these are definitely the best once for a while!
sample_reviews_en.author: E Durman

sample_reviews_en.text: I really like the beer here. They have a great selection, and it's delicious, especially the ones they brew themselves. Today I tried the Hazy 888 and loved it – very aromatic. The food is delicious too! 😍 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Onvadee Siripadungtham

restaurants.name: Bantatthong Café
restaurants.address:

1800 Banthat Thong Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: #WhereToSendYourKidsLooking for a cafe or restaurant in the Banthat Thong area, I stopped by here, Bantatthong Café. This shop is decorated in a cool industrial style with soft jazz music. They offer a variety of bakery items, coffee, drinks, and wines, as well as Thai food and Italian food. There are also spicy salads. It's quiet in the morning, with few people, so it's very comfortable to work. There are plugs and Wi-Fi.🧡Today, I tried simple dishes like Spicy Bacon Pasta, Green Curry Fried Rice, and Wai Wai Salad. Everything tasted great and was not too expensive. All together, it was only 390 baht. Anyone passing by should stop by to eat, drink coffee, or sit and avoid the crowds for an hour. The shop is warm and the service is very good.📍 Location: Opposite the go-kart track parking lot #BangkokCafe #bantatthongcafe #WhereToSendYourKids
sample_reviews_en.author: Vachiraporn Yenchaisith (fonnie lapluie)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice coffeeshop slag bar on Banthat Thong road located just across the Chulalongkorn park. The coffee is good. They also offer food. More for brunch or lunch. But there are some breakfast options as well.

The prices are slightly high. Especially for their beers. Cappuccino was 100 Baht which is ok. The place itself is nice. The staff seemed a bit bored when I was there. But maybe they were just annoyed because of the construction next door. It was very loud.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small cafe and pub. The retro decor is striking. Comfortable seating, soothing international music, cool air conditioning, and a great atmosphere.

The owner personally introduced us, and he was friendly.

Recommendations:
- Delicious burnt cheesecake. The cake is homemade.
- A wide selection of specialty coffees. This time, I tried the Chinese coffee (a flavor I've never had anywhere else, but I liked it).
sample_reviews_en.author: WoonWoW

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop's atmosphere and decoration are calm and simple. There are coffees to choose from (you can ask the barista). For those who don't drink coffee, there are many non-coffee options to choose from.
The desserts are still not to my liking. They probably aren't homemade.
Parking must be parked at the 100 Years National Park. then walk across the road
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitima C.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Didn't intend to stop by.
Just looking for a nearby cake shop for my sibling's birthday.

And everything we ordered was delicious!
Delicious and worth every penny.

Sorry for the typos and typos.
I'm a bit dizzy. 😅😂😂😂

Strawberry shortcake
Chocolate fudge
Red velvet

Thumbs up! 👍👍👍
If I'm ever in the area again, I'll definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pookpiky

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is nice and cool. There's a wide variety of food to choose from. I ordered the Korean pork rice for 130 baht. I thought the price was a bit high, and the taste was too salty. The wait was also long. Overall, though, it was good. The restaurant is comfortable and has a menu with savory dishes, desserts, and drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: TANAPORN K.

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered a cappuccino, I think it's a bit overextracted bcs it's slightly too bitter, the texture of the foam is not that smooth like how a cappuccino should be. Maybe my expectations were too high. But the ambience and environment here are great. Can't deny. A very good place to chill.
sample_reviews_en.author: Firdause Jesfrydi

sample_reviews_en.text: From the outside, the shop looks simple and ordinary, but the atmosphere inside is great, perfect for relaxing. The menu is quite extensive and diverse, offering a full range of drinks, desserts, and savory dishes. The prices are reasonable, and the food tastes good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalita Ngamsanguanprapa

restaurants.name: Swadish Indian Restaurant
restaurants.address:

Second road, Pattaya City, Amphoe Bang Lamung, Chon Buri 20260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a top spot for great Indian food. Every dish we ordered was delicious, we absolutely loved everything. The mango lassi was perfect, definitely the best I’ve ever had. The fizzy lime soda with spices was the perfect choice after a heavy meal, super refreshing. The service was great as well, very attentive and helpful. Thank you for making our dinner so special. I’ll definitely come back next time I’m in Pattaya 💯🍋‍🟩
sample_reviews_en.author: L

sample_reviews_en.text: There are plenty of Indian restaurants in Pattaya, and this smaller place was chosen based on the reviews for an early dinner - and we were not disappointed. The food was excellent (Butter chicken and Chicken tikka masala + side dishes) and the service was really friendly! A peaceful atmosphere, at least during our visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ida Hakala

sample_reviews_en.text: had a wonderful experience at Swadish. The food was absolutely delicious and full of authentic Indian flavors. Every dish was well prepared, fresh, and perfectly spiced. The presentation was also very nice. Good staff recommend place
sample_reviews_en.author: Raju Bhai

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent service and food quality is superb if u miss Indian food. Staff name Bindiya ji Govind Rekha Pratap
sample_reviews_en.author: yamraj Singh

sample_reviews_en.text:
It’s fabulous ,delicious ,yum yum
I had a masala dossa
Recommended place to visit
Staff r so friendly
sample_reviews_en.author: Prakash Waglay

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent Indian food when you tire of Thai food
Staff are exceptional especially Mandhira and Aarti
sample_reviews_en.author: dean martin

sample_reviews_en.text: The best of the best in complete thailand. Very affordable prices, and mazing quality
sample_reviews_en.author: Nikhilesh Patil

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mast paneer tikka masala and tawa roti
And services so good 😘 like this restaurant
sample_reviews_en.author: Mayur Garg

restaurants.name: Sawang Noodle
restaurants.address:

264 Si Phraya Rd, Maha Phruttharam, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant specializes in single-dish meals like noodles, crab claw dumplings, and char siu pork. It's a small shop in a shophouse, relocated from its old location on Rama IV Road. They have two other branches. The noodles here are still handmade using bamboo sticks. It's a family business; the first-generation grandfather has passed away, and five siblings take turns running the place, with grandchildren helping out. They offer a fairly diverse menu, but we ordered the dry char siu pork and crab claw noodles (large claws) for 520 baht, plus shrimp dumplings for 15 baht. We also ordered soup for 20 baht per bowl. The food is delicious, and has been awarded a Michelin star for several years.
sample_reviews_en.author: พร้อมพูล ชอบเพื่อน

sample_reviews_en.text: Great noodles! Got a small egg noodle with crab claw, BBQ pork and crispy pork, and absolutely enjoyed the dish! Small thin noodles, chewy with great texture and wonderful flavor from the lard. Not really a huge fan of crabs, but it is pretty good too. BBQ pork was a delicious essential for the noodles for sure, and the crispy pork was delicious! Place is small, almost missed it on my walk to find this place, and little tables available. Food comes up pretty quickly though!
sample_reviews_en.author: jkus eats

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is like it's hiding in a building at the side of the road.
My friends mentioned the restaurant original recipe is more than 50 yrs+.
They served egg noodles with different toppings meat options. I tried egg noodles with crab meat and pork.
The pork meat is tender and chewy while the Crab doesn't has unpleasant smell seafood. There are different portion of crab meat up to your desire.
I like the streamed shrimp wrapped dim-sum. It's flavorful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angelica

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered crab meat noodles and a wonton and char siu platter.

The noodles contained several small, pebble-like fragments of crab shell.

The texture of the noodles themselves wasn't bad.

The soup lacked flavor; only the garlic smell was prominent.

The wontons and char siu were unremarkable; you can find better places on Charoen Krung Road or in Chinatown.

I feel like the taste has declined compared to before the pandemic.
sample_reviews_en.author: MAKOTO NISHIMURA

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles are chewy yet soft and delicious. The char siu and crispy pork have a nice, slightly smoky aroma. The crab claws are the smallest I've tried because I ordered the smallest bowl, but the sweetness of the crab meat is still delicious and didn't disappoint. The only downside is that it's an old restaurant, and the atmosphere at this branch might not be very appealing.
sample_reviews_en.author: OaT OaT

sample_reviews_en.text: Small place and very easy to miss on the street. But food is amazing. If someone likes sea food I can tell this is a good choice. Menu is very simple but this local is famous for crab meat so you should try a dish with this. Portions are very small also so I recommend to order more food. Prices a lot higher then normal street food but this is due to Michelin star.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna Wnuk

sample_reviews_en.text: I intentionally walked all the way from Samyan to eat here because I love the taste of this style of noodles and char siu pork. Eating it brings back childhood memories. The noodles are perfectly soft, and the char siu pork is truly roasted, not artificially colored. I ate three bowls of dry noodles and a bowl of wonton soup. Worth it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Natavudh Townamchai

sample_reviews_en.text: 💖 A lovely person recommended this place to me, and I can confirm it's delicious! The noodles are tasty, the char siu pork is delicious, and the dumplings are delicious. The crab, however, was just okay with a slight smell. Overall, it's good! You should try it if you have the chance, but the portions are small, as rumored! 55555
sample_reviews_en.author: sama muay

restaurants.name: Lao Garden
restaurants.address:

67 หมู่ 10 ข้างฮาบิโตะมอลล์ กลุ่มคอนโดthe base T77 พระขโนงเหนือ Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
[Urban Oasis] Refresh at On Nut's "Lao Garden"⭐︎ A lush, detached restaurant nestled behind Bangkok's T77 area. The soothing space, with its pond filled with koi carp and small canals, will make you feel like you're traveling to Laos! Large fans keep you cool outdoors and protect you from mosquitoes. 

Every dish is exquisite, and you can even adjust the spiciness to your liking, a delight for Japanese palate! Juicy kaw moo yang and flavorful Lao sausages pair perfectly with sticky rice. Heartwarming service, like complimentary popsicles after your meal, is also a plus. Live music on weekends and a quiet hideaway on weekdays make this the perfect spot for relaxing with family and friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: アムロ礼

sample_reviews_en.text:
I go to Habito very often, but I only tried this restaurant today and I'm impressed. They have a diverse menu, including Northeastern Thai food, à la carte dishes, single-serving meals, burgers, and beer. Today I ordered papaya salad with grilled chicken and finished with a burger.

Overall, the taste was great and the atmosphere was fantastic. Especially with the nice weather today, it was very relaxing and I could sit there for a long time. You can even feed the fish!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ka Tib

sample_reviews_en.text: I live close by This place used to be my favorite. The food is not up to standard today, really got me disappointed. We ordered large grilled chicken, green curry with Roti and bean salad. I’m pretty sure the chicken was left over from yesterday it was sooooo dry, when u reheated it so many times the chicken dry out and the skin became like rubber. Green curry was so bland and watery 🤮🤮only The salad was ok. Bye bye forever…
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattareeya T.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food prices are a bit high. The fried pork tastes good but the bones are a bit hard. The grilled pork neck is delicious and flavorful. The papaya salad is average. The fish sauce is not rich at all. Maybe because the customers are high society in this area, the fish sauce is not tasty. The atmosphere is good, cool, suitable for chilling and sipping beer, more than going to eat papaya salad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ciwach Wongnicom

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent food, consistently good and value for money. Nestled at the back of Habito, Lao Garden not only has great cuisine, but a fresh, outdoor, green garden ambience as you dine on a deck overlooking a koi filled pond. Never too hot or bothered by mosquitoes due to the abundance of fans and circulating air.

The staples of kao moo yang, larb moo, somtam and gai yang are to die for.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lawrence Chaney

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste used to be better. I'm not sure if the chef changed. The taste was terrible. The papaya salad with Luang Prabang was like they forgot to add shrimp paste. The stuffed squid was very salty. The papaya salad with sour crab and fermented fish was sour. The beef, which is the restaurant's specialty, was salty. The taste was lacking in every dish I ordered.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wine

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is good, the atmosphere is cool and shady. There are many Isaan foods to choose from. The price is a bit high. Somtam Poo Pla Ra, the fermented fish sauce is spicy and delicious. Grilled beef with jaew sauce. The grilled beef is very good, delicious. The jaew sauce is spicy and just right. As for the fried rice and pork neck rice, the taste is normal.
sample_reviews_en.author: K K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a great atmosphere, shady and cool.💚😊
The food tastes good, quite palatable.
The food came out very quickly, no long wait.🫶👏

The service from the staff was excellent, fast and helpful, and they gave great food recommendations.

The restaurant has separate seating areas for smokers and non-smokers.🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanathorn Ngamchai

restaurants.name: Lucky's Hungry สาขาเดอะมอลล์ไลฟ์สโตร์งามวงศ์วาน
restaurants.address:

430 ถนน งามวงศ์วาน ตำบลบางเขน อำเภอเมืองนนทบุรี จังหวัดนนทบุรี 11000 บางเขน Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This American-style casual dining restaurant offers very generous portions; the plates are overflowing, making for great photos, and the food comes out quickly. The combination of large carbs and meat dishes is incredibly filling and satisfying, offering excellent value for money.

We ordered the American fried rice set meal. The roasted chicken leg had a crispy skin and juicy, tender meat, served with a runny fried egg, German sausage, and roasted cherry tomatoes. The accompanying creamy sauce was also quite good. Surprisingly, the fried rice even contained raisins and came with blueberry jam (is this how authentic American fried rice is always served?). The other dish was tomato-flavored macaroni with fried chicken. The macaroni was coated in a thick sauce, the noodles were chewy, and the large pieces of fried chicken had a fluffy, crispy skin and a generous amount of meat. Both dishes were slightly sweet, suitable for those who prefer a sweeter flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: YU CHEN

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, generous portions, and free rice refills.
One dish is enough for two people; it's just the right amount to feel full. It's so delicious we finished the whole plate without feeling overly full. Having dessert and a sweet drink afterwards makes it perfectly satisfying.

I ordered the fried rice extra spicy; the tomato sauce flavor was very strong. There were no onions in the fried rice, and you can request it without raisins.
The fried egg was cooked perfectly to order – crispy white with a runny yolk.

In summary, I recommend one dish for two people, or two dishes for three people if you don't eat a lot, so you won't feel excessively full.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suwathep Banyatledthaworn

sample_reviews_en.text:
This American fried rice has a flavor that's friendly to both overweight and average-sized kids.
It's so delicious that eating too much might make you feel nauseated, even with the sour berries helping to cut through the richness.
For me, it was a little too rich.
It's enough for two people to share. 👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: phiphat phatthanapromsuk

sample_reviews_en.text: For American fried rice, this is the place to go. I discovered their Ari branch. The price is reasonable for the portion size, and the American fried rice is absolutely delicious. Their macaroni is also fantastic; I order it every time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Topman JDM

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! The crispy chicken was great and the pieces were large, just the way I like it. It was my first time trying it and I was very impressed. The staff provided excellent service. I'll definitely be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arm Attayoko

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted great! The fried chicken was excellent, the other fried items were great, and the fried eggs were perfect. I ordered three dishes even though I was alone!
sample_reviews_en.author: THEPNATEE KIATMALAWONG

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! It's really in the top 3 that people talk about and definitely worth trying. Whether you like one more than the other is another matter.
sample_reviews_en.author: Disarong Sookmak

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! At first, I thought it would be expensive, but it wasn't at all. It was well worth the price, and the portion was huge!
sample_reviews_en.author: preeyaporn boondee

restaurants.name: Ohayo
restaurants.address:

543 Chok Chai 4 Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🎏This is a very traditional Japanese restaurant. It feels so hidden, you wouldn't even notice it if you weren't looking closely, lol. If you think of early Japanese restaurants in Thailand, this is the place you'll remember. The atmosphere is quiet but comfortable, open, and the staff are lovely.🎐

🐟Today, I ordered a hot pot. The soup was delicious. The grilled mackerel with salt was especially good. I loved how there were very few bones. Overall, the seasoning was well-seasoned and not too salty. Overall, it was good. I'll definitely come again.👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Chollada Ch.

sample_reviews_en.text: This Japanese restaurant in Chokchai 4 offers good food at reasonable prices. I recommend the yakisoba and the grilled salmon with teriyaki sauce. In my personal opinion, the lower part of the salmon with the skin is tastier than the middle part with the bone. Remember to tell the staff if you want that part; I forgot this time and regretted it a little. The portions here are quite large. I also liked the hot tea; it has a subtle roasted rice aroma and helps cut through the richness of the food. Parking is convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: aura pk

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and reasonably priced. The restaurant atmosphere is okay, clean, and has parking. I ordered shrimp curry, and they added pork to the curry soup, which is great because other restaurants usually just put it in the soup. I really liked it. The sashimi was also fresh and not fishy. Very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yotin T

sample_reviews_en.text: The food service at this restaurant is above average. However, from the street, you can see the parking lot, but the inside of the restaurant is almost completely invisible. There are over 500 to 1,000 restaurants in this area, but a restaurant like this is truly rare. This is an area that needs improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jin Maeda

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is average in taste and inexpensive. The dragon roll tasted okay.
But I really didn't like that the iced green tea came with sugar. It was extremely sweet. I asked for it unsweetened, but they said it wasn't available; I had …
sample_reviews_en.author: ** PYMN **

sample_reviews_en.text:
Japanese home kitchen style restaurant
It feels like eating a warm meal
The food tastes really good ☺️
You can feel the fresh ingredients in every bite🍵

I found this restaurant by accident
But it has become my regular restaurant now 😅
sample_reviews_en.author: Lex Songlerts

sample_reviews_en.text: There's parking available, the service is excellent, the food comes out quickly, the prices are very reasonable, delicious, and great value. I will definitely come again. I especially loved the cold noodles and the fried pork.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maruko Jomzonn

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the best and most delicious Japanese restaurant I've ever eaten at. The wasabi is authentic, not too pungent, and you can eat it with every bite. The food is amazing. I'll definitely be back. Highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: TAWAN'S SUNSHINE

restaurants.name: Das-Berliner Bistro
restaurants.address:

482 หมู่ที่ 10 Pattaya Sai Song Rd, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It wasn't easy for me to find. You have to go in next to a sports facility, or, like me, through the parking garage.

The decor, with all the posters, reminded me of bistros and pubs from my youth—about 40 years ago. It still has charm, though.

The waitresses were very friendly, attentive, and warmly welcoming, speaking German.

I had a mixed salad and Gypsy schnitzel with boiled potatoes. Delicious food. It reminded me of Germany. Perhaps it could have used a bit more spice, but that might be because I've been in Thailand for a long time and eat very spicy food. In any case, I'll definitely come back and try some German dishes. By the way, the value for money is excellent. Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: F.X. KUCHLER

sample_reviews_en.text:
Quality German food, has a German dark Dunkle style beer and wheat beer as well as chang and Leo. Other beverages available. I always seem to go in late afternoon 1600. Usually quiet then but have walked by 1800 and it was very full..
They have a nice selection of the common basics plus breakfast, burger, sandwichs.  The food same quality and half the cost of a couple of larger German restaurants.
They are easy to walk to but are small and tucked away. Cozy atmosphere with pictures and interesting decor.. no view and not upscale or touristy.

Eat in, take away or delivery.

I like it here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaek Wels

sample_reviews_en.text: I used to go to Chill Inn for schnitzels, not anymore, as the staff there have serious attitude problems.  The schnitzels at Das-Berliner are superb, as are the potato and cucumber salads.  Friends have tried other menu items, and all reports are excellent.  Staff here are also top notch, always smiling and efficient.  Only issue I have with the place is that the decor is tired, hasn't been changed in years ... but I suppose that is part of the charm and doesn't affect the food quality.  Can highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anthony Thai

sample_reviews_en.text: From the outside, the restaurant didn't look very inviting. I considered turning around and leaving. But thanks to the many good reviews and my craving for a hearty German meal, I went in. I had a Jägerschnitzel (hunter's schnitzel), and it tasted really good. It was a bit thin and breaded, but otherwise, there was nothing to complain about. I quite like the atmosphere. It has a bit of a 90s pub vibe. The only thing is, the tables and chairs could use replacing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zyx

sample_reviews_en.text: We went to the Berliner Bistro today. I have to say, judging by the exterior, we almost walked further, but the food was good. The interior is reminiscent of a bistro/pub from the 90s. If you're missing German cuisine in Pattaya, this is the place for you. The prices are absolutely reasonable: meatloaf for 179 BHT or goulash with noodles for 179 BHT. If you're not into fancy stuff, you should stop by here. The bistro is located on a side street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Heiko Hintze

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very tasty german food.  I ate Schnitzel and my mate had schweinhaxe.
Both of us wery satisfied.
The restaurant was almost full ca 2 weeks ago at our visit.
Hard to find and when you find it it looks simple inside but the food and service.. mmmmm. Recommend!
Just beside/inside Sportsman soi 13 alley.
sample_reviews_en.author: L S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don't be put off by the back entrance. I made that mistake on the first morning of my vacation and didn't go in... On the second-to-last day, I happened to be passing by again and had a fantastic German breakfast with cappuccino, bacon, eggs, bread rolls, and toast...
Great!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mad Rabauke

sample_reviews_en.text: Fantastically good waiters and chefs. Eat here very often, lovely German, European and Thai food. Very reasonable prices on food and drinks. Have been a customer here for almost 15 years and still just as good. Highly recommended 👍. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Knut Håverstad

restaurants.name: Magari De Sushiya Kazu
restaurants.address:

3 ซอยเมธีนิเวศน์ สุขุมวิท Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Magari de Sushiya Kazu is a small low key hidden spot— 🤤🍣 but the quality is anything but ordinary what I love most is the  “ intention” behind every single piece.

Each sushi is crafted one by one right in front of you, and you can truly feel how everything has been carefully thought through from the temperature of the rice, to the balance of the fish, to the timing of each course.

Every bite that wowed me:
✔️The fish is incredibly fresh—sweet delicate and melts in your mouth
✔️The shari (rice) is lightly seasoned, never overpowering, but perfectly elevates the fish
✔️Some pieces have subtle creative twists that keep things interesting while still respecting tradition
Service:
Warm, friendly, and charming, yet still professional. The chef explains each piece in a relaxed, natural way—it feels like dining at a friend’s home.

🌟Overall for me: 8/10 🌟🌟🌟🌟
This isn’t a flashy omakase spot—it’s the kind you learn to love the more you understand it. If you appreciate precision and honest flavors, you’ll absolutely fall for it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Api K.

sample_reviews_en.text: Sushi is served piece by piece. The Japanese chef is friendly. The rice is thin, the pieces are small, and there are many types of fish. The quality is close to omakase grade, but at a price in the tens to low hundreds of baht. One person ate about 20 pieces, and the other 10+. The bill came to 2700 baht. Excellent price and quality! Reservations are unlikely to be successful as it's usually full. We will definitely come again. The service was good, attentive, and they refilled our water constantly. On another visit, the rice seemed a bit hard. I didn't ask the chef about it. We didn't eat that much, but it was almost 2000 baht per person. It felt less worthwhile that way, or maybe there weren't any hidden charges before? I can't remember.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tui Dusadee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dinner with friends. This restaurant is an open Japanese kitchen style with many zones : sushi bar, yakiniku tables, private rooms and teppanyaki bars. Wonderful atmosphere.

The staff was so friendly and welcoming. The highball on frozen lemon was refreshing.

Many menus were sold out on my day. Sushi came in such tiny portions for about 60-200THB per piece. The quality of the fish was okay at its price point, better than chain izakaya restaurants. Some dishes were not as fresh as I expected though. Sushi rice was tasty, but small.

Recommended for people who would like to try many menus in small portions, but not for the hungers (as you will be a bit surprised by the total bill if you get full).
sample_reviews_en.author: Thossaporn Poonwatana

sample_reviews_en.text:
2025 10.07 Visit Review
After my visit, the service, hygiene, and taste have all changed.

I recommended this place to many friends, but I was so disappointed.

8-piece Omakase
Maybe that's why they gave me such a huge portion of sushi rice.

The waitress just squashed a fruit fly at the sushi table with her hand right in front of me. Oh no -_-

The head chef couldn't see me, either because I was sick or because I was alone at the sushi table.

I saw bugs crawling out of the sushi storage area three times, so I took a video.

They advertise a lot on Line, but there are so many expensive and delicious places. It's hard to find a cheap and delicious place.

I won't be visiting again.
≈====≈========
sample_reviews_en.author: 반조회광

sample_reviews_en.text: This is such a hidden gem! The fish is incredibly fresh, delicious, and tender. The rice in the sushi rolls is amazing. The soups and everything else are fantastic. They have some unique dishes, and ordering the chef's recommendations is fantastic. Everything from the sashimi to the soup is great. We went at midnight, my boyfriend had two beers, I was sleepy so I left at 1 AM, but he stayed until closing time. Apparently, the chef was having so much fun, making sushi for us to try and refilling the soup. He ended up having six more beers! Hahaha. The restaurant is great, I'll definitely go back. The soup is good for curing hangovers but not for keeping you awake, so I went home to sleep.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boat KR

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good variety of seafood options and very reasonable price points. Some people mention that the sushi pieces are on the smaller side, but that’s likely how they keep the prices accessible while still serving decent quality fish.

I wouldn’t consider it omakase-level dining — it feels more like a casual sushi or izakaya-style spot. They have a nice range of maguro cuts (around six or more types), which is great if you enjoy tuna. There were also quite a few seasonal specials available when I visited, including items like firefly squid.

Overall the quality is mid-range, but that’s reflected in the pricing.

My favorite dishes were the ankimo with ponzu sauce and the oysters.
sample_reviews_en.author: Foodie Bites

sample_reviews_en.text:
I called the restaurant to ask if reservations were possible or if they only accepted walk-ins. A male employee said they didn't take reservations and only accepted walk-ins.

Upon arriving at the restaurant, another employee asked if I had made a reservation. I explained that I had called and the employee who answered said they didn't take reservations and only accepted walk-ins, and that the only available slot was at 11 PM!!!

In short, you can reserve a reservation via LINE. Why didn't they mention this when I called? I wouldn't have wasted over an hour driving here. I'm not eating here anymore. Goodbye!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nina Nina

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited because I was craving sushi.

To save time, I ordered the 1,300 baht chef's choice sushi set.

They served dishes like sashimi, chawanmushi (steamed egg custard), grilled items, and nigiri sushi, keeping an eye on my pace and making sure there weren't any long gaps between dishes.

The quality was about what you'd expect for the price.

They also have a wide variety of other dishes, so it could be used as an izakaya (Japanese pub) as well.

The taste isn't bad, and the prices aren't too high, so it's a sushi restaurant you can easily visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: KA

restaurants.name: Baan Steak Tad (Setthakit Village)
restaurants.address:

400, 19-20 Thanon Mu Ban Setthakit, Bang Khae Nuea, Bang Khae, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Why only 5 stars? It should be 8-9 stars!
The food was incredibly delicious. I personally loved the bread; crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. The prices were very reasonable. The mushroom soup was excellent, and the steak was tender and delicious. The service was great; they even opened and closed the door for us.^^
sample_reviews_en.author: ศรัญภควัด กลิ่นเกษร

sample_reviews_en.text:
Where did the old owner go? I wanted to go eat there again.
It's a new franchise, and the food is way too sweet. I haven't been there in a long time. I still saw review pictures of the old shop, but when I went, it was a completely new shop. So disappointing! Or did they change the style of the shop? It's a shame.
sample_reviews_en.author: ton_somkit

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! I drive past often and never realized it was this good. It was raining today and I was looking for a place to take shelter. The food was amazing! I loved it so much. I'm so proud of the staff and owner. I don't want it to become too famous, then everyone will be scrambling to eat there.
sample_reviews_en.author: รพีพรรณ ดอกยอ

sample_reviews_en.text: This is really exploitative of consumers. I ordered through Line Man and received a very small portion. Even the french fries were just scraps. I'm not complaining about the price, but there should be a more appropriate quantity.
sample_reviews_en.author: ทิวารัตน์ วงศ์สิน

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and I really liked it. The staff were lovely, always smiling and polite. The price was good, and the atmosphere was great – it was air-conditioned and not hot. I was very impressed! 😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Supisara Champahan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food and portion size are good value.
However, I wish the fish steak had a creamy salad dressing; it would go much better with the fish steak.
The gravy sauce doesn't really suit fish steak.
sample_reviews_en.author: aum2600 gmail

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and very affordable. Felt like great value. The mushroom soup was surprisingly good. The pork and chicken weren't tough, and the fried fish wasn't mushy or oily.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mawinner

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken steak and fish were delicious, the service was good, the ice water was very cold, the fried sausages were very crispy, and the mushroom soup was also tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khun Khun

restaurants.name: Orathai Seafood Wang Lang
restaurants.address:

91 10 ซอย วังหลัง Siriraj, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: 19.09.25 Enjoyed a delicious lunch of fried corn with a sweet peanut dipping sauce, nam tok moo (grilled pork and fresh shallots in a spicy-sweet sauce), and grilled snails with a cilantro-lime-chili dipping sauce. The dishes arrived quickly (although we were there at noon and the restaurant was not very busy), and came out the perfect temperature. If you are used to Isan cooking than the pork will be mild to you, it was a very pleasant balance of heat and sweet, and was creamier and thicker than Northern style due to a small amount of rice starch in the liquid, rather than the usual toasted rice topping. Price was great, totaling 270 bhat for two people, three dishes. Finally, AC was decent, tabletops were clean, and bathroom had big soap: a rather nice dining experience, would certainly recommend, especially after a morning poking around Wang Lang market.
sample_reviews_en.author: Josephine McCormick

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant I frequent a lot. Every time I go, I encounter minor problems, like finding small stones, almost the size of green peas, or steel wool in my food, but I usually choose to overlook them. However, yesterday was really not okay. I ordered food over half an hour ago and still haven't received it, even though the table next to me ordered at the same time and their food arrived first. Another issue is that plain rice was served less than 5 minutes after I submitted my order, but the main dishes arrived over half an hour later. Of course, the rice was dry, and I had to cover it with another plate. Honestly, I think if the main dishes haven't arrived yet, they shouldn't serve the rice that long beforehand. This happens every time I go.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratri Phromsakon

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant definitely deserves 5 stars!

We were just looking for an air-conditioned restaurant because it was so hot.

But every dish was delicious and great value for money! Our group of five ordered six dishes, and everything was excellent except for the salmon sashimi, which was a bit ordinary. You can also ask them to make it mildly spicy. The Thai milk tea was a huge cup for 40 baht and wasn't watered down. The rice was more than 1.5 times the size of other restaurants, so the portion size didn't match the price. It's cheap and the portions are very generous. Anyway, highly recommend it!! You definitely won't be disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunny Kuo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located in Soi Wang Lang, this som tam restaurant is very clean, air-conditioned, and the food is very reasonably priced.

We ate here for two and paid less than 300 baht, but we were very full.
I highly recommend the som tam platter, it's absolutely delicious! ✨
I also ordered the sweet liver, which was tender and perfectly cooked.

The pieces were thick and filling.

I'll definitely be back if I'm in the area again.
I just learned that Orathai not only has sushi, but also delicious som tam and Isaan food. ✅👍🏻💕 I recommend everyone to try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: whanjai

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was terrible. I was extremely unimpressed with the service and the staff's response.
I ordered rambutan in syrup, but what I got was frozen rambutan ice cream. I asked the staff, "Didn't you order rambutan in syrup?" They said that this is how the restaurant usually serves it, freezing it for customers. So I reluctantly paid for it and stopped eating. That's it.
The food wasn't as advertised. The restaurant was crowded, so they'd take whatever they wanted. It's not right. Please change the menu name and food photos. I'm so disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chong Kung

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant upstairs has air conditioning and comfortable seating.
The wait for food was very long. We ordered 4 dishes.
After 30 minutes, only 2 dishes arrived.
After another 45 minutes, the papaya salad platter and salmon soup finally arrived.
1. Papaya salad platter: The papaya salad itself was just okay, the shrimp was boiled but still raw inside, but the fried chicken was delicious.
2. Fried calamari: Okay.
3. Minced pork salad: Delicious.
4. Salmon soup: Not okay. It looked like papaya, and the taste was too salty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panawat Yodkumlue

sample_reviews_en.text:
An absolute gem 👍🏻

The chicken wings are outstanding - juicy on the inside, perfectly fried, and coated in a fantastic, crispy batter. The papaya salad was fresh and well balanced, and the laab was full of flavor, bold, authentic, and really well seasoned.

On top of that, all staff were incredibly friendly, attentive, and helpful - you feel welcome from the first moment 🙏🏻❤️

We truly enjoyed our visit and will definitely come back. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Maria Neubert

sample_reviews_en.text:
While browsing Wang Lang Market, I smelled a delicious restaurant, so I went in!!!

The air conditioning on the second floor was nice and cool.
The open kitchen on the first floor was very clean, and the staff were friendly.

It's probably a Thai Isaan restaurant, but
the som tam has a wide variety and is delicious.

If you're hungry after visiting Wang Lang Market, I highly recommend this place!!!
It's great value and refreshing!
sample_reviews_en.author: jake Kim

restaurants.name: Pagoda Chinese Restaurant
restaurants.address:

199 Sukhumvit Alley 22, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Our experience was far from satisfactory. We had indicated that one person at the table was vegan, and accordingly, we ordered five dishes, including three meat dishes and two vegetable dishes. When the first two meat dishes were served, we waited in vain for the vegan dishes. It was only upon inquiry that the staff explained they would serve the other dishes once we finished the first ones. This resulted in an unreasonable delay, leaving the already served dishes to grow cold.

The service also left much to be desired. They failed to inform us that the dishes were served without rice, and we had to order it separately. My cocktail took over 20 minutes to arrive, while other guests received their drinks within five minutes. Another frustration was that the waiter only inquired about drinks from one person at the table, rather than serving the entire group.

Overall, the experience at this restaurant was disappointing. Despite the high prices, neither the food nor the service met our expectations. The lack of communication and coordination from the staff led to unnecessary delays, and the served food grew cold, making the situation even more unsatisfactory.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex L.

sample_reviews_en.text:
🥟🥢 Pagoda Chinese Restaurant: A premium Chinese restaurant with a glamorous atmosphere that will make your lunch extra special.

Elevate your lunch. Let’s dim sum! 🥢✨ It's not just the ambiance that's impressive; every dish is a work of art, crafted by Chef Oscar Pun and his talented team. Whether it's a business meeting, a celebratory feast, or just a delicious meal with a loved one, authentic Cantonese cuisine is perfect.

The restaurant features a modern Chinese design in a red and black color scheme, luxurious and classic with a contemporary touch — you'll feel the premium atmosphere the moment you step inside.

Highlight: Enjoy unlimited dim sum, baked and fried dishes, noodles, and congee for lunch at only 890 THB net per person. Incredibly good value!

📍 Pagoda Chinese Restaurant
🏛️ Bangkok Marriott Marquis Queen's Park
🕰️ Monday - Friday 11:30 - 14:30

#callmebacon #pagodachineserestaurant
#allyoucaneatdimsum
#bangkokmarriottmarquis #callmebacon
sample_reviews_en.author: CALLMEBACON

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is our second visit to this location. The food tastes good, and the service is excellent.

Peking duck is served in three courses here. The first duck meat, with crispy skin The second duck leg with plum sauce The third dish is stir-fried duck meat with ginger and spring onions.

Food is delivered so quickly after you place your order. Dim sum is excellent here. Deep fried crispy prawn and mango spring rolls and steamed rice rolls with crispy prawn are my favorites.

The atmosphere is second to none.

Parking is easy to find.

If you live in Bangkok and crave Dim Sum and Chinese cuisine, I recommend Pagoda.

Club Marriott members receive a 30% discount, and a 50% discount voucher is usable.

Tastiness: 4.5/5
5/5 for service
5/5 for ambiance
4/5 for value for money
Overall rating: 4.5/5
sample_reviews_en.author: Chitaphol Rattanathikun

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Chinese restaurant in the Marriott hotel in Bangkok has amazing dim sum and roast duck.

I met a friend for lunch at Pagoda Chinese Restaurant near the office.
I highly recommend trying their dim sum.

🥟 Shrimp dumplings: Large, fresh, and bouncy shrimp. So satisfying to chew!
🥟 Shumai: Large dumplings with generous filling. Very filling and delicious.

🦆 Peking duck: Incredibly crispy skin. So crunchy with every bite!

🍰 The Tiramisu with Maotai was a pleasant surprise.
I initially thought the flavor would be strong, but it was actually subtly fragrant.
It added depth to the Tiramisu's taste.
A truly memorable dish.

📍Pagoda Chinese Restaurant
🏨 Bangkok Marriott Marquis Queen’s Park
sample_reviews_en.author: St. LuTiaNA

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every time I eat here, I have to order the Peking duck. The skin is crispy and fragrant, the meat is tender. All three dishes made with the duck are excellent.

Taste: The Peking duck is the highlight. Delicious, tender meat, crispy skin. All three dishes made with the duck are also delicious. The congee is smooth and creamy.

Atmosphere: A Chinese restaurant in a hotel. Elegant and comfortable, suitable for families or formal events.

Service: Standard hotel service, attentive, and served at just the right pace.

Price: Relatively high, but worth the quality, especially the duck dishes.

Conclusion: A restaurant I can keep coming back to, especially if I want really good duck.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apiwat Aksornsart

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Hong Kong-style Chinese restaurant is located on the 4th floor of the Bangkok Marriott Marquis Queen’s Park Hotel on Sukhumvit Soi 22.

We tried it because, as Club Marriott members, we received a 50% discount on food, allowing us to order a variety of dishes. It was also a birthday celebration.

The seafood dishes were made with fresh ingredients and cooked to order. The taste was surprisingly good, exceeding our expectations. We had previously overlooked this restaurant and gone to other places, but this one was excellent. The only downside is that they don't serve dim sum in the evenings.

We'll definitely come back for lunch next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kitibordee Yindeear-rom

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited Pagoda, a popular Chinese restaurant in Bangkok! 🥢✨
The restaurant has a sophisticated yet relaxed atmosphere, making it perfect for a special meal. The Peking duck, in particular, was exquisite; the skin was crispy, the meat juicy, and it was incredibly delicious! 😋 The way it was wrapped and the balance of condiments were perfect, and I enjoyed it thoroughly from start to finish!

The staff provided attentive service, making it a comfortable and recommended spot for dates or business dinners. If you're looking for authentic Chinese food in Bangkok, I highly recommend you try this restaurant! 🇹🇭✨
sample_reviews_en.author: ゲンキング4

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was one on one which stellar. The lady that took care of us was diligently and carefully explained each sauce and dishes ingredients (my partner had some food allergies). To me food tastes okay. But.. Not very considerate made i.e meat cut in big pieces hard to chew and vegetable too long I had to cut it into 3 parts each time before eat. The restaurant decor was luxurious and spacious but no customer from the beginning to the end of the meal. It's located in the hotel. So, it's understandable for emptiness as Bangkok had so many famous restaurants, local and tourist normally went to those places.
sample_reviews_en.author: LS SPK

restaurants.name: คาวหวาน
restaurants.address:

25 Thanon Thetsaban Rangrak Tai, Lat Yao, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a beautifully decorated restaurant located in an alley near the Rangsan Tai Municipality. Film crews often shoot dramas here. The menu is diverse, but seems to focus mainly on Northern Thai cuisine.
They also have a storefront in Bong Marche market under the name "Nai Hong's Braised Duck," and a bakery called "Ob Aroi" (Delicious Baked Bread).

I often buy the braised duck set with four portions of noodles for 399 baht. The braised duck is delicious and the portion size is good.
The stir-fried minced pork larb is Northern Thai style and very tasty.
The young jackfruit curry doesn't quite taste like a typical Northern Thai curry; it's more like a vegetable soup.

The restaurant offers various types of baked bread and palm sugar cupcakes, which are delicious.

The staff provides good service, and the owner is friendly and helpful with recommendations.
The prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: K. Wangvitayakun

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant I didn't have high expectations for at first. I found it on Google Maps and decided to give it a try. It exceeded my expectations! The place has a quiet, cafe-like feel, located under a building. They have a huge menu. The owner, an elderly gentleman, is incredibly friendly and provides excellent service. He's very helpful and gives great recommendations. The Northern Thai food was surprisingly delicious, especially the dry-fried minced pork larb – it was amazing! The sweet and savory fried chicken with fish sauce, as recommended by the restaurant, was absolutely fantastic – crispy, fragrant, sweet, and perfectly balanced. Highly recommend trying it! The prices are also reasonable. I'll definitely visit again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Enjoyeatingwithjah

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had such a great dinner here. The space was really comfortable and relaxed, it just felt easy to sit back and enjoy the night. Everything we ordered was so delicious. The northern Thai sausage was exceptional and full of flavor, the tom yum was amazing, and the khao soi was very delicious and comforting. We were very impressed with everything we ordered.

The owner came by our table a few times just to say hello and chat, which was really nice and made the whole experience feel even more welcoming.

And don’t skip dessert, the cantaloupe balls with coconut ice cream was big enough for 2 or 3 people and so refreshing. We left happy, full, and already talking about coming back. Highly recommend this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dean

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, just the right balance of flavors. Fresh ingredients. The restaurant atmosphere is amazing! There are various seating options: floor seating, sofa seating with chairs, and bar stools with high stools overlooking the trees outside. Most importantly, the owner is incredibly kind, friendly, and gives excellent food and drink recommendations.^^ We ordered two dishes and two drinks: fresh egg noodles in northern Thai style with tender pork ribs, a set meal with extra spicy green chili dip and northern Thai sausage, glass noodle larb with minced pork and pork sausage, honey lemon soda, and sky passion fruit soda.
sample_reviews_en.author: be boyz

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located in an alley not far from Bong Marche Market. They have a very diverse menu, with many options for Northern Thai set meals. The fresh vegetables and crispy pork rinds are excellent. They also offer healthy choices and a wide variety of single-dish meals. The owner provides excellent service and thoughtfully recommends dishes. Coffee lovers shouldn't miss this place either. They also have Thai desserts; I recommend the "Kleep Lamduan" (a type of Thai cookie), which is truly delicious, as well as the healthy whole-grain cookies and rice crackers – definitely worth buying to take home!
sample_reviews_en.author: Phattriya Anantasestagul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted great.

The dishes I ordered were fusion cuisine, a perfect blend of Thai and Western influences (Spaghetti with Northern Thai chili paste and shrimp).

The owner and staff provided excellent service.

They also gave us complimentary cookies, a new flavor: dried shrimp. The first bite was surprising, but the flavors blended well together – the cookie texture and the finely ground dried shrimp had a nice aroma of cilantro and other herbs.

The Tom Yum soup with pork ribs was moderately spicy, but refreshing with the freshness of the vegetables and spices.

I finished every last drop!
sample_reviews_en.author: noo nueng

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant specializes in Northern Thai food. The prices are on the higher side, but not excessively so. The portion sizes are appropriate for the price. The taste is average, not amazing.

There's no parking at the restaurant; you have to park on the side of the road in the alley. There's plenty of seating, but the air conditioning is a bit too cold. You can't sit for long, so you have to eat quickly and leave.

The crispy pork wasn't crispy at all; it was rather chewy. As for the restaurant's recommended dish, "Lam Bon," I wasn't impressed enough to warrant trying it as advertised.
sample_reviews_en.author: N. T.

sample_reviews_en.text: Medium size restaurant about 10 tables. Provide various foods and drinks. The northern style foods are their highlight. By the way they have another dishes provides in various style. I have order noodle name "Kao Soi" (northern famous noodle) with the duck drumstick serve with the lime, shallot, and prickle in traditional style. It's delicious. My friend order rice topped by shrimp chop and paprika plus salted egg and tofu. Good taste. Drinking the passion fruit frappe so refreshing. Will come back to try other menu in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narongrat Srimee

restaurants.name: ริมนนท์ หมูกระทะบุฟเฟ่ต์
restaurants.address:

10 Soi Nontaburi 8, Tambon Bang Kraso, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I decided to try this restaurant after seeing many reviews. I got one set of pork, and when it was almost finished, I ordered another set because it's a buffet. I ordered a long time ago, but the food still hadn't arrived. So I asked the staff how to track my order. They just replied that there were a lot of people, instead of actually tracking my order (the table next to me ordered twice and received everything they ordered), but my table didn't get anything. Since the staff weren't ready to serve me, I decided to pay the bill and go home. In short, was it a buffet or did I only get one set of food? 😅😅 One time is enough for this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: อับดุล เลียซอก

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good value for money. Taste is 7/10. It's a buffet, including drinks, for 188 baht per person. The menu isn't extensive, but the pork they use is high-quality – not the artificially colored pink pork. Service is fast.

The restaurant was very crowded. If you sit at an outside table, the drink, dipping sauce, and vegetable refill stations are quite far apart. The restaurant should rearrange the stations so they're not clustered together; it gets very crowded otherwise.

We noticed the electrical outlets are very low around the restaurant. This could be dangerous if it rains. We hope this is improved.
sample_reviews_en.author: Na tasha

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to this restaurant for the first time today, based on reviews. It was terrible. I ordered and waited for 40 minutes. They were out of napkins and said they were going to buy more, but never came. When I went to get dipping sauce, they were out of bowls and spoons. I waited another 20 minutes for them to wash the bowls. The pork was in small scraps, and the dipping sauce smelled awful. I ordered two plates of pork but only got to eat one before having to ask for the bill. I couldn't take it anymore. The staff didn't even look at customers, and it was difficult to get their attention.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicha Nicha

sample_reviews_en.text:
All the marinated pork was delicious. We went during the 60:40 government subsidy program. The service was good, the queue moved quickly, we didn't have to wait long, and we were very impressed that while I'm pregnant, the staff brought a chair with a backrest for me to sit on (so thoughtful 😁). The grilled prawns were delicious, but we ordered extra because they weren't included in the promotion price. It wasn't expensive considering how good the dipping sauce was for the grilled prawns.
The promotion price was 149 baht, refillable drinks were 49 baht, totaling 188 baht. Great!
sample_reviews_en.author: ปิยพร นนทภา

sample_reviews_en.text: I saw the restaurant's post from the owner in a buffet lovers group. It was 149 baht, and I didn't have high expectations, but when I ate there, WTF! It was way too good for the price. The staff, especially the older folks, were incredibly friendly and the food was clean and delicious in every dish!!! I'll definitely be back. This BBQ place makes incredibly delicious grilled meat. Fried rice with egg is only 50 baht!! But the portion is huge! All the dipping sauces are great. And there's truly no time limit! We sat there from 5:50 PM to 9:45 PM and had a great time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ta B i r d

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant uses high-quality, fresh, and clean ingredients.
The owners, an elderly gentleman, are very kind and provide excellent service; it was very impressive.
All the dipping sauces are delicious.
It's a BBQ pork restaurant located in a house, giving it a feel like eating BBQ at a friend's house.
The atmosphere is nice and charming.
The BBQ pork buffet is 149 baht per person + 39 baht for refillable drinks (totaling 188 baht per person).

This is another lovely BBQ pork restaurant that I've fallen in love with. I'll definitely be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: theSMOKKOK

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a great all-you-can-eat Korean BBQ place close to home, within walking distance. I can go alone whenever I want, the atmosphere is nice, the restaurant is large and not too hot, with both indoor and outdoor seating. It's also very affordable if you bring friends, under 188 baht per person including unlimited drinks. To make it worthwhile, you mainly need to love pork because they focus on tender, marinated pork. Overall, it's good value for the price. They also have a huge selection of soft drinks in every color.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siripraphaphon Singhburajarn

sample_reviews_en.text: The price is reasonable, the dipping sauce tastes good, and the meat quality is okay for the price. Service is fast and the restrooms are clean. However, I'd like to see improvements to the vegetable and dipping sauce station – making it cleaner (there were a lot of flies), wider (it gets crowded and difficult to move around during peak hours), and better management of the odor (there's a very strong cat urine smell, which negatively affects the atmosphere inside the restaurant).
sample_reviews_en.author: phusanisa

restaurants.name: Never Give Up Pattaya
restaurants.address:

580 ตำบล หนองปรือ Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150

sample_reviews_th.text: The food was delicious! The chef prepares each dish to order, so there's a bit of a wait, but everything is served hot. It's great value for 550฿ – just imagine how much it would cost if you ordered everything separately!
sample_reviews_th.author: Thunchanok unagul

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm staying at the hotel nearby and decided to give it a try following Google's review. I want to say that this restaurant is what I would call a "brasserie" in Belgium, and I thought I would never find one in Thailand, but here it is! It's all that we expect of a brasserie in my home country, the show is not the owner or the place, but everything is in the dish, and it's accessible in price. The dishes are amazing, we had the orange duck (with a Thai twist) and the lemon sea bass. The dishes are great, well presented, and tasty. All tastes are well balanced and the Orange Duck especially with the extra spice is just perfect. All that comes at an extremely affordable price for the quality you receive. There should be more places like this in Thailand. And yes please never give up, your restaurant and food are awesome 👌
sample_reviews_en.author: Yorick GROEVEN

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food Taste: Great taste, delicious.
Food Quality: Uses good, fresh, and clean ingredients.
Atmosphere: Nice music, pleasant atmosphere, perfect for dinner with friends while enjoying a glass of wine.
Service: Lovely, smiling staff, good service.

Price: Good value for money, using high-quality ingredients. The sandwiches that came with the food were delicious, especially the mushrooms sautéed with the steak. Today we had the 490 baht buffet for two people, it was excellent.
I'll definitely come back again. I wonder if the restaurant can manage at this price in the current economic climate. Please support them! I want this good and delicious restaurant to last a long time.
sample_reviews_en.author: B Bem

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited this restaurant after seeing it on a Thai YouTube channel.
It's not cheap for a Thai restaurant, but the food is worth the price. I ordered duck with orange sauce and salmon with miso sauce. The combination of the very tender duck and orange sauce was fantastic, and the salmon was thick and fresh. I felt the portions were large, but the food was so delicious that I finished it before I knew it. I think you can enjoy a wider variety of dishes if you go with a group.
The staff were also polite and kind, so I would recommend it for solo travelers.
sample_reviews_en.author: k a

sample_reviews_en.text: Sitting here right now smashing the pork satay and beef salad plus coconut….great coconut, great spicy beef salad, but omg the pork in satay sauce was literally the best home made satay I’ve ever had…and I’ve lived in Singapore for three years so I’ve had my fair share! Wish I had time to run through the whole menu here! Exceeded my expectations, love it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Samuel Kumar

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped by this eatery with the evocative name “Never Give Up.” Well… the road is still long. The food was pretty mediocre — salad with no dressing, just a pot of mayo. The salmon was a bit better, nicely seasoned with black pepper and served with a decent (though not homemade) mashed potato. Could do much better : Never Give Up!
sample_reviews_en.author: Deal Stiller

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have been in Pattaya for 20 days now, testing a lot of restaurants. This restaurant is a hidden GEM 👍👍  Food is perfect, and low priced for high Quality 🤩

I really love the Crispy pork in basil with rice and eggs (I ask my eggs well done)
And the Beefshank in basil is amazing to 😋😋

Service is fast and good 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: I try everything

sample_reviews_en.text: All the foods here are 5 stars. We enjoyed them so much we visited for both of our vacation days in Pattaya. All the meats are well cooked and seasoned. Not to mention the prices are definitely of good value. Live music was great as well. Just an all around must try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Shiroyuki Satsuki

restaurants.name: Mad Moa Asok
restaurants.address:

139 100 Pi Sayam Samakhom Alley, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This cool, casual restaurant in the heart of Asoke-Sukhumvit is perfect for unwinding and enjoying easy dining with drinks. Highly recommended are the currywurst (homemade sausage with the restaurant's special curry sauce and delicious fries), the smoked corned beef pasta (slightly spicy but worth the price, with perfectly cooked pasta and a flavorful sauce), and the cream truffle mushroom dish (equally good). The hot calamari is also ideal with a cold drink after work. If you're looking for an evening out, this is a must-try.

The owner and staff are very friendly, the food comes out quickly, and the flavors are very comforting. Parking is available at the Sermmit Building parking lot (free for the first hour, 60 baht per hour thereafter).
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasin Keatparitus

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited this place after seeing its high Google ratings while having coffee with a colleague nearby. The opening time was 5 PM, but I went in about 10 minutes before opening time because the sign at the entrance said "opened." It felt like they were still getting ready to open, but I appreciated that they showed us to a table and turned on the air conditioning inside.

The food was not as good as I expected... For a $10 salad, the portion was too meager, the dressing was too strong and salty, and the grilled beef was just so-so. The pasta was also on the salty side. Also, while we were eating, two dachshunds were running around and barking inside the restaurant.

Honestly, I'm not sure if it's worth visiting again at this price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donggeon Kang

sample_reviews_en.text: Located on the 2nd floor, the restaurant offers a fusion of various international cuisines, which surprisingly blends together incredibly well. Every dish is delicious. The meat with chimichurri sauce has a slightly chewy texture, but it's not tough at all. The grilled Hoki fish is particularly amazing; the sauce is flavorful and the fish is firm. They have a rotating selection of craft beers. The atmosphere is perfect for hanging out and socializing with friends.
