The fried chicken, served with the restaurant's special homemade chili sauce, is incredibly delicious. The restaurant doesn't have many seats, so reservations are recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Penpicha Rojananavin

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant boasts a super cute and comfy atmosphere, perfect for relaxing and catching up with friends. The food is excellent, with a diverse selection including both menu items and special dishes. Prices are reasonable, adding to the overall value. My personal favourite is the Mad Moa Beef Burger, and I highly recommend trying the Banana Foster to round off your meal. Additionally, their signature cocktails are delicious. The staff is incredibly friendly and attentive, making the dining experience even more enjoyable. Would surely go back again!

sample_reviews_en.text: This buffet restaurant in Thonglor offers great value. If you're looking for a dim sum restaurant with a wide variety of dishes at a good price, this is the place. The buffet is priced at 555++ baht, which works out to a net price of 682 baht. The variety of food is excellent, as it doesn't just include dim sum, but also congee, soup, fried rice, main courses, and desserts. We really liked the dim sum; the taste was great, the ingredients were high-quality, and it felt premium. There's a wide selection of dishes, and the food comes out steadily – not too fast, not too slow. The staff are lovely. The shrimp dim sum uses large shrimp, and they're very generous with the ingredients. The drunken chicken is incredibly tender and delicious with the chili paste. Focus on the dim sum when you go, as it's exceptionally well-made. The soups are just okay, and the main courses and stir-fried vegetables weren't very tasty. Overall, it's great value for the price. We recommend calling to reserve a table, otherwise, it gets very crowded.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nanny Tems

sample_reviews_en.text:
This dim sum buffet restaurant has a slightly retro atmosphere.
But it's incredibly delicious! Almost everything was delicious.
The shrimp were real shrimp, plump and juicy. So satisfying!
My only minor complaint is that some dishes didn't arrive completely. I had to ask for them three or four times.
I ordered the fried taro with the first bill, and only got it when I was about to leave.
Even tables that came in later and ordered later received their food before me. I still hadn't received my fried taro even after they checked out and left. The congee also didn't come; I had to keep asking for it.
If they could fix this, it would be perfect.
Oh, one more thing: the drunken chicken still had a reddish interior. I'm not sure if it was sous vide chicken, but I personally wasn't comfortable eating it. It would be much better if it were cooked more thoroughly so there was no red color at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tisha

sample_reviews_en.text:
This dim sum buffet restaurant is amazing!

The chef is authentically Chinese. Here are some of the standout dishes:

1. Shrimp rolls (Hae Geun): Incredibly bouncy and delicious.
2. Shrimp dumplings (Sui Jee): Excellent.
3. Drunken chicken: I've tried it at many places, but none are as good as this one.
4. Sesame sticky rice: My absolute favorite.
5. Ginkgo nut and water chestnut paste: Just like eating in Hong Kong.

There's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, you're guaranteed to be full.
They also have congee, fried rice, char siu pork, stir-fried vegetables, and many other things we haven't tried yet.

I'll definitely be back!
Free parking for 2 hours.
Food is served quickly.
However, there might be minor mistakes occasionally.

Overall, the taste of the food is a perfect 10 out of 10!
sample_reviews_en.author: pitchaporn prukratsameepong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent dimsum and service!!!! ( you can do buffet or la a carte from the menu)
Not a lot of choices but it is cover all basic dimsum that you would like. The portion is good (appropriate for a single buffet portion) so they make you try a lot of things. The price is very reasonable for all you can eat, drink is included.
Although the back place is a little old and dirty around restroom’ area but its clean up front. The service is great and quick service, very well.
Parking at the back with limited. There is the sign that point out to the parking, stamp the parking ticket at the restaurant for free parking.
Overall, one of the best dimsum restaurants in bangkok in my opinion. Highly recommended. And call for reservation in advance

sample_reviews_en.text:

The owner didn't seem to be Thai. To top it off, the AC was broken during my visit.
On the bright side, parking is located in the condo, which is quite convenient. The price is almost reasonable—I had the buffet, which came out to 681 THB net (including VAT and service charge). Just a heads-up: you need to make a reservation in advance to get a table.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Chinese dim sum restaurant is perfect for families or groups of friends, as you can order and share a variety of dishes. The restaurant isn't very large, so it's best to call ahead to make a reservation rather than walk-ins.

The food is buffet-style, with no time limit.
Overall, the taste is good, but the portions are large enough for 1-2 people.

Recommended dishes:
Fried tofu skin, fried taro, shrimp dumplings, chives, sesame dumplings, rice noodle rolls, dumplings with all fillings, fish maw, and fried sesame dumplings.
Not recommended: Fried rice.

Service: Average.

Parking is available under the condo, but there's a fee for parking beyond 2 hours.

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, it was just okay. The xiao long bao wrappers weren't great—thick and hard. The shrimp dumplings, shrimp rice noodle rolls, and fried shrimp with tofu skin were all good. Anything with shrimp was excellent. The lava bun was tasty but the filling was a bit sparse. The black sesame bun was good, but the green bean bun was a little too sweet. The soup was just average. The desserts were delicious, especially the mango pudding. The price is 555++ baht per person, excluding drinks, totaling almost 700 baht. I recommend making a reservation beforehand. There were some minor discrepancies in the food orders, and the staff seemed quite confused.

Eating the buffet with friends is very worthwhile.

sample_reviews_en.text:
A late-night ramen fix. The restaurant is located in a lively area across the main street from the Soi Cowboy sign. It's conveniently located near MRT Sukhumvit and BTS Asok stations, and the fact that it's open until late at night is a big plus!

◆Order
Green Onion Chicken Ramen 125 baht

The soup is served warm, ensuring a consistently good taste every time. While it's hard to compare it to authentic Japanese ramen, you can feel the effort they put into maintaining this quality in Thailand. My friend who went with me raved about it!

The staff's earnest attempts to speak Japanese were also endearing and very comforting. The fact that they accept credit cards is a welcome bonus for travelers. It's the perfect place for a comforting late-night meal.

Thank you for the meal!

✅️ As for the steak, personally, I think the beef steak is decent. It seems like it was frozen, marinated, then reheated and grilled, but I think it was well-prepared.
⛔️ The salad, I think, was presented rather sloppily. The dressing was barely there. I think arranging the salad nicely on the side would look much better. This one is a fail.
🥰 The side dishes were varied and good. I ordered papaya salad, which wasn't sweet, just sour and slightly spicy, but not as spicy as typical papaya salad. I also ordered spaghetti, and it seemed like the noodles had been left out and the sauce had been pre-made. I didn't think it was fresh or fragrant.
🥰🥲 In summary, I've eaten at this restaurant many times. Next time I come, I'll emphasize that the salad should be shaken dry, and the dressing should have less sugar. I ordered tea, and it was extremely sweet. I also ordered chrysanthemum tea, and it was sickeningly sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: P

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely fantastic experience at Normal Steak! The food here is honestly anything but 'normal'. I specifically ordered the chicken steak and the fried chicken, and both completely blew me away. The fried chicken had the most perfect, satisfying crunch on the outside while staying incredibly juicy and flavorful on the inside. The chicken steak was also perfectly seasoned and cooked just right. Along with the fantastic food, the service and atmosphere were top-notch. Highly recommend to anyone in the Huai Khwang area craving amazing chicken!
sample_reviews_en.author: IKG (DOMINIC)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This steakhouse offers incredible value.

The prices are good, the portions are large, and the taste is standard for the price. You can refill your water and cheesy bread as much as you like.

You'll definitely be full after eating here. The staff are lovely. The restaurant is a bit small, but manageable.

Because of the prices and its proximity to an area with many foreigners, there can be some disruptive customers who are constantly shouting and talking, which can slightly spoil the atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirayu Visanuruk

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went in with absolutely no expectations.

The price is around 200 baht, and with all-you-can-eat options, it's great value for money.

Putting all that aside, the chicken is really delicious!!

The skinny male manager (pictured♡) is very friendly and professional, just as the reviews say.

However, the female manager (pictured) seemed unwilling to work;

She was frowning and I couldn't tell if she was even handling the bill.

Seriously...

Aside from that, everything was great :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Local guide master

sample_reviews_en.text:
The steak was just okay; it lacked the natural flavor of beef.

The sausage was delicious, and the accompanying spinach was salty and tasty.

The double cheese and beef burger is highly recommended—it's really good!

The truffle pasta was just okay.

The spinach and cheese pasta with macaroni was also just average.

The seaweed and egg drop soup was just okay.

The lemon tea, which comes with free refills on main courses, was pretty good.

Worth a try if you're passing by.
sample_reviews_en.author: 朱爱吃

sample_reviews_en.text: Don't come here if you're just looking for a place to eat. There was only one double burger left. I ordered it first, but then the waiter came over and said they were sold out. I ordered a steak instead. Later, I found out that they gave the last one to other foreigners. The fries weren't freshly fried either. Just for the first point, please, those of you who understand Chinese, skip this restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrick “Dr.chill” Chung

sample_reviews_en.text: Satisfying, delicious, and affordable – these are the perfect descriptions for this restaurant, which boasts unlimited bread and drinks. The steaks are flavorful, with many rich sauces, and the side dishes are perfectly complementary. However, it's recommended to come on foot or by public transport, as the restaurant is right on the street and parking might be difficult.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prempree Vongcharoen

sample_reviews_en.text: The steak is delicious. I also ate the pork chop and spicy chicken. The papaya salad was as good as the one at Eat… (another restaurant). Bread and drinks are available for unlimited refills. The restaurant has a wide variety of menu items. Takeout is also available. It's easiest to get there by MRT, Huai Khwang station, exit 1, just a short walk away.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phunop S.

restaurants.name: ร้านก๋วยเตี๋ยวเนื้อวัวนายเที๊ยบ สาขานาคนิวาส 21
restaurants.address:

ร้านก๋วยเตี๋ยวนายเที๊ยบ 5 ลาดพร้าว 71 Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely delicious! If there's parking available next to the shop ✔️ Nai Thiep Beef Noodle Soup, Nak Niwas Soi 10, is another famous restaurant from the past in the Senanivet area. This restaurant has two locations: one in Nak Niwas and another near Senanikom, Wang Hin. If you like big, chunky pieces of beef, the toppings are incredibly delicious! The broth is fragrant with spices. Before serving, the restaurant adds fried oil, which adds a nice aroma. The broth is rich and flavorful. The restaurant is open from 8 am to 3:30 pm. It's easy to spot; it's opposite the Shell gas station, next to Tree Coffee, a coffee shop with delicious desserts. #ChanyaSaysIt'sGood
sample_reviews_en.author: Toptotravel - Toptotravelvariety

sample_reviews_en.text:
(Ordered via Grab)
-The food is delicious, the broth is good, the spice aroma isn't too strong, not too salty, the meat is tender enough but not quite melt-in-your-mouth. The price is good, 100 baht for the generous portion.
-Service: I didn't go to the restaurant, but they provided all the necessary condiments.
-Atmosphere: I didn't go to the restaurant, but judging from the pictures, it's a typical noodle shop that doesn't focus on decoration.

I recommend trying it, it's delicious and reliable.

Order or go try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ton-Harnsiri Thessiri

sample_reviews_en.text:
This noodle shop serves delicious beef noodles with a flavorful broth that's slightly sweet – just right.
The beef slices are large and satisfying, and the stewed beef is perfectly tender.
The fresh beef is also soft, and the tendon pieces are large and bouncy. Overall, we think it's excellent and very delicious ♡

Parking is available next to the shop or on the street. It might be a little difficult to find, but you can probably find a spot by circling around.
They accept both cash and QR code payments.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manaschanok Buanark

sample_reviews_en.text: The meat, tendons, meatballs, and offal are clean, high-quality, and odorless. They are tender and soft, and the broth is flavorful and well-balanced. The chili vinegar sauce is just right, not too sour. The portion size and price are reasonable. I've been here many times, and the taste has never disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thatsarid P

sample_reviews_en.text: Open 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM. The beef noodle soup is served with a subtle aroma of Chinese herbs. All the offal is well-prepared. Those who prefer stronger flavors might need to add some seasoning, but for most people, it's as is. Parking is available on the street in front of the shop on even-numbered days.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prapasri T

sample_reviews_en.text:
Price, quality, and quantity—all excellent. A highly recommended noodle shop. The fresh beef is tender, the stewed beef is very good, and the offal is delicious.
***Very important: On even days, park on the side of the noodle shop. On odd days, park on the opposite side of the shop. 09:00 - 15:00.***
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyapong Ratanakungval

sample_reviews_en.text: I've tasted it. The most urgent thing that needs improvement is the saltiness of the soup. Reducing the saltiness would be much healthier. The meat, meatballs, and offal are delicious and tender. The price is reasonable. I'll definitely eat there again, but please reduce the saltiness a little, sir.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุระสิทธิ์ พรหมศิริ

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious & the prices were very affordable, especially for the portion sizes. It definitely feels like a place where locals eat, which made the experience feel more authentic. Highly recommended if you’re looking for tasty noodles beef without the touristy price tag!
sample_reviews_en.author: Luiza Rosaria Regar

restaurants.name: KIMI NOMU
restaurants.address:

14, 2 Soi Somkid, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for a quiet, romantic birthday celebration for your partner, this might not be the best place. It's more suitable for a fun hangout with friends. The restaurant is crowded, the tables are quite close together, and it can be noisy. This might be because we didn't do our research well enough. ***The restaurant is quite dark; the candlelight provides very little illumination.***

The food was good, although the menu might be a bit limited. Overall, the flavors were excellent. I was particularly impressed with the Asari udon; the strong flavor was great for cutting through the richness. The DIY salmon temaki was also delicious. The Banoffee dessert was not too sweet and very tasty. The staff were very kind and accommodating when we requested candles.

Parking is quite limited; we arrived at 7 PM and there were no parking spaces available. We had to park at Central Chidlom, which wasn't too far to walk.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rada Witthayasak

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Japanese fusion restaurant is located in Soi Somkid on the second floor of a renovated old house. The space has gone through several restaurant concepts over the years, but its location remains one of its biggest advantages—right in the heart of the Chidlom district.

It’s one of those restaurants with a great atmosphere and consistently strong crowds. Even on a Sunday like today, the place was still packed. The vibe leans young and social, mostly small groups of two to four people.

Many of the dishes are highly creative, blending Japanese and European influences.

One example is the toast topped with maguro. At first glance, the style almost feels Spanish-inspired.

Another standout is the udon tossed in rich mentaiko sauce. The texture is creamy, savory, and uniquely satisfying. Visually, it resembles spaghetti, but the flavor is far richer and more indulgent. This dish easily gets an AAA rating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saharath Chy

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is lovely, with a classic vibe that really sets a romantic mood. The service is excellent—staff are very attentive, asking about allergies and making sure to remove any ingredients I couldn’t have.

The sashimi was incredibly fresh and highly recommended. I also loved the rice cooked in a pot with grilled fish (I can’t recall the name), though it does take some time to prepare, so it’s worth being aware of that. Overall, the food was very good.

The price is on the higher side, but considering the location and quality, it’s reasonable for a special occasion.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploypun Ninlakarn

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came on a Sunday evening. The parking lot was full, and the security guard told customers to park at Central Chidlom (they actually used the word "tell them away").

The restaurant is quite small, with tables very close together; you can hear everything the people at the next table are saying. It's suitable for gatherings with a group of friends.

The food tasted okay, a Japanese-Italian fusion? The spaghetti noodles were thin and the flavors weren't strong, but I must commend the baked rice with fish and the baked rice with beef; they were delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nunticha S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Terrible Service from K.Pat. we have reserved the table ways advance. We have emphasized many times that we need the table in the middle. Yet, when we arrived, they put us on the side where there is barely any light to take photo.

Had they informed us earlier that they cannot arrange the seat, we would have gone somewhere else. This comoletely ruined my Sister Birthday experience.

The food is below average for Omakase, there is no attention in details and the flavour is kinda off.

Very terrible experience. Not worth the money paid.
sample_reviews_en.author: Watcharapon CL

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere. I like that it stays open until midnight (but last order is at 9:30 PM). It gets quite crowded, so I recommend making a reservation beforehand (if you want to come during off-peak hours, come after 8 PM). The staff provides excellent service. The food is delicious; I highly recommend the baked rice and the stir-fried udon – they are incredibly tasty! Other dishes were just okay for me. The prices are mid-range. The restaurant has parking available and is located in the Siri House complex.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bangkok Hilton

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fusion cuisine, Japanese-style pasta.
The flavors are rich, unique, and delicious.

The clay pot rice (1000 baht) is delicious and fragrant; the fish is perfectly cooked, tender and bouncy.

The portions are quite small. Pasta dishes are 300-500 baht, but the quantity isn't enough to fill you up.
For two people, you'd need to order three pasta dishes to feel full.

The restaurant is quite small, with tables placed very close together, lacking privacy.

The restaurant has a wide selection of wines.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanwisa P

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem tucked away on the 2nd floor in Soi Somkid. The atmosphere is cozy yet vibrant, perfect for hanging out with friends in the heart of the city.

The food is incredibly fresh 🍝🥢and packed with creative flavors —my FAV is maguro yuzu somen... and lots of unique dishes worth trying. Their Japanese wine 🥂selection was surprisingly good, and the staff gave great recommendations.

Definitely a spot worth coming back to for good food, drinks, and great vibes.😘
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanitta Chartpong

restaurants.name: Saxsi Rooftop Restaurant & Bar
restaurants.address:

188/1 Naradhiwas Rajanagarindra Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Saxsi Rooftop Bar is located on the 9th floor of the Sora Hotel Silom, and its ambiance is undeniably appealing. I visited with a friend, and while the venue has a lot of potential, our experience was less than ideal.

Upon arrival, no staff greeted us, but we didn’t mind too much and found our own seats. However, after waiting for a while without any attention from the staff, I had to go to the bar to check if it was self-service. Three staff members were at the bar, and one of them quickly apologized, saying he would come to our table.

We ordered two gin and tonics, but despite there being only a handful of other patrons (six besides the two of us), the drinks took a noticeable amount of time to arrive. The drinks themselves were decent, and the cleanliness of the space was satisfactory, but the service left much to be desired.

While the setting of Saxsi Rooftop Bar is impressive, the service experience fell short of expectations. I hope they can improve in this area to fully match the potential of the venue.
sample_reviews_en.author: mjesec luna

sample_reviews_en.text:
My girlfriend and I recently visited Saxsi Roof Top Bar and had an incredible experience! The service was top-notch, with friendly and attentive staff who made sure we had everything we needed.

Special shoutout to Putin, our server, who went above and beyond to make our evening special. His recommendations were spot on, and he made sure we felt like VIPs.

The food was also amazing, with a great selection of dishes to choose from. We opted for the salad and chicken curry and it was cooked to perfection. The flavors were rich and delicious, and the presentation was beautiful.

Overall, I would highly recommend Saxsi Roof Top Bar to anyone looking for a great night out. The combination of excellent service, delicious food, and stunning views makes it a must-visit destination. Thanks again to Putin and the team for a fantastic evening!
sample_reviews_en.author: Oscar Escobar Arenas

sample_reviews_en.text: I don’t know how this place received 4.8 stars together. It is a below average place. Although it started good, it just did not end well. People are nice but they are not attentive. We went there as 2 people and my main dish did not come at the same time and I had to wait for another 15 minutes or so. The ice cream we ordered at the end was plain disaster. When I visited the men’s room I realized that there was no soap, neither was there napkins. Then there was a guy who just got out of the other stall and looked like a guy who works in the kitchen as he walked into the kitchen and he did  look at me in the eye, smiled and left the bathrooms without washing his hands. At that point I was like oh my gosh!! It is a place not to go. I strongly recommend that you try another place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Taner Oktar

sample_reviews_en.text: Staying in this hotel - Sora hotel Silom and was given a welcome drink. Had my welcome drink and some finger food at the rooftop bar.  The night view was stunning looking directly opposite Mahanakhon Bangkok and the cool evening weather and nice music was perfect for the night. The welcome drink was really good, had the additional cocktail - Concrete jungle and it was strong and nice taste and that was recommended by Mix (the happy staff) the most friendly, greatest service staff there. He recommended me the finger food and the drinks and they did not disappoint me at all. I enjoyed it very much there. Hotel guest got 20% off from the menu. Thank you very much for your hospitality and great service. Highly recommend this hotel to everyone
sample_reviews_en.author: leslie chua

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re looking for a chill and relaxed atmosphere, head to Saxsi Rooftop at Sora Silom. Jill and Mixer were amazing — super attentive and friendly! Their Happy Hour drinks from 4pm-7pm are delicious and definitely worth it.

Tonight there was an acoustic guitarist serenading the evening — such a nice touch that made the whole vibe even better.

Will definitely come back again to enjoy this moment. 😌✨

For those staying at Sora Silom Hotel, this rooftop is a must-visit — it’s literally right above Chong Nonsi BTS station, close to Silom area and easy to access via BTS to explore the rest of Bangkok.

Highly recommended! 🍸🌃
sample_reviews_en.author: lawmathew ya

sample_reviews_en.text:
A newly opened cozy, relaxing and chilling rooftop bar in Silom. The location is great as it's super near to BTS Chong Nonsri which makes it easy to commute to.

However, a canned beer at the rooftop bar!!?  San Miguel light should come as a bottle with a slice of lime on top, shouldn't it? I was totally stunned by this fact. Please kindly keep this comment to your consideration because if you keep serving canned beer, you will surely lose a good first impression from customers.

I loved the vibe, the view, the staff and the service, but the canned beer. A slap in my face. 😭😭😭😭
sample_reviews_en.author: Pharinya Auttho

sample_reviews_en.text:
BAD quality of food…
Atmosphere of this restaurant is great but cannot say the same about their food. Food is not tasty and portions are too tiny. Also, we ordered deep fried chicken tendons and instead of mean it was bone inside. We could not even eat it and we were so annoyed by the experience. Obviously we told waitors about it and did not pay for it but still not a good experience to have and they should be more careful!! They add 8% service to the bill without asking which is inappropriate for their bad quality of food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sonia Barzegar

sample_reviews_en.text:
Breathtaking Views, Unforgettable Experience!
Dining at Saxsi Rooftop is truly a feast for the senses. The panoramic views of the skyline are nothing short of magical, especially as the sun sets and the city lights begin to twinkle. Whether you're there for a romantic evening or just catching up with friends, the atmosphere is elevated by the stunning scenery. The food is as impressive as the view, with every dish crafted to perfection. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a dining experience that’s a cut above the rest!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mo Neeta

restaurants.name: Cafe Blu Pattaya
restaurants.address:

Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're a long-term tourist in Pattaya and your budget usually limits you to eating at the night markets or one of the "regular" restaurants on Beach Road, then a visit to Cafe Blu feels like a welcome break from your vacation.

The decor is beautiful and stylish, the atmosphere is subdued, and there's no shouting from staff across the dining area, no street noise, and no loudspeaker blaring from vendors.

This positive experience extends to the quality of the food. We were delighted with the taste and presentation.

The staff was friendly and unobtrusive.

Instead of a worn-out menu, the one here is presented on a tablet on the table. The selection is extensive, so everyone can find something to their liking.

The prices are naturally higher here, but absolutely justified.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manfred

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is one of those places where you feel you made the right choice from the moment you walked in. Many details reflect the restaurant’s attention to quality from the ingredients and flavors to the service from the staff. Everything feels well balanced. The food tastes great and the quality matches the price, while the atmosphere is comfortable and relaxing.
The service is also impressive. The staff are polite, attentive, and helpful with menu recommendations. The food is served at a good pace, allowing you to enjoy the meal comfortably without feeling rushed.
Overall, this restaurant maintains a very high standard. If I had to rate it, it would easily be a full score without much hesitation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bami

sample_reviews_en.text:
What really makes the experience stand out, though, is the service. The staff are attentive, friendly, and genuinely make you feel welcome from the moment you walk in. On top of that, the owners are incredibly cool and clearly passionate about what they’ve created, which adds a personal touch you don’t often find.

If there’s one small thing to improve, it would be the signage—it can be a bit tricky to find the place at first. But honestly, once you’re there, you’ll be glad you made the effort.

The restaurant put me off at first because it is located in Acadia condo resort but they have parking and the staff were welcoming, I’ll go definitely back
sample_reviews_en.author: graham henley

sample_reviews_en.text: Some of the food was super nice and some really bad ! Onion soup was super nice - salmon bruschetta taste of nothing - Mexican fajita was crazy spicy - burgers was super boring and really dry and boring bread. The staff really did the utmost to make up for all of this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kenneth Hovmøller

sample_reviews_en.text: A very nice restaurant by the pool. International and French cuisine. They prepare excellent food with good ingredients. Prices are a bit high, but very well justified. Impeccable and very polite service from the staff. No complaints whatsoever on my third visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: sym pass

sample_reviews_en.text: Lovely dinner. Staff bent over backwards to accommodate. Not the busiest evening, but it was very pleasant and kitchen was turning over a fair amount of take away orders. Lovely experience and for my wife to express an opinion, it has to be good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jacqueline

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the Mediterranean chicken wrap, which came with pesto sauce—a detail I really liked. The portion size was decent, but unfortunately, the wrap arrived a bit cold. The ambiance of the place was fine, and the service was excellent …
sample_reviews_en.author: Betül sohtorik

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a very good restaurant, modern with good temperature and the food is very good. It's pretty fast service. The prices are fair, sad to hear you may move but it's understandable because of the location in a lower/middle class resort.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lc C

restaurants.name: MENSHO TOKYO (One Bangkok)
restaurants.address:

1 Rama IV Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hello all,

I am back from my food review haitus.

Hardly post reviews nowadays but for this restaurant, I will make an exception.

I ordered their signature chicken ramen and was given the choice of normal/extra creamy for the soup base. Ordered the extra creamy version since I’m looking for a chicken ramen to replicate my Tokyo’s experience. I have never been so wrong this year.

The chicken soup tasted close to a carbonara texture and I don’t understand how are all the meats included ‘cold’ and the pork doesn’t not blend well with the chicken soup. I could taste the ‘porky’ taste in the chicken soup and I don’t know how I should describe it other than simply disgusted and left a weird after taste.

The egg with their logo seared on it was horrendous, felt like it was prepared hours ago and the egg losing its texture . Ramen on a thicker side, depending on your preference.

Wouldn’t recommend here, prefer to ramen at the lower floor. Thank me later. Tonchin Ramen
sample_reviews_en.author: Chi Foong Wong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited this restaurant alone for lunch on a Friday. The dining area was moderately busy, providing a pleasant and lively atmosphere. The staff were very kind and provided service in English, which made the experience smooth and welcoming for an international visitor.
For my meal, I ordered the signature ramen, fried chicken with black vinegar sauce, and a cold green tea. Every item was delicious and well-prepared. The signature ramen was flavorful, and the fried chicken was a highlight with its well-balanced sauce.

The restaurant stands out for its high level of cleanliness and professional hospitality. The quality of both the service and the food was consistently high throughout the entire visit. Given the excellent service standards and the quality of the dishes, it is a reliable spot for an enjoyable meal. Every detail, from the attentiveness of the team to the food preparation, was handled with a high degree of care.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yoshi S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Normally I love classic Tori Paitan ramen at Mensho but the creamy broth is not as perfect like in the past so it was a perfect time to try other menu!

Umi shio ramen, surprisingly amazing. Even though I was never a big fan of shio ramen. The clear broth got natural sweetness punch from clams. House-made noodles is very satisfying to eat, even shio ramen features thin type noodles, still got good amount of chewiness. Marvelous.

For a high price, I’m glad they are generous with thick sliced of chashu pork. It’s flavorful and so tender.

New version of Abura soba also very tasty. White truffles oil add crazy aroma to this dish. Another satisfying dish just like Umi shio.

Fried chicken with grated radish and black vinegar sauce was a fine snacks as well. Probably the best tasting out of all appetizers here.

Overall, Mensho will always delivered. Quality ramen and snacks. A bit expensive but worth the whole experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cafe S

sample_reviews_en.text:
The signature ramen dish, with its truffle-infused broth, gives it a more fusion feel than a traditional dish.

There were several types of meat available, but they lacked A5 wagyu. The staff offered to substitute, indicating a problem with ingredient management in the restaurant. They still charged full price, making it overpriced compared to other restaurants. The flame-grilled char siu pork was tastier than the other dishes, if you disregard the fact that they said they were out of A5 wagyu. The soup was very thick, and the side dish lacked minced garlic, making the soup become cloying after eating about a third. There were very few vegetables, and the noodles were quite firm.

The seating is uncomfortable because there are only counter seats, it's difficult to place things, and the aisles are narrow. It's good that there are partitions to prevent odors from spreading.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chote Foodie

sample_reviews_en.text:
*Umi Shio Ramen*
Highly recommended.
Perfect for those tired of thick, creamy ramen broths.
For those who want to try a clear ramen soup with a rich umami flavor, a subtle hint of the sea, and a perfectly balanced salty-umami taste. You can easily keep sipping it. The broth is complex; it's hard to guess what ingredients are used and how long it's simmered to achieve this deliciousness.

The noodles are perfectly chewy and soft.

The chashu pork is thickly sliced ​​with a bit of fat; it melts in your mouth when you pick it up – incredibly tender.

Overall, it's well-balanced, not greasy, and you can eat it again and again.
The price for two people, including drinks, is approximately 1,000 baht.

I love ❤️ the taste and will order it again and again whenever I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: FAT AND HAPPY

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located on the 1st floor, The Stories zone. Coming in the evening on a weekday, there's no need to queue.

I ordered the Signature Tori Paitan. The soup was incredibly rich and flavorful – my favorite soup at this restaurant! The beef, pork, and duck were tender and good, but the chicken had a strange, sour taste. It wasn't like spoiled food, but it was just too strong and overpowering. I'm not sure if it's the cooking method or if the ingredients had been prepared a long time ago, but it wasn't to my liking, so I'm deducting points for that.

The atmosphere is bar-style, with all tables and chairs. The tables and chairs aren't quite the right height; the low tables mean you have to bend down to eat, which isn't very convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: p.

sample_reviews_en.text:
For years, Mensho Tokyo has been one of my favorite ramen spots in Bangkok, so of course I had to check out their new location at One Bangkok. The big advantage here? No crazy queues like at their Sukhumvit branch — we didn’t even have to wait a minute.

Luckily, the quality is just as good as the original. My personal favorite is still the Wagyu ramen — pricey, but absolutely worth it. We also tried the spicy chicken ramen, which was great too. Only downside: they don’t serve an egg with it by default. Do yourself a favor and order an extra smoked egg — they’re seriously to die for.

And of course, a fresh draft beer on the side pairs perfectly with a steaming hot bowl of ramen. Can’t go wrong.
sample_reviews_en.author: nik

sample_reviews_en.text:
This legendary ramen restaurant, with a great reputation, is located on the 1st floor of The Storey.

Finally, I got to try it. I'd been meaning to come for a while, letting my kids play on the 6th floor while I went down. I didn't have to wait in line and ordered the restaurant's signature ramen. The first bite was impressive, but after more than half the bowl, it became a bit too rich and cloying. I guess I ordered the wrong thing; it wasn't for me. I'll come back and try something else next time.

But I won't order this bowl again because it had way too many different ingredients mixed together – like a buffet where they just dumped everything together.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kitibordee Yindeear-rom

restaurants.name: Korkai Chicken Rice
restaurants.address:

1636 Banthat Thong Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Air-conditioned Hainanese Chicken Rice restaurant.
The restaurant has a beautiful minimalist design.
Good prices with a variety of chicken cuts to choose from, such as thigh, drumstick, with skin, without skin, etc.
Good service.
When we went, there were no other customers at all; it was very quiet. Even after we finished eating, there was only one other table occupied, even though it was in the evening.

Several staff members were relaxing at a table at the very back, near the kitchen. The sound of their conversations and mobile phone recordings was quite loud.

Anyway, I hope it stays open for a long time because the taste is really good. I especially liked the soup, and the size of the special portion is very good value.
Keep up the good work! I'm rooting for you!
sample_reviews_en.author: King Bob M.

sample_reviews_en.text:
• A Hainanese Chicken Rice shop on Banthat Thong Road.
• Large shop with plenty of seating, spacious, and air-conditioned.
• Minimalist Muji-style decor. The Hainanese chicken rice shop has beautiful and comfortable décor, a good atmosphere, is clean, and has good service.
• Very affordable prices! Boiled chicken rice is 60 baht, special is 70 baht!!
• The chicken meat is firm and not mushy. The rice is fragrant, soft, and not soggy. The dipping sauce is excellent, with a well-balanced and delicious flavor. The soup is served piping hot and has a great, well-balanced flavor.
• The fried chicken is crispy. They probably use the thigh meat because it's firm, tender, and delicious.
• Generous portions, great value for money. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Eattillyoudrop foodie

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was wandering around looking for lunch in the Banthat area.
I found this Hainanese chicken rice shop. The shop looked nice, with a good atmosphere.
It was air-conditioned, nice and cool.

Since I was hungry, I ordered the special.
It turned out to be a generous portion, both chicken and rice. I really liked it.
They also gave me soup, which wasn't bad.
Although the rice wasn't very fragrant, it wasn't bad.

I deducted one star because, on the day I visited, there seemed to be a small child, possibly a staff member's child, running around and making noise.
I didn't feel very comfortable with that.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kantapong Chantarasiri

sample_reviews_en.text:
Solid stop for simple, well-known Asian comfort food—Khao Man Gai (Hainanese chicken rice).

I went for the large mixed chicken rice, and it was very satisfying: tender, juicy chicken with fragrant rice and a good balance of sauces. Everything came together nicely, just the way chicken rice should. Paired it with an iced black coffee, which was straightforward and refreshing, making the meal even more enjoyable.

No-frills, comforting flavors done right. A great option if you’re around Banthat Thong Road and craving proper chicken rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Farangondiet

sample_reviews_en.text:
Various types of Hainanese Chicken Rice.
The restaurant is spacious and comfortable with plenty of tables and air conditioning.
The Hainanese chicken rice is of standard quality and tastes good.
Overall, the price is quite high.
_Fried chicken: Decent.
_Boiled chicken thigh: Very tender.
_Boiled chicken breast: Quite chewy, but not dry.
_Rice: Good, fluffy and fragrant.
_Dipping sauce: Decent.
_Pumpkin soup: Very fragrant and tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nana Relax

sample_reviews_en.text: This chicken rice shop sells boiled chicken, grilled chicken, and fried chicken. The prices aren't cheap for chicken rice, but the taste is okay. It's air-conditioned, so you can sit comfortably. The portion size is decent per serving. However, I don't know why, but I think ordering a mixed plate of different flavors gives you a larger and more filling portion than ordering a single plate (though it's more expensive).
sample_reviews_en.author: Ukrit Tulyanitikul

sample_reviews_en.text: Hidden gem. Forget about the famed micheline chicken rice at Pratunam. This one is way better than that one. Rice is fragrant, chicken is tasty. The crispy one is really good, boiled and spicy also taste good. Resto is clean, comfortable seating area with clean washroom at second floor. Price is reasonable. So glad we found this resto, we came by accidenr only due to boat noodle resto nearby didnt opened yet.
sample_reviews_en.author: britr

sample_reviews_en.text:
Underrated chicken rice in BKK. Definitely deserves more recognition. The rice was fragrant, boiled chicken breast was tender and flavourful and the fried chicken was crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. Their sauces were also delightful and compliments the dish.

I must also say that the restaurant was extremely clean and modern.
Please come here instead of Go-Ang
sample_reviews_en.author: Unicorn unicorn

restaurants.name: Soul Bistro Restaurant & Lounge
restaurants.address:

64, 131 M 9 Soi Buakhao, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I wanted to give a positive review but unfortunately I can’t. I tried a little of everything and first thing I will say if the greens and cabbage is definitely CANNED FOOD. They didn’t even try to cover up the fact. So to change 220 - 250 baht for canned vegetables is disrespectful. Especially when Thailand is know for its fresh produce. I have found collards and cabbage at the fresh markets. Cat fish over cooked. Jerk chicken just had some old baked chicken with some sort of jerk sauce poured over it. Terrible. Wings were basic and Mac and cheese was just basic also. Best part of the meal was the corn bread. Look at this place like a Bar, and you know bar food is mediocre.
If you want real quality soul food I suggest Qulture Lounge.
I hope they do better, or just stick to bar food.
Service was also a joke to preoccupied with her cell phone. I had to ask for plates twice!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kuyang CJ

sample_reviews_en.text: Ok ok ok. This review is coming from an American who has spent many years in the south. 🤣 I’m impressed with how spot on they have the food. I got the chicken wings (I mean chicken wings are chicken wings) they were tasty. Waitress gave me some homemade ranch. 🔥. Had the mash, Mac and cheese and the corn bread. I wanted to try the banana pudding but I was full. All the flavors are pretty spot on for being in Thailand. Sweet tea was good too. I’ll go back for sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: IG: fulltimegrind3r

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was absolutely delicious! Dined in 2 days straight.
Lengthy wait because everything comes out fresh but it's well worth it. Hands down some of the BEST yams I've ever had. 10/10 wings, 10/10 greens, 10/10 mac & cheese... definitely my new go-to spot 👌🏾 …
sample_reviews_en.author: L

sample_reviews_en.text: Soul Bistro is the spot to hit when you’re craving that down-home Southern cooking from back in the States. I loved everything — from the shrimp and grits to the collard greens to the banana pudding. Every time we’re in the area, we have to stop by for our fix.
sample_reviews_en.author: martina kerns

sample_reviews_en.text: Service was slow—30 minutes for a slice of pie and wings with barely anyone in the restaurant. The sweet potato pie filling was decent, but the crust was a letdown. It had that thin, crispy egg roll wrapper texture instead of a proper flaky …
sample_reviews_en.author: Rodney Boatner

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant was close to my hotel and since I grew up in the deep south of US, I wanted a little home cooking. The place is connected to a hotel. It is very nice inside with a full bar and even a pool table. I got the catfish plate. It …
sample_reviews_en.author: Freetirement Randy & Lori

sample_reviews_en.text: Although I love that soul food is in Pattaya I have to be fair and honest. I personally went to the restaurant to order to go. I brought my gf from The Philippines so she could try my cultural food.  The place fit the name . The ambiance …
sample_reviews_en.author: John Snow

sample_reviews_en.text: The PANCAKES really surprised me and were very delicious. They had a nice cake flavor, as did the CORNBREAD (my toddler is obsessed).The CHEESE EGGS OMELETTE is probably the most flavorful in Pattaya! I ordered both CABBAGE and COLLARD …
sample_reviews_en.author: Danni Duff

restaurants.name: Gen Japanese Charcoal Grill & Bar
restaurants.address:

7 Soi Sukhumvit 25, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious! Worth the price, very affordable. Everyone has to try it, you won't be disappointed! Don't miss out, I loved it so much I wrote a long review. We ordered the 4 dishes shown in the picture, shared by 4 friends, and it cost around 500+ baht per person. We initially prepared 1,000-1,500 baht 🥹 The price was surprisingly good. You can even book a private room. The price is too good to miss. Every dish was delicious. If I were to rank my favorites:
1. Pâté with bread: Wow!
2. Grilled skewers: You have to try their recipe. The chicken is slightly undercooked, but it's so delicious, especially the liver. It's amazing! You have to order the set like in the picture (but some skewers were just okay, like 2 skewers were nothing special, the rest were delicious and amazing!).
3. Salmon donburi: Salty. We ordered the small pot.
4. 4-piece roll: This was delicious, amazing! I gave it a 4 because it's easy to find elsewhere. The ones above are hard to find haha.
But if you're coming with 4 people, I recommend ordering another dish. We ate dessert afterwards, so it was just the right amount to fill us up haha. Overall 10/10. Extremely impressed!
sample_reviews_en.author: แบมว่าดีย์

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently dined at this restaurant and was impressed with the food, especially the grilled Hokke fish; it was well-grilled and delicious, just like in Japan.

However, there are some issues I'd like the restaurant to seriously improve in terms of management and etiquette in public areas.

Noise management in the restaurant:
A Japanese family occupied a table behind me where their child was playing an iPad with loud music, disturbing other customers. Normally, Japanese restaurants should have a more considerate atmosphere, but the restaurant didn't inform or ask for their cooperation at all. This significantly detracted from the dining experience.

Inconsistent service:
A confusing situation arose when a staff member initially offered me a seat to place my bag on, but after a while, asked me to move it to a basket on the floor. This was despite the fact that there were still other empty tables available and there was no immediate need to clear a seat.
The conflicting instructions given by the staff made the service feel inconsistent and lacking in flexibility in attending to customers.

Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sea

sample_reviews_en.text:
It’s a Japanese-style dining experience with an impressive number of staff and waiters—perhaps even more than necessary—but that reflects the meticulous and attentive nature of Japanese hospitality, which I truly appreciate.

However, there are some operational issues that could be improved. From 10:30 to 11:00 a.m., I was told that no food orders could be made, and the staff advised me to go to the pool bar instead. When I went there, I was told again that I couldn’t order food—but later discovered that this was actually incorrect information. Such miscommunication is frustrating and gives the impression of poor coordination among staff.

In addition, the restaurant closes at 14:30, which feels too early, especially for a restaurant located inside a hotel. I believe hotel restaurants should operate continuously or at least offer some light dining options throughout the afternoon. Guests expect flexibility, not rigid time restrictions.

Overall, while the service quality and hospitality are commendable, management should pay more attention to consistency, communication, and guest convenience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kay K

sample_reviews_en.text:
Apart from the beef tongue and sashimi, the other dishes were subpar—especially the Gindara, salmon claypot rice and the sushi rolls, which were particularly disappointing.

The service was a complete disaster, with the staff appearing utterly clueless. A few examples include:

1.	When I ordered salmon sashimi, the staff member failed to note it the first time. When asked to repeat our order, she hesitated and said, “Err… some kind of salmon dish? What was it again?”

2.	There were two fish dishes on the menu. When the first one was served, we asked her to clarify which fish it was, she literally whispered her response, when asked to repeat, she responded with another whisper and left leaving us dumbfounded.

3.	When we requested the plates to be cleared so desserts could be served, the staff removed only a single plate from the table and then disappeared for quite some time. We had to call them again to get the rest cleared.

Overall, it is completely a great disappointment, we regret coming here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peeranut S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing 👀‼️ I was there from 6:00 AM to 8:30 AM. It's located in a newly built Japanese hotel🇯🇵, on the first floor of the Sotetsu Grand Fresa Bangkok, in the Asoke area's Sukhumvit 25.

"Sumibi-yaki Gen" in Ekkamai and "Jidori Ryori Ken" in Phrom Phong have both been featured in the Michelin Guide Bangkok guide for six consecutive years. This up-and-coming restaurant inherits their flavors and philosophy.

The breakfast buffet is a shocking 390++ even for non-guests🤣🤣🤣!!

Juice, jam, dressing, miso soup, seaweed, and coffee are all delicious.

The coffee☕️ was delicious🤤

Lunch and dinner options ranged from izakaya-style dining to high-end cuisine😆😆😆
Because it's a hotel, parking and all the amenities are available.

Close to Asoke Station😆😆😆🙇‍♀️

Amazing! Absolutely guaranteed!
sample_reviews_en.author: 近藤かおり

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located on the first floor of Sotetsu Grand Fresa Bangkok.

Open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

I ordered the chicken ramen and mini yakitori rice bowl.

Tea and coffee after the meal were included.

The chicken ramen was beautifully presented; it almost felt a shame to eat it.

The taste was light and exactly what I was looking for.

Mixing in the charcoal-grilled char siu added a delicious smoky flavor.

The chicken ramen alone might not be enough for someone very hungry, but the mini yakitori rice bowl was generous and filled me up.

The yakitori was high quality, moist and fluffy.

The yakitori sauce wasn't too strong, so those who prefer stronger flavors might find it lacking.

To give you an idea, it tasted similar to the sauce used for grilled eel.
sample_reviews_en.author: orochi

sample_reviews_en.text:
A branch of the famous Ekkamai restaurant, Sumibi Yaki Gen, has opened on the first floor of Sotetsu Fresa Inn.

Everything is delicious.
There's nothing that's not tasty. As it's a charcoal grill restaurant, I recommend the grilled dishes.
This time I had marinated tuna and mitsuba, seared local chicken, duck, beef stew, and more. Everything was excellent, but the duck was especially well-cooked. It was juicy and flavorful, and went perfectly with wine.
They have a wide selection of alcohol, but not many wines. However, there are so many dishes that go well with wine that I always bring my own (500 baht corkage fee).

I'll be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tetsu Saito

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was one of the best Japanese dining experiences I've had in a long time. Every dish was outstanding, and the quality of the ingredients was evident from the very first bite.
The sashimi was exceptionally fresh—the tuna, salmon, and yellowtail were incredibly tender and practically melted in my mouth. The Wagyu beef strips were rich, perfectly cooked, and full of flavor. To finish, the pudding dessert was absolutely delicious and the perfect ending to an unforgettable meal.
The presentation of every dish was beautiful, the service was attentive and welcoming, and the atmosphere was elegant yet relaxed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yonatan Shafri

restaurants.name: Ginza Tenharu BKK
restaurants.address:

3F-23 999 Gaysorn Centre Phloen Chit Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Perfect tempura. I tried the Singapore branch and so decided to also sample the bkk branch. We went for the 5000 baht menu for dinner. As expected, service and attentiveness were top notch, ambience cosy and exclusive with a 10 seat counter. Chef in attendance was polite, deliberate in his cooking and serving speed. Complimented with a yuzu soda and a junmai daiginjo from ichigawa, we enjoyed a multi course tempura omakase. We were pleasantly surprised by the Uni on tempura seaweed dish as the serving was double that of the Singapore branch, as well as the tempura mackerel which was perfectly executed with a hint of rareness in the middle. Three choices we had to make 1) special tempura dish. We chose Hokkaido scallop and A5 wagyu, 2) filler dish; we went with tendon and dashi chazuke, and 3) desert where we went for yuzu sorbet and mochi in azuki. Perfect meal. Won’t be surprised if this is the best tempura in Bangkok. Pricey but worth it
sample_reviews_en.author: M4l2K T4N

sample_reviews_en.text: High end omakase sushi is now a dime a dozen in Bangkok. But omakase tempura is maybe more challenging because it demonstrates the finely-tuned skill of frying different ingredients to a perfect texture/crisp/crunch. The seafood tempura is superb, the signature raw uni on tempura fried ‘cracker’ is not be missed. But the seasonal vegetable tempura omakase is also very unique. There is more variety in taste and  sensation in the plant kingdom! In fact the best dipping sauce for vegetable tempura is just salt to appreciate the purity of vegetable flavor. (I also prefer beer to pair with tempura instead of sake… because… fried food. ) We’ve been there 3 times for special occasions and it’s consistently excellent. Each person in the party can pick a different set omakase: they are very accommodating and flexible.
sample_reviews_en.author: uzbek celia

sample_reviews_en.text:
I hate leaving places like this a bad review but, if I had known this I would not have come.

The staff is great and the food was nice. Not incredible, but good. Maybe it’s overpriced, but it’s certainly not bad.

What is horrible is that our 6500thb++ meal was less than an hour long. I’m sorry, that is inexcusable with a set menu at that price.

We showed up at 19:45 or so and were out the door in less than an hour. A meal like this should be an experience that last around 3hrs.

And the ambiance was not very nice. Just us two in an empty restaurant. The only sound was our voice and the refrigerator.

Not great. And it’s a shame because the chef and staff were so nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joe Guilmette

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is located on the 3rd floor of Gaysorn plaza - it is a little bit difficult to notice along with other restaurants. I have an amazing experience with their tempura omakase course. Their ingredients were fresh and each of the dishes were well prepared - it is worth mentioning that they never reused their oil. Staffs were very friendly and take time to explain the cooking method of tempura from how the batter was made, how each proteins were preserved, or even how the used oil was disposed. The only downside is that it is a little too pricey in my opinion but it is an amazing experience worth trying once in  a while.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kongpope Naranong

sample_reviews_en.text:
My first experience: Tempura Omakase
The owner was friendly and easy to talk to, and we quickly became friends.
The restaurant has a great atmosphere.
The tempura was crispy, fragrant, and delicious.
When you hear the word "tempura," you might think of it as oily, but
it didn't leave me feeling heavy at all.
They used seasonal ingredients and served it in a way that suited them, and I had a really enjoyable time enjoying it with all five senses, including the sound of frying across the counter.
This is a restaurant I'd like to visit again.
I'd love for everyone to have this experience.
Thank you very much 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: YOSHIO WATANUKI

sample_reviews_en.text: I have been here last Friday for the first time with my colleagues. This place interior is very calm and warm. The chef has already prepared the fresh ingredients such as vegetables, fishes in front of you. So you can see what you would eat forward. The chef has been preparing all process in front of you, cutting, flouring, tempura-ing. You can enjoy in every step !! The taste is absolutely completely delicious even it has pasted for days... I wish to experience there again and of course very recommended place for any occasions, with friends of couples.
sample_reviews_en.author: Viriya Yuvajita

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re looking for the best tempura omakase in Thailand, this place is a must-visit. The food is absolutely delicious — each piece is perfectly crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. The flavors are well-balanced and truly satisfying.

The staff and chef are friendly and welcoming, which makes the whole dining experience even more enjoyable. On top of that, the price is surprisingly affordable for the quality you get. Highly recommended for anyone who loves authentic Japanese cuisine!
sample_reviews_en.author: Suphanut Thattinaphanich

sample_reviews_en.text: Came back again and wasn't disappointed. I love how the menu changes with the seasons, so there's always something new to enjoy. The maitake was full of aroma, the bitter melon was surprisingly light and not too bitter, and the crab-stuffed mushroom was definitely the highlight for me. Finishing with the ochazuke made the meal feel complete. Can't wait to come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: 天云

restaurants.name: Klinkwan
restaurants.address:

142/5 ซอย จุฬาลงกรณ์ 3 Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The duck was incredibly delicious! The skin was perfectly crispy, and the pancakes were chewy, soft, and flavorful, without any unpleasant floury smell. The price was also excellent; we ordered a set that came with vegetables and Mie Goreng for only 489฿. The Bak Kut Teh was also decent.
The Mie Goreng was just okay, but the duck was amazing. I highly recommend ordering it. Two people were more than enough to fill us up.
There aren't many seats, but you can park in the parking building in the alley next to the restaurant.
sample_reviews_th.author: Ruby Rr

sample_reviews_th.text:
Wow!! LOVE it! 🤩🦆

Such a good deal — half crispy skin, half juicy meat on that smoky, roasted Peking duck. 🔥 Perfectly done!

Love the open kitchen concept too — fresh ingredients, right in front of you, and everything feels so alive.

And the finale… just-right มะกอกน้ำ sorbet 🍧
Refreshing, delicious and the perfect sweet finish to cleanse the palate. ✨

Crispy • Juicy • Smoky • Refreshing — what a combo! 😋

#MadamBananaLike
#DefinitelyRevisit
sample_reviews_th.author: Nijaya I

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's not on the main road, it's a bit of a hidden gem. It's a small shop in a single shophouse unit, serving Chinese fusion cuisine. The owner, apparently, is the chef and does all the cooking himself.

The "Aroma Duck" (I wanted to order roasted duck or Peking duck but they were sold out, so I got this instead) was surprisingly delicious!
The steamed pancakes were served warm and were amazing – chewier and softer than some some fancy Chinese restaurants. The fried duck was crispy, and the dipping sauce was different from Peking duck; it was a rich, sweet and sour flavor that wasn't cloying.

The "Soul-Slaying Rice" (Hong Kong-style char siu pork) was tender, well-marinated, fragrant, and delicious – meeting the standard (of places like churros, grilled pork, or Roastman).

The prices weren't exorbitant. It was a good portion for one person. I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: WingZero 00W0

sample_reviews_en.text: A friend recommended this restaurant. If they hadn't, I probably wouldn't have tried it, because the name makes it hard to guess what they sell. I thought it was just a typical Thai street food place, even though I work in the area. So this is the first time I've tried it! I tried the crispy-skinned roast duck rice, the char siu pork rice, and the stir-fried green beans with minced pork. Every dish was delicious! The flavors blended perfectly. The olive juice was also surprisingly good, like guava and plum juice – a unique and interesting drink. In short, I loved it! I'll be back to try other dishes next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wannakorn Sri

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really really good place. The roasted duck is probably the best duck I had in Bangkok, maybe even ever. Also the Malaysian olive drink is amazing and super unique, I never really found anything like it anywhere else.

For me I would come back just for the duck + that drink. If I’m more hungry then fried rice or the beef bowl too, both are really good.

The place looks very simple and usually doesn’t have many people inside, which is crazy because the food is actually very special. Definitely recommend trying it.

So far I’ve already eaten here 5 times and I’m definitely going to come back many more times.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hubert Smółka

sample_reviews_en.text: Wow, this place absolutely blew my socks off. Had the best roast duck I’ve ever had, the crispy skin sensational. Also ordered loads of other dishes too. The dumplings, fried rice and cucumber salad were all outstanding too. Lovely smaller restaurant with great service and can see the chefs working their magic in the kitchen too. Amazing place to eat if in the area!
sample_reviews_en.author: Aaron Webb

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I tried the Char Siu Rice and loved it so much! It felt like I was eating in Hong Kong. The sauce and chili paste were perfect.

I'll try the duck dish next time.
Honestly, I work in this area and only recently discovered this hidden gem.
It's like eating at a fine dining restaurant, but at a much more affordable price. I highly recommend trying it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Methus Boonsri Pond

sample_reviews_en.text: Craved peking duck so I looked for places in Ban That Thong area. Found this place on Google Maps and ate there twice during my 1-month stay in Bangkok! Would recommend the special roasted duck set that also comes with sambal cabbage and nasi goreng rice. The char siu rice bowl is also good. Top off your meal with the ambarella fruit juice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ysabel Ortiz

restaurants.name: Maison Au Milieu - เมซง โอ มิลลิเยอร์
restaurants.address:

Maison Au Milieu, 799 ซ. ลาดพร้าว 48 แยก 22 Samsen Nok, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This hidden gem in Ladprao 48 serves delicious food with rich and flavorful dishes.
- The spaghetti with bacon and dried chili has a generous amount of bacon – so satisfying!
- The grilled pork chop is perfectly cooked, not dry, and the side dishes are delicious.
- The pizza has a soft crust and you can order a half-and-half option.
- Finally, we ordered Khanom Jeen Nam Ya (rice noodles with curry sauce) to finish off the meal. The flavor is rich, and the restaurant adds some bird's eye chili for those who like it spicy. 😍

Before leaving, we ordered some drinks. I personally love their dark chocolate; it's rich and creamy. We ordered it with less sugar, and it was just right.

Overall, we were very impressed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Supitchaya

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I ate at a restaurant near my house located in Soi Ladprao 48. It's a bit hidden, and the pin on the map isn't quite right, it's about 100 meters from the restaurant. They serve both Western and Thai food. Today I ordered pizza, spaghetti, pork chops, and crab curry noodles. All the food was delicious, and the drinks – tea, coffee, and cocoa – were good too. The prices are reasonable. It's worth supporting. I went at 1:30 pm, so it wasn't crowded, but the restaurant said it gets busy in the evening. There's parking for 5 cars on the premises.
sample_reviews_en.author: KD DDD

sample_reviews_en.text:
This hidden gem is located in Soi Ladprao 48, intersection 8, very close to our house. We've been here many times. If you sit inside, you can even see the roof of our house! 😬🤭😬
The atmosphere is absolutely amazing. There's plenty of parking in front and beside the restaurant. We went with 3 people and ordered a lot, but forgot to take pictures because we just dug in as soon as the food arrived! 🤣🤣🤣
All the staff are cheerful and friendly, and the owner's sister is lovely.
😘😘😘

Most importantly, every dish we ordered was incredibly delicious! 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: ก้อย จ้า

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious, especially the pork chop steak, it was my absolute favorite! For drinks, I ordered a Kyoto cocktail, which was very refreshing. For dessert, the toast with vanilla ice cream and fruit was perfect – not too sweet, and the combination was great. We went for our anniversary dinner with my boyfriend. The atmosphere was lovely, the owner was very attentive, and the staff provided excellent service. The restaurant is cute, the plating is lovely, and the food is delicious. I give it 100/10! I will definitely go back again. 💗💗🥺
sample_reviews_en.author: J Pttp

sample_reviews_en.text: Every time I come, I have to order the crab curry noodles. It's spicy and delicious. Another dish I tried was the beautiful cumin leaves I saw while strolling through the garden. I just had to order it – the Picanha beef stir-fried with cumin leaves. It looked amazing, and it tasted delicious too. The quality is exceptional. Even though it's deep in Soi Ladprao 48, near intersection 23, there's always a steady stream of customers. That's what they call a hidden gem! And to top it all off, I finished with homemade ice cream. Excellent! 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍💕🌸👌
sample_reviews_en.author: Kat Katkamon

sample_reviews_en.text: The portions are large and worth the price. Personally, I'd rate the taste as average. Today I ordered pork stir-fried with kimchi over rice + salad + onsen egg. The mocha was amazing! The milk was good, the coffee was perfect, and the sweetness was just right. I loved it so much! It's a little disappointing that the restaurant doesn't have a dessert menu, but they did have fresh milk tofu pudding that day, so that was great for finishing off. The restaurant is a bit out of the way, but it feels nice and private.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattawat Chinpitakwatana

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a small shop but there's plenty of parking. The food is absolutely delicious, a perfect 10! And it comes out quickly. If you're coming with a large group, I recommend calling to reserve a table because there aren't many seats, but the food is great, the coffee is decent, the prices are reasonable, and importantly, you can support Thai businesses by buying from here!
✨ The staff are also very helpful and the owner is lovely. I'd give this place a 10 out of 10! It's really good, you have to try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Araya Klaewkla

sample_reviews_en.text:
Such a nice hidden spot in the suburbs of Bangkok 🤍

The place is super cozy and comfortable perfect for coming with your laptop to get some work done while enjoying really delicious food. Their Tom Yum pasta is amazing, and the natural coconut ice cream is definitely a must-try!

The staff are incredibly friendly and caring, and I genuinely felt at home here. Such a warm and welcoming atmosphere.

Definitely recommend stopping by, trying their delicious food, and enjoying the vibe✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Viktoriya

restaurants.name: YIAM Restaurant
restaurants.address:

Pattaya Sai Song Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Unfortunately, the restaurant didn't live up to expectations.
1. The mushroom soup was so thick it was as if a packet of starch had been poured into it. In general, it seemed as if they had simply opened a can and heated it up.
2. The famous Hungarian goulash, which is called "bogracs" in Hungary, was spoiled by excess acid.
3. The pizza with mushrooms and ham was far from the same Italian one. Thin, overdried dough. Even in the Chill-in restaurant, similar pizza is much tastier.
The chef was not even satisfactory.
The smoothies were good. Therefore, to the bartender: No complaints.

2. The famous Hungarian goulash, which is called "bogracs" in Hungary, was spoiled by excess acid.
3. The pizza with mushrooms and ham was far from the same Italian one. Thin, overdried dough. Even at the Chill-in restaurant, similar pizza is much tastier.
The chef isn't even satisfactory.
The smoothies were good. So, no complaints about the bartender.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sergei Artemenko (We'll help)

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a simple restaurant, this branch in Soi Nai Bazaar, off Pattaya Second Road, easily accessible on foot or by motorbike. The staff are attentive and the food comes out quickly. This was our first time here and we were impressed with the taste of the food 😋😋👍👍. However, I would like to criticize the Khun Yiam branch in Soi Buakhao, next to Sutus Court. The food tastes inferior to other branches, and the service is terrible. The staff were rude, saying things like "Just give it to them," having a stern expression, and showing a lack of care. It's baffling! Foreign tourists can eat anywhere they want. I recommend staff training; it would greatly improve the situation. The staff member in question, possibly a cashier, stood at the counter all the time, speaking and behaving terribly. 🤣😂 There are many other things I don't want to mention; they spoke loudly, like they were at home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arunwatee Sangphitak

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really enjoyable and very affordable place in Pattaya. We arrived absolutely starving and left feeling like we had eaten enough food for a small village.

We had pineapple fried rice with seafood, Massaman curry, crispy shrimp cakes, two Chang beers and two mango smoothies. The food arrived in under 10 minutes, everything tasted good and the whole feast was only 815 baht for two people.

It’s not a fancy fine-dining restaurant, but that’s not really the point. Good Thai food, generous portions, fast service and great value. A solid 4/5 from us.

We filmed our whole visit too. Search YouTube for

Crazy Swedes Hot and Spice

and the video

YIAM Restaurant Pattaya THIS Is How Much Food We Get for 400 Baht Swe original Eng Dub
sample_reviews_en.author: Crazy Swedes Hot and Spice

sample_reviews_en.text:
Situated on the busy corner of Soi made in Thailand and 2nd road, this little gem of a restaurant hits the mark in terms of quality food along with reasonable prices.

Either dine in or take away and sneak down soi 8 across the road to the beach front to eat.

I've been coming to Pattaya for many years and when staying in the area this restaurant is always my go-to for breakfast, lunch, dinner or a 3am munch - this place is 24hrs!

The ladies who serve customers in this place are friendly, polite and helpful - and love to have a joke with a smile.

If you found this review helpful, please give me a thumbs 👍 up (it's free!) and follow me for more honest reviews 🙂
sample_reviews_en.author: Riccardo Taylor

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered potatoes and specifically told them not to put bacon in it 3 times. The dish came back with bacon. The arrogant waitress took the potatoes back into the kitchen, picked the bacon off and returned the dish. I noticed that there was still some bacon in the dish. I told the waitress and this time she took the plate back into the kitchen and brought it back saying they cooked a new dish. I didn't eat it but was charged for it hence this review. I have never ever  in 10 visits to Thailand experienced such pathetic and rude staff. The manager was not available for comment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ozan Yusuf

sample_reviews_en.text: I had walked past this restaurant several times and it always busy, which to me is a good sign. The waitress who greeted me was polite and court, so was the waiter who took my order. The drink and food arrived promptly. The sweet and sour chicken was tepid. It tasted ok but I like my food served hot. I paid my bill and waited over 10 minutes for my 10 baht change. I was going to tip 20 baht but my change never arrived. I think it is rude to assume I didn’t want my change. I did not tell the waitress to keep it. Better restaurants in the area. I will not return here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Blue Mango

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food here is good,

but if it's busy, you should be patient as it can take a very long time (40 minutes in my case), and if the wrong thing is brought, you're not exactly thrilled.

Otherwise, it's recommended.

Update: Being approached 12 times while eating to buy something isn't very pleasant.

The food is still good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lars Bildat

sample_reviews_en.text: A great cafe. We've been here at least three times because we really liked the food, mostly Thai, and we've never been disappointed. We always ask for it mildly spicy, because if you don't mention it, they'll bring you the usual spicy, and spicy means incredibly spicy. Be careful when ordering! I highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Артём

restaurants.name: Coffee Beans By Dao
restaurants.address:

GF, 06 Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Coffee Beans By Dao (Siam Paragon)
"I've returned several times and have never been disappointed at the Siam Paragon branch. The food here is of premium quality and the taste is consistently excellent.

• Black Pasta with River Prawns: The prawns are large, fresh, and have a sweet, bouncy texture. They pair perfectly with the rich, creamy sauce – not at all cloying.
• Khao Soi Chicken: Authentically Thai and flavorful. All the traditional toppings are included. The noodles are soft and the broth is wonderfully fragrant with coconut milk.
• Snacks: The crispy rice crackers with toppings are delicious and very enjoyable."
sample_reviews_en.author: Jim635

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited Coffee Bean by Dao Comfort Restaurant, and it turned out to be a truly cozy and satisfying experience. The place is perfect whether you come alone for some quiet time or with family for a relaxed meal together.
The menu is simple, but every dish we tried was comforting and full of flavor. What made the visit even more special was getting to explore their childhood-style desserts—they brought a sense of nostalgia and joy that made the experience feel warm and memorable.
Overall, it’s a lovely spot to unwind, enjoy good food, and create happy moments. I’d definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: prow vechasit

sample_reviews_en.text: At this Paragon branch, some of the staff simply didn't seem in the mood to work. Even though they tried to hide their emotions while talking, their eyes told you so. One staff member kicked a table when I offered them one, and when collecting payment, they just slammed the scanner down, threw it around, and walked away. They didn't even give a receipt or a thank you. There are so many unprofessional staff members. They should look at the standards at the Iberry branch; their standards are much higher. We weren't eating for free, by the way. Thank you very much. 🙏🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: Happy TOMMY

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried Coffee Bean by Dao last month and absolutely loved it! The vibe is super cozy and great for catching up with friends.

The food is lovely — classic Thai flavors with a fun modern twist. Everything tasted fresh and full of flavor, but my favorite part of the meal was definitely their calamansi soda drink. It’s so refreshing — tangy, fizzy, and perfectly balanced. Honestly, it’s one of the best drinks I’ve had in a long time!

The whole experience just felt easy and enjoyable. Highly recommend this place if you love Thai food with a twist!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jagamo

sample_reviews_en.text: With other food we have ordered, we ordered a cold latte with oat milk. When found out it’s sweet, we communicated about it. We were told that it’s by default sweet and we need to communicate beforehand if we don’t want it sweet. When asked if we can still switch to non-sweet, just told us we need to order one more non sweet one, and need to stick with the drink that’s already given to us.
