The attitude was very poor and disrespectful. Won’t ever visit again
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason Chang

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been a customer since their Sukhumvit 39 branch and I love their cakes, but today I was very disappointed with the service. I went in to buy a cake to take home and stood waiting, trying to call out to the staff, but no one paid attention. Some staff members just stood there, making eye contact and then looking away without asking anything. They walked to the cashier and just kept their heads down playing on their phones.
sample_reviews_en.author: Y M

sample_reviews_en.text: It's been a long time since my last visit. Everything looks the same; the restaurant is in the same location. The food is okay, maintaining its high standard. The staff are friendly and provide good service, but the prices are a bit steep. It's a nice place to relax and enjoy the view, with a decent mall atmosphere. I would recommend the crepe cake; it's still their signature dish, unchanged.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nat Ketumarn

sample_reviews_en.text: Authentic Thai food. Variety of options. Some dishes can be customized. Offer some international dishes like pasta, sandwiches, pizza and burgers. Some international dishes are Thai infused. Heat can also be adjusted. Recommend: green mango salad, tom yom, papaya salad, green curry salad and durian sticky rice. Suitable for groups.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sure Mi

restaurants.name: Am Huong
restaurants.address:

314/316 ซอยเอกชัย62 ถนนเอกชัย แขวงบางบอน Bang Bon, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
On July 27, 1967, I visited branch 1, Ekachai 62. I won't comment on the taste as it's a matter of personal preference, but I will comment on points that make me not recommend this restaurant:

(1) Most of the food was not hot; almost everything was very lukewarm.
(2) The bill didn't match the menu prices. There was no prior notification that the prices had increased. When I inquired, they said the old prices hadn't been updated yet. This is unbelievable; if they were being honest, they should have informed me or written the new prices in the menu beforehand.
(3) The staff were unwilling to serve. I ordered Vietnamese noodle soup and should have had a separate bowl to share it with. I understand they might have forgotten, but when I asked for a spoon, they didn't bring one. I'm confused as to why they couldn't think of that.
(4) Food portions were small.
(5) The cleanliness of the restaurant was poor. I found two large, unidentified insects on the wall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pruetthi Bunjongkalkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Some of the food wasn't hot. There was a hair in the steamed rice crackers and in the side dish of the Vietnamese grilled pork sausage. I informed the staff, who then told the owner. They resolved the issue by removing the hair and bringing back the original dish. A plate of steamed rice crackers had three pieces; I found a hair in one of the last pieces, so they remade two pieces for me.

The dipping sauce for the Vietnamese grilled pork sausage wasn't to my liking; it lacked flavor. This might be because the side dishes—mango, cucumber, and banana—were not sliced ​​finely like I'm used to elsewhere. They were sliced ​​thinly, so they lacked the sourness and crispness. The pork was also cold.

They accept the government's co-payment scheme. The restaurant has air conditioning and a modern, stylish decor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teerarat R

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food came out quickly, which was great. We tried everything on our first visit and were very impressed.

This is another one of my favorite Vietnamese restaurants 🥬✨
Fresh vegetables, generous portions, and a mild flavor suitable for all ages.
The Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage) was amazing, and the Vietnamese noodle soup was incredibly fragrant and delicious 🤤🍜
Eating here felt like a mini-Vietnam experience 💚

#AmHuong #VietnameseFood #NemNuong #VietnameseNoodleSoup #VietnamesePizza #DeliciousRestaurantBangBon #RecommendedFood #Foodie #VietnameseRestaurant #FoodReview #RestaurantReview #BangkokFood #ThaiFood #TikTokFoodReview #BangkokFood
sample_reviews_en.author: Singto Dao

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten here many times. Their pho is delicious and has a truly unique Vietnamese flavor. I've tried other pho restaurants where the broth was like a kway chap, which was a real disappointment.
All the food here is delicious. The sago with cantaloupe is the best. Even the iced coffee is tasty. The staff are lovely and provide excellent service. I give it 10/10/10.

I’ve been eating here almost every weekend. Their Pho is the best comparing to any other Pho I’ve tried before. They also have many dishes on the menu you can choose, big portions and reasonably priced! ❤️❤️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: nutthamart nudsombat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Warning for vegetarians:
I ordered two bowls of "Pork Pho," and after eating it, I could strongly smell beef.
I asked if they gave me the wrong bowls, as I ordered pork pho.
The staff said that if you order pork pho, it will have pork broth.
But a moment later, another staff member said that the pho was pork but the broth was a mix of pork and beef, with a grumpy expression and no apology.
My family ordered pork because we don't eat beef.
They charged me the full amount for the inedible pho.
Other dishes were okay, as per the bill.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phat Hong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is a small, two-shophouse unit with air conditioning, but there were a few flies.😅
The food tasted good; every dish was delicious. The side vegetables were fresh and plentiful, and you could ask for refills.
The drip coffee was fragrant, delicious, and strong.
The service was good and fast.
The prices were reasonable.
There's parking for about two cars on the street in front of the shop. Do not park in the white/red zone. If it's full, you can park at the gas station next door.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pretty Sudanee

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old Vietnamese restaurant in the Bang Bon area. Whenever I'm in the area, I always stop by because I miss the consistently delicious taste. The fresh vegetables are great, the prices are reasonable, the food comes out quickly, and the service is efficient. You can park at the nearby Bangchak gas station. I recommend the grilled pork with betel leaves and the Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage).
sample_reviews_en.author: Suwandee Chaiwarut

sample_reviews_en.text:
I waited about 20 minutes for the Nem Nuong to cook, which is quite long.

The restaurant provided the rice paper wrappers beforehand, but now they seem to have been dipped in water, making them dry and hard because of the long wait for the pork.

Normally, other restaurants provide raw rice paper wrappers.

As for the side dishes, it seems they're giving much less now, such as unripe bananas and cucumbers.
sample_reviews_en.author: A cha

restaurants.name: เจ๊หมวยข้าวผัดปู
restaurants.address:

10 Ratchaphruek Rd, Bang Ramat, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old restaurant in this area, probably existing even before The Circle opened, because I've been eating here since my school days.
It's a roadside eatery, easy to eat at, food is prepared quickly, and the prices are inexpensive.
The taste is good. If you want something simple, quick, and filling before heading home, I recommend it. They have a variety of menus, including fish ball noodles, à la carte dishes, dumplings, and steamed buns.
I've dined here since I was in high school. They have operated here for more than 20 years, I assume. It's perfect for those looking for a quick, easy, and delicious meal before going home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Parisara Chancharoen

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and reasonably priced, with a nice roadside atmosphere under shady trees. The restaurant offers a variety of dishes. Today I had crab fried rice, stir-fried chicken noodles, and dumplings. They were all good, but I liked the stir-fried chicken noodles the most; it had a wonderful wok aroma. They also have items for takeout like traditional Thai sweets and zongzi (rice dumplings). Parking is convenient along the roadside.
sample_reviews_en.author: sara boon

sample_reviews_en.text: 1. I ordered a special Tom Yum Yen Ta Fo with wontons, but received regular Tom Yum noodles. 2. I ordered a special Tom Yum Yen Ta Fo, but received regular Yen Ta Fo. Improvements are needed, both from the person taking the orders and the person preparing the food. If unsure, they should have double-checked instead of just making the order haphazardly. It was very disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: PATCHARIN

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is located on Ratchaphruek Road, opposite The Circle Ratchaphruek. Parking is available on the side of the road. This home-style restaurant serves delicious made-to-order dishes. We recommend the steamed dumplings and the rice topped with morning glory and crispy pork. The prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rose

sample_reviews_en.text: The tom yum noodle soup with fish balls is delicious. The à la carte dishes are tasty. The steamed buns with minced pork and barbecued pork are not dry or hard, the filling is flavorful, and the prices are reasonable. I eat here regularly and always stop by whenever I'm in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: กฤษฎาพร ศรีพันธุ์พิพัฒน์

sample_reviews_en.text: Parking is available along the entire street. It's like a roadside food stall/restaurant that's open all day. They have a diverse menu, the prices are affordable, and it's a reliable place – you won't starve if you have this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tahn Chai-a-ya

sample_reviews_en.text:
The crab fried rice was good and dry.
The stir-fried water spinach was delicious (70 baht per plate).
The steamed buns and dumplings were tasty.
The coconut jelly wasn't very good.
Parking is available on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: NS SV

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a made-to-order restaurant with a wide variety of dishes to choose from.
The food tastes delicious.
The prices are reasonable.
The restaurant is located by the roadside and is easy to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanan Tassananchalee

restaurants.name: La Mémoire
restaurants.address:

Bang Wa, Phasi Charoen, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a small but very cozy cafe. It's surrounded by trees and beautifully decorated. There's outdoor seating where you can relax and enjoy your coffee. The indoor area is well-divided into zones, with limited seating but very inviting. The drinks are flavorful and worth the price. We tried the orange coffee and hot chocolate, and they were even better than expected – definitely worth the money! There's also convenient parking. What impressed us most was the owner's friendliness. They were very attentive, helpful, and even recommended promotions and discounts. Anyone who visits during a promotion is very lucky! We'll definitely stop by again to try other menu items.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nannz Society

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stopped by in the afternoon. The cafe has a relaxing atmosphere with trees and a fish pond. There are many cozy corners to sit and enjoy your coffee, and soft music plays in the background. It's very comfortable.

Today I ordered coffee and a plate of fried chicken wings. They tasted good.

Overall, it's a cafe with a great atmosphere, perfect for relaxing in the afternoon. If you like quiet, shady cafes, I recommend checking it out. ☕🌿
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuch Tham

sample_reviews_en.text:
Small coffee shop in local area. Green setting. Not crowded so you can quietly work or enjoy your reading. There are some cake varieties plus simple snacks and meals. There is also a massage house in the same area which I have not tried but looks good from outside.

Just one point, their choco banana drink didn't use a real banana but a syrup which didn't taste or smell like banana. I have to try other drinks next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Meena Kom

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good point
1. One of heaven for smoking people.
2. A lot of Green.
3. Alway Open until 6 pm. even Covid-19 period.
4. Not much customers.

Adventure point
1. 90 baht for mix berry frappe. Start from 95 baht for piece of cake.
2. Need car or bike taxi it far from Bangkhea MRT station
3. Because of Covid-19 only available garden area .
4. Prepare mosquito spray.

Ps. Good speed Wi-Fi
sample_reviews_en.author: Emorn Trade Story

sample_reviews_en.text: The cafe is in a garden with many trees, providing shade and a pleasant atmosphere. The service is good, the coffee is decent but beautifully presented, and the pastries are delicious. Parking is convenient, and they accept the government's co-payment scheme. There is also a COVID-19 screening point as required by the government.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamonrat Subprasert

sample_reviews_en.text: For anyone looking for a quiet cafe to unwind and relax on their day off, I highly recommend this place. The atmosphere is great, very natural, cool and comfortable. There are many seating options to choose from, and the parking lot is very spacious. The prices are reasonable, and there are several seating areas to select from.
sample_reviews_en.author: ICECREAM CREAM

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is great, and it's not far from the BTS (Skytrain).
They have both drinks and food, and the prices are reasonable.
However, I'm only giving it a 4 because the coffee wasn't very good.
It was made with light-roasted beans, and the milk wasn't very aromatic.
It tasted quite sour when brewed...
sample_reviews_en.author: Warawut Songserm

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop has a nice atmosphere, is peaceful, shady, and cool. They play good music, and are a great place to sit and read a book. They have good tea and coffee, snacks, and clean water. The air-conditioned room is also nicely decorated, and the outdoor area is natural and not hot. It's wonderful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ekalak Sahaphongse

restaurants.name: The Bull
restaurants.address:

313, 270 Pattaya 3rd Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Not sure who she is—but the server/co-owner a ladyboy ,had such a bad attitude from the time we arrived.All the Thai wives were offended and left and even went to eat elsewhere.

The western owner /boyfriend not sure who he actually was—asked me what was wrong—he said they never said they had Thai food—i agreed i was wrong,I told him the ladies were upset with the Ladyboy”s attitude,and not about the food as they knew we were going to a steak place.

The friend’s rump was good,but my sirloin/strip-loin was grisly and had sinew and although it was a buffet ,i opted out after the first one.

Cannot have a bad attitude when running a resturant in Pattaya—too many others to choose from.

The western guy just popped in spoke to me and left again—no apologies about his staff/ co-owner.

It’s as if they were doing us a favor to serve us.
Very poor—we wont be back  🤦‍♂️🤦‍♂️
sample_reviews_en.author: Greg Sheard

sample_reviews_en.text:
We (2) went there today for their "all you can eat" steak promo. It included a "cold cuts and cheese" platter mini buffet, which was great. The welcoming was warm and personal. Service throughout was very attentive and the food was great.
We choose the waguy rump steak.
Well cooked and seasoned, served with veggies and a variety of sauces to choose from. My gf had a chocolate fondant dessert and I took an espresso with Amaretto on ice. All good.
It wasn't very busy, but very pleasant. Easy access and parking too.
Certainly coming back.
Owner and service staff were very polite and attentive. Paid THB 2,500 (or so).
Definitely worth it
It was an "all you can eat" promo, but 1 plate each was more than enough!
See you next time!
sample_reviews_en.author: Cees Cuijpers

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Bull certainly has some of the best steaks in Pattaya.  Had dinner there last night and can’t remember ever having a better steak than the 250g  tenderloin (approx 2000 baht) Pic below, it’s incredible.

Steaks come with 1 side and 1 sauce, and extra sides very reasonable (80-120 baht) if you want to adds. I had the truffle mash potatoes and cauliflower gratin. Almost didn’t post a review because this place is quaint, and doesn’t have many seats inside (maybe 20) and keep the secret for myself.  But it’s so good and restaurant is so worthy hope this review helps them even more.

Oh also brought takeaway spaghetti meatballs home for the next day (280 baht) and the portion big and very high quality sauce and meatballs. .
sample_reviews_en.author: Happy Man

sample_reviews_en.text: A  Wagyu steak came swimming in some kind of oil. When I asked the owner he told he said it was infused seed oil. Never have I seen this done to expensive steak in all of the world. I have modified my review because of owners response, as I may have been too harsh initially with my state of discomfort. I have had good steaks in cheese or in butter, but never seed oil. It seems like an insult to an A5 steak.  I opened with a question because i honestly didn't know what the oil was, i was not just "looking to complain". My companion's meat looked excellent, with no apparent extra oil. The tiara misu was excellent. Full disclosure:  I cannot digest seed oils and just never ask because I have never encountered this before.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Chiara

sample_reviews_en.text: Took my wife to The Bull laat night. Funny thing was I took her there for the steak and she got ribs. I decided to get lasagna since I hadn't had any in years. Had the black platter mixed appetizer. Appetizer platter was very good, Ribs were falling off the bone and delicious. Lasagna tasted great but looked not the best and was mushy. Guy sitting at table next to us commented his wagyu steak was the best he had ever had. Have to go back now to try it. Had regular flow of customers, a bit small and they were still putting patio tables together while we were there at 7pm Overall though, a pretty good meal. Definitely not for people wanting to save a baht price wise but good value for what you get.
sample_reviews_en.author: Clark Elder

sample_reviews_en.text:
So disappointed with this place. After seeing the tik tok videos my wife and I were excited to try the Bull. When we arrived there was no one in the restaurant but three lady employees sitting around the tables , we were not greeted and did not feel very welcomed. After looking at the menu I noticed the prices were not the same as online. When I enquired about the difference one of the ladies became aggressive and rude and told me it was six years old. The attitude I received was unacceptable so my wife and I left , will never be back.

They way you responded to my complaint proves my point , terrible customer service. Your version is not what happened maybe you should get your ears checked.
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert Hamblin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went there on a Sunday for the AYCE promotion. Didn’t really expect much due to the inexpensive price. First steaks we ordered medium rare steak and it ended up more well cooked. I ordered one more round and requested more rare. I guess the waiter only heard rare as it was served 20% cooked. Another patron had the same issue and he mentioned that the cook was Thai. Maybe less experienced in cooking steak maybe?

As I began talking more to the other patron also noticed the meat used was not that great hence the inexpensive price. He did state that other nights he goes there the dining quality is much better.

Not too much of a crowd for a Sunday.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tommy Fong

sample_reviews_en.text: First time for me eating at the Bull Restaurant, and I choose a Sunday when they run their all-you-can-eat steak buffet meal, which gave you a choice of Striploin or Wagu Ribeye, sides and a charcuterie and cheese selection. Most impressed. Excellent, well presented, food. Attentive staff. In particular, I thought the variety and quantity of the charcuterie and cheese selection was outstanding. I could have happily just had that, but it does go without saying that the steaks were cooked to my own personal choice and were flavourful. I also couldn’t get enough of their roast potato sides. The Nam Jim Jaew sauce was also top notch. Recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Graham Cotton

restaurants.name: Hunger Pangs
restaurants.address:

312 70 Soi Lengkee, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited Hunger Pangs and had their signature burger — and wow, it did not disappoint.

The quality of the imported beef was amazing, it was juicy, flavourful, and cooked perfectly, paired with melted cheese and all the toppings.

Overall it’s one of the best burgers I’ve had. I’d happily come back again and try more from the menu. Highly recommend if you’re craving a proper, high-quality burger.

If you’re craving a great quality smash burger with fries and a milkshake in a nice cool AC restaurant, then this is your place!
sample_reviews_en.author: katrina edwards

sample_reviews_en.text: The signature burger tasted absolutely excellent. The meat and bacon were delicious and juicy. The fries with fish were delivered from outside and must therefore have been prepared elsewhere. The fries were overbaked, too hard, and didn't taste good. It would also be desirable to have a selection of delicious homemade sauces on the table instead of these cheap versions of ketchup, etc. The waitress didn't say a single word to me or my girlfriend but prepared the burger well 555
sample_reviews_en.author: Turtle

sample_reviews_en.text:
So good!

100% homemade burgers. Not pretentious. It's just really, really good!

Proper burgers here!

I got the blue cheese burger and that was fantastic

Other burger places nearby will either be out of the freezer,or one of those really tall ones just full of salad and sauce

This was all about the burgers onions and blue cheese

I rarely care about food but they deserve business!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicholas Barrett

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, it's a decent burger place. What makes 4 stars is i think the burger bun 🍔 needs improvement for a restaurant that specializes in burgers. It's not toasted, and it felt like a bun you buy from a grocery store. If they have a brioche option to elevate their burgers, then I think it will improve the overall enjoyment of a burger.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thaigerr86

sample_reviews_en.text: Just had panang curry, really enjoyed it. Also green curry very nice too. The staff are really friendly too. I have tried all the burgers too & they are awesome. Must say the lady that served does speak good English too, & very nice with a lovely smile.will definitely be going back over the next 6 weeks 🙏🙏🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Brian Walker

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a very satisfying meal. I ordered the signature burger, triple cheeseburger, milkshake, and bacon cheese fries. The only thing I wish was that the cheese was a little more melted... It was a bit disappointing that the cheese wasn't completely melted. But it was still delicious. 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: 이혜진

sample_reviews_en.text:
Some of the best food, atmosphere, and prices in the area.
The people here were very kind and friendly, and made me feel welcome everyday. Which is good, because all my meals here were so delicious, it makes you want to come here for breakfast, lunch,  dinner, and their milkshakes.
sample_reviews_en.author: pablo picante

sample_reviews_en.text: The burgers are straight-up fantastic—big, juicy, and packed with flavor. Those chips? Absolutely crispy and perfectly seasoned. The staff were awesome, super chill, and made the whole vibe great. Plus, the service was lightning fast, so I was eating in no time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adam Bews

restaurants.name: The Waterside at Chesadabodin 2025
restaurants.address:

199 Soi Nonthaburi 1, Tambon Suan Yai, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It was a rainy day so we had to settle for a table inside. The service was everywhere and nowhere at the same time. The restaurant is very disorganized, there are things everywhere. Everytime the bar worked with the blender, the noise was very loud. The kitchen was very slow. Not sure how they would handle it during a normal day. Food was not as per review, bland, lacks flavors, boring. I'm kind of disappointed considering the review are good and the overall rate is 4.5. They must have had a bad day...
sample_reviews_en.author: Nadim Xavier Salhani

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a lovely atmosphere by the Chao Phraya River. The view is beautiful in the evening, and at night the lights from the Chetsadabodin Bridge reflect on the water's surface, making it a pleasure to watch. The food is delicious, and the portions are generous. The staff provides good and attentive service, although during busy periods, their attention might be slightly limited, which is understandable. It's definitely one of my favorite restaurants that I'll be returning to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patcharin Pulgasam

sample_reviews_en.text: My first visit was amazing! I really just wanted a riverside restaurant with a nice atmosphere to take my wife for Valentine's Day dinner, but the food was incredibly delicious. The prawns were huge – I highly recommend them! The "stir-fried pork belly with chili and salt" was the best – the jasmine rice was so smooth and delicious. And the staff were especially great, particularly the slim and beautiful LGBTQ staff member who provided excellent service. I'll definitely be back! ❤️👍🏻🦞🦀🥘🍲🍚
sample_reviews_en.author: Wisit Supprat

sample_reviews_en.text: A brilliant place to eat with an extensive menu, great food, a brilliant location and most importantly a team who deliver the best service ever. Just be careful of how you interpret your satnav because if you approach from the west side of the river you can touch the restaurant as you cross over the bridge but you have a nightmare of U-Turns to navigate to get back to where you need to be. The price is very reasonable too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nick Gilbody

sample_reviews_en.text: I went for lunch with 20 friends. The staff were very attentive and lovely. The food was delicious, and there was karaoke, which was a lot of fun. We sang for 3 hours! The musicians really helped make the experience enjoyable. The restaurant has both indoor and outdoor seating by the Chao Phraya River. Next time, I'll have to try the outdoor seating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunetnit Soontarotayarn

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating here since they first opened, and the food was always good until my last visit. Did they change chefs? The portions seemed smaller too. My family and I decided we probably won't go again. There are plenty of other restaurants with great views. They haven't been able to maintain the same quality since they opened just a few years ago.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anuchit Saejung

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was good. I went to eat on Mother's Day. There were a lot of people and the tables were full. The service wasn't very thorough, but they were sincere. The food was delicious, but it came out a bit slow (maybe because there were a lot of people, which is understandable). Overall, it was good. I liked it and would like to go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chompoonuch Hemtanon

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant boasts a lovely atmosphere by the Chao Phraya River. The evening breeze is cool and refreshing, and you can enjoy the beautiful view of the lights lining the Chetsadabodin Bridge. The food is delicious, every dish is excellent.
There's also soft folk music playing in the background, making for a pleasant dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: SAKKHEE SANSUPA

restaurants.name: Sathon 11 Art Space
restaurants.address:

404 ซอย สาทร 11 Thung Wat Don, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It looks like a very attractive place, but in reality, the staff doesn't even write down your order, brings extra food, and adds the extra to the check. The ribs were so dry you couldn't even tear off a piece. I don't recommend the kitchen either. They have billiards, a plus for me, but not worth it. EVERYTHING TAKES A LONG TIME.
——-
It looks like a very attractive place, but in reality, the staff doesn't even write down your order, brings extra food and attributes the extra to the check. The ribs were so dry you couldn't even tear off a piece. I don't recommend the kitchen either. Billiards is here, a plus for me, but not worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Максим Цой

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very nice place and different than other restaurants. Honestly, the Buffalo Chicken Wings were the best wings I ever ate in my life! No lie! Absolutely amazing. Other food also great!
Cocktails were very good! Not all bars/restaurants in BKK serve good cocktails, but these were just great! And again, I was amazed by the Tom Ka cocktail. It actually tasted like Tom Ka soup! What an amazing experience to drink this cocktail!
Recommend the Buffalo wings and the Tom Ka Cocktail. Visit this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: S. C.

sample_reviews_en.text: I was very tight on budget and they tried to rip me off with one price on the menu and the other at check out, luckily they caved quickly 😅  On the plus side, they had a gender neutral bathroom and some small photo exhibition on the walls. However, the gallery part is clearly an afterthought, the place is mostly just a pub …
sample_reviews_en.author: Eu

sample_reviews_en.text: It happened to be near my house, so I decided to go. It's quite secluded. The beer in this photo was delicious. It has a great atmosphere and serves delicious drinks, so it looks like it's going to become one of my favorite places. It also seems like we have similar tastes in music. I'll definitely visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: 雨露市徳雄

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was delicious, but the waiter said he forgot everything and ended up bringing too much, and too expensive.

Keep an eye on what they bring you.

It was delicious, but the waiter said he forgot everything and ended up bringing too much, and too expensive.

Keep an eye on what they bring you.
sample_reviews_en.author: COFE MOVER

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place was a great little find.
Really cool atmosphere and vibe. Some amazing art on the walls.
Great Food and Drinks menu.
The staff are amazing. The hospitality was exceptional. They went out of their way to accommodate us and make us feel welcome.
And the owner Mike is a cool cat.
sample_reviews_en.author: James Suttie

sample_reviews_en.text:
Love the vibes of this place!!
Great food and great drink prices!

The owner is awesome and staff super helpful!

I did an event for expats and we all had an amazing time!! Love it!! 💕💕💕

Highly recommended to go here for a great night out of eats & drinks!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Follow Fauzia

sample_reviews_en.text: A pool hall with events. A meeting place for expats. Pool area, smoking, and no air conditioning, separate from the bar (which is air-conditioned). Original decor, but the artwork isn't very interesting; don't come for the art, but for the atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ulrike

restaurants.name: ขนมปังนมสด ก้อย&เอส
restaurants.address:

87 Thanon Tanao, Talat Yot, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍨 Sweet tooth hotspot on Khao San Road! 🍧

Every time I'm in Bangkok, I have to stop by this shop.
Deliciously sweet and generous portions. The owner is cheerful and the owner is lovely.

- The whipped cream here is incredibly satisfying. If you're not careful, it'll fall off! 50 THB
- Cold crepe. You can't even see the crepe because the whipped cream covers it!
40 THB
- Iced milk 35 THB
- Peach soda 35 THB
- Toasted bread with butter and condensed milk (lots of condensed milk!) 15 THB

If you're passing through Khao San Road, you can definitely stop by.
The shop is closed on Wednesdays and Sundays.
Open 6:30 PM - 11:00 PM

Long Gone
sample_reviews_en.author: sulawan utaphao

sample_reviews_en.text: I opened Zoom from Google Maps. It wasn't far from Krua Baworn restaurant, so I walked over to try it. At first, I only planned to order the toast, but I ended up ordering three things! Everything was delicious, especially the whipped cream – it wasn't too sweet, and the bread was perfectly soft. What surprised me most was the breadcrumbs sprinkled on the iced bread; they were amazing – not too dry at all. I'll definitely be back next time. Also, the owner was very friendly and talkative; I couldn't keep up with the conversation! 🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: SOMCHAI SOMPHIW

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a bit of a wait, but the service is excellent and attentive. It's worth the wait. The food and drinks are delicious and exactly what you order. The owners are friendly and always willing to wait even when there's a long queue. It's a small shop tucked away in an alley, but it's very popular. It's a hidden gem that not many people know about, but you have to try it at least once. Their signature activity is finishing your drink as soon as it's blended – a unique and interesting dining experience! Definitely worth trying! 🥰😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Alongkorn Thongsai

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is in a small alley with about 6 tables that can seat about 15-17 people. Usually, if there are a lot of people, the wait is very long. I once waited for 2 hours because it was very crowded. Overall, the desserts are delicious. I like the whipped cream that is very delicious and given a lot. As for the drinks, my favorite is the Bulgianchi, a blue-green drink. If you drive, you can park at Soi Trok Barrangsi, which is a parking lot. It costs 20 baht per hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: bweis

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! The menu is diverse, the prices are reasonable, and the service was excellent. The restaurant is very easy to find, just a little past Khao San Road. Koy and Es are very friendly. The whipped cream was exactly as pictured; we couldn't finish it all because they give us so much! We ordered all of this for two people, but it's really more suitable for 4-5 people. The whipped cream platter is the best – so satisfying! OMG, it was amazing! ✨✨️
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanipat Thongsom

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, affordable, and generous with portions... If you're in Khao San Road and don't check this place out, you'll regret it!
*The male owner has a tough, loud style (probably because he once had a lot of drunk foreigners causing trouble). If it's your first time, don't be surprised... you'll get used to it! 555
**The shop is in a small alley, so there's no parking for cars. Motorcycles can park along the sidewalk.
sample_reviews_en.author: อภิชัย อําคา

sample_reviews_en.text: This toast, iced bread, and sweet drink shop on Khao San Road is amazing! I ordered a blended cocoa and it exceeded my expectations – not too sweet, just perfect! The honey toast was huge with tons of whipped cream. The prices are affordable for everyone. The owners are both incredibly lovely, polite, and provide excellent service. They're fun to talk to! I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: รัชตะวัน ป้องกก

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm so impressed!
This shop is adorable. At first, I just walked past it tucked away in an alley and didn't think much of it, but wow, it's packed!
They have a huge menu, the whipped cream is thick and delicious. The owners are lovely, they called my name loudly and chatted with me. I'll definitely come back again.
And the customers here are all very good-looking!
sample_reviews_en.author: nicha atom

restaurants.name: Welovewine Restaurant
restaurants.address:

2 Ngamwongwarn 25 Alley, Tambon Bang Khen, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Terrible experience. I called to make a reservation for an adult's birthday celebration. The person who answered said they would find a nice table in front of the wine room. When I arrived, there was a company party going on, making a lot of noise, and the table I reserved wasn't available. No one knew what was going on when I asked. However, the staff tried to resolve the issue by moving me to a private room. The person who handled the situation for the adult was very good at it, I commend them for that.
But I was very disappointed. The person who answered should have informed me about the company party.
sample_reviews_en.author: P pop

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is absolutely delicious! There's chill music, a great selection of beers (you can even sample the draft beer before ordering!), and we always order:

Our go-to dishes are:
Tam Luang Prabang (spicy papaya salad),
Yam Woon Sen Boran (traditional glass noodle salad),
Tonkatsu (pork cutlet), and
Pad Krapow Gai (chicken basil stir-fry).

This has become our family's regular restaurant. The staff are all lovely too! 100/10!
sample_reviews_en.author: suvaporn phasuk

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is way too expensive, extremely overpriced, and the taste is terrible. I ordered glass noodle salad with minced pork, and the pork wasn't fresh; it smelled like it was about to rot. It was awful. The service was also poor; the staff seemed confused. I definitely won't be coming back. And the live music wasn't performed by the usual female singer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yimyam

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the atmosphere is great, especially if you're celebrating a birthday. The restaurant provides complimentary desserts and allows you to take photos that can be printed and framed beautifully. Celebrating a birthday with friends here was a truly memorable experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Deenee K.

sample_reviews_en.text: Last week, I went to the restaurant with two friends. The craft beer was delicious, and the food was excellent. However, one thing that needs improvement is the staff member with long, chubby hair; she had very strong bad breath that left a bitter aftertaste. Please address this issue.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jib Saisamorn

sample_reviews_en.text: Award-winning beer, delicious food including glass noodle salad and German pork knuckle. It's a large restaurant with Japanese food as well. It gets crowded, so reservations are recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rose

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the service is excellent! I come here for my birthday with friends every year and it's never disappointing. We even got a commemorative photo as a gift!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanatorn Yodthong

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes great, the service is good, and the atmosphere is comfortable, spacious, and airy. You can really relax here for hours. It's especially great for large groups.
sample_reviews_en.author: Realbbaifern

restaurants.name: จ่มดู๋
restaurants.address:

Soi Lat Phrao 80 Yaek 22, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located in Soi Ladprao 80. This soi has several branches. This is the main branch with plenty of parking. The lighting is a bit dim at night. There's a good amount of seating. The atmosphere is good for drinks and watching football. They sell Northeastern Thai food, but also have some Thai dishes. The prices are high, around 100 baht and up per dish, but the food is delicious. The papaya salad is great, the hot pot is great, and the grilled fatty beef is delicious. There are quite a few Chinese customers. Some tables can be very noisy. There are mosquitoes late at night. The staff aren't very attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffey

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but the wait was incredibly long. I ordered four dishes and waited two hours for only three! 😂 There were many staff members, but they didn't seem very attentive to customers. The wait was so long, anyone who's very hungry might get frustrated. I recommend being extremely patient! 🥹🥹 The fourth dish still hasn't arrived.
sample_reviews_en.author: boonyisa thitichailaikorn

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, the restaurant is large, breezy and chill, perfect for hanging out with friends or for those who love hot pot and Northeastern Thai food, especially the really good ones. I also like the wide variety of delicious broths to choose from. The prices are moderate and friendly, and there's plenty of parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: ฮอนด้า ไฮเทค

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was quite salty, and the service was terrible. The staff were just sitting around playing on their phones, ignoring new customers and only taking care of existing ones. Never going back. This is in stark contrast to Mai Thiang restaurant in Mengjai, which offers excellent service to both new and returning customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: อลิษา นุชพัด

sample_reviews_en.text:
Highly recommended! I've eaten here many times and it's always delicious.
The food was so good I didn't even have time to take pictures! But my recommended dishes are the "Koi Kua Moo Suk" (similar to minced pork salad but spicier), "Suea Rong Hai" grilled beef, grilled pork neck, papaya salad, and thin rice noodle salad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fayrethan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Many of the dishes tasted good, but the restaurant stopped selling alcohol after the New Year.

However, the staff were incredibly difficult to get their attention; they barely looked, making it hard to get their attention. Ordering food or paying required precise timing.

The prices were moderate.
sample_reviews_en.author: NC PS

sample_reviews_en.text: This Northeastern Thai restaurant serves flavorful, spicy food at affordable prices. The Tom Yum soup and the crying tiger beef are excellent. The grilled pork neck is also delicious. Actually, many dishes are tasty. There's parking available, and the restrooms might be a bit unsuitable for women.
sample_reviews_en.author: chanida engpornsin

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is moderately delicious and the price is not too high. The bathroom should be improved a bit because there is no place to put tissues. When I went in, I saw tissues placed on the trash can lid with no place to hang them. The entrance to the parking lot is a wide hole.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภัทราพร ผลถวิล

restaurants.name: Tenjo Sushi & Yakiniku Premium Buffet
restaurants.address:

234/3 เมเจอร์ซีนีเพล็กซ์ รัชโยธิน (โซนอเวนิว) ตึกc/c Building ชั้น 2 Phahonyothin Rd, Lat Yao, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
First time eating at this place during this winter holiday. It’s in the same old spot.

Right next to it, there used to be a rotating hot pot place that my wife was pretty sad to see go. The new place still isn’t open yet 🤦‍♂️

Still busy — same as always. We went for the 399 THB set (ends up around 470 THB per person after service charge and VAT). Mostly ordered beef, jar-marinated pork belly, regular pork belly, fried baby shrimp, and sushi.

One thing I noticed: the “jar pork” doesn’t actually come in a jar anymore — maybe trying to cut costs?

Taste was still pretty good overall. Only downside: a tiny portion of what we ordered never showed up.
sample_reviews_en.author: HAOLIN LI

sample_reviews_en.text:
- I'd like to suggest some improvements (the number of customers has increased, but the service feels worse than before).
- Regarding staff, I suggest having a dedicated cashier or front-of-house receptionist to greet and provide initial service. The service has been quite concerning lately.
- Closing time: I understand the kitchen closes at 9:00 PM - 9:30 PM, but the restaurant is advertised as closing at 10:00 PM. However, customers can only dine until 9:45 PM. This means customers who arrive at 8:00 PM have very little time to dine, and by the time they get their food, it's already 8:45 PM.
- The restaurant remains clean as before.
-
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalermchai Kummee

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍴Tenjo Sushi & Yakiniku Premium Buffet (Major Ratchayothin)

****Overall, a disappointing experience****
There weren't enough staff, resulting in slow service.
The food took a long time to arrive. I had to ask for sushi and egg soup 2-3 times before it finally arrived. The wait was very long.
The pork was quite dark in color when served.
Only some items were tasty. There wasn't a wide variety of appetizers.
The fruit was wilted, and the dragon fruit was sliced ​​very thinly.
They ran out of crepe batter and didn't refill it, and they were out of garlic. The vegetables weren't very fresh either.
sample_reviews_en.author: La Pluie

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was good, the meat was decent, but the dipping sauce wasn't as good as Tee Noi or MK. The service was extremely slow, slow at every step. When I went, the restaurant was half full, tolerable, but then it got completely full. I ordered food 25 minutes ago and it still hadn't arrived. I had to go and find a staff member. I'd like to thank the young female staff member, who I think wasn't Thai, for her eagerness and quick response. As for whether I'd return, if there are other restaurants, I'd go somewhere else. At this price point, other places are far superior.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khun Review

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually eat at this branch, but today I felt like everything had deteriorated significantly. The tempura shrimp was soggy, the fried salmon salad was also soggy (it's usually crispy), the squid sashimi wasn't fresh, and the charcoal grill wasn't hot enough; the staff had to stir the charcoal 3-4 times. After ordering, it took 20-30 minutes, and the staff said that if it took longer than that, we could order again. This isn't an proper solution. We ordered and waited, and now we have to order again and wait all over again. I hope they improve their service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachan Pathomthong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Even with the cheapest buffet course still priced at 470 baht, the food quality has declined, the menu has been reduced, and the fruit in the display case was very wilted. The staff are good, but due to insufficient numbers, service is slow. Even at lunchtime with only a few tables occupied, food still takes a long time to arrive.

Regarding the food, orders are never complete; rice and soup still arrive even after finishing the meal. Even the grilled items are slow to arrive. I don't understand this issue; is it a system problem or something else?
sample_reviews_en.author: Anon La

sample_reviews_en.text: Don't bother coming here!!! The staff is scarce, service is slow. I ordered sushi three times and it didn't arrive until after I'd already finished eating and was ready to pay the bill. It wasn't that I was full, it was that I was too lazy to wait any longer. The only edible cut of meat was the fatty cut. The shoulder blade meat looked terrifying, like human flesh, I wouldn't dare eat it. The taste was okay, but the wait was unbearable. It looked deserted. If you can't afford it, just close down. It's ruining Tenjo's reputation, honestly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Doobeedoo

sample_reviews_en.text:
The quality of foods and service is okay But you have to be careful when you order because if you order and can't finish your foods , they will charge you from cheapest at 40 bath to 60 bath per 1 piece.
And the stuff didn't tell me about the rule but gave me this rule paper later after I ordered some foods already when I asked to give some foods back because we didn't eat it yet they said can't give back, it's fine but I just won't go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: 5C999 HAA

restaurants.name: Kyoto Uji Saryo
restaurants.address:

Siam Takashimaya - ICONSIAM Shopping Center, Unit G10, G Floor 299 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This shop, located on the grand floor of Takashimaya in Iconsiam, offers drinks, ice cream, and Japanese sweets featuring Uji matcha from Kyoto. They also have a food menu featuring noodles and rice bowls made with Ibonoito somen noodles.

Ideally, I should have tried their popular Japanese sweets and matcha ice cream, but since I was hungry, I'll review their food menu.

I tried the chilled tantan somen. It's a somen version of tantan noodles without broth. It was quite tasty. The Ibonoito noodles were well-coated in the sesame sauce and cooked to perfection.

This shop is small, located along the walkway leading into Takashimaya, so don't expect much in terms of service or atmosphere. It's more of a place to grab some ice cream or quickly slurp down some noodles as you pass by.
sample_reviews_en.author: Staff Terry's Cafe

sample_reviews_en.text: For those who love noodles, especially thin noodles, these are incredibly delicious. The thin noodles are soft and chewy. This is my second time eating here. The minced pork somen in soybean soup, both hot and cold, has a light soybean aroma. The soybean smell isn't too strong. Both are incredibly delicious. I came to Icon specifically to eat them. The chicken is fried until crispy and the meat is very soft and juicy. It's a shame they have delivery. Next time I'll come try another menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: K. N.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This noodle shop's cold set is definitely worth it. The broth might be a little sparse, but the toppings, including the sweet egg noodles, shredded egg, wakame seaweed, and imitation crab, are all excellent.
I especially like the large set with the swirling broth to prevent the noodles from sticking together, and the soft ice cream dessert in hojicha and matcha flavors is rich and very fragrant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teepui Kiatdilokrath

sample_reviews_en.text: I used to love this place during COVID. But now, the matcha is terrible, very low quality. For 190 baht, you could get a top-grade matcha at many Thai-owned restaurants. The service is also very slow; I waited a long time. I definitely won't go back. I don't recommend it. The new shop is small and not inviting. It's a shame about the good memories I had at the place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poonnapa P.

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s just a small restaurant, two tables with some of counter bar seats. This place is for matcha lovers, their soft serve is very good, strong matcha flavor. They also have variety dishes of ramen . You can select the small portions so you can try their desserts. Sorry, forget to take the photo of their soft serve ice cream.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khoong Yaowares

sample_reviews_en.text:
Can't speak for the soba or other menus, in terms of the dessert we had the mix soft serve. I think we chose this because it provided bits of their other dessert specialty. It was okay but can't stay that there was anything that stands out.

Service was very slow, there was only one server attending to all the other tables.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dolly C

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food poisoned after dinner. My toddler child and I both puked few times in the middle of the night, and I personally kept diarrhea whole night for like 10+ times. It was terrible.

It wasn’t our first visit but first time experienced so bad. Will not visit again and not recommend
sample_reviews_en.author: Winnie

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located on the G floor, Siam Takashimaya side. There aren't many seats, but the staff provides good service. The lemon cold noodles are refreshing, although there's a little too much lemon, but it goes well with the fried chicken.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bestlingchan

restaurants.name: Sri Kamin
restaurants.address:

PGVF+8QW, Soi Chulalongkorn 5, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
•This is a really delicious restaurant, the food suits my taste perfectly. I eat here regularly.
•If you order the spicy sour curry, it's very flavorful and rich. If you don't like spicy food, ask them to reduce the spiciness.
•The fern salad is delicious, well-balanced with sour, salty, and spicy flavors – a perfect combination!
•And the stir-fried Gnetum leaves with egg is superb ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
•The staff are very friendly and provide excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tonkanya Jintana

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is air-conditioned, perfect for Thailand's hot weather. The food is delicious. I eat here every time I'm in the Chulalongkorn University area. I love that they have brown rice. The stir-fried Gnetum leaves with coconut milk and fresh shrimp is amazing; I always order it. You can also get your parking ticket stamped at the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: KP Ken

sample_reviews_en.text:
Southern taste in Bangkok!

It’s Sunday evening in December and we came in a party of 4. Parking was super easy and walking distant was short. Our table was on the second floor, which was really nice. We ordered, then, within 5 mins, our food were on the table. All dishes were delicious like others said. I’d repeat!
sample_reviews_en.author: Vuttikon Thaidecha

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good southern Thai food, but according to the real southern Thai, it not spicy enough. However it’s really spicy for me.

The taste is really special, and it is totally different from the food you can find on street. The ingredients are also great.
It’s some flavor I’ve never had before.

Nice experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Po Yu Chung

sample_reviews_en.text: the food is amazing and the restaurant is clean! We were touch by the owner’s kindness:) we asked for help to grab a motorcycle but it was difficult to get one under the heavy rain, he even offered to give us a ride! Thanks and hope everything goes well with you:)
sample_reviews_en.author: Eyria Wu

sample_reviews_en.text: Taste is ok, but a bit blend for me to be the Southern food. Location is easy to access. Service is fine. Price is fine for the standard of city restaurant, but a bit high if you compare to street food (250- 500 THB for two people)
sample_reviews_en.author: Omiracle T

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a regular minced pork basil stir-fry. The food was incredibly spicy 😭😭😭 It was the spiciest basil stir-fry I've ever had in my life. I had to order two extra bottles of water (20 baht per bottle of Namthip water).
sample_reviews_en.author: Thananyarat

sample_reviews_en.text: The food at this restaurant is delicious, authentic Southern Thai cuisine. I bring my family here very often. I highly recommend it! There are only 4 tables, so you can make reservations in advance. They open at 11 am. 👏👏👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Chantratip Dachthanasinraksa

restaurants.name: Talalaks Siam Paragon
restaurants.address:

991 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The satay is much smaller than the picture, it doesn't worth 80฿. The taste is just ordinary. As the only choice for vegetarian in the canteen, it's very disappointing.
sample_reviews_th.author: Jia Yin Foo

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited in the afternoon of 20 July. Talalaks is located in the food court downstairs, and requires use of a coupon card like most spots here. The food court is massive to the point that it took us a good 20 minutes to find this vegan spot. Ultimately we located it, and gladly picked up their rice plus 3 dishes offer for 80 Baht. The dishes were healthy portion sizes, and the food was excellent. Finding a table was a challenge, but like in most Bangkok food courts, people happily share seats at their table, so we quickly found a place to sit.

This food court is popular, crowded, has good offerings for reasonable prices, but can be confusing and stressful. Just be patient, walk around it for a bit too find what you want, then sit down and make a new friend and enjoy your lunch.

The staff at Talalaks was helpful and the food was on point. We plan to return soon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dan Pieloch

sample_reviews_en.text: Wow.  All vegan in a food hall was a first for me.  Maybe things have changed, but I didn't find a buffet to self-serve from as I thought I'd read about.  I was led by a helpful person through an amazing number and variety of take out enterprises to a small opening where, indeed, the Talalak sign was clearly evident, and the food was displayed to choose from.  As I don't speak any Thai I just said : "soup" as I'd seen a bowl leave, and it looked super.  He put a bunch of stuff in, some I figured out, like tofu and greens, but there were also a couple of bites of probably some type of fake meat.  Tasty.  Plus noodles with a little spice on top.  It was really a bit chaotic in there for photos, though.  Anyway, if you are in Bangkok, and you just happen to find yourself on the ground in the not very down to earth at all, Siam Paragon, head to Talalaks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bracha Jemille

sample_reviews_en.text:
OMG -
This is literally my fave place in Bangkok!!
The food is the food of vegan dreams - so simple and tasty and ridiculously good value.
The food hall is so overwhelming chaotic but Talalaks is a haven of veganism and impeccable flavour!
Doesn’t matter what you get it’s going to be delicious.
So delicious that I flew back 2 months later to eat the entire menu !!

Located in Siam paragon in the basement / load up a prepaid card from the kiosk and you’re good to go!

Staff are very patient and friendly
sample_reviews_en.author: Jamie Karpen

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered Tom Yum soup, it's very very delicious 🤤 The store is not easy to find, it's in the Food Court, not the Gourmet section and not the dessert or supermarket section. There were so many food stores that it took me around half an hour to find it. The location of this vegan restaurant is somewhere next to the wall like a proper food store, not in the middle of the food court like a stall. So go to the end of the building inside and walk along the wall, you will find it this way faster.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ada W

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was absolutely delicious. We've been here several times now. It's great to have a vegan restaurant option.

We had the satay skewers (I think number 1), as well as numbers 10 and 11.
Everything was incredibly filling and delicious, and really great value for the price!

We had eight satay skewers; I just took the photo a little late ;)
As for the atmosphere, it's in a mall, so naturally it's busy and a bit noisy, but that's not a problem :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Oreo 134

sample_reviews_en.text:
The canteen offers a good selection of vegan-friendly options, and the service was both attentive and quick. The menu includes English translations, which makes ordering easier. The rice with three dishes was decent, but the fried rice noodles truly stand out as one of their best offerings. Highly recommended.

Pros:
Clean
Cheap
English menu
Good food
Vegan

Cons:
Needs to look for seats
sample_reviews_en.author: ルーシャスLucius

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cheap and delicious vegan food; my green curry spaghetti is only 85 baht.
For tourists who visit Bangkok frequently, I suggest getting the Rabbit Card at the Skytrain station. You can use Rabbit Card to pay at most food courts in Bangkok etc, besides using it to take SKYTRAINs. Really convenient.
I like the food and price here, will definitely come back and try other dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yellow Bear

restaurants.name: Local Thai Restaurant
restaurants.address:

183/72, Tambon Nong Prue, Amphoe Bang Lamung, Chon Buri, 20150, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is incredibly affordable, perfectly seasoned, and serves delicious food, making it a great choice.

The only downside is that the white rice is of extremely poor quality.

It's a shame.

It was watery and had a lot of stuck-together parts like mochi, which is my least favorite type of white rice. 😢

So, be careful when ordering dishes like gapow rice, which are primarily made with white rice.

I don't recommend this restaurant for Japanese people who value the taste of white rice.

I avoid dishes that mainly consist of white rice, and instead order noodles or fried rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: 根岸隆司

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I walked into a small local Thai restaurant on Beach Road, Soi 13.
The kitchen is open-air, so there’s no air conditioning inside.

I ordered a plate of fried rice and stir-fried pork with kale. The food was very good and the prices were very reasonable. This is a simple local home-style restaurant. If you’re not looking for fancy décor, this is a great place to try real Thai food.
sample_reviews_en.author: W H

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice little inconspicuous restaurant worth a visit. Great value, great tasting food, quick service and good variety.
Update: Back a year later. Food still very tasty and prices great. Only downside was waitress taking the order did definitely not seem very happy. Eye rolling, sighs and no smiles.
Not enough to prevent a return visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul H

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're looking for excellent Thai food at extremely reasonable prices, you've come to the right place. Don't expect a restaurant with uniformed staff; you wouldn't be in the right place. But if you're looking for your everyday dining spot, you're in the right place... (arghh, even the green beans are good...😁). …
sample_reviews_en.author: Lt_Anderson

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stayed at a hotel across the street, so I went there a few times. It opens early in the morning, so I often went there after my morning run.

Menu items start from 50 baht, so you can enjoy a casual meal. Water is self-service.

If it were in my neighborhood, it's a place I'd want to visit again and again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yasu

sample_reviews_en.text: Great Thai food. Dishes are the perfect size (if you are not a big back westerner). Setting is a small shop. Sitting inside was very hot. Outside was more airy but you are sitting on a small plastic chair in the street. Overall this place is great for a quick bite to eat and food is very flavorful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gal Tu

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is one of my favorite places in Pattaya to eat Thai food. If you are a spicy food lover, this is where you can get really spicy food. Ask for the Thai special spicy. This was praised by my friend who likes spicy food. I go here several times during my vacation. The food is affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jarkko Karlsson

sample_reviews_en.text:
This has to be a hidden gem 💎!
Absolutely one of the best Thai restaurants i had food in
Would definitely recommend
Seems like good home cooked meals
As the prices are very reasonable 60-70 baht a dish please leave a good tip as this is definitely family/women owned ♥️🦦
sample_reviews_en.author: Ramy Ramy

restaurants.name: ขนมแม่สาขาโลตัส อ่อนนุช
restaurants.address:

ชั้น2, โลตัส สุขุมวิท 50 ประตูเข้าออก BTS, 1710 Sukhumvit 50 Aly, Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The staff are lovely and provide good service. There's a wide variety of Thai desserts to choose from, with plenty of toppings and just the right amount of sweetness – not overly sweet. I first tried them at the Big C Samut Prakan branch, and the owner was very nice and gave great recommendations. They also have butterfly pea/lemon drinks that are refreshing.

💸 125฿
🚗 Parking available at Lotus (first 2 hours free).
sample_reviews_th.author: Thunyamas Onthong (Por)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely delicious Thai desserts! Every dessert was perfectly sweet—not overly sugary and you can really taste the high quality of the ingredients. The portions are generous, and the prices are very reasonable for the quality you get.

They also accept advance orders for seminars, office events, parties, and other special occasions, making them a great choice for catering.

Highly recommended if you're looking for authentic Thai sweets. I'll definitely be coming back!
sample_reviews_en.author: GuideGift

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here! My mom tried the crispy rice crackers and they were sooooo delicious! The flavor was perfectly balanced. The service was excellent, truly outstanding. The atmosphere was lovely, with cute teddy bears on the tables. I highly recommend this place! The food was truly delicious; we finished everything, even the coconut milk! 🥰🥰🥰🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: kharin Thongnam

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is adorable, all the desserts look delicious, and the colors are so cute! I love the blue color scheme.
The desserts and ice cream are very tasty, not too sweet 👍🏻🫶🏻 and the prices are reasonable.
The minimalist shop is cute, but I wish it were bigger so it could accommodate more customers ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanakarn Kidrai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent (mostly) non-processed deserts, with thoughtful gentle touch to cheer up or perfect wind down your hectic day.  Excellent service too!

Recommend for no-plastic fan. I'm on a week plastic-free challenge, and they helped me to use my container.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tiffany HI

sample_reviews_en.text: Extremely expensive! 60 baht for a small cup of shaved ice. The taste was so bland I had to ask for extra coconut milk, but they charged me extra for it. Never again! I almost wanted to return the other two desserts I bought. 😅
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicharee S.

sample_reviews_en.text: Thai desserts are delicious and not too sweet. Butterfly pea ice cream with coconut milk is incredibly refreshing and delicious. The sweetness is just right, perfectly balanced by the creamy coconut milk. It's fantastic! 🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: Hathaithip Dramed

sample_reviews_en.text: The pastries are delicious and taste great. I wish the shop would consider using a microwave to warm the pastries up so they're ready to eat; that would be great! 👍👍👍 The staff are lovely and provide good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Veeranuch

restaurants.name: Kohinoor Indian Food (oldest and best indian restaurant in pattaya)
restaurants.address:

17/5 หมู่ที่ 10 Pattaya Sai Song Rd, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently had the chance to dine at Kohinoor Restaurant, located right in front of Camelot Hotel in Pattaya, and I must say—it was a pleasant surprise. The restaurant specializes in Indian cuisine, and as someone who enjoys authentic flavors, I was genuinely impressed.

What stood out the most for me was their South Indian menu. The dishes were delicious and tasted just like home—fresh, flavorful, and well-prepared. It’s not always easy to find that level of authenticity outside India, but Kohinoor nailed it.

A special mention to Mr. Prem Kumar who served me. He was extremely polite, attentive, and made sure everything was just right throughout the meal. Service like that adds so much to the overall experience.

If you're in Pattaya and craving good Indian food, especially South Indian, I’d definitely recommend giving Kohinoor a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: kabir saini

sample_reviews_en.text:
Many times I walked passed in front of this restaurant and finally today I went in. Actually I was pretty scared and mindful about Indian food etc.. but.. I'm absolutely impressed! This evening I had one of the best food experiences in my life. The food was absolutely delicious, rich and very complex flavor. The highway masala paneer was absolutely insane good. Silky, smooth, savory, rich and spicy. OMG I love it. The chicken butter was fluffy, sweet very delicate. I definitely recommend the food this restaurant.
The staff is nice but cannot speak English properly, but can help you to select the food and explain the recipes.
Also the location is cozy and very clean.
3 plates + 3 bread + 1 rice + 4 beers around 1300thb.
sample_reviews_en.author: Riccardo Demartini

sample_reviews_en.text: In my opinion, this is the best Indian restaurant in Pattaya. The staff is very friendly, welcoming and helpful. Large selection of dishes. Cooked with soul by real professionals and culinary masters. The portions are large and very appetizing, the price is not high. Inside is a very beautiful, atmospheric interior in Indian style, good music. Large premises, clean, neat. The restaurant is located next to Walking Street, so I definitely recommend visiting. If you have never tried Indian cuisine - you really should visit this place. I will definitely visit it every time I come to Pattaya and recommend it to all my friends. I really want to say a huge thank you to the owner and chef for the welcome :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Greg

sample_reviews_en.text: The perfect place when you are craving for home food in a foreign land. We reached there during lunch time and we were the only customers at that moment. Skeptical if the food would be fresh, we placed our order. The very friendly staff said they would take 30 mins time as they prepare the food only on order. It will totally worth waiting the time. The food arrived piping hot and fresh, the taste and flavors were just like home made.. ghar ka Khaana. Very reasonable prices. Worth every penny we paid. My kids said this was the best meal they had in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sindhu Suresh

sample_reviews_en.text: Guys, only Indian will see, so I will post in Hinglish, so the place is very nice, ambience is good, neat and clean, everyone has a welcoming nature, now comes the best part, THE BEST FOOD INDIAN WHICH SABKO CHAIYE OUT OF INDIA, YOU WILL PROVIDE YOU THE BEST FOOD, and their staff is very good, we stayed here for three days, the second day, even this famous AMRITSAR restaurant is better than this, please visit it once, please
sample_reviews_en.author: Deependra Yadav

sample_reviews_en.text: I had an amazing experience at Kohinoor Restaurant in Pattaya. The food was fresh, flavorful, and truly authentic — just like home-style Indian cooking. The staff were polite and attentive, and the atmosphere was warm and comfortable. I especially loved the [butter chicken / biryani / naan — you can mention your favorite dish]. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for quality Indian food in Pattaya!
sample_reviews_en.author: Babu Bhati

sample_reviews_en.text: After visiting multiple cities and towns in Thailand, we finally found an Indian food heaven. Kohinoor restaurant offers everything your Indian appetite craves for. With pleasing ambience, hindi- punjabi music plays while you enjoy your drink and food. Food is top quality, very helpful and interactive staff. would recommend every Indian food lover to visit here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pratik Kantelya

sample_reviews_en.text: Love the atmosphere and location on the main road with proper seating and comfortable chairs. I have tried Indian dessert  Gulab Jamin which was outstanding. I couldn't resist and asked for another one . If was fresh and delicious 😋. The services provided is excellent and very affordable prices.Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yousef Abdo

restaurants.name: SHELL WE MEAT KOREA SEAFOOD
restaurants.address:

322 16 Soi Ratchadaphisek 3, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited this restaurant with a group of friends, expecting a great dining experience, but unfortunately, it fell short in several areas.

Corn Cheese: The corn cheese had a strange, unpleasant smell from the hot pan, which made the taste almost inedible. I don’t think it should have been served to customers in that condition.
Vegetables: The vegetables were not fresh at all and appeared wilted, which was off-putting.
Seafood: The salmon, shrimp, and crab were fresh but had a mushy texture, which wasn’t very enjoyable.
Meat & Pork: While the meat and pork were decent, they didn’t live up to the standard set by other restaurants at this price point.
Service and Cleanliness: The pan heated up quickly, but I noticed that Chef Lon didn’t seem to be paying attention to food grade. Additionally, the tea bottle that was served seemed reused and was not very clean, which was concerning.
Overall, I left very disappointed, especially considering the positive reviews I had seen online. Unfortunately, I won’t be returning, and I can't recommend it based on my experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chutikan Pinmanee

sample_reviews_en.text:
I intend to go there since I Saw in YouTube Peach eat lak 👀When I came there you have to walk to the small building Not too much tables there were two floors I ordered for 399 B, I was so disappointed as follows
Not much veg to select , only cheap ones
Not free refilled drinks
Too expensive with that s price
Only two room toilets
Dirty area for preparation food
Serves was terrible
Dishes as mentioned in the menu, were all cold and moderate
Taste was fair
If possible I would like to ask the restuarant that u hire Influencer for review since it absolutely differed from the review
I do not recommend
sample_reviews_en.author: chayuttorn iemsakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you love pickled seafood, this is a great value. You can eat unlimited pickled shrimp, crab, and salmon, and there's also grilling. There's a wide variety of pork options, including pork belly, pork neck, regular pork belly, soy sauce, and sauce. There's also a good variety of side dishes, including other dishes like kimchi soup and bibimbap. The prices aren't too high, so it's a great value for Korean food lovers.

However, it's located in an alley, so parking can be difficult. It's more convenient to park at Fortune Town or Central Rama 9 and walk there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Montawach Lew

sample_reviews_en.text: Korean buffet (90 mins) comes with variety of packages. The cheapest one starts at 199 baht (VAT exclusive) and the most expensive one is 599 baht in which you get to try all of the available packages. The only drawback is that the seafood set does not include salmon and other types of fish. Cash, QR code payment, and credit cards (with 3% of credit card processing fees) are accepted. The staff are freindly and very service-minded. The owner is friendly and welcoming. A good place to hangout with friends or family.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pia Suwannalert

sample_reviews_en.text: I went yesterday and it was not really impressive food experience. Nothing was delicious. Seafood quality was so bad.Crab tasted so bad that I could only eat half piece.  You’re allowed to upgrade price with better quality. Plus the food was served very slow. We waited around 30 minutes until we get foods. Meanwhile customers beside who came later than us got food first. Portion was very small and no one informed. I don’t think I will visit this restaurant again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lee Arin 0527

sample_reviews_en.text: At 499 baht, it felt like a waste of money. The portions were small, the marinated salmon was extremely thin, the shrimp were tiny, and the pork belly had a slight odor. The raw beef salad was pale and not fresh. I wasn't impressed, especially since I saw it on TikTok. It wasn't like the reviews at all! I'm a little disappointed. They also gave us too little time – only 1 hour and 30 minutes.
sample_reviews_en.author: วรชพร ธนปัทมกรมหัท

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you want to best taste of korea food , this buffet you have to try for one life. The taste is very good. Everything in menu so delicious. And about service they service you like a prince & princess.
My recommend menu is beef steak and about seafood so great too. But in my mind everything is great. For one life must try this buffet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patt Kurita

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Korean Bbq restaurant is situated in narrow alley which you can park in front of the restaurant
There are various materials and ingredients for grill on the big pan
Their hot pan is excellent and easy to grill all stuff
After Bbq, you can enjoy four kinds of Icecream
The reception has a game for getting free of charge
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanthip Trisurat EVE

restaurants.name: Eau Hua Suki Lat Phrao
restaurants.address:

2, 1 Soi Lat Phrao 71, Saphan Song, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I highly recommend trying this place!
I eat here very often, and everyone I recommend it to loves it.

It's an old-fashioned sukiyaki with incredibly tender, melt-in-your-mouth meat.
The broth is flavorful and savory after adding the meat.
Meat lovers will adore this place; the meat is super tender.
- There are two dipping sauces: fermented tofu sauce and a sukiyaki sauce with added lime.
It's delicious and perfectly balanced.
- All the meatballs are delicious and have a bouncy texture.
- I also recommend the shrimp patties; they're bouncy and chewy.

The price is on the high side, but it's worth it considering the quality of the ingredients.
It's less crowded during lunchtime, but I wish more people went!
Because it's one of my favorite restaurants.

There's plenty of parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: me sanya

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is spacious and convenient, with individual hot pots for single people.
Parking is very convenient. The restaurant is large and spacious but hot; fans are needed.

The dipping sauces are delicious and fragrant.

Taste 🌟🌟🌟🌟
Quality 🌟🌟🌟
Service 🌟🌟🌟
Cleanliness 🌟🌟🌟
Convenience 🌟🌟🌟
Price 🌟🌟🌟

*☺️☺️*This is a personal opinion based on my preferences, tastes, experiences, biases, and quirks. I paid for the meal myself, so I'm giving an honest review and critique based on what I ate and experienced on the day I visited. I want to see feedback used for improvement, rather than anger, hatred, or curses. I ask for forgiveness here and now.☺️😊**
sample_reviews_en.author: วันจันทร์ ที่ผ่านมา

sample_reviews_en.text:
Review of Eaw Hua Sukiyaki (Traditional Sukiyaki) ⭐⭐☆☆☆ (2/5 stars)

The food tastes okay, and the ingredients are of good quality, but the service is very slow, even though the restaurant isn't crowded. The wait is so long it spoils the atmosphere. The dipping sauce needs extra seasoning to be tasty. The price is quite high compared to the portion size and service.

✅ Fresh ingredients, okay taste
❌ Long wait even when there are few customers
❌ Inattentive service, a bit pricey

Recommended dishes: Marinated Pork Sukiyaki / Fried Shrimp Dumplings

If the service were faster, it would be more worth returning!
sample_reviews_en.author: P Peepo

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went around noon on a weekday. There was nobody there, it was so lonely. I was the only one in the whole restaurant. The restaurant is beautiful and clean, and there's plenty of parking.
They offer set meals for one person, which is convenient, with various prices.
The sukiyaki was delicious, already cooked so you don't have to cook it yourself.
The shrimp patties were nice and bouncy.
The shrimp spring rolls had a bit too much ginger flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: thanita panyaamornwat

sample_reviews_en.text: Came to this restaurant for a single serving dish. This suki yaki restaurant is massive and can accumulate large group of people. I dine in during lunch time and the place was mostly empty as the restaurant is more popular in the evening. I ordered the thick gravy pork noodles. The pork was very well marinated and nice thick cut. However the flavor was a bit bland for my liking. Love to return again just to try out their suki yaki
sample_reviews_en.author: Katethip Varanyuwatana
