sample_reviews_en.text:
The traditional sukiyaki had very well-marinated pork. The ingredients were of good quality. The restaurant is spacious with plenty of seating options. Besides sukiyaki, they also offer a wide variety of other dishes. The prices are on the higher side, but the food is of good quality.

Price: 3/5
Quality: 4/5
Taste: 4/5
Cleanliness: 5/5
Speed: 5/5
Service: 5/5
Location: 5/5
Value for money: 4/5
sample_reviews_en.author: Akapatr Chiraarreebutr

sample_reviews_en.text: This Chinese-style hot pot is delicious. I recommend letting the staff prepare it for you. Their process involves mixing the meat with egg, pouring it into a pot of boiling water, and then reducing the heat. The flavor is fragrant and delicious. There are two types of dipping sauces; mixing them together is great. All the staff are lovely. ❤️🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: นอนน้อย คอยรีวิว

sample_reviews_en.text: I recommend the beef sukiyaki set, stir-fried beef with oyster sauce, and the heavenly spring rolls. They're all delicious! The restaurant is very large, with several zones and even seating for solo diners. There's plenty of parking. I've had the opportunity to use the service many times. The food is consistently delicious every time. :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukwan At.

restaurants.name: Another Hound Cafe - Emporium
restaurants.address:

622 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a very disappointing experience at Another Hound Cafe. I ordered the lobster pasta, which was bland and far below expectations for a dish at this price point. The service was also notably slow, adding to the overall frustration.

The most serious issue, however, was a payment error. A staff member mistakenly charged me **11,374.13 baht** instead of the correct amount of **1,347.41 baht**. While I understand that mistakes can happen, this was a clumsy error with significant consequences, as it resulted in a large and unexpected withdrawal from my payment account.

What made the situation worse was the handling of the mistake. No meaningful concession or compensation was offered—only a verbal apology—which felt wholly inadequate given the inconvenience and stress caused.

Overall, the combination of poor food quality, slow service, and a major billing error left me extremely dissatisfied. I will never patronize this restaurant again and cannot recommend it to others.
sample_reviews_en.author: D LS

sample_reviews_en.text:
I loved Another Hound Cafe back in my school days, especially the one in the upscale Emporium department store. It's been renovated countless times, but I still love coming here.

The menu has changed a few times, but the taste remains outstanding. The bread served before the meal comes with three toppings: butter, vinegar, and a special sauce—fluffy, hot, and incredibly delicious. You absolutely must try their many fruit-based specials; they're not only visually appealing but also very tasty.

The pasta is cooked on a firmer side, creating a satisfying chewy texture. Combined with the aroma of olive oil and basil, it's a perfect match! The smoked duck is tender and oily, yet not greasy at all and has a wonderfully springy texture, though it's a little too oily... The passion fruit dessert retains the fruit's natural tartness, but it can get a bit cloying after a while...
sample_reviews_en.author: David Yeh

sample_reviews_en.text:
There are variety of food choice. Also its taste.
I ordered
- calm soup: it is good balance of taste
- pork chop with cherry sauce: this dish is technically fried pork chop serve with stir fried bacon+dried chilli which this combination turned out a very greesy taste.
The cherry sauce taste is very weak
I do noy recommended this dish
- grilled kurobota with stir fried sticky rice: grilled kurobota is good, stir fried sticky rice taste  could be abit stronger.

The atmosphere is good, not too crowd
Disappointing service. The service staffs seem not enough.
Some cant not understand thai well but she hesitate to ask other and answer wrongly about bill payment which madd me waste time to get voiding payment and pay again.
The mistake of payment made this restuarant looked unprofessional which is different  from its past.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wilasinee K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here because I needed coffee and needed to do some work on my laptop. I got enticed by the cafe’s name and even more so the menu, and had to order some food.

First impression was that the staff service was faultless. Very professional and well-spoken.

The menu also looked very appealing, hence an unplanned meal on my part. Food was pretty good. I wouldn’t say it’s the best, but I think above average. I had a chicken pate — it was good, but obviously couldn’t be compared to the ones I’ve had in Europe nor high end restaurants in Asia, although it did get rid of that craving for me. Mushroom soup was delicious. Coffee was good.

I deducted a star mainly because despite food being of decent quality, it was very expensive, and also because they did not have any wifi for guests.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zi Jing Kang

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really enjoy having my lunch here. I was going to order the pot of mussels but they don’t serve it at the moment. Then I went for the Cha Go Go Go spaghetti dish as recommended by the staff. Although the ink spaghetti itself doesn’t seem to be made in-house but the flavor is fantastic! It definitely has its Thai flavor in it and it was surprisingly delicious with a bit spicy 🌶️ kick.
I also had a cup of latte and a strawberry layer cake to finish the meal. The cream in between the crepe was so light and tasty. The cream to pour onto the cake was light and fruity. And the coffee itself was bold just like the strong Italian espresso you wanted. I have had many coffee around Bangkok and this one is by far the best! Would definitely like to come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Catherine

sample_reviews_en.text: found this gem at Emporium. Amazing atmosphere, staffs were attentive and food came pretty fast. so far, the best pasta i have had tried here in bangkok. totally loved it, although the bacon was kind of salty. nevertheless, enjoyed it very much. the drink was amazing as well. the pad thai was one of the best we have had and to finish it off with the sweet cake. i love the charcoal bread provided with the butter as well. overall we had an amazing experience and will definitely come back again. on a side note, i suggest visiting before or after lunch time. we were lucky to have entered before 12pm, not many guests around, as soon as 12pm hit, there were alot of office workers arriving for their lunch. does seem like a popular place for office workers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nozaroc Traeh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Relaxing atmosphere, no loud music.  Nice modern decor.  The food, though, is less than impressive.  Tuna tartar with avocado is way too salty.  Thai style spicy spaghetti with lobster tail is a bit too heavy with whole garlic.  Service, although, polite needs improvement.  After taking order for charred squid, the waitress came back 5 minutes later only to inform of its unavailability for the day due to lack of ingredients.  The kitchen should make aware of that to the staff from the beginning.  Cutlery was taken away after appetizers, but never replaced when entrees were served.  A bit annoying, to be honest.

Prices on the menu are a little deceptive.  They are before 10% service charge, and 7% VAT on top of it all, so keep that in mind.
sample_reviews_en.author: mars universe

sample_reviews_en.text: I have been here so many times during the first year it was opened, before 2009, I couldn’t recall exactly when. Good to revisit and know that they keep their standards. There used to be long queues and a fashion store next door, that was the old days. I have seen many renovations. At least 3-4 times. Changing the vibe, the hype that actually grow with age. Today it was empty. I got round seats on my own. Soft and cozy. I highly recommend their fusion drinks. Western food is better than Thai. Their Thai food is the modified version. Some new generations and foreigners love it. Many frequent visitors are Japanese. Basically, their Thai food is mild, not to my liking but would always come here for western food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tamruja D.

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือ ป.ประทีป สาขาพัทยา
restaurants.address:

WWG3+P62, Lieb Tang Rodfai Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm already a loyal customer of P. Prateep, but this branch is a huge disappointment. The service at this branch is terrible. The staff are grumpy, sullen, and give you really annoying stares. I had to call each staff member repeatedly to get their attention. I ordered more Thai dessert cups, and then they just disappeared. After a while, I followed up, but another staff member said they were out of dessert cups. Why didn't they come and tell me they were sold out? They just left me sitting there confused. It's the worst experience I've ever had. They act like they don't want to serve customers at all. Absolutely awful. 👎🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: พรสวรรค์ อินทองหลาง

sample_reviews_en.text: I love the taste, it's delicious! But the staff seems less and less willing to serve every day. I keep hearing an older female staff member complaining that a new male staff member is shirking his duties. The staff don't smile or greet customers as often. The atmosphere is less appealing because of this. I want to eat there often, but with this kind of service, I'd rather not go. Other famous chicken noodle soup restaurants, no matter how busy they are, always speak politely, refill the condiments and fresh vegetables constantly, and the owner never frowns when you ask for what you like or don't like.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornpat Soommat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and the taste is good, but the service is extremely slow. We ordered and waited for over 40 minutes. What's really unacceptable is that the staff didn't even take our orders. They ignored us when we called them, and we had to deliver the order ourselves. They also didn't pay attention when we asked for payment.

I really hope they improve their service. I've been eating here since they were a small restaurant, and I always come here whenever I'm in Pattaya, but this time was really not okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bella Pratchayaporn

sample_reviews_en.text: Good service, spacious and comfortable atmosphere. The food is delicious and clean, and the prices are affordable, starting from 50-60 baht and up depending on what you choose to add or customize. Even the special dishes are inexpensive. Importantly, everything we ordered was at the regular price, especially the noodles 😁 The meat or meatballs are plentiful for only 60 baht. It's very filling and worth it! I've eaten there twice and have never been disappointed. I'll definitely go again! 🤍🇹🇭
sample_reviews_en.author: โสภา กฤษวี

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is perfect for those who can handle spicy food. The boat noodle recipe uses a broth that doesn't completely cover the noodles. It's delicious even before adding any condiments.

If you're a foreigner and enjoy noodles, give this place a try.

Those who get hot easily shouldn't come, as the restaurant doesn't have air conditioning. However, the air circulation is excellent because it's spacious. Parking is convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warintorn Phiromkanokphat

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm not good at English myself, but the staff here are absolutely terrible. I was passing by and saw a lot of people, so I went in. The menu had no pictures or English. If it weren't for the young, friendly woman working there, I almost couldn't order and left. The food was delicious, but the portions were very small. I think the supermarket's sampling corners could offer more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeongmin Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm so annoyed by those orange juice vendors. They offer you a sample, and if you don't, they keep talking. Once you do try it, they keep urging you to buy. If you buy only a little, they keep pressuring you to buy more. It's so irritating!
It's not even that tasty! I think it's too sour, but they keep saying theirs is too sweet. Ugh... so irritating!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bhu wadad

sample_reviews_en.text: We're disappointed. We thought it was terrible. It was too sweet and too salty; there was no choice of flavors at all. We've encountered strongly flavored noodles before, which we understand, but this was the worst we've ever had. We keep wondering why they have so many branches. Or maybe it's just this particular branch, we don't know.
sample_reviews_en.author: สิริ ศรียุทธนา

restaurants.name: Sho Ryu Ramen Phatthanakan 53 | โชริว ราเมง พัฒนาการ 53

2847 Phatthanakan Rd, Phatthanakan, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, the food is delicious. They currently have a buy one get one free promotion, and they also offer free boiled eggs.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุภัทรีย์ เอี่ยมลอย

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! The restaurant also has promotions! The best part is that it's open until 5 AM, perfect for late-night eaters! 🍜
sample_reviews_en.author: จุฑารัตน์

sample_reviews_en.text: The ramen was delicious and flavorful, and they offered unlimited free boiled eggs. It was a filling and worthwhile meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalumphon

sample_reviews_en.text: I thought I was in Japan. It's a ramen shop in Thailand that's practically identical to a Japanese restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: 5kids w Gori

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ramen is delicious, and there's a wide variety of menu options.
They also include a boiled egg.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kitiporn Luang.k

sample_reviews_en.text: The waitress was lovely and provided excellent service. The food was delicious and rich in flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ai Kirisame

sample_reviews_en.text: Great taste, perfect for late-night cravings after midnight. Ramen buy one get one free.
sample_reviews_en.author: Srcgrace

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the staff provided excellent service; everyone was lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jv Jj

restaurants.address:

QF5C+748, Charan Sanitwong 24, Ban Chang Lo, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a restaurant that comes to mind when I'm looking for a late-night meal, after 9 PM. Foodland has a large, convenient parking lot.

The menu mostly offers simple one-dish meals. My regulars are American fried rice and rad na. They use high-quality ingredients, are delicious, and the prices are reasonable. The service is excellent, the food comes quickly, and the cleanliness is maintained.
sample_reviews_en.author: WW Holmes

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a very good restaurant because it is open 24 hours. The quality, craftsmanship, and taste are consistent no matter when you go, at what time, or at what time. It is fast, delicious, and well-organized. I feel comfortable eating here all the time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teepui Kiatdilokrath

sample_reviews_en.text: Located in Foodland Charansanitwong, it has convenient parking. Sometimes you need to get a queue number. The staff are welcoming and provide good service. Food doesn't take long to arrive, and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: itti jfk

sample_reviews_en.text: This legendary restaurant at Foodland serves Thai-style à la carte dishes in a Western-inspired atmosphere. The portions are generous, offering great value for the price. Highly recommend trying it at least once.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr. Kornravit Inthachai

sample_reviews_en.text: A small restaurant in Foodland, full of people, limited seating, good service, quick service, food comes out quickly. The food is the same as usual, not cheap, but rather expensive. The taste is normal.
sample_reviews_en.author: manilla phin

sample_reviews_en.text: Affordable and delicious, true to its name, it's a favorite among night owls as it's open 24 hours. The food is tasty and there's a wide variety to choose from, including both savory and sweet dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: AOHAORR SKK

sample_reviews_en.text: There are many dishes to choose from, moderately priced, freshly made, delicious, clean, good service, comfortable atmosphere, not hot, parking available in front, convenient and comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: KASIAN THIANTHAWORN

sample_reviews_en.text: Easy food inexpensive good service. All that is needed for a quick meal. Maybe atmosphere nothing that great, but considering pricing and quality of food, who will complain.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay narang

restaurants.name: Chocolatier
restaurants.address:

ชั้น 2, Dragon Town, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really liked the atmosphere of the restaurant. It was great. Sitting outside in the evening was very relaxing. Later in the evening, the staff turned on low fans to blow on your legs and provided mosquito repellent spray.

Before entering, there's a screening point with temperature checks, Thai Chana QR code scanning, or sign-in. Inside, it gets crowded on weekends, and many people don't wear masks, so you need to be a little careful.

As for the food, the taste was average, edible but not terrible. Personally, I thought the Western dishes tasted better than the Thai food. For example, the Tom Yum soup and seafood dipping sauce were a bit too sour.

**The restaurant is on the 3rd floor, and the restrooms are on the 2nd floor. There's no elevator. This is for your information in case you're traveling with elderly people.**
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanvi K

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very beautiful place, feels great to sit down and relax there. Also a good place for beautiful photos. The staff was very polite and could speak good English which is great!

However the drinks come fast and the desserts take a long time to be prepared. By the time our desserts arrived our coffees were already cold. Apart from that neither me nor my friend enjoyed the dessert taste. They are quite pricey and looked really nice and beautiful, but didn't taste good. I'm really not sure what the reason is. Maybe next time we should try their cakes instead.

Accessible by the BTS (National stadium/Siam station) + a bit of walk, MRT (Samyan station) + a bit of walk, bus, taxi.
sample_reviews_en.author: In Bkk

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of my favorite restaurants. Everything is great: the food, the drinks, the location, the size of the place. The only thing that bothers me is the grumpy-looking guy with glasses; he's not suited for a service job (I think he might be partly the owner). I've wanted to inform the restaurant about this in person several times for improvement, but I didn't want a confrontation, so I'm writing this to help. I'll still visit often. (Personally, I can let this go, but I've taken my family there before, and some of them clearly expressed how uncomfortable they were with the guy's service. I think other customers might have experienced this as well.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Beem Keeratithananun

sample_reviews_en.text: Google maps says they are open, their sign says they are open but the guy inside says they are closed…. I showed up an hour before they close, the restaurant is impossible to find so I walked around in the rain for 20 minutes trying to find it then the guy inside says they are closed already even though their sign, website, and google maps all say they are open for another 40 minutes. Everyone should avoid this restaurant the staff are terrible. It is also impossible to find unless you feel like going on a wild goose chase for 20 minutes. Awful service, 1/10 restaurant, there are much better dessert options in this area.
sample_reviews_en.author: keegan k

sample_reviews_en.text: While strolling along Thonglor Road, I suddenly had a craving for a refreshing iced chocolate. A quick search on Google Maps showed this shop nearby, which was conveniently located just a short drive from the ground floor of Dragon Town building. The shop has a beautiful, lush decor and offers a full menu of food, desserts, and drinks (if I remember correctly, it used to be located in the Baan Inmon project by the Chao Phraya River with a beautiful view). The dark chocolate was rich, fragrant, refreshing, and not at all milky – 150 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: cosmo

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Good location: easy to reach from MRT BTS, though a bit confusing as you need to get to the UPPER floor of Dragon town
- Interior: spacious, modern, beautiful and green
- Food: very delicious with reasonable price
- Dessert & drinks: so so except for the tasty chocolate
- Service: good in general. I wish they clean the table better; there are obvious stains on it. As we continued to sit there after lunch, I had to wipe the table myself after the staff cleared the dishes.
Worth to go.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cam Tu Tran

sample_reviews_en.text: Location is the best, service was nice and attentive. Easy parking space. Many selection of cakes and drinks. My cappuccino was too sweet so i asked them to add more ice instead they made a new one for me. Awesome i appreciated their solution cause i will always remember this for sure. The new cup taste exactly what i was looking for. Blueberry cheese cake was nice and yummy a great combination with a pot of herbal tea. Nice garden and plantation design. Great ambience and atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amazeme

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was amazing! I loved it ✨ There's both outdoor and air-conditioned seating. The food tasted good, and the smoothies were large, rich, and worth the price with no added VAT. However, the steak was extremely salty today; the surface of the meat was coated in salt, like someone had spilled salt on it. It was so salty it made my eyes water 😂 The staff provided excellent service too (almost forgot to mention that).
sample_reviews_en.author: Benyapa

restaurants.name: BYBLOS 24 - Restaurant & Bar
restaurants.address:

99, 397 Sukhumvit 24 Alley, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Last night we decided to come here it was open and the only thing they were serving on the menu is pizza and calzone!

So that’s what we had we had a pizza and a calzone and both of them were really good from what we remember lol it was around 2:30 or three in the morning last night so we actually enjoyed the entire experience this is a really cool place I’ve been watching it get renovated!

And now I got a chance to see inside it was pretty trippy because I think there’s like a dance floor but the lights were cool the decorations really different very club like ambience with tables for dinner I don’t know if they’re open during the day for lunch but we did enjoy the food!

I would try this place out .. they are open  quite late so that’s a big bonus for people like us who just found this restaurant in our path to finding something to eat in this area!

Follow Fauzia for more reviews of fun bars restaurants and lifestyle experiences in Bangkok you can follow us on Facebook Instagram TikTok in YouTube for more!!
🥰🤣🥰🤣🥰🤣🥰♥️♥️🙏🏼💞💎🦋
sample_reviews_en.author: Follow Fauzia

sample_reviews_en.text: Avoid this place for lunch. The menu isn't the same as in the evening; we came for the Lebanese salads, but at lunchtime they only offer pizzas and European salads. It's very expensive for a salad with no dressing, just a few bits of tuna and olives, and some raw vegetables: cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and bell pepper. There was absolutely no sauce, no olive oil, no vinaigrette; thankfully the waitress brought salt and pepper. The decor is nice, but since we were the first ones there at 12:30 pm, the air conditioning wasn't working, so we were sweating profusely for the first half hour. The lemonades were good and well-presented, but 530 baht per person for this lunch is very disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: DOMINIQUE MC

sample_reviews_en.text: I had been traveling by this place for days while going to play tennis. From the outside it looks very interesting and I had to give it a try. I broke tradition by consulting Google Map. I can tell you after going for lunch I was right. This place is unique in its look. However, the food, staff and service were second to none. The lunch was fantastic. The atmosphere was beautiful. I felt like I was at a cafe on the Mediterranean.  I wish I could have given it more than five stars. Loved it so much that I booked dinner reservations for that evening. In my mind this is a must visit for any traveler to Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ken Paradiso

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to BYBLOS and loved it 💕
It’s a Middle Eastern × Mediterranean restaurant bar with such a nice vibe.

The menu is mainly Lebanese-style, with lots of hummus, grilled dishes, and tasty mezze (small plates) that are perfect for sharing. Everything was super flavorful but still easy to enjoy, even if you’re new to this kind of cuisine!

It’s the perfect spot for a night when you want to enjoy both great food and a beautiful atmosphere. Definitely recommend if you’re looking for a slightly special night out in Bangkok ✨

Oh—and the pizza was really good too 😍🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploy Chanida

sample_reviews_en.text: One of nicest restaurants I've been to. The servers are very attentive. I stayed in the indoor restaurant and it's so relaxing and it dulls down the noise from the outside. The only downside is the food. I think all the food we ordered are too salty that you can no longer appreciate the spices and ingrdients. You can have better food somewhere else with richer flavours.
sample_reviews_en.author: Summer Issa

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was very poor. The staff cannot speak english which made giving order and asking for other information pretty difficult. After ordering 20 mins later the staff came and mentioned that one of the dish we ordered was not available. By that time the dishes ordered by my partner were already on the table.
sample_reviews_en.author: shifaau didi

sample_reviews_en.text: We were a family of 4 celebrating my birthday last night and we highly recommend this beautiful restaurant..The food and drinks were great (Portions, Taste and quality of fresh ingredients) We were served by Oscar and he was great too..The ambiance is amazing..Will surely come back..
sample_reviews_en.author: Joel Diallo Toussaint

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant’s looking so nice to take pictures. Then foods are pretty delicious. Customer Service is so great. Really like customer service of one staff. Her name is Krista. She is so kindly, lovely & polite.
I really wanna prefer guys. U should go this shop if u come to BKK.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zin Thu Zar Oo

restaurants.name: Riverside Terrace Anantara Riverside Bangkok
restaurants.address:

257/1-3 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Road, Samrae Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Super unprofessional and disrespectful towards guest - I cannot believe they can call themselves a five-star hotel even.

For us to pay 10k+ pp for NYE dinner just to be treated like beggar begging to just get seated is way too much. The part where we arrived early is understandable that they were not ready, but not even a decent place for us to wait - and just told us to wait in the lobby, just that. The whole chunk of guests were just flooded the lobby like a shelter place on Christmas day, like two thumbs up five star quality.

To make the matter worse, while we were waiting to be attended to, they rather took photo of themselves dressing up than taking care of guests - like is this a joke? Thought they were creative with the ‘Cirque’ theme - but in the end the theme just represent a freak show of ill-mannered staff that is just not up to standard.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tisa Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have to give a review bebaute I had the best experience with staff during yesterday's evening dinner buffet.
I got a very unlucky mishap: a half burnt spike of a river prawn got deep under the skin above my thumb nail. Very painful and really hard to remove.
3 people of staff were around helping me, and especially 2 all the time until the tiny bit painful, burnt parts of apple were removed, with alcohol, a pin and other little improvised instruments (it took about 30 minutes).
Big thank you to waiter Khun William and also waitress Khun Nee.

The food options were rather normal for a 5-star place like this, very good yet not exactly outstanding. But with the great atmosphere of this place, and I know the Anantara Riverside since its beginnings when it was still part of the Marriott chain.

The memorable experience was simply this staff! 👍🙏🏻🙏🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris

sample_reviews_en.text:
Highly not recommended!

The restaurant has a river view, so it's satisfying for a 10-minute walk, but the actual atmosphere is messy and chaotic.

The food selection and taste are both terrible. If this is going to happen, don't offer a buffet for dinner.

The Japanese food section is hard to find.
Look carefully; they're hidden away, and if you ask, they give you a piece of meat. Is this a buffet?

The BBQ is dry and twisted, and the steak is made with lean meat, slightly thicker than shabu-shabu.
You've experienced the true taste of a 1-2 star buffet.
The food is so bad it's not even worthy of a 3 star rating.

And after eating, I got a stomachache.
This is my third time using the bathroom.
Of course, I'm writing this at 3 a.m.
Pay more attention to hygiene!!
sample_reviews_en.author: 마세바스찬

sample_reviews_en.text: The performance runs for about an hour starting at 7 PM. We visited via a shuttle boat from Sathorn Pier. One downside was that guests couldn't take the steak or maki rolls directly; instead, they were grilled in small batches upon request and brought out by a staff member. I was expecting grilled seafood, but instead, pre-cooked seafood was placed on ice for guests to pick up after it had cooled down. The staff were very friendly, and the performance was much better than I expected. Located by the river, the scenery was beautiful, and sitting in the outdoor seating area is recommended for viewing the show as it is closer to the stage. I thought that next time, I would like to stay overnight and experience the hotel's other services as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: EUNHEE YANG

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very bad dining experience. The waiter had already provided water, but Ms. Noon, the manager, took the water cups away without informing us when the person collecting our food wasn't there. Her service attitude was poor and should have been explained to us in person.

1. The restaurant's order instructions were unclear. The meal price included water and soft drinks, but discounts were not included. Service charge and tax were calculated at the full price.

2. It was very hot indoors, and the air conditioning was insufficient.

3. We were dining until 10:00 PM, and they started clearing away the food around 8:30 PM. Terrible 👎
sample_reviews_en.author: 林鼎超

sample_reviews_en.text: Had the international dinner buffet at the riverside terrace restaurant. Giving only 3 stars as for the price paid i expected much tastier food. When compared to the food offered by other restaurants in thailand i would say a sub par experience. The restaurant offers a great variety of food of many cuisines. Also they have a cultural show that can be ranked as "mehhh" at best. If you are taking a table near the river the view is nice and romantic. But it is a bit smelly.
sample_reviews_en.author: sasika gunasekara

sample_reviews_en.text:
Varieties of dishes to choose from and most were delicious.  I was very impressed with the Chicken Tikka and the prawn curry, the chicken was very tender and tasty, loved it!  The quality of dessert was exceptional.

The down sides that we have found was some  seafood ran out quite quickly, the crab and the rock lobster in particular.  These two items are very popular, the restaurant should be able to better forecast the amount to be ordered from the reservations.
sample_reviews_en.author: Skao Krit

sample_reviews_en.text: Dining at Riverside Terrace was a treat. The restaurant boasts a diverse menu with something for everyone, complemented by attentive and friendly service. The Thai dancing show adds a unique cultural touch to the evening. The open-air setting by the Chao Phraya River creates a magical ambiance, making it a perfect spot for a special occasion.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kritsana Potsatian

restaurants.name: Eatduan by Nathong ICONSIAM
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 299 Charoen Nakhon 5 Alley, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The dish looks exactly like the menu photo — vibrant, appetizing, and beautifully presented. The tom yum flavor is authentic and well-balanced: pleasantly sour, not salty, and moderately spicy. It’s flavorful without being overwhelming, making it very approachable for foreigners who want to experience real Thai taste. Highly recommended for both locals and visitors.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chitrapan Saengchan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Its a little hard to find, tucked between Taco Bell and Ya Kun at the lowest underground level.
The stir fried cabbage, tom yum noodles and scrambled egg with basil pork rive was delicious. The prawns were sweet and well cooked, I'd go for that over the squid/seafood. The cabbage had a fantastic char and wok hey as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: R

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff were truly excellent, professional, and courteous. The Thai food was of adequate quality, also appreciated by many Europeans. The atmosphere was typical of a shopping mall, which I didn't find particularly pleasant, but it was still convenient for shopping. I
recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: PAOLO BIANCHI

sample_reviews_en.text: Tasty food with generous portions. The service was friendly and efficient, making the whole experience enjoyable. The only downside is that the restaurant is a little tricky to find, but it’s well worth the effort once you get there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Sun

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum Noodles with Seafood and Crispy Pork Belly won over my wife's palate after she tried different versions over past few meals. The stir fried trio of Pork with Thai Basil and scrambled egg was also yummy
sample_reviews_en.author: Arif Lukman

sample_reviews_en.text: I almost miss this restaurant, thank God I managed to find them. I ordered their bestseller tomyam hotpot. The portion is big and really tasty yummy. The staff very friendly. Highly recommended here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Elene Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: Great food and great service. Food was amazing. One of my top spots at icon Siam. And Puk was our server. Very friendly and nice guy. Highly recommend
sample_reviews_en.author: Niro Tham

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was rather bad. I was supposed to leave a tip for the waiter, but the cashier added 50 yuan to the total bill without my permission.
sample_reviews_en.author: Feng Z

restaurants.name: Hera Sauna เฮรา ซาวน่า
restaurants.address:

64, 148 Thep Prasit 5, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I used to come here often and was amazed by the changing lighting of the swimming pool and the sauna. I thought that was a cool gimmick I hadn’t seen in any Pattaya saunas.

For 220B (or 110B after 20.30) you get to use the steam room, sauna and swimming pool that are clean as well as the floor.

You are welcomed with a Thai flower-infused drink and a bottle of water. The staff are friendly and helpful, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The location itself is open and airy, with perks like card games and board games for entertainment.

One thing I’ve noticed is that on busier days, the cold pool isn’t as cool as it is on quieter ones.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pok Chutiphon

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love this place. I’ve been visiting for almost a year and will continue to do so.

Very relaxing environment with a great sauna, steam room, ice bath, hot and cold plunge pools, and swimming pool. You are given a free cold drink and a water on arrival. It is 220 baht for the whole day, and if you come at 9pm it is half price. There are lots of tables, chairs and sun loungers—it is very spacious and never feels cramped even when busy. They have a good food menu, and you can now get massages here too.

All of the facilities are always working, it is always clean, and the staff are so lovely and welcoming. Thank you Hera Sauna🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Emily Hill

sample_reviews_en.text: Hera sauna is in my opinion the best sauna in whole of Pattaya. Their sauna Sessions are 🔥 they have cold plunge, and everything you need for a good saunaday. Food is super good also and lovely atmosphere with super energetic and polite staff - always with a smile and a laugh, taking good care of all their customers. Escpecially staff member Ae are making you feel very comfortable and welcome in the sauna. Big credit to everyone else on the team also 🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Mikkel Jensen

sample_reviews_en.text:
There are decent facilities here at a reasonable price (220 baht/day), but unfortunately, the water has so many chemicals in it that it irritated our skin before we had even left.

And we thought it was really strange that they tell you to shower every time you enter the hot tubs or pools... Even if you just came from the sauna, which begs the question: why?!

It makes no sense. It's still just water.

So for those 2 reasons, we probably won't be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tim G

sample_reviews_en.text: Really nice spa with dry sauna, steam room, jacuzzi, and cold plunge. The facility is very clean and well taken care of. The staff are friendly and nice   Massage and full restaurant menu with beers and drinks available. The best part is the 4x daily special sauna sessions where they play music while fanning the heat after pouring scented ice balls over the heater. Many people here are monthly members.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Kim

sample_reviews_en.text: Has everything a spa should offer. This establishment is fairly new (not even a year old).. is very clean and open space .. they also provide 4 free Sauna ceremonial sessions throughout the day. Definitely a spa I’d recommend to try out…Paul (the owner) is also a really nice humble man who has put his heart and soul into this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Zacharia

sample_reviews_en.text: Its a good place. They have a sauna show, ice bath and a free drink. The lady who is manager has a big mouth though, judges people as they walk in and can be rude. She should learn to zip it shut, dont argue with customers and do her job without the attitude and judging. Otherwise its good and i would have given 5 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: matthew boss

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited 4 different Sauna in Pattaya and this is the best for me. Dry Sauna room is the best. Now there is also an ice baht. Entrance fee 220baht is a good price. Very nice owners, they just started and making improvements all the time. Few times a day he does an session in sauna room with leaves or oil which is great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Koen Lemmens

restaurants.name: Rotinis Cafe and Hostel
restaurants.address:

497/7 Phetchaburi Rd, Thung Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stumbled upon Rotinis Cafe during our Bangkok trip, and wow, what a find! This halal spot near Masjid Darul Aman totally won our hearts (and stomachs).

The grilled beef here is absolutely chef's kiss – juicy, tender, with melt-in-your-mouth fats that were pure heaven. My kids loved it so much they immediately asked for a second order! You know it's good when the little ones won't stop raving about it. Honestly, I don't blame them – it was truly exquisite.

We also tried the nasi kerabu Thai-style, which was a pleasant surprise! Not bad at all – a nice fusion twist that added something different to our meal. The flavors were authentic and well-balanced.

What we really appreciated was the variety on the menu. From local Thai favorites to comfort food, everything looked appetizing. The atmosphere is casual and welcoming, perfect for families who want great halal food without any fuss.

Fair warning: come early if you can, as there can be queues during peak times – but that's always a good sign, right? Definitely worth adding to your Bangkok halal food list!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anas Alwi

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was there for breakfast on May 9 and May 10. They have another place in an alleyway I think, but this place is right on a main street, so it's easier for you to find. It's right near the Darul Aman Mosque.

The place is small but not that small. It can still hold about 10-12 clients at a time. There are seats for babies too. And the staffs were very friendly.

The food was served fast (about 5-10 mins) and yummy. The egg chocolate roti was sweet and chewy. The beef porridge was just a little a bit salty for me, but I think it depends on each person's taste. Drinks tasted good too. They even give you bamboo(?) takeaway cup holder, very cute.

And the price is very reasonable. All of my breakfast was under 100 bath. Will definitely come back to this place if I'm going to Bangkok again in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Trần Phương Nhi

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you want to go here, I advice you to take BTS Phaya Thai Station cause its consider near than BTS Ratchathewi.

The food was amazing. I ordered tomyam noodle, roti egg choc, and beef skewers delicious as Don Donki in Malaysia. All those food delicious.

Next day, we ordered via grabfood nasi briyani ayam and roti egg. Still not dissapointed, we can eat it before go to airport. This review is just few days after arived Malaysia and I already miss food I had in Bangkok. Thank you Rotinis and you is leaving in my brain literally for free. Hope to visit Bangkok again in the future :(
sample_reviews_en.author: Siti

sample_reviews_en.text:
Outstanding Malaysian halal breakfast.  Nasi Lemak was decent.  The ikan bilis was a little sweat and not too salty.  The rice was aromatic but not too strong on the coconut.  My only complaint was the chicken thigh was a little dry.  I think it must have been precooked earlier in the morning.

I also had the roti breakfast set which consisted of two types of roti with a thin chicken curry canai.  Very flavorful with a well done fried egg.  The two types of roti were the highlight of the meal.

I will definitely be back for this delicious Malaysian breakfast.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Bruneel

sample_reviews_en.text:
Looking for something to eat in Ratchathewi? This place is definitely worth a visit! If you’re craving halal Malaysian food at an affordable price, I highly recommend it.

I ordered the Satay and Thai Tea, both were delicious. The Satay was flavourful and the Thai Tea was refreshing 🍽️

The restaurant is quite small, but it has a warm, homey atmosphere. The staff are also very friendly and even speak Malay, so don’t hesitate to ask for their recommendations.

If you’re around Ratchathewi and looking for a cozy spot with tasty food, give this place a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Reza Alif

sample_reviews_en.text: Went here for breakfast, the cafe is quite small and limited seats are available. Luckily we have a seat during our visit even though there were a lot of people at that time. There are a variety of foods to order from roti to tomyam to fried rice. The food is all good and delicious, the portions are fair and the price is also affordable. The service was also very nice and the waiter could speak Malay. The waiting time is not long. Despite the size or the cafe they can maintain the cleanliness of the venue.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hafizun Mushtafa

sample_reviews_en.text: Definitely a Malaysian & Muslim choice for a halal breakfast place. Everything we ordered here is sooo good. Their roti of many kinds are amazing! We tried the roti telur with chocolate and milo also their roti chacol and everything is tasted good. Iced coffee is good. Service is fast with cozy ambience. Staff is also friendly and price is certainly reasonable. Their grilled beef is a must try!
sample_reviews_en.author: M. Asyraf Shariffuddin

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is superb, delicious and worth for money..Taste is good, the preparation also fast. For the first time, the Google mention it is closed on Wednesday but they have 2 outlets nearby..In term of rooms it is a bit smaller..around 20 pax max..if go a lot of people, recommended to book first..Please bear in mind, they only received cash only..No Card, No Online and No Transfer..Cash Only
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohd Amrin

restaurants.name: Gimme Gimme Cafe and Gallery
restaurants.address:

ใกล้ BTS, ปาก Phet Kasem 25/4 Alley, Bang Wa, Bangwa, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Gimme Gimme Cafe

A cafe on Phetkasem Road.
Decorated in a blue color scheme.
It's a cafe combined with an gallery.
The decor is very nice.
A white, black, and cream color scheme would probably work well with this one.
The cafe has two floors.
It's right on the main road with parking available.
Plenty of parking spaces, no need to risk parking on the street.
You can sit for as long as you like; 2 hours is enough to get your parking ticket stamped.

Lemon Coffee
Coffee mixed with lemon and the fizziness of soda.
Very refreshing.
Perfect for those who want something fresh.
Strong lemon aroma.
The sourness is prominent, with a faint espresso flavor.
But if you like it sweet, you'll need to ask for syrup.
Personally, I don't like sweet drinks, so this is perfect.
7.5 out of 10
Price: 110 baht

Latte
This one is good. It has the intensity of espresso,
but still maintains a smooth texture.
7.8 out of 10
Price: 80 baht

P.S. Currently, there's a Lunch Time promotion: food + drinks for no more than 80 baht each, or a special price of 200 baht. Try it out!

#CoffeeReviewFestival
#PanitTheFoodie
😊☕️🍰
sample_reviews_en.author: Panitta Ruengpanyawut

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wonderful wonderful. The food was delicious. The drinks are delicious. The air conditioning was amazing. The staff was friendly. The atmosphere was a vibe.
I have to take a star for one reason only: the amount of ice in their drinks is criminal. I couldn't get my straw in my cup. I was so hot and thirsty, I finished the drink before the ice melted and the cup was completely full of ice. So I only got 1/3 of a beverage and the rest just melted away. It's just a waste and I ended up buying two drinks, which whatever. I don't mind buying more but I do mind paying for ice. Just add water if you want to cut ingredients and save money.
Also, takeout cups for dine in is a crime against our already dying planet. Come on people! Respect Mother Earth 🌍🌎
sample_reviews_en.author: Lexi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great tea and coffee.. Excellent in fact. Small meals.. Chic.. Ellegant.. Great ambiance good music.... Not what what i expected as i walked in..  fast forward to 09 November 2022 more than a year later... The menu changed a bit.. and seating arrangements previously shown in photographs has changed to more dining tables and much fewer lounge chairs... service still good.. food still great.. drinks menu still extensive..

27 April 2025
Counter service still polite and friendly - some dishes not available on the menu.
Excellent venue for a small dinner.
sample_reviews_en.author: B. F. G.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is near BTS Bang Wa, on the main road. There's no parking lot, so you have to park wherever you can find a spot in the nearby side streets. They have a diverse menu, including coffee pairings, and a variety of desserts. The food isn't bad; it might not be amazing, but we ate everything we ordered! We especially liked the brownie – we prefer it soft – so we asked them to warm it up, and it was delicious.

Overall, we liked the spaghetti and the crispy pork more than the rice dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Here and There by Cher

sample_reviews_en.text: This chic and chill cafe is so peaceful, perfect for unwinding. The food is incredibly delicious and the portions are generous. The desserts are also amazing. It's definitely worth more than the price. They don't use MSG, and there are comfortable seating areas perfect for working. I'm so glad this cafe is near my house! It's open until 10 PM 🩷. The service is great, and the food and desserts come out very quickly. The iced chocolate is also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natchaporn Pornwechamnuay

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere inside the shop is great. The shop has a wide variety of menus including food, desserts, and drinks. The drinks include both alcoholic and non-alcoholic options. We ordered a less-sweet caramel milk tea and a less-sweet rose lemon tea. Both drinks were less sweet as requested, had a sweet aroma, and tasted delicious.
It's very easy to get to the shop because it's near the Bang Wa BTS station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Me May

sample_reviews_en.text: The interior is unique, perfect for taking interesting photos, and there's pleasant music playing in the background. It was quite crowded on the weekend, but there aren't many seats. It's good for both breakfast and lunch. I didn't particularly like the croissant; it was soggy, but the waffles were delicious, and the fruit was fresh. They have a wide selection of drinks and a varied menu ☕️🧇
sample_reviews_en.author: Varvara M

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was a bachelors student when they were starting. I was their customer even before their soft opening. Tbh, this is a place for the coffee lovers. But if you arent one, dont worry. This place has amazing pictures which you could keep staring at all day.

The owner himself is one of Nikon's brand ambassadors and most of the shots are his. Dont mind asking for an autograph😂
sample_reviews_en.author: Sudev Kumar Shah

restaurants.name: Thong Fah Thai Restaurant
restaurants.address:

1249 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
AVOID - Rips off tourists.
Was enjoying a lovely meal here until the bill came. EVERYTHING had increased in price and the lady was being very coy about showing us the actual bill. 3 months in Thailand and one of our most expensive meals for very simple Thai food. I checked back over the menu and she bought out another one with higher prices. So I found another menu. She was trying to charge us the highest price for every dish and I had to explain that the higher costs shown was for the choice of meat. For example; we had chicken she was trying to charge us for prawns. Some prices just wasn’t even there.
A friend went the next day and she did the same to them.  This lady is a cheat!
sample_reviews_en.author: N T

sample_reviews_en.text:
First thing first, I liked it when there is pricing on the menu. and this shop has it. So, less chance of getting conned.

Their claypot ginger chicken rice and Pad Thai was good. Eat it with pickled chilli and it's wonderful. Their coconut water is fresh and their mango sticky rice is delicious. Though the mango sticky rice is a bit pricey.

Overall, it was very good customer service and hospitable because they tried speaking English.

Oh ya, their pork satay is so so. Chicken is better. Anything with pork is cheaper in Thailand. Tom Yam here is also average. You don't miss out if you don't have it.

My advice to the owners: Think your old pictures need some dusting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Reshmy Ranee

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. Staying nearby, I walked in. The owner spoke some Chinese and English. The menu had pictures and prices, making it easy to order. When I ate there, other foreign tourists were also dining. The owner was very friendly, and we communicated in simple Chinese.

2. The rice noodles were delicious, with a light broth.

3. The basil pork can also be made without spice; simple and delicious.

4. A local shop; even the chairs are unique.

5. There are customer feedback comments on the wall.

6. The orange drink was good. Ordering a drink comes with a cup of ice, which dilutes the sweetness.
sample_reviews_en.author: WIN DUAN

sample_reviews_en.text:
At first glance, the menu looks cheap, but in reality it's not.
The price of stir-fried dishes varies depending on whether you order them with or without rice.
The option without rice is about twice as expensive as the option with rice.
If you order a few dishes without rice as snacks to go with your beer, it can get quite pricey.
The taste is average.
When I asked for some sliced ​​cucumber, which they serve with khao pad as a palate cleanser, they gave me about five pieces,
but they still took 50 baht from me.
It's a bit disappointing, as the lady there seemed very kind and homey.
sample_reviews_en.author: ぱんとら

sample_reviews_en.text:
Small typical Thai Restaurant near by the Ibis river side hotel.

We just came by they way late evening.
The lady talks English, she loves her restaurant have a very good feeling for her home made food and is on top very kind and professional.
Her  restaurant is lead by hearth and brain.

I am vegan and have lots of extra asking

Papaya salad with our sugar and no  fish  sauce.
Her papaya salad was simply the best what I ever had.
Green curry vegetable like a dream .

Highly recommended.
They are just simply perfect 💕
sample_reviews_en.author: De 3d slayer Kroll

sample_reviews_en.text:
I drove here based on the hotel information: unfortunately, I only got as far as the entrance area.

First of all, I couldn't find suitable shoes, and walking barefoot wasn't allowed in the front area.

When I asked what was offered and what the inside looked like, I was told to look it up on Google.

And when it came to admission, I was only offered expensive packages for 3000 THB, or I could just opt ​​for a regular admission ticket to get a feel for it.

So I later went to Let's Relax Onsen instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: R.-E. St.

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is close to my accommodation and the food is delicious, so I've been there four times. Everything I've tried—tom yum goong, chicken fried rice, phu pad pong curry, and suki—was delicious. My kids enjoyed every meal. It's also great value, so I could order five or six dishes without feeling overwhelmed. They only serve musate in the evening, but when I got there too late, they were all sold out, which was a shame. Next time I visit Thailand, I'd love to stop by and try musate.
sample_reviews_en.author: 위현아

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stumbled upon this local restaurant while staying at the Ibis Riverside Bangkok. It's a bit pricey for a local restaurant, I'd say. However, the two of us ordered seven dishes, and they were all delicious. In particular, the morning glory, the hangover-fighting rice noodles, and the stir-fried squid were all above average and perfectly suited to Korean palates.
It's close to our accommodation and a great restaurant. I also really enjoyed the Tom Yum Goong.
sample_reviews_en.author: jeeyeon Kim

restaurants.name: かつや - Katsuya - Fortune Town branch
restaurants.address:

47 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Atmosphere/Facilities: Shopping mall food counter, Japanese cuisine, air conditioning, wooden tables and chairs

Specialties: Tonkatsu (fried pork cutlet) rice, tonkatsu set meals

Located on the first floor of the Fortune Town Digital Mall near Phramakul MRT station in Bangkok, this is a Japanese tonkatsu (fried pork cutlet) restaurant. A good place to grab lunch after a long day of shopping. A bowl of tonkatsu rice and a drink cost 188 baht. This is one of the cheapest Japanese restaurants in Thailand, especially considering the air conditioning.

The overall taste was pretty good. The sauce was on the sweeter side, unlike typical tonkatsu sauces; it was more like a sauce for eel rice. The tonkatsu was made to order and very crispy. The rice was perfectly cooked and tasted great with the tonkatsu and sauce. It was so delicious you could eat it one after another.

The drinks were just average.

I wouldn't make a special trip just to eat here, but if you're nearby, you can give it a try.

The bad experience was that it took 15 minutes after I ordered for the waiter to come and tell me the food was already made and I had to change it. That was way too long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ray's Original

sample_reviews_en.text:
We arrived at this branch around 5:40 PM. We ordered the Lava Shrimp Rice with Creamy Egg and Chicken Katsu. We waited for a very long time, almost half an hour. There were only 4 people in the restaurant, including our table. When the food was finally served, it was the wrong dish – I think it was a cheese-topped rice dish. I told the person taking the order that I had pointed to the picture, but they got it wrong. She said, "I'm not very experienced yet," with a stern face and no apology. I was very dissatisfied and walked out. We had to pay for the food ourselves.
The female employee, whose name I don't know, was short, plump, and dark-skinned.
sample_reviews_en.author: pannida Chansri

sample_reviews_en.text: The food didn't match the pictures at all. The staff were playing around, throwing things around noisily. Even when someone warned them that there were customers present, they didn't stop. They were joking around, sulking, and making sarcastic remarks to other staff members outside the group (not the one who warned them). They kept throwing things around, making a lot of noise, and repeated the action. The stainless steel pot was very loud from the moment we sat down until the food was served. I wonder if there was a senior staff member who could have told them off? There was no senior staff member at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dd Dd

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my go-to restaurant when I crave pork cutlet rice. I often eat at the Fortune branch. I like it because the portion size is generous; there's a lot of rice and large pieces of pork. Compared to the price, it's quite a lot, very filling. The taste is a Thai-style Japanese, easy to eat and delicious. The food is always served hot and fresh. I've ordered many dishes at this branch; the curry is also delicious, and the soup is good too. The service is decent, except for the billing process which is a bit slow every time. The restaurant is clean, comfortable, and the service is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Acha Yhamruksa

sample_reviews_en.text:
it is chain restaurant you find almost in.many shopping mall, value for money, can eat all crispy and fried chicken, shrimp.pork etc but oyster missing, better order set meal with miso soup and tea drink, fast and courteous service

visited today again, ordered creamy mala hotpot with pork meat, it was spicy enough but seems a bit too salty, green tea ordered refill adds 15baht, the restaurant absorbed VAT, which i did not need to pay, and no service charge
sample_reviews_en.author: dr ken chao

sample_reviews_en.text: Walk pass the restaurant many times, finally gave it a try. Ordered the 269 set + refill drink. It is really valued for money. In fact that it is too much food for one person. The pork cutlet is nice but pretty standard. I ordered the fried chicken skin as my second dish. It is sinful and delicious. What surprised me is the soup. Usually most restaurant serve miso soup but Katsuya  serve a very hearty soup, packs with lots of veggies. Feel very homemade.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kesmond Kwek

sample_reviews_en.text:
Katsuya Japanese Restaurant (Donkatsu) is located in Fortune Town, Level 1. Quite busy around 7 pm but serving fast. Happy with Loin and Minced Katsu set, comes with rice, miso and small sides. Katsu is crispy outside and juicy inside, but that minced katsu was the real deal. Set of three sauces on the side. Topped with matcha ice cream to finish the feast.

Generous portion for the price. Clean place. Happy to visit again. Recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Farangondiet

sample_reviews_en.text: Quick serving menu, suitable for lunchtime. Nice Katsu with good care from robot-like staff. Tonkotsu Sauce is a bit too sour. Recommend sasemi salad dressing instead. Nice to still have refill drinks (Pepsi, Lipton, Greentea) also promotions with ShopeePay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supoj Tom

restaurants.name: Zaab Eli
restaurants.address:

ศูนย์การค้าเซ็นทรัลเวิลด์ ชั้น1 (โซน HUG THAI เลขที่ 4 4/1-4 ซ. วิภาวดี 2 แยก 4-4 Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Zaap E-Lee, this branch, is consistently the standard you can rely on.

I usually come with my group of friends, but this time I intentionally brought my mother to experience it herself, and I wasn't disappointed at all. The food is still spicy, flavorful, and perfectly balanced in every dish. The quality and attention to detail remain the same.

What I especially appreciate is the warm and professional yet friendly service. Every visit isn't just about eating; it's an experience I want to repeat.

For me, Zaap E-Lee isn't just my regular restaurant, but one of my favorite comfort places where I can confidently bring my loved ones. 🌶️
sample_reviews_en.author: MAXTERIALBWOY

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an Isaan restaurant in a shopping mall that really makes great food. Having tried several branches, I personally like this one the most.

My favorite dishes:
- Som Tum with thin rice noodles: My absolute favorite. So flavorful! It pairs perfectly with the crispy pork cracklings.
- Duck Larb: They have a slightly fusion twist here, adding fried shallots, but it works surprisingly well.
- Strawberry Som Tum

If you're looking for an Isaan restaurant in a mall, I always recommend this one.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marmalade Pear

sample_reviews_en.text:
So disappointed！We ordered a small salad, which was priced at 95 THB on the menu.
However, when we got the bill, it was 120 THB. They said it was because an egg was added, but we never asked for an egg — we only ordered the small size. The waiter admitted it was their mistake, but the staff member who seemed like the manager had a bad attitude.

In the end, they only refunded 15 THB. This is the first time during our trip in Thailand that we felt like we were being overcharged.
sample_reviews_en.author: Totoro

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the prices were standard for CentralWorld. The restaurant isn't very big, so there aren't many seats, but it wasn't crowded when I went, which was fine. What I liked was that you could order your food with your preferred level of spiciness. Dishes I didn't want spicy weren't spicy at all, while those I wanted were satisfyingly spicy! Haha.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanit Paopao Vinitchagoon

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves incredibly delicious and flavorful food, especially the spicy mangosteen salad, which I order every time I visit. It's amazing! All the food is fantastic and suits my taste. If you don't like spicy food, be sure to inform the staff, otherwise it will be extremely spicy! 😽
sample_reviews_en.author: Yokavee โยกาวี

sample_reviews_en.text: When I entered the restaurant, I immediately saw a rat inside the shop. That made me feel very uncomfortable and concerned about cleanliness. On top of that, the food took a very long time to be served after ordering. Overall, my experience was very poor and completely unsatisfactory.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ye Yint Paing Oo

sample_reviews_en.text: Came because of the good reviews, but the service was rude. I politely asked a staff member (who appeared to be the manager) about a dish. He didn’t look at me, said “no,” and walked away. Completely unprofessional. I left and went to a Michelin-listed restaurant nearby instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rebecca S

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and came out quickly, but the waitress, a bit chubby, was unbearable. It was like she was being forced to work there. We asked for a child's plate because we were afraid our child would break it, and she just had a world-weary expression on her face.
sample_reviews_en.author: J F

restaurants.name: Donita Thaifoods
restaurants.address:

122/79 Ratchaprarop Rd, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
First time here, and glad to say we had a pretty good meal overall.

Some dishes were flavourful with a good kick of spice. The menu had plenty of options — almost too many — and we had a hard time choosing! Thankfully, most of what we ordered turned out well.

The standout was the sotong with curry — done nicely with great flavour. The tom yum soup was also a hit: intense, rich, and just the right level of heat (we asked for extra spice). The pork omelette wasn’t too bad either — simple but satisfying.

Unfortunately, the fried rice was a major disappointment. The flavour just didn’t land at all, and we had expected much more from that dish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ars 3276

sample_reviews_en.text:
I found quite a few positive reviews on Google Maps, but my experience wasn't quite there; the prices were high compared to the quality.
The staff were enthusiastic and served quickly, the tables and chairs were clean, but the food didn't suit my taste. Partly because I'm a foreigner, I wasn't sure if the restaurant actually made the food authentically. I ordered two mango and avocado smoothies, and they felt mostly ice and water; the price wasn't cheap at all. The Tom Yum flavor was decent, but not outstanding compared to other places I've tried.

Overall, I won't be returning to this restaurant…
sample_reviews_en.author: Diem Le

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited this place twice in one week that I was in Bangkok, and had been here multiple times in the last 10 years. The food is so good and affordable!

Their seafood tomyum soup with milk is one of the best I ever had, and their standard is super consistent. I have to have this everytime I come to Bangkok!

The pad thai is too wet and sticky for our liking, but the flavours were on point!

Had the somtam (papaya salad) to-go and it was really addictive, though it was abit too spicy for us even after we requested for less spicy already.

10/10 would recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicole L

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had Pad Thai with Tofu (80 baht) and while it was fairly cheap, it was not edible whatsoever. Tofu was basically raw and the whole meal tasted like oil, completely missing the usual sticky sauce. Didn’t come with nuts either. Had MUCH better food for less money.
Sitting there was uncomfortable as there were several kids playing about 10 different videos/songs on full volume which neither the staff nor parents cared about.
Would definitely not recommend eating here and do not understand the many good reviews.
sample_reviews_en.author: enie kapllani

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is so good; delicious food, great service, good portions, reasonable prices. They’re walking distance to our accom so we’ve eaten here everyday for the past 5 days, sometimes twice a day. We’ve had the pad Thai, Tom yum, green curry, red curry, omelettes, fried rice, this amazing fried pork dish (crispy pork belly with chill and salt stir fry), fried prawns, veges, all of it is fire, all times of the day and night. The consistency is on! Also had all the smoothies…all fresh and delicious! 10/10
sample_reviews_en.author: Celia Taylor

sample_reviews_en.text: Great local taste with affordable price. The place is a bit at the narrow alley but easily accessible to search at google map. Recommend to walk along the alley rather than taking the taxi coz it might take longer. The shop is a bit small so there aren’t many tables but still they can manage it. The foods are really nice and you can ask them not too much spicy if you are not a fan of chilies. Try their signature dishes and for the drinks, try coconut smoothies. You will love their authentic taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anita Cai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing food, very friendly & cheerful staff, quick service & very reasonable prices.
The place does not have an ambiance to speak of... but it more than makes up for it with incredibly tasty food.
For me, the crispy pork (available in a number of dishes) tops the list. Even the fish is always cooked to perfection- soft, moist & delicious. The veggies are crisp & tender.
For me, this is one of the best small Thai food restaurants in all Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neil Pereira

sample_reviews_en.text:
This wont be the easiest place to find, we happened to walk past it while looking for something to eat and decided to give it a try.

I’ve forgotten the exact name of the dish I ordered, but it was an instant noodle dish and it turned out to be surprisingly good. The broth was flavorful, the noodles were satisfying, and overall it was a tasty meal.

Definitely worth the calories, and I’d be happy to drop by again if I’m in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: James Tan

restaurants.name: Chef's Table by Lebua เชฟส์เทเบิล บาย เลอบัว
restaurants.address:

61st Floor, State Tower, 1055 Si Lom Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was only our third Michelin restaurant experience, and we actually flew into Bangkok for the night as a break from our beach vacation in Phuket. Overall, the experience was good, but not great. The food was, as you'd expect, beautifully presented, and tasted good, although a few of the items were not to our taste (which is fair enough). We did the wine pairing, which again was good, but not great. Can't really say why, other than it leaned into whites (and a cider!), and we tend to prefer reds.

Our main issue was the upsells before dining. This is already a pretty expensive endeavor for most of us, so the upsells for more caviar, more truffle (and one other option I forget) got a little tedious, and it made the whole thing a bit tacky. Have it as an option on the table perhaps, but we don't need the song and dance.

We stayed in the hotel, which as others have said, is looking worn in places. I don't know how to describe it, the room was huge, and well appointed, but the overall vibe was a typical 1990's US Marriott, so not really becoming of the restaurants at the top.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pete White

sample_reviews_en.text:
Service experience started at the very ground floor itself. Kudos to the management team for attention to details. Being escorted up to the restaurant is a bonus as there are multiple establishments in the complex. Not easy to navigate as you need to make lift transfers.

Once at the restaurant, you will be handled gracefully over. Staffs are engaging and offered to provide a tour of the place and kitchen. The excellent service went all the way until we leave the hotel. We were gracefully escorted to the hotel lobby and arrangement made for the taxi as well. Much much appreciated.

Food wise, was rather disappointed. We tried both menus since we get to choose the dishes. Presentations and plating are beautiful, but sometimes less is more. The over all feeling is the chef is experimenting and hope to get feedback from the diners rather than serving a well curated dishes. Some ingridients on the dishes seem out of place.

Certain dishes like the langustines are spot on. But both fish dishes fall flat (taste and seasoning).
sample_reviews_en.author: Guanny G

sample_reviews_en.text:
9/10 It was a great experience from the moment we walked in the restaurant. The staff was beyond excellent in their service and accommodation. They went above and beyond to make sure everyone had an amazing time.

One person in our party was such a picky eater that the staff ended up talking to the chef, and he changed the menu for him to accommodate his palate, this was already 3 courses in. Quick dynamic thinking by the staff and the chef, we were all very impressed.

The food was excellent, every dish sets up and compliments the next. This is something I have come to expect from a restaurant of this caliber.
Im a supertaster and I want more complexity in my dishes and that wasnt present in the first 2 courses, but as the courses progressed the complexity of the dishes compounded and I was impressed by the chefs food pairings. The Dessert was a stand out because the flavors were risky, but it works and its impressive. I highly recommend the restaurant and ask for Louise to book your reservation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Malek Batterjee

sample_reviews_en.text: Our dinner at the Chef's Table was an exceptional experience.  We selected the restaurant among the Lebua offerings in part because of the open kitchen experience, and we were able to spend some time watching the dessert and cold food preparation throughout the meal, and then having time where the chef explained our main courses and finished them in front of us.  All the food courses were exceptional, and they were so flexible in making adjustments for food preferences (although I am not sure that the current option would have easy vegetarian options, I would imagine that you could certainly ask about this in advance).  We also very much enjoyed the lavish cheese selection, the terrific wine pairings and the many supplemental dessert courses.  We left feeling appropriately full.  Service was all around terrific.  The Michelin stars are well deserved and we would strongly recommend this restaurant, and go back in the future if we have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kelly Ormond

sample_reviews_en.text:
Beautiful experience and great location to celebrate a birthday!

Our waitress (sorry we didn't get her name!) was excellent, friendly, and knew where to draw the line between being overfriendly and super professional.

The restaurant deserves its 2 stars however if I had one thing to say is that we were surprised to see the kitchen close and the team including the chef leave. We understand this is how things work in a standard restaurant but that shouldn't be the case at a restaurant where it is all about the open kitchen in the middle of the room.
The end of our dinner felt a little lonely but then again our waitress made it up for it.
This blue vanilla dessert is still haunting my dreams. I need more!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeremy

sample_reviews_en.text: flavour explosion since canapés with live piano for ambience . I went for the 5 course seasonable menu(with no wine pairing)  and glad that I did . This is testament to their awards . Service is exceptional as expected of a 2-star Michelin . There was (pleasant) surprise after surprise (which I will not disclose). I took the offer for an interactive experience which allowed access to the kitchen bench to watch the magic happen (plating). I am glad to go easy on the bread for dessert room. The sommelier was patient and offered lovely recommendations for a champagne and red . I look forward to returning to try the signature menu. Definitely a special experience .
sample_reviews_en.author: Suzanna Wong

sample_reviews_en.text:
There are not enough positive words to describe this amazing experience. From the amazing staff that greet you at the lift down to the last mouthful of cake you get to experience back in your hotel with the gift they give you at the end the whole dinner was an absolute highlight for me!

The food is some of the best I have tried in the world, the staff all know every single detail and you can see and feel their passion for the food and the restaurant. Not to mention the chef is so friendly!!

If you are going to Bangkok plan your trip around this restaurant !!!

Could not recommend this restaurant more highly enough!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Marina Makhlin

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve always considered culinary experiences as part of a cultural experience, and this tasting menu took me to a tasteful journey through Thai and French culture.

The service deserves a special mention because the staff knew what we needed even before we knew it. Roy and Christian, fellow Filipinos, were excellent part of the team. Their trio(I forgot the name of the other staff) made the experience so memorable. Kudos also to the sommelier who presented the best wines France has to offer. She knows her craft so well.

Lastly, hats off to the chefs for sharing with us their passion and art through food! ✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Marielle Baun

restaurants.name: Byrd’s Nest Café Vino เบิร์ด เนส คาเฟ่ วีโน
restaurants.address:

1230 Soi Yothinpattana 11, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a restaurant where I regretted spending my money. The food is extremely overpriced; the quality of the food doesn't match the price paid at all. The atmosphere is okay, but not amazing.
The duck breast salad costs 450++ baht. The vegetables are okay, but the dressing is bland, like pre-made dressing. The worst part is the duck breast; you can tell it was microwaved and then sliced ​​and placed on top of the vegetables. It's totally not worth the price.
The pasta tastes like what you'd get at a typical franchise restaurant. There's too much bacon and very little of it. You can find much better-tasting and higher-quality pasta elsewhere for 350++ baht.
A regular bottle of Singha water is 50++ baht, with ice separate. The service is standard; the staff didn't even ask to open a new bottle of water. Credit card payments require a minimum of 2000 baht. Once is more than enough. Everything is unreasonably expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rasita Tachaworrawong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Bird's restaurant, singer of Bird and Heart band, I heard from my friend that both of them will come to sing on Sunday during the day.
Good songs from the band, very beautiful.

The restaurant has 2 parts, the outside is a garden and the inside is a glass room with air conditioning and a stage at the end, can accommodate about 15 tables.
As for the food, it is very slow. It took 50 minutes to wait for both dishes.
Fried rice with beef - The pieces of beef are very small, probably less than 200 grams, and the beef is well-done. It looks very different from the picture on the menu. I took the reference picture from the restaurant's FB because I didn't want to ask for the menu to take a new picture.
Salmon pumpkin quinoa - The salmon in the picture is a bit overcooked, but overall it's delicious.

I think the restaurant should inform or adjust the waiting time for the food to be faster.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warit Sakdaronnarong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Byrd’s Nest Cafevino 🌿🌟🌷☕️
A brunch cafe on Ram Intra Expressway with a great vibe and a natural feel🌱 For those looking for a place to chill, sip coffee, or work comfortably, this place has a wide selection of brunch menus🤍 The outdoor atmosphere is super shady. Recommended dishes are the Smoke Salmon Benedict🍳 and the Squid and Prawns Arrabiata Pasta🍝. They serve a huge plate of food. Every dish is delicious and the staff is lovely✨. In the evening, it opens as a restaurant with live music🎤 Next time I will come and try it🥳

Byrd’s Nest Cafevino‼️
🕛 Open Tuesday - Sunday (Closed Monday)
☕️ Coffee & Bakery 09.00 - 16.00
🌮 Brunch & Coffee 09.00 - 16.00 (last order 14.30)
