🍷 Dining & Live Music 17.00 - Midnight
🚗 Car Parking Available
sample_reviews_en.author: Onnicha Kp

sample_reviews_en.text:
- There's parking for about 9-10 cars (if it's crowded).

- The restaurant is beautiful with a nice atmosphere, offering both indoor and outdoor seating areas.

- The food is quite expensive, but the portions are large. The menu mainly consists of bread, spaghetti, salads, and smoothies in a cafe style.
The two dishes I ordered were spaghetti and English breakfast, both delicious.

- There's a 10% service charge even though I felt like I wasn't getting any service. We had to share plates and pour our own water, and the staff didn't really pay attention when we called them. It felt like I was being overcharged, especially since the food prices already seem to be significantly higher than cafe prices.😅
sample_reviews_en.author: Beta -

sample_reviews_en.text:
A bistro & cafe with a Khao Yai feel...but without the long drive! Located just off the expressway in Ram Intra, the atmosphere is incredibly lush and relaxing. It feels like you've been transported to another place.

Must-try dishes include:
🔥 Garlic fried rice with picanha steak. Incredibly fragrant with garlic, the meat is juicy and absolutely delicious!
🍝 Smoked bacon spaghetti stir-fried with chili, garlic, and olive oil. Slightly spicy, incredibly fragrant, and incredibly delicious. It's comfort food.

Everything is great: the atmosphere is great, the music is great, and the food is excellent. I'll definitely be back.
#ByrdsNestCafeVino
#bkkfoodie #cafehoppingbangkok
sample_reviews_en.author: Moof Around

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fans of Bird Thongchai and Hart must visit this restaurant because it's owned by Bird Thongchai. You can be assured of a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The food is delicious, there's live music with different bands playing every day, the service is good, and there's ample parking.

Those who enjoy 80s and 90s music will love it. We loved it too. It's a great place to see classic artists from the past – a heartwarming experience.

Nice and welcoming ambiance. Live music to soothe your soul. It's great to see your favorite artists Byrd & Hart at the restaurant.

Food is tasty. Plenty of car parking space.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puenjai P.

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, warm and cozy. The food is truly delicious, every dish is excellent. There's live music around 7 PM, and they play and sing well. Around 9 PM, there are special selected performances. Tonight, I saw Chompoo and Ping (from the band Fruity), who were fantastic and entertaining. On Sunday nights, they have Bird & Heart, which I loved. They have a wide selection of drinks, including interesting cocktails, wine, and draft beer. Reservations are recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: WanI wani

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍽️ During lunchtime, the restaurant serves bistro and cafe-style food.

🐮 The Picanha Steak Sandwich is grilled to perfection, with a smoky aroma and crispy bread.

🥓 The 8-hour smoked bacon is served with almonds and rocket salad. The bacon is smoked to perfection.

🍃 The restaurant has air-conditioned rooms and a garden area, which is pet-friendly.

🎷 Live music is available on Saturdays and Sundays. The restaurant is beautiful and has a relaxing atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: ไป- กลับเมีย

restaurants.name: On the Table @ La Villa Aree
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 356 อาคาร ศูนย์การค้าลาวิลล่า ห้องเลขที่ LAV01LS103 ชั้น 1 Phahon Yothin 7, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I waited about 30 minutes for the first dish to arrive—and it was just a salad. This was surprising, as my previous visit (on a busy Friday) had a similar wait time, which was more understandable given the crowd. However, today was different. The restaurant wasn't busy—only a few tables were occupied, along with two delivery drivers—so the delay was disappointing. Given the 10% service charge, I expected more efficient service. Unfortunately, based on this experience, I wouldn't recommend this branch. There's definitely room for improvement.

I've eaten here twice, and both times the food took over 30 minutes to arrive. The first time was on a busy day, so that was understandable. But today, there were only a few tables occupied, along with two delivery drivers, yet the wait was extremely long. The pizza arrived last, after I had already finished four other dishes, and I still had to wait another 10 minutes. Improvements are needed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saiparn K

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food Taste: Mediocre, nothing amazing. The pictures looked appetizing, but the taste was very average, and the food wasn't even hot. The miso soup was very bland, the ebiko cream spaghetti was bland, lacked flavor, and the noodles were hard. The katsu shrimp was okay. The Buta Hayashi Omu Rice looked appealing, but the taste was mediocre. Most of the food was quite bland. The watermelon smoothie and chocolate milkshake were just average.

Food Waiting Time: The wait for food was extremely long, at least half an hour. It wasn't worth the wait. We had to keep asking about our food, and takeaways are not available. The pudding can only be eaten in the restaurant. Not suitable for lunch due to the long wait time.

Price: Prices are typical for a cafe (including a 10% service charge).

Service: The staff didn't smile.

Personally, I wouldn't return.
sample_reviews_en.author: nojam jn

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was looking for a place to sit and thought to give this place a try. I didn't know this was japanese as i walked inside seeing Pizza.

I had Tofu Teriyaki Don (Veg). It was simple but delicious. Ordered Popeye & Oilve Pizza with thin crust and it was something. It was not enough for two people but one can fill in nicely. Glad they give ketchup bottle and not one spoon of ketchup like other places.

Hot Honey Lemon was outstanding.

Nice clean environment and people are lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Racha King

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a fusion restaurant, blending Western and Asian cuisine. This branch has plenty of seating and isn't too crowded.

They offer set menus, making it easy to order and the dishes mix well together. It's a great place to gather friends and have a relaxing meal.

They also have a wide selection of desserts; you could easily come just for the desserts alone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanachai Tundulyasaree

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, comfortable seating with no queue, perfect for a relaxed chat. Located on the ground floor of Villa Ari, it's easily accessible. The food is delicious; I especially liked the garlic fried rice with teriyaki salmon – the rice was fragrant and the fish portion was large.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kindly 4uth

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is very spacious, but there are hardly any people. The staff are standing around looking bored. As soon as I walked in, I understood why there were so few people. The smell in the shop is very important. I'm not sure if the smell is coming from the air conditioning or not.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kantan RBS

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the first branch I've had to give one star to. Normally, this is one of my favorite restaurants. Today, the staff were grumpy and uninterested in talking to customers. I ordered spaghetti, and the taste was worse than usual. In short, this is just a review of this branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปริพัฒน์ พฤทธิกุล

sample_reviews_en.text: The desserts were tempting and delicious. The staff provided excellent service, and the atmosphere was lovely with the air conditioning perfectly cool. I personally loved the tea bar menu, especially the mixed berry rose tea – you have to try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mickey Mx

restaurants.name: Cherry Padthai
restaurants.address:

76 1-2, Talat Yot, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been in Bangkok for several days now and I can say without a doubt that this is the best pad thai I've ever had. The woman who runs it is incredibly friendly and even speaks a few words of Spanish. I highly recommend it; we loved it.
It was very quick and very inexpensive, with generous portions—much more than at other places where I've paid more. If you're in Bangkok, this is a must-stop if you want a good pad thai. The stall is spotless, and you can tell the food is high quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mónica Mateu

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really loved the place. Even though there's no air conditioning, there are plenty of tables and chairs, the service was good, the chicken pasta was delicious, my boyfriend had the shrimp pasta which was also good, and the mango dessert with sticky rice was excellent.

I don't think it's expensive at all, contrary to what some previous reviews have said.

It has a really pretty fountain with fish (I recommend coming in the afternoon and maybe at night if it's open).
sample_reviews_en.author: Gavi Olavarria

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honestly the best pad Thai I’ve had in Thailand, super cheap and tasty! Made fresh infront of you, there’s a little station to add peanuts/ lime/ spice which is great, sad to have found this on my last day!

Edit: came back 9 months later and it’s still as good, we only are in Bangkok for 2 days but I will have cherrys at least 5 times
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarah Wood

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good pad thaï chicken, and surely others are too. The location at the time I write this comment isn’t right she is more down the road next to Weeden ! Look for her kart she is doing amazing food and copious amount too ! Very kind lady
sample_reviews_en.author: Alan

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing pad thai. So far the best in Bangkok. Big portions and very cheap price. Has a lot of eggs tho. The owners are super friendly and welcome you with big smile. Highly recommend 🩷 we went twice there on the trip and it’s always fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: K P

sample_reviews_en.text: The best Pad Thai on Khaosan Road, and in terms of quality/price ratio, I think it might be the best in all of Bangkok. Pad Thai with chicken for only 50 baht. Very friendly service, who even remembered us when we returned a second time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krystian

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious pad thai with fresh ingredients, prepared by an incredibly friendly couple. My daughter only wanted the noodles with meat, which was no problem at all and even on the house. They absolutely refused to accept any money for it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bajram D.

sample_reviews_en.text: I really love the pleasant background music and the taste, which suits Korean palates without any strong preferences! All the staff were incredibly friendly, making for a very enjoyable dining experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: 신재진

restaurants.name: 割烹 夢 Kappo Yume bangkok ความฝันที่เป็นจริง
restaurants.address:

725 Thong Lo, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We also enjoyed the New Year's cuisine 🎍 [Happy New Year Dinner Course] (↓Menu)
Kappo Yume Bangkok is a hidden Japanese restaurant in the Thonglor district.
The owner and head chef, Chef Hayakawa, and his wife were very kind, friendly, and eloquent, with lovely smiles, creating a cozy and friendly atmosphere.
The menu for this day was a special five-day New Year's Festival course.
(Available from January 1st to January 5th)
The meal was an auspicious New Year's set. The food was served quickly, so there was no long wait, and the chef was very skilled. The food was also delicious, allowing you to enjoy traditional Japanese cuisine. Each dish was delicious, thanks to the unique kappo style.
The menu here changes monthly, while retaining signature dishes.
You can enjoy a variety of seasonal dishes, so I plan to return.
There are three parking spaces in front of the restaurant. The bar counter can accommodate up to nine people. A VIP room is also available for up to six people.
Walk-ins are not accepted, so we recommend making a reservation one day in advance.

[Menu]
Uni
Osechi
Mochi Soup
Surprised Dish
Sashimi
Grilled Fish
Tempura
Wagyu/Truffle
Osekihan
Pickle
Dessert
sample_reviews_en.author: ふじー

sample_reviews_en.text:
✨A hidden gem where you'll discover cuisine that's like opening a jewel box✨
With delicious flavors, a wonderful atmosphere, and a friendly host and hostess,
this Japanese restaurant is a dream come true.

The chef, who has served as a chef at official residences around the world, offers the quintessential Japanese dashi broth, a flavor that seeps into your body and is a sublime experience. Other dishes, such as Oma tuna from Aomori and seared beef with generous amounts of Italian truffles, brought out the finest ingredients with delicate yet skillful preparation. The dishes, presented in traditional Thai benjarong pottery, also highlight the elegant atmosphere.

This restaurant is perfect for those seeking a hidden gem where you can savor authentic Japanese cuisine without pretense. Whether it's for a special occasion or just to recharge, this restaurant offers a relaxing atmosphere and a truly recharged energy. A must-visit for Thai and international fans of Japanese food!✨
(I had the January omakase course.) Apparently, they also serve osechi ryori (New Year's dishes) every year.
sample_reviews_en.author: ayumi MA

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a hidden gem.

A cozy, homey Japanese restaurant.

The chef, who served as a private chef at official residences in France, UNESCO, Ukraine, and Thailand for many years, showcases his skills in this authentic Japanese restaurant.

I'll never forget the zoni (rice cake soup) with its rich bonito broth! I want to eat it again!

I'd like to revisit just for that; I've never tasted such delicious broth before!

There are counter seats and private rooms, making it recommended for business dinners, dates, and family outings.

It seems they also have a chef's authentic kids' meal that children can enjoy.

How luxurious!

They also source carefully selected ingredients from Italy and France, and the monthly changing menu allows you to savor seasonal dishes!

And best of all, even though I ate my fill with the OMAKASE course, my stomach didn't feel heavy at all.

That's truly the essence of good cooking.

The course starts at a very reasonable 2800++! You'll be greeted by a friendly owner and a soothing proprietress.
sample_reviews_en.author: K I

sample_reviews_en.text:
What a truly special experience. The food here was absolutely delicious—every dish felt like a work of art, and it was unlike any other omakase I’ve had in Bangkok. You can really feel the passion behind every bite.

What made it even more memorable was how the chef personally shared the story and origin of nearly every ingredient. His knowledge and love for food are on another level, and it made the entire meal so much more meaningful.

His wife was just as wonderful—so warm, kind, and engaging. She made us feel completely at home and brought such a lovely energy to the evening. It honestly felt like we were guests in their home, not just diners at a restaurant.
It’s rare to find a place that combines incredible food, deep knowledge, and heartfelt hospitality all in one. Can’t wait to come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neo Chaikhot

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a meal at Kappo Yume with Chef Naoki. He's incredibly experienced in cooking, and each course was excellent. The restaurant has a traditional atmosphere, the service was superb, and the chef was very friendly, straight from Japan – so charming! ❤️ As for the food, each course is imported directly from different regions of Japan, according to the season. Everything is incredibly fresh, and the flavors are amazing, captivating from the first bite to the last. ❤️ I was extremely impressed. If I have the chance, this is definitely one of my go-to restaurants. The ingredients, service, and food quality were all top-notch. 😊 My favorite part was the rice – it's truly the best! ❤️❤️ There's parking for about 3 cars in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: luxproglam

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's presumptuous of me to comment.
From the ingredients to the preparation (is that what you call it?) and the way it's served, everything is done with care.
It somehow reminds me of Bushido. Cooking is a matter of mind, technique, and body.
The gentle smiles and hospitality of the proprietress and staff add to this gentle harmony.
This is a spacious tea room.
A wonderful time to relax and enjoy gourmet food.
It's a space where you can really feel that Bushido and the tea ceremony are connected!
Once you've been there, you'll want to make a reservation again right away...
But I can't visit that often (lol).
Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: 藤井祐造

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered a 5,000 baht New Year's meal.
I was really looking forward to it because Yume's food is so delicious, but...
I was surprised when it arrived! 💨
It came in a supermarket-style New Year's package, with no main ingredient, and all the ingredients were cut into tiny pieces, making it look more like a makunouchi bento.
In short, I thought it was pretty disappointing.

I know it's difficult to do this overseas, but for that price, I wish they'd put a little more effort into it.
The food was delicious, but...
I was kind of disappointed (-.-;)y
sample_reviews_en.author: Emu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kappo Yume Bangkok is an omakase restaurant in Thonglor that we consider a hidden gem. It's been open for over a year, and most of its customers are Japanese, so it might not be very well-known to the general public.
The restaurant serves omakase in three courses: 2,800 / 4,800 / 7,200 THB. All courses use high-quality, fresh ingredients imported from Japan and are prepared by a Japanese chef.
We had the 4,800 THB course, and the ingredients were fresh, varied, and delicious. We think it's well worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarat Traipiyavong

restaurants.name: A. Elbasha Sukhumvit 26 Branch (Halal Lebanese & Turkish Restaurant) Family Branch فرع العوائل
restaurants.address:

No. 12/70 72 1Soi Atthakawi Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I loved the food, vibes, and service. The beef Kabab wrap tasted super fresh and I really enjoyed the sauces that came with it. Another thing that I loved about this restaurant is that they actually serve MT. DEW, which is a rare find in Bangkok. This restaurant has branches all over the city, so I definitely plan to come back and enjoy more dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neil Schmitt

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered chicken kabsa and other items, but the rice turned out to be spoiled. We informed the employee, and she confirmed it was spoiled. When the bill arrived, instead of compensating us with something else, they wanted us to pay for …
sample_reviews_en.author: Go back Salalah

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good place, splendid hospitality worth every dime. Branch manager K.Noi is knowledgeable and K.Hussam also accommodate us with the highest gratitude.

Appreciate every minute there
sample_reviews_en.author: Louize

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food, great atmosphere, and excellent service. It's well worth the price with a wide variety of menu options. Plus, there’s plenty of parking right in front.
sample_reviews_en.author: MPaWN

sample_reviews_en.text: I had an absolutely wonderful time at Elbasha! This family-friendly branch is a gem for anyone looking for authentic Halal Lebanese and Turkish cuisine. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Kasinchin Sivanarthanon

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food with unique flavors, featuring Halan-style braised beef, a Chinese dish of quality and deliciousness passed down through generations.
sample_reviews_en.author: ศตวรรษ เดวัน

sample_reviews_en.text: Great food, super friendly staff, and a really nice atmosphere. Everything was fresh and delicious. We’ll definitely come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ertan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food there’s something off and doesn’t taste it right! Even we paid for 4000bhat and price isn’t cheap at all .
sample_reviews_en.author: Naw Su San

restaurants.name: Paesano Italian Restaurant
restaurants.address:

63 Nak Niwat Rd, Khwaeng Lat Phrao, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Mediocre food that was a bit overpriced for the quality."

sample_reviews_en.text: Very enjoyable experience at Paesano Lad Phrao, the restaurant is very easy to find and has a lot of parking which is fantastic. It feels like an old school italian place with the music and the vibes, very romantic. We had all the signature items that were recommended. The French onion soup is great, piping hot and full of flavour. The pizza is a light crust, freshly baked and lots of topping. The spaghetti alio olio and lamb are the stand out,  the spaghetti is al dente, garlicky,oily and delicious. The lamb is clearly a standout dish, seared, roasted until medium and served with some "home fries". It's meaty, flavourful and beautifully cooked. The home fries aren't listed on the menu but can for sure be ordered, they are roasted potatoes with caramelized onion. I definitely recommend coming here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Amancio dos Santos

sample_reviews_en.text:
Reminisce with a classic Italian restaurant from a time when Italian cuisine was just starting to become popular in Thailand. This is an old, long-standing establishment that's still around today. The atmosphere and red-brick decor, once a popular trend, remain as they were, making you feel as if you're dining in Italy.

The menu seems to focus more on flavor than appearance. The pasta, though simple in look, is rich and flavorful, catering well to the Thai palate. Dishes like the clam pasta, bacon and garlic pasta, or the seafood risotto are all quite good. In addition to pasta, the restaurant also serves pizza, steaks, and classic desserts like tiramisu.

It's a great spot for dining with family and friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumol

sample_reviews_en.text:
What impressed me was the service. On my first visit, a short male staff member came to recommend the menu, constantly observed and refilled my drinks, and asked how I was doing. The other staff members were also good.
As for the food, the recommended dish, baked clams with bread, was delicious. The two types of bread were great. The pork chop was large and perfectly tender. The spaghetti with bacon and garlic was okay but a little dry. The Italian salad was also decent. The shrimp soup was just okay. We ordered red wine, and the restaurant has a decanter.
The restaurant has plenty of parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Taksaorn Sirikantaramas

sample_reviews_en.text:
Paesano has been my favorite restaurant ever since it first opened back when it was still in Soi Tonson. I’ve celebrated so many special occasions there—including the most important one of all: I proposed to my wife at Paesano.
Every dish holds a memory for me. The garlic clams, garlic bread, onion gratin soup, Italian special salad, and pepper steak are all absolute perfection.
Thank you, Paesano, for not only serving amazing food, but also being part of the most meaningful moments of my life. I’m truly grateful.
sample_reviews_en.author: 岩松正剛

sample_reviews_en.text: Paesano has been an Italian family favorite for decades! From the lobster bisque to garlic bread with baby clams to shrimp diavola to lamb chops to any pasta or pizza on the menu - this place is delicious. It originally used to be located in Soi Ton Son, but since it’s moved to this location nothing has really changed - interior looks the same, service is as great as it was previously. Highly recommend for a family meal, especially a celebration!
sample_reviews_en.author: Devi Bajaj

sample_reviews_en.text: Another old time tried and tested Italian food establishment of Bangkok. First time at their not-so-new location since they moved. One of the best Lamb racks you'll find in town, lovely non-buttery clams and bread basket. Pasta is okay but they have a signature chili oil and do very good tomato sauce. First class service and everything on the dessert menu and bakery are good (scrumptious and moist banana muffin and bael fruit cake).
sample_reviews_en.author: Monsicha Pongrujikorn

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu isn’t very intuitive, so I’d recommend the first timer checking it beforehand. The lamb is excellent in terms of flavor, though the portion is on the smaller side. The pasta was a bit lackluster because the noodle is overcooked (both dish that we had), and the dessert was a disappointment especially from the chef’s perspective I was dining with.
sample_reviews_en.author: kris soju

sample_reviews_en.text: Paisano has the up & down moments but our latest visit were good one.  There are only a few restautant from my childhood's era that're still in biz.  For new gen, they might not enjoy Paisano as much as the old gens because theToday's ideal Italian foods have drastically changed.  Yet, people like us will always going back to dine at Paisano.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pete Zee

restaurants.name: Tempura Yamaya (One Bangkok)
restaurants.address:

B1F, One Bangkok, Parade Building, 1 Witthayu Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Have been craving for some really decent tempuras for a while. Did some research and found this restaurant in ONE Bangkok. The reviews seems good enough for me to decide that this is the place I would like to get my tempura craving fix.

We arrived about 5pm and there is a queue of 14 ahead of us. Ended waiting for 40 mins which is actually not too bad.

We seated in the counter where we can see the kitchen in action.

We ordered:
- Salmon tendon (with additional toppings - chicken and oyster)
- Fish tempura set which includes shrimp, white fish, scallops and some vegetables and shrimp cake
- Cold dipping udon

First of all, the ingredients used are very very fresh and very high quality. I really like the big fat and juicy shrimps which is cooked to perfection. The batter was light and airy, just the way I like it in tempuras.

Side dish were a bit too salty to my liking though. Mentako was too salty even if we eat it with rice. Soups and pickles are alright though not amazing.

Udon was cooked al dente which i love it very much.

All in all, a very pleasant dining experience which I would strongly recommend anyone to at least give it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Low

sample_reviews_en.text:
Read reviews and want to try. Don't like deep fried meal but trust in Japanese style and Google reviews. Waiting for about 1 hour in afternoon period. Scan QR code in QueQ application then can go anywhere.

Order for 3 menus, Yamaya set, Mixed Yamaya set and Kid set change rice to udon. The Kid set was the best of mine. Refill rice, miso soup, takana vegetable and cod roe (mentaiko). Takana and cod roe were served first before main set. The only taste for these are salty. Without rice I hardly eat cod roe alone, it was very salty.

Fried shrimp was fresh and appropriate size. Every fried was oily. Rice was the best in set menu. Miso soup was not salty as think. There were three kinds of salt to seasoning, yuzu salt, curry salt and green teas salt. Yes, salts again. Make everything much more salty and no other taste.

Service was nice and standard like in Japanese restaurant style.

Price was reasonable. Slightly too expensive for fried meal. If you are not mentaiko lover, nothing to enjoy.

Recommend for only cod roe lover. Salty is the definition here. Have time for about 2 hours for afternoon meal, and 3 hours for lunch or dinner time.
sample_reviews_en.author: P. Jit.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is great but service level is terrible and being treated as 2nd grade  customers you went there in t-shirt, shirts and slippers though your bill comes at 2,7xx THB for 2 persons.

We went there around 15:00 hrs and we were very hungry, so we asked for a table for 4 to accommodate all the dishes. However, the waitress told that the table is for 3 or 4 guests and point us to a small table for 2 instead.

Next, The waitress THINK that we order just 1 set, so she told us that the side dishes are for a person who ordered set menu only, so I asked her to checked the order to see that we ordered 2 set, one for each of us, not just 1 set for 2 persons. The point is my friend ordered an Udon, which came to serve first before our set menu arrived, that’s the reason why she judged us like that.

MY RECOMMENDATION: Don’t go there in your cozy attire unless you want to be treated as 2nd grade customers which I experienced it myself during this meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vivit Chareonsin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great Tempura (Japanese deep-fried dishes) restaurant to visit in One Bangkok!

Quality food, excellent services, good atmosphere.

I visited here with my family including 2 kids on Saturday for dinner. We need to get the queue via QueQ application, or you can get from the staff at the restaurant. It took us around an hour for waiting, but it is alright because we knew from its comments that everyone usually waits for at least an hour.

We ordered Tempura set, Cold soba set, Raw salmon with rice, salmon salad, and Oyster tempura as topping. In summary, quality of its dishes was great with excellent services. They also provided 3 types of salts to enjoy with your tempura dishes, as well as buffet for Mentaiko! I did not rate 5 stars for the meal, since I used to try better Tempura restaurant with similar price before.

Anyway, this restaurant is still highly recommended to visit, where you need to prepare for an-hour waiting queue.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chawalit K

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food itself was delicious, and I was delighted to find tempura of this quality in Thailand. However, there was a very disappointing aspect to the ordering system.

When I paid an extra fee to change my set meal to udon noodles, I was not provided with white rice, and refills were not available. There was absolutely no explanation at the time of ordering, such as "Are you sure you want to avoid running out of rice?"

As any Japanese person would understand, white rice is absolutely essential to enjoy Yamaya's signature all-you-can-eat mentaiko and takana. If paying an extra fee meant losing the rice (and the all-you-can-eat enjoyment), I wouldn't have changed my order in the first place.

It wasn't a matter of money; I was extremely upset by the lack of transparency in the service. Given how wonderful the food is, I strongly hope for improvements to the menu descriptions and operations.
sample_reviews_en.author: KJ

sample_reviews_en.text: This esteemed Japanese tempura establishment enjoys a distinguished reputation, yet its allure is somewhat tempered by the prolonged wait times that persist throughout the day. During peak dining hours—such as my visit at 6 PM, which required a 40-minute wait—securing a table can be an exercise in patience. Once seated, however, the attentive and efficient service ensures a seamless dining experience. The tempura itself is crisply executed and undeniably flavorful, complemented by the generous provision of unlimited rice, pickled vegetables, and Mentaiko (Alaskan pollock roe). However, the Mentaiko proves to be excessively salty, overshadowing its usual briny richness. Moreover, despite the elevated price point, the overall quality fails to justify the premium, leaving a lingering sense of unmet expectations and an experience that, while enjoyable, falls short of true excellence.
sample_reviews_en.author: TP TP

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went around 7 PM, there was no queue, and I got a seat at the counter to watch the chefs fry the food.

The menu prices are quite high, starting from 3xx baht and up.
Some menu items include unlimited refills of mentaiko, pickled vegetables, rice, and soup, which felt very worthwhile.

I ordered the salmon tendon, which was delicious, especially the salmon roe – creamy and not fishy. The tempura was perfectly fried, not oily. The portion was small, but enough for a woman to feel full. The mentaiko and pickled vegetables were quite flavorful; eating them with plenty of rice would be better. They also have different flavored salts for dipping; I liked the matcha salt, it was fragrant.

Overall, I was impressed. Worth the calories! I'll definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: C k

sample_reviews_en.text:
The famous tempura restaurant in town. Honestly, the atmosphere is not so good, especially the smell of fried food really bothers me. Anyway, it's normal for the tempura restaurant. I just don't like it.

Coming to the food, to me it's just another normal tempura. Nothing mesmerizing that gives me a wow factor. The food tastes good as it should. I ordered Tendon. You get the unlimited rice, soup and mentaiko if you order the rice bowl or food set. I consider the price point is on the pricier end - not worth the money I would say.

I am lucky that I don't have to queue up for the restaurant. If you want to try, it's a good tempura restaurant on an expensive price point with nothing fancy. If you have to queue up, I don't think it's worth the wait.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayanan Kumhom

restaurants.name: Swensen's Lotus Bangkapi
restaurants.address:

3109 Lat Phrao Rd, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
On February 14th, around 2 PM, I entered the store and ordered the ice cream shown in the picture (it was a promotion, so it shouldn't have been sold out, and there was no notification that it would take a while). I also ordered a lava cake. I waited for a very long time, about half an hour, until two tables that came after me received their ice cream. I then called a staff member to ask why people who came later received their orders first; wasn't it a queue system? The staff member went to rush the order without any explanation or apology. After a while, the ice cream was served, but the lava cake was given to the table next to me, who arrived later. I called a staff member again to inquire, saying I understood the ice cream was taking too long, but why did the lava cake get served to the table that came later? The staff member apologized and said it was a mistake. I then requested to cancel the lava cake. I would like Swensen's to improve its ordering system or something similar (which received no explanation).

The branch manager was present, but there was no discussion, explanation, or apology.

From member number 023FCC73AC8D9
But I don't want to eat here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: piriya vachiranuphab

sample_reviews_en.text:
They tricked customers into buying the Ultrasmooth 89 baht ice cream.
The ice cream was the same as always, just with a small cup to capitalize on the hype, which sold out in an hour.

The ice cream wasn't special; it was just regular mocha almond.

The advertising was exaggerated and misleading, claiming a secret recipe to lure people in. The ice cream was just ordinary, tricking people into thinking it would be something special.
They just jumped on the bandwagon. I'm very disappointed in the brand.
I arrived at 11:45 AM and it was already sold out. The ice cream was just ordinary, not the Ultrasmooth formula.
A waste of time and the brand's inflated price is unreasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Na Ni

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Table clearing and wiping were inadequate. The table was smeared with ice cream and the same cloth was used to wipe the seat, which was quite dirty. Separate cloths should be used because using the same cloth makes the seat sticky and unclean. (I asked them to wipe the seat again because they wiped it hastily and not properly; there was still water and other stains on the seat.) They should receive more training in table cleaning.
- The water was served in a glass almost full, causing spills. The younger staff members didn't seem to care.
sample_reviews_en.author: BF

sample_reviews_en.text: The order taker smelled of body odor. Upon arrival, they asked if we had a membership card, which we did. After checking, they didn't say anything negative and didn't offer any promotions. In short, it was a waste of time logging in. They also ignored customers, requiring us to repeatedly hold up our glass to ask for a refill, even though this branch is very small and the seating is only a short distance from the counter. The wafers were chewy and the worst I've ever had.
sample_reviews_en.author: Napee Petch

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my...lost-ever number of times I've eaten here. This time I ordered something new, trying the Biskov (which I already love) but still keeping the one with macadamia nut (my absolute favorite). Swensen's maintains its standard, and the drinks are better now—cold and easy to drink. The last time I came, maybe a year ago, it smelled like tap water and wasn't cold. It seems like they've improved this time. The atmosphere is pretty much the same as before.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ainthira Swatsuk

sample_reviews_en.text:
Normally, the staff are very helpful, willing, and smiling.
Today, the manager took the order himself. I'm not sure if it was because it was a holiday and there were a lot of customers, or what. If you're not feeling well and not ready to provide service, you should rest. The way he looked while taking the order was terrible. But if this is already his standard, we'll have to adjust our approach.
sample_reviews_en.author: สิริพร นารอง

sample_reviews_en.text: I waited a very long time today. There were few staff members, and the queue wasn't long at all, but the service was extremely slow. The service wasn't good. Another staff member seemed unprepared for work, like she was under pressure or something; she ran off crying (even though customers were still waiting). I hope they improve this aspect. If they can improve this, it would be great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nong kwang

sample_reviews_en.text: Every time I pick up an order from this branch, they never start processing it, even though it's been there for a while. I always have to inform the front counter. And when they finally do, it's incredibly slow. What's the point? Do they just not care about the work at all? And this happens every single time.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปลายทาง ที่ว่างเปล่า

restaurants.name: ลิน เยาวราช ก๋วยเตี๋ยว ข้าว ติ๋มซำ
restaurants.address:

436 Charoen Rat Rd, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This small noodle restaurant is a real find that stands out for its wide variety of noodle options (and very good ones) at an affordable price. The place is very clean, impeccable and has a really cozy atmosphere, creating a comfortable space where you feel at home from the moment you sit down. In addition, the service offers a fast and friendly service. Without a doubt, it is an ideal option to enjoy good quality food without complications.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaime Asensio

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a nice atmosphere and comfortable seating.
The 80s music is very relaxing.
The minced pork is tender and the tom yum flavor is delicious.
It would be even better if the basil chicken didn't have dark soy sauce. 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: Bow Ch.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, especially the noodles. Today I ordered minced beef basil stir-fry, which was fragrant, and pork neck basil stir-fry, which was a little salty. The chili fish sauce with garlic was perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: thananit suntiviriyanon

sample_reviews_en.text: The Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) was delicious, the Tom Yum broth was perfectly seasoned, the meatballs weren't fishy, ​​and each bowl came with slightly sweet, crispy fried batter. The kids loved it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tiffany T

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is cool and comfortable. The restaurant looks clean and spacious. The food is delicious; the stir-fried pork neck with garlic is tender and flavorful, and the rice is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kitipong K.

sample_reviews_en.text: On my way to IconSiam, I happened to stop in and took a break with some kuay teow and Pepsi. It was refreshing and I was able to eat it even though I didn't have much of an appetite.
sample_reviews_en.author: akemi yajima

sample_reviews_en.text:
Suggestion for the restaurant:
For the beef stir-fry, if the portion is this small, I suggest raising the price and increasing the quantity.
Please don't keep the portion this small.
sample_reviews_en.author: chayanon Thambanjong

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu is diverse, but I highly recommend the stir-fried pork neck with basil rice – it's the best! The food tastes delicious, and the restaurant is clean and comfortable. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittinan Tairat

restaurants.name: Cafe L'appartement คาเฟ่ลาพาร์ตเตอมองต์
restaurants.address:

Ratchadaphisek Rd, Khwaeng Din Daeng, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The place is so beautiful! There are tons of photo opportunities, it's not crowded, and there are plenty of spots to take pictures from, with no one blocking each other's view. The desserts are delicious, and the drinks aren't too sweet, just right. The Red Velvet cake is amazing; the cream cheese flavor is so strong. It's super private, you can walk around and take pictures comfortably without any staff pressuring you. After ordering, you just place your receipt to reserve a table, and they'll bring your food and place it on the table for you. We ordered one drink and one slice of cake for only a little over 200 baht, but the photo spots were absolutely stunning!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anthiya T.

sample_reviews_en.text: The cafe is very easy to get to, located in a 3-4 story building on the main road, about 1 km from the entrance of Ratchada Soi 3. It might be a bit far from the MRT Phra Ram 9 station, but you can easily walk there from Fortune Mall. The food and drinks are delicious, and the cakes are amazing. The prices are reasonable, around 200+ baht per person. Most importantly, the photo opportunities are fantastic! The cafe has a sweet, bright, pink and white theme, perfect for a girly look. There are photo spots on all three floors, so bring your best outfits!
sample_reviews_en.author: TN

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the red velvet cake, it was delicious, really good, I liked it.
The chocolate drink was just okay, not worth the price.
There's no parking. The shop told me to park at the hotel and walk over, so I found parking on the side of the road in a side street and walked back.

When I went, they said there was an event going on, so there were no tables available, so I ordered takeout.
sample_reviews_en.author: Veer C.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a beautiful and charming cafe with a great atmosphere and tons of photo opportunities. Every corner is stunning, like something out of a princess! The food, drinks, and cakes are delicious. However, it's a bit difficult to get there as the street is narrow and cars are passing each other.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thipphawan Nillawan

sample_reviews_en.text: I love this cafe' in BKK. My favourite are blueberry cheesecake drink and chocolate mousse. It has cute, aesthetics and elegant decoration in one place, better for birthday photoshot. I went for my friend's bd shots. I also got the aesthetics pictures as you see🫣🪽
sample_reviews_en.author: Thant thiri thu

sample_reviews_en.text: The place is quiet and peaceful. The decoration is perfect for birthday photos and gives such a cute princess vibe. The food is affordable and tastes amazing. I really love this place, so I often bring my friends here and take photos for them. Definitely a 10/10!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ei Ei Phyu

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is very cute and the service is excellent. Today, May 31st, will be the last day the shop will be open, so hurry and come take pictures!
The shop offers a free shuttle service; you can park at the hotel and a staff member will drive you to the cafe.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploygigi

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is so beautiful, fit for a princess, absolutely amazing! The cake, cream, and drinks are all delicious and perfectly balanced. So worth it! 😭😭😭 I can only say pure bliss, 1000000/10! I'll definitely come back with my significant other.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nawa

restaurants.name: Pan Bagels (แพน เบเกิลส์) ประดิษฐ์มนูธรรม
restaurants.address:

Pradit Manutham 15, Ladprao, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Pan Bagels' Pradit Manutham branch is located in an alley next to Central Eastville and is another branch that stays open quite late (8 PM). The shop is spacious and comfortable with about 7-8 tables. The menu offers both individual and set options. The staff are helpful and knowledgeable about each menu item and its ingredients.

I tried the Classic Ham, Egg & Cheese (฿179) to eat in. It comes with two sauces and the ingredients are of good quality and generously portioned. However, personally, I felt the flavors didn't quite complement each other; each component stood out more on its own.

I also ordered a Plain Bagel and a Truffle Cream Cheese bagel to take home. The truffle aroma was very strong.

Another thing I appreciated was the attention to detail. The packaging includes instructions on how to store and reheat the bagels to maintain their delicious taste, and they offer complimentary water without being asked. It shows they care about the customer experience.

There's parking available in front of the shop, making it convenient for both takeout and a comfortable dine-in.
sample_reviews_th.author: Jelly bear

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ve been to Pan Bagels three times now, and every visit has been amazing. The bagels are always fresh and full of flavor, they taste incredible every time. The service is excellent, with friendly and attentive staff who make you feel welcome. The atmosphere is also one of my favorite things about this place. It’s really chill, cozy, and a great spot to relax while enjoying a meal. I highly recommend Pan Bagels to anyone looking for delicious bagels and a great dining experience in Bangkok. I’ll definitely be coming back again!❤️😃🥯
sample_reviews_en.author: Nay Htoot Hlaing

sample_reviews_en.text:
The bagels were incredibly delicious! I ordered the chicken avocado one, and it was so fresh. The chicken was perfectly cooked for the bagel; it was moist and not dry. It was served hot, not dry from being left out in the air. I loved it!
The ingredients were fresh, and the sauce was just right, not too much to overpower the other flavors. The price wasn't exorbitant either; the quality was worth the price. I was very impressed. So delicious!

We also ordered a triple cheese sandwich, which was just as delicious! 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Me W.

sample_reviews_en.text:
There's a wide variety of bagels to choose from.
The bagels have soft bread inside and a large, fluffy egg filling.
They taste delicious.
The shop is clean, the staff are friendly and smiling, and they give good menu recommendations.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nansikarn Lux

sample_reviews_en.text: The bagels are excellent. They have a chewy texture and a delicious crispy finish. They're still the best bagels in this area. This branch has a slightly better atmosphere than the Chaeng Wattana branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanomkwan Dhebyasuwan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten here many times. Today I ordered takeout, and the bagels are amazing! So delicious, the cream cheese is incredibly creamy.
Whenever I'm in the area, I always stop by. I love it so much!
sample_reviews_en.author: Patarawarin Or-aisoon

sample_reviews_en.text: The place is cozy and the ham, egg & avocado crispy sandwich is really delicious. We didn't even have to wait so long to get the food. And also the baristas are so cute and nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Isaac Jen Alexei

sample_reviews_en.text: "Spotless place, good vibe, and easy parking! Hidden in a little street beside Central EastVille. Delicious food—absolutely loved the juiciness of the bacon and eggs."
sample_reviews_en.author: nina

restaurants.name: Bacchus & Co.
restaurants.address:

150 Soi Sukhumvit 16, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small French restaurant serving authentic French cuisine, prepared by an experienced French chef. The quality of the food is excellent, and you can really taste the care and experience in every dish. 🇫🇷

We tried the chicken cordon bleu, merguez with small pasta shells, and chocolate dessert. Everything was delicious. The chicken cordon bleu was crispy on the outside and tender inside, while the merguez were flavorful and paired nicely with small pasta shells and butter. The chocolate dessert was rich and satisfying — a lovely way to finish the meal.

I also really enjoyed the atmosphere. The restaurant is cozy, warm, and beautifully decorated, with a charming wine-bar area that gives the place a lovely French bistro feeling.

Overall, a wonderful place for anyone looking for authentic French food in a cozy setting. We had a very enjoyable dinner and would definitely come back to try more dishes.☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: กรองกาญจน์ คงช่วย

sample_reviews_en.text: One of my favourite restaurants in Bangkok  hands down. Baccus brings real French bistro soul to the city: authentic flavours, beautifully executed dishes, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere that makes you feel like you’re sitting in a small bistro in France. As a French chef myself, I’m picky about authenticity, and this place delivers every time. The quality of the food, the attention to detail, and the overall experience make it one of the best spots in Bangkok. Highly recommend to anyone looking for genuine French cuisine done right
sample_reviews_en.author: Le Loïc

sample_reviews_en.text: Honestly, this place is worth the detour. The food is wonderful. Okay, I admit I'm French, so cheese, bread, charcuterie, and wine are part of my life. But this restaurant awakened my taste buds. Even the wine by the glass was delicious, which is rare even in France, so finding that in Bangkok is wonderful. Even if you're not always in a hurry to get back to Europe, a glass of wine with good bread and cheese is a wonderful moment. Joy will welcome you. Enjoy your meal and long live France!
sample_reviews_en.author: didier villevieille

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent French food and friendly service.

We came two days in a row and tried their burgers, sandwichs and croque-monsieur. Everybody was super happy with the food. The deserts (apple pie, profiteroles and chocolate mousse) were super refined and excellent as well.
Service was great as well. The waitress is super smiling and friendly, always attentive to our needs. Ben is managing an excellent and family friendly fine establishment. :)

Strongly recommended by our family of 4!
sample_reviews_en.author: Martin DL

sample_reviews_en.text: A wonderful taste of traditional French cuisine. Every dish was beautifully prepared using high-quality ingredients and authentic French flavors. The cozy atmosphere, warm hospitality, and attentive service made the dining experience truly memorable. It’s also pet-friendly, which is a lovely bonus. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone who appreciates classic French cuisine. 🇫🇷🍷
sample_reviews_en.author: Paravinee 5566

sample_reviews_en.text:
We are regular customers when we're in Bangkok, however, on our last visit on November 30th we were disappointed to learn that Luc, the former owner, was absent and that after speaking with the staff, we learned he had sold the restaurant.
It's a shame because he was a great source of information about wines and menus.
Anyway! It's still a good place to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay Led

sample_reviews_en.text:
The new owner of this Frenchy place on Sukhumvit 16 is doing a great job!
The cordon bleu was a real hit — perfectly crispy breading with delicious, flavourful cheese inside. I was so hungry that I didn’t even have time to take a picture before digging in! Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicolas Vivin

sample_reviews_en.text: What a gem in the middle of Bangkok. Have been missing the feeling of an apero since relocating to Bangkok from Europe. Food is delicious, the service excellent. I ended up ordering the tuna steak for dinner with a nice Provence rose. I ll definitely be back very soon
sample_reviews_en.author: kostas rossoglou

restaurants.name: PadThai Wangdoem
restaurants.address:

145 Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I’m a vegetarian and originally I thought I could order mango sticky rice or smoothies only. However, it was a big surprise that the chef was willing to customize the dish for me, so I ordered Pad Thai egg. 😆 I really enjoyed this vegetarian Thai food~
Moreover, I truly appreciate the staff for being so patient with my poor Thai. She also taught me how to say fried rice seafood (ข้าวผัดทะเล) hahaha
What a enjoyable dining experience~
sample_reviews_th.author: Yi “JuJu” Jhu

sample_reviews_en.text:
After taking photos in my Thai costume at Wat Arun and returning it, I Googled nearby restaurants and decided on this one, just a 1-minute walk away!

I was so hungry at the time! 🤣

The scrambled egg and basil pork rice was delicious!

The scrambled eggs were expertly made, and the basil pork was slightly salty but not spicy.

The Tom Yum Goong (mama noodles) had a good broth, slightly sour and spicy, rich but not greasy. The noodles were basically instant noodles, and the portion was generous. If you don't want noodles, you can order the soup separately.

The fried chicken wings were crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, and the sauce gave them a unique flavor.

The mango smoothie was very thick and delicious, with a nice slice of mango on the rim. I'm so envious of Thais who can eat mangoes all year round! 🤣

-
Many foreigners dined here, including Taiwanese, Chinese, and Westerners. The dine-in area was completely full at 3 pm! 😌
sample_reviews_en.author: Josie Liu

sample_reviews_en.text:
An absolutely impressive restaurant! Starting with the Pad Thai, the flavors are perfectly balanced, with chewy, tender noodles and fresh, plump shrimp—so delicious that we had to order more! The Tom Yum Kung is rich and flavorful, with a perfect blend of spicy, sour, and aromatic herbs that taste like it’s freshly made in a traditional Thai kitchen.

The Papaya Salad hits all the right notes—sweet, sour, salty, and spicy—beautifully combined. The Fried Rice is another highlight, with perfectly cooked, fragrant rice that isn’t mushy, leaving a delightful wok aroma in every bite.

The restaurant is clean, the atmosphere is inviting, and the air conditioning is refreshingly cool, making it a great spot to escape the heat. The staff are friendly, attentive, and always serve with a smile.

This is truly a gem for authentic Thai cuisine. If you’re in the area, you must stop by and try it—you won’t be disappointed! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanakan Ngamlerdrasamee

sample_reviews_en.text:
I specifically ordered a pineapple smoothie without sugar, and the server clearly confirmed this. However, what I received was probably the sweetest smoothie I’ve ever had — it tasted like it was loaded with sugar.

We also ordered a papaya salad without egg, but it was served with egg anyway. This was definitely not due to any language barrier, as the staff member spoke good English and seemed to understand our requests.

Overall, it was disappointing that such clear dietary preferences were not respected.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lena W.

sample_reviews_en.text:
A three-minute walk from Wat Arun (Temple of Dawn) and I discovered a hidden gem of a restaurant! These little gems of Thai cuisine are mostly tucked away in alleyways.

This stir-fried prawn noodles was so delicious I almost licked the plate clean! The prawns were huge, and the noodles were springy and flavorful. The owner was friendly, the place was clean, and the Thai food was affordable! 🇹🇭 I also recommend the fried chicken wings and basil rice! The mango smoothie is a must-try!

#pad Thai wangdoem
sample_reviews_en.author: 王钰凯

sample_reviews_en.text:
Agree with others rating 2*, no idea how this place got over 4*.
Ordered crispy pork with basil, out came big (2x1x5cm) bits of soft pig fat, crisp zero. I've had this in other places, day and night difference. Uneatable, sent back. Ordered stir-fry pork with basil and chilli, that was ok in taste but not for that price. On the picture of the item there's rice, that didn't come along, cost extra. Pad Thai prawn also lacking in flavour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Z C

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good. Went for a classic chicken pad thai was really good. Portions are big for the price. Come here instead of falling for those tiktok turist trap which are usually double the price smaller portions and not as tasty as these local places. Def recommend. Service superb as usual.
sample_reviews_en.author: Antonia Lenck

sample_reviews_en.text: I stumbled upon this place and found it delicious. The environment was comfortable with air conditioning. I really liked the basil rice, and the drinks were also very good, though a bit too sweet. The owner was very nice. Note that cash is the only accepted payment.
sample_reviews_en.author: jiang

restaurants.name: Fam Time Steak and Pasta @The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi
restaurants.address:

3522 ชั้น M, Lat Phrao Rd, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I went on a Saturday evening around 5 pm. It wasn't too crowded. This branch has a quiet and comfortable atmosphere, giving off a more private feel than I expected. It's perfect for having dinner with friends, family, or a special, uncrowded meal.

I ordered:
-Grilled salmon salad (195฿)
-Margarita (195฿)
-Fettuccine carbonara (195฿)
-Truffle mashed potato (115฿)
-Panna cotta (95฿)
Overall, the food tasted good, and the menu is quite diverse.

My favorite dish was the Truffle Mashed Potato. The texture was smooth, and the truffle aroma was clear and fragrant without being overpowering. The other dishes were easy to eat, with a moderate and pleasant taste.

That day was my birthday, and you can ask the staff to play music and bring out the cake or dessert at your desired time, although the timing might not be perfectly precise, so you might need to allow some extra time.

In general, it's a restaurant with a great atmosphere, more suitable for chatting, spending time, and having a special meal than a place where you'd rush through.
sample_reviews_th.author: Jelly bear

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant focuses on spaghetti, but also offers pizza and other comfort food options for those who enjoy pasta and starchy dishes. The flavors are delicious and perfectly suited to Asian palates. The menu offers a wide variety of choices, including meat, vegetable, and other starchy dishes, and every item is well-prepared.

The branch at THE MALL Bangkapi is located right next to the entrance connecting to the Sky Walk, making it easy to find. The restaurant is beautifully decorated in a warm and inviting style. However, some areas inside the restaurant might be slightly out of sight from the staff, making it a little difficult to get their attention. Overall, though, it's a great place to dine with friends or family. The food is delicious, the atmosphere is pleasant, and it's ideal for a meal with family.
sample_reviews_en.author: Littlepaw

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place literally suitable for everybody, young kids to elderly. It’s simple Italian-Thai food but done just right with fresh ingredients, handmade pasta.

Everything I had was so delicious 🤤 Salmon pesto cream fettuccine is my absolute favorite! Chewy fettuccine absorb pesto sauce very well. Grilled salmon nice and succulent.

Italian sausage aglio olio also simply delicious, quite spicy. A perfect pairing with garlic butter pizza bread or you can dip in ranch sauce (much better than I expected).

Cheesy baked spinach and bacon is another comforting dish. Again, you can paired with garlic butter pizza bread.

Personally, service I got was very good. Thanks to a girl staff name Mai. Her service with genuine smile makes everything better.

I want to come back already.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cafe S

sample_reviews_en.text: I really like the pizza and food at this restaurant. The taste is delicious and suits my palate. The pasta is also very tasty. This time, I ordered French fries at this branch and they were amazing, like they were freshly fried. Another thing I love is their chili oil; it's delicious and fragrant. This branch is also beautifully decorated, with a nice atmosphere. The staff are welcoming and attentive. The prices are neither cheap nor expensive, just mid-range. This is my personal opinion based on my experience. The location is also great, right next to the mall entrance/exit connected to the BTS Skytrain, making it easy to get to and easy to find. I'll definitely visit again! 🙏🏻👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Pratya Kanchanachettanee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fam Time Steak and Pasta at The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi is a very welcoming restaurant with a beautiful, well-designed interior. The atmosphere feels upscale and inviting, and it's conveniently located near the exit, making it easy to access.

The food was decent, although the prices are on the higher side. Portions were a bit smaller than expected for the cost, but that is fairly common in more premium dining establishments. The restaurant was busy throughout my visit, which is usually a good sign. The staff were helpful and attentive, and the restaurant was clean and well maintained overall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Meng Thao

sample_reviews_en.text: We came to The Mall Bangkapi. You need to scan your parking receipt when you leave. We spent a while looking for the restaurant; it's on the corner of the building. The atmosphere is nice, but since we were a large group, we got an oval table that wasn't very comfortable. After a while, a table became available, so we moved to a new one, which was much better. The pizza, pasta, soup, and fries were delicious, with a moderate flavor – not too cheesy (good for those who don't like cheese). The prices aren't expensive. The staff provided good service, and the food didn't take long to arrive.
sample_reviews_en.author: nittaya lumjiektes

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went as a couple, ordered four dishes + peach tea, and the total bill was around 1000 baht.

Overall, the food was delicious and suited our taste. We chose their signature dish, "truffle pizza," which was fragrant and tasty, but a little too rich. Next time, we'll try a different topping.

What impressed us most was the Parpadelle Smoked Bacon Pink Sauce. The fresh pasta was amazing, and the flavor was perfectly balanced. We had to use the pizza dough to scoop up all the sauce!

We'll definitely be back. The taste and quality were worth the price. 🩵
sample_reviews_en.author: Kornsarai Just

sample_reviews_en.text: I was planning to eat at this restaurant because the menu looked very appetizing. I went to queue, but the staff member taking orders at the front of the store completely ignored customers. When I tried to ask something, they just looked past me, pushed their way through, and went to give my order to a Grab driver instead. Then they walked around me again, even though I was still waiting. They didn't serve customers and didn't care at all. I was really looking forward to eating there, and this branch was the most disappointing experience I've had.
sample_reviews_en.author: สกาว

restaurants.name: Beeru
restaurants.address:

1713, 1715 อรุณอัมรินทร์ Bang Yi Khan, Bang Phlat, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is one of the must-try izakaya restaurants in the Thonburi area for both food and drinks! The quality, price, and quantity are all excellent value.
I loved the chashu; the meat was incredibly tender and the sauce complemented it perfectly. The curry rice was spicy and flavorful. For appetizers, I highly recommend the paprika fries and the garlic cucumber – they're incredibly delicious and addictive!
For those who enjoy a drink, they have both draft and bottled beers, and even Butter Beer from Harry Potter (non-alcoholic!). As you can see in the picture, it tastes quite similar to the one at Universal Studios, the only difference being the milk foam.

/// If you're driving, I recommend parking at the nearby condo. When I went, parking cost 40 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phukijnat Kijmaneemas

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small izakaya near Rama VIII Bridge, right next to a Lumpini condo.

They have a wide variety of food, including appetizers, main courses, and alcoholic beverages.
But I usually focus on eating rather than drinking.

Personally, I like the Biryani fried rice, paprika fries, and seared marinated mackerel sashimi.
Other dishes are also good. My friends like the char siu pork, nabe (hot pot), and the curry rice is tasty.

The prices are mid-range to high; you can easily spend a lot if you eat well here, haha.
The restaurant has a chic style and isn't very big. You can park next to the restaurant or in the condo next door for 20 baht per hour.
The staff service is okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichsaran Ves

sample_reviews_en.text: This traditional izakaya restaurant is located in the Rama 8/Bang Yi Khan area. To get there, follow Arun Amarin Road towards Rama 8 Bridge. After the bend, look for the entrance on the left. The restaurant is quite small, with a friendly, homey feel. The menu offers a variety of dishes, but portions are quite small, so you'll need to order several things. Prices are moderate to slightly expensive. The food is delicious, and there's a wide selection of alcoholic beverages. Overall, it's good, but the parking is very limited next to the restaurant. It's recommended to park in the nearby condo (20 baht per hour) or take a taxi for easier parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิชชพงศ์ อริยสุนทร

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant provides a cozy atmosphere for those looking to relax and unwind after a long day of work with colleagues. However, some have noted that their dishes are plain and not particularly flavorful. Nevertheless, this restaurant is renowned for its excellent selection of beer. If you are looking for an enjoyable evening with a Japanese-style atmosphere, this is the perfect place for you. However, if you are looking for an exceptional culinary experience, this might not be the best choice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rattichai Kumpinyoboon

sample_reviews_en.text: Always having good experiences from this amazing place. On Friday you should make a reservation first cuz the waiting can kill your mood and hunger. The food is great esp the shashu pork (Japanese style grilled pork) and sashimi and raw squid with wasabi. And you pair these with a nice jug of Asahi beer. It's like heaven. Oh and there are many kinds of beers n ciders for you to choose as well. Enjoy!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayapim

sample_reviews_en.text: I like the ramen here. The bowls are huge, there are lots of vegetables, and the noodles are okay. Other than that, you can eat and snack on them continuously. You can sit and relax, but not for too long because the shop is not big. It's suitable for those who like to drink lightly. You can park at Lumphini for a small fee. P.S. I wish it was open during the day so I could order to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stellar Thip

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices are comparable to typical mall food. The atmosphere is great, beautifully decorated but a bit dimly lit. The restaurant is also a little hard to find. But the food is delicious. I tried the Beeru Ramen, which is basically ramen served in a beer glass with egg white foam on top, but it was really tasty. Overall, it was a great experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Purin Piwat

sample_reviews_en.text: If you’re a beer enthusiast, this place is a must-visit! 🍻 With an impressive selection of craft and classic brews, a cozy atmosphere, and top-notch service, it’s the perfect spot to unwind and savor every sip. Whether you’re here to discover new flavors or just enjoy a cold one with friends, you won’t be disappointed. Cheers!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sangsan Kpm

restaurants.name: MOOMGAPAO มุมกะเพรา Mercury ville ชิดลม ชั้น 4
restaurants.address:

540 Phloen Chit Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Excellent kaphrao, always. I stop by often as I live nearby. Some interesting variations offered, including my favorite, กะเพรา​เปิด​พะโล้​/kaphrao​pet phalo​/stewed duck in chilli and holy basil. Some folks like a dry kaphrao, others like it saucy/juicy, but I like it right in between the extremes, and Moom Gapao gets it just right. Chilli level at medium is perfect. They also ask you whether you want a soft or well-done yolk on your fried egg topper. Or a small omelet if preferred.

Way better than the Mark Weins place in Sukhumvit. Not as good as my favorite street vendor on Lang Suan but her hours are extremely limited, it's takeaway only and the wait time is very long. So this is my go-to for kaphrao in the neighborhood despite it's shopping center location.
sample_reviews_th.author: JJ Cummings

sample_reviews_th.text: Moomgapao is a must-visit spot if you're a fan of Thai basil stir-fry (กะเพรา). Located on the 4th floor of Mercury Ville Chidlom, the restaurant offers a variety of creative twists on the classic กะเพรา dish. You can choose from different …
sample_reviews_th.author: PK PTD

sample_reviews_en.text:
This gapao rice specialty restaurant is located on the third floor of Mercury Village, directly connected to BTS Chidlom Station.

With a huge variety of flavors (from chicken to shrimp) and a variety of sizes, it's a must-try for gapao lovers.

Actually, they apparently offer various options for spiciness, but my Thai skills weren't enough to help me.

Prices start at around ¥300, so while they're more expensive than street food stalls, they're still significantly cheaper than regular restaurants.

This is a gapao rice specialty shop located on the 3rd floor of Mercury Ville, directly connected to BTS Chidlom Station.

They offer an impressive variety of options—from chicken to shrimp—as well as multiple portion sizes, making it a dream spot for gapao lovers.

It seems you can customize things like spiciness and other options, but with my limited Thai language skills, I couldn’t really manage that level of customization yet…

Some dishes are priced in the 300-yen range, so while it’s more expensive than street food, it’s quite affordable compared to regular restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: KAZUYA WAKASUGI

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice joint for quick Gapow rice (Thai Spicy dish with basil) located on 4th floor of Mercury Ville Chidlom. Provide good service with ideal Thai fast food dish. This place highly focused on Gapow dish, and they only have 2 options on their menu for you to select between Chicken or Pork Gapow.

Overall dining experience here is ok. It’s nice to have Thai fast food dish in nice and quiet environment.

Warning : it’s spicy!! Make sure you can handle one.

Overall rating
Pricing : reasonable
Place : 7/10
Food :5/10
Service : 8/10
Cleanliness : 8/10

Hope this helps!
ACWJ
sample_reviews_en.author: Andi Chin Weijieng

sample_reviews_en.text:
The stir-fried basil chicken was dry, not greasy, and delicious. The fried duck egg was perfectly cooked; spooning the yolk over the basil chicken was pure bliss. The price is reasonable considering the location and quality.

I ate there in the evening, so the atmosphere was quiet. The table and chair arrangement wasn't overly formal, just casual.

You order at the counter, and the staff will give you a buzzer to alert you when your food is ready.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chudaporn Pitukhoontrakool

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really enjoy the food here. This restaurant is our ‘safety’ option when we miss home-cooked meals while traveling in Bangkok, but the food is truly delicious, especially with the addition of egg.

Lunch and dinner can get busy, making it hard to find a place to sit, but the staff is attentive and manages everything well. They are always friendly and eager to recommend you, especially since we can’t handle spicy food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Katharina

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered at 2 PM and waited 10 minutes at the counter to place my order. Two staff members finally came over because they had both gone out to buy their own food at the same time, making customers wait. The "light" chicken basil dish was terrible; so salty my tongue went numb for hours after eating it, and it was dripping oil from the bottom of the bowl.
sample_reviews_en.author: jan kij

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is cheap (if you pay with credit card is more expensive than local card); good taste, nothing super different. Fast service, the girl was not in so good mood though. They serve you in plastic plate and with plastic fork, which is not so nice. They could use proper ones, after all its in a shopping center, not on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nina Marinova

restaurants.name: Sousaku Gourmet Shabu Buffet สาขา Central World
restaurants.address:

Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sousaku, a suki/shabu restaurant, has a branch located in the Central World shopping mall. The store is relatively spacious, offering multiple seating options. Upon entering, the staff promptly directs guests to scan the menu via a QR code or provides a physical menu upon request. The menu features a variety of options, including beef and pork sets, vegetables, sushi, and assorted side dishes.

After ordering, a complimentary serving of mixed root vegetable chips is provided. While the chips themselves have a pleasant taste, their texture isn’t as crunchy as expected, and they carry a distinct stale aroma, suggesting they may have been sitting on the shelf for a while.

Once the food arrives, the staff offers to start the cooking process by adding the meat and vegetables to the broth before allowing guests to take over as they eat.

Overall, this is a decent spot for a quick shabu meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisana Varanyuwatana

sample_reviews_en.text:
The 999+ set meal was totally worth it. The beef tongue and grain-fed beef were excellent – ​​tender, flavorful, not chewy, and the pieces were large. The sashimi was incredibly fresh. Ordering a set meal also gets you shrimp; the shrimp were large, firm, and bouncy, and delicious even when blanched. The fish roe and eel sushi were also good; I ordered them twice and ate three pieces of each.
I tried the beef in the 799+ set and it was just okay, but the wasabi squid was delicious – I ordered two bowls of it!
The dessert was red bean mochi with milk. It was sweet, the red bean paste was smooth, and the mochi wasn't overly chewy – pretty good. I tried to take pictures of everything I ate; if the pictures are similar, it means I ordered them again 🤣 Overall, I was very satisfied. I've signed up for a membership and will invite my friends to go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dear J.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sousaku Gourmet Shabu Buffet at CentralWorld  is honestly one of the best shabu experiences I’ve had. It is the kind of place that makes you lose track of time just enjoying food. From the moment the pot starts simmering, the aroma of the broth rich but not overly salty already sets the tone.

The spread is seriously impressive. Thinly sliced premium meats, fresh vegetables, crispy fried dishes, beautifully prepared sushi and sashimi, flavorful fried rice, and even juicy hamburg steak.
Everything tastes fresh, well-seasoned, and made to keep you going for “just one more dish.”

Every bite feels satisfying without being heavy, which makes it dangerously easy to keep eating. Great atmosphere, smooth service, and food that actually lives up to the hype.

If you come here hungry you’re going to leave very, very happy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phutagan Srimongkol

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the opportunity to try Sousaku's newly opened branch at Central World. It's an all-you-can-eat shabu-shabu, sukiyaki, and sushi restaurant with three price options. The atmosphere is nice and beautifully decorated. Although the space isn't very large, the tables are well-arranged. Recommended dishes include the fresh and clean sweet shrimp sashimi and the delicious crab roe rice. The beef is of good quality with beautiful marbling; meat lovers must try it – the meat is tender and in large slices. The dipping sauces and soup are good. My only minor complaint is the limited dessert selection. The staff were polite and provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: wera

sample_reviews_en.text:
This branch only offers an all-you-can-eat buffet for shabu and sushi.

I chose the top-tier package, and the beef was definitely worth it. I don’t think the lower-priced packages offer the same quality.

The sashimi was fresh and nicely sliced—not too thick. The nigiri was decent, although the rice didn’t hold together very well. The premium sushi from the top-tier menu took quite a while to arrive, and we had to follow up a few times.

Service depends on the staff serving your table, so the experience may vary.

Overall, if you’re coming for shabu, it’s a good choice. But if your main focus is sushi, there are better places to go.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noharachin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very disappointed meal after watching influencer, the food were significantly difference.
Vinegrated sushi rice is horrific DRY and COLD with tasteless. Claimed that fresh made but all seaweed in gunkan was wet and little soaky.
We asked chef to put wasabi while making sushi but they refused to put the wasabi like traditional nigiri. The wasabi was made before at your table and tastes like horse radish.
3 kinds Tuna, Takkuan, Shime saba tasted great (only fish part). Uni is acceptable. Hot green tea always filled by kindly staff. There will be 3000 THB for this meal.

Lots of things need to be improve if they accept these comment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gunnaphon Anamnart

sample_reviews_en.text: This authentic Japanese restaurant is located on the 7th floor of Central World. We wanted sushi really bad, so we came here when we saw the sushi bar with Japanese chefs at the counter. We ordered the seared salmon sushi, which has a little bit of mayo and a tiny burnt veggie on top. They were so good that we ordered another round! We also ordered the salmon sashimi and the shrimp sashimi. Both were very fresh! The other sushi and rolls we had were very good too. Really recommend this place if you want high-quality sushi and sashimi. This place also offers sukiyaki shabu. Things could be a bit pricey here, though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nora Man

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located on the 6th floor, Atrium zone. Look for the Chatee restaurant and turn right towards the Central zone. The restaurant is almost at the end.

We opted for the most expensive buffet option and were not disappointed. The quality of the meat, rice rolls, sushi, hand rolls, A5 beef, and sashimi was excellent. There was a wide variety of choices.
