However, at this price, they should really add giant oysters, abalone, large prawns, and crab legs to make it even more worthwhile (based on other restaurants in the same tier). Overall, we were satisfied and would definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jinny J

restaurants.name: Bella Healthy Food
restaurants.address:

120 Chang Watthana 7 Alley, Thung Song Hong, Lak Si, Bangkok 10210, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ve always been coming to the Immigration office to do my 90 days report or Visa extension. During one of my usual visits, I stumbled upon this cafe with my friend while we were looking for a place to eat and chill. I absolutely loved the Spicy Smoked Salmon Bagel. Even when I wasn’t a fan of Pesto sauce, I definitely loved it this time. This was my second time at this cafe and as usual the staffs and the owner were very welcoming and friendly. The staffs even once borrowed me a charger to charge my phone ahaha 😆. The price was quite worth it and fair compared to other similar places around the city. Now this cafe is going to be my always go-to place to eat and relax whenever I have business at the Immigration office. It’s at a corner so it’s quieter than the rest of the complex. I definitely recommend visiting this place when you pay a visit to the Immigration office!!!🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: Thet Myat Noe Su

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have been there for the first time.

Their coffee and bagels are really good.

🥯 🥑 I had omlette bagel and my wife tried avocado bagel. Both of them are so nice. The bagels are fresh and soft. Their ingredients are rich. The bagels are satisfying and filling.

The shop has many tables and the chairs are comfortable. The staff is friendly.

You should have a cup of coffee there when you wait in the queue in the government offices such as the Immigration Department or the Visa Extension Department.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emre Senbabaoglu

sample_reviews_en.text:
A great variety of food. We enjoyed our meal here. Recommended if you come to the immigration office and crave some Western food while waiting. They also have a good coffee machine.

Two stars off for the atmosphere because of the loud Thai country music (I’m Thai, and I still found it unpleasant 😅). It conflicts with the restaurant’s style. I want to sip good coffee in a quieter environment and not feel like I’m sitting in a street food stall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirikanlaya Nakprasit

sample_reviews_en.text:
By Hot Latte they mean really HOT, like boiling the milk, despite fact that we clearly asked for mildly warm milk.

Its “Italian style” claims the foreigner owner behind the counter. I been to Italy multiple times and trust me, always happy with the coffee there.

For premium priced coffee (95thb while neighboring are around 45-50thb) we expect premium service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Florian Wagner

sample_reviews_en.text:
- 3% extra charge on the credit card

Great sandwiches with a very little avocado but they all taste good. Pasta was good too. At least they have healthy food than other outlets where you only have cakes and other premade drinks.

Lovely people

They recently started charging 3% Again, better to have card options than not to have at all.
Thanks
sample_reviews_en.author: Racha King

sample_reviews_en.text: Coffee is pretty good and the price is still cheaper compared to similar shops in the city. The sandwiches are tasty, especially the avocado, cream cheese, with addittion of bacon. My wife had a craffle and it was good es well. The owner was friendly and helpful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Demis G.

sample_reviews_en.text: Wow! Best thing about immigration haha. I got the salmon bagel and it was lovely and warm and huge! The sauce on the side is a good idea too so I can cut calories a bit haha. Nice service and good value for such a huge bagel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tania Reiher

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing food! Great service! Conveniently located next to the Visa center. Fills up fast with customers during lunch break. Their Paninis are great!  Been here several times. Always delicious
sample_reviews_en.author: Raymond Myo-Lwin

restaurants.name: T space
restaurants.address:

428, 1 Soi Sukhumvit 93, Bang Chak, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Friendly team serving fabulous food.. value priced for this quality."

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant feels like home; it's more like eating at someone's house than in a restaurant. The atmosphere is great, and the service is attentive. There's a steady flow of customers, neither too crowded nor too quiet. There's a diverse menu; the minced beef basil stir-fry is delicious, and the pasta dishes are also excellent. The Parma ham and truffle pizzas are also fantastic. The food comes out gradually, so service might be slightly slow, but it's within a manageable wait. There's ample parking. The interior has nice music playing, and the outdoor area is shady and relaxing, giving a homey feel. The staff seem young and approachable. Overall, it's a great experience, the food is delicious, the prices are good, and the staff are friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marisa M

sample_reviews_en.text:
T Space, tucked away on the quieter Sukhumvit Soi 93, is a hidden gem that offers a refreshing escape from the bustling main road. I visited for lunch, and the experience was a pleasant surprise, blending modern vibes with approachable Italian & Thai fusion cuisine.
The restaurant’s exterior is unassuming, but stepping inside reveals a sleek, contemporary space with warm lighting and minimalist decor. Think wooden accents, cozy seating, and a touch of industrial charm—perfect for a casual date night or a catch-up with friends. The outdoor seating area is a nice touch, especially for Bangkok’s cooler evenings. Pizza, salad, burger & coffee are well recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Devlim

sample_reviews_en.text: A very comfortable place with excellent air conditioning. The menu selection wasn't extensive, but we ordered crepes, coconut curry, and crème brûlée, all of which were delicious and reasonably priced. The crepes were crispy and served piping hot. The curry was pleasantly sour, and the omelet with rice was surprisingly tasty. The crème brûlée wasn't particularly impressive. It's a bit of a walk from BtS, but easy to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: Esion lai

sample_reviews_en.text: An unmanned restaurant with no staff. I went there because the reviews were good, but when I entered the entrance, I couldn't see a single staff member. There was one other group of customers eating, but it was a strange sight. I waited for about five minutes hoping that staff would come, but still no one was in sight, so I gave up and went to another restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: 信雄木村

sample_reviews_en.text: It's an Italian restaurant. My friend's restaurant, who is the chef, was closed, so he recommended my friend's restaurant, who is also a chef (wearing glasses). We ordered four dishes. At first, I thought that was a lot, haha. In the end, everything was delicious and we ate it all ❤️😁❤️😁❤️ Plus, they gave us a banana pizza.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aphiwatch Wiboonwattanakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The best pizza I've eaten in Bangkok!!! They make their own pizza dough everyday that makes all the difference. They have an extensive menu, selection pizza, pasta, seafood and also offer popular Thai dishes. The atmosphere is tranquil and calming. I'll definitely be back and I recommend it wholeheartedly💯💯 …
sample_reviews_en.author: jaynish.patel Patel

sample_reviews_en.text: My girlfriend and I regularly grab a bite here. From the bright smile of the lady owner to the succulent taste of the food and the relaxing, homey atmosphere, it's simply one of the best dining experiences in town. Looking forward to many more evenings contemplating the stars from the terrace.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yoan Bruchet

sample_reviews_en.text: This cafe is a great place to sit and relax. The service is good, and the food is delicious, especially the Italian dishes. You can even come here to work. They have a wide variety of coffees. The owner is friendly and welcoming. The food matches the menu. It feels like being at home here.
sample_reviews_en.author: LP. C

restaurants.name: Sudrit Nan Thailand
restaurants.address:

1523 Rama IV Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The coffee was very good and reasonably priced. The café is nicely decorated with lots of fish, which makes the atmosphere charming. However, there were quite a lot of mosquitoes.

There’s also no dedicated restroom for customers — you have to use the hostel’s bathroom on the second floor, which was not very clean, had no tissue, and even when I brought my own, there was no trash bin available.

Great coffee and ambiance, but the restroom situation definitely needs improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ganyanat Phathithin

sample_reviews_en.text: The coffee here was unique and definitely had a specialty vibe — I really enjoyed the distinct flavor that I hadn’t experienced elsewhere. However, the place also functions as a hostel upstairs, and it seemed like the decoration wasn’t fully finished yet. There was a noticeable smell that made the atmosphere a bit unpleasant. Seating was quite limited and not really comfortable for relaxing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panisara

sample_reviews_en.text: A specialty coffee shop in Samyan that is worth trying. CARTIMOR, the coffee beans recommended by the barista. Great taste, flora flavor , easy to drink and go well with Latte. Ordered Dirty is a dark roast. People who like hard body should like it. A variety of drinks you can try on Thai coffee beans. Nice atmosphere, nice barista.
sample_reviews_en.author: LAPIN _11

sample_reviews_en.text: This coffee shop in the Samyan-Banthad Thong area, not far from Chulalongkorn University, offers a wide variety of coffee beans from Nan province—so many that it's hard to choose! I ordered a latte, which was okay, maybe a little too bitter. It's a small shop with limited seating, but the staff were helpful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mint's

sample_reviews_en.text: This coffee shop offers a unique and distinctive flavor, with a smooth and aromatic taste unlike any other. It's conveniently located near Sam Yan MRT station and a short walk from Sam Yan Mitrtown, right on Rama IV Road. The shop has a warm and inviting atmosphere, perfect for relaxing.
sample_reviews_en.author: CAT_CLUB CHANEL

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop owner was very nice. They made the wrong latte; it was supposed to be an Americano. I didn't want to change it, but they insisted on giving us a different one. They have 7-10 kinds of coffee beans to choose from. The ambiance and flavors are both excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tztsung Tz

sample_reviews_en.text: This Nan-originated coffee shop has won numerous awards. Their coffee is exceptional, especially the specialty beans sourced from various regions of Nan province. The shop's ambiance is inviting, making it the perfect spot to enjoy a morning cup of coffee.
sample_reviews_en.author: KürzV X

sample_reviews_en.text: The latte was delicious! It was authentic. It's a rare opportunity to be able to drink and buy Thai N an coffee! It was my first time. Payment is cash only. The baristas barely speak English, but... the shop has greenery and is exotic and …
sample_reviews_en.author: hassie

restaurants.name: Beer Hubb (Pattaya Beach Road)
restaurants.address:

262, Hotel Nautical Inn, 1 Beach Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Beer Hubb in Pattaya was a fantastic surprise and easily one of the most enjoyable places we visited.

What really sets this place apart is the incredible variety. Whether you’re craving Italian, Indian, Thai, or something to pair with a great drink, there’s something for everyone. The food was delicious, but the real highlight was their own craft beers. I absolutely loved the concept of being able to sample different beers before deciding which one to order. It’s a brilliant idea that lets you discover your favorite without any guesswork.

A special mention goes to our server, Apple. She truly made our evening memorable. Her cheerful personality, warm smile, and genuine hospitality made us feel like we were guests in her own home rather than customers in a restaurant. Her recommendations were spot on, and she was always attentive without ever being intrusive. Staff like Apple are the reason people return.

The atmosphere is lively yet comfortable, making it a perfect place to relax with friends or family over good food and excellent beer.

We’ll definitely be back the next time we’re in Pattaya. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nilay Vakil

sample_reviews_en.text:
##A lovely place with an amazing ocean view! 🌊🌅##
Beer Hubb is located right on Pattaya Beach Road, making it a great spot to relax and enjoy the beautiful view of the sea.
The coffee was amazing ☕️, and their mango sticky rice was absolutely delicious — definitely one of the best I’ve tried in Pattaya! 🥭🍚
The staff were very helpful, friendly, and welcoming, which made the experience even better.
It’s especially nice in the evening, when you can sit back, enjoy the sea breeze, and watch the beautiful sunset. 🌅
Definitely a place I would recommend if you’re looking for a relaxing spot with a great beach view and a lovely atmosphere. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Souad Yassine

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Beer Hub is perfectly located right on the beach promenade. The view is magnificent. You can sit upstairs or downstairs.

The welcome was always very warm. The staff are all very friendly and do a fantastic job. Very service-oriented.

The food is very good. The stir-fried cashew nuts were the best. It's a bit pricey for the location. The menu is extensive... We've been here twice already.

There's always someone singing live downstairs.

We would definitely go back a third time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Susi S

sample_reviews_en.text: This is our regular dinner spot. We alternate between the Na Kluea and Beach branches. On Saturday night, we drove there, and a security guard guided us to a parking spot. There was only one space available, and two motorcycles were parked over the line. The security guard walked away without helping us move the motorcycles, leaving us to get out and move them ourselves. My friend had to yell at us to just skip the meal and go to another restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emma Patchanee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice bar and restaurant, all wood, with live music downstairs and lovely views from upstairs.
The food is varied, and what we tried was very good.
The atmosphere is pleasant, they have good drinks, a variety of beers, and the staff is friendly.
The prices are a bit high. A Thai beer is 99 baht, but if you go for the craft beers and cocktails, the price skyrockets, and the food isn't cheap either. Typical tourist spot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Antonio Socías Carrillo

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was great. I came with friends today and tried many different craft beers. Some were quite expensive, but there were also more affordable options. Overall, I loved the atmosphere and the beer experience here. The Thai food was also delicious, especially the papaya salad and sun-dried pork. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนพร สวนบัว

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is clean. Apple (the owner) is very nice and the service is great. She's also good at getting people drunk! The food is delicious, but the only downside is that the waitstaff are very good at getting people drunk too! 55555555 Overall, I liked it. ❤️🫰🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Warissara Kawsaythong

sample_reviews_en.text: A great bar with a huge selection of draft craft beers! Lots of fruity ones – peach, pineapple, blackberry, lemon. There are even stouts with salted caramel, peanut butter, and tai tea. There's live music in the evenings – it's nice to hear a guy and a girl sing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Diana

restaurants.name: โคตรเซียน สปาเก็ตตี้ ซอย จุฬา 3
restaurants.address:

81 Chulalongkorn 3 Alley, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Food is above average, the pasta is perfectly al-dente, though the Hamburg steak can be a bit chewy, yet not unbearably so, yet the sauce balances the richness of the glaze reduction with the aromatics perfectly. The seafood pesto was very delicious, in fact, we went back for seconds. The atmosphere is par for the course, but the service is amazing. The people seems truly passionate about their food, overall an extremely pleasant experience and I would recommend others visit here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Katherine Kerman

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! The flavors were well-balanced and the air conditioning was nice and cool 🍽️. We each got a free large glass of lemon tea 🍋. The service was great; the staff and the elderly lady were very kind ⭐️. The price was reasonable, not too expensive. The prawns were big! 🦐
sample_reviews_en.author: Chutikarn Amornpisalnmit

sample_reviews_en.text:
An underrated little shop! The white sauce pasta and pesto pasta were both excellent. The shrimp were huge and meaty! 👍🏻 I also unexpectedly received some delicious durian (thank you, owner! 😽)

If you can't find good food, don't hesitate to come in!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tasha

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is so nice and the pasta taste more like homemade version, which is good! I’d recommend the pesto pasta because it’s not like normal pesto, they use thai basil ❤️

The price is also affordable. 159 baht for a pasta
sample_reviews_en.author: BT88

sample_reviews_en.text: Walked in to get a small bite to eat and got offered a whole meal. Creamy mushroom soup is amazing and the service comes with a smile. Catered to me being Vegiterian, would highly recommend if you’re in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ripley Weston

sample_reviews_en.text: I went several times during my lunch breaks at work! I liked the food that are both authentic and can recall tastes of Europe and some with Thai touches! I recommend this restaurant and the staff is very friendly
sample_reviews_en.author: Mattéo Bethon

sample_reviews_en.text: We had pesto pasta with shrimp. The pasta was fresh, delicious, and full of flavor at local prices. The food was served very quickly. The staff is great and friendly. We highly recommend this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamil Janik

sample_reviews_en.text: Good service , So delicious! The spaghetti carbonara with bacon was creamy and flavorful. The bacon was crispy and added the perfect salty taste. I’ll definitely order again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thae su su san Julia

restaurants.name: Northeastern Thai
restaurants.address:

33 1 Soi Loet Punya, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered Grilled beef but the waiter served us a dish looks like pork meat. I immediately told the staff I didn’t order this and he said this was beef that I ordered.
We tried that but it definitely not beef, so we asked two others waitress if they served us the wrong dish. They checked with their palm to see our orders and she agreed we ordered beef. She pointed to the dish of pork and told me that was beef. That’s ridiculous!!
When we asked the waitress to cancel the dish since they didn’t serve me grilled beef but pork instead. The waitress looks super annoyed and rude and spoke Thai that we can’t understand.
I am so disappointed about their attitude and  dishonest.
And something we don’t understand is why they do this? The grilled pork neck and grilled beef actually cost the same.
At the end they didn’t charge us the dish of pork neck but already brought me unpleansant experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicole Wu

sample_reviews_en.text:
On our way back to the hotel from the MRT, we saw this small, local restaurant. It had plenty of seats, but it was packed during mealtimes, so we decided to try some Thai-style hot pot.

First of all, the prices were very reasonable; you wouldn't feel bad ordering too much. But the three of us were just too greedy! We wanted to try everything, and before we knew it, we ordered way too much. The staff had to come over again to confirm our order.

The steamed egg was delicious—plenty of ingredients and very flavorful. The pork neck and squid were perfectly cooked. The grilled fish was sweet and fresh without any fishy taste.

The hot pot itself was generous with ingredients, but the broth was a bit sweet. You have to put the raw egg on top of the meat slices before cooking. There were also plenty of vegetables and glass noodles. We were so full!
sample_reviews_en.author: 千HSu

sample_reviews_en.text:
I keep coming back for the sea bass, and it never disappoints. The whole fish was incredibly fresh, perfectly cooked, and packed with flavor from the garlic, lime, herbs, and chili. It’s easily one of the best sea bass dishes I’ve had in Bangkok.

The seafood here is consistently excellent. The clams were fresh and flavorful, and the shrimp dish had just the right balance of spice and seasoning. Every plate felt like it was made with care and quality ingredients.

What really sets this place apart, though, is the staff. Everyone is welcoming, attentive, and genuinely friendly. They make you feel like a valued guest from the moment you walk in until the moment you leave.

If you’re looking for outstanding seafood, amazing sea bass, and service that keeps you coming back, this place is a must-visit. I’ll definitely be back again soon. 🌟🐟🍤
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeremiah Luttrell

sample_reviews_en.text:
As a tourist, I find this eatery quite delicious with good location.
The staff was polite to bring us the menu and served very quickly.
We choose 3 simple dishes. Fried rice, pork basil rice and morning glory (veggie). The fried rice was a little bland, but maybe jt was supposed to sprinkle fish sauce on top (what we didn’t do because of the spicy chillies in the sauce). The mince pork basil was delicious. The last one, morning glory veggie was a little too salty for us. Overall everything was good and the total was 220baht (one coke included).
I normally would prefer to eat inside the food court but this was a good alternative with wide choice of dishes.
Would recommend if you stay nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ngân Thùy

sample_reviews_en.text:
Since my hotel room won’t be ready until 2 pm, I was wandering in that area and thinking what I should eat. This place caught my eyes because it’s half-open design. I was seated. When I looked at everyone walking on the street around this placed, it feels so chill.
I ordered Som Tum and half of a roasted chicken, later I added a bottle of cold beer. Som Tum is on point, although less sugar added will be better. Roasted chicken was juicy and flavorful; dipping sauce is spicy but delicious.
When I paid my bill, I was shocked it only costs me 300ish. Such a great value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gu Lin

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were looking for a quick meal near our accommodation and found this place on Google Maps by searching “Northeastern Thai.”

It’s a local restaurant, but the place was relatively clean and comfortable.
The food was not overly spicy, so it was easy to enjoy even with kids.

We ordered seafood fried rice and green curry.
The green curry was coconut-based, mild, and flavorful without being too heavy.
There’s no air conditioning, but there is an indoor restroom and plenty of tables.

A good option if you’re looking for a reliable local meal without strong flavors.
sample_reviews_en.author: jessica Sun

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant was very nice and willing to help prepare the vegetarian dishes! I ordered Pad Thai, and although I don't eat the five pungent vegetables (garlic, onions, leeks, and shallots), the restaurant probably forgot in their busy schedule and added chives, but thankfully they were easy to pick out! I also asked the restaurant to add an extra 20 yuan worth of vegetables. Vegetarians who don't eat the five pungent vegetables should specifically ask the restaurant not to add them.

Other options include fried rice and stir-fried vegetables.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chiao Chiao

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had an amazing experience at this restaurant!

The chicken with cashews was absolutely delicious, and the rice was excellent too. But the real star of the show was the pineapple smoothie – it was fantastic!

The only downside was that the place was a bit noisy, but that didn't detract from the overall experience.

Plus, the prices were very reasonable, especially considering how delicious everything was. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for great food at a great price!
sample_reviews_en.author: Artem Bykov

restaurants.name: Lucky Suki, The Prom Din Daeng branch
restaurants.address:

4755 Pracha Songkhro Rd, Ratchadaphisek, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Came here for a casual suki night but ลัคกี้ สุกี้ สาขา เดอะ พร้อม ดินแดง said “sit down, let us bless you with broth and nostalgia” — and I surrendered willingly 🫕🥚🐷

The vibe? Straight up OG Thai suki joint energy — red trays, plastic chairs, smokey air, and the kind of menu that hasn’t changed since Nokia ruled the world. I threw inหมูหมัก, ผักบุ้ง, วุ้นเส้น, and of course, cracked an egg into that bubbling broth like I was casting a delicious spell 🧙‍♂️🥬🔥

But the real MVP? That signature suki sauce — spicy, tangy, garlicky, slightly sweet, and fully addictive. I dunked everything into it like a man possessed. The pork was tender, soup was comforting, and service was fast in that classic “auntie yells your order across the room” kind of way.

Left full, happy, and smelling like a hotpot hero. If you want real Thai suki that hits the soul, not the IG trends — this place is your lucky draw.
sample_reviews_th.author: PK PTD

sample_reviews_en.text: A famous sukiyaki restaurant has opened at The Prom, Din Daeng/Huai Khwang. There's parking available at the shopping center; get your parking ticket stamped at the restaurant for free parking. The restaurant is on the 2nd floor, a large space with over 50 tables, and also has a bar area. You can choose two soup bases. I tried the special soup and found it just okay. The clear and black soups were sufficient. The food selection is typical: meats, vegetables, meatballs, seafood, and snacks. During my visit, there was a promotion for glass shrimp, king prawns, and Australian beef for an additional 30 baht, which I enjoyed. The meats were sliced ​​just right, though some servings were too thin. The taste was good. What I liked most was the wide variety of snacks and slushies, as well as the dipping sauces – spicy and a fermented tofu sauce (similar to a mild sauce for children). A word of caution: service can be slow during peak hours, and food quality might drop. Overall, it's a good restaurant, and I'd visit often if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิชชพงศ์ อริยสุนทร

sample_reviews_en.text:
Relaxing and having a meal at Lucky Sukii's new branch!
This is TheProm's 12th branch! 😊✨️
Enjoy unlimited delicious food for 219 baht, open late until 2 AM.

Our favorite shabu-shabu restaurant! 😍 Fresh and clean ingredients.
Perfect for night owls like us, open until 2 AM.
Every time we come, we're happy. The taste, the atmosphere, and the service are all excellent.

Order food by scanning the QR code 📒
Lucky and Hengheng the robots will help serve you.

Dim sum is available only Mon-Fri 10:30 AM - 4:00 PM
(Excluding Sat-Sun and public holidays)

Unlimited drinks and fried food at the bar.
🥤 Smoothies are a highlight.

5 types of soup are available.
Special soup is Boat Noodle Soup, served until September 30, 2021.
🥫 3 dipping sauces: Cantonese, Hainanese, and Seafood.

Price 219 💸 (excluding 39 baht for refills and 7% tax)
net 276 Tax included 🥤🍨

🎉Promotion🎊🎁
Celebrating the grand opening of our new Din Daeng branch!
Enjoy unlimited free bubble tea 🧋 for 10 days only!
Starts July 26th - August 4th, 2021 at all branches.
sample_reviews_en.author: นอน ว่างๆ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lucky City restaurant is located in The Promdindaeng.

The Promdindaeng parking lot has approximately 45 to 50 spaces.
Double parking is not allowed.

Parking is charged, but if you dine at the restaurant and get your parking ticket stamped, you can park for free for 4 hours at 20 baht. After that, it's 30 baht per hour.

There is a diverse menu available, and you can order through an application. Robot servers are used for serving.

They have a good selection of drinks, including chrysanthemum tea and blended punch. For those who like bubble tea, they offer Taiwanese bubble tea with self-serve tapioca pearls.

The pork is tender, but the beef might be a bit chewy, though acceptable.
The squid is served in small portions; you might need to order several servings.

The river prawns are small but look good, though we didn't order them.

The soup bases are flavorful, almost all of them.

The dipping sauces are the typical sukiyaki sauces found at most BBQ restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Penyanun Cordero A.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went for dinner at 10:30 PM, no queue.

Buffet prices start at 219 baht. There are 5 soup options. The restaurant is spacious, bright, and comfortable.

Impressed with the fried food station; the chives were excellent 👍🏻
(The French fries were a bit soggy).

Drinks include both soft drinks and Slurpees, which were delicious!

The beef and pork were good quality for the price.
There are two dipping sauces: Lucky Cantonese and Lucky Hainanese.
Personally, I preferred the Hainanese sauce; it was more flavorful.

I think the vegetable set was very generous and complete.
There was too much pumpkin and carrots; I couldn't finish them, which was a waste haha.

I deducted a star for the service. The staff weren't very cheerful, seemed grumpy and in a bad mood, and weren't attentive. I had to keep calling for them.

But the food was delicious, especially the fried items. I'll definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Putt Te

sample_reviews_en.text:
Divided between 2 people, 308 THB each (because we chose the mala soup + pork bone soup at 29 THB each). Waited in line for 50 minutes. Arrived at 6:50 PM and got into the restaurant at 7:40 PM.
Delicious! Clean and satisfying. But it would be even better if they had seafood dipping sauce.
The restaurant has 2 types of sukiyaki dipping sauce.
The mala soup is rich and the pork bone soup is rich. Eating it with udon noodles is incredibly satisfying.
They also have Australian beef, fresh squid, fresh shrimp, and cheese which is very delicious.
On the day we went, they didn't have dim sum or Taiwanese milk tea. Too bad.
Each fried item looked very appetizing.
Food was served quickly almost every time we ordered. Only the last order came out a little slow, but not too slow. The staff were all very helpful and enthusiastic.
sample_reviews_en.author: RIGHTNOWPHOTO

sample_reviews_en.text:
Complaint regarding staff at The Prom Ratchada branch:

Today (March 14, 2026) at approximately 6:40 PM, I stood in line at the designated queue area. There was already one person in line. Then other customers arrived later and went to the counter. The staff told that group of customers that they didn't have a queue number. I pointed out that I and another customer arrived first, but the staff just apologized and ignored me. I repeatedly emphasized that the other customer arrived before us, but the staff still prioritized the group who came later. I was extremely upset and left the restaurant. I've eaten here many times before and have never experienced anything like this. I may not come back again. I'm so disappointed I want to give a 1-star rating on all apps.
sample_reviews_en.author: GRAVITY ram

sample_reviews_en.text:
The wait for food was long, the staff were disorganized with the queue numbers, and they served the wrong food to the wrong table. I ordered one type of soup but received something else.

I sat at my table for almost 10 minutes and the pot still hadn't arrived, even though I timed it from the counter.

The staff kept dragging the garbage cart and dishes close to the tables, creating a strong smell of food scraps that made me not want to eat. This is despite the parking lot being just a short distance away – they prioritize convenience over safety. The garbage cart and food delivery robots obstructed pedestrian traffic. I reported it to the staff three times, but they just brought it back and dumped it again shortly after, as shown in the attached picture.
sample_reviews_en.author: ton kuma

restaurants.name: Lily's Kitchen
restaurants.address:

78, Subdistrict, 97 Moo 9 Nongprue Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Delicious food, fast and good service, large portions, reasonably priced."

sample_reviews_en.text: Li's Kitchen, a Sichuan restaurant in Pattaya, is one of the best Chinese restaurants I've ever had. Their dishes are very affordable and offer great value. The service is also very warm and welcoming. The location is excellent; a Chongqing hot pot restaurant recently opened nearby, making parking very convenient. Their ingredients are incredibly fresh. The location is fantastic; a Chongqing hot pot restaurant has opened across the street, and this area seems to be a Sichuan food street. The environment is great, and the location is right next to the night market. It's a great place to try their food. I think Li's Kitchen is one of the best Sichuan restaurants I've ever had. I always make sure to visit Li's Kitchen whenever I'm in Pattaya. There are so many Sichuan restaurants nearby now, which is great.
sample_reviews_en.author: jianquan wang

sample_reviews_en.text: As a northerner living in Chengdu, I always visit Li's Kitchen in Pattaya. The dishes are always authentic Chengdu flavors. This time, however, I was a bit disappointed. I ordered several of the same dishes during the day and at night, but the flavors and cooking styles were completely different. For example, the Fuqi Feipian (Five-Hearted Lung Slices) the daytime chef prepared was authentic Chengdu flavor, rich in the aroma of red oil. But at 11 p.m., the dish I ordered was surprisingly crispy bamboo shoots and served with a spicy, sour vinegary northern-style mixed vegetable. Consistency is a key element of a quality restaurant, and I hope the owner will prioritize this.
sample_reviews_en.author: 王伟奇

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent authentic Sichuan Chinese food in Pattaya. Lily’s Kitchen (Li Jia Chu Fang) really stands out with bold flavors, fresh ingredients, and generous portions. The dishes are spicy, rich, and taste like real Chinese cuisine, not a tourist version.
Service was fast and attentive, and the atmosphere is clean and comfortable with a nice Chinese-style design. Prices are very reasonable for the quality you get.
If you are in Pattaya and want real Chinese food, this place is definitely worth visiting. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dainis Ledājs

sample_reviews_en.text: Flies are everywhere, landing on our plates, and it's disgusting even to sit there. We even had to kill one because it kept sticking to us. The moro tofu had a strange aftertaste, like it had too much baking soda, and it left our tongues numb. We'd had it before and we know what it tastes like. We had to avoid eating from plates where flies had landed.
sample_reviews_en.author: nastya skornyakova

sample_reviews_en.text: The environment was clean and bright, and the food was delicious—I finished it before I even had a chance to take pictures (it would be even better if there were a little less food). It was authentic and catered to a wide range of tastes. I'd definitely come back to try other dishes. It's rare to find such good Sichuan food in Pattaya!
sample_reviews_en.author: Isaac Chua

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a very Chinese-style decor, which looks festive. The waiters are friendly, the environment is clean and hygienic, and the food is served quickly. Moreover, the food is delicious and reasonably priced. Chinese tourists visiting Pattaya should definitely try this Sichuan restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: x zhou

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered the dry pot pork ribs and shrimp, boiled fish, and hot and sour shredded potatoes, all of which were very delicious and authentic Sichuan cuisine. The portions were generous, and I would definitely come back to this restaurant in Pattaya next time I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gigi

sample_reviews_en.text: Food came out super fast and tasted amazing — so good that I had to order two extra bowls of rice! The restaurant has a lovely Chinese-style decor and a great atmosphere. Prices are very reasonable for the quality and portion size. Definitely worth coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: nannan sri

restaurants.name: Thai Rung Rueang Yen Ta Fo - Charoen Phon
restaurants.address:

1154 Banthat Thong Rd, Rong Mueang, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time here, and I ordered the thin rice noodle yentafo. Every element was perfect. The noodles were tossed with crispy fried garlic, didn't stick together, and were perfectly cooked. There were three or four types of meatballs, all delicious and unlike the fake bouncy ones from other places. The fish cake was tasty, and the yentafo broth and sauce were spot-on – not the fake pink broth you find at other low-quality places. They used only the tender parts of the morning glory, the wontons were perfectly crispy, and there was plenty of pork. All this for only 60 baht!! Free tea!! And there's a cat to welcome you too. Anyone passing by *needs* to try this. It's a 10/10!!

It was so delicious I forgot to take pictures. So delicious I had to write a review to help promote the place. I'll definitely be back. One of the most perfect yentafo in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Waratsinthawee Phongsinchitchayaphakin

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍜 Review: Delicious Roadside Yentafo Noodle Shop

If you're passing by this area, I highly recommend trying the yentafo noodles at this shop. It's a small shop by the roadside with no parking, but the taste is extraordinary!

✨ The highlights are the chewy noodles, the very fresh fish balls and fish cakes, and the rich, flavorful yentafo broth with just the right amount of fermented tofu aroma – not too strong.

🥢 The shop has about 40 seats, not many tables, but they turn over quickly. If you come during lunchtime, it will be very crowded. I recommend avoiding peak hours or ordering takeout instead.

🚫 Caution: There is no parking. You'll have to park at Lotus Rama 1 and walk over, which is more convenient.

Overall, it's a famous yentafo noodle shop with great taste. If it weren't for the parking issue, it would be "worth the wait"!
sample_reviews_en.author: ประวิทย์ ทวีโชค

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thai Rungruang Yentafo Charoenphol is a yentafo noodle shop in the Charoenphol area that has been open for over 50 years. It is famous for its secret yentafo sauce with a rich flavor and its homemade fish balls that are chewy, soft, and not fishy. Yentafo: The highlight is the rich sauce and generous toppings, including fish balls, shrimp balls, and fish cakes.
Fried Pork Dumplings: Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, a great appetizer.
Location: 1154 Banthat Thong Road, Rong Muang Subdistrict, Pathum Wan District, Bangkok (Located at the foot of Charoenphol Bridge, opposite Lotus Rama 1)
sample_reviews_en.author: Vit

sample_reviews_en.text: Worst service ever! After finishing my meal, I carefully gathered the tissues and placed them next to my bowl, only to have the owner yell at me and tell me to throw them in the trash? Seriously, is this a restaurant or a military camp? Shouldn't cleaning up be the staff's responsibility? If customers are supposed to do everything themselves, just close the restaurant and cook at home! It was incredibly frustrating! Terrible manners, no sense of responsibility, no concept of service mind. Be prepared to be yelled at if you plan to eat here. One visit is enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tr O

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very polite and friendly waitress. She spoke English and explained to me how things worked.
I was about to order something I didn't like, so I really appreciated her explaining what I was about to order.
So I ordered what she recommended, very good, but could have been a little more flavourful in the broth. But maybe that's how the dish is.

Cost very little for that service, so I don't understand why people give such a bad review. Yes, it's on the side of the road, but they make the best of the situation.

Recommend👏
sample_reviews_en.author: kim long

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is of excellent quality. The fish balls have no added flour like other shops. The soup is always piping hot. The staff provides great service and is very friendly. If you come to this restaurant, you must try at least two dishes: the noodle soup and the Yen Ta Fo (pink noodle soup). If you're very hungry, order the crispy wontons, which are incredibly delicious; the wrapper is thin and the filling is amazing. In short, everything at this restaurant is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Passakorn Chumpoonta

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! The crispy fried dumplings are excellent, with plenty of pork filling. The boiled dumplings are also tasty, and they pair well with either seafood dipping sauce or soy sauce. The shrimp meatballs are delicious, and the Yen Ta Fo soup broth is perfectly balanced. I've eaten at this restaurant 30 years ago, and it's still as delicious as ever. The quality hasn't dropped at all!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wiboon Laorstiankul

sample_reviews_en.text: The mushroom meatballs are delicious! The boiled dishes with dipping sauce are good, the fried dumplings are tasty, and the flatbread noodles are good too. However, the noodle dishes I ordered had too much garlic oil, making them a bit greasy after eating. There's no parking. The soup is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna Sun

restaurants.name: เถ่าชิ่วน้ำเต้าหู้มือหนึ่ง พรานนก-กาญจนาภิเษก
restaurants.address:

9/5 Bang Phrom 39 Alley, Bang Phrom, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a really crowded shop. We arrived at noon and it wasn't open yet. We've missed it many times. Today, I passed by around 3 p.m. and had the chance to park and let my boyfriend go get something to eat. He came back carrying a whole bag.
Six bottles of soy milk for 100 baht.
A bag of tofu without toppings for 16 toppings for 25 baht.
Bua Loi Nam King (55 baht).
Kaya toast (I can't remember the price).
Total cost about 300 baht.
Out of curiosity, I quickly opened a bottle of zero-sugar soy milk and tried it. The first sip...not rich, not fragrant...
Okay, maybe I expected too much. I took a second sip and let my boyfriend have a sip...and it was the same...
The kaya toast was taken out for dinner. It was delicious. I tried another bag of unsweetened soy milk. It was the same. I didn't try anything else. I bought some for him.
In short, these days, don't get excited by social media and seeing a crowded shop. The shop isn't doing anything wrong; they're just following their own recipe. I just had too much hope. But if this shop opens in a mall and we meet another owner...it's worrisome.
sample_reviews_en.author: T TAN

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was edible, but it wasn't served hot at all. This one was a bit soggy.

Soy Milk with Toppings - There were a lot of toppings, and the soy milk wasn't bad. It was mild, not too sweet, and medium-bodied, but not hot at all 😭

Sangkaya Bread - Very average. No milk on top, and the bread wasn't hot anymore, and it wasn't soft.

Ginger Juice, Tofu Puffs, and Lotus Seeds - This one wasn't very hot either. But what really bothered me was the tofu puffs. They had a smell that was about to go. They were almost too much. They weren't fragrant, but they were almost spoiled.

Bua Loi - They were cold again. The sesame filling was quite coarse, and the dough was chewy.

Overall, the restaurant seemed to have a lot of staff, but many were confused. It seems like everyone came here because of the reviews on TikTok.

I had high hopes for the soy milk here. The taste wasn't bad, but I really wish they could improve the heat. I came here to eat on a rainy, cold day, expecting something hot to warm my stomach. 🥹
sample_reviews_en.author: Rafrenze (ゆう)

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was very crowded, and I waited in line for about 10 minutes.
Once you get a table, check the menu, write down your order and table number on a piece of paper, and pay at the counter first. When your order is ready, a staff member will bring it to your table.

I ordered soy milk with extra tofu skin. The taste was okay, but the soy milk wasn't very rich and was a bit too sweet (even though I asked for less sugar when ordering, it was still very sweet for me).
The volcano milk with ginkgo nuts was a bit bitter.
Finally, the custard bread was just okay; the custard was decent.

I really wanted to try the fried dough sticks, but I ordered the three dishes beforehand and was afraid I wouldn't be able to finish them. So I asked to order just one, but the shop doesn't sell them individually. I wish the shop would consider selling them individually; it would be great for those who want to try them. Because if they're delicious...next time I'd order a set.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oomchu Pichit

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're driving along the new Phran Nok bypass road, you'll know Tao Chiu Soy Milk shop.

People have been stopping by since they first parked along the road, and now they have their own parking lot next to the shop. It gets harder to find parking late at night, so you might have to park further away.
The shop offers a wide variety of soy milk with many toppings.

My favorite is the spicy ginger soup with glutinous rice balls. It's delicious, especially with added lotus root and chewy ginkgo nuts. Adding crispy fried dough sticks is also great. Many shops' ginkgo nuts aren't soft and chewy, but these are truly chewy and tender.

As for the soy milk, it's rich and creamy, with a distinct bean flavor. You can tell it's not made with artificial cream or other artificial flavorings.

The shop opens at 3 PM, and as soon as it opens, a queue forms.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wara Pong

sample_reviews_en.text:
✅ If you prefer less sweet, light flavors, you'll like this shop.
🚗 There's parking for about 20 cars + street parking available.
💰 Scan payment is accepted.
🚨 Fried dough sticks (Patongko) are sold from 4 PM.

💛 Food: The custard buns are delicious, the bread is soft and warm. The cold fresh milk and grass jelly with milk buns (volcano style) are suitable for those who like light, mild, and healthy flavors. However, I grew up with sweet and strong flavors, so it felt a bit strange to me. There were a lot of Thai people of Chinese descent eating here, it felt like being in Chinatown (I'm one of them, but I'm really not used to this taste, sigh). I'll try the fried dough sticks next time, and if they're delicious, I'll adjust the rating.

💛 Service: OK, wait time for food is about 5-10 minutes.
sample_reviews_en.author: mmeimeii

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice tofu drinks and good Thai desserts in this area.
Lots of people waiting for a table at night.
Quite pricey.
Taste was so so, not that impressed…
Low service.

Delicious, but not wow. I don't know what's so wow about the long queue.
The soy milk was served in a bowl. I asked for a glass, but the staff said they didn't have it. Served like this.

I don't like the attitude of this staff.
They pressed the water and handed it to the customer, almost throwing the water in the glass at them. Heh heh.
Manners…👎🏻

If they're going to serve, they should inform the customer. They're too lazy to press the water. With so many people in line, who wants to wait for the water to be served?

I only tried it once. Nothing made me want to come again.
If I had to wait in line…bye.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ja JaMie

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ate here twice, around the same time.
The first time, I arrived around 7 PM on a weekend and there were still seats available, but after that, it got very crowded. I saw a long queue, and it got even more crowded as it got later. It seemed like people finished their dinner and then came here.

The fried dough sticks (patonggo) were delicious; soft and tasty, and served hot.
The tofu pudding was okay.
My friend said the soy milk and ginger-flavored glutinous rice balls were good.

But the custard buns were just average.

The second time, around 5 PM, it wasn't too crowded, and parking was easy.
You can find parking near the front of the shop, but if it's very crowded, you might have to park further away.
sample_reviews_en.author: SSS BKK

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an interesting soy milk shop. What I liked was the huge variety of toppings and options, over 100 items! They have soy milk, ginger tea, steamed buns, custard, and many more topping choices. Don't come when you're starving because the queue is very long. It's super crowded. I arrived at 9 PM and waited for 16 people ahead of me, about 30 minutes. The convenience of having parking inside is great. I felt that the food and desserts were a bit too sugary. Personally, I don't like sweet things and don't add sugar at all, but I ordered ginger tea and even with a little sugar, it felt too sweet. It depends on personal preference. But overall, the shop is clean and uses good quality ingredients.
sample_reviews_en.author: PMWP Petra

restaurants.name: Kai Yang Klang Bueng
restaurants.address:

4, 1 Sanam Golf Alley, Nong Bon, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a real missed opportunity with a new customer. I'm very disappointed with the restaurant. I went for a birthday dinner with my boyfriend. We drove past, saw the restaurant looked inviting and the atmosphere was nice, so we stopped for a meal and a few drinks. Normally, my boyfriend and I order a lot of food, but since I usually drink, we ordered two dishes first and five bottles of beer, planning to order more later. The first staff member, a woman who spoke what sounded like she was from the Shan ethnic group, greeted us well. After that, she disappeared and didn't provide any further service. There were only three tables occupied in the whole restaurant, but it seemed like they only served foreign customers. I waved to order a third dish, a steamed sea bass, but when it was served, it was spilled everywhere. There wasn't even an apology. It was very difficult to get their attention by waving. They completely ignored the customers. Also, the ice tongs were left on the table, but they took the ice bucket away. I was so confused. Is this acceptable?
sample_reviews_en.author: Jidapa Teerak

sample_reviews_en.text:
✅ If you're in the Bang Na, Srinakarin, or Udom Suk area,
📍📍 don't miss this! 📍📍
A delicious restaurant with a relaxed, riverside atmosphere reminiscent of childhood. This is the place to be!

Kai Yang Klang Bueng (Grilled Chicken in the Middle of the Pond) 🍗🐔
📌📌 Must-try dishes: Crispy skin, tender meat, and a delicious dipping sauce. Also try the crispy basil pork neck.

👀😎 Enjoy the relaxing riverside view and watch the large catfish – a kid's dream!

🐠🐟 Activities: Feed the large catfish with bread.

You absolutely can't miss “Kai Yang Klang Bueng”!

Getting there 🚕: By car or BTS Yellow Line, get off at Suan Luang Rama IX Station.

Nearby attractions: Seacon Srinakarin, Train Night Market, Paradise Park.

Plus, if you want to host a party, there are private rooms available for karaoke.

Great atmosphere, convenient location, delicious food – you can't miss it! If you like Northeastern Thai food, you absolutely have to try this! 😍😋😋
#GrilledChickenInTheMiddleOfTheBueng
#kaiyangklangbueng
sample_reviews_en.author: พิชชาพร บุตรทอง

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was a bit slow, both the waitstaff and the kitchen.
Even though there were no customers, there was a sign saying "Sorry for the unsatisfactory service," so I wasn't too bothered. I waited about 10 minutes for my food. The first dish served was papaya salad, followed by fried pork neck with basil, crispy-skinned grilled chicken, and minced pork with basil and a fried egg.

The papaya salad was very ordinary, nothing special, just edible.

The fried pork neck was delicious, tender, and well-marinated with great flavor.
Highly recommend.

The crispy-skinned grilled chicken was delicious, and the tamarind dipping sauce with three flavors was good.

The minced pork with basil and a fried egg was a complete failure.

Overall, it was okay.

There were plenty of fish to watch while you waited.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eat with Dude

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came based on other people's reviews. I ate there on a Friday lunchtime in April. It was very hot, and perhaps because of the time of day, we were the only table occupied. There's an air-conditioned room, but it wasn't on, so it was quite hot. They needed fans to help.

As for the food, I ordered four dishes, and they were all delicious. My favorite was the Tom Yum Pla Kang (spicy fish soup). The fish was tender and had no fishy smell. Next was the Som Tum Korat (papaya salad), which was flavorful and delicious. The Larb Moo (spicy minced pork salad) was also very good. The first three dishes were so delicious they overshadowed the crispy-skinned grilled chicken. I highly recommend it, but it might be better to go in the evening when the weather is cooler.
sample_reviews_en.author: Norrapat Towanabut

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came on Makha Bucha Day, from noon to 2 PM. There were no other customers, so we had the whole room to ourselves.
The staff provided excellent service. The restaurant has many tables.
Parking is available on the street in front of the restaurant, or in the large parking lot.

We ordered several dishes, including papaya salad, grilled pork neck, fried fish, shiitake mushrooms, glass noodle salad, and others.
Overall, nothing was particularly delicious.
The glass noodle salad was a bit bad; it was too sour and salty.

Another drawback was that the air conditioning wasn't working properly.
The price wasn't cheap either; we spent 2000 baht, but only ordered basic dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: W. W.

sample_reviews_en.text: This cafe restaurant has a stylish location and atmosphere. The food is quite tasty. I usually go there early for business meetings. It gets crowded at night, so the evening is a good time to go when it's quieter and has a nice atmosphere. It's close to the monorail station, so it's easy to access. It's also conveniently close to the night market. I liked the fact that it's near a pond, making it feel like it's floating on the pond, and the wooden architecture gives it a colonial-style feel. There were lots of fish in the pond. Some were carp and killifish, but there were also a ton of catfish-like fish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kent

sample_reviews_en.text:
Recommended dishes include the crispy-skinned grilled chicken, which is incredibly delicious. The chicken is tender, well-marinated, and the skin is perfectly crispy. The steak with Jaew dipping sauce is also highly recommended. All the dishes taste great, but they are quite spicy. If you don't like spicy food, you should order them non-spicy.
The food and staff are good, but the restaurant is showing signs of wear and tear due to low customer volume. We need to support them by buying their food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patteera Lynn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stumbled across this gem of a place when it was raining so heavy out, the staff was so friendly and hospitable and didn’t pressure us or rush us at all despite it being 45 mins to closing.
Fried fish, fried prawns, fried beef, steamed squid and even a plain omelette was one of the best things we’ve eaten on this trip. Really will recommend this place 100%!

We didn’t even take a picture of the food as they all tasted so good. We only have pictures of the table wiped clean
sample_reviews_en.author: Cherie Ling

restaurants.name: ร้านนภนานา
restaurants.address:

Soi Yothinpattana 3 Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It's understandable that it's a holiday and they're short on staff, so the food is slow, but there should be better management. We waited over an hour for our food. We solved the problem by buying drinks and take-away food to eat first, but that might have made the food even slower because it was the same person preparing it. I'm just guessing, because I don't understand why it took so long. Even though they said there were many Line Man orders, they should have managed the customers better. We were a group of over 10 people. In the end, we asked to cancel some dishes. Only a few items arrived, and they rushed out after we canceled, but we also received food we didn't order. We quickly paid because we wanted to go to another restaurant. We got take-away appetizers, 6 plates of fried rice, and 2 plates of fried chicken, totaling over 3,000 baht. What shocked us was that we also received smoked duck, priced at 320 baht (as pictured), which we didn't order but had already paid for. We only noticed it at the next restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: atapong sinchaisri

sample_reviews_en.text:
*Yothin Phatthana 3...
It's been a while since I've been to Yothin Phatthana 3, and a lot has changed, including this restaurant, "Nok Nana."
It's a Thai restaurant with a warm atmosphere, offering seating both inside the building and on the riverside terrace.
The Thai food is excellent, with rich flavors and expertly prepared curries and spices.
The menu is diverse, and some dishes are
hard to find now, such as Nam Prik Long Ruea (spicy shrimp paste dip) served with fresh turmeric and vegetables, stir-fried pork belly with chili paste and young tamarind leaves, and sour curry with prawns, served with fried king mackerel in fish sauce and mango salad!
It's beyond imagination to find such delicious food in this small restaurant.
*I wasn't disappointed at all. The taste, the freshness of the ingredients, and the skillful cooking of the chef were all superb. Each dish was prepared to order. There's a slight wait, but it's well worth the visit.
"Nok Nana," Yothin Phatthana 3.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oldpal Koffee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is very expensive compared to the portion size. Everything tasted like oil.
Even the taro sticky rice balls were tasteless, with shredded coconut still attached to the shell.
The quality/quantity of the food, which used to be delicious, is now terrible.
The minimum price is 185 baht. Expensive but delicious is one thing, but expensive and the portions are small and not tasty.
I was very disappointed after driving a long distance to eat here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Irene T

sample_reviews_en.text:
12/10 for the taste of the food, but not worth it if their service time is not improved.

Waited almost an hour for our food and only got to talk to the waiter a couple of times in that hour - no updates on when we’d be getting our food. When we ordered a replacement for the food that was out of stock - it took half an hour more.

Hopefully they improve their service time, but will keep coming back until that day arrives.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nij Mee (Zign)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, but...
- Waited 40 minutes or more.
- We arrived earlier than everyone else. We were the second table, but three other tables that arrived later received their food before us.
- Wrong orders served more than 3 times.
- Asked for a children's set meal, received an adult set.
- They gave us rice that another table had requested to be taken away, even though we hadn't received our order yet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prakasit Damrongsri

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop had a euphorbia cactus plant in front of the shop, near the parking area. We didn't notice it at first. My son was opening the trunk of the car and backed into the cactus, getting 3-4 long scrapes and getting pricked by thorns. The shop staff came out without apologizing and even said that no one ever gets pricked by them before. It was terrible. We just left.
sample_reviews_en.author: Omi Jung

sample_reviews_en.text:
Waiting for food almost 1 hour. I had to walk to give them my orders by myself. I ordered Pad Thai with Shrimp, it tasted too sweet. So I had to add some fish sauce, but there was something in the cup.

Actually, I kinda like their outdoor vibes, but they should’ve taken care of the customers well and improved the taste of food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasithorn

sample_reviews_en.text: Small but beautiful place for having food and drink. Food is really delicious. Price is not cheap but acceptable. Thai dessert is really good too. Kanom Tom is soft, not too sweet and full of aroma…strongly recommended. We sit in outdoors area which is nice. The only down side is that it take long time for food to be served.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaktat J.

restaurants.name: อาหารป่าทุ่งสองห้อง
restaurants.address:

24/30 Kamphaeng Phet 6 Rd, Lat Yao, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a local forest restaurant near our house. We've had other dishes here before, and the overall taste is okay. But today, I'm a vegetarian, so I decided to give it a try. I ordered straw mushroom basil rice (not on the menu, so I had to ask the chef to make it :) She was so kind and made it for me!), along with a sunny-side-up egg and stir-fried morning glory with tofu. I have to say, it was absolutely delicious!!! The basil was perfectly seasoned and paired perfectly with the rice. The morning glory wasn't overly salty, and the flavors were perfectly balanced. It's a great option for vegetarians.

During the day, this restaurant is light and quiet, but at night, this restaurant is absolutely amazing! The owner sings incredibly well, especially the song "Red Bicycle."

The service was also excellent, and the staff was very attentive.

P.S. Parking is available, but not very much. The restrooms may not look particularly luxurious. The restaurant has a rustic Thai feel, perfect for sipping on drinks and listening to music, which is okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gullyawat Lertpeerakorn

sample_reviews_en.text: We went here after visiting the museum nearby. The menu is all in Thai and the staff didn’t really speak a lot of English. There were pictures in the menu we could point at and we chose things kind of randomly (pictures have no prices) Everything we ordered was absolutely delicious! We had to order more food because we wanted to try their other dishes. All of the dishes we ordered were addicting, spicy and flavourful! Service was attentive as well. We ordered a large beer, they refilled our glasses and checked in to see if we wanted more. There was live music as well that made the vibes really nice! Just be aware that they do charge 20 baht for ice which we didn’t know. We ordered 4 dishes, a side of rice and a beer. The bill came out to 690 baht which I think is very reasonable considering the quality of food and service! Maybe pricey for some but I really recommend trying!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanya K

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant has a simple, homey style, not luxuriously decorated, but possesses the charm of a neighborhood eatery that people frequent. The atmosphere is lively in the evenings, and tables fill up quickly, so it's recommended to allow extra time.

The food, in general, is flavorful and well-seasoned, befitting authentic Thai "jungle" cuisine. Those who enjoy strong flavors will love it. The service is friendly and attentive, reflecting the restaurant's familiar and caring approach to its customers.

Overall, it's a great place for a serious meal with friends or family, focusing on delicious and satisfying food without any formality. If you're craving truly spicy Thai food, this is the place! 🌶️
sample_reviews_en.author: noo maree

sample_reviews_en.text:
This wild game restaurant offers affordable prices and very generous portions. Recommended dishes include: Spicy Catfish Soup with Tamarind (150 THB), Tender and Flavorful Stir-fried Venison (180 THB), Stir-fried Frog with Holy Basil (180 THB), Salted Beef Fried Rice (80 THB), and Papaya Salad with Crab and Fermented Fish Sauce (80 THB). Everything is delicious and great value for money. They also have a promotion on Carabao Beer: 3 bottles for 289 THB.
The restaurant has parking, live music at 6 PM, and a cool, relaxing atmosphere perfect for an evening out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawarisa Boonkoy

sample_reviews_en.text: Tung Song Hong Wild Food Restaurant is located at the entrance to Wat Thewasunthorn. The food is flavorful and spicy, using high-quality ingredients such as fresh, large prawns and squid. A recommended dish is the Pla Kang Tom Madan (a dish featured on the "Khrua Khun Toi" cooking show). The flavors are not overly sweet, following the traditional wild food style. The water spinach salad is also recommended if you like the dressing used for it; it's quite similar. And for those who enjoy spicy and flavorful dishes, this place will surely satisfy you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Atisnoob Pnr

sample_reviews_en.text:
A rustic, homey restaurant serving "jungle" cuisine.

Overall, the taste is okay – rich, salty, and spicy – ​​but I think it could be even "wilder" and spicier. Overall, it's suitable for people from Bangkok.

Prices are 100-200 baht per dish, which is good considering you can order a variety of dishes. The portions are also appropriate for the price – neither too cheap nor too expensive.

There is parking available in front of the restaurant and along the roadside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teekatas Sivakua

sample_reviews_en.text:
3.5 out of 5 stars
Spicy water spinach salad with shrimp: Sweet, similar to stir-fried clams with sweet chili paste.
Tom Yum Seafood: The best dish, but not quite up to a rustic restaurant level. Only slightly spicy.
Fried rice: The rice was soggy and not soft, and the pork was tasteless.
I suspect they changed chefs, as previous reviews mentioned stronger flavors, but this wasn't the case at all. The prices are also a bit high; fried rice alone is 80 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanapol Jantaraporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The stir-fried venison with garlic was delicious and not chewy.
The tom yum soup with mackerel and sour mango was spicy.
The stir-fried eel wasn't very flavorful, and the fish wasn't firm.

Overall good, but the food was slow to come out and there were a lot of mosquitoes, although they provided fans.
The singer sang beautifully.
Prices were around 180 baht per dish.
sample_reviews_en.author: ลักขณา ภู่พันธ์

restaurants.name: ARIZUKI HANSAR BANGKOK
restaurants.address:

1ST FL., 3, HANSAR HOTEL, 250 SOI MAHADLEKLUANG 2, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This casual Japanese spot has a wonderful, welcoming atmosphere with an incredibly friendly team of chefs. The sashimi is exceptionally fresh and delicious, and the Ankimo (monkfish liver) is an absolute standout.

During the afternoon, they offer lunch sets that are great value for the price. In the evening, the vibe transitions perfectly into a chill spot where you can leisurely sip sake or a few drinks while ordering a steady flow of dishes as appetizers. Even their big-kernel peanuts are amazing—sweet, fragrant, and rich. With such a diverse menu, it’s a place I see myself returning to frequently because I want to try absolutely everything. Plus, parking is a breeze since it's located right inside a hotel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Samita Dhanasobhon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had such a great dinner at ARIZUKI! The food was excellent from start to finish, with fresh ingredients and authentic Japanese flavors in every dish. Everything we ordered was delicious, but what impressed me most was how balanced and clean the flavors were without being overly complicated.

The restaurant has a cozy yet upscale atmosphere, and the staff were friendly, knowledgeable, and attentive throughout the meal. It felt like one of those places where a lot of care goes into every detail.

Definitely a hidden gem for Japanese food lovers in Bangkok. Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion or simply craving quality Japanese cuisine, ARIZUKI is a place I’d happily recommend and revisit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Golf B.

sample_reviews_en.text:
To be honest, I've avoided motsunabe (offal hot pot) since I was in Japan because I disliked the smell.

However, Aritsuki's motsunabe had no unpleasant smell or taste, and I thoroughly enjoyed it.

I was impressed by the free-flowing sake. The sake was well-maintained. It wasn't sour or bitter; it was delicious sake!

It was even better Japanese food than what I've had in Japan.

I'll refrain from giving it a perfect score as it goes against my personal policy, but the content deserves a perfect score.
sample_reviews_en.author: yu ta

sample_reviews_en.text: Perfect lunch with high quality ingredients very good vibe and also with private zone ,all ingredient are fresh and staff very professional especially Khun Bobby she’s friendly and good take care ,I will cone back again for sure !
sample_reviews_en.author: Thirapat Sani

sample_reviews_en.text: Great Japanese food with fresh ingredients and authentic flavors. The sushi was high quality, and the service was friendly and attentive. Cozy atmosphere—perfect for a casual meal or a small gathering.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeen na

sample_reviews_en.text: I like that they have a wide variety of menu items at different prices. The food tastes good. The restaurant is clean and quiet. The staff provides excellent service. I will definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kingkarn Siriwat

sample_reviews_en.text: A wonderful dining experience with authentic Japanese flavors. The ingredients were exceptionally fresh and of high quality. The service was impeccable. Suitable for all occasions.
sample_reviews_en.author: Witchapon Makkitti

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered this, I ordered that, I ordered something quick, I couldn't get it. I just ordered miso soup, and it took exactly an hour to arrive. The service was absolutely terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Takon Pachker

restaurants.name: PJ's Restaurant & Café
restaurants.address:

430/162 Soi Arunothai, Pattaya City, Amphoe Bang Lamung, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The worst restaurant in Pattaya. 35 minutes after ordering, they informed us that the cook forgot to cook. There were six customers in the restaurant. They have incredibly high prices for a rundown restaurant with poor service. It was the second visit and another tragedy. I don't understand the positive reviews. I definitely don't recommend it and I'm not alone. I write these praises myself. The fact that they have an empty restaurant at noon is a sign of satisfaction.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiri Strouhal

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is an absolute gem.
Great service, fantastic fresh food.
More than willing to make changes due to dietary requirements without blinking an eye.
100% worth the trip to find this place.
Grilled salmon with salad is outstanding.
It's one of those little places that are just done right and because of that, people keep going back.
I rarely take the time to write reviews but this fantastic, honest, well run little place deserves it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Culburra Beach

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great place, a wide selection of breakfasts and other food. You can create your own breakfast from individual ingredients.
The food is delicious. The cappuccino had a nice, rich foam, but the coffee itself was a bit bitter for my taste.
The service was very pleasant; it's clear the girls are working hard.
They have milkshakes and fruit smoothies, but the breakfast portions are quite large, so we'll try them separately next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Inna Nechaeva

sample_reviews_en.text: My breakfast was truly outstanding. You can tell that the ingredients are chosen with love and care. I know how difficult it is to find really good tomatoes in Thailand, and even the pickles are homemade. Absolutely fantastic! Go here and enjoy your breakfast; it's the best German breakfast I've had in Pattaya so far. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Lang

sample_reviews_en.text: A great place with an amazing food. Had breakfast here multiple times and it was always well prepared, there are many options so everyone always found what to eat. Staff here is super friendly and attentive to details if there is something you dont like in a dish they always happily changed it to something else.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saule Gecaite

sample_reviews_en.text: It was so delicious and the portions were huge! Great value for the price. The service was also excellent. The vendors were so friendly and fun to talk to. Each vendor is incredibly welcoming to customers. I loved it! This is my second time here, and I'll be coming every day! ❤️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Nxm punch

sample_reviews_en.text: The service is super friendly. I've eaten there several times and everything is delicious. The creamed sliced ​​meat with noodles and the schnitzel with gravy and fries taste just like home cooking. The side salad is great too, of course. I …
sample_reviews_en.author: Philipp Zmaritsch

sample_reviews_en.text: Every single details are looking at to makes you live a unique experience. Afordable, friendly hospitality, quality, tasty, comfortable in a local Thai atmosphere. Here you can use English or Thai language. Even if hot around, this place …
sample_reviews_en.author: Farang Abroad

restaurants.name: Khao Tom Pla Saphan Lueang
restaurants.address:

1838 Banthat Thong Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stopped by a famous fish porridge shop near Saphan Lueang. It's an old, well-known restaurant in the area. The atmosphere is simple and homey, not fancy, but clean and comfortable.

I ordered the fish porridge. The porridge was piping hot, the broth clear and fragrant – very comforting to sip. The fish pieces were large, fresh, and not fishy at all. The addition of fried garlic and celery added a wonderful aroma, making the combination perfectly balanced.

The price is reasonable, suitable for dinner or a late-night meal. If you like traditional fish porridge with a mild flavor, focusing on freshness and broth, I recommend giving it a try.

⭐ Summary:
– Taste: Mild and easy to eat
– Fish: Fresh and large pieces
– Price: Friendly
– Atmosphere: Homey and comfortable

If you're passing through Saphan Lueang and feeling hungry and want something hot and light, this place is great! 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: tam tt

sample_reviews_en.text:
This rice porridge shop prepares its ingredients incredibly well. Everything is perfectly cooked, with no unpleasant odors. After trying it, I happily ordered the mixed seafood platter without hesitation. Normally, I hate fish in rice porridge shops because other places often leave the scales on, resulting in a fishy smell and lots of bones. But this shop had none of those problems. The fish was delicious. The pork ribs weren't tough, the tripe wasn't chewy, and the shrimp and oysters were perfectly cooked – not overcooked or undercooked. Delicious!

The rice porridge itself is simple, the ingredients are ordinary, but the preparation is better than any fine restaurant.

I'm happy to pay for their skill.
sample_reviews_en.author: UnTee Jo

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re looking for a comforting, light meal, this Teochew-style fish soup/porridge spot on the Ban That Thong stretch is worth checking out. You’ll have to walk past the busiest section of the street—it’s tucked near the university park, which gives it a quieter, more local vibe. (Not many tourists here!)

The soup had a nice, clean flavour, but if you’re into bold or heavy flavours, it might not hit the spot for you. The fish slices were a bit overcooked for my liking, but still, the meal was enjoyable overall. Definitely a solid option if you want something light and simple.
sample_reviews_en.author: Evasaurus

sample_reviews_en.text:
For the fish porridge, it was quite delicious. The portions were generous, and the ingredients were very fresh.

After all, you get what you pay for. A bowl of 220 baht is reasonable.

However, if you live far away, it's really not worth making a special trip to eat here.

For me,
the taste was just simple, sweet seafood porridge; nothing particularly amazing.

But the overall environment and dining atmosphere were good. If you happen to be passing by, I would still recommend going in and giving it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: BLAKE CHENG

sample_reviews_en.text: This rice porridge shop offers a variety of options, including seafood and pork offal porridge. The taste is delicious, and the ingredients are fresh and high-quality, but the portions are quite small. There's very little rice in the porridge; you'll finish it in just a few spoonfuls. The shop is air-conditioned, making it comfortable to eat. Those with a big appetite might not feel full, but the ingredients are very fresh and tasty. The soy sauce dip is okay, but the seafood dipping sauce is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirirat Sirikul

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurants in the Chulalongkorn shopping district have all stood the test of time to establish themselves here, so you don't have to worry about making a bad choice. The fish porridge features fresh seafood, a sweet and flavorful broth, and the freshly cooked taste is immediately apparent. It's generously portioned with minimal seasoning, and the oysters are plump and delicious. A must-try when visiting Bangkok, and the prices are affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: 嚴明德

sample_reviews_en.text: The shrimp and oysters were fresh, with no fishy smell, and perfectly blanched. The pork stomach and kidney were large, thinly sliced, fresh, and thoroughly cleaned. I recently tried a new dish, the blanched vegetables, which paired well with the rice porridge. The restaurant hasn't had grouper for several days now. The portion sizes are perfect for snacking or as an appetizer.
sample_reviews_en.author: N N (Pom)

sample_reviews_en.text:
📌 Seafood and Fish Porridge Restaurant - Order for Home Delivery
🦈🦐 Seabass and shrimp porridge: Good quality ingredients, perfectly cooked, but the broth was bland and tasteless.
🍽 Mixed Seafood Salad: The pre-made dressing wasn't spicy enough.
♦️ Soybean dipping sauce and seafood dipping sauce: Very diluted, needs improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lara Linh

restaurants.name: Tam yua yuan
restaurants.address:

Inthamara 33 Alley, Ratchadaphisek, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a small, upscale Chinese restaurant, but the prices are reasonable considering the large portions compared to other restaurants in the area.
