The stir-fried vegetables are delicious and there's a wide variety to choose from. I'll definitely be back to review it again. I took friends there and everyone loved it. The prices are also very reasonable considering the large portions. Parking is probably best at Stadium One or the nearby Lotus, then walk across the street. The stir-fried vegetables reminded me of my trip to China. The braised pork knuckle with mantou is amazing – the pork is stewed until tender, and the mantou is crispy on the outside, soft and fragrant on the inside. Some people might not like the curry noodle dish, but the Hong Kong-style fried rice is delicious. The baked shrimp with glass noodles is flavorful and the shrimp are fresh. The braised tofu in red sauce is also good. Overall, it's a great place to eat and check in. It's usually busy, with plenty of tables available, but I think if it becomes popular with younger people, there will be long queues, so come early!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bamroung Tangsanga

sample_reviews_en.text: Today was unlucky. We ate at a restaurant that had been booked for three large tables by someone the owner knew. As a result, we ordered six dishes, but only two arrived. We ate them all and then sat waiting in silence for almost half an hour. Neither the staff nor the owner paid any attention to us. When we inquired, the staff said the food was served in order, and that we had to refill our own water because they were busy with those three tables booked by the owner. >>> In summary: If you want delicious food, this restaurant is good. But if you want good service, I recommend going to another restaurant. Even the female owner didn't pay attention to customers. Just sit and wait for your food; refill your own water. They only serve their acquaintances first. >>> If you're willing to accept the risk of poor service, then come here. The price was average; six dishes for four people cost 2000 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: nachcha pattaraarchachai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food: Everything was quite salty. The baked rice was delicious.
Service: The wait for food was extremely long. The drunken chicken and sesame oil jellyfish took almost an hour. After that, the food came out one dish at a time, every 15-20 minutes. We went with 4 people and ordered 5 appetizers and 5 main courses. The total waiting time was about 2 hours. (We waited until we wanted to cancel the order, but the staff said they had already started preparing the food, so we waited again. This went on until we finally got to eat all the dishes😭)
Atmosphere: The ventilation was very poor. The smell of stir-fried chili was very strong. We kept having itchy noses.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chotika Mahatkomol

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop has moved from Yaowarat.

The food is just as delicious as ever.

My family's favorite dishes include:
- Chicken Gam Long (the chicken is tender and comes with just the right amount of sauce, no dipping sauce needed)
- Stir-fried Morning Glory with Shrimp Paste
- Clay Pot Fish (priced by weight, spicy and delicious. I loved it. After I finished eating most of the fish, I asked the shop to put it in noodles and mix it in. It was delicious!)
- Stuffed Patongo (eat it while it's hot, slightly crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, and very enjoyable)

I recommend giving it a try! ^^
sample_reviews_en.author: Natnapat Sermchaisrikul

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant moved from Yaowarat (Chinatown). The food is delicious and perfect for family meals.

However, regarding the service... while it was very fast back in Yaowarat, my most recent visit (August 11th) resulted in a nearly half-hour wait for my food. The order of service was also poor; the main dishes were served first, without the rice or noodle dishes I ordered at the same time. Even after asking for them, I still waited considerably.

I hope this was just a coincidence on that particular day and not a recurring issue like when they were in Yaowarat.
sample_reviews_en.author: YunYan Pattarin

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. They have a new menu item: baked rice with beef. The beef was tender, not sticky, and the rice was beautifully cooked with separate grains and a wonderful aroma. Everything we ordered was delicious. The fish was very fresh and the flavor was just right. The fish maw soup was authentic, rich, and fragrant. We order the hot plate chicken noodles every time we come. The staff constantly refilled our water. The prices are very reasonable. 🫰
sample_reviews_en.author: Pacharaporn Bamrungkit

sample_reviews_en.text: This old restaurant from Yaowarat, which recently moved, still serves food as delicious as before. Almost every dish we ordered today was excellent, including the braised pork belly, stir-fried noodles with gravy, fried duck tongue, steamed fish with egg white, and stir-fried goat with fried dough sticks. Only the fried tofu with chili and salt was tasty, though a little bland.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanasit K.

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best Hong Kong style restaurant by a long shot! We ordered 5 different dishes and each one of them were absolutely delicious! My 8 Yr old loved their chicken fried rice. Owner is kind and the staff are extremely attentive. This restaurant goes on my bookmark of places to come back to the next time we come back to Bangkok! Thank you!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jenna Carroll

restaurants.name: Choorotz — ห้องอาหารชูรส
restaurants.address:

167/4 Prachathipatai Rd, Bang Khun Phrom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Last Saturday evening, I went out for dinner and wasn’t sure at first whether the restaurant inside the hotel would be good. However, from the moment we walked in, we were warmly welcomed by the staff. There was also a singer and a guitarist performing live, and the music was absolutely beautiful.

We ordered several Thai dishes, including spicy grilled beef salad with pea eggplants, crispy tofu with chili and salt, and stir-fried kale with oyster sauce. Every dish was rich in flavor and absolutely delicious.

The Western food was just as impressive. We ordered the seabass steak — the portion was very generous, and it tasted amazing.

Overall, this is definitely a restaurant worth visiting in this neighborhood. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pradubkwan Anthonna

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love it here! Very good and, above all, attentive service and incredibly good food! 😍❤️‍🔥

Many thanks to the entire service team & the kitchen AND also the entire hotel team for the wonderful time we were able to experience and enjoy here!

We were here last year and would come back again and again!

Thanks also for the flexibility of the service staff! We eat vegetarian food and all our wishes were fulfilled! I felt completely comfortable and welcomed at every moment! Thank you, thank you, thank you ❤️🙏🏼

We look forward to the next few days with you!

PS: What we would like to see on the menu next time (of course, it's not a must), but it would be a great treat, would be mango sticky rice 🥰😁🙏🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: Maren Meier

sample_reviews_en.text: Awful experience. The server forgot to punch in my order, so I sat 40 minutes before I asked, in which case they whipped up the worst pineapple fried rice I’ve had the pleasure of tasting. There were 3 shrimps total, dry slices of pineapple, and zero flavour. Absolutely disappointed. The rice tasted like it came out of a ready made packet. Update: However, the staff the next night was extremely accommodating, and went as far as to offer us a dining experience on their behalf, which was extremely kind! I really appreciated the correction, which was very unexpected! This has now changed my review from 1 star to 5 stars! Please pay a visit during your stay!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yana Bezborodko

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had 2 very delicious Dinners.

Very friendly stuff, my Spaghetti were too spicy at First, they made me new and brought a free Drink That reduces the spiciness in my mouth.

Green Curry and Chicken Soup with coconut milk can be Highly recommended.

On one evening the Restaurant had very nice live music (one singer and a Guitar)

You get 20% discount for Food for every Night you are staying at the Hotel next to the Restaurant.

Nice atmosphere. Very cosy :-)

Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: Marion Gregorczyk

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was truly top-notch. Special thanks to Cream and Bell from their restaurant team who tended us professionally made the experience extra special. Also like to thanks Nook from the hotel sales team, who was incredibly patient and informative when we asked about the rooms, she even took the time to show us the hotel facilities even though I was only visiting briefly for dinner. A genuinely pleasant and thoughtful experience overall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Surious PSarn

sample_reviews_en.text: During our stay, we ate at this restaurant every day and were never disappointed. The service was always attentive and flexible. There were many vegetarian options, and they were always willing to adapt the dishes. We also worked there every day, and no one minded. We always felt very comfortable. There was a wide variety of delicious dishes to choose from. We'd gladly return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sergej Ryapolov

sample_reviews_en.text: Visited twice during a business stay at the Pranakorn Heritage Hotel and was pleasantly surprised. Despite being a hotel restaurant, Choorotz offers a wide variety of delicious dishes with great attention to quality. The staff were consistently attentive and friendly, making both visits enjoyable. A solid choice whether you're staying at the hotel or just passing through.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joe Preece

sample_reviews_en.text: Came here two nights in a row. The first night, we faced a few problems that dampened the experience. However, the next night, the restaurant went above and beyond to course-correct and provided an exceptional experience. The staff was very attentive and kind, while the chef went out of the way to bring out some of the food. Lovely hospitality and a must visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Natalia Tivirikin

restaurants.name: Tong Tem Toh
restaurants.address:

39 Charoen Krung 44 Alley, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Saw this place on our way to breakfast and went back to check it out at lunch. The server was fantastic and very accommodating. The restaurant was clean and nice. I ordered pork rinds with a side of veggies and green chili sauce as my lunch because that's what I felt like and I was not disappointed- however the other 3 people I was with all got the Khao soi, and I ended up being jealous. It looked so good. I think I read on the menu that these dishes were more common in Chiang Mai, so it features some different things from a lot of the other places around Bangkok. Anyway, it is tucked away on a narrow side street, and we honestly wouldn't have known about it had it not been for the breakfast spot we visited a couple of doors down. Was a lucky find and easily stood out as one of our favorites on the trip.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cory Hammerstone

sample_reviews_en.text: Northern Thai food here is flavorful, rich, and authentically delicious, although a bit pricey. The menu is diverse, and while the dishes may seem ordinary, they possess a unique charm and distinct flavor. The "Jim Som Mok Kai" (spicy dipping sauce with egg) is tangy, salty, and full of garlic, peanuts, and chili peppers – perfect as a snack or with sticky rice. The "Larb Muang" (Northern Thai minced meat salad) was a bit bitter for my taste, especially when eaten with water spinach and pork cracklings. Luckily, it wasn't as crowded as in Chiang Mai, as the smaller restaurants in Bang Rak aren't overly demanding. I would definitely recommend some restaurants in the Bang Rak area.
sample_reviews_en.author: P E A C H

sample_reviews_en.text:
A famous Northern Thai restaurant from Chiang Mai. Though the shop is small, the experience is excellent. The staff are genuinely impressive — very polite, attentive, and always smiling. They take the time to explain the menu, give thoughtful recommendations, and make sure every table is well taken care of. Their friendliness and service-minded attitude make you feel truly welcomed.

The food itself is authentic and delicious, with flavors that really capture the taste of Northern Thailand. Combined with the outstanding service, the overall experience is very impressive. Highly recommended for anyone who wants both great food and warm hospitality.
sample_reviews_en.author: NNchan

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the Bangkok branch of a much loved restaurant in Chiang Mai. It serves authentic northern Thai cuisine like herbal sausage (sai oua),   local veggie stir fries, pork salad (larb kua moo), curry noodle with chicken or beef (kao soy). It's a casual spot, fast service, and value for money. That being said, the original Tong Tem Toh in Chiang Mai is in a whole different league – seriously, make the trip if you can. I also got the feeling that many dishes here in Bangkok are re-heated when you order, which was a bit disappointing. It's okay for a quick fix, but doesn't compare to the real deal!
sample_reviews_en.author: The Foodie's Diary

sample_reviews_en.text:
Personally, I like this branch. The female staff member named May has excellent service mind; she's polite, humble, and always smiles and bows to customers.
The food tastes great; every dish is delicious. I especially like all the omelets because they're not greasy and the flavor is well-balanced even without sauce.
The location is convenient, in Soi Charoen Krung 44, a short walk from the main road. It's near the Shangri-la Hotel and the famous coffee shop "Sarnies" in the area.
Parking is available at Central Bangrak or in the parking lot behind the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: BRC

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried their food and it was really nice—very authentic local Thai dishes. You can let them know your preferred spice level. Even if you choose less spicy, the flavor is still rich and deep. The fish soup tasted great and the portion was generous. They also served vegetables I had never tried or even seen before, and they tasted really good. The eggs were delicious too. I’ll definitely go back again if I return to Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: JAY CHUA (蔡戔倡)

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my first time visiting this restaurant. The location of the restaurant is not very obvious. I happened to pass by and saw that it was fully booked with guests. So, I decided to boldly give it a try. The result was beyond my expectations. The taste was much better than that of some famous restaurants, and the price was not too expensive. It's truly a Michelin-level restaurant among the common people.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrew Miao

sample_reviews_en.text:
I got the Braised Pork Belly Hang Lay curry and Northern Thai Sausages.

The pork belly was so soft and fell apart, it packed a lot of flavour. The curry sauce was delicious. The Northern Thai sausage was excellent, a little rich but I still managed to finish it all.

The staff were superb, very friendly, spoke good English and attentive. It is small inside and filled up quite quickly when I was there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Elphinstone

restaurants.name: VIVIN Suk 22 - café grocery bistro - Local Organic Natural Artisan
restaurants.address:

No, 267/5 Sukhumvit Alley 22, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
An absolute hidden gem in Bangkok! ✨ From the moment you step inside, you’re welcomed by a beautiful, cosy atmosphere that makes you want to linger. The food was outstanding—fresh, incredibly flavourful, and made with high-quality organic ingredients that you can truly taste in every bite.

What makes this place even more special is the lovely shop inside the restaurant, where you can purchase many of the same organic ingredients used in the kitchen, all proudly made in Thailand. A truly unique dining experience with amazing food, wonderful ambience, and exceptional local products. I can’t recommend it enough!
sample_reviews_en.author: MasterRewiew

sample_reviews_en.text: We went their their first event, the Poule Frites night, and it was incredibly delicious. We loved every bite. We also really appreciated all the staff being so very friendly, courteous, and welcoming, especially the owners. Everyone was putting forth so much effort to make sure we were given as much food as we wanted and that we were fully satisfied with our meal. Will be excited to return and try the rest of their dishes, including their desserts which looked great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sealina Carroll

sample_reviews_en.text: The food here is honestly so good, the Hache steak with eggs is my go-to every time. Super cozy spot with all the natural wood and organic ingredients, you can feel the quality. Staff is super friendly and that's a big reason I keep coming back. One of those places that just feels right
sample_reviews_en.author: BYAS / House Music

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small, lovingly designed oasis. Decorated with many beautiful accessories.

The staff is very, very friendly.

The owners personally greet all guests, pay attention to the smallest details, and are very empathetic.

This café is a must-visit when in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dieter Huber

sample_reviews_en.text:
Viven Sukhumvit Soi 22 cafe beautiful surroundings, food was excellent had the roast beef meal ( available Sunday)  this time.
Service is excellent, staff are courteous and helpful.
Various takeaway cheeses, pickles etc on sale.
Highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: N Lorand

sample_reviews_en.text: A must-visit hidden gem in Bangkok! Tucked away in Sukhumvit 22, housed in a stunning 3-story historic wooden building full of charm and photo spots. The menu beautifully reinvents local flavors with premium ingredients—the truffle soufflé …
sample_reviews_en.author: Hkfoodiesis

sample_reviews_en.text: I went for the Thai Cheese Buffet and had such a lovely time. The cheeses, jams, and all the accompaniments were amazing. I also really appreciated how informative everything was, the signs helped explain what we were eating, and Sam (?) …
sample_reviews_en.author: Praiya U.

sample_reviews_en.text: Finally, in a traditional Thai wooden house, you'll find cuisine prepared with top-quality, organic, and entirely Thai-sourced ingredients. The icing on the cake: the staff is incredibly attentive, the atmosphere is a haven of peace, and …
sample_reviews_en.author: Jean VIVIN

restaurants.name: ร้านข้าวแกงกาย&กัน (หลานตาลี)
restaurants.address:

11 Charoen Krung 6 Alley, Wang Burapha Phirom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Scam!!!!!!
Usually one topping costs +10 THB. I chose three toppings: fish, pumpkin and broccoli. So 60฿. But after I got my food they demanden 100฿!!!!!!!!! I told them „but I have just three toppings“ but they still demanded 100 😡😡😡

(Also the fish didn‘t taste like anything)
sample_reviews_th.author: Patority

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered delivery because of the good reviews. The portion size in one bag was surprisingly generous! I'm not sure if it's because I ordered close to closing time.

• Stir-fried tofu with minced pork: The taste was good, the tofu wasn't too dark yellow, but it was quite oily; there was a lot of oil floating on top.
• Stir-fried spring onions with minced pork: Similar to the other dish, it was also excessively oily. The taste wasn't to my liking because the smell was quite strong; I initially mistook it for garlic florets.

I'll try ordering other dishes next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puripat Kitkarncharoensin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kai & Gan Curry Rice Shop (Lan Tali)
I've walked past it many times...but this is my first time eating there. They have a huge variety of dishes, so many to choose from! Today I ordered stir-fried duck tendons, fried chicken, and a bowl of pork blood soup. It was delicious and reasonably priced. Free ice and complimentary soup are provided...very thoughtful!
P.S. The shop participates in the government's co-payment scheme.
sample_reviews_en.author: ChubbyArin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The curry rice is so delicious~ The best!!!!!
Every dish is delicious. I've been here many times and always order the stir-fried catfish.
The fried chicken is the best~!!!
The restaurant is very clean, there's free tea, and although it's fan-cooled, it's not hot at all 😋🤤

Just an update!!!
The restaurant now has a second floor with air conditioning. The food is just as delicious as before.
sample_reviews_en.author: May Wang

sample_reviews_en.text: After a month traveling by bicycle in Thailand with more restaurants than I can count , this one stands out. Amazing quality lovely staff . Highly recommended if you would like to experience the highest quality breakfast/lunch in the country! Buffet so you can easily choose also they will help in English.  Frog the house specialty. We'll be back next visit to bangkok
sample_reviews_en.author: stuart barry

sample_reviews_en.text:
I just ate there. There's such a wide variety of dishes, I couldn't choose! Everything was delicious. I had two dishes for 40 baht. I loved the soup. Free ice. Thank you to the owner who served the soup; he was very attentive and caring. Whenever I'm in the area, I always eat at this restaurant.
Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: mon Pornratchata

sample_reviews_en.text: It is a local eatery, and the staff spoke English well, so I had no trouble ordering. It was 75 baht for rice, soup, 4 side dishes, and ice. The curry tofu and basil pork stir-fry were delicious (the basil pork was incredibly spicy), but the braised pork and stir-fried squid were very tough.
sample_reviews_en.author: 뇽뇽뇽

sample_reviews_en.text: In principle, one dish costs 30, two dishes cost 45, and meat dishes cost an extra 5-10 yuan. The taste is very much to the liking of Taiwanese people~ It's really delicious, and the restaurant also provides soup and iced water, which is very thoughtful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Deno Yeh

restaurants.name: Indigo Indian Restaurant
restaurants.address:

หมู่ที่ 10 27-28 Pattaya Sai Song Rd, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Poor hygene. Got bad food poisoning after going to this place. And the toilets smell like they haven't been cleaned for weeks. Avoid. (Indigo & Kerala House seem to be the same restaurant).

IN RESPONSE TO THE REPLY: This is not a fake review. I see you have a habit of automatically claiming a review is fake whenever you get a bad review. I think you would do better improving your hygene instead of trying to pretend there's nothing wrong. I only had 1 vegetarian dish and that's the only thing I ate all day. All you had to do is heat it properly. There's no excuse.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul B

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food and very good friendly staff. Can order both Northern and Southern Indian food which is best suited for us. As we enjoyed eating dosa as well as Paneer Butter Masala. Quite helpful with the selection and also very good tables and seats. The area is very close to walking street therefore we went to walking street thereafter. Staff are amazing and very helpful with our questions. Paneer butter masala is perhaps bigger than we expected and we had to order Nan to finish the Daal Makhani and Paneer Butter Masala. Will visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nanda Linn Aung

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent food... Tried chicken biryani very tasty.. And authentic Kerala style food... Special mention about chef ABI to  bring authentic Kerala taste to the dishes they serve...( Abi is like a  brother who will be avialable for any of your needs in d city)... Used to take king fish curry and matta rice Kerala style everytime... King fish curry is very authentic and you won't even get in Kerala this type of taste and flavor with malabar tamarind (kudampuli) added providing special tastes to it...
sample_reviews_en.author: Hafeez Khan

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best indian restaurants around Pattaya walking street. To start with, they have a fine variety of south indian and north indian foods. The staffs are friendly and the service is awesome. Even though the quality of service and food are far better than other Indian restaurants around, they are quite economical as well. A budget friendly restaurant in the heart of Pattaya ! People from Kerala can cheer up, as they provide the traditional Kerala lunch as well !!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sapnil Mukund

sample_reviews_en.text: First review-Poor response and no quality food. Edited review- How can u call as a fake review? U provided poori with sabji when dined at restaurant and for online order you didn't provide sabji. In ur food item listing u haven't mentioned sabji not included. How do u sell poori without sabji? I have photos, grab listing, watsapp chat and call recording. U go to any extent I will do the same for you. Throwed the food in dustbin at last.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rahul RK

sample_reviews_en.text:
Average food.
Biriani is good
Fish curry is good
Chicken curry below average and very much oily
Fish Fry, we bought 2 sets (two pieces in one set). The first set was good but second set was very bad. Not properly fried.
Meels/Thali is average, but quantity is good for 2 to 3 adults.
Spice level is too high, tried to bring Kerala Flavour with spice which is wrong.
Most importantly it's too costly, for the food they serve......
sample_reviews_en.author: Ranjith S

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have been to this city for 4 times in last year. This is the regular food place for my group. Best you can get in different country. Food is delicious. Tasty. Staff is also caring. They serve the best. Although staff is from Myanmar, they understand the needs of Indians so well.
Kudos to the owner and lots of respect to the staff.
In love with indigo.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hardik K Shah

sample_reviews_en.text: Good Indian restaurant which is near walking Street.  We can easily walk. You can bring beer/wisky and you can drink which is very cost effectively.  In same hotel you find one Tourist Agent I forgot his name but I suggest you should only take information not any buy any ticket since it is very expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Netaji Patil

restaurants.name: อะไรซุนเด
restaurants.address:

246 อาคารไทม์สแควร์ ชั้นที่ 4, Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Rating: ⭐☆☆☆☆

Title: Poor Sanitation and Lack of Management - Plastic Procurement at Sundae Soup

It used to be fine, but today was the worst. A piece of plastic was found in my Sundae Soup. The service was so poor that I wasn't even offered a glass of water throughout my meal.

I complained about the plastic and requested a CCTV check, but the staff spoke neither Korean nor English, making communication impossible. There were no Korean managers or assistants in the kitchen or restaurant, so I couldn't get any explanation.

Despite this hygiene incident, they still charged me the full 320 baht. Food hygiene and basic service are completely lacking. I highly recommend this place.

Used to be a decent spot, but it has gone downhill. I found a piece of plastic in my Sundae Soup today, and the basic service was non-existent—not even a glass of water was provided. The staff couldn't communicate or explain the plastic, and there was no manager or Korean owner present. I asked for a CCTV check, but they didn't understand. Despite the safety hazard, I was still charged 320 THB. If you value food safety and basic service, stay away.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom J.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is a real hidden gem! “Arai Soondae” is a Korean homemade restaurant with a Korean chef/owner. The taste is exactly like eating in Korea!

First, the surprise is the generous side dishes – 10 different kinds, all unlimited and free refills!!! There’s rice, omelets – and let me tell you, every dish is delicious 😋

Next, the soup is hard to find in Thailand. It’s a Korean-style offal soup, with a unique flavor unlike Thai offal soups. It pairs perfectly with the side dishes and dipping sauces.

The kimchi cold noodles are also amazing – I loved them! The Korean noodles are wonderfully soft and chewy. The fried dumplings are also good. Overall, everything we ordered was delicious.

I highly recommend this place. Most of the customers are Korean. I want Thai people to discover this delicious, homemade Korean restaurant that’s not too mainstream.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gracelicious (Kaegrace)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Arai Soondae is a Korean restaurant serving homemade-style Korean food, just like a mom would cook at home. Open for over 20 years, it's well-known among Koreans living in Thailand, but perhaps not as widely known among Thais.

The restaurant serves authentic Korean home-style cooking, resulting in a homey flavor that isn't overly spicy. Some of their signature dishes include Korean sausage (starting at 600 THB), pork trotters (starting at 600 THB), special kimchi-braised pork (starting at 700 THB), stir-fried Korean sausage (starting at 600 THB), tuna seaweed rice rolls (200 THB), grilled mackerel (300 THB), spicy clam salad (700 THB), and seafood tofu stew (250 THB).
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarat Traipiyavong

sample_reviews_en.text: It's incredibly delicious~~ I didn't realize I liked Sundae Gukbap this much... I finished the whole bowl. The side dishes were tasty too. It truly is a King's Table. Thai food is good, but maybe it tastes even better when you eat hot Korean food once in a while... Arai Sundae. It exceeded my expectations by a million times. It is the absolute best. If you come to the Asok Station area in Bangkok, you absolutely must try it. I found this place after seeing a Naver blog post... It is a real hidden gem. If a place like this in Australia had a King's Table with this kind of taste, they would have built a skyscraper... I will definitely visit again~~♡♡♡
sample_reviews_en.author: 피아노연습브곰

sample_reviews_en.text: The very first restaurant I visited upon arriving in Bangkok during my trip to Thailand was a Sundae Gukbap place. Located on the 4th floor of the Bangkok Times Square building, it was easy to find. Since they open at 10:00, we entered around 10:30 and ordered the Sundae Guk. The side dishes served beforehand were cubed radish kimchi and shredded radish; my wife remarked that it is difficult to achieve this kind of flavor using Southeast Asian radishes. We thoroughly enjoyed the Sundae Guk and the side dishes. The taste of the salted shrimp paste was also fantastic. I highly recommend this place to Korean travelers. It is delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaesun Jang

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, I found a Korean restaurant in the Asoke area. I randomly stopped by to try it out, as this is considered Korean Town. I think the name is something like "Sundae" (I read it on Google, sorry if I mispronounced it). The food was delicious, and the side dishes were plentiful. One person ate until they were full! All the pictures I took were for two people. It was delicious and filling. The restaurant has a wide variety of dishes and is located on the fourth floor. They don't accept parking unless you're taking the BTS, so it's more convenient to come by BTS.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Smith

sample_reviews_en.text:
I used to think Arai Sundae was the place to go for Sundaeguk in Bangkok... but I went back after a long time and was so disappointed. The variety of side dishes increased, but the main Sundaeguk was really bad... Even though I went when I was super hungry, I still left some behind... I have no intention of ever going back. Also, wouldn't it be better to just raise the prices? Why do they charge for water...? It really turned me off seeing a Korean restaurant act like that.

The staff were okay... but everything else was terrible...
sample_reviews_en.author: douri jung

sample_reviews_en.text: Raise the price of sundaeguk and if you order 5 servings of sundaeguk, they send 2 slices of radish kimchi. If you're going to reduce the amount of garlic and pepper, don't give it to them at all. LOL. And I don't know how much water you put in the sundaeguk, it's just plain water. Put some sundae in it and boil it for your conscience. It's hard and edible. The owner has changed. The chef has changed. It's inedible. They'll change to another restaurant soon because they're going to go out of business.
sample_reviews_en.author: Min Kim

restaurants.name: Sinchai Potchana
restaurants.address:

39 Arun Amarin Rd, Bang Yi Khan, Bang Phlat, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This rice porridge restaurant is located on the main road and has been open for 45 years (since 1981). They have a very extensive menu and parking is available along the roadside.

The menu consists of à la carte dishes to be eaten with rice porridge or plain rice.
The food has a moderate flavor profile, neither too strong nor too mild.
1) Mixed vegetable stew (Tom Jap Chai): Dry style, delicious, sweet from the vegetables.
2) Chicken with cashew nuts: Standardly delicious.
3) Seafood Tom Yum: Ordered spicy, and it was quite spicy. Delicious, and the seafood was fresh.
4) King mackerel salad: Very delicious. Large pieces of fried fish, topped with the salad dressing.
5) Stir-fried bitter melon with egg: Very appetizing, the yellow of the egg contrasting with the bitter melon. However, it was a little bland; the flavor came more from the egg than the bitter melon.
6) Fried pork intestines in soy sauce: Also tasty.

Overall, the prices are moderate, the menu is extensive, the flavors are moderate, and it's conveniently located on the main road.
sample_reviews_en.author: attpocari

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I had the opportunity to try a rice soup restaurant near my accommodation. I sat and ate alone, so I could only order a few dishes. I hardly even looked at the menu. I ordered Chinese chives, egg tofu, and minced pork, and I wanted to eat some kind of fish, so I ordered fried mackerel with fish sauce. Both were delicious. This restaurant has seats on the sidewalk by the roadside, and there's also an air-conditioned room inside. I ordered two dishes in total, one bowl of rice, and one bottle of water, for a total of 270 baht, which is considered a fairly good price. Next time I go, I'll probably try ordering something else.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tumnam Nuanual

sample_reviews_en.text: Sinchai Pochana is a rice porridge and side dish restaurant with a wide variety of tasty dishes. The fish is very fresh, and the food is well-prepared. The atmosphere is typical, and parking is available on the street. The highlights are their use of high-quality ingredients, mid-range to slightly higher prices, and experienced cooking skills. There's an air-conditioned indoor seating area or you can enjoy a relaxed outdoor seating experience without worrying about the road dust.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pa pa

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered three dishes and waited for over half an hour for the food.
The oyster omelet seemed like it had to wait for other tables to order before it was made, because it took so long. It was so long it ruined my mood. There weren't that many people.
The food wasn't that delicious. The minced pork and pickled mustard greens soup took almost an hour. I don't know what's so difficult about it to make.
In short, one visit is enough. The wait for food was extremely long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lalich P

sample_reviews_en.text: I found this place on the map and decided to try it. The reviews said everything was delicious, and after trying it myself, I can confirm it was true! I loved the braised duck, and the pickled crab with roe was incredibly spicy and delicious, especially paired with the chrysanthemum tea 😁😁. Luckily, I went after the rain, so it wasn't too crowded, and I found a parking spot since the restaurant is right on the road with parking for about 5-6 cars.
sample_reviews_en.author: N P

sample_reviews_en.text:
The braised duck intestines were excellent, with no unpleasant smell. The duck meat was juicy and tender.
The duck leg and thigh were incredibly tender and delicious.
The shrimp in fish sauce were fresh and bouncy, and the dipping sauce was good.
I chose the crispy oyster omelet, and it was very crispy.
Overall, I liked it; the food was delicious and arrived quickly.
Parking is available on the roadside in front of the shop. Let's go!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nt Ome - Travis

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came based on reviews. My favorite was the oyster omelet; it was the best I've ever had. Everything else was flavorful and spicy, but the stir-fried tofu with chili and salt was a bit bland and didn't absorb the flavors well enough. Dipping sauce would have been better.

Parking is available on the street, and someone will direct you. The staff, mostly older people, were very nice. The food came quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanruthai P.

sample_reviews_en.text: This rice porridge restaurant was visited based on reviews. The omelet was a little oily. The stir-fried morning glory with crispy pork was delicious. The clam dish wasn't very flavorful. The spicy chicken with mango, with a Chinese-style kick, was quite tasty. The prices are reasonable, the restaurant is clean, and it has air conditioning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Will PvR

restaurants.name: บ้านเกด by บ้านแซ่บวังหลัง สาขาตลิ่งชัน
restaurants.address:

99 1 Borommaratchachonnani Rd, Chim Phli, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten at this restaurant many times before, but never reviewed it. Today, I tried it again and ordered the same dish: beef fat fried rice. The beef was perfectly tender, still chewy, and the beef fat had a nice aroma. It had chili and shallots mixed in with the fried rice, giving it a slight spiciness. The crispy beef fat pieces added a nice dimension to the dish. It's best eaten with chili fish sauce; adding a little more chili and fish sauce enhances the flavor. Meat lovers will probably enjoy it. The price is quite reasonable, and one serving is enough for a satisfying meal. I also ordered the shrimp fat fried rice, which looked great and tasted standardly delicious and easy to eat. For those who haven't tried this restaurant before, I recommend it, whether for individual dishes or for sharing with a group. It's a Thai food restaurant with a diverse menu. Personally, I'm more impressed with the individual dishes. I'm not sure if there's more parking than what's available next to the restaurant. It might be crowded during lunchtime. You can follow the pinned location on the map, but be careful to use the parallel road coming from Taling Chan, otherwise you might miss it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narong Lumdee

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my go-to restaurant! Every dish is delicious, especially the fried items and the flavorful Tom Yum soup.
This is one of my favorite restaurants that I can visit repeatedly because the taste is consistently excellent in every dish.

Fried Tilapia: Served hot and crispy, the highlight is the side dish of savory fried fish roe. If you're lucky, you might even get a generous amount of roe inside the fish!

Tom Yum Soup: The sour and salty flavors are perfectly balanced! The spiciness is just right for central Thai people, but those who love very spicy food might find it comfortably spicy.

Stir-fried Prawns with Fresh Chili: Another recommended dish not to be missed. The aroma of garlic is amazing, and the sweet and savory flavors are perfectly infused into the prawns.

Fried Pork Dishes: This restaurant excels at fried pork. They offer a variety of options, including crispy and juicy fried pork belly and "dust-coated" pork, marinated with the restaurant's unique recipe. The taste is delicious and unlike anything else.

If you're looking for authentic, flavorful, and consistently delicious Thai food, I highly recommend this restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Peeraset Bu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pros:
1. Good quality ingredients at reasonable prices.
2. The food tastes generally delicious; some dishes are exceptionally good, such as the following today's orders:
- Beef fried rice: Delicious, a must-order! 5/5
- Spicy beef stew: Delicious and flavorful! 5/5
- Stir-fried noodles with water spinach: Good, but I wish it were spicier! 4.5/5
- Luang Prabang papaya salad: Not very flavorful, the fermented fish sauce wasn't fragrant (or maybe they didn't add any?). The restaurant might not be skilled in this style, but it's acceptable. 3.5/5
However, I saw many tables ordering other dishes that looked just as appetizing.
3. The restaurant is clean and the air conditioning is good.
4. Good service.

Cons:
A minor issue is the parking; there's only space for about 8-9 cars. If you're coming with a large group, you might need to consider parking carefully.

Overall, the food is delicious and good value. I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: wasin maneerat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Baan Kade by Baan Saap Wanglang, Taling Chan Branch 🌶️

There's parking for about 10 cars, quite convenient 🚗
The restaurant has a homey, cozy feel, comfortable seating, and it's air-conditioned, so you can eat for a long time without getting hot.

Perfect for a relaxing meal with friends or family in a quiet atmosphere.

They have a wide variety of dishes to choose from.

Recommended dishes:

Sour Curry with Cha-om and Shrimp 🦐 The shrimp is very fresh, the curry is rich and flavorful.
Turbo Beef Fried Rice 🥩 A good portion for two people, the beef is tender, and the rice is beautifully cooked.

The portions are appropriate for the price.

However, you might have to wait a little for your food during peak hours 😅

💸 Prices are mid-range, not too expensive.

📌 Summary: A Thai restaurant with a homey feel, comfortable seating, cool air conditioning, and delicious food. Perfect for a relaxing meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rose

sample_reviews_en.text: I stumbled upon this place by chance. The staff and owner were incredibly kind. The restaurant is air-conditioned, clean, and comfortable, with plenty of parking. Today I had the beef fried rice, which was huge – enough for two people! The beef wasn't too tough, and the fried rice itself was excellent. I loved that it had chopped chilies, shallots, and garlic mixed in to cut through the richness. I also had the fried instant noodles with crispy chicken, which was delicious and brought back childhood memories. The noodles had a perfect chewy texture, not too mushy. And finally, I had the spicy pork rib soup; the ribs were incredibly tender. I ordered it less spicy, and the flavor wasn't too strong – just right. The beef fried rice was 270 baht, the fried instant noodles were around 100+ baht, and the spicy pork rib soup was 160 baht. Overall, I felt the prices were very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: lplplplplp

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the chance to try this place at lunchtime today.
Because yesterday my dad took my mom there.
I have to say, it was delicious! The stir-fried noodles with water spinach were great – lots of ingredients, not greasy,
the noodles weren't soggy, the bacon was fragrant, and the shrimp was tender, sweet, and perfectly cooked.
Next up was the stir-fried tofu with chili and salt, and stir-fried Gnetum leaves with egg.
Then came the spicy pork rib soup – very flavorful,
not too sour, not too salty, perfect for cleansing the palate with its zesty kick.
Finally, the fried tilapia with garlic,
served with seafood dipping sauce. The fish was fresh, the meat sweet, and it was fried crispy,
but not oily. I highly recommend you all try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: sine merry

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Thai restaurant offers a diverse menu, everything is delicious, and the prices are good. It's located on the main road with parking available. The food comes out quickly, and the staff are helpful with recommendations.
- The beef fried rice is delicious, perfectly cooked, and has a generous amount of grilled beef.
- The sour curry with fried acacia leaves has a rich flavor, and the acacia leaf pieces are thick.
- The fried tofu with chili and salt has a very well-balanced flavor.
- The deep-fried pork belly with fish sauce is tender, not tough or chewy, and tastes great.
- The Luang Prabang papaya salad, ordered spicy, was deliciously spicy and flavorful.
sample_reviews_en.author: NEST

sample_reviews_en.text:
It might have been an unplanned promotional stunt. It was very crowded on Sunday. I ordered two breakfast items, but only received one – the beef fried rice. The other item took a while to arrive, so I asked for the bill because it still hadn't come. As soon as I asked for the bill, the food arrived immediately. I couldn't eat it, so I took it home in a doggy bag. I probably won't go back again. The food tasted average.
The owner apologized profusely and was very friendly. I'd like to encourage them. I would suggest closing the shop entrance near the parking lot to avoid misunderstandings and to save time having to keep asking customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ve Are Family

restaurants.name: MAKAI Acai Bar (Asok)
restaurants.address:

Mille Malle, 66/4 Sukhumvit 20 Alley, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love açaí, but this one was not the best—just a simple, icy bowl. It wasn’t as smooth or silky as other açaí bowls I’ve had elsewhere. Because the blend was icy, the peanut butter froze at the bottom, which made it less enjoyable to eat.

Otherwise, the portion size, fruits, and other toppings were great. I simply didn’t like their açaí blend, which I felt had too much water added to it. That likely caused the ice shards throughout. The service was basic—nothing special.
sample_reviews_en.author: William

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food is good.

But service is quite horrible, cashier was looking at her phone all the time, she still missed the order, even we are the only table in the restaurant. Need to revise the order 2-3 times.

The vibe is quite bad, small and sad. The toilet is far far away, no washing area in the restaurant.

Just order it via delivery services. No need to sit-in.

I will not go back again, even my best friend are gonna have a wedding ceremony there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukhum Cheff Truengtrachitkul

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered delivery through grab for a couple açaí bowls. Know that they’re small portions at western prices. They’re fine but not great açaí bowls. Barely any honey, fruits are frozen and the amount of chocolate on their bowls is no where near what they display on their menu. Take advantage of their combos if you’re ordering more than one bowl. We personally won’t be coming back for more when there are plenty of alternatives out there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason Jocson

sample_reviews_en.text: The place is not as advertised. Ambience is more like a mall type of place with too many plastic plants and very little soul. Definitely disappointing compared to the photos. We had the açaí and “Tame my dragon” bowls. Fruits were cut nicely but both were basically frozen solid with no taste whatsoever. Will look elsewhere for our next breakfast since this was definitely not worth our money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Aakjær Sørensen

sample_reviews_en.text: Great smoothie bowls, from acai to green to coconut. Really enjoyed the berry one, I added an extra of peanut butter. They use superfoods like Goji berries and chia which is nice. The Greek yogurt parfaits are also yummy, they top them off with granola. The place is a bit hard to find because it is small and inside a mall. Missing good coffee. Service was nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sofia De la Mora

sample_reviews_en.text: Came here after training to enjoy an acai bowl - the 'Dirty Mind' acai has a delicious nutty acai base from the peanut butter and the dark chocolate brownie complements the variety of fruity flavours. The fruit was good quality and the brownie is not too sweet! I would return to try the other combinations. Five stars for how clean the cafe is ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
sample_reviews_en.author: NИ Studio

sample_reviews_en.text: Just ordered two cacao smoothies. Paid $12 USD for two children sized smoothies. Waited over an hour for delivery as well. Smoothie was decent but was expecting a standard or large size not children's size for 180 bhat each plus tip for driver. Total equaled 400 bhat - around $12 USD. Way overpriced. Other options around the corner are better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anahata Love PR

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very overpriced. Açai bowl and lunch cost 910 baht.

Açai was still frozen like a slush. Wasn’t too bad but not amazing.

Chicken salad was basically just lettuce but the flavours were good overall.

Hummus I ordered was basically a loaf of bread and a tiny pot of hummus.

Overall 7/10 would come again out of necessity but not by choice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Louis Green

restaurants.name: Pui Fish Ball Noodle
restaurants.address:

Maitri Chit Rd, Pom Prap, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the dry spicy noodle salad. The noodles were thin, round, soft, and chewy. The spicy dressing was perfectly balanced with a mix of sour, sweet, salty, and spicy flavors—no need to add anything.

The highlight was the fish balls; smooth, bouncy, and flavorful, and importantly, free of any fishy smell.
The fish cake (Huer Kwai) was also delicious; firm, bouncy, and fragrant, it paired perfectly with the dry spicy noodle salad.
The seaweed fish balls were another favorite. They had the bouncy texture of fish and a light, fragrant seaweed aroma—delicious!

Next, the rice noodle rolls were also delicious. They came with all the toppings and were drizzled with a flavorful braised sauce that was easy to eat and reminiscent of traditional rice noodle rolls.

Finally, the steamed dumplings (Khanom Jeeb) had thin, soft wrappers, flattened like the rice noodle rolls, and a generous filling—very enjoyable to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Toi Chao

sample_reviews_en.text:
This noodle shop is an old establishment in the Phlapplachai area, likely open for decades. It's located directly opposite Wat Phlapplachai, but the owner mentioned they'll be moving to a location behind the shop in about six months.

I personally love their dry Shanghai noodles with spicy dressing – delicious!
The regular noodles are perfectly cooked, and the fish balls are tasty, not fishy, ​​and have a nice bouncy texture.

The rice noodle rolls, wonton wraps, and steamed dumplings are also delicious; the steamed dumplings have a very generous filling.

The hibiscus, longan, and plum juices are homemade, and have a good balance of sweetness. They also offer iced tea for those who prefer it.

Prices are clearly displayed.

Parking is available at Wat Phlapplachai, directly across from the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angsupa Phachala

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was shopping near by in Chinatown for som3 products for our shop, and took a walk around to explore the area.

And what a lucky find. Needed to rest, and refill energy, and I came across this place.

I started with a super tasty cold plumb drink and then also had a lunch.

As per the recommendation of a very lovely and well-spoken daughter of the owners
I had chosen their signature meal,

a Fish ball noodles, the egg type noodles.
All made in-house from fresh ingredients!

And man, I loved it. This is becoming a regular spot for me from now.

That said, I definitely recommend this restaurant to fellow travellers and hungry souls of the area looking for something extraordinary.

HK
sample_reviews_en.author: Imon Ghoshal

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely a hidden gem! Their fishballs are made DAILY, super early in the morning. The texture and freshness of the ingredients are so pronounced, almost shouting!! This is one of those places that had been using traditional method for decades, if not generations. And the price is almost ridiculously cheap. You pay one third of what you normally would have in those resto of similar kind in the mall, but this one is far better.
The only drawbacks are that they have no aircon and toilet...oh and they only accept cash, so bring some on your visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mai Paul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is called "Jae Pui." I recommend ordering the clear broth soup; the soup is incredibly delicious, with a sweet bone flavor. Try the thin or thick noodles; they're soft and chewy. The fish balls are tasty and bouncy. I also recommend ordering the crispy wonton wraps and steamed dumplings as appetizers; they're delicious.

The restaurant is a bit hidden; look for the sign and then look inside – it's at the back. The staff are friendly and provide good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warintorn Rassamee

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best fish ball noodle spot in town - especially for a noodle lover like me. Fish stick is my most fav. There are some additional menus such as “Rice Noodle Rolls”, “The dumplings and shumai” made with the restaurant’s special recipe and served with a tasty dipping sauce, were delicious. Overall, I was very impressed with this place and will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warinnie

sample_reviews_en.text: Chance upon this stall serving noodle while exploring Chinatown. The noodle was delicious and I enjoyed it. The bowl of noodle was 70baht. It comes with an onsen egg, fried wanton, various type of fishcake and fishball. Noodle was nicely cooked and tossed in lard oil and some other seasoning. I think place is really worth trying.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sean Goh

sample_reviews_en.text: The fish balls with seaweed were quite tasty, but the other types of fish balls were just average. The soup was also nothing special, and the shumai didn’t really stand out either. I went outside of regular meal times so the place was very quiet and comfortable to sit and relax. Overall, it didn’t really feel worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: em emmm

restaurants.name: Bargyuu บาร์กิว/RoofTop Bar & Charcoal grill
restaurants.address:

466/5 Phahonyothin Rd, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Elevated grilling with a view! 🔥 Enjoy a Japanese BBQ experience at Bargyuu บาร์กิว, our rooftop charcoal grill spot overlooking the skytrain.
There are beef, pork, grilled salmon, sashimi, deep fried chicken and garlic rice to be served for you .
sample_reviews_th.author: Sumol

sample_reviews_en.text:
Bargyuu Rooftop Bar offers a fantastic experience with stunning views. I had the opportunity to watch the sun go down while also seeing the BTS train pass by every 5 minutes, which was truly amazing.

The food here is good, though not particularly special, but the incredible atmosphere makes it all worthwhile. It's the kind of place where you can enjoy the moment, and it feels like every cent spent is worth it.

The service was also exceptional. The waiter was friendly and attentive, taking care of our belongings and even reserving the best spot for us to enjoy the sunset.

Overall, Bargyuu Rooftop Bar is a great place to relax and enjoy breathtaking views, great service, and a memorable atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Diệu Hà

sample_reviews_en.text:
A rooftop Japanese yakiniku restaurant. The scenery isn't spectacular because the building isn't particularly tall, but the atmosphere is still quite pleasant. However, you must ascend via a stairway. There is no elevator. As a result, neither the elderly nor people with disabilities are well served.

Food variety is good. The beef menu is excellent. It appeals to me greatly. The cost is a little high, but it is still reasonable. The staff is friendly and helpful.

It's best to take the BTS Skytrain, but parking is available nearby if you drive. On the ground floor, there's also an all-you-can-eat yakiniku deal called Guru Gyu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kongdej Keesukpan

sample_reviews_en.text:
fb : Travel Cafe Eat Drink - Malaysia & Asia

Good location of this Japanese yakiniku restaurant in Ari, with a rooftop bar at 5th level where you can enjoy your drinks at the balcony while the BTS train pass in front of you.
Variety of beef from Japan and also local wagyu are available from the menu.
Nice vibe especially at night when this place is lighted up.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ong C

sample_reviews_en.text: 🥩The wagyu beef was almost soft until very soft, if it's thinner, it may melt in your mouth. All types of meat are prepared on the same plate. This bar is on the fifth floor and is on a rooftop during the meal, you will see the view of the BTS passing by. You can park the car in the alley next to it
sample_reviews_en.author: Pupae Zuza

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good view and good food but the hype was too much because of social media.
The stair are not friendly for drunk people or little babies or disabled person.

Good atmosphere although the view is good if not raining.
The price is little on the stiff side
2 people around 2,000 thb
sample_reviews_en.author: DW

sample_reviews_en.text: lovely atmosphere and service was okay but payed a significant amount between 4 people and really didn’t get that much food! when you order a large tray of beef you only get one tiny side - if more & larger sides were included with the meal it would be better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Liza Smith

sample_reviews_en.text:
The rooftop bar was spacious. You can easily spend hours there drinking draught beer and chatting with your friends.
However, Yakiniku didn’t meet my expectations. They cut the meat so thick that it took you nearly minute to chew a piece.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phongsathorn Meethawolgul

restaurants.name: Taraba Prime Japanese Restaurant
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 1 Sukhumvit 20 Alley, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Many of the dishes are surprisingly affordable, especially the sashimi, which is unexpectedly cheap considering it's in Sukhumvit. The prices are excellent.

The sashimi is very fresh.
The plum soda is delicious and not too sweet.
The green tea refill is very fragrant; it'll make you feel green! (Haha)

I like that there's parking in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: PuAy PoLLy's Journey

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came for a weekend dinner and truly loved the dining experience!
You can truly see the freshness and quality of each ingredient they use, and the presentation was absolutely stunning! I highly recommend to order sashimi set.
The elegant atmosphere and attentive service of their staff made the experience extra special🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: May

sample_reviews_en.text: The dry-aged fish sushi was amazing! It's hard to find that in other restaurants. The sashimi was very fresh. I ordered three different rolls and they were all delicious. They're unlike the rolls you'd find at typical Japanese restaurants. The restaurant has a nice atmosphere and the service is good. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: panadda sithibus

sample_reviews_en.text: I absolutely loved this cozy restaurant! The Taraba crab was incredibly fresh, juicy, and sweet 🦀. I was impressed that they could prepare multiple dishes from a single crab, perfect for families. Don't miss their Sapporo promotion 2+1 🍻, it's a great deal! A truly lovely experience. 💖 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Schanider Dit

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the atmosphere was nice and private, and the staff provided excellent service 💖🌈✨. I loved it and will definitely come back. I recommend visiting; it's located just a short distance into Sukhumvit Soi 20, easy to get to, and has parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ananya Songsiri

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm writing this review while I'm still at the restaurant with my wife. It's an understatement to say we've never eaten so well in our lives. Yes, we paid more for Bangkok standards, but the quality is superior to many other places. The …
sample_reviews_en.author: lorenzo raso

sample_reviews_en.text:
Having the opportunity to spend special time with a special person on a special day, I always think of this restaurant. Every time I come, I'm never disappointed with the quality of the ingredients, the taste, and the service.
🥰🥰🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Sireetorn Amornpokin

sample_reviews_en.text: The crab was incredibly fresh, the meat was tender, fragrant, and delicious. The restaurant is beautiful with a great atmosphere, perfect for a dinner date. The service was excellent. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kantima Srinawakul

restaurants.name: Suan Bai Baue Restaurant
restaurants.address:

73 Rat Burana Rd, Rat Burana, Bangkok 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We came here on a family recommendation. At first glance, the restaurant seemed a bit upscale and chic. Upon closer inspection, I was surprised by the fake parquet flooring, which warped in many places and was quite tripping hazard. The menu offered a wide selection. The food itself wasn't particularly good, but it wasn't bad either. The desserts, however, were almost absurd. A cheesecake doesn't have the consistency of a cream cake! It tastes fresh and moist, not like some greasy, chemical-laden cream! Banoffee is made with caramel, bananas, and shortbread. A British delicacy. What they were selling here had nothing to do with that. All the desserts were just brightly colored and extremely sweet. We couldn't finish them! The desserts were served with thin plastic spoons that bent under the sticky mess. I only expect to see plastic cutlery in a cheap takeaway coffee shop. The staff seemed to be standing around joking with each other. What's completely unacceptable, however, is that one of the young men brazenly picked his nose, searching for something. No sooner had he found it than he inspected what had been in his nose and took it into the kitchen area. Thanks a lot for that.
sample_reviews_en.author: J K

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently had the chance to dine at Baibua Restaurant, and I must say, the atmosphere was incredibly relaxing from the moment I walked in. The restaurant is spacious and airy, with seating areas perfect for family meals and other relaxed conversations with friends. The overall ambiance is warm and inviting, making it a place where you can linger without feeling rushed.

The food was excellent. Many dishes had a well-balanced, easy-to-eat flavor, each with its own unique touch. The ingredients seemed fresh, and the dishes were perfectly cooked – not overly strong, making them easy to enjoy. The portions were also generous and offered good value.

The service was another highlight. The staff were attentive, polite, and answered questions in a friendly manner. The food arrived relatively quickly, making for a comfortable and relaxed dining experience.

Overall, it's a restaurant with a great atmosphere, delicious food, and excellent service – perfect for a chill meal. If you're in the area, this is definitely a restaurant worth trying.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปวีร์ (พีร์)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was okay, but some dishes weren't particularly flavorful. We sat outside and no staff were present, so we had to call for food inside the air-conditioned room, where there were three tables of customers, but the staff were all standing around. We asked the staff if they didn't have staff to attend to the outside seating, and they replied that they didn't, and that customers had to call for food. If that's the case, the outside seating area shouldn't be open. Customers wouldn't be comfortable having to call for food every time they order. I'd like to see this improved.
Note: While I was typing this comment, a female staff member apologized for not attending to the outside seating area. She sincerely apologized, and I'm no longer upset.
sample_reviews_en.author: เมทินี เฉลิมโยธิน

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a great family restaurant with a lovely atmosphere. The high ceilings make it feel spacious and comfortable. Parking is convenient. Outside, there's a fountain with fish and fish food for sale, and a pen with about 5-6 goats (there might be more living in the goat enclosure), they're so cute and playful. They have a huge menu, lots of cakes, and delicious coffee with an impressive coffee machine.
sample_reviews_en.author: thitapas gositarunroj

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, there's plenty of parking, and the food is delicious. However, some dishes might be a bit bland, like the stir-fried three-smelling dish. I felt the flavor was a bit weak. The food came out quickly. At the time I went, several large tables had already been reserved. I haven't tried the coffee or desserts yet. The price is not expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aomsin Ck

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and clean. There are drinks and cakes. Everything is delicious...5 stars. The food comes out quickly. The air conditioning is cool and comfortable. The shop is beautiful, clean, and shady. The price is appropriate for the quantity.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanita Kijsirikan

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is clean, the air conditioning is nice and cool, and the seafood, such as squid and shrimp, is very fresh. I recommend the pizza as well; it's delicious. There's plenty of parking. I highly recommend this place for families.
sample_reviews_en.author: อ๊อด สุขแสง

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, family-friendly. There are many large tables that can accommodate 10-15 people per table. The food is diverse, including seafood, Thai, and Western dishes. Everything is delicious. The seafood is very fresh. The …
sample_reviews_en.author: Thansinee Watanavitaya

restaurants.name: เกาเหลาสามหมู ข้าวขาหมูร้อยอาจารย์ (ร้านอยู่ในซอยจุฬา18 ไม่มีสาขา)
restaurants.address:

392 ซอย จุฬาลงกรณ์ 18 Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been a regular customer at this restaurant for a long time. I've always given it 5-star reviews on Wongnai (a Thai food review website). But today, after returning to eat, everything has dropped significantly, starting with:
1. I personally think the bouncy pork isn't cooked through. I tried cutting it open, and the inside was still red, even though the outside was white (normally, boiled bouncy pork should be white). The staff insisted it was cooked, so I don't know what to say. Please look at the pictures. I personally didn't dare eat any more.
2. The soup isn't as sweet as before. Previously, it was incredibly sweet and delicious, I'd finish the whole bowl. Now, the sweetness is weak. Maybe it's because I ate in the evening.
3. The rice, in my opinion, has a lingering smell. It's like the rice cooker was cooked and then the stove was unplugged; the rice wasn't hot and had an odor (this is just my personal opinion).
4. They used to sell ice cubes with tea, but they don't anymore, according to the staff. It's a real shame.

The good thing is that there are now proper seating areas, comfortable seating inside the shophouse, not just sitting on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: TheLuckyman153

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here in the evening because the shops across the street were closed, but I was pleasantly surprised. The prices were reasonable and the food was delicious. I devoured it all and felt very grateful. 🥰 The service was excellent. The napkins were even thick tissues, and there was a restroom. I highly recommend it. The pork neck with basil and rice and the minced pork with basil and rice were both very good. The Thai milk tea was a bit too sweet, so you can add some water. Overall, I really enjoyed it. 🙂‍↕️
sample_reviews_en.author: yiying li

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant serves pork leg rice, as well as noodle soup, egg noodles, pork blood soup, and stir-fried basil with rice. It's a single-unit shophouse with no air conditioning.

The pork leg rice features tender pork knuckle and a rich, flavorful broth. It comes with a boiled egg and kale. You can ask for extra broth. Chili and garlic are available on the table. Payment can be made via bank transfer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponchagarj Ngamukos

sample_reviews_en.text: I went in because I was craving Khao Kha Moo. The meat was tender, and the seasoning wasn't too strong, making it very easy to eat. I was also happy that there was a generous amount of vegetables on the side. The grass jelly was delicious, so I highly recommend ordering it. The staff were also very kind. I'll definitely go again!
sample_reviews_en.author: takako kiuchi

sample_reviews_en.text: Parking is quite difficult at this restaurant, even on a Sunday. I came based on Google Maps reviews and ordered the pork knuckle rice. The taste was average. I also ordered a bottle of water. The pork knuckle rice included meat, skin, intestines, and one egg. The total bill was 90 baht, which I thought was a bit expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: orarig rasri

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is not so far from the main Banthat Rd and have very reasonable price for a good decent food. My kid love their pork belly and not spicy at all. We are very satisfied with their service as they try to understand us. Please consider put English name on Google Maps so your restaurant will easier to find :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Martha Maria Guntoro

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant has a diverse menu. I ordered the basil chicken and it was delicious, but the crispy pork had a bit too much fat.

🚙 You'll need to find parking near Im Park.

♿️ Getting into the restaurant is quite difficult; you might need help carrying your luggage.
sample_reviews_en.author: NoBi Kung

sample_reviews_en.text: It was so delicious 😋 Please come and try it 🍽️. The pork leg rice and the basil-flavored pork rice were both very good. The Thai milk tea was a bit too sweet and needed to be diluted with water. Everything was delicious though.
sample_reviews_en.author: yashu fang

restaurants.name: Bossa Cafe'
restaurants.address:

29 ซอย งามวงศ์วาน 6 แยก 3 Bang Khen, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my second visit to this cozy little spot not far from the city, and it didn’t disappoint. We went as a group of six and ordered quite a few dishes. The prices were very reasonable, especially considering the quality and service.

The place is nicely decorated and has a warm, welcoming vibe. Parking is a bit limited, but still manageable. If you’re planning to go around lunchtime with a larger group, I’d recommend booking ahead—it tends to fill up quickly.

We ordered the deep-fried shrimp with wasabi sauce (definitely a favorite), Thai papaya salad, and a shrimp sour curry that came in a modest-sized pot—plus a bunch of other dishes. Overall, the flavors were solid and satisfying across the board.

One in our group did experience an upset stomach afterward, though it’s hard to say if it was the food or something personal. It was their first meal of the day, and they hadn’t eaten anything before that, so it might have just been a sensitive stomach.

All in all, great food, thoughtful service, and a spot worth revisiting—which, clearly, I already did.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jennyne S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here to try the coffee at this shop located near the Ngamwongwan expressway entrance. I ordered a special menu item, but I can't remember the name. I think it was something like nut black coffee, 75 baht. It's an espresso shot + syrup + milk foam. I asked for it less sweet (but it still felt quite sweet, haha).

- The atmosphere is nice. It would be more relaxing in the evening (it's hot outside at noon).
- The coffee tastes good and the price is reasonable.
- They have a proper food menu, worth trying (a bit pricey).
- The air-conditioned area has limited seating, divided into two rooms.
- There's Wi-Fi, but I couldn't connect.
- The staff provided good service. They were polite when asked questions and gave good menu recommendations.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalinee Thirasupa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Who would have thought that a quiet restaurant in this area would serve grilled river prawns?!

This restaurant has a relaxed atmosphere and is located on a side street near the Ministry of Public Health. The food is pretty good, you won't be disappointed. But the real surprise is that who would have thought a quiet place like this would have grilled river prawns? The prawns are good, large, and have plenty of roe. The price is reasonable. If you're passing by the Ministry of Public Health, give it a try, you won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: pimchanok palakawongse na ayudhaya

sample_reviews_en.text: The coffee tastes excellent, and the cafe's atmosphere is beautiful and relaxing, with lush greenery and a pond with fish swimming in it. There are seating options both inside the air-conditioned room, outside in a beautiful garden setting, and by the water where you can watch the fish. There's also a separate restaurant where you can order food. The cafe is conveniently located right next to the Ngamwongwan expressway and has parking available; if it's full, you can find parking along the roadside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naphat Sangkaew

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant and cafe is located behind the Ministry of Public Health. Everything on the menu is delicious. It's recommended to reserve a table or order your desired dishes in advance via LINE because if it's busy, the food might take a little longer to come out. I love the crispy chicken with wasabi sauce; it's a must-have at every table. Parking might be a bit difficult though.
sample_reviews_en.author: ไม่กิน ก็เที่ยว

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food at great prices, surrounded by a peaceful, lush green garden by the water in a refreshing atmosphere.
Recommended dishes include Gaeng Liang (Thai vegetable soup), crispy chicken, Som Tum (papaya salad), fried fish/pork/chicken wings, and more. You should definitely try them!
sample_reviews_en.author: นิตยา มหาผล

sample_reviews_en.text: Enjoy a wide variety of fragrant coffee and a selection of delicious food in a tranquil and relaxing atmosphere. Their signature dishes include shrimp in fish sauce, fried minced pork salad, chicken tom kha soup, crispy chicken with wasabi, and the must-try papaya salad with crab.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pahurat K. Taisuwan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. We really liked the wasabi fried chicken; it sounded unusual on the menu, but we were not disappointed. The only downside is the limited parking. The restaurant also has a cafe area with air-conditioned seating, so it's not hot.
sample_reviews_en.author: CHOCO CHOCOSHOO

restaurants.name: Raintree Pub
restaurants.address:

116, 63-64 Rang Nam Alley, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Found the music bar on Google. Great find, my sister in law wanted to drink some wine so our waiter ran around to Lotus honget is a bottle. Superb service great level of English and answered many questions about things to do in Bangkok. Retro pub with a fab band 👍🏽👍🏽. They did a full set of songs on English for the foreigners in the pub. They even sang a very funny happy birthday for my sister-in-law and she got a squeaky plastic chicken off a guitarist as a pressie 😂🤣 - FANTASTIC night's entertainment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve “Sparky”

sample_reviews_en.text: This live music pub on Soi Rangnam plays from dusk till 1 AM. It's a true live music pub, an old establishment open for over 20 years. They play bands like Caravan, Pongthep, Carabao, Pu Pongsit Arak, Khon Dan Kwean, Konglo, and Karmachon. The owner is lovely. It's not crowded, and they really play what you request. It's one of the few truly live music pubs left. Importantly, it's not crowded, making it very friendly and welcoming. Please support them so they can continue to thrive.
sample_reviews_en.author: jaksu takrudkaew

sample_reviews_en.text: This bar is the perfect place to end the day on a high note. The food is good, the atmosphere is lovely, and the musicians convey a passion that you can feel in every note. It's an authentic spot with exceptional service. The young man who served us was always very attentive and helpful, which made the experience even better. We loved it and will definitely be back on our next trip.
sample_reviews_en.author: catalina moreira

sample_reviews_en.text: Came here on a whim; left wishing it wasn't closing. Amazing live Thai folk music. Upon entering and sharing we were English and Irish they proceeded to share with us a Thai version of Westlife songs and Johnny Cash. Even Simon and Garfunel. Very talented and kind people. Beer satisfactory, no craft beer unfortunately. Staff friendly and helpful. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachael Winifred

sample_reviews_en.text: A lively bar serving authentic folk music... In an era where it's increasingly difficult to find bars playing genuine folk music, the atmosphere here is relaxed and the musicians are friendly... It brings back old memories from 30 years ago, when I had my favorite bar near Siam Square, next to the Novotel Hotel, called "Dallas Cowboy." 🍺🍺🍺
sample_reviews_en.author: Jum_poo 2000

sample_reviews_en.text: We went after dinner for drinks and the music, so we can't speak for the food, although it smelled delicious. The music, however, was fantastic.  The band leader made us feel very welcome and told us what the songs were about since e couldn't understand the words. It was a lovely way to close the day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Heidi Rhodes

sample_reviews_en.text: Wish we would have found this earlier! The music is great and everyone was so welcoming! The music starts a little after 9 PM. We truly enjoyed the Thailand folk songs and they did sing us some English songs too. Thanks for a great memorable evening!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lorri Peltz-Lewis

sample_reviews_en.text:
All of this is my personal experience with my friend; it may vary from day to day, but I hope the restaurant will take it into consideration as feedback.
I went with two friends, intending to just have one bottle of liquor to chill …
sample_reviews_en.author: Perm Sr

restaurants.name: Seafood Land บุฟเฟ่ต์ ทะเล ปิ้งย่าง
restaurants.address:

781 S.k. Soi 2, Khlong Bang Bon, Khet Bang Bon, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you like grilled seafood, you'll probably enjoy it because the food is fresh. But if you prefer pork, you'll be indifferent.
The service from the staff was terrible. We called them two or three times for the same things. Eventually, they started walking away and didn't come to our area anymore because they couldn't provide the service we needed.
The table arrangements when there are large groups are also poorly managed; tables are placed blocking the walkways.
We asked for a fan many times because our table included a pregnant woman, a child, and an elderly person. The staff said they were out of fans, but we saw plenty of them placed near the restrooms.
