If they weren't working or had any problems, they should have informed us, but they just disappeared and didn't come to that area again. The service was terrible.
Overall, apart from the seafood, I think everything else was bad. The service needs improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noon Piyatida

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good service, good food.
But if you come on a weekday, it's like a completely different restaurant. Many items are sold out.
My first visit was very impressive. Great food, lots of variety, very fresh.
A month later, I came on a weekday, and the taste was completely different. But I'm still giving it a chance. I came on a Sunday at the beginning of the month, and it was okay. I just went again,
but they were sold out. It wasn't even 7 PM yet. It must have been the last round.
sample_reviews_en.author: Takumi Kingston

sample_reviews_en.text:
All-you-can-eat curry rice buffet.
At first, I could tolerate finding chicken shell in the fried enoki mushrooms, but then I found steel wool in the mushroom soup. Around 12:40, they started not refilling the food, or only refilling the curries. The "son-in-law eggs" (a Thai dish) were refilled twice, some items were refilled only once, and some weren't refilled at all. The fried items ran out and weren't refilled. It's been like this since I arrived.
sample_reviews_en.author: MR•MOS MATTER TH

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant looked good in the reviews, but the reality was terrible.
Poor management, staff couldn't provide adequate service.
The food wasn't fresh and not worth the money. The only good seafood item on the day I went was the shrimp, which was live. Everything else seemed old. The soda dispenser wasn't refilled; it was like drinking sugary drinks without carbonation. Overall, it's not worth it. Go to a regular BBQ restaurant instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: sumanut radeerom

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great. There's a wide variety of seafood, both regular dishes and lots of appetizers—so many that you can't try them all. I really liked the soy sauce marinated salmon. There are also special menu items that you have to scan to order, which were okay (the stir-fried squid with curry powder served with rice was delicious). ˖°🌊🎐𓇼⋆🦪₊
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimamonl

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is indescribable. It's on the sweet side. The dumplings were mushy and falling apart. Many dishes need improvement. The seafood wasn't bad, but the marinated shrimp and crab were a bit too sweet. The desserts were a complete disaster; nothing like what I've had before. The dipping sauce was also a bit too spicy.
sample_reviews_en.author: 메이is몬BE베

sample_reviews_en.text: Recommended for seafood lovers. Fresh shrimp, shellfish, and large crabs. Oysters (you shuck them yourself, so I skipped that). Plenty of food and drinks to choose from. The price is considered good value. /Note: Changing the grill costs extra. 3 people, 1,100-1,200 THB.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yonnarong Wongsopha

sample_reviews_en.text: The seafood is fresh, with fresh crab and shrimp kept on ice. However, the pre-cooked pork and fish need improvement as they weren't as fresh. The staff were polite and friendly. The venue is beautifully decorated, and the prices are reasonable. Overall, I was impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Darika Thamvanich

restaurants.name: Indian food 17
restaurants.address:

325 Ngamwongwarn 22 Alley, Tambon Bang Khen, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
From the skills of Thai chef who has learned and practiced traditional Indian cooking until at proficient level before opening this Indian restaurant in Thailand and later expanded to many branches today both in Bangkok and its vicinity.

"The secret of deliciousness is good quality ingredients” whether it's fresh meat and seafood that have been selected. Combined with "various condiments and spices that are all imported directly from India" such as basmati rice, curry paste, saffron and others. The shop cooks using traditional recipes. It makes you feel like you've eaten authentic Indian food. But the taste is right for both Thais, foreigners and even Indians themselves.

Indian Food 17 serves northern Indian food. Recommended menus include Masala curry, Biryani, Mutton butter curry, Tandoori grilled chicken, Palak paneer curry, etc.

In conclusion, if you want to experience traditional Indian food, and Thai people can eat it without difficulty. Don't miss it at all. Ranked "One of the five Indian restaurants in Nonthaburi" surely.

By: Sunset @ Nonthaburi peer
LGL10 F6B
♎️ Enjoyably reviewing either Engineering documents or Yummy foods😆 ♎️
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanakorn Jornjarern

sample_reviews_en.text:
Indian restaurant near The Mall Ngamwongwan.

They have a wide variety of dishes, including curries, chicken, and naan bread.

-Lamb Masala Curry 240 THB - I thought the portion was very small for the price. The lamb was well-prepared and delicious. The curry was a little too salty, but the sourness balanced it out and prevented it from being too bland. It tasted great with the naan bread.
-Naan Bread - I recommend the garlic naan; it's delicious and not too thick. I personally prefer it thicker. The plain butter naan is also good.
-Tandoori Chicken 22 THB - 3 pieces. It was very well-prepared, the chicken was incredibly tender and delicious.
-Naan Bread - Approximately 50 THB
-Drinks: Coke 25 THB per can

I thought the portions were a bit small, but the taste was okay. The total bill was over 600 THB. A bit pricey!

There's no parking. The restaurant is on the roadside. You can park in The Mall Ngamwongwan and walk a short distance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cherry Ja

sample_reviews_en.text:
This affordable Indian restaurant has several branches. Parking is available in front of the restaurant, but there are limited hours. Honestly, I rarely see anyone parking.

I recommend parking at The Mall Ngamwongwan and walking there. It's not far, about 100 meters.

The food is delicious, especially the butter and masala curry. The flavors are excellent, smooth, and well-balanced. They offer fish, shrimp, chicken, and goat.

The naan bread is freshly made, large, fragrant, and delicious. I love the butter and garlic.

The biryani is delicious and rich, using authentic Indian basmati rice.

The tandoori chicken is fragrant and flavorful.

The portions are quite large, but the prices are reasonable. The restaurant may look ordinary, but the taste is good and worth it. Cash and bank transfers are accepted.
sample_reviews_en.author: S Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious!!!
This Indian restaurant has amazing food, and the prices are surprisingly affordable.
- Butter chicken: A classic dish, the flavor is perfectly balanced and creamy, not at all greasy.
- Lamb madras: A rich and flavorful lamb curry with dried chilies, not too spicy, and the lamb is incredibly tender. So good!
- Crab masala: My first time trying crab curry in an Indian restaurant! It was a great combination, giving off a slightly Thai food vibe, haha.
- Shrimp biryani: Surprisingly huge shrimp! Fresh, bouncy, and delicious – amazing value for money.
- Naan: Ordered both garlic and cheese naan, both delicious, perfect for dipping in the curry.

The bill for all five dishes came out to just over 1000 baht. So affordable! They had shrimp, lamb, crab, and chicken too! 🥺💖
sample_reviews_en.author: kaewnum PT

sample_reviews_en.text:
-Park your car at The Mall and it's about a 2-minute walk.
-The Pani Puri is crispy and delicious, I liked the potato filling.
-The Indian spinach and cheese curry and the lamb masala curry were both delicious.
-I tried the grilled mushrooms and they were tasty. The mushrooms were firm and flavorful, like puffball mushrooms, and perfectly seasoned.
-The grilled chicken was cooked just right, not dry like the ones I've had at other restaurants.
-The staff provided good service, but the restaurant was very stuffy inside. There was no air conditioning and the fans were very weak. It was impossible to stay there for long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chulee Kobwitthayawong

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Indian restaurant has an extensive menu. It was my first time trying Indian food, so I asked a lot of questions. The staff gave detailed explanations about the flavors.

I don't know what "authentic" Indian food is supposed to be like, but it's definitely different from Thai food. The taste is unfamiliar, and there's a strong spice aroma. It's definitely not bad for Thai people.

The restaurant is in a single shophouse unit on Ngamwongwan Road. I recommend parking at The Mall and walking over, as long-term parking is prohibited in this area. So I ended up getting takeout instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: LordGift

sample_reviews_en.text:
This small, green Indian restaurant is located on Ngamwongwan Road, not far from The Mall Ngamwongwan. Almost everything on the menu is delicious. The prices are on the higher side, but the taste is worth it. You won't be disappointed if you like Indian food.
I recommend the Tandoori Prawns; the prawns are large and firm, the flavor is excellent, and it's worth the price.
There is no parking available. You have to park in The Mall Ngamwongwan and walk left, which is about 200 meters.
sample_reviews_en.author: K. Wangvitayakun

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and they have a huge menu. I've eaten here many times and still haven't tried everything. My favorite is the masala; it's packed with ingredients and pairs perfectly with the naan bread. Importantly, they provide pickled onions to cut through the richness. The tandoori chicken is also good, not too dry and well-marinated. I highly recommend it. If you like Indian food, you can't miss this place. And you can also order through food delivery apps.
sample_reviews_en.author: Punn Bhavabhutananda

restaurants.name: Tien Sin
restaurants.address:

เขดบางรัก บ้านเลขที176.ซ.ศรีเวียง ถ. เจริญกรุง Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely amazing vegetarian restaurant in Bangkok!! 👌💖
They have a buffet style set-up and you can point at the dishes you want to eat. They have a good variety of different veggie curries and faux meat dishes and everything we tried was delicious. Prices are incredibly cheap for the great quality of food, you get rice + 1 choice for 35baht, rice + 2 choices for 45baht and rice + 3 choices for 50k. Besides the great prices, the staff were very friendly and welcoming!! 😍 Unfortunately we discovered the restaurant only on our last day in BKK, otherwise we would have eaten there every day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brina

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very good Vegan / Vegetarian outlet (I will not say this as restaurant). Great food. Tried for 3 years and no complaints at all. Staff may be little less understanding of English but you will still be able to order what you want.

Prices are very very reasonable. Only Thai Vegan food available here. If you reach before 12.00 12.30 pm, you will get more choices of food.

Four wheeler parking will be an issue, you can park your car nearby (@ Robinson) and enjoy your food here.
sample_reviews_en.author: dkkhamar

sample_reviews_en.text: Love this simple place simple food. The rice with selected dishes are yummy with local flavours. Rice plus 2 dishes cost 45 bahts. The noodle/rice vermicelli/Kway Teow soup dishes are tasty too, i would say simple, tasty and very local. I love them. The Kway Teow soup cost only 40 bahts. Satisfying breakfast for me. They opens from 6.30am to about 7.45pm, closed on Sunday. We stayed in Bossotel hotel and Tien Sin veg is just in the opposite street. So convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Reen Nana

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fantastic vegetarian food. I had no idea really how to order, but the woman in charge was so friendly and encouraging despite my complete lack of Thai. Her (limited) English and some pointing got us through. Didn't love the spring roll, but seriously loved everything else.
One of the few places we found in Bangkok that used tofu, and it was great. (It's a shame because tofu is like the perfect vehicle to absorb all those great flavors you get in Thai food).
sample_reviews_en.author: Joseph Candelora

sample_reviews_en.text: Got there at 1:30pm. Maybe that's why the point & pick dishes were so cold & unappetizing. Flavors were average - edible. 2 sides + rice 50 baht. Curry puff not worth getting, cold & hard. Better order noodle soup or fried dish from menu (looks like separate stalls). A bit pricier by 10 or 20 baht but tastes better - & I realised later that's what all the locals chose. I checked, & it seems everything is vegan. Limited English, one speaks some Mandarin.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lia X.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Probably the best place to eat imo within a 20minute walk of here if you just want healthy tasty thai veg food - has good salad rolls and stuff to go too but is mostly a buffet-type place.

40 or 50 baht or something a place, has the best massaman curry I've probably had anywhere out of 15-20~ places I've had it (on the buffet/trays when they have it) and always a few tofu and veg dishes that aren't oily or anything - just herbed up and nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zachary K.

sample_reviews_en.text: Buffet style canteen with a few simple vegetarian dishes served over rice. We paid 50 baht each for a generous portion of rice and three sides. The food was underwhelming, with one particular dish being unidentifiable and hard to stomach. However, the food might have been better fresh out of the kitchen earlier in the day as we arrived after lunch hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Irene Q

sample_reviews_en.text: Good vegetarian Thai food restaurant only open during day and frequented mainly by locals.  Helpful staff though very limited English. Fried rice was nice with decent amount of vegetables in it, and the tofu in red curry sauce was really good. It had a bit of a bite to it without being too hot. All in all a great cheap place to have lunch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phil Hogben

restaurants.name: On the Table @ Central Rama 3
restaurants.address:

5th Floor, 79 Sathu Pradit Rd, Bang Phong Phang, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is one of our family's go-to spots whenever we're at Central Rama 3. Located on the 5th floor, it's easily accessible. The atmosphere is bright and comfortable, with sofa seating perfect for relaxing – ideal for family meals.

The menu offers a wide variety of choices for both children and adults. The kids love the calamari, garlic bread, and fruit smoothies, while the adults always order the Tom Yum Seafood Spaghetti, Smoked Salmon Cream Cheese Pizza, and Salmon Rice. Everything is delicious; the chef's cooking is consistently excellent – ​​it's always the same great taste.

The service is fast, polite, and attentive, making every visit a memorable experience.

In short: If you're looking for a restaurant with delicious food, a great atmosphere, and suitable for all ages, especially for a special family meal, this is the place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pokchat Chaowalit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Terrible! If you're going to have a credit card promotion but the service isn't ready, this is awful. We got a table around 6:30 PM. We ordered three things: chicken breast salad, Hawaiian pizza, and salmon steak.
At 7:15 PM, we hadn't even received water, and we had to ask for it 2-3 times. The food we ordered arrived at 7:30 PM, one plate of chicken breast salad, but the plates, spoons, and forks didn't come. We had to ask for them. The table next to us, who arrived almost half an hour later, got their food first.
The front-of-house staff were very slow, and the kitchen was slow too. In the end, we only got the salad and asked for the bill. The staff were rude and abrupt. With this kind of service, they shouldn't be charging a service charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nanthida Vachiraprakarnsakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm extremely disappointed with this branch.

I ordered two dishes and neither was tasty. It's nothing like the other branches I've been to, which were much better.

Creamy Sauce Udon - Very few toppings, the portion was sparse. The onsen egg was overcooked and cracked. Even after informing the staff and getting a replacement, it was still unsatisfactory; the yolk was still overcooked and cracked. The shrimp roe was barely visible. The salmon roe was acceptable.

Salmon Roll - The rice was very soggy and not firm, and the filling was very sparse.

The quality and quality are far below standard.

I'm very disappointed and will not be going back. I wouldn't recommend it to anyone either.
sample_reviews_en.author: Billy Than

sample_reviews_en.text: I was so angry! I hadn't even finished eating when the staff were rushing to mop the floor and get ready to close. There was no sign warning us to be careful because the floor was slippery, and we didn't know. The staff also overcharged me. I just stared at them and hurried over to tell them they'd made a mistake. In short, I slipped and got hurt all over. The floor was so slippery, I could barely walk. If this had happened to an elderly person, like my mother, how would you take responsibility? Please answer.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชาลิสา ภู่เกลี๊ยะ

sample_reviews_en.text:
There's currently a promotion for sets for 699 baht or 999 baht.
Today, I ordered the small set, which was delicious and up to standard on-the-table.
But I also ordered extra garlic clams.
When I checked my order, I heard...
I waited for more than 10 minutes. I initially told my son that the baked menu would take longer. 😅 But in the end, I didn't write it down.
sample_reviews_en.author: Huala Lullaby

sample_reviews_en.text:
- I waited for my order from 7:30 PM to 8:00 PM and still haven't received my food, even though there were only a few orders and people who came after me had all received their food.
- They mixed vegetarian and meat items with the meat dishes.
- The staff didn't notice that there was a problem with the order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noppa Udom

sample_reviews_en.text: Yesterday I ate at the Ari branch and the staff were lovely, attentive, and enthusiastic. Today I brought my family to this branch and the staff there lacked enthusiasm, didn't smile, and provided service that was just going through the motions. It was very disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oatty Kanjana

sample_reviews_en.text: Giving it another chance. I actually like the food, but I was disappointed with the service before to the point where I almost didn't eat there. But I came back because I wanted to eat pizza. The staff were more attentive, and the menu looked as delicious as ever.
sample_reviews_en.author: petchpailin pongboriboon

restaurants.name: 64 Restaurant (Sixty Four Restaurant)
restaurants.address:

57/1 Soi Sukhumvit 64, Phra Khanong Tai, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
64 times better than I anticipated:
Read reviews ,but arrived not expecting them to live up to my expectations.
Located a short walk from the BTS,very easy to find.
Walked inside and immediately felt  a lovely laid back feel  surrounded by a lovely decor.
The restaurant does many different types of food  ,but I had Schnitzel on my mind so I went with that, with fried potatoes  and   a salad.Salad arrived first I was really hungry and nibbled I could immediately tell how fresh and crunchy the salad was,as my Schnitzel and potatoes arrived ,nearly immediately after I can honestly say its the best schnitzel I have ever had & the potatoes were so fresh and tasty also.,I ate the whole dinner very quickly as it was so good.
I met the host /owner and you sense his passion and pride in the restaurant and its food.
Would highly recommend & I look forward to returning and trying another one of the delicious gravies ,and or other dishes...
Michael Australia
sample_reviews_en.author: M I

sample_reviews_en.text: This German restaurant is located inside Hafele Design Studio. Who would have thought something like this existed? It's not fancy, but it's nice, clean, spacious, and has a great atmosphere. We arrived after 7 PM, and there were only 5 tables occupied – spacious and comfortable, not noisy, with soft background music. We ordered Schnitzel (pork schnitzel with mushroom sauce) – the pork was tender, lightly breaded, and slightly crispy; the sauce was rich but not salty, very fragrant and delicious. The salmon salad was flavorful and tasty, served with a side of green salad. They have bottled German beers – 5 brands lined up on the counter – we ordered 3 bottles and they were all delicious; a great selection. The staff were attentive and polite. Parking in front of the restaurant is very convenient. This has become one of our must-visit spots!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongpan Pornprommin

sample_reviews_en.text: I received a recommendation for this restaurant. However, the experience was far from satisfactory. To begin with, we were greeted with the words: "We're closing in 5 minutes, do you even want to stay?" Commercial electronic music was blaring from a speaker in the corner, completely out of place with the interior and the food. The salad was fresh, but prepared with absolutely no care and far too little dressing. The currywurst was average or even below average compared to other German restaurants in Bangkok. The fries were okay, and the sauce was also okay. The sausage wasn't properly cooked and was rather bland. On top of that, we were attacked by 3-5 mosquitoes every 20 seconds or so, which was incredibly annoying. A real shame. We wish them continued success.
sample_reviews_en.author: siggi spaleck

sample_reviews_en.text: We had a private company party. The food was delicious, as always, even though it was a buffet this time. However, I was annoyed by the single staff member at the counter who seemed unwilling to serve and had a grumpy expression the whole time. When I tried to order additional pizza from the buffet (because I'd told my friends the pizza was delicious), they said it wasn't possible because it was a buffet and they didn't have anyone to make it. Seeing my displeasure, they later said it was possible to order. Then, a little later, when someone else tried to order more, they said they only had 4 pizzas left. But then more kept coming! What's going on??? Ordering extra means paying extra, it's not a freebie from the buffet!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jedsada Supanchanaburee

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went to Peter's restaurant on Christmas Eve. We ordered a colorful mix of different dishes to share with our Thai friends. Peter is an excellent representative of German cuisine. All of the dishes we ordered were outstanding. In my opinion, the schnitzel and the pork knuckle were particularly noteworthy. If you're ever in Bangkok and craving German food, this is definitely the place to go. Besides the excellent German cuisine, Peter is a superb host. Very attentive, he came to our table, chatted with us, and always made sure his guests had everything they needed. It couldn't have been better.

Best regards to you, Peter, and Happy New Year!
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrick Keim

sample_reviews_en.text: I was disapointed in the food we had at this restaurant as it did not measure up to the reviews that I read online. It supposedly  serves German food, but there was something wrong with the seasoning and sauces. The schnitzels were bland, dry, and too thick; not as tasty as others that I have eaten. This restaurant is an extension of the Haefele Showroom. It looks nice, but has the atmosphere of a train station, not very warm and inviting. The restaurant staff were rather distracted, as they were quite busy serving workers from the Haefele Showroom their lunch. If you want to eat German food in Bangkok, there are better options available!
sample_reviews_en.author: John Kane

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place serves truly authentic German food – you can tell they’ve put a lot of care into the details of the taste and the authenticity of each dish. By far the best German food in town that I’ve tried. The service is excellent – super friendly and even willing to create dishes off the menu if you ask. The atmosphere is quiet and relaxed, making it perfect for a calm meal. I’ve been here more than 10 times already, and it never disappoints.

Also it’s really cheap! Impossible to find in other places.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mat

sample_reviews_en.text: I live across the street so I do go to this restaurant from time to time. The food is good, as is the service. I love Jaegerschnitzel and order it whenever I go. The last time I had it (one week ago) the hunter sauce was very poorly done, way too thin(watery)! To be honest, I won't be ordering it again. I will simply have a schnitzel with no sauce. I wish they could do a good Hunter sauce!
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul

restaurants.name: Have A Zeed Central Rama 9
restaurants.address:

Floor Room #717, Rama IX Road 9/8,9/9 Central Plaza Grand, Rama IX Soi 7, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Have A Zeed - Central Rama 9

A modern Thai restaurant with incredibly delicious food 😍 The atmosphere is clean and comfortable, perfect for family or friends outings.

My favorite dish was the stir-fried noodles with shrimp. The noodles were fragrant from the wok, the shrimp was fresh and plump, and the flavor was perfectly balanced 🍤 The papaya salad was also perfectly spicy, with a balanced sweet, sour, and spicy taste 🌶️🥗

Another dish that exceeded expectations was the mushroom soup. The broth was fragrant and refreshing when sipped hot 🍄 And the fried pork neck was amazing – crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, and paired perfectly with the side dishes 🤍

The food came out quickly, the staff provided good service, and the prices were reasonable for the quality. This is definitely a restaurant I'd revisit repeatedly ✨

#HaveAZeed
#DeliciousRestaurantRama9
#ThaiFusionFood
#CentralRama9
#RestaurantReview
sample_reviews_en.author: สาธิต ฟองจัน

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service and ambiance were excellent, but the air conditioning was too strong, so the food cooled down quickly and became unappetizing, which was a shame.

🚫The curry crab meat🦀 was very oily and cooled down quickly, becoming quite greasy after a few bites.

⭕️The most satisfying dish was the 🥩Garlic Beef Fried Rice, which was delicious! A small bowl of spicy and sour sauce was provided, making it tasty whether you poured it on or not.

❌The raw marinated salmon consisted of only a few slices, and the seasoning didn't suit my taste; it would have been better eaten raw with soy sauce🥲.

❌The ice in the Thai tea was made from frozen Thai tea leaves; I didn't ask about the sweetness level, and it was way too sweet for me...

There is a service charge, which will be included in the final bill.
sample_reviews_en.author: suzy

sample_reviews_en.text:
Have A Zeed at Central Rama 9 is a fantastic modern Isan restaurant.
The menu is very diverse, from spicy salads to fried dishes and great side plates.
Every dish looks beautifully presented and incredibly appetizing.
The flavors are bold, authentic, and truly capture the essence of Northeastern Thai cuisine.
I especially loved how traditional dishes are given a premium twist.
The atmosphere is cozy and stylish, perfect for dining with friends or family.
Service is friendly and attentive, making the experience even better.
Portions are generous and worth the price.
Everything tastes fresh and well-prepared.
Highly recommended for anyone who loves Thai food with a modern flair!
#HaveAZeed #CentralRama9 #ThaiFoodLovers #IsanCuisine #MustTry
sample_reviews_en.author: Attakorn su ku m

sample_reviews_en.text:
Have a zeed! A restaurant where you can't go wrong with any dish you order!

✅ Thai Corn and Coconut Salad 💰120 For those who like sweet and sour flavors, order this cold dish.

✅ Fried Chicken 💰120

✅ Sizzling Oysters 💰230 The scrambled eggs are very good, highly recommended!

✅ Pineapple Fried Rice 💰300 Super delicious!

✅ Spicy Stir-fried Pork and Tofu Rice Bowl 💰180

📍Address: Floor Room #717, Rama IX Road 9/8, 9/9 Central Plaza Grand, Rama IX Soi 7, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

⏰Hours:
Monday-Sunday 11:00 AM - 10:00 PM

🅿️Indoor Parking
sample_reviews_en.author: Le Le

sample_reviews_en.text: VERY SPICY. Came with a group. Had the pineapple fried rice, pad kaprao, Tom yum, glass noodle salad with pork, pork bone soup, stir fried vegetables with garlic. and pork tendon soup. Only the vegetables and fried rice weren't extremely spicy, even compared to other Thai places in Bangkok and around Ao Nang. Multiple members of our group had stomach pain from the spice level. Tasted good though. Recommend getting the coconut juice to cut the spice. There are pharmacies in the mall selling gaviscon of you need it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jonathan Kim

sample_reviews_en.text:
A nice place to eat thai food. They have plenty of varieties & known for their spicy dishes. But they can also adjust the level of spiciness upon request. And for groups, they also have set menu with discounts on drinks.
This time, opted for tom yum goong, stir fry morning glory, chicken larb & fried sea bass with fish sauce & green mango dip. Overall the food are done nicely & the portion is suitable for sharing.
Service is always quick here as well which is always a plus point.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maharani

sample_reviews_en.text: Very bad experience. I suggest staying away from this place. The papaya salad was extremely sweet, and the sticky rice had no flavor. The Pad Thai with shrimp was also overly sweet and smelled terrible—probably because the oil was bad. The shrimp in the Pad Thai wasn’t cooked properly and was still raw. Even after I asked them to cook it more, they just brought it back after one or two minutes. A total waste of money. Very bad experience overall. Service was friendly
sample_reviews_en.author: J.S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Have A Zeed at Central Rama 9 is a Thai restaurant with incredibly flavorful and well-seasoned dishes. Their Pad Thai, noodles, and desserts like mango sticky rice are all delicious. The ingredients are fresh, the presentation is beautiful, and the atmosphere is comfortable, perfect for dining with friends or family. The staff provides excellent and fast service. Highly recommended! 👍

#HaveAZeed
#DeliciousThaiFood
#CentralRama9
#MangoStickyRice
#AmazingPadThai
sample_reviews_en.author: อรณภา

restaurants.name: The Charm Tree Steak and more
restaurants.address:

48, Bang Bon 3 Soi 12, Lak Song, Bang Khae, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've passed by this place many times before finally stopping by. Once I did, I regretted not discovering it sooner! 😂
The restaurant has parking for about 15-20 cars. There are both indoor and outdoor seating areas. It was quite busy the day I went, but the wait wasn't long, about 15-20 minutes, and all the food arrived.
-Spaghetti with dried chili and seafood: Just the right amount of spiciness. The shrimp, squid, and mussels were all firm and bouncy. The pasta was well-cooked, not too hard.
-Pork neck: I really liked this one. It was very tender and flavorful, like it had been marinated. The black pepper sauce was salty with a hint of sweetness, just right and not too greasy.
-Stir-fried pork with basil: This is considered one of the best stir-fried pork dishes in a steak restaurant like this. The pork was tender, and the seasoning was better than many other stir-fried pork dishes I've tried.
Overall, it's a restaurant with a nice atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Witthaya Chansomboon

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is about my 5th visit. Today I tried ordering something different, but it was too salty. My throat felt dry afterwards. I ordered a duck leg (I can't remember the name, but I really liked how tender the duck meat was). The mushroom soup (my dad ordered) was also salty. It's a shame.

This was my 2nd visit. The atmosphere is great, the staff are lovely, and the food is delicious. The lamb steak had a slight gamey smell, but it was tender and tasty. The pork steak was also tender and delicious. The mushroom soup was huge! The pumpkin soup was thick, with a bit of a pumpkin curry feel. I wasn't a big fan, but my mom loved it. I personally prefer the spinach soup. The chicken with mashed potato sauce was unfortunately spicy. I wish they would mention that on the menu, especially for children. But it was delicious; the chicken was very tender. The grass jelly with milk was also good, not too sweet. I'll definitely try other dishes next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Labyula Berlina

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've listened to feedback from many riders waiting for food in front of the restaurant.
1. The food takes a very long time to arrive; I don't know what the kitchen management system is like. Riders wait for orders for at least 30-40 minutes each. It's a very long wait.
2. Riders arrive and the orders have been in place for a long time, but when customers come into the restaurant and order food, the riders see that the customers have already received their food, while they still haven't received theirs.
This is feedback from fellow riders.
sample_reviews_en.author: บวรวิชญ์ ต้นลําภู

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, and the staff are lovely and try their best to serve customers. However, I was really disappointed with the food service today. I don't know what the kitchen management system was like, but dishes were being served out of order, even though our table arrived first. We waited so long that we had to cancel some dishes that hadn't arrived yet, which really ruined the dining experience. I hope the restaurant can improve its management to make things smoother in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supaporn

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered pork and sea bass. I was particularly impressed with the dishes that had cheese, such as the spaghetti carbonara, baked spinach with cheese, and garlic bread with cheese. The soft-shell crab salad and the Japanese black sesame soup were perfect for cutting through the richness. The restaurant has parking and a ramp, which is helpful for my mother who uses a cane to walk.
sample_reviews_en.author: Catthy Rut

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant offers a wide variety of Thai and Western dishes at very reasonable prices; in fact, it's quite cheap. The quality is good for the price. I especially like the menu variety. The restaurant is comfortable, air-conditioned, and the staff are attentive. There's a very large parking lot, which is convenient. I highly recommend it to anyone in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brûlée

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! I go there regularly. I like the Caesar salad, pork steak, truffle risotto, and all the spaghetti dishes are delicious. If you like spicy food, I recommend the drunken noodles, red sauce spaghetti, and carbonara – they're all great!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pankanok Tiptaweecharn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent steak quality. I recommend the Ribeye steak and their mash potatoes.
The atmosphere is superb with a big tree behind their restaurant and quiet surrounding.
Might be a bit difficult to get to as it is quite deep inside from the main road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thach Trakarnwichit

restaurants.name: Baan Jiam บ้านยายเจียม (Coffee bar & Breakfast)
restaurants.address:

97 Trok, Watratchanadda, Wat Bowon Niwet, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
BEWARE!
Two of us went because of the great review rating of this place. I cannot figure out how they have these reviews. We went when it was not very busy. We waited 45min for the first plate and the eggs were burn to a crisp (black) on the bottom. The person with me continued to wait over one hour when we decided we are no longer waiting. They never acknowledged the wait time until we said we were leaving. To wait that long and then have burnt food is what lead me to this review. We were not offered a discount or a remedy to the situation. I would suggest not going here even though the environment looks nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jarrod

sample_reviews_en.text: This morning, after visiting Wat Ratchanadda, I walked past Baan Jiam and decided to go in. To my surprise, there were two cats waiting to greet customers and even leading them in! Inside, there were already four tables of foreign customers enjoying coffee. The atmosphere was lovely. I ordered coffee and breakfast, and I wasn't disappointed. The coffee was strong and delicious, and the pan-fried eggs and croissant were tasty. If you're passing by the Bangkok City Hall area or strolling around, I highly recommend checking out this cafe.
sample_reviews_en.author: นพัสศัย โพล้งจั่น

sample_reviews_en.text: The cats provided excellent service and were very cute. The staff were kind and lovely. The drinks were delicious, and the cakes were also tasty. The prices weren't too expensive. It's a cozy, homey cafe with a great mood and tone, and there are many photo opportunities.
sample_reviews_en.author: Juthamanee Sukolphanit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Half the fun is trying to find this eatery in the small alleys.  Expect a simple but delicious breakfast experience surrounded by plants in an small structure packed with character (and friendly service).
Mind your head if you are tall, like I am...
sample_reviews_en.author: Nat Webb

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice place in terms of looks, but it took an hour for the food to arrive. Only when serving did they mention that three ingredients (including the sausage and the salad) were out of stock. They resolved this by providing extra avocado and …
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom

sample_reviews_en.text: I can't comment on the rooms because it's a café. We loved it; the avocado toast was delicious, the coffee exceptional... we went back twice. Highly recommended, and it's also a very peaceful place, although you do need to take your time.
sample_reviews_en.author: rosa cruz

sample_reviews_en.text: A charming place. A small, homely, and charming cafe in an old wooden house in a small, picturesque alley. Delicious food, excellent coffee, and jazz music in the background. A getaway from the hustle and bustle of the city. A delight.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hannah Simkin

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, quiet and peaceful. The drinks are delicious. The entrance is through a small alley, giving it a truly local community feel. It's fun to discover, and it's not overly crowded with tourists.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wannarit Pongprayoon

restaurants.name: FEI JI Chicken Rice (เฟ๋ยจี ข้าวมันไก่สไตล์สิงคโปร์)
restaurants.address:

139 Bang Ramat Rd, Bang Ramat, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I received Hainanese chicken rice as a gift from a colleague. The box was very fancy. Inside, there was one box of rice, one box of boiled chicken for one person, one ginger dipping sauce, one sweet soy sauce dipping sauce, two spicy dipping sauces, a small portion of pumpkin soup, and one serving of chicken gravy.
- The rice was perfect for those who prefer non-soggy rice. It was fragrant rice, cooked with separate grains. The rice itself had a slightly garlicky fried rice flavor. I personally loved it because I don't like soggy, oily rice.
- The boiled chicken was the best! Very tender, made from the thigh. It was soft but thoroughly cooked, with no red parts. It paired well with the gravy.
- My favorite dipping sauce was the spicy one. It was sweet and sour. Adding a little of the ginger dipping sauce made it even better. It wasn't very spicy, or even spicy at all, which is why I usually can't eat spicy food.
- The pumpkin soup was a bit small compared to the amount of chicken and rice.
But overall, I was impressed. I don't know about the service or price because it was free.
sample_reviews_en.author: methinee chasombat

sample_reviews_en.text:
FEI JI Chicken Rice (Fei Ji Singaporean Chicken Rice)
This Singaporean-style chicken rice restaurant in Bangkok serves incredibly delicious chicken. The chicken is high-quality, tender, juicy, and not dry. The gravy is tasty, and the dipping sauces are good. The liver is also delicious.
Convenient parking is available. The restaurant is newly renovated, clean, and looks nice. There weren't many customers. Chicken rice sets are available in S (for one person), M (for two people), and L (for four people). Blood sausage and boiled liver are sold separately. There are three types of chicken: boiled, fried, and grilled. For boiled chicken, there are three dipping sauces: dark soy sauce, sweet sauce, and sour soy sauce. For fried chicken, there is a spicy dipping sauce. For grilled chicken, there is a spicy dipping sauce. The rice is soft, delicious, and beautifully presented.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pim lada

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the most mushy Singaporean Hainanese chicken rice I've ever had.
The restaurant also serves Thai Hainanese chicken rice, and I was told that the Singaporean and Thai chicken are the same type, the only difference being that for 20 baht you get a sesame oil-based gravy and a chili dipping sauce.
The chicken liver was very ordinary; it was already served with the gravy, so there was no extra charge. The liver wasn't firm or bouncy, and the connective tissue and blood vessels weren't completely removed.
The rice was dry, not oily, and not fragrant.
The soup was almost tasteless; you could tell because the pumpkin didn't absorb any flavor at all.
But the restaurant is nice.
However, the tables were wobbly, making the meal unpleasant.
Takeaway containers cost 10 baht each.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanathnun Pongroj

sample_reviews_en.text: This Hainanese chicken rice restaurant, originally a takeaway business since the COVID-19 pandemic, opened a dine-in counter earlier this year. Parking is convenient, and the newly renovated restaurant is clean and looks good. It's not very busy. They offer chicken rice sets: S for one person, M for two people, and L for four people. Boiled blood and liver are sold separately. There are three types of chicken: boiled, fried, and grilled. For boiled chicken, there are three dipping sauces: dark soy sauce, sweet sauce, and sour soy sauce. For fried chicken, there's a spicy dipping sauce. For grilled chicken, the rice is perfectly cooked. All the food is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: พร้อมพูล ชอบเพื่อน

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've driven past this place many times.
At first, I thought it was a cafe.
Who would have thought it was a Hainanese chicken rice restaurant?
So today I decided to stop by and try it.
The Hainanese chicken rice was incredibly delicious.
Truly Singaporean style. The boiled chicken was very tender.
The grilled chicken was also fragrant with lemongrass.
The atmosphere was fantastic.
Honestly, you could even come here for a date.
The only downside is that the restaurant closes very early. Open from 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM. Guaranteed delicious taste.
The atmosphere is superb. Plenty of parking, no need to fight for a spot.
sample_reviews_en.author: PuEnGBeLL KanWat

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Hainanese chicken rice is among the best. The chicken is tender, bouncy, and juicy, with a delicate flavor from the sesame oil – not overly salty, it perfectly complements the chicken. The dipping sauces are varied and comprehensive, unlike Singapore's which doesn't offer separate grated ginger, but the chili sauce is also delicious. I recommend eating in moderation and going often; eating until you're full might get a little cloying due to the chicken's tenderness.

They also have fried and grilled chicken, but if you're going with a small group, stick to the boiled chicken to save room in your stomach :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Wacharapol Nitheranont

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything was perfect! This Singaporean-style Hainanese chicken rice restaurant has incredibly tender chicken. I ordered the S-sized set for one person, and it was just the right amount to fill me up for 139 baht. The set comes with three types of dipping sauces. I personally liked the orange-colored sauce the most; it's slightly sour and spicy, and tastes amazing with the chicken. The sauce poured over the chicken was also generous and flavorful. Excellent!
The restaurant is clean, well-decorated, and beautifully decorated. The air conditioning is comfortably cool, and there's ample parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: S. J. (HOOG)

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best Singaporean-style chicken rice restaurants in Bangkok. The chicken is tender, juicy, and never dry. The sauce is flavorful, and the dipping sauce is decent. The liver is tasty, but served cold; personally, I think it would be even better warm. What I liked most is that there's no need for reservations or long queues like at some other restaurants. The restaurant is comfortable, there's plenty of parking, and the staff provides good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bestlingchan

restaurants.name: Up2u Restaurant ร้านอาหาร อัพทูยู
restaurants.address:

103 Charoen Rat Rd, Bang Khlo, Bangkolaem Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious Food, Excellent Service in Charoen Rat

If you're looking for a restaurant with a great atmosphere, delicious food, and excellent service in the Charoen Rat area, Up2U is a must-try!

⭐ Food Taste – Every dish we tried was delicious, especially the traditional glass noodle salad, which had a perfectly balanced sweet, sour, spicy, and fragrant Thai dressing.

🚗 Parking – Spacious and convenient, no need to waste time searching for a parking spot.

😊 Service – The staff were lovely, attentive, and provided excellent service.

✅ Value for Money – High-quality food with great taste, a wonderful atmosphere, and excellent service. Definitely worth a visit!

📌 Conclusion: This is a restaurant I highly recommend everyone try. You'll definitely want to come back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mo J.

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small, family-run restaurant.
Ordering from the recommended menu, the food tasted great and arrived quickly. The drinking water was also delicious. The recommended dishes are pictured. The rice is jasmine rice, 30 baht per plate, perfectly cooked – not soggy, with beautiful, separate grains.
Prices are moderate, not too expensive, but the food prices do not include 7% VAT.
Other menu items can be inquired about from the main menu or ordered.
The restaurant has two floors, with the upper floor available for private functions.
The staff are lovely, attentive, helpful, and always smiling.
There is free parking.
For two people, the bill came to approximately 500-600 baht per person.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploiieas As

sample_reviews_en.text: Up2U is a hidden gastronomic jewel. I came across it while searching for a restaurant after the hotel receptionist sent me "7/11"! The name caught my attention, and after reading recent reviews and seeing some photos, I knew this was the place to eat. Upon entering Ta and Nay greeted me with much enthusiasm that I immediately felt at home. I tried the Tom yum sek, which is a bit spicy with three different kinds of chillies. I also had the salt crusted snapper and a slat crusted snapper. I paired it with a butterfly pea and lemon beverage. I couldn't eat the dessert, because I was very satisfied. I did, however, drink a lemon and honey tea which hit the spot right on😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Hector HUERTA

sample_reviews_en.text: This small restaurant may be small, but the flavors are extraordinary. The stir-fried noodles with water spinach and shrimp were delicious, with plump, firm shrimp. The glass noodle salad was beautifully colorful and very tasty. The winged bean salad had perfectly thinly sliced ​​winged beans that weren't bitter at all, and the shrimp were of excellent quality and firm. I especially loved the fried corn (the name might not be exactly as listed on the menu), it was incredibly addictive. I actually ate many more dishes but forgot to take pictures. The staff were lovely, polite, and super friendly. 🙂
sample_reviews_en.author: A V

sample_reviews_en.text: I found this place by chance on Google Maps and wanted to try a 5-star restaurant. I ordered rice noodles with crab curry, rice, tom yum fish soup, crab omelet, fried chives, hot tea, and finished with sour orange juice. Honestly, I couldn't find anything to criticize. All the ingredients were fresh and presented meticulously. As seen in previous reviews, the atmosphere was warm and inviting, and everyone received excellent care. I give it 6 stars. (Apologies that no one took the time to take photos.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Kiatiyut Tiansuwan

sample_reviews_en.text: Choosing this restaurant to celebrate my friend's wedding was definitely the right decision. The food was delicious! We ordered over 10 dishes, but I didn't take any pictures because everything looked so appetizing. Everyone started eating as soon as the food arrived, so I didn't have time to take photos! The owner and staff were kind, attentive, and provided excellent service. The venue is suitable for small group parties, has a nice and private atmosphere, and plenty of parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthamon Prakaiboonthawee

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here after seeing a 5-star review. It was lunchtime on a weekday and there wasn't much people, I'm not sure if it had just opened. The staff provided good service, but the food was just average in taste, and the prices were typical city prices. I ordered based on a recommendation for crab curry noodles, but they said they were out of crab and substituted chicken instead, yet charged me the same price as the crab curry noodles 😵
sample_reviews_en.author: Pearl At.N

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, flavorful, and very much to my liking.
The service was good, and they offered menu recommendations (if you can't decide what to eat).

The stir-fried cabbage with fish sauce was crispy, fragrant, and very tasty.
The spicy pork rib soup was flavorful and lived up to its name.
The sour and crispy fried shallots were refreshing, and the combination of various toppings was excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yaowalak Pronpipat

restaurants.name: Dum Handi Biryani -Opposite Holiday Inn
restaurants.address:

No 6 Sukhumvit Alley 22, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We came here with high expectations but disappointed by the taste. They are also charging extra 10% on top of VAT which I have never seen in any other restaurant in Thailand. They are scamming people plus its not worth the price you pay here. Regarding the service charges its written almost hidden at the end of the menu in a very small format
sample_reviews_en.author: Alqama Bin Sadiq

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pathetic food ! Chicken was chewy. Had to get it changed but came out to be more pathetic
Dont visit this place, as they dont care even if you like the food or not
Asked them to call the chef but they said he went to sleep and cant come !
Had to leave the food and go back hungry at 4:00 am in morning
Pathetic experience!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: tushar lather

sample_reviews_en.text: It was amazing. We had the hydrebadi biryani as well as Kathi roll which gave us a flavor of infia away from India. Highly recommend it to anyone who's missing biryani or wants to have it for the first time! What they've written on their menu is true- they make the biryani they dont heat it like other restaurants
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakhi Chaturvedi

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious biryani and perfect size for 2 people. The spices are just right. For biryani, must wait around 30 min for cooking. Surprising to see many biryani options from various region. Appetizer was outstanding as well. Good service and they have multiple locations.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prakit

sample_reviews_en.text: I been to this restaurant. And this restaurant smells so badly then we left from there. And it was strongly bad smell coming and restaurant hygiene is quite poor. They didn't maintain properly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaber Salam

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Paneer 65 was amazing!!! We would certainly recommend this to all.
The vegetarian Hyderabadi Biryani was absolutely delicious!!! Freshly made to perfection!!! Wonderful experience!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bhavini Amalsadia

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food is not good
I order aloo kulcha but one time coming hear ana one full raw aur kerla paratha very bed this not kerla paratha very hard, not good chanal masala
sample_reviews_en.author: SURYA GUSAIN

sample_reviews_en.text: If you wanna have authentic Indian food come to Dum Handi Biryani. Fresh chicken, Good Ambience and most important taste of India. Also it’s Halal.
sample_reviews_en.author: HUSSAIN RAJ

restaurants.name: Bangkok Grill (Sathon 11)
restaurants.address:

294 296 ซอย จันทน์ 18/7 Thung Wat Don, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Bangkok Grill 🥩🍽️

📍 Local Thai Steakhouse

🍗 Chicken: Very flavorful, but a bit too salty.

🥩 Pork Chop: The meat quality was okay, but a little difficult to cut.

🍄 Mushroom Soup: Average.

🧅 Onion Rings: Not worth ordering.

💰 Prices are a bit higher than typical steakhouses.

🤔 However, the overall quality is similar to other steakhouses, nothing particularly outstanding.

👍 If you happen to be nearby and craving steak, consider giving it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: 小威（LP）

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is still as delicious as ever; I've been eating there since the restaurant first opened. But lately, every time I go, I see a group of elderly people playing cards and drinking in the restaurant, usually at the table near the cashier. It's really annoying. It happens every evening. It's just too much to go out for dinner with my family and have to deal with a group of drunkards playing cards.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supisara Cswl

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the portions are generous, and the prices are reasonable, comparable to those in a shopping mall. It's perfect for a family meal. The atmosphere is relaxed and not crowded. There are large TV screens on the left and right walls. There's outdoor seating as well as air-conditioned indoor seating. Parking is available in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Walmanee

sample_reviews_en.text: Letting people sit outside drinking beer and smoking isn't so bad, but the door keeps opening and closing, letting the cigarette smoke into the shop and bothering me the whole time I'm sitting here. At first, I tolerated it, thinking they'd stop. But the worst part is, the staff went and bowed to the people smoking. Okay, I'll go do it myself then.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kiri Mongkonlaksanakun

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is clean, and they have a good variety of dishes on the menu. The food tastes great, and the prices are very reasonable. We ordered mackerel rice to take home, and the restaurant packaged it very well. It was still delicious when we got home. The staff were polite even on the phone. We were very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tarat Pasuthasatit

sample_reviews_en.text: We only liked the soup; the pork chop was just okay, and the mashed potatoes were average. The good thing is the generous portions and free parking for 1 hour (for orders over 300 baht). The staff were welcoming and took orders well, but the cashier charged the wrong table.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prapaporn K

sample_reviews_en.text:
The male waiter provided terrible service and spoke rudely. He really needs to improve. I brought my family of three to eat here.
Normally, the two times I've eaten here before, the female waiters were okay and polite.
sample_reviews_en.author: Worrawoot Kaeksa-ard

sample_reviews_en.text:
The green curry spaghetti was good. The spicy chicken was also delicious. The Vietnamese noodle soup was just okay, too salty. The food didn't take long to arrive.

(Family/local vibe. Casual.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Oh Vorapak

restaurants.name: Khao Kaeng Khun Ying
restaurants.address:

QFJX+XJ3, Ratchawithi Rd, Bang Yi Khan, Bang Phlat, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I usually look for restaurants like this.
There are always people eating there, and lots of taxis waiting. I've often found some really good places.

The food taste is standard.
They use mid-range ingredients, focusing on standard dishes and offering good value for money for the average person.
Dishes like basil chicken, fried catfish, fried pork belly, and spicy minced pork curry, etc.
The soups are also cut into small pieces, making them easy to drink.

The restaurant atmosphere is ordinary.

The service is also average.
It's the kind of place where you don't have high expectations, and you won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisby

sample_reviews_en.text: It's at the foot of the Sanghi Bridge, on the way out. Regarding parking, I saw people parked on the side of the road, but there might be traffic enforcement. The food tastes good. In my meal, I had 2 plates of rice with 2 toppings, 1 fried egg (the shop will arrange them on the food cabinet, if you want to eat, just grab it), 1 bowl of bitter melon soup, 4 bags of rice to take home, 1 cup of lightly sweetened iced black tea, the total price was 315 baht. I happened not to withdraw any cash, but the shop allows you to transfer money as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: charat thangwongchuket

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste of this Khao Kaeng restaurant is good. I had fried pork with green chicken curry over rice. Everything is ok and I would have given more star than 3 but they did not wear mask all times and the place need to clean up and taken care in cleaning. One big problem is that although there are many staffs but birds still can come into the end of the restaurant which seems to me that bird used to come in often.

The rice and curry shop at the foot of the Sanghi Bridge has a wide variety of dishes to choose from. It's always busy, but there's no need to wait for a table as the shop has ample seating. There's also a Siam Tea shop nearby where you can order drinks to eat in the shop and pay for your meal. The food tastes good and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitichote Pao

sample_reviews_en.text: It's been a while since I last visited. Parking on the street in front of the shop is usually full, but today I managed to find a spot. I ordered three dishes to take home: stir-fried green beans (a little too sweet) and panang curry (similarly, I wish they'd adjust the sweetness level).
sample_reviews_en.author: NHU Ying

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. I personally like the braised tofu in red sauce, bitter melon soup, and stir-fried pumpkin. The iced tea brewed by the auntie is also tasty. Parking is a bit difficult to find, but there's paid parking in a nearby alley, which is convenient and worry-free.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nalinee S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
What I like:
* Variety of food
* Freshly cooked
* Lots of seats (during no rush hour)
* Open early in the morning

What I dislike:
* No parking lots
Able to park on the roadside,
but very dangerous
* Quite closed to the bridge
Need to have skills to park
sample_reviews_en.author: Beam Pavini

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and meets the standard of Thai rice and curry. The ingredients are of good quality, there's a wide variety of dishes, the prices are affordable, and the portions are generous.
sample_reviews_en.author: apinun jindaniradool

restaurants.name: ตี๋เตี๋ยวยำ
restaurants.address:

929 Nawamin Rd, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The shop is clean, the noodles are delicious, and the price is very cheap at 50฿.

Ordering online is more expensive than eating in the shop. I rate this as one of the best shops in the Nawamin area. If you're passing through Nawamin, I recommend stopping by this shop.
sample_reviews_th.author: 22Thunwaa

sample_reviews_th.text: The Tom Yum noodle soup is delicious, only 50฿ per bowl, and the portion is generous. I highly recommend the fried pork with garlic rice; it's incredibly delicious! 💖💖
sample_reviews_th.author: Momo Thunchanok

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old favorite shop that I keep coming back to. Before, I used to eat dry noodles, but now I order the small dry noodles or the large Tom Yum noodles. I find the Tom Yum delicious, perfectly spicy, and reasonably priced. They give generous portions, leaving you feeling full. They're not fussy, just make sure you order clearly.
It was one of the first shops in this area to convert a house into a noodle shop about fourteen or fifteen years ago. I thought it wouldn't survive, but it's become a favorite of the housing estate residents, the locals, and even those further away via Grab delivery.
Today I had the large Tom Yum noodles with boiled meatballs. I was sweating profusely; it was a great way to work up a sweat. Afterwards, I went across the street to order an iced coffee.
sample_reviews_en.author: ตะนาว 419

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum Yen Ta Fo with pork was overflowing with ingredients (it seemed like there were more ingredients than noodles 😂). The soup was flavorful and hardly needed any extra seasoning. The service was fast and the price was friendly (50/60 baht). The restaurant has a high ceiling with water spray to cool it down during lunchtime, making the atmosphere not stuffy. It would be perfect if the person collecting the money (the owner?) smiled more. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Duke Dick

sample_reviews_en.text:
A bowl of noodles shouldn't take this long.
They're only concerned about delivery rider orders, while customers eating in the restaurant have to wait.
If they're going to be that concerned about rider orders, they shouldn't even bother selling in the restaurant; it's a waste of time.
It would be different if the wait was because the restaurant was crowded, but there were only 3 tables of customers in the whole place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jakkrit Kamsalai

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a very clean and delicious Tom Yum noodle shop. The flavor is perfect, no need to add anything extra. There's plenty of pork and other ingredients, it's easy to eat, and the thin noodles are chewy and delicious. The iced coffee is also tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Namfon Prasongdee

sample_reviews_en.text: The lady taking the orders made a displeased face and mouthed insults at the customers while they were ordering. If she doesn't want to take orders, she should find another job, because service work requires basic manners towards customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: NUS THI

sample_reviews_en.text:
Let's try the fried pork with garlic and pepper rice + fried egg.
The price is great, and you get a lot of rice, it's very filling.
The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, comfortable seating, and the other dishes are delicious too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Skookik S

restaurants.name: Khong Prasoet Crispy Pork
restaurants.address:

304-6 ซอย สุกร Thanon Mittaphap Thai - China, Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Roast pork and crispy pork rice is 50 baht. They give generous portions, and the sauce is delicious, well-balanced – not too sweet, not too salty, and not too watery. It's really good, I loved it! And the price is amazing, starting at 50 baht for everything.

Takeaway is 60 baht.

They have roast pork, crispy pork, chicken, Chinese sausage, and also sukiyaki (soup and dry), and braised goat. The sukiyaki comes without the dipping sauce – you add it yourself.

The food is served in paper plates with short spoons, giving you a nostalgic feeling of eating from a bowl as a child. I didn't mind the paper plates at all.

I came during lunchtime on a weekday, and there was no queue. The food came very quickly; I ordered and waited less than 3 minutes before it was ready. Perfect for hungry people! It's like sitting down and having the food placed in front of you right away.
sample_reviews_en.author: SunnyMiya

sample_reviews_en.text:
Try it once. If you don't like the taste, you don't have to order it again, but you should definitely try it.

I haven't eaten here in a long time because I didn't have a suitable friend to invite.
It's a restaurant that serves rice with roast pork, crispy pork, and chicken. The sauce is thick like typical roast pork rice, but I feel like they added curry powder, which makes the taste different.
The roast pork and crispy pork were just average, in my opinion.
But the chicken was very well-prepared.
And what impressed me the most was the braised lamb. It's a braised lamb in a red sauce that tastes great. It's refreshing and doesn't have a gamey smell. The lamb meat and tendons are very tender.

The atmosphere in the restaurant now consists of tables outside and they use paper bowls instead. I think it makes the atmosphere less inviting.

The service is standard.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisby

sample_reviews_en.text:
A bit hidden away from the busy streets of Chinatown, we found this little gem in a small alley.

The old lady serving us was super helpful with the menu and when we paid she even gave us extra small change while warning us from the local cab drivers.

The food itself was super cheap and very tasty. We tried the pork belly and some chicken. The dishes came literally right away, just after we ordered. The pork was very tender, but also had a beatifuly crisp skin. The gravy was delicious and the cilantro fresh. Before ordering, you can also take a look the variation of meats stored behind glass at the counter.

Of course, don't come here if you expect luxury seating. It's a place you want to go to eat like a local.
sample_reviews_en.author: sirtriplestarch

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic street food. Excellent crispy pork on rice (khao moo krob) with homemade sauce, dry stir-fried sukiyaki, and traditional goat soup. (Crispy pork on rice, dry sukiyaki, and traditional Chinese herbal goat soup - incredibly delicious!)

My uncle introduced me to this hidden gem decades ago, and it's still the best crispy pork in the area. The pork isn't too fatty and has a clean, fresh taste. The dry sukiyaki, which is stir-fried vegetables with chicken or seafood, and the goat soup make a great combination with the crispy pork on rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pong S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Khao Moo Krob Khong Prasert • Odeon Roundabout, opposite Wat Traimit
...
Pork rice with crispy pork and Chinese sausage for 60 baht per bowl. Generous portions of pork, rich gravy, and a touch of soy sauce and vinegar for a delicious balance of flavors.

Other menu items include sukiyaki (soup and dry versions) and chicken rice.

The owners, including the grandmother and staff, are kind and patient.

Parking: Seems like there's space for one car in front of the shop; otherwise, you'll have to park nearby or in Wat Traimit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oaddybeing B

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has the feel of a long-established establishment. The khao moo daeng (char siu rice) and khao moo kroep (fried pork noodles) are delicious. Although it was in Thai, the lady kindly explained the menu to me, saying, "These are popular with Japanese people." The food is impeccable, with the flavor of a long-established restaurant, but the plates (bowls) are made of paper, perhaps out of eco-consciousness, which is a bit dull. I wish they would serve the food on regular plates or bowls.
sample_reviews_en.author: THAI SANPO FUJII

sample_reviews_en.text:
Open in the morning, close in the afternoon. Delicious food, clear pricing. Long-established, authentic taste. You must try it! Don't be fooled by the charm, don't be fooled by what you hear. We recommend you try it yourself.

Delicious food without MSG, traditional flavor. You must try it. Come in the morning for an less crowded experience.

Cash only. No soup provided. (I repeat, NO soup!)

Want to try the lamb soup? Good for your health. Maybe next time.

I'll keep searching until I find it!
sample_reviews_en.author: 吴ViNa

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried the food based on reviews. The pork sukiyaki with egg broth was delicious, almost no need to add any extra seasoning. The glass noodles were good, the pork was a little dry but still tender. The dipping sauce was spicy. The mixed rice dish had a very fragrant sauce with a subtle curry powder aroma. Adding lime juice helped cut through the richness. Each dish was 60 baht, and the portion size was good value for the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Keratikorn P.

restaurants.name: Have A Zeed - Terminal 21 Rama 3
restaurants.address:

356 Terminal 21 Room SH1039 Floor, 1 Rama III Rd, Bang Khlo, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a great time and experience here before we go back to our home country. It is a must try if you are craving Thai food inside the mall. We love their Tom Yum. Its soup is creamy and has a lot of seafood in it. You can request a less spicy type (yes it is really less spicy). You can order a cup of plain rice, so it will be more delicious.

Their Pad Thai is also good, and the Thai milk tea was not that sweet which I really loved. Also, the milk tea blocked ice presentation looks creative and unique.

This is a really good value for money. The service was fast and they are also kind to handle our requests. I love the atmosphere because of its color and lighting. It looks modern.

Will definitely come back soon!
sample_reviews_en.author: Joyce Rine

sample_reviews_en.text:
Have a Zeed, located in Terminal 21 Mall in Bangkok, offers a delightful Thai culinary experience. During my visit, I ordered the Egg Fried Rice, Salmon with Thai Sweet Sauce, Steamed Rice Topped With Stir Fried Minced Pork With Basil leaves and Chilli, Pork Fried Sausage, and Mango Sticky Rice.

The mango sticky rice was simply amazing, perfectly balancing sweet and creamy textures. The fried rice and salmon were both great, with the Thai sweet sauce adding a delicious touch to the dish. However, the pork fried sausage was just average and didn't stand out compared to the other selections.

Have a Zeed is a worthwhile stop for anyone craving Thai flavors with some exceptional dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sheen Skaria

sample_reviews_en.text:
Feb 2026

Prob came at a super busy time as the menu was running out and had to wait for 15 mins to get a table.  Some dishes was not available.

The Wins
- grilled beef was hands down a winner here.  It is done just right, medium rare and quality of meat was on point

The "Ok" dishes
-  mixed veg with salted fish was decent.  Crunchy veg but just a tab too much salted fish making it a tab bit salty
-  Crab Thai curry.  Was expecting better.  Its ok, not a total fail.  Lek's Seafood near Chong Nonsi BTS still tops this.

For restaurant in a mall setting, this still ranks a win.
sample_reviews_en.author: SY Ng

sample_reviews_en.text: Been here multiple times whenever I'm in Bangkok. Food here is excellent. If you cannot take the local level of spicy, you can just mention it to them and they will adjust the level. Dishes I often come back for are the pineapple fried rice, river prawn (either with glass noodle or just with fried garlic), grilled pork neck and Tom yum. To me they serve good, clean and awesome tasting food at a reasonable price. Do come earlier if you have groups 5 and above otherwise you might have a queue for quite a bit especially on weekends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alvin Tang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Must try place… was in Q for about 30min before get our seat, was systematic with Q no.

They will take your order in advance when closer to the Q.

Food was served hot and fresh, the price was reasonable with the portions served, services was good and there are many staff walking around to attend to you if you need service

Seating arrangement was closed to next table if you prefer spacious this is not the place.

The only comments the food serving was a little slow even after order taking
sample_reviews_en.author: ben (Boboramen)

sample_reviews_en.text: We went to the branch of Have A Zeed in Terminal 21. A very busy place with many customers in Q. The queue system was very efficient. The restaurant is well decorated and clean. Serving staff were very polite and attentive.The food served was very delicious. Best dishes were yellow curry crab and river prawn with garlic and chilli. However, the drinks were pretty awful, worst being the Thai Milk Tea. I will definitely come back again for the delicious food (but no ordering drinks!).
sample_reviews_en.author: Ritz Bitz

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is really good. I have been there about 5 times. I like the food but I have no idea why they want the customers go back right away after the bill payment. Every time I have the same experience and that makes me annoyed. They even don’t care the customer face expression, the attitude there is “you already paid and then you go”. Do we need to keep the payment without paying if we wanna sit more? I’m confused and that makes me to concern to go there next time as always……
sample_reviews_en.author: AH K

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re in Bangkok and craving authentic Thai food, this place is a must-visit!

As someone from Singapore, I’ve had my fair share of great food, but the dishes here are truly exceptional.

The flavors are bold, authentic, and absolutely delicious.

I was so impressed with the beef steak that I ordered it twice—it was cooked to perfection!

If you’re from Singapore, or anywhere for that matter, I highly recommend making a stop here. You won’t be disappointed!”
sample_reviews_en.author: Alvan 秉德

restaurants.name: Chon Thai Restaurant
restaurants.address:

The Siam 3, 2 Khao, Vachirapayabal, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely incredible.

The food is delicious. My boyfriend and I wanted to try traditional Thai food, and our experience was definitely excellent.
The service is spectacular. Grace served us, and we want to emphasize that she made our experience a thousand times better. My boyfriend is allergic to shellfish, and there are many things he can't eat. Grace was very patient and made sure that everything we ordered was shellfish-free. She also recommended dishes that were amazing. (The grapefruit salad is simply divine.)
We felt the prices were totally reasonable considering the location and service the restaurant offers. It's totally worth it.

The place is beautiful. We were lucky enough to be the only ones in the restaurant since we arrived a bit late, and they close at 10:30. It has a magical vibe because the restaurant is right on a river.
In short, if you want to have an excellent Thai food experience, this is the perfect place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dhamar Girón Pérez

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dining at Chon Thai Restaurant felt like discovering a quieter, more elegant side of Bangkok. Located inside The Siam Hotel along the Chao Phraya River, the atmosphere was absolutely beautiful — especially during sunset when the river slowly reflected the evening lights.

What I loved most was how peaceful and refined the experience felt. The heritage-style architecture, candlelight, and riverside setting created a truly romantic atmosphere that made the entire dinner feel special. It is the kind of place where you naturally slow down and enjoy the moment.

The menu focuses on authentic Thai cuisine presented in a refined way, and I also appreciated that they offer vegetarian options as well. Service throughout the evening was warm, attentive, and very polished.

A wonderful choice for date nights, anniversaries, or anyone looking to experience Thai dining in one of the most beautiful riverside settings in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: RattoWanderlust

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best Thai restaurants in Bangkok with a great atmosphere and view, "Chon," the Thai restaurant located in The Siam Hotel, is housed in a century-old traditional Thai house situated on the banks of the Chao Phraya River, surrounded by lush greenery. Semi-outdoor seating allows you to enjoy the cool breeze and close-up views of the Chao Phraya River, making for a relaxing dining experience, especially during sunset.

The restaurant serves authentic Thai cuisine with a wide variety of dishes, all with rich and well-balanced flavors—not overly spicy. Here are some of the dishes we tried:
1. Stir-fried Snowfish with Chili Paste (950 THB)
2. Grilled Pork Neck (690 THB)
3. Fried Duck Salad (490 THB)
4. Squid in Black Ink Sauce (590 THB)
5. Crab Curry with Betel Leaves (950 THB)
6. Mixed Coconut Ice Cream (300 THB)
7. Traditional Ice Cream (350 THB)
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarat Traipiyavong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Probably the best Thai restaurant on the river, with a great view and excellent food.

Somewhat hidden in a quiet, non-descript street in the Dusir destrict.

Located on the Chao Phraya river, this restaurant is part of The Siam hotel.  One of the quieter, reclusive very high end hotels in Bangkok.  Think Singapore Raffles Hotel, or The Strand in Yangon, but more modern whilst keeping classical line and and exceptionally well managed serene experience.

The tasting manu is well worth the higher price tag, well currated selection of Thai dishes served beautifully in a serene Thai home garden by the river environment.
sample_reviews_en.author: OzAka

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you want a truly special evening, I highly recommend this restaurant.
The atmosphere is amazing, perfect for a date with someone special, whether it's family or your loved one. Everyone who comes here is impressed. The food, however, might not appeal to everyone as it's a mix of international and Thai cuisine, so the flavors might not be familiar to Thai palates. There might also be some delays in ordering, requiring you to follow up several times. Overall, it's a great restaurant in terms of atmosphere and elegance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neung IR

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing experience.
The whole evening was fabulous. From the boat journey, cruising the chao Praya at night just for us. The arrival on the jetty, with welcoming Thai smiles. The buildings are gorgeous and was worth wondering around after our dinner, the collection of antiques is quite something. The food was very very good but what blew our mind was the chocolate dessert, Cocoa Nueb (?) Not sure about the name. I should have taken a picture just to remember it. Please put a picture of it here if you have one. Enjoy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Renaud Lemaire

sample_reviews_en.text: To get to this restaurant you need to pass through The Siam hotel which is already an experience. It is like a well done museum where each element you look at has a story to tell. The restaurant is at the river side and has a beautiful view. The food is delicious and service at high standard. Beautiful entourage as you have the feeling to be in a forest. We took tons of pictures. It is just like a small paradise. It is a perfect place to celebrate something special.
sample_reviews_en.author: Matilde Picazio

sample_reviews_en.text: Had an exceptional breakfast at Chon Thai Restaurant at The Siam Hotel in Bangkok. The à la carte selection is plentiful.
