The décor is traditional Thai, and the atmosphere has great, relaxing vibes especially the semi-outdoor area, where a pleasant breeze passes through, making the seating very enjoyable. The food is tasty and satisfying, with excellent presentation. As for the staff, they are extraordinarily professional and warm.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alinko

restaurants.name: Heychom Thai Dessert Bar
restaurants.address:

320 Maha Rat Rd, Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Heychom Thai Dessert Bar presents its iced jasmine tea as a small ceremony: a wooden tray holding a tall glass packed with ice made from jasmine tea and jasmine flower petals, a bottle of concentrated jasmine tea, a decorative glass vessel with sweetener, and a jasmine garland that reinforces the floral theme.

The ice itself is brewed jasmine tea! It is lightly golden, aromatic, and studded with edible petals, so the drink becomes more fragrant as it melts rather than diluted!! This fragrance forward approach runs through the rest of their menu as well, from coconut based desserts infused with pandan or jasmine, to sticky rice sets paired with seasonal fruits, to soft, lightly sweetened sago and bua loy served in warm coconut milk. Many items echo the same sensory philosophy of layered aroma, gentle sweetness, and traditional Thai ingredients presented with modern elegance. Whether it’s their coconut panna cotta, pandan ice cream, or mango sticky rice, each dish is plated with the same attention to scent, texture, and visual detail that defines the jasmine‑tea ritual I experienced. This is a must visit stop when I am in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Traveling Pug

sample_reviews_en.text:
Desserts and drinks of a really high quality. The foi thong and thong yod were the best I’ve tasted after many visits to Bangkok. The coconut milk used in the glutinous rice desserts were more fragrant than most. Thai milk tea was creatively presented, with milk poured over ice cubes made of tea (although this presented a problem if you drink too fast, and the last bit became concentrated tea).

My main complaint was that half the menu was unavailable on the day we came (at least 3 items we picked were unavailable, until we settled on the items pictured). Surely the menu can be pruned down if stock is such an issue?
sample_reviews_en.author: Jia Jin Low

sample_reviews_en.text:
I dropped by this Thai dessert cafe after seeking some refreshment after a hot new year day.

I ordered boi loy (dumpling in coconut milk) a set of Thai desserts (the gold series made for special occasions and consists of egg yolk, sugar, flour) and took coconut cookies and crispy colorful cookie (sampannee) back home.

It was so rare to find these Thai desserts because it took a lot of time to do it. Very awesome and it was delicious.

Despite all good things, the seats are limited so they are often packed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poonie Tiengtrong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Subtly luxurious while pertaining classical Thai roots.

This place boasts some very nice Thai flavors. Their key is delivery. The packages and presentation is contemporary, but the flavor is like a time machine trip taking you back in time.  You will find some menus that are a rarity, with some nice finishing touches.

Recommended menus: Heychom mango w/ sticky rice and tea set.

Make a stop if you are in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patarapol Koopitakachorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The place is done up beautifully. Here all the beverages are served deconstructed - tea in cubes, juices bottled; sugar syrup in a little container; milk in a separate tumbler. Which means the sugar never really blends well with the ice, the pre-brewed tea cubes never fully release the flavour - ultimately making it a sub-par experience. Not for everyone, i guess.
The mango sticky rice was good though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rakesh Shuchita

sample_reviews_en.text:
Such a hiddem gem right across Wat Pho. The drinks are super tasty, the sweets are nice and the staff is very helpful and can give you advice if you are not sure what to choose.
Prices are great as well. Also everything comes unsweetened and they offer syrup to make your drinks as sweet as you prefer. We tried the Butterfly Pea Flower Tea with lime juice and it was tasty and refreshing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Roberta T

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a small shop offering a variety of traditional Thai desserts. The Sampannee is smooth, soft, fragrant, and melts in your mouth. The Aloo is also good. The Bua Loy is delicious, with soft dough served warm, and pairs well with a bitter coffee. The butterfly pea flower drink, with syrup added to taste and a squeeze of lemon, turns a beautiful purple color.
sample_reviews_en.author: BD Life

sample_reviews_en.text: Beautiful little place opposite Wat Pho. The best meal I think I’ve ever had. I have coelliac disease and so didn’t want to take a chance on something I didn’t know the ingredients. So opted for a safe bet with mango sticky rice and Thai tea frappe, both absolutely stunning. Wish I’d found it at the beginning of our trip rather than the last day 😔
sample_reviews_en.author: Jo Parsons

restaurants.name: Tid Munz (Samyan)
restaurants.address:

709 Banthat Thong Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A truly authentic Thai restaurant that everyone traveling to Bangkok should try at least once!

What's special here is that they use the same grill and hot pot, which is great fun for groups of friends or family. The dipping sauces are flavorful; be sure to try the oyster salad with Thai sauce – it's incredibly delicious and addictive. The combination of grilling and hot pot is fantastic, a true example of the vibrant Thai dining experience.

The atmosphere is casual, with many locals, making it a true "favorite" spot, not a tourist trap. The prices are reasonable for the quality.

If you want to experience authentic Thai cuisine, this is a place worth visiting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thinh Tran

sample_reviews_en.text: Arriving at the food street, I discovered an all-you-can-eat barbecue and hot pot buffet for 276 baht, advertised as a two-hour all-you-can-eat option. After sitting down and asking the male staff, he confirmed it was all-time, including drinks, food, and seating. He spoke Mandarin and English. The ingredients were fresh, especially the various cuts of beef and pork displayed in the refrigerator. Around 5 pm, there were already many Thais dining, as well as tourists. The only downside was that it was a Thai holiday and alcohol was prohibited that day; otherwise, one could have enjoyed a leisurely drink and a relaxed atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: 旅遊迪人

sample_reviews_en.text:
Terrible experience. The staff completely ignored customers.
We waited almost half an hour for our stove, even though there weren't many customers. People who came after us got their stoves first. When we asked the receptionist, she just told us to wait and didn't get up to check on us. The restaurant is disorganized, and the staff members are not neatly dressed. We had to ask the table next to us for more soup. The service was awful. There were about 10 staff members sitting in front of the restaurant doing nothing, only busy clearing tables and collecting payments. I will definitely not be visiting this restaurant again.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิทยา ศรีวงษ์

sample_reviews_en.text: We ate there on a Sunday between 6 and 7 PM. The restaurant was full, but they were out of tissues. The staff solved the problem by taking tissues from our table and giving them to other tables, right in front of us without asking or telling us, even though we hadn't finished eating. That's a terrible way to manage things. I don't understand why they don't buy more tissues to replenish the supply. It also seemed like the staff were just looking after each other; I don't know how they're trained.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sireethon Klinhom

sample_reviews_en.text:
The price is 276 baht per person, including all self-service food: beef, pork, vegetables, seafood, ice cream, noodles, rice, soft drinks, etc.
The staff will ask you to choose a grill (as shown in the picture) or a frying tray at your table, and they will bring it to your table. You just choose your food and mix your dipping sauce to your liking.
You will pay extra for beer or hot pot dishes.
The staff are quick and enthusiastic, so you won't have to wait long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thảo Trần

sample_reviews_en.text:
I entered the restaurant alone, smoking weed to hide my shyness.

I was rudely shown to my table by the pink-clad employees loitering at the entrance, but my table wasn't made of wood, it was stainless steel... I wondered, "Are they mistaking me for Chinese?"

The table wobbled with every step, making it impossible to concentrate on my meal.

The staff's service was terrible.

The freshness is inferior to Japan, but it's cheap and tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: でんがなまんがな

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was adequate; they let us choose our table. After we chose a table and went to get food, they asked us to move to a table in the middle, which we preferred because we like privacy. We arrived first and chose our table first, but we still had to move because people who arrived later were given the table we had chosen. There was a lot of food, and it was delicious, but the dipping sauce was too sour.
sample_reviews_en.author: พรนภา สุปวน

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is full of locals, which is a good sign! The menu is buffet-style (276 baht per person) where you choose from meats, seafood, vegetables, etc. Drinks and dessert (a selection of ice creams) are unlimited. There's a cooking device on the table (like a BBQ). The staff explains how to use it. The only downside is that it gets hot with the cooking, even though the restaurant is open (outdoors).
sample_reviews_en.author: Anne-Marie Mongrain

restaurants.name: peppery Thai Bistro
restaurants.address:

Warehouse 6, 2194 ถ. เจริญกรุง Wat Phraya Krai, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Peppery Thai Bistro

Peppery Thai Seafood is located in Warehouse 2, Asiatique The Riverfront Night Market, Bangkok. It's a comfortable, air-conditioned Thai seafood restaurant. Prices are a bit high for a tourist hotspot. Signature dishes include Pad Thai, curry crab, crispy pork, and a variety of elaborate fruit juices.

Appetizers and cold dishes generally start at around 180 baht. Main dishes like Pad Thai cost around 150-220 baht. Tom Yum soup costs around 220-300 baht. Large seafood dishes like prawns or stir-fried crab cost around 680-780 baht each, with weight options available. Average cost per person, including drinks, starts at 600 baht. The staff are friendly and the food is served quickly.

Location: Asiatique The Riverfront, Warehouse 2, opposite the famous Hand-Label Thai Milk Shop

Opening Hours: Approximately 5:00 PM daily – 24:00 (in conjunction with night market operating hours)
sample_reviews_en.author: 凱凱

sample_reviews_en.text: We waited for our food for over an hour and had to inform the staff to find out that one item was out of stock and had to be sourced from another branch, causing the long wait. They didn't inform us at all so we could have chosen other menu items. The management was terrible. There was a table of foreigners who arrived before us but had already received their food, forcing us to inform the staff. The staff simply said they were really busy today due to the fireworks and the large number of customers. They did apologize, but I think this will be my first and last visit. They need to improve their management. The food tasted good, but the prices are geared towards foreigners; many items are quite expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Atthapon Pansri

sample_reviews_en.text:
Oh wow we really enjoyed our dinner at the Peppery Thai Bistro in Asiatique. The atmosphere was chill and the food was spectacular. One hundred percent recommend the stir-fried morning glory with garlic sauce. Optional to add in some crispy pork but I really liked that. My friend loved the stir-fried braised beef with sweet basil and spices. The beef was tender and delicious. We both loved our dishes so much that we wish there was a chain closer to home!

Now for my standard comments. Location is clean and well kept. Indoor seating is air-conditioned and comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christine L

sample_reviews_en.text: Peppery Thai Bistro at Asiatique offers a delightful culinary experience amidst the vibrant atmosphere of the riverside complex. With its diverse menu featuring authentic Thai flavors with a modern twist, it's a must-visit for food enthusiasts. While the prices might be slightly higher, the quality of the food and the charming ambiance make it worth it. Whether you're craving classic Thai dishes or innovative creations, Peppery Thai Bistro delivers a memorable dining experience in the heart of Bangkok. Loved the Tom Yum and the fried rice so much!
sample_reviews_en.author: Genta

sample_reviews_en.text: We preferred this place because it’s an authentic Thai restaurant, and it definitely lived up to our expectations. I tried the Pad Thai and it was delicious — well-balanced, flavorful, and nicely cooked. But the real highlight for me was the corn salad. It had the perfect level of heat and a really fresh, vibrant taste. The portions were good, the atmosphere was cozy, and the staff were friendly and helpful. If you enjoy Thai cuisine or want to try something new, this place is definitely worth checking out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sinem çakır

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just arrived in Bangkok tonight and decided to walk around the area for dinner. We randomly chose this Thai restaurant.

We ordered grilled pork neck, soft shell crab, and a stir-fried vegetable dish. Overall, the food was decent but nothing particularly memorable. The grilled pork neck could have been cooked a bit longer as it lacked the smoky charcoal flavor, and the soft shell crab had a little too much batter.

Still, it was a reasonable meal for a casual stop while exploring the neighborhood.
sample_reviews_en.author: Savan

sample_reviews_en.text:
So that food was actually pretty decent and also unique in how it was served (out of a pineapple for example) but really wasn’t impressed with the service. It just took so long for someone to come by to take our order and then also took way too long for us to be able to flag someone to get our check. Granted we were sitting in the corner but still.

That being said, food was great so I wouldn’t rule them out just for our service encounter. Give me a shot!
sample_reviews_en.author: Siddig Siddig

sample_reviews_en.text:
What an amazing restaurant with an outstanding team, led by the talented Chef Dar.

We visited as a family, so we had the chance to try a variety of starters and main courses, and every single dish was absolutely delicious. The quality of the food, the presentation, and the service were all exceptional.

Thank you to Chef Dar and the entire team for such a wonderful dining experience. We will definitely be coming back and highly recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fahad

restaurants.name: นิตยาไก่ย่าง สาขาสามย่าน มิตรทาวน์
restaurants.address:

944/1 ชั้นที่ 4 Rama IV Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Quite a nice restaurant with plenty of seating.

The environment is clean, the service is fast, but by Thai standards quite cold, without any sparkle.

The menu is clear, with lots of photos, and bilingual, in Thai and English, which is definitely a plus.
In addition to the traditional Som Tam, which simply cannot be missed on the table, I ordered a salad with minced pork and rice noodles.
The Som Tam is good, but with no distinct flavor, as if flat. And that includes the dressing. It was certainly prepared from fresh ingredients, but the taste was completely average to below average.
On the other hand, the minced pork salad was amazing. A perfectly prepared mixture in which the juicy meat was wonderfully combined with shallots, liver and other herbs. The fresh mint on top was incredibly refreshing.

I'll probably never go here for Som Tam again, but I'd definitely stop by again for the meat salad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kena Groot

sample_reviews_en.text:
They have both Northeastern Thai and Thai food. The food selection is extensive, the taste is good, and the prices aren't too high. I liked many dishes. There's a great variety of food to choose from.

The fried sea bass with fish sauce was good; well-fried, large pieces of fish, and not too salty.
The sweet liver dish was perfectly cooked, not too tough, and delicious.
The papaya salad with crispy catfish was also good.
The basil omelet was delicious (I forgot to take a picture).
They also have a variety of desserts.
The grilled chicken had good quality meat.

The restaurant is quite large, but it's echoey and noisy due to conversations and crowds.
sample_reviews_en.author: SSS BKK

sample_reviews_en.text: Nittaya Kai Yang – Samyan Mitrtown, Bangkok located on the 4th floor of Samyan Mitrtown, Nittaya Kai Yang serves up authentic Isaan-style grilled chicken and other northeastern Thai favorites. The signature grilled chicken is juicy, well-seasoned, and the standout dish by many visitors. The restaurant also offers deep-fried snapper with sweet sauce, spicy papaya salad, and sticky rice for a full Isaan experience. The space is clean, comfortable, and popular. Expect a wait during peak dinner hours. Prices are reasonable and portions generous, making it a good value for a flavorful Thai meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalermchon Suttaluang

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was great, with flavors that Thai people love. The chef is skilled. We ordered fried sea bass with fish sauce, fried duck beaks, sun-dried beef, black sticky rice, grilled chicken, and chicken larb. The prices were standard, not expensive. The fish was very large and fried crispy and delicious. The grilled chicken was dry but seasoned with black pepper. The sun-dried beef was excellent, with great flavor. My favorite was the fruit salad; it was delicious, and a little bit of fermented fish sauce would have added the perfect savory kick.
sample_reviews_en.author: BERICH CHANNEL

sample_reviews_en.text:
Craving an authentic Isaan flavor without leaving town? Look no further than Nittaya Kai Yang. This local chain has become my go-to for a taste of Northeastern Thailand.  They have branches all over the city, making it convenient to grab a delicious and affordable meal.
This branch is on 4th floor of Samyam MitrTown.

Their menu is packed with Isaan classics like spicy papaya salad (som tam), grilled sticky rice (khao niao), and barbecued meats bursting with flavor and much more for spicy salad !
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumol

sample_reviews_en.text:
Adding to my review after five years!
I really wish they would open a branch in front of my house. The food is delicious, the prices are reasonable, and the portions aren't huge, so you can try many different dishes.
The grilled chicken has such a crispy and fragrant skin! Honestly, everything on the menu was delicious. I'll definitely go back again.

---
I ordered several dishes but was too busy eating to take pictures. The overall portion sizes aren't huge, but the taste is great! ^^
sample_reviews_en.author: Monkey on the run

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'd give it a 2 overall rating because the food didn't pass.
But I could give it a 3, since we didn't get to try Nittaya's signature dishes.
Because there were only two of us today, we wanted to try individual dishes.

The only dish I had a problem with was the recommended fried rice with salted pork rinds. It didn't come hot enough. I think it definitely wouldn't pass.

Please improve.

The restaurant's atmosphere is nice and spacious.

The service was a bit below par.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisby

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered 3 items:
Spicy rice noodle salad: Gave it five stars, but the taste wasn't as good as other branches.
Spicy glass noodle salad: Not spicy enough.
Spicy catfish salad: The first bite was very salty, the second bite was extremely salty.
The staff were friendly, nice, and polite.
The food came out very slowly. When we arrived, we were the second table without any food. There were only 4 tables occupied in the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oleo Unlim

restaurants.name: Sanidchan Boat Noodle & Hotpot ก๋วยเตี๋ยวสนิทจันทร์
restaurants.address:

245, 19 Sukhumvit 31, Khwaeng Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
You have to admit that the signature dish here is the Dry Boat Noodles!

Flavor (Taste): The restaurant seasons it to be perfectly well-rounded (กลมกล่อม) and just right.

Spiciness (Heat Level): For those who don't eat very spicy food, we recommend ordering low spiciness (เผ็ดระดับน้อย); you'll still get a decent, zesty flavor. You can slurp up the sauce without needing to add any extra seasoning!

Texture: The noodles are thoroughly coated with the dry sauce. The pork/beef (whichever you choose) is tender and soft, resulting in a perfect bite every time.

🍮 End the Meal with Something Sweet

After enjoying the spicy boat noodles, you must finish with a cool, refreshing dessert or some fragrant toast:

Khanom Thuay (Thai Coconut Milk Custard): The sweet Khanom Thuay here is a classic and perfect choice. The sweet, creamy, fragrant coconut milk helps balance the spiciness.

Toasted Bread: If you prefer something a bit more substantial, try the Toasted Bread with Custard (Khanom Pang Ping Sangkhaya). The bread, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, paired with the sweet custard, is another equally impressive menu item.
sample_reviews_th.author: Sumol

sample_reviews_th.text:
Wagyu noodles were very very delicious!  Great quality wagyu.
Kapraow was one of the best i’ve had in Bangkok
ขนมถ้วย is a must! Aroi makk
Overall, well worth a visit
Will return
sample_reviews_th.author: Nataporn Chaiprukmalakan

sample_reviews_en.text: I was staying at the Public House 31 hotel around the corner and found myself walking past Sandichan shortly after it had its soft opening. I liked the minimalist design and the food on the menu looked appealing, so I made a point to stop in the next day. I’m glad I did - the meal was simple and delicious (pork broth, pork, noodles and vegetables), and the staff was very helpful and friendly. I ate here twice more during my 10 days in Bangkok, trying a few different menu items. If you’re staying in the area, this place should be on your rotation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eduardo Canto

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came alone around 17.10 on a Saturday.
There were only two guests. The place is clean, quiet and relaxed.
The waiter speak little English.
The Wagyu was extremely tender and fresh. The soup tasted great and thick though I should have asked little spicy instead of 50% spicy.
The lime juice was just refreshing particularly to cool down the spicy soup.
I was served within minutes of my order.
This is not the cheap street noodles but with choice of high quality beef and pork in a air conditioned restaurant and with little background music
sample_reviews_en.author: L K

sample_reviews_en.text:
Boat noodles were tasty albeit on the saltier side, slightly more expensive but they are generous with their meat portions. Chilli is spicier than usual so if you can’t take chilli get the least spicy option, and add your own chilli powder afterwards.

Location is a bit far from the main road but the restaurant is housed in a beautiful little structure. Waitress speaks a little English and they have Thai, English and Chinese menus. They also accept credit card but there’s a 3% surcharge if your bill is below 500 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Loki

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don’t fall for this trap. Scammy place. It’s overpriced and then they charge you service charge and tax separately is if it was the US or something. Is this even legal? Pay your own taxes and the salaries of your employees.

Then they do not want to accept contactless payment even though their machines work for that and you can check it out for yourself bc they will accept your contactless payment if you leave them no other option.
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went to Sanidchan Boat Noodle & Hotpot — honestly such a good spot. The boat noodles were sooo flavorful, just hits. Ended up ordering way more bowls then I planned 😆

The hotpot was also a whole vibe with friends, super fun to share and everything tasted really fresh. Overall just good energy, easy place to hang and eat for hours tbh. 10/10 def going back again 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Watanya Morrison

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sanidchan Boat Noodle – Sukhumvit 31
A small but charming boat noodle shop that truly exceeds expectations. The beef is top quality, with several premium cuts to choose from, perfect for meat lovers. The menu also offers a variety of refreshing drinks to complement the meal. To finish, don’t miss their delicious desserts, which make the perfect sweet ending.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sittitam Ruengcharungpong

restaurants.name: Italian Proudfa
restaurants.address:

402/10 อาคาร 2 ซอย ลาดพร้าว 94 Srivara Rd, Phlabphla, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Not the best Italian around. Most dishes came out bland and the truffle soup was on a fine line between absolute disaster and a pompous experiment. The cook could take more lessons on the instant packets of pasta texture, not up to par even from a pretentious Italian cuisine. Don't waste your meal, time and money here. Lots of better options in Bangkok now.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brian Reka

sample_reviews_en.text: I really enjoyed the pasta and lamb steak, which were delicious. However, I was quite disappointed with the pizza and foie gras. The restaurant is open and has a lot of seating. It's not very crowded, so it's quite quiet. The staff are not very attentive to customers, but they are polite.
sample_reviews_en.author: Say my name

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was not tasty ribs dry and no taste the pasta was spicy which shouldn't be for pasta corsera. Service not attentive we order a starter which never came and when the mai corse was served they told us Parma out of stock. No wine list no white wine just 4 red wines on a shelf.
sample_reviews_en.author: gerd med

sample_reviews_en.text: Tomahawk is the name of a popular type of beef steak. It comes from the rib set, like ribeye, but is cut from the 6th-12th rib cage. This results in a large surface area, and the meat at the base is trimmed to expose the bone, leading to a larger piece of meat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nanthawat Aisuwan

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a pizza through Line Man, with truffle mushroom sauce and Parma ham toppings. Both toppings were delicious. The price was 520 baht, and there was a discount because I ordered through the app. This restaurant makes very thin pizza crusts.
sample_reviews_en.author: jira pin

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, and the restaurant had karaoke, making it a lively place to eat, drink, and have fun! I thought their pasta was fantastic! I wish they offered delivery! I'd love to be able to enjoy such delicious food without leaving home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Meng Shen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every dish we ordered was delicious, and the service was good.
The only downside was the mosquitoes inside the shop.
There is convenient parking available right in front of the restaurant within the condo area.
sample_reviews_en.author: MooNut

sample_reviews_en.text:
I bit pricey for the quality of food
almost all drinks from the menu were out of stock. Only expensive Paulaner beer - when we wanter simple Singha, and no cocktails available
sample_reviews_en.author: Eugenia

restaurants.name: Keawloon BKK (Advance reservation only)
restaurants.address:

21/3 Saeng Chan, Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
We tried the set menu for 6-8 people in July. The menu is in the last picture.
Our group really liked the appetizers. The stir-fried sweet dish was perfectly seasoned; we even ordered extra unripe mango. The ingredients were fresh and succulent, especially the seafood. Another dish that impressed us was the salt-fried river prawns, served with a seafood dipping sauce that cut through the richness (though none of the dishes were too rich! lol).
Personally, I didn't find the flavors that strong; they weren't spicy enough to burn my stomach. The restaurant tends to add a sourness to their shrimp paste chili dip, sour soup, and salads, which I thought was perfectly balanced.
We finished with easy-to-eat coconut ice cream with fried peanuts, a nostalgic treat.

It's a shame that only 5 of us could come this time, so we were incredibly full, but we finished everything! (?) And the bill came out a bit expensive at 1465฿ per person. I recommend coming with a larger group in case someone backs out!
sample_reviews_th.author: Jaa J

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Thai restaurant requires advance reservations due to limited seating. They serve a set menu for 2-4 people. The portions aren't small and come with a bowl of steamed rice. The appetizer is sweet shrimp with shrimp paste, which gives it a similar feel to nam phrik. There's also a plate of nam phrik, so there are plenty of dipping sauces. I personally enjoyed the sour mackerel soup with chamuang leaves, which was easy to sip. The turmeric fried fish with toppings was delicious, unlike anything I've ever had before. The rice wasn't too oily, unlike biryani. The fried fish was incredibly delicious. The salt-fried shrimp were much larger than I expected. My parents loved it. We also ordered the morning glory soup with fresh shrimp in coconut milk. The flavor was incredibly rich and smooth. I might return if I change the set menu again.
** There are three tables downstairs, so you can sit close together.**
sample_reviews_en.author: Supaporn C

sample_reviews_en.text: Southern Thai food and some dishes are mixed with Sukhothai style. Let's start with the atmosphere. We really like this kind of atmosphere. It looks very Thai and comfortable. The houses are in the old style but clean. The food that I really like is the first dish, stir-fried shrimp with sweet shrimp and sour fruit. This is a traditional southern food that is hard to find. I really like this dish. The flavors of all three go well together. Turmeric fried fish with rice has a fragrant turmeric aroma and chewy rice. The fish meat is good. When this dish comes, you have to eat it immediately. Spicy grilled pork salad with wild olives. This tastes very good. I really like it. The grilled pork is very fragrant. And the shrimp with shrimp paste and stink beans taste good. The shrimp are big and plump. The service is very good. I like it. But I think this set is good for six people.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ann

sample_reviews_en.text: The meal came as a set (as pictured) for 6900 baht, including drinks. We ordered one additional dish, bringing the total to 8000 baht. There were 6 of us, so it came out to a little over 1000 baht per person. However, the food we received consisted of salted fried eggs, omelets, and boiled eggs. The presentation was like something you'd get at a street food stall. For 8000 baht, we were quite disappointed, expecting something more worthwhile, especially since reservations are difficult to obtain. Adjusting the pricing would likely improve the experience. The taste wasn't a problem; the price was the main issue.
sample_reviews_en.author: Itchybag Bagbag

sample_reviews_en.text: This home-cooked restaurant uses carefully selected ingredients from southern Thailand, offering a blend of Pak Phanang and Sukhothai styles of cuisine. The food is incredibly delicious; every dish is amazing. They even provide instructions on how to eat each dish. Reservations are required, and the restaurant serves set meals containing 10 dishes – a very generous portion, ideal for 6-8 people, with plenty of leftovers to take home. The atmosphere is relaxed, but it can get a bit noisy if other tables are talking loudly. Overall, I would definitely make a reservation and eat here again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kandy M

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant requires reservations, operates in timed sittings, has no parking, and the food is served in a confusing order. In our opinion, almost every dish was too salty; the coconut milk curries were excessively rich. The ingredients were good, though, which is understandable given the relatively high price. Perhaps it was just our personal taste.

The atmosphere is like eating at home; the tables are spaced close together, making it easy to hear everything. On our visit, there were young children who were quite noisy and disruptive.

You can try it, but we wouldn't go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lelada T

sample_reviews_en.text: Discover the authentic flavors of Thailand at Chef Phat's Michelin Bib-rated home dining experience, "Kaew Loon"! Located off the beaten path, this intimate setting serves a fusion of Northern and Southern Thai cuisine, reflecting Chef Phat's rich heritage from Sukhothai and Pak Phanang. With only 12 seats per round, twice a day, the menu showcases the perfect balance of sweet, sour, salty, and umami flavors using fresh, carefully selected ingredients. Booking may be challenging, but the experience is well worth the effort. Don’t miss the dessert!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ken Wong

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant has a homey, grandmother's dining experience. The menu is simple, but we loved it. You can feel the care put into the cooking. The way they explain the story behind each dish during service makes the meal even more special.

Food: The restaurant offers a set menu that changes monthly, suitable for 6 people. You can take leftovers home.

Service: The service is incredibly friendly.

Atmosphere: It's a converted house, simply decorated, clean, quiet, and peaceful.

✅Reservations are recommended. There is parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khamnatee Chivapornthip

restaurants.name: We Hotel Riverfront
restaurants.address:

218, 1 Charan Sanitwong 96/2 Alley, Bang O, Bang Phlat, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A comfortable hotel, ideal for those who want to stay in a quiet residential area of ​​Bangkok.

The rooms are pleasant and very well-equipped (super comfortable bed, large TV, shower with perfect water pressure and temperature). It's a shame the air conditioning automatically resets to 20°C. More clothes racks in the bathroom would also have been appreciated. The surrounding streets are narrow, but this isn't a problem for getting to the hotel by taxi. I also didn't encounter any issues with stray dogs.

The highlights of this establishment are:

- its riverside location, surrounded by greenery and birds, offering a beautiful panoramic view of the city
- its rooftop pool, which had a perfect temperature but lacked sun loungers and parasols
- its well-maintained garden
- its value for money
- its proximity to the Rama 7 boat stop, allowing easy access to the city center for a few baht

Areas for improvement:
- The restaurant's prices are far too high
- The restaurant service could be more efficient, and communication could be improved (e.g., it's unclear whether service is at the counter or at a table in the garden).
sample_reviews_en.author: Edouard Manet

sample_reviews_en.text: Even though the hotel is a bit further from the city, it has some very clear advantages. The air quality is significantly better, there's no noise at all, and it's right on the river. You can enjoy a meal on the terrace in the evenings. Don't hesitate to book this hotel, it's truly great, absolutely wonderful. The service was absolutely wonderful and attentive. The rooms are beautifully furnished and meticulously clean, the beds are of very good quality, and the distance to the city is really no problem. You will love it! From the nearby Rama 7 pier, you can reach all of Bangkok by express boat for just 22 baht (60 euros/cents) and have a Chao Phraya River boat trip at a bargain price. Or take a Grab taxi to the city center for €8, for example. The hotel also offers a free shuttle service. This hotel is truly a gem and a hidden treasure. The panoramic pool is also worth mentioning. And the hotel restaurant is exceptionally good. I will always stay at this hotel from now on.
sample_reviews_en.author: N9761YXthomasr

sample_reviews_en.text: Even though the hotel is a bit further from the city, it has some very clear advantages. sample_reviews_en.author: Thomas Hans Georg

sample_reviews_en.text:
rather cheap. the rooms are relatively good for the price. clean, not old.  However the location is terrible!  there is absolutely nothing here.  The closest 7-11 must be about 10 minutes away.  The hotel is at the end of the alley on the river so it's going to be a long walk to get anywhere.  If the hotel was located somewhere else it would get more stars.

update: after staying here again, I Still believe that it's rather good value for money. added a star or 2.  however, the disadvantage about the location remains the same.  the restaurant/bar has such potential and could be a highlight of this place.  it's a shame they're not doing anything to improve it to make it live up to its potential.  Seriously needs someone with a vision.

The water pressure and temperature consistency is great in the shower.
sample_reviews_en.author: S Y

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Quiet Riverside Hidden Gem
"Excellent choice for my 10-day business trip. Highly recommended if you are looking for a quiet and relaxing atmosphere.
The Room: Clean, modern, and very private as the hotel doesn't have too many rooms.
Food: Breakfast is a la carte (made-to-order), not a buffet.
Location: It’s tucked away quite deep from the main Charan Sanitwong Road, but the riverside tranquility makes up for it. Still conveniently close to MRT Bang O.
Travel Tip: You can easily walk to Rama 7 Pier. Take the Orange Flag boat around 5:30 PM to ICONSIAM—it’s the perfect time to enjoy the beautiful sunset and evening views of the Chao Phraya River.
I would absolutely stay here again for future work trips in the area."
sample_reviews_en.author: CyaNie

sample_reviews_en.text: Is my favourite hotel of the trip. We are so glad that we book it at the end before we went back to our country. I could totally see myself come back to Thailand again just to stay in this hotel for more days. The preference was amazing. The view was very nice in the hotel. The staff are all very nice and well spoken in English hotel were extremely clean compared to the other hotel we have spent in Thailand. The only thing I would’ve give advice is swimming pool. It needs to be more shadow , umbrella or tree cover there , it was very sunny and too hot to stay , which swimming pool should be a relaxing place to spend time with the family . Hopefully the next time I go back there, will see the improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Trip.com Member

sample_reviews_en.text:
The room wasn't bad, but some of the reception staff were unwelcoming in their demeanor and speech. The hotel is located in a very deep alley, making transportation difficult. The hotel shuttle service is inflexible; noon means noon, 2 PM means 2 PM, not every half hour or hour. Given your location near the MRT, you shouldn't have such a fixed schedule. Even a golf cart dropping you off at the main road would be helpful. Overall, the staff were unhelpful, their expressions were condescending, and their dialogue was just empty words. Why hire them? They could use AI for customer service instead.

P.S. Sitting by the river is unbearable; there are too many mosquitoes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prabhanicha Ngernklomthanadol

sample_reviews_en.text: The room was clean, the bed was soft, the pillows were comfortable, and there was a sofa to sit on. The bathroom was spacious, but the room itself was quite cramped. There was no place to put cosmetics, no makeup mirror, and the bedside table was too narrow to place anything; I had to put my phone and wallet on the floor. I tripped over the bed and bruised my legs because the room was so small. There was no balcony, and the view of the river was very, very distant. The restaurant served delicious food in a comfortable setting at reasonable prices. The riverside atmosphere was beautiful and perfect for relaxing. The room price was a little over 2,000 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rattanaporn Jansee

restaurants.name: LUNAS LUNAS
restaurants.address:

420 Sukhumvit 71 Rd, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Luna Luna on Sukhumvit 71 Rd is an exceptional spot in Bangkok! The space is incredibly spacious and beautifully modern, with a high-end vibe that makes you feel comfortable and inspired. It's a perfect place for digital nomads, offering a great environment to work efficiently while enjoying a stylish setting. The pastries are a real treat—delicious and freshly baked, adding to the overall wonderful experience. The staff are extremely friendly and attentive, making you feel welcomed whenever you visit. I highly recommend Luna for anyone looking for a chic, spacious café that combines excellent coffee, pastries, and a great atmosphere for work or relaxation!  The coffee prices are very reasonable and they offer pour over as well as espresso.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thawn Lowing

sample_reviews_en.text:
Right, well, popped in for a quick coffee and bloody hell, the barista is an absolute stunner. Couldn’t tell you what the coffee tasted like, to be perfectly honest—was far too busy trying not to stare at this ridiculously good-looking chap behind the counter.
Chiselled jaw, lovely smile, made my coffee with the sort of effortless charm that would make James Bond weep. Nearly walked into a table on my way out because I was still gawping like a proper muppet.
Coffee was probably lovely. Can’t remember. Will definitely be back tomorrow. And the day after. Possibly every day until I work up the courage to ask if he’s single.
Highly recommended for caffeine and eye candy.
PS: The dog is really cute
sample_reviews_en.author: Alin Kasemtanakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lunas Lunas Cafe is hands down the best coffee spot in town! The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, making it the perfect place to relax or catch up with friends. There’s plenty of parking available, which is a huge plus!

The service is exceptional—friendly and attentive staff who really make you feel welcome. And let’s not forget the baristas; they’re not only skilled but also quite handsome, adding a nice touch to the experience!

I tried the Majeed coffee, and it was uniquely delicious—definitely a must-try! If you’re looking for a great cup of coffee in a charming setting, Lunas Lunas Cafe is the place to be. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: prisana

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came here to work a bit and the place didn't disappoint. Very calm ambience, soft background music, and beautiful garden to look at.

The owner and staff were very attentive. I finally found a cafe that sells pretty good decaf latte. The decaf price is a bit higher but acceptable, it is rare! Also got Thai tea which was pretty good and I had it with oat milk. Food price is reasonable. Their egg n mushroom toast was tasty, just a bit improvement: dont dry out the toast too much.

Cash or scan recommended. Credit card gets 3% charge.

Will definitely come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mithuna12

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cute little cafe on Sukhumvit 71 with parking available. The place has a relaxing, green vibe 🌿 with plenty of seating, perfect for working or spending time.

Prices are quite reasonable. I tried the Dirty, which was just okay, the milk felt weak and made the coffee lose some of its edge. The iced Americano was fine, and the matcha was average but drinkable.

Overall, not bad. The main highlight is definitely the atmosphere, parking convenience, and friendly service.
sample_reviews_en.author: K4

sample_reviews_en.text: Really liked my time here. It’s in a super cozy house, so the whole place feels homey and relaxed. There are plenty of outlets, which is perfect if you want to get some work done. Do not skip the matcha banana bread, it’s seriously amazing. Definitely a spot I’d come back to!
sample_reviews_en.author: Harold Rolloos

sample_reviews_en.text:
I accidentally discovered this place, and it turns out it's their soft opening today!
The coffee is good quality and the prices are reasonable. There's a lot of seating and the shop is huge with plenty of parking. They even have outdoor seating where pets are allowed. 👍🏾👍🏾👍🏾
sample_reviews_en.author: Pisanu Leeprasert

sample_reviews_en.text: We had a wonderful experience at this café. The cappuccino was absolutely delicious, and the bruschetta and toast we ordered were equally tasty. The staff were very friendly and helpful, making our visit even more enjoyable. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dion Stokhorst

restaurants.name: Masu Maki & Sushi Bar
restaurants.address:

Sukhumvit 39, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We ate here for dinner. We loved it; the food was generous and the fish was excellent. The space was small and intimate. Unfortunately, we arrived a little late, and last orders were at 9:00 PM. To be honest, the staff rushed us a bit, and we were asked to pay before we'd finished our meal. We were offered broth and a dessert to finish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Giulia Galli

sample_reviews_en.text: We are an Indian family and had a great experience at Masu Maki & Sushi Bar. We instantly got a seat without a booking, which was very convenient. The food was fresh and delicious, the staff were friendly, and the atmosphere was comfortable for families. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: perminder saluja

sample_reviews_en.text: A very cute and intimate spot. They had the largest selection of sushi that I could find out of the options that came up on my Google search and they definitely live up to their reviews. Their portions are HUGE, and their Thai Tea ice cream …
sample_reviews_en.author: Demi-Lin Duncan

sample_reviews_en.text: The sushi was great, the service was mediocre. After 1:15 hours the waiter basically waited for us to leave. When we asked to see the dessert menu, he told us all of the desserts are finished.. the atmosphere is very basic
sample_reviews_en.author: רועי מינקוב

sample_reviews_en.text: Cozy sushi place near emquatier! If u travel by train its super easy. The food is so fresh and big portions. So many varieties of food. Definitely will go back again. The place is quite small so u need a reservation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phanploy Anankamanee

sample_reviews_en.text: Such a lovely sushi place 🍣 Everything was fresh, delicious, and beautifully presented\. The atmosphere was cozy and the service was wonderful\. Definitely coming back\! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Karyna STRYZHACHENKO

sample_reviews_en.text: Yummy sushis..fried rice..lot of veg menu available...vast menu..reservation recommended..must visit if u love Japanese with family n friends..in heart of Sukhumvit:)
sample_reviews_en.author: Simi Sood

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the staff provided excellent service; they were lovely, friendly, and helpful. I recommend calling to make a reservation beforehand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Netchanok Thongplod

restaurants.name: Chinda Hotpot Branch 1 Huaikwang
restaurants.address:

363 Pracha Rat Bamphen Rd, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been a customer since this restaurant became famous, and I'd still wait in line for up to 3 hours because I really like it.
My most recent visit was on August 1st, 2025 (388 baht buffet).

Pros: The soup and dipping sauces are still as delicious as ever!!!

Areas for improvement:
1. Meat quality: I feel the meat isn't the same as before; it seems the grade has changed. There's only one section of meat on the conveyor belt, and it takes a very long time for it to reach me because the food is spaced far apart. The conveyor belt also rotates very slowly.
2. Restaurant atmosphere: The lighting is quite dim. When there are few people, it feels quiet and deserted, not as inviting as before. I'd like the lighting to be brighter to make it feel more lively.

I still love the taste of the food, but I'd like to see improvements in the quality of the ingredients and the restaurant's atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anyamanee D

sample_reviews_en.text:
This branch has excellent service, but parking is difficult to find. I recommend not driving.
The food is clean, the dipping sauces are delicious, the vegetables are fresh, and the meat has no unpleasant smell. The restaurant is well-maintained.

It's very different from the Rayong branch.
Why is it so different? I couldn't stand eating there.

If you're in the Huai Khwang area, I highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kathie Beskmann

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is clean and soups are nice. I would like to recommend to mix mala soup and other soup. It's good for the price, I will come again and eat . I would like to recommend to make the menu in English too because I am from Myanmar and I don't know Thai and Chines and small trash can to put tissues.The staffs are helpful and kind.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hannah

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was so repetitive. I brought a foreigner along and the staff grabbed my phone and changed the language to Thai without asking permission at all 🤦🏻‍♀️ For this price, the food should be better. We spoke Thai to the staff, but they couldn't understand us. It was so confusing. First and last time here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cherbelle Khanittha

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is small, but the food is delicious and the staff are fast. Compared to other branches with buffets, the price is reasonable; you might want to go to a buffet instead. If you eat little, this place is good as there's a wide variety to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: chill chill japan

sample_reviews_en.text: They have both buffet and à la carte options, depending on your preference. Jinda Sukiyaki is known for its delicious dipping sauces and broths. I recommend the mala sauce and the white pork bone broth; they're both tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: พี่กุ้งกดสิว สาขาจตุจักร

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes good as usual, no change. However, I would recommend that the restaurant close during construction hours because it creates a lot of noise pollution while we eat. Thank you for your consideration. 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Khanet Kanhawek

sample_reviews_en.text: The mala soup with pork ribs is delicious! If you're not very hungry, I recommend ordering the regular menu instead, as the buffet is 383 baht per person. But if you focus on meat, it's probably worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: ToeyKai

restaurants.name: Bonchon Central Rama 2
restaurants.address:

ห้องเลขที่ 183 ชั้น 1 เลขที่ 160, Rama II Rd, Samae Dam, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This popular Korean fried chicken restaurant chain, with many branches in Thailand, makes incredibly good ramen. The ramen is very rich and flavorful. The chicken is as good as ever, but my friend and I both agreed that the garlic ramen seems saltier lately – we're not sure if they've adjusted the recipe.

If you're a member (free registration via the app), you can use a coupon for unlimited ramen refills. There are also many discounts and promotions on Wednesdays, and plenty of new member coupons.

The staff are friendly and helpful, making an effort to communicate, recommending promotions and menu items, and answering customer questions. They are attentive and polite, and they regularly check on your soup and refill it as needed.

There's also an AIS point redemption program for discounts, and credit cards are accepted.
sample_reviews_en.author: Muse SA

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was so slow. The staff seemed like they'd just woken up. We sat down for a while and had to ask for a menu before they brought it. We ordered ramen and waited so long that my boyfriend's soup got cold before we finally got it. My boyfriend ordered refillable hot tea and had to ask for it twice. They even got the bill wrong; we ordered one bottle of water but were charged for two. I was extremely unimpressed with the staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: nutthamart nudsombat

sample_reviews_en.text: Bonchon Central Rama 2 is a great spot for anyone who loves Korean‑style crispy chicken with bold, flavorful sauces. The chicken is perfectly crispy on the outside and tender inside, coated with rich Soy Garlic or spicy Hot sauce. Service is quick even during busy hours, and the bright, comfortable seating makes it easy for both dine‑in and grab‑and‑go.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumol

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went for dinner... not crowded on a weekday...
The fried chicken was delicious... ordered mid-wings... the tonkatsu-style fried pork belly with rice was a little too salty... the grilled pork belly ramen, ordered spicy level 3, was very spicy...
sample_reviews_en.author: Meany Seeda

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here many times and I'm always impressed. The crispy chicken with sauce is delicious and stays crispy for a long time (I wish I knew the recipe!). The staff are friendly, provide excellent service, and are very attentive and lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Muay

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was slow. Many orders or requests, such as asking for chopsticks, ordering drinks, and ordering food, took over 10-15 minutes. The staff made a mistake on the bill, over 300 baht, but they corrected it quickly after I pointed it …

i visited here with the group
very disappointed for the menu i was ordered 4dish  they said doesn’t have they cannot do it but they didn’t bring the menu out and after that I did order some of the curry with my friends we ordered to eat but when they serve on the table they bring just only one each first and they ask for the check first before the food drop on the table I don’t wanna have any problem that’s why I pay first but after that 15 minute I still waiting for my food they didn’t make it yet the next day three people in the group get diarrhea on the morning  we’re not gonna come back here

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant offers a wide variety of side vegetables to eat with your rice noodles. The vegetables seem clean because I didn't get an upset stomach after eating them. There are many different curries to choose from, and they are delicious. Of the curries I tried, I liked the spicy bamboo shoot chicken the most. The food didn't take long to arrive, and the staff provided good service. The restaurant doesn't accept cash and is open 24 hours, but it closes for one and a half days every week.
sample_reviews_en.author: N N (Pom)

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here, and it was a terrible experience. It's one thing to make a mistake when frying chicken, but the owner, an elderly lady, was indifferent. She just took the money without talking to me or explaining anything. She just didn't care about the customers; she just wanted to collect the money. She wasn't even supposed to fry the chicken! I'm glad to see that there are a lot of customers. Please take this comment into consideration.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dew Kittituch

sample_reviews_en.text: Although there were many staff members, it seemed chaotic and the service was slow. Items were served one at a time. You wouldn't get your food unless you asked. Out of three people, only one person received their order (after they had almost finished theirs), while the other two waited a long time before having to ask about their order, even though they had ordered the same thing. However, the taste was definitely good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanya BAOSINGSOUAY

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually eat here regularly, but I usually order through the app. This time I had the opportunity to eat at the restaurant in person. The menu has even more options than on the app. The food is delicious, especially the rice noodles which I always order; the vegetables are always fresh. The papaya salad is also delicious, with perfectly cooked papaya strips.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mutita Thainpatanagul

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a local restaurant near The Emerald Hotel, where I stayed when I visited this neighborhood last November.

You choose your toppings and bring the noodles yourself.

Afterward, before the curry is served, you transfer vegetables from a salad bar-like area into a bowl,

and mix them together with the curry to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: K 365bestfood

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍜 Khanom Sen Mo Thong, Prachasongkroh 36, is another famous restaurant in the Huai Khwang area well-known to those who love Khanom Jeen (Thai rice noodles) and Northeastern Thai food.

Its highlights include: ✅ Fresh rice noodles ✅ Rich and flavorful broth ✅ Plenty of fresh vegetables to choose from ✅ Affordable prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naja LoveTravel&Cooking

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice noodles with coconut milk curry were delicious (ordered without chicken feet), but the portion was a bit small. The spicy noodle salad with fresh shrimp was extremely salty; even someone who doesn't like salty food could handle it. The basil chicken was also too salty. Only the rice noodles were tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: reino

restaurants.name: Yim Yim Steak
restaurants.address:

50 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Talat Phlu, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here without any expectations, as I was very hungry. The steaks, priced from 69-119 baht, were very well prepared.
The thin, tender rib-eye steak was tender and fell off the bone, with a wonderful aroma. The tri-colored chilies added a nice touch of flavor. The smoked pineapple ham was delicious and worth the price. The sauce was a bit bland, but it was delicious when paired with the chili peppers on the table. The spicy fried chicken was tender and not tough. It was moderately spicy. I recommend ordering something else if you don't like spicy food. Overall, the taste was delicious and the price was reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pannita

sample_reviews_en.text:
Location: In Talat Phlu, walk down the soi (alley).

Atmosphere: The restaurant isn't very big, serving Western-style food, but it has a cozy feel.

Menu: Plenty of options – steaks, spaghetti, som tum (papaya salad), and fried snacks.

Taste: The fried chicken is delicious. The steak is well-prepared, grilled evenly throughout, staying hot until the last bite. However, the sauce isn't particularly outstanding; they use a lot of black pepper, overpowering the flavor.

Price: Friendly and reasonable.

Service: Good.

Drinks: Many options available; I recommend the lemon tea.
sample_reviews_en.author: Midori Saka

sample_reviews_en.text:
Affordable steak, a quick and easy meal with no expectations.
The quality of the ingredients and the taste are excellent value for money, and the quality is excellent, considering the incredibly affordable price.

The meat used is of acceptable quality and seasoned to perfection. It was grilled a bit dry, and the accompanying sauce was only slightly sweet, which wasn't impressive.
Other appetizers, such as the fried chicken wings and fried fish, were bland, but still enjoyable as a snack.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miu Terasawa

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ate there once and felt like that was enough.
Overall, the food tasted average.
The french fries were delicious, but the rest, like the marinated pork and beef, wasn't very good.

The restaurant is located towards the back of the market. There's plenty of seating inside.

Parking in front of the restaurant requires some skill.
Parking is scarce in Talat Phlu, and the parking spaces are very narrow. It's a struggle to get in and out; you'll get tired turning the steering wheel!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rangsiii Wongsaeng

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very affordable price, quality matches the price.
The restaurant atmosphere is okay, the service from the staff is good, and the food is prepared very quickly. I ordered 4 dishes and they arrived incredibly fast. The fried shrimp salad tasted good, the spaghetti was a little bland, and the steak was unbearably salty. I personally liked the salad. Overall, this restaurant is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: 메이is몬BE베

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate at this restaurant after playing games. The food tasted okay considering the price. My friend ordered chicken nuggets, but they were cold inside. Another thing I didn't like was that I went late at night, near closing time. The owner was just sitting there getting a massage with liniment. Wouldn't it be better to wait until closing time? So self-centered.
sample_reviews_en.author: Viroon Manacharoenying (BubbleBoard)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This steakhouse offers a warm, family-like atmosphere, perfect for a large group or a couple.
The air-conditioned interior is cool and comfortable, and the prices are reasonable. The overall taste is excellent, and the price is reasonable. This is a good choice for those looking for a home-style steak at an affordable price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Lai

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices are affordable. I've personally eaten here since before they revamped the menu, and I think it's better now than before. It's a good option for those on a budget, but don't expect too much. The American fried rice I had was completely tasteless, and the dipping sauce for the steak was quite salty.
sample_reviews_en.author: ploy smile

restaurants.name: Baan Dok Pud
restaurants.address:

Ladprao 48 Yak 28-16, Samsen Nok, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Baan Dok Phut 🌿 Ladprao 48

A Thai dessert cafe in a lush garden setting. The atmosphere is peaceful, with a koi pond in the middle of the shop, giving it a homey feel like visiting relatives, but with meticulous attention to detail ✨
The Thai desserts are beautifully presented, with a delicate, not-too-sweet flavor. Every corner is perfect for photos 📸

Recommended Menu Items:
• Pandan Coconut Jelly / Fruit Jelly
• Pumpkin Custard
• Taro Pudding
• Refreshing Homemade Drinks

Suitable for chilling out, sipping coffee, or having fun taking photos with friends.

📍 Ladprao Soi 48
🕰️ Recommended to visit in the late morning – afternoon for beautiful light.
🚗 Parking available (check with the shop for confirmation).

#BaanDokPhut #LadpraoCafe #ThaiDesserts #BangkokCafe #CafeHopping
sample_reviews_en.author: Alan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This shop appears in Reel magazine a lot, so I stopped by today to try their Pla Krim (60 baht) dessert. The dough was a bit hard, but the coconut milk was fragrant and sweet, and the taste was really good. However, the portion was too small 😅😅 The bowl was tiny, and there was very little Pla Krim; I had to use a spoon to find it.
I also bought some other desserts to try: black sticky rice with custard topping and coconut jelly. They were delicious 👍👍👍👍
As for the Bua Loy Kai Tao (Vietnamese rice balls in coconut milk), which my grandmother used to make often, the filling wasn't as strong in flavor as the one she makes at home. It was still pretty good for a Thai dessert.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanlop Sangvonyodhin

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a Thai dessert cafe that really does make great desserts. The desserts are beautifully presented and look delicious. They have a wide variety of Thai desserts on the menu, and the taste is excellent – ​​not too sweet, making them very enjoyable. They also have a selection of drinks, including coffee and other herbal drinks, which are refreshing. I personally loved their "Pia Koon Song Kruang" (a type of Thai sticky rice pudding), which was fragrant, sweet, and creamy. I also loved their blended coffee with gardenia flowers; it wasn't overly coffeey, but creamy and delicious, and topped with whipped cream – it was like eating a dessert! Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ppoun PC

sample_reviews_en.text: I absolutely love this place, and come here every time in Bangkok! The staff is so lovely, the atmosphere is calming, and the dessert is always amazing. It's so nice to be able to spend a little bit of time outside the city and in a relaxing environment like this one. The place is surrounded by Koi as well! And the dessert is always fantastic. I always buy the glutinous rice balls (filled with mung bean and coconut) in coconut milk, and they are delicious! Filling too! And rhe pandan latte was refreshing and light. I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a break from the bustling city, and to enjoy some traditional thai desserts!
sample_reviews_en.author: Clarissa Karantzis

sample_reviews_en.text: Sweet tooth alert! #Desserts We came as a group of three, each having a set meal: two servings of pork curry with cha-muang leaves and one serving of massaman curry. We ordered five desserts: black bean sticky rice, coconut milk pudding, candied banana, taro fritters, and bua loy (Thai rice balls in coconut milk). We also took some home: taro custard, thong yip (Thai sweet egg yolk dessert), thong yod (Thai sweet egg yolk dessert), foy thong (Thai sweet egg yolk threads), and met khanon (Thai sweet rice flour dessert). So satisfying! 🫰
sample_reviews_en.author: หมึกดํา

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're craving a taste of authentic Thai desserts in a serene and tranquil setting, look no further than Baan Dok Pud. This hidden gem, surrounded by lush gardens and a koi pond, offers heavenly thai desserts that are truly irresistible.

From the delicate Khanom Kho (stuffed glutinious rice ball with coconut filling in coconut) to Peat Poon with Corn (pandan pudding in sweet coconut cream) every bite is a testament to the perfect balance of flavors and consistency.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nigel Low

sample_reviews_en.text: Thai desserts here are excellent, with just the right amount of sweetness – not overpowering. The coconut jelly is fragrant and bouncy, the coffee-flavored jelly is perfectly balanced, the sticky rice with longan has large, fragrant longan pieces, the black sticky rice with custard is not too sweet and the sticky rice is firm, and the Khanom Kho (a type of Thai dessert) might be a little too sweet for the filling, but the coconut milk has a wonderful sesame aroma.
sample_reviews_en.author: rojana dumkeungtrakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
All the desserts are delicious, but they could be a little less sweet. People are eating less sugar these days, but desserts still need to be sweet, not less sweet at all. The Khanom Kho (coconut jelly), coconut jelly, and Piak Poon (black sticky rice pudding) were all excellent.

The food menu is limited. The pork stew with cha-muang leaves and the braised pork with rice were delicious. It would be great if they added a basil pork with fried egg to the menu. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Imchai Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍞 Nom Aro Milk Shop

🧃 Nom Aro is a popular milk and bread shop in Pattaya. It's been around for a long time and is a favorite among both locals and tourists. Their signature dishes include pandan custard toast and their unique red syrup iced bread. They also offer a variety of hot, cold, and blended fresh milk drinks and coffee. The atmosphere is relaxed, perfect for unwinding and chatting with friends or recharging after a day of sightseeing. If you're in Pattaya, don't forget to stop by and try it! The shop is located in South Pattaya, near the South Pattaya intersection. Open daily from 3 PM to midnight.

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a bit tricky to find, but trust the directions; they might take you down some strange roads, but you'll eventually get to the restaurant. The food was really delicious, not too busy, and the service was slow, but once you taste it, you forget all that. It's truly delicious, and it's a family business with very friendly staff. I loved the buttered chicken; it's definitely become my favorite Indian dish now. I hope I find one this delicious again! 😀
sample_reviews_en.author: Deniz Kopru

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a wonderful dining experience at Luxmi Restaurant. The food was delicious, fresh, and full of authentic flavors. The staff were friendly, attentive, and provided excellent service throughout my visit. The restaurant was clean, comfortable, and had a welcoming atmosphere. The prices were reasonable for the quality of the food and service. I highly recommend Luxmi Restaurant to anyone looking for a great meal, and I look forward to visiting again!
sample_reviews_en.author: KYAW LWIN OO GP

sample_reviews_en.text: This hidden gem was an impulse food pick, and WOW was that the right decision. It is by far the best Indian food I’ve ever had and an absolute highlight of the culinary side of my trip through Bangkok. The service is so  friendly and the presentation is authentic. I wish I had a photo to share of the food but I inhaled it all too quickly! Highly recommended if you love great flavors and a bit of spice!
sample_reviews_en.author: Giovanni Damon

sample_reviews_en.text:
I felt very welcome and the food was great! I walked in alone late at night, and the owner invited me to join him at their table. We spent a fine evening with great biryani!!

I read some bad reviews here criticising the restrooms, so i'd like to adress that. The restrooms are just your south east Asian standard restrooms, not overly clean but also neither gross nor disgusting.

sample_reviews_en.text: THIS is the best Indian restaurant in all of Bangkok! Luxmi aunty is absolutely amazing and so is her husband. The chicken biryani, butter chicken, and daal makhni were all delicious. However, the parathas were the best  thing, and Luxmi aunty was nice enough to make us 4 parathas after we initially ordered 2.
sample_reviews_en.author: Menahil Shahid

sample_reviews_en.text: We return to Bangkok every year and always eat here at least once or twice. Delicious Indian food and super friendly people. It takes a bit of searching, but it's definitely worth it. Afterward, walk over to Happy Bar, which is just around the corner, which is also nice!

sample_reviews_en.text: Just ate here on our last night before returning to England.  The food was delicious - best Indian we have had in a long time.  The service was great, the food was lovely, tasty and fresh and the garlic nan was just Devine.  Will definitely return

restaurants.address:

89 ชั้น 2 Alley, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We first visited Yim Yim 10 years ago and had the chance recently to come for dinner again. I’m glad to say the standard remains the same and we had a superb dining experience. The taste is true to its Teochew roots.

Unlike the other more popular restaurant at level 1, Yim Yim uses very little artificial seasoning and choose the let the freshness of the ingredients shine. It’s especially suitable for people who do not chase that MSG kick.

Strongly recommend the pig stomach soup as well as the Tom Yam seafood soup. The oyster omelette was also very well done with just the right amount of wok hei.

Don’t miss the yam (orh nee) dessert. We usually don’t eat it with sticky rice but Yim Yim serves it with sticky rice so we decided to give it a try and was pleasantly surprised by the great combo. The yam was thick and not overly sweet at all.

The restaurant is now managed by the fourth generation boss. Wish him the best of luck and please keep up the good work. 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: KL T

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Chinese food. Open your mind, and let me tell you, everything was delicious!
Yim Yim Restaurant, 130 years old, now run by the 4th generation.
13 dishes for 7 people, total cost was a little over 7,000 baht.
Everything was finished!!!!
Hu Sae is Teochew-style raw fish, a rare find, unlike Japanese sashimi.
Very fragrant with sesame oil.
Ginkgo nuts stir-fried with salt, delicious and very sweet. Highly recommend ordering!!!
Roasted suckling pig with bread and sauce, the best! The skin was incredibly crispy.
I don't eat vegetables at all, but I liked the stir-fried kale with sole fish (I think).
Taro and sea bass soup, the broth is amazing, don't miss it!!!
Other dishes, I can't remember the names, I ate too much.
And to finish, taro ice cream.
Park at Wat Chaiyaphumkaram and walk over.
This restaurant has escalators for the elderly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nu_ Nui

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Steamed Pomfret with Fermented Soybean Paste*: Fragrant fermented soybean paste, slightly salty, naturally sweet, fresh fish with tender flesh.
- Shrimp Roll*: Bouncy shrimp, fragrant shrimp flavor.
- Stir-fried Noodles with Shrimp: Good taste.
- Fried Braised Pork Intestines: Crispy outside, fragrant braised pork, delicious.
- Crab Fried Rice: Normal taste, edible.
- Fish Maw with Crab Meat: Fresh crab chunks, fragrant ham, normal taste, edible.

Visited for the second time (1/11/25)
- Roasted Ginkgo Nuts with Salt**: Chewy texture, sweet with a hint of saltiness, very delicious, ordered two plates.
- Roasted Suckling Pig*: Crispy skin, meat stir-fried with garlic and pepper, fragrant, tender meat.
- All other dishes were also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: HummingbirdS

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old Chinese restaurant, probably over 100 years old, located on the second floor of Tang Jai Yoo restaurant. The current owner is the 4th generation. The Chinese food is delicious, with authentic flavors. Many dishes are excellent. My recent visit included:
