sample_reviews_en.text: It's a short walk from Wat Mangkon MRT station. There are about ten tables, each seating six people. It's best to call and reserve a table. We went right when the restaurant opened (11 am). The food was good, fresh, and the portions were generous. If you want to try several dishes, order the smaller sizes. The owner is very polite and lovely ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Han Umarn

sample_reviews_en.text: An old, established restaurant in Yaowarat, serving authentic Chinese food. It has a Shell Chuan Chim (Shell Recommended) award and other accolades. I especially like the steamed pomfret with plum sauce; it's good value for money. There are wheelchairs upstairs. Parking is available at the temple across the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pardej Ov41

sample_reviews_en.text:
Laughing Laugh Restaurant is a long-established restaurant founded approximately 100 years ago by my great-grandfather, who hailed from Xian Tou in Chaozhou.

The seasonings and sauces of Chaozhou cuisine suit Japanese palates. You can feel the history within the deliciousness.
sample_reviews_en.author: Koji Sabaijai

sample_reviews_en.text: It's definitely delicious, but you should invite some friends who are good at cooking to eat with you. The people at the tables around you are having a great time chatting, and you learn something from them... haha.
sample_reviews_en.author: พัฒนพงษ์ สร้อยอินทรากุล

restaurants.name: Baan Dinso
restaurants.address:

113 Trok Sin, Wat Bowon Niwet, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The atmosphere is amazing! 🌿✨ Peaceful, and the food is delicious. Truffle lovers must try it! Pasta is only 150฿ per dish, the mushroom soup is also amazing, don't miss the truffle pizza too, it's incredibly delicious and satisfying! 🍕 The owner is also very friendly and cheerful. The location is great, perfect for a leisurely stroll around.
sample_reviews_th.author: Lazy Babe (กว่าจะได้เที่ยว)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Comfortable stay, delicious food, in the heart of the city!
I had the opportunity to stay at Baan Dinso and was impressed from the moment I arrived.

The accommodation is warmly decorated, clean, and located in the heart of Bangkok. It's easy to walk to Wat Phra Kaew, Khao San Road, or Wat Saket (Golden Mount).

What I loved most was the cafe downstairs – it's adorable! The spaghetti is amazing, especially the truffle clam and tom yum goong (spicy shrimp soup). The flavors are rich and satisfying, but not too spicy. The tom yum is perfect! 💯
The atmosphere is great, perfect for relaxing or chilling with friends.

If you're looking for accommodation in the old city area that has everything – food, sightseeing, and relaxation – I highly recommend this place. You'll love it as much as I did!

There are many dogs and cats in the alley, but they aren't aggressive at all. I enjoyed walking around with the cats so much that my friends came looking for me! 🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattaya Yongchaitrakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place feels so warm and homey — like having a meal in a charming old wooden house from the King Rama V era. The atmosphere is simply wonderful! 🏡

Every dish was delicious, especially the Tom Yum Kung Spaghetti, which I absolutely loved! The flavor was rich and aromatic with Thai herbs, and the big juicy shrimp made it a perfect Thai–Italian fusion. 🍤💛

The Truffle Mushroom Soup was smooth and fragrant, and the Pesto Fettuccine with Grilled Salmon was so good I couldn’t put my fork down! As for the soda drinks — fizzy, refreshing, and a perfect match for the meal. 🍹

What impressed me the most was the staff — they can speak Thai, English, and Chinese, which makes both locals and international visitors feel completely at ease, just like being at home. 🥰

Prices are reasonable, the food is worth every bite, and the service and atmosphere are top-notch. A cozy little spot to relax and enjoy the heart of Bangkok. 🇹🇭
sample_reviews_en.author: เที่ยว Like สาระ

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have to say it was a wonderful experience! The property is centrally located but is literally an oasis of peace. We had breakfast (delicious and plentiful) in the garden. The house is colonial-style and very well-kept, truly beautiful!
The room was very clean, and they offered to clean it during our stay.
Every little detail is taken care of! There's shower gel and shampoo, and towels and a toothbrush are provided.
The staff was truly AMAZING, always kind, smiling, and attentive! We felt pampered every step of the way. You can tell they love their job.
On our last day, they even held our bags and asked us if we wanted to take one last shower when we came back to get our bags before leaving for the train station!
I will recommend this property to everyone; the welcome was definitely one of the best I've ever experienced! Congratulations! Keep up the good work! ;)
sample_reviews_en.author: Eve s

sample_reviews_en.text:
This old teak house, renovated by heritage architects, welcomes you in a relaxed atmosphere with soft jazz playing in the background. You'll need to walk around barefoot, which adds to the comfort.

Unbeatable value for money for a house located in the quiet of a small alley, just a few minutes' walk from the hustle and bustle of Khao San Road, the temples, and the Royal Palace.

The welcome is lovely and generous. The breakfast is divine and plentiful (special mention for the "Standard Set" menu).

Spacious and bright room with a private shower room.
Even the shared showers are perfectly clean.
Many thanks again to the staff for their attentive service. We will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Charles Murzeau

sample_reviews_en.text:
At the day of our arrival, tucked away in a small side street, we discovered what I can only describe as a peaceful oasis. From the very first step onto the premises, you can feel a calm, welcoming energy. The house itself has a unique design - beautifully decorated, spotless, and full of character.
The staff were exceptionally kind and helpful, always greeting us with warm smiles. Breakfast was amazing and plentiful. It's a perfect place to relax and unwind after long days of exploring the city - well-connected yet hidden away from the noise.
We'll definitely return to Bangkok, and it will be hard to find a place that tops this one. Truly recommended! :)
sample_reviews_en.author: sml

sample_reviews_en.text: At the day of our arrival, tucked away in a small side street, we discovered what I can only describe as a peaceful oasis. From the very first step onto the premises, you can feel a calm, welcoming energy. The house itself has a unique design — beautifully decorated, spotless, and full of character.The staff were exceptionally kind and helpful, always greeting us with warm smiles. Breakfast was amazing and plentiful. It’s a perfect place to relax and unwind after long days of exploring the city — well-connected yet hidden away from the noise.We’ll definitely return to Bangkok, and it will be hard to find a place that tops this one. Truly recommended! :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Trip.com Member

sample_reviews_en.text: Very traditional/local house so if you want a different experience to the commercial hotel vacation, this is a good choice. It's close to Khao San so this being a busy tourist area, you do hear a lot of tuk tuks and the walls aren't soundproofed but it was fairly quiet after around 11pm and in the mornings. Breakfast was ok, there are a few options but they didn't have the juice on both days. The room wasn't cleaned either so I bought bottled water (they do have a water machine though). Overall, i'd say it's pretty expensive for what you get but its a unique experience whilst staying in Bangkok. The staff were very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Trip.com Member

restaurants.name: ครัวหลานตาชู อาหารใต้
restaurants.address:

2 Soi Nawamin 74 Yaek 3-10, Ram Inthra, Khan Na Yao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small restaurant with a nice atmosphere, with only 5-6 tables.
Food Review

Stir-fried Three Smelly Fish - Tasty, but they forgot to add pickled garlic. When I asked, they brought the pickled garlic juice in a bowl. It was a nice side dish, but it would have been even better if it had been stir-fried.

Stir-fried Shrimp with Shrimp Paste and Stink Beans - This dish was incredibly flavorful.

Boneless Carp - The fish was large, boneless, but had half a fish roe.

The dipping sauce was a mild mango salad. I personally found this dish quite rich.

I'll try other dishes next time.

Parking is difficult because it's in a narrow alley with houses next to each other. The restaurant is on a corner. There's parking in front of the restaurant for about 2-3 cars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phanrat Phatchararatpreda

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was very unimpressed. The wait for food was extremely long; I had to rush them. After half an hour, I still hadn't received my food. Even home-cooked food shouldn't take this long. The staff's manners were terrible. I will definitely not be going back. The food tasted very ordinary. If I weren't in a hurry, I would have given the restaurant a direct comment, but I had to rush to another appointment.

P.S. Food was spilled on a customer, and they were completely indifferent. No apology or anything.

I'm giving this a million negative review and will never set foot there again.

Attached is proof that I actually ate there. The menu items I ordered are shown in the photos; these are the only ones I photographed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Baby Azalea

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall, everything was delicious, but some dishes had a unique flavor specific to the restaurant.

The squid in black ink sauce was tasty, the turmeric-fried sand fish was very good, but the yellow curry was a bit too sour; those who like sour flavors might enjoy it.

Cleanliness could be an issue, but it might just have been that day. There were flies in the restaurant and in the food (fried flies), but I continued eating after removing them because I understand. Those who are more concerned about hygiene might find it unpleasant.

Parking is available on the street. I went on a Sunday afternoon and found a spot wasn't difficult.

I would definitely come back if I'm in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poome Pet

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a truly authentic Southern Thai home-cooked restaurant. The ingredients are high quality. The boneless deep-fried tilapia is crispy on the outside but still tender and juicy on the inside. It's served with fish sauce and a spicy dipping sauce that's delicious with the fish roe. If you like fish roe, you must order this because there's a generous amount of it!
The sour curry with sea bass and coconut shoots is flavorful and not too spicy, making it easy to eat.
The stir-fried Gnetum leaves with egg have a generous amount of egg and leaves.
The braised pork has a strong black pepper flavor, not sweet at all, but I wish the pork was a little softer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanan J

sample_reviews_en.text:
The sour curry with sea bass and coconut shoots was incredibly delicious. It was sour, followed by salty and spicy. Most importantly, the fish was fresh and sweet, and the coconut shoots were fresh and crisp, with no odor at all. Delicious!!!

The stir-fried stink beans with shrimp paste was incredibly flavorful. Not too spicy (for my taste), with a hint of sweetness from the shallots. Delicious and well-balanced.

For dessert, we ordered the real sago palm. They were out of stock at first, but the restaurant made them fresh. It took a little while, but it was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: hapuy fluffy

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old original southern restaurant located in Soi Nawamin 74, Intersection 3-10. You can drive in and park on the side of the road in the alley. The reception staff are very friendly. If you order takeaway, you don't have to wait long for your food. The price of stir-fried shrimp paste with stink beans is not expensive and the amount is reasonable. The taste is strong and spicy. The taste is balanced by the roasted pork belly with salt.
sample_reviews_en.author: cosmo

sample_reviews_en.text:
As with most foodies, I love to try different restaurants and food to satisfy the taste bud. This restaurant falls under the category of a good find that I would like to come again to try out other dishes on the menu. Food is delicious though I find the stirred fried curry with red curry paste a bit too spicy for me and another dish a bit too sweet. But that is me, a foreigner.

By the way, the desserts by themselves are worth a return visit
sample_reviews_en.author: GL

sample_reviews_en.text: This is another restaurant I'd highly recommend. Every dish is delicious, authentic Southern Thai cuisine with bold, flavorful tastes. The shrimp is crispy and succulent, the coconut shoots are sweet, and the curry and shrimp paste aroma are amazing. The restaurant is quite small, with only 6-7 tables and one staff member, so service might be a little slow, but the food is truly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: poramet s

restaurants.name: อาม่าติ่มซำโฮมเมด Ama Dimsum Homemade
restaurants.address:

556 Rama IV Rd, Maha Phruttharam, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
#A-MaDimSum

This dim sum restaurant caught my eye when I walked past. The place looks beautiful and clean, and I could see the high-quality, fresh ingredients. The prices were reasonable, so I had to try it.

I ordered the fried chive dumplings as an appetizer; they were delicious, crispy, fragrant, and the dipping sauce was great. They came with hot and cold chrysanthemum tea, both tasty and not too sweet, reminding me of the old days when I used to buy them at the pharmacy.

Every dim sum dish was delicious and incredibly fresh. Unlike some famous dim sum chains that freeze ingredients and send them to branches to be steamed, this fresh preparation allows you to really appreciate the aroma and flavor.

The lava buns and mantou were all excellent; the dough and taste were perfect.

The Bak Kut Teh was amazing, incredibly fragrant with Chinese herbs.

I'll definitely go back again. The restaurant stays open late, which is great for those returning from a party.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thapakorn Pinpongphan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited for breakfast. The neighborhood has many delicious restaurants, and it was crowded with people parking on the street to eat. The restaurant is bright and clean. The staff provided excellent service, and all the dishes I ordered were delicious. They have a large selection of dim sum; you choose from the refrigerator, put them in a basket, and hand it to the staff for steaming. Besides that, they have a wide variety of soups, moo grob, stir-fried vegetables, noodles, bak kut teh, and more – so many choices it's hard to decide!

This is a good place to go when you're tired of spicy Thai food or want something lighter in the morning.

Of course, the restaurant is open until 2 AM, so you can also come for drinks and snacks from their extensive menu. It's a versatile place.
sample_reviews_en.author: toshio okamura (oka3)

sample_reviews_en.text:
A dim sum restaurant with reasonable prices.
The food tastes good, the dim sum is delicious, small and just the right size, not too big.
The shrimp dumplings are good, the wrapper is thin and translucent, the texture is bouncy, and there's plenty of shrimp inside.
The fried shrimp spring rolls are small and bite-sized, crispy on the outside.
The filling is packed with shrimp, and there's no shrimpy smell.
The Hong Kong style char siu noodles (listed as "Grandma's Style" on the menu)
are stir-fried to a perfect dryness, with a fragrant wok-fried aroma.
The seasoning is mildly salty with a hint of sweetness.
The char siu pork is good, not dry, firm, tender, and not chewy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Todsaporn Sritrakul

sample_reviews_en.text: A quickfix for dim sum craving at the odd hours. The shop has an extensive menu of dim sum and a variety of Canton style stir fry and rice dishes. You can choose a variety of dim sums and ask them to steam as per your choices. Bak Kut Teh was nice with soft pork ribs. Prices were on the expensive side but that was understandable since it is a proper restaurant. Hong Kong Style Stir Fry Noodles are recommended that the dish which stands out the most. Go there only if you are craving for a quick Canton style meal in the middle of the night. Parking can be done In front of the shop at night time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thusnai M

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is good for the price. It's not the big, Hong Kong-style dim sum, but more like the Hat Yai style dim sum. It comes with a dipping sauce made from fried chili peppers. The shrimp dumplings are tiny, and I personally like the chewy texture; those who prefer a lot of filling might not like it. Other steamed dishes have a clear broth that's like egg soup.
The char siu buns have a spiced flavor, the zongzi is pretty good, and the fried chives have a chewy texture. Overall, it's delicious. I'll try other things next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kayoo Chuen

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here. The braised pork knuckle was delicious; it tasted like it had been braised for a long time, the broth had soaked into the meat. It's located on Rama 4 Road, opposite and near Samyan. This place is famous for its Southern Cantonese-style noodles. I tried the soy sauce tofu, which I haven't seen on the menu in a while. Overall, I liked it. They said you can park in front of the shop, but I parked across the street at Samyan Market. I'll visit again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sutada Kittiwannakul

sample_reviews_en.text: Many choices for dimsum lovers with reasonable prices. The signature dishes were really tasty, while some of the dishes were a bit too sweet for me. Somehow, many locals may enjoy them this way. The staffs were attentive and polite. Too bad that they're only a few parking spaces by the road in front of the restaurant. In case you can't find a space, it's better to park at the Sam-yan market on the other side of the road and walk here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mister Friday13th

sample_reviews_en.text: The dim sum is delicious, in an old-fashioned style, with familiar flavors from childhood. The Betong noodles are also tasty. The downside is the parking; you have to park on the side of the road, and sometimes you can't even get a table because there's no parking. The staff aren't Thai; when I asked for extra sauce or a bowl, they just nodded but didn't do it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fatty girl

restaurants.name: ร้านอาหารเสวย
restaurants.address:

170 Sukhumvit 24 Alley, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was a little disappointed because I had planned to bring my family here to celebrate a birthday. We considered several restaurants before deciding on this one because the food in the pictures looked appetizing and the restaurant's atmosphere seemed inviting.

However, upon actually eating, I felt the quality had changed from what I had previously enjoyed. The portion sizes were smaller, and the taste was rather mediocre, not as delicious as before. Compared to the price, it felt like it wasn't worth it.

While we were eating, I saw quite a few Chinese tourist groups, which made me wonder if the restaurant might have adjusted the flavors to suit tourist tastes. This is just my personal opinion, though.

Therefore, I was quite disappointed this time, as I had intended to bring guests and family for a special occasion, and everyone shared the same opinion.

The staff were excellent, polite, and attentive. However, the taste and portion sizes didn't meet my expectations. This will likely be my last visit to this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bondi K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time at this restaurant. It's huge, with plenty of parking. The restaurant has many tables, perfect for parties and gatherings. The food is very diverse and delicious. The recommended dishes are excellent.

Some of the standout dishes include the oyster omelet (with large oysters), the stir-fried water spinach (fragrant, fresh, and crispy), and the delicious fish cakes.

For those with a sweet tooth, the mango sticky rice is a must-try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Owaychai Saelim

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Thai seafood restaurant with a great reputation.
The menu features delicious and reliable dishes like Pad Thai Kung, crab fried rice, and more. The Pu Pa Pong Curry is particularly good, with crab meat spread on top.
The prices are also reasonable, with a 6-7 course meal for a family of four coming in at around 2,000 baht. The service is excellent, and I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: D.S Han

sample_reviews_en.text: I didn't post about ordering because I was discussing work with foreigners. I was very impressed with the food; it was fresh, delicious, and the foreigners praised it highly. A friend recommended it, and the staff were very attentive and helpful. I was so busy with work that I couldn't finish everything and had a lot left over, which was a shame I couldn't take home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suesi C.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ambiance was great, the food was fresh and delicious, the grilled Thai prawns were cooked to perfection with springy meat, the curry crab was rich and flavorful, every dish was delicious, and the Thai milk tea was also very good. The staff were friendly, diligently clearing plates, and providing prompt service.

Highly recommend dining here! 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna Tsai

sample_reviews_en.text: Perhaps because it is located in a nice spot downtown, it was clean and tidy. I heard it is famous... but a wedding was taking place on one side while we were eating. It is a restaurant with good food and reasonable portions. I am not sure if the guide told us to remove the odor, but they said it was easy to eat because there was no strong smell.
sample_reviews_en.author: 임효묵

sample_reviews_en.text: I attended a wedding at Savoey Restaurant. The venue was beautifully decorated, creating a lovely atmosphere. The space was a good size for about 10 tables. The staff provided excellent service, the food was delicious, the air conditioning was cool, the chairs were comfortable, and the tables were large and round.
sample_reviews_en.author: Athikhom Srisornvaneekul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Truly a veteran in Thai/seafood cuisine.
The taste is consistently excellent, the service is great, and parking is convenient.
Recommended dishes include stir-fried cabbage, chicken gulai, fried liver, and moon-shaped spring rolls. Definitely coming back!
sample_reviews_en.author: โกญจนาท ศุกระเศรณี

restaurants.name: Buntudthongfishball Nawamin
restaurants.address:

448 Nawamin Rd, Khlong Kum, Bueng Kum, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really didn't want to give any stars, but if I don't give stars, I can't write a review.

Almost perfect, just... not accepting customers, just... only doing delivery orders, just... only doing takeout orders. Maybe try setting up a kiosk? Or if you're going to continue like this, find a manager. Also, separate stations for takeout/dine-in.

I was planning to eat here before going to the airport, just in case. Coming here for a quick meal before heading to the airport would be great!🤣😂
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalunthorn T

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent

This well-known chain restaurant maintains very high food standards. The food is delicious, and the portions are appropriate. The fried minced pork dumplings are especially tasty. The Yen Ta Fo sauce is milder than most modern restaurants, with a perfectly balanced flavor. I really liked it.

There's an air-conditioned seating area, but we preferred sitting outside for a nicer atmosphere.

Parking is very convenient. The restaurant is open until 9 PM, which is great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jack Worapan

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch of Banthat Thong Fishball Noodle Shop has seating both in air-conditioned and open-air. The area is a hub for several restaurants, so parking is plentiful. The taste is up to Banthat Thong's usual high standard – delicious! The service is quite good, attentive to customers and always happy to provide anything requested. The food took a little while to prepare, perhaps because it was busy today. Overall, it's very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanarat Prechawanich

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located on the main road and has a spacious parking area in front, accommodating many cars.
There is seating both outside and in an air-conditioned room. The staff provides good service, and there is a good variety of menu options. The food comes out quickly, and the portions are appropriate. The noodles and fish balls are made from fish meat. There are also rice dishes on the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: JARUNUN wudttirawadt

sample_reviews_en.text:
Banthat Thong Fish Ball Noodle Shop is famous for its delicious fish balls. I've been eating here regularly since I was a kid. My mom and dad have been eating here since they were in Yaowarat! 555
This branch has plenty of parking, which is great. The taste is delicious, and the seating area is spacious and airy, with both air-conditioned and outdoor seating. Open daily from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sakura Midori

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually eat at this restaurant regularly, both this branch and the Ladprao 71 branch, as well as ordering online for home delivery. I always order the same menu. Today, the noodles had a sour, unpleasant smell and were inedible. The quality has changed significantly. I don't think I'll be using their service again. Also, the wait was longer than usual, even though there wasn't a queue.
sample_reviews_en.author: nuttari k

sample_reviews_en.text:
Coming from kilometer 8, past the Wat Suwan Prasit alley, past the condo, it's on the left-hand side, opposite the Bangchak gas station. There's plenty of parking. It's nice and breezy, and they have air-conditioned rooms. Prices are 60-105 baht, plain ice is 2 baht. The taste is average.
Personally, I think Chiang's fish ball shop is better.
sample_reviews_en.author: teera k

sample_reviews_en.text: Fast. I got food in under 5 minutes. Noodles are bouncy and delicious. I like the shrimp balls the most and the shrimp is very moist and not dry. The fish balls are soft, moist and tender. The price is quite high compared to local stores. It is 70 baht. I recommend this place. Good restaurant. Has air conditioning inside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fishy Buy

restaurants.name: SALA 31 Cafe & Grill
restaurants.address:

19 18 หมู่ 3 Bangkruai-Sainon 31 Alley, Bang Si Thong, Bang Kruai District, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I like this place. We had dinner here several times and their fish are always fresh. No matter be it the whole Fried Seabass in Fish Sauce you ordered, or the slices of Seabass meat stir fired with Thai herbs, they will always be quality and flavors upheld. This place is also famous for its moo-ka-ta, many people come here for that iconic Thai dining experience. They have a band that comes in the night, alcoholic beverages accompanying into the late hours. A place for good social dining. The place is also a café, but unfortunately, you will not be able to enjoy a good cup of Joe because it appears to be a tuition center of some sort in the afternoon. There is always a cluster of teachers and students occupying the café section (so I can’t give 5 stars for the atmosphere). They do not seem to feel any remorse for turning the purpose of a café into their own personal space. So, for chilling and a good meal this place be, a café not so it is.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khun Lim

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, with an air-conditioned area of ​​about 4-5 tables, perfect for chilling and chatting with friends. There's live music. They have a wide variety of dishes, and most of them are delicious. The lemon sauce fried chicken is amazing, and the jellyfish salad is sweet and sour. My only criticism is that the instant noodle salad had hard noodles, like the water wasn't boiled properly. Most dishes are priced around 159 baht, which is considered high for some items. There's parking available next to the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vawie

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, every dish from the main courses to the appetizers. The atmosphere is relaxed, with live music, including 80s, 90s, and 2000s hits, and they also have Thai-style BBQ.
Perfect for hanging out with friends or having a family meal.
The staff provides good service.

Dishes ordered:
- German pork knuckle
- Stir-fried mixed vegetables (with pungent herbs)
- Salmon salad
- Glass noodle salad
- Clear tom yum soup with sea bass
- Deep-fried pork belly with fish sauce
- Fried chicken with lemon sauce
- Grilled beef
- Grilled pork
sample_reviews_en.author: Elaell Peredhil

sample_reviews_en.text:
A great find! From the moment we walked in, the place felt warm and welcoming. The service was attentive, and the staff made sure we had a great experience. The food was nicely presented and full of flavor of Thai.

I like the live music added a nice touch to the atmosphere, and the selection of Thai local beers was a great to experiences.

Most importantly, the local owner is very helpful and speaks English, making it easy for visitors. Plus, there’s convenient parking. Definitely worth a visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kun Kitikun

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my go-to bar, lol.
The liquor is perfectly chilled, and the mixers are ice cold.
The food tastes good and the prices are reasonable.
There's both air-conditioned and open-air seating.
There's live music (on some days).
And I didn't encounter any checkpoints on the way home, lol.
The staff are attentive and keep mixing drinks. 🤣
What more could you ask for?
sample_reviews_en.author: Pokchat Boonyaku

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, and the staff, both men and women, are friendly and polite. They offer beer, snacks, and meals, which are prepared quickly. There's live music, though I'm not sure of the exact dates, so it's best to check with the staff beforehand. The atmosphere is quite private and not too busy. Overall, it's suitable for meetings. 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Phaka Dhamma for Life

sample_reviews_en.text: The stove was very dirty, not to mention the pans which were stained. The seating area didn't feel clean. The food tasted terrible. I ordered fried rice for my son; it tasted good but took an inexplicably long time. The garlic and chilies were blackened, which we weren't used to, or maybe they were old and had been refrigerated for too long.
sample_reviews_en.author: edDo pongsakorn

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great; it's a chill restaurant. The staff provides excellent service. There's no corkage fee for bringing your own alcohol, and they constantly refill your drinks.😅 The prices are moderate, neither expensive nor cheap, but the food is delicious and flavorful. The Tom Yum soup and various salads are spicy and well-seasoned.
sample_reviews_en.author: May May

restaurants.name: Tense.bkk (กาล)
restaurants.address:

252 Somdet Chao Phraya 5, Somdet Chao Phraya, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
An absolutely perfect experience from start to finish.

The service was outstanding, our server was incredibly kind, attentive, and genuinely cared about making our evening special. A special mention to the chef as well, whose passion truly shines through his work. You can feel the depth of research and creativity behind each dish, elevating Thai cuisine in a refined and modern way.

Every dish was delicious. The seafood was exceptionally fresh and beautifully prepared. Our absolute favorites were the Ocean Treasure, the Tense Pasta, and the Chu Chi Black Cod Fish, unforgettable dishes, perfectly balanced and full of flavor.

The cocktails and wine were also excellent, thoughtfully selected and perfectly complementing the food.

An exceptional restaurant in Bangkok that I highly recommend. We enjoyed every moment and will definitely return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amaya

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently dined at Tense BKK and had an exceptional experience. The food was not only delicious but also presented with precision. The ambience provided a perfect setting for an enjoyable meal. What stood out was the chef's personal touch, as they took the time to explain each dish at our table. The staff, notably our server, were not only friendly but also displayed a high level of professionalism.

As a mostly-female party, we greatly appreciated the server's assistance in ensuring our safety that evening. His courteous gesture of walking us to our hired car and helping us communicate our requests to the driver added an extra layer of customer care. Tense BKK not only excels in culinary delights but also in providing a thoughtful and accommodating dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Choi Orcena

sample_reviews_en.text:
Unimpressed food with great service.

Great things about this restaurant are the service and the decoration. The waitress was very polite, service mind and educational about the menu. The waitress provided storytelling for every dish.

The food was unique and dulled at the same time.

Enjoy the Sexy Chilies and Sun garden, it was flavorful, creative, and inspirational.

Chicken Playground, What a truffle, and Trat Namphrik Ong - Crispy Pork was a bit dulled. (not bad for taste but unimpressed)

Disappointed with “Salted Yolky Sous Vide black cod fillet” - the name gave us the impression of “salted yolks” but it tastes the same as Stir Fried Crab with Curry Powder.

Hopefully, brunch and cafe could change the rating for this restaurant.

Parking is available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Awaybutnotalone “Awaybutnotalone”

sample_reviews_en.text:
I couldn't believe how people could give this restaurant a five-star review.
NOT WORTH THE MONEY.
To be honest, I felt like I'd been robbed and I want my money back.

The taste is not bad but not a wow. And not match the price.

We had Khana-Plakhem for an appetizer and we get 1 piece of sourdough (520thb as I remember)

The atmosphere is even worst.
I've been drinking wine here with the Chinese house god🙄 I mean,
I'm not being offensive but the price is nearly fine dining but it is just a Thai-Chinese house re-decorated.

The restaurant is an open bar style but the bar is a mess, unwell organized, and always noisy. We can't even hear what the waiter said.

Bad experience and we’re not coming back ever again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mirei

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was okay but I many times have been to the places that did better in the same price range. I liked the creativity and the concept of time they used, but some dishes to me needed more balance in flavours and the rest tasted okay but nothing special. Loved the cocktails. The service was on the good side but too good that can make some people feeling awkward. I even needed to ask the staff to leave me alone since I got an important call from work after paying and waited outside for the car, which he refused and that caused me to the need to cancel the call and get the bike to just leave as soon as possible. Sometimes great service means you listen and respect the choices of your customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: A Lin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don’t know where to start about this place at all. Truly a gem.

Every dish served was so thoughtfully curated and tastes so delicious.

I ordered one dish from every section and none of it disappointed me. It was fantastic. The scallop on truffle brioche was bomb. The rigatoni alla vodka was to die for. My partner loved the small bites tom yum krathong.

The seabass with cilantro was so refreshing. We ended with a brown butter dessert and that also was so satisfying.

I am definitely going to come back here and I really hope everybody gets to experience the amazing food that they serve.

It was so creative and I cannot wait to be back
sample_reviews_en.author: Pree Chawla

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolute delight!

I love the Sunset beans coffee, cld really taste the whisky of the roast.

This is our 2nd lunch of the day hence we ordered a Foccacia and Chicken Pla to share.

The focaccia was very fresh, the accompanied ingredients such as kale really goes very well with the running yolk on top.

The Chicken Pla was fry to the optimum temperature, tender on the inside and crispy on the outside. The tom yum style sauce, flavorful and rich, it goes so well with this dish. The marinated tomatoes really blew us away. It was sweet and cooking to end off this dish.
sample_reviews_en.author: cindy teo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great food! And even greater service!

All the food are superb and extremely beautifully done. Lots of the dishes we had are delicately done and taste amazing. Job’s Tear take on Risotto are sooo good!!!

I found the price range is a bit on the upper side, similar to what’s on Sukhumvit Rd. Though food quality and taste doesnt compromised here, it might be considered tad bit pricey for Thonburi side, hence this put Tense.bkk a different positioning from other places on this side of Bangkok.

Ps. Wine selection here are inexpensive but The Tense cocktail is a must!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kuang Kobkijcharoen

restaurants.name: Toh Kim - Park Silom
restaurants.address:

ตึกปาร์คสีลม ชั้นL, เลขที่ 1 Convent Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
OVER-RATED chicken rice. A place that I will not return for a second time…
Chicken: Good and quite juicy. However for a XL size portion, it is rather pathetic. Hardly can we tell whether it’s half a chicken or less coz it’s all piece and pieces. More like “leftovers” of what can’t be sold.

Rice: Horrendous. Super oily unlike others that we had tried. The minute you put the rice in your mouth, it tasted like a layer of oil lingering. Also, it has a “powdery” feeling.

Sauces: Chilli sauces are good. But not the black soy sauce. Tasted like caramelised sweet sauce.

Service: Good but can be better. Very messy and out of control. When we ask for a bill, Staff gave us the wrong bill. She didn’t even know she made a mistake and gave a very STUPID look. We had to explained to her numerous time till we ask one of the executive to help. Gee… she must go back for training.

Compared to those chicken rice from Montien Hotel and Boon Tong Kee, Toh Kim needs to do better. At least we know we pay for what we ordered. Well, from what I can see it’s the MANAGEMENT need to work hard and see their shortcomings. If they are an arrogant type of management, no point to give feedbacks. True?
sample_reviews_en.author: Allen Yeo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thai-Hainanese Chicken Rice at Park Silom (a famous restaurant)
*The rice is fragrant with garlic but a bit soggy and can get cloying after a while. The portion per bowl is a bit small.
*Boiled or minced chicken is available in your preferred size. The meat is tender and the skin is thick but not too greasy.
*Fried chicken tastes good, but the skin isn't very crispy.
*Mixed offal (gizzard, liver, blood) is good, the meat is tender, but sliced ​​too thinly, not very satisfying. The soy sauce topping is delicious; it's not necessary to add garlic as it masks the aroma of the soy sauce.
*Spicy chicken wing and winter melon soup is flavorful and helps to cut through the richness of the rice.
*Pickled radish is crispy, delicious, and tasty.
*Fried tofu with tamarind sauce has delicious tofu, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. The tamarind sauce is flavorful and rich.
*Soybean dipping sauce is fragrant, delicious, and tasty. Chili and ginger are provided to add.
*The staff provides good and fast service.
*The atmosphere is a bit crowded. The restaurant is small, and there are many people waiting. Sitting inside is hot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lara Linh

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first visit. I ordered the plain boiled chicken, it came with a small side of zucchinis and two slices of blood pudding. Also, ordered the cucumber with sesame oil and a bowl of plain white rice. They gave me a free soup, it was slightly spicy with coriander, pieces of winter mellon, and a small piece blood pudding. The chicken was tender and juicy, the cucumber was fresh and tasty.  The soup was good as well, they even provide a refill for the soup, so I had an extra bowl.. I paid THB 275 for the meal which I thought was good value. The service was quick and efficient, the staff were very attentive suc as asking if I wanted a second serving of soup. The restaurant was not that big but the overall environment and atmosphere was OK. I would definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuklc Yuklc

sample_reviews_en.text:
Toh-Kim certainly makes a good first impression with its nicely decorated shop. The ambiance is a cut above many other chicken rice establishments, which is a definite plus.

However, the dining experience had its drawbacks. The chicken liver, unfortunately, had a rather yucky, not-smooth texture that was quite off-putting. Similarly, the chicken itself was a bit tough for my liking, making it less enjoyable than expected. While the rice had a good aroma, I found it somewhat hard to swallow, which was a shame given its promising scent.

Overall, considering the quality of the main components, Toh-Kim felt quite pricy compared to other chicken rice shops in the market. While the decor is appealing, the food itself didn't quite hit the mark for me, especially at its price point.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ben C

sample_reviews_en.text:
Toh Kim Hainanese Chicken Rice is one of the most recommended spots for chicken rice lovers. The rice is fragrant and flavorful without being greasy, while the chicken is tender, juicy, and freshly prepared. The dipping sauce is rich, savory, and perfectly complements both the rice and the chicken.

The restaurant itself is simple and casual but clean and comfortable. Service is friendly and efficient. Portions are generous for the price, with options like boiled chicken, crispy fried chicken, and side dishes such as soup and offal that many regulars recommend.

Overall, Toh Kim offers a well-balanced, satisfying chicken rice experience that’s great for breakfast, lunch, or a quick meal any time of day. Definitely a place worth trying if you’re in the area!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sittitam Ruengcharungpong

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a Thai-Singaporean fusion style Hainanese chicken rice. The chicken is sliced ​​thickly; I ordered the breast, and it was cooked until juicy. The skin seems to have the fat removed. If you prefer chicken that requires more chewing, this isn't for you because it's incredibly tender. The rice is quite expensive per bowl, but it's fragrant with garlic and soft. The dipping sauce is sweet with a hint of saltiness. The soup is excellent, with a savory, slightly salty flavor, containing small pieces of chicken and vegetables. Refills are available. Personally, I found it delicious. The atmosphere is like a typical shopping mall restaurant, with a Chinese-style decor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanomjeankai P.

sample_reviews_en.text: This chicken rice restaurant offers a unique combination of Hainanese and Thai styles. The steamed chicken is tender, and the fried chicken is perfectly crispy on the outside while remaining soft inside. Several types of sauces are provided, adding variety to the meal. Although the price is slightly expensive, the quality and taste make it worthwhile. The store’s layout is unusual, with the kitchen located in the middle and seating areas on both sides. This design sometimes causes staff to overlook customers on one side.
sample_reviews_en.author: NNchan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Might come back if they would have change some recipe 🍚
The rice texture is somewhat odd, doesn’t taste like normal fully cooked. The taste and flavor could be a little bit more intense.

The wing was too bland.

The thigh was well, the doneness, the tender, the taste, and its fragrance are all well.

The sauces were amazing, all kind you would need. 👍

The best menu was the liver and gizzard, it was beyond perfect.

By overall, for now if you miss it, do not regret. Wait for after soft opening and let’s find out again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ritthikorn Siriprasertchok

sample_reviews_en.text: How could I say it not in a bad light, but this is not a bar that I would spend a night with tbh. I was there cuz my friend wanna grab beers before getting to night clubs. And it was very boring while I was there with my friend. The virgin bloody Mary was basically a tomatoes juice with a celery in it, nothing else. Better pregame at 7-11 or other minimart to save your money. However, if you have some extra coins, just go show them love. Support the community, and don’t be such a stingy person like me (sorry, but I’m a broke person from a 3rd-world country 🤷‍♀️)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don’t know how the reviews are so horrible for the staff. Every single person we have encountered tonight has been super lovely. Free popcorn, drinks constantly topped up, photos and silly TikTok videos taken for us. It’s our friends birthday and they put a candle in a brownie and brought it out singing happy birthday. They could not have done anymore to make us feel welcomed. Great bar. Great vibe. Great staff. 💯 recommend 🙌🏽
- Straight Gal from Aus with a faggy best friend 🏳️‍🌈
sample_reviews_en.author: Julz Perry

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there in soi 4 for eating during 4 days and the last day I arrive at 19:55 for happy hour so I place my cocktail order at 19:59 and they refused me happy hour finish at 20:00 !!!!! Omg I never saw that !! The kitchen is not so bad but no smile here !! Or just one smile to remember you are a Farang who must pay the full price all the time!!! If you can go in other bar take the other one!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yann Me

sample_reviews_en.text: Last year, my partner and I came here for drinks. We were served by a deaf-mute waiter who was very attentive and friendly, and the other staff members are great too. That's why we came back this year and also had something to eat. It was delicious. The outdoor tables could be spaced further apart, but that's the only thing we can complain about.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jennifer Bardon

sample_reviews_en.text:
" A True Gem in Silom "

I stumbled upon this small restaurant in Silom and was pleasantly surprised. The food was delicious, packed with authentic flavors that made every bite memorable. The service was outstanding—attentive and friendly. Definitely worth a visit for a genuine taste of local cuisine and a warm, welcoming atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Folk’s Story

sample_reviews_en.text: The food at this restaurant is delicious, and the staff are also lovely and friendly. If you're looking for a delicious Thai restaurant near Pat Pong Market, I highly recommend this restaurant I've been here with my family five times now, and I've been impressed every time. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiratchaya

sample_reviews_en.text: We didn't try the food, so I can't rate it. The drinks were excellent, though. The service was great, everyone was friendly and nice. We wanted to come back, so we did :) A family trip. Prices are typical of pubs. AAA, and they're looking for a full-time DJ :) (end of June 2025).

sample_reviews_en.text: Be cautious about the pricing. When I raised concerns about overcharging, they reviewed the bill and made adjustments. However, upon closer inspection, I noticed the overcharge hadn't actually been corrected. When I inquired further, they …

sample_reviews_en.text: On April 15, 2015, my family of seven went to eat at the Central Rama 3 branch. Just as I was about to put some chicken in my mouth, a rat ran up to me under my table. Since the whole family was already afraid of rats, they all jumped onto their chairs. I tried calling the staff and telling them there was a rat, but they ignored me and continued serving food to other customers as if nothing had happened, even though a customer at a nearby table had been shouting about a rat. About five minutes later, a female staff member walked by and called out to them, so they helped move the table. They were responsible for two bottles of water, but the tomboy staff member I had initially called to help didn't come to help or even bother to offer any help. There was no apology, only an apology from the female staff member who was walking by.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarunpong Phukchomngam

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating at this restaurant for a long time, and the food always tastes great. However, today I encountered a problem with the plain rice; they ran out and it took quite a while to cook. If they knew the plain rice wouldn't be enough and would take this long, they should have informed customers from the start. Customers could then decide whether to continue eating here or go to another restaurant. They only told me about the long wait after I'd ordered my food. And eating plain rice with sticky rice isn't really a good combination either. It was a very disappointing experience. I've eaten at this restaurant many times over the years and never had this problem before. I hope they will improve and address this issue. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kampon

sample_reviews_en.text: The food, especially the papaya salad, spicy salad, and fried fish, tasted delicious; I highly recommend them. However, I wouldn't recommend the grilled chicken and grilled pork neck. They weren't hot at all; they should have been prepared in advance and kept warm. There weren't many staff members in the area where we were sitting. We asked for seafood dipping sauce several times because we wanted to eat it with the fried fish, but we never received it. The staff didn't even acknowledge our request, which was confusing, especially since there weren't many customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: bokbaek

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, and the service was almost good. There's a call button, but… I pressed it three times and no one came. I suggest removing this button altogether. I also had to ask for my ice cream… it took a very long time, 10-15 minutes, and I had to ask three times before I finally got it.

While pressing the call button didn't bring anyone, the bill came very quickly.

Finally, there was no apology from any of the staff; they just had grumpy expressions.

I recommend these improvements.
sample_reviews_en.author: นายพงษ์ชัย วัชรเขื่อนขันธ์

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered grilled chicken, sticky rice and papaya salad.  The chicken was served in 10 minutes but the other two never come.  Had to follow up many times and waited for a long time.  I got mad when I saw that two other tables that came afterwards were served all the food.  Money and time were wasted for a poor standard food and service.
sample_reviews_en.author: 0uileng Saetang

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! The food here focuses on Thai-style dishes, with great flavors like grilled chicken, grilled chicken thighs, and papaya salad. The restaurant is located inside Central Rama 3. Parking is available at the mall. There's a wide selection on the menu, and the prices aren't too high.
sample_reviews_en.author: PotDoi Story

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually eat here. Today, I was standing in front of the restaurant waiting for someone to come and take me to my table. The staff walked in and out and looked at me like it wasn't their job to take the table. They didn't say anything. Hmm, so I just walked out. I didn't get to eat. The end.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yin Work

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant offers a menu that you can order on your own phone. It is a new normal. I think it is very impressive and you can how much your order will cost you after finishing the ordering. The service is very efficient and friendly. So far I have not been disappointed at fried fish here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nong Ch.

restaurants.address:

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited as a party of three and ordered six dishes, giving us a good variety to try.

The clear tom yum soup with prawns (25% spice) had a pleasant tangy flavour that was refreshing without being overwhelming. The grilled pork neck was tender with a lovely charred aroma that added great depth. The lemon squid had a well-balanced combination of spicy and sour flavours, making it one of our favourites.

The mango salad, also ordered at 25% spice, was fresh and enjoyable, though I think 50% spice would have complemented the strong dressing and mango flavours even better. The chicken wings were exceptionally tender and the meat came off the bone effortlessly. Finally, the stir-fried cabbage was lightly seasoned and served as a great palate cleanser alongside the more intensely flavoured dishes.

Overall, the food was delicious and well prepared. My only minor feedback is that the lighting around the high tables was a little dim, and the music could have been slightly softer to make conversation more comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wilfrid Chua

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited from Japan, and overall, everything was fantastic! The atmosphere was great, and the Thai food was absolutely delicious. We were lucky to catch their Buy 1 Get 1 Free happy hour, too. The pricing was completely transparent and exactly as stated on the menu.
We ordered Tom Yum Goong, two other dishes, and two highballs, which came out to around 1,300 THB. While it might be slightly on the pricier side by local standards, the food quality is top-notch, and the restaurant is clean with a wonderful ambiance. Personally, I think it's a great spot and well worth a visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Art I

sample_reviews_en.text: In the evening, I had a Tom Yum soup and mango sticky rice, both excellent. There was a DJ playing great local and international pop music—the sound was perhaps a little loud, but it was fine. So much so that I came back the next day for lunch to have fried fish and mango salad, which was very fresh and cooked to perfection—simply excellent. The staff is also very pleasant and attentive. I highly recommend it; the atmosphere is great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrice H

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good place, little noisy perhaps on the music front and not the cheapest place about for sure - worked out about 20% more than other places we had eaten this week. That said the food was amazing, the staff were polite and helpful and the place was clean and fresh.

Good little fond if you’re in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Southgate

sample_reviews_en.text: We found this restaurant by walking around near our hotel. This is a nice but not too fancy restaurant. Every dish we have ordered is perfectly made and tastes so delicious. I’m very impressed. The service is excellent and the atmosphere is nice too. We have dinned here twice in our five days in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Land Rambler

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great value 2 for 1 beer promotion.

This place is great, in an area where food options are all kind of too fancy and expensive. Food quality was good, service was perfect.

Don’t let the fact that it seems kind of like a generic chain deter you. Definitely recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike Finkelstein

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went for dinner during my stay at the Conrad.

The happy hour was good, the atmosphere was nice, and the Thai food was really delicious.

I was sad because they cleared the table with quick service just as I was almost finished eating.
sample_reviews_en.author: jina park

sample_reviews_en.text: The air conditioning is cool and the atmosphere is clean. It transforms into a pub vibe in the evening. The food is delicious. For dinner on the last day, I had steamed fish, pork neck, and shrimp fried rice, and I was very satisfied.
sample_reviews_en.author: 성raon
