353 Phra Tamnak, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came for a quick bite before our departure, couldn’t order anything else because the staff said they’ll take longer time to prepare. friend rice is okay, while the fried basil chicken with rice is a little salty. They play some background jazz piano and the seating are quite spacious. Pricing like the rest of the hotel’s restaurants is reasonable..
The concern we had was when we came in at 11:50 was there’s no one at the front and we had to get the menu and seating ourselves and find the staffs to order afterwards.. Maybe because they’re still busy preparing at the back or having staff meeting but hotel stated that this restaurant opens 24H, this shouldn’t happen.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anita Rosaleh

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a truly wonderful experience at the hotel and at the Panoráma Étterem! From the moment we arrived, we felt genuinely welcomed – the service was exceptionally kind, attentive, and professional.
The Sky Terasz is simply magical! The drinks were fantastic, the atmosphere was amazing, and it’s hands down the most beautiful sunset spot. We absolutely loved watching the sunset from there – it was an unforgettable experience every single evening.
A special thank you Nasin and Luilasinee for being extra kind and thoughtful with the children as well. It truly means a lot to families. A warm, family-friendly place that we would happily return to anytime! 💛
sample_reviews_en.author: Bogi Orosz

sample_reviews_en.text:
Breakfast here was truly impressive — wide variety, delicious flavors, and everything beautifully prepared. What stood out most was the warm, attentive service from every staff member.

Special thanks to Chef Ratchanee, who made us feel so welcome with her kind recommendations and genuine care. She took time to share about the food and made sure everything was perfect.

We left with full hearts and happy smiles. Definitely coming back to Royal Cliff and Panorama next time in Pattaya! 🌅✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Siren Ja

sample_reviews_en.text: Sirnya at the front desk was helpful and spoke English making my experience great. She would contact her boss/collegue Jane when things needed to get done. As a strict vegetarian it was not only amazing to have so many clearly labeled options but the special request service to get tofu was so wonderful (us vegheads need our 9 essential amino acids) and it was facilitated in such a wonderful and professional way by both Sirnya and Jane who went out of their way to give me a great time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chadwick Schroeckenthaler

sample_reviews_en.text:
My family and I just stayed at the Royal Cliff Grand Hotel in early September 2025, and we were totally in love with its stunning clifftop location.
​Our room was spacious and clean, and close-up view of the sea. We also got to try the Afternoon Tea at the Beach Terrace and watched a beautiful sunset.
​A special thank you to Khun Nasin and Khun Wilasinee for their amazing hospitality and service. The food and desserts were beautiful and very good taste.
You have to try this!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nawarat Makayatorn

sample_reviews_en.text: Nasin was everywhere making sure guests were happy and getting all their needs met, as well as caring conversation to get to know people! I can highly recommend Panorama for ambiance, food, and employees like Nasin! (He taught me what Pandan plant is and even went to find a leaf!). I ate there 3 times (breakfast lunch and dinner) and it was all good! The sea bass was delicious as were the tropical salad and Alfredo pasta I ate!  Breakfast had lots of options!
sample_reviews_en.author: Megan Olson

sample_reviews_en.text: My wife and I stayed at the Royal Cliff Beach Terrace for one week for our wedding reception. We met Nasin at the breakfast on the first day where he already knew who we were and made sure we were taken care of for our entire stay. The entire staff was by far the most professional, attentive, welcoming, and kind team I have ever experienced, and we cannot wait to get back here to do it all again. Thank you Nasin for treating us like Royalty!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dustin

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a wonderful experience at Panorama for breakfast. The variety of food offered is impressive, catering to different tastes and preferences. Everything was fresh, flavorful, and well-presented. The service was equally outstanding. Staff were attentive, friendly, and made sure everything was perfect. The overall atmosphere was warm and welcoming. Highly recommend it for anyone looking for a satisfying and enjoyable breakfast experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratthasirin Wangkanond

restaurants.name: Salad Factory - The Crystal SB Ratchaphruek
restaurants.address:

RC5X+XF4, Maha Sawat, Bang Kruai District, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Garden feeling / green / fresh & airy creates an environment to settle in for lunch or dinner. A/C of course a plus ✅. In the USA our favorite restaurant is at home yet here at the Salad Factory they have 5x the offerings which takes dining to a better level. Every green leaf whether Cos , rocket or otherwise is here as a foundation for our perfect salad. Next 5 veggie choices or more for a little extra. Freshness matters here and they serve many meals keeping the offerings fresh ! Add nuts, berries, raisins,  and choose a main dressing or more. ( I mixed Caesar & Red wine vinegar ) , croutons are available , I added bleu cheese along with a slice of Kanom pan gatiem ( garlic/ cheese toast ). Always delighted as I am a salad officiando and Salad Factory is above the rest. Glad they have fresh fruit smoothies as a strawberry banana choice wins out 🏅. Pricing is really fair - remember they have enough to allow for the perfect salad creations , so add items to suit your desire. Thanks also to The Crystal for the insight to have this establishment , always a highlight !!! I must mention that these servers / staff are super hygenic , attentive and kind. 5 ⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: Greg Alexander

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is spacious and located on the 1st floor of Central Ratchaphruek.
The dishes I ordered and liked at this branch are:
🦀
Soft-shell crab salad with chili and salt
(The dressing is spicy, sweet and sour, a good seafood flavor)
🍤
Fried shrimp and fruit salad (served in a beautiful woven basket, I'm not sure if it's made of taro. It tasted good, but was a bit hard.)
The price and the portion size are very good value.
🥗
The mixed fried mushrooms with salt were also delicious. Dipping them in the sauce (I think it was chicken sauce) and it came with a small salad.
🥖
The bread and garlic chips only came with 4 slices. The bread was thick, very filling. Compared to what you get, the price is a bit high. It would probably be better with soup. But for 3 people, ordering this much was more than enough.

Overall, the atmosphere, taste, and price are all excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: pong chaivoot

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm a frequent customer and the food is always delicious, but I have to deduct points because the service is consistently slow. I always wait almost 30 minutes for my food, even when the restaurant isn't full. I understand there are a lot of Grab orders, but sometimes the queuing system is strange. I ordered takeout myself and waited at the restaurant. I ordered first, even before other tables that came in at the same time, but my order was the last. Two tables that arrived at the same time had already finished their meals and ordered a second time, and I still hadn't received my order, even though I only ordered a salad, nothing grilled or fried. Please improve this.
sample_reviews_en.author: TaTja_p

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the great restaurant in crystal ratchapruek , the medium size department store at the middle of ratchaphruke road, this restaurant mainly sells food with various kind of vegetable.

I tried fried duck with rocket salad which is very delicious , the duck is very crispy but soft inside , rocket salad and sauces are also tasty.

The desserts here are also very nice , the cold yogurt with mango are not too sweat and look healthy, not mention the honey toast which is high calories but worth try.

Anyway i would like to visit this restaurant in the future with my family again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Purich Surunchupakorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, the staff is polite but sometimes a bit slow. The atmosphere is nice. / I really liked the glass noodle salad, it was well-seasoned. The soup was also good, and the yogurt bowl was delicious.

*Update June 2025*
I think there are too few staff members. Everyone seems hardworking and constantly doing things, but there aren't enough to serve all the customers, resulting in very long wait times. There were also some mistakes with the orders. I understand they might be overwhelmed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cps Bypc

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant that my family really likes and comes here often. The food tastes good, it's delicious and healthy. However, some menu items are a bit confusing, like the scallop steak; sometimes there are 6 scallops, sometimes there are only 3. We haven't ordered it lately because we're afraid we won't be full 😁 The prices aren't too expensive, they're reasonable. The service is good, the restaurant has a comfortable decor, and it's clean inside. Give it a try, you won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Niccy nan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This salad shop offers high-quality, fresh, and clean salads at reasonable prices for the quality. The portion sizes are just right, and they have a diverse menu including salads, steaks, burgers, appetizers, and various rice dishes.
The staff provides good service. The restaurant has about 10-20 tables, and it can get quite busy during meal times, but the wait for a table or food isn't long.
You can park in The Crystal parking lot for free.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐพงศ์ มูลพันธุ์

sample_reviews_en.text: I called at 3:20 PM to order three items. The person who answered said it would be ready in 20 minutes. In summary, I arrived half an hour later and waited another half hour. There were only two tables occupied in the restaurant. They said they had a lot of orders. If you can't manage time, don't be an order taker; find a different job. The owner needs to improve.
sample_reviews_en.author: กมลทิพย์ วุฒิปราโมทย์

restaurants.name: DID - Dine in the Dark
restaurants.address:

a Luxury Collection Hotel, Sheraton Grande, 250 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
An unique dining experience in Bangkok. I highly recommend DID Bangkok to tourists or anyone looking for an unforgettable night out with friends. Reasonably priced menu, great food, and excellent service.

There are however few things I’d recommend DID to change. The waiter working outside the dark room should go through a more intensive English training, as we were unable to understand a word he was saying, which led to countless confusion and misunderstanding. DID also needs a lot more waiting staff at the bar area. After our waiter brought us out, he disappeared and no one came to serve us. We didn’t even get our after meal beverages and had to leave because we were waiting for way too long. Last but not least, they were extremely fixated on us not finishing the soup. We explained 3 times that it’s more common for us to eat the “stuff” in the soup, and not drink the liquid. However, due to language barrier, we felt somewhat uncomfortable when bombarded with interrigatory questions.

Nevertheless, these are all minor problems. That was my 3rd visit to DID Bangkok and I would continue to visit this establishment every time I bring friends to Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kevin Lin

sample_reviews_en.text: Dining at Dine in the Dark, is an experience I won't soon forget. You enter through BarSu at the Sheraton Grande, and from the moment we walked in, the service was exceptional. The staff, particularly Khun Moo, made us feel incredibly welcome. Khun Moo's warmth and guidance eased us into the experience, creating a comfortable atmosphere amidst the initial uncertainty of dining in complete darkness. The concept of eating without sight initially felt daunting, but to my surprise, it turned out to be much easier and more enjoyable than I had anticipated. The absence of visual distractions allowed me to fully immerse myself in the sensory experience of the meal, heightening my other senses and making the dining experience uniquely cozy and intimate. As for the food, while it was satisfactory, it was the overall experience that truly made the meal memorable. Dine in the Dark offers a journey that challenges your senses, and a rare opportunity to disconnect from the visual world and connect with more strongly with the people around you and the nuanced layers of flavors.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ivo Niet

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stepping into a completely dark dining room, you'll enter another world. Expert visually impaired guides will lead you and provide assistance throughout your 4-course meal. The menu rotates monthly, offering a choice of Thai, Western, or a surprise selection prepared by the hotel.

Even familiar dishes take on a whole new dimension in the dark. You'll delight in discovering new sensations as you slowly grasp, cut, and taste, guessing what's on your plate before the restaurant reveals it at the end of your course. Each dish features intriguing textures, like the 3 amuse-bouche I tried, or a main course with diverse elements, such as salmon confit with tarragon hollandaise alongside beef in orange sauce. (Don't worry about repeat menus; they change regularly, and you can inform them of any allergies in advance.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Korn KnightZ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Waiter was so funny, so attentive, so cool, the experience is always worth it, if you haven’t done something like this, and you want to, and bangkok is your best bet, do it!

👎The food was rather bad, I’ve been to a few Dining in Dark’s and the food felt subpar compared to the others.

👎 it smelled really bad inside. It took awhile to get over the poor stench

👎 normally, after being in total darkness you’d want to be eased into other senses.

🚫NOPE, NOT here, after your meal they straight up walk you into a super night club to sit and wait for check. It was really loud and bright in the club/bar and not what I’d want, nor any of my guest wanted after darkness for 2 hours. I really recommend they consider a calm reception room with tea and coffee to chill out and ease into reality again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brad Badly

sample_reviews_en.text:
From the moment we stepped into Dine in the Dark, we knew we were in for something extraordinary. The 4-course meal was absolutely delicious—every single bite was bursting with flavor and expertly prepared. Not being able to see the food heightened every other sense, making each dish a delightful surprise.

The staff was incredibly attentive and professional, guiding us through the experience with warmth and care. Their ability to make us feel comfortable in total darkness was impressive and deeply appreciated.

This isn’t just dinner—it’s a captivating journey that challenges perception and leaves a lasting impression. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Bangkok. A must-try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Brianna Watson

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great experience at dine in the dark! Walked past this place and decided to give it a try. Wasn't aware that they hire visually impaired servers - it is really a good concept!

Food was really excellent and fabulous! Our server (Moo) speaks excellent english and has made our dinner enjoyable - always checking in and make sure that we are alright and that the dishes are to our taste. I did not mentioned prior that I do not like lamb and Moo immediately switched my dish for me upon knowing about it.

This is a must try for everyone! I booked through chope and had a B$500 discount. Once again, very grateful to Moo and the staffs for letting us such an enjoyable experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: J lim

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely loved our experience at Dine in the Dark! We just walked by and saw the sign, and decided to try it out - it was fantastic. The food was amazing and the experience overall is truly unique. All the waiters are completely blind, and you dine in absolute darkness. The food is easy to eat but a culinary treat that will leave you guessing - just as fun as eating it! We opted for the surprise menu, and they were great at accommodating any allergies and dietary preferences. Our waiter, Ball, was humourous, knowledgeable, and overall just spectacular. Highly recommend Dine in the Dark for a great evening of food and a very memorable time overall!
sample_reviews_en.author: Shub Sengupta

sample_reviews_en.text: Great experience for the surprise dinner here .. Was there with my sister and her bf .. Can't believe the service was amazing! All foods are delicious and all surprise me after knowing what it is !! If you don't like darkness, don't go, but if you are the one who loves to try something new and exciting experiences... you can't miss this !!! I love the most how friendly of the waitress that she is attentive and pay attention to us in every moment. Also, care about how we feel.. Love it all that night. Perfect service!! 🥰 Sorry too.. about the picture.. there foods all are secret so I can't show here how beautiful it is !! Haha
sample_reviews_en.author: Annyhandmade Ann

restaurants.name: Siam Cuisine
restaurants.address:

115 1 Surawong Rd, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely phenomenal! 3 day stop in Bangkok and we ended up eating here twice a day, each day! Why go elsewhere when the food is this delicious, affordably priced, in a lovely intimate space with air conditioning and fans, and is conveniently around the corner from the night market? After our first amazing meal we wanted to explore their entire menu!

Our absolute favorites: Penang curry chicken (+ white rice), deep fried fish in sweet chili sauce (+ white rice), sweet & sour shrimp (+ white rice), grilled barramundi fish salad, shrimp Pad Thai (light and flavorful!), fried spring rolls stuffed with chicken (got this twice!), chicken karaage (super moist and tender!), pineapple fried rice with shrimp, and Thai iced tea. Literally the highlight of our trip!! The food was worth it alone. Highly recommended 🙌
sample_reviews_en.author: SK

sample_reviews_en.text: There were a lot of mixups with the food. First I got the wrong dish. Then I got the regular papaya salad instead of the one with crab, then they just put the crab on top while it's supposed to be seasoned differently and then I had to send it back to the kitchen again because it was not spicy while I explicitly asked to make it spicy like for a Thai person. It's also supposed to be the most spicy dish on the menu. Even when they added some more chillies it was not really spicy but I didn't want to send it back to the kitchen a third time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ramses Verachtert

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a lovely experience at this Thai restaurant. The ambiance is warm and cozy, making it a perfect place to relax and enjoy a meal. The atmosphere feels inviting without being too busy or loud.

Their coffee was surprisingly good—rich, smooth, and a great complement to the food. It’s not always easy to find a place that does both Thai dishes and coffee well, but they definitely nailed it.

Overall, a great spot if you’re looking for delicious food, a comfortable vibe, and a nice cup of coffee to finish your meal. ☕✨
sample_reviews_en.author: michelle ann perez

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dined at Siam Cuisine and ordered the tom yum soup, chicken satay, sweet and sour fish, and cashew chicken — all the dishes were amazing, full of flavour and well prepared.

Unfortunately, they had run out of sticky rice that day, which was a bit disappointing. On the bright side, the watermelon and lime smoothie was super refreshing and paired really well with the meal.

Prices were very affordable, making this a great spot for tasty Thai food. Would definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tau Id

sample_reviews_en.text: Tried the American fried rice here. The rice itself was really fragrant and tasty, but the sides like the fried chicken and sausage felt a bit small, so it didn’t feel super filling. Service was good though, the staff were friendly and I got a seat pretty quickly without much waiting. The price is a little on the higher side, but overall the taste was good and I enjoyed it.
sample_reviews_en.author: John de j3k

sample_reviews_en.text:
If I could give a maximum of 10 points, I would give 10. Incredible delicious food. Jenny and all the Crew there, give top service and do really their best to fullfil all your wishes. The Chef cook incredible awesome food. Long a go that I got such a delicious chicken with cashew nuts and also the Paneng.
Thanks for your service
Best regards
Uli from Khon Kaen
sample_reviews_en.author: uli m

sample_reviews_en.text: I stumbled upon this restaurant quite by accident and everything I tried was phenomenal. The food is really delicious, but I would especially like the green curry chicken with roti, for dessert, of course, mango sticky rice and for pizza, a mango smoothie. The staff is very friendly and the atmosphere is very pleasant. Definitely recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boris Sertic

sample_reviews_en.text: Mamoang Kau Niao. The mango was good, but the sticky rice was terrible. If they're going to charge a higher price of 220 baht than the other restaurants, they should offer better sticky rice. The mango gets 4 points, the sticky rice gets 1 point, so the overall score is 2 points. I don't know about the other dishes though.
sample_reviews_en.author: ぱぴーよん

restaurants.name: Front Room
restaurants.address:

Lower Lobby, 151 Ratchadamri Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I had a wonderful experience at Front Room Restaurant. The food was absolutely delicious, and I love that they invited บ้านสวนลุงไข่ to create his special dishes here — such a unique touch that made the meal even more memorable.

The service was also amazing. Our server, Bell, took excellent care of us throughout the meal. She was attentive, kept everything clean, and made sure we were comfortable the whole time.

Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for great food and warm, thoughtful service! 🌟✨
sample_reviews_th.author: Marcus Bah

sample_reviews_th.text:
Came here on the 9th of Jan as a good luck blessing in Thai belief. We call it ก้าวแรกของปี
Had an amazing experience exploring Thai cuisine in a new romantic way. Coming with 4 people altogether, we were welcomed by the friendly, accompanied staffs. We got complimentary desserts too.
sample_reviews_th.author: Tamruja D.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had Saturday brunch here yesterday. We were part of a large group so we were in a private room at the back. The staff looked after us tremendously, it’s always tricky with a large group but they managed us well.

The real pull here is the quality of food. Of all the brunches I’ve been to in the city I’d say this one stood above all the rest. The seafood was super fresh, the beef cheek (a choice of one of four mains to accompany the buffet) was so tender it melts in the mouth. The duck option was really good too, topped with a little foie gras too. The caviar trolley is of course a welcome addition and it made two visits while we here!

The free flow wine package is fun. The wines aren’t particularly serious and there’s no champagne package, that is available by the bottle only. But the Prosecco is dry enough to work with the food.

Very much enjoyed. My thanks to the entire team.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dom

sample_reviews_en.text:
The flavors are bold but refined, with just the right level of spice, sweetness, and depth. Presentation is elegant, making every plate feel special. It’s the kind of meal that keeps surprising you bite after bite.

The service is friendly and genuinely attentive. Staff are knowledgeable and happy to explain dishes, which makes the experience feel even more personal.

The space itself is stunning, with natural light and a modern Thai aesthetic. It feels luxurious yet relaxed, perfect for both special occasions and slow, indulgent lunches.

If you’re looking for something memorable and a little special, this spot absolutely delivers. Highly recommended for anyone who loves Thai food and wants to experience it at a higher level.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanawat Pengdith

sample_reviews_en.text:
A near-perfect dinner! The food quality was, of course, guaranteed at a restaurant in the Waldorf. But what impressed me most was the staff's impeccable service.

Speaking of the curry, my wife coughed twice, and the manager immediately came over to ask if it was too spicy. She offered to adjust the spiciness if she couldn't handle it. We told her it wasn't necessary, and a little while later, she brought my wife a glass of milk to help with the spiciness. We were truly flattered.

I hadn't expected anything special from a restaurant in the hotel lobby, but the food and service were completely unexpected.

If I ever travel to Bangkok again, I will definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: KKF T

sample_reviews_en.text: We dined on December 25th (2023), Christmas Day. Personally, I thought the lighting in the Front Room restaurant was a little dim, but it didn't hinder the dining experience. However, the mood and tone lacked vibrancy, making the atmosphere rather gloomy. The entrance also had a smell from the restroom or sewage, which didn't contribute to a very positive impression. But all the staff were excellent – ​​enthusiastic, smiling, greeting, welcoming, and serving very well. The food was delicious; everything was tasty. If the atmosphere had been better, it would have been perfect. Thank you for the complimentary 4th anniversary cake. Overall, it was a good experience. 👌🌟
sample_reviews_en.author: A PARK

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing experience and will be repeated!
We are staying at the Waldorf Astoria hotel and dinner at the Front Room restaurant was an easy and quick alternative as it is in the same location as the hotel. The surprise was excellent! We were received warmly and extremely professionally. The whole team is very pleasant, especially Mrs. Nong! The food is especially tasty, true to Thai flavors and at the same time refined. The portions are generous! On the occasion of my birthday and our dating anniversary, we received complimentary gifts that we loved!! I highly recommend a visit. We will return tomorrow. Quality, flavor and convenience are what we have here.
sample_reviews_en.author: ZHCamposS

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great place and wonderful food. Pricy for the local standards.

Got the lunch set menu. I was never the type that likes tiny one bitters at expensive places, but this actually kept me full.  Maybe im getting older, but I really enjoyed the food. Servers are super attentive. Wonderful customer service.

Dessert was the star of the show for me.

Coconut ice cream with sticky rice and pieces of jack fruit with some other stuff (tapioca?). I recommend to eat at least one scoop of the ice cream first as when you get lower to the other stuff, the ice cream gets over powered. The coconut ice cream is not very sweet which matches my palate.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fat N

restaurants.name: เจ๊ ไทย-อีสาน
restaurants.address:

708 ซอย อาคารสงเคราะห์ สาย กลาง Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is divided into zones: an indoor area with live music and an outdoor area for chilling out.

The owner and staff provide excellent service.

Almost all the food is delicious, and the drinks are reasonably priced.

The food is incredibly flavorful.

It's a place where you feel warm and welcome, like you're eating with friends.

Everyone seems to be having a lot of fun. The music is great for dancing late at night, but not as lively in the early evening. Overall, it's a good place to visit, but there aren't many tables, so reservations are recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ao Trafford

sample_reviews_en.text: The minced pork with pickled plums was bland and not flavorful at all. The papaya salad with pickled fish and the corn salad were okay. The grilled chicken was delicious, especially the dipping sauce. The grilled beef was just okay. The shrimp skewers were tasty, but the seafood dipping sauce was terrible – not sour at all. Overall, the flavors weren't spicy enough. This restaurant is weak on lime. Plus, we ordered grilled intestines but didn't get them, even though a table that came later received them, so we canceled that order.
sample_reviews_en.author: JuJi wu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Isaan & Thai Restaurant
Menu and prices as pictured.
Personally, I thought every dish tasted delicious.
However, the portions were a bit small, making the prices feel a little high.

It was quite crowded and noisy on a Saturday evening. A weekday would probably be better. We waited a while for our food, and they forgot some items, so we asked to take them home in a doggy bag.
All the staff provided good service, and the air conditioning was cool.

Parking is available in the nearby alleys, which is convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angsupa Phachala

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a small restaurant serving Northeastern and some Southern Thai food. It can get a bit crowded on Fridays and Saturdays. There's live music, which is enjoyable, and the singer has a good voice. Some dishes are a little too sweet, like the Luang Prabang papaya salad. Other dishes are great; I especially liked the traditional glass noodle salad – it was delicious. You'll need to find parking in the side streets as the restaurant is located in a residential area. The food is reasonably priced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pikapoo Yamkosum

sample_reviews_en.text: The food and prices are top-notch. It's a cozy little restaurant with incredibly delicious food. You absolutely must try the fried chicken, and ask for extra spicy papaya salad. Don't forget the spicy fish soup and finish off with some amazing sun-dried beef. There's live music at 7:30 PM and 10:00 PM. The musicians are lovely, mainly playing 90s (and 2025s) music (they can play requests!). Just ask for a specific song, it's a delightful experience. I'll definitely be back! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Daddy Microwave

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered grilled squid, and the first bite tasted like it was rotten. I thought it might not be cooked through, so I asked the restaurant to grill it more. Even after eating it again, it still smelled bad. I wasn't happy with the squid. The price was quite expensive, but the amount of squid was very small, and it smelled awful. In short, I couldn't eat it. The female staff member also seemed unwilling to provide good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manggo

sample_reviews_en.text: The duck larb was delicious but a little sour. The grilled chicken was tasty, tender, and fragrant, and the dipping sauce was okay. The papaya salad with salted egg was average. There are plenty of tables, and you can park on the side of the road. The restaurant also serves Southern Thai food in addition to Northeastern Thai food. There is an air-conditioned area and outdoor seating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Songwut W

sample_reviews_en.text: This small restaurant has a great atmosphere and delicious food. The main menu features Northeastern Thai (Isaan) cuisine, but they also offer excellent Southern Thai dishes. Service is decent but could use some improvement. Prices are reasonable, and there's live music every evening in two sets, at 7:30 PM and 10:00 PM. Overall, highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: TED-TON P.

restaurants.name: Sammitr Tomyum noodle
restaurants.address:

25 7 Soi Sukhumvit 16, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited this restaurant while traveling alone.
I went around 4 PM, so I was the only customer.
I ordered the Creamy Tom Yum Noodles (82 THB) and Thai tea.
The noodles were sen lek (thin rice noodles?).
The balance of sourness and creaminess was exquisite and truly delicious!
You could also taste the cilantro.
The meatballs were also delicious.
If I travel to Thailand again, I definitely want to go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ka Ko

sample_reviews_en.text:
Back to Bangkok from Krabi ✈️ We have 1 night and 2 days left, so we dropped off our luggage at the Hilton and headed straight for lunch…

Clear Level 3: It’s not *super* spicy, but since it’s hot, I recommend Level 2 🥘

Creamy Level 1 + Toppings: Even a spice wimp can finish it all 😋

Dumplings: They’re delicious! 🥟🥟🥟

It was a perfect meal, complete with Thai tea nearby! 🥤🥤🥤
sample_reviews_en.author: hyunkyung yoo

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're craving Leng (a type of Thai pork porridge), you have to think of this restaurant. There's no other place as good as this one. You can choose your flavor here. The minced pork omelet with rice is soft, fragrant, crispy, fresh, and delicious – a favorite among locals!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirikan “j” wilailan

sample_reviews_en.text: My first visit was very disappointing. We arrived and were about the third table in the restaurant. We ordered at 11:40 AM: two bowls of sukiyaki and fried dumplings. The dumplings arrived about 5 minutes later. Another 10 minutes passed, …
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamonwan Ruangkham

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the tomyum soup with egg noodles, fish balls, and ground pork for 82 baht. It was really tasty because the broth was mildly spicy and flavorful. The toppings went well with the noodles too. I couldn’t ask for more.
sample_reviews_en.author: pasta

sample_reviews_en.text:
26.08 Air conditioning available 🙆‍♀️

The Cream Tom Yum (82 baht) was really delicious!! I ordered it with yellow bami noodles. 🍜

It's the best to have an iced Americano at Invisible Cafe right next door after eating..
sample_reviews_en.author: Minum kopi

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant serves delicious tom yum noodles.
You can choose your soup, noodles, and spiciness to suit your taste. Personally, I always order tom yum noodles with clear soup and sen lek noodles. …
sample_reviews_en.author: KA

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tasty, cheap, good ingredients.
The egg was onsen egg quality for example.

Clear (lighter on flavor) and thick (more lime and hence the lovely sour comes thro) broth both awesome.

Recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hoi C

restaurants.name: Ticket to Rice Food & Drink
restaurants.address:

2283 Phahon Yothin 49/1 Alley, Lane 3-4, Lat Yao, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted okay, and the prices were mid-range, commensurate with the quality of the ingredients. I had the black spaghetti with crab meat; the crab meat chunks were large.
The grilled pork salad with black sesame seeds had two types of salad greens, and the dressing wasn't to my liking. The grilled pork had too much sauce, so I couldn't taste the pork itself.
The menu offers a variety of dishes, all visually appealing. Next time, I'll try the roti with green curry and the rice with garlic shrimp.
sample_reviews_en.author: kantinan peawsa-ad

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is a hidden gem in Bangkok.

The East meets West homie-style food here was outstanding, and the service was great. The owner was also super nice and friendly.
They offer different menu options, reasonable prices, and a nice atmosphere. We really enjoyed every single dish we ordered.
We'll definitely come back!

Every dish was delicious. Wow! We ordered five dishes, but forgot to take pictures of two. The atmosphere was lovely, and the service was excellent. We'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: megan L.

sample_reviews_en.text: This small restaurant is located by the roadside near the BTS Forestry Department station, but the food is surprisingly delicious and worth the price. Reservations are recommended as the restaurant has limited seating and is often fully booked. Walk-ins are also fine, though; I've eaten there several times and it can be a bit of a gamble.
sample_reviews_en.author: Han ShuDo

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes good, comes out fast, the quality is worth the price.
The owner and staff provide very good service.
It is convenient to travel because it is right next to the BTS.
You can walk in but I recommend calling to make a reservation in advance because the space is limited and there are few tables.
PS. The bathroom is clean. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Gogo

sample_reviews_en.text:
A cute little restaurant with a lovely atmosphere, located right next to the BTS station.
The beef fried rice is incredibly delicious!
The beef is tender and the rice is tasty.

The other dishes my friends ordered also looked great.
If you have the chance to pass by, you should definitely stop and try it.
You won't be disappointed! ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: P Si.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was good, the portions were large. The cream of mushroom soup was tasty, smooth and without any mushroom chunks. The grilled sea bass steak was fresh, the pork chop was a bit tough but still manageable. The salad was delicious. The lady who didn't smile didn't affect the taste of the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Be Pui

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every dish was delicious, unbelievably delicious!
The prices were very reasonable.
The restaurant is on the main road, no parking, but it's near the BTS.
The restaurant doesn't have many seats, so it's recommended to make a reservation beforehand.
sample_reviews_en.author: wilasinee yoochatchaval

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a small restaurant, so if you're going with a large group, you should probably call to reserve a table beforehand. The prices are reasonable for the food; the taste is good, the ingredients are high-quality, and the plating is beautiful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ying DD

restaurants.name: ครัวติ๊กป่าเถื่อน
restaurants.address:

Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A real home restaurant with great Thai food.
The restaurant can be tricky to find because is in a house located in a little soi.. but don't let you foolish from the outside appearance.
Inside the ambient is very cozy and warm home feeling. Only few tables are available. Perfect for a little group of friends, family or couple.
It's also possible book a private room for eat and play karaoke with private toilet as well.
During the evening is available bar tender for cocktails.

The food is absolutely amazing!
Be ready to eat spicy.. here they are not kidding!
A nice selection of Thai dishes and other very unusual like deer, frogs and even rats.
If you want to taste real Thai food I strongly suggest you this place. No fake thai dishes made for tourists here.

The portions are definitely big and the price is very very affordable.
We ordered 4 dishes, 2 cups of rice, 2 big beers, a bottle of Soju and an ice bucket for 1110 thb total
(see pictures).

The service is done from the super nice owner.

It's available delivery and take away as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Riccardo Demartini

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious local food. The owner runs the restaurant from their own home, so parking is limited; you'll have to park wherever you can find a spot. Not recommended if you're in a hurry, but if you're willing to wait, it's definitely worth it. I'll definitely come back again, but this time I'll call to reserve a table and order food in advance. The female cook has amazing cooking skills. I especially loved the sweet pork, jungle curry, and fish curry. The portions are large, even the rice is delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nillaphat Chayawiwatkul

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the best restaurant in Pattaya. Located in a quiet alley, it is a hidden local restaurant. The store is very comfortable and plays good music. And the food tastes very good. In fact, it was the best "Ppu Pat Pong Curry" I've ever eaten in Thailand. During my stay in Pattaya, I was able to enjoy the owner's good food and drink. There is a family who always welcomes me. Oh, and there is a cute cat family living in front of the store. If you're traveling to Pattaya, make sure to check it out!
sample_reviews_en.author: Joy J

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is incredibly delicious, especially the spicy salads and the sea snail sashimi, which is a must-order every time I come. It's so fresh and sweet. It's also great for those who like to drink, with a variety of liquor, beer, wine, …
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattaporn Deepiriyanon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wild food, seafood, and a la carte dishes.
🌟 Delicious, spicy, and no MSG. 🌟
Large portions.
Feels like dining at home.
Extensive menu.
Jasmine rice.
Fresh seafood.

Parking is a bit difficult.

Will definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saxophone

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service staff were friendly and chatty, and the cocktails were delicious.

Food taste is subjective; personally, I don't like salty food. Some dishes were delicious, while others weren't to my liking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fame Pitchanuch

sample_reviews_en.text: A hidden gem in Pattaya. Check the map, but it's best to call the restaurant first to check their secret, fresh, and delicious menu. Just thinking about it makes my mouth water! I want to go again!
sample_reviews_en.author: TonRoachz Dud

sample_reviews_en.text:
the owner is ready to serve. food is authentic Thai taste and delicious. portions are doubled size

did this review at end of meal which explains the disservice to the dishes

😂😂
sample_reviews_en.author: Zoe Teo

restaurants.name: AKA Yakiniku # Central World (7th Fl.)
restaurants.address:

999/9 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I asked about redeeming points, and a staff member came and said they needed to check the terms and conditions first. They didn't smile at all. If they had stood there any longer, it would have felt like I was begging. Once seated, I mentioned I wasn't familiar with the place and wanted advice, but nobody offered any. I was constantly stared at while eating, feeling like I was being treated like I was begging for food. Only one or two staff members were genuinely helpful, the one who brought me a lime shot at the end. In the end, I didn't get the discount I expected, and the terms and conditions were unclear. I saved up points just to try it. One time is enough. Terrible experience. No wonder none of the branches offer more than 4 points. If you're thinking of trying it, don't bother. While you eat, they just sit there watching you, as if they're cutting your food too much. It was very uncomfortable. If you want to waste money and have an unpleasant experience, then go ahead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Napatida P

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honestly, I don't even want to give them a star because this branch fails in both food quality and service.

1. The waiting time for food is quite long.
After ordering, we had to wait about 20-30 minutes, and almost every time we had to follow up with the staff to get our food. Some orders required following up twice.

2. The food quality and cleanliness need improvement. The meat was mushy and not in the standard pieces it should be. Also, the counter for dipping sauces and condiments was quite dirty, and the spoons ran out without being refilled promptly. The staff said they didn't have time to clean them.

3. The number of staff seemed insufficient for providing service, causing delays in many processes, including taking orders, serving food, and managing the front of the house. The back-end management system also seemed inefficient.

Overall, this experience was quite disappointing, and I hope the restaurant will improve both the quality and service. 🙂
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwanprateep Ruttakorn

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten at other branches before without any problems. The first time I ordered delivery, they didn't prepare the food and waited for the rider. The second time, the order was incomplete, and I waited until the food was cold – I don't like cold food! I had to go and contact them myself. The restaurant said the driver didn't contact them, and the driver said the restaurant didn't contact them. I'm not judging, but I want to point out that customers have to follow up themselves. It took 60 minutes to get the missing items. If the restaurant can't manage its staff to handle unexpected situations, they should consider hiring new staff. When I called, they said, "I wasn't the one who contacted them about this." Who's going to wait for you like that?
sample_reviews_en.author: Fuyuko Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The type of place you go to when nothing else is open and you're super hungry - that's exactly what we did. 3.9 rating for this place is a bit much - it's more of a 3 ( and I'm being generous).

Meats are just okay, banchan bad to mid. There are no perilla leaves or sides you expect from a Korean BBQ.  Even the sauces are lackluster, friend items just okay.

Service is pushy at first (they'll try to get you to get the most expensive package - honestly not worth it), later it's inattentive. The grill doesn't get hot enough, despite asking the staff multiple times. During our visit at 9:30 the Ac was also turned off so you're sat there sweating through the entire, very average tasting meal.

Avoid unless you're  super hungry.
sample_reviews_en.author: N Anita Amreen

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place has a truly refined vibe, particularly reflected in its menu offerings.

This has been my most disappointing experience so far. The food will definitely justify the cost if the service improves from this point on. I didn't wait long for a table, but I ended up waiting about 45 minutes for my first order to arrive.

I spent over 700+ baht for just 3 plates of beef, 1 prawn, 4 scallops, and 1 plate of squid.

The wait was so lengthy that I completely lost my desire to place an order. While there is a wide variety of side dishes available, the pace of service leaves much to be wanted.

The meat ofcourse quality is great but the staff and service really downgrade the restaurant itself.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sai

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the most honest Chinese comment. Your travel savior!

If you're used to Taiwanese 700 NTD Japanese BBQ, please don't eat at this place. This place is worse than BBQ from 20 years ago. Some of the meat is even reconstituted beef. The freshest items in the whole place are carrots and cucumbers (these two are quite delicious). The staff are very friendly, mostly young Thai people.

But the ingredients are really not good. For your trip's sake and your spouse's mood, don't eat it! Don't eat it! Don't eat it!

The picture shows fresh cucumbers and carrots, and chemically treated squid.
sample_reviews_en.author: 毛波星

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, but the two times we've experienced this, where we ordered a long time ago and it still hasn't arrived, even after the time limit had expired, and it's expensive to order. The staff asked if we had received everything we ordered, and we said no, but they didn't change anything. They just went into the kitchen and came back out walking normally. We're very disappointed because we really enjoy the food, and this makes us want to stop eating there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyathida Klasuek

sample_reviews_en.text:
Are people who give 4 or 5 stars having too low standards, or...?

I really regret not reading the reviews before going to this restaurant. I ordered an 899 yuan set meal, and the first plate of meat didn't arrive until 20 minutes later, and the shrimp didn't appear until an hour later, and even then, I had to ask them to bring it up. I'm giving my first review to this restaurant; it's truly outrageously bad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chun Hin Chau

restaurants.name: Nicha Steak & thaifood padthai (ณิฌา สเต็ก-อาหารตามสั่ง-ผัดไทย)
restaurants.address:

135 1 Samsen 4 Alley, Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very disappointing. The pork steak was so salty I couldn’t eat more than one bite. When I asked the waitress to fix it, she said they cannot because it was already mixed. I even had to ask twice before getting an answer. This was my second visit, but definitely my last. Poor food and poor service.
OMG! I can't believe u guys reply me like that.Of course my friend finish all and I'm the one who bring her to your shop because It was near and also our order are not the same she had Pork steak and mine is spicy one I think the problem is here your spicy I don't know what's your made of.and also we are not order the same time it didn't mean u cook the same time.Check well with your staff. And  also when I came first time I already told the staff that steak is a little bit salty and u know what she said she said may be it's too much of chicken powder I just want to remind u and let u know about your restaurant.And u may have question why I came back second time because at first it's not that much salty and I already inform the staff about that and I thought I would get better food next visit but it didn't.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hlaing Mai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nicha totally nailed it! I went for the Bullsize Half‑Heart Rice with stir‑fried morning‑glory chicken and an egg – super delicious and seriously spicy. I asked for extra heat, was sweating while I wrote this 😂, but the staff checked in to make sure I could handle it.
The kitchen’s open, so you can watch the cooks in action, and they’re really friendly. Chill vibe, tasty food – definitely coming back!

They have crocodile burgers, that’s next on my list
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuki Coirin

sample_reviews_en.text: super lovely spot, wandered from our hostel looking for some dinner and we found this restaurant. The smoothies were so delicious and refreshing in the heat and the food was classic traditional thai cuisine at a very good price. Would definitely recommend and definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tala Hamish

sample_reviews_en.text: Just found this store as I arrived my Hostel in Bangkok, Never expected Thai Food will be this great, and I liked everything I ordered, from the Fresh Smoothie and Thai Signature Dishes! Will surely recommend them because the food is beyond its price! AROII MAKK!! 👍😋🤤
sample_reviews_en.author: Rove Gallego

sample_reviews_en.text: Best fried rice in Thailand! All the food is delicious but the fried rice is a must try. Chicken, crispy pork or squid, all of them really tasty. Also tried the garlic and pepper chicken rice and the crocodrile basil fried rice and also really savoury
sample_reviews_en.author: Paula Ortega Ribas

sample_reviews_en.text: I've tasted my favorite crispy pork with fried rice which is rare to find. It's delicious and I really liked it. I would love to go back and taste other menus. The owner and their staffs were friendly as well. Thank you!😃
sample_reviews_en.author: Panมหัศจรรย์แห่งตัวเลข Pan

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a great local spot with affordable dishes. As a vegetarian I find lots of things on their menu - you can just ask for them to make it without meat. Their papaya salad in particular is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bea Lehmann

sample_reviews_en.text: I can really recommend the food here to everyone. It tastes great, and the quality is excellent! The service was good, and the staff were friendly. I'd love to come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Hölzli

restaurants.name: เช็งซิมอี๊ & ฮกหลี คิทเช่น (สาขา ติวานนท์)
restaurants.address:

248, 250 Thanon Tiwanon - Pathum Thani, Talat Kwan, อำเภอเมือง, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
If you're looking for a unique and delightful dining experience that combines delicious noodles with refreshing Chinese ice shavings dessert, look no further than เช็งซิมอี๊ & ฮกหลี คิทเช่น in ติวานนท์.

But the highlight of the meal has to be the Chinese ice shavings dessert. Perfect for cooling down on a hot day or simply indulging your sweet tooth, these flavored ice shavings topped with various toppings are a treat for both the eyes and the taste buds. The combination of textures and flavors is simply exquisite.
sample_reviews_th.author: Wisanu Tuntawiroon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Terrible. The portions were incredibly small. I ordered the special seafood stir-fry for 120 baht (regular is 90 baht). They added one extra shrimp and one piece of crispy squid, but in total I got three tiny shrimp, 2-3 pieces of crispy squid, and two tiny pieces of squid. They were stingy with even the noodles. I could only eat 4-5 bites. The taste was mediocre, the service was terrible, and the kitchen was dirty.
The sweet soup with coconut milk cost 60-70 baht, but they gave me what looked like a 20-30 baht dish. The longan juice was old and almost spoiled, the ginkgo nuts were hard and black like they were old stock, and the boiled fish balls were so hard they could break a dog's head. This place is practically doomed. If you're going to this restaurant, I recommend Nai Bai's place instead. The prices are more reasonable, the taste is better, and the ingredients are ten times fresher. I don't mind paying more, but taking advantage of customers like this is unacceptable. A restaurant like this shouldn't be allowed to continue operating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Haroon Boonmee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Expensive food, poor service, terrible atmosphere.

The restaurant smelled bad, had cockroaches, and was swarming with flies.

I reported the cockroaches to the staff twice.
The first time, the staff member just stood there looking at the cockroaches without doing anything and then walked away.
The second time, the staff member looked around and said, "Probably because there's construction in the next room. We don't usually have them," and then walked away.
There was no cleaning or attempt to get rid of them. No apology was offered.

Of course, I wasn't asking for a free meal or a discount; I was paying full price for the food.

I was very disappointed with the service and the atmosphere. The cleanliness was poor. The noodles tasted good, but the price was exorbitant compared to the overall quality.

I do not recommend eating here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bhanasut Hunsajarupan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Last vegetarian meal of the year!
Hok Lee Noodle Kitchen, Cheng Sim Yee, Karai
A vegetarian noodle and wonton shop, Cheng Sim Yee.
Sells vegetarian food every year. Come before closing time.
Vegetarian Basil Rice 60 baht
Standard flavor vegetarian basil rice, with tofu and mushrooms.
Vegetarian Stir-fried Mee Sua 60 baht. No leftover ingredients.
Stir-fried Mee Sua with kale and carrots, no other ingredients.
Stir-fried Mee Siu is okay, just no ingredients.
Lotus Root Drink 20 baht per bottle, 3 bottles for 50 baht.
Refreshing.
Taste 7.5, Price 7
Ingredients 7, Cleanliness 7
Service 5
sample_reviews_en.author: KALPHAPON POLWACHARAPAT

sample_reviews_en.text: This noodle shop, serving excellent single-dish meals and desserts, is one of the branches of both Hok Lee and Seng Sim Yee, which are family businesses. However, this branch is special because of the ingredients and the staff, setting it apart from others. I highly recommend the BBQ pork fried rice; it's truly delicious, with a Thai-Chinese fusion flavor reminiscent of childhood. The desserts are also tasty. Overall, it's a bit pricey compared to typical restaurants, but definitely worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Babe MMM BecXguide

sample_reviews_en.text: For desserts, I'd rate Ceng Sim Ee as my absolute favorite in terms of taste, quality, and price. The crispy water chestnuts and coconut milk dessert are the MVPs! If you don't like it too sweet, you can order it without syrup. The shop also sells noodles, dumplings, and fried rice, which are all delicious. There's no parking lot, but you can park on the street in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vimlet Kir

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! They have air conditioning and charging stations, and the price isn't too high, very reasonable. The soup was a bit too salty for my liking. I wish they had boiled eggs. They also have desserts, which I love – you can have something sweet after your savory meal! There's no parking lot, you have to park along the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Freeze Kiwii

sample_reviews_en.text: The homemade noodles are delicious, chewy and soft. They can be made in many ways, including Hong Kong-style stir-fried noodles with a fragrant wok flavor. They also have a variety of desserts. Parking is available on the street in front of the shop. There are air-conditioned and fan-cooled seating options. Overall, it's great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mahassavi Burirak

restaurants.name: Likhit Kai Yang
restaurants.address:

31/1 Phaniang Rd, Wat Sommanat, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came to this restaurant thanks to a recommendation from a famous YouTuber who recommended it. I came here and I must say that the place is totally worth the recommendation. First of all, the place seems to have a local atmosphere, but both locals and tourists eat there. Second, the young guy at the counter had a really good knowledge of English so it was easy for me to communicate with him afterwards and tell him that I really enjoyed it and that I came because of a YouTuber's recommendation. Third, the food was both very, very tasty and well priced so my impression of this place is very positive. If you are looking for Thai food with local flavors and with kind staff, then this is the place for you. I have also attached pictures of part of the menu and a picture of the food I ordered. From what I understand, this place has also been around for many years and I wish them to be around for many more years because they deserve it, the place is very worth it.
This restaurant is also very close to Rajadamnern Stadium so I ate there and immediately afterwards went to watch Muay Thai. I highly, highly recommend this restaurant
sample_reviews_en.author: IndiePewPC FIX

sample_reviews_en.text:
I saw that the restaurant has replied to my previous review.

There is no issue with my orders. We were no that hungry so we ordered lesser. That is why I was extremely clear to the lady server that I only wanted the THB180 tom yum. I specifically pointed to the THB 180 and told her "180 small".

She nodded and took my order. Based on this interaction, it is reasonable to assume that I ordered the smaller tomyum. However, this restaurant over-charged me and gave the bigger one. There was no information till the bill at the end.

It is not even about the extra 100 baht. Its about being honest as a business.

If you are not even honest as a business and overcharge your customers, how do you expect them to return? This is very disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Albert Ho

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food tastes.. average. Service is good, as in the boss and the team will try to service and pour the beer.

However, I rate it 2/5 only because I ordered the tomyum soup for 180 THB. I was very clear to the lady server that I only want the 180 one.

In the end they served the most expensive 280 THB one. When I questioned them about it, they said that it had been served so they cannot do anything about it. They did not give me any refund.

I am putting this review to warn other potential dinners of this situation. When you order from this restaurant, please make sure you tell them very clearly and have a record. They might over-charge you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Albert Ho Jian Qiang

sample_reviews_en.text:
The worst meal I've had in twenty years in Thailand!

This restaurant benefits from the stadium. Before the fights, tourists come looking for something to eat. We had the "famous" grilled chicken. It was awful. It looked like it had been left out in the sun for a day after being grilled for too long, and it tasted like it, too. The papaya salad was also a disaster. We were asked if we wanted it spicy or not and had requested two chilies per salad. We received papaya salad with no chilies and no flavor at all.

The service is pushy and tries to lure customers from the street to the tables.

I strongly advise against going there!
sample_reviews_en.author: Scrat

sample_reviews_en.text: Stay away from this restaurant!!!!!. I had taken my friend to see a Muay Thai match and before a match we decided to look for a place to wait. My friend walked past this chicken place. The old man at the front of the restaurant had talked to my friend and said this is  the number one chicken in Thailand  and pulled my friend to a table by not asking if we are really want to eat a chicken. The food has come out and is not tasty. Not recommended for this place, especially since the annoying old man tries to upsell his food and keeps saying 'number chicken' in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yakun Laokasem

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was delicious. Service was good. Everything went well until the end. Asked for the bill but when I wanted to scan and pay. I was rejected. Saying they do not accept PromptPay even though they let me scan the QR code. For some reason after seeing my banking app. A lady straight up rejected me. Told me to go ATM to withdraw cash. After paying, she even asked for tips. Which is totally fine but the way she requested for it was like I owed her money. Was already in our mind to give. But the way she asked for it was abit of a turn off.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was our first meal in Thailand and it was absolutely delicious!! Highly recommend their chicken, with sticky rice, and papaya salad. Everything else was great too! And make sure to pair meal with a nice cold beer.

Staff was kind and so attentive! Owner even showed us what order to eat things in, how to pair with garnishes, and even made our dipping hot sauces to our liking!

Must visit. We came on a Monday, but if you end up being there on a Saturday, get some dinner and head to stadium which is next door to watch some boxing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Talayeh Khoshab

sample_reviews_en.text: Very authentic food, look and feel. The owner will try  to make sure you eat the dishes in the correct way and not like a culturally blinded tourist. It can feel a bit intrusive but you can probably also just tell him to leave you alone. I liked it a lot to have someone explain to me how something should be eaten and which dishes pair well with each other. It also feels like the owner enjoys to guide travelers into the world of Thai food. Would highly recommend. Vegetarian options available as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrick Schneider

restaurants.name: The Gallery Sushi Bar ซูชิและฟัวกราส์คำโต
restaurants.address:

122/1 Lad Prao Wanghin Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Anyone looking for easy-to-eat sushi with great value for money, I highly recommend this place.
60฿ ~ 80฿ for huge pieces of salmon on so-small rice balls, and other fish are also well-priced for sushi 🔥🥵
The fish quality is excellent too. I think it's truly better value than going to famous sushi restaurants in malls.
sample_reviews_th.author: Bank Benug

sample_reviews_th.text: One word: Huge! It was as big as my wallet! If I remember correctly, this dish cost around 800฿. Every dish was fresh, and the clam soup was delicious. 😇 I've been there 5-6 times and have never been disappointed.
sample_reviews_th.author: Amanda cara

sample_reviews_en.text:
First off, let me say the food was okay. The sushi was creative and tasty. However, I'm not sure if it's because the owner wasn't there, didn't oversee the restaurant, or what, but:

1. The service was poor. The staff seemed unwelcoming.
2. There was a lot of pressure. They handed out the menu and immediately demanded to take our order. We asked to read it first.
3. Another source of pressure was that as soon as we finished eating, the staff rushed over to clear our plates. It felt impolite.
4. The staff had very long fingernails; it felt unclean.
5. The staff were constantly on their phones. I understand they might be bored, but maybe do it discreetly.
6. The restaurant smelled musty and was small. When there were no other tables occupied, the staff just waited to clear our plates. We felt pressured while eating.
7. I'm confused why it's called an Izakaya, because the menu is very limited. It doesn't feel like an Izakaya, does it?

Just something to think about.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kundel Bury

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited over a week ago and only just had time to write a review. The restaurant has service staff, but their manners don't quite match the price of the food. The owner probably hasn't trained them; they likely just monitor the kitchen at regular intervals and haven't been taught proper etiquette. When we ordered, a staff member shouted to the kitchen asking if they had the items, right above our heads! It was very confusing 😂. They even reached in to grab plates that were sold out. As for the foie gras, which they claim is huge, it was indeed impressively large and delicious with a wonderfully fragrant seared flavor. However, the other sushi dishes had unappetizing rice – not the kind suitable for sushi, and the toppings weren't particularly impressive. It feels like they're just selling the huge foie gras portion; it was delicious, but that was all I tried. It wasn't really worth braving the traffic to get there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saaa Su

sample_reviews_en.text:
Large portions, a truly satisfying bite!
This type of restaurant caters to Thai people who love large sushi pieces with thick, overflowing slices of fish – a truly satisfying and budget-friendly experience.
• Taste: Emphasis is placed on the satisfying quality of the ingredients. The fish pieces are larger and thicker than authentic Japanese sushi, and the sauces are rich and flavorful.
• Must-try items:
• Engawa (flounder fin): Torched to release the fat, topped with shrimp roe or green onions. The richness of the fish explodes in your mouth with every bite.
• Foie Gras (goose liver): Thick slices, torched until crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, drizzled with a rich, sweet sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Worawi Thanprajan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was a little disappointed with the price. We spent almost 7,000 baht for 3 people. It was a bit expensive because we ordered 3 pieces of foie gras, expecting it to be amazing. The sauce was sweet, and the foie gras itself was okay at first, but it became very greasy and we couldn't finish it. They should really offer an option to choose between large or small pieces, because when eating with foreigners, some don't like sharing food. As for the sushi, it was just average. The fish wasn't very fresh or sweet, and the rice was just plain. The only piece I liked was the fried sushi.
There were so many mosquitoes in the restroom, like, a lot!
sample_reviews_en.author: Amornrat Kasing

sample_reviews_en.text:
I found this Japanese restaurant from review but I found it really overpriced for the quality and quantity of the food.

Despite being their first customers, the staff seemed uninterested and unenthusiastic.

The Salmondon came in a very small bowl, with only less ikura, and unlike other places, it wasn't served as a set with miso soup. The salmon wasn't fresh either.

The Crispy Roll was disappointing; it was deep-fried like a breaded item, which didn't complement the dish at all. The Sriracha and mayonnaise sauce overpowered the filling, and the fried batter didn't taste good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panisara

sample_reviews_en.text: Having eaten at many restaurants before, this one's fish was too dry, the sauce didn't match the dish, and the price was too high. The portions were large, but the flavor didn't match. The atmosphere was cramped and uncomfortable. The staff were friendly, but the food was disappointing. You'll definitely be full after eating here, but if you're looking for great flavor, I'd recommend another restaurant. At this price, the food should be more delicate and delicious. This is just my personal opinion; it wasn't as good as it should have been.
sample_reviews_en.author: น้ําแข็งไอซ์เจริญทรัพย์ น้ําแข็ง

restaurants.name: Mahi Guest House & Restaurant
restaurants.address:

325, 136 Pattaya 13/3 Alley, Pattaya City, Pattaya, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently had a delightful dining experience at Mahi Guest House & Restaurant in Pattaya City, Thailand. The restaurant surpassed my expectations with its delectable cuisine and warm ambiance.

The menu at Mahi Guest House & Restaurant offers a diverse array of dishes, each prepared with care and precision. The flavors were exquisite, and the presentation showcased the chef's culinary expertise. Whether you're a fan of Thai cuisine or international fare, there's something to please every palate.

The staff at the restaurant were attentive and friendly, providing excellent service throughout my meal. The welcoming atmosphere and prompt service added to the overall enjoyment of the dining experience.

If you're in Pattaya City and looking for a fantastic dining option, Mahi Guest House & Restaurant is a must-try. I can personally vouch for the delicious food and the inviting atmosphere. Five stars well-deserved!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sampath Dissanayake

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stayed at Mahi Guesthouse in Pattaya, Thailand, for three nights and had a wonderful experience. The room I got was very clean and comfortable. I met a Bangladeshi brother there who was extremely friendly and helpful — since we were from the same country, he even gave us the room at a very reasonable price.

As it was my first time in Pattaya, he guided us well about the nearby places and local arrangements, which made our stay much easier. The food quality at the guesthouse was also impressive, especially the seafood, which tasted amazing.

Overall, it’s an excellent place to stay if you’re looking for a good-quality hotel on a small budget. Highly recommended for Bangladeshi travelers visiting Pattaya!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rabiul Karim

sample_reviews_en.text:
Vegan be very careful. I ordered a kulcha masala. It visibly had cheese in it... I asked if it was cauliflower or cheese. Answer: paneer. "But paneer is cheese" I reply... "No no, paneer but not cheese, like soy"

It did not look nor smelled like soy. I think the cook and server just lied to my face and added regular paneer in an item that wasn't supposed to contain any. Besides, I asked no butter, ghee, cheese, etc.

Could be very dangerous for someone with an allergy. It sure feels very heavy on my stomach and I barely ate any, in doubt removing what I could.

Stir fried Thai vegetable was good, but I did not enjoy my meal due to the bread.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julien Mettraux

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent service. Low cost. Looks of caring, helpful. Delicious food. Net and clean. Friendly manner staff. Give the great ideas overall trip. Free Guid ideas, book rides more more easier your short trip. Lots of enjoyable trip I spent. I never forget his hospitality. I will recommend to my friends and families for Pattaya trips.
- Mitu Karnaine
Toronto, Canada
sample_reviews_en.author: Mitu Karnaine

sample_reviews_en.text: Im travelling and I've eaten at plenty of Indian restaurants in seattle where im from. This restaurant makes everything from scratch. Everything grilled very well and seasoned well. This was a very fun experience to try Indian food in thailand. Very friendly people. A must try for sure. Loved the butter chicken. Not too sweet and a bit spicy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vincent Trichanh

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely rude staff, who chose to ignore my wife, the toilets were filthy! We ordered beers after waiting 10 mins no beers, no waiter to take our order. We walked. There are more interesting places on the same street to spend your cash. Probably the worst Indian restaurant I have been to
sample_reviews_en.author: DampierreBrowns

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner was Bangladeshi and so well behaved.But the enviorment of the room was not so good but we got great view from the Balcony. The room and the bathroom was not so clean.Not recommended. But if you wanna stay at cheap rate you can surely enjoy your stay at this hotel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Iftekhar Rafi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cozy Stay with Good Food
Mahi Guest House & Restaurant offers a comfortable stay with a friendly atmosphere. The rooms are clean, and the staff are warm and helpful. The restaurant serves tasty food, making it a convenient place for both stay and meals.
sample_reviews_en.author: Roknuzzaman Mohammad

restaurants.name: Sharples
restaurants.address:

ซอย นิวพลาซ่า, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've tried fish and chips outside the UK tens of times and while sometimes it's palatable, most of the time it's just battered dory with french fries - which isn't bad but it's not fish and chips.

This place is the closest I've had to having real fish and chips outside the UK. I've been here twice now and can say it's a solid attempt. Being in a country so far away from home you are limited by ingredients and produce to make it 100% exact. But Sharples has done it.

Id say the chips could be slightly less greasy but they can fix that easily - that's about it. The cod is proper flaky cod, the mushy peas are spot on, the batter is very good, they have proper Sarsons vinegar and good condiments.

10/10 for effort
Staff are very good especially the main lady who accommodated for my allergies.
9/10 for authenticity and flavour.

Credit where credit is due... Highly recommend if you want a taste of home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khalid Alam

sample_reviews_en.text:
Popped in here a few months ago on my last trip, I'm normally more than happy eating Thai food for my entire holiday, but I'd literally had enough spice, so for a change and it was a Friday, I'd decided to have a Chippy Tea. It was late, about 7 pm and there were only two other customers so seating wasn't a problem, the place was clean and bright, lovely and cool and the girls were extremely efficient and friendly.  I'd settled for the steak pie, chips, gravy, battered bits and bread and butter, washed down with an ice cold red Fanta, everything was amazing, the food was served piping hot with plenty of delicious gravy to drown my pie and chips in. I can't remember exactly how much I paid, but it wasn't a lot.
Hopefully I'll be back in November, I'll 100% be back in again when I do.
sample_reviews_en.author: Terry L

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the Atlantic Cod in batter with chips and mushy peas. I was given a menu quite promptly, the young lady took my order in English without any difficulty or miss communication.
My meal arrived quickly, was served hot and the batter was crispy. I fully enjoyed my meal and would reccomend anyone try it. One thing of a minor nature, the staff didnt know the wifi password, well at least they tried so full points there. Perhaps the manager/owner could make staff aware of wifi logon details. All in all a pleasant eat in dining experience, will return.
Updated. 22 Jan 2024.
As promised, I did return,Atlantic Cod, chips & mushy peas. Served piping hot and freshly cookedlovely smiling staff, cool aircon, seating available insoide or outside, parking outside for motorbikes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Derek C

sample_reviews_en.text:
Firstly, excellent fish and chips. Nice crispy light batter on both the cod and haddock. Chips were superb. Planned on sharing the chips but in seeing the Friday special, we both got chips and somehow managed to eat everything.

Our order was taken but we were not offered drinks and actually didn't even see they had them until the chef opened a bottle of beer to make more batter.

The man and lady in the kitchen appeared to be working well but the single server out front was clearly overwhelmed.

A couple of rather grumpy and unpleasant customers (not together) who couldn't understand why their meals hadn't arrived added stress too.

Will try again and hopefully next time mushy peas actually arrive too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Kalisch

sample_reviews_en.text: Firstly, I went to Sharples on the lake outside of Pattaya on Friday. I have fish and chips, curry sauce excellent all around the service, the staff and the venue as I looked at the menu I seen they had salmon fishcakes so I thought next time I will go for them today. I was passing New Plaza in Pattaya. I thought let’s have the salmon fish,cake and chips. sat down and ordered but unfortunately no fishcake so I went for the steak and kidney pie. I’m not a lover of kidney but it was okay. Good portion of chips. I don’t usually do two days in a row of English food but this was very good for long time. Keep up the good work except make sure you have your stock available full time 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Kevin Palmer

sample_reviews_en.text: Have tried all 3 sharples restaurants over a 6 month period and I have to be honest and say all of them serve bang average food! I have had the cod which was obviously frozen and absolutely tasteless! Tried the scampi was absolutely horrendous and when invited out a 3rd time tried the pie was clearly a catering pie from a nearby supplier with the van parked outside! Chips are ok, service is poor but all 3 of them even on a Friday which is there “special “ day are absolutely dead as a doornail!!!! No idea how they stay open? Far better restaurants near by!! Don’t believe the paid youtubers
sample_reviews_en.author: Steven Benn

sample_reviews_en.text:
A great fish & chip shop in Pattaya
The chips was great the potatoes had a slight sweet taste fried very well nice and crispy but soft inside was given a good portion 😎
The Cod was excellent a nice crispy batter not to thick and  was cooked beautifully
The mushy peas was on point and the curry gravy was good
No complaints best place to eat if you fancy a change from Thai food
4 star for atmosphere only because there was only 2 people in restaurant
Staff very friendly and polite
Will differently return 😎
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Robinson

sample_reviews_en.text:
Iv got to say I WISH l'd get the same chips you advertise in the pictures here cause l definitely don't! and haven't done for months and the chips are smaller,
I really enjoy your fish + chips but it's nothing like the proportions l used to get when you first opened.
YUPPPPPEEEEEEE! Visited Sharples fish & chips and happy to say some Has see my reviews because my fish  & chips yesterday was wonderful ie bigger fish and bigger portion of chips so Thankyou and lm looking forward to my next visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Laws
