sample_reviews_th.text:
It's a lot of things.
1 person, 1,159฿++, the price of the item is 1,159 baht.
There is a lot of things that happen in the future. There are many things that …
sample_reviews_th.author: チャッキー

sample_reviews_en.text:
We chose to eat at this restaurant because of the good reviews.

We encountered a very rude staff member. All the other waitstaff were lovely. When ordering, they mentioned we could sign up for a membership to get a discount at checkout. My mother didn't know how to sign up. The cashier spoke very harshly to her. Our whole family was there, and my mother was very upset by the cashier's rude behavior. We were very disappointed and would not recommend this restaurant.

We request that the restaurant improve its service and the attitude of its staff.

Regarding the food, we ordered the most expensive set menu, and the food was mediocre in taste.

The service mind was poor and unsatisfactory. I wouldn’t recommend. The cashier was being disrespectful. The food was mediocre at best, below our expectations. Both the service standards and the attitude of the cashier staff should be reviewed and improved.

After writing this review, a staff member contacted us by phone to apologize, saying they didn't mean any harm and that we should have mentioned our dissatisfaction at the front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aey Alysha

sample_reviews_en.text:
This buffet restaurant always impresses everyone I bring. We usually eat at the Saphan Kwai branch, but this was our first time at this branch. The restaurant maintains its standards very well; the food is just as delicious as always.

This branch is a bit busier and more chaotic, so some dishes might be missing due to lack of service, and the staff are constantly busy. You have to call them loudly, otherwise they won't notice. At the Saphan Kwai branch, the staff are attentive, constantly changing plates and assisting without being asked.

But the taste and quality of the ingredients are excellent. We opted for the 999 baht option; the meat was delicious, the seafood was fresh, and the sushi, appetizers, sweet shrimp, and fried shrimp were all top-notch. Even the desserts, like the cantaloupe and ice cream, were fantastic. You can enjoy both BBQ and shabu-shabu in one place without paying extra.

If you want to eat high-quality meat in an all-you-can-eat buffet, I highly recommend this restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mew Tnc

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came based on reviews. I ordered the top set, 1259++ baht, paired with the all-you-can-eat yellow-label drink for 1459 baht net. It was excellent! The yellow-label drink was fresh and ice-cold, very refreshing. I only like fatty meat, grilled medium rare, and I enjoyed the salmon belly sashimi. However, the selection wasn't very extensive. I liked the "Ribeye Cap Off" and "Premium Harami." The staff were very attentive, constantly checking on the grill and refilling the yellow-label drink. The service was great, just as the reviews said. My only complaint is that for this price, they didn't have salmon belly sashimi. I also forgot to try the Wagyu Giant. I got a little carried away with the drinks. If you're a drinker, you'll definitely love it. If you prefer fatty meat, you might not be so satisfied.

The midday/afternoon time was comfortable; the atmosphere wasn't crowded. I recommend it if you prefer less crowded times.
sample_reviews_en.author: Afro Maple

sample_reviews_en.text: I parked in the hotel's parking garage and got my parking ticket stamped at the restaurant for 3 hours of free parking. I tried the most expensive set, and the meat in that set was excellent – ​​not tough at all, even the thick cuts and the shoulder blade which are usually tough. The meat flavor was strong and delicious even without dipping sauce. My favorites were the 5-second grilled beef and the premium karubi sukiyaki. They provided three dipping sauces, all delicious. The sushi was good, but I preferred the meat. I also tried the Jorosu beef from the 849++ set, which was okay but tougher than the beef in the 1159++ set. Each dish comes with many pieces; if you want to try several items, you can ask the staff for only half a plate. The grill was very hot, and the staff were attentive. This is a restaurant I would definitely return to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Earth Earth

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Japanese Yakiniku (bbq) right below the hotel. Cannot decide if its 3.5 or 3 stars. We got the 589baht buffet (note that the price does not include taxes, another 17%).
Beef cuts were extremely dry, the pork and chicken are both ok. Loved the Ton Toro (fatty pork neck) best. We ended up eating the beef cuts together with bacon for better flavour. We also ordered the cheesy scallop and ebi, which is chopped up scallop and small prawns with cheese (not worth the add-on price IMO). The buffet comes with cooked stuff like ebi tempura roll, which was ok. Desserts like rock melon and ice cream was good too.
Overall service was prompt. Some dishes took extremely long time to arrive, some not at all, not sure if its due to staff unsure what we talking about. Hot grill change is very frequent without us prompting. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Cheow Mong Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Choosing this restaurant for Valentine's Day was a great decision.
I loved the dimly lit atmosphere, perfect for grilling. We opted for the mid-range set, which cost less than 800 baht for about two hours of dining. It was a full-on BBQ experience with a fragrant grill, and you could also choose shabu-shabu – a 2-in-1 deal! The meat, vegetables, and side dishes were all excellent. The dipping sauces were delicious, the grilled items were tasty, and the shabu-shabu broth was rich and flavorful. The only downsides are that it's a bit of a walk from Union Mall, near the MRT station, but located inside a hotel – a little far if you're coming from the MRT. The restrooms are a bit far, on the second floor of the hotel. Overall, it was great value. I'll definitely come again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pisan Taweesuk

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located inside the Quarter Hotel. You can park in the hotel parking lot. After parking, the restaurant is located behind the hotel lobby.

There was a short queue when I went, waiting about 20 to 30 minutes.

The meat and other dishes were varied and good value for money. The food was served relatively quickly, although some items took longer and required following up with the staff.

I really liked the table design; it had a designated spot to place plates. Staff would place newly served dishes here, and if you needed to return a plate, you could also place it in the same spot, saving space on the dining table.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charlie Vongphantuseth

restaurants.name: SAEMAEULGAMJATANG69새마을 감자탕 타이신 스퀘어
restaurants.address:

1521/1 อาคาร ศูนย์การค้าไทยซินสแคว์ 7JKGAdoUQT4A35eP7 เลขที่ตั้ง https://maps.app.goo.gl 10110 Sukhumvit 69 Alley, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the medium size Gamjajang, and considering it's overseas, I think it's the best.

The dried cabbage was so delicious that I ordered extra.

Parking is convenient, the staff are friendly, and my child wants to go back tomorrow and order extra dried cabbage four times.

I had such a great time at the restaurant a few days ago that I ordered a medium size Gamjatang via Grab for delivery yesterday evening, Friday.

I added two extra portions of dried cabbage.

Unlike when I ate at the restaurant on the first day, the meat had a bit of a gamey pork smell.

Perhaps because my expectations were high after enjoying it so much the first time, the gamey smell was quite disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: 장승환

sample_reviews_en.text:
Saemaul Gamjatang has moved. It has relocated from its original spot to a location closer to the BTS station across the street. If you enter the first floor and walk straight in to the left, you will find it.

The gamjatang is delicious with plenty of meat and generous portions, but today the fresh kimchi was too salty. It seemed like the cabbage was pickled a bit too much. So I asked them to change the kimchi, and they gave me sour kimchi instead, haha.

Oh, but the restaurant was extremely hot. Since gamjatang is cooked over a fire, it gets hot, but it was really, really hot, so I mentioned it to a staff member, and they did bring a small fan.
sample_reviews_en.author: moon

sample_reviews_en.text:
I asked the owner to contact me... but they didn't.

The service is terrible, and there is no manager.

Content: Since there is no manager, it is a complete mess. They treat customers like total pushovers. It feels like the staff are just dragging the business out of us. The service is awful!!! Please train your staff. This is my third visit since they moved, and I don't think this is right. Train your staff properly. If the owner isn't here, shouldn't you at least make sure the manager is reachable? There are only inflexible staff, no manager, no owner, and nowhere to vent. I will absolutely never go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: 이동한

sample_reviews_en.text: Their pork bone soup is really delicious, living up to its reputation. It's exactly as my Korean friend recommended – that I had to try this restaurant. If you want to see the full video, you can check it out on YouTube. The kimchi is also delicious; I ordered two plates! The owner is Korean but speaks English. Most of the customers are Korean or foreigners. If you don't want to dine in, you can order through LINE Man.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rao journey เราเจอนี่

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Gamjatang soup has a rich flavor but isn't spicy; you can enjoy the broth. The pork ribs are tender and soft. The kimchi side dish is delicious, fresh, and clean.

The blood sausage is well-prepared, soft, and easy to eat. Dipping it in salt is fantastic.

The service is good; the staff are enthusiastic, attentive, and always smiling.

The restaurant is clean, and the atmosphere is just like eating in Korea.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fai Pinky

sample_reviews_en.text: The meat is good, but the flavor was a bit weak; I tend to have a strong palate. The potato stew was perfectly fine. However, the braised kimchi was so bad that I didn't even bother taking a picture. Please check if that's how it's supposed to be served or if it has spoiled over time. The staff were cheerful and the service was good. I'm giving it 4 stars because of the braised kimchi.
sample_reviews_en.author: kc

sample_reviews_en.text: Such a hole in the wall hidden restaurant! Flavourful gamjatang and the meat falls right off the bone. Huge servings, lots of mushroom, mochi and vegetable as well. Service is fast and staff is polite and helpful, despite some language barriers. They used Google translate so there's no issues communicating. Reasonable pricing. Will definitely be back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: shu shu

sample_reviews_en.text: Two service staff can barely speak Thai or English so I’m not sure how the restaurant owner expects me to order. Bad and run down interiors. Very limited food menu. The taste was not bad but not that great either. For the price, (which is standard of any Korean restaurants along the sukhumvit line) I expect wayyyyyyyyy more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pang K. (ソースヒメ)
