sample_reviews_th.text:
We went here on a weekday evening. I ordered the Thai green curry (แกงเขียวหวาน). I myself am half-Thai and make this curry at home as well.

It was lacking in flavor, very watery instead of creamy from the coconut milk. It was by far the worst green curry I have ever tried. The chick was overcooked as well.

Making Thai green curry is not difficult at all. I think they used an instant package for this dish.
sample_reviews_th.author: Malissa O.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best the best!!! Totally♡♡♡♡♡
The food was delicious and the quantity was so good that I couldn't even pay for the gln, so I wrote a review and went there ☆ but they don't charge me 🐶 If you go, you have to have pineapple fried rice ㄱㄱ The panmi spring rolls are so delicious 🐕 Oh my!!!!!♡♡♡♡♡♡
The service is the best ☆ It's the best
Oh, by the way, I give it 9 stars 🥰 I'll give it 5 stars because it's so good😘
sample_reviews_en.author: gy io

sample_reviews_en.text:
Disappointing. We were here before, then the food used to be good. Today we think we had leftovers from the weekend. There was no taste, the Pad Thai had no taste, the Massaman curry was very watery. The portions were very small today.

The staff, the girl who served and a young man who was probably the cook were talking to each other and looking at their mobile phones.

We won't eat here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaco

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very good Thai Vietnam food.
I went to alot of food places in Bangkok but this is the best one for my.
Nice fresh food clean restaurant nice stuff and nice prices for what you get.
I went 3 days to this restaurant and evry day was just a great food experience :).
I am back in Februari for shor.
Try pho bo, Chia gio, springrols are very good and chicken cash nuts.
sample_reviews_en.author: Milos Zarkovic

sample_reviews_en.text: We've been ordering delivery from this place for about a year, and everything was great, but we once got severe food poisoning from the food—probably from undercooked or stale shrimp. It's a nice place with a great atmosphere and excellent value for money, but it's not something we're hungry for anymore.
sample_reviews_en.author: Виктория Водная

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm so angry! I ordered beef but they gave us chicken instead, and the shopkeeper didn't even tell me. They also charged me the price for beef. Personally, I thought the taste was just average; it was a bit too salty, and the soup noodles were too bland.
sample_reviews_en.author: 黄杰瑜

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a great cafe. We stopped in for lunch and were very pleased! The food and presentation were excellent. We were even surprised that the place was almost empty during lunch. It was delicious and the price was reasonable. We definitely recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom Hardy

sample_reviews_en.text: Was there last night. Worst spring rolls I've ever seen. All that green stuff you see on the plate was out of one of them. Terrible!  The second dish that we ordered was a spaghetti dish. The only taste the dish was sugar, and I mean loaded …
sample_reviews_en.author: Rick Podworny

restaurants.name: Spice Market
restaurants.address:

Anantara Siam Bangkok 155 Ratchadamri Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This was  by far the best upscale Thai food experience in my life. The newly redesigned Spice Market restaurant of the Anantara Siam Bangkok hotel was a highlight of my stay in Bangkok. The menu offers an array of local dishes from different parts of Thailand purely and only from local farmers carefully selected by the young executive chef of the restaurant. The service goes beyond your expectations and experiences. Our waitress Paully guided us passionately through the extensive menu and ensured we had no allergies. Her attention to detail was a testament of genuine hospitality that makes you feel entirely at home. There was a lady chef (unfortunately I did not manage to catch her name) coming out of the kitchen to talk about some of her dishes and how she makes them. It was a gastronomical journey through Thailand with many little surprises in between. There was a traditional hand washing ritual at the table after our meal that was unique! And the little home made gift each guest receives from the restaurant at the end of the meal just put a big smile on our face and ensured me that I will be back to the Spice Market soon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Martin Žídek

sample_reviews_en.text:
Spice Market in Bangkok is truly an exceptional culinary destination and, without any doubt, one of the ultimate references for authentic high-end Thai cuisine. Every detail of the experience is thoughtfully curated, from the elegant atmosphere to the extraordinary presentation of each dish.

This is not simply a dinner, it is a complete journey into the richness of Thai gastronomy. The flavors are perfectly balanced, authentic, refined, and capable of elevating traditional recipes into something unforgettable. For anyone searching for the finest expression of Thai cuisine in Bangkok, Spice Market is absolutely the place to experience.

What makes the evening even more special is the impeccable service. The team creates a genuine sense of hospitality, making guests feel welcomed, cared for, and fully immersed in a 360-degree dining experience. The attention to detail, warmth, and professionalism transform every moment into something memorable.

A must-visit restaurant for those who appreciate authentic Thai cuisine at the highest level. Super recommended!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Baldassare Schembri

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had such a wonderful dining experience at Spice Market Bangkok. The atmosphere was elegant and relaxing, and every dish was beautifully presented with authentic Thai flavors. The staff were warm, attentive, and made us feel genuinely welcomed throughout the evening.

The balance of spices, freshness of ingredients, and traditional cooking style really stood out. Definitely one of the best places in Bangkok for refined Thai cuisine. Highly recommended for both locals and visitors looking for a memorable meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: JUSTDO 1LL

sample_reviews_en.text: First meal in Bangkok and this was great. Food and service were excellent. Server took the time to describe some dishes then we went with her recommendations. So many nice touches like cold wet towel before meal, then free little deserts. One thing I have not seen is after the meal, the server bringing bowls to pour water over your hands, had towels to dry. A bit pricey, our lunch for three was $118 USD. I think the lunch price is the same as dinner. We plan on coming back for dinner during our stay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike

sample_reviews_en.text: Arguably the BEST Thai restaurants I have been to. The food there has amazing spices from top to bottom, the dishes are quite spicy if you don't have high spice tolerance. When the spices exploded in my mouth I felt extremely happy and satisfied. The staff were very attentive and provided us great service. The atmosphere was very relaxing and made the experience even better. Do come here I highly recommend it
sample_reviews_en.author: theamy79@gmail.com ael5582

sample_reviews_en.text: The spice market is a must visit if you are in Bangkok. We had the best dinner here ever. Everything was amazing from the ambiance to the hostess paully, she was so professional and knowledgeable and told us everything we needed to know about the menu. The service was incredible and the food was even better! We will definitely visit again when in bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Duaa Hahsim

sample_reviews_en.text: Hands down …to be one of the best Thai Restaurant in the city of Bangkok. The Panang Gai Yang ( Chicken Red curry )  and the Crab Omlette was bursting with flavor and perfectly cooked. Khun Paully was incredibly friendly and made sure we had everything we needed. The ambience and atmosphere at the restaurant was perfect ! Highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gopal Kadkade

sample_reviews_en.text: Always great to go to this restaurant again.  We had stay one night there on Saturday.  Enjoy ourselves.  The food was great as usual.  Service was over expectation.  The restaurant stall (Khun Pook & Khun Paully) gave us the best service ever.  Thanks again for the services.  Will definitely go there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Samarth Suvajarachai

restaurants.name: ร้านมัลลิกา ชุมพร
restaurants.address:

1873 Henri Dunant Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Delicious Southern Thai Food (Chumphon Style)"
Mallika Chumphon is a Southern Thai (Chumphon style) restaurant located on the 2nd floor of the Thaweewong Thawansak Food Court. When I visited, it was lunchtime and the restaurant was packed, but I didn't have to wait long for my food. It was served quite quickly. The food was delicious and suited my taste (because I'm from Chumphon). They provided a generous amount of vegetables to eat with the chili paste. The staff provided excellent service. I was very impressed.
(Pictures taken on 11 January 2023)
sample_reviews_en.author: Kij Thangs

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious. This was my first time here and I was impressed with many dishes, especially the yellow curry and fish cakes. They were absolutely delicious. I'd love to come back and try more.

The only thing I'm not happy with is the stir-fried morning glory with eggs (I didn't take a photo). The flavor wasn't quite right for me. I'm not sure if it was the chefs, but this dish wasn't quite right.

Overall, it was very good. I'll definitely go back and try it again.
sample_reviews_en.author: sawin bomb

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located on the second floor of the food court. It's a Southern Thai restaurant serving made-to-order dishes. If you're dining alone, they have single-serving dishes available. The atmosphere is pleasant and friendly, and the staff provides good service.
The shrimp paste fried rice was delicious and flavorful, but I would have preferred the sweet pork with less fat. The watermelon smoothie was refreshing and not too sweet, just the right amount of sweetness.
sample_reviews_en.author: narisara nawakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a Southern Thai restaurant with delicious and well-balanced flavors. You can choose your desired level of spiciness, perfect for those who don't like spicy food or can't handle very spicy food.
Personally, I love the Tom Som Pla Krapong (sour fish soup with sea bass). The broth is delicious and easy to drink, the fish pieces are large, fresh, and free from any fishy or muddy smell.

#TeteTakesYouToTaste #RecommendedRestaurant
sample_reviews_en.author: Krit Kaewkraisee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food at Chulalongkorn Hospital, located on the second floor of the cafeteria. I ordered stir-fried morning glory with eggs, stir-fried shrimp with stink beans, and stir-fried chicken with cashew nuts.

This restaurant's southern food is delicious and well-balanced. Other restaurants' shrimp paste dishes tend to be salty, but this one isn't. It's perfectly tasty. I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Norrapat Towanabut

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious Southern Thai food.
We recommend the Southern-style khanom jeen curry, yellow fish curry, and turmeric-fried sandfish.

The seating is spacious and perfect for families.

The staff are attentive and friendly, and the food comes out quickly.

Since this is a hospital restaurant, if the hospital parking lot is full, you may have to park near Lumpini Park or Chulalongkorn University.
sample_reviews_en.author: rongpong olanpetikul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything was delicious, reasonably priced, and the flavors were excellent. The portions were just right for the price.
I recommend the stir-fried morning glory with eggs and the shrimp paste and squid.
Sorry, I didn't have time to take a photo.
The restaurant is on the second floor. Take the escalator and walk straight to the end. The restaurant is on the left.
sample_reviews_en.author: Raweewan Thabloha

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and there's a wide variety of dishes. However, I wish there were side vegetables with every spicy/strong-flavored dish, not just those with curry paste. For example, all chili paste dishes should include fresh vegetables as well, because some people enjoy both steamed and raw vegetables with their chili paste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hataikarn Chauvakij

restaurants.name: Nang Linchi Thai Roti
restaurants.address:

128, 11 Nang Linchi Rd, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today, I'm introducing a roti shop that has been famous for over 37 years. It's located on Nang Linchi Road, Soi 5/1, in front of Pornkan Medical Center, near 7-Eleven.

Highlights of the shop:
• Pandan Roti: The roti dough is light green from the addition of pandan leaves, giving it a unique aroma.
• Diverse Menu: Customers can choose their preferred dough thickness and fillings, such as:
• Thin and crispy roti: 10 baht
• Thick and soft roti (using 2 balls of dough): 20 baht
• Roti with egg: 18 baht
• Thick and soft roti with egg: 35 baht
• Banana roti with egg: 40 baht

Opening Hours:

The shop is open from 4:30 PM onwards until evening. Closed every Monday.

Today, I tried the thick and soft roti, 26 baht per piece. The pandan aroma in the dough, with a slightly salty taste that contrasts with the sweet condensed milk, and the soft dough were delicious.

Give it a try if you have the chance!
sample_reviews_en.author: เดินสายกิน เดินสายเที่ยว ศราทราเวล

sample_reviews_en.text: I went today based on reviews. The wait wasn't too long, but the vendor, an elderly man, seemed very unfriendly. I don't know why, but he looked grumpy while making the roti. I read many reviews saying it was delicious, so I had high expectations. However, the taste wasn't much different from other roti, but it was acceptable, so I gave it 5 stars. But the service wasn't very good. At least if they had informed me that there would be a long wait and asked me to sit down, I wouldn't have minded. But the vendor was quite rude, so I'm only giving it 2 stars. For anyone planning to go, the taste is good, but the service needs improvement. This is my actual experience; I don't know about other people's experiences, but I think they might be better (maybe).
sample_reviews_en.author: Oraphan Pollajun

sample_reviews_en.text: This roti shop is very popular. Its highlight is the roti dough, which is fragrant with fresh pandan leaves, making it deliciously aromatic and refreshing, unlike typical roti. They sell many types of roti, but no mataba (stuffed roti). They offer choices of thin or thick roti and various fillings like banana. If there's a long queue and you need it quickly, I recommend ordering the regular one. They usually have some pre-made, so it might be faster. However, it's best to call ahead to order. The seller seems busy and serious, probably because of the high volume of orders, but once you talk to them, they're polite and friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: DukeTK

sample_reviews_en.text: YOU HAVE TO GO HERE! :D The best roti I've ever tasted and the husband and wife are the nicest and sweetest couple ever. They were both so friendly even though it was the end of the day and we didn't share the same language. When I left a small tip, they tried to give me another roti! In terms of the roti itself, the texture was perfect - chewy, crispy and soft. I loved the slight pandan flavour, bananas in the middle and not too sweet. There are a few stools there if you want to sit down and eat - they were so good while hot and fresh. I tried roti from a different place during my trip and it was nowhere near as good as this!
sample_reviews_en.author: Cynthia Lau

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nang Linchee Thai Roti

I saw a review on a Facebook page saying it was delicious, so I went to try it. It really was delicious! The roti was soft and fragrant with pandan leaves. An elderly couple runs the stall, and although they get a lot of orders, the wait wasn't long. There are chairs to sit and wait in front of the stall. The price has increased slightly, but it's still acceptable. The stall is located on the sidewalk with lots of people walking by, near the evening market with many food and other stalls.

🚗 There's no parking, but I recommend parking at the nearby 7-Eleven on the same side and walking over.
sample_reviews_en.author: sunantha jarat

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️This is a roti stall on the sidewalk. Closed every Monday (because of city inspectors). They don't accept bank transfers (though someone before me was able to transfer). There are chairs to sit and wait, but since the sidewalk is already narrow, I felt bad for people walking past.
⭐️The pandan-flavored dough is very fragrant; you can smell it even while driving past.
⭐️I ordered the thick and soft version, and it lived up to its name – incredibly delicious.
⭐️The owner is very fast and skilled, chopping it into pieces for easy eating.
sample_reviews_en.author: ครีม ไม่กินเผ็ด

sample_reviews_en.text:
Give it a try. The line isn't too long.
I ordered the thick and soft version with banana and egg.
The roti dough was chewy and crunchy.
I didn't get to try it while it was still hot, but it was still delicious.
The shop is a street cart.
They seem to accept phone orders, so it's a good idea to call ahead and pick up.
You can park at 7-11 and walk there. Parking is available for 15 minutes. If you don't have to wait in line, you should be fine. Otherwise, you can buy at least 200 baht at 7-11 and park for an hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naruporn Ananpongsuk

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best Roti I have ate!
Highly recommended :) to set there and watch him prepare your order and a lot of people from the neighborhood is around waiting for him, it’s absolutely worth:)
The Nang road is recommended as well for who is looking for cozy neighborhood, very delicious food, fresh vegetables and fruits
sample_reviews_en.author: hagar hamadi

restaurants.name: นี่ไงร้านกินเต็ก
restaurants.address:

19/119-120 ถนน เลี่ยงเมือง Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was delicious! This was my first time here. We ordered beef steak with jaew sauce, pork steak with jaew sauce, and ham steak with French fries in juicy cheese sauce.

At first, the three of us arrived at the same time as several other tables, so we had to wait a bit. Luckily, there was a big screen English movie with Thai subtitles on the screen for us to enjoy.

My partner said the beef steak was a bit overcooked, but the meat was perfectly marinated (I didn't specify the doneness level, so they probably chose medium rare). My pork steak was fine. My son's ham steak was okay, juicy, and the meat wasn't dry or tough.

I don't usually like steak, because it's usually tough if it's dry. But this restaurant is excellent. I highly recommend it for steak lovers. The prices are reasonable, too, at around 100 baht per plate (+/-).

There's an air-conditioned area with only a few tables, and an outdoor area with a few tables, which is quite okay. There's a large fan and a movie to watch while you wait.

The restaurant is on the roadside, so you can park on the street in front of the restaurant.

**Thank you for the delicious steak.**
sample_reviews_en.author: Tab Tab

sample_reviews_en.text:
This not-so-secret restaurant is located right by the roadside (before the entrance to the Nonthaburi bypass road). I have to say, it exceeded my expectations! Today I ordered the chicken steak with Jaew dipping sauce. The piece was huge and incredibly satisfying. The chicken was lean but not tough, grilled to a perfect aroma. The Jaew sauce was a perfect balance of sour, salty, and spicy, cutting through the richness beautifully. It was so enjoyable to eat, but the piece is HUGE! Those with smaller appetites might need to take some home.
Another dish I ordered was the cheesy French fries. This is a must-try! They were served piping hot, steaming, with a generous amount of melted cheese. We ate until we were exhausted, but still couldn't finish it all. It was totally worth it!
For those planning to go, parking can be difficult as the restaurant is right by the road. You might have to find parking elsewhere and walk a short distance, but it's worth it for the delicious food and huge portions. If you're in the area, give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Muayyme

sample_reviews_en.text:
I often pass by this steak restaurant, which is always bustling with customers, so I decided to join the queue and give it a try. The menu primarily features a variety of steaks, including pork, beef, chicken, and pork belly, along with appetizers like French fries, chicken nuggets, and salads. They offer both individual dishes and combo sets, but be warned—portions are generous, often leading to leftovers that you'll want to take home. I sampled the small set of barbecue pork ribs, which were tender and flavorful, complemented by French fries and a fresh salad. The taste was well-balanced, appealing to both Western and Thai palates with a hint of sweetness. The pork belly steak was another highlight, marinated and grilled to perfection, served with two dipping sauces that enhanced the experience. Overall, the prices were reasonable for the quality and quantity, making it a trusted spot for steak lovers in Nonthaburi.

By: Sunset @ Nonthaburi peer
LGL10 F6B
♎️ Enjoyably reviewing either Engineering documents or Yummy foods😆 ♎️
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanakorn Jornjarern

sample_reviews_en.text: The steak is delicious, large, and affordable. The dipping sauces for both pork and chicken steaks are amazing! The restaurant marinates the meat perfectly, making it tender and melt-in-your-mouth. The beef steak was a little chewy; I preferred the pork. The spicy dipping sauce is great, especially with the basil leaves. Highly recommend for steak lovers – you won't be disappointed! As for the salad, the lettuce was a little bitter. If you're watching your calorie intake, I recommend asking for the dressing separately, as they pour it generously over the salad. The Korean instant noodle salad had soft noodles and a delicious flavor. 😅😅 Overall, everything was delicious. Parking is available on the street. The staff, despite their somewhat rugged appearance, are very polite and provide excellent service. 55555
sample_reviews_en.author: NewBirD

sample_reviews_en.text:
The steak was a large portion, offering good value for the price, but the taste wasn't very good. The chicken wasn't tender enough, and the dipping sauce was overly sweet, to the point it shouldn't even be called "jaew" (a Thai dipping sauce). The spaghetti was quite salty, and the carrots were undercooked—I don't know if that was intentional, but it really ruined the taste. The staff weren't very attentive, and they were very slow to bring water and ice. I saw the table next to me get their food a long time ago, but they still hadn't received their water and ice. On the day I ate there, one table right in front of the grill was very noisy. I'm not sure if they were celebrating, but it made it an unpleasant place to sit.
**Overall, the portion size was good value for the price.**
sample_reviews_en.author: H2O

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for affordable steak in Nonthaburi, this is the only place to go. Everything is delicious, the service is good, and it's worth the wait.
(Photos from several visits 🥩🥗🍟)

...The ingredients are high quality, and all the meats are marinated deliciously.
They grill everything fresh to order; nothing is pre-grilled and reheated. It might take a little longer, but it's definitely worth it 😋 The dipping sauce is consistently delicious, with a perfect balance of sour, spicy, and salty flavors. The various salads are also excellent, with a full range of sour, spicy, and salty flavors. The pork with lime is incredibly good, and the steaks, especially the combo sets, are incredibly good value – you can mix and match anything and you'll be stuffed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Brite Wanrayangkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Could you call this a fusion steak? It's a steak, but the side dishes are basil, cucumber, and carrots, served with a spicy dipping sauce (you can order other side dishes as well).

The steak is a large portion, good value for the price. The meat is tender and flavorful, but it feels more like eating grilled pork/chicken with spicy dipping sauce.

There's air-conditioned seating and outdoor seating. The staff are friendly, but you might have to wait a while for your food. I've been there both when it was busy and when it wasn't, and the wait was the same.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalida nut

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating here for 9 years, and the taste is still the same. It's a true steak restaurant; the steaks are HUGE! Today I ordered spicy, sour, and sweet chicken sausage salad, and drunken noodles with chicken – perfect for those who like their noodles moist and not dry, but skip it if you don't like salty food. The shrimp in fish sauce were large, not small. And importantly, the steaks here are made to order, not pre-made. You might have to wait a little, but not too long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanthicha Supawong

restaurants.name: ไก่ย่างยุคเก้า Kai Yang Yulk Kao
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 79 Chulalongkorn 3 Alley, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
ไก่ย่างยุคเก้า (Kai Yang Yulk Kao) – A Flavor Explosion of Northeastern Thai Goodness!

If you're looking for mouthwatering Isaan-style food, ไก่ย่างยุคเก้า (Kai Yang Yulk Kao) is an absolute must-try! The grilled chicken (kai yang) is insanely tasty — juicy on the inside, crispy on the outside, and full of smoky, aromatic flavor from the traditional marinade. Every bite is packed with that perfect balance of salty, garlicky, peppery goodness that Northeastern Thai food is famous for.

Their som tam is fresh, spicy, and just the right amount of tangy. Pair it with sticky rice and a bit of nam jim jeaw (spicy dipping sauce), and you've got a meal that hits every craving. The vibe is casual, friendly, and full of local charm — just like eating at a roadside stall in Isaan.

So delicious, so satisfying — this is real Thai comfort food that warms your soul!

5/5 – A true taste of the Northeast in every bite.
sample_reviews_th.author: Wisuta Phuwiangkaeo

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted okay, but the papaya salad was incredibly salty, to the point of being inedible. Luckily, the restaurant replaced it. The male owner was loudly scolding his employees, and the way they were giving orders was extremely toxic. The entire time I ate, I could hear the owner yelling and shouting at his staff, which ruined the atmosphere. If he wants to train his employees, he should do it after the restaurant closes. People come to enjoy a relaxing meal, but listening to the boss yell at his employees is awful. This might be because the owner is toxic, so the employees aren't motivated to cook, and customers suffer from the taste of the food. If the owner stopped being toxic or if people just didn't go to the restaurant, they might get more customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Landers

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ “Delicious food with bold flavors!”

I was very impressed after trying it! The Northeastern Thai dishes are intensely flavorful and satisfying. The grilled chicken with fermented fish sauce is especially amazing – spicy and delicious! The mixed papaya salad platter with various side dishes like pork sausage and fried chicken skin is incredibly satisfying. The mixed meatball papaya salad platter is also non-stop delicious. I highly recommend these dishes: 1. Mixed papaya salad platter, 2. Grilled chicken, 3. Mixed meatball papaya salad platter, 4. Spicy soup, 5. Grilled sticky rice. The atmosphere is friendly, the staff are attentive, and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yahk Long

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was stunned at how much food we ordered, and enjoyed, at Kai Yang Yulk Kao last week for just under 1000 baht.

A whole bbqed free range chicken and an assortment of Isaan food classics - somtam, larb, sai krok (sausage), sticky rice, grilled pork neck, and sizzling beef.

All were beautifully prepared and cooked and we left satisfied and very full so we couldn’t ask for more and we highly recommend it for Isaan food.

They were a bit short staffed however, on the night but a minor quibble.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Meng Yee

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. The flavors are rich and good. The shop is on the side of the road. There are a lot of seats. It's probably because there are fewer people walking around these days. This is an Isaan restaurant. The grilled chicken is delicious. The grilled beef is also delicious. The som tam is also delicious. The flavors are focused on the right amount of spicy and sour. There is no parking here. You have to travel to the shop. You can park your car at the Mint building.
sample_reviews_en.author: PotDoi Story

sample_reviews_en.text:
Out of all the restaurants I've eaten at on Banthad Thong Road,
this one was the most disappointing.

The grilled chicken was very dry, mostly bone, with very little meat.
The instant noodles had strange textures, and the pork rinds smelled awful.
The Tom Yum soup was just okay.

I left a lot of food uneaten. So sad. What a waste of money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tap

sample_reviews_en.text: We went without high expectations, but the food was surprisingly delicious. We ordered papaya salad with fermented fish sauce, spicy papaya salad with fermented fish sauce, corn salad, and grilled chicken. Everything was tasty, although the chicken might have been a little dry. Overall, it was good, and the prices were reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: parinee senasu

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were lovely and the service was excellent. The food was delicious! I especially loved the Tom Yum soup; the pork pieces were perfect and the flavor was addictive. I highly recommend the Tom Yum and the Thai papaya salad. The grilled chicken had a rich, spicy flavor that was incredibly tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: benjawan potikul

restaurants.name: Sasirada Cafe
restaurants.address:

28 2 Soi Bangsrimuang 3, Bang Krang, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Good Thai southern home-cooked food that spice Nonthaburian.
Hidden in the alley is one of the great Thai Southern comfort food. They specialised in Thai Rice Noodles with 4 sauces and all the vegetables. Quite spicy but all was good taste, I myself like น้ำยาไม่ใส่กะทิ, all other dish was great as well, a deep-fried Sillago, crab meet omelette, braised pork.
sample_reviews_th.author: Sasawat K

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a southern Thai restaurant. Every dish is full of flavor. My favorite is probably the Moo Hong. It's soft and smooth on the tongue, stewed well, very well-rounded, and the sauce is rich. The sour curry with sea bass and pineapple is great. If you like spicy food, slurping up the soup will be very delicious. I personally scooped up the fish and pineapple and poured a little sauce on it, which made me eat more rice. 👍 The turmeric fried sandfish is a must-order; it's so good that you can eat both the head and the tail. They also have crab omelet, which is delicious but a bit too oily. I didn't take a picture. I ate it right away, lol. For dessert, they had caramelized bananas. It was edible, but the caramelization didn't penetrate the meat because the bananas were still a bit sour. The corn in coconut milk was edible, but not wow. This restaurant has a lot of places to take pictures, lol. Especially the women's restroom is airy and comfortable. The front of the restaurant is also very nice. The owner really prioritizes the atmosphere. There is enough parking space.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanomjeankai P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Southern Thai food.
The best dish here is the sour fish curry with sea bass. Closely similar is the stir-fried minced pork with chili paste. The fish kidney curry is also excellent.
If you're very hungry and order fried dishes, be prepared to wait a while. The restaurant says they make everything fresh to order; nothing is re-fried, so it takes longer.

For those who don't like spicy food, there's a spicy option with three pungent smells.
The stir-fried Gnetum leaves with coconut milk are fantastic.

We had kids in our group, so we ordered the large traditional fried rice – enough for two kids to share comfortably.

After your meal, don't forget dessert! The menu changes daily, but the must-try is the apple caramel. It's the perfect dessert!
sample_reviews_en.author: Oraphin Sa-ardkaew

sample_reviews_en.text:
A southern-style cafe and restaurant. The second floor is a shabu restaurant, but reservations are required. We ordered three dishes, all delicious and not too spicy for us. We wanted to try other dishes, but we were just two people.
The bathroom was beautiful and clean. The staff were polite and provided excellent service.
For drinks, you get coins to put in the claw machine. Each cup costs 2 coins, which was fun. The dessert we ordered was a cheesecake, which was delicious and the cheese was good and worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karnjr Asp

sample_reviews_en.text: The flavors here are incredibly bold, they definitely don't skimp on the herbs and spices. Both dishes we ordered were spectacular in taste. I’m usually not one to go crazy on the coconut soup, but I found myself slurping up most of the Tom Kha Kai. The Southern-style catfish with chili paste was so authentic it transported me straight to Southern Thailand. The main drawback was the lack of actual meat. The catfish felt like mostly head and tail, and the chicken portions in the soup were small and sparse.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khun Lim

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious. The shrimp and fish are cooked perfectly, not overcooked. I recommend the stir-fried shrimp with stink beans and the sour curry. The service is attentive and the staff are all polite. There's plenty of parking, and the bathrooms are clean and fragrant with no musty odors. There's also a cafe inside. The drinks are delicious. You can even use coins to enter the vending machine to win a prize! 🫶🏻✨🫶🏻

P.S. It would be great if the menu had pictures too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanwanut K

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has parking available next to it. They serve Southern Thai food from Surat Thani; the flavors are rich but not too spicy, and it comes with side vegetables and shrimp paste dip.
I didn't try the desserts or drinks.
The braised pork was delicious, made with fresh ingredients. The service was good, and the prices were reasonable considering the portion size and quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: sa harat

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was incredibly delicious! The cooking was excellent, the ingredients were fresh, the shrimp was very fresh and sweet, and the curry paste was perfectly seasoned.

The Southern Thai food was superb. I liked that the portions weren't too large, allowing us to order several dishes.

The restaurant atmosphere was nice, the air conditioning was cool, and the staff were attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: TEERUNYAPUN V.

restaurants.name: Shabushi by Oishi
restaurants.address:

3rd Floor, The Mall Bangkapi, 3522 Lat Phrao Rd, Khlong Chan, Khet Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
On Monday, March 2nd, at approximately 5:30 PM,
I went to eat at Shabu Shabu, The Mall Bangkapi branch, and chose the 399+ set.
Upon entering, I chose my soup base, picked up some sushi and fried items, and sat down to eat. I then picked up food from the conveyor belt, but there was very little food – mostly vegetables and pork. There was almost no seafood like shrimp or squid. Seeing that there was no shrimp, I asked a plump female employee for some. She nodded in agreement, but after many minutes, she still hadn't brought any. I had to rudely grab some from another conveyor belt, which only gave me two plates of shrimp (6 shrimp total) and one plate of squid, but it was practically just scraps. I felt it wasn't worth the price. Overall, the food on the conveyor belt was scarce, and there was very little sushi. The restaurant didn't seem to be that busy, so there should have been more food available. I got so frustrated after eating for a while that I left before my time was up. I hope management or relevant personnel will improve this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Itthipat .P

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I wasn't allowed to enter the restaurant. Shocking. I bought a voucher on lazada and asked to sit at the table instead of the counter because I wanted to have proper space and some solitude while eating and 2 soups in a pot. Staff on reception wasn't accomodating, spoke zero English and just told me no, I can't sit at the table. There was no queue, but I was willing to wait in the queue if needed. She said 'tables are not meant for lonely customers'. It was insulting. They also talked behind my back with each other, turning their backs to me. I asked to talk with the manager and she showed zero experience in conflict management and no English as well. Even though I live here, next time I will prefer to go to Seacon Square or choose another restaurant. In any other branch you can seat at the table alone. Never a problem. Don't expect to see Thai hospitality here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gleb Sapunov

sample_reviews_en.text:
My first time at Shabu Shabu, I was a little disappointed because they were out of a lot of items since the restaurant opened. But then again, many Shabu Shabu branches have low ratings, so I had no choice but to eat at the branch closest to home, haha.

But this time, they did a great job! I used the 100 baht discount on the Bev Food net app and paid only 320 baht for shabu shabu, sushi, and cheese dip. The ingredients, like vegetables and mushrooms, were very fresh, clean, and beautifully presented. This time they even had straw mushrooms (which is often missing). The sesame and seafood dipping sauces here are excellent.

As for the communal plates at the bar, they might need to be more careful about washing them to prevent stains. The staff weren't very smiley, but they were helpful and cleared the plates constantly. I went at 1:40 PM, and it wasn't crowded.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jamais Vu

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, I ate at this branch in the early afternoon. The male employee spoke to me without any politeness, asking, "What price are you choosing?" and "What kind of soup?" At first, I didn't think much of it. After I finished eating and went to pay, the same male employee came over and asked, "Are you a member?" and "How will you be paying?" I was surprised; do they not use polite language with customers here? I chose to pay via scan. After scanning, I showed him the receipt, but he ignored it and continued talking on the phone. I held the screen until I asked, "Can I leave now?" He glanced at me and nodded, without even a word of thanks, and then went back to his phone. He didn't even give me a receipt. Is this how the restaurant trains its employees?
sample_reviews_en.author: thadejj

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to this restaurant on Valentine's Day with my boyfriend, and it was a terrible experience. I regretted spending my money on what we received. We waited in line for a long time, and when we finally got there, the food on the conveyor belt looked unappetizing. We asked the staff for something to eat, but they forgot. They were out of ice, the place was very dirty, and there wasn't much food left. We entered at 8:07 PM, and around 8:40 PM, the staff brought the payment slip. It said we could eat until 9:37 PM, but it was crossed out as 9:00 PM. We asked the staff if we could eat until 9:00 PM, and they said yes, because the mall closes at 9:00 PM. But they only told us with 20 minutes left! It was a awful experience. I will never go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutnicha Jundee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The LGBTQ staff member was quite lazy. By the time the conveyor belt reached us, there was only vegetables left. When I asked if I could order something, she said to just pick it from the conveyor belt. I started complaining, saying, "If you want me to pick from the conveyor belt, then why not just make me sit at the starting point? Because by the time it reaches me, there's only vegetables, no meat." Then another male staff member with glasses came and said I could order from him. After a while, the LGBTQ staff member served us, but not everything we ordered. The same male staff member asked about it, and then he went to get more for us.
If there were 10 staff members like that male guy, it would be so much easier.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jah Srn psr

sample_reviews_en.text: I saw a lot of good reviews so i thought this place is best for the birthday night. But why i felt so disappointed. Two soups (Tom yum and chicken) just taste like water with salt. I mean this is Thailand, everywhere has good Tom yum but not this place. And we choose the most expensive package but only few sushi menu Lol. Sushis with the same taste. And for the meat? only 4 types and 2 fish and one shrimp. 4 types of vegie??? I saw the kitchen put eggs, vegies, and other things to the plates but not meat??? only 2 fruits as dessert and one untasteable ice cream and popsicles????? I mean i can get better ones at others for 399. 2 person for 850 but unsatisfied
sample_reviews_en.author: Ariana

sample_reviews_en.text:
After finishing our meal and going to pay using our points for a 2-for-1 deal, the staff said the system was down and they couldn't do anything. They left many customers waiting to pay. Why didn't the restaurant announce this before customers got up to pay? They knew when each table's dining time was up. We couldn't use our points and had to pay the full price of the food, including tax.
We couldn't scan to pay; cash only.
What if we didn't have cash? If the restaurant had informed us beforehand, we wouldn't have felt so disappointed. I'm definitely not going to use this branch again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kannikar

restaurants.name: Omu
restaurants.address:

6th floor, zone B ,Central World, 999/9 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been a customer of this restaurant for a long time and it's one of my favorites.
Today, I had a rather negative experience at the Central World branch.
The food is delicious and the staff are polite.
However, when it came time to pay, because we showed our LINE account for points and discounts,
the staff member who brought the bill said that next time we should inform them before using any discounts, as it wastes time for them to go and apply the discount (in a tone and with a look that was very unpleasant). Then, the same staff member told the customer to go and scan the bill themselves.

(Normally, every time I've been here, there's never been a problem. In the past, other staff members would take the bill, apply the discount, and then bring the bill to the table for payment.)

I recommend that the restaurant instruct all staff to ask customers after taking their order if they have any LINE friends or are using any discounts. Normally, when it's time to pay, we just raise our hand, and the staff brings the bill. It's inconvenient for customers to shout to inform the staff when it's time to pay that they're using a discount.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mina

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is truly authentic Japanese omurice at a great price. The menu is diverse and tastes just like eating in Japan. I highly recommend their signature dish, the demi-glace hamburger with grilled mushroom salad – it's amazing and the combination is perfect. Don't forget to order the lava egg (+20 baht) for a runny, melt-in-your-mouth experience, because the regular egg wrap is just plain and nothing special. The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, stylish decor, and good service. There's no queue outside, but... I ordered a pork hamburger but received a beef one, and I disagree with the extra charge for the lava egg, so I'm deducting 2 stars for the service.
P.S. Main courses take a little while to prepare, about 15 minutes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alisa Chobisara

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely great value. In a culinary landscape that prices meals in mall including drinks from usually 300baht/person.upward Omu had the beat lunch deal I’ve seen in a long time below 200thb for a main + salad + drink. But it’s not only the price, it’s the quality of the food. The omelette was perfectly cooked though you can choose your lava level where your omelette will basically melt over your rice. The burger was delicious was delicious but most importantly the sauce, curry, gravy whatever you want to call it was top quality and very delicious. Portion wise it was perfect for our hunger level and next time at Central during lunch I will check out their other dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Biedassek

sample_reviews_en.text: Omu Restaurant is a must-visit for anyone who loves omu rice done right. Their wide selection of omu rice dishes is consistently delicious, with each plate offering rich flavors and satisfying textures. What truly sets Omu apart is the presentation—every dish arrives beautifully plated, and the signature lava effect rice is a standout, creating a fun and memorable dining experience as the fluffy omelet gently opens to reveal the rice beneath. The combination of great taste, visual appeal, and attention to detail makes Omu Restaurant a fantastic spot for both comfort food lovers and first-time visitors alike.
sample_reviews_en.author: alvin chan

sample_reviews_en.text: I was looking for lunch and wanted to try this place for a while. I saw they had a lunch promotion, so I decided to give it a try. I ordered the omelet rice topped with a pork hamburger. In terms of taste, I thought it was decent for the price. However, for me, the sauce was a bit too strong – very sour, sweet, and salty. It depends on personal preference. The pork was a little tough. The omelet rice was average, but the egg was a bit dry. Perhaps it's due to the price. Overall, it's edible, but I wouldn't eat here often.
sample_reviews_en.author: Serawut Mun

sample_reviews_en.text: My child wanted to eat omurice, and I found this restaurant. However, after reading the reviews, I was a little hesitant, especially regarding the taste (many people said it was too salty) and the service. But I decided to give it a try, and it was the right decision. The taste was great, and the staff were friendly and easy to call. It was our first time, so we took our time looking at the menu, but they gave us plenty of time without pressuring us. The portions were large and filling, and the price was reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Whitney R

sample_reviews_en.text:
Missed this place their outlet in Singapore closed years ago. We were their first customer shortly after opening as we had a flight to catch.
The fried rice in my omurice was tomato based which was delicious and the egg was so soft and was excellent with the demiglace sauce.
My son loved his lava egg on a pork hamburg. Although it would be even better with fried rice instead of white rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Wong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Omurice⭐️🥚
This is a shop I've been going to since high school. I'm so happy it's still here today. The soft-boiled egg and Japanese rice have an overall very smooth and delicious flavor, no matter which menu item you choose. The prices might seem expensive, but the food is really filling; I almost couldn't finish it. The staff provides good service, and I also like the shop's decor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alise

restaurants.name: Hokkaido Izakaya Susukino
restaurants.address:

Thailand, Bangkok, Si Lom Rd, 6F

sample_reviews_th.text:
Let's try the yakitori (grilled chicken) for 300฿. You can only choose from the grilled chicken options they offer. Drinks are not included.

The chicken thigh was the best, very tender. The salt-grilled version was okay, and the teriyaki version was also decent.
I preferred the soy sauce-grilled Tsukune (minced chicken).
Other menu items mostly use chicken breast as a base, not including offal like heart, liver, and chicken butt.

If you have a big appetite, it's probably worth the price. But honestly, eating just the chicken, especially the breast, is quite filling. They give you 90 minutes to eat.

The Sapporo draft beer was delicious.
sample_reviews_th.author: SSS BKK

sample_reviews_en.text:
Looks as great as it tastes!

Edit: Service was incredibly slow. We sat on table 4 at 6:15 for the yakitori buffet and we were only served three times in the 90 minute window (AND we reserved ahead). A bit of a shame really as food was quite nice and the waitresses seemed quite attentive. Sadly I could not recommend anyone to dine here.

The only redeeming factor for service was that they offered a free parfait for the table (albeit we already ordered one and they didn't make that one free but gave us another one we didn't want and charged us for the other). Maybe next time offer free drinks or something earlier on instead of letting your customers wait for an hour without food served on the table.
sample_reviews_en.author: Varit Senapitak

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's located on the 6th floor, next to the parking garage.
Just take the elevator up and you'll find the restaurant right away.

The atmosphere is like being in Japan.
We came during lunchtime, and they have lunch sets which are reasonably priced, delicious, and filling.
They also provide watermelon and cold green tea.

It wasn't very crowded during lunchtime.
We waited for our food for about 10 minutes.

The food tasted delicious.

The staff informed us that the yakitori menu is only available in the evening, so we ordered the lunch set instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนิดา ธีระภิญโญ

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had the yakitori buffet (330 per pax svc. inclusive). Personally for me, the chicken felt a bit bland but my friends really love them. Would suggest the chicken thighs and fish egg sauce.

Overall this place is a great place to hang out after work. Quite a few selection of alcohol, the beer price isn't too expensive and there is private room.

The entrance can be quite easy to miss. Face the car park building, on the right corner has small staircase leading to the elevator, then go to 6F.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peeranut S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Japanese-style izakaya located in Thaniya.

I had been there for lunch before, but this was my first time visiting in the evening.

Although it's advertised as a Hokkaido izakaya, there aren't that many Hokkaido dishes on the menu; it's just a typical Japanese izakaya.

The food is all reasonably priced, and the taste is just average, nothing special. They have zangi (fried chicken), but it just seemed like regular fried chicken to me.

The spacious interior is a big plus.
sample_reviews_en.author: KA

sample_reviews_en.text: A great spot for quality Japanese Izakaya. The sashimi is fresh and well-prepared, while the charcoal-grilled dishes are flavorful and cooked to perfection. Prices are very reasonable for the quality and portion sizes offered, making it an excellent value for money. Friendly service and a comfortable atmosphere make it a place worth visiting again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cloudy Day

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Japanese restaurant that feels just like dining in Japan.

The food focuses on Hokkaido-style dishes, and the taste is absolutely delicious.

The atmosphere is just like being in an izakaya in Japan.

The service is excellent.

I highly recommend this place. It might be a bit hidden, but it’s definitely worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: fridayclub

sample_reviews_en.text:
My entire family of 4 got food poisoning from this restaurant.
Salmon was soft and mushy like it had been melted and refrozen after already beginning to decompose (rot).

Texture of the fish all wrong. Broke apart into soft gooey mush when touched gently with chopsticks.

Ingredients used definitely not fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: saran anning

restaurants.name: Ryoshin the premium sushi house
restaurants.address:

299 Sukhumvit 21 Rd, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered food at 12:03 PM and waited until 1:40 PM to get it. I ordered the mackerel with sauce. I've eaten here many times before, and it wasn't like this. This is a set meal with mackerel for 250 baht. Even a large tuna is much bigger. I ate the whole set and wasn't full. It was so long and not worth the money. The rice was like baby food, the kind you'd give a 6-year-old. It's like they're afraid you'll be full. I don't know what happened to make the restaurant's standards drop like this. I don't think I'll go back there again. What a waste of money!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: M'ATTY PYT

sample_reviews_en.text: not good restaurant and very expensive for the quality of food. The photos are far from real dishes. besides, most of the dishes of the menu werr sold  out. They also wanted to charged  more than 100 baths for a glass that my daughter of two years old have broken accidentally...if they do not want accident, they should have kids plastic glasses.... get away from this restauranr
sample_reviews_en.author: Silvia Valero

sample_reviews_en.text: The salmon was very fresh, and every dish was delicious. The atmosphere was great, perfect for dining with family or friends. The staff provided excellent service. Highly recommended! 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuwaret Wisetnan

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant looked great, and I was impressed upon entering. The food was delicious, and the staff provided excellent service. I recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Araschaporn T.

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited with my children in the evening. It was really nice because they were friendly. Friendly restaurant with good service. Thank you~~
sample_reviews_en.author: Ahreum Jo

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was good, the staff were polite, the food was delicious and reasonably priced, and the hot green tea was incredibly fragrant.
sample_reviews_en.author: ป อ น ด์ เ จ้ า าา

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is okay, portions aren't very big. Service can be slow at times, but overall it's delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apieaw Poorizz

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the staff were very friendly and provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: KANTAPHAT MADBUNTOW

restaurants.name: Peko Hokkaido Kitchen
restaurants.address:

5 15 Thong Lo, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dinner at Peko Hokkaido Kitchen on Soi 49.
Even though I'd already eaten ramen and was full, I still went when invited.
It didn't disappoint.
At the recommendation of the Japanese owner, I ordered their signature beef dishes, shipped directly from Hokkaido, and everything was delicious. I started with roast beef and beef jerky, and then proceeded to two plates of steak, just like any other meat-loving woman.
The prices were reasonable, and I'd like to try it for lunch next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: james won

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ve been coming to this restaurant for about 10 years, but this is my first time writing a review. The signature roast beef, presented in the shape of a rose, is both visually stunning and absolutely delicious. It pairs perfectly with wine. My personal favorite is the beef curry, a rich and flavorful dish infused with the aroma of the meat. It also goes well with wine. The atmosphere is relaxing, and the staff provides excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gourmet Advisor

sample_reviews_en.text:
The meat seemed very fresh and of excellent quality. We had the steak and the stew, and both were truly delicious! The bread that came with the set was also fantastic, with a strong buttery flavor. I'd recommend the bread here.

Luckily, the restaurant wasn't crowded, but when the food was served, the piping hot soup slid past my 1-year-old son, which gave me a slight chill, so I've given the service 4 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mami F

sample_reviews_en.text: We had the lunch set, which included grilled beef and stew. The grilled beef was amazing! Perfectly medium-rare, tender with just the right amount of marbling, and incredibly flavorful. The stew was also excellent; rich, with a delightful sweet and sour taste. The beef and vegetables were very tender, not chewy at all. Served with bread, it was a perfectly filling meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: zerochaphil me

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there for lunch.
I had the 10th Anniversary Special Lunch, which allows you to enjoy both their popular beef stew (half portion) and hamburger steak at the same time.
It was simply delicious. Not in a bad way, but it had a certain feel of a typical Japanese family restaurant.
It's a place you can easily go to when you're craving meat.
sample_reviews_en.author: KA

sample_reviews_en.text: I like the taste and the atmosphere. It's a bit like an old-school Japanese family restaurant. The price is quite high, but the quality is worth it. I eat here occasionally for special occasions; it's a great treat for myself. What I especially like is that the steak isn't too dense, just light and satisfying.
sample_reviews_en.author: T-ra missu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Homie style, main menu is beef as they import beef from Japan. Their recommend ed menu is beef stew. But i tried Hamburg instead( hamburg fan)
Their Hamburg come with good portion and meat is juicy. Sauce is good too
They have set lunch menus that are good valve
sample_reviews_en.author: Jink Kuru

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best meals we’ve had in Thailand - so well prepared and very kind service. We walked by on a less busy night and weren’t sure whether to go in but so glad we did - the quality is really next level and such a relaxing atmosphere. Highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Char

restaurants.name: Verlan Bangkok
restaurants.address:

76 Sukhumvit 26, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had dinner with friends at this restaurant and it was such a lovely experience. The atmosphere was cozy and welcoming, and the food truly exceeded expectations.

We started off with the complimentary bread and butter — simple but so good it set the tone for the meal. For appetizers, we shared several dishes. The shrimp cocktail with kaffir lime sauce was surprisingly flavorful, a refreshing twist that we didn’t expect. The mochi cheese was a fun and indulgent favorite (a true treat for cheese lovers!), and the chicken liver pâté served with toast and delicious accompaniments was so good we had to order extra.

For mains, we had two standout dishes: the steak and the pork shoulder. The steak was juicy, but the pork shoulder was the unexpected star — tender, rich in flavor, and absolutely unforgettable.

We ended the night with a dessert I can't quite remember the name of, but I do remember the miso ice cream on top — such a unique and satisfying finish to our meal.

All in all, it was a perfectly balanced dinner shared with great company. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: chayanuch piyapanyamongkhol

sample_reviews_en.text:
A brand new French bistro in Bangkok. We went there on valentine day, the restaurant was around 70% occupied by customers during peak hours.

The menu lineup looks interesting and could be more comprehensive with a few more green options. The male stuff who took our orders did very fine job introducing dishes and giving recommendations.

Most of dishes we had were flavorful, interesting ingredients using, bold yet balanced seasoning, decent portions. We ordered 4 dishes with 2 desserts and the dinner costed me around 3,000 THB, quite a decent deal for delightful dinner in lovely setting.

The stuffs were very active during the soft-opening period, cheers for the hard works. And if they could be slightly more attentive, the service would be more smoothly enjoyable. It was a busy night but we were overlooked by stuffs a few times even we sat at a table opposite to the main entrance.

Anyway, we had a good dining experience there and would love to be back again soon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sillapat Tangsuknirundorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
I checked out this newly opened restaurant, and it was so amazing that I had to go back the following week! The food is just that good. The bread was fresh and addictive, and the shrimp cocktail is a must-try—it was flavorful with a unique twist! The pappardelle was cooked to perfection, the fried chicken was crispy and juicy, and the beef was incredibly tender and well-seasoned. Every dish hit the mark!

Beyond the food, the restaurant has a fantastic vibe—stylish decor, a warm atmosphere, and an inviting feel that makes you want to stay. They also have a private room, which I’m definitely planning to book for a dinner in the future. Another major highlight is their wine selection—one of the best I’ve seen in Thailand! Whether you're a wine lover or just looking for a perfect pairing, they’ve got you covered. Plus, they have plenty of parking, making it super convenient.

If you haven’t been yet, this place is definitely worth a visit. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: JungHyun Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Verlan is a true gem in Bangkok’s dining scene.

Great selection of natural wines — their cellar is a treasure trove for wine lovers.

The ambiance strikes the perfect balance between elegance and warmth, making you feel instantly welcome without losing its sophisticated charm.

The food is outstanding, built around the philosophy that great ingredients speak for themselves.

We had the onion tart, which delivered deep umami flavors and was incredibly satisfying, and the whole roasted fish, which was perfectly cooked and full of flavor. The duck was another highlight — lightly crispy, tender, and absolutely unforgettable.

There’s also a generous dessert offering, which is surprisingly hard to find in Bangkok.

Everything we tried was delicious, and we’ll definitely be back to explore more of the menu. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Justin Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a most enjoyable dinner at Verlan. The location was superb and interior decor suggested cozy and cool. The appetizers were outstanding and the pipping hot bread paired with slightly smoky butter and sea salt was grand opener. Outstanding dishes for us were the onion tart and the dry aged duck breasts which were cooked to perfection with a crispy skin served with black garlic paste and picked star beans. Overall a most enjoyable new bistro experience. My only suggestions to the restaurant is
1. Explain the dishes better so people know how to enjoy it best
2. The food profile is very similar with rich reductions, black garlic, onion paste. If they can incorporate acid and/or even a hint of citrus to the dishes, I think the balance would be an improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: DW175

sample_reviews_en.text:
A true hidden gem in the Khlong Toei neighborhood of Bangkok. From the moment you turn off of Soi Sukhumvit 26 into the parking lot you know you are somewhere special. The oversized wooden doors swing open to welcome you and your guest on a chill journey of culinary delights. From the onion soup to the Thai Tajima Wagu tenderloin everything we had was fantastic. Don’t miss the mixed salad (impeccably well
seasoned and not pictured because I inhaled it) the wine selection is quite extensive, and if you ask nicely they may make you a nice tasting flight of the wines by the glass if you are indecisive like me. Overall I am very impressed with this amazing oasis and cannot wait to return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexis De Berry

sample_reviews_en.text:
I didn't have high expectations for the food because of the many reviews. But when I actually tried it, it was surprisingly delicious. Every dish was tasty, the prices were reasonable, the cocktails were great, and they used high-quality ingredients. You could feel the chef's care in each dish; everything was well-prepared and the portions were generous – just enough to fill you up. The atmosphere was nice, the music was good, the restrooms were clean, and there was ample parking.

However, I was seated next to the kitchen door, and there was occasional noise from conversations in the kitchen whenever someone opened the door.
sample_reviews_en.author: อุฟฟุฟวยยวยฟวย อันเยวทวยนวยทวย

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely fantastic! The restaurant is close to our condo, so wanted to try without much expectation. Blown away by the flavors! We tried the liver terrine, parsley pappadelle, red snapper, and tenderloin. Every dish was delicious. A lot of depth, fresh local ingredients. Didn't know Thai beef could taste that good! Dessert was also nice. Extensive wine list. Verlan Negroni is another must-try, fragrant with a good kick. Love this place. Not so many photos because I was lost in enjoying the flavors!

Edit to add that service was also very friendly and attentive. Really amazing experience at Verlan Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pich PP

restaurants.name: Nai Him's Ivy Gourd Shoots Noodles
restaurants.address:

147 Happy Land Sai 1 Rd, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
A hidden gem in Bang Kapi, truly hidden! 🚕

There's no parking in front, beside, or behind the shop. If you're driving, you'll have to find your own parking.

The noodle soup with morning glory is flavorful, slightly salty, and very fragrant with pepper. The clear broth is delicious and you'll finish the whole bowl. The fried garlic is incredibly aromatic. For those who love pork offal, this is heaven! My partner loves it so much, he considers it the best offal place ever.

They only offer three types of noodles: thin rice noodles, vermicelli, and egg noodles (the egg noodles are the highlight).

They also have pork blood soup and rice. If you don't eat offal, order "three types of pork offal soup + blood," that's the shop's signature dish.

The picture shows a "small bowl of noodle soup without offal, special" for 70฿. Everyone who visits this shop is sure to be impressed.

⏰ We recommend coming around 11:00 AM or 1:30 PM because it gets crowded at lunchtime and there are few tables.

Free Chinese tea is available! ✨🎉
sample_reviews_th.author: Arinta

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mr. Him's, the legendary odorless offal shop. I won't give a long review, but let's just say it's incredibly good! Here's a summary:

- The minced pork is like a savory stir-fry, with a little fat mixed in. It's delicious with hot rice.

- The offal is superb. Everything is perfectly free of any unpleasant smell or taste, unlike some shops that use artificial offal.

- The blood is sweet. While pre-packaged pork blood is clean and safe, it's not as sweet and delicious. Fresh blood, if not fresh enough, can have an odor. This blood is sweet, soft, and melts in your mouth.

- The kidney is amazing, bouncy and chewy like chewing on a Pipo pudding.

- I ordered the dry noodle soup (70 baht) and rice (5 baht). Parking is difficult, but there's a paid parking lot nearby for 20 baht.

- Mr. Him, the owner, or "Pa Him" ​​as many call him, is a laid-back guy who doesn't use much polite language, but he's cute. You can see he took a picture with us! 5555+

📍 Mr. Him's Noodle Shop Behind Happy Land Market, Bang Kapi
💰 Dry Noodle Soup (Kao Lao) 70.- Rice 5.-
⏱️ 10:00 AM - 3:00 PM
🙏🏻 P.S. If you want to eat all the offal, go before noon.

#DietStartsTomorrow
sample_reviews_en.author: พรุ่งนี้ค่อยลด 2morrowdiet

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been eating at this noodle shop since my university days. I've been coming back since their old location, and I followed them even after they moved to Happy Land. The owner, an elderly gentleman, meticulously prepares each dish, spending time slicing and arranging the pork in each bowl. It takes a while, but it's worth the wait.

As for the taste, it's my absolute favorite noodle shop, number one in my opinion. The broth is rich and flavorful with a spicy kick from the black pepper. The pork offal is clean and odorless. The minced pork might be a bit salty for those who don't like salty food, but I love it!

A word of caution: order everything you want in advance. If you enjoy it and want to order more, you'll have to wait longer. They serve in order of arrival; no skipping the queue. For those with weak willpower, the owner's son might seem a bit stern and intimidating. Don't be picky when ordering. Prepare your order and your menu beforehand, and you're guaranteed a satisfying meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siripansa Thongkumnerd

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious!!!
The offal had no gamey smell at all. The broth was clear and fragrant with pepper; perfect for sipping hot.

The intestines at this shop are a bit salty, maybe because they're boiled in fish sauce or have some secret recipe. If you don't like salty food, I recommend avoiding eating the intestines plain.

The pork was also incredibly delicious. The minced pork was tasty, and the tender pork was the kind that still felt like pork in both texture and flavor, unlike the tender pork nowadays that barely tastes like pork anymore. Delicious!

The chrysanthemum tea was perfect; rich but not overly sweet, and had a lovely chrysanthemum aroma.

The chopsticks were cute; it shows attention to detail.
I finished the whole bowl of the broth; no need to add any seasoning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tara Terra

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely delicious! Poh Teck Tung, I had to wait! Haha.
This hidden gem in the Happy Land area.
This noodle shop serves incredibly delicious morning glory.
The morning glory isn't overripe, and the offal isn't at all stinky. The best dish here is definitely Xiang Ji. The owner cooks the noodles until they're really crunchy and, most importantly, there's no fishy smell. The minced pork is chopped very finely. The small pieces are cooked just right, and they're incredibly chewy and tender. The soup is incredibly flavorful.
The pork bone aroma is amazing. I'm telling you, it's delicious!
- There's parking a little past the shop, turn left.
Then turn right and you'll see a parking lot under a building with a barrier.
It costs 20 baht per hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pariyaporn W.

sample_reviews_en.text: We ate at 11 am on a Sunday and the tables were almost full. We waited for our food for over 10 minutes. The noodle soup was like a pork blood soup, with morning glory (not many vegetables) and offal, which was well-prepared, clean, and easy to eat. The noodles were thinner than usual. Overall, it was delicious. Personally, I liked the dry egg noodles with minced pork. Parking on the street is difficult; it's best to park in the parking lot behind the Nomjit shopping mall, which is 20 baht per hour. On the day we went, we paid 40 baht and parked for 1 hour and 4 minutes because we went for a walk afterwards 😂😂😂 (Free parking requires receipts from the mall totaling 500 baht). The restaurant is closed every Monday.
sample_reviews_en.author: yimp yimpdow

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nai Him's Tamlung Noodles
Another delicious pork noodle shop in the Bang Kapi area.
It's a clear broth pork noodle soup. The shop doesn't have bean sprouts, but it does have tamlung leaves. The pork toppings are generous, including sliced ​​pork, crispy pork, and pork offal.
The tripe, intestines, and kidneys are in good-sized pieces, clean and delicious. It's another shop that I can say is delicious without needing any luck.

sample_reviews_en.author: นาย กาแฟ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Recommendations:
1) Arrive before 11:00 AM (guaranteed to get a bite).
2) Parking is available at the Happyland building. 20 baht per hour.
3) Bring your own tissues.
4) Order both takeout and dine-in.

The taste was pretty average, so you might expect a bit more. The soup was well-seasoned, but a bit too sweet for the bone broth. The thin noodles were excellent. The minced pork was good, too. The offal wasn't huge and didn't smell bad, but... it was average. The crispy pork was cut like... hmm.
The restaurant has a lot of regulars. Be prepared for the service of a long-established restaurant that doesn't have to cater to casual customers.
😀 An unbiased review, giving an overall picture.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chamq-.-p

restaurants.name: TamTam Restaurant
restaurants.address:

50 Sukhumvit 42, Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: TamTam Ekkamai is undoubtedly one of the best somtum shops in Bangkok. This cozy spot serves up bold and delicious flavors that leave a lasting impression. Their somtum is a standout and bursting with the perfect balance of spice, sweetness, and tang. I ordered their best seller Somtum. They have a wide menu of classic Thai dishes like crispy fried pork, fragrant boiled rice, fresh vegetables, and flavorful dipping sauces, every meal here feels both comforting and satisfying. Beyond the food, what truly elevates the experience is the warm, friendly staff who always welcome you with a wide smile. Their genuine hospitality makes you feel like part of the TamTam family from the moment you walk in. Once you’ve dined here, you’ll quickly understand why customers keep coming back. It’s a place where great food and heartfelt service go hand in hand. Must visit restaurant, if you are in this area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Smohith P.M

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a bit noisy when you go, but it's really good for the price. It's air-conditioned, but it's cheap. The tom yum soup has a lot of peanut powder, so it's savory and delicious. The tom yum soup was just okay... why bother?
Try the morning glory.
It has the perfect amount of fried shallots and garlic, so
it's just spicy, but the mild shallot and garlic flavors complement each other perfectly.
The fried rice reminds me of a delicious Korean restaurant. The keum yum soup has a lot of fat, so it can smell a bit at times.
I went there about six times while staying at Ekkamai.
For breakfast, this is the place for morning glory som yum soup. Grab some from the corner and try it. It's delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Victoria Kim

sample_reviews_en.text:
TamTam is hands down one of my favorite somtam spots in the area. The flavors are bold, authentic, and properly spicy — just like real Pattaya-style somtam should be. Every dish is packed with flavor and never feels watered down.

The menu has a great variety beyond somtam too — grilled meats, larb, and other Isan dishes are all well-seasoned and super satisfying. Ingredients taste fresh, portions are generous, and everything comes out fast.

The vibe is casual and lively, perfect for eating with friends or family. Service is quick and friendly, even when the place is busy.

If you’re craving real, spicy, no-compromise Isan food, TamTam Ekkamai is a must. Easily 5 stars from me 🌶️🔥
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaithawat Dongcharoaen

sample_reviews_en.text:
TamTam Restaurant (Som Tum Pattaya – Ekkamai branch) is a wonderful spot with great food and a warm, welcoming atmosphere. The dishes were delicious, fresh, and full of authentic flavor – exactly what you hope for when craving Thai cuisine.

The staff was very friendly and attentive, providing excellent service throughout the meal. Prices are also very fair, offering great value for the quality you get.

A really nice local restaurant with tasty food, top service, and a relaxed vibe. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Max

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited this place for Thai food for my last dinner, and if I ever go back to Thailand, I definitely want to come back here again!
The owner was very friendly, and the restaurant was really clean and nice! I think the prices were very reasonable.
The pork belly dish was also delicious 🤩🤩🤩
I tried Tom Yum Goong for the first time, and I ate it all without leaving a single bit. It was really delicious.
The Som Tam and other Thai food were also delicious. Seriously.
sample_reviews_en.author: emmaa

sample_reviews_en.text:
The seasoning is strong, which makes it even more delicious. It's great that there is no service charge. The beer is lukewarm, so order some ice to drink with it!

++ I visited twice while staying at a nearby accommodation and really enjoyed the meal.

You cannot use cards; only cash or scanning is accepted. Pad See Ew doesn't seem to be on the menu, but they made it for me when I asked. They also gave me cilantro when I asked if I needed it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dayeon Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here because of the good reviews.
Three Morning Glory rolls were really delicious.
The fried pork belly was amazing.
The pork neck rolls were delicious.
The egg pancakes were delicious.
The Tom Yum Kung was delicious.
The two fried chicken wings were delicious.
Four bowls of rice.
A large glass of water.
Two juices.
Total: 1,127 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: 오경주

sample_reviews_en.text: 7 dishes and 2 drinks for only 673 Baht... super affordable and delicious! You can request to have your dishes to be made non-spicy. The front of house staff is very friendly and helpful. Very clean environment, with air-con and music, couldn't ask for more at this price range! Hands down the best restaurant I've been in Bkk🥰🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Jing Yi Tang

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรืออยุธยา สาขา2
restaurants.address:

221/8 ม.8 บิ๊กวันคอมเพล็กซ์ Phuchao Saming Phray, Samrong Klang, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is a simple shack, a bit dark inside, so you have to look carefully from the street to spot it.
Parking is available along the roadside.

The prices are inexpensive, and the portions are commensurate with the price. A regular pork boat noodle soup is 15 baht, a special is 25 baht, and the dry version is also 25 baht.
The broth is rich and on the salty side, with 1-2 small pieces of pork in the bowl.
They give you a generous amount of vegetables in a large bowl.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fia Fia

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered takeout but asked for chopsticks and chili peppers from the condiment table because the chili peppers they give in the takeout set are different. The staff said they didn't have any, even though they were on the table. They didn't care about the customer, and a noodle shop should at least have chopsticks. I usually eat there often, but it seems like they've changed staff. The noodles taste delicious, but the service is terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cherry _

sample_reviews_en.text:
The flavor of the waterfall noodle soup is rich, well-balanced, and uniquely the shop's signature. The broth contains a generous amount of pork blood, but it's not overly thick.

The price is 20 baht for a regular serving and 30 baht for a special serving.
sample_reviews_en.author: วริยา มารศรี

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dry noodles seasoned just like the boat noodles I ate as a kid. Very delicious. Always dry.
Dry noodles (beef or pork): 30 baht
Pork with broth: 20 baht
Beef with broth: 30 baht
Rambutan in syrup: 25 baht
