Parking available next to the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanyathorn Wasukree

sample_reviews_en.text: They dropped the noodles in a clump, but didn't blanch them and put them in the bag. It was awful. The person who blanched them just pretended nothing happened, but I still paid the same price. I'm done with this shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: britney wongka

sample_reviews_en.text:
The noodles were edible, but the lime juice wasn't sour at all. I added over 10 spoonfuls and it still wasn't sour.
The price was inexpensive: 10 bowls get you a free bottle of soda.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sky Yaem

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is delicious boat noodles. I've eaten here countless times.
The flavor is intense, the pork is tender, and the broth is rich and flavorful. The dry version is also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thida P

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, generous portion, only 20 baht. I ate until I was full. The broth is rich and flavorful, with large pieces of liver. It's authentically Ayutthaya boat noodle soup.
sample_reviews_en.author: krissana beer

restaurants.name: Pavilion
restaurants.address:

G Floor Dusit Thani Bangkok, 98 Rama IV Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Sunday brunch at Pavilion is seriously so good! The food was fresh, and there was an amazing variety to choose from—Thai, Chinese, Western dishes, and a great steak selection. There really is something for everyone!

The abalone siu mai was one of my favorites. The truffle spaghetti was also excellent—they shaved so many slices of fresh truffle on top without holding back at all! The foie gras portions weren’t huge, but that didn’t matter because you could order as much as you wanted, and it was absolutely delicious.

There was also unlimited caviar, and the steak section had a great variety of cuts. Meat lovers will definitely be happy here! And the desserts were just as impressive as the savory food. There was such a huge and varied dessert section, plus ice cream too—definitely not to be missed.

The staff were also incredibly lovely and attentive. They regularly came by to check if we needed anything, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable.

Such a happy and satisfying Sunday brunch experience! So much variety, great quality, and plenty to eat. I left feeling very happy and very full! Definitely worth trying. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Nitchawee C.

sample_reviews_en.text:
We have been here for Sunday brunch. The restaursnt was well booked and they called us before to check whether we are really coming as there seems to be a waitlist. So if ypu want to come here I recommend to book well in advance.

This Sunday Brunch is superb. Service was amazing, they were almost more staff members vs guests and were literally reading our wishes from our lips.

Food was great both in terms of variety as well as in terms of quality. There is a huge buffet and on addition a good set of dishes ypu can order from the menu. Each time ypu order they bring you a 'taster-size'portion such that you can enjoy a good part of the different options.

Price is upper range for Bangkok but very fair for the quaöity and level of service you receive.

This was my best dine out experience in Bangkok so far.
sample_reviews_en.author: Raphael Maccagnan

sample_reviews_en.text: Exploring new food spots has become my favorite hobby lately! 😋 I stumbled upon this amazing restaurant that serves the most authentic dishes. It felt like I was transported straight to Dusit with every bite! 🇹🇭 The flavors were so rich and genuine, truly a culinary adventure. I'm already planning my next visit to try more of their incredible menu. This place is a must-try for anyone who appreciates real, delicious food. Seriously, if you're a foodie, you need to add this to your list! My taste buds are still doing a happy dance. ✨ Don't miss out on this gem! #FoodieAdventures #AuthenticCuisine #RestaurantFinds #TasteOfThailand #FoodGoals
sample_reviews_en.author: Halley Christoforus

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and varied, quite good actually. I recently ate at their Phra Nakhon branch, and personally, I think this one is better. The Thai food is excellent, with more variety. The Chinese food and dim sum were good. I didn't try much meat, but I tried some and they were great. The seafood platter was tucked away in a corner, out of sight. It's a shame I missed out on the soft-shell crab; it was already wilted and dry. The staff said they were out of soft-shell crab and gave me fried shrimp instead. The crab chili paste was also delicious, comparable to Southern Thai restaurants. You should try it if you have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: สิริพงศ์ เหมือนเงิน

sample_reviews_en.text:
A true hidden gem in Bangkok. Every dish was absolutely delicious—each one perfectly executed and genuinely memorable. From the moment we walked in, the service was exceptional and attentive in all the right ways.
A special thank you to Bee and Aoo for taking such great care of us. Their professionalism, warmth, and thoughtful recommendations made the entire experience even more enjoyable.
An outstanding dining experience from start to finish—we’ll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mario

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sunday Brunch at Pavilion Dusit
The food is very well suited to Thai palates, with a great selection of Thai dishes featuring familiar and authentic flavors. The seafood is exceptionally fresh, and several dishes really stood out.
The only downside is that the restaurant can feel a little crowded and noisy due to its limited space. That said, the excellent food and attentive service made for a very enjoyable dining experience overall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dada Dada

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best Sunday brunch options in Bangkok right now.

Unlimited lobsters with countless lines of cuisine.

Great value, very delicious. Around 3500 baht per person.
The food selection is extensive, but I felt the dining area was quite small, making the seating feel a bit cramped (it's nowhere near the size of Dusit Thani's previous restaurant).

Overall, I liked it and will visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachadech Marprasert

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you are looking for delicious food and a beautiful atmosphere, Dusit Thani Pavilion is the place to go. Every dish we tried was "very nice" and worth every penny.

The staff here also nice. They are so lovely and professional. Huge thanks to Nonny, Sun, and Tar for their great energy and constant smiles. Their hospitality made our visit feel very special. I will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Binod Ojha

restaurants.name: Chai Jia Chai 蔡家菜
restaurants.address:

265/2 ซ. สุขุมวิท 31 Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Chinese omakase restaurant uses creative techniques to blend Chinese and Western ingredients.

Even the appetizers are enough to boost your confidence. The first bite of foie gras was amazing, the uni was incredibly sweet, there was snow fish, duck, the highest grade Iberico ham, and caviar was generously added.

The main courses were incredibly substantial. It started with Yipin Guanyan soup using bird's nest (75,000 baht per kilo) and succulent Alaskan crab, followed by fish maw (35,000 baht per kilo), abalone, giant truffles sliced ​​continuously, A5 Wagyu beef with 20-year-old orange peel sauce, and their signature dish, lobster congee – each person got half a huge lobster!

And the dessert was incredible. No matter how full you are, you'll want to keep eating it. I loved every bite, especially the coconut-infused tofu pudding that melted in your mouth.

It's safe to say this restaurant doesn't just rely on top-notch ingredients; the chef has incredible experience and exceptional technique. Most importantly, the taste was truly impressive. It really worked, it wasn't just a figment of my imagination.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirada Chokwareeporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
MUST VISIT Modern Cantonese Omakase in Bangkok‼️😍

Feast on the grandest and most luxurious Chinese meal fit for royalties at the award-winning Modern Cantonese Omakase @chaijiachai.bkk that’s in Bangkok’s Top 25 restaurants! 🙌

Every elegant dish is an impeccable masterpiece to behold; exceptionally prepared with not just one but a magnificent combination of the freshest, finest jewels of the land and sea; resulting in a sensational symphony of indelible heavenly flavours and intricate textures. 😍

In fact, it’s my second visit here because my first experience was truly phenomenal and this time was even more impressive, surpassing my expectations! 👏

Truly Chai Jia Chai is more than an excellent fine dining establishment but a destination to visit for any epicurean, where Chef’s Tsai admirable creativity and culinary prowess exalts precious, elusive ingredients to its zenith 🌟

📍 Chai Jia Chai
🚗 265/2 Soi Sukhumvit 31, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
⏰ 12pm-2pm | 5pm - 10pm daily
💰 BHT 3800, 5800, 9800, 13800

Check out my full review and video on HAPPYLIZZIEEATS on Instagram or Tik Tok
sample_reviews_en.author: Happylizzieeats

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chai Jia Chai by Taiwanese Chef

This fine dining Chinese restaurant, helmed by a Taiwanese chef, offers a meticulously designed multi-course dining experience. The presentation is beautiful and spectacular, incorporating real ingredients to tell a story.

The food was incredibly delicious and diverse. What impressed me most was the exceptional quality and portion size of the ingredients, reflecting the chef's meticulous attention to detail. I also appreciated the unique and distinctive flavors of the dishes; they were not overly seasoned, emphasizing the natural taste of the ingredients.

Highly recommended for those who enjoy Chinese or Taiwanese cuisine. It's a must-try.

I learned about this restaurant from the Top 25 Restaurants Bangkok list, where it ranked 12th in 2024.

Reservations can be made via Google Maps or the restaurant's official Line account. Bookings are generally recommended.

The restaurant offers three course menus priced at 5,800, 9,800, and 13,800 THB.

The restaurant is located in Sukhumvit Soi 31, right on the street. Parking is available free of charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wann :D

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chai Jia Chai is one of Bangkok's most exciting fine dining surprises — a remarkable Cantonese-Taiwanese omakase experience tucked away in a residential building on Sukhumvit 31. The chef's creativity shines through every dish: refined, elegant presentations with deep, nostalgic flavours.

Standout dishes include the exceptional lobster rice soup and the beautifully prepared seafood courses. The chef interacts with diners throughout the meal, adding a personal and intimate touch that elevates the whole experience. Service is attentive and genuine.

The clean, minimalist setting lets the food do the talking. For lovers of refined Chinese cuisine in a unique setting, this is an unmissable dining destination in Bangkok. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexander Ericsson

sample_reviews_en.text: Because we made a reservation in advance, there was no need to wait. The overall atmosphere of the restaurant is like a private kitchen. It's not very big, but the decor is exquisite. The ingredients are also very particular, all high-end, and the chef is from Taiwan. Most of the waiters speak Chinese, and each dish has a written description. They launch a theme every three months or quarter, cooking according to the theme's ingredients. This is a high-end Chinese restaurant and a very good choice for Chinese restaurants in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jing Huang

sample_reviews_en.text: The first time I heard of “Cantonese Omakase”, I wanted to try it out to see what it’s like. Turn’s out it be an amazing meal of delicious food, beautiful food presentation and professional service. The Omakase course itself was well thought through. The Chef really showcased his variety of skills in every of the courses. My favorite was the Kaviari Caviar Foie Gras with Taiwanese style Iberico ham pancake, 72hrs braised abalone, A5 wagyu beef with Xinhui 20years dried tangerine peel and lobster porridge was the best!
sample_reviews_en.author: Fa S Boonvisut

sample_reviews_en.text:
A super luxury Cantonese and Taiwanese style fine dining restaurant. It is omakase type so you don’t have to choose the dish but just choose the price of the course. Every dish is well prepared and the chef only using highest standard quality ingredient. Dish serving is also full with fun so really enjoyed the whole set of dinner. The price might be high but you get what you paid.
The only catch is the selection of alcohol beverage is limited so might consider to bring you own.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Pai

sample_reviews_en.text:
For the main course, it's usually beef, but for those who don't eat beef, the restaurant offers the option to substitute lamb or shrimp. They do a great job of catering to customer preferences.

Towards the end of the meal, the chef brought out some Kaoliang liquor (58% alcohol) for us to sample! The aroma was intensely strong; one glass is definitely enough to get you drunk.
sample_reviews_en.author: Antonio Oattono

restaurants.name: Mummaam Suki
restaurants.address:

อาคารด้านในของโลตัสโกเฟซ ติดกับร้าน คิวพิคและสเต็กลุงหยิก 24/58 ม.5 ในโลตัสโกเฟซ พัทยา 53 Noen Plubwan Rd, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're in the Pattaya area and love buffets, come check this place out! MooMaam Suki in Pattaya might be just what you're looking for. They offer three price options, so choose the one that suits your budget and appetite. The seafood, meats, and vegetables are fresh and clean. There are many dipping sauces to choose from; I personally like the Cantonese-style sauce which isn't too sweet. It's all up to your preference! You can customize your own sauces. There's also a wide selection of desserts, or you can finish with ice cream. The restaurant is spacious with plenty of seating and convenient parking in front.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuch S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today my wife and I visited the Mummam Suki buffet and were very satisfied. We were especially impressed by the river prawns – fresh and tasty, there were really a lot of them. The atmosphere is pleasant and cozy, the staff is polite and attentive.

Interestingly, there were almost no Europeans except us. There were only Europeans accompanied by Thais, which made our experience even more unique. We highly recommend this place for those who want to get a real Thai culinary experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: viktar kamylevich

sample_reviews_en.text: I came from Bangkok and randomly looked for a place to eat, and I found this restaurant. It was totally worth the money I spent. The ingredients were high quality, the dipping sauces were delicious and varied. I even tried making my own sesame sauce by mixing it with the restaurant's special sauce – it was surprisingly good! The staff were also excellent and very polite. I wish they had a branch in Bangkok. Personally, I think it's better than the big brands in Bangkok in every way.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jackpurcell eiei

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here, and the meat was incredibly delicious! The dipping sauces and the music playing in the restaurant were also great. However, I'm deducting points because the staff didn't explain the promotions thoroughly. I specifically mentioned beforehand that I wanted to use the senior citizen discount, but the staff told me to sign up for membership without mentioning how to use my father's information. As a result, I didn't get the discount.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bussaya Kon

sample_reviews_en.text:
A great value suki specialty restaurant frequented by locals.

It is a buffet-style restaurant, so it is a wonderful local eatery where you can enjoy a generous and delicious meal...

The bill came out to about 1,500 baht for 4 people (including two beers).

The price is reasonable.

A restaurant worth visiting during your trip to Pattaya.

Disadvantage: Long waiting times due to its popularity.

Pro: You can enjoy a variety of dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: 조대찬

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't know how to explain it, but I've been here so, so often. Like, seriously, I've been eating here for almost 3 years straight, since they first opened. The quality is still as good as ever. I've met the owner, and she's incredibly kind. Some days she'd give away free beef, other days marinated shrimp or salmon. But now I've moved to Bangkok, and I really miss this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Blacx mirror

sample_reviews_en.text: Great value for money. Very affordable prices, huge variety of food, including pork and beef, fried items, and tons of dipping sauces. Lots of desserts too, like ice cream and cake. Very impressed. The seating is comfortable, like a study table for an exam 😄 They're open late but the food selection is still excellent. I really wish they would open a branch in Nonthaburi.
sample_reviews_en.author: JJ JJ

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! They have both grilling and shabu-shabu, perfect for those who want to try both. Lots of choices, the restaurant is clean, and there are many dipping sauces to choose from. The dark broth is amazing! The beef is high-quality, not tough at all, very tender. The pork is good, and the seafood is also good. But expect a bit of a wait! 🥲
sample_reviews_en.author: Nini Nene

restaurants.name: Harlan‘s Pattaya
restaurants.address:

โครงการเวลคัมทาวน์ Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve been to Harlan’s Pattaya about four or five times, and each visit has been a little different, which is part of the appeal.

The food is consistently very good, and Harlan himself is usually in the kitchen as the chef and owner. He has a strong reputation, and it shows in both the quality of the food and the way he interacts with guests. He’s friendly, welcoming, and clearly takes pride in the restaurant.

One thing to know is that the menu changes fairly often. That can be a positive if you like variety, but if you find a favorite dish, there is no guarantee it will still be there the next time you visit. For me, that makes each visit feel more like an experience than a place where I go back for the exact same meal.

The restaurant itself is smaller and intimate. The atmosphere is fine, but not really the main reason I go. The food and the personality of the place are what stand out more than the setting.

Overall, Harlan’s is a very good restaurant with excellent food, a talented chef-owner, and a unique feel. It’s not necessarily somewhere I would visit every month, but it is definitely worth returning to from time to time when you want something a little different.
sample_reviews_en.author: Don Thompson

sample_reviews_en.text:
On my first trip to Pattaya, Thailand, I went to "Harlan's Pattaya" 🇹🇭✨ The restaurant had a wonderful atmosphere and was the perfect place to enjoy a meal during my trip!

I misread my reservation time and was an hour late, but when I emailed them, they replied "We're waiting for you" and welcomed me with a smile, which I really appreciated.

This time, I had the meat in puff pastry, T-bone steak, and pasta 🥩🍝 Everything was delicious, but the meat in puff pastry was particularly memorable! The fragrant aroma of the pastry and the deliciousness of the meat inside were a perfect match, and I enjoyed it to the very last bite 😋

The T-bone steak was also substantial and satisfying, allowing me to fully enjoy the deliciousness of the meat! The pasta was also seasoned just right and paired perfectly with the meat dishes 🍝✨

The portions were generous, and I was completely full!

I would recommend this restaurant to anyone who wants to enjoy delicious meat or Western food in Pattaya for a little luxury 🥰 It was a wonderful meal that will be a memorable part of my trip! If I ever have the chance to go to Pattaya again, I would definitely like to visit again! ✨
sample_reviews_en.author: T I

sample_reviews_en.text:
Another influencer restaurant.

While the quality of the meat at this steakhouse was excellent—tender, flavorful, and cooked to perfection— Even though I had originally ordered wagyu and was served something else
almost everything else about the dining experience was disappointing. The atmosphere was truly dreadful, with harsh lighting and dated decor that did nothing to enhance the meal.

The noise level was absolutely unbearable; conversation was nearly impossible as sounds bounced off hard surfaces, creating a constant roar of voices, clattering dishes.

Perhaps most unpleasant was the overwhelming smell—an intense mixture of grilling meat, smoke, and grease that clung to everything. While you expect some aroma in a steakhouse, this was excessive and followed me home on my clothes.

If you're solely focused on quality meat and can tolerate terrible ambiance, deafening noise, and powerful odors, this place might work for you. Otherwise, there are surely better options that offer good steak without the sensory assault.
sample_reviews_en.author: FARID ZAID

sample_reviews_en.text:
That wasn't dinner, that was a gastronomic experience. Being fortunate enough to have travelled around the world eating in some fine restaurants my opinion here is simple, Harlan Goldstein has got it nailed here in Pattaya. Myself along with my brother and friend Scott who lives in Pattaya were there on Tuesday evening sitting in what turned out to be the hot spot seats were we could chat with and witness the creative magic of Harlan, what a pleasure!!
I had the foie gras starter followed by his now legendary signature Beef Wellington, the lads had a mixture of prawn and sashimi starters then sea bass and steak mains. It was excellent, all of it.

If you're coming along to Pattaya this is a must do for anyone who loves the real deal.

A fantastic experience ran by a man who clearly knows his stuff along with the assistance of a more than dedicated long serving Thai team.

Kindly,
Michael Buttery
sample_reviews_en.author: Mick B

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came back to Harlans Pattaya for a follow-up visit after the recent changes, and the improvement is noticeable.

The dining area now feels much calmer and more comfortable, and the new separation from the kitchen has solved one of the biggest issues from our previous visit: you no longer leave the restaurant with your clothes smelling like steak. 😄

Most importantly, the food remains outstanding. The quality, presentation and execution were once again on an extremely high level. The Beef Wellington was excellent and, in our opinion, the overall food quality is still Michelin-level.

It’s great to see a restaurant listening to feedback and actually improving the guest experience without compromising the food.

Highly recommended and definitely one of our favorite places in Pattaya.

#KOLBMASTER
sample_reviews_en.author: Stefan Kolb (#KOLBMASTER)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Second visit to Harlan’s, always a great culinary experience as well as angreat atmophere with brilliant staff. We opted for the grilled wagyu, a real masterpiece. Below my feedback from the first visit.
A great dinner experience at Harlan.
Service is amazing, always there to care about your well being.
We opted out for the chief set menu and were very satisfied with the 5 set dishes. The chief took time to present the menu to us and any feedback were welcomed.
The location place is also quite convenient and fit the purpose 'soi welcome town'
Thanks for all attention provided and the great food
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrick Antivackis

sample_reviews_en.text: By far the best steak dinner I have had in the 3 years I have lived in Thailand!First off I would like to mention the owner and his lovely staff,thank you all for making my wife's birthday so special,the owner and chef is an extremely friendly fellow as were the waitresses.Now on to the important things,the food was out of this world delicious,from the smoked beef taco appetizer to our main course ribeyes and finally the sizzling sauce brownie and vanilla ice cream.Harlans is a must if you are in the Pattaya area,to be honest if I could give more than 5 stars I would!
sample_reviews_en.author: Erik Rivas

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We went to Harnals Steaks in Pattaya and had the Five Combat – simply outstanding! 🥩 The meat was cooked to perfection and tasted absolutely fantastic.

We especially want to commend the excellent staff: super friendly, attentive, and courteous. The owner even greeted us personally, which we found very nice. You really feel welcome here.

Highly recommended – we will definitely be back!

And a special thank you to Kolbmaster (Stefan) for the great recommendation – it was absolutely worth it! 👍😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Danny

restaurants.name: Wine Connection Royal Garden Pattaya
restaurants.address:

218 Beach Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food is mediocre but the staff is sooo bad.

I have paid my bill and was waiting for my change at least for 20 minutes. When I left the restaurant, I just realize that they never bring it back to me. I was to lazy to go back for 80 THB and probably I give if for tip to the waitress anyway if she would have brought it.

But she never came back intentionally, that what makes me very angry. I went there 2 times this week and the small girl serving outside was the only person that made a very very bad impression twice ( the rest of the staff very friendly). Finally she ripped me off of my change. I think she will be noticeable multiple times as her service is really bad!
sample_reviews_en.author: David Zander

sample_reviews_en.text:
Some of the reviews of this place are quite unfair. I found the service good and the prices for wine very fair. Purchase wine from the shop at the store price, and open it at the dinner table without additional markup or corkage fee.

The only criticism I have is I found the restaurant to be quite loud. It was about 75% full when I was there. The internal architecture reflexs and bounces sound around. This is not someplace a couple will enjoy a quiet dinner together.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chuck Thompson

sample_reviews_en.text:
We're familiar with the chain from Bangkok and decided to have a glass of house wine. The glass of white wine was limited and not to our liking, but that's relative.
Furthermore, the staff left the cutlery behind and ignored us, even though the restaurant was quiet.
No goodbyes at the checkout.
Just because you don't eat doesn't mean you should receive zero service, even though they're charging a 10% surcharge.
It's also noisy.

Review 25 Feb. 2026
sample_reviews_en.author: Vengaguy

sample_reviews_en.text: There's a 10% service charge on the bill. If the bill is 2000 Baht, 200 Baht is added as a service charge without being asked. That's quite a lot by Thai standards. Hidden costs or tourist traps? What's more, I had to wait over 20 minutes for the bill before I could pay and leave. Unfortunately, I only noticed this on my fourth visit. I certainly won't be going back. No thanks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Inter Peter

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate there with a colleague and the food was amazing. The meat was perfectly cooked and the fries were world-class. The only downside was the awful air conditioning – it was really freezing cold, unbearable, which really detracted from the atmosphere. A smile while serving wouldn't hurt. As far as the food is concerned, it's highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Claudio Bianco

sample_reviews_en.text: Having visited their Bangkok locations many times, we came here with high expectations, and it remains a great choice. The food and drinks were pleasant, the service was good, and the atmosphere was lovely. The Parmesan pizza with truffle sauce was especially fantastic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pasan Sensouk

sample_reviews_en.text: A good place for wine in Pattaya. The wine is fairly inexpensive (by Thai standards). Unfortunately, the quality is average to below average. The place itself has a fairly atmospheric atmosphere, but the interior is tired. So, it's worth a visit, but not a great place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrey Samokhin

sample_reviews_en.text: Overwhelmed waiters who didn't have time to take our order or give us our change when we left. They ordered the wrong type of wine. Of the five dishes we ordered, one was completely forgotten (so it arrived 40 minutes after the others). A …
sample_reviews_en.author: Loic LAGADEC

restaurants.name: Mangosteen Cafe @ Ratchaphruek
restaurants.address:

Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I highly recommend trying the Chef's Table experience at this Thai restaurant near Ratchaphruek, behind the Christian church. The S size (for two) requires a reservation one day in advance.

It was a truly impressive new experience. Perfect for those who want to try authentic Thai food, meticulously prepared with a complete presentation – sight, taste, smell, sound, and color. The food is beautifully decorated, using premium ingredients, fresh from the restaurant's own garden, offering vibrant colors from natural sources, and without MSG.

The owner is very helpful and welcoming, just like when I first dined here. I'm happy to see the restaurant continuously developing and innovating. They maintain a strong concept, and there's a gallery on the second floor showcasing various art pieces downstairs.

The atmosphere is calm, airy, with greenery and a fish pond to enjoy. It's perfect for a special occasion or for introducing foreign friends to a serious yet informal Thai dining experience.

The price is reasonable considering the quality, premium ingredients, and the experience.
I recommend booking in advance, especially for evenings or weekends.

If you're hesitant, book now! :)
sample_reviews_en.author: ศิริภัสสร ศิริไล

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was so beautifully presented I almost didn't dare eat it, and it was incredibly delicious. I learned that the owner loves art and plays Thai music.
It's modern Thai fusion cuisine that retains its original flavors. We ordered an appetizer set, Ma Hor (a type of Thai sweet), spring rolls with dried fish and watermelon (very refreshing), Hom Rak Nai Suan (similar to a Thai noodle dish), served in bite-sized portions, stir-fried green beans with Mahachai fish sauce (great for snacking, fragrant and not too salty), and minced pork with salted fish (delicious). The food here is generally mild in flavor. I saw many tables occupied by adults who seemed to be enjoying their meal. For drinks, they offer butterfly pea flower tea with stevia and water. We finished with apple sorbet served with sweet fish sauce – I loved the creativity! It was topped with sliced ​​apples arranged like a flower, very beautiful and intricate. The owner was incredibly lovely, personally recommending and taking orders, and constantly asking how the food tasted. The restaurant is located behind the church in Taling Chan, on Ratchaphruek Road, with convenient parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patteera Wongsawan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Thai restaurant, with its royal Thai cuisine, boasts beautifully designed dishes. Importantly, every dish was delicious and impressive. The owner provided excellent recommendations, and you could feel the care put into each dish. The atmosphere was lovely and private. While the prices might be a bit high, considering everything, it was well worth it.

- "Hom Rak Nai Suan" (a Thai dish)
- Smoked Duck Red Curry
- Fruit Som Tum with Crispy Fried Sea Bass
- Salted Egg Yolk Chili Paste
- Sea Bass with Tamarind Sauce

I loved the Smoked Duck Red Curry the most. It was rich and spicy, with a lovely smoky duck flavor, and plenty of fresh fruit that provided a refreshing contrast.

This is a restaurant I will definitely visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Caloriesvoyage

sample_reviews_en.text:
Intentionally drive to this place for lunch but very disappointed.

The atmosphere is cozy and quiet but the food is below my expectation. My order was padthai and salad roll, which are their recommended menu. Food presentation is fabulous but padthai taste bland and was too soggy and sweet, feel like I was having stir-fried bean sprout. The salad roll was ok.

What’s really frustrating is the drink. After meal, I asked for a take away glass but this is what I got… (Should have a proper take away)

Compared to the price, they should have improved their staff training and be able to communicate in Thai. (The waitress is Burmese and not seem to understand what I was asking)

Pricey and not worth the money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pitchayapa Pathomthanasarn

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is beautifully decorated. Each dish is meticulously and beautifully presented, and tastes delicious. Each dish tells a story, making you feel the care and intention put into every bite. The atmosphere is lovely and friendly, with a homey feel, like having a meal at a friend's house. The service is also wonderful, and they even give out complimentary fruit to take home. Overall, I was very impressed with everything – the food, the service, the atmosphere. I will definitely come back again. I highly recommend it; you won't be disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Natchaya Suket

sample_reviews_en.text: Home cafe with a touch of uniqueness in the design - traditional foods with the twist in flavour, this kind of food is hard to find nowadays. The shop also have the chef table experience to enjoy in 2 hours time. The owner is very friendly and helpful with all of the menu. One of my recommended dish was the grill duck in curry soup. The price might seems little too expensive but it worth for the taste and experience. The shop are quite small with a few tables so reservation in advance would be a good idea.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasawat K

sample_reviews_en.text: Mangosteen cafe (Mangkud Cafe) is a cozy and unique restaurant. There are about 8 tables. So recommend for you to call ahead before heading to the restaurant. There are parking in front. The food is very tasty and well presented with the traditional recipe. Food is colorful with edible flowers. There is no MSG in the food (as it claims): nowadays it is not easy to find food without MSG. Friendly service makes luncheon more enjoyable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nong Ch.

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is absolutely adorable! You can tell they put a lot of care into every dish. The food is beautifully presented and tastes delicious. Plus, there are activities to do while waiting for your food – the owner plays the zither during the meal, and there's an art gallery to admire. It's a truly impressive experience enjoying traditional Thai food. And they're pet-friendly too! I give it 100/10!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pj Praew

restaurants.name: Pae's Brass Pot Congee
restaurants.address:

320 ถ. ประชาราษฎร์สาย1 Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Michelin Bib Gourmand porridge place that also sells fried chicken rice noodles (a rather ubiquitous Thai dish) and fish maw soup.

I did not have the fish maw, just the porridge and chicken Kway Teow. Honestly, the porridge was not that fantastic. Whilst they were silky enough, it lacked the umami of other pork porridges that I have tasted, often imparted from the ingredients added into the porridge.

The fried rice noodles fared better cause it had wok heat in abundance and being Thai type rice noodles, slight chewy and fun to eat with tender chicken. But not really Ann Guay Tiew standard, the Michelin Bib Gourmand famous for this dish.

All in, not a bad place to have a meal but if I am just going for porridge, prefer to do it at the other former Michelin Bib Gourmand place in Silom that got dropped from the list. Perhaps I should have ordered the fish maw or the crab rolls that other tables were ordering.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wilson Foo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Back in the day, when I visited my aunt's house near the sawmill alley, I used to eat at this congee shop very often. It's been there since her father ran it, probably over 30 years. After my aunt passed away, I only passed by this area occasionally. When I went back, I found her children were running it, and they've even won a Michelin Bib Gourmand award for 5 consecutive years!

~ The congee itself is delicious; the rice is smooth, the minced pork and other ingredients are excellent. It's fantastic with the mini fried dough sticks. The only downside is that for the price, I wish they gave a little more congee.
~ The sukiyaki (soup and chicken) is delicious. They even brought unlimited dipping sauce from a bottle!
~ The stir-fried chicken is fragrant and delicious, just as good as the famous shops near Central Hospital.

I'll definitely be back again when I'm in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: yudhapong mapan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Paek Jok Pot of Brass, 38 Years
This restaurant appeared in my search results after I was running errands in the Bang Pho area and searched for "Michelin Guide restaurants near me."

From where I was, it was only a 10-minute walk, and I wasn't disappointed.

I ordered food for myself and my younger brother:
1. Two servings of seafood dry rice
2. One serving of shrimp spring rolls
3. One serving of fish congee

After eating at the restaurant, we ordered two more items to take home:
4. Two bags of grouper fish congee
5. Four boxes of stir-fried chicken noodles

That concluded our meal and the purchases we made to share with our family.

In summary, the food was so delicious that we bought some to eat another meal and share with our family. Although the portion sizes were a little small compared to the price, the taste was excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Montree Tripetpisai

sample_reviews_en.text:
This old-school breakfast spot in the Bang Pho area opens at 6:00 AM. Parking is easy nearby; park at the MRT Si Yaek station and walk over.

The owner cooks everything themselves and is very friendly and cheerful.

The shop is small, a single shophouse unit, and has a long list of Michelin stars, indicating its quality.
There isn't much seating inside; most customers order takeout.
The menu offers a wide variety of classic dishes.

The congee has a medium-smooth texture, but is soft and delicious.
The minced pork patties are tasty, with a mild flavor suitable for those who don't like salty food.
They also have fish maw soup, fish porridge, stir-fried pork, chicken, and seafood.
The crab claws and shrimp rolls are all delicious.
**The soy sauce dipping sauce looks tempting.
The prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: W. W.

sample_reviews_en.text: To be honest, I stumbled upon this place by accident. I saw it was a Bib Gourmand restaurant and decided to try it. I ordered the pork congee with egg (60 baht) and it was delicious! I really liked it. The congee was already lightly seasoned, with a well-balanced flavor that didn't require any additional seasoning, just a touch of pepper. The texture of the congee wasn't too watery; it still had a nice rice-like consistency. The pork was minced pork, not the bouncy kind you find at many other places. The owner was kind and polite, and the service was good. The restaurant was clean and pleasant, the prices were reasonable, and there are many other dishes that look tempting. I'll definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thaya Aungtananukul

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there because it was Michelin-starred lol

Thailand has so many Michelin-starred restaurants, it's fun! 😂
Sometimes I find myself looking for the Michelin stickers to buy 😜

I ordered the pork porridge and the soup pictured, which I wasn't quite sure what it was!

It was delicious, but the ingredients included shiitake mushrooms, quail eggs, and one other ingredient I couldn't identify...
What could it be??

Adding a yellowish 🟡 chili vinegar-like substance gave it a different, delicious flavor.
The porridge is delicious with soy sauce or black vinegar? 😋
It might be a little more expensive than you think? 😛
sample_reviews_en.author: ふわふわふわわ

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Michelin Bib Gourmand restaurant, awarded 5 consecutive years, is a must-try, especially for its congee. I ordered pork congee with egg. The rice is smooth and firm, and the flavor is natural, with no added seasonings. We added soy sauce to our liking. The minced pork was well-seasoned. They actually have a wide variety of other dishes on the menu.
The restaurant is located on the roadside with no parking. I recommend parking at Gateway and walking over.
sample_reviews_en.author: M Shayutpong Kiatpimolkul

sample_reviews_en.text: I eat here very often, but my favorite dishes that I order frequently are the braised pork ribs with red sauce and rice (the meat is incredibly tender and the flavor is well-balanced), the stir-fried instant noodles with chicken (delicious), and the fried rice (generous portion and tasty). The dry rice porridge, regular rice porridge, and congee are just average and need additional seasoning. If I don't know what to eat, I can always come to this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: พรหมพร นาคบรรพตกุล

restaurants.name: The House by Hongkong House
restaurants.address:

1 Yotha 1 Alley, Bangkok, Samphanthawong, Please select 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We originally wanted to grab a drink at the live music bar across the street, Two More, but since we were a bit hungry, we decided to have a bite to eat first… and we stumbled completely by chance upon this Chinese restaurant.

And what a pleasant surprise it was! The food was quite good, especially the Peking duck with its perfectly crispy skin, as is tradition, as well as the dim sum. There were also quite a few Chinese customers in the restaurant, which is always a good sign.

But the funniest thing was the atmosphere! At the back of the room, there's a small, very local karaoke bar, mainly run by the regulars. The average age must have been around 70 😄 Each table seems to have its own designated singer; the owner puts the requested songs on the screen, and everyone takes a turn singing.

And of course, we were invited to join in… So we ended up singing an American song in front of the whole room! 😂 A rather improbable but really enjoyable experience.

A place discovered completely by chance, with decent food, an authentic atmosphere, and above all, a truly memorable time!
sample_reviews_en.author: Skp

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here based on TikTok reviews that were so good, so I had high expectations, but it wasn't quite as good as I'd hoped.

The food was okay, but not exceptional. Some dishes were delicious, others were just average; they could have been better. But what was really not okay was the atmosphere and service.
- The restaurant seemed busy all the time. The staff didn't make much eye contact or provide much service.
- I went specifically for dim sum, but several items were sold out.
- I understand that the food comes out gradually, but sometimes I've already finished eating and have to wait, which disrupts the dining experience.

What was quite shocking was that the restaurant has a shared drink cart in the middle, meaning all the tables get ice from the same ice bucket. Bottled water is just piled up there, even if it's not empty. If you want more water, they grab a bottle that you don't even know if it's yours and pour it for you. This was so unacceptable that I eventually had to ask them to put the water on my own table, and they didn't even refill the ice.
sample_reviews_en.author: bbugsbunny

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were walking randomly, looking for a nice place for dinner. My husband wanted to have duck and we just happened to pass by this great place. It looked interesting so we decided to give it a try.
We had a wonderful evening. Great food and a very interesting and cheerful ambience.
Although we don't speak Thai, the waitress tried her best to understand us. We were very grateful.
Another wonderful thing was that she kept topping up our jasmine tea - something that is rare nowadays, I don't know why, and felt like the good old days.
Finally, the ambience. We had such fun. There were 4 or 5 tables with groups that were having such a great time.
Many of them seemed to know each other. Most of them sang karaoke and also offered money clipped to a rose.
Amazing atmosphere!
We don't know if this restaurant is always like this but we loved it and will definitely return.
Congratulations to the owner - who we think was a gentleman always paying attention to everything and making his guests feel at home - and also to the staff.
Thank you
sample_reviews_en.author: Teresa Carvalho

sample_reviews_en.text: Discovered this restaurant by Eatigo and came here for peking duck. The restaurant offered discount price set for only thai baht 700 for 12 pieces of crispy duck skin with crepes and cucumber cum spring onion side dish coupled with 2 dishes of duck meat prepared on your choices, including black pepper sauce, sweet and sour sauce, soup, noodle, lettuce wrap... etc. The food is inspired by Hong Kong style cuisine as mentioned by the restaurant owner's son. Other food items like shark 's fin, shrimp, fried omelet with oyster are also available in the menu but we were just too full to order anything else. As the restaurant did meet our expectations and the food was really tasty, we would definitely come again to try other dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Martlet

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem in the Talad Noi area that hasn't been widely reviewed yet. The food here is truly delicious, and what stands out most is the freshness of the ingredients — from chili, coriander, and bean sprouts to scallops and crab — everything is fresh and high-quality, well worth the price.

The staff are knowledgeable and attentive. With the dim sum currently 50% off, the prices are very reasonable. Most of the customers are families and mature diners, creating a calm and comfortable atmosphere.

The restaurant also serves beer from lunchtime onward, and there's parking for two cars right in front of the shop.

(Note: The Thai text at the end is a separate, unrelated advertisement and has been omitted from the translation.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Suthira Techamaneewat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don’t recommend going here.

Pad Thai was super super spicy, which as far as I checked shouldn’t be. I couldn’t finish the dish after two bites.

Also I was basically scammed here. my end bill should have been 540 bhat but in the check 590 bhat magically appeared in the summary. No explanation where additional 50 bhat came from. I didn’t have enough cash so I asked them to split the amount into cash and credit card payment. The waitress took my card and went to another room to her boss and then I saw that they charged significantly more than they should have.

Worst experience eating in Bangkok, should’ve gotten a skewer from a food stall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Liza A

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went on a weekday during lunchtime. The atmosphere was relaxed, and the dim sum quality far exceeded the price, as it was 50% off every basket, costing around 50 baht each. The restaurant didn't compromise on quality at all. All the shrimp-filled dim sum were excellent; every bite was full of bouncy shrimp. The crispy shrimp rice noodle rolls are a must-try, with plenty of shrimp. The fried tofu skin was crispy and not oily, with thin tofu skin and a generous amount of shrimp inside. The food came out quickly, and the staff provided attentive service. I will definitely be back again.
IG: Timmyeong
sample_reviews_en.author: Panyada Inthun

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a Chinese dim sum restaurant located at the entrance of the soi (alley). I eat there often because I work in the area. The restaurant is open in two shifts: lunch and dinner. The evening atmosphere is a bit chaotic, with tables rotating and live music. However, it's mostly regulars who sing Chinese songs, so it can get quite loud and you might have to shout to talk to each other.😅
For those who bring a car, you can park on the street in the soi, or drive about 100 meters past the soi where there is a valet parking service.
sample_reviews_en.author: PPR

restaurants.name: Pia Restaurant
restaurants.address:

17 Lat Phrao Rd, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
First of all, I'd like to say that I'm very impressed with the owner of this restaurant. She's polite, provides excellent service, and is very warm-hearted.

The food is delicious, Thai-Chinese style. I wanted to try the Rad Na, but I didn't order it because it was so hot. Everything I ordered was delicious. The only downside is that the shrimp were frozen. If they were fresh from the market, they would be even better.

After eating, I just realized there's an air-conditioned room upstairs. If you're coming to eat here, ask the owner.

P.S. I was a little confused when I arrived because the owner was walking back and forth between the front and back of the shop. It seemed like they were working there with their grandmother. You might have to wait a bit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rote S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I followed the recommendation for this famous noodle dish (Rad Na). After trying it, I personally prefer the Pad See Ew (stir-fried noodles with soy sauce). Probably because it's more flavorful and drier – very delicious 😋. But my absolute favorite was the tender pork! Both the Rad Na and Pad See Ew were amazing. The pork was marinated so well, it's the secret to its tenderness 😭👍🏻. Plus, they give you a generous portion.

P.S. Even the small portions at this restaurant are huge! If you want to try several dishes, I recommend ordering to share. You'll definitely be full because the portions are really big 🤲🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Chollada Ch.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good food, reasonable prices, not too strong flavors, and really good ingredients.

The Rad Na is a great value, with well-marinated pork and sweet, crispy Hong Kong kale. The noodles come with a slightly sweet, special sauce.

The Satay pork has a delicious dipping sauce with a hint of spice. The pork is tender and tender. Highly recommended.

The fried rice has a wonderful wok-style aroma.

The only downside is the wait, but it's delicious. The free tea is incredibly fragrant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suratchata Shu

sample_reviews_en.text: The Rad Na and Pad See Ew were as delicious as advertised, but the food took quite a while to come out, especially for dishes other than Rad Na and Pad See Ew. Even though the restaurant has two floors of seating, the service is quite slow and needs a lot of improvement. Even though it's been open for decades, they still can't serve customers systematically. You have to wait a long time for a table and food, and if you come at noon, you'll have to be patient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dhiraphong Srifuengfung

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pia (Ladprao 64)
​This is an old, classic Thai food restaurant inside Ladprao Soi 64.
It has been open for a very long time and is well-known by people
who live in the area. It's a simple, no-frills kind of place.
​You must try their Pad See Ew. They use a special kind of noodle
that is very soft, chewy, and springy. Other popular dishes
are the Rad Na (noodles in gravy) and the Pork Satay. The taste
of the food has stayed the same for many years
sample_reviews_en.author: Chawala Cheewakanon

sample_reviews_en.text: A must-try for anyone who loves tender pork in sticky soup fried noodles. Be prepared to wait because these are made one by one in a family-style setting, served in large portions at a low price! Parking is available in the alley next door. This alley (Ladprao 64) has a traffic light allowing you to turn to the opposite side of the street, which is a large residential area with a modern community.
sample_reviews_en.author: sakul leksrisakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Rad Na (noodles in gravy) and Pad See Ew (stir-fried noodles with soy sauce) are delicious. They come in several sizes; the large size is really big, so don't order impulsively.

The food comes out quite slowly, so allow some extra time.

Parking is available in the alley next to the restaurant. Search for "Pia Restaurant Parking".
sample_reviews_en.author: Tida

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is a well-known local spot in the Ladphrao area.
Its homey dishes and the owner’s warm welcome made everything taste even better.

I ordered Pad See Ew because it looked delicious at first glance in the photos — though it turned out a bit sweeter than my preference.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimchanok P.

restaurants.name: Sanyod
restaurants.address:

4, 4 / 1-2, Central World, 6th Floor, Rajdamri Road, Pathumwan, Khet, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
แสนยอดSANYOD【盛悅】
Authentic Thai-Chinese dining at a reasonable price with an exceptionally wide menu that covers budget-friendly options and more indulgent dishes. A solid choice for sharing, with flavors that balance Thai and Chinese influences, great for groups or casual meals.
sample_reviews_th.author: Theng Seng Tan

sample_reviews_th.text: Sanyod Restaurant (แสนยอด), established in 1962, is a legendary Teochew Cantonese restaurant with 64 years of history. It has been a Michelin Bib Gourmand for nine consecutive years from 2018 to 2026. …
sample_reviews_th.author: TOM TENG

sample_reviews_en.text: I was running errands at CTW and was very hungry. I stopped by after seeing the menu outside. It wasn't too crowded, and the staff provided excellent service. The stir-fried scallops with XO sauce were delicious, up to standard, but a little oily; I'll have to ask them to reduce the oil next time. Both stir-fried vegetable dishes were good. I asked for the braised grouper with fermented black beans and bitter melon, and the chef delivered exactly as requested. Finally, I had the minced pork and pork tripe stew with plums to cleanse my palate; it was very refreshing. I also asked for dessert, but it was initially hard, so the staff took it back to fix it. It was delicious. The winter melon juice always reminds me of my grandmother; she used to love it.
sample_reviews_en.author: ohh mylord

sample_reviews_en.text:
The roast duck is very chewy and cold. I asked for it to be boneless, but it came with pieces of bones. The wonton soup was average, came with a broken plate, even though it is supposed to be a Michelin star. I guess it's better to go to a cheap and cheerful place because they usually have better taste and service than this place.

My suggestion is to train your staff to properly remove the bones and provide customers with the best possible plate, not a broken one.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ci Ci

sample_reviews_en.text:
a reliable thai-chinese restaurant.

this big chain restaurant served many kinds of thai-chinese food but the highlight would be noodles with gravy (Rad-na). they have a lot of them from normal thai pork Rad-na to chinese style Rad-na and mee.
The taste was good and authentic however the price was a little expensive for the menus.
This branch was a little cramped but service was fine and standard.

I ordered chinese style noodles in egg gravy. :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanin Rungwanichsukanon

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is just as good as the original but the vibes are off. The old school original location is just totally different than this high end mall feeling. Prices are ok. Radon is still the best dish in my opinion. A Medium size is good for two semi hungry adults.

We walked in on a week night and it was very empty. they take card, cash and scan to pay.

This location is located in central world and very wheelchair friendly ♿️
sample_reviews_en.author: Kevin Kwok

sample_reviews_en.text: Famous Cantonese style Chinese foods restaurant certified by Michelin logo since 2018 to 2022. Well known for rice noodle in thick gravy with a choice of pork, beef or even seafood. Original shop located at Bangrak district while there are more branches in Bangkok area, including this one in CTW.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattapong Manothai

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but the service was terrible. I asked for condiments, but they didn't bring them until after I'd finished eating. They even took a chair from my table and gave it to another customer without communicating or asking permission beforehand; they just took it without asking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naput B.

restaurants.name: Bigknit Cafe
restaurants.address:

1st floor RQMALL Sukhumvit 49, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
You MUST come here if you: 1) want to learn to knit/crochet; 2) love to knit/crochet; and 3) love a calm cozy atmosphere.

i went here twice in a row because the food and drinks were delicious. not only was it easy to learn everything due to the auntie who helped me learn the basics of knitting, but after attempting for over 5 years, i finally can follow tutorials since i have the basics down. i thought at first “maybe it will be nice class but bad food”, but both are excellent!!

also so much yarn to choose from. you must bring your own material if you don’t take a class for the big knit bags, and it does run about $15 including yarn + knitting needles. however it’s totally worth it. considering many classes nearby cost 3500 baht , it was very worth it to make a bag at 1800 baht (i didn’t take this class but saw many). you don’t need to make reservation as all workers know how to do this, but if you want to learn to knit i recommend calling in advance as someone workers do and don’t know how to. honestly i would come here every day. great drinks. great people. and finally learned to knit 💗
sample_reviews_en.author: M

sample_reviews_en.text: My friend and I thoroughly enjoyed ourselves at this cafe! The food tasted great but since I had ordered alot of things with cheese, they got a bit rich for me which was helped greatly by them already providing ketchup with each menu that had cheese! Very thoughtful. 🥰 After eating we went to make keychains, but because they only had the big strap options(no thread keychain option, only thicker ones like ours or even thicker🤣), we were unsure if we would be happy with our design but eventually we were extremely happy! They were also kind enough to take off the straps from displays since we didn't like the available straps, which made us pleasantly surprised. The owner/staff are all kind of quiet but if you ask them things they will be more than willing to help and teach. We stayed for around 3-4 hours in total, just catching up and taking our time with the keychain designs and they did not hurry us at all. I would definitely reccomend to a friend to come here! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna Kuvinichkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here for breakfast with a friend. It’s a cozy nook away from the hustle and bustle of Bangkok. You get to speak your mind and also let your mind go wild into thinking innovative and productive workarounds. They have a wonderful yarn collection (though I didn’t buy any), it was wonderful to just look at and fade into another world.

I was craving for a good egg salad sandwich and that’s exactly what I got. As my friend puts it, “it wasn’t either sweet or salty” - it had a perfect blend of healthy goodness. (Oh and it didn’t come alone - it came with a garden salad and fries - fries for breakfast 🤫) I topped this with the Thai tea and it made my day.

They say the desserts are a must try - but with the fries for breakfast. I think dessert was a given “for next time”.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sneha Susan Jacob

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great corner of Bangkok to crochet quietly. I had a hot milk tea and a mini slice of brownie. For the brownie and drink I think I paid just under 200 baht. Milk tea tastes like 3-in-1 mix, but took a while to prepare. I went on a Wednesday afternoon, not very busy but there was a steady flow of customers coming in and out to purchase yarn. Many of them seemed disappointed to find out that a medium size bag (their signature yarn bags) cost about 1500 baht to learn to make. They'll teach you FOC as long as you buy the yarn. So, the amount you pay depends on how big you want to make your bags.

I bought 3 balls of yarn at 250 baht (50g, 180m) each. Most of their yarn costs about 190 to 500 baht each. Very pricey, you're paying for the atmosphere and tools can be borrowed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phy Ke Xin

sample_reviews_en.text: Each colour priced at 1100 baht. Yarn is hard, not soft and squishy as it looks in pictures so storage will be limited. Asked the price as it was not stated anywhere. As soon as I showed hesitance towards making a bag because of the price, they became very unfriendly and hostile. Tried asking if there were other crochet items we can make like the other bags, plushies and hats they had displayed but they just said no. Their oreo ice blended drink was not good. Just tasted like diluted ice blended chocolate drink. Aesthetic is good but everything else is a no from me. Never coming back here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kelly Chong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came here after a long day to treat myself. Ended up crying and staff didn't care.

Warning: they don't offer refunds whatsoever. They also do not have prices on any of their yarn. Average price per 50g ball of yarn is £10, or 500 bhat. I tried to return 3 balls of yarn within 5 minutes to be told I couldn't return. I admit, I have had a very difficult day, and I did go back to me seat and quietly cried to which they didn't give a shit and avoided eye contact the entire time.

Avoid like the plague. Go literally anywhere else.
sample_reviews_en.author: Louise Tennant

sample_reviews_en.text:
**This knitting cafe is NOT for absolute beginners.**

The instructor was incredibly unfriendly and unhelpful. Despite being assured that I could knit there without prior experience, she was dismissive and unhelpful when I inquired about suitable projects. I felt unwelcome and like I was interrupting her personal knitting project. I should have just watched free tutorials on YouTube instead.

However, if you're buying yarn or simply looking for a pleasant place to knit without much guidance, this cafe is quite nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: NEUFii Panida

sample_reviews_en.text: From BTS Phrom-Phong, get to downstairs and turn yourself to get The EmQuartier on your left hand side after that go straight on untill you see Sukhumvit49 Lane on your left hand side then you turn left to Sukhumvit49. And you have to go straight on until end of the way, turn left a bit and turn right again so continue straight. You will passed Samitivej Sukhumvit Hospital and Bigknit will be on the left. You can take the short course to knit the bag. The Bigknit has teacher to teach you to knit. 👛
sample_reviews_en.author: iingz TD

restaurants.name: ZaoMu 枣木牌北京烤鸭Peking Duck(The street)
restaurants.address:

Thailand, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon, Din Daeng, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon, Ratchadaphisek Rd, 邮政编码: 10400

sample_reviews_en.text:
I finally got to try the authentic Peking duck I've been craving! 🦆✨ This time I discovered a few more dishes I loved, so I'm just jotting them down here~

🥢 Peking Duck
I ordered half a duck. The meat was tender and juicy, with a wonderful jujube wood smoky aroma. It was oily but not greasy. The duck, cucumber strips, and scallions served in lotus leaf pancakes were so satisfying! You can choose between sweet bean sauce and chili sauce, which is quite fun to try different kinds. The duck carcass was cumin-flavored, very fragrant, and I even took some home as a snack! 😂

🍚 Duck Fried Rice
It was so delicious! The rice was perfectly cooked, with plenty of duck, green peppers, and carrots. Every spoonful was packed with ingredients, and I couldn't resist having a few more bites! 😂

🥗 Cold Lettuce Salad
The tangy and spicy flavor was very appetizing, and the crunchy lettuce was a perfect way to cut through the richness of the Peking duck.

🍮 Duck Pudding
Finally, of course, we had to have an adorable duck pudding 🦆💛. The texture is a bit like a chilled jelly, paired with honey grapefruit sauce, it's refreshingly sweet and not too greasy, perfect for an after-dinner treat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Beryl

sample_reviews_en.text:
Super authentic Peking duck, generous portions, and affordable prices. Half a duck is enough to fill two people up! I especially loved the duck fried rice! The rice was perfectly cooked, each grain distinct, and there was a generous amount of duck meat—you could taste it in almost every bite. It was savory and delicious, perfect for a Chinese palate.

The chicken feet stew was also amazing. The chicken feet were stewed until incredibly tender, falling off the bone with the slightest touch, and the sauce was perfectly infused with flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cavira wang

sample_reviews_en.text: 🥢Authentic home-style cooking. The roast duck has a glossy skin, and the slices of meat are perfectly marbled with fat and lean meat, bursting with aroma. The cold chicken leg salad is tangy and spicy, a perfect appetizer, and goes perfectly with a bowl of hot rice. The stir-fried eggs with vegetables are full of wok hei (wok aroma), an absolute must-have with rice. Overall, the flavors are delicious, and I was very satisfied with my meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dui Dui

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today's duck feast! ✅ The roast duck has crispy skin, fragrant meat, and is incredibly juicy; the Sichuan-style spicy chicken is tangy and addictive; the duck carcass is fragrant with salt and pepper; and the Grandma's pickled vegetables are perfect with rice.

The whole meal is delicious and satisfying, no disappointments! Duck lovers, give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: 啦啦点点

sample_reviews_en.text: Great food, fast service, and excellent value. The Solo Peking Duck Set was delicious with crispy skin and tender meat. The shredded duck fried rice was also a highlight, and the roselle tea and roasted milk tea were refreshing. Clean restaurant, friendly staff, and quick service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siang Ting Han

sample_reviews_en.text: Very authentic and delicious Peking duck for a very good price! Same quality as the expensive restaurants but for a fair price. The other dishes are also very authentic! Highly recommend. My Chinese friend recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: Celena Liu

sample_reviews_en.text: The Peking duck was served in a spectacular and appetizing way. The taste was decent, although there wasn't much fat on the duck. They provided plenty of pancakes and also included some fried duck.
sample_reviews_en.author: S M

sample_reviews_en.text: An inexpensive Chinese restaurant next to Foodland on The Street... I ordered sour and spicy chicken. The sauce had no sourness at all, but was extremely salty. The chicken also had too much skin.
sample_reviews_en.author: BeboBeing

restaurants.name: Baan Ying (Central Rama 9)
restaurants.address:

L7 Centralplaza, Grand Rama 9, Huai Khwang, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Full restaurant at lunch. Were seated quickly and order taken. But the kitchen seemed to function in fits and starts- so food came out in batches with long gaps in between.
The service staff were efficient and doing their best. But, for a 10% service tax, they could do better.

Pork and cowslip creeper clear soup was outstanding. The stirfied squid and crispy chicken with garlic were good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Review Mutt

sample_reviews_en.text:
Giw was our server and what an amazing person, she was very patient when I was ordering and she even recommended me with baan ying omelette rice with minced chicken. She is super friendly and kind, she has a beautiful smile and she made me feel at home.
The ambience is amazing and so is the food and Thai milk tea.
Would definitely recommend this to my friends and family.
😁
sample_reviews_en.author: A B

sample_reviews_en.text: I had dinner in baan ying rama 9 central. Seabass got bones inside which almost got me hurted. Also, I have ordered not spicy but it ended up extremely spicy at the end . How can the staff being so careless. What if I have allergy towards spices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angie Ho

sample_reviews_en.text: The foods are delicious. Nice atmosphere and great service. We strongly recommend this restaurant especially if you have some guests.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jidapa Noinart

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant smelled weird 🤨 The fried rice that looked light was delicious. The fried rice noodles were just so-so.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fangfang Zhi

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is inexpensive and delicious, offering good value for money. The atmosphere is spacious and comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Magchakraphong PH.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing food amazing service jiw and they are super super sweet and the food is really nice
God bless you
sample_reviews_en.author: Mazen Magdy

sample_reviews_en.text: The food selection is incredibly diverse. You can find everything you want here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Moo Veggie

restaurants.name: Red Chilli Cafe
restaurants.address:

222 Phatthanakan 20 Alley, Lane 8, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Excellent service, reasonably priced yet tasty food."

sample_reviews_en.text:
Red Chilli Café is a hidden gem serving authentic Italian cuisine. The food tastes truly Italian — full of flavor, freshly prepared, and beautifully presented. The price is amazingly reasonable, much cheaper than many other Italian restaurants, yet the quality is absolutely top-notch.

The restaurant is located inside the village clubhouse, offering a private and cozy atmosphere. I have been here many times with family and friends, and every visit has been a delightful experience. It’s definitely a place I will keep coming back to. Highly recommended!

Red Chilli Café is a truly authentic Italian restaurant with excellent food. All dishes are fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The price is very reasonable, much cheaper than many other Italian restaurants, yet the quality is outstanding.

The restaurant is located inside the village clubhouse, offering a peaceful, private, and cozy atmosphere, perfect for a visit with family or friends. I've been here many times, and each time has been a delightful experience. It's a place I highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Orrahappy

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a restaurant my friends have long recommended. We're a good Italian restaurant with good prices. They've moved to the clubhouse in the Phakamas Village, right on the Google map.

When we arrived around 2:00 PM, there weren't any customers. The friendly staff was helpful and provided excellent advice.

The pizza here has a thin, crispy crust that's not too fattening. The Parma ham was a bit dry, but it was delicious and well-priced.

The Avocado Shrimp Salad was a surprise. I thought it would have lots of vegetables, but it was focused on the avocado and shrimp. This was my favorite dish. I love avocado, and it was seasoned well, but it was mixed with mayo. If you like mayo, this is a must-try.

The Spinach Risotto could have been richer, but the flavor was okay.

I also ordered a Carbonara pizza to take home, which was also thin.

The price for two pizzas, one risotto, and a salad with avocado and shrimp and fish sauce was less than 1,000 baht. It was amazing! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Ruttiya V.

sample_reviews_en.text: I've lost count of how many times I've eaten here. I wanted to review it and encourage more people to come try it. Everything is delicious. This time I tried the Japanese-style spaghetti with shrimp roe, and it was great, because I usually only eat the bacon and chili spaghetti. Don't even get me started on the meat dishes; they're so juicy! My friends who came here were all amazed. I never get tired of coming back. Even the fries are delicious; my friend even took some home! 55
sample_reviews_en.author: Nantipak Sasiwattanasirikul

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious homy western restaurant located in a big neighborhood. The aus sirloin steak was really tender and the portion was really big as well. We also love the chicken steak, chicken wings and fries and pizza. Really happy with the food😁😁 The only menu that we didn't like much was the Spaghetti Tobiko, it was quite dry and salty, but everything else was nice! Prices are really reasonable too for the quality, and service is good👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Sabrina Wu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Spacious and airy place.
Food deducted 1 star: ordered medium rare lamb ribs, received medium almost well-done.
Rocket salad: fresh vegetables, decent dressing.
Calamari: a bit salty and oily.
Spicy stir-fried pasta: flavorful.
Spinach gratin: delicious.
Avocado dish: just average.
sample_reviews_en.author: KhunYUONE 1956

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent service, reasonably priced yet tasty food.  The owner goes out of his way to make sure you are comfortable.  I sampled the musroom soup, several salad items, pasta and pizza which were all excellent. Family friendly as well. I look forward yo returning in the near future
sample_reviews_en.author: John Cork

sample_reviews_en.text: Spacious, clean, unpretentious and practical. Many Italian food options, at reasonable prices, but I went for the beef krapao, which was great, and the coffee was OK. Even if the place lacks a bit of character and charm, the venue is comfortable and the hostess kind.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fabyú

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the prices are incredibly affordable. The atmosphere is comfortable and friendly. The chef and the owner are lovely and take great care of their customers. I highly recommend this restaurant; you won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vacharavee Phattrapeerapat

restaurants.name: Long Jiu Lou
restaurants.address:

323 หมู่ 10 Phuchao Saming Phray, Samrong Tai, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're craving suckling pig and Peking duck, this restaurant is a great choice. However, you need to book the suckling pig one or two days in advance, and for the Peking duck, besides the skin, you can choose two ways to prepare the duck meat: stir-fried pork floss and cabbage, and sweet and sour stir-fried duck, both very delicious. The dim sum is generally okay, and the prices are reasonable. The only downside is the location; you'll need to call a taxi!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thomas Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious. It wasn't crowded, but the ingredients were fresh and high-quality. The portions were generous for the price, making it great value – even better than some dim sum buffets in the city. My family loved it. The staff were attentive, refilling our water without being asked. The air conditioning was cool and the restrooms were clean.

The dim sum was delicious; the abalone pieces were large, and the grouper was fresh and not fishy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanyarat Suthamlert

sample_reviews_en.text: This authentic Chinese restaurant in Samut Prakan serves delicious Peking duck with crispy skin and a large portion; you can even use the meat to make two different dishes without extra charge. Their stir-fried spinach is clean, fresh, not oily, and not overly salty. The dim sum is freshly made, and importantly, they are generous with all their dipping sauces.
sample_reviews_en.author: PAMILA PD

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is average in taste. The highlights are probably the lobster congee and the hot appetizer, fried radish cake. The rest – the Peking duck was tough, the sauce was too sweet, the braised goose leg noodles and the sea bass weren't very fresh. The lobster was fresh enough. The prices are moderate.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ubon

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating here since the restaurant first opened. The food is delicious, especially the Peking duck; the skin is perfectly crispy. I'm also impressed with the stir-fried ginkgo nuts with chili and salt; I order it every time. And the shrimp dumplings (Hargow) have plump, juicy shrimp inside.
sample_reviews_en.author: PADERMSRI ANGKHUMSUB

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was pretty good, the atmosphere in the restaurant was nice, the staff were polite and provided good service. I was a little taken aback by the bamboo shoot soup; the price and portion size seemed strange. Everything else was okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: PJ.Patsapon

sample_reviews_en.text: We called to reserve a table and ordered our food in advance. When we arrived at noon, we were seated right away. The restaurant is beautifully decorated with many photogenic spots. The food arrived quickly after we were seated. The …
sample_reviews_en.author: Nokpisa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious. Good dim sum. Private rooms available.
The duck was standard, but I have a favorite that hasn't surpassed it yet.
The food was slow to arrive, I don't know if it was because it was a festival.
I'll probably come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vachiraporn Yenchaisith (fonnie lapluie)

restaurants.name: Supa Restaurant
restaurants.address:

512 Rong Mueang Rd, Khwaeng Rong Muang, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I found this inexpensive restaurant near the Hua lumphong train station and mrt. It has 7 tables and no AC. Owner is nice and service is good. Has many choices. I picked the crispy pork with I believe morning glory. I found out at my annual checkup in bkk that I was pre diabetic so I excluded rice and beer. :(. This is a terrible problem to have in any country including Thailand. I have eaten too many carbs while living here. Too many sweets and beers and cola and rice and pastries and ice cream. I got what I deserve yet I only weigh 65k.  Oh well sorry for the extra information.

It is hard to rate these kind of restaurants because it does not compare to the more expensive tourist and wealthy Thai destinations. I rate it based upon the price.  I spent 100 baht so how can I complain if the food is fresh and flavorful? Atmosphere? Similar to most restaurants. It again is not a fine dining establishment.

Come try and I think you will not be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ronnie Staff

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best hidden gems in Bangkok. Super affordable, family-run restaurant. Amazing hospitality from the lady who runs the shop. Some of best fried rice and kra pow I’ve had across the county. It’s much less crowded than the next door 511 restaurant (also pretty solid), but this place was much better and flavorful. Please come here and support an amazing local business. You will be happy!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rishab Ramapriyan

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is located opposite bangkok station. The aunty helped us selecting something to our liking. We ordered the fried prok wirh kale and tice, a watermelon shake and a pint. I had the shrimp Tom yum soup with rice and the fish spring roll. Paid 360 bath. Everything was yummy and affordable. This place is also Sha awarded.. Definitely recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aipou Chang
