sample_reviews_en.text: We stayed at a hotel near the restaurant, came because of the reviews and the location, and we chose the best place! Typical food at a good price and very tasty; the Pad Thai and Thai spring rolls were delicious, and the original teas were also very good. The place is small and old but charming. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Cristina Moliner

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was exceptionally friendly. The food was delicious! Low prices, and there was a wide selection of dishes.

A great place for a tasty and filling meal. I especially recommend the coconut and ginger soup – very aromatic – and the deep-fried dumplings – very tasty!
sample_reviews_en.author: Krzysztof Zieliński

sample_reviews_en.text: super tasty!! got the pineapple fried rice (vegan) and loved it. It was prepared fresh and quickly :) I payed 70 for the rice and 10 for a water! It’s right next to the metro and has a cool view on the pretty buildings across the street. I would definitely come back :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Lucie K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant near Hua Lamphong is inexpensive. I ordered pineapple fried rice and pork with lime sauce. The fried rice was very generous with cashews and raisins, and tasted delicious.
The restaurant is open from approximately 8 am to 8 pm. ...Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naruemol Karn

sample_reviews_en.text: Overlooking Bangkok railway station this small family-run restaurant is a gem. We had an early dinner there. Food is inexpensive, simple yet satisfying. The green curry chicken and pad Thai were delicious. Large portion. Best Thai meal for my trip.
sample_reviews_en.author: JustLinahere

restaurants.name: Katsu Katsu คัตสึ คัตสึ ลาดพร้าว
restaurants.address:

284 Lat Phrao Rd, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is located opposite Big C Ladprao. You can park and cross the pedestrian bridge to get there. Parking at Big C is free for 3 hours, very convenient.

This is a small shop. When I ate there, there was only one table occupied, but the delivery service was packed. Motorcycles were constantly picking up orders.

I had set C, which was a great price. The total was 203 baht, no extra charges. The green tea was good, and the fried pork was perfectly crispy. The portion size was just right for a woman. My only complaint is that the miso soup was a bit too salty. If they could reduce the saltiness, it would be perfect.

I encourage everyone to support small businesses so they can stay open longer. I will definitely come back again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lelachanok S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The tonkatsu was delicious, 170 baht. The dipping sauce was slightly sour and refreshing. It rivals the chain restaurants in shopping malls but is much cheaper.
It's even better than many tonkatsu restaurants in Japan. Drinks are about 30 baht, with no VAT or service charge. Cabbage is not refillable. The dressing is sesame dressing. The restaurant is very clean and beautifully decorated. Highly recommended! Parking is available at Big C Extra. I'll definitely go back again. Great value!

Recommend this restaurant, very clean, and the food itself is very delicious. I tried the Tonkatsu, which is 170 baht, and the drink is about 30 baht. No VAT or service charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rawikan Kaewprasith

sample_reviews_en.text:
Atmosphere: Nice, small and cozy, giving a good Japanese feel.
Service: The staff didn't greet us. They opened the curtain, saw we were seated, and then closed it again. We were confused for a while before they brought the menu. When checking out, they only showed the price, not the receipt.
Food: The best thing was probably the miso soup. The fried pork had an odor, and the noodles were cold, chewy, and stuck to the chopsticks in a whole clump.

I felt very disappointed leaving the restaurant. Usually, if a restaurant needs improvement, I'll tell the staff directly because I know they'll listen. But here, I have to give my feedback through this platform.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukritta Sukkasem

sample_reviews_en.text:
An absolutely delicious spot, the katsu here is superb. The regular katsu is already wonderfully cooked, delicious and pairs perfectly with the sides, but the Kurobuta-katsu of course is a notch above, though naturally a bit pricier.

Value-for-money is spot on overall, so if you want to save you can happily order the regular katsu and still be very satisfied. The miso soup and the other dishes we tried were very tasty as well.

Honestly, it’s the best katsu I’ve had outside of Japan. The staff was always friendly and attentive. I highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Luca Fleck

sample_reviews_en.text: This Japanese pork cutlet restaurant features pork cutlets and shrimp as its signature dishes. The taste is average. The restaurant is located in a shophouse opposite BigC. There is no parking in front of the store; if you're driving, you'll need to park at the mall and walk across the pedestrian bridge. Seating inside is limited, and the restaurant is quite cramped. The atmosphere is Japanese-style. The menu is limited, focusing mainly on pork cutlets and shrimp. The restaurant does not accept credit cards, only scan-to-pay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Be Birth

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Tonkatsu, both in taste and price. Crispy and not greasy, the pork is juicy and tender, not dry. The dipping sauce is a perfect match. The shredded cabbage is tasty and not bitter. Salad dressing is available in bottles for you to refill as much as you like. The miso soup is a little salty. Alcohol is also sold.

The atmosphere is relaxed, Japanese style, clean, with background music playing. There aren't many seats, but I saw delivery drivers picking up orders constantly.

(VAT 7% added)
sample_reviews_en.author: ppunn

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Japanese restaurant has a simple and comfortable atmosphere. The food is of very high quality and worth the price. The tonkatsu is perfectly fried – crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, and not greasy – served with fresh shredded cabbage. The shrimp is large, crispy, and fluffy. It pairs perfectly with the Zaru Ramen.

The restaurant also gets a lot of delivery orders, but dine-in customers don't have to wait long for their food. Suitable for both lunch and dinner. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Fang P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I walked past this cute little shop located opposite Big C on my way back. The fried shrimp with egg over rice was delicious and moist, the fried pork was perfectly tender, the crab roe was excellent, the dumplings in miso soup were soft and tasty, the seaweed salad was crunchy, and I finished with a refreshing yuzu sherbet ice cream to cleanse my palate.

The staff were very attentive. It's a shame the air conditioning wasn't working well that day.
sample_reviews_en.author: ohh mylord

restaurants.name: The BK Restaurant
restaurants.address:

Sukhumvit 71 Rd, Khet Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Indian-Burmese restaurant is considerably more affordable than those in the Nana area. The place is clean, and the portions are suitable for 1-2 people. It's hard to find an Indian restaurant that sells curry dishes in large trays, but they have them here. A tray costs 180-200 baht, with both chicken and vegetarian options. The chicken set includes chicken and lentil curry, rice, chapati, crackers, yogurt, rasmalai dessert, and spicy pickles to balance the flavors. It feels like good value for under 200 baht.

The momo dumplings were a bit thick. The butter chicken soup was delicious and rich (though the flavor didn't quite penetrate the chicken). The fish masala curry had a bit too many bones. All the lentil curries were flavorful and delicious. The warm Burmese rice noodles were unexpectedly tasty. The chai masala tea was very sweet; those who don't like sweet drinks should order it less sweet. Everything was served hot, and the flavors weren't too strong or spicy, which should appeal to Thai tastes. The staff speaks Thai and can recommend dishes. Free hot tea is served. I've been there 3 times already and will go again soon! 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: kudosu

sample_reviews_en.text:
BK Restaurant is a wonderful place to enjoy delicious food in a comfortable and welcoming atmosphere. The restaurant is clean, well-organized, and perfect for dining with family, friends, or colleagues.

The food is fresh, flavorful, and prepared with care. The menu offers a variety of dishes to suit different tastes, and the portion sizes are generous. Every meal is served beautifully and arrives promptly.

One of the highlights of BK Restaurant is its excellent customer service. The staff are friendly, attentive, and always ready to help, creating a pleasant dining experience from start to finish.

Overall, BK Restaurant provides great food, outstanding service, and excellent value for money. It is definitely a place worth visiting, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a satisfying and enjoyable meal. 🍽️✨🌟
sample_reviews_en.author: Moon

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food at B.K Restaurant is absolutely delicious and authentic. They offer a wonderful mix of Indian, Nepali, and Burmese dishes, all freshly prepared daily. Every plate is full of vibrant colors, rich flavors, and a great balance of spices.

The thali (platter) presentation looks incredible, featuring fluffy rice, soft and warm roti, flavorful curries, fresh vegetables, and tasty side dishes. You can tell that the ingredients are fresh and the cooking is done with a lot of care.

Overall, if you're craving real, homestyle Burmese meals that are healthy and fairly priced, B.K Restaurant is definitely a place you should try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Shano bhai Bosneth

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was in the area, so I visited this place that I had bookmarked.

Time of visit: 12:00
Number of people: 2

Items ordered:
Butter chicken curry
Egg curry
Momo
Plain naan?
Cheese naan?
Masala tea

Total: 556 baht

The butter chicken curry lacked sweetness and depth of flavor.
The egg curry had about 3 boiled eggs in it, and was pretty much what I expected.

The momo's dipping sauce was too spicy, ruining the momo's flavor.

The masala tea was a sweet ginger tea.

I was shocked, especially since I had high expectations.

The staff were sitting around on their cell phones when there were no orders.

I won't be visiting again...
sample_reviews_en.author: Bangkok &Tokyo life

sample_reviews_en.text: Really pleased to learn from seeing a recent twitter post from a customer that BK Restaurant is back! Had enjoyed meals at the 'between soi 3 and 5' location years ago, and then one day came for dinner and the restaurant was gone. Now some years later it's great to have the family-style restaurant back, with their Myanmar/Nepali/Indian cuisine offerings. Tasty dishes, friendly service, and good value. I enjoyed a thali set with some samosas on the side that left me more than satisfied. Just about 20-25 meters on the left inside Pridi Banomyong Soi 6, a nice bright room you can't miss.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ex Len

sample_reviews_en.text:
We found this place from Google search while we were looking for Indian food nearby. Though the place was very small, food was delicious and 2 staffs were very friendly who created a homely feel around.
We were welcome with traditional drink.
We ordered Aloo paratha, Egg burji & Muttar Pander, each item was very tasty.
Additionally they served a Nepali snack Sel Roti. They said they had a bulk order of sel roti today, so thought of giving some complimentary to the guests.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shiju Mohammad

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing food!!! Their juices are so healthy and delicious and low cost. Their Indian Thali is also delicious and a lot of food. Momos are great and even better is their fried tofu. The owner and chefs are so kind. Very clean restaurant. Lots of options for vegetarians and vegans and also meat eaters.  5 stars!! To find this place, walk in the Phra Khanong /6 alley a little bit and boom there it is! Must try garlic Naan!!!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Katherine

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you want real home-cooked Indian/nepali food, this is the place. I’ve tried almost all the good Indian restaurants in Bangkok, the expensive ones and the budget ones too. But don’t let the look of this restaurant fool you… if you want food that truly satisfies your soul, come here and thank me later.

Just one note: come hungry and come for the food. If you’re looking for Instagram pictures, maybe try somewhere else 😂
sample_reviews_en.author: Ankit Sahu

restaurants.name: Burapha Rang Nok Restaurant
restaurants.address:

63 ซอย Plaeng Nam Rd, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This well-known restaurant in Chinatown, Bangkok is famous for its bird’s nest desserts, drawing a constant stream of tourists who come specifically to try this traditional delicacy. The bird’s nest is served chilled and refreshing, with a smooth texture and naturally light sweetness, making it especially enjoyable during Bangkok’s hot weather.
The shop itself is super cooling, offering a comfortable escape from the heat outside while you enjoy a cold bowl of bird’s nest dessert. A thoughtful bonus is their free ice-cold chrysanthemum tea, which is refillable and pairs perfectly with the dessert, adding to the overall refreshing experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hau Keong Yoong

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is located on the roadside near the entrance of the soi (alley). There's a very large neon sign in front of the shop. The menu clearly shows the prices, except for the bird's nest, which you have to check at the front. The price varies depending on the quality. For those who like and are familiar with this type of dish, you can order special variations, such as adding ginseng, a soft-boiled egg, or specifying how much broth you want. I come to this shop very often, but I've only tried the bird's nest this time. I'll try some of the savory dishes on the menu next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: A B C Traveller

sample_reviews_en.text: Went for bird nest and shark fin at this rather famous eatery but the e4xperience here wasn't too great. The bird nest was okay but a little diluted. The shark fin soup was kind of awful, it had quite a fair bit of crab meat shells in the soup as well as hard edges of the shark fin and it really affected the mouthfeel and the overall palatability. There wasn't much people dining in here as well, and its safe to say I probably would not be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julius Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered rock sugar snow fungus and fresh milk white snow fungus. It wasn't too sweet, just right. Both bowls were served chilled, which was acceptable. The snow fungus pieces were eaten as a chilled dessert, which was refreshing. Each person also got a cup of chilled jasmine tea and a dish with candied ginkgo nuts and honey. The price was flexible and didn't require a special trip. You could eat it after walking around and feeling tired.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachel To

sample_reviews_en.text:
Yaowarat Classics
Bird's Nest Soup with Abalone in Red Sauce
Crab Fried Rice, Stir-fried Fish Maw
The taste is consistently good, just like before.
As soon as you sit down, a refreshing and fragrant chrysanthemum tea is served.

Burapha Bird's Nest, Plaeng Nam
Yaowarat, Bangkok

#singhaeat #singhareview
#singhafood #singhafood
sample_reviews_en.author: SINGHA chanel

sample_reviews_en.text: Chance upon this shop. We ordered the 300baht bird nest which was explained to us that it is made up of broken birdnest. We ordered the birdnest in rock sugar and another one in coconut. Both are nice. Texture is more bouncy than the normal whole piece of birdnest. Overall quite a good experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joseph Zhi Wei Heah

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a famous old shop in Chinatown specializing in bird's nest and shark fin. I visited during the Chinese New Year, and the whole street had a festive atmosphere. Chrysanthemum tea is complimentary. Tourists might want to check it out and give it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wei Wei

sample_reviews_en.text: The bird's nest menu didn't list prices, but they verbally told me they were 500, 800, and 1000 won. I ordered a 500-won bowl, which was about the size of a fist. It's worth trying if you're interested; they offer a small cup of chrysanthemum tea for free.
sample_reviews_en.author: 亨

restaurants.name: Sichuan Restaurant | 川味坊
restaurants.address:

14, 19 Sathu Pradit 19 Alley, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of the best Sichuan Chinese restaurants in Bangkok! The restaurant in located in Nara Place, a community mall complex in Soi 24 Narathiwas Road or Soi 19 Sathu Pradit Road. It’s also opposite Le Raffles (which houses the Animal Café). The nearest BTS station is Chongnonsi plus a 15 minute taxi ride or walk for around 20 minutes from BRT Thanon Chan Station. It’s right behind Central Plaza Rama 3 shopping center. There are quite a lot of dishes to choose from, all of them being authentic Chinese dishes, and are priced in the medium-high range. Our family’s favorite is sliced fish in spicy pickled vegetable soup. You can request for the dishes to be made less spicy if you’re not used to Sichuan pepper which has a numbing effect (and lasts for around half an hour after eating). The dan dan noodles 担担面 is also a must try. The seating area covers two floors so waiting time shouldn’t be that long even during rush hours, but there is limited parking on site in the evening and the Soi (Street) can be really congested during after-school hours.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suthida Chang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chinese! Again! This time Sichuan style!

I have been coming to this place for years and have been the go-to for Sichuan. Located on the middle soi of Narathiwat in Sathorn district, I recommend them if you’re into pungent spiced and oily, yet freshly cooked hot meals!

The price is on the average but well deserve for the generous portions and the fast and furious Chinese cooking…from wok to table in minutes. You know you’re in yer right place for Chinese when your veggie dishes are served extremely hot and still crispy at each chew.

I wanted to rate the full five star but the evening when i was there, the waitresses seemed distracted and anxious to close… so 4 stars should suffice until then ^^
sample_reviews_en.author: OceanSevens

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Chinese restaurant serves delicious food at reasonable prices.

- Prices per dish range from 100-300 baht.
- Besides individual dishes, they also offer mala hot pot.
- The staff provides good service.
- There is ample parking, but it's shared with other businesses. There was still parking available during lunchtime when I visited.

- Total cost:
Stir-fried eggplant
Sweet and sour beef
Braised beef
Approximately 800 baht
sample_reviews_en.author: Teay Kz

sample_reviews_en.text: This long-established Sichuan restaurant offers authentic flavors and generous portions, with its signature pickled fish and Sichuan-style chicken remaining popular. Service has improved recently, and the new dishes are a pleasant surprise. However, the food is on the salty side and a bit pricey; be aware that tea is charged per cup. Parking in the alley can be tight at times, but overall, it's worth a return visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: 曼谷外围Outcall Services

sample_reviews_en.text: Yummy Sichuan style Chinese food in bkk. Fresh ingredient and sauces from China make all dishes are like eat them in China. Staffs are friendly though they dont speak Thai fluently. Menu is in Chinese English and Thai. Price and portion of food is so reasonable. Free Parking in front of the restaurant. Guarantee the real Chinese food from real Chinese chef.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aey Angel

sample_reviews_en.text: Located in the residents area which surrounded by dining venues and high-rise condominiums. The foods there are great with a big portions. You will find many Chinese speaking customers inside and staffs, but it's not a big problem since there are menus with other languages and photos. Prices might quite high, but their portions are big and acceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kana Pan

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible food full of msg. Waiters taking order can barely speak Thai. First dish very salty and my tongue was burning with MSG. Told them with the help of Google translate not to put MSG In the remaining food but the next dish again same thing once asked they said we forgot. Will not recommend at all if you love your gut.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anita Namrata Kewalramani

sample_reviews_en.text:
Waited 1 whole hour and got 2 dishes, while 3 other tables that came after us got all the food and checked out. Waitresses are so stupid they canceled dishes that did not have enough ingredients although we ordered something else in replacement. The new order did not go in the kitchen.
Sechuan chicken is super salty.
sample_reviews_en.author: nuchanaa

restaurants.name: Long Doux
restaurants.address:

1124/5-7 อาคารแสงสว่างวัฒนะ Vibhavadi Rangsit 26 Alley, Chom Phon, จตุจักร Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Highly recommended for lovers of Vietnamese and Thai-Isaan cuisine, especially those looking for a long-established restaurant with great taste near Lat Phrao Intersection. This restaurant has been open for a while and is a favorite of many in the area. Its highlights include flavorful yet easy-to-eat dishes, fresh ingredients, and a wide variety of menu options, including Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage), Banh Cuon (Vietnamese steamed rice rolls), Pork Wrapped in Betel Leaves, Lemongrass Fried Fish, and the Fondue, a must-try dish among many.

* Nem Nuong: Rich dipping sauce, plenty of fresh vegetables.
* Pork Wrapped in Betel Leaves: Fragrant spices, very enjoyable.
* Lemongrass Fried Fish: Crispy on the outside, fresh fish inside.
* Meat Fondue: A signature dish ordered by almost every regular customer.

The restaurant has a relaxed atmosphere, perfect for family, friends, or a romantic dinner. It's conveniently located near the MRT Phahonyothin station and has ample parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: tam tt

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was excellent, but I'd like to review the food because while I believe the recipes are the restaurant's own, they don't taste like the Vietnamese food I've had before.
Grilled pork with betel leaves - The restaurant didn't grill it, they fried it. It was a little oily.
Beef pho - The recipe is similar to Phetchaburi-style red broth noodles, not like authentic Vietnamese pho. It doesn't have onions, and the soup is very sweet.
Vietnamese steamed rice rolls - The dough is like Thai steamed rice roll dough, and the filling has mostly pickled radish with hardly any minced pork.
Fried sea bass with lemongrass - Looking at the picture, I thought I would get a whole fish, but in reality, there were only a few pieces of meat. The restaurant probably doesn't actually give you a whole fish.
In conclusion, anyone wanting to eat authentic Vietnamese food should be prepared for the fact that the restaurant uses mostly adapted recipes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jedsada

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten here many times, probably 5 or more.
It's delicious every time. This is authentic Vietnamese spring rolls (Nem Nuong).
I recommend ordering it without the rice paper wrappers already soaked.
This way you don't have to bother peeling off each wrapper one by one while eating. There's plenty of vegetables included, everything you need.
However, lately the vegetables haven't been washed properly. Have you changed the staff washing the vegetables? Please improve this immediately. I would be very happy if you did.
The coconut pudding for dessert is delicious.
The service is excellent. There's a sink for washing hands and the restroom is clean.
I will definitely come back again when they've improved the vegetable washing process.
sample_reviews_en.author: THIPTAWAN THIPTHIAM

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a Vietnamese restaurant perfect for a family meal. There's some parking available, but limited. You can get off at Phahonyothin MRT station and walk there. The restaurant is near St. Louis Church and has been open for over 37 years. We ordered Nem Nuong (grilled pork skewers) – available in three sizes – fried spring rolls, Banh Cuon (steamed rice rolls), grilled pork with vermicelli, pork toast, and Vietnamese pizza. Overall, the food tasted good and was reasonably priced. During the New Year festival, the restaurant offered a coupon draw for a 5% discount or a free dessert. The staff provided good service. In summary, it was a great place and we'll definitely be back again. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Peace-Akido

sample_reviews_en.text:
Vietnamese, Thai, and Northeastern Thai Food

The restaurant has plenty of seating, but making a reservation will help you avoid disappointment.

They offer a wide variety of Vietnamese dishes, including Nem Nuong (grilled pork skewers), Yum Moo Yor (spicy pork sausage salad), and Moo Hor Bai Cha Phu (pork wrapped in betel leaves). They also have fondue, with rich and flavorful dishes.

Overall, the taste is good and sure to please. It's fun to come with a large group and share the dishes.

A must-try for those who love vegetables.

P.S. There's road construction in front of the restaurant, so plan your parking accordingly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanachai Tundulyasaree

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything was delicious, but the food was a bit slow to arrive, probably because there were a lot of customers and many orders came at once.
The service was excellent; the staff were attentive and even apologized for the delay in serving the food.

The prices were reasonable, not too expensive.

They offer both Vietnamese and Northeastern Thai (Isaan) food.
It was my first experience trying Vietnamese food.

If you're passing through the Ladprao area, stop by and give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Big Mama

sample_reviews_en.text: 10am-99pm (last order 8:40pm). Closed Wednesdays. Staff stay upstairs. Parking available next to the restaurant (3 spaces). The Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage) is delicious, not greasy or oily, and the ingredients are quite complete. Small set is 165 baht. #BangkokTravel The air conditioning is comfortable, the dining area is spacious and not cramped, the music isn't too loud, and the staff are lovely and attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kris Tang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Looking for delicious Vietnamese spring rolls (Naem Nueang) in town? I recommend this place! They offer three sizes: Small (100 THB), Medium (195 THB), and Large (250 THB). It's clean, delicious, and the service is good.

There's parking for about 5-7 cars in front of the shop, but if it's full, you can park in the nearby alley (but check the odd/even day parking restrictions).

The shop is open from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: P P

restaurants.name: Habib's Kebab Biryani Curry (Halal)
restaurants.address:

Terminal 21, LG030, Soi Sukhumvit 19, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Top notch food quality/ value for money
As a family, we have a regular dinners at Habibs branch outlet in Sukhumvit Soi 22 for the past 3 months for all of our special occasions ie birthday party and get to gather Have to admit that they offer one of the best Indian and Middle Eastern Food , variety selections and high quality ingredients. The must try Biryani / Butter chicken with Naan which i order everything i visited.   On top of this, we are well taken care off by  Professional Staff They are very friendly and fast to response to lot of my requests. They made me feel like home every time i visit silk road, they know exactly what i wanted.
sample_reviews_en.author: Red Apple Foods limited

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu shows normal-sized pizzas. However, when you order them, they look nothing like the pictures. To start with, the pizzas are only the size of your hand (literally, just the size of an outstretched hand, which is outrageous for 279 baht). Then, the pepperoni pizza has strangely sliced ​​sausage on it that doesn't look anything like the picture on the menu. When we asked about it, they claimed the pictures on the menu were only meant to suggest what the pizzas would look like, which is simply fraud. At least we were able to return this monstrosity of a pizza and only paid for the drinks, which didn't exactly improve the whole experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marwin

sample_reviews_en.text:
So I'm ok with paying money for good food...but the  food quantity and quality did not match the bill I got charged. The pizza was horrendous, but maybe that's my fault for ordering pizza in a halal food place. Do not order this. The meat lover set had like a very modest amount of meat on it. The place looks like a fast food joint but it charges double. Only good thing we're the servers who were very nice, but the mgmt needs to relook at theier food quantity or their prices. A hard no go for me.

Update*
A much better and more authentic and more reasonably priced halal place is upstairs on the San Fran floor
sample_reviews_en.author: Pema Wangchug

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here for dinner and left with a new life purpose: eating more Indian food. The biryani was so fragrant that even my neighbor probably smelled it when I got home. 10/10 experience and Warning: The garlic naan here is addictive. I ordered one… then another… then another. Send help. And overall everything is perfect and I will also come back here with my friends to eat 👍😋
sample_reviews_en.author: smile preet

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered the meat platter, beef and chicken tikka.Flavour was good and it definitely hits the spot. According to the staff, portion is for 1 person which is true for the chips however there was barely any meat. The portion would surely be adequate if the person is a vegetarian child. For the price paid I guess I expected a fair portion.

Still finished it though…
sample_reviews_en.author: Ibrahim LM

sample_reviews_en.text: value for money indian food restaurant, nice staff, nice foood, i tried vegetarian curry and chai tea today, i m mad at chai tea! meaning i am curiously in love with chai tea! it taste good here too, the only minus is the restaurant a bit small with only two 4-seat table, and five 2-seat table, about 150+ sq ft area, hopefully it will expand as business grows
sample_reviews_en.author: dr ken chao

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the mutton rogan josh here and it was surprisingly good. The meat was tender, the sauce had a rich, balanced spice profile, and the portion size was just right. The service was quick, prices are reasonable for Terminal 21, and the food came out fresh. Overall, a solid spot if you’re craving something flavorful and comforting while in the mall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bogdan Alexandru Constantin

sample_reviews_en.text: Tiny cockroaches everywhere on the walls. Don’t go here if you value cleanliness. When I pointed out to the waitress, she swiped one off the wall using her bare hand and continued serving us without bothering to wash her hand until another customer called her out. I managed to get a picture of one. Look out for more along the gaps of the mirror.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khairul

restaurants.name: 4649 Restaurant Bar & Gallery
restaurants.address:

234 Yi Sip Song Karakadakhom 1 Rd, Pom Prap, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Great vibe and a really nice place to chill with friends. The music is at a comfortable volume, and the lighting creates a cozy, stylish atmosphere ถ้าperfect for photos 📸
sample_reviews_th.author: Parakorn Srimaiphun

sample_reviews_en.text:
4649 Restaurant Bar & Gallery is a hidden gem that perfectly blends art, food, and atmosphere. The moment you step in, you’re welcomed by a stylish and artistic interior that sets the mood for a unique dining experience. The menu offers a creative mix of Asian fusion and modern comfort food, beautifully presented and full of flavor. Their signature cocktails are also worth trying — balanced, bold, and refreshing.

Whether you’re coming for a casual dinner, a drink with friends, or to enjoy the latest art exhibition, 4649 is a place where creativity and good taste meet. The staff is friendly, the music is great, and the overall vibe is effortlessly cool. Highly recommended for those who appreciate great food and artistic ambiance in one place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratchawan Ounyaa

sample_reviews_en.text: The curry was delicious and the service was great when we asked for help with the cocktails. They explained everything patiently even when we were asking the same questions for the nth time. The atmosphere is also very chill and instagram-worthy. They were screening one of my favourite coming of age anime's new episode when we were eating our food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kinga “szerecsendio” Biró

sample_reviews_en.text: If you miss the Japanese bar/restaurant vibe. This is the place! Food is great good portions and a reasonable price. Soft music in the background good idea for date night or a catch-up night with your friends. Staff are fluent in English and offer good service
sample_reviews_en.author: Jessi J.Hadsons

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice little Japanese cocktail bar. Lighting was nice with chill music. Drinks were good and edamame was a nice snack, only would have wanted more because it was good.

In a quiet area a few blocks away from the main strip of Chinatown.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tyler N

sample_reviews_en.text: Really cute place, Torikatsu kare was very delicious and the cutest dish I have ever had, sweet and good spicy with crispy veg. Also the cocktails and beers were nice. Just overall a very comfy place to hangout and relax :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Natalie Sahusilawani

sample_reviews_en.text: Had an amazing night!! This place is very nice, with the Japanese cocktails and Japanese menu. Kara-age and Udon where 10 out of 10, especially with a cold beer. Cocktails were also great. Very nice crowd of people also.
sample_reviews_en.author: Georgios ming

sample_reviews_en.text: This bar is so good, it has banger music, the japanese vibe, insane cocktails but the best of all is the staff! They are so nice and really fun. I think this is my favorite bar in the whole of Chinatown.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emiel Vandenbroeck

restaurants.name: Charoen Thai Phochana
restaurants.address:

ปาก Somdet Chao Phraya 5, Somdet Chao Phraya, Khlong San, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I was driving past Icon Siam and decided to check out the reviews to satisfy my curiosity. Before going, I called the restaurant and the person who answered was very nice. I read so many reviews that I decided to write my own review. This is my first time eating here, and I'm definitely going back. Everything was delicious, honestly, I'm not exaggerating. I don't just say everything is delicious; if it wasn't, I wouldn't write a review and ruin the restaurant's reputation. The fried rice was perfectly cooked, each grain individually flavored. I'm getting hungry just typing this review! If I'm in Bangkok again, I'll definitely stop by. Please look at the pictures 😘 #TasteIsDifferentForEveryone
sample_reviews_en.author: Phimwilai

sample_reviews_en.text:
The grouper fish soup with taro was light and refreshing, the fish was firm and bouncy.
The garlic and chili shrimp was excellent, the shrimp was fresh and delicious, and it was spicy as requested.
The stir-fried mixed seafood was good, the flavor wasn't too strong, and it paired well with the seafood dipping sauce.
The crispy fried pork intestines were delicious, but felt a little oily.

The owner was very friendly. It was raining heavily when I went, and he came out to help me call a taxi. So kind!

I've been eating here for over 10 years, and it's still as delicious as ever.
sample_reviews_en.author: manatsanan leksrisakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was decent, but the manners of some of the staff need improvement. I was with my boyfriend, who is considerably older than me. When a woman came to clear our plates, she mumbled something about us. She seemed to be an older woman, not the one with short hair, but she whispered softly enough for us to hear, and it was quite harsh. We felt very uncomfortable. Whether she was serious or not, we felt like we heard it. Please keep an eye on your staff and prevent them from being rude to customers. Whatever you think, keep it to yourself and don't express it outwardly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arisara Piboonchaiyawat

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old-style Teochew Chinese rice porridge restaurant with delicious food at reasonable prices. It's been open for a very long time and only serves dinner. The restaurant is located on Somdet Chao Phraya Road. If you're coming from the small roundabout, it's just past the motorcycle shop. You'll see cars parked along the road; find a parking spot. It's recommended to park in a group to reduce the risk of getting your car towed. You can park on the street in front of the restaurant from around 6 PM onwards. It's a single shophouse unit with only a few tables.
sample_reviews_en.author: Winyu Arayangkoon

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted great. The fresh shrimp rolls were delicious, with plenty of shrimp and a generous filling – highly recommended! The sizzling oyster omelet was also very good; the batter was delicious, and the dish stayed hot even as it was nearing its end. The stir-fried fish maw and chicken with cashew nuts were fragrant and flavorful, with a balanced taste that you could easily keep eating. The pork and shrimp dumplings were incredibly delicious, with a generous filling and a lovely peppery aroma. The crispy fried pork neck was also delicious and addictive.😋🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Mon Mon

sample_reviews_en.text: A great place to try local cuisine at its best! The tom yum in a giant heated bowl is superb—I've never seen so many king prawns in one dish. All the other dishes I chose from the photos were also delicious. The staff doesn't speak much English, but they're very friendly and eager to please. I highly recommend it to anyone who appreciates authentic Thai cuisine!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lida S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious and the service was great. I arrived before the restaurant opened and the owner brought me a chair to sit on. She even came back to thank me when I left! It made my day! I'll definitely go back again. 🩷

P.S. I loved the Moonlight Spring Rolls the most!
sample_reviews_en.author: Im Cha

sample_reviews_en.text: I didn't have any expectations going in as I was in the area to attend a funeral. But the locals did recommend this place and I was not disappointed. The place was packed! And a long line started to queue up. The food was great and the price was very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vip Angkoon Klangchanee

restaurants.name: Sherbet Club Bangkok
restaurants.address:

59 Soi Sukhumvit 63, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The lighting, music, and girls were all perfect, creating an incredibly lively atmosphere, and sure to fill your wallet. Adelaide was very attentive, communicating in English without any problems. Prices start at 1600 RMB, but only for in-person interaction; if you want to take someone home, you'll have to negotiate. The equipment is a bit dated, so remember to book in advance.
sample_reviews_en.author: 曼谷外围Escort Bangkok 看主页

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is lively and great, with plenty of enthusiastic girls, and the DJ and performers are very professional. The service is attentive, making it a good place for friends to relax and have fun. However, the equipment is a bit old, and the price starts at 1600 RMB per person, so it's recommended to find someone familiar with the area to show you around.
sample_reviews_en.author: 曼谷上门服务 Escort Bangkok 看主页

sample_reviews_en.text: The decor is lavish, the performances are fantastic, the girls are beautiful and enthusiastic, and while the drinks are on the pricier side, the service is attentive. If you don't speak Thai, just ask Ade; he can easily arrange a private room and order drinks. It can get a bit noisy when it's crowded, but overall it remains a top choice for Bangkok's nightlife.
sample_reviews_en.author: 曼谷上门服务Outcall Services

sample_reviews_en.text: High pressure tactic, very poor customer service from the girl we had to pick. Won't name the girl but definitely won't be back, felt like a very underappreciated ATM, when initially going did not think would feel like this or it would have a working lady atmosphere. Don't recommend
sample_reviews_en.author: Tallow Marble

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is tricky. Watch out ‼️ Very ambiguous pricing and they surprise you with a huge bill at the end. The service is rude and they play games all the way up until you literally try and walk out. Beware ‼️
sample_reviews_en.author: Trial

sample_reviews_en.text: The bar is great, beautiful, and spacious. Most importantly, the girls are incredibly cute. Go early in the evening before others choose them. The music is good and the songs are great. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natawat “Rareun” Suphajumpiya

sample_reviews_en.text: I don’t get the hype. High pressure sales tactics and the girls all stay in the back rather than socializing table to table. Show was pretty good in the few moments i could stop and catch my breath
sample_reviews_en.author: Aleksandar Marjanovic

sample_reviews_en.text: First time at Sherbet, overall a good experience. The arrangements were excellent; I recommend booking through Ad. Lots of Thai nightlife resources, fantastic!
sample_reviews_en.author: 泰享受

restaurants.name: นายฮุย ก๋วยเตี๋ยวลูกชิ้นปลา Nai Hui Fish Ball Noodles
restaurants.address:

155 Yaowarat Rd, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop is located in a side street in the bustling Yaowarat central market. It's very crowded, with people constantly coming and going. I had the chance to try it, so I stopped by. The shop has a gimmick: fried taro and seasoned fish balls. The noodles are perfectly cooked; I especially liked the "peppah" noodles. They give you toppings like round fish balls, fish cakes, seasoned fish balls, and fried taro – everything was delicious! I prefer the dry version of the yen ta fo because it allows you to better taste the sauce. Overall, it was great and I want to go back again! It's crowded, so you might have to wait a bit, but the shop isn't big. The owner was observing and constantly checking on customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalalai J.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mr. Hui's Fishball Noodle Shop
This old shop in Yaowarat Fresh Market has been open for over 80 years. They make their own fishballs. I often pass by this shop because I shop in the market. It's always busy. They offer clear broth fishball noodles, tom yum, and yen ta fo. The soup is excellent – ​​clear, refreshing, and perfectly balanced in saltiness. The noodles are also good, round and thin, not too bouncy or crunchy, chewy, and fragrant with egg. The fishballs are firm, round, and crispy with a rich flavor and aroma. The shrimp balls are soft, and the taro fritters are perfectly sized, fragrant, and slightly sweet. The shop is closed on the 1st and 16th of every month.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supha Kit

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're walking through the old market, this is a place you should definitely stop by. They make their own fish ball noodles; they're odorless, chewy, and bouncy. The shrimp balls are sweet and juicy, and the broth is clear. I ordered dry noodles, seasoned with roasted peanuts and a little sugar, and sprinkled with chili to your liking – a must-try. Another secret weapon is their Yen Ta Fo (pink noodle soup), with a salty broth, served with regular wide noodles – which I particularly enjoyed. In short, if you're looking for a place to sit and eat in the old market, this is a great option.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dawud

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're hungry while at the market, try the fish ball noodle soup. The fish balls are bouncy, fresh, and not fishy. The fish cake and fish dumplings are delicious in every bite. The broth is clear, fragrant, sweet, and well-balanced. The noodles are perfectly cooked. The portion is generous for the price. If you're a fish ball lover, you must stop by and try it. You won't be disappointed! 🍜🐟

They also sell fish balls by the kilo if you want to buy some to keep at home for making noodle soup. And they have all kinds of egg noodles too.
sample_reviews_en.author: วริยา มารศรี

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodle soup tasted good, the broth was good, the fish balls were okay, but the shrimp balls and fish cake were good. The male owner provided terrible service; he was impolite, loud, and wouldn't let us sit at the same table as him. There had to be another solo customer to sit with us. He even took our items from the corner of our table and placed them in the middle for that solo customer without asking or telling us. When we repeated our instructions, he kept saying he knew, but ultimately got the order wrong.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jimmii Haha

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is so delicious! Every time I come to Yaowarat (Chinatown), I always stop by this restaurant.

The noodles are excellent – ​​chewy and springy. The toppings are also fantastic, including fish balls, shrimp balls, fried taro, and fish cake. I personally love their fish cake. The fried garlic is also fragrant.

The broth is clear and fragrant, slightly salty but delicious and served piping hot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sorapong Yuthtrai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chanced upon this stall while walking along the alleys of Yaowarat. Saw many people queuing outside and decided to give it a try for breakfast.
We ordered:
1. Fried fish skin - crispy and nice
2. Fishball luk chin - nice
3. Fish cake - soft and nice though I found it a tad salty
4. Fried taro - not to my liking as it is very hard
5. Kway teow soup was really good, always love Thai kway teow nam.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Ryan Soh

sample_reviews_en.text: The soup has a mild pork flavor, and the noodles are a little too soft. The bowl contains round meatballs, shrimp, fish cake, and fried taro. The fish cake has a thick skin and a nice fried aroma. The other meatballs are also standard. The restaurant has a good number of tables, but it gets very crowded during lunchtime, so you might have to share a table and be patient while waiting. Cash only.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pat K.

restaurants.name: Panettone
restaurants.address:

303 Thanon Nakhon Chaisi Rd, Thanon Nakhon Chai Si, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "The English menu is well overpriced and the food we ordered was below average."

sample_reviews_en.text:
Parking was a bit difficult as the restaurant isn't very big. The owner was very friendly and gave great recommendations.

The braised beef with sour tamarind was delicious; the soup had a well-rounded sour and salty flavor.
The shrimp salad with coconut milk was amazing, highly recommended! It came with 6 large shrimp for less than 200 baht – great value!
The drunken noodles omelet – at first I thought it would be just okay, nothing special, but I ended up finishing the whole plate unexpectedly.
The spring rolls – I ordered them because I'd never tried them before. The dipping sauce was made from rambutan, and it had a rambutan aroma, quite unique. It's not really a spring roll, but the dough is chewier – hard to describe.
The rice was fragrant, well-cooked, not soggy, with beautifully separated, chewy grains – very appetizing.
The gateau cake was delicious, but it seemed like it had been refrigerated; the cream was a bit hard. It would have been better to take it home so it could melt perfectly.
On the way out, the owner gave us a free sample of a dessert – it was like nougat mixed with puffed rice, very fragrant and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naru Pan (Tuang)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm not sure if the food just wasn't to our liking or if we ordered the wrong dishes.
We ordered Khao Chae (rice soaked in fragrant water) and Yam Som Chun (spicy salad with pungent citrus fruits), but the Khao Chae wasn't fragrant at all, and the ingredients were just okay. The Yam Som Chun also didn't have much of a pungent citrus flavor; it tasted like a mix of crispy catfish and pork served with shrimp paste rice – not bad, just lacking the aroma.
The restaurant has retro-style wall decorations, but the air conditioning wasn't working. We ordered a cake based on reviews, but it was incredibly hard, like it had just come out of the freezer, and tasted like butter mixed with wafer pieces.
We also ordered drinks, but they didn't bring them for a long time. They later told us they were out of ice and only brought it after we finished eating.
Parking is on the street, which is a bit difficult and quite busy.
There were no other customers when we went. The food wasn't particularly fast or slow, but the service was lacking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naruporn Ananpongsuk

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is highly recommended. 🌟

The owner was there when we arrived, and she was very friendly. She approached us and chatted with us for a bit, asking where we were from and recommending dishes to try. The place has a retro vibe. We ordered deep-fried chicken wings, an omelet with basil and chili, and a beef dish whose name I've forgotten—it looked like a beef stew. Everything was delicious, and we thoroughly enjoyed it all. The beef was so tender, the chicken was crispy and flavorful, and the omelet was tasty and had vegetables in it too! In total, we paid 450 baht, which was quite reasonable for the quality of the food and the fact that it was lunch for two people. ^,^
sample_reviews_en.author: Hencris Manas

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious authentic Thai food in a grandma's old house atmosphere. Good price and good portions. The staff lady was so nice and helpful.

Some of the dishes were traditional Thai, I'd never even heard of them before. I tried them and they were incredibly delicious. The atmosphere was like eating at my grandmother's old wooden house. The staff member was lovely and very helpful, giving great food recommendations. I'll definitely go back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: K S

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food at this restaurant is delicious. The owner (I believe her name is "Khun Lek") is very friendly and seems to be in a good mood. The waitstaff are also very nice.

The restaurant isn't large, but it feels warm and welcoming.

Importantly, the food is reasonably priced, and the ingredients are of good quality. You can tell the cook puts care and skill into the food.

Delicious, affordable, and with good ingredients. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: an pao

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant serves traditional Thai food. The owner is very friendly, chatty, and recommends ingredients for each dish.
As for the food, we ordered Khao Chae (rice in chilled broth), Moo Tom Madan (pork stew with sour fruit), and Chak Pia (stir-fried spring rolls), and everything was delicious. The Shrimp with Lime and Fresh Milk was just average, but they did give a generous amount of shrimp.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yong.-yng Orawanhanothai

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small, old wooden house, filled with delicious food, attentive service, and truly impressive hospitality ♥️

I've been eating at this restaurant for over 10 years. The taste hasn't changed at all; everything is incredibly delicious, from savory dishes to desserts and drinks. A must-try is the braised pork ribs – it's heavenly!
sample_reviews_en.author: SUPATTHRA KANJANAPUNWONG

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant might be a bit hard to find and parking might be difficult if you're not familiar with the area, but I can assure you the food is incredibly delicious. The Gaeng Raewang (a type of curry) and Yam Woon Sen (a glass noodle salad) are the best, and there are many other truly tasty dishes as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: คนจริงๆ นะ โฮ่งๆ

restaurants.name: DA-TE - SAKABA
restaurants.address:

9/1 ถนน สุขุมวิท Khwaeng Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food and an amazing atmosphere!

The spacious interior offers many private rooms, making it suitable for a wide range of occasions—from dates and meals with friends to business dinners and banquets.
The counter seating, in particular, has a fantastic vibe and is perfect for enjoying a relaxed drink in the evening. Large group parties are also welcome.

The menu is extensive, featuring everything from casual robata-style dishes such as yakitori to fresh, high-quality sashimi and authentic sushi.
The sushi is truly top-notch!

As the name suggests, the restaurant also offers a great selection of Date (Sendai) regional specialties.
Must-try dishes include:
• Sendai Yakisoba
• Sendai Cold Noodles

Both are absolutely delicious and highly recommended 🥰

With excellent food, great atmosphere, and outstanding versatility, this is a restaurant I can confidently recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploy Chanida

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the best Japanese Restaurant in BKK. I recommend everyone to go there. Every foods are delicious like you go to eat at Japan 🇯🇵. 💕

Da-Te Sakaba – An authentic Japanese izakaya with great ambiance and top-quality food 🍣✨
For those seeking privacy, there are private rooms, and for those who want to watch the chefs prepare dishes up close, the counter seats are perfect 🥢
Must-try dishes include fresh sashimi, Sendai-style yakisoba, and juicy grilled meat – all absolutely delicious! Perfect for special occasions or unwinding after work 🍶💕
sample_reviews_en.author: Auntigan Suthiraparn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is great, the food tastes good, and the staff provides excellent service. There's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, including sashimi, yakiniku, tori,
as well as à la carte options and a large selection of drinks such as sake, whiskey, and more. Overall, it's a good place to visit, conveniently located near the Phrom Phong BTS station with parking available. I highly recommend trying the sashimi.
All the fish here is imported from Japan.
sample_reviews_en.author: อนุชา ไชยเคน

sample_reviews_en.text:
Menu may looks pricey, but believe me, its worth!

Ingredients are so fresh, cooked by chef who know what he doing, resulting in tremendous experience with freshness, umami, and perfection, combined with polite and helpful services for all staffs and traditional atmosphere.

No more to say, but this is a "must try-worth it" Japanese restaurant in Sukhumvit 31
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarun Sutharoswatcharatorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in Soi Sukhumvit 31. Parking is available behind the restaurant. There are several private rooms, but reservations are required.
The food is fresh and delicious, with a truly authentic Japanese feel. The menu offers a wide variety of choices. The staff is very helpful and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nanthida phothirat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The oysters were delicious, but both I and my customer got sick from eating raw oysters.

The oysters themselves were fresh and tasty, being from Japan, but we both developed symptoms about 24 hours after eating them, so I think it was norovirus. The restaurant isn't at fault, so there's nothing we can do about it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puramuk

sample_reviews_en.text:
Date Sakaba. This place is a favorite of certain people.
Date Sakaba has a wide variety of menu items and the quality of the fish is good. Despite an unexpected power outage that lasted about 30 minutes, we continued drinking and headed straight to Geiko, still exhausted.
sample_reviews_en.author: james won

sample_reviews_en.text: I truly believe this is the best Japanese restaurant in Bangkok. Since the pandemic, I've been thinking, "I want to come back and eat here again someday!" and so I visited again with a friend this time. I'd even consider going to Bangkok just to eat at this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: shemesh megu

restaurants.name: L'Escargot Bistro
restaurants.address:

51/2 Soi Ruamrudee Phloen Chit Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I approve this rating for many reasons.
The white wine was good and chilled.
The red wine was very good, but at €130 a bottle, that's to be expected, I'd say.
We ordered two starters: salmon, avocado, and snails, but they arrived quite late... the starters were very good.
Then came the duck confit with potatoes, which was excellent, and the cordon bleu, which was far, far, far, far too coarse—inedible, even half would have been too much.
The chocolate mousse was way too rich in chocolate and, above all, too hard, but we finished it anyway.
A pleasant meal that deserves a greeting in French for a French restaurant of this style.
Lots of Bordeaux wines to choose from, but almost no Loire or Burgundy, and they didn't even have the bottle we ordered first!

Good Thai-style service: as soon as you finish a dish, they take it away 😄 even too much!
Perhaps the menu is too large; between the one under the plate, the one on the chalkboard, the menu itself, and another chalkboard on the wall, it's a bit confusing! We had two glasses of white wine as an aperitif and a bottle of red wine for €250, a bit pricey.
sample_reviews_en.author: Virginie Baumert

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is definitely another place in Ruamrudee that's "beautiful from the outside to the inside." 🐌✨
Personally, I love the design here the most:
🏛 Exterior: It has a classic bistro style, making for very chic photos. It feels like a cafe in Europe.
🎨 Interior: The highlight is the "wall painting" (Mural Art of a woman and a dog). It makes the shop feel lively and has character, not too plain. Everyone who comes here has to find a spot to take a picture with this wall. It's perfect.
🫖 Note: Another thing that impressed me is the tea (Gryphon) imported from Singapore. It's incredibly fragrant. You can smell and choose your own at the counter. Sipping it warm perfectly complements the shop's atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sugarcanebkk

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really wanted to love this place - French bistro style food is my favorite! We had decent starters but our mains were horrible… a very expensive ribeye (apparently from Argentina) was the chewiest ribeye I have ever had, the cafe de Paris sauce was lumpy and the steak tartar was brown (I guess prepared earlier and put in the fridge - wasn’t off/spoiled at all, just discolored) and a bit spicy which normally is not the case, with Tabasco
as a request or served on the side. The crepe Suzette was over sweet and I couldn’t taste the flambé at all… really sad as it’s priced at the level of exceptionally good restaurants so I had really high hopes but was let down.
sample_reviews_en.author: Craig Clark

sample_reviews_en.text: The classic dishes are delicious; the duck confit is tender and flavorful, the restaurant uses high-quality cheeses that pair well with every dish, and the tenderloin steak is perfectly grilled and fragrant. The prices are reasonable for the quality. The staff are attentive and friendly. The restaurant has a French-style atmosphere, filled with flowers and greenery. Recommended if you enjoy authentic French cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kullapus S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
What a fabulous dinner and setting. The Cassoulet was perfect and service exact. Definitely in the must return to list.
If you buy a Bottle of wine there, they waive the corkage to also bring your own. Very generous.
The Owner is extremely friendly and a joy to talk with.
Highly recommend going.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ronald Asher

sample_reviews_en.text: I liked the friendly and uncrowded atmosphere. The service was excellent; they were very attentive, always asking if we needed anything else, and very polite and gentle with customers. The shop was clean and beautifully decorated. I will definitely come again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rungnata Poonsil

sample_reviews_en.text: My dinner was good. The restaurant was quiet and they had a table available for me. The service was also reliable and the wait staff were knowledgeable about the menu. The prices were expected for a French restaurant. I'd go back again and try more of the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jonathan Marc

sample_reviews_en.text: I come here for dinner at least once each time I am in Bangkok.  I just arrived from a week in Paris and this was as delightful a meal as I had in the motherland.  I ventured out onto the street after experiencing the earthquake on the 26th …
sample_reviews_en.author: James Howaniec

restaurants.name: Cute Corner Cuisine
restaurants.address:

2, 3 Sukhumvit Soi 18, Klongtoey, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Me and my husband recently dined at Cute Corner Cuisine and were blown away by the experience. From the moment we stepped inside, we were warmly welcomed and the hospitality of the restaurant set the perfect tone for the evening. Tomm created a personalized menu for us that was nothing short of exceptional, showcasing the best of Thai cuisine.

Each dish was perfect, and every bite was delightful! The quality and freshness of the food were evident, and it was clear that each dish had been prepared with care and passion.

Beyond the incredible food, Tomm’s warm conversation made us feel like cherished guests. The combination of delicious cuisine and welcoming atmosphere made for an unforgettable dining experience.

Cute Corner Cuisine truly captures the essence of Thai hospitality and flavors. If you're looking for an outstanding meal and a cozy, heartfelt environment, this is the place to be. We can’t wait to return!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anne Ros

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm going to give this place a 10 star rating. Hard to describe this brother sister restaurant operation. It feels like you are at a friend's house and they cook for you, it happened that this friend is a great cook with great and likeable personality. I don't have pictures of the food for you here. I don't even have time to think about taking pictures. Because the food was That great. The night we went, our family and friends, a group of 15 in total didn't even have time to talk until all the food were done for. The first prize goes to Spicy Stirred Fried Spaghetti with crispy fish filets and Southern style curry super spicy but was our favorite. This Place is a must go. And don't forget to finish your meal with an Iced Latte, the best in town.
sample_reviews_en.author: Liza Davies

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant that will deeply attract you... I especially love the row of long tables. They were originally taken from the roof of a house and converted into dining tables. The restaurant's beautiful design is delightful. The beautiful proprietress is an excellent cook. You can even ask her to cook your favorite dishes to satisfy your taste buds. The friendly and handsome owner makes you want to drink cup after cup of coffee. And there's the 8-year-old manager with a Superman hairstyle who serves guests very attentively. Delicious food, coffee, and a super convenient location. There are also comfortable and reasonably priced guesthouses for rent upstairs. Thoughtful service... Thumbs up! Friends visiting Bangkok... Don't miss it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mun Whye Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: My absolute favorite restaurant is Cute Corner Cuisine. They offer a delightful blend of Thai and international cuisine. What I truly admire about Tomm's cooking is her ability to incorporate the natural flavors of the ingredients, while also paying attention to the vibrant colors of the food and the presentation on the plate. To enjoy a meal at this fantastic restaurant, it is necessary to make a reservation and place your order at least one day in advance. Tomm herself will even send you photos and a list of her most popular dishes, giving you the opportunity to choose your preferred option. Though it may seem a bit complicated, I assure you that the experience is well worth it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Patama Pat

sample_reviews_en.text:
RESERVATION ONLY.!

The small cozy 1 table restaurant serves home style find dinning with Thai-European fusion food.

Every dishes delicate cook by Khun Tomm, owner chef of the restaurant.

The concept of this restaurant is enjoy food and drink in you friend kitchen and dining room.

Food are delicious, but the best is friendly with friend atmosphere.

Parking available in Condominium parking lot behind the restaurant.

Please be noted, during Covid situation this restaurant is open for ressrvation and take away only.

ATK test also available and required.
sample_reviews_en.author: Debchatra Svasti

sample_reviews_en.text: My wife and I had a wonderful dinner at Cute Corner Cuisine. It’s a by reservation only restaurant; no walk in. It was easy communication with Tomm, the owner and chef of the restaurant, by WhatsApp, to decide on the menu.  Restaurant is a short walk from Asoke BTS sta.  Food was great. We liked the Tomkha Salid fish soup, cooked with coconut milk.  River prawn was good too. Atmosphere was excellent and Tomm attended to all details to deliver a good experience.  Strongly recommended for those wanting to try something different.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neo Chian Lim

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dear Khun Tomm, thank you for enjoying  all of us very much my birthdayparty at your lovely cute and cozy "Cute Corner Restaurant" with very delicious Thai specialities, nice dessert and good wines. It is the perfekt place to celebrate a wonderful party with Karaoke fun singing. We can highly recommand your Thai cuisine, friendly good service and the lovely place with the correct Name CUTE CORNER!
KOP KHUN KRUB a thousand!! Best regards and wishes from Marcel and friends (moon heart eyes)
sample_reviews_en.author: smooth shaver

sample_reviews_en.text: The first floor is a restaurant, and the second floor is an Airbnb. I didn't use the restaurant, but I used the dorm. I've stayed at five-star hotels, but this place is much better. It has two spacious, soft beds, a laundry room, a small veranda, a desk, a sofa, a dining table, a smart TV with YouTube support, free Pringles, Lay's Chips, and a few bottles of water. You can also use the gym right next door for free. The owner is also very kind. I'll be back soon!!!!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: 권다은

restaurants.name: ฉ่า แกงป่ารสเด็ด ผัดเผ็ดรสจัด
restaurants.address:

983 Bang Phrom, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I didn't take pictures of the food because I forgot. It was so delicious, I wanted to share. I want good restaurants to do well so they can stay in business for a long time.
The food tasted amazing, I was very surprised. Everything I ordered was delicious. The stir-fried dishes were fragrant and flavorful, with rich tastes.
I recommend the "Three-Flavor Stir-fry," the chicken with cashew nuts (it's the best!), the stir-fried pork belly with mild chilies, the jungle curry (be careful, it's spicy!), the clear tom yum soup (it tastes good), and the stir-fried shrimp heads with chili and salt.
I'll come back to try all the dishes.
Parking is available along the side of Phra Thep Road.
The restaurant might look dark from the outside, but the inside is okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siri Sun

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely delicious, but if you're coming here, please be patient.
It's a family-run restaurant, so it takes a little time, but it's worth the wait.
This time, I ordered the salted egg squid, the soft-boned fish curry, and the jungle curry. They were all a perfect ten, no deductions.
It was so delicious I forgot to take a picture of the squid.
The curry was the best. If you have time, be patient.
I highly recommend giving it a try, especially if you like spicy food!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sitawach N

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious, but a bit too sweet, typical of Kanchanaburi. The stir-fried noodles took a while because they were made the old-fashioned way, not left out. They were slowly baked over low heat. The day I went, the noodles were a bit soggy, but the flavor was good. The fish balls were authentic, soft and bouncy, and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: N Yanachan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my third visit.
Don't miss the Choo Chee Soft-Shelled Fish and the Stir-fried Squid with Salted Egg. The restaurant prepares each dish with care, so if you're extremely hungry, skip this place. But I guarantee it's totally worth the wait.
Try it once… and you'll want to try it again and again and again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joe Ns

sample_reviews_en.text: This wild game restaurant serves delicious fried frog with garlic. The frogs are large, crispy, and have firm, chewy meat. The spicy stir-fried beef with pickled bamboo shoots is very flavorful, and the stir-fried three-pungent vegetables have a wonderful wok aroma. The fried fish is also very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Navakamon Shop

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant, located in the Taling Chan area, serves wild game dishes with curry pastes and ingredients sourced from Kanchanaburi. The flavors are bold and delicious; every dish we ordered was excellent. Even though we arrived before the restaurant opened, it was quickly packed with customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: sanansin yuangthab

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the portions are generous, and the prices are reasonable. They mostly focus on spicy dishes like jungle curry and stir-fried bitter beans. The river fish dishes are served in large, beautiful pieces, and are very fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patsakorn Kitcharoen

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is similar to the one in Kanchanaburi, but the jungle curry in Kanchanaburi is a bit spicier. We ordered 3 dishes for 700 baht. The fried fish was a bit overpriced at 430 baht for 2 pieces.
sample_reviews_en.author: มัณทยา ยุวนวรรธนะ

restaurants.name: Ronin Pizza ลาดพร้าว18
restaurants.address:

178 Lat Phrao 18 Alley, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pizza, which is supposed to be the star dish, was just average, decent but not amazing. What I liked were the burrata cheese salad and the pork chop; they were delicious. This restaurant's mashed potatoes are also delicious, smooth and creamy. The tiramisu was huge, but the taste was typical, not too sweet, acceptable but not amazing either.
The service was good. There's convenient parking, and the food didn't take long to arrive. We went early, around 11:30 am, because we were afraid it would be crowded. Apparently, this restaurant is popular, so we called to reserve a table beforehand. Overall, I think I'd come again, but I wouldn't order the pizza again; it was too ordinary. I should try other dishes instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pam VK

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dec. 2025, they moved to a new location, so I went again.
This time the restaurant is spacious with plenty of parking.
They've added several new menu items.

The pizza is just as delicious as before.

The restaurant has about 5 tables, so I recommend making a reservation if you plan to eat there.

We ordered the ham truffle pizza and chicken ribs.

Honestly, the food prices are quite high.
But the pizza is incredibly delicious! The crust is both crispy and soft.
The ham truffle topping is crispy, soft, and moist.
Eating it while it's hot, the first bite is amazing! I loved it!

They no longer have pasta on the menu.

There's limited parking in front of the restaurant, only about 4-5 cars.
sample_reviews_en.author: PAVINEE THAMMAPIMOL

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been a customer since the COVID period, but never actually visited the restaurant; I only ever ordered delivery. Today I finally got to eat there and I was surprised – the restaurant is huge and so crowded!

Of course, the truffle pizza is highly recommended, but it tastes even better when eaten at the restaurant. In fact, all the food was delicious.

I recommend calling ahead to reserve a table if you want one. We arrived early, finished our meal quickly, and when we walked out, the place was already packed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Phakwipha Kaewwisit

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ate pizza at this restaurant and I have to admit, it's really delicious. The flavor is just right, the crust is delicious, slightly crispy and soft. I loved it! 🍕😋

I ordered four things: pizza, spaghetti, Caesar salad, and mashed potatoes.
All the food was good. For dessert, I ordered yogurt ice cream, which was incredibly smooth.

I'm worried about gaining weight if I eat here often, but once I start, I can't stop!
I'll definitely be back! 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: Chubby Nan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pizza is delicious, Ronin style.
The Burrata was very good and tasty.
All three pasta dishes were well-made. The drunken noodles were excellent, with fresh ingredients, and the mashed potatoes were delicious.
The Tiramisu could be improved.
Regarding the large scale of the restaurant and the large number of customers, the service might not be as attentive at times, or the staff might be a bit tired, but the manager provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: TK KT

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The crust is thin, soft, and chewy, especially the edges. Dipping it in the accompanying dip is amazing.
- Ham Truffle topping: Very fragrant, not greasy, and the ham is of good quality and not overly salty.
- Margherita topping: Refreshing, with a tangy flavor from the tomatoes and a creamy, cheesy aroma.
- The restaurant has a relaxed atmosphere. I recommend making a reservation beforehand. The staff provides good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: G Green

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd tried their pizza once before and loved it, so I came back with my mom. We ordered a few other dishes and I have to say, everything was delicious. The rocket salad was refreshing, and the sausage was amazing. The pizza was incredible; even the crust was delicious. Parking was convenient and spacious. The atmosphere inside the restaurant was great; it felt upscale but not uncomfortable – warm and inviting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natapon Penchan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really like this place. It's my favorite pizza place and it's not too far from home; I can drive here easily. The 2-pizza promotion is great value, especially considering the quality. If you don't like thick crust, you won't be disappointed with this place. I absolutely love the truffle pizza; it's my absolute favorite! So flavorful and smooth.

I recommend calling to reserve a table beforehand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mudmee Boonchuayluar

restaurants.name: Maesriruen
restaurants.address:

41 Pradit Manutham Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mae Sri Ruen Convenience Store: Clean, complete, and good.
The food is delicious and very convenient.
The food is served quickly and of good quality.

The food is clean and tastes good. I like it.

The pork larb has a clean taste and isn't too spicy.
If you prefer a spicier taste, just let them know.

The fresh spring rolls with egg topping are delicious.
The filling is generous, and the sauce is tasty, a perfect balance of sweet, sour, and fragrant.

The chicken noodle soup is in a small bowl.
But it's sweet; they even put sugar in the bowl!
If you don't like it sweet, tell them not to add sugar.

The pork satay is delicious and tender.

Taste 🌟🌟🌟
Quality 🌟🌟🌟🌟
Service 🌟🌟🌟🌟
Cleanliness 🌟🌟🌟🌟
Convenience 🌟🌟🌟🌟
Price 🌟🌟🌟🌟

*☺️☺️* This is a personal opinion based on my preferences, tastes, experiences, biases, and quirks. I paid for the meal myself, so I'm giving an honest review and critique based on what I ate and experienced on the day I visited. I want to see feedback used for improvement, rather than anger, hatred, or curses. And I'd like to ask for forgiveness here and now, okay? ☺️😊**
sample_reviews_en.author: วันจันทร์ ที่ผ่านมา

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mae Sri Ruen Kitchen is already famous for its savory dishes, but their desserts are just as delicious as their savory food.
The desserts are made fresh right in front of the shop. The kanom krok (Thai coconut pudding) is as delicious as ever. They even have riceberry kanom krok here, which is best eaten hot. They also have small, bite-sized kanom bueang (Thai crepes). There's a wide variety of other desserts in the display case that you can order from the staff. However, the staff weren't very cheerful or smiling.

Price: 4/5
Quality: 5/5
Taste: 4/5
Cleanliness: 5/5
Speed: 4/5
Service: 3/5
Location: 5/5
Value for money: 4/5
sample_reviews_en.author: Akapatr Chiraarreebutr

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a typical Thai food place. They are well known for their chicken noodle. This is served either with soup or dried. Very small portion and not filling at all, but for the price of 65Baht, you can get a decent meal elsewhere. All the other menus we ordered were just okay. Sauces tasted too commercial and does not have that homey taste anymore. Atmosphere is just like any other regular Thai reataurants. Overall, still okay for a quick mediocre Thai food, but expect to pay more for less.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phadet Asai

sample_reviews_en.text: Mae Sri Ruen (Homepro Ekamai-Ramindra) located at the rightmost front of Homepro Ekamai-Ramindra home improvement store, was one of convenient Thai restaurants on Pradit Manutham Road. It offered several kinds of simple Thai dishes with standard tastes at moderate prices. Its original restaurant was on Lat Phrao several decades ago. It was a bit popular among Baby Boomers and Generation X guests due to its convenient location, variety of dishes, standard tastes and acceptable prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Itt Pamarapa

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste of the food is completely mismatched with the price. I've eaten at Michelin-starred Rungruang Noodles (Street Food), and compared to this, the broth tastes like tap water. The shredded chicken is thinly sliced ​​and just placed on top to make it look like there's a lot, not crispy at all, and oily.
Where is the quality? Where exactly? What time do they even serve it? Never again.
P.S. This restaurant has a 10% service charge + 7% VAT.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bilitis Somritsuk

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old noodle shop that I've been eating for a long time. Now it's easier to find, with branches in various shopping malls. My go-to order is the dry tom yum noodles with thin rice noodles; the seasoning is perfect, almost no need to add anything. However, the portion is a bit small; one bowl is almost not enough to fill me up. The pork satay is standard, and the kanom krok (Thai coconut pudding) is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Burassakorn Tajama
