sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes great. My favorite is the Tom Yum Chicken Noodle Soup; it's incredibly delicious. Every time I come to Mae Sri Ruen, I always order it. Almost all the other dishes are delicious. The Kanom Krok (Thai coconut pudding) is also tasty, especially when eaten hot. Overall, it's great. The service is also good; the staff are lovely and polite. This branch is located inside HomePro.
sample_reviews_en.author: ไอจะของจีน

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is tasty and meets standard expectations, but the portions feel very small. The Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) had very few pieces of meat, the herbal drink was packed with ice, and the green curry with rice noodles was in a tiny bowl.

The only thing that was absolutely delicious was the rice flour pancakes (Khanom Krok), which taste amazing at every branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: NY H

restaurants.name: Bollywood Spices - Indian Restaurant
restaurants.address:

S Pattaya Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Bollywood Spices Pattaya – Great for Indian Groups!Visited Bollywood Spices for a group lunch and was impressed by the massive hall with huge seating capacity – perfect for big groups or parties. They offer a self-service buffet that's straight forward and value-for-money, especially if you're craving familiar Indian flavors.The buffet lineup was solid: fresh salads, cooling raita and achar, hearty dal and chole, plain rice, a mix veg curry, tender chicken dish, and a sweet finish with pineapple halwa. Food was decent – not gourmet, but flavorful and consistent for the price. Self-service keeps things quick, though it can get crowded during peak hours. Recommended for families or groups seeking affordable Indian buffet vibes in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: BHUWAN TRIPATHI

sample_reviews_en.text: Just that u need to see where steps are from d sitting to go to get ur buffet i guess many sply old people fall and break their face n bones ...  that yellow color glowing light should be their. Was terrified to aunty's face after her fall...
sample_reviews_en.author: Deepa chhabda

sample_reviews_en.text: Stopped here after our visit at Coral Island. The food wasn't good at all. Barely ate a few things here. Need to work on the taste a lot. Won't recommend someone visiting here for some time unless the chef changes in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kuldeep Gera

sample_reviews_en.text: Food is so bland many items are there but the item served didnt  have the spices it's name depicts bollywood spices  hope indian cuisine is promoted in better way with good authentic cooking styles
sample_reviews_en.author: Brijesh Valsalan

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a below average restaurant, usually booked by the tour operators. They had very limited items and of below average taste. If you have no other options then one can choose this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shoban Babu

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was really tasty and matches my Indian taste buds. Buffet lunch was served to us and was good. Food can be rated 9/10 a minor flaws can be ignored but as a whole it was good
sample_reviews_en.author: Yash Saxena

sample_reviews_en.text: Clean simple dining room and food in the style of an Indian restaurant. We were there after an optional trip. So it tasted delicious. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Milan Leško

sample_reviews_en.text: Came here post coral island visit, it was complementry lunch from tour company...food was OK OK only...would not recommend anyone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Asheesh Vijay

restaurants.name: สเลญวน Slay Yuan ICONSIAM
restaurants.address:

ชั้น 5 ห้อง 515/1, ศูนย์การค้า ICON SIAM, เลขที่ 299 Charoen Nakhon 5 Alley, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
My partner had wanted to try this restaurant for a while. I was a little skeptable at first, but I was literary blown away at how good this is. From the moment we walked in, we were already greeted warmly by the friendly staffs and the amazingly beautiful decor really impressed me!

Ordered:
Thai spicy papaya salad
Vietnamese steam rice rolls with clear soup in hot pot
Grilled chicken wings
Nem hong served with herbs and rice paper

Every dishes was sooooo delicious! Vietnamese steam rice rolls with clear soup in hot pot is an absolute must order! The soup is so tasty with umami and is a great start to our meals!

Nem hong served with herbs and rice paper is delightfully well done! A work of art and yet tastes so great!

I will be back soon to try other dishes on the menu for sure!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Low

sample_reviews_en.text:
Salenyuan 🌿🍽️

This restaurant offers a perfect blend of Vietnamese and Northeastern Thai cuisine. Almost every dish we ordered was delicious; the flavors were bold yet easy to eat. There's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, ideal for sharing among a group.

The prices are on the higher side compared to typical Vietnamese restaurants, but they're standard for the iBerry chain. Overall, the food quality and atmosphere are excellent.

If you enjoy Vietnamese and Northeastern Thai food, this is definitely a restaurant you should try! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: nys

sample_reviews_en.text: We eat at the Iberry chain of restaurants very, very often. We've tried every single one, and the ones we frequent are mostly in the Icon Siam location. We love that the service and food taste consistently good every time we go. Some people say the prices are a bit high, but we don't eat there every day (we eat there every week!). It's definitely a restaurant we'd take guests from out of town to; the taste is consistently delicious and the quality never drops – no need to worry!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jintana Uarakolan

sample_reviews_en.text: The pho with beef was flavorful, and the papaya salad, spicy salad, and Vietnamese grilled pork skewers were all delicious without being too sweet, making them refreshing. The lighting in the restaurant was quite colorful, so the food photos came out a bit color-distorted.😅
sample_reviews_en.author: chicky jj

sample_reviews_en.text: Slay Yuan Isan Vietnamese Street is a new spot from Iberry Group that just opened, and it’s definitely worth checking out. The food is seriously good, the Thai-style decor is super aesthetic, and the prices are actually really fair. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: veeraphong jiraphanphong

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time trying Vietnamese spring rolls with rice paper wrappers that didn't need soaking. It was a little difficult to eat, but it had a unique charm. I liked the plain rice and the generous portion of fresh, delicious vegetables.
sample_reviews_en.author: TANAPORN K.

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the opportunity to eat here. I work across from Icon Siam, and at first, I didn't have high expectations for the taste, thinking it would be bland. Honestly, I came because I wanted to sit and enjoy the million-dollar view while …
sample_reviews_en.author: กิติภา สุ่มสมิง

sample_reviews_en.text: Really good place and good pho totally recommend for everyone. Super authentic. They are patient about everything. Good service. Reviewing to come back to it. But for westerners be careful about spiciness of the food. It’s really spicy
sample_reviews_en.author: Sofiia Sofiia

restaurants.name: Original Chula Hakka Noodle
restaurants.address:

1967 Banthat Thong Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the oldest noodle shops on Banthat Thong Road, located on a corner.
I never ate here when I was a student; this was my first time trying it.
Finding parking is difficult, sometimes easy, sometimes difficult.

There are a lot of Grab and Line Man delivery drivers; they're constantly coming and going.
There aren't many seats inside, and the food takes time because of the long queue. You write your order on a piece of paper and hand it in.

All the meatballs—fried, steamed, yellow tofu, pork, and shrimp—are delicious.
They have small round noodles and flat noodles; you should specify before ordering.
The clear soup is easy to eat.
The Tom Yum with chili paste is also good.
Overall, it's great, except the shop's atmosphere looks a bit cluttered.
sample_reviews_en.author: W. W.

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered food for home delivery through a food delivery platform. The restaurant made mistakes with both orders. When I reported it to the platform, an employee called and spoke rudely and emotionally, berating me and saying, "The restaurant didn't do anything wrong, you did it yourself. It's definitely not your fault... The food is expensive. Next time, if you can't eat it, call the restaurant and we'll replace it so we don't get penalized." They repeated this several times. It's a shame the food was delicious, but I probably won't order from them again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poonperm Vardhanabindu

sample_reviews_en.text:
I received an incomplete order. I called the landline number to report it, but no one answered.
So I called the next day because I had just found the restaurant's mobile number.

The person who answered spoke in a harsh tone and said it was "normal because the restaurant is by the road," and asked, "Why didn't you call yesterday?"

I've been a customer since 2009, but I don't think they'll get my money again.
Beware of this "never-complete" tone at the restaurant if you receive an incomplete order.

Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saruntorn K

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Hakka-style noodle soup with fish balls and the fully loaded Yen Ta Fo (pink noodle soup) came with everything you could want, including crispy squid balls and pork-stuffed tofu. I'd give it high marks for having so many toppings. It was fun to eat everything together. The flat noodles were also very good. If you don't like Yen Ta Fo, I recommend trying the fish ball noodles instead.
It's a shame I didn't order the spicy salad version; it looked delicious. I'll definitely stop by again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wipawee Sakulpanitjaroen

sample_reviews_en.text: "Chula Hakka Noodles (Original Shop)" has been selling for over 60 years. They make their own meatballs of all kinds, including pork meatballs, crispy meatballs, shrimp meatballs, white tofu, yellow tofu, fish meatballs, and fish cakes. In two words, they are all incredibly delicious! You definitely have to come here.
sample_reviews_en.author: toon Chanatip

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dry flat noodles with spicy dressing.

The noodles are chewy and the flavor is sweet from the chili paste.

All the meatballs are delicious.

The broth has a medium flavor and isn't too hot.

60 baht. Payment via bank transfer.

Opens early in the morning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teerapat Ungsriwong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I bought a bag of takeout for 50 baht.
The pork meatballs (not steamed) were 2.50 baht each, so 10 of them cost 25 baht, but they charged me 80 baht in total. So, are they charging me for steamed meatballs, or would they just charge me 5 baht extra?
sample_reviews_en.author: pamod mod

sample_reviews_en.text: I wasn't very impressed after trying the food (it was my first time). Even though there were customers walking in, they prioritized takeout orders over dine-in orders. If they were really busy, they should have stopped taking takeout orders …
sample_reviews_en.author: Wachara

restaurants.address:

sample_reviews_en.text:
After reading the reviews, I wanted to try this dish because I wanted to know which fish balls received a Michelin star.
You can park on the side of the road, following your friends, either on the left or right side. Look carefully. I came in the evening, not sure if anyone's ever had their wheels locked.
- Small dry noodles, made to make your own salad. The noodles were chewy and soft. There was no soup included. I ordered the fish ball version. The fish balls were delicious and bouncy, but they were delicious to the standard that fish balls can achieve. I wasn't impressed with the Michelin rating.
- Tom Yum fish noodles, the salad was light and you could add a little more. The fish maw was a bit salty. The fish balls were delicious, as mentioned above. The fish noodles were just so-so.

I came in the evening, so it was quite crowded. I ordered takeout and there was a long line. Overall, it was delicious and the price was acceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: attpocari

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️ Michelin-worthy 50 Baht Noodle Soup! Long queues, but worth the wait because it's genuinely good.

🍢 The shop has 3 branches located close together in the Bang Bon-Bang Khae area.
🥢 Regular 50 Baht, Special 60 Baht, Noodle Soup without noodles 60 Baht.
🍜 The wonton noodles are delicious, soft, but would be even more fun to chew if they were a little chewier.
🍢 The meatballs are all excellent, on par with the famous ones in Yaowarat.
🍜 The broth is rich and fragrant with soybean paste; just a little seasoning is enough to make it delicious.

Location📍Bang Khae Road, Nong Yai Intersection
⏰️ 4 PM - 9 PM
🚙 Street parking available at night.

🙏 Thank you all ♥️
for following!

YouTube 🎬 Paopao Studio
TikTok 🎙️ Paopao Studio
Wongnai 🍭 Paopao Studio

#StreetFood #EatBeforeBed #PaopaoStudio #BossFishBall
sample_reviews_en.author: Paopao Studio

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fishball Noodle Shop

Homemade fishballs

Various types of fishballs
Including fish balls, fish cakes, and fish dumplings.
I have to say, some shops in Yaowarat (Chinatown) could be ashamed.

Bouncy, chewy, and soft.
No fishy smell and no starchy feel.

The broth tastes good.
The noodles are also good.

The price is affordable.

No need to go to the famous shops in Yaowarat.
This shop is truly good, worthy of its Michelin Star.

There's a long queue, but the queue management is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khongwut Aries

sample_reviews_en.text: If you love fish balls, whether they're fish sticks or round balls, I highly recommend this restaurant. It's the most delicious I've ever had. The fish balls are chewy and crispy, the fried fish sticks are delicate, and the flat noodles are delicious. However, you might have to wait in line for a bit. If you're going to eat them or buy them to take home, I recommend adding the sour sauce with fish maw to enhance the flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chitapol Jiraratpisal

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious. Personally, I like the clear soup the most. The Tom Yum soup that's prepared with wide noodles is a bit cloudy and white. The Yen Ta Fo sauce is just okay. The meatballs are delicious. The fish dumplings are very good. I think this branch is more delicious than the one at Ekachai. You can stop by when you pass by. The noodles in the normal soup are delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: K GK

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible service. The process is slow; you have to wait. I called to order half an hour in advance, but they only started making it when I arrived. The male employee managing the queue was terrible and let me wait a long time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aunchu Beckaun

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, high quality, no need to season.
The soup is incredibly flavorful. I love it.
But there are only a few tables, so you have to wait.
Parking is a bit difficult.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanrada T.

sample_reviews_en.text: It's really delicious... The assistant may look a bit young, but that's just his appearance. In reality, he handles the work very well. He doesn't miss any orders.

sample_reviews_en.text: We visited Westwood Restaurant last night with my family and had a wonderful experience. The food was very delicious. The atmosphere is cozy and comfortable, The staff were very friendly and helpful, making sure we had everything we needed. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for good food and great service in a warm setting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattama Phaenklang

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely loved this place! The Thai food is full of flavor and beautifully presented. I was also pleasantly surprised by their sourdough pizza — the crust is perfectly crisp and tangy. Breakfast here is a treat too — fresh, hearty, and delicious. A great spot for any time of day. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamilla Orynbassarova

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pizza paradise! A stunning beautiful outdoor / indoor setting. Full Thai, western menu with services from a helpful, multi-lingual team.

My experience was both delicious and delightful. Will return to sample more of the menu.

Update.. a return visit March 2026.. same exceptional pizza!
sample_reviews_en.author: Stephen G

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food tasted alright. Salad was good.

We had some issues with communication on orders, they also missed one of our orders and was charged on the bill which I asked to have it corrected. Very polite, just lack of English fluency.

Venue is nice and quiet. May return for salad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Louie Parker

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered pizza and Thai food. The pizza was the worst I've ever had; the mushroom pizza was topped with huge chunks of king oyster mushroom and ham… the crust was also incredibly mediocre. The food looked completely different from the pictures. I highly discourage eating it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ting Qi

sample_reviews_en.text:
A cozy little restaurant surrounded by greenery 🌿

sample_reviews_en.author: Nay Thu Rain

sample_reviews_en.text:

The restaurant is a bit hidden away, but it's well worth eating here! 👍👍👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Sebastian K.

restaurants.address:

sample_reviews_en.text:
Khao Soi Lanna Happy Land

This hidden gem of a Northern Thai restaurant is located in the Happy Land village area of ​​Bang Kapi. The atmosphere is wonderful, like eating at a friend's or relative's house, as the owners run the place themselves. There are several private seating areas to choose from. It's a family-run business offering a wide variety of Northern Thai dishes, including Khanom Jeen Nam Ngiao (rice noodles with spicy pork broth), Khao Soi (Northern Thai curry noodle soup), Nam Prik Ong (spicy chili paste), Nam Prik Num (spicy green chili paste), Tam Khanun (spicy jackfruit salad), Gaeng Hung Lay (Northern Thai curry), Larb Nuea (Northern Thai minced meat salad), and Sai Ua (Northern Thai sausage). They truly have it all. Personally, I love their Khao Soi, and this place makes it exceptionally delicious – rich and flavorful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panjapon Khamsajja

sample_reviews_en.text:
8.5/10 The price is too low compared to the quantity. For a man, one bowl of Khao Soi is definitely not enough to fill him up (80).
Sai Ua (Northern Thai sausage) was very delicious, soft texture, not too strong smell, very good texture.
Khao Soi had a good taste, and they gave a lot of pickled vegetables.
My boyfriend liked the Nam Ngiao, it was easy to eat.
Nam Prik Num was spicy but flavorful.
The food came out slowly, but that's understandable. We arrived at 12:30 pm, and the elderly are doing everything themselves.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark K

sample_reviews_en.text: This Northern Thai restaurant is hidden away in a village, so parking can be a bit difficult. The atmosphere is very homey, run by a couple (please be patient if your food takes a while to arrive). We ordered Khanom Jeen Nam Ngiao (rice noodles with spicy pork broth), Sai Oua (Northern Thai sausage), Nam Prik Ong (Northern Thai chili paste), and fried chicken wings. Everything was delicious, but the Sai Oua was our favorite. It came with a side of vegetables. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: kratenkt

sample_reviews_en.text:

*If another restaurant surpasses this one in the future,
I will update this information again 😘

Taste and portion size ✅

The atmosphere is just like eating at a traditional Northern Thai restaurant run by your uncle and aunt ✅
🚙 Parking available on the sidewalk in the alley.
🛑 Closed every Monday.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chamq-.-p

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a restaurant with seating areas inside a house. It's located in a village, and you can find parking along the roadside. The owners, an elderly couple, are lovely. The beef Khao Soi is delicious; the beef is tender and not chewy. The Nam Prik Num (green chili dip) is flavorful. The fried chicken wings are amazing. The Larb Muang (Northern Thai minced meat salad) eaten with hot sticky rice is fantastic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Penluck Ruangrabeab

sample_reviews_en.text:
Northern Thai restaurant
Family-run business
Relaxing atmosphere at the end of the alley

sample_reviews_en.author: ร้านกาแฟนายกวง-光明

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a pleasant, shady atmosphere and serves delicious food. Every dish is great, from Khao Soi and Khanom Jeen Nam Ngiao to Nam Prik Ong, Nam Prik Num, Sai Ua, Larb Nuea, and Tam Khanun. The highlight is the hot, crispy fried chicken wings – highly recommended to eat them at the restaurant! The sticky rice is incredibly soft.
sample_reviews_en.author: putharin ph

sample_reviews_en.text: It was great to be able to sit and eat at the restaurant. sample_reviews_en.text:

you don't need to give those insincere reward cards in the first place.

sample_reviews_en.text: It's incredibly delicious! But this branch is quite crowded, both with customers in-store and online. There's a bit of a wait, so I recommend ordering in advance, doing something else, and then coming back later.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just found this hidden gem, their chicken rice was surprisingly good. I like their rice itself which is tender and aromatic. Their chilli spice also delicious ( not too spicy )

KH Guide & Rating :-

Accessibility   : 4/5 ( a bit hard to find parking but easily seen from the main road )
Cleanliness     : 4.5/5 ( toilet and kitchen area are also clean)
Ambience        :  3.5/5
Food quality    :  4.5/5
Price                 : 5/5 ( value and attractive )

To visit  again : yes

Returned to this chicken shop for many times since the first visit. This is strongly recommended one in Bangkok for economical chicken rice and yet delicious chicken rice ( both the rice and rice included the soup are delicious ). For this price range is hard to find especially this is no road side stall but in a comfortable shop lot, conveniently just 50m from  MRT station.
sample_reviews_en.author: HC_KH%

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is located right at the entrance of Soi Phawana. Parking can be difficult to find. There's plenty of seating, and the shop is spacious and airy, but it can be a bit confusing to navigate once you enter. You have to order at the front counter where the chicken is displayed. Most people prefer to sit inside the shop. Boiled chicken rice starts at 29 baht, fried chicken rice starts at 39 baht, and mixed chicken rice is 69 baht. I tried both the regular and jumbo sizes to compare; the difference in size is noticeable, but the portions are generous for 29 baht. The rice, chicken, and dipping sauce are all delicious. The rice is flavorful, and the chicken is juicy. Overall, it's very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffey

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice food place serving both locals and tourists. Convenently locate right next to the Exit of Phawana Station (MRT Yellow Line), the place specialize in chicken dishes (Hainan, fried, roast...) serving with white rice. The chicken was tender and juicy, althought it comes with a dipping sauce I would prefer eating the chicken meat on it own. The staff was super friendly, the cashier speak good English and all of them were sincerely nice toward foreigners like me. Pricing is typical for a local food vendor in thailand around 50-100 bath per dish, but the portion was generous. Definitely will return when visit Bangkok again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanh Phong Nguyễn Hữu

sample_reviews_en.text:
This chicken rice shop offers dishes starting at just 29 baht – an amazing price! The portion size is decent, the rice is fragrant and soft, and the chicken is juicy. It's a very filling and budget-friendly option. If you're worried about not being full, they also have a jumbo size.

First, order at the counter in front of the shop, then find a table. You'll need to help yourself to the dipping sauces, straws, and tissues.

The shop is located near Phawana Station. If you're driving, you can park in Soi Ladprao 37, but you might need to pray a bit for parking!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lilla

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste was mediocre. There was a lot of rice but very little chicken, even though I ordered the jumbo size. The rice grains were still hard.
There was no breast meat, only drumsticks and thighs.
The ordering process was confusing. The restaurant was empty, so they made people stand in line on the sidewalk to order at the counter.
A woman was already ordering, so I waited inside the restaurant. The staff kept shouting, "Order at the counter!"
I had to shout back, "I know! I'm ordering!!!"
The staff were rude and spoke poorly.
No more!!!

I randomly stopped here because I was craving chicken rice, and I’m so glad I did. The chicken was super tender and juicy, the rice had so much flavor, and the crispy skin on top was just perfect. Simple food, but done really well.
The place itself is relaxed and easygoing, nothing fancy — just good vibes and good food. Service was quick and friendly, and everything felt fresh.
Honestly, it’s the kind of spot you come for a quick meal and end up thinking about later. I’ll definitely be back.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Baan Mai Yentafo (Wooden House Yentafo)
A noodle and à la carte restaurant.
The yentafo (pink noodle soup) has a rather strong fermented tofu flavor.
Those who like it will say it's delicious.
Those who don't like it will say the smell is too strong.
The noodles and vegetables are perfectly cooked; the vegetables are crispy.
The toppings are very generous.
Including fish balls, round fish balls, fish cakes,
fish tofu, crispy squid, fried fish balls,
fried tofu, crispy wontons, and white mushrooms.
The portions are large and the prices are reasonable.
The highlight is the boiled wontons; they are incredibly delicious.
You don't need to add any seasoning because they are already flavorful.
If you want to come, come on over, but don't forget to order the boiled wontons!
There is no parking lot; park on the side of the road, but be careful not to get your car towed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piya Jirapapongpan

sample_reviews_en.text: The first time I ordered wonton noodle soup with Yen Ta Fo broth. The second time I ordered wonton Yen Ta Fo broth + steamed dumplings (the dipping sauce is different from other places), it was delicious. The Yen Ta Fo broth had plenty of toppings for the price, and the wontons were tightly packed. There are several noodle options to choose from, including Kiam Yee noodles. They also have non-Yen Ta Fo options.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nok Binkasan

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles are delicious, the meatballs are tasty, clean and high-quality. The Tom Yum noodle soup is very delicious, no need to add any extra seasoning. They also have a variety of à la carte dishes. The restaurant has been open for many years and has maintained the same quality; it has never changed.
sample_reviews_en.author: ฮายารี บินซูฟอย

sample_reviews_en.text:
Highly recommend for those looking for Thai Halal food. I tried the wonton and Yentafo noodles, both great choices and tasty. The restaurant is clean.

(Highly recommend for anyone passing through this area and looking for a clean, home-like Halal restaurant.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Haseem Kodae

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a really tasty and delicious Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup), especially the boiled wontons with dipping sauce – the dipping sauce is fantastic! Add some gravy noodles with the boiled wontons, and you'll say it's truly amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanagorn Suthipong

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered through a delivery app, but they suddenly canceled the order without calling to inform me beforehand. I wouldn't mind if they had called to explain the reason, but this is really rude.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pavarisa

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles are delicious and reasonably priced. If you come during peak hours, you might have to wait for a table for a bit. They serve both noodles and other à la carte dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aom Yampol

sample_reviews_en.text:
The noodles are delicious, and the à la carte dishes are also tasty.
The prices are moderate, and the food is prepared quickly, so you don't have to wait long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr. Nattkorn Sawachaipoun

restaurants.name: เช็งซิมอี๊ แป้งกลมอารมณ์ดี ตรอกโรงหมู
restaurants.address:

1455 Khao Lam Rd, Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cheng Sim Yee
Good Mood Round Flour Dessert, Trok Rong Mu (Pig's Alley)
A legendary 70-year-old traditional shaved ice dessert shop, nổi bật with its uniquely chewy and sticky "round flour noodles" (flat bok kia). Importantly, it's the original, only one branch, not a franchise like many others.

Lunchtime (12:30 - 16:30): Located in a shophouse inside Soi Trok Sukorn 1 (Trok Rong Mu), next to Si Morakot Roast Pork Rice shop, opposite Trok Rong Mu Noodle shop. Comfortable seating available.
Evening-Night (17:30 - 21:30): They move their cart to sell as street food on Khao Lam Road, opposite Tang Chua Lee Fish Head Restaurant. It's recommended to go when they start setting up because it gets crowded. Must-try menu items start at around 25-40 baht, with over 20 toppings to choose from, using their special syrups: longan syrup, coconut milk, and palm sugar. (Cheng Sim Yee): Chewy white, round rice flour sheets, a unique recipe from the Coconut Milk Shop: chewy, creamy, and subtly sweet, served with fresh coconut milk. Lotus Root/Lotus Seeds: Large, crispy, and perfectly cooked. Longan Syrup Dessert Set: A popular menu item, refreshing and sweet, perfect for cooling down.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything on the menu is delicious!
Starting with the Cheng Sim Yee (a type of Thai dessert):
The round rice flour dumplings are amazing, chewy and soft.
The Chinese dates are crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, and perfectly sweet.
The job's tears/barley are fragrant, nutty, and soft to the touch.
The lotus root is chewy, not hard, and sweet and fragrant.
The longan juice isn't too sweet (I wanted to stick a straw in it!).

The coconut milk is fragrant and creamy.
The crispy water chestnut is the best!
The dough is soft and chewy, and the water chestnuts are crunchy and delicious.
The individual water chestnuts are lightly boiled/candied, soft on the outside but still crunchy.
The black sticky rice and the triangular sticky rice are also incredibly delicious.

I've tried 4-5 different dishes so far,
and haven't found a single one that wasn't delicious! 🤣

Google says they open at 4 PM,
but it's better to go around 5:30-6 PM.
Some days they open late.
Some days you can't park on the street because it's still early in the day.

Usually, you can park on both sides of the street.
Just don't block the alley or the bus stop.
sample_reviews_en.author: MyBlooD MJ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cheng Sim Yee, Happy Round Rice Dumplings, Trok Rong Mu (Pork Alley)
We waited in line for the evening to get the cart and set up the table, but there were tons of fans waiting. They started serving around 6 PM, but the exact time may vary depending on the day. They have a variety of dishes, from Cheng Sim Yee to the shop's highlight: Happy Round Rice Dumplings, freshly boiled right next to the cart. They have a chewy texture, thin and delicious. We even ordered extra chewy dumplings! The prices are very friendly, 30-40 baht, or you can customize your order with unlimited choices. Feel free to try whatever you like! It's truly delicious, highly recommended. It's definitely worth the wait. (You can eat savory food nearby while you wait, then come for dessert at this shop.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Sudawan C.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I had the opportunity to try the crispy water chestnut dessert with coconut milk, and it was delicious! Fragrant and perfectly sweet.
I waited in line for a very long time, but I was willing to wait because my boyfriend really wanted to try it. I have to admit, the wait was very long, but the young man in the red bow managed the tables and the queue well. He was very clear in his speech (telling us to wait) and organized the queue efficiently. We ate the crispy water chestnut dessert with coconut milk and the coconut milk sago dessert, which were both delicious and worth the wait. While waiting, he kept walking around and chatting with us to keep us entertained. I will definitely go back again.
P.S. I told the staff this ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: eiei èi

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered a special longan jelly dessert and coconut milk cendol.
Most items are priced between 30-40 baht.
Free tea is available.
You can choose from the shop's menu or customize your order.

The staff are friendly and provide good service.
I ordered a 40 baht item and added sago pudding, and they charged the original price.

The longan jelly dessert was refreshing, and all the toppings were delicious.

The cendol had fragrant and delicious coconut milk, not overly sweet. All the toppings were tasty.

If I'm ever in the area again, I'll definitely stop by. If you haven't tried it, give it a try! It's cheap and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: TNPFAR

sample_reviews_en.text: This old-style shaved ice shop is located in Sukorn Alley. It has no branches. I visited during lunchtime and didn't have to wait long. They have a wide variety of toppings to choose from, all looking fresh and appetizing. I ordered the water chestnut jelly, candied lotus root, and coconut milk shaved ice. The water chestnut jelly was crispy and the tapioca pearls were thin and delicious. The candied lotus root and coconut milk shaved ice were also excellent. I loved it! It was refreshing and reasonably priced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Koy Koya

sample_reviews_en.text:
The crispy water chestnut dessert is delicious, especially with the coconut milk. There's a bit of a wait, but it's worth it.

It was very crowded, but a young man helped find a table. He was very loud and clear in his speech. I liked both the dessert and the service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eiei Ei

sample_reviews_en.text: The place is easy to find and convenient to travel to by public transport. The desserts are delicious and sweet, and the prices are reasonable. There are tables to sit and eat, and the service is good and friendly. Sweet tooth lovers should definitely try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: chai Jomphon

restaurants.name: Jae Kai Isan food
restaurants.address:

163 20 Phaya Thai Rd, Khwaeng Thung Phaya Thai, ทุ่งพญาไท Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: This is a truly hidden gem, serving authentic Northeastern Thai food – No. 1 in flavor. The food is incredibly delicious, and the owner is 100% Northeastern Thai. The papaya salad (ตำซั่ว) and the fermented fish sauce are amazing. The seafood corn salad is incredible, and the stir-fried noodles with soy sauce are unlike anything I've ever tasted – a must-order! Even the simple fried rice is delicious. The prices are great. I was starving after getting off the BTS at Phaya Thai station and saw this place, so I went in. They had a lot of customers, both Thai and foreigners, and the staff provided excellent service. I'm amazed at how hard it is to find such a delicious Northeastern Thai restaurant!
sample_reviews_th.author: one day

sample_reviews_en.text: Although this was my second time in Thailand, this was the most authentic and down-to-earth roadside restaurant I've ever eaten at. While the shop itself is unassuming, even resembling a hole-in-the-wall restaurant in Chengdu, the seating arrangement is neat and clean, and the staff are incredibly efficient at taking orders, serving food, paying, and clearing away plates. Even during peak hours, when the place is packed, it doesn't feel chaotic. Furthermore, the shop is right next to the Phaya Thai train station, with local slow trains stopping and passing through almost every hour. If you're lucky, you can even experience a "Train Market" atmosphere while you dine. As for the food, needless to say, just look at the pictures. And the prices are very reasonable, definitely worth eating there every day. However, the prerequisite is that you like Northern Thai flavors. If you can handle spicy food, then you absolutely shouldn't miss it. We ordered five dishes, a beer, and a water, and it only cost us less than 14 euros. I doubt you could find many similar places even after eating your way through Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ying Zhang

sample_reviews_en.text:
July 2025, was here for dinner for two. It is conveniently  located between  the CP tower 7-11 and the SRT Phaya Thai railway tracks'  embarkation/disembarkation point. Next to the Phaya Thai APL / BTS station. A truly authentic local thai alfresco dining experience with good food at reasonable prices with friendly, courteous, and diligent service staff. We ordered the grilled pork neck, stir fried lamb stomach, grilled blood cockles, pork fried rice and stir fried morning glory (water convolvulus).
Grilled pork neck - sufficiently flavourful and tender with good spicy dipping sauce.
Stir fried lamb stomach - flavourful with thai basil with al dente texture.
Grilled blood cockles - plump and fresh with a good spicy dipping sauce.
Pork fried rice - flavourful with generous amounts of tender pork slices.
Overall it was a satisfying dining experience. I will certainly be back here to try their other menu items on my return to Bangkok soon.
FYI this location is popular and  open in the mornings selling takeaway  breakfast fare for commuters on the way to work or school.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rajen Arasu

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the perfect som tam (papaya salad)!
The fermented fish is incredibly delicious, you have to roll a ball of sticky rice to dip it in. It's so spicy!!!
The cucumber salad (papaya salad) has a base flavor similar to fermented fish salad (pla ra) = delicious.
The minced pork salad (larb moo) has the perfect balance of flavors = delicious.
The glass noodle salad (yam woon sen) may look bland, but the flavor is top-notch. All the flavors are well-balanced, not too sour.
The boiled dishes are also easy to slurp down, with just the right amount of flavor.
The fried chicken is so delicious you don't even need dipping sauce.
The instant noodle salad (yam mama) has bouncy noodles and the flavor of the salad is excellent.
The chicken tendons are fried perfectly, crunchy, and don't need dipping sauce.

This restaurant is one of my favorites.
sample_reviews_en.author: MonKao GoAround

sample_reviews_en.text: Zero service plus they kept missing dishes. We ordered a hot pot, and then the pre-cut side dishes didn't arrive forty minutes! When we asked, they said they'd forgotten again. We ordered four dishes, and three were missing – we only found out ourselves! It was awful. We had to ask to find out they'd forgotten, and they kept apologizing. The food was slow to arrive, and the place was incredibly chaotic and understaffed. The food tasted good, but the wait was too long 😭 They even missed the pork neck meat, hastily cutting it and just throwing it haphazardly onto a plate. It was also very hot. If you have time and patience, you can go, but if you're in a hurry, I advise against it. There are no chairs while waiting; you have to stand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Monica

sample_reviews_en.text: I come to Bangkok every year. This time, I was pleasantly surprised to discover this little shop. The female staff member speaks some Chinese, and the male staff member is gentle and patient. The food is authentic. I've tried many Michelin-starred restaurants in Bangkok, but few have this lively, down-to-earth atmosphere. Watching the trains rumble by, sitting by the tracks in my spare time, smoking a cigarette, and chatting with the people next to me—this was the best experience of my trip to Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Justin C

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really great restaurant, delicious food, proper local vibe and nice service! I recommend 100% The bbq meat was delicious, the papaya clams salad a killer (the clams were so fresh and they were really kind to make it a tiny bit less spicy for me as well). Don’t think twice and go!
Also if you’re scared of the heat + the seating being outdoor: fear not, they have covered the restaurant with fans so you will always have one blowing on you at some point.
sample_reviews_en.author: Magali B

sample_reviews_en.text: What a great meal. Came here for a late night authentic Thai food meal and we were very surprised. The food was too good. The grilled prawns were fantastic and the seafood tum yum soon was amazing. The food was fantastic. The food came fresh and quick and the staff was extremely helpful and friendly. Overall had an amazing experience. Will definitely be back .
sample_reviews_en.author: Ali Sajan

restaurants.name: ยัมมี่ แหนมเนือง ปั้มบางจากพระราม2
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 8/4 ห้อง A07 แสมดำ Samae Dam, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Everything was delicious, especially the Vietnamese spring rolls (แหนมเนือง), papaya salad (ส้มตำ), and the dipping sauce – absolutely amazing! The fresh vegetables were clean and delicious. I loved it and will definitely go back again. The service was also great.
sample_reviews_th.author: Patinya Pakdi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Vietnamese and Northeastern Thai food, a good combination.
The restaurant is air-conditioned, comfortable, and doesn't have many tables.
The staff are polite and provide good service.
The food was served quite quickly, completely and correctly.
The Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage) had a delicious dipping sauce, complete with all the ingredients, and the fresh vegetables were straight from the refrigerator, very refreshing. The Nem Nuong itself was sliced ​​a bit too small.
The fried chicken wings were very well fried, crispy and delicious.
The spicy pork sausage salad was a bit sweet.
The prices are standard, considering the quality of the ingredients.
Other dishes were also good. The papaya salad with crab and 3 chilies was so spicy it made my mouth burn!
I'll come back to try other dishes.
-:-:-:-:-:-:-:-
Parking is available in the gas station and in front of the restaurant, very convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nana Relax

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Nem Nuong from the famous Daeng restaurant had a dipping sauce that was a bit too sweet. The Nem Nuong itself was okay, but quite expensive.

Other dishes were also on the sweet side, such as the spicy pork sausage salad.

The Pho broth was a bit bland and needed a lot of seasoning to be palatable. It wasn't oily or too sweet, and the noodles and ingredients were decent.

The mushroom dumplings (I can't remember the exact name) were fragrant and okay.

The fresh vegetables were prepared and kept chilled, so they were crispy. Additional vegetables cost 30 baht each.

Overall, the prices were high, especially the Nem Nuong, which came to over 800 baht. Many dishes were on the sweet side.

Parking at the gas station was difficult; I circled around and couldn't find a spot, which was very frustrating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chess Pisit

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Thai papaya salad was incredibly delicious, the best I've ever had in my life. Unfortunately, I ordered it less spicy but it was very spicy 🥺 But I persevered because it was so delicious and fragrant. I don't know what it was, but the papaya salad had an amazing aroma!
Everything I ordered was delicious too.

The service was great. The staff were smiling and welcoming to every table. I hope the owner takes good care of them because they seemed very dedicated to their work and not just playing around like in other restaurants 😊😊

I also ordered chicken pho, but forgot to take a picture 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuntharat S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a set of Vietnamese spring rolls from "Daeng Naem Nueang." I bought it to take home in the evening. My mom already ate some.
This is what I ate next.
I bought the small set to take home, a whole box for 375 baht, ready to eat. The small set has 4 skewers of pork / there are four of us in our family.

There are two sizes to take home, the other size is probably 6xx baht / 8 skewers of pork.
They are already sliced ​​and individually wrapped, looking nice.
Parking is limited.
I'm eating it now. If it's good, I'll definitely buy it again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Im migrant

sample_reviews_en.text: Today was my second time eating Vietnamese food at this restaurant. It's delicious, clean, the food is tasty, and the prices are reasonable. The staff provides excellent service, the atmosphere is clean, and the food arrives quickly. Most importantly, I loved the Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage) and the Som Tum (papaya salad) – it was perfectly seasoned. I give it a 10/10/10 rating! ⭐️⭐️⭐️🇻🇳✨👍🥗
sample_reviews_en.author: ณพรรษสร เงินธัญทรัพย์

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, I especially love the Vietnamese grilled pork sausage (Nem Nuong). The service is good, the restaurant looks clean, and the prices are reasonable. I've eaten here many times and finally had the chance to meet the owner. After talking to them, I could tell they truly love and are dedicated to making delicious food to satisfy their customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: ct t

sample_reviews_en.text: A large bowl of pork pho is 120 baht. The aroma of fresh herbs and vegetables is wonderful; it's delicious and I order it every time. The rice crackers and pork sausage salad are also tasty, the vegetables look fresh and clean. The longan juice is sweet and fragrant. The restaurant is quite small; I wish they offered delivery.
sample_reviews_en.author: Petra Ariya

restaurants.name: FlowerCafe144
restaurants.address:

144 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
An atmospheric establishment. The walls are covered with messages from guests from all over the world—you feel like your paths are crossing.

The food is delicious, the portions are huge. You can tell they really care about their guests.

But be prepared that this isn't a "European" establishment. And there are some unique features, such as a very "lived-in" restroom.

If you're prepared for this not being a sleek Western restaurant, but a truly vibrant Thai establishment, then definitely come for the delicious food and hospitality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arina Mudrenova

sample_reviews_en.text: Best Thaifood we had in Bangkok!! And the owners were extremely nice, the restaurant so pretty and the atmosphere is special! We can 100% recommend this place! And please, show the respect they earn! A young woman came in, talking loudly with a friend via videochat -  also while ordering and eating. That is not only annoying for other guests, but also shows no respect for the people offering this lovely atmosphere and amazing food!
sample_reviews_en.author: Coco Schuh

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stopped here for lunch. The Thai food was delicious. Even my girlfriend, who doesn't like Thai food, loved the fried rice!
There was pleasant music, and while you waited for your food, you could leave a drawing on the wall as a souvenir. At 4:00 PM, there were no other customers inside. There wasn't much seating inside, just four tables.
A cozy, quiet cafe with delicious Thai food!!! I highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Кеша Муравьев

sample_reviews_en.text:
🥰🥰🥰 I stumbled upon this restaurant by chance and it turns out to be a gem. I ate very well and was very warmly welcomed in a cozy and charming place.

I stumbled upon this restaurant by chance and it turns out to be a real gem. I ate very well and was very warmly welcomed in a cozy and charming place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Samira Bien1

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner is very kind. We ordered sticky rice with mango and the owner gave us extra mango! (The sticky rice was very soft and delicious, and the mango was also very sweet and delicious). Overall, 10/10. The stir-fried noodles with chicken were also very generous in portion and absolutely delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prakaiyok _

sample_reviews_en.text: We had dinner at Flower Cafe in Bangkok and absolutely loved it. The food was incredibly authentic – honestly the best meal we had during our time in Bangkok. The owner was so kind and a perfect host, making us feel really welcome. We would come back anytime and highly recommend this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Eliane Huonder

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop front is beautifully decorated in a traditional Thai style. The restaurant is comfortable and family-friendly, the food is delicious, and the fresh fruit drinks are great. The mango sticky rice is especially amazing! And don't forget to write on the wall!
sample_reviews_en.author: Malee Pimnara

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very nice cafe. While we were waiting for our food, they brought us markers to draw on the wall.
Drinks were served in beautiful glasses decorated with fresh flowers.
The cafe has a pleasant atmosphere, air conditioning, and vintage jazz playing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kate Volchihina

restaurants.name: Café Amazon
restaurants.address:

999 Kamphaeng Phet 2 Rd, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cafe Amazon is a very popular cafe chain in Thailand. There are many branches, many of which could be found within large petrol station stops. Cafe Amazon provide similar food and drinks like Starbucks and Coffee Bean but at half the price.

Images show menu and pricing of coffee and tea in Cafe Amazon I took as of May 2024

Aside from selling purely coffee or tea, there are also smoothies, chocolate and milk for those non caffeine addicts out there.
Aside from just drinks, the outlets do stock up additional items like cakes, muffins, sandwiches, brownies and biscuits. But then again, some outlets would have more stock while some, with limited choices. Their outlets usually close early- between 7pm to 8pm depending on area and the store. So if you arrive too late while at highways, well, you would need to be contented with the take away coffee from 7 Eleven. ☕️☕️☕️
sample_reviews_en.author: Lê Nguyễn Trâm Anh

sample_reviews_en.text:
My favorite cafe in Bangkok. Yum!
———— EN
I tend to avoid chain stores when it comes to coffee (although my love for Starbucks lasted a long time) and choose smaller, authentic cafes. Amazon won me over :) These coffees are truly delicious! I recommend them.
Every single one, and it would be hard to pinpoint one specific and best.
Some places reminded me of the Amazon jungle :) The staff, although rarely speaking English, were always smiling and friendly!
The only thing I don't like is the packaging of everything in plastic bags (literally, plastic wrapped in plastic with plastic), but that's a general problem in this part of the world, not this particular cafe.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kinga K. (ninisiaq)

sample_reviews_en.text: There are no mobile phone charging plugs like other Amazon outlets. They are located outside the building. If you walk out of the passenger terminal, turn to the right until you see a green-roofed walkway. You can order less sweet and get the normal sweet. The staff are rude and make faces like they are dissatisfied all the time. They only pressed the wrong number once and acted like we did something wrong. The small number of tables are dirty. The surrounding view is dirty with standing water. And finally, if you have a suitcase, you have to lift it up and down the road. There is no ramp. It's terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Xe Rin

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff had unwelcoming expressions 🙄. They spoke politely, but their demeanor and facial expressions were not acceptable. The staff needs training; service work requires a cheerful and smiling attitude. I initially encountered a male staff member who was unpleasant, but then I met a female staff member whose expression was so unapproachable – you shouldn't be working in customer service.
sample_reviews_en.author: กัลยวรรธน์ พันใจธรรม

sample_reviews_en.text: TERRIBLY BAD EXPERIENCE I ASK BIT MORE MILK  IN TO MY LATTE COUSE TOO STRONG FOR ME AND I ALSO I DO TRANSLATION IN GOOGLE THEY LOOK LOOK EACH OTHER'S AND DONT PUT A BIT MILK IN TO MY COFFEE  AND I LEAVE MY COFFEE THERE I PAY 65 BAHT FOR NOTHING ( THAT STAFF THERE OUT OF COMMENT SO BAD NOT GOOD FOR AMAZON COFFEE )
sample_reviews_en.author: Mladen Angelov

sample_reviews_en.text: This coffee shop is near the exit for Mo Chit 2. While the shop is compact, it's comfortable and not stuffy. I stopped in and sat down. Wow, the air conditioning is nice and cool. The staff aren't very pretty, but they're cheerful and bright. The taste is the same standard as any Amazon branch, and it's okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitipon Promjabok

sample_reviews_en.text: Since arriving here, I've felt happy. At first, there might have been some confusion because my wife brought me to live with her sister without having to pay for accommodation, and I also got a job. From the first day until now, my wife and I have been happy all along.
sample_reviews_en.author: อดิศักดิ์ เจริญสุข

sample_reviews_en.text: I love this chain of coffee shops. There is nothing like bing surrounded by tropical plants while drinking your coffee. I wish they had more breakfast options though. It is mostly sweet stuff but sometimes you just want a small sandwich for breakfast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrea

restaurants.name: Mr. Bao MALATANG @Century อนุสาวรีย์ชัยฯ มิสเตอร์เป้า หมาล่าทั่ง 麻辣烫 麻辣香锅
restaurants.address:

Century the movie plaza เลขที่ 15 ชั้น B ห้อง D003, D006, C001-C003 Phaya Thai Rd, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Mr. Bao MALATANG
My favorite Mala Tang restaurant! Only 35฿ per portion! Every dish is delicious. The broth is fragrant and rich, the ingredients are clean and tasty. The staff provides excellent service. Love it! ♥️🥰🍜

📍Century Branch, Victory Monument
⏱️ OPEN: 10 AM - 8:30 PM

#MalaTang #malalovers
#DeliciousRecommendation #MalaTang
#mrbaomalatang
sample_reviews_th.author: Ploypailin Pathinthanapon

sample_reviews_en.text: The spicy mala dry noodles are delicious, with a rich and flavorful stir-fry. You can choose your spice level. I like that it's not too numbing. You can pick and weigh your own ingredients; it's 35 baht per 100 grams, plus 10 baht for dipping sauce. There's seating available and a self-service drink dispenser. They have a promotion where you get a free drink if you leave a Google review. I eat there every week; it's conveniently located in the mall with parking available in the basement. I'm hooked and can order takeout as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawarin Punyawajee

sample_reviews_en.text: Mala Tang at Century Mall costs 35 baht per 100 grams, but some ingredients are priced separately and not included in the 35 baht per 100 gram price. The taste is decent, with a dominant spiciness. The ingredients are clean, but personally, I feel that the pork belly should be sold by the gram rather than in bags and then in sets. When I was scooping, I thought there wouldn't be much, but it weighed 600 grams!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaisiri Sanjai

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an honest review: I've never had mala like this before, this was my first time trying it. The staff recommended that for those who haven't tried it before, I should try the soup version first because it's easier to eat 🤩 And the best part is that you can choose your spice level 😍 Even people who don't like spicy food can eat it, that's really great! There are 4-5 menu options to choose from 😽
sample_reviews_en.author: Duangkmonloeda Srisuda

sample_reviews_en.text: $35 per 100g food. Get the food you like, include various types of meat, veggie, fish ball, basically all hot pot items. Pay according to your weight.  Soup can choose different level of spiciness.  Taste is ok, but need to mind taking too much. Otherwise going to other all you can eat will be more cost effective. My bowl 🥣 cost 189.87 include vat 7 %
sample_reviews_en.author: Hung cw

sample_reviews_en.text: The ingredients are fresh, clean, and varied. The black shabu-shabu broth (add 10 baht) is fragrant and flavorful, priced at 35 baht per portion. The staff are friendly and provide good service. It might get crowded during lunchtime, leading to a longer wait for food. I suggest lowering the music volume in the restaurant a bit.
sample_reviews_en.author: เด็กแว่น

sample_reviews_en.text: Interesting experience of choosing the ingredients of my noodle soup. Pity the instructions in English are a bit scarce, otherwise more foreigners could enjoy it. I like that you can choose the level of spiciness. A generous bowl of noodles with chicken, vegetables and mushrooms  cost me 160 Baht paid with Visa card.
sample_reviews_en.author: L V (Traveler)

sample_reviews_en.text: They offer a wide variety of ingredients, you can choose the spiciness level of the soup base, and there are several dipping sauce recipes to choose from. Overall, it's delicious and the price is reasonable. I wish they would increase the number of tables to accommodate more customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: กมลพักตร์ คู่ปิตุภูมิ

restaurants.name: CHANN | Bangkok-Noi
restaurants.address:

30/1 Soi Somdej Pra Pinklaow 1(Behind Wat Dusidharam, 27 Borommaratchachonnani Rd, Arun Amarin, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We stayed in this hotel because Conde Nast recommended it. Lovely boutique hotel with a beautiful view of the river, but it's really difficult to get to. You have to park at least 5-10 minutes away, and walk by foot through the small alleys with street dogs littered about. Also, just a few metres along the small street right before you get to the hotel, there is an empty lot filled with STILL sewage water boarded up using rusty metal - a potential health hazard and not the best experience!! I wish the hotel would offer free boat transfers to and fro, which will make the experience A LOT more pleasant. The rooms are not soundproof, so you can hear other guests walking about/opening and closing doors, etc. The hotel is beautiful, but we'll only come back to stay if they're able to improve on the experience getting to/from the hotel.
sample_reviews_en.author: S Go

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stay 2 nights and totally regret it.
The location by the canal sounds nice. BUT please keep in mind that the noise from the canal is no joke. You hardly sleep quitely from the boat ride very late at night and very early in the morning.
The reception staff was ok. They tried to help what they could, but I think they were short of staff, see only a couple of people running the place.
In short- nothing impressive, not a relaxing stay, and the food not a worth bib gourmet.. no need to come and try anything.
Ps. We paid more expensive than the current price because we moved the booking from late April to late July. I paid 12xxx baht, but at the reception desk, I saw it reduced to 8xxx baht now. Make sure you got a bargain if after reading my review and you still want to try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Beau Palida

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best experience we had here was the Thai dessert and the apple tart.  They were very well decorated and delicious.  The river view was very nice and i like the wooden balcony by the canal that customers can enjoy the view and relax.
Car parking is far away at the temple, and the walking alley was complicated and a bit unsecured.
The worst thing I experienced here was the drinks.  Hot Americano, the quality and the size was disappointed.  Another disappointed drink was ice Mocha, milk was added too much, that wasn’t a good balance and not enjoyable at all.
In conclusion, I don’t recommend this place for a coffee lovers, but this is good for photographers who are looking for a river view scene with a nice wooden house.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gunn Polparsi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The perfect little getaway from the regular Bangkok hotel scene. It's out of the way, somewhat inaccessible from the rest of the city, but the isolation is perfect if that's what you're looking for. It's hard getting around so this isn't the place you want if you're exploring the city. This is where you go for some reprieve.

WiFi can be intermittent so it may not be ideal for work travelers.

Don't get a room facing the river -- it's a working river so as charming as that sounds, it's incredibly noisy.

Food is good -- which matters because there isn't anywhere else to eat around here.

Most importantly, the staff are fantastic. They will go out of their way for you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alan Soon

sample_reviews_en.text:
The hotel itself is nice and the room is nice but the location is terrible and the area stinks unbelievably bad. I had booked the hotel for two nights but after the first night I had to book somewhere else and leave.

The room I stayed in had a view to the canal whilst I was sleeping you could literally hear everything going on in the hotel and I hardly slept and neither did my wife.

There's a small single track not even wide enough for a car to get to and from the hotel and it's a 5-10 min walk to get a taxi and there's 0 shops around.

The location is basically in the slums of Bangkok and it's not a nice place to be in. I would recommend anyone to think twice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Niall Maguire

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lovely small hotel a the junction of the Chao Phraya river & the Bangkok Klong.
Thai style room with everything you need, a reasonable size & very comfortable. Great dinner in the restaurant on our one evening there and super breakfast.
River is always noisy from early morning so back garden rooms are best.
Very convenient for the Royal Barges museum and the Bangkok Thonburi Station (to Kanchanaburi).
Other reviews have marked down the location but I would suggest they haven't done  their research. This hotel is not convenient to the centre of Bangkok (MBK, SkyTrain etc) but very convenient for the River Taxis covering access to the Royal Palace, Wat Arun etc.
sample_reviews_en.author: Debra Holmes

sample_reviews_en.text: The hotel is well put together with luxury design and décor. The room was comfortable, clean, and spacious. We opted to stay at the hotel for dinner because the local area does not seem inviting for foreign travelers. The hotel restaurant was very nice but out of many menu items. While we enjoyed our time at the hotel, I would only recommend it to those who are not interested in touring Bangkok during their stay. It might be perfect for travelers looking to stay strictly at the hotel for relaxing. Be cautious as to not arrive after dark because you will have to walk through a neighborhood alley to reach the hotel. I highly recommend the in-room massage.
sample_reviews_en.author: Melissa R

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a little difficult getting to this place as it's tucked away down a long alley so you'll have to park far away and walk to it. Best to call ahead and have staff meet you at the parking lot, which is off site next to the nearby temple. They also carried our luggage for us, which was nice since it was a couple minutes walk to get it, but the riverfront location and very nice setting makes it worth the trouble. The rooms are beautiful and modern.

You can take a boat directly from the hotel to anywhere on the Chao Praya River. The breakfast was a little disappointing, but I really miss this hotel and I cannot wait to visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Austin Nicol

restaurants.name: ร้านมันส์กุ้ง​ เบียร์การ์เด้น
restaurants.address:

20​ ซอยประดิษฐ์มนูธรรม25​ Pradit Manutham Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food and dishes tasted very good; many items were delicious. However, the downside is that we ordered a lot of food, but it didn't all arrive. The food came out very slowly, and some items were missing, like they were being held back. We waited a very long time. We reordered, added more items, but the dishes we initially ordered still didn't come. Some items were ordered 2-3 times and still didn't arrive, to the point where we didn't eat anymore.

I would like them to improve their order taking system a little, because waiting for so long is frustrating.
sample_reviews_en.author: krapalm krapalm

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the buffet, but they kept the food waiting for two hours, and it still didn't arrive. I absolutely do not recommend this place. The worst part is I can't give it 0 stars. If you're interested in this restaurant, I recommend going to another one. There are many better options. Based on my experience, it's impossible for this restaurant to get more than four stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pacman Chai

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is very sweet, especially for those who don't like sweet food. The atmosphere inside the restaurant is okay because it's spacious and there's live music, but there are a lot of mosquitoes. Even sitting inside, the mosquitoes kept biting me.
sample_reviews_en.author: Papangki Dada (아이)

sample_reviews_en.text: The band needs improvement; their singing wasn't very good, and the sound system was too loud—sitting close to the stage, it was like the speakers were breaking. The food prices and taste were reasonable and delicious. The atmosphere was nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wara Korn

sample_reviews_en.text: Its yummy! And its not really crowded but nothing special just regular dine in restaurants. We can listen the live band from the near by restaurant Zap Indy 🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: Mild

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes good, the prices are reasonable, the seating is comfortable with both outdoor and indoor options, and there's live music.
sample_reviews_en.author: to-ny-19 tony999

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food, great atmosphere, nice music, reasonable prices, buffet available, convenient parking. 💯👌✌️
sample_reviews_en.author: Prakasid Onta

sample_reviews_en.text: We held a company party here, the staff took great care of us, and the food was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: sumo Chenyuu

restaurants.name: MK Restaurants The Mall Bangkapi
restaurants.address:

L3, 3522 Lat Phrao Rd, Khlong Chan, Khet Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate here last month. Actually, I've eaten at this branch twice now, and I've been unimpressed with the service neither time. I ordered the duck and the jade noodle set, and the wait for my order was incredibly long—unforgivably long. I kept asking for the jade noodles until I'd finished my duck and almost run out of the broth before it finally arrived. I asked 2-3 times, which shouldn't have taken that long. Plus, customers at every table in the restaurant were calling the staff to ask for their orders, as if the staff lacked experience in customer service. There was no apology for the slow service. And getting a refill of water required asking 2-3 times, even though they should have noticed what the customer needed immediately. I definitely won't be using this branch again. I've never experienced service like this before.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jelly Jelly

sample_reviews_en.text:
I usually eat at MK quite often, but mostly with friends or family.
Today, I had the opportunity to try it alone, and it was a great experience.
Since I was working in the area, I walked past the restaurant and the aroma was so tempting that I decided to go in. 😆
I ordered a bowl of duck noodles, priced a little over 100 baht.
But the service was as good as ever. The staff treated me like family.
They refilled my tea repeatedly; they were very attentive.
Besides the delicious taste and the fond memories I have from eating there since childhood,
it's the service from the staff at every branch that makes me a regular customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Matsupa Pong-udom

sample_reviews_en.text: It was a terrible experience at MK, The Mall Bangkapi branch. The service was awful. From the moment we entered, they didn't explain any promotions. Getting a staff member to refill our dipping sauce or water was incredibly slow. Even after they finally came, their demeanor and facial expressions showed they didn't want to serve us. It's as if MK hasn't trained its staff properly before they start working. The service was truly terrible. All the staff working around 11:30 AM on March 20th, 2025, provided awful service. It felt like we were begging for food. There were no smiles to be found there.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐกาญ สุขมิ่ง

sample_reviews_en.text:
I first ate at this branch last year and wasn't very impressed. The staff weren't very attentive and the food was very slow.

I just came back today hoping it would be better, but it's the same as before. The food is extremely slow. I ordered dessert and waited over 30 minutes, even after asking 2-3 times, and still didn't get it, so I canceled it because I was in a hurry.

And if you order a birthday cake, you'll wait almost an hour! That's in stark contrast to other branches where you get your order in less than 5 minutes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Melonbunny

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is beautifully decorated.
This branch doesn't have tablets on each table.
The tissue box is also plain, not the cute figurines like in other branches.

I have to give the food 2 stars
because the cleanliness needs urgent improvement. I found a hair in my dish next to the shredded cabbage. It probably came with the large plate of sliced ​​pork, as it was the only dish served with cabbage. The staff called the manager, but they only apologized and showed no responsibility whatsoever. I was very disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Billy Than

sample_reviews_en.text:
It seems they renovated after the pandemic, and it feels more spacious now. I like how each table is so roomy.

There are plenty of staff members, and their service is meticulous and attentive.

It might just be my imagination, but the duck pieces seem more generous than at other branches (lol). There are so many restaurants in The Mall Bangkapi, and I'm always spoiled for choice, but when I'm undecided, I usually go for MK. It's one of my favorite restaurants because you can eat lots of vegetables!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kori Planning

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was incredibly slow to come out. The table next to us, who arrived later, had already received their food.

The staff placed the wrong order on the wrong table without asking, just walked away.

The ice machine was constantly making loud banging noises; it sounded like they were arguing in the kitchen.

The rice noodle rolls were very bland, different from what I've had before. Plus, the rolls smelled stale. I told the staff, and she just gave me a blank stare.
sample_reviews_en.author: บ ริ

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a wide selection of dishes and they always seem to come up with new menu ideas, which keeps things interesting. The black shabu broth is flavorful and nicely balanced — not too strong, just right — though I found the ponzu sauce a bit too mild for my taste. It’s one of my regular go-to places, and I like that they also offer single-serving sukiyaki dishes for when you want something quick and comforting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anchalee A.

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวไก่มะระนายกานต์ พัฒนาการ25
restaurants.address:

Phatthanakan 25, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Very generous portions, delicious taste, regular price 50฿, special price 60฿. Fresh bitter melon, basil, and drinking water are free. Parking is available on the roadside. No restroom.
sample_reviews_th.author: PaciFic TH

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem of a chicken broth noodle shop
50-60B
Very popular with motorbike taxi drivers and locals
The portion size is definitely 1.5 times larger than other street food noodle shops
You can add as much thinly sliced ​​bitter melon as you like, and all condiments are self-serve
Pandan leaf water is also free, but if you're worried, bring a water bottle
It contains various parts of chicken and cabbage as accents, and you can add as much bitter melon as you like, making it the most impressive street food noodle shop I've been to in the last few years
It's simply incredibly delicious
2026/3 Still incredibly delicious, and the price hasn't changed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tetsuya Harada

sample_reviews_en.text: I buy from them very often and eat there regularly. They give generous portions and the taste is good. But this time, I ordered the usual special, and the portion was much smaller than usual. I also ordered extra chicken necks but no shredded chicken. In the end, they gave me shredded chicken instead of chicken necks, yet I paid the special price. I'm not sure if they even read my order. I'm very disappointed this time.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชุตินันท์ ผลจันทร์

sample_reviews_en.text:
Park your car on the side of the road.
Get in and queue to choose your preferred order (we chose regular).
Choose your noodles and toppings.
Pay and receive your bowl of bitter melon, vegetables, and condiments—it's buffet style, you can season it to your liking.
Then take it to your table to eat.
Drinks are served in glasses with straws, no ice, but the pandan leaf drink is refreshing.

In short, it was delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Youtube Premierm

sample_reviews_en.text:
The noodle shop is located right by the roadside near the entrance to Khlong Tan Police Station. You can park on the side of the road (check the picture for parking hours).
**You can choose which part of the chicken you want: skin with fat, offal, tendons, blood, or chicken feet. The noodle soup, in my opinion, is very delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krittanan Suayod

sample_reviews_en.text: I think this is the best chicken noodle soup I've ever had. Even though I live on the Thonburi side of Bangkok, I still drive here to eat. It's delicious, clean, and I love it. What I like most is that they already remove the chicken tendons from the bone. It's perfect for eating with a guy; no need to feel embarrassed.
sample_reviews_en.author: nisha.nashi nashi

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! I've been eating at this place for a long time. The owner remembers me as soon as I order. If I buy takeout, I usually get one bag of noodles and one bag of soup without vegetables – it's amazing! But if I eat at the shop, the pandan leaf drink is so refreshing.
sample_reviews_en.author: BUN LULET

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s incredibly delicious! It’s loaded with all the ingredients. I love how the shredded chicken is separated into breast and drumstick pieces. The chicken joints are also pre-cut. It’s incredibly awesome…
sample_reviews_en.author: Pochachorn Chulkaew

restaurants.name: Kway Chab Silom - 맑은해물탕 국밥
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 2 Convent Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
When comparing to Pattaya, Bangkok food is so much yummy and cheaper.

After checked in to the hotel, we walked across and found this restaurant.

Both the seafood noodle and Kway Chab are very good! 👍🏼 😋

With 2 herbal drinks, seafood noodle and Kway Chab, they cost ฿210.

The best part is, we could use Malaysia cashless system (Touch n Go eWallet) to pay!
👍🏼👏🏼❤️
sample_reviews_th.author: Albert Khor

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're coming for lunch, I recommend ordering only the noodle soup or rice noodle soup. Absolutely do not order the pork leg rice. I went with three friends; A and I ordered pork leg rice, while B and C ordered noodle soup. The noodle soup was served within 10 minutes, but A and I waited 40 minutes, only receiving noodle soup and rice noodle soup, with no pork leg rice at all. We asked for it three times until we couldn't wait any longer and left. It turned out they had just finished preparing our food, so we canceled the order. If you can't manage a large menu, you should only sell one item that you can prepare immediately. Having too many items on the menu if you can't manage them all is very disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sompard Varavorarith

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is a famous local restaurant, and it seems it has even been featured on Thai TV.

Since the menu listed seafood broth and pork broth as the signature dishes, I tried both.

I liked the seafood broth because it had a clean taste in a clear broth. So, when I revisited, I tried the pork broth, but it had a slightly strong spice flavor, so it wasn't to my liking. Maybe I should have ordered the fish broth (sea bream) listed under the seafood broth on my second visit... haha.

ENGLISH review FOLLOWS ⬇️

Here is maybe famous restaurant. There are two signature menus: Seafood broth & Pork broth.

I think the seafood one has clean and better taste than the pork one.
sample_reviews_en.author: J Y

sample_reviews_en.text: On February 25th, 2026, I visited the Silom Noodle Shop between 9:40 AM and 9:55 AM. The food itself was fine, nothing special, but the service was disappointing. I ordered pork blood soup with rice (2 bowls), but the soup didn't have any pork blood. I asked if it was supposed to be pork blood soup, and they said yes, but they were out of blood. Why didn't they tell me this when they first took my order? I could have ordered something else. It's not a big deal, just disappointing. Customers come specifically to eat here, and if a menu item isn't ready, they should be informed. 😮‍💨
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนายุทธ ปิติ

sample_reviews_en.text: The air is breezy and cool, not stuffy, perfect for enjoying hot food. If you're in Silom and like kway chap (Thai noodle soup), you must stop by this place. Cleanliness is excellent, the staff are very efficient, and you won't have to wait long. The broth is delicious and doesn't need much seasoning; it's not too sweet or too salty, just the right flavor. You can eat it without adding any extra condiments. The restaurant also accepts government subsidy programs, so you can use your benefits here.
sample_reviews_en.author: เลาะไปเรื่อย

sample_reviews_en.text:
Feb 2026

Hearty brunch, local flavours.

Place doesn't have the ambience but it's Thai soul food.

The menu selection was itself enticing alone.  Kueh chap differs slightly from the Malaysia version (soup is slightly sweeter, and Kueh chap is thicker) but it's good!

Sea bass rice soup - you can go wrong with Thai rice soup for breakfast, lunch or dinner.  Soup is hearty smooth and fish taste as it just came off the fisherman's boat.

I will return for a round 2 breakfast!
sample_reviews_en.author: SY Ng

sample_reviews_en.text:
This fell flat to me, the soup was one-dimensional & lacked depth. I had a craving, saw this, & went in to dine... Finished the food but not impressed; unlikely to return.

Didn't really enjoy this, & that surprised me - because I much prefer herbal over peppery for bakuteh. (Just my preference.)

For Thai Gway Jub, I'm discovering that peppery suits the dish much more. Perhaps because of the nature of the ingredients that are included?
sample_reviews_en.author: Emily S
