sample_reviews_en.text: The kway chap is great although the broth is on the salty side. I tried the crispy fried pork the 1st time and decide i like it. This is a great restaurant to try these thai traditional street food. Although i do not speak Thai, i have no problem with the dishes and ordering. The server make sure i can get my all thr food i have ordered, utensils and sauces even though i am not familiar with its restaurant layout.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ken W

restaurants.name: Acai Story - Velaa Sindhorn Village
restaurants.address:

87 Lang Suan Rd, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
It is very obvious that they put less Acai berry, or any other fruit for that matter, in the base mix. It tastes like purple crushed ice. Not taste. Not good enough if you are paying nearly ฿380 for a serve. The fact they charge extra for granola is just ridiculous.
Go elsewhere.
sample_reviews_th.author: N Bell

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a drink at Acai Story in Velaa Sindhorn Village, and the refreshing and clean taste left a strong impression. They offer many healthy, fruit-based drinks, making them perfect for a light snack. I was even more satisfied because the drinks weren't overly sweet, and you could really taste the fresh ingredients.

The atmosphere is modern and calm, making it a great place to stop by for a break, and the staff were friendly, so ordering was easy. If you are looking for a healthy drink, I highly recommend Acai Story for a fresh beverage right in the heart of Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: HOI YOON KIM

sample_reviews_en.text: Pretty good açai, fun size is very sufficient for a light breakfast, 120 baht. I found the acai to be a little too sweet and not enough tartness / fruit flavour. I thought the fruits bowl was nice, but I found the mango too ripe, and the amount of fruit to feel a bit sparse. More chia / coconut would have been nice. Overall, good, quick, reliable breakfast option. You can walk 500 metres straight shot south to Lumphini park to sit and enjoy. There are not seats at this location
sample_reviews_en.author: Isabella Grandic

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a small shop close to Lumphini Park that has a large variety of açai based bowls and smoothies. I had a açai bowl with Greek yoghurt,fresh fruit and coconut shavings. It was refreshing and delicious. The staff at the shop was courteous, efficient and English speaking. There is both indoor and outdoor seating available. I highly recommend this establishment to those that enjoy the Brazilian “superfood” açai.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Kapshuk

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very solid açai bowl. The fun size is a good snack or very light breakfast. They have options with and without yogurt. Vegan and non-vegan options.
As someone who loves Greek yogurt, I loved the Sunshine Swirl bowl. The fruit on top was fresh and ripe. They have bowls with nut butter or chocolate as well. They also have smoothies for 220 baht.
All bowls are 120-380 baht.
No seating, just a window.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cass

sample_reviews_en.text: The acai was unfortunately frozen when we received it, as it looks like they take it out of the freezer only when needed, which meant we had to wait a little while for it to thaw and reach its best flavor. I’ve had better acai bowls elsewhere, and given the experience, I probably wouldn’t return. That said, the service was nice, and the location is lovely!
sample_reviews_en.author: Klara Novak

sample_reviews_en.text: after A it’s B. B for banana and bad!!!! This ain’t açaí. It’s giving glass half empty. Bought the standard and it came with 1/2 the volume. I might as well cut my baht paper in half too. Don’t pay for this :p Don’t be sorry, do better! And bring me a better acai bowl and I will consider my language again >:<
sample_reviews_en.author: Ivan

sample_reviews_en.text: Introducing the new menus, these two are buy 1 get 1 free promotion right now. The one in the front has peanut butter in it as well, it did go unexpectedly well with Acai. The one in the back has many golgi berries in it which I loooveee because not only is it delicious but also full of vitamins!
sample_reviews_en.author: fairpeerada

restaurants.name: เครปนมสด จุฑาพร
restaurants.address:

60/14 Chok Chai 4 Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Delicious! Crispy batter, great filling, good price!!!!
This is a truly authentic crepe, using quality ingredients.
The person making it seems very dedicated to each one.
**It might not be suitable for impatient people because you'll have to wait a while.**

We ordered ours pre-cut, which was convenient to eat.
Menu ordered: Nutella + peanut butter = 65฿ and Spinach + cheese = 45฿
sample_reviews_th.author: Panrawee Phichayamontien (Gift)

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Jutaporn Fresh Milk Crepes" - I saw so many recommendations for this place, and it's no surprise it's always busy. Just watching the preparation process, you can tell each crepe is made with care.

The crepe batter is incredibly fragrant; the aroma wafts out even while waiting outside. The batter is perfectly thin – not too hard, not too soft that it breaks easily. You can see how they spread the batter evenly and smoothly. The fillings are generous, with plenty of fresh milk, eggs, strawberries, chocolate, and other toppings. The filling is substantial but not overly sweet, creating a perfect balance.

Another thing I appreciated was the cleanliness and organization of the crepe-making area. The tools were neatly arranged, the ingredients looked fresh (not left sitting around to dry), and the staff were incredibly skilled. It was so enjoyable to watch that I even filmed a video!

Even with a steady stream of customers, the wait wasn't long because the process is fast and efficient. The staff were friendly, smiling, and answered menu questions in detail, making it feel like a warm and welcoming small shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charinrat N

sample_reviews_en.text:
00:39 AM. Just got home.

Took a shower and washed my hair, then lined up for a crepe at midnight. Sacrificing myself tonight to load up on carbs before bed.

Reviews said the queue wasn't too long in the early evening and parking was difficult, but even at midnight there was still a queue. Waited about 20 minutes.

But it was delicious, the filling was overflowing, the batter was crispy, and they had rainbow and charcoal crepes.
There were tons of fillings to choose from, lined up like a tree, and the price was affordable, just as the reviews said. I was so happy! ❤️

Jutaporn Fresh Milk Crepe Shop, Chokchai 4 Soi 18.
At night, you can park right in front of the shop, although there are delivery riders waiting there.

Today I ordered shredded coconut, banana, and Nutella.
Total price 80 baht.

I only ate half and felt full.
Maybe I'm a light eater or they give you a lot? 555
sample_reviews_en.author: Santipa Yoothanom

sample_reviews_en.text: I've passed this restaurant many times and always see a lot of people, so I didn't eat there. But today, seeing there weren't many people, I decided to eat here. I sat and waited to be called in order, but two people in line came after us. When they arrived, they ordered and paid. I didn't mind, but I was confused because they finished before us and got cut in line to be served first. I'm not okay with this if a restaurant this delicious does this. The taste is said to be delicious, the dough is crispy, and not too sweet (I ordered Foi Thong, Luk Raisins, and fresh water). But the management is terrible. Even a famous restaurant like this shouldn't do this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattapon Keawploy

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's delicious! The crust is very crispy. I ordered the Nutella and banana one and it was delicious as is, with chocolate sauce drizzled on top.
🍌 I also ordered two pieces to be frozen. After two days, I took them out to thaw and ate them, and they were still delicious. The banana was like eating ice cream, and the crust wasn't soggy or wet.

♥️♥️ The map said they open at 7 PM,
but when I got to the shop, there was a sign saying they open at 8 PM.
I'm not sure about the exact time.
✅ When you arrive, write your order on a piece of paper and hand it in. There are numbers on the paper, remember the numbers! 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: pavinee charoenphol

sample_reviews_en.text:
The legendary folded crepe of Chokchai 4 now has shorter queues! We arrived at 9 PM and there were only 4 people ahead of us, so we waited less than half an hour.

The highlight is the crispy batter; it's delicious even eaten plain. There's a wide variety of fillings to choose from, and the price is very affordable. When you arrive, grab a blank piece of paper and write down your fillings. If you want it folded and sliced, write that down. If you don't write it, it will be a regular triangle. Remember to write your name and phone number too, in case you forget.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arinta

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop has four ovens, and the wait time is about 5-6 people. It takes about 20 minutes, with each person waiting 4-5 minutes.
If you're in a hurry, try calculating the time.

When ordering, read the sign at the front of the shop carefully so the cook can make the food to your liking.

Once you've got your menu, write it down on paper and wait for the seller to prepare it.

I personally ordered and took it home. It took about 20 minutes, and it wasn't crispy. I recommend ordering and eating it right away at the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanetpol Thammapanont

sample_reviews_en.text: The crepe shop offers both savory and sweet fillings, with a wide variety to choose from. When I went, the wait was short. Upon arrival, you write down your order (the order slip has a queue number, so remember it!). The crepe batter is crispy, perfect for those who like it crunchy. Towards the end of the day, if they added more sauce to make it more soaked, it would be even better. Overall, it's delicious! 🫶🏼✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Nichakorn Chaikumharn

restaurants.name: Tue Kha Tang Stewed Pork Leg Jelly
restaurants.address:

689 4 ถ. เจริญกรุง Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Chilled Pork Leg and A La Carte Dishes
•Pork Leg: Delicious, tasty even on its own. There are two dipping sauces: chili vinegar and soy sauce. The chili vinegar sauce is just sour; it would be even better if it were a bit saltier and sweeter. 200฿
•Stir-fried Noodles with Water Spinach: 60฿ Delicious.
•Crab Basil Stir-fry with Rice: 80฿ Adding a little chili fish sauce makes it even better.
sample_reviews_th.author: attpocari

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the shop my dad used to take me to buy pork trotters to take home. Today, I was in Talat Noi, so I brought a friend to eat in the shop instead, to soak up the atmosphere.

Upon entering, the owner greeted us warmly and recommended the shop's signature dishes. Since we had already eaten other things, we ordered a small bowl of pork trotters and stir-fried noodles with water spinach and crispy pork to try.

The pork trotters tasted as delicious as ever. Eating it with the soy sauce was so refreshing and perfect for beating the heat.

But what unexpectedly turned out to be incredibly delicious was the stir-fried noodles with water spinach and crispy pork. The noodles had a wonderful wok-fried aroma, the crispy pork was freshly fried and hot, and the flavor was perfect without needing any extra seasoning. Plus, the price was great and the portion was huge!

It was so delicious! I'll definitely come back next time to try other dishes. 🫶💕✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Fuka Kung

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't know how to say "green vegetables" in Chinese, but the fried rice noodles were absolutely delicious, with a wonderful wok hei (wok aroma). The only downside was that there were only three shrimp in the plate, but they did give us a fried taro strip wrapped in bean curd skin. Their braised pork knuckle rice was excellent; you absolutely must eat it with the skin on. Their braised egg was also good, but the lean meat was a bit dry. This restaurant is most famous for its aspic, which is a little greasy, but it's fantastic with their red chili sauce, which has a slightly sour flavor. The pickled cabbage in the pork knuckle rice was a bit sweet, but the taste was really great. If you go, you must try their drinks—they're not on the menu, but you can ask for monk fruit; they're delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: cc Bangkok

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop is located in an alley in the old Chinese town, surrounded by secondhand car parts stores. I came here because I saw it recommended online! I ordered the pork jelly for 70 baht, which had pork leg meat and pork skin, full of collagen, and had a refreshing taste. I also ordered the crab fried rice, which had a generous amount of crab meat. It was cooked by a female chef, and the rice was cooked with a wonderful wok hei (wok aroma) and each grain was distinct. This shop is open from morning until 2 pm, which is considered brunch. It's okay if you miss the brunch hours, as there's a restaurant next door that serves dinner, with crab fried rice with ribs. I'll definitely come back next time!
sample_reviews_en.author: 老陳的行程

sample_reviews_en.text:
A rather inconspicuous shop tucked away in an alley, but it's very popular – mostly with locals. It was hot, and while the dining area lacked air conditioning, there were fans – not bad. They bring you a glass of ice after you order. Unlimited drinks on the table – (especially diluted winter melon tea!)

Pork knuckle jelly (70B): A true collagen powerhouse! Icy cold with a jelly-like texture, not greasy at all.
Crab fried rice (100B): Highly recommended – not oily, the rice is perfectly cooked, each grain separate, and bursting with wok hei (wok aroma). Even better with fish sauce and chili!

Looking forward to my next visit to try other dishes! 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: 范曉儀

sample_reviews_en.text: It's not just the pork knuckle that's delicious; they have a wide variety of dishes, like a made-to-order restaurant. Today I tried pork knuckle rice, cold pork knuckle, crab fried rice, and stir-fried noodles. Everything was delicious. The crab fried rice was even better than some famous fried rice restaurants. The pork knuckle was served in large pieces. Most importantly, the service was excellent and the staff were very friendly. It was a very relaxing experience. The prices were reasonable too. I recommend going early in the morning when it's less crowded and they have everything you want to try. The restaurant opens at 6 am.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tommy Weerapol

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tue Kha Tang Stewed Pork Leg Jelly is a nice spot to stop by while exploring the Talat Noi area.

I tried the pork knuckle jelly cup, served with a variety of dipping sauces. The texture was rich and bouncy, full of flavor, and quite unique—definitely something different and worth trying.

I also had a fresh coconut with plenty of pulp, which was refreshing and balanced the richness of the dish well.

Good service and tasty food. A great little stop if you’re walking around Talat Noi and want to try something local and a bit different.
sample_reviews_en.author: Farangondiet

sample_reviews_en.text: I saw a video of this restaurant in a LINE group and wanted to try it. I called twice, but they said they were sold out. So I decided to reserve 5 bowls in advance, at 200 baht per bowl. I asked them to slice one bowl for me, and the other 4 arrived unsliced. I put them in the refrigerator to eat later. The taste was good enough; I ate almost half a bowl by myself. One bowl is usually enough for 4-5 people. The restaurant also serves other dishes, Monday to Friday.
sample_reviews_en.author: พร้อมพูล ชอบเพื่อน

restaurants.name: Jones' Salad สาขา เทอร์มินอล 21 อโศก (Terminal 21 Asok)
restaurants.address:

รหัสไปรษณีย์ 10110 เลขที่ 88 อาคาร ศูนย์การค้าเทอร์มินอล 21 อโศก ห้องเลขที่ 4021A,4025A ชั้นที่4 ซ.สุขุมวิท 19(วัฒนา) ถ.สุขุมวิท แขวงคลองตันเหนือ เขตวัฒนา จ คลองตันเหนือ Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The overall service at noon 2nd of April 2026 was very disappointing. The staff seemed confused and untrained, with little to no sense of customer service.
1.	When I was standing at the counter, no one came to take orders. Staff were busy using their phone and appeared confused about previous orders.
2.	The female staff taking the order struggled to understand Thai language and was unfamiliar with the menu and POS system, asking the same questions multiple times.
3.	I waited over 20 minutes for just two simple items. Even after following up twice, the order had not been prepared. The team appeared disorganized and unable to manage the workflow.
4.	The queue quickly escalated from no wait to a crowded front area, as orders were not being completed in a timely manner.

Overall, this reflects extremely poor management, lack of training, and an unacceptable service standard. This was a complete waste of time and not a place I would ever consider returning to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bhayu T.

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped by Jones Salad at the Terminal 21 Asok branch. This is one of my top choices when I want something healthy and reasonably priced. The salad greens look incredibly fresh and clean, and the portions are quite generous. It's perfect for those looking for a healthy main course. The taste is great and easy to eat, with a variety of dressings to choose from. I especially appreciate the efficient and fast service, ideal for those on a tight schedule or looking for a quick lunch break. If you're in this area and can't decide what to eat, I highly recommend trying this branch. It's worth it and will leave you feeling full!
sample_reviews_en.author: M Thana

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the worst experiences I’ve ever had in Bangkok. Today, June 29 at around 2:38 PM, the waiter didn’t approach me at all or even hand me a menu. I had to get it myself. After that, I waited around 15 minutes and no one came to take my order.
When I finally asked what was going on, the waiter started complaining about staff shortages. It was obvious they were avoiding taking orders ; I’ve honestly never seen anything like this in my life.
Of course, I left and will never come back
sample_reviews_en.author: Flow

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Pretty crowded
- Food preparation time is quite long, probably because of a lot of customer + they are still adapting to the work as it was just recently open. However, they are very polite and keep following up with the kotchen team and keep us posted.
- The sauces used in most menu contained quite a lot of mayonnaise which can be a little bit too creamy/oily like of taste
- The veggies are quite fresh
- The chicken breast was sous vide so it's perfectly soft and juicy
sample_reviews_en.author: Duangkamol L.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was really good, to the point that I forgot to take a photo of the appetizer. Luckily, I managed to get one of the main dish. The Big Fish & Curly Fries were great crispy, with only a slight richness that wasn’t greasy at all. Everything went really well with the sauces that came with it.

The staff were friendly and quick. Prices are a bit on the high side, but still reasonable for what you get.
sample_reviews_en.author: John de j3k

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything was fine except they don't bring my drinks which was Very berr, and I have to finished my food without my drink so I asked to cancelled it but they refusd to do it!!! I don't know who is the owner, boss or supervisor, this is not the way your staff should behave with your loyal customers that rude :(

*Reply: I requested my drink to eat them with my lunch not for take away!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Metoo Miu

sample_reviews_en.text:
40 minutes wait on 3 salads and a pasta carbonara.
And the pasta even came after 10 minutes.

All food came separately and none of us dined at the same time.

Shakes and fresh juice were good. Lemonade tasted like juice at the hotel buffet 🧐

We suggest to try some other place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marc Genning

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant pre-mixes the salad with the dressing, which is better because it's more evenly distributed than if you did it yourself, but the downside is that some people might worry about using too much dressing. The seaweed and puffed rice included are nice and crispy.
sample_reviews_en.author: N N (Pom)

restaurants.name: Oh mama restaurants
restaurants.address:

111 3 Thanon Tani, Khwaeng Talat Yot, Khet Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An excellent option for eating near Khaosan Road.

I had my first meal in Thailand here, and it was a very good experience. I ordered chicken fried rice with a pineapple smoothie, and both were delicious. The smoothie was very cold and refreshing, perfect for the Bangkok heat.

The staff was very friendly, especially the young man who served me, who was always attentive and very cordial.

The place is clean, comfortable, air-conditioned, and offers a very pleasant atmosphere to relax after exploring the city.

It's also very well located, near Khaosan Road and the Lomprayah office, making it ideal for those passing through or heading to the islands.

Best of all was the value for money: I only paid 150 baht for the chicken fried rice and the smoothie, an excellent option for eating well without spending a lot.

I would definitely return and I recommend it to anyone who wants to try authentic Thai food in a very touristy area of ​​Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: DORCA HT

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited around 11 PM as a party of two.

The restaurant was bright and clean, with pleasant background music, creating a wonderful atmosphere.

This time, we ordered beef pad thai, som tam, stir-fried morning glory, and stir-fried beef with garlic. Every dish was perfectly seasoned and truly delicious. I especially recommend the beef pad thai and som tam.

The service was excellent; the young female staff were very kind. You can choose the spiciness level from 1 to 5, and we chose "2," which was just the right amount of spiciness.

The staff jokingly told us, "Don't give everything 5 stars," but sorry! (laughs)

In reality, it was such a wonderful restaurant that I wanted to give everything 5 stars.

This was our last dinner on this trip to Thailand, and I'm so glad we chose this restaurant. I would definitely like to visit again when I come back to Thailand.

Aroi mak! 🇹🇭❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Puffy Montana

sample_reviews_en.text:
Was here for breakfast. I fell for the fake reviews and decided to give this place a shot.

I ordered scrambled eggs and wanted to add bacon and onions to them (ingredients which they have given they have other menu items that include them). They declined and said only what’s on the menu, even though I would have been willing to pay extra for them.

Ended up just getting disappointingly plain eggs.

Then when it was time to pay, they said cash only. Mind you, this area is one of the most highly trafficked tourist areas and they had no sign outside that noted *cash only*

Overall disappointed in this place. The server was nice, but that’s about it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Landon L

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm Japanese. I went there on my last night in Thailand.

I went around 10 PM on a weekday, so there were no other customers and I was able to relax.

All the food was delicious, and I ate it all up! It's a more luxurious meal than street food.

Even if you don't like spicy food, they can adjust the spiciness for you, so no worries!

However, the walkway to the tables is past a hotel and there's a bar next door, so there might be a lot of people coming and going depending on the time.

I wasn't there for very long, so it didn't bother me.

I recommend this place to anyone who wants to enjoy a slightly more luxurious Thai meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: A C

sample_reviews_en.text:
5/5 Stars ⭐ "Just wow x fresh!
OH MAMA Bangkok hits the ultimate home run with their seafood.
The Pad Thai Seafood is incredibly fresh, perfectly stir-fried, and packed with snappy, tender seafood.
The Tom Yum Kung is a masterclass in rich, aromatic, and authentic Thai spice—absolutely delicious but packs a massive, fiery punch! Pro-Tip for handle spicy food: Just ask the server for "Phet Noi" (little bit spicy) and pair it with a sweet side dishes,
🥵🔥🌡
If the soup is still too spicy to you always with mayonnaise! Also, 🧊Icy Thai Milk🥛 Tea 🍵 to instantly cool your tongue.
*Drink yogurt later
😁Enjoying Bangkok😉
sample_reviews_en.author: Luthyra's Vibe Official

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had lunch at "OH MAMA Bangkok," located in a quiet area a little away from the Khao San area.

I ordered the classic gapao rice, stir-fried morning glory (pak boong fai daeng), and pad thai.

The gapao had a rich, robust flavor that went perfectly with the rice. The pad thai had a perfect balance of sweetness and aroma, and the stir-fried morning glory retained its crispness—both were of consistently high quality.

The restaurant had a stylish and clean atmosphere, making it the perfect place to quickly enjoy delicious classic Thai food while sightseeing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Satoshi Watanabe

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm Japanese.
I visited before 7 PM and had the crispy chicken pad thai and chicken gapao!
Perhaps because it was before dinner time, there were seats available and I was seated right away. The taste was to Japanese liking, and the spices could be adjusted, making it perfect for a meal before spending the night in Khao San! Compared to current Japanese prices, the prices aren't exactly cheap, but they're not bad! I was able to relax and enjoy myself! There were English-speaking staff, and the service was excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: いそだあやむ

sample_reviews_en.text: We really don't know where the good reviews come from. The menu recommended dishes like Pad Thai and Phanang Curry, which we both ordered. We both had stomach problems, or even food poisoning. And unfortunately, it didn't taste good at all :( We were very disappointed!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna Kühl

restaurants.name: ร้านอาหารมุมทอง
restaurants.address:

155/51 หมู่ 5 หมู่บ้านสมชาย ตำบลบางกรวย Bang Kruai District, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
This roadside stall is located next to มุมทอง Noodle Shop.
I usually eat their fish noodles and pork satay, which are also delicious, but I've never reviewed them before. Recently, I had the opportunity to try their papaya salad. The papaya salad was amazing; if you ask for it spicy, it's super spicy! Delicious and flavorful. However, after ordering a second serving, the spiciness started to change.
The wait wasn't long, the service was fast, and everything was delicious. Most importantly, the prices are very, very cheap!
sample_reviews_th.author: Sabine Kim

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a local restaurant I've been frequenting for a long time. I mostly order delivery. I like their small bowl of tom yum soup with minced pork; they give you a generous amount of pork. I usually eat alone, but I order an extra bowl of tom yum soup with minced pork for extra protein and vegetables.

The tom yum flavor is well-balanced, though sometimes it's a bit too sour or sweet, but you can adjust the seasoning. Overall, it's delicious and I never get tired of it. They also have waterfall noodles (not the boat noodle style), which I initially preferred the tom yum version of. They also have yen ta fo, som tum (papaya salad), and various drinks like sweet beverages.

The atmosphere is airy and breezy, not hot, and comfortable to sit in. It's located right by the road.

There's parking for about 7-8 cars next to the restaurant, if I remember correctly. I usually try to avoid lunchtime because I'm afraid there won't be any parking spaces.
sample_reviews_en.author: CATTNNSSPP

sample_reviews_en.text:
A simple, local noodle shop by a small canal.
- They offer clear broth noodles, tom yum, nam tok, and yen ta fo. Their yen ta fo is the best; it's fully loaded and has the best flavor. The other noodles are average. The quality of the meat isn't bad, just average for the price.
- They also sell snacks like fried fish cakes, fried meatballs, and fried dumplings.
- The guava juice is delicious, and the ice cream is okay.
- The atmosphere isn't great because the canal isn't clean, but it's located on a bend in the road, which is a very good location. There's parking available, and you can also park on the opposite side of the road before the bend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brownie

sample_reviews_en.text:
I drive past this restaurant often, and today I finally had the chance to stop by. The tom yum soup was rich and sour, and the yen ta fo had a home-style flavor. The pork satay was incredibly delicious. The small plates were surprisingly delicious. It was already afternoon, and the restaurant was still crowded. The price was reasonable at 40 baht, with a 50/50 discount.
The cleanliness of the restaurant could be improved. The floor was extremely dirty, especially the cooking area. The noodle counter was so dirty that we couldn't see it clearly, we didn't want to eat. Several tables weren't cleared, and glasses were still left unattended.
sample_reviews_en.author: รีวิวตามจริง ไม่จิงโจ้ CENTER

sample_reviews_en.text: The food at this restaurant is delicious. I've eaten here many times. The crispy catfish is served in generous portions, the marinated grilled pork neck is tasty, and the soups and papaya salad are also good. However, I once had a papaya salad with frozen shrimp that was still very cold. I might need to remind the vendor next time. The prices are moderate to high, but worth the money. The only problem is the limited parking, and it gets very crowded during lunchtime.
sample_reviews_en.author: Waroonrat Wiroonrart

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum noodles are delicious, no need to add any seasoning. The fish cakes are delicious, I always buy some to take home after eating at the restaurant. The prices are reasonable. Across the street, there's a shop selling fried bananas, fried potatoes, and fried shellfish. They're delicious and not expensive, even though they don't have a Michelin star like some of the shops around Rama 5 Bridge.
sample_reviews_en.author: เขมิกา ลีลารุจิ

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came to visit a friend near Wat Lum Alley, and they took me to this restaurant, Moom Thong. They have a variety of dishes. The Tom Yum pork noodle soup was delicious, the pork satay was tasty and a good portion size, and the papaya salad was spicy. It's a good place for families or friends to bring their friends along. There's parking available.
The prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pranee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Easy-to-eat som tam, grilled pork neck, delicious grilled chicken, excellent dipping sauce, and excellent fried chicken wings.
Traditional pork noodles from Bang Kruai. Delicious tom yum soup with a sweet and fragrant broth. Various toppings and fresh meat. Recommended: dry noodles and tom yum. Don't forget the delicious herbal tea and ice cream for dessert.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khemmachart Inkaew

restaurants.name: Kinnaree
restaurants.address:

7 ซอย เอกชัย 89/0 Bang Bon Nuea, Bang Bon, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
So I met a friend of mine here for lunch 🥗 to catch up and discuss things as he doesn’t live here but he come to quite often enough that whenever he does come here we try different restaurants!

Because he was staying in the hotel here we decided to go here to make it easy for everybody and he loves his place because he said the food is really quite fresh and good and it really was!

High turnover here in terms of food which means the food is quite fresh and made in-house and it comes out steaming hot and very delicious!

🤤
Of course I had to add chili peppers to my food because of course we’re in Thailand so eat like the Thais - pet maak!! 😂 🌶️

If you’re in this area on this really busy street that has 1001 restaurants I swear I can never understand how they fit everybody into this street but it is a fascinating street nonetheless so here we go!

Follow Fauzia for more food reviews in this Nana area - you can find us on Facebook Instagram YouTube and TikTok for video content that you would want to see what we’re up to!

😍🥰😍🥰😍🥰😍😍🥹
sample_reviews_en.author: Follow Fauzia

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great to see the city from a calmer, more elegant side of dining. Kinnaree feels upscale but still approachable. The dishes arrive in large portions and are filling. I ordered a Green Curry Chicken and a Seafood Fried Rice, the latter actually suggested by the waiter. I agreed almost automatically, then realized the portions might be too much and asked if we could make one of them half-size or cancel the fried rice. The waiter reassured me, “No, no, it’s not big,” but when I called him back a minute later saying, “I really won’t be able to finish it, I’ll also have a beer,” he replied that the order slip had already been sent and couldn’t be changed. That left me disappointed; the meal ended up being far too large, and I couldn’t eat even half of it.

Still, the green curry sauce was really good, rich, balanced, and aromatic, though the large orange-skinned Personally, Thai eggplants inside had a slightly citrusy and unusual taste I didn’t enjoy. I found myself drinking most of the curry instead of finishing the solids.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mustafa Gokcel

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a classic BKK Restaurant in Sukhumvit area. It was 24 hours. Covid changed the hours. So not sure now. One of the best areas for late night food and people watching. Many indoor, outdoor seating.
Kinnaree has Thai dishes and American dishes. Great dessert options. Lots of Ice Cream choices. It’s a very typical Thai atmosphere. Service can be great or completely horrible. Part of the charm. I’ve seen customers shouting angry complaints. Many just rude no matter where they eat. A few of the Waitresses will put you out in the street if you cross the line. Also customer can be in a suit or shorts. You never know what to expect here. That’s part of the charm. I can honestly say in the Eight years I’ve been going here I’ve never had a bad meal. Inexpensive. Many choices. I love this place and every time I’m in BKK I go here to eat. I hope they are back to 24 hours.
I highly recommend this restaurant for the food and a complete Thai Sukhumvit experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: SuperBillybob53

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Kinnaree location, nestled inside the Grand Business Inn on Soi 11, excels as a reliable and essential dining spot. It offers a clean, quiet oasis, providing a welcome break from the relentless pace of the surrounding street.
While the menu includes both Thai and International selections, the kitchen's true strength lies in its skillful execution of traditional Thai dishes, delivering familiar and authentic flavors. The most valuable feature is its 24-hour operation, making it an indispensable choice for travelers needing a consistent, comforting, and dependable meal at any hour—day or night. This is a functional and high-value restaurant focused on serving quality food with friendly efficiency.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohammed Islam

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's simply very tasty.
However, I didn't feel particularly impressed by the price.
I went with a Thai friend, and when I asked for their opinion, they said it was "simply tasty."

The staff were polite and their hard work was evident, so I rate that higher (lol).

Because of its location, people of various nationalities were using the restaurant, which was also fun.

I might go again if I'm nearby, but I don't think I would go out of my way to visit this place.

No, it's incredibly tasty!
But I feel like I could get something similar elsewhere...
sample_reviews_en.author: HIRO SHIMIZU

sample_reviews_en.text: Open 24hrs, mix of thai and international. Dinner style. Overpriced food that is mediocre nothing special. Not worth the price. Order pad thai, seafood noodle and water total 375 Bhat The pad thai took an extremely long time to come. The place was not crowded when we went in, but it took almost 30mins. Seafood noodle took 10mins. Staff were nice and apologetic, but kitchen was very slow. Overall basic food that is a ripe off and takes forever to come.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hayam M-A

sample_reviews_en.text:
I absolutely love this place. The design of the restaurant is stunning. We are in a pond surrounded by greenery and fish ponds in the middle of sukhumvit.

My favourite dishes are the grilled sea bass, the care veggies and the petchaburi tanod.

I come here again and again. The best hours are before the busy dinner hours when it s quieter and not absolutely full.

On some nights they also have live music! Always super lovely with talented musicians
sample_reviews_en.author: Delphine Berger

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm staying nearby and happened walk pass for breakfast.
Is a small cafe that serving their guests and also accept walk-in customers.  We have ordered the seafood noodle soup, pancakes and phad thai and breakfast set.
Their seafood noodle soup paste is nice and sweet,  prawn is fresh. Phad thai is also very much well prepared.
Comparing with many others hotel or local restaurants,  their price is reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Esmond Chun

restaurants.name: The Nest (Robins Nest Guesthouse)
restaurants.address:

Soi Diana Pattaya, Pattaya City, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Took family for dinner tonight 29/07/2025, normally a great night and food, but tonight for the 1st time in 15 yrs, been left totally disappointed. Ordered 3 Lasagne's, all with garlic bread and 2 with fries. 1st 2 came, both with the garlic bread, which was fine. When I asked where the fries were, staff hadn't put them through. Then another staff came and asked if I wanted fries. My food still hadn't arrived at this time. So I walked out leaving my family to try to enjoy their food. Still no fries arrived. They wanted them to eat their food without the rest of it. Having to wait yet again for the fries, which would have been cold by time they had come. Anyway my wife and grandson both tried it and said it was not nice. I must insist that this is the 1 and only time I've had a bad meal at this establishment, it's always been a 5☆ service, so can only put it down to maybe a new member of staff. But still had to pay for a bad service. Sorry ROBINS NEST
sample_reviews_en.author: John Coates

sample_reviews_en.text: First i very sorry to give bad review but to be honest about room , not good  not elevator bathroom wet they not make it separeted shower, noisy until 4am then i booked 7 days but in 5 days i'm move to another hotel because shower not water 😞😟 and thats situation i get periode then i going down tell reception, she say wait 30 min i was so stress mad then uncomfortable so i move and i'm not trust them 30 min shoewer what happents if until at night shower not work? And going down to need somebody help me carry on my stuff nobody help me just 1 lady she very nice i'm forget she name , then here houskeping nice friendly smile but the another staff not nice u will regret if u stay here so don't trust by picture but trust by review i never leave bad review 😑, tv  not good , Ac not good too ,just location good here
sample_reviews_en.author: Jess

sample_reviews_en.text:
I haven't  rated the room because not staying here... BUT over 10 years of coming here i have never given feedback.  Well 10 years will explain THE NEST.. its always maintained great staff, great Guinness, lovely family & friendly atmosphere.
So many changes in this city,.. BUT ROBINS NEST... simply they have kept it special,  simple , but excellent service,  food,  ..but more importantly the staff... thank you , THE NEST..see you tomorrow
sample_reviews_en.author: Pete Pete

sample_reviews_en.text: I eat in this place three times per day and add two people which I’ve done so for the last six months tonight I ordered lasagna and asked for some Parmesan cheese which they were going to charge me for. I have an Italian dish and Parmesan cheese is a condiment so should be serve free with the pasta. Yes they did bring it to the table free of charge later but I told her to take it back, they lost. I will never ever eaten this place again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lee atlas

sample_reviews_en.text:
While I never stayed in the rooms here, the sports bar is great.
The food is excellent, and I ate here regularly on my recent trip to Pattaya.
A good selection for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and they do daily specials with their evening meals.
They also have some nice deserts.
A great bar for watching sport, although it’s a quiet relaxed atmosphere.
Prices are reasonable, and staff are very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter O Connor

sample_reviews_en.text: As far as Pattaya bars go, this one is very civilised. Its my go to bar for watching sport. Numerous screens and staff always happy to help finding what youre after. Food is quite good and the menu is massive. All pub style food, perfect with a few beers. Always go here to watch Australian sports finals
sample_reviews_en.author: C C

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place and reasonable prices. Unfortunately, we didn't know when the outdoor grill was open, but we came back a second time and it was definitely a winner! Special thanks to the manager for his attentive service to all guests! We wish you success, thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bybluk

sample_reviews_en.text:
I come here to watch early morning Sport when other venues are closed, as it's open 24 hrs. I usually order a breakfast while watching NFL Football. The standard of food & service is very good.
I've never stayed in their rooms, so cannot comment on that aspect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ric Vic

restaurants.name: Hong Kong Bangna
restaurants.address:

58/1 อาคาร Bizzo, Soi Bang Na-Trat 23, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered takeout. The first bite of the duck had a strange, waxy taste that I can't quite describe. I ordered half a duck, but the color of the duck in the box was uneven—half darker, half lighter, as if the darker side was old. After the first bite, the second piece I picked up had a dark greenish-purple, almost fluorescent color, like it was spoiled. I felt nauseous and vomited afterward. The crispy pork and char siu weren't tasty either, and the milk tea was awful. I wondered why it took so long to prepare, because this type of food is usually just chopped up and packed into boxes once an order is placed. It seemed like the food wasn't fresh. When I ordered, there was only one table of three customers. Now, I don't dare eat the rest of the food I ordered.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tingkat Catering

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered takeout. The first bite of the duck had a strange, waxy taste that I can't quite describe. I ordered half a duck, but one half was darker and the other lighter, as if the darker side was old. I wondered why it took so long to prepare, because this type of food is usually just chopped up and packed into boxes once an order is placed. It seemed like the food wasn't fresh. When I ordered, there was only one table of three customers. I don't dare eat the rest of the food I ordered.
sample_reviews_en.author: View

sample_reviews_en.text: Went to eat with friends... The restaurant has convenient and hassle-free parking... The atmosphere is great for eating, chatting, and having fun... Regarding the food, I have to say, fans of Chinese food will love it... I give it a very high rating, especially the braised fish with pickled cabbage; the broth is very flavorful, not too salty or sour... And another dish I must mention is the braised lamb... There's absolutely no gamey smell (I think it's better than some famous restaurants in Ekkamai!), the broth is fragrant with Chinese herbs but not pungent... The meat melts in your mouth... The stir-fried vegetables are excellent, just like those in Hong Kong... And most importantly, the price is very reasonable...
sample_reviews_en.author: Prapan Lekawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tried the Hong Kong noodles and the Szechuan Tofu rice. The former is a rare find in Bangkok, but the taste couldn't be compared to the original noodles in Hong Kong. The latter tasted fantastic. French toast was unique with peanut butter.
Prices are relatively high averaging 300baht per main course, subject to service charge and taxes. The place is located in a basic air conditioning setup, with an outdoor section for those with pets or wanting to take a smoke.
sample_reviews_en.author: S

sample_reviews_en.text:
No need to fly to Hong Kong! This place is amazing because it's made by Hong Kong locals. The food is delicious, reasonably priced, and the flavors are top-notch. The portions are huge; two people ate and couldn't finish it all, so we took some home for the next meal. The price, quality, and quantity of food are all perfect.

Anyone missing Hong Kong, or wanting to try Hong Kong food, shouldn't miss this restaurant. You have to try it! 🍽✨️🥰🐷
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirimon Chantakulvanich

sample_reviews_en.text:
Char Siu and Fried Egg Rice (TBH158) – The char siu was extremely dry, super tough, and super lean. The egg was fully cooked, and there was barely any soy sauce. The whole bowl of rice was just dry.

French Toast (TBH88) – Nothing special, just a regular peanut butter French toast.

Red Bean Ice (TBH78) – As bland as water. The red beans had no flavor, tasted like ready-made red beans, and the whole drink was unsweetened.
sample_reviews_en.author: jay kung

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing food and service . The owner is so hospitable and warm felt so comfortable because of the exceptional service given by the restaurant owner himself. He also offered us a complementary desert and soup and requested the staff to give us food early inspire of the rush at the restaurant . The food was really delicious. Felt like we just went to Hong Kong and came back . It’s surely a 10 on 10.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arpita Kamat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Revisited Mar 2025 - I ordered their Hong Kong style milk tea and a French toast. A very typical Hong Kong style afternoon tea.

Truly reminded me of tea restaurants in Hong Kong. I enjoyed the Garoupa fish soup very much.  I seldom order lemon tea in HK but it was highly recommended by a friend so I tried. Yes, 100% authentic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Yeung

restaurants.name: Sumalee Pad Thai St Louis
restaurants.address:

17 Chan 18/7 Alley, Lane 22, Thung Wat Don, Sathon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The noodles at Pad Thai Sumalee are perfectly chewy, and the flavor is rich and intense. I was happy to finally get to eat here since they're closed on Sundays, and I visited on a Saturday this time.
For parking, you need to use the snooker club's lot in the adjacent soi – it's 30 baht per hour.
I had the Pad Thai with shrimp, and the shrimp were fresh and large. The sauce was well-mixed with the noodles, creating a satisfyingly rich flavor, though I think it could be even more intense, which would be amazing. They provided a full set of accompaniments: chives, banana blossom, and crispy bean sprouts – truly complete!
The stir-fried daikon radish cake (chai tow kway) was cut into large cubes and stir-fried with egg, coating each piece. This gave it a nice chewiness and the texture wasn't mushy at all.
On the table, the condiments included clean-looking chili powder and peanuts.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aey Angel

sample_reviews_en.text:
This old-style Pad Thai shop has been open for decades. Good price, delicious, not too greasy.
The fried oysters are very crispy and delicious.
The oyster omelet is good and tastes like the ones in Chinese restaurants, but much cheaper.
The shop is clean and only accepts cash.
Parking is available on the street or in the Soi Yuang Nguan.
sample_reviews_en.author: wan wong

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're in this area, you have to order the (special) Pad Thai! It's super filling! I arrived at 1 PM sharp, so there wasn't much of a queue. If you're worried about the queue, call ahead and order in advance so you can eat when you arrive! Hehe.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr. Chokchai Metapipattanakul

sample_reviews_en.text: Best Pad Thai (ask for no chilli powder added)! This place is my go-to for Pad Thai, tried many but this has been my favorite. They have been adding topping from the classic one with prawn to sausages.  You can also try Oyster Thai Omelette …
sample_reviews_en.author: pg w

sample_reviews_en.text: This Pad Thai is 10 of 10, the flavor is amazing, the place is a little hidden, a hidden gem. I’ll definitely come back soon. The service is great, they speak English, very helpful, they ask you if you want it spicy or not 😅 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Guillermo Castrezana

sample_reviews_en.text: This was our favorite Pad Thai, we liked it so much that we ordered an extra plate even though we were full! We had both the shredded pork and plain. The seafood pancake was great as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warren Libbey

sample_reviews_en.text: The Pad Thai with thin noodles is delicious; it seems to be the auntie's special recipe. They also have fried mussels. The auntie is still in good health. The shop mainly accepts cash.
sample_reviews_en.author: saravut kitisrivoraphant

sample_reviews_en.text:
Best food, atmosphere, and friendly service

The Pad Thai I tried for the first time was the best

The fried items were very delicious, the best!

I also recommend the lemon soda!
sample_reviews_en.author: 미나리

restaurants.name: Rustic Lounge
restaurants.address:

231, 14-15 S Pattaya Rd, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐ 1/5 — Shockingly Overrated

I rarely leave harsh reviews, but Rustic Lounge at 231, 14-15 S Pattaya Rd deserves it. We ordered Fish Biryani, Mutton Biryani, and a Barbecue Platter — and every dish was a disappointment.

• The biryanis were completely tasteless. No spice, no aroma, just bland rice and dry meat.
• The barbecue platter was so dry it was practically jerky. Not just bad — genuinely inedible.
• The only dish we managed to finish was the Chicken Thai Fried Rice, and even that was just barely acceptable.

To top it off, the service was painfully slow. We waited far too long for food that wasn’t worth the wait. I’m baffled how this place has such high ratings — maybe we caught them on a bad day, but nothing about our experience was remotely good.

Would not recommend. There are far better options in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Abdul Kareem K R

sample_reviews_en.text:
**Rating: ★★★★★★★
Incredible Halal Indian Cuisine – Bursting with Flavor!**

The food here is absolutely incredible! Every bite is packed with deep, authentic flavors that transport you straight to India. The aroma of spices fills the air, making your mouth water as soon as you step in. From the rich, creamy curries to the perfectly seasoned biryanis, every dish is crafted with care and bursting with layers of taste. The naan is soft and fresh, while the tandoori meats are tender and succulent. The balance of spices is masterfully done, giving each dish a depth that is simply irresistible. If you love bold, vibrant, and flavorful food, this place is an absolute gem. Definitely one of the best halal Indian food experiences I’ve had – highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Amna Al Suwaidi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ambience of the restaurant is nice and well done, but unfortunately the overall experience was disappointing. The prices are quite high compared to the quantity of food served, which felt very less for the cost.
What made it worse was the staff behavior. We were invited to come in and place our order, but after ordering we were told that the kitchen was already closed. If the kitchen was closed, there was no reason to invite us or take the order in the first place. This felt disrespectful and very unprofessional.
Basic courtesy and clear communication were missing. Ambience alone cannot make up for poor service and lack of respect for customers. 😤
sample_reviews_en.author: Shiv

sample_reviews_en.text:
Awesome place! A huge variety of food to include Indian, Thai, Bangladesh, and Turkish. I don't think it's advertised as America but some of the things they had were American, too, and would be good for kids.

The staff was great. Very accommodating and polite.

Not sure if it was just a different style but I did feel like the butter chicken curry was extremely buttery. I've had the same curry at multiple other Indian restaurants and they were all good. Here, it comes to you with the pile of butter just sitting on top and even after stirring it in all you tasted was butter. Perks, it did have a lot of chicken though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anthony S

sample_reviews_en.text: Asli is a Bangladeshi restaurant. The food is beyond excellent. We ate chicken biryani, rice, ayran (yogurt drink), and tandoor bread. Everything was delicious. We loved it. The owners are Muslim. The food is halal. However, the place and products are very luxurious. The prices are reasonable. We ate four different dishes for the price of one kebab in Istanbul. It's newly opened. It needs support. The expenses are high. Don't look for another place. Come here. You'll thank me... Guaranteed. By the way, 1 baht is now 1 lira. We used to get 5 baht for 1 lira. Ah, those were the days.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bulent Aylı

sample_reviews_en.text: I just forgot the word to describe this restaurant. It completely makes you feel like you’re at home, enjoying your mother’s cooking! Absolutely delicious. I’m from Bangladesh and had been looking for a good restaurant for the last two days. I was very upset with the food at other restaurants and felt sick from not having good food. Then I found this lounge thanks to ChatGPT. Yes, you heard that right—ChatGPT! I was a bit unsure before arriving, but the excellent service and delicious food at Rustic Lounge compelled me to write this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Imtiaz Ahmed

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for the best Bengali Desi food restaurant in Pattaya, look no further! Rustic Lounge house co; ltd is best option!
The food quality here is exceptional, and the service is truly remarkable. The owner, Mr. Monsur, is a genuinely humble person who adds to the welcoming atmosphere. You won’t be disappointed with your dining experience at this fantastic establishment!
sample_reviews_en.author: Neha Kong

sample_reviews_en.text: This is very unfortunate that we found this restaurant just before our departure from Pattaya. Found very clean and cozy environment. The food was exceptionally tasty. It is not only to meet our hunger but it gave us a feel of family outing. We will miss this restaurant. I highly recommend to visit at least once. Btw the owner and staff's behaviour was mesmerising too...
sample_reviews_en.author: Mustafiz

restaurants.name: Saffron Thai Restaurant
restaurants.address:

21, 100 S Sathon Rd, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Saffron Thai Restaurant, located in a high-rise building in Bangkok, boasts stunning views and exquisite cuisine.

---
When dining in Thailand, Saffron Thai Restaurant is definitely a restaurant worth making a special trip to. The views from its high-rise location are breathtaking, overlooking the entire city at night. The atmosphere is elegant and romantic, perfect for celebrations or important occasions. The food is also of exceptional quality, with meticulous attention to detail and layering from appetizers to main courses. The spices, the balance of spiciness and sourness, and the freshness of the seafood are all handled flawlessly, perfectly showcasing the essence of Thai cuisine with a modern twist.

The service staff are friendly and attentive, handling everything from introducing the dishes to the pace of serving, making the overall dining experience even more complete. The restaurant itself has a subtle aroma and a comfortable atmosphere, which, combined with the view from the window seats, makes it hard to leave.

If you're looking for a Thai restaurant with great views, exquisite cuisine, and excellent service, Saffron should definitely be on your list.
sample_reviews_en.author: 王哲忞 Ivan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a truly wonderful experience at Saffron Thai Restaurant. The food was absolutely delicious – authentic flavors, beautifully presented, and cooked with such care. What made my visit even more special was the warm and attentive service. Khun Namfon took such great care of us, making sure everything was perfect and always welcoming us with a kind smile. She made us feel at home throughout the evening.

I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for an authentic Thai dining experience with exceptional hospitality. I will definitely come back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyawan Rojrachsombat

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there using JTB's early booking special.
Everything was delicious and I was satisfied, but the food was basically Asian-style, and the only dishes that really defined Thailand were the curry and dessert.

We followed the dress code properly, but there were some old men wearing sneakers, so I wondered if they would be a little more lenient.

I had wondered if it was really necessary to go to the trouble of having a fancy hotel dinner overseas, but it was nice to be able to have a meal like this for at least one day overseas.
sample_reviews_en.author: やってみた

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went to Safron just to check if they could still accommodate us while knowing that they were fully booked. But after checking they found a table for us.
It was well worth a visit to indulge in the Thai cuisine at its best form and presentation. The spices they used was a real treat to our palates but don’t be deceived by the size of their servings on the pictures on their menu because after the meal we both felt we ordered too much. Service was excellent and but lighting was a bit too dim for us.
sample_reviews_en.author: TimeTravelPassion

sample_reviews_en.text:
Horrible service and arrogant staff. Went in on a relatively empty day and had to wait 45mins because the staff forgot to place the order.

I think he did that cause he wanted to sell us the set menu in the end. That's what he offered when we chased him for our food.

When we requested to escalate the issue in between the staff said he is the manager and whatever complaints I had, I had to speak to him.

Service and food is not worth it even if you have complimentary coupon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chirag Bhatia

sample_reviews_en.text: Our family and friends of 11 dined at the Saffron last night. We ordered tom yoong soup, softshell crab green papaya salad, fried squid( the squid ink sauce was sooo yummy ) red beef curry, green chicken curry, sea bream, morning glory, and mixed vegetables. All were delicious, fresh ingredients with great sauce. The four different kinds of rice were good to go with the dishes. We would totally recommend friends to come dine here. Our server Namlos S. was super helpful!
sample_reviews_en.author: Vivian

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great Experience

The place has a really nice atmosphere, calm, inviting, and not too noisy.
I love the classic style of the space, and the food is absolutely fabulous.

The flavors are well-balanced and everything feels thoughtfully prepared. The service, especially from Khun Ying and her team, are warm and welcoming, which makes the whole experience even better. Definitely a spot worth visiting!
sample_reviews_en.author: VW Bureechana

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ms. KORN’s hospitality and guidance were exceptionally thoughtful, which allowed us to fully enjoy the dining experience.
The food was excellent, and the combination of the beautiful night view and the comfortable, relaxing seating made the evening even more special.
We truly appreciated the warm and attentive service throughout our visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuki MAKINO

restaurants.name: LengHong RYUHO - เล่งหงษ์ ริวโฮ
restaurants.address:

Rama II Rd, Bang Mot, Chom Thong, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
F&B: Fresh, clean, and excellent quality for the price.
Service: Staff are attentive and friendly.
Price: Great value for money considering the quality of the food.
Environment: Clean, simple, and comfortable. There's a slight odor, but it's not unpleasant.
Note: Currently, there's a buffet promotion for ฿999/person, and it's reduced to ฿899/person for groups of two or more, making it incredibly worthwhile.
sample_reviews_th.author: BigYee

sample_reviews_en.text: The allure of unlimited fish roe at an 899 baht net buffet was enough to drive all the way from Lat Krabang, across the river! But it was totally worth it. The food was incredibly fresh and the fish roe was truly unlimited. It was so delicious I forgot to take pictures! I ate so much I only have a few photos 😅 But you absolutely can't miss the steamed buns. I especially loved the jade beard and taro with ginkgo nut buns 😇 We had a reservation for 3 PM and waited over half an hour for our food, which is understandable given the large number of customers and a wedding taking place that day. However, around 4 PM, with only a few tables left, the food came out faster. The staff were friendly and provided excellent service, so the initial wait wasn't a problem at all. This is definitely a restaurant I'll be back to again 👍🏻🥰 I love fish roe 🟠🟠🟠
sample_reviews_en.author: Oil Nana

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dear Mr. Song, I am a friend of Petch Grand Ex. On February 13th, 2026, I planned to dine at your restaurant, arriving around noon. However, the staff said we were fully booked, which confused me greatly. I checked Facebook and there was no such announcement. The staff said they were so busy serving only the customers already seated that they couldn't keep up. Their demeanor suggested they weren't very willing to serve. I had planned to go and wasted a lot of time driving a long distance, risking my safety on Rama 2 Road. If you're not prepared, don't advertise to attract customers. Furthermore, there was no prior notification. I personally like you, Mr. Song; I watch your show often, and I'm very close to Petch. We're good friends. If you need any information, please contact me.

Wijak Asawalertpanich
sample_reviews_en.author: วิจักขณ์ อัศวเลิศพานิช

sample_reviews_en.text: We went to the Japanese buffet section for the first time, last Sunday around noon. The staff were very polite, helpful, and provided excellent service. We had a 7-year-old with us, and when they served the steamed egg custard, the staff member warned us to be careful as it was hot, with a loving look in their eyes. We were very grateful. The staff were very courteous, gradually clearing our table after we had finished eating. The overall atmosphere in the restaurant was relaxed, unhurried, and warm. Everything was delicious. Even the dark-skinned valet parking attendant was attentive, waving cars and holding an umbrella for customers during the light rain. The staff here seem to have a genuine desire to serve. I'm really happy for the owner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Watcharee Sae-nai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried the 899 net buffet and was impressed by many things.

Atmosphere: Pleasant and relaxing. The meticulous decor creates a very relaxing and comfortable atmosphere. It's perfect for spending quality time with family, friends, or your loved one.

Food: Fresh and diverse. All ingredients are fresh and of excellent quality, from seafood and meat to vegetables. The seasoning is superb, well-balanced, and delicious in every dish I tried. There's also a wide variety of choices.

Service: Attentive to detail. The staff are very caring and attentive, providing excellent, quick, and thoughtful service. This includes replenishing food, clearing plates, and inquiring about customer satisfaction, making the meal even more enjoyable and memorable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tawan Boonithee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Leng Hong Ryuho is a Japanese buffet restaurant with prices of 699 baht (599 baht for 2 or more people) and 999 baht (899 baht for 2 or more people).
We came with 4 people, so we got the 899 baht price, which included one bowl of shark fin soup per person. The sashimi was fresh and delicious. However, there was a considerable wait after ordering, which might slightly affect the score. But the ingredients were fresh and definitely worth the price, both the service and the food quality. Steamed buns take 20 minutes to prepare, as this was stated. Sashimi also requires waiting, so if it's running low, order gradually.
I highly recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natemiseiko

sample_reviews_en.text: The food service was extremely slow. Some of the items we ordered were served at the same time as items ordered by other tables, and took several rounds to arrive. Some items we ordered as soon as we entered the restaurant took almost an hour to arrive. The fish was only moderately fresh. The sushi rice was hard, almost undercooked. Many items were out of stock and we had to ask the staff to find out. One visit is enough. I hope they improve their service and order processing speed because many customers were complaining about the slow service. By the time the food arrived, our meal was over, and we had to keep asking for it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Makawan Suakum

sample_reviews_en.text: The ingredients were incredibly fresh, fresher than many well-known places I've eaten at. At first, I hesitated and considered going to another place because I'd never eaten here before, but choosing this place was definitely the right decision. The quality was excellent, the food was well-prepared, and everything was incredibly fresh. The food came out super fast because it wasn't crowded, and most importantly, you can order as many pieces as you want – no forced set meals! I didn't regret spending the money at all. I'll definitely find time to go back again; I was most impressed by the freshness of the ingredients.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natnicha Tantiwongvatin

restaurants.name: Sam chicken shawarma
restaurants.address:

290 Soi Samran Rat, Khwaeng Samran Rat, Khet Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered Mixed Veg, Rice, Veg Fried Rice and Chicken Wrap for Lunch, it tasted so good that we did a take out of Veg Wraps and Chicken Wrap for Dinner as well. They can customize based on how spicy you want it. Also, the lady who cooks the food is super nice and friendly. As others have mentioned, the paratha(bread) for wrap is made fresh along with everything else and  the wrap bread stayed soft even many hours when we had it for dinner. The Indian curry tastes just like they make in Indian homes. The food was pretty inexpensive with Chicken Wrap costing 70 THB and Veg wraps costing 60 THB. Everything tastes so great, i definitely recommend it to anyone who wants to enjoy Indian food or wraps or just a great meal in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pari

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’m very sorry, but unfortunately I can’t leave a positive review for this place.

I ordered paneer butter masala, which was priced at 200 on the menu. They also offered a regular paneer curry for 150. Unfortunately, I have the impression that I was served the regular curry, even though I paid for the butter masala.

The dish did not have the characteristic creamy, buttery tomato flavor typical of butter masala. It also didn’t look like butter masala — it simply tasted like a regular curry.

Additionally, for the first time in my life, I was served naan that looked like this. I often dine at Indian restaurants and have never received anything like it before. It did not taste like traditional naan at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natalia

sample_reviews_en.text: I never give bad reviews; I just don't go back, but my experience was awful yesterday, and I'm still in it. I wanted to get a shawarma, so went to your restaurant. The lady was talking to a friend loudly and angrily.  Her treatment towards me was minimal, and somewhat harsh!; to a point of feeling like I was a nuisance to her. I almost got up a few times to leave but I stayed. That was unfortunate for me because I ended up with food poisoning, which I'm still dealing with. I've spent a lot of time in Thailand, and I've never gotten sick from the food, nor been treated like I wasn't wanted. Not a great dynamic!
sample_reviews_en.author: D. S. Cullom

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sam Chicken Shawarma on Soi Samran Rat is a great spot for fresh, flavorful shawarma. The roasted chicken is juicy and well seasoned, and the veggies are nicely seasoned too—all packed together with loads of flavor in a satisfying portion.

I played it safe with the spice level and ordered “nit noi”, then tuned it to perfection with a bit of Sriraja Panich on the side. Works perfectly.

The place has a lively, energetic vibe, making it a fun stop while exploring the area. If you’re a shawarma or Indian food fan, this is definitely a place worth visiting. I’ll be back for sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Farangondiet

sample_reviews_en.text: Normally, it costs me a lot more for Indian food around this area, but this place offers affordable everyday prices, good taste, and generous portions. The shop may look closed when there are no customers, but you shouldn’t hesitate to visit. I had chickpea curry with rice, and it cost me only 70 THB. It's a great spot for lunch before exploring the area or spending the afternoon at the nearby public park.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chainaphat Channak

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a local shop, and Indian inspired food. The best part is that it's the most affordable Indian food in Bangkok and made fresh and the wait is short. The roti is huge and every baht spent is worth the taste. It's perfect for vegetarians as there is paneer, Dahl and other vegetable dishes. The owner's friendly their oldest son is genuinely helpful. Languages spoken is Thai and English.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wajdi Edross

sample_reviews_en.text: Brilliant street food! I went to eat to this place after craving some chicken. We ate a briyani and a chicken wrap, it was excellent. We requested the food to be spicy and were impressed with the dish. If you like some authentic Indian fusion street food you can’t go wrong here. It  is a family run restaurant and they do look after you. The prices are very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vithusan Raveendran

sample_reviews_en.text:
Vegetarian options
💚🌱💚🌱💚

Ordered the lentil dal and rice plate
100 Baht

Was medium in spiciness
Dish was plated nicely with some fresh, raw vegetables (cucumber, lime and onion slices)

Young son was the server for the evening
So sweet

Food was very tasty and reasonably priced

I would return
I woukd recommend
👍💜👍💜👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Jia Moon

restaurants.name: วราภรณ์ ซาลาเปา บางจาก เกษตร-นวมินทร์
restaurants.address:

สถานีบริการน้ำมันบางจาก เกษตร 88/1 นวมินทร์ Chorakhe Bua, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This modern-style steamed bun shop has a beautiful and clean-looking interior, instilling confidence in its quality and hygiene. They have implemented disease screening measures:
controlling the number of people entering the shop, using temperature checks, and having partitions for ordering, payment, and pickup.
The prices are slightly higher than typical shops.
The dough and fillings are excellent, generously portioned, and delicious. They offer a variety of menu items, and the service is good and fast. Some customers buy large quantities for catering or as snacks.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุวภัทร ชํานาญวนกิจ

sample_reviews_en.text:
This branch is located in a Bangchak gas station. The shop's decor is pleasing to the eye.
The furniture colors are beautiful. I arrived before noon and almost didn't get to eat. Luckily, I got the last two mantou buns!!!
They were so delicious! The buttery toast was fragrant and crispy.
13 baht each. If you haven't tried them yet,
I highly recommend them. They're so tasty you'll be hooked. You can also order them in sets.
They also have custard/condensed milk fillings.
I like to eat them plain, toasted, with coffee or cocoa, it's delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naerunyaporn Rodlak

sample_reviews_en.text:
These steamed buns are so good, even if you buy them in the morning and eat them in the evening, the dough is still soft and not tough. They're even better if you eat them hot right after they're steamed... I ordered so many things, way more than I could eat, but they were all delicious!

I can't forget to mention the "Bak Kut Teh." It exceeded my expectations; I've had Bak Kut Teh elsewhere that were more peppery, but here the herbal stew flavor was very distinct. If you like that kind of flavor, I recommend trying it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Fox ChiLala

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff at this branch provided good service, even though I only visited once.
I ordered 6 dumplings.
I thought they would give me a large box.
I ordered 3 different kinds, 2 dumplings of each.
I asked them how to tell which dumpling had which filling.
They described the fillings.
When paying, I asked if I could use a card.
They said they had just installed the machine and it wasn't convenient yet.

When I received the order, they gave me a small box with the fillings written on it.
Good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nisarat Niramitvasu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything was great, and I really like Waraporn; it's delicious. The only thing I didn't like was the service at this branch; the chubby employee wasn't very polite.
I'd like to see that improved, especially the way she speaks to customers. I understand the staff might be tired, but we're customers too.
Compared to the Sukhumvit 5 branch, the service is excellent.
Even when I visited in the evening, the service was still great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Weesuda Teetha

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I stopped by Waraporn Steamed Buns shop 🥟🥢 and it was amazing! I can honestly say their steamed buns are genuinely good, no exaggeration 👀. They also have tons of other menu items 😋, so many to choose from! I'll definitely be back next time 👍 #WarapornSteamedBuns #DeliciousRecommendation
sample_reviews_en.author: Manrut Hamarungka

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff were very polite. The steamed buns were big, with generous fillings, and delicious 😋
The prices were reasonable. The restaurant was spacious, beautifully decorated, and had plenty of parking.
They also had burgers 🍔 on the menu that looked very tempting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alldays Daily

sample_reviews_en.text: We regularly buy Waraporn's steamed buns and dumplings at home. It's so convenient that they're located in a gas station on the way to Kasetsart University Veterinary Hospital. We can stop by to use the restroom and buy some to give to the vet – happy happy!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rungnapa Dachpibulyos

restaurants.name: Bur Bar คาเฟ่ & บาร์ ถนนพระอาทิตย์ พระนคร
restaurants.address:

8, 134 Phra Athit Rd, Chana Songkhram, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really had a bad experience.After finishing my food I was going to sit in the outdoor which is in the road to smoke. As there is a couple beside my chair i tried to move a bit distant as they don't feel uncomfortable. Owner stopped me from moving the chair and i stopped but after a few second he took the chair so that i cant sit. You should actually know how to behave with customer.
Now come to the food, its good but the portion size is sooo small like its a kids meal. And very important this is they don't provide any drink menu, they play a bad strategy over here. For a 250ml coke they charge you 40 bhat without providing any ice or glass whereas you can get a coke in 10-15 bhat in all over the bangkok. If you charge that much higher you should mention it in menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zabed Zeffry

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honestly, the best burger I've had in MY LIFE!  I'm not kidding when I tell you this.  I'm from North America, I've eaten burgers all over the world, and this is by far the best.

The burger seasoning was unlike anything I've tried before because they put their Thai spin on it, the buns were fluffy and cooked to perfection, and the service was top notch.  I ordered a single cheese beef burger and my partner ordered a double cheeseburger - both were absolutely delicious - that we ordered another one!

Wow!  Why do I always discover the best eats in my last night in Bangkok?!
sample_reviews_en.author: Adelita

sample_reviews_en.text:
A clean and amazing place

I can honestly say it’s currently the best place I’ve eaten at in Bangkok.
The staff are incredibly classy, friendly, and welcoming. Every time I visit, I meet different people there, and each one is special in their own way.

The food is healthy, fresh, and delicious. Yesterday I tried the cheeseburger, and it was so good that I wanted to take a picture… but I forgot because I was too excited to eat it 😄

I recommend everyone to try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: HASSAN ASHAD

sample_reviews_en.text:
I walked past this little eatery and was enticed in by a cool photograph of a burger on the wall. What a great find!

The burger was delicious and the perfect size for me. The decor is funky. The music chilled. The service is quietly non-invasive, so I lingered for quite a while. I was gifted a little bowl of fresh grapes after my meal, which topped it off perfectly.

I really like this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tracy Wilkinson

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very serious place! Delicious real coffee!
The caramel apple pancakes have a very soft, airy texture, and the combination of flavors is fantastic. 😍
And the peanut butter bun is made with real peanut butter, not some artificial flavor like most places.
Everything was very, very delicious! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
A breakfast-pancake place in the morning, and a burger place after 5 in the afternoon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eszter Mónika Koczinger

sample_reviews_en.text: Really great home-made burgers and good fries. The owner made it all by himself in his very hot kitchen! He even got us an ice-tea from next doors because he didn't have it himself. Hard working guy, with lovely burgers! He has around 4 tables with room for around 12 people inside and like 6 people outside, in a cosy atmosphere. No 5 points because of the road next doors.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fenno Duijvesteijn

sample_reviews_en.text: The burgers were delicious. We had the double cheeseburger. Be warned if you don't like spicy food because the sauce is a little hot, but nothing that will ruin the meal. The fries my boyfriend had were good, and I had the hash browns, which I also enjoyed. We would definitely go back if we had more time in Bangkok. The guy who served us was lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: María Alejandra Suárez

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing! We arrive and he was staring to close (it was 22ish in a slow Monday), but with a great smile he told us that no problem to have dinner.
