I had the huge burger and it may be one of the best burgers ever. Wanted to take a picture but I was lost in it. Great experience. Ah! They also have fancy coffee and other stuff
sample_reviews_en.author: Cristobal Bragagnolo

restaurants.name: Apple vegan cafe & restaurant ร้านอาหารเจ คาเฟ่เจ
restaurants.address:

WVGQ+XG3, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a completely vegetarian restaurant. The owners are very friendly and polite. The owner's wife speaks good English, so communication wasn't a problem!

I highly recommend the fruit juices. You can mix fruits and vegetables; I ordered carrots and beets! However, be aware that mixing two different types of fruits and vegetables adds to the price of one drink (35+35), which seemed a bit overpriced. I only realized this after seeing the bill.

So, I suggest ordering only one type of fruit or vegetable.

But seeing the bill wasn't great.

The owner kindly offered an option to order without sugar!

I also ordered a mango smoothie, which was delicious even without sugar. The mango was quite tart, but the mango itself was sweet enough!

We also ordered green curry and tom yum soup, both very authentic and delicious! Rich and flavorful!

Rice was ordered separately. One serving was enough for two people, as the rice bowls were quite large.

Personally, I think the green curry is tastier, but it's on the sweeter side and can get a bit cloying towards the end. Tom Yum soup is just average—it's delicious too!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yue Zhen Li

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wow! 🤩 This vegetarian restaurant truly blew my mind! 🌱💥 I honestly didn’t expect vegetarian food to taste THIS good! 😍

I tried their plant-based “chicken” 🍗 and “pork” 🍖 — and let me tell you, it was absolutely DELICIOUS! 🤤 You wouldn’t even guess it’s not real meat. The texture was perfect, the flavor was rich and savory, and every bite was full of goodness! 🥢🌿

The seasoning was just spot on 👌 — not too salty, not too bland. Everything was balanced perfectly. The presentation was also beautiful, and the portions were generous. 🍽️✨

The staff was super friendly 😊, the place was clean 🧼, and the atmosphere felt cozy and peaceful 🌸. I could feel the love they put into every dish 💚.

As a vegetarian (and even if you’re not!), this is honestly one of the best places I’ve ever eaten at! 🌍💚 Whether you’re curious about plant-based food or a long-time veggie lover — this spot is a MUST-VISIT! ✅

I’m definitely coming back again — many times! 🔁🥰
Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Thank you for such an amazing experience! 🙏🍴💚🌱
sample_reviews_en.author: mr. Guru

sample_reviews_en.text: Pattaya has loads of vegetarian restaurants but only a few totally vegan places. I love Apple Vegan Cafe and I hope it succeeds. It's run by a husband and wife—the husband operates a juice, smoothie, and coffee stand out front, and the wife cooks in the back kitchen. She speaks pretty good English and she's super nice, in addition to having a hard-core work ethic. Most dishes are heavy on vegetables and quite healthy. The menu is loaded with delicious vegan meat offerings made by a local Buddhist supplier. I especially recommend the sea bass and duck items, but you can't go wrong with anything on the menu. A big meal comes to around 200 baht. Whether you're vegan or just want a cheap and delicious meal loaded with healthy veggies, consider this place a must-visit. Opens for breakfast and closes late.
sample_reviews_en.author: Erik Marcus

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food here is literally like you went to grandmas house and she cooked a hearty meal for you with love. The owner and her family run it out of their home and the three do all the cooking and serving on their own. Half of the things we ordered, they just ran across the street to grab ingredients to make for us 😂 they were so so sweet, and the food is so yummy. We loved this place so much we went back the next day.
Please note: the older woman Spoke very very little English so if you’re not a Thai speaker, it’s good to come prepared with some research on basic phrases (eg, She didn’t understand us when we tried to order a bottle of water in English) but her daughter speaks very good English and is usually there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nikita Buggo

sample_reviews_en.text: We were excited to try this place bit unfortunately the portion of food my husband received was offensively small. It was at least 3 times smaller than it should be. He ordered spaghetti carbonara and left hungry and very disappointed. He was really offended that they gave him such a small portion. It was not more than 100 grams. Unfortunately I can't recommend this place and am surprised by its high scote as it is below mediocre taste wise also.
sample_reviews_en.author: Merlin Taş

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was good.  My girl is the vegan but I got to make her happy.   Owners daughter was playing what sounded like YouTube videos on the side but kids will be kids.  It kind of killed some of the romantic mood to be forced to listen to a child's loud play list, but the owners seemed to be on top of everything else.
Small family atmosphere was enjoyable to dine in.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tour guide to thousands

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is simple in this family vegan restaurant, but the food is fresh, delicious and inexpensive. And the husband and wife who operate it are delightful. The husband operates the smoothie bar while the wife appears to be doing all the cooking. Smoothies can be made to order, eg., no sugar and with or without “smoothie powder.”
sample_reviews_en.author: David Davidoff

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s good they offer vegan, but I waited almost an hour for two pancakes without syrup that looked made 5 minutes prior. At the time of writing this the sandwich still hasn’t arrived. It feels like they took a break after I made my order, so I wasted a part of my day just waiting and wondering why. Not recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrew Elizaga

restaurants.name: Suklert Burger & Halal Food
restaurants.address:

23 Soi Chulalongkorn 5, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the best papaya salad in this area and in my life, especially the Luang Prabang style. It's perfectly balanced – salty, sour, and savory, not too sweet, but not so salty that you need to drink water constantly. I could easily finish a whole plate by myself.
The grilled chicken is slightly crispy on the edges, tender and juicy inside, not dry, with crispy skin. The flavor is just right, not too spicy, but it pairs perfectly with the papaya salad. Delicious, not too salty.
Their grilled meats are also excellent. The grilled beef is delicious, chewy but not tough. The spicy beef salad is perfect, with just the right balance of salt, sourness, spiciness, and the aroma of roasted rice. I always order a lot and never worry about not being able to finish it all because I always finish every plate. The sticky rice is also soft but not soggy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Minhyun Hwang

sample_reviews_en.text:
To be honest, the management on the day I ate there was terrible.
Tables were served in a "first come, first served" manner, even those ordered later were served first.
The wait for food was extremely long, which we understood, but!!! When the food finally arrived, the grilled meat was ice cold. I was confused about what we were waiting for. Personally, on the day I visited, there was another table of customers being very noisy. I asked the staff to please ask that group to be quieter for the sake of everyone's space. We were there to eat, not to listen to people talking; it completely ruined our mood. The staff acknowledged the issue but did nothing to inform us. We just endured it, hurried to finish eating, and paid the bill. Please improve this. (This is my personal opinion based on my actual experience and payment.)
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนพล เชน

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious Halal Street Food!

Suklert serves up one of the best halal burgers I’ve had .. juicy, flavorful, and served on a soft, fresh bun.

The fries were crispy and perfectly seasoned, with tasty dipping sauces on the side.

Everything is freshly made and super affordable. The casual outdoor seating gives it a relaxed, local vibe.

Definitely worth checking out if you’re in the area and craving halal fast food!
sample_reviews_en.author: A.A.

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant's food is incredibly delicious. I was amazed from the very first bite. I personally love spicy food, so I asked the restaurant for a spicier version, and they delivered exactly what I requested. The flavors were rich and perfectly suited my taste. I was extremely impressed. If you like spicy food like me, you absolutely have to try this place. You won't be disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanthip Phatthanawiwat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Seconde Time that I come to eat here
Ordered 2 times the same meal and never disappointed
Burger super juicy, chiken pop delicious and not oily just perfectly cook, really stunning and super affordable.
I will come back again for sure
No picture unfortunately I just smashed my plate 😅
sample_reviews_en.author: Dany Rekik

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sitting outside offers a better atmosphere.
The inside might lack ventilation fans.
It's probably still under renovation.
The spicy salad is delicious, and the beef burger is also tasty.
For a halal restaurant in the Chulalongkorn University area, Banthat Thong, this one is a winner.
sample_reviews_en.author: neemrA trammoS

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service staff were excellent, lovely, and helpful.
There's a prayer room and ablution facilities.
The restrooms are well-equipped.
The Luang Prabang papaya salad was delicious and spicy.
The grilled chicken had just the right flavor.
I recommend the beef burger.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fa Za

sample_reviews_en.text: The first time I came for a consultation, I liked the doctor's advice. I went home to decide and then decided to come back for surgery with the doctor. The doctor is lovely, and all the nurses are lovely, especially Nurse Aomsin; I really like her.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patchada Jirasawanont

restaurants.name: Spaghetti Indy
restaurants.address:

Ratchadaphisek Rd, Talat Phlu, ธนบุรี, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
#Food#
-Spaghetti: I ordered the Carbonara with Ham and Bacon.
It's a common spaghetti dish, but the restaurant made it exceptionally well. It was delicious!
The creaminess wasn't cloying at all, and the crispy bacon was a perfect combination.
-Basil Pork Rice: This was an authentic basil pork dish, without any green beans or other vegetables to interfere. The taste was surprisingly delicious, especially considering it was supposed to be in a spaghetti restaurant. The rice was high-quality jasmine rice, which was noticeable.
-Drinks: The restaurant only offers water on the menu.

#Service#
The staff were very welcoming.
Even though I went around 6 pm and the restaurant was full, the staff managed the queue efficiently.

Overall, everything was excellent – ​​the food, taste, and price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Super Joe NTP

sample_reviews_en.text:
In terms of taste, the pasta is around 3.5 stars, but the value for money earns it a 4.
It was a cool day so the lack of air-conditioning didn’t bother me, though it might be uncomfortable when it’s hot.
Pasta is inexpensive with many choices, but alcohol is not available. The scallop truffle cream pasta was flavorful and coated the fettuccine nicely, but the scallops seemed to be imitation, something like a scallop-like fish cake?, which makes the price feel a bit high. The carbonara was on the simpler side and nothing impressive.
Satisfying for the price, though probably not a repeat visit for me.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gourmet Advisor

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have to say, I've been a customer since the restaurant first opened. The quality of the food remains consistently good, the portions are generous, and the prices are very reasonable, making it easy to eat there frequently. If I get bored with the same menu items after a while, I can always ask the chef if they can make something different. If they have the ingredients or can make it, they always do. It's a really lovely restaurant.

During crab season, they offer angel hair pasta with crab, but my boyfriend wanted rice, so we ordered stir-fried basil pork with crab over rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: sally cha

sample_reviews_en.text:
The spaghetti restaurant is located inside The First Night Market, and it’s an absolute hidden gem.

I’ve traveled all over the world and lived in the United States for more than 30 years, and I can honestly say this is the best pasta I’ve ever had. What impresses me most is their consistency, they somehow make every dish taste just as incredible every single time.

My favorite is the Chicken Pesto Pasta. I don’t know what their secret is, but they absolutely nail it on every visit. If you’re anywhere nearby, this place is a must-try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Alice Kan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried the spaghetti and it was amazing! Great price too.
-Carbonara: The sauce was quite rich. Overall, it was good. The pasta was well-cooked, the sauce tasted great, and they gave a generous amount of bacon and other ingredients. I personally loved it. For 99 baht, I recommend it.
-Fettuccine with Creamy Chicken Sauce: The sauce was good, and the pasta was perfectly cooked.

The staff were lovely and provided good service. At a cheap price, I want to try other menu items next time. I'll definitely go back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Cherry Ja

sample_reviews_en.text: A restaurant specializing in pasta. A wide variety of pasta dishes with diverse sauces and accompaniments. It's quite rare in Thailand to find a non-Italian restaurant that offers so many excellent pasta dishes. A must-try and much more... The service is fast. The dishes are prepared right in front of you, giving you a clear view of your order. To place your order, a menu with beautiful photos and a number for each dish is provided; simply find the number on the order slip to easily order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bernard Fti

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is not far from my condo and Talat Phlu market. Whenever I can't decide what to eat, I often come here. Everything on the menu is delicious. I personally love the sous vide chicken breast with both sauces. They also have a new menu item that meat lovers will surely enjoy: the AUS beef striploin with penne and gravy – the meat is juicy and the sauce is perfectly balanced. The service is also excellent; attentive and helpful in explaining and recommending dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: mint miyazaki

sample_reviews_en.text: The price, taste, and quantity are completely mismatched. This dish is 129 baht; in a major hotel or shopping mall, it would cost 300-500 baht, but this is genuinely only 129 baht. I was surprised when it was served. I don't usually eat Western food at outside restaurants; I've had bad experiences with two places before, but this was so delicious I wanted to order more, but I was alone. The portion was huge, and I still haven't finished it. I'll definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tong Chupong

restaurants.name: Yang Noey Kasetsart University
restaurants.address:

1979/2 ตลาดมดแดง Phahonyothin Rd, Lat Yao, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Grilled Butter BBQ at Kasetsart University 🐷🧈🔥
For all you BBQ buffet lovers, you have to come to this place! The atmosphere is super trendy and youthful 😆 It's always crowded, but they have everything: pork, beef, seafood, vegetables, side dishes – everything you could want 🥓🦐🥬

The prices are very reasonable. The buffet starts at around 200-300 baht, with unlimited time and unlimited refills of drinks. They have a wide selection of sweet drinks and soft drinks 🥤✨

📌 Little tip:
If you come in the evening or on Friday-Saturday, we recommend coming before opening time because it gets very crowded.
📍 Location: In front of Kasetsart University (near the Ngamwongwan gate)
⏰ Opening hours: Approximately 4 PM – 11 PM
sample_reviews_en.author: Vanida AEKKATIN

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to this BBQ restaurant today, February 14th, 2026, and the staff was terrible. My boyfriend and I arrived around 7 PM and ordered meat from three staff members (two women and one man), but we never received our order. Meanwhile, two tables that arrived after us and right next to us received theirs. Isn't that confusing? If the staff forgot or weren't paying attention to customers, they should consider reprimanding them. Honestly, it was a very unpleasant experience. Everything else was great except for this! I understand there were fewer staff today, but getting our food before those who ordered earlier is impolite. You can check the security camera footage to see what time we arrived!
sample_reviews_en.author: นพมาศ บุญสงคราม

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is crowded these days, so you might have to wait in line for a bit.
I came today but they were out of ice cream and watermelon.
I'm so disappointed! Before, they had two ice cream freezers, now there's only one.
I thought they would refill it constantly because it's so crowded.
In short, I didn't get to eat any ice cream today. The last time I came, the ice cream was amazing.
They had many flavors, but today they didn't have any spare ice cream or watermelon.
sample_reviews_en.author: imvwie

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a nice open layout and is conveniently accessible by BTS Skytrain. Parking is limited, so arrive early. The dipping sauce is flavorful and not too spicy. The meat is good quality. The stir-fried mushrooms with butter are tasty but a bit oily. The pork sausage salad had some bone fragments. The menu isn't very diverse. I saw other reviews mentioning squid eggs and salmon, but I didn't see any. Too bad! 😑 The staff provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Keaw Koong

sample_reviews_en.text: They miscalculated the bill for our table, charging for four people instead of three. I only realized this after I got home and saw the bill. I don't want a refund, I just want the staff to be more careful. At first, I thought the price had gone up, so I checked the price on their page, but it was still the same. Then I did the math and realized they charged for four people instead of our table. What a mess! 🥹🥹
sample_reviews_en.author: waraporn japromsen

sample_reviews_en.text: My friends and I were waiting for like 2hrs coz the tabels were not enough and people who already finished just sit and chat though a lot of people in line were waiting with an empty stomach. The quality of food is OK due to price. So my suggestions is u must come early for a table and make sure that day  wasn't a special day or holiday otherwise u may have end up like us :(
sample_reviews_en.author: Punnapop Nagamati

sample_reviews_en.text:
There are far fewer staff now, but I can see their effort.
The food quality is just okay. The tender pork was still pink even after cooking. The pork in the large platter seemed more like ham than fresh pork. The beef in the smaller platter had tendons that were difficult to chew. It used to be much better when the restaurant first opened. I hope the restaurant will improve.
sample_reviews_en.author: ryho

sample_reviews_en.text: The service staff were all excellent. The food quality was average, but running out of pork and having customers wait in line is unacceptable. My first visit was unimpressive. There was a shortage of food, ice was gone, pork and shrimp were out of stock. I urge management or the owner to improve this urgently, especially in this highly competitive market, or face bankruptcy.
sample_reviews_en.author: กฤตพล ทองงาม

restaurants.name: Liaoning Dumpling House
restaurants.address:

14/44 Srinagarindra Rd, Nong Bon, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has two branches; this is the Srinakarin branch.
It's located in the alley opposite Paradise Park.
There's convenient parking.
The restaurant has two floors, with a simple, homey, Chinese-style decor.

I like the round tables; they make it easy to serve yourself.
The menu is huge!
The portion sizes are quite large.

For example, the braised fish with pickled mustard greens only comes in one size, served in a pot.
I wish they offered a smaller size for 2-3 people so they could share.

The braised fish with pickled mustard greens was incredibly delicious, flavorful, and not fishy at all. It was truly amazing. You can order the chili separately so even children can eat it (it's a bit sour).

Other dishes were tasty, typical of this type of Chinese restaurant, but nothing as impressive as the braised fish with pickled mustard greens.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachi Zhang

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a nice, spacious atmosphere and isn't stuffy. The staff were very helpful in recommending dishes, pointing out things that were too spicy and recommending others because they were delicious. There's a huge variety of food, making it hard to choose! The prices are reasonable, and the food is fresh. The dumplings were incredibly juicy and delicious. Some dishes were a bit salty, so you might need rice to balance them. The fish stew with pickled vegetables was excellent – ​​perfectly balanced with a nice sour and salty flavor. On the way out, we ordered fried mantou and pumpkin mantou. The food arrived quickly and in quick succession. All the stir-fried vegetable dishes were excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Churindhorn Nitatvijit

sample_reviews_en.text: I used to frequent the Silom branch for many years and this was my first time at this branch. The food tasted great; I think it's even better than the first branch. The steamed and fried dumplings were delicious, and they're the type with soupy filling even when fried. Other dishes I tried, like the pork belly and sweet and sour pork, were also very good. The pork was salty, so I recommend eating it with mantou rice or various fried rotis. Another favorite dish is the fried scallion roti served with pork belly; they go together very well. The prices felt quite high, and higher than the other branch I used to eat at.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanasit K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
There are many Chinese customers, but a fair number of Japanese as well. Chinese food everywhere is becoming localized and evolving to have unique local flavors, so I make it a point to visit Chinese restaurants whenever I travel.

This place is also highly regarded.

The dumplings have large, delicious wrappers! The noodles are medium-thick, almost like udon. The sweet and sour pork is also distinctive with its thick slices of meat. Everything is excellent. I was very satisfied.
sample_reviews_en.author: 1969やす

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Taiwanese Chinese restaurant has been around for a very long time, probably almost 20 years, since it was in the building across the street. Our family used to eat here often; we love all the dumplings. The salads and dishes with sesame oil are also delicious, especially the fried dough – we order it every time we come.
I'll stop by again and add more photos later.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuchala Baba

sample_reviews_en.text: This Chinese restaurant serves authentic Chinese food. The stews and braised dishes are delicious, especially the braised sea bass with pickled mustard greens. However, I personally feel that Chinese food often uses a lot of MSG. ^_^ The fried dough sticks are crispy and tasty, and the tea is fragrant.
sample_reviews_en.author: phong larp

sample_reviews_en.text: The sauerkraut fish soup base was authentic, the dumpling wrappers were thin and the filling was fragrant, and the chili oil was very genuine. The only downsides were that the beef patties were a bit small and the shredded potatoes were slightly overpriced, but overall the taste was still quite good.
sample_reviews_en.author: 北宁上门服务Escort Vietnam看主页

sample_reviews_en.text:
• A Chinese restaurant that feels like you're in China, from the food taste and atmosphere to the decor. Most of the customers and staff are Chinese.
• Food portions are quite large.
• The menu is extensive.
• The staff provides good service.
• Parking is available in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: BeboBeing

restaurants.name: เตี๋ยวบางกอก ซีคอนบางแค
restaurants.address:

607 Phet Kasem Rd, Bang Wa, Phasi Charoen, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been eating here since the restaurant first opened. It's definitely my go-to place whenever I crave boat noodles. Having kids made it inconvenient to take them to street food, but this is a boat noodle shop in a mall that delivers such a satisfying taste! :) I always eat 5-6 bowls every time I come.

I love the fried taro the most; it's so delicious! 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Finixe Jung

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is tucked away in a corner of the mall.
Take the escalator down and walk around carefully to avoid going into the wrong restaurant.

The menu is diverse, although some pages seem a bit long.

The food tastes delicious, and there are plenty of appetizers available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mew Naka

sample_reviews_en.text: Bangkok Noodles Restaurant – Seacon Bangkae Branch is an excellent choice for lovers of Thai cuisine, especially noodle dishes. The restaurant boasts a rich and authentic taste, with well-balanced broths and distinct flavors that suit traditional Thai palates.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Thitiphan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is good, with a medium flavor, not too spicy. However, there are both rice and noodle dishes to choose from. Overall, it's okay, but the pork is very little!!! I ordered the stewed pork set and it came as shown in the picture.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gotrip Cnx

sample_reviews_en.text: We bring our family here regularly. The noodles are delicious, there's a wide variety of dishes, it's convenient, and there's plenty of parking in the mall. The staff are lovely, friendly, and very attentive. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Peony Natt

sample_reviews_en.text: Mini noodle bowls are 19 baht each. I like it because I can choose from many different kinds and bowls, and I don't have to wait in line. It's quiet and comfortable to sit there.
sample_reviews_en.author: lee lee

sample_reviews_en.text: Every time I go to Seacon Bangkae, I have to stop by this restaurant. The food is delicious, the prices are cheap, and the restaurant is spacious and clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Auraphak Taipat

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything on the menu is delicious. We come here as a family regularly. I highly recommend coming here; it's definitely worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattalun Tul

restaurants.name: Muan Moojum Charoenrat
restaurants.address:

10120 3627/32 Charoen Rat Rd, Bang Khlo, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🥢 Moo Jum (Thai Hot Pot) & Nua Jum (Beef Hot Pot) - Saphan 2 Branch

A hot pot restaurant that offers a complete experience in both taste and atmosphere.
Fresh and clean ingredients, fragrant and perfectly balanced broth.
The grilled pork and beef are flavorful and perfectly grilled with a smoky charcoal aroma – delicious with every bite.

The Northeastern Thai dishes are equally impressive.
Som Tum Korat, Larb Moo (spicy minced pork salad), and Yam Woon Sen (spicy glass noodle salad) are intensely flavorful and authentically home-style.
They pair perfectly with the hot pot!

The staff provides excellent and attentive service.
This is a great value hot pot restaurant, perfect for a family meal or a gathering with friends.

📍 Location: Saphan 2
🔥 Delicious hot pot, fragrant grilled beef, generous portions, excellent service

#Eatanywhere
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachit Chairat

sample_reviews_en.text:
This pork hot pot place is so good, once I discovered it, I couldn't stop eating it! 😂

🥰 The best is the grilled intestines, I love them so much, I can never resist ordering them.

😝 The grilled pork neck is also amazing, seriously delicious.

😋 And of course, the pork hot pot is a must-try. The price is great, they give you a generous amount of meat, and the vegetables look clean.

🥳 The grilled pork tongue is perfectly grilled and crunchy.

🫣 The papaya salad is just right, and the fermented fish sauce is even better.

Overall, I discovered it in the middle of last year and have eaten there more than 5 times.
sample_reviews_en.author: Asanee S.

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves hot pot, BBQ pork, à la carte dishes, and papaya salad—everything you could want in one place. The food is delicious and spicy. The salt-fried chicken is amazing, highly recommended. The grilled pork neck wasn't as good, it was tough like it'd been grilled for too long. However, the grilled beef was incredibly tasty, sweet and juicy. The papaya salad and various spicy salads are flavorful and delicious. If you're passing through the Charoen Rat area and don't know what to eat, stop by here first. There's bound to be something that satisfies your craving.
sample_reviews_en.author: BW JP

sample_reviews_en.text: I would like to commend and thank the restaurant for maintaining its high standards. The food tastes great, the quality is excellent, and the staff are attentive. Everything was truly delicious, and the prices were reasonable. (I recommend supporting the young woman who comes around selling bottled orange juice; her freshly squeezed orange juice is incredibly delicious!) I only managed to take photos of these dishes: fried chicken wings, grilled pork intestines, fried pork intestines, and "Tiger's Cry" (a type of Thai beef salad). Everything was absolutely delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ananya Torpaisan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant, Muan Moo Jum, is an old, traditional establishment located on Charoen Rat Road. It's been open for over 10 years and offers seating both along the roadside and inside, as well as a second floor. The menu features a variety of Thai dishes, including hot pot and even BBQ pork, offering a diverse selection that you can try every time you visit.

Recommended dish: Salt-grilled snakehead fish. It's delicious and comes with two dipping sauces: seafood and a spicy green chili sauce, served with blanched vegetables. A truly tasty meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: Gigs Boontharak

sample_reviews_en.text:
**Stars/Ratings Compared to Quality, Quantity, and Price**

The non-spicy dishes tend to be on the sweet side, like the cashew nut shrimp.
The papaya salad, ordered non-spicy, sour, sweet, and without MSG, was to my liking.
The grilled pork neck salad was okay, but it might not have been real pork neck as it lacked fat, though I still liked it. The fried intestines were alright and not smelly.
This restaurant also has duck beaks. Overall, it's okay. If I live nearby, I could eat here often; it's not expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: C Muthita

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is an embarrassment to Thailand. They clearly operate with two menus, intentionally charging foreigners higher prices. This kind of dishonest behavior is exactly why some tourists leave Thailand with a bad impression. Absolutely unacceptable.

This restaurant severely damages Thailand's reputation. They clearly use two menus, deliberately charging higher prices for foreigners. This dishonest behavior is what causes tourists to leave Thailand with a bad impression.
sample_reviews_en.author: g g h g

sample_reviews_en.text:
Northeastern Thai food restaurant serving Som Tum (papaya salad), Jim Jum (Thai hot pot), and grilled fish.
Located at Muan Moo Jum, Charoen Rat Road.
On the roadside opposite Bangkok Animal Hospital.
The restaurant is on the same side as GO Wholesale.

Pork hot pot set: 200 baht.
Grilled fish: 300 baht per fish.

Delicious Northeastern Thai food at reasonable prices.

The restaurant accepts cash and QR code payments.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supawut Saengrassamee

restaurants.name: ไฮ่ ราเมน (Hai Ramen)
restaurants.address:

32 Rama IX Soi 43, Phatthanakan, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The ramen was delicious! The noodles were amazing, apparently fresh, and you can choose the firmness of the noodles (and you can get one free extra serving! 👏🏻💕). The broth was also delicious and flavorful, and you can choose the richness. I love ramen and have tried many places, but this one is in my top 3! The atmosphere was great, the restaurant is decorated very cutely. What impressed me most was the staff; they were so friendly, recommended the menu well, and were so lovely! 🫶🏻 I will definitely be back! 👑 (This is a genuine review, not because I got a discount! 😁👍🏻) P.S. I forgot to mention they also have yakiniku/sukiyaki, which looked delicious. I'll try that next time! (The ramen and yakiniku areas are in separate rooms, so if you're worried about smoke, don't worry!)
sample_reviews_en.author: Praew SITA Aiew

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've driven past this place many times, and today I made a point to eat here. It's really good!
It's a ramen shop with fresh noodles, offering two types: thin and thick.
You can also choose how soft you want your noodles to be, which is great.
You can also choose the level of richness of the broth; I personally chose medium and it was perfectly balanced.
The pork is cut into large, thick slices, which is very satisfying.
The portion size per bowl is generous, and you can get free extra noodles once if you're still hungry.
The atmosphere is pleasant and comfortable.
The staff are very friendly and provide excellent service.
Overall, it's a great place. I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rungsun Thongborisut

sample_reviews_en.text: The ramen has a rich flavor. I ordered the shoyu tonkanzu ramen, and it had an authentic Japanese feel. Recommended for those who miss the old-style Japanese ramen you'd drive to. You get one free noodle refill. If the broth hadn't run out, they would have given me more! Even better, the staff were incredibly lovely, providing excellent service, attentive care, and giving great recommendations. I would definitely come back. This place deserves 5 stars in every way.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oran Saen

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate here today because it's close to home. I ordered a set meal and you can choose your noodles – thin or thick, how cooked you want them – from three levels of doneness. You can also choose the level of richness. Importantly, if you're worried about not being full, you can add extra noodles! The price is very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: มนฤดี สุดใจชื้น

sample_reviews_en.text: Definitely overrated for a 4.9 rating with 240 reviews. The ramen was very bland and disappointing, even though I specifically asked which one was their best seller. The beer was served carelessly with way too much foam, and they even charged an extra 3% for credit card payment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittikhun Phiantangkitcharoen

sample_reviews_en.text: The ramen tastes just like the ramen at a nearby shop that uses a tick-tick-paper ordering system. It's so similar I wonder if it's the same chef. But this shop gives larger portions. Parking is a bit difficult. The staff provides good service. The grilled items are excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ming Ming

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and reasonably priced. I ordered the combo set for 219 baht, which included dumplings and unlimited tea refills. I deducted one point because it took a very long time; I timed it and waited about 20 minutes, but the noodles were definitely freshly made.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rintratha A

sample_reviews_en.text: The ramen was delicious! I ordered the shio soup set. It's MSG-free and has a very authentic flavor. The restaurant is cute, in a Japanese style. It wasn't too crowded, and the staff provided excellent service. They even offer free refills of noodles!
sample_reviews_en.author: Matinee Phuangprathum

restaurants.name: Khao San Sek (ข้าวสารเสก)
restaurants.address:

1121 1123 Song Wat Rd, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
📍Khaosan Sek (ข้าวสารเสก)
@khaosansek.bkk
💵 1000+ THB / person
⭐️ 9/10

My favorite place for Thai casual fine dining by Chef Pam of Potong. Enjoyed by Thai locals and tourists alike.
sample_reviews_th.author: Poonnapa P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
It offers good experiences to explore the fresh ingredients around Thailand that integrate into the theme, like Rice, Chili, Palm Sugar, or Fish sauce. The restaurant belongs to Chef Pam, who is one of the Top 50 Best Chefs and owns the popular Michelin restaurant Potong. I recommend making a reservation in advance, as walk-in depends on luck and may take a while.

I love the vibe and service at the restaurant, the food is so amazing and impressively flavorful. It tastes like it's supposed to be, not to adapt to only a Western-like style. My favorite dishes are Grilled Catfish and Fish Sato Crudo. Rice is also special, which is from Petchboon, giving a different texture than normal Jasmine Rice and free refills. We refilled it a few times as it’s so good:)

The portions aren’t big, so you can order a few dishes to taste. Fish sauce granita also gives you an interesting taste.

I love this place, definitely will go back to try more !!
sample_reviews_en.author: Miki T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Looking for a great meal and a unique experience? This place has it all with amazing fusion Thai cuisine that will wow you with every dish. The staff are very attentive. Try it once, you won't be disappointed.

Black Sticky Rice: Aromatic like crème brûlée, with a unique twist.
Sago Worm Larvae: Crispy and delicious, surprisingly flavorful, with a fragrant coriander aroma and a sweet, garlicky, peppery taste.
Crispy Chicken Skin with Caviar: Generous amount of caviar for the price, and the chicken skin is perfectly crispy and delicious.
Pork Ribs: Perfectly braised ribs, not tough or mushy, with a bouncy texture and a sweet, well-balanced flavor.
Green Curry with Beef: Rich and flavorful.
Smoked Pork Belly: Very fragrant.
Quail Basil Stir-fry: Just the right amount of spice, not too spicy.
Egg Above the Clouds: A unique and perfectly blended fusion of omelet and salted egg.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tul Trueng

sample_reviews_en.text:
Khaosan Sek is one of the hottest casual dining Thai restaurants for both Thais and foreigners in the Song Wat area. Renovated from an old building, the interior is decorated with wood and brick in dark brown, orange, and red tones, creating a classic atmosphere.
The menu features fusion Thai dishes served in relatively small portions, perfect for sharing among a group.
The food is flavorful and well-balanced.

Dishes we tried:
1. Clams (405 THB)
2. Roasted Suckling Pig with Khaosan Sek Sauce (550 THB)
3. Crispy Chicken Skin with Coconut Caviar (580 THB)
4. Braised Pork Ribs with Three Spices (350 THB)
5. Lamb Massaman Curry (790 THB)
6. Crab Curry (390 THB)
7. Eggplant Salad with Winged Beans and Young Coconut (460 THB)
8. Steamed Bread with Coconut Ice Cream (250 THB)
9. Salt and Pepper Meringue (230 THB)
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarat Traipiyavong

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely loved Khao San Sek! Great, attentive service and the food was packed with flavour — exactly what I wanted while in Bangkok. I never got to try Potong, but honestly, this already blew my mind. Every flavour was there and everything just worked. For me it was the suckling pig. Yum! Portions are a little on the smaller side for sharing, but I’d happily order more next time. Would definitely come back! And the little inhaler as a gift before we left - nice touch. Thanks!
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrew l

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thinking from an introduction to Thai food experience perspective, Khao San Sek is impeccable in terms of presentation, thoughtfulness of story telling and dining experience without being too overwhelming. Showcased into 5 separate themes, the way the flavours and food progressively introduced in the house menu introduce us to a food journey that wowed us through and through...

Oh, Chef Pam, where were you? 😆
sample_reviews_en.author: Ivan Ong

sample_reviews_en.text: we visited song wat road and wanted to eat in a restaurant with air conditioning, but it was a huge disappointment. this restaurant is labeled as “fine-dining” but the experience was definitely not the case. the setting is just like a normal restaurant, though the staff are friendly, but the food portion was extremely small and the food doesn’t suit my taste. i do not recommend this restaurant 😩😩😩
sample_reviews_en.author: Violet

sample_reviews_en.text: Lived up to the hype, everything about this restaurant was fantastic. The menu was interesting, varied, yet also approachable. Food did a great job of meeting the creative concept. Plates were fairly sized, quality was there in the food and ingredients. Really love the creativity here. Service was also excellent – Jake was great!
sample_reviews_en.author: Abby

restaurants.name: Sook Station
restaurants.address:

45-49 Sukhumvit 101/2 Alley, Bang Na Nuea, Khet Bang Na, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Sook Station is a hotel that also functions as a working space, conveniently located near Udom Suk BTS station. The ground floor is a cafe, the mezzanine is a working space, the second floor has guest rooms, and the third floor is divided into various meeting rooms. The layout is well-organized and beautifully decorated. What I liked is that despite having five floors, there's an elevator! You can order single-dish meals with delivery to the meeting rooms, which is very convenient. The restrooms are clean. The only downside is that some rooms aren't soundproof because they're connecting rooms, so some noise might leak through. Overall, it's convenient, clean, and has everything you need. Check the pricing for details!
sample_reviews_en.author: iluvtravelling dotcom

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wonderful and picturesque place. The details of the interiors are very well thought of.  Entering the lobby area you are greeted by that contemporary artistic design and friendly smile of staff. I stayed in the first floor where I had some lovely pictures. The place is set of a prison design. Rooms are made in cells with bunk beds and metal bars. They even give you a prison stripy outfit for the pictures.
A nice and open air roof top with a hot tub, barbeque set and seating areas. Cool for private group parties. Amazing place though a little far out from the centre but certainly recommended for a couple of nights at least for the photos.
sample_reviews_en.author: Awny El-Bayaa

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a great workshop venue. The decor is beautiful and the atmosphere is nice. The food is decent, priced between 80 and 100+ baht, which is considered expensive but acceptable since it saves you from having to go out looking for restaurants. The workshop prices are relatively cheap compared to other places. There's parking for about 10 cars in front of the shop. If you arrive before 8:00 AM, you might have a chance to park there. If you arrive later, you might have to park across the street or about 100 meters into the alley where there's market parking for about 30 baht per day, which is okay. Overall, I really liked this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Preeyanun Tantipongvanich

sample_reviews_en.text: This co-working space is decent; the room is large and located on the 3rd floor. You can order food, but it's expensive, especially the drinks. The equipment in the room is complete, although there were some issues. Sometimes the HDMI cable didn't work, and requesting a replacement took a long time. Service was slow for food, drinks, and when requesting assistance with equipment problems. There were students and tutors next door, but the noise didn't disturb our room, which was great. The staircase is quite narrow, and the elevator was out of order the day we were there, making it difficult to walk down.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prode P

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came here for the jail theme hotel . Booked the bunk bed .
It was alrite .but for the price I paid I think the room is definitely small . Hardly had any space to open my luggage .
Walking to train around 6 min .
Surrounding the hotel is ABIT difficult to find food and massages .need to walk to the other end of the street to get massages as well as street foods .
sample_reviews_en.author: Khor CHEE JIAN

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the opportunity to attend a workshop here.
The place is a great place to work, with a nice and friendly atmosphere.
The coffee shop is also good; the iced tea and iced Americano are excellent.
Parking is a bit limited, but overall it's okay.
It's near the BTS station, within walking distance. It's quite busy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gavin Montfleur

sample_reviews_en.text:
I only visited the café on the first floor of the hotel. The atmosphere inside is very relaxing, making it a comfortable place to unwind. You can also have a meal here and order Thai dishes like Khao Man Gai. However, the drink menu isn’t very extensive.

It’s about a 5-minute walk from BTS Udom Suk Station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Z Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a cafe with seating areas for coffee and food.
There's also a meeting room for work, with a capacity of approximately 15-20 people. It's clean, has 4 floors plus a rooftop, and is convenient and comfortable. It's easy to get in and out and close to the BTS Skytrain.
There is parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: LOVEVER HAPPY

restaurants.name: Aoba Shabu (Phattanakarn)
restaurants.address:

227 ซอย พัฒนาการ 65 Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tasty authentic taiwanese shabu😋😋
Tried their beef set today (THB 369) and the beef was good😋 Their mala soup is also not as salty and spicy compared to chinese style ones👍
Also tried their pork and Taiwanese hotpot balls today, all good 👍
However the lamb meat wasn't that good... kind of disappointing for the quality.

They also provide authentic hotpot sauces, and also free tofu pudding as dessert! The tofu pudding was really good.

Overall, it was pretty good, but i think it was kind of expensive for the quantity. They also add 10% percent extra for service charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sabrina Wu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Enjoyed tasty, authentic Taiwanese shabu today! Tried the lamp set — the lamp was tender and delicious. Their mala soup was flavorful but milder, not as salty or overly spicy like the Chinese-style versions, which I really appreciated. Also tried the pork and Taiwanese hotpot balls — both were great.
They offer authentic hotpot sauces, and as a nice bonus, they serve complimentary tofu pudding for dessert, which was really good.
Overall, it was a pretty enjoyable experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: wowchun

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've driven past this restaurant many times, but this was my first time eating here, and I was very impressed. The staff were very friendly and lovely. The food was fresh, the soup was flavorful and not too salty with a fragrant mala aroma, and the dipping sauces were varied. You can refill the glass noodles unlimitedly, and there were also desserts.
The tofu was delicious! It's a shame I didn't have much time to eat. I will definitely go back again next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: lapapus nutithawat

sample_reviews_en.text: The food quality is decent. The restaurant has a slightly old-fashioned atmosphere. The owner runs it herself, like a typical restaurant. The chili dipping sauce is delicious, and the soup is okay. However, the restaurant charges a 10% service charge, which we didn't expect, making the total price higher than anticipated. There's no parking available; you have to find parking in the nearby alleys.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prompen Wattanabud

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a real Taiwanese shabu confirmed by me! Set is very good and they have taro, pumpkin, tomato in the set. Sauce is also very Taiwanese. They serve glass noodle, fruit, tofu pudding for free! In the store also have many Taiwanese customers. If you want to try a real one you must come here! They also sell some grocery from Taiwan like instant noodles or drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gene

sample_reviews_en.text:
The owner provides excellent service, offers good advice, and is enthusiastic.
The food is served quickly, delicious, and has a refreshing taste—perfect for a rainy day.
The prices are very good, with sets ranging from 229-369 baht, and the portions are just right to fill you up.
Free dipping sauces, fruit, dessert, and glass noodles are included.
sample_reviews_en.author: Titinan N

sample_reviews_en.text:
This hot pot restaurant offers authentic Taiwanese flavors and also sells various local seasonings. The tofu pudding and desserts are especially amazing—it feels like being back in Taiwan! Highly recommended!

Authentic Taiwanese hot pot! Love the local groceries they sell. The desserts and tofu pudding are amazing—a real taste of home!
sample_reviews_en.author: Shawn Wei

sample_reviews_en.text: I came back two days in a row! This shabu-shabu restaurant is incredibly delicious. They have set menus and à la carte options. I recommend ordering a set; it's super filling! They also have vegetarian options, with tons of vegetables. There's unlimited glass noodles and you can even get dessert. It's all so delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: ฝน

restaurants.name: Krua Maliwan
restaurants.address:

9 Nang Linchi Rd, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, I had the opportunity to revisit the Industrial Technology Department (Royal Thai Air Force) after 44 years since graduating. On the way back, it was lunchtime, so it was a bit crowded. We walked around looking for a restaurant. This one looked promising, with air conditioning. We ordered simple dishes, each a plate of à la carte: rice with sweet and sour fish, and rice with crispy pork belly stir-fried with salt. The prices were standard. The taste was decent, but the rice was a bit hard; it would be better suited for fried rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: surapong c.

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything is delicious. They have Thai, Chinese, Western (some dishes), and à la carte options. I always order their salad; it's a signature dish with a unique dressing. The black pepper fish is great for those who like spicy food. In short, everything is delicious! 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: สมศักดิ์ ศรีกลัด

sample_reviews_en.text:
Roadside made-to-order restaurant. Air-conditioned room with fans to keep it from getting too hot.

Family-run business, friendly staff.

Food: Decent portions, better quality ingredients than typical roadside stalls.
Recommended:
- Seafood stir-fry
- Fried rice
sample_reviews_en.author: WoonWoW

sample_reviews_en.text: The best of the made-to-order restaurants. Everything is delicious. The chefs are kind. I've been eating here for over 10 years. They maintain the food quality standards. The price is worth it. The ingredients are fresh. The shrimp and squid are very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panyawat Phannoi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very delicious 😋 Thai street food style with vast variety of dishes in resonable prices. A restaurant has an air conditioning AC 🤩 with many tables so a big group of 10 people is possible 😀.
Friendly staff is a big plus.👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Sompol Tue

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has moved from its original location to in front of Bangkok Technical College. The new location is quite spacious, and the food is delicious. I'd love to eat there more often, but the wait is a bit long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicky J.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, there's a wide variety of menu options, the prices are student-friendly, the air conditioning is cool, and you can park on the street in front of the shop on even-numbered days only.
sample_reviews_en.author: akkharanij Jiamniyom

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner puts a lot of care into every dish. I recommend two dishes that I was very impressed with: the macaroni was very fragrant, and the dry seafood sukiyaki was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: โกมลชนก บัวภา

restaurants.name: Frame Cafe&Restaurant งามวงศ์วาน 47
restaurants.address:

99 Ngam Wong Wan 47 Alley, Lane 29, Thung Song Hong, Lak Si, Bangkok 10210, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The food was delicious! (Didn't get a chance to take pictures, haha)
- The restaurant staff were very attentive to customers. We went for dinner on the evening of the 15th, planning to watch the meteor shower, but the restaurant checked and confirmed it would last until 2 AM on the 15th, so they took us up to the rooftop to watch instead.
- Thank you very much to Bank, Or, and Pat. I wish you both great success in your business!
sample_reviews_en.author: winwin non

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and comes in many styles. The atmosphere is great. The restaurant is decorated spectacularly with various art installations. There's also a cafe with good coffee. There's plenty of seating and many photo opportunities. They also have a hotel. The restaurant is easy to find and has ample parking. It's perfect for a date, a group of friends, or family. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuit jarumporn Sandhisiri

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service staff training needs improvement.
Some of the service staff kept staring at us constantly, and sometimes seemed to be whispering to each other, which was very uncomfortable. And finally, they charged an extra 10% service fee, which is completely incomprehensible.
加强服务员培训。
有几个服务员一直盯着我们看，一会儿又好像在说悄悄话，让人非常不自在，最后居然还收了10%的服务费，无法理解。
sample_reviews_en.author: 暹罗流浪猫

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a hot latte, secretly hoping for latte art…a little disappointed. However, the other food items were delicious, varied, and international. The atmosphere was comfortable; the cafe is located in a hotel, and there's parking available. It's a nice place to work or just chill.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gavin Montfleur

sample_reviews_en.text: Stopped by Frame Cafe & Restaurant for a meal. The atmosphere is great and the restaurant is very comfortable. Highly recommend it to anyone visiting! The food is delicious, and they have tasty snacks to munch on too. 👍 #FrameCafeAndRestaurant
sample_reviews_en.author: Bua Cute

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but the service was unimpressive. The staff stared at customers inappropriately, constantly standing and chatting amongst themselves. They didn't smile when taking orders, and people kept staring at me while I ate.
sample_reviews_en.author: napas pt

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is beautifully decorated. Model enthusiasts will likely enjoy the collection, which is full of beautiful items.
The shop is newly opened, so the management system may be a bit clunky. There is parking on the side.
sample_reviews_en.author: santirote keatsirirote

sample_reviews_en.text: The Thai food is delicious, the desserts are amazing, the coffee is average. There's a 10% service charge and VAT, and the bottled water is expensive (25 baht, and it's not even mineral water).
sample_reviews_en.author: Methinee nn

restaurants.name: The Market@5
restaurants.address:

18 Phaya Thai Rd, Thung Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
My family and I had an amazing dining experience at The Market@5, and I want to highlight the outstanding efforts of the service and kitchen teams.

A special thanks to the service team—K. Ellie, K. Thaida, K. Pang, and K. Pim—who took exceptional care of my table and surrounding area. Their attention to detail and warm, attentive service made the experience seamless and enjoyable.

I also want to compliment Chef Nhoon from the Abalone in Brown Sauce station & Khao Soi Wagyu Beef, Handling demanding guests with such professionalism, excellent service language, and impeccable manners is truly commendable.

The food was fantastic—flavorful, perfectly prepared, and a highlight of the evening.

The teamwork displayed by the entire staff was remarkable. Even with a full house, everything was managed effortlessly, ensuring a hassle-free and enjoyable atmosphere for everyone.

Thank you all for making the evening so memorable! I highly recommend The Market@5 to anyone looking for excellent food and top-notch service.
sample_reviews_en.author: KengTele Talk

sample_reviews_en.text:
Introducing a must-try Sunday brunch for buffet lovers—"Splendid Sunday Brunch" at The Market@5 restaurant, Eastin Grand Hotel Phayathai.

This Sunday brunch offers a top-notch dining experience with over 100 premium dishes from around the world. With so many options, you won’t know where to start! Enjoy four full hours of indulgence while listening to a live band that enhances the atmosphere with beautiful music.

What sets this buffet apart is the exclusive selection of unlimited lobster, abalone,—something rarely found elsewhere. You can savor as much lobster as you like, indulge in abalone served with abalone soup noodles, and enjoy unlimited Häagen-Dazs ice cream all in one place.

Plus, they offer plenty of credit card promotions, making this Sunday brunch even more worth trying!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rinrada Rinrada

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Ate lunch at The Market@5 three days in a row while attending the Bangkok HIV Symposium, and I’m genuinely impressed by the consistency. The variety is staggering—spanning over 1,000 sqm with distinct live stations. The 'street food truck' concept is a cool touch, especially the unique Airstream beverage station.

Vegetarian Highlights: They offer a fantastic range for plant-based diners. The salad bar is crisp and premium, but the real winners were the vegetable Thai curries and the custom pasta station where you can request exactly what you want. 🥗🍝

Pro-Tip: Don’t skip the dessert section! The Thai sweets and the fresh fruit selection are top-tier. It’s the perfect high-energy fuel for a long conference day. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐"
sample_reviews_en.author: nardyx87

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a wonderful breakfast buffet here in The Market@5.

Greeted warmly by the staffs and brought to a table of our choice. Staff explained clearly how we could navigate our way through the buffet and also to keep an 'occupied' card face up to show that we are still eating.

There were many stations of different varieties. Ranging from the eggs station to the salad station, juices and fresh fruits too.

Food that we got ourselves were quite tasty, do try the pastries if you are here. They don't look much but they taste very good.

Staff were quick and efficient in clearing empty plates. They were friendly and full of smiles, kudos to them.

Totally an enjoyable buffet breakfast. Definitely worth a revisit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bryan Fang

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place stands out for its quality and value for money. We came for dinner on a Saturday and enjoyed unlimited oysters, giant grilled prawns, abalone, and sirloin steak. The sashimi corner had everything from scallops and hamachi to salmon, all incredibly fresh – no need to worry about stomach upset! ^^
The dessert corner was also excellent, with delicious mini chocolate pieces and a whole army of macarons and cakes (this time I was lucky enough to find the hard-to-find Modavic Russian honey cake, which was amazing!). We finished with Häagen-Dad ice cream.
In addition, they have special dishes that change every 2-3 months. This time, they featured snow crab legs and crab roe rice bowl.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tann

sample_reviews_en.text: It is definitely the most varieties and well rounded buffet breakfast we ever had. There is a map (last photo) showing the different types of cuisine to choose from. We are so happy that we stay here for 5 nights so have many opportunities to experience them all. Attentive service - I asked if there’s mango and they brought over the green mango. I asked if the soy milk can be hotter and they reheat one immediately for me. This is the beginning of our SE Asia trip and we are definitely start on a very high note. We are very much looking forward to enjoying the good food at this hotel. Totally love it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaman Kwok

sample_reviews_en.text:
The market@5 occupies the entire 5th floor of Eastin Grand Hotel Phayathai, it is a stylish and lively dining space with warm lighting, bold wall art, and a touch of playful charm.

The festive décor and open layout give it a modern market-hall vibe, making it just as enjoyable to look at as it is to dine in.

The shiny food and refreshment truck, reindeer decorations, and open seating together with the lavish spread delights not just my appetite, but a feast for my eyes as well.

We love coming here to enjoy the festive atmosphere and the vibrancy of the place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sam Liew

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice dinner buffet at the new Eastin Grand Phayathai Hotel. The restaurant is very spacious and comfortable, offering an International Buffet with various cuisine stations to choose from. There are plenty of drink options including soft drinks, coffee, tea, and herbal drinks. The dessert selection and fruits are also very good. Additionally, they serve Häagen-Dazs ice cream 😋😋

Located in the heart of Bangkok, the hotel is easily accessible from BTS Phayathai, with a walkway directly connecting to the hotel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supanee Kosolsirisukkul

restaurants.name: เนือย อาหารจานด่วน
restaurants.address:

9/444 Chok Chai 4 Rd, Khwaeng Lat Phrao, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'd like to give an honest review. The food was okay, the taste was acceptable.

However, the information provided needs improvement.

We called in the morning to inquire about the Ryukyu fish roe. While it's our fault for calling, we didn't anticipate the restaurant's response regarding the availability of roe.

They didn't inform us. If they had limited quantities, they should have mentioned, "Only one serving available, would you like to reserve?"

I'm giving this feedback for improvement and request that the restaurant take note of this.

I was angry with myself for about 5 minutes and felt very disappointed.

While I was calling, they had already served other customers, and it was sold out. The restaurant should consider that when a customer calls, it means they want to eat it.

Why didn't they ask for the customer's name and record it?

I will also learn from this experience and, from now on, I will always provide my name and make a reservation whenever I call. Please improve this.

With improvements and changes in everything,

I believe that we can achieve even greater progress.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sherryzaza

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and tastes like authentic Southern Thai cuisine. The restaurant is a bit small inside, so you might have to wait if it's crowded. Preparing the food takes a little time, especially if there's a long queue, but the wait isn't too long and the taste is worth the wait. The prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tatqongs Keawwi

sample_reviews_en.text: The female staff member was very lovely. All the dishes were delicious; I've eaten there many times. The fried tofu was excellent, the rice bowl was very good (though it might not be enough for a man), the sour fish curry was tasty, and the crispy pork was perfectly cooked.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natsasi P

sample_reviews_en.text:
Coming like this is a bit disappointing. For 95 baht, only 4 shrimp.
If it were served as fried rice, mixed together, it might not look so bad. But coming like this, with only 4 shrimp—even 5 or 6 would be more acceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiraprapa Chenchatkan

sample_reviews_en.text: We eat here very often. My mom loves it, and I love it too. I highly recommend it to anyone who loves Southern Thai food; if you haven't tried it yet, you absolutely must. You'll be hooked!
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrapee Tunporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is flavorful, with both à la carte single-dish options and side dishes.
The prices are good, the service is good, and the restaurant is air-conditioned.
Parking is a bit difficult.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sutathip Suchiow

sample_reviews_en.text: There were three of us, and we each ordered something different. I tried everything, and it was all delicious. I wouldn't deduct any points out of 10. And the ice was free too!
sample_reviews_en.author: weeapong kulviset

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! The crispy pork belly was in large pieces, the tom yum soup with squid and eggs, and the stir-fried stink beans with shrimp paste were incredibly tasty! 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanikarn Klampak

restaurants.name: Robin Hood Tavern
restaurants.address:

The Avenue Shopping Centre, Thanon Pattayasaisong, Muang, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Visit #6: Continued excellent service & delicious food. This time I reserved using the online app & it works really well. Visit #5 is another solid agreement from the 3 of us that this is possibly the best restaurant we've encountered. Service, comfort, location & menu are fantastic. Gary figures this is the best burger he's had anywhere in Pattaya. Absolutely wonderful lunch today made even better due to excellent service by our talented & knowledgeable server Tip. We 3 started with Soups of the day: Potato Leek & Ham Pea, each served with savory Garlic Toast. Coffee & Tea for our friend & we shared a 1/2 Carafe of Chardonnay with Tip freshening our glasses in timely fashion. Entrees: Philly Beef Cheese Steak Baguette, Chicken Kiev with Home Fries, Cod with Home Fries. Deliciously large portions. We feel we may have a new favorite restaurant in Pattaya. Nice location, plenty of parking, spacious, nice decor. Very well done. We're already looking forward to our next visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gerry Steiert

sample_reviews_en.text:
Looking for a real English pub atmosphere in the heart of Pattaya? Meet Robin Hood Tavern.
If you feel like taking a short break from Thai food and sitting in a place with a warm atmosphere, cold beer and good sports - this pub is the perfect place to close the corner.
The menu: Classic and comforting Western and British food - from huge English breakfasts, through traditional fish and chips and rich meat pie, to a Sunday Roast on weekends.
The atmosphere: Wooden design of a traditional pub, a well-air-conditioned interior space (and outdoor seating), and huge screens broadcasting all the football, rugby and live sports matches.
The location: Located on the second floor of The Avenue complex (on Second Road) - a great and accessible stopover in the city center.
A great place to start the day with coffee and breakfast, refresh with a pint of beer at noon or catch a good game in the evening.
sample_reviews_en.author: ציפי עדני מרדכוביץ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service staff are polite and attentive to the customers.
Well designed pub, spacious and plenty of tables.
The beef in the cottage pie melts in the mouth.
Beef dripping chips are delicious.
The hand dryers in the bathroom are powerful.
All finer details are thought about.
It is clear the owner cares about the business.
25th August 2026 ordered the lamb doner Kebab with sweet potatoe fries. The most delicious kebab I have had anywhere in the world. Lamb slow cooked for 8 hours melts in your mouth. Pitta bread so fresh and slightly crisped perfectly. Salad fresh. Chilli and Yoghurt sauce delicious. Sweet potatoe fries cooked to the perfect crisp. I do not understand people's comments that it is expensive... it is fairly priced when using superior ingredients and training chefs to correctly prepare and cook all the dishes on the menu. Congratulations on an excellent business.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gavin Brown

sample_reviews_en.text:
5 stars across the board. The food has been very good. The seating and atmosphere are very comfortable.  AC is delightful.  The cost honestly isn't expensive. Both our Breakfast and Sunday Roasts in our 2 trips were very tasty and filling.  Service is very polite, attentive and accommodating. The beef roast was delicious. NINA, our server was a very nice and patient with our Kid. This isn't just an Expat flop or Pub/Bar with food - we're very comfortable here as a family.  Max also made sure to stop by our table and ask about our meal and service at the Sunday Roast.  We will keep coming back as this is the new standard of service - comfort and value in Pattaya.  Well done staff: thank you.

2026 UPDATE: Still great.. still good value... Great Service.  Got stuff just hanging out while the rained pored outside today and they were very welcoming.  Thanks again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cavalier X

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have to say I was a bit disappointed with this place. Tried the Fish and Chips and the cod wasn't really fresh and was way overcooked. The beer batter was somewhat greasy and tasteless and fell off the fish, I ended up not eating most of it. The chips were double fried and delicious, but that was it. The dish definitely didn't merit the relatively high price

Service was a bit annoying. I ordered soda water but received still water instaed. After noticing the mistake I asked the waitress to replace it' and she replied that she cannot as I had already opened the bottle! To their credit, another staff member came and corrected to the original order without charging me twice, But why all of this unnecessary interaction

Don't know if I fell on the wrong dish or the wrong day, but my feeling is that there are better places of this sort in town
sample_reviews_en.author: Zak Hofman

sample_reviews_en.text:
Apart from the endless road works in this location, I was happy to find this place open at 7am.  Very well-designed interior, friendly staff.  However, I recommend re-wording the menu details to let customers picture what they should expect.  Both our orders came in the form of all ingredients being inside a piece of a bread, be it banquette, French bread, or English muffin.  Despite this, the food was very tasty and nice presentation.  Recommended for quality and price.
As an update (21 May 2025), It is so great to see this place standing strong and alive, they still provide top quality service, delicious meals, and fantastic atmosphere. I love to come for breakfast here when most other places are not open yet.
Love this place and I will always return for more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Husain AlHusaini (Husain_Tula)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great cod n chips with mushy peas. Lovely clean place, great prices, big food portions with spotlessly clean toilets too. Food was tasty and arrived quite quick. Seen YouTuber David Strachan eat here and though we would give it a go. Thoroughly enjoyed it and would recommend eating here.

Came back again this week 2026 and had lovely pork chop with all the trimming and a few cold Chang beers. Truly is a must go to place when visiting Pattaya. Spotlessly clean terrific service and prices were more than satisfactory for the food & service we received. Would loved to have went back for the big breakfast but ran out if Pattaya time

Defo return again each & every time I’m in Pattaya 🇹🇭
sample_reviews_en.author: Jon Mul

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the most consistent restaurant for me, I like the service, food good, I am able to eat keto off breakfast menu. Max, the leader, is an excellent example of customer centric management. He is a talented people person and has interesting and unique food ideas!!!  Great place for me. as I have tried more items on the menu.I've become an even bigger fan of this particular restaurant. i would say they're very lucky to have a talented person like max and some of his ideas.I've tried many of them and they're quite good. keep up the good work.I say that as I find myself eating there.Sometimes three times in one day
sample_reviews_en.author: ROB PARKS USA

restaurants.name: Al Ghawas Restaurant- مطعم الغواص بانكوك soi3
restaurants.address:

82 2 Soi Sukhumvit 3, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Honestly, I heard several people criticize the restaurant, but I thought it was impossible based on my experience with the restaurant in the UAE, where it's known for its excellence. Unfortunately, we ordered rice, jashid (a type of rice dish), chicken majboos, and harees. The harees was delicious and spicy, no doubt about it, but both rice dishes arrived cold. I couldn't taste anything, and even when I asked them to heat it up, it was still cold. I'm wondering what the problem is with their food; how can it arrive cold? Besides, the rice was awful, and I tried to fix it with sauce, lemon, daqoos (a spicy tomato sauce), and jashid. The rice portion was much larger than the jashid, and a third of it was ready-made fried onions.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suaad Faridi

sample_reviews_en.text:
A pleasant experience and a unique Arabic atmosphere abroad.

The place features comfortable floor seating and a very pleasant ambiance that transports you to your homeland. It's well worth a visit to enjoy the space and experience a change of scenery.

Food and Service: The food quality is generally average and is a reasonable option for those seeking authentic Arabic cuisine while abroad. My only observation is that some dishes seemed to have been prepared and reheated rather than being completely fresh.

It was a good experience to enjoy the seating and the Arabic atmosphere, but I hope the food quality and freshness will improve to make the place truly exceptional.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warm Vibe

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the finest and cleanest restaurants, offering Arabic, Gulf, and Emirati cuisine, managed by Emiratis and open year-round.

They offer special discounts during national holidays.

They have two branches in Bangkok: one in the Grand 5 Hotel building opposite Souq Waqif, and the other next to the Amari NH Hotel. They serve authentic Emirati breakfast.

Their lunch and dinner meals are unparalleled. I tried the Madhbi (lamb stew), the Kingfish Stew with rice, the Nashif (lamb and rice dish), the shawarma sandwiches, the arugula salad, and the Levantine kebab – absolutely perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ahmed Alhosani

sample_reviews_en.text: The new Al Ghawas restaurant on Arab Street in Bangkok is very bad. I do not recommend visiting it. The management is bad, the service is bad, and the food is bad. It doesn't compare to other restaurants on Arab Street like Abu Dabba or Al Romansiah. The service is also very bad, and the staff, from the waiters to the rest of the staff, are very rude. The cashiers are also bad. There are no other services like Wi-Fi, and they don't offer the usual hospitality like water or tea that is common in other Arab restaurants on the same street. I do not recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tariq Aldoukhi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was perfect! We ordered lentil and vermicelli soup, a smooth Arabic salad, and chicken ghuzi with dried lamb. Honestly, the food was delicious and clean. The presentation and cleanliness were excellent, and the staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, especially Ms. Khadija. We hope to see this level of service in Arabic restaurants in Bangkok.

Best of luck to the restaurant management!

Haha, the pictures are after the meal. I regret not taking any pictures!
sample_reviews_en.author: JASEM ALSHEMEILI

sample_reviews_en.text: Since I'm not a big fan of rice dishes when traveling for fear of food poisoning, this is my second visit and their food is amazing, so tender and delicious! We ordered chicken madhbi, lamb mandi, and jareer salad. The staff are very helpful and cooperative, and the prices are excellent, but it would be better if the restaurant didn't play music because it's annoying. 😁 Note to the delicate ladies: the restaurant's design is just okay. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Locally thoughts

sample_reviews_en.text: The new branch is not a comfortable environment for relaxing and having lunch or dinner. Their service is extremely poor and slow, and they often forget orders. May God bless them and increase their business, but there aren't enough employees. The pressure is immense, and they don't have enough staff. That's not our problem; we wait for orders, and even delivery takes an hour and a half or more. This is the last time we'll order from you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nouf Alali

sample_reviews_en.text: Unfortunately, my experience was unsatisfactory. We arrived at the restaurant at 11:06 PM, and the food didn't arrive until almost an hour later, even though the restaurant wasn't crowded enough to justify such a delay. The wait was very long and negatively impacted our experience, and I don't expect to visit again. I hope they pay attention to speed and improve their service.
sample_reviews_en.author: M Alshehhi

restaurants.name: ลงหม้อสุกี้ แบริ่ง - ลาซาล
restaurants.address:

591 ถนน แบริ่ง - ลาซาล, Bang Na Tai, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Good value for money. No 7% VAT (even better value during the government's co-payment scheme). Air-conditioned and the air conditioning works well. The food and snack menu is average, but they replenish items quickly. They have a wide variety of toppings on the ice cream. The restaurant is clean and spacious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Disanuphong Dussadee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food offers a wide variety of choices at affordable prices, and the service is fast. The restaurant can be noisy inside, but it's spacious and not crowded.
The taste is slightly sweet for those who don't like sweet food, but for those who normally eat it, it's very delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: NuAuY janjamsri

sample_reviews_en.text: This shabu-shabu restaurant offers affordable prices, a wide variety of dishes, and decent quality food. It has parking, making it very convenient and easy to get to. The staff and owner are polite and provide good service. There are plenty …
sample_reviews_en.author: rnaucthtay nutty

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an all-you-can-eat sukiyaki restaurant with no time limit. The broth isn't too strong in flavor. I like the duck intestines, which are hard to find at other restaurants. The ice cream is Magnolia, which I personally think is better …
sample_reviews_en.author: Bug Bo

sample_reviews_en.text: Ingredients are ok, a variety of meats to choose from, three types: ribeye, blade, crying tiger, ribeye, very soft, pork is also soft, pork neck, at a very economical price, worth it, now there is a grilling option to choose from, add a …
sample_reviews_en.author: Peach P

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the vegetables are fresh, the quality is good, the price is good, and the staff provides excellent service. Just looking up, a staff member will immediately come running to you. The restaurant is air-conditioned, …
sample_reviews_en.author: Chorphakar Deephun
