sample_reviews_en.text: The food was okay and tasty, but the staff who seated us were very insistent on putting us in their designated tables. Customers can't choose their seats, even if there are empty tables; the staff still try to get you to sit in their …
sample_reviews_en.author: koiiok ump

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious. I like it very much. What I like most is that there's a big bottle of cheese for you to squeeze yourself. Cheese lovers smile sweetly. The staff are lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: 王芷莹

restaurants.name: app.bangkok
restaurants.address:

68/1, BNN Park, ห้องเลขที่ A01, Nak Niwat Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is decorated so cutely! The atmosphere is homey, with a lovely color scheme and mascots, making it suitable for all ages. It's perfect for a date with your partner or for families with young children. We brought our little niece and she had a great time. This restaurant ticks all the boxes!

They've added over 30 new menu items. Our recommendations include the Parma Ham Pizza, Spaghetti Black Ink Shrimp Sauce, and Spinach Puff with Sausage & Truffle Sauce.

Parking is readily available. We highly recommend this place; the food is delicious! My friend and I ate everything on the menu. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Taetae Phonaumpai

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went during Christmas, the atmosphere was amazing. We didn't order a lot of food, but the overall taste was good and the service was excellent.
Pizza Margarita: The crust was soft. We ordered it a while ago and asked them to reheat it, which was great. Lots of cheese, delicious, and basic.
Sweet potato: We ordered this again because we love it so much. It's delicious and very enjoyable to eat, especially when hot.
Spaghetti: The spaghetti was also delicious, but the price was a bit high compared to the portion size. Personally, I felt the egg mixture was a little strange.
sample_reviews_en.author: sonananoon P.Y

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service really needs to sort out big time!
I arrived around 5pm ordering some food to take home. The waiter let me wait on one 2 seater table near the door. After 20 minutes of waiting they asked me to leave the table, said this table was reserved. Obviously, there was no reserved sign on my table and other tables around me were available.

Although, foods are fairly good, not so authentic but taste right. Didn’t like their pizza though, the crust was half the size of the whole pizza, too big I guess. Pasta was okay, fish&ship were super soaking and oily.

Big shame.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sanpathit Tavijaroen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Not anymore….

Disorganized team and no customer orientation.
When we arrived all tables were taken and we were asked to wait outside. Another party came along, walked in and was offered immediately a table cleaned up. We asked to change to another table which again was given later to another customer yet again.
Food is average at too high price for the quality. The third dish -spaghetti with meat balls - arrived 15 minutes after the first two dishes with hot meat balls and COLD spaghetti…

So I guess this was a one time try and never again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lothar Mergili

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and the portions are generous.
Prices start from around 150 baht and up.
The restaurant has a cute decor, perfect for a meal or gathering.
There are many beautiful photo opportunities.
The wine is smooth and tasty, starting from around 1100 baht and up.

The staff provides excellent service, they are friendly, smiling, and attentive.

Sign up for membership during your birthday month and receive a free toast served with delicious ice cream.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ananthana Rakphan

sample_reviews_en.text:
All day brunch place in Nat-Niwat road(Ladprao 71)

The restaurant is in a small shop community. Parking is available altogether with other restaurants there.

The restaurant offers breakfast options, pasta, pizza, protein dishes. All food we tasted were good, the service was great, they also had live DJ performing while we were there.

I would say it’s a decent brunch place and can be a good choice for anyone who need to dine around there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sillapat Tangsuknirundorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious! There's a good variety of dishes to choose from. I tried several items and they were all delicious. I liked the tomato salad the most. The atmosphere was nice and the restaurant looked clean. For drinks, I tried the peach matcha latte and it was amazing. The fruit croissant was also tasty. Highly recommend!
The food might not come out super fast, but it wasn't too slow either.
sample_reviews_en.author: Duangduean L.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and reasonably priced. There was plenty of parking, and the food didn't take long to arrive. However, I'm deducting points for the service. Usually, other restaurants that charge a service charge would refill your water or recommend dishes, but here they just placed the food on the table. Also, the table next to us, who arrived and ordered later, received their pizza before us.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angkhana 16

restaurants.name: ส้มตำลุงหนวด
restaurants.address:

80, 6 S. Vibhavadi Rangsit 16, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Esan food with perfect flavors—this place is no joke. From the outside, it might look like just an average local street food spot, but I’d say they serve truly authentic Esan cuisine that doesn’t compromise to cater solely to foreigners or Bangkok locals.

I ordered several dishes and enjoyed every single one. The grilled beef was perfectly cooked and came with a delicious dipping sauce. The spicy soup and somtum were also excellent. You can really smell and taste the fresh herbs in the soup. As for the spiciness, make sure to let them know your preferred spice level if you’re not a fan of too much heat.

Highly recommended for those craving real Esan flavors!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chen E.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best Esan-style Thai meal you will ever eaten. Don’t let the facade deceive you, venture into this cozy and electric-fan restaurant and order some of its spiciest dishs and they will get you hooked.

A grilled pork marinaded with chilli, spicy pork salad, spicy zaap soup, grilled chicken, som tum and many others, are just some of the Esan wonder you could try and I assure you you will keep coming back for more. It’s like they instill a cocaine in the meal which make you crave and reminiscing.

They allow you to bring your own liquor free of charge as well. One time I brougt a bottle of wine because why not?
sample_reviews_en.author: Tossapol Chaisamritpol

sample_reviews_en.text: Uncle Nuad's restaurant is located in Soi Viphavadee 16. It's a small roadside stall with no parking; you have to park on the side of the road, which is a two-lane street with traffic going in both directions. Finding parking is difficult. The food is typical papaya salad, with an average taste—not bad, but not amazing. I came to try it because I heard an advertisement on an FM radio channel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maeying Duangkhae

sample_reviews_en.text:
The owners, a father and mother, are very lovely. The Northeastern Thai food tastes authentically Northeastern Thai, with rich and flavorful ingredients.

I'm from central Thailand, but I appreciate the care put into preparing Northeastern Thai food, along with the owners' friendly atmosphere and constant greetings to guests. It makes me want to visit this restaurant at least once a month.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanaphat Sornchumni

sample_reviews_en.text: No matter how many times I come, it never disappoints. The skill is consistently excellent, the taste never changes, everything is truly delicious. Whenever I'm hungry, I just stop by; the owner is always open. Everyone is very friendly and lovely. The only downside is that the shop is a bit far from the main road, and you have to find your own parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutpaphat Klungsuwun

sample_reviews_en.text: The bill for two people came to 364 baht. It's not too expensive, but not cheap either. Personally, I like sweet food, but none of the dishes here are sweet. The flavors are salty, sour, and spicy – ​​very strong flavors. If you don't like sweet food, I recommend this place. The grilled items were plentiful and well-grilled.
sample_reviews_en.author: Asia rara wi

sample_reviews_en.text: All this plus water and ice for 190 baht is very reasonable. The taste is delicious (Thai papaya salad), the chicken is a little bland but it's perfect with the spicy dipping sauce (which is a bit salty). (The food is quite flavorful, so if you don't like spicy or salty food, I recommend writing it on the order form.)
sample_reviews_en.author: alin jaichoeychom

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of my favorite bars in Bangkok.

Rather than a clean restaurant in a shopping mall, this is the kind of place I'd want to take drinkers who are looking for a unique experience to Thailand. They have quite a few menu items you won't find elsewhere. Mushrooms and nem niao (steamed rice) are perfect as snacks.
sample_reviews_en.author: J K

restaurants.name: Neo Suki
restaurants.address:

224 บางนา ก.ม.1 ถนน เทพรัตน์ Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I chose Tom Yum soup and chicken broth; both were delicious. However, the Tom Yum soup cost an extra thirty baht. The dipping sauces were tasty, with several options, including a Cantonese-style sauce and a Chinese-style sesame sauce. I ordered roasted duck, but had to wait a very long time for it to be served—I finished my sukiyaki before the duck arrived. I've had roasted duck at their Khlong Sam branch before, and it was excellent, with crispy skin and tender, delicious meat. This branch in Bang Na isn't quite there yet; the duck skin was a bit chewy, perhaps because they didn't roast it fast enough. Overall, the taste was still delicious. The Khanom Krong Krang (Thai crispy rice cracker) with coconut ice cream was also good, but it melted very quickly; the cracker itself was still warm. When I ordered, the staff told me it would take ten minutes to cook the crackers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arng Choi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food in general was very good. The shrimp and fish were fresh, and the soup was really good. The highlight was the dipping sauce bar; there were many recipes to choose from, allowing you to mix and match to your liking. They weren't stingy with the garlic and chopped chilies.

The price was reasonable, I'd say. It's more expensive than some buffets, but the quality is better accordingly.

The service was excellent; the staff were attentive, smiling, and never rude.

However, I'm deducting one star because ordering rice was incredibly slow. I had to ask for it twice, for every bowl. I ordered one bowl each time, and had to ask again and again before I finally got it.
And it's happened every time I've eaten here – I've had to ask for the rice multiple times. It's baffling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chinnasri Pinijudomkarn

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, it was tasty, but not amazing compared to MK. It's similar to MK in terms of menu items like roast duck, roast pork, and red pork. They also have an à la carte section with appetizers, meatballs, various meats, vegetables, and promotional meat sets. The prices are slightly lower than MK, but there's usually a long queue. They offer two or three soup options; I had the regular soup. The bill for two people was over 1000 baht. The meats and meatballs were okay. The restaurant atmosphere is alright, but a bit cramped. It's located inside HomePro near Bang Na. Give it a try! Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: JANNARONG NA-CHALAM

sample_reviews_en.text:
The soup base is truly excellent. It's not too salty, fragrant, savory, and full of umami flavor. Definitely no MSG. It doesn't burn or irritate the throat. I don't know, I just finished the whole bowl, it was delicious. I wish the restaurant would sell the soup base in bottles at the front of the store.
The mala soup is delicious, and the dried fish soup is also very delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: za ray na

sample_reviews_en.text: We ate on a weekday, so there were no promotions, it was quiet and peaceful. However, the chairs weren't clean; the previous customer had spilled sauce and hadn't wiped it up. The food was average; the meat was good, but the vegetables weren't very fresh. It's good that this branch has a self-service sauce bar. The roast duck, however, was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: AhCin P

sample_reviews_en.text:
This branch is located on the 1st floor of HomePro Bangna. Walk straight inside, it's on the right. The food is delicious, fresh, and clean, and the staff provides good service. Today we had the 890 baht set meal. The set included a variety of dishes and a good amount of food, enough for 3 people.
*There is a 10% service charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Koy Wiriya

sample_reviews_en.text: Neo Suki is delicious. It's a nice change from the famous suki restaurants. The pork is tender and tasty, but the beef is tough despite being more expensive. The fried shrimp isn't made with fresh shrimp, but the batter is perfectly crispy and delicious. The broth is flavorful. Overall, it's good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suthida Chaw

sample_reviews_en.text:
They offer a variety of dipping sauces, including a delicious Teochew recipe. Today I tried them all, and I have to give a thumbs up to the Teochew one.
On Tuesdays and Wednesdays, they have a promotion: buy the second set for 26 baht. Divide by 2, then 2 sets, and you'll be full.
sample_reviews_en.author: NIRAMOL RUPSOM

restaurants.name: Sannin No Sushi
restaurants.address:

11 Sutthisan Winitchai Rd, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my favorite restaurant in the Saphan Khwai area. I've been a regular customer since before they even had nabe (hot pot) on the menu. I especially love their Japanese cold noodles, especially with the seared salmon – it's the best! Their salmon sushi is also excellent, the tofu salad is delicious, and their Grandma Tiang's chicken is good too. Now that they have the Karubi beef nabe for 499 baht (not net), it's still fantastic and they give you a generous portion of beef.
Last time, we ordered too many appetizers and were too full. This time, we didn't order any sushi or anything like that, we focused on the nabe and it was enough. The set includes rice, ramen noodles, plenty of vegetables, and a rich broth – it's perfectly filling. If you're still hungry, you can order extra beef separately. It's a great option without having to rush through a buffet. It's delicious, worth the price, and the atmosphere is peaceful.
If you're coming, you can park at Big C and walk a short distance to the restaurant. It's not far at all. (Parking at Big C is probably the cheapest option, avoiding the risk of parking on the street.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasion G. Ta

sample_reviews_en.text:
The chef/owner is incredibly lovely!
(I don't usually write reviews unless it's really bad, but I wanted to praise this one.)
- Parking: It's a small restaurant, but they offer 1 hour of free parking across the street (but it's not a long walk).
- Service: The service was excellent from the moment we parked. The chef answered the phone, and even when the staff didn't know the details, he spoke to everyone himself. He walked across the street to wait for us at the parking lot to explain things and give directions.
- Food: The taste was okay, but the sauce and rice might be a little too sweet/salty. The ingredients were good and worth the price.
- Honesty: The food matched the pictures, especially the engawa, which was supposed to be about one ruler's length (I can't remember the name). When it was served, the chef came over and said it wasn't long enough, so he added another piece. I was very impressed! These days, many restaurants try to cheat or cut costs. I wish the restaurant continued success!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mook Nnr

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time trying this restaurant. I ordered several dishes.
🍽️ Fried Pork Cutlet Rice Bowl (189 THB) = Served with Japanese rice and stir-fried cabbage with sesame oil.
The fried pork cutlet was large and perfectly crispy on the outside. It was delicious with the mustard sauce and the sweet and sour sauce provided by the restaurant. The stir-fried cabbage with sesame oil also helped to balance the richness.
🍽️ Spicy Cold Noodles (119 THB)
🍽️ Chicken Karaage (159 THB)
The food tasted good and the portions were appropriate for the price.
📌 The fried items were excellent, especially the fried pork cutlet and the chicken karaage. They were perfectly fried, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside.
👩 The staff provided good and friendly service, and the food was served quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: La Pluie

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went there because of the draft beer deals the shop posted on Facebook group. Turn out that the beer the shop ordered have not arrived, so they offered the same deal for the bottled beer, which was very nice of them.

They also gave us one piece of nigiri on the house for each of us. The food was too good that we didn’t really care about taking photos, especially the salmon salad. The sashimi was fresh as well as the sushi, all were great. Yet, I think this is more of a Thai-Japanese fusion izakaya, so the taste will be stronger and more saucy.
sample_reviews_en.author: 8ummumbonum

sample_reviews_en.text: We chose to sit on the second floor for a feel-good Japanese restaurant experience with tatami mats. The atmosphere is decorated in a cute, homey Japanese style. 🥰 Ordering food is convenient via QR code. The soba and the chicken with tamarind sauce are amazing! The restaurant is clean, and the staff are attentive and provide good service. I recommend taking the BTS and walking as it's located on a main road and finding parking might take a little time. Highly recommended! 🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Sudawadee Poungpong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The curry was fragrant and had a mild, balanced flavor—not too strong.
The fried pork was crispy, thick, and tender—delicious.
The complimentary sushi was surprisingly delicious. The fish was fresh, odorless, and tender, possibly lightly seared in the center, with what seemed like coarse salt. I was very impressed. I usually don't eat sushi or raw fish, but I still liked this.
sample_reviews_en.author: WingZero 00W0

sample_reviews_en.text: Japanese food with creative twists. Tempura is deep-fried very well. Light, crunchy, and not oily at all. Sannin salad is a very fun dish with salmon, candied apple, avocado, and fish roes. Thai style saru ramen is amazing, blending Thai herbs and saru sauce perfectly. Highly recommend. A lot of valued lunch set.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthanit “Honda” L

sample_reviews_en.text: My favorite part about Sannin is the atmosphere of the upstairs!! So cozy, floor seating, fully equipped with games. As a vegetarian, I was recommended a roll that originally had meat but was able to customize with veggie only and it was so delicious. Never can go wrong with an avocado roll
sample_reviews_en.author: Hannah Ross

restaurants.name: SHUNN SONGWAT ฉุน
restaurants.address:

1222 2 Song Wat Rd, จักรวรรดิ Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing pad kra pao that brought me back two nights in a row! I initially discovered this gem because of the DJ playing great music every evening nearby, but the food is what made me return.

As someone who loves pad kra pao, I can confidently say this place nails it. I tried the chicken on my first visit and the shrimp on my second – both were incredibly fresh and bursting with flavor. They offer different spice levels, which is a nice touch.

It’s a small, charming spot on Song Wat Road with authentic, well-executed Thai food. If you’re in the area and craving pad kra pao, don’t miss this place. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: K Ash

sample_reviews_en.text: Cool restaurant with a modern concept. Ordering is done digitally and the food arrives super fast almost like fast food. Everything we tried was very tasty. A big plus is that you can customize every dish and choose your preferred spice level. Low spicy 🌶️ is actually low. Prices are very reasonable for such a hip neighborhood. They also offer really good European wines which we did not try. The place is clean and has a cool Bangkok Thai vibe mixed with an American fast food feel. Clear recommendation and thanks for the great food experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Matthias Dannhorn

sample_reviews_en.text: Did not expect much at first (loud music, fast-food vibe), but the food is seriously good. The Kapraw Full Load was amazing, I ordered it twice 🤣 Crispy basil, garlic pork, chili, and potatoes instead of rice, crunchy, spicy, and super addictive. Also tried the sausages served with cilantro, fresh chilies, and ginger, bold and delicious. Easy 5 stars 😘
sample_reviews_en.author: Jordy Meow (Offbeat Japan)

sample_reviews_en.text: The beef with basil is very good. The crispy cockles with basil are delicious and unique. I have to come back for more. The fish sauce with chili is unlike any other. It's made to look like a spicy salad dressing. It really opens up my taste buds. I ordered the pork with plum sauce and slurped it up hot. It's very easy to swallow.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nana Khampanich

sample_reviews_en.text: Chanced upon this stop for lunch while walking at SongWad and it was a good surprise. One of the better pad krapow’s around and service was quick! Very small and hipish outlet which is overall comfortable and cooling from the heat. Toilet is also available for dining customers and was clean. Worth a visit imo
sample_reviews_en.author: Abraham

sample_reviews_en.text: I walked by this place and decided to give it a try.. and I’m so glad I did! The food was delicious, full of flavor and beautifully presented. The atmosphere was cozy and welcoming, and the staff were super friendly. Definitely worth stopping by if you’re in the area!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mjo

sample_reviews_en.text: We walked into the bar; two tables were occupied, and everyone was eating. A man stood behind the counter and said hello. When we asked if we had takeout or sandwiches, he said, "We're closed." We asked again, "Were we closed?" After all, …
sample_reviews_en.author: Evgeniya Chumakova

sample_reviews_en.text: The basil beef was delicious and flavorful. The difference was the fried garlic added to the basil, which had a slightly crispy and chewy texture. The aroma of the pan was fragrant. The crispy fried egg needed a little improvement. The …
sample_reviews_en.author: Parchaya Veecharungson

restaurants.name: Paetee Restaurant
restaurants.address:

50, 949 Soi Mu Ban Mueang Thong Thani Khrongkan 6 Soi B 2, บางพูด, Amphoe Pak Kret, Nonthaburi 11120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I ate three dishes, and they were all delicious. I'll definitely be back to try the other dishes. Ranking my favorites from most to least:
1. Stir-fried Tofu with Minced Pork. I really like this dish. The tofu is crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. The minced pork is seasoned perfectly.
1.2 Crispy Chicken with Garlic and Chili over Rice (ordered for delivery). It's delicious. The chicken is crispy and fragrant. The flavors are similar to those at Hong Phochana in Rangsit.
1.3 Stir-fried Three-Friend Seafood Rice (shrimp, squid, fish). Delicious, fragrant with three friends and a full complement of ingredients. I recommend ordering it (ordered for delivery).
2. Fried Sea Bass with Fish Sauce. This dish has only one flavor: sweet. It's delicious, perfect for those who can't handle spicy food. The fish is fried perfectly, crispy and crunchy.
3. Thick Tom Yum with Seafood Soup: The flavors are sour, bland, and spicy, cutting through the richness nicely.

There's parking for two cars in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: sky

sample_reviews_en.text:
It’s beyond expectations!!!!!!!!!!

It’s very hard to find a decent Chinese Thai restaurant that offers not only tasty but quality food. THIS IS ONE.

You can taste the quality of ingredients, the techniques of the chef, and the originality of flavors.

Cashew Chicken: perfect crunch of each bite with balanced amount of sauce, making the dish neither greasy nor dried.

Minced pork with olive: the black olive has the crunch and fresh taste, well paired with the meat. Such a wonder.

Watermelon and chicken in pickled plum soup: the fresh pickled plum has such a identical flavor that makes your mouth watering without becoming overpowering and the chicken coming right off the bone. It’s delightful, warming and great to have on the table.

The price is surprising reasonable. Definitely coming back to try more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lucinda Liu (lulu)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Large restaurant, clean, good service, good atmosphere, not expensive, generous portions, very delicious.
I highly recommend everyone try this restaurant at least once.

Braised Sea Bass with Taro (280 baht) - Like steamed sea bass with soy sauce but in soup form. The soup has a delicious and well-balanced taro flavor. Plenty of fish meat.
Chicken Stir-fried with Cashew Nuts (130 baht) - Very delicious.
Large Black Olive Fried Rice (180 baht) - Delicious (but there was one small piece of coarse black olive, the rest was smooth).
Minced Pork Stir-fried with Salted Egg (130 baht) - Very delicious.
Chrysanthemum Tea (25 baht) - Typical.

Overall, I was very impressed with this restaurant on my first visit. Everyone in the restaurant is friendly, the food tastes great, and the portions are generous.
sample_reviews_en.author: San Lang

sample_reviews_en.text:
A porridge-style restaurant that doesn't have rice porridge, lol.
The flavors are good. Today, I ordered the Tom Keam Buay with minced pork, similar to tom yum but with lots of plums. The Squid with Salted Eggs is squid coated in batter and stir-fried in salted egg sauce. It's chewy and crunchy, and the texture is just right. The last dish was the stir-fried chicken with cashew nuts. If I didn't think I'd order too much, I'd order more. It was so good and incredibly rich. My niece ordered the minced pork and tofu over rice. It wasn't spicy, just the right amount of sweet and salty. Overall, the price and flavors matched well. The atmosphere was nice. I heard there was a Line Man promotion: 2 rice sets with side dishes for 120 baht. It's really good, you should try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: kikises vap

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a casual, air-conditioned atmosphere and is clean and tidy.
- Steamed sea bass with taro: This is deep-fried sea bass, with a sweet flavor.
- The fried potatoes are delicious and not greasy.
- Auntie's fried pork is made from ground pork mixed with diced pork and fried, which is another delicious twist.
- Fried rice with preserved fermented soybeans: Delicious.
- Stir-fried long beans with shrimp: I forgot to try the shrimp, but the stir-fried long beans were delicious.
- Steamed pork with pickled mustard greens: A bit sweet.

There's parking in front of the shop for about three cars.
The owner is very helpful and provides good advice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pear Barley

sample_reviews_en.text:
Another hidden gem in Muang Thong that's so delicious I have to share!
This Chinese fusion restaurant offers a warm, homey atmosphere, just like eating at home.

⭐️Recommended Dishes: These are the restaurant's star dishes, incredibly delicious. Personally, I recommend the BBQ ribs; the meat is so tender you barely need to chew. Absolutely amazing (no exaggeration!).

🚗 Parking: There's parking for about 3 cars in front of the restaurant, and you can also park across the street.

🏞️Inside: The atmosphere is warm and inviting, like eating at home. Plenty of seating.

💵Prices: Moderate, but worth the price considering the delicious food.
sample_reviews_en.author: chrys

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried this place in August 2025.
The prices for the food and side dishes are considered average.
The garlic shrimp rice with chili is great with the sour/fish sauce and chili dipping sauce. Price: 120 baht.
The chicken stir-fried with cashew nuts was delicious, with a good amount of cashew nuts for the chicken. Price: 130 baht.
The steamed sea bass with soy sauce was the best dish. Price: 250 baht.
The minced pork with plum sauce was almost good, but the flavor was a bit too mild and it seemed a bit bland. Maybe they should reduce the serving size or add more pork.
Overall, it was good. I will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: JokerXIII

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and the atmosphere is great.
I really liked the cashew chicken.
The stir-fried cabbage with fish sauce and creamy egg was so soft and delicious.
The preserved olive fried rice was also delicious and hard to find elsewhere. The minced pork stew with plums, ginger, and chili was very refreshing and easy to drink. The baked pork ribs were tender. The minced pork basil stir-fry was a little too sweet, but the prices were very reasonable. The fried pork from Auntie's shop reminded me of eating home-cooked meals when I was a child. I liked it.
The burnt cheesecake was smooth and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saqoo Saimoo

restaurants.name: Great Shanghai
restaurants.address:

682/8 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Wide variety of food, tasty and reasonably priced for the area."

sample_reviews_en.text:
Here, we enjoyed a wide variety of dishes, from traditional Chinese cuisine and dim sum to classic teppanyaki dishes. Their signature dish is Peking duck, with its crispy, fragrant skin and exquisitely thin, crepe-like wrapping. The dim sum dishes, such as xiaolongbao (soup dumplings) and shrimp fried bread, were also filling, flavorful, and highly satisfying.

Prices are reasonable, relatively affordable even for local Thai prices (from 1 to 200 baht), making it a great place to stop by for lunch or dinner. The portions are large, so sharing with a group is a great way to sample a variety of flavors. While the service is more subdued than friendly (some reviews have mixed reviews), the delicious food and good value for money will satisfy most.

The restaurant's vibrant, casual atmosphere is captivating, with a vibrant, friendly atmosphere. It is a comfortable place for large groups and families, and is visited by a wide range of customers, from veterans to tourists. If you want to enjoy authentic Chinese food at a reasonable price, this is a restaurant you should definitely consider.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuta Takaoka

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great Shanghai A La Carte Restaurant 📍(Near BTS Phrom Phong)
...Highly recommended, you have to try it! And if I have a chance to be in this area again, I'll definitely come back...I found it by accident because I was so hungry at the time. After trying it, every dish was delicious.
...Especially the 'Tom Yum Noodle Soup,' I can say that this is the correct flavor! The broth is rich and doesn't need any extra seasoning.
...The 'Braised Pork Leg Rice' is soft and tender, and the portion is generous.
...And the 'Hainanese Chicken Rice' has fragrant and perfectly oily rice, the chicken is soft and juicy, and the dipping sauce is amazing 👍 Most importantly, the price is very friendly considering its location near BTS Phrom Phong. I spent 190 baht for 3 dishes plus drinks. If you're passing by this area, I highly recommend it, don't miss it! I'll definitely come back to try other dishes next time!"
sample_reviews_en.author: มังงะ 180

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is average or slightly below average. And as for the price, it's just average.

As others have mentioned, the name "Great Shanghai (Great Shanghai Pochana)" seems to refer to the restaurant's past as a famous Peking duck establishment. Now, it's just a regular Thai restaurant that seems to have taken over the premises, and the menu has absolutely no Shanghai or Chinese feel to it.

If you want to eat authentic Thai food in a chaotic environment, it might be worth a visit, but if you're looking for a great dining experience, you're better off looking elsewhere. You'll only be left with regret.

Incidentally, I was charged 15 baht for a 10 baht bottle of water. (Apparently, they confused it with the 15 baht Pepsi I ordered at the same time.)

That's the kind of place it is. I recommend going there patiently and without getting irritated no matter what happens.
sample_reviews_en.author: Takeshi Sakaguchi

sample_reviews_en.text:
🌟 Another delicious restaurant that I highly recommend. The prices are reasonable for a street food spot in this area.
The restaurant is decorated in a Chinese style, with round tables and Chinese chairs.
🌟 A wide variety of food is available, including Chinese food, Isaan food, chicken rice, pork leg rice, coffee, and tea. The restaurant is located right next to BTS Phrom Phong.
🌟 Delicious, tender, and juicy chicken in a coop for 120 baht.
🌟 This morning, I tried the grilled pork neck rice with a fried egg for 80 baht. The price is reasonable for this area.
🚘 Parking is not available. Parking is recommended at Emporium, Emquatier, or in the alley if you can find a spot.
🦽 Wheelchair accessibility
sample_reviews_en.author: AmyLoveMaToom

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was so hungry, I ordered a lot. None of it was tasty.
- Grilled chicken salad: The chicken looked like it'd been grilled since morning; it was cold.
- Northern Thai noodle soup (Khanom Jeen Nam Ngiao): It was thick and tasted like the bottom of the pot.
- Grilled pork, chicken, and vegetables: They didn't season anything at all. Absolutely no flavor. They probably expect you to dip them in sauce.

This is the only time I'll ever go there. If the location wasn't good, they would have gone out of business a long time ago, I swear. The taste needs urgent improvement. Or maybe they just sell whatever they can get because of the good location?
sample_reviews_en.author: Wongsatorn Kitkasetkun

sample_reviews_en.text: This was the worst service I've ever experienced, especially the female cashier at the counter. Her attitude was terrible; she was very rude and ignored customer orders, pretending not to hear them. The wait for food was incredibly long, so I decided not to eat there. The cashier's behavior was extremely inappropriate and disrespectful towards customers who were paying for their food and not asking for it for free. If any customers use this service, please remember her face. Her behavior is unacceptable. Your restaurant may be large, but why is your service standards so low and terrible?
sample_reviews_en.author: mongkon sleeloed

sample_reviews_en.text:
I heard it closed quite some time ago, but wow, it's still open!
Peking duck is their specialty, but the sauce was too sweet for my taste.
This is a memorable Chinese restaurant where I had my farewell party a long time ago when I returned to Japan for work.
I think it must have been in business for about 50 years now.

...but then, looking more closely, there's not much left of what it used to be. Is it a Thai restaurant or a Chinese restaurant?
It used to be a fairly well-known, long-established Chinese restaurant.
But it's amazing that even the name remains.
sample_reviews_en.author: Onica

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place next to Naraya used to be a Chinese restaurant, but now it's transformed into this kind of street food court. When I asked the staff what the restaurant's name was, they handed me a piece of paper with "Great Shanghai" written on it. So the name hasn't changed? I'm not sure.

Every morning when I pass by here, it's packed with people buying breakfast, but this is my first time actually eating here.

There's no air conditioning inside. It's hot, so I immediately ordered a Chang beer.

The food is surprisingly solid and tasty, though.
sample_reviews_en.author: james won

sample_reviews_en.text: The Fashion branch took the order and made a mistake. I couldn't hold it and eat it. The filling spilled out. The staff rolled 4-5 rolls and didn't close any of them. They stood and watched while making the order. They should have been able …
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploypich R

sample_reviews_en.text:
Umami, a branch in MBK near the entrance of Pathumwan Princess Hotel.
This branch is spacious with plenty of seating, quiet, and serves generous portions of salmon. They have salmon bowls, which my son loves.
The ice cream is also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattawan Pipitwech

sample_reviews_en.text: Overrated place. Food is at best average. Portion of salmon is not as much as what is shown in photo and the sauce on rice does not seems to give out any taste and don't feel the value of 149 baht. The place only have 3 tables.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bill

sample_reviews_en.text: Definitely one of the best food at Siam Center with the reasonable prices. I love spicy salmon roll and cheese salmon roll. You should try it. Just grab and go. That’s easy and convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Onchira Bunyaphala

sample_reviews_en.text: ...ROLL&BOWL offers a variety of delicious options to choose from, such as salmon, tuna, eel, shrimp, and crab stick... You can enjoy a single serving or a complete set menu as you like. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr.Herokung

sample_reviews_en.text: They offer a variety of sushi rolls and other dishes, all delicious and affordably priced. They also have some fried snacks, but there aren't enough tables.
sample_reviews_en.author: sorawich rungrotjanarak

sample_reviews_en.text: Overrated place! Rolls are drowning in mayo sauce, and the taste is mediocre. Messy presentation and they didn't even have napkins. Wouldn't recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aleksandr “ApVaper” Andreev

sample_reviews_en.text: The salmon at the MBK branch is very fresh and not fishy at all. The rice is still hot, and the rolls are bigger than what I usually buy. Great value.
sample_reviews_en.author: lapasrada kiddee

sample_reviews_en.text:
🌟 Orange Mala Hotpot Restaurant: Delicious Soup, Unlimited Free Rice, Dipping Sauces, and Tea 🌟

✅ Spacious, airy, clean restaurant with pleasant music. Ordering is easy with a menu provided.

📍 Pick your ingredients, weigh them, choose your soup, and order meats separately at the counter.
📍 The vegetable, fresh ingredient, and noodle section has a wide variety of choices, well-arranged and fully stocked.
📍 You can choose your desired level of spiciness and numbness in the mala soup.
📍 After paying, go pick your rice, choose your dipping sauce, and get your tea—all free! Most importantly, the price is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: J'adore

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here twice now. The restaurant is clean, the staff provides good service, and there's a wide variety of food to choose from. Rice, tea, and dipping sauces are free.
sample_reviews_en.author: middle middle

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is nice, the room is air-conditioned, and the mala hotpot is very spicy and numbing. The staff provides good service. Tea, rice, and dipping sauces are free.
sample_reviews_en.author: Olive Oil

sample_reviews_en.text: The mala is delicious, filling, and great value. The music is nice, and there's free tea, free rice, and free dipping sauce. The staff are good and generally okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mayny Mayny

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food, clean restaurant. Meat dishes are charged separately, but I think the price is okay and reasonable. Rice is unlimited if you eat in the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: SUDARAT AINPHEN

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! The portions were huge! The restaurant was clean, comfortable, and had a great atmosphere. The music they played was also amazing! 10000/10000
sample_reviews_en.author: Hathaikwan J

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the service was excellent, and the rice and water were very tasty. I was very pleased that they provided free rice and water.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tharaya Yachaiya

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is very clean, has plenty of seating, and a wide selection of items. The soup is delicious and flavorful! ✨👍🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: pps scarls

sample_reviews_th.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere and convenient parking. The food tastes delicious. I recommend visiting มุมกะเพรา (Moom Krapow) restaurant. Importantly, the staff are excellent. ☺️👍
sample_reviews_th.author: Thanarat Klueankrathok

sample_reviews_en.text:
▶️ Previously, we only sold Pad Krapow (Thai basil stir-fry), but now we've added other dishes such as garlic and chili stir-fry, chili paste, and gyoza.
▶️ Choose from 5 levels of spiciness 🌶️🔥
▶️ No MSG, reduced oil and sodium for healthier options.
▶️ We use duck eggs, fried runny yolk (lava style) or crispy cooked.
▶️ Duck eggs are larger than chicken eggs, yielding more yolk and a richer, creamier flavor. Chicken eggs are also available.
▶️ We use high-quality jasmine rice, which is soft and fragrant.
▶️ We focus on lean, skinless meats.
▶️ Our Pad Krapow is stir-fried dry, without other vegetables, allowing the flavors to penetrate the meat.
▶️ Recommended: Pad Krapow with Wagyu Beef (dry-fried minced Wagyu beef). With crispy fried eggs and runny yolks, so delicious!

🙏 Thank you all ♥️
for clicking "Follow"!

YouTube 🎬 Paopao Studio
TikTok 🎙️ Paopao Studio
Wongnai 🍭 Paopao Studio
sample_reviews_en.author: Paopao Studio

sample_reviews_en.text:
The customer service staff is not very efficient.
1. I walked into the store in the afternoon. The cashier was eating lunch, covering their mouth with their hand while taking orders. They could have just eaten in the back and come out when customers arrived.
2. After paying, I tried to collect points, but they said they didn't know how to do it. They said they were filling in for someone from another branch. Shouldn't all branches know how to do this? In the end, they asked me to leave my phone number, but I don't know if I'll get any points for that.
The food is actually delicious, but the staff could be better trained. Maybe I should discreetly survey the staff sometime.
sample_reviews_en.author: arsarn yongyuth

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dear Owner or Manager,
I am a regular customer who frequents your restaurant between 7:00 PM and 8:00 PM. Every time I visit, I have to worry about whether the staff will say "we're out of rice," which is often the case, leaving me disappointed and forcing me to leave. It's not just me; many other customers have experienced the same problem.

Can you help resolve this issue? If you're worried about leftover rice until the next day, you could cook smaller batches or close the restaurant at 7:00 PM to avoid customer disappointment.

This problem occurs very frequently, as I visit every week.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arnut A

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located in a PT gas station. It's air-conditioned and comfortable. The system for returning plates after eating helps the staff. The prices are moderate, neither cheap nor expensive. The taste is okay; the stir-fries are cooked well and dry. If you like spicy food, you might need to order the spiciest level. Even the level 2 spiciness required adding extra chili peppers to the fish sauce. This is only for those who really like spicy food.
sample_reviews_en.author: None Love

sample_reviews_en.text:
The basil pork dish tasted rather dry and rough on the tongue, probably because the pork was lean. It lacked the expected spiciness, giving it a more health-conscious feel.

The restaurant's atmosphere was beautiful and cozy, free from any musty or cooking smells. The staff were friendly, lovely, and provided excellent, attentive service. Prices start at 70+ baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sattapittarat Boabarn

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time here. The restaurant is comfortable inside. I was very impressed with the staff; the service was excellent and they were very polite. The food tasted delicious and suited my palate. I personally like this style of food. You should try it yourself because everyone's taste might be different. Overall, it was a good experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: ลลิตภัทร เปรมกิจ

sample_reviews_en.text: This basil stir-fry has a well-balanced flavor; it's not overly sweet, doesn't have a strong soy sauce smell, and contains no MSG (as stated on the sign). I usually order the minced pork basil stir-fry with a crispy fried egg with a runny yolk, and it's always exactly as ordered.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kannitha P.

restaurants.name: Met Cafe Bangkok
restaurants.address:

918 ซอยสุขุมวิท 55 (ซอยทองหล่อ) ถนนสุขุมวิท คลองตันเหนือ วัฒนา Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Be careful — it’s overpriced. The menu shows prices without clearly mentioning that service charge and VAT will be added on top. Then, when the bill comes, they casually add both, which is misleading. It puts you in an uncomfortable position because you don’t want to cause a scene or argue, even though it feels a bit scammy. So instead, I just won’t come back. Never again.

On top of that, for the price you pay, what you get on the plate doesn’t match expectations. The dishes are basically 80% rice with just a small amount of meat. There are little to no vegetables, which is ironic considering they proudly advertise that they grow their own vegetables in the restaurant. Definitely not worth the money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benoit Labrunhie

sample_reviews_en.text: We decided to try this place based on reviews. We've driven past it many times but never tried it. Many items on the menu looked delicious, but perhaps because we had high expectations based on the reviews, we felt the portions seemed smaller than what the influencers received. The angel hair pasta with crab meat was delicious, the penne with sataw was also good, but we didn't quite understand the African chicken – the taste and how to eat it. The chicken itself was tasty, but the side dishes were just okay. Overall, it's a nice, chill place to have a meal with friends. The restaurant is quiet, there's parking, and the staff are friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanilicious

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice cozy little place hid away from the main Thonglor Street (Just a little bit opposite of Camillian Hospital).

MET Cafe combines the amazing global foods in one place adding its own little kick. Every dish we had was delicious. The seafood was fresh. The grilled chicken was well cooked — soft, tender, and juicy. The Thai food was great. The foods were all in all amazing that we spent most of the time digging in and forgot to take pictures.

Service deserves a five-star and so does the ambience. The desserts were definitely part of the highlight.

Recommended Dishes: African Rhapsody Chicken, Duck Confit, English Sticky Toffee Pudding
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamolkarn Srimongkol

sample_reviews_en.text: Don't be fooled into coming here. The shop looks nice, the coffee is premium-priced (130+), but tastes exactly like street coffee. I wouldn't even buy it for 70 baht a cup if it tasted like this. The cakes are mediocre, 240 baht each, hot tea is 240 baht, plus a 10% service charge and 7% VAT. I ordered two drinks and one cake and spent over 600 baht. The price isn't the issue, but the terrible taste is unacceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tita P

sample_reviews_en.text:
Quite an interesting place where you can find not only proper and fine cuisine but also simply go for ice cream and dessert. Some people even go shopping since the second floor is a fashion shop with stationary items. I like that you can always find fresh flowers used to decorate the place 😊

Last time we went I was surprised that a simple salad and parsley chicken wings could taste so fine and delicious 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Meng

sample_reviews_en.text:
My all-time favourite and go-to place for both casual meals.
Amazing food, wide range of options, and lovely atmosphere 🎐

Personal favourites: salmon pesto spaghetti, angel hair crab meat, african chicken, lamb chops, banana upside down, lemon soda without syrup (they’ve really mastered the ratio for this one) 🍋

📍 parking available
🐕 dog friendly (indoor, air conditioned area !!)
sample_reviews_en.author: prao s

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hidden Jem of thonglor. I recommend to anyone that want to just have a coffee, dining, or just have a quick fix. Love all the food I ordered, still have freshly bake bread and garlic butter to go with.

I’m a fan of chicken wing and tried a lot but I must say they perfect the butter and garlic wing. Tender and flavourful, a delight to my palette. Will definitely come back for more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rick Lim

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, the atmosphere is great, and the prices are reasonable for the Thonglor area.
(Not cheap, but that's the typical price range for restaurants in this area. The portions are moderate, and the taste is delicious.)
I had the spaghetti, and it was delicious and not greasy. My friend ordered the roast duck and said it was delicious. The ice cream was also tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Blissful Day

restaurants.name: Savoey Pork Satay Nakhon Pathom
restaurants.address:

16 แผงที่ 4 ถนนประชาสงเคราะห์ แขวงดินแดง, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Crispy Pork and Roast Duck Noodles 60฿
Crispy Pork and Roast Duck Rice with Egg 70฿
Pepsi with Ice (2 glasses) 22฿
sample_reviews_th.author: Mii Blue

sample_reviews_en.text:
A popular roadside restaurant famous for its roast duck and satay.

This roadside restaurant focuses on duck, roast pork, crispy pork, and juicy, tender meat, as well as satay with a delicious dipping sauce. They also offer a flavorful tom yum noodle soup. Overall, the food is good and doesn't need much seasoning, but the meatballs aren't particularly outstanding; they seem to be store-bought rather than homemade.

The owner and staff are friendly and good at sales. Upon arrival, the elderly woman in the kitchen mentioned an air-conditioned section located somewhat hidden inside. We sat there, and only after finishing our meal did we notice a sign stating a 5 baht per person charge for using the air-conditioned room. We're not sure if we were charged, as we didn't see the bill, but we felt it was unfair if they didn't inform us beforehand, especially since the elderly woman herself suggested we sit in the air-conditioned room upon arrival.
sample_reviews_en.author: NNchan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sawoey Pork Satay Restaurant, Nakhon Pathom, is an old established restaurant in the Din Daeng area, located on Pracha Songkhro Road.
It's famous for its pork satay, starting at 80 baht for 10 skewers.
The pork satay is grilled over charcoal, giving it a fragrant aroma, and is generously coated in a flavorful sauce. The pork is not dry and tastes great. It's served with a side of pickled vegetables to balance the richness.
They also offer various rice dishes, noodles, roast duck, char siu pork, crispy pork, and Chinese herbal stews.
The taste is good, and the prices are moderate—neither cheap nor expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nat P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the best roasted pork I've ever had. It's so tender and not dry at all! Delicious!
The satay pork is also delicious. The pork is tender and the dipping sauce is sweet, not spicy.
The mixed egg noodles are amazing and the portion is huge! You'll be stuffed! The price is reasonable, but not super cheap.
The owner is a great salesperson and gives excellent recommendations. He makes everything on the menu look so tempting. It's fun just listening to him sell.
The chrysanthemum tea mixed with monk fruit is delicious. The iced coffee isn't sour at all, which I love.
This is one of my favorite restaurants!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pheeraya Malakrong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The owner intentionally sold expired food, claiming it was still edible.

I bought noodles and grass jelly to take home. Upon checking the grass jelly at home, I discovered it was expired. When I called to inquire, the owner replied that it was still edible and nothing would happen. (Audio recording available)
(Purchased on October 17, 2023)

The mixed noodles with egg were good, and they charged extra for the soup. The pork satay was tasty, but the owner's attitude made me wonder if the ingredients used were also expired.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gotha Benj

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered the special mixed rice bowl for 100 baht. It was HUGE! Supporting Thai businesses.

The sauce had a unique sweet and savory flavor. The soy sauce and chili dipping sauce was good. The char siu pork was good, the crispy pork was good, and the boiled egg was excellent. I'd deduct points for the roasted duck which had a slight odor and the quality of the rice.
The complimentary soup was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yanin Pittayasathornthun

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pork satay is delicious and excellent, the duck rice is good, the roast pork and crispy pork, and the noodles are average. Oh, I almost forgot, the bitter melon soup is also tasty. As for the price, this restaurant offers quite good value.

It gets hot and crowded during lunchtime, so service might be a bit inconsistent. It's much more comfortable to sit in the early evening.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanuay Math

sample_reviews_en.text: Still delicious as always. The mixed rice dish with roast pork, crispy pork, and special duck is 100 baht. Bitter melon soup is 50 baht. I ate here 2-3 years ago, I don't know if the prices are still the same, but I understand that things are more expensive now, so the rice might be a bit pricey, but it's delicious, so it's okay. ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: LoliPloy YH

restaurants.name: Bang Lamphu Tom Yum Kung Restaurant (Original - First) Branch 2
restaurants.address:

228 Phra Sumen Rd, Talat Yot, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
• Garlic minced pork on rice: absolutely delicious. The garlic comes in chunky pieces, not finely minced, super fragrant and flavorful.
• Traditional clear Tom Yum Kung: mild and non-creamy, the authentic recipe. The richness comes from shrimp fat and prawn stock with three large, fresh, bouncy prawns, along with coconut shoots and king oyster mushrooms. Only wish they had used straw mushrooms instead.

It’s a great place to eat. The only downside is the restaurant might feel a bit small.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puripat Kitkarncharoensin

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been a customer of this restaurant for over 10 years. I've ordered glass noodle salad with shrimp, tom yum soup, and garlic squid and shrimp to eat at the restaurant, and the food was always fresh and delicious. So I ordered one bag of tom yum soup and two bags of garlic shrimp to take home. I received a total of 12 shrimp, but 8 of them were not fresh; the meat was mushy and soft. Only 4 were fresh. I'm very disappointed with the restaurant for doing this.
sample_reviews_en.author: กนกวรรณ อินทโฉม

sample_reviews_en.text:
I usually order delivery, but today it arrived in person.
The restaurant is located on the main road. If you're lucky and the road is clear, you can park right in front of the restaurant.
Their signature dish is the Tom Yum Goong (spicy shrimp soup) with young coconut shoots. The flavor is perfectly balanced; I've never found anywhere else that tastes as good as here. I've been eating here for decades.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chansawad Jetphukthai

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! The price was great. The river prawns were plump and delicious. Everything was tasty. I'd rate the garlic stir-fry as number one, and the Tom Yum soup is a must-try. I almost didn't order it at first (I would have regretted it!). I'll definitely come back. The total bill, including water, was 514 baht. Excellent value considering the quality of the ingredients.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chavinee Jermsuwan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. It's authentic Thai food with flavors perfectly suited for foreigners. The taste is great, the restaurant is located by the roadside and near the Bang Lamphu area. The prices aren't too expensive, and there's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, including fresh seafood and single-serving meals.
sample_reviews_en.author: PotDoi Story

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Tom Yum Goong (spicy shrimp soup) was delicious, and it even had coconut shoots. The shrimp were large and plump; I highly recommend this dish.
The stir-fried water spinach with crispy pork was tasty, and the crispy pork was perfect.
The cockle larb didn't really taste like larb; it was a bit too sour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lin L

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! I had the Tom Yum Goong (spicy shrimp soup) first thing in the morning; it really opened up my taste buds and was incredibly refreshing. The price was reasonable for the portion size. I usually eat at the street food stalls, but that branch was closed on Monday, so I ate here instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jan Daesung

sample_reviews_en.text: The wait was extremely long. There was no queuing system, and the food wasn't served in order. They just made the dish for whichever table they thought of first. If possible, go to another restaurant. For me, it wasn't worth the wait because the taste wasn't that great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawared Piyajitmetta

restaurants.name: River Cafe and Terrace at The Peninsula Bangkok
restaurants.address:

333 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Our experience at the Peninsula Hotel Bangkok was truly exceptional from start to finish. The service level was the top — attentive, professional and genuinely caring. Every staff member made us feel special and well taken care of.  incredible Sunset Cocktail Cruise was memorable for us with buffet dinner at River Cafe & Terrace after it. The variety of food was astonishing, with an impressive selection of grilled seafood, succulent meats, and a wide array of delicious options that satisfied every palate.

A special thank you to Manager Sitthichai, who went above and beyond to organize a birthday celebration for my husband. His attention to detail and personal touch made the occasion truly unforgettable. We are deeply grateful for his dedication and warm hospitality.

Overall, the Peninsula Hotel Bangkok exceeded our expectations, and we look forward to returning soon. Highly recommended for anyone seeking luxury, superb service, and an unforgettable dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amina

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a wonderful dinner at River Café & Terrace to celebrate my girlfriend’s birthday, and it turned out to be a truly memorable evening.

The riverside atmosphere was beautiful and relaxing, especially at night with the stunning view of the Chao Phraya River. The food was delicious, with a great variety of high-quality dishes, and everything we tried was well prepared.

What made our experience even more special was the exceptional service from K. Krit. He was incredibly attentive, friendly, and professional throughout the evening. He made us feel genuinely welcomed and ensured everything was perfect for our celebration. His warm hospitality truly made our birthday dinner even more memorable.

Thank you, K. Krit that gave an awesome hospitality and good service minded at The Peninsula Bangkok, for such a wonderful experience. We will definitely be back and highly recommend River Café & Terrace to anyone looking for a special dining experience in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanischai Sutthitaveesup

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the distinct pleasure of enjoying a decadent breakfast at The Peninsula Bangkok today. One is truly spoilt for choice with the vast selection available. Whether one desires vegetarian or non-vegetarian, hot or cold dishes, coffee, tea, fresh fruit, or juices, you name it, and it is there. They even accommodate specific requests, such as tailoring your omelette to be made with egg whites only.
However, it was not just the breakfast that was outstanding, but also the customer service, which was at its absolute peak. For instance, after I had finished my hot meal and brought some fresh fruit to the table, a staff member named Tui was so attentive that she approached and asked if I would like my cutlery changed. She promptly replaced it for me. This is customer service on another level, and I was highly impressed. Other staff members were also incredibly pleasant, checking in to ensure everything was to my satisfaction. A truly 5-star experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vik Knowledge

sample_reviews_en.text:
✨ The staff is very good. Very impressive. 🫶🏻
We came in wanting to sit by the river but there was no vacant seat. After a while, the staff came in to inform us that there was an vacant table, even though we had forgotten about it. But he still remembered.

The staff is very observant. We took the food and were about to ask for a plate to share. The staff came in to ask immediately. 🥰
Folded the napkin for us, moved the chair when we were about to sit down, and collected the plate very quickly. 🍽️
The ice melted in the glass, so he came in to offer to change the glass immediately. 🧊💦
When we were picking up the bag and getting ready to leave, he came in to ask if the parking ticket had been stamped. 🚗💳

The staff noticed all of this without us having to ask. 🥹👏🏻
Really impressed. Worthy of being a premium service 💯❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: บัว

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a buffet dinner at the restaurant. There are both air-conditioned and outdoor seating areas. We reserved an outdoor seat, which is perfect for a dinner date or a family outing.

- The atmosphere was great. A cool breeze, and we could watch the boats and the river from under the small lamps on the tables. There was plenty of spacious seating. We went on a Saturday evening, so it wasn't too crowded.
- The buffet line was standard for a hotel. There was steak, Japanese food, seafood, and Thai food – quite comprehensive.
- The cake section had a huge selection, which I loved! Everything in the dessert section was delicious.
- The staff provided excellent and attentive service. Importantly, they also took beautiful photos for us!
sample_reviews_en.author: Panyaporn Ch

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s our first time here and we loved the vibe. We dined outdoor and our table was in the 2nd row. It’s a windy night and we sat for a while. They offer a pretty good variety of food and, as a local point of view, it’s delicious. Another great thing that we experienced tonight was an excellent service. We told the staff that I wanted to have more bbq scallops and the chef told me they ran out of it. A few minutes later, we were surprised that they came with small portions of Hokkaido scallops as an apology. All in all, we left with smiles and will definitely one back for our anniversary.
sample_reviews_en.author: Opas Noppornpitak

sample_reviews_en.text: We purchased a dinner buffet package from the Paksabai Facebook page and ate here. The food was as delicious as always, and the selection seemed more diverse this time. The flavors were excellent, with some dishes even better than before. The atmosphere was fantastic. We reserved a table by the river, but it rained heavily. The staff provided exceptional service; they were attentive, friendly, and polite. They even surprised us with an anniversary cake! I'd give them a perfect 10 out of 100! I loved this place and will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Merkin N.

sample_reviews_en.text: We planned to go for a buffet dinner that included Alaskan king crab and blue crab. We called ahead and they had both types of crab for 2590 baht per person, with a 50% discount if we arrived on time at 6 PM. In the end, we arrived on time and the price was 1245 baht, but there was no Alaskan king crab, only blue crab. There was also Japanese food, lots of cakes, Thai food, and seafood on ice. Was it worth it? I don't know, but we didn't get our money's worth because we're not big eaters.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปภัสณัฐ เป็งกาสิทธิ์

restaurants.name: Makanan Muslim Halal
restaurants.address:

QG3Q+7HW, Unnamed Road, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a no frills, street food style, all halal food cart, with freshly made, delicious food. It might be difficult to find, but if you are familiar with the Pratunam area or can use Google maps, it is a breeze to get to. If you are using the BTS, get off at Chitlom, walk towards Central World. On a hot day, use the R walk, which basically walks you through a mall and gets you to the over pass to get to Pratunam. Coming off the Chitlom station, use the walk way towards Central World, look for signs for R walk and follow it. Get into Platinum and walk it to the other side and exit to a over bridge, after crossing it, go down and take the first right into the side road ( soi ). Keep walking straight and you will get to the place. Hope this helps. The food is cheap, portions are small, so order more than one if you are hungry 😋.
sample_reviews_en.author: K K

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried the tomyum here and it was a satisfying experience. The broth had a rich, well balanced flavor which is spicy, sour, and aromatic, just as a good tomyum should be. The meat was fresh, and the portion size was decent for the price.

However, service could be improved, as the staff seemed a bit overwhelmed during peak hours. The environment is simple but clean, making it a comfortable spot for a quick meal. Overall, it's a solid choice for halal Thai food in the area. Would definitely return! ⭐️
sample_reviews_en.author: May Ngiloh

sample_reviews_en.text: I found out about this from TikTok, and it's REALLY THAT delicious! I have breakfast here almost every day because the food is so delicious. I ordered their tomyam beef short rib noodles, they're that delicious. The meat is tender and big. We ate for 6 people and only spent around 400 baht. If it's busy, you can just ask the seller how many people there are. If it's full, they'll usually direct you to the shophouse nearby. Overall, I recommend it for those looking for halal food in Pratunam👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Bibi

sample_reviews_en.text:
A must go if you wanna try Thai Street food. I had the Beef ribs Tom Yam noodle, flavorful and rich dish, tender beef complements the spicy, sour, and savory tom yam broth.

This is right inside the Pratunam Market, you can get lost. You need to find the nearest landmark, that is First House Hotel Bangkok. You can also refer to TikTok videos on the direction.
sample_reviews_en.author: Azza Juliany

sample_reviews_en.text:
My top recommendations for halal food in the bustling street of bangkok. Very close to shopping spot. Very local! Its very delicious!
Please try their short rib tomyam. Make me wanna go back again and again.
The place is very crowded. Not recommended for big group. It only host for 10people. But please try.
They sold out around 3-4pm come early!
sample_reviews_en.author: abdul latif abang

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff was very efficient and food didn't take too long.. The briyani n short rib was already sold out at 12pm when we visited so we had tom yam,beef noodles and fried beef  to share.. flavours was on point and price very reasonable.. sitting in front of their stall can be hot n stuffy but overall well worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Polong New

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious halal food in Pratunam. The portions are generous and tasty, with a wide selection of flavors. If you're unsure about halal food in Pratunam, you can come here. You can experience Thai halal food. The prices are very affordable for tourists.

The vendors are also friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Frysca Putti Muviana - fryscpm

sample_reviews_en.text: The food here is really amazing. If you are a muslim and looking for halal places to enjoy the local thai food, then this is the spot! Unfortunately our hotel was a bit far so we couldn’t try it again. But in shaa allah when come back this will definitely try
sample_reviews_en.author: Ahmed Jamaldeen

restaurants.name: Bistro4 Restaurant โรงแรมเซ็นทารา ไลฟ์ เซ็นทาราศูนย์ราชการและคอนเวนชันเซ็นเตอร์ แจ้งวัฒนะ
restaurants.address:

120 Moo 3 Convention Centre, The Government Complex ถนน แจ้งวัฒนะ Thung Song Hong, Lak Si, Bangkok 10210, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate breakfast at the hotel for three days and lunch at the training course for two days. I experienced stomach pain because the food wasn't hot, possibly because it had been cooked a long time ago or contained a high number of harmful bacteria. The bakery items at the Central Group hotel were also not tasty; they should meet the same standards as the bakery items sold in Tops within Central, which are much tastier.
sample_reviews_en.author: VAJJARINTRA CHANSAKUN

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The restaurant has a great atmosphere.
- It's connected to the hotel and the Vayupak Convention Center.
- Every dish is delicious (I ate there two days in a row).
- Closes at 10 PM.
- Beer is available.
- The basil pizza is amazing; it's cheesy and the basil is super spicy. The price is reasonable. Highly recommend trying it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pavielin 林美丽

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was very tasty. The beef massaman curry was very delicious. The staff provided excellent service, up to Centara standards. The atmosphere was nice. It's a good option for those staying here but don't want to go out to eat in the traffic.
sample_reviews_en.author: แมวส้ม

sample_reviews_en.text: Really enjoyed delicious food, great service and friendly staffs especially An, Nun & Bung. Have a good time here. Highly recommended place to dine in with your friends and family.
sample_reviews_en.author: VaiNyang Lite

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was very complete, an international buffet. The chef grilled delicious lamb; he's a great chef. If I have official events here again, I'll definitely come back here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasin Daha

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a location that requires traveling quite a distance, and finding parking can be difficult.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khong khwan

restaurants.name: กินกับเชฟอั๋น - Gin Restaurant - Since 2014 by Chef Aoun
restaurants.address:

821 Rama IV Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The first time we came, there were 8 of us and we ordered 16 dishes. Every dish was delicious.
This time, I brought my sister to eat here, and I told her how delicious it was before we even arrived.

Thank you, Chef Aun, for making such delicious food. My efforts in promoting it were well worth it.

Today, the three of us ordered 5 dishes to eat at the restaurant and 1 more to take home (Beef tripe with bread).
Pomelo salad, stir-fried eggplant, stir-fried green beans, rice mixed with shrimp paste, and crab curry with betel leaves served with vermicelli noodles.
Every dish was delicious, especially the pomelo salad, which was perfectly balanced. While some restaurants serve it wet, this one was dry, preserving the crispness and aroma of the ingredients. Even after finishing the dish, they were still crispy.
I highly recommend this dish!
sample_reviews_en.author: sompong reanthong

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was delicious.

I came to Bangkok without knowing anything or having a plan, just on my way back to Korea. Since I didn't know any restaurants, I bought a uniform from a nearby shop, and feeling hungry, I went into a place with air conditioning.

I heard that the Pad Thai series is famous in Thailand, so I ordered Pad Thai. I also heard that Som Tum is delicious, so I ordered that, but the owner's daughter recommended the Som Tum with corn.

First off, it was delicious, and the chef in the kitchen is a great cook.

I highly recommend this place if you're not sure what to order, or if you're wandering around the neighborhood and it's hot, but eating out on the street is even harder.

I don't have a picture of the corn Som Tum; I only have the Pad Thai. I must have forgotten to take a photo while I was eating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ivan Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious! Amazing! I have to go back. The flavors were so intense! I wanted to try the beef Khao Soi, but my family doesn't eat beef, so I'll have to come back again.

We ordered many dishes, and the restaurant served everything at once, so I didn't get a chance to photograph each dish because we were so hungry! We ate as soon as the food arrived.

The restaurant is a small shophouse. If you're going with a large group (5 or more people), I recommend calling ahead to reserve a table.
sample_reviews_en.author: anny t

sample_reviews_en.text: You won't be disappointed eating at this restaurant. The food is so delicious I don't even know how to describe it. It's truly amazing! The Khao Soi, the shrimp paste fried rice, the scallops with mango salsa, and the spaghetti with dried chili, white wine, and crab meat – I'd give it more than 5 stars. We finished every dish. It was excellent! The restaurant is easy to find, located by the roadside with bright lights. The food came out quickly; we didn't have to wait long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ning Ning

sample_reviews_en.text: Waiting for my child to finish school, I walked from Banthat Thong to Wangyai Mitrtown and decided to stop by this small restaurant. The staff were very attentive, and the food was delicious. Was it the best I've ever had? Not really, but there was nothing to complain about; everything was perfect. The price was reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: วรพล แก้วกระจาย

sample_reviews_en.text:
Shrimp paste fried rice, chicken soup with cardamom, stir-fried crab with chili peppers, stir-fried yellow chili peppers... every dish was delicious!
There are many more dishes I want to try. I'll definitely go back again.
*I was so engrossed in the food I forgot to take pictures! 😄👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Ja Thannapat

sample_reviews_en.text: Of course I have to find the best restaurant of this trip on the very last day 😭 Everything about this place is 10/10 for me. Greatttttt food, amazing staff, homey vibe AND really convenient location. I’ll definitely come back first thing next time I’m in Bangkok. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Jayden Nguyen

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food and good service. I recommend the rice salad and the stir-fried squid with stink beans and shrimp paste. The flavors are rich, fragrant, not too salty, just perfect. The taste is strong, with plenty of ingredients and good quality stink beans.
sample_reviews_en.author: A A

restaurants.name: SOM Pasta in the Garage
restaurants.address:

1/234 14 Out Door Wattana Rd, Thung Song Hong, Lak Si, Bangkok 10210, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This home-kitchen style restaurant has converted a house's parking area into a dining space. There aren't many seats.
There's no air conditioning, but they have a portable air conditioner. The restaurant isn't big, and there aren't many tables, but the food is incredibly delicious and the portions are generous – just the right amount to fill you up.
The dishes I ordered were: Salmon Capellini Pasta with Black Noodles, Tom Yum Shrimp Pasta (Recommended), and Penne with Green Curry and Fried Chicken.
All three dishes were delicious, especially the Tom Yum Shrimp Pasta, which was perfectly cooked with a complete Tom Yum flavor. The shrimp itself was grilled (or flame-seared), fragrant, and had a wonderfully firm texture – absolutely delicious.
The prices are considered mid-range to high. Main courses will cost around two 100-baht bills (but they're delicious and worth the portion size). One bill is more for appetizers than main courses.
sample_reviews_en.author: Settawut Prapaso

sample_reviews_en.text:
Randomly found this spot on Google map since it’s not far from where I live, so I went to check it out.

All the pasta dishes I order were properly crafted. Everything tasted homemade especially all the Thai spices, herb paste which is the most important seasoning ingredients.

Spicy pesto bacon pasta was really scrumptious. The pesto blend tasted powerful, full of flavors. Bacon is thick also very meaty, much more satisfying to eat. Only took me few minutes, all gone.

Tom Yum pasta with prawns was also delicious. Perfectly grilled prawns with good smoky aroma. Flavors of Tom yum paste also very strong but Spicy pesto pasta was much better.

Eating inside the garage was pretty cool too. Kinda like dining at friend’s backyard. Definitely will come back again soon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cafe S

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a hidden gem tucked away in a deep alley. They serve incredibly delicious Thai-Italian fusion food at very reasonable prices. The owner, a young woman, is very dedicated and creates all the menus herself. The food is beautifully presented, looking just like high-end restaurants, and they use high-quality ingredients. However, there are limited tables because the owner and her mother prepare each dish individually, so they can't always keep up and you might have to wait a bit. It's recommended to call ahead to order. You can park on the street in the alley.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kessara Kosalprapai

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're in the Chaeng Wattana area, you should try this newly opened place. If you want a cozy, homey feel, like having neighbors cook for you, I highly recommend it. Personally, I loved their mashed potatoes – smooth, creamy, and not too spicy; you can eat it continuously. If you like Panang curry, try this one – it's not overly spicy and pairs perfectly with the pasta. The Tom Yum Goong (spicy shrimp soup) is incredibly flavorful; I recommend eating it hot right away. And the fried chicken and sweet potato are amazing – I loved them!
sample_reviews_en.author: TTRY

sample_reviews_en.text:
Superbbb pasta here!!! I ordered two dishes today, the panang one and the Salmon one. They are both really great but I love the panang a bit more. They cooked the pasta really well (Al dente in my opinion). I will be back to try more dishes for sure!!
The downside of the shop is there are limited seat so be sure to book first and there is no restroom there, you must walk (or drive) around 300 metres to the public restroom. By the way, overall is great!!
Oh, I almost forgot, the price is cheap and reasonable. 🧡🧡🧡
sample_reviews_en.author: Poom Ritthirungrat

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a pasta restaurant with a fusion menu that's easy to eat and tastes great.
The Tom Yum Goong pasta is amazing, perfectly balanced.
For meat lovers, I recommend the Massaman Beef with Mashed Potatoes. The beef melts in your mouth, combined with the smooth mashed potatoes, it's incredibly satisfying.
The fried chicken is crispy and delicious, with juicy meat inside.

All dishes are made in-house by the chef. It's recommended to call and make a reservation beforehand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warascape

sample_reviews_en.text: We came as a couple and all three dishes were delicious. The flavors were perfectly balanced, no need for extra seasoning.
