The spicy salmon was excellent; the mashed potato stew was amazing with its tender meat; and the grilled pork panang curry was authentically Thai, slightly sweet but well-balanced. The prices were reasonable, not expensive at all. The chefs graduated from Dusit Thani and worked together – they were lovely. We'll definitely visit again! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Note Lekhakul

sample_reviews_en.text: Great value! I ordered the white sauce pasta and the beef massaman curry with mashed potatoes. The portions were huge! The pasta was delicious and not at all greasy. The beef was tender and fun to chew. The mashed potatoes were smooth and creamy. Overall, the taste was excellent. Drinks are self-service with glasses and ice provided. They have both soft drinks and water. Very impressed! (It might be a bit hot around lunchtime.)
sample_reviews_en.author: เกตน์สิรี บรรจงเปลี่ยน

restaurants.name: Smile​ Restaurant​ Asiatique เอเชียทีค
restaurants.address:

2128/5 ถ. เจริญกรุง Wat Phraya Krai, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Good Taiwanese-Chinese restaurant. I used to be a regular at the original restaurant in Sutthisan when I lived over there in 2019. it was too far to go back so I had to miss out for a long time. When I was running past Asiatique a few weeks ago I was really happy to see that they opened another restaurant in Charoen Krung. The menu is the same as in Sutthisan as far as I can remember. And even the prices haven’t changed significantly. It‘s a bit less cosy but still a nice place for a bowl of hearty beef noodles and Chinese dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was really good. At first, I hesitated because these places always don't look inviting at first glance. They look like all the standard, cheap restaurants here. This food was also really cheap, but it tasted really good. The portions were really huge; I thought I'd get a small soup, but I got a lot of noodles. The dumplings were also great. Really good food with great quality beef. It's a really nice place, and you don't have to prepare anything to eat here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arkadiusz P

sample_reviews_en.text:
I just finished dinner and am writing a review on Chatriumsbuck.
The beef noodle soup is delicious, like beef and cabbage soup with a little bit of our soybean paste.
The shrimp fried rice is freshly stir-fried over high heat and delicious.
The xiao long bao was a little lacking in seasoning, but it was okay.
The Japanese-style cucumber salad whetted my appetite.
Surprisingly, it suited my taste buds perfectly, so I plan to visit again when I move.
sample_reviews_en.author: 공수레공수거

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited twice while staying at a nearby hotel. The sweet and sour pork, cucumber salad, xiaolongbao, fried rice, and beef noodles are all so, so, so, so delicious. On the first day, I ate two bowls of noodles and ordered more because they were so good. Absolutely delicious. I wanted to try the stir-fried green beans, but I was too full, so I'll come back next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: 송영민

sample_reviews_en.text: The best restaurant near the Daesal Hotel ㅜ I regret going on the last day. Shrimp fried rice, beef noodles, morning glory, Japanese cucumber salad, xiao long bao... It was so delicious that I kept adding more, but the shrimp fried rice was the best fried rice I've ever had and there wasn't a single dish that wasn't delicious ㅜㅜ Everyone, you have to go!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ya nana

sample_reviews_en.text: Big surprise. The place was empty when we came, and the area was busy, but the prices were low, so we decided to try it (I think it's quite new venue). We ate fried rice with chicken, some beef soup and cucumber salad. Everything was very good, and the noodles made on site were very delicate, the service was nice. It's worth visiting this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maciej Sartys

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best beef soup of my life

Was returning to my hotel and happened to come across this cute place . It was empty and i had no expectations of the food

The beef soup that i ordered was just heavenly.i have never eaten such amazing food for this price

This is what makes Thailand the food capital of the world
sample_reviews_en.author: nathan anand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the best Chinese restaurant I’ve ever tried. The food tastes exactly like authentic Chinese cuisine, and everything is freshly made. We ordered rice, soup, eggs, and tofu. Next time, we plan to try the noodles because I saw that they are handmade. The owner is also very nice and friendly.

我们喜欢这餐厅。
sample_reviews_en.author: Raya Nway

restaurants.name: โหระพาแคทเทอริ่ง รับจัดเลี้ยง รับจัดงานทำบุญบ้าน รับจัดงานแต่งพิธีเช้า
restaurants.address:

1649 Soi Jaransanitwong 75, Bang Phlat, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The team was very professional. They arrived ahead of schedule. They were highly skilled in organizing the ceremony, from preparing the venue and the order of the ceremony to providing food for both the monks and guests. The food was delicious, both savory and sweet, and all the eating utensils were provided, making things much easier for the hosts. The service fee was reasonable; in fact, doing it ourselves might have been more expensive. I promise that if I need to organize another event, I will definitely use their services again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitima Suksasunee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted delicious, clean, and suited my palate.
Complete equipment provided.
The team managed their time well, were polite, and provided excellent service.
The venue was kept tidy and impressively maintained.
The admin was lovely and provided excellent service.
Ms. Jan gave great advice and was very kind.
There was constant follow-up before, during, and after the event.
sample_reviews_en.author: B Acc.

sample_reviews_en.text: The service at this restaurant was excellent. I was impressed with many aspects, including their punctuality, the order of the Buddhist ceremony, the master of ceremonies, and the entire team – everyone was very professional. The food was also top-notch; guests praised the taste – it was delicious, fresh, clean, and the service was outstanding. 100/100!
sample_reviews_en.author: Porntip June lee

sample_reviews_en.text: Most of the food was delicious, with a balanced taste that wasn’t too salty or too sweet. Spicy dipping sauce was tasty. Only a few dishes weren’t that great. Sunflower sprout was fresh, crispy, and sweet, but some fruits was a bit too hard. The utensils for eating was clean. The prices was affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nunnapat Euamaneerattanakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The team was lovely and very accommodating. The food was delicious, and they worked professionally. The host was very relaxed. Everything went well. Overall, 10 out of 10. The overall experience was excellent. Great value for money. I highly recommend Horapa Catering.
sample_reviews_en.author: 62.7.354 CHANYANISA

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent and professional. The staff were efficient, easy to talk to, and lovely. The food was delicious, exceeding expectations. It was served hot, flavorful, and well-equipped. It was perfect for a small housewarming party.
sample_reviews_en.author: Somruedee Kaoto

sample_reviews_en.text: I used their services for two events back-to-back: a midday meal for monks at home and another at the temple. I found out they were practically the only restaurant that offered boxed sets for the monks' midday meal. My relatives praised the …
sample_reviews_en.author: Mawjew

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my second time using Horapa's services today, and they're still as good as ever. The food is delicious and high-quality, and most importantly, it's affordable. They don't charge much extra for locations outside their usual area. I …
sample_reviews_en.author: Tachapon Boonsap

restaurants.name: Khao Tom Somphong
restaurants.address:

747 Udom Suk 49 Alley, Bang Chak, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
"I ate at this restaurant today and was a little disappointed with the food quality. The omelet I received seemed like it was made with old eggs, was very oily, and didn't smell fresh. I hope the restaurant will take this feedback into consideration and improve the quality.

*Another dish, called "Stir-fried Squid with Egg Yolk," was more fried than stir-fried. It wasn't quite a dry stir-fry.
sample_reviews_en.author: kunlatida namwised

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service is disorganized. The food tastes okay, but
the wait for food is extremely long.
The dishes are prepared and placed on plates at the front, but then cooked in the back. Some spilled during the process of being transported to the back of the restaurant.
The food preparation itself also seems haphazard.
sample_reviews_en.author: Navas T

sample_reviews_en.text:
Never been dissapointed even after trying many dishes here. Always great tastes with reasonable prices.
Yam Wunsen(Thai glass noodle salad) is one of signatures here and a must-try. Other hot dishes are good as well.
Many locals eat with Khao tom(Thai rice porridge). You must try it out, too!
sample_reviews_en.author: Santa Claus

sample_reviews_en.text: This late-night rice porridge restaurant is delicious, with a wide variety of dishes. The taste is good, and the prices are moderate. The omelet and spicy salad are tasty, and the mixed vegetable stew is also good. Overall, it's very delicious. I will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Will PvR

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're craving rice porridge, this is the place to go. No need to worry about food not matching the description, being unappetizing, or having bad service. There's plenty of parking behind the restaurant. The food is reasonably priced, served quickly, and the service is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimsook Rungruang

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is a great spot for late-night dining with alcohol available. It's clean and well-lit, and the food comes out quickly. The staff is friendly and attentive, and there's parking nearby. However, the food tends to be on the salty side. Prices are fair, though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supawit Chirayukool

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall food is good and price is friendly for all. Generally, food taste is slightly way of salty. I really like the spicy salad pickled mustard green.
You have to sit at the back of the restaurant. There is one more seating section which is better than front part.
sample_reviews_en.author: Call me Rocky

sample_reviews_en.text: This rice porridge restaurant in the Udom Suk area has parking behind the shop. The food is pretty good, the prices are slightly higher than other rice porridge restaurants, but it's convenient. There's seating both in front and behind the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: U-Maraj S.

restaurants.name: ข้าวมันไก่ตอน (สูตรไหหลำ)
restaurants.address:

1461 Banthat Thong Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Stopped by this chicken rice shop ข้าวมันไก่(สูตรไหหลำ) for a quick meal, and it delivered exactly what you’d expect from a local, everyday eatery. The food is simple and straightforward, nothing particularly special but decent by Bangkok standards.

The portion and price are good, making it a value-for-money option if you’re in the area and need a fuss-free meal. It’s the kind of place locals grab a quick bite — no hype, no fancy setup, just basic comfort food.
sample_reviews_th.author: Crumpled Nomad

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there twice during my stay in Bangkok.
First of all, the 24-hour operation is a lifesaver.
The first time was at 4 AM, the second time at 5 AM.
Both times I was seated immediately, and I only had to show a screenshot of the restaurant's Google photos I'd taken beforehand.
The soup came in a larger bowl than usual, which was nice.
The taste was perfectly acceptable and delicious.
Considering the price of the food, the age and cleanliness are understandable.
I recommend it if you're hungry late at night.
sample_reviews_en.author: 社長

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is extremely dirty; it's already been in the news. The glasses aren't washed; they're either thrown away or simply dipped in water and placed back in the same spot. Anyone going there should be careful about various viruses. I want the relevant authorities to investigate this restaurant. The restaurant reported my comment, and I won't accept that. The restaurant must take responsibility.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanaphat Pdr

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a Hainanese chicken rice shop that you can eat at repeatedly without getting bored. The rice is delicious, fragrant, and freshly cooked. The chicken is fresh daily, with sweet meat. The price is affordable, and they give generous portions; order the special and you'll be absolutely stuffed! It's incredibly good value.
sample_reviews_en.author: chatchais s.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Both the fried chicken rice and Hainanese chicken rice were delicious.
The chicken soup even had chicken wings in it!
The pepper flavor was rich and delicious, and the soup also contained winter melon. Thumbs up!
sample_reviews_en.author: bin bin

sample_reviews_en.text:
This chicken rice shop is open 24 hours a day.
You can choose your chicken part, whether it's thigh, drumstick, or other parts. It's one of the really delicious shops I frequent, especially when I'm drunk, haha.
sample_reviews_en.author: Acting sub Lt. Phaophatthana Chinapradita

sample_reviews_en.text: I hit the jackpot with something shocking. That green tap water hose...the restaurant was using it to make soup! Is that even allowed? 😐 I saw it and immediately got up. I couldn't eat any more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mar

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's incredibly delicious!

It's a little different from the Khao Man Gai you find around here.

It's really tasty.

The complimentary soup is also delicious 🙏
Thank you 🙏🙏🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: YUKINO S

restaurants.name: Shabu Nang Nai (MengJai)
restaurants.address:

140 Ratchada Niwet Road, Samsen Nok, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
2-hr Shabu Buffet
Great and fast service
฿416.XX = ฿389 + 7% (2024)
฿389.00 = ฿349+฿40 (2022)
sample_reviews_th.author: Chaisit Siricharoenchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the chance to try this place again after being so impressed last time. It's an amazing place! They have over 800 different fresh vegetable items, including sunflower sprouts – perfect for vegetable lovers. And the other dishes are incredibly good. I highly recommend the shrimp meatballs; they taste exactly like those from a famous noodle shop in the Saphan Luang area. The shrimp and squid are so fresh and bouncy! 👍👍

This time, I chose the pork bone broth again, but they also added boat noodle broth, which they said was a new addition. It exceeded my expectations!

The service was incredible; I felt like I was in a palace. The staff were constantly refilling my water and other items – no need to walk to get anything yourself. So convenient for lazy people like me! 😂

If you're looking for a great place to eat, give this place a try. It's a hidden gem, and I'm afraid it'll get too crowded! 😆😆
sample_reviews_en.author: Khaimook Chay

sample_reviews_en.text:
We used to come here quite often when we lived in the area. Now that we’ve moved out of the city, we came back after a long time—and everything is still so, so good.

The soup, dipping sauces, and overall food quality and taste are excellent. The service is also amazing. The staff even told us that the cook was on leave, so they specially made shrimp dumplings for me. They let me try one first to see if I liked it, and it turned out to be really delicious—so I ordered 2 more.

The beef, pork, dumplings, and even the vegetables were incredibly fresh and high quality, especially considering the very reasonable price.

100% recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattha Lek

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. I like the ponzu sauce the most. But when the food was sold out, the staff didn't tell me. When I followed up on the food, they said it was sold out and the staff came to say that the kitchen was closing soon, so hurry up and order food. So I ordered 2 dishes and waited and waited, but still didn't get it. It's like the staff has already cleared the kitchen. I'm not sure why the staff didn't come to tell me because I didn't want to complain. I feel very disappointed when I see something like this.
sample_reviews_en.author: mojijam mm

sample_reviews_en.text:
All the food was good, excellent, fresh, and clean.
The vegetables were super fresh, and the various meats were complete, catering to different preferences. The best part was the peeled shrimp, served already boiled – no need to peel them yourself! I highly recommend it. Come on, if you're still hesitating, come now!!! Also, the ice cream is amazing!!!! The coconut and mocha flavors were oh my god! And most importantly, the staff were incredibly lovely and provided excellent service. 10/10/10!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sutthinee SNR

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a small branch, but it gets packed late at night. The quality of the meats is excellent; I personally loved it. There's also a wide variety of dipping sauces to choose from, including seafood, sesame, and ponzu, but I personally prefer the ponzu sauce – it tastes good with everything. For the soup, I ordered the black broth and mala broth. I wasn't quite to my liking for the mala broth, but it was edible. Everything else was great.
However, parking is quite limited.
sample_reviews_en.author: june nuttida

sample_reviews_en.text: The food quality is excellent, and the price is more than worth it. The mala soup paired with the black broth is delicious. The beef is of very high quality with many cuts to choose from. The vegetables are clean, and they even have shrimp marinated in fish sauce. The staff provides excellent service. The restaurant has convenient parking. Come and eat here! I hope this restaurant stays open for a long time because it's incredibly good value!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattawut Thawornchai

sample_reviews_en.text: The food quality is excellent, and the ice cream is delicious (the owner must have carefully selected the ingredients). It's a small shabu-shabu restaurant with quality comparable to larger establishments. Although the menu isn't extensive, everything is delicious and fresh. ***The mocha and coconut ice cream are the absolute best; even bigger restaurants can't compare.
sample_reviews_en.author: PaTcY .N

restaurants.name: Crepes&i เครปแอนด์ไอ เครปเย็น เครปญี่ปุ่น เครปกรอบ
restaurants.address:

ตลาดเสนีย์ ตรงข้ามซีคอนบางแค Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Personally, I was indifferent. The crepe batter was tasteless, and the whipped cream was oily and rather bland. It needed to be eaten with ice cream or caramel sauce. As for the fruit, if they use imported fruit, they should choose seasonal fruits because if they don't, you might get very bland fruit. The grapes I ordered were very bland. But the mango was delicious, really big pieces, but the price was high accordingly. There's an extra 5 baht charge for takeout. I might come occasionally, but I probably won't because with this taste and price, you can get something similar in a mall. I'm giving it 4 stars because it's easy to get to, near the BTS, and the staff are friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamonwan Keawkram

sample_reviews_en.text: It arrived super fast! I didn't have to wait long at all, less than five minutes. The aroma was amazing! It looked so delicious and appetizing! They gave a huge portion, with plenty of filling, and the dough was so soft!
sample_reviews_en.author: ศิริกมล บุณโยดม

sample_reviews_en.text: I just ate there yesterday. The shop is cute, the staff are friendly, and the crepes were delicious. The whipped cream is unlike anywhere else; I personally loved it. I'll definitely eat there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noppadon

sample_reviews_en.text: The cold crepe batter was incredibly soft, the fresh whipped cream wasn't overly sweet, and what I liked most was that they used only fresh fruit—other shops only use frozen fruit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nan phawt sue khalein Nan phawt sue khalein

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to this restaurant late at night. The atmosphere was great and the staff were lovely. The mixed fruit crepe and the yaki-pan crème brûlée were delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Phoy Sodala

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here many times. It's a restaurant I've recommended to many friends. The crepes are as delicious as those in Japan, and the staff are lovely. 😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Sripirom Jampathong

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is cute and the crepes are delicious. I especially love the Nutella banana crepe with extra whipped cream. I've ordered it three times already.
sample_reviews_en.author: Veerachat Puengpian

sample_reviews_en.text: The cold crepe is absolutely delicious! The whipped cream is perfectly creamy and fragrant, and the crepe batter is soft. It's just right. Come try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Soonyata Mianlamai

restaurants.name: Krua Pak Pla restaurant
restaurants.address:

1 Krungthep Kritha 8 Alley, Lane 4, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Dishes reasonably priced, and very tasty with friendly staff."

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything we tasted was delicious.
The first time, we took elderly people there, and my grandmother ate everything. The taste was good, not too spicy.

- Fried shrimp heads: Easy to eat, not hard.
- Fish stir-fried with cashew nuts: Delicious, the sauce had a tomato flavor.
- Red curry sea bass: The fish was tender, fresh, and not fishy. The red curry sauce was rich and not too spicy.
- Small plate of braised pork knuckle: This is a must-try. It's so tender it melts in your mouth.
- Steamed buns: Delicious, the dough was good, not hard.
- Sour curry with egg and herbs: This dish was prepared cleanly. The soup wasn't too spicy, much better than expected.
- Fish cakes: This was also good, seemed to not use too much flour.
- Lod Chong (Thai dessert): Very delicious.

We ordered 7-8 dishes for 4 people, totaling 1180 baht, which is considered inexpensive.
The restaurant has a relaxed atmosphere, playing Thai pop music from the 90s. There are shady trees, the staff provided good service, and the restrooms were clean. However, you have to walk down stairs to the back of the restaurant, which might be a little difficult for elderly people who use canes or wheelchairs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyada B.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is practically my regular restaurant. There's a pretty female staff member who's very friendly. I've tried a variety of dishes, some are delicious and some are just okay. My favorites are the crispy chicken wings, fried minced pork salad, crab fried rice, and pork sauce spaghetti. I also like the lemon tea. The only things I can remember that weren't so good were the glass noodle salad (I tried it again and the noodles were still hard) and the sour curry (which I thought was too diluted). Anyway, I'll keep going back because it's convenient and close to home. There's parking for 4 cars in front of the restaurant, but you can also park in the side street. Most importantly, the prices are very cheap.
sample_reviews_en.author: JC PP

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves a variety of Thai dishes, all bursting with flavour. The deep-fried chicken is a highlight—well-marinated, crispy on the outside, and tender on the inside. The stir-fried rice is perfectly seasoned, and their seafood sauce complements the dishes exceptionally well. Another standout dish is the stewed pork, braised until soft and juicy with a well-balanced blend of spices. Overall, I highly recommend this spot if you’re in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bella S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Such a cozy place with a country style atmosphere. Nice and comfortable furniture, very clean and well maintained dining area which also includes porch seating. Friendly staff, nicely cooked food and delicious. Car parking is at front, but be aware of the surface steep incline that could scrape the underside of your sporty car.
All in all, lovely food, good atmosphere, reasonably priced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Husain AlHusaini (Husain_Tula)

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for simple yet delicious Thai food, this is the place. The "Chicken That You Can't Stop Eating" is truly addictive; it's so delicious you won't be able to stop! The cooking skills here are truly amazing. 10/10/10 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
The atmosphere in the restaurant is a bit like the 80s. Most of the customers are from the 80s generation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warakorn M

sample_reviews_en.text: The fried rice with dried fish is delicious, and the green seafood dipping sauce goes perfectly with it. The service is good, the restaurant is very clean, and most importantly, the food's taste is consistently delicious – it's always the same! I also love the steamed buns; they're soft, dense, and taste great with the dishes. Excellent!
sample_reviews_en.author: pop plew

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was average, but the prices were a bit high compared to the quality. The Tom Yum Goong soup was okay, but the shrimp weren't fresh and had a bad smell. They were small, weighing 30 shrimp per kilogram. A bowl cost 195 baht, and you only got 5 shrimp.
The service was average, even though there were hardly any customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanel T

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a small restaurant with surprisingly impressive food. The food tastes great, and the atmosphere is relaxed with only a few tables. It looks like a place you'd pass by, but the atmosphere and taste are like eating at a close friend's house.
- Food taste: 9/10
- Atmosphere: 7/10
- Staff politeness: 8/10
- Parking: 6 units
sample_reviews_en.author: กฤษณ์

restaurants.name: T RESTAURANT "Chez Philippe"
restaurants.address:

49/68 Phatthaya Tai 12 Alley, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A true hidden gem.

I've lived right next door for five years and I never realized how good this restaurant is. What a mistake!

The food is excellent, beautifully presented, and exceeds expectations, especially at this price point—remarkable value for money. Chef-owner Philippe takes the order himself, which shows real dedication and pride in his work.

Philippe is polite, professional, and very talented… but rather focused 😄 Let's just say he lets the kitchen do the smiling for him—and honestly, it does a great job.

The front-of-house staff is warm, friendly, and attentive, which perfectly balances the experience.

The four of us enjoyed duck breast, duck confit, beef fillet, and an omelet, followed by five desserts—so good I had two more. All accompanied by three carafes of wine.

An excellent, discreet spot on a small street that's definitely worth a visit. I would definitely go back. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Grant

sample_reviews_en.text:
After about twenty meals at this French restaurant, I think I can offer a solid opinion.

It offers excellent value for money, with a more than sufficient variety of dishes. I've never been disappointed, neither by the quality of the ingredients nor by their preparation.

Some might be put off by the setting: the space is small, open to the street—with the sounds of scooters and barking dogs—and there's no air conditioning. But the well-placed fans do their job effectively.
It's the complete opposite of a modern lounge. This place reminds me of the good old restaurants of "old France," where you can enjoy a delicious meal without breaking the bank, with the TV on, but the sound off (sports channel).
As for the criticisms leveled at Philippe, I don't quite understand them. Perhaps his only "flaw" is simply being natural and unpretentious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saka Puz

sample_reviews_en.text:
I found this place by chance. What a gem! The chef is from Nice and most of his day specials are Provence typical meal.
I was there on the Daube day and it brought me back to my childhood when my Mum used to cook it for us.
The egg mayonnaise with home made mayo were also a very good surprise at... 90THB! The Tartare was also great with home made fries.
And when i thought it could not get better, the chef told us the dessert were home made. We had tatin (superbly made) a very nice Charlotte mango and my personal favorite , floating island !
If you look for French food very affordable in a quiet environment, go there. Nothing fancy but simply great food !
A warning though ! The portions are extremely generous ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrice Pischedda

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just tables under a canopy somewhere in the middle of nowhere. I couldn't figure out where there's anything French here, because I'm not well-versed, but that doesn't affect my rating. The menu simply doesn't list the ingredients for many dishes (like it says some kind of meat, but it's unclear whether it comes with a side dish or not, or what they cook it with). There's no grammage, no photos. Oh well. In any case, the food is very average; McDonald's is naturally tastier. My salad was simply some cold canned food garnished with lettuce leaves (see photo).

In short, this place is below the average shavoukha in the center of town only in terms of "French cuisine."
sample_reviews_en.author: A D

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited this restaurant with a friend in August 2023. The owners and chefs are a very nice French couple. We had a great time. It's a French restaurant, but it's unpretentious and you can enjoy delicious food at a reasonable price. The location is a little hard to find, but it's only about a 10-minute walk from Third Road or South Road, so it wasn't a problem for me. I highly recommend this restaurant, so please give it a try. I will definitely visit again, and I look forward to that time. I hope the owners and their husband stay healthy and keep up the great work.
sample_reviews_en.author: 橋O D

sample_reviews_en.text:
Little french restauraunt in the middle of nonwhere. Took a chance it would be good based on location and pictures of the menu. Small menu usually means they do the dishes they have excellently. Being able to exist away from tourist areas meams they have consistent repeat customers.

Glad to say the food was excellent, the chef and staff very nice, and it was full of french patrons. Felt very different to the restaraunts elsewhere in pattaya.

I would highly recommend it, although the french patrons might be annoyed if they have to start waiting for a table. ;).
sample_reviews_en.author: alpaul

sample_reviews_en.text:
There were three of us, and we arrived quite late at Chez Philippe, but the welcome was very warm.

We tried the tuna tartare with mango, the country terrine, the two-salmon rillettes, the grilled hanger steak with shallot sauce, as well as the mango charlotte and the chocolate mousse: everything was excellent.
The ingredients are high-quality, well-prepared, tender, and very flavorful.
A very good French restaurant with prices that are more than reasonable considering the generous portions. We highly recommend it! 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Benjamin Hardouin

sample_reviews_en.text: Although I knew the establishment by name and its good reputation within the French community, it was my first time there! I wasn't disappointed by the warm welcome from the owner, nor by the quality and quantity of the food. Just one small drawback: it seems the service provided by a local person wasn't appreciated by their own compatriots! The two local ladies who were with me were surprised by a certain behavior they considered impolite, even inappropriate!
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert Miralles

restaurants.name: Nak La Mookata Victory Hub
restaurants.address:

ชั้น 3 ศูนย์การค้าวิคตอรี่ฮับ Phaya Thai Rd, Khwaeng Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recommend coming here later in the evening if you want to avoid long waiting times. I arrived after 9 PM and was able to get a table immediately without having to queue, which made the experience much more enjoyable.

The restaurant serves à la carte instead of buffet, so it’s actually very convenient if you’re dining alone. You can order just the right amount of food without feeling overwhelmed or wasting anything.

The staff were quick, attentive, and efficient throughout the meal, which made the service feel smooth and pleasant. One interesting detail was that some of the dishes were delivered by a robot, which made the dining experience a little more unique and fun.

One thing I really liked was the variety of sauces. They were all well-seasoned and added a lot of flavor to the dishes. You can tell some thought went into them.

The meat was fresh and good quality overall. My favorite dish was definitely the crispy fried intestines, perfectly cooked, crispy on the outside and still flavorful inside. It’s a must-try if you visit.

Overall, this is a nice place with good food, reasonable prices, and an enjoyable atmosphere. I would definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kim Kim

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a Korean BBQ restaurant with unlimited vegetables and a wide variety of menu options at good prices.
-I ordered the L-sized pork set, and it was pretty good. The pork was well-marinated and not too salty. The soup wasn't too salty to start and had a nice peppery aroma, making it easy to eat the vegetables continuously without getting a dry throat or mouth.
-The vegetable section had a good selection, including sliced ​​and shredded cabbage, bok choy, Chinese cabbage, wakame seaweed, celery, pumpkin, carrots, and corn. The staff kept replenishing the supplies.
-The dipping sauces were excellent. I liked the original, the "Narka" (Hunter's) sauce, and the "Naraka" (Cute) sauce (a BBQ sauce similar to one of the famous restaurants). They were all delicious.
I went in the evening, so there might be a bit of a queue, but the smaller tables moved relatively quickly, and some items were sold out. The staff provided good service. It's an air-conditioned Korean BBQ restaurant with a view of the BTS Skytrain, and you don't have to worry about your hair smelling like smoke because there are exhaust hoods.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pariyapath Eiamtrakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The female employee named Wu was terrible. Her service and attitude were awful. I asked if I could have the pork wrapped to go, and she said, "Just pick it out, I'll wrap it for you," with a blank expression and furrowed brows.
I waited and waited. She walked around the vegetable bar without looking at me, ignoring my gestures. I looked around the whole store for other employees, but no one passed by. Finally, I went to the cashier and asked them to wrap it for me. I eat at this branch regularly and have never encountered an employee with such a bad attitude. I would like to suggest that if you intend to work in customer service, you must pay attention to customers, speak politely, and smile more often. Doing this wastes customers' time. If you're busy, you can tell another employee to wrap it for you, instead of making the customer walk around looking for someone to wrap it for you. I hope the manager will train this employee so she doesn't behave like this with other customers.
I probably won't eat there again. This employee ruined the atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Onuma

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food and service are generally fine, nothing special.

However, this branch's desserts are often not as good as the Siam branch. I've eaten here before and it was delicious, but lately something's changed.

- I once had the brown sugar dessert and it was soggy, like they just poured butter and sugar into it (this was a while ago, I didn't take a picture). I asked to exchange it, but they brought the same thing, and the staff even asked if I didn't know it was supposed to be that way. Seriously?! 🥹

I usually eat here regularly, and normally it's not so soggy that it feels like it's just soaked in sugar and butter.

- But today, I went back again, this time for the cheese dessert, and it was like in the picture – burnt and not crispy.

I understand it's not a dessert-focused restaurant, but they should still make it better than this.
sample_reviews_en.author: P picha

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm deducting one star because the staff member, who seemed to be a foreigner, spoke with a thick accent, and I couldn't understand her either.
She had us scan a QR code to order food and also gave us a menu.
Because I was hungry, I didn't check what was included in the basic set menu.
The food was delicious. I really liked the sukiyaki dipping sauce. They had fresh lime slices available for customers to serve themselves at the counter. You can take unlimited vegetables.
I was impressed with the staff member at the counter; she was very helpful. I hadn't reached the minimum bill of 279 baht for the hot pot set, but I was already very full and couldn't eat any more.
So, I tried to find something to add to my bill to reach the minimum, and she was very understanding.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ubonrat Suksombat

sample_reviews_en.text: Quality ingredients at a reasonable price. We ate there as a couple; the set we ordered in the picture was 279 THB. The total bill was 492.20 THB. The price is acceptable, but credit card payments require a minimum of 500 THB, and QR payment is slightly more expensive than cash, though it's kind of mandatory because the promotion doesn't accept cash. A little annoying. You might have to wait in line if you go in the evening, but it's worth it. The pickled egg dipping sauce (12 THB) is amazing! The garlic fried rice is also delicious. Free unlimited vegetables and 3-4 free dipping sauces to choose from. The soft pork coated in egg is the best! The beef tongue is good, and the pork belly is excellent. You have to try it yourself! 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: NWD

sample_reviews_en.text: This BBQ pork restaurant offers great set meals. We were very full; even though there were only two of us, we ordered many dishes and couldn't finish them all. The taste was delicious. The fried pork neck salad was especially good, but I wish they used more real lime juice for a stronger lime aroma. The BBQ pork sets had fresh ingredients, but I wish they offered a set with only pork meat. The robot mascot's song "BBQ pork, BBQ pork" was very catchy and cute. Since there were only two of us, we had a lot of raw pork left over, so we asked to have it packed to take home, and the staff kindly provided excellent service. Plus, the restaurant stays open late, which is great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanakarn Khrueson

sample_reviews_en.text:
This air-conditioned BBQ pork restaurant has several branches. It's not a buffet, but the vegetables are unlimited.

The marinated pork and beef are tender and delicious in every dish. The soup is sweet, not too salty. There's a variety of dipping sauces to choose from, and you can help yourself to the vegetables.

The atmosphere is nice with individual, private seating areas. The staff provides good service, although most of the serving is done by hand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Icecoolice

restaurants.name: Khao yiphun
restaurants.address:

B104 UBC2 591, Sukhumvit 33 Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This famous Japanese curry restaurant has been around for a long time, and it's a favorite of my friend, but I hadn't had the chance to try it until today.

I finally got to visit and give it a try, and it was fantastic! The taste, price, and portion size were all excellent. It was filling, delicious, and great value. The curry wasn't greasy at all; it had a unique hamburger-like flavor that was decent, though not outstanding. The portion was huge! My only criticism would be that I didn't like the scrambled eggs as much; they were a bit overcooked and not very appealing. But the rice was amazing – incredibly soft, perfectly cooked, and just right.

The bacon and stir-fried vegetables were a good size dish, salty, with a hint of pepper and a subtle bacon aroma.

Overall, this restaurant is a Japanese comfort food style place that you could eat at often. It's definitely a hit with big eaters!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pesama Saksanit

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Japanese restaurant, Khao Ngai, has a casual, open-air vibe and is near BTS Phrom Phong. They offer a variety of dishes, including rice bowls, pasta, and basic curries.

Personally, I don't eat raw fish, but I love their curry! I've been wanting to try this place for a while, so I ordered the pork cutlet curry. The curry isn't too strong; I'm not sure if it's vegetable-based, but adding the Japanese chili powder (available at the counter) made it perfect. It was just the right amount of spiciness and rich flavor. Delicious! I'll definitely be back. 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Rita Eatalone

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came without any expectations, but it exceeded my expectations so much! I've been searching for this kind of curry in Thailand for so long, and today I finally found it! Yay! The curry sauce is rich and flavorful; I've never tasted anything like it in Thailand. The mentaiko spaghetti had al dente noodles, perfectly chewy, and the mentaiko sauce coated the noodles just right—not too soggy and not too dry.

Overall, I loved it! It's now on my list of favorite restaurants. 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: Wirunya Rattanawongchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cheese Hamburg Curry Rice
The curry is mild and the hamburger is tender.
Wagyu Beef Stir-Fried in Sauce Rice Bowl: The tender Wagyu beef is stir-fried in a salty sauce that goes perfectly with the rice.
Karaage Rice Ball: The fried chicken is perfectly crispy on the outside, but still juicy on the inside.
This restaurant is known for its delicious rice from Niigata.
The restaurant is open-air with a few seats.
You'll find it right away after walking down the stairs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kinjonboum

sample_reviews_en.text: A small Japanese restaurant on Sukhumvit Road,just right after enter the basement and right across from Emphere. great-tasting dishes The Japanese rice here is especially delicious — soft, fragrant, and perfectly cooked. Also have spaghetti choice. Prices are very reasonable, making it a great spot for both lunch and dinner. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Unplanned traveller L.

sample_reviews_en.text: Just down the stairs of the building, you'll find a covered food stall where you can quickly and casually enjoy some Japanese food. I ordered a half portion of unadon (eel rice bowl) for 250 baht, and the eel was thick and surprisingly delicious. The addition of imitation crab meat is so typical of Thailand!
sample_reviews_en.author: Eire E

sample_reviews_en.text: I came based on reviews. This time I tried the curry rice with hamburger patty topped with cheese. It tasted good, the patty was large and the cheese filled the plate. I also had the spaghetti carbonara with bacon and cheese sprinkled on top, in a delicious sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Girawatt Rakjirapaak

sample_reviews_en.text: had the tonkatsu bento there with curry, the curry is quite salty, the texture of the breaded cutlet is also different from how it usually is but okay crunchy, still can’t tell if like it or not, might wanna give it another try for the burger on rice tho
sample_reviews_en.author: Pep

restaurants.name: SUPAROS THAI - ITALIAN RESTAURANT
restaurants.address:

63 S Sathon Rd, Khwaeng Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was amazing! The flavors were perfect, and there was a wide variety to choose from. I loved the presentation; both savory and sweet, Thai and Italian, were delicious. The prices weren't exorbitant, the restaurant was beautiful with a great vibe, and they had a full selection of drinks. The service was excellent (💯💯), and there was convenient parking. I loved it and want to go back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: NampeungVoice

sample_reviews_en.text: Highly recommended! New hidden gem on Sathorn Road! food at Suparos Restaurant is absolutely delicious and beautifully present. atmosphere is cozy and comfortable, paired with good music that makes for lunch and dining experience even better. The staff are incredibly sweet and offer excellent service mind. prices and portion sizes are reasonable and definitely worth it. I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ochawin การคํานวนยอด

sample_reviews_en.text: Wonderful restaurant with both authentic Thai cuisine and a great selection of international dishes and wines. The food was delicious, the service was excellent, and the staff were very friendly and welcoming. They also offer great breakfast and lunch set menus at very reasonable prices. Definitely a lovely place to dine and relax 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Palmy .G

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I tried Thai food and it was delicious! I especially loved the crispy pork with Chinese kale. All the dishes tasted great and were delicious – excellent value for money. The restaurant atmosphere was great, beautifully decorated and very comfortable. The staff were friendly and lovely. I will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: เฉลิมชัย สุธรรมเมธา

sample_reviews_en.text: I am not a tourist here. I live in Bangkok for eight months, and so far, by all means this is the best and most subtle restaurant I have visited in Bangkok. I am picky on everything. Nothing but admiration on the quality of the food (spectacular) and the services as well. I will visit again. Highly recommend place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Edward-William Bradford

sample_reviews_en.text: I strongly do not recommend this place. Please go to another restaurant. Today I ordered pork cutlet curry rice, and they gave me very little curry. I couldn't even finish half of the pork. They wouldn't let me ask for more; I had to ask for ketchup to eat with the pork cutlet instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khamawat Siritheerasas

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, both the Thai and Italian dishes. Everything we ordered tasted great. The restaurant's atmosphere was beautiful, and the staff were lovely and attentive throughout. We were very impressed and will definitely bring our family back next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: J Hcr

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here based on reviews. My impression was great the moment I walked in. The staff were very welcoming, the atmosphere was wonderful, the food was delicious, and the wait time was short. The staff were very attentive. I will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Guo kamonnet

restaurants.name: Friendly Restaurant
restaurants.address:

385 27 Khopai Rd, หนองปรือ Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Good, well priced, with karaoke rooms and large bar and entertainment area."

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place comes alive anew around 6 or 7 AM. As the host bars close, all the bar hostesses flock here. Loved by both locals and tourists in Pattaya, Friendly Restaurant is a Mukata specialty shop that lives up to its name with friendly service and outstanding taste. 🥘

Quality and Composition: It showcases the classic Mukata, allowing you to enjoy fresh meat, seafood, and various vegetables to your liking. In particular, the shop's unique secret sauce maximizes the umami of the meat, and the accompanying side dishes are all neat and delicious, making it hard to stop eating. 🦐

Atmosphere and Service: The neatly maintained outdoor seating is perfect for savoring the Thai nightlife, and fans placed throughout the restaurant ensure a comfortable dining experience. True to the shop's name, the staff are very cheerful and attentive to your needs, making you feel pampered throughout the meal and leaving me very satisfied. ✅

This is Pattaya's best Mukata restaurant, lacking nothing in 'taste, hygiene, and service.' If you are looking for a pleasant meal at a reasonable price, I highly recommend this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Steel

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been here many times for meals and karaoke. This time, three of us visited specifically for a meal.

We ordered a hot pot as the main dish, along with two kinds of som tam, khom yang, and three beers, for around 1300 baht.

The ingredients were fresh and the presentation was beautiful.

The hot pot soup was delicious, with the flavors becoming more concentrated the longer the ingredients simmered.

The menu had a huge number of dishes, so I've uploaded a picture.

The restaurant is large, with countless seats. There are also many billiard tables. A large pond in the middle of the restaurant creates a nice atmosphere. Pop art characters are decorated throughout, which is a nice touch.

Wi-Fi is available via a captive portal login. Upload speed was 41 Mbps, and download speed was 29 Mbps.
sample_reviews_en.author: Syo Kei

sample_reviews_en.text:
A friend recommended this place as a great spot for Mukata, so we came together!

Of course, I came with a Thai friend, and I confidently grilled the meat and offered it to him first.

However, he didn't touch the meat I gave him and started eating only the seafood and vegetables. Curious, I took a bite of the meat and realized why he hadn't eaten it. Since I exercise regularly, I ate all the meat by myself to get my protein intake. The meat wasn't inedible, but the quality fell far short of my expectations! However, the broth, seafood, and vegetables were quite excellent. The atmosphere and everything else was good, but regarding the meat quality, it seems like someone needs to provide feedback to make changes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Park

sample_reviews_en.text: This was the worst food I’ve ever had in my 8 trips to Pattaya. There was no meat on the ribs, it was basically bones and it was way too spicy even though the menu didn’t mention this. I requested they correct my order so they brought me new ribs without spicy sauce but there was so much salt that it tasted terrible. They also refused to credit my bill for the uneaten ribs so I ended up paying almost 900 baht for terrible food. Meanwhile there was an old man hauling rocks and sawdust through the restaurant with a wheelbarrow while we were eating. Now I’m still hungry after all this. Worst restaurant I’ve ever been to in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rick Todish

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great late-night food spot with chill vibes

Went here after a long night out—definitely hits the spot if you’re looking for something tasty and easygoing after midnight. The staff were friendly, service was pretty quick even though it was late, and the music kept the vibe alive without being too loud.

The menu has a good mix of Thai and Western dishes. I tried the pad kra pao. Prices are reasonable for Pattaya, and the portions were generous.

Only reason it’s not 5 stars: seating could be a bit more comfortable, and the lighting inside is a bit harsh. But for what it is—a fun, casual after-party refuel—it absolutely delivers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael S.

sample_reviews_en.text: The mukata is tasteless. Who said it was good? I think I've lost my sense of taste. It's just a place to book while being caged. The other food is delicious. A lot of hostesses and fans come here. It's a place where they work and there's karaoke inside. It's quite expensive. 700 baht for 1 hour, 1,500 baht for 3 hours. It's a place where hostesses eat women's butts. There's no picture of the mukata because it's tasteless.
sample_reviews_en.author: Soul Eternal

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited this place 4 days in a row. I visited when it opened and early in the morning. In the early morning, many locals come to eat and have a drink. The Mukata was very delicious. The other dishes were also very delicious. The price is reasonable. If you want to feel the local atmosphere, you should definitely visit here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dean Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the perfect place for those who want to eat after a night out, play billiards, and drink and chat until dawn. There was a Champions League match at 3 AM, which was great timing. A pleasant atmosphere. Mostly locals, very few foreigners know about it. Safe and clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: selçuk cantekin

restaurants.name: Diamond Maharaja Kitchen
restaurants.address:

4 Sam Sen Rd, Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It was absolutely awful. Normal Indian curry is made to order and takes a long time, usually in a metal container. This place was ready in less than ten minutes, and the chicken was sour. It was definitely pre-made and reheated, because I heard the microwave. The Indian long-grain rice was also not freshly cooked. It was terrible, like self-heating rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: yuhang diao

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great place, delicious food, and friendly staff! I had the butter chicken which was yummy. I choice no spice because I wasn’t sure how spicy it would be here in Thailand but will definitely go with the medium level next time!

Thank you having us!
sample_reviews_en.author: Cory C.

sample_reviews_en.text: Outstanding!!! Excellent cuisine, highly recommended. The restaurant offers not only Indian dishes, but also Thai and Chinese. We had Indian food and it was fantastic... we'll definitely be back, thank you so much!
sample_reviews_en.author: Johannes Settele

sample_reviews_en.text:
Highly recommended! The food is really good and the service is excellent (the guys here are very friendly, we felt very comfortable).

If you are vegetarian I recommend the paneer tikka masala, it was incredible!
sample_reviews_en.author: Emily Pressey

sample_reviews_en.text: We came as a family for launch and we really enjoyed the food as it was freshly cooked and it closes best halal restaurants we had for other people in my opinion I would recommend them to try butter chicken curry
sample_reviews_en.author: Yunus Ahmed

sample_reviews_en.text: We came here for dinner after a very long day with 2 young kids. The staff were very accomodating & patient. They made the dhal non spicy & brought out chocolate ice creams post meal for the girls! …
sample_reviews_en.author: Kirsty Hayler

sample_reviews_en.text: Great food with many vegetarian options. The staff was very kind and helpfully. Some money had fallen out of my bag when I left and they came to give it back. They deserve your visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Noah E

sample_reviews_en.text: I enjoyed some delicious Indian food after a long time! I'll definitely come back for dinner with my family next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: 末木竜司

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือ ตา-ยาย
restaurants.address:

116/16 Phetkasem Sai Kao Rd, Wat Tha Phra, Bangkok Yai, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The noodle soup broth is incredibly rich and delicious, no need to add any seasoning. The thin noodles are god-level good. The price is affordable. The elderly couple who run the place provide good service. Come early in the morning; some days they have amazing crispy pork rinds.
Give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Poot

sample_reviews_en.text: The boat noodle soup is not too spicy, perfectly balanced and doesn't need any extra seasoning. They also have freshly made crispy pork rinds. The price is very cheap. It's run by an elderly couple, but it's located by the roadside and finding parking is difficult.
sample_reviews_en.author: pol2006 pol

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and reasonably priced. The broth has a great aroma and the braised pork is well-prepared. Parking is a bit difficult. It's packed at lunchtime, but it's worth it. You have to try it! The crispy pork cracklings are a must-try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fud Rott

sample_reviews_en.text: I stop by every time I pass through... the green pork cracklings are amazing! I never make it in time, they're always sold out. Before, the owner used to save some for me, but now I only go there occasionally, so I always miss out!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pennapa Sriromruen

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles were delicious, no need to add any seasoning. They tasted great with the crispy pork cracklings. The grandparents were so lovely, fun to talk to, and very friendly. The price was incredibly cheap! 🍜
sample_reviews_en.author: Nampetch ITP

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is just right, not too bland and not too thick. The pandan leaf drink is worth the price. The grandmother is lovely, friendly, and always smiling and welcoming.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanny (SIDEBURNER)

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is great, delicious without needing any extra seasoning. And what you absolutely can't miss is the dry rice noodles; they are the best dry noodles ever.
sample_reviews_en.author: Niroj Teelek

sample_reviews_en.text: The boat noodles with rich and delicious broth are very affordable (25-35 baht). The elderly couple who run the place are kind and remember my regular orders. 😻 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Worachai Chainuan (Kim)

restaurants.name: VILAS วิลาศ
restaurants.address:

Velaa Sindhorn Village, B1 Floor, E103, Lang Suan Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Been to this place multiple times. It’s giving Thai Style-fusion-tapas with wide options of Thai alcohol pairing and wine. The food is bold and a bit spicy. 🌶️
Perfect for TGIF or friends’ hangout. I always love their wagyu quail egg with caviar. I also love their ขนมเบื้อง dessert - a perfect combination of sweet & savory.
sample_reviews_th.author: Min

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at Vilas, and it was truly an outstanding experience from start to finish. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, with just the right balance of elegance and comfort. The staff was attentive, knowledgeable, and genuinely friendly, making us feel welcome the moment we walked in.

The food was excellent prepared by chef Bank and his team. Every dish was beautifully presented and bursting with flavour. The ingredients were clearly fresh and thoughtfully paired—each bite felt carefully crafted.

What really set this restaurant apart was the attention to detail. From the pacing of the courses to the wine recommendations that paired wonderfully with the dishes, everything felt seamless.

I highly recommend Vilas for anyone looking for a memorable dining experience. Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion or just treating yourself to a great meal, this place absolutely delivers. Thank tou you to the chef team, Khun Gan, Khun Yiyi and Khun Leklek for great service. Ill be back for sure!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kenny Karlsson

sample_reviews_en.text:
✨ Vilas — modern Thai fusion done right, with surprisingly affordable prices.

Started the meal with sweet shrimp paired with rich, creamy yellow sauce and crispy kanom krok — a fresh, playful opening that instantly woke up the palate. 🦐💛

The tom som seabass was incredible: perfectly balanced sweet-and-sour flavors with an aromatic fragrance that made every sip refreshing and appetite-opening.

The roasted duck bowl was both delicious and beautiful. Juicy duck over warm rice, elevated by the staff finishing the dish tableside with a stunning cheese scratch — simple, elegant, and so satisfying. 🦆🧀

Dessert closed the meal perfectly: ultra-thin crispy pancake with caramelized sugarcane ice cream — light, fragrant, and not overly sweet.

A refined Thai experience that feels special yet approachable. Definitely a place worth revisiting. 🇹🇭✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Amornrut Namasondhi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dining at Vilas was truly a standout experience. Each dish felt thoughtfully designed, with flavors that were well-balanced and exciting in every bite. The menu offers a refreshing take on Thai cuisine, rooted in authentic flavors but elevated with modern cooking techniques 🧡

The atmosphere was warm and comfortable, with just the right lighting and space to enjoy the meal. It’s a great spot for couples, friends, or even family gatherings. Perfect for both locals and tourists looking for something a little different.

The presentation was beautiful, and you can really tell that high-quality, fresh ingredients were used in every dish. Everything felt carefully crafted and full of flavor 😊

Highly recommended if you’re looking for a memorable dining experience in Bangkok.✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasinee Thongperm

sample_reviews_en.text:
My personal experience with Vilas was excellent. The food was flavorful, with an interesting and somewhat complex taste profile.

For the main dishes, my personal favorite was the grilled fermented short rib and the Northern tomato relish with smoked pork. The meat was tender and well-presented.

However, the sweets and desserts were not to my personal taste. They would be more suitable for those who enjoy Thai-style sweets fused with Western desserts, offering a complex flavor balance between sweet and sour or sweet and salty. But as I mentioned, not my cup of tea.

The service was outstanding, and I would recommend Vilas for those seeking a refined fusion and fine dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wongsphat Amnuayphan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went here to celebrate my birthday, and it was hands down the best Thai fusion restaurant I’ve ever been to. Every dish we ordered was incredible and gave us a whole new appreciation for Thai fusion cuisine. Each bite was full of flavour, and every dish exceeded our expectations.

The service was just as amazing. Everyone was so warm and welcoming. The manager even treated us to two shots of Ya Dong (Thai herbal liquor), which was such a thoughtful gesture and tasted fantastic.

The restaurant itself is quite small, but that adds to its cozy and intimate atmosphere. Thank you for an unforgettable birthday dinner and such delicious food. We’ll definitely be coming back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Aurora Jibigoa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Exceptional dining experience at VILAS! The food was beautifully presented and full of unique, refined flavors. Highlights of the night included the thinly sliced wagyu beef topped with glossy caviar and a delicately marinated quail egg, a luxurious bite that simply melted in the mouth, and the charred sweet corn skewers served on mini tortillas with fresh greens, crispy shallots, and pickled vegetables, a vibrant mix of smoky, sweet, and tangy notes.

Chef Bank and the team are both welcoming and incredibly talented, making the whole evening even more special. The staff were attentive and warm, creating a perfect atmosphere. Definitely a place I’ll be visiting again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Alberto

sample_reviews_en.text: A solid 5-star experience at Vilas. The food here is highly complex in flavor but surprisingly approachable and easy to eat. A huge standout for me was their in-house fermented fruit and Thai herb spirit—it was absolutely fantastic and a must-try. The only downside is the price-to-portion ratio. The portions are quite small, and each dish feels more suited for one person rather than sharing. However, considering the top-tier ingredients and execution, the pricing is totally understandable. Great place if you value quality over quantity.
sample_reviews_en.author: WOODWOO

restaurants.name: Thaanfai Restaurant Rama 9 (ถ่านไฟ พระราม9)
restaurants.address:

15 ซ. หัวหมาก 21 Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had planned to go for dinner,
based on reviews, but I was very disappointed because there was a private party going on.
It seemed to be a company party or something, I'm not sure.
It was very noisy and disturbed other tables.
1. If there's a private party, customers should be informed beforehand to ask if it's okay. We could have gone to another restaurant. We called to ask if there were tables available before arriving.
They could have informed us then, but they didn't.
2. Some members of the private party even sang instead of the main singer.
They sang off-key and shouted loudly.
3. When asked why they didn't move tables, the restaurant was small and they could hear from anywhere.
4. They asked if we were okay. Should we be asking others if they're okay, even if it causes them inconvenience? No one is okay with that.
5. Overall, it was a bad experience. I understand having a private party, but the restaurant's failure to control the noise and allow other diners to have some peace and quiet is something the restaurant needs to address.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mildmy CHERLIYA

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was excellent, I was impressed with every dish! 🫶

The steak was tender, juicy, and perfectly grilled with a wonderful aroma. Eating it with salt really brought out the flavor of the meat.
The grilled prawns were large, fresh, and had a bouncy texture, with a rich and flavorful sauce that wasn't too heavy.
The salmon was also well-prepared; the skin was crispy, and the flesh remained moist and not dry at all.

The salads were very fresh, especially the one with fruit and walnuts; the flavors complemented each other well, making it not too heavy.

The restaurant atmosphere was great, perfect for a relaxing meal with friends or a partner.
Overall, it was great value for money. The food was high-quality and delicious in every dish. I will definitely come back again! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
sample_reviews_en.author: Usaki JR

sample_reviews_en.text:
For meat lovers, come to this restaurant! It's incredibly delicious, everything is perfect.
The bill today was around 6,000 baht (2.5,000 baht was wine). Everything else was amazing and delicious. The beef fried rice was especially good, fragrant, flavorful, and the beef was top-quality.
I recommend making a reservation beforehand. Parking is a bit difficult; there's parking in front of the restaurant or on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: กินกับแว่น

sample_reviews_en.text: The grilled meat was completely charred on the outside on all sides, ruining the texture and flavor, leaving a bitter aftertaste. The tongue was also over-grilled, burnt and crispy on the outside. Overall, it was a waste of good meat and not worth the price. However, the spaghetti and salad were okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ati M

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good price, a little far.
Good taste, everything is okay.
The meat is cheap compared to its quality, the clams and shrimp are good, the pizza has a crispy crust.
The Vongole was a little greasy, but maybe that's just my preference. I'll try other pasta dishes next time.
Good atmosphere 👍🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: ICE THANA

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is quiet and peaceful.
Not too crowded.

Good service.
It has a Western-style atmosphere, serving steak, spaghetti, etc.

The food is generally good,
but considering the price range,
I can think of other options that offer more to my liking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Park Bodhisundara

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and great value. The medium-rare picanha was perfectly cooked, tender and flavorful. Everything was delicious. The surprise was the grilled sweet clams; perfectly cooked with a crunchy texture. The burrata salad was refreshing and …
sample_reviews_en.author: Patcharee Srisupho

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food at good prices. The beef tongue was excellent ⭐️
The atmosphere is nice, the restaurant is beautifully decorated, suitable for both special occasions and everyday outings. The staff are lovely and provide good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: praeww

restaurants.name: Little Vikings Cafe and Restaurant
restaurants.address:

95, 16 Soi Lat Phrao 41 Yaek 8, Khwaeng Chan Kasem, Khet Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you love Western food, you absolutely can't miss this place! It's a small restaurant located under an apartment building (you could call it a hidden gem ^^) but the quality is exceptional. They serve homemade Swedish-style food made with care. The chef makes everything from scratch, from the sauces, ham, sausages, and bread to the ingredients for drinks like butterscotch.

We ordered the 6-Hours Beef Stew (240 baht), Cold Cut Combo (250 baht), a hot homemade butterscotch latte (60 baht), and Tiramisu cake.

The Cold Cut combo includes Viking sausage, ham, and smoked salmon, served with Lux sauce and a balsamic-dressed salad to balance the richness. Everything was delicious because they use high-quality, fresh ingredients.

The stew was also fantastic. The chef braised the meat until it was incredibly tender and melted in your mouth. It was fragrant, flavorful, and rich, but not at all greasy. It was perfect paired with the homemade bread.

The restaurant is located in Soi Ladprao 41 and has parking available in front. It's open daily from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM and closed on Wednesdays. We were very impressed and will definitely be back! :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukwan At.

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Little Viking" is a hidden gem serving authentic Swedish food in Soi Ladprao 41 (Soi Phawana). Located on the ground floor of an apartment building, it has an atmosphere like having a meal at a Swedish friend's house.

The chef is half Thai and half Swedish, and he makes everything himself, saying he dislikes buying ingredients. Even the sausages are homemade, and the ham is cured in-house. While eating, you'll see only one person operating the entire restaurant – the chef himself! He handles everything from taking orders and serving water to cooking, serving, collecting payments, clearing tables, and washing dishes. Yet, the food comes out surprisingly fast.

The meatballs, pork balls, smoked salmon spread, and salsa were incredibly delicious – I practically licked every plate clean! The taste is simply amazing. There are many other dishes on the menu that I'll definitely try next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Swedish restaurant tucked away in a small alleyway. The food was excellent; the chef is also the owner, which I believe is why the quality remains consistently high. Their homemade meatballs were even better than those from IKEA. Swedish meatballs are delicious, perfectly cooked, and rich in meat flavor, served with mashed potatoes, bread, and jam. I'd definitely come back to try other dishes sometime.

In the afternoon, the air conditioning wasn't very strong. On my way out, I saw they were selling homemade wholewheat bread, so I bought one to take home. 👍🏻 It was delicious; this bread was definitely worth the price and inexpensive—in fact, it was cheap considering the quality.

You can park your car in front of the shop. I happened to be buying something at the Lotus convenience store across the street, so I parked there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fat Fat

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. The flavors were rich and intense. The spaghetti was tasty, and the beef stew was very tender and easy to eat; the soup was enjoyable. I usually don't like meatballs, but these were surprisingly good with the blueberry sauce. They also tasted great with the mashed potatoes. The portions at the restaurant are quite large. Three of us ordered three dishes and were quite full. The owner gave us a free sample of the lamb ribs. The unique flavor of the lamb combined with the restaurant's marinade was excellent and very flavorful. Parking is available near the restaurant or at the Lotus store across the street. Motorcycles can also be parked on the side, as the restaurant is located in an apartment building.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawarin Punyawajee

sample_reviews_en.text: This Swedish-English fusion restaurant in the Ladprao area has a homey atmosphere, like having a meal at a friend's. The owner is kind, talkative, and provides great recommendations. The food is generally delicious, using high-quality ingredients. I particularly enjoyed the pork meatballs and Shepherd's pie. The homemade bread is delicious, crispy, and crunchy. I also tried their homemade limoncello, which tasted just like the one in Capri. Overall, I was very impressed and will definitely return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bump Woratans

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just found a little and homey cafe near my hotel. They had western and Italian menu like pasta. All menu they cooked homemade with delicious taste, great service, faster, and the restaurant also clean.

The owner is also a chef in this restaurant. We also get free mineral water here and free flow. Price also affordable. All good and very recommended.

Best menu : Shrimp Marinara (pasta aldente with literally much shrimp inside), Butterscotch Coffee Mocha (good coffee, not too sweet)
sample_reviews_en.author: Dian Nitasari

sample_reviews_en.text:
A cozy little restaurant on the 1st floor of an apartment with authentic affordable Swedish food. The owner Kent is a Swedish-Thai born and raised in Sweden, who then later became a 20-year chef, just like his father.  His passion for cooking shines through our conversation about his nostalgic memory with all the menu he tasted when he was young.

Would surely return and try all the other menus!
sample_reviews_en.author: Parivat Sukriket

sample_reviews_en.text: I don’t think anyone can beat little Vikings meatballs with mashed potatoes and lingon berry. They are absolutely amazing,. They even beat my grandmother’s meatballs who I always believed make the best one in the world. And today i ended up my dinner with a newly baked semla. 10 of 10 points from me. No one will be disappointed here that’s a guarantee from me .
sample_reviews_en.author: Pak Wan

restaurants.name: Junya Bake & Brew
restaurants.address:

149 moo 2 Ratchaphruek Rd Tambon Bang Khun Kong, Amphoe Bang Krua, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been buying bread from this shop since before it became as famous as it is now. I feel like the service quality has changed. Before, I'd come after a workout looking disheveled, and the staff would still greet me with a smile. Today, I was dressed similarly, looking a bit shabby, and the staff still greeted me with a smile. I asked if they had focaccia, and a staff member wearing a black vest and washing dishes looked me up and down, staring intently into my eyes. I was really confused. Okay, I was dressed shabbily today, but the shop has changed a lot since I used to walk in. Normally, all the staff were friendly. Now they're giving customers this judgmental look. This is just feedback. I'm happy the shop has become more famous, but improving the service to match its success would be great. Personally, I probably won't come back because I can find equally delicious bread elsewhere, and I don't want to waste money on a shop that looks down on customers. I won't be posting photos, but if the shop sees this, they'll probably remember me.
sample_reviews_en.author: kratib nisapat

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came to try it based on the reviews, to see if it's really delicious or just a hype.
I missed out on the loaf available at the shop.
So I tried the sourdough, which was delicious and not too sour. It came with cream cheese and jam to spread on it (personally, I thought the sourdough tasted like normal, and the cream cheese and jam were pretty standard).
However, what really needs improvement is that the shop also sells other food, and the space is quite cramped. The kitchen might be connected to the customer seating area, but there's no ventilation at all. The smell of food is pervasive and it's very stuffy. Just waiting for takeaway food was already unbearable; I couldn't breathe properly. In my opinion, it's not very cozy or inviting for a meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: pajaree yokumporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried the Salmon Sourdough and was very impressed! 🥖🐟 The sourdough bread was perfectly baked, with a crispy, fragrant crust and a soft, chewy interior. It had a subtle tanginess, typical of authentic sourdough, which paired perfectly with the high-quality, fresh, and non-fishy smoked salmon.
The sauces and marinades were flavorful and complemented the salmon well. It was perfect with the onsen egg and vegetables, not at all greasy.
The drinks were refreshing and helped cut through the richness of the food. The atmosphere was comfortable, suitable for both a meal and a cafe experience. There is plenty of parking. Customers keep coming in steadily. The shop is small, but there's a constant flow of customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuttun pi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is located in the Suan Dok Lamjiak project. There's plenty of parking and it's easy to find. The shop's decor and atmosphere are very nice. The staff are friendly and smiling. They offer a menu of food and drinks to enjoy in the shop.

Currently, if you want to buy sourdough bread to take home, you need to come by 10 am because the shop sells a limited quantity. Only one bag per person is allowed, and it's likely sold out by 11 am. The bread is soft, light, with a thin, crispy crust that's easy to chew and not chewy. It has a mild, delicious sourness.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poly T

sample_reviews_en.text:
The sourdough here is the real star—beautifully crusty on the outside with that perfect chewy, airy interior. You get that subtle tang that tells you it’s been properly fermented, not rushed. Whether you go for a simple slice or something topped, it feels thoughtfully crafted and seriously satisfying.

Their cold brew coffee pairs perfectly with it—smooth, low acidity, and super refreshing in Bangkok’s heat. It’s not overly bitter, just clean and mellow, making it easy to sip alongside a slow breakfast or afternoon chill.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wisanu Tuntawiroon

sample_reviews_en.text: This sourdough bread shop lives up to its reputation. I've been here twice and missed out both times. This time, I intentionally came a little before opening to queue, as recommended by the staff. Finally, I got to try it. The bread is as fragrant as other places I've tried. The menu has many tempting items; I'll try to sit down and eat in person sometime. However, I recommend ordering in advance if you live far away, rather than queuing, as there's a chance you might not get your order.
sample_reviews_en.author: tome Nattapong Worapivut

sample_reviews_en.text: I was really early in line, like the first person in the queue. The sourdough bread is delicious, but if you live in the city, you can just eat it in the city. The jam wasn't bad, but not amazing either. But the drinks were awful, really not tasty. It's a bit expensive. And when I asked for a paper bag, the owner said they only give them to people who order 2 loaves or more, but they said for takeout only 1 loaf per person 😞
sample_reviews_en.author: Sai Siritra

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm unsure about the taste because they took pre-orders until there was nothing left to sell in-store. It should be marked as closed on Google Maps. I traveled there and there was no bread available because it was all pre-ordered. I queued to order drinks, but the coffee was sold out. Even though I waited until opening time, the shop didn't have anything ready for sale. I'm very disappointed after traveling all this way.
