sample_reviews_en.author: Monnapha

restaurants.name: Feuang Nara
restaurants.address:

3 Naradhiwas Rajanagarindra Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Delicious Pad Thai at Feuang Nara (ร้านอาหารไทยเฟื่องนรา). A good balance of sweet, sour, and spicy flavors, freshly prepared and beautifully presented. Quick and friendly service. Highly recommended if you're looking for authentic Thai food in the city center.
sample_reviews_th.author: Henrik Peters

sample_reviews_en.text: I was very disappointed with the food. I ordered glass noodle salad, and it should have been spicy and flavorful, but it tasted like it only had lime juice. I asked them to add more chili, but the taste didn't change at all; they only added a few chopped chilies. The other dishes might be more suited to foreigners; the flavors weren't strong enough for Thai people. I was disappointed because this is Thailand, with all the ingredients available, they should be able to make better-tasting Thai food. The service was terrible; the staff seemed completely inattentive. When it was time to pay, they didn't even thank the customer. I was the one who thanked them and bowed, even though the food wasn't good. No wonder they have no customers. I will definitely not be going back.
sample_reviews_en.author: WanWaew Nuanphong

sample_reviews_en.text: Ok food, but overall disappointed by slow service (our drinks took a long time), and there was not sticky rice! No sticky rice in a Thai restaurant! Disappointing.. (strange because they have Mango sticky rice for desert). The food was also quite spicy in spite of asking for non spicy. On the plus side, once they arrived, the Mango smoothie and the Thai iced coffee were absolutely delicious! Our final disappointment was the Mango sticky rice that we had to return because the bruised Mango and dry rice. They initially did not want to take it back. (see photo).
sample_reviews_en.author: Jean-Yves Bouguet

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lovely place to eat, good atmosphere. Food was decent, nothing mind blowing. However the service was poor. We ordered 1 draught beer, they then left two on our table, later in the meal they then brought a further 3rd beer saying “you buy 2 get 1 free” even though I’d only ordered 1 originally. Essentially they make you pay for 2 beers, and give you 3 without you ordering this. Felt like a cheap tactic to get an extra 100baht out of us.

Overall, decent Thai food, just left a sour taste in our mouth with the whole extra beer situation.
sample_reviews_en.author: James McCreath

sample_reviews_en.text: For our first dining experience in Thailand this place knocked it out of the park! The food was fresh and delectable! We started with the butternut pork as an appetizer then on to our main courses. Had green curry and chicken cashew with veggies! Also, they offer a large variety of drinks, I went for the fresh coconut they prepare and bring to the table. It was excellent and always good to hydrate! This place is very clean, they clean as you eat and it’s very welcoming! This place is a must!
sample_reviews_en.author: T Thomas

sample_reviews_en.text: I love the food, I have tried the khao pad moo and the squid with rice and egg. Both were really tasty and the restaurant decor is so pleasing to the eye. Service is good and all the employees were really polite and helpful. A bonus was the air con, as a Finnish traveler I overheat easily so the air con played a big part in why I choose the restaurant in the first place. And the prices aren't too high but aren't the cheapest either.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ea Toivonen

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the second time I've been to this restaurant (6 months apart)

The food is really good.
The price is good for the middle of Bangkok. Across the main road is Mahanakhon SKYWALK

The service is always friendly.

The food doesn't all come out at the same time, but when it's ready. Some people won't like that, but it isn't a problem for me. Rather have the food hot and at the table than it going cold in the kitchen.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ethical Retreats

sample_reviews_en.text: Rate food 3/5. Touristic restaurant style. Rate ambient 4/5. Rate staff 2/5. Was waiting 10 min to find someone ask for the bill. Rate management. 1/5. If not finish your food and want take away they charge 10 baht extra for the pack. Are not the 10 baht the problem. Could add to each dish 5 baht more. Is how the customer feel after this. OK the box looks nice and keeps the food fresh but please give me a brake.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dreamer and the Full Moon

restaurants.name: ครัวพี่เล็ก ข้าวแกงหาดใหญ่
restaurants.address:

ถนนโชคชัย4 ซอยทะลุแมคโครวังหิน กลางซอย ลาดพร้าว, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were standing around chatting loudly in the restaurant, as if they'd never spoken before. We couldn't find a chance to interrupt, and they were talking too loudly. The cashier was only focused on counting orders and didn't listen to the customers at all. When they made a mistake, they blamed the customers, even though we'd already told them we were waiting for our curry. The person who was supposed to serve the curry didn't seem to hear us at all; they just walked away to do something else with a straight face, not interacting at all to ask us to wait or anything. We didn't know what to do next. This was our first time eating there, and we encountered this kind of situation.
sample_reviews_en.author: mewreviews

sample_reviews_en.text: I've passed by this place for years and never thought of eating here. Today I decided to try it. The food tasted okay, but the service was terrible. It's one thing if they can't keep up with the large number of customers, but the service was awful. When I ordered something, the vendor was unresponsive and slow. I ordered dessert and didn't even get it. I waited for a while before they finally asked what I wanted, even though it only takes a few seconds to scoop it. After they told me what I wanted, they completely forgot what I ordered. In the end, I didn't get my dessert. Paying the bill was slow, and taking my order was also slow. Never again. One visit is enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: nan lomla

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is good and delicious. Parking is limited. The price is a bit high. The restaurant's management system could be improved. Customers should be able to pick their own vegetables and chili paste, because sometimes I don't eat a lot of vegetables, and many tables end up with leftover vegetables. I've almost finished my meal and am still waiting for my water, so I have to go get it myself. It would be much easier if customers could pick their own from the start. The staff wouldn't be overwhelmed and unable to keep up because they keep saying, "We'll have a staff member bring it to you soon."
sample_reviews_en.author: Jan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Southern Thai curry and rice restaurant offers delicious food with a wide selection of dishes: fried chicken, shellfish curry, fish offal curry, turmeric fried fish, and more. Everything is delicious. The vegetables and chili paste are served free of charge, and they accept a 50/50 (half-half) payment method, which is rare in this area. The restaurant opens early, but the food is served in full force from 9 a.m. onwards.

The sago here is also delicious, authentic sago, a rare find.

The curry and rice are more expensive than elsewhere, but the portions are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phakwipha Kaewwisit

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is spicy and the prices are quite high, but the restaurant is reasonably clean.
The service is okay, but the people serving the food and taking orders are slow and don't seem to pay much attention to customers. I was surprised that the rice and curry dishes require writing down the order and then being served at the table; it would be much faster if they could just serve it immediately after ordering.
sample_reviews_en.author: PpP P.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but when we got there, the front parking lot was full, so we got out of the car to see if we could park on the side. But another person was driving behind us and was going to park as well. The staff quickly ran over and waved the car behind to park before us, so we ended up with no parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Purahong Nawarat

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is very expensive. The price is not displayed. It says 2 items for 60 baht. When you actually pay, it's several hundred. The price of each item is not the same and they don't inform you. They don't really care about customers when they order something. It's like they don't want to sell.
sample_reviews_en.author: THEQRIZA

sample_reviews_en.text: I've driven past this place many times, so I decided to stop by today. The food tasted good, and the portions were decent, though more expensive than average. However, the service was terrible. The management system was awful; there was no …
sample_reviews_en.author: CHIEW Pongsiri

restaurants.name: Buzza
restaurants.address:

9/242 Soi Ratchadaphisek 66, Wong Sawang, Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in Soi Ratchada 66,
before the left turn at Kasemrad Hospital.

It's at the beginning of the soi, close to the main road.
There's ample parking.

The restaurant isn't very big, but the food is delicious and flavorful.
The portions are large and worth the price.
The flavors are on the stronger side.

There are two air-conditioned indoor seating areas and an outdoor area in front.

The restrooms are located in the outdoor area.
The service is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Koii Oki

sample_reviews_en.text: Bustling and bustling! Stop by Buzza for delicious and reasonably priced food. The crispy pork knuckle is amazing, a huge piece! The spaghetti carbonara is rich and flavorful. The green curry fried rice was a bit bland, not very spicy, I had higher expectations. But the onion rings are huge, crispy, and delicious. Judging by how much the kids eat, we always order them every time we come.
sample_reviews_en.author: moomeaw_ultra_mang@hotmail.com Naruemon1543

sample_reviews_en.text: A delightful and cozy restaurant just a short walk from Kasemrat Hospital. The antique clock decor gives it a unique, homey charm. Buzza excels at both Western and Thai food, with everything from tasty soups and German pork knuckle to authentic "Yum Woon Sen." A great place with ample parking. Be sure to check their opening hours on weekdays.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aimamorn Suvichakorn

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. I recommend the fried squid with garlic, baked mussels with butter, pork with lime sauce, and the grilled pork salad with garlic cloves, which enhances the flavor even more. The restaurant closes at 2 PM and reopens at 4 PM. Parking is very convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: lucksika moonchinda

sample_reviews_en.text: The salad was delicious and the price was reasonable for the portion size. They also have single-serving dishes on the menu. The atmosphere was warm and homey, and it was clean and nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: mon S

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted okay, but the service from the staff, including the owner, wasn't very good. They spoke without politeness and didn't even say thank you after the payment was made.
sample_reviews_en.author: thatchaporn suppawat

sample_reviews_en.text: Very homey and nice local dishes. Mix German sausage spicy salad is a must. Every dish was done to perfection. Also Tom Zaap Buzza ! Recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: LocalLens

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, affordable, and there's a wide variety to choose from. The service is excellent and the atmosphere is pleasant.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภรมน ยศเมฆ

restaurants.name: woogobzip 우곱집 Thailand
restaurants.address:

99 29 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Khwaeng Din Daeng, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant isn't located on the main road, but a few tens of meters further in. There's parking available for 3-4 cars, or you can park at the Esplanade mall parking lot. Alternatively, you can take the MRT to Cultural Center station, which is a very convenient walk away. The restaurant serves authentic Korean food and offers various table sizes depending on the group size. There are also private rooms available for reservation. The menu has many options. Today, I ordered Wagyu beef, pork belly, and pork neck, all grilled for you by the staff. I also ordered Tteokbokki, Korean chicken soup, and seafood pancakes. They even included two complimentary Korean steamed eggs. Overall, the food was delicious, with flavors adjusted to suit Thai tastes. I particularly loved the Wagyu beef – it was incredibly tender and melt-in-your-mouth. The pork was equally good. The Tteokbokki and Korean steamed eggs are must-try dishes. The total price was around 4,xxx baht, considering the large selection of Wagyu and pork, making it excellent value for money. The staff provided excellent service. I highly recommend this restaurant; you won't be disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: T.P

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honestly, I didn't intend to eat here. I was driving past and saw it, and since I was craving Korean food, I decided to try it. I want to shout out loud how delicious it was! Everything was so incredibly delicious. First of all, the side dishes were gone in less than a minute after they were placed on the table. I asked for refills, and I'm not sure if it was the owner, but they brought them to me. I was so hungry and a little embarrassed. But when they realized I was hungry, they brought me some fried dumplings and another dish I didn't even order. They were so incredibly kind! And it was so delicious, I could scream. The beef bone soup is a must-order. How many more times do I have to say how delicious it is? 😂😂😂 I didn't get to try the BBQ because my order got lost, but I was already so full. The price is great. It's totally worth it! Oh, I saw that they have Korean-style karaoke upstairs. I'll definitely try it next time. Hehe. Finally, I'm definitely coming back. From not planning to come, now I'll be coming back regularly. ❤️❤️❤️
P.S. I didn't take pictures of the food when it arrived, only when it was all gone 😂
sample_reviews_en.author: GL Kohkaew

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited this restaurant, a cozy Korean BBQ spot tucked away near Esplanade Ratchada. The food was delicious! The meat was tender and flavorful, and I loved that the staff cooked it for us at the next table. No smoky hair or lingering smells here!

The side dishes were a highlight. They offered a great variety such as  refreshing kimchi, spinach etc. Suggest kimchi soup as a very comforting soup. They were all incredibly tasty. Plus, you can refill the side dishes as much as you want. The staff were friendly and tried their best to provide good service, even if there was a slight language barrier.

I was pleasantly surprised to find that they offered a complimentary egg custard pot and fruit for dessert. It was a nice touch to end the meal. If you're looking for authentic Korean BBQ with a quiet atmosphere and delicious food, I highly recommend giving Woogobzip a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ju Janya

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was so good that I visited twice during my short four-night stay in Bangkok. The service was impeccable. I was so impressed by how delicious every single dish I ordered tasted just like the ones I had in Korea. This is truly a true gem.
If I ever return to Bangkok, I'll definitely return.
I highly recommend this place to anyone traveling to Bangkok.
We're the type of people who never trust reviews, but after reading the previous reviews, we were skeptical, but this is a restaurant we truly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: 심윤희

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited because I wanted to eat gopchang in Bangkok, and it exceeded my expectations.

The gopchang had no gamey smell and was savory, and the daechang was chewy and delicious.

The woodaegalbi also had a nice charcoal flavor, and overall, the food quality was excellent.

I was satisfied, as expected from a place frequented by Korean celebrities.

The staff were friendly, and I liked the atmosphere, which felt like a traditional Korean BBQ restaurant.

I would definitely visit again 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: 김혁

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited Woogopjib because I was really craving Korean food while on vacation in Bangkok. The atmosphere was great, and although I couldn't try everything, the pork belly and tripe had plenty of fat inside. The japchae was even tastier than what I've had in Korea.

Besides that, the fish roe soup had an amazing broth, and I am so grateful that they gave us yukhoe and japchae as a complimentary service for my birthday. I am 100% willing to visit again next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: 이은규

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere was chill and easy going, the staff were AMAZING, full of smiles and humor, and the food was excellent. We were Greeks trying Korean for the first time and honestly, it was something else.

It was so good in fact, that even though we were in Bangkok for 10 days and there were thousands of places we could visit, we ended up coming back here twice 🥹🥹

Big plus: stays open later than other restaurants, more in-line with European dinner times.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dimitris Sfounis

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything we ordered was delicious. I especially loved the tteokbokki.
The restaurant asked about our preferred level of spiciness beforehand. The prices were reasonable, and it was easy to get to. The smell didn't linger on my hair or clothes much, although that might be because we went early, at 5 PM, when the air conditioning had just been turned on, so it was a bit warm. It got better after a while. I'll definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: milkii

restaurants.name: Chang Canvas
restaurants.address:

197 Witthayu Rd, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chang Canvas is basically Chang’s official restaurant and beer house, with a nice European beer hall vibe. The decor feels pretty luxury and there are tons of corners that look great in photos.

The craft beer selection is pretty limited, especially the seasonal ones that are exclusive to this place. Each one has its own character but still keeps that hoppy note. Personally, I liked the Rose the most since it’s super easy to drink and leans a bit sweet, while the others have stronger flavors. The place is huge and really well decorated, and the staff were great at recommending beers based on what you like or what you’re eating.

Food is a bit pricey, but I think the beer prices are pretty reasonable considering the atmosphere. There aren’t many places where you can have a beer and get this kind of vibe. Definitely worth trying.
sample_reviews_en.author: John de j3k

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were satisfied last time, and since my child wanted to see a live music performance again, we visited again.

There was a notice at the door stating that entry was not permitted due to it being a private event. When the staff member saw us, they made an 'X' with their arms. When we opened the door and asked how we could check the schedule in advance, they answered very unhelpfully, saying it was the calendar on their Facebook page.

When I checked Facebook, the schedule only went up to May. Today is June 2nd. There was absolutely no information provided.

I felt that the time and effort we spent traveling a long distance to visit this place was wasted. My child was also very disappointed.

If you want to run such a wonderful space, please ensure that your system is properly established as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: 길송희

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, the atmosphere was nice, and the service was pretty good, but the food packaging was incredibly careless. Instead of properly sealing the dipping sauce cups, they were just secured with rubber bands. I was lucky mine only spilled at home; I can't imagine how messy it would be if someone else spilled it in their car. And the outer packaging was paper, which is easily absorbed.

Another issue was that I reserved a table via Instagram. Someone confirmed my reservation, but when I arrived, my name wasn't on the list. The receptionist then said they would provide an extra seat??? However, that's somewhat forgivable because the seat itself was okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chulapat Amatachaya

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a restaurant with an on-site brewery, producing fresh beer right there. It's located in One Bangkok. You can ask the staff for directions. If you're in a different building, you can take a golf cart.

The restaurant is huge inside, divided into many zones, giving a good sense of privacy. The staff provides excellent service. Some days there's live music, which is very enjoyable.

The food is delicious! The soft-shell crab is crispy and tastes great with the sauce. The sushi rice is delicious, and the sashimi is high quality. I personally love the rosé beer; it's fragrant and easy to drink.

Overall, it's a great place.
sample_reviews_en.author: JoyJoy

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chang Canvas is located in One Bangkok. The atmosphere is like a beer garden, and the service staff are very attentive. The food isn't as expensive as you might think. I ordered the German pork knuckle, and the portion was surprisingly large; I couldn't finish it. The dishes in the pictures were even bigger than they looked when they were served.
The restaurant often has promotions in the evenings, so you should check if there are any deals. The food tastes good, and it's a convenient place to stop for a drink after walking around the mall or coming from Lumphini Park.
sample_reviews_en.author: 단비96

sample_reviews_en.text:
We have group dinner for annual meeting here abt 30 people.
The staff is well trained and really helpful.
The food is great, Thai food is taste like authetic, passionfruit dressing salad is ready good for fresh start.
I love that sushi roll so much, great idea for fusion food. They use Thai-rice instant of JP rice.
I try IPA indian gooseberry and Rose  roselle. Let’s say I love them. Chang should sell them for mass in the store.
And Special thank to Khun June, she help us a lot with the photograph and recommended the food and sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitapa Janurai

sample_reviews_en.text:
You can enjoy Chang beer on tap, and they also serve craft beers like Dunkel and IPA.
During lunchtime, which is available including Sundays, you can order a meal for as low as 89 baht (as of August 2014).
You also get nuts when you order a beer.
The only thing I couldn't finish was the raw bean sprouts in the Pad Thai, as it's unfamiliar to Japanese people.
There were also some interesting things, like the sugar topping.
The taste was very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: petenひかのゆうり

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a light dinner, and perhaps because it was Sunday, it was nice that it was quiet for the size of the place. The performance was lively, too. Seems like a great spot for beer. Is the Tom Yum-flavored peanuts this place's signature? It's a shame the rice portion is a bit small. The pork rice bowl tasted like pork ribs and was very tender. The fried rice was delicious as well. The scale of the pub, extending to the second floor, is impressive.
sample_reviews_en.author: 고해룡

restaurants.name: Shantou
restaurants.address:

491, สีลมพลาซ่า 39-40 ชั้น 1, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is tasty, but the location in Silom Plaza is very stuffy and smells terrible. It's like a ghost town. The food is like the first batch of Chinese restaurants that opened here. However, this restaurant has fresh fish, shellfish, and seafood that's still swimming in the water, and they prepare it well. It's flavorful and the prices are good. I tried it again to see if the steamed fish was any good, but it wasn't. It lacked the soy sauce and pork lard flavor I like in Hong Kong. The fish was also steamed and sliced, not served whole. I deducted one star because I was expecting a high-end restaurant, but it wasn't up to that level. It's just basic Teochew cuisine, good enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tui Dusadee

sample_reviews_en.text:
I just had one portion of rice, some clams, and 500g of crab, and the bill came to over €50. At first, they told me the crab cost 1,800 THB per kilo, but in the end they charged me 2,400 THB per kilo. On top of that, the staff couldn’t even speak English and insisted on talking to me in Chinese.

This kind of pricing is unbelievable and feels like a scam. Bangkok is not what it used to be — these days it’s overpriced and disappointing. Honestly, I would recommend traveling to Vietnam instead, where you can still enjoy high-quality seafood at much more reasonable prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: B S

sample_reviews_en.text: Totally authentic Chinese Cantonese/Teochew restaurant, just like the food from China, not like the modified Thai-Teochew restaurants. All the dishes I ordered were tasty and plenty of wok-hei (hot wok with high heat). They have fish tanks with live seafood and they also offer many options for hot pot. Parking is plenty with the large underground parking lot, don't forget to have your parking ticket stamped at the restaurant. Price wide, I think it is very reasonable, I had 3 stir-fries and one fried rice and the total came to 850 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: David T

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is clean, spacious, and the service is attentive and fast.

The food comes out quickly. The taste is authentically Cantonese.

The fish soup is delicious, the broth is hot and refreshing.

My favorite is the stir-fried potatoes. You can order them in several ways: plain, just sour, and spicy/sour.

The boiled chicken is tasty, and the dipping sauce is perfect.

The Cantonese-style fried rice is the best! Even though I'm trying to cut down on carbs, I couldn't resist. This dish is a must-order! 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: TOAH Z.

sample_reviews_en.text: On the evening of December 2nd at 22:25, I ordered a plate of stir-fried bullfrog with shredded ginger from the waiter at the restaurant entrance. At 22:30, I ordered a plate of fish maw and chicken soup inside the restaurant. I waited until 22:50 when the fish maw and chicken soup came, but the stir-fried bullfrog had not yet arrived. I continued to wait. At 23:10, I asked the waiter and found out that the service staff at the door did not place an order for me. The bullfrog was not fried until 23:25!
sample_reviews_en.author: Steven

sample_reviews_en.text: Food that they actually served me was great. Good chef. But the service was terrible. I placed an order and only one thing actually made it to the table. After about 30 minutes of waiting I finally asked where the rest of the food was and they said one moment. I got ignored for 10 minutes, then I called them over again and just requested the bill. My order was wrong, and it was just a waste of time and bad experience. Even though the food was nice I will never recommend this place to anyone
sample_reviews_en.author: Joseph Sannino

sample_reviews_en.text:
First time visiting.
The taste was delicious, well-balanced, and rich.
The food came out quickly and the staff provided good service.
The stir-fried chicken with chili would be much better if it were just chicken meat; they stir-fried it with the bones, which was difficult to eat, but the taste was delicious.
I was impressed with the sweet and sour stir-fry; the flavor was well-balanced and went perfectly with hot steamed rice.
There is parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ang Aungvara

sample_reviews_en.text: Restaurant next to the Furama Hotel, in Silom Square. Some of the fish in the tanks were dead. The food was good, but we ordered rice, fried octopus (which was the best part), and fried prawns. They asked for €60 for a bottle of wine! And that was the cheapest one… we thought it was incredibly expensive. We were going to have lobster for dinner, but we didn't dare. We'll try our luck at other nearby restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eva Patricia Pingarron Morillo

restaurants.name: Thaan Fai Restaurant
restaurants.address:

228/1 Soi Yothin Phatthana 7, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The overall ambiance and decor of the restaurant are beautiful, with plenty of photogenic spots.

Since we went at lunchtime, there were only two other tables occupied. We were a family with two children, and the staff only served two glasses of ice. We had to ask for two more glasses of ice for the kids.

Regarding the food, we initially asked how many pieces of lamb there were, and they said 5-6, but only 4 were served (as pictured). The price was 1,450 baht. Each piece was unevenly cooked; some were overcooked, and others were burnt to the point of being bitter. We felt it wasn't worth the price, as the burnt pieces ruined the flavor, and the overcooked pieces needed to be re-burned.

Another dish was the Tenderloin (200g) for 580 baht. The piece was quite small compared to the usual 200g portion. We suggest adding a salad, fries, or mashed potatoes to the plate to make it look less empty and more worth the price.

Overall, we're not sure if it's because we went at lunchtime and the head chef hadn't arrived yet, but we felt the food wasn't worth the money.
sample_reviews_en.author: nitaya yongratanamongkol

sample_reviews_en.text:
Saw a few reviews on socials and came to try and this is my honest review.

Food: Everything is on par. Beef quality is right there even the standard ones. All steaks got some decent crust but it could be better by reverse sear or other methods that make the steaks evenly cooked on the inside (thicker cuts like tenderloin and picanha would be much better as those two steaks we got were a bit too raw inside and thus a bit too chewy). Other menus are good though. Recommend beef fried rice!

Price: Excellent price. Everything is value for money.

Service: Kinda meh tbh. Staff can def greet and suggest menus to customers better. A service mindset made all the difference. Would def tip if the service was better (no service charge here so that’s prolly the reason why they are not attentive).

Atmosphere: Nothing too fancy, nothing sub standard.

No pics taken on this visit as we felt everything was just ok.

Will probably revisit on a budget day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arsarn Panichkit

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was average in taste; not as amazing as most reviews suggested. I personally like beef fried rice, so I wanted to try it here, but I felt indifferent. The amount of beef was quite small, and the aroma wasn't very strong.
The shrimp spaghetti was topped with a mayonnaise-like sauce with shallots, slightly spicy.
The grilled corn was perfectly dry and crispy, served with a mayonnaise-based sauce (I think it was the same base as the spaghetti).

The staff provided good service, and the restaurant had a comfortable, homey feel.
sample_reviews_en.author: vs.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is beautiful and spacious.
The staff were unfriendly and didn't offer any greeting or recommendations, placing the menu down with a stern expression.

The ribeye steak, ordered medium rare, came medium, with hardly any pink left.

The shrimp pasta was plentiful with decent-sized shrimp, but the cream sauce was too heavy and thick, almost like eating it with salad dressing.

The burger was okay; the bun was buttery.

Parking is available on the street.
They do not accept credit cards.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanwisa P

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious for all dishes! My most favorite dish is Beef fried rice in a pot! This is good texture with the good combination of all ingredients. Burratta salad is the one that is so good as well. I didn’t expect at all but it’s really impressive.

The price is reasonable with the quality. Will come back for next meal again. Recommended! 🤭
sample_reviews_en.author: fns

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was so delicious I didn't have time to take photos! The meat quality was worth the price. The tongue was good, the picanya was good, but the ribeye was a bit tough. Other dishes besides the meat were good too. The salad was amazing, so refreshing, you should definitely order it (rocket salad).
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimpidcha C.

sample_reviews_en.text: The steak was delicious, tender, and cooked just right. The tuna salad was beyond expectations, and it's my favorite dish at the restaurant right now. And, even better than expected, I recommend ordering the "grilled chicken skin." It perfectly represents the restaurant's name.
sample_reviews_en.author: omng

sample_reviews_en.text: It's one of the best places I have eaten steak at in Bangkok. If you are looking for good quality steak and a great place to take your friends, then Thaan Fai is the place for you. The owner definitely takes great to ensure that every plate …
sample_reviews_en.author: Amoreé du Pisani

restaurants.name: Sala Restaurant
restaurants.address:

27 7 S Pattaya Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I was treated to a fantastic soup, the atmosphere was great, and I recommend it to everyone. By the way, the dish isn't spicy, but you can also ask for more pepper if you like it spicier.
Price: 100 ฿
sample_reviews_th.author: Даня Авдюшев

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped by this restaurant after searching for places near the hotel. Perhaps because it was a little past lunchtime or because it was a weekday, we were the only customers, but I highly recommend this place!! The Tom Yum Goong was incredibly delicious, and as for the water spinach... well, what can I say? We also ordered an extra dish called the "raw shrimp salad"!! Wow~ Honestly, I was a bit scared it might be fishy! But guess what!! It was seriously, incredibly delicious!! It tasted like Odori marinated in fish sauce, and oh my god, it made me desperately crave soju!! I think every dish on the menu would be delicious too; this is definitely a great restaurant!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kyunghwa Seo

sample_reviews_en.text:
I happened to pass by this restaurant, and since it's always crowded during lunchtime and has good reviews on Google Maps, I decided to go in when it was empty around 7 PM.
I ordered Stir-fried Tofu with Mixed Vegetables and a Chang beer.
The Chang beer was well-chilled and pleasant to drink.
The Stir-fried Tofu with Mixed Vegetables was different from what I expected; there was a generous amount of minced meat and the seasoning was good, but there were few types and amounts of vegetables, and the tofu seemed to have been mixed in after it was finished stir-frying.
The service was also rather disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Takeuchi Tadamichi

sample_reviews_en.text: The food here was excellent. It is mostly Thai food with a western menu items available as well. Everything tasted so fresh and the portion size was generous. Located at the top of Soi 19, it is right next to a main road so you will have noise from the traffic. This did not bother me because I was really focused on the tasty food. I recommend this place to anyone in the area. The prices were also very reasonable and the place had a steady stream of customers but didn’t get overcrowded.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Jeffcoat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Truly a hidden gem!
This local eatery offers a wide variety of authentic Thai dishes, all customizable to your taste.

Their fish and other congee porridge variations are a must-try, along with their flavorful omelette options.

The place is clean, economical, and run by a friendly and attentive staff.

It’s heartwarming to see such great quality at such reasonable prices.

Let’s support and celebrate gems like these that keep the essence of Thai food alive!

Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Victor Lobo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely delicious Thai food. Friendly staff. I've rarely eaten better in Thailand. The papaya salad (Thai Som Tam) is my absolute recommendation.

Absolut leckeres Thai-Essen. Personal freundlich. Raten besser in Thailand gegessen. Der Papaya-Salat (Thai Som Tam) ist meine absolute Empfehlung.

The Thai food here is definitely delicious. The staff is friendly. I've rarely eaten better in Thailand. The papaya salad (Thai Som Tam) is my absolute recommendation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr. Unknown

sample_reviews_en.text: Make sure to point out on the menu exactly what you order, as they tried to charge me 150 baht for the stir fried kale that was clearly listed as 100 baht with mushrooms, as mine didn’t have any so it’s cheaper. Having lived in Thailand for 10 years, I find it quite disrespectful that they assume foreigners won’t notice the pricing. Because of this, I won’t be returning, and I’d advise others to be cautious if you decide to visit this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Allen M

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited for the first time after seeing the reviews and photos.

I ordered the noodles I wanted.

It didn't look like the photo. Maybe it was a different dish?

Well, the food was pretty tasty as usual at this Thai restaurant.

I'd like to try their other dishes next time.

The prices weren't too expensive.

It was early evening, so I was the only customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: 輝宮城

restaurants.name: Rabiengboon
restaurants.address:

6th floor, MBK Center, 444 Phaya Thai Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Thai vegetarian food can be found at MBK, located on the sixth floor at counter 7 (07), which is easy to find. The overall dining experience was excellent; the dishes were authentic, fragrant, and very spicy, perfect for those who enjoy strong flavors.

I ordered three types of curry with white rice for only 70 baht, a great deal with satisfying portions. Besides curry, there are also various other options such as fried noodles and soups, allowing you to customize your meal to your liking.

Payment is convenient; in addition to prepaid cards, WeChat Pay and Alipay are accepted, making it very user-friendly for travelers.

Overall, it's a great vegetarian restaurant with affordable prices, a wide variety of choices, and excellent flavors, definitely worth a try. 🙏🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Ven.Sheng-yin

sample_reviews_en.text: THIS IS A MUST VISIT! I am not a vegetarian person but this place really made me happy with the food. It is in a canteen at the top of the mbk centre so it does feel a bit chaotic. You will select a rice and a number of freshly made dishes which seem to change all the time. I selected three items over red rice. Each dish was absolutely packed with flavors, spicy, sweet, salty and all the goodness and vegetables. I could have easily had 2-3 portions of the dish as was so tasty. It is a must visit for anyone!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bonsai Ninja

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dine-in: 24 November 2025
Updated/uploaded: 28 November 2025

◾ THB70 for (Brown rice with 3 vegetables)

✔️+ve
◾ Not difficult to locate (at MBK)
◾ Hygiene environment.
◾ Fair price (for brown rice with 3 vegetables)

❌-ve
◾ Food served cold.
◾ Unexpectedly over spicy.
◾ So-so for customer service.
◾ Inflexibility choice of payment: Must buy a card with loaded credit instead of paying cash.

*Opinion based on my experience as a world wide traveller and a seasoned vegetarian.
sample_reviews_en.author: _ Teo

sample_reviews_en.text: I got my hopes up because of other people's reviews but the experience wasn't great. It's located on the 6th floor in a dirty food court which was difficult to find at first. The food itself was disappointing and looked like it had been sitting out for ages. The only benefit is the meals are 70 bhat. And sadly there isn't much choice of vegetarian food in the surrounding area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Holly Marí Sutton

sample_reviews_en.text: Among the tastiest ultra-cheap vegan restaurants I've ever eaten at in Asia. It's in the 6th floor food court of MBK Center. You can't pay the restaurant directly but instead need to figure out how much your food will cost and then buy a card charged with that amount from the food court's cashier. My delicious lunch of rice plus three items cost just 70 THB.
sample_reviews_en.author: Erik Marcus

sample_reviews_en.text: Not very friendly or welcoming staff. Served me cold food. When I asked how I’m meant to eat it cold they said they don’t have a microwave. A lot of their menu wasn’t available and we went around lunchtime so not sure why it wasn’t. Located in a food hall so you could probably find much better places to eat at
sample_reviews_en.author: Sanjeet

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a decent place. I had noodles with tofu and soybeans in a spicy coconut sauce for 80 baht. It's a cafeteria-style place, but it's perfectly fine for a quick, inexpensive bite. And yes, you have to buy and top up your card first to pay right there in the food court; you can't pay with cash or card.
sample_reviews_en.author: Артем Печорин

sample_reviews_en.text: You can get Vegetarian Thai food at this location, just look for the counter 7 on the 6th floor. Food itself was very authentic, tasty and spicy. I went for the 3 curry and the rice option for 70 Baht. They have some other options too like fried noodles, soups,etc.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vishal B

restaurants.name: Chaiyapram
restaurants.address:

Phlap Phla Chai Rd, Wat Thep Sirin, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This hidden Thai restaurant is quite tucked away.
The map leads directly to it.

The menu offers various Thai dishes. I tried several today:
- Crispy pork belly with fish sauce: This was the best dish of the day.
It was crispy but not hard, not greasy, and not oily. It paired perfectly with the spicy dipping sauce.
- Ma Hor (a type of Thai dessert) and Ma Oun (another Thai dessert): Standard, but tasty.
- Stir-fried glass noodles: Dry and flavorful, quite standard.
- Red curry with roasted duck: Generous portion of duck meat, the sauce wasn't too thick. Personally, I prefer a thicker curry.
- Banana cake with caramel sauce: The sauce is homemade. It has a unique sweetness—I'm not sure if it's like condensed milk, but it was interesting.

Overall, the food is decent and meets standard expectations, but personally, it's not the best I've ever had.
Prices are standard.

The owner is friendly, helpful, and provides good recommendations.
The restaurant is quite small. Luckily, there was no queue when I went.
It might be a good idea to call and reserve a table beforehand.

There's no designated parking area. Parking at Wat Thepsirin and walking might be more convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichsaran Ves

sample_reviews_en.text: A hidden gem near Wat Thepsirin, I went there following a review by Ploy Jariyavech. I've visited this temple for years but never noticed this restaurant because it's located down a side street. I wasn't sure if there was parking nearby, so I parked at the temple and walked over. Entering the restaurant felt like stepping back in time to my childhood, before bright streetlights. The restaurant is quite low-ceilinged with antique-style tables. The Thai food is expertly prepared by a chef, and everything we ordered was delicious. After the savory dishes, don't forget dessert – the coconut ice cream is perfect for sharing. The toppings are generous, and the ice cream has a lovely smoky flavor from the candle-smoked topping. It's so delicious you'll forget about dieting!
sample_reviews_en.author: Suppasa Aimsaard

sample_reviews_en.text:
Some traditional Thai dishes are hard to find elsewhere. They do a great job with the curry pastes. My favorite dishes are:
- Ranjuwan Curry: The shrimp paste aroma is wonderful, with a perfect balance of sour, salty, and spicy flavors. Delicious!
- Stir-fried Pork Belly with Shrimp Paste: Also delicious, with a fragrant shrimp paste aroma.
- Coconut-Coated Shrimp with Crispy Coconut: The coconut coating on the shrimp is rich and creamy, a great combination.
- Bangleh Chicken with Roti: This dish is a bit spicy, the coconut curry has a beautiful color, and it pairs well with the crispy roti.

Parking in the side streets might be difficult to find.
The restaurant is small, so if it's busy, you might have to wait a while for your food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Varistha Phetcharakupt

sample_reviews_en.text: A truly spectacular place! The owner speaks excellent English, and he and his wife are incredibly friendly. They cook the most traditional and spectacular food I tasted in my three weeks in Thailand. The menu is only in Thai, but with the help of Google and the owner's language skills, ordering wasn't a problem. I must again highlight the kindness of the owners, who shared their fascinating history in the culinary world. This place will definitely be a must-visit on every trip to Bangkok. Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrick Messinger

sample_reviews_en.text: This small, cozy restaurant has a retro atmosphere and serves authentic, traditional Thai food. Each dish incorporates unique twists and turns, creating a signature flavor for the restaurant. The owner, Khun Ton, is incredibly friendly, offering great menu recommendations and attentive service. We ordered six dishes, and they were all delicious, but the must-try items are the sea bass with tamarind chili sauce, the smoked duck breast salad with mango dressing, and the crab cakes.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภักดี เลิศรุ่งโรจน์

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was looking for a quiet restaurant near my guesthouse to escape the hustle and bustle of the city. I followed the Google reviews and I'm so glad I did! It wasn't easy to find this little restaurant tucked away in an alley, but it was worth it. The owner is super friendly and speaks good English. I had duck curry with rice and also pandan chicken. Dishes cost between 100 and 200 baht. I really enjoyed it! Go there without hesitation!
Thanks again, sir, for the chat :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Alix BOIROT

sample_reviews_en.text: Wonderful! If you're passing by, you'd hardly even notice the entrance; this place is a true hidden gem. And what a owner! Incredibly interesting, friendly, and sociable. I found this place completely by accident. I saw reviews of sea bass with a signature sauce and came specifically for it. The fish was delicious. The sauce is based on garlic, chili, and tamarind. The perfect balance of heat, sweetness, and spice. I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nina

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a warm, homey atmosphere. All the dishes are delicious, but the prices are a bit high and the portions are small. However, it's acceptable considering how tasty everything is. We ordered the Chaiyaphram fried rice, deep-fried pork belly with fish sauce, Tom Yum soup, and braised pork. They even gave us a complimentary dessert while we waited for the bill, which was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: aelfy1992

restaurants.name: Tasty Bakery
restaurants.address:

524/1-2 Phahonyothin Rd, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This old-style eclair shop in the Saphan Kwai area has a thin pastry, a light and fluffy filling, and a lovely subtle milky aroma. I buy them regularly; once you start eating, you can't stop! I recommend buying them before noon because they sell out very quickly. Lately, it seems they've been making more, so you might have to wait. You can reserve them and then grab something to eat nearby before picking them up. They taste great and come in several sizes.
The mooncakes are also delicious; I ordered the jujube filling this time. The filling is dense, smooth, and not grainy at all.
The carrot cake is also tasty, but the crust is a bit too thick.
The chicken pie and chicken puff pastry have crusts that are a bit too thick for my liking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Freeze Kiwii

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tasty Bakery Review – Legendary Eclairs in Saphan Khwai

Tasty Bakery is a long-established bakery that's been open for over 50 years. Their signature eclairs are their small, thin crusts, dense, and fragrant fillings, perfectly sweet and creamy. They come in both vanilla and chocolate fillings, and each one is just 3.50 baht!

Besides eclairs, they also offer a variety of fillings, including shredded pork, minced pork, raisins, and chicken pie. The flavors are truly homemade.

Located on Phahon Yothin Road near Vimut Hospital, they only accept cash, have no parking, and are recommended to arrive early, as the eclairs sell out quickly.

Conclusion: Simple, tasty, and reasonably priced. Worth a stop for a souvenir.
sample_reviews_en.author: NATKOM CH

sample_reviews_en.text: Besides the delicious eclairs, they also have pork buns, banana cake, cheese and sausage buns, and pandan cake that you shouldn't miss. I've been eating here for over 30 years. Everything is made fresh daily. Their old-fashioned birthday cakes are also a must-try, if they still make them. Their loaf bread is also incredibly delicious and fragrant, very hard to find these days. I've been eating here since I was a kid, back when I worked at the Saeng Thai Optical shop next door. I grew up with this shop. Highly recommended. The prices are fair.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kampon Jeamsamran

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't know if I had too high expectations because of the social media hype, but I bought about four items, including eclairs. The taste wasn't great; I've had much better. I tried eating several eclairs and trying to stay positive, without any bias, but I'd give them 2 out of 5 stars. The mooncakes were the same. Ultimately, taste is subjective. In the end, they're all just sitting in the refrigerator, and I haven't thought about them since.
sample_reviews_en.author: John mango

sample_reviews_en.text: The eclairs are delicious. A small box of 10 pieces is 40 baht, which is perfect. The pastry and filling are just right; I like the slightly firm and crispy pastry, and the filling is a light, creamy milk filling. They have many other pastries too. I'll go back to try them. They say their chicken pie is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: ChaCha Peach

sample_reviews_en.text: Eclairs are soft, delicate, and not too sweet. 10 pieces for 40 baht. They sometimes sell out quickly by the afternoon. The mooncakes are soft, the filling is delicious, and the taste is just right. 65 baht per box, not expensive. Other pastries are generally delicious and make great gifts at reasonable prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: niwtboy taworn

sample_reviews_en.text: The eclairs are delicious; I couldn't stop eating them. They're even better chilled. The pastry is soft, the filling isn't too sweet, and the crust is thin with a generous filling. 10 pieces for 40 baht. The shop only accepts cash. It's an old-style bakery with many pastries that are hard to find these days.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mang Por

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! My family loves it. Pineapple pie and durian mooncakes are a must-try. It's hard to find an old, traditional shop with this retro-style dessert, but the taste is unchanged. The filling is generous, the crust is perfect, and the proportions are just right. Go early or they might sell out! 😘😘😘😘 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Irine ladypopcorn

restaurants.name: GO ROTI x CAFE @ Susco Square
restaurants.address:

SUSCO SQUARE ชั้น 2 Bang Mot, Thung Khru, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: A really nice place to hang out and relax with friends. I went there with my friend, and one thing I really liked is that they offer free tea, which feels very welcoming. We ordered banana roti with chocolate sauce, corn roti, Apollo cocoa, and lemon soda. The lemon soda was quite strong and a bit sour, so it wasn’t my favorite, but the roti was amazing soft inside, crispy outside, and very satisfying. I especially loved the banana roti, and the Apollo cocoa was rich and delicious. The café also has board games, so it’s fun to spend time there, and the place is very cute and perfect for taking photos. The atmosphere is cozy, the staff are friendly, and the prices are reasonable. Definitely worth visiting if you love roti and chill cafés. ☕️✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Vivien

sample_reviews_en.text: It has a cozy aesthetic vibe with warm lighting and comfortable chairs. They also provide free Wi-Fi and soft background music, which makes it a perfect place to relax or study after class. The café is very photogenic, so it’s great for taking cute photos with your friends. The staff are kind and polite, and the service is really quick. I also like that they provide a sink for washing hands and free refilled tea. The prices are reasonable, and I always enjoy ordering the sweet corn roti with condensed milk. It is crispy, sweet, and delicious, and it pairs perfectly with the tea they offered. I highly recommend this café to students near KMUTT campus.
sample_reviews_en.author: May Myint Myat

sample_reviews_en.text: The roti shop is located on the 2nd floor of the gas station (there's an elevator). They have both regular seating and floor-sitting options. The staff makes the roti fresh right in front of you. There's a variety of menu items to choose from, with prices ranging from mid-range to slightly high. However, considering the service from the staff and the atmosphere, it's worth it. You can relax and chill for a long time. Free refills of tea are available, and there's a sink inside the shop in case you get food on your hands, but the restrooms are downstairs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Monthon Saethang

sample_reviews_en.text: The cafe offers a soothing relaxing vibe with many different roti to choose from while staying. It is a nice chill place to hang out with your friends while enjoying the delicious desserts or for studying when you have to concentrate for an exam. I personally like to go there to enjoy eating roti while spending some time by myself, and occasionally going there to have fun eating while chatting with my friends. My favourite part of the cafe is that when at least one drink is ordered your whole table will be able to unlock an unlimited refill tea.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pontakorn

sample_reviews_en.text: The roti cafe is located on the 2nd floor of the Susco gas station in Phutthabucha. They offer a variety of roti options, from thin and crispy to thick and soft, with many toppings. They also have their signature Cha-Chuk (pulled milk-tea) on the menu. At the cafe, you can sit and work, or play board games with friends. The prices are slightly higher than average, but the taste is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mmhewy S

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate at this restaurant last year and the service was excellent. However, when I ate there last week, it was the complete opposite. For example, the tea service was terrible. The table next to us kept asking if they wanted refills, but they ignored our request. What kind of double standard is this? And they even stared at the customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nathuer Bamber (Gent)

sample_reviews_en.text: The desserts are delicious and reasonably priced. One serving is quite large, enough to share; two servings are perfect for three people. The atmosphere is nice, and they offer delicious free tea. There are also board games to play, and plenty of parking. It's perfect for any occasion, whether you want to relax, work, or just unwind.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chairuk B

sample_reviews_en.text:
The café mainly serves roti, with both savory and sweet options. The roti was fresh and delicious. I also like the vibe of the place—it feels very homey and relaxing. They provide board games and free refilled tea, which is a nice bonus.
Overall, it’s a great place to relax with friends, and I would recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mioru Nanami

restaurants.name: P72 Hotel Walking Street Pattaya
restaurants.address:

412, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I stayed in this hotel for more than a week and it was all good. I stayed in the new building so the rooms were bit more comfortable and modernised. Just at the right place if u want all the actions just opposite to your doorstep 😎 The ladies who are working at the restaurant are super friendly, just love them. But dont know why i see a complaint about the reception lady being rude from many reviewers, but most of the time during my stay there was a sweet guy taking care of the reception and who was really well behaved. May be i presume the night lady at the reception. Everything is so good if u stay at the new building. Cleaning staffs come every day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aniket Dasgupta

sample_reviews_en.text:
Suggestion (in Thai – polite and constructive tone):

Respectfully, we would like to suggest that displaying the Saudi Arabian flag inside the bar may be inappropriate, as the flag contains sacred Islamic sayings that are highly respected by Muslims.

Displaying this symbol in a place where alcohol is served may make many Muslim customers uncomfortable and could discourage them from patronizing the establishment.

Considering or avoiding the use of religiously sensitive symbols would demonstrate respect for cultural diversity and positively impact the establishment's image in the long run.

Thank you for your understanding and consideration.
sample_reviews_en.author: zeez saad

sample_reviews_en.text: The location is unbeatable, with a pedestrian street and food stalls right downstairs. The back rooms are quiet and clean, and the retro style is a plus. The staff are proactive and attentive, resolving any issues promptly. However, the air conditioning is slow to start, the hot water is occasionally unstable, and the bathroom has no curtain, making it slippery. Breakfast is an extra 130 baht. Overall, it's still great value for money and recommended for travelers who want to experience the night market but are looking for good value.
sample_reviews_en.author: 芭提雅上门Escort Pattaya 看主页

sample_reviews_en.text: The room is spacious. The bathroom is also spacious. There is a refrigerator and a safe. The bathroom does not have a water heater. The air conditioner is small and slow to cool. The location is right on the walking street. It is not far from Bali Hai Pier. The staff is not very helpful. I will deduct points for this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tunjira Kingwongsa

sample_reviews_en.text: The room is old but not too bad. It's conveniently located near places to eat and visit. There's motorcycle parking but no car parking. The female staff weren't very welcoming, but the male staff member was helpful and even stored my helmet for me.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ascend Company

sample_reviews_en.text: The hotel rooms are extremely tiny and the walls were disgusting. The washroom door touches the closet while showering. One can barely stand inside. The drainage system is very bad in the washrooms. The receptionists are very neglectful …
sample_reviews_en.author: Deepshikha Choudhury

sample_reviews_en.text: Good budget option near walking street. Rooms were neat and clean. They have bar as well on walking street side. Bed mattresses were little harder. Hot water option was not working in bathroom. Overall highly recommended for short stay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mack Solanki

sample_reviews_en.text: The hotel is located right in the city center. Therefore, if you want to sleep in at night, this is not the hotel you are looking for. The staff are helpful in every way; the only downside is that the windows in the rooms face a wall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Erol Ulusoy

restaurants.name: Ros'niyom Silom Complex
restaurants.address:

191 Si Lom Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Let me start by saying you will NOT get an authentic Thai street food taste (I am Thai). There are other chain restaurants in department stores that come closer to everyday tasting home cook or street Thai food. Instead, Ros’niyom has more of a higher-end, modernized, and slightly internationalized version of Thai food.

With that in mind, the restaurant offers great tasting food despite being on a slightly pricey side. My favorite is hands down the “Sun-dried Pork served with Sticky Rice (หมูแดดเดียว ข้าวเหนียวนุ่ม).” Seriously, you should try it at least once.

Apart from that, I found most of their food to be pretty good.

I would not order any of their noodles though. Foreigners may enjoy them, but I feel they taste too “westernized” to be actual Thai noodles so you ended up with somewhat overly sweet but not spicy enough Thai noodles.

As far as the atmosphere goes, this particular branch is spacious enough that you never feel cramped, and the decoration feel very relaxing.
sample_reviews_th.author: Romson Preechawit

sample_reviews_th.text:
It's a place where you could expect its standard taste every time. Though the price is quite high, but the quality is great. I always eat ขาหมูพะโล้ and ไก่ตุ๋นคาราเมล and it's the same taset even it is a different branch.
Downside is that the service is too slow. It's quite crowded during meal time and you need to wait longer than other shops.
For vegetarians, I saw a page of vegetarian option in the menu. You could try.
sample_reviews_th.author: Mae Hame

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is another restaurant I frequent, as it's close to my office. I'm fascinated by their traditional tom yum noodle soup.

But there are two dishes I really recommend. The first is the "Fish Ball Bomb," which is essentially a fried fish ball. The fish balls are incredibly chewy and fried to a crispy outside and soft inside. The highlight is the dipping sauce, which is seafood-inspired but sweet. It's so delicious you'll eat it all before you know it.

Another recommended dish is the "Fried Chive Dumplings." The chive dough is chewy and has a crispy exterior that doesn't sting your gums. Lovers of fried foods will love this.

I don't know if it's the same at other branches, but this one seems understaffed. You have to look carefully for anything you want. And what I dislike the most is the abundance of mosquitoes. Every time I sit there, I get bitten by mosquitoes. It's so confusing, even though it's in a shopping mall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poramaporn L.

sample_reviews_en.text: I stay in this area for a month each year, and I always eat dinner here because it's a Thai restaurant that really suits my taste. They have everything you could want, from every type of noodle dish to som tum (papaya salad), nam prik (chili paste), pad Thai (pad Thai), green curry, red curry, panang curry, and massaman curry. They also have many set meals at reasonable prices. It's suitable for both Thais and foreigners. You can tell the staff your preferred spice level, and they always ask about any food allergies after taking your order – a special level of thoughtfulness here. They also have a wide selection of drinks, including lemonade, hibiscus tea, butterfly pea tea, coconut, and various soft drinks. Whenever I'm in Bangkok, I always stop by this restaurant. The staff are always excellent. I highly recommend it! It's located at Silom Complex, perfect if you're in the Sala Daeng area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jakky Neo

sample_reviews_en.text:
This past week, I found myself drawn to Ros'niyom based on its bustling lunchtime crowd. Nestled conveniently within the mall, Silom Complex near my hotel, it offered a quick and casual option for a Thai food fix.

The menu boasts a focus on authentic dishes at reasonable prices. I opted for shrimp paste fried rice, tom yam noodle, som tam salad, and fresh longan juice and it delivered on its promise.

While the service was efficient. The ambience is similar to what you'd expect from any other mall eatery.

Overall, Ros'niyom is a solid choice for a satisfying and affordable Thai meal in a convenient location.  I wouldn't hesitate to return on a future trip.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chand De Silva

sample_reviews_en.text: Actually this review is for Ros’niyom located in CentralWorld which is not shown on Google maps yet. The Thai food is good there, large portions, clean and authentic. Somtam and other salads were generously stuffed with fresh and clean greens, crab fried rice was not greasy and has actually larger chunks of crab meat not like some water down same dish served at other places. I am actually a food freak and don’t eat raw vegetables or junky food just everywhere. Myself and my Thai guests that know Bangkok food scene liked the food and service. I would recommend the restaurant for everyone that likes Thai street food. Ros’niyom at CentralWorld.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marek Mark

sample_reviews_en.text: Courteous staff and unexpectedly calm setting on a Saturday evening. For people who like to try a variety of Thai dishes with a ‘tame’ interpretation. I felt the flavors have been toned down quite a bit, assuming it’s due to the location and the target group being foreign tourists? I ordered the minced pork coconut stew with salted egg and the Marian plum (mayongchid) in sweet fish sauce. Enjoyed the first dish but the Marian plum was primarily sweet and I missed some tanginess, tasted a bit one dimensional. Otherwise lovely experience with good service, it’s a restaurant chain that can be found at many locations all across Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nat S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
— Competent, Clean, and Comfortably Predictable —
At Ros’niyom, you get exactly what you expect: good food, polished presentation, and the quiet hum of a well-oiled restaurant chain.
I had a pad Thai with prawns (220 THB) and a lime soda (65 THB). A 10% service charge was automatically added—not a surprise in this sort of setting. The pad Thai was as it should be: flavorful, balanced, and properly done.
The venue inside Silom Complex is modern and professional, though I’d say the experience leans more polished than personal. A safe and solid stop if you’re after quality without quirks—but don’t come expecting character.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leo Grey

restaurants.name: McDonald’s Silom
restaurants.address:

Silom Building, 64 Si Lom Rd, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Coming from the U.S. trying McDonald’s in other countries is always a fun way to explore what other countries like to eat. I always order items unique to the country. I ordered two prosperity burgers, one pork and one fish. It also came with fries and a drink.
The fries were fries but the burgers were definitely different from what I’m accustomed to. They both had a sweet sauce and heavy mayo  that I had to wipe off. I preferred the fish as it was less sweet.
It was interesting, but next time I’m getting a safe and familiar item just in case .
sample_reviews_en.author: Grace Shim

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to McDonald's for the first time in Thailand. The taste is very much an acquired taste, I didn't like it. The Big Mac had a weird pickle on it. The fries were covered in tough, old oil. The price was average, and the taste was terrible. I won't be going to McDonald's in Bangkok again. It's not even worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Герман

sample_reviews_en.text: Bad McDonalds location with lazy employees. If you order online, there is only a 50% chance they will make your order. The good news is that Grab will offer you a $40 baht voucher for each time the restaurant fails to make your order - so I’ve simply been making free money by ordering from this location every day lol
sample_reviews_en.author: Justin G

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff was nice but busy. I arrived at 9am and got the dark color hash brown with no texture, I think this is overnight food.
I talked to the manager that it is burn, he threw the old one immediately , then cooked a fresh one and deliver to my desk. Overall the service is great!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mandy Lai

sample_reviews_en.text: We stopped in for lunch. The cafe was very cold, a perfect contrast to the street outside. The food was just like anywhere else at McDonald's, and the service was fast. The cafe was clean and comfortable. We had a great time relaxing and cooling off.
sample_reviews_en.author: Надежда Каменская

sample_reviews_en.text: Not much to say a Filet-O-Fish meal I don't usually stop at McDonald's but I like them on occasion and this was one of those times nothing wrong with the food but again this is McDonald's nothing super outstanding either I'm sure I will return
sample_reviews_en.author: Yesitis Dakid

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here for an easy breakfast, great surprise to find out they do the traditional big breakfast which UK used to do, but have stopped since early 2000’s, all the food in one plate, the hash brown is better than uk too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phai Dip

sample_reviews_en.text:
While I was gone for a few minutes to go to the toilet, everything, including the tray, had been cleared away. 
It seems that even my half-drunk bottle of water and personal belongings had been thrown away.
sample_reviews_en.author: bc a

restaurants.name: Tairyo Sushi - Ari
restaurants.address:

Phahonyothin, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
June 2016
Newly open Japanese restaurant at Centric Ari Station. We tried Sushi, Tempura and grilled fish. The taste was not bad. General cleanliness and service were fine.
However, we had waited around 30 min to get the first dish served after order, I believe this can be improved and make it faster as this was their first day!
I give 3.5 stars this time.

**Update June 2026
I visited again in 2026, Ordered Salmon roll , Nabe. the food quality and services are good. 5 stars 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukit Nualchanchai

sample_reviews_en.text: Good Japanese restaurant with delicious food, a clean environment, and good service. I had the Chirashi Don and Shirauo Karaage combo set, and both dishes were very good. The price is not quite cheap, but it suits the quality, and they offer many promotions. Overall, a good choice for a decent Japanese lunch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manaswee Wongsuryrat

sample_reviews_en.text: This was a nice discovering while I stayed in the Ari area for a week to explore.  I dined here 2 times, ordered the same dish and really enjoyed it.  Will go back for sure when I'm back in Ari.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cadiz Wilmo

sample_reviews_en.text: Your salmon was excellent, large and satisfying pieces, so delicious I didn't even have time to take a picture! The sushi with foregrain was also delicious, the seared perfection was great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Punnarat Biawmai

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious. This was my first time here, and we came with a group so we could try many different dishes. Thai Plus is accepted. There's a wide variety of set menus to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: Petchie Petchie

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, fresh, and clean. The staff provides good service. There's parking available. They offer both buffet and à la carte options. I recommend giving it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Watcharaphol Wichaisuek

sample_reviews_en.text: Let's try the sushi roll. It was well-presented, the ingredients were fresh, and the taste was good. The restaurant atmosphere was comfortable and not hot.
sample_reviews_en.author: sukit

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time trying this type of donburi, and it was amazing! The food came out very quickly, and the staff were lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jittinan Kitsumritroj

restaurants.name: ราดหน้ายอดผัก (นายเหลา ตลาดนางลิ้นจี่) สาขาโชคชัย4
restaurants.address:

114 Chok Chai 4 Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the noodle shop I've been eating at since I was a kid, and the taste hasn't changed at all.

Every dish on the menu is delicious, from the noodles in gravy to the stir-fried noodles with soy sauce, the chicken stir-fry, the satay pork, and the fresh spring rolls. Every time I come, it's hard to choose!
But I always order the beef noodles in gravy because it's hard to find it elsewhere.

The only downside is that the shop is by the roadside, and finding parking is difficult. Sometimes I drive past, see the place, and want to eat, but when I see there's no parking, I have to just pass by.
sample_reviews_en.author: YSPK (JA)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nai Lao's Stir-fried Noodles with Vegetables (Nai Lao, Linchee Floating Market) Chokchai 4 Branch

Nai Lao's Stir-fried Noodles with Vegetables has several branches near my house, but if you want the oldest one, it has to be the Chokchai 4 branch, near the police station. This restaurant is very old and has been open for a long time. Their stir-fried noodles with soy sauce are delicious. My personal favorite is the beef stir-fried noodles. Importantly, the prices are affordable. Their grilled meatballs are also tasty, served with a dipping sauce. The service is quite fast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panjapon Khamsajja

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍜 A famous Rad Na (Thai gravy noodle) spot in Chokchai 4, always crowded thanks to its unique flavor.

📌 Signature dishes include Rad Na, Pad See Ew, and Moo Satay 🥢
✨ Rad Na with rice noodles – rich dark gravy, salty-forward, with a smoky wok aroma that keeps it from being greasy.
🥬 Only tender young kale stems are used – crisp, fresh, and satisfying to chew.
🐖 Marinated pork slices are big, soft, and melt-in-your-mouth with no toughness.

🔥 True street-food vibes – simple setup but packed with quality in every dish.
😋 A must-try for noodle lovers visiting the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: meCHER foodie

sample_reviews_en.text:
The noodles in gravy were delicious and had a lovely wok aroma.
The pork satay was incredibly delicious.
However, on the day I ate there, there was a large group of teenagers who were very loud and boisterous, showing no consideration for other customers in the restaurant. I almost wanted to leave. They were extremely rude.
sample_reviews_en.author: Npc_ Elemento_Otaku

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is stir-fried pork. It's essentially stir-fried noodles with soy sauce. Stir-fried noodles isn't just about adding crispy squid and calling it stir-fried; it's stir-fried noodles with marinated pork.
**But the taste? It's really delicious, like stir-fried noodles with soy sauce.**
sample_reviews_en.author: sorayut kitiudom

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the portions were generous, and it wasn't expensive. The owner and staff were welcoming and friendly. The food was a little slow to arrive because there were so many orders, and the restaurant was a bit hot, but overall it was a great place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Worawut Tantipisnu

sample_reviews_en.text: Rad Na with egg, stir-fried chicken, stir-fried pork, fragrant with the aroma of the pan, very delicious, not expensive, even though it's far away, I still drive to eat. The pork satay and dipping sauce are also delicious. I'm a regular customer of this shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phichit Poonpolwatanaporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honestly, this is still the best Rad Na (Thai noodle dish with gravy) we've ever had. We've tried many other places, but none are as good as this one.

The portions are generous, the price is affordable, and the service is fast – no long waits.
sample_reviews_en.author: Niphaphon Na Chiangmai :Nan789

restaurants.name: Kome Steak โคเมะสเต็ก สเต็กกระทะร้อนสไตล์ญี่ปุ่น
restaurants.address:

762/2 Rama III Rd, Bang Phong Phang, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Good atmosphere, I’m really satisfied with the  huge amount portion of food with reasonable prices and good services

อร่อยมากก
So delicious!!
sample_reviews_th.author: Salaithorn Srisuchart

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Hidden Gem for Japanese Steak Lovers

This Japanese steakhouse feels like a warm hug the moment you step in — homey, welcoming, and filled with the comforting aroma of grilled meats. The atmosphere is relaxed yet refined, making it perfect for both casual dinners and cozy gatherings.

What truly stands out is the value. You get generous portions, and they offer free refills on rice, soup, and vegetables — a rare and thoughtful touch that makes the experience feel extra satisfying.

The menu features a great variety of steak cuts, from ribeye and picanha. You can really tell they care about quality and letting you enjoy your meal your way.

If you’re looking for a place that combines comfort, quality, and a bit of Japanese soul — this spot is absolutely worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirasa Opatumphun

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kome, Japanese-style hot pan, delicious with all elements... 🥩🔪♨️ Japanese-style hot pan steak restaurant with simple but beautiful minimalist decoration.
Actually, when you come to this restaurant, you have to eat steak. There are Pikanya, Ribeye, Striploid, Hanger, Tongue. You can choose happiness as you like.
The food in the set will be served with thin shredded cabbage, crispy and delicious. There are 2 types of salad dressing, thick white and black poppy, both very delicious. The black sesame will be a little more sour.
Overall, it is very impressive. The value of the set comes with hot or cold green tea. There will definitely be a repeat.
sample_reviews_en.author: NB Kanom

sample_reviews_en.text: I was quite disappointed. I expected it to be tastier. The price wasn't cheap either; a set was over 400 baht. The meat was very ordinary, with no meaty flavor whatsoever. I ordered the picanha, and it was also very average, like buying meat from the supermarket and cooking it myself. Both sets I ordered were recommended by the restaurant. Honestly, I regret spending my money.
sample_reviews_en.author: pp

sample_reviews_en.text: A new steak on a stone type restaurant that offers value set menu. Their portion is really generous in my opinion and the ingredients are quite good. The taste sits right in the middle for me though, a safe balance with sauces for you to add. If you’re looking for a chill value meal then this is it. P.s. your hair and clothes will smells after the meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: N S.

sample_reviews_en.text: If you’re a beef lover, this place is a must! 🥩 I had the picanha and ribeye.It was perfectly grilled — juicy, tender, and full of flavor. The sides were great too, especially the soup. Super friendly staff and great vibes all around. Not cheap, but totally worth it for the quality. Can’t wait to come back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: wichapas kong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there hoping to find some good teppanyaki nearby. Sadly, it was a letdown. Everything I ordered was so bland. Even though I ordered several types, like, four different things for two people, it was all flavorless.

If you still wanna try it, maybe ask for extra salt or something.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pipe Warawuth

sample_reviews_en.text:
August 2, 2026 @ 1315
The customer service staff were attentive and very polite.

The restaurant manager and staff may lack experience in handling a large group of ill-mannered customers who were talking very loudly and disturbing other customers who were peacefully dining.
sample_reviews_en.author: paitoon suntivisut

restaurants.name: Rimfang Restaurant
restaurants.address:

