235 ถนน ประชาราษฎร์ Tambon Suan Yai, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "A great place to eat and reasonably priced too."

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The restaurant is located by the river, with both floating raft seating and seating on the bank.
We went on a Saturday afternoon, and the sun was quite strong. Choosing to sit on the raft might cause dizziness due to its proximity to the pier, where boats frequently depart during the day.
- The food was fresh and delicious in every dish. I recommend the crispy pork with chili and salt; it was incredibly crispy and delicious.
- The staff provided excellent service. We requested to move tables twice, and they promptly provided an extra fan when we asked for it.
sample_reviews_en.author: kate space

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a riverside restaurant located near the Nonthaburi pier, close to the old Nonthaburi Provincial Hall. Parking is available around the area. The food is delicious, the atmosphere is great, and the service is good. The food doesn't take long to arrive, and there are plenty of tables. Dinner would probably be more relaxing sitting by the river. I went during lunchtime, and it was quite hot, but overall the atmosphere was lovely. There's also a shrine nearby that you can visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: N T

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every couple of years when I visit Bangkok, I hop on the boat taxi and go up the river to Nonthaburi. The river trip is always interesting.
Rimfang restaurant on the Chao Phraya is always on my itinerary. Not fancy but a good place to relax and have a beer and some Thai cuisine (average, anyway). Not far from the pier.

I've been coming here since 2006. This is a great local riverside restaurant.

The staff is friendly 👍🏽
sample_reviews_en.author: William Hartz

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, not overly sweet. The grilled prawns were very fresh, and the dipping sauce was good. However, the food was served slowly, even though there weren't many customers. The restrooms were clean. The atmosphere was nice, with live music. The staff frequently forgot items we ordered, requiring us to remind them several times.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teacher Warongporn Eungpairor

sample_reviews_en.text: A riverside restaurant with a good atmosphere in the Nonthaburi pier area. The food is delicious, the quantity is good value for money, and the staff are attentive. However, the only downside is that the restaurant is a floating raft. When the express boat docks, it brings with it big waves, causing the raft to rock until you feel dizzy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sutham Passworatham

sample_reviews_en.text: Highly recommended. Right on the Chao Phraya River. The food is delicious. The restaurant is on a platform over the river. It rocks a bit when boats go by, which could be a problem for people prone to seasickness. The restrooms are clean. However, the restaurant's name has changed. It now has a new name.
sample_reviews_en.author: Udo

sample_reviews_en.text: From Sathorn Central Pier in Bangkok, take the orange boat to N30. As soon as you exit the pier, you'll see a Chinese-style archway and a Thai-style rooftop restaurant on your right. It has an indoor air-conditioned area and an outdoor area. It's a riverside restaurant and highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: 蔡嘉宏

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my second visit and the atmosphere is great. It's right by the river, quiet and not crowded. The food is delicious and reasonably priced. I love the music they play; it's lovely. The staff are very attentive and provide excellent service. Plus, they allow dogs! 🥰🫶🏻 Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Snowy Story

restaurants.name: Black Canyon @PTT Viphavadi Rab 1
restaurants.address:

181/2 Vibhavadi Rangsit Rd, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Black Canyon PTT Vibhavadi 1st Infantry Regiment: This is a glass noodle salad, 195 baht per plate. I'm baffled by the taste; it's terrible. The ingredients are incomplete, no tomatoes, and the vegetables are very sparse. The staff took a long time to bring the dish and didn't even provide plates or spoons.

First, only, and last time here. Long wait for food, no plates served, no tissues, and the staff are inattentive. Warning anyone considering this restaurant: the taste is awful. Go to 7-Eleven instead.

Long wait for food, no plates served, poor service, no tissues. They're so stingy! The glass noodle salad had only 3 shrimp, no tomatoes, just a little bit of red onion, mostly noodles. Very disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boodsaba Sodsongkij

sample_reviews_en.text: Avoid coming on Sunday mornings. The food takes an extremely long time to arrive. The food is delicious, but it's a complete waste of time. The staff didn't inform us about the long wait or queue, so we could have gone to another restaurant.😢 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongsakorn Bupparenoo

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is up to Black Canyon's standard, but the gas station is really crowded and finding parking is difficult. It's especially frustrating to see able-bodied people taking disabled parking spaces. Does PTT have any solutions for this?
sample_reviews_en.author: Khun pol

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered stir-fried kale with crispy pork (vegetarian version), but received basil chicken with glass noodles. I couldn't contact the branch either. Terrible service and lack of customer care.
sample_reviews_en.author: ลลินดา น้อยคําสิน

sample_reviews_en.text: The service staff were very quick and efficient. The area was clean, the food was delicious, the service was good, and the drinks were good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alisa Sada

sample_reviews_en.text: The coffee is freshly brewed and delicious, the food is freshly prepared and tastes great, and the service is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Capt.Saksarun Nakkaraj

sample_reviews_en.text: Recharge the car, recharge the people. The food is delicious, but a little pricey.
sample_reviews_en.author: วัฒนา พงษ์พันธ์

sample_reviews_en.text: It was incredibly awful. It's like the cook doesn't know how to cook at all. 😭 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Pintira Tanwanitchakul

restaurants.name: Greenmine Steak & Coffee
restaurants.address:

1295 Ramkhamhaeng Rd, แยกคลองตัน, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food was great, but for western food (I’m from Canada) I would like to see more bread or something else to have with my food. Also good for cleaning up the plate since the quality was soo good.

Staff were extremely fast, helpful, and were always nearby if I needed anything. So an easy 5 stars.

Atmosphere was great, but music could have been slightly higher or maybe have a tv or something playing in the background? Just a good way to avoid being on your phone to entertain yourself while waiting (which it wasnt a long wait at all)

If I could have put 4.5 stars I would have! I’ll definitely be going back. Overall fantastic place with amazing food quality and fast service. Highly recommend to any westerners wanting a mix of home and Thailand in their dishes 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Mahlon Knight

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food and great service. Highly recommended! You won't be disappointed! Absolutely surprised! A small cafe tucked away in a corner, serving great drinks and tasty food.
Service was very pleasant.
Pity, we didn't have photos to prove it, as we didn't plan to review until after we finished the meal.

Recommend if you're close by and looking for a simple but tasty meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Me W.

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the dishes I tried was the chicken steak with mushroom sauce—juicy and tender, paired with a rich and flavorful mushroom sauce. Not only was the food delicious, but the restaurant’s atmosphere was also very cozy, with an Instagram-worthy interior design, making it the perfect spot for photos while enjoying your meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lilly Rose

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good quality and clean food.
Fresh vegetables.

Ordered medium rare grilled steak, perfectly cooked.
Fresh and clean fruits and vegetables.

The seasoned dishes have a slightly sweet taste.
For those who prefer a stronger flavor, try asking for the restaurant's spicy dipping sauce; it's just right.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kay Cee

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, and there was a wide variety of drinks. I loved it! The atmosphere was chill and perfect for relaxing and taking photos. The second floor is great for photography enthusiasts. The staff were lovely and provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ladda Seepupan

sample_reviews_en.text: When I was in Bangkok, I stayed in a Hotel which was just aside this wonderful restaurant. We had few DINE-IN and TAKEAWAYS from here. I would happily recommend this place to anyone who loves food. They have quite a good number of items in …
sample_reviews_en.author: Bibin Sam (Bibs)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I would highly recommend this place. The food here is yummy, clean and satisfying. Staffs here are helpful , polite and considerate. We stayed in a nearby hotel and Green mind is one of our go to places.
Keep up the good work and thank you .
sample_reviews_en.author: shoma mathew

sample_reviews_en.text: This healthy restaurant offers affordable prices and a wide variety of menu options, including salads, steaks, pasta, and fresh, clean vegetables. The grilled chicken steak is perfectly cooked, well-seasoned with a slight spiciness. The …
sample_reviews_en.author: Akapatr Chiraarreebutr

restaurants.name: OUTLAW PIZZA (สาขา พัทยา)
restaurants.address:

312 31 Soi Lengkee, หนองปรือ, ชลบุรี, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I had high hopes for this place, but the pizza had no taste, you need to add salt to the dough and your sauce has zero flavor, you need spices, also your oven is not hot enough, I asked for my pizza to be crisp and cooked longer and it was not. I asked for a cup of the spicy marinara sauce so I could add flavor to the pizza but it did not, the nice waitress asked me if I wanted Tabasco sauce and I said sure, that did the trick, I never like to bash a business but you need to give the pizza flavor, flavor does not always mean you add spices, but flavor is added but the way you cook the pizza, FYI if you let the dough sit over night using the cold rising technique it would add to the flavor. This is my honest opinion
sample_reviews_en.author: Gene Montoya

sample_reviews_en.text: Outlaw Pizza is the best pizza I've had in Thailand. A 12-inch cheese pizza cost 300 Baht. They use good ingredients so it's totally worth it. You can choose thick or thin crust. I chose thick crust (in the picture). The people unhappy with the pizza are picky eaters. They don't realize how difficult it is to operate a genuine pizza parlor in Thailand. My pizza tasted almost as good as in the U.S. And that was more than I expected. Outlaw Pizza is located on Soi Lengkee, between Soi Buakhao and Third Road. (A little closer to Third Road) Enjoy...
sample_reviews_en.author: Jean Gabin

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stopped here far one of my favorite food combos, pizza and wings. I also ordered 2 big bottles of Leo. I took my time eating out in front of the shop where it was nice to people watch and listen to the music from the near by bars. The weather was just perfect to compliment my experience.

The petite and beautiful lady working by herself kept checking on me and my time here quite pleasant. I can only be mad at myself for eating here only once during my trip, but i will come back in future trips.
sample_reviews_en.author: Appreciated Images

sample_reviews_en.text:
A medium pepperoni pizza was delicious for one man. It wasn't too salty for pepperoni. Still, Koreans might find it too salty. We arrived at 11 p.m., so there were no customers, and the pizzas were freshly made and delivered perfectly.

Later, a large pizza was delivered.
They seem to be serious about their pizza sauce. They use a variety of spices, but it's not overpowering.
I ordered a thin crust, but it's good. A regular crust would be much thicker.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joosoo “Blackbean” Park

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've just had a pizza in outlaw pizza.
I had a thing crushed supreme pizza and it was absolutely delicious the base of the pizza very very good the sauce again very good the topping's fantastic I enjoyed this pizza so much I will be going back you can bet your life on it the ladies that serve me speak good english and the place is very clean to.pizza lovers you gotta try this place I highly recommend this place you will not be disappointed
sample_reviews_en.author: Yiannakis Yiacoumi

sample_reviews_en.text: Sign says “Best Pizza in Pattaya Guarantee.” This not in the top 10. We ordered the spaghetti and Supreme pizza and all I can say is this place would be closed after a week back in the states because nobody would return to order again. I normally eat pizza every few weeks to take a break from Thai food. The pizza is missing one ingredient, flavor. I know now and won’t be ordering again. They get two stars because it was edible.
sample_reviews_en.author: HKABUK

sample_reviews_en.text: I got a 9" thin crust pizza with pepperoni, Italian sausage, and black olives.  It was made to order and took about 15 minutes to come out.  I ate it in my hotel after a 20 minute walk. The crust was crispy, but with a little chewyness that I enjoy.  The regular sauce is not bad, it compliments the pizza well.  A good bit of toppings in every bite.  Overall a very good pizza.  I will definitely be eating here again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nathan Kishimoto

sample_reviews_en.text:
👍🏻Pros: It's pizza.
👎🏻Cons: perhaps the most tasteless pizza I have ever eaten.
🛞It's rubber.
🧀They use mayonnaise instead of cheese.
💧The dough is very dry.
🥤And instead of 0.5 Pepsi, they delivered me 0.345 Pepsi (but I returned the money for this).
=====
💔 I would not recommend pizza here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kir Tenn

restaurants.name: Arabesque Egyptian & Indian Restaurant (Halal) - Nana (Rich Walk)
restaurants.address:

35, อาคารอาคาร 1, Soi Nana Nuea, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A wonderful experience at Arabesque Restaurant.

I tried the grilled fish with white rice, and the taste was truly exceptional and well-balanced. The fish was fresh, perfectly seasoned, and cooked to perfection. The service was excellent, fast, and the staff were very respectful. A great place for lovers of halal food and Arabic and Indian cuisine in Bangkok. I highly recommend it.


Excellent experience at Arabesque Egyptian & Indian Restaurant.

I tried the grilled fish with white rice, and it was absolutely delicious. The fish was fresh, perfectly seasoned, and cooked very well. The service was outstanding, fast, and very welcoming. A great halal restaurant in Bangkok for lovers of Arabic and Indian food. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr.Hisham A Bajudah

sample_reviews_en.text: If I didn't know it was there, I would not have found it .... Hidden gem on suhkumvit Soi 3 2nd floor of the Arabesque ... The 2 guys outside stop me and invited me in to taste the foods of their restaurant. I was looking for a simple Swarma on the street but agreed to try their place. I had the Egyptian Salad as well ... Both so tasty and they presented me with Egyptian Mint tea to finish off the meal ... and a Hooka to try but I have given up smoking ... If you've smoke from a Hooka, do try that ... It is a treat not to be missed even if you have never smoked.   Devi was my server and she was so attentive ... When in Bangkok, do not give this fabulous place a miss ... Try it without regrets
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeff Greenfeld

sample_reviews_en.text:
An excellent Arabic restaurant with truly authentic flavors. The food was delicious, fresh, and beautifully presented — you can really taste the quality of the ingredients and traditional spices. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, perfect for both a relaxed dinner and a night out with friends.

Special praise goes to our waitress Aye, who was absolutely wonderful. She was kind, friendly, and very professional, making us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. Her recommendations were spot on, and her attentive service made the whole experience even better.

Highly recommended, and we will definitely be coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dikkas Dikkas

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a nice experience at Arabesque Egyptian & Indian Restaurant (Halal) at Nana, Rich Walk. The location is convenient, especially if you’re around Sukhumvit.

The restaurant offers a good mix of Egyptian dishes, and the food was tasty with decent portion sizes. It’s a good option if you’re looking for halal food in the area.

The staff were friendly and service was smooth.

Overall, a reliable place for a satisfying meal, especially for those looking for halal options in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasim Reza

sample_reviews_en.text: The lamb soup is similar to our beyran, exquisite. The half grilled chicken was perfectly cooked. The Egyptian salad is like our shepherd's salad, but exceptionally good. The Egyptian rice is rice with vermicelli. And we finished it off with tea. I didn't try dessert because I don't eat dessert. You can definitely smell the familiar saffron/cinnamon aroma in every dish. I think you should come without hesitation. It's a complete feast of flavors.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hopti Kopti

sample_reviews_en.text:
I am 57 years old, visited and eaten in over 60 countries. This is my first ever food review.
The quality expected from a top restaurant in Bangkok, the Arabesque did not disappoint. However the reason for my first ever restaurant review was because of a particular dish - the Lamb Fajitas. Oh my, the best ever, and i have eaten in many Arab restaurants. Outstanding, i will be back soon, and HIGHLY recommended. Great job ARABESQUE.
sample_reviews_en.author: Darren Spencer

sample_reviews_en.text:
I absolutely love Arabic food, and here you can try some of the most delicious Lebanese dishes! We ordered baba ghanoush, mutabbal, chicken béchamel, meat kofta, and doogh — everything was incredibly tasty.

Their bread was also amazing: fresh and hot. The only thing that didn’t really match my taste was the stuffed eggplant, because it had dill in it. But overall, everything was excellent!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anahid Danesh

sample_reviews_en.text: Masha'Allah, the place is clean and tidy, the food is absolutely delicious, and the Egyptian atmosphere is superb. The Indian food is also very, very tasty, and the service and staff are incredibly wonderful. The shisha, combined with the mint tea, creates a truly relaxing atmosphere. My regards to everyone involved in this wonderful effort. Thank you to the Egyptian restaurant, Arabesque.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohamed Elmasry

restaurants.name: ข้าวมันไก่ตอนสมชาย พระราม 7
restaurants.address:

40-6 Soi Bang Kruai-sai Noi 4/2, Bang Kruai, Bang Kruai District, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, May 15th, 1968, at 9:20 AM, the chicken rice was as delicious as usual, but something was different. The young woman with glasses spoke and looked displeased when I asked for extra soup. I was confused; was she really that stingy? I'm a regular customer, and the owners, an elderly couple, have never complained when I ask for extra soup before. But this girl with glasses... I was shocked! 😲😲 (I ordered two special mixed chicken rice and asked for three bags of soup). She replied that she couldn't give me extra soup based on the amount of rice I ordered; she was just being stingy with the soup! 5555
sample_reviews_en.author: วนิดา ประนันโต

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chicken Rice (Special) 50 Baht (October 4, 2022)

The shop is located in front of the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT) at the entrance of Bang Kruai Soi. It's always busy from opening to closing time. They also have fried chicken. The rice is good, the chicken is good, the dipping sauce is okay, and the soup is sweet with winter melon. There's no ginger or chili available to add at the table. They don't sell other soup options.

There's no parking at the shop. Park on the street in front of the shop or in the Krung Thai Bank parking lot, the entrance is next to the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponchagarj Ngamukos

sample_reviews_en.text: This delicious Hainanese chicken rice shop, formerly located near the entrance of Bang Kruai Soi, has now moved to Bang Kruai Soi 4/1. The new shop is larger than the old one, but the taste is still as good as ever. The rice is soft, with beautiful grains, not too oily; the chicken is tender; the dipping sauce is rich, flavorful, and fragrant with bird's eye chili and sliced ​​ginger; and the soup has a refreshing, winter melon flavor. There's parking for 2-3 cars, and it's not crowded, making for a comfortable dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: May Dmone

sample_reviews_en.text:
The original Hainanese chicken rice stall in front of the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT) at the entrance to Bang Kruai Soi has now moved to the area near the Makham curve inside Bang Kruai Soi.
Today I tried the special thigh meat and offal set for 50 baht (March 24). The taste and portion size were okay.
There is plenty of parking before the stall, which is convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tang Raksat

sample_reviews_en.text:
This traditional Hainanese chicken rice is delicious. The dipping sauce is delicious. The chicken is juicy enough, not too dry or too oily. The broth is smooth and the blood and liver are delicious. It's best to order the boiled chicken rather than the fried chicken.

It's a familiar Hainanese chicken rice flavor. The chef is elderly, so it may take a bit longer, but it's worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karn Santidhananon

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a delicious Hainanese chicken rice shop. They give generous portions, it's great value for money, and you can choose your preferred part of the chicken. The broth is fragrant and tasty, and the dipping sauce is a traditional, well-balanced flavor. The owner is lovely and provides excellent service. 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Gift T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The rice was cooked well, with each grain separated.
The chicken was tender and the skin was thin.
The offal was just right.
The sauce was moderately flavorful.
The soup was tasty and served hot.
The price was reasonable for the portion size.
The staff was helpful.
Parking might be a bit difficult to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: BiG

sample_reviews_en.text:
One or two years ago, everything at this restaurant was delicious. But I don't know why, but now the dipping sauce for the boiled chicken has changed; it's not as tasty as it used to be.
The staff, however, are still as lovely as ever. The only difference is the taste of the dipping sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Opp Po

restaurants.name: Nuanua, hot pot, stewed beef, Rama IV
restaurants.address:

2820 Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The restaurant is located at a bend in the road, as indicated by Google Maps. Parking is available right in front of the shop. They also have an air-conditioned indoor seating area. We ordered the mixed hot pot (300฿), which was more than enough for two people – way too much! The broth was clear and refreshing, the offal wasn't gamey or chewy, and it went perfectly with the chewy rice noodles. Delicious!
sample_reviews_th.author: Rungrat Phiriyasinsak

sample_reviews_en.text: I saw a recommendation from a blogger on Sweet Potato who lives in Bangkok, and since I was nearby this time, I decided to try it. I ordered the beef and offal hot pot, and the portion was incredibly generous, including beef brisket, beef shank, beef slices, beef tongue, beef heart, beef intestines, beef liver, beef tripe, beef balls, and more, served with water spinach and rice noodles. The taste was absolutely amazing, with a rich, meaty aroma that perfectly suited Chinese palates. I tried another place nearby last year, and both places were highly recommended. This place is a bit smaller, but the air conditioning made it more comfortable, and the owner speaks some Chinese. A must-try for beef lovers!
sample_reviews_en.author: WEI LI

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is one of the best braised beef restaurants I've ever tried.

We ordered a hot pot for 300 baht + two plates of blanched water spinach for 20 baht + two bowls of rice for 20 baht.

The taste was great, the broth wasn't too salty, the braised beef melted in your mouth, and the fresh beef wasn't too tough. We really liked it because there was no gamey smell at all. The owner was very friendly. If I'm in the area again, I'll definitely go back.

If you have the chance, give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: JKS

sample_reviews_en.text: This is another one of my favorite braised beef restaurants. It's across from Channel 3, and lots of celebrities eat here. The braised beef has a clean, refreshing flavor, not too herbal. They give generous portions at an affordable price. I especially love the tendon, glass noodles, and intestines – they're incredibly delicious. I ate three bowls by myself! You should try it; you won't be disappointed. You can park on the street in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: nattayos riewpitak

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes delicious. The broth has a balanced flavor, not too salty or too sweet, and is fragrant. The meat has a chewy texture, perfect for those who prefer it not too tender. The offal is good and odorless. The hot pot is good value for money. The thin noodles are perfectly cooked and delicious. The gotu kola drink is concentrated, and the chrysanthemum tea is fragrant. The food is served quickly, and the owner is lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jrw Kms

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been eating there for many years. If I'm passing by, I'll call ahead and go eat there often.
The food tastes great, especially for meat lovers.
If you like meat, I recommend trying the all-you-can-eat hot pot.
The owner and his staff provide good service.
The atmosphere inside is air-conditioned.
You can also sit outside in the evening.
However, there's no parking. Overall, I'll eat there whenever I'm in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploy Yam

sample_reviews_en.text:
Beef noodles here are seriously good
Highly recommend the thin rice noodles special style, the texture with the rich broth is perfect and so comforting
Also tried the wide noodles with mixed beef, everything tender, flavorful, very satisfying
Easy five star bowl and a place I want to come back to every time I crave beef noodles
sample_reviews_en.author: ChuLuxe Explorer

sample_reviews_en.text:
While dining in the air-conditioned restaurant, I felt that the shadows from the ceiling fan were irritating my eyes. I suggested turning off the ceiling fan, as there are already wall-mounted fans on both sides.
This would be for the eye health of both customers and staff in the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pheeravas Theeravanijpoln

restaurants.name: Omakase Ten
restaurants.address:

66 N Sathon Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
My first time trying an omakase 15-serving course.
The food was incredibly filling.
The first course was a welcome treat: Yuzu clams. The yuzu aroma was delightful, and the texture of the yuzu jelly, along with the refreshing tangy flavor, was invigorating.
Every subsequent course was delicious, with high-quality ingredients. The truffle in the sushi was excellent – ​​not overpowering, with a sophisticated truffle aroma.

I loved the Emperor Sea Bass sushi. It was torched, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, with a delicate aroma and a wonderfully firm, chewy texture.

The 15 courses in total were incredibly filling and satisfying.

The 14th course was ramen! The Kurobuta pork was fragrant, and the broth was aromatic. Luckily, everything else was delicious, so I finished it all and continued on happily.

Dessert today was a truffle crepe with yuzu ice cream – simply amazing.

The chef was friendly, and the staff were welcoming and provided excellent service. I'll definitely come back here again. I loved the quality of the food and the value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasikan Taechabannapanya

sample_reviews_en.text:
An exceptional omakase experience with Chef Tin — a true showcase of craftsmanship, balance, and flavor. Our 20-course journey was thoughtfully paced, with each dish personally introduced and explained by the chef, offering insights into ingredients, technique, and inspiration.

By the fifth course I was already nearing full, yet each subsequent plate was too beautiful to resist. Every bite was a study in freshness — clean, precise flavors that let the ingredients shine without unnecessary embellishment. From the first sashimi to the final dessert, the progression felt harmonious and deeply satisfying.

The ambiance was intimate and serene, allowing the focus to remain on the food and conversation. Service was warm and unobtrusive, complementing the overall experience perfectly.

Reservations are essential as they only seat pre-booked guests — plan ahead to secure a spot. A must-visit for anyone who appreciates authentic omakase prepared with heart, precision, and respect for seasonality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Juliana I

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time ever trying omakase!! After browsing reviews, I finally found this restaurant. It was an amazing experience! The chef was hilarious and super friendly. Every bite was delicious. Chef Tin is truly talented, sharing stories about each dish, the different types of fish served, the preparation process, and chatting non-stop. He kept cooking and serving without a break – I was so full! I booked a 4,2xx baht course, but it seemed like they initially prepared a 1,9xx baht course. After eating a couple of dishes, we noticed something was off, so the chefs changed the course to what we had booked and started over. In the end, we ate until we were stuffed! The organization, responsibility, and management made my first omakase experience incredibly enjoyable. 100/10 ⭐️⭐️⭐️ I'll definitely be back! My partner 🩷 is on their third visit, so imagine how amazing they must be >\\\< The food is truly fresh and delicious, I can confirm that!
sample_reviews_en.author: Laksanaaree Sasithanakornkaew

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best price to taste ratio for an Omakase you’ll find anywhere. It can even give the omakase in the 10,000 yen range  in Tokyo a run for their money

Omakase Ten use a pretty generous ingredients for the 2000 THB set. If you’re a local you can usually find a deal for 1999 in local app like Wongnai

However you can contact the restaurant directly to inquire about promotion. Now to  the food

Why do I rate it so highly? It’s their sushi chef ability to marinate and age their fish. This is what elevates the skill and the result when it comes to omakase

While the chef is Thai, he’s trained in Japan. However being a Thai, he’s more willing to experiment with modern ingredients like truffles and the result is scrumptious

For 1999 set or even 3700 set, there’re only couple place in town that’s equaled in the highly competitive Bangkok on jade scene
sample_reviews_en.author: Oni Giri

sample_reviews_en.text:
Omakase Ten is a great option for anyone looking for high-quality omakase at an affordable price.

The highly skilled chef expertly utilized premium ingredients, incorporating each one thoughtfully and with purpose, and meticulously took great care in the presentation of each dish.

The sea urchin's delicate texture melted in my mouth, leaving me wanting more of its buttery flavor. The wagyu beef, cooked to perfection, was a symphony of tenderness and flavor, making it the best I've ever tried. And the abalone, with its bouncy yet succulent consistency, was a rich and savory delight, perfectly complemented by the pop of the salmon roe.

Each dish was a symphony of taste and texture, a culinary masterpiece that left me yearning for more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eleonora

sample_reviews_en.text: It was an incredibly impressive omakase experience. There's parking available at the restaurant, and the atmosphere is very cozy and private. We had the 17-course meal, which was quite filling. The ingredients were incredibly fresh and delicious in every piece. The chef used very generous portions. Overall, the food was refreshing, with frequent yuzu flavors that effectively cut through the richness. Every bite was heavenly. Personally, I loved the sweet shrimp and otoro; they melted in my mouth so beautifully. The chef was very attentive and friendly, always answering questions about the presentation. What impressed me most was that when the chef knew I love ikura, he added extra to the dishes that had it. It felt so thoughtful! 🥺
sample_reviews_en.author: Wattanun Wuttirat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely impressed with Omakase Ten. Every course was beautifully crafted with top-quality ingredients, and you can truly feel the attention to detail in both flavor and presentation.

The chef explained each dish clearly and with passion, which made the experience even more enjoyable. The progression of flavors was well-balanced, and nothing felt rushed.

Service was warm, professional, and attentive without being intrusive. The atmosphere is calm, elegant, and perfect for a special occasion.

Definitely one of the omakase experiences I would happily return to and recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalita Adisaipas

sample_reviews_en.text: Good fish, everything else is good, but I deducted points because the rice was not cooked, and when you chewed it was still rough, half-cooked, half-raw in some grains. How could a restaurant of this level make a mistake? The rice was scooped from a large pot and microwaved. I'm not sure if this is the method used to make sushi rice or what. I'm telling you what I saw. The restaurant will consider the rice and make improvements. Since they didn't tell me when I ate, they didn't want to deduct points from the restaurant, so they told me after leaving the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wat D.

restaurants.name: "Nalu Nani" Cafe & Thai Restaurant
restaurants.address:

181 Sukhumvit Alley 22, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The bar on the first floor is under 1,000 baht for two people!

During promotions, you can stay for around 500 baht.

The karaoke bar on the second floor is also incredibly cheap.

Nalu Nani's interior is bright and colorful, with a casual and cozy atmosphere that invites guests to relax and enjoy their meal. The menu features a range of traditional Hawaiian dishes, such as poke bowls, loco moco, and spam musubi, as well as a selection of fresh juices and smoothies.

One of the highlights of Nalu Nani is its commitment to using fresh, locally sourced ingredients in its dishes. The cafe works with local farmers and producers to source the freshest and highest-quality ingredients, ensuring that each dish is both delicious and sustainable.

All menu items are available for takeaway, with a 10-baht container fee.

Recently (February 2026), the menu has been updated and expanded.
sample_reviews_en.author: N I

sample_reviews_en.text:
A complete failure of a dining experience. The service was highly unprofessional, and the food quality fell drastically below acceptable standards—it is a downright disgrace to the local dining scene. Without a doubt, this was my most disappointing experience in Thailand.
>Furthermore, the ambiance is practically non-existent and profoundly uncomfortable. The restaurant forcefully subjected diners to a single, endless loop of a short snippet of Miley Cyrus’s 'Flowers', resulting in an absolute auditory disaster.
Avoid this place at all costs. I will absolutely never step foot in here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Barrow

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wow. Where do I start. This part of town in Bangkok has been very expensive compared to where I was previously and then I stumbled across this place.  Great menu, reasonable prices compared to its competitors.  I ordered 2 meals as 2 meals were the same price as 1 meal from the local competition.  The meals were delicious, and the staff were amazing especially Yee. Yee was super friendly and a breath of fresh air, she was so polite and courteous and friendly and helpful.  Very giving of her time to all customers evenly.
I will definitely come back here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Glen Kendall

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don't trust Google's reviews.
If you're looking for a place to eat, I recommend somewhere else.
The taste is simply monotonous and not tasty. (My child raved about the vegetable dishes, but the flavors aren't for adults.)

The staff were very friendly. It was a very good experience as an entertainment. They were very kind to the children, and it felt just like the atmosphere of Sukhumvit Soi 22.

I'm glad my family got to experience it.

The meal had an impact that lasted until the next day.
sample_reviews_en.author: etranger13

sample_reviews_en.text: The worst service and every thing. After i eat they give me hand bill with written 10 % taxes. And also they dont know what type of taxes is this. And when i ask i never come back then the staff and manager say no problem dont come back. And on the food side when i order food that one also not come with salt pepper or any sauce. Even u need to ask for sauce and salt pepper. Ridiculous service and charge high money on thai food. I especially ask every one don’t eat from there.
sample_reviews_en.author: My Life

sample_reviews_en.text: They used to have dishes like loco moco, but they don't anymore. The food is pretty much adapted to Japanese tastes. The katsu curry was tasty, but the portion was small. If you want curry, you might be better off going to another restaurant. The fried pork is quite recommendable. It's a good place to go when you're a little hungry on Sukhumvit Soi 22. They also have pad thai and gapao, so it's suitable for people who want something mild that suits Japanese tastes.
sample_reviews_en.author: 2pong

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stumbled upon this little Thai restaurant, and what a pleasant surprise! Both dishes we ordered were delicious. The woman who served us was lovely, spoke English, and we were able to chat with her, which is rare in small Thai restaurants. Just be aware that the pad thai comes with a kind of seafood sauce; you can even see tiny shrimp in it, and it's a shame that this isn't mentioned.
Otherwise, it was very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bruna Domingues

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was so glad they were open until late at night!
The food was delicious, and above all, the staff were amazing! It's a place I'd definitely want to visit again!
The smoothies were huge! I was very satisfied.
It seemed like they had unlimited karaoke for 100 baht! (Sorry if I misheard)
I thought it was a place worth coming to! I'll be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: ゆう

restaurants.name: Kao Soi Thengthrong
restaurants.address:

368 อาคาร บางกอก ซอย รัชดา 17 Ratchadaphisek, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This holiday was a full-on Northern Thai food feast! 😋 It started with spicy stir-fried minced meat salad (Larb Kua), incredibly flavorful and packed with spices. It was perfect with hot sticky rice.

Next up was Khao Soi, with its rich, aromatic broth and soft noodles – absolutely delicious! 🍜 And of course, the Nam Ngiao, a mild and comforting soup perfect for sipping. 🍲

Finally, some fragrant and spicy Nam Prik Kha (chili paste with galangal) served with fresh vegetables – another delicious combination! 🌶️

Honestly, it was amazing, like being in Chiang Mai! 🏞️ If you love Northern Thai food, you have to try this. You won't be disappointed!

#NorthernThaiFood #LarbKua #KhaoSoi #NamNgiao #NamPrikKha #Delicious #Satisfying #TravelThailand
sample_reviews_en.author: Review Hunter

sample_reviews_en.text:
The saying that prices in Thailand are cheap is a thing of the past... I used to be so disappointed in Thailand day after day because the food was either too cheap and tasteless or looked strange, or the prices were just too high.

But! This restaurant is so delicious and affordable! The garlic meat, the spicy General Tso's chicken, and the mild curry are truly tasty. I visited for lunch for four consecutive days, and we ordered whatever we wanted to our heart's content, costing about 100 baht per person.

This is the first time four guys traveling together have voluntarily left a Google review. Koreans, you absolutely must come here. You won't regret it, seriously!
sample_reviews_en.author: 한덕규

sample_reviews_en.text:
Another find as part of my Khao Soi quest in Thailand. A little bit out of the way,  about a 10 min walk from Sutthisan metro station. Blink, and you might miss it because it's tucked down a nondescript alley.
This was a one person operation on the day I was there. There's no menu for foreigners here, just pictures on the wall (which is better really, that whole a picture paints ...).
To the point, this is straight up as good as it gets . Would have loved more curry broth but that's me. It's spicy enough but for those that like a little zing, their fried chili paste brings on another layer of flavor and taste. All this paradise for THB60
sample_reviews_en.author: D Yew

sample_reviews_en.text: The Khao Soi with beef was incredibly delicious! I've never had it this good anywhere else. It's very rich and flavorful, in true Thai style, although it was a little spicy. Those who can't handle spice might need to ask the restaurant to reduce the spiciness. I'm not sure if people from Northern Thailand would actually like this flavor though. 😂 The restaurant is nice; they definitely like Liverpool, judging by the wallpaper. The lighting is warm, the music is relaxing, and the atmosphere is cool. The service is good, and you can help yourself to the vegetables and condiments as much as you like.
sample_reviews_en.author: Surasit Khokkruad

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has parking ^^

It opens at noon sharp, but sometimes things might not be ready yet. Anyway, we went when we weren't hungry, so we could wait!

The price is good. We got to eat Northern Thai food to our heart's content. The Khao Soi was delicious. There's a central table where you can add your own vegetables – awesome!!!

The restaurant has air conditioning. We went at noon, and they had just turned it on, but it wasn't hot. We were okay. Getting to eat delicious Khao Soi for 65 baht was impressive! 🤭💕
sample_reviews_en.author: ประภัสสร จันทร์แดง

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually order from them very often; I'm practically a regular customer. But lately, the shop on the Robinhood app has been opening very late. Sometimes it's already afternoon and they're still not open. Also, the menu options through the app are too limited. I wish they offered all the items available in the physical store.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rattiw Ratti

sample_reviews_en.text: Another little jem i found by accident . Off the main road but had to try their Kao soi ♥️. Love the cozy feel of the resturant . Ice cold beers served with a beef kao soi- that good i had 2 portions . Side dish was  crispy fried pork . Price was good too. Pop down and enjoy an amazing thai dish .
sample_reviews_en.author: tony claridge

sample_reviews_en.text: Had pork curry and fried chicken and they’re amazing. Fried chicken in particular is crispy and delicious. Recommend trying this place out. The shop only opens at weekdays tho and sometimes you have to wait a while for your order to arrive. Other than that it is an awesome place with cheap prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aung Myo Win

restaurants.name: Flinders Street Cafe : Specialty Coffee & Fat Cat
restaurants.address:

16/1 Pracha Chuen Rd, Khwaeng Bang Sue, Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "The coffee is really good and reasonably priced."

sample_reviews_en.text:
It is a cosy cafe that is beautifully decorated and helmed by 3 cats. The coffee is really good and reasonably priced. It would be great if it was opened on weekdays as well - I’d definitely drop by to work.

I found it adorable watching the orange cat looking over his human making coffee. Please do not to impose into the cats’ personal space unless they seem inclined, as anyone who is familiar with felines would know. The poor orange cat was extremely ruffled when a visitor forcibly stroke it - and was (gently) bitten - as evidenced from his grumpy face here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Foo Jia Xin

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a cute, cozy cafe, like eating at a friend's house (because it's actually the owner's sister's house, lol).
There are three cats to entertain you. The gray cat is the most entertaining, meowing constantly and even climbing onto the table to show off, lol.
The coffee and drinks are delicious. The banana cake isn't too sweet at all, which I loved. However, there isn't much parking, so you might need to call ahead to inquire. If you come by motorbike, parking is easy. 🐱
sample_reviews_en.author: PuffyMegan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent!
I loved the desserts and drinks; they were high quality and more than worth the price. They use good ingredients.

The cats were adorable and fluffy, very healing.

I will definitely go again.
It looked like it would be hard to find, but it's not difficult at all. Just walk slowly and you'll be there.

Anyway, I loved the atmosphere and the collectibles in the shop. It's so lively.
sample_reviews_en.author: SAJEE. VI

sample_reviews_en.text:
A super cozy home cafe with a few cats to play with! 😸
The Dirty Fat Cat menu is incredibly smooth. The Nutella and coffee go together so well. There's so much to choose from, I couldn't decide, so I asked the owner to recommend a brownie that wasn't too sweet and was just right. It pairs perfectly with the drinks. Overall, I was very impressed and will definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanyanach Ngokon

sample_reviews_en.text: The three cats are a bit aloof and don't play much; one seems timid, but they're incredibly cute with super soft fur. The drinks and desserts are delicious, but service is a little slow, so be patient. From the outside, the shop looks very hidden, like it's not a cafe, but the inside is beautiful and stylish.
sample_reviews_en.author: natcha engchuon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Giving it a perfect score! The drinks and desserts are delicious.
The cat doesn't like being petted but is super cute!
There's parking for 2 cars. It's best to call ahead to check (about 10-20 minutes).
There are limited tables (call ahead).
The owner is very friendly, lovely, and kind. I want to go again!
sample_reviews_en.author: PandanBell

sample_reviews_en.text:
The mood and tone of the shop are great. The 4-legged friends are super cute. The drinks are okay, and the banana cake is delicious and freshly baked.

The owner is lovely and attentive. He provides good customer service.
However, parking is limited. You can park two cars inside the house.
sample_reviews_en.author: VaVanVa

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a small cafe located in a house with a cozy, homey feel. The decor is a blend of street style and mid-century modern, yet warm and inviting. The shop isn't very spacious, but it feels comfortable because the owner is very laid-back. …
sample_reviews_en.author: S K

restaurants.name: Club Miyabi
restaurants.address:

11 Soi Thonglor 25, Sukhumvit 55 Rd., Klongton-nua, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Transparent Pricing

While it's a bit pricey, the pricing is clear and transparent. The staff are well-trained, and unlike many establishments of this type, they don't get so caught up in their own entertainment that they neglect the customers. This makes it a good place to bring customers who want to enjoy themselves a little longer after their meal. They also speak Japanese, and unlike many other places, they rarely only interact with Thai-speaking customers.

However, since it's not a stereotypical Thai establishment, making unreasonable demands can sometimes lead to conflict. Therefore, it's not suitable for customers who aren't comfortable with a sophisticated, casual experience. If that's your intention, you'd be better off going to a different place or going to Thaniya or Patpong.
sample_reviews_en.author: Masahiko Ishikawa

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a bit pricey, but there are many beautiful girls, so I think it's worth it. You can also keep your bottle for a year. I recently bought three bottles during a promotion, and they manage them well. It seems you can't take the girls home, but it might be possible depending on the girl's schedule. There are many beautiful girls. There are more girls between 8:00 PM and 9:00 PM, but after two hours it's almost full and there are fewer girls. I heard that many of the customers are Japanese people living in Bangkok. The girls in black clothes apparently don't speak Japanese.
sample_reviews_en.author: masa

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is of high quality, with authentic sauerkraut fish that combines Sichuan and Shaanxi flavors; the Japanese-style service is attentive, and the atmosphere is upscale, suitable for business or relaxing with a few drinks. At over 1000 RMB per person, it's a bit pricey, but the bill is transparent, the staff are attractive, speak fluent Japanese, and have a friendly bottle-keeping policy. The location is a bit far from Thonglor station, so arrive early during peak hours. Overall, it's still worth a return visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: 曼谷上门服务 Escort Bangkok 看主页

sample_reviews_en.text: There are a lot of women there and they speak Japanese well❗️It's great to be able to drink with a woman whose face I like. She's also a good singer. I'd like to go again if I have the chance. It's that kind of place.＼(^^)／
sample_reviews_en.author: 藤倉一郎

sample_reviews_en.text: The quality remains high, but the prices have gone up, which is understandable considering the rising cost of living. It's a good place to take customers, but if you want something more sophisticated, try another place.
sample_reviews_en.author: T S

sample_reviews_en.text:
I used this restaurant to entertain clients.

Although we didn't order any food, the staff provided excellent service.

They went the extra mile to make our clients feel comfortable and happy, which was very helpful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chipo

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're going there, I recommend going with the image of a high-class club in mind. The quality of the women is high. There are also many women who can speak Japanese. If you have the chance, why not give it a try?
sample_reviews_en.author: 小原眞

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited this place for a second round of drinks after dinner with my fellow expatriates. Since there were staff members who could speak Japanese, the conversation flowed easily, and we had a very productive time.
sample_reviews_en.author: HIDEAKI TERAMOTO

restaurants.name: RK Food Garden 81
restaurants.address:

183 ซ. สุขุมวิท 81 Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It is a convenient food court with many stores offering a variety of food, drinks and beverages. I think there are many Thai and Japanese restaurants. Although it is called a food court, there are also bars, and I think most of the restaurants are mainly open in the evening. There are plenty of tables and seats, so you will have no trouble even if you go with a large group. Prices are inexpensive at all restaurants. Even if you have already ordered something, they will ask for your drink order as soon as you sit down, and even if you are in the middle of drinking, they will offer you alcohol, so it may not be very comfortable for those who do not drink a lot of alcohol. There is a parking lot in front of the food court and attendants are available. Just be careful not to drink and drive. Weak-willed people who drink when encouraged to do so, even if they have no intention of doing so, may want to take a Taxi or walk to the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Munetsugu Kaneko

sample_reviews_en.text:
We live nearby and normally always have dinner at this place as they have many different shops. Today I parked the car at the car parking but didn’t go into the market directly because I was talking with a friend across the road. Suddenly a woman and a man came talk to us that we can’t park the car if we don’t eat at their place. I told them politely that I’m just having conversation with my friend about 5 minutes and then I’m going to eat there. The way they talk was very rude, we immediately decided to go inside the market for dinner but that woman said us to get out of the market. You don’t need to eat here just get out that’s what she said.
We enjoy to have Dinner at that market but we are not coming back there anymore. It’s so humiliating to get yelled in front of other customers by those uneducated, ignorant and no service minded security guards or I don’t even know their position because they are not wearing security uniforms
sample_reviews_en.author: Htu Khaing

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here in May'25 for Burmese Food because I miss those. When I get there with my empty Cha Tra Mu Thai Tea takeaway cup which cannot be thrown on the way and also there, the staff from other restaurant, I guess from the bar, warned I cannot drink outside drinks there which I understand that place only doesn't allow outside alcoholic drinks and they tried to charge fine for bringing the empty Cha Tra Mu empty cup!!! Such an inconvenient place to get my missing Burmese Food craves. Won't go back again, like never and it's rather ordering online for my favorite foods from there!
sample_reviews_en.author: Phyu Ko

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small night market with 95% locals (more like an outdoor food court with several restaurants than a night market).
There are no souvenirs, just food, drinks, and live performances. The staff are all friendly, and the tables are cleaned frequently, so it's always clean.
There's also a pocket die. For 20 baht, you can play pocket ball with the owner. He's really good at it... I'm so bad at it, the owner even taught me how to play. You can ride a bike from Onnut Station for less than 30 baht! I had a great time, eating, and enjoying the food.👍
sample_reviews_en.author: 띠띠

sample_reviews_en.text:
This food garden used to have a large number of stalls, so you could enjoy a variety of international cuisine, but recently many of them have closed, so it has become dominated by Thai food stalls.
There are many cheap hotels in the area, so it is quite lively, mainly with tourists.
If you walk a little further straight, you will find Himawari Shokudo, a Japanese restaurant, an Italian restaurant, cafes, and bars, so it might be a good idea to try some of these restaurants in combination.
sample_reviews_en.author: 浅香洋平

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, I came to eat at this restaurant, but there was only one food stall to choose from. I had bought food from outside, but I had a meeting with a friend to have dinner here. Suddenly, an older man wearing glasses and a long-sleeved shirt came over and started scolding me, telling me to put my food down and take it home to eat. His tone and demeanor were very unpleasant. I felt that he could have just said it nicely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimphat C.

sample_reviews_en.text: We had dinner at Mali Hku, a Kachin traditional shop, and was very satisfied with the taste. I’ve been missing these traditional dishes from my home country, and this meal truly fulfilled me. We tried two dishes, and the Sa Hpye was outstanding – so good that you shouldn’t miss out on it! The pork tenderloin salad would also be perfect with a beer. Overall, this shop is a great place to enjoy authentic Kachin cuisine!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nang Lee Hark Onn

sample_reviews_en.text: The place is spacious, clean, has fans to keep the air circulating, not hot and stuffy. There is a pool table, a craft beer counter, free restrooms, parking. The wait staff are very good, sharp-eyed and quick-witted. In the early evening, there is a band, but the music is a bit slow and lingering, not suitable for early evening. Food prices start at 120 baht. Some restaurants have a very long wait.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicky Sea

restaurants.name: Bruno's Restaurant & Wine Bar
restaurants.address:

306 Chateau Dale Plaza 63 Thappraya Rd, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I saw a recent YouTube review of this restaurant and decided to give it a go. I turned up alone and without a reservation on busy valentines day. I was warmly met by Andy the manager who very kindly accommodated me. I ordered the Australian Rib Eye, with Mashed potato and Mushroom truffle sauce. It was very delicious. I would go as far to say it was the best steak I have eaten in a very long time and hands down the best steak in Pattaya! It was juicy, tender and cooked to perfection. The staff were attentive and courteous, with Andy being the perfect front of house host. I found the atmosphere to be very relaxing indeed! The evening was finished off with a delicious courtesy Irish coffee. The price was very reasonable too and well worth the money in my humble honest opinion. Thank you so much. I will return with my wife.
sample_reviews_en.author: Knightstorm

sample_reviews_en.text: This Pattaya Iconic restaurant has maintained their excellence over the many years we have visited (initial location was on Soi 1). Food quality was perfect, I would suggest the Rack of Lamb, great taste and presentation 5 star. Service very attentive, noticeably more female staff serving these days. Very nice ambiance and modern decor, the building has three distinct rooms separated  by glass walls, giving it a nice open feeling. The only issue was the wine list, while some what OK (a little pricey, but extensive) our wine of choice was sold out one our second bottle, improvement in this area would make improve my rating. Look forward to my return visit at the end of March.
sample_reviews_en.author: เกรแฮม รูดด์

sample_reviews_en.text: A shocking fall of standards and care since I last went here. We were concerned on arrival that the building had a huge for sale sign on it. I should have taken the hint. Still top shelf prices but sloppy I-don’t care attitudes were very much what we experienced. We had the suckling pig between 3 of us and completely devoid of crackling and the pork was tough and very unpleasant indeed. Not that anyone asked nor cared. They opened up their smokers section latter in the evening so that we HAD to leave because of the sickening cigarette smoke, or that’s the impression I was given. Sell the joint Guys there are much nicer places at these lofty prices
sample_reviews_en.author: David Smith (OzJockey)

sample_reviews_en.text: Get ready for an evening of fine dining...this place is a must. First, from the moment you step in until the time you check out, the staff is most cordial and very professional. Second, the ambience is close to being luxurious and the atmosphere is stress free. I could write many lines about the quality of the dishes...I'll just say INCREDIBLE!! It is, by far, one of the best restaurants I've been to since I've moved to Thailand (8 years ago). You might catch a glimpse of the owner as he goes around and greets customers. Oh, and the bill...very reasonable. I can't wait to go back. Cheers!
sample_reviews_en.author: André Garant

sample_reviews_en.text: Not A Great place at all. Steaks were undercooked and after 50 minutes of waiting I was very disappointed. My family also was not happy because as soon as we walk in people are smoking right in the lobby. Service was terrible as well, people who arrived later than us were served first And I think this was because they were discriminating us from the beginning. I would definitely not recommend this place to anyone. Just horrible please avoid
sample_reviews_en.author: Arun Kumar

sample_reviews_en.text:
Competently prepared meal as befits a restaurant that has been around for a while. It does not have the flash of genius that Au Bon Coin displays but very good meal all told. An extensive wine list with some gems. The quality of the martini I had surprised me, easily the best I've had in Thailand.

There are always some interesting company at dinner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alok Singh

sample_reviews_en.text: Went on NYE. Food was excellent and well presented. 2,800b set with about 7 courses. Only 2 little hiccups, one when got served set menu out of turn and later when waited a long time for a course but overall thought it was excellent value especially compared to the totally rip off prices Hotels were charging for inferior quality
sample_reviews_en.author: Alfred the Great

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice decorated interior with good service.... way too expensive though as food were mostly just mediocre and my rib eye was more tendons than meat asking my fellow guests around the table confirmed my critique. The whole city area unfortunately is plagued by a taxi mafia and using  them is more than unpleasant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andy H

restaurants.name: CHARM GARDEN
restaurants.address:

200/4 Rama II Soi 33, Bang Mot, Chom Thong, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
CHARM GARDEN has changed!!!

Previously... it was a clean and healthy place. The food was mild, not overly salty, and had a pleasant, organic feel, made with carefully selected ingredients.

Now... it's spicy Thai food, and the portion sizes are larger (and the prices are higher).
This initially surprised us when we were about to order.

The signature organic rice and traditional, lightly seasoned flavors are gone.

It's not that it's bad, it just depends on personal preference. The kids' corner is still there, and the service is still good. Just a heads up, if you get ice in your water, you'll get a bucket of ice (30 baht)!🤣🤣

The smoothies are still delicious. The rice dishes, however, have changed.
sample_reviews_en.author: patsorn Rak

sample_reviews_en.text:
Yesterday we had the chance to host our baby’s party at the restaurant. One word I’d say is TERRIBLE. The restaurant’s preparation was NONE. I arrived 30 mins before the event starts and even had to tell waiters to sweep off the dust on the floor. The room was very dirty like a rotted, isolated ghost house. Tags on the stage’s backdrop was still somebody else’s wedding names long before our event and the restaurant didn’t care enough to remove it from the stage. Besides, wine glasses weren’t washed…until I told them to.
Most importantly, they charged us 650thb/pax when only 7 dishes of food were served. I gotta say, I’m very disappointed in Charm.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fern SS.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Giving it full stars for everything: food, service, and atmosphere.
The food was randomly ordered, but everything turned out delicious.
- German pork knuckle: crispy on the outside, tender on the inside.
- Stir-fried shrimp with chili: very delicious, with kaffir lime leaves added for a fragrant and tasty flavor.
- Salmon pizza: delicious without needing any extra seasoning.
This is an honest review; the food photos aren't focused on aesthetics, just the real thing.

We had lunch here and didn't have to wait long; the food was prepared quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manow Manow

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a wonderful atmosphere, like eating at home. There's a Plan Toys play area for children to keep them entertained. The food is delicious, suitable for both adults and children. There's ample parking space and a very large outdoor area in front of the restaurant for kids to run around.
sample_reviews_en.author: Papassarin Alcotec

sample_reviews_en.text:
A restaurant run by one of Thailand's top chefs 👩‍🍳
I wasn't a big fan of the sweet sauces (perhaps because the food selection was mostly fried), but the food was carefully prepared and delicious.
There was a kids' area with lots of Plan Toys toys, making this a great place to bring kids.
sample_reviews_en.author: MJmama

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, and the staff were great, providing excellent service. However, there was one woman—I'm not sure if she was the manager or the owner—who had a very unwelcoming attitude. Her demeanor in the restaurant was quite poor and needs improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakorn Ketkaew

sample_reviews_en.text: I used to be a big fan of Chef Top's cooking show, going every week. His Thai chef's table food was the best. I recently missed it and stopped by, but it's completely changed. The food has all changed, and the restaurant is painted pink. It's lost its charm.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sangaroon Cheamsawat

sample_reviews_en.text: The place is beautiful, the food was mediocre, and the chef was incredibly rude and shouldn't be working in service at a wedding. Is it appropriate to speak so disrespectfully to guests at someone else's special event?
sample_reviews_en.author: T B

restaurants.name: Man Hin by Chef Man
restaurants.address:

Grand Centre Point Lumphini ชั้น L, โซน Worklab, Rama IV Rd, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Excellent! The food is delicious, the staff is attentive, and the atmosphere is great—clean, spacious, and comfortable. The food is especially tasty, particularly the dim sum and chicken rice. Truly lives up to the Chef Man name. Reasonably priced. I’ll definitely come back againใ
sample_reviews_th.author: popsook morndee

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Cantonese-style café has a nice modern look and friendly service, but the food doesn’t quite live up to its promise. The flavors feel more average than authentic Cantonese — not quite like what I’ve had in Hong Kong or other good Cantonese spots.
Their signature Hainanese chicken rice was a mixed bag: the chicken was tender and tasty, but the rice was disappointing — flat and lacking the fragrance it should have. The fried rice was also below standard. On the bright side, the steamed buns were soft and flavorful, and the salt-and-pepper tofu was nicely done. The char siu could have been great if it had been grilled a little more for that smoky finish.
One real letdown, though, was the use of melamine plates — quite disappointing for a restaurant that presents itself as refined and stylish. For a place that looks this polished, proper tableware should be part of the experience.
The café is clean, the staff attentive, and the overall atmosphere pleasant. But considering the price, the food feels a bit underwhelming. It’s an okay experience — just not one I’d rush back for.
sample_reviews_en.author: Norraphol B.D.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes good and the prices are very affordable. I didn't even have time to take pictures 😁 I've been here many times because I like to charge my car here. The Hainanese chicken rice is 99 baht, a good price.
I used to give a better rating, but today I want to update my review from my 5th visit, and I was not impressed with the table. We usually choose our usual round table, and normally when we come as a couple, we always order at least 8 dishes. Today, after we sat down, and the table was empty and didn't have a "reserved" sign, a staff member asked us to move to another table, saying that this table was reserved. Since we had already ordered food, we moved. But after sitting for 3 hours, that table was still empty, while the table we moved to was overflowing with food.
sample_reviews_en.author: เชฟอามซีเครทบาร์ Chefs Arm Secret Bar

sample_reviews_en.text:
Standout was the Onsen Chicken Rice (THB 99) — tender sous‑vide chicken breast, fragrant rice cooked with chicken fat, and bright ginger‑scallion sauce, all at excellent value.
Other dishes included the Egg Noodle with Shrimp Wonton (THB 129), simple but umami; dim sum staples like Siu‑Mai (THB 145) and Ha‑Kao (THB 145), competently done but standard; Chicken Feet in Black Bean Sauce (THB 125), savoury and familiar; and Shrimp Wonton Soup in Szechuan Sauce (THB 129), toned down in spice.
Snacks and desserts rounded things out: the Crispy Milk Roll (THB 79) was pleasant but forgettable, while the Thai Tea Pudding (THB 60) was outstanding — custardy, balanced, and refreshing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Man Hin by Chef Man (文轩定稿) offers a delightful dining experience, particularly if you're a fan of chicken rice. Many reviewers praise the short waiting times and the overall quality of the dishes.
The grilled chicken stands out with its crispy skin and excellent flavor, though some might find the portion size a tad small. While the chicken itself is delicious, it would be even better if served with a sweet chili sauce rather than the two accompanying powders, which weren't to everyone's taste. Beyond the chicken, you'll find that many other items on the menu are also highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ben C

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located in an office area and isn't very spacious. The food was very mediocre. The pickled cabbage fish wasn't good, the duck was just okay with coarse skin, the noodles in the gravy dish were sticky and clumped together, and the gravy lacked aroma. The Hainanese chicken rice was also just average. The staff were quite disorganized, making two wrong orders and serving food slowly, requiring constant reminders. Overall, I was not impressed at all. Compared to Hua restaurant at Grand Centerpoint Surawong, Hua is much better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thunchanok Sirikantaramas

sample_reviews_en.text:
Another real deal for Chinese food lovers. This shop offers a quick yet flavorful bite with a casual hawker-style vibe. The food is mainly Cantonese-based cuisine, so expect mild, comforting Chinese dishes.
Portions are decent and very good value for money, with plenty of menu options to choose from. The only downside was the ordering system, which caused a longer wait due to a system error.
That said, the staff and service were great—friendly, always smiling, and genuinely service-minded.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanakorn Lertudommungmee

sample_reviews_en.text: A Chinese restaurant by the famous Chef Man, known for his authentic flavors and quality dishes. The signature Hainanese chicken rice set starts at just 99 THB, offering excellent value for money. The menu includes a wide variety of Chinese dishes — we tried about 8-9 items, and every dish was delicious. Service is attentive, and the food is served very quickly. Overall, great taste, fair prices, and impressive quality from a well-known chef. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattapong Manothai

restaurants.name: Woodhaven Casual Eatery
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 98/9 ม.9 ถนนราชพฤกษ์ - นนทบุรี1 Bang Krang, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently had the pleasure of visiting Woodhaven Casual Eatery for lunch, and it was a delightful experience. The ambiance is warm and inviting, perfect for a relaxed meal.

To start, I ordered a Quesadilla, which was generously filled with melted cheese and perfectly seasoned chicken. The balance of flavors was spot on, and the fresh guacamole served on the side was a wonderful touch.

For the main course, I chose the Spaghetti Bolognese. The pasta was cooked to perfection, and the Bolognese sauce was rich and hearty, with just the right amount of seasoning. It’s clear that they use high-quality ingredients, which made the dish incredibly satisfying.

Complementing the meal was their impressive selection of craft beers. The staff was knowledgeable and recommended a locally brewed IPA that paired excellently with both dishes. The beer was crisp, refreshing, and enhanced the overall dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wisanu Tuntawiroon

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was average, but the quesadilla was amazing – absolutely delicious! The restaurant has a nice atmosphere; it was hot, but the air conditioning kept us cool. The service was good. Here are my personal opinions on the other dishes:

The truffle mushroom soup had a good texture, but the truffle flavor was too weak.
The bacon and dried chili spaghetti was okay.
The shrimp pesto spaghetti was rather bland; the pesto color wasn't very noticeable.
The pasta was well-cooked, not mushy, and perfectly done.
The pork chop was standard, but a bit dry. The sauce was delicious.
The "cat's scream" rice dish wasn't quite up to par.
The Belgian chocolate drink also felt weak in flavor.

I'll definitely come back again to try other menu items.
sample_reviews_en.author: PyippyN

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant offers a diverse menu including Thai, European, and Mexican cuisine. It has convenient parking, air conditioning, and a limited number of seats. The atmosphere is cute.
The food is delicious. The mixed sausages I ordered were all excellent, with the slightly tangy mayonnaise-mustard sauce cutting through the richness perfectly.
The Mexican pizza had a crispy crust and stretchy cheese, with mild-flavored toppings. It was delicious paired with the ranch sauce, although the portion was a bit small (which I loved!).
The "Cat's Eye Rice" was flavorful, rich, and not too spicy, and came with a clear soup. I'll try the Shake Sugar next time. The staff were friendly and welcoming.
sample_reviews_en.author: sa harat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, and the service is great and very friendly. It's a small restaurant, so the menu might not be extensive, but the food is delicious – just as good as what I've tried before.

The coffee shop next door is also excellent. I highly recommend it. If you have the time and enjoy drip coffee, you should definitely come here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prasong Kajonrattanadeth

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a bright and airy atmosphere.
The food is delicious and doesn't take long to arrive.
I recommend the "Cat's Scream Rice" and the salmon steak.
The drinks are delicious; I ordered matcha and lychee soda, both perfectly sweet.
It's easy to find, located on the main road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Colorful Lovely

sample_reviews_en.text: This has become our family's comfort zone. Whenever we crave delicious, homey-tasting food, we think of this place. We were impressed with their fried rice from the first visit, and on our second visit, we accidentally ordered the same …
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwankamol C.

sample_reviews_en.text: Thank you to the restaurant for catering to picky eaters and those with underlying health conditions like us. The food was excellent, just like mom's cooking. The atmosphere was warm and friendly. We were very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: P Parn

sample_reviews_en.text:
(Translated by Google) All the food was delicious, including the stir-fried salad, Mexican pizza, and Pad Thai.

(Original)
All the food was delicious, including the stir-fried salad, Mexican pizza, and Pad Thai.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปีเตอร์

restaurants.name: เตี๋ยวเรือเด็กมีเส้น
restaurants.address:

341 15 Charan Sanit Wong Rd, Bang Khun Si, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: A dining room with bowls for 12 THB. Soup with a little noodles, a piece of meat and a ball of I don't know what, of course spicy and with the possibility of varying the contents. I wanted to try how Thais eat. Although I encountered a language barrier, which was a much bigger problem for the staff than for me, in the end the Thai couple sitting next to me helped me a little and ordered me a bowl. In the end I had two and I was satisfied. The final point was that a Thai couple paid for my expenses and thanked me for sharing. Thailand is simply a country of kind people. Come try it and bring a translator, although it doesn't help much anyway 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: M

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a noodle shop that makes consistently delicious noodles.
The taste is consistent. For those who like boat noodles, I highly recommend this branch of Dek Mee Sen Boat Noodles.
There are a decent number of tables and seating.
The price for noodles, pork cracklings, pork rinds, fried dumplings, or a small bottle of soda is 12 baht.
Ice is 2 baht per glass, but it's free if you bring your own glass.
A large bottle of soda is 30 baht.
This is another shop I often go to with my son.
The only downside is that you have to park on the side of the road or near the bus stop.
sample_reviews_en.author: ม่อน ช่างภาพสายเหมา

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has terrible service. It wasn't very crowded, but the food took an extremely long time to prepare; I waited half an hour and still didn't get my order. And the cook kept complaining in the Isaan dialect the whole time. I don't know what they were complaining about – and I'm not trying to bully them, but they were complaining excessively and it was really annoying. Please excuse my slightly blunt language. Also, I ordered no vegetables, but I still got a lot of them.
sample_reviews_en.author: ผู้ช่วยศาสตราจารย์ เซี่ยงไฮ้ น่ารักจัง (เฟย์)

sample_reviews_en.text: They give you a lot for the price, which is cheap at 40-50 baht. The meatballs are delicious. I saw a lot of people there, so I decided to order takeout. But the takeout experience wasn't great. The kid taking the order seemed a bit confused. Order slowly and don't rush, or they'll get confused. Haha. You can park on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: อารยา เจนการ

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant really reminds me of Ayutthaya boat noodles. The prices are cheap, and the portions are small, allowing you to try a variety of toppings. There's a wide selection of side dishes. Overall, it's good. If you're craving Ayutthaya boat noodles, I highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hoshi_Hutt

sample_reviews_en.text:
The seating is cool and comfortable.
Orders don't take long to arrive.
The noodles are delicious, the broth is rich and flavorful. It's a shame there's no meat.
The crispy dumplings, pork cracklings, and pork rinds are excellent.
The Thai steamed pudding is average.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kurk Kosaurous

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a boat noodle shop with a spicy flavor, 12 baht per bowl.
Side dishes include crispy wontons, pork cracklings, and pork rinds. There are several branches; this is the branch near my house at the electric train intersection.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vit

sample_reviews_en.text: Good price but you should call to reserve a table in advance. If you walk in you might have to wait for a table. The pork rinds are very delicious and go well with the thick boat noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bang Pu

restaurants.name: Lucky Panda - American Chinese Eats (Pattaya)
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 111/69-70 ตำบลหนองปรือ Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I discovered this restaurant through GrabFood and have ordered from it many times. Since I always enjoyed their delivery meals, I decided to visit the restaurant and dine in.
