The positive points are that the restaurant is extremely clean and well-maintained. You can see the kitchen from the dining area, and it’s very impressive how hygienic and organized everything is. I originally thought the food might be pre-cooked, but each dish is actually made fresh to order, which makes it very delicious. This restaurant is very clean and serves great food, so I feel completely confident ordering from it on GrabFood as well.

The only downside is that the portion sizes are quite large. I think it might be difficult for one woman to finish a full set on her own. However, if you’re sharing with a friend, it shouldn’t be a problem.
sample_reviews_en.author: Na Thai

sample_reviews_en.text: Hi! As a Spanish guy coming from Azerbaijan- land of the tastiest food, I can say that I couldn’t get used to the Thai food since they have some weird smelly spice that I can’t bear. However, this Chinese restaurant is a great relief for me. First, it was a great portion and I wouldn’t expect such big portions. I ordered 1 combo menu - noodles and honey chicken and 1 stirred rice with shrimps. I didn’t like noodles and rice very much since they had some burnt flavour; nevertheless beef, shrimp, chicken and vegetables were fantastic. I also got free fried something while I was waiting for my orders. Recommended it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Diego Martinez

sample_reviews_en.text:
Their menu is very extensive and has lots of options for different diet types. The menu includes dishes that vegans and vegetarians can eat. And the vegan items are denoted and marked as vegan. The restaurant is very clean and I love the panda theme, it is adorable. Staff is very cheery and responsive, and you can see the inside of the kitchen as they cook.And it looks like they are very clean and organized. I got vegetarian food and my partner got carnivorous food.

As for the taste,  the taste is amazing and the ingredients seem really fresh and it has really good flavors and it's served for you hot and ready.
sample_reviews_en.author: Margot Taylor

sample_reviews_en.text: Good taste, large portions. This is authentic AMERICAN Chinese food. Ordered five times from this place - basically once a week. The first order was one off all the other ones excellent and pretty consistent. I stick to Gen tso's chicken but also tried orange and Mongolian beef. Always well packaged and arrived fresh and hot even though the total delivery time is 50 min for my location. I wish they used thigh meat instead of breast but that's their prerogative. Highly recommend to all the Americans nostalgic for the taste of home. To quote Homer Simpson, "Extra MSG please"
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Kostko

sample_reviews_en.text:
Outstanding. I am from the US in many Chinese American restaurants are Hit or Miss when it comes to quality and actually cleanliness.

This was outstanding both. I had to stir fried black pepper beef. I thought this was going to be breaded pieces with just like chunks of beef inside. I was wrong. It was sliced beef. No breading couldn't ask for better fresh fresh vegetables.

A dinner platter did come out to about $10 but it could have fed three people easily enough for two.

The girls there. The staff are very nice. The low main was outstanding.

I will be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: william henry

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered here about 3 or 4 times before on Grab with no problem. But today when I got my order it was packaged wrong. It was not what the receipt said I ordered. I called and asked them to resend the right order. The lady found my receipt and asked me to wait. She then hung up on me. I called back and she asked me what I wanted her to do? So I told her to please send me the correct order. She hung up on me again. I tried to call back 2 more time but someone would cancel the call. Very disappointed
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Wheeler

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely delighted to find this new restaurant in central Pattaya. The location is great, the atmosphere is bright, clean and lively, the open kitchen is a real treat. The food is absolutely perfect American-Chinese cuisine - very much like what we have in the US. Portions are generous, and the quality is fantastic. We had egg drop soup and a set menu that included General Tsao chicken, vegetable chow mein, and some very nice BBQ pork. Excellent, and at a great price!
sample_reviews_en.author: Scott Lewis

sample_reviews_en.text:
Watched this place being built and was looking forward to trying it!

Ship is well decorated, clean and tidy.  Staff are a little unsure of the systems but I put that down to new shop!

The hot&sour soup was lovely but my sweet&sour rice bowl was made without any sweet&sour sauce; so it was basically chicken balls, a few bell-peppers and onions fried together… I’m sure it was just a mistake and I hope to give it another try on my next visit to Pattaya!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lee Bee

restaurants.name: Duck Noodle
restaurants.address:

209 374 ม ซอย พัฒนาการ 61 Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating at this restaurant for over 20 years, since before I got married and even after my children grew up. The broth is fragrant, sweet, and perfectly salty. It's refreshing to sip. Personally, I don't add anything. I just ask for the chili and lime sauce to dip into the duck meat, offal, and intestines. It's incredibly delicious. The tables, chairs, containers, and spoons are all clean and air-conditioned, so you don't have to sit in the dust, heat, or sweat, ruining your mood. This restaurant is truly excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: ตือ

sample_reviews_en.text:
An old, established duck noodle shop.
The shop is located deep in a village alley. There's parking for 3 cars in front of the shop, or you can park along the road.

- The braised duck is delicious and tender. What makes it even better is the flavorful broth.
- My wife really liked the pork satay; the dipping sauce was delicious.
- The steamed dumplings and braised pork leg were good, as expected.

The prices are reasonable. It's delicious, and if you're in the area, I recommend trying it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hi

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating at this restaurant since I was a kid. It's an old, established place that started in Soi Thua Ngok, then moved to Sao Chingcha, and now it's on Phatthanakan Road. Everything is delicious and clean. The braised duck is excellent, with a perfectly seasoned broth. The duck intestines are made in the traditional way, without any additives, crispy and enjoyable. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Aidsdeb Thong

sample_reviews_en.text:
This old-established duck noodle shop offers both braised and stewed duck noodles, as well as duck offal (braised duck offal) and pork leg. Snacks include pork dumplings and pork satay.
You can eat in the shop or order as offerings for various festivals.
The shop has seating for about 50 people. Parking is available on the street. Dishes are priced between 45 and 65 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thamniap Urankul

sample_reviews_en.text: Some say this is an old shop from the Giant Swing, but it's been open for over 40 years since it opened in Soi Phatthanakan 61. The duck noodles are delicious, with tender duck meat and a fragrant broth of five-spice powder. They also have pork leg rice, but I didn't try it. The satay and dumplings are also quite good, and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Coke Somchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
An old established restaurant in Muang Thong 2/2 village.
The food tastes great, especially the pork leg rice and duck noodles.
They also have pork intestines, steamed dumplings, pork satay, and many other dishes.
There isn't much parking in front of the shop, but you can park along the side.
sample_reviews_en.author: Junlaphan Sangsubhan

sample_reviews_en.text: This time I ordered for home delivery. The owner was so lovely and gave great advice, suggesting I order directly from the shop and use Grab for pickup as it's cheaper. They're so attentive to customers! The filling is amazing – so bouncy! Highly recommend to everyone!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nalin Gmail

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came to this restaurant based on reviews and it was delicious. I wasn't disappointed at all! ^^ The soup was well-balanced, and the duck and offal were clean and odorless.
My personal favorite is the duck intestines and dipping sauce. They were very enjoyable.
sample_reviews_en.author: A J

restaurants.name: I LOVE PIZZA (Pattaya)
restaurants.address:

I LOVE PIZZA 34/27 ม.10 16 ซ.บงกชใต้ ต.หนองปรือ Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A true piece of Italy in Pattaya – absolutely fantastic!
I had an amazing experience at I Love Pizza. This is not just another “Italian-style” place — this is the real thing.
The owner is Italian, the products are authentic, and you can taste it immediately.
From the cured meats to the pizza and even the coffee — everything feels like stepping straight into a small trattoria in Italy.
The quality of the ingredients is outstanding, especially the cured meats. You can tell they care deeply about tradition and authenticity. And finally, a place in Pattaya where you can get a proper Italian espresso ☕🇮🇹
Warm atmosphere, real Italian hospitality, and food made with passion.
If you love real Italian food, this place is a must-visit.
A little piece of Italy in the heart of Pattaya — I loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Roberto Pagnotta

sample_reviews_en.text:
UPDATE:CLOSED AS ON END OF MAY 2025. NO SPECIFIC REASON MENTIONED.
across the road from the old location
An excellent suprise this little Italian restaurant a bit off the side of the main tourist attractions, which is good for the tranquility of the customers, pleasant atmosphere and fresh temperature, friendly welcome and service by the waitress, outdoors and indoors seatings, a wide selection of authentic Italian cuisine, pastas of course but also different Italian dishes, mouth watering desserts all at reasonable prices. There's also Italian sausages, hams and cheese on sale at takeaway. Limited but sufficient choice of wines and beers. Clean kitchen and toilets. Very warmly recommended for an Italian experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: One Step at a Time

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu and food was absolutely fantastic! It took us so long to decide what to have, prices were great too with pizzas for less than 260bt!! Pasta dishes were also very reasonably priced - 200-220 baht depending on the dish but you can choose whatever pasta you like too. Can’t recommend enough, if this place was more popular the atmosphere would be a 5/5. Overall the food was unreal and pricing was amazing for some traditional Italian food.
sample_reviews_en.author: T Hamid

sample_reviews_en.text:
I like this place.  I visit on a regular basis for their pizza.  (FYI the place has relocated a few yards from its original location across the road).

Please be aware this a proper Italian pizza with excellent ingredients and bread coming all the way from Italy.

It’s not a nasty budget pizza which can be found in Pattaya and is well worth the money IMPHO.

You get what you pay for!
sample_reviews_en.author: P.O.

sample_reviews_en.text:
A wonderful pizzeria with a very cozy atmosphere. The pizza was incredibly delicious—high-quality ingredients and a truly Italian flavor. The tiramisu was simply magnificent: tender, one of the best I've ever tried.

A special thank you to the friendly Italian owner—you can tell he loves his craft and his guests. I'll definitely be back and highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Алина Король

sample_reviews_en.text: Big thanks Manuel,you made me feel at home..food cooked at the moment,delicious pasta,I tried Amatriciana and was simply amazing..also other courses like starters main and pizza,cozy and pleasant place with very friendly staff...5 stars without doubts...Higly reccomended ,if I will back to Pattaya i will not miss it!!
sample_reviews_en.author: valerio cosentino

sample_reviews_en.text:
A great Italian restaurant.

The pizza was perfect. It was thin crust, had a good amount of topping, and was priced well.

The pasta, although was well presented with a sizable portion, slightly lacked some seasoning. Furthermore, the wrong type of pasta was served.

All in all, a nice place for Italian cravings 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Yawarakai O.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tonight I had Fettuccine paglia e fieno with sausage and mushrooms, a real taste of Italian kitchen, just delicious!
Been here several times, never disappointed. All dishes are made following the original Italian recipes and with quality ingredients.
Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ezio Auditore

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a less sweet matcha smoothie, and my friend had an iced tea. Both were delicious. I sat and worked while I waited, although there weren't any power outlets to charge my phone. I also ordered some toast – one slice with butter and sugar, and another with Nutella. I didn't have high expectations, but the bread was surprisingly good and soft. Overall, this cafe made me feel like a foreign tourist walking around the Wat Bowon area and luckily stumbled upon a great cafe. I'll definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuntawan Nualsri

sample_reviews_en.text:
I like very much the little terrace of this café which is shadowed by plants
I tried the moka oreo frappe... very good and reasonable price (70 Bahts)
Nice cozy atmosphere... the café is small so maybe it can be crowded sometime (I went on Sunday morning and I was the only customer)
The service is ok (not super but ok)
To summarize... a good place to spend some time
sample_reviews_en.author: bartholome pascal

sample_reviews_en.text: An unsweetened iced Americano. The taste is sour first, then bitter. The atmosphere is relaxed, but not ideal for chatting with friends as the space isn't very large. It's suitable for reading or doing something quiet alone. Overall, it's good for enjoying coffee, relaxing, waiting for someone, etc.
sample_reviews_en.author: Juckrit Wongtavilarp

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's right next to where I was sleeping so I popped in for a coffee
The place is small but the design caught my eye right away
Simple but tasteful
I sat outside
It was calm and pleasant
I ordered a coffee
It arrived quickly
The taste is nice, nothing special but it totally does the job
sample_reviews_en.author: reviewer

sample_reviews_en.text: This coffee shop has a nice atmosphere and is a great place to sit. It's located opposite Wat Tritotsathep and next to the Centra by Centara Hotel Bangkok Phra Nakhon. The coffee tastes good, and they also have toast, but I only tried the coffee. The price is reasonable. I liked it.
sample_reviews_en.author: P Panyaphirom

sample_reviews_en.text: A really cute place with super friendly staff! Drinks can be ordered hot or cold, and you can also choose how sweet they are. You can sit either inside the air-conditioned café or outside. The café is a bit small, but it has a lot of charm. We would definitely recommend it.

sample_reviews_en.text: Me and my boyfriend spend some lovely time in this small cafe. He ordered an iced coffee and I got the banana frappe. I loved my drink! It was sweet and refreshing. I really liked the fact that the cafe has air conditioning, it makes it perfect for a break!
sample_reviews_en.author: Vittoria Perinato

sample_reviews_en.text: We stayed at the hotel down the road and really enjoyed our morning coffee trip to Vespa cafe! The staff are friendly and take their time to make delicious coffees, we are from London and this is the best iced coffee drink I’ve had! Thanks ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Stephanie simmonds

sample_reviews_th.text: There weren't many people today, so I decided to try it. It was delicious! It's like a mix of pancakes and roti. The banana and honey with crushed almonds was 30฿; the honey was very fragrant. The chocolate filling was really rich, 25฿.
sample_reviews_th.author: Obayareep

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop, which I've seen frequently on TikTok, is located in Soi Charoen Krung 22. Luckily, there were no people when I went. The lovely vendor recommended both sweet and savory fillings for me. I ordered ham, egg, and cheese with lettuce. The vendor asked me if I wanted vegetables first. Then, she grilled the dough on a pan, added butter, and added the filling of my choice. The portion was just the right size to fill me up. The filling was like a hot sandwich, fragrant with butter and stuffed with filling. The sauce was so moist. I also ordered the chocolate banana, which was sprinkled with nuts. This was also good. The bananas were thinly sliced ​​and full of pieces, going well with the chocolate that was just the right amount of sweet. There was a crunchy texture from the nuts. I was quite impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thaya Aungtananukul

sample_reviews_en.text: I found this shop in a daze when I got out of the car to take a photo at Talad Noi. I saw a long line of people so I stood and remembered that I had seen this shop in a review. I didn't have to wait long. The shop made the food quickly but the quality was good. It was very delicious. One piece was not enough. I really wanted to order ten plain pastries. They were very delicious. The price was not expensive. I was very impressed. Crispy, soft, and fragrant. I still want to eat them. I will go back for more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Babydragonflyz

sample_reviews_en.text: I liked it! Honestly, the taste wasn't incredibly amazing, but it was as good as I expected: easy to eat and affordable. We ordered both of their popular items: banana chocolate and ham, egg, and cheese. Personally, I'd recommend the ham, egg, and cheese one. The bread was warm and soft, the vegetables were fresh, and the cheese was delicious, even though we ate it in 38-degree Celsius weather! 😭 The owner was very nice. 💕
sample_reviews_en.author: Lauren Eatsome

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, worth the price. It's a bread dough that doesn't rise, giving it a roti feel but not as chewy as roti. When eaten with chili paste eggs, it's awesome. Add vegetables too. 1 filling 25, 2 fillings 30. They intentionally wrap each sheet individually, making it super easy to eat. The seller is friendly, not frowning. Standing and watching while they make it is so satisfying. I want to make it too.
sample_reviews_en.author: D S

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small local vendor, run by nice people.
Got chocolate and banana filling for 30 Baht. It was super tasty! not overly sweet.
Their flat bread is like something in-between roti and pancake.

The line can be long as this place went viral on social media many times, but the line moves really fast, I never have to wait long.

Give them a try if you are in Talat noi area. ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: SN S

sample_reviews_en.text: The seller was very friendly and polite. The wait wasn't long, and the portions were generous. They used bananas from 7-Eleven. The banana chocolate sandwich was 30 baht, and the ham, cheese, and egg sandwich was 40 baht – great prices! I overheard the seller saying to a customer, "Come back again!" I really liked that; I've never heard any vendor talk like that before.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mai Chiangmai

sample_reviews_en.text: Such a tasty street food if you are on the go! We came in January and had to come back and visit the stall when we arrived in Bangkok this April. The lady that works there is soo smiley and kind, she really makes it such a nice experience and works so hard. We had both a chocolate banana and egg chilli combination and they were both delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tal Edwards

restaurants.name: Pizzicotto
restaurants.address:

RR Space 1st fl, 593/2 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Roman-style pizza that’s hard to find in Bangkok!
Pizzicotto serves true pizza alla pala, crafted by an Italian chef who really understands the art of Roman-style pizza. The crust is light, crispy, airy, and full of character — exactly how it should be.

There are so many pizza toppings to choose from, ranging from classic Italian favorites to unique signature combinations. Everything is made with fresh, high-quality ingredients, including an impressive variety of hams and cheeses. You can even order cold cuts to enjoy alongside their wine, which makes the experience feel truly Italian.

They also offer excellent vegetarian and vegan pizza options, prepared with the same care and creativity — perfect for anyone looking for delicious plant-friendly choices.

Another highlight is their wide selection of wines by the glass. The choices are surprisingly extensive, and the prices are very affordable, making it easy to pair your pizza or cold cuts with the perfect wine.

If you’re looking for real Italian flavors, premium ingredients, and a warm, enjoyable dining experience, this place is highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Phan Takkavatakarn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pizzicotto is a small Italian restaurant and takeaway run by Cesare, with a simple but very well-chosen menu. They do not try to offer dozens of dishes; instead, they focus on a few authentic Italian specialties and prepare them properly.
You can choose from pizza, a few pasta dishes, salads, beef fillet and beef tartare. The lasagna, in particular, is absolutely delicious and undoubtedly one of the highlights of the menu.
Some restaurants succeed mainly because they are in a great location. Others, like Pizzicotto, deserve to succeed because they combine the quality of the ingredients and the food with the friendliness, passion and availability of the person running the business.
Cesare is always welcoming, attentive and genuinely helpful, making customers feel at home from the moment they arrive.
Pizzicotto is an informal and honest place where the quality of genuine Italian food speaks for itself. Highly recommended, both for dining in and for takeaway.
sample_reviews_en.author: Roberto Pasceri

sample_reviews_en.text:
Quality pizzerias are all over Bangkok but Pizzicotto definitely stands tall among the list for me. The highlight of this quaint spot isn't just the wide variety of Pizza al Taglio (which you'll love every bite of) but also it's customer care that goes the extra mile to ensure you have a wonderful experience here. We tried the Greek Pizza, which wasn't in the prepared selection, but was made fresh for us and absolutely enjoyed it. The Blueberry Tiramisu stood for us as it was light, flavourful and a welcome twist on the original. The owner was also kind enough to offer us a brilliantly made Shakerato(pictured here), claiming that we wouldn't find something like this anywhere else in Bangkok - and he was absolutely right!

While we couldn't photograph the food as we were busy scarfing down the meal, we promise it would be something you'd definitely remember!

Looking forward to many more visits to this lovely restaurant 🍕
sample_reviews_en.author: Aditya Dogra

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hidden on Sukhumvit Road, just a short walk from EM Quartier and Phrom Phong BTS, I discovered a tiny Italian gem that deserves much more attention.

My first visit was actually at breakfast time — I tried their croissants with a cappuccino… and they were so good I ended up having two. That experience convinced me to come back the next day for dinner.

This time I went all in: Four Cheese Pizza, Nduja Pizza, and Burrata with Parma ham. The flavors were authentic, rich, and genuinely Italian — the kind of quality you don’t easily find.

The place is small and simple, so I didn’t expect much at first. But after being impressed by the food, I returned once more and tried the tenderloin tartare — fresh, delicate, and excellent.

If you’re around Phrom Phong and craving real Italian taste, this little spot is absolutely worth a visit. I’ll definitely be back whenever I’m in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrea Sciortino

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem in Bangkok! The pizza is absolutely delicious — not the typical round pizza, but the traditional rectangular Italian-style pizza (pizza al taglio). Every slice is generously topped with high-quality prosciutto, and you can really taste the freshness of the ingredients.

The passion fruit tiramisu is outstanding — honestly the best tiramisu I’ve had in Bangkok. Everything tastes natural, authentic, and made with excellent ingredients.

The owner is a very friendly Italian who clearly cares about the quality of the food and the overall experience. If you’re looking for genuine Italian flavors in Bangkok, this place is definitely worth a visit. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anya

sample_reviews_en.text: A small but truly excellent Italian pizza restaurant. The food is outstanding, featuring a thin, crispy crust, fresh and delicious tomato sauce, and tasty toppings. It is easily one of the best pizzas I’ve had here in Bangkok. The staff are incredibly friendly; the owner even provided a complimentary amuse-bouche. Highly recommended for a quick pizza—it is absolutely delicious! It is less suitable for a romantic, candlelit evening for two, as this fine establishment features high tables rather than that kind of setting, but it delivers on every other front. Thumbs up for those who prioritize quality and delicious food over a fancy atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steven-MUC

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ventured here and happened to meet the owner, Cesar, who was a very kind dude.

As a New Yorker, my pizza standards are high + specific. With that said, the Roma-style pizza here was solid. It is more thick / bread-heavy than I prefer, and I would've appreciated more sauce + toppings, but it definitely is an authentic pizzeria.

I took advantage of their promotion - free soft drink or can of Leo with two slices - and got the margherita (120 thb) and a diavola (150 thb) alongside a coke zero. They take credit card, which I appreciate tremendously, and the prices are net. Can definitely envision myself coming back here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anish Thakkar (Doc Thakkar)

sample_reviews_en.text: Top sour dough. I'd prefer it even more crispy. Decent tomato sauce, but the Thai "mozzarella" doesn't work. It is too far away from mozzarella. It has no flavor and should be replaced with something that adds something to the dish (Margerita in my case) Also, the Foccachia was completely covered with this cheese, nothing I've never seen in Italy. An absolutely highlight was the AMAZING red wine by the glass. I loved it. Please let me know if you replace the mozzarella and I will edit the review. UPDATE AFTER RESPONSE FROM OWNER: Thank you, I should definitely give the other mozzarella a try :)

exotic and homey decoration

sample_reviews_en.text: I highly recommend this restaurant! I found it by accident when I was visiting my friend Jeab at her house and we wanted Italian food. I searched Google Maps for "Italian restaurants near me," and the reviews said the food was incredibly delicious – like, super amazing! I was like, "We have to try it!" It was a really hidden gem; Jeab was confused about where I was taking her. When we got inside, we were surprised to find no one there. After a while, the owner came out to greet us. We ordered three dishes, and everything was delicious! The truffle dish was perfect – not at all cloying. The cake was also amazing. I can't even begin to describe how delicious everything was; we finished every single dish! The owners were incredibly attentive and the restaurant is run by just the two of them. The atmosphere is super cute and homie, with cute animals and rare plants. We were so happy! 🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Noon Suchanya

sample_reviews_en.text:
A literal hidden gem! Wish I'd found this place sooner!

They serve a variety of uniquely flavoured gelatos - we tried the salted caramel popcorn and panna cotta - and it was one of the most vibrant gelatos we've ever tasted.
The aglio olio was simply out of this world, a basic but must try dish for anyone visiting.

The restaurant is run by 2 super friendly chefs, who've done a great job decorating the garden with lots various exotic trees - a baobub! - and exotic animals e.g. meetkats, which I assume most people wouldn't expect to see one here.

The gives off an omakase-like vibe, but more like eating over at a friend's place once you get to know the chefs.

Would definitely visit again and again and again.
sample_reviews_en.author: S. Chaunchaiyakul

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there because my senior recommended it, saying I absolutely had to try it and that I would love it, along with all the descriptions. Once I actually went in, I have to say it exceeded all the words my senior described. The atmosphere and the feeling were amazing; you could feel the care and attention put into every detail. Every tree and every arrangement showed genuine love and passion. Just seeing the 18-year-old Baobab tree was more than worth it. And most importantly, the owner (P' Em) is incredibly lovely, loves plants and animals, and we chatted so much we lost track of time. Thank you for creating such a special place. I will definitely be back! 🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: Pound dnuoP

sample_reviews_en.text: Came here because of words of mouth of how good Gelato here is and ended up super impressed with how wonderful the food is. Salad is fresh..dressing is homemade and really good! Salmon is crispy on the skin while meat is juicy and tender. NZ ribeye steak is perfectly cooked to medium rare as requested. Gravy is tasty and very well balanced. Truffle tortellini is DELICIOUS!   And Almond espresso gelato is a perfect cherry on top. Aromatic,bold but smooth! I 100% recommend this place 🤌👌
sample_reviews_en.author: Chad Jariya

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious! The pasta dishes were amazing, and the homemade salad dressing was incredibly tasty. The gelato ice cream was also delicious, and the layered chocolate cake with soft cream was fantastic. The owner cooks and bakes the cakes herself. If you like a shady, tree-filled place, I highly recommend it. There's an air-conditioned room and outdoor seating to enjoy the trees.
If you go on a Saturday or Sunday, call to reserve a table.
sample_reviews_en.author: OrangZomSom

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was incredibly delicious and perfectly suited my taste. I love this type of food, and I also love the smoothies. The cake was amazing, so soft and smooth. The gelato is the best for me; I love so many flavors! The owner provides excellent service. I'll definitely be back again to try all the gelato flavors they have! 😻 I highly recommend it; you'll be hooked! 💗 It's so relaxing and refreshing, it's like a true healer.

sample_reviews_en.text: I took my beloved girlfriend to lunch at this restaurant. The atmosphere inside the restaurant made me feel relaxed. The staff and the owner were very friendly, very skillful, and recommended the menu. It made the atmosphere feel like I was home with my family. And most importantly, the gelato best of the delicious. If you have never been to take your lover, you will not be disappointed in your decision.

Affordable prices, highly recommended, you absolutely must try it!

If you come early, they even have karaoke, but you have to arrive before 9 PM because the main kitchen closes at that time. After that, only snacks will be available. The taste is good and the prices are reasonable.

Price: 5/5

sample_reviews_en.text: I just stopped by for breakfast because it was next to the hotel, but the staff are friendly and the food is delicious. I ordered orange juice, and it was great because it had pulp in it, just like at Tipsamai! I had the 59-baht pork fried rice, and it was really tasty! The 129-baht Pad Thai on the first page of the menu also had four plump shrimp in it, and it tasted better than Tipsamai. Why would anyone even go to Tipsamai?
sample_reviews_en.author: 설순

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good food, nothing special but good enough and you can't get anything at that price so overall quite good. Lemon tea was really nice and fresh! I would definitely buy again.

I could hardly believe it. And it's not a rundown looking place either. It's just a block away from a lot of the touristy stuff but much cheaper. I'll probably eat here again before I leave Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gregory Tertichny

sample_reviews_en.text: Great food! We were adventurous and tried a couple new items (the naem fried rice includes a fermented raw traditional thai sausage and the pranakorn pad thai includes dehydrated shrimp). Definitely out of our comfort zone but still tasted good. The chicken fried rice was a safe and tasty option! Affordable for the area too.

sample_reviews_en.text:

Ordered shrimp fried rice and seafood tomorrow yum. It was so good, feels like a home cooked meal.

Staff were kind, friendly, and attentive. Will definitely visit again before flying back!!

sample_reviews_en.text: Hi guys, we've spent several evenings here for dinner. The food is simple and good, the service is perfect, and the prices are reasonable. It's an intimate place with a great atmosphere. One evening, we were invited to sing karaoke. Highly recommended.

168 Charan Sanit Wong Rd, Bang O, Bang Phlat, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food at this restaurant is delicious and not too expensive, but the staff weren't very attentive to customers. Perhaps it was because we were dressed casually? They served rice in a bowl without a serving spoon, and the Tom Yum soup came in a hot pot without a ladle. They also didn't serve all the dishes we ordered, which was a bit disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noonat Bumbim

sample_reviews_en.text: The place is not maintained. Kinda old. It's Thai restaurant with a great ambiance near the river. Sheep is no where to be seen but they have cute rabbits. Tasty food with reasonable price. Better to come before 5pm for a good music. It has an outdoor and indoor seating. A good place to chill with your friends, family and kids.
sample_reviews_en.author: MsGlessy

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice atmosphere. Cool breeze off the river, live music & excellent food. Only complaint which seems to be the norm in Thailand is that they stand there, wanting to take your order before you're even seated let alone any chance to browse the menu. (No English menu). A minor irritant & we well definitely return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stuart MacKenzie

sample_reviews_en.text: I wouldn't even give it one star. I don't know if the staff didn't hear me or what, but I called them over, they made eye contact, walked around, but didn't respond. The food took forever. I finished three dishes, and the fried rice still hadn't arrived after an hour. The review said the water was tasty though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lapatrada Mincharoen

sample_reviews_en.text: Enter via Soi Charansanitwong 86/1. The restaurant is located on the banks of the Chao Phraya River. The restaurant is spacious and has several zones. The atmosphere is good. Sit and relax in the evening. The food is delicious and the price is reasonable. The staff provides excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Su

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is large and spacious with ample parking. It can accommodate a large number of guests, so much so that the staff may not be able to provide service as efficiently as they should. The atmosphere is pleasant, with a riverside view and a view of the Parliament building.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aphicha Yoosomboon

sample_reviews_en.text: This place looks amazing with a nice view. Sadly it was very quiet when we came here, might be because it was a weekday. Dont expect to see sheeps around, they might have become dishes... If you like a quiet place to hang around with food and drinks, this is a great place to go.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jun Hui

sample_reviews_en.text: The nearby MRT station is not ready Dec '19. It's a single restaurant & open air by the river. Good for families & couples, it's a little out of the way, for those not driving, you need to walk out of the lane to main road to catch a taxi as it's a dead end lane.
sample_reviews_en.author: D. lee

restaurants.name: ครัวริมโมงค์
restaurants.address:

245 Phatthanakan 25, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: A fantastic dining experience at ครัวริมโมงค์! We ordered steamed fish, tofu, grilled prawns, spicy cashews, and chicken with rice. Every dish was delicious, fresh, and packed with authentic flavors. Be warned—the spice level is seriously intense 🌶️🔥, extra extra hot just the way we like it! The staff were extremely friendly, energetic, and attentive, making the whole experience even more enjoyable. Great food, great service, and a lively atmosphere. Highly recommended for anyone who loves bold and spicy Thai food. We’ll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_th.author: Mukesh Lalwani

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the portions were appropriate for the price, but the salmon sashimi was thawed frozen salmon, which wasn't fresh. This should have been disclosed to customers beforehand. There were a few mosquitoes. The atmosphere was nice with pleasant, non-noisy music, and the staff were lovely and friendly. The Thai papaya salad with salted egg and the sour curry were especially delicious ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: ปนัดดา

sample_reviews_en.text:
🥗 The food tastes great. The papaya salad is amazing and the grilled meat is fantastic.
✨ The restaurant atmosphere is great, situated under big trees, very chill vibes.
There are large fans to keep you cool and also ward off mosquitoes.
🚙 There is parking behind the restaurant.

(But there are always vendors selling things like peanuts, milk, cakes, and pudding.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Lilly

sample_reviews_en.text: The food used to be much tastier and spicier. We're not sure if they changed cooks or what. We ate there in the afternoon in April 2019. We're not sure if the cook is still there in the evening, but the food wasn't as spicy as usual. The papaya salad, tom yum soup, and tom khlong soup weren't very spicy at all. It wasn't terrible though, just edible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patcharin Jenjai (GAPPER)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there after being invited by a Thai friend.

The restaurant was located on the street, and I was the only Japanese person there.

The food was authentic Thai cuisine, and many dishes were very spicy. As someone who loves Thai food, it was a great restaurant for me.

However, access is a bit difficult as there is no public transportation.
sample_reviews_en.author: 岐阜・台湾・タイなどのグルメ紹介Mochichi

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the service was good, but the peanut vendor was too persistent. It would be better if the restaurant didn't allow him to sell there. The first person who came was fine, but before I could even finish my dish, another one arrived. The second person, after politely saying no three times, still wouldn't leave...
sample_reviews_en.author: ยูทูป พรีเมียร์

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was fantastic, but many dogs and cats, couple of dogs growled at us when we came in and dogs mating while having dinner gave us a good laugh,

Food was fantastic,  but we were hassled by people all night, did wreck the atmosphere and made us annoyed as we just wanted to eat, talk and enjoy, not be hasles all dinner
sample_reviews_en.author: Simon & Heidi FOLLOW US

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and served very quickly. The atmosphere was great, with seating in traditional Isaan-style huts. The staff were attentive, quick, and efficient; they even came over just by being made eye contact. I recommend the clear tom yum soup with catfish; it's spicy and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dear Tanatchaya

restaurants.name: Tim Dumpling
restaurants.address:

452 ถ. เจริญกรุง เเขวงสัมพันธวงศ์, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I had No. A9 , No. N6 and No. D5 for lunch. It was cost only 189฿.
Roasted pork rice is very nice for people who can’t eat spicy. No. N6 is for people who like tomyum or something which is mixed with spicy & sour. It’s good too.

It was a little bit hot after eating hot meals.

After having lunch I recommend to vist Wat Mangkon (Chinese Temple). Good for photo shoot.
sample_reviews_th.author: Mei

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, I specifically went to this restaurant. I walked in and sat down at a table. While waiting for a waiter, I felt something hard poke me in the back. I turned around and saw a male employee holding a menu, but the menu had accidentally poked me in the back. He didn't apologize, just put the menu down without saying a word, had a grumpy expression, and walked away. When my friend and I tried to order, another employee came over. My friend had ordered Tom Yum noodles with broth and then asked to change it to dry noodles right then and there. The employee was still standing at the table, but he said, "It's not possible, it's already been ordered." He spoke curtly, without any politeness, and had an unwelcoming expression. Then he walked away. I wonder if they even train their staff in manners? And I'm also curious about why a customer asked to change to dry noodles while the employee was still standing at the table, but they couldn't?
sample_reviews_en.author: GOLF NAKA

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tim's Dumpling at China Town, Junction Thanon Mansion offers a wide variety of noodle dishes with delicious toppings. The taste of the food is exceptional, with flavors that surpass expectations. The noodles are cooked perfectly, and the toppings complement them beautifully. Whether you prefer spicy, savory, or mild flavors, Tim's Dumpling has something for everyone.

Not only is the food delicious, but it also offers great value for money. The portion sizes are generous, ensuring satisfaction, and the prices are reasonable considering the quality and quantity of food served.

Overall, dining at Tim's Dumpling is a delightful experience for noodle lovers. With its diverse selection of noodles, flavorful dishes, and good value, it's a must-visit in China Town, Junction Thanon Mansion. Don't miss the opportunity to tantalize your taste buds at Tim's Dumpling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Theng Seng Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff at the restaurant provided very poor service. There was no service-minded attitude or friendliness toward customers. The overall management was also disappointing the staff appeared unmotivated and uninterested in their work. When it came time to pay, instead of assisting, they made customers walk over to them to settle the bill, showing a clear lack of proper service.

If I were the employer, I would feel very disappointed with this level of service.

As for the food, the portion size was extremely small compared to the price. At 80-100THB per bowl, the noodles were barely enough just a few bites and it was gone. Compared to other nearby restaurants, this place offers significantly less food for the same or even higher price, which does not justify the cost at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chompoopink

sample_reviews_en.text:
The dumplings are delicious and large, with a moderate portion size. Men might need two bowls. It's one of the few places where I like the taste of their dumplings so much that I've made a note of it. I wish they'd add a little more noodles; that would make it perfect. Overall, it's delicious, and I think I'll go back if I visit the temple again. The dumplings with spicy dressing are crispy and tasty. Those who like a tangy and strong flavor will probably enjoy it. I ordered the mixed pork platter because I wanted to try several things. The price is reasonable.

I went at lunchtime and saw there were still seats available, so I tried eating in. However, a few minutes later, a line of about 3-4 families were waiting for tables. I was very lucky to get a table before them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alisara Kach

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is one on my list to visit in Thailand.    It’s easy to find and very close to the subway station(Wat Mongkon station) just a few minutes walking distance.

We were not sure about the giant plate that we wanted to try so we asked one lady then she said yes. We guess she is one of the owner, no time to chat much because they are very busy. All staffs there seem nice and friendly, there are couple of them who speak English very well. Big score from me to their management.

We got the table and order the giant plate plus some snack plates. They all are very delish! The crispy wonton is our favorite. The service is great and fast!

After our shopping we came back for another plate. Two times in a day :P And we will be back on our next trip for sure!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kay N. A.

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere on the street corner is nice, with a good view. The restaurant has plenty of tables and isn't crowded. The staff are friendly and don't pressure you while you're choosing your food. I tried their recommended dish, Szechuan-style spicy noodles – and wow, it was delicious! The flavor was strong, with a tangy kick and a spicy kick. The meatballs were firm and not starchy, and the thick, crispy wontons were a perfect match. The blanched vegetables were tossed with fragrant sesame oil. At first, I thought the broth would be like any other, but it had a unique, indescribable Chinese aroma – I can't quite pinpoint the herbs.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณรัญภัช ใจชอบ

sample_reviews_en.text: Every time I go to Wat Leng Neiy Yi, I always stop by this place on the way back. It's delicious; the dumplings are big and filling, with a well-balanced flavor. The shop is on a street corner, there's no parking, and there are only a few tables inside. They accept cash and QR code payments. The staff are polite, courteous, and provide good service. The prices are reasonable. You should definitely give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ruechaphon Rakpong

restaurants.name: Pizza Hut
restaurants.address:

19/106 หมู่ที่ 5, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⚠️ Attention guys!
💪🏻I ordered three medium (M) size pizzas here - two on sale and separately.
👌🏻And they delivered three 17cm pizzas!
🙀These are the smallest pizzas I have ever seen in my life.
💰But their cost is like a full-fledged medium (M) pizza!
😅 I have no idea how big their small (S) pizzas are.
🤢As for the taste - it's a complete disappointment, as if they use mayonnaise instead of cheese.  It's like a cheap canteen pizza.
🙊 By the way, no one speaks English on the phone.
🔍 On the site you will also not be able to find any information about the size of the pizza.
⛔️ To sum up, the pizza hut in Thailand is very, very bad!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kir Tenn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Natural Date Bliss
🚩 Made with 100% natural ingredients.
🚩 Sweetened with dates.
🚩 Made with rich, creamy fats from almonds.
🚩 Made with plant-based and fruit proteins.
🚩 Uses a variety of health-beneficial ingredients to enhance the flavor of these flourless cookies 😋
These almond cookies are made without wheat flour, butter, or crisping agents. The almond flour makes the cookies crispy on their own, not hard.
sample_reviews_en.author: วรัชยา งามขํา

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited this Pizza Hut at PTT Service station on Sukhumvit Road, Pattaya.
Was told I would have to wait 100 minutes for my order.
Obviously wasn’t going to wait that long.
Just left.
Seems badly run if they are unable to cope.
Can you imagine visiting any other restaurant and being told your food will arrive in 1 hour 40 minutes?
Pizza Hut management where are you???
sample_reviews_en.author: Alastair

sample_reviews_en.text: Friendly and fast...No restrooms, limited parking for automobiles, but motorcycles no problem. Our waitress spoke and understood English and was very helpful.  Fourteen (14) tables and two high chairs for small children. So you have seating for twenty eight (28). Good location for most on the dark side. 500 meters from the Bypass on Noen Plubwan. Free WiFi
sample_reviews_en.author: Rocky Skaggs

sample_reviews_en.text: Don't go there! A bunch of monkies working in a pizza shop. Dropping their knives and tools on the floor then continue cutting. Waited 55 min. for a pizza that was going to take 20 min. turned out they had not even started making it. There are 15 people running in circles doing nothing. Never going back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lasse Olsen

sample_reviews_en.text: The pizza tasted as it should and it was perfectly fine to eat there. It was probably a takeaway restaurant but there were a few tables so it was perfectly fine to eat there. They didn't have plates or regular steel cutlery, but disposable cups and disposable plastic cutlery worked just fine. 🍕🙂🍕 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Steinar Møllerop Nordbø

sample_reviews_en.text: Please keep the tables clean. When I sat down to eat, there were still food scraps all over the table. The atmosphere was okay, and the staff should smile more often. I don't know where the staff are rushing to. The people in line behind me were walking like rockets, so I couldn't really keep up.
sample_reviews_en.author: blackdog moka

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is up to Pizza Hut's standards. Suitable for take-away. There are few seats, not suitable for sitting in the shop. I like this branch because they often have promotions (other branches don't). The downside is that parking is difficult. There is only motorcycle parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stk Runig

restaurants.name: Hikiniku To Come (Central Park)
restaurants.address:

5th floor Zone C, 946 Rama IV Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: A great dining experience for about 750 Baht for a set meal. When you get to level 5 of the mall come  to the quiet end and you will find the restaurant. Your experience starts at the ordering terminal (only 1 and I can see this as a problem when it busy as the ordering has many options not easily understood). Then you get a ticket and you are seated at any of the open bar type counter seating where you face the grill in the center where all the patties are grilled.  They will explain to you the dining ritual or give you a piece of paper that explains it.  With the set meal you get 3 each perfectly grilled hamburg placed in front of your to enjoy.  They come one at a time.  For each piece there advice a way to enjoy it with several condiments.  Take your time and savor each piece.  No need to hurry.  Each bite is an umami bomb.  I suggest coming closer to closing time (they close at 930 and I came at 9 and they gave me an hour to enjoy the ritual). Well worth it and definitely an IG moment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joey C.

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Phenomenal Dining Experience – Absolutely Worth the Wait!
I had an incredible meal at the new Central Park branch on the 5th floor. The concept here is brilliantly simple but executed to perfection. You get three freshly grilled, juicy wagyu beef patties served one by one straight from the charcoal grill to your individual station.
Each patty is packed with rich, smoky flavor and stays perfectly hot. Pairing the meat with their free-flowing, fluffy rice (cooked in traditional pots) and a fresh raw egg yolk creates the ultimate comfort food bite. They also provide a great variety of homemade condiments and sauces, allowing you to customize every single mouthful.
The service was fast, friendly, and attentive. The queuing system requires some patience and do not flow logically (we got 289/290 but 298/299 were admitted earlier).
But for food this high-quality and an atmosphere this immersive, it is 100% worth it. I will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Edwin Goh

sample_reviews_en.text: The wait can be long during peak times. You get a number, wait to be called, order the food, wait again for a free seat. There’s only one set menu (side dishes available too) so it’s pretty straightforward. I opted out of the extra sauce as they have different condiments on the table. Quality rice (unlimited refill) and miso soup comes with the set menu (3x90 grams beef). The beef was juicy and tender. The restaurant is loud and not a place to linger. Basically eat and leave, especially if there’s a line. Seats weren’t made to be comfortable. There’s a paper in the drawer that explains how to enjoy the meal and the various condiments offered. I found in the 2 branches I visited, the staff were rather abrupt and rushed in explanations on the ordering issue and    the dishes. I understand we are in Thailand but there are non Thais and tourists who visit the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: RMz

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were there on the less busy day. There were only 5 queues ahead of us but seating took longer than expected.

For the food wise, Am I the only one who thought the meat and rice was just average? There is nothing special about it
Most overrated place and overhyped in my opinion.

The restaurant vibe was overwhelming, I feel rushed from very beginning till the ending of the meal. There were no relaxed moments and not to mention that the background music was too loud. It was hard to hear what was staff saying or even talking to your friends.

The entire restaurant was filled a lot of smoke; the exhaust fan was practically useless. The whole dining experience felt like my lungs were screaming fresh air for entire time.

The service was great. Staff were very friendly, nice and efficient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noey Natnaree T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is good and definitely worth the price. The burger is tender, freshly cooked, and grilled right in front of you.
One thing I didn't like was the staff member taking orders at the reception. She seemed to be in a hurry even though it wasn't busy and there was no queue. Instead of explaining the menu, she focused on upselling. I think it would have been more helpful if she had informed customers about all the sauces available and explained the optional add-on sauces they offer.

I ordered both signature sauces she recommended, but I actually found the sauces already available on the table to be much more delicious.

Overall, it was still a good experience, and I'd definitely come back for the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fritzie M.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a popular restaurant that hamburger lovers should definitely visit at least once, and I finally went! The long lines had kept me from going until now.

The charcoal-grilled hamburger, cooked right in front of you, is crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside. You can really taste the natural flavor of the meat, and it pairs perfectly with rice.

The freshly cooked rice is also delicious, and they serve it little by little, which is a nice touch!

I liked the hamburger with grated daikon radish the best.

It's a truly satisfying restaurant where the quality of the ingredients shines through because of its simplicity.
sample_reviews_en.author: 近藤かおり

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the nicer Hamburg places in Bangkok - pretty nice atmosphere, their only menu offering is their 3-hamburg-pieces sets which come with radish alongside the 2nd and fresh Japanese egg yolk for the 3rd piece.

The only availabe customisation is kimchi and/or their special sauces, though the default ones are already good enough for me (+ you can get free pickled vegetables anyway at your table). You can also get your rice refills if you need more.

Staffs are very informative and attentive - you paid for your order upfront before sitting down at the table/counter, and yes, they accept cards as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panpakorn Siripanich

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tried this Japanese beef spot because everyone’s talking about it—and yeah, I get the hype. The place has a strong vibe, very trendy, and the presentation makes everything feel premium. The beef itself is definitely good—tender, flavorful, melts nicely—but honestly, it’s not mind-blowing.
For the price, I expected something unforgettable. Instead, it feels like you’re paying a lot for the atmosphere and the trend more than the actual experience. Don’t get me wrong, it’s delicious and worth trying once, but it doesn’t quite justify the cost.
Good for the vibe, not for the value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sam Danesh

restaurants.name: ตำมัง Tammang Sathorn-Charoenraj Isaan Vegan
restaurants.address:

3641, 10 Charoen Rat Rd, Bang Khlo, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dining at Tammang was honestly one of those rare experiences where expectations get quietly exceeded without trying too hard. It’s listed in the Michelin Guide, but the vibe is refreshingly simple — no pretentiousness, just seriously good food.
What makes it stand out is how confidently it sticks to being 100% plant-based while still delivering the bold, punchy flavours Thai cuisine is known for. You don’t feel like anything is “missing” — if anything, the creativity in replacing traditional ingredients (like fish sauce with fermented soy) adds a whole new layer of depth. �
Michelin Guide
The dishes are vibrant, spicy when you want them to be, and incredibly satisfying. You can tell everything is made fresh — there’s this raw, almost street-style energy coming from the kitchen that keeps it grounded and authentic.
And the biggest surprise? The price. For a Michelin Guide–recognized place, it’s ridiculously affordable. You walk in expecting a splurge and walk out wondering how it cost so little.
Overall, it’s the kind of place that proves great food doesn’t need to be expensive, complicated, or exclusive. Just honest flavors, done right.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krishang Agarwal

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything we ordered was incredibly delicious! The mild-spicy papaya salad was flavorful and well-balanced, even as vegan as the regular version. The grilled squid (with oyster mushrooms) was amazing, especially with the seafood dipping sauce; it had a lovely smoky aroma and a nice crunchy texture. The crab curry with rice noodles was superb – perfectly seasoned and just the right amount of spiciness. The tapioca pudding with pork filling was sweet and tasty. In short, everything was delicious. We'll definitely be back and want to try other dishes!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattawadee Vee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The menu offers a diverse selection of hard-to-find dishes. Overall, the taste is good. What could be improved is a more flavorful use of ingredients, but not so salty, and a more umami flavor typical of Northeastern Thai cuisine.
The service was excellent. The staff were efficient and polite.
The overall atmosphere of the restaurant is okay, but it's a bit echoey. If someone speaks loudly, it can feel quite noisy. However, I appreciate the restaurant's attentiveness and willingness to ask for customer feedback, which is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sutapatr Tangstitporn

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, and the male staff member provided excellent service and recommendations. There's a wide variety of Northeastern Thai dishes on the menu. I personally loved the grilled chicken rice with the spicy dipping sauce. It would be even better if they added more rice dishes and single-serving meals to the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mind Mimi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious! It was a very enjoyable vegetarian meal. Every dish, from savory to sweet, was amazing. I was so impressed, everything was so good I didn't even have time to take photos! 😅
The menu is diverse.
Parking is available on the street.
The atmosphere is nice, air-conditioned, and they play pleasant music.
sample_reviews_en.author: SMEs Product Champions

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, flavorful, spicy, and amazing—far beyond vegan! Recommended dishes: Glass noodle salad, corn salad, Luang Prabang style papaya salad, mushroom curry, sun-dried squid (vegetarian), fried spring rolls, and incredibly soft sticky rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploymont Meechai

sample_reviews_en.text: The eel curry was delicious, just like regular food. But the sweet vegetable curry with ant eggs wasn't quite right. I think job's tears don't really go well with curry; they're more suited to desserts. The spicy beef soup was also very tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirisart Siriyotha

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was flavourful and satisfying, with a good variety of options to choose from. Some dishes leaned slightly on the sweeter side, but overall still enjoyable. Many of the dishes are based on soy protein, which gives a hearty, filling …
sample_reviews_en.author: NATTHA PODOK

restaurants.name: Yuzu Suki ゆずすき - Ari
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 82/1 Soi Phahon Yothin 5, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: High quality of foods and ingredients.  Great service from staff that spent time to explain menu and to check feedback.  We ordered a yuzu ramen and a staff asked for any improvement as ramen menu has just launch and sold for 40 days.  Frankly it’s a two separate different taste of yuzu and ramen broth, but after 3-4 took I liked it 😀. We didn’t order any meat set as we were full from our dinner so just wanted something light and focus only on dessert.  The suki soup I chose tofu and it was so good.  Overall I think foods came in small portion and salty-led taste even fried garlic rice but we really like their desserts…so good!
sample_reviews_en.author: Montruethai Keereerat

sample_reviews_en.text: First time trying this branch and was very impressed. We went around 4pm so there weren't any other customers and the restrooms were being cleaned. However, the staff were welcoming and very attentive. The shop is nicely decorated, shady, and has plenty of parking. The food is delicious like other branches. However, this shop doesn't have a small pot for each person (as far as I can see). If you come alone, you'll get a big pot. The staff helped scoop the foam out of the soup and also packed the leftovers to take home without me asking. I'll definitely go back and support you again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna Fhaumnuaypol

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall, the restaurant is good quality. I hope you don't encounter the same staff member as me (the young woman who charged and served, also took orders, spoke in a tone that seemed disrespectful to customers, like she was tired or annoyed).

⭐️Good Taste
⭐️Clean restaurant

⭐️Good taste
⭐️Cleanness inside and out

But I would recommend this place to my friends because the food is good. They probably won't be as unlucky as I was, lol. (The atmosphere is ruined by one person. Poor owner.)
1. Wrong bill
2. Bad mood 😭

Recommended, but good luck to you for the service 🥹
sample_reviews_en.author: GoWentWhy

sample_reviews_en.text: The service at this restaurant was terrible. When we stood at the entrance, no one greeted us. Later, when we wanted to order more food, a staff member took our order, but the food never arrived, even after the restaurant closed. In the end, they simply told us that the last order had already ended. We were forced to leave without having enough to eat. It was a very disappointing experience. I hope the owner sees this review and improves service management.👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Danny Xu

sample_reviews_en.text: Good atmosphere, good quality food, but the dried fish soup is a bit salty. The set menu is good value for money, reasonable price, and there is parking available. Both set menus and a la carte are recommended. The staff provided good service. On the day I went, it was raining, so I brought an umbrella to pick up at the car.
sample_reviews_en.author: Have a good day

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is my ramen treat restaurant. The dishes are on the pricier side (most higher-end ramen in Bangkok is) but the serving portions are good and the flavour is great. If you dine in there's a good selection of condiments on the table and the atmosphere is nice. They'll also serve a small bowl of complimentary edamame
sample_reviews_en.author: CT

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was of excellent quality, with fresh ingredients and well-balanced flavors. Each dish was carefully prepared and beautifully presented. Overall, it was a very satisfying dining experience, and I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for great food
sample_reviews_en.author: Trisaporn khumsap

sample_reviews_en.text: The ramen tasted okay, and the price was very good. The A5 Wagyu beef I ordered was incredibly delicious, absolutely amazing! The staff provided excellent service; they were polite and offered good service. The location is great, with parking available. 🤩
sample_reviews_en.author: ผักในสวน
