restaurants.name: Pathe
restaurants.address:

พลับพลา 337 Lat Phrao 94 Alley, Khwaeng Phlabphla, Khet Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A friend invited me to this restaurant because of the beef menu. I don't usually eat beef, so I don't remember it, but I took a picture.
The savory food was okay, but I wasn't particularly impressed with any of the special dishes. This branch doesn't have the "Jum Brah" (jum brah) I wanted to try. I've been to the Kasetsart branch before, and this branch only has S&P desserts like "ruby in coconut milk" and "taro dumplings" (which I usually don't like, because they're sweet).

⭐Cleanliness is okay.
⭐Service: The staff are attentive, always checking in and refilling.
⭐Food tastes okay, but I wasn't impressed.
⭐Decoration and atmosphere inside the restaurant are probably okay, but I sat outside because I brought some pork. The outside didn't look very inviting.
⭐️The restroom is okay, but it's far from the women's area. It's next to the back parking lot, and it's very dark.
⭐️Parking: There's a decent amount of space.
⭐Overall: Average, but not edible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nat Poratip

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pateh Town in Town restaurant has a great atmosphere and delicious food. There's ample parking at the back. Overall, it was a good and impressive experience.

I participated in the MotoGP 2023 cheering event. It was a lot of fun and I was very impressed with the race at this track. I'm happy that Pecco won the championship again this year. It was fantastic.

Congratulations to the 2023 MotoGP World Champion - Francesco Bagnaia🏆

#ValenciaGP A glimpse of the fierce competition at the final race in Spain - Francesco Bagnaia secured the victory and the 2023 MotoGP World Championship.

#DucatiThailand #ForzaDucati #DucatiLenovoTeam #TeamPecco #BACK2BACKgnaia #MotoGP #Champion
sample_reviews_en.author: อังเคิลเสือเอก (อาจารย์เสือ)

sample_reviews_en.text:
When I didn't order alcohol or beer, they made a face. Next time, they could have just said they don't serve people who just want to eat regular food.
The taste wasn't that great either. The sour curry (it tasted bland, like they forgot to add curry paste).
I ordered it by the pot. The menu clearly stated it was sold by the pot (but the staff kept emphasizing that it was sold by the pot!?). That's disrespectful to the customer. Why did they have to ask? I can pay the 10% service charge normally, but with this kind of service, this is my only visit. End of review...
sample_reviews_en.author: Porntep yindeeamornchai (Fight)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This famous chilled beer bar near Lat Phrao Intersection has expanded to the Ramkhamhaeng area. The food is just as delicious as before. This time, I ordered their signature "Hao Dong" (spicy stir-fried chicken) dish, and it was quite good. This branch wasn't too crowded, making it comfortable and relaxing. The staff provided excellent service. When checking out, they even offered a complimentary cup of hot tea.

Price: 5/5
Quality: 5/5
Taste: 5/5
Cleanliness: 5/5
Speed: 4/5
Service: 5/5
Location: 5/5
Value for money: 5/5
sample_reviews_en.author: Akapatr Chiraarreebutr

sample_reviews_en.text: Restaurant tax 7% plus 10% service charge. Having a beer is a great idea; it goes well with the very salty chicken wings. The food was decent, not bad, but the portions were a bit small. Three dishes for two of us, and we were still hungry, cost 660 THB including two Coke Zeros. A nice restaurant for Bangkok, ideal for groups. This restaurant is a nod to Route 66 in the southern USA. Courteous staff, fair prices, 20% above average in the area. Several photos are available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michel Lamer

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice environment for drinking beer and hanging out with friends 👍👍
The beer here is served in frozen cups, so its always cold, and waiters come and change the cups often👍
The service here is pretty good, but i think the taste of the food just average.

Overall, its a nice place to have beer, next time I will come back just for the beer.
The price is kind of expensive, they also charge an extra 17% for service and VAT.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sabrina Wu

sample_reviews_en.text:
They're so good at chasing customers away, and so quick too!
It's a bar/restaurant, so they're usually lenient.
They let customers order the beer promotion because they just arrived.

They wanted them to order, so they did.

But when there were only a few customers left,
they just started taking the plates away.
Uh... that's way too much.
(They took the plates from their hands at 11:37 PM.)

I'm never coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: NaTt T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place impressed me so much. It's incredibly chill, the decor is so beautiful I'd want to decorate my house! The music is great, it feels like I've been transported back to World War II.

Another thing that impressed me was the beer glasses. They were ice-cold, and if the ice wasn't right, they'd change the glass for me. If you like beer, I highly recommend checking this place out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Attanop B

restaurants.name: Umenohana Restaurant Solaria Hotel
restaurants.address:

2nd Floor, No. 1 Sukhumvit 14 Alley, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I thoroughly enjoyed my experience at their Osaka, Japan, store, and decided to try their Bangkok location today for lunch, with friends.

This restaurant primarily serves tofu dishes, but they also offer meat-based options.
We opted for the lunch set, which included a variety of tofu-based dishes and bara sushi (rice topped with small cuts of fish and vegetables).

The service was impeccable. The Thai staff made an effort to speak as much Japanese as possible, which was a lovely touch.

To complete our meal, we were served a small dish of almond gelatin and fruit salad, as well as hot tea.

All in all, the total cost per person was around ฿800, but considering the authenticity and the quality of each dish, I’d say it was well worth it!
sample_reviews_th.author: Travel Coffee Andy

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to this place with a group of friends on my first visit. The décor is very Japanese, and even the waiter could speak Japanese, which added to the atmosphere.

The menu, like many Japanese restaurant menus, is unnecessarily long and filled with an overwhelming number of choices. To keep things simple, I pointed to one of the set menus so I could sample a variety of dishes and try to grasp the essence of what this restaurant offers, especially as it specialises in tofu.

I asked the waiter to serve the dishes in their intended dining sequence so I could appreciate each one individually. Perhaps I was tired in some way, but I did not find the overall impression of the food particularly outstanding. However, the service was undoubtedly a highlight. The waiter knew the menu very well and frequently offered thoughtful recommendations.

Will I return one day? I am not sure. I am not a big tofu fan, and perhaps I need to spend more time understanding the menu before making a fair judgment. Somehow, I feel I did not quite capture the essence of the dining experience this time, and there may still be something about this place that I have yet to discover.
sample_reviews_en.author: Winona Wang

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to this restaurant in Fukuoka with my husband and we absolutely loved the food. I'm so happy they opened a branch in Thailand. We used to frequent their Thonglor branch, and now they've moved to this Asoke branch. We've been here many times; it's our go-to restaurant whenever we're in Japan, and we eat here in Thailand too. We're always impressed. The atmosphere is comfortable, the food is meticulously prepared, and the flavors are delicate and well-balanced in every dish.

If you're looking for delicious Japanese food near Asoke, this restaurant is perfect. The staff are polite, attentive, and friendly, making for a smooth and enjoyable meal.

Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and we definitely want to return.
sample_reviews_en.author: A. W.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tofu is their specialty and recommended to order the Kaiseki sets to savour the wide range of dishes. Some of the dish is beyond unbelievable. There's a vegetarian set also at the back of the menu. The place opens for dinner at 6pm and is quiet before more of the dinner crowd comes in.

Edit: Went back the second time and they quietly didn't serve the crab jelly dish, which was mentioned in my prior review as the dish that was beyond unbelievable. Told them about it twice and they brushed it aside saying they compensated it with a larger silky beancurd dish, which isn't on par with the crab jelly at all. Disappointed with the level of service especially when it's a special meal out with our parents.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pearce

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited with friends after being introduced by an acquaintance, and it turned out to be a wonderful dining experience. What impressed me most was the authenticity of the Japanese cuisine, with each dish feeling carefully prepared and true to tradition.

If you are looking for a japanese restaurant, Asoke is a great area to explore, and this place is well worth visiting. The staff were very polite and kind throughout the meal, which made us feel comfortable and welcome from start to finish.

I would definitely love to come back again for another gathering with friends or colleagues. It is a place I can happily recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanakarn Techaumnuaywit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Found this restaurant by chance.  Guessing Japanese food at a Japanese restaurant should be relatively more reliable.

It did not disappoint.

Ordered 2 special tofu lunch sets & a sushi set for the 3 of us.  As apparently this restaurant is famous for its tofu cuisines.

We had tofu suimei, tofu stew, tofu salad,  deep fried tofu (that actually tasted like deep fried fish cube). On top of that we were lucky to be one of the 5 people who got to try the snow crab chirashi don.  But of course, all meal ends with a delicious dessert. Tofu with mixed fruits.

All in all, completely fulfilling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Winnifred Wong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the opportunity to visit this restaurant on a special occasion and was very impressed with the attentive and friendly service. The staff were very considerate and made our celebration especially memorable. The food here is exquisite and delicate in flavor, which was what impressed me the most.

I visited this place on a recommendation from a close friend and was not disappointed. Located in the Asoke area, it's a place you shouldn't miss if you're looking for excellent quality Japanese food. I would definitely return again as this experience made our special day even more memorable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panwad Chirapornchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
We revisited this restaurant for a family meal, and every dish was elegant and delicately flavored. The care taken in each bite was evident, and we all thoroughly enjoyed it.

The staff were also very polite and kind, and their attentive service was very pleasant. The calm atmosphere that allows for a relaxing meal is also a major draw.

I feel this is a restaurant you can confidently choose when you want to enjoy Japanese food in Asoke. I would definitely like to visit again. I'm looking forward to our next visit with my family.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yume M

restaurants.name: แม่วรรณเตี๋ยวต้มยำมะระ
restaurants.address:

112 Borommaratchachonnani Rd, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located in a PTT gas station on Borommaratchathani Road. I ordered Tom Yum pork noodle soup, and it was delicious – not too sweet, and I asked for it not too spicy, but it was still very flavorful. The soup cost 65 baht, which is great value considering the portion size. It was packed with ingredients; the liver was a little tough but still acceptable, and the pork intestines were well-prepared. The offal had no unpleasant smell. The fried shrimp balls were also okay. I was indifferent to the Yen Ta Fo (pink noodle soup). I recommend the Tom Yum more. Overall, I'd give it a thumbs up and will come back again. Since the restaurant is located in a fairly large gas station, parking wasn't a problem.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suchaya C

sample_reviews_en.text:
This pork tom yum noodle shop is located inside a gas station with several restaurants, sharing a large parking area. The shop itself is a small, air-conditioned space with about 8 tables. They don't serve beef.

The pork tom yum noodles were flavorful and not too spicy. They included offal: large pieces of liver (firmly cooked), large pieces of tender intestines, and heart. You can add minced pork slices. The noodles were chewy and soft. The crispy pork cracklings were dry, bland, and not crunchy. A small piece of bitter melon was also included.

They also offer fried snacks like fried dumplings and fried meatballs. Payment can be made via bank transfer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponchagarj Ngamukos

sample_reviews_en.text: Mae Wann's Tom Yum Noodle Soup with Bitter Gourd, Rama 5 Branch, is located inside the PTT gas station on Borommaratchachonnani 30 Road. There are two entrances/exits, one at the back of the gas station. The restaurant is air-conditioned. Recommended menu item: Tom Yum Noodle Soup (55 baht), ordered with thin rice noodles. The restaurant prepares it richly and flavorfully, with pork, liver, minced pork, and bitter gourd – no need to add extra seasoning. Another option is the Yen Ta Fo (60 baht), with chewy and flavorful noodles. The restaurant has plenty of seating and ample parking in front.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ph031

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time eating here, recommended by friends. The atmosphere is nice, the food tastes good, and there's a decent selection of dishes. *I recommend the fried dumplings; you have to try them at least once, you won't be disappointed.*
The restaurant is easy to find, accessible via Borommaratchathani Road and the road under the expressway.
It's located in the PTT gas station area, with convenient parking.
If you're passing by, give it a try.
It gets busy during lunchtime.
Prices are generally 50+ baht for many dishes.
The restaurant doesn't use MSG.
sample_reviews_en.author: ไปทุกที่มีทาง01

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually order the seafood tom yum noodles, but the fried squid with eggs wasn't very good today. The batter was bland and the dipping sauce was too sour from the vinegar; I prefer it with real lime juice and a homemade seafood dipping sauce rather than a blended one. I'm still giving it 5 stars, just giving constructive criticism for improvement. I usually only order the seafood tom yum noodles and have never ordered any fried items before. This was my first time trying the battered and fried squid with eggs, and it wasn't as tasty as advertised.
sample_reviews_en.author: tiparom kochasenee

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum soup with just one piece of braised bitter melon was a bit small. The flavor was delicious, with a nice, thick broth. It would be great without MSG. The dried chilies were spicy; you should specify that you want it less spicy. The pork slices were too thick, making them less tender. They should be sliced ​​thinner. Overall, it was delicious and reasonably priced. The restaurant is located at the very back if you enter from Borommaratchathani Road; if you enter from the Srirat Expressway, it's right by the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ojo Zung2u

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum noodle soup with bitter melon was perfectly spicy, the portion was generous, and it was delicious and filling. It was packed with ingredients and reasonably priced. The flavor was authentic, without any MSG, and had a fragrant aroma of pepper and Tom Yum spices. The noodles were perfectly cooked, neither mushy nor hard. The ingredients were high-quality and fresh. There was a variety of side dishes to choose from, and ice cream was available for dessert. Delicious and great value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mojiijp

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the seafood tom yum without noodles and was impressed with the fresh ingredients like shrimp and squid. The soup was also tasty. The price is definitely worth it. Their dumplings were okay too and quite enjoyable as a snack.

The place is located in a gas station, which makes parking very easy with plenty of space.

The staff were nice, but I did feel a bit pressured as three of them stood right in front of me watching while I was eating, which was a little uncomfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chen E.

restaurants.name: ป.สะเต๊ะ ประดิพัทธ์ P.Satay Pradiphat
restaurants.address:

241/5 Soi Pradipat, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This satay shop is located in Pradiphat. Since it was raining the day I visited, I stopped by. The staff were very welcoming and explained the menu items. They offer pork, chicken, and beef satay, as well as other dishes with satay added to them.

I ordered 10 skewers of pork satay with 2 slices of bread. It took about 10-15 minutes to prepare because they grill it fresh on the stove. The taste was perfect; the satay had a wonderful aroma, and the pork was incredibly tender. Dipping it in the pickled vegetables and peanut sauce was amazing.

It was delicious! I'll definitely come back again. 🙏✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Fuka Kung

sample_reviews_en.text: I can honestly say this is truly authentic pork satay. The skewers are large, lean, yet the pork is grilled perfectly and incredibly tender. The peanut dipping sauce is delicious and they give you a generous portion. The pickled vegetables are also tasty. Prices are 100, 200, and 300 baht for sets of 10, 20, and 30 skewers respectively. As a woman, I was full after 8 skewers; 10 skewers were more than enough. I highly recommend this place; the food is genuinely delicious, clean, the atmosphere is nice, and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phonpan Chiangkhang

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried the pork satay and beef satay.
The pork satay was tender.
The beef satay was slightly chewy.
The dipping sauces, especially the pickled vegetables, were tasty.
Area for improvement: They should be grilled and served hot like other restaurants to retain the charcoal aroma.
However, when I ate at the restaurant, the pork satay seemed like it had been prepared a while ago. The charcoal flavor seemed to have disappeared.
sample_reviews_en.author: Freedom Logo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Impressed at first glance and stepping in...we ordered all menus, Beef, Chicken, and Pork satay, all so tendered with flavor rich.
Peanut sauce been asked to refil as we dip brimfully, went well with the vinegar cucumber and shallot dip and their 2 rice dishes....1. Kaprao pork Satay and 2. Pork Satay fried rice..

We are thinking to open kinda this Satay shop with their supplies ....

Will go back again
sample_reviews_en.author: Vatistam PRUANGVIRIYA

sample_reviews_en.text: This satay restaurant on Bangkok's Pradipat Road is popular among locals. The charcoal-grilled satay is fragrant, slightly crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, making it easy to eat. The peanut sauce in particular is rich, with a good balance of sweetness and richness that makes it addictive. The cucumber acha is also refreshing and pairs well with the satay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yusuke

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is an absolute must if you are a satay fanatic like I am. The menu is simple, beef, pork, or chicken satay. I got the chicken satay and it was the best I have ever eaten. It was absolutely phenomenal and delicious. The peanut sauce was also amazing and they give you a large portion of it. This place is a must -visit if you’re in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrick Krol

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork skewers are large, lean, but not sold individually. They are priced per skewer, and sold in sets of 5 or 10. A set of 10 skewers costs 100 baht. Beef skewers are more expensive. The taste is on the salty side. The pork is tender, not bad, but not appealing enough to make me want to eat them often.
sample_reviews_en.author: AleXander

sample_reviews_en.text: Haven’t tried satay and thought to give this a try. I ordered the pork: thick and on the sweeter side which I don’t prefer. The peanut sauce was good. Pairs well with the toast and the veggies in vinegar. The luohangue juice was fantastic! I was full at the end of the meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna Huynh

restaurants.name: The Pizza house Halal
restaurants.address:

129 Thanon Tanao, Wat Bowon Niwet, Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The pizza was very small and very expensive; it wasn't homemade, it was store-bought. I was very hopeful that I would eat a halal pizza, but it was terrible. It was undercooked, and when we gave it back to them to be cooked again, the same thing came back. The chicken was very dry. I paid 775 baht for an inedible pizza and chicken. It was the worst pizza I've ever eaten in my life. I'll say "may it be haram and cursed" because you disgraced me in front of my family.
sample_reviews_en.author: Abdullah Aciker

sample_reviews_en.text:
After so much findings i finaAfter trying so many disappointing options in Bangkok, especially while travelling from India, this restaurant was a pleasant surprise. They offer a huge variety of both vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes, and everything we tried was full of flavour and tasted amazing.

The quality of the food and the authentic taste truly stood out. If you are looking for good Indian food in Bangkok, this place is definitely worth visiting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohd. Amaan

sample_reviews_en.text: 390v, over €10 for a mini frozen pizza?? Seriously, that's ridiculous!!! Plus, it really wasn't very good... Then again, it was empty, so I understand better now... I'm having trouble understanding the rating and the reviews... there must be a lot of fake reviews...
sample_reviews_en.author: Medy

sample_reviews_en.text: Worst Margherita Pizza ever! Store bought, dry, bland and an abomanation of a Pizza. The owner and staff were nice, but food was just horrible😫. The most whack part was probably ketchup and kewpie mayo as condiments! Would not revisit and would not recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunil ravindaran

sample_reviews_en.text: ⚠️ the owner are adding a pseudo tax coming out of nowhere that they won't make you pay if you leave 5 stars on google. Never seen that kind of tax in Thailand !!
sample_reviews_en.author: Valentine SANTIER

sample_reviews_en.text: Hands down one of the best pizzas! 🍕 Perfect crust, amazing cheese pull, and super fresh toppings. Hot, tasty, and totally satisfying. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sehaj Kaur

sample_reviews_en.text: It's actually one of the best and delicious 😋 restaurant in Kho San Road , the pizza is fresh and the staff are so nice and welcoming
sample_reviews_en.author: Abi

sample_reviews_en.text: Most delicious meal after going out. Great place, best service. If you are in for a late night treat this is the place to be! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Mitchell van de vrugt

restaurants.name: เครปสมหวัง สาขาสุขุมวิท 23 (อโศก)
restaurants.address:

Sukhumvit 23 ล็อค S3 ชั้น G ทางเข้าอาคาร Interchange 21 ฝั่ง, Soi Sukhumvit 23, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Tokyo desserts at affordable prices in the heart of Asoke, located on the G floor, near the exit of Sukhumvit Soi 23, Interchange Building.
sample_reviews_en.author: candyminimart Mini

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! The crust is crispy, the aroma is wonderful, absolutely amazing! I love it!
sample_reviews_en.author: SeReGa Aller

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is cute. The staff are very friendly. They give good advice. The price is okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peach

restaurants.name: Roasted Duck Pratoo Thong
restaurants.address:

102 ซอย Thanon Happy Land Sai 2, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mixed Rice with 3 Toppings (Special) at Pratu Thong Roast Duck restaurant near Happy Land... Short review: Generous portion for the price, but the taste wasn't quite right.

- The duck skin was a bit overcooked; not crispy, but not chewy either. The meat was juicy, mildly salty, with a slightly burnt skin aroma.
- The char siu pork was very salty, perhaps too salty. The meat was juicy, not chewy, with a little fat marbling.
- The crispy pork skin wasn't crispy, and some pieces were a bit chewy, possibly because it was eaten last and the sauce had soaked into the skin. It was slightly salty, almost tasteless.
- The sauce was watery, like a soybean paste sauce, slightly salty.
- The soup was clear and slightly sweet, lacking much flavor.

The price was 75 baht. The portion was large, but would I return? I'd have to think about it. However, if I'm hungry and passing by, I'd probably go in.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oak Sonthitiwitoon

sample_reviews_en.text: My first order had a problem, but I let it slide because they sent something else instead of the item they initially ordered because it was out of stock. I was going to call to ask, but they'd already closed their shop on the app. Today, I ordered through Line Man. Only one item was out of stock, and the seller was unhelpful and had a sarcastic tone. They tried to tell me to ask the rider about canceling the order. Normally, other shops are easy to deal with when items are out of stock, but this shop was just arrogant. They don't even want to sell to customers; they should just close their shop on the app next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Baw Baw

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very delicious roasted duck noodles😋😋 The noodles are so good! The duck and sauce is also very tasty😃
I also love their bitter melon soup with pork spare ribs👍👍
The only menu I didn't like was the chinese kale with oyster sauce..... it was very ordinary and the quantity very small.
Prices are also inexpensive and they even have indoor air conditioning seats👍👍👍
However there are no parking spaces nearby, better to park at lotus or the mall bangkapi and walk here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sabrina Wu

sample_reviews_en.text: Pratu Thong Roast Duck, located in a shophouse near Happy Land, has air-conditioned seating, but I ordered takeout. They offer honey-roasted duck, crispy pork, honey-roasted char siu pork, braised duck wings, and noodles. I ordered crispy pork, but it was a bit too fatty. The duck skin was chewy, possibly because it was for takeout and not reheated, unlike eating at the restaurant. The braised pork ribs and char siu pork were acceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: พิชัย แตงอ่อน

sample_reviews_en.text: The duck rice is simple yet flavorful. If you like an authentic Chinese taste, this is the place to go. The duck skin is really crispy, and the sauce is just right – not too salty. The bamboo shoot soup, unfortunately, might be a little bland on its own, but when paired with the duck rice, it's a perfect contrast and cleanses the palate. If you're in the Happyland area, give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: อ.แบงค์ เคลียดวง Banktarot

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually order delivery through the app, but today I had the chance to eat at the restaurant. It was just as delicious as always, and the service was excellent. It's a small shop in a single shophouse unit with air conditioning, and the prices are fantastic. The roast duck is delicious, the pickled ginger is amazing, and the pork dumplings are also delicious. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tan Tuan

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here a few times already. I usually order rice with barbecued pork, crispy pork, and duck mixed together. Sometimes I also have dumplings, depending on my digestion capacity. Today I ordered the same thing as usual, plus some steamed dumplings to take home. The prices are reasonable, not overly expensive. It's authentic Chinese cooking.
sample_reviews_en.author: ตะนาว 419

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is in a single shop unit but it's air-conditioned, looks clean, the staff are helpful in recommending dishes, and the food tastes good. If you want to try something new or are tired of mall food, you should come here. We ordered a lot, two sets for two people, and had leftovers to take home.
sample_reviews_en.author: กิน เที่ยว เยี่ยว นอน

restaurants.name: Took Lae Dee
restaurants.address:

Foodland Supermarket สาขา พัฒน์พงศ์ 9 พัฒน์พงศ์ ซอย 2 Surawong Rd, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious local food at a great price!

I had a great experience dining at Took Lae Dee in Bangkok. It’s a simple, no-frills restaurant but the food speaks for itself—authentic, flavorful, and very affordable.

I ordered Thai tea and a few local dishes like Pad Kra Pao and Tom Yum, and everything was tasty and well-prepared. The Thai tea was perfectly sweet and refreshing—just what I needed in the Bangkok heat!

🍛 Quick service and freshly made meals
🧋 Thai tea was rich and creamy
💸 Great value for money
👍 Clean place with friendly staff

Perfect spot if you want to try real Thai food without breaking the bank. I’ll definitely come back next time I’m in town!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rafihan Alrasyid

sample_reviews_en.text: Took Lae Dee, a 24-hour restaurant next to Foodland supermarket, is popular with both locals and tourists. I've visited many times, enjoying the courteous and efficient service. The restaurant's layout is simple but clean, suitable for group dining or dining alone. The menu features both Thai and international dishes, and beer is available. However, my recent spicy beef noodles lacked the expected heat, and the turnip cake with bean sprouts was too sweet. Despite this, dining with a friend was pleasant as always. Given the decline in food quality, a 3-star rating seems fair.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zainal

sample_reviews_en.text: Good food, great price! We always come here for breakfast, which is really more than just breakfast. There is also a deal for ‘breakfast’ before 9 am everyday. We can order something else like steak or some local Thai dishes available in the menu for breakfast too! A famous singer stopped by for an American Fried Rice and the dish was suddenly a popular for awhile. The place is not that big and can be crowded from time to time.
sample_reviews_en.author: pramoch r

sample_reviews_en.text: A wonderful local-style eatery offering both Thai and Western dishes. The food is truly delightful, with flavors that suit both local and international palates. Cleanliness is impressively high compared to typical neighborhood restaurants, making the dining experience comfortable and enjoyable. Located just off Patpong, this spot is perfect for anyone seeking authentic yet accessible meals. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: roi tal

sample_reviews_en.text: We loved coming here every morning for a delicious breakfast. We still can't believe how little we paid for what we got. 65 baht (happy hour from 6:30-9AM, otherwise 81 baht) gets you 2 eggs with bacon, toast, butter, jam, fruit juice and fresh coffee (which was pretty good as well!). The place is clean, air-conditioned and the food was served really quickly by friendly waiters. We highly recommend this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Angelo

sample_reviews_en.text: "Cheap and Good," a name you can always trust. I recommend the garlic pork rice; it tastes just like when I was a kid. Remember the steak you ate as a child? Well, here it is – "Cheap and Good" still exists! The "Princess-style" basil rice, with your choice of four fried eggs: Thai, Western, runny yolk, or raw. And the minced beef noodle soup, which is becoming increasingly hard to find, is still available.
sample_reviews_en.author: auttapong maesincee

sample_reviews_en.text: Upscale Denny's in a higher end grocery store.  I ordered the Japanese fried garlic rice with ham and the American breakfast.  They wanted me to drink the coffee, but I am not a coffee drinker.  I got a small glass of pineapple juice which they upgraded because I drank it so fast.  The American came with toast, eggs to order, butter, marmalade, and bacon.  It was really good at 0400 in the morning.
sample_reviews_en.author: James Schulze

sample_reviews_en.text: Always a reliable and cheap eatery, which is right inside the foodland supermarket, and is opened for 24 hours! Simply amazing. They hace recently updated their menu and approach, a bit more variety now. I can always get a good meal abd go on grocery shopping, right after. This branch is located in the middle of the colorful red district of Bangkok, you'll get all sorts of interesting customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wong Francis

restaurants.name: สเต็กใบตอง
restaurants.address:

420, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The steak tastes good, my daughter likes it and we go there often. We've been many times before, but the last time we went, the wait for food was quite long. We saw the table next to us get their food already. When we inquired, the restaurant said that the ingredients for our order weren't ready.

I would like to suggest that the restaurant should have staff inform customers whether they are willing to wait or not, so that customers can decide whether to wait or change their order, to reduce conflict between customers and the restaurant. (There were a lot of mosquitoes the day we waited. We waited over 30 minutes for our food; waiting any longer would be unacceptable.)

We've never had any problems before; this was the only time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuttagrita Buengbongkoch

sample_reviews_en.text:
Banana Leaf Steak & Vegetable Garden
Steak, Spaghetti, various Fried Rice dishes, Ice Cream
Mix Grill 259 Baht: Beef, Chicken, Fried Dolly Fish
Vegetable Salad, Buttered Bread, French Fries
Served with gravy and mayonnaise
Very generous portions, affordable price. Regular beef, Well Done
Slightly tough. Chicken is tender. Fried Dolly Fish is crispy. Salad dressing is typical.
Ribeye Beef Basil Rice 99 Baht
Sliced ​​ribeye beef, fragrant basil stir-fry with dried chilies.
Tender beef, not chewy.
Mahachai Fresh Coconut Ice Cream with three toppings 30 Baht
Delicious ice cream, standard Mahachai ice cream.
Taste 7, Cleanliness 7
Price 8, Service 5
Ingredients 7
sample_reviews_en.author: KALPHAPON POLWACHARAPAT

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food, cheap prices, generous portions, and open late – a great option for those who finish work late. I often go there when I can't think of anything else to eat. Their beef steak is delicious; I've brought many friends here and they all love it. Their pork, chicken, and other steaks are also tasty. It's perfect for special occasions and celebrations. Suitable for all ages, friends, partners, and family – any occasion! I love this place. Please don't close, it's close to home, otherwise I won't have anything to eat late at night! 😂
sample_reviews_en.author: Fh Ah

sample_reviews_en.text:
A steakhouse near my house that I've wanted to try for a long time.

Food: The food was served quickly. The chicken steak was delicious. The beef steak was a bit tough, but the flavor was okay. I wish the spaghetti tomato sauce was a bit richer. The garlic bread and french fries were delicious.

Price: The prices were reasonable for each menu item; not too expensive and affordable.

Atmosphere: Good ventilation, a cool breeze, and parking available near the front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Can BRC

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious and served relatively quickly, except for a few dishes which seemed to be made to order. Overall, the menu is diverse, offering main courses, appetizers, and desserts. The music in the restaurant is quite relaxing.

Sorry, the atmosphere is only 4/5, but everything else is perfect.

The restaurant has fans, but there are still a lot of mosquitoes.

(If you have allergies or are bringing children, I recommend applying mosquito repellent beforehand.)
sample_reviews_en.author: KkN

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted great and was reasonably priced. The staff were lovely, friendly, and hardworking. They even had curtains on the roof to cover the ceiling when it rained, creating a cool and comfortable atmosphere. Music was playing constantly, though a bit loud, but it was still lively. The only thing I deducted a point for was the slow, even very slow, service. However, considering the taste, it was well worth it. I highly recommend coming here to eat!
sample_reviews_en.author: กัปตัน อเมริกา

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a steak restaurant with a diverse menu, both savory and sweet.
The quality is appropriate for the price; one serving is satisfying.
The chicken is tender and juicy, but not very spicy, despite the name.
The beef was cooked as ordered, medium rare, but still a bit tough.
However, it wasn't so chewy that it was impossible to eat.
Overall, I rate the atmosphere and the prices highly.

🚗 There is parking available in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: MISSYS

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't know if it's the same for everyone, but I ordered using a discount code, and the quantity decreased accordingly—it's ridiculously low. Normally, even without a discount, the quantity is the same. But this time, after using the code just once, the quantity decreased significantly. I'm disappointed and probably won't order again. The quantity was really reduced, and the code didn't even give a huge discount.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suchanari Juyprasert

restaurants.name: Kumpoon - Central EastVille
restaurants.address:

22/53 On La-iat Alley, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
- Papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce: Okay, the crab is boiled and mildly spicy.
The bamboo shoot salad is good, you can ask for extra spice, but if you don't, it's slightly sweet, but not unpleasant.
- Sticky rice 25฿: Very small portion, probably around 100g.
sample_reviews_th.author: Peony J.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is my go-to when I crave fermented fish sauce. Their fermented fish sauce flavors are perfect for me. This time, they have a much wider menu. The fried rice with deboned catfish is excellent; you can choose between fried rice with fermented fish sauce or plain rice. We chose plain rice, and mixing it with the catfish meat was fantastic. The catfish was firm, in large pieces, and boneless.
The Vientiane-style papaya salad is my favorite. I usually order Lao-style papaya salad, but this Vientiane version is the best. The fermented fish sauce, shrimp paste, and crab paste are perfectly balanced, and the thick shredded papaya is excellent.
It was so delicious I ordered two more dishes to take home: the fried rice with fermented fish and the tomato soup, which were as delicious as always.

*I wish the restaurant would make smaller portions of their spicy salads for single diners.
sample_reviews_en.author: ploy hirun

sample_reviews_en.text:
I got the chance to try this place with friends because of the hype.
The reviews were overwhelmingly positive!
I'd seen this place for a long time but never had the chance to try it before.
The service was good.
Some dishes were delicious and of good quality.
I was a little disappointed that the single-serving dishes weren't filling.
It's not like one dish wasn't enough to fill me up.
The portions were large, but the quantity wasn't enough, especially considering the price and the reviews.
The tables and chairs were cramped, as you can see from the serving dishes.
It's rare to find delicious and worthwhile papaya salad in a mall, and even rarer to find something even better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sitthichai K

sample_reviews_en.text: Personally, I especially like papaya salad with cucumber. This restaurant makes it spicy and delicious, but compared to the bamboo shoot and fresh shrimp salad, I prefer the sourness of theirs more. It's spicier, more balanced, and has a better flavor. The Khao Suan Kwang grilled chicken had little meat; I suspect they used free-range chicken. It wasn't very fragrant with spices. I felt indifferent about it. I didn't try the grilled catfish, but judging from what my friend said, it might not have been grilled well enough; the meat was a bit puffy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutsara WANG

sample_reviews_en.text: I saw good reviews and wanted to try it. But after trying it, the taste wasn't to my liking at all. The flavors were all over the place, lacking or being excessive. The papaya salad was way too sweet. The restaurant wasn't very crowded when I went, but the food took a long time to arrive. The air conditioning wasn't working properly; it was very hot. Personally, I think the prices aren't very reasonable compared to the quality and quantity.
sample_reviews_en.author: Punnara Phoomchareon

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here many times before, but this time it seems like the restaurant has recently been renovated. The food prices have increased. More importantly, the two dishes I ordered today were both extremely salty. The papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce was edible, but the mixed mushroom soup was unbearable; it was too salty.
sample_reviews_en.author: RT Kao

sample_reviews_en.text: It's hot, and the air conditioning isn't very effective. The papaya salad is bland, but the spicy soup is delicious and flavorful. The Luang Prabang papaya salad is the best! The fried chicken is tasty, the pork neck is average, and the fermented pork salad is good. The overall taste of the food is average.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicha Da

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is clean and the decor is comfortable and relaxing.

The food is easy to eat and there's a wide variety.

The flavors are mild and not too complex.

The staff provides good and polite service.

Suitable for couples or families.

Wine is available.
Beer promotions are also offered.
sample_reviews_en.author: chamachote chokboonmongkol

restaurants.name: Per Te
restaurants.address:

70 72 Soi Langsuan, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: What a lovely surprise. Passing by it looks like a bakery or cafe but in fact its a wonderful Italian eatery. They have another space in back for larger parties but up front there are just 3 tables seating about 9.  The ambiance is ultra quaint trattoria.  The owner is a lovely young woman Chonlada who first brought out some homemade breads. I ordered the porcini risotto which I enjoyed immensely. Coincidentally, there were 2 friendly gentlemen who were finishing their dinner who asked where I was visiting from. They both said they enjoy eating at this little gem often. They asked where I was staying and I told them The Duchess (aka Natural Ville Exec Residences), coincidentally one of them is the CEO/owner!  He was very nice and welcomed me to Bangkok, raved about Per Te and the owner.  While not my first visit to Bangkok, it is my first time to the Wireless area and it was a great start to my vacation, thanks to Per Te/Chonlada and "C" from The Duchess and his friend. Very impressed with both.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cam Wong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff/owners show that they care about the food they serve their customers, and they make everything themselves. We went for a Valentine's Day date, and we absolutely loved every moment in this restaurant. We were greeted kindly both by the owner and a cat. The atmosphere is warm, their plates and cutlery are cute, and the decorations give it a nice European feel.
The French onion soup was really nice. The cesar salad was delicious and included prosciutto. My lasagna with lamb and tomato sauce included a generous amount of cheese. Our truffle ravioli was creamy and  delicious.
I hope you've made it this far because it needs to be mentioned: the apple crumble is to die for. It is honestly one of the best (if not the best) one you will ever have.
If you are going for a date or just for a nice meal, you will absolutely not be disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: David Potvin

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had such a lovely time at Perte! The restaurant has a warm and cozy vibe that makes you feel comfortable right away. The staff were really kind and welcoming, and the atmosphere was perfect for a relaxed dinner with friends or family.

I ordered the Spaghetti Bottarga (spaghetti with fish roe) and a Salad, and both dishes were wonderful. The spaghetti was flavorful and perfectly cooked — the bottarga added a nice salty touch without being too strong. The salad was fresh, light, and refreshing, a great balance to the pasta.

Everything tasted homemade and prepared with care. You can really feel the love they put into their food. I’ll definitely come back again soon — it’s one of those places that make you feel happy just being there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krissda Choovisit (Ko โก้)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Disappointing Experience – Would Not Recommend

Unfortunately, our visit to Per Te was a letdown from start to finish. We were the only guests in the restaurant, and the constant bing of the microwave didn’t exactly set the tone for a fresh, authentic meal.

The complimentary bread was rock-hard and tasted old. While the dishes were nicely presented, the taste told a different story. The pasta was far from al dente — just hard and undercooked — and the duck ragout had a strange, fishy flavor that was frankly unpleasant.

With so many excellent Italian restaurants in the area, I strongly recommend choosing another spot. Looks can be deceiving — and sadly, this place just didn’t deliver.
sample_reviews_en.author: Markus Lichtenheldt

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dining at Per Te feels like visiting an old-school Italian grandma’s house—cozy, full of character, and effortlessly charming. Every little detail, from the plates and cutlery to the quirky cat décor, adds to the homely vibe.

We sat outside by a lovely fountain, with a cool 11-seater trailer nearby. The food was  light yet flavorful—airy calamari, hearty but balanced bolognese, and a carbonara that hits just right. Unlike many Italian spots, you leave satisfied, not stuffed.

The complimentary garlic bread (excellent!) and lemon sorbet were the perfect touch. A cozy, no-nonsense dinner that truly hits the spot—would definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: N Anita Amreen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don't let the tiny entrance fool you, this restaurant is actually bigger than you can see from the sidewalk. The outside seating is where you want to be. They also have a train car in the garden that has private seating which is good for a small party of friends or family. Sitting in the garden is loud but the ambience makes up for it. You can tell the others like cats and rabbits with all the cute decorations.

I personally think the prices for the food are reasonable. The food was good, not great. I like my pasta hot, not warm. The menu has a lot of items I want to try, so I'm going back. Give this place a chance. You'll love it.
sample_reviews_en.author: David HUDGENS

sample_reviews_en.text:
Per Te Langsuan feels like discovering a secret backyard oasis in the heart of Bangkok - perfect for romantic dinners or quiet family meals.

The menu is create around homemade Italian classics. We ordered several dishes:
* Maiale: country-style sous-vide pork chop,
mashed potatoes, asparagus, oyster mushrooms
* Branzino: baked sea bass, sautéed spinach, mozzarella
* Panillada: mixed seafood cooked in a white wine sauce
* Spaghetti with Crispy Fish (Thai Style)

Service was professional and up to the standard you’d expect from a restaurant like this. Overall, a great dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: aerngncpt Thanin

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is one of the best Italian restaurants I have ever been to, and I go to Italy every year. The spaghetti with crispy bacon was exquisite, the consistency, fresh ingredients, taste and quantity just perfect, the amatriciana is divine too and the lava cake and brownie are simply heaven. Yes it is pricier than Thai food but cheaper than poor Italian food I have had in the UK and it is worth it for the quality. i actually can't praise this place enough, it made my stay in Bangkok infinitely better. Eat in the garden, it is like a little Roman oasis.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adele Clarke

restaurants.name: Roly Poly Cafe & Cuisine
restaurants.address:

1274 ซ. อนามัยงามเจริญ 25 Tha Kham, แขวงบางขุนเทียน, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, the atmosphere is great, and the restaurant is cutely decorated, perfect for a family meal. There are play areas for children of all ages, with toys and board games, so you can enjoy your meal while watching your kids play.
The crispy pork, fried chicken skin, and glass noodle salad are all delicious and the kids love them.
The Pad Thai tastes just like the famous restaurants in Phetchaburi; delicious without the long journey.

Definitely coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vichuta Jaitheing

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely amazing! Almost every dish is delicious.
Even the desserts are delicious.
They only use high-quality ingredients.
The owner is very attentive, taking care of every table.
If you want something a little spicier and sourer,
just ask the owner's mom
or the staff.
They're always smiling and provide genuine service. 🙏
I'll definitely be back! 👍👍
A complete menu of sweet and savory dishes, all in one place! 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: ณชาภา แซ่ตั้ง

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious.
I ordered the crispy pork stir-fried with chili and salt. The pork was truly crispy and not tough.
The Pad Thai had crispy pork with chewy and soft noodles.
The palm sugar ice cream was fragrant and not too sweet, just right for those who don't like sweet things.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimnipa T.

sample_reviews_en.text: Come sit and wait for your child to finish an activity with Teacher Emmy (Humble Home). The food is good, delicious, Pad Thai is delicious, good coffee, delicious desserts as well. Everything is complete in one place. The atmosphere of the shop is comfortable, nice to sit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pankanok Tiptaweecharn

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, with both indoor and outdoor play areas for children. The food is delicious and reasonably priced. The staff and owner are very friendly and provide excellent service. It was my first visit and I was very impressed. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nisakorn Tatiyong

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is very delicious, especially the fried larb and pad thai. The desserts are also very delicious. The shop is very spacious with many tables. There is a zone for children to play and board games. It is very suitable for families. I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sujittra Puncharuchikul

sample_reviews_en.text: First time here, I loved it. The Pad Thai was delicious and well-balanced without needing to add any seasoning. The owner and staff were lovely and even offered watermelon as a free drink after the meal. A must-try is the various cakes. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Intelligence Tourism

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was incredibly delicious! The BBQ pork was fantastic, and the vegetable soup was MSG-free – so tasty!
The rice dishes were also amazing. Highly recommended! The atmosphere was great, and the staff were friendly and welcoming.
sample_reviews_en.author: tuksinawadee kammoonmart

restaurants.name: Top Korean Restaurant
restaurants.address:

Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I love all of the side dishes. Everything was delicious. The egg roll arrived warm. The pumpkin rice was delicious and sweet. The beef soup was smooth and easy to swallow. Both types of pork were grilled by the restaurant. You just have to wait to eat. It was a private room. I really like the staff call button. It's very creative. There were 2 of us and we were as full as if there were 4 of us. 🤣 The owner is a real Korean. The shop has been open for 2 months. The plates and bowls are still new. The staff understands Korean well and knows the menu very well. I wish there were some fruits like watermelon to cleanse the palate. After eating savory food, it felt a bit lacking without sweet food. 🤣 The service is good and the food is delicious. I will continue to patronize.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paowara Kang

sample_reviews_en.text: At first, I didn't expect much because there were so many Korean restaurants nearby. But I saw a review of Jjapaghetti and spicy tteokbokki, so I decided I had to go here and took a Grab. First of all, the water was barley tea? Doonggulle? It was refreshing and delicious. As I was eating the side dishes, the main dishes came out. It was kimchi stew, and I don't usually eat stew with meat in it because it's Korean. It's tough and smelly, but I was surprised that it was delicious here. The tteokbokki was spicier and sweeter than I expected. The two of us ordered three dishes and ate until we were full. If you really want to eat Korean food, I recommend it. I think I'll go again next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: 최예랑

sample_reviews_en.text: Although the restaurant is a bit far from Jomtien, I searched and found it. As a tourist, I didn't have a car. I rode my motorcycle. However, I parked closer to the restaurant entrance. The staff came out and told me to park further away. When I told them I was there to eat, they told me to park in the designated spot. I repeated this, but they refused, so I turned around. So I headed to Hanwoori Garden. I searched and found Hanwoori Restaurant. I parked on the left side of the Hanwoori Garden restaurant entrance. I didn't say anything, and instead, they guided me to my room. Fortunately, I was treated well at Hanwoori Restaurant and had a great meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: 야스민

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first trip abroad with my kids, and I ended up staying in Thailand.
The Top Pool Villa was in perfect condition.
The bed and bedding were perfect👍🏻
Top Korean Restaurant was seriously sooooo delicious!!!!
We ate out at restaurants and went to the night market, but we ended up leaving everything behind. We ordered ramen, rice, and tteokbokki at Top Korean Restaurant, and now I'm writing this review while eating there. ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
My 11 and 13-year-old daughters insisted we only eat here and not eat out during our stay...
If I ever get the chance, I'll definitely come back and stay here again👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
Please keep this place open for a long time~
sample_reviews_en.author: 박유리

sample_reviews_en.text: When you crave Korean pork ribs, this is the place. They're boneless, but they're also low in fat and delicious. If you ask them to grill them for you, they'll cook them for you. 👍 It's convenient and doesn't smell bad. 👍👍 The side dishes aren't overly seasoned, so they're all delicious and clean. I'll definitely be back. The lettuce kimchi and yacon pickles come to mind. The owner and staff are friendly. The food is delicious. This is a must-visit. 👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: 대형

sample_reviews_en.text: the restaurant is like a scam, the typical korean barbecue grill is just not existing... event when there is a picture on the website. the service is at least trying to help but to much of a langauge barrier. the food was ok but please state it clearly... when korean bbq i wanna grill my meat like it's supposed to be done. the private room looks like in a hospital very bright light and cold. also no music inside... to bad
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Michael

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is large, the staff are polite, and the food comes out quickly. They even have private rooms, which makes it very comfortable.

The prices are quite expensive. Order just enough to fill you up, which is about 400 baht per person. If you order more than you'd like, the prices are even more outrageous.

The menu is smaller than I thought. I didn't know what to order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panithee Krongsut

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is spacious and pleasant, following the New Normal guidelines; it's not crowded. There are handwashing sinks nearby for customers, so they don't have to walk far. The decorative lights are sparkling, and there are beautiful photo opportunities. There are also handsome guys (Oppa) who will even bring the grill to your table!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anuchit Srechote
