I was very impressed with my visit to Dubai Specialty Coffee. The atmosphere is luxurious, beautiful, and tranquil, perfect for relaxing and spending time with family. The family seating area is spacious and comfortable, suitable for everyone.

All the coffee and drinks are of excellent quality and reasonably priced considering the quality of the place and service.

What impressed me most was the service from the staff, especially Reema and the coffee expert Lux, who were friendly, polite, professional, and attentive to customers.

I highly recommend Dubai Specialty Coffee to anyone looking for a stylish coffee shop with a great atmosphere, perfect for spending quality time with family.
sample_reviews_en.author: Humaid Chookah

sample_reviews_en.text:
In short, it's wonderful and delicious. It's located on Soi 3 Street in Nana, in the new market, in the underground basement. The cafe is very small but elegant, and what matters most is the taste and quality. We wish them continued success and hope to see branches in malls and expansion to other areas.

In short, it's located on Soi 3 Street in Nana, in the new market, in the underground basement. It's very small but elegant, and what matters most is the taste and quality. We wish them continued success and hope to see branches in malls and expansion to other areas.
sample_reviews_en.author: خلفان الشامسي

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dubai Latte officially became my favorite coffee!!!
It had such a unique flavor that I honestly can’t even describe it properly.

This café is full of thoughtful little details, and you can really tell that a lot of care went into everything. That made the whole experience feel even more special and charming.

I also tried their Medovik honey cake — it was super fresh and absolutely delicious!
The avocado toast was also really light, fresh, and tasty.

Definitely one of those cafés that stays in your mind even after you leave.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anahid Danesh

sample_reviews_en.text: This Dubai-inspired café serves excellent coffee, with options for both single-origin and blended beans. I really enjoyed the Shafar Orange Black, which had a fresh and interesting taste. You can also ask the baristas to prepare your coffee as a drip. The desserts, made by a Le Cordon Bleu chef, are a real treat. The minimalistic decor features portraits of important figures who helped unite the seven emirates, making this café a must-visit for coffee and dessert lovers.
sample_reviews_en.author: IdaCupSong IdaCupSong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The place is small but tidy and worth a try, especially for specialty coffee lovers.

I tried the V60, and they had about six types of coffee beans to choose from, which gave me a nice selection. The prices are a bit above average or high, but the coffee quality is good.

The only thing that might confuse you is that the coffee shop's location isn't very clear, as it's inside a small building on the ground floor, so be aware of that if it's your first time visiting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Abdulaziz A

sample_reviews_en.text: When the cafe first opened, it was excellent. They had several types of coffee, and the desserts were always varied. I used to visit from time to time. But after a while, everything changed, from the quality of the Americano to the desserts. I ordered a Brazilian Americano, but the waiter didn't do it right. He made it twice, but it wasn't as good as before, so I left the cafe without drinking anything. I hope they look into this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Moza Ahli

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to the Nana area and followed a review. It's located on the ground floor of a building. The shop isn't very big, but there's plenty of seating. The dirty coffee tastes good, complementing the slightly sweet milk, and the latte art is beautiful. If you're in the area and want to enjoy a relaxing coffee, this shop is great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rosie R.

sample_reviews_en.text: Their interior is cozy but quite small. We tried their filtered coffee but it wasn’t something special. From my perspective it was quite overpriced compared to the other cafés. The thought behind is quite clear - more oriented for high class people but the quality of products is regular. For the price we excpected more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aleš Matějka

restaurants.name: ถ่านไฟเก่า กริลล์รูม
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 857 Samsen Nok, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A truly warm, family-friendly place where you'll want to return.

The restaurant left a very pleasant impression. It feels more than just a business, but a true family-like atmosphere: calm, cozy, and homey.

I'd especially like to mention the owner—an incredibly sweet, kind, and attentive person. It's clear he genuinely cares about his guests and strives to make everyone feel comfortable, which immediately creates a special atmosphere.

The food is delicious, the presentation is meticulous, and the service is pleasant and unobtrusive. This isn't a faceless tourist spot, but a restaurant with character and soul.

Establishments like these are especially valuable: you come here not only to eat, but also to feel good.
The atmosphere is a special plus. Everything is very calm, welcoming, and unfussy. Pleasant jazz music plays.

A great place for a family dinner, a get-together with friends, or just a pleasant evening. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone who appreciates delicious food, friendly service, and genuine Thai hospitality.

We were very pleased and will definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Сергей Адоньев

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a must-visit spot that I highly recommend. The food is absolutely delicious, made with high-quality ingredients.
We started with the Hunter Minestrone Soup, where the slow-braised vegetables were perfectly tender, blending beautifully with the rich and aromatic broth.
For the main course, we had the Roasted Tunisian Lamb Shoulder—the lamb was incredibly tender, juicy, and infused with just the right amount of spices. The Spinach Gratin was a delightful side, with perfectly grilled spinach and creamy, melted cheese that made it impossible to stop eating.
To finish, we indulged in the Caramelized Banana with Ice Cream & Almonds—the caramelized banana was soft, fragrant, and so perfectly done that even the peel was edible! This dessert was hands down our favorite, and I highly recommend ordering it.

I’ll definitely be returning multiple times because there are so many more dishes I want to try. Plus, the service was outstanding—special thanks to the kind gentleman who guided us through the menu with great recommendations!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tess Nichanart

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited Tharn Fai Grill with my wife and a group of three others shortly after they reopened from COVID, it was okay but it seems they are struggling with returning to normal operation and the experience suffered.

The food was extremely slow in being prepared and only one dish came out at a time to different tables in the restaurant, we later learned this was due to the fact that the owner/chef was handling the kitchen solo-admirable and difficult, but not the best situation. The food itself was very good and you could tell it was prepared with care, however we weren't a fan of the ribeye steak as it was pretty lean but that seems to be common with Thai beef.

Tharn Fai Grill Room definitely has the coziness feeling stretched to the max and being inside is like going home; the exposed brick and meticulous decor surrounds you with warmth. I imagine when the restaurant is in gear this would be a five star visit and I will definitely be returning to give them a second shot later in the future!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sean Kelly

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was told name, loosely translated, means, "the lover you having visited for a long time", or maybe more like, "the girlfriend you've been missing for a while". Hehe, Google translate says it means, "Charcoal Grill Room", which I think is probably more accurate, although less romantic.

Great restaurant in an awkward spot. Excellent food, with a friendly and attentive staff, and affordable prices. Comfortable dining room is suitable for a dinner for 2 up to a medium sized party.

The location is a bit out of the way, but you should be able to get a taxi to take you there, even if you have to ask 2 or 3 until you find one that knows where you want to go (par for the course in Thailand!). But it's certainly worth the effort to find the place.

HIGHLY RECOMMEND
sample_reviews_en.author: Dave Weinstein

sample_reviews_en.text:
The decor was great and the menu looked good. Then the food arrived.

Unfortunately it just wasn't very good, definitely not up to the prices charged.
Chewy eggplant starter (should melt in the mouth, not chewed like a hard gum) with a minuscule portion of toasted bread (2 small slices) that wasn't crispy. Then fish with pesto. The fish was dry and overcooked, the pasta just ok but there again the portion too small, but the pesto was overwhelming and killed all other flavours. Plus he mixed some kind of chewy chinese mushrooms in the pasta that didn't match the dish at all.

800 bath (including a compulsory 10% service fee) for a chewy starter, an overcooked mains and a coke ?  I don't mind paying for good food but to this wasn't even close. I won't be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Serenia & Alain Bertholet

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been there 2-3 times. The first time I wanted to try the beef, the second time I tried the lamb, and the third time I tried some of the regular menu items. Each time I ordered a salad because there weren't many vegetables in the steak dishes. The price is moderate to high, but acceptable considering the ingredients, portion size, and the chef's experience. If the taste wasn't to my liking, I wouldn't go back. A plate of lamb costs 7-8 baht and is enough for two people. Don't miss the desserts. I'm impressed that the chef/owner asks about my preferences and recommends dishes that perfectly match my taste. I like going there because the restaurant is relatively quiet and not too crowded.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wachiraporn Buikwang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Spinach salad: Good, sweet, refreshing, fresh vegetables, delicious.
Bread: Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, delicious.
Clams: Not cleaned properly, found several stones, mild flavor, with a hint of wine.
Spaghetti with beef: Delicious, beef cooked perfectly, creamy sauce with onions.
Pork tenderloin: Slightly overcooked, a bit tough, but the garlic sauce paired well with it.

The owner is lovely and provides excellent service.

Finished the meal with pear ice cream: Sweet and sour, just right.

Overall, the food was delicious, but the price was a bit high.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ketchup

sample_reviews_en.text: For those who enjoy a quiet atmosphere with relaxing background music, besides steak, the other dishes are also interesting. It's a place I've visited many times and always enjoy. The steaks are priced according to weight, and overall it's good. The owner, P' Kai, is also very friendly and always willing to listen to feedback and make improvements.
sample_reviews_en.author: Norasun poti

restaurants.name: Madame Keaw Restaurant
restaurants.address:

59 Samsen 4 Alley, Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Unfortunately, it just wasn't tasty (neither the green curry nor the fried rice, nor the garlic and pepper chicken).

I went three times because my child wanted to have the very tasty croissants from the highly recommended café next door for breakfast, and unfortunately, it wasn't tasty each time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sebastian Diergardt

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was okay. The atmosphere was typical of this type of restaurant. Unfortunately, the staff lied - you pay after receiving your order.
I paid beforehand, and the lady tried to convince me that she only charged three coconatas, not four.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anatol Mickielewicz

sample_reviews_en.text: This cute little restaurant offers delicious food at a reasonable price. They have many vegetarian options, including tofu. I paid 80 baht for rice with vegetables and cashews in a sweet sauce. Relaxing music makes it a very cozy atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Magstes Bucht

sample_reviews_en.text: We had an authentic Thai meal at the restaurant. The service was excellent! The staff were very kind! The pad Thai and the fried noodles with shrimp were delicious! Special mention also for the mango salad: amazing! …
sample_reviews_en.author: Stephanie Quadros Tonelli

sample_reviews_en.text: beautiful thai food perfectly cooked, crispy veggies, a really lovely tom yum kung with 4 big langos in. close enought to the maddening crowd without being in it. thoroughly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: rats kobek

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was awesome, cheap (much cheaper than the other ones in the street) and tasted very well. The employees where very friendly and the food came within minutes after ordering
sample_reviews_en.author: Mels Frenken

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is really delicious! The prices are reasonable, the portions are generous, and it's incredibly tasty. (I'm from the same town as the owner!)
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐภัทร บุติกาวงษ์

sample_reviews_en.text: Located towards the end of the busy area, the price was very reasonable and the staff was very friendly. The food came out very quickly as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: A. Ogawa

restaurants.name: The Yard Restaurant
restaurants.address:

22, 1 ซอย สาทร 11 Yan Nawa, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🌟 The Yard Restaurant offers a homey atmosphere, like having a meal at a friend's house. Renovated from an old wooden house, the restaurant is beautifully decorated, spacious, and divided into several private and group seating areas.

🌟 The menu features both authentic Thai and Western fusion dishes. My favorite is the crispy pork belly – large pieces, crispy skin, and tender meat. I also recommend the pomelo salad and the fried flower salad; they're unique but surprisingly delicious. They have a wide selection of desserts, but the taro bingsu wasn't quite to my liking; it could have been sweeter and more fragrant.

📍📍Location: Sathorn Soi 11 (Saint Louis), near Assumption College Primary School. The restaurant is a short distance down the soi on the right-hand side.

✅ Open daily ⏰ 11:00 AM - 9:30 PM

🚗 Parking: Limited parking in front of the restaurant. We recommend parking at the AIA building (parking fees apply).
sample_reviews_en.author: Patinya Wisuth

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was actually good, but a little pricey. The atmosphere was great. It felt like a private venue with a garden in the middle. There were restaurants on both sides; one on the left was a cafe, perfect for relaxing and reading with a cup of coffee, and the one on the right was for those looking for a proper meal. Their menus were varied but the food tasted good.

The restaurant has a cozy, homey feel and beautiful decor. The atmosphere inside is warm and inviting. The food wasn't bad at all. Personally, I thought the prices were a little high, but it was worth trying. Parking might be a bit of a gamble, but overall, it's worth a visit if you're in the Sathorn area. :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Pocharaphol Wongpromvej

sample_reviews_en.text: I arrived at the restaurant at around 4:30 PM and there were no other customers at the table.When the staff saw what was happening and my friend walked in, they gave me a warm welcome.The menu has a wide variety. During the vegetarian festival that I went, the restaurant also sold vegetarian food.I love my friends ordering Thai food and ending with dessert.Every dish we ordered tasted good.Even though the Thai food we ordered was not traditional Thai, it was perfectly cooked.The price is quite high, but when compared to the atmosphere of the shop and the location, it is understandable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fury Mah Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is dog-friendly, perfect for pet-loving parents.

The food is delicious and tastes just like the air – the name of the restaurant, not the air you breathe, because it's owned by the same person.

I haven't even tried the pineapple fried rice yet, but just looking at it tells me it's going to be delicious.

And my partner finished the truffle mushroom soup by the time we got back to the table.

The lamb was incredibly tender, with a lovely light grilled aroma and a melt-in-your-mouth flavor.

The service is friendly and welcoming. Just pay the bill – it's worth it!
sample_reviews_en.author: พศภณ วัฒนสมบัติ

sample_reviews_en.text: Tucked away in the vibrant cityscape of Bangkok, The Yard offers a delightful dining experience with a cozy, laid-back atmosphere. The food is a fusion of Thai and international flavors, all prepared with fresh, high-quality ingredients. The staff are friendly and attentive, ensuring a warm welcome for both locals and tourists. Whether you’re looking for a casual meal or a place to relax with friends, The Yard’s inviting garden setting and thoughtful menu make it a perfect choice. A must-visit for anyone seeking a peaceful escape from the city’s hustle.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanchaya kuram

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was in the St. Louis/Sathorn area and wanted a place to work.
There are actually many cafes, but I don't know why I chose this one.

I was impressed from the moment I walked in, an atmosphere I didn't see from the outside.
The individual chairs facing the window seem to cater to current customer behavior—working alone or reading alone—and the atmosphere is great.

The coffee was excellent too. I lost track of time.

I'll have to try the food next time.

The service was also up to standard.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisby

sample_reviews_en.text:
The chicken massaman curry and squid ink spaghetti were delicious!
Many dishes tasted great, but the prices are high, around 400-500 baht per dish.
The atmosphere in the restaurant is nice, and the staff provided excellent service.
However, parking is very limited, only enough for 5-6 cars.
The entrance to park in front of the restaurant is also a bit difficult.
My friend said the restroom smelled terrible and they should improve it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sbview ssn

sample_reviews_en.text: I wanted to visit this place because the atmosphere seemed nice, but... we ordered pizza and salad, and the pizza was just... like frozen pizza. To think I'd get pizza like this in Sathorn... I was the one who chose this place, so I felt so bad for my friend. My friend was so upset that she even asked if it was homemade, and they said it was... If this is homemade pizza, then... hmm....
sample_reviews_en.author: 건방진륌삐

restaurants.name: Nua Kuck
restaurants.address:

61, 8-9 S. Vibhavadi Rangsit 16, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This somtum (papaya salad) restaurant lives up to its name, "Nua Kak" (meaning "deliciously flavorful"). I've tried their papaya salad, cucumber salad, long bean salad, and corn salad. I haven't tried their mango or star fruit salad yet. My top picks are the cucumber and long bean salads – they're neck and neck, practically identical! I love them both. Second place goes to the Korat-style somtum, and third to the corn somtum. The crab and fermented fish somtum was good, as usual, but not as amazing as the others. I highly recommend trying their somtum; it's definitely delicious here!

The side dishes are excellent, with pork, chicken, and other à la carte options. Order anything! Enjoy it with fermented fish sauce and sticky rice – it'll be gone in no time!

Oh, and there's no parking at the restaurant, so be prepared for that. 🥹
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanida S.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a simple, local somtum (papaya salad) restaurant, but the taste is anything but simple. It's easy to find, located on a main street. Everything is delicious. The grilled pork neck, corn salad, fried intestines with garlic, and spicy pork rib soup are all excellent. The restaurant is spacious, airy, and clean. The prices are reasonable. We went with 5 people, all big eaters, and ordered over 20 dishes – and the bill only came to 1,300 baht. We were completely full.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benz

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a Thai restaurant that offers a selection of very good quality local dishes. My Thai wife really enjoyed the Thai papaya salad, which she ordered several times. The staff is polite and helpful. I've ordered takeout and dined in several times. The food is good. They have an indoor dining area with plenty of tables. The prices are reasonable and the service is quick.
sample_reviews_en.author: François Cheutin

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Northeastern Thai restaurant serves a variety of Northeastern Thai dishes, including larb, koi, om, tom saap, miang pla, jim jum, pad mee korat, and various types of som tum (papaya salad) such as som tum pla ra, som tum Thai, som tum sua, etc.
Overall, the food is delicious.
It's clean, affordable, and the service is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Soottipong Winyoopradist

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the wait wasn't long at all. There's a wide variety of dishes on the menu. The papaya salad was surprisingly large, I loved it! I highly recommend the spicy pork rib soup and the Korat-style stir-fried noodles; you absolutely have to try them!
sample_reviews_en.author: Milk PM

sample_reviews_en.text:
My boyfriend and I ate here several times during our time in Bangkok. The food is delicious and the staff is very friendly and helpful. We would recommend this restaurant to anyone, whether local or tourist.

Warm regards from the bus to Phuket 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Cece Mariposa

sample_reviews_en.text: The star fruit salad is incredibly delicious! The mixed salad and the green bean salad with crispy pork are the best. The fried chicken and grilled pork neck are tasty. The sweet vegetable curry with ant eggs is overflowing with ant eggs!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pannarai Power

sample_reviews_en.text: Many delicious dishes, especially the stir-fried noodles with a perfect flavor. The papaya salad is also excellent. The owner is lovely and friendly. The staff provides good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: lucksika moonchinda

restaurants.name: Nai Lao Duck Noodle
restaurants.address:

1097 Rama IV Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been a regular customer of Nai Lao's duck noodle shop for many years. Every Sunday morning after attending Saphan Lueang Church, I'd eat there.

Until one day, I found a steel wool scouring pad in my bowl of noodles. I told the staff, and they went to tell the elderly owner. The owner just ignored it, as if it wasn't a big deal.

After that, my family stopped going there. We switched to Cheng Gong's Hainanese chicken rice instead; it's much safer and less risky.

I think to this day, they still don't realize why some customers have disappeared – it's all due to the owner's ignorance and lack of concern for cleanliness, or even the desire to apologize to customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Varanyu (Yu) S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
.:: Nai Lao Duck Noodle Soup ::.
🍜🦆
Banthad Thong Road is a hub of delicious food and trendy spots near Chulalongkorn University. This restaurant serves duck noodle soup and duck rice, with flavorful broth and gravy, along with tender duck meat.
But the absolute best is probably the duck basil stir-fry. Crispy fried duck meat stir-fried with basil, the flavor is incredibly rich. You won't be able to stop eating it, whether with rice or on its own.
💰 Rice/Noodle Soup: 50 THB per bowl / Duck Basil Stir-fry: 100 THB/bag
📍Banthad Thong, Samyan, Chulalongkorn University
[••• ••• •• ] (8/9 hedonic scale)
#OngjeedsDish #MustToEat #TomorrowI'llBeThin
sample_reviews_en.author: OngJeedS Natchar Mahannop

sample_reviews_en.text:
Samyan is known for lots of long-standing family-run eateries and…many duck noodle stalls too!

This one has a menu that goes beyond just duck, they got crispy pork too . But what really stood out were those super fine, silky flat rice noodles —so satisfying to slurp! It’s been a while since I’ve had noodles this delicate and smooth.

However the duck slices were a bit on the tough side but the offals were clean and nicely cooked. The soup has good flavour though it wasn’t as rich or aromatic as some of the older stalls in the area.

The stall is spacious and decent ventilation, it is a lot more comfortable to eat in especially on a hot day.
sample_reviews_en.author: J a (Ja)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This duck noodle and crispy pork rice shop has great-tasting food. The crispy pork is excellent, and the duck isn't tough. It's a small shop in a shophouse with fans. You can park behind the shop within Chulalongkorn University grounds (20 baht).

The service was excellent. I parked on the street and got my car towed 🥹
I had to go pay the fine at Pathumwan Police Station. The owner offered to give me a ride back and forth on his motorcycle. Amazing service mind!

I'll definitely go back again, but I won't park on the street again 🥺
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattana Pong

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small, old-fashioned noodle shop
serving Chinese-style braised duck.
Chinese herbs are added for a perfectly balanced flavor.
The duck has minimal gamey smell and tastes great.
They offer a variety of dishes.
Today I ordered duck soup with vermicelli noodles.
You can choose whether or not to include offal.
The staff remembered my order well.
Parking is available in front of the shop in the evening,
and there's also a parking lot behind the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nathiran

sample_reviews_en.text:
● The duck noodles are delicious. The broth is also delicious and has a unique aroma. I could finish the whole bowl.

● The price is average, usually around 50-60 baht.

● The chrysanthemum tea and iced black tea are also good.

● The shop is clean and the equipment is clean.

● The owner is polite, kind, and friendly. I highly recommend it.

***Please subscribe to the "google" YouTube channel. Thank you :) ***
sample_reviews_en.author: Champ Googagle

sample_reviews_en.text:
Experience in this shop was terrible.
I recommend to avoid this shop. Even the shop is clean, bowls and chopsticks look clean.
But!!!
Soup tastes too salty, Noodle is not properly cooked. Duck is overcooked and dry. Some random guy came in to the shop and chit chat with staff. Then he sit next to me and talk to the staff over my food, even the whole shop is empty. This bother me so much and staff ignores it.
sample_reviews_en.author: : Petch

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nai Lao's Duck Noodle Soup, a seventy-year-old establishment from Chakrawat, boasts tender duck meat and a rich, flavorful broth. The standout dish is the duck intestines, braised duck leg with Chinese herbs and kale – absolutely delicious!

Ordered fresh spring rolls, pork intestine soup, steamed rice flour dumplings, and chive dumplings from the shop next door to complement the meal.

#Eatanywhere
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachit Chairat

restaurants.name: Pad Thai Ar-Simp (Bantadthong)
restaurants.address:

1458 Banthat Thong Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pad Thai Ar-simp is an old, established restaurant, passed down through generations. I tried their Pad Thai at the Banthat Thong branch, now run by the third generation (the first branch was run by their mother). Anyone who says Banthat Thong doesn't have delicious food should think again! 😄

The flavor of their Pad Thai is "perfectly balanced and delicious without needing any extra seasoning." The noodles are chewy, the tamarind flavor is amazing, and the sauce is a perfect balance of salty, sweet, and sour. They even roast their own peanuts, which add a wonderful aroma. And it starts at only 60 baht! The restaurant has air conditioning, clean tables, and a restroom, making it a great option in the notoriously expensive Banthat Thong area.

The restaurant is completely smoke-free, and they even include crispy fish for added protein. Delicious, great value, and a fantastic price!

📍 Pad Thai Ar-simp, Banthat Thong Branch
💰 Starting from 60 baht
⏱️ 4 PM - 12 AM
🚘 Parking: Chulalongkorn University Centennial Park or Stadium One (small parking fee applies)
🙏🏻 P.S. Their grilled pork neck is amazing! Try it!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: พรุ่งนี้ค่อยลด 2morrowdiet

sample_reviews_en.text:
[Food]
Shrimp Pad Thai (Pad Thai Kung) ★★★★☆
Pad Thai that's not too sweet. The sweet and sour flavors are well-balanced. The shrimp was cooked directly from frozen, without thawing, so it was a bit undercooked. (You can see the cooking area.)

Spicy Crispy Pork ★★★☆
The texture is delicious when it's freshly fried. The sauce is tangy.

[Service & Atmosphere]
The food is excellent, but the hygiene is a bit lacking. Large trash bags are placed inside, and ants and flies swarm the sticky tables. If you're concerned, the cooking area is located outside, so grabbing or takeout is recommended. Located in a market, the price is reasonable for the quality of the food.

+The food is generally sour and sweet, so it didn't pair well with the orange juice. We took the orange juice out for dessert.
sample_reviews_en.author: 름식

sample_reviews_en.text:
Craving for moo krob (crispy roast pork). Saw the pork hanging in the window so took a gamble. Ordered the
1. spicy fried moo krob. Ok taste. 6 out of 10.  Alittle bit fatty
2. Fried turnip cake. Dish was precooked before and then fried (reheated) in wok. So it was cold inside. Wasn't fresh. No wok hei. Tried to explain to waitress. Lost in translation.

Overall the staff and cooks seem tired. Maybe a long day. 🥱

Think this is a hit and miss place. Hopefully you will have a better experience than us.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hoi C

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been to Banthong Road 3 times and eaten at 6 restaurants. This one is the best of the 6. Their Pad Thai is authentic, with all the ingredients, perfectly cooked – not too soggy and not too sweet. The stir-fried chicken is also delicious. They use good quality crispy squid and give a generous portion. I recommend the fried Dolly fish.
sample_reviews_en.author: j_soraya

sample_reviews_en.text: The Pad Thai had a moderate flavor, and the noodles were chewy and soft. The grilled pork neck was real pork neck, but it seemed like it had been pre-grilled and then reheated by frying, searing, or microwaving. The Tom Yum soup was creamy and a little too sweet, but the seafood was fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: Monkeyaey

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, truly deserving of the "Two Golden Spoons" award from The Spoon TV show. They have a Mother's Day promotion: order the "Auntie's Pad Thai" (the restaurant's signature dish) and get a free stir-fried chicken, dry sukiyaki with marinated pork, or radish cake. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: kulkas

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted delicious, but the service was terrible. My boyfriend and I specifically came to this restaurant to order the "Auntie's Instant Noodle Hot Pot" dish. However, since it was our first time, we didn't realize the names were …
sample_reviews_en.author: Yananthon Naksingha

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was generally tasty. The Pad Thai was delicious, but the crispy pork in the Pad Thai seemed like it had been prepared a while ago or something; it wasn't very crispy and a bit chewy. I really liked the grilled pork neck. There …
sample_reviews_en.author: Mm Wawa

restaurants.name: Daeng Pochana
restaurants.address:

792 792 Phiraphong Rd, Wang Burapha Phirom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It has crispy pork and other meats, but I can't tell what kind...
As you can see in the picture, it's exactly what we think it is... a sweet and salty sauce, lol. I thought it would be a bit bland and plain, like Pak La Pao Moo Sap or Khao Kha Moo, but it's a sweet and salty sauce with just the right amount of seasoning, so it's a bit addictive... After one bowl (a small amount for an adult male), I couldn't finish it, so I ordered another. I ate it with the soy sauce and sliced ​​chilies on the table, and I ate it with a chili or two. The slightly spicy, sweet, and salty flavors were perfect together, lol.
I went in for breakfast with no expectations, but it was quite delicious, lol. (Crispy Pork Rice Bowl 2 + Water = 150 baht)

※I couldn't eat it because there was no information on whether it was satay or moo ping.🤨🤨🤨
sample_reviews_en.author: 아야어여으이

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ate here two years ago and posted it on Facebook. I just noticed it wasn't posted on Google.

This old restaurant is delicious, charming, and reasonably priced. I used to go there often because I had to go find food in that area. Recently, I changed jobs and haven't been there much.

I went back that day to find food and stopped by to eat. Everything was just as delicious as before, but the restaurant has moved to a new location.
I use the word "classic" for this type of restaurant.
If I have the chance to go there again, I'll definitely go there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Term

sample_reviews_en.text: Daeng Pochana is one of the older restaurants in the Lang Wang area. I ordered the Tom Yum Yen Ta Fo noodles for 60 baht. For me, the soup had a medium to light body, with a strong spiciness from the chili powder and no sweetness. The noodles were cooked well, with a nice chewy texture. There were plenty of toppings, but nothing particularly outstanding. Overall, it was edible and nothing to complain about, but nothing exceptional either. Parking might be difficult; you might have to park at Mega Plaza, China World, or The Old Siam.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prachaya Harncharoen

sample_reviews_en.text:
This time I was quite disappointed. They were rude when I paid, and they removed the spring onions that had been placed on the table from the start, even though they should have been edible. They were considered prepared for the customer, not something that needed to be ordered.
But if the staff had removed them before I was even eating, that would have been unacceptable service and made the customer feel really bad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chana K

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my second time eating here, and the taste is just as delicious as before. The restaurant doesn't only have rice dishes; they also have noodles. The prices are good, starting at 60 baht. If you pay by bank transfer, the minimum transfer amount is 150 baht. If you're coming alone and not eating a lot, bring some cash. Parking is limited.
It's about a 3-minute walk from MRT Sam Yot station.
sample_reviews_en.author: เดชาธร คลซื่อ

sample_reviews_en.text: The roast pork rice is excellent and comes with chilled spring onions. The fish ball noodles with Yen Ta Fo are delicious. The pork satay is delicious, thick and soft, just the right amount. The pickled vegetables are good. The food is fresh and clean. If you come to visit The Old, you can stop by. This old restaurant has moved from the Piraka Market.
sample_reviews_en.author: นุชจรินทร์ เวโรจนากรณ์

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. Today I ordered rice with roasted pork and crispy pork, and wonton noodles. I really liked the wonton noodles; the noodles were perfectly springy and the broth was delicious. I really enjoyed it! The price is a little high, but the portions are generous and the taste is great. It's worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธวัชชัย อารีย์

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop near The Old Siam serves red pork rice, crispy pork rice, clear soup noodles, tom yum noodles, and yen ta fo noodles. The prices are all delicious, and the pork is truly crispy when you order it. There are both plain and mixed options, so the prices are different.
sample_reviews_en.author: novem xtis

restaurants.name: สเต็กอร่อยเหาะ @ บางกอบัว
restaurants.address:

Phetchahung Rd, Bang Kachao, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The portions are really big for the price you pay.
The fried chicken I ordered is done like a schnitzel, very crunchy on the outside and moist on the inside. French fries and coleslaw are included, for the price of 90 baht. I put in my glasses for size comparison haha.
The lemon ice tea is 30 baht, which is really affordable too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nguyen Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. I ordered the beef and pork steaks; the portions were large, perfectly marinated, and not tough. The drunken noodles with shrimp were delicious, with fresh, large shrimp. Overall, everything was tasty. You can park right in front of the restaurant. I arrived around 1:30 PM, so it might have been a bit hot.
sample_reviews_en.author: coldday

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a pleasant and delicious meal at affordable prices. For example, the basil chicken/pork dish is only 39 baht, and drinks are around 20 baht per glass. There's parking available next to the restaurant. The taste is good, although the basil chicken/pork was a little too salty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patramet Tansiri

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here, and I was very impressed. I didn't expect the portions to be so generous. It's great value for money, not expensive at all. They even offered to pack up the leftovers I couldn't finish. I'll definitely be back! Love it! 😘😘😘😘
sample_reviews_en.author: นภาพร ชูแก้ว

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a prominent steak restaurant in this area. The menu style is similar to Samyan Steak. The taste is acceptable and the price is friendly. Personally, I prefer the made-to-order dishes here. Many dishes are very delicious. However, I …
sample_reviews_en.author: DukeTK

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate Tom Yum shrimp 🦐，  was like a set for $60 bats the flavor was very good..fresh and full of flavor. The eggs was fried in the moment. My friend ate the green curry and they said was also delicious 🤤. I also recommend try the Thai tea.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adel

sample_reviews_en.text: The black pepper pork steak was delicious and tender, but the sauce was a bit too sweet. The food came out quickly, and the price was reasonable. The roof is made of metal sheeting, so it can get quite stuffy without wind.
sample_reviews_en.author: นิวัฒน์ กิจรุ่งเรืองกุล

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a restaurant that sells various steaks, spaghetti, and simple fried foods. The taste is decent, the prices are affordable, they have many types of steaks, and the portions are very generous.
sample_reviews_en.author: รัตนา สร้อยสุวรรณ

Photo 2 dans l'avis rédigé par Yosuke Ono
Photo 3 dans l'avis rédigé par Yosuke Ono
3 autres photos dans l'avis rédigé par Yosuke Ono
Photo 1 dans l'avis rédigé par Tharaphop Pokaanon
Photo 2 dans l'avis rédigé par Tharaphop Pokaanon

restaurants.name: ก๋วยจั๊บเยาวราชเจ้าเก่า เฮียตั่วเท๊า
restaurants.address:

385 Itsaranuphap Aly, Chakkrawat, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Crispy pork is a must-try! This place serves amazing clear broth noodle soup 🍲✨
If you're in the area and miss this place, you'll regret it! The clear broth noodle soup is rich and flavorful, with a fragrant pepper aroma that tickles your nose. Sipping it hot is pure bliss. But the absolute highlight is the "crispy pork." The skin is incredibly crunchy, the meat is perfectly tender, and the offal is clean and odorless.
The noodles are also perfectly cooked, not mushy, with a nice chewy texture. The prices are very reasonable, truly befitting a long-established and famous restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Luktan Toro

sample_reviews_en.text: Because the shop is in the middle of the market, the seating isn't very inviting due to its cramped space. However, the vendor provides good service, and the noodle soup (Khao Piak) is delicious. The flavor isn't overly strong with stewed pork; it's more peppery and salty with fish sauce. They give a decent amount of toppings, but very little soup. I ordered the noodle soup without rice, and the portion of soup was less than half full. I finished the soup before the rice even arrived. It feels like it's expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paninie W

sample_reviews_en.text:
Uncle Tua Tao's Old-Style Yaowarat Noodle Soup Shop 🍲
This is another shop I have to come back to. The broth has a strong, fragrant pepper flavor, perfectly balanced and satisfying. The offal is very well-prepared, with no unpleasant smell at all. The pieces are large and substantial, especially the liver which is perfectly tender. I was very impressed. Even though it was hot and I was sweating while eating, I can honestly say it was incredibly satisfying. It was definitely worth the trip to eat here.
sample_reviews_en.author: ALISA LAPP

sample_reviews_en.text:
While browsing the market, I saw locals lining up to eat something, so I just blindly followed suit. It turned out to be a street stall selling Kuay Jab.

Perhaps because it was lunchtime, I waited for about 10 minutes. When I ordered, they asked what kind of meat I wanted, so I just told them to put everything in.

It was my first time trying Kuay Jab, and I really enjoyed it!

However, the portion was smaller than I expected, so it felt more like a snack than a proper meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Juno

sample_reviews_en.text: This noodle soup (kuy chap) stall in Yaowarat market offers both thick and clear broth options, as well as pork blood soup and rice. The taste is delicious; the broth is rich and flavorful, unlike other stalls that use a sweet, clear broth. I like that they provide pepper to add. The stall is quite hot, with a constant flow of customers. The food is served hot and quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Atisnoob Pnr

sample_reviews_en.text: Another hidden gem was discovered in Chinatown, Bangkok. Some might frequented the famous Kway Jab stall along the main road. I suggest trying this stall. It has a different flavor profile, which is not the usual peppery kind. It has a distinct shallot oil taste. Overall, it's definitely worth your sweat to try this out. 👍🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: Koh Shun Quan

sample_reviews_en.text: The best part of the noodle shop is the peppery broth and the crispiest pork belly that seems to be a match made in heaven. Been frequenting the place for more than 15 years and still maintains the same quality. The tight dining area and the humid atmosphere seems to be the perfect vibe for this Chinatown treasure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Francis Fetalvero

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a non-spicy noodle soup, suitable for those who don't like spicy food (you can add chili powder and pepper yourself). It includes crispy pork and various offal.
Personally, I didn't find the taste quite to my liking, and the noodles were soggy, but the location is excellent and definitely worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kuma Odd

restaurants.name: Blackmoon Bangkok
restaurants.address:

1113 -​ 1117 ชั้น​ 5​- 6, Phahonyothin Rd, พญาไท, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Not suitable for those who can't climb a lot of stairs. The entrance requires a climb of 2-3 more flights of stairs before you actually reach the actual entrance.

The service is excellent, everyone is attentive and friendly. You can have the bartender make you a customized cocktail, just ask for your desired flavor.

The food is delicious. The truffle spaghetti is delicious and not too rich. They also have mala skewers available to order.

The music is great, and the musicians are attentive and entertaining. Both bands, even though they're from different genres, are attentive.

If you want to take a photo with the moon, head to the top floor. You'll see the Skytrain passing by the restaurant, making it a great photo opportunity.

There are two floors of bathrooms. The air-conditioned floor is shared, while the top floor is segregated for men and women. Vomiting is prohibited. A 500 baht fine is imposed for those who vomit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tonfun Phiphatthada

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem in the Ari area 🌕 located on the 5th floor of a building, with both indoor and outdoor seating. It was raining on the day we went, so we opted to sit inside. The music was amazing! The band was great, never too slow, and the entertainment was excellent. The transitions were also great.
The seats were spacious and comfortable, with little moons on the tables, which really complemented the restaurant's theme.
The food was delicious, especially the mala (spicy pork). I couldn't resist ordering it. Another highlight was the hot fries with mayonnaise. They were so delicious I wanted to ask for some mayonnaise to take home. My friends kept complimenting me on how delicious their fries were.
If you're looking for a place to chill and hang out with friends, I highly recommend this place. The owner is also very friendly.
P.S. Be careful when you come back down the stairs! 🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: Mynameisnok kkk

sample_reviews_en.text:
When you take the promotion 3 jars of beer (a jar of 1L) and you get 1 glass of 50ml for free ,
- i would recommend you to make sure that you’ve received all three jars.
- you should know that the free glass, they already put in the 3rd jar WITHOUT telling you before so when you look for the free glass of 50ml there’s no glass of it.
It’s not about the money it’s about HONESTY please!!
If the owner is seeing this review, you can check on the camera. We were at the table next to the cashier on the 4th December 2023 between 19:30pm-21:30pm.
The welcome service was nice at the beginning, it could be better if your staff can stay in a good manner with the clients especially the lady at the bar.
Sadly, you have a nice place, nice dishes but one rude staff can broke everything. Bad experience for this time.
sample_reviews_en.author: pimpisa nititiranun

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today we ate in the rooftop area. Depending on the Thai weather, it was a bit dark, but the atmosphere was good. I wish they would add more lights so I could see the food better. The music wasn't too loud, which was good for chatting with friends. I recommend the rooftop area. The live music area is quite loud, but the air conditioning is comfortable. The BTS train noise drowns out any conversation, but it comes infrequently. The speakers for the live music downstairs are even louder.
But the salt-grilled salmon was delicious.
The beef fried rice was filling, but dry. If you prefer your rice piping hot, order something else.
The fried pork larb needs to be eaten quickly because it's quite salty. If you leave it for too long, the saltiness will become overwhelming.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pittawat Saetang

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is okay, but it's very high up, mom. It's tiring to walk up and down six floors, so be careful if you're drunk. The band is good, but the sound system is poor. It's very loud. The bathroom stank of mothballs. There were few restrooms. The restaurant is divided into four or five zones, each of which is quite narrow and crowded. The food is okay, but it's hard to call the servers. The outdoor zone has no staff standing by. It takes a while to get them to call you. The atmosphere is exactly as advertised. The food is okay, but it takes an hour and a half. Hello! It's not good when you're hungry. They charge VAT and service charge.
There's no parking, so you might have to park in Soi Ari.
sample_reviews_en.author: MOMO N.

sample_reviews_en.text: Not good at all. Food is very expensive. Waited for 2 hours. Taste is like 50-60 baht per dish. French fries are delicious. But the truffle spaghetti is very salty. The shop is very loud, very dark. Eating is almost impossible to see. It doesn't feel like a restaurant, more like a pub. Booked another table and got another. The chairs are not comfortable. The floor is tilted. Sitting is always sliding. If you want to dance, no one is dancing. If you want to talk, you can't hear each other. Eating is also impossible to see. I don't understand why they are here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kulsaran P

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered the Gin Girl cocktail, priced at 320 baht (excluding 7% VAT). The flavor was rich, sweet, and fragrant with cinnamon. The shop is easy to find. Just walk down from Ari BTS station and head back towards the Pearl Bangkok building.
The shop is located on the third floor, on the rooftop of a shophouse. We went on a Friday. It wasn't crowded, so we enjoyed the cool breeze and the view of the moon and the train. There was live music playing, which was a great way to escape the hustle and bustle.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chonnicha P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere was great, the music was good, but the place was a bit small. The table we got was small, and the chairs were uncomfortable. There were two of us, but the table felt insufficient. This might be because it was a Friday and we walked in without a reservation, so all the larger tables were already taken.

The food was delicious though. We ordered a few things to share, but they were surprisingly good. The beer was refreshingly cold, perfect. We might come back again if we have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Soon Nerd

restaurants.name: The Tavern
restaurants.address:

21 19 Sukhumvit 4 Alley, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stopped into The Tavern because I heard about their food and I was impressed. It was Tuesday, so they had a special menu for Mexican food. Tacos, enchiladas, beans with meat, etc.

The food was great. I was not expecting the tacos to be as large as they were, nor how delectable they would be. I had the steak and ground beef tacos. I was stunned at how good they were. The meat was "melt in your mouth" soft and delicious. The burger and fries were also great.

And one other thing I wasn't expecting, was how friendly the staff and the customers were. It seemed like everyone knew each other's names already. I wasn't sure where to sit, but everyone was so friendly and asked for me to sit near them. They invited me into their conversation and I felt like I had been a long time customer, even though it was my first time in.

Enjoy the food here, stay for the company.
sample_reviews_en.author: Determined dirty panda

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve been here several times and always feel welcomed by the staff. I went back again last night for a chill dinner with a friend. The restaurant was full and had such a lively atmosphere, with people chatting and enjoying their time. It’s a kind of vibe you don’t usually get at regular Thai restaurants.

We ordered a cheeseburger and a grilled cheese this time, and both were really good. The owner was very nice and even gave us a sample of his cake, which was delicious. I also tried the steak before and it was juicy and flavorful. The cheesecake I had last time was rich and delicious too. Definitely recommend trying the dessert here!

If you’re around the Asok or Nana area and looking for a chill spot with cold beer and good food, definitely check this place out!
sample_reviews_en.author: Blair

sample_reviews_en.text:
My second visit review in the morning reflects a one-star improvement in all categories. The staff was pleasant, the food was excellent and the clientele were a bunch of good people.
First visit right before closing
The lady that stayed in the small office was pissy and angry.
The shining light in the entire affair was the female that cooked my hamburger to perfection. Delicious! Very little room for improvement. She was tipped accordingly and I hope she tipped out the others after a little knowledge has been bestowed upon them.
I will be back but I will never visit during dark hours again based on the experience I had.
I usually like to add photos in my reviews but I didn't want to push my luck because they seemed  angry and hostile.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dugless Mohr

sample_reviews_en.text: Home away from home for States. Things are changed a bit since 2 years ago. Instead of cartoons and Playboy mag clippings now it's service patches from military, police around world. 😁​ And Tawadaeng lager and dark on tap. Food still good thing as before. 😊 Windows have been opened up to give more airiness around the central bar. Original review 2024: Home away from home for USA. Place is time capsule of days gone by, in all the good ways. Gary Larson cartoons, clips from old Playboy magazines. Unique for Bangkok. Multiple tellies in small place, and friendly crowd. Only one beer on tap though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Misma Silfver

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is absolutely delicious and fresh. Cold beet! We ordered the bacon cheeseburger and the bacon cheese chicken burger. I think they put the entire chicken on the burger. Absolutely delicious. Hamburger was meaty, Juicy and flavorful. The ladies that work there are very friendly.  I always buy them a round  drinks(inexpensive lady drinks). I travel by myself so it's great to have drinking buddies.
I went there the next morning for breakfast and had the bacon egg and cheese sandwich It was just as delightful as the dinner. Definitely give this place a try. You will not be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Casey

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place for breakfast lunch ect. . Very friendly owner  Who is American and speaks English. Being my first time in Thailand I met an American outside. We started a conversation and carried it inside. The service is quick and professional. All food is spot on. I have been out of the USA for close to six months this place hits the spot. Bathroom is very clean. Building has AC. highly reccommend to anyone who comes here who wants a great American breakfast or really just a conversation, food a beer and a break from the heat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gustavo Restrepo

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have had breakfast in a few places in Bangkok and NONE are even close to THE TAVERN. and the girls who cook your food are so customer service friendly..they don't beg you for drinks and cook like professional chefs .
I love the food here and the owners and management make you fell like you are family when you walk in the door, I know TOM will put you up on whats what in Bangkok if you are new timers..I love the breakfast sandwich, but they have good meals throughout the day 😋..if you miss the TAVERN its your loss 10 stars!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Randell Simon

sample_reviews_en.text: Wow. Unexpected jewel! One of the best burgers I have had in Bangkok. Simple, tasty American style burger. I had the bacon cheese burger and the bacon was greatness  and the cheese real. Onions just a bit sweet and strong. Cooked to perfection. Beef tasted like western style beef without a hint of that eastern beef taste. In Nana hankering for an American style burger? Come by to this place. Questentiall hole in the wall place that ticks all the boxes for a burger.
sample_reviews_en.author: Justaguy

restaurants.name: TUK-TUK BAR & BISTRO
restaurants.address:

61 Phadung Dao Rd, Khwaeng Samphanthawong, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Was very eager to eat at this restaurant since the menu featured vegetarian dishes. I placed the order first with someone who didn't understand it despite me pointing to the menu. He called someone else who also couldn't understand anything I said and couldn't answer a question. Then the third person took our order and seemed confused by the very simple order of two people.
Food took forever to come out.
And I took one look at the curry and knew it was going to be really bad. Ordered panang curry and got some watered down crap tofu thing where the peas weren't cooked. No veggies in the dish. Expensive compared to other places.
Maybe their positive is their cocktails and the quieter atmosphere but don't ever come here expecting the food to be good.
One of the worse meal I had in three weeks in Thailand.
Staff was sweet and kind.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bindu Oommen Fernandes

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is a gem hidden amongst hundreds of food choices. We stumbled upon this place after rigorously searching for something safe and appealing to eat. The staff were very friendly and attentive to their customers. Warm inviting staff is always a plus in my book. The restaurant is very clean and the food options are plenty.
I decided on the traditional Asian cuisine and damn it was amazing. The portion was somewhat small for me but the price was so good that I ordered 2 of them. One with shrimp and another with chicken. I requested mild spice and it was just the perfect amount of heat that wouldn't burn a hole in my stomach but enough to thoroughly enjoy the food. I highly recommend this place for great food and really dedicated staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrew Clairsentien

sample_reviews_en.text:
A nice restaurant to sit down and eat in, in Chinatown. The food I had was really good here and the atmosphere was very fun. I think our experience may have been better food-wise because I ate with a Thai friend so they made more authentic perhaps than normal, as there were quite a few tourists outside too. I ate here as a group, though, and everyone’s tastes were catered for; from a member who doesn’t like spicy food as is a fussy to my husband and I who love spicy food and wanted to eat more authentically Thai.
I had the “drunken” noodles which our Thai friend recommended and they were very good, especially for my first meal in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicole Blackbourn

sample_reviews_en.text: So we wanted somewhere close to our hotel and as always the google maps rested helped.  Not sure if it was the right thing to do but I ordered one of the dishes I make at home for comparison, superb food, but wishing I ordered slightly spicy instead of thai hot, however I persevered and the food was delicious, tracie tried a similar dish but sensibly went for medium spice.  Service has been great, food superb and great people watching place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Chapple

sample_reviews_en.text:
Service was friendly, but the food was very bland. I had mild stomach issues and diarrhea the next day and a half.
I came in after normal dinner hours and there were only 2 other tables. I ordered the panang tofu. It came out very light yellow and soupy. Lacking in flavor. The tofu is just large chunks of plain white firm tofu. The cauliflower shrimp tasted like it was just steamed and sauce was poured on top.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gloria M

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolute gem just off the main drag in China Town. Came here as it was highly reviewed and was not disappointed. Food was the best we've had in Bangkok. Pad Thai was gorgeous and the banana and taro spring rolls for dessert were lovely. Prices are very reasonable too. Seems to be family run. Service was prompt and very friendly. Would recommend to anyone.
sample_reviews_en.author: richard stagg

sample_reviews_en.text: Stumbled across this place only because I saw a group with a tower of beer and thought why not call in for 1. Decided to have the Pad Thai and it was simply amazing and all you expect fm an authentic Thai dish. Staff are lovely and friendly. Great place for lunch and a rest fm walking the markets, less than $16 AUS with 2 large beers
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Pitman

sample_reviews_en.text: Unfortunately, I didn't get to eat at this cafe because I was waiting for my taxi. But the staff is very friendly and sweet, especially the girl in the red sweater. I was standing there eating a mango, and she offered me a seat at their table so I wouldn't have to stand there. It was so kind of her, my heart melted.
sample_reviews_en.author: Olesya Tsarenkova

restaurants.name: Haha Mala Chinatown
restaurants.address:

57, 59 Thanon Phat Sai, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem that's not mainstream 🥲 I want everyone to go try it! When we went, there were hardly any people. To be honest, I wondered if it would even be good since there weren't many people, but it exceeded my expectations! It was delicious, the staff provided great service, and the owner was very kind. There's a 2-hour time limit, but the staff didn't ask for the bill or rush us out. The owner even told us to eat a lot! 5555555 They were so good at refilling the soup! They kept coming back to refill it after we'd been eating for a while. 5555555 I really want this place to become more popular! After we'd been eating for a while, a lot of Chinese tourists started arriving. I'll definitely go again. I'm so impressed! Thumbs up! 👍🏻🥹
P.S. I wish they had desserts like ice cream!
sample_reviews_en.author: Naramon NOICHAIYAPRUEK

sample_reviews_en.text:
🔥 OUYU, a newly opened restaurant in Yaowarat (Chinatown), combines shabu-shabu with traditional Chinese lotus root soup and delicious grilled meats all in one place.
🌶️ The mala spice provides a perfectly balanced numbing sensation.
🍲 The lotus root soup is fragrant and refreshing.
🥩 The grilled meat is tender and juicy; a perfect combination!
The restaurant has a modern Chinese atmosphere, ideal for both shabu-shabu and meat lovers. Don't miss it if you're in Yaowarat!
• The staff are lovely and provide excellent service, constantly refilling the soup.
📍 Restaurant Location: 藕遇 OUYU, Yaowarat (Soi Phat Sai)
⏰ Open 11:00 AM – 11:00 PM
sample_reviews_en.author: supattra pramsornbut

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've walked past this restaurant so many times 🤣 and finally decided to try it, and let me tell you, I wasn't disappointed! Haha Mala serves authentic Sichuan hot pot, directly imported from Chengdu 🐲🌶

The hot pot is HUGE! They have several soup options, and the flavors are incredibly rich and delicious – I couldn't stop eating! 🥢

The ingredients are top-notch; the vegetables, beef, pork, shrimp, tofu skin, and skewers (mala skewers) are incredibly diverse and satisfying. You can also customize your own dipping sauces to your heart's content 🏮

I'm definitely going back again! 💖
sample_reviews_en.author: NongBam Boo

sample_reviews_en.text:
I specifically ordered the 399 menu item just to eat it.

However, when I tried to order the 399 item, they said it was sold out and wouldn't give it to me.

Even the basic 299 menu item didn't show up as sold out.

Shouldn't they have told me in advance that this menu item wasn't available? ㅠㅠ

Also, it lacked the characteristic numbing sensation of mala.

Even the hot pot I ate in Italy felt much more authentically Chinese than this. And the meat was seriously tough ㅠㅠ The tofu tasted sour, too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Won워니

sample_reviews_en.text: Today we had a promotion for 199 baht instead of 299 baht. There's a wide variety of food, including beef, pork, and seafood, at a great price. The soup was delicious and flavorful. The food arrived very quickly. The staff were attentive, and the owner was lovely, even serving us at our table. They really cared for every customer. The atmosphere was like being in China; there were a lot of Chinese people eating there. Very impressed 💕 We'll definitely come back again 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: chon

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
For all mala lovers, don't miss this! 🥢 Rich, flavorful broth with just the right amount of spiciness and numbness. Packed with ingredients, it gives you an authentic Chinese feel – you'll almost be transported to Beijing! 🤩

📌Currently offering 👇👇👇
📢 📢Promotion 🔥📅
🔥 HAHA MALA Chinatown 🔥
Authentic Chinese-style mala hot pot and BBQ
Super value deal for only 199 baht!
Spicy, numbing, and intensely flavorful – you'll be shouting "Hahaha!" after every bite! 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: BABY THAIGIRL

sample_reviews_en.text: Second time here! Found this place by just walking and as a mala lover I had to try and it was fairly new, everything was super clean and hygienic. Staff were quick to understand what I wanted to order and they have unlimited plum ice d tea option too 🩶 wish they just played some music in the background because it was a little awkward eating at a restaurant that is super silent so everyone could hear each other’s conversations 😅 otherwise 10/10 !
sample_reviews_en.author: fyena

sample_reviews_en.text: It's incredibly delicious, and the restaurant is super clean. The atmosphere is amazing. Whether you come alone, with friends, or with family, it's perfect. The pork and beef are so fresh and delicious, and the vegetables are incredibly fresh. Everyone really has to try it! The price is also incredibly cheap, great value for money. Come in large numbers, everyone! It's a hidden gem in Yaowarat, and the staff provides excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: TIKTOK FOMNAKUB FOMNAKUB

restaurants.name: Chef Pao Italian Homemade
restaurants.address:

24 39 Sukhumvit 65, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Overpriced based on overall quality and service."

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you find yourself in the vibrant Rama9 area and have a hankering for some delicious Italian cuisine, look no further than Chef Pao Italian Homemade. Tucked away in a small corner, this unassuming restaurant packs a punch when it comes to delivering mouthwatering flavors.

The menu at Chef Pao is a testament to their commitment to traditional Italian cooking. Offering a variety of classic dishes, each carefully crafted with fresh ingredients and prepared with love, it's clear that quality is a top priority. From the moment my appetizers arrived, I knew I was in for a treat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wisanu Tuntawiroon

sample_reviews_en.text: I've definitely eaten here at least 10 times. It's a homey Italian restaurant with a warm atmosphere. The decor might not be fancy in the city center, but the food is just as good as any high-end restaurant. Chef Pao makes the best spaghetti, no matter the dish. I heard he's selling the restaurant, and I wanted to write this review to encourage him. I'll be so sad if I don't get to taste Chef Pao's cooking again. It's become one of my favorite restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Linlada

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every dish at this Italian restaurant is delicious, and the ingredients are plentiful. The owner pays attention to every detail in each dish, which is so lovely. It's one of my regular spots, but I never manage to take pictures!
I highly recommend it to anyone passing through this area. My favorite dessert is the Tiramisu cake, but it's not available every day, so you have to ask the staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peace Peace

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't want to go here again and I don't understand why it only has 5 stars. I ordered 2 main dishes and 1 side dish, but this is the first time in my life that all 3 dishes were tasteless.... The main dishes were not fresh and the shellfish was spoiled. I also asked for a refund after eating one fork, but they refused and I ended up paying the full price.
sample_reviews_en.author: daniel kim

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to this place because of its reviews but honestly I think it's over-rated. I ordered pork chop, the meat was tough with pathetic portion (only a small scoop of mashed potato and 5 stalks of mushrooms, not even a single vegetable. The service was cold. I expected warm welcome as it is family restaurant and homemade food but it's not the case.
sample_reviews_en.author: Grace Lim

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and flavorful, served quickly, and reasonably priced. However, there's a slight dog smell. Occasionally, the dog defecates in the restaurant. While it's been cleaned up, it would be good to spray some alcohol to eliminate the odor.
sample_reviews_en.author: menisa sompit

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish was amazing! The chef was lovely and in a great mood, maybe a little surprised. This time I went with two senior colleagues, but we ordered a lot! The staff were incredibly nice too. I loved it! 😍😍😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Soda infinity

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pork steak was delicious, perfectly grilled.
The sauce was good, and the mashed potatoes were smooth.
The squid ink spaghetti had a great, flavorful taste. It was delicious and the price was reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: BIGMAX AUTO บิ๊กแม็กซ์

restaurants.name: Khao Kang 1974
restaurants.address:

QF5X+WHR, Ram Buttri Aly, Talat Yot, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: A traditional street food restaurant with ready-made dishes in bowls. You choose what you want and pay according to the quantity. 1 side dish with rice 40 ฿, 2 side dishes 50 ฿, etc. The food is good. Many Thai customers too.
sample_reviews_th.author: Aki Ilmanen

sample_reviews_en.text: Coming here for years now! Nowhere in Bangkok have I found better Thai street food with the same price, taste, and quality standards! This is how Thailand used to be 20-25 years ago. The deep fried catfish, pad kra pao, and green curry are …
sample_reviews_en.author: Aslan Venom

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is so annoying!!!!! In good way, we've been coming on and off for 3 or 4 years and it's still excellent, the food is so good and tasty with many many choices, we ate here most nights, I want to try other places but the value for …
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Middleton

sample_reviews_en.text:
I eat many times here when I stay around Khaosan. Eating and take away.
Here is a long-standing food stall. The staff are always smiling and kindly, and the best thing is that there are many types of Thai food, and everything is …
sample_reviews_en.author: MoNa IRo

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's so delicious.

Thai home-style set meal.

1 topping. 2 toppings. 3 toppings. Please choose your favorite.

The curry varieties are too sweet for Koreans.

It is extremely hot since we are outdoors. Please get it to go.
sample_reviews_en.author: 오미영

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been coming here since 2001. Absolutely love it, their massaman, garlic chicken and penang curry especially. Family run place operating for 52 years.  They finally raised their prices this week, by 5 and 10 thb.
sample_reviews_en.author: Deanna Almdal

sample_reviews_en.text: Have been coming back to this place for at least the last 15 years. Despite its location near KSR it remains true to its model of serving good cheap street food. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Holger

sample_reviews_en.text: The best food in Bangkok is here! Amazing flavors, great prices, filling portions—this place is a 10/10. Every time we're in Bangkok, we have lunch and dinner here. Don't miss it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sabdy Aragon

restaurants.name: บะหมี่เกี๊ยวหมูแดง 2030 ยู้
restaurants.address:

27 Phadung Dao Rd, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wonton Noodle Soup with BBQ Pork (Yoo 2030)
...
It's a small shop located in front of a Chinese grocery store in the middle of Texas Lane.

Wonton Noodle Soup with BBQ Pork + Crab (80 THB), without crab 60 THB.
The BBQ pork is incredibly delicious – tender, juicy, slightly fatty, with a perfect balance of salty and sweet. The noodles are cooked just right, neither mushy nor hard. The wonton wrappers were a little soggy today, but that's okay. Overall, it's delicious! It seems the shop has already seasoned it to a certain level. If you like spicy food, just add some chili.

Summary:
The flavor is well-balanced, the portions are generous and filling, and the BBQ pork is amazing! Highly recommend trying it.
**For those who like wonton noodles, I highly recommend it!**

Ordered for takeout, dry noodles without soup.
It would be even better if they provided soup.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amps

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is run by an elderly couple, but friendly, the prices are cheap but the food is delicious. The night I stopped by to eat, customers came and went constantly, but the couple served the food quite quickly. Anyone passing by at night can try it.

The shop is run by an elderly couple who are very kind and welcoming. The prices are cheap, but the food is surprisingly delicious. I came by in the evening, and even though customers kept coming in one after another, they still served the food very quickly. If you’re passing by at night, it’s definitely worth stopping by to try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nguyen Huyen

sample_reviews_en.text: We stumbled upon this charming Chinese noodle stall on our way out of Chinatown. Tucked into a side street, it’s a little less chaotic than the main street in Chinatown. The noodles caught our eyes as we walked by. So happy we decided to sit down and try them! We tried the egg noodles with bbq pork, pork dumplings and crab meat in both broth and no broth. Both simply amazing! The noodles were perfect. The pork was marinated so nicely, both in the bbq and in the dumpling! Loved it so much, we came back for lunch on another day. Lovely, friendly owners.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tamara Ashour

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a nameless roast pork noodle shop in front of the 2030 shop. The roast pork is excellent. The lady cooks the noodles to the perfect chewy texture, tossing them in oil. The fried garlic is the best part of the noodles. The crab meat is generously chunked and filling. The crab and roast pork wonton noodles are incredibly reasonably priced at 80 baht.
- You can park at the Texas parking garage. Walk down the building and turn left, and you'll see the noodle shop right away.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pariyaporn W.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is absolutely amazing, 10 out of 10. The staff are incredibly kind—you really feel like part of a family here. There are only two dishes to choose from, but wow, they are unbelievably delicious. I enjoyed it so much for the price—it’s truly a hidden gem. Everyone has to try this.

The pork dumplings—oh my god—were the best dumplings I’ve ever had in my life, and I’m not even exaggerating. Everyone, run here. The place is 10/10, the food is 10/10.
sample_reviews_en.author: Полина Головкина

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pork and crab meat wonton noodles, located right next to a shop selling offerings for religious ceremonies, by the roadside. The taste is good, seasoned perfectly without needing any extra seasoning.
The roast pork is tender, the sauce on the noodles is slightly salty, and the crab meat is just a small garnish. The portion size is just right, the price is affordable, and the food is prepared quickly; you'll be eating in no time.
sample_reviews_en.author: T Jaroen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very solid local noodle spot with a classic Chinatown feel. Nothing fancy, but that’s exactly why it’s good.

The egg noodles with red pork and wontons are the highlight, simple, well seasoned, and really satisfying. Everything comes out quick and fresh.

Prices are cheap and portions are just right, perfect for a quick meal while walking around the area.

Overall, a great go to place for an easy, tasty bowl of noodles. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Sercan Çelik

sample_reviews_en.text: After the bustle of Yaowarat, walked down randomly and their noodles caught my eye made by an elderly woman like my mom. For only 60 bht, I knew I had to eat here. I chose the noodles without soup, wontons with chicken wings. Although simple the flavor is hard to master and not all places can do this. This place also sells red envelopes in which tables are set in front. I would eat many bowls of this. Excellent!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna Huynh

restaurants.name: Chatuchak Pork Leg
restaurants.address:

821/1 Kamphaeng Phet 2 Rd, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: It didn't taste as good as what I've had elsewhere. You have to try it yourself. The price is #฿#*@*!*@฿???
sample_reviews_th.author: Pacharaphol T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Once and I don't think I'll go back again.
The taste was okay, but the price was unreasonable. Compared to other pork leg rice places I've eaten at, the portions were very small.
The minced pork and seaweed soup was bland. Seaweed isn't expensive, but they put so little in that it was tasteless.

I've never encountered pork leg rice where you had to buy garlic separately.
The rice was 12 baht per plate. I ordered two plates, and they served two plates plus one extra bowl (the amount of rice in each plate was extremely small).
So I asked what the extra bowl was for…
The staff replied that it was for refills. I thought the amount of rice in the plate was small, so they put extra in the bowl for those who eat a lot and want refills, so that those who eat less wouldn't waste food.
But I had to pay another 12 baht for the refill.
Very strange. I've never seen a restaurant like this before.
sample_reviews_en.author: kamonrat winairaing

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's located on the edge of a gas station and doesn't have a conspicuous sign, but the restaurant is constantly bustling with customers. The menu features stewed pig's feet, claws, and small intestines, all of which are thoroughly prepared and not at all sticky or smelly. A Gunma resident, for whom stewed offal is his soul food, expressed his admiration for the careful preparation, to which the owner humbly replied, "I'm glad you noticed," which was quite impressive. 
When you say "Khao Ka Moo," you usually mean rice on a plate with meat on top, but here the rice and meat are served separately, as is the norm. Two bowls of rice with one plate of meat is quite light. Don't forget to order the simple seaweed soup, too.
sample_reviews_en.author: THAI SANPO FUJII

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'd heard about this place for a long time—it's famous and not far from my house. I'd tried to stop by several times, but there was never parking. This time, I finally found a parking spot and got to eat here.

The restaurant is quite large, air-conditioned, and resembles an old-style food court, but it's very clean. They only sell one dish: braised pork leg with rice.

The price is quite high. I ate alone and ordered a small plate of braised pork leg with rice for about 100 baht.

The braised pork itself wasn't to my liking. It was dry, watery, bland, and not sweet at all (which is good), but it wasn't salty and lacked aroma.
Taste is subjective, of course.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charlie Vongphantuseth

sample_reviews_en.text: My kids rate this place as their number one favorite braised pork leg. It's delicious, clean, and the flavors are perfectly balanced and harmonious. The chilies and garlic are neatly peeled, and the dipping sauce goes perfectly with the braised pork leg and intestines. The seaweed soup also makes you want to eat more of the braised pork leg—from one plate to two, and now that my kids are growing up, they're eating three or four plates! I've been eating here since before I had kids, and the taste is still as delicious as ever. The only downside is that parking is difficult, and the restaurant is closed on Sundays, don't forget!
sample_reviews_en.author: Onjira R.

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Mediocre" is probably the best way to describe this restaurant.

My first visit was unimpressive. I ordered rice with toppings, but they didn't have any, so I ordered a small portion of pork leg, one rice, and one bottle of water. However, they served only one plate and one bowl of rice, without explaining why there were two servings.
