The final bill was 96 baht. After eating, my only feeling was that not a single word felt "delicious" or "worth the price." The quantity, taste, and overall experience were all disappointing. I definitely won't be returning.

P.S. 3 stars only for the cool, air-conditioned atmosphere!
sample_reviews_en.author: supawat apinanpisut

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork leg is sometimes very salty, other times bland. They don't sell it with rice; it's only sold separately, and the price is considered expensive—100 baht for a plate of pork leg and a small portion. Rice is 15 baht for half a scoop. The owner tries to sell seaweed soup along with the pork leg, which is uncomfortable. Parking is difficult; it's mostly taxis waiting for passengers in a gas station. It's a very bad location, and considering the food and prices, it's a loss for the customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: ขาเดียวก็เที่ยวได้

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there intending to buy pork leg rice, but they charged me for everything else. They didn't offer pork leg with rice because they only intended to sell the pork leg separately. And the rice, sold separately, was ridiculously expensive. Plain rice was 15 baht, I don't remember the exact price, but I ordered just rice, yet they included so many other things, even garlic! In the end, it was almost 200 baht. In short, go buy pork leg from somewhere else.
sample_reviews_en.author: TPCH PM

restaurants.name: Silom Village Restaurant Silom
restaurants.address:

286/1 Si Lom Rd, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The atmosphere during the day is relaxing. Walk inside and find any table you like (the seating is open daytime). In the back there is a waterfall and open area.

For lunch there are several stands to select from, including pad thai, fried oysters and eggs, pork and rice, and a selection of traditional Thai desserts.

This is a good place to come and get to know the original flavors.

The khao griap bpak maaw (ข้าวเกรียบปากหม้อ) is original flavors that's hard to find elsewhere. The woman making them has been there for over 30 years. Be sure to take a bit of chilli and a bite of cilantro or lettuce to follow; it helps balance the sweet and salt.
sample_reviews_th.author: FiT

sample_reviews_en.text: Nothing to be amazed about. The Typical touristic rip off place filled with tour operator groups. We went there as a couple and were immediately served with a chinese style food specially made for complicated tourists. By complicated I refer to the simplicity of the food that tasted like nothing. No salt no spices and which has  nothing in common with real Thai food. It looked like a kind of chinese style food. The staff first served every guest and continued to do so for all other incoming ones before the show even started. We had the time to finish diner and dessert before the show even started. All the tourists were talking so loud that we couldn't even hear the musicians playing. The show was short, less than an hour and combining food, show and loud tourist ambience was in my opinion not worth the price. Very disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: M M

sample_reviews_en.text: We enjoyed our stay at this hotel and really appreciated the service. The staff were very friendly and looked after all our needs very well. Their facilities were very good and matched what was advertised. We liked the Siam touches with the decor and design of the building. We would certainly return to this hotel and area as we enjoyed it very much. The breakfast buffet was to die for and left us full and ready for the day in the city. It is centrally located along BRT with connections to the rest of the city. Going on skytrain to get around avoids the heavy traffic in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: AZAL HUSSAIN

sample_reviews_en.text: The first two times I went to Bangkok, I ate at Silom Village. Since then I've always seen it as that: The place where you eat on your first two visits to the city and then never again. It's first-timer tourist friendly and comes with an experience that caters to that demographic exactly. It's an upgrade to the 'Thai restaurant' you know from back home, with some 'Thai ambience' without being too exotic. Don't get me wrong, the first two times I went there, I liked it for what it was, but nowadays I'd say there's a lot of options that offer better quality and value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karsten Aichholz

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the experience to enjoy the Thai traditional show at their venue Ryan Theo thats in the second floor of the village. The venue is very comfortable and spacious. The dinner and show offer was worth every penny. The dinner is a variety of the Thai dishes and the show is of traditional Thai dances of local culture and tradition where the dancers wear beautiful costumes and dance on the stage and in the restaurant area itself. For being in silom that's in Bangkok centre  is a great place to enjoy a good time and appreciate the Thai culture.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shara Fernandez

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is a strange combo of Thai and American food. Actually, it might be a 100% American restaurant, just Thai style. I've never seen seafood pizza and seafood soup at an American restaurant before. It's in the middle of a strange touristy shopping village, with lots of souvenir shops. So I think that most people that come here arrive on tour buses. But the food is tasty, and the service is good. It's all outdoor seating, but they have fans all over, so it's pretty cool.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joseph Dewey

sample_reviews_en.text: Lovely lovely place in and around silom. Visited here with my dad who has been coming here since late 1980's. Open air dining with complete traditional and local cuisine with live music and dance performance. To talk about the food, extremely fresh and tasty are the seafoods. Truly i haven't tasted such freshness with lemon chilli and garlic sauce. Do try out! And oh such a historic place it is, safeguarding the teak houses. Do visit and enjoy!
sample_reviews_en.author: Salman Malim

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dance show including a traditional set menu.

Several options are available:
Standard
Vegetarian
Fish

The food is delicious!

Main course, fruit, tea/coffee

Dance show with fantastic costumes and traditional dances, such as the Harvest Dance, Ramakien, etc.

Lasts approximately 2 hours.

The entire event takes place in a theater-style setting.

It's definitely touristy, but still well worth seeing.

Reservations are required!
sample_reviews_en.author: Birgit

restaurants.name: Indian Touch 1 Restaurant (Since 2011)
restaurants.address:

358 2 Pattaya Sai 2 Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It takes a talented cook to get splendid food but it takes a super gentleman behaviour to become a Super Restaurant which is this place. Located in the busy street of South Pattaya, easily accessible, very delicious food. Mr. Sunny is a gem of a host and quite informative too. We had multiple top notch items like Chicken Nuggets, Chilly Chicken, Mutton Stuff, Manchow Soup....  even vegetarian options were perfect. One can easily enjoy booze with food at affordable rates. Highly recommended if your staying in area nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: ESHANK SINGH

sample_reviews_en.text:
Of all the places in Pattaya I have eaten,I would recommend this place.The food is tasty and quantity is decent. For all Indians looking for Indian restaurant in Pattaya just try this place.

For the owner- why is the slim lady so dull, her attitude and approach is not positive at all. If you order something why does she make faces ? Do you think guests visiting you and paying for for your service will accept this behaviour ??
sample_reviews_en.author: Deepak G Harlalka

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of d best Indian food joint in pattaya...Homely feel..service is excellent..They prepare food according to ur taste..u jus tell them n dish is urs..
Perfect for family..They attend u personally n ask ur taste..
I'm visiting this place since last 10yrs..My only one stop in pattaya..
I recommend everyone to visit this place and u will b their fan..
Pattaya mai rehkar bhi Ghar ka swaad..
sample_reviews_en.author: kiran shanbhag

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place to dine in in the whole pattaya, may it be veggies or non vegg,,,, Great location,,, Delicious food and great staff with smiling face every time from restaurant owner upto the sweeper.Interiors also so amazing... Recommend this place to dine in.... Everything was very clean.... will visit this restaurant again and again when I will be in pattaya..... Good place for kids also
sample_reviews_en.author: WASEEM SHAHNAZ MALIK

sample_reviews_en.text: We've been using this restaurant for years, and their delivery service is incredibly unpredictable! It's like Russian roulette: one time the delivery is fantastic! But the second time, they bring you a lamb chop with hair, no meat. 🤬 Guys, do something about this, it's disgusting! Last time I got the perfect lamb, but this time it's simply inedible! It's like someone's already eaten it!
sample_reviews_en.author: A AA

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food is too good
Hygienic
Good portion
Considerate enough to give all the utensils and cutleries needed for takeaway packages
They allow you to change certain items in the thali set (capati instead of roti) which is a really nice gesture because alot of the indian restaurant doesnt allow that

Definitely recommend for people to try the food
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay Cool

sample_reviews_en.text: Sunny paaji is a nice person, he runs this restaurant, if you are in Pattaya and staying near the walking street you should surely visit his restaurant which serves the amazing Indian food, to be honest it felt like home made food in Thailand, i wish him good luck and will surely visit him next time, when I will be in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rohit Bahl

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the place where we enjoy food and family weather . The staff is superb...... And very friendly... Please must visit and enjoy the food and your trip.... Specially they make food as per customer taste....
My whole family enjoy a lot.....
My family tasted all dishes
Veg and non veg
sample_reviews_en.author: Sonia Ariyal

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวหมูสนั่น (สูตรผู้พันเป้ง) - หลังตลาด อ.ต.ก. (ติดประตู 4)
restaurants.address:

101 Kamphaeng Phet Rd, Chatuchak, จตุจักร Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
• This noodle restaurant is surprisingly excellent. The taste is truly authentic Thai-style pork noodles, with a well-balanced and traditional flavor profile, especially the clear soup noodle.

• Although the price is on the higher side, it is still worth it if you appreciate this classic Thai noodle style.

• However, the pricing of side dishes is noticeably excessive. Items such as pork satay (moo satay) and crispy pork fat (kak moo) feel unreasonably expensive.

• The location is very convenient, situated next to Or Tor Kor Market Gate 4, and parking is available within the market area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongpit Pinsai

sample_reviews_en.text: A hidden gem near Chatuchak! The pork noodle soup was incredibly flavourful, with a rich, aromatic broth that tasted like it had been simmered for hours. The pork was tender, the meatballs had a nice bounce, and the noodles were cooked just right. Simple, authentic Thai comfort food at its best. The portions are generous, prices are reasonable, and service is quick even during busy periods. Definitely worth stopping by if you’re around Chatuchak!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sherie Lim

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best pork ball soups I’ve had in Bangkok. The broth was packed with depth without being overly salty, and every ingredient tasted fresh. The pork was juicy, the noodles had a great texture, and the crispy toppings added a nice crunch. Fast service, authentic local flavours, and excellent value for money. I’ll definitely be back the next time I’m in the Chatuchak area!
sample_reviews_en.author: Z W Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: Only 5–6 tables were occupied during lunchtime, yet we still waited over 25 minutes for just two bowls of noodles. The noodles were very plain and had almost no flavor. The prices are unreasonably high for the quality, and it feels like the restaurant mainly targets tourists rather than offering genuine value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex Non.

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent pork noodles! The shop is very clean and the food tastes great. It’s a perfect spot for a quick meal, whether you're alone, with friends, or with kids. My son and I both love it here. Highly recommended for everyone!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanyarat Wiphatawat

sample_reviews_en.text: Quite hard to find less salty food in Bangkok, but here is super perfect, mild flavor, good combination still remain Chinese-Thai flavor characteristics. Honestly follow influencer to eat here and end up loving it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Taniya MATHASMITKUL

sample_reviews_en.text:
First thing! Easy Parking, that’s help a lot 😁 This is kind of classic pork noodle that I like.

Recommended:
- Signature Dry Pork noodle with the Ba-teng (Caramelized Pork)
- Pork Noodle Soup
and
- Pork Satay
sample_reviews_en.author: Phurinat Sirirat

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best noodle shops around the area w reasonable and affordable pricing. Their satay pork is worth the price and they use very good ingredients. The pork is soft and thick.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pep Ruckpanich

restaurants.name: Oros
restaurants.address:

317/9 Nakhon Ratchasima Rd, Dusit, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been to this restaurant before and I like the food. It's delicious, like home-cooked meals, just as advertised. The atmosphere is also warm and inviting.
However, the staff were constantly on their phones and ignored customers.
On one occasion, I was quite startled because they were playing a video on their phone very loudly and laughing loudly. I don't know which employee it was, but I hope the restaurant will reprimand them. Otherwise, you'll definitely lose customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: pornlaphat pinyoying

sample_reviews_en.text:
I drove from Bang Na because I saw reviews of the Khanom Jeen Sao Nam (rice noodles with coconut milk sauce) on TikTok.
It wasn't as amazing as I expected. The coconut milk was very diluted and lacked any coconut flavor. They also gave very little dried shrimp. Disappointing. // The restaurant has parking. // They accept credit cards for purchases over 1500 baht. // There is a 10% service charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sanpechuda Khamphira

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every dish was truly delicious. I was so impressed I forgot to take pictures! The rice with chili paste and seafood was amazing, as were the stir-fried noodles with vegetables and the sour curry with shrimp, acacia leaves, and egg. The shrimp was so fresh and succulent.

For dessert, I recommend the banoffee pie and the lime in syrup. They were delicious and perfectly sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thachasorn Asadathorn

sample_reviews_en.text: I was quite shocked by the price, portion sizes, and taste. Every dish was rather bland. The garlic pork with rice for 165 baht looked exactly like the picture. Personally, I think if something was delicious, a higher price wouldn't matter, but this meal felt like it wasn't worth the money. (Maybe I'm not the target audience.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Max

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was awful. I ordered a less sweet drink, but it was ridiculously sweet. The staff were also unhelpful. While I was eating, the table next to me, which had just left, only cleared their plates without wiping them clean. They didn't even wipe them down after they finished eating. It was very confusing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sutatta Ch

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a relaxed and spacious atmosphere with convenient parking.
Every dish we ordered was delicious. They have many tasty bakery items; I especially liked the quince cake. As for Thai desserts, I was particularly impressed with the preserved kaffir lime, which is very hard to find elsewhere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pine P

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious.
The Khao Soi with beef exceeded my expectations; it was very rich and flavorful.
The fried larb was crispy and tasty.
The crispy tuna with the spicy dipping sauce was delicious.
The omelet was fluffy and moist.
The restaurant was clean and spacious, with parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanakan Chuengmankhong

sample_reviews_en.text: They offer a wide variety of delicious cakes and a variety of tasty food. The exterior is beautiful and shady, and parking is convenient. Inside, the shop is spacious and comfortable, serving fragrant, strong, and refreshing fresh coffee.
sample_reviews_en.author: ครีมมี่ แชลแนล

restaurants.name: Rungfah
restaurants.address:

361 ถนนลาดหญ้า แขวงสมเด็จเจ้าพระยา เขตคลองสาน Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old-fashioned restaurant with flavors reminiscent of the TV drama "Prisna"... A friend recommended the Hainanese chicken rice, saying it had a lot of garlic. However, the rice was just okay, at least it wasn't hard. The soup was terrible, very watery, with no soupy texture. When I asked the waiter, they just added sauce. I ordered the thigh meat with skin, like free-range chicken, and the flavor was weak. It would be better if they sliced ​​the cucumber more thinly and saved money; currently, the cucumber slices are large and bitter... The stir-fried mixed vegetables (Ho Ngok Kwai) were mediocre, unimpressive. It had old-fashioned almonds and cashews, but the combination of both didn't work. They used uncandied jujubes, making the overall taste a bit bland... The spicy stir-fried catfish was tasty, with some crispy bones and some non-crispy meat, and it was heavily seasoned with basil and coconut milk... The Lod Chong Wat Chet was good, standard... The hot chrysanthemum tea was typical, not too sweet... The service was excellent... Personally, I wouldn't go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khunnai Many

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a shame to see a place like this empty, especially on a day like Mother's Day. This restaurant is a true gem, a time capsule of a bygone era. They specialize in "cook-shop" cuisine, a wonderful fusion of Chinese, Thai, and Western flavors that you just don't see much anymore.
I've been here a few times, and the food is consistently fantastic. The pork chop with pea gravy is an absolute must-try. The pork chop is perfectly cooked, and the gravy is rich, savory, and full of flavor. The Hainanese chicken is another standout dish, with juicy, tender chicken served with fragrant rice.
The service is always excellent. The staff are attentive and genuinely happy to see you. It's the kind of place where you feel like a regular even on your first visit.
I truly hope this restaurant stays in business. It's a unique part of our culinary history, and it would be a huge loss to see it go. If you're looking for a taste of nostalgia and some seriously good food, please do yourself a favor and check it out. You won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puvanai Dardarananda

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's an old family restaurant that's been in my family since my grandmother's time, followed by my mother's, and now my children.

My mother told me that she loved the Chinese herbal goat stew here.

This restaurant is my family's hangout spot. We've been eating here since before air conditioning. If you let my mother choose a restaurant, don't even ask her. Just drive straight here.
Cross Taksin Bridge, stay on the left, and turn onto Charoen Nakhon Road—you should be able to drive with your eyes closed.

This restaurant is very close to our family, having been eating here for three generations.

Fried shrimp salad, boiled chicken, fish fillet with chili sauce, stir-fried morning glory, and stir-fried shrimp balls with morning glory...these are my favorite dishes.

This is a restaurant you can't miss if you're passing through Lat Ya. It's a hidden white elephant, hidden away in plain sight, and only hunters know where it is.
sample_reviews_en.author: อันดา ฟ้าใส

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm a Hainanese person who's been familiar with this type of food since I was a child.

Today I ate:
1. Braised goat: Delicious, no gamey smell, fragrant with spices, the clear broth paired perfectly with the tangy dipping sauce.
2. Hainanese rice noodles: Served in a hot pot, the flavor was a bit bland and needed to be eaten with the shrimp paste sauce. The offal was well-prepared, except for the liver, which was very tough.
3. Stir-fried shrimp balls with Chinese cabbage: This dish had a refreshing flavor, emphasizing the sweetness of the vegetables and the crispness and deliciousness of the shrimp balls.
4. Hainanese mixed vegetable stew (with glass noodles): This restaurant didn't stir-fry it dry, and the taste was just like what I used to eat as a child, bringing back fond memories.

Parking is available on the street.
Prices are moderate, not too expensive.
I'll definitely come back to try other dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: HIA CHIM - TASTE MASTER

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hainanese-style Cookshop Chinese Restaurant

I've been wanting to try this place for a while but never had the chance. Today was a great day! My first impression is that the restaurant has a very old-fashioned vibe, but it's surprisingly clean, bright, and inviting. It was quite empty when I went, and the staff provided excellent service. The menu might not be extensive, but the way it's designed makes ordering easy – I really liked that.

The food tastes very homey, like eating grandma's cooking. The flavors are perfectly balanced in every dish; no single flavor overpowers another. There's a light wok aroma, but what I really appreciated was that it wasn't overly greasy. It felt light and not heavy after the meal. It's a unique style of Chinese food that I highly recommend everyone try.

The prices aren't too high, and it would probably be even cheaper if you go with a group and try a variety of dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pesama Saksanit

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was quite bland and mostly starchy. I'm not sure if that's typical of Hainanese Chinese food or if the restaurant intentionally made it that way. The prices weren't too expensive, and the portions were just right for the number of people.
- Tom Yum Fish Head Soup: This was too bland for my taste. If you prefer a saltier or stronger flavor, you might need to ask for more fish sauce or soy sauce.
- Stir-fried Shrimp Balls: I'd never had this before. It's similar to Rad Na (Thai noodle dish with gravy), with a hint of pepper. It was delicious.
I think this restaurant probably makes good Rad Na. I'll try it next time. There's parking in front of the shop on the street. The restaurant reserves parking spaces with cones. If you're going to eat there, let the restaurant know, and they'll remove the cones so you can park. After the meal, they sell gelato ice cream. I'll try that sometime too.
sample_reviews_en.author: P. Lert

sample_reviews_en.text:
A good place. We ordered a large portion of braised goat in a broth with Chinese spices, shrimp in a sweet sauce with fruit and cashews, a salad, and hot jasmine tea.
I wouldn't say the portion was large or that it contained a lot of meat; it was a normal portion, and the meat was good, but the dish itself wasn't a 10 out of 10 for me; it was just a decent soup with meat.
The shrimp in a sweet sauce were delicious, a good, tasty dish.
The salad had an unusual sauce, just vegetables and sauce.
The tea was pleasant; it was slightly sweetened.
You can't pay by card; only cash or QR code.
The staff is very pleasant and friendly. One girl understands and speaks English; the others don't, so all communication went through her. This didn't cause any discomfort; she's very pleasant.
Check: 705 baht
sample_reviews_en.author: Дмитрий Култышев

sample_reviews_en.text:
This old Hainanese Chinese restaurant has a simple atmosphere, but the taste and quality of the food are surprisingly good, befitting its more than 40 years of operation. My favorite dish is the deep-fried pork ribs with gravy. The pork is incredibly tender, the outside is perfectly crispy, and the gravy is flavorful. It pairs perfectly with the restaurant's sour dipping sauce. The stir-fried shrimp balls with vegetables are also excellent; the shrimp balls are bouncy and firm, the vegetables are crispy, and the sauce isn't too salty.
Another favorite is the fish maw soup; the broth is rich and fragrant, perfect for sipping hot. The food comes out quickly, and the prices are reasonable for the quality. It's suitable for both family meals and bringing friends to try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuttun pi

restaurants.name: Ventisi at Centara Grand at centralwOrld
restaurants.address:

24th floor, Centara Grand and Bangkok Convention Centre, 999/99 Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time having a dinner buffet here, and I was pleasantly surprised by everything – the atmosphere, the service, and the food quality.

The restaurant's ambiance is fantastic, offering panoramic city views, especially stunning during sunset and into the night. The live music, performed by a beautiful singer, created a relaxing and romantic atmosphere, perfect for families, couples, or celebrating special occasions.

The food selection is incredibly diverse; it's a pleasure to browse and find almost everything you could want, including lobster, prime rib, steamed crab with milk, grilled river prawns, baked sea bass, giant crab legs, as well as a wide variety of seafood, sushi, sashimi, hot dishes, and desserts. The ingredients are fresh, high-quality, and the food is constantly replenished.

Overall, it's a buffet that offers exceptional quality, atmosphere, and a worthwhile experience. If you're looking for an international dinner buffet with beautiful city views and live music, I highly recommend this place. I was impressed from my first visit and will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: SK Katair

sample_reviews_en.text:
Buffet lovers can't miss the Grand Dinner Buffet at Ventisi Restaurant, Centara Grand Central World Hotel.

Enjoy an unlimited feast of diverse international dishes, including fresh seafood such as:

lobster, river prawns, Alaskan crab, blue crab, mantis shrimp, and various types of oysters.

Plus, a wide array of other dishes like foie gras, beef steak, pasta, sushi, roasted suckling pig, boat noodles, and dozens of desserts – too many to list!

The regular price is 3,224 THB net, including soft drinks.

If you save or screenshot this post when booking and mention that you saw it on Celeb Ping's page, you'll receive a special price of only 1,990 THB net!

This incredible value buffet at a special price is not to be missed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarat Traipiyavong

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is amazing value! They have unlimited steamed crab with milk, blue crab, and other fresh seafood. The other dishes are also surprisingly premium. My parents loved it.

We started with half a lobster per person, followed by foie gras, truffle dishes, three types of oysters, and Michelin-level roasted suckling pig. We could eat a variety of things non-stop without getting bored.

There's also a full selection of Thai desserts, cakes, and ice cream, all with stunning views from the 24th floor. The atmosphere is fantastic, perfect for a special family celebration.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jingjai Review

sample_reviews_en.text:
First of all, when we had seated, the waitress didn't explain anything and walk away. Don't even ask what drinks would you like? We have to walk to other stafd to ask about how the structure was.
Secoundly, The food was horrible. Seafood was not fresh. Cheses were very dry. Dessert were like just out of the frozen. My friend even has diarea that night.
The only good thing was the atmosphere which they had live music.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthiga Graipuy

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, especially the Thai dishes which were very flavorful. The shrimp, crab, and squid were plentiful, and the Surat Thani oysters were fresh and tasty. There was a wide variety of bakery items, especially the rich and delicious tiramisu. The service was excellent, particularly from Paweena (Nan), who was very attentive and caring. I will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kae+ Hauhin

sample_reviews_en.text: A spacious restaurant offering a wide variety of buffet dishes with hardworking, attentive staff ready to serve you. Delicious food with different daily menu rotation including the famous Kam's Roast Duck! Plus, live music to enjoy while you dine. Come drop by and give us a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tan Kittiwat

sample_reviews_en.text: the service was so exceptional! we received a complimentary birthday cake, all the servers were patient, bright, and spoke great English. Especially shean, drey, mae, cris, juls and lys, all of them were amazing to us. awesome experience, would recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: sybel

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is delicious and beautiful, the service is excellent, and the waitress was very helpful and fast. The food was delicious, and I will definitely come again.

Thank you to Saif Muhannad for the delicious food. Note: The food is halal.
sample_reviews_en.author: عبدالوهاب العثمان

restaurants.name: Lantumsom
restaurants.address:

49/2 1 Lat Pla Khao 75, Anusawari, Bang Khen, Bangkok 10220, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm at table 16. I'm not a regular customer, only visiting 3-4 times a year, but every time I go, there's been a problem. Sometimes the order is wrong, sometimes they forget something. But this time, I think the problem is definitely due to back-of-house management. 1. The order was extremely slow. I waited over 30-40 minutes. I went for dinner, not to a cafe to enjoy the atmosphere. They're playing with human hunger! It's like a fine dining restaurant where one dish comes out per hour. It's ridiculous. If you're going to claim you have a lot of orders, the customer doesn't need to know whether you have many or few orders, because that's not the customer's problem. What you need to know is that customers come to eat. And the atmosphere isn't that great. If you can afford to open a restaurant like this, buy some licensed music to play for your customers. Don't use Bluetooth phone speakers that cut out every time a message or call comes in. I've been a non-regular customer for three years now. In short, the standards never improve; they only get worse every day.
sample_reviews_en.author: March Aounsri

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stir-fried minced pork larb (119 THB): Not as dry as I'd hoped, but the flavor was really good. Spicy and hot, I liked it.
Spicy bamboo shoot salad with fresh shrimp (129 THB + acacia leaves 25 THB): Delicious. Sour, salty, with a hint of sweetness. The fermented fish sauce was fragrant, and the shrimp were very fresh and bouncy.
Grilled chicken wings (129 THB): Served hot. The flavor was good, but the wings were very small and didn't have much meat.
Spicy minced pork soup with plums (129 THB): Mildly sour and salty. The soup was delicious and easy to drink. They gave a lot of pork, and the bowl kept it warm very well.
Black sticky rice (20 THB)
Pickled shellfish (30 THB): Good flavor.
Thai melon dessert (49 THB): Delicious. If you don't like the smell of candle smoke, skip this one.
Coconut pudding (40 THB): Delicious.

They have a huge menu, including single-serving dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pui Natpaphat

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here several times before and the food was delicious. However, this time I ordered three items for takeout: one papaya salad and two fried items. The wait was extremely long, 45 minutes! The staff said it took longer because of the fried items, but it was far too long. They should improve their preparation time for takeout orders. The papaya salad with crispy pork rinds was terrible this time; it was awful. It seemed like the papaya salad had been prepared long before, but the wait for the fried items caused the rinds to become soggy and the fish sauce tasted bad. They should manage their takeout preparation time more efficiently. I recommend eating at the restaurant rather than ordering takeout.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nilawan Silapasorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ordering system is good,
but the food service management urgently needs improvement. The wait for food was extremely long.
Tables that arrived first took forever to get their food served,
even though tables that arrived later ordered relatively simple dishes.
They should distribute the food more evenly to all tables; that's a good approach.
However, the challenge for the restaurant is to figure out how to manage this to encourage repeat visits. Personally, one visit is enough because of the negative first experience. It wasn't the food that was bad, but the restaurant's management was inadequate. The wait for food was too long; it was as if there was no manager.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anny Memee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is reliable, whether you prefer it with or without fermented fish sauce. I don't usually eat fermented fish sauce, but I could eat here without any problems; it seemed clean.

For fried dishes, I recommend the deep-fried pork belly with garlic, served with green chilies – it's delicious!

The spicy salads are standard, reasonably priced, and the portions are decent.

If you want to try Northeastern and Northern Thai food, I highly recommend this place. It's clean, the taste is reliable, and there's parking available – very convenient!
sample_reviews_en.author: Worachat K

sample_reviews_en.text: 📍 This somtum (papaya salad) shop is located deep in a side street off Lad Pla Khao. Don't miss it! It's incredibly flavorful, spicy, and sour – a perfect blend of tastes. I recommend asking for it extra spicy for the best experience. The fruit somtum, however, is a bit sweet, in a more upscale style. They also have other dishes. 🔆 It gets very crowded in the evenings, so expect a wait. 🚗 Parking is available in front of the shop. #SomtumWithFermentedFishSauce #SomtumWithCrabAndFermentedFishSauce #LadPlaKhao #BangKhen
sample_reviews_en.author: Julie Wu

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has delicious food. I really like the fermented fish sauce dip they give to every table. The Korat stir-fried noodles are amazing, flavorful and rich. The salads and spicy papaya salads with fermented fish sauce are also tasty, but if you don't like salty food, you might not like them. There's plenty of parking in front of the restaurant. There's an air-conditioned area and an outdoor seating area. The restaurant is clean, the staff provides good service, and the owner is kind.
sample_reviews_en.author: orapim sundaraketu

sample_reviews_en.text: My first time eating here was a truly impressive experience. I usually order papaya salad with fermented crab, but I was hooked on their Thai-style papaya salad with crab. It was so flavorful and delicious! They have a wide variety of papaya salads, so I'll definitely come back to try more. The food is quite spicy, so if you can't handle spicy food, you should specify that. The fried pork belly was delicious served hot! The staff were also very friendly and attentive. I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: ALICE K.

restaurants.name: After You Chinatown 唐人街店 - อาฟเตอร์ ยู เยาวราช
restaurants.address:

9 Phadung Dao Rd, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
After You's Yaowarat branch is beautifully decorated with a Chinese theme, fitting the Yaowarat atmosphere well. There are plenty of photogenic spots. However, I personally felt the shop was a bit small; it might feel cramped when it's crowded.

As for the desserts, they were as delicious as ever, never disappointing 😋. The sweetness was just right, very enjoyable, especially the ones I tried which were loaded with cream and toppings – so satisfying!

Overall, I liked it. If you're walking around Yaowarat and want some dessert, stop by. The shop is beautiful and the desserts are delicious. But if you want to relax comfortably, you might want to choose a less crowded time.

Summary: Shop Beauty ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ | Dessert Taste ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ | Seating ⭐️⭐️⭐️½
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattapol Kumglad

sample_reviews_en.text:
The female cashier wearing glasses treated foreign customers very differently from local Thai customers. When taking our order, she had an unfriendly attitude, never smiled, and spoke to us impatiently, which made us feel very unwelcome 🙄

We ordered two kakigori. After we finished the first one, we waited at least 30 minutes for the second. We asked the staff about it, and they told us it was being prepared. However, during that time, we saw several customers who arrived after us receive their kakigori first, finish eating, and leave, while we were still waiting for our second dessert 😡

This was a very disappointing experience due to both the poor service and the excessive waiting time.

First and last visit ❗
sample_reviews_en.author: Xiao Qi Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was generally delicious, especially the Butter Bun, which was very tasty. The shaved ice was also good, with unique toppings that included a bread-like texture and small grass jelly-flavored jelly pieces, creating a rich and layered experience.

However, the service could be improved. The staff seemed rather serious, and their interactions felt somewhat unfriendly, which slightly affected the dining experience.

Additionally, some of the toppings in the shaved ice had rather unique flavors, and their appeal might vary from person to person; not everyone might like them. Overall, the food is worth trying.
sample_reviews_en.author: 陳冠廷

sample_reviews_en.text:
This shop in Chinatown is small but has a super chill vibe; it's like Hong Kong, like Cholon, truly nestled in the heart of Chinatown.
I ordered the sticky rice mango bingsu, and oh my god, it was incredibly delicious. The outside is a rich, creamy layer, followed by a layer of finely shaved mango-flavored ice, served with two sauces: a fragrant mango sauce and a creamy coconut sauce. Inside is sticky, sweet rice. Overall, it's totally worth the money.

Note that this shop doesn't accept cash, so be sure to bring a card or money transfer app.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bích Trang Nguyễn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Bad attitude, staffs are so rude when serve drink and take order to customer

Today April 23,2026
When i order drink the waitress wearing round glasses and 1 other staff look like Manager they were so unrespect us, impolite, and showing careless when take order and process payment also

Really bad services, horrible experiences,  not friendly for all staffs here to foriegners, bad mouth after look at us and whipering something...
Everyone should be avoid here
After you in China Town
sample_reviews_en.author: Kate Y

sample_reviews_en.text:
The cafe has a Chinese-style decor, which fits well with the vibe of the neighborhood. It's located near Texas Suki.

✅️ The souffle is delicious and goes perfectly with the strawberry sauce.
✅️ The pomegranate Americano has a great combination of coffee and pomegranate.
✅️ The matcha pistachio coconut smoothie is delicious and perfectly balanced.
sample_reviews_en.author: J'adore

sample_reviews_en.text: Cute little hideaway just off Yaowarat road. If you want a slice of calm and a bucket load of dessert after the chaos of the main drag, this place is heaven. Pricing is reasonable, portions are large but the desserts are so good that you don’t feel it. Would highly recommend as a last stop before you head home.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Moseley

sample_reviews_en.text: Le concept est sympa, mais l'accueil est glacial. On a vraiment l'impression de déranger la fille à lunettes en caisse, ce qui est très surprenant et loin des standards d'hospitalité auxquels on est habitués en Thaïlande. Une formation sur …
sample_reviews_en.author: FERLAZZO FERLAZZO

restaurants.name: Katsushin Naradhiwas かつ真 ナラティワ店
restaurants.address:

PGGH+V7V, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating at this branch. I came on a Sunday at lunchtime and the restaurant was quite quiet, with only 2-3 tables of customers. The taste was good, but compared to another branch, I felt it wasn't quite as good. The fried cheese was delicious, a must-try dish. The salad dressing wasn't to my liking; I wish they had a yuzu dressing. The restaurant is quite dimly lit, almost dark, which makes it feel a bit gloomy. The staff were attentive. On the day I visited, they were out of parking tickets, so the restaurant gave me cash to pay for parking at the building instead, which is free for 2 hours.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nelinya Thanyanitiphath (Nenae Nelyn)

sample_reviews_en.text: Katsushin, located in the I.T.F Tower on Naradhiwas Road, is a tonkatsu restaurant with a focus on high-quality, deep-fried pork dishes. Alongside the signature tonkatsu, the menu offers a variety of deep-fried dishes, seafood, and other Japanese staples, with options like refillable rice and side dishes for a complete meal. The restaurant is known for its friendly service and welcoming atmosphere that feels cozy and authentically Japanese. It’s a popular spot, especially during lunchtime.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalermchon Suttaluang

sample_reviews_en.text:
I liked the atmosphere of the restaurant. It was dimly lit, making me feel warm and cozy. I really wanted to order a beer or a highball.

The food was delicious. The batter was crispy and not greasy. The pork inside was tender and juicy. It was very well done.
The appetizers were also good. I ordered fried shrimp and grilled stingray fins.

You can check the price from the bill I've included.

There's a 10% service charge. The service was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pokchat Boonyaku

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great place to have a good, delicious Tonkatsu set that is affordable and valuable.

There are many menu to choose from, I ordered tonkatsu with cheese and hoba leaf inside, and everything is delicious and pork is quite tender. Rice and salad is refillable, but Miso soup can be refilled only once. Personally I recommend Beef tongue, it was very tender and juicy.

Vibe is great, but restaurant is quite small and can be fully packed on weekends.
sample_reviews_en.author: KOKO

sample_reviews_en.text: Silom Office worker maybe enjoy crispy Tonkatsu lunch set like this. Pork sirloin tonkatsu size M served with hot steamed rice, miso soup and unlimited salad cabbage. Either taste or quality of ingredient are quite good. Impressed with the delicious side dish which didn't know what it was called. Warm atmosphere like a japan. Wait no long and also quite reasonable price at 3xx for full lunch set.
sample_reviews_en.author: LAPIN _11

sample_reviews_en.text:
Beware, less choice of menu at this branch comparing to 1st branch which located 500m away.

This Restaurant branch pays cash for only 1-hour parking fee while original branch with stamp get free 2-hour parking.

I would go to original branch since 2 of my favorite choices are not serving here and usually I can’t finish my meal within an hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: mr pOd

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff should have informed us beforehand that ordering one menu item for two people didn't include rice refills, and then charging extra for rice. It feels like we were denied that. If they had told us, we could have ordered extra. The restaurant was hot and smelly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chakrit (Tee+) Choopreeda

sample_reviews_en.text: We came for lunch without a reservation, and luckily there was a table available. We ordered the lunch set, which included rice, soup, and vegetables with unlimited refills. The crispy fried pork was delicious. The food didn't take long to arrive.
sample_reviews_en.author: 난난NHUN

restaurants.name: Savory Malatang สาขา The Mercury Ville @ Chidlom
restaurants.address:

Phloen Chit Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a comfort food to those who loves Sichuan cuisine. Overall the Mala Tang here has great taste. I ordered the spiciest level for the soup base because it is not that spicy. There were varieties of vegetables and noodles to choose from.

Speed of serving: for malatang, just regular servicing sites. Not extremely fast. The lineup during lunch time is extremely long.

Service: The cashier seems confused; whatever requirement I told her, she did not pay attention. So I talked the manager instead.
The manager knows how to take care of the customer, and translate the requirement such as “no garlic, don’t overbook the potato slices” to the cooking process in the kitchen.

Some suggestions: More vegetable varieties suchs as celtuce or gong cai will be nice additions. More ball varieties such as Taiwanese or Chao Shan Pork Balls or squid balls.

Why the lotus roots are not crunchy? They are generally soft and absorb a lot of water to begin with.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamolkarn Srimongkol

sample_reviews_en.text: Heard there was a new mala soup place and dropped by after work. The shop is small and tables are very near each other. There wasn't a wide variety of ingredients but they were quite fresh. 4 soups to choose from and we chose the spicy mala & original. The spiciness cannot be changed. The original was quite bland for me as i prefer it stronger whilst the mala was about average. Service was quick and friendly. The variety of sauces is also quite limited. Won't be back here as other places are more tasty. But drop by if you are nearby, it's still better than some of the other mala restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Crypto Calories

sample_reviews_en.text:
The mala is delicious! We love this brand. The white mala soup is great, and the stir-fried noodles are fantastic. However, the female employee who handled the payment on August 4th, 2026 at 5:55 PM was not pleasant. She had a grumpy expression when I made a mistake at checkout. I would like her to improve her demeanor and customer service.

Luckily, the pretty, slightly chubby female employee provided excellent service. She was the best! She helped resolve the issue and found items that were out of stock. 💕
sample_reviews_en.author: RATTANA RUEANKAEW

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just had my inaugural Malatang experience, and it was a flavor-packed adventure! 🌶️ Being able to handpick ingredients from the fridge adds a unique touch. 💡

Pro tip: Dive into the mala soup – it's a taste explosion! 💥 Remember, you pay by the weight of your chosen ingredients. Ready for your own culinary journey? 🍜✨ #MalatangMagic #SpicyAdventure #FoodieFinds
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachadech Marprasert

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just tried it earlier today in the evening. The taste and the atmosphere is absolutely authentic.

The choices of food, though is not too many relatively to those of in China, but the ones here are still many enough and it still gives me 100% malatang experience.

Kudos to the owner who has done a great research as well!
sample_reviews_en.author: Peam Suttapirom

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I had the chance to try their dry-fried mala. It was very well-made, not greasy, and the spiciness was just right. However, I didn't see the chili flakes that other restaurants use in their dry-fried mala; it must be their unique recipe. They also gave me a free glass of chrysanthemum tea today.
sample_reviews_en.author: Minky Somtong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thai cabbage, in my memory, isn't as good as highland cabbage, but this dish was incredibly delicious.

The stir-fried crab meat was excellent.

The oyster omelet was delicious, and the sauce was very unique.

The waiter was fantastic!

My first meal in Bangkok was unforgettable!
sample_reviews_en.author: 夏花

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered Tom yam Goong, Crab Meat Curry and a Basil Pork. The dishes are nice and delicious. I will recommend to my friends if they travel to Bangkok. The staff are nice too, they explained and recommended some dishes for us as they know me and my friend are tourists.
sample_reviews_en.author: Axel Kan

restaurants.name: SUNNY MAN Naradhiwas
restaurants.address:

32, 34 Naradhiwas Rajanagarindra Rd, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I stopped by hoping for a good meal, and the food honestly exceeded expectations. Every dish was impressively flavorful, and the Japanese small plates were so varied that choosing was part of the fun 😋

The lively, cheerful atmosphere made the whole time enjoyable, and everything felt worth more than the price. If you are looking for an Izakaya in Sathorn, this is a place I’d happily return to again!่
sample_reviews_th.author: Dolly

sample_reviews_en.text:
I usually love this restaurant and this is my fourth time eating here. I understand that food takes time to prepare, but this time I was extremely disappointed. I ordered the Wagyu beef sukiyaki as my first dish, but it came last, and the first serving was the wrong dish – clam soup! The staff took it back and talked to the chef for a while. I waited until all the other dishes were finished, and when it finally arrived, I was shocked to find the beef was in tiny scraps! Don't even call it Wagyu sukiyaki; it was more like tofu in beef soup. I was so disappointed. It was also too sweet. It was nothing like what I expected, and the price was way too high.

🚩I have been contacted by the restaurant and they have taken responsibility. I still love this restaurant, and the owner is very attentive to customers. They explained that the incident was due to a new chef and staff member making a mistake. 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: P. C.

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious! I loved it!

I went for a meal because I wanted a relaxed atmosphere after work, and I was impressed from the moment I walked in. The atmosphere was warm and friendly; it was very relaxing.

The food was incredibly delicious, especially the meticulous preparation from the open kitchen, which allowed me to see how each dish was cooked, making it even more appetizing. There's a wide variety of small Japanese dishes to choose from, perfect for ordering at your leisure.

The price was reasonable considering the quality and the experience. It was worth it, and I'll definitely go back again. If you're looking for an Izakaya in the Sathorn area with a great atmosphere and delicious food, I highly recommend it! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: keerati sansuk

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried this place because I wanted to find a chill spot after work, and I was pleasantly surprised. The menu is incredibly creative, with each dish having a unique feel that's hard to find elsewhere. They also offer a wide variety of small Japanese dishes, making ordering fun and enjoyable. 😊

The atmosphere is lively and vibrant, perfect for hanging out with friends or just relaxing for drinks and food. The service was efficient, making the meal flow smoothly without feeling rushed.

For the Sathorn area, this Izakaya-style restaurant is excellent value for money. It offers great taste, a fun atmosphere, and creative menu ideas. I definitely plan to go back and try other dishes next time! 🍻
sample_reviews_en.author: Wannee Sriwarakulkit

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went after work and was impressed from the start by the lively, fun, and inviting atmosphere. Seeing the open kitchen where each dish was meticulously prepared made the food even more delicious. There's a wide variety of Japanese small dishes to choose from, making ordering quite enjoyable 😊

What I liked most was the service from the staff; they were attentive and friendly. The prices felt reasonable for the quality. If you're in the Sathorn area and want a relaxed izakaya-style dining and drinks experience with diverse options, this is definitely worth a return visit. If you're arriving late, it's advisable to call and make a reservation!
sample_reviews_en.author: Aun B

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there because I wanted a comfortable place to relax after work, and I was impressed from the very first bite. The food was delicious, exceeding my expectations. The variety of small Japanese dishes available made ordering fun and enjoyable. 😊

The atmosphere was lively and vibrant, perfect for a casual meal and drinks. The service was efficient, and the food arrived at a good pace without a long wait.

I was especially impressed with the value for money. I felt like I got more than I paid for. For anyone looking for an izakaya around Sathorn, I highly recommend trying this one! I definitely plan to go back again next time. 🍻
sample_reviews_en.author: si si

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a very relaxing time here, with a calm atmosphere that made it easy to unwind after a busy day. The open kitchen was especially nice to watch, and seeing each dish prepared so carefully made everything feel even more delicious 😊

For anyone looking for Izakaya, Sathorn has a spot with plenty of choice, especially Japanese small plates, so it was fun deciding what to order. The flavors were the highlight for me, and everything tasted thoughtfully made.

The pricing felt fair for the quality, and overall it was a warm, satisfying experience! I’d happily come back to try more dishes next time
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanathut Tantiveerakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went because I saw the happy hour offer and it was more than worth it. The food was delicious, especially the well-balanced flavors of each dish, and you could really feel the care put into it. They use truly fresh ingredients.

The atmosphere was lively and fun, perfect for hanging out with friends. There's a wide variety of Japanese izakaya-style small dishes to choose from in Sathorn, and it's great value for money. 🍶

It would be even better if they had a few more menu items, more diverse food and drink promotions, and more affordable sake. I'll definitely be back! 😄
sample_reviews_en.author: Pamornpan Komolpamorn

restaurants.name: Hie Ming Crispy Pork Belly
restaurants.address:

10 Lat Ya Rd, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This famous crispy pork shop is located near Wongwian Yai. I actually found out about it from a travel guide, but it took a while to get there because I didn't have the chance and thought parking would be difficult – which it was. However, you can park briefly in front of the shop with your hazard lights on. The shop owner said there's no police to chase you away or tow your car if you park for just a short time. Knowing that, I've been a regular customer since then.

The crispy pork is quite lean and tastes great even without dipping sauce. But with the two sauces they provide, it's absolutely amazing. I've bought it to take home, and the crispiness decreases a bit. I recommend putting it in an air fryer to revive it and make it taste just as good.

I'd say if you eat this crispy pork with the famous gravy from other shops, especially if you like roasted pork, it's incredibly delicious, I guarantee it. If it's not too far to come, using a delivery rider is a good option. But if you're a true crispy pork lover, you absolutely must try it at least once before the world ends.
sample_reviews_en.author: tome Nattapong Worapivut

sample_reviews_en.text:
Following a friend's recommendation, I took the train from Wongwian Yai to Mahachai around 6 PM, got off at Wongwian Yai station, and walked using Google Maps.

I ordered 2 portions of crispy pork belly, full price 140 baht (government subsidy program accepted).

The crispy pork was incredibly crispy; you could hear the crunch from the person next to me. The meat was also plentiful and delicious. It came with a sweet soy sauce. It lived up to the hype my friend gave it! 😍

The seller was very nice and even helped me order drinks and noodles from a nearby shop. However, the seating is right by the Wongwian Yai roundabout. If you're sensitive to dust or smoke, I wouldn't recommend sitting inside. Takeout is better.
sample_reviews_en.author: CJJ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Taste - 6/10
Service - 10/10
Price - 9/10
Parking - 4/10

Recommendation - Crispy pork, crispy pork, crispy pork.

Pros - Okay price / Good service

What to expect - Ok price. Good service.

Cons - (I'd like to offer a different opinion from others (and the social media trend)) The taste isn't up to par. The skin is crispy, but the pork meat is a bit tough, and without the dipping sauce, the meat is rather bland (not salty enough). Parking is difficult.

Don’t be surprised - (I beg to differ from others (and the social media trend)) the taste is still below average. The crackling is quite crispy. However, the meat part is a bit tough and, without the dipping(s), too bland (not salty enough). Parking is difficult.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thaweechot Tatiyapermpoon

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Hia Ming Crispy Pork" Shop
- A famous shop in the Wongwian Yai area.
- Previously, it was very popular, crowded, and sold out quickly.
- Now, the crowds have thinned out, but there's still plenty of crispy pork left in the evenings.
- The pork skin is crispy and puffy, not hard, with not too much fat and the meat is nicely tender. Price is 70 baht per 100 grams.
- The shop adds pandan leaves during frying for extra aroma.
However, the pandan aroma isn't very noticeable when eating.
- There are two types of dipping sauces: a sweet and salty black soy sauce, and a chili sauce with a good balance of sweet and sour.
- The shop is located right at Wongwian Yai. Parking in front of the shop can be difficult.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amornthep Numsricharuenkul

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the real deal crispy pork at Wongwian Yai, next to the pawnshop near the famous pork blood soup restaurant. The pork is incredibly crispy, with just the right amount of fat, and tastes amazing with sweet soy sauce and spicy sauce. It's the perfect accompaniment to a bowl of pork blood soup. The owner's mother chops it into large pieces by weight, at 70 baht per 100 grams. It's prepared fresh, not greasy at all. A must-try for crispy pork lovers; a real gem in this area!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasin Keatparitus

sample_reviews_en.text: Uncle Ming's Crispy Pork, Wong Sian Yai branch. The owner is lovely. The pork is crispy with a puffy, crunchy skin and tender, juicy meat. You can choose your pieces and specify whether you want more or less fat. It's 70 baht per 100 grams. Luckily, I went when the shop first opened and it wasn't too crowded, but soon people started lining up. Uncle Ming is making more pork now than before, so even those who arrive later can get some. I highly recommend trying it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rika Kumphol

sample_reviews_en.text: This famous crispy pork vendor near Wongwian Yai, at the end of King Taksin's sword, offers customizable crispy pork with your choice of less or normal fat, crispy skin or puffy skin. It comes with two dipping sauces: a sweet dark soy sauce and a sauce similar to chili sauce. Priced at 70 baht per 100 grams, the crispy pork is delicious, flavorful, with crispy skin and tender meat, free of any unpleasant odor. Perfect for buying and eating right away.
sample_reviews_en.author: RRAARRIINN

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the crispiest and most delicious crispy pork belly I've ever tasted. When you eat it, a fragrant, delicate spice aroma lingers in your mouth. The crispiness gets a 100/10! I bought it the first time and ate it all before I could take a picture, so I had to go back for another purchase 😁
-As for the price, it's not expensive at all for crispy pork belly. Even making it myself, the ingredients and labor wouldn't cost this much.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kritsada Wong

restaurants.name: Verygood steakhouse
restaurants.address:

สวนหย่อมวัดยางบางจาก Khuha Sawan, Phasi Charoen, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Steak restaurant in a garden next to Wat Yang temple.
The atmosphere is like a garden with a playground.
They offer a variety of steak options: fried chicken, fried fish, grilled chicken, grilled sirloin, grilled tenderloin.
Snacks are also available: french fries, onion rings, nuggets, salad, and sausages.
Rice sets are also available.
Prices start at 49 baht, with set menus available up to a large steak platter for 399 baht.
The taste is average, edible, except for the sausage which we didn't like.
Dipping sauces include Jaew (spicy dipping sauce) and basil sauce, which were tasty.
Parking is available next to the temple.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apinyaked Thangrod

sample_reviews_en.text:
It lives up to its reputation! Follow the road down the alleyway along the temple wall and you'll find the shop.

The steak with spicy dipping sauce is absolutely amazing! So delicious and very reasonably priced.

Personally, I think this is one of the best street food steak places I've ever tried.

The shop is open from 4 PM to 10 PM. You can reserve or order in advance via LINE. I bought three boxes to take home – just to satisfy my craving!

See you later! Don't forget to come and try it! It's a great shop, so please support it!
sample_reviews_en.author: MESSIK.456 M.

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been here 3-4 times now. Parking is available at the temple. Every dish is delicious. The jaew sauce is excellent. The pork neck is amazing. It practically melts in your mouth. There's a full range of fish steaks and chicken steaks. The burgers are the highlight. If you're with 3 people, I recommend ordering a large tray because you'll get to eat everything without having to waste time choosing. 😋😋
sample_reviews_en.author: LY T

sample_reviews_en.text:
As night fell, mosquitoes began to appear. The pork steak and crispy fried fish were delicious. Unfortunately, there was no grilled fish. I don't recommend the sausage.
The atmosphere was pleasant along the canal, under a tall and large Indian almond tree. The atmosphere was open, airy, and comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ying K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This roadside steak restaurant is located in the small park of Wat Yang temple. It has a nice atmosphere and good service, situated by the park and not too crowded. Recommended dish: a huge, filling steak for 399 baht.

The restaurant is open from 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM, Monday to Friday.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alongkorn Thongsai

sample_reviews_en.text: This steak restaurant in the park serves delicious and affordable steaks. There aren't many tables, but it's always busy. Motorcycles can be parked, but I'm not sure about car parking. The menu offers a variety of options, especially steak platters priced under 500 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: kookykiss kook

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was mediocre, neither bad nor amazing.
The public tables had bird droppings; they should wipe them down.
As for the service, I ordered and waited for an hour before asking if my food was ready. The vendor said he forgot to make it. 🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: พัชชารัตน์ โภคินวัชรเกียรติ

sample_reviews_en.text: We arrived around 5 PM, and the food was a bit slow to come out, we waited about 40 minutes. Parking is available along the road or in the temple grounds. The restrooms are in the temple. The restaurant is located in a community garden area.
sample_reviews_en.author: poonsak poonsiripooriya

restaurants.name: rose and ray
restaurants.address:

5th fl 839 ถ. เจริญกรุง Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there with friends celebrating a birthday but got an unpleasant treatment from the staffs, slow responses and unequal service.

We were not allowed to use flash for photos, while others were. When we asked if a staff could take a group photo for us, she asked us to wait for over five minutes. We eventually decided to take the group photo ourselves, outside the restaurant but in a connected front room. Other customers had spent time there, but when we went in after them, the staff immediately informed us that it would be closing soon.

I’m unsure why we received this treatment, especially we paid nearly 5K THB and ensured we followed the restaurant’s regulations.

Unlike the reviews, the taste was quite good but the quantity compared to the reviews is obviously different. the atmosphere was not exceptional, dark and unwelcoming outside.
We tried to understand this is a new restaurant, but we are still wonder by the poor service we experienced.

Could you please explain why we didn’t receive the same quality of service as other customers despite we also paid a 10% service charge ???
sample_reviews_en.author: Shermaline S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to Rose and Ray in the Talat Noi district.

Located on the fifth floor of an old building in the old town, the restaurant's antique atmosphere may be overwhelming, but once you see the restaurant's exterior and interior, you'll feel like you're in another world.

It's a restaurant with a solid style and concept, with a wonderful interior and a very girly and stylish atmosphere.

Women will especially love it.

This Western restaurant also allows dogs.

Every dish was beautifully presented and delicious, so I'd definitely like to return.

Shiso Gin
Gin, Shiso, Egg White, Yuzu,
Lemon, Soda

Yuzu Marigold Sour
Gin, Marigold Tea, Egg White,
Yuzu, Honey, Lemon

White Wine

Burrata Strawberries

Chicken Liver Pate,
Caramelized Bacon Onion,Sourdough

Hamachi Crudo with Yuzu Honey Mustard,
Shiso Flowers,Olive Oil

Linguine White Wine with Pan
Seared Scallops, Shiso Leaf, Fish Roe

Capellini Ponzu Truffle
with Hokkaido Hotate and Ikura

Pistachio Raspberry Tiramisu
sample_reviews_en.author: ふじー

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re looking for a cozy spot with a warm, inviting ambiance, Rose and Ray is the place to be. From the moment you step in, the atmosphere wraps around you like a comforting hug, making it perfect for a relaxed meal.

The food? Simply spectacular. One dish that stands out is their Rose and Ray African Chicken and Herb Rice. The chicken is perfectly crisp on the outside yet juicy and tender inside—a true testament to their culinary mastery. Paired with three unique and flavorful dips, it’s an explosion of taste in every bite. The herb rice complements it beautifully, adding a fresh and fragrant touch.

Not to forget their Chrysanthemum and Peach Tea—a perfect pairing that elevates the whole experience. Its delicate floral notes and fruity sweetness provide a refreshing balance to the rich flavors of the meal.

This place is a gem—highly recommended for anyone who loves great food, cozy vibes, and thoughtful drink pairings. Don’t miss it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chirachatra Tejasen (Kong)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Rose & Ray certainly lives up to its name, offering a beautiful setting with cool lighting that creates a lovely atmosphere. It's a great spot for various occasions, whether you're out with family, friends, or on a date.
The food here is truly impressive. We found the ingredients to be of high quality, and each dish was prepared thoughtfully. The burrata with tomatoes was incredibly fresh, and all the pasta dishes we tried were perfectly al dente with excellent flavor. For dessert, both the pistachio raspberry tiramisu and the chocolate mousse cake were delightful ways to end the meal.
The staff also deserves a mention. They are consistently polite and attentive, which adds to the overall pleasant dining experience.
Overall, Rose & Ray is a place worth visiting. It feels like a hidden gem that's definitely worth checking out, and I'd be happy to go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: mewmiu P

sample_reviews_en.text: the restaurant is freshly vibrant and unique. they always decorated the place with fresh flowers which gives liveliness to the place. the artisanal and quirky decor, the little details here and there, truly enhanced the uniqueness of the place which is contrasting to the environment of the area and i simply relish the differences there. aside the atmosphere that stole my heart, i enjoyed my time there with a group of friends. the menu is varied and extremely intriguing. some of the ingredient combos in their dishes sound so fun and experimental. i would love to try them all one day. so far, my favorite dish would be capellini truffle ponzu with hotate—so refreshing and tasty. it’s different, unique, and it’s nothing like i’ve ever tried before. i still am thinking about it and i cannot wait to visit this place again! <3
sample_reviews_en.author: bratz type beat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hidden gems in Taladnoin area. The location is in the old building at5fl. If I'm not worng. Before you walk into the restaurant. You may thinking is that correct way? However there is the label to tell you where the restuarant is. Price is abit higher if we compare with normal meal. But worth for dinner with special friend or couple. Today order is
1. Seasonal fish ratatouille - fresh ingredients crispy skin fish
2. Bucatini Arasi Clams with garlic chili - personal though who like Al Dente is ok but for me I would prefer a bit more softer that Al Dente. other ingredients is nice and fresh clams.
3. Mix salad with Stracciatella - the best for starter fresh sour with passion fruit and creamy by cheese. - my fav dish ever!!
4. End with dessert Tiramisu pistachio
sample_reviews_en.author: Gibguew U

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is one of those places you don’t just stumble upon. It really feels like a hidden find, hidden away on the 5th floor of an old building.

You can tell how much care went into the space. They kept the nostalgic character of the building and blended it nicely with a more modern touch. It’s cozy but still quite spacious, so it feels private and relaxed.

The food leans toward contemporary French. Not too heavy, with some lighter and more refreshing options. Portions are generous, and everything we ordered was solid. The steak and fries and spicy bacon spaghetti stood out, both cooked really well.

And don’t skip the pistachio raspberry tiramisu. It’s lighter and more refreshing than the usual version, but still creamy and very satisfying.
sample_reviews_en.author: N S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every dish was truly delicious. The owner, a young woman, oversees and serves the food herself.
She does a fantastic job, but the portion sizes are quite small. The flavors are easy to eat, not too strong, making it enjoyable to enjoy. If you're going with a group of friends, you can order a lot because the portions aren't huge.

The best dish was the pistachio raspberry tiramisu. I didn't expect much at first, but after trying it, I ordered it immediately.

Parking is available on the sidewalk. The shop is a little difficult to find because the sign is small, and you have to take an elevator up. The building downstairs looks almost abandoned, but once you get to the top, you'll find a cute shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vasinee P.

restaurants.name: ร้านสวัสดี สาขาเสนา(หอยทอดสวัสดี)
restaurants.address:

2008/19 Phahonyothin Rd, Sena Nikhom, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Considering the portion size compared to the price, it's a bit expensive.
But considering the taste, it's worth it.

The restaurant is on the main road. It has air conditioning inside (we went early in the morning, around 9 am, so it wasn't on). It's a short walk from BTS Sena station and not far from Paolo Kaset Hospital.

We ordered two dishes: Pad Thai and fried mussels.
- The Pad Thai was well-balanced and delicious, no need to add any extra seasoning. 50฿. It only had dried shrimp as meat.
- The fried mussels were crispy and delicious, not oily, and not greasy. 50฿.
- Ice was 2฿/glass.
- Free water is available on the table. They also sell soft drinks and black tea.

If I have business in the area, I'd probably eat here again. But if not, I probably wouldn't. However, if you're passing by, I recommend giving it a try.
sample_reviews_th.author: P

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sawadee Restaurant, Sena Branch - Fried Oysters

Menu: Fried Oysters

Taste: Absolutely delicious! I loved it. The fried oysters were perfectly crispy, and the dipping sauce was amazing. A must-try! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

Location: Clean, small shop, and good service.

Price: Very affordable. They also have other menu items; fried oysters start at 50 baht, and the service is fast.

Recommendation: Eat at the restaurant to enjoy the crispy, hot oysters served fresh. The dipping sauce is a perfect match! 🤤🤤🤤

Parking: No parking available. You can park at Bang Khen Market or in the Sena Soi parking lot, whichever is more convenient. Alternatively, take the BTS to Sena Nikhom station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puiiz Srichaisantikul

sample_reviews_en.text:
My favorite place for more than a decade. My regular dishes are the fried clams and pork noodles. They provide friendly and quick service at very, very good prices. Air conditioning was recently added. You can park at the nearby hospital. Cash is preferred, but you can also pay via bank transfer and QR code.

I've been eating here since I was a child. The fried clams and pork noodles are delicious! The food is served quickly, and the owner and all the staff are lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Duangkamon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Recommendations: Try the fried oysters; they're crispy and not greasy.
The portion size and price are okay.
The restaurant is clean, the food comes out quickly, and the service is good.

Personally, I found the noodles a little too sweet, and there was a strange smell, but I can't pinpoint what it was.
I've never encountered a smell like that in noodles before.

The restaurant is located by the roadside and is easy to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: Taksinee Khongthan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there specifically to eat today.
Very disappointed.
The batter was hard and chewy, the shellfish looked old and tasteless, the batter tasted bitter and had a foul smell, like it was fried shellfish that had been fried a long time ago. Very disappointed. Every time I've gone there before, it wasn't just passing by or a stop, I intentionally went to eat there.
sample_reviews_en.author: เดอะทอย

sample_reviews_en.text: 67.01.20_Today after school at the agricultural college, I stopped by to eat some fried oysters. This shop focuses on crispy fried oysters, stir-fried with just enough bean sprouts to cook them. When eaten together, it's not too greasy. It's topped with chili sauce. I recommend eating it with a soft drink to help reduce the greasiness. All this cost 62 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: ห๊ะะะ

sample_reviews_en.text: The fried oysters were delicious, perfectly crispy and dry. / The stewed pork soup was also tasty. / The atmosphere in the restaurant was pleasant and not too hot. / The cleanliness was average. / There's no parking lot; you have to drive further to the market's paid parking lot. / The restaurant is located right by the road. / Excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Trainer 24hrs

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's been a while since I last ate there, it's one of my favorite restaurants.
I just went three days ago.
The radish cake was very oily.
It didn't look appetizing at all.
I was so disappointed. It's a shame about such a good restaurant.

But the chive noodle soup tasted the same as always.
The owner and staff were as lovely as ever.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sutathip Suchiow

restaurants.name: Analog Sky Flow
restaurants.address:

1351/1-5, GUMP's Cross, ชั้นที่ 5, Charoen Nakhon Rd, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everyone says this is the hidden bar of the Charoen Nakhon area, and yes!!!!! It really is a secret.

Take the elevator up to the 3rd floor of the GUMP’s Cross project and then walk up the spiral staircase at the back for another two floors to reach the rooftop.

Besides the beautiful live music every Saturday, you can't miss the incredibly delicious Pizza, which I highly recommend everyone try.

Enjoy the 90s atmosphere with Thai and international music, along with a nostalgic vibe that many people will surely miss.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tarn Suppayaluk

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Hidden Bar You Shouldn't Miss
Childhood Memories 🩵🩵

Welcome, our rooftop neighbors.
The view from your place is so fulfilling. On a nice day with a cool breeze and beautiful fireworks, paired with delicious food that fills us up for dinner.

We wish your bar good sales and lots of customers.
Of course, anyone who comes for tea at our shop, we'll be sure to tell them to go up to your rooftop too.

Note: Exit the elevator on the 3rd floor and walk up the spiral staircase at the back to reach the rooftop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiancha Gump's Cross

sample_reviews_en.text: This hidden gem on Charoen Nakhon Road is located on a rooftop. The ambiance is great, the view is stunning and relaxing, the music is fantastic, and there are plenty of seating options. The food is delicious, and they offer a wide variety of drinks, including beer, cocktails, and non-alcoholic beverages, some with set menus available. Whether you want to have a meal or just chill with drinks, I highly recommend it. I was very impressed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Care' Ry

sample_reviews_en.text: I love this place so much. If you are looking for a place for New Year Fireworks, this is the place! You can see fireworks from Icon Siam, and Chao Phaya River. The staffs are friendly and humble. The cheese pizza is so good. The prices are reasonable. On new year eve, they even prepare birthday cake and accessories for me as a gift! Highly recommended and will visit again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Zin Win Mar

sample_reviews_en.text:
The drinks are reasonably priced, starting from a few hundred baht, perfect for those who want to chill. There's also a wide variety of snacks.

I can honestly say this place is a rooftop hangout for those who want to fully relive the 90s era – the atmosphere, music, and drinks are all incredibly cozy.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภัสสร แสงสว่าง

sample_reviews_en.text: I was amazed when I walked in. The mood is great, the music is great, the food and drinks are great. I honestly didn't think there could be a place with such a perfect and amazing atmosphere. Once I found it, I was convinced. It's truly excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: MsEmma TV

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden rooftop bar with a great collection of 90s vinyl records. On a clear day, you can enjoy a view of the Chao Phraya River and the most beautiful fireworks in Bangkok.

Special: Enjoy live folk song performances every Saturday night.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pa Prank

sample_reviews_en.text: Chill out and enjoy the view from the rooftop. The atmosphere is great, and there's live music. I recommend the glass noodle salad; the noodles are chewy and the taste is delicious. I've been here many times.
sample_reviews_en.author: KANSIREE J.

restaurants.name: ร้านป้าสำราญ
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 37/8 หมู่ 10 Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍛🍜 Braised Pork Rice and Roast Pork are incredibly juicy and delicious!
