This restaurant has a friendly atmosphere with a decent number of tables inside. The front of the restaurant is divided into two sections for rice and noodle dishes.

The menu includes Hainanese chicken rice, roast pork and crispy pork rice, braised pork rice, and chicken and duck stew noodles, starting at 55 baht.
🐽 The roast pork, crispy pork, and braised pork rice here are incredibly juicy. The roast pork is good, not too chewy, the braised pork is soft and tender, and the crispy pork is very crispy. The sauce is on the sweeter side and rich.
🍜 The noodles are served in a thick broth (like a stewed pork broth) with a sweet and savory flavor. The stewed meat is quite tender.
👨‍🍳 The owner is friendly and polite, and helpful in recommending condiments and dipping sauces.

Parking is quite difficult at the restaurant. You can park on the street in front of the restaurant or across the street (parking is prohibited on even/odd days on this street, and on the restaurant's side, it's prohibited on odd days). Alternatively, you can park at the Friendship Mall for a small fee.
sample_reviews_en.author: j. chon

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old, long-established restaurant that I recently had the chance to try.
The recommended dish is the braised beef noodle soup. The braised beef is so tender it melts in your mouth, the spices aren't overpowering, and it has a subtle beef aroma. The beef meatballs are decent but a little bland. The broth is rich and flavorful, though slightly sweet, but well-balanced.
Another recommended dish is the braised duck noodle soup. It's okay, but the duck meat isn't as tender as I'd like. The broth is decent.
Another recommended dish is the roasted pork and crispy pork rice. It's just okay, nothing outstanding.
The prices are considered inexpensive.
The downside is that parking is difficult. Be careful about parking on this street; you might get a parking ticket without realizing it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stk Runig

sample_reviews_en.text: Super delicious local gem, top-notch service 👍 Everyone, I’ve discovered a real hidden local gem! 🤩 The atmosphere was cozy and really nice. And what can I say about the food? It was seriously delicious! 😋 In particular, the main dishes, the beef noodles and pork belly rice bowl, were truly unforgettable. The owner was so kind, and the service was top-notch. 👍 It’s a place I definitely want to visit again! You all have to give it a try! Highly recommended! 💯 #LocalGourmet #RestaurantRecommendation #BestGourmetEver #HiddenGem #Foodstagram #Eatstagram #DailyLife #Daily
sample_reviews_en.author: 송영준

sample_reviews_en.text:
ABSOLUTELY DELICIOUS 🤤

The beef-noodle soup 🍜 and the pork-leg on rice are very typical Thai dishes, but rarely have I had such a delicious experience, extravagant.

This has to be grandma’s special recipe, absolutely stunning and satisfying, very flavorful, rich taste.

If you add a little chili 🌶️ powder and you could be the happiest human in the galaxy. What an astonishing restaurant ! 👅

Very friendly staff, we will go there regularly. It’s just too good to only go once. 👍🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel A

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant truly embodies the warm and welcoming spirit of the local community, offering heartwarming dishes that reflect authentic Thai flavors.

The food was both delicious and genuine, and the staff made the experience even better with their friendliness and hospitality. I genuinely felt the warmth and kindness of the Thai people and the neighborhood here.

Service was excellent—fast, efficient, and easy to communicate with. I’ll definitely be coming back!
sample_reviews_en.author: jy Liew

sample_reviews_en.text: I stumbled upon this local restaurant while randomly walking down the street, looking for breakfast. I chose the menu based solely on the photos, but the beef bowl was quite tasty. The owner greeted me warmly even though it was only 30 minutes before the restaurant opened. Thai-style rice bowls are often a bit bland, but this one had a bit more seasoning, so I think Koreans would enjoy it. I added fries and it was delicious. (Beef bowl + extra fries = 70 baht)
sample_reviews_en.author: 므하하하하

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's really popular with Chinese people! Maybe it's because there's a hotel nearby where many Chinese people stay? I went at 9am. It was full and they only left one table for me.
I had a double meal of Khao Man Gai mix and crispy pork and BBQ pork mix. The menu circled in my photo is where you can try the mix, so I highly recommend it!
Two for 120 baht! Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: Shinya Mukai

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pork leg rice is incredibly delicious. The pork is tender, and the sauce is flavorful. It's like the restaurant's signature recipe. It's different from other places, but it's delicious. I've been here twice and will definitely go again!
The restaurant serves it with soup. The price is reasonable. There's some street parking in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: wirin sittikhat

restaurants.name: Puradak The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi
restaurants.address:

Floor 3, Dining Garden, Lat Phrao Rd Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I used to order Puradak every week back in Korea. My kids loved it so much... I was disappointed that there wasn't a Puradak after moving to Thailand, but then I found one in Bangkok, so I gave it a try...

Taste: I naturally expected the kimchi stew to be sweet. It is Thailand, after all... ㅠㅠ The tteokbokki isn't the main dish, so I'll let that slide. I ordered the Original chicken, which is the main item, but the chicken had a slightly fishy smell and a musty odor. I fry chicken in a deep fryer at home every week, and this smelled exactly like old chicken. It didn't look like there were many customers, so maybe the turnover wasn't fast, which might be the reason... Anyway, it was a smell I never encountered at Puradak in Korea... If it were a matter of the chicken's storage condition or the time, of course it wouldn't be like this every time. The frying and the visuals are similar to Korea's, though... I hope they manage things properly to maintain consistent quality and taste. Also, they don't provide the sauces they give in Korea. They just gave me mayonnaise and ketchup lol.

It looks like they just opened, but if it's still here in a year, I'll definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: chh j

sample_reviews_en.text:
Premium Korean fried chicken, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. A must-try for foodies!
🍗 Must-order menu items!
• Fried Chicken (Chili Mayonnaise & Black Alio flavors): The chicken here is amazing! It's perfectly fried, crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside.
• Chili Mayonnaise flavor: Creamy, savory, sweet, and very smooth. The jalapeño peppers perfectly cut through the richness.
• Black Alio flavor: Rich black soy sauce with a fragrant garlic aroma. A well-balanced, salty-sweet flavor. Those who love strong flavors will adore it.
• Onion Rings: Crispy and not greasy. Perfect for dipping while waiting for your main course.
• Kimchi Tofu Soup: Rich and flavorful soup with just the right amount of spiciness. Sipping it hot alongside the fried chicken helps cut through the richness and is very refreshing. The tofu is incredibly soft and smooth.

You might have to wait in line a bit because the restaurant fries everything fresh to order, served steaming hot – a testament to their attention to detail. The crispy deliciousness is definitely worth the wait!
sample_reviews_en.author: GraceisGrace

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ate at this restaurant yesterday. Almost everything on the menu was delicious, especially the Black Aglio fried chicken and Red Tteokgangjeong (worthy of being called Korean fried chicken and perfect for tteokbokki lovers)! ...But what impressed me even more was the excellent service from the staff (especially Ko)!

Incident: A customer ordered a promotional menu and paid, but the item was out of stock.

Solution: Ko consulted with her supervisor/manager and offered the customer a similar, more expensive promotional menu item without charging extra.

Customer feedback: Impressed by the excellent service mind and superb problem-solving skills.

Thank you and my appreciation to Ko and the supervisor/manager of Puradak, The Mall Bangkapi branch, for their attentive service. I will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dao Siree

sample_reviews_en.text: We've eaten here three times already, but lately, the quality has been declining and the service has gotten worse. We're very disappointed and regret spending our money. The female staff member was unfriendly and seemed forced to work, while the male staff member was cheerful and friendly. We definitely won't be coming back. Also, the rice was extremely hard; even after we asked for it to be changed, it was still hard. It was a really disappointing experience. 🥲 We've never reviewed a restaurant negatively before; we usually only give positive reviews to other places, but this one...ugh.
sample_reviews_en.author: นงนุช เลิศธนากิจ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The chicken tastes exactly the same as in Korea.

The tteokbokki is inedible.

I found a hair in the chicken sauce and called a staff member, but they were too busy cleaning up and didn't give any feedback.

I tried to bear it and keep eating, but then a second short hair appeared. Since it was just two men eating, we tried to let it slide. But then, the final blow came—one more short hair—so we just left it.

The person who appeared to be the manager was only on their phone, and there were no Korean staff or managers present.

Do not come here. It is unsanitary.
sample_reviews_en.author: 윤슬아범

sample_reviews_en.text: It's very expensive compared to what you get. The taste is terrible, like eating at a street market stall, which is even better. It can't compare to good restaurants at all. Good restaurants are more expensive, but you get better quality. This one is completely lacking in flavor. The kimchi soup was meager, the sliced ​​pork was awful and extremely greasy, and not tasty at all. The chicken mayo was the cheapest and worst-tasting mayo ever. I think the good reviews are probably due to promotional offers for customers. I'm telling you, don't eat here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fern Mattikan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Puradak is a Korean fried chicken restaurant that first opened its first branch on Banthad Thong Road and has since expanded to include several locations, including one in Bang Kapi, not far from my house. So I took the opportunity to try it out.

I ordered...

🌟 Boneless Mabuloro (spicy fried chicken coated in sauce and sprinkled with fried garlic powder)
🌟 Spicy dry ramen and fried chicken
🌟 Kimchi dumpling soup
🌟 Fried Korean dumplings with pork filling
🌟 Fried chicken wrap with chili mayonnaise sauce
sample_reviews_en.author: NiNG648

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Korean fried chicken.
I like the boneless thighs; they're easy to eat, crispy, and delicious. There are several recipes to choose from.
I tried the original and the extra spicy versions... I felt I preferred the original. The extra spicy sauce was a bit too sweet, but the chicken was crispy and high quality.
The kimchi soup was very good and flavorful. The rice, however, wasn't very soft.
The radish and kimchi were very tasty and refillable.
The staff were friendly and helpful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chuniji Iam

restaurants.name: แม่ลำใย ข้าวต้มปลาเก๋า
restaurants.address:

82/2 Kanchanaphisek Rd, Bang Chueak Nang, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The taste is clear. If you're health-conscious, this restaurant is the answer. However, the quantity is a problem. In the picture, there are 5 shrimps, but in reality, there are only 3. 150฿. Grouper rice porridge 180฿ is also a small amount.
sample_reviews_th.author: Nantawan S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Looking at the menu at first, the prices might seem a bit high, but once the food arrived, I understood. The portions are huge, the ingredients are incredibly fresh, and the pieces are generous. In my opinion, it's worth the price.

🎏 Grouper/Sea Bass Congee: You can ask for extra rice for free. The fish is super fresh, perfectly blanched, and odorless. The broth is clear, light, and mild in flavor, with a fragrant fish broth. Two dipping sauces are provided: soybean paste and seafood sauce.

🦐 Tom Yum Mixed Seafood: Grouper, sea bass, and shrimp. As usual, there's a huge amount of seafood. The Tom Yum is clear and the flavor is incredibly light, like a feather!

🎣 Fried King Mackerel with Soy Sauce: Two pieces. The flesh is firm, perfectly fried, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. The soy sauce is only slightly salty, almost not salty at all, with a hint of sweetness.
sample_reviews_en.author: Iam Pupakae

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was driving around this area and searched on the map, saw this restaurant had good reviews, so I stopped by. Be careful not to drive past the entrance. After coming down from the bridge, stay to the left and turn in. It's a row of buildings along the road, but you can park in front of the shop.
I ordered two bowls of sea bass rice porridge. You can choose between 50 grams or 100 grams of fish meat. We chose 50 grams. The price is 100 baht per bowl. You can choose how much rice you want (the restaurant doesn't charge extra for this).
The fish meat was fresh, delicious, and not fishy.
The total price, including one bottle of water, was 210 baht (the restaurant didn't charge for two glasses of ice).
sample_reviews_en.author: ชวัลรัชย์ กิจสนาพิทักษ์

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant offers delicious and healthy food. I specifically came for the mixed fish porridge; the fish was fresh and not fishy, ​​the prawns were large and plump with a firm texture, and the fish bone broth was sweet and MSG-free. Other dishes also looked tempting and tasted great. We went with a large group today, so we had the opportunity to try many items. The stir-fried fish with celery was a must-order at every table, and the creamy egg rice was perfect for the kids. The prices are reasonable for the quality of the food. Although there weren't many staff members, they were lovely and provided excellent service. I will definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Achara Jung

sample_reviews_en.text:
I saw a recommendation on a Facebook page for a convenient restaurant in Thonburi, so I decided to stop by.

The taste is up to standard, and the ingredients are fresh.
It's Thai-style fish porridge. Their Tom Yum dishes are really good and flavorful.
However, I still prefer the Chinese style fish porridge; the broth here is a bit bland.
The stir-fried dishes have a typical Thai flavor.
The prices are a little on the high side.

The staff provided excellent service and were very friendly.

The atmosphere is simple, as it's a shophouse with limited seating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisby

sample_reviews_en.text:
This isn't a typical Chinese-style fish porridge place like Kimpo.
The taste is more like the Rayong-style fish porridge I ate for breakfast at my homestay, mainly because it uses celery and ginger as herbs.

The broth base is rather plain and not sweet enough.

But, the real highlight of this restaurant is the ingredients.
The fish, squid, and shrimp are incredibly fresh and cut into large pieces.
The Thai-style seasoning (like a spicy salad) is very well done.

The price reflects the quality of the ingredients; neither cheap nor expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pipe Pavich

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a restaurant I've driven past many times but never had the chance to stop by. Today I finally did, and I wasn't disappointed.
The taste was quite good, the fish was fresh and not fishy, ​​and the portions were generous. I didn't have to wait long after ordering. There's plenty of seating available. Normally, the restaurant sign is huge, but I asked the owner and they said it was damaged by heavy rain.
There's a wide variety of dishes to choose from. I'll definitely be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: SD Chindapol

sample_reviews_en.text: I was impressed with the food from the first time I visited. The ingredients are fresh and clean, and the chefs are meticulous in selecting them. The taste was perfect for me. Another dish that impressed me greatly was the spicy salad; it had a well-balanced and authentic flavor. The owner is polite, lovely, and friendly. The atmosphere in the restaurant is simple and comfortable. This restaurant consistently maintains its high standards, and I'm always impressed every time I return.
sample_reviews_en.author: varittha petchsom

restaurants.name: Bannraorimkhong
restaurants.address:

23 Bang Khanun, Bang Kruai District, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall, it's an impressive restaurant. The prices are moderate, the ingredients are fresh and of good quality, and the portion sizes are just right—not too much or too little. The service and hospitality are excellent, and the overall atmosphere of the restaurant is great.

Regarding the taste, I personally found it to be moderate—neither bland nor too strong—making it suitable for those who prefer mild or medium flavors, and also for those who like strong flavors.

My only suggestion is that the restaurant could try increasing the intensity of the flavors a little, especially the balance and umami of the dishes. Some dishes lean too much towards sweetness and saltiness, resulting in a lack of full flavor dimensions. If the flavors were slightly more intense, I believe it would appeal even more to customers who prefer stronger or more intense flavors.

However, this is just my personal opinion based on individual taste preferences. Overall, the restaurant is of good quality, and I believe that with a slight adjustment to the flavors, the food would be even more outstanding and impressive. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: SOPHITA KAEWKONGSRI

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is relaxing by the canal with parking available. There aren't many tables, so the food might be a bit slow because the owners cook everything themselves, but watching the water while you wait is very pleasant, like being at home with a gentle breeze. I recommend the crispy pork stir-fried with chili and salt – it's excellent; the pork is perfectly crispy, not hard or chewy. The tamarind sauce shrimp is delicious, but unfortunately, the chef battered and fried the river prawns, which I didn't like. The Korat chili paste is similar to Nam Prik Ong, but it wasn't quite to my liking. The grilled fish cake was fragrant, the stir-fried cabbage with fish sauce was decent, but I wouldn't recommend the grilled intestines. The prices are reasonable. The owners are very friendly. For dessert, they have a dessert similar to Khanom Thuay (Thai steamed rice pudding), but with a custard topping instead of coconut cream. Overall, I liked it and would visit again. The restaurant is only open on Saturdays and Sundays.
sample_reviews_en.author: Areerat V

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant staff are always smiling and in a good mood. The food is delicious, especially the dishes with shrimp and fish; the shrimp and fish are incredibly fresh and have a firm, chewy texture. The taste is fantastic, and the atmosphere is relaxing by the canal with boats passing by constantly, offering scenic views without being noisy – perfect for a family dinner or gathering. Recommended dishes include Tom Yum Seabass, Sour Curry with Shrimp and Fried Omelet with Mixed Vegetables, Traditional Glass Noodle Salad, and Shrimp Salad. Prices are moderate, neither cheap nor expensive. The place is clean, and they offer a wide variety of drinks, especially the blended coconut drink which tastes just like Mahachai ice cream. For Thai dessert, I recommend the banana pudding in a cup. The restaurant is only open on Saturdays and Sundays, until 9 PM. What impressed me most was how quickly the food came out, and how every dish was served on fresh banana leaves – amazing! ❤️❤️ 10/10
sample_reviews_en.author: Anuranyath Thanphatcharativanont

sample_reviews_en.text:
***The restaurant is only open on Saturdays and Sundays.***
The food is delicious, flavorful, and reasonably priced.
1. Three-flavor fried sea bass *****
(Crispy outside, soft inside, perfectly balanced sour, spicy, and sweet flavors)
2. Traditional glass noodle salad *****
(Sour, sweet, and spicy in just the right balance)
3. Clear tom yum soup with sea bass ****
4. Crispy wontons are incredibly delicious.
Not oily at all *****
5. Crispy pork basil rice. This dish:
The flavor is average (personally, I found it ordinary).
6. Grilled seafood curry in banana leaf wrap. The curry paste is fragrant and the flavor is delicious, but the bottom is burnt. It seems like the heat was too high. You have to only scoop from the top of the wrap; if you scoop from the bottom, you'll get a burnt and bitter smell.
sample_reviews_en.author: Worashin Chaiin (Little Pig)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This canalside restaurant is incredibly delicious! 🤩
It feels like eating at a relative's house. Every single dish was amazing (and I mean every single dish!), but my favorite was the steamed sea bass with soy sauce. The rich, savory flavor, served with hot rice, was simply the best ⭐️

The portions aren't too big, the prices are reasonable, and the atmosphere around 5-6 pm is fantastic – cool breeze, great view, and the food is perfectly delicious 🥰 There's parking available, and the owner is incredibly lovely. They gave great recommendations and a warm welcome. I was extremely impressed!

The restaurant is only open on Saturdays and Sundays. I'll definitely be back! 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Tine. ee

sample_reviews_en.text:
I only ordered two dishes: fried sea bass and tofu and minced pork soup. Both were delicious with minimal seasoning, reasonably priced, and offered a great atmosphere and excellent service. I suspect everyone taking orders is related; it didn't feel like hired staff, so the service felt genuine.

This restaurant also has an "unseen" gem: a stunningly beautiful traditional Thai house, one of the best I've ever seen, though unfortunately dilapidated.
Please support this restaurant so they can earn income to repair the house. The traditional Thai house will also become another selling point for the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Terdpong Mongsonti

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, fresh, and the portion sizes are just right. The prices are reasonable.
I highly recommend the dish of the day: grilled beef with spicy dipping sauce. The marinade and grilling of the beef is excellent; it's tender, fragrant, and has a great texture.
The iced tea is tasty, fragrant, and well-balanced.
The atmosphere is relaxing, with views of the canal – so peaceful!
The staff are friendly and provide great service.
* The restaurant is only open on:
Saturdays and Sundays
from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: Si Thanapat

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a chill atmosphere, like eating by the river at a friend's house. The food is so delicious I wanted to tip the chef! It's only open on Saturdays and Sundays. It's not too difficult to get there, although the entrance to the soi (alley) might be a little hard to spot. Follow the map and stay to the left; look carefully (there's a sign in the soi pointing to the Immigration office). Parking is adequate for the size of the restaurant. I'll definitely be back! Everyone who comes here is happy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarayut Podjanaprechakul

restaurants.name: Lil cafe
restaurants.address:

293/8, Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been there many times. The owner is probably an architect or interior designer. They also offer various drawing classes. The shop is beautifully decorated, with a warm atmosphere and lots of pretty figurines. They have board games to play. I went specifically for the coffee; they have a selection of beans and make it using a Rok hand-press espresso machine and a hand grinder (I think it's a Timemore). The coffee is really good, and they even add a frothed coffee foam on top. The prices are very reasonable.

The only downside is parking; it can be difficult to find a spot if there are cars parked right in front of the shop.

Overall, it's a great place to work or relax for extended periods. It's also convenient for hanging out with friends, playing games, or having business meetings because it's quite quiet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaiwat Mas

sample_reviews_en.text:
- It's good. The shop isn't very large, but it has enough space for several tables. The atmosphere is relaxed.
- I ordered an iced cocoa. The taste was okay, but the cocoa powder hadn't melted yet. There was a small amount at the bottom of the glass. When you drink it, make sure you drink it from the top. If you drink it from the bottom, it won't be cold enough due to the small amount of ice. I think they put the drink in first and then add the ice (this is just a guess).
- When served, it comes as a set on a tray. It includes the drink you ordered, water, a (paper) straw in a bag, and tissues.
- Since it's a paper straw, if you don't drink it quickly, the straw will soak in the water for a long time and bend, making it difficult to drink.
Overall, it's okay, about 8/10.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nunoo Tongkorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Love this cozy cafe. If you are ARMY you might want to drop by. There are small corners with touches if BTS and the owner teams up with several ARMYs to hold birthday workshops for the members birthdays.

The cafe also offers large tables that are comfortable to work at and a variety board games to play as well.

The drinks are also very nice. Don't know where my other pics are. I've had the latte, caramel macchiato, borahae, and dalgona. All wonderful.

Get her by MRT and a small walk or bus ride. If you intend to drive here there is only curbside parking from 9-3.

Reccomend visiting their IG page to check if they're open as sometimes they might be closed for special events.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karina Suvapataya

sample_reviews_en.text:
“Welcome lost visitors who are looking for somewhere to heal.”

Today, I'm a lost visitor seeking a place to heal myself. This cute little shop is a short walk from the Tao Poon MRT station. Inside, there are about 5-6 tables, books to read, and board games to play. The atmosphere is chill and relaxing.
The owner is also lovely, smiling, and friendly, which makes the atmosphere even better.

Today I ordered an iced latte (70 THB) and a carrot cake (90 THB). It was a large, satisfying slice with plenty of ingredients. Eating and reading a book was a great vibe.

Come visit, everyone! 🫶
sample_reviews_en.author: Elle Amfine

sample_reviews_en.text:
This not-so-secret coffee shop is tucked away discreetly around Pracha Chuen Soi 8.
(You might need a bit of observation to find it.)
The shop's decor is perfect for figure enthusiasts and those who appreciate cute cafes. The atmosphere is calm and warm, ideal for reading a book or catching up on your favorite series with your laptop. However, the real highlight is the visually stunning drinks, which are readily available.
The coffee and other drinks are excellent, and considering the ambiance, the price is more than worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Al3soluTz

sample_reviews_en.text:
A coffee shop that serves both tea and coffee. The shop is decorated cutely, with a brown and white color scheme, and seems to favor wood accents. The drinks taste good, and there's a wide variety of menu options. Parking is available on the street in front of the shop. It's not too crowded, making it convenient for working or taking away.

⭐️A lot of drinks
⭐️Clean shop
⭐️Nice Service
⭐️Cute decor & Clean Toilet

⭐️Wide menu selection
⭐️Clean shop
⭐️Friendly and lovely service
⭐️Cute decor and clean restroom
sample_reviews_en.author: GoWentWhy

sample_reviews_en.text: What a missed opportunity! I've been around here for years, but I only just discovered this cafe. It's amazing! Everything is perfect: the taste, the presentation of the drinks, the clean and comfortable atmosphere, the soft background music, the prices (very affordable), and the high-quality ingredients. I give it a perfect 100!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jessica Cute

sample_reviews_en.text: This small cafe by the roadside provides excellent menu recommendations. We ordered the Honey Comb Latte, which was fragrant and delicious. However, once the honeycomb melts, it becomes a bit sweet. For those who don't like sweet drinks, I recommend ordering just the latte. The coffee is delicious and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lah Pipatcharoenkij

restaurants.name: Custard Nakamura
restaurants.address:

595/2 Soi Sukhumvit 33/1, เเขวง คลองตันเหนือ Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
While any oh how walking the street saw this Japanese bakery, walked out with a few of their bakes.

I'm sold guys! I had the 𝐏𝐨𝐫𝐤 𝐜𝐮𝐭𝐥𝐞𝐭 𝐒𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐰𝐢𝐜𝐡 and it was so so good la! Good amount of the cutlet and the veggies in it goes so well. Wishing I did buy more of it 😆

And that tiny 𝐂𝐫𝐨𝐪𝐮𝐞𝐭𝐭𝐞 is also so yummy! The only regret was not getting more 😅

✨Pork cutlet Sandwich 45฿
✨Croquette 25฿
sample_reviews_th.author: S.Y

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small bakery jam packed with Japanese breads, sandwiches, and desserts. The mince meat sandwich and fried pork sandwich looks like their flagship items and are on the corner of the table as you walk in. The sandwiches are not in perfect condition and the bread is smashed around from the weight of the bread and probably because it has been sitting there for a while. There are so many breads I chose a couple to try out. You should be on your way to your hotel or somewhere to eat these items when you leave. It is not something you want to be carrying around. If this was Japan, the rating would be lower. There just aren’t many Japanese bakeries in Bangkok.

Mince Meat Sandwich: 7/10
-Lots of sautéed onions and well seasoned patties
-Tonkatsu sweet sauce and mayonnaise
-Bread is squished and not great to eat

Egg Salad 6.5/10
-I can only taste salt and mayonnaise

Custard 7.5/10

Visit: 1
sample_reviews_en.author: Yu-Ting

sample_reviews_en.text:
There are some good looking “mama made it” sandwiches and baked goods. Unfortunately both times we visited it was so incredibly cramped inside that we couldn’t even move. We gave up without buying anything. Smelled good, though. 😊
Sad to report that the food we bought when we went back again yesterday did not meet our expectations at all. I lived in Japan for ten years and have eaten in many neighborhood bakeries. To me and to my wife, the food we bought was very disappointing with the exception of the hamburger sandwich. It was, indeed, quite tasty. The other best seller we bought, the sweet potato danish, was a disappointment, and the curry bun we got by accident (it was mismarked as melon pan) was one of the worst of that sort that I’ve had. The curry was almost tasteless.
sample_reviews_en.author: Reginald Williams

sample_reviews_en.text:
Custard Nakamura locates on Sukhumvit 33/1 Alley, 3 mins walk from the Emquartier. The place have vast selections of bakery (Japanese style). Prices are pretty cheap comparing to others. Signatures here are the sandwiches (they give you huge chunk of meat!!).

The place was open for more than 45 years and counting!

The place can get cramped easily due to its very small space and flows of customers in and out at all times. Freshly baked from the oven. Friendly staff and cashier are there to serve your needs.

Nearest BTS Station is PhromPhong. Opens daily from 9am.

Please make sure to get a membership card (stamp) for discount for each time you purchased your bakery.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donny Boonyamanop

sample_reviews_en.text: This Japanese-style bakery is amazing! The prices are affordable, and the taste is great. They have a huge variety of pastries – so many choices you'll be spoiled for choice! It's packed with people, and everyone's buying at least five items, which is understandable because everything looks so tempting and the prices are mostly in the tens of baht. It's easy to find, located in Soi 33/1; just walk a short distance into the soi. Their cheese bread and cheese-filled bread are fantastic when warmed up in the air fryer. I bought some kind of fried pork sandwich for my boyfriend, and he vouched for how delicious it was. They also have a loyalty card program.
sample_reviews_en.author: WA AN

sample_reviews_en.text: Custard Nakamura is a very popular Japanese bakery and dessert shop located in the Phrom Phong district. The shop offers a delightful variety of authentic Japanese desserts. It’s quite small, but packed with so many delicious treats that you might have to walk around 2-3 times just to decide what to get! With nearly 100 menu items, including bread, Danish pastries, croissants, savory sandwiches, cakes, puddings, cookies, and rolls, you’ll definitely find something to satisfy any sweet tooth. Their signature custard pudding is especially popular and not to be missed. The shop is always packed with customers and operates as take-out only.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chomticha S.

sample_reviews_en.text: If ever their was a shop that needed bigger premises then this is it. Food is great and good value, including sweet treats, donuts and proper English bread. Go when it's busy (is it ever quiet?) and you'll become adept at carrying a tray, balancing pastries on it and squeezing past everyone else to get to the cashier at the wrong end of the shop! Utter Bangkok bakery chaos. If ever a place needed a different layout (cashier by the door for example) then this is it. But it works, just don't even consider going inside if you are claustrophobic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Jones

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pastries are reasonably priced. Of all the ones I tried, I liked the melon shio bread the best. The others were just okay; they didn't seem to be made that fresh.
There were a lot of foreign customers, and they were really scrambling to get what they wanted, making the atmosphere in the shop and the queues chaotic.
The staff weren't smiling at all. Personally, as someone who works in service, this is just my opinion.
I like that they have a loyalty card for discounts, which you can pick up yourself at the counter.
sample_reviews_en.author: Smiling Spoon

restaurants.name: Shabushi by Oishi
restaurants.address:

444 Phaya Thai Rd, Khwaeng Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's been at least 11 years since I last ate at Shabushi. I decided to try it again on a Saturday evening to see what it would be like. I found the food to be just okay, but the food and service were nonsensical and below standard for the price of 400+ baht (net). Most other shabu-shabu restaurants in the market at the same price point offer a much better experience. Besides the quality of the food on the conveyor belt, there were other issues:

- The food line was sparse; for example, the curry pot was empty and wasn't refilled, the soy sauce was gone, and some menu items only had the labels left.

- The water I got from the dispenser had a strange smell (like Chinese medicine, similar to the smell of a Chinese hot pot restaurant), so I had to switch to green tea instead.

- The staff didn't explain how to order, and when I asked for a menu from one of the staff members, they acknowledged it but didn't bring one (I later found out the menu was right where they were standing; I had to go and get it myself).
sample_reviews_en.author: Max Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: On May 1st, 2026, between 6:30 PM and 8:30 PM, the service was terrible. The staff were unprepared, unhelpful, and ignored me. I asked for more soup, but no one came. I even mentioned a woman with two braids who walked past several times but still ignored me, forcing me to stop eating because the soup was completely gone. They wouldn't even say they forgot, despite walking past so many times. They didn't say anything when I asked for the bill. I told a female staff member that we were out of ice cream spoons and I wanted to get them myself because it was busy and I wanted to help reduce the workload. When I asked where they were, she was happy when I offered to get them for my table, but then they disappeared. All the staff at this restaurant are the same; if you're not ready, don't do the job. I ended up eating ice cream with the chopsticks I used for the shabu-shabu instead. It was ridiculous. The service was absolutely awful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mind mm

sample_reviews_en.text:
Having skipped it couple of times earlier this time we gave it a go and Shabushi didn’t disappoint us. Unsure what to order from the menu at Japanese restaurant, head to this place in MBK, a place filled with of restaurants and eateries.

Shabushi, for inquisitive foodie like me, offers buffet that has a train of items running beside you and you can take what you like. Additionally, you can also order from the menu and they very courteously serve at your table.

Amazing variety of Sushi, Seafood and pork meat. Vegetarian items going to your soup are also in plenty.

Pick two soups and they let you pick other items from the train or kept at buffet counters. They serve you sauces at your table. Don’t miss their wasabi, it’s bold !!

Try out this place ! It’s real value for money !!

Did I mention plenty of ice creams and awesome Chinese tea ?
sample_reviews_en.author: sharad bishnoi

sample_reviews_en.text: I feel like the staff aren't prepared, or there aren't enough people to keep up. I've been sitting here for almost 20 minutes, and the conveyor belt only has shellfish and tender meat. The food line looks sparse. Maybe it's because there aren't many customers, so they haven't restocked. That might be true, because when there are a lot of customers, the food line is full. But isn't that right? No matter how many customers come in, there should be enough food to serve them all. When I tried to order, everyone seemed busy. They couldn't keep up with clearing the plates. Before, they would clear even less than 5 plates a day. Now, each table has plates piled up like a tower; a slight nudge and they'll fall over. I hope you'll improve this. If you're going to continue operating, you need to listen to your customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jitlada Maneemaroeng

sample_reviews_en.text:
The quality of the ingredients is better than before. The Australian beef is tender and the quality is comparable to competitors.

The service is terrible. After walking in, the staff told me to check the prices outside the counter instead of seating me.

The fried food and sushi were never refilled. I asked several times when they would be refilled, and the staff said there weren't many customers and they were out of stock.

When they finally refilled, people in the restaurant could only take a little before it ran out again. Even though there were fewer than 20 people in the restaurant, it was unbelievable that they could let the food run out like that.

Even with the 50% discount, I still felt like I wasted my money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittipob Vadcharasakulkol

sample_reviews_en.text: I like hot pot so this is a pretty good place to go. For 399 baht you get many choices. The food comes around on a conveyor belt and you get to chose meats, veggies, seafood, etc. It is not the best selections, but not bad either. They have a hot bar that has shrimp tempura and other fried foods. There is a sushi area that you get to try many different types of sushi rolls. All sodas are included in the price and well as ice cream. They have a great dipping sauce for your shabu. I usually have to get up and go find it if I need a refill. I wish they would put it in strategic areas around the restaurant. This is a chain restuarant all over Thailand so you can find it in just about any city. Usually in the malls.
sample_reviews_en.author: Freetirement Randy & Lori

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went there last week, around 8 PM. There was hardly any food left on the conveyor belt.
No staff member came to ask us or bring a menu. We had to call a staff member over, ask for a menu, and order. The staff seemed rushed; we only managed to order two items before they left. We had to call another staff member over. We ordered from three different staff members and only got a few items because some were sold out.
Then, around 9 PM, the staff started clearing up and refilling drinks, even though there were still customers sitting there.
Very disappointed with the service and the food.
They need to significantly improve their service.

I will definitely not be returning to this branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Viparat Yangnok

sample_reviews_en.text:
This all-you-can-eat shabu-shabu restaurant offers two price options. The most expensive option includes a wider variety of beef, but the first price option is sufficient for those who don't eat beef. The appetizer line includes various side dishes, sushi, and fried items like tempura, fish nuggets, grilled mackerel, as well as soup and rice. The conveyor belt also offers a good selection of ingredients. Desserts include fruit, ice cream, and drinks such as tea, fruit juice, and soft drinks.

The staff provided good and efficient service, frequently clearing used plates. The atmosphere inside the restaurant was a little dark.
sample_reviews_en.author: Moonstone Podcast

restaurants.name: Suki Masa - Siam Paragon
restaurants.address:

991 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered the set with masala beef. We each got five pieces per set.
The beef itself was good, but overall, everything in the sukiyaki was just too salty.
The beef was salty, the sauce was salty, the stir-fried glass noodles were salty, and the stir-fried vegetables were also salty.
The free dessert was also really sweet.
The price was high. We felt it wasn't worth the price considering how little we got for our taste. Maybe other menu items are better.
But this dish was unbearable. My kidneys would suffer.
The service was good and the atmosphere was nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ariyaporn Khumteepapiphat

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to Suki Masa and was very impressed 😊 The food was fresh and high-quality, the soup was delicious, the staff provided excellent and attentive service, and the restaurant was clean and comfortable. I'll definitely go back again when I have the chance 💕
sample_reviews_en.author: Toyy Story

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time trying this place, and the food tasted great. The quality of the ingredients was excellent; both the pork and beef were cut into nice, thick slices, not too thin.
The staff were also friendly, smiling, and attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongpun Nokyungthong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Sukiyaki beef was really good and the tempura serving was quite big. Overall the food quality was tasty and we will come
Back again
sample_reviews_en.author: JC Chen

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff member named Kaew is the cutest ever! She deserves an award. The food is delicious and worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angel 666

sample_reviews_en.text: This shabu-shabu restaurant is one I can visit often; the food is delicious and the service is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawika Sutthiwiwatchai

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything is delicious! I really love the cold noodle that comes with the sauce! Very chewy and tasty 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Madison Perez

restaurants.name: Khun chye Noodle house
restaurants.address:

8, 4 Phatthanakan 30, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're craving authentic Vietnamese food, head over to Khun Chai Restaurant. At first, I thought it was just a regular restaurant, but they have a fusion Vietnamese menu! I wanted a fusion of Vietnamese spring rolls and grilled pork skewers, but with minced pork instead of meatballs. The seafood dipping sauce was spicy and flavorful, with real sliced ​​garlic. It came with a Vietnamese-style vermicelli salad with minced pork. It was so delicious! You can even mix it with the minced pork spring rolls. My boyfriend had the crispy pork belly with chili and salt, and their crispy pork belly was amazing! But we forgot to order the Nagoya-style fried chicken today, so we'll have to come back another time.
Parking is a bit of a gamble, but eating at the restaurant is definitely more enjoyable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natviiz_PBVRAR

sample_reviews_en.text: I waited a very long time. I ordered "braised chicken" noodles. The braised chicken was hot on the outside, but the inside was red and frozen. I informed the restaurant, and they took it to fix, but it took longer than microwaving it at home. It took so long that I waited until I finished paying. It seems they said it took longer because they were braising it fresh. Really? Braised it then. I took a bite of the noodles, and they weren't hot anymore. I left immediately. I'm glad to have left the restaurant. I felt sorry for myself if I had to eat it. Is it normal for a food business to treat customers like this? I didn't hear an apology from anyone in the restaurant. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: 2 Nutt

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious! I loved everything I ordered.
There are so many more dishes I want to try, I'll definitely be back.
The instant noodles were perfectly cooked, the broth was rich and flavorful, and the crispy pork was great.
The Bigomoi was amazing! The sticky rice was soft and the coconut milk was rich.
The portion sizes weren't huge,
but the quality was worth the price.
The restaurant is air-conditioned and has parking right in front, which is very convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aui Petitz

sample_reviews_en.text:
Khun Chai is my go-to restaurant for delivery because it's near my condo, delivery is fast, and the food is always hot.

My favorite dish is the Tom Yum Noodles. The flavor is spicy, well-balanced, and complete – I barely need to add any extra seasoning. The ingredients are served in a good portion, enough to fill me up, and the price is affordable.

If you're in the Phatthanakan area or looking for a delicious delivery restaurant, I highly recommend this one! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: Sadayut Cheedlumduan

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is delicious! I loved every dish I ordered: fried rice with mackerel and acacia leaves, wide rice noodles with roasted pork, spicy instant noodle salad with crispy pork, and the large wontons with their amazing broth. The service was good. It gets very crowded around lunchtime, and there's usually no seating. We always stop by here whenever we get our car checked at the Honda service center.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noonok Prapaporn

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here. The food was pretty good. It wasn't crowded the day I went, so the food came quickly. The prices were reasonable and the portions were generous. I ordered spicy pork rib curry, stir-fried tofu with chili and salt, and stir-fried morning glory with shrimp paste and minced pork.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kipzy Thongza

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant in Soi Pattanakarn 30 offers a wide selection of delicious food at reasonable prices. The food arrives quickly and the service is excellent. There's parking available in front, but it's not very large.

#TravellingAsACouple
sample_reviews_en.author: Bell Belle

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is reasonably priced but tastes good. My favorites are the stir-fried wide rice noodles with egg and pork ribs, and the baked clams with butter and garlic. Other à la carte dishes are also tasty. The menu is quite diverse.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanasit K.

restaurants.name: Nikusho Thaniya
restaurants.address:

No:, 14/6 Surawong Rd, Si Phraya, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The meat was delicious. I ordered the Omi Wagyu set with salt-marinated beef. I didn't even get to try the Australian beef. Plus, there's a promotion going on right now, so it's even more worthwhile. (This price isn't finalized yet, which I was a little annoyed about because they said it was finalized when I inquired before going to the restaurant.)
Free parking is available at the Charn Issara building; you can get your parking ticket stamped at the restaurant.

The staff provided excellent service. They were very friendly and attentive, constantly checking on us when items ran out and changing the grill without complaining.

Don't order too much at once, as the meat gets very rich and fatty. It's a shame the dipping salt isn't the same as in Japan, where it's slightly sweeter. They also have seafood dipping sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fon Kawaii

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here for Japanese BBQ because of the high ratings, but I was very disappointed.

Japanese BBQ really tests the freshness of the meat.

But the meat at this restaurant felt extremely stale.

It had a very strong fishy smell and the meat was loose and crumbly. The boxes used to serve the meat were also very dirty. The price doesn't justify the restaurant's price.

It looked like all the meat and vegetables were pre-cut and frozen, as they were covered in frost. I can't understand why they only offer ordering service and don't offer any grilling service, yet they charge a 10% service fee. In China, you can get a really good and fresh Japanese BBQ meal for around 200 RMB in a prime location. The intestines were also very fishy. My experience was extremely unpleasant. 🙅
sample_reviews_en.author: xueer zheng

sample_reviews_en.text: Visited January 2024: Had Japanese Wagyu Beef at this place for my birthday dinner in Thailand. The Wagyu was imported straight from Japan to Thailand, & it was exceptionally delicious. Service was great as well, & you can even request the waitresses to cook the meat for you. High quality Japanese food after taking a break from Thai food. Definitely also walk around Soi Thaniya right in front of the restaurant...Basically it's Bangkok's Little Japan neighborhood, with Japanese signboards & expats making it feel as if one was in Tokyo. 🇯🇵 🇹🇭
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert Hasan

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice small Japanese bbq restaurant with a Korean twist.  Many set lunch to choose from with different cuts of meat and price points.  The wagyu beef was excellent.  Juicy and tender as expected.  Other cuts of beef were so so.  The pork set was good.  With the cheek meat and belly being very tasty.  Although there were Korean lettuce and bean sauce to wrap the meat, they don't refill them, which is very strange to me.  They used real quality charcoals that impart a nice smell to the grilling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jim Tseng

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was totally worth it! We got the purple set, which included 300 grams of A5 beef per person – that was more than enough! The tenderness was incredible, it just melted in your mouth.
The seafood was also delicious, and the seafood dipping sauce was amazing. We were so full! The ice cream was delicious, and the staff provided great service. It's a shame it was the last day of the buffet though. ><
sample_reviews_en.author: SIBBIL HONG

sample_reviews_en.text:
Here after a year, this Japanese restaurant is still one of my favorite! Great yakiniku. Meats are fresh and high quality. Side dishes are delicious. The soup is a bit salty. There is a great selection of Japanese wagyu if you are a fan.  Nothing else to complain; however, they cancelled my favorite lunch menu. There are no parking spaces, but can park in Thaniya area.
#Japanese #Restaurant
sample_reviews_en.author: Maison Ray

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located on Surawong Road, opposite Thaniya Soi. There is no parking available. The restaurant has multiple floors, is well-decorated, and has a nice atmosphere. There's a wide variety of menu options, the staff provides good service, and the food doesn't take long to arrive. The meat is quite good and delicious, and the price is reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Athit Upakan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Niku sho offers all-you-can-eat yakiniku with imported Japanese beef. The beef is high-quality but too oily. oysters and prawn taste nice.

However, both my wife and I had diarrhea after the meal. At 2,000 baht per person, it's quite expensive. The idea of unlimited Japanese beef is good, but the health issues and high cost make it hard to recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: siraprapha laongthong

restaurants.name: GUGU Chicken สาขา Seacon Bangkae
restaurants.address:

ตั้งอยู่ ซีคอนบางแค เลขที่ B06 ชั้น B เลขที่ 607 Phet Kasem Rd, Bang Wa, Phasi Charoen, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Korean-style fried chicken restaurant was having a promotion. They recommended buying 10 pieces of chicken and getting 10 extra.

They had several flavors to choose from. I ordered the creamy onion sauce chicken (249 THB) and the black pepper truffle sauce chicken (259 THB). The price was based on the more expensive option, giving me 20 pieces for 259 THB.

The chicken tasted okay. Personally, I didn't really like the black pepper chicken; the sauce didn't really go well with it. But the promotion was very worthwhile. It was delicious and filling for two people; we could have taken some home if we couldn't finish it all.

Also, expect a long wait. They have both online and in-store orders. I waited about 20 minutes. It took quite a while for the food to arrive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cherry Ja

sample_reviews_en.text:
Korean-style fried chicken
There are many flavors to choose from.
Crispy on the outside, tender on the inside.
Delicious. Many other options.
You can choose to eat until you're full.
There's a promotion every 9th, 19th, and 29th.
Buy 1 get 1 free. Good price.
Another delicious fried chicken shop.
You can choose to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanaseth DEJ

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the staff are lovely. I eat here almost every day. Sometimes there's a wait for food, but the staff are very dedicated. I'm impressed. They have a lot of promotions, and the offers are almost always different each time I visit. Also, the Rosé Tteokbokki is my absolute favorite! 🤟🏻🤍🤟🏻🤍🤟🏻🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: 25th

sample_reviews_en.text: It wasn't very crowded. The restaurant has a bright, cheerful color scheme. The chicken was delicious. The food took a while to arrive, but that's understandable since it's freshly fried. Overall, it's a good, typical Korean fried chicken restaurant – comfort food at a normal price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supraween Ekjit (PGe17)

sample_reviews_en.text: They don’t have water, they don’t haves chickens, they don’t have French fries, they don’t have lemon tea. Food flavor is not good. I had to go to McDonalds to get French fries and I asked for ketchup and guess what? They don’t have ketchup either. Why is the restaurant open?
sample_reviews_en.author: Christopher Warren Jr

sample_reviews_en.text: Korean fried chicken wings with Yangnyeom sauce. The sauce is slightly sour, a little sweet, and mildly spicy – ​​delicious! The batter is crispy but a bit thick. I happened to eat here on a day when they had a buy 10 get 10 free promotion.
sample_reviews_en.author: Surat Lertpanomwan

sample_reviews_en.text: Why are walk-in customers getting their orders before delivery riders? Delivery riders waited almost 30 minutes, while walk-in customers got their orders quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: อรรถพล พงษ์ประเสริฐ

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch feels slower than others, even though it's crowded and the wait is excessively long. It's confusing; other branches don't seem to be like this.
sample_reviews_en.author: เกศแก้ว วงษ์เคี่ยม

restaurants.name: Teaw Roo Noodles
restaurants.address:

PHW8+V22 มหาวิทยาลัยศรีนครินทรวิโรฒ สุขุมวิท กรุงเทพมหานคร Bangkok, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: As a noodle lover, I tend to give high ratings to my favorite restaurants. Today, I was the first customer, which was great! The weather wasn't hot, and there weren't many people. I was the first in line at 8:00 AM. Usually, at lunchtime, it's packed with students, staff, and professors. You can write your order on a slip of paper at your table and then give it to the person taking orders at the kitchen. Once seated, you can get ice (self-service). They also have crispy pork rinds available, which you can grab and eat. You pay later. The prices are clearly displayed on a sign. The taste was great; I didn't even need to add any extra seasoning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Totoey Umaporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
#NoodleHole at SWU Prasarnmit
I go to SWU often, but only recently discovered this hidden gem and its delicious noodles.
It's located behind the Faculty of Physical Education, or what's now the SWU gymnasium.
The shop is incredibly clean, and the pork noodle soup with thick broth is amazing! The liver and intestines are juicy, the pork is tender, the meatballs are bouncy, and the flat noodles are perfect. I've eaten there three days in a row – a hat-trick! :) 23.08.67
sample_reviews_en.author: Nonglucky Lorde

sample_reviews_en.text:
This noodle shop is located in the university. If you order the regular version, it will be spicy, even though the menu doesn't specify. If you don't like spicy food, you need to order it non-spicy.

The price is moderate; not cheap, but not excessively expensive.
The broth is very tasty, but the blood jelly isn't very rich.
The shop is quite hot and dark.
I would go back again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natchaya kraikrutee

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️Delicious and reasonably priced.
⭐️First-time visitors might get lost a little.
⭐️They say SWU students have to eat here 👍🏻
⭐️The owner provides excellent service, engaging in conversation 💗
⭐️Free self-service ice and water, available in small and large cubes. Plenty of seating.
⭐️Normally there's a queue, but there was none the day we went, so we got our food right away.
sample_reviews_en.author: ครีม ไม่กินเผ็ด

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the pork noodle soup. The noodles were flat noodles, or "peppah" noodles, which are quite hard to find these days. It was delicious! I especially liked the intestines and liver; they were perfectly cooked. I went around 8 am when the shop had just opened, so there weren't many people. The shop was very clean, and the owner was lovely and kind. 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: panrasmee

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small restaurant tucked away in a side street near Srinakharinwirot University.

Pork noodle soup...a ​​simple dish, but delicious.

Inexpensive...free self-service drinking water.

There might be a queue around lunchtime, so come early.

Coffee, milk tea, and desserts are also available.

(Year 2025...visit again in 4 years)

???
sample_reviews_en.author: Ng 999

sample_reviews_en.text: I saw EarthMix reviews on EMS so I decided to try it. It's a few hundred meters from GMM, a bit hard to find, but just follow the map. The noodles were delicious; those who like spicy food will love it, though it was so spicy my nose was running. The orange juice was great too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nguyễn Bích Hằng

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is a true hidden gem in town. Their boat noodles are super yummy and offer amazing value for the price. A vital heads-up for fellow foodies: they are closed on weekends, so plan your visit for a weekday. Absolutely love it!

P.S: tho its very local but its clean :)
sample_reviews_en.author: S. L

restaurants.name: ร้านนัวนอกไห
restaurants.address:

Sirindhorn Alley, Bang Bumru, Bang Phlat, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the opportunity to try "Nua Nok Hai" and I must say I was very impressed. The food is authentically Northeastern Thai in flavor, with bold and authentic tastes. Especially the papaya salad and various spicy salads, which are both spicy and flavorful, living up to the restaurant's name. The cooked fermented fish sauce is fragrant and well-balanced, without any fishy smell, making it easy to eat even for those who don't usually eat fermented fish sauce – you might even fall in love with it!

Recommended dishes include the spicy vermicelli salad with generous toppings and the flavorful papaya salad with plenty of ingredients. They also have hot pot, perfect for a family or group of friends.

The restaurant has several branches, and the Sirindhorn branch has a comfortable air-conditioned dining area. If you're looking for authentic Northeastern Thai food with bold flavors, quality ingredients, and great value, I highly recommend trying "Nua Nok Hai."
sample_reviews_en.author: sopida

sample_reviews_en.text:
I saw it on my Facebook feed, so I called my kids and husband to try it because it's not far from home.

First thing I liked was how clean the restaurant was! The tables, hallways, and restrooms were spotless.

Usually, when I go to Isaan restaurants, there's a smell that I really dislike.

We ordered 7-8 dishes, and they were all delicious.
The Thai papaya salad was good.
The noodle salad with pork sausage was decent; the noodles were chewy and the pork sausage was tasty.
The fried pork sausage and chicken were served hot and were delicious.
We ordered the salmon larb again.
Drinks, sticky rice, and ice were reasonably priced.

It's not far from home, so we can come back anytime we crave spicy food.

Highly recommend! Delicious, clean, and very affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ally Nilpayack

sample_reviews_en.text:
About a year ago, I came across this brightly-stand-out restaurant among the area.  As a new employee, I searched for places where I could rely my stomach on for regular meals.

And I found this place, located just around the corner.  That was when my journey began... journey back and forth this place!!

My most favorite dishes have always been Papaya Salad with Fermanted Crabs, Spicy Minced Pork Salad, Sun-dried Beef.. and of course, the friendliest green bottle!

The owners are kind and friendly.  That goes to the staff as well.

Lunch time may not seem to be that busy, but when the afternoon arrives, you'll be stunned by the crowd!

So, don't waste your time reading this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Great Scot

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don't want to spoil it, I'm afraid the tables will be full 😁😁😁. It was exactly my taste. The Luang Prabang papaya salad was incredibly flavorful. The grilled pork neck was perfectly grilled, with just the right amount of fat, making it so enjoyable to eat. The spicy pork rib soup was so delicious, I didn't even have time to chew before the ribs were bouncy and tasty. Another dish was the fried pork sausage; it wasn't oily, chewy and surprisingly delicious. Then there was the pork stew, so refreshing and fragrant. I can honestly say this restaurant is a must-try.
Almost forgot two more things: the plating was beautiful and the prices were good. That's all 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: prapan worakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious. The shrimp and squid are very fresh and good.
The clams are large.
The dishes with fermented fish sauce are incredibly flavorful.
I liked the seafood noodle salad (150 baht), it was a generous portion and great value.
The fried chicken was delicious.
The grilled pork neck was a bit fatty.
The grilled beef tasted good but was a bit tough.
The sun-dried beef was better.
The Thai papaya salad was delicious.
I went on a weekday, it wasn't crowded.
I went on a Saturday, it was very crowded and I had to wait a while.
sample_reviews_en.author: เอื้อยชวนกินชวนเที่ยว

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant's fermented fish sauce is amazing! So delicious! I'm so jealous of people on the Thonburi side of Bangkok 🥹 The price is great, the portions are generous, the ingredients are high quality, and the flavor is incredibly intense. It's officially on my list of favorite somtum (papaya salad) restaurants, and I'll definitely be back!

🌶️**The food is very spicy! If you can't handle spice, let the staff know. But it's so delicious! I was crying while eating it, lol. It's so spicy I almost died, but it's worth it!😆**
sample_reviews_en.author: Amzmie

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a very delicious Isaan restaurant. Their som tam is spicy, their grilled pork neck is delicious, and their fried chicken is also delicious. The prices are reasonable, and the service is excellent. The owner is very friendly.

The restaurant opens in the evenings and has air conditioning. It's easy to find, just a few hundred meters past Tang Hua Seng in Thonburi. Parking is available on the street.

If you're in the area and want some som tam or grilled pork neck, I highly recommend it. It's truly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ning Play & Learn เพลินเรียนรู้

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a restaurant we stumbled upon while driving and stopped at by chance, but the food was surprisingly delicious! The pork hot pot broth was amazing, the grilled pork neck salad was flavorful, and the shrimp patties were crispy and tasty. Overall, for three people, the bill was a little over 400 baht. We were very impressed and will definitely come back if we're in the area again.

I only managed to take these few photos because we were too busy enjoying the food before it all arrived! 555555
sample_reviews_en.author: BNP TONG

restaurants.name: Saiya
restaurants.address:

141 Sing Waet Lom Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Japanese restaurant is tucked away down a side street off Thonglor. They serve set meals in the evening and have a counter seating, making it convenient for single travelers.
I ordered the Today's Mother's Set Meal for 280B, which seems to change daily. It seems they were serving chicken cutlet that day.
As you can see in the photo, it was very filling. The miso soup (pork miso soup) was delicious, with a great balance of broth and miso. I would have liked to order it as a standalone dish.
The chicken cutlet itself was also incredibly tasty. It was crispy fried with a fine batter and went perfectly with the accompanying katsu sauce.
There were five large portions, which was very filling.
There were many other options on the menu, but the set meal was enough to fill me up, so I stopped there.
I'd definitely return and try something else.

Most of the table seating was occupied by groups of regulars. It's best to check availability beforehand.
sample_reviews_en.author: TAKAN

sample_reviews_en.text: I’m not sure any reviewer has ever been to Japan ! Cos this place is a mess..  literally stuff lying everywhere and stuff on every surface. More staff sitting around than customers, peek thru the curtain into the kitchen, stuff everywhere.  Food hygiene is impossible.  Imagine your Grandma has a hoarding addiction, this is her Dining room. No Sashimi last night (so they can’t run the place properly either) and 1 Izakaya stick … hang on does it say Izakaya restaurant??  So managed to order other dishes and all were 4/10 max !! I would say larger than average portions but of below average quality. And .. 1900bht for 2. Expensive.  Never going back. Bad tummy today. And the menu is a Giant mess of odd pages, some photos, some English, some Thai & Japanese, explained by a waitress that embarrassingly giggles when nothing was available. Gordon Ramsey could not save this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: David G

sample_reviews_en.text:
I enjoyed chatting with the middle-aged owner. I heard that there are many regular customers who are hardcore expatriates (?), and that the regular golf tournament attracts more than 50 people. This shows how close the relationship is between the customers and the restaurant.

The restaurant's selling point is the reasonably priced, home-cooked meals made by the owner, with a home-style flavor. The food is simple and tastes like something you'd eat at home, which is so comforting.

They also have a wide selection of alcohol, including sake. I think this restaurant fulfills the image of a happy Japanese expatriate: just the right amount of your favorite drink, eat home-cooked food, communicate in Japanese, and then go home and watch TV while you sleep.

I recommend the bluefin tuna, which arrives on the weekend.

I felt so happy, I'll do my best again tomorrow.
sample_reviews_en.author: K M

sample_reviews_en.text: "This was my first time visiting Saiya Japanese Restaurant & Bar and I have to say it's a hidden gem! From the outside, it looks more like a cozy home than a restaurant, which gives it a warm, homely atmosphere. A friend told me it was the best local Japanese spot in town so I'm so glad I came! The food may look simple at first glance but the flavors were truly traditional Japanese, delicious and heartwarming. The prices are also very reasonable, great value for the quality. Honestly, it reminded me of the traditional food and atmosphere I had in Shirakawa-go. I felt so at home and could have stayed there for hours! The owner and staff were also very kind and provided excellent service. It's a great place to enjoy delicious food in a relaxed and comfortable environment. I highly recommend it!"
sample_reviews_en.author: Suparak Toomkosita

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Japanese izakaya located a little way from Thonglor.
I think the cooking is done by a Japanese woman who appears to be a mother.
The menu is extensive and reasonably priced.
I ordered too much since it was my first time, but the portions were quite generous.
The yam with salted squid was delicious.
The rice noodles were huge!
It was a bit cheaper because it was during Songkran, but I had two beers.
Revisited. Had the mapo eggplant set meal.
220 baht. I think it's reasonable.
It's a good place to eat alone.

Yam with salted squid.
Rice noodles.
Fried chicken cartilage.
Stir-fried kung sin cai.
950 THB.
The fried chicken cartilage was huge; maybe that was unnecessary.
Want to come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paisley

sample_reviews_en.text:
I used to frequent this restaurant while I was staying in Bangkok.

I visited again since returning to Japan at the end of last year.

The new staff members were friendly and always smiling, and the restaurant had become even more wonderful.

The owner's mother was as healthy as ever and remembered me, which made me very happy to see her again.

I think you can enjoy Japanese cuisine here better than at any other restaurant in Bangkok.

The prices are reasonable, and the service, atmosphere, and taste are all top-notch.

I said I would visit again before returning to Japan, but unfortunately, I had to return home unexpectedly.

I will definitely visit again when I come back to Thailand!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rico

sample_reviews_en.text: Fantastic local Japanese place that makes you feel transported to a Japanese side street and not in Bangkok. Clientele is almost exclusively Japanese and most menus are in Japanese and Thai, but many items also have English. Sashimi is super fresh, comfort foods are excellent. In two visits every dish has been amazing. Do yourself a favor and order a dish or two off their “Osusume” (recommended) menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Cypert

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited in mid-August, and the proprietress's health had recovered, and the sashimi was back on the menu. It was very fresh and delicious!

Today's "Ofukuro Teishoku" (mother's set meal) was also delicious and a great value, and I really like it.

I especially recommend making a reservation if you're going with children.
sample_reviews_en.author: tk tk

restaurants.name: UD Restaurant うまロイ食堂
restaurants.address:

25, 5 Central Pattaya Rd, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is run by UD-kun, a familiar face from YouTube's U-D Island.

It's an open restaurant facing the street, with both counter and table seating.

The restaurant mainly serves Thai food, and everything is delicious.

They have a wide variety of menu items, from hearty rice dishes to snacks to go with alcohol, so you'll be sure to fill up.

Thanks to UD-kun's personality, it's a fun restaurant that attracts many locals and tourists every day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tasuku Captain

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there in September 2025. In addition to Thai food, you can enjoy Japanese favorites such as marinated squid and wasabi soy sauce. UD was also there and we toasted together. I had a really good time. I will go again when I come to Pattaya. If you search for "Namiyoshi Channel UD Restaurant Uma Roy Shokudo" on YouTube, you can see videos of the restaurant's atmosphere and food. Check out YouTube 😆
sample_reviews_en.author: 山下敏広

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited last Tuesday night. UD was not there at first, but one of their staff contacted me and I was so grateful that they came to the restaurant despite their sore back. The food was delicious, the service was great, and I had a really enjoyable time. I will definitely stop by again the next time I go to Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: shingo S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the place to go for a Pattaya getaway! UD and his fun friends will welcome you and teach you all sorts of things, from Thailand's sights to politics. They're also very kind to drinkers and families with kids...the staff were incredibly helpful!

Looking forward to another Pattaya getaway this time around! 😍
sample_reviews_en.author: mami sewaki

sample_reviews_en.text: This bar is popular with Japanese people. The atmosphere is great. They also serve yakiniku on the second floor and have a karaoke system. The owner is especially friendly and fun. The restaurant's name is a combination of umai (Japanese for "delicious") and aloe (Thai for "tasty").
sample_reviews_en.author: 브이콘

sample_reviews_en.text: In Pattaya, halfway through my week-long stay in Bangkok, I headed to Uma Roi, a restaurant specializing in Isaan cuisine (Chim Chum)! The Isaan food I was looking forward to was delicious. The friendly staff made for a very pleasant and uplifting experience! Highly recommended! 😉
sample_reviews_en.author: shala yoga

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped by for dinner. As expected, there's no air conditioning, so it's hot. I ordered marinated squid grilled over charcoal, but the charcoal fire never got going, so it never cooked. The grilled pork khoa yang was just average. Almost all the customers were Japanese.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponte Pusta

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped in for dinner just before heading home. The owner is very friendly and the atmosphere is comfortable. There are many Japanese customers, but it seems like both regulars and first-timers can enjoy themselves. Next time, I'd like to have a drink and relax.
sample_reviews_en.author: Monkey Road

restaurants.name: Brunch of Idiot
restaurants.address:

350 Maitri Chit Rd, Pom Prap, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve finally found my new favorite brunch spot! The vibe at Brunch of Idiot is incredibly relaxed and welcoming—it's the kind of place where you can actually sit back and lose track of time. What really sets the environment apart is the artwork; the walls are covered in inspiring and fun pieces that give the space so much personality and spark great conversation.
​As for the food, it was truly outstanding. I ordered the BLT, and it was perfect—the ingredients were fresh, and the flavors were balanced. But the real star of the show was the Orange Americano. I’d never tried that combination before, but it was surprisingly refreshing and has officially become my new favorite coffee order.
​To top it all off, the staff are super sweet and genuinely attentive, making the whole experience feel personal. If you’re looking for high-quality food and a creative, chill atmosphere, I highly recommend stopping by. I’ll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rephvew De'eze

sample_reviews_en.text: The vegan breakfast I had here left me speechless - I’ve been vegan for 10 years and I rarely come across a new way of making vegan scrambled eggs that is also truly flavorful and has any resemblance to actual eggs. These scrambled vegan eggs are mind blowing - made with tofu skins and cashews, the texture is very unique, the flavor also on point (very eggy, unlike many egg alternatives). And to make things even better, the tofu scramble is served with very tasty, crunchy bread, caramelized onions, juicy kale, roast tomatoes and incredible pulled “pork” made of mushrooms. I was stunned by the texture (much more firm than that of pulled pork made from jackfruit, so good) and the deep flavor profile. Everyone should try this and congratulations to the chef, this is truly groundbreaking cooking! ❤️ (gonna try to recreate this at home and will fail for sure lol!)
sample_reviews_en.author: Daphne

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem! The menu here was way beyond expectations.

The owner kindly offered us a homemade shortbread to try — and it was absolutely lovely! Buttery, not too crumbly, with just the right touch of sweetness. Truly well made.

I also loved the Thai-style sauce — such a unique flavor that stands out from the usual.

Their scrambled eggs were perfectly cooked, soft and silky, and they gave such a generous portion of eggs.

Highly recommend this place if you're looking for something delicious, thoughtful, and made with care.

Bonus: I requested a turmeric soy latte even though it wasn’t on the menu, and they made it for me! It was fragrant, comforting, and so delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Little Sandria

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing brunch place close to Chinatown. I really loved this place. The food was great, the design was really thought out. Each piece fit amazing in the industrial/ mid century aesthetic they proposed. They had some great pieces of art.

Now the food was absolutely delicious. We tried a bunch of things on the menu and nothing disappointed. It’s also great if you have indigestion and you want some bland food because you can make your own bowl or have one of the probiotic bowls.

The smoothies and juices are also delicious. Everything well above expectations. If I lived in the area I would definitely come often here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Catalina Popescu

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely beautiful vegan brunch at this cool place 5 minutes from Song Wat. I will be fantasising about the vegan mushroom rice bowl - it was so dam good - sweet; spicy - delicious. Great coffee also. Lower stars in some areas as it was Sunday morning and they were a bit overwhelmed. Would highly recommend and will be dreaming of that rice bowl until next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: LouLou O

sample_reviews_en.text: Brunch of Idiots" is actually a genius spot if you want a great, quiet atmosphere and amazing food. The PBBBP sandwich and Pulled Chicken Melt are absolute must-tries and are filled with flavor and incredibly filling. Pair them with the Iced Peanut Butter Coffee to wash it all down. Highly recommend checking this place out!
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Gilliland
