sample_reviews_en.text: If you’re happy to pay premium prices for unfinished walls, self-service, and menu items being unavailable, this place might be for you. Bangkok has far better breakfast spots with better food, better service, and better value. Not terrible, but I'd avoid.
sample_reviews_en.author: B Schwarz

sample_reviews_en.text: A cozy spot tucked away in Chinatown, just a few minutes from the Wat Mangkon Blue Line station. The menu offers plenty of variety, including vegan options, and the dishes are full of flavor. Service, however, could be more attentive—the …
sample_reviews_en.author: young young

restaurants.name: Hula Poke & Salad Bar
restaurants.address:

99 Soi Saen Sabai, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very good place! I walked-in randomly, because I was waiting for my car to be washed nearby. From outside the shop looks simple and clean. It has recently opened -as the owner, very welcoming and friendly, explained to me.
I could enjoy a fresh salad, a delicious guava juice and a kefir, and work peacefully on my computer for one hour with a good WiFi. No annoying music, which is a real plus for me! Super kind staff.
Unlike many “healthy“ food shops, this one is not pretentious or “Instagram-oriented” at all, but it offers a customisable choice of super fresh and healthy food.
The shop also deals with FoodPanda or Grab, which is very convenient for office work. As it’s rather simple food (all it needs is to be fresh, which it is), it’s also quick -and therefore a much healthier option than a pizza!

After eating a salad I just ordered a few more to take home…

Simple and just good! Very good value for the money, and one can fee it is a place with a heart.

I strongly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maître Jean Chouart

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hula Poke & Salad Bar in Khlong Toei delivers a seriously satisfying bowl. I went for the Seared Tuna Bowl, with a half-salad, half-rice base and spicy mayo on the side—such a great combo.

The bowl was packed with fresh mango, avocado, cucumber, edamame, and crispy fried shallots. The tuna was perfectly seared, super tasty, with a nice peppery kick that tied everything together. Honestly, you can’t ask for more.

Great portion for the price, clean space, and friendly, fast service. Definitely recommended.

Small tip: grab one of the few seats to eat in and enjoy 20% off—totally worth it. Even better, Dylan’s Craft Sandwich is just around the corner, making it a perfect combo stop if you’re extra hungry or sharing with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Farangondiet

sample_reviews_en.text: I found this poke spot as I was craving some fresh food. The service was great and the staff answered all my questions and gave recommendations on the menu. I ended up ordering the seared tuna and it was delicious. The chunks of mango were ripe and really added to the dish. I also picked up a fresh Guava juice which they told me they make the juice themselves. All in all really good spot. I dined in, but looks like they are mainly a takeout place as I saw signs for Grab etc. The place was clean and designed well for a small shop. 5 stars, good food and friendly people.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Manns

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is not the first choice for a romantic dinner. It is mostly take away. However, there are a few tables and when you eat in it’s like 20 percent discount. And while it might not be the coziest place it’s still nice because the girls who work here are super friendly and the bowls and salads are very tasty. Prices are ok as well. I guess the ordering prices are slightly on the expensive end. But when you eat here it’s totally ok.

I had the Greek salad while my girlfriend had a bowl with tuna. Both were excellent!
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text: Poke is a Hawaiian seafood rice bowl. There are so many options on the menu that it's hard to choose, but this time I went with the classic salmon for 295 THB. Salmon mixed with vegetables like avocado, edamame, and cucumber, and served with rice in a miso mayonnaise sauce was very satisfying. The service is also fast, so I'll be coming here often from now on. By the way, they offer a 20% discount for dine-in customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: 2pong

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried this classic dish from the restaurant. It came with a generous amount of ingredients. The salmon was diced into bite-sized pieces, firm, fresh, and had no fishy smell. The avocado, cucumber, edamame, and fish roe added a crunchy, creamy, slightly salty texture. I liked the mango, which prevented the flavor from being too cloying. Overall, it was easy to eat, satisfying, and perfect for a light, healthy meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: worakamon Sriworawoottichai

sample_reviews_en.text: I was looking for a quick bite in the Thonglor area and visited this place after checking Google reviews. It seemed newly opened, as the interior was clean and the space was pleasant. The food itself was fresh, the portions were generous, and the sauces paired perfectly with it. Grab orders kept coming in non-stop while I was eating, giving it the feel of a local hidden gem, so I highly recommend it!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Hannah Kim

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant doesn't have parking and there aren't many seats, but it's comfortable enough to eat there. It seems to focus more on takeout, as I saw a Grab delivery driver picking up food. I ordered a salmon salad and chose Shoyu Wasabi dressing. It came with both soy sauce and wasabi in separate packets. The salmon was pan-seared.
sample_reviews_en.author: N N (Pom)

restaurants.name: มักข้าวซอย
restaurants.address:

8 Prawit Lae Phuan 11 Alley, Bang Chak, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I wanted to eat Khao Soi topped with a generous amount of fried shrimp, so I went to มักข้าวซอย. I ordered the fried shrimp Khao Soi. The fried shrimp and Khao Soi are so similar in color that it's almost funny. The taste is just like fried shrimp and Khao Soi. For people from Aichi Prefecture, Khao Soi is a soothing dish!
sample_reviews_th.author: PAPA - san

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the best Khao Soi and Nam Ngiao I've ever had.
Good price, generous portions, comfortable and clean seating. Everything I ordered was incredibly delicious.

Parking might be a bit of a challenge in the alley, but it's totally worth it.

The Khao Soi with fried shrimp had big, plump shrimp and a crispy batter. The Nam Ngiao broth was amazing – not too sweet, I loved it.

The braised beef melted in my mouth. It was fragrant and delicious; I could die from eating it.

The Nam Ngiao broth was incredibly fragrant and refreshing.

The Larb Kua was unbelievably delicious, the spices were so strong they made my nose tingle.

Finally, the cream cheese and crab stick dumplings were fragrant, tasty, and I could eat them forever.

I'd give it 10 out of 10 if I could.
sample_reviews_en.author: namotatsara

sample_reviews_en.text:
Should be the best Khanom Jeen by far in the Bangna Srinagarinda area.  Service is basically one man show and food is made order by order.

For menat least was worth the wait. This is homecooking level, Grandmas taste , taste extracted through cooking and boiling step by step rather than bombing with ready made ingredients. The broths , you can taste the spices used cleanly.

The noodles are a MUST TRY.

The absent star was because of the cream cheese wantons. Decent on its own, but for me , does not go well with the mains.

I did not get to try the Sai Uerk, I believe its sold out for a reason.

I will come back for sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Asmira Global Advisory

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a Northern Thai restaurant with incredibly cute decor, giving off a Japanese cafe vibe that's very comfortable. The tableware is beautiful, making the food look appetizing the moment you see it. The service is excellent, creating a warm, comfortable, and attentive feeling. As for the food, it's delicious to excellent. The curry paste is fragrant, and the Khao Soi (Northern Thai curry noodle soup) feels like being transported to Chiang Mai. Highly recommended! I went without high expectations but it exceeded my expectations. The prices are also very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arisara Roff

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a small Northern Thai restaurant specializing in Khao Soi. I ordered the beef Khao Soi, and the beef was incredibly tender, not chewy at all, and the portion was very large. The broth was rich and moderately spicy.

The restaurant also offers other Northern Thai dishes such as Larb Kua Muang, Nam Prik Num (green chili dip), Nam Prik Ong (red chili dip), and Khanom Jeen Nam Ngiao (rice noodles with spicy pork broth).

Service might be a little slow because the owner does all the cooking and serving.

Parking is available in the alley next to the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karin Parmthai

sample_reviews_en.text:
A lovely little restaurant with authentic Northern Thai flavors. The Khao Soi was fragrant, rich, and perfectly balanced, and the Nam Ngiao was also excellent.

The restaurant is cozy and charming, and the owner is very kind and welcoming. They have been running the restaurant for about four years, and the owner is originally from Chiang Mai. Many of the ingredients and products are brought directly from Chiang Mai, which really adds to the authentic taste and atmosphere.

A wonderful place to enjoy comforting Northern Thai food. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Prawut PATHOMYOK

sample_reviews_en.text: This Northern Thai restaurant is my go-to place. As soon as you open the door, the aroma of Northern Thai spices fills the air. The food is delicious; the Northern Thai larb is exceptional, and the Khao Soi, Nam Prik, and Nam Ngiao are all fantastic. The curry pastes are incredibly flavorful and generous. Everything is made fresh, and the wait time is short. The interior is comfortable, air-conditioned, clean, and tidy. Parking is convenient right in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: JOHN LEE

sample_reviews_en.text: First time trying it, the atmosphere in the restaurant is clean and looks good. I ordered 3 dishes: Khao Soi Nuea, Hang Lay Curry, and Nam Ngiao Noodles. It exceeded my expectations. The food was very delicious. I don't usually like Nam Ngiao, but eating at this restaurant was amazing with the taste. It was so delicious that it came out of my mouth. The ingredients are good and worth the price. You get big pieces of meat. I will definitely go back again. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: noey patharanit

restaurants.name: Restaurant Patt
restaurants.address:

Charoen Rat 7 Yeak 7-6-1 Alley, Bang Khlo, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
An elegant and memorable fine dining experience at Patt Restaurant. I never expected to find such a beautiful hidden gem inside an old printing house building on Chan Road. From the outside, the building looks simple and old-fashioned, but once you step inside, the atmosphere completely transforms — it feels like dining in a charming French restaurant somewhere in France or Switzerland.

Every dish was beautifully presented and thoughtfully crafted, with excellent balance of flavors and attention to detail. The lobster dish and chocolate soufflé were standout highlights. The staff were professional, friendly, and communicated fluently in English, making the entire experience feel warm and welcoming.

Perfect for special occasions — whether for couples, family gatherings, dinners with friends, or even a fully private event.

Tip: reservations are required at least 5 hours in advance, and the restaurant does not accept walk-ins. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a sophisticated and memorable dining experience in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: PP

sample_reviews_en.text:
Patt is the latest fine dining spot by Chef Big, set in his family’s old printing factory. Right from the entrance, you get a sense of history, with printing machines from Chef Big’s parents on display—one of the first things that really caught my eye was the front desk, crafted from machine parts.

The dining area on the third floor has a high, dome-like ceiling with clever touches that bring in a printing theme. Chef Big, a Top Chef winner, served us himself, starting with three amazing appetisers and walking us through each dish. The menu blends contemporary French cuisine with local twists, showcasing fresh seafood like abalone, fish maw, crab, and clams. One of my favourite dishes was the chilli pasta with beef tartare —an unforgettable combination.

Chef Big has woven his family’s printing legacy into the dining experience, too. The dining experience ends with a memorable dessert that embodies Chef Big’s core values mentioning how his parents are his big supporters, bringing his vision to a sweet and meaningful close.
sample_reviews_en.author: Win K

sample_reviews_en.text:
Before talking about the food, let me first commend the service! If the score is out of 10, I'd give it a 12! The service was beyond words. Everything was thoughtfully designed and perfectly balanced; nothing felt too much or too little. All the staff were outstanding, attentive to customers at all times, but without making us feel uncomfortable or disturbed.

Even though the staff walked around to every table, we felt completely private at our table. What impressed me most was that if we needed any assistance, we just had to look up, and within two seconds, a staff member was there to help.

As for the food, I must say every dish was delicious! Each bite was exciting, like discovering new flavors. The chef created and executed the menu brilliantly, exceeding all expectations.

I hope to have another wonderful experience like this next time. I truly had a wonderful time at Restaurant Patt. Thank you for making my birthday this year so special!
sample_reviews_en.author: Warinda Somrith

sample_reviews_en.text:
✨ Thank You Message ✨

We had the most unforgettable dining experience at Patt Restaurant to celebrate both my birthday and our 6th wedding anniversary. It felt truly special as we were the only guests that evening, making it almost like a private celebration.

A heartfelt thank you to the chef and the entire team for crafting such an extraordinary menu — every course was not only visually stunning but also perfectly balanced in flavor, showcasing incredible creativity and refinement. From start to finish, each dish was a delightful surprise and a true masterpiece.

We are deeply grateful for the warm hospitality, thoughtful presentation, and for making this occasion so memorable. It was more than just a meal — it was a beautiful experience that we will always treasure.

Thank you once again to the chef for sharing such passion and artistry through your cuisine. We look forward to coming back soon!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lu Chen

sample_reviews_en.text:
New fine dinning in Bangkok just opened about 6 month ago.

French cuisine fusion with Thai style taste.

Own by Chef Big - Thailand top chef champion 2023

We did order “Best of Patt” courses menu
I like the most is the hors d'oeuvres - consist of 3 bite that taste compliment each other very well,

Most of the menu was great ingredients , bananas prawn, lobster tail, Japanese scallops. Look like well thought out. Tastes test.

My Lease favorite was the pigeon - it cook well buy just not match with source and tastes something…

Overall are great experiences , excellent service,
Price include tax and service charge about 4500 thb per person
sample_reviews_en.author: Krissada I

sample_reviews_en.text: Having sampled Michelin-starred restaurants across Thailand for over 10 years, I can confidently say that Patt is consistently at the top of my list. The flavors aren't just visually appealing; they're perfectly balanced and harmonious. It's clear that every dish is meticulously prepared, and each bite is a distinctly delicious experience. It's not just novelty, but genuinely delicious, thanks to the high-quality ingredients and just the right amount of spiciness. It's a culinary experience that truly shows you what a Michelin-worthy restaurant is.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaiyaporn Suratemeekul

sample_reviews_en.text: To be honest, it really exceeded my expectations. The food is excellent, with new and creative dishes. I was especially impressed by the quality of ingredients the chef used, such as fish maw, abalone, A5 beef, and large egg crabs. For the price, it’s a great value (as other fine dining restaurants rarely offer these ingredients). With the chef’s creativity, each dish has an exceptional taste. The atmosphere is also very nice, as the place is newly built, and the staff are friendly and provide great service. I highly recommend visiting this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Duangjarin Sirijongkolthong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chef Big's (Top Chef Thailand 2023 Winner!) restaurant, formerly known as "I Want to Cook But Don't Want to Eat," has been renovated. It's beautiful, luxurious, and spacious. The chef is always lovely.
The food is easy to eat, easy to understand, and delicious—they don't skimp on ingredients. The baby chicken Pithivier was amazing—not dry at all, and incredibly fragrant.
My daughter and I went and were very impressed.
❤️❤️❤️
The price is good considering the quality.
Book now before it gets too popular, because it's definitely going to be!
sample_reviews_en.author: Aornyapat P

restaurants.name: Mango sticky rice
restaurants.address:

269 Phahonyothin Rd, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop is incredibly delicious. I usually love sticky rice with mango, it's my favorite. I'm from Chachoengsao (Eight-Riw), and I always eat it every year during mango season when the mangoes are so sweet and delicious. I used to have a favorite shop in Chachoengsao. Now that I work in Bangkok, I've tried many shops before finding one that I really liked. I've even tried some famous shops in Bangkok, but I felt they weren't as good and were too expensive. I rely on this shop for my meals regularly. I highly recommend it! It's delicious and very affordable. This is a genuine review from the heart.
sample_reviews_en.author: Atthaphon Rhomchareon

sample_reviews_en.text:
The sticky rice with coconut milk was sooooo good! Soft and smooth, soaked in coconut milk, slightly sweet, and slightly salty. It was the most delicious I've ever had. A box for 40 baht comes with one small mango, sticky rice, and coconut milk. Even though the mango wasn't very sweet, it didn't matter because the sticky rice was so good. You could even eat it plain.
It was so cheap.
P.S. I couldn't resist, so I ordered another set because I don't come here often. I asked the auntie if she'd like a cold mango, and she told me to take one (as seen in the last picture).
sample_reviews_en.author: Busaba Wanchana

sample_reviews_en.text:
This original shop has been located at Saphan Khwai intersection for over 40 years, originating from Phetchaburi Province.
The sticky rice grains are beautifully made and can be kept outside until evening (do not leave the coconut milk poured over it).
I've been buying it since it was 5 baht per pack, then 7, 10, 12, and now 15 baht per pack (currently).
Highly recommended! Most recently, on May 15th, 2024, the shop had to relocate to Salirat Wiphak Road, on the way towards Sutthisan, and is now located on the roadside in front of Saphan Khwai Pharmacy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prawit Ngamsiripol

sample_reviews_en.text: I decided to visit after reading other people's reviews. It's located right next to the bus stop in front of the 7-Eleven. As the reviews said, the sticky rice was perfectly soft, and the coconut milk was just the right amount of sweet, perfectly complementing the sweet and sour taste of the mango. It was delicious. The price was also reasonable at 40 baht, so I was very satisfied. I highly recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: じょじょじょぬらりひょん

sample_reviews_en.text: This auntie sells sticky rice with coconut milk and mango sticky rice. She also sells unripe mangoes separately. She's kind and lovely, easy to talk to, and gives generous portions. You can order exactly how much you want. The mango sticky rice is 40 baht, and I couldn't finish all the sticky rice! She gives such a lot. The mango is fresh and sweet, and the coconut milk is thick and creamy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sansak Lowmankong

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good mango sticky rice. The rice especially is well cooked and not too sweet! Mangos are perfectly ripe. This is NOT a restaurant but a street vendor who is very well known in the area. There's usually a lineup just by the pedestrian overpass stairs. Get in line, pay your 40 baht, and enjoy the food! She also sells coconut custard and a few other desserts.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachel Freedman-Doan

sample_reviews_en.text: For 40 baht, you can eat incredibly delicious mango sticky rice. It's available for takeout only. The portion is generous and the flavor is perfectly balanced. They'll peel a whole fresh mango and top it on your order. They probably open around 1 or 2pm and are sold out by 5pm. If you're passing by, be sure to give it a try!!
sample_reviews_en.author: YUKIKO SEINO

sample_reviews_en.text:
This lady has the best coconut sticky rice from all those I tried in Bangkok.
The pudding is amazing, and all the mix.
I ordered twice as I couldn’t resist and also because I wanted to try the black rice.
The rice is just made perfectly!!!
I crossed the entire city to go there and I don’t regret it at all!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Oumayma Koubaa

restaurants.name: Blue Monkey Bar and Indian Restaurant
restaurants.address:

74/3 Ram Buttri Aly, Talat Yot, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited this restaurant and had a genuinely enjoyable experience. From the moment I walked in, the ambiance stood out—warm lighting, tasteful décor, and a relaxed vibe that made it perfect for both casual dining and special occasions.

The menu offered a good variety of dishes, and everything we ordered was fresh and well-prepared. The standout for me was the main course—it was flavorful, beautifully presented, and cooked to perfection. The portion sizes were satisfying without being overwhelming. The drinks were also well-balanced and complemented the meal nicely.

Service was attentive without being intrusive. The staff were friendly, knowledgeable about the menu, and quick to accommodate requests, which added to the overall comfort of the experience.

I’d definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a reliable dining spot with great food and a welcoming environment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Makeup by Shameen

sample_reviews_en.text: I want Thai people who have never tried Indian food to give it a try. The taste is amazing; the spices aren't as strong as you might think. You can choose your desired level of spiciness, and the staff will always ask. The prices are also great. The restaurant offers both Indian food and various drinks at very reasonable prices. Anyone who wants to try Indian food should come here. The service is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siraphatson Munlipum

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was deliecious, I had the non-veg thali for 299 THB, you are allowed to select chicken curry dishes, if you ask the waitress she will show you the options. The waitress and the owner of the establishment are very friendly and helpful. Good prices for the food and halaal!. I chose chicken madras, it was perfectly spiced and the flavout was so good. The ginger tea was likr karak chai
sample_reviews_en.author: Jas Chou

sample_reviews_en.text: Had a great time at Blue Monkey Bar and Indian Restaurant. I ordered the chicken kabob, pani puri, and crispy chicken — everything was flavorful and fresh. The atmosphere was chill with moderate noise, making it a perfect spot to relax and hang out. Staff members are super nice and welcoming. Ended up staying for almost 2 hours because the vibe was that good. Definitely recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Khadijah LEE

sample_reviews_en.text:
An excellent little place located in a small little shop almost missable, a delicious Indian curry was had, great portions and full of the expected flavour.

I did ask for mine to be spicy it was a little mild but I know they often cater to overly ambitious tourists , so a pass is given as flavours where on point.

I’ll be back but pushing for a few extra chilli’s
sample_reviews_en.author: Calum Hogwood

sample_reviews_en.text: Stayed at rambutri road few days and i had my lunch and dinner everyday at blue monkey bar and indian restaurant. Food taste is really good and service from staff was excellent. I would say its perfect place for everyone who are visting khawsan or rambutri road.i would recommeny my family and friends sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krishna Mehta

sample_reviews_en.text: I have tried Indian food in almost all restaurants in Bali, Dubai and Thailand. This has the most authentic and genuine tastes. The mutton rogan Josh is too good! Even the simple daal is amazing! A must try if you're in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kashan Akmal

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were incredibly polite and always had a smile on their faces. The food was simply delicious, and the cocktails were fantastic too. Thank you so much for the wonderful experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Hamid Hem

restaurants.name: SEE FAH (สีฟ้า) – Esplanade Cineplex Ratchadapisek
restaurants.address:

99 ห้อง B12, Ratchadaphisek Rd, 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We stumbled on See Fah by chance and we were pleasantly surprised by the quality of the food. We didn't know beforehand but it is apparently quite a famous chain in Thailand. We can ordered the Tom yum soup and Pad Thai. Both of which while being classic Thai dish's had some more modern touches and were certainly a step above what you might expect from these dishes. The Tom yum had a great heat and depth of flavour in particular. The black jelly in milk and Durian ice cream were also very good. Well recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff are very good. The taste is good. The price is okay, in the tens or hundreds. It's suitable for all types of groups of friends/families because the menu is so extensive. There are so many to choose from that you'll want to eat everything. Most importantly, the food is served quickly!! It's very suitable for choosing a restaurant to eat before going to see a play. There's only a little time, but it's still in time!!! I recommend having dessert too (I forgot to take a picture 😆).
sample_reviews_en.author: พี่หมีจอ (Bearjor)

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious! I've known and eaten here since I was a child, and I always come whenever I have the chance. The restaurant is clean, and the service is good. My go-to dishes every time I visit are the roast duck and fresh spring rolls. My favorite main course is the "Knight's Noodles," while my mother prefers the "Koy See Mee" (stir-fried noodles with seafood). For dessert, we always have the candied bananas and coconut ice cream. Highly recommended! ✨💖
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanaporn Wongsopa

sample_reviews_en.text:
See Fah is a well-known restaurant chain with many branches, offering a wide variety of savory and sweet dishes.

Today, I tried:
•	Roasted Duck: Nice flavor with crispy skin, though there was a slight gamey scent. Overall, it was decent.
•	Emperor Noodles: Tasty, but needed a bit of seasoning to bring out the full flavor.

This branch felt a bit cramped due to its limited space, which made the dining experience somewhat uncomfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Non

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were looking for real Thai food.  Thought we found it here. We ordered Tom Jeut which wasn’t recognizable in taste. And then we ordered Kale with marinaded beef. Probably had the least taste and texture was like soft rubber beef. The worst I’ve had! And the Laap Kai was passable. The best part of the meal were the drinks.

We will never come back to this place … sorry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter DeWit

sample_reviews_en.text: Enjoyed a great meal at See Fah. Classic Thai comfort food with well-balanced flavors and generous portions. Service was polite and efficient, and the location at Esplanade makes it very convenient. A reliable choice for casual Thai dining — would definitely come back again. 👍🍽️🇹🇭
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirumporn Fifi Nittayawan

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating at this blue restaurant since I was a teenager, even now that I have a family and children. It's still delicious, the taste hasn't changed, the quality is excellent, and the service is good. I frequent this branch often, bringing my children to eat here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kris Pornwatanapas

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, perfect for bringing older people to eat. We finished everything. The price is mid-range, neither cheap nor expensive. Personally, I think I'll come back to eat here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: หมี คุง

restaurants.name: DROP BY DOUGH
restaurants.address:

Sukhumvit Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant I frequent; I'd say I'm a big fan. I go to EmQuartier almost once a week and have been buying from them for a very long time. My mom and sister eat there too. We've eaten there before, but we usually order take-away so we can carry it and go for a walk, or sometimes we'll sit in the shop (outside the window) where there are seats, but only for a short time (never linger)! We'll have a little something to eat and then go for a walk. But this time, after ordering, I had my mom wait outside the shop (in the usual outside seating area). While waiting, when the staff called out that our order was ready, we went to pick it up as usual and came back to sit. I thought we'd only sit for a short time and then get up to go for a walk. It wasn't very crowded that day. After I opened the box of Cinnamon Pop and ate one, a staff member quickly came over and said that we couldn't eat in the shop; if we did, there would be a service charge. I was confused and disappointed, to be honest. I'm not sure if the restaurant changed its policy or if this has been the case for a long time and we just didn't know.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratchata Oonchitti

sample_reviews_en.text: I eat donuts almost everywhere I travel. I found these to be incredibly bad for the price. The dough is extremely oily, indicating that they fry too long or over proof the donuts. A good donut shouldn’t be light and fluffy and you shouldn’t be getting oil oozing with every bite. The donuts are also overly sweet and I think this is to cover up the fact that the dough itself is pretty low quality. A lot of hype around this shop but that’s all it is; they’ve spent a lot on design, location and marketing without actually focusing on the core of what they do: making a good product. I’ve had cheaper and better donuts than this in my home of New York City before; a city notoriously much more expensive than Bangkok. Would not recommend at all. If you’re craving a donut, you’re better off just going to a chain like Krispy Kreme; you’ll get a higher quality, albeit mass produced, donut there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karim Butt

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mu husband and I came here yesterday evening with our small toddlers for an early dinner after spending an afternoon at Harbour Land.
My husband and my sons had a grilled chicken with rice and Nutella doughnut. Chicken was very tasty, doughnut so-so (I haven't tested Nutella at all though). And I have ordered buratta berry salad.
Firstly they served all meals at different times: doughnut first, then chicken, and buratta the last..
I'm sure it wasn't fresh as I'm still sick since midnight, vomiting and diarrhea. So, please, be careful with dairy products as it has to be fresh! I sure will not be eating mozarella for a while, because of the way I feel at the moment. And will not be coming back here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marija K. Wälchli

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a very cute donut shop 🍩💕 The donuts here are soft, fragrant, and not overly sweet. Each flavor is unique, and the premium taste shows attention to detail with every bite.

I tried the new donut flavors of the month:
- HOKKAIDO MILK TARO
A donut filled with Hokkaido milk and plenty of taro. I loved the taro topping; it was sweet and had a strong taro aroma.
- SWEET CORN
A donut with corn and torched cream cheese, filled with a generous amount of corn. It's very unique and eye-catching.

Overall, it's a donut shop that's delicious, has beautiful photo opportunities, and a great atmosphere. If you have a sweet tooth, you absolutely have to come here! 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Alisa K

sample_reviews_en.text:
DROP BY DOUGH at EMUARTIER
💭💬 This is a very cute donut shop 🍩💕 The donuts here are soft, fragrant, and not overly sweet. Each flavor is unique, and the taste is premium—you can tell they put attention to detail into every bite. They also serve alcohol. Today I had a delicious savory meal in a quiet and peaceful atmosphere. It was Christmas time, so the donuts 🍩 🎀 were all Christmas-themed and super cute! Merry Christmas 🎄 🎁 🎄

@dropbydough
HANDCRAFTED DOUGHNUTS & COFFEE
EMQUARTIER 1st FL.
10.00 - 21.00
#delicious #100delicious #milliondelicious
#DROPBYDOUGH
#Donuts #MerryChristmas 🎁 ⛄ #Christmas
#EMQUARTIER
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr.Kittipon Prangkaew (Jaded)

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came here to try the donuts, as they’ve been generating a lot of buzz. Unfortunately, they didn’t live up to the hype for us. The donuts were far too sweet, making it hard to even finish a second bite. The dough itself was fairly average, with nothing that stood out. To be honest, I’ve had better donuts from other bakeries.

As for the Thai milk tea, it was a big disappointment. It was overly sweet, to the point where one sip was more than enough. I’m not sure if it’s meant to taste like that, but it was simply overwhelming.

Sadly, I won’t be coming back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: D C

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the most popular donut brands in Bangkok, Drop By Dough has multiple branches across the city.

Their donuts are generously sized without being overly doughy and are fully stuffed with delicious fillings. Flavors range from classics like strawberry and chocolate to modern twists such as matcha & Anoki bean and lemon meringue.

They also offer some savory options alongside a well-curated selection of coffee, sodas, and other drinks.

No other brand comes close to Drop By Dough in terms of quality, but be mindful—their deliciousness comes at a price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisana Varanyuwatana

sample_reviews_en.text:
No matter how many stars anyone gives in their review, we give it 10000/10! The food tastes amazing. I was secretly screaming with delight; it was so delicious. The donuts were good, but the main dishes were even better and worth the price. The chicken was incredibly delicious! Come try it! If I lived closer, I'd eat there every week! 😭🤍🔥🔥🔥🔥
The chicken is good, the sauce is good, the potatoes are good... I'm screaming with delight!
sample_reviews_en.author: phattra Ksn

restaurants.name: Yakiniku Aroi
restaurants.address:

10 12 14/3 Surawong Rd, Si Phraya, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This Japanese-style yakiniku restaurant is a three-minute walk from BTS Saladaeng Station, right in front of Thaniya Road. They greet you in Japanese when you enter, and the service is polite and they serve Japanese lemon sours. The yakiniku is quite high-end, and the baht has gone up, so it doesn't feel like a bargain like it used to, but they still serve delicious meat that feels like it's worth the price, just like eating it in Japan. I especially like the firm texture of the beef tongue. They also accept cards like American Express, which is convenient. They often have yakiniku campaigns, but when you use them, you can't use your credit card and you have to pay in cash. Be careful if you don't want to pay in cash. Thank you for the meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: 孤独旅トミモン

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a Japanese-style yakiniku (grilled meat) restaurant.
🥩 The restaurant is clean and has a free VIP room with no extra charge. 👩‍🍳 The staff are friendly and smiling; they come to your table very quickly after you ring the bell.
🥓 The food tastes authentically Japanese. The seafood dipping sauce is incredibly spicy and perfect for those who like it very spicy. 🍦 Last but not least, they offer free vanilla ice cream. You can enjoy both savory and sweet dishes in one place.
🅿️ Finally, the restaurant offers a parking service to pay for your parking (nearby parking lots include Thaniya and Yada).
sample_reviews_en.author: Phatcharee Uaimue

sample_reviews_en.text:
I didn't expect this yakiniku restaurant to offer such high-end, premium quality meat, delicious taste, and superb service. This place is underrated and not popular among Thais; mostly foreigners frequent it. I highly recommend it to everyone. You'll leave feeling happy with the taste and service.

I recommend it to Thai people. It's similar to Ginzado, but the meat is incredibly delicious and of high quality. The service is superior to other restaurants; all the staff are lovely. I was very impressed and will definitely recommend it to others. However, the price is quite high.
sample_reviews_en.author: Canbettt

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious and good service.

Meat was very good, I’ve order “aroi set” It’s included meat, pork, prawn, squid and vegetable. It’s quite reasonable price. Other menu is quite expensive. But we didnt order it. So this meal is quite good for us.

Service was very good, all waitress and manager were very polite and being in good manners. No bad things.

Overall experience was very good, love it here.

Finally there’s complimentary fruit or ice cream.

Recommend!!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukhum Cheff Truengtrachitkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The meat is of very good quality, tender, delicious, and smells amazing when grilled. The restaurant atmosphere is nice, comfortable seating, and the staff are friendly and provide good service.
Overall, it's great value for the price. I'm very impressed and will definitely come back again! 🤟🏻🥩

Great quality meat, very tender and flavorful 🍖
Nice atmosphere, comfortable seating, and friendly staff
Good value for the price. Definitely will come back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Arisa Pleonphanasamut

sample_reviews_en.text: I've driven past this restaurant for years, and finally got to try it. I've eaten at many yakiniku (Japanese BBQ) restaurants before. Upon entering, I took the elevator to the second floor; the atmosphere was okay. What I was a little curious about was the difference between regular and premium beef tongue. The staff said the premium tongue was thicker and softer. When it was served, I was curious to see how thin the regular tongue would be.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ekapol Kesakomol

sample_reviews_en.text: This Japanese-style yakiniku restaurant serves delicious meat, and they have staff who speak Japanese. They also seem to have private rooms that can be used for entertaining clients. There are also special offers for reservations made via LINE, so it's best to make a reservation through LINE.
sample_reviews_en.author: 芋焼酎

sample_reviews_en.text: This place was a disaster. If you don't speak Japanese, don't expect to be serviced well. Somehow our bill came out to 2k/person with very mediocre meats and poor recommendations. Tax and tip were mandatory. Vibe was dead. Tried to kick us out 20 minutes in advance yet let the Japanese stay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tyga Hero

restaurants.name: Pi Mao Rad Na Rim Khlong Lord
restaurants.address:

125, 4 Fueang Nakhon Rd, Wat Ratchabophit, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I got the information that they serve crispy noodle, turned out there's no one such, just one dish, flat noodle (guay tiew). I don't get it, do I get false information?
The seller speak no English at all, and has no respect to tourist. Has no intention to serve and respond the question, totally bad service.
Since I'd already come a long way, I ordered what they had.
Their rad na (noodle poured by thick gravy) actually was not bad at all.
The gravy itself was so good with tender pork slices and some greens inside, fragrant, savory, full of flavour. Generous portion also.
Dining area, literally you are eating on a pedestrian, with some tables and seats.
With only THB 50, surely reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rbw dinata

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered Rad Na for takeaway today. It is certainly one of the best Rad Na I've had in recent years. It's an old-school cooking style. The flat noodles aren't too thin, and you can smell the aroma of the wok hei. The pork is perfectly marinated.
The chef himself was polite and kind enough to wait for us to pick up our order, even though we arrived an hour late after closing time. 😊🙏 This restaurant makes incredibly delicious Rad Na. The wide noodles are tasty, not thin and mushy, and stir-fried to perfection with a fragrant wok aroma. The marinated pork is delicious and plentiful. The owner is polite, provides good service, and is always smiling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sue Thatchai

sample_reviews_en.text: I bought it to go on Saturday, January 3rd, 2026. I liked it because the price was only 50 baht, which wasn't expensive. You get a generous amount of broth, meat, noodles, and vegetables. The thick noodles were fragrant, chewy, and soft. I was hooked! The owner, a friendly man, was nice. The taste is delicious and comparable to other good noodle dishes; it's not like you can find something uniquely delicious, but it's definitely worth it. The strong point for me is the great value for money and the generous portion size. I'll definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Secretary

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, fresh, clean, and affordable. Lots of people buy takeout, at least 10 packs each, some even order 40 packs! Amazing! At 50 baht, it's a filling meal. The noodles have a fragrant wok-fried aroma, the marinated pork is tender, and the broth tastes great – no need to add any seasoning. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: กิ่งแก้ว ฉัตร์รัตติชัย

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing stall with friendly owners! I really enjoyed eating here while staying at the hostel nearby.

The menus are in Thai so make sure you have the translate app downloaded so you can read it - otherwise I’m sure the staff will help you.

Would definitely come back when I’m in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Harry Pegrum

sample_reviews_en.text: The stir-fried noodles by the canal are delicious. The wide noodles are fragrant and have a wok-fried flavor. The gravy is a bit salty. The price is incredibly cheap for the quality. Highly recommended, but sometimes they sell out very quickly, so you might not be able to get any.
sample_reviews_en.author: Parchaya Veecharungson

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing food, tried previous night as take away good but no where near as good as tonight, sitting at their tables on the path/canal amazing service and amazing food highly recomend but be aware it is a food cart so wont be here at all hours. Delicious though, highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Matthew Bruder

sample_reviews_en.text: The stir-fried wide rice noodles have a fragrant wok aroma, and the rich, flavorful sauce is well-rounded, not overly sweet. There's a generous portion of tender, marinated pork. Each bowl is made with care, dish by dish, so there might be a queue.
sample_reviews_en.author: อาร์ทอี๊ด Eatart

restaurants.name: Akiba Izakaya (อกิบะ อิซากายะ)
restaurants.address:

12 13 Lat Phrao Rd, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Izakaya is small and cozy, but the quality is top-notch.
There aren't many seats inside; most are on the second floor, with a few outside in front. However, it's quite hot these days, so sitting outside without air conditioning would be unbearable. 🥹
The atmosphere inside is perfect for Japanese anime lovers. It's decorated with numerous items from various anime series. It was so much fun just browsing! I loved it.
There's also a gachapon machine you can play.
For food, the staff hand you a menu, you write your order yourself, and then call a staff member to take it, which is convenient.
The restaurant isn't too noisy, so you can have a conversation without shouting.
The food is delicious. The salmon is fresh, and the grilled skewers are served hot and fresh – absolutely delicious! They seem to have some kind of buy five get one free promotion right now, which is a good deal. The prices aren't too expensive either.
There's a decent selection of drinks, especially beers, with many different flavors to choose from. However, the sake selection is a bit limited.
The staff are very polite and provide excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Papanatty

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is pretty delicious except for the fried chicken but the skewered grilled chicken was phenomenal. I do think it is on the pricier side. Still, the beer is pretty reasonable. There was also a buy 3 get 1 free for M-size beers too.

The shop was full of anime figurines and posters and even some slightly NSFW posters in the bathroom. I would not recommend bringing kids here even if you just wanna have a meal.

The seats on the second floor were full when I went so I had to sit on the first floor at the counter and it wasn’t very big.

One funny/weird thing is that you need to sign a receipt when you get an alcoholic drink.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nawat Ngerncham (Nawat)

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent, and the restaurant's atmosphere truly felt like an authentic Japanese izakaya. The food tasted exactly like the original. I had the chance to talk to the owner and learned that their family has direct Japanese ancestry, so it's no surprise that everything was so perfect and wonderful. I highly recommend this restaurant; once you've been here, you'll want to come back again. Almost forgot! The restaurant has a membership card and offers additional discounts during members' birthday months. Thank you so much for creating such a wonderful dining and drinking experience! I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: P. P (PEUN)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Japanese restaurant is perfect for relaxing after work. It gives you the feeling of how Japanese people come to have drinks after work to relieve stress. The restaurant is decorated in an authentic Japanese style. They only serve Asahi draft beer. During my visit, there was a promotion: buy 3 get 1 free (all 3 glasses must be the same size). The food is delicious in an authentic Japanese style, but personally, I felt the prices were a bit high.

Price: 4/5
Quality: 5/5
Taste: 4/5
Cleanliness: 5/5
Speed: 5/5
Service: 5/5
Location: 5/5
Value for money: 4/5
sample_reviews_en.author: Akapatr Chiraarreebutr

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped by Akiba Izakaya for dinner. They have a lot of premium menu items. Today I ordered the mixed fish rice bowl, and it was packed with toppings: uni, fish roe, sweet shrimp, and fresh fish. The grilled scallops were also large and fragrant, and paired well with the side dishes. Another dish I loved was the large, flame-seared beef slices; they melted in my mouth. The staff were friendly and attentive, which was great. If you like Japanese food, you shouldn't miss this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: pai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Akiba Izakaya is one of those places you almost don’t want to review because you’d rather keep it to yourself.

Fabulous Japanese food, ice-cold beer, great music and a genuinely cool little izakaya atmosphere that feels a world away from Bangkok the moment you sit down. Nothing pretentious, just seriously good food, warm people and the sort of place where one drink very easily becomes several.

An absolute gem in Lat Phrao. I’ll be back. 🍺🍢🇯🇵

★★★★★
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr. Matthew Jennings

sample_reviews_en.text: I recently visited this place, and it has quickly become one of my favorites for drinks and snacks! The atmosphere is fantastic, and they serve the best drinking snacks in the area. Everything was fresh, flavorful, and paired perfectly with the drinks. The service was also top-notch, making the whole experience even more enjoyable. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a great spot to relax and enjoy some good food and drinks!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jang Isara

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is very Japanese, with anime posters everywhere. Today I ordered the soy sauce marinated salmon to try; the fish was fresh and they gave me a generous amount of chili and garlic. The fried items like the tonkatsu and french fries were crispy, freshly fried, and hot. The staff were friendly and cheerful, constantly refilling our water. Highly recommended for those who want to chill after work.
sample_reviews_en.author: อมรรัตน์ พรมอ่อน

restaurants.name: Teppen Premium Langsuan
restaurants.address:

B104, 87 VELAA AT SINDHORN VILLAGE, Room no, 105 Soi Langsuan, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A year later, I visited again, and the atmosphere was still lively.

Unfortunately, the quality of the meat had deteriorated significantly. The same whole-beef order came out completely black this time.

It had been thawed, refrozen, and thawed again; the flavor was no longer what I expected—the rich, oily texture was gone.

What a waste of the beef.

The price remained the same, but the quality had clearly declined.
sample_reviews_en.author: William Wu

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best grilled beef, Japanese style. Staffs are knowledgeable, quick and caring. Alcohol is fine. Maybe beer or sake is better than mixed drinks or sangria. Parking right underground of the building and don't forget to stamp for fee reduction(or free). Cute plate of thank you chocolate drawings.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suwanna Suwannaphong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was enjoyed a lot. The food is great. The place is clean. Service is so awesome. The thank you plate and thank you banner made the dinner end so happy!

The only thing I can’t give 5 stars is the air conditioning was really weak. Same as the other branch I tried in Thong Lor. I barely could breathe🥵
sample_reviews_en.author: Sonia

sample_reviews_en.text: I think, this establishment does not align with the expected standards of a Teppen restaurant. The menu appears to have undergone modifications, and the food quality does not live up to its freshness expectations. The cost-to-quality ratio is unbalanced, leading to a sense of dissatisfaction.
sample_reviews_en.author: Error Pichita

sample_reviews_en.text: The lunch set is suitable for those who want to eat meat at a reasonable price. The meat is of good quality but on the higher side. Service was slow and the ordered items were incorrect. Overall, the restaurant and the food taste are good.
sample_reviews_en.author: NITA 88

sample_reviews_en.text:
I go there quite often. They’ve changed the menu recently.
All meat I ordered was frozen today.

Please serve the Yukke(Yukhoe) after fully defrost.

Hope chefs can read this message.
sample_reviews_en.author: T T

sample_reviews_en.text: This location used to be the best. Beef was so tender and prices reasonable. What happened ? The beef is smaller potions and tough. Very disappointed because it used to be the best.
sample_reviews_en.author: Captain Ahab

sample_reviews_en.text:
Staffs are very nice and helpful. But the price is too expensive than the quality of the food.
There is no refill for hot green tea which is strange for this type of restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: S D

restaurants.name: ตลาดแจ่มจันทร์
restaurants.address:

ตลาดแจ่มจันทร์ Thepharak, Mueang Samut Prakan District, Samut Prakan 10270, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered grilled beef rice but got fried beef instead. The chicken salad smelled bad. They were chatting and playing around while preparing the food, forgetting my order. I asked for a quick meal because it was during my break, but they gave me a takeout box. Where am I supposed to eat that? Didn't they notice I ordered a Coke in a glass with ice and sat waiting – was I supposed to order it to go? And they didn't even apologize. They just laughed and made it seem like a joke. If you're not ready to sell, don't sell at all.
In short, I, the customer, bought something for 218 baht and ended up eating on the side of the road like a beggar.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mook Muay

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall, the market has a good atmosphere, parking, plenty of tables, a variety of food options, restrooms, a separate chill-out bar area, and live music.

***I'm deducting one star because some of the female waitresses at the Nam Chan restaurant used inappropriate language. The owner or employer should have reprimanded or retrained them on customer service.*** Please look into this.

✅However, the other staff members were polite, friendly, and welcoming.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apsorn Siri

sample_reviews_en.text: The music is terrible. The atmosphere is chill, but they're playing EDM and rock music—utterly thoughtless. The food and beer aren't expensive. The DJ should be replaced.
sample_reviews_en.author: รุ่งโรจน์ เพชรบุรี

sample_reviews_en.text: The salmon salad wasn't fresh at all. It was overpriced and not worth it. The music wasn't great, but the atmosphere was nice. I hope they improve the salmon.
sample_reviews_en.author: สิริวิมล โสภะบุญ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food, ice-sweet beer, and the waitstaff are super cute and friendly. Come and try it!
#JamchanMarket
sample_reviews_en.author: ภากร โพนสงคราม

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were lovely and provided excellent service, especially the young lady.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanjan June

restaurants.name: Tonkatsu Wako
restaurants.address:

6 FL, 8-9 9 Rama IX Rd, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
High-quality service and fried seafood here

UPDATED 2026.08.17

Actually this restaurant was my favorite one in Central Rama9, i came here like almost once a week. I loved the well-cooked rice, crispy fried pork and everything. Another good thing in this restaurant is that they provide free cabbage, which means if you can add cabbage for free.

However, today (2026.08.17) around 17:00, I saw a staff was cleaning someone’s table. And the one did not eat any cabbage in his plate, then, i saw the staff put all the cabbage in the USED back to the cabbage plot. That plot is used for adding on cabbage for anyone who wants. And once after the staff did this action, she looked at me. It seems that she wanted to see if anyone saw her action. Unfortunately, i saw it.

I would say, i will never come here again with such of hygienic issue. I am not sure if it was the SOP of the restaurant or it was just personal action from that exactly staff. There were CCTV inside the restaurant, and if this was NOT SOP inside this restaurant, i suggested management team looked at the video.

Again, i will never come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steven

sample_reviews_en.text:
This tonkatsu restaurant offers unlimited refills of rice and vegetables. The tonkatsu is tender inside and crispy outside, served with hot, soft rice. There are several sauces to choose from, including tonkatsu sauce and salad dressing. The side dishes are also delicious, and the soup is rich and flavorful. Green tea is also refillable. I ordered the pork loin tonkatsu nabe, which was incredibly tender with just the right amount of marbling. The nabe soup was fragrant, sweet, and not too salty, with egg and onions – a perfect combination. Eating it with the hot Japanese rice was pure bliss.

The staff were very friendly and the food arrived quickly, even though it was busy. There's plenty of parking, with free parking for a limited time; exceeding that time will incur a fee, but you can get your parking ticket stamped.
sample_reviews_en.author: Punnatorn Vechaputi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best Tonkatsu ever!
Every dish is made fresh, so there's a slight wait of 10-15 minutes after ordering.
But everything is made with care.
- Hot rice!!!!! As hot as an iron at home!
- Juicy pork loin!!!! Like the rain after work.
- Crispy breadcrumbs, crispier than your bank account at the end of the month.
- Unlimited refills of cabbage and rice, like a solace from the stress of work.

This dish reflects the lives of working people around here so well it brings tears to your eyes the moment you take a bite...

It cost 529 baht after VAT and service charge.
For the large pork loin set.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaiyapak Panaviboonporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall, the food was good and delicious. The fried items were crispy and not oily, with great flavor.
The restaurant offers free refills of rice and cabbage.
The rice served in a pot was delicious; the texture was truly unique, and serving it hot in the pot was fantastic. I was very impressed.
The pickled vegetables seemed unremarkable, but they paired surprisingly well with the rice and helped cut through the richness.
The sesame dressing was incredibly delicious, a particular favorite.
Free green tea was served, with both hot and cold options available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanyarat Jirarattanatham

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pork loin cutlet was absolutely delicious — perfectly fried with a crispy outer layer while the inside remained tender and juicy, not chewy at all. The rice was also excellent, with a soft texture and served nice and hot.

One of my favorite parts was the shredded cabbage. It was incredibly fresh, crisp, and so enjoyable to eat — and the best part is that you can get unlimited refills! It made the whole meal even more satisfying. Overall, a really great tonkatsu experience. Highly recommended! 😋🍽️
sample_reviews_en.author: Lita

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pork loin tonkatsu was delicious. The pork wasn't tough, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. The pork pieces were large and satisfying. Cabbage and rice were refillable.
The pork and shrimp nabe was hot, with a runny egg and one shrimp. The flavor was well-balanced.
I personally didn't like the shrimp croquettes. They smelled fishy, ​​like they added shrimp fat and roe, making them feel mushy and fishy.
sample_reviews_en.author: สิงโต พี่ชายท๊อฟฟี่

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten at many Tonkatsu Wako branches, but I'm most impressed with this one. All the staff are very hardworking and dedicated to providing excellent service. The kitchen is also very fast; the food is prepared quickly, so you don't have to wait long. The staff are always there to assist customers. I'm very impressed and love this branch the most! ❤️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Gift DTH

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is quite spacious, but it can get crowded during peak hours, so you might have to wait in line. The food is delicious, as expected from Waco. The rice is fragrant and soft; I like the rice here the most.

The pork is well-prepared, just like at other branches I've visited – not too fatty. You can refill the cabbage as much as you like.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vasinee P.

restaurants.name: na talatphlu
restaurants.address:

865/9 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Talat Phlu, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A wonderful find we came across whilst exploring Talat Phlu and its food market.

The best craft beer bar I’ve come across in Bangkok. 12 draft beers on tap with the staff happy to let you sample a free taste of a beer to help you decide.

Loved the Inedit Wheat beer for 310 THB for 500 ml, my mate played safe and went for the Carlsberg at 170 THB, Had some very tasty karaage chicken 110 THB as a snack to share. Both beers served icy cold in perfect condition, along with some complimentary nuts.

The interior decor is both quirky and tremendously well chosen. Love the attention to details the owner(s) have shown. Was around a 20 minute walk from Talat Phlu BTS station on the Silom line, the Talut Phlu SRT station is closer.

Super friendly, good atmosphere with background music at a comfortable volume. The Talat Phlu area is a fascinating step into a little of the old Bangkok, hardly any tourists and a vast array of food options both street side and in the Talut Phlu food market.

Definitely will return next time I'm on this side of the River.- terrific!!
sample_reviews_en.author: D J

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re looking for a quiet and cozy place to chill, this spot is highly recommended.
A small beer bar located in a compact building next to Talat Phlu market, offering a calm and relaxed atmosphere away from the crowd.

They have a nice selection of beers along with light snacks to enjoy.
The lighting is pleasant, the music is not too loud, making it perfect for conversation and unwinding after work.
Definitely a hidden gem that could easily become your go-to spot 🍻
sample_reviews_en.author: Rungnapa. R

sample_reviews_en.text: What a find in the outskirts of Bangkok city! It seems western bars and pubs are not quite common in this area (we were used to staying in central Bangkok), but we stumbled upon this joint while craving a beer and some respite from the summer heat. Great service, the owner was nothing but helpful. Big range of craft beers. Bonus is that they serve Guinness in various styles, including Nitro. Also they serve beers in 1L glasses if that’s something up your alley.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amanda Tee

sample_reviews_en.text:
This craft beer bar, as the name suggests, is located in the Talat Phlu area.
The shop is called "Na Talat Phlu."

At first glance, the exterior doesn't look like a beer bar.
But once inside, the atmosphere is slightly dim, perfect for chilling, listening to music, sipping draft beer, chatting, and socializing. Everything is just right.

The shop accepts cash and QR code payments.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supawut Saengrassamee

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Typical craft beer bar with standard craft beer flavors.
- Prices are as listed on the tap, no extra charges (they even give you a handful of chicken leg snacks, so delicious you'll want to buy more!).
- You can bring any food you like; they're quite generous.
- The second floor is dimly lit, perfect for hanging out with friends, reminiscing, or gossiping about other people.
sample_reviews_en.author: pigachuuu

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a true hidden gem! You'd walk right in and no one would know they sell craft beer! 5555 I've been a long-time customer and I'm never disappointed. The shop does a great job selecting and rotating their beers. It's a small shop perfect for solo visits, dates, or friends. Plus, you can even order som tum (papaya salad) from the shop next door! The best part! 5555
sample_reviews_en.author: Benjarat Wongcharoenrat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very nice decorated feels like you’re in some old style European dark pub, they have 10 different craft beers on tap.
Serving snacks and they have a very old school arcade game console in the back to play for free.
There are not many seats so it gets full quickly.
One more thing the outside doesn’t make it look attractive but it’s definitely worth to go in!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bjorn Bosveld

sample_reviews_en.text:
10 taps, but I've hand-picked them all; I like them all.
It's a small shop that doesn't feel cramped, and the decor is beautiful.
But from the front, you can't tell it's a beer shop at all
because the door is closed 😅 It's actually located in the middle of the restaurants in the Talat Phlu area. I'll definitely be coming back often; it's very close to home.
sample_reviews_en.author: EveRy KT

restaurants.name: KAI by Nippontei, Japanese Restaurant, Gaysorn Amarin 4th Floor
restaurants.address:

4th Fl, Gaysorn Amarin, 496, 502 Phloen Chit Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Went here for the first time—kinda hidden up on the 4th floor inside the food court zone. My unagi don was ฿490, plus ฿190 side set. The side came with 6 thick pieces of sashimi, a small bowl of salad, soup and green tea. They're all delicious! Would go back again for the same set but wouldn't need the shard salad as I was a bit too stuffed with the salad and desserts. Oh, the Hokkaido milk pudding and matcha ice-cream were interesting. The pudding is smooth and a bit too sweet for me though not overly sweet. The ice-cream was great; not very sweet at all!
sample_reviews_th.author: Mook NP

sample_reviews_th.text:
Superb taste with reasonable price!
You can have Bluefin Tuna (Akami) with rich taste of freshness with below 500฿

This restaurant is located in Gaysorn Amarin’s food center (top floor).

What a pity that Tuna bowl was already removed from the menu. BUT you can order side dish or Kaisen Don which included 2 slices of Akami.

*Hamachi also has unique taste from other restaurant that I’ve tried.
sample_reviews_th.author: Pisut Mingsagul

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve been to this restaurant three times. The food is delicious, clean, and my family really loves it. Unfortunately, the service from one particular female staff member — the thin, fair-skinned woman — has been very disappointing.

Every single time I’ve ordered from her, she has missed some of my items. Even last Friday, when my husband placed the order for me, the same thing happened again. What was even more frustrating was her attitude, as if the mistake was somehow my fault, rather than hers.

What’s interesting is that another female staff member is completely different. She is friendly, smiles, apologizes when something goes wrong, and actually takes responsibility. It’s very clear that these are two very different levels of service.

The food is great, but good food alone isn’t enough. If your staff are trained to the same standard, why is the customer experience so different depending on who takes the order? I really hope the restaurant takes this seriously and improves its service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manass Jannn

sample_reviews_en.text: I arrived at the restaurant at 11 am and was able to choose a seat right away without a reservation. The staff were very friendly and provided excellent service. The sashimi and the Yuki Omakase set were incredibly fresh and premium, and absolutely delicious. The eel rice bowl was amazing, and the wagyu teriyaki rice bowl was also fantastic. You can order them as a set, and for dessert, they offer ice cream. On my way back, I ordered two salmon mentaiko onigiri, which were also delicious. The restaurant is located on the 4th floor of Gaysorn Amarin, and parking is convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nokpisa

sample_reviews_en.text:
As soon as I saw "By Nippon Tei," I immediately pulled in and ordered an onigiri to try. It was incredibly delicious! The rice was amazing!!! So sticky and chewy.
The onigiri was huge; one piece was enough to fill you up, two pieces would be enough to make you full. The rice was incredibly delicious; the restaurant seemed to have a sign saying it was from the Tohoku region, but I can't remember the prefecture. 🍙🍙
The staff were lovely and provided excellent service. I was very impressed. I went alone but didn't feel uncomfortable at all. I will definitely go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: S Thanasupapan

sample_reviews_en.text: A more affordable version of nippontei. This is really our comfort meal. The space is small but yet very comfy. The wagyu and omakase rice bowl is amazing so fresh and well prepared and tasty. The grape soda drink was so good too and not from a bottle but homemade. The small negitoro bite was really mouthful and yummy too. The best part is the pork salad it’s really worth the price and the salad dressing is umami not too sweet or sour. Finished off with the strawberry pudding which melts in my mouth. Love this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: M M

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just a passerby luckily made a stop at the restaurant.

All the fishes were very fresh. It was perfectly served in size (slice) that made it even enjoyable. Their Hamachi is quite outstanding. Only thing that I think would make this bowl perfect is for the rice to be a little more flavoured, and more moist (probably it was late lunch that rice started to dry)

But all in all, still get it a 5 stars for this price range.
sample_reviews_en.author: James Su

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was very delicious and the service was excellent. The staff were all friendly and welcoming. I highly recommend this restaurant. I give it 5 stars. The food was very delicious and the service was excellent. All the staff are warm and welcoming. This is a nice restaurant that you will never miss. I give it 5 stars for sure!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: CAVOK

restaurants.name: Mae Sri Ruen (The Mall LifeStore Bangkapi)
restaurants.address:

3522 Lat Phrao Rd, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: My mom ordered fried rice with dried fish, 169 baht per plate. The dried fish seemed like it was pre-made; it was hard, chewy, and smelled rancid. The vegetables were just tiny stems. It was a waste of money. They didn't even bring water; the first dish arrived before the water, and we had to ask for it. Really disappointing. I won't go there again. The Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) tasted terrible; it only smelled like fermented tofu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rosanan Thunhikorn

sample_reviews_en.text: Central Thai cuisine boasts rich flavors, perfect for curry lovers who enjoy a moderate level of spiciness. The taste is delicious and satisfying without being overly intense or burning your mouth, yet still offering a satisfying kick of chili and ginger.
sample_reviews_en.author: To To

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken noodle soup is delicious and affordable. However, other single-dish meals made to order are quite expensive. Everything tastes great, the staff provides good service, and the restaurant is clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rich Richy

sample_reviews_en.text: I went twice, and the white kanom krok (Thai coconut pancake) was always sold out. One staff member offered to make it, while another said it was out of stock.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐณิชา พละศักดิ์

sample_reviews_en.text: I came for lunch on a Saturday and it wasn't very crowded. The menu is the same as other branches. Today, the noodle soup wasn't very hot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panya Wanchana

sample_reviews_en.text: The food variety is good. Some dishes were to my liking, others were just average. The diversity of the menu is what's interesting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dieter Komut

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were reluctant to work. When called to take the menu, they argued with each other, talked loudly, and ignored customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tidarat Rangsom

sample_reviews_en.text: Being addicted to sweets is so outdated. I wish they would reduce the sugar in all menu items; that would be great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirun NiN27

restaurants.name: Swensen's Big C Rajdamri
restaurants.address:

97/11 Ratchadamri Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The service staff were not very good. They placed the glass down hard. The whipped cream was not tasty. The female staff member had a sullen face, looking like she was not willing to serve and work. I felt disappointed. I really like eating Swensens and have eaten at many places. Every place has good service except for the Big C Super Center Ratchadamri branch. The service of the staff should be improved.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanya Phunvongsa

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff invited customers into the store, but once inside, they didn't bring a menu. We had to ask for it. When the menu finally arrived, it was incomplete, and the staff member walked away again, disappearing after repeated requests. The ordering process was also confusing; those who ordered first received their food last, even though their items were almost ready. I'm very confused by the system.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattraphorn Phalavaddhana

sample_reviews_en.text:
The male staff member was rude! We ordered an extra scoop of ice cream and asked for a change and refund, but he refused and insisted we eat the extra scoop on the spot.

We had already finished our meal and were full. Why force people to buy more food? Tourists aren't treated like this!

The final refund was processed by simply taking money away! We are customers, why are we treated this way?
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuki Ting

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was fine but when I finished my ice cream there and wanna take the Grab, I just came back and asked the waitress where I could take the Grab taxi, she helped me to find out but the guy looked like the Manager just threw my phone back to me and ordered the waitress to do her job, like “ignore him just go”.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tuấn Anh Nguyễn

sample_reviews_en.text: I had very terible experience two days ago. The waitress (Modtanoy) showed grumpy face to us after I reuqested to change another table instead of taking one she instructs. I am sorry that maybe that is Swense rule-- doesn't allow customer to take another table. All I want to do enjoy ice cream ..but seems I fail.
sample_reviews_en.author: Scott Lin

sample_reviews_en.text: Located inside Big C commercial center, this restaurant offers many kind of ice creams such as chocolate, brownie or fruits. The ice creams are delicious but it was not really cold as I went here at the evening. Not many people at this time (only me and a family). I recommend to taste, but maybe not in this one.
sample_reviews_en.author: Exelar

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered a cappuccino, French toast with Nutella and ice cream (199 THB), a Dubai ice cream sundae (179 THB), and a lemonade. Prices were quite low for the area (total: 563 THB), but the quality was rather mediocre (the banana slices were still half-frozen, and the French toast was hard and difficult to cut).
sample_reviews_en.author: Emilie

sample_reviews_en.text:
The DIY set -
Good and fun set for children.
Encourage creativity to decorate own ice cream
The Durian ice cream set came with sticky rice and real Durian flesh on the Durian ice cream.
Nice.

Was kinda quiet on the weekday.

They do not accept cash for payment. Need to use the credit card.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zen 00

restaurants.name: ลาบนัวอุดร จตุจักร Larbnuaudon Jatujak
restaurants.address:

1094/29 Phahonyothin Rd, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! The flavors were perfect. Just look at the picture! The shrimp was fresh, and the ingredients were high quality. I highly recommend the stir-fried basil with tender beef – it was incredibly delicious! I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumintra Laencote

sample_reviews_en.text: This Isaan restaurant makes incredibly flavorful and delicious food! They have 3 branches 🌶️✨ A must-try dish is the "Crispy Fried Mackerel," which is incredibly crispy – you can eat the head and bones! It pairs perfectly with the tangy …
sample_reviews_en.author: warit srimadee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Easy to get to, parking available in front of the shop. Food was a bit slow to arrive, but the wait was acceptable. Ordered 4 dishes and 1 pitcher of beer for 600+ baht, which was very reasonable.
The food tasted okay.
Recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: A Victory

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant lives up to its name. The papaya salad is flavorful and the grilled dishes are excellent. The Meridian drink is smooth and pairs surprisingly well with Northeastern Thai cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: OporGoodgirl

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish was delicious and full of flavor. The staff were friendly and welcoming, creating a warm atmosphere. Great value for the quality of the food. Highly recommended!👌👌👌
sample_reviews_en.author: Guang

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. The deep-fried sea bass with fish sauce was absolutely amazing. The grilled beef tongue was also delicious. Everything was tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: ด.ญ. ญาดา มุจนานนท์

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and flavorful, especially the grilled intestines – not chewy and not smelly at all. The mushroom curry was also perfect. 💯 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Saralee Pensook

sample_reviews_en.text: You MUST order the "Tiger's Tears" (a type of Thai salad)!!!! The papaya salad with pickled and fresh crab is amazing. I love it so much!!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Phiyada Si

restaurants.name: Craft Cottage
restaurants.address:

Red Light District, LK Metro Aly, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm often in Thailand and eat out every evening. The service was friendly and the atmosphere was okay. There's a pool table, but the music was very loud; I don't know if that's only the case during Songkran. The food isn't recommended. My salad was dressed only with olive oil, and you had to search for the feta cheese crumbs. The steak was tough, like it had been boiled rather than fried. The best things were the fries and the half-fried garlic clove. I know you can't expect an imported steak for 500 baht, but Kiss and Food does it better and cheaper. Maybe the cook was just having a bad day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Willi G.P. Buech

sample_reviews_en.text: From westen to Thai food, this place caters for all. There were 5 of us and there is not a bad dish at all. Very well presented and tasty. Great range of beers and there is also a pool table. The location is great as you can watch people walk pass while you eat and recharge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Biohazard

sample_reviews_en.text: Located at the entrance to Soi Diana on the LK Metro line, I often stop by here to grab a bite before heading to the go-go bars. The food is delicious, but the prices are a bit high, probably due to the location. Try their tap beer selection, it's pretty good.
sample_reviews_en.author: SHIN

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered one small meal with fish for one person but they bring me a huge fish without asking me before (small one was finish already) and also charge a expensive price for it.
It was food for 3 people going mostly to waste, thats something i don't support!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: benjamin öllerer

sample_reviews_en.text: The setup here and the staff were very nice. I came by because I noticed they had craft IPA beers that I've never tried. Ordered one made in Scotland and it was great. Slightly pricey but worth it. They do have numerous cheaper priced beers …
sample_reviews_en.author: J Ryan

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered Brewdog Punk IPA but what they served me was disgusting. I don't think it was actually Punk IPA, more like the contents of the drip trays or something at the bottom of a barrel.  And at 379 baht I expected a little bit of quality. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Ian Ren
