sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant was really great. I loved the food, everything was tasty and high quality. The atmosphere was light, relaxed, and fun, and the service was excellent. The waitresses were friendly and welcoming.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eliya

sample_reviews_en.text: An overpriced place with no selection. Craft beer is the only thing here in name. They have a few US craft beers in the fridge and a couple of taps. The decor and service are Thai, but the price is steep.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexander Rusanov

restaurants.name: Took Lae Dee
restaurants.address:

17 Ramkhamhaeng 15 Alley, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
"Affordable and Delicious!" Just like the name suggests.
Come whenever you're hungry, you won't be disappointed.
The minced pork rice porridge is hot, fragrant, and delicious. A large bowl, generous portion, only 62฿ – great value!
You can eat in a cool, air-conditioned room. The food arrives quickly.
sample_reviews_th.author: yudhapong mapan

sample_reviews_en.text: good service, good food, it actually opens 24 hours a day and accepts order online, value for money, i like the onion soup, quava juice, salmon steak, seafood steamed rice and yellow or green curry with chicken, but they have a lot on the menu if you like to try, i usually spent 400-500 each visit. foodland membership allows some credit points for the bill. they have the english menu if they recognize you as foreigner or you can ask for one (it is interesting there are more items to choose from english menu, eg mushroom soup not on thai menu but on english menu ). i believe same price on both menu but i never checked or compared. it is often said there could be dual price for locals and foreigners for some restaurants, some parks and some entertainment establishments, even hospitals (and some expats not happy about dual pricing) but i tended not to care too much. Anyway it is more important to enjoy good service and yummy food. by the way, the restaurant could be full during peak hour lunch or dinner time, so i avoid dining on these time slots.
sample_reviews_en.author: dr ken chao

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very convenient restaurant. It’s open 24 hours everyday and located just next to foodland where you can do your grocery shopping. It’s also very easy to get a parking there as people come and go quickly without lingering around (the parking is free).

The restaurant itself has a very decent service and attentive staffs. It is well lit with and very clean open kitchen and American dining style with the booth and bar seat. The service is also super quick so it is great for you if you’re in a hurry to grab a quick lunch.

The must try here is the guava juice and please get the banana fritters with ice cream, it is to die for. It’s so yummy!!!! 😋 🍌🍦
sample_reviews_en.author: Charlie

sample_reviews_en.text: The Ramkhamhaeng branch has expanded its space and has more tables, making it ideal for a quick bite before heading home. The food comes out quickly, there's a wide variety of menu options, and the prices are moderate. It's open 24 hours. I've been eating here since their breakfast menu was 69 baht with free drinking water. They've adapted to the economic situation, but the taste and service remain the same.
sample_reviews_en.author: JamesMa Channel

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the most unimpressive branch. I ordered crispy fried eggs but got regular fried eggs. I ordered soft-boiled eggs but got almost raw eggs; the egg whites were still runny and barely cooked. I asked for a remake, and they gave me a raw egg that had been microwaved until it was like a hard-boiled egg stuck to the cup... I wish they would learn from other branches, such as The Street or Ramintra.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratthasirin Wangkanond

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ate here today at 11:30 AM. The food didn't taste as flavorful as before. The pork yakisoba sauce wasn't as rich as it used to be, and the chicken in the basket wasn't crispy. The quality of the food wasn't the same as it used to be.
The Thai coconut pancake (Khanom Krok) wasn't crispy; it was served completely cold. It wasn't delicious at all. I was very disappointed this time.
sample_reviews_en.author: NuyNui official

sample_reviews_en.text:
Affordable and good food at Foodland. It's a fast-food restaurant where you can also shop. They have a wide variety of dishes, all freshly prepared. You might have to wait in line at certain times because it can get very crowded.

The food is good and clean, and there's convenient parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: A Victory

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was surprised to see the dish looking EXACTLY like on the menu.

Tasty, great service, tones of options on the menu.

Maybe in the other place you have slightly lower price for the same dishes but this place covers the difference with tidy comfortable airconditioned interior.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nina Kilaru

restaurants.name: ความสุข หมูกระทะอาหารอีสาน นวมินทร์
restaurants.address:

Nawamin Rd, รามอินทรา Khan Na Yao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The pork portion was too small for 250฿.
The food tasted good though.
The soup wasn't provided; we had to keep asking for refills.
sample_reviews_th.author: KK

sample_reviews_en.text: The dipping sauce is delicious, and the pork is excellent. They have a birthday month promotion with a 10% discount. I got the discount on my first visit. The following week, still within my birthday month, I went back because I loved the dipping sauce. This time, the owner said the discount couldn't be used. I asked if I couldn't use it again, and the owner replied, "Then customers would just keep coming back all the time?" I was confused. I ate within my birthday month, paid for my meal, and the restaurant and customer made money. What's wrong with that? Maybe I'll just visit once a year then. (The customer experience was negative. Importantly, the promotion didn't specify that it could only be used once a month. I was planning to go every week because the food is delicious, but I wasn't happy with the response and the promotion. They should think carefully before running promotions.) Even the discount wasn't significant. I just wanted to use my birthday discount, which only happens once a year. ***I'd rather go to another restaurant, P'Kiew.***
sample_reviews_en.author: Moomuu

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and reasonably priced. They have everything from papaya salad and BBQ pork to single-dish meals. The BBQ pork is sliced ​​pork, which is perfect – they have pork neck, pork belly (which looks like bacon, amazing!), and fragrant, tasty liver. The dipping sauce is fantastic; I usually don't like dipping sauces, but this one is exceptional. I dipped a lot! The egg fried rice is delicious. I initially hesitated, wanting garlic fried rice, but the owner said everything is good. The egg fried rice was a generous portion, equivalent to a whole box of rice. The spicy papaya salad is outstanding, and the chicken skewers are amazing. The atmosphere is nice, the music is good, and it's close to my condo. Highly recommend! Excellent food quality 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Pu Potter

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited on August 2nd, 2024. It's a small restaurant with only a few tables. There's parking, but maybe limited space. The BBQ pork was delicious, and the dipping sauce was tasty with a fragrant sesame flavor. I also ordered the fried intestines and fried chicken tendons, which were delicious, crispy, and freshly fried. The papaya salad was okay, with a moderate taste. I wasn't disappointed with my order. The only downside was the very long wait that day. However, the staff communicated throughout the process. It was probably because they were short-staffed that day. Overall, it was good, and I'll definitely go again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: VARAPORN SAVINAI

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a very high-quality Thai BBQ restaurant. The ingredients are excellent.
The dipping sauce is delicious, the service is great, and the staff are very friendly and welcoming. The other appetizers are also delicious, even small dishes like the garlic fried rice are incredibly tasty. I will definitely be back. This is a 100% genuine customer review.
When I find a good restaurant like this, I want to support it. I want the restaurant to last a long time, and I promised the female owner that I would write a review. I will be a frequent customer from now on. Please maintain the quality and I wish you great success and many customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sujittra Unesenee

sample_reviews_en.text: The dipping sauce is incredibly delicious! The meat portion is just right. The basil fried rice is tasty and flavorful. The restaurant is located inside, so it's a bit hard to spot, but the food is amazing. There's a Chay Si noodle shop at the entrance of the alley. Give it a try! I'm hooked and it's close to home, so I'll definitely be back. They have a lot of menu items, including salads, papaya salad, fried and grilled dishes, and single-serving meals.
sample_reviews_en.author: Violet Kiki

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, clean, unique dipping sauce with a well-balanced flavor.
The food was delicious and came out quickly. We ordered the small BBQ pork set, which was just right for two people. The soup was just right, not too salty. The grilled pork neck was tender and delicious.
The papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce had a well-rounded, sweet, and sour flavor.
Good service. We will definitely come back again if we have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Surat Suphatha

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and hygienic. The dipping sauce is amazing, hard to find one like this! Generous portions, very filling. Ordering the large set even gets you a free large bottle of Coke. They also offer a discount on birthdays. In short, it's incredibly delicious! Definitely coming back. The owner is lovely. The atmosphere is nice and airy, not hot. There's parking available. The papaya salad is fantastic! 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: ลดารัตน์ ประทุมโช

restaurants.name: The Duck Restaurant
restaurants.address:

4, 9 Rang Nam Alley, Khwaeng Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted good, but it wasn't amazing. While eating, I was very annoyed by the vendor who kept complaining about her employee. But what was most unacceptable was when I went to pay. I asked how much it was, and she spoke softly, or maybe my hearing wasn't good. I asked a second time, and the vendor made a face, rolled her eyes, and spoke sarcastically instead of saying "ka" (a polite ending for "ka"). What was she trying to convey? I was very disappointed with this kind of service and I don't want to go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: arikaa

sample_reviews_en.text: The male employee who collected the money had a terrible attitude. Normally, I always eat there when I'm in the area. Today, I went as usual and simply asked if there were any seats available upstairs, but he gave me a disgusted look and didn't answer anything. I don't know why. Then, the female owner had another man take me upstairs instead. When he went to prepare my duck noodle soup, he poured in peanuts mixed with chili, and there were weevils in it! I was very disappointed and there won't be a next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: lali mano

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork hock meat is tender and juicy, but k would appreciate more sauce over my rice, because my rice is on the dry side than the moist side. Based on this, I would give 4 star as such a big plate only costs 60, so it’s the value for money is great! But I deduct 1 star because hegine is actually a concern. Staff use bare hands touched food that will be served to you right after. After I had my food, I didn’t feel uncomfortable, but the scene looks troublesome to me
sample_reviews_en.author: Gu Lin

sample_reviews_en.text: Many dishes are delicious. I recommend the duck noodle soup, duck rice, and pork leg rice. The duck meat is tasty, and the duck offal has no unpleasant smell, making it easy to eat. Plus, it's inexpensive. The pork leg rice is also delicious, and they even have pork leg noodle soup. Importantly, it's very cheap. A special duck noodle soup is only 60 baht. They accept the government's co-payment scheme, making it even more economical. Definitely worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Weerayut Thianthong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don't understand why the owner, a woman, constantly yells at her employees, especially since the restaurant isn't busy and most of the staff are Burmese.
❗After she scolds her employees, the amount of duck meat in my bowl decreases. It's always been more than this❗

Taste: Good
Price: Reasonable
Atmosphere: Everything would be better if the owner were quieter.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puan Puan

sample_reviews_en.text: Totally didn’t expect the duck noodles to be this good. I found the place just by following the smell of the soup—it was too good to ignore. It’s run by an old local couple who were super sweet. The noodles were warm, tasty, and really comforting—felt like eating at home. The place is super cozy, and you’ve got to try the duck intestines too, they were amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: thrias welda

sample_reviews_en.text: They have an English menu. We ordered duck rice and pork leg rice. Both were very flavorful! And you can’t beat the price!! Deducted some points because the rice and meat were not warm upon serving. They give you hot soup instead to pour over. It can get quite hot inside too while you’re eating. Overall, I will come back here to eat. It’s cheap but good!
sample_reviews_en.author: Blessy Chio

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered duck noodle soup and duck wings.

Duck noodles soup includes duck offal and meat. The meat was tender and delicious.  Soup was tasty but should’ve asked for no veggies as it could be slightly overpowering.

Duck wings were nothing special.

I came here around 8am and the place is small so do come early to avoid large crowds.
sample_reviews_en.author: SC

restaurants.name: NJ GRILL STEAK & MORE
restaurants.address:

67 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Samre, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I went alone late at night. The restaurant closes at 9:30 PM, and I planned to arrive around 9:00 PM, so I called ahead to inquire. I ordered a medium-rare steak, which was grilled very well but was tough and full of connective tissue, making it difficult to chew. I also felt there was excessive rosemary. Instead, I ordered a BBQ pork steak, which was tender, fragrant, and delicious. The "Pork Heaven" (a local pork dish) was tasty but even tougher and impossible to swallow. The presentation of the pork was also poor. The Hawaiian pizza was good, with soft cheese. Regarding the service, the new staff member didn't know the dishes and couldn't offer recommendations. I'd like to see improvements in the skills of both the kitchen and serving staff. I'd like to visit again, but this is just my honest feedback.
sample_reviews_en.author: HIA CHIM - TASTE MASTER

sample_reviews_en.text: If you’re after a solid meal without breaking the bank, NJ Grill Steak & More is a winner. We went for lunch in early February, and while the place is pretty basic, the service was quick and friendly. The food was surprisingly good for the price. The Caesar salad, even with the unexpected bacon, was delicious and only 110 baht. My wife’s fish steak was another crazy cheap find at 99 baht, and she really enjoyed it. I went for the picanha steak—good portion, but a bit too chewy for my liking, and the gravy wasn’t quite there. Still, at 300 baht, I can’t really complain. Drinks were simple—just Chang beer and orange juice. Everything was clean, and honestly, for these prices, it’s a no-brainer if you're in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: A. Vakarelski (Vakgram on Instagram)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a steak restaurant located along Charoen Nakhon Road.

The restaurant has about five or six tables inside, on a single floor. Parking is available along the sidewalk in front of the restaurant.

It's a local-style steak restaurant with a variety of menu options, including pork, chicken, and beef steaks, spaghetti, pizza (with various toppings), rice dishes, and salads. The menu is quite diverse.

The food tastes good, and importantly, the portions are generous for the price, which isn't too expensive.

If you're looking for a convenient roadside steak restaurant, I recommend this one.

Cleanliness: 8/10
Food Taste: 8/10
Crowd Count: 7/10
sample_reviews_en.author: ben s.

sample_reviews_en.text:
On covid outbreak, I used to order delivery from this place but did not have a chance to eat at the restaurent thus this time I walked in

The place was ok. organize and spacious. there was only 4 or 5 tables

I ordered porkchop and teriyaki streak.
teriyaki one was fine. a bit too sweet but still taste good. on another hand, pork chop was disappointed. overseasoned and overcooked lead to the pork was tough. I had hard time eatting it.

the price was ok though. not cheap but affordable.

not sure if they have parking or not but you can just park on the street
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanin Rungwanichsukanon

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. They moved the restaurant, but didn't update their location on Google Maps, causing customers to go to the wrong place. When I called to inquire, the staff said the restaurant was still open but didn't mention that they had moved.
2. Upon arrival, the staff seemed unwelcoming. There was no greeting; they just handed me the menu and walked away. They didn't even thank me before I left.
3. I ordered a salad and received very little dressing. I was charged extra for additional dressing.
4. The taste was mediocre, and the price was average.
sample_reviews_en.author: sky sightseeing

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is for the new location in Botany Park in  Khlong Son.
The space is open, airy, and comfortable. There is a lot of parking close by.
The menu is the same as the original location and everything is prepared fresh, to order. Any of the pork dishes are truly wonderful and the BBQ ribs are outstanding.
Service is very good and they attend to everything quickly and efficiently.
Highly recommend and there is no other steak or BBQ restaurant like it nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert Tritico

sample_reviews_en.text:
Better than expected!
😆 The steak tasted great. The grilled pork with rice was also delicious. The pork was a bit fatty, perfect for those who love protein and prioritize taste over fat content.
A single steak with fries, bread, and salad costs 109 baht.
Oh... the mushroom soup tastes different from typical restaurant soups. It's milky with a strong mushroom flavor. I wouldn't recommend it for children as they might not eat it.
sample_reviews_en.author: PinG Juthamas

sample_reviews_en.text: This steakhouse in Charoen Nakhon is affordable and offers a diverse menu including steaks, spaghetti, and rice dishes. The food is delicious, making it a great place to visit repeatedly. It's suitable for families, friends, or couples. The restaurant plays music, making for a relaxing dining experience with pleasant conversation. Parking is available right in front of the restaurant. It's a perfect place for a simple dinner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Meetoh Reserve table รับจองโต๊ะ

restaurants.name: Homok Mae Boon Ma
restaurants.address:

10300 802/3 Thanon Nakhon Chaisi Rd, Thanon Nakhon Chai Si, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the chance to buy from them last year, and everything tasted delicious. Parking is usually difficult. I was craving it again, so I suggested we order together from work. Based on my previous experience, I thought I'd call ahead and pick it up tomorrow because I was worried about parking. When I called to order, it seemed like the elderly lady took the order. I understand she works alone, but it's her shop, and she shouldn't have spoken to a customer like, "For such a small order, why don't you order in person?" It was unacceptable. I don't know if my order was considered small for a popular shop, but I ordered 3 sets of rice noodles, 4 large steamed fish cakes, 7 small steamed fish cakes, and 10 fish cakes. For me, that's a lot. After hearing that dismissive attitude, I decided I wouldn't be a customer. I've worked in customer service before, and I've never spoken to a customer like that. I wasn't rude at all when I called to order; in fact, I waited until she finished selling before picking up my order. I really wanted to eat there, but after that comment, I hung up. End of review.
sample_reviews_en.author: นิภาพร บํารุงเขตต์

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! The curry is rich and flavorful, and the price isn't too expensive. I bought some snakehead fish in a basket for 25 baht each. Parking with the hazard lights on in front of the shop should be fine. This was my first time there. I parked behind the old Edison department store, and it was 40 baht per hour, which is very expensive. A vendor there told me to park in the alleyway at the entrance where there's a Cafe Amazon, it's much cheaper.
sample_reviews_en.author: April Maysa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mae Boonma opened a stall in Sriyan in 1982 selling steamed fish curry (hor mok) in a curry shop.
She served steamed snakehead fish curry (hor mok) and striped catfish curry (hor mok) in curry.
She also had a special steamed snakehead fish belly curry (hor mok) that sold out around 1 p.m.
The curry was delicious, with fresh, sweet fish and fragrant coconut milk.
At lunchtime and dinner, customers were busy, so they had to wait in line.
sample_reviews_en.author: Soottipong Winyoopradist

sample_reviews_en.text: If it's steamed snakehead fish in banana leaves, there's a long queue. Many people order 30 or more. I ordered 20. The snakehead fish was full and delicious. I waited almost an hour. If you order steamed minced pork in banana leaves, you'll get it right away. I ordered fried catfish cakes to eat at home. It's delicious. I'll find a chance to eat it again. Most people order to give it away because it's delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pinid Pinidmai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've tried steamed fish curry at many places, and they're all pretty similar in flavor and intensity. But when I found this place, wow! The flavor is on another level. It's incredibly fragrant with curry spices, and the minced pork filling is amazing. Absolutely delicious! Their rice noodles with curry sauce are also fantastic, and their fish cakes are good too.
The owners are both lovely and super friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: จมูกพาไป

sample_reviews_en.text: The flavors are rich and the price is reasonable for the quality, especially the steamed snakehead fish in banana leaves, which has chunks of boneless fish meat and no fishy smell. Besides snakehead fish, they also have steamed pork and striped catfish in banana leaves, rice noodles with curry sauce, and striped catfish cakes. It's recommended to call and order in advance because the queue is very long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supanee Lertchaiyalit

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is really delicious, but the quantity in each serving isn't standard. The more you buy, the less there is in each serving. I only buy it for myself; I wouldn't dare buy it as a gift for anyone. #If you can accept the quantity issue in each serving, then go ahead and buy it, because you have to admit the taste is really better than other places selling steamed fish curry.
sample_reviews_en.author: G G

sample_reviews_en.text: Steamed snakehead fish in banana leaves, steamed striped catfish in banana leaves, and steamed minced pork in banana leaves – all delicious and flavorful. It's a shame I missed out on the fried fish cakes and rice noodles with curry sauce; they were sold out by the afternoon. The shop is next to Auntie Aor's fried rice and fermented pork salad shop in Sriyan.
sample_reviews_en.author: Timmy ItchyFeet

restaurants.name: Soi Voodoo
restaurants.address:

107 2 Ranong 2 Rd, Khwaeng Thanon Nakhon Chai Si, Khet Dusit, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The small shop has only a few tables and serves izakaya-style fusion cuisine. The marinated mackerel fritters are amazing, and the miso tofu puffs are also wonderful. The owner cooks everything himself, and the service is warm and welcoming. The average price is 400-600 RMB per person, which is a bit high; parking is difficult to find. Overall, the flaws don't outweigh the merits, and it's still worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: 曼谷上门服务Outcall Services

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish is delicious and personally cooked by the owner of 10+ years. We loved the Smoked duck breast salad, Baked Eggplant Cheese Miso, Crispy Tofu, Cheesy Spinach, and Deep Fried Tako. The owner and the lovely waitress provide amazing, friendly service. Feels just like eating at a friend's house!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichaya Wongchana

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a small, cozy restaurant where the chef is very dedicated to making delicious food. Every dish is amazing! My favorite is the miso sauce tofu skin; it's incredibly satisfying and pairs perfectly with beer. The chef and the staff are also incredibly friendly and provide excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: pzl

sample_reviews_en.text: Generally, it's a small restaurant, perfect for chatting with friends. The food is average. It might not be suitable for groups of more than 6 people. There's an outdoor area where smoking is allowed. Parking is available along the roadside, but be aware of parking time restrictions.
sample_reviews_en.author: Preawpan Adulyasak

sample_reviews_en.text: Hidden gem. Awesome service. Owner also cooks all the food. Every dish was amazing. I’ve been in Thailand almost 3 months and genuinely some of the best thai/fusion food I’ve had. We shared 9 dishes. So good we didn’t take any pictures. Thank you🙏🏽
sample_reviews_en.author: Will

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a small restaurant with only a few tables, serving fusion cuisine similar to an izakaya. The owner cooks in the kitchen with great care. Some menu items are uniquely delicious, especially the burnt marinated mackerel, which is amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chic Lerts

sample_reviews_en.text: One of my comfort place for dinner in Dusit neighborhood! Very lovely staff and homey atmosphere:) I highly recommend miso baked eggplant, spinach pasta, and meat namtok! ps. There’s a cute cat at the restaurant as well
sample_reviews_en.author: mimi

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious! 🫶🏼 The atmosphere was great and private. The chef put so much effort into the food; every dish was prepared with such care. This is now one of my favorite restaurants. 🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: Mxngpa

restaurants.name: La VIE Bistronomy
restaurants.address:

117 39-40 Phaya Thai Rd, Thanon Phetchaburi, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Celebrate my daughter and wife's birthday booked at La Vie Bristo but since they have an event so got moved down to Piano bar. We requested for complimentary bread as remember the bread here is so good. However, the bread that we get is not as we experienced before, it looks like the bread for the hotel's breakfast buffet. The appetizer is burreta cheese salad, the cheese made from dairy is fresh and we quite enjoy this one. For main course we selected Wagyu steak, Seabass steak and Salmon steak. The Wagyu steak piece is quite thin but very good for grill to medium rare as specified and quite flavorful not melt in the mouth but enjoy. Salmon and Seabass are good as standard. Overall i give 4 stars as compared with previous experience before. Drinks from the piano bar are superb particularly the Penicillin cure. Love it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puwanat W.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited there at 1.30pm very hot , but the waitress got a fan blowing for us once we requested.
Steak , we ordered medium , it seems overcooked a bit , but still ok.
Pesto salad, few veggies on the plate , but so fresh.
Pesto pasta, a lil bit creamy for me, I tot it would be a real basil with nutty.
The kimchi rice , good that they give the crispy pork skin, the flavour is plain.
Fried rice, unbelievable, they did it so yummy.
Wedges not oily, passed!
Salmon soba damn good. So refreshing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ju Janya

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stopped by for breakfast this morning.
The welcome hospitality wasn't great.
The food selection was limited, the taste was mediocre, but the quality of the ingredients wasn't up to par.
The coffee wasn't good.
The juice was acceptable.
Almost all the staff seemed to be trainees.
After eating, the smell of food lingered on me, indicating a ventilation problem.
I'd like to see improvements in service, food, and the venue.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thira Woratanarat

sample_reviews_en.text:
I spent one week here and found the staff to be excellent. The food was of a high standard with variety each day.Pim, Beyonce and Tan at reception were outstanding. Jonnie and Kaprow at La VIE Bistronomy were attentive and best of all was the delightful Jume who has an amazing smile and service to match
Overall the hotel is a place i would highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark

sample_reviews_en.text:
Congratulations!
A huge thank you for your warm welcome, an incredible and unforgettable stay. Thank you to the reception and valet parking staff, thank you to the housekeeping team, thank you for the wonderful time spent at the Signature restaurant, and a big thank you to Johnny, the breakfast manager, and his entire team. A wonderful hotel!! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Philippe Bally

sample_reviews_en.text: I am simply enchanted by the wonderful restaurant. I am thrilled by the atmosphere of service and the approach to guests. I would like to especially mention Johnny, the restaurant manager. A charming man with a big heart and a first-class service approach. I will recommend all my acquaintances and friends to come to the Vie Hotel.
sample_reviews_en.author: ירון שירים ישנים פלומבו

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went with my 2 years old.
Salmon was incredible. Really good.
The Caesar salad was atrocious. The chicken was so dry my son couldn’t even swallow it and had to chew for 5minutes on it.
Price 1200 bath, that’s all we ordered with a bottle of water. Disappointing.
Staff was lovely
sample_reviews_en.author: Mathilde Canterini

sample_reviews_en.text: Aroi Mak Mak! The buffet at the hotel was really good, plenty of delicious options and everything tasted fresh. The service was excellent, especially from Johnnie, who was very attentive and friendly throughout our meal. Definitely a great breakfast experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lidya Cendana

restaurants.name: Hom62 bar&cafe
restaurants.address:

บ้านเลขที่1 ซอยสังคมสงเคราะห์10 Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This small, vintage-style café has seating for 8-10 people. The menu offers a perfect blend of Thai and European flavors. Every dish is meticulously prepared with care, from the tender and melt-in-your-mouth garlic fried rice with beef tenderloin to the carefully selected, aromatic coffee. Every item on the menu is memorable, and importantly, the prices are affordable, allowing you to enjoy a wide variety of delicious dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pinit Phunvichardkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
This adorable home-style cafe feels like stepping into a friend's charming living room. It’s  a delightful oasis with small gardens, and a calming little fountain. Perfect for a quiet afternoon catching up with friends or a solo escape with a good book or Netflix. Food & coffee are available. However, the taste is pretty standard.
Parking is 3-4 cars only.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumol

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing place for a Sunday morning.
Chill music, quiet environment, great deign and most of all, very kind and smiling staff. All you need to start a Sunday on a great mood! 👌☀️

I almost left in a rush without paying... 😅🥲
I sincerely apologize for this.

🫣🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Thomas Varoux

sample_reviews_en.text:
The rice salad with mackerel menu is so tempting; just looking at it makes my mouth water.
It pairs perfectly with strawberry soda. This is another place I always stop by whenever I'm in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: ขนมครกสิงคโปร์ สูตรยายไสว

sample_reviews_en.text: I highly recommend the homemade pizza, tom yum sea bass soup, stir-fried beef with basil and rice, and seafood spaghetti. The atmosphere is great and the restaurant is decorated very cutely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phattriya Anantasestagul

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is beautiful and very cute. The food is very delicious. The owner is cute. The staffs are very good at providing good service and taking good care of us.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jariya Kittipanjamas

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food and drinks selection is quite diverse, including coffee, pizza, and french fries.
The taste is good. You can stop by and support them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pitchaya Ammartmontree

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food & dessert, nice decoration with cozy atmosphere.  Polite and friendly services are very impressive. We definitely do come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vararak P

restaurants.name: รศ 168
restaurants.address:

136 138 Thanon Mahannop, Sao Chingcha, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The stuffed pastries (ขนมใส่ไส้) were very expensive (ขนมค่อม). I asked the price to buy them but didn't. The food tasted good: chicken noodle soup, papaya salad, Padang-style pulled tea, and roti.
sample_reviews_th.author: Saaw Muakkaew

sample_reviews_en.text:
Forget the word Bangkok for a moment, but wait...it's still Bangkok. The atmosphere within the radius of Lan Luang is chic and unique, unlike anywhere else. It's a vibrant, modern old city, perfectly situated near Bangkok City Hall and "Lan Khon Mueang" (City Square). The people in this old city are lovely, and the street names are charming. If you're thinking of a creative economy in a chic old city, with money circulating on weekends and a modern mix of customers and vendors, this is it.

Those who have previously dined at well-established, reputable restaurants in hotel food courts will love this area (or even more), as the food is excellent and the portions are generous. The area seems to have carefully selected high-quality vendors, and the service is superb. Taxis are readily available in this area, and staying here for a while, perhaps enjoying coffee at Double B Hostel, could become your holiday wishlist. It's also a great place to host international guests.

The amazing food in this picture cost 2360 baht for 10 people – no exaggeration! We paid almost instantly! 🎉🥹
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattraniya Mongkol

sample_reviews_en.text: This food court is clean, air-conditioned, and has ample seating. I went around noon on a weekday, and it wasn't too crowded, perhaps because there are many other restaurants in the area. Inside the food court, there are several stalls, but most people seemed to be eating at the curry rice and yen ta fo (Thai noodle soup) stalls. Today, I chose Nai Ouan Yentafo, the cheapest stall at 89 baht. The taste was decent, not amazing, but the ingredients were okay. For payment, if using cash, you need to exchange for coupons at the counter. If you want to pay by QR code, you can transfer directly to the stall (this might be to prevent staff from handling cash and to avoid the hassle of giving change). Feel free to choose something to eat here! As for parking, you have to find parking along the roadside. I'm not sure about odd/even day parking restrictions, but I saw people parking in front of the stalls.
sample_reviews_en.author: April Maysa

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time there. There are two floors,
but most people only sit downstairs.
I ordered some noodles downstairs, but I couldn't remember the name. I made a mistake and they didn't have any! 🤣 They let me exchange them, but I was too lazy to do so. They also accept half-and-half payments, which was great!

Upstairs, there's a chicken rice, khanom jeen, and basil duck, and things like that. But my favorite was the roti shop.
I had roti with cheese, which was delicious. The tea was also average.

I don't know where to park, so I'll have to find a spot, since I parked my motorbike at Ramani Nat Park and walked there.

I'll add a few more photos later.
sample_reviews_en.author: ดวง_ พาตะลอน

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's an air-conditioned room with fans.
Multiple payment methods are available via QR code scanning.
It's a two-story food court with typical prices. As it's a food court, some stalls might be slightly more expensive.
I ordered two dishes of rice and curry for 50 baht, which was reasonably priced. The Tom Kha Gai (chicken coconut soup) was very spicy and sour, which I loved, but the pork chunks were too tough and too salty, making them difficult to chew.
•There are restrooms on the first floor for diners.
•There might be a fee for using the restrooms for non-diners.
•There is parking for motorcycles, but car parking might require finding a spot nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anyongg'ng

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good variety of food and generous seating availability. Great hidden gem where locals go to for local food. Away from the extremely touristy options, this is definitely a place I’d highly recommend.

I tried the mixed chicken rice, fried chicken wings, fried wantons,  Tamselek noodles, Guay chap yuan noodles and banana crepes. Everything tasted really good and very affordable. Second floor has additional seating and 2 shops. A chicken rice shop and a roti / bread shop.

Located very close to Wat Suthat, if you’re in the area, consider this place. Really good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Weng Choong Chan

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a very well-designed food street. The two-story indoor area is air-conditioned. The Hainanese chicken and fried chicken rice on the second floor are delicious. On the first floor, there are Michelin-recommended noodles. The Michelin-recommended noodles have a light and delicious soup, tasty noodles, and good toppings. Overall, the food and dining environment are excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: alan huang

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here because the restaurant I was planning to go to was closed, but I'm satisfied! I couldn't eat the Seonji-eo-mae-du noodles because I was hesitant to go to the restaurant after seeing only this, but I tried them here. Both of the dishes in the picture are delicious! The staff are all friendly and nice~! Please note that Alipay is accepted.
sample_reviews_en.author: 이혜린

restaurants.name: DishCovery greenery
restaurants.address:

PCXF+PGH, Bang Chueak Nang, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The restaurant is beautifully decorated, the food is delicious and reasonably priced, and the staff provides excellent service.
1. Ham and Cheese Spring Rolls (120฿): A delicious appetizer, crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside, perfect with ketchup.
2. Baked Spinach with Cheese (140฿): Includes ham, excellent taste.
3. Duck Breast Basil Rice (195฿): Pieces of duck breast stir-fried with basil, you can choose the spiciness level.
4. Pesto Fried Rice + Grilled Salmon (240฿): A huge portion, I didn't expect pesto sauce to be used with rice. It also comes with shrimp roe sprinkled on top.
No service charge.
sample_reviews_th.author: Porsche Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small restaurant with beautifully decoration and good food.

The restaurant is right next to "take a breath cafe" and it is not hard to find if you go through the main route.

The local route is small and might be a bit difficult to navigate.

The place offer plenty of parking space.

The food was decent.

We ordered duck namtok and I think despite a bit too much with sweet taste, the dish was still quite palatable and satisfactory.

Pasta olio duck was very good. I absolutely love the dish.

Fried ham cheese spring roll was so good. It was absolutely an amazing appetiser.

Place was clean and we'll decorated with high roof and high cieling in a nordic style house. There was a small pond next to the house so there are also outdoor seating by the water.

There are not too many seats indoor which is great. We love that.

The service was alright. Food come out quickly.

The cost was reasonable. We will definitely go back and try out more in their menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puey Ounjai

sample_reviews_en.text:
“DishCovery Greenery: Where Cozy Meets Classy!”

This cafe is as cute as it gets—cozy vibes with both indoor and outdoor seating, plus a secretive second floor that’s perfect for working in peace. There’s also a private room if you’re feeling fancy! The menu has a mix of proper meals and desserts. Tried the Thai milk tea, and it’s good but nothing to write home about. The food’s a bit on the pricey side, but the presentation is on point.

The staff? Super helpful and always eager to serve with a smile. It’s quiet here, making it perfect for work or a laid-back meal. So, if you’re looking for a cute spot that feels like a mini escape, this is it—just be prepared to shell out a bit more!
sample_reviews_en.author: Moshi J.

sample_reviews_en.text: The staffs are very good at service, my heart is full 😁💖 They always open the door to welcome me warmly since the first time I went. Thank you for the small things, always apologize, speak very politely, really impressed. As for the food, it's equally good, both Thai and Western menus are delicious. But the salmon tom kha is a little annoying. The salmon is given a very large piece, like you'll definitely be full. But since it's too big, it's not cooked evenly. 🥹 And the food took a bit long to wait. I went during a time when there were a lot of customers. P.S. I'm a bit disappointed that the meat was sold out that day. I really wanted to eat it, ten million chickens 🐄🐄
sample_reviews_en.author: Varissara Nattapattana

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located between two large restaurants, so you have to look carefully. There's convenient parking.
The food is delicious and beautifully presented, exactly as pictured in the menu. The taste is excellent.
My favorite dishes are the purple sweet potato soup, duck confit, calamari, and the flower salad – all beautifully presented.

The drinks are great; the green tea and cocoa are rich and flavorful.
The fruit juices are perfectly mixed and refreshing.

The restaurant is beautifully decorated with unique items.
The owner is lovely and friendly, explaining each dish and item in the restaurant.
Highly recommend visiting!
sample_reviews_en.author: Toffy Luang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Looks good and expensive but find their prices very reasonable because of the quality and size. Staff is very polite and eager to serve customers. I guess the owner cooks food himself so they are made by heart.

===

Added for the fourth visit this restaurant for a quick meal trying another menu. I still get good, delicious meal, in a peaceful vibe.

People might get attracted with the other restaurant next door. Come little further you will get better food and services.

Believe me. I’m living around here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supapong Areeprasertkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
A lovely restaurant and cafe with a nice, open atmosphere and parking in front. The menu is interesting and the food is delicious.

The atmosphere is quite open, with plenty of photo spots both inside and outside.

The menu offers a wide variety of fusion dishes. My favorite dishes are the penne with tom yum sauce (dry), which is delicious and flavorful. The purple sweet potato soup is beautiful and flavorful. The confit duck is also very delicious and flavorful. I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: ครัวเห็นหมี see me kitchen

sample_reviews_en.text: A cafe in the Phutthamonthon Sai 1 area, a little way into the alley, the atmosphere is quite nice. The shop is not very big, the high ceiling makes it not stuffy. We ordered the grilled pork neck flower salad, decorated with many flowers, the flowers are edible too. The taste is delicious, not too spicy. The flower pollen lemon soda drink is sour, sweet, fragrant, refreshing. The Honey Lemon cake is also delicious, not too greasy. There is ample parking, medium price.
sample_reviews_en.author: สราวุฒิ จินดาประเสริฐ

restaurants.name: MYCHEF BOX RAMINTRA (RESERVATION ONLY)
restaurants.address:

88/4 Ram Intra 13 Alley, Lane 8, Anusawari, Bang Khen, Bangkok 10220, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
"A hidden Chef's Table in the Ramintra area: Luxurious flavors in a friendly, homey atmosphere."
• Highlights: Emphasis on ultimate privacy, as reservations are required in advance (Private Dining). Perfect for celebrating special occasions.
• Food: Fusion and European cuisine, premium ingredients like a 5-star hotel, yet with easy-to-eat and meticulously prepared flavors. The meat and pasta dishes are exceptional.
• Atmosphere: Warm and friendly. The chef pays attention to every detail, as if cooking for family.
• Price: Excellent value considering the quality and exclusive service.

The food was incredibly delicious. The chef truly made it from the heart. Hearing him talk about the fish almost brought me to tears. Thank you for opening such a wonderful restaurant! 🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirun Boonpasuk

sample_reviews_en.text: The tables are arranged in a long table style. All the food is delicious, including soups, salads, pasta, and steaks. While the prices might be a bit high, it's well worth it. The menu adjusts based on the availability of fresh ingredients, so you always get to eat dishes with the freshest ingredients. The chef and his partner are also very friendly and provide excellent service. However, the restaurant is reservation-only as there are only about 8 seats, except if there are seats available, in which case walk-ins are welcome (but the seats further inside might be a bit hot because they're near the grill).
sample_reviews_en.author: Wan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chef's Table in Ramintra Soi offers premium ingredients at amazing prices.

The highlight is the Wagyu beef paired with Chao Phraya river prawns, offering a delightful combination of tender, juicy beef and succulent prawns, served with a flavorful seafood dipping sauce. This dish is a must-try, earning 5 stars.

Next recommended is the Panna cotta dessert, with its bouncy texture, served with strawberry sauce and crispy honey – a perfect ending to the meal.

Reservations are highly recommended as the restaurant limits seating capacity per day.
sample_reviews_en.author: ARM Siripat

sample_reviews_en.text: It's good!!! The shop is in a small alley, like a village (you have to book in advance). I didn't think there would be a shop in here. When I arrived, the chef was very welcoming. The taste of the food is considered good. It's definitely to the Thai palate (I think). The ingredients are very good. For the price, it's very worthwhile. I consider it another quality shop. Delicious, reasonable price, and the chef is fun to talk to. Very knowledgeable. Excellent presentation. I like it. I'll definitely come back to try the rest of the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanon Deewong

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd give it a million stars! Everything was perfect, from the meticulous and dedicated chef who was so lovely, to the excellent service, the amazing taste of the food, the beautiful presentation, the clean atmosphere, and the affordable prices. They use high-quality ingredients from Thai farmers. It was incredibly good value! Every dish was wow-worthy. Thank you so much for creating such delicious and wonderful food for the world! 🤩🥇👍 I recommend making a reservation in advance. Come and support the chef! ❤
sample_reviews_en.author: Wip Cha

sample_reviews_en.text: I loved the atmosphere of the restaurant; it has a chef's table vibe, but reservations only, no walk-ins. It feels very private, as they only seat 8 people, limiting the number of guests. The food was delicious and flavorful. The strawberry panna cotta for dessert was incredibly smooth (they also have a mango version, depending on your preference). I highly recommend trying it. Both the chef and the owner are very friendly. You have to try it! ☺️☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Kingkarn Ratanawijit

sample_reviews_en.text: The chef provided excellent service, sharing stories about the ingredients they were preparing. The food was incredibly delicious! You absolutely have to reserve the river prawns because the restaurant explained they have to catch them themselves. The ribs and corn were a perfect combination. The smoked salmon was tender, and the truffle-infused mashed potatoes were smooth and delicious, pairing perfectly with the sauce. I loved it! ☺️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Annaya Kawepukdi

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a great restaurant with delicious food and a wonderful atmosphere. It's a chef's table style restaurant where you can watch the chef prepare your meal. The decor is beautiful, and they use fresh fish from Thai waters that the chef catches himself, resulting in exceptional flavor. The chef provides excellent service, engaging in conversation and offering helpful recommendations. Reservations are highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirasit Gosiyapan

restaurants.name: TWELVE BAR & CAFE'
restaurants.address:

234/10 Lat Phrao 12 Alley, Lane 2, Chom Phon, จตุจักร Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This small restaurant is beautifully decorated with a great atmosphere, perfect for small groups of 2-6 people for drinks or a meal. I highly recommend trying it.
The restaurant is divided into two zones: the glass dome zone is open during the day, while the indoor zone opens in the evening around 5 pm. The food here is delicious, thanks to the owner's love of food and their own recipes, as well as the chef's excellent cooking skills.
Recommended dishes include crispy pork belly with chili and salt, and spicy pork ribs with cumin leaves – the flavors are bold and delicious. The thin-crust truffle pizza and Hawaiian pizza are also excellent without needing any extra seasoning. They also have an interesting item on the menu: grilled pork neck, which I must try sometime.
There is a corkage fee of 500 baht per bottle if you bring your own wine.
Reservations are recommended.
There is no parking in front of the restaurant; you have to park in the parking area provided by the restaurant (the entrance is a bit narrow). There is parking for about 10-12 cars, and the restaurant provides a golf cart to transport you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kosit Boonroungkaw

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to Twelve Bar and Restaurant on my birthday (31/08/2023). I wasn't sure if I would go there at first because it was a rainy night. But I didn't regret going.

I ordered ..
- BBQ pork ribs. The dish was quite juicy. The aroma of the seasonings enhances the flavor of the meat.
- Spaghetti with dried chili and bacon. It was also delicious. It's not very oily. The flavor was spicy but not overpowering, and the bacon was tasty but not overly crunchy.
- Chicken wing. It was pretty crisped, but the meat inside was tender and wonderful.
- The last one was Hawaiian pizza. The crust is soft, and in the middle was a load of cheese and pineapple. I prefer more crispy and less cheese on this dish.

Overall, I pretty much like this restaurant. The food was tasty, and the owner was very friendly. She's very nice and good-looking. She paid attention to every little detail. I would recommend it to anyone who is looking for a nice place with a great atmosphere and nice old classic live music.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanidapha Sunthonhong

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant has a great atmosphere and is close to my workplace. It's perfect for a relaxing after-work hangout with friends! 🍷✨

The atmosphere is chill, they have wine promotions, and the food is delicious (unfortunately, I didn't take pictures!). Another thing that impressed me was the owner's excellent service; they constantly greeted and checked on customers, making everyone feel very welcome.

If you're looking for a chill after-work spot with delicious food, great wine, and warm service, I highly recommend this place! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: LA Choppers

sample_reviews_en.text: Twelve Bar & Cafe is a beautiful cafe in the Ladprao area 🍽️ 🍰🍹. The atmosphere is great, shady, and the decor is stunning – every corner is perfect for photos! Content creators, you absolutely can't miss this place! Twelve Bar is located on Ladprao Soi 12 and has parking available. It's near the MRT Ladprao station, just an 800-meter walk into the soi. Their crispy pork and pizza are amazing! The staff are lovely, and the owner is incredibly kind and friendly. Highly recommended! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Wilaiporn Khruasri

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is truly amazing. The atmosphere surpasses Sukhumvit. The entrance is a bit challenging due to the narrow street, but once you get to the restaurant, it's even more impressive because of its beautifully designed setting. Every dish was delicious, and the ambiance was wonderful in every corner. The owner is lovely, making already delicious food even better with their exceptional service. Since it's so close to home, I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Napissara Chaturongakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant's ambiance is incredibly meticulously designed. Walking in, I was amazed, especially by the transparent, air-conditioned dome on a day with 38-degree Celsius weather. The food was delicious, every dish was great, especially the sea bass steak – it was perfectly cooked! We sat there for 6 hours – imagine how much we loved it! (Let the pictures speak for themselves!) I will definitely be back. Highly recommended! ♥️😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Thatchakorn Prutnoppadol

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lovely little place secret garden style. Had the chicken and ginger spicy - and it was - that's the way I like it. 120 Bhat portion perfect as don't like too much on a plate. Tried the local YES beer nice slightly lemony IPA. Was gently served by the beautiful Yuday of Siam-Burma mix. They have a very cool part glassed off but I preferred the outside warmth and fans. Music is laid back jazz/soul.
PS the cocktails very good!
sample_reviews_en.author: Grant Dyer

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is something else. The atmosphere is magical. The food is better than delicious. The service is the next level. I’ve been to some expensive restaurants that call themselves “the highest level”, but those are nothing compared to the Twelve bar. My deepest appreciation to the owner and to the staff of this magical place 🙏🏼 I haven’t seen anything better!
sample_reviews_en.author: Karina Alek

restaurants.name: ไก่ย่างแซ่บสะท้าน Kai Yang Zeep Sa Than
restaurants.address:

561 Thanon Si Wiang, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Absolutely amazing Thai food! We came here hungry and everything we ordered was seriously delicious. The flavors are authentic, bold and perfectly balanced, the ingredients taste fresh, and the portions are great for the price.

The grilled dishes in particular were fantastic — juicy, smoky and full of flavor. The staff were also super friendly and welcoming, which made the whole experience even better.

Definitely one of our favorite Thai food experiences in Bangkok so far. Great food, great value and a place we would absolutely come back to. Highly recommended! 🇹🇭🔥
sample_reviews_en.author: Jannik Wegenast

sample_reviews_en.text:
Air-conditioned somtum (papaya salad) restaurant with grilled free-range chicken.
Delicious somtum, grilled chicken, and grilled pork neck.
Delicious tom yum. Nice atmosphere and good service.
Food comes out quickly.
The prices are a bit high but acceptable. The food is worth the price. The interior looks clean and tidy. The staff speaks English.
However, parking is a bit difficult (parking in front of the restaurant).
#AirConditionedSomtumBangRakCharoenKrung
sample_reviews_en.author: One’s Trips

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here after reading reviews because I wanted to eat delicious Isaan food.

I dropped in on a Sunday after 7 PM but was seated right away! There was a beer event going on, so we got lots of free beers, they printed a photo on the foam, and we received so many services without really understanding why – it was so much fun!

The food was delicious, and the waitresses were very kind.

It's a wonderful restaurant where you can easily bring children!
sample_reviews_en.author: kawakami kawakami

sample_reviews_en.text:
The end of my trip to Thailand

A great restaurant I discovered just when I was starting to feel tired of Thai food

They say Isan is the Jeolla Province of Thailand

The Isan-style Som Tum, regular Som Tum, chicken wings, Isan-style pork soup, and Tom Yum Goong—every dish was delicious

Especially if you like Jeolla Province cuisine, you must try the Isan-style Som Tum.
sample_reviews_en.author: youhwan pak

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a clean and comfortable atmosphere, good service, and the food comes out relatively quickly. It's suitable for dining with family or friends.

Overall, it's good value for money. I will definitely come back again if I have the chance. Highly recommend it for those who love Northeastern Thai food and grilled chicken. ❤️🐔🌶️
sample_reviews_en.author: PYT PY

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant I have to say, and I tried it for the first time and the taste was amazing, I wasn't disappointed at all. For anyone looking for delicious and spicy papaya salad and unique grilled chicken, I highly recommend this place. The atmosphere is comfortable and not cramped, and the staff are friendly and attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunny

sample_reviews_en.text: This place gives out free food for 5 star reviews making it's rating totally undeserved and fraudulent. The food is very much average and the service whilst pleasant a little unprofessional (the serve needlessly topped up my glass from my beer bottle but overflowed it spilling it everywhere - I prefer to pour my own beer).
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Baron

sample_reviews_en.text:
A friendly and clean restaurant. The air conditioning works well, and it is cool inside.

It was my first time trying the Shrimp and Corn Som Tum, and it was delicious.

We ordered Shrimp Pad Thai, Morning Glory, Chicken (Half), and Shrimp and Corn Som Tum, and everything was tasty!
sample_reviews_en.author: David Seo

restaurants.name: Sushimai Huamak
restaurants.address:

118 Soi Ramkhamhaeng 32, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stopped by and wasn't disappointed at all! The ingredients were fresh, clean, and the quality exceeded the price. The sushi pieces were just the right size, the flavors were well-balanced, the rice was soft and not too firm, and the salmon was fresh, sweet, fatty, and melted in my mouth. What I liked most was that the portions were generous for the price, allowing me to try many different dishes.

✨ What impressed me most was the restaurant's attention to detail. The plating was surprisingly good, and the service was friendly. The food came out quickly, and I didn't have to wait long. The atmosphere in the restaurant is simple and comfortable, perfect for a light snack or a full meal.

Recommended dishes: Salmon sushi, mixed sashimi rice bowl, and various rolls. Every piece is worth it!

The restaurant is located in the Hua Mak area, easy to find. If you're nearby or passing by, I highly recommend trying it. I'm sure you'll love it as much as I do! 💕
sample_reviews_en.author: snhinter coordinator

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I stopped by this restaurant because I saw they had a huge selection of Japanese food at reasonable prices, especially their sushi, which was incredibly tempting. However, I was in a hurry today and only tried a few pieces. I'll definitely be back to try more next time!

For my main course, I ordered grilled pork steak served with Japanese sesame salad. The pork was fragrant, tender, and had a rich flavor. It paired perfectly with the sesame salad, which was dressed with Japanese dressing. Adding Japanese rice made it even more satisfying and filling. The rice was soft, fragrant, and went perfectly with the pork.

The restaurant's atmosphere was lovely, clean, and the soft music made it very comfortable. The restrooms were also clean, and there's parking right next to the restaurant, so you don't have to worry about finding a spot.

Overall, it was great! Delicious, filling, and worth the price. Next time, I'll do a full sushi review!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nawat A

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came here because of Seventeen Right Here Concert, this place near Rajamangala Stadium!!

The food is so nice, especially the 🥩Wagyu Beef Salad & 🥟Chicken Gyoza 😍😍 10/10🫶🏻 Would like to try some more

Price are reasonable , the price are below than the restaurant from my hometown Penang, Malaysia. Not very small portion, can order more to share it with friends.

They also prepared phone holder on each table,so sweet.🤣The female staff can speak a little bit mandarin, and the owner can speak fluent English and he's kind😆and cute too hahaha💯👍🏻

It also provide free wifi and charging plug~~ 🤩especially suitable for foreigner fans to watch concert nearby !! Overall ,I recommended this restaurant👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Sharon Ooi

sample_reviews_en.text:
A word of caution before confirming your order, as I made a mistake and they exceptionally agreed to change it.

But double-check to avoid any problems.
Simple and efficient, the best sushi in the area!
It's clean, fresh, and fast.
A very professional sushi bar, and the staff are absolutely lovely 😊💕😊
The small miso soup is perfectly balanced and seasoned 😋
The dishes are flavorful and generous, sometimes too much so, like the California rolls—they're so big you have to eat them in several sittings 😳
The fresh wasabi has the character of a true samurai 🤪
So go for it without hesitation ☺️☺️☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: MikoThai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've never been disappointed eating at this branch. The food tastes great, it's clean, and the service is fast. The owner is lovely, provides excellent service, and is attentive. My go-to dish every time I visit is the pork steak; the salad dressing it comes with is delicious.
The cheesy gyoza is also juicy, and the spicy salmon salad helps to balance out the richness – it's a perfect combination!
sample_reviews_en.author: Phannita

sample_reviews_en.text: It exceeded my expectations so much! The food tasted great, the ingredients were fresh, and the salmon wasn't thinly sliced ​​– it was a full, satisfying piece. The soup was delicious, and the noodles were perfectly chewy. Overall, I give it a perfect score, no complaints! A great place to stop by after visiting the hospital ♥️
sample_reviews_en.author: Tatcha P (Tulip)

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is beautiful, clean, and has a nice, relaxing atmosphere. However, it's not very noticeable, so cars might miss it. Parking is limited, but if you come during off-peak hours, you can easily find a parking spot. There's also a market nearby where you can park.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chutapong Chandilokchod

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is lovely and the food is delicious.
The pork shabu shabu is amazing!
The thinly sliced ​​beef is perfectly tender.
The marinated salmon is good, and the cold noodles are also good.
The staff are very friendly.
I'll definitely come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Parn Winyukul

restaurants.name: KFC Caltex Theparak OB
restaurants.address:

Caltex, Thepharak Rd, Thepharak, Mueang Samut Prakan District, Samut Prakan 10270, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I was very upset by the behavior of the staff at this restaurant. Around 2 AM, my family and I arrived for dinner. After a while, someone informed the restaurant that something had gone missing from our table. It appeared to be a phone. A staff member walked over with the phone and kept looking towards our table, as if we had taken it. This continued until we finished our meal and were leaving. On the way, the staff member continued to look at us with the same expression. It's understandable to be suspicious, but the restaurant has CCTV cameras. Please review the footage before judging others. The staff member's gaze was inappropriate. They could have simply approached us to inquire, instead of acting as if they had taken the phone. During working hours, staff members shouldn't gossip about customers. I would like to know how the restaurant will address this issue with staff members who behave in this manner. What the staff member did was playing with people's feelings. I am very disappointed with some of the staff at this branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: nicky Kaewchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
This KFC branch at the Caltex gas station is a convenient rest stop.

• Taste and Quality: The fried chicken is delicious and meets the standard, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, typical of KFC. The service is generally good and quick.

• Restaurant Atmosphere: The restaurant is quite large and spacious, with plenty of seating options. It doesn't feel cramped. The interior is clean and pleasant.

• Parking and Accessibility: Conveniently located in a gas station, but parking spaces might be limited during peak hours or lunchtime. At other times, parking is usually easy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kornpapop Arunpan

sample_reviews_en.text: I just visit that KFC yesterday for takeaway myself and I order as per show in first photo for 199THB bucket. And after just take a way to my room and after sometimes I open and saw the chicken is wrong it’s not a same as I order. Then I go back to return but that time it’s close. For evidence you can see in first picture which one I order and another photos can see which one I get it. I order as shown in photo leg pieces but I got Brest pieces. It’s so bad to see that. I don’t know who’s responsible for that. And I wasted my 199THB
sample_reviews_en.author: Parvinder Singh

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, I came to eat with my family around 2 a.m. It seems like someone lost something near the table where we were sitting, and then he came looking for it and looked at the camera. He assumed it was a phone, because a call came in and it connected. But instead of the staff approaching and asking nicely if they had seen anything, they glared at us and our family with inappropriate looks from the moment we sat down to eat until we left the restaurant. This has left me and my family feeling dissatisfied with the staff's actions.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mingkwan Udomsuk

sample_reviews_en.text:
I usually buy from this branch and have never had a problem. Today, I bought 6 pieces of Zesty Wings for 99 baht. When I got home and opened the box, there were only 5 pieces of chicken. The staff should be more careful. I'm writing this review so they can be more cautious and improve.

Update: Today, March 12, 2025, I went to buy again and informed the staff that the chicken was incomplete last time. They gave me the branch's phone number and apologized. Today I received 7 pieces of Zesty Wings as compensation.
Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: SunnyKwan แม่พันวา

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible. We ordered at 3:50 AM. The staff said it would take 15-20 minutes. We didn't mind and sat waiting. It wasn't until 4:35 AM that our order arrived. The staff didn't call us; one person just placed the order down, and another staff member said, "Isn't this order supposed to be called?" I was so angry. Normally, they're supposed to call customers when their orders are ready, right? We waited forever, even though there were only a few people in the store. Not a single apology. Awful experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนพร อดทน

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were unhelpful, standing silently, ignoring customers, not mentioning promotions, or showing any willingness to serve. I ordered a cocktail but didn't receive it. There was a complete lack of attentiveness; the store wasn't busy with customers, and when I went to pick up my order, they just walked away. Another staff member had to ask if my order was ready. I paid for my item but received this kind of service.
sample_reviews_en.author: พรทิพย์ ภู่โต

sample_reviews_en.text: *The counter staff at the lower market are gossiping about customers.* They say, "Orders by phone are never prepared; you have to wait in front of the branch anyway. If you don't call to order, they always say we haven't pre-fried them and you have to wait 15 minutes. They're never ready. Terrible. A waste of time. Even if you call to order, they won't put the order in a box so you can pay and pick it up right away."
sample_reviews_en.author: ton -1

restaurants.name: Birdhouse Cafe & Bar
restaurants.address:

3 ยูนิต RQ.7, ซอย ประชาคดี 3, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Had a great time at Bird House. The cocktails were really good—well mixed, flavorful, and easy to enjoy. The service was smooth and attentive, and the staff made the whole experience comfortable and welcoming. Great atmosphere for relaxing and enjoying drinks. Would definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Foodies by S&Y

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was really not that good. My dish was 80% rice, and 10% garnish, and 10% is supposed to be the salmon, but the salmon tasted not fresh anyway, also was really salty.

The premise is nice tho with grass and space. But the place was pumping kinda bad top 40 music …..  -_-
sample_reviews_en.author: S L

sample_reviews_en.text:
Love this place man. I once dreamed of a place where a bar is next to a playground and I have finally found it.

Food is great, drinks are cold, kids have fun. Recipe for success.

I wish I can gatekeep this, but I rather they do well and never close down ❤️🔥
sample_reviews_en.author: Tang K.

sample_reviews_en.text: Cannot recommend this place enough, the staff are friendly and helpful, the food & drinks are delicious and the atmosphere is great. There is indoor and outdoor dining both offer comfortable places to enjoy your food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Connor Blake

sample_reviews_en.text: Food, coffee and cocktails a calming vibrance with friendly service. I personally only got a coffee, but the food looks great for a nice lunch or breakfast (by breakfast I do not mean European or American breakfast)
sample_reviews_en.author: Ski

sample_reviews_en.text: My kids love it and we come here for meals every week! The food and drinks are delicious in this relaxed atmosphere, and I really enjoy it. The staff are friendly and kind. I highly recommend it!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Hitomi S

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop has two floors and is like a separate house. They have many taps of draft beer, a nice atmosphere, and are perfect for socializing. The salads are pre-dressed, and the coffee is good too.
sample_reviews_en.author: N N (Pom)

sample_reviews_en.text: Love coming here in the morning for coffee and in the afternoon with the kids! Absolute hideaway from the busy streets of Sukhumvit! Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sira Chainapong

restaurants.name: Otto Italian Restaurant
restaurants.address:

11th Floor, MUU BANGKOK, Thong Lo, Klongton, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This will be my last time visiting this place, and I won’t recommend it to anyone. The food was mediocre and unimpressive. The service was terrible—both the waiter and waitress seemed confused.

After we finished our meal, my friend ordered tiramisu, and we expected my birthday cake to be brought out along with it. However, my cake had a bit of glitter on it. They refused to light the candle for my celebration, giving the ridiculous excuse that it would “mess up” the restaurant. The glitter was already stuck on the cake, so their reasoning made no sense. Even if I blew on it, the glitter wouldn’t fly away.

To make things worse, they told me that if I wanted to light a candle and blow it out, I would have to pay a fine. I found this completely unnecessary and tried to be as reasonable as possible. My friend even ordered an extra tiramisu just so I could have something to blow a candle on, but in the end, the waitress served it without a candle.

One of the waitresses was kind enough to say I could light one candle, but this was an important day for me, and the whole situation left me feeling upset.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwanchanok Khunanukhun

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Otto was one of the highlights of my stay at MUU Bangkok Hotel.

The restaurant offers a refined yet approachable dining experience, combining contemporary Italian cuisine with a warm and inviting atmosphere. The interior feels elegant without being overly formal, making it suitable for both special occasions and relaxed dinners.

What impressed me most was the attention to detail in every dish. The ingredients were fresh, the presentation was thoughtful, and the flavors felt balanced and authentic. Each course was beautifully executed while remaining comforting and enjoyable.

The service was attentive and professional throughout the meal, with staff who were knowledgeable about the menu and genuinely welcoming.

Whether you are staying at MUU Bangkok or simply looking for a quality Italian restaurant in Thonglor, Otto is definitely worth a visit. A wonderful combination of good food, stylish surroundings, and warm hospitality.
sample_reviews_en.author: RattoWanderlust

sample_reviews_en.text:
A well deserved 5 stars for Otto Italian Restaurant in the Mu Hotel.

We were a table of 10 and the team were very, very attentive and friendly but not intrusive.

The best carbonara we’ve ever had and we know our pasta! Steak was so buttery and the way they did the spinach infused with the garlic and the broccoli so garlicky.

We enjoyed our drinks including a delicious fresh watermelon drink and the classic cocktails we all know and love.

Also the ambience was lovely. Intimate, modern and good music.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paris S

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything here was exceptional. I went there to have dinner with my friends, and we were unanimously impressed. The food was delicious, very unique and the wine was great, perfect selection with a very good price. The best part of this place was the service. The staff members made sure that we had a great time. Moreover, their photography skill was on point! We had a memorable and will definitely come back :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Sugar Wong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Normally I don't like Italian food, but Otto Italian Restaurant inspired me to change my mind when I made the reservation for my wife's birthday dinner on Sunday. The food tastes good and I'm really impressed.
Most especially, K. Fang, who gave us the expert service and the surprise birthday cake for my wife, is excellent, as is the chef. I will surely back.  Thank you ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Chana Nuchniyom

sample_reviews_en.text: Otto Italian is going to be my favorite secret spot. My husband and I was going to order Mixed Seafood Grill but told that it was sold out. We were disappointed from the start but the seafood dishes that we ordered, Calamari Fritti, Neri Con Polpo, and Grilled Gamberetti, were absolutely delicious. We'll definitely come back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Junko S

sample_reviews_en.text: This Italian restaurant in Thonglor, located in the MOU hotel, offers a calm and private atmosphere. The staff provides attentive service, and the food is served on time. Overall, the taste is good, making it suitable for parties with friends or dates. Parking is available in the Eight Thonglor building.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suparat Juna

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff are so friendly, especially khun Boom she was so kind and provided us excellent service! This is our first time here but we are very impressed. The food was amazing and the restaurant was great! Love the design and decoration everything. Would recommend this place for dinner 👍🏽 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Few natcha
