sample_reviews_en.text: Today I was wandering around Ladprao Wanghin and suddenly had a craving for Korean food. I searched for Korean restaurants near me and found this one. It's a small place with about 6-7 tables. At first, I was a little hesitant, but then I saw a sign saying "Traditional Korean Food," so I stepped in. The restaurant is small and cute, with comfortable seating. They have a variety of dishes to choose from. You can grill the food yourself or have them grill it for you (I was a bit concerned about ventilation if I grilled it myself, but today I asked them to grill it for me because I still had other things to do). Let's look at the food! Today I ordered for 4 people, but it felt like 10! Overall, I'd give it an 8.5 out of 10. It was great!
sample_reviews_en.author: เสียเงินชิมแทนเธอ by Pikk

sample_reviews_en.text: I have been to numerous Korean restaurants in the Sukhumvit area and I have to say that this is the best Korean restaurant I have been to in Bangkok! I was so impressed by how authentic it was and having lived in South Korea, I have set my …
sample_reviews_en.author: The Traveling Pug

sample_reviews_en.text: The price is well worth the generous amount of side dishes. Every new customer is surprised by how delicious all the side dishes are. The main menu features authentic Korean dishes, many of which I've never tried before (though I've seen …
sample_reviews_en.author: patawat watakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The meal was amazing! 12 side dishes, so much food! And it was authentic traditional Korean food. I was so full and it was delicious! The staff were very attentive. It felt just like I was actually in Korea.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chutima Pongpanichnukul

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but I especially loved the abundance of side dishes. The portions were huge, so be careful not to overflow the table! 🤣🤣 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Saeleung N.

sample_reviews_en.text: The service and atmosphere are okay, but the food is too salty. The side dishes are okay, but the food I ordered was too salty, so I left it.
sample_reviews_en.author: 중심

sample_reviews_en.text: Here, they serve incredibly generous portions of appetizers and side dishes. Overall, I was very impressed and will definitely come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Flower Studio Bkk

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the service was excellent, and there were plenty of side dishes. I loved this restaurant, it's fantastic!
sample_reviews_en.author: Km Moblie

restaurants.name: Ban Phanfa
restaurants.address:

591 Phra Sumen Rd, Wat Bowon Niwet, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today, I had the opportunity to try Baan Phan Fah, and I must say, I was impressed from the moment I stepped inside. The overall atmosphere is comfortable, airy, and spacious, perfect for a relaxing meal or even a business meeting.
The dishes I tried today were "Beef Noodle Soup" and "Lemon Tea." The beef noodle soup was definitely the highlight. The broth was rich and flavorful, with a distinct beef aroma, but not overly greasy or heavy. The highlight is its unique taste, unlike any other restaurant; you can tell it's their own special recipe. The beef was tender, easy to chew, and paired perfectly with the broth.
The lemon tea was refreshing and just right, with a perfect balance of sweet and sour, helping to cut through the richness of the soup and making this a truly complete meal.
Overall, it's a high-quality Thai restaurant, both in terms of taste and atmosphere. If you like beef noodle soup or are looking for a comfortable place to dine in Bangkok, I highly recommend trying this place at least once. You won't be disappointed! 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Thinnaphop Po-iem

sample_reviews_en.text: I went for breakfast before heading to the Grand Palace. When I arrived, they were cleaning the courtyard. Maybe because I went so early, they said only Khao Soi was available, so that was the only thing I could eat! As for the taste... I honestly couldn't really tell if it tasted like anything, maybe because I didn't have an appetite in the morning or if I lost it because of the heat. The noodles were soggy, and I only ate the chicken leg and left most of the rest. It wasn't terrible, but it was just so-so. It's not worth making a special trip just to eat there. The staff were very friendly though.
sample_reviews_en.author: 박민지

sample_reviews_en.text: This establishment provides a truly delightful culinary experience. I savored the Khao Soi Beef, Tom Yum Kung noodles, and Green curry with naan.  Each dish was so delicious that the flavors linger in my memory.😋🤤👏 The authentic Thai flavors are a testament to the chef's skill. Every bite was a delightful and memorable experience. 💯🌟👍 The service was attentive and enhanced the overall dining experience.  I dined there around 4 pm, near closing time at 5 pm, so we were the only patrons. 🧑‍🍳🍜🇹🇭 I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone seeking an authentic taste of Thailand. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: DoubleB

sample_reviews_en.text: I’m so glad I tried this little gem it has the best Khao soi I think I’ve ever had. The owner/ family member of this family owned restaurant told us they have been using the same Khao soi recipe for 85+ years and I don’t doubt it. Staff are lovely and the food even better. Outside seating area is super nice however there was construction works happening right across, didn’t ruin any experience however jealous to those who can experience the natural street side with this Amazing resturant.
sample_reviews_en.author: maddox ecke

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I came to eat a famous restaurant in the district of Passafa Leela. The restaurant is in an ancient house over 185 years old. 🏡 very nice atmosphere. 🥰 food is also delicious. 👍 recommended menu is the beef noodle, strong taste, mellow 🍜. The Tom Yum Goong noodles 🦐 are very spicy. 🌶️ end with the fried Thai noodles with sticky noodles, 🍝 delicious. Who comes to this area to try? Next time, try the beef noodles 😊 #Ancient home #delicious #recommended #delicious #tasty #tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Theera Sukcharoen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lovely family run restaurant. We came here on our first night in Bangkok (stayed at Ayathorn Hotel) 1 min walk away and also our last night in Bangkok.
We had the green curry, Tom yum, pad Thai, fried pork with chili leaves, fried morning glory veg. Drinks are good too! Had a lemon ice tea. Prices are really good too.
The family that own it gave us mosquito spray and put the fan on us to help with mosquitoes
sample_reviews_en.author: Robyn Davies

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted decent. However, if the condition prevents the shop from opening, I wish they would close temporarily and reopen later. Due to construction, the floor was covered in dust and shoe prints, and the water in the restroom was not working. I had to wait for quite a while to pay because the owner was nowhere to be seen.
sample_reviews_en.author: 최근영

sample_reviews_en.text: This Thai restaurant serves delicious food at affordable prices. Their braised beef noodle soup in a hot pot is especially good. The elderly couple who own the place provide excellent service. There are large tables available, perfect for families or groups of friends. Parking is available in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cherry Nongnapasorn

restaurants.name: Royal Orchid Dining Experience, Thai Airways (Vibhavadi Branch)
restaurants.address:

89 Vibhavadi Rangsit Rd, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This cafeteria is located on the second floor of Thai Airways' headquarters. It's open from 7:00 AM to 2:00 PM. The main entrance is straight ahead, then enter the left building of the two buildings and take the stairs to the second floor. The other entrance is straight ahead, then turn left and walk a little further until you come to a ramp on your right. Follow that up to the second floor.
The cafeteria operates in a basic cafeteria style, so you order, carry your food to your seat, and clean up after yourself. However, there's also a Preferred Seat Menu, a set menu with a prefix of THB 699 per person, which includes full service.
The employee cafeteria is open to the public, so prices are low. Airplane enthusiasts will appreciate the scattered tables made from engine parts and wheel displays. The menu includes classic Thai dishes like pad thai and gapao rice, but for some reason, there are also a number of meaty dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: YOLO

sample_reviews_en.text:
#EmOshwithBest Today we present... "Chicken Cordon Bleu" served with French fries and steamed vegetables at the Aroi Lon Fah restaurant at Thai Airways International Public Company Limited's headquarters.

Chicken wrapped in ham and cheese, breaded and fried, served hot and freshly fried with gravy. So delicious! This dish is another signature dish of Thai Airways' kitchen. Pair it with smoked salmon Caesar salad and butterfly pea and lemon juice for an incredibly delicious meal. You'll want to fly! 55555 If you'd like to try it, head to TG's headquarters on Vibhavadi Rangsit Road. Open only on weekdays (Monday-Friday). 🍽️✈️💜🇹🇭
sample_reviews_en.author: Chinatorn Kai

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there yesterday because I wanted to try some of their dishes and enjoy the atmosphere, but when I arrived, there was nobody there. Only 1-2 tables were occupied, even though it was a special holiday in May 2023. Some of the monthly specials weren't available as advertised. I initially thought it would be like the YouTube videos, with lots of people, a lively atmosphere, and air conditioning. I ordered to eat in, but instead got my food to take home. It was confusing. Overall, the food was decent. I hope they improve their service a little because I want to come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arisara Piboonchaiyawat

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the cafeteria operated by Thai Airways. If you're visiting for the first time, you might not know which one it is, so in the photos I've provided, you'll see a building connected to a larger building with a fountain. The smaller building is the cafeteria, the first floor houses the Thai Airways merchandise shop, and the second floor houses the cafeteria and an ATM. Food prices are neither cheap nor expensive. Free water is provided, and you can order food at the cafeteria and pay at the cash register after receiving your food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eunjun Choi

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time here. They're open Monday to Friday, even on New Year's Eve and New Year's Day. The atmosphere is great, like being on an airplane. The food is impeccably delicious. The fresh shrimp Pad Thai was flavorful and the shrimp was perfectly chewy. The salad was also excellent. Every dish was served in generous portions, well worth the price. If I have the chance, I would definitely return. This is a restaurant from Thai Airways.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pasawut O.

sample_reviews_en.text: The Royal Orchid Dining Experience by Thai Airways offers a truly unique concept! The airplane-themed setting and comfortable seats make you feel like you’re dining in the sky. The Thai and international dishes are beautifully presented and full of flavor. Service is excellent, and prices are reasonable for the quality. A must-visit spot for those who love elegant and creative dining experiences. 🍽️✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Our_Discoveries5

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the Thai Airways employee cafeteria, but it's open to the public. The entrance is designed to resemble an airplane, as shown in the photo, and the seats inside are repurposed from actual Thai Airways seats.

While not extremely cheap, the prices are relatively low considering it's an employee cafeteria. The taste is decent.
sample_reviews_en.author: マンボウ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Spacious and the seats are fun!
They're using seats that were previously used on airplanes. I've been there twice now!
The first time it was too sweet.
The next time I went it was delicious.
I'm looking forward to seeing what it's like next time!
The parking lot is large and the restaurant is spacious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mai mai

restaurants.name: พงษ์เพชรหัวปลาหม้อไฟ
restaurants.address:

55 36 Ngamwongwan Rd, Thung Song Hong, Lak Si, Bangkok 10210, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The prices didn't match the menu; they added 10-20 baht to every item. They gave the reason that the new menu wasn't ready yet (but the POS system had already fixed it).
I'll change the star rating once the menu is fixed.

Food was prepared quickly.
Recommended dish: Fried pork belly.

Additional information from the restaurant's response:
1) I don't know which page the prices were updated on, but as of today (3 days later), the menu image still shows the incorrect prices compared to what was charged to the customer.
2) On the day I ate there, we were the only table ordering.
3) We received 3 menus; at least 2 had the same prices. I didn't check the price of the third one.
4) When ordering a new menu, don't you change all of them at once? Why do you have to order them in batches of 2?
sample_reviews_en.author: Saengchai Thitiolarn

sample_reviews_en.text: I met friends for a simple meal and arrived well before them. The owner was very kind and didn't pressure me, saying I could order even if it wasn't served yet, as they were worried the food would get cold and not taste good if I waited too long for my friends. They said the food came out quickly when my friends arrived. When my friends arrived, the food was out in less than 5 minutes. The food was delicious, with a moderate flavor. I liked that all the staff were friendly and provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supamon Aroonsrimorakot

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I had the chance to eat here after seeing a recommendation on Facebook! It was so delicious. The tom yum soup with grouper head was incredibly flavorful and satisfying. The marinated prawns were huge and super tasty. The atmosphere was great, especially in the evening with the lovely breeze. The service was excellent; I was impressed from the moment I got out of the car. They were very welcoming and chatty. I will definitely come back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: อัจฉราพร เทียมชัยภูมิ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fresh and clean food.
The spicy salads use real lime juice, giving them a zesty flavor.
All the stir-fried vegetables are excellent, not too salty. Highly recommended!
Today I ordered stir-fried kale with salted fish, and the flavor was just right.
The tom yum fish soup was also delicious, not fishy at all.
The kids' favorite dish is the deep-fried pork belly with fish sauce. Don't miss it!
Coming around 6 PM is perfect, with a cool breeze.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manixnoi PNS

sample_reviews_en.text: Tom Yum Sea Bass (280 baht): The Tom Yum soup was packed with ingredients, the fish was fresh, tender, and delicious. The Stir-fried Morning Glory with Chili (60 baht): The vegetables were crispy and the flavor was good. The owner was friendly, the place was clean, and the prices were reasonable considering the portion size and quality of the food. Parking is available at the roundabout behind or next to the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ayumu Saruwatari

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Grouper head hot pot (thick/clear broth) 380 baht. Large pot, strong heat, rich seasoning, no fishy smell at all.
- Steamed mussels, large size, very clean, spicy dipping sauce 120 baht.
- Stir-fried bitter melon with egg, slightly bitter, fresh and delicious 90 baht.

Good atmosphere, music playing, parking available next to the restaurant, good service, reasonable prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawarisa Boonkoy

sample_reviews_en.text: #PongphetFishHeadHotPot #A La Carte Their signature dish is fish head, meat, and eggs in a hot pot. They offer a wide variety of dishes including stews, stir-fries, curries, fried dishes, and salads – everything is delicious. They have rice porridge and steamed rice. There's a huge menu and they also serve alcoholic beverages. #Delicious #HighlyRecommended 🤤🤤 #Happyboy💯
sample_reviews_en.author: Natee Korsanan

sample_reviews_en.text:
🥚 Steamed Seafood Egg Custard: Incredibly soft and smooth texture, with a rich and savory flavor. Large prawns and big pieces of squid make for a perfectly delicious combination.

🐟 Clear Tom Yum Fish Head Soup: A flavorful and tangy broth, easy to drink. The fish head is fresh and odorless.

🦪 Mussels: Served fresh and large, with a spicy seafood dipping sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jittraporn Moonchaisuk

restaurants.name: Grill EN Izakaya
restaurants.address:

Ratchaphruek Frontage Rd, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This izakaya has a relaxed and friendly atmosphere, a decent selection of food, and excellent service.

I've driven past many times, wanting to stop by, but it was always overlooked. Luckily, it was open during the New Year period, so I was able to visit.

Ordering is convenient; you can scan to order and see the total price.
- The sukiyaki set (pork and beef) is around 200 baht. It comes complete with dipping sauces, including an egg yolk (edible raw) or regular sukiyaki sauce. What I really liked was the delicious soup.
- The cucumber salad was tasty.
- The tofu salad was a good size.
- The cold noodles were also good.
- The salmon sashimi was cut into large pieces, or you can order the 300/500 gram portions if you have a big appetite.
- The tuna larb was very flavorful and delicious.
- The grilled fish with roe was good.

Overall, the service was great, the food came quickly, and the prices were excellent – ​​not expensive at all. They also had promotions on alcoholic beverages like beer.

I will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: attpocari

sample_reviews_en.text: The meat was tender and delicious, they also had yukke (spicy minced meat). The beef fried rice was incredibly tasty. The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, with an outdoor seating area that was very relaxing on the cool day I went. There was no grilling smoke smell, and there was parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Haru.

sample_reviews_en.text: The quality of the pork set was much better than expected. Fresh, clean, delicious, and a good price. The staff were attentive. However, the music and traffic on the road were a bit loud. Other than that, everything was great. I will definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akira Petit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Grilled Beef and Pork Set 1: Unexpectedly delicious.
Three dipping sauces available: seafood, spicy Thai dipping sauce (jaew), and yakiniku.
Nice atmosphere, chill roadside location. Most importantly, the price is good.
A huge selection of drinks!
sample_reviews_en.author: Siratirat Dabbhasuta

sample_reviews_en.text:
The grilled beef is good, tender, and delicious. The pork set is also great. I come back here very often because it's close to home, the prices are reasonable, and they have beer promotions.
The restaurant is perfect for chilling and chatting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rainy Talk

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried it because it's close to home. The quality of the meat, considering the price, is quite good. Sitting outdoors, there were no mosquitoes because they have mosquito traps. There weren't many staff members, but the service was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puncharat Pichaipatworakul

sample_reviews_en.text: This is another great izakaya. The prices are reasonable, the meat is delicious with many cuts to choose from, and they have draft beer. It's located by the roadside and doesn't have air conditioning. Definitely a place I'll be back to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wimonphan M

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small izakaya near my house, nice atmosphere, not crowded.
The meat was incredibly delicious ❤️❤️
All the dipping sauces were excellent, the beer was good, and they had a 3+1 promotion, ice cold.
The staff were lovely and attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paweennuch Chomklin

restaurants.name: Isan Rod Ded
restaurants.address:

3, 5/6 Rang Nam Alley, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.author: 范曉儀

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted very bland, like they only used MSG. The wait was extremely long; I expected it to be delicious. Even busy restaurants have much better food queuing systems. I waited from when it wasn't raining, through the rain, and through the rain stopping, and still hadn't received all my dishes. Tables that came later got their food first, which was confusing. There's a complete lack of attention to the order of food preparation and taste. It's like they're just making food to sell to foreigners. I'm giving it one star because the staff provided good service; everything else is beyond that.
sample_reviews_en.author: Just min

sample_reviews_en.text: We spotted this place on our way to the hotel and decided to grab a bite tonight. It's a local eatery, mostly frequented by locals. There's no fancy ambiance or air conditioning; it serves Thai home-style dishes with a wide variety and a strong wok hei (wok aroma). We ordered six or seven dishes, and everything was delicious and to our liking. It was the most satisfying meal we had here; we ate non-stop. Including drinks, it cost a little over 60 yuan per person.
sample_reviews_en.author: Z Z

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but the staff was a big factor. Last time, I asked a young woman to bring my check, but even though there was change to be paid, she just handed me the money and didn't bring it back, instead leaning on the table and fiddling with her nails. She acted like tips were expected and had a bad attitude. No matter how good the food is, I've lost all desire to go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: emi

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're working or sightseeing in the Soi Rangnam area and craving delicious, spicy Northeastern Thai food, this is the place to go. Their papaya salad, grilled beef, nam tok (spicy beef salad), larb (spicy minced meat salad), pork bone soup, and grilled pork neck are all incredibly tasty. I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: สมชาย สุภิญโญกุล

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a restaurant serving Isaan (Northeast Thai) cuisine that's been around for decades (lol)!

You order by writing your order on a piece of paper and handing it to the staff, but it seems like you can order additional items verbally.

The prices are reasonable, so I recommend this restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponta Tanukida

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food here is delicious. There’s this grilled meat dish served with their special sauce, absolutely amazing!
There was also a liver dish I didn’t take a photo of, but it was outstanding as well. It was so good that I ended up eating a lot of rice with it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason Nguyen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Home-style Thai food, reasonably priced, with small and large portions.

The pork neck is delicious and cheap, a must-order!

We ordered 5 dishes + 2 servings of white rice + 2 large bottles of Leo beer for 710 baht.

I'd love to come back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Linda

restaurants.name: The Mani Bar and Grill
restaurants.address:

18 Sukhumvit 4 Alley, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Mani Bar and Grill: A High-End Gem Elevated by Amazing Staff
Stepping into The Mani Bar and Grill is like discovering the city's best-kept secret—it is, without a doubt, a true gem. This establishment sets the absolute standard for a high-end bar experience, blending sophistication with genuine warmth.
The atmosphere and service are flawless. The music is pitch-perfect—high-quality and expertly curated, yet never loud, allowing for relaxed conversation. This is the ideal spot when you want pure class and a relaxed environment, free from any kind of disturbing scene.
What truly elevates The Mani, however, are the incredible staff members, especially Gwen and Nick. They are the heart of this bar. Their service is genuinely nice, sincere, and attentive, demonstrating a level of professionalism that is increasingly rare. They ensure every guest feels welcomed and valued.
If you are looking for a refined, top-tier experience where the cocktails are superb and the service is even better, look no further. The Mani Bar and Grill, thanks to people like Gwen and Nick, is simply the best in town.
sample_reviews_en.author: V Jadhav

sample_reviews_en.text:
First visit to have something to eat. Decided on the Australian steak, with black peppercorn sauce. Ordered a Coke. Sat outside to enjoy the evening.

Coke arrived no place mat, every time I took a drink, water dripping all the time.

Steak arrived, really disappointed. Jacket potato covered in cheese, couple of vegetables, and a little dessert bowl with the pepper sauce.

Poured the sauce onto the steak and it was really watery, no thickness to it. Cut into the steak and it was a really cheap cut of meat, pepper sauce was tasteless.

Overall a very bad meal. Only thing good was having a cigarette outside waiting for this attempt at a steak meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: craig Read

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was absolutely terrible. Everything we got was cold, not even room temperature, cold to the touch. The steak we ordered was literally raw and cold, we asked for medium. When we showed the waiter she offered to cook it more for us, after it came back it was still raw. The picture below is the steak after it was cooked more. The service was not the best either, the food took a very long time as well as getting the bill. Luckily the Maison hotel resolved the bill afterwards after we told the front desk about it, but if we were not guests I'm not sure what the outcome would have been.
sample_reviews_en.author: John M

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wow!
We popped in for a cocktail on our way out and had such a great experience. Kim, our server, was very attentive and showed us to a lovely seat facing the road—an amazing spot for people-watching.
We started with a Cosmopolitan and a Long Island, both freshly made (not from a carton) and absolutely perfect.
When we went for a second round, bartender Nuch offered to create a surprise twist on a traditional Cosmopolitan—of course we said yes! And wow 👌 it did not disappoint.
We’ll definitely be back as often as we can. Beautiful surroundings and fantastic service. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: rachel mcneary

sample_reviews_en.text:
What I liked about this bar is unlike all the other bars on this street,  you could sit down, relax, talk without overpowering music blasting.
The staff are professional,  well groomed and friendly.  Its not a bar girl bar.
You can sit there, enjoy the meal, and watch the night life go by from the sidelines if you want.
This was my go to bar for three nights.
Happy hour over several hours gives good value for drinks and the menus good for food.
So if you want somewhere quieter to relax and converse but still see the nightlife shenanigans,  this is a good place to be.
sample_reviews_en.author: nz monsterman

sample_reviews_en.text: Really nice change for this area . Nice to see a place with class move onto the street , the menu is very diverse and a nice change from the usual fare on the street. Had the pleasure of being served by Ayla who was very attentive and ensured we were well taken care of immediately. To be honest I’m coming back a few times before I leave as there is so much on the menu I want to experience. Great drink specials and atmosphere is really fun, a must try and highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike Taylor

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is a mind relaxing with good music, food and a it's a break from the busy street. If you need a breather for a moment in the famous nana street then this is a place for you. The staff, chef and everyone here is so cool and helpful. I'm a vegetarian so I didn't got the lot of options but they still have varieties they can customize. They will help as much as they can and will never force you for any try out. I loved the place 🫰 must visit for a break.
sample_reviews_en.author: PANKAJ KUMAR

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited this restaurant with my friends and we enjoyed it overall. There are plenty of seats on the terrace and a bar.
The service was excellent and the staff was polite and friendly. Food dishes were served quickly. The portions were small, but the prices were reasonable for this kind of establishment.
The only downside I noticed was that the smoothie did not match the menu. We were brought a regular milkshake and a very sweet one.
Everything else was good!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nadya Levina

restaurants.name: Uncle Ooh
restaurants.address:

PH45+2FF Unnamed Road Bang Kachao, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Awesome. Lovely staff, ferry from Wat Khlong Toei Nai วัดคลองเตยใน over the river. Driving not so easy but not impossible. But if you’re on the island this is a place for food.
sample_reviews_th.author: Ron Small

sample_reviews_en.text: Very poor management. Came into the restaurant and no staff was waiting to greet us. Had to walk to find a table myself. Sat and waited for a very long time and no one came to take the order, so had to ask for it and write it down myself. Waited for the food for a very long time. After a while, they came and said they were out of stock. When the food arrived, they came one at a time but the rice didn't come. When asked, they said they had just cooked it but didn't inform us from the beginning. Sat and watched until the food was completely cold, then the rice came. The soft-shell crab stir-fried with curry powder was very sharp and burnt. The steamed squid with lime was very sour. Had a very bad feeling. Would like the restaurant to make a major improvement. Not impressed at all. Came with the intention of driving here but encountered this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peerada Rampuengkit

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant we decided to go there after work. Unfortunately the way to getting there by car quite Challenge for us. The small size or city car able to pass through the way to restaurant parking lot. Which accommodate around 10 car maximum. The size of the car should be city car. The Sedan like Altima or Camary not applicable to get there.

Food: Good taste as original menu. But not presentable. However the taste really good and reasonable prices.

Service: It is most challenging for us. Might be the language barrier or something. We called them many time to orderore food from the menu or service's it seem slow and without attention. I assume may two-way communication. As some of service staff cannot speak local language properly.

Atmosphere: Of course nice view only that.

Glad to visit for experience only.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwanchai Quinzy Yokto

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food:
- Many dishes taste delicious.
- Good value for money.
- Wide variety of menu options.
- Recommended: Chicken stir-fried with cashew nuts (delicious), fried sea bass.
- For 6 people, the total bill was around 900-1000 baht, divided among us, so it was less than 200 baht per person. Great value!

Service:
- The staff seemed not to be Thai and didn't understand Thai well. We ordered pork fried rice but received crab fried rice, but our friends and I didn't mind.
- The cutlery had black marks and stains.
- The tables weren't wiped clean; we had to ask for a cloth to wipe them ourselves.

Atmosphere: Very good, breezy and cool.
sample_reviews_en.author: BB

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food was absolutely delicious and prices were like Bangkok 20 years ago, but of course there is a catch: We had to wait 40 minutes for our first 2 dishes to come out, and then another 30 minutes for the next 2, even though the restaurant was almost empty. They also didn’t bring out one last dish, even though we kept reminding them every 5 mins for an hour. The waitress kept telling us it’s coming. In the end we asked for the bill, and that last dish wasn’t even on the bill 😂

Great views though and staff were very nice. Bring all your patience 👍🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: Po Bunyapamai

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant offers an incredible dining experience with stunning water views, making it the perfect spot to unwind while enjoying delicious food. If you're looking to explore further, the water taxi stop right next door offers a quick ride into the city. The fish strikes a perfect balance of savory, spicy, sour, and sweet, the Tom Yum seafood soup being a standout—it was absolutely perfect, with just the right amount of heat and tang. Crispy pork was fresh, fried to perfection with what seemed like new oil, creating a delightful crunch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vee Romo

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's recommended to arrive before 6 PM and relax for a long time. After 6 PM, live music starts and the restaurant will start to fill up.

Sometimes there are tour groups, so it's recommended to call the restaurant beforehand to check. It's best to come during a time when there are no tour groups.

The food is fresh, especially the grilled fish, which is excellent. Overall, the taste is good.

The atmosphere is great, the view is beautiful, and sitting at a table by the water is cool and breezy. There is parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cookie Chill

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff member was unwelcoming. When I called to order food, she made a grumpy, displeased face as if she were eating something she didn't know what it was. (A woman, probably in her early 20s). When I asked if she was willing to take the order and why she made that face, she just replied that she always looked like that. She didn't greet me when I walked in, and her expression was unwelcoming, even though the restaurant was empty. My mistake for coming here. First and last time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ps Mika

restaurants.name: Oishi Ramen
restaurants.address:

QJ8R+GQ6, Lat Phrao Rd, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited this chain twice and I enjoyed the food. My japanese suki was a little too peppery though- to the point where I felt like I was inhaling the pepper itself!

The ramen was great; rich broth and bouncy noodles. Please note I did order extra toppings on the side so my ramen looks full. If yours doesn't come out looking like my picture then you might have to splash more baht. Whenever I eat meals here I also love to get their refillable cold green tea to drink along side with the dishes because I felt it really complements each other.

Service is good. They leave you alone after you recieve your meal and for the payment is self-service.
sample_reviews_en.author: sera loh

sample_reviews_en.text: I came to eat here today because I saw Chef Big's menu sign and it looked delicious, so I wanted to try it. But I was disappointed. The ramen was very bland and not tasty. The broth had a hint of sea flavor, but it was too fishy. The fried toppings were also too salty. Other dishes were okay. The stir-fried ramen with clams was delicious and flavorful, and the noodles had a nice chewy texture, but there were very few noodles in the portion. They should increase the quantity. The atmosphere in the restaurant was okay, the service was good, and the prices were not expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: CoCo Glam

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice bowls are generously portioned, the price is good, and it's filling and delicious. Paying via Shopee Pay gets you an extra 10 coins, which is a great deal. They also offer refills in the store, including Est. Green tea and sweet tea (not sweet if you prefer).
sample_reviews_en.author: Natdawin Khemtanunchawit

sample_reviews_en.text: I found another wonderful place that serves delicious ramen. Located on the top floor of The Mall shopping center, this little restaurant is cozy and busy. I ordered the tempura shrimp with the pork belly ramen and it was very good. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Larry Cortez

sample_reviews_en.text:
nothing oishi here......
1) Broth is nothing Japanese (texture, taste,. quality)

2).pork is 4 slices of thin lousy industrial ham, not meat

3) ramen is instant noodles

that's my interpretation of this joint
-broth -pork -ramen = empty bowl

AVOID
sample_reviews_en.author: Gabby

sample_reviews_en.text: Good...but why does it feel like the stir-fried ramen with clams has less portion than before? 🥟Gyoza is okay, okay. The fried pork is not very flavorful. The Tom Yum Salmon Ramen is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pookka’s channel

sample_reviews_en.text: The food came out quickly and the price was reasonable. However, I deducted points because the food bowls were chipped. There were two of us, and both our bowls were chipped.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suchaowadee Na

sample_reviews_en.text: These aren't fresh noodles. Even after boiling, they're still clumpy and crushed, not even strands anymore. It was so frustrating; I'd rather walk across the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปิ๊ก ทศพล

restaurants.name: โย่ง แซ่บเลยก๋อ
restaurants.address:

517 Rama III Rd, Bang Phong Phang, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located on Rama 3 Road, right near Terminal 21 Rama 3, this spot is hard to miss at night. It stands out with its bright, vibrant lighting and tables spilling out onto the sidewalk, packed with diners.
This is a go-to place for  bold, and spicy Isan food (Northeastern Thai cuisine) cooked to order.
Highlights & Recommended Dishes
Deep-fried Sun-dried Pork (Muu Daet Diao): A real winner—tender, flavorful, and not too oily.
Spicy Beef Soup (Tom Saep Nuea): The broth is excellent, and the beef is perfectly tender.
Speed: The food arrives sometimes fast.
Points to Note
Service & Management: Because it gets so crowded, orders can sometimes be missed. The billing system and overall floor management could definitely use some improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aey Angel

sample_reviews_en.text: Yong Restaurant (Zab Loei Kor) Rama 3. The restaurant is located before Rama 3 Soi 25. This spicy Isaan food restaurant just recently opened. I passed by and saw it was packed with people every day, so I had to give it a try. The food takes quite a while because there are a lot of people and few staff. Each dish isn't very big. I tried several dishes and found that the food is very spicy. If you can't eat spicy food, you have to tell me in advance, or else you'll cry. I highly recommend the grilled chicken with crispy skin and good flavor. The restaurant also has grilled shrimp (600 baht/kg). It's fresh and the meat isn't mushy. The price is reasonable. There's parking on the side of the road in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fame Wasa

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was terrible and not worth the price. I don't know if it was the staff or the owner, but they seemed to be in a bad mood and acted like we were begging for food. They were rude and abusive. It was a very low standard of service. I didn't read the reviews before coming because someone recommended this place. After reading them, I'm not surprised; everyone's complaining. Don't they have any intention of improving? All the comments are in the same vein. I strongly do not recommend this place. They answered politely when I asked questions, but were irritated and had a terrible attitude. The restaurant itself isn't great, the food isn't amazing, and the service is awful too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Junjira Ponglong

sample_reviews_en.text: From the moment we sat down and the waiter came to take our order, their face was sour, their voice curt, and their attitude completely unwelcoming. They didn't want to answer any questions, making disgusted faces and sounding like they were being forced to serve customers. The food was quite slow to come out. We ordered the seasoned oysters, and they were extremely fishy and unsanitary; dark liquid was visible on the plate. The fried chicken wings were bitter and burnt. Overall, it was a terrible experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: พิมชนก ปะลุวันรัมย์

sample_reviews_en.text: We almost didn't make it. I'm so disappointed. How dare they serve oysters like this? I asked to exchange them, and they ended up making a oyster salad instead. Both of us got diarrhea. I usually go there often, but this time I'm definitely put off. The cost of the oysters isn't much, 3 cans for 100 baht... // If they're not good, I recommend throwing them away. If you don't want to throw them away, make them yourself. It's better than selling them. From someone who runs a business too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike SJ

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was incredibly delicious! The fried pork intestines with garlic were excellent; the intestines were fresh and odorless, and the garlic was very fragrant. The spicy pork soup was fantastic, with plenty of pork and a very enjoyable broth. The papaya salad was also good. There are many other delicious dishes I discovered unexpectedly, but they were so good I had to come back again. The service was good, although some staff members seemed a bit grumpy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yellow’bnws

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything is delicious, order anything! You won't be disappointed with any of the dishes. The flavors are great, not too spicy. The "Pork Crying" (a type of spicy pork dish) is amazing! The grilled pork neck is so tender and melts in your mouth, even without dipping sauce. The fermented fish sauce has a nice aroma, not a strong smell. It's a roadside restaurant but has plenty of seating and parking along the street. Highly recommended for a night out!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rabby Kratai

sample_reviews_en.text: The female staff member had grumpy teeth, a sour face, and was completely unwelcoming. The service was terrible. The food was delicious, but the service was extremely slow. I ordered the pork waterfall dish and asked about it four times; it took 30 minutes to prepare. It wasn't that the place was chaotic, but they simply lacked attention to detail in their management.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mintra Cp

restaurants.name: มานารส อีทเทอร์รี่ แอนด์ บาร์ (ManaRos Eatery & Bar)
restaurants.address:

68 Amnuay Songkhram Rd, Khwaeng Thanon Nakhon Chai Si, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste of the food wasn't quite up to par with the price. The stir-fried glass noodles with cowslip flowers were too salty, the tom yum soup was too sweet, plain rice was 30 baht per plate and bottled water was 30 baht, which is quite expensive.
However, the staff provided good service and the restaurant's atmosphere was luxurious, showing attention to detail in the decor.
sample_reviews_en.author: ice ch

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! Every dish we ordered was amazing. The restaurant is clean, beautifully decorated, and the staff provides excellent service. It's a new place, and parking in front of the store is convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Passawee K

sample_reviews_en.text: All the food was delicious, and the service was very polite and courteous. Parking is available on the street; most of the area consists of houses and offices, so there aren't many cars parked there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tul Trueng

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted great and the menu was diverse. The restaurant was clean, the staff were polite and attentive, and the food came out relatively quickly. Overall, I was very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichada Khiewnorapai

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the atmosphere inside the restaurant was great. 🥰 We ordered so much food I didn't have time to take pictures; the kids ate it all very quickly!
sample_reviews_en.author: Phusimas Suwannapal

sample_reviews_en.text: The room was very well-decorated. All the food was delicious and arrived quickly. The staff provided excellent service. The speaker and microphone sound were very clear.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phantakan Juntarabute

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, Southern Thai style. The restaurant is quiet and peaceful, which is nice. Parking is limited; you have to park on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: SuperMom

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the chef has excellent skills. There are private rooms on the second floor with a great atmosphere and good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boonyawith Klangnarong

restaurants.name: Janrapee
restaurants.address:

226/8 Thanon Si Ayutthaya, Dusit, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere in the restaurant is great. It's decorated in an antique style with soft, yellow lighting. Each table can sing karaoke and choose their own songs; mostly old classics, very pleasant to listen to. The food is delicious and reasonably priced. The prawns are huge – I rarely find restaurants in Bangkok that serve such large prawns, and they give you a generous portion too! The tamarind sauce fried prawns are truly delicious. The stir-fried cabbage with fish sauce is excellent – ​​a must-order! Other restaurants tend to make it oily, but this one isn't. The grilled pork neck isn't dry, and the dipping sauce is great. The jungle curry with chicken is packed with ingredients, spicy but delicious. My favorites are the glass noodle salad and the sea bass miang – absolutely amazing! The fried prawn salad and sour curry were just okay. The staff were very helpful and friendly. I was very impressed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ntm L.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This long-established restaurant in the Thewet area offers a comfortable, clean atmosphere with cool air conditioning and live music from the 80s and 90s. The staff are very attentive and friendly.

The food is delicious and the portions are generous.
• Proudly present: Pad Thai with fresh shrimp. The flavors are authentic, with very high-quality shrimp and clean vegetables. Crispy wontons are also included.
• Fried shrimp salad with generous vegetables and fresh shrimp.
• Somtam Thai: Delicious, fresh, and clean.

There are many other dishes on the menu. Perfect for groups. 🩷
sample_reviews_en.author: Puripat Kitkarncharoensin

sample_reviews_en.text: This Thai restaurant features karaoke, where multiple tables can take turns singing. The volume is moderate, with some singing being good and others off-key, but it's a fun and enjoyable atmosphere. It's a great place to hang out with friends or family, and they can also host birthday parties and other special events. There are private rooms available, or you can choose to share the main hall. It's a unique and fun restaurant with a great atmosphere. The food is delicious, though on the higher side, and the portions are quite large.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mook ToTravel

sample_reviews_en.text:
Rare gem Thai restaurant in this area
Found by accident as most of the places in this area got no parking but not this one

It was truly fortunate to find this restaurant

It was old and very long time survived through many summers

PAD THAI is a must try
You won't find this good pad thai easily in Thailand

RAAD NHAA SEAFOOD also great

Signature grilled pork is also awesome
But thinner slice would be better

Many regular and foreigners as well

Waitresses are well trained and polite 😉
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanatpol WilTech168

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, there's plenty of parking, and the staff are friendly and provide good service. However, I wouldn't recommend it for group bookings or private events because the restaurant's management isn't professional enough to handle scheduling conflicts with other events. Booking a group event here might not be worth the price and could lead to a disappointing and unenjoyable experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Super SS

sample_reviews_en.text: 5 Star Home Style Thai Food reviewed by Thais. i somehow stumble into this restaurant by accidents. it was awesome. Every dishes is truly delicious and very thai in all aspects. The ingredients is fresh and very true to Thai style home cook. You won’t find this tyep of food in the malls or hotels. If i were michelin, i would rate it as “ worth to take a detour when you are in bangkok”
sample_reviews_en.author: Wen Moon Sir

sample_reviews_en.text:
Plenty of parking space. The food is pretty good, everything is decent, especially the Pad Thai which is flavorful. The staff provides good service.
However, the atmosphere, the stage, the music, and the live singer are not pleasant at all. Overall, it's very suitable for gatherings of older people; not suitable for children or teenagers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gift L.

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited Janrapee twice whilst we stayed in Bangkok. A very warm welcome, wonderful. Attentive staff and the food was delivered to our table, hot and tasty.
Not only did we receive great service, the entertainment was great too. Thoroughly enjoyed the karaoke. Nights to remember, thank you Janrapee😉
sample_reviews_en.author: Richie Carter

restaurants.name: Mavi Restaurant Bangkok
restaurants.address:

ชั้น G, The Phyll, 1770 Sukhumvit Rd, Phra Khanong Tai, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Was happy that we stumbled across this little gem, service was great, location and view is perfect, the owner was very welcoming and has trained his staff to be the same, explained all the dishes and gave recommendations, food was light, fresh & lovely, and he even gave us a free garlic ice cream to trial before he puts it to menu…& wow, sweet flavour that leaves a subtle garlic aftertaste👌🏼absolutely fantastic if your a garlic lover, highly recommend this place if your in Bangkok!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Damien Beale

sample_reviews_en.text: I recently discovered a Turkish restaurant in Bangkok, and it was a remarkable experience! As a Turkish native, I couldn't resist trying out a Turkish restaurant abroad, and I must say, it was an absolute delight! The food was incredibly authentic, reminding me of home in Turkey. If you're in Thailand and craving Turkish cuisine, Mavi Restaurant is a must-visit. You won't be disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: beren dabağoğlu

sample_reviews_en.text: The Mantı (Turkish ravioli), Meze Plate, and Lahmacun (Turkish Pizza) were absolutely delicious, bursting with flavors that made me feel like I was back in Istanbul. I want to express my heartfelt appreciation to the owner and chef of Mavi Restaurant for creating such an outstanding dining experience. If you’re craving Turkish flavors in Bangkok, Mavi Restaurant is the place to be!
sample_reviews_en.author: OLSAN SÖZEN

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great place for Turkish food. I've lived in Turkey for some time and I can tell the taste is very authentic. They even serve the tea in the same tea cups with little plates that you see in Turkey. And I mean exactly the same.

The owner and servers are very friendly and caring. You can see they care a lot about their work.

Go there and try their menemen and gevrek for breakfast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eugene B.

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice restaurant except its closing before promised time, so if you wanna visit there don’t be late otherwise you could get an answer that it’s already closed )) that’s why I put 1 star for service, other all things are 5 stars. Thai girl on the service is so cute, helping a lot. Chef is good too, but he should not close the restaurant almost 1 hour before.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mirza Alp

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing Turkish restaurant in Bangkok!

They are newer, with a super nice location in the Thong Lor area along Sukhumvit. Outdoor and indoor space, very clean.

The owner is very kind, and passionate about the food. Best hummus in the city, and excellent quality organic lamb and beef for really decent prices.

I will certainly be returning!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dylan Cocco

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place really does Turkish food very well. It’s not just kebab and well known Turkish dishes, but also homecooked comfort food like manti and lentil soup.

We had a lovely meal here and the chef takes real care in his dishes. Thankyou for satisfying our Turkish food cravings!
sample_reviews_en.author: Holly Payne

sample_reviews_en.text: I am new to Turkish food, and I know only this place in BKK (pardon my ignorance) that serves it. And it's very good! Dishes are unusual and exciting and, of course, delicious. The staff are friendly and willing and ready to explain things. Worth visiting and going back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lerkiat Vongsarnpigoon

restaurants.name: Bang Krabue Khao Tom Pla
restaurants.address:

15 Amnuay Songkhram Rd, Thanon Nakhon Chai Si, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This old-fashioned fish porridge shop in the Bang Krabue area has been open for a long time. It's run by three elderly women who open in the evenings. They serve fish, squid, minced pork, and pork tripe porridge. The shop is in a single-unit shophouse next to a 7-Eleven. You can park on the street. They don't accept QR code payments, so please bring cash. Be patient, as the elderly women tend to serve slowly. The shop's signature dish is the fish porridge; you must order it. The dishes I tried were fish porridge and blanched fish with dipping sauce.
- Fish porridge: The rice porridge was well-cooked and not mushy. The fish was fresh and not fishy at all. The broth was fragrant and flavorful. I recommend eating it with the shop's soy bean dipping sauce; it's delicious.
- Blanched fish with dipping sauce: The fish was incredibly fresh and not fishy. It tasted great with the shop's soy bean dipping sauce, which was not too salty and had a fragrant soy bean flavor.
If you're passing through Bang Krabue, give it a try. It's delicious, no need to say more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirichai Thananunthakit

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is one of those rare places that feels like stepping back in time. Run by three lovely elderly ladies—grandmotherly figures who cook everything with care and tradition—you’ll get a real taste of Bangkok’s old-school street food culture here.

The fish porridge is simple but packed with flavour. The fish is fresh, soft, and served in a comforting, aromatic broth. Prices range from 60–100 THB per bowl, which is incredibly fair for the quality.

Just a heads-up: service might be a bit slow at times since it’s all handled by the grandmas themselves, but that’s part of the charm. Be patient—it’s absolutely worth it.

If you’re after something truly authentic, heartfelt, and delicious, don’t miss this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: noneofthewishes

sample_reviews_en.text: Grandma said she's been selling this since her great-grandfather's time, and emphasized that it was back in the World War II era. She smiled. I saw her and her two siblings selling it together. Her older sister is 83 this year. If you're passing by, please stop and support them! There's always a crowd. Their rice porridge is delicious, only 70 baht per bowl. They have fish, chicken, and pork tripe, all perfectly cooked and tender. It's fragrant with sliced ​​galangal. Add a little soy sauce dip and a touch of chili vinegar, and it's absolutely delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jutamart Deechaiya_Inpringananta

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fish porridge and fish soup, Grandma's cooking skills! This is an old shop, over 100 years old, run by three grandmothers. The broth is light, sweet, and flavorful. The grandmothers are so lovely and attentive to their customers. The fish is boneless, not a single piece! A bowl costs less than 100 baht, around 70-80 baht. Considering the care, taste, and portion size, it's incredibly good value. Eating it makes me miss my own grandmother back home.

Even the fish soup with pickled mustard greens can't compare to Grandma's clear broth sea bass soup. ☺️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Palm kongsamran

sample_reviews_en.text:
First time and forever customer!
Ordered chicken rice porridge, and to my surprise, it was exactly how I like it.
The rice porridge was soft and went perfectly with the tender, well-cooked chicken.
I especially loved the addition of blood pudding.
The seasonings were standard, but the addition of dried galangal powder and a little bit of soy sauce dip was special – excellent!
There aren't many tables, and the owner, an elderly lady, prepares the food quickly. Her grandmother also helps with serving.
I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimnaree Limsreenak (Foonchan19)

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop opens at 5:30 PM and usually sells out by 8:00 PM. The fish porridge is 70 baht and it's delicious! The broth is flavorful and fragrant with garlic, and the rice is soft – everything is perfect. The grandmother gives a generous amount of fish, and it's not fishy at all. It's served with a fermented soybean dipping sauce from the condiment tray, and maybe some galangal powder, but it adds a nice aroma. Thank you, Grandma, for making such delicious and good food. Wishing you good health!
sample_reviews_en.author: ChaCha Peach

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice porridge was mildly flavored but delicious. It reminded me of my childhood. The rice was perfectly soft, the broth was hot and fragrant with homemade celery and fried garlic. Adding crushed galangal to the porridge made it even better. The fish was fresh, not fishy, ​​and in large pieces. The spicy salad was also delicious. Grandma and her family are still very healthy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattakan Srisawat

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old-style fish porridge stall in the Bang Krabue area. Three elderly women work together to prepare and serve the food. The fish porridge has a refreshing flavor, and adding the fermented soybean dipping sauce makes it even better. Parking is available along the road, but be mindful of odd/even day parking restrictions. They also accept bank transfers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayavat Chareonraj

restaurants.name: ไพร์ม เบอร์เกอร์ สุขุมวิท ซอย 11
restaurants.address:

Building 33, Sukhumvit 11 Alley, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love my late-night burgers in Bangkok!

Tired of Thai food and don't want to go back to the hotel at this hour? Prime Burger, I don't know why, but I always think of you.

First off, don't compare the burger itself to Shake Shack—it doesn't win! But the gravy, cheese, and bun—one bite and it's just... well, a little bit more than that. Okay, at 2 AM, being able to eat this kind of burger is amazing! The combination of time and space is just perfect!

But what I love most about this place isn't the taste! It's the location! Location, location, location—they've chosen it perfectly, cleverly hiding in the chaotic streets of Bangkok. You sit down, cars drive by, people walk by, the warm air... I love that feeling.

Especially in Bangkok at night, it's strange how I suddenly crave a sinful burger, fries, and Coke, and then sit on the roadside daydreaming.

A late-night savior when you're tired of Thai food.

Not the best burger, but at this hour, you're irresistible!

Ugh... I want some more! 🍔
sample_reviews_en.author: Boost Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: I recently visited Prime Burger and tried two standout items: the Stockholm Burger and the Phuket Burger. The Stockholm Burger impressed me with its perfectly seasoned beef, creamy cheese, and crisp vegetables, all held together by a soft, toasted bun. The Phuket Burger delivered bolder, Thai-inspired flavors, combining a spicy, aromatic sauce with a juicy patty and fresh herbs for a vibrant, unforgettable bite. Both burgers were well-crafted and beautifully presented. Paired with Prime Burger’s friendly service and relaxed atmosphere, the experience was thoroughly enjoyable. It’s a great spot for anyone craving quality, flavorful burgers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nikhil Joseph Saji

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very disappointing experience at Prime Burger. The waiter never informed us the ribs were pork. In a street full of Muslims, the least you can do is clearly mention it. I took one bite and immediately realized something was wrong. When we asked to remove it from the bill, they refused. Very disrespectful and careless.

The chicken burger was also terrible the chicken looked old and dark brown inside, not fresh or clean at all. Total waste of money. Service attitude was okay, but staff seriously need to inform customers what’s in the food. Some people have allergies or religious restrictions. Definitely my last visit, same for my friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aa hani

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very disappointing experience. The service was extremely poor, and the staff’s attitude was rude and unprofessional, especially when we asked to split the bill into two payments.

We waited around 70 minutes for our order, and when the food finally arrived, it was cold. The prices were also extremely overpriced considering the quality of the food and service. On top of that, the restaurant was not clean.

Overall, a very poor experience. The service, food, cleanliness, and prices were all disappointing. Definitely not worth the money, and I would not visit this restaurant again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ebraheim

sample_reviews_en.text:
Exceptional burgers .

Full packed flavour .
Moist and packs the wow factor .
Staff know there work 5 🌟

EDIT ......

Have now had prime burger in pattaya also sukhumvit 11 bkk plus prime burger in central mall bangkok.  And with out a doubt or lie. These burgers are exceptional . My go to burger place .the daily burger is also awesome comes with fries mixed as sweet potatoe fries and normal crispy fries . Hands down you wont find any burger any where better.  10🌟 if could give it .
sample_reviews_en.author: Neil Bridson

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is below average, also took about 10-15 min to come out after placing order and did not look to busy. The pricing is obviously over priced cuz it’s a high tourist area and tbh the only good thing about this place is the decor and atmosphere inside. Rather go McDonald . I had the Bangkok burger btw. Asked for single patty and they gave me double and charged me for the double . You’re better off walking less than 5 min to the nearest 7/11
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeremias Ibanez

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't understand how this has a 4.8. First time trying a prime burger location. Menu full of stuff with burgers in the back, seems odd for the branding. Burger looked decent but tasted watery. Not greasy, just wet. Also poorly seasoned if any at all, like no salt. Just wet beef. Not inexpensive either. I suspect just not great quality frozen patties plus not a decent job cooking them either. Disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike

sample_reviews_en.text: Gave it 2 /5 mainly because of delivery. If you want, better go there and eat. Delivery is never as whats mentioned in delivery apps. The dtivers are usually there waiting for orders to be ready. If they kbow are crowded,  they shouldn't take orders. We ordered at approx 11:15pm. Delivery time changed 3 times. Food arrived 130am. Distance of 2km.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adnan Al-Hinai

restaurants.name: The Hidden Lighthouse
restaurants.address:

90/3 Soi Seri Thai 9, Khlong Kum, Bueng Kum, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was incredibly slow! I ignored the reviews and came on a day when it wouldn't be crowded. I brought my parents from out of town, and I'm so disappointed. Our order was incomplete, and we waited 15 minutes for drinks, even though the restaurant wasn't busy. I'm definitely not coming back!

------ This isn't even an apology! Did you even read how long our drinks took? We only rushed to get them when we asked for them. And the order wasn't complete? Did the staff member even mention that the table next to us, who ordered later, received their food at the same time?
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayanid Kumnerdsirikul

sample_reviews_en.text: We chose this restaurant for our Valentine's Day date, thinking it had the best atmosphere in the area. However, the food service and management were terrible. We arrived at 5 PM, ordering only three dishes. We arrived at 5:10 PM, the first dish arrived at 6 PM, and the second at 6:15 PM. Almost two hours later, we still hadn't received all three dishes. It was awful, very disappointing and upsetting. They really need to improve their management and the speed of food preparation. It seemed like the restaurant wasn't ready to handle a large number of customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: จารวี หลงน้อย

sample_reviews_en.text:
🎴07/2026
The restaurant is a good size, medium-sized, not too big and not too small. It has air conditioning with a high ceiling and also an outdoor area. It's located next to a reservoir (pond) and has a lighthouse photo spot. The food tastes OK, the dipping sauces are good. Some dishes aren't quite as flavorful, but overall it's tasty. On Saturday evenings, there's soft music to listen to (solo singer with guitar).
Parking: You can park in front of the restaurant and in the lot across the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fullteni พิมมี่ดี๊ด๊า

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is right by the lake, the atmosphere is great. There's an indoor area with air conditioning and an outdoor area where you can enjoy your meal while taking in the breeze and the view in a relaxed way.
There's plenty of parking, so you don't have to circle around looking for a spot 👍🏻

As for the food, there's a wide variety to choose from.
The taste is excellent, the food looks incredibly appetizing.

Seriously, it's delicious, I'm not exaggerating! I want to go again 😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Pronpat p.

sample_reviews_en.text: I learned about this restaurant from a friend who studied with me at NIDA. My first visit was amazing; every dish was delicious and great value for money. The atmosphere was fantastic. I've been a regular customer since then, even after graduating, and I still frequent the place. I've brought friends and family, and they all agree it's incredibly delicious. ♥️
sample_reviews_en.author: Marc Krajangwat

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was served very slowly and was incomplete. We had to keep asking for it for over an hour. The most outrageous thing was that tables that arrived after us got their food first. When we arrived, there weren't many people, only about 3 tables. We waited for our food until it got crowded, and it still wasn't all there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Last War

sample_reviews_en.text: The service is excellent, the prices are reasonable for the portion sizes, and the taste is authentically Thai. I recommend calling ahead to reserve a table as the restaurant will have one ready for you. There's plenty of parking right next to the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piya-orn Lucktong

sample_reviews_en.text: All the food was delicious! I especially loved the mint cocoa; I had two glasses! The atmosphere was great, the staff provided excellent service – everything was perfect. I came to celebrate my birthday and was very impressed with everything.
sample_reviews_en.author: Moodeng

restaurants.name: JOHNNY Food & Drink
restaurants.address:

223-225 ซอยจุฬา 11 Rama IV Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The taste was alright, but I felt the restaurant wasn't very honest. I ordered สุกี้แห้งไก่, which was listed as 65 baht on the menu, but the owner charged me 95 baht. However, the portions were very large. There weren't many customers that day, and delivery was sporadic.
sample_reviews_th.author: Jasmine Chen

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here based on reviews. It's a small, homemade-style restaurant. The menu has two pages: the first for rice dishes and the second for side dishes. The prices aren't too high, and the food tastes great. I didn't feel like the food was too strong or heavy (no dry throat or mouth afterwards).

Dishes I ordered:
- Stir-fried pork with oyster sauce: It was stir-fried with a bit of sauce, mildly salty. Kids would probably like this one.
- "Muen Lee" (a type of Thai noodle dish): This dish wasn't spicy, but the flavor came from the chili paste. Delicious!
- Oyster omelet: Absolutely delicious! I don't know how to describe it.
- Tom Yum Goong (spicy shrimp soup) (I ordered the chilies separately): This dish was very flavorful, just the way I like it.

The service was up to standard. Overall, I was very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: WEERASU.T

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chanced upon this stall near chulalongkorn uni area! Tried some of the dishes recommended by the staff and it was very good! The curry egg with chicken resembled the curry crab in Som Boon seafood restaurant, the yum mama had the right sourness/spiciness, and the oyster omelette was crispy and perfect too.

Most importantly, this meal with 3 drinks only cost us 625 baht. Very affordable, will definitely return for more!
sample_reviews_en.author: Xin Fang Chia

sample_reviews_en.text:
✅ Minced Pork Noodle Soup: Sour and sweet flavors, chewy noodles.
✅ Stir-fried Chicken Spaghetti: Tastes like stir-fried chicken, soft noodles.
✅ Khao Muen Li Pork: Good flavor with chili and glass noodles.
✅ Korean Pork Rice: Sweet, fragrant with sesame, delicious, tender pork.
✅ Ham and Cheese Spring Rolls: Mediocre, frozen food.
Price: 310 Baht

This restaurant has reasonable prices. Highly recommended. ⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: alice prince

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating at this restaurant for over ten years, since it was in its old location, just one room, next to Ton Kok restaurant and the 555 photocopy shop back in the old Samyan Market era. I can confirm it's delicious and has a diverse menu. Personally, I recommend the "Exploding Egg" dish ⭐️😍. The prices are friendly, and the food comes out very quickly. If you haven't tried it, you must!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pastharee J

sample_reviews_en.text: Just a short word! AROI KOD KOD!!!!!! especially yellow curry with chicken is da best of yellow curry that i ever eaten in my life!!!! and the price of foods also very reasonable as well. anyone still swipe the review of this restaurant, i wanna tell you to put your phone down and let’s eat it!! you will not disappoint with any their menu. i guarantee! 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: kittgumbs

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered Thai milk tea and the "Johnny Fried Rice" for lunch. The tea was watery. The rice came out suspiciously quickly, and observably undercooked in hindsight. Whatever, I risked it. The flavour was okay, but I felt ill for hours afterwards. Could be a one off, but disappointed to not be able to give a glowing review like the others.
sample_reviews_en.author: T.K. Teoh

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped by by chance while passing through because it was crowded. It seems like a great value restaurant frequented by nearby university students. The prices are affordable and the menu is diverse. I ordered the Pad Krapow Moo because another table ordered it, and it was really good. I really enjoyed the meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: EA K

sample_reviews_en.text: I requested a receipt for company reimbursement. The price per cup isn't cheap. I submitted the request on the day of purchase, but the admin team is not coordinating, they don't read or reply. The next day they said they couldn't issue it because the deadline had passed. I'm very disappointed, especially over something so simple as a receipt. I don't think I'll be a customer again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kristy Krittiya

sample_reviews_en.text: Gulger Map should improve the map to make it better to drive on the main road. It is not recommended to drive in the alleys, there are heavy traffic, the alleys are narrow, it is difficult for cars to pass each other. Please improve the navigation to make it easier to drive on the main roads.
sample_reviews_en.author: kreawpassorn passaranon

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is great, delicious and guilt-free. The restaurant often has promotions, and the staff provides good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: สิราพัชรกุล ปัญญาพงศ์นาวิน

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating it for a very long time. I'm still eating it, continuing to eat it. I only eat Just Fruit 🍎
sample_reviews_en.author: Me& My podcast

sample_reviews_en.text: The Acai menu has a wide variety of choices, and there are discounts available. I'm having trouble deciding!
sample_reviews_en.author: taweewat soponitthiwat

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish was delicious, and the staff were very friendly and helpful. The kitchen looked clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gil Gitti

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! The fruit is fresh, and the taste is consistently good, just like at other branches.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apisara Prajongket

sample_reviews_en.text: It tastes delicious and is beneficial. I really like to eat it. Everyone in the house likes it.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุวคนธ์ สุวรรณเลิศ

restaurants.address:

