sample_reviews_en.text:
For Hong Kong-style noodles, I highly recommend this restaurant. It might be a bit hidden, as it's located in a house.
The taste is great, and they have a variety of other dishes. The prices are reasonable.
It can get quite crowded on weekdays during lunchtime, so you might have to wait for a table.
sample_reviews_en.author: Janyaporn Pokhuntod

sample_reviews_en.text: This home-style restaurant gives you the feeling of having a meal at a relative's house. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, with both air-conditioned indoor seating and outdoor seating. The owners, an aunt and uncle, are lovely and make delicious food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wannaporn Punudom

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the restaurant is peaceful with a steady stream of families coming in. The owner, an elderly lady, is lovely. The tuna salad had a generous amount of tuna. The Hong Kong-style noodles were delicious. Very impressed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chatlada Akarapas

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant, located in a converted residential house in Soi Chaengwattana 14, surprised me the first time I went in. But the food was delicious and reasonably priced. There are limited tables, so you should definitely try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supharin Jiraratchakit

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a restaurant located in a house, beautifully decorated, like having a meal at a friend's house. The food is delicious, especially the Hong Kong-style stir-fried noodles with crispy fried noodles, which is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suchat Luelamsombat

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small restaurant with limited seating, like having a meal at a friend's house.
You can't talk too loudly.
Parking is available in the village alley.
The food, in our opinion, was decent and clean.
Prices are moderate.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tasama Meechai

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, especially the stir-fried noodles with gravy. The rice with chili paste and mackerel was also tasty. The atmosphere was nice, very homey, like eating at a relative's house. It was lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tharanee Baltip

sample_reviews_en.text: All the food was delicious, and the atmosphere was lovely, like having a meal at a relative's house. The owner, an elderly couple, was very kind and attentive, and extremely friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ampa Sangsumritchai

restaurants.name: ก๋วยจั๊บน้ำข้นเจ๊แดง
restaurants.address:

QG7R+M5H, Alley, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The restaurant has a wide variety of dishes, including noodle soup, pork leg, and pork blood soup, all looking delicious. Today I tried the thick broth noodle soup and it didn't disappoint. They gave a generous amount of ingredients, and the noodles were good, not too hard. Only 60฿ per bowl.
sample_reviews_th.author: Wanvi K

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered Kuay Jab, Rice with Roasted Crispy Pork, Vegetable and Pork Blood Soup, and Chrysanthemum Tea and Roselle Tea. All the dishes were very reasonably priced.

The Kuay Jab soup was rich and flavorful; the sauce on the roasted crispy pork was delicious; and the vegetable and pork blood soup had a very fresh taste. None of the pork offal had any unpleasant odor—it was all very tasty. The drinks were also nice and on the sweeter side.

This place stays open late into the night, and every dish makes for a great late-night snack. Highly recommended for anyone nearby to come and give it a try.

We also ordered pork offal cake, crispy roasted pork rice, vegetable and pork blood soup, and chrysanthemum tea and roselle tea. All the dishes were reasonably priced.

The pork offal soup was rich and flavorful, the crispy roast pork sauce was delicious, and the vegetable and pig's blood soup was very fresh. The pork offal had no unpleasant smell and was very tasty. The drinks were also good, mostly sweet.

This restaurant is open late into the night, and all the dishes are great for a late-night snack. Highly recommended for anyone nearby.

With nornor.
2025/07/18
sample_reviews_en.author: YK Yeh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dec 2025: I am a Level 7 contributor (400 reviews) on Google and regularly write unbiased feedback on my experiences in both Asia and Melbourne.  I have landed late in Bangkok and was looking for a worthy eatery that is open past 10 pm. Serendipitously, I found this eatery near my hotel. It is on the road side, with 3 stalls. The one that I went to (when you face the eating area) is on the right, nearest the road. I am not sure if these 3 stalls are related.

I ordered the kuay chap, which is 🐖 entrails with rolled noodles and a plate of stewed pig's trotters(palo stew pig, on the menu). The intestines,  liver are so tasty with no smell, and the meat is generous in portion. The pig's trotters are so tender that the meat melts in your mouth.  There is also a nice layer of skin fat. Absolutely delicious! The chilli is tangy and they also provide pickled green chilli. I love it. I paid 140 Baht in total, including an iced lemon tea. It's outdoor sitting on a busy road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Justin Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Forgot to take a picture of the pork knuckle before mixing it with the dipping sauce…
Iced black tea 20 baht
Pork knuckle 60 baht
They have kway chap, pork knuckle, roasted pork, and crispy pork.
I ate the pork knuckle.
The taste was just okay, nothing amazing, but the dipping sauce was satisfyingly sour, I liked it haha.
I secretly checked the dark-colored sauce for the roasted pork and crispy pork, and it smelled sour like it was spoiled, with lots of foam. I didn't take a picture because I didn't eat it… I don't know if it was like that or if it was really spoiled…
Personally, I've wanted to try it for a long time because it's near the Victory Monument. Next time I'll try the kway chap.
There are many tables, and there are always people watching over the customers. They are very fast; you order and get your food almost immediately. Maybe because I went when they had just set up the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: AiRiJi

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant gets busier the later it gets. I've been eating here for years, and the taste has always been the same. The food is served hot and quickly, and the prices are reasonable. There are tons of tables, and they're always kept clean. There are plenty of staff, and the owner manages everything very well, always attentive. They sell a variety of dishes: noodles, rice noodle soup, roast pork rice, crispy pork rice, and braised pork leg rice. They even offer free tea, which I love!

The noodles are tiny and delicious (I didn't get a chance to take a picture, my boyfriend ate them!).
The crispy pork rice has a great sauce; it's sweet and savory in its own unique way. The pork is truly crispy (again, I didn't get a chance to take a picture, I ate it too!).
The rice noodle soup has a well-balanced flavor; the offal and blood aren't gamey.
sample_reviews_en.author: patchara pattamintorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, generous portions, and great value for money. It's near the hotel, and it's a pity I only discovered it on my last night before returning home, otherwise I would have gone more often.

The staff are friendly and helpful. It's a collaboration between several small vendors, sharing menus and seating. Clean and fast service.

The three-in-one rice (char siu, roast pork, sausage) is a must-order at 60 baht. The pig's blood noodle soup is also delicious at 60 baht, and it comes with a glass of iced tea – so satisfying! I would definitely visit again if I come back. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrick Lin

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a really delicious restaurant, especially the braised pork knuckle rice 🐷

We ordered the braised pork knuckle rice (60 baht) and the pork offal and vermicelli soup (60 baht), both were very tasty. The pork offal soup had a lot of different parts, so it's good for trying something new (because there are quite a few parts I don't like, such as pork skin, lungs, and intestines). I highly recommend the braised pork knuckle rice; the sauce is perfectly seasoned and goes absolutely wonderful with rice!
sample_reviews_en.author: Cheer Wong

sample_reviews_en.text: The thick broth noodle soup (Khao Piak) has a generous amount of toppings and is delicious. The crispy pork is also good, and the broth is tasty without being overly sweet. A regular bowl costs 50 baht. Even though there are many customers, the food comes out quickly after ordering. There are plenty of tables to sit at. The menu offers a variety of dishes including Khao Piak, rice with roasted pork, crispy pork, and pork leg, as well as noodles, all at reasonable prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pariyapath Eiamtrakul

restaurants.name: Manna Cafe Nana
restaurants.address:


sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent service! The owner is lovely.
The food is delicious and reasonably priced.
Recommended:
Green curry with beef
Served with roti bread.
It's delicious when eaten together. The curry paste has just the right amount of spiciness, creamy and sweet, but not overly sweet.
Stir-fried noodles with fermented soybeans and sea bass
The noodles are crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, and the sea bass comes in a large piece. It's more than enough for one person to be completely full.

They have many delicious cakes for dessert.

For drinks, we ordered iced milk tea. The tea here is amazing!
It's strong, perfectly sweet and creamy, and fragrant.

If you're passing through the Bang Kruai area, try stopping by this restaurant!

sample_reviews_th.text: บริการดีครับ อย่างอื่นอาจจะปรับให้ดีได้ —  I’d really like this restaurant to change the tables, chairs. As for the food, it was average. I went for weekend dinner buffet, beef was chewy to eat. Grilled station truly lived up to its name, burnttt. Some dishes ran out and were not refilled, such as parma ham. Desserts were delicious, though. The staff were lovely, and the service was quite good to excellent.
sample_reviews_th.author: Piyawat Jirapatwong

sample_reviews_en.text: My husband and I enjoyed the breakfast buffet at "Feast," a restaurant located inside the Royal Orchid Sheraton Hotel. The first thing that surprised us was its spaciousness and open atmosphere. The restaurant has a classical and luxurious interior and decor, allowing you to enjoy your meal in a relaxed setting. There were many staff members, and they were all smiling and attentive, so the service was excellent. There are stairs at the entrance and inside the restaurant, which may be a little inconvenient for wheelchair users, but you can enjoy an elegant breakfast while overlooking the Chao Phraya River from the spacious terrace seating. The variety of dishes is simply amazing, with a wide range of international cuisine including Western, Thai, and Chinese. Omelets and noodles are made to order by chefs in a live kitchen style, so you can enjoy them fresh. Overall, the quality of the food was high, and it was one of the most satisfying breakfasts I've ever had. I would definitely recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gen Olive

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Royal Orchid Sheraton Riverside Hotel in Bangkok offers a beautiful blend of comfort, great service, and unforgettable river views and one of the highlights of the stay is Feast, the hotel’s signature all-day dining restaurant.

Feast lives up to its name. The international buffet is generous, fresh, and full of variety. You’ll find live cooking stations where chefs prepare dishes right in front of you, adding a fun and personal touch to the experience. Whether you’re in the mood for Thai favorites, Asian specialties, or Western classics, there’s always something that stands out.

The real treat is the view. Dining right along the Chao Phraya River creates a relaxing atmosphere, especially in the evening when the boats drift by and the lights reflect off the water. The staff is friendly, attentive, and quick to help, which makes the whole experience even more enjoyable.

The Feast is absolutely worth a visit. It’s a great spot for couples, families, or anyone who enjoys good food with a great view.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Fieger (Devil Dog Marketplace)

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I dined at Feast restaurant in the Royal Orchid Sheraton Hotel. Having tried several hotels in this area, this one was the most impressive. The seafood was already peeled and ready to eat – no need to peel yourself! This included mussels, crab, mantis shrimp, and lobster. The seafood was incredibly fresh and sweet, with no fishy taste at all. The staff were attentive and cleared plates without needing to be asked. Unfortunately, the beef and cheese weren't quite to my liking, but the seafood was outstanding – a perfect 10 out of 10. This time I used a Hungryhub promotion for 2,500 baht (buy one get one free, 1,250 baht per person) for a 3-hour dining experience (12:00-15:00). It was excellent value for money. The restaurant also had live music and complimentary tea and coffee, making it a truly wonderful dining experience. I would definitely like to return. The restaurant is located right by the Chao Phraya River with a beautiful view.
sample_reviews_en.author: Atthimate Teerabannaluck

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is by the Chao Phraya river with air conditioned space and outdoor space.
We were at the restaurant for a Sunday buffet brunch. Food was good and plenty. They have a lot of seafood grilled to order, sushi, chinese, thai, indian and western food. The Sunday brunch was very kid-friendly. There was a clown to entertain children while parents eat. 😍 He made balloons into cartoon characters for the kids and kids can also color printed pages at the activity table. I highly recommend this restaurant especially for families.

2026 updates:  still highly recommend Sunday brunch here for families. The day we went, they have a little setup for kids to make their own mini cupcakes. There was live music and the vibe was relaxing.
sample_reviews_en.author: NJ P

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a high-priced hotel Sunday Brunch buffet, but considering the quality and variety of the menu, it's worth it. It's suitable for families, company events, couples, and colleagues. Highlights include Alaskan king crab legs, grilled seafood, and fresh oysters from three different countries. There's a huge variety of food, and you can comfortably eat within 4 hours. There's live music for about an hour. The food is delicious and fresh, both savory and sweet, as well as the drinks.

My only request is that they offer ikura (salmon roe), like at the Asoke branch.

Booking through Hungry Hub gives you a buy 2 get 1 free promotion, which is great value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rich Richy

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an amazing Sunday Brunch at a five-star hotel for 2500 THB net, but if you buy directly through the hotel's Line account, you get a buy one get one free deal, making it only 1250 THB per person. You won't find a better deal anywhere else. Just eating the lobster, beef, and oysters is more than worth it. This restaurant combines menus from TharaThong (Thai restaurant), Giorgio's (Italian restaurant), and Siam Yacht Club – a complete selection of dishes. Highly recommended for buffet lovers or those who enjoy Sunday Brunch; it's incredibly good value!

sample_reviews_en.text:

Looking at past blog posts, it mentioned that they served various BBQ dishes cooked fresh on the spot, but perhaps because it was a Monday, that wasn't available.

My overall impression is that, despite being a hotel breakfast, I can't really recall any signature dishes. I got a discount, but it wasn't as good as I expected.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pros

•	Comfortable setup and decoration with enough space for both diners and food.

Cons

Rating:

sample_reviews_en.text:
Late-Night Thai Comfort at Jimjoom99 Banthat Thong

We thought this restaurant might be quieter at the late hour we visited, but to our surprise, the crowd just kept coming in for supper! It was buzzing with locals, and we were equally amazed to see so many people enjoying their claypot meals — a true sign of a local gem.

We ordered the BBQ pork neck, which was incredibly tender, juicy, and full of flavor. It paired perfectly with their signature red dipping sauce — a great start to our meal.

The highlight, of course, was the Thai-style claypot hotpot. The lemongrass-infused clear broth was deeply aromatic and soothing. We added in a basket of fresh vegetables, sliced chicken, pork, and finished with rice vermicelli. It was nutritious, comforting, and satisfying — served with a flavorful mookata-style sauce that tied everything together.

We also shared a plate of Thai crab meat fried rice, which was beautifully cooked — dry, fragrant, not too oily, and very easy to enjoy.

This was a wholesome, authentic Thai supper, and we felt truly blessed to have stumbled upon such a hearty meal so late at night. Highly recommended for anyone craving warm, flavorful comfort food after hours.
sample_reviews_en.author: WanderWithWit

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a great place to visit if you enjoy authentic Thai hotpot. Everything we ordered was delicious, and the portions were relatively small, which was just nice for 2 of us.

The restaurant can get very crowded during dinner time. If you prefer to sit in the air-conditioned area, expect to queue for around 20–30 minutes. Otherwise, you can usually get a seat in the non-air-conditioned section within about 5 minutes.

We ordered the pork hotpot, river prawns with glass noodles, and butter scallops. The pork hotpot and river prawns were excellent. The scallops were fresh and tasty, although I found the butter sauce a little too rich for my liking. Overall, the food was delicious, and I would recommend this place if you’re visiting Bangkok
sample_reviews_en.author: Grace

sample_reviews_en.text:
Last time we were here for Jeh O Chula and passed by this hotpot place with all tables being occupied, so we just came back again and have a try! This is my first time ever to try this thai style hotpot called chim chum and it was sooo great! The soup base was boiled with many spices which turns out tasted like tom yum in a less sour and spicy version! We had the beef and seafood combo for hotpot and also the grilled pork neck recommended by the friendly staff, everything was fresh but just the portion is a bit poor, i think it just good enough for one person serving.. other than that eating this traditional thai hotpot with chilling beer next to the street is just satisfying!

Love it more than hong kong style hotpot!
sample_reviews_en.author: Cherrei Ho

sample_reviews_en.text: If you’re looking for the best Thai Clay hotpot in Bangkok, I highly recommend this place. A Chinese friend of mine suggested it, and it’s well-known in RedNote as well. I decided to try the claypot soup, and now I’ve visited three times. While the prices are a bit higher than other Thai restaurants, the quality and taste of the food make it well worth it. The claypot hotpot is exceptional, and the raw shrimp salad is my personal favorite. My only downside is that the portions are a bit on the smaller side. The restaurant has three floors to choose from: an air-conditioned room, a live show room, and an open area on the 4th floor, each offering a unique atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: GlobeStepsby Yune

sample_reviews_en.text: I wish I could give zero star for this place. I’ve already read reviews about having poor service at this place but I did not expect it to be THIS bad. I’m not sure how they expect us to cook our food at a steamboat/hotpot place when it takes them forever to refill the soup. On top of that our pot is NOT HOT so it takes forever to boil and our meat ended up soooo tough. We’ve asked them to change our pot/add charcoal since before we started cooking our food yet such simple request cannot be fulfilled even after 45mins??!!?? What is so hard about changing a pot? The food is also very average so please do yourself a favour and stay away from this restaurant.

sample_reviews_en.text:

(Looking at other tables, it seemed like we ordered a bit too much...) They only give you one sauce by default, so you have to order your own sauce (free). The green sauce is delicious!!

It was nice to have a good mix of meat and seafood. The rice had a unique texture—fluffy yet chewy. At the end, I set aside some rice to dry on a plate, whisked an egg to make egg soup, and mixed it all together; it was amazing!! I want to come back again.

2577 Phatthanakan Rd, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
8/10 Delicious at a Super-Friendly Price – Maximum Satisfaction
I stumbled upon Kihyoe by chance and have zero regrets giving it a try.

Located near MaxValu Supermarket Phatthanakan, this cozy Japanese restaurant serves grilled fish dishes that are as good as those in premium Japanese restaurants, but at a much more affordable price. The menu isn't huge, but it's varied enough to keep you coming back with family.

The space is small with limited seating, so be prepared to wait if it's busy. Food can take a little time to prepare, but it's worth the wait. Plenty of parking is available in the MaxValu area.

Delicious and great value for money.
I accidentally found this small Japanese restaurant near MaxValu Phatthanakan. The grilled fish is just as delicious as those in premium restaurants, but at a much more budget-friendly price. The menu isn't extensive, but it's varied enough to keep you coming back. Seating is limited, and the food is prepared fresh, so there might be a slight wait, but it's worth it. Parking is convenient in the MaxValu area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oil Suebsiri T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located in the Maxvalu area at Phatthanakan intersection.
The shop is on the outside.
Not recommended if you're extremely hungry.
The shop is quite small and has few staff.
When we went, we waited almost 20 minutes.
We noticed many other tables that arrived before us hadn't received their orders yet.
We had to call a staff member over to check on our orders.
This meant we had just arrived...
The staff apologized for the delay, which was nice.
But what made everything better was...
Delicious!
The food was very well-prepared. We ordered sukiyaki and a pork cutlet rice set.
The portions were generous, and considering the price, it was great value.
Forget about the slow service, everything else was perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: lee lingnoy

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went in thinking, "Japanese food in a place like this?" It was lunchtime and almost full.

The posters were clearly in native Japanese, indicating Japanese ownership, which raised my expectations.

The menu prominently displayed "Kyushu Cuisine." My mind immediately pictured manly food prepared by Kyushu delinquents wearing headbands and special attack uniforms.

It took a little while for the food to be prepared.

The taste was average. Since it was lunchtime, I couldn't experience the true essence of Kyushu cuisine; I think I'll have to visit in the evening to fully enjoy it.

As a genuine Japanese restaurant, not a fake one, I'd give it a double thumbs up.
sample_reviews_en.author: K M

sample_reviews_en.text: This Japanese restaurant is located in the Maxvalu Pattanakarn shopping mall. The food is tasty but preparation is quite slow. The price and portion size are reasonable for one or two people; the dishes aren't very large. The restaurant's atmosphere is simple, without any special decorations. The service is simple, not particularly outstanding or attentive to customers. The ordering, processing, and payment system is quick and efficient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanya Songmuneeroj

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a small, cozy restaurant with delicious food. They seem to put a lot of care into their menu. If you like crispy, non-greasy fried pork, I recommend it. However, you might have to wait a little while for your food. Overall, it's a good place to grab a quick meal.
I glanced at the table next to me and saw that they had a huge, delicious-looking piece of salmon; I'll have to try it next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Worapon Komonwilas

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Japanese restaurant is located inside Max Value, Phatthanakan branch, a short walk from the Airport Link Hua Mak station.
Recommended dishes include grilled eggplant, fried chicken salad, and kimchi vegetable soup.
There are both regular seating options and traditional Japanese-style low seating.
There is ample parking available inside Max Value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lucho

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pork hamburger had a sour smell and taste (from the pork, not the sauce). The restaurant refused to replace it, saying it tasted normal and that they'd eaten at many other restaurants without it being this sour.

In short, I only ate the fried egg; I didn't dare eat anything else, but I still paid the full price.
Once is enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: กวินเชษฐ์ กวินภิรมย์สิน

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, both the main courses and side dishes. Personally, I thought the price was a bit high compared to the portion size, but overall, the service was good. The restaurant has a slightly dark atmosphere, but there are also Japanese-style seating options.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phimagine

restaurants.name: After Yum • The Crystal เลียบด่วนเอกมัย-รามอินทรา
restaurants.address:

เดอะคริสตัล เอกมัย-รามอินทรา 215 Pradit Manutham Rd, Khwaeng Lat Phrao, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: It tasted good, but the lemon was a bit too bitter. There should be a way to manage the bitterness so it doesn't ruin the salad. The fried pork neck was the best. Ice is 2฿ per glass. They close at 11 pm. It's good for people who work late to have a meal here.
sample_reviews_th.author: FAh Kochannel

sample_reviews_en.text:
Arrived at the restaurant at almost 8pm, sat and waited + ordered food for a while and got into the restaurant, didn't wait long for the food.

Taste: The sauce is not very delicious, the first bite is okay, but when eating more, it's only sour, sour first, then sweet.

Ingredients: Good quality, but some dishes are too expensive, even though they come in large portions, such as salmon salad, the salmon quality is not that good, thin slices, not fatty salmon.

Price: Some are reasonable, but some are too expensive, there are many small prices, such as plain ice 2 baht, bottled water 20 baht, Pepsi 60 baht per liter - canned 30 baht, box to take home 10 baht.
*3 people went to eat, ordered all of these, each person almost 800 baht.

Favorite dishes ✨ and recommended:
- Glass shrimp in fish sauce: Big, firm shrimp, delicious with pickled garlic.
- Crispy fried soft-shell crab with three sauces: delicious.
- Blue crab salad: Fresh crab.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thrisha PH

sample_reviews_en.text: I was lucky it wasn't crowded today. It was my first time eating here; I usually dislike restaurants with long queues. The queuing system was good, and the food came out quickly, probably because there weren't many people today. The spicy salad (yam) here might not be the absolute best, but it's tastier than many other places. It's not overly sweet like some others, and the ingredients are high-quality with plenty of meat. The prices are on the higher side but reasonable. The fried pork neck was delicious. The drinks are a bit pricey. I feel it's better to go with a group of people. Regarding the spicy salad, I wish there was more variety of vegetables. If it's your first time and you're unsure about your preferred level of spiciness, you can ask for extra chili peppers. Overall, I liked it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warassanuwit Chiaranai (Ging)

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. The flavor is much milder than the original restaurant.
2. The only vegetables in the salad were large red onions, which seemed like they had been chopped and left out for a long time. They lacked the usual salad-like aroma.
3. The fried pork belly also seemed like it had been fried a long time ago; it wasn't crispy but very chewy.
4. The shrimp was strangely hard and unusually chewy; I don't know what it was soaked in. After eating, all three of us had diarrhea and stomach cramps all night.
5. The salmon was overpriced for its quantity.
6. The sticky rice was like old sticky rice; it was loose and no longer sticky.

It would be a great pity if the owner can't maintain the same quality if they open more branches. From a loyal customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narumon Jitwittayapon

sample_reviews_en.text:
This famous spicy salad (Yum) restaurant from Pattaya now offers delivery to your home, saving you the hassle of waiting in line at the restaurant.
The taste is consistently the same as the original branch, with generous portions of ingredients. Some dishes even offer a choice of dressing flavors from the Pattaya or Bangkok branches.
However, I personally think the packaging could be better. The rider delivered a long distance, and some of the fried shallots fell out of the box.

My recommended menu item at this branch is the fried soft-shell crab with garlic. I especially like the spicy salad here; the soft-shell crab is larger than at most other restaurants, the meat is juicy, and it's incredibly satisfying.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jira

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've heard good things about this restaurant for a long time, ever since it first opened at the Cartech gas station in Pattaya. I hadn't been there for years, until they finally opened in Bangkok.

The management is excellent, the ingredients are fresh, and the sauce is rumored to be a bit too sweet. From my own experience, I think it's well-balanced: sour, salty, spicy, and sweet. The glass shrimp sauce is different from the usual sauce, more intensely spicy. The fried food is served quickly and not too salty, just right.

As for the price, I think it's worth it for the quality of the food. Overall, I'm impressed. The more friends you invite, the more diverse the menu is. I highly recommend giving it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: suwanchai sukkanalak

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten here in Pattaya during COVID, but they couldn't sit down, so they only had takeout. The taste was average. Now that they've opened a branch in Bangkok, I'm back to try them. I have to say they're incredibly delicious.
• Glass shrimp in fish sauce, with a choice of two dipping sauces.
• Fried chicken
• Spicy fried pork neck salad, very delicious.
• Spicy salmon salad, delicious.
• Fried pork belly, delicious.
• Roasted squid eggs, with a choice of two dipping sauces, delicious.
• Spicy cockle salad, the least delicious of all the dishes I've ordered.

Overall, it's delicious, I'm hooked. The price is reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: attpocari

sample_reviews_en.text:
Finally got to eat here! I've been to Chonburi many times but never been to the original After Yum branch.
This time, I came to the branch at The Crystal, and it was surprisingly quiet. After finally getting to eat, I have to say the flavors were amazing! I chose the three-flavor dressing with fermented fish sauce for the fried pork neck salad. The fermented fish sauce wasn't too strong...it was very refined. As for the marinated shrimp, it was crispy and sweet...the fish sauce had soaked into the shrimp. Eating it with pickled garlic...I'm definitely coming back for a second and many more times to this restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wariya Wongsuriyanan

restaurants.name: A-Goo Crab Fried Rice
restaurants.address:

406 Chan Rd, Wat Phraya Krai, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to try the famous crab fried rice. I also tried the spicy and sour pork soup.

◾️Crab Fried Rice
It's so simple and rustic, I think they don't use any MSG, really bringing out the natural flavor of the ingredients. I liked it. The taste is milder than crab fried rice at other restaurants.
The texture is among the best I've ever had in Thailand.

◾️Spicy and Sour Pork Soup (Hot and Sour Soup)
Even though I don't usually like spicy food, I was able to finish it all, even though I was sweating.
The menu, which includes English, doesn't list it as 100 baht, but the Thai sign inside the restaurant says it starts from 60 baht, which is plenty for one person.
The pork is tender, but since it's the leftover meat after the broth has been extracted, it's not juicy and tender, but rather a bit dry.

Personally, this drink made my tongue tingle, making it difficult to appreciate the delicate flavor of the crab fried rice. So, if you don't like spicy food or want to fully enjoy the crab fried rice, the regular boiled pork ribs might be a better choice.

In any case, it's delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: PINOKO

sample_reviews_en.text: There used to be days when it was delicious, but on the days I bought it, I had a feeling it wouldn't be good because the cook had their phone glued to their ear, talking from before they started cooking until it was finished. The taste was never consistent. Sometimes it was so delicious I wanted to come back for more, but I was always disappointed. The plump female foreign employee was constantly on her phone. It's like, "I wish I could buy lottery tickets that are this accurate!"
sample_reviews_en.author: WATER KHING

sample_reviews_en.text:
The crab fried rice is bland, more suitable to be eaten with side dishes than on its own.
The bitter melon soup is good, the goji berries are sweet and delicious, and the cilantro enhances the flavor.
The pork ribs are tender and juicy, easily falling off the bone, very delicious.
The crab fried rice comes without any side dishes.
Parking is available on the street in front of the restaurant. On even days, park on the restaurant side; on odd days, park across the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirad Sreerattana-arporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Disappointing fried rice. The crab fried rice was so tasteless and dry, not sure why the rating is so high. Their tom yum goong was not bad though, I like how they allow you to add the chilli yourself to adjust the spiciness level to suit your tastes.

However, the stall is right by the main road so it can get quite noisy and uncomfortable with all the car emissions. Would not return.
sample_reviews_en.author: GG K

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice little Street Stall with small like restaurant inside.
The food is very fast and somewhat tasty. Not the best fried rice but very cheap price for an on the go kinda of day.
The place is very near a busy street so you get that urban noise of cars and motorcycles while eating.
The staff doesn't know English but you have a English menu to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: Luís Tiago

sample_reviews_en.text: I was looking for cheap , local fried rice - without the seafood smell . Was a bit hesitant about the crab fried rice bt it was the best Ive had ever and absolute worth for money. They dont do anything apart what they have on the menu( i asked for chicken / egg fried rice) but also because its worth trying their menu! Do give it a go :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Nithyashree Gopu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fried rice with various toppings:
Including crab, barbecued pork, Chinese sausage, or crab meat.
Good taste, fragrant wok aroma.
Generous portions.
Soup is available to order to sip on.
Including spicy and sour pork rib soup (Leng or Ribs),
or bitter melon Leng (a mild but flavorful soup).

The only downside is the parking situation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Unexpert

sample_reviews_en.text:
📌📌📌

For 2 people:
Crab fried rice 180.- + Chinese sausage 20.-
I actually wanted to add more crab meat, but they were out.
So I added 6 shrimp instead (15.- each).
Tom Yum Goong (clear soup) 100.-
**They were very generous with the chili fish sauce! 👍🏻👍🏻

Crab fried rice 450.- Recommended for 3-4 people.
sample_reviews_en.author: R B

restaurants.name: SUSHIRO
restaurants.address:

ฺB floor, เซ็นจูรี่ เดอะ มูฟวี่ พลาซ่า สาขา อนุสาวรีย์ชัยสมรภูมิ, 15 Phaya Thai Rd, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400

sample_reviews_th.text:
I went to the Otoro Festival.
120฿ → 30฿ is too cheap. Sushiro's staff are well trained, and with this quality at this price, there's no way anyone can beat them. They're amazing.
Although this store was crowded, I was able to get in more easily than at other stores.
sample_reviews_th.author: チャッキー

sample_reviews_en.text:
In Japan, you're used to sensory overload. It's the same here. Everything is moving, you order food on a tablet, which, when you're selecting your meal, resembles a children's game.

As soon as the food arrives via its own conveyor belt, music starts playing, and the order is displayed on the tablet. Everything is gamified. But what can I say? The concept works, and I really enjoyed it.

I can't comment on the taste in other branches (I haven't been to a shopping mall that doesn't have a sushi restaurant yet), but the food here was top-notch. The selection of sushi is almost extravagant compared to what we in Europe understand by sushi. Seven types of tuna alone, in numerous unfamiliar variations, the sweet shrimp, and the tempura pumpkin were divine.

We've never had rice like this before. It was definitely the best sushi we've had outside of Japan. You'd think raw fish and rice always taste the same until you try something like this.

You can expect to pay around 350-500 baht per person, plus a 10% service charge.

On the plus side, water and genuine matcha green tea are provided free of charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sam Masghati

sample_reviews_en.text: The Pokemon promotion was absolutely ridiculous. They're incredibly greedy for customers' money, especially the soda at 120 baht a glass, with a completely random selection of Pokemon balls without any disclosed ratio. They don't even tell you if a particular branch has all the Pokemon you want. If it's truly random, it should be sealed in a container that staff can peek into. It's not transparent at all; it feels like a gamble. I drank several glasses throughout the promotion, spending thousands of baht just on drinks, and still didn't get all the Pokemon I wanted. And the Hyper Ball was practically nonexistent... The Gungal chicken sushi was incredibly salty; it felt like paying 60 baht a plate for future dialysis...
sample_reviews_en.author: Astray Max

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's no surprise that this branch didn't have a queue. I saw no queue, so I drove here on purpose. I thought chain restaurants would all have the same standards, but they didn't.
The first issue with this branch was the air conditioning wasn't cool. I don't know what temperature they set it to. I asked the kitchen staff to help me cut the squid, as I had a small child who couldn't bite through it himself, and there were no knives or scissors provided at the table. The staff member said he wasn't being harsh and called the manager. When he arrived, he was rude and asked what the customer wanted. Even a manager like this should be addressed immediately. This branch is unacceptable. It's terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ben Shoi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The is next level sushi restaurant due to the food ordering&serving system. Just submit order via tablet and the foods are automatically served right at your table next to you. There is a variety of imported fishes and seafoods with one of the most cost-effective ways I have ever seen. Also, drinks are free here like hot and cold water, or even green tea.

What I dont like is the queuing system, I got a queue at 19.50 and need to wait 30 mins until 20.20 get seated, while there were many available tables. What's that supposed to mean??? I dont know why they kept me waiting ???? Deduct 2 stars

Recommended: Clam, Ark Shell, Hotate, Scallop, Tunas/Bluefins, Tuna with soy sauce marinate
sample_reviews_en.author: Ssy

sample_reviews_en.text:
I like the salmon, fried chicken, milk tea, scallops, and fried shrimp.
The tuna isn't fishy, ​​and the special menu items are reliably fresh.
The restaurant is in the basement next to Tops. The queue isn't long.
The staff always give good recommendations before the meal.

Why are they so polite and soft during the introductions, but then shouting so loudly during the welcome that it fills the whole restaurant?
If you like that, then go ahead and eat there, but my boyfriend didn't like it, so we haven't gone back.
Edit: My friend went recently and the welcome wasn't so loud anymore. It was great!
sample_reviews_en.author: Natta M

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ate there today and was very impressed!
The restaurant is on floor B.
When we went around 3 PM, it wasn't crowded.
The staff asked if we had been there before.
We said no, and they explained everything clearly, which was great.

If you have any further questions, you can just ask the staff.
They were very helpful, not rude or dismissive at all, and always smiling.
They gave good recommendations and the service was excellent.
Overall, I was very impressed!

The food was fresh, as expected from the restaurant.
I will definitely come back to this branch again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: N

sample_reviews_en.text: The famous Sushiro restaurant has opened in the basement of Century Plaza. There was a bit of a wait due to the large number of customers, but they managed the queue quite quickly. They use iPads for ordering, and food arrives on a conveyor belt at prices of 40/60/80/120 baht depending on the dish ordered. I liked the matcha powder available to brew with hot water at the table. Plain water can be ordered from the staff and is very cold, as many reviews mentioned. The taste was delicious and the prices were reasonable. Overall, it was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิชชพงศ์ อริยสุนทร

restaurants.name: บ้านผักปลายสวน
restaurants.address:

Nakhon In Rd, บางกรวย Bang Kruai District, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Baan Phak Plai Suan restaurant is located near the Rama V Bridge. After crossing the bridge, drive to the intersection (do not go over the overpass), then go straight to the traffic light. Drive straight for about 200 meters, and the restaurant will be on your left. You can park along the roadside. The menu is extensive, ranging from rice dishes and noodles to Khao Soi, Nam Ngiao, Pad Thai, and much more – a complete selection. They also have snacks like traditional Khanom Krok (Thai coconut pancakes), fried tofu, fried taro, and various sticky rice desserts. They also offer fresh coffee and many other drinks. The food is delicious and doesn't disappoint. The milk tea, however, isn't particularly amazing but is standard. The seating is comfortable and the atmosphere is nice and unique. The restrooms are clean and up to standard. The service is excellent and attentive. I give this restaurant four stars. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
sample_reviews_en.author: ลุงเอี้ยมแดง Uncle red apron

sample_reviews_en.text:
For the main course, I ordered rice with spicy catfish curry, a fried egg with a runny yolk, and stir-fried vegetables, served with chili fish sauce.
It was excellent. Followed by Khanom Jeen Nam Ngiao (rice noodles in a rich broth) with pork bones, minced pork, dried chilies, and pickled vegetables – a truly authentic Northern Thai dish from the owner. The taste was spot-on.
I finished with Khanom Krok (Thai coconut pudding) with spring onions and taro filling – I'm not sure if that's dessert or good news!
The same shop also has a coffee counter where you can enjoy a hot cup of coffee while soaking up the natural surroundings and the midday sun, getting your dose of Vitamin D.
Then I went back to work.
sample_reviews_en.author: narong Tawee

sample_reviews_en.text: Came to eat on a rainy day. Walked into the shop, there were about 10 employees, no one took orders. At first, sat at a table. After a while, walked over and asked where to order food. The employee said to sit and wait, someone would come and take orders. After 10 minutes, no one came until having to call, even though there were hardly any people in the shop. Ordered chicken over rice, found a steel wool to scrub the pot!! The employee went to change it. Came again, the mushrooms were extremely sour, more sour than lemon. Very disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tk Pond

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has delicious food, a nice atmosphere, and it's not too hot. There are several zones. Parking is on the side of the road. The pork leg with basil is delicious. The meat melts in your mouth. The Pad Thai isn't soggy. The spicy pork rib soup is also delicious. The price is not expensive. The food comes quickly. There's fresh coffee, traditional Thai coconut pancakes, and Khao Soi. The service is quite good and friendly. The traditional coffee is delicious and not too sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: เฮียกวง ชอบรีวิว

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food selection is diverse, with à la carte and single-dish options.
The taste is okay. I tried several dishes; the pork leg rice and noodle soup were very good. However, the Khao Soi (Northern Thai curry noodle soup) wasn't quite to my liking – it was too spicy and not well-balanced. But the rest of the dishes were tasty.
However, most restaurants charge separately for each dish, which can be inconvenient.
The staff were diligent, hardworking, and friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alice Dp

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a great atmosphere and a wide variety of delicious food. They offer à la carte dishes, central and southern Thai curries, rice noodles, and various other dishes. It's a garden-style setting, and the staff are all very friendly. They also sell fresh vegetables and fruit at reasonable prices. Parking is available along the roadside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Janny Pat

sample_reviews_en.text:
You probably remember me. When we went out to eat today, when we were paying, you said to the waiter, "Why don't you go get the food for that guy first? He can wait here. He won't die." I stood there speechless.

The words and tone of voice kept playing in my head. The speaker never remembers, and the listener never forgets.
sample_reviews_en.author: ICE BR

sample_reviews_en.text: This rice and curry and à la carte restaurant is spacious, like sitting in a garden, and offers other menu items as well. The food is prepared cleanly. My favorite is the fried rice with mackerel and kale; it's incredibly delicious! I often go there for breakfast. Highly recommended! 🙏👍 …
sample_reviews_en.author: IDENTITY CONFIDENCE

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited on November 18, 2023. The price of alcoholic drinks didn't match the menu; it was listed at 590 baht, but the bill came to 640 baht. When I mentioned it, the staff member told the cashier that they were going to create a new menu, …
sample_reviews_en.author: นิพิฐพนธ์ เทศน์ธรรม

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is good, the atmosphere is great, and there's live music. The portions are generous, not just small servings. The food is flavorful and spicy. The restaurant has both air-conditioned indoor seating and outdoor seating for smokers. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasion G. Ta

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish was delicious. We ordered the traditional glass noodle salad, small somtam, grilled beef with chili sauce, fried pork belly with fish sauce, and fried rice with rice. The restaurant has a friendly atmosphere and live music.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kapook

sample_reviews_en.text: So disappointed the service and timing of servers 🙄 . The dishes came one by one finish even we had waited for like half an hour. The taste is so so. The atmosphere is not bad with the live band.
sample_reviews_en.author: natphatsorn lersiriphong

sample_reviews_en.text: I really love the glass noodle salad! The stir-fried pork with rice and the stir-fried salted beef with rice are excellent, not too greasy. It's a cozy atmosphere. They also have live music. …
sample_reviews_en.author: T P

sample_reviews_en.text: A restaurant that has been open for a long time. The atmosphere is quiet and not too noisy, but you can sit for a long time. The food is delicious and the price is not expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Art Art

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food with reasonable price, Cozy atmostphere bar, good live music and friendly welcome service from little black cat 💛✨🖤 highly recommended 👍🏻👏🏻🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Paarada Suksiriwattana

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious. Mmm, really delicious.
It felt like having dinner at a friend's house. The owners were very friendly. …

restaurants.address:

Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually order delivery, but today I wanted to try eating at the restaurant for a change of pace. This is my first time at this branch. The staff were lovely, the service was good and friendly. The restaurant is spacious and conveniently located near my house with parking available. Today I ordered New York pizza, which was on a buy one get one free promotion – a great deal! There was also a promotion for a large bottle of Pepsi for 32 baht, buy one get one free. We ate the pizza between two people and had leftovers to take home for several more meals.
sample_reviews_en.author: เมนกา ม้วนหน้า พาเพลิน

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited The Pizza Company at The Park, and it was a pretty standard experience. The pizza, pasta, and wings were all good, just as you’d expect from The Pizza Company. The flavors and presentation were consistent with their usual quality.

The restaurant wasn’t busy, so the service was quick, and the staff was attentive. It’s a reliable place to grab a casual meal without any hassle, especially when you want something familiar.

Overall, it’s a solid choice if you’re looking for a typical Pizza Company experience in a relaxed setting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukawat Keratimanoch

sample_reviews_en.text:
I called to order pizza, but the staff didn't want to answer the phone.
Why? There weren't any customers in the store.
I paid for my order, I wasn't asking for anything. Terrible attitude.
I called 4-5 times and they didn't answer. When I went to buy it in person, there wasn't a single customer. Terrible. Do the staff choose their customers? I want to know.
sample_reviews_en.author: ราตรี สาคร

sample_reviews_en.text: This pizza place has excellent service and prepares pizzas quickly. Currently, dine-in is not available (due to the third wave of COVID), but you can order for delivery. If you're passing by or live nearby, I recommend trying it. It's located around Bangkok Kreetha, Bang Kapi area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthaphon Poh

sample_reviews_en.text: Very slow service. The staff is more busy to do deliveries than take care of customers that come to the restaurant. Waiting time for pizza over 30 MN. The staff is also not so nice to customers when they are a bit slow to order. more training required.
sample_reviews_en.author: Philippe Suthimai

sample_reviews_en.text: We shop at this branch regularly. The staff provides good service, but the new staff should receive more training. They're still making mistakes when taking orders. Our order was even incorrect, but they were happy to correct it when we called.
sample_reviews_en.author: นภัสวรรณ ใจหมั้น

sample_reviews_en.text: I bought pizza to take home today. This branch's pizza tastes great, looks appetizing, and the wait wasn't long. The staff provided good service, the order was correct, and they weren't confused like typical fast food restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: CoCo Glam

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff at this branch lack training. When I ordered delivery and the item was out of stock, they didn't solve the problem and then pretended to be ignorant, letting the customer argue with the rider. Very bad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kate Cat

restaurants.name: Siam Nora
restaurants.address:

66 ซอย สุขุมวิท 31 แยก 4 Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a good dinner here with the southern thai dishes.

We had similar dishes in other restaurant and this place has their own unique flavours to these dishes.

Seabass yellow curry was very spicy even tho we asked for normal spicy but thats typical southern spicy i guess 😅
My thai wife who rarely wants very spicy food said this needs to be spicy to really enjoy it. Ingredients fresh ! The staff will ask you how spicy u want it so if u cant handle thai spicy then ask for less spicy.

Squid with pearl garlic was delish . I love this dish and the shrimp paste and pearl garlic with kaffir lime leaves really pops the flavours in this dish. Well done.

7 southern pungent noodles has stinky beans and cha-om. Well seasoned glass noodles and pearl garlic made this dish very tasty overall.

Seasonal veg was just nice. Not too heavy on the seasoning.

Overall good experience. Decor is modern and bright for their ground floor tapas and bar area and you get some old school charm in the old house where we dined.

Service : friendly

Food service : good pace

Seating : indoor air conditioned / open air courtyard for ground level.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wilfred Spykerman

sample_reviews_en.text: Wow, what an exceptional experience.We came here for our last night in Thailand. I can't say enough how phenomenal everything was..... first the cocktail menu, was seriously the best drink menu I've ever seen.  Our first server/bartender gave detailed history of the ingredients and areas of thailand they inspired. We had a few appetizers,  duck spring rolls,  tod mun -fish cakes,  and their glass noodles. All were outstanding. For main dishes,  we had a few curries and the crispy sea bass and that was definitely a highlight.  You can see the passion that went into renovating the house and the care that went into developing the menu. The service was attentive and just the whole experience is something I will miss when we go back to the states. Bravo to Siam Nora for creating something so memorable!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Siri Cerber

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really enjoyed the Khao Yam Sawoey (rice salad). It was packed with ingredients, flavorful, and fragrant with herbs; you could really taste the authentic Thai flavors. Other dishes I tried included Tom Pae Sa (steamed fish soup), Moo Ruan Kapi (stir-fried pork with shrimp paste), Kung Pad Sataw (stir-fried shrimp with sataw beans), and Gaeng Massaman Khaem Met Khanun (lamb massaman curry with jackfruit seeds). Each dish had a distinct flavor and character.

I personally appreciated that the food here didn't try to be bland in taste, preserving its Thai authenticity. It was a meal with clear flavors and many interesting details to try, especially for those who love Thai cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Norah S

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food here is amazing! We came early on a Friday night and it wasn’t busy, so we had constant attention from the staff. Their recommendations were excellent, we tried the crispy duck spring rolls, madame bulan style coconut noodles (pad Thai with a coconut flavor!), southern shrimp and chili relish with local vegetables, and my favorite was the grilled half rack of pork ribs.

The portion sizes are generous and we barely had room for dessert - stuffed coconut dumplings in coconut milk, and along with ice cream.

They have received a Michelin star for 9 years running, and it’s well deserved. Prices are also reasonable. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ty Burgess

sample_reviews_en.text: An exceptional early dinner at Siam Nora in Sukhumvit 31. The restaurant is situated in a beautifully preserved heritage house, striking a perfect balance between traditional warmth and a clean, understated aesthetic. The kitchen executes Central and Southern Thai cuisine with absolute precision. The flavors are unapologetically bold and authentic, yet the presentation remains sharp and minimalist. Opting for an early seating meant the ambiance was quiet and the service was highly efficient. A highly polished, well-run establishment that delivers on quality without unnecessary pretension.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ali B

sample_reviews_en.text:
I highly recommend this restaurant for its excellent food, cozy atmosphere, and attentive service. The dishes are always fresh and flavorful, with a great variety suitable for different tastes. The environment is comfortable and welcoming, making it a perfect place for family gatherings, casual dining, or special occasions. Overall, it offers a very satisfying dining experience and is definitely worth visiting.
Special thanks to Shar for providing outstanding service throughout the dining experience. Friendly, attentive, and professional — truly made the visit even more enjoyable.
sample_reviews_en.author: brenda tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a wonderful dinner at Siam Nora Dining with my friends today. We ordered several dishes including the fish, squid, tom yum, and starters — everything tasted really good and full of flavour.

Knowing that the restaurant is by Chim by Chef Noom, a Michelin-star chef, I honestly feel the price is very reasonable for this quality. The food presentation is nice, ingredients are fresh, and the taste is very authentic and refined.

Definitely worth visiting. Highly recommended for anyone who loves quality Thai food in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eric Ng

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really enjoyed our meal here. The food was super nice, especially the tom yum and the whole fish dish. The flavours were rich, balanced, and not boring at all. Every dish we ordered was cooked very well.

For a restaurant connected to Chef Noom, the price is actually very reasonable. You can taste the quality and effort in the recipe, but the pricing is still friendly compared to many high-end Thai restaurants.

Good food, nice dining experience, and worth the visit. Will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leong Mun Hoe

restaurants.name: Chef Man (Wireless Road)
restaurants.address:

2/4 อาคารบีดีเอ็มเอส เวลเนส คลินิก ห้องเลขที่ 22-44 ชั้น จี Witthayu Rd, ลุมพินี Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I've used other branches before and liked them. This was my first time trying this branch to celebrate Mother's Day. I was surprised that this wasn't the famous Chefman. The service was generally okay, although slow and out of order despite having informed them of the menu in advance as requested. The quality and taste of the food were vastly different from other branches and need improvement. Another thing I'd like to suggest fixing urgently is the tableware; the spoons were extremely dirty, not just a few, but the entire table of 10. They should be replaced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Voravut Wongkaew

sample_reviews_en.text:
As a regular customer at Chef Man, I've given this branch a try several times, but I believe the food quality still doesn't compare to the hotel branches.

The first two times I thought it might be just the day, but on my fourth visit, I'm certain the food quality isn't as good as other branches.

The service is good, but I'd like to see improvements in the food's taste. Out of 10 people in my group, everyone agreed.

There's a minimum spend of 15,000 THB to use the private room; a room charge applies if the minimum is not met.
sample_reviews_en.author: Norah S

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is as delicious as ever. This branch seems to fill up slower than others; if other branches are full, you can reserve a table here. Parking is available in the basement; take the elevator up. The restaurant is located on the main road and has a nice atmosphere. The prices are standard for Chef Man restaurants, comparable to other branches. If you want to order Peking duck, you must order in advance; you cannot walk in and order it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Namae May

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste isn't as good as other branches.
The char siu pork is delicious and juicy.
The jellyfish is bland.
The honey char siu pork pie doesn't have a flavor and smell that goes well with the char siu pork.
The char siu pork bun is normally delicious.
The fried fish is hollow, dry, and sweet.
The xiao long bao has little filling; overall, it's just average.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karoong kungzZ

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my second time here since last September.
The food is elegant and lightly flavored - delicious.
You need to make a reservation in advance for the Peking duck! There's only one type of Shaoxing wine, and I had it by the bottle. If they had an aged wine, it would be even better - I also enjoyed the dessert. It's perfect for entertaining.
sample_reviews_en.author: HIROSHI IIO

sample_reviews_en.text: The food on the menu wasn't outstanding enough to be amazing considering the price. Some dishes were below par for the chef's standards; for example, the seafood XO noodles were too mushy and broke easily. The best and most worthwhile dish was probably the Peking duck. The dim sum was very average.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wichatchaya Chong

sample_reviews_en.text: This is arguably the leading Thai-Chinese restaurant. Must-try dishes include the Snow Mountain Buns, with a flaky crust and juicy char siu inside, and the Fish Maw Noodles, featuring large, creamy fish maw with a wonderfully emulsified texture. We also recommend ordering broccoli with the sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Frank Fu

sample_reviews_en.text: The first restaurant was full because we didn't have a reservation, so we went to this branch instead. Every dish here was absolutely delicious. I was so hungry that I forgot to take pictures, except for the fish maw noodles, which were incredibly tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kuan Yu Chen

restaurants.name: Upper T
restaurants.address:

ตรงข้าม 711/1 Charoen Rat 7 Alley, Bang Khlo, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
for food, I would like to give 4.6 because the tasty of some menu ,"หมูฮ้อง", is not similar to the original.
BTW, I loved atmosphere and staff is so friendly.😊
sample_reviews_th.author: PannPatt Hi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is fantastic. This restaurant is hidden away amidst a lush green garden in the Rama 3 area, offering a peaceful and relaxing feeling. It's perfect for families, couples, or friends.

I was impressed with the restaurant's homemade food, especially the pizza – the homemade dough is freshly baked, fragrant, soft on the outside and perfectly crispy on the inside. The fresh pasta is made daily, chewy and soft with a rich, delicious sauce. Recommended dishes include the clam and cheese pizza and the fettuccine with bacon. The Apple Crumble is also delicious, served warm, a perfect way to end the meal.

Another favorite feature is the private room on the second floor, ideal for birthday parties, meetings, or private gatherings. The atmosphere is friendly, and the staff are attentive and provide excellent service.

If you're looking for a restaurant with a great atmosphere, delicious food, and beautiful photo opportunities in the Rama 3 area, I highly recommend trying this place! 💚
sample_reviews_en.author: Jantornthanee Pisittiporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had such a lovely time at Upper T Restaurant in Bangkok! The food was excellent – ​​I especially loved the Italian sausage ravioli and the pork chop with its creamy mushroom sauce. The garden is beautifully maintained and creates such a relaxing atmosphere. There's also a separate brunch menu, and the dishes here are very well plated and thoughtfully prepared. Highly recommend this place if you're looking for good food and cozy vibes in the city. 🌿🍷 There is also some wine on display for drinkers.

I was very impressed with my visit to Upper T Restaurant. All the dishes were delicious, especially the Italian sausage ravioli and the pork chop with creamy mushroom sauce, which were incredibly flavorful. The garden atmosphere was very well maintained and relaxing. They also have a separate brunch menu, and each dish is beautifully and meticulously presented. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking for delicious food and a comfortable atmosphere. 🌿🍷
sample_reviews_en.author: natsasidech _222

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant offers Italian Fusion and Thai home-cooked dishes, perfect for those who like to try new things at mealtime. It's a one-stop shop for both flavorful and spicy Thai food and mild, balanced Italian fusion cuisine. I tried several dishes today:

- Caesar Salad: Crisp, refreshing vegetables, delicious dressing.
- Crab Cakes: Another recommended dish. Delicious when eaten hot. The crab meat is firm inside, and the spicy seafood mayo dipping sauce is amazing!
- Salted Fish Spaghetti: Excellent pasta, the salted fish is so fragrant it makes your stomach rumble 🤤
- BBQ Pork Ribs: Served with french fries. The ribs are marinated intensely, tender, juicy, and fall off the bone.
- Garlic Bread: Absolutely delicious! Perfectly baked, crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, buttery, not dry or rough. They even sell it in packs so you can bake it at home. Brilliant!

Next time I'll try their Brunch! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: ไปนู่นไปนี่ฉันจะตีก้นเธอ Facebook page

sample_reviews_en.text:
This fusion restaurant, serving both Western and Thai food, is located behind HomePro Rama 3. There's parking available. The restaurant isn't very big, but there are private rooms. The staff are attentive, and all the food is delicious.
- Soft-shell crab salad: Fresh and crispy vegetables, large pieces of soft-shell crab.
- BBQ pork belly: Very delicious. The pork is tender, and the dipping sauce is excellent, with a tangy flavor similar to ponzu sauce.
- Pesto risotto with salmon: A large portion. Adding a little salt and pepper helps balance the richness.
- Steamed halibut with soy sauce and fried noodles: A family favorite. The fish is tender but firm, similar to cod. It's delicious with the fried noodles.
- Grilled lamb: A large piece, well-grilled. My dad loved it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittitouch คลินิกทันตกรรมบ้านสีขาว โคราช

sample_reviews_en.text:
🥗 Looking for a delicious Italian-Thai home-cooking style restaurant in the Rama 3 area? I highly recommend Upper T! They have a wide variety of dishes, comfortable seating, and a warm, inviting atmosphere. Perfect for groups of friends or families. They also have a diverse drink selection.

🍴 Dishes we ordered:
🍜 Salmon Salad
🔹️ Stir-fried River Prawn with Chili and Prawn Roe Pasta
🔸️ BBQ Pork Ribs
🔹 Coconut Pudding
🍹 Pinky Berry

🍝 The food is delicious, portions are generous, and the prices are reasonable. Everyone will be full and happy!

⏰ Opening Hours
Brunch 11:00 – 15:00
Dinner 17:00 – 22:00

*Parking available
sample_reviews_en.author: Wilaiporn Khruasri

sample_reviews_en.text:
🥗 Looking for a delicious Italian-Thai home-cooking style restaurant in the Rama 3 area? I highly recommend @upper t! They have a wide variety of dishes, comfortable seating, and a warm, inviting atmosphere – perfect for the whole family.

🍴 Today's Menu:
🔸️ Spaghetti Carbonara
🔹️ Braised Pork with Egg
🔸️ BBQ Pork Ribs

☕️ Café: 08:30 – 16:30 (closed on Monday)

sample_reviews_en.author: 2littlebosses

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish was delicious, both the Western dishes. The lamb was grilled just right and fragrant. The spaghetti carbonara was delicious. The Italian roti was delicious and not too greasy. The Thai food, the fried shrimp with salt, was very delicious. The shrimp was fresh. The service was good and the price was reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Petcharee A.

restaurants.name: Praya Bar
restaurants.address:

1680 Banthat Thong Rd, Rong Mueang, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "The food is extremely bland and overpriced, small portions."

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located at the intersection, on the 4th floor. You need to take the elevator on the side of the restaurant. I'm not sure about parking because we live nearby and walked there.

There are both air-conditioned indoor seating and outdoor seating. The weather was nice and cool the day. We chose to sit outdoors before; it was very relaxing with pleasant music at a good volume. The atmosphere is great, as it's opposite Chulalongkorn University's 100th Anniversary Park, so it's quite spacious. I heard they have live music from Wednesday to Saturday.

The cocktails are delicious. We went during happy hour and tried several, and liked the cinnamon one the best.

The staff were helpful and provided good service.

The food is reasonably priced and tastes good.
sample_reviews_en.author: b sakura

sample_reviews_en.text: Intimate setting here on the second level. Both outside seating and a great bar with tables in close proximity to the performing musicians.Fine food and beverages, attentive service.Easy to have conversations and enjoy the live music vibes. Make reservations ahead as there is magic happening here. To give one bearings of where Praya bar Bangkok is you just need look out from the terrace and Chulalonghorn University is close at hand .Easy to relax, enjoy friends company, and take in a great music performance. Plan on spending  a couple of hours here. The headliner/ guitarist/ vocalist is quite well known for his Elvis Presley impressions and pure voice.This was one Enchanted evening at Praya !!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Greg Alexander

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's such a beautiful place in a nice location with gorgeous decor, great vibes and good music. Food was great and it was such an amazing deal we got from Hungry Hub. It was really cheap and we couldn't even finish all the food coz it was a lot!

It's too bad that the team was not well trained if at all. Staff were rude, almost seemed like they hated their jobs. Table was full of empty dishes and glasses and they didn't fill it or clean it unless you asked for. Mind you there were only 3 tables at the time of service.

They have a lot to offer but we would never go back there. It's ashamed really.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tan Lueng

sample_reviews_en.text: I recently visited Praya Bar in Bangkok. The bar has a calm and relaxing atmosphere, perfect for adults to enjoy a drink at their own pace. The staff were polite and friendly, making me feel comfortable even though it was my first time there. The cocktail I ordered was beautiful to look at and had a great balance of flavors – I was very satisfied. I highly recommend it to anyone looking to relax and enjoy a drink. It's also a perfect spot for a date or to end a trip.
sample_reviews_en.author: tk tk

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good cocktail. Was there with our clients. The bar has very good lightings. Very comfortable the ambience. Very good service, by the owner. We wanted to sit for 1 hour. They let us have a reserved table for 1 hour. Flexibility is very important in food & beverage business. Very good. Another thing which is very very good. They have one of the Top 10 cleanest toilet I ever seen in Bangkok. Thumbs up. Good toilet means good management. Will be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Asia Apparel Neo

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've tried On the Rocks cocktails in many places and countries,

but this one at this bar is truly my number one favorite. The bartender was amazing; his recommendations were simply superb! 🫶🏻🫶🏻🫶🏻

It's so well-balanced. The aroma comes first, it's smooth on the sip, but still has a distinct character. After drinking it, I understand why such a simple cocktail can be so memorable.

It's a drink I finished and immediately wanted to order again. 🥃🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: Baitoei Surasit

sample_reviews_en.text:
✨ Praya Bar Bangkok: 10/10 Vibes! ✨
The ultimate trifecta: amazing atmosphere, mouthwatering food, and flawless service! 🥂
From the photo-ready "Light My Fire" neon lights to the cozy, stylish interior, the vibe is absolutely unmatched. Add in ice-cold drinks, delicious spicy shrimp, and staff that treats you like a VIP, and you've got the perfect night out in the city.
✅ Great Atmosphere
✅ Delicious Food
✅ Excellent Service
🌟 Highly recommend! 🌟
sample_reviews_en.author: Nalinee B

sample_reviews_en.text:
I asked for a cocktail recommendation, and the waiter (a confident-looking male waiter with glasses) said, "I already wrote it down." Then he asked, "Can't you say it again?" I sat there for an hour, and he came over to ask if I wanted anything else. I said no, but he kept pushing the menu. Seriously, couldn't I just sit down first?

I spent 1600 baht for an hour and was kicked out. I just needed to vent a little.
sample_reviews_en.author: zaikaew jokkaew

restaurants.name: Buckys Burgers n Buds - Open 1pm to 6am
restaurants.address:

Pratumnak Soi 5, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Nice American style little diner, delicious cheeseburger 🍔 with fried egg ฿159.

Friendly and welcoming staff, perfect pit stop for one’s late night snack!!
sample_reviews_th.author: Ziggy Stefaño

sample_reviews_en.text: I gave 5 out of 5 for atmosphere as there is no reason to blame the restaurant but during the day it is a building site so we got our order to go. We can’t both want a nice venue and complain when they are being built so 5 out of 5. I enjoyed a double cheeseburger and fries and while my partner had a single bacon cheeseburger. The bacon cheese burger is good but the star of the show is the beef which is show cased into elegant simplicity of the double cheeseburger. That is the order, let good ingredients and masterful cooking do the talking. We carried our food home via motorbike and it did not suffer at all from the trip. There are “try hard” burgers to be found on Soi 5, they have their place. But if you just want a solid, tasty burger accompanied by McDonalds cloned fries stop by Buckys
sample_reviews_en.author: mike casey

sample_reviews_en.text:
I dislike writing reviews but this place should honestly be looked at by a health inspector.

The staff is unpleasant and clearly unhygienic. The use of gloves is completely meaningless when they handle money and food interchangeably, right in front of customers. Basic food safety standards are simply not being followed.

The smash burger was a greasy disaster — not juicy, but so oily it was literally wet and soggy. Heavy, unpleasant, and borderline inedible.

If this is what they’re comfortable doing in plain sight, I seriously question what happens behind the scenes. Very poor hygiene, very poor quality. Avoid.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mena Soci

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just disappointment. Pretty advertising and nothing more. Not tasty cheeseburger, dry, got a rotten lettuce leaf. Not enough filling, uninteresting sauce. The price for this wretchedness is clearly too high. 169 baht is too much. Maximum 80 baht and I would not eat it anymore.
For the sake of experiment, I ordered another cheeseburger down 100 meters the street at the cafe "I like burger". 100 baht. And it is juicy and has a lot of vegetables, the bun is normally colored and toasted. Not food of the gods, but definitely tastier than the first cheeseburger.
sample_reviews_en.author: E R

sample_reviews_en.text:
I felt peckish and needed a good burger since I only had a tuna salad earlier for dinner. It was already late (as in 11 plus); I asked ChatGPT where I could have a good burger in Pattaya. Buckys Burger was its response (open till 6am).

I took the bike immediately and rode 8.6km to this Buckys location eventhough the Walking Street outlet was nearer.

I ordered the bacon cheeseburger (169 baht) and 6 small pieces of chicken wings (99 baht). The bill came up to: 268 baht (with tax).

Damn, the burger was awesome! My wife also loved her spicy chicken wings.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adrian Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: The smash burgers here are next-level. Perfectly crispy on the outside, juicy and flavorful on the inside. Every bite was packed with deliciousness. The toppings were fresh, the sauce was flavorful, the buns were soft and buttery yet held everything together perfectly. Try the wings too, the sauce is the perfect mix of spicy and sweet. The service was welcoming, fast and friendly, and the atmosphere was real chill, making it a great spot to hang out with friends. Definitely my new favorite burger joint! And when you finish check out what's upstairs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Devin Johnson

sample_reviews_en.text: Om nom nom. The burgers where so good. The lady who made our burgers most nights we where there was amazing. She was so nice and the food was so good. 10/10. Honestly couldn't find a fault and that's rare! The dispensery upstairs is also great the Russian guy who normally works there is easy going and not pushy like most you find in other shops. Can't wait to come back just for a burger!!🍔Our selection was only so expensive becuse we fatties and added patties 😂😂
sample_reviews_en.author: lee

sample_reviews_en.text: The burger was pretty good but expensive for what it was. One irritant was the fact that on then menu is one price but when you try to pay, VAT is added which means you pay more than you expect. Very underhand tactics and possibly not legal. The chap making the burgers was surly and didn't actually speak. It's a shame that while the food tastes good, everything else means I for one will not return and I would not recommend ithis place to anybody.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ian

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍜 Clear broth pork meatball noodles in the middle of Soi Sinthawee (Rama 2 Soi 43)

🥢 An old and classic favorite among locals.
Open from evening until 11 PM. The place is bustling with people until closing time.
🙍 Mostly regulars who come in to eat and chat.

Price 💰 Regular 40 baht, Special 50 baht

sample_reviews_en.author: Paopao Studio

sample_reviews_en.text: This pork noodle shop is worth driving a long distance to eat at. The pork meatballs are delicious, the broth is flavorful, and the chili vinegar is just the way I like it. The owner is incredibly friendly, as you can see from the customers who come to chat with them. It's fun to watch the owner talk to the customers while you eat. However, finding parking can be difficult.
sample_reviews_en.author: Modern Premium ผู้ผลิตสินค้าพรีเมี่ยมอันดับ 1 ของไทย

sample_reviews_en.text: This is another great pork meatball soup shop in Soi Sinthawee 16. The broth is delicious and unique, fresh, clean, and perfect for frequent visits. It tastes good whether you add seasonings or not. Overall, everything is excellent. I recommend trying it; you won't be disappointed. Open daily except Sundays. 40 baht per bowl, reasonable price.
sample_reviews_en.author: jate SATHON BK

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pork meatballs are delicious and I really like them; they're homemade.

sample_reviews_en.text: It's so delicious! If you like clear broth noodle soup with meatballs, I highly recommend this place (the best in the world!). The staff are all very friendly too.
