restaurants.name: Punsuk Vegetarian
restaurants.address:

34 Pom Prap, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re searching for a true hidden gem in Bangkok, this Thai vego spot deserves to be at the very top of your list. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted by friendly, smiling staff who made the experience feel welcoming and relaxed. The restaurant itself is spotless, with a clean and cozy café vibe that instantly sets the tone for a memorable meal.

The star of the show was without doubt the duck curry with rice — hands down the best curry I’ve had in Thailand. At only 110 baht, it felt like an absolute steal. The curry was perfectly spiced for me (I love it hot!), but if you prefer a milder kick, just mention it when ordering. The flavors were sensational: rich, aromatic, and beautifully balanced, with tender duck and those delightful little Thai eggplants adding texture and depth.

It’s rare to find a place that combines affordability, authenticity, and such a warm atmosphere, but this restaurant nails it. If I ever return to Bangkok, this will be my first stop without hesitation. Thank you for such an unforgettable meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: Natasha Mackintosh

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is vegan, even though it's called "Vegetarian." All the menu items are listed as "plant-based." The restaurant is located near Chinatown, a little further north.

The concept is twofold: there are daily specials from the counter (cold) and à la carte dishes. The menu didn't match most of the menus listed here on Google Maps; for example, there were no curries like green or red curry. Instead, there were many dishes with meat substitutes and vegetables.

I opted for the "Curried Rice." The dish consisted of various meat substitutes with potatoes and carrots in a very thin curry sauce (no coconut, just oil and spices). It came with rice. It sounds simple, but it tasted delicious.

The prices are also fair and reasonable, although a bit higher than local non-vegan street food stalls.

Overall, I was satisfied with my visit to this restaurant and would recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Timo Daedrich

sample_reviews_en.text: Fully vegan restaurant in the Chinatown area. Seems like they specialize in Sushi and Japanese cuisine, but they also have some Taiwanese, Chinese, and Thai options. I didn’t try the sushi this time, but seems that’s what most people order. I went for a Chinese style seaweed soup and Thai tofu skin salad - both were delicious. Portion sizes were huge - very generous. Prices are a bit high for what it is, but not too bad. They have some frozen vegan protein for sale as well as some vegan snacks and vegan ice cream and popsicles. I had a durian popsicle that was awesome. I’d definitely go back and try some of their sushi dishes next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Guy Braverman

sample_reviews_en.text:
Unfortunately, I arrived just before closing time (due to traffic), but they were so kind and didn't rush me. I quickly ate half of my meal and had the rest packed up. Several older women were serving. With a little bit of app knowledge, gestures, and a touch of openness to new things, you can definitely get a delicious meal.

I ordered: noodle soup (excellent), Pad Thai (a bit different from what I was used to, not as green and colorful, but tasty), and the fried duck (it was okay, but I'm generally not a big fan of meat substitutes).
sample_reviews_en.author: Wolkenschrubber

sample_reviews_en.text:

My husband managed to eat some of it, but I honestly don’t know how, I felt sick just trying it. I would not recommend this place.

Highly recommended.

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good service and a nice ambiente, the food was amazing and we even visited 2 times in our 4 day stay in bangkok. We especially liked the papaya salad and the pad thai. You have to try!

sample_reviews_th.text:
Kokie Nomsod Pattaya (戈吉牛奶) is a vintage-style milk shop offering a variety of milk and refreshing sweet drinks. They feature pure fresh milk, pink milk, milk tea, and generous toppings. The flavors are smooth, perfectly sweet, and ideal for those with a sweet tooth or looking for a refreshing and chill street drink in Pattaya.

⏰ Opening Hours: Daily 4:00 PM – 9:30 PM

#KokieNomsodPattaya #โกกี้นมสด #ร้านนมสดพัทยา #PattayaDrink #พัทยา #Chonburi #เครื่องดื่มเย็น #นมสดพรีเมียม #CafePattaya #สายหวาน #StreetDrink
sample_reviews_th.author: Facebook / TikTok : Check In

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the opportunity to visit during Songkran.
We stopped by a little later in the evening, with light rain falling. Luckily, the restaurant wasn't crowded due to the festival. We waited about five minutes to clear and set up tables, and then we were able to seat 10 people.
There's a wide variety of delicious dishes to choose from. For dessert, we ordered fresh milk, kaya toast, ginger-flavored bua loy, and tau tung.
The fresh milk and steamed kaya toast were incredibly delicious.
The other dishes were all delicious and reasonably priced.
We ordered a leisurely meal. Overall, everything was excellent.
Everything was delicious, but the tables inside were a bit small due to the rain.
We couldn't sit outside. I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: บุญฤทธิ์ พยัคฆชาติ

sample_reviews_en.text:
This shop is super cute! (100% adorable!)
The staff were very friendly and polite.
We arrived late, so we called to let them know we were coming. They waited for us. We arrived at 9:15 PM. The desserts were delicious; the shredded egg yolk toast was amazing, the flavors blended perfectly. They also have custard buns with various fillings that we tried. The orange pudding was tasty, the grass jelly was excellent, and the white moss milk was delicious, fragrant, and creamy, though a little too sweet. Overall, it was great! Very impressed. We'll definitely come back to eat here again when we're in the area. Loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pannakorn Nakhorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
This fresh milk toast shop is located in the mosque compound. Parking is available.

On the day we arrived, it was drizzling. There were only about 6-7 tables inside. There were several more tables outside, but they were wet, so people were crowded inside instead.

The bread was okay. The Thai tea filling was fragrant and toasted. The drinks were rich, but lacked a strong milky aroma. It seemed like other ingredients had been added to the milk, such as Dreamy powdered milk or artificial creamer. The prices were reasonable, similar to other shops.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sariya S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This cute shop is located inside a mosque. We went on Saturday and Sunday evenings and had a great time. The staff were all lovely, polite, and courteous.
The desserts were absolutely delicious. Everything was delicious. I'm not usually a fan of toast, but this was so good. I ate every bite carefully. It was deliciously sweet, salty, and rich. It was fragrant and not at all greasy. The presentation was so lovely! The pudding wasn't overly sweet.
However, the soy milk was a bit thick.
sample_reviews_en.author: ppave

sample_reviews_en.text:
The dessert shop is next to the mosque.
The desserts are delicious.
I ate there last year, and this time I went back again, and it's still just as delicious. They've even added some new menu items.
This time I had the shredded egg yolk toast, which was delicious and worth the price.
The custard is also very tasty.
The drinks are good too.
If you're passing by and want a late-night dessert spot with reasonable prices, I recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuts B

sample_reviews_en.text: This cafe has a lovely atmosphere, with both indoor and garden seating. The desserts are delicious, including shaved ice, ice cream, steamed buns, toast, and several special menu items. The portions are generous and offer good value for money. Some items might be a little too sweet, but the overall taste is good. It's perfect for relaxing after a meal. There's parking right in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nittakan Thamamnuaykij

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fresh milk is delicious, fragrant, creamy, sweet, and perfectly balanced.
The bread is incredibly soft.
The pudding is also delicious, and the grass jelly is sweet.
The prices are reasonable. Finding parking is a bit difficult. If I have the chance to go to Pattaya again, I will definitely stop by again.

sample_reviews_th.text:
I don’t think they did a good job with Pad Thai. The food just tastes so sweet and nothing else. The prawn is big, but it smells a bit. The wait was quite a bit. I don’t think it is good enough for 120฿.

Overall, fairly disappointing. I wanted to like it, but I couldn’t. If you’re planning to eat at the place with AC by this one though, just eat here. It’s still better.

sample_reviews_th.text:
It was my favorite Pad Thai in Bangkok but in past few months I can feel the taste was different. I always order for the signature dish of the restaurant (ผัดไทยมันกุ้งกุ้งสด) but it was very sweet and noodle very dried and the shrimp are tasteless.
But the good thing is staff are very nice and friendly
I hope they can make it like the old standard.
sample_reviews_th.author: Siwatchaya Kosol

sample_reviews_th.text: It is a good Pad Thai place. I know it is not the most famous one, but it is good anyway. Recommend to add chilli, sugar (บรรดาเครื่องปรุงต่างๆ นานา) into your Pad Thai and then order coconut juice. It will be a good meal!
sample_reviews_th.author: Jakrapong Kongmalai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Utterly disappointed. The queue for Jay Fai round the corner was too long and Thipsamai havve yet to open at 4.30 pm. So we decided to give this place a try after reading some positive reviews( now I think people might have mistakenly reviewed their neighbour instead).There were German cockroaches crawling on the wall near the inner tables. The workers seem to think nothing of it. The pad thai standard was not even that of the mall foodcourts. The prawns were stale and I suspect some sort of artificial colouring was used to enhance the colour of the noodles. The portions were also small - not that we want to eat more of it.
So they will continue to thrive from the spill over effects from its more illustrious neighbours. Please dont try as you will surely regret it.
To be fair there were pics of the owner with some celebrities on the wall. But I think that was a distant memory from a long time ago.
sample_reviews_en.author: JC

sample_reviews_en.text:
My husband whose favorite dish is Pat Thai bring me to this place.

Actually I am not a big fan of this menu but once I have ever taste it from the near by restaurant, I realized that this menu is really fascinated.

However, with its small and locally style restaurant could bring to the overlook but the good thing is that there is no long queue here while the taste is great.

I do recommend you guys and also those tourists who love to have the original taste of Pat Thai to visit here.

There are varieties of Pat Thai offered but my favorite one is Pat Thai with shrimp’s fat and prawns on it (Prawn Pat Thai). I could say that this one is the most premium Pat Thai style and also the most expensive one but it worth trying.

Definitely revisit this place and also wish you guys enjoy a very good Pat Thai here.😊👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanjana Chaksangchaichot

sample_reviews_en.text: Perfectly good pad thai at a fraction of the price charged by the famous, Michelin-starred place next door or the astronomically priced, even more famous Michelin-starred joint with the long lines of waiting tourists at the end of the block. This is where local workers come to eat. But for the price, it’s still too high when you can get pad thai of equal quality for half the price anywhere else in Bangkok. Since good ratings and Michelin stars seem to spell the imminent demise of good street food, I’ll do Lueng Pha the kindness of giving it only three stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wayndering

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is next to Thipsamai Padthai Pratoopee. This is another Pad Thai that has been open almost the same time as Thipsamai opened.

The taste is not much different, but it has its own style and is more affordable than Thipsamai. And of course, you don‘t have to wait in long queues that are crowded with foreigners but it is a restaurant that does not have air conditioning and is more like old style.

The staff are mostly elders and may take a little time to do things but the service is good, and the food is also nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ctn Pkt

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible. Was aware there would be a queue from other reviews so this was fine and I was quite happy to wait. But after sitting down it took 45 minutes to be served. All the locals in the restaurant who sat down after us were served first - they clearly weren’t keen on us being there. They also told us they had run out of one of the dishes which they then served to someone else who also sat down after us. Food was average - definitely not worth the wait.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rich Cooke

restaurants.name: Tenjo Sushi & Yakiniku BBQ Premium Buffet (Terminal 21 Asok)
restaurants.address:

88 ศูนย์การค้าเทอร์มินอล 21 อโศก ห้องเลขที่ 4012 ชั้น 4 Soi Sukhumvit 19, Khlong Toei Nuea, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited Tenjo at Terminal 21 Asok and unfortunately had a very disappointing experience.

Several items we were served appeared to be of poor quality, and some seafood, especially the mussels, tasted spoiled. At first we thought it might be the seasoning or preparation, but after trying different dishes we became increasingly concerned about the freshness of the food.

When we informed the staff that one of the dishes tasted bad, the situation became even more alarming. Shortly afterwards, cockroaches appeared on our table, which completely ruined our confidence in the restaurant’s hygiene standards.

We had already eaten most of our meal before realizing there was a serious issue, which left us worried about possible food poisoning. Thankfully, the only compensation offered was a 50% discount, which did not feel adequate considering the circumstances.

We chose this restaurant based on its reputation and expected a much higher standard of food safety and cleanliness. We hope management investigates these issues seriously, as food quality and hygiene should never be compromised.

Unfortunately, we cannot recommend this restaurant based on our experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cynthia Garay

sample_reviews_en.text:
★☆☆☆☆

One of the worst dining experiences I've had in Bangkok.

The fish I was served smelled and tasted as if it was no longer fresh, which immediately raised concerns about food quality and safety.

What made the situation even worse was the hygiene. During my visit, I saw cockroaches inside the restaurant and took photos, which I am attaching to this review.

After I complained, the staff offered me a 50% discount on the bill. While I appreciate that they acknowledged there was a problem, a discount is not an adequate solution when the issues involve both food quality and cleanliness.

Given the location, prices, and reputation of this restaurant, I expected much higher standards. Unfortunately, this experience fell far below what is acceptable. I would not return and cannot recommend this restaurant until serious improvements are made to its hygiene and quality control.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jose Luis Sanchez Espada

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great Yakiniku and Sushi experience! I got seated right away with no wait. Depending on where you sit, you get a nice view too, especially by the window.

The meat tasted great and the charcoal grill worked perfectly, everything cooked quickly and evenly. I had read that some people complained about the grill not being hot enough, but I can't confirm that. Every now and then an order got forgotten, but that's pretty normal for buffet restaurants, it's just part of the experience. The service was otherwise really good.

Two small downsides. The QR code for ordering didn't work for me, a staff member had to give me a hotspot just so I could order. And the plastic cups were a bit disappointing, drinking out of them feels more like a kid's birthday party than a restaurant. A bit more quality there would be nice.

Overall though, a solid experience that I'd gladly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jonny Nie

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food (4/5): The ingredients are of good quality, meeting Tenjo's standards. There's a wide selection of grilled meats, perfect for meat lovers. The sushi looks appetizing and is well-made.

Service (5/5): The staff provided excellent service, attentive, serving quickly, and efficiently coordinating table changes.

Atmosphere (2/5): Points are deducted for the heat inside the restaurant. The indoor area was extremely hot, making it almost unbearable to eat. The grill area was particularly stuffy, forcing us to ask the staff to move us to a table near the entrance where the mall's air conditioning provided some relief. I hope the restaurant improves its air conditioning and ventilation system.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charinrat.N

sample_reviews_en.text: If I could give less than 1 star, I would. We waited 15 minutes for the grill to arrive. The charcoal wasn't strong enough, even with the fan on, it wasn't powerful. There was a lot of ash. We asked for more charcoal and waited almost another 10 minutes. They refused to change the grilling grate, even though they had it ready to be changed. We had to ask 2-3 times. Most of the meat was tough. The second and third rounds of food we ordered arrived very late, almost at closing time. The floor was very dirty. There were baby cockroaches walking on the back of the chairs. The staff removed them, but they reappeared shortly after. Furthermore, the staff were very lethargic.
sample_reviews_en.author: ยุทธพงษ์ จริยาณวัตร

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch has very slow service. Orders are frequently missed, and follow-ups are ineffective. The seating is crowded. Food takes at least 20 minutes to arrive. The only things that come out quickly are the sushi, marinated shrimp, and marinated salmon – but those take forever to cook. The grills aren't hot enough, and the food takes ages to cook. After repeatedly asking the staff about our food, they get grumpy. By the time we left, we found out some of the missing items were actually served to the wrong table. We're done with this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: MA-Praphassorn

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was incredibly slow, the slowest I've ever been to a restaurant. I've never had a restaurant that was this slow before. Time ran out before the food was served. Isn't that unbelievable? The food itself was good, but the service and how they served it were terrible. This is definitely the last time I'll eat at this branch. Other branches never have this problem, but this one is awful. The food service was disorganized and incredibly slow. If they keep managing things like this, they're going to go bankrupt.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noodee Twitter

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food was so-so but staff was incredibly terrible 🥲
only one great staff her name is “Tangmo”
She been so helpful, delightful and served with service mind !
So I couldn’t help myself on tipping her 100 baht ! Cause she earned it !
But other staff were so attitude, grumpy and frowned!
Even when I said “Thank you” they’d grumpy turn around and walk away without any polite response lol
I finished this meal discomfortable 🥲
“Tangmo” staff were the best thing in this meal
!
Oh ! And Bubble milk tea ! Yumyum
sample_reviews_en.author: Griffin Wong

restaurants.name: KFC Seacon Bangkae
restaurants.address:

607 Petkasem Road Bang Wa Sub-district, Bang Wa, Phasi Charoen, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently had the opportunity to dine at the KFC branch in Seacon Bang Khae. I was impressed from the moment I arrived by the clean and organized atmosphere inside the restaurant. The seating area was quite spacious, comfortably accommodating solo diners, groups of friends, and families. The staff were polite, friendly, and prepared food quickly, even during peak hours.

As for the food, the fried chicken maintained KFC's high standards: crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, and with a perfectly balanced, rich flavor. The French fries were freshly fried and hot, and there was a wide variety of drinks to choose from. The meal sets offered good value for money considering the quantity and quality. The self-ordering kiosks added convenience and reduced waiting times.

Another highlight is its location inside Seacon Bang Khae shopping mall, making it convenient to stop by for a meal while shopping or running errands. Overall, it's a well-serviced branch with quality food, a clean environment, and attentive staff. It's ideal for those looking for a delicious, convenient, and value-for-money quick meal in the Bang Khae area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kritsanabas Thongsuk

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. I ordered one thing and received another. When I checked the bill, it was different from what I ordered. I told the counter staff, and they said I had ordered something different and asked if I wanted to change it. I didn't because I felt bad for the back office. Also, there wasn't always someone at the counter, so customers had to wait at times. I saw staff going to put on makeup, which ruined the atmosphere and made me not want to eat. Personally, I've worked in service before, but I've never behaved like this towards customers. I would like to see the staff be trained better. (At times, I even saw them grouping together and chatting at the counter.)
sample_reviews_en.author: 5120ทิฆัมพร ขาวพ่วน

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered tuna corn, but the portion was much smaller than usual, almost half a cup. The staff might have been in a hurry to scoop it out and didn't pay attention to the quantity.
The floor around the drink dispenser was constantly wet, like the ice machine might be leaking or something. There were signs warning customers to be careful, but customers still have to walk there to get drinks. I saw several people slip, but luckily no one fell. There were staff members wiping up the water occasionally.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gook

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered crispy chicken with green curry, but received spicy chicken rice instead. When I asked the staff about it, they said they entered the order as "spicy chicken rice," but I actually ordered crispy chicken with green curry. The staff member seemed annoyed and asked if I wanted to change my order. I didn't want any trouble, so I accepted the spicy chicken rice. The service was very poor, especially the way they spoke to customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sodsai Kongweha

sample_reviews_en.text: I just went there and asked to choose my chicken pieces. The staff said I had to wait 40 minutes, which we knew was a lie because they didn't want me to choose. Normally, fried chicken takes 15-20 minutes to fry, so why would I have to wait 40 minutes? And the staff member had a really grumpy face, like they were upset with someone. Next time I'm going to a different restaurant. Bye KFC Seacon Bangkae, it was terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: MonRa Ly

sample_reviews_en.text: Its a fast food restaurant u cannot make ur guest wait for 40 min for a chicken strip ,if u cant give in time atleast have a decence of offering something else and not waste others time ,very unprofessional staff didnt bother about the order getting delayed haven’t even apologised even once insted of tht laughing not at all good very unhappy with the staff will not recommend anyone to come here
sample_reviews_en.author: Ninad Lad

sample_reviews_en.text: If you want to pay cash, you can just tell them at the counter. You can order that way too. But what if someone wants to pay cash? Don't you think about older people who don't know how to do it? I know how to order through the system, but I prefer to pay cash rather than scan to pay. And then you act so displeased and rude. Please train your staff better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Onanong Maneelertudom

sample_reviews_en.text: It was extremely hot. I ordered the spicy chicken rice bowl and got only 3 pieces of chicken, a tiny bit of rice, and countless pieces of onion. It's nothing like other branches because I usually eat there regularly and know what I mean, but this was very disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: ppiioopp llmm

restaurants.name: Mae Sri Ruen (centralwOrld)
restaurants.address:

Room B 307 - 309 999/9 Ratchadamri Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I always come here for Spicy Chicken Noodle, Seafood Noodle with pink sauce, Thai, Pork Satay and Thai coconut pudding (ขนมครก). Simple, easy and pretty standard for the taste. Fried chicken and sticky rice is nice to have too.
sample_reviews_th.author: Sumol

sample_reviews_en.text:
The portions are quite small, but the food is truly authentic Thai.

Mae Sri Ruen has many delicious dishes, most notably their chicken noodle soup. The prices might be higher than elsewhere, but that's understandable considering the rent. The bowls are small; a woman can eat two or three bowls and feel full. The tom yum broth is delicious. I recently tried their fresh shrimp pad Thai, which was also incredibly tasty. The noodles were chewy and coated in a sweet and fragrant pad Thai sauce – perfect without needing any extra seasoning.

For dessert, their kanom krok (Thai coconut pudding) lives up to its reputation for being fragrant and delicious. Eating it fresh and hot at the restaurant is pure bliss.

The restaurant has spacious seating and good service. However, they only accept cash and bank transfers for orders under 300 baht. Interestingly, the menu states that prices do not include a 10% service charge, but they didn't add it to the bill.

(Update April 2025: The restaurant now adds a 10% service charge to the menu prices. I'm not sure if this was a previous error, but the taste and service remain excellent.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Princess Mia

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been to Maesriruen here and at the ICONSIAM store, and at both locations, everything is delicious - it's one of my favorites. 

Of the dishes I had this time, the pomelo som tam was absolutely delicious. The sourness and spiciness was very refreshing and delicious. My son loves the river prawn pad thai and khom yam, and I always order the au suwan, which is loaded with seafood. 

Their signature dish was originally the chicken-topped kway teow, so their noodles are also delicious. Thank you for the meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: kei natsui

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, the value for money was disappointing, especially the service. Two staff members were chatting behind the counter, doing nothing, even though the serving staff seemed busy the entire time. There were only a few tables occupied, and no staff came to greet us; we had to approach them ourselves. However, the food itself tasted good, particularly the Tom Yum chicken noodle soup, the spicy fried rice, and the seafood stir-fry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ten Kitwarun

sample_reviews_en.text:
BEWARE: Looks can be DECEIVING!!!

Ordered
1. Phad Thai w 2 River Prawns
2. Phad Thai prawn wrapped in omelette
3. Half Roasted Chicken
4. Thai Milk Tea

ONLY THING that tasted DECENT was the river prawn egg gravy.

River prawn was super small.
Both prawns felt too dry (likely overcooked), chicken tasted more like fries and super dry as well.

Did not bother finishing the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kun Yang Goh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Was a nice place to just have some Thai sweet and tea to rest our tired feet from all the walking.
Ka Nom Buang as well as Ka Nom Krok had a delightful sweetness and did not feel heavy at all.

There was not many staff who could speak English, but everybody tried to understand us and it was really heartwarming.

Onlu thing is they didn't have much warm drink options.
sample_reviews_en.author: Minako Ishibashi

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Riceberry Kanom Krok is nice with a lot of coconut milk and some sweetness
- Khaopad Namprik Rong Reau is very spicy but is quite tasty
- Pad Thai with prawn is pretty oily. The chilli sauce is served on the prawn 's head (!?)
- The male waiter keeps on asking why not order this too.. better order that too.. for several times and it is annoying a little bit
sample_reviews_en.author: Duangkamol L.

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent restaurant. Fast and efficient service. I really enjoyed the "Suki" dish. The stress is on the last syllable. "Su'ki." Easy for Russians to remember 😂. The battered shrimp was delicious, but very sweet. We ordered kale in oyster sauce. Also excellent. The kids had crab fried rice and chicken skewers. We also ordered a Thai dessert with coconut - 😋.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ulia Ku

restaurants.name: ข้าวมันไก่ลิ่มซังท่าพระ สูตรโบราณ พ.ศ.2512 สาขาท่าพระ
restaurants.address:

Charan Sanit Wong Rd, Wat Tha Phra, Bangkok Yai, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The flavors are average, tasty but not amazing.
- Boiled Chicken Rice (50฿): The rice is quite oily, the chicken is okay, not dry, the dipping sauce is delicious, and the soup isn't sweet.
- Wonton Noodle Soup with BBQ Pork (50฿): Generous portion, soft noodles, tasty pork, the soup is quite bland but tastes good with seasoning.

The restaurant has no parking. Free water and ice!!
sample_reviews_th.author: P

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere...the restaurant is located by the roadside. There are not many tables. As for the taste, the rice is delicious; it's not too oily and can be eaten plain without dipping sauce. The chicken is neither dry nor overly juicy. The soup is fragrant, made from simmering bones, and tastes delicious without being too salty (the restaurant gives a large bowl of soup, they're not stingy with the broth). Free water is available, but you have to serve yourself. The restaurant only accepts cash, no bank transfers.
sample_reviews_en.author: เมยาวีย์ อิทธิอริยเศวต

sample_reviews_en.text: The special Hainanese chicken rice portion is considerably larger than the average restaurant. The rice is well-cooked, and the dipping sauce is flavorful with a balance of salty, sweet, and spicy notes. I particularly appreciate that you can refill the sauce yourself at your table. The chicken meat is tender and not too chewy, but the skin wasn't quite up to par; it was like jelly, likely not cooked long enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nanthawat Ouysinprasert

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Hainanese chicken rice shop, with its traditional recipe dating back to 1969, sells from 6 AM to 4 AM, with a 2-hour break. It lives up to its name; the rice is delicious, the chicken is slightly dry and crispy like the old-fashioned recipe, and the dipping sauce is also authentically flavored. They give you a generous portion for only 50 baht. Absolutely fantastic!

#ThisShopIsMyFavorite
sample_reviews_en.author: S M

sample_reviews_en.text: The person chopping the chicken was chewing betel nut and not wearing a mask. It was really unacceptable. They were talking on the cutting board all day. But the dipping sauce was delicious and the chicken was tasty. If they make the improvements, I'll come back. My criticism is for the sake of improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: jarungvit lorwicheanrung

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lim Sang Chicken Rice, First Branch, MRT Tha Phra (Soi Christ Church) **Cash only**
Rice: Well-cooked, soft, separate grains, with a rich chicken flavor.
Chicken: Soft chicken skin, beautiful color. Deducted 1 star because the chicken meat was dry.
All the staff at this branch are foreign workers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cityflo Chan

sample_reviews_en.text: The portion was generous, the rice was soft and well-cooked, the chicken was a little dry, the soup was a large bowl and enjoyable to sip, and the dipping sauce was served in a large pot so you didn't need to ask for refills often. Overall, it was a good dish, filling and worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poring V

sample_reviews_en.text: The soup and dipping sauces are delicious, and importantly, they give generous portions, making it great value for the price. I highly recommend it! 50 baht for a filling and delicious meal. If you're passing by and don't stop to eat, you're missing out big time!
sample_reviews_en.author: virit thongsri

restaurants.name: Yakiniku Kintaro
restaurants.address:

4/6 Sukhumvit 33 Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there because I heard they serve raw liver, but the color was completely different from the sample photo.
I wondered if it was okay, but it was just average...
What surprised me was the size:
Is it really that small...?

I ordered the liver rib chop, but the moment I saw it, I knew it wasn't going to be any good.
The tendons were completely intact, with only small cuts.
As expected, it was so hard it was impossible to tear, so I left more than half of it and left after 30 minutes.

I'll probably never come again.
It's expensive, it's all about cash, and there's nothing good about it.
sample_reviews_en.author: m s

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to Shichirin Yakiniku Kintaro.

It seems to have a long-standing, loyal following.

It's located on Sukhumvit Soi 33.

The pork was incredibly delicious, and grilling it over charcoal further enhanced its flavor.

The prices are reasonable, and considering the quality, it's a very cost-effective restaurant.

And what impressed me most was the unique style of the dessert: tomatoes!

It was refreshing and perfect after the meal.

It's a yakiniku restaurant with a relaxed atmosphere where you can enjoy a leisurely meal with friends or family.

I would like to go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: チャッキー

sample_reviews_en.text:
Taste preferences vary from person to person.

The staff were very polite!

Regarding the food:

The liver sashimi didn't look particularly appetizing, but it was delicious with its firm, springy texture.

The other meats had a strong gamey smell.

The kimchi had a sour taste with the natural flavor of the vegetables.

It's not on the cheap side, but the portion sizes are generous, so it might be good value for money if you go with a large group!
sample_reviews_en.author: toh shin

sample_reviews_en.text: The price is 1500 baht per person; please, please, please do not come to this BBQ restaurant. It's not cheap, but the quality of the meat is worse than a 300-500 baht BBQ all-you-can-eat restaurant. The beef is handled terribly; no matter how you grill it, it's still not tasty. It's full of unremoved tendons and membranes, tough and inedible. The quality is truly terrible, and I will definitely not come back a second time.
sample_reviews_en.author: voireJie

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff grilled and cut the Riburos for us, and the pieces were thick and large. They changed the grill frequently, which was great. The charcoal lasted a long time, so we didn't need to refill it. The grilling was done well, but we felt the flavor of the meat wasn't as good as the Jou Karubi. The grilled tongue was nice and crispy. After the meal, they provided a dessert of chilled tomatoes topped with condensed milk.
sample_reviews_en.author: N N (Pom)

sample_reviews_en.text: After walking around the new shopping mall, I went across the street to a yakiniku (grilled meat) restaurant called Kintaro! It looked like a small shop! But from the moment I entered until I left, their service was excellent! Thumbs up! The meat was very good, and most importantly, it was charcoal-grilled! After finishing the yakiniku, they even gave me dessert and iced tea! I'll definitely come again next time!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Gary Ma

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's nice to share with friends; the average cost per person is 800 baht. The staff helps with grilling, allowing me to enjoy my meal in peace.

The meat quality and flavor were quite good. I ordered the No. 31 mixed meat platter, which cost 1310 baht (excluding tax). Today, it came with kimchi, shredded cabbage, and seaweed.

Overall, the food was served very quickly.

No service charge was charged.
sample_reviews_en.author: 普羅大眾

sample_reviews_en.text: It is a yakiniku restaurant, and they serve kimchi and Korean-style seasoned vegetables as side dishes. The food is delicious overall, but it is a bit disappointing that smoking is allowed indoors. The tables are spaced far apart, and since it is a meat restaurant, the smell of grilling meat prevents the cigarette smoke from wafting in, but if the fire goes out, the smoke does drift in a little.😅
sample_reviews_en.author: Kensuke Ueda

restaurants.name: PESTO Pasta and Espresso Osteria
restaurants.address:

Ramada By Wyndham Sukhumvit 87, 9/1 1st floor, Sukhumvit 87 Alley, Bang Chak, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Unfortunately this was the wrong place to choose for my final night in bangkok,  the wine at 350 baht a glass had an offer of 2 for the price of one but the glass was effectively half a glass!! The bruschetta for starters was OK.  Sadly things went downhill from there as I ordered the lasagna,  which was probably the worst lasagna I have ever tasted.  In fact  I don't know how they have the ordacity to call it lasagna.  It was simply a few layers of not very nice pasta with a beef sauce  surrounding it on a plate. Needless to say I couldn't  finish it!! When I ask to speak to the manager  the waitress  did not understand so I did not  pursue that.  Hardly  surprising the restaurant was empty given the exorbitant cost of the poor quality food .
sample_reviews_en.author: Eddie Scraggs

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food was microwaved, pasta just fell apart in your mouth, overcooked, no bite to it. Didn't look like the pictures on the menu.

The coffee is INSTANT coffee... not coming back here again. Which is a shame since it's a nice-looking restaurant and the staff is good too.

The sodawater with lemon was nice.

Management has to change the policies and train the people to serve quality food & coffee that matches the prices they have on their menu.

I don't usually write reviews, but the value equation felt way off here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rutger Gommans

sample_reviews_en.text: So I went to this restaurant to have the buffet breakfast and I can tell you that this is not terrible at all! They don't even have the basic which would be scrambled eggs... I'm very surprised that a big group like Wyndham approve such a poor quality... Then out of curiosity I went to check the review of the hotel itself and I understood that this hotel is poorly managed... I'm just happy that I'm not staying in this hotel for my trip in Bangkok, the standard should be a lit higher for a big chain like Wyndham!
sample_reviews_en.author: makri achour

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cozy little spot with excellent pasta and coffee. I came for brunch and really enjoyed everything – the soup was rich and comforting, the pasta was cooked perfectly al dente, and the bread and olive oil were a nice touch. The coffee was smooth and well made, not bitter at all.

Service was friendly and attentive without being intrusive, and the atmosphere is calm and relaxed, perfect for a slow meal or a coffee break. A lovely place if you’re looking for good Italian-style food and espresso.
sample_reviews_en.author: ChuLuxe Explorer

sample_reviews_en.text: So so good! Great experience at Pesto restaurant! We ordered the burrata salad, the pesto gnocchis and the 4 cheese pizza. Everything was delicious especially the gnocchis. Totally homemade, melted in the mouth and the pesto made with thaï basil was so appetizing. Same pesto was used on the burrata salad and the taste was so refreshing. More over the team is nice and the atmosphere very relaxing. We recommend this restaurant 100%
sample_reviews_en.author: Quentin Durant de Saint André

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was small cozy restaurant, location is 5 min walk from Onnut station : the food was average we ordered rocket salad, pesto fettuccine and chicken Parmigiana. The pasta was cooked too long and lack of cheese. Unfortunately This place doesn’t know concept of Italian restaurant, they didn’t give any complimentary bread. And the live music is way too loud.
Price reasonable and service was ok. Not sure if I want to go back
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattareeya T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a cappuccino, and it was absolutely first-class. Simply fantastic!

I work in an authentic Italian restaurant with very good coffee, and this one was excellent!

The coffee was absolutely fantastic!

The food on the tables next to me looked good, especially for an Italian restaurant abroad.

Unfortunately, I didn't have time, otherwise I would have loved to eat there.

The service was very friendly!
sample_reviews_en.author: Samuel Koch

sample_reviews_en.text: Came for lunch. The male waiter had an air of arrogance with him during his entire service. No smile, annoyed face. The female waiter was so much kinder to us. Perhaps the male waiter needs more training or if he doesn’t like the job, he should quit. Absolutely pathetic. Been here twice and unfortunately won’t be returning. Food was 4/5.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suren Raj

restaurants.name: Ale House - Riverside Bar
restaurants.address:

Ale House - Riverside Bar 123 Charoennakorn, Krung Thon Buri Road, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We contacted the bar via Instagram to ask if we could reserve a table for the evening of the Champions League final. We received a reply stating that there were no more tables available outside, but that we could reserve one inside. I accepted after three minutes and therefore assumed we had a reservation.

When we arrived at the bar on time, our reservation couldn't be found in the system, and we were told there was no table available. After arguing with three different employees for 5-10 minutes, we were finally offered a table outside.

When we sat down, we had to ask for a menu, and no one apologized once for the apparent mistake someone had made with the reservation.

Throughout our visit, we observed several tables remaining empty. Why were we then repeatedly and explicitly told that there was no table available for us?

We sat in the bar for about two and a half hours. During that time, we weren't asked once if we wanted to order anything else or if everything was okay, even though our drinks had been empty for a long time.

For this extremely poor service, you pay 270 baht for a beer (including service and tax), which makes this bar an extremely expensive bar in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noah Jerie

sample_reviews_en.text:
We frequent this bar. They've recently reopened after renovations, and when we visited a few days ago, the bar looked much better than before, but the prices were significantly higher! There's a 20% discount for the first month.

The service was excellent. The bar faces the Chao Phraya River, and the view of the passing boats is absolutely stunning! Definitely worth a visit! This is a review from two years ago.

Tonight, June 4th, 2026, we came back for drinks. Manager "Off" was so nice! We were very happy with "Off's" five-star service, which made for a pleasant evening. The other staff were also super nice.

Thank you for your excellent service!

The beer here is especially good, the bar environment is super comfortable, and the decor is stylish yet cozy. There are many TVs, making it a great place to watch sports! 👍👍 Highly recommended!

We'll definitely be a regular customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jess戏说国际旅居

sample_reviews_en.text:
​I wanted to give 5 stars because the place has a lot going for it, but a couple of frustrating incidents spoiled our night. My wife and I stepped away to use the restroom, leaving our bags and belongings at our table. A staff member ran after us demanding we pay the bill first, assuming we were walking out. Once I explained, they pointed us to the indoor restroom, but I wish they had checked our table first. To make matters worse, we ordered two more beers after that which were never served. It turned what should have been a wonderful evening into a disappointing one, and we likely won't be back.
​It’s a shame because the rest of the staff were lovely, welcoming, and friendly. Plus, the Happy Hour promotion (99 THB for a draft beer) is a great deal for a venue like this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thet Htet Aung

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a fantastic time at Ale House - Riverside Bar. The atmosphere and the river view were stunning, but what truly made the evening memorable was the exceptional service. I want to give a special shout-out to a staff member named Film. She is incredibly beautiful and kind, providing service with a genuine smile that made me feel so welcome. Her hospitality added a special touch to my visit. Highly recommended!"
sample_reviews_en.author: Juhyuk Kang

sample_reviews_en.text: Let me start by saying absolutely great food and drinks. But most importantly the service from Pao, Toy and Nobi beyond exceptional. Very friendly, professional and suggestions about the menu spot on. My wife and I felt comfortable and relaxed. The staff made the whole experience 5 stars. Thanks to Hilton for having a great spot to have a few drinks great food and good conversation with staff. Go Knicks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Larry Searles

sample_reviews_en.text: A lovely evening spent with family, enjoying live music and a view of the Chao Phraya River. Everything was delicious (burgers, Caesar salad, and fish and chips), the setting was very pleasant, and the service was incredibly friendly. Thank you to Nobi and his colleagues for their hospitality. We'll be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Céline

sample_reviews_en.text: Great food and drinks right on the river close to iconsiam.. Bartender - NOBI was really friendly and did everything to make my visit comfortable.. the show all English/european football matches here - three screens at the bar inside and a big screen outside.. perfect for a pint and a PM match😀😀 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Olav Solholm

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're looking for a sports bar with a great atmosphere by the river, I highly recommend this place. The screen is huge and the picture is crystal clear – it's incredibly satisfying! The staff are all lovely, and they have a full menu of food and drinks. I loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lookpat Zuza

restaurants.name: BBQ FUSION
restaurants.address:

33 Rama III Soi 48, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Disappointing Dining Experience in Bangkok

Rating: 1/5

Title: Avoid this place!

We visited BBQ FUSION during our recent trip to Bangkok from India, expecting authentic INDIAN AND CHINESE CUISINE . Unfortunately, our experience was a disaster.

Food:

·	Tasteless and uncooked dishes
·	Starters took 55 minutes to arrive
·	Main course was inedible due to undercooking

Service:

·	Severe staff shortage
·	Inattentive and slow service
·	Orders were delayed, and requests were ignored

Ambience:

·	Average decor, but cleanliness was maintained

As travelers, we were excited to try local flavors, but BBQ FUSION failed to deliver. For a city known for its culinary excellence, this restaurant fell short.

Recommendation:

Avoid this restaurant unless you're willing to compromise on taste, quality, and service. Bangkok offers countless better options.

Details:

·	Date of visit: 13th September 2024
·	Location: BBQ FUSION
·	Cuisine: INDIAN & CHINESE

Tips for the management:

1.	Improve staffing levels.
2.	Focus on quality and taste.
3.	Enhance service efficiency.

Until then, we'll take our business (and appetite) elsewhere.

Would not recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Somya Vyas

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is incredible and one of the best Indian fusion restaurants in the world. They serve a variety of food from Indian to Indo-Chinese to Lebanese and every recipe is distinct and has its own flavor profile. They have a sliding spice scale and can adjust all of their dishes and our kids loved the hakka noodles, gol gappa, and of course the gulab jamun.

I genuinely could not identify which dish is my favorite because they were all so good but I highly recommend the daal makhni (which has rajma and an excellent flavor depth), corn fritters, and paneer or chicken tikka masala.

Their table serving is very unique as they have a hot grill built into the table to keep grilling the tandoori kebabs.

The thing that really sets this restaurant apart is the owners Mani and his wife who take so much care of each customer. It's no surprise to me that most of their customers are repeat customers. We can't wait to go back!

If you are looking for a party venue, this is your spot. They can host 100+ people and have an excellent staff who will take care of your guests. 10/10.
sample_reviews_en.author: Priya Gulati

sample_reviews_en.text:
From its name, you would never guess that BBQ FUSION is an Indian restaurant, though it does incorporate a mix of Chinese influences.
The restaurant focuses on serving delicious finger foods and light grilling right at your table. However, since there is no exhaust system like in a Korean BBQ restaurant, the smoke tends to fill the entire room, leaving those at non-grilling tables smelling of smoke as well.
Another highlight is the large wooden dance floor, a nod to the fact that Indian people love celebratory gatherings.
We came for a meal of Indian-fusion dishes, many of which were what the restaurant considers "Indian-Chinese." As Chinese people ourselves, we said, "This isn't Chinese food!" while our Indian companions insisted, "Yes, it is!"😆
The restaurant is excellent at accommodating both vegetarian and non-vegetarian guests without requiring any complicated requests.
The food's presentation gets a solid 8 out of 10. As for the taste, it was a bit hit-or-miss; some dishes were very delicious, while others were less so.
Parking is only available on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aey Angel

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently celebrated my son's birthday at BBQ Fusion, and I can't say enough about the fantastic experience we had! Geetu Jee and her team went above and beyond to make it a memorable celebration.

Geetu Jee personally ensured that every detail was taken care of, from rearranging the seating to create a spacious atmosphere to ensuring that the ambiance was perfect for the occasion.

The food was absolutely delicious! Every dish was prepared with care and attention to detail, and it received rave reviews from all our guests.

What stood out the most was Geetu Jee's dedication to ensuring that everything ran smoothly. Her professionalism and commitment to customer satisfaction were evident throughout the entire event.

I highly recommend BBQ Fusion to anyone looking for a perfect venue for their special events.
sample_reviews_en.author: Samir Roul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Family run Indian restaurant with great potential for big groups and functions.
Great service, very attentive staff, professional throughout.

Menu was extremely extensive, so i choose from the special set menu, specifically the mutton curry set. Plus a side of chicken tikka.

The chicken tikka BBQ was superb, and the dhal, roti, and rice was very nice!
While the lamb was a touch dry, the sauce was pretty decent.
Furthermore, the sweet lassi was exceptionally good because of their signature blend of cloves and special spices of the orient.

Consider making a reservation before arrival.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oliver Farrington

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the Non-Veg Live Grill on the table, including succulent pieces of paneer tikka grilled live. The whole experience was truly delightful, watching the smoke rise as the skewers were slowly cooked to perfection. The flavors were rich and well-balanced, and the live grilling at the table added an interactive and enjoyable touch to the meal. BBQ Fusion truly delivered on both taste and atmosphere, making it a wonderful dining experience. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy delicious grilled dishes with a unique presentation!
sample_reviews_en.author: Litesh Dhir

sample_reviews_en.text:
**Rating: 5/5**
**Title: A Culinary Delight!**
I recently dined at BBQ FUSION and was blown away by the authentic flavors and vibrant dishes! Grills were super amazingand the butter chicken was creamy and perfectly spiced, and the garlic naan was the best I've ever had—so soft and flavorful! The staff were attentive and friendly, making our dining experience even more enjoyable. Highly recommend this gem for anyone craving delicious Indian cuisine!
sample_reviews_en.author: Deepak Bhatt

sample_reviews_en.text: Worst food you might get diarrhea after eating the food that's how we felt every dish has same taste it must be because of the gravy they add in every dish is almost the same pathetic table service waiter jumps at your table if you ask something as if he's ready to begin his very last marathon of his life it's too quiet place not because of the architecture the real reason is no customers
sample_reviews_en.author: New Outlander

restaurants.name: Lim Kwong Meng
restaurants.address:

294 ซอย จุฬาลงกรณ์ 15 Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Hidden legendary Tae-jew Chinese resturant
฿฿

Legendary Tae-jew food with reasonable price. I recommend Chinese raw fish. Their technique is quite similar to Japanese sashimi. No unplesant blood smell.
They are good at fried dish also. The taste is quite light (no MSG?) with firing aroma.

Comparing with price and quality, this is one of my favorite Chinese resturant.
sample_reviews_th.author: Pichet Wattanapreechanon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lim Kwang Meng, Samyan, Rama IV Road
Next to Samyan Mitrtown
A Chinese seafood restaurant offering a wide selection of Chinese dishes. Popular dishes include shark fin, roasted pork, and more.
Fish head in a hot pot with taro soup: The sea fish head in a thick, rich soup.
The fish is fresh and the soup is incredibly thick and delicious when slurped hot.
Stir-fried duck tongue with Hong Kong kale: Chewy duck tongue and crispy kale.
Ham wrapped in goat skin with fresh bamboo shoot salad dressing. This is a unique dish. I've never tried it before. The ham is wrapped in soft goat skin.
Dipped in salad dressing and served with fresh bamboo shoots.
Oyster omelet, fresh oysters, stir-fried with eggs dry.
Topped with chili sauce, delicious.
Cold pork leg with chili and lime sauce, tender.
Dry-fried fish maw: Authentic fish maw, stir-fried dry and delicious.
Stir-fried deer with black pepper: The deer meat is tender and has no unpleasant smell. The black pepper is well-seasoned.
The chilled chrysanthemum tea is refreshing. Restaurant prices are reasonable.
Thank you, P'Hook OSK101, for this meal.
Taste: 8, Price: 6
Ingredients: 8.5
Cleanliness: 8
Service: 7.5
sample_reviews_en.author: KALPHAPON POLWACHARAPAT

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lim Kwang Meng Restaurant, a long-established restaurant in the Samyan area.

Wanting to try Chinese sashimi, this is the place to go. The fish was incredibly tender, and dipping it in the sweet and sour sauce enhanced the flavor. The sesame seeds added texture.

Another appetizer that impressed me greatly was the sesame oil jellyfish. It was unbelievably good; the salty flavor and fragrant sesame oil made it a great starter.

Next was the Hong Kong style fried noodles. It was a little too salty, but the base flavor was delicious.

The steamed fish with soy sauce was excellent. The fish was large, and the generous amount of vegetables, ginger, chili, and scallions made it incredibly fragrant.

And of course, the roasted suckling pig was a must-try. The skin was perfectly crispy and not chewy, while the meat was incredibly tender – perfect for older adults! 😆

Parking is available at Samyan Mitrtown or the Samyan parking lot; 2 hours for a flat rate of 20 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Usanisa P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered the 2 person menu from the menu card showing off their long history of being in the news, both tv and newspapers. After we got our food it was clear why the latest news was 10 years old.
The free cashew nuts were incredibly dry and tasteless. The shrimp spring rolls were tasteless and just gave an odd taste. The Tom Yum soup had a decent spicy flavour with good shrimps, but had way too many inedible vegetables, which just meant you were digging around for the yummy bits.
The digging continued with the fried chicken and cashew nuts. Out came a soaky dish with a bunch of chicken which was either very old or from the very cheapest parts of the chicken. So we were once again digging around for the few yummy cashews.

Do not go here. Try real Chinese food in the EmQuartier center
sample_reviews_en.author: Nick C.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Chinese restaurant has a warm and inviting atmosphere, perfect for families, especially those with elderly members. The staff were attentive from the moment we called to make a reservation, confirming that we had a table on the second floor and asking if it was convenient for us to walk up. ☺️

The food tasted great, perfectly reflecting the Thai-Chinese palate. The menu is diverse, and the "small" portions are actually quite large, with plenty of leftovers to take home for several meals.

Parking is available in the Samyan Mitrtown parking lot. The restaurant is located in a side street; just walk out of the building and you'll find it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Navaporn Luengluepunya

sample_reviews_en.text:
Teochew Cuisine

Huo Sae: Teochew-style raw fish sprinkled with toasted sesame seeds, served with plum sauce. Soy sauce and wasabi are available upon request. Side vegetables include cucumber, radish, pickled radish, and pineapple.

Chilled Ham Wrapped with Goat Salad…Tong Ee Ya
This dish undergoes several processes to achieve its intricate appearance, served with an ancient dressing. A favorite!

Large Teochew dumplings with a unique Teochew aroma, served with fried garlic.

Ee Mee…Teochew Crispy Noodles
Topped with ham and chives, seasoned with sugar and soy sauce before eating.

Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside taro snow ice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Montana Twinprai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wow, the better half wanted Chinese this evening and this one popped up, very traditional qnd authentic as it could be 😁.

FOOD: lovely, good portion size, very good ingredients, well prepared, very delicious 👍. 9 / 10.

SERVICE: we came rather late and was the only table there. The service was excellent, the advice the recommendations were all on point. 9 / 10.

FACILITY: a little dated but has good house keeping. I believe there are 2nd floor too. Parking could be a little challenging. 7 / 10

PRICE: very reasonable, there are choices for plate size, very convenient. 8 / 10.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panu Tatirat

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very old school Thai Chinese Teochew restaurant recommended by a close Thai friend of mine.

The roasted suckling pig dish is simply delicious.  The pig skin is crispy n go well with the steam bread, cut cucumber, pickled ginger slices, etc.

A good share for at least 4pax as it is about ThB 2600.

The owner, 2nd generation, is a very friendly young man. We got talking n learned about his upbringing fr the Bangkok Chinatown!
sample_reviews_en.author: Keehong Lu

restaurants.name: Lee Kitchen
restaurants.address:

710 26 Sathu Pradit 58 Aly, Bang Phong Phang, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a legendary Chinese restaurant serving high-quality cuisine. Recommended dishes include the fragrant and delicious bamboo shoot soup, as well as their desserts. Located within the hotel, it offers ample parking. The atmosphere is reminiscent of an old-fashioned Chinese restaurant, reflecting its heritage, while the flavors of the food are well-suited to Thai palates. There is a wide variety of à la carte dishes to choose from, catering to individual preferences.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hangseam Bannarakna

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old, established Chinese restaurant. The food is delicious, but the prices reflect the high quality of the ingredients.
The Peking duck with basil stir-fry, recommended by the chef, is incredibly tasty and flavorful.
The crispy noodles in gravy are delicious and rich in sauce.
The hot, crispy fried Chinese dates for dessert are also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Our Memories

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the service was great, and the atmosphere was simple yet peaceful and clean. There's convenient parking, making it easy to eat even when it's raining. It's also wheelchair accessible as there's an elevator from the parking level right in front of the restaurant. I was impressed with everything. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: M&M

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a truly delicious dish, you absolutely have to try it. Despite the long and arduous journey from one end of Taiwan to the alleyways of Bangkok, it was absolutely worth the price of admission. Even my grandchildren said it was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cheng Andrew

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I took my family out for a meal. The food was delicious and high-quality.
Chef Lee himself oversaw the meal and was very friendly. The staff provided excellent service. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Kan Tira

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious, especially the radish cake and the salted fish with rice. I've never tasted anything like the kaloji dessert anywhere before.
sample_reviews_en.author: MoTTol KT

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a restaurant that's difficult to find and difficult to go to for Japanese people on business trips, but all the food was incredibly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: kazuyuki nakagawa

sample_reviews_en.text: Shark fin soup is delicious and fragrant, living up to its reputation. Don't forget to try the radish cake too; it's incredibly tasty!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nut Kung

restaurants.name: Zaab Eli (แซ่บอีลี่) – Little Walk พรานนก
restaurants.address:

ชั้น 1 อาคาร E 517 Phran Nok Phutthamonthon Sai 4 Rd, Bang Phrom, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I gave 4 stars, but this is actually one of my favorite branches. I usually visit every two weeks. But today, something happened at this branch. The taste has completely changed. Every dish was too salty. Even worse, the chicken curry with fermented fish sauce had a strange smell. I was very disappointed today. When I asked the restaurant, they said the food team was only here today, which confused me even more. The food team tasted every dish, but the taste from a month, two months, or three months ago was so much better. It was so much more balanced. This tasted salty and lacked any other depth. I had to add extra lime to several dishes. Please check your ingredient storage and reconsider adjusting the flavors of this branch. Otherwise, I'll really regret it, because before, it was so impressive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cho C

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of my favorite Northeastern Thai restaurants because the flavors always suit my taste. I have my go-to dishes that I order every time I go. While the taste might vary slightly between branches, this Phran Nok branch consistently delivers excellent food. There are many dishes I always order, such as the grilled honeycomb wrapped in banana leaves, which has a wonderful pandan aroma, and the Luang Prabang papaya salad, which is incredibly flavorful. You can order these two dishes without hesitation. I also really enjoy other dishes like the grilled Wagyu beef, which is incredibly tender.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naja Namotasa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Zaap E-Lee Little Prannok

The food maintains the brand's high standard of taste, just like at other branches. The food is delicious and flavorful, in the typical Isaan style, and fresh vegetables are provided free of charge.

However, I would like to see improvements in front-of-house management, particularly the communication skills of the manager, who speaks loudly and impolitely, and even argued in front of customers, which negatively impacted the dining atmosphere. Otherwise, the food and service were excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rose

sample_reviews_en.text: Zaap E-Lee, Little Walk Phran Nok branch, offers a diverse menu. Food is served quickly, with minimal waiting time. The staff provides good service. The taste is excellent, and the quality is worth the price. It gets crowded in the evenings; it's better to go later in the night when it's less busy. I usually eat at this restaurant, and the taste is consistently great across all branches. There's ample parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattawipa SaeTae

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was flavorful and delicious, but the grilled chicken took a while to prepare because it was being reheated. I recommend ordering it in advance. A minor complaint: the service was slow; dishes that came out of the kitchen first were served later.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ochin Orapan Hengarepone

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, though slightly on the high side. The Jaew Hon (spicy dipping sauce) was amazing, not too spicy. There was a bit of a wait for the soup, but the other dishes came out very quickly. The honeycomb and grilled …
sample_reviews_en.author: lplplplplp

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate at Zaap Eli's newly opened Phran Nok branch and everything on the menu was delicious! The staff were lovely, and the service was fast and efficient. Very impressed! ✨✨😍😍👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻👏🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Rujirat Sera-ard

sample_reviews_en.text: Clean, delicious, and good service. The fermented fish sauce and shrimp paste are excellent. The sticky rice is soft, and the chili paste is superb.
sample_reviews_en.author: Onweena Patta.

restaurants.name: Mustard Indian Kitchen & Bar
restaurants.address:

SV City , Spicy Mall, Rama 3 Road SV Tower G41 900/31, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've just dined at the Indian Restaurant in SV City Rama 3 and was genuinely impressed. Every dish I ordered was a hit—from the perfectly crisp and aromatic garlic naan to the smoky, well-spiced paneer tikka. The green vegetable kebab was a delightful surprise—vibrant, flavorful, and beautifully grilled. And the palak paneer? Creamy, comforting, and packed with depth.

The balance of spices, freshness of ingredients, and warmth of service made the experience truly memorable. If you're craving authentic Indian flavors in Bangkok, this spot is absolutely worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sakda Preudtiwatdhana

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, especially:
1. The chicken tikka was incredibly tender and juicy. I've been to many Indian restaurants, but I've never had one this good.
2. You absolutely have to try the panipuri. It's a great appetizer that opens up the texture and flavor perfectly. The crispy bread and juicy filling, combined with the sauce provided by the restaurant, is simply perfect.

In short, if you find the restaurant, just go in! Don't let the surroundings fool you into thinking it's ordinary, because this place is surprisingly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Theerapat Pongboripat

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've never found an Indian restaurant that I liked this much before. It's the first Indian restaurant in my life that, after eating there for the first time, made me want to come back again.

✨ Pani Puri - Crispy, round balls with a sauce similar to our seafood dipping sauce. The taste explodes in your mouth with a refreshing sweet and sour flavor. It's a must-try dish to awaken your taste buds.

✨ Butter Chicken - Tender, flavorful chicken in a creamy, fragrant butter curry. Dipping it in hot garlic naan is the best!
sample_reviews_en.author: Antonio Oattono

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place completely changed my mind about Indian food! I used to think it wasn’t for me because of bad experiences at other restaurants. One of my besties recommended this place, and now I’m recommending it to you.

The service is absolutely amazing, and the food is delicious. The lamb was so good I had to reorder it—and yes, I even ordered more to go!

If you’re looking for flavorful and authentic Indian food, you won’t be disappointed. This restaurant has officially become one of my favorites.

Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Virajrada Vejviriyawattana

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is located in SV city mall at ground floor. A hidden gem at Rama 3. Their menu has plenty of vegetarian and non-vegetarian options and each dish is filled with warmth and joy of indian cuisine. Whatever dish we tried it was delicious. We had our lunch, dinner and evening tea here.
Dal makhani, Punjabi Kadhi is a must try. My husband tried Tandoori chicken and egg curry and he absolutely loved it. The restaurant owners are Indian couple and very humble.
We definately recommend this place to everyone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Priti Maurya

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great taste, great food, so delicious 🤩

This Indian food is incredibly delicious. I personally loved the roti, naan, Chicken Curry, and Chicken Tikka – they were amazing! The other dishes were also delicious. I don't usually eat Indian food, but I really liked it after trying it. If you've never tried it before, you should definitely give it a try – you'll love it!

The restaurant is located at SV City Rama 3, G Floor, Spicy Mall Zone. Come and try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ann Ann

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a really delicious Indian restaurant!
We went as a couple and ordered:
Birryani lamb: The lamb was tender and had no gamey smell. The rice was delicious.
Chicken butter: I loved this one! It was delicious and suited Thai tastes.
Mango lassi: I'm not sure if it's always available, but it was refreshing.
Garlic naan
Masala tea
If you want to try Indian food for the first time, I highly recommend this restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chadapron Kammoon

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious. Everything was great. The chicken was perfectly cooked, tender and juicy. The goat was also delicious, with no gamey smell, and the spices were well-balanced – the flavors were exactly to my liking.

The restaurant is located inside the building. Just inform the security guard. You can park in the building and get your parking ticket stamped for 3 hours of free parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Watchara Rattanacharoen

restaurants.name: Bowlito Sathorn Square
restaurants.address:

98 Sathorn Square, N Sathon Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The burrito was tasty, okay. It wasn't exactly like the original, but overall good. The tortilla was crispy, delicious, and fragrant. I didn't like the sauce they provided; the sauce mixture wasn't very flavorful. The staff didn't seem to know how spicy customers like their food, so they might not put enough sauce in. Some people prefer spicier food, so the sauce inside wasn't enough. When I asked for extra sauce, they provided it, but it still lacked flavor. Everything was too plain. And importantly, the staff taking orders weren't very knowledgeable. I asked for brown rice, but they gave me white rice. They just nodded in understanding. If they didn't know, they should have asked. Since they weren't Thai, it caused even more confusion. The menu was in English, so I explained in English, and they nodded again, but I still got white rice instead. They should really have someone who can speak English taking orders, as it's crucial. The atmosphere was average, like a food court, but the view outside was nice and relaxing. Compared to the price, it's not the best place for this kind of food. It feels like a franchise, easy and convenient to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: F U

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very sad to write this because this place has been one of my favourites and has consistently delivered great food.

Unfortunately, the Aloha Salmon Bowl has changed significantly. The portion size has clearly been reduced and it looks nothing like the marketing photos anymore. My recent delivery contained just five small pieces of salmon, very little mango and an overall bowl that felt much smaller than what I had come to expect.

What makes it disappointing is that it used to be such a great dish. I completely understand that costs increase and prices sometimes need to rise. As a regular customer, I would much rather pay a little more and receive the same quality and portion size than have the serving reduced to the point where it no longer feels like the bowl I’ve enjoyed for so long.

I really hope they revisit this because it was once one of the best bowls available for delivery.
sample_reviews_en.author: Justin Pattison

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve been here several times but this time I wanted to write a review on the burrito. I had the best burrito super super tasty. I’m very glad you got a check choice of two sauces, and my friend ordered the tofu burrito which she said was extremely tasty as well.

Was not too pleased with the size of the guacamole that you get for the price that you paid and the chips were bought they’re not like homemade chips but nonetheless it’s OK!

Being that I’m craving Mexican food. This was a really good burrito to have to satiate that Mexican craving.!

Arribaaaaa Arribaaaaa …. Highly recommend
sample_reviews_en.author: Follow Fauzia

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant makes delicious and reasonably healthy Mexican food, but the owner seems to have a strange vision. This branch is located in an office building, so it should really open earlier so office workers can buy food before work. It opens at 10 am; why not open at 7-8 am like the other restaurants in the building? No wonder several branches have closed – poor marketing and management. It's a shame because the food is delicious, the portions are generous, and it's good value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Chamvuthipreecha

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and clean, but there were only two staff members; one was playing on their phone and the other provided very poor service. They weren't cheerful or smiling, and answered questions curtly, as if they didn't want to serve. The restaurant was quite messy that day; I saw some unknown bags on top of the condiments. Overall, Bowlito restaurants in all branches are delicious, but if you want good service, I wouldn't recommend this branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaya Poy

sample_reviews_en.text: I've ordered online many times, but this is the first time I've eaten at this restaurant. Their Chicken Brown Rice is delicious and offers great value for money. The chicken is firm but not hard to chew. It comes with plenty of vegetables. You can choose two sauces; I chose Thousand Island and Sour Cream. When I mixed everything together, it was light and flavorful, and very filling. If you work around Sathorn, I highly recommend trying it.
sample_reviews_en.author: AUI

sample_reviews_en.text: Healthy Mexican food with good healthy options.  It is similar to American chain Chipotle.  You choose uour own fresh ingredients.  Very fresh and delicious.  This is not an authentic tasting Mexican fooos restaurant.  Good seating with cold AC inside this small shopping mall.  It is a bit tricky to find. It is located near the Starbucks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploy Wang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mexican-style restaurant
and a bowlito shop.

I tried the beef rice bowl with teriyaki sauce; it was delicious, with a sweet flavor.
The nachos were also crispy and tasty.

Overall, the food tasted good and the price was reasonable considering the quality and quantity.

The restaurant accepts cash, QR code payments, and credit cards.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supawut Saengrassamee

restaurants.name: วราภรณ์ ซาลาเปา ปตท.ประชาอุทิศ 35
restaurants.address:

ปตท.ประชาอุทิศ 35 เลขที่ 527 Pracha Uthit Rd, Rat Burana, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Waraporn Salapao is my absolute go-to for a quick and delicious meal. It’s hands down one of the best places for affordable, high-quality dim sum, especially their pork buns with soft white buns, which are a must-try.

The shop is always spotless, but what I love most is the consistency. The food is always fresh and the service is incredibly efficient. The staff are polite and welcoming, making the overall experience even better. Whether you’re looking for a reliable breakfast, a light snack, or a sit-down dim sum lunch, it never disappoints. I’d highly recommend it to any dim sum lover.
sample_reviews_en.author: Catsu Neptune

sample_reviews_en.text: There are no tables to sit and eat; it's takeout only. The chrysanthemum green tea with pandan jelly was yellow the first time I ordered it, and green the second time. It was just the right sweetness and had small jelly pieces to chew on. You can choose between ice cubes or crushed ice. The spicy vegetable bun with pepper and crispy jicama pieces was good. The steamed mantou with custard was also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: BD Life

sample_reviews_en.text:
These steamed buns are really delicious. I always stop by to buy them whenever I'm traveling long distances. I usually order the minced pork and quail egg steamed buns and the pork dumplings. While they weren't mind-blowing, they were pretty good.

As for drinks, I ordered Thai tea. It was quite sweet but strong and delicious. I always order this set every time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanawat Chan-in

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop at the gas station has a pretty good selection of items. Their steamed buns are still my favorite, always, with their soft and fragrant dough. Their dumplings are of very high quality, especially the crab dumplings which are packed with crab meat, and the seaweed dumplings which are incredibly flavorful. Come try them!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pitchanok Champathong

sample_reviews_en.text: The gas station isn't very big, and there isn't much parking, but the restaurant inside has ample seating. The place is nice, the staff provides good service, and the food is delicious and meets standard expectations.
sample_reviews_en.author: kan tem

sample_reviews_en.text:
Besides steamed buns, they also have dim sum, rice noodle rolls, and many other dishes. Feel free to stop by and try them!
But you might have to wait a little because they steam everything fresh to order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akekaluk Ntk

sample_reviews_en.text: Like the other branches, you can eat here without worrying about the quality. Even though it's located in a gas station, the restaurant has a good atmosphere and is well-organized.
sample_reviews_en.author: chutima Rachaneekonkilas

sample_reviews_en.text: It's always consistent and quick with good to decent dimsum! Steam dumplings are all delicious. Stickyrice one is okay. Service is good to okay. Small restaurant but quick.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sazzie Zer

restaurants.name: เฮียจั๊วเซียนตุ๋น
restaurants.address:

96, 3 Suk Sawat Rd, Bang Pakok, Rat Burana, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
