Beef noodle soup with the flavor I've been searching for. The broth is incredibly clear, easy to drink, and perfectly balanced. It's delicious whether you add seasonings or not.
The braised beef is perfectly tender, and the braised tendons are soft yet still have a satisfying chewiness.
The meatballs are soft and bouncy, so delicious!
I haven't tried the other dishes yet, but I overheard customers at the next table saying the fried pork neck and fried chicken are amazing. I'll have to try them next time.
P.S. I ordered some noodle soup to take home for my family to try. They told me, "Next time you go, don't forget to buy some more!"
If you're in the Suk Sawat area, don't miss it! And for those who aren't, you absolutely must try it too!
sample_reviews_en.author: kritkamol soontong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The aroma of braised beef fills the air as soon as you walk in. The braised beef noodles are made with authentic, unadulterated broth, allowing the natural flavor of the beef to shine through. The dish features large chunks of fresh and tender beef, excellent tendons, and crispy, clean tripe. What I particularly liked was the fermented tofu available to season the broth or as a dipping sauce – a unique feature rarely found elsewhere.
The other dishes and fried items are equally good.
A pleasant surprise at the end was the delicious iced coffee.
Besides the excellent food, there's a comfortable air-conditioned seating area, clean restrooms, and plenty of parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: se rial

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was worth the trip. The meat has a clear, clean, natural, and high-quality flavor. You can tell they put care into it, from sourcing to preparation. The texture is excellent, full of flavor. The owner provides great service, attentive, smiling, and willing to serve.

There's plenty of parking. It's a great meeting place for friends.
Highly recommended. A good restaurant with high quality food that deserves a mention.
sample_reviews_en.author: อรุณทอง บัวรุ่ง

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a bowl of stewed pork soup, no offal or meatballs, to take home in a bag, intending to eat it for lunch. However, when I opened the bag, I saw that the portion was very small and not what I ordered, as it included both offal and meatballs. I would like the restaurant to improve its customer service and communication between the person taking the order and the person preparing the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rojjanapol Limsumungkongul

sample_reviews_en.text: Let's try the special beef noodle soup, unseasoned. The broth is clear, tea-colored, and has a mild, unremarkable flavor that doesn't require any additional seasoning. It's perfect for those who prefer mild flavors. The portion size is just right, not too small and not too large. There's air conditioning and the staff are welcoming.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alongkorn Gmail

sample_reviews_en.text: The braised beef and tendon were perfectly tender. The broth was clear and easy to eat, with a mild, comforting flavor. The stir-fried basil with braised beef was dry-style but had a strong, spicy flavor. The parking lot is spacious, accommodating more than 20 cars, and there are also 3 charging stations, which is very convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pob & Petch Jarasjanyawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The beef noodle soup was refreshing and delicious.
The boiled beef shank with dipping sauce was excellent.
The fried pork neck was also delicious, and the spicy dipping sauce was fantastic. The roasted rice powder was fragrant.
I was so engrossed in eating that I forgot to take pictures. I'll definitely go back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Natiya Saelao

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a really delicious beef noodle soup.
The broth is excellent, and the noodles are good too. I highly recommend trying it.

I ate there after 8 PM, and the shop was still open, even though Google Maps says it closes at 8 PM.

The shop has a sign saying it's closed on the 1st and 16th of every month.
sample_reviews_en.author: aumma happy

restaurants.name: KOSMO Resto & Bar
restaurants.address:

199, 1 Sathon Soi 12 Alley, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Recommend! Happy hour is amazing good price in Sathorn and many choices, snacks only 160฿
sample_reviews_th.author: Ben Yang

sample_reviews_en.text:
KOSMO Resto & Bar is a MUST if you’re looking for a great lunch spot!
If you want an easy, delicious, and effortless meal, you won’t be disappointed here. We had the Smoky stack burger and the Niçoise salad, and both were fantastic. The burger was massive, juicy, and exactly what you want in a good burger, and the Niçoise  salad was equally big with plenty of tuna and a very tasty vinaigrette.
The staff ate so lovely, and the vibe of the place is really comfortable and welcoming. highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris

sample_reviews_en.text: I recently discovered KOSMO, and what a great find! The steak was perfectly cooked, tender, and flavorful, paired with crispy fries and a homemade Béarnaise sauce that tied it all together. An absolute treat. The quality you get for the price in this neighborhood is just unbelievable, and on top of that, the staff is super friendly. Exceptional service, welcoming atmosphere… I’ll definitely be coming back, and I highly recommend everyone to check it out! It’s my new favorite spot in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: A EPEE

sample_reviews_en.text:
Edit.
Well that's ruined a great pizza. Doubt we will have another. No longer hand made perfection. Now same same rubbish, and it's smaller 😔
<<<<>>>
Cannot fault the food and the happy hour. The food, at least some of it, is available on happy hours for 160. I will post a happy hour menu. The service is great as is the place. The happy hour food is reasonable size and perfect with a few beers. 2 or 3 and you are definitely done, fed and satisfied with proper quality food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nelly Byrd

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was surprised. This restaurant is quite good. They have European and American food, as well as Mexican food. The prices are reasonable. The service is very attentive. I come here two or three times a week.

Wow, I'm shocked. It's much better than I expected it to be. I had tacos (Tuesday night special) and they were fantastic. Done in a Tex-Mex style, large, and very, very flavorful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Matthew Klinestiver

sample_reviews_en.text: A bit of an odd mix. Loud dance music at 6:30pm with a nightclub style security man at the front. While the service was great and happy hour specials good, it’s almost too loud to talk. It’s as if they aren’t sure if they want to be a club or pub/restaurant. Always enjoyed the Prakanong location but this was not overly conducive to eating and chatting with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Scott Coates

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered chicken sandwiches and specifically asked for the sauce on the side as I want no sauce on the sandwiches. When the food arrived, everything was covered in sauce anyway.

It’s a simple request and shouldn’t be that hard to get right. Pretty disappointing experience. The two female (non Thais, speak A1 English) waitresses were absolutely clueless.
sample_reviews_en.author: Than Chu

sample_reviews_en.text: Fantastic location and convenient from Saint Louis BTS. Just as lovely as the original branch! Love the Sathorn exclusive food items including Happy Hour snacks: Buffalo Chicken Sliders, Smothered Fries, Meatballs and Mini Hot Dogs. The Seafood Chowder (NE style) and Tagliatelle alla Puttanesca on the dinner menu only at Sathorn were fantatic as well!
sample_reviews_en.author: Burin Tauthong

restaurants.name: Kung's Restaurant
restaurants.address:

116 Sukhumvit Alley 22, Khwaeng Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Classic Thai local restaurant. First but not last time there found on Google maps. I searched for some unfussy and inexpensive Thai food which I more than got!

I love supporting local places like this. Family run, basically sitting in a parking lot but with food served with love!

I ordered seafood Tom yum fried rice (which I didn't see on the menu but the chef happily made) and stir fried morning glory with extra garlic and chili without sauce or oil, (a healthier version). The seafood was fresh and tasty.

Quick and delicious and great value especially in Sukumvit. Highly recommended if you are in the area looking for something tasty with no frills. This is an example of a hidden gem in Bangkok! I will be back. They are open every day except Sunday.
sample_reviews_en.author: James (Jimbob)

sample_reviews_en.text: i have been living in this count try for 18 years. i am writing a review about Kung's Restaurant which is an outdoor venue in a parking lot. Where are you going to get better Thai food than this anywhere in Bxngk0kk, or perhaps even in Thailand ? You are not. The owner loves food and understands it. What a very rare phenomenon. Obviously it depends What you order and in what way you want it, but i would say that mostly the dishes here are 'SUCCULENT'. There is also a surprising mix of aliens and indigenous peoples.
sample_reviews_en.author: Unicorn Education & Consulting

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food at P' Kung's restaurant is delicious.
Generous portions at reasonable prices... excellent service!
The atmosphere is also great, with both Thai and foreign customers.
The restaurant is located behind 7-Eleven, near the sauna.
They have a full range of food and drinks.... Highly recommended, it's delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Somsom

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very small street food restaurant with incredibly lovingly prepared dishes.

Just don't arrive too late, as everything is cooked fresh and they might run out of something if you arrive much too late. That just makes it even more charming. The people in the restaurant are super friendly. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Julian Eggert

sample_reviews_en.text: Such a hidden gem! We stumbled upon this tiny food stall while searching for affordable food and were very happy to have found this place. Everything was full of flavor, portions were very generous. The owner is so kind and even remembered us after just one visit. Definitely worth stopping by! :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Alaina LaFountain

sample_reviews_en.text: Really great, authentic Thai food! Everything is freshly cooked, full of flavor, and served quickly. I make a point of eating here every time I’m in Bangkok, and it never disappoints. Definitely don’t miss it if you’re in the area. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna

sample_reviews_en.text: A real hidden gem! It's small and absolutely adorable. The owners are incredibly friendly and attentive to your needs. All the ingredients are fresh, and you can taste the difference. I'd love to come back! ♥️ Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nadja Eggert-Belz

sample_reviews_en.text: Incredible local food with the sweetest lady chef and service. Highly recommend this “back alley” type dining experience for an authentic Thai meal & experience. Everything was delicious & she was so kind to us, and our baby!
sample_reviews_en.author: Karpe Diem

restaurants.name: Underhound
restaurants.address:

1st Floor Siam Paragon, 991 Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This new restaurant offers French fine dining, under the Greyhound brand.
The staff provided excellent service from the reservation process to providing excellent recommendations on food and drink choices.

Each dish is suitable for one person.
The lobster soup takes quite a while to prepare, and the soup has a strong lobster flavor. The bread is quite flavorful, which enhances the flavor even more.
The wagyu steak was served medium rare with a side of crispy sweet potatoes, adding another level of flavor.
The food was delicious and you can order a pairing to complement your order.
The orange-flavored duck breast was tender (a bit tough) and served with baby carrots, potatoes, and red onions, which helped to cut through the richness.

The mocktails were a perfect blend of tea and fruit.

Overall, I was quite impressed with the food, drinks, and service.

VAT 7% and service charge 10%.
You can earn Greyhound points.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jira

sample_reviews_en.text:
I bow down to the chef.
The Foie Gras Sausage is absolutely delicious. For 590 baht, it's not like a ghost at all. For the price, you get the full flavor of the foie gras.
I highly recommend it to anyone who loves foie gras.

The Hokkaido Burnt Cheesecake for dessert was so good. It was a perfect cure for the Fromage craving.

The Wildberry juice, something of the restaurant's signature, was a perfect blend. It was fragrant and refreshing.

Please support it. It's so delicious. I'm afraid it won't last long. It's so delicious and worth the money.

1st floor, Paragon, next to Zara Home
sample_reviews_en.author: Onamon Chaipramote

sample_reviews_en.text: Tried the restaurant "Underhound" in Bangkok and was not dissapointed. It is a modern take on the French cuisine. Ordered Crepes aux Fruits de Mer (Mixed Seafood Crepe). The stuffed crepe was creamy and yet not bland- quite flavorful infact. The salad had a tangy dressing that complemented the maincourse perfectly. The vibe of the cafe was chic- I went for an early dinner so it wasn't very crowded too. Breads served before the meal were soft and airy. Really happy with the experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Faizan Bhatti

sample_reviews_en.text: French cuisine under boutique shop. The quality of foods are excellents. Oyster are fresh, juicy and salty as they came. Escargot are also delicious. Another recommended is lobster bisque. Not only creamy buy also lobster meat there. Beef is also thumbs up but just tiny comment on the resting time of the grill. As a bit cold, i guess chef put them to rest longer than usual. The service is superb beyond standard. Overall, I do recommend and definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitakorn Ussayaporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Elegant interior. I so in LoVE with the menu! It’s done so beautifully and artfully.
Food was just average, we ordered duck, the vegetables that came with it was undercooked, baby carrot was still so hard to bite
pesto creamy pasta with seafood was a bit too oily
Crab salad was good
Steak was a bit cold when it reached the table
Drink choice was nice
Staffs speak English very well and very attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tum J Srirat

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is located next to Greyhound/Smilehound at Siam Paragon. I visited on a whim after shopping, and while it's not particularly large, I absolutely loved the space! And the food is absolutely delicious. It's a bit pricey compared to other Bangkok restaurants, but considering the atmosphere and taste, it's reasonable! I'll definitely be back again when I go back to Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Songyi kim

sample_reviews_en.text: The Greyhound restaurant is located on the 1st floor of Siam Paragon, near the Prada store. The decor is said to be inspired by Parisian subway stations, but it wasn't particularly impressive. The food was decent; okay if you like Western food, but overall the prices are quite high. It's a small restaurant, offering a bit of privacy.
sample_reviews_en.author: SD Surakit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Another new innovative fusion cuisine by the Greyhound group that's just opened 12 days ago.

Very refreshing... Worth trying if you're in Siam Paragon and have tried their other eateries within their chain of restaurants / cafes.

It is a little odd they don't include napkins for a French- fusion table setting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex Ong

restaurants.name: Maha Thai Cuisine
restaurants.address:

218, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A spacious terrace with a wonderful sunset view. The atmosphere was so relaxing that I didn't want to leave.
First, we tried the tom yum soup; it was delicious, spicy, and a generous portion for one.
The grilled scallop miang appetizer had a generous amount of ingredients on a leaf, with a thick, sweet, jam-like sauce in the center. If you drizzle the sauce on the leaf, it all comes together deliciously.
The tamarind-glazed shrimp were perfectly cooked, large, and generously coated.
The grilled squid was served with my favorite green sauce, along with a salad with generous amounts of chili pepper.
The staff was polite and attentive, and the wait for our order wasn't long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ирина П.

sample_reviews_en.text: This Thai restaurant is beautiful and the food is delicious, and importantly, the prices are reasonable. The Pad Thai with large prawns is perfect as is, no need to add any extra seasoning. Meat lovers must order the beef curry – it's incredibly tasty. The fried chives are crispy and soft at the same time, absolutely delicious. Most importantly, the restaurant is stunning, located in Moon Whale on the rooftop of the Royal Garden Mall. It's very relaxing and beautiful – highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rojjana Rungrattwatchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I am very displeased, I order a dish with 3 kind of meats but I asked something as simple as some salt for the rib eye and it took a lot of time, it was already cold and I couldn’t eat it.
The only response was a “I’m sorry” and I couldn’t even eat the best part of my dish.

Chicken and pork were very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mauricio Palacio

sample_reviews_en.text: Visited “Shaloba Boutique Coffee Cafe” @ Pattaya and the service and location is exceptional. I recommend the coffee and the staff are very attentive. Throughly enjoyed my recent visit and will visit there again soon on my next visit. Satisfied customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kochakorn Yaipotong

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and flavorful, the service is excellent, and the atmosphere is fantastic. It's one of those restaurants I've been to many times and never get bored of. The prices are also very reasonable for what you get.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hydra Olympus

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Thai food was delicious, every dish was flavorful. The atmosphere and view were amazing, with a 180⁰ sea view.
The staff were lovely and provided excellent service.
The Gaeng Raewang (Thai curry) was number 1.
sample_reviews_en.author: M_Life Journey

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the atmosphere was great!! I especially liked that there was parking available. You can park in the Royal Garden Plaza shopping center and take the elevator to the 3rd floor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patipol Chawasit

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious I forgot to take pictures! I recommend the Khao Soi, pomelo salad, spring rolls, and fresh jade dessert. The prices are also very good. And don't forget the Hellboy drink!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anuwat Meenayothin

restaurants.name: Irin Garden Thai Restaurant
restaurants.address:

ฝั่งตรงข้ามปั้มบางจาก Muban Flower Lee Garden Alley, Nong Bon, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered two boxes of minced pork basil rice with a fried egg, and extra minced pork, at 90 baht each. The rice was overflowing in each box, but the minced pork was minimal. It was never like this before when I ordered. I called the shop, and the owner answered, saying, "I cook it myself, and I give you more minced pork than usual, but I don't scoop the rice." She acted surprised, like, "Really? You cook it yourself, you know perfectly well." I'm done with this kind of business. I order the exact same dish at James's shop for only 80 baht, and they give you way more minced pork. I'll never set foot in this shop again, even though it's right at the end of my street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanawat Bunni

sample_reviews_en.text: I've passed by this place for years but never stopped. Then I saw on Facebook that they now have air conditioning, so I decided to try it. I wasn't disappointed! The stir-fried squid with egg and the pork ribs were delicious. There was nice music playing and a beautiful waterfall where you can see the fish. I'll definitely go back. I wish they had more vegetable dishes, and maybe some fried larb (a Thai dish). I'll try other things next time. The prices are reasonable, the service is good, and it's conveniently located opposite the Bangchak gas station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jo Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
2025: The restaurant accepts the government's co-payment scheme. Partially renovated, several menu items are sold out or unavailable, limiting options.

2020: Located on the main road, corner of Soi 47.
Parking available in the soi. Participates in the co-payment scheme. Accepts credit cards for purchases over 500 baht.

The menu has a fairly large selection of dishes.
The taste of the food varies depending on the dish.
Some are sweet, some are salty.
Portions are quite small compared to the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: ttt_ttt

sample_reviews_en.text: No matter how many years I've been eating here, the food is always delicious. They have live music, air-conditioned rooms, and outdoor seating – very chill with a cool breeze and relaxing music. The food is amazing, although the winged bean salad was a bit too strong for my liking. Everything else was delicious! Some items were sold out when I visited, but the herbal fish salad was fantastic. The Super Soup was also good. The prices haven't changed much. Overall, it's a great place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bhakapat mac

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located by the road, has live music to enjoy, and the singer is entertaining. The atmosphere is shady with trees. The portions are large, and the prices are reasonable, but the taste tends to be on the sweeter side. Overall, it's okay. The servers are lovely, provide good recommendations, and are always smiling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornpimon Deesri

sample_reviews_en.text: I loved it! The atmosphere was great, the food was reasonably priced and you could order as much as you wanted. The staff were attentive and took good care of us. The singers were entertaining and chatted with each other. I highly recommend it. Driving from Ramintra was well worth it!
sample_reviews_en.author: MAMU Channel

sample_reviews_en.text: I finally got to eat some delicious Gai Yang after a long time. The portion was generous and I was very satisfied. However, it takes 45 minutes to cook, so the waiting time is part of the experience. I just had to be patient, like I was going to eat eel.
sample_reviews_en.author: JUN TAKIMOTO

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the prices are fair, and the seating is comfortable and relaxing, like eating in a garden at home. They offer Northern Thai, Northeastern Thai, and general Thai dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thirayut Sawadsrisook

restaurants.name: TASTY EGG VARIETIES
restaurants.address:

Shop No, Opposite V C Hotel, 16 Soi Kama, Pattaya City, Amphoe Bang Lamung, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Heaven for Egg Lovers – and More!

Tasty Egg Restaurant in Pattaya is an absolute delight — especially if you’re an egg lover! With over 100 varieties of egg-based dishes, this place truly lives up to its name. Every dish I’ve tried has been unique, flavorful, and cooked to perfection.

From spicy egg curries to cheesy omelettes, from egg biryanis to fusion street-style snacks — the menu is a paradise of creativity and taste. But that’s not all — even their veg dishes are super tasty and satisfying, making it a great spot for everyone.

And of course, how can I not mention their Chai? Hot, aromatic, and full of desi comfort — it’s the perfect way to end your meal.

If you’re in Pattaya and looking for authentic, delicious Indian food with a twist, this place is a must-visit. Great food, warm service, and unbeatable variety!

Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ravindra Panchal

sample_reviews_en.text:
Awesome Food. I never knew that some of these dishes existed before trying them here.
Price is reasonable and you can request the chef to customize as per your taste.
The location is quite near to the walking street, so great to grab a bite at any time of the night since it is open till 5 AM.
I just wish it was open for breakfast too since I am more of a morning person.
It requires you to walk a little inside the Amphawa street with many other food joints, so it can be a little difficult to not get distracted, but still worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charchit Gupta

sample_reviews_en.text:
I wasn't really expecting an indian restaurant but it was really good. The eggs are indeed everywhere and always perfectly cooked. The kitchen was able to make non spicy dishes for us which is really nice and rare for these kinds of restaurants!
The portions are a little small and it feels pretty expensive for the quantity but I guess that's just the area
sample_reviews_en.author: Maloe Amn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food.
ASSAL SURTI TASTE.  After long time ,taste the food like home town.. every Indian should visit for original indian taste..
Recommend to visit ..
sample_reviews_en.author: Hetal bardolia

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best egg dishes available here @ tasy egg.
Awsome taste and yummy dishes.
Must try once, pl do contact badal bhai at tast egg.
sample_reviews_en.author: dhananjay hood

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good service. The stuff explained to me about the food and recommendations. The food arrived very fast and tested amazing
sample_reviews_en.author: משה מינץ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Staff is ok. But the manager not ok. He thinks he is serving us free food.
Very pathetic customer service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Althaf M L

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is amazing and excellent. The service also very good and prompt. We had a homely feeling.
sample_reviews_en.author: amar desai

restaurants.name: Chaykhanan1bukhara (uzbek/Russian Food)
restaurants.address:

352 950 Moo 12 Nongprue, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I wanted to try as many dishes as possible, I asked if there was a big appetizer platter, nope - but yes, I realized it later.
So I took 8 mixed dishes.
Beef tongue, I loved it (we have it in Italy too) but there was no sauce whatsoever. Zero.
The dumplings, good, but again zero sauce. And salty. Way too salty. Maybe it's the way it is, but really, no sauce? Not even in a broth?
The eggplant with the sour sauce good, but cold? I understand not hot (even though I was expecting them to be at least warm), but cold as "from the fridge"?
Bone marrow, well, you either love it or hate, this version had pistachios, it was not a bad combination.
Proper chairs, proper cutlery, in general low prices (we spent 1320 in two only becuase we took a lot of dishes).
So, overall it was good, but too many things seemed off to me - and I admit it, I do not know anything about Russian cuisine.
If you already know what to eat, I think the prices are very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Massimo Peroncelli

sample_reviews_en.text:
From the sign, you immediately realize this place is going to be interesting, to say the least! Step inside and see the atmosphere created by the interior – everything is simple, yet tasteful and in Uzbek style. I've attached a photo.

I have a special relationship with Uzbekistan (I've been there twice already this year), and the food there is the most delicious I've ever tasted!

So, let's transport ourselves to this place while in Pattaya, and feel like we're dining in a completely different country! 💛

My order: Achichuchu salad (100 baht), Kulcha (30 baht), tartar sauce (50 baht), Chang 0.3 (50 baht), Beef shashlik (150 baht/1 skewer).

Results of the visit: the flatbread was fresh and delicious! Achichucha salad made with very good tomatoes, moderately salty, just the way I like it. As they say, "Guys, I don't know what they put in there, it's simply mind-blowing!" 🤭 The shashlik is very good, tender, and fresh! I highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Alya Traveler

sample_reviews_en.text: I wouldn’t recommend this restaurant at all because you pay heavy for extremely little quantity. Firstly, it takes a lot of time to prepare the meal and bring it to your table. Secondly, the images are deceptive of plate whatever is shown in the menu the quantity is very small. Thirdly, there is no coordination between the staff. So, I would say go at your risk. But its not at all worthy. And moreover, our bill was 500 thai baht but they added it wrongly and gave us 750 thai baht. Double check the bill if you come here but please come at your own risk.
sample_reviews_en.author: Subhajit Majee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Have you ever tried food here?? If no, i kindly recommend you to visit this marvelous place that serves many national dishes, my personal favorite one here is juicy dumplings which are being served either fried or boiled in water.
And the atmosphere in the restaurant was absolutely warm, it felt like dining in a very expensive place even though the prices are very small for the way staff serves food, so I stayed very pleased.
I will deffinetely come back here someday
sample_reviews_en.author: David

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hello everyone 👋 for food lovers!
This is, without exaggeration, one of the best places in Pattaya.
The meat is incredibly tender, it just melts in your mouth 🤤
The salads are fresh, juicy, and truly amazing
The pilaf is just right, flavorful and rich
And the warm adjika is a special treat 🔥

All in all, if you want authentic Uzbek flavor, this is the place for you. We'll be back again and again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Жизнь в Таиланде с Михаилом Девятовским

sample_reviews_en.text:
The beef manti are very tender, the dough is thin, but not so thin that it breaks. 😀
The achichuk salad is thinly sliced ​​and has a nice tartness.
The presentation is classic, and the waiters are great.
Shahrom, Asror, Ali

We also tried all the different types of shashlik and the honey cake here.

The restaurant has been recently renovated, the restrooms are clean, and it's cool and cozy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natalia Nikolaeva

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm so glad this place is open 24/7. I usually only get out late, and many places are already closed by then. I've only been here once, but I'll definitely be back. The staff are polite and very pleasant, and the veranda is simply stunning. Everything is beautiful and neat. I loved the food, the menu is varied, and everything is very welcoming. Thank you for your work.
sample_reviews_en.author: Яна Кичатая

sample_reviews_en.text: We've been to this place many times, far from our usual food, it's a godsend. The mastava soup is love, the samsa is superb, the shashlik is like home, everything is delicious! Special thanks to the waiters Asror and Shahrom, they always greet you with a smile and know how to offer all the dishes, so you want to order everything at once. Great guys!
sample_reviews_en.author: Дилара Сарым

restaurants.name: Yakiniku Kemuri Japanese BBQ
restaurants.address:

155/8-9 Sukhumvit 11/1 Alley, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a hole in the wall type of place and was a bit hard to find (it is inside of Ramen Tenso) but I’m glad I found it. The food was spectacular (try their hand made garlic dip) and staff kind and attentive. I liked the low key japanese vibe of the place. Must try if you’re looking for Yakinikku 😄 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Vignesh Murugesan

sample_reviews_en.text: Walked this lane so many times but never knew this place existed but never too late! The entrance is tucked between shops and the lift is at the back. Interesting little place and love the charcoal grill!! Meats are good (I went for the assorted wagyu beef set). Give this place a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rayson Lim

sample_reviews_en.text: Found out about this by chance! It is located on the 3rd floor so it is kind of hidden but a new gem! Thank you Wan for the great service! The food tasted very authentic, affordable and open til 1. Perfect for drinks and food and you can smoke inside too! Will definitely come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna Schütte

sample_reviews_en.text:
The place is a little bit difficult to find because it is located in the 3rd floor and the entrance is only through a small corridor.
We had 3 typed Wagyu beef plate and a Budae JJingae soup set. Everything taste great and I can highly recommend this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: J. F.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Self-grilling and charcoal which we prefer! Good variety for meat selection and quality was really good for the price. Service was attentive and kind. Simple and tasty. No complaints.
Go inside and pass the ramen shop to the elevator for the 3rd fl.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ash C

sample_reviews_en.text: Was craving some Japanese grill and found this place on the map. The meat quality was really good and everything tasted delicious. I originally thought it would be slightly cheaper than the restaurants in the mall, but it actually ended up …
sample_reviews_en.author: Min Zou

sample_reviews_en.text: Great little place that serves some delicious meats that you get to grill at your table. Kinda hard to find, you have to go inside the ramen place and head on up to the 3rd floor. The waitress was adorable, her English wasn’t great but we …
sample_reviews_en.author: Mischa Kriens

sample_reviews_en.text: Never to a Japanese restaurant before, I hesitate to go but a girl convinced me, oh my god, the food and the beef was so good, very delicious, the girls that served as was awesome, this my place to go for good food when I’m in Bangkok
sample_reviews_en.author: M J

restaurants.name: Yinxiang Hunan
restaurants.address:

30, 1 Thiam Ruam Mit Rd, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
First, let me talk about my favorite: stir-fried pork with chili peppers. The chili aroma is incredibly strong, and the perfectly balanced lean and fatty pork is stir-fried until very fragrant—a true rice-eating machine! 🍚

#WukongGroupBuy Only 99 baht!! This price is outrageous in Bangkok!

The signature dish, asparagus stewed fish, was a first for me. It was so unique! I thought Hunan cuisine was all spicy, but the fish was incredibly tender, and the broth was sweet and savory. I drank two bowls straight away! 🥣
The pickled pepper frog was the kind of dish I raved about as soon as it arrived. The frog was very tender, with a strong pickled pepper flavor—a perfect balance of sour, spicy, and savory, incredibly appetizing.

The wasabi prawns were a rare find in Bangkok, a seafood dish served in a light broth. The icy, spicy sauce was very refreshing, and the prawns were huge.

The snails were also amazing. The more you sucked on them, the more addictive they became—the kind of dish you couldn't stop eating while chatting! 🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: rinrintsz ccc

sample_reviews_en.text:
Who knows! I found authentic Hunan cuisine in Bangkok! ✨ Impression Hunan truly lives up to its reputation as a ten-year-old establishment. Every dish is bursting with wok hei (wok aroma), incredibly spicy and perfect with rice.

A group of three ordered a whole table full of hearty dishes! 👇
▫️Signature Asparagus Stewed Fish: Tender fish, incredibly flavorful and spicy.
▫️Impression Jumping Frog: Firm frog meat, stir-fried with green peppers for an amazing aroma.
▫️Nine-Seed Spicy Crab: Spicy and flavorful, with plump crab meat.
▫️Braised Pork Belly with Preserved Mustard Greens: Rich but not greasy, perfect for mixing with rice.
▫️Wild Mushroom and Free-Range Chicken Soup: Light and refreshing, incredibly comforting. Perfect with coconut, cola, and passion fruit soda to cool down the spiciness.
sample_reviews_en.author: YueYuan Liu

sample_reviews_en.text: This Hunan restaurant offers authentic flavors; dishes like cured pork and lotus root tips taste just like home. The ingredients are fresh and plentiful—it's rare to find so many common Chinese vegetables in Thailand. The environment is clean and tidy, with spacious and bright private rooms. However, the prices are quite high, ranging from 500-2000 baht per person, making it only moderately cost-effective. Service is inconsistent, with slow response times during peak hours. Payment methods are inconvenient, as online payment is not supported. It's suitable for diners with a sufficient budget who crave authentic flavors; it's advisable to confirm the menu and prices in advance to avoid misunderstandings. Overall, it's a good place to satisfy cravings, but don't have too high expectations.
sample_reviews_en.author: 河内上门服务Outcall&Incall

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in a three-story shophouse.

The two upper floors are for reservations or larger groups, and include private rooms.

The staff speaks Chinese and seems to be from northern China.

We were a group of 13 and went upstairs, but the smell of cigarette smoke was too strong. We sat downstairs, and while there was still some cigarette smell, it was tolerable.

The staff who asked about the menu and recommended dishes weren't very knowledgeable. They didn't even know what kind of fish was.

The staff needs better food training.

The food is Chinese cuisine, and the prices are quite high. The taste is average.

Parking is available in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: ben s.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is tasty, but a little oily, so you have to eat it quickly while it's hot. The fish dishes have a strong fishy smell, like someone hasn't put on deodorant – a typical fishy odor. If you don't like salty fish, I recommend avoiding it. The prices aren't exactly budget-friendly, but the portions are generous. The stir-fried pork with lotus root was perfectly crispy, I really liked it. Try to avoid sitting near the door; it gets hot and sweaty when it's opened and closed. The service is okay; if you don't speak Chinese, speak loudly, as the staff seem more comfortable with Chinese. You might need to call for the bill or to order takeout a few times.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cholthisha Nokkrut

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Hunan cuisine, very flavorful and spicy, although the taste might be slightly different due to the use of Thai ingredients. If everything were truly authentic Hunan food, I wouldn't be able to put my chopsticks down.

Overall, it was a delicious and enjoyable meal.

Smoking is prohibited in the restaurant. This is a bit frustrating for Chinese people, as they smoke everywhere – where it's forbidden, they smoke; where it's not forbidden, they smoke even more! 😆

The restrooms are on the second floor, which might be inconvenient for elderly people.
sample_reviews_en.author: TOAH Z.

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered their signature asparagus and fish stew, and "jumping frog" (a type of frog dish), as well as scallion oil chicken, braised pork with fried tofu, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. Every dish was incredibly delicious with rice. These weren't authentic, modified versions of Hunan cuisine; the spiciness and flavor were truly genuine!

You can even pick out fresh ingredients from the seafood tank right in front of you, and they'll be cooked to order – so incredibly fresh!
sample_reviews_en.author: Echo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Coming to this restaurant felt like an insult to my taste buds.

As a native of Changsha, I found the Hunan cuisine here to be completely subpar. The cauliflower was boiled instead of stir-fried, and the dry pot chicken was also boiled. The service was also poor, with the staff being slow and inefficient. I don't understand how they gave me the previous positive reviews. Three of these dishes costing 245 RMB is far too expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lola Wang

restaurants.name: LAF hotel
restaurants.address:

3 Soi Phahon Yothin 5, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: My boyfriend and I stayed in this capsule hotel for only 1 day. Just for sharing my experience with others. First of all, the hotel is cheap and overall is acceptable. But there are some could be improved better. I've used Agoda to book one night. The best thing for this hotel is it doesn't need any deposit from tenants. And for couple like us they do provide queen size capsule bed. Staffs are friendly and location is great because it near to the Mrt station. But the toilets are really really small. I can't imagine how those European or larger size people will use the toilets. And the most disappointment part is the breakfast in the next morning. Breakfast is including in our booking fee. So I planned to enjoy their breakfast and so save money as well. But they are only provided some simple ingredients for tenants like milk, ham and bread. Simple ingredients also acceptable if only they were fresh. But they aren't. Milk has passed it sell by date as well as bread. In the end, we spent our money for the breakfast. Suggestion for hotel owner please make sure your ingredients are fresh before you provide it to your tenants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tsyee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Location; the building is by the road, nearby the main road and less than 5 minutess walk from Ari station. The hostel is on the 2nd, 3rd and 4th floor. On the first floor is a bar (at night) and a cafe (at noon).

Room; capsule bunkbed style, perfect for introverts like me. Each capsule has its own locker, electric sockets, clothes hanger, towel, pillow, blanket and a small cabinets. Room was super chill. Unfortunately, cleanliness of the capsule is not a 5stars. I can get 3 stars max, coz still many bugs (dead ones).

Outside the room, was another locker room with self service passcode. Then, the shower room comes with shower soap, shampoo, conditioners, all from well known brands. The toilets and wastafel are on the other side. Everything are clean.

On the 2nd floor is the common room, with tables, bean bags, kitchen & sinks. Everything are well prepared, and guests are directed to be self service.
sample_reviews_en.author: rachmat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Clean and quite capsule hostel that provides privacy and keyless digital lockers. the interior is beautiful.
A small digital is also available with capsule beside bed.Bed are comfortable .
Free breakfast should be prepared yourself in small kitchen.common area is available. Staff are friendly.
Cafe and bar is available on ground floor with craft beer and nitro coffee.

The clean showers are provided with toiletries and a towel.

Ari BTS station is just 250 metres from hostel. 7-eleven is around 350metres from hostel.
I highly recommend this hostel if you are looking for quite and comfortable hostel with some privacy.
sample_reviews_en.author: siddesh siddu

sample_reviews_en.text:
A nice hotel with friendly staff, great place to sleep in capsules for a few nights or just to rest your head for a night.
Do note that their bathroom and toilet are squeezy, there is little space to manoveur around especially the toilets.
Another plus point is that they have coffee and beer available at ground floor which is super convenient. For beer bottles that have no price indication, you might want to check with them first as there is an imperial stout that costs 500 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brother Bruce

sample_reviews_en.text: Very clean and new installations and really friendly staff. Good value for the money. Convenient location of lockers near the sleeping area and toilet and shower in the same door. Towel provided and capsule very comfortable and makes it feel you have more intimacy. Fast wifi and help your self breakfast provided with basics: eggs, milk, bread, cereals. I would go back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Iker García

sample_reviews_en.text: Beautiful hostel, just opened therefore really really clean, lobby/bar clazzy style during daytime chill jazz music, staff is super friendly and helpful, easy communication in english, offering nitro coffee, on weekends many people in the evening, saw business people around Ari having meetings in the hostel. Just awesome atmosphere here. I will definitely come back
sample_reviews_en.author: Pedja Petrovic

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything is so perfect. Start from booking, when I asked question in their facebook, they quickly responded and booked for me. When I arrive, the welcome is superb. Free space to do many thing. Breakfast that is self made.||The Bar downstair is nice. and no voice leaking. I can sleep comfortably in my capsule
sample_reviews_en.author: nattyllqoo

sample_reviews_en.text: We not staying overnight at here just stay for the noon bcs we had to catch bus on afternoon.. it was fun the bed was comfy, the bathroom is clean  & i love the bar it seem quite calm down there. The owner lady is Nice & understand english very well♥️.  If we come to bkk again will choose to stay here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yusof White

restaurants.name: Red Lobster
restaurants.address:

PHG5+462, QSNCC, Bangkok, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located at the Queen Sirikit Convention Center and is quite well-decorated. The food evokes an American atmosphere. Today, we ordered the lobster and spaghetti, a special lunch set that comes with lemonade, a small rocket salad, and ice cream – great value at only 599 baht.

The lobster was well-prepared, available in two styles: baked with cheese and grilled, served with a delicious seafood dipping sauce; the lobster was tender and succulent.
The spaghetti arabiata had a tomato sauce with a hint of chili, slightly spicy and flavorful. We also ordered the creamy shrimp spaghetti, which was tasty.
Another item we ordered was baked potatoes with lobster.
We were incredibly full!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ketsada Sutthiumporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a sudden urge to get some Red lobster biscuits while in Bangkok. The service is good since there isn't anyone in the restaurant which should've been my 1st queue of things to come.The ranking for the food is as follows:

Shrimp appetizer --- 5/5
Biscuits ----  0/5 ( Dry and tasteless. A far cry from a real red lobster biscuit)
Margarita ---- 5/5
Salmon with shrimp 0/5 ... ( Smell rancid, didnt dare to eat it)
Smash potato ---  0/5 ( taste it awful, had some weird after taste)
Spinach  --- 3/5 ( just eatable)

Total price 1700++ bath to be extremely disappointed.

Wouldn't recommend
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr. Cruz

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the better restaurants available in the newly renovated Queen Sirikit National Convention Center (QSNCC) in Bangkok, Thailand, Red Lobster is well-known for its flavourful seafood menus and its cheddar bay biscuits.

So of cause I ordered these during my visit. I found their foods to be tasty, without being overly oily and salty. The seafood ingredients were good (not the best I have eaten, but good). The signature biscuits were a bit dry for my liking, but was a good 'plate sauce sponge' to clean the plate.

A convenient location with plenty of parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisana Varanyuwatana

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is easy to find and conveniently located. Exit BTS Phrom Phong via the connecting walkway to EmSphere, and the restaurant is on that floor. We ordered both streamed lobster and lobster with spaghetti. The staff were attentive and caring. The food was delicious, the lobster was perfectly cooked, and they provided seafood dipping sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: umaporn pongpan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall, it might be the most expensive restaurant in the venue. Because of that, it's a place where you can relax a bit and not be too crowded.

The food is delicious. They have some reasonably priced pasta dishes at lunchtime, but it's still more expensive than the other restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: まい

sample_reviews_en.text: Tasty American style seafood. The pricing is quite high for the price. The pasta dish was really tasty. The lobster in the sandwich was a bit small porrion size unlike overseas. Food service very slow. The staff was very friendly and helpful with explaining each dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sandee Tour

sample_reviews_en.text:
A place where you can eat lobster dishes

Including soup and grilled lobster, etc.

The prices are a bit on the higher side, but

You can eat in a cool indoor environment,

And the hygiene isn't bad either.

The staff are friendly and smile a lot, too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Danny Kim

sample_reviews_en.text: Dont go!!! I am realy disapointed. Service nul, lobster vas massacred and spagheti a ailo e olivo vas very hard. And plus they have hidden fees so price at the and even higher then in France in Marseille or Paris.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miroslav Starosta

restaurants.name: Ping's Surawong
restaurants.address:

294, 3-4 Surawong Rd, Si Phraya, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for delicious shark fin soup or authentic Chinese cuisine in Bangkok, this is an absolute must-visit restaurant. Located on Surawong Road, it's easily accessible.

Their signature shark fin soup is served piping hot in an earthenware pot. The soup is incredibly rich and flavorful, with each sip filling your mouth with deliciousness. The shark fin itself is thick and has a wonderfully firm texture.

Besides that, they offer a variety of other dishes, such as fried rice generously topped with crab meat and fragrant abalone rice cooked in an earthenware pot. No matter what you order, you can't go wrong. This is a highly recommended restaurant for special occasions or when you want to enjoy luxurious and delicious Chinese food in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Icey

sample_reviews_en.text: I am very confused with this restaurant. It has loads of positive reviews and it is reasonable to have expectations. I came here for a late lunch at 2pm. The air conditioner was turned off for energy saving so it was quite warm. I ordered their signature dishes. The one in the claypot was fish maw with king prawns. I did not expect the dish was served with lukewarm temperature. In fact it tasted like not properly reheat overnight food. The other one is stir fried flat noodles in thick sauce. All the flat noodles were stick together. I am really doubtful if the chef knows how to cook properly for a stir fried noodles. I left the restaurant with a lot of questions.
sample_reviews_en.author: Simon

sample_reviews_en.text:
It is a nice quiet place but there’s no Duck noodle soup??😳
The only reason why I went because of
Took Ti’s review.  By the way, on 12/7/22 they were out of Shark Fin soup and the crab cakes.  I was very disappointed.  Please be accurate with your reviews people!! That’s the whole point of taking time to read reviews, so you have advanced information before you sit down!!  Please get it together Took !!
Also goose that is all fat and no noodles can no way be misinterpreted for Duck Noodle soup!!!!!!!! Thanks
sample_reviews_en.author: Rich Thompson

sample_reviews_en.text: My visit to Ping Surawong was a journey through a variety of textures and flavors, starting with a superb braised shark fin and an excellent fried fish maw that were both standout dishes. However, while the other braised items like the fish maw and abalone rice were satisfactory, the repeated use of the same broth in all braised dishes led to a uniform taste that diminished the excitement towards the end. A great spot, but could benefit from a little more diversity in seasoning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chee Hoo Lau

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. First dish: Thai curry crab. The crab meat is coated in a rich, golden curry sauce, smooth and flavorful, perfect for mixing with rice.

2. Second dish: Lobster and vermicelli casserole. Large, split lobster is baked with vermicelli, soaking up the sauce for an incredibly fresh and delicious flavor.

3. Third dish: Shark fin soup in a clay pot. The broth is thick, rich, and nourishing.

The entire meal is bursting with seafood flavor, a truly authentic Thai seafood feast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dais

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually eat shark fin soup in Bangkok's Chinatown, but this time, a local guide recommended this place. The combination of shark fin and crab meat was excellent. The braised harpoon had a very unique texture. The braised duck feet were stewed until the meat easily separated from the bone, making them very delicious. The abalone risotto, though a small bowl, was a perfect match of abalone and Thai rice. Very delicious and worth revisiting.
sample_reviews_en.author: caitlin lee

sample_reviews_en.text: Having eaten there myself, I was completely wrong. Don't believe the online reviews. It's not good, the portions are small, the place is small, the service is bad, and you don't feel like you're eating at the worst restaurant. The experience is just like eating in Hong Kong, where there are plenty of choices in Chinatown.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ivan Wong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don’t be mislead by negative reviews. This place uses genuine ingredients,and is more than a sharkfin restaurant. Service is good. Try their fried rice which they take pride in.
Of course, as sharkfin is served in fewer restaurants including in Hong Kong & Singapore, Pings will be your go-to spot.
sample_reviews_en.author: melillo joe

restaurants.name: ร้าน เช้าตู่
restaurants.address:

QFGH+79M, Arun Amarin, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We went there on November 19, 2025. A colleague had told us about it several times. It's located near Lotus Pinklao, in the same soi (alley). It's just a short walk in, turn left, and there's plenty of parking. The food is delicious and comes out quickly; we only waited a short time. The prices are very reasonable. There's live music, mostly 80s and 90s songs. We're not sure if you can request current songs, but they sing well for our generation, haha. The staff are lovely and attentive. Feel free to share your view, as it's a convenient, flat area. The atmosphere inside the restaurant isn't fancy, but overall it's great. If you want to listen to music, enjoy delicious and affordable food, and have attentive staff, come here! (You can tell from my face that I'm happy, haha!)
sample_reviews_en.author: วรกมล เสือแป้น

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious; I loved every dish I ordered. The atmosphere was nice and comfortable. The food prices weren't cheap, but not excessively expensive either. The singer was beautiful, and the service was excellent. However, the men's restroom needs improvement. It looked unclean; the sinks lacked soap and mirrors, and the toilets were also dirty. The bidet spray barely worked, and only one toilet flushed properly; the other required manual pouring. It was completely unsuitable for a restaurant like this. It felt like using a restroom in a remote temple in a rural area. I have to criticize this. I hope the restroom will be improved next time I visit.
P.S. If it's still the same next time I go, I won't be coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปรณัฐ ยศหนองทุ่ม

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was nice, and every dish tasted delicious, but there was a bit of a wait. That's okay, I could wait. However, what I couldn't accept was the terrible service from the staff. They were impolite, and I kept raising my hand to ask for the bill for a very long time, but no one paid attention. I couldn't wait any longer and went to tell one of the staff members that I wanted the bill. The staff member just looked at me with a displeased expression. I don't know what they were angry about, but there was no "please wait" or apology whatsoever. They just went and sat down. Then, after about another 15 minutes, someone finally brought the bill.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sokha Chim

sample_reviews_en.text: First of all, I've passed by this place many times and never thought of going in because I saw that it was surrounded by buildings and I figured the restaurant would be hot and stuffy. But I was wrong. Today, I decided to try it. Inside, there was a lovely breeze and the air was nice. The staff were very friendly and provided excellent service. We ordered five dishes, as shown in the pictures, and they were all delicious. I have to give a thumbs up to the chef! The prices were also reasonable. I'll definitely be back often.
sample_reviews_en.author: Belle Sugarspice

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I went to eat with my kids and grandkids. We ordered many dishes, and I have to say, the food at this restaurant is inexpensive and everything is delicious. The tables are comfortable, there's music playing, and they have a wide selection of drinks, including cocktails. I forgot to take pictures, but I'll take some next time. This restaurant is conveniently located next to Lotus Pinklao, before Central Pinklao, with easy parking for both cars and motorcycles. Give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: ชุมพร สถิตานนท์

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is good and affordable, and the service is good, but there's one (and important) drawback: the guitarist's playing is completely haphazard. The sound creates a claustrophobic atmosphere. The guitarist should do some homework and stop messing around.
sample_reviews_en.author: worrachata CHARTSORN

sample_reviews_en.text: First of all, we liked the prices. We felt they were quite cheap, especially the set meals. For 500 baht, you get a spicy hot pot, fried larb, and a huge grilled fish (the size of a clay pot lid!). It's like they're deliberately selling off …
sample_reviews_en.author: hispeed design

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a terrible shop. They completely ignore incoming orders. When you show them the order details, they say they don't know. If they want to sell online but don't have an order processing system at the shop, they shouldn't even bother. …
sample_reviews_en.author: ธีรภัทร มหาสมบัติ

restaurants.name: The Little India Makkasan
restaurants.address:

Peak Mansion, Soi Ratchaprarop 8, Makkasan, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I recently had the pleasure of dining at this exceptional Indian restaurant, and I must say it was a delightful experience from start to finish. The ambiance was warm and inviting, the service was impeccable, and the food was simply outstanding.

From the moment we were seated, the staff made us feel welcomed and attended to our every need with a smile. The menu offered a wide variety of authentic Indian dishes, each bursting with flavorful spices and cooked to perfection.

Overall, this restaurant exceeded all expectations, and I can't wait to visit again to indulge in more of their delicious offerings. If you're looking for an unforgettable dining experience, look no further than this gem of an Indian restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Abhay Ghosalkar

sample_reviews_en.text:
Its an absolutely 7 star restaurant. The welcome boy very motivated and passionate. He practically convinced me to visit the restaurant for dinner. The restaurant was clean and well-lit. The people inside were very presentable and homely. The food was provided pretty fast and was very very good in taste. The cooking instructions were followed diligently and carefully. The taste of the food was different as compared to other restaurants near them(in a good way). Must visit again for another good meal before leaving Thailand.

God Bless You...Cheers!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunny Sharma

sample_reviews_en.text: its was such a homely experience outside India . Food is Extremely delicious portions was very much appropriate we ordered a veg thali and that was quite a constant order there for the days we have stayed in Bangkok . All the Staff and the 2 Bhaiya were extremely polite and helpful with the customization in our thali and chai was the cherry on the top all in all it was a delighted experience and i surely recommend tis place to my people who is travelling to Bangkok
sample_reviews_en.author: vishnupriya sharma

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went there just to have snacks but the ambiance, service and above all the taste of almost all the food items we ordered forced us to finish eating our dinner with them as well . Chicken seekh kebab , Kashmiri dum aloo with lacha parantha was one of our favorites. We tried there chicken  biryani as well & it was super delicious & flavorful.
Prices are reasonable enough . We’ll definitely come back .
sample_reviews_en.author: Snow White

sample_reviews_en.text: Living in Bangkok for many years and tried many indian cuisines restaurants, little India near Ramada hotel, Pratunam came as a huge surprise as food was authentic n delicious, price was super economical, staff recommendations for food were just perfect. Mutton Rogan Josh is Highly recommended!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Admire Tailors

sample_reviews_en.text: I"ll bring my family for lunch at 11:30 AM restaurant was so good the food was awesome.. Everything was good but the best one is the service guy( A pakistani boy) this Pakistani  boy saifi can hold all services by individual he can handle all the customer in very good manner ♥️I loved it 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Car Lover

sample_reviews_en.text: The place is amazing and hygienic, the taste is Authentic. And prices are very reasonable. Staff is very careful and courteous while attending. Had a great time. It's very close to Indira Market and Platinum in Pratunam area and right next to my hotel Ramada Makkasan, Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arshdeep Singh

sample_reviews_en.text: Awesome food experience. It taste so good I gave them a thumb up. Double nan bread included, with extras on the side. Mango lassie could have a little more yoghurt in it. Good romantic Indian music. Thank goodness I found good Indian.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sara G.

restaurants.name: KAGONOYA
restaurants.address:

เมอคิวรี่ 540 อาคารเมอร์ Phloen Chit Rd, ลุมพินี Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten at this restaurant many times and am even a member. Today, I was shocked by the service; it was terrible. My family of seven and I arrived first and ordered because we were hungry. The restaurant gave us two separate tables next to each other. Our table only had three serving dishes, so we asked for more. The first employee pointed to the opposite side, implying we should just grab that one first. However, there were four of us at our table, and if we grabbed that one, we'd have to ask for more anyway. So we chose to ask another employee instead. We understand the food was slow because the employee seemed new and confused. My family and I like this restaurant, but we hope they improve their staff. We understand that some staff members might be upset even with masks on, but poor service really affects the overall experience. Even if the food is delicious, this kind of service makes it not worth the money.
sample_reviews_en.author: JIDAPHA CHUENBAMRUNG

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

“I was impressed from the moment I contacted them via Facebook. The admin responded quickly, provided detailed information, and coordinated with the branch to get what I needed. Truly excellent service!

On the day I dined, all the staff were attentive and caring, from the counter to the end of the meal. Especially Ms. Praewphan, who was lovely and very attentive. Thank you! The entire team also provided continuous care, refilling food and drinks without fail, making me feel comfortable throughout the meal.

The food was very fresh and of high quality. The menu was diverse. The salmon and beef slices were beautiful and delicious. The side dishes and ice cream were also tasty. The cleanliness of the restaurant and utensils was excellent. The atmosphere was comfortable, suitable for both families and friends.

It was a very worthwhile meal. I will definitely be back! 💖”
sample_reviews_en.author: c r ê p ê

sample_reviews_en.text:
I usually order the 699++ set. I just found out they have a promotion right now: 20% off for your first Grab Dine Out payment. That's awesome!

I've eaten at all the branches, and I don't know why, but I feel like the beef and salmon sashimi at this branch are the best.

However, I have to deduct a star because they were out of so many items, even though it was a Saturday. There was no shrimp, no sesame dipping sauce, and no gyoza.

This branch has the best view, but the other branches are delicious too. I love the soup; the dark broth is simmered until it's not too salty. It's better than many famous restaurants. I keep coming back to this one even though I've tried many others.

The fried items are also delicious. The sushi rolls and steamed egg custard are good too.

Another plus is that all branches are less crowded, so there's no need to queue.
sample_reviews_en.author: PuAy PoLLy's Journey

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kagonoya is famous for its shabu-shabu buffet 🥢, but if you don't want a heavy meal, try their lunch set. It's just the right amount, filling, and totally worth it 🍱✨.

The set includes rice, soup, and side dishes. You can choose add-ons. Hot and cold green tea is refillable.

The service is average; it's a little difficult to get the attention of the staff, and they seem a bit inattentive. The seating area for the lunch set doesn't have a hot pot, but the smoke and smell are similar to the buffet area because it's the same zone.

The price depends on the menu you choose. The meat portions in the lunch set are generous, the quality is good, and it's delicious.

Kagonoya is famous for its shabu buffet 🍲, but don't miss their lunch set — balanced, filling, and totally worth it 🥩🍱
sample_reviews_en.author: Sugarcanebkk

sample_reviews_en.text:
Another great shabu buffet restaurant (for English please find below)

Kagonoya is a shabu buffet restaurant with various price options. The restaurant has plenty of seating and the staff provides excellent service.
Regarding the food, the ingredients are fresh, clean, and there's a wide variety to choose from. For those who prefer lean meat, I recommend the "Outside" beef (I don't quite remember the name). It's very tender and delicious. Overall, it's a great shabu restaurant.

There are various price ranges for this shabu buffet (I'm not sure if there is an à la carte menu). The staff is very nice and has excellent service.
There are many things to eat here, e.g., beef, pork, sushi, salad, fried chicken, dessert, etc.
I would recommend this place to shabu lovers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prasertsak Sinsab

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have been to many all-you-can-eat places but never to one that tells you to STOP EATING (not just stop ordering) right at 90 min.  The food is ok/worth the price but this rule definitely gives it a different class (comparable to a place with 299/399-THB pricing?)  BTW the restaurant was empty when we went so it was not like people were waiting for our table.

This did not happen at Mega Bangna location but, then again, I was not really timing my meal while I was there.

Hot pot and fried food is good but, I found sushi menu to be surprisingly subpar for a Japanese food chain from previous visit at Maga Bangna location, so we did not order many sushi items here.

I wonder if it is like this in Osaka.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ku Ho

sample_reviews_en.text: I didn't expect much service, I came to try it during a promotion, but I was pleasantly surprised. I came back twice in one week. The food is delicious and the staff are very attentive. My partner loved it. I've seen several reviews mentioning the service, which might vary depending on the situation, but personally, I work in a restaurant myself and have employees, so I understand their needs. When you go to a buffet restaurant, you don't expect concierge-level service. Overall, I give it 5 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jak Sw

sample_reviews_en.text: Before entering the restaurant, the staff did not inform us about any items that were out of stock. They didn't ask which course we wanted, but simply led us to a table and gave us a QR code to order food. Overall, the staff seemed unwilling to provide good service. They even served the wrong dishes. When we called for attention, the staff ignored us. We were very disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeen Jean

restaurants.name: MEET66
restaurants.address:

66 หมู่ที่ 8 ซอย ราชวินิตบางแก้ว, Bang Kaeo, Bang Phli District, Samut Prakan 10540, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today, I had planned specifically to eat at this restaurant, but my experience was extremely disappointing. I must commend the waitress for her excellent and polite service, but I must criticize the two female office workers who assisted us.
1. They made unpleasant facial expressions towards customers. 2. They stood around gossiping about customers, making faces. I admit I was very offended, and I observed their behavior to see if they were actually doing it. They were indeed looking at our table, making faces, and gossiping about us.
I read the reviews and understood that the service was poor. The pizza was average, but I would commend the steak; it was delicious. Would I recommend this restaurant? I don't think so, because my experience was very unpleasant, uncomfortable, and upsetting. I feel sorry for the owner who has put so much effort into the restaurant, promoting it well to get good reviews, only to encounter such staff.
As a fellow business owner, I can say that the restaurant needs significant improvement in terms of staff management, and I will definitely not be returning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bovi Roddee

sample_reviews_en.text: It's better not to go back. I recommend trying other restaurants in this area; there are plenty of other food options. I ordered three dishes but only received two, and the service was terrible. Honestly, I've never encountered a pizza place at this price with such bad service. The problem is, I was dressed casually, and I thought the staff might be perceived as more upscale for this restaurant. I tried to call the staff several times before they finally came, and it took even longer for them to notice or pay attention. I think the service was unacceptable. The food and atmosphere were okay though. I practically had to walk to get everything I asked for, for example, sauce. I'm not sure if pizza sauce should be on the table, but every other place should have it. For spoons and glasses, I had to go and get them. I tried waving my hand to get their attention, but they didn't care. There is a service charge here, but I think the service was just not okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arisara Poopan

sample_reviews_en.text:
There's parking available. The place has a cafe section and a restaurant section. I went during a holiday and the wait wasn't too long, but there are two entrances. Customers just sat down when they saw an empty table, while some waited outside.
The staff seemed tired, as it was a holiday, but I only saw two people standing at the main entrance. The woman seemed to have worked there for a while and was quite efficient, while the man seemed new and confused when asked questions. Another person came out occasionally.

The food didn't take too long to arrive, coming out gradually. The taste wasn't as amazing as the influencer reviews said. The crispy pork and pizza were overrated in the reviews, but the taste was very ordinary. Overall, the food was quite bland.
sample_reviews_en.author: ateenyboss Yurin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ordering staff at your restaurant was very rude.
When we placed our order, we clearly ordered three corn soups. The staff member even repeated our order back to us, and everything was confirmed correctly. However, when the food arrived, we were served truffle soup instead.
When we politely pointed out the mistake to the staff member who took our order, she rolled her eyes and let out a loud sigh. We felt this was very disrespectful.
I don't understand why we were treated this way. The incorrect order was the restaurant's mistake, so shouldn't customers be allowed to point it out?
It's such a shame because I've always liked this restaurant and have been a loyal customer. This experience was very disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zoe Chen

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is mediocre, the kind you'd find anywhere else. It's expensive, and the portions are small. A salad costs over 300 baht but only has a handful of vegetables.
The pizza crust is good, but you need to add cheese to make it worth the price. Without it, the toppings are dry.

The staff weren't very service-minded, didn't smile, and served the food with one hand, placing it on the table and walking away with a dismissive look. I guess we expected too much service for a basic restaurant.

The atmosphere is quite nice, peaceful and relaxing. It's worth trying if you want to experience it, or you could go to another restaurant instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: warunnapa Wisitset

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came here to hang out with friends. Overall, the taste was average. Some things were delicious, like the grilled chicken. The prices were quite high (very high). The pizza wasn't great, but the spaghetti had good sauce and noodles. The staff in the food area weren't very attentive to customers. We called for a staff member to order more, but they ignored us. In the end, we ordered ourselves.

It's a shame, because the restaurant has a really nice atmosphere and beautiful decor. It's shady, with lots of trees, very refreshing.

I think for the price, the service should have been much better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Baby squid

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is beautiful, the food is okay.
The service was terrible. There was no welcome or escort to a table. When I asked for a replacement for a dirty ice glass, a short-haired female employee brought an empty glass. I asked for more ice, and she made a displeased face, walked away abruptly, and slammed the glass down. There was no thank you when paying, and she didn't even open the door for me. Considering the restaurant's appearance, the food prices, and the 10% service charge, I wouldn't give it any stars for the service. I was very unimpressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naparat Phrapemporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food is so-so, acceptable if it was only cafe but shouldn’t called bistro. Food also way too expensive compare to quality. Service is bad. Staff didn’t take care of customer at all, just hang around at the bar even there almost no customer. Alarm went off in the kitchen but staff didn’t inform customer what happened.

Outside environment is very nice but dining area is not match it, looked unfinished.

There are better restaurants in the area.  Not recommend to go to this place. Should wait until it either improve or gone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thayawat Unnanond

restaurants.name: ข้าวต้มโต้รุ่งผักบุ้งโชว์
restaurants.address:

Soi Lat Phrao Wang Hin 30, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything was delicious. The price was reasonable for the quality and quantity. We ordered four dishes, three bowls of rice porridge, a bucket of ice, and a bottle of water. The total cost was 390 baht.

We ordered the gourami salad, sea bass tom klong, tofu with herbs, and stir-fried morning glory with red chili paste.

The restaurant is a family-run, all-nighter. The kitchen and food preparation area are located in front of the restaurant, where the food is cooked over a blazing fire right on the roadside. When we went, the restaurant was full, so we got a table by the roadside. The food arrived quickly and was delicious. I was willing to eat it even though I was fighting the car fumes. Haha. I'll definitely go again. The restaurant opens at 5:00 PM. :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukwan At.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is a bit bland, but that's a plus as it should be easy for everyone to enjoy.

The service is quick and efficient. The restaurant occupies a single shop unit with outdoor seating; the seating along the side is airy and comfortable.

Parking is available on the street, but be sure to check the odd/even day parking restrictions.

The prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pensupa C.

sample_reviews_en.text: Come try the fish maw salad and pork stir-fried with salted eggs. The taste is better than expected. I will definitely come back again. Price 200+ (2 people). The atmosphere is next to the road at the entrance of Soi Lat Phrao-Wang Hin 30. Parking on the side of the road. On even and odd days, ask the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tamakob Tamakob

sample_reviews_en.text: Finding parking was extremely difficult. The alley was too narrow, and after circling around to find a parking spot, I walked to the shop at 4 PM. They said it wasn't open yet, it opens at 5 PM. They should update the opening hours here. It was a waste of time.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนัญญา

sample_reviews_en.text: This unassuming restaurant serves surprisingly delicious food. The Tom Yum soup is flavorful and spicy, and the prices are very reasonable. I went at 7 PM and every table was full. The food didn't take long to arrive. Parking is available on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kate N.

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm usually hesitant about restaurants with no street entrances, but this place is delicious. I especially recommend the cashew chicken stir-fry. The fried fish is also delicious. Street parking is available. Am I the first Korean to review this place?
sample_reviews_en.author: Derek Kim

sample_reviews_en.text: The wait wasn't long, the food was delicious and easy to eat, and the price was very reasonable. Five dishes cost 450 baht, including drinks and ice. The portions were just right, but not too small. I'll definitely come back and give it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phuthimet Phitakchatwong

sample_reviews_en.text: This unassuming roadside rice porridge shop in Wang Hin is a small place you shouldn't miss. The food is delicious, prepared quickly, and reasonably priced. There's seating both inside the building and outside, with street parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poopea Sakuntra

restaurants.name: ร้อยโต้รุ่ง 100 TO RUNG
restaurants.address:

546/4 Phloen Chit Rd, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The "forgotten husband" rice porridge was delicious, but I wish they added taro. The side dish portions weren't large, but the salads were excellent, especially the fried fish salad and the shrimp salad with salted egg.
The place is beautiful because it's an old bar.
There weren't enough staff, so the service was a bit slow.
The parking fee was too expensive at 100฿.
sample_reviews_th.author: Ler鍾樂

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nong Zen is the best, very friendly. All drinks are as excellent as the food.

Everything was truly delicious. We went with 3 people and ordered about 10 dishes + 2 types of rice porridge. It's a shame the salted fish with coconut milk was sold out. The prices are reasonable, and the ingredients are high quality. The pork tendon stir-fry with basil was all tendons, no meat. The spicy chicken wing stew was so spicy it made my mouth burn! I didn't get thirsty afterwards, which means it didn't have much MSG (?). The service was great, not quirky or pushy.
