The drinks were refreshing and unique, with a perfect balance of sweet and sour – great for caffeine lovers. It's not too far, not too close, but parking might not be the most convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jane Ladpli

sample_reviews_en.text: If something is out of stock or unavailable, just tell the customer. That's much better than scrambling to make something and ending up with a bad result. We finished our meal, and the drinks still hadn't been served. Even after asking for the bill, the drinks still weren't ready. We waited, even after paying, because we'd already ordered them. In the end, we got Thai tea with lumpy, undissolved milk, no lid, and a cracked rim on the glass (the staff said every glass was like that; one glass had one crack, another had two). If I were the owner, I wouldn't serve low-quality products to customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jak Tas

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very first time trying black sticky rice porridge. Also known as "forget your husband" dish because it's so good when you eat it you forget about your husband.

Every dish added texture and flavour which elevated the experience.
Parking here is TIGHT however the staff are so helpful and friendly.
Agree with some other reviewers, service can be a bit slow. We had to remind them to bring the sticky rice out even though it's meant to be the star of the show.
Otherwise a lovely experience, great tastes and flavours and I'd definitely return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mary Nguyen

sample_reviews_en.text:
100 To Rung is a rice porridge restaurant perfect for a casual meal with friends or after work.
The food tastes good, with a suitable menu selection—not too few, not too many to choose from. Service is relatively quick, with dishes arriving all at once. The prices are reasonable, not too expensive. The atmosphere is lively.

The main drawback is probably the parking. Parking in the complex is quite expensive at 100 baht per hour. Otherwise, you have to park in another building and walk back, which is a bit inconvenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fon C.

sample_reviews_en.text: This rice porridge restaurant shows how much effort the team puts into preparing the food. Every dish looks simple, but it's incredibly delicious. The flavors are anything but ordinary. The taro rice porridge is amazing, with a wonderful taro aroma. The spicy salad is well-made, and the stir-fried dishes have a fantastic wok-fried aroma. We really loved it. The restaurant has a nice atmosphere and beautiful decor, and the staff provides excellent service. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Boat K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The restaurant claimed they misplaced my order, but I waited 30 minutes and received nothing.
- I had to ask for everything from water to my food.
- They served tables that arrived later and had more than 10 people. They need to pay more attention to the order in which customers enter the restaurant.
- The level of attention given to customers and problem-solving is terrible, especially considering the location, price, and positioning of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suwichaya Piyapisut

sample_reviews_en.text: 🍚🥢 This affordable rice porridge restaurant in the Ploenchit area serves delicious food. It's perfect for a relaxing after-work meal and conveniently located near the BTS. I highly recommend it! The food is truly delicious, with each dish carefully prepared. It caters to families, friends, and couples alike. The menu is diverse, and every dish is flavorful. The staff are friendly, and the "Husband-Forgotten Rice Porridge" lives up to its reputation!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wilaiporn Khruasri

restaurants.name: PLACE INN indian food
restaurants.address:

314 9Soi Banphanthom Ban Phan Thom, Khet Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I strolled behind Wat Tritotsathep in the Wisut Kasat area. Normally, when I visit this temple, I'd stop for roast duck, but today I was craving spices, so I stopped at this small Indian restaurant. The Indian food here is inexpensive. I ordered Chicken Tikka Masala, and the restaurant made it with a rich flavor – a tangy tomato taste with a hint of saltiness. The chicken was grilled well, tender and delicious. It came with naan bread and mint chutney. This meal only cost 2 red cards (approximately 1200 Thai baht).
sample_reviews_en.author: Art Suwarnatemiya

sample_reviews_en.text: Great affordable food. I chose and ate well. Ordered a beer which went flat. Checked glass and poured again and it had head ?. Very affordable and satisfying food. Vegetable pakora were the standout but the meal was great overall with big portions.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kevin Costello

sample_reviews_en.text: Amzing value local Indian restaurant. Quality is top notch, good variety of standard indian fare. Only 4 tables, but they mostly do take away. Decor is basic but fine for the price. Recommend the pani puri and the malai kofta. Never had a …
sample_reviews_en.author: Tim Brown

sample_reviews_en.text: Had a wonderful experience here. An Indian must come here if he stays nearby. What a taste friend. They make authentic Indian flavours. And that too, in very reasonable rates. If you go anywhere else, you will find Indian restaurants much …
sample_reviews_en.author: Sanjay gadari

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent food!
Chicken biryani and raita: excellent and generous portions.
Drink: a real lassi, not that kind of "shake" full of ice!

I recommend this unassuming little restaurant. The service is friendly and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: James Bond

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice resturant and food also is really amazing proper indian taste. And one of the Chief mr. Vikram cooked very nice.. i didn't taste like this in Thailand during my trip. Staff also nice well trained and service also well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Malik Iqbal

sample_reviews_en.text: I walked past this Indian restaurant and decided to stop by for the first time. The food was decent, the restaurant looked clean, and the prices were normal, not expensive. It's located in a small alley with no parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploywan Prangthong

sample_reviews_en.text: It was absolutely delicious 😋 We ordered chicken masala, fish masala, and cheese naan, and everything was excellent. The prices are reasonable, so don't hesitate to eat here!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Romain Messmer

restaurants.name: The White House Bangkok
restaurants.address:

199 8 Soi Sukhumvit 16, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at The Whitehouse Restaurant in Bangkok, and I must say, it was an exceptional experience. The food was not only delicious but very creatively served, which made for a truly unique and memorable dining experience. Everything from the appetizers to the main course was beautifully presented and tasted fantastic.

The waitstaff was attentive, knowledgeable, and made sure that every detail was taken care of throughout the evening. One of the highlights of the evening was the live music, which added to the already memorable ambiance of the restaurant.

Overall, The Whitehouse Restaurant is an absolute must-visit for foodies and anyone looking for a truly exceptional dining experience. I highly recommend it and being a Latvian myself, feel very proud of such a great representation of Latvian talent and taste in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nata Ro

sample_reviews_en.text:
A stunning place. ❤️❤️❤️ We dined at this restaurant with our children, and they were incredibly impressed by the food – they devoured all the meat we ordered, the chef's compliments, and the desserts. 🤣
Excellent food, intuitive service, a beautiful setting, and excellent live music. Each dish was an incredible aesthetic, visual, and gustatory delight, a complete harmony of flavors. Very tender and delicious meat, unusual and magnificent sauces, and incredible desserts.
You will be served delicious complimentary dishes from the chef.
This is a place for true gourmets. I highly recommend everyone to visit this place.
If you have a special event, book a table here. You will be incredibly impressed. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Мария Зырянова

sample_reviews_en.text: The White House Bangkok is a charming hidden gem in Sukhumvit 16, offering a refined Modern Creative Cuisine experience inspired by Latvian and Northern European flavors. Chef Aleksandrs brings strong culinary identity and artistic expression to every dish, with seasonal tasting menus that are thoughtfully composed and beautifully presented. The ambiance is warm and intimate, perfect for a relaxed fine-dining evening, and the live music on selected nights adds a cozy, welcoming mood. A wonderful place for diners who appreciate creativity, storytelling through food, and a truly distinctive dining experience in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ubolrat Chawteerapluk

sample_reviews_en.text:
You must visit this joint some what like a bistro and well defined bakery in the front.

Food is incredibly presented and preparations for the same is very innovative. As I had crispy kale with papaya salad but papaya was cut and induced in the dish in form of Rolls along with base tasted and textured very close to humus but not actually  Humus for sure.

Beef fried rice, another great options but can't comment as its was consumed by my friend.

By look-- very tempting.

Last but not the least , Goat cheese cake is the actual showstopper.

You want to eat until  stock finishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: SONBIR KUMAR

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had our Valentine’s dinner here and it was truly unforgettable. Every dish was beautifully presented and perfectly prepared, with amazing flavors in every bite. You could really feel the care and attention put into each course.

The service was exceptional — attentive, warm, and genuinely thoughtful, which made the evening feel even more special.

The atmosphere was romantic and elegant, creating the perfect setting for a wonderful Valentine’s celebration.

Thank you for making our night so memorable. We’ll definitely be back! Happy Valentine’s Day
sample_reviews_en.author: Pheera Iam

sample_reviews_en.text: I strongly believe the culinary scene in bangkok has gained a  new shining star ! Congrats to Chef Alex and his team providing us an excellent dining experience. It started up with awesome cocktails from the fun filled cocktail bar where expert bar tenders create the most amazing cocktails. Dinner was excellent, very creatively presented food and super tasty. A culinary  journey that embraces the heritage of Chef and thus a wonderful experience all through. Thanks also to great service team accompanying us through this journey. Absolutely loved it !
sample_reviews_en.author: sarphp

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent food and service. Rare gem in the hustle and bustle of Bangkok - once you step inside, you are transported to the serenity of Latvia - at least that’s what I imagine it is like there as I have never been to Latvia- but now more eager to visit there one day. Meticulous attention to detail on each of the dishes- we felt very special there for the entire evening. Deserve a Michelin star. Thank you for an unforgettable evening. We will be back soon.
sample_reviews_en.author: snakey

sample_reviews_en.text: The presentation and service was absolutely amazing. The food is so delicious. I took about ten instagram videos and 20 pictures! I messaged the restaurant on Line for a reservation (they responded quick btw) and when I got there I was kindly greeted and shown to a table. The menu was explained to me in great detail. The Riesling wine was strong and smooth. I will definitely be back! Thank you White House BKK for the experience ! 😘
sample_reviews_en.author: Forever Faye

restaurants.name: Eastlane อีสท์เลน ข้าวหมูแดง หมูกรอบ ก๋วยเตี๋ยวคนคลุกเนื้อ
restaurants.address:

60/1 สุทธิพงศ์1 Sutthisan Winitchai Rd, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant truly focuses on taste. The crispy pork is perfectly cooked, making for a delicious crispy pork rice dish. The price is affordable, and the portions are generous; you can eat until you're full for about 150 baht per person. The highlight is the beef and the chili oil. The chili oil is amazing! I loved it so much! But don't put too much on; taste it first, as it's spicy. But if you like spicy food, it's incredibly satisfying. It elevates the dish by a factor of 10, better than chili powder.
The braised beef rice with chili oil is incredibly satisfying.
The food quality is comparable to good Chinese restaurants, but served in a street-side shop with affordable prices. You don't need to go to a fancy restaurant, but the taste is very close.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suparkorn Tipsumonta

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is tasty and the flavors are decent, but the price is quite expensive.
The service is very slow. There were only two tables occupied, but we waited a very long time.
Actually, I've eaten roasted pork and crispy pork rice at many places and never had to wait that long. Even at Sri Krathum restaurant, which was very crowded with many delivery drivers, I never waited more than 5 minutes. This restaurant, however, made me wait over 30 minutes. I'm baffled.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yos Chomsitakul

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is located in a single shophouse unit in Soi Viphavadee 16. I decided to order delivery because I knew it would be too hot to eat there (the food is delicious, but the atmosphere would ruin it). The taste was okay, but the crispy pork had a lot of fat and the skin wasn't very crispy. The roasted pork was cut into chunks and a bit difficult to chew. The price was average.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nikornkeait Lueprasitsakul

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered from Eastlane via Lineman, and it didn’t disappoint! The red roasted pork and crispy pork with rice were flavorful, with a well-balanced gravy that wasn’t too sweet. The noodles with special spicy sauce had a great kick, and both portions were generous. Prices are reasonable, making this an easy go-to for my roasted pork cravings. Will definitely order again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Naw Hsu Ei Thin Zar (kk)

sample_reviews_en.text: Hong Kong style roasted pork and crispy pork rice. The roasted pork has a fragrant, grilled aroma, and the crispy pork is tender, bouncy, and has a crunchy skin. The sauce is neither too sweet nor too salty, just right. The soup is a little too spicy with pepper.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poonyaporn S.

sample_reviews_en.text: The roasted pork and crispy pork rice is delicious, but this time I tried the dry beef noodles. You can ask for extra sauce if there's not enough. The staff seemed a bit confused at times. Everything else was good, but the restaurant was a little hot.
sample_reviews_en.author: nawawan aiamaksorn

sample_reviews_en.text: The braised beef melts in your mouth, the shrimp dumplings have whole shrimp inside, the meatballs are delicious, the roast pork and crispy pork rice are excellent, and the chili oil is amazing and perfectly balanced. They also sell very good coffee.
sample_reviews_en.author: RATCHANON THEPPABUTRA

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles come with different levels of spiciness to choose from. I recommend trying the mildest option first, as even the mildest is delicious. The dumplings are amazing, and the dipping sauce is great. Highly recommend trying them.
sample_reviews_en.author: vetchayun suwanalup

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวหมูตุ๋นเจ๊ปู
restaurants.address:

23/6 Sukon 1 Alley, Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
JPU_NOODLES & Chicken Rice
This shop combines two businesses: noodles and chicken rice.
I ate here on a Saturday morning, so it was very comfortable and there weren't many customers.
The staff provided good service, and the owner was very friendly.
The chicken rice had a well-balanced flavor, and the broth was fragrant. I liked the broth; it had a subtle pickled lime aroma, and the skin was crispy. It was delicious.
The shop is located in Khao Lam Alley, near a famous restaurant.
The braised pork noodle soup was rich and flavorful, with a fragrant Chinese herbal aroma. There was plenty of braised pork...
The portion size isn't very large.
sample_reviews_en.author: ChubbyArin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Conclusion: This is a delicious local restaurant.
I wanted both chicken and fried chicken, so I ordered a mixed order. Just the chicken or fried chicken was 50 baht, and the mixed order was 80 baht. Both were delicious. The grandmother kindly advised me to add a little ginger to the marinade and sprinkle it lightly on the chicken or rice for a different flavor. The fried chicken is served with a spicy chili sauce.
There's no air conditioning, but the fan made it comfortable even on a 34-degree day.
sample_reviews_en.author: SeokGeun Park

sample_reviews_en.text:
We've been in Bangkok for three days and have eaten out several times. This is definitely the best!
Good and friendly service, communication in English, good prices, but above all, FABULOUS!!!
We had the fried chicken with noodles in broth. I liked it so much that I ordered a second helping of the exact same thing. As of this writing, the restaurant has a 5.0 rating, and I can already see why.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krzysztof

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is really good and cheap. And the owners are very kind and friendly. I had both fried chicken dry noodles and braise pork noodles, and all of them are really good. My friend and I really had a great time here. 👍🏻

Also, they accept cashless payment. Which is quite rare in this neighborhood.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pitchayut Chitsinpchayakun

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! My friend and I went to several other restaurants and they were always too crowded, so we looked for one that was cooler. This place was quite busy, but we didn't have to wait in line. The staff were friendly and spoke English quite well. The food was served quickly. 10 out of 10!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chiêu Phụng Trương

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came for breakfast on a Sunday morning. It was very comfortable and there weren't many customers.
The staff provided good service and the owner was very friendly.
The Hainanese chicken rice had a well-balanced flavor, the soup was fragrant, and the fried chicken was crispy, delicious, and tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัลช์วีณา คุณภัทรโภควินท์

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place for a quick meal. J'Pu is very friendly and she even gave us extra! We had Namtok noodle and Fried chicken noodle and both were delicious. We spent around 120 bath for everything. They accept cashless payment (very rare in this neighbourhood). would eat here again 10/10
sample_reviews_en.author: Beem Beem

sample_reviews_en.text: My wife and I wandered into this shop by chance and are happy we did. The chicken and noodles were very tasty, and Jpu gave me extra broth. We had a lovely conversation with her and it was one of those serendipitous highlights of our time in Bangkok. Her shop is also very clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: JB

restaurants.name: Moody's Bar
restaurants.address:

270, 2 ถนน ราษฎร์บูรณะ, Bang Pakok, Rat Burana, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The overall atmosphere is comfortable and relaxing, with pleasant background music and clearly defined seating areas—the air-conditioned rooms are quiet and inviting, while the outdoor areas effectively avoid noise pollution. The food is generally above average, with the vermicelli salad and fries being particularly outstanding, and the steak also performing well, although some soups were slightly underwhelming. Service is warm and attentive, but the speed of service may vary depending on the number of customers; patience is advised on weekends. Prices are on the higher end of the spectrum, but parking is convenient, making it a great place for gatherings with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: A Google User

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's been a long time since I last came here. Back then, overall, it was good and fun.
But today, I came again after the renovations. The place looks nicer now, but everything else isn't great.
The music is so boring it makes me sleepy, especially the songs they play during the band's breaks. I brought drinks intending to sit for a long time, but I wanted to leave after the second glass. It was quite tiresome. There are too few staff members. It takes forever to get their attention; I have to keep looking around until my neck hurts before I finally get their attention and wave them over. So frustrating.
sample_reviews_en.author: CYN

sample_reviews_en.text: The music was great, the food was delicious, and the singer was a very talented entertainer. The staff provided excellent service, were welcoming, and very friendly. The restrooms were clean and beautiful. The restaurant is beautifully decorated in a chill-out style. There were a few mosquitoes. It's a great place to relax, socialize, and meet up with friends. There are many seating areas. The food didn't take long to arrive; it was served very quickly. The staff were attentive and checked on every table, even seeing customers off. They were very lovely and friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saowalack Thapaim

sample_reviews_en.text: The overall atmosphere is relaxed, with pleasant background music, clearly defined seating areas, quiet air-conditioned rooms, and a noise-free outdoor area. The food is above average; the vermicelli salad and fries are particularly noteworthy, and the steak is also good, although some soups are slightly disappointing. Service is warm and attentive, but the speed of service varies depending on the number of customers, so patience is advised on weekends. Prices are moderate to slightly high, parking is convenient, making it suitable for gatherings with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: 曼谷上门服务Outcall Services

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great! 💫
❤️The staff provided excellent service, recommending drinks and chatting with us.
💓They were open during Songkran, which was fantastic!
❤️The musicians were great, the singer had a beautiful voice, and the entertainment was superb. It was so good I almost didn't want to tell anyone, afraid it would get too crowded.
❤️The atmosphere was relaxed, spacious, comfortable seating, not cramped, and breezy.
💓Perfect for people in their mid-30s who are worried about back pain. 🥰🥰🥰😘😘

💚Why did I only just find out about this place? 555 The food was delicious. 🍰
sample_reviews_en.author: Phatharachanok Tessanan

sample_reviews_en.text: A hidden gem for all tourists: the service is excellent and attentive. The location is lovely, perfect for both partying and dinner. The steak was superb. Unlike typical Thai restaurants, the music is at a very pleasant volume. Highly recommended if you're looking for a more authentic local experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexander S.

sample_reviews_en.text: My last visit was in May 2025. The wait for food was extremely long. The plates, bowls, spoons, and glasses were not clean and appeared unhygienic. The food tasted strange; the spicy pork rib soup tasted particularly sour. I wasn't impressed at all. Never going back again. 🙂‍↔️🙂‍↔️😞
sample_reviews_en.author: JīngBǎo_Kaew

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every dish was delicious, the music was great, and the service was excellent.
The atmosphere when you enter the restaurant is like being in Thonglor.
The food was just as delicious as it was 10 years ago, but the restaurant has been renovated, and the atmosphere is even better now.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jelly Pink

restaurants.name: ร้าน ดอกทานตะวัน สาขา2
restaurants.address:

849 Sukhumvit 81 Alley, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a small restaurant, but it has a wide selection of dishes and attentive service, making it a comfortable place to be. I used a Google coupon to get some vegetable soup after my drinks. It was delicious! It's inexpensive, so it's a great place to stop by during your trip.
sample_reviews_en.author: mieko sakamoto

sample_reviews_en.text: It's very bad service. I had to wait over 1.5 hour for my order and they missed one of them. I tried to contact but they ignored me without taking responsibility. Bad service. The food is too salty. Not recommend this restaurant. I wish I can rate 0 star.
sample_reviews_en.author: Công Trí Nguyễn

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you want to eat here, DON’T.
My first ever one star review in my life
Got their food from grab and it's the worst we have ever. …
sample_reviews_en.author: dietheflu

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food and great service. There's a wide variety of dishes to choose from. The owner is Japanese and very lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwanapipat99

sample_reviews_en.text: There are many Japanese izakayas in Bangkok. The menu is incredibly extensive and the ingredients...
sample_reviews_en.author: Papa Tanukimusuko

restaurants.name: Mama Pasta
restaurants.address:

41/33 M10 Phatthaya Tai 16, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely horrible. They messed up my order and didnt give the scallopini, instead seems they replaced it with overcooked fries which less than half the price and which i already ordered a serve of. So i got 2 serves of disgusting overcooked frozen fries, garlic bread was 3 tiny pieces and looked very average. Spaghetti tasted bland and no sauce. Overall was terrible experience and will never ever order from here again!! Nearly 500 baht wasted on this. They shouldnt try to cheat people by giving them fries instead of what they actually ordered and the food itself was very average to woeful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Zuraw

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited the restaurant alone just after 4 p.m. There were no customers, and a friendly waiter was serving and cooking alone. Perhaps because of the time of day, the restaurant felt a bit cluttered and quiet. I ordered carbonara for 150 baht. The noodles were a little soft, but the flavor was delicious. However, the restaurant's location isn't particularly convenient, so I'm not sure whether it's worth walking or taking a taxi to get there if you're sightseeing.
sample_reviews_en.author: chebutrip

sample_reviews_en.text: Staying in the LK Legend for a month I got talking to an Italian guy about 60 or so years old, he told me he didn’t drink alcohol it instead enjoyed fine food… he gave me a tip about Mama Pasta, she said ‘it’s as close to Italy as you will fine here in Pattaya’ and was he right! Wow, food is amazing and very cheap, with a glass of nice white wine for 100 baht, I’ve been here most days since.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Burke

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered take away from Mama Pasta as was craving some garlicky spicy spaghetti and wow I was not disappointed.  TBH it was to cure a hangover and so affordable on Grab that I went for two dishes.  Both around 180-200Bht and full of flavour not to mention great quantity.  Would definitely recommend and will return.
sample_reviews_en.author: World Traveller

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to eat there after reading reviews.
I ordered the aglio e olio, but it was incredibly spicy.
This is the first time I've had aglio e olio with so much peperoncino.
It was spicy, but the taste was good.
I ended up eating it all.
I'm curious about the other dishes, so I'll try them next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Happy miyamiya

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is good, but the kids who work as waiters are subpar.  Yelling, hitting each other, running around, forgetting half of the order because other things are more important.  You should use service staff who care about the guests and don't have childish games in their heads.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hans Krause

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a seafood pasta. Wow! Love it. Very big portion. Seafood with big shrimps, squids and mussels.  They were very fresh. It's only 180B. Most pastas are around 120-150B. Real Italian foods.
Not a fancy place though but new and very clean. Going back soon. Recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: Dom Van

sample_reviews_en.text: We have eaten there twice, the first time order the Greek salad and a pizza and pasta the Greek salad was not very good but the rest was good , the second time we both had a pasta dish both where nice , service is not great that’s why they did not get 5 star .
sample_reviews_en.author: mickey kolody

restaurants.name: Thippharot Chicken Grill
restaurants.address:

608, 15-16 Sathu Pradit Rd, Bang Phong Phang, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The sourness is dominant, other flavors are lacking. This is an honest review, and at 50฿/bag, the portion is very small. The best thing is probably the grilled chicken.
sample_reviews_th.author: karnsirimay saengsuma

sample_reviews_en.text:
Crispy-skinned grilled chicken that I happened to pass by. They grill it fresh in front of the shop, so I stopped to buy some to take home and try.

- The signature dish, grilled chicken, is large with crispy skin and a decent flavor. It's grilled a bit dry; those who prefer soft, juicy chicken might not like it.
- Grilled pork neck is fragrant and delicious, not overly fatty. I liked it.
- Thai papaya salad wasn't quite to my liking.
- Corn salad with salted egg tasted good.

Overall, the prices are reasonable considering the portion sizes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Farng M Wong

sample_reviews_en.text: The food has a moderate flavor, depending on personal preference. We thought it was delicious, especially the Thai papaya salad and the crispy-skinned grilled chicken. The salads were a bit sour, which I personally like, so I found them tasty. The only downside is parking; it's difficult to find, or almost impossible, depending on your luck. You have to park on the side of the road, checking the signs for odd/even day parking restrictions.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phempriza Pirajkman

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is known for its perfectly seasoned, crispy-skinned grilled chicken. It pairs wonderfully with dishes like papaya salad, larb, nam tok, or tom yum soup. Parking is available on the street in front of the restaurant, but be sure to check the odd/even day parking restrictions. I highly recommend trying it. The restaurant is located approximately on Soi Sathu Pradit 54, opposite Kasikorn Bank.
sample_reviews_en.author: เอ Asp auto

sample_reviews_en.text: They grill gai yang and catfish over charcoal. They apparently grill it for about 30 minutes. Half a gai yang is 100B. The skin is crispy and the inside is soft and fluffy, and it's delicious. Catfish is 120B. Beef is 100B. Som tam and pork bone tom sep moo are also good. The regular som tam is too spicy, so it's best to order it without any spice. The fried catfish salad was surprisingly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manuel Velazqez

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the most healthy, clean and economical grilled chicken shops in the world. Super clean restaurant with a friendly family working extremely hard all day to serve us this amazing taste. Whenever you want to eat grilled chicken, eat it as it gets ready from the grill. If you put it in a plastic box it can become another thing. I always eat at the restaurant. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Areeb

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered through Grab, as you can see in the picture. I specifically requested no chili, but they still put chili in it. Do you understand what it's like for someone who doesn't eat spicy food? How am I supposed to eat this? I'd just have to throw it away. What's the point of eating something so painful? ***The restaurant should check the notes.***
sample_reviews_en.author: Cat Yana

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! The grilled chicken had crispy skin, not extremely crispy, but the standout feature was the tenderness of the meat. I usually don't eat chicken breast because it's dry, but I ate all the pieces here! Every part was tender. It was topped with fried garlic, which complemented it well. The papaya salad with fermented crab was also good.
sample_reviews_en.author: wasakorn faknuam

restaurants.name: ร้านเจ๊ปุ้ยเจ้าเก่า
restaurants.address:

761, 2 Chan Rd, Thung Wat Don, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop front looks ordinary and cluttered. I've passed by many times without paying attention to eating there. Today, I read the sign and decided to give it a try. The noodles were pretty good, and the meatballs were of good quality, but the price might seem a bit high for this type of shop. The rice noodle rolls were also delicious; I personally liked the bamboo shoot filling. However, I didn't like the sweet dark soy sauce dressing; it lacked aroma, so the flavor wasn't quite there.
sample_reviews_en.author: DukeTK

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dry rice noodle salad, very delicious.
The noodles are perfectly cooked, not mushy.
The seasoning is delicious, a perfect balance of sour, salty, spicy, and sweet.
The meatballs and dumplings are tasty, and the offal is clean.

Only 50 baht per bowl.

They also sell rice noodle rolls.

The mooncakes sold at the front of the shop are also pretty good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teerapat Ungsriwong

sample_reviews_en.text: Yen Ta Fo, both dry and soup, very good. Small dry, large dry, delicious. Good noodles. Clean shop. A bit slow because there are a lot of riders. Don't go during lunch time, you'll be irritated. There's no parking, but 20 meters past the shop there's an alley on the left, go in 20 meters, on the right there's parking for 10 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: chintat viasuvanna

sample_reviews_en.text: Fish balls/fish maw kueh, tastes okay, fried fish balls/dumplings, tastes okay, fish dumplings, taste good, pork pieces/intestines/hearts are soft and taste good, soup is well-rounded, Yen ta fo sauce is okay, rolled noodles with chives/bamboo shoots/cabbage/sweet potato filling, tastes okay, sold at a moderate price (4.3)
sample_reviews_en.author: pongsathorn poolpoka

sample_reviews_en.text: I bought it to eat at home, so the noodles were a bit too close together. The meatballs and dumplings were delicious, but the soup was just okay. If I had eaten it at the restaurant, it would have been even more delicious. Avoid lunchtime when there are a lot of long queues.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vannaporn Aeh

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is not too spicy, it focuses on smoothness. If it's Tom Yum, it's also good and smoothness. Anyone who likes Tom Yum with minced pork can order this. There's a lot of minced pork.
sample_reviews_en.author: DARAYANYANIN CLAIRE BY BELLEBACK

sample_reviews_en.text: I love the rice noodle rolls that come with generous amounts of garlic, cilantro, chili vinegar, and soy sauce. The fried garlic is homemade. You have to try it yourself!
sample_reviews_en.author: Audcharawan Jiranthorn

sample_reviews_en.text: Haven't been there in a while, the shop has moved, but still has the same Yen Ta Fo noodles, Tom Yum noodles, and noodle soup. The soup is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: W C

restaurants.name: กะเพราแท้ สาขา แม็คโครศรีอยุธยา
restaurants.address:

565 Thanon Si Ayutthaya, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste was good, authentic basil stir-fry, nothing added. It was quite spicy and dry-fried. However, the price is quite high. I wish the egg was presented more nicely, and most importantly, the rice was cold and bland, and it was just plain rice—too ordinary. They should increase their budget to buy jasmine rice and cook it better. Given the size of the restaurant, they should aim for better quality food. And if possible, they should also provide soup.
Ordering soup separately is expensive, and the menu doesn't offer many choices.
Overall, I wasn't impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kodchanan Bupasiri

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was good, but the rice might need improvement. For over 100 baht, the rice was like the mushy, broken grains you find at roadside curry stalls. I wish they used better quality rice; it would enhance the flavor. The meat was good, and the crispy pork was excellent. I usually don't like mushy, broken rice like this, so I often choose restaurants in malls that are more expensive hoping for higher-quality rice. 😂 If they changed the rice, I'm sure it would taste even better and attract more customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dadá Wa

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very authentic taste of Pad Kra Prao. Recommended if you would like to taste authenthai Thai Kra Prao rice, this is the place to come and try by yourself. You can choose the level of spicyness and I recommend you go with the standard one.

The pichanha beef steak was perfectly grilled but it was a bit too tough to chew. The decoration of this place is mimicking local Thai roadside hawker stalls.

Great food with okay service but the price is a bit too steep for the food portion served.
sample_reviews_en.author: apiwatbob

sample_reviews_en.text: The original Pad Krapoa should be done like this. Dry and aromatic with no additional vegetables or onion. You can select chilli level according to to your taste bud. This type of Krapoa is nostalgic as these Krapoa are too watery. This is hand down one of the best Krapoa recipe I have ever eaten. Simply lip smacking. They do also have some other dish. All are equally good. Recommended. The Original Pad Krapao.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thusnai M

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my go-to restaurant and a safe zone for basil pork lovers like me. It's close to home and the taste is great; I could eat here every day. My favorite is the XL minced pork basil pork, which has the same amount of rice but double the amount of meat – incredibly filling!

They offer five levels of spiciness, which varies from day to day, but for a spicy food lover like me, level 3 is usually my go-to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peeradon Ariyanukooltorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The basil chicken tasted okay, but the management system was terrible.
I ordered two dishes. The first dish came in the normal queue. The second dish took half an hour to arrive. I watched the tables next to me, who came later, already get their dishes—three tables in total. I had to ask three times before it finally arrived. Thank you very much.
sample_reviews_en.author: สา ซ่า

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place specializes in pad kra pao so naturally small menu.
I've tried the version with crispy pork belly and medium spicy. I'd say p spicy actually but still tasty. The pork belly was crispy and juicy. Quantity was decent but considering the price Iit could be a lil more I think. Overall I liked it.
sample_reviews_en.author: L

sample_reviews_en.text: The basil chicken here isn't just for filling your stomach, it's about getting "into" the flavor. Not trying it is a life-changing mistake 🤤 Every dish is amazing, and I can honestly say it's worth every penny, especially the crispy pork – it's absolutely fantastic! …
sample_reviews_en.author: Teerakorn Tulasueb

restaurants.name: ร้านยำเสนา
restaurants.address:

หมู่บ้านเสนาวิลล่า84 720 ซอย แฮปปี้แลนด์ 1 แยก 3 Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This spicy salad (Yum) shop is located quite far out, requiring a long drive across a bridge. It's on the left-hand side; don't worry about getting lost, it's in a village. It's a bit dark inside.

It's a very simple, homey place, like a casual street food stall. There are two couples working, and the tables aren't particularly fancy.

The menu is extensive but decent. I ordered 5 items for 3 people and they were all delicious. My favorite was the shrimp fried rice; the shrimp were large and perfectly cooked.

The spicy salad was delicious, not too sweet, and very well-balanced. I'll definitely be back.

Parking is easy nearby. They're available on LineMan & Grabfood.

They serve in order of arrival. There weren't many people, but there were a lot of deliveries, so the wait was long – you could sit and have a beer while you waited until you were hungry. They don't serve alcohol or liquor.

The restroom is not available. I recommend finishing your meal before you come; it's incredibly spicy!

Wash your hands outside, don't go inside.

Overall, I'd come back and bring my mom, but I'll make sure to use the restroom before I arrive. Promise :)
sample_reviews_en.author: PS

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a salad (spicy Thai salad) restaurant I've been eating at since I was a kid, for over 20-30 years now.
It's still as delicious as ever.
1. Sour curry with acacia leaves and shrimp: Rich and flavorful sour curry with thick acacia leaves that absorb the broth perfectly, along with large shrimp. 150 baht.
2. Kale stem and young coconut shoot salad: A family favorite. We order it every time we come. Tender and crispy, with a satisfying crunch with every bite. 120 baht.
3. Grilled pork neck: I dare you to try it! The best in half of Bangkok. You can't come without ordering it. Tender, juicy, and perfectly balanced. 150 baht.
4. Instant noodle salad with squid and shrimp: Packed with ingredients, with a perfect balance of sweet, sour, and spicy flavors.
120 baht.
This is an old, family-run restaurant located in Sena Happy Land village. It's quite deep inside the village; it wouldn't have been open this long if it wasn't truly exceptional. There's parking available in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jakaphan Manpiriya

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in Sena Villa, Phase 2.
Enter the village, cross the bridge, and it's on your left. 🏠

The spicy salad is incredibly delicious and flavorful. It doesn't leave your throat burning or make you excessively thirsty. 🍅🌶️🍋‍🟩🧄🧅

The ingredients are fresh, clean, and the food looks just as appetizing as it tastes! 🐙🦐

The restaurant is open in the evenings and closed on Tuesdays.
If you're worried about finding it closed, it's best to call ahead to check.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanathorn Ngamchai

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant's pork neck dishes are absolutely not to be missed. The fried pork neck is the best – crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, and golden brown. The crispy catfish salad is intensely flavorful and incredibly delicious. And to finish, the grilled pork neck with lemon is the perfect ending; the smoky aroma of the grilled pork blends wonderfully with the savory salad dressing. It's so good, I'll definitely be back many more times.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sweet Berry

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant offers a wide variety of Thai salads (Yum), and every single one is absolutely delicious. The prices are very affordable, the ingredients are fresh and clean, and the atmosphere is simple and friendly. Even though it's located in a somewhat secluded area, it always has customers. You should definitely stop by if you have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Catzmo

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious...but I didn't take any pictures because I was with older people...what a shame. My favorite dishes are the fried pork patties and the crab omelet. Honestly, the crab omelet at Jay Fai's isn't as good; this one is much better. Another amazing dish is the stir-fried shrimp with chili and salt. You should definitely try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: sarun59

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is located in a village. You have to park on the side of the road to eat. This is my second time here. I'm hooked on their grilled pork with lime.

The food tastes great. The lime dishes are very flavorful, but the spicy salad wasn't quite as zesty. They give generous portions of ingredients, and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Uracha Wesaratchakon

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is in a village. The taste is suitable for eating with family. I recommend the Cha-om salad. Highly recommended. The taste is rich, sweet and sour just right. The shrimp in fish sauce is very fresh. The shrimp are very big. Worth the price. The shrimp stir-fried with fresh chili, the shrimp are big and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: n

restaurants.name: Nuan Somtam
restaurants.address:

Soi Bua Phueng Phatthana, Bang Kobua, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ate there on June 21, 2023, almost noon. It was extremely hot.

I ordered Som Tum (Thai papaya salad) with one chili (delicious!) and stir-fried rice noodles with water spinach.

Unbeknownst to me, the noodles contained chili, making them inedible. I asked the owner if I could take them home in a bag (to rinse them with hot water), but she insisted on making a new one without chili.
I felt really bad and kept saying no, because it was my fault for not knowing it contained chili. But she insisted on making a new one.
Finally, I got my order.

Thank you so much, and I'm truly sorry for the inconvenience.

The owners were incredibly kind.

They even wanted to take a group photo, but I was busy watching the World Cup and missed it.😅

Next time I go, I'll order the fried rice with grilled pork neck or something like that... I overheard the next table ordering it and it looked delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: YuKiMuRa

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was so delicious, I just had to leave a review! 😅 I ordered Pad Thai, grilled chicken, stir-fried rice noodles with water spinach, grilled pork salad, garlic shrimp and squid, sweet liver, Thai papaya salad with salted egg, papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce, and incredibly soft black sticky rice from Nong Khai. It was all so good I forgot to take pictures! 😅 The couple served everything we asked for. Even though the uncle looked a bit stern, he even drove his motorbike to buy more beer! 😆 I hope more people will come and support them so they won't be lonely. 😋 Park your car on the side of the road by the green trash can and walk along the bridge to get there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kira Mi

sample_reviews_en.text: I called to ask for directions many times because I'm not from around here. There was no tantrum at all. It's a really cute hidden gem of a restaurant. I didn't even get a chance to take pictures when the food arrived, but I just wanted to shout, lie down and shout, how incredibly delicious it was! If you're nearby or passing by, HAVE to try it. It's seriously amazing, the grilled pork neck is the absolute best! I wanted to scream! The dipping sauce is also incredibly delicious. I can't even describe it. You have to try it yourself! Come support the owner! ❤️❤️ The food also came super fast!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: I’m here to review

sample_reviews_en.text:
Anyone visiting Bang Krachao should stop by and eat at this restaurant. I must say the owner is incredibly friendly, the food is cheap, and the portions are generous.
Recommended dishes:
Pad Thai
Shrimp stir-fried with garlic and chili
Tom Yum soup
Shrimp noodles stir-fried with mimosa
Grilled pork neck
Thai papaya salad

The restaurant is accessible by motorbike or bicycle. There is parking available. If you come by car, you can park on the side of the road and walk in.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poongmhanoi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Introducing a hidden gem of a restaurant with amazing value and quality!
If you're visiting Bang Nam Phueng, you absolutely must stop by.
I highly recommend Aunt Nual's Pad Thai and the grilled pork neck fried rice.
It's a shame the owner wasn't grilling chicken this time.
He said he started grilling it but nobody came.
He said he ate it all himself until he got gout! 🤣😂555 (Just kidding!)
The owners, an elderly couple, are super fun to talk to and very friendly. 😁😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Pomeko Channel

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the portions were generous, which I really appreciated. I enjoyed the forest breeze and ordered some to take home for my family. The elderly couple who own the place are so lovely. It's a very chill place. The street you walk down is like a small canal, it's not too isolated, there are people passing by all the time, and there are houses further in.
sample_reviews_en.author: sleeping beauty

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has great food, good ingredients, and reasonable prices. What I really want to recommend is the owner, an elderly gentleman. If you want a fun and lively atmosphere, you have to come here because the owner is incredibly quirky but kind. He's a joy to talk to and will keep you laughing throughout your meal. Park on the street and walk in.
sample_reviews_en.author: Niracha Junsri

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant makes every dish to order perfectly. Delicious, flavorful, and reasonably priced.
Recommended: Thai papaya salad (the papaya salad noodles are correctly made, great taste) and the stir-fried instant noodles. Honestly, I didn't expect it to be so delicious; no need to add any seasoning at all! 👍👍💖
sample_reviews_en.author: yada Kulthanawat

restaurants.name: Burger Inc.
restaurants.address:

20/6 Soi Ratchadamri 2, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stumbled upon this burger joint in Bangkok by chance, and since the ratings were so high, I visited out of sheer curiosity.

After trying it, my curiosity was completely satisfied. I understood why it received a perfect score.

The owner was incredibly friendly, and although it appears they share the first floor with the newly opened Kitsch Cafe, the shop itself was also very clean.

The burger was juicy, and the bun was perfectly toasted. If you are in Bangkok and craving a burger, I highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sung Joo Lim

sample_reviews_en.text: The double cheeseburger is 340 baht. It has two thick patties, each about 2 centimeters thick – a satisfyingly full bite. The price is worth the quality and location. There's comfortable seating with 5-6 tables, and they also sell coffee. The buns are a normal Thai size, not the big, wide American-style buns that are served with thin slices like those in franchises. I prefer this style; it's more satisfying. Next time I'll try the lamb burger.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chananvit Wayuparb

sample_reviews_en.text: Tucked away in a little alley in Chidlom, this place is definitely worth seeking out. I tried the double cheeseburger with sweet potato fries and both were excellent. The burger patties were incredibly tender without being overly oily, and the sweet potato fries are an absolute must-order. The restaurant is also very comfortable to sit in, and the service was outstanding. Will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirinya Suttapong

sample_reviews_en.text: Tried Burger House today. The burger was tasty and juicy, and the bun was fresh. Fries were nice. Service was quick and staff were friendly. Prices are affordable for the quality. The place is small but clean and comfortable. Overall, a good spot for a quick burger. I would come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Florida Weldu

sample_reviews_en.text: I was throughly intrigued upon first viewing Burger Inc.'s menu that promises what's in its title, as well as a smattering of some Japanese influenced dishes, such as Hambagu Steak and Arabiki Sausage Curry. After having sampled a few items …
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeremy Johnson

sample_reviews_en.text: Tucked away on a quiet street, this spot feels like a hidden gem that’s just starting to get the attention it deserves. The space is modern but laid-back, just a chill place where you can sit, relax, and actually have a proper conversation …
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a hidden gem I discovered by chance while passing by. It's easy to miss because there's no sign, but the quality of the burgers is excellent. The owner is friendly, and considering the prices of restaurants in the area, I highly …
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanhoi Heo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Review for delivery order via Grab
I ordered the Mushroom Swiss burger. The bun was delicious, and the beef patty was good too. Overall, it was very tasty. It would be even better if they added a relish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwan Jamigranont

restaurants.name: หมูกระทะคุณปอ
restaurants.address:

43 718 Rarm Intra 3 Alley, อนุสาวรีย์ Bang Khen, Bangkok 10220, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This famous restaurant, which I've heard of for a long time but only recently tried, is quite stuffy, typical of a BBQ restaurant, but they have fans running constantly, which helps a little.

The BBQ pork is inexpensive and great value for money. Everything is fresh, including the shrimp.

Vegetables are free to take, ice is free, and they have every type of dipping sauce imaginable. You can make your own sauce however you like – it's awesome!

The fried side dishes are excellent and delicious, and reasonably priced.

The staff are also attentive and come promptly when called.

Overall, it's great and definitely worth the money. It gets crowded, so if you come late, you might have to wait in line.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sompound

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've never eaten moo krata 12 times in a month, and I've never liked moo krata this much before. No matter how much I liked it, I only went about it three times a month. No matter how addicted I was, I'd never been able to eat it this much. The lovely staff might have made a mistake by charging me the wrong amount. I ordered a small set and got a large set. I'm not a good person, but I didn't dare cheat them because their food was so good value. It was a great value, better than a buffet. They had my favorite vegetables, which no other restaurant had, and they were always free to serve as miang (rice cakes). It was so delicious.
Thank you for making such good moo krata that I could eat every day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeff EMO

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's amazing! All this for 389 baht. For two people, it's 195 baht per person. So filling, so delicious, and so cheap.
There are so many different kinds of dipping sauces, and they're all delicious. They have everything from moo kata (grilled pork) sauce, seafood sauce, jaew (jaew), sesame and peanut sauce, and even Japanese-style yakiniku sauce. They even come in bottles. Check them out!
If you're on a budget but still craving moo kata, this is the place to go. It's so filling, you'll have to take home a packet of instant noodles instead! 😂
- Large moo kata set 269 baht
- Marinated salmon 80 baht
- Medium bottle of Pepsi 30 baht
- Water 10 baht
- Free vegetables/ice!
sample_reviews_en.author: RIGHTNOWPHOTO

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a non-buffet style Thai BBQ (Moo Krata). You order sets/plates.

Delicious, generous portions for the price, and good quality ingredients.

Peak hours in the early evening might mean a long wait.

The restaurant isn't hot inside, with plenty of fans, but be warned, you'll definitely smell like smoke!

Service is a bit self-service as it's busy and staff can't attend to everyone.

The fresh vegetable line is extensive and clean. There are 3-4 pre-made dipping sauces, but plenty of condiments to customize your own.

Parking is available for 3-4 cars in front of the restaurant.

This is now one of my top choices for a la carte Moo Krata.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarunyapong Hotarabavanond

sample_reviews_en.text:
Whenever I want to eat Mookata (Thai BBQ), it always has to be Khun Por's restaurant because it's cheap, good value, and delicious. But today, when I went, I understood that costs have increased lately and the economy isn't good, so adjusting the prices is okay.
However, today I felt that the quality and quantity had decreased, even though the price had increased? The pork belly was like a ghost of pork. It's not like before when it was thick, pink, and white. Compared to the increased price, it's not as good value as before. I'm a little disappointed because before it was amazing. It used to be my number one favorite restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Barbie

sample_reviews_en.text:
Khun Por's BBQ Pork, next to Central Ramintra.
Come on Saturday or Sunday evenings, expect a queue. We had about 20 people in line, but the wait wasn't too long, around 30 minutes.

Overall, it was great. The meat was excellent. We ordered two plates totaling 500 grams for 430 baht. The marinated salmon was good for the price. The pork set was also generous with a variety of options. The jellyfish was good.
Vegetables, mushrooms, dipping sauces, and ice are unlimited!
sample_reviews_en.author: หมูอ้วนตะลุยโลก MooAuan Explorer

sample_reviews_en.text:
-Pork BBQ: Decent ingredients, good price.
-Beef / Beef tongue: Excellent, delicious, quite good.
-Vegetable buffet: Unlimited refills, but I have to deduct points because the vegetable bar had so many flies! I didn't dare pick any raw vegetables to eat, especially the watermelon.
-A huge variety of dipping sauces, from many different countries. Many of them were delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: muay_ann apk

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, really good. The prawns I ordered were huge! The vegetables were fresh and clean, the dipping sauce was tasty, and there were plenty of side dishes. It was more than worth the price. The pork belly was also excellent – ​​I even ordered an extra large plate!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kai Dow

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเนื้อ ป้าศิริ (เจ้าเก่าบางขุนนนท์)​
restaurants.address:

62 55 Bang Khun Non Rd, Bang Khun Non, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: If anyone has ever eaten beef noodle soup at that old shop in Bang Khun Non, it used to be located opposite the nursing student dorms in Bang Khun Non Soi. I've been eating there for over 10 years, since I was in university. Back then, I ate there very often. I still remember the taste of the fragrant broth and the clean offal. Lately, I've been passing by that area more often, so I went back to eat. At first, I saw that it was the only shop that had moved from its original location to the entrance of Soi 8, Bang Khun Non. Then, suddenly, the owner opened another shop, which I followed to. It's also at the entrance of Soi 8, but the old shop had moved for reasons unknown. I tried it once, but the broth wasn't the same anymore. Today, I went back to Aunt Siri's shop, and I can say with certainty that the taste is exactly the same as before. It's delicious and incredibly satisfying.
sample_reviews_en.author: Permsak “ตี๋โคตรรีวิว” Chantarawongsakul

sample_reviews_en.text: This old-school beef noodle shop in Bang Khun Non is easily accessible on foot from the MRT Bang Khun Non station. It's conveniently located. It gets moderately busy during lunchtime, but there's usually seating available. The noodle broth is clear but flavorful and delicious, just the way I like it. The beef pieces aren't very large, but they're fresh. They also serve papaya salad and rice dishes. The prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tang Raksat

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my absolute favorite beef noodle shop! The broth is perfectly seasoned and delicious even without adding any extra seasoning. The beef is excellent in every cut, from fresh and stewed to the offal; nothing smells bad at all, everything is incredibly tasty. I'll definitely be back for more – I love it so much! The price is also reasonable considering the generous portions. I'm officially a regular customer! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Wan Ya

sample_reviews_en.text: Legendary beef noodles in Bang Khun Non. Aside from Nai Tee, there's also Aunt Siri, whose taste is delicious and still open for people to eat. This shop isn't the best, but it's the one I like the most. The flavor of the soup, beef, offal, quantity, and price are all perfectly balanced. No matter where we move, we've been going to eat here for a long time. But after COVID, we've always ordered to take home to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bestlingchan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Review of the stewed beef: The broth is good, rich, and slightly sweet and salty. Paired with the homemade dipping sauce (the chili and lime juice are amazing), it's a perfect match.
The stewed ingredients are cut into small pieces, so some pieces look like scraps. However, considering the price and value (a regular noodle soup costs 60 baht), it's quite good and not expensive. I'll definitely be back ;)
sample_reviews_en.author: Duke Chieocharnyont

sample_reviews_en.text: Famous stewed beef in Bang Khun Non area. The soup is a bit too sweet. It tastes like stewed pork noodle soup. But it depends on the person's preference. Personally, I felt that the beef today was a bit tough. The chili sauce here is very spicy and sour. It's very spicy and sour. A set of satay beef is 70 baht. The beef is soft and fragrant. You can park on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maie Chubbie

sample_reviews_en.text:
The beef noodles were okay. The beef was tender and the offal wasn't smelly or tough, but the soup was sweet and salty, with a lot of seasonings. It made me thirsty.

However, the cleanliness was not up to par. The floor was dirty, and the spices had probably never been washed (I didn't dare season them). Pigeons had even entered the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Good food hunter

sample_reviews_en.text: This noodle and beef noodle shop is a great place in the Bang Khun Non area. The taste is good and the price is reasonable. They give you a good amount even though the pieces of beef are small. The tea here is delicious. I come here often and it's close to my workplace. There's parking for motorcycles.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chet Pro

restaurants.name: Shun No Aji Sushi Bar
restaurants.address:

8 Phatthanakan 53, Khwaeng Suan Luang, Khet Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Shun No Aji is a true hidden gem in the Phatthanakan area. It's a small and cozy place that offers a truly feel-good dining experience. The quality and freshness of the fish are on par with high-end Japanese restaurants. The sushi rice is perfectly balanced—not too hard, not too soft—with just the right hint of flavor. The prices are excellent value for the quality.

Seats are limited, so reservations are recommended. Street parking is available, though it can be a bit tricky to find. Note that credit cards are not accepted here. A must-try spot for sushi lovers in this area.

Shun No Aji is a small Japanese restaurant hidden in the Phatthanakan area. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, giving you a good feeling from the moment you step inside. The quality and freshness of the fish are comparable to high-end Japanese restaurants. The sushi rice is perfectly cooked, neither too hard nor too soft, and has a well-balanced flavor. The prices are reasonable for the quality.

Reservations are recommended. Street parking is available but can be difficult to find. Credit cards are not accepted here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oil Suebsiri T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sushi Bar

The restaurant uses A++ quality fresh ingredients in every dish ordered. Some dishes are even reordered to ensure the taste is perfect. It could be said that this restaurant uses ingredients comparable to those found in high-end omakase restaurants.

The service is impeccable. This may be due to the restaurant's counter-bar style with only three small tables, allowing for efficient and comprehensive service.

The atmosphere, from the moment you step through the door, feels like entering an authentic Japanese restaurant—not a touristy spot, but a local eatery catering to the Japanese community.

Overall, this restaurant is perfect for foodies and lovers of Japanese cuisine, especially sushi and sashimi. The average price is considered "worthwhile" given the quality of the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nate Amp

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted okay for the price.
However, the pictures on the menu didn't match the actual food served, which was a bit disappointing.

The Wagyu roll showed 5 pieces in the picture, but only 4 were served.
The Chutoro sushi had caviar in the picture, but didn't.
The Akami avocado roll didn't have sauce or mayonnaise in the picture, but was served with a lot of it.
The Maguro sashimi had wasabi on every piece in the picture, but only every other piece was served.

The only thing that was okay was the steamed egg custard.

The atmosphere in the restaurant was nice; customers sat at the bar,
the owner sat at a table to the side working on their computer 😓
Hot tea took a while to heat up, and refills had to be requested.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nichakul Kaewsolod

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is really cute and has a warm atmosphere. It's not hard to find, but parking can be a bit of a gamble. If you really can't find a parking spot, we went on a weekday and were able to park at Uniqlo, which was easy.
The menu has a wide variety of dishes. The fish is fresh and delicious, and it's seasonal fish. There were some things we didn't even recognize, which was great to try new things, and they were all delicious. We were happy! The staff were also lovely and provided good service. My friend and I sat at the counter, so we were able to split our bills. We were very impressed!
sample_reviews_en.author: yosita’ sr.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fish was very fresh. The price reflected the quality – neither too expensive nor too cheap. There was no service charge. I usually prefer sashimi rice to have a slightly sour taste, but this wasn't sour at all. It depends on personal preference. They offer a selection of unique seasonal fish, so it's not repetitive or boring like other restaurants.
Would I come back? Personally, yes.
The price, which allowed me to try almost every dish, was 1500-2000 baht per person.
That's reasonable for a restaurant with such fresh and delicious fish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dlwlrma

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small Japanese restaurant serving high-quality food at reasonable prices.
They have a wide selection of fish, but if you're a fan of donburi (donburi bowls) or rolls/handrolls like me, they also have a wide selection of dishes. Every dish is rich and delicious. You get to enjoy quality food at a reasonable price. I'll definitely be back. Although this is a small restaurant, I recommend making a reservation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittiphit Sirisawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Shun no Aji is a sushi spot with good quality that matches the price. The fish is fresh, flavors are balanced, and overall it feels worth what you pay for. 🍣✨

The restaurant itself is small and quiet, with limited seating. It’s more suitable for dining solo or with a companion rather than in a big group. A comfortable, calm place to enjoy sushi without the crowd.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fon C.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is delicious, but the portion is small and not worth the price.
I'm not sure if other positive reviews mentioned having a different chef than the one we did, but there are many comparisons to other good Japanese restaurants. I want to emphasize that the quality and taste are truly excellent, but for this price and portion size, it's surprisingly small.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaewbudsakorn Srimai

restaurants.name: 又一村 Another village
restaurants.address:

22, 421 Rama II Soi 54, Samae Dam, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
13/12/24
The food was very flavorful and delicious. Every dish was great. I highly recommend the stir-fried squid with chili and salt – it was amazing! The only downside was that the staff didn't understand Thai very well.

Food Taste: 5/5
Portion Size: 4/5
Price: 4/5
Atmosphere: 4/5
Service: 3/5
Cleanliness: 5/5

Overall: 4.2/5

P.S. This is all my personal opinion.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaitakorn Ruengnithikongkrai

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a Hakka Chinese restaurant. The food tastes good, the restaurant is clean, the service is good, there's parking available, and the prices are reasonable. My family's favorite dish is the snakehead fish stew with pickled mustard greens. It's served in a large bowl, the snakehead fish is in chunks, boneless, and not fishy. We order it every time we go! ^-^
sample_reviews_en.author: Zaa NoData

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've lost count of how many times I've eaten there. The food is so delicious! I love it so much.
I recommend the steamed sea bass with pickled cabbage and a little chili, the stir-fried eggplant in an earthenware pot, and the pork meatball soup. It's delicious with the chili paste. It's also great paired with the restaurant's tea.
sample_reviews_en.author: Labyula Berlina

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner was very welcoming. I liked the food from Meizhou, Guangdong. I personally felt the salt-baked chicken was too salty. I recommend the Rehmannia glutinosa and pork rib soup, the medicinal chicken soup (with ground urchin), and the seaweed and meatball soup. The stir-fried dishes were also good.
sample_reviews_en.author: summer ZHANG

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a really delicious Chinese restaurant. The owner is very friendly. I recommend the fish stew with pickled mustard greens; the portion is huge and the flavor is rich and spicy. The stir-fried green beans are also very tasty. I've been here many times with my aunt and will continue to come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayapat Chaisansuk

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an authentic Jiangxi Hakka restaurant. Their signature dishes are stuffed tofu, braised pork belly with preserved mustard greens, and grilled frog legs. The food here is incredibly fresh. Everything is made to order; moreover, the fish and frog legs are alive. The owner is very welcoming.
sample_reviews_en.author: N C

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves authentic, home-style Chinese food, just like the food you'd eat at home. However, it's a bit hidden in the location; you need to search for "another village" on the map. There's plenty of parking, and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bao Bao

sample_reviews_en.text: This is Hakka Chinese food. There were a lot of Chinese people, and we were the only Thais at our table. The food was delicious and flavorful. The stir-fried green beans were fragrant with fish sauce, and the dipping sauce for the fried …
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarintip Likasitwong

restaurants.name: Faan Rama 3
restaurants.address:

762 โครงการบางกอกสแควร์ 2 Rama III Rd, บางโพงพาง Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten at their Kanlapaphruek branch before and loved the food. The Rama III branch is now much more convenient to get to. Overall, the food is delicious, with well-balanced flavors that aren't too strong.

- The stir-fried noodles are Chinese-style, perfectly seasoned. You can add soy sauce to enhance the flavor.
- The fried rice has beautifully separated grains, is dry, and has a lovely wok aroma. It's topped with crispy fried fish.
- The stir-fried fish maw is good; I appreciate that the bean sprouts are trimmed, preserving their crunch. The flavor is mild, but you can add soy sauce or spicy seafood dipping sauce to enhance it.
- The fried chicken is crispy and not oily. It comes with XO sauce for dipping.

The restaurant focuses on single-serving dishes. Set menus are good value and include refillable drinks. You can take it home; try the Oolong tea and chrysanthemum tea. The stir-fried noodles for takeout are excellent, both the Hong Kong style and the XO sauce versions. The noodles are chewy and perfectly cooked, and can be reheated without becoming mushy. The restaurant also participates in the Thai Chuay Thai Plus program, making it even more economical.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kla Klanarong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried this restaurant because my wife saw the reviews and it wasn't far from home, so we decided to give it a try.

The food variety is good, focusing on stir-fried dishes and noodle soups.
There are many unique dishes that you can't find at other restaurants, such as fried noodles in gravy – something I haven't seen in a long time, and not many places make them.

There's a good selection of snacks and desserts.

Refillable drinks are available, like most buffet restaurants, and you can even refill and close the lid before leaving – that's great!

The service is good, and you order via QR code.

One minor observation: when ordering, place your order and submit it immediately, then reorder each time.

If you order and then edit the details, the system seems to remember your initial order and doesn't update it. When the food arrives, the staff insists it was your initial order, not the second one you edited. Be careful with this; if you need to make changes, it's better to delete the order and start over.

The atmosphere is relaxed, and there's convenient parking in the complex, which is free – a great feature!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ophas Kriangsiripong

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Chinese restaurant offers both à la carte dishes 🍛 and set meals 🍱. The food is delicious, and every dish is tasty. Set meals include refillable drinks 🥤. The shrimp, kale, and salted fish fried rice 🥘 has a wonderful wok aroma. The minced pork with plum sauce 🍲 has a delicious, well-balanced soup with a subtle ginger aroma. The fried chives are also delicious, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. The steamed dumplings have a tasty pork filling. The stir-fried noodles with gravy are flavorful 🤤.

The restaurant is located in the Bangkok Square project. They use a QR code system for selecting menu items and ordering. The food doesn't take long to arrive, the staff provides good service, and parking is convenient 👍.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pitak Y.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Chinese-style restaurant is located in the Bangkok Square Rama 3 (Chatuchak Rama 3) project. The interior is spacious, air-conditioned, with many tables. Parking is available on the street in front of the restaurant.

Orders are processed via QR code. The menu includes rice dishes, noodles, and various soups. We ordered stir-fried wonton noodles, soy sauce noodles, fried chicken wings, gravy noodles, garlic chicken rice, and pork bone soup. Personally, I found the stir-fried wonton noodles to be the best. The other dishes were average in taste, not very flavorful.

Some drinks are refillable; you can get them from a self-service machine. The cups provided are take-away cups, so you can take your drinks home.
sample_reviews_en.author: J Phinun

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fan Rama 3 is part of the same chain as Ruenros Restaurant (Chinese food).

I was impressed with the taste and price, especially during the government's co-payment scheme (July 2026).

The Cantonese-style pork noodles in gravy tasted like those from a high-end restaurant; the shrimp and salted fish fried rice also tasted like a high-end restaurant, fragrant, fluffy rice, lightly oiled, with a delicious wok aroma; the fried chives were fragrant, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside; and the minced pork and preserved plum soup with ginger had a broth similar to congee but slightly richer, balanced by the sourness of the preserved plums.
sample_reviews_en.author: Montree T.

sample_reviews_en.text: This Chinese restaurant offers affordable single-dish meals with a wide variety of options. It's air-conditioned, has plenty of seating, and isn't too crowded during lunchtime. Orders are placed via QR code. The dumplings are delicious, and the stir-fried noodles with pork are flavorful. The Chinese sausage is tasty, and the wide rice noodles have a nice, chewy texture and a fragrant wok flavor. The portions aren't very large, though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponchagarj Ngamukos

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant makes many dishes that suit my taste. Today I ordered the stir-fried noodles with seafood, and the flavor wasn't too sweet, which I liked. It had a nice wok-fried aroma when I ate the noodles. The gravy for the noodles wasn't too thick or sticky. The fried chives were well-prepared and not greasy. There's a clean restroom, plenty of parking in front of the restaurant, and the staff provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Qīng

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a comfortable seating area and delicious food. There's a wide variety of rice and noodle dishes to choose from. I highly recommend the crab curry rice – it's fragrant, flavorful, and delicious. The prices are reasonable, making it a complete and satisfying meal all in one place. It's perfect for families or groups of friends, and they even have mild-flavored dishes suitable for children.
sample_reviews_en.author: Napat. A

restaurants.name: กุ๊ยรสกรุง ตลาด 9 Yard
restaurants.address:

บางกระปิ 9 Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Every dish is delicious, fresh, and very clean. Grilled shrimp with the back split is 250฿ per kilo. Very good value. The restaurant has a nice atmosphere and the food is not expensive. You have to come and try it!
sample_reviews_th.author: Chanaporn Somparsong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I just tried this place because I was hungry... and there's a rice porridge shop near me...
I found this shop offers free rice porridge! What?! So I decided to give it a try...

The food was incredibly delicious! The staff were attentive and helpful, and they even provided fans for cooling.
I ordered via QR code, and the food arrived quickly.
The seafood was freshly prepared to order. We got 8 shrimp in 1 kg for only 250 baht!!!
The seafood dipping sauce was delicious, spicy, and perfectly seasoned.
You can refill the plain rice porridge as much as you want; it comes instantly.
Other Thai dishes were also excellent and perfectly suited to Thai tastes.
And most importantly, the prices are incredibly cheap and budget-friendly.

I really want this shop to become more famous. It's great value, and the opening hours (5 PM - 11 PM) are perfect for people socializing, those who've just finished work late, or those who are hungry late at night.

If I lived closer, I'd eat here more often. The only drawback is that it's inaccessible by public transportation (no buses or trains). You need a private car. 🥲🚗
sample_reviews_en.author: supatmethee wannachalee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Late-night congee that's more than just congee! 🍲
They also have amazing, fresh, clean, and delicious seafood because they own their own fishing boats. Seafood lovers absolutely have to come here!

🦐 Grilled prawns (split back) are only 250 baht per kilo – incredibly cheap!
🦀 Pickled crab with roe is 99 baht each, with plenty of roe!

The congee is equally amazing, with options like corn, taro, pumpkin, potato, and pandan leaf for only 99 satang per bowl! Or you can have plain congee for free!

✨ Must-try dishes:
• Crab curry – rich and fragrant with spices
• Squid in black ink sauce – huge squid!
• Spicy crispy shrimp salad – intensely flavorful
• Stir-fried pickled radish with egg – fragrant from the wok
• Chicken with cashew nuts – the sauce is perfect!

With so much deliciousness, you have to try it! Open until late. Don't miss out!
sample_reviews_en.author: Fooddiarytoday

sample_reviews_en.text:
The seafood is incredibly fresh and the prices are surprisingly good. Large prawns (about 10+ pieces) for only 250 baht is incredibly cheap considering the quantity and freshness. The oysters are also fresh and plump, large (5 plus 1 free), this dish was around 300+ baht (I don't remember the exact price). The dipping sauce is spicy and delicious, especially with lemon.
