Other dishes like marinated crab, grilled prawns, and fried fish are also excellent; the meat is sweet, firm, and not fishy. Everything is well-prepared and the prices are fantastic because they own their own fishing boats.

The atmosphere is relaxed, perfect for a meal with friends or family. The prices are friendly, you don't need to spend a fortune to enjoy a delicious meal. Highly recommend for seafood lovers, it's truly worth it. They're open until 5 AM too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Np Sp

sample_reviews_en.text:
🦞🦀🐙🦑 Kui Rot Krung Restaurant

A late-night rice porridge restaurant that uses its own fishing boats to source its ingredients. We offer fresh, live seafood at affordable prices.

🍚🍵 Importantly, plain rice porridge is free – eat as many bowls as you like!

🍵🍚 Pumpkin, pandan, taro, and corn rice porridge are only 99 satang per bowl.

🦑🐙🦪 Must-try dishes:

🦀 Stir-fried crab with curry powder and crab roe sauce. We use crab roe as an ingredient in our sauce for an extra rich and fragrant flavor. Delicious with hot rice!

🛶🛶🛶🛶🛶
🎀 Open daily from 5 PM to 5 AM.
🦀 Location: Rama 9 Soi 6, roadside, inside 9 Yard Market.
#KuiRotKrung #LateNightRicePorridgeRestaurant #SpicyPickledCrab #MincedPorkStewWithPlums #MincedPorkStewWithPlums #Delicious #MustTryRestaurant #TikTokFoodReview #HiddenGemBangkok
sample_reviews_en.author: Eatwith Youuu

sample_reviews_en.text:
The stir-fried Gnetum leaves with eggs looked a bit oily, but it tasted delicious.

The seafood hot pot with steamed egg custard was flavorful and packed with seafood.

The Tom Yum seafood soup had two large river prawns and was moderately spicy.

The minced pork with preserved olives was a little too sweet; I personally found this dish just okay.

The prices were moderate. Some dishes came out quickly, while others took a little longer. I ate there on a Tuesday night and there were no other customers. From what I observed, most of the other restaurants in the market were frequented by Chinese tourists; I didn't see many Thai people.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donlawat Chitsing

sample_reviews_en.text: Grilled prawns are incredibly cheap, only 250 baht per kilo, and super fresh. They're grilled right in front of you! Crab with roe is 99 baht each – you'll hardly find that price anywhere else. This place does it exceptionally well. The food is delicious, and they have a huge selection of rice porridge. The rice porridge is free, but if you want the colored kind, it's only 99 satang. It's perfect for a late-night snack or anything like that because they're open from 5 PM to 5 AM.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nipat Kanadnid

sample_reviews_en.text: For those who love rice porridge with a full set of side dishes, I highly recommend this restaurant. They have fresh seafood, and the grilled prawns are incredibly cheap! They even have their own fishing boats to source their ingredients. Most importantly, unlimited free rice porridge! They have colorful options like corn, taro, sweet potato, and pumpkin for only 99 satang each. The price is amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nichakan Wichai

restaurants.name: No Name Thai Street Food
restaurants.address:

1656 Soi Phanu Rangsi, Khwaeng Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really delicious, honest, and authentic Thai food. The whole place feels very genuine, and the staff are incredibly kind and welcoming.

Prices are very fair, especially for the quality and portions you get. With a couple of drinks, you’re still around 200 baht, which is great value.

We tried dishes like Pad Thai, Pad Kaphrao, and Pad See Ew, and everything was tasty and freshly made. The food was so good that we actually ordered more after finishing our first round. If you’re hungry, two dishes per person is a good idea.

Overall, a wonderful experience and exactly how you imagine good, simple Thai food should be. Definitely a place we’d come back to. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Sercan Çelik

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant was hot, but the food was so delicious I want to go back!!!! Four people ordered four dishes, but it wasn't enough, so we ordered two more. I think two dishes per person would be enough. It's really delicious! The pad thai is a little salty, and the fried rice is a little bland, so if you eat them together, you can keep eating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Young

sample_reviews_en.text: After a couple of times in Bangkok, I finally found the best tom yum soup! Show this picture and ask them. It is OUT of this planet. So creamy and the flavor is unreal. Wish I knew this place before. Ps. What a lovely family, thank you Jena for your hospitality 🥰!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Laura Vanti

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don't know what they put in the food here, but it's simply unbelievably delicious! 10/10
The owner/worker was incredibly sweet!
A very simple but authentic place. If you want to come for real Thai food, this is the place for you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Тимур Валеев

sample_reviews_en.text: I had amazing Pad Thai Chicken. Super friendly people here 🙏🏼. Very fair prices. The Pad Thai cost 60 and a soda 20. The portions are on the smaller side, but definitely fair for the price. …
sample_reviews_en.author: L B

sample_reviews_en.text: It was wonderful, exactly what you imagine good and honest Thai food to be like. We had Pad Thai, Pad Kaphrao, and Pad See Ew. With two drinks, you're looking at 200 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: LEX

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered Pad Krapao with egg twice. So far, it's the best thing I've eaten, only 70 baht each time, including egg and soup.

Wow, a must for every visitor to Talat Noi!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ni Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is so delicious and the prices are so affordable!

The portions aren't as small as you might think.

You should definitely visit if you're in Songwat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jonghoon MOON

restaurants.name: Phra Nakhon Boat Noodle
restaurants.address:

Thailand, Bangkok, Ratchathewi, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon, Phaya Thai Rd, 邮政编码: 10400
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Very fairly priced and tasty dishes."

sample_reviews_en.text:
BEWARE!
It's a SCAM!
You have heard "too good to be true"?
Well there IS microscopic bowls of noodles for 16 Bath, but you will have things that you didn't order put on your table and you will be charged for them.
I ordered 4 bowls and it was ridiculously small amount of food and then I was charged for things I didn't order and I was going to leave without paying, but I am in another country, so I was stuck.

Go downstairs to the food court and eat a big bowl of good pork noodles for 45 Bath, chicken noodles for 55 Bath and it's like 8-10 bowls if you compare it to what you get in thia place.
If you are not feeling "adventurous" stick to Chesters or KFC, but really the food court is great, or read my review of a brilliant place 100m away that will make your taste buds sing.

DON'T eat at this place, it's really not worth 16 Bath even and if you are curious like me, you will be ripped off.

I don't write bad reviews normally, but this is a nasty place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrik Caesar

sample_reviews_en.text: Your branch at Market village hua hin staff needs to improve their customer service and etiquette. Very poor customer service, not helping customers to get better meal by offering size. We order small and was surprised when our order arrived. The server should tell us that the small size is too small so we can order bigger. The most disappointing part is one of your staff cutting her fingernails in front of us while we are eating. So disgusting. You need to train them about customer service and etiquette.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nora Esperanzate

sample_reviews_en.text:
This branch's food is delicious. The noodles aren't too chewy, and the broth is rich (taste before adding any seasoning!).
A large bowl is 80 baht.

I like the crispy pork cracklings, but they're a bit pricey at 30 baht for a tiny portion.

They also have a small plate of pork-topped bread (4 pieces for 59 baht), which is surprisingly delicious. I really liked it. The pickled vegetable dipping sauce was also tasty.

The food arrived quickly. There were plenty of staff, and the service was fast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anongsri Boon

sample_reviews_en.text: To find this restaurant, exit the BTS station, go to the second floor of the department store, and walk to the very back. There are many branches of the boat noodle shop, but even though the small bowl has increased to 20 yuan, it's still worth trying. I ate two small plates of something that looked like cheese and was charged an extra 20 yuan. As for the taste, the beef (bottom right) was the one I liked best; the rest were quite ordinary. It was more of an experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: richter lin

sample_reviews_en.text: I initially thought it was a street-side shop, but it turned out to be inside a department store. It was lunchtime for office workers, and there were many people working on the ground floor. The bowls were small, but you could order a variety of flavors, which was great. For noodles, each table had two small bowls of pandan cake (a type of flat cake), stacked on top of each other, for 20 baht. You could just grab them if you wanted.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeanne Chang

sample_reviews_en.text: Seeing so many people visiting, I couldn't resist following the trend! But after actually trying it, I found that, perhaps because the bowl was so small, the taste was really just so-so! Even the "Tom Yum" flavor wasn't quite there! The pork skin wasn't fried enough to be fragrant, but the drink and coconut milk cake were okay!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tina Yeh

sample_reviews_en.text: We ate here yesterday and although the food and price is ok, we were put off by the cockroaches which we saw walking onto our table. But the worst thing was that my wife contracted food poisoning after eating here. I guess those roaches were warning us not to eat here. Avoid this dirty place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zero T

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is not full-flavor . I recorded you to go to original restaurant. It’s not far from here.
If you don’t like spicy food , you may inform them that no chilly  because normally this noodle they always add chilly on the dish.

On the picture is small size 16 baht
Big size is 60 baht
sample_reviews_en.author: Great Grace

restaurants.name: Ruchi Restaurant
restaurants.address:

1/63 m 10th, Central, Pattaya Cross the hotel of Baisaya Beach, 1/63 M 10 Central Road OPP; Basaya Beach Hotel, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent. The staff were helpful and spoke clear Thai. They recommended dishes that Thai people could enjoy, and even suggested alternative options if the taste wasn't to everyone's liking. Overall, it was a great experience. The food was reasonably priced, the wait time was short, the service was good, and it's located in a tourist area, making it easy to find. The restaurant was clean. I will definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: LOZAN SB

sample_reviews_en.text: The service from the female staff was extremely poor. At first, I wanted to cancel the food, but my partner didn’t want me too. Today (7/9), I came to eat at the restaurant and saw a cockroach. The staff spoke in her local language and didn’t come over to take care of the situation or remove the cockroach, which is not okay. Since I also work in the service industry, I believe “service mind” is something that should always be present.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panadda Boonrod

sample_reviews_en.text: A hidden gem. I was staying in Amari Pattaya and were on a lookout for good Indian food and our search ended with this restaurant. Came across this restaurant by chance while travelling on the Tuk Tuk. Had Indian food in many restaurants in Thailand including Bangkok and Phuket but found this the best. Ordered Take away to the hotel after that for the rest of our stay for both lunch and dinner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dinesh Pushpan

sample_reviews_en.text:
It a Best Restaurant for Halal Food.
They Serve Indian, Bangladeshi & Thai Sea Food.
Veg & Non-Veg food & Indian Thali Item Available here.
*Food Decoration: Good
*Test: Good
*Service: Best.
*Price: Not So High
*Location: Great (Canter Pattaya beach)
Restaurant Owner r so Friendly.
You Easy speaking here Hindhi, Bangla, English & Thai as you want.
ITs a Family & Friendly Restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: SAJIB SARKAR

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent restaurant with excellent service. The waitresses are all friendly and easy to talk to. I had the Bhindi masala, two chapati rotis, fish tikka, and dal (yellow lentils). Everything was delicious. I've dined here a couple of times already. The food is always good. I know, with its star rating, it's underrated. I'm very happy. Thank you for the great food and service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ondino Matteio

sample_reviews_en.text: Don't go this place. Restoran 2 lady staff attitude is so rude and chief is Napali. Owner from Bangladesh but all staff from nepali. Food was tremendous poor expensive as well compare to Others Restaurant. I stayed 4 days in Pattaya never ever i  went that Ruchi Restaurant. We are 5 friends went pattaya from Malaysia. Pls Don't go save your money and time. Thanks ( RAKIB)
sample_reviews_en.author: Rakib Hasan Md

sample_reviews_en.text: I have visited Ruchi restaurant many times. First day I tried Indian Tea with Chicken tikka masala and Naan believe me it was amazing. Thanks to Mr. Baythar for cooking a delicious meal for me. The next day tried Thai food and it was also very good. My taste in Thai food is not that good but I appreciate the taste and love it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Syed Saad

sample_reviews_en.text: Located on Pattaya Klang Road, right next to the beach, I had the pleasure of dining there for several days, and each time, their hospitality and the quality of their food impressed me deeply, I have visited October 2025 highly recommended, it's suitable for tamilnadu people try butter nan channa masal .
sample_reviews_en.author: mohamed arshath

restaurants.name: T. TONG Mu Kratha
restaurants.address:

3185 Rama IV Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
T. TONG Mu Kratha is a delicious Thai restaurant in Bangkok, located near Big C on Rama IV Road in the Phrom Phong area.

Mu Kratha, a popular Thai street food, is a BBQ dish combining grilled meat and hot pot, similar in style to Genghis Khan-style BBQ.

While many restaurants offer a buffet style, T. TONG Mu Kratha is not a buffet, but rather a clean restaurant with a street stall. The menu offers different sizes of Mu Kratha; the S size is suitable for solo diners.

You can also enjoy delicious hot pot soup and special sauces. They also have a good selection of Thai beers, making it a great place to enjoy a casual Thai BBQ hot pot with friends.

Prices are: S size: 329B, M size: 429B, L size: 529B
sample_reviews_en.author: 近藤かおり

sample_reviews_en.text:
A local Mookata restaurant. I stopped by late at night because I heard they are open until 2:30 AM.

Even though it was 1 AM, about two-thirds of the tables were occupied,

and the air-conditioned interior was pleasant.

Although it uses a gas grill rather than charcoal, there is a feature to adjust the heat,

and the ingredients are served neatly.

You can add chili peppers and garlic to the sauce,

but for a Korean palate, it was definitely loaded with garlic.

I ate my fill, mainly with Mookata meat and whiskey (Regency), and paid less than 1,000 baht.

You can add extra meat to the basic Mookata combo (I added pork and beef).

It is a place you can go if you suddenly crave Mookata late at night.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Kam (Hu-doi)

sample_reviews_en.text: I often visit Bangkok, but I'd never tried moo kata. Hot pot in a hot country? I don't eat hot pot much in the middle of summer in Japan. By the sixth night, I'd exhausted all the Thai food and finally decided it was time to try it. Not knowing how to prepare it, I glanced around, but the woman at the restaurant helped me out. I'm so grateful... The food was better than I expected, with a variety of sauces, and thoughtful touches like providing soy sauce when she realized we were Japanese. It was just over 500 baht for two people. We also had three beers, so it was reasonably priced. You can add extra toppings, so even big eaters will be satisfied.
sample_reviews_en.author: Masaru Kawasaki

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a Mookata restaurant that stays open late. When I visited, I was the only foreigner there; it seemed to be mostly frequented by families or groups of friends. The location is a bit out of the way, but since I went alone, I took a Grab bike to get there.

First off, the food was served neatly, and although the staff didn't speak English, they explained in detail how to eat it, so I was able to enjoy the meal.

I had the 390 baht set, and the meat, vegetables, and seafood were all quite fresh. The Som Tum I ordered along with it was also spicy and delicious. I recommend this place to anyone who wants to experience Mookata!
sample_reviews_en.author: Junwoo Kwon

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop has at least 2 floors. The ground floor is a bit nicer than the second floor. But both floors seem to need refreshing.

Food was average. We had mookratha and som tum. Ingredients for mookartha looked fresh, but the fire was coming weakly out of the gas canister. As the result the grill pan was barely heating. Took us a while to get the meat grilling. It kind of ruined the experience.

Also, surprisingly almost no service on the second floor.

Price wise it was cheaper than other places I have been to. We paid 840 thb for 3 people for mookartha and a som tum salad, a couple bottles of water.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rustam Usmanov

sample_reviews_en.text:
Moo Kata, a popular street food in Thailand, is a dish that combines grilled meat and hot pot, similar in style to Genghis Khan-style BBQ.

This was my first time trying Moo Kata, and I'm so glad I did – it was delicious!

This restaurant is not a buffet, but rather features a clean interior and a street food style.

The hot pot soup was flavorful, and the special sauces and dipping sauces were also delicious; I enjoyed it to the very last bite.

They also have a wide variety of Thai beers, making it a great place to enjoy delicious Thai BBQ hot pot with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: tokyo dogs

sample_reviews_en.text:
Open late, if you're craving a cold beer and a Mukata, come here.
The outdoor tables and indoors are equipped with three air conditioners and fans, making it cooler than outside.
There are two types of sauces, so you can dip your meat and seafood in them. They give you plenty of minced garlic and chopped peppers, so you don't have to order anything extra!
The prices are reasonable, and there's no parking.
We arrived around 12 a.m. and it was full of locals. The staff was friendly, and our orders came out very quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: L

sample_reviews_en.text:
I happened to pass by this restaurant and saw a lot of customers there, so I was curious. 

It's a local moo kata restaurant. 

Moo kata is a dish where you can enjoy both grilled meat and hot pot in a special pot. 

While the menu is written in English, the side dishes are only in Thai. 💦 However, there are photos, so you should be able to order. 

It was cheap, delicious, and had a great local atmosphere, so I highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: りとるみい（Little My BKK）

restaurants.name: Provence
restaurants.address:

PGWR+38R, Lobby Gaysorn Village, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Nice ambience, outdoor, garden dining feel but is indoor.

Thai restaurant despite its name. They are famous for their boat noodle. However while their boat noodle is decent, good broth, its not the best especially with this price and just the most standard set up, the condiment side veggies is just bare minimum and too little.

Price.... very pricey here, tou are paying for eating at Gaysorn mall. Good is 2-300฿++ which is understandable but all drinks; coffee, juice, softdrinks are almost 200฿ as well. Definitely paying to be there Price.
sample_reviews_th.author: Kwan Jamigranont

sample_reviews_th.text: Food is super cold, right from the kitchen. I ordered ข้าวขาหมู at 11.00 am on 18th Jan 2024.  I hope the owner would check on quality of service as the food is pricey, yet cold.. unacceptable 😕
sample_reviews_th.author: Pakamon T.

sample_reviews_en.text: They are very very unprofessional,  me and my wife both order one one single dish each and they serve my wife first then after 20 minutes when my wife almost finish her food I ask the waiter that where is my food then she check and came to me that chef is preparing,  after another 15 minutes I ask again then they said chef had forget to cook your food and the waiter came to ask me that sorry but can not do anything forget is forget do you still need food or not very rude then finally I cancel.paid bill and left. This restaurant food is just a street food but charge 3 times more than other places with a bad service, just because they are in a luxury shopping mall they feel that they can do anything. There are many more better choices around do not go there.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The boat noodles have maintained their consistent taste and quality for ten years, making it a fun experience to enjoy Thai noodles in a Western-style restaurant. The fish ball noodles were very sweet and refreshing.

The only downside was that the waitresses didn't smile much, but they were very attentive to our requests and responded quickly. However, one waitress was overly attentive, asking if we wanted drinks or other appetizers, which might have made us feel uncomfortable or pressured.

We ordered mango sticky rice, but because the mangoes weren't of good quality, the waitress proactively informed us and suggested we order another dessert.

Overall, the food, ambiance, and atmosphere were all excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: irene kwan

sample_reviews_en.text: We had a business meeting for lunch. Everyone ordered food, including some sharing dishes... The meal took no more than 30-40 minutes. After we finished eating, we continued our work discussion while having drinks. A female staff member stood over us, constantly interrupting our conversation, asking if we wanted dessert twice. When we said no, she started clearing our plates and wiping the table, interrupting our conversation even though the table wasn't dirty. She stood there with an unfriendly expression. In the end, my colleague and I asked for the bill... There were fewer than 3 other tables occupied in the restaurant. The whole meal took about 1 hour and 15 minutes, and the bill was over a thousand baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emmy Yongrasameewong

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place has a long history, as it was Bangkok's first luxury boat noodle shop, over 40 years old. Since then, they've been located in the Peninsula Hotel, a long-established business in the Peninsula Plaza. They moved to Gayson many years ago. I've been eating their beef ball boat noodles for a long time; it's more expensive than other places. Their signature dish is pork/Wagyu beef boat noodles, with a delicate flavor. They also offer Thai dishes and desserts.

✨A very relaxing and clean environment to enjoy a delicious bowl of boat noodle soup! The beef noodles we had were excellent, with plenty of beef. The Northern-style curry noodles were also very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: YK C

sample_reviews_en.text: A wonderful place in a shopping center on the ground floor. It's set up like an outdoor park. Umbrellas, tables. I was noticed as soon as I took the escalator down to the ground floor. I looked at the menu on the counter and decided to have something to eat. It was hot outside, and there was a holiday going on; everyone was splashing water. It was fun. I also asked for an outlet to charge my phone. The service was friendly and quick. The food was delicious. I had rice with chicken and bananas for dessert. I loved everything. I recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dmitri Semenjuk

sample_reviews_en.text: I went on a day the restaurant recommended the fried oysters, so I ordered them. However, the oysters weren't fresh at all; they had a very strong smell. The edges of the oysters were hard, like they were frozen. I was disappointed with the quality, especially considering the price. The atmosphere was nice and the staff seemed happy to serve, but the food only looked good on the plate. I hope the restaurant will improve the quality of its food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nat pua

restaurants.name: KubKao' KubPla Market Place Dusit
restaurants.address:

ชั้นที่ 1 โครงการ มาร์เก็ตเพลส Ratchawithi Rd, Wachira Phayaban, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered Set B through Line Man, which was supposed to be sour curry with acacia leaves, but what I received was sour curry with cowslip flowers. If an ingredient is unavailable, you should call and inform the customer, or at least ask if they need to change the menu item whenever they want. Please take this into consideration. ///I usually dine at the restaurant, but at a different branch, and the service is excellent. They always inquire about food allergies and inform me if an ingredient is out of stock. I'm disappointed that the quality varies between branches.
sample_reviews_en.author: SP P.

sample_reviews_en.text: The Kub Kao Kub Pla restaurant, situated in Market Place Dusit, boasts an appealing interior design characterized by a high ceiling. The staff members are friendly, adding to the positive atmosphere, and the authentic Thai cuisine they offer is delightful. One standout dish is the red curry, showcasing the restaurant's commitment to delivering an enjoyable and genuine Thai dining experience. The ambiance, combined with the welcoming staff and delicious offerings, makes it a noteworthy choice for those seeking an authentic taste of Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wesley Wong

sample_reviews_en.text:
As good as it always does. All the foods are super tasty and clean. The restaurant has been decorated nicely. There is not so much crowded in the evening tho unlike during the afternoon.

Morning glory is the best around. The shrimp donut is quite good as well (I ordered one without the almond tho)

However this branch served quite a hard, sticky squid. Idk whether it is not so fresh or not. Still it is acceptable.

Parking here costs quite a lot but you could stamp for 4 hrs free parking after you finished your meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: SwiftFox

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a nice, simple avenue-like atmosphere. The menu is diverse, offering Thai food. The sour curry with cowslip flowers is rich and flavorful, with large, fresh prawns; the broth is distinctly Thai, though not quite home-style. The braised pork leg with soft-boiled eggs is sweet, savory, and fragrant with just the right amount of spices. The crispy pork stir-fried with chili paste and salted egg is delightfully crunchy. The price, around a thousand baht, we think is reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: hispeed design

sample_reviews_en.text:
👉🏼This restaurant is located in the Marketplace Dusit project.
👉🏼The atmosphere in the restaurant is very good.
👉🏼All the food is delicious, complete with all the flavors, including pomelo salad, papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce, spicy seafood spaghetti, sour curry, fried sea bass with fish sauce, fried taro, and the ice cream is also delicious with a wide variety of flavors to choose from.
👉🏼The service is good, fast, and the staff are very attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jitima K

sample_reviews_en.text:
There is parking available in the Market Place Dusit complex.
Free parking for 4 hours with purchases of 500 baht or more.
The restaurant is beautiful, well-decorated, and the air conditioning is cool. The staff are polite.
The food is delicious. I liked the stir-fried pork with shrimp paste; it was very flavorful.
However, the stir-fried squid with salted egg was a bit chewy, although the sauce was rich.
There were many foreigners dining in the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cactus156

sample_reviews_en.text: The 1,200 crab omelette was all egg and added four pieces of 1 inch crab meat on top. I had to call on waiters so many times to add an order, drinks and ask for bill. I even took my drinks from the counter because no one bothered to give it to me and my family. I came on a Friday at 11AM. The service for its’ price is not worth it. Although the other food is always good like green curry, tomyum and pork knuckes. Other branches are so much better.
sample_reviews_en.author: TextandTalk ___

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is situated outside of the shopping mall which offers a somewhat exclusive experience with large window allowing plenty of sunlight. The decor has a luxurious vintage style creating a pleasant atmosphere. The food is absolutely delicious, and they have a large menu to choose from. I was particularly impressed with their quick service and limited waiting time for orders. I'll definitely make another turn in the near future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daz Prins

restaurants.name: กินเผ็ดก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือ สาขา (รามอินทรา)
restaurants.address:

Lat Phrao 87 Alley, Lane 29, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste of the food is neutral (a bit sweet). They give a small amount, 25 baht per bowl. Personally, I think it's expensive. And... my younger brother ate it and woke up the next morning with a swollen face (swollen like an allergic reaction). The family couldn't sleep at all. They probably put something strange in it. I recommend being careful. Other people might be fine with it, but it could be dangerous to eat it. This wasn't the first time we ate waterfall soup. It was our last meal of the day. When we woke up the next day, my younger brother's face was so swollen that he had to take antihistamines. We've eaten boat noodles at every restaurant, but this one was different. (This review is based on my experience.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Sam Pim

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes good, but it's a self-service ordering system. We ordered a while ago, but the staff were still playing on their phones until my friend pointed it out, then they finally started preparing our food. The wait was quite long, even though we were the only table there, and there were several staff members. It seemed like it was almost closing time and they didn't want to serve us. I initially considered ordering more, but after that, I lost interest. I came based on reviews and was quite disappointed with the experience. Please improve this.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุธิดา องพระเทศ

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was delicious! I loved it 😋 The spiciness was just right, flavorful and perfect for my taste. Both the pork and beef were tasty, the meat was tender, and the noodles were perfectly cooked, not mushy. Everything together was perfectly balanced.

We went during lunchtime, it was a little hot, but overall I was very impressed. Another thing I liked was being able to order food via QR code, which was very convenient and saved me from waiting for staff to take my order. Anyone who likes spicy food will probably love this restaurant 🌶️
sample_reviews_en.author: Mickey Amollapa

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was good, this was my first time eating here. The portion size was a bit small considering it's called "special"... I have a complaint about the staff; almost every table didn't have spoons and chopsticks. There were probably 7-8 tables in the restaurant, but only 1-2 had them. When the food arrived, we had to go look for spoons and chopsticks. Also, we saw a staff member using their mouth to bite open the bag of meatballs. I'm not sure if the restaurant has knives or scissors.
sample_reviews_en.author: patcharin chitrisri

sample_reviews_en.text:
The noodles themselves were delicious...
So good, no need to add any seasoning.
But the meatballs, boiled beef, and stewed beef were just average.
Parking is limited, and the prices are a bit high...
For 4 small children and 3 adults, the bill came to a little over 1,000 baht. I was quite surprised. After asking around, they said the price varies depending on the type of noodles. Okay, fine....
sample_reviews_en.author: Wild Gentleman (GeOvOiDl)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious.
The mobile ordering system seems to cause frequent problems. It would be better to discontinue the paper-based ordering system; it would be easier to understand, reduce arguments with customers, and it might not be convenient for elderly people dining alone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pavaris Taweesap

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered pork rinds. They were in a jar, and the staff picked them out with their hands, put them in a bowl, and then even ate some from the jar themselves.

The portion was small, but the taste was okay, although there was way too much fried garlic.
sample_reviews_en.author: 07 รวิทษรา Amp

sample_reviews_en.text: The crispy pork rinds are very expensive and not worth the price. First, a small bag for 27 baht via Grab, compared to 25 baht at the shop. It's extremely expensive and a blatant exploitation of consumers.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณิชานันทน์ วิริประพรชัย

restaurants.name: Man Fu Yuan Samyan Mitrtown
restaurants.address:

Samyan Mitrtown Parking Lot, G Floor, 902 Phaya Thai Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at Man Fu Yuan Samyan Mitrtown, commonly known as หม่านฟู่หยวน, a dim sum haven that left me enthralled. With its serene ambiance, impeccable service, and a delectable range of dim sum offerings, this restaurant quickly earned a special place in my heart.

Speaking of the menu, it boasted an extensive selection of traditional and innovative dim sum dishes. From the moment I sampled their signature har gow (steamed shrimp dumplings), I knew I was in for a culinary treat. Each piece was meticulously crafted, offering a burst of flavors that were simply delightful. The dumplings were steamed to perfection, with the translucent skin revealing succulent shrimp inside.
sample_reviews_th.author: Wisanu Tuntawiroon

sample_reviews_th.text:
Let's try the buffet, 598฿ net (excluding drinks).
Steamed/fried dishes are freshly made, so you might have to wait a little.
The food tends to be bland + sweet with sauce.
The menu isn't extensive, but it's worth it.
The portion sizes aren't very large, suitable for one person.
The ingredients are okay, the shrimp is nice and bouncy.
sample_reviews_th.author: NIPON AROONRUANGSIRILERT

sample_reviews_en.text:
This dim sum restaurant has many unique and delicious dishes. There are several items I've never tried anywhere else, and they were all tasty.

I was most impressed with the Japanese sweet potato custard lava dumpling. It was unique and delicious, with a distinct sweet potato flavor and a rich, sweet custard.

The golden-wrapped shrimp was perfectly crispy, and the shrimp was succulent.

The crispy rice noodle rolls with duck filling were also unique and tasty.

The Sichuan-style shrimp and mushroom dumplings were unique and delicious.

The shrimp and spinach har gow was just average; you can find similar dishes elsewhere.

I'll definitely be back. They have many other dishes I haven't tried yet, but they all look delicious.

The restaurant is located on the 1st floor of Samyan Mitrtown.
sample_reviews_en.author: SSS BKK

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a great Hong Kong-style Chinese restaurant with delicious main courses, dim sum, desserts, and drinks.

The restaurant is beautifully decorated in a simple, clean, and comfortable style.

The prices are a little high, with a 10% service charge and 7% VAT. However, considering the quality and taste, it's still worth it.

I'd deduct one star for the service. Some of the staff may not have received complete training for a restaurant of this caliber, resulting in slow and clumsy service. However, I appreciated their effort and dedication, so I can't deduct a star for that. But I recommend immediate improvement. (On my last two visits, the service was much better, which I commend.)
sample_reviews_en.author: WW Holmes

sample_reviews_en.text: Recently ate here yesterday for Dinner (keep in mind i came during rush hour on Queen's Suthida Birthday), its somewhat near HK Style since there's only 3 round tables (one in a small room) while the rest are styled in normal restaraunt seatings. Honestly, 1196 baht is 299 HKD which is a steal and a bargain. Food was contently tenderous and yummy. For 2 hrs 30 mins, and a free refill of Chrysamthemum Tea (if you order it for 60 baht per person). Atleast the staff aren't standing like mannequins and they actually come to you and refill for free, but you can ask not to. Eat everything you order, they charge you original pricing if more then 25% of the food is not eaten. 10/10 still 🤤
sample_reviews_en.author: Davion So

sample_reviews_en.text: It's hard to imagine that a branch of a well-known chain restaurant could offer such drastically different food quality. If you've been to Man Fu Yuan in One Bangkok, you'll be absolutely disappointed. The difference is unbelievable. None of the dim sum dishes were good... especially the almond soup, which was practically watery; the wontons in chili oil, with a filling as hard as rubber; and the shrimp dumplings and siu mai, which I've never had before. I seriously doubt how these high-rated reviews came about. I suggest you don't come here. If you absolutely must have Hong Kong-style dim sum, definitely don't come here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Brian

sample_reviews_en.text:
Quality dim sum at pretty reasonable prices is a big reason we keep coming back to Man Fu Yuan (MFY) since it opened two or three years ago in Mitrtown.

Service is consistently good, there are a lot tables, and we can always get a car park in the mall - so big ticks for folks living in Bkk with elderly relatives.

I especially like the duck cheong fun and teochew dumplings. Food from their ala carte menu is also reliably good. Oh, there is also a banquet room for private events.

Though you don’t need to book, MFY gets busy at lunch times so it pays to arrive a bit earlier.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Meng Yee

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is far from what a HK or Chinese restaurant taste.

The shrimp shumai was overcooked and chewy.

The taste of duck 腸粉 was not on the point and the meat was like "are you guys bankrupt and no money to buy meat?"

The taste of radish cake "蘿蔔糕” was off point too. FYI the sauce was incorrect, too sweet.

Tea we order refilled and the waitor was so passive and not fill the pot until I'm going to pay the bill and then he reluctantly refill.

If this restaurant is in HK or China or Singapore, im pretty sure the restaurant will close soon.

2 stars because in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wade Ming Cheng Lee

restaurants.name: Green Season
restaurants.address:

Phatthanakan 53, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is a two-unit commercial building in Soi Pattanakarn 52, located at the corner of the first alley on the right (formerly a bicycle shop). There are quite a few seats. They have both Thai and Vietnamese noodle dishes. Their selling point is probably the chicken feet, but I don't like to eat them, so I ordered them without the chicken feet. The taste is acceptable and the price is not expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Coke Somchai

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles in the dish tasted good, but there was very little meat compared to the price. The restaurant was clean, air-conditioned, and the service was good. However, I wish the restaurant would consider reducing the amount of meat. I wanted to go back again, but when I ordered it without vegetables, the amount of chicken was so small that it felt like it wasn't worth 60 baht. 😢
sample_reviews_en.author: AWK Journey

sample_reviews_en.text:
The spaghetti with grilled pork was amazing from the first bite. I've never had anything like it before; it was a truly delightful experience.

The noodles were tossed in the sauce perfectly, adding a nice kick to the flavor.

Both dishes were excellent. I highly recommend trying them. Seriously!
sample_reviews_en.author: zuccanp

sample_reviews_en.text:
I think there were about three four-person tables inside.
The atmosphere and interior decor weren't great, but
the salad wraps and salad bowls were generous and the prices were quite appealing. They were also fresh, which was nice.

The yogurt and other sauces didn't seem homemade.
sample_reviews_en.author: Grace Noh (Grace)

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant looks clean and the food looks appetizing and tastes good. There's a good selection of dishes, including healthy options. They also have a special set menu available until 2:30 PM, which includes food, a drink, and a salad.
sample_reviews_en.author: PotDoi Story

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very nice Vietnamese rice noodle soup (Khao Piak) at a good price (60-75 THB).

I would recommend ordering their side dishes as well, be it Isaan sausage or boiled white Vietnamese pork sausage (Cha Lua). I would visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panpakorn Siripanich

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great taste, clean, and so good I came back for more. Good quality food at a reasonable price.
My favorite dishes:
Beef tenderloin
Chicken breast steak
Northern Thai sausage roll
Spaghetti pesto
Garlic bread
Ceasar salad
sample_reviews_en.author: Dear J.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wow, someone recommended ordering through Lineman.
I didn't expect much at first. But it turned out to be surprisingly delicious!
The curry and miang (Thai wrap) were all incredibly tasty. I'll definitely order again.
sample_reviews_en.author: pu tara

restaurants.name: Tieng Kway Chap
restaurants.address:

579/2 ซอย ลาดพร้าว 101 Lat Phrao Rd, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: This delicious Vietnamese noodle soup (Goi Chup) shop is located in Soi Ladprao 101, แยก 15 (intersection 15). Besides Goi Chup, they also offer spring rolls, steamed dumplings, shrimp dumplings (Hakka), and pork bone congee. If you're in the area, please consider Auntie Tiang's Vietnamese Noodle Soup shop for a delicious meal.
sample_reviews_th.author: surapong ch

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was delicious! The noodles were chewy and soft, and they gave a generous amount of broth (which I liked). The soup had a mild, mild flavor. The price was reasonable. The steamed dumplings were okay, but not amazing. The pork sausage was incredibly delicious! Great on its own, and even better with the noodle soup.
Overall, it was good. I'll definitely come back again.🤓😉
Oh, they also offer takeout, which is very convenient. They even provide instructions on how to prepare and eat it!😃
sample_reviews_en.author: K M

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! Generous portions and the broth is rich and flavorful. I'm sure more than half the people living in Lopburi have eaten here. The price is reasonable considering the quantity. The shop is located on the street in the middle of the soi (alley). You can sit inside. If you haven't been here before, you might think it's only takeout because they have so much food that it covers the front of the shop! 555555555
sample_reviews_en.author: Somjuak PH

sample_reviews_en.text:
Another delicious restaurant in Soi Ladprao 101, located right next to the most famous noodle shop in the soi, so people don't often notice it.
The Vietnamese noodle soup (Kuy Jup Yuan) is incredibly flavorful and satisfying. The broth is hot, the noodles are good, and the Vietnamese sausage is excellent. It sets a high standard.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jack Worapan

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodle soup is delicious, the broth is tasty, but those who prefer milder flavors might find it salty. There's no pork blood and no minced pork visible. Ordered for takeout. Price is 45 baht, special 55 baht. (22/6/67) They stay open late. Parking is available in front of the shop and along the side alley.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปูเป้ สุพรรษา

sample_reviews_en.text: The broth is delicious and flavorful, the noodles are perfectly cooked, and the onsen egg is soft and just right. This is a Vietnamese noodle soup shop that still maintains affordable prices and provides generous portions, especially in these economic times.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poranee Phureesitr

sample_reviews_en.text:
Posting an old photo. This picture was taken when I ate there on March 8th, 2018. I don't know if the price has changed since then.
Taste: Delicious 9/10
Price: Reasonable
A little small for someone who usually eats a lot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Goodgirl SFC

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodle soup is delicious. You can add extra toppings, eggs, or make it special however you like. The price is reasonable; not cheap, but not too expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krit Rocky

restaurants.name: Chai Potchana
restaurants.address:

2059 New, Bang Kapi, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Chai Phochana restaurant is located opposite Wat Mai Chong Lom, right at the foot of the pedestrian overpass. It's open from 8 am to 4 pm at the latest. On Saturdays and Sundays, they only sell roasted pork rice. I tried the roasted pork and crispy pork rice, and it was delicious! The crispy pork was excellent, the Chinese sausage was good, and the sauce wasn't too sweet. If you find it too sweet, you can eat the dried chilies to balance it out. The dried chilies don't look like much because they're small, but they're crunchy, tasty, salty, and not too spicy.😃 There's a steady stream of customers, mostly regulars. Free water is available. You can park at the Esso gas station just past the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: yimp yimpdow

sample_reviews_en.text:
Got charged 320 baht for 2 plates of meats + 1 rice + 1 egg. Not sure if we got scammed honestly as the price at the front is 60baht for “large plate”

We wanted 1 rice with meats plus 1 plate of just meat but due to language barrier they charge us more.

Taste is so so there are better roast pork out there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anton

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating here for 35 years. I work in this area and always stop by. The owner is lovely. I support this shop in a shophouse. The roasted pork and crispy pork are delicious, and the sauce for the crispy pork is amazing. They're not stingy with the spring onions and chilies.
sample_reviews_en.author: siriporn k

sample_reviews_en.text:
Recently, they seem to be closed on Sundays.
I ordered the classic three-meat platter. The crispy pork was delicious!
I don't like sweet things, so next time I'll order it without the sauce.
The owner is very friendly and attentive,
This is a restaurant I'd like to return to!
sample_reviews_en.author: Licaco

sample_reviews_en.text: Crispy pork and roasted pork rice with egg. The crispy pork is really good. The price is very reasonable at 50 baht. Free water. If they improved the interior of the shop a bit, it would probably be much more popular. You can park at the Bangchak gas station next door.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narin P. Rattanaroj

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant specializes in seafood. I especially recommend the Poo Pad Pong Curry (100g) for 150B. It's loaded with vegetables such as peppers, chives, onions, and green onions, and has a sweet, not spicy flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manuel Velazqez

sample_reviews_en.text: First visit. Michelin restaurant. Somewhat mid class price but the food was good! So no complaints! Even friends that open Thai restaurants back in Country said their food was awesome too! ❤️ but be sure to q early!
sample_reviews_en.author: WCH Yoon

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don't know the name of the dish, but it was delicious.
It had a sweet and spicy flavor, similar to Japanese cuisine.
Even though I don't understand Thai, the staff were very kind.
Thank you very much.
sample_reviews_en.author: 大西克人

restaurants.name: Wichian Buri Roasted Chicken (Bangna-Trat soi 4)
restaurants.address:

21 Soi Bang Na-Trat 4, Bang Na Tai, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is clean, with handwashing facilities and fans for cooling. They offer soft drinks and ice cream. The papaya salad is very spicy, the waterfall pork has large, fatty pieces of pork and a strong flavor, and the minced pork larb is packed with ingredients and has a great texture. The grilled chicken is a must-try; it's full of herbs and spices, and the skin is crispy and the meat is tender when eaten at the restaurant. However, if you order it for takeout, you might only get tender meat. The owner is polite and there is convenient parking.
*If you order it not spicy at all, you might need to ask them to wash the mortar and pestle because there's still a lot of chili left.
*You can call to reserve the chicken in advance because it sells out very quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kan Shida

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a restaurant I've driven past many times but never seen before. I stumbled upon it after seeing reviews, so I decided to give it a try. The location is excellent, and Suan Lan looks decent, as is typical of grilled chicken restaurants.

We arrived around noon, and luckily, there was only half a grilled chicken left, so we ordered some grilled pork to try as well. Overall, the grilled chicken and pork were well-made, especially the jaew sauce. The som tam and larb were also quite tasty. Overall, it was delicious, but if you're planning to come early, it looks like it'll sell out quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jayklee

sample_reviews_en.text: The signature menu item is as the name suggests: grilled chicken. I've eaten here many times. Sometimes the chicken is freshly grilled, with crispy skin and tender meat. It's so delicious that I have to order more. Sometimes I come and the chicken isn't very hot, with the skin not very crispy. I feel sad and we fight over it to finish it. The other menu items are okay, with average flavors. The service is good. The weather has been very hot while I've been eating here.
sample_reviews_en.author: N. sukkaluk

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came for lunch around 12:30 PM, it wasn't too crowded.
The restaurant is clean, the food is delicious, and the owner is lovely and kind.

Personally, I really liked the crispy star fruit salad; the flavors were perfectly balanced. It was amazing with sticky rice and grilled chicken. 10/10/10!

Another recommended dish is the bamboo shoot larb; it's hard to find elsewhere.

The prices are reasonable.

Parking is limited.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kuna Pun

sample_reviews_en.text:
Famous Wichianburi grilled chicken, this is a small branch.
Parking is convenient, although sometimes you might have to park a little further away.
Plenty of seating, all chickens are grilled fresh, good and friendly service.
Prices are reasonable.
Went at lunchtime and the place was full, indicating the quality and deliciousness.
The papaya salad is quite dark in color; you need to specify the desired spiciness.
sample_reviews_en.author: Worawit Laosatirawong

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my go-to somtum (papaya salad) restaurant near my office. Almost every dish is delicious.
I highly recommend the grilled chicken – it's the epitome of crispy on the outside and tender on the inside.

The somtum, larb, and nam tok are all flavorful. If you don't like spicy food, be sure to tell the owner, as her cooking tends to be quite spicy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakatas Srichai

sample_reviews_en.text: The roasted chicken is so good and well priced! We were told the chicken would take 15 minutes when we arrived, and it was right after lunch hour, so that made sense. We were served much faster than that and everything was hot and delicious. We also tried the pork neck and the sauce that came with it was perfect! Great lunch spot!
sample_reviews_en.author: Alicia Glassmeyer

sample_reviews_en.text: The grilled chicken was delicious. The meat was juicy and not dry. The highlight was the dipping sauce, which was different from other places. The owner was also very kind. At that time, my family had ordered chicken in advance. When we arrived at the shop, the chicken was already cold, so he grilled it fresh for us.
sample_reviews_en.author: Janni Wu

restaurants.name: ครัวบ้านย่าx2
restaurants.address:

32 1 Somdet Chao Phraya 3 Alley, Somdet Chao Phraya, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This small restaurant behind Wat Anong doesn't have a huge menu, but it's a lifesaver, as there are hardly any restaurants in the area.

Their signature dish is the Pad Thai. It's absolutely amazing, just like the flavors I had as a child. The dried shrimp are truly unique, and the tofu is cut into bite-sized pieces for a textured texture. A squeeze of lime is just right.

Another dish I had that day was the Pad Thai with Chicken, which was amazing. It had a slight burnt flavor, truly living up to its name. Some restaurants don't have that flavor. It's like Pad See Ew without the soy sauce. I highly recommend this place.

If you're looking for something different, they have Pad Thai with Papaya, served with two large shrimps. It's satisfying, and Pad Thai with Takoyaki is definitely unique.

The desserts here are huge, so you have to share. They're so good, but the flavors are average.

If you have a chance to visit this area, definitely give it a try. Especially the Pad Thai, a must-try!! 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Phatsakorn Kritsamai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I intended to eat noodles at a nearby restaurant, but it was closed. So, I stumbled upon this place by chance, and it turned out to be incredibly delicious!
The seabass was amazing. Today I ordered the red curry stir-fried seabass and the garlic-fried seabass. The flavors were perfectly balanced and spicy. It was incredibly satisfying with rice. The rice was plump, fragrant, and neither too soggy nor too hard.
I will definitely be back! 👍🐟✨

(Note: The repeated phrases "Planned to get noodles nearby but it was closed, so I stumbled upon this simple local place instead, and it turned out to be AMAZING. The seabass was super fresh and tasty. Tried the red curry stir-fry and the garlic-fried seabass, both were so good, definitely coming back!" are a separate, unrelated statement and have been omitted from the translation.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Mint Chaninprasert

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and MSG-free!!

However, I'm deducting one star because the food was a bit slow to come out and there's no air conditioning 😅 but there are mist fans.

The food and drink menu has a good variety.
The restaurant stated that all ingredients are from the Royal Project and are pesticide-free.

Many dishes were delicious! Check out the pictures!
The fried meatballs and fresh orange juice were also delicious, but I didn't get a chance to take pictures.

Service area: Both inside and outside the restaurant.
Parking: The restaurant has designated parking spaces.
Restaurant size: Small, with approximately 4-5 tables. There's only one cook.
Service: Excellent. They offered additional food recommendations, checked if everything was complete, and were very friendly and lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Night Sjjr

sample_reviews_en.text:
I initially tried it because I saw pretty good reviews on Google, but I liked it so much that I went back the next day.
It's a small, family-run restaurant with a cute, clean feel. There aren't many seats, so it might be a little hot during lunchtime, but the service is excellent, attentive, and the staff are very friendly. There's also parking available in the alley.
As for the food, it's delicious, appetizing, and made with good quality ingredients at reasonable prices. Some of my favorite dishes include the traditional stir-fried chicken, the stir-fried rice with chili and salted sea bass, the crispy chicken basil rice, the fried meatballs, and the tom yum goong (spicy shrimp soup). They even serve complimentary hot tea after your meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phsr

sample_reviews_en.text:
Another delicious restaurant I highly recommend you try.
- Stir-fried sea bass with basil: very delicious, with a wonderful wok aroma and no fishy fishy smell. Basil lovers will love this dish.
- Stir-fried shrimp with chili and salt: very fresh, crispy, and sweet, and perfectly fried, with a wonderful aroma, just like the wok.
- Tom Yum Goong noodles: large, fresh shrimp. The soup is flavorful and well-balanced, but it's also very clean, as the oil used is directly from the shrimp heads. The restaurant also uses rice bran oil.
The owner is very helpful and offers free tea. I highly recommend giving it a try. The price is reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rinrda Blue

sample_reviews_en.text:
It couldn't be better! From the first bite of Pad Thai to the last spoonful of Lod Chong, it was a complete delight. Each dish has a unique flavor that I'm sure you won't find anywhere else. We also tried the chicken rice noodles, spaghetti with shrimp, and the chili sea bass, and everything was exquisite. Complimentary green tea was served at the end.

It makes you want to try every dish and live in Bangkok so you can make this your favorite restaurant.

This would cost five times more in Mexico and be five times less delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Edgar Arellano

sample_reviews_en.text: What an amazing little restaurant we found as our first food stop in Bangkok. It did not disappoint. The food was so flavorful with every bite, the staff was very friendly and the service was exceptional. They were so accommodating and helped us with lending a cycle bike so that we could ride over and exchange currency at a bank and then eat there (does not take card). We are planning to come back before we leave Bangkok, it was so good! To any foreigners reading this review, this place is worth trying!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jenel Alohalei

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and affordable.
The Pad Thai was perfectly cooked, with chewy noodles, a balanced sweet and sour flavor, and a wonderful wok aroma.
The chicken basil stir-fry was tasty, perhaps not as spicy as my mom's homemade, but the ingredients were excellent. The chicken was all lean meat, without skin, bones, or tendons. Considering the price, it's very reasonable.
However, parking is a bit difficult. For first-time drivers, I'd say don't bother coming.
sample_reviews_en.author: ** PYMN **

restaurants.name: Khrua Ban Por Ta
restaurants.address:

23 Phatthaya Tai 8 Alley, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went there last night. Everything tasted great. The squid with lime sauce was delicious, and the squid in black sauce was also tasty. They forgot to include some items on the bill, but the young server was very attentive.
My only complaint is about the toy store. They seemed unwilling to sell, avoiding questions and pretending to be engrossed in their phone. I almost wanted to leave the store. I was really confused. To be honest, I was trying to control my emotions. If you don't want to sell, then don't. We're here to buy, not to beg. This is the first store I've encountered that didn't offer anything and seemed unwilling to sell. My child took a while to choose because they needed time to decide, and I hurried to get something for my child out of consideration for the shopkeeper. But that shopkeeper really deserved to be scolded. I really hate it when people look down on me.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mathavee Jun

sample_reviews_en.text:
The reviews were great, so I had very high expectations.

- Squid in black sauce: Sweet. My daughter tried it for the first time and loved it, but I was indifferent.
- Squid with salted egg: Okay, the salted egg sauce was very flavorful.
- Clear soup with Chinese cabbage and minced pork: The broth was good, but the minced pork was undercooked, still pink inside.
- Ordered fried chicken wings with fish sauce, but didn't receive them. The order was probably missed. Luckily, it didn't appear on the bill.
- The parking attendant was useless. They urged us to back up quickly, but the car in front of us waited for minutes without saying anything.

Probably won't return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanida Tul

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ate at the restaurant on August 29th at 5:30 PM. When leaving, cars were stuck in traffic going in the opposite direction. The restaurant didn't have any signs indicating the entrance or exit. A staff member was shouting from the back of a car, "This is the entrance, not the exit! Go straight!" Why didn't they come and wave? They just let the cars get stuck in traffic going in the opposite direction. How was anyone supposed to know which way to go? It was terrible.

The service inside the restaurant was also slow. I ordered just one plate of plain rice and waited 15 minutes. Most of the staff couldn't communicate at all. I had to go find someone who spoke Thai.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rejina

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, the taste was great, and there were so many menu options!
The restaurant was spacious with plenty of tables.
There were lots of staff and the service was prompt.
The stir-fried scallops with basil were extremely spicy, like it didn't even taste like regular basil stir-fry anymore! 55555 But it was delicious. If you want that kind of spiciness, you have to specify the level of spiciness.
Everything else was great. The baked scallops with butter were incredibly fragrant and delicious. The Tom Yum Goong (spicy shrimp soup) was very rich and flavorful. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: july

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to this restaurant because it was advertised as cheap, delicious, and fresh. Shellfish sashimi was 450 baht, squid sashimi was 400 baht, and Tom Yum Goong was 200 baht. As indicated by the stickers on the menu, the prices have increased considerably. Compared to other restaurants, it wasn't cheap at all. They said the sashimi would be served with ice packs, but there weren't any, so it wasn't cold. However, it was undoubtedly fresh. The taste was good. Unfortunately, there were no fish in the tank, so I couldn't have fish sashimi. That was a shame.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hige Yuki

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was very impressed. The physiotherapist gave detailed and easy-to-understand advice and explanations about the cause of my symptoms, and provided attentive care throughout the therapy session.

After the treatment, I felt significantly more relaxed and the tension was noticeably reduced. I also received advice on stretching exercises and self-care to continue practicing at home.

The atmosphere was great, the service was friendly, and it felt very professional. I highly recommend this place to anyone experiencing muscle aches or tension. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthapon Kingkaew

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pattaya is a seaside town, but it's also a tourist destination, so there aren't many cheap and delicious seafood restaurants. However, this place is an exception. It's a little far from the city center, but it's worth the trip.

I had the squid ink stir-fry and the shrimp with salted egg stir-fry, and both were delicious. The ingredients were fresh, the cooking was excellent, and I was very satisfied.

The service was also very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bunta OZAKI

sample_reviews_en.text: It's so delicious! There are so many delicious dishes at this restaurant 🥰💖. A friend recommended it, and I personally loved everything on the menu. I've been back twice already. If you're in Pattaya, I highly recommend trying it. There's ample parking. However, at times it can get crowded and the staff might not be able to attend to everyone, and there might be some delays in service. But I will definitely go back again! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
sample_reviews_en.author: Amzmie

restaurants.name: JehJong Moo Tod
restaurants.address:

ด้านติด หลังโลตัส 348 ต้นๆ ถ. ทางรถไฟสายเก่าปากน้ำ Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Jae Jong Moo Tod is a fantastic local Thai-style fried pork branches that offers delicious food at very affordable prices for everyday people. Besides their famous fried pork, they also serve a variety of other Thai dishes.
The main branch opens very early in the morning and is always busy with local residents and workers who come for a quick, tasty, and budget-friendly meal. Its popularity is a testament to both the quality of the food and the reasonable prices.
Personally, I really enjoy this traditional Thai-style fried pork. The flavor is simple, authentic, and incredibly satisfying. If you're looking for a genuine local food experience, I highly recommend giving it a try.
Branches located inside shopping malls or food courts usually open later in the morning, following the mall's operating hours. Overall, it's a great choice for anyone who loves classic Thai comfort food at a great value.
sample_reviews_en.author: veeraphong jiraphanphong

sample_reviews_en.text:
For Thais, this place is probably already well-known 😋. It's a great value fried pork with rice shop. If you're passing by, you should definitely stop by and try it!
The rice with curry in a bag is super cheap 💸, but if you want to eat in or take it home, they also have it in boxes.

For expats who came across my review — if you’re looking for a very affordable Thai meal in Bangkok, this is definitely worth trying!
Fried pork with rice is a must-try! 🐷🍚✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Koyabapla

sample_reviews_en.text:
Jae Jong's Fried Pork shop started as a budget-friendly fried pork stall and now offers a wider variety of dishes, with many new menu items. Every item is 2 for 42 baht.
The service remains the same; you can get refills of rice if you're still hungry. The atmosphere is still the same – no air conditioning, no fans – and the dipping sauce is its signature spicy flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: KnightmanS ThanaboonS

sample_reviews_en.text: Every time I go, they always give generous portions. The amount of food is more than worth the price. I came around lunchtime, so there was a bit of a line, but the wait wasn't too long. I ordered some fried pork to take home afterwards. You can park at Lotus for free for 2 or 3 hours, I think.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suphak Sa-ard

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating here since before the restaurant became famous, then it was featured on the SME Tii Taek TV show and instantly became a huge hit. People queue for kilometers! The taste isn't for the upper class or sophisticated ladies. The …
sample_reviews_en.author: นักรีวิวที่ผ่านทางมาจําไว้ซะ

sample_reviews_en.text: It was very crowded today... I went to deliver rice to the shop and there was a long line of people buying. The staff were friendly... but there's limited seating area, so if you arrive late you can't get a seat and have to order takeout.
sample_reviews_en.author: Weerawat Saracom

sample_reviews_en.text: Taste is a matter of personal preference. The prices are cheap, and there are many menu options. It's crowded, seating is limited, and parking is difficult because it's on a narrow street. The inside of the restaurant is hot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Click

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I took my child to eat at this restaurant. It was very nerve-wracking having to constantly watch for cars driving past. The staff weren't very attentive. It's not a suitable place to bring children.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eakkachai

restaurants.name: Karma indian restaurant
restaurants.address:

371/3 moo 10 nongprue Banglamung Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

An outstanding dining experience at Karma Indian Restaurant! The food was absolutely delicious, with authentic flavours and exceptional quality in every dish. The service was warm, attentive, and made us feel truly welcome.

What makes this place even more special is the owner and his wife. They are genuinely kind, humble, and passionate about ensuring every guest has a memorable experience. Their personal attention, hospitality, and sincerity create a welcoming atmosphere that feels like home.

If you're looking for authentic Indian cuisine served with heartfelt hospitality, Karma Indian Restaurant is a must-visit. Highly recommended—I look forward to coming back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yogesh b.n

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ve been a regular customer here for quite a while, and there’s a good reason for that. The food is always fresh, delicious, and high quality, with authentic Indian flavors that never disappoint. The restaurant is very clean, cozy, and has a warm, relaxing atmosphere. The staff are always friendly, attentive, and provide excellent service. The consistency in both the food and the service is what keeps me coming back. Without a doubt, one of the best Indian restaurants in Pattaya. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: อุบลวรรณ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Karma Restaurant, Pattaya – A Culinary Gem!

I’ve been dining here for a month, and every meal has been nothing short of finger-licking delicious! The flavors are authentic, the quality is top-notch, and the hospitality is unmatched. The owner’s vision and dedication to customer service truly set this place apart—he knows exactly how to make guests feel valued.

Karma isn’t just a restaurant; it’s an iconic spot for anyone craving exceptional Indian food in Pattaya. Highly recommend! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: Shiny Sharma

sample_reviews_en.text: We saw this restaurant had great Google reviews and after visiting we understand why. Food was delicious and service was impeccable. We ordered several dishes and all were tasty and spiced to our preference. We especially enjoyed the starter/side dish called Channa chaat, a refreshing dish of subtle flavours. Our favourite main dish was the Mutton rara - one just wants more:-). We definitely can recommend this place for anyone searching delicious authentic Indian food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert Christiansen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice place ,warm.welcome

Chicken Biryani what we order was too wet,
Tika ,meat was not OK
Even lassi was terrible ,we thought to drink expensive lassi ,masla wale 🤗
One thing ,Soup was OK 👍
We lost this dinner ,will never turn back there.
Boss is coming to check is food OK, that is fine
But we don't want to complain while eating.
Food must talk 🤑🤑🤑

WE FEEL SICK WITH THIS FOOD 😪, NEXT MORNING.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kepler Fly

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very place for Indian food in the heart of Pattaya. The food is great and the service is good. Liquor is also available here and the ambience too is good. Located close to Camelot hotel and cannot be missed.

North Indian dishes are well made here and many Indians patronise this place.

Give it a try and sure you will like it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Richard Jones

sample_reviews_en.text: I coming to pattaya since few years and have visited this place couple of times in few months. They have maintained service and quality. I find this the only place where staff and owner actually care for your well bieng. Just wish them great luck and hope they will maintain the standards they have set.
sample_reviews_en.author: CHEF LAL

sample_reviews_en.text: Glad I read the reviews. This place has amazingly good food. I was pleasantly surprised to have been served the best tandoori chicken I have ever tasted! Everything was delicious. The staff and owner were very attentive. I highly recommend if you are looking for delicious Indian food.
sample_reviews_en.author: André Betancourt
