Unit-114 88 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The restaurant is located in The Parq building on Rama IV Road.
Therefore, there's plenty of parking; you can park in the building.
- The menu is diverse, including rice dishes, noodles, and dim sum, and the taste is good.
- They offer coffee and tea with various bean options.
- There are tables both inside and outside.
- They also have vegetarian options.
sample_reviews_en.author: Surattana Boonsai

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're visiting Benjakitti Park for a run, don't forget to stop by this restaurant. The food is delicious and the atmosphere is great! ^^
sample_reviews_en.author: Sutee Toz Wichayawanakun

sample_reviews_en.text: A chill breakfast spot to hang out with friends, open from 7 am. Located near Benjakitti Park. I recommend the toast and Ceylon tea.
sample_reviews_en.author: thavaleb boon

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is so cute! The staff is very friendly. I ordered the rice with pork delicious! And the coffee is good!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Curry

sample_reviews_en.text: Great food, excellent service, and a lovely atmosphere and good location . Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rainnie’s Diary

sample_reviews_en.text: Love coffee here especially Cofete Columbia …good place for chilling with good food & coffee
sample_reviews_en.author: Nathana Suthibest

sample_reviews_en.text: It would be great if they accepted card. But the service and food were really good.
sample_reviews_en.author: priya vishwanathan

sample_reviews_en.text: The traditional Thai breakfast was quite delicious. The staff were very helpful.
sample_reviews_en.author: vuong nguyen

restaurants.name: Tazu
restaurants.address:

358 ห้อง 209 อาคาร La Villa Phahonyothin Rd, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
They offer both buffet and à la carte options.
We opted for the à la carte set at 599 baht, which included 4 plates of meat, 2 appetizers, and 2 sets of vegetables. It was enough for two people and very filling. The meat plates were huge!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thaweechai Saiwongse

sample_reviews_en.text: The shabu-shabu with its flavorful dark broth, good quality pork, and dipping sauces with plenty of scallions, carrots, chilies, and garlic – absolutely delicious! The sesame dipping sauce with scallions is also fantastic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vila Yong

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my favorite Japanese-style shabu-shabu restaurant in the Ari area. The food is delicious, the ingredients are high-quality, and the service is friendly. I'm a regular customer and have never been disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: KB

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, high-quality, reasonably priced, and the staff provides excellent service. If you're in the Ari area and don't know where to eat, I highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Taew

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the 599 baht set and was very satisfied. The ingredients were good and the staff provided excellent service. I'll definitely try the more expensive set next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sila Cosmo

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted better than expected.
The meat was tender and had no connective tissue.
The restaurant's atmosphere was great, like being in Japan.
sample_reviews_en.author: davidnaooooooo

sample_reviews_en.text: The information is inaccurate, as some reviews suggest, leading to misunderstandings. The review says 599, but the picture shows a set for 1200.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ken Pitak

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating here since I was a kid, and I'm so impressed with everything – the atmosphere, the service, and the food quality. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Sorawit Phankasem

restaurants.name: Kogoro Katsu - The Circle Ratchapruk
restaurants.address:

โครงการเดอะเซอร์เคิล ราชพฤกษ์ เลขที่ 39 ห้องเลขที่ L7 Ratchaphruek Rd, Bang Ramat, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Served with creamy, enjoyable edamame. Order anything, every menu item is delicious. We recommend starting with the cheesy corn, followed by the cheesy pork loin set, and switching to butter corn rice – a kids' favorite! 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitinan Boonyakiat

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! I loved the rice so much – fragrant, soft, and perfect! The meat wasn't tough, and you could get refills as much as you wanted.
sample_reviews_en.author: Moowaan MK

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! High-quality ingredients. Refills of rice, soup, and cabbage are included. Excellent value! Very satisfied!
sample_reviews_en.author: waranya Vathunyutakavin

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu is diverse, and the set meals include refills of rice and side dishes. The prices are good value.
sample_reviews_en.author: dubukid

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the atmosphere is great. They have menu options and soups for children.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanissorn Panarungsun

sample_reviews_en.text: It was so delicious! I didn't get a chance to take a picture before I finished it all.
sample_reviews_en.author: เจนกิจ แย้มกสิกร

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the service was good and fast. The staff were very lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khitanchali Ploysuwan

restaurants.name: MALAHUB หมาล่าฮับ บางหว้า ( หมาล่าทั่งแบบชั่งน้ำหนัก) (bangwa branch)
restaurants.address:

1 11 Phet Kasem Rd, Bang Wa, Phasi Charoen, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Self-serve mala soup is 45฿ per portion. The soup bases are all the same price and there's a wide variety to choose from. The self-serve area is well-maintained and cleaned by staff. Free ice and self-serve dipping sauces are available. Today I chose the pork bone mala soup, which wasn't too spicy. I ended up scooping almost 400฿ worth! I was so full!
sample_reviews_th.author: Neeranuch C.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was about to take the BTS and had a long journey ahead. I asked myself if I could make it to my destination on an empty stomach, and realized I couldn't. So I looked for a restaurant near the BTS, and importantly, it had to have air conditioning because it was so hot.
I spotted this restaurant and went in. They had a wide variety of food to choose from, and the quality of the ingredients exceeded my expectations. The air conditioning was also nice and cool. I ordered sukiyaki because I didn't want anything spicy. I scooped my food, weighed it, and paid. The staff took my bowl, cooked it, and gave me a buzzer to let me know when it was ready.
When the food arrived, it was piping hot. Everything was perfectly cooked, not overcooked. The shrimp was crispy, just the way I like it. The broth was a little mild for sukiyaki, but it was still delicious. The price was good too. Next time, I'll have to try other menu items.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nitcha Maneechai

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd like to say that this is the worst service I've ever used. I recommend eating at another restaurant. Today, I picked up seaweed and the seaweed wasn't cut at all. It almost all went into my basin. I asked the staff to help me cut it. There were 3-4 staff standing there looking at each other and not doing anything. I told them to help, but they didn't help me until I had to help myself. After I helped myself, they took it in and said to their friends, "Have you not cut it yet? Or did you cut it? I saw you put it in for a moment and then took it out. It's like you didn't cut it at all. It's like you just put it in for them to see." Then, when I ordered mala soup, I said that I didn't want tea beans. When I opened it, I wanted to eat the tea beans. The cup was full of tea beans. I tried to pick out one ladle. It was a lot. They gave a lot as if they were being sarcastic. This is really not okay. The staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: กชกร ตู้พิมาย

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Mala Hub branch near Bang Wa station is a mala tang (spicy hot pot) restaurant where you pay per gram for what you scoop. It's very reasonably priced, delicious, and clean. All the ingredients are fresh, including vegetables, meats, meatballs, tofu, and noodles – a huge variety to choose from, and everything is excellent.

Personally, I love the different types of tofu skin, the various pork cuts, and the fresh vegetables like spinach and lotus root. The pork bone soup is rich and flavorful; I always finish every last drop. The best part is the dipping sauces – they're incredibly tasty and well-balanced, with sesame, sukiyaki, and the restaurant's own special blend.

This branch isn't very large, quite cramped, but it's air-conditioned. The staff are very friendly and provide excellent service. However, there's no parking available. It's conveniently located near the BTS station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Punnatorn Vechaputi

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is amazing! I've eaten at two branches: Pinklao and Bang Wa, and they were both equally delicious. The restaurant is clean, the pork is high-quality and doesn't look like it's been sitting overnight (judging by the color), and the mala pork bone broth is incredibly tasty. They have a wide variety of dipping sauces, and they're all delicious. I'm hooked! The restaurant is a bit small, but that's understandable given the limited space. There is a second floor, though.

There's no parking; you have to park at the Shell gas station across the street and walk over. However, it's very close to the Bang Wa BTS/MRT station, so taking the train is more convenient. I called to ask about parking, and the staff were very polite. I was impressed with everything.
sample_reviews_en.author: Axxmq T

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, around 9:30 PM, I went to eat mala. I ordered pork ribs in mala soup. When it was my turn to pick up my order, the employee just prepared the ribs without any explanation. I told her I ordered mala ribs, but the female employee said, "I'll change it for you." Then, she took the food to the kitchen and said, "Hey, can you add more mala for the customer?" A man in the kitchen, speaking in a very annoyed tone, said, "Oh my god!" I was stunned. You made a mistake, why are you acting like this? I was very displeased. I made a face, and the female employee probably saw it. It was terrible. She probably thought her voice was quiet, but I was still standing there.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภัสสร คีรีวัลย์

sample_reviews_en.text: They switched my order with someone else's. I only noticed when I got home and was about to eat. The items I chose were very similar, because I only picked meat, vegetables, and a few other things – no noodles. But what I received was almost identical to what I picked, but with the meat removed and noodles replaced. It was a whole bowl of glass noodles with hardly any meat. I'm so disappointed! I've already informed the restaurant, and they've said they've taken responsibility. Anyone ordering takeout should check their order themselves; don't rely on the staff. Their attentiveness really needs improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamolwan K

sample_reviews_en.text:
This mala restaurant is near BTS Bang Wa station; you'll find it right after getting off the station.

They offer 8 types of soup. If you don't like mala soup, I recommend the yen ta fo soup or the pork bone broth – both are delicious and flavorful.

There's a decent selection of ingredients, including meatballs, pork, seafood, various noodles, and vegetables. They're priced by weight.

There are various dipping sauces to choose from. I liked the house-made sesame sauce; it was just right and didn't need any extra seasoning. The price includes the soup and dipping sauces.

Minimum order is 200 grams.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cha BRN

restaurants.name: Ros’niyom Siam Paragon
restaurants.address:

Thailand, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon, Pathum Wan, Bangkok, Rama I Rd, 邮政编码: 10330

sample_reviews_th.text: I have searched at several places everytime I visit Bangkok for Kanom Jeen [ขนมจีน] but I never managed to find it for some strange reason. This time, I finally spot Kanom Jeen [ขนมจีน] on the menu of this restaurant inside Siam Paragon. Timing could not have been better as I had to go to the airport as soon as I finished lunch. And what a last meal in Bangkok it was for me! I am happy to see that this restaurant has outlets in other parts of Bangkok and I will definitely keep an eye out for them if I am in the area and perhaps next time I will have more time and stomach space to try other items on their menu!
sample_reviews_th.author: Henry

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ros’niyom Siam Paragon is a great spot if you’re craving comforting Thai flavours with a modern touch.

We really enjoyed several dishes here — the Deep Fried Chicken Wings served with Sticky Rice were crispy, juicy, and very satisfying. The Pan-Fried Chive Cakes were fragrant and nicely crisp on the outside, while the Papaya Salad was refreshing, well-balanced, and full of flavour.

However, we were a bit disappointed with the Fermented Rice Noodles with Southern Crab Curry. While the curry itself was aromatic and rich, the amount of crab was unfortunately too little, which took away from the overall experience of the dish.

On a very high note, the Thai Tea Granita with Glass Jelly was absolutely outstanding — easily one of the best granitas we’ve ever had. Super refreshing, not overly sweet, and incredibly well executed. A must-order dessert!

Overall, Ros’niyom delivers solid Thai comfort food with some real highlights. With a bit more generosity on certain dishes, it would be even better. Definitely worth a visit when you’re at Siam Paragon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leonard Lim

sample_reviews_en.text:
📷 Crab Meat Fried Rice (418 Baht)
📷 Crab Meat Pad Thai (495 Baht)
📷 Mango Sticky Rice (208 Baht)

🥓 Food isn't the best, average tasting and nothing special. The mango isn't very sweet as well. I don't even understand why this store is so hyped up amongst tourists.

🤑 Very expensive and definitely not worth every cents I've paid for.

👎 Waitresses were not friendly even though it wasn't very crowded. I guess when you are a popular store, service standards need not be maintained? Food quality is meh and the audacity to put a higher than average price for this?! No thanks, never again, bye.

🔥 Huge disappointment despite reading good reviews on this restaurant. I guess the higher the expectations the higher the disappointment when it fails to deliver? Please please please just eat somewhere else, there's load of restaurant serving Thai cuisines at much lower rates which tastes even better. Don't pay to cause grievances to your stomach.
sample_reviews_en.author: CNHE

sample_reviews_en.text:
A wide variety of Thai food, drinks, and desserts. I got the Fermented Rice Noodles with Salted Mackarel and Fermented Fish Paste ‘Plara’. I chose normal spice, and holy—it was one of the spiciest things I’ve had. The spice level wasn’t actually too bad if I were to only having a few spoonfuls, but after the 5th spoon or so, my mouth started burning from how spicy it was, so I had to order sweet chrysanthemum to calm the nerves. It was good though, and would order it again but with the mild option lol.

The pork balls were really good too. I added them to my spicy noodle dish and it tasted really good together!

Lastly was the Kua Gai Noodles that my friend got. I didn’t get to try it, but it looked good!

Atmosphere of the place wasn’t great since it’s located in the middle of the busy G Floor food area of Siam Paragon, and we sat on one of those tables in the walkway itself, so people could’ve easily bump into our chairs and stuff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Faa Papon

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, which is why I came here specifically for it. However, this experience was very "bad." First, the staff didn't greet us, making us wait at the door for a long time before we realized we needed to give our names to reserve a table. Second, they were impatient when we took our order 🙄, and then they didn't confirm it after we ordered. Later, they brought the wrong food and questioned us. Finally, we saw them take the food back to the kitchen, and less than 10 seconds later, they brought out the exact same food and delivered it to the table behind us. Lastly, they lacked basic professionalism and etiquette as a service industry worker. Because we weren't Thai, they acted "high and mighty." I don't know if that person was the manager, but her attitude was very disappointing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mocha

sample_reviews_en.text: Ros'niyom, situated in Siam Paragon, stands as a delightful haven for those seeking an authentic Thai noodle experience. Boasting a diverse menu, the restaurant offers a myriad of noodle options, accompanied by distinct and flavorful soup bases. It caters to a variety of preferences, allowing patrons to choose the perfect combination that suits their taste buds. This establishment proves to be an ideal choice for individuals who wish to savor the richness of Thai noodles without resorting to the hustle and bustle of enjoying this renowned street food on the roadside. Whether you're a noodle enthusiast or someone looking for a break from typical street-side fare, Ros'niyom provides a welcoming ambiance and a menu that promises a satisfying Thai noodle experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wesley Wong

sample_reviews_en.text: Bad bicker manager. Restaurant should hire a better one. No sense of service at all. Giving wrong change to wrong table. Not deliver all orders correctly. Lack of concentration. This tomboy has low skill communication with customers and untrained service mind. She/He does not even know what customer ordered and never learn how to answer in a nice way. Other members were doing a good job. Maybe i-berry is too big to take care small important detail like this. I still like ros’niyom foods but i expect you to select nice and smart manager to work especially in this Paragon branch. Atmosphere supposed to be good that day but it was totally bad day for me. Hope i will never see this manager when i bring customers to your restaurant again next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: N. C.

sample_reviews_en.text:
rarely leave negative reviews, but this place truly deserves one.

The food was incredibly disappointing. The seafood wasn’t fresh, most of the dishes were bland, Considering the prices, the quality was nowhere near acceptable.

The service was even worse. When we first arrived, the lead staff spoke English perfectly well while taking our order. However, when we politely pointed out that the food wasn’t good，she suddenly acted as if she couldn’t understand a single word of English. That was extremely frustrating and unprofessional.

Poor food, terrible customer service, There are plenty of better restaurants nearby. I definitely won’t be coming back, and I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone.

I recently had the unfortunate experience of dining at this restaurant, and I must say it was a complete disappointment. The service was abysmal, with rude and inattentive staff who seemed more interested in chatting amongst themselves than attending to the needs of the diners.

As for the food, it was bland and uninspired, lacking any real flavor or creativity. The presentation was lackluster, and it left much to be desired in terms of quality.

I can honestly say that I will never set foot in this establishment again, and I certainly would not recommend it to anyone else. It was a complete waste of time and money, and I regret having chosen to dine there. Needless to say, I will be taking my business elsewhere in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniil Sia

sample_reviews_en.text:
A truly enjoyable Prosciutto di Parma Night, made special by the presence of Chef Bruno, who shared his knowledge of the production process and the original territory behind this iconic product.

The experience went beyond tasting — learning about the curing, the time involved, and the importance of origin added real depth to the evening. Everything was well presented, thoughtfully paced, and focused on quality rather than spectacle.

It was a relaxed, informative, and genuinely enjoyable night, made special by attention to detail and respect for tradition. A great balance between education and pleasure.

Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amanda Sun

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant opened about half a year ago, so older reviews are irrelevant.
Very good value for money.
Pleasant and tasteful ambiance. Friendly service and a very nice owner. We were never disappointed in the 8-9 times we ate there. The calamari fritti are great, and the pasta is very good. And there are changing specials, such as osso buco, slow-cooked beef ribs, and similar. All excellent, at very reasonable prices.
All in all, highly recommended.
One of the best Italian restaurants in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Schumm

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't know know how this gets 4 stars. Out of the whole entire menu, the 2 completely different dishes that we picked to have, they came back and said they had neither.............Uhhh you're a restaurant.  Are you kidding me? Our waiter had no clue what we were asking regarding questions on the dishes. I wanted to leave, but she felt sorry for the staff and wanted to stay. She ordered what looked like pizza. It was ok. Really disappointed overall. 😞 I definitely won't be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bryan Wimber

sample_reviews_en.text: The worst Pizza we ever had. It came with a topping of ordinary salad and a meagre layer of only one kind of cheese, contrary what had been promised on the menu. When confronted, staff admitted that they do that regularily. Eventually the boss came in and also did not apologize. Google doesn't allow zero stars, therefore I have no choice and give just one. A real tourist trap for people arriving with the airport bus!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jan Holldorff

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent service, nice clean place. The food was decent enough, however there are many places offering higher quality in this price range, so the value isn’t there. The reason I probably won’t return is they were blaring religious music, making it uncomfortable for me. Not everyone is Born Again Christian and I’m not interested in going to your church. Indeed, it brings back some painful memories for some of us.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brian

sample_reviews_en.text: In a strategic location with ample parking, you'll experience the atmosphere of a true Italian trattoria and pizzeria. The simple yet elegant decor provides a relaxing al fresco dining experience, allowing you to rediscover the products and flavors of Italian cuisine far from home. The owner, a true expert in the restaurant business, is excellent company, the staff is friendly, and the bill is fair. I'll be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Gigi Monterastelli

restaurants.name: Charlie Brown's Restaurant (Thai cuisine)
restaurants.address:

315 303 Naradhiwas Rajanakarindra 24 Alley, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came here after noticing how many locals were dining inside, and that’s always a good sign. Even though the restaurant has a western menu, the Thai dishes are the real highlight—authentic, flavorful, and prepared with care.

We ordered the garlic chicken, pad see ew, and Thai iced tea. Each dish was spot on—the garlic chicken was perfectly seasoned and savory, the pad see ew had that delicious smoky wok flavor we love, and the Thai iced tea was just the right balance of sweet and creamy.

On top of the food, the service was excellent. The staff were so warm and welcoming, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable. What’s fun is that a massage place around the corner recommended this spot to us, and we couldn’t be more grateful for the suggestion.

Overall, this is a gem of a restaurant—authentic, delicious, and friendly. We left happy, satisfied, and definitely planning to come back again.

My husband even mentioned it’s his favorite place in Bangkok since we were able to get some real Thai food not far from
Tourist areas where it was hard to find good Thai food
sample_reviews_en.author: Shaifa Hirji

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is incredibly disappointing and embarrassing.

My family dined at this restaurant during a very stressful time for us. Everyone in the family was in a state of shock and anxiety. We had a normal meal, and the total bill was approximately 650 baht.

However, afterward, when I checked my bank statement, I found my card charged 2,500 baht.

This difference of 1,850 baht is completely unexplainable and unacceptable. If I hadn't checked my account later, I would never have known about this excessive overcharge.

I believe this is unacceptable and cannot be overlooked. Whether it was a serious error or a deliberate act, charging a customer 2,500 baht when the meal cost only about 650 baht is something the restaurant should take serious responsibility for.

During a very stressful situation, we chose to trust the restaurant to charge us correctly, but I was the one who discovered the discrepancy myself through my bank statement.

It's truly shameful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alicia Turellier

sample_reviews_en.text:

This place is horrible. Avoid it. Owner is stuck up, angry little guy who has some serious issues and clearly lots to compensate. 😉

He literally takes his day off to answer every bad review instead of trying to improve his behaviour or food/drink related issues that ex-visitors bring out.

In advance his reply, went to taco bell and although it wasn't the food quality I expected at least decent behavior, humanity and decency was there. Something you cannot find in Charlie brown.

Food in Charlie brown is decent but inconsistent with the side order of attitude from the owner 😆 Would not go there again if Molino actually amazing place to go.

For owner - can't wait for you ready-for-anger-management review 😆😆

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent Thai restaurant at very reasonable prices considering the originality and quality of the dishes. Good cocktails at reasonable prices. Efficient and very friendly staff. They offer some more original dishes while remaining completely authentic, such as beef and vegetable broth with three spices (kao lao nua toon) and green curry, served with excellent paratha/roti (kaeng khiaew waan kab roti), which makes all the difference. They also serve Western dishes like steak and pasta. Pleasant and discreet background music. A big thank you to the entire team.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rudolphe

sample_reviews_en.text: The food selection was diverse, and the taste was just acceptable. However, when we said we would pay by card, we were told there would be an additional 3% surcharge. Although it felt unreasonable, we agreed. What made us uncomfortable was that we were then asked to process the card payment at a neighboring shop (a spa), not at the restaurant itself. As foreigners, this left us wondering whether we were treated this way because of that, which was an unpleasant experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eun Joo Park

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu here includes Thai food as well as other dishes like fries, burgers, and sandwiches. We ordered green curry chicken and water spinach. Overall, the taste was quite good, and the environment was clean and spacious, making for a comfortable dining experience. The prices were reasonable, and the coconut water was also very delicious!

sample_reviews_en.text: The lemon chicken is as delicious as ever...a must-try dish at this restaurant. The stir-fried squid with salted egg yolk is rich and flavorful, not too strong, and perfectly cooked with a tender texture. The staff are polite and provide excellent service as always.

My kids love their chicken biryani and I am quite surprised since usually they didn't like any middle east/indian food. Definitely will be back here again when we can

sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel

sample_reviews_en.text: A truly wonderful experience. The service was very polite and discreet. The presentation of the food was reminiscent of an Arab country. The quality and taste of the food were outstanding. A really good Arab restaurant in the south of Pattaya. We will gladly return. A well-deserved 5 stars.

sample_reviews_en.text: We liked the selection and prices. We walked about half a kilometer, choosing where to have dinner. While there was no traffic on the street, the terrace was quite cozy. I've eaten here several times and the food usually comes out quickly.

But the last time, I waited over 40 minutes for my pizza, which was extremely slow. I had to follow up several times, and there was no explanation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ahgaht Meevuttisom

sample_reviews_en.text: The Seasons branch has a promotion every Tuesday: buy one medium-sized pizza or larger and get one free. I'm not sure when the promotion ends, but it's been running for several months since the store opened.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jin Kerkarchachai

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious, affordable, and they have lots of promotions. If you're tired of the same old pizza, you should try it. But if you order it to take home, you should have a microwave to reheat it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumrid limvongsuwan

restaurants.name: Banthat Tong Roast Duck
restaurants.address:

ซอย จุฬาฯ 14 Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We have passed this restaurant a few times and decided to give it a try.

We ordered the Roast Duck since this is a duck joint; surprisingly had a smokey flavour to the meat. The whole duck is quite small so  you have to order other dishes as well to have a worthwhile dinner.

However, we complained to the staff that the meat was very tough - almost like biting into bullets.

If the duck meat was softer, i would have given this a solid 9/10.

Also, the outdoor dining section allows smoking (so all you smokers can enjoy a ciggie after your meal).

Would recommend to try this place out, but also try and order other dishes as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mister Eats

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time here. Here's my personal summary:
- The atmosphere is quite hot. The restaurant is airy and not stuffy, but being a hot pot restaurant, it can get quite hot, which somewhat ruins the atmosphere.
- The taste of the food: I personally think it's average. It's delicious and edible. The hot pot soup is a bit bland, and the sauce is a bit too sweet. The som tam (Thai papaya salad) is a bit too sour.
- The price is average to a bit high, but understandable. Businesses need to make a profit.
Overall, it's okay. Nothing to complain about. 👍🏻🎊🎉
sample_reviews_en.author: Wisaroot S.

sample_reviews_en.text: The clay pot hotpot and fried rice were both bland, not at all like typical Thai food. The staff service was mediocre, and basic communication with tourists needs improvement. When I tried to pay by card upstairs, employee A said it wasn't possible. Only after asking employee B did they tell me I had to go downstairs. By then, employee A had already settled the bill. When I tried to tell the counter I wanted to pay by card, they said it wasn't possible, as it was already paid. Overall, a poor experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: 胡小胖

sample_reviews_en.text: Almost everything was good except the service. We were a group of four and ordered several dishes, but they only gave us one set of spoons and forks, which we only got after asking for them three times. Imagine, ordering hot pot and not getting spoons! Even ordering individual dishes, no spoons! Eating the larb (spicy minced meat salad) was incredibly difficult with chopsticks. And to top it all off, they yelled at their staff in front of other customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rainy Sad

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered food almost two hours ago, and the restaurant still hasn't accepted the order. I called their call center, and they said the restaurant hasn't received the order. If they're going to offer delivery, they should check their order status. When I called to ask, the person speaking was unhelpful and said they would check and call me back, but they never did. What's so difficult about that?
sample_reviews_en.author: kot s.

sample_reviews_en.text: Crispy skin, juicy meat, and consistently well-roasted duck. The grilled meats are equally good and worth trying nice variety and proper char. Multiple papaya salad options pair well with the meats and add good balance. Quick service even during peak hours. No hype, just solid food done right with good music, try the top most floor open roof.
sample_reviews_en.author: Victor Lobo

sample_reviews_en.text: Located in the Banthat Thong area, this restaurant serves Northeastern Thai (Isaan) cuisine. It's a small shophouse with seating on both the first and second floors. The portions are small, and the food is average in taste. There's live music on the second floor, but the atmosphere is hot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nat P.

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered at 6:09 PM on Grab, and the system showed the shop was open. I checked again at 6:30 PM, and it still showed normally. The rider accepted the order. But at 7:09 PM, my order was cancelled, saying the shop was closed. Unbelievable. They didn't notify me or call.
sample_reviews_en.author: Auftoyou

restaurants.name: ขนมจีนยกซด สาขา บรรทัดทอง
restaurants.address:

979 Banthat Thong Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Been in Thailand for over 20 years and first time I had that fried fish with their signature green curry and it was the first time to have that combo and it was great. The plate was little over 100thb which is now considered cheap given how the local landlords squeeze rentals out of businesses. The restaurant seems to have a deep history and connection to the south and it could be felt on the palate. The fish was super crispy and the meat had great texture. The simplicity of rice and fish and a balanced dose of southern herbs was the perfect marriage coming together on that spoon. Price and quality didnt feel like a rip off unlike some other places and I will be back for more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Biedassek

sample_reviews_en.text: The wait for the restaurant's main dishes was quite long, over 20 minutes. I don't understand if the noodle sauce is freshly made in each pot or what, but the crispy pork basil stir-fry and garlic squid, which I ordered at the same time, arrived first. I finished my rice before the noodles finally came. Oh my gosh! The fried salted egg was delicious, and the squid was tasty. As for the noodle sauce, it was salty first, then saltier again, with a spicy finish, but the consistency was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Luv TXT

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff weren't Thai and couldn't understand my order. After taking my order, 10 minutes later they came back saying they didn't have it, and pointed to the salad, saying it was bamboo shoots. Okay, fine. But when it came out, it was lotus stems! And I only ordered a salad, but it took forever. People who came after me ordered other dishes and got their food first. This needs improvement. The taste was okay, and the food looked appetizing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phichyapha Siangyen

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the "Nam Ya Pa" (spicy jungle curry), and it was unlike any I've ever had at other restaurants. My friend from the South said it was the spicy southern style curry, and it was indeed very spicy and flavorful. I loved that it came with boiled duck eggs, and the fried chicken was delicious—it's the best fried chicken I've ever had at a Khanom Jeen (Thai rice noodle) restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamonporn Nawaphom

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my second time eating here. The first time I had Khanom Jeen (rice noodles), which was delicious and flavorful. This area has a lot of tourists, but the restaurant serves authentic, rich-flavored Thai food. This time I had Kua Kling (stir-fried minced pork with chili paste), which was also delicious and spicy just the way I like it.
sample_reviews_en.author: j_soraya

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! The crab meat noodle dish was excellent, as were the garlic pork and the fried pork. The seafood dipping sauce and chili fish sauce were also great. Everything was impressive. A great place to eat. The prices are a bit high, but reasonable considering what you get and its location in a tourist area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krit The Samsam

sample_reviews_en.text: Every time I go, I'm impressed as always. The food is delicious and worth the price. The salted fried egg is 39 baht, and it's delicious—not too salty, just the right flavor. I secretly tasted my friend's and ate it with the lava squid, and it was a perfect combination.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuiiz Parudee

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my second visit, and both times the food was delicious. I especially liked the deboned fish rice and the stir-fried shrimp with chili and salt rice. The chili fish sauce dipping sauce also showed attention to detail. The rice was amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: HP

restaurants.name: Poom poom good steak ตลาดห้วยขวาง
restaurants.address:

5451 Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is very reasonably priced. You can choose your own side dishes (2 choices) and one sauce (the Jaew dipping sauce is excellent). There's a wide variety of food including steaks, burgers, spaghetti, salads, fried items, and many drinks. The meat portions aren't very large, so if you have a big appetite, you can choose the value set which lets you choose two types of meat in one dish. On the day I went, I ordered approximately…

- Black pepper chicken breast steak
- Baked chicken with cheese
- Grilled fish steak
- Pork chop
- Tu salad
- Mixed vegetable salad
- Mushroom soup
- Baked mashed potatoes with cheese

All this for only 509 baht!!!!

The downside for those driving is there's no parking. You have to find your own parking, which is very difficult. I recommend taking public transportation.
03/01/2569
sample_reviews_en.author: ปัทมา นาเวช

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a beef steak (75% cooked) and a pork chop. The first time, the pork was undercooked, so we asked them to grill it again. The person who took the food was okay with that, but I'm not sure if the person who served it just didn't want to do their job or what. As for the beef, it was 75% cooked to the point of being inedible. I didn't dare eat it because I expected 75%, not even medium rare. Normally I only order chicken at this restaurant, but this time I wanted to try something different. I probably won't come back again. Less than an hour after eating, both of us felt nauseous, and I personally experienced vomiting and dizziness the whole time. This will definitely be my last time eating here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mananyanat Wanna

sample_reviews_en.text: The steak was worth the price, but the service was terrible. My grandmother hadn't eaten steak in a while, so she wanted to try it, but the meat was very tough and chewy. She accidentally swallowed it and choked, but the staff remained indifferent and uninterested in assisting the customer. They left the customer to fend for herself. My boyfriend helped with first aid, and she was able to spit out the meat, but after that, the staff didn't check on her at all. They just stood around chatting and playing on their phones as if nothing had happened. Do we have to wait for someone to lose consciousness before they'll come to help?
sample_reviews_en.author: VaVa

sample_reviews_en.text:
A message to the owner or QC:
The papaya salad side dish was terrible!!!
It tasted like leftovers piled together; the papaya strips were chewy, not fresh or crispy, more like candied papaya. It tasted like papaya strips in chicken dipping sauce with artificial lime juice.
Or maybe it was because I ate there at 8 PM? I recommend you don't sell this dish at all because the steak was delicious. It's a real shame. The baked mashed potatoes with cheese had very little cheese today. Even though I was hungry, I could tell... the quality is inconsistent. This is feedback for improvement. Thank you very much.
sample_reviews_en.author: giftmomon momon

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordering through LINE MAN is very convenient, no need to go to the store. The taste is okay, delicious and suits my palate. The portions are large and filling. The packaging was very good. The papaya salad was a little too spicy. The garlic fried rice seemed slightly burnt and the rice was a bit hard. Everything else was good. I deducted one star because they didn't include tissues even though I requested them in the note.
sample_reviews_en.author: Freeze Kiwii

sample_reviews_en.text:
The chicken steak was great value, but the pork was too tough. Even the half-inch thick beef was chewy; they need to improve that. But it's still worth the price.
They didn't provide cutlery for almost 3 minutes while serving the food, causing it to cool down. They need better training in this area.

Overall, it's good value for money, and the taste depends on personal preference.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poramate Lerlertkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted great. The price was unbeatable. The portions were definitely enough to fill up a guy.

However, the chairs were a bit uncomfortable to sit on. The service staff were excellent.

Considering the price alone, it was incredibly good value for money. If you live nearby and are a meat lover, you should definitely give it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kurt Lin

sample_reviews_en.text: Poompoom restaurant is delicious! The quality of the ingredients is excellent. At first, I wasn't open to it because I thought it would be like any other steak restaurant, but after my first visit, I've been coming back regularly. The atmosphere is nice, the air conditioning is cool, and it's not crowded. I really like it!
sample_reviews_en.author: อรปรียา สนไธสง

restaurants.name: Mae Boonliang
restaurants.address:

662 Soi Sukhumvit 93, Bang Chak, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a mango sticky rice shop I've been eating at since I was a child. Back then, it was located near Phra Khanong market, almost 30 years ago. The sticky rice is still soft, delicious, and fragrant, and the coconut milk topping has that unique aroma of the shop. It's a shame the shop is located in a deep and narrow alley. You can park in front, but it's quite difficult because there's always traffic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kenny Kenny

sample_reviews_en.text: This sticky rice with mango is the best I've ever had. It's hard to find one this delicious elsewhere. The shop owner is also very kind. Every year, my friends and I order sticky rice with mango to offer to the monks at six different temples. Sometimes the shop owner gives us a discount, and sometimes they even send extra sticky rice with mango to offer to the monks.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชัชวาล อรรถกิจโกศล

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating here since I was a kid. Their shrimp paste fried rice is number one; no other place can compare, neither in quantity nor taste. Their braised pork rice is also delicious and flavorful. This restaurant is truly legendary. I remember it being featured on Channel 7's "Here at Morchit" show, but unfortunately, it's closed frequently.
sample_reviews_en.author: PIPIU

sample_reviews_en.text:
The mango sticky rice at this shop is the best. I've been eating it since I was a kid.
The braised pork rice is also incredibly delicious, and the shrimp paste fried rice is amazing too. Everything is delicious! If you go a little late, you'll probably miss out. Sometimes they're sold out by 10 am.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nancy Dufault

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered a set of sticky rice with mango for a 100-day memorial service for the monks.
Also ordered some to take home and eat myself. The taste is delicious, as always. The service is good, convenient, and very fast. The shop also accepts the government's co-payment scheme.
sample_reviews_en.author: cherry KT

sample_reviews_en.text: I just found out they have seating inside the restaurant. They have a menu with pork leg rice, noodle soup, thick broth rice noodles, and rice mixed with shrimp paste with generous toppings, plus tea and coffee. Everything is delicious and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ekawin Satitkit

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! I eat a box a week, and I've gained weight because of it. It's not expensive either; 60 baht per box, and there's a lot – enough to fill you up completely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanita Prasong

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a really delicious rice mixed with shrimp paste, but lately, the owner, an elderly lady, has been closing the shop frequently due to age-related health issues.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oraya Mahachon

restaurants.name: ครัวเพลินรส สดจากทะเล
restaurants.address:

98 ถนน กัลปพฤกษ์ Bang Kho, Chom Thong, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and of standard quality (a little on the sweet side). When I went, around 5 PM, there were only two tables occupied, so the food came out quickly. There was only one staff member (excluding the cook), but they worked with heart and provided excellent service, almost like they owned the place. I was particularly impressed by this gentleman; he was efficient, gave good recommendations, was polite, and attentive to customers like I've never encountered before. My only minor complaint is that the shrimp in the glass noodle casserole wasn't very fresh. Otherwise, everything was great. Overall, the food was delicious. The price wasn't cheap, but not excessively expensive either.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peeraya Tamarree

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant serves delicious food in a traditional Thai style with a unique aroma.
The seafood fried rice is a must-try with a squeeze of lime.
The peppery aroma is outstanding. The meat is worth the price and the flavor is rich.
The poached mussels are incredibly fragrant with spices, plucked cleanly, and are fresh and sweet.

I personally don't like the fried squid with fish sauce; it's a bit tough, but my girlfriend loves it.

The crab omelet is delicious, typical of any omelet, and not greasy.

The waitress who took my order was very friendly and gave good recommendations. The atmosphere of the restaurant may not be beautifully decorated in every corner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peeraset Bu

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Clean restrooms.
- Park your car on the side of the restaurant and walk to the entrance. Avoid parking on the street as cars drive very fast.
- Food is beautifully presented and tastes great – spicy, fresh, clean, and made with fresh ingredients.
- The staff provides good, polite, and helpful service and offers good food recommendations.
- Delicious drinks.
- There's a small stage area where you can sing or hold events.
- The indoor area is air-conditioned, keeping you cool.
sample_reviews_en.author: MAMRITA Mam

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, using fresh, high-quality ingredients. I tried it for the first time and was immediately impressed. The uncle provided excellent service, was friendly, and very skilled. The price is reasonable. The food portions are generous. Parking is available in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sahatsanai Saengchart

sample_reviews_en.text:
The cockles were huge! Great value, very fresh, and delicious.
I haven't eaten cockles this big in a long time.

You can park right in front of the shop. The price is moderate, and it was delicious. I felt it was worth what I paid.

I'll definitely come back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichamon Tipsuwannakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is very delicious. All the food is fresh. Recommended dishes are the squid stir-fried with salted eggs and the sea bass fried in fish sauce. The staff are friendly and kind. They also give you sweet mangoes with fish sauce when you finish eating.
sample_reviews_en.author: 601 43พิชญาภา

sample_reviews_en.text: This seafood restaurant serves incredibly fresh food. The crab curry is absolutely delicious, 100/10! However, some dishes are extremely sweet, such as the mango salad (with fried fish in fish sauce) and the stir-fried fish maw with taro and ginkgo nuts.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natt Tachothai

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and tasty (I thought the food was a bit too sweet). The staff provided excellent service. I was alone but took very good care of every table (if I remember correctly, his name was Uncle Ton). He was very attentive to the customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: BubixPersona

restaurants.name: ลาบศรีสะเกษ เลียบทางรถไฟตลิ่งชัน
restaurants.address:

559 29 Liap Thang Rotfai Taling Chan Rd, Khwaeng Bang Khun Si, Khet Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Review of an Authentic Northeastern Thai Larb Restaurant – Unforgettably Spicy! 🔥🌶️

I stopped by to try this famous larb restaurant in the area, and I can say I wasn't disappointed.

🥗 Som Tum (Papaya Salad) – Intensely flavorful, with a perfect balance of sour, salty, and spicy, just like an authentic Thai papaya salad, with fragrant fermented crab and fish sauce.

🐟 Grilled Fish – Large fish with firm flesh, perfectly grilled, crispy skin, and juicy meat. Served with both Jaew dipping sauce and seafood dipping sauce, it was excellent.

🥣 Tom Khom (Bitter Soup) – This dish is a highlight! The broth is rich and flavorful, with just the right amount of bitterness (for those who can tolerate it), and fragrant with herbs. Served piping hot, it's incredibly satisfying.

📍 Restaurant Atmosphere
Simple, homey style, but very inviting. Friendly service, like eating at a relative's house.

💸 Price
Budget-friendly. You can have a filling meal for less than 100 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Molly ʕ·͡ᴥ·ʔ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant's atmosphere is great, very pleasant to sit in. The food looks and tastes delicious. The service is excellent; the staff are attentive, polite, and caring. The prices are very reasonable, not too expensive, and offer good value for the quality and ambiance.

However, my only complaint is that the food was quite salty, so salty that it numbed my tongue. If they reduced the saltiness a little, I think the food would be even more delicious and perfectly balanced.

I initially considered asking the restaurant to remake it, but I was very hungry and didn't want to waste time, so I ate it. Next time I have the opportunity to return, I will try to ask the restaurant to reduce the saltiness. Overall, I was very impressed with the atmosphere, service, and price. I hope to patronize the restaurant again. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: รินรดา พรมวรากุล

sample_reviews_en.text:
The grilled intestines were extremely tough. It was like they were boiled and then served without any grilling. They were so tough that no one could eat them; we had to take them home. We informed the staff, but they were indifferent. We ordered papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce, normal spicy, but it was so spicy we couldn't eat it. And they didn't put any crab in it, without informing us at all. When we asked, they only told us later that they were out of crab. They didn't change it for us, and said that another staff member forgot to tell us.
*Other things I've mentioned were spicy, but even the normal spicy dishes shouldn't have been this spicy. I've eaten there many times before, but this will definitely be my last time.*
sample_reviews_en.author: Mon Natthamon

sample_reviews_en.text: The food I ordered was terrible. This was my first time using the service. I ordered non-spicy, but what I got was inedible spicy. However, I had to eat it because it was a waste. I'm not a person who can eat spicy food very well. The parentheses after it clearly say "non-spicy." However, the other food was okay. The price was a bit high for some dishes, but I was a little dissatisfied. The service was normal. When I informed the staff that the food was wrong, they didn't react at all. I understand that I had already eaten it, but at the very least, they should have apologized or something rather than being stubborn like this. (I don't have any bad intentions towards the restaurant, just regular customers who come to use the service.) 🙂
sample_reviews_en.author: นฤมล ช่วยสุคนธ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
Responding to the restaurant owner's reply:
Even if it's boiled for hours, you should check how tough it is before serving it to the customer. If three people ate it—not just one person—and said they couldn't chew it, it must be extremely tough. I've attached a picture showing the color; is this what you'd expect from staff grilling it in a charcoal oven? I can say this because I've eaten there many times, and this was the worst. I informed the staff, but they were indifferent and didn't say anything. They didn't offer to grill it again or anything. I'm quite disappointed because I've eaten there quite often, not just once or twice, and the food today was different from previous visits.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mon nattamon

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located on the road parallel to the railway tracks. I drove past late at night and saw it was open. I've seen the name often before, but I'm not sure if there are multiple branches. The food is delicious, and the portions are large, good value for money. It's a shame we were only two people, so we couldn't order much because the dishes were so big we were afraid we wouldn't be able to finish it. It would probably be perfect for 4-5 people. The staff were friendly and the food came out quickly. There's also a cocktail bar, and the view from the roadside parallel to the railway tracks is quite pleasant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jumpoon Accessories

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant was a chance encounter. I happened to be driving along this road and checked Google Maps for good restaurants. I saw good reviews and decided to stop by. The food was delicious, flavorful, and very spicy! And most importantly, the portions were HUGE! I was shocked when the staff served it. Usually, somtum (papaya salad) restaurants serve small portions. Even the dessert bowls were big! It wasn't just the serving size; the portions were generous. The price wasn't expensive, and the staff provided good service. Parking was limited, possibly due to road construction.
sample_reviews_en.author: นนฑพร ปิ่นวิเศษ (แนน)

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located on the road parallel to the Taling Chan railway line, making parking quite difficult. They serve delicious Northeastern Thai food. Recommended dishes include: Steamed Bamboo Shoots with Pork / Tamarind Salad / Papaya Salad with Crab and Fermented Fish Sauce / Spicy Pork Tendon Soup / Chicken Curry with Egg Clusters / and the must-try Traditional Glass Noodle Salad. However, the Jaew Hon (spicy dipping sauce) could be a bit more flavorful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiraprapa Srithong

restaurants.name: Bangna SaemaeulGamjatang 방나
restaurants.address:

เหนือ Bangna SAEMAEULGAMJATANG 방나 Bizzoเลขที่58 อาคารบิซโซ ชั้นที่2 Bizzo 58 บางนา/บางนา ถนนเทพารัตน Bang Na Nuea, บางนา Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was very inconvenient when I visited the Sukhumvit area because there was no parking, so I'm glad there is a parking lot in the Bang Na area.

The bone broth soup is so delicious that it's a place I find myself returning to.😋 The bones crumble easily, so I found myself silently focusing intently on picking the meat off the bone.👍

I also ordered the sundae gukbap (blood sausage soup with rice). First off, I was very happy to see that salted shrimp paste was served with it. The sundae was hot, and I thought it would have looked like a larger portion and been easier to eat if it had been sliced ​​just a little thinner. However, I was a bit disappointed that there was no salt. Nevertheless, I enjoyed it with ssamjang (dipping sauce) in the Gyeongsang-do style.

Above all, the bottled beer here is served incredibly cold. It's almost frozen cold.🍺
sample_reviews_en.author: Nikoniko Thai (니코니코 타이)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Gamjatang Korean Pork Rib Soup: The taste is just like in Korea!
Because the owner is Korean.
I first tried this dish in Korea and loved it.
I haven't found many restaurants in Thailand that sell this dish, so I started searching for one in Bangkok and found this place.
I've eaten here several times but never reviewed it.
Today, I finally decided to write a review.
As I mentioned, the owner is Korean.
Most of the customers are also Korean.
The staff are lovely, attentive, and remember even small details about you.
If you haven't tried it yet, you should!
Even without flying to Korea, I can satisfy my cravings by eating at this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sayaporn Srisoonthorn

sample_reviews_en.text: First off, it's delicious. The meat separates well from the bone, and the seasoning is good. I'm not sure about the fried rice, but I think it would be good to remove the corn from the steamed egg and focus on the pure flavor. I lived nearby for nearly three years but this is my first time visiting this area. It's nice. There is a 7% surcharge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Goo Yang [Peter]

sample_reviews_en.text:
The gamjatang was clean-tasting with no unpleasant odor from the bones, and the broth was moderately rich, making it great to eat with rice.

The sundae was chewy yet mild in flavor, and the combination with the liver was quite good. Overall, it was a nice place for a clean meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: 송우준

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork soup is at the level of a famous Korean restaurant. The gamjatang has a slightly light broth and is quite salty. The radish kimchi is also delicious. It seems like a place frequented by local Koreans. Delivery or
sample_reviews_en.author: P U (ggeagzzang)

sample_reviews_en.text: The store was clean and there was no meaty smell at all, and the food was delicious. The portion was quite large, so I couldn't finish it all and had it to go. It's nice to eat Korean food after only eating Thai food.
sample_reviews_en.author: 김효연

sample_reviews_en.text: In Thailand, I often visit this place whenever I miss home. Their Gamja-tang is made with real pork backbones, and that deep, spicy umami flavor from the kimchi is just unforgettable. It’s the ultimate soul food
sample_reviews_en.author: hyoung bo shim

sample_reviews_en.text: The portions were larger and the food was delicious. The meat was very tender. The soup was fragrant; it was my first time trying it, but the food was really good. I'll definitely come again next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: marton lancelot

restaurants.name: Adam O Adam
restaurants.address:

185 Sukhumvit 81 Alley, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Adamoadam is a hidden gem in Bangkok that every burger lover needs to try! I ordered the Sucuk Burger (Anatolian sausage), and it was an absolute flavor bomb, juicy and perfectly spiced. The fries on the side were crispy and delicious, rounding out a fantastic meal.

Beyond the food, the experience was top-notch. The restaurant is tucked away in an alley, making it feel like a secret spot only the lucky ones know about. The owner was super friendly, welcoming, and clearly passionate about great food.

Highly recommend checking this place out, you won’t regret it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Minnie Pham

sample_reviews_en.text: Found this hidden gem, Pizza Adam Adam, and it completely exceeded my expectations! I ordered the classic Margherita pizza, and it was incredible. The crust has the perfect Neapolitan-style char—crispy on the outside, airy and chewy on the inside. The tomato sauce is fresh and tangy, perfectly balanced with generous melted mozzarella and fragrant basil. Plus, it's 100% Halal certified, making it a fantastic spot for everyone. Highly recommended for all pizza lovers!
sample_reviews_en.author: Gardenian

sample_reviews_en.text: Awesome, delicious, fresh, happiness, casual comfortable...... Comfortable until your belly is stuffed with his Amazing cooking..... I am full now. That pizza in this pictures was 1 of 4.... my belly is a bulging and I feel like my shorts have shrunk 4 sizes in the last one and a half hours. Everything he and his lovely wife cook is just full of love and deliciousness. Easy access from the Onnut BTS....Tell him Morten and Flano sent you. 😁 😋😋😊🙏🌺
sample_reviews_en.author: John Flano

sample_reviews_en.text: The first time ordering here we got steak and it was not only amazing but the best I’ve had in Bangkok. We were eating family style and everyone at the table voted to order a second one. Today I had the pizza and it was also delicious with surprisingly great crust. The comments about the kind owners, a husband and wife, are all true. Highly recommended and remember, this restaurant is located at RK’s Food Garden 81.
sample_reviews_en.author: Martin B

sample_reviews_en.text:
Adam O Adam has exquisite premium steaks and burgers. My personal favorites (Sucuk burger and the New Zealand beef steak) are featured in the images.
Aside from the reasonably priced, high-quality food, you'll encounter memorable customer service, the friendliest yet most professional I've ever encountered.  Thank you, Adam O Adam 😃.

I highly recommend it to every hungry, fellow meatlovers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeerinan Pipatkulthana

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a burger 3 days ago and it was brilliant, tasty, textured and awesome presentation so I went again today 8th May and I had the signature pizza with beef and chicken, I have to say I have never ever had a better or tastier pizza in my life, the service is awesome and the food matches the service, would recommend to anyone, p.s for the Muslims it is all halal food. I am from the u.k.
sample_reviews_en.author: breathe again

sample_reviews_en.text: A business that deserves a 10 out of 10 in every aspect... You can find clean, delicious, and healthy food at reasonable prices. Plus, the pleasant conversation and friendly service are a bonus 😅 And let's not forget the complimentary tea... Wishing you abundant and prosperous earnings, Ethem abi!
sample_reviews_en.author: Fatih Yılmaz

sample_reviews_en.text:
This food court offers affordable Italian food. The pasta tastes almost like mine.

They're currently offering a 100 baht discount on medium-sized pizzas. I had a Margherita with blue cheese; the pasta and cheese were delicious.

Open until midnight, a great place to go after 10 pm.
sample_reviews_en.author: Huang Keiko

restaurants.name: จอมพล หมูกระทะ สนามบินน้ำ
restaurants.address:

2 Soi Nonthaburi 40, Tambon Tha Sai, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
✨ Atmosphere
This restaurant has a great atmosphere, perfect for chilling out. If you go during cooler weather, I recommend sitting in the outdoor area for the best vibe. There's a cool breeze and live music to enjoy.
After the live music ends, the restaurant mainly plays songs from the 2000s, especially songs from the Kamikaze label.

🍖 Food
This is an à la carte restaurant, not a buffet. The ingredients are fresh; the pork, beef, and seafood look clean and of good quality. The dipping sauces are excellent, with both regular and fermented fish sauce options, plus fresh lime for you to customize your sauce.

💰 Price
The price is quite high compared to the amount of food you receive. If you expect to eat a lot like in a buffet, you might need to order several dishes. However, considering the quality of the ingredients and the taste, it's acceptable.

Summary 🥢
Suitable for those who want to eat quality-focused Korean BBQ, aren't big buffet eaters, enjoy 2000s music, and want a chill atmosphere. If you don't mind the price and parking, it's a restaurant worth trying at least once!
sample_reviews_en.author: Narueporn Roopmok

sample_reviews_en.text: The Thai-style BBQ pork is delicious. The ingredients are fresh, the pork is tender, the bacon is good, and the dipping sauce is spicy and well-balanced. The grill heats up quickly, so you don't have to wait long. The restaurant has a comfortable and friendly atmosphere. The prices are reasonable and offer good value. There's convenient parking. It's perfect for coming with friends or family. You'll definitely have a delicious and satisfying meal! ✨💖
sample_reviews_en.author: bear babe

sample_reviews_en.text: We went on a Friday evening and it was crowded. There was live music too. Personally, I think the place is chill and perfect for enjoying chrysanthemum tea. We tried the BBQ pork, fermented pork ribs, and stir-fried instant noodles. Overall, it was delicious. There are three types of dipping sauces that you can mix and match to create tasty combinations. The restaurant has a parking lot just past the restaurant on the left, which is very convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sawanya Boonrawd

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good service.
Good atmosphere.
The BBQ set was delicious; everything was great, especially the squid which I usually dislike but still found tasty.
The grill was spacious and allowed for plenty of vegetables.
Parking is available right in front of the restaurant.
I asked the staff what time they close and they said 10 PM, but it depends on how many customers leave. Very impressed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Peachhr - Insurance Instructor นักวางแผนประกัน

sample_reviews_en.text: The ingredients are high quality and the food is delicious. The dipping sauce is the best I've ever had at any BBQ restaurant. The staff provides attentive service. I've eaten at two branches with my family and everyone loved it. I was impressed with both the staff and the owner. The atmosphere is great, perfect for socializing and relaxing after work.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patcharin Pulgasam

sample_reviews_en.text: We went as a group of three and ordered the "Pork Platter" for three people, plus two side dishes. It was just the right amount to fill us up. The food was pretty good, and the dipping sauces were delicious. There was live music, and importantly, the roof could be opened and closed when sitting outdoors, and there was also an air-conditioned area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apple Sangnapa

sample_reviews_en.text: The Thai-style BBQ pork is excellent. The dipping sauce is superb, the meat is fresh and clean, and the staff are lovely and very attentive. The atmosphere is chill, with both air-conditioned and outdoor seating options. If you go during the rainy season, there are quite a few mosquitoes, so I recommend bringing insect repellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: PTM SS

sample_reviews_en.text: The spicy salads and papaya salad are delicious, with a strong, flavorful taste. The grilled meats are of good quality. The only thing is the dipping sauce; it would be even better if it were spicier. The restaurant atmosphere is nice and relaxing. The staff are lovely and provide good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: YAO Jiratt

restaurants.name: GING GAI - กิ่งไก่ สาขารามคำแหง 49
restaurants.address:

2171 Ramkhamhaeng Rd, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was incredibly delicious! It was my first time trying it. The seafood yellow noodles had incredibly fresh shrimp and squid. I have to say, it's very difficult to find a restaurant in Thailand that serves such fresh squid these days. The basil stir-fry was perfectly seasoned, and the restaurant was attentive enough to ask about my preferred level of spiciness.
As for the fried chicken, I was happier eating it without the gold leaf topping. I know the restaurant uses food-grade gold leaf, which isn't harmful, but I still felt uncomfortable eating it without it. I wouldn't have known, otherwise I would have told them not to sprinkle it on.
The restaurant was clean and simply decorated. The staff were very polite and provided excellent service. Parking is available in the alley next to the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: CoCo Glam

sample_reviews_en.text:
Getting There: The restaurant is located on Ramkhamhaeng Road, near Soi Ramkhamhaeng 49. It's accessible by private car, public bus, or Khlong Saen Saep canal boat (Wat Thep Lila pier).

Atmosphere: The restaurant is large and spacious, with both indoor and outdoor seating. The atmosphere is comfortable and friendly, perfect for dining with family or friends.

Food: King Kai Buffet offers a wide variety of dishes, including fried chicken, fried shrimp, fried squid, à la carte dishes, som tum (papaya salad), spicy salads, and much more. Their fried chicken is a signature dish, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, with a delicious flavor. They also offer a wide selection of desserts and drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jingjai Review

sample_reviews_en.text: May I revise my review? I consider this constructive criticism. I'd like to see more attention paid to the food, both in taste and quality, before serving. For example, the stir-fried basil noodles should be dry, not soggy. The minced pork with garlic rice was too dry. The pork bone soup also had the issues I mentioned, and since it's served in a hot pot, it should have a flame to keep it warm. Finally, rewarding customers with a 5-star review is fine, but you shouldn't wait for them to take pictures to see if they've reviewed it before they've even finished eating. If you're going to give a reward, you should be willing to accept it after the customer has finished their meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: KHON PacharA

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fried chicken was incredibly delicious! Crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, with a perfectly balanced Northeastern Thai flavor. The papaya salad was tasty and easy to eat. 100/10!

The fried squid was also incredibly delicious! 100/10! Perfect for snacking or as an appetizer.

All the staff were lovely, providing excellent service. They were polite, cheerful, and took great care of customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Llws MT

sample_reviews_en.text: The Thai papaya salad was full of flavor and delicious, a must-order dish. The tender Mae Sai pork was also excellent; I ordered it again and again. The pork was tender, grilled to perfection with a unique aroma, and there were so many dipping sauces to choose from! Overall, the food arrived quickly, the staff were friendly and provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: AUM VK

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes great, the service is amazing and exceeds expectations! The owner is also lovely. The photos you take here are Instagram-worthy, but the prices are incredibly affordable (only tens of baht!). ❤️ The vanilla toast is only tens of baht but comes in a huge portion! Excellent 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Statice

sample_reviews_en.text: The portions are huge! There's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, and the prices are very reasonable. The restaurant is air-conditioned and comfortable, and the food tastes delicious. I really enjoyed it. Next time I'm in Ramkhamhaeng, I'll definitely come back here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: นิต อรุณนี

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered crispy chicken rice with northern-style sauce. The fried chicken was well-cooked, the sauce was rich, and the rice was fragrant. I was very impressed.
The tissue paper with the cute chicken print was adorable.
Next time I'll try the fried papaya salad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jimmy Asawa

restaurants.name: PERB
restaurants.address:

ตึก A, One Ari, ชั้น4, 9/2 Soi Ari 1, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Jaew (spicy dipping sauce) and Som Tum (papaya salad) restaurant in Ari has a nice, air-conditioned atmosphere, perfect for a meal with friends or for taking foreigners. The restaurant and food look clean and well-prepared. Reservations are recommended during peak meal times.

- Australian Beef with Fat: Grilled well, some pieces were a bit chewy. The sauce was delicious!
- Australian Beef Som Tum with Vermicelli: Spicy and flavorful, the noodles were chewy and delicious. The vegetables were fresh and crispy, and there was a generous amount of beef. Delicious!
- Jaew Pork Set: The Jaew Hon (spicy dipping sauce) pork soup was delicious and spicy, but not suitable for those who can't handle spicy food. A good amount of pork was included.
- Grilled Sticky Rice (forgot to take a picture): Waited a bit while for this. It was good for cooling down the spiciness. Crispy on the outside, still soft on the inside.
sample_reviews_en.author: happytummy

sample_reviews_en.text: The upscale restaurant for Esaan food, setting on the rooftop of community mall in Ari.  They serving authentic Esaan Raw meat like Goi and Soi Ju, this kind of food you can find only on street-food restaurant or real local Esaan place. Food here is real nice and varies on Esaan food. The recommended food here is Goi Nuea and Som Tum Lao with Khao Jii, Goi Nuea is spicy raw beef salad this one is authentic Esaan food, you can taste the flavor of meat with chili and lime, it's very strong in flavor and delicious.  Larb Ped and Tom Zaap ( Spicy Esaan Soup ) is also recommend and delicious dish. The grilled beef or Crying Tiger is ordinary, it's quite hard to chew and not that flavorful. PERB is worth to visit place to enjoy Esaan food in Ari
sample_reviews_en.author: mrjoey15

sample_reviews_en.text:
PERB Thai Isan Cuisine is on the 4th floor, One Ari Building.
That comes with a roof top city view on the 4th floor

Polite and good service Staff.
The food has rich flavor.
A little high price but it's worth the price compared to the quality and taste we get.
I love all menu that order today.

Menu:
Charcoal Grilled Pork Neck⭐️: Tender pork, fragrant grilled but a bit salty, must be eaten with sticky rice to go well together.
Papaya Salad with Lao Noodles ⭐️⭐️: Chewy noodles go well with the rich papaya salad sauce.  Will be quite spicy for people who don't eat spicy.
Spicy Pork Cartilage Soup ⭐️⭐️:The pork is very tender and fragrant with spices.
sample_reviews_en.author: mangdanoi zzz

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sad experience.
Ran out of gas stove for the hot pot in a friday night (how are you operating your restaurant?) and only tell us after we ordered. Should have let us know once we arrive. isn't it your main signature dish?
Took very long time to serve food and did not care to bring out utensils together, letting us stare at the sidedish without rice and plate for a long time.
The light bulb keep flashing almost the entire time and turned dim at one point. Yet, no attempt made to change the bulb.
Taste fine but not good enough or have large portion enough for the price.
Could have done much better, compared to othe restaurants in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: P J

sample_reviews_en.text:
Superb!

One of my favorite Isan restaurants in town.

The flavor profile and consistency were outstanding and on point.

Came here many times and was never disappointed with the food and service.

The majority of the Somtam / Papaya salad was excellent.

Grilled chicken was tasty.

Hotpot and other kind of soup was delicious.

There is not much to complain about except that all the beef menus are chewy.

Highly recommend this place, it the taste of real Isan food, and no turn down the flavor.

Service was great, and I paid for parking in the nearby parking garage.
sample_reviews_en.author: Awaybutnotalone “Awaybutnotalone”

sample_reviews_en.text: Ran into this place by accident but honestly best mistake of the day. Food was amazing, grilled pork melts in your mouth, fried rice was nice and smoky, gotta try the "tum sen lek" spiciness and flavours come through perfectly together (please note normal spice is 8 chillies). Also just tried their new "kanom jean dish" definitely recommend the crab curry one. 100% will come back 😀 (entry is on the top floor of the building)
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrick Apilukpuvadol

sample_reviews_en.text:
A premium experience for Thai Spicy hotpot, served in styles of soup—all of them are for spicy tongue.

Meat and vegetables, Papaya salad and many more main dishes on the list are well prepared.

It locates on the stair-only 3rd floor, offering good views at window seat. Price is undeniably higher.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thee Theerapat

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best Esarn food restaurant to try and definitely will repeat! All the ingredients were fresh and the taste of each dish was top notch. Located in Ari with easy access to BTS line. The menu has a large variety of dishes and drinks to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mo Limlek

restaurants.name: Chao Xiang Restaurant ( 潮香大酒楼 ) - The Travellers Ratchada
restaurants.address:

The Travellers Hotel 255 19 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chinese restaurant near MRT Ratchada
-Guitar Duck: A highly recommended and worthwhile dish, currently on promotion for 600 baht, suitable for 4-5 people. The duck skin is crispy, the meat is tender, and it tastes great with some kind of dipping sauce.
-Hoi Jor (Chinese sausage): Good flavor, another recommended dish for those who like Chinese food.
-Fried Mantou (steamed buns): Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, very well made, perfect to order as an accompaniment to other dishes.
-Fish Maw Soup: The taste is rather ordinary, not outstanding, but a decent option if you like this type of dish.
-There are special promotions including a free fruit smoothie, a discount coupon for a coffee shop, and a Thai massage coupon. Unfortunately, I received the coupons but haven't had a chance to use them yet.
-The restaurant is clean and the staff provides excellent service.
-Food prices do not include VAT and service charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nunn Nopth

sample_reviews_en.text: Recent reviews say the restaurant's service is terrible, and we experienced it right away! So our mood wasn't great from the start. When ordering, they kept trying to recommend the buffet, but since we were a family gathering, we naturally wanted to order our favorite dishes. Unfortunately, they didn't have their signature dishes—no curry crab, no mantis shrimp—and kept saying we needed to make reservations in advance. Is this still a high-end restaurant? Their glory days are over; they should just focus on improving their service and food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicole

sample_reviews_en.text: The food wasn't bad, but the price wasn't suitable for family gatherings; it seemed more like it was priced for foreign tourists or club-goers. The non-private dining rooms were too cramped and the dining environment was uncomfortable. The fried sea bass wasn't greasy and was quite delicious, while the shredded chicken was so salty it was almost inedible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Janice Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: I should mention that I haven't actually dined there yet. I plan to go next time because I saw the restaurant while staying at the hotel above it. I found the staff at the hotel to be very helpful, but the restaurant manager had terrible service mind and no manners whatsoever. I'm deducting stars for the service, focusing solely on the manager's behavior.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wissuda U.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is definitely one of the best Chinese restaurants in Thailand!
