The atmosphere is modern Chinese style, comfortable seating, perfect for families or celebrations with friends. The food tastes great, the ingredients are fresh, and it's served quickly – no long waits! Plus, the staff are very attentive. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: ARIYA NGAMKHAM

sample_reviews_en.text: The roast duck has crispy skin and tender meat, and the wraps are incredibly fragrant! 🦆 The pickled cabbage and sea bass is fresh, tender, and boneless, with a tangy and appetizing flavor. 🐟 Fresh ingredients, authentic taste, and great value for money—definitely worth coming back again and again! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: suphitcha laokamnoed

sample_reviews_en.text: I've driven past this place many times and wanted to try it. Today I finally did, and the food was quite delicious. The taste was really good, and the prices weren't too high, just average. We were 8 people, and it came out to about 600+ baht per person. Great value! You should try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thannyachat Boonsathianwarasin

sample_reviews_en.text: The dim sum buffet is a buy 4 get 3 free offer, costing just over 600 baht per person. The food is delicious and worth the price, but service can be slow, so you might have to wait a bit. There are private rooms available, suitable for large groups, and convenient parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chusclert

restaurants.name: Sava Thai Thai Flavour
restaurants.address:

ชั้น M 622 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stopped at SAVA for a relaxed lunch and were pleasantly surprised. The restaurant itself is beautifully designed, with elegant blue-and-white décor that feels fresh, stylish and distinctly Thai. It is a lovely setting to escape the bustle of the shopping centre.

We ordered the Tom Kha Gai and Green Chicken Curry with jasmine rice. Both dishes arrived beautifully presented and piping hot. The Tom Kha Gai was rich, creamy and fragrant, with a wonderful balance of coconut milk, herbs and gentle spice. The Green Curry was equally enjoyable, packed with flavour and made with fresh ingredients. The rice was perfectly cooked and complemented the curries very well.

Service was friendly, efficient and attentive without being intrusive. The restaurant was spotless, comfortable and offered a welcoming atmosphere throughout our visit.

Considering the quality of the food, the attractive surroundings we felt it offered excellent value for money. A very enjoyable lunch and a place we would happily return to when visiting Bangkok again. Highly recommended for anyone looking for modern Thai cuisine in a beautiful setting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Y M

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sava Modern Thai Flavour Emporium is located in Emporium shopping mall, in the zone near the brand-name shops.
The atmosphere is nice, the restaurant is quiet and comfortable, and the decor is beautiful. Food prices include 7% VAT and a 10% service charge.

The prices are quite high, but the crab meat is very fresh and tastes amazing with the seafood dipping sauce – very flavorful and delicious! The quality matches the price; it's delicious, worth the money, and the service is excellent. The place is beautiful, the ambiance is lovely, and the staff are cheerful. It's definitely worth the price for the delicious food and great service. I will definitely eat here again if I have the chance.

Pros:
• Excellent service and impressive staff smiles.
• High-quality tea.
• Delicious desserts, especially the cakes – truly amazing!

Cons:

• The restaurant is a bit hidden, but its location in the shopping zone is convenient.

#Delicious #100Delicious #MillionDelicious
Sava Modern Thai Flavour Emporium
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr.Kittipon Prangkaew (Jaded)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sava is one of my favorite restaurants in Bangkok. It’s a great place to gather for a meal with family or a large group of friends. The atmosphere is beautiful and not crowded.

In addition to having a wide variety of dishes to choose from, you might have to hold back because it’s impossible to try everything. They also offer many desserts that I really love.

Today, we enjoyed a relaxed meal and conversation, finishing with dessert without feeling rushed to leave, as it wasn’t too busy. I highly recommend coming here to enjoy delicious food in a comfortable setting.

The staff provide excellent service and are very friendly—it was truly impressive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Goi Susa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Second visit to Sava, a French-style modern Thai restaurant.
Last time I tried Marco Polo tea and desserts at Mariage Fréres. Today I tried the crab cakes that Jack Ma ate on the street. The waiter suggested I order some Thai jasmine rice, which cost only 5 RMB [laughing]. But I already prepared Japanese rice porridge at home yesterday.

I just can't resist the temptation [laughing].

Don't be fixated on street stalls, especially the ones with long queues.
It's too hot 🥵 [laughing][laughing][laughing][laughing][laughing][laughing] The 17% service charge isn't a big deal. You're the most precious thing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julie WENG

sample_reviews_en.text:
MARIAGE FRÈRES tea is available, and as expected, it never disappoints in terms of quality. The Mango Passion Fruit blend is excellent—the slight tartness perfectly balances the sweetness, cutting through any richness. I was able to enjoy my afternoon tea with dessert in a very peaceful setting. Highly recommended!

Pros:

•	Excellent service
•	High-quality tea
•	Desserts are decent

Cons:

•	None that come to mind
sample_reviews_en.author: ルーシャスLucius

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stopped by for takeout. The restaurant was quiet and comfortable, with nice decor. Prices include 7% VAT and a 10% service charge.

I ordered crab meat rice to take home. The price was quite high, but the crab meat was very fresh. It tasted great with the seafood dipping sauce; the sauce was excellent, very flavorful and delicious.
I'll try eating at the restaurant next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: attpocari

sample_reviews_en.text:
The interior design looks very inviting and was one of the reasons we chose this restaurant.

The service was friendly and the food arrived quickly.

Overall, the food was unfortunately only mediocre and didn't impress us.

Furthermore, the restaurant's location makes the food unnecessarily expensive.

Next time, I would definitely choose a different restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ben Ten

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is beautifully decorated and located quite far away. It's suitable for 4-5 people. If you come with more people, seating might be a bit difficult.

The food is delicious, but the wait is very long. Each dish takes about 25-35 minutes or more to prepare. I wouldn't recommend it if you're hungry.

The staff is friendly, but the food is slow.
sample_reviews_en.author: Putt Te

restaurants.name: Prim
restaurants.address:

31 Ekkamai 2 Alley, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Prim is an old address hiding in plain sight off Ekkamai Soi 2. I’m told it’s 66 years old as of January 2026, and it feels like the sort of place that has stopped needing to prove anything. The room is a Thai sitting pavilion with air-con - double-height beams, a pierced-timber gallery - but the table is what keeps you there. Wing-bean salad arrives crisp and ridged, held together by a coconut-milk dressing that smooths heat and lime into something you can keep eating. Baked rice with minced pork and Chinese black olives goes dark and briny, then wakes up with cashews, chilli and a hard squeeze of lime. Fried prawn cakes are pure texture: crackle, bounce, plum sauce. The Thai-Chinese comfort lane stays open with fish maw soup and stir-fried crab with curry powder, and when you want a bigger swing, river prawns turn up in a garlic-heavy tamarind glaze with the best richness still hiding in the head.
sample_reviews_en.author: Loo Yeo

sample_reviews_en.text: Since it was right in front of my hotel, I didn't want to venture far, so I went. It's a restaurant renovated from a house. It was dinnertime, but there weren't any customers. I thought I'd come to the wrong place, but they were already inside, so I didn't feel like leaving, so I ordered food. I think I waited for over 15 minutes. There was no music, no TV, and I sat alone in the silence. I could hear the occasional cough from the closed kitchen door. The food was average. I asked for the bill, and they just scribbled it down on a piece of paper. One crab fried rice, a Morning Glory, and a bottle of Chang Beer. I think it came to around 20,000 won, including VAT. They gave me a lot of coins in change, and among them, I saw one I'd never seen before. It wasn't a baht, but a "candy" coin. This place is very considerate to its foreign guests.
sample_reviews_en.author: jinwoo park

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the restaurant I ate at most frequently during my recent trip to Bangkok. While they don't serve luxurious ingredients, they serve traditional, simple, and delicious Thai food at relatively low prices. The gentle flavors are a distinctive feature. The staff didn't speak English well, but they kindly communicated with me using gestures. 😊 I ended up ordering too much on my first visit, but they were able to help me out with gestures, which was very helpful. The restaurant is beautifully maintained in the style of a traditional Thai house, and it's very relaxing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hi Mi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Within walking distance from the station, about 10 minutes.

Located in a quiet residential area.

A renowned restaurant housed in a renovated old house, and as rumored, everything was absolutely delicious.

The yakisoba and shrimp fried rice are sure to be loved even by small children. For a family of five, including two beers and juice, it only cost 400 baht per person, even when we were completely full. Excellent value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hideto Shirai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Rather empty on a Thursday night but their service are definitely not slow.

Food comes very quickly even when they said the fish will need 20min to prepare. Everything is very yummy and we love the fish on the pan.

I think the menu is not extremely local so if you are less adventurous, this would be a good place to have a meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: T Y

sample_reviews_en.text:
Highly recommend the curry crab! The tom yum soup is also a must-try! The stir-fried vegetables are perfectly cooked with wok hei (wok aroma)!

I suggest ordering white rice! All the dishes go very well with rice!

The only thing I don't recommend is the moon shrimp cakes; they're too thin and not as good as the ones in Taiwan!
sample_reviews_en.author: Richard Chen

sample_reviews_en.text:
The preserved olive fried rice is delicious, and the various baked rice dishes are also tasty.

Prim is a hidden Thai restaurant in a side street off Ekkamai. I used to have dinner there often when I worked in the area.

The food is delicious, the prices aren't too expensive, and the atmosphere is quite calm and private.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boonwirat Thiemwongkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
An authentic hidden gem Thai restaurant.
The service is great and the food is outstanding.
This Thai restaurant serves incredibly delicious dishes with perfectly balanced flavors. It truly deserves a Michelin star, even more so than some restaurants that have received it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Belle Xu

restaurants.name: Wanyen Dessert
restaurants.address:

220/1 Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sweet Dessert Shop, Pradipat Road
The atmosphere is like a shophouse, with about 5-6 tables.
Free self-service water.
I ordered the Sweet Noodle Soup with Toppings (THB 50).
The sweet noodles were packed with toppings and served in longan syrup. The noodles weren't mushy, and the longan syrup was sweet and fragrant, not overly sweet. The preserved ingredients, like lotus root and jujube, were well-prepared, chewy, and not too sweet. Unfortunately, I was full before I could try anything else.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boat ANRPS

sample_reviews_en.text:
The weather is getting hotter every day, so I need something to cool me down. I'm craving shaved ice from Wanyen Dessert - Pradipat, Saphan Khwai. They have it! And they have tons of toppings. They don't just have shaved ice either; their coconut milk is so fragrant. I could easily eat 3, 4, or 5 bowls! It's so hot, let's order some to cool down!

And the steamed dumplings from the street vendor are so good!
sample_reviews_en.author: Freeze Kiwii

sample_reviews_en.text: This dessert shop is located on Pradipat Road. They offer a wide variety of choices, all delicious and enjoyable. The prices are moderate and reasonable for the portion sizes. Parking is available in the Green Pradipat Market for 10 baht per hour, which is likely more convenient than parking on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanaporn K.

sample_reviews_en.text: The bok kia (a type of Thai dessert) wasn't tasty at all. The texture was quite strange; the noodles weren't chewy at all. It was more like eating white rice noodles in a Thai dessert called lod chong. It would probably be tastier if the recipe was adjusted.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mai Naetima

sample_reviews_en.text: For those on a keto or low-carb diet who crave a rich, fragrant dessert, try our fresh coconut flesh and job's tears dessert, topped with pure coconut milk (no added dairy or syrup). This will help reduce your cravings for sweets, sugar, and carbohydrates.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saja Phiangdin

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is hidden gem. Any dessert in coconut milk are very tasty because of coconut milk.
Worth the price but do not expect any fancy vibe because it is norm local shop.

It is just local dessert with cheap price&good quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pop Hong

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here many times. The water chestnut jelly, coconut milk dessert, and lod chong (Thai dessert with rice noodles in coconut milk) are delicious. The coconut milk is homemade and very fragrant with palm sugar.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nunthiporn Phanbanlaem

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a standard shaved ice shop with a wide variety of toppings. It's another good spot in the Pradiphat area for a dessert after a meal. The shop isn't big, but it can sometimes get crowded.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prakit

restaurants.name: Khao Soi in Kala (Northern Food)
restaurants.address:

1345 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Khao Soi in a Coconut Shell
A Northern Thai restaurant located on Charoen Nakhon 21.

- Hang Le (Northern Thai Pork Curry) 80 baht. Very delicious, but not fatty. Those who like fatty pork belly will be disappointed, but if you're health-conscious and prefer less fat, you'll love it. The pork is also very tender. I thought that because it's not fatty, it would be tough or dry, but it wasn't at all. It was very tender. The flavor is well-balanced, not too sweet or salty. It's perfect mixed with rice.
- Larb Kua (Northern Thai Stir-fried Minced Meat) 70 baht. Delicious! Not the sweet version. Not too much makhaen (Sichuan peppercorn), which prevents it from tasting greasy. It has liver, intestines, and pork skin – everything!
- Kua Ho (Northern Thai Stir-fried Mixed Vegetables) 80 baht. This was an unusual dish; the first time I've ever tasted anything like it. It was sweet and had a lot of vegetables: snake gourd, long beans, baby corn, eggplant, bamboo shoots, and edible flowers. Personally, I didn't really like the flavor; it was too sweet.

You should come and try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thananont Krittayawiwat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cute little shop serving Northern Thai Cuisine!

I popped in and they were closing up the shop but they asked what I would like and told me to have a seat.

Based on other reviews and staff recommendation, I had the Beef Khao Soi. The broth was delicious and well balanced…. all I added was a squeeze of lime.

The beef was literally falling apart in my mouth as it had been cooked perfectly. There was a generous amount of crunchy noodles on top and soft egg noodles below. It came with a side plate of onions and some delicious pickled vegetable.

I also enjoyed a rosella juice with dinner which was tart with the right amount of sweet…. I’m not a big fan of sweet and I thoroughly enjoyed it!

I’m staying opposite side of the river but I would definitely walk back again for more!
sample_reviews_en.author: Forest CPB

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes delicious and suits my palate. The price is reasonable for the portion sizes and location. Those who eat little might find it filling, but even as a big eater, I still felt like I got a lot. The staff are very friendly and polite. The atmosphere might be a bit cramped, but that's understandable considering it's only one shop unit away. I often order the Nam Ngiao (Northern Thai noodle soup) because it's delicious, the Khao Soi (Northern Thai curry noodle soup) is tasty, the Hung Lay (Northern Thai curry noodle soup) isn't overly sweet, and the Khua Ho (Northern Thai stir-fried pork with herbs and spices) is slightly spicy.
sample_reviews_en.author: natnat

sample_reviews_en.text:
I didn't come for Khao Soi, I came for other Northern Thai dishes. I wouldn't recommend them.
Everything seems microwaved. The pork is tough like it's been microwaved. The taste of the food is average to good, but the meat is so tough it's inedible and not tasty. However, I'll give it points for cleanliness.
In short, just come for the Khao Soi. Don't bother with anything else.

(Khao-soi is good, but the other food feels like it's been microwaved. You can just feel the texture.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Sin Wuu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Terrible service. They're taking advantage of consumers. The prices are exorbitant.
I ordered through Grab, and the price was 135 baht per dish, even though it was a special order. They didn't even make the full meal; they only gave me this much. I suspect they raised the price because of the government's co-payment scheme. They're clearly trying to exploit consumers and make full profit.
May their business decline if they continue like this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kuro Boy

sample_reviews_en.text:
I bought Khao Soi with beef to take home... The beef was tender and soft, in very large pieces, and there was a generous amount of it. The soup was delicious, just the right amount of spiciness, and the coconut milk wasn't too thick or too thin 😋 Great value for less than 100 baht.

The Sai Ua (Northern Thai sausage) was also delicious and not fatty, but I forgot to take a picture before it was all gone 😅
sample_reviews_en.author: Charmy L

sample_reviews_en.text:
this place served khao soi noodle.
a traditional noodle from northern thailand. you can choose between chicken or beef.
I ordered beef one. It was very good.
the beef was well cooked. the soup was very yummy and tasty.

the place was a little bit disappointed. quite diry and not well organized.

the staff was a little careless and some time went missing from country

the price was ok and reasonable
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanin Rungwanichsukanon

sample_reviews_en.text: I first learned about this place through Grab Food and then ate at the actual restaurant, and I can say that Khao Soi is best eaten at the restaurant, not delivered! This place isn't very well known because of its location, but the Khao Soi here is one of the best I've had in Bangkok! It's not spicy, so it's easy to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Staff Terry's Cafe

restaurants.name: เช็งซิมอี๊ ห้วยขวาง
restaurants.address:

773, 23 Pracha Rat Bamphen Rd, Samsen Nok, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Have you ever read the feedback? Is there any training for the staff? Does anyone oversee how the staff behave? Because this is the first time I've been this angry.

There was an extra item on my menu, so I brought the bowl back to inform them that they had made an extra order that I hadn't placed. The staff member accused me of ordering it, even though I only asked my mother, "Mom, do you want two bowls of mixed dessert?"
They stood there pointing at me, it was so frustrating. We argued like that until everyone in the restaurant was looking. Their coworkers had to apologize on their behalf. The person who started it all just stormed off with a furious expression, completely uncaring. I definitely won't be using their services again. My favorite restaurant is ruined by staff with such a bad attitude.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ixyourzo

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to buy takeout on July 26th at 8:30 PM. The female employee provided terrible service. My boyfriend ordered water chestnut jelly, and the employee asked what kind of syrup he wanted. He said coconut milk, and then she asked if it was fresh or boiled coconut milk. My boyfriend turned to ask me which type he wanted, and we had already decided on boiled coconut milk, but before we could order it, she had already scooped out the fresh coconut milk. I don't understand why she asked if she didn't want an answer. And when it came time to pay, what was going on? She mumbled under her breath, and I had to ask twice to make sure she said "100 baht." If you're not comfortable answering questions or providing service, please find another job.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aom Wongsaton

sample_reviews_en.text:
Whenever I crave a cool and refreshing dessert, this is the place I go because they have a great variety of options that are easy and quick to enjoy.
My go-to orders are frequently the Grass Jelly with Fresh Milk (Chao Kuay Nom Sod) and the Jumba (a mixed ice dessert). They are absolutely perfect for anyone with a sweet tooth!
They also offer various ice cream flavors where you can choose and customize your own toppings right at the counter.
All in all, this chain is a reliable spot for a sugar fix, with many convenient locations throughout the Bangkok metropolitan area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tess Nichanart

sample_reviews_en.text: Cheng Sim Ei at Huai Khwang is a popular dessert spot that is worth trying at least once. The desserts were okay for me and not really my favorite, but I can understand why many people enjoy them. The place was busy and had a lively atmosphere, which shows how well loved it is by customers. The staff were very good, friendly, and attentive, which made the experience pleasant. Overall, while it was not my personal favorite, I would still recommend it for others who want to try something popular and well known.
sample_reviews_en.author: Justin Roberts

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ate at Cheng Sim Yee (a local dessert shop). After finishing, I realized I forgot to take pictures.
The shop is cute, beautifully decorated, the desserts are okay, and the prices are reasonable.
The only downside is that this branch boils the longan juice with sugar already mixed in. Some branches boil plain longan juice and add syrup, allowing you to choose the sweetness level.
But at this branch, you can't ask for less sweetness because it's already mixed together.
sample_reviews_en.author: ** PYMN **

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is located at Pracha Rat Bamrung 27, opposite Chan Hun Bamrung School. It's a famous dessert shop, clean, with seating available. Prices start at 40 baht, with a choice of 1-4 toppings. The syrups include various types such as coconut milk, boiled coconut milk, fresh coconut milk, red syrup, longan syrup, and ginger syrup. Adding milk costs an extra 10 baht. For takeaway orders, the shop carefully packs the dessert with ice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffey

sample_reviews_en.text: It was average, okay, nothing amazing that would make me want to go back again. But the desserts I ordered came out quickly. There's free unlimited refills of tea and water. The atmosphere is minimalist, a modern cafe with light wood tones and neon lights with quotes. There's a wide selection of desserts to choose from. The fresh milk costs an extra 10 baht but wasn't tasty at all, which was a bit disappointing and a waste of money.
sample_reviews_en.author: NWD

sample_reviews_en.text: I like to order sweet potato, red bean, young coconut, ginkgo nuts, and goji berries with fresh coconut milk (no syrup) and finely crushed ice. It costs 60 baht. It's delicious and refreshing. If you're driving, be sure to read the traffic signs along the road carefully, especially regarding odd/even days and parking times, as several cars have been towed or given tickets.
sample_reviews_en.author: กิตติ วอทอง

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวไก่กะละมังร้านพี่กบ บุฟเฟต์ สาขา1
restaurants.address:

Soi Pracha Uthit 97/4, Thung Khru, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: It's a buffet restaurant that serves both noodles and rice with curry. The prices have changed according to the economic times; it used to be 89฿, now it's 109฿.
sample_reviews_th.author: บาส ไม่รู้จะอธิบายยังไง

sample_reviews_en.text:
Terrible! Unbelievable!!! I came based on reviews, thinking it was a buffet. When I arrived, they didn't tell me anything. I only found out when I was about to get food that it was 20 baht per bowl. What?! I was so confused. Turns out, they've changed it. It's no longer a buffet. They even announced it in a video on their page, but people who don't watch or follow them won't know. They should change the restaurant name too. Please change the parking sign. I'm going crazy. I drove so far to eat here, and the food was awful. The basil chicken with offal was spoiled. I'm going insane. How can they cook like this?
Anyone reading this, go to another restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Soft Sunmeaw

sample_reviews_en.text: No air conditioning, open-air seating area, suitable for breakfast or dinner. They offer a complete Thai menu, with spicy curries that go well with rice. I liked the galangal chicken, the sweet stir-fried preserved radish, and the generous portions of chicken legs. There's also a chicken noodle soup station with various chicken parts; I liked the breast and leg. They have clear soup with pork blood, minced pork, and kidney. For my meal, I had rice noodles with preserved radish and galangal chicken, along with clear soup with minced pork, kidney, and blood, plus a chicken leg. It was enough for two meals in one sitting!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ammy Enjoy

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a popular and value-for-money buffet restaurant in the Thung Khru area, located at Soi Pracha Uthit 97/4, Thung Khru Subdistrict, Thung Khru District, Bangkok. The highlight of the restaurant is its all-you-can-eat buffet at a budget-friendly price of only 99 baht per person (price may vary depending on promotions or times, such as evening congee buffets or the original price of 89 baht). Customers can choose from a wide variety of dishes without time limits.
sample_reviews_en.author: toon Chanatip

sample_reviews_en.text: Nat, the big eater, just reviewed this place 3 weeks ago and it already has 500,000 views. I came hoping for a buffet, but it turned out to be rice and curry for 20 baht with very little side dish. It's nothing like the review! What's going on? If you can't sell like other restaurants, don't even bother offering a buffet. And don't let anyone with a camera into the restaurant. I'm suspicious of them.
sample_reviews_en.author: pan pun ji

sample_reviews_en.text: Every time I go, the restaurant is closed on Mondays and Tuesdays. It used to be 89 baht and it was always very crowded. The rice and curry dishes were decent, but they had fewer fried items. After they increased the price to 109 baht, it became less crowded. The food wasn't as good as before, they just added desserts. I haven't been there recently, but I heard they no longer offer the buffet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratchayut Dananansuk

sample_reviews_en.text: Around 3 PM, I walked into the restaurant and there was no one to greet me. I asked what I wanted to do to get curry rice, and a male employee said, "The curry is all gone, only plain rice is left. Would you like plain rice?" This was despite customers already seated getting up to get curry. I was very disappointed, as I had a strong desire to eat there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kornchanok Tha.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Announcing a change: Previously, the buffet included pork blood soup and chicken noodle soup. Now, only the rice and curry buffet is available for 99 baht.
Chicken noodle soup is sold separately by the bowl.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชา ไทยไม่หวาน

restaurants.name: Tt Café
restaurants.address:

1059 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small rooftop bar visible from the BTS platform in Thonglor. It's been a while since I last visited, as they now serve beer. They serve Singha and other craft draft beers. Yesterday, when I ordered one glass, they gave me a small glass of the same beer for free. Lately, I've been enjoying pale ales and IPAs at bars. Yesterday, I had a Rogue Outta Line IPA and a Fresh Haze Squeez IPA. The owner recommended the Squeez, and it was definitely delicious.
The rooftop is low, but it's comfortable. It's also great for drinking while watching the trains pass by.
The entrance is on the first floor, the coffee shop/bar on the second, and the front desk? The accommodation is on the third and fourth floors. The rooftop bar is on the roof.
sample_reviews_en.author: ard Milli

sample_reviews_en.text:
My legs were shaking when I got back from Ayutthaya, so I was grateful that they gave me a lower bed when I made the reservation.
Afterwards, I was able to relax in the cafe area, and they even lent me a knife to cut the mango I bought at the supermarket.

Furthermore, I mistakenly thought I could hang my laundry on the rooftop, but it turned out to be a bar. I had to beg them to let me use the drying space next door... I'm truly grateful for their hospitality.

A highly recommended place to stay after a long time! I bought a coffee at the cafe as a tip 😉

I drank a Thai-style cafe au lait for 90B
sample_reviews_en.author: saburo akai (もずもずく)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited Tt cafe on its opening day, and it was fantastic! The staff was incredibly friendly, she suggested great nearby attractions to visit, which made my trip extra special.

Tt is beautifully designed with cozy, well-thought-out decor and a lovely view overlooking the train station, makes it perfect for solo travelers, providing a comfortable and welcoming space to relax or plan the next adventure. The coffee was delicious! In the evening, the place turns into a lively bar, making it perfect for both day and night visits. Highly recommended for any traveler seeking a memorable experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Hoài Hương

sample_reviews_en.text: What makes this place different from all the other bars and cafés of Thonglor? In a word: Everything! Think cosy, comfort, character, and charm. The first thing that strikes you is the beauty of the room itself: a masterclass in eclectic design. Coffee, Cocktails, Food & Wine: always on point. Then there is the music: quiet classic in the am; soulful jazz in the pm. Go and treat yourself to something very special. Places like this linger in the mind - for good reason. Speak to the owner (K. Chart) who will welcome your feedback.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Mountbatten

sample_reviews_en.text: A lovely, quaint café overlooking the escalator up to Thonglor rail platform and Sukhumvit below. Chill, homey vibe with good a/c and wifi. Offering perfectly brewed coffee and extensive offerings of wines, craft beers, and cocktails. The street level entrance is a bit difficult to spot unless you know to look for the signs. It is definitely worth searching out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Collin Kinnear

sample_reviews_en.text: Good place for your stay in Bangkok, next to BTS so you can go quick everywhere, good bars & restaurant in the surroundings, nice chill area for coffee & breakfast, dorms & privat rooms available, good atmosphere at the rooftop bar at night, each level has barhroom and toilet. Take earplugs just in case for a good sleep.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tina Steinecker

sample_reviews_en.text:
A friendly hostel with very welcoming staff. We had booked a private room with a shared bathroom. The room was large and comfortable, although a bit noisy as it faced the street (Sukhumvit Road). The shared bathrooms were clean and pleasant.
The small rooftop terrace was a nice touch!
sample_reviews_en.author: Iris Gagneux

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice hostel in a very convenient location, right next to the BTS Skytrain Thonglo Station.
Beds are reasonably priced and comfortable. Just as long as you have some place to go during the day, the A/C is turned off in the rooms in the daytime so an afternoon nap is impossible.
sample_reviews_en.author: ManWai Yeung

restaurants.name: On the Table Silom Complex
restaurants.address:

191 อาคาร Silom Complex ชั้น B, Si Lom Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
On my way home thought I would slip into complex and I know this is the same place I had some food food here is extremely disappointing!

I ordered the soup with the beef 🥩and veggies!! 🥗  guy-beef is something like that and when I got it … it was super small size, 2 pieces of beef only and the broth was soooo sweet like they poured a cuppa sugar in it!!

I didn’t know if I should return it because the girls could barely understand English I asked them if there was noodles in it to bring up three people let me know that there might be noodles in it they were not sure which was really surprising !

I would not recommend this place to eat unless you love sugar in your food!! To my sugar is for dessert 🍮 not soup!!

I literally felt like I did not eat anything!

I did not want to complain because I don’t think the girls would’ve understood it as much as I could with zero enjoyment and I hope that they improve under their menu and technique  of cooking!!

Follow Fauzia  for more food adventures in Bangkok beyond follow us here as well as
sample_reviews_en.author: Follow Fauzia

sample_reviews_en.text: Now this is like finding gold! Popped in here to be treated to the most amazing food. We had the Tomyum Seafood Spaghetti; a stunning Shrimp Tomyum Pizza (which I’d never even heard of before much less tried) and a serving of Crispy Quinoa Sushi. Let’s start with the spaghetti. Everything was cooked to perfection and of excellent portion size both in required amount and value for money. Superb flavours were evident in every mouthful. Now, to that pizza! This should be their signature dish in my humble opinion! The thinnest crust I’ve ever had hosted a stunning amount of flavours and textures. Unbelievable, truly amazing. The Sushi was beautifully presented and was accompanied by soy sauce and a VERY powerful wasabi paste - handle with care! Washed down with a delicious glass of Lychee Lemon Soda, this was truly a delicious meal at very very reasonable cost and served by helpful friendly staff. Will we come back? Oh yes … in a heartbeat. You should too - highly recommended. You’ll find them on the basement floor in Silom Complex.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brendan Gorman

sample_reviews_en.text:
we went to sit there from 12.10 pm and ordered within 5 minutes, in that’s time have around 3 tablets who sat there already. The waitress picked up our owner but kind of confused. The beverage came and some is missing. The foods is too long and needs to hurry them many times. The last place we received is 1.20 pm and still we need to cancel for 2 more place we ordered.

Waitress not be at front, have 3 of them and no more tables accepted us. We wanted to call to ask but too slow and not fast action at all.

I tasted of the foods for me is nothing special and specifically comparing with the price. This is not worthy.

I am not recommended this shop at all, I am not so sure for the other in the country but this one is not the good one needs to visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Baitoei N.Obradovic

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stopped by On the Table Restaurant for a light dinner before our spa appointment and decided to revisit our favorite Kitsune Tofu Truffle Udon. We also ordered a Pumpkin Soup and a Popeye Olive Pizza for sharing.

While the Kitsune Udon tasted quite different from what we previously enjoyed at the Mercury Ville branch — it lacked the same truffle aroma and rich flavor — the Pumpkin Soup and Popeye Olive Pizza were perfectly done. Both dishes were flavorful and comforting, just what we needed before our appointment.

The service was also commendable — the server was attentive to our needs and made the dining experience pleasant. Overall, a cozy spot for a light meal, though we hope the udon’s taste can be made more consistent across branches.
sample_reviews_en.author: N. Gan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today we had the Lunch Set 🍱. They have a promotion until January 31st, 2025. It's a really cute set, packed with the restaurant's best-selling dishes. We could choose from a main course, appetizer, salad, and soup. The set also includes side dishes and dessert. And this Lunch Set starts at only 259 baht!

🍮 The highlight of the set was the smooth and creamy Earl Grey pudding with sauce and whipped cream. It was the perfect way to end the meal. The special thing is, the restaurant created this dessert specifically for the Lunch Set; it's not on the regular menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: nutsfoodjourney

sample_reviews_en.text:
I usually only eat savory dishes or snacks here. This was my first time trying their desserts because a friend raved about their toast. And it was true! The toast was incredibly soft 😚 The ice cream and fruit complemented the toast perfectly, with a balanced sweet and sour flavor. It lived up to its appearance!

As for the pizza, the thin, crispy crust was as delicious as always. I tried the bacon and mushroom toast for the first time. There was plenty of bacon, but not enough mushrooms. The bacon was quite fatty, making it a bit cloying towards the end.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ning Santana

sample_reviews_en.text:
First time trying this branch and it was terrible.

When we made our order, server informed us that there was no wasabi. So we cancelled our sushi. Then they informed us that the crispy topping for the thai salmon dish was also not available.

Server did her job well to inform us. But it was very annoying to be informed that items cannot be prepared as per the menu.

Also, the table we sat at (4 seater) had an issue. The table top rocked whenever we rested our arms on either side, rocking the surface.

Not going back a second time for sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Edmond Lim

sample_reviews_en.text: On the table is one of my favorite restaurant chain. There are plenty of healthy and delicious food. This time I’m on vegetarian, their choice of vegan is super tasty and healthy. My all-time in love menu is baked-seafood-miso rice. You can order to try, their pizzas are also crispy and yummy. I like their pizza tomyum specially. Their hospitality is also helpful and nice staff. Highly recommend to try comfort and Japanese fusion food here. Any chains and any branches. Their sofa seats are so inviting and fluffy - happy seats for me
sample_reviews_en.author: Kulthirath Pakawachkrilers

restaurants.name: Tai Heng
restaurants.address:

67/4 Yaowarat 8, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Original Hainan food. We have known this restaurant for 50 years and they have never let us down. We love ขนมจีนไหหลำ which is now, too bad, available on Fri and Sat only. Their chicken rice is unique, brownish and garlic added. Their beef Hainan Styled Sukiyaki is also great.
sample_reviews_th.author: pramote sukanich

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant, with a history spanning over a century, was founded in 1920. The most popular dishes are Hainanese chicken rice and sukiyaki.

The Hainanese chicken rice is quite delicious; the rice is fragrant with chicken oil, the chicken itself is flavorful, and the skin is fairly crisp. The only downside is that the chicken breast is a bit dry; the second cut is very tender.

The sukiyaki is flavorful and has a wonderful wok hei (wok aroma), making it a very appealing dish. Remarkably, the restaurant states that their dishes are MSG-free.

Don't worry about finding a seat, as the seating is across the street!

Perhaps because it's located in a small alley and primarily caters to local residents, the prices are very affordable. Two dishes plus two cups of snow tea cost only 120 baht!
sample_reviews_en.author: YAP FLY

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Hainanese chicken rice was delicious! It's a flavor that's hard to find elsewhere. The rice was fragrant, the chicken was tender, and the dipping sauce was rich and flavorful. It was very tasty, and the price was very reasonable at 60 baht for the rice, with the option to choose thigh meat.
Another thing that was amazing was the stir-fried dried fish maw. It was incredibly delicious and the portion was huge, with crab meat too! 250 baht, which is very affordable considering the quality, taste, and quantity. I will definitely go back again. I was very impressed. The service was also great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ashita K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This old Chinese restaurant has been open for 105 years!!!

There are about 10 tables inside.
The tables are antique. There's no air conditioning, but the inside is cool and comfortable.
Everything looks old and somewhat disorganized.

I stopped by for a meal.
I ordered dry sukiyaki; it was stir-fried to perfection with a wonderful wok aroma.
The dipping sauce was delicious, unlike any other.
Absolutely fantastic, very tasty.

I also ordered drunken noodles (Pad Kee Mao).
This dish was really bad; they probably didn't know what drunken noodles were.

The service was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khongwut Aries

sample_reviews_en.text: This long-established Hainanese Thai restaurant is hidden in the alleys of Chinatown. It was closed for a while but has now reopened. Its signature Hainanese dish, Khao Man Gai (Hainanese chicken rice), has the subdued flavor you'd expect from a long-established restaurant. Its Hainanese kanom jing, similar to udon, also has an original flavor. Its specialty is sukiyaki (Thai-style sukiyaki... but completely different from Japanese sukiyaki), which can be enjoyed in individual portions on a plate or in a bowl, or in an authentic hotpot.
sample_reviews_en.author: THAI SANPO FUJII

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came for the Famous Chicken Rice... It Was Gone

Went on Day 2 of CNY, super excited to try their legendary Hainanese chicken rice—only to be told sold out. Devastating.

BUT. Still a great meal. You don't survive 120 years without knowing what you're doing. Had some other classics instead, and honestly? Everything worked. Place with many elderly locals, English menu available, little shrine next door.

Moral of the story: go early. Or accept that even after a century, they still run out of the good stuff.
sample_reviews_en.author: J Z

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a very classic atmosphere.
The Hainanese chicken rice is incredibly delicious; it's my personal favorite.
The dry sukiyaki, whether with beef or seafood, is equally amazing.
The dipping sauce is old-fashioned, with a salty and spicy flavor. The stir-fry has a wonderful wok aroma.
The dry-fried fish maw is also tasty, and the stir-fried noodles with seafood are delicious too.
Anyone who likes traditional Chinese food will probably love it.
I highly recommend giving it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: JustkidDy _

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Hainanese Chinese restaurant offers an old-school dining experience at affordable prices.

The dry sukiyaki is a must-try; it's stir-fried to perfection with a wonderful wok aroma, the dipping sauce is delicious, and the marinated meat is tender and flavorful.

The Hainanese chicken rice is also excellent; the chicken is tender and chewy, the rice is fragrant, not soggy or greasy, and the dipping sauce has a unique and delicious flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanasit Muangsrisak

restaurants.name: Naiades ใน-อดีต Wine Bar
restaurants.address:

Pibulsongklam 15 Alley, Suan Yai, นนทบุรี, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious.
The prices are reasonable. The restaurant has only been open for a month.
They don't have a Thai menu.
They mostly serve Italian food, like spaghetti, steak, and wine.
Grilled shrimp with delicious dipping sauce.
The riverside atmosphere is great, with a cool breeze (I forgot to take a picture of the riverside). The surroundings are lovely and the restaurant is currently being renovated. You can have dinner there. It should be beautiful when it's all finished. It's a cute little restaurant with indoor tables. The entrance is a bit small and private.
The staff may need some training.
I'm not very skilled yet, but I understand it's just opened.
There are two branches, the first in Khao Yai.

Parking is in the alley on the side of the road, so you can park in a hidden spot.

The highlight is the rose-infused water. It's incredibly fragrant and refreshing.
You can refill it as much as you want.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปลาดี้มารีวิว

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here hoping for a delicious New Year's Eve meal.

I ordered a Wagyu steak for 1200 baht, requested rare but received well done.

I ordered mushroom soup, which looked like chicken stew and tasted awful.

I ordered salmon steak; the fish was black, oily, and swimming in dark liquid.

I called the owner to ask if there was a chef and why the food was like this. They said there were staff helping, but these were really young staff members. It was incredibly cruel to treat customers like this on New Year's Eve.

Even if you didn't charge me for the inedible food that I hadn't even tasted, along with an apology for the poor preparation, it's still incredibly disrespectful to customers who came specifically to eat at your restaurant. If you're not ready to open a restaurant, don't bother. It would be better to just close for the New Year.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supaluck Keopratib

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small, hidden gem by the Chao Phraya River.
Offering an incredibly private atmosphere.
Excellent in every aspect.
A truly impressive restaurant.

The food tastes great; every dish was delicious.
Portions are so generous we couldn't finish everything and had to take some home.
The service is great, the vibes are fantastic, and the taste is superb.
Enjoy the sunset in the evening.
You can sit, eat, and sip wine until late, with a cool breeze.

The restaurant has a selection of wines priced around 1000+ baht.
There's no corkage fee if you bring your own wine.

This is another Chao Phraya riverside restaurant I highly recommend!!
Come, it's incredibly good, truly amazing.

Reservations are required in advance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pitinun Phungsripheng

sample_reviews_en.text:
Charming Riverside Dining Experience

This cozy little restaurant feels like dining at a lovely riverside home. Located along the Chao Phraya River, it offers both set menus and à la carte dishes, with a nice selection of wine to pair with your meal. The atmosphere is perfect for relaxing while watching the sunset over the river. The owner is very friendly, and the staff provide excellent service. As for the food—simply delicious.

This should capture the vibe you’re looking for!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rattanawadi Niothong

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a cute little restaurant right on the water. The owner spoke English and was very welcoming. We tried the garlic bread, Thai steak, and bacon fried rice. All were great but when I go back I'll get the bacon fried rice and the mixed veggies dish, as the roasted veggies that came with the steak were fantastic. It's a small place that only had one other guest while we were there, but the staff was very accommodating. They brought a fan over and turned on the nice lighting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emily Napear

sample_reviews_en.text:
This eatery has a great river view. Parking is roadside only, and you need to walk down the alley to the eatery, as it's too narrow for cars. The staff and owner are very service minded and friendly. They accept cash and QR code payments only. We think this place is great for celebrating special events, going on dates, or having dinner with friends and family.
**By reservation only, no walk-ins.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pia Suwannalert

sample_reviews_en.text: For those who love peace and privacy, this place is perfect because they limit the number of customers and reservations are required. It feels like having a meal at your grandparents' house, just like when you were a child. The food is excellent, and sipping wine while watching the sunset and the river is truly relaxing. Thank you to the staff for taking such good care of us.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornrat Boonchuswat

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small riverside restaurant with only a few tables, a nice, quiet atmosphere, and the owner's service is excellent and very friendly. Every dish is delicious (the garlic bread is amazing!) and the prices are not too expensive. The owner even peeled a mango for us to try for free! 🥰

🚗 If you're arriving by car, park inside the alley and walk down the alley a bit.
sample_reviews_en.author: cnn e

restaurants.name: Watermelon restaurant Ratchaprarop22
restaurants.address:

53/8 ปาก Soi Ratchaprarop 22, Makkasan, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a small street-side restaurant serving late-night snacks. Several dishes I ordered were delicious; the Tom Yum soup was very flavorful, and the fried noodles were fragrant. There were many foreigners around, and the owner speaks fluent English. It's extremely good value for money, and there's a 7-Eleven right next door for you to mix your own drinks. Overall, I highly recommend it. If you live nearby, you can give it a try, but it's not necessary to make a special trip; it's a great local eatery.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunny Ying

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant was near my hotel, and the food was absolutely delicious. I finished every last bite, even though I was already full. Before leaving, I took a picture of the meat, and the owner even gave me a piece. This restaurant in Thailand also has an elderly lady who cooks dishes that surpass those on must-eat lists or popular online restaurants! It was fantastic, and I'll definitely come back to eat here again next time I'm in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: 张荣煜

sample_reviews_en.text: An incredible culinary discovery! We had the pleasure of dining at this Thai restaurant in Bangkok, and it was absolutely delicious! The fresh ingredients and dishes prepared on-site made all the difference. The welcome and service were warm, attentive, and friendly. We loved every dish and will definitely be back! If you're looking for an authentic and delicious place, this is THE place to try without hesitation! 😋👌
sample_reviews_en.author: Sébastien Petorin

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and reasonably priced. We (4 people) ordered 6 dishes and it only cost 750B. The owner and staff are all enthusiastic and friendly. The only downside is that there are only 2 people serving, so the food takes a little longer to arrive. But on the bright side, the food is very tasty and they even have a Vietnamese menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Linh Nguyen

sample_reviews_en.text: We had tom yum and fried pork. The portions were huge. The meal plus rice, cola, and water came to 310 baht. It was delicious. We'll definitely come back. I didn't feel any pain afterward and felt great. We ordered medium spiciness, and it was fine, not too spicy, just right, even though I don't eat much spicy food. I recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Екатерина Швецова

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every food you order here is so delicious and gives you pure authentic vibes.
The chef is very friendly and staffs are active and attentive. Best location to explore street food  with reasonable prices. Come here for dinner very often still have nothing to complain about. Strongly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aung Kyaw Kyaw

sample_reviews_en.text: I arrived in Thailand late at night, hurriedly checked in, and visited this restaurant nearby. As it was my first meal since arriving, I had high expectations, and the taste was truly satisfying without any frills. Although I came by chance, I'm glad I found this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kimtanoi

sample_reviews_en.text:
We have eaten at this eatery three times and on each occasion the food has been cooked to order and really delicious.
Some of the best food we have had whilst touring SE Asia. Our thanks to the helpful young lady serving and to the chef who works very hard.
sample_reviews_en.author: Helen Letheren

restaurants.name: Jankasem BBQ & Seafood
restaurants.address:

2585 Lat Phrao Rd, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
***** Urgent Staff Improvement Needed!!!!! The staff are incredibly lazy and don't respond when called. *****

The food is delicious, the dipping sauces are amazing, and there's a huge variety of food to choose from, such as spicy crab salad, spicy chicken feet salad, spicy fresh shrimp salad, fish maw soup, crab curry noodles, glass noodle prawns, spaghetti, tom yum soup, boiled cockles, vegetable salad, fried foods, nuggets, french fries, crackers, fried crab sticks, and various marinated pork, chicken, and beef in many different recipes. There's also fresh liver, quail eggs, tofu, meatballs, glass noodles, and various vegetables. They also have ice cream, Thai desserts, sweets, and shaved ice. If you like all-you-can-eat BBQ, I highly recommend this restaurant. I love the dipping sauces and the variety. There are plenty of tables, good ventilation, and convenient parking. However, the main issue is the staff. They are very inattentive to customers. Even waving or calling them doesn't work. This happens every time I come. Many of the staff are lazy. If possible, changing the staff would be greatly appreciated.
sample_reviews_en.author: wannalak Wawkratok

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant staff seemed confused and didn't understand the language well. Regarding the food, we ate at 5 PM, and later that night, someone in our family experienced severe stomach pain, diarrhea, and vomiting. We went to the hospital, where the doctor diagnosed food poisoning. We suspect the cause was contaminated utensils combined with substandard food. We have already filed a report with the Department of Public Health to provide initial information and will speak directly with the restaurant to request compensation for the damages incurred and ensure they take full responsibility. (If anyone encounters a similar problem, please don't let it slide, but pursue it to the fullest extent. Responsibility and improvement are essential qualities for good business practices.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Wimonrat

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the worst restaurant I've ever eaten at. I've never gotten sick from a buffet before; this is the first time. I had severe diarrhea. The food wasn't even that fresh, the taste wasn't amazing, and the service was terrible. It was my first time there, and the staff didn't explain that you're supposed to get one stove, but they brought two! Then, they charged me for the extra stove at 89 baht, even though I didn't order it. I'd give the food a 6 for taste and a 10 for dirtiness. The restaurant doesn't seem to care about customer reviews at all; they should improve. I suspect they don't want regular customers, as most people only go once. And I won't be going back. It's not worth the medical bills. Absolutely awful. I'm speechless.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanyanee Muangmee

sample_reviews_en.text:
A great self-serve buffet with a lively atmosphere. The parking lot is a little tight, and after 6 pm it gets busy very quickly, so best to arrive early. Prices are reasonable, though it seems you pay extra for the burners.

The precooked food was delicious (minus the occasional flies, but that’s Thailand), and the live shrimp station was a highlight — fun to watch everyone rush to the tank for first grabs.

The restaurant is well staffed, the food overall was good, and the vibe is energetic and chill. Expect mosquitoes, flies, and other little flying visitors, but that’s part of the open-air charm.

Overall, a lively spot with good food and a fun buffet experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Meng Thao

sample_reviews_en.text:
Jankasem BBQ & Seafood is hands down the best BBQ and seafood place I have had in Thailand. The seafood variety is excellent, with so many options to choose from, and everything tasted fresh and well cooked. The grilled dishes were especially flavorful and very satisfying.
What makes this place even better is the pricing. The quality you get for the price is amazing and feels like great value for money. The atmosphere is casual and comfortable, perfect for dining with friends or family. The staff were friendly and attentive, which added to the overall experience. I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for top quality BBQ and seafood in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Justin Roberts

sample_reviews_en.text: The seafood wasn't fresh, and when I asked for chopsticks and glasses, the staff looked confused, as if they didn't understand Thai. I went to the restaurant because I saw they had a lot of grilled seafood and a wide variety of choices, but I went around 10 PM, and there weren't many customers, so they didn't refill the food, even though people were still getting it. They just put tissues and wet wipes on the table without telling me that they cost extra, as if they were forcing me to buy them. And most importantly!!! I went specifically for the grilled seafood, but instead, it wasn't fresh. The next morning, I had diarrhea and had to go to the hospital.
sample_reviews_en.author: I‘am whale

sample_reviews_en.text:
Please be careful this restaurant not to bring any child.
This is not a positive environment for family with kid to dine there.

An elderly Thai waiter in a green shirt at the left corner side of the entrance was very rude to the customers. He never comes and cleans our table.

We are royal customers there. We bring our kid and he doesn’t even give a glass cup to our kid even he plans to charge for baby.

At the end, I complained personally the elderly Thai Waiter to the owner of the restaurant.

The cleanliness of the environment has also become weaker that no one mobbed the muddy and water floor near our table for two hours straight.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ja Seng Raw Lahpai

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was good, with a choice of seafood and pork, but the grilled items were a bit limited. It seems they focus more on seafood. I was confused though, they charged an extra 10 baht for tissues and wet wipes. The staff placed them there, and I thought they were included in the buffet price. They didn't say anything about the extra charges. It seems they're trying to make money however they can. Next time, please inform customers beforehand so I don't have to use your service again. This will be my first and last visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: teeraphanon pumkaew

restaurants.name: อี้จาสุกี้หม่าล่า สาขาบรรทัดทอง
restaurants.address:

1390 Banthat Thong Rd, Rong Mueang, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Decided to have non-Thai food today, and chose this Mala Hotpot restaurant.  The shop banner in the Google Map profile is not the same, but I am sure it is the same restaurant.  Maybe refurbished… 😉

Modern clean conveyor belt 1 person hot pot restaurant.  Many soup bases to choose from.  I chose a 2 soup pot:  Pork Bone Broth (which was too rich so I added water to it to thin it) and Szechuan Mala Soup (which was fine).

Multiple ingredients on the conveyor belt and also fridges.  Ingredients fresh, and regularly refreshed from the high turnover.

I thoroughly enjoyed the food.  Staff was fast and attentive, and there was this girl staff who spoke native Thai, and could speak Mandarin Chinese (普通話) and English.  👍👍👍... She was also very friendly and polite.  Top marks to her.

Bill came to 483 Baht.

Thanks for a wonderful dinner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chesper-Joghne Pang

sample_reviews_en.text:
This used to be my number one conveyor belt hot pot restaurant.
Back then, there were long queues, and I could wait for hours.
Now, maybe due to the economy, high rent, or fewer tourists,
the restaurant seems much quieter than before.
The food selection and drink menu have decreased.
The broth still tastes delicious, and the dipping sauces are still plentiful and tasty.
However, the broth, especially the mala broth, was very diluted after the second refill.
I couldn't eat any more.

I tried ordering delivery. The mala broth was spicy and numbing, and the portion was generous. The dipping sauces were well-made and the packaging was excellent.
They also included a complimentary cup of white wood ear mushroom soup, which was bland and slimy – I couldn't eat it. 🥹
sample_reviews_en.author: J Sawittree

sample_reviews_en.text:
The first few times in this conveyor belt individual hotpot were absolutely super. Everything felt fresh and clean, from veggies to premium meats, making it a go-to for us. But on our most recent visit, the quality dipped noticeably - not quite as fresh overall. It seemed like some items might have been stored for a couple of days, possibly to stretch supplies and avoid waste.
That said, the special sauce (dipping), mala and tomato soup based were good. The pork soup was not bad; could taste the milk which toned it down a bit.
We still love the overall vibe: lively atmosphere, impeccably clean restaurant and servers with genuinely good attitudes and attentive. Hoping our next visit brings back that super experience 😊!
sample_reviews_en.author: N (Princess)

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant isn't very big. In the center is a conveyor belt bar, with family-style tables nearby. There's a food bar and a sauce bar with a huge variety of sauces, including seafood. The staff are lovely, the restaurant is clean, and tissues are provided. Prices are based on color, and sauces and soup are charged separately. The taste is similar to Yi Ja Chula (the restaurant near Chula Soi 5), maintaining a good standard. Drinks are available both at the bar and in the refrigerator, and items are constantly refilled. It feels like they have more food options than the Chula Soi 5 branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: 10 สุนิษา

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and clean, but the atmosphere in the restaurant was unpleasant. The music was jarring, making the meal less enjoyable, and the constant phone calls from the kitchen staff were incredibly annoying. The staff didn't seem to warn each other about the noise; it was disturbing customers from the moment we sat down until we finished our meal. The noise pollution was significant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Moonin

sample_reviews_en.text:
I liked the delicious and rich bone broth. As for the shrimp, squid, vegetables, and tofu, there was a huge selection. The conveyor belt was slow, so there were chilled display cases for easier access, as you can see in the picture.
The service was also okay.
Drinks can be picked up from the bar in front of your table.
The atmosphere in the restaurant wasn't stuffy, which was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaaey Methaporn

sample_reviews_en.text: Yija's new branch on Banthat Thong Road is not far from Stadium One. The restaurant occupies two shop spaces and offers both a revolving bar and self-service options. The soup is delicious, and there's a wider variety of ingredients. The dipping sauce bar is a bit cramped in a corner, especially if many people are getting up to mix their own sauces at the same time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanjana Sangkittipornchai

sample_reviews_en.text: I order online regularly, but I was very disappointed when I went to the store. The staff were completely uninterested. The store was closed, and they didn't even ask how many people were in line or how long the wait would be. They just didn't do anything at all. Yes, it was my first time there, but other stores on Banthat Thong Road don't treat me like this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Iam Pppphu

restaurants.name: Zanzibar restaurant
restaurants.address:

139 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We decided to try this restaurant because it looked great from the outside and seemed busy, but unfortunately the experience was extremely disappointing. It ended up being the worst meal I’ve had during my entire month in Thailand.

There were four of us, and none of us could finish even half of our dishes. The steak was tough and rubbery, almost like chewing gum, and the chicken was full of bones and completely lacking sauce or flavor. When we politely mentioned the issues to the staff, they didn’t seem to care or offer any solution.

To make things worse, the bill was incorrect — we were overcharged by about 1,400 baht, with items added that we never ordered. Thankfully we caught it, but it made the whole experience even more frustrating.

Overall, I would not recommend this place. The food, service, and billing experience were all disappointing. Definitely not worth the time or money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Carmen E.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been to this restaurant twice in the last two weeks. The first time I had a really good meal, but the second time was a different story.

Perhaps because it was Valentine's Day and the place was very busy, the food was worse. Also, the drink was much smaller than the first time, although the price remained the same. And when they brought my drink (draft beer), they brought me a small plate of cashews, which I assumed were complimentary. But when they brought the bill, they wanted to charge me 220 baht for those cashews, which I hadn't ordered.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jose GZ

sample_reviews_en.text:
We like to sit here in the evenings for a few drinks.

The service in the garden has improved, but it's still not very well organized.

Management tolerates people bringing their own drinks. Maybe there is no management!

That's convenient if you don't plan on spending a single baht here! haha
The live music is good, but way too loud.

That's convenient if you have nothing left to say to each other!!

14/11/2025 The cozy garden is no longer there!

The garden is open again...but the prices are exorbitant.
sample_reviews_en.author: M

sample_reviews_en.text:
had a great experience at Zanzibar Restaurant in Bangkok. The food was delicious, full of flavor, and beautifully prepared. Every dish tasted fresh and authentic, and you can really tell that care goes into the cooking.

The atmosphere was warm and comfortable, and the staff were very friendly and attentive, which made the whole experience even better. It’s a perfect place to enjoy a relaxed meal and good vibes.

Highly recommended, and I’ll definitely be coming back again.
Special thanks to Vy & Douk
sample_reviews_en.author: SHAMLAN 80009

sample_reviews_en.text: Phenomenal service and fantastic food. Our waitress was very attentive and went out of her way to make sure our food was pregnancy safe and made recommendations without being asked. She also made sure that anyone who came after us who wanted to smoke was redirected to a new smoking area for our safety. The orders were all perfect. She even saw my husband get a bug bite and came over with complimentary bug spray (we forgot ours). She attended all our needs without being asked - 100/10
sample_reviews_en.author: Amanda Mahoney

sample_reviews_en.text: If you’re looking for a great atmosphere on Soi 11, Zanzibar is it. The lush, garden-style seating is beautiful, and the live music really sets a cool, relaxed mood for the evening. The food was delicious and the cocktails were well-made, definitely high quality. It’s a bit on the pricer side compared to other spots nearby, but you're paying for the great ambiance and the live band. Perfect for a date or a nice night out with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maggie Bacelic

sample_reviews_en.text: Zanzibar Bangkok is a beautiful and relaxing place right in the heart of the city. It has a spacious garden-style layout with lots of greenery, cozy outdoor seating, and a calm atmosphere that’s perfect for unwinding. The food was tasty, especially the seafood dishes, and the drinks were well prepared. The staff were friendly and attentive, making the whole experience even better. A great spot for dinner or a casual evening out.
sample_reviews_en.author: O D

sample_reviews_en.text:
They do have a beautiful garden, where it's much quieter than in any other bar or restaurant in this area. The music is fittingly cool as well, smooth jazz and pop. The singer is backed up by a real jazz guitar player (!!!), not a bland keyboard, how cool is that!
We did not taste the food, but the drinks were really fine, well worth the money. An absolutely recommended experience on Sukhumvit Road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wolfy

restaurants.name: เล่าจึง ก๋วยเตี๋ยว ลูกชิ้นปลา
restaurants.address:

40/3 หมู่2 ถนน พุทธบูชา Bang Mot, Thung Khru, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fish balls taste good.
Not fishy. The fish cake is delicious.
The soup broth tastes good and is tasty.
Fast service, didn't have to wait long.
Good location, right on the main road, fairly large restaurant.
They also have Hainanese chicken rice, duck rice, and satay pork.
One of the best tasting restaurants in the Phutthabucha area.
Bus stops nearby.
Easy to find with a clear sign.
Air-conditioned room, comfortable while eating.
Prices are not too expensive.
Reasonable and acceptable.
Parking available behind the restaurant.
Clean restrooms.
Another restaurant worth trying.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanaseth DEJ

sample_reviews_en.text:
➡️ This is a roadside fish ball noodle shop on Phutthabucha Road.
➡️ If you order the dry Yen Ta Fo, taste it before adding any seasoning; it's already good.
➡️ The dry egg noodles have good texture and aren't soggy.
➡️ The fish balls aren't fishy, ​​but they feel like they have a starchy texture.😓
➡️ There are more than 10 tables, and there aren't many customers, so there's no need to wait.
➡️ There's a restroom available.
📌 The dry Yen Ta Fo with wide noodles is delicious and doesn't need any seasoning.
sample_reviews_en.author: pasuree anusath

sample_reviews_en.text: Originally, there was air conditioning, but it has now been removed. This is evident from the fact that all the glass walls have been removed, and the fan coil (cooling coil) has also been removed. However, a fan is now installed to help dissipate heat. The menu, which previously included pork leg rice, duck rice, and zongzi (rice dumplings), is no longer available. Only Hainanese chicken rice and noodles remain.
sample_reviews_en.author: Somsak Lee 【李】

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fish cake and mixed meatballs with dipping sauce were excellent.
However, the Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) was too sweet.
The Zongzi (Chinese rice dumpling) was just average.
On my way back, I ordered some fish cakes to take home for my relatives because they were delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: NOPPADON WIJITPIYAKUL

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is near my house, but I don't come often. It looks clean and well-organized, not too crowded. They have high chairs for children and about 10 tables. There's a restroom available. The soup tastes good, and the fish balls are decent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chavarit Waiwong

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious, but there aren't many customers, maybe because of the bad economy. These days, everyone's competing with promotions to attract customers. Try offering a fish ball noodle buffet; I guarantee it'll be packed.
sample_reviews_en.author: สมฤกษ์ ศรีสิทธิสกุล

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, I went to check it out and tasted the worst Hainanese chicken rice I've ever had, even when I was really hungry. No wonder it was so quiet. If they don't improve, they're definitely going to fail.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narong k.sak

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken rice was okay, the rice itself was fine, but the dipping sauce has changed a lot; it's not the same as it used to be. The staff also seemed less attentive to customers than before.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nok Kitisaro

restaurants.name: Ern Manee เอิญมณี
restaurants.address:

Earth, 109-110, 7/1 Ekkamai Rd, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the opportunity to experience an exclusive dinner featuring Modern Thai Cuisine with signature dishes from Chef Paopae Jessica Wang.
This restaurant was awarded by COOLfahrenheit.
The restaurant serves fusion Thai food from all four regions of Thailand, with bold flavors. They offer both regular menu items and Chef Table options. Everything was delicious. The restaurant is located in the Earth Ekkamai project and has plenty of parking. You can get your parking ticket stamped at the restaurant. The restaurant is beautiful with a great atmosphere. The chef is renowned from the MasterChef Thailand program.
sample_reviews_en.author: MkukkikM

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was absolutely delicious! I was impressed with everything. 🥹✨
Both the savory and sweet dishes were perfectly prepared. The taste was great, the ingredients were high quality, and it felt like great value for money.

Importantly, the food came out very quickly; no long wait at all. 👍
The staff were also very attentive, lovely, and provided excellent service.

The atmosphere was also great, perfect for relaxing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Radhaya Neelaphol

sample_reviews_en.text:
The dishes we ordered were steamed egg custard, spicy minced pork salad (larb), crab croquettes with curry powder, pork satay, and yuzu soda.

The food tasted delicious and well-balanced overall. The larb was not too spicy, and most of the dishes were very easy to enjoy. The yuzu soda was also extremely refreshing and really delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Limeme Design

sample_reviews_en.text: Okay this is hands down one of the best restaurants I've ever been to in my life. Not just in Thailand but in my life. The food was fantastic, I couldn't get enough. Everything was delicious from the appetizers to the main meal to the dessert and even the drinks. Loved it all. Will be going back before I leave!
sample_reviews_en.author: Cam Cal

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a nice, comfortable atmosphere.
It's perfect for a family outing.
The food tastes good and the ingredients are of high quality.

Recommended dishes:
Salmon Choo Chee Spaghetti
Pad Thai
Grilled Chicken

Convenient parking is available and easy to find a spot.
sample_reviews_en.author: อิศม์เดช จิตติวรสิทธิ์

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is the highlight. The flavors are well-balanced and just the right amount of spiciness; it doesn't feel like it's been overly adjusted to cater to tourists. The ingredients are quite fresh, and the portions are decent considering the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: พีรชา พงษ์กูล

sample_reviews_en.text: The Thai food here is incredibly delicious, with authentic Thai flavors. I was especially impressed with the sour curry with acacia leaves and shrimp. The staff provided excellent service, and the restaurant was comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saranya Kanchayaphak

sample_reviews_en.text: The food isn't just visually appealing; the flavors are well-balanced and the fusion is perfect. I loved the crab croquettes with curry powder the most. The desserts were also delicious, fragrant, and not too sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kantapong Ngamprasertsith

restaurants.name: Freddie RiceCurry
restaurants.address:

7/146 Chok Chai 4 Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Because I wanted to eat Katsu Curry Rice and we had to visit a place near Soi Latphrao 71 so we stopped by Freddie Rice Curry, the same curry rice eatery that once was my favorite near Phra Sumen Fort but it was permanently closed last year. Right now, they have only 2 branches left which are Soi Latphrao 71 and Rama II Road but the Rama II Road are quite far from our zone so Soi Latphrao 71 is more convenient for us.

Anyway, the eatery also has another business inside and it has a bigger sign than Freddie's in front of the building so you should be aware of that.

The taste was a little bit different from Phra Sumen Fort branch and it didn't have Fukujinzuke served as a side dish of Curry Rice so I was quite disappointed 😞 I just hope I have a chance to visit Rama II Road branch to test the taste though. If it is the same as this one, I will have to find my new favorite curry rice place 😅
sample_reviews_en.author: Nathathida Atirekasâra

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is located at the beginning of Wang Hin, and I've wanted to eat here many times, but either I drove past it, or there was no parking, or just bad luck. Today was a good day, so I invited my colleagues from work to come with me. As soon as we parked and walked in to order, what I expected happened: a police car drove straight towards us to tow our car. They have odd/even day parking restrictions, and it was my fault for parking on the wrong side. Now, let's talk about the taste. I ordered the fried pork curry, requesting level two spiciness. The curry was rich and spicy, and the fried pork was a bit too much batter for Thai style, but still acceptable. The side dishes were delicious. Overall, it was good value for money. (If you don't like it, don't tell me!)
sample_reviews_en.author: khomwit khumpasano

sample_reviews_en.text:
Review from 2021: Delicious. The crispy pork was incredibly crispy and there was more of it than rice, which surprised me! 555555 I ordered spice level 4, but I thought it wasn't spicy at all. Even adding more chilies didn't satisfy me.

Update June 14, 2024: The restaurant has moved to Ladprao 71. It's located in the same building as the Jim Jum restaurant, which was confusing as I drove around for a while. Luckily, there's a sign in front of the shop, but it's not very prominent. The menu has fewer items now, I'm not sure if it's because of the move, but the portions are still generous. I ordered spice level 10 and it was spicy, even adding more chilies didn't satisfy me. Next time I'll order level 20.
sample_reviews_en.author: Work Roland

sample_reviews_en.text:
-The crispy pork stir-fried with chili and salt is delicious, a must-try. Personally, I think it would be even better eaten with just rice, without the curry. -The fried pork is tasty and not greasy.
-The curry sauce is rich and flavorful, with a rating of 0-5. If you don't like spicy food or can't handle much spice, ordering a rating of 2 or lower would be ideal.
-The shrimp patties are delicious, highly recommended.

Parking: Park on the street in the alley opposite the restaurant. The restaurant is located in a residential area, so it might be a little hard to find, but using GPS will definitely help you find it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arunrat Pum
