sample_reviews_en.text:
The hidden curry rice bistro in Chok-Chai 4.
This Japanese curry rice is quite different style from other restaurants/ bistros.
This is a combination of Japanese and Thai curry rice style which I really fall in love with it.

The meat is good, the curry sauce is great.
There're 5 level of hot for the sauce. I chose level 5 for the grilled pork, and level 3 for the stirred-fried chili-salt crispy pork.
Both are great.

There's no official parking area, but you can park in front of the bistro which is reserved for the customers of this bistro only.

The price is reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poppii Cactus

sample_reviews_en.text: 1. Considering the price, quality, and quantity, it's a no-go. The price is high, the food isn't tasty, and the quality is lacking. The rice was hard, cold, and very dry. The curry was overly spicy and lacked balance. I ordered grilled chicken and pork neck, which were acceptable. The service was average, like a typical Thai street food stall. The prices are too high, especially for the chicken or pork dishes (190+ baht). For beef, I recommend going for steak instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jadesarit Orantanasin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was absolutely delicious. They offer a variety of curries, and you can choose from five different spice levels.

The service staff was very friendly and helpful. We got by very well with English. Main courses cost around 90-150 baht.

A small update after a few more experiences: Having now visited the islands in the north and south, I can definitely say that this is where I've had the best crispy pork with curry sauce so far.

Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: G. H.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Homemade Curry Rice
This curry rice shop is located in front of a house. The flavors are rich and each dish is made fresh and the portions are generous.
The sauce leans towards Indian curry, with a variety of toppings to choose from and a spiciness level of 0-5.
The pickled vegetables are on the sweeter side with a slight sourness at the end.
The shop is located in a village; parking is available along the road. There are limited seats, around 12.
sample_reviews_en.author: Numz Nisa

restaurants.name: Rangnam beef noodles
restaurants.address:

133/7 แขวง มักกะสัน เขต ราชเทวี, Ratchaprarop Rd, Makkasan, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I want to say it's incredibly delicious. From what I've eaten before, both the meat and the broth are fragrant, rich, and satisfying. They give you a generous portion for the price, which is very reasonable. It's so delicious, I highly recommend trying it. The offal has no unpleasant smell at all. When I crave noodles, I always come to this shop. It's located right on Ratchaprarop Road. There's no parking, and the shop doesn't have air conditioning, but it's super crowded with long queues during lunchtime. I understand why it's so delicious. You can also buy it to take home, and they still give you a generous portion. It's rare to find a place like this these days that gives you so much and is so delicious at such an affordable price. They have both noodle soup and offal soup. You can choose to have everything or just some ingredients. Just tell the owner; she's kind and friendly.
#PIKI #IG : princekishiro #Tiktok : @princekishiro #youtube : princekishiro #Page : fanclubprincekishiro
sample_reviews_en.author: Prince Kishiro (KIRA)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The beef noodles were delicious, with tasty slices, chunks, and meatballs of beef. The broth was rich and flavorful, and the meal came with complimentary ice, perfect for pairing with the winter melon tea on the table – a refreshing treat on a hot day.

The staff didn't speak English, but you could order by showing photos from Google reviews and using gestures. The dining environment was basic; there was no air conditioning, but the indoor fans were acceptable. It might not suit those with high expectations, but for travelers staying nearby looking for a light meal, this was a great place to try the delicious beef noodles. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason Hsu

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an original restaurant that has been open for over 20 years, since its days in Soi Rangnam, behind the former State Railway of Thailand (SRT) building. Now it's King Power. The staff is still the same, having been with the restaurant for a long time. I've been eating here since elementary school.

Overall rating: 8.5/10
Braised beef: 9 (Good)
Meatballs: 9 (Good)
Fresh beef: 8.5 (Average)
Soup: 8.5 (A bit too salty on the day I went)
Quantity: 9 (Appropriate for the price)
Price: 9 (Inexpensive, 50-70 baht)
Cleanliness: 7.5
Staff/Service: 8.5
Restroom: 7
sample_reviews_en.author: Attapol Khamsuwan

sample_reviews_en.text: I remember eating delicious stewed beef noodles in Soi Rang Nam almost 10 years ago. Today I had the chance to come again so I walked to find it. I found that it had moved outside. I tried ordering a small bowl with soup to test the taste. Let me tell you, it was not good. The small noodles were old, the soup was not good. The fresh meat and offal were cut into small pieces and did not taste good. If you want to eat, I recommend the stewed beef meatballs. The stewed beef is three layers. It is still delicious. The price is not expensive, 50-60 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donovski Rotten

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is located on Ratchaprarop Road (formerly in Soi Rang Nam). Anyone who likes meat will definitely say that this shop is really great. The soup is rich, the meat is tender, and the meatballs are delicious. Unfortunately, there is no parking in front of the shop because it is right on the side of the road. The shop is not very large, so it gets quite crowded at noon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Coke kuanwilai

sample_reviews_en.text: Such a hidden gem especially now when its literally hidden behind construction, they serve a bowl of beef noodle with a rich borth and lot of toppings of of beef (and pork?) with bakso (meatball) that is very tasty and bouncy. Recommend to visit in the morning for breakfast. The seller speaks no english but we can order using google translate or just show the picture.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gusti

sample_reviews_en.text: The ingredients are okay, but the broth's flavor isn't the same as before. It's still well-balanced, but the standard when it was in Soi Rangnam was the best. Now, the broth has too much sauce, making it too salty. It would be much better if they used the old recipe. Overall, it's okay, but I believe it can be improved. I'll go back and try it again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teerapant Rungjui

sample_reviews_en.text:
The broth was perfectly balanced, not too sweet or salty, and fragrant with the aroma of fried garlic.

The offal was good, clean and soft, and the intestines were delicious and tender.

The staff were friendly and cheerful.

The noodle soup was 80 baht, and the rice was 10 baht. Great value. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teerapat Ungsriwong

restaurants.name: Thip Volcanic Fried Mussel & Oyster
restaurants.address:

1022 21 ซอย เจริญนคร 34/2 Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
So delicious!

The Pad Thai with fresh shrimp and shrimp paste was amazing. It was rich and flavorful without being overly sweet or greasy. The taste was perfect without needing any extra seasoning. Highly recommend! ✨
I don't remember the exact price, but it was probably around 120 baht.

The Oyster Platter is another must-try for oyster lovers. I don't know how they store the oysters, but they were incredibly fresh.
The batter for the oyster fritters was crispy, fragrant with egg, and so delicious I wanted to eat the batter alone. The chili sauce is also homemade and adds extra flavor. Highly recommend!
The price was 150 baht, not expensive at all.

If you're in the Charoen Nakhon area, give it a try! The restaurant is next to Ng้วนลี (Ng้วน Lee). It's easy to find.

You can park in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_th.author: Rafrenze (ゆう)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Love it! Delicious, just right, satisfying, and absolutely wonderful!!!

The owner is also amazing!
((In short))

The ingredients are so good. The shrimp are amazing. The shrimp baked with glass noodles is just perfect, so beautiful and full of flavor. The bacon and glass noodles are a real hit! So delicious! The surprise is the minced pork omelet rice!! It's not wrong, it's not sinful. I want to eat it, but it's not too runny, not too mushy, not too oily. I'm confused. Why didn't they mention the Pad Thai with oyster omelet? It's so good, that's why I typed it at the end.

I like this Pad Thai flavor. The shrimp are really good. The oyster omelet is good.

But FYI, I usually don't like oysters. I love the quality of the seasonings here. They use Italian olive oil for frying, not tah! By the way, where have I been? I've never eaten this before, haha.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pang Kate

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're craving oyster omelette, I highly recommend this restaurant. I've been searching for delicious oyster omelettes for ages, and finally found this place. It's not very big, with about 5-6 tables.

My favorite dish here is the Hoi Thop Hoi. The oyster omelette is delicious and not greasy. The restaurant serves their own special oyster omelette sauce, which is not spicy. The crispy bean sprouts and the oyster omelette on top give it a delicious variety of textures.

The Pad Thai is also delicious, with a squeeze of lime for extra flavor.

The baked shrimp with glass noodles is a little sweet.

The crab omelette is also excellent, with large crabs and not greasy.

If you're craving it, I recommend being patient. The chef here is elderly, so expect a bit of a wait. If you're in a hurry, I recommend calling ahead to order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patty Park

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of the best Pad Thai and fried oyster restaurants in Bangkok. The restaurant is air-conditioned and comfortable, with a limited number of tables. Today I ordered the "Oyster on Oyster" (a type of fried seafood omelet). The batter was crispy and delicious, and it came with two types of oysters – mussels on top and oysters on top. It was delicious served with both chili sauce and oyster sauce. There was a generous amount of oysters. The other dish I ordered was the shrimp and crab oyster omelet. It's not on the menu, but I always order it because it's always so delicious. The shrimp and crab are incredibly fresh, and the batter is perfectly seasoned with a mild flavor. It pairs perfectly with the provided seafood dipping sauce. Overall, everything was incredibly delicious. I'll definitely be back often.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittitee Kamonnawin

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is really delicious, but the billing is strange. I ordered the regular Pad Thai with shrimp for 100 baht the first time, but lately I've been charged 135 baht every time. When I asked, they said, "The shrimp are big today, do you know how much they cost per kilo?" Next time, just change the menu. Don't write 100/135 anymore, just write 135 baht per dish. From being a regular customer, I feel this price is inappropriate considering the service and the restaurant's environment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sandy Charlespeterson

sample_reviews_en.text:
As a Malaysian coming from the food heaven state, I can confirm to say that this place is a must visit hidden gem.

The chef’s are the aunties that own the place. You’ll get a home cooked style food here.

The place is air conditioned making eating here very comfortable especially now when the weather is super hot.

Friendly people in this place. Would definitely come again
sample_reviews_en.author: Ng

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been a customer of this restaurant since it was located at Robinson Bang Rak. This new location is much better. The fried oysters aren't too greasy; they use good quality oil. The restaurant is comfortable, but parking is limited. Overall, I still consider this a legendary fried oyster place. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Anne Christmas

sample_reviews_en.text: Worth the wait in line... The fried oysters are crispy on the outside, thin and soft in the middle, and not greasy. The Pad Thai with Chantaburi noodles is also excellent; the noodles are thin, chewy, and have a perfect balance of sweet and sour flavors.
sample_reviews_en.author: vechayan ngernsrisuk

restaurants.name: บะหมี่ - เกี๊ยว ข้าวหมูแดง หมูกรอบ
restaurants.address:

18 On Nut 60 Alley, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a place I've been eating at since it was a street cart until it moved into the alley next to the hospital, opposite Eiam Market. The noodles are delicious, and the char siu pork, crispy pork, and dumplings are amazing. The price is still 50 baht, and they offer free water and ice. The shop is closed every Saturday and Sunday. There's no parking in front of the shop because the alley is narrow. It's better to go by motorcycle or walk. It's about 200 meters from the main road. They don't accept bank transfers; cash only.
sample_reviews_en.author: jaru gill

sample_reviews_en.text: There are both rice, noodles and dumplings, red pork, crispy pork, everything can be ordered, delicious and the price is very friendly. It used to be a cart selling at the corner of Srinut intersection, opposite Aiem Market in the evenings, but now it has moved to sell in the alley. If you drive your own car, it might be difficult to find parking because the road in front of the shop is quite narrow and there are cars parked.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poramet Boonnumsirikij

sample_reviews_en.text: The wonton noodles were delicious; the noodles were good, chewy and soft, and the wontons tasted good too. The char siu pork was decent, but the crispy pork was quite salty. It was okay as a noodle soup, but the crispy pork was too salty when eaten dry. The soup was okay, slightly on the sweet side.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanasit K.

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a shop located in a small alley, but there are tables to sit and eat at. The food is delicious and of high quality. The noodles are amazing, especially when eaten with the crispy pork dumplings. The owner is also friendly and the portions are generous. I highly recommend this shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kantawat

sample_reviews_en.text: It was really delicious! The noodles were very fragrant, the thin noodles were perfectly cooked, the pork dumplings were very tasty, the soup was good, the char siu pork and crispy pork were excellent and generous portions. The price was inexpensive. It was really, really good!
sample_reviews_en.author: Satantantan channel (Yontida Ma Review)

sample_reviews_en.text: The dry noodles, wonton soup, roast pork rice, and crispy pork are all incredibly delicious. If I lived closer, I'd eat there every day. Eating at the restaurant wasn't enough; I always bought some to take home. You should try it; you won't be disappointed, I guarantee it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pranee kaewprasert

sample_reviews_en.text: There's no parking, so I park on the side of the road. Then when I got to the front of someone else's shop, they looked displeased and wouldn't let me park. It's better to say there's no parking. I came to eat near closing time. While I was …
sample_reviews_en.author: Chommy Spice

sample_reviews_en.text: The dry noodles are delicious, I highly recommend them! There's plenty of seating, but parking is limited. You'll have to park at the entrance of the soi (alley) and walk. The food is great!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kuck Oyl

restaurants.name: ผัดไทยคุณยาย หมู่บ้านเสนาวิลล่า ซ.7
restaurants.address:

124 Happyland Rd, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Delicious and affordable (regular ฿45, with shrimp ฿65). The flavor is predominantly sour, like tamarind, different from typical Pad Thai I've had, but overall it's tasty.

P.S. We bought it to take home today because of the air pollution in Bangkok lately; we didn't eat at the restaurant.
sample_reviews_th.author: Pathitta D.

sample_reviews_th.text: The authentic Pad Thai I've been searching for is delicious! It has 4 shrimp for 85฿, a great price.
sample_reviews_th.author: noopang luksameenet

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Pad Thai noodles are chewy and delicious.
But if you don't like it sweet, you might want to tell the chef beforehand.
Because it's a little on the sweet side.
Squeeze some lime and add a bit of chili powder, and it's delicious.
I like the shrimp in the fresh shrimp Pad Thai (cooked shrimp).
The fresh shrimp is delicious; I ate it with the shell on!
The hibiscus juice at the restaurant is very tasty and concentrated, but I had to dilute it with water because it was too strong, haha.
There are 4 tables to sit at next to the shop. If you go at the wrong time or during peak hours with many orders, you might have to wait a while.
Because the restaurant also accepts orders through delivery apps.

Parking: There's parking for about 2 cars in front of the shop.
You'll have to find parking in the nearby alleys or in front of people's houses where you think you can park. I don't think there are any "no parking" signs.
sample_reviews_en.author: kiNg pAkma

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered from them for home delivery a couple of weeks ago, and I ordered again today. The taste is excellent. The shrimp is fresh and fragrant, and the Pad Thai has a well-balanced flavor. I love the chewy noodles, and the combination with chopped mango and crushed peanuts is delicious. The crispy pork rinds are the best part! The Pad Thai is reasonably priced for the portion size. The restaurant itself is also nice, with a village atmosphere, shaded by trees, and only four tables. The food didn't take long to arrive. This is truly authentic traditional Pad Thai. Those who are used to modernized Pad Thai should try this; the taste is different. I've tried many places, and this traditional style is hard to find. It's delicious and satisfying.
sample_reviews_en.author: kwankhao kantawong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Traditional Pad Thai with Fresh Shrimp: This dish shows great attention to detail in the ingredients. The noodles are soft and the flavor is rich. The shrimp is excellent—fresh, fragrant, with crispy heads and tails that are easy to chew. The fresh vegetables are delicious, and it even includes mango. The highlight is the homemade crispy pork cracklings, which are incredibly fragrant and made from rendered pork fat. At 65 baht, it's excellent value.

Chrysanthemum Tea: Worth trying; it'll transport you back to your childhood.
Roselle Juice: Sweet and rich, even better with ice.
Longan Juice: Fragrant longan with delicious pulp.

Located at the entrance of Soi 7.
sample_reviews_en.author: StariO2D

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a small shop with incredibly high quality. The owner pays close attention to flavor, uses top-quality ingredients, and the cooking technique, aroma, and overall quality are excellent. The owner is also very friendly.

The Pad Thai is incredibly flavorful and delicious. The price is unbelievable for this quality.

I had a great conversation with the owner; they were very friendly and had a wonderful perspective. They care deeply about their family and have a well-established system. I was extremely impressed and will definitely be back. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ice Apitsada

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small shop with two tables located in Sena Village 84. Parking is available in the village. If there's an open spot on the main road in front of the shop, you can park.

The Pad Thai with sour mango and pork rinds was delicious, but not for those who don't like sweet things. It was too sweet. It would have been even better if the sweetness was reduced.

The Roselle juice was also good. It was rich, very sweet, and a little sour. I felt it was a great value. 1 bottle is 15 baht. You can mix it with water to make 3-4 bottles of Roselle juice. 😆
sample_reviews_en.author: Cha Cha

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pad Thai is very delicious. I have ordered it before and it was delicious, but eating it at the restaurant is more delicious. The sauce coats the noodles very well. I like that there are mangoes and pork rinds. The total amount is a lot.
Fresh shrimp 65, regular 45, good price.

There are not many tables in the restaurant. Sit under the trees. If the weather is hot, it might be a bit hot. But the weather is good now, so it's okay. You can park on the side of the road.

Congratulations on the spoon award.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angsupa Phachala

restaurants.name: Beef & Bone
restaurants.address:

17, 78 Nawamin 111 Aly, Nawamin, Bueng Kum, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: High quality of meat! Would recommend to reserve the meat before you arrive. Pork ribs are amazing as well (was too hungry so i forgot to take a photo😅). Tender & soft. Not dried at all! The atmosphere is great with the live music and the staff is very attentive. Received a complimentary wine as a gift from the restaurant as I celebrated my birthday there. Definitely worth to visit and I will for sure go back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Patsachon Niyomthai

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best experiences we've had in Bangkok. From the moment we walked in, the team welcomed us like family, warm, attentive, and genuinely lovely throughout. The food was outstanding, easily the best steaks we've found in the city. A wonderful evening from start to finish. We can't wait to come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Caleb Govender

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious! I didn't have time to take pictures before I started eating. If you want to try the top items, order them in advance as they take 45 minutes to prepare because they slow cook. That way you won't have to wait. But other items that don't require waiting are also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: ome Ga3

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is very well-designed; it feels relaxing to sit down.
The tables are spaced far apart, providing a good level of privacy.
The Aus. Wagyu Rib-eye was grilled perfectly, with a lovely smoky aroma. The meat was tender and easy to chew, not tough at all. I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: jackie jatuporn

sample_reviews_en.text: Great-quality beef—tender and delicious. The staff were friendly, the atmosphere was lovely, and the music was excellent. Highly recommended! 🥩✨
sample_reviews_en.author: GUNN PACHARAKIJCHAROEN

sample_reviews_en.text: The steak was incredibly delicious! The meat was so tender. I didn't get a chance to take a picture because it was gone so quickly. Everything
sample_reviews_en.author: Duangjai Buakhwa

sample_reviews_en.text: It's so delicious! I've been here many times. The steak and the beef tongue are incredibly delicious, you have to try them! 🤤🤤
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirawit Khantaraksawong

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my second time here. The beef tongue is delicious! Call to reserve a table beforehand so you don't have to wait long.
sample_reviews_en.author: PRANG S

restaurants.name: Nourish
restaurants.address:

2 Witthayu Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Oh gosh, look at those peacocks! Anyways, I’ve had some of my best breakfasts at Nourish, the restaurant that basically carries the Movenpick BDMS on its back. Sure, it doesn’t dive deep into Bangkok street food or classic Thai flavors, but it sticks to its theme: clean, healthy meals that actually make you feel like you’ve made a responsible life choice. True to its name, you leave feeling nourished instead of guilty.

Our server, Tao, deserves a medal—or at least a free coffee—because he’s the kind of person who notices when you need caffeine before you even do. He even handed me a to-go cup, which is basically the breakfast equivalent of a standing ovation. The rest of the staff are just as pleasant, smiling like they’ve all had three green smoothies and a life coach pep talk before their shift. Fresh, healthy options everywhere, great service, and coffee that follows you out the door. Honestly, the only thing missing is a treadmill by the exit to complete the “wellness” experience. Wait, they actually have that too!
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a chance to check out the hotel buffet that’s been suggested to me by Trip Advisor, and I’ve got to say, it's a pleasant surprise. Nan and her team nailed it with their attentive service and genuine smiles.

The spread was all about quality ingredients, which you could taste in every bite. The chicken soup noodle was the star for me. It had this homey, heartwarming flavor that kind of just hugged you from the inside. The noodles had that perfect chew, and the broth was seasoned to perfection.

Everthing I tried was fresh, and you could tell they were all about the natural goodness of the ingredients. Even the veggies in the stir-fry had that just-picked taste.

The ambiance added to the healing vibe, making it more than just a meal—it was like a mini-retreat. They've got something good going here, a place that serves up not just food, but a whole mood. Definitely leaving satisfied and feeling healthier than when I walked in. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thảo Linh Phạm

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nourish at Mövenpick Bangkok deserves every bit of its praise.

It's rare to find a place that makes you pause and appreciate the morning ritual of breaking fast.
I left each breakfast not just satiated, but with a sense of having partaken in something special.

Each dish presented a masterclass in freshness, with a plethora of options that catered to an international palate while paying homage to the rich, local Thai flavors.

The selection was extensive, featuring everything from succulent fruits, sliced to perfection, to an array of artisanal bread and pastries that could easily grace the windows of a Parisian boulangerie. The attention to detail was evident in the perfectly seasoned savory dishes, the indulgent sweetness of the pastries, and the aromatic bliss of freshly brewed coffee that harmonized with the quiet buzz of satisfied diners.

This is a gem worth sharing, highly recommend for fellow travelers to experience. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Huan Vu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very disappointing. Went for lunch. We were the only customers. The whole place was empty.
When we arrived nobody showed us to a table or brought us water or menus. They just kind of pointed at the tables. The tables had iPads with menus but they had passcodes on them.
We sat there waiting then had to yell out. It was empty so it wasn't like they were busy.  We complained politely that it was unacceptable. From then on we received the service we should have received from the beginning.
The food here is not cheap. We had two starters, 3 mains and 2 beers and it came to 2200 baht.
The spring rolls with smoked salmon were nice but the rest was mediocre at best.
Everything came out luke warm to cold.
I can see why it's empty. Not sure how they possibly keep the place open with nobody there and such average food and service. With so many great offerings in Bangkok we won't be returning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Samuels

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’m going to gush about this place, so be ready for a long review. The white peacocks, the huge glass window, the staff and healthy food combined into a perfect bday lunch for my mom.

Not only did they have a wonderful choice of vegan menu, but was kind enough to show each dish’s calories. Our favorite was the Buddha Bowl, don’t let the gentle name fool you, the wasabi sauce was delightful and refreshing.

Four staff (khun Nan, M, Baitoey and one other staff) kept my mom engaged in friendly, polite conversations, and knew when to leave us to enjoy our meals. The kitchen surprised my mom with a lovely chocolate cake too, thank you for making the old girl laugh, good medicine for the heart.

I will definitely come back again. Special thanks to khun Pang - the manager who drop by to check everything was going well at our table!
sample_reviews_en.author: N Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nourish – BDMS Wellness Clinic (Lunch Buffet) 🥗🍲

Nourish offers a full-fledged, healthy "Eat Clean" lunch buffet.
The food line includes a salad bar with fresh organic vegetables and low-fat homemade dressings,
hot vegetable soups, and protein-rich options like herb-baked chicken breast and lemon-baked fish.
Whole grains and various cereals are also available to customize your dish.

Desserts are also health-conscious, featuring low-fat yogurt, fresh fruit,
and low-sugar sweets that you can enjoy guilt-free.

The restaurant's atmosphere is bright, clean, and minimalist.
It's perfect for a post-health check-up meal or a healthy lunch break.

This meal is ideal for those who want a complete and nutritious meal,
while knowing it's good for your body. 🍃

#EatAnywhere #NourishCafe #BDMSWellness #HealthyBuffet
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachit Chairat

sample_reviews_en.text:
ABSOLUTELY DELICIOUS!!!
Went to NOURISH for Christmas Day Brunch. Not only was the buffet huge with so many choices, the presentation was magnificent and the food was absolutely delicious! It didn’t only look good but the taste was fabulous. The selection of desserts was amazing. The service and non alcoholic mocktails were excellent as well. Sincere thanks to Khun Pang, the Restaurant Manager, who helped make numerous changes to my reservation with people being added a few times. She was wonderful! I went to the Banyan Tree the Christmas before and it could not even come close to NOURISH! I know where I will be for Christmas 2026 ☺️Compliments to the Chefs and Service team for putting on a Christmas spread of note!!! My pics say it all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steven B

sample_reviews_en.text:
Another highlight we cannot forget to mention is the "Nourish" all-day dining restaurant, where we enjoyed all three of our meals. We started with a delightful dinner, followed by a buffet breakfast, and a Sunday lunch, all of which were thoughtfully crafted under the concept of "Health brings Wealth." I particularly loved their selection of cold-pressed juices, organized into 4 Groups: A, B, C, and D. Additionally, their Signature International Dishes, which include Japanese, Western, Indian, and Thai foods, were equally impressive.

I recommend this restaurant to everyone who loves to experience tasty & healthy food and exceptional service from their staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shilin Kanishthanaga

restaurants.name: Good Roots Sathorn
restaurants.address:

1st Floor, Sathorn Square, 98 N Sathon Rd, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I eat at this restaurant very often. I love their sushi burrito; I highly recommend it. I eat it every week! I love that the rice is crispy inside – it's delicious. You should eat this dish quickly if you order it, otherwise the rice will lose its crispness. Their beef basil fried rice is also amazing; adding an onsen egg makes it even better! The miso salmon and miso tofu are also tasty. I've ordered their salads before, and they're all delicious. It's healthy food that's easy to eat, with vegetables in every dish, and the flavors are good – not bland or dry. They also provide complete calorie and nutritional information, perfect for people on a diet, making it easy to track calories and protein intake.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimyada Kuansataporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good Roots Sathon is a nice café conveniently located in the yard of the W Hotel in Bangkok, making it easy to access for hotel guests and locals. The atmosphere is relaxed, suitable for a casual lunch or a hearty breakfast.

The menu offers a variety of options, with the avocado toasts being a standout choice. The salads are fresh and flavorful, and they also serve some interesting smoothies that include chicken, which is worth trying if you're looking for something different.

Overall, Good Roots Sathon provides a solid dining option with good food and a convenient location, making it a worthwhile stop if you're in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oleg D

sample_reviews_en.text: My first time trying a chicken breast smoothie!!! I decided to give it a try because the staff were so nice and gave great recommendations, explaining the ingredients. I chose the Honey Yuzu chicken breast smoothie. It was tangy and fragrant, with chewy chicken breast pieces that weren't gamey at all. It was easy to drink and didn't feel forced. One bottle provides 60g of protein, making it a great protein drink option. It's so good, I just had to write a review! 🤩💪🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: Juthathip Intaramana

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the Chicken Kimchi Bowl for 260 baht.
Considering the price, it's not expensive at all. The portion is generous.
Every menu item clearly shows the calorie count. This one is 487 calories.
It's grilled chicken breast, which might be a little dry for some people.
The side dishes include kimchi, cabbage, stir-fried spinach, and Hong Kong kale. Overall, it's delicious and healthy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chatlada N.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food is quite tasty but takes usually quite some time even the restaurant is empty.
A few times they mixed up my order or forgot the order of my colleagues.
Portions are small, even the “large” one and now they increased the prices - and the amount of “egg salad” you get in your wrap please see yourself below.
Will definitely go here less often.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fabi Flöt

sample_reviews_en.text: They advertise each chicken shake as having 60g of protein, but it’s made with just one chicken breast. That’s roughly 100g of chicken, which is closer to 30g of protein, not 60g. This feels like false advertising. I asked the staff to explain or provide nutritional info, but they couldn’t give a clear answer and seemed unsure themselves.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jorge Luis Santovenia II

sample_reviews_en.text: Didn’t get to go to the restaurant yet, but Order take away at first the salmon appeared really pale and I was a little skeptical, but it tasted really good. Every component in the bowl is good all the vegetable as well as the rice will definitely go visit the store to try other dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: j s

sample_reviews_en.text: I love the Tunacado dish; they're very generous with the avocado. The ingredients are top-notch, and the taste is great. It's a very filling breakfast that will keep you going until the afternoon. Luckily, I came on a day with a 15% discount for dine-in, valid until April 10th, 2024.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitiya Chantaphao

restaurants.name: BUCKY BURGER N BUDS
restaurants.address:

Sophon Building, 104 Walking St, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the chicken burger for 89B (95B including 7% VAT).

This is a highly-rated restaurant. It was my first visit, and it was as delicious as the reviews said.

The chicken patty is shaped into a flat sheet and grilled on a griddle.
The meat was perfectly cooked, and I could really taste the chicken's flavor.

The bun was fluffy. However, they spread margarine (or something similar) on the inside of the bun before grilling it on the griddle to make it crispy. Perhaps this is a technique to prevent the juices and sauces from the chicken patty from soaking into the bun.

I seasoned it to my liking using the mustard and mayonnaise provided.

I watched the preparation process, and the staff were incredibly focused. You could see their sincerity in their approach to making hamburgers.

I've uploaded the menu with prices.

As mentioned earlier, please note that the displayed price plus 7% VAT will be the final payment. (The pricing is transparent.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Syo Kei

sample_reviews_en.text:
I didn’t realise that I had eaten at this particular Bucky’s Burger n Buds @ Walking Street a few years ago. The reason why I came here tonight is because I was in need for a good burger for supper and one that opened quite late in the morning since it was already 1am+.

Anyway, I ordered and took away the bacon cheeseburger (169 baht before tax) and a 6 piece chicken wings (99 baht before tax). The burger is consistently awesome at either branches for this price point.

This will be my go to burger joint in Pattaya from now on since the other burger places charge about 260 baht and up.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adrian Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
It is seriously f***ing delicious.

I just went there because I was feeling peckish after drinking. Even though it was a street stall, it was so clean that my expectations were high, but it was actually surprisingly delicious.

It’s even better than the burgers I’ve had in the U.S. If you really want a burger, don't go to the famous chains; make sure you try it here. You absolutely won't regret it.
sample_reviews_en.author: ビン

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the better burgers I've had in SEA. I had the double cheeseburger with some hot sauce on it. Really good place to get a late night meal after a few drinks. Gotta get a little more lettuce and onions on there but besides that it was a pretty damn good burger.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Chlan

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place for a burger near Walking Street. 99 baht for smash single burger 🍔 is really good value. The kitchen is very clean too. If you are eating burgers at McDonald's and Burgers King on WS, you are missing out on this joint.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thaigerr86

sample_reviews_en.text: Best burger in WalkingStreet area! Almost as good as old owner. 99 THB for a standard burger good price and beef of good quality. Very noisy area recommend takeaway. Allways grab a burger or 2 when visiting this area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dave Legendary [Notforsale]

sample_reviews_en.text: It's inside between the bars... There is green lightening of beer chang... Cook is professional, very good work, burger was delicious but the bun could be bigger quality
sample_reviews_en.author: Juseppe EU

sample_reviews_en.text: Great cheeseburger. Location is very central in the middle of everything on Walking Street but that also means it comes with loud music from several directions
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Putz

748/9 Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
A spicy Northeastern Thai fusion restaurant in the heart of Bangkok. The flavors are bold, the ingredients are generous, and the taste is incredibly delicious and satisfying! 🥵

🔥Promotion: Fried Foie Gras with Garlic 99฿ until the end of this year!!

📍Jarung Ros Zaap
🚇 BTS Saphan Khwai
⏱️ Open 5 PM - 1 AM (Closed every Monday)

#JarungRosZaap #NortheasternThaiFood #Delicious #MustTry
sample_reviews_th.author: Ploypailin Pathinthanapon

sample_reviews_th.text: Wow, the taste was amazing! The price and quality of the food were very reasonable. The foie gras was on sale for 99฿. The restaurant is very close to BTS Saphan Khwai station, just a short walk away. I'll definitely come back again. The fermented fish sauce was incredibly flavorful.
sample_reviews_th.author: SR

sample_reviews_en.text:
“⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Jarungrod Zapp is the ultimate modern Isan experience! The food is incredibly spicy.
🧡 The foie gras melts in your mouth. 💜 The crispy, yet well-balanced, sticky rice with shrimp paste is spicy and flavorful.
💚 The spicy salmon and shrimp paste salad is a perfect balance of sweet, sour, and salty.
🤎 The Isan sausage comes in two flavors: sour chili and spicy larb. The spicy aroma of the spices wafts up your nose.
🩵 The young coconut papaya salad is incredibly sweet and crunchy. 👍 I personally love this dish because I like a little sweetness.
🤎 The thin rice vermicelli salad with pork rinds is incredibly crispy.
🧡 The grilled rice is fragrant.
💚 The sweet fried rice noodles are childlike.
Plus, the restaurant's chill atmosphere is easy to get to via any BTS station, but only Saphan Khwai. I highly recommend trying every dish!
👍👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: BABY THAIGIRL

sample_reviews_en.text:
No matter how late it is, Som Tum (papaya salad) is always within easy reach❣️🌶️
"Jarungrod Zapp"
.
This Isaan fusion restaurant is open until 1 AM‼️ It's amazing and cool. In this day and age, you can eat Som Tum anytime. For those who love Isaan food, there's a wide variety of dishes. 👉Easy to get to, right next to BTS Saphan Khwai station.
.
It's become our regular spot. Whenever we get together with friends, we always go here. Isaan lovers shouldn't miss it.
.
📍Jarungrod Zapp
⏰5 PM - 1 AM (Closed every Monday)
🚗Parking available in front of the restaurant
sample_reviews_en.author: Nammon Rattaseree

sample_reviews_en.text:
The flavors are perfectly balanced, a 10/10, no deductions at all.
This roadside restaurant offers a variety of dishes, including à la carte options, but today I ordered some salads. The crispy pork was incredibly crispy, the shrimp was super fresh, and the taste was amazing.
The grilled beef was so good it melted in my mouth.
The papaya salad was fantastic, truly complete.
Finally, a beer or two to finish it off was perfect. It's near the BTS, so you can get a little tipsy and head home chill.
sample_reviews_en.author: บ่าว สุรกิจ ส. กดติดตามได้รีวิวตามจริง

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been there with friends, and everyone agrees that the restaurant uses very high-quality ingredients. Every dish was fresh, clean, and delicious. The staff were friendly and provided excellent service. The food also didn't take long to arrive.

I highly recommend the Salmon and Shrimp Paste Mango Salad and the Crispy Pork Rind Noodle Salad. They are incredibly delicious and spicy!

Importantly, the restaurant is near Saphan Khwai BTS station, making it very convenient to get to.
sample_reviews_en.author: bbb

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely delicious!! After wandering around Chatuchak Market for several hours, we passed by this restaurant, and the Google reviews convinced us to eat there!
The flavors of the dishes were just incredible!!! We love Thai food and know quite a few restaurants in Bangkok now, but this time we were blown away, and I'm not exaggerating! Plus, the prices are reasonable, so don't hesitate to try it :) I highly recommend it and will definitely be back!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Maggy LEP

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is a hidden gem! Pok was so nice to us, and the food was delicious. We had a flavorful pinnacle fried rice and a perfectly caramelized pork fried rice. It was the kind of food that reminds you of home and makes you smile. They clearly put a lot of care into this seemingly new restaurant. I really hope they’ll be more popular. 😊 Sorry that I forgot to take more photos, and only have a photo of the tasty coconut salad. 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Bao Chau Pham Nguyen

restaurants.address:

12.930483610113463, 100.88120517843575284, 1 Pattaya Sai Song Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Breakfast was at a restaurant near the hotel. I ordered a rice porridge-like dish that wasn't on the menu, which the Thai person next to me was eating (70 THB). I regretted not ordering noodles, but it wasn't bad.
sample_reviews_en.author: O A

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was great, initially I ordered noodles but they weren't available anymore. At the end they forgot to remove from the bill but they honestly admitted the error
sample_reviews_en.author: Alessio Vecchiet

sample_reviews_en.text: I really like the fried sea bass with fish sauce at this restaurant. The price is reasonable and the service is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ming Jamjuree

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the staff are lovely and always smiling. I highly recommend this restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: มลฤดี พุทสา

sample_reviews_en.text: Good service, delicious and flavorful food. You can stop by for a meal no matter how late it is.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pascal Raymond

sample_reviews_en.text: Located on the main road, the food is delicious and the staff provides excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: P. Pat Phat

restaurants.name: Ballad Riverside Rooftop Bar & Restaurant
restaurants.address:

59 Rat Burana 11 Alley, บางปะกอก, Rat Burana, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
This newly opened restaurant has a great atmosphere and a beautiful river view. The food and drinks offer a wide variety of choices, both Western and Asian, and the prices are reasonable.

(Note: The repeated phrase "รักบรรยากาศ และวิวแม่น้ำสวย This restaurant We loved the atmosphere and the great view of the Chao Praya River. The food and drinks have good variety and are not pricy" is a separate, unrelated comment and has been omitted from the translation.)
sample_reviews_th.author: Mim T

sample_reviews_en.text:
The reservation system was terrible. I booked a table online, specifying a table number and time, but when I arrived, someone was already seated. The staff said they'd been there for a long time and offered me another table to wait, which was completely unacceptable. I wanted to move to another restaurant, but that would waste time, so I went to the rooftop instead. Luckily, the atmosphere was great and it didn't rain. The view and ambiance from the rooftop were fantastic, and the staff were lovely.

On my way back down, I found a band playing incredibly loud music. The staff said they were a private band that had booked the entire place. I don't understand why they would book the whole place and then open it up to other customers in the first place. Why not have a private room or just book it completely without accepting other customers? It was very disruptive and ruined the atmosphere.
I hope the restaurant will improve its management of this. It's a shame because the restaurant is beautiful, the view is great, the atmosphere is good, the food is okay, and the staff are lovely and provide good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanyamat Wannaothong

sample_reviews_en.text:
We booked a restaurant for dinner and photos with friends almost a month in advance, but then the restaurant called to cancel. We were furious because they initially showed no responsibility. We had already bought a birthday cake in advance.
I admit I spoke disrespectfully, using informal language because I was with my friends. The restaurant offered a 10% discount, which we declined. They offered a private room, and when we asked if there was a charge, they said it was free. We understood that free services should be provided properly, not treated like this. There were tables and chairs piled up, and even the black tablecloths didn't completely cover them. The restroom was downstairs. What I've written in the chat reflects the actual situation. We had 9 friends with us, and they said the restaurant didn't show them any respect. So we ordered food costing around 2,300 baht, took photos, and left quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naphat Akkarawong

sample_reviews_en.text: I went for lunch. The food was delicious and the atmosphere was nice, but the service was a shame. I regret the 10% service charge. From the moment I entered, I didn't see a single smile from the staff. I ordered pizza initially, and even after being reminded, it didn't arrive, forcing me to wait for a new one. Finished plates weren't cleared; they just piled up on the table. I had to ask them to clear them because I ordered more food and there was no space. They served three glasses of water at once, but simply placed them in the corner of the table without bringing them to me. This needs improvement, especially if they're going to charge 10%.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nath Pipat

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a riverside bar on the Chao Phraya River with a fantastic atmosphere, live music, excellent service, and delicious food. The menu features a fusion of Italian and Thai cuisine. The Thai food was incredibly delicious! We ordered the pomelo salad with fresh shrimp and the salmon chu chee curry, which were the best dishes of the meal. I expected the Thai food at this style of restaurant to be quite ordinary, but it was surprisingly good. The music was also great and perfectly complemented the atmosphere. The restaurant's style is beautiful, decorated in white, cream, and red tones. Even the tableware is pretty and matches the theme.
sample_reviews_en.author: Achariya Tringamwattana

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a great atmosphere. I love the large windows that offer a full view of the river. They serve both Thai and Western food, and the prices are reasonable. There's live bands in the evenings, making it perfect for a fun date with friends or a night out. The rooftop is also great for taking sunset photos.

(Note: The repeated phrase "Great atmosphere with amazing river view. It offers both Thai and Western dishes and a wine list. Good value for money. Good place for group of friends or a date night. Tip to go to rooftop for sunset photo." is a separate, unrelated statement and has been omitted from the translation.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Turk Supachanya

sample_reviews_en.text:
The reservation system is terrible. I made a reservation yesterday and received a confirmation, so I assumed everything was confirmed. However, I decided to double-check with the restaurant via LINE, and they told me they had a private event on that day, so my reservation was not valid.

I recommend that anyone booking online contact the restaurant directly to confirm their reservation. Otherwise, you may waste your time because there is no notification if your booking is cancelled or unavailable.
sample_reviews_en.author: นราทิตย์ จันทร์ผ่อง

sample_reviews_en.text:
We asked for a table arranged in a long line for our group, but the manager said no, the tables had to be arranged horizontally as the restaurant had initially planned. This was despite the fact that there were no other tables available except for another group celebrating a birthday, who were seated far apart but in a shared area.
They were singing karaoke while quite drunk, and we had to sit and listen.
The food was okay, but the portions were small, served on large plates.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rinrapas Prem

restaurants.name: 965bkk
restaurants.address:

965 Soi Wanit 2, Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A good looking cafe whose whole premise is to attract the “Instagram crowd” (despite what the owner says in their unprofessional replies to some of the reviews). That alone should indicate to you that this is a cafe for posers.

The food? Ridiculously small portions and overpriced.

The crowd? Well…despite their “no photos on stairs or walkways” rule there were a couple of ladyboys wearing nothing but a string over their behinds that took over the whole space for photos. Then there were the girls being passive aggressive as they competed for photo spots with everyone else, and so on. So this is not a “nice cafe to relax and grab a coffee at”.

Staff? Nothing to write home about. Our server was nice though.

Advice: get rid of the rules around taking photos. Enforcing them alienates your customers. Just walk across their shoots if you need to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shahriar Siddiqui

sample_reviews_en.text: My first visit was because I happened to be walking by and decided to take a look. I just had my camera slung around my neck, as people usually do when they're out taking pictures in that area. I hadn't even taken it out of the store yet when a staff member loudly and sternly confronted me, repeatedly saying in English, "No photography!" I politely explained that I understood and that I'm Thai, thinking they might have misunderstood me as a foreigner, but they didn't listen to my response. They just kept shouting, "No photography! No photography!" Should I have responded sternly or rudely to get them to speak politely? Now, I don't even want to walk past it anymore. 🫥
sample_reviews_en.author: Penelopy

sample_reviews_en.text:
965 Cultural Center – definitely something different

An interesting and unusual place that you won't necessarily find on every Bangkok list. That's precisely why I enjoyed my visit.

The location has its own unique character and offers some truly beautiful and extraordinary photo opportunities. It's not your typical tourist trap, but rather a place to discover, wander around, and observe.

If you want to explore Bangkok beyond the temples, malls, and usual tourist attractions, this is definitely a place to stop.

For me, it's another typical Bangkok moment: You go somewhere, not quite sure what to expect – and in the end, you're glad you went.
sample_reviews_en.author: Timm Brenzel

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place to unwind. This is an old building converted to a cafe. Not too crowded which is a plus. Friendly staff. The receptionist lady (san! Can’t recall her name properly and apology for that) was friendly and briefed the history of the place. Found the food little overpriced compared to the portion they serve. Specially the tea. But I traded the issue with happiness. Guests maintained and respected the quiet environment. I would recommend some light readings on tables if possible. Will be back again if I visit that area in future.
sample_reviews_en.author: samiha samiha

sample_reviews_en.text: Old house turned to cafe and shop. This is the place for photos, appreciate the old town, sit back and chitchat with friends. Limited drinks menu just for afternoon tea/coffee break not a full cafe. All staff are not Thai but they can speak Thai and English. If you expect cafe and bakery this place is not for you but if you like art 🖼️ and old town, this is the place for you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rapheephan Thanduan

sample_reviews_en.text: If I could have stayed there longer I would have. An absolutely stunning environment, beautifully refurbished 200 year-old building, and very kind people. I wish they served something to eat because I would have stayed for a few hours more. Reading and writing while the rain was drizzling and delicious flat white in hand…a dream. Can’t wait to be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aline Badr

sample_reviews_en.text:
Truly my favorite place in BKK!
It brings me so much peace just staying there listening to the music, staring at the many plants moving in the wind. Drinks & food are great too (especially the espresso flavor). Staff very welcoming. Idk if I'm ever turning into a ghost this is the place I wanna haunt forever
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex Grigorie

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice place! I actually don’t know where the bad reviews come from. The owner was super cute and asked me and my girlfriend if we wanted to do a fotoshoot which she did free of charge (she knows all the right angles). All in all I give solid 5 stars. The cafe opens only on weekends :)
sample_reviews_en.author: k g

restaurants.name: Versailles Restaurant
restaurants.address:

45/43-44 ถนน จรัญสนิทวงศ์ Wat Tha Phra, Bangkok Yai, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The buffet costs 459 baht. The service is good, the staff, especially the lovely older lady, is chatty and the atmosphere is nice with cool air conditioning. However, the food quality is a letdown.
I only liked the shrimp fritters, steamed fish with lime, steamed fish with soy sauce, and the pork ribs with sauce and black bean sauce.
Everything else was unappetizing and unbearable. I'm definitely not going back.
Most of the dim sum items listed as shrimp on the menu had way too much pork fat mixed in. It was very juicy and sickeningly rich.
I felt nauseous all night and couldn't sleep.
The shrimp dumplings, which should have been delicious, were not at all.
I've never encountered a restaurant with such terrible shrimp dumplings before.
The shrimp with corn also had a strange, unpleasant smell, like it was spoiled. Did they steam leftovers from the previous day?
One time is enough!
sample_reviews_en.author: Toshio【年男】

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a friendly atmosphere, and the staff are welcoming and provide good service. They refilled our chrysanthemum tea generously. We didn't opt ​​for the buffet; we ordered individual dishes at 65 baht each, except for the special menu items which we didn't order. We weren't happy with the soup menu; for example, the bamboo shoot soup in the picture was tiny, like a dipping sauce bowl. It was a bit disappointing. The taste was okay, but it was extremely expensive. If you're not going for the buffet, I wouldn't recommend ordering it. Order something else instead. Is it worth 65 baht per dish? The buffet is more worthwhile. We ordered 5 dishes plus drinks (I'm not sure how much), and the total was over 400 baht. For us, we thought it was expensive, but we might come back to try the buffet again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pika Parn

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is still a quality dim sum restaurant. Memories of eating there as a child are cherished. The food is still incredibly delicious. If you have the chance, please consider supporting this restaurant. They now have a buffet, booked through Hungry Hub, at a very reasonable price of just over 400 baht.

Besides the food (the buffet we went to), you can also order a la carte.

Of course, there are more luxurious restaurants with better taste. But with this price, this atmosphere, this taste, and this quality, this place remains a legend that has endured for a long time.

I'm impressed with the staff who are still there and have served everyone for so long. They're attentive, like adults who care for us, to the point of feeling embarrassed. The atmosphere is relaxed and lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: SITTIKORN G.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I happened to eat there one evening and saw that they have a dim sum buffet during the day, so I invited my family to come again. The dim sum pieces are huge and taste pretty good. They have a handmade, not mass-produced, taste. The flavor might not be consistent, but it's satisfying. Eating a lot might be overwhelming, but there are other dishes to balance it out. It's very filling, so I recommend ordering a little bit of each to try first because they are huge.

I recommend the garlic dumplings and the chive dumplings.
sample_reviews_en.author: T-ra missu

sample_reviews_en.text: People who choose the buffet shouldn't have a problem; the taste is good and the service is good. We ordered a la carte, but the prices on the menu didn't match. We ordered Hakka-style pork sausage, which was listed at 250 baht on the menu, but was charged over 300 baht. We pointed it out, but the restaurant said they had increased prices but hadn't updated the menu yet. We really liked everything about the restaurant, but this experience was very upsetting, and we don't want to go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Katoon Fendi

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don't understand the hype around this place. As a person from Hong Kong it's food is just alright, it's really just mid in all honesty. But the price is pretty reasonable, even considering the ok quality of the food.

The service is top notch which is expected from this level of establishment, it exceeds    this expectation however due to every individual waitresses attentiveness and sincerity.

Its atmosphere reminds me of the 80-90's and gives off a very homey feel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gladiator Cows

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old, established Chinese restaurant. I've eaten here every Chinese New Year, Mid-Autumn Festival, Father's Day, and Mother's Day.
The food is delicious in every dish.
The service is quick and efficient from the long-time staff.
We've become quite close.
I recommend making a reservation during holidays.
However, the prices have become quite expensive lately.
So I don't come as often as before.
There is ample parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natta

sample_reviews_en.text: I went for lunch on a Sunday afternoon. The entrance to the restaurant was very dark with no lights on. After eating, I personally thought the fried taro was delicious. The other dishes were just okay, but there were no customers at all. The elderly woman who greeted us (I'm not sure if she was the owner) said that the main restaurant would be closing around the end of the year, but the Nonthaburi branch would still be open.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sopa Boonleuang

restaurants.name: Freelax Café & Restaurant
restaurants.address:

406/47,Moo9,Soi-Bongkod-3 Pattaya 3rd road Lamung District, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Not "TENDER" loin, just an edge of fillet!

My partner and I ordered two sets of the set menu.

The soup and appetizers were unremarkable and mediocre.

The tenderloin steak wasn't tenderloin at all; it was probably the very end of the fillet. It seemed they used the thinnest part that couldn't be sliced, resulting in a lot of sinew, very tough, and not tasty. Fillet usually cooks quickly, but this cut must have taken a long time to cook. Furthermore, it wasn't seasoned with salt or pepper at all, so the flavor of the meat was completely lost. It seems someone who doesn't know how to cook or handle meat cooked it.

The cream caramel for dessert was the hardest and most excessively sweet I've ever eaten.

However, the bread was all-you-can-eat, and the olive oil on the table was very fragrant and of high quality. These two points were satisfactory.


Offering such a set menu for around 400 baht must be difficult, but even taking that into account, this visit was simply disappointing.

The reviews seem positive, but I think they're a bit overrated.
sample_reviews_en.author: 小池健太郎

sample_reviews_en.text:
What a great value set menu for lunch. 3 courses for 200 baht plus any beverages.

The summer set menu has six starters or appetizers plus six options for the main course and four choices for dessert.

Sitting in the outside area is very pleasant at the moment with a nice coolish breeze making fans unnecessary. Of course that means you will encounter the smokers, so if you want to be further away, take a seat inside.

Service is very prompt and friendly, with the French tradition of a bread basket being provided on all tables continuing.

You certainly will not leave there hungry.

The a la carte menu is very comprehensive and reasonably priced although didn't order anything from it on this occasion.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Kalisch

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is worthy of being called a French diner. Most of the customers are French residents. The value for money is incredibly high, with a set meal of soup, salad, main course, dessert, and an after-meal drink costing around 300 baht. The price of the set varies depending on the main course, but if you order a steak, the rib eye is tender and recommended. The meat is quite red if you order it medium, so if you like it well-done, I recommend ordering it well-done. The dessert is not too sweet, which is to Japanese taste, and they will change your after-meal drink to tea if you don't like coffee. It's a comfortable restaurant with good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: けちけちサリー

sample_reviews_en.text:
On my second visit on Sat. 3-22, I got there at 7:30 and the place was very busy. I eat the soup, salad and ice cream, 90 minutes later I asked where is my beef stew and mash potato? The waitress said she has serve it to me. I asked her to ask the kitchen if the beef stew had been made.  The middle age kitchen lady claim I had eaten the food.
I am 60 years old and only weight 130 pounds.  Common sense should tell them that I can not eat two plates of beef stews with mash potato.
Someone else had posted before that their reservation was forgotten and they were left with no table.
If the place is busy, You might get mess up too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Johnny Ngai

sample_reviews_en.text:
French Restaurant

Almost all the customers are from overseas.

I think it's fine to think of it as French cuisine that matches the price.

This time I chose the set menu, 450 baht.

The fillet steak was tough and had gristle, which was disappointing.

However, considering the current cost of living in Thailand, it's reasonably priced, so I suppose it can't be helped.

It might be a restaurant where you have to compromise.
sample_reviews_en.author: 輝宮城

sample_reviews_en.text: Had a booking for 5 for 7.30 pm tonight (6 December 2018). Turned up at 7.25 pm, the place was heaving, no free tables. A waitress tried to say that we hadn't booked, until it was proven that we did, but they messed up. Great disappointment as two people are on their last night and they specifically requested to dine there. No apology from the manager, so will definitely NEVER go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike Presern

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu hasn't been changed for so many years 😞 which is kinda of disappointing coz the food is quite good indeed. It's located in a small alley with a dead end making it impossible to park a car. The ambiance is pretty laid back with customers being mostly french retirees. Come on guys wake up! and renew the menu please. More customers will come for sure !
sample_reviews_en.author: One Step at a Time

sample_reviews_en.text:
A restaurant where you can satisfy your hunger with a reasonably priced Western course meal. 
It's located off the main soi so it can be difficult to find at first, but it's often fully booked with farangs at dinner time and reservations are required. 
Soup, salad, main course, dessert and coffee cost around 300 baht, making it great value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: HANA PATTAYA

restaurants.name: Tempura Kanda
restaurants.address:

Building 36, Eight Thonglor, 88/1 Soi.Sukhumvit55, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is one of my favorite tempura restaurants!
I've been eating here since their old location, and my impression is still the same.
The staff are polite and attentive, the chef is friendly and pays attention to detail.
The tempura batter is thin, crispy, light, and not oily.
There are many types of salt and sauces to choose from, making it very enjoyable to eat.
They offer both set menus and à la carte options.
For anyone who loves tempura, I highly recommend trying it at least once. 🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: bok kiya

sample_reviews_en.text: Spent Christmas Eve at Tempura Kanda, and it was absolutely perfect! The tempura was incredibly fresh, light, and crispy—every bite was a true delight. The chefs were amazing—authentic Japanese food experts, highly professional, and genuinely friendly. The restaurant was spotless, and the atmosphere was warm and inviting. Every little detail was thoughtfully crafted to make the meal unforgettable. If you’re looking for authentic tempura, this is the place to go!
sample_reviews_en.author: ChuLuxe Explorer

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is delicious, and the chef's frying skills are excellent. The batter is not thick and not greasy. Eating tempura here is like eating tempura at Tempura Kondo (two Michelin stars) in Japan, but in a calmer, more private version that we prefer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisnan Viravan

sample_reviews_en.text: We went there without making a reservation after seeing the Michelin sign, but it was a mystery as to whether it really got a Michelin star. The table wasn't even set, the chef only put on his white coat after we entered the restaurant, and …
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark F

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stumbled upon this tempura restaurant by chance.
It was a real eye-opener to see the wide variety of tempura and the meticulous frying process. The shirako (fish roe) was fragrant, oily, and had a wonderfully …
sample_reviews_en.author: Tern THITINAUNG

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there for lunch. The food, price, and service were all poor. It's been a while since I've had such a bad experience. It's not a place I would recommend to others.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naoya K

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has moved from previous site to  Eight Thonglor. Using fresh and premium ingredients. Skilled food-preparation. Good taste. Pricey though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rathian

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and varied, like a whole new experience. It was Ginza-style tempura omkase.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wallop Sangngen

restaurants.name: Napoliza Restaurant & Musashi Isakaya
restaurants.address:

273 275 Somdet Phra Chao Tak Sin Rd, Bukkhalo, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
the restaurent was part of multiple restaurent in same build. possibly to had same owner. they serve different food.
this one focused on italian food like pizza and pasta.

the place was well decorated. it gave italian vibe as it supposed to be.

I ordered half-half pizza (parma ham, salmon). the pizza was nice. they made it on italian style. good portion for 1 or people.

the staff was ok. they served and took order well but that did not justify for service charge though.

the price was on expensive side and when you include vat then service it become really expensive for what you got
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanin Rungwanichsukanon

sample_reviews_en.text: The service is elegant and the space very cozy. The food was delicious or it was me who was starving. Anyway, it's the second time I'm here, because I really enjoyed it. The prices are average compared to other similar restaurants. Cheap when compared to some fast food chains which also offer the same products but with a lot less quality. I'll definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rui Magalhães

sample_reviews_en.text: I've passed by this restaurant hundreds of times and never stopped. Luckily, I was at Samitivej Hospital, so I decided to try it (without any expectations). Turns out, the food was surprisingly good, the prices were reasonable, the service was excellent, and there was a wide variety of dishes to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jariya Hawangchai

sample_reviews_en.text: We booked a room for a party with friends. The food was unbelievably delicious! There was a huge selection of dishes – Thai, Italian, Northeastern Thai, Japanese – and everything was perfectly prepared. The desserts, especially the soufflé, were amazing! The service was also excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nisarat k

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant isn't very big and is right by the road.
Parking is available behind the restaurant.
The menu is extensive with Thai, Northeastern Thai, Italian, and Japanese food 😜

The service is good, but the food was a bit slow to come out. The char siu pork was excellent 😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Fang Thanya

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered the spaghetti, Bolognese and chips on the side.The portion sizes were not the biggest that is why I ordered chips as well.The food was average at best.The restaurant was empty and Singer for entertainment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrew Cudworth

sample_reviews_en.text: Best Indian breakfast in Thailand now just 15 mins drive from Bangkok airport on the way to Pattaya. Its a sightseeing spot + Indian food , I was so exciting seeing snakesfighting show and visiting the museum.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lovely location and beautiful atmosphere. Some live music on certain nights and a wonderful selection of food. I've visited numerous times changing things.
A great place for a good feed. 🙏 ✌️
sample_reviews_en.author: Nathan Hamilton

restaurants.name: The Shamrock Irish Pub • BTS Bang Chak
restaurants.address:

BTS, 43 Sukhumvit 97 Alley, Bang Chak, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Just had a 3 course Sunday Roast. Big plate of food that I couldn’t finish (my big belly is deceiving) and just for ฿250. I can’t complain at that.
sample_reviews_th.author: Jason Newey

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a mediocre experience during my first visit. It was a small issue, but made an unfortunate first impression.

I ordered the Sunday roast. They said they were out of beef and offered chicken/pork instead, which is perfectly fine. Unfortunately they were also out of soup (which comes with the roast) and did not make this clear at the time of ordering. I asked about a possible discount at the end because part of what I ordered was missing, but the staff declined. I don't remember being told when ordering, but it could have been a language issue.

On the plus side, the roast was tasty and you get the crispy pork skin. The portion is small compared to other pubs in Bangkok, but the price is less expensive. Good for people with a smaller appetite.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kevin Hsu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cozy Irish Pub very close to the BTS Bangrak Skytrain Station.
Very friendly service! Conscientious Myanmar staff with a very friendly owner- Chef... great pub food - the Sunday Roast 3 course special is huge value for money ... fresh cooked, enormous portions ...2 options = combo plate  of roast pork and chicken or a roast beef plate ...comes with 2 green veges, Yorkshire Pudding, generous gravy boat and purple relish plus a fresh tomato soup starter and sweet chocolate brownie dessert. Happy hour beer pints available... I'll go again!! Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mo Apted

sample_reviews_en.text:
Actually awful food & super hilarious seeing the owners response to people’s negative reviews. Seems this is why they cannot run a business. They take 0 accountability on their god awful food. 0 pride, 0 respect. 0 taste.

+1 for saying my girlfriends picture is edited,
It’s not so I appreciate the compliment 🙏😊

If he spent half his energy in improving his food & service as he does responding to all the many negative reviews than maybe, MAYBE he could serve something editable. Place should seriously be shut down.

Guy thinks he has banter too 😬😬😬
sample_reviews_en.author: Finley Price

sample_reviews_en.text: I was out late one night around 11 pm because I couldn't sleep. Many of the bars closed at 12 am in or around the area. Luckily, I was able to find this place on Google Maps and stated that closing time was at 2 am. Perfect! While I was there, I had the pleasure of meeting the manager (Dave). Very nice gentleman, and he spoke english very well. The bar is nice and a cool little spot to chill at. I will add this place to the many places that I frequent when out and about. Many thanks, Dave. See you again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jimmy Mac

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very good Irish breakfast!
Always sceptical of a full Irish abroad but this was very decent.
No mushrooms available on the day but the server gave me an extra egg on the house which was nice. Also no white pudding but I got two black and they're a decent size and tasted great so no complaints here. Rashers are also great. Quite good value also I reckon, would definitely recommend.
Only criticism would be I like two eggs with my full Irish, so not much to criticise.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cameron Murphy

sample_reviews_en.text: Since its opening, this spot has quickly turned into my favorite local bar! Location good, food good. But most of all, the staff is amazing. They have always been friendly and accommodating. When I was having a bad day and wanted extra cheese they gave me so much cheese! It is such a friendly, local, welcoming place-because of the Burmese staff. Thank you guys so much.
sample_reviews_en.author: Madeline Wight

sample_reviews_en.text:
Been here a few times for drinks and decided to try the Sunday lunch. I've eaten at quite a few of the regular haunts like Red Lion, Robin Hood, Old English etc and I have to say the lunch was impressively good value for money. Give it a try.

Just an update I tried the Pan Fry Up breakfast this morning, 199 baht including coffee and enjoyed it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stephen Cross

restaurants.name: Viet Cuisine Garden and Cafe Wongsawang
restaurants.address:

878 Wong Sawang Rd, Wong Sawang, Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came here because of reviews on Google Maps. I went with 4 friends that day. Maybe we were just unlucky 🙂‍↕️
1. I ordered pork sausage pho. Before I even ate it, I found a short, black hair in it. I have long hair, so it wasn't mine. I informed the staff.
2. My friend ordered crab claws. After eating, all 3 of us confirmed that it tasted unusually sour, similar to fermented pork sausage. We called a staff member to have it checked because the ones we've had before didn't taste like that.
In the end, they fried a new one for us, and it tasted normal.
So we don't know if they served us a spoiled item that they forgot to check.
The staff didn't inform us or say anything about why.
Finally, we got a 10% discount on the service charge for the sour crab claws.
But I'm still confused why there was a service charge when there was only one staff member in the whole restaurant 🧐
This was the first time I've experienced this, and I probably won't go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Grace Rattana

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Vietnamese restaurant is a rare find in this area. Located in a residential house, the entrance is a bit difficult to find due to the narrow gate and small sign. It's situated between Big C Wong Sawang and Bangkok Bank.

The atmosphere is like eating in a living room; it can feel a little quiet when there aren't many people. The staff provides excellent service. The food is clean and delicious, especially the Nem Nuong (grilled pork skewers), Banh Cuon (steamed rice cakes), and Vietnamese Bua Loy (rice balls in coconut milk). However, the dipping sauce was a bit bland. The Shrimp Wrapped in Sugarcane, Pho with Pork Sausage, Fried Bananas, and Ice Cream were just okay. The grilled pork ribs were disappointing. The food is suitable for the whole family. There is parking available both in front and behind the house.

I'll definitely visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Choo Hokierti

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located just past Big C Wong Sawang, probably the second house from there. Once you reach Big C, stay to the left and keep an eye out. Be careful not to miss the restaurant.
The restaurant has many trees, making it shady and pleasant. Parking is convenient. It's not crowded, so reservations aren't necessary.
The food is delicious and prepared quickly. The dipping sauces are all quite mild in flavor.
The staff provides excellent service. They are polite, attentive, and speak respectfully.
The restrooms are convenient. *However, there is a difference in floor level. Customers should use the restroom before the difference in floor level and then close the door after passing through the uneven surface, as they could trip and fall if walking quickly or on a wet floor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanawat Detsang

sample_reviews_en.text:
I absolutely love the vibe of this place. It’s set in a house and has a beautiful garden right in the front, so it really feels like you're eating at a garden home rather than a typical restaurant. It’s also super convenient because you can park right there without any hassle.

The food is exactly what I was looking for: simple, authentic Vietnamese dishes with so much variety to choose from. Everything I tried felt fresh and healthy. It’s a really quiet and peaceful spot, making it easy to actually sit and have a conversation while you eat. Definitely a new favorite for me in Wongsawang neighborhood.
