sample_reviews_en.author: Chen E.

sample_reviews_en.text: The dipping sauce for the Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage) has a dominant sour taste. The pork is firm, and my family mistook it for meatballs. The rice paper wrappers are translucent and slippery due to the tapioca starch content. The pho with pork sausage has a mild, mild flavor similar to a thick soup. This was my first time buying it to eat at home. Each restaurant naturally has its own unique flavor, and this was the first time I've tried Nem Nuong with pineapple, which was unusual. The place looks nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanakorn Kangphom

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, with a shady garden and is clean, but it's a bit dark inside.
The food is delicious. The Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage) is served wrapped in lettuce in bite-sized portions. The black pepper ribs are very tasty, with a rich flavor and fragrant spices.
The garlic clam bread is flavorful and goes well with the bread and seafood dipping sauce.
The lemongrass and lime drink has a fragrant lemongrass aroma with a delicious tangy lime flavor that's not too sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: สิงโต พี่ชายท๊อฟฟี่

sample_reviews_en.text: April 2022. This Vietnamese restaurant is near Wong Sawang intersection. First-time visitors need to pay close attention to the entrance as it's quite narrow, resembling the entrance to a private house. Once inside, the atmosphere is pleasant, like having a meal at a friend's house, with shady trees. The food is delicious, and the staff provides excellent service. There are many more dishes I want to try, so I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: ฅนสัญจร

sample_reviews_en.text: This Vietnamese restaurant near Big C has convenient parking and a diverse menu. They have Nem Nuong (grilled pork skewers), fresh/fried spring rolls, and Banh Xeo (Vietnamese savory crepe), which I like the most. They also offer vegetarian Vietnamese dishes. There's a small garden in front of the restaurant, and it displays the "Khun Hreed" (a Thai religious symbol) logo.
sample_reviews_en.author: warin wong

restaurants.name: Mocha & Muffins Riverside
restaurants.address:

Krung Thonburi Road, Samrae, Khet Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for a cozy coffee place to hang out and have a light meal, Maa laa cafe situated within the Anantara Riverside Hotel might just be your ideal spot. The cafe is not too crowded, making it the perfect spot to relax and catch up with friends over delicious food and drinks.

The atmosphere of Maa laa cafe is incredibly inviting. The lighting and interiors are done up tastefully, adding to the ambiance and making it perfect for a quick meeting or a relaxing afternoon. The staff is always welcoming and helpful, making sure your time at the cafe is enjoyable.

The food at Maa laa cafe is delicious, and there is a wide range of options to choose from. You can pick from their scrumptious light meals such as salads and sandwiches, or indulge in their baked goodies. Their coffee and blended drinks are also highly recommended.

Overall, Maa laa cafe is a fantastic destination for anyone looking for a cozy cafe with excellent food and drinks. The serene ambiance, the friendly staff, and the tempting treats are sure to make your visit superb. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wisanu Tuntawiroon

sample_reviews_en.text:
I actually look for a place to stop for some coffee. I decided to skip at the plaza at front and spend a time in the hotel is better.

Food and Beverages: I was order Ice Macciato and some signature chocolate cake or look like brownies or something. The texture of cake itself quite hard and seem dry a bit. But the Ice Macciato quite disappointed 😞 for me. As I mentioned just made as normal standards no need less or more sugar. Make it easy for them. However, once the drinks arrived. I felt a bit spoiled with test. However I didn't mention to them or bothered them as per many customers there for them during 17:30 ~1810 hrs.,

Service: Quite different from the River terrace. I think they need some training. As per first approach to me they told me that all items here not included with happy hours.

I was questioning to them that. Did I asked for happy hours? Since first beginning to the Cafe. I was asking that what choice of coffee you have here.

By the way she did Apologize to me for not good listening.

Location: Good point Location before go to main dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwanchai Quinzy Yokto

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mocha & Muffins at Anantara Riverside Bangkok is a delightful gem! We had the pleasure of enjoying their Cod and Tom Yum Noodles, and both dishes were of good standards!

The Cod was perfectly cooked, light, and flavorful, making it a healthy yet satisfying choice. Note that the Cod in Thailand defers from the usual Pacific Cod which most of us maybe familiar with. It’s firmer and not as strong to the taste. Honestly we didn’t know it was Cod at first until we did some research ourselves 😂

The Tom Yum Noodles, on the other hand, were bursting with Thai flavors—with a healthy spin to it! Give it a try!

The ambiance of the café is cozy and inviting, especially with the larger cushioned chairs. The staff were attentive and friendly, ensuring we felt well taken care of.

Whether you’re looking for a wholesome meal or a unique twist on Thai cuisine, Mocha & Muffins is definitely worth a visit especially if you are staying over at Anantara Riverside Bangkok.

Food might be on the pricey side though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Justin Ngien

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came for Afternoon Tea. The staff were friendly and smiling, the atmosphere was nice, and the pastries were delicious. Both the drinks and pastries weren't overly sweet and tasted great. Overall, we were impressed.

***
June 2026

We had the new Heritage-themed Afternoon Tea. It's a blend of Thai savory and sweet dishes. The set included:
-PANDAN COCONUT SCONE
-Mulberry & Banana Preserve | Whipped Coconut Cream
-TANG MO PLA HAENG REIMAGINED
-YUM SOM O ROYAL POMELO SALAD
-TOM KHA GAI KRA THONG TART
-TROPICAL COCONUT PANNA COTTA
-LUK CHUP – THAI FRUIT CONFECTIONS
-MANGO COCO DELIGHT

Signature specials drinks included:
-Monsoon tea - Green mango sticky rice
-Monsoon tea - Chao phraya blend
The tea wasn't sweet, and the savory and sweet pastries weren't overly flavorful and were easy to eat.
The atmosphere was great, and the staff were as attentive as ever.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sutthida S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The afternoon tea from the KTC promotion, with each person getting their own pot of tea.

Before starting the afternoon tea, we ordered a salad to nibble on, which was okay in terms of taste.

In the afternoon tea set, it began with scones and sorbet in the savory section. The egg yolk bread with tamarind was delicious. Another item had a combination of passion foiegras and orange, which was okay, but the scent of orange overwhelmed the passion foiegras a bit.

The mango mousse pastry tasted great, but the rest were just okay. Some items were a bit too sweet. The lemon tart was both sour and sweet.

The ambiance in the café was quite nice.

The hotel itself is relatively large, located along the Chao Phraya River, offering a pleasant area for strolling.

The staff were very attentive and provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panisara

sample_reviews_en.text:
Afternoon Tea at Mocha & Muffins ‼️

Overall, I'd give it a 9/10. It was delicious, clean, and the portions were generous. The presentation was also excellent, and the staff were able to skillfully present each item.

It seems like this season's theme is Matcha, as most of the pastries contain matcha green tea, such as: Shio Pan, Scone, Mousse, and Namba. Everything had a very distinct matcha flavor.

My only minor disappointments were: Matcha Latte wasn't included in the afternoon tea set (matcha lovers would be thrilled if it were!), and the air conditioning was a bit warm.

Otherwise, everything was great, living up to Mocha & Muffins' reputation 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Earn Nigizer

sample_reviews_en.text:
The cafe is located on the ground floor of the Anatara Riverside Hotel.
The afternoon tea set is perfect for a relaxing afternoon meeting with friends or having a quiet conversation in a 5-star hotel atmosphere.
The set includes over 10 savory and sweet snacks, along with a choice of two drinks: tea, coffee, or chocolate.
The savory dishes are flavorful, not too spicy, and beautifully presented. The desserts are not overly sweet, but well-balanced and thoughtfully made.
The surrounding atmosphere is calm and quiet, ideal for conversation, discussions, or relaxation. The staff provides excellent, professional, friendly, and smiling service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Samphant Ponvilawan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had afternoon tea at Mocha & Muffins in the Anantara Riverside Hotel. The set included tea or coffee and a variety of sweet and savory pastries, beautifully presented and delicious. On the day I visited, the sweet treats were tropical fruit-themed, with refreshing tartness. The savory items were also tasty and of good quality (though some of the bread was a bit dry).

The atmosphere was nice, spacious, and comfortable, perfect for a relaxing afternoon tea or coffee.

The staff were polite, provided good service, and were always smiling.

The shop also sells various baked goods at reasonable prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pui

restaurants.name: ร้านลูกชิ้นน้ำใส นายแดง
restaurants.address:

66 ถนน Rama VI Soi 30, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nai Daeng's Clear Soup Meatball Shop is located in front of the Budget Bureau. It's easy to get there, but parking is difficult. I recommend taking a tuk-tuk or taxi.
The recommended menu item is the clear soup meatballs. You can choose any type of noodles, but the real highlight is their meatballs – they truly live up to their reputation. The pork meatballs are soft and melt in your mouth, with a bouncy texture that's very easy to chew.
Today, I ordered the special clear soup with vermicelli noodles and a generous amount of meatballs. The first bite was already flavorful. After that, you can customize it to your liking. Today, I added some salty chili vinegar. I'm not sure if it contains fermented soybean paste, but I added a little so I could brag to my friends later, haha.
If you're in the area, stop by and try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Eggkarpol Benjarkarn

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a good noodle shop. I like the dry noodles with dark soy sauce; the flavor is well-balanced. The broth is good, and the meatballs are delicious. If you order the grilled meatballs too, they're amazing. What surprised me a little is that a bowl of noodles is only 40 baht, which is a good price. The portion isn't too big or too small... but I'm puzzled by the chrysanthemum tea at 30 baht – almost the same price as the noodles! It seems a bit unbalanced, but I still drink it 😅 Overall, it's good, easy to eat, and it's becoming one of my regular spots.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leeyakorn J.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nai Daeng Meatball Shop is located at 66 Rama VI Road, Soi 30, Phaya Thai Subdistrict, Phaya Thai District, Bangkok 10400, on the roadside opposite the Ministry of Finance (Office of the Auditor General).
The shop sells pork meatball noodles; no beef is served. The prices are moderate, and the quality is also moderate. The shop is air-conditioned. In addition to noodles or soup, customers can also order boiled or grilled meatballs to eat in or take away.
Parking might be a bit difficult to find, depending on your luck.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaroonphan Lim

sample_reviews_en.text: Pork noodle soup and grilled pork meatballs are around 40-50 baht per bowl, depending on the type of noodles. Grilled pork meatballs are 9 skewers for 100 baht. The food is delicious; if you want it spicy, just add chili powder and pepper. The shop is easy to find, located opposite the Ministry of Finance on Soi Ari Samphan.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sattharattana Pinrattana

sample_reviews_en.text: The meatballs are definitely delicious, as the name suggests. The only downside is that they charge 30 baht per glass for drinks, and the chrysanthemum tea is completely bland, lacking any aroma; it's like drinking plain water. Please improve this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jimmon is A wife

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stumbled upon this place.
Really good option to grab a quick bite.

Normally I'm not a huge fan of pork balls as they are quite fatty. Here they seem healthy and also the quality is good. The grilled ones are delicious too. Will come more often.
sample_reviews_en.author: YJ Jiang

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was really good. Nice, cheap, quick and easy. English speakers will have it a hard time communicating but if you have google translate then nothing will be a problem! (Photo is the special which is the 2nd one down the list)
sample_reviews_en.author: Sean

sample_reviews_en.text: The meatballs are delicious, soft and chewy, made with pure pork. The broth is flavorful, fragrant, and clear; I finished the whole bowl. There are pickled chilies to add to the noodles, giving it a spicy and savory kick.
sample_reviews_en.author: กฤษณะ กลันทกสุวัณณ์

restaurants.name: COCO LIMA BKK - RONGMUANG 2
restaurants.address:

6 Rong Mueang 2, Rong Mueang, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was impressed from the moment I called to make a reservation. The staff were courteous, attentive, and friendly. Upon arrival, the staff saw I was wearing a sleeveless shirt and arranged a seat away from the air conditioning, turning down the air conditioning.
We started with the main course I had planned to try:
- The paella was perfect! It was a portion for about two people. The seafood was quite fresh, and the rice was just the right amount. What I liked most was the rice that stuck to the pan, lol.
- The mussels with garlic and tomato were my next favorite. The mussels were so fresh and didn't have a fishy smell at all. They went perfectly with the tomatoes and bread provided.
- The shrimp alvocado salad was refreshing and refreshing. No need to say much. I'll definitely be back at this restaurant.

I forgot to mention that I also ordered white wine with a buy-one-get-one-free promotion. It was a great deal! ⭐️😙🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Noramon Rungnirunporn

sample_reviews_en.text: This year sadly I am spending the Christmas festivities alone. I saw a reel from Coco Lima. They had dinner menu, at the restaurant . I texted and they explained the Xmas menu , and that includes a bottle of wine. I asked about the posibility of delivering to my place, and they were extremely polite and friendly on the IG chat. Ladies and gentlemen, the dinner is delicious, complete, healthy ,a juicy chicken with roasted vegetables and they have been extremely mindful with the delivery and the time I wanted the food. Thanks for making it possible and I hope to meet you soon at the restaurant. Merry Christmas, from my home to yours!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lourdes Vasquez

sample_reviews_en.text: Coco Lima BKK is an absolute gem! The moment you step inside, you’re greeted with a vibrant, tropical atmosphere that instantly makes you feel relaxed and welcome. The food is nothing short of amazing – fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Their creative fusion of Thai and Latin flavors is truly unique. The cocktails are also a highlight, perfectly crafted and refreshing. The staff is friendly, attentive, and clearly passionate about what they do. If you’re looking for a place with great vibes and even better food, Coco Lima BKK is a must-visit! Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: N K

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a wonderful brunch at Coco Lima in Bangkok and was thoroughly impressed! The cozy and inviting atmosphere makes it an ideal spot for lunch or a relaxed catch-up with friends. The menu offers a great variety of options, ensuring there’s something for everyone. The food was flavorful and beautifully presented, and the service was attentive and friendly throughout. I highly recommend this gem for anyone looking for delicious meals in a charming setting. I’ll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ismail Zekhnini

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very underrated restaurant, the food is AMAZING. Price is a little high, drinks portion is small but you will get ingredients of great quality. The staffs are friendly and professional too. The fries, scallop pasta & tomyam noodles was a surprise to me, I will try their Breakfast menu soon. If you happen to stay in Sapin, I think worth trying at least once.
Update: Had their breakfast as Room service the next day, the toasts are great! No regrets adding on Salmon, super yummy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hayley Ng

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is located in a hotel and has parking. The atmosphere is lovely, colorful, and vibrant. The Grilled Corn Ribs were delicious but very difficult to eat. The Chicken Pate Brioche was fragrant and tasty but the portion was quite small. The Coco Paella Seafood, a Spanish rice dish, was delicious with large, fresh prawns. The Churros for dessert melted in my mouth. The staff provided good service but seemed a little confused about the menu. Overall, I liked it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mon C.

sample_reviews_en.text: What a great restaurant to find in Bangkok.  Located in the Hotel Sapin, with car parking in the hotel parking area, which is secured. Right from entering the restaurant,  we were greeted by smiling and very friendly staff. The menu is extensive, and so are the coffee's and drinks. A very good wine list is also available. The meals were served in a decent time and the food was great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gordo W

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere inside the restaurant is cute, inviting, comfortable, and relaxing, perfect for having a meal with family, friends, or a romantic date. The service is excellent; the staff are attentive and provide helpful recommendations.
As for the food, it's delicious! The ingredients used are of high quality and worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattchar M.

restaurants.name: ตำตำ ต้นตำรับ | สามย่านมิตรทาวน์
restaurants.address:

ชั้น B1 944 944/1 Rama IV Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious!!! The restaurant is comfortable, the tables aren't too small, and there aren't too many seats, so it's not crowded. The staff prepared every order correctly, exactly as briefed. The sourness was perfect, just the way I like it. You can request less chili and less spiciness – whatever you want. I was very impressed, and most importantly, the papaya salad wasn't sweet! That's what real papaya salad should be like. I ordered it less spicy, but it wasn't overly sweet; it had the perfect balance of saltiness, sourness, and spiciness. Okay, the price was good too. I loved it. I especially loved the pork larb – it was so delicious I didn't even take a picture!
sample_reviews_en.author: TANAPORN K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best dish was the grilled pork neck. That's it.
The flavors were confusing; they didn't really taste like authentic Northeastern Thai food.
The sticky rice was dry and hard.
It's a good thing I didn't order the regular papaya salad, I ordered the fried version, I was afraid of regretting it.
We ordered quite a lot, I think we didn't order any duplicates.
Everyone at the table had the same opinion.
But if anyone wants to try it, feel free. You might like it.
It depends on your taste and palate.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fern K

sample_reviews_en.text:
July 28, 2026
9:30 PM
This was my second time eating here. The service was terrible both times. The first time, the staff spoke impolitely and showed displeasure. This time, the new staff member taking our order even yelled at us and showed displeasure when we inquired about the food. My friend and I were very dissatisfied. This will likely be the last time we eat here. The service is truly awful and needs significant improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cherdsak

sample_reviews_en.text:
Deliciously spicy and flavorful! 🥗🔥
Tam Tam Zapp Cafe at Samyan Mitrtown
A complete selection of delicious Northeastern Thai food: Som Tum (papaya salad), Larb (minced meat salad), Tom Yum (spicy soup).
The flavors are incredibly rich, the atmosphere is comfortable, and the service is great. It's a favorite spot for lovers of Northeastern Thai food.
Definitely in the city! 🌶️🥢

#TamTamZappCafe
#SamyanMitrtown
sample_reviews_en.author: TM Abasi

sample_reviews_en.text: ​Tum Tum Esan Restaurant at Samyan Mitrtown is a great spot for authentic Thai north-eastern food. I was really happy with the quality and flavor, and the prices were very reasonable for the good portion sizes. The location is super convenient, as it's inside Samyan Mitrtown which has a direct link to the MRT Samyan station. It’s an excellent choice for a satisfying and easy-to-access meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: Boon Sri

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant's somtum (papaya salad) is delicious! It's spicy and the fermented fish sauce somtum is incredibly flavorful. The fried chicken wings with fish sauce are also tasty and served hot. The tom yum soup is just average. If I had to recommend something, I'd definitely suggest the somtum with crab and fermented fish sauce. Whenever I'm at Samyan Mitrtown, I always eat somtum here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Eurng Manita

sample_reviews_en.text: The stir-fried Gnetum leaves were delicious and very fragrant. The "Nam Prik Jom" (a type of chili paste) was a little too salty, but it was okay with the vegetables. The mushroom curry was tasty, but the presentation might not be as appealing. Finally, the mango salad with salted egg had mango that wasn't sour and was predominantly sweet. Overall, the food was a little too salty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Churindhorn Nitatvijit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mango salad with salted egg: Very sweet.
Lotus stem salad with fresh shrimp: Very sweet.
The dressing for the salad/spicy salad tastes exactly the same, no difference.

*Extra charge for fermented fish sauce (no flavor) + fresh shrimp.
Larb: Very sour, no other flavors.
Fried fish: Small.
Grilled pork neck: Very thinly sliced.

Desserts are suitable for tourists.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sisacha Chin

restaurants.name: Go-Ang Pratu Nam Chicken Rice (Siam Paragon)
restaurants.address:

G Floor, Gourmet Eats Zone, Siam Paragon Shopping Mall, 991 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered the chicken rice and the fried chicken rice. The chicken’s texture was tender, but it was chewy at the same time. Cooked to perfection. The chicken’s skin was something different from what I had with the Cantonese steamed chicken’s skin - it’s just something else that was very tasty.

The fried chicken rice was really the star! Crispy skin, tender meat, flavorful rice… This is to die for! I was really impressed with how dry and crispy the fried chicken was! Not dry in the bad sense, but it wasn’t oily at all!

You can skip the chicken blood curd. Not bad, but rather bland.

The portions were small (as usual in Thailand), so if you’re someone who likes eating, perhaps go for the “large” portion.

Overall - highly recommended! Will definitely come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: 羊くん

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is one of the branches of Go-Ang Chicken Rice Pratunam, which has received Michelin recognition. Not good as original one but its okay.

The chicken, cooked to good quality, boasted a tender and juicy texture, while the rice was flavorful and aromatic, each grain separate and infused with the essence of chicken.
The dish was thoughtfully accompanied by a dark and richly flavored blood pudding and crisp, savory skin that added delightful textures to each bite. Served with a side of fresh cucumbers and a sprig of cilantro, the meal was a symphony of flavors. It’s no surprise this dish has earned such acclaim.

If you r at Siam and looking for a chicken rice michelin, this place is for you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Huan Vu

sample_reviews_en.text:
To be clear… This is a mall food court… at for this particular location… but you definitely need to have this dish if you are in Thailand.

Very basic: boiled or fried chicken and rice. Simple. Nothing fancy.  But the taste and flavor is out of this world good.  The chicken is cooked with their special seasonings and the rice is cooked (apparently) with the chicken broth they create from making the chicken.  Be sure to put some of their special sauce with it for the extra kick.  It is absolutely worth the long line wait time and the hassle of finding a table to eat at in the mall.  And just to try it, I had the bitter melon soup. Also very good.

Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: G Vo

sample_reviews_en.text: The Hainanese chicken rice here is delicious, I’d give it a solid 4/5. The flavours could be a little stronger however the chicken tasted fresh and clean with none of that unpleasant feather/chicken smell that I’ve experienced at other places. The wait time can be quite long, with queues sometimes taking 10–15 minutes, but the line does move steadily so just be prepared to wait a little. Once it’s your turn, the food is served immediately so there’s no need to come back later or wait for a buzzer. Pricing is also very affordable compared to the rest of the food court and it’s definitely worth trying. Ate here multiple times on my Bangkok trip.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eve Vamos (Eve)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Serves what is easily the best Hainanese chicken I’ve ever had.

The chicken is incredibly tender and juicy, with that clean, silky texture that shows real care in preparation. The rice is fragrant and flavorful on its own, but really shines when paired with their sauces.

Everything comes together in a simple but very satisfying way. It’s the kind of meal that doesn’t need anything extra because it already nails the basics perfectly.

Definitely worth the Michelin recognition it has received, and absolutely a must-try if you’re in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paolo Almodovar

sample_reviews_en.text: The Chicken Rice Shop stall, located in the Siam Paragon food court, is well-known for its long queues,due to its Michelin Star certification. The rice is fragrant and pairs perfectly with the main attraction: the poached chicken. This chicken is exceptionally tender and succulent, almost melting in your mouth. Its subtle yet distinct flavour is enhanced by the aromatic blend of ginger and garlic used during poaching. The chicken's juiciness is perfectly balanced, making it an exquisite dish that leaves a lasting impression.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rudy

sample_reviews_en.text:
At the food court inside Siam Paragon, there's this famous restaurant Chicken Rice. They moved here, which makes it much more convenient to try!

Overall, it's not exceptionally delicious. The chicken is okay, but nothing particularly special. I waited in line for half an hour. There were rumors that credit cards weren't accepted, but they actually are, so you don't need to buy those prepaid cards from the counter.

I also tried the chicken feet soup, which has a very strong medicinal herb flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: H PC

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Michelin chicken rice which is now available in a lot places and one of it are inside Siam Paragon. Ordered the mix chicken rice.

The rice are fragrant which I absolutely love it. Steam chicken are ok. Fried chicken are good as it still crispy on the skin.

Overall food are good. Have been eating here every time I travel to Bangkok. Price might be slightly expensive compared to other chicken rice but it is worth it. Queue can be long as they are famous.

Will I repeat? Absolutely yes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Y Meng

restaurants.name: Lao Maison
restaurants.address:

117/7 หมู่3 Nakhon In Rd, ตำบลบางขุนกอง Bang Kruai District, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sophisticated recipe of Asian food. Never get bored because it is created from the heart and also for people's life. Totally different from franchised restaurants in the town! Good here has HAND MADE taste!

Our regular order... Khanom Jiin phat kraphao, and they now have Naem Nuang! (Vietnamese fresh spring roll) Super Aroi!
sample_reviews_en.author: C B

sample_reviews_en.text: I came on Saturday, August 31st, 2019. They open at 11 am, but I arrived early and stopped by for breakfast. I had coffee and a banana waffle. The atmosphere was nice, the taste was delicious, but the price was a little expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul

sample_reviews_en.text: A small Thai fusion restaurant with homey atmosphere. Great service. The food is really tasty. Some dishes are quite salty and spicy. "Miang Pla Kra Pong" is recommended. Limited parking space shared with other shops in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: niabtv

sample_reviews_en.text: I go there very often. The food is high quality, parking is convenient, and the prices are reasonable. I recommend the stir-fried morning glory with shrimp paste, the fried rice with canned fish, and the waffle with ice cream.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suparerk Kamolvat

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything on the menu is really delicious. We've eaten here many times; it's our family's favorite restaurant. You absolutely can't miss the Luang Prabang grilled pork and the stir-fried glass noodles with acacia leaves.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angkana Methakul

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! The stir-fried sticky rice is a must-try; the flavor is amazing. And the steamed egg with larb (or egg wrapped in larb) is also delicious, with a spicy kick.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tosapon Amornpitpratya

sample_reviews_en.text: It was my first time there. I ordered five dishes and they were all delicious. The staff were polite and the service was excellent. I will definitely go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vitamin_B

sample_reviews_en.text: Interesting Isan Thai-Inter fusion food. Varieties and yummy as well. Parking available on site but limited. Cozy ambience. Dessert menu also available.
sample_reviews_en.author: wallapa d.

restaurants.name: Hippie Cafe Pattaya
restaurants.address:

352, 324 Pratumnak Soi 4, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: A nicely decorated comfortable cafe resteraunt sadly let down by it's service staff. I sat down at a table and the waitress never spoke just put the menus on my table. I get she might not speak English and my Thai is not great, but she could have at least said hello in either language and a smile can go a long way. Anyway I ordered the American breakfast and English tea. The I'm sorry to say was terrible though the rest of the breakfast was good except I firstly I had to ask for milk for my tea then I had to ask for sauces and condiments, things that should automatically be offered. Lastly the thing that really got my goat, is the addition of VAT to the bill at the till, it's unnecessary and frustrating, what you see in the menu is what you should pay!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ian

sample_reviews_en.text:
This used to be a nice cafe, but now unfortunately waitress staff look unhappy,   customer service has deteriorated too!

I’ve been regular customer here, before its expansion, it used to be a charming relaxing nice little cafe, but unfortunately following a couple of visits at Christmas, we experienced poor customer service, our breakfast order was mixed up, young waitress didn’t listen to what was asked for…simple suggestion for management, after food order is taken, repeat it back to customer, thereby simply avoiding any misunderstanding.

There’s now an additional 7% charged for VAT however, this is only apparent by a  small sign at the counter!

It’s shame, as food quality is reasonably good, hence 5 stars 🌟 food above!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ziggy Stefaño

sample_reviews_en.text:
Please ignore all the 1-star reviews. This is the best café in Pattaya. I don’t say this lightly. The staff the ambience, the food quality the attention to detail the friendliness customer service, cleanliness, hygiene. Everything is 5-star.

Management is so kind very nice people. The staff are very friendly. The food is delicious. And it’s in a very quiet area of Pattaya and near the beach. I recommend the mixed berry smoothie.
sample_reviews_en.author: Model Citizen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had to wait 15 minutes to get a menu when only 3 tables occupied ..at 8 pm asked waitress what time they close she said 10 pm..after serving within 10 minutes at 8.30 pm she comes back to say they are closing now  as they have no water..not that i needed water...can they not wait till the customer finishes the meal ?
looks like staffing issues still exist they were all in a hurry to leave ..not a good experience
sample_reviews_en.author: shumith g

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything was great!! We came with our one-year-old.
The atmosphere was nice. The food was delicious.
While my wife and I ate peacefully, the guys entertained the little one. It was absolutely fantastic. Anyone who knows will understand what I'm talking about.
—-
Great place!! Wishing you success and growth. Greetings from "Saint Petersburg"
sample_reviews_en.author: Вероничка Лотус

sample_reviews_en.text: Used to go there a lot, today was the first time in probably over a month or two. Vat was included in the price before, but now they are slapping a 7% vat on top which was a surprise. I didn't notice the if menu had been updated, prices in it were the same as before so if it has been updated about the vat, it is in very small print somewhere.
sample_reviews_en.author: anu liikanen

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is very good but the service and some stuff are very impolite and rude, just ruined my mood today. She yelled at me when I came yo order one more coffee for my friend who was coming. Also it takes super long to wait for order. Coffee takes like 20 minutes. Ahhh just a disappointment
However food is great :(
sample_reviews_en.author: Polina Sidneva

sample_reviews_en.text: this place to me is underrated at 4.4 should be closer to 5 based on my experience. I had a lovely english breakfast meats changed to grilled chicken for a very good price given the quality. staff were very responsive and friendly. the cappuccino was yummy. Put this place on your life to go to!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Scott Butler

restaurants.name: Don Giovanni at Centara Grand at Central Plaza Ladprao Bangkok
restaurants.address:

1695 Centara Grand at Central Plaza Ladprao L Fl, Lat Phrao Rd, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don Giovanni at Centara Grand Ladprao offers a refined yet welcoming Italian dining experience that impresses both in flavor and ambiance. The restaurant’s classic décor, warm lighting, and professional service immediately set the tone for a memorable meal.

We began with the artichoke soup, which was velvety smooth and deeply aromatic—earthy, slightly nutty, and beautifully balanced. It’s the kind of starter that comforts and excites at the same time.

Next came the pizza, freshly baked with a thin, crisp crust and generous toppings. The dough was just chewy enough, with a nice wood-fired aroma that gave it an authentic Italian feel. Whether you go for a classic Margherita or something more elaborate, it’s hard to go wrong here.

The pasta was a standout—al dente and richly sauced. We tried a truffle-infused tagliatelle and a seafood linguine; both were skillfully prepared, with each ingredient contributing clearly to the dish’s overall profile.

For dessert, the tiramisu was an elegant finale: light layers of mascarpone cream, espresso-soaked ladyfingers, and a dusting of cocoa that brought just the right bitterness to balance the sweetness.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wisanu Tuntawiroon

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant serves delicious, well-balanced classic Italian food. Every dish is exceptionally well-prepared, living up to its reputation.

The steak was incredibly tender and perfectly cooked, with just the right amount of spice and balsamic.

The risotto was creamy and light, with a subtle lemon aroma that beautifully complemented the tuna.

The truffle ravioli was flavorful, savory, and delicious, cooked just right with a satisfyingly chewy texture.

The baked shrimp had a very refreshing sauce with a mild spiciness that perfectly balanced the other dishes.

The tiramisu wasn't overly coffee-heavy, offering a mild and easy-to-drink flavor, making it a perfect ending to the meal.

The management and atmosphere were excellent, befitting a restaurant located in a Centara Grand Hotel. It's suitable for dining with friends, family, or for business meetings.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maho Fargush (Mahomahodesu)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don Giovanni Italian Restaurant | Centara Grand Ladprao - Centara Hotels & Resorts is a legendary Italian restaurant that has been serving customers for over 30 years.
Today, we had lunch and ordered 3 dishes each. Everything was delicious. The vanilla rigano ice cream for dessert was amazing.
Experience authentic Italian flavors at Don Giovanni Restaurant - Sineh Bangkok, located in the lobby of the Centara Grand at Central Plaza Ladprao Bangkok. It features traditional home-style dishes prepared by Italian chef Don Giovanni | Centara Grand Ladprao - Centara Hotels & Resorts in a warm, classic atmosphere, perfect for dates and family gatherings. Indulge in the classic Italian dining experience and sample dishes from... - BKKMENU
sample_reviews_en.author: Pim lada

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a wonderful dining experience at Don Giovanni. Every dish was beautifully presented and delicious, from the appetizers to the desserts. The quality of the ingredients and attention to detail were outstanding.

What truly made our evening special was the exceptional service. Arnon, Pla, and Kakai were incredibly attentive, professional, and genuinely kind. They spoke politely, thoughtfully served and divided the dishes for us, and made sure we were comfortable throughout the entire meal. Their warm hospitality made us feel truly welcomed.

Thank you for such a memorable evening. We will definitely be back and highly recommend Don Giovanni to anyone looking for excellent Italian cuisine and outstanding service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fatty girl

sample_reviews_en.text:
I like Don Giovanni.  Their food is always spot on, really fresh ingredients and the staff are always courteous and would leave you alone to enjoy your lunch and food without hovering.

I had a lunch 2-course meal with tiger prawns salad today and the prawn was very fresh.  Their bread is also very good. I had salmon that was supposed to come with pasta but with low carb diet, they provided me with vegetables instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaruwaree Snidwongse

sample_reviews_en.text: Anju Bar restaurant has a fantastic atmosphere. The cool breeze and stunning views of Bangkok are amazing. The Korean food is delicious, beautifully presented, and everything tasted so fresh and flavorful. The cocktails are also superb – I wanted to order more! The service is lovely; the staff are friendly, attentive, and always ready to help. I will definitely return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ann Kamishiro

sample_reviews_en.text: Love for some Italian food got me here. The Pizza 4 cheese and Tagliatelle Scallops was yum. The Scallops were replaced by prawns and they made it well. Expectations were far better and I enjoyed my Italian cuisine out here. The ambience is good but in the evening there were mosquitoes which were quite disturbing. Overall the service and food was a great experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joby Chacko

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. There were only two tables occupied in the whole restaurant, and they didn't even ask if we wanted still or sparkling wine. They didn't bring a wine menu unless we asked. I was initially planning to order wine, but after this experience, I won't. The service was like they didn't want to serve at all. It wasn't worth the 10% service charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: vincent ryoz

restaurants.name: Enter Terminal 21 Rama 3
restaurants.address:

ศูนย์การค้าเทอมินอล21พระราม3 ชั้น 2 Bang Khlo, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish tasted sweet. The papaya salad tasted like the cook had dropped a whole lump of palm sugar into it – a very strange flavor. The Pad Thai was sweet, the riceberry rice was hard, and the Tom Yum Goong (river prawn soup) tasted like Tom Kha (coconut milk soup), bland and not spicy at all. The staff were confused and frequently served the wrong dishes. We ordered stir-fried cabbage (50% off, only 90 baht per plate), and it was oily, soggy, and not crispy. Don't be fooled by the set menus, like the 4-item set for 990 baht, because some of the items you want might be sold out, forcing you to choose something else. For example, they were out of pork satay, and when we asked if we could have chicken satay, they said no, we had to change our order entirely. Overall, if you're going to eat at this restaurant, go to another place or try "Khao Khap Pla" (a Thai restaurant chain) – the food tastes much better. This meal cost almost 2,000 baht, but everyone at our table agreed it was terrible. This will be our last time here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thomas

sample_reviews_en.text: I went on a Saturday around 11 am, not sure what to eat. I saw this restaurant was quite crowded, so I decided to try it. Mostly tourists, with a few Thai people. Plenty of tables, and a diverse menu with everything from single dishes to snacks and main courses. Today, I ordered some recommended dishes. The shrimp paste fried rice was flavorful and met expectations – not too sweet or dry. The crab spring rolls were soft and tasty, with a crispy shell and fresh, firm squid that wasn't mushy or fishy. The dipping sauce was spicy and delicious. The minced pork with salted fish had a noticeable salted fish aroma but was a bit dry; the taste was okay. The crab curry with betel leaves had a strong curry aroma and a very thick curry sauce with a sparse amount of crab meat and betel leaves. They also provided small dessert cups to snack on before the food arrived. The portions weren't as large as they looked in the pictures. Overall, everything tasted good, and the prices were reasonable. In summary, it's a good place to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanyaraht Chi

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was good until the extra large river prawns, which came last and kind of spoiled everything, the XXL river prawns was not fresh, and had a weird plastic taste to eat, meat wasn’t firm but rather soft and slushy. We probably should have stop before ordering the prawns, the grill pork neck was soft and chewy, clear Tom yum soup is extra spicy but taste amazing, satay was great as well, and I can’t remember the soup we order but that was the best item among all that we had, the ambience was nice and chill. Overall I’d recommend visiting at least once and skip the XXL river prawns, which by the way cost a bomb
sample_reviews_en.author: C L

sample_reviews_en.text:
Consistently Excellent Southern Thai Cuisine!!
This has become my regular spot in Bangkok for Southern Thai dishes. The flavors are spot-on and genuinely delicious. I'm always impressed by how quick the service is, and the staff is incredibly welcoming. A must-visit if you love authentic Thai food!
"Located on the 2nd floor of Terminal 21. The service is great, the food comes out fast, and the Southern Thai dishes are delicious."
sample_reviews_en.author: Aie Boonsong

sample_reviews_en.text: This Thai-style restaurant is known for its delicious southern dishes. The overall taste was excellent, with just the right amount of pleasant spiciness. The set menu offered great value for money. The atmosphere and service were also top-notch.
sample_reviews_en.author: NNchan

sample_reviews_en.text: 🙏🏻😋 They've added more new set menus! Just as delicious as always 😃 I highly recommend coming. The staff are attentive and provide excellent service. Great value for money 🥰 I've been coming back several times because the staff are so good ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Wikanda Supasanan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was so delicious I forgot to take pictures! I only managed to photograph one dish: the shrimp patties.
But I highly recommend the stir-fried morning glory with egg; it was incredibly tasty and had a lovely wok-fried aroma.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teeranan Suebphlai

sample_reviews_en.text: I liked the stir-fried pork with sweet fish sauce the most. The dipping sauce complemented the flavors perfectly. That was my favorite dish. Everything else was okay. The staff were polite and provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Onyaphat

restaurants.name: ร้านลูกหมู หมูกระทะ
restaurants.address:

601/2 Sor. Thoranin 6 Alley, Khwaeng Huai Khwang, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, it wasn't a very good experience. The customers were very noisy and disturbed other tables, and the restaurant didn't do much about it. The noise was like a religious festival in northeastern Thailand – a terrible dining experience. The restaurant itself was okay, though. They seem to focus more on larger tables. If you prefer a quiet atmosphere without ear-piercing noise, I recommend finding another restaurant. But if you enjoy chatting in a group without caring about other people, this place might be perfect. I usually don't complain about restaurants, but this one was definitely not okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: luxur ouss

sample_reviews_en.text: Thai BBQ (Moo Krata) - Delicious food, clean, excellent service. The dipping sauces are incredibly tasty. The ingredients are very fresh. The restaurant's atmosphere is clean and tidy, the music is pleasant and doesn't disturb the meal. The air-conditioned room is comfortably cool, not stuffy, and doesn't smell of smoke; it's spacious and airy, making it easy to breathe. Overall, 11/10! Definitely coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanatphong Yoatwarathanarot (บลู)

sample_reviews_en.text: We came based on reviews and it was delicious! We ordered the 399 baht BBQ pork set, marinated shrimp, and the crab curry was amazing. I didn't expect much at first, but it was really delicious. The crab curry was thick and flavorful, the BBQ pork had all three dipping sauces (even a BBQ expert would agree!), and the marinated shrimp were huge and so tasty! 🙂
sample_reviews_en.author: Irene

sample_reviews_en.text:
Awesome!
Ordered the 599 baht set: peeled shrimp and pork – not too thin, not too thick.
The atmosphere inside the restaurant (with air conditioning) and outside is nice.
The Marian plum salad was very authentic; they weren't stingy with the plums, and the shrimp were fresh and large.
sample_reviews_en.author: Najananta Chanjirawuoz

sample_reviews_en.text: The dipping sauce is amazing, the marinated pork belly is fragrant, tender and delicious, the fish in broth is flavorful and tasty, the grouper is fresh and firm, the pork fried rice, mango salad with dried fish, and fried chicken tendons are all truly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Uchukorn Vanittherdthai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Come on over, this is it! Great ingredients, delicious dipping sauce, and air-conditioned BBQ pork. 10/10, no complaints.

P.S. The stir-fried instant noodles are amazing! So fragrant from the wok, and the portion is huge – I almost couldn't finish it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yui Sarun

sample_reviews_en.text:
The vibes are amazing, the atmosphere is great, and the music is good. We came around 1 AM.
The food is delicious, the dipping sauces are the best! The service is good, and the staff are lovely. We loved it and will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: กัญญารัตน์ เพ็ชรเขียว

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, even without dipping sauce. Generous portion of pork, very flavorful. The restaurant is beautifully decorated, with a cafe-like feel. It's a shame there's no parking because it's located in an alley. It stays open very late.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nina Kanyapat

restaurants.name: Fish de Mom Restaurant ปลาของแม่
restaurants.address:

165 2 ถนน เลี่ยงเมืองนนทบุรี Talat Kwan, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Bottled water is 55 baht, the price is exorbitant considering the quality of service.

🍽️ The prices are high for each item, although the portions are quite large.
🧑🏻‍🍳 The service was extremely slow, even though there were less than 3 tables occupied!
🍚 Rice in a bowl: The rice was very hard, not soft and fragrant jasmine rice. A female employee with a tattoo on her arm said she would fix it. I thought she would bring a new bowl of rice, but instead, she just "reheated" the rice from the bowl and served a new bowl.
🤓🌟 The short-haired female employee with glasses provided the best service. She was attentive to customers from the moment they entered. She was the only one who served water; the others were grouped together playing on their phones, waiting for closing time, completely ignoring us.

🦑 Stir-fried squid with salted egg yolk (330฿): Rich and flavorful, delicious.
🍖 German pork knuckle (520฿): Crispy and tender.
🐠 Fried sea bass with fish sauce (485฿): Beautifully presented.
🦐 Shrimp in fish sauce (220฿): Spicy and delicious.

Overall, the food was delicious, but I wish the restaurant would improve its service to match the price.
sample_reviews_th.author: Vanillin Chaophuwiang

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Thai restaurant focuses on fish, but also offers Italian and Vietnamese dishes. The atmosphere is great for socializing, with an outdoor riverside area for strolling and a small playground for children while they wait.

The food has a mild flavor, not overly spicy.
Today I ordered: Stir-fried sea bass with celery (485 baht, 4/5), Crispy shrimp omelet (185 baht, 3/5 - not crispy at all), Tom Yum Goong (170 baht, medium size, 4/5 - not too spicy, just the right amount of sourness), Fried chicken wings (165 baht, 3/5 - not quite right, both the aroma and taste were bland), Rice (served in a bowl, but not a large portion; for 3 people, ordering individual dishes would be better), and a watermelon smoothie (79 baht, 3/5 - rather bland). The restaurant has parking for about 15 cars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Samphant Ponvilawan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Large portions perfect for sharing. Fresh ingredients, good quality. The taste is moderate to good, not too strong or overpowering. It's hard to describe, but it doesn't quite hit the mark in any one area. It's a mild flavor suitable for all ages. The quantity, freshness, and quality of the ingredients are good, but would I order again?
This meal cost 2400+ baht, with a 10% birthday discount.
Set meal 1250 baht (steamed egg custard, glass noodle salad, stir-fried mixed vegetables, fried chicken, fried sea bass with fish sauce) + additional orders: stir-fried shrimp with sataw, tom kha soup, banana blossom fritters, shrimp curry, 2 bowls of rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanarat Sungsuwan

sample_reviews_en.text: I've driven past this restaurant many times, always looking dimly lit, so I never went in. Today was a good opportunity to try it. The food was delicious, although it took a while to prepare, even though the restaurant wasn't crowded. But it was worth the wait! The fish was incredibly fresh, and the presentation was exquisite. My dad said the fish preparation was on par with a hotel chef – boneless, you can eat every part! (See the last picture for proof! 🤣🤣)
sample_reviews_en.author: Jidapa Vongnisakorn

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, with seating options both indoors (air-conditioned) and outdoors. It's family-friendly and has a coloring area for children. The food tends to be quite spicy, but you can specify your preferred spice level. I highly recommend the "Pad Sam Men" (stir-fried three pungent vegetables), it's amazing! There's plenty of parking, with wheelchair access although it requires a short detour. The restrooms are clean, and the atmosphere is nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: กันย์สินี ดาด้วง

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the portions were large, especially the fish, which was amazing – big, fresh, and delicious. The staff provided good service and warned us beforehand that the portions were large, as we were only two people. There was plenty of parking and the restaurant was clean inside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaew Pun

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. The flavors were great. The Tom Yum Goong (spicy shrimp soup) was excellent, the fried sea bass with fish sauce was tasty, and the stir-fried chili paste wasn't as spicy as in Southern Thailand, but it was still delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vongvut Vongmanee

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish was delicious. Out of 10 people, everyone praised the food. The portions were large and the prices were reasonable. I highly recommend the "stir-fried three pungent vegetables" (Pad Sam Men); it was incredibly delicious! 😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarinee kerdsuthi

restaurants.name: ร้านจุ่มแซ่บอ่ำหล่ำ-เพิ่นว่า (SaepAmLam)
restaurants.address:

320 Wang Lang Rd, ศิริราช Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Riverside Isan (Thai's North-Eastern Cousine) restaurant. With outdoor seats (good at evening) and air-conditioned inroom seats (good at lunch). Photogenic atmosphere. Order via QR code from your phone, pretty convenient. All dishes are delicious and spicy by default. If you want milder taste, please note that when ordering. Highly recommend the Grilled Chicken, very juicy and aromatic And signature dish Moo-kloog-phoon (Spicy Herbal Fried Pork) Only downside is there's no parking lot. And finding parking space nearby is also a pain. Better come by other transport method. If you happen to be sight-seeing nearby, it's worth a little detour to visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: last Chuengcharoen

sample_reviews_en.text: This Northeastern Thai restaurant is located inside Wang Lang Market. It's a small shop, air-conditioned, with about 6 tables. They offer a diverse menu and the food tastes great. The papaya salad is flavorful and spicy, the oyster salad is delicious with fresh, non-fishy oysters, the snail larb has crispy snails, and the mushroom curry is very tasty. Overall, the food is delicious, and you can choose your spice level. The prices are reasonable, and the staff provides good service. The restroom is located outside, to the left. There is no parking. Northeastern Thai food lovers shouldn't miss this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pixel 8 Bit

sample_reviews_en.text: We were walking around looking for a riverside restaurant and saw the sign, so we walked in a bit randomly. At first, we thought it would be just an ordinary place with a nice view, but!!! The food was incredibly delicious! We didn't expect it to be this good. We weren't disappointed at all. The prices weren't expensive at all, and the staff were very attentive. If you want a great atmosphere and delicious food, I highly recommend this place. There's seating upstairs with air conditioning and downstairs by the river. We'll definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: watchara watchara

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the pleasure of having our first lunch at this restaurant in the local market during our first day in Bangkok with my family. As a vegetarian, I was initially concerned about finding healthy and non-spicy options. To my delight, I discovered a menu offering well-prepared, flavorful dishes at an affordable price. Despite the language barrier, we made use of a translator and enjoyed a truly wonderful lunch. This restaurant exceeded our expectations and made our first day in Bangkok memorable. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Betina Pflug

sample_reviews_en.text: This riverside restaurant near Wang Lang has a great atmosphere. Come in the evening and you can sit outside; the breeze is cool and it's not hot. You order via a scanned QR code. The menu booklet has pictures but no prices. The food doesn't take long to arrive, and everything tasted good. The ingredients were fresh. I expected the grilled chicken to be dry, but the inside was juicy. The prices are a bit high, but that's for the atmosphere. The staff provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fon Kawaii

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes pretty good. The hot pot is okay, but not amazing. If you're going with 4-5 people, I recommend ordering a set meal, it's probably more worthwhile. The food prices aren't too expensive, but you can expect the price to reflect the atmosphere. There's an air-conditioned room available for when it's hot, but sitting by the river in the evening is beautiful.
sample_reviews_en.author: หมูหวาน

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is great, with seating right by the Chao Phraya River.
The papaya salad with thin rice noodles is delicious; the noodles are chewy and the fermented fish sauce dressing is spicy and flavorful.
We also ordered the large hot pot set, and it was incredibly filling!
You can ask for refills of everything – the soup and dipping sauces are incredibly tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: C S.

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I went to eat Luang Prabang salad with fresh shrimp. With Crying Tiger, Luang Prabang Salad, good taste, fermented fish, no smell. Tiger Crying is a lot. Whoever likes it, it's heaven. Needless to say, the atmosphere is very cool. The price is cute and not very expensive. Try going to the store and see.
sample_reviews_en.author: ThE JuK MoNsTeR

restaurants.name: Trattoria@22
restaurants.address:

18 Phaya Thai Rd, Thung Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at Trattoria@22, located on the 22nd floor of the grand Easton Hotel in Phayathai. The restaurant offers a stunning view of the city, which alone makes it worth a visit. The ambiance is sophisticated yet comfortable, providing an ideal setting for both casual dinners and special occasions.

The kebab, one of their standout dishes, was cooked to perfection. The meat was tender and flavorful, seasoned just right to bring out its natural taste. It was served with a side of fresh vegetables and a savory sauce that complemented the dish beautifully.

To finish off the meal, I indulged in their baklava. It was a delightful treat, with layers of crispy pastry and a sweet, nutty filling that was just the right level of sweetness. It was the perfect ending to a satisfying meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wisanu Tuntawiroon

sample_reviews_en.text: Usually I don't do too many hotel restaurants, but this placed is one of the best places I've eaten at in my travels.  The food was on another level.  The iberico pork was so tender and flavorful.  The razor clams were light and fresh.  The spicy tuna and oyster tartar had a nice twist with the fried hot peppers.  The beef ragout was very rich and savory.  Even the complimentary snack of bread and dip were great.  Staff were amazing, changed silver wear, asked if we needed small bowls or plates.  Had great views of the city since they sat us next to the window.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emerson Chang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Simply amazing!
After a long day of travelling in the heat, we were just craving a good, hearty dinner.
We were warmly welcomed and soon the complimentary starter arrived - delicious.
The Boullabaisse was fantastic and our pizza was just amazing - Bangkok can have great Pizza as well.
Our server Max has to be especially mentioned - he made us feel welcomed and knew our wishes, before we even had them!
Over all, a special evening with a stunning view over Bangkok.
We will come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Maxi Hieke

sample_reviews_en.text:
The whole experience was 10/10 on everything. Food is  very delicious with a diverse variety and aesthetic too. My favourite was salami pizza which was way tastier than pizza in Italy. The ambient was cosy and calming bringing excellent vibe.
The service is spotless—you feel very welcomed and the staff is genuine happy that you are there. I wish this whole experience and vibe would exist everywhere. Much love
sample_reviews_en.author: Claudia Tudorascu

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stayed in the hotel so came for dinner. Took the mushroom soup (I think it was portobello, not porcini) and fish soup, which were ok. The gnocchi had a burned taste and seemed not fresh, but they immediately replaced them with tomatoes pasta which was ok. I took the chicken/pork skewers which were… again, ok.
Bottom line it was ok, but not someplace we will return to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shlomo Wygodny

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s a restaurant that’s open for everyone but it’s located inside a hotel so the hotel residents come occasionally. Variety of mediterranean options. The food was very good. Prices are not so cheap compared to another places in Bangkok. However it was really good overall. Very welcoming and kind staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lama Taha

sample_reviews_en.text: If I can give 10 stars for service I would. The food in this restaurant might be expensive but it's worth every dollar spent. I would like to thank the waitresses Kaew, Nune and Cheer for making my girlfriends birthday experience so amazing! This is definitely the highlight for the whole bangkok trip!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lye wei jun

sample_reviews_en.text: The Unicorn Tower restaurant at the Eastin Grand Hotel offers a cozy seating area. The restaurant serves Mediterranean cuisine. We tried the pizza, which was exceptionally delicious. However, the beef pasta was not as impressive, as the …
sample_reviews_en.author: Tony Chote

restaurants.name: C’est ici.BKK เซอีซิ
restaurants.address:

2nd Floor Cove Hill, 1888 ถ. เจริญกรุง Khwaeng Wat Phraya Krai, Khet Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time eating here. I wanted to try both Japanese and European food.
- The T-mix fish rice bowl had very fresh fish and delicious rice. It's rare to find rice this good at a restaurant.
- However, the European food, especially the spaghetti, was too bland. So bland that I couldn't taste the sauce or the fish.
- The European dishes came out slowly, but the sashimi was quick. I had to finish each dish before it arrived.
- What I thought was really bad was the menu scanning system. It was very buggy, jumping around, making my eyes tired, and it was hard to go back to the previous menu. I had to open two phones to show the staff the menu. When an item I wanted was out of stock, I had to go back and try again, which was difficult. The staff stood there looking annoyed.
- Considering the quality compared to the price... If it were European food, it would be considered expensive.
- The sashimi might be more expensive than typical Japanese restaurant brands, but I prefer the freshness and quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: PATNAREE KOR

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very disappointed with our experience.

We paid over 7,000++ for 4 people without ordering any alcohol, so we expected much better service and quality.

The food was just okay, nothing special for the price.

The biggest issue was the service — staff seemed untrained, didn’t know how to properly serve or clear plates, and one staff member even dropped a plate on us.

They only softly said “sorry” and did nothing afterward. Not even offering napkins / towel while clearly noticed that it has stains our clothes.

To make things worse, the manager who initially helped serve our table completely vanished afterward and was nowhere to be found when problems happened. It was also very strange that the staff decided to move a table away from us to another area while we were pretty much the only table in the restaurant (while we went to the toilet moving belongings)

For this price point, the service standard was unacceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: minnie tha

sample_reviews_en.text:
C’est ici.BKK is located on the second floor of Cove Hill in the Charoen Krung area.

#WhereToGoAfterDroppingUpKids
A hidden gem with a warm European feel 🩵 but subtly incorporating Japanese elements.
C’est ici.BKK is located on the second floor of Cove Hill in the Charoen Krung area.

The dishes I tried today were:
🍝 Garlic Bacon Pasta: Chewy noodles, fragrant and creamy, perfectly seasoned.
🥩 Black Pepper Steak: Very tender meat, grilled to perfection, juicy without needing to be overdone.
🍝 Salmon Cream Mushroom Pasta: Rich and flavorful sauce, incredibly delicious.
🍣 Salmon Rice Bowl: Fresh fish, delicious rice, a perfect combination.

Overall, it's a restaurant that has it all: “Great food + Great atmosphere + Beautiful photo opportunities.”
Perfect for brunch, dates, or meeting friends. 💯

#cesticibkk #WhereToGoAfterDroppingUpKids #HiddenGemBangkok #BeautifulCafe
sample_reviews_en.author: Vachiraporn Yenchaisith (fonnie lapluie)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a great atmosphere.
The decor is blue, white, and brown.
There are plenty of photo opportunities, but it's best to avoid peak hours. There are various seating areas, and the restaurant is a bit dimly lit.

The food is delicious, but also very expensive.
You need to scan a QR code to see the pictures.

The menu offers both Japanese and Western dishes.
Each dish is huge and perfect for sharing with friends.

Recommended dishes include the large sushi pieces, some under 100 baht,
and the foie gras sushi (160 grams) with delicious rice and sauce. It's perfectly grilled, tender, and delicious in every bite.
It's enough for 8 pieces and costs 890 baht.

The salmon bomb is 290 baht per piece, topped with foie gras.
It's incredibly delicious, even without wasabi,
because the sauce is already amazing. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: GraceisGrace

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently tried C’est ici.BKK on Charoen Krung 70. The restaurant is located in the Cove Hill project, and the atmosphere is great – comfortable and not cramped.

We ordered several dishes, including Burrata cheese with baked tomatoes (the cheese was very soft and easy to eat), Salmon Zen and Sushi Set (the ingredients were fresh and of good quality), Pasta salmon cream sauce (the sauce was rich but not cloying), and Foie gras (which was soft and delicate).

We finished with French Toast, which was fragrant with butter, soft, and very enjoyable. They also offer free refills of green tea, making it a great place to chat for a long time.

Overall, it's a suitable restaurant for a casual meal or a special occasion that's not too formal.
sample_reviews_en.author: 1 9 9 X

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tried it for the first time and probably won’t go back again. Overall the food wasn’t bad but it wasn’t that impressive either compared to price.  Foie Gras was great and probably that’s it. The rest of the food is average.

What put me off the most, however, is the length of wait. We have been waiting for so long for just Japanese raw fish don which was supposed to be done quickly. The order of food came very messy, from us ordering everything at the same time. I think the restaurant is clearly understaffed.

For the price that we paid (Bt5,000++ for a family of 5), I expected some more professional restaurant food and services.
sample_reviews_en.author: N T

sample_reviews_en.text: Following a review about the huge foie gras, we love foie gras and have to admit, this place is the best. It was a truly complete experience, both in terms of ingredient quality and taste. The menu is beautifully designed and every dish looks delicious, and the chef prepared them perfectly. I love that they offer both European and Japanese cuisine, which blends together so well. The restaurant is beautiful, the atmosphere is great, there's convenient parking, the service is impressive, and most importantly, the owner is incredibly lovely. If you're in the Charoen Krung area, I highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nathakan Thammasoontorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant offers a fusion of Western and Japanese cuisine. Most of the portions are on the larger side, and the ingredients are of average to good quality, but not amazing. The foie gras sushi is served in very large pieces, so I recommend ordering it. Overall, I recommend dining here with 3-4 people.
- The restaurant is located in the Cove Hill complex. Parking is available within the complex, but there aren't many spaces.
- It can get crowded at times, so reservations are recommended.
- They also offer birthday cakes; just inform the restaurant when you make your reservation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Twk

restaurants.name: Moo Satay Hia Sa
restaurants.address:

Soi Yaowarat 11, Chakkrawat, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I will give it a 8/10. We arrived around 5 pm. I’m not sure if they have own table can seat at there. Anyway, we take out and bring to next step. When we taste it, it already getting cold but the flavor still really good! I regret only bought 10 pcs… The chicken is soft and the satay sauce has peanut flavor. They also give us some side dish, sour onion and cucumber. 🥒
If you go to Chinatown, please give it a try and eat right now!
sample_reviews_en.author: J H

sample_reviews_en.text: Good solid place for satay, sauce, and bread. My only gripe is that its way too busy at night. I had to sit on a stool right behind the vendor where the trash is and saw a huge roach crawl by. I ignored it and finished the food because it was that good, however, the meat felt a bit tougher than other places. Nothing too special or different than other places but worth a try since they offer toast with the meat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lex Braxman

sample_reviews_en.text:
Barely eye-catching, this pork satay stall tucked in the middle of street food crowds in Chinatown.
Tender well-marinated pork meat, delicious dip peanut sauce, clean, well grilled by the master.
Good service of pretty young lady owner, friendly and humble.
Pricewise, cheap, truly worth every baht.
Highly recommended and definitely will be back again
sample_reviews_en.author: Rbw dinata

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pork satay is tender and delicious, easy to chew.
The dipping sauce tastes great.
The owner is lovely and very friendly.
The pork satay is grilled quickly, no long wait.
You can eat at the shop.
Pork satay is 8 baht per stick.
Toasted bread is 5 baht per slice.
So delicious and impressive, I'll definitely go back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Natsinee _naka

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered 15 skewers for 120 baht, bread 5 baht each. The dipping sauce has lots of peanuts, it's fragrant, sweet, and creamy. The pork satay is tender with just the right amount of fat marbling, and the flavor is predominantly sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dear J.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hia Sa Pork Satay is the best very delicious and tender. It pairs perfectly with the peanut sauce and the cucumber–chilli–red onion vinegar dip. Amazing combination.
Truly the best pork satay in Bangkok highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: S P

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's delicious! The pork is tender and the dipping sauce is flavorful.
If you only order the pork satay to eat at the restaurant, there's only one table available, so you might have to wait a bit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poonyaporn S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's so delicious! I order it often and will continue to support this shop.

P.S. I don't usually eat fatty meat, but the one here is incredibly delicious and a must-try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pou pee

restaurants.name: Mozza by Cocotte - EmQuartier
restaurants.address:

693 Sukhumvit Rd, Klongton Klongtoey Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped by after shopping for a glass of wine. The front end staff are very helpful. I was looking at the menus appetizers and wine list. (Which I had done at other restaurants in the mall.) The hostess noticed and provided a list of glasses of wines with good price value.   Exactly what I was looking for. Sometimes, I want an expensive bottle of wine with a nice dinner but today I just wanted good table wine and a little something to eat - and she seemed to understand what I was looking for.  I ended up having a coupe glass of the red and Creme Caramel dessert.  The staff did a great job taking my order and bringing the first glass of wine right away. The atmosphere was relaxing, the seats are comfortable. As I finished my first glass of wine, a decent pour, the staff was quick to notice and inquired if I’d like another glass of wine. I had a second glass of wine as I finished my dessert.  I have learned restaurants that execute at the top of their game  for customers having a small bite to eat and a couple glasses of vino provided a wonderful dining experience. I am looking to return for a great meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: michael

sample_reviews_en.text:
Disappointing Experience  Great Vibe, Poor Food Quality.

I spent over 6,000 THB on this meal (including over 1,000 THB in Service Charge and Tax), and I must say it was not worth it at all. While the presentation looks premium, the food quality failed in almost every dish:
• Pizza: It looks good in photos, but the taste was subpar. The dough was tough/hard and lacked the aroma or flavor you’d expect at this price point.
• Steak: The biggest disappointment. The meat quality was very poor for the price. It was incredibly tough, chewy, and loaded with excessive fat. There was nothing 'premium' about it.
• Prosciutto: Very dry and lacked suppleness, as if it had been sliced and left out for too long.
• Service & Value: You’re paying a 1,000+ THB service charge here. While the staff provided good service, it simply cannot compensate for the poor food.
Summary: The restaurant is beautiful and the staff are professional, but if you are looking for authentic, high quality Italian food, I suggest going elsewhere. This place is only good for photos and check ins. I won’t be returning for a second time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasi T

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mozza by Cocotte is a restaurant serving homemade Italian cuisine.

Atmosphere: The restaurant has a traditional Italian feel, decorated with striking dark wood furniture, alternating tile and wood flooring. A prominent feature is the open kitchen, allowing you to see every step of the fresh pizza-making process. There's also a bar area adorned with a variety of wines, creating a perfectly balanced atmosphere. Comfortable seating is available both indoors and outdoors.

Menu: The menu offers a diverse range of Italian dishes, including oven-baked pizzas, pasta, risotto, cheese and cold cuts, etc.

Dishes I tried:
**Tiger Prawns Aglio Olio: Large, sweet, and flavorful prawns that paired perfectly with the spaghetti and rich sauce.
**Mangia Fuoco
**Salmon Tartare
**Bufalina: Homemade pizza with a delicious crust – crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, with a slightly burnt, fragrant aroma. Each pizza is topped with homemade sauce and high-quality ingredients. Simply superb!

Overall, if you enjoy Italian food, I highly recommend this place. It's suitable for both friends and family.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wob Yahcsinivmaht

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of my favorite places for a really good Italian style dinner, delicious lunchtime salad or evening cocktail hour.  Everything I have ever tried has been very good -- salmon steak, nicoise or Caesar salad, lasagna, tiramisu, plus my all-time favorite mussels in a mildly spicy tomato broth served with pesto garlic toast.  So good!  Great for solo dining, with another person, or for a group celebration.

Special kudos to the staff and the kitchen crew.  Servers are super attentive -- quick to welcome with a smile, and they seem to have a special of anticipating diners' need before one can ask.  They have even gone the extra mile to make a musical birthday dessert presentation that was fun and very touching.  The kitchen staff is amazingly fast and flavorful, beautifully plated dishes are well orchestrated to arrive just as the table is ready to enjoy.  Amazing!

One might think "forget it, just another chain" but Mozza honors all the standards you would expect in a fine independent restaurant.  Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Radley Cramer

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mozza is a perfect place for friend gathering. The vibe is great and lively. Available both indoor and outdoor seats. A bit pricey but worth the experience.

Chicken Milanese tastes good especially the dipping sauce made of tomato with mixed herbs which is so flavourful.

Octopus salad is so refreshing. Well balanced of veggie, mashed potato, seasoned octopus, and dressing. Love the chopped up olive in dressing which is kalamata type (I believe).

Salmon steak tastes alright. Crispy skin while the meat is quite well cooked. Serving along with a bit of grilled veggie. Wish there is more of side dish to make it more filling.

Pizza with smoke salmon is perfect. Raw rocket on top of salted smoke salmon and sour from some kind soft cheese.

Dessert part. Tiramisu is yummy and not too sweet. Caramel custard is so satisfying as nicely sweet. Panna cotta is not as good as other dessert due to its too firm texture.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apichart Dausiri

sample_reviews_en.text:
I discovered Mozza by Cocotte and it quickly became my favorite place in Bangkok.

From the very first visit, I was impressed by the elegant atmosphere, impeccable cleanliness, and the positive energy of the team. The staff are exceptionally friendly, attentive, and professional — something you can truly feel in every detail.

The food is simply outstanding — fresh ingredients, carefully prepared dishes, and flavors that truly stand out. Every visit was consistent in quality, which is something quite rare.

It’s not the cheapest place, but it is absolutely worth it. This is the kind of restaurant you keep coming back to without hesitation.

During my stay, I chose to eat here multiple times — which says everything.

Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Szilard Danko

sample_reviews_en.text: I have no idea why it took me so long to write the review for Mozza. The best of best place in Phrom Phong area. We go there several times and every time we go, we have a great time. The most consistent food and drinks you could ever have. The drinks are perfect, the food is delicious and the service is top notch. I wish I could list down the name of the staff who are best in that restaurant perhaps it will be all of them. Shout out to both front and backend team. We bring all of our families, friends and friends of friends there because this is the place that makes us feel like home. Seriously, don’t think twice to visit , you will have one of the best times of your life. Highly recommended !!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ei Phyu Sin Aung

sample_reviews_en.text: Went today around 3 PM when not many customers. The food is superb. We love everything that we ordered: seafood salad, lasagna, and pizza. Pizza and lasagna were amazing.
