However, the service is lousy. Nobody cared to offer the menu. We had to wait and requested it. The waitress was not professional: rushed to pick up the empty dishes too often and too close. When the time to check, the credit card was left on a counter while the cashier and a few waitresses were chatting, dancing! We had to wait longer till a new shift of waitresses to get her attention that we waited for the check! Again the food is good, but the service charge is totally overpriced!!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nong Ch.

restaurants.name: Sae Phun ข้าวหน้าไก่แซ่พุ้น
restaurants.address:

490 Thanon Tanao, San Chao Pho Sua, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Saephun Chicken Rice Restaurant 👍🏼😋⭐️
I found this delicious restaurant by searching "Michelin Guide" (in Thai) on Google Maps. It appeared and was within walking distance.

After visiting the Chao Pho Suea Shrine with friends, we looked for a delicious restaurant to refuel in the late morning.

The restaurant has a simple, clean decor. There's a food preparation area and about 8 tables for customers. The staff are quick to take orders.

A Michelin Guide sign, awarded for 7 consecutive years, is prominently displayed, along with a board showcasing the restaurant's history of over 100 years (the storytelling is very enticing).

My friends and I tried three dishes:
1. Chicken rice with Chinese sausage and fried egg
2. Emperor's Shrimp Dumplings
3. Stir-fried Hong Kong kale with oyster sauce

The food was served quickly, and every dish was delicious and to our liking.

We also ordered Luo Han Guo herbal drink and chrysanthemum tea to refresh ourselves and quench our thirst. The taste is up to standard.

I would like to encourage everyone who is in the area to try the legendary deliciousness of this restaurant. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Montree Tripetpisai

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted good, but the behavior of the woman—I'm not sure if she was the owner—was quite unpleasant. We brought our dog in a stroller and asked for permission beforehand, which she said was fine. As we were pushing the stroller to choose a seating area where our dog could get some fresh air after being in the hot weather, the woman made a remark implying something like, "Do you really have to push it all the way there?" Her demeanor and facial expression were very upsetting to us. Our dog was in the stroller the whole time and didn't cause any trouble. We were really looking forward to enjoying delicious Michelin-starred food, but this kind of behavior was very disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puean Puean

sample_reviews_en.text:
Their noodles are delicious, the thin noodles have a perfect chewy texture. The pork ribs are number one; they're so tender they fall off the bone, even though there are only 3 pieces in the dish for 150 baht. As for the shrimp dumplings in the picture that I ordered, I initially thought they'd only have pork, but after biting into them, I had to say "Wow!" They're well-made, crunchy and bouncy with a real shrimp flavor. 4 pieces for 150 baht, worth the deliciousness. They have many accolades over the years.

If you're visiting the Shrine of the Tiger God, you must stop by! Highly recommended! 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: KpN U

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Michelin-starred restaurant near the Chao Pho Suea Shrine serves chicken rice and shrimp dumplings. The shrimp are large and the dumpling wrappers are thin. It comes with stir-fried kale to balance the flavors. The taste is delicious, but if you like spicy food, you might want to skip this place. 🥹
I'm deducting one star because they charged for the soup; it should have been included. The restaurant doesn't have many seats, and it's a bit hot and stuffy. It's not a filling meal, but it does satisfy your hunger. There's no parking at the restaurant.🚗
sample_reviews_en.author: Fonnie

sample_reviews_en.text: The winning ticket! This little restaurant is absolutely worth the detour, so much so that you'd cross town just to eat there. The value for money is exceptional, with fresh ingredients cooked right in front of you. Here, there are no frills: you savor the food and you'll want to recommend it endlessly... It's absolutely amazing! The welcome is very professional and the service is quick, without any unnecessary fuss. Don't be discouraged if you have to queue, it's really worth it. A big yes!
sample_reviews_en.author: laurent

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is clean and the staff are attentive.
The chicken rice is delicious, and it's great that it's not too salty. The ingredients are good.
The noodles are excellent, like Hong Kong style noodles, and the pork pieces are large.
The prices are very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakkad Kaew

sample_reviews_en.text: Mixed of tourist and locals. The shrimp dumpling is 150b because they gave the whole piece of prawn. What i dont like is the prawn is overcooked. Another dish is fried crispy noodle with chicken gravy and it is too little gravy. My noodle can not soak to wet and soft.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oscar Chee

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the portions are just right, and the atmosphere is great. The owner is friendly, smiling, and chats with customers. The taste is excellent, befitting a restaurant that has received awards. I will definitely come back if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: pattanid sripirom

restaurants.name: COPPER SPOON Breakfast Thai-European Cuisines
restaurants.address:

64 Chaloem Phrakiat 21 Alley, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Breakfast at Copper Spoon was okay, but nothing special, especially considering the exorbitant prices.

The service and staff are a complete disaster! The employees are total amateurs – unfriendly, disinterested, and barely speak English. I wanted to order a second coffee, but the employee wasn't even remotely friendly or helpful. That's unacceptable.

The worst part: There's a poster in the restaurant offering a free Coke or coconut if you give them 5 stars on Google. They're essentially buying their reviews with cheap drinks! It's an absolute outrage and misleading for other customers. I give my review honestly and I'm not going to be bribed with a free drink.

Another joke: I wanted to take my food to go – and they actually charged extra for the cardboard box! With the already exorbitant prices, that's just petty and customer-unfriendly.

In short: The service, the rip-off review scheme, and the extra charges for takeout make the visit unpleasant. I won't be coming back and therefore cannot recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: LuXuS

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent place 👌 we go in everyday for coffee and sometimes we eat there aswell, staff and owners are very welcoming and professional. Coffee is always good and the atmosphere is excellent, background music just right, perfect air conditioning temperatures, spotlessly clean and well organized, not a bad word to say about it, only gave a 4star for the food as we don't really eat in there so can't really comment, only had light snacks etc... our go to coffee shop in Pattaya, Top marks 👌
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Mccormick

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been to Copper spoon quite a few times, and they always do an amazing job. I've never had a bad meal there. The food is always fresh, beautifully cooked, and consistently excellent.
This time I had the salmon with stir-fried spinach and garlic sticky rice, and it was absolutely amazing. Everything was cooked to perfection and full of flavour.
I highly recommend Copper spoon if you're looking for consistently great food, excellent quality, and a meal you can rely on every time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ade Meaden

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely fantastic little cafe. Service was fast and friendly. Food was very tasty and at great prices. Best Penang chicken curry I've ever had.

Update to my previous review. I've used Copperspoon almost every day for the last 2 weeks, mainly for breakfast but also had evening meals here. Always great service and quality food. Tried some new dishes and drinks and you get what you pay for. It's a lovely place to sit and enjoy great food. Thank you
sample_reviews_en.author: Craig

sample_reviews_en.text: Fantastic restaurant, one of my favorite places for brunch! A very nice setting, super quiet inside, you hardly hear the road noise and so makes it perfect for you to read or work as you munch. The options for dining are phenomenal and I always go with their Thai offerings and I am never disappointed. Full of flavor and spice! Service is great and fast too.
sample_reviews_en.author: S S

sample_reviews_en.text: Really enjoyed this place! The food was delicious, nicely presented and the service was friendly and attentive. Relaxed atmosphere without feeling boring, and everything we ordered was spot on. Definitely a place we’d happily come back to when in Pattaya 😄
sample_reviews_en.author: Don Corleone

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the atmosphere is great, and the staff are lovely. They play soft instrumental music, which is very pleasant. The food is reasonably priced, and you can specify your preference for spicier Thai food. I will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: ball sukawat

sample_reviews_en.text: We chose this place based on ratings and reviews. They have a wide selection of Thai and European dishes. I ordered Pad Thai with seafood, but it came with shrimp (they rang it incorrectly). It was delicious, but I'm lowering my rating for that.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ирина Мелехина

restaurants.name: Zafran Eatery (Indian Food)
restaurants.address:

392, 26-27 Chakkraphet Rd, Wang Burapha Phirom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had an amazing experience at Zafran Eatery in Bangkok! The food was absolutely delicious, with great flavour and generous portions. Everything tasted fresh and was really well prepared. The atmosphere was welcoming and comfortable, and the service was excellent from start to finish.

Definitely one of the places I’d recommend checking out if you’re in Bangkok. Great food, great service, and a really enjoyable dining experience. Will definitely be coming back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukhraj Sidhu

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came across a review saying it was so delicious they didn't even take pictures. I understand what they meant, lol. This was my first time trying Indian food. There are many restaurants in this area, but we chose this one for the hot pot. And the hot pot was surprisingly good! 🥹🥰 I highly recommend the butter chicken; eating it with roti bread is amazing. 💗💗💗💗💗
The service was good, the atmosphere was nice, and the air conditioning was comfortably cool.
sample_reviews_en.author: MS WL

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’m Sri Lankan, and when I visited Bangkok, some of the local meals were not suitable for my taste. I wanted to try Indian food, and that’s when I found this restaurant.

I can definitely recommend this place if you are looking for Indian food in this area. I tried the fried rice, and it was worth the money. The restaurant is located in front of a small river, which gives a nice and relaxing atmosphere while dining.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dhanushka Hemachandra

sample_reviews_en.text: Worst food, I have ordered veg Thali.. first Bhindi masala came uncooked.. very hard to chew then after feedback restaurant staff replaced Bhindi masala with Mix veg and that was fully uncooked. They don’t know how to cook and what is the food recipe.. just mixing vegetables with masala and do not have any idea of anything. Very very bad experience.. worst food in Pahuraat ever eat there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukh Thakral

sample_reviews_en.text: It's so delicious, I've been here twice already. The food is amazing. The staff gave great food recommendations. The air conditioning was too cold when I was chilling but didn't tell them, so they were very observant and turned it down for me.🥹 The prices are okay, and the desserts are delicious too. Everything is delicious. I'll definitely come back again when I get my paycheck.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boonthira _g

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the prices were reasonable, not too expensive. The staff had excellent service minds, constantly checking on us and taking care of us. The desserts were subtly sweet and not harsh on the throat. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanwanyiii

sample_reviews_en.text: Extremely delicious food. The vegetarian Indian dishes were outstanding—rich in flavor, unique, and refreshingly different from the usual offerings. They also have an excellent fusion menu worth trying. The owner was very kind and …
sample_reviews_en.author: Monica’s Taste

sample_reviews_en.text: In the Indian quarter by the canal. An unassuming restaurant offering a wide selection of Indian dishes. The atmosphere is a bit cold, but the spicy food warms it up. Remember to specify your level of "spyness".
sample_reviews_en.author: Moi

restaurants.name: Sea you
restaurants.address:

WVJM+9XH, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It was so hot and the grill fire died within 20 minutes. It was so hard to get foods done grilled in time. We tried to full fill our selves but like I said,  hot n fire so easily dying. We had to leave the place ASAP n not even finished a profer meal. And yet the casher or I guessed she's the owner 🤔 was asking me where I am from. N told me I should pay 100 bt for wasting foods on the GRILL. I told her we had not enough time to grill second dishes because the fire died too quick. You see the dish is so small so you have to grill at least 2 times if you want to get enough food for one person. N she looked at me with that threatening eyes n asked me if the staff changes the fire now, will we finish the wasted food again!  I love most of the experiences in Pattaya n I am willing to visit Pattaya again but this place remains the worst in my whole trip time. BTW the shrimps n most of the sea food are all dead without any cooling system. N it is soooooo hot you should check if the sea foods are freshly served.
sample_reviews_en.author: JEANNIE JOHN

sample_reviews_en.text:
The selection wasn’t the greatest, but for the price you pay, you are getting your money’s worth.  There’s crabs, shrimps, squids, oysters, snails, clams, and meats.  Since there are no labels on the food, you kind of have to guess what the meats are.  They do charge for ice, but it’s cheap.
The servers do not speak English, so it was a little challenging to get them to add coal.  As for atmosphere, it’s outdoor seating, nothing fancy, they do provide fans to help keep you a little cool, just don’t be downwind of the grill, or you will be covered in ash.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a wonderful dining experience at Seayou Mukata Buffet Restaurant. The price was very reasonable for the quality and variety offered. The seafood was fresh, and the soup was both flavorful and satisfying.

I especially enjoyed the dessert options — the sweet watermelon was refreshing, and the ice cream came in a delightful variety of flavors. Overall, it was a satisfying and enjoyable meal. I’d definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a tasty and affordable buffet. Loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: GlobeStepsby Yune

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don’t go here unless you bring Thai friends.
I came alone, and the staff just dropped off a grill and the beer I ordered. They refilled the charcoal once — that was it.

Meanwhile, tables with Thai guests got both a grill and a hotpot. The servers poured their beers and even helped them with the barbecue. Nobody cared to check on me. I honestly felt like a second-class guest.

First picture my table. Other two with Thai.
sample_reviews_en.author: JohnF

sample_reviews_en.text: First time eating Thai Barbecue in Pattaya, I still struggle with the concept of going to a restaurant and cooking your own food but when in Rome :). The food was good, tried lots of different food, fish, pork, chicken with noodles, rice and eggs etc.  At 190 baht per head the food is excellent value and good service.  Will go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Captain Hellrazor

sample_reviews_en.text: Went very late at around 11pm, place was still open with many guests. Very nice and affordable seafood buffet with live shrimps (which was my favourite). They have my food options in the buffet line, and many meat and seafood. But 1 of the …
sample_reviews_en.author: Kian Tat (Asian Gordon Ramsey)

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is good but the service and staff are rude, unhelpful, and don't explain anything. I tried several times to translate or ask for help or someone to understand but was being said. Instead I received looks like I was the issue. Our …
sample_reviews_en.author: Gena K. Peerman

sample_reviews_en.text: Great value bbq seafood for 290 baht per person, all you can can eat. It is a cook yourself arrangement. Each table has a charcoal grill and a hot pot ring. Seafood selections are river prawns, squid, oysters in shell, crabs, snails, and …
sample_reviews_en.author: Fazi Phil

restaurants.name: Kim
restaurants.address:

882, 884 886 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is incredibly dishonest with customers. Terrible experience. I ordered 150 baht worth of battered and fried shrimp and received 6 pieces. They were undercooked (2 pieces were taken out and both were undercooked, and the tails had already been removed; I didn't check the others). I asked them to re-fry the whole plate until cooked. After about 5 minutes, it came back with 2 pieces of mushrooms instead! When I was about to pay, I informed the staff. They went to the kitchen and were told that there were 2 pieces of mushrooms there to begin with. That's impossible because the first time I ordered, I saw all the shrimp tails intact. Unfortunately, I didn't take pictures, so I have no evidence, and I didn't inform the staff immediately when I noticed the mushrooms.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pitchapas Amornchairojkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and reasonably priced, considering the quality and quantity. We highly recommend the pork satay; the coconut milk aroma is amazing, truly delicious. And surprisingly, the braised pork congee is surprisingly good, something we've struggled to find elsewhere, but here it's easy to find.

We highly recommend this place, especially during the vegetarian food festival.
The stir-fried water spinach with vegetarian ingredients is freshly made and incredibly delicious.
The buffet-style dishes here are already excellent.
And the vegetarian fried items are truly amazing.
Come and try it, it's genuinely delicious. It's an old, established restaurant in this area. 🥰

Oh, you can park along the street here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pang Kate

sample_reviews_en.text:
Typical Chinese Eatery in Charoen Nakhon.

Charoen Nakhon reflects the Thai-Chinese history like not many other areas. It has been the commercial heart of Thonburi - former Thai capital - in the best decades. This is one reason why you find so many old Thai-Chinese families and restaurants here.

Kim is one of them. A very nice restaurant with all the staple dishes: tofu, Hongkong style noodles, fish, etc. The menu comes with little surprises. But sometimes it’s nice to go to places where you exactly know what you will get.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text: Abalone noodles, sea bass noodles, fish and taro hot pot, and Hong Kong style stir-fried noodles – these four dishes were excellent! ❤️❤️ However, the braised goose leg in clay pot wasn't good. The price is commensurate with the quantity and quality. The Chinese kale used was crispy Hong Kong kale without any bitterness. The noodles were crispy, and the fish was very fresh. Highly recommend! I went back twice in one week. ❤️ The restaurant has air conditioning and clean restrooms. Overall, it's very clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirihunsa Poon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Crispy Pork Stir-fried with Chili and Salt (4 servings)
Spicy Pickled Crab Salad (4 servings)
Stir-fried Noodles with Water Spinach (5 servings)
Chicken Stir-fried with Cashew Nuts (5 servings)
Squid Stir-fried with Salted Egg (3 servings)
Pork Fried Rice (2 servings)
Chinese Kale with Crispy Pork (4 servings)
Stir-fried Mixed Vegetables (3 servings)
Pork Satay (2 servings)
Shrimp Salad (2 servings)
sample_reviews_en.author: Suwicha Boonyindee

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. Recommended dishes include crispy noodle stir-fry, shrimp rolls, pork satay, hot plate oyster omelet, etc. The squid is large and full of eggs. The restaurant uses grade A ingredients, and the prices are not as expensive as you might think. The only drawback is finding a parking spot that isn't in a red-and-white zone; that depends on your luck.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siwapon Kangkan

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a clean and delicious Chinese-style restaurant. They also sell satay! Yesterday, a customer ordered 130 skewers, and we had to grill them for them. The restaurant has even received a "Clean and Delicious Restaurant" award from the Bangkok Governor. Anyone interested is welcome to come and support us! Delicious food at reasonable prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narumol Malairattana

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! It lives up to its reputation as an old, established restaurant. The pork satay skewers are large, the dipping sauce is great, and the price is good (10 skewers for 120 baht). The crab fried rice is 100 baht for a small plate. The best dish is the crab cake – large, with plenty of crab meat, and so good!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anas Klinreun

restaurants.name: Bura Marie - Central Park
restaurants.address:

ชั้น G ศุนย์การค้า เซ็นทรัล ดุสิต 946 Rama IV Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there in December of 2025 to meet up with old friends.  I was told that this place was recently opened within the last six months. The restaurant itself is located within the big and new Central Park mall, famous for the roof top park located across and south of the Lumphini Park. The restaurant sits on the ground floor (1st floor) of this Central Park mall. This mall focused on serving foods unlike the other malls in Thailand, where the food court is at the bottom floor only.

I have to add context here for other tourist stopping by and they may not know. This comments are not for the local Thai people.😁

I guess the best way to describe this restaurant is that it serves high-end street food. This is a compliment.  Everything we ordered were so good; clean, authentic and delicious. It is definitely on the top of my list to come back if I am around this area of town. Yes it is a qualifying statement only because there are so many places to eat great Thai foods in Bangkok.

I highly recommend this place if you have a craving for authentic Thai street food and are willing to pay for it as it is not a street food price. 😆

Cheers
sample_reviews_en.author: Prat Prathnadi

sample_reviews_en.text:
🌶️ A Culinary Gem for Thai Flavor Enthusiasts

If you’re craving Thai cuisine that doesn’t hold back on authenticity, this restaurant delivers an unforgettable experience. The dishes burst with bold, layered flavors—especially the curries, which showcase the intense richness of traditional Thai curry paste. From the first bite, you can taste the meticulous balance of herbs, spices, and aromatics that define true Thai cooking.

🍽️ Service & Atmosphere
The staff are warm, attentive, and knowledgeable, enhancing the overall dining experience. The ambiance is elegant yet relaxed, making it ideal for celebrating a special occasion or treating yourself to something extraordinary.

📅 Plan Ahead
Due to its popularity and limited seating, reservations are a must. While the prices lean toward the higher end, the quality of food and service more than justify the splurge.

💰 Worth Every Baht
This isn’t your everyday dinner spot, but for those seeking a memorable meal steeped in Thai tradition, it’s absolutely worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boonsita R.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited Bura Marie for a long-time friends’ gathering. The ambience is nice, but it does get very noisy, so it might not be ideal if you’re looking for a calm or intimate atmosphere.

The restaurant is located inside Central Park, which means everything feels new, trendy, and premium. Naturally, the prices reflect the location and décor, so expect the bill to be on the higher side.

As for the food, nothing really stood out. We ordered many dishes, and the one my friends liked the most was the Moo Maggie’s. The restaurant even gave us a Maggie’s-themed souvenir with that order. Personally, I found the dish quite ordinary—probably the best among what we tried, but still nothing memorable.

A reservation is recommended, especially during busy hours.

We skipped dessert because my friends had tried it before and felt it wasn’t very interesting.

Overall, Bura Marie offers a trendy setting with average food, better suited for gatherings where ambience matters more than the meal itself.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutthinee J.

sample_reviews_en.text:
A tea house that delivers food at a very high level.
On our visit, Moo Maggi was a new addition to the menu and it was executed beautifully—aromatic, salt-forward, and deeply savory. The combination of bird’s eye chilies, garlic, and cilantro brought everything together, almost like the flavor profile of sago dumplings with pork filling.

Other dishes were equally well crafted. The fried rice with crispy catfish chili paste was balanced and cohesive, with each element complementing the others and becoming more expressive when eaten together.
The stir-fried liver with bird’s eye chilies stood out in particular—clean-tasting, well seasoned, tender, and never dry or tough.
The wide rice noodles stir-fried with shrimp and bird’s eye chilies were robust, well-woked, and very satisfying.

Overall, I was thoroughly impressed. Prices are on the higher side, but the quality of both the food and service justifies it.
sample_reviews_en.author: MARINA PHONE

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fried Fish – 3/5
Nicely presented with a crisp exterior and fresh herbs on top. The texture was good, but the seasoning was slightly uneven and the flavor did not fully stand out. Decent overall, though it could benefit from better balance.

Fried Pork Strips – 4/5
Well-caramelized with a rich, savory glaze. The meat was tender and flavorful, pairing well with the fresh herbs and vegetables on the side. A satisfying and well-executed dish.

Stir-Fried Lotus Stem with Shrimp – 4/5
The shrimp were fresh and properly cooked. The lotus stem added a pleasant crunch and contrast in texture. Lightly seasoned but balanced, making it easy to enjoy.

Spicy Salad with Egg and Cashews – 4/5
Bold flavors with good heat and depth. The soft-boiled egg added richness, and the cashews provided texture. Well-composed and enjoyable, especially with rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emm Roc

sample_reviews_en.text: The Thai food here is delicious; everything we ordered was tasty and well-balanced. The atmosphere is nice, quiet, and the staff provides good service. However, I ordered my food with the chilies served separately. When it was served, the dish was full of chilies. I informed the staff that I had requested the chilies be removed because it was for a small child to eat as well, and asked them to change it. The staff took the dish back to the kitchen and returned with the same dish, but without removing all the chilies, without preparing a new meal. I know this because the staff didn't remove all the chilies. Although no one was affected as there were no food allergies, the kitchen staff's attention to detail was very low. Anyone planning to eat here should instruct the staff and carefully check the food beforehand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bubblegum

sample_reviews_en.text:
A newly opened restaurant, but the service is already impressive. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, making it a great place to enjoy a meal.

The menu focuses on authentic Thai dishes that are full of flavor. I really appreciated that the food is not adjusted to be bland for foreigners, yet it’s also not overly spicy — just the right balance to let the flavors shine. Even though the restaurant was full, the dishes came out quickly, with no long wait times.

Prices may feel a little high for an everyday meal, but considering the quality of the ingredients, the taste, and the attentive service, it’s well worth it. A great choice if you enjoy authentic Thai food served in a refined and welcoming setting.

Add: 2nd visit
Still didn't disappointed, we love all dishes we have ordered. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Rinrada Rinrada

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurants in the iBerry Group welcome the season of popular Thai fruits with their unique flavors, such as mangosteen and santol, with special food and drink menus from various restaurants in the group.

🍛 We dined at Bura Mare, a Thai restaurant known for its rich flavors, which offered a variety of special dishes including:
1. Mangosteen and crab meat dip with herbs, served with seasoned gold leaf (395 baht)
2. Santol salad, served with shrimp crackers and fresh vegetables (285 baht)
3. Rice noodles with mangosteen sauce and fried Chaiya salted egg (320 baht)
4. Spicy santol curry with fresh shrimp and basil (330 baht)
5. Santol smoothie and mangosteen smoothie (149 baht)
All the dishes were flavorful with a balance of sweet, sour, and spicy, yet refreshing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarat Traipiyavong

restaurants.name: เตือนเตี๋ยวหมู สน.ประชาชื่น
restaurants.address:

53 Thetsaban Nimit Nue Rd, Lat Yao, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
🍜 Delicious noodles in the Prachaniwet area, starting at 20฿/bowl. The noodles and pork are perfectly cooked, and the broth is flavorful and well-balanced. The Yen Ta Fo noodles are wonderfully chewy, and the jellyfish is perfectly crunchy.

Snacks include fried wontons for 5฿ per bowl (5 pieces) and crispy pork rinds with fragrant, crispy fried garlic that's not oily.

🥤 Soft drinks are available, and water is free (self-service).

It gets busy between 11:00 AM and 1:00 PM, so please order everything at once to avoid delays.

P.S. The owner and all the staff are over 50 – very friendly and lovely! They might ask the same questions or forget some, so please be patient!
sample_reviews_th.author: Aom P.

sample_reviews_th.text: So delicious! The taste is amazing and the price is unbelievable. Regular is 20฿, special is 40฿. The soup is good, the ingredients are plentiful, and the tom yum is perfectly seasoned – you can eat it as is. If you like it spicier, add more to your liking. Avoid lunchtime as it's very crowded. The vendor works alone, so service might be a bit slow.
sample_reviews_th.author: Duke Chieocharnyont

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've wanted to eat here for a long time, but it's closed on weekends.
Today I passed by and finally stopped in at 12:45 PM (Google Maps said it closes at 1 PM, but when it was time, customers kept coming in. I overheard them saying it closes at 2 PM).

I ordered the regular size (small bowl, 20 baht). I loved it! It felt like eating boat noodles.
The noodles were good; the thin noodles were decent, and the thick noodles were chewy.
I wrote down my order all at once.

The chili vinegar sauce for the Yen Ta Fo (the bowl in the picture) was delicious. I really liked it.

*Next time I'll order the large dry Yen Ta Fo Tom Yum.*
Note: I told myself I ordered 4 small bowls and I was full.

P.S. When I came, it was crowded, and many people were ordering takeout. I waited about half an hour. It was very hot and I was sweating profusely. If you're really hungry, you can cross the street and buy some fried bananas.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akha U.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This pork noodle stall is located by the roadside. There aren't many seats, but it gets very busy at lunchtime, with both dine-in and takeout customers.

I ordered a special dry Tom Yum noodle soup (thin noodles) for 50 baht (August 6, 2024). The bowl wasn't very big, and the noodle portion wasn't very large. It only contained liver, fish cake, sliced ​​pork, and minced pork; no meatballs. The seasoning was well-balanced, not too spicy. The noodles were cooked perfectly, not hard. The fried garlic was fragrant. Even though it was dry, they gave me a side of broth topped with fried garlic and green onions. The broth was fragrant and not too sweet.

The crispy pork cracklings were 10 baht. They were freshly made, not oily, and had a little garlic attached. Delicious, highly recommended. Drinking water is self-service. Payment can be made via bank transfer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponchagarj Ngamukos

sample_reviews_en.text:
This noodle shop near Pracha Chuen, close to the police station, is one I've wanted to try for a long time. I personally love Tom Yum noodles. The shop is like a small shack with only a few tables, but it's always busy. I heard it closes early too.

I recommend the Tom Yum noodle soup. The regular version isn't spicy at all; even someone like me who can't handle spicy food can enjoy it. Order the crispy pork rinds extra – they're delicious and freshly made every day. Their peanut topping is excellent; I practically finished it all. Personally, I think the soup version is tastier than the dry one. The Yen Ta Fo (pink noodle soup) was just okay.

The owner/staff are very friendly and polite. It's a great place!

Parking is a bit difficult; it's on the street, so check the odd/even day parking restrictions.
sample_reviews_en.author: K C

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here based on reviews, but I won't be eating here again. The owner spilled hot soup all over my hand and didn't even apologize. My hand stung terribly, but the owner didn't care at all, just stayed silent and went back to making noodles. The taste wasn't amazing at all; the tom yum was bland, and the portion size was as pictured. The dumplings were just plain fried dough. The service was terrible. The old lady who was clearing tables was licking her fingers while eating dumplings and then went to get dumplings to put in my bowl. Ugh. Go ahead if you want to eat here. And there's no parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suchada

sample_reviews_en.text: The portion size was incredibly small, the smallest I've ever seen. It was ridiculously small. I understand it's only 20 baht per plate, but that's just the noodles, not even enough to finish in one bite. I've never encountered such a ridiculously small portion anywhere. The shop isn't fancy, it's just a roadside stall, but they charge exorbitant prices. The taste wasn't even that great. I regret wasting my time driving all the way here based on reviews.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yutya Hahanak

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles were delicious, the wide noodles were soft. I ordered them dry, but they weren't too dry. Nearby, there's a smoothie shop run by an elderly lady, and her smoothies are amazing! I bought a lime smoothie, and she blended it so finely. Please support her, anyone passing by should definitely try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bloudmoon

restaurants.name: Berlin's Doner Kebab - Ladprao 18
restaurants.address:

28 Lat Phrao 18 Alley, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Premium German-style kebabs, Halal certified for both chicken and beef 🥩
Original Beef Kebab, Regular size – let me tell you, it's huge! Generous filling, fragrant bread, juicy meat. Order a set for +60฿ and get a soft drink and …
sample_reviews_th.author: maTang kwa

sample_reviews_th.text:
Promotion Set 144฿ Had the original chicken kebab, so Juicy, love the garlic sauce
Best I had
Didn't think able to get this in Bangkok
Next time I need to try the feta salad seems look so good.
sample_reviews_th.author: NWD

sample_reviews_en.text:
Seriously… wth. This is one of the most amazing sandwiches I’ve ever, EVER had in my life. Combo the Berlin special sauce with the spicy sauce and thank me later. Insane.

Edit: Pretty much had this 5 days in a row. It’s that damn good. Tried the beef donor. True the chicken donor. Tried the wrap (eat the wrap IN store, don’t order) Tried the falafel… it’s mid if you’re a falafel connoisseur. I’m still leaving it at 5* because it’s very rare I eat at the same place more than 3x in a week because it’s soo good. This place was one of those few times I did in fact visit or order at least 5x in one week upon discovering it.

I’ll repeat, if you can handle any sort of spice level. Spicy sauce & Berlin sauce combo is amazing. However I can understand if it’s too strong for some.

Enjoy. Than heay Arroy!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sǎwåd33e

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you like real Döner Kebab, don’t come here you will be disappointed… i have been eating kebabs all my life and im sorry this is the worst berlin style kebab i have ever got. The chicken is just cold piece of chicken reheated on a pan with water. The chicken is white as my ass. No taste at all. There is more salad in my bread than chicken. They should call it a cesar salad in bread !
259 baht for that, its a scam. You can get better for 100 baht in a nightmarket.
The kitchen look like a laboratory of Break in Bad tv show. Maybe the owner should stop his business and sell crystal meth instead or just go back in Berlin because he probably forgot what is a Döner Kebab !
sample_reviews_en.author: The New Path

sample_reviews_en.text: Berlin's offers authentic kebabs with quality ingredients and smothered in delicious sauces. As a foreigner in Thailand, they serve food desirable to foreigner taste, and a taste of home for many, whether you are from Germany, Greece or Israel! The beef and lamb kebab is hearty, and the meat is sliced right off the roaster. Pita bread is fresh and depending on how hungry you are, the large size will definitely leave you satisfied! Falafel kebab is also a flavorful medley of herbs. The chicken wrap was delicious as well, with a side of seasoned fries!
sample_reviews_en.author: FiT

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have been to some Turkish kebab shops in Bangkok, which give very less meat in kebab wraps. This German-style shop gives a lot of meat in all kinds of kebab, which is quality and delicious. The döner wrap is also very good.

Moreover, there are healthier choices if you do not eat bread. I chose döner - gym box as a meat lover.

The owner and the staff are very friendly. Lastly, the shop is clean although it is small.

I will definitely come here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emre Senbabaoglu

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a fantastic German style Doner Kebab restaurant. The original is extremely delicious. But I also really love the quesadilla. It's so delicious and just tastes perfect. They have a small dining area. All of the people that work here are ultra friendly, and extremely helpful. Their french fries are amazing. They're mildly seasoned and delicious. It's pretty close to Lat Phrao street on soi 18.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joseph Dewey

sample_reviews_en.text: I saw this place pop up in my feed, and it's not far from my house in Chokchai 4 and my workplace in Ratchada 18. I went to the Ladprao 18 branch, and the atmosphere was like eating in Berlin! They serve German food 🇩🇪 with Turkish 🇹🇷 influences, a perfect blend. I ordered the Doner Kebab with beef, and it was huge! I was completely full. Although it's pricey, it was worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasan Saeng-ngern

restaurants.name: KRUNGTHAI BISTRO
restaurants.address:

4 Rang Nam Alley, Khwaeng Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The instant noodle salad was 150 baht per plate, very expensive and too salty. I ordered apple, lime, and soda, but it was sickeningly sweet and undrinkable. The stir-fried minced pork with basil was also extremely salty; I had to order more water. Then they told me I was the first customer in 60 years to say the 150 baht instant noodle salad was expensive. This restaurant might sell to beer and liquor drinkers, but if you're not, and you're looking for a good meal, I recommend another restaurant or go to Krua Bangkok instead. The staff have no service mind. If I wasn't hungry, I would never go there. Highly not recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jai K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Phat Pong Curry (contains shrimp and squid, not crab)

Pad Thai

Morning Glory

Watermelon Juice

Total: 480 baht

All dishes tasted above average (personally satisfied as the seasoning wasn't too strong)

Since the portions aren't large, I recommend ordering 2-3 dishes per person, or 4-5 dishes for 3 people.

The restaurant was clean and the staff were friendly.

I took the photos after almost finishing everything.

Cards are accepted, but there is a 3% fee (still cheap).
sample_reviews_en.author: aero

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and very affordable. There are a lot of foreigners and working people during peak season. It's not too crowded in the evenings, very relaxing. You can chill and have a meal with friends. They also have a membership program, which is great. If you're coming, you can park at Century Plaza and it's just a few steps away. It's in the alley opposite Oasis, very convenient. You can also walk through this alley to Phaya Thai, which is also very convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: dumppiee OO

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent small restaurant with great food and very affordable. You can see a lot of students and young workers eating here.
The place is very  clean with super kind staff.
They have the menu in English as well and the bf is spectacular.  I went there one time for dinner and came back right the next day for breakfast. It is hidden in an alley so only if you are staying in a hotel in that alley you will know it exists.
Highly recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: Jim Zec

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's delicious... Hmm, it's not insanely delicious, but...

It's just delicious the moment you take a bite! So it's tasty and you don't get tired of it.

Som Tum, Morning Glory,

...Poo Pad Pong Curry Rice, etc. The seasoning is just right and everything is delicious.

Everything else is delicious too...
...You can also pay by card, though there is a small fee 🥹
sample_reviews_en.author: hyeri kang

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a good experience on my first visit so I came back to try some other dishes. The food is delicious.  The staff both times have been friendly. The menu is printed in English and Thai and pointing at the items works best. The place is clean and I have watched them disinfect the tables as guests leave. I have tried the Pad See Ew and the chicken and peppers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Markoski

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is really delicious. The owner is also very friendly. As a flight attendant, I have a lot of opportunities to visit Bangkok, and I always come here on flights. It's great for ordering a variety of dishes alone, and the interior is kept very clean. I'm always a bit greedy, so I order a lot, but if I ask, they'll pack any leftovers in a neat container.
sample_reviews_en.author: yeony

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very clean store. Kind owner:)

Ordered Somtam, Tom Yum fried rice, Pad thai, watermelon juice.

Somtam is pretty spicy but a must order item. Super good.
Tom yum is also good but pad thai wasn’t good as I expected. Watermelon juice is reallllllly sweet i think they put some honey in it.

If you stay around this area, you should visit this place :)
sample_reviews_en.author: SH khai KIM

restaurants.name: Buenos Mexican Restaurant
restaurants.address:

Jomtien, 413/9-10 Thappraya Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Tried two consecutive nights prior to my first initial experience and sadly I must confirm that the food from this venue may likely be tainted at times. Specifically when ordering via Grab. Both online orders caused me to vomit shortly after eating. It just did not sit well on my stomach whatsoever considering I am an avid partaker of Mexican cuisine. Total items ordered included beef and chicken chimichanga (2), beef Mexican pizza (1), hard shell tacos (4) and an order of flautas. This is over a course of three separate eating trials. I cannot in good conscience maintain my 5 star rating for this establishment. It is highly unlikely that I will reorder for delivery from this location. My dine in experience was better than my delivery experience. My true rating would be 2.5 stars, respectfully. My constructive recommendation would be to remove the restaurant from delivery services as this food may not travel well and runs the risk of spoiling the reputation and prestige of the brand associated with this establishment. .
sample_reviews_en.author: DBS Concepts LLC

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered enchiladas a beer and a chicken burrito. Very simple you would assume. The enchiladas came out and I waited for about ten minutes before slowly starting to eat while we waited for a simple chicken burrito. The salsa Rojas was without taste. The beans were thick and without flavour and the rice the same zero seasoning. By the time my whole meal was consumed I finally asked the wait staff where my fiance's food was and they didn't have an answer. The owner came out of the kitchen and when I asked why such a long wait (nearly 1 hour) he just said wait after asking again he informed me that it wasn't ordered. He offered zero apology didn't even offer to cook it for us quickly he just simply let me go back to my table. I quickly paid my food and left. I will never come back especially when I can cook the same thing at home at a much higher level in half the time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrick Ryan

sample_reviews_en.text: First time here.Its hard to find decent mexican food in Thailand but this did the job.Had the sizzling fajitas with some soft tacos kept warm in a pouch... beautifully decorated and attentive staff... when I said to the manager I missed some sour cream he brought me some immediately....ice cold beer(next time I try the margaritas)....only the music was a little bit to loud but it's a personal choice ..if you are craving for mexican this is the best you can find in jomtien area....staff didn't know the names of the dishes but the restaurant is still pretty new....food came out at different times but who has been to Thailand knows it happens in most restaurants.....prices around 300 and up....beer 100 soft drinks 70 water 40...
sample_reviews_en.author: Jimmy B

sample_reviews_en.text:
The young waiter who served us was fantastic. He could see I was hot and bothered and organised not 1 but 2 fans to cool me down. Thank you for that.
The food was amazing! I had steak fajitas, tortillas were hot and in like an oven mitt and hubby had steak burrito and the flavours were amazing. Loved everything that was served. Even loved the plates it was served on.
The owner came over to chat and had noticed my arm in a sling and took the time to ask what happened. Which I thought was nice and showed empathy.
Decided to have dessert which was churros and OMG AMAZING. Hot, cinnamon and sugar. Yummy.
Sad we left this restaurant to the last on our last night in Jomtien as we would have alternated nights.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chloe Bartlett

sample_reviews_en.text: I really enjoyed finding this place in Thailand days earlier and came back as I like Jomtien.  I had the chips and red salss [fresh] and my joy was real.  They served me nice, very warm tortillas chips for dipping and the red sauce cured my need for some Mexican flavors with a beer to go along. Then I ordered the chimichanga and it was done, executed well and you can tell the ingredients and recipe are done with real care.  Delicious, inspired to try a flight of tequilas to set things to another level and had a great meal.  Plan on returning and trying more things.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pal Irvin

sample_reviews_en.text: im from southern California. i know a few things about mexican food. ive.been coming to Thailand 26 years. usually i avoid mexican food in Thailand, becsuse for me it doesn't compare. Bueno is a new restaurant in jomtien complex and the owner is from southern California, so i thought i would give it a try. wow was i surprised . ive eaten here three times now. ive had the burrito, the fajitas and the nachos. all three were  spot on. i can easily say this is the best Mexican restaurant in thailand. please give it a try in jomtien complex .
sample_reviews_en.author: David R

sample_reviews_en.text: As someone who comes to Jomtein on occasion, it's good to have a tasty new restaurant at the jomtein complex.   The restaurant is new and very vibrantly decorated, clean and tasteful.  It has great Mexican vibes!  They have an extensive menu of drinks and food. I had the 3 tacos set, different  fillings and they were ALL good.  Lots of accompaniments come with them.  The frozen mango margarita was delicious as was the classic.  The staff are very friendly and can speak English.  I'll be back for sure!
sample_reviews_en.author: Joey B

sample_reviews_en.text: We moved from Bangkok, which was a food mecca for authentic Mexican cuisine. But Pattaya has proven itself to be a desert for good Mexican food. We found Buenos on Jomtien Walking Street and decided this will be our go to from now on. The atmosphere is very festive, the wait staff are attentive and the food is awesome. Tom, the owner hails from California and brings a fresh Cali-Mex flavor that we need here in Jomtien. The margaritas are delicious and the prices are great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dorothy Sykes

restaurants.name: Phonjaroen
restaurants.address:

53 7 Phaniang Rd, Wat Sommanat, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stumbled upon this restaurant by chance and decided to try it.

The restaurant seems quite old, probably been open for many years, but it's still clean and has a charming, old-world feel.

The staff were attentive and helpful, recommending dishes, refilling water, and clearing plates regularly.

The crispy-skinned grilled chicken was delicious, and the dipping sauce was good too – a must-order. The beef salad was okay, not bad, but the shrimp seemed like it wasn't very fresh, as the heads were separated from the bodies and the meat was starting to get mushy. However, the flavor was still rich. The sun-dried beef seemed a bit underwhelming, with a strange, sour smell that I've encountered at other restaurants. The stir-fried dishes were flavorful and the ingredients were as expected. The prices are neither cheap nor expensive, and there's a diverse menu.

The beef stir-fried with oyster sauce was excellent – ​​a must-order; it was incredibly tender.

Overall, it was an okay place to eat, offering a nice, old-world atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sompound

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went to a funeral at Wat Sommanat and had a little time before the ceremony. I checked Google Maps and came across a restaurant name that sounded similar to our last names: "Pholcharoen" and "Charoenphol."

It's a small restaurant located opposite the Ratchadamnoen stage sign. The atmosphere is relaxed, and the owner, an elderly lady, is very friendly. We ordered three dishes: original crispy-skinned grilled chicken, spicy pork salad, and spicy pork rib soup. I can honestly say this place is truly delicious. The grilled chicken had crispy skin but the meat was still juicy – ​​absolutely delicious! The spicy pork salad and the spicy pork rib soup were also excellent. Anyone passing by this area should stop by; you won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panuwat Charoenphol

sample_reviews_en.text: This place seriously deserves a Michelin star. The food was impeccably spiced, well balanced, fresh, light, and made with so much love and care. It is the best Thai food I have ever had, and I have tried many places, from 5-star establishments to hole in the walls. One aspect of my food experiences that I always yearn for when I try out restaurants is if the food offers nourishment, that secret ingredient called love. This place has it! The food tasted like a home cooked meal made by grandma. The proprietor and chef is a super sweet woman who takes pride in her food. She has such a beautiful face and personality. I’m really so impressed with this restaurant and wish her all the best. Phonjaroen is the best kept secret of Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nhi Nguyen

sample_reviews_en.text: We found this restaurant based on Google reviews. It's located behind the Rajadamnern Stadium and looks very unassuming from the outside. The interior, as is typical of these types of establishments, but the food and selection are in a different league. All the dishes we ordered were fresh, made on site, and very tasty. If you enjoy places with a "local" atmosphere and typically Thai dishes, I highly recommend it and encourage you to visit. Overall, it's a very nice place with friendly service. We'll definitely visit again when we visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patryk Topolski

sample_reviews_en.text:
Quickly served, delicious and open post 17:00 🫣

I was scouting for good piece to eat and was not disappointed with this one, close proximity to our place with nice selection of Thai dishes.

Run by family and we guess (grandparents?) who when they have seen our daughter did spend couple of minutes advertising them.
That also added a charm to the place itself.

Regarding food - we ordered pad Thai, morning glory, Tom yum, fried rice and everything was really good - can truly recommend
sample_reviews_en.author: Sebastian Kochanowski

sample_reviews_en.text: Before arriving for Muay Thai fighting at Raja Stadium my husband and I searched area food choices. Yes, there is a great place owned by family for over 50 years, we decided on this restaurant based on reviews and 2 aunties cooking! Please come enjoy the calm environment and exceptional food! Service with beautiful smiles ! Papaya salad so AROI!! CHICKEN AROI MA! 🥰 Kap Kun Ka 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Dani Baribeau

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the grilled chicken, fried rice noodles, and stir-fried morning glory, and everything was absolutely delicious! The flavors were perfectly balanced, and the dishes were cooked to perfection. If you’re in the area to watch Muay Thai, this place is a great spot to enjoy a meal before or after the match. Highly recommended for both the food and the experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Shuo Zong

sample_reviews_en.text: Food is subpar compared to other Thai food I've had. Much pricer than other places. The owner is very friendly but quite pushy, kept pushing for us to order more... And insisted that we gave tips. I am OK tipping if I genuinely was impressed but there's nothing much to wow about.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chow Jia Hui (chowjiahui)

restaurants.name: สมัญญาก๋วยเตี๋ยวเนื้อตุ๋น
restaurants.address:

23/14 Soi Nawamin 111 Yaek 2, Nawamin, Bueng Kum, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: A small but very delicious Muslim beef noodle shop. It's hidden in a small alley, but the taste is not small at all. The fresh beef is delicious, the stewed beef is perfectly tender, there are many offal to choose from, the soup smells of Chinese herbs. In addition, the shop also sells stir-fried basil with rice. The taste is rich and very delicious. The shop is in Soi Nawamin 111, intersection 4-2. You can park on the side of the road in the intersection.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aood Waiyavutti

sample_reviews_en.text:
The stewed beef noodle soup is delicious, with perfectly cooked, fragrant beef. The beef is cut into large pieces and then sliced ​​before being served in the bowl, resulting in a distinct flavor.
The stewed beef with tripe is also very tasty. This is a restaurant that puts a lot of effort into its food.
The prices are affordable, and the portions are generous.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภูมิ ตรี

sample_reviews_en.text: Good. You can come and eat here. The noodles are more delicious than I thought. Everything is well done, but the fresh beef is a bit tough. The beef tongue with basil is soft, delicious, and melts in your mouth. The portions are generous and they don't take advantage of customers. The price is not expensive. I will come and support you again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ordinary Decent Criminal

sample_reviews_en.text: This Islamic-style beef noodle shop is located in a deep alley. It's delicious; the stewed beef isn't overly mushy, making it enjoyable to chew. The fresh beef is unmarinated and simply blanched. The broth is fragrant and flavorful. Highly recommend trying it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimnatthar T

sample_reviews_en.text: The meat is very fresh and delicious. You can stop by and visit. It takes a little while to wait because the chef uses fresh cutting methods, so the food is fresh and delicious. You may have to wait a bit. Eating delicious food requires patience.
sample_reviews_en.author: บานเถิง

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! The broth was fragrant with spices, perfectly balanced in flavor, not overly sweet. The meat was genuinely fresh and incredibly tender, not marinated to the point of losing its flavor. The stewed meat melted in your mouth, the …
sample_reviews_en.author: Net Flix

sample_reviews_en.text: A delicious stewed beef restaurant with reasonable prices. The beef tongue with basil rice is very delicious. The beef tongue is soft and not tough. The stewed beef noodles are also delicious. The boiled stewed beef is also excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Surachet Khemtrong

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious beef and chicken noodles with a flavorful broth that's so good you'll want to finish the whole bowl. You should try it! Located in Soi Nawamin 111. They also have beef basil rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pooyailee channel

restaurants.name: กุ้ยช่ายคุณแม่
restaurants.address:

520 Thanon Tanao, San Chao Pho Sua, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Khun Mae's Chive Dumplings (Shrine of the Tiger God): This shop sells small chive dumplings in boxes of 10 for 40 baht. I bought two boxes to try, focusing on the vegetable filling. This is a general review of all the fillings I tried (vegetable, taro, jicama, bamboo shoot). The taste was average; nothing was exceptional that would make me feel like I had to come specifically to this shop. At 4 baht per small dumpling, it's not cheap. Both in taste and price, I still prefer my regular dumpling shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: MrStew LuiRoj

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried them and the chive dumplings were delicious. The dough is very thin, but when I tried to use a fork to pick them up and put them in my mouth, the filling spilled out. They should change from the forks they provide to spoons so you can scoop up both the dumpling and the dipping sauce at the same time; it tastes much better that way. The fillings available are chive, bamboo shoot, and taro. They cost 40 baht per pack. They are truly delicious; chive dumpling lovers shouldn't miss them!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanakrit Ruangroj

sample_reviews_en.text:
They offer both fried and regular chive dumplings. We bought the square-shaped and dumpling-shaped fried chive dumplings. Personally, I preferred the dumpling-shaped ones; they had more chives and tasted better. The square ones were a bit too doughy. The dipping sauce was a good balance of salty, sour, and sweet. Overall, the fried chive dumplings were just okay. Next time, I'll try the regular ones.

Chive dumplings are 45 baht per set.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peach Phichsinee

sample_reviews_en.text: Freshly made chive dumplings are displayed in the back. The aroma of the fried chive dumplings is so inviting, I stopped by. The price is very good, not expensive at all, 45 baht per set. There are several fillings to choose from, both fried and fresh. The fried chive dumplings are crispy and delicious, and the dipping sauce is a perfect balance of sweet and salty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Parchaya Veecharungson

sample_reviews_en.text:
May 2023
Price: 45 baht per box. Thin crust, lots of filling. The dipping sauce is slightly spicy with chili. Located on the roadside near the Chao Pho Suea Shrine. Parking is difficult; it's best to call and order in advance and pick it up yourself, as police officers are constantly patrolling and your car might get towed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nithiwich Jb

sample_reviews_en.text: The dough is nice and thin. I recommend the chive and taro fillings; they're generously filled and soft. The bamboo shoot filling only has bamboo shoots, and the jicama filling is a bit bland. Ordering via Grab was great. Eight dumplings with different fillings cost 40 baht, excluding delivery fee.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanthida 'Mim' Saiphim

sample_reviews_en.text: Kuichai comes in both fried and steamed versions. The fried version is crispy on the outside and soft on the inside with a lot of filling. The steamed version has thin dough with a lot of filling and a delicious dipping sauce. It's perfect for taking home if you don't have a place to sit and eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: NoBi Kung

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thin dough
The taste is okay, acceptable.
The portion size is just right.
The dipping sauce is okay.
There's quite a long queue for the fried chive dumplings.
If they don't fry them, there's no queue; the steamed version is also delicious.
Try it out, it depends on personal preference.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naszha Pimpawatin

restaurants.name: Valencia Spanish Restaurant
restaurants.address:

64/69 หมู่ที่ 12, ปาก Thepprasit Rd, ตำบล เมืองพัทยา, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is really really good.
The fried squid was nice crispy outside and yummi inside. The crust adds well to the taste of the squid and doesn't cover it. Recommended starter.
The mixed paella was amazing. The right crust on the ground of the pan which is important for the taste. Chicken, mussels, squid and shrimps combine to the full harmony of a good paella.
We had paella for 2 which easily would feed four. We will be happy to eat the leftovers tomorrow.
The ambience could be improved with some Spanish decorations and music. Feels like a small restaurant in a small Spanish village.
Suggest that you bring your big family or a group of friends with you. Will feel like a Spanish family dinner. Wine glasses are properly filled. Perfect to enjoy the evening.
Highly recommend if you prefer quality of food over Instagram locations!
sample_reviews_en.author: Joe Di

sample_reviews_en.text:
World-class paella.
I am a professional chef and I know what I’m talking about: this paella is truly exceptional. Perfectly cooked rice, outstanding depth of flavor, and flawless balance—executed at the highest level.
The sangria is excellent as well, fresh, well-balanced, and clearly made with high-quality ingredients.
Service is absolutely perfect: professional, attentive, and warm without being intrusive.
Since discovering this restaurant, I have been coming back every single week—and that alone says everything.
A rare experience. This is how it should be done. Greetings from switzerland.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angela Salvisberg

sample_reviews_en.text: Very cozy atmosphere, a home, but the paella was restaurant level perfection - savory socarrat just like in Valencia. Bomba rice cooked to perfection. The house wine paired flawlessly, I had a red wine that had just the right sweetness and somehow reminded me of sangria minus the citrus and so on. I had a vegetarian version but filling and satisfying nonetheless. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: R R

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious. I love their paella the most. This is our family's regular restaurant. Whenever we're in Pattaya, we like to call and order it. Even if we don't eat at the restaurant, we take it back to Bangkok. It's still delicious even when refrigerated.

I recommend calling ahead to order before arriving at the restaurant. The owner, Khun Nan, is very friendly and lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poonyisa G.

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time trying Spanish food, and it was delicious, especially the seafood! The owner was lovely, and the service was friendly and welcoming. I recommend calling ahead and ordering about an hour in advance to ensure you can enjoy your meal without waiting too long. 🥰🙏🏻 I'll definitely be back! …
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaimuk Singha

sample_reviews_en.text:
The look of the dishes was good but the taste was not what we expected! The ingredients which is a bit lack of freshness! And limited menu to choose...  (only 6 things in the menu)
But the old lady was very helpful and very educated!
Keep going and hope to see more things in your menu!
sample_reviews_en.author: ml7177

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. The paella must be ordered in advance. The price is per person, and the portion increases based on the number of people.

A single portion of paella is sufficient for two people, unless you only want the paella.

3. This is a family restaurant.

4. Good value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Su Yeshi

sample_reviews_en.text:
small and kind of hidden place, paella is very delicious and huge portion , 600 THB for 2 persons and we took about 30% home as we couldn’t finish
you need to do a reservation if you don’t like to wait as the place is not busy and the food need about 45min to be prepared
sample_reviews_en.author: Juergen Tyralla

restaurants.name: KRUATAMSANG
restaurants.address:

53 Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant has delicious food and amazing smoothies. The service is good.

It was still delicious on my second visit, but lately the quality seems inconsistent. Some dishes are still as good as before, but some things I ordered were inedible.

The pork was tough and fatty, and the chicken was very fatty and had an off smell.

The train station fried rice used to be much sweeter; the last time I ate it, it was extremely sweet.

The shrimp paste fried rice is delicious.

The fried chicken wings are amazing.

The food service is a bit slow. Sometimes it's fine if we're not in a hurry, but when I go with family, the food doesn't always come out at the same time, with long gaps between servings.

The service is good though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Being Journal

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stopped by here for lunch. We ordered stirred fried cabbage, rice with fresh veggies, Chinese sausage, and pork. I got the curry, mixed eggs with pork and white rice. The best dish was the curry egg mixed pork over white rice. It had flavor, and it came out warm. The pork slices were pork belly. The cabbage stir-fried wasn't anything special. My wife ordered the flavor rice with fresh vegetables, Chinese sausage, pork, and egg. The dish was cold. That shouldn't be. The picture on the menu isn't even closed to what came out. I noticed that there were tiny bugs and ant by the window.
Service and food came out quickly. I wouldn't come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Calvin Ng

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten at this restaurant many times, but this is the most disappointing experience so far. Normally, when I order the creamy scrambled eggs with rice, they're served in one dish, ready to eat, looking appetizing and delicious. But lately, the creamy eggs have started looking unappetizing and lumpy. This time, they were served in a separate bowl, and I had to pour them over the rice myself. When I asked the owner, they couldn't explain why they were serving it separately, even though it used to be served in the same dish before.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zoom

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere in the restaurant is nice, it's air-conditioned, and the staff provides good service. As for the food, dishes with coconut milk are incredibly delicious! The crispy pork stir-fry with chili paste is good, the stir-fried noodles with chicken are tasty, the drunken noodles with instant noodles are delicious, even the fried pork sausage is good. However, the prices seem a bit high. Overall, it's good. I like it!
P.S. If you're hungry late at night, sorry, because the restaurant closes quite early.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rainie

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been in Thailand for two weeks now, and this is in my top 3 best places, not just 3rd. The Thai milk tea is the cheapest I've seen and definitely one of the best. The curry is excellent and really inexpensive, especially considering the portion size. The chicken is delicious; it could perhaps use a few more vegetables, but for 79 baht, it far exceeded my expectations.

I recommend it 100%. I live right next door, and I think I'll be going back regularly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anthony Bonnafé

sample_reviews_en.text: This à la carte restaurant serves incredibly flavorful and delicious food that I just had to recommend. I happened to eat there while waiting for errands. While eating, I was wondering why there weren't many people eating there, even though it was so delicious. When I went in, there was only one other table occupied. But by the time I paid, the restaurant was full! The prices are moderate, and the food quality is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wirote T.

sample_reviews_en.text: We've  lived in the area for 4 years and walked past this restaurant many times. Glad we finally tried it. Large menu which you can scan to view online or they do have traditional menus. Good prices for example crab fried rice for 99 baht that also comes with seaweed soup is excellent value. Large comfortable space with three air conditioning units set at 22 degrees. Enjoyed everything we ate and will be back. Recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: Geordie boy lost in Asia

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. We were two people, and the waiter brought us only one menu  although the restaurant was empty. Bringing two menus for two people is basic service.
2. We asked for a not spicy dish, however it was still spicy. The waiter never asked if it is ok.
3. We asked for the menu again to order a drink, the waiter brought it but then took it back without even asking.
In summary: The waiters service was bad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eran

restaurants.name: ครัวนามิจัง Krua Nami Chan
restaurants.address:

87 Ban Kluai Nuea Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Updated January 2026
I had beer with som tam korat and finished off with khao pad moo gof. The spicy-salty som tam goes well with beer, but it's quite spicy, so if you don't like spicy food, ask for an adjustment. The khao pad was fluffy and light and delicious. This is a rare, affordable restaurant in this area. I'm changing my rating from 3 to 4.

First post:
This open-air Thai restaurant is under a tent roof. It's a bargain in the area. My meal of khao gapow moo gof, kho moo yang, and a medium bottle of beario came in at less than 300 THB. The kho moo yang was a bit dry and not very good, so I wouldn't recommend it. The gapow was not badly seasoned. Unfortunately, due to Loy Krathong, they closed earlier than usual, around 7:30 PM, while I was still eating, which was disappointing. I wish they'd at least stopped pushing up chairs at the table right next to me. I'm sorry that the score was so low, so I'll come back to eat again at a later date.
sample_reviews_en.author: 2pong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very underwhelming after seeing such high reviews. Maybe they reduce the Thai flavour for farang in the area (being Thong Lor) but food flavour was very underwhelming. For those that eat Thai/Isaan food want that strong punch flavour in different dishes.

I ordered sticky rice and later told us that they didn’t haven any when I asked for it when food arrived. Could have said at the start and thought it was poor service along side not offering ice to go with the beer.

Lastly I order grilled pork neck…. It wasn’t grilled so it didn’t have that delicious chat flavour that comes with the simple but delicious dish…… which they forgot and rushed to serve after we asked about it rest of the food was mostly finished.

Food wasn’t bad but there was much left to be desired (when you are used to eating Thai food in Thailand)
sample_reviews_en.author: Tyler Hope

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food was solid overall for a casual local street restaurant.
The chicken with cashew nuts was tasty with good wok flavor, though I would’ve liked a bit more sauce for the rice. Also worth noting that the portion was on the smaller side.

The chicken pad kra pao was enjoyable too, but I was surprised the chicken came in larger chunks rather than minced, which is what I usually expect from pad kra pao.

The chicken pad see ew took unusually long to arrive despite the restaurant not being busy. Unfortunately it was the weakest dish of the three. The seasoning was very mild, almost bland, and there was a slight aftertaste from another dish that may have been cooked in the same wok.

Still, for the price and local atmosphere, it was a decent experience overall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eat the world

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant gave me the wrong order, and the staff's attitude afterward was very poor.
Even though I specifically asked for no spice, there were still chilies in the dish. There were multiple mistakes.
And there was no apology at all. I was very unimpressed with the service.
However, the food was delicious; I really liked the taste. It's a shame about the poor service.

The staff brought the wrong order, and their attitude afterward was very poor.
Even though I clearly asked for no spicy, there were still chilies in the dish, and there were multiple mistakes.
Despite this, there was no apology at all, which was very disappointing.
The food itself is delicious and I really like it, but the service was unfortunately disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: I6 09

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ive lived in Thailand many, many years as a foreigner. I have also lived in this neighbourhood for many, many years.

Discovered this place by accident, because the restaurant we wanted to go to, further down the road, was closed.

And what a lovely discovery !

We were impressed by the variety and value in the menu. Lots and lots to choose from, and everything we had was absolutely excellent.

Ive been looking for an unpretentious, true to form, local Thai eatery in Thonglor, and was delighted to discover this place. Its truly authentic, and offers fantastic food, at dirt cheap prices !

Dont be put off by its looks. This place is a GEM !
Highly recommend !
sample_reviews_en.author: pierre

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was looking for a place near my hotel in Sukhumvit where I could experience the Bangkok atmosphere at a reasonable price, and I stumbled upon this place.

The food is delicious and very affordable. It's a place where locals gather with their families, and tourists enjoy Thai food with Singha beer.

I went there twice during my two-day stay, ordering green curry, mixed vegetable stir-fry, and gapao rice.

Everything was delicious. Even better, the cost performance is amazing! ✨
I definitely want to come back here on my next trip to Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: クロブチメガネ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Okay, it's street food and not a proper restaurant, but the people are incredibly friendly and the food (we didn't have a single thing that wasn't delicious 😋) is unbeatable, around 80 baht +/- absolutely fantastic!!!

Lots of locals and grab truck drivers also get food here, which is a great sign. 👌👌👌 It's on a side street directly opposite the Salil Hotel 😉 (The food is better than the breakfast at the Salil 🫣 sorry).

It's open from 8 am to 11 pm... amazing, you absolutely have to go, it's so delicious and affordable!!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Asti N.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Well, I'm at the hotel across the street… I thought, "Yeaaaah, a restaurant right across the street! Thai food… let's try it…"

1) I ordered the chicken wings… in the picture there are a lot… we only received 4, and they were half-dried out…
2) Chicken curry… with rice, but no rice…
3) Seafood noodles… we threw the dish in the bin… not bad, but when it's seafood and you're not sure… well, it's better not to eat it!!!

So I really don't recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jonathan Masure

restaurants.name: HAPPY FRIED RICE Pattaya
restaurants.address:

389/7 Phra Tam Nak 5, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: If you want to enjoy genuine fried rice, be sure to visit here. This place is right on the road so you can find it easily. And I really liked the open kitchen she had because it had been kept clean. Don't forget to read the 7 rules of life on the kitchen wall.I was so touched by those rules.😁😁 The boss seemed to be proud of herself about her lovely own restaurant. I ordered 4 kinds of foods so I had to wait for a long time(about 20-25 minutes) because there was only one stove. But it was worth to wait. All the food I ordered was so great. I got the foods with to-go box to my hotel room and the packaging of the food was so neat. I want to say thank her to experience her food. Take care and I hope to enjoy your meal next year again. 😍😍
sample_reviews_en.author: GELA (ANGELA)

sample_reviews_en.text: Recently found this lovely place by chance when moving to Pratumnak area and walked past, the food is health focused and cooked with healthier oils and ingredients - it has meal prep option & the tastiest fried rice dishes! I like she removes the tail on the shrimps for a better eating experience! Overall I cannot fault this place, you can message on instagram or call to order or ask any questions, the first time I went she was busy so defiantly contact in advance just incase she is prepping meal plans as it is just the one lady working here! There is also a fresh juice shop close by that does the best fresh pressed juices - recommend ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Jade x

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Best. Fried. Rice. I have ever had in my life. The perfect amount of oil, perfectly separated and coated kernels of rice, perfect balance of tangy, pungent, and savory, superb wok hei.  And just look at the glisten on that sea bass.

I’m culturally biased to Chinese cuisine but this was just perfect, better than anything I’ve had in China or NYC or LA or anywhere, and I’ve eaten a ton of fried rice.  The ingredients aren’t as fancy as like crab fried rice but the cooking skill stands on its own.  And the lady there is so friendly and nice.  Highly recommended!!
sample_reviews_en.author: tobias shen

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is absolutely one of the best places for fried rice.. the "fried rice chili bacon garlic" is soooo good!!

I eat Thai  food all the time  and fried rice one or two times a week but if I'm near Happy Fried Rice, I will always go there.

I now order one extra fried rice for take away for the next day. That's how much I like it

The fried rice tastes light, not greasy. They use fresh ingredients and keep their kitchen very clean.

The staff are very friendly too.
