I highly recommend this restaurant if you want fried rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Harrington

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my second visit to Happy Fried Rice in Pattaya this year 🙏

These definitely won't be my only visits. I'm thrilled! I've rarely eaten such fresh, delicious food in such a great atmosphere. I already miss the food and am looking forward to my next visit.

This quality, these wonderful people, and this price... Wow!!! 💪
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Zürcher

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered fried rice with gapow rice. I was looking for delicious gapow rice and ended up here. The rice was fluffy and tasted like authentic Chinese food, and it was delicious. I was able to talk to the owner, and it was clear that he puts great care into his cooking. This is one restaurant I'd like to visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kohei S

sample_reviews_en.text:
The rice really makes you happy, simply just delicious, real soul food --> now I will test the protein fruit ice cream 🤩

Edit: Have just tried the freshly homemade mango protein ice cream, no joke the best I have ever eaten... so fruity, i think im addicted now and i dont even feel Bad about it because its healthy
sample_reviews_en.author: Tobias Esslinger

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner is very charming, which explains the numerous 5-star reviews. Our two rice dishes were good, but lacked the full flavor of Thai cuisine. It's fine if you live in the neighborhood. If you're in Jomtien or Pattaya, don't make the trip. The 30-minute wait was a bit long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ed Ed

restaurants.name: พี่พึง หลอดวัดราชบพิธ ตามสั่ง
restaurants.address:

70 Fueang Nakhon Rd, Wang Burapha Phirom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I happened to stop by this restaurant, lured by the smell of garlic. The fried rice, mixed with lots of crispy fried pork on the outside, was delicious! It was quite spicy, but the spiciness lingers. It was crowded with locals, and some people were taking out. For 70฿, I got a portion that was more than one woman could finish, and I was very satisfied! I'll definitely come again! The English-speaking staff were very kind and friendly!
sample_reviews_th.author: なーさん

sample_reviews_en.text:
Since I often walked past there and always saw people sitting and eating, I decided to try it myself.

There's no set menu, but the waitress gives you a choice. You can put together your own meal, for example, whether you want rice or noodles, chicken or meat, and so on. I asked her to put something together for me, and the food arrived fresh at my table two minutes later. It was noodles with meat and seafood. All in all, absolutely delicious.

The meal cost 80 baht, and the Coca-Cola was 25 baht.

Unbeatable value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julius Menzler

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place to eat. My partner and I didn't know where we wanted to eat and stumbled upon this place on the way. We were served by a friendly woman who was happy to help us choose our food. I went for the chicken noodles and they tasted amazing. I was allowed to choose how spicy I wanted my food and she also gave me good advice. The food tasted great and was reasonably priced. All in all, a great experience and typically Thai. If you ever want to eat truly authentic Thai food (in my opinion), this is the place to be.
sample_reviews_en.author: T.J.R

sample_reviews_en.text: This made-to-order food stall serves tasty and inexpensive dishes with generous portions. The stir-frying skill is good, though not outstanding; it lacks the characteristic wok aroma, but there are no burnt-on bits in the food. The wait isn't long. They've been selling food by the canal near Wat Ratchabophit for at least 20 years. Free ice and water are provided. The vendor is friendly. Eating upwind near the Krung Thai Bank will prevent you from being affected by the cooking smell.
sample_reviews_en.author: Absolute Command

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! The fried egg was super crispy and not oily at all. It was a perfectly cooked fried egg. I usually buy it to take home, but today I tried eating in. There was quite a wait, but once the food arrived, it was worth it. It was so delicious! Now I understand why there are so many people and long queues. Importantly, the young man who served us was very polite, friendly, and had a great personality. 🥰 I'll definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: VK Google account

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is very cheap and the ingredients are fresh.
The atmosphere is relaxing by the canal, and the wait time is short.
(The prawns and squid are large.)
P.S. The crispy pork is incredibly delicious! The restaurant opens at 5 pm, and by 7:30 pm, the crispy pork is almost sold out. If you want to try it, I recommend going early.

✓Food isn't overly sweet.
✓Inexpensive prices.
✓The taste is consistently delicious on all three visits.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pinyarat Panpakdee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Thai street food. Just let the lady at the food cart know you're coming, and she'll assign you a table and tell you the current wait time.

There's no set menu; it's all about ordering. You can choose soup (Tom Yum), noodles, or rice.

Then you choose your meat and whether you want it with or without egg.

And very importantly—the level of spiciness. Very tasty and a good portion size.
sample_reviews_en.author: K. Wölk

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great food at a reasonable price. This street food spot offers a good variety of Thai dishes, and the option to customize your meal makes it even better. The portions are satisfying, with a decent amount of chicken, meat, and prawns in each dish.

Simple place, but good food and good people. definitely worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Deepak Asokan

restaurants.name: Ginzado
restaurants.address:

53 1 Sukhumvit 26, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ginzado is a yakiniku (Japanese grilled meat) restaurant that I've been a regular at for many years, and it consistently maintains a high standard in both ingredient quality and service. They offer various grades of meat to suit different preferences and budgets, from entry-level to premium, and the quality is always worth the price. For those who don't eat beef, they also have pork options. The meat is grilled over charcoal, giving it a wonderfully enticing aroma.

Previously, lunchtime meals included rice and pickled vegetables, but now there's an additional charge of about 80 baht per person. However, it's worth it because the kimchi is incredibly fresh and delicious. This set includes rice, soup, pickled vegetables, and ice cream, all with unlimited refills.

The restaurant has two floors, all air-conditioned. Reservations are recommended on weekends and during peak meal times as it can get quite busy. Parking is available, although limited, with a steady flow of vehicles. They also sell high-quality meat to take home at reasonable prices. For meat lovers, this remains one of the most highly recommended restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: SuperAuis Nantawan N.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is recommended for those looking for a cost-effective yakiniku (Japanese BBQ) lunch around Phrom Phong.
This time, I ordered the lean meat platter for 280B. While the amount of meat seemed a little small, the quality was good, and being able to grill it over charcoal made it satisfying.
What was particularly good was that kimchi, namul, and rice were all refillable. The kimchi and namul were also delicious, and considering the whole set, I think it offers excellent value for money.
I added sparkling water for 30B and ice for 50B.
The restaurant is spacious, clean, and has a comfortable atmosphere for a relaxed meal. Its proximity to Phrom Phong, within walking distance, was also convenient.
Those who want to eat a lot of meat might find the portion size a little small, but it's recommended for those who prioritize meat quality and the overall balance of the set over quantity.
At this price, the content is highly satisfying, and I would like to use this restaurant again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ren

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ginzado is an excellent Japanese restaurant in the Rama 4 area of ​​Bangkok.

Upon arrival, a large parking lot makes it easy for diners to park their cars without the hassle of finding a free spot.

The restaurant is charming, with two floors and plenty of tables.
In the center of each table is a space where the barbecue is placed for cooking meat and vegetables.
The menu offers a wide selection, but Ginzado is especially famous for its meat.

The staff is kind and friendly, and many speak English.

I absolutely recommend this restaurant. The food is delicious, and it's wonderful to share dinner with friends or family.

🅿️ Parking: ✅️

♿ 🅿️ Wheelchair Parking: ✅️

🛗 Lift/ramp: ❌️

sample_reviews_en.author: Sandro Nick

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is definitely a great value restaurant that I'd like to visit again and again. Meat lovers should definitely try it at least once. It gets crowded at lunchtime, so reservations are recommended. You only have one hour to enjoy the lunch set, but you can order extra meat as much as you like. The meat quality is excellent. I never asked for refills of the rice and side dishes, so I don't know if they are refillable. For dessert, I recommend choosing ice cream or fruit instead of the instant coffee included in the set. The dipping sauce for the meat is very tasty. There's also a butcher shop where you can buy groceries to take home.
Pro: Good meat, delicious side dishes
sample_reviews_en.author: Sobthana Anprasert

sample_reviews_en.text:
In my 3 month stay in Bangkok, I cannot count how many times I came here to eat.

What an incredible Japanese bbq. First I was amazed on the amount of options they had. Their meat options were endless and it looked like they virtually had every part of the cow on their menu.

I chose A1 A2 A5 as my favorites. The cooking time is less than 30 seconds on each side, any more than that is a disservice to the meat.

The meat is unbelievably good here. Juicy, fatty from the wagyu and has an amazing flavor profile that I have trouble finding in many other beef bbq places.

Also PLEASE order J2, the ramen. WOW! it was better than I ever imagined.

Ginzado is a MUST visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ali

sample_reviews_en.text:
When eating Japanese-style yakiniku in Bangkok, the difference in meat quality is more noticeable than the price difference compared to Japan.

While the skirt steak and tongue at Ginza-do look fresh, the density of flavor when chewed is a notch below that of Japanese yakiniku in the same price range.

The staff are polite, the atmosphere is calm, and there are no complaints regarding the service.

Given the limited yakiniku options in Bangkok, it's a "passable" choice, but if you go expecting authentic Japanese yakiniku, you might be disappointed.

If you can accept that, it's not a bad choice.

Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: 世界のユウイチロウ&co

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was bomb 💣 as usual!! But service was really unexpectedly bad. After ordering shots of alcohol they brought soda mixed with alcohol. After not helping after bringing the drinks without even asking they eventually brought a new set of drinks for us just to realize it was the same thing just in a different glass. Finally we got the shots but they didn’t do anything to help. Hopefully they improve there staff. They weren’t as friendly as before. Otherwise food was too good. Great recommendation!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr Wander

sample_reviews_en.text: 5 stars all the way. I came at 2pm and the lunch crowd has left. Very delicious.  High quality, good service, beautiful restaurant.  The meat is more flavorful and delicious than Yakiniku Like!. for about the same price.  Can you believe I got all this for 280b++?  Light jazz music in the background.  I'm Very happy with this lunch. (Dinner and special order beef are more expensive of course).  This is a big, 2 storey high class restaurant suitable for business dinners, expensive dates.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lawrence

restaurants.name: CoCo ICHIBANYA
restaurants.address:

G, Siam Paragon Shopping Center, 991 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Waiting for food 40mins! Are you kidding me.

The 2table that came after i order got food already. They order the same dish as me!!

The staff is not friendly. They dont even know how to speak politely, and the behavior is not what you expect from people who work in service industry.

The curry is not well cook. I can even see some carrot and vegetable not properly blend in the curry(see pic of a lot of orange veggie chunk)

More over. The restaurant is poorly maintain. Many crack tiles on the counter and chair. This likely to be the hidden place for pest and insect. As i work in hospitality and have experience in F&B, the level of hygiene is not met standard.

I though i visit some far country side restaurant not in some high end malls.
I mean even the country side restaurant, staff is friendly.......
sample_reviews_en.author: Manawat R. (Knight)

sample_reviews_en.text: Please see my review history for my credentials in reviewing Coco Ichibanya. This Thai branch is indistinguishable in quality to the Japanese counterpart. The maximum spice level is Level 5, which is about a Level 4 by Japanese standards. The curry sauce is representative of the Japanese version. The mushrooms are different which is to be expected but provide the same flavour quality. Kirin Ichiban is not available here, but instead Asahi and Heineken. The Asahi beer is brewed in Thailand but is also indistinguishable from Japanese-brewed Asahi, as is expected from the quality of most South East Asian beers. I highly recommend this one to get the true Japanese Coco Ichibanya experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bumblebara

sample_reviews_en.text: I was excited to eat this Japanese curry. I stopped by and escorted by the cashier infront of the restaurant. Then after few minutes waiting, no one came with menu. Then I saw the cashier who welcomed me, give menu to a table that was empty when I came. I was disappointed then I came to the cashier to ask for the menu, because no one coming with menu, even the waitress. Then when I came to cashier to ask for the menu, I don’t understand what she said (cuz I don’t understand Thai) she ask her waiter friend to bring the menu to my table. That was really ruined my mood to eat here. But beside that, over all the food and the service are 👍🏻 okay
sample_reviews_en.author: Ivonny Gunawan

sample_reviews_en.text: (10/3/2020) Both curry dishes were tasty as always but the thing that I was disappointed most about this restaurant was the staff. They were not only treated us with bad customer service since we stood in a queue until got a bill but also kept the change without our permission. We, however, went to cashier and asked them to get the change back. The grumpy staff at cashier desk eventually gave us the change but she didn’t make eye contact or even say sorry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sariya S.

sample_reviews_en.text: The curry rice 🍛 is only one good thing about this place otherwise it’s deserving no stars. Rude waitresses, bad attitude towards customers. Waiting time for one order per one client is unusual as I waited 30 minutes but another group which came later got order served before mine. While it is in category fast food, but not so fast and not first come first serve at all, unlike in Japan where staff work with integrity. Blame the franchise owners.
sample_reviews_en.author: Madames Pagy

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s a pretty standard Coco experience if you’ve ever been to one before. It’s one of the best Japanese curry places in California by far. This particular one was fine and had salmon which ours don’t but it came out almost immediately and the curry was more warm than hot/fresh. Overall worth it and much cheaper here than in the US. I’d say it’s worth it if you’ve never been and if you have then it's a safe bet for some good quick curry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Acefej

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍛 COCO, Siam Paragon Branch, G Floor
🍚 Ordering process is the same as all branches: order your menu, choose your spiciness level. For those who like medium spiciness, we recommend levels 2-3. For those who like it very spicy, go for levels 4-5. You can increase or decrease the amount of rice.
🍝 I like the feature of being able to choose as many optional toppings as you like.
🍥 Food prices do not include a 10% service charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanachai Udomwan

sample_reviews_en.text: A standard plate of Japanese cuisine. Good thing about it is that u can choose how much rice and curry you want as well as the spice level. Nothing special but cannot go wrong as well. Green tea milk shake is pretty good and addictive. Can give this restaurant a try if you’re nearby as i do not see it being able to go wrong with the food which is a very safe choice
sample_reviews_en.author: Jia Wei

restaurants.name: Buondi Italian Restaurant
restaurants.address:

391/72 Thappraya Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was searching online for good value Western food and this place came up, so I went.
(I took a songthaew, and a woman who appeared to be of Indian descent got on even though the bus was crowded. She seemed to be a pickpocket, and there was a bit of a fuss on board. I'd never gotten on a crowded songthaew, and the driver didn't try to force me onto the bus, so there's a chance she was in on it.)
For some reason, the menu is also written in Japanese, and the majority of the customers were Thai, with only a few Westerners who seemed to live there.
It's true that this price is cheap for Italian food in Pattaya, but the taste was just so-so.
The risotto was as generous as fried rice, but there was almost no cheese flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kuushinsai Kuushinsai

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's been a long time since I last visited before the pandemic.
The restaurant has been renovated and is now beautifully bright.
I ordered caprese, beef carpaccio, and vongole. The prices are relatively reasonable, but the flavors are robust.
The restaurant had a rich international flavor, with Americans, French, and Indians.

It had been a long time since I visited the restaurant before the pandemic.
The restaurant had been renovated and was clean and bright.
I ordered caprese, beef carpaccio, and bongole. The prices are relatively reasonable, but I think the taste is good.
The restaurant had a rich international flavor, with Americans, French, and Indians.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shigeki Namatame

sample_reviews_en.text:
May 2, 2025 Brunch
I happened to be passing by around 2:30 PM and remembered this place.
I'd been curious about it ever since I'd heard it was reasonably priced and delicious. My order came to 400 baht in total: a beer chaan (60 baht), mozzarella and tomato (160 baht), and beef carpaccio (180 baht).
Condiments like olive oil and salt were available on the table, so you could customize your meal to your liking.
sample_reviews_en.author: TAKEZO

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten several times at this restaurant. It's near to a whole clutch of other Italian places which I think fall into a much higher price bracket. I've always enjoyed the food. I
My usual is spaghetti carbonara with a green salad. Both are excellent. I couldn't improve on the oil and vinegar dressing. And the spaghetti is always just "al dente". Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bradiston Fernhead

sample_reviews_en.text: The carbonara with the green salad is good. I'm editing this to emphasise how much I appreciate this small "taverna". The green salad is big and they add their own vinaigrette which perfectly suits me. The pasta is cooked just so, and the carbonara sauce is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phineas John

sample_reviews_en.text:
Not a big cozy restaurant. If you are tired of Thai food, you can come here (although it is on the menu, of course)). We took lasagna and pork chops with fries, they brought it quickly, it was delicious.
Smiling friendly staff
There is Wi-Fi)
sample_reviews_en.author: Илья Кондратьев

sample_reviews_en.text:
Decent food. Cheaper than the other Italian restaurants in the Jomtien area. I really liked the risotto. Friendly staff. The staff informed me about the 30 minutes preparation time for the risotto👌
FYI: No dessert menu. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Rune Sonne

sample_reviews_en.text: I love this restaurant so much. Every time I have the chance to come to Pattaya, I always eat here. The spaghetti with clams and the tuna salad are both exceptionally well-prepared. I highly recommend this restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Supharat Phichayaanutarat

restaurants.name: Hachiban Tukcom Pattaya ฮะจิบังราเมน ตึกคอมพัทยาใต้
restaurants.address:

ตึกคอมพัทยาใต้ ชั้น G, 8 Moo 10 Tukcom Pattaya G Floor Tambon Pattayatai Amphoe Nongprue Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the pork bone tantanmen for 105B.
It was spicier than I expected. I didn't really get the pork bone broth flavor, but it was still tasty and I ate it all, including the soup.

On another day I had yakisoba for 105B and gyoza for 83B.
Delicious. The taste is on par with what you'd get at a Japanese restaurant, so for the price I'm happy.

On another day, I had 8chanmen (soy sauce ramen) for 83B and gyoza (12 pieces) for 164B. I come here when I suddenly have a craving for gyoza. The gyoza took a while to cook, so they were served after I finished the ramen.
It's sad to see the gyoza gradually dwindle as I eat the plentiful supply...
sample_reviews_en.author: Syo Kei

sample_reviews_en.text: I found No. 8 Ramen on the first floor of Tukcom, so I went there for lunch. I ordered Gomoku Ramen, which arrived about 10 minutes later. The soup was made with chicken and pork bone broth and was very tasty. The Gomoku ingredients, which I believe were in a pre-packaged pouch, were not crunchy and were rather runny. It took a while to pay, and I felt the operation was slow considering how many people were there. Water and ice are also available at an additional charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: 大野びんすけ

sample_reviews_en.text:
From the moment the waiter came to take my order, he had a rude and unpleasant expression on his face.
It's been a while since I've had ramen. I pointed to the miso ramen I've always wanted to eat and ordered it.
The ramen that was brought out was not miso ramen, but something completely different.
There was no point in saying that this wasn't what I ordered, so I ate what was brought out.
What a disappointment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kumi

sample_reviews_en.text: When customers place orders, do you read the notes I've included? Please read the notes; otherwise, why have them there? This has happened several times at this branch: they put the extra noodles in together at once, making them soggy and hard, and difficult to separate.
sample_reviews_en.author: คุณพัค กับขนมโมจิ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff's attitude is better than when I ate at Sentan.
They also don't charge a service fee, which is a plus.
Their cold noodles are just like Japanese cold Chinese noodles!
The sesame dandan noodles are delicious, but the soup can sometimes be a little watery.
sample_reviews_en.author: k s

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped by for a quick breakfast with my Thai girlfriend. What she ordered was even more delicious than what I ordered. My girlfriend likes the matcha latte from the Amazon across the street, so I brought it over and drank it.
sample_reviews_en.author: 밤천사

sample_reviews_en.text: The customer service is terrible. The atmosphere is too lethargic. The ramen is lukewarm. I've been here many times, but the prices are getting higher and the quality is getting worse every time I go.
sample_reviews_en.author: もえちゃんどん

sample_reviews_en.text: Food always freshly prepared and tasty and not pricey. Very clean.good value. Love karamen with boiled egg added  (spice minced pork,beansprouts,seaweed,fresh ginger,noodles)
sample_reviews_en.author: Dallyman Spondulicks

restaurants.name: ต้นหมูกระทะ
restaurants.address:

184/4 Soi Phahon Yothin 1, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We really enjoyed the meal!

All the staff were very friendly.

My husband and I went together, just the two of us.

We ordered the 399 baht set!!

It comes with two types of pork (pork belly and pork neck) and a little bit of offal?

It includes shrimp, squid, vegetables, egg noodles, and a cola.

As soon as I took a bite of the pork, the seasoning was so delicious

I vowed to order more,

but I was too full to order any more ㅠㅡㅠ

The seasoning was perfectly salty, savory, and just right.

The sauce is a spicy sauce, but even my husband, who can't handle spicy food, ate it well!

They only sell beer, so we brought our own Regency bottle, got permission,

and drank it!! We bought just ice without any extra charge,

mixed it with the cola, and had a great time!

As a long-term traveler, I went to Pattaya and am coming back to Bangkok on January 1st!

I think I'll be visiting often haha.

If you need more after eating, you can order extras.

I think it costs around 59 baht for an extra order!!
sample_reviews_en.author: 최미선

sample_reviews_en.text:
This BBQ pork restaurant is located before the expressway entrance to Victory Monument, on the Phahonyothin side.

It's easily visible to passersby. The interior isn't very spacious, with several tables suitable for two to five people; larger groups can be accommodated per table.

This is my second visit, and this time the dipping sauce seemed a bit too sour.
However, the atmosphere is nice.
It's conveniently located.
Ordering is easy; the restaurant is small, and staff are readily visible when called.

It can get busy, especially around 8 PM, as tables might be full.
There's no dedicated parking; it's recommended to ask the restaurant about parking options. Motorcycles can temporarily park on the median, but I'm unsure about car parking.

The dipping sauce was a little too sour.
Overall, it's an okay BBQ pork restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tazz

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a traditional Thai barbecue dish that combines Japanese yakiniku and shabu-shabu. There are grooves around the hot plate where you can pour soup, and meat and vegetables are simmered there. Meanwhile, you can grill the meat in the center of the hot plate. This cooking method allows you to enjoy both grilling and stewing at the same time, so there are plenty of flavor variations and you'll never get bored. It's also fun to eat it with friends and family, and the best part is choosing your favorite ingredients and sharing. The Thai sauce, nam chim, adds a particularly delicious accent, making it even more delicious. If you've never tried it before, give it a try! I'm sure you'll love it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yusuke

sample_reviews_en.text: Ton Moo Kata restaurant is located near the Victory Monument, just before the expressway entrance. It's best to walk or take public transport. Motorcycles can park in front of the restaurant, but there's no parking for cars. Prices are set at 199/299/399 baht. We recommend the 399 baht set, which includes a Pepsi – it's delicious and filling! The dipping sauce is amazing, the charcoal fire is strong and doesn't weaken, the pork belly is good, and the shrimp are huge and fresh. The staff provides good service. Extra pork is about 59 baht per plate. Shrimp, tofu, vegetables, and instant noodles can be ordered separately. They open at 3:30 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chunethara Sirimongkol (jjcchuen)

sample_reviews_en.text: When Khun Ton was there, the service was excellent; we barely had to wait. But when Khun Ton wasn't there, the staff was terrible – no service at all. They didn't answer any questions and we waited 50 minutes for our order. Does any other BBQ restaurant have this kind of experience? Today I ordered papaya salad and couldn't eat it after waiting 50 minutes. It was the worst experience I've ever had. In the end, I didn't get to eat and had to leave. It was too bad.
sample_reviews_en.author: jax4254 ki

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a really delicious Thai-style BBQ pork place. The dipping sauce is perfect, the marinated pork is flavorful but a bit salty. The soup is also on the salty side, but adding corn makes it slightly sweeter, just right. The 399 baht set includes a Pepsi. The staff provides good service, but you need to choose your table carefully because if you get a table with the grill placed above you, the smoke will get in your face.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pariyapath Eiamtrakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a popular restaurant with a constant stream of customers.
The nam chim (dipping sauce) is a little spicy, so if you don't like spicy food, you might want to bring your own ponzu sauce or something similar.
For two people, the 399 baht set is more than enough to fill you up!
Great value for money! 👍 They also have beer, so you can enjoy your meal and drinks at your leisure. 🍺
sample_reviews_en.author: カトちゃんネル

sample_reviews_en.text:
I thought long and hard about this restaurant. The taste was excellent, but there were a few minor flaws, such as the pork not being sliced ​​completely, the fire being too strong at first and dying down very quickly, and the grill turning black immediately after grilling.
However, overall the service was very good and the food tasted great.
So, in conclusion, it's a full 5 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: BLUE เพื่อโลกและสันติ

restaurants.name: Penlaos Rama 9 - เป็นลาว พระราม 9
restaurants.address:

Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A famous restaurant from Khao Yai has opened near my house. The decor is nice, but the staff seems a bit undertrained. There weren't many customers, so some dishes weren't as fresh as they should have been.

The grilled free-range chicken was a real disappointment. It was unmarinated, tasteless, and completely unacceptable – dry and tough.

What I liked was the Luang Prabang papaya salad; the noodles were perfectly crispy. The steamed pork belly with bamboo shoots was also delicious.

I didn't really like the type of noodles in the crab and fermented fish papaya salad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Orange Juice

sample_reviews_en.text:
The flavors were delicious and well-balanced (we specifically requested it extra spicy). The portion sizes were moderate – not too small and not too large – allowing us to order a variety of dishes in one meal.

Eating the dried chilies on the side was incredibly satisfyingly spicy.

Another thing that impressed me a lot was the desserts. They were delicious! There were many dessert options to choose from.
The prices were good. Overall, I was impressed with the taste, portion sizes, and service. I'll definitely visit again. 🩷
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattarasupang Kho

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a review based purely on my personal feelings.

I was indifferent to the Lao papaya salad; I expected it to be more flavorful. Other dishes were quite salty, so if you plan to visit, remember to specify your preferred spice level. The prices are reasonable, and there are interesting and worthwhile promotions. They also have refreshing ice-cold beer. Parking is available along the roadside (even/odd days). The staff provided good service. I'll try other menu items in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Easytotalk25

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is great and the staff are lovely. We visited right after they opened, and there were quite a few mosquitoes in some areas. The team kindly moved us to a brighter spot, which we appreciated, but the shop should really take this seriously and fix the issue.

Other than that, everything was excellent — especially the air-conditioned restroom, which was clean and hygienic. We’re big fans of PenLaos anyway, so we’ll definitely be back often.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ayusakorn Arayangkoon

sample_reviews_en.text: This delicious fun restaurant blends in perfectly with the entire neighborhood, which has a Miami Calle Ocho feeling to me (and that includes the mural art). Colorful, tasty and fresh. I loved the grilled Kor Moo, duck larb and eggplant salad. The freshly boiled Pandan drink was a delight. Will happily come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Markus D

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, especially the Lao curry, minced pork salad, Thai papaya salad, and grilled pork neck. The staff were very attentive and caring, making me feel like I was having a meal at a friend's house. Especially Nong A... I'll definitely come back to try other dishes!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yim Pamata P.

sample_reviews_en.text: Spicy food lovers! 📌 You should check in at "PENLAOS" Rama 9 branch @penlaos, an Isaan restaurant with a Michelin Bib Gourmand award, without having to drive all the way to Khao Yai. The flavors are still amazing, spicy, and they use the …
sample_reviews_en.author: AURA ไดอารี่

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious, especially the Lao-style papaya salad, which was very tasty and suited my palate. The restaurant is spacious and comfortable, the food didn't take long to arrive, and the staff provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: G Green

restaurants.name: Taverna Romana Bangkok
restaurants.address:

87 Sukhaphiban 2 Rd, Dok Mai, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It took me 10 years to find an authentic Italian Restaurant in Bangkok. And what I mean with authentic is recreating the flavors you know from Italy with a high standard and no compromise. Taverna Romana is now our go to place for Italian food. As the name indicates the menu has a focus on Roman dishes and what we tried was outstanding. The Amatraciana with fresh homemade pasta was hands down exactly what we had and loved when visiting Rome. All bakery we tried was outstanding as well and the olive oil used was so good. The atmosphere and service was also impeccable and it's a really nice restaurant to spend your evening. Can't wait to for the next time!
sample_reviews_en.author: Moritz Gottschalk

sample_reviews_en.text:
How could we Romans not try this trattoria, which had been highly recommended? I gave it five stars overall because, not only did we have a wonderful time and the place was beautifully decorated, but we truly felt like we were back in Rome. The food and everything we tried, from the pasta dishes to the pizza, including the antipasti and everything else, were truly top-notch. Everything was made with the finest ingredients and with attention to every detail.
If you're in Bangkok and you love Roman cuisine, you can't miss this enchanting place.
My husband, I, and our two boys, aged 12 and 14, were truly satisfied.
sample_reviews_en.author: claudia maurizi enrici

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I visited an Italian restaurant near my house and met the owner, who is Italian and cooks everything herself. It was delicious, unlike any other Italian restaurant I've tried. The square pizzas are a perfect size, and the dough is special – soft and crispy at the same time; you don't need to order a whole pizza. The pasta here focuses on the noodles and the uniquely flavorful sauces. The prices are reasonable considering the taste and quality. The owner is lovely and speaks excellent Thai. The staff are also very helpful. This is my second visit, and I'll definitely be back for a third! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Apimuk Dam-on

sample_reviews_en.text: As Italians, we were honestly impressed by this Roman restaurant! The food felt truly authentic and brought us straight back home. The flavors, ingredients, and preparation were all excellent, and everything tasted fresh and delicious. The atmosphere was lovely, and the staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming. It’s not easy to find food that genuinely feels like home when you’re traveling abroad, but this place really nailed it. A little piece of Rome in Bangkok — highly recommended, even for Italians!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lara Munaro

sample_reviews_en.text:
Have been more then a few Italian restaurant in Thailand, Taverna Romana was one of the best , the warm simplicity and most inviting food that take you back to the streets of Roma.

Simone was great host  and a Chef , same goes to Menaa for her service with professional smile .
Ciao!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr saada

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was fine. The service/customer service was incredibly slow. Took 30 minutes to take our order. Then all of our food didn’t come out at the same time. And a simple pizza took 30 minutes extra to make. It was NOT busy, only 3 small tables.
sample_reviews_en.author: Grace Poetter

sample_reviews_en.text: My first time here, and I was truly impressed! The food was absolutely delicious, with an authentic taste of Italy. The atmosphere was lovely, and the staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming. Definitely a wonderful dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jariya Wijitwong

sample_reviews_en.text: Eating here is like eating in Rome, maybe even better, because you'd never expect a place like this in Bangkok. Original Italian ingredients are expertly prepared by Simone. Congratulations, a stop recommended to all foodies.
sample_reviews_en.author: paolo giannetti

restaurants.name: ก๋วยจั๊บน้ำใสตรอกวัดพระพิเรนทร์ ฝั่งวรจักร
restaurants.address:

PGX4+6GJ ทางสาธารณประโยชน์, ถ. หลวง Ban Bat, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
🍲🔥There is a hidden noodle place at this location you must try

This place runs by a few local aunties and uncles And they make one of the best and affordable (street style) crispy pork noodle. They even add little park ball into the noodle soup which I’ve never seen anywhere else.

You can park by the road.

I’m not sure if the aunties or the uncles can speak English so you can just show them the picture, maybe.

💵It’s around ฿60 or ฿70 per bowl
sample_reviews_th.author: Peta Harrion

sample_reviews_th.text: Hidden in the small alley even the local might not aware of. The taste is awesome, the quality of food is nice, hot soup. The must to find out. Go early and don’t miss the mince pork(ไส้หมูสับ), crispy pork.
sample_reviews_th.author: AquarTech TechDailyUse

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a noodle soup (kuy chap) shop that I absolutely loved, but I don't get to visit this area very often. Last time I was going to take a friend to eat around here, but it wasn't on our itinerary, so we passed on it. The shop is located in an alley that leads to Wat Phra Phiren. There's no sign, and only a few tables. It's only open for 3 hours a day. The owner is very friendly and even invited me to take pictures with him, telling me to take lots of photos.
The highlight of this shop is the crispy pork. The skin is incredibly crispy, and it remains crispy and delicious even when added to the soup. The soup is also delicious, well-balanced, not too sweet or too salty. They also have homemade sausages, which are very hard to find elsewhere. The taste is truly unique. I highly recommend trying it.

#FoodieTour
#FoodieAdventure
#KuyChapJaeKiang
sample_reviews_en.author: M Shayutpong Kiatpimolkul

sample_reviews_en.text: I give it 5 stars because of the quality of the food. It's well-prepared, fresh, and the crispy pork is perfectly crunchy, the liver is tender and odorless, and they also have pork tongue and pork heart, which are hard to find elsewhere. They also have minced pork sausage, making this single menu item—Khao Piak—unique and different from other shops. Even though it's in a small alley, it's clean and meticulously prepared. I love their chili vinegar sauce; they use only coarsely chopped bird's eye chilies without garlic. A regular bowl comes with minced pork sausage, liver, crispy pork, and heart, while the special adds pork tongue and heart. You can tell the seller what you want or don't want included. Parking is available at Wat Phra Phiren, a short walk away. They open around 10:20 AM.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pooh Prapaporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a very old noodle soup (kuy chap) shop, and the taste lives up to its long history. The broth is sweet and fragrant, not spicy with pepper like other shops. They give you a generous amount of toppings, but personally, I only eat the crispy pork, pork intestines, tofu, and sliced ​​pork.

The highlight is the pork intestines, which are minced pork stuffed inside – incredibly delicious and hard to find elsewhere. The crispy pork is very crispy, but the meat is a bit dry and tough. The sliced ​​pork is tender, probably from the neck.

Overall, it's good and worth trying. It's tastier than many famous shops. However, the shop's atmosphere isn't great; it's in a narrow alley. I recommend ordering takeout to eat at home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puripat Kitkarncharoensin

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! The soup is tasty even without any seasoning, but adding chili vinegar makes it even better. The soup doesn't have a strong peppery smell, but they provide high-quality pepper on the table for you to add. I went in the late afternoon and didn't get all the toppings, but the crispy pork was excellent. It stayed crispy and delicious even after being added to the soup. I loved the service at this restaurant. It was excellent. They understood my order perfectly after the first try. They had a great queuing system, alternating between takeout and dine-in orders, and they prepared the food very quickly. I didn't have to wait long at all, and they weren't rude or dismissive to customers. I loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: April Maysa

sample_reviews_en.text:
A famous secret soup kway chap shop. The soup is delicious, no need to add seasoning, and the toppings are generous. The extras are delicious and odorless. The crispy pork is perfectly crispy. Most importantly, the minced pork balls are delicious and not tough.

The secret clear soup kway chap in Bangkok is served with many toppings (Crispy Pork Belly, Minced Pork and Egg in Pork Intestine, Braised Pork Tung, etc.) and the taste is very good. Prices start at 50 THB.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanadee Indradese

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop has been open since 1959 (according to the owner). The soup has a mild flavor, slightly sweet and not as spicy with pepper as some of the more famous shops. The ingredients are plentiful but the portions are a bit small; you usually need to order extra. What sets it apart from other shops is the sausage, which is delicious and not smelly. The shop is located in a narrow alley and has only 3-4 tables. It's best to come before noon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poonnapop Nutkumhang

restaurants.name: chao doi coffee world's Sub
restaurants.address:

316, 318 Soi Buakhao, ตำบล หนองปรือ, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cappuccino :

I have ordered a hot cappuccino here aprrox' 15 times.

On 14 occasions, it was the best cup you will find in Thailand.

The cup size is perfect, the foam is done perfectly and once the foam is gone , the espresso does not loose its deep flavor ( unlike other places , you are not left with watery tasteless substance)

Something works properly here.

(I was recently very disappointed by other chao-Doi branches that lost the coffee-touch and deteriorated into the tasteless)

Great job soi bukao branch ! Just keep the great attention in each cappuccino.

( the subs are also great here )
sample_reviews_en.author: BigApple19 19

sample_reviews_en.text:
I am sat in.tjid coffee shop now whilst waiting for my husband to have a hair cut. The food and coffee is great, the atmosphere is interesting but then you are on soi bhkao.
My poor review is due to the staff. In my many years travelling Thailand I have to say the staff here were not typical friendly Thai. There were 5 members of staff and not one of them smiled, they were abrupt and totally un  Thai like. Maybe it's the location and the clientele I don't know but my husband who joined me said exactly the same.
Just thought I would say. 🤪
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarah Sassy

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a coffee shop I visit three times a week.
I ordered a tuna sandwich (119B) and an Americano (50B).
It's great to be able to eat fresh vegetables and tuna, which is rarely found in Thailand, in a sandwich.
However, a year ago, the sandwich was on promotion for 79B, so it's a shame that it's no longer such a good deal. I hope they bring that price back occasionally.
You can eat your coffee and meals inside the air-conditioned shop or on the outdoor terrace. The terrace faces Soi Buakhao, so it's not a quiet environment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Syo Kei

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered a sandwich and an iced coffee, but they mistakenly brought me the sandwich meant for another customer.
The young man who brought the sandwich seemed unenthusiastic and unfriendly from the moment I ordered. I said, "Isn't this the wrong one?" but he insisted it was correct.
However, a few minutes later, a foreign customer also said, "This isn't what I ordered."
It seems they mixed up my sandwich with the other customer's.
There was no apology or anything afterwards.
sample_reviews_en.author: Spanky Kun

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great staffs and a friendly atmosphere with the Best subs and pastry in Pattaya!! The meatball sub is a MUST!! All subs with fresh veges and all are full of volume and real tasty. Loved the toffee cake👍 A nice place to start your day or have a nice lunch / dinner. Inside is very clean and cool. Outside is nice and able to smoke cigarettes. Coffee, Thai Tea, cakes are amazing👍 If you haven't been here please try. You'll love it✌
Thanks to the owner😂 I'll be back soon‼️
sample_reviews_en.author: G Iwasaki

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a ham and cheese with lettuce,tomatoes,onions, jalapenos it took a hour and a half to make and delivery, once I received it, it had No lettuce, No jalapeño. They they put Cumber which I did order.This was my first time ordering from this place. It will be my last time ordering, I was better off going to the 7 11 and pickup items.to make my sandwich. Such a shame.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jerry Howell

sample_reviews_en.text:
I saw a great promotion for this shop on LINE MAN, so I decided to give it a try. The sandwich arrived still warm and tasted amazing! The bread was really flavorful and delicious.
For drinks, I ordered a non-sweet Matcha Choc. The matcha tasted authentic and fragrant and the chocolate was rich and intense. I absolutely loved it! 🫶🏻🫶🏻🫶🏻🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Naruedee Sutthirat

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything looking good for a ham and cheese roll and looked very appetising until I noticed they were handling money and then grabbing the ingredients and roll with the same hands unwashed. Basics...... I literally walked out and put the bag of food in the bin across the way at the seven eleven. Get your staff up to speed on hygiene.
sample_reviews_en.author: g c

restaurants.name: Odashi Hakkei
restaurants.address:

267/16 Soi Sukhumvit 63, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The oden was delicious. 90 out of 100 points.

However, the food was incredibly slow to arrive.

Just when I was enjoying a pleasant conversation with my friend, the proprietress interrupted us for no reason, completely disrupting the flow of our conversation.

The room was so hot that I had to eat while sweating profusely. Why is it so hot?

There were hardly any waitstaff, making ordering difficult. This was stressful.

The exhaust fan was so loud that we couldn't have a quiet conversation. Speaking loudly caused the sound to echo off the concrete, making it hard to hear. Ugh, so frustrating. This was also stressful.

When I ordered shochu, I was told they didn't have any. I understand that they might not have all brands of sake, but not having shochu? Isn't that a sign of poor inventory management? They could just have the proprietress, who came all the way from Okayama to chat, bring some.

This place is absolutely unsuitable for entertaining clients.

It's too expensive for everyday use, and too noisy for solo dining.

If you ask me if I'd come again, I would if I was being treated to a meal, but I wouldn't come if I had to pay for it myself.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leo Shingha

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is Hidden Oden Bar, where we went for our second round.

If you order the oden you want, it comes out bubbling hot in an earthenware pot, and the broth is refillable, so you can enjoy it warm.

A quiet and calm atmosphere.

Both the staff service and the food were delicious.

We ordered curry udon, and they thoughtfully divided it into two bowls for two people!

Ample parking.

The restroom is on the second floor of the restaurant, so it is a bit far, and the path leading there is dark, so it feels a little scary.
sample_reviews_en.author: J Hong

sample_reviews_en.text: This Japanese oden restaurant is incredibly authentic and delicious. It's a good place for a simple dinner, but the downside is that you'll smell very strong on your clothes afterward, and it will linger all night. You'll have to wash all your clothes to get rid of the smell when you get home. Overall, the food is so good I'd definitely go back, but I'd just wear something simple and not anything too formal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ampomega

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a specialized oden shop, and the prices are on the higher side due to the high-quality imported ingredients. However, the deliciousness is worth it overall. The broth is excellent, and the stars of the dish are the stuffed cabbage, minced chicken meatballs, and braised beef. Another very good dish is the seafood kakiage; it's best eaten hot. Overall, I would definitely return if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sahasahwat Chanchi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The prices are a bit higher than usual, and the menu is fairly limited. The restaurant has mostly counter seating and a quiet atmosphere. The food was decent with mild, easy-to-eat flavors, but overall, it was quite average.

The prices are a bit higher than usual, and the menu is limited. The restaurant mainly has counter seating, and it was quite quiet. The food was average and easy to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phonwalai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recommend the course menu centered around dashi (broth). Everything, including the oden (Japanese stew), is exquisite. It seems to be run by a ryokan (traditional Japanese inn) in Okayama, and the Japanese head chef happened to be there checking things out.

I'm a little worried about what will happen when he leaves and it's just the Thais left. 🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: masa

sample_reviews_en.text: At first glance the discreet door in an empty building does not seem promising but once pushed the small shop has a charming Japanese atmosphere. All the food was deliciously flavored by the dashi and the staff was very friendly. The chef is clearly a master of his craft and it is entertaining to seat and watch him cook. Will definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tony R

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant might be a little hard to find. All the seating is counter seating, with one private room.
The flavors of all the dishes use the same Odashi broth as the main base.
The set course price is very reasonable, actually quite affordable.

The food tastes great and is of good quality. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: ZOENGILY

restaurants.name: เฮือนอุ้ยคำ ณ ท่าข้าม
restaurants.address:

ร้านเฮือนอุ้ยคำ โครงการอนินทาวน์ เลขที่8 85 ซอย เทียนทะเล 7 แยก 2 Samae Dam, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
You don't have to fly all the way to Chiang Mai to enjoy authentic Northern Thai cuisine!

For a taste of traditional Northern Thai cuisine, we recommend "Huean Uikham," an authentic Northern Thai restaurant that brings the atmosphere and flavors of Chiang Mai to the Tha Kham-Rama 2 area.

🌿 Some of my favorite dishes include Khanom Jeen Nam Ngiao (rice noodles with rich, fragrant Khao Soi), traditional Hang Lay Gaeng (spicy curry), Nam Prik Num (chilled nam prik ong), served with freshly boiled vegetables, and Sai Ua (spicy sausage with fragrant herbs). The flavors are truly authentic, just like you're dining in Chiang Mai.

🍴 The restaurant's atmosphere is warm and friendly, truly living up to its name, "Huean" (home), making every meal feel like you've returned to a true Northern Thai home.

👉 Northern Thai food lovers shouldn't miss this restaurant. I highly recommend it as a must-try for the Rama 2 community. You'll be hooked and will want to share it with everyone.

#HueanUikham #AuthenticNorthernFood #TastyThaKham #TastyRestaurantRama2 #MustTellAboutDelicious #ChillCheeva
sample_reviews_en.author: Chill Cheeva

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered food the first time, but one plate of rice was missing. I informed the staff and ordered an additional plate of rice. There was no response for about 5 minutes. I went to ask for the rice myself. After asking, a staff member came and said the rice was out of stock and they had just cooked more. This was during lunchtime, and the restaurant wasn't that busy; there were only two other tables of customers.
1. Were they unprepared? Lunchtime is expected to bring in a lot of customers.
2. Why didn't they inform me from the beginning that the rice was out of stock after I had already ordered the food? I had to go and ask for it to find out, but I had already ordered the food.
3. Terrible service. The prices weren't cheap either; they charged for everything, even a glass of ice. I understand that everything has a cost, and they can charge you, but the service should be better. In short, I didn't get to eat this meal. I paid for the food I ordered, but didn't get to eat it, and I will never go back there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภารดี

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chicken and beef Khao Soi are delicious. If you miss Northern Thai food, this is the place.
I also recommend the galangal chili paste with steamed beef, Nam Prik Ong (Northern Thai chili paste), Sai Ua (Northern Thai sausage) with Nam Prik Num (Northern Thai green chili paste), and Khanom Jeen Nam Ngiao (Northern Thai rice noodles with spicy broth), among many other dishes. The portions are generous.
The service is excellent and the staff are very polite. The atmosphere inside the restaurant is pleasant, open-air but not hot.
There might be limited street parking.
Alternatively, you can park at the 7-Eleven at the entrance, cross the road, and walk a short distance into the soi (alley).
sample_reviews_en.author: Radaa_ Int

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a Northern Thai restaurant near my house that I frequent—more than 10 times now. It's run by authentic Northern Thai people, and the service is excellent and friendly.

The food is delicious and up to standard, and the prices are reasonable, mostly around 60-100 baht per dish. Larb Kua is a go-to, as is the Kua Ho (a Northern Thai dish). They also have various chili pastes that are good, and seasonal bamboo shoot curry, which is perfectly tender and delicious with sticky rice.

The Khao Soi and Nam Ngiao are also delicious and up to standard.

Besides Northern Thai food, they also have a la carte dishes and easy-to-eat single-serving meals.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thikumporn R. (Kirara Lab)

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The Ho curry was a bit too sweet.
- The Nam Ngiao noodles were quite tasty and the portions were generous.
- The Nam Prik Num was a bit dry.
- The minced pork with basil (not pictured) was also served with dark soy sauce, but edible.
I went at 1:00 PM for my first meal of the day.
I had diarrhea at 4:00 PM.
When I arrived, I had to call the waiter myself. There were food stains on the table, so I had to call the waiter to wipe them up. After writing the order, I had to bring it to the kitchen. There was only one table full of customers at the time.
I understand that it's difficult to enjoy this kind of food fresh.
I went to try it to find out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rikakawabata

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Northern Thai restaurant with a homey, warm atmosphere and soft, soothing music playing in the background.
A wide variety of Northern Thai dishes to choose from: Khao Soi with sliced ​​pork, chicken, beef, and tonkatsu; khanom jeen nam ngiao; khantoke (rice vermicelli soup), tam khanom khoon (spicy salad with jackfruit), gaeng ho (rice porridge), hung lay (spicy salad with spiced pork), larb khua (spicy laab), and various nam phrik (chili paste). Overall, the taste is delicious.
The service is excellent, attentive, polite, prompt, and friendly.
Parking is available along the fence in the entrance alley.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pretty Sudanee

sample_reviews_en.text: There were 2 of us who went to eat there and bought some to take home for another person. In the end, everyone had diarrhea (my girlfriend and I ate only one meal that day because we were trying to lose weight). My mother had to go to the hospital for an injection. I absolutely do not recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanapong Chainapawet

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today, Yong invites you to try a Northern Thai restaurant. The restaurant is located in Soi Thian Talay 7, Bang Khun Thian Road. Recommended dishes:
Khao Kan Jin, Northern Thai appetizers, and stir-fried pork cabbage curry.
The atmosphere is great and the restaurant is very clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Somchai Thanapanisakul

restaurants.name: เจ้แป้นปูเป็น กะเพราปู อาหารตามสั่ง
restaurants.address:

Phra Tamnak, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's delicious! The flavors are bold and the ingredients are high quality.
The price is reasonable.
There aren't many seats; it's a small shop run by three people.
They have à la carte dishes, pork leg rice, and noodles.
The basil chicken is delicious, with a well-balanced flavor. If you like spicy food, you can order it extra spicy.
The rice is soft, and the crispy pork is excellent. Highly recommend ordering it.

The shop prepares everything fresh to order. Expect a 10-20 minute wait for your food because it's always busy.

There are also many foreign customers.

Parking is available in the alley next to the wall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Screenby Kokae

sample_reviews_en.text:
This popular restaurant is known for its crab and crispy pork gapao and khao khamoo. When I visited at lunchtime, it was nearly full. I ordered the crab gapao for 100B, topped with a fried egg for 10B.
The crab meat was plump and the flavor was very satisfying. The portion is small, so if you're hungry, you might want to order another dish.
The food is quite spicy, so it's best for foreigners to order a less spicy option.
Water is self-service (note that there is a trick to turning the electric pump on and off).
sample_reviews_en.author: Syo Kei

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant offers delicious food and great service. I especially recommend the crab dishes and the excellent noodle soup but chicken and other dishes are also great. The dishes are very tasty and at a very good price. The staff is always smiling, making the dining experience very pleasant and enjoyable.
Hoghly recommended to visit especially if you are in nearby Unixx apartment.
sample_reviews_en.author: A A

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and affordable. The restaurant is located on a corner at a bend in the road. If you're lucky, you might find parking in the side street or one car can park in front of the shop. This is our second time eating here, and the quality hasn't changed. There are a lot of foreigners and Thai people eating here. Overall, we like it. Free water and ice are also provided.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarisa Sanguandeekul

sample_reviews_en.text: Just grabbed some takeaway. Pad krao pow looked and tasted awesome. Shrimp fried rice, shrimp are big and juicy. Grandma chef is an amazing cook. Saw other people's food, tom tum goong, lots of big seafood, shrimp, octopus and looked very fresh and 😋 Staff really nice and helpful. Sorry for the 1 photo took a big bite of the ka pow. Thank you for the delicious food.
sample_reviews_en.author: dj wakeeta

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious. The crab is fresh and the meat is firm. The portion might not be large; two plates would be enough for most people. However, the government-subsidized scheme works well.

The downside is the inconvenient parking situation on a hill. There's no parking available at lunchtime.
And it gets very crowded, with long queues of over 40 minutes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phakornkarn Maytinee

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is like a roadside stall, but the food is superb. The crab stir-fry with basil is delicious and worth the price. The shrimp omelet is also excellent. The rice is good. There's no parking lot; you have to park along the wall next to the shop. I've made a note of it and will definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Faii R.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes good and the portions are worth the price. The crab fried rice has fresh crab and a fragrant buttery aroma.
The Pad Thai has a well-balanced flavor and fresh shrimp.
If it's crowded, you might have to wait a little while.
Parking is a bit difficult to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: Can Do

restaurants.name: ร้านสูตรเตี๋ยวต้มยำหมูรสเด็ด
restaurants.address:

533 Chom Thong Burana Frontage Road, Bang Pakok, Rat Burana, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Park your car in front of the shop and write your order at the counter.

The food tastes good. The crispy pork cracklings are fragrant and not rancid.
The fried dumplings are crispy and thin, not oily.
The noodles taste good, delicious, and have plenty of toppings.
The atmosphere inside the shop is very cool and shady.
sample_reviews_en.author: PEM TABIEN

sample_reviews_en.text:
This noodle shop offers a relaxing garden atmosphere and delicious tom yum soup. The noodles are generously toppings including pork slices, minced pork, intestines, liver, fish cake, fish balls, and dried shrimp. Free ice and water are provided, giving you a homey feeling.

Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tipwan Trakarnwijitr

sample_reviews_en.text: Upon arrival, write down your order, get a queue number, find a free table, and wait for your delicious meal. There's self-service for drinks. The interior is lush with greenery, making it a relaxing place to wait. Highly recommend this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanchai Pirom

sample_reviews_en.text: A real hidden gem! The noodles are delicious and fairly priced, with generous portions of fresh ingredients. Parking is limited, and there are only about 9 tables since it's a cozy, family-run spot inside their home. You might have to wait …
sample_reviews_en.author: Honest Reviews รีวิวที่จริงใจ

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious without needing any extra seasoning. Generous portions with plenty of toppings. Even the regular size is big, but the special is even more filling! Hard to find this price anywhere else. Noodle lovers shouldn't miss it!
sample_reviews_en.author: สัญชัย วงศ์จุราภรณ์

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles are delicious, with generous toppings, and the price is affordable. The owner is friendly and welcoming. It's a small shop with a shady, cool atmosphere for dining inside. Ice and water are provided free of charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: T. Pims.

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍜 This noodle shop serves incredibly delicious Tom Yum Pork Noodles.
The food tastes amazing, truly living up to the shop's name. It was quite busy during lunchtime when I went, so I had to wait almost 20 minutes. But I can …
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattapart Worakun (Earth)

sample_reviews_en.text: For those who are impatient or hungry, run away! The owner admits that the wait is extremely long, to the point that they even offer to cut off a sticker in front of the shop or cancel the order without hesitation.
sample_reviews_en.author: ยูโรเป็นหมูสีทอง BJ

restaurants.name: Pa Song Pee Nong Restaurant - ร้านอาหารป่าสองพี่น้อง
restaurants.address:

32 Charat Wiang Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Google led us here — a tiny hole-in-the-wall spot hidden in the back alleys of Bangrak, where prices are almost normal for this otherwise pricey neighborhood.

We tried the lemongrass salad. Let’s say… I’ve had worse. Thin slices of lemongrass with fried shrimp and peanuts — edible, but nothing that’ll haunt your dreams in a good way.

The Tom Yum Goong? Incredibly sour, completely out of balance. The shrimp had that unmistakable “grown in a puddle somewhere inland” flavor — classic cheap farmed shrimp.

The fried rice with chicken was decent, but the portion could politely be described as minimalist.

All in all, one of those thousand little Bangkok places you stumble into, eat, and forget about. Food was meh, hygiene… questionable.

But, the staff were so genuinely friendly and lively, I’ll be nice: 4 stars — strictly for the people, not the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: nik

sample_reviews_en.text: Anyone in this part of Bangkok should definitely eat here. I'm usually a fan of the famous papaya salad, but here I found the absolute highlight: "The Lemongrass Salad"—I've never eaten anything so delicious. Everything else is also incredibly authentic and pure Thai cuisine. The owner is unique in his personality. You can tell he cooks with love. The prices are absolutely reasonable, and every baht is worth it for what you get. We're in Bangkok often, and this certainly won't be our last visit. I'm already looking forward to the next time. As for the atmosphere, I can only say it's as authentic as I've always imagined Bangkok street food to be. 🙏😀🙏😀🙏😀🙏😀🙏😀🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Tankred

sample_reviews_en.text:
First of all, the restaurant is not exactly where google puts it. It is on the other side of the alley. It has a lighted sign with ‘Jungle food two sisters shop’ on it.
The woman who cooks is a true home cooking chef. Thai dishes well made with lots of flavor. We had the Larb Moo (minced pork with basil), the incredible and not to be missed lemongrass salad (with small bits of fried squid) and the Tom Kai Ga (chicken coconut soup). All excellent.
It is a true family place with grandma hanging around, helping her daughter out and handling the accounts. The baby and toddler are looked after by whoever is not cooking.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Thomsett

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice little super low key restaurant in Bang Rak. The place is family run and only has a handful of tables. They serve Thai lunch: stir fried, deep fried and boiled dishes. What they also have - and I was craving for this - is jungle curry (gaeng pa). This is a rather soupy curry without coconut milk. It can be very spicy. And so it was here. I liked it. I love spicy. It lacked a tiny bit of depth though. But still a very good lunch spot with great value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a small, rustic-style restaurant with 8 tables (air-conditioned) and 2 tables with fans. Prices are moderate. It's located in an alley behind Lerdsin Hospital, near the expressway. It's popular with office workers from the nearby area, police officers from Yannawa Police Station, nurses from Lerdsin Hospital, foreign tourists, and in the evenings, it's a favorite spot for drinkers who enjoy rustic-style food as bar snacks.
sample_reviews_en.author: พัฒน์ดิลก ขุนแท้

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm Japanese. 

I went here because a non-Japanese foreigner had said that the coconut curry was delicious! 

It's a family-run business, and the mother's seasonings are absolutely delicious! 

The slightly sour gapow and coconut curry are seasoned in a way that you won't find anywhere else and are absolutely delicious! 

Everyone is nice, so Japanese people are welcomed with open arms. 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: s s

sample_reviews_en.text: Walked into their shop near to closing at 9pm. Their warmth and hospitality is top notched! Despite almost near closing, they still invited me into the shop. I went for their lemon grass salad.. yes! It is superb as many others have raved. Will be back to try other dishes. Their kindness will make you not regret making your way there, though their place is not a fancy restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Minibeing

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is a row of two adjoining shophouses, divided into one cooking area and another air-conditioned room for customers. Seating is a bit cramped, but the restaurant offers a variety of delicious dishes, including jungle curry, fried fish with fish sauce, fried catfish cakes, and steamed fish with lime. If you're not from the area, it can be a bit difficult to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thatha Bkk

restaurants.name: KFC PT Ratchada
restaurants.address:

232, Kwang, 1 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Chan Kasem, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Currently, this branch has three touchscreen ordering systems and one counter ordering system (cash payment only). This is ideal for customers who prefer cashless payment methods and want a close-up view of the menu, unlike before when you had to ask staff about available items in chicken sets or promotional menus.

It might not be suitable for those who are not comfortable using technology, as ordering directly from a staff member would offer menu recommendations.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bankskull

sample_reviews_en.text: The female staff member had an extremely unwelcoming attitude. The portion of the spicy chicken wings was very small. The first time was acceptable, but the next time was the same. If you're in a hurry to leave, you can just leave; don't make such an unwelcoming face and just do a half-hearted job. Unacceptable service! This kind of service is terrible!!! Please improve if you see this.
sample_reviews_en.author: thanthip plodjinda

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken pieces were very small (I ordered two thighs), but they were served hot and tasted good – crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. The restaurant itself was very clean, with two floors and comfortable seating. The design was beautiful, and there was free refillable water, hand washing facilities, and parking available in front of the store.
sample_reviews_en.author: Punnatorn Vechaputi

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. There was no queue. I used a coupon and ordered extra items, but they wouldn't add them to the order. They just nodded "yes, yes" and walked away. In the end, I only received the order from the coupon, not the extra items I ordered. I had to order again. The staff didn't understand Thai, so they fired me.
sample_reviews_en.author: Grimoald Herstal

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but the staff were unwelcoming. Seriously, do they even want to be employees? I'm so confused. If this is how you serve customers, maybe they should just stay home. Or maybe this KFC branch needs to provide staff training? This was on August 4th, 2025, between 10:30 PM and 11:30 PM. Please check the list.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suphatcha Mooncumsan

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered one item each of Chicken Pop and Nuggets, but the quantity was entered twice. After correcting the quantity, upon receiving the delivery at work, I found "only one packet of chili sauce" for 7 Chicken Pop items... Order placed on May 24, 2069 at 9:16 AM (time as shown on the receipt).
sample_reviews_en.author: JFT

sample_reviews_en.text: I would like to ask the staff at 10:00 AM on July 26, 2025 to please smile at the customers. I understand that you are tired from work or maybe it is a bad day, but I do not want to receive service with a frown on my face like this. Please fix this a little bit...!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thiple K

sample_reviews_en.text: The female employee had an unwelcoming expression. I ordered 8 pieces of chicken to take home and received only two packets each of ketchup and chili sauce. I asked if I could have more sauce, and she gave me one of each. Seriously, have …
sample_reviews_en.author: Poramate Chuenjit

restaurants.name: ลาบรื่น อีสานคราฟต์
restaurants.address:

307/58 Bang Khun Si, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is amazing, 10/10. Perfect for a date or hanging out with friends. The lighting is beautiful, every corner is great for photos. The staff are attentive and lovely. The food is delicious, every dish was impressive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Justin Munich

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and spicy, and you can adjust the spiciness level. Just let the staff know what kind of flavor you prefer. The food comes out quickly, the staff are lovely, and the service is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jutinut Sagaethong

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is warm, cozy, and comfortable, like having a meal at a friend's house. The food looks appetizing and tastes delicious, exactly as advertised – no deception here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thos MN

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. I usually order through the app, but this was my first time having the chance to dine in at the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manlika Jay

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious with a wide variety of menu options, the prices are reasonable, and the restaurant has a nice atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alue

sample_reviews_en.text: Easy to get to, convenient location, wide selection of menu items, and food doesn't take long to arrive.
sample_reviews_en.author: nootchakarn nootchakarn

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is good, we ordered a whole table full of dishes. My friends come here often. It's delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: บุญรัตน์ ปฐมชัยวิวัฒน์ (มาช่า)

sample_reviews_en.text: The ice was very cold, the food was delicious, and they served German Red Sun beer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hua Wai

restaurants.name: Dragon Shabu by Giants
restaurants.address:

208 ลาดพร้าว Phlabphla, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10312, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
There aren't many staff, so they might be busy, but the staff are friendly and helpful.
They have a wide variety of menus.
You need to put a mat on the grill before grilling.
The grill will shut off if it gets too hot. To turn it back on, press the power button, select the cooking menu, and lower the temperature to around 800 degrees.
There's not a wide variety of vegetables.
I ordered the premium version today.
The meat, vegetables, and sauces may not be of the highest quality,
but that's probably because the price is not too high.
If you're just interested in a variety of food and a satisfying meal, this is the place to go.
They have ice cream and refillable drinks for the premium version.
For the regular version, you pay an extra refill.
Pay 279 baht and get a refill, ice cream, soup, and duck meat.
This restaurant is more suitable for those on a budget.
If you want to eat high-quality, delicious duck meat, you might want to go somewhere more expensive. Personally, the taste may not be to my liking, but considering the price and variety, it's worth it. The service is good. 5 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mochiko Aringato

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm disappointed. We went there last July, and the food seemed very different. The quality seemed to have dropped. Some of the dishes we used to order weren't available, and it didn't look very clean. Before, when I lived in that alley, I was a regular customer for 5-6 years. It was one of the first shabu-shabu restaurants that came to mind because it was cheap, there weren't long queues, and it was always full. The food variety was great, which is why I dared to write a review. But now it's changed so much. I'm not sure if it's a change in management. The last time I went, there were only two tables occupied besides us. They didn't even turn on the air conditioning; they were only using fans, and the small room felt stuffy, like we were being suffocated – that really annoyed me. There were so few people, it's unlike before. People in the area who used to eat there probably feel the same way and aren't coming anymore. I hope they improve; maybe I'll go again someday.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fahsai1203

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my third time at this restaurant, but I'm extremely disappointed this time. It doesn't feel worth the price. Many items were out of stock. The vegetables in the display case were wilted and didn't look fresh, like they'd been sitting there for 2-3 days. The french fries were soggy from being fried too long. The fried chicken looked like it had been fried a long time ago and was unappetizing. They didn't inform me about the items that were out of stock; I had to go and ask for them myself. The staff were uninterested. Nothing on the menu seemed fresh; it all seemed like leftovers from previous days. The staff were indifferent, playing loud music in the kitchen, and didn't come out to greet customers at all. This is my last time here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeeranajoy

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is located in front of Thong Charoen Mansion, right in the middle of Soi Maha Thai. We sat on the second floor, but the stairs were very steep, so it's not suitable for those with weak knees or older children.
The price is 199 baht plus a refillable water bottle for 29 baht. Water is self-service, with plenty of space for you to pour yourself. Vegetables are also available, and fried snacks are available. You can grab them when you want to eat and change the menu. The shabu with two soup compartments is 29 baht. They also have a grill. The menu is extensive and well worth the price. I like it. The shop no longer accepts phone reservations; walk-ins are the only option.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanida Santiniwat

sample_reviews_en.text:
It used to be so much better before it became like this.
If you ask what you can expect for this price, there are other restaurants that are cheaper and better.
No fried food.
Only 4 types of vegetables.
The only dessert is ice cream. I understand that.
The ice cream is rock hard, impossible to scoop. Three flavors, and they're all hard.
They don't tell you what's unavailable. People just order anyway. I probably won't go again.
The total price, including drinks, was 318 baht. I can pay that, but I have to complain. I paid money to eat here, and I'm disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: ẞḥäđöẅ

sample_reviews_en.text: The mala soup was very diluted, not spicy at all. The spiciness came from the mala dipping sauce instead. Otherwise, the meat was thick and plentiful. They also have dessert. However, I went at 12:30 and there was only one staff member who hadn't finished setting up yet, but the service was quick even though there weren't many people. They provide a free grill, and the price is cheap at 279 baht including drinks for the meat set. Overall, it's okay. The music was good, but it was a bit of a premium sound system, which was a bit disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: nappp klit
