sample_reviews_en.text: I've seen this place for a while, but this was my first time. Here's an update for those looking for information. Their food is pretty good. The dark broth is okay, not too salty. The marbled pork, which is like sliced ​​pork neck, is excellent; it melts in your mouth whether you boil or grill it. Everything else is good too – fresh fish, fresh shrimp, good scallops, and the grilled pork is delicious. However, the restaurant isn't very big, and the air circulation isn't great. They offer both boiling and grilling options.
sample_reviews_en.author: วันวิสาข์ มหิทธิหาญ

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted okay, but it's not the first restaurant I'd think of, and I'm unlikely to return. For example, I ordered the clear tom yum soup; it had all the ingredients, but lacked the authentic tom yum flavor because it was too sweet. I had to add bottled lime juice, but even that wasn't real lime juice; it was okay as a temporary fix. The service was good. There's seating upstairs and downstairs, but it's often crowded. It's convenient to come by motorbike as there's parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pitchayanin Limsakul

restaurants.name: wwa HUALAMPHONG
restaurants.address:

318 Maha Phruettharam Rd, Khwaeng Maha Phruttharam, Khet Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. The menu should be scannable on your phone, and online ordering should be possible. The menu file is a Google Drive file, which is inconvenient to view. This needs significant improvement. They provide a QR code to scan instead of printing the menu.
2. A service charge shouldn't exist. I felt the service wasn't commensurate with the price paid. The menu prices are quite high, and I felt it wasn't worth the money. Some drinks didn't match the pictures, and the taste and atmosphere were very average, nothing amazing.
P.S. This is my personal opinion. I recommend trying the service yourself first.
sample_reviews_en.author: A M

sample_reviews_en.text: It's even better now that they've opened closer. I used to go to their Siam branch often, but now they've opened at Hua Lamphong MRT station, much closer to my neighborhood. The pastries are delicious, the coffee is good, the atmosphere is great, and every corner is perfect for taking photos. It's also a great place to work. They're still as good as ever, and the staff are lovely. I haven't tried their food yet, but I saw other tables ordering some and it looked amazing. I'll definitely try it next time!
sample_reviews_en.author: Peurae is here

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of my favorite cafes in Bangkok. It's not crowded, perfect for working comfortably. The decor is very stylish and hard to find in Thailand. Every corner is great for taking photos with plenty of natural light. The food and drinks are delicious; I especially love their spaghetti. I've been here more than 5 times – highly recommend it! The staff are also incredibly friendly and provide excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marakang ger

sample_reviews_en.text: A gem in the middle of old district, next to Hua Lamphong Mrt station exit 1. Perfect location for traffic and people watching. Such chill and calming vibes. Food and coffee are of top quality. Especially love the lemon cheesecake, such a treat on a hot afternoon. Highly recommend this place 👍 hope to come again next time we visit Bangkok ❣️
sample_reviews_en.author: Sandy Khik

sample_reviews_en.text: A stylish, modern café with a sleek “office-like” design and plenty of creative art pieces throughout the space. The coffee is reasonably priced and tastes good. The staff seemed a little reserved, so I didn’t feel comfortable asking too many questions, but overall it’s a nice spot with a unique atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: cha xvi

sample_reviews_en.text: I have to say, this is a place I'd definitely want to return to. The food and coffee are delicious, and most importantly, the staff are incredibly kind. They don't look down on any customer, regardless of their background. I'll definitely visit again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปุ้มปุ้ย รุ่งโรจน์

sample_reviews_en.text: The unique clothing and accessories designs in wwa's signature style have made me a regular customer since their Siam location. When they moved to Hua Lamphong, I had to follow them! The new store is beautiful, like an art space – the vibe is amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutt V

sample_reviews_en.text: Food and drinks are okay, 6/10, but the service wasn't really professional. There's VAT, but the service didn't justify the cost. The person who seems to be LGBTQ+ looked unwelcoming, which ruined the whole vibe of the cafe (I went there last week).
sample_reviews_en.author: Minka [Nicky] Rangsithadakul

restaurants.name: Zaozen ซาวเส้น One Bangkok
restaurants.address:

PGGW+HMR, Witthayu Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The experience was somewhat disappointing. We ordered chicken wings and pork ribs, and upon tasting them, we noticed the meat wasn't in good condition and the flavor, especially the fried taste, wasn't pleasant. We told the staff, but were surprised that we were still charged for both dishes.

The rest of the dishes we tried were very good, and overall, we enjoyed the food. Therefore, we believe that by improving the quality control of some products and handling these kinds of situations better, the experience could be much improved.

We at least expected the substandard dishes to be removed from the bill. Even so, we want to emphasize that the rest of the food was very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: edgar sanchez rodriguez

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely delicious! The noodles are packed with flavor and super authentic. Great atmosphere and friendly service as well. Highly recommended if you’re at One Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Hou Ze Zhu

sample_reviews_en.text: We came for Mother's Day dinner. The atmosphere was nice, there were window seats available, and the menu had many tempting dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: chuphong wang

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was great, absolutely fantastic! The food was incredibly delicious. It's a shame I didn't take any photos.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ubonphan Kankhuntod

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the portions were generous. The staff were very friendly and provided excellent service! 👍🏻 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Wankanok Choomee

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! The restaurant is beautiful, and the staff were very kind and provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pailincha

restaurants.name: ร้านอาหารเหนือ กาดหลวงมินิ
restaurants.address:

10/6 10/6, Pracha Chuen Alley, Wong Sawang, Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Khao Soi (Northern Thai noodle soup) was delicious. It's the kind that, in addition to the pork blood and tender pork bones, also has really tasty minced pork patties, which you don't often find at other restaurants. The only other place I've found that's famous is Aunt Suk's Khao Soi restaurant in Chiang Rai.
The other dishes were equally delicious, such as the stir-fried larb and the Hang Le curry, which were also quite good.
It's interesting that this restaurant, despite offering so many different dishes, is located at a rest stop on the expressway heading towards Chaeng Wattana.
I was so impressed with my first visit that I had to come back for a second time the next day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vrapol Supowkit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Northern Thai Food at Prachachuen Rest Area

• A small northern Thai food spot located in the Prachachuen rest area, a rest stop with shops and restaurants along the expressway. (Note that you need to pay a 15 THB toll fee to access this area.)

• The food is authentically northern Thai and tastes delicious. However, the prices are relatively high considering the small portions — for example, Khao Soi Gai (Northern Thai Curry Noodle Soup with Chicken) is priced at 100 THB. Still, it’s worth it if you are passing by.

A hidden gem for those looking for authentic flavors!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongpit Pinsai

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a small restaurant with only a few tables, but there are extra tables outside. They serve authentic Northern Thai food, with portion sizes that are just right—not too small, not too big. Everything was delicious.
The staff were very friendly and provided excellent service. They also have items you can buy to take home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maytika Seangpaikaew

sample_reviews_en.text: The Khao Soi with pork was delicious, I really liked it because the pork was very tender. The Sai Oua (Northern Thai sausage) was also good. The Som Tum Thai (Thai papaya salad) had a perfectly balanced flavor. You can choose to eat it with crispy pork rinds, which is what I like. The prices are a bit high though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prisy Buasruong

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a mini-sized Northern Thai restaurant. The staff are friendly, the food is served quickly, and it tastes great. The dry sai ua (Northern Thai sausage) and the rich, flavorful khao soi (Northern Thai curry noodle soup) are delicious. Prices are one way to eat in, with a slight price increase for takeout.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amm Suthepin

sample_reviews_en.text: I bought it to eat at home and nothing was right. I ordered a set of Khao Soi but they gave me fried garlic. The Khao Soi was too sweet and overpowered the other flavors. It was too sweet and didn't fix the sweetness. The quantity was not worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bee JR

sample_reviews_en.text:
The steamed fish curry was delicious, and the stir-fried minced meat salad was also delicious.
The green chili dip was delicious too.
The mixed vegetable curry was good as well.
I'll go eat there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tawat Kunwutthiphongsak

sample_reviews_en.text:
A cute little Northern Thai restaurant with delicious food.
If you're craving authentic, home-style Northern Thai cuisine, stop by!
You won't be disappointed 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: MAXIMUS

restaurants.name: The Palm 29 Bar, Restaurant & Lounge
restaurants.address:

502/44 M10, Soi Buakhao, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered Chicken with Cashew Nuts, which I’ve only ever had as the crispy fried version before — I honestly didn’t know there were different styles.

So when the dish arrived looking different from what I expected, I politely asked one of the female staff (small build, long hair tied up), “Is this chicken with cashew nuts?” — just to be sure I got the right order.

She replied, “Yes,” but in a rude and dismissive tone, with a facial expression that clearly showed annoyance. She even clicked her lips at me. That made me feel really uncomfortable.

I wasn’t being rude or causing any scene. I was just genuinely confused and asked a simple question.

The food itself was okay, not bad at all. But the service needs serious improvement, especially in staff attitude and how to respectfully communicate with customers.

I understand working in service can be exhausting, but if someone isn’t willing to provide basic courtesy or respect to customers, maybe they shouldn’t be in this line of work.

Customers come to enjoy a meal — not to be treated with attitude.
I hope the management considers training staff more thoroughly in customer service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phonthida Usaprom

sample_reviews_en.text:
A nice place, right in the center of the Tree Town Pattaya Night Market neighborhood, with music and a pedestrian area, accessible from Soi 2 and Soi Buakhao.
Italian and Thai cuisine, fair prices, and carefully prepared food.
Also recommended because it stays open late (5 a.m., if I'm not mistaken) but also opens for breakfast.
There's a pool/snooker table, lots of entertainment nearby, and the Pattaya Night Bazaar.
I don't recommend the restaurants on Soi 2, which are very chaotic, crowded, and have terrible service. It's better to stop here at The Palm 29 before or after shopping. It's close by, much more convenient, and has better food!
sample_reviews_en.author: free dom

sample_reviews_en.text:
After being in Thailand for 40 days, this has ro be the worst restaurant I have tried.  The food was ok, the coctails where without alcohol, the service was terrible.  My food was already cold when I got my cuttlery and the garlic shrimps with garlic where totally without garlic and ofcourse there was no lime with them.
With all the restaurants in Tree town being full I should have realized somethimg was wromg with this place as it was empty.
We where a group og 9 people and we where all dissapointed.
The only thing that gets 5 stars out of 5 stars is the bottled Chang beer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sveinn Valtÿr Sveinsson

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is excellent! Whether it's Thai cuisine or the pizza... the value and portion sizes are excellent. The staff is friendly and attentive, and special requests are also accommodated! The prices are reasonable, especially considering that Treetown is right next door. This is also the only issue that occasionally causes disruptions. The loudness of the music in the area and the traffic, despite being on Walking Street, sometimes take some getting used to.
We really enjoy eating and drinking here, even during the day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Michael Wutz

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've frequented Palm 29 many times this year when I was in Pattaya for two months in total. I love it there. The decorations are great. They gave me tiki bar vibes. The food is excellent and the staff was always very nice. You can even play "free" pool there (I say "free", because you still need to order something).

The only downside is people smoking while you eat (hence a 4 and not a 5 star rating). It's rude and inconsiderate.

I love Tree Town in general, but this is now my favorite place there. :-)
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter de Zeeuw

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a huge menu with lot of different dishes to select. It proposes typical Thai and Italian food, the quality is excellent. I'm Italian and I can state with no doubts that it's very difficult eating so well even in high valuated restaurants in Italy. Service and cleaning are very good too. Prices are more than reasonable. I found my restaurant in Pattaya ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Alessandro Pinelli

sample_reviews_en.text: The 4-cheese pizza was fantastic — perfectly crisp crust, rich cheese flavor, and seriously tasty in every bite. Service was attentive and friendly, which made the whole experience even better. The menu also has tons of variety, and you can even mix and match items to create your own fitness-friendly meal if you want something lighter. Great food and great vibes!
sample_reviews_en.author: Somchai Maleekasem

sample_reviews_en.text: A restaurant I highly recommend! The food quality is good, and the prices are very reasonable, an amazing value for money that's hard to find. I go there often, and I’m always satisfied. The atmosphere is welcoming and relaxing, perfect for a dinner with friends or a quiet lunch. The staff is friendly and always helpful. It has become one of my favorite spots!
sample_reviews_en.author: SecurityService Modena

restaurants.name: ROOM 191 Khaosan
restaurants.address:

191 Khaosan Rd, Talat Yot, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I wish I could give 0 stars.

Came here because of the good reviews, but this turned out to be one of the worst dining experiences I’ve had. The food was just average, but the real issue was the owner, who was extremely rude and unprofessional.

We waited over 1 hour for our food and had to ask three times. When we followed up again, she immediately said “No! No!” as if we were lying. I even showed her a photo of when we arrived as proof, but instead of apologizing, she raised her voice and shouted at us.

I was not upset about the wait I understand restaurants get busy. But her attitude was completely unacceptable. She spoke to us as if we were asking for free food, with no respect at all.

I brought foreign friends here hoping they would experience Thai hospitality, but instead they were shocked by how we were treated. The way we were treated was demeaning and disrespectful, as if we were beneath basic human respect.

The atmosphere was completely ruined. We couldn’t even finish our meal.

Very disappointing. I will not come back and do not recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Asma Leila

sample_reviews_en.text:
For us, Room 191 is the best restaurant on Khaosan Road – easy to miss, tucked between a massage studio on one side and larger bars on the other. They offer both takeaway street food and small seating behind the stall on simple stools. The staff was quick, attentive, and friendly, and they happily accommodated special requests.

The menu has a wide selection, prices are very reasonable, and everything is freshly prepared and delicious. Even our kids, who aren’t big fans of Thai food, enjoyed the alternatives like fries and chicken nuggets, which were tasty as well.

Don’t expect a five-star restaurant – it’s street food with minimal seating at the street side – but it’s well-located, not as noisy as other spots on Khaosan Road, and you can still watch plenty of the street activity while enjoying your meal. We’ll definitely be coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Volker U

sample_reviews_en.text: We went on a tour, got a massage, and had a meal. I visited after seeing reviews here. Khaosan Road is always crowded, but since we arrived late, it was even busier. There were many young people, just like us, enjoying alcoholic beverages with their meals. It suddenly started raining heavily, so I was worried about when our food would arrive, but it came out very quickly. This is because the kitchen is located at the entrance of the shop and covered with plastic sheeting. The staff didn't seem flustered by the downpour; they protected the stovetops and served the fried food immediately. We ordered Pad Thai, along with Som Tum (spicy seasoned vegetables similar to kimchi) and Morning Delo Lori. They also have a wide variety of beers and drinks, making it a great place to have a drink.
sample_reviews_en.author: Monica seol

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have been here twice during my stay in Bangkok. We had Tom Yum, green curry and the fried rice.
Tom yum is absolutely amazing, with lot of flavor but not spicy. I love spicy food but in this case was perfect the way it was, so you could enjoy other flavors. I was amazed by the quantity of shrimps they put in the soup, around 12. In Europe if you are lucky they put you 3 😅
Green curry was very good too, a bit more spicy than Tom Yum.
Rice was nothing special, which was a shame.
People is very nice, but don’t expect service like in a restaurant, cause it’s still a street place.
Place is clean, and we spent between 400 and 520 bat as we ordered beers.
I would recommend you to try this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Simona Sanna

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food quality depended on the dish, not the cheapest and kind of small portions
Menu is nice, but they dont have juices, only alcoholic beverages
Service was nice and the food came very fast, spicyness was adjusted perfectly :)
Food came on paper plates with plastic forks, No A/C only fans
Music was nice
We paid 430 for a coke and the following foods:
Food: Thai Papaya salad - very good, chicken pad kaprao fried basil - very good (but also just chicken, no rice, no egg which would be typical?) chicken teriyaki also good, but the cheese fingers looked nothing like the picture  and tasted exactly like nothing
sample_reviews_en.author: Pia Polzin

sample_reviews_en.text: This is not a horrible restaurant its a pathetic restaurant. Probably the people who rated it 4.9 were high on weed. The owners lack communication skills and cant understand basic English. They made us wait for over 20 minutes, considering the fact that we were the only ones in the restaurant who ordered food. My recommendation would be starving to death would be better than eating here. One fact they have zero idea what teriyaki sauce is. Sadly Google doesnt allow me to give zero star thats why the minimal rating 😑
sample_reviews_en.author: Amlan Dasgupthaa

sample_reviews_en.text: Very bad. Food came out cold. I specifically asked for very spicy TWICE (ped ped mak) and it was not spicy or even hot. And why is a curry on a paper plate? Put it in a bowl. I only ate a little. The waiter had earphones in while I ordered which felt very rude. When I told the waiter the food was cold, he didn't care or apologize. Disgusting treatment of their customers. These people give Thailand a bad name for their terrible service and food. Shame on them. Eat anywhere else but here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Holly

sample_reviews_en.text:
In 2024 we visited and I haven't shut up about the curried stir fry dish since, in November 2025 we visited on 3 occassions. Fantastic flavours, great place to eat in a busy tourist area.

As a coeliac it can be difficult for people to feel confident eating in new places, heres an idea of all the dishes I had that they were able to make gluten free - massaman curry, penang curry, curried stir fry chicken/prawn and thai green curry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hannah Jarrett

restaurants.name: ร้านสารคามจิ้มจุ่ม ถนนโพธิ์แก้วแยก 9
restaurants.address:

111 109หมู่6 ถ. โพธิ์แก้ว Khlong Kum, Bueng Kum, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's clean. The sticky rice is soft, and the papaya salad with fermented fish sauce is delicious.
The spicy shrimp salad is very tasty. The Thai papaya salad is delicious. The tamarind leaf and egg cluster soup is very tasty. The beef waterfall salad had slightly tough beef. The pork waterfall salad used lean pork, which was a bit hard. However, the grilled pork neck waterfall salad was very tender and delicious.
The spicy pork soup is delicious, and the grilled pork neck salad is excellent.
The grilled chicken is incredibly delicious, and the dipping sauce is unlike any other.

The hot pot is good; the portion size is worth the price, and the dipping sauce is delicious.

The grilled liver, grilled intestines, grilled pork neck, and grilled tongue are all very tender and delicious. I loved them! The fried pork intestines with garlic are also delicious. It gets busy during lunchtime, so you might have to wait a little while.
They sell Mahachai ice cream in small cups, which is delicious.

Parking is available on the street in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jipjip Veeranuch

sample_reviews_en.text:
Drive into Soi Phothikaew and continue straight for a short distance. Look for the Suzuki car dealership on your right; just a little further on, you'll find Sarakham Jim Jum restaurant on your right. You can park along the roadside. The restaurant has about 8-9 tables, comfortable seating. They make delicious Northeastern Thai food, and you can choose your spice level. The grilled intestines are amazing, the spicy pork neck salad is tasty, the papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce is rich and flavorful, and the mixed beef and offal hot pot is excellent – ​​a dish I order every time I visit.

The prices are reasonable to moderate. It's a steady stream of customers, especially after 6 PM. You can dine in or order takeout. It gets very crowded on weekends. Come try it; you won't be disappointed. Everything I've ordered has been delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: **air-air-air**

sample_reviews_en.text: The service is good, attentive, and fast. The restaurant is clean and has street parking on both sides. The food is reasonably priced and delicious. The Thai papaya salad is delicious, with a fragrant, authentic lime flavor. The corn salad with salted egg is delicious; the corn is tender and the salted egg white isn't too salty. The spicy pork salad is tasty, flavorful, and not too fatty, making it not greasy. The grilled pork neck has just the right amount of fat marbling. The bamboo shoot soup is tender and served piping hot, unlike other restaurants. It's clean and safe. The pork hot pot is delicious and inexpensive. Overall, the food is delicious, clean, and reasonably priced. I recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Happiness Happiness

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has delicious food, and the prices are reasonable. The papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce is incredibly flavorful. Other recommended dishes include: crying tiger beef, grilled pork ribs, grilled intestines, duck larb, grilled pork neck, spicy beef salad, grilled catfish, papaya salad with fresh shrimp and fermented fish sauce, and the fried duck beaks are all excellent. The dipping sauce is amazing; it's so good that you'll barely finish the broth! It can get a bit crowded in the evenings, but you can usually find parking along the roadside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hello Kitty

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Thai papaya salad was delicious. The correct Thai papaya salad had just the right balance of sourness and spiciness – absolutely delicious.

The Korat-style papaya salad had a strong fermented fish sauce smell; those who don't like fermented fish sauce might not like it.

The grilled pork neck was delicious and the portion was generous.

The minced pork and duck salad was perfectly balanced and tasty.

The spicy chicken feet soup was delicious.

Most of the dishes were large portions at reasonable prices.

It was very busy. Parking is available along the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ao Trafford

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a som tam shop that opens from noon onwards. You can eat here over and over again without getting bored. Every dish is outstanding, especially the grilled pork neck, which is incredibly delicious, tender, and juicy. The som tam with 20 chilies is incredibly spicy. Slurp down the spicy pork cartilage soup, which is the best! Finish off the spiciness with a fizzy drink. Wow, it's so amazing. It reminds me of Isaan som tam. This shop is the answer. You won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeerapha K.

sample_reviews_en.text: The cook changed and the taste wasn't as good. Usually, the food is delicious, but this was the first time I couldn't finish both dishes. I asked for a new order twice because they didn't follow my instructions, and I was getting really angry and hungry, wondering what they didn't understand. I wrote my order very clearly, just like every time. This time, I was very disappointed, and I might not choose this place first if I want Northeastern Thai food. I'm very let down.
sample_reviews_en.author: BiBi Booboo

sample_reviews_en.text: This roadside restaurant sells Northeastern Thai food. Parking is available in front of the shop depending on the time, or you can park in a small alley between the BBQ restaurant and the papaya salad shop. The food is reasonably priced. The papaya salad noodles are crispy, like a tasty fruit salad. The grilled meat is not tough but lacks a strong meaty smell. The fried chicken wings are crispy and delicious. The food comes out quickly, and it's quite busy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffey

restaurants.name: Bun Meat & Cheese Burger - Thonglor
restaurants.address:

335 Akkhara Phatsadu Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This hamburger restaurant was a chance find while driving around. It's located in a common area with many restaurants to choose from, but this hamburger place caught my eye and I wanted to try it. I ordered two hamburgers and one hot dog. My professor was okay with it. We sat at a restaurant next door, but they said all the tables were full. I also didn't order the fries. The hamburger was delicious, and the meat was tender.

There's live music, and the atmosphere is like a food court abroad, with many foreigners eating. It's fun, and you can buy various things to eat in the restaurant. There are many different types of shops here, including a pizza place, Thai food, som tum (papaya salad), coffee shops, and bars. I ordered a beer to go with my hamburger, and it was delicious.

There's a parking lot with limited parking spaces, so you might need to leave your keys with someone else. Remember to get your parking ticket stamped, as there's a parking fee, but it's not too expensive considering it's in the city. The restrooms are clean. The day I went, everything was fine.
sample_reviews_en.author: PS

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm Thai but from the UK and was staying in Thong Lor for a few days between Xmas and NY.. I found this little fortress of solitude seeking out the Crackhouse and I got a bit obsessed with it. The Crackhouse breakfast pancake burger beat a McMuffin (and I love a good McMuffin) and a bonus was that they did proper poutine. Meat and Cheese Burger did the best burger I've had in a while.. didn't know I needed my soft briochey bun to have crisp edges till now!! And you can get a junior size too if you want something small.. their parmesan truffle mayo fries were also so crisp and earthy. Seven Suns also worth a visit for some great matcha drinks and Roots for some good coffee.. something literally for everyone here. Such a cool space, great atmosphere to chill, write, meet with mates in shaded or air conned spaces. Proper blissful.
sample_reviews_en.author: daraponv

sample_reviews_en.text:
I always had good impression with Bun Meat and Cheese, ever since they showcased the "Shake Shack" burger during their campaign/event. I used to recommend to many of my friends.
But today, I was extremely disappointed ☹️ I know their buns are well known for being soft but (even when it was a dine-in), mine was super soggy, and all ingredients were just falling out of place, making the entire burger-munching experience not quite pleasant. Fries were also pale, not crispy at all, and just didn't hit the mark. Chicken wings were dry, but still okay.
I wasn't a happy customer today, and not sure if I'll return. Hope the original recipe-maker/manager (whoever in charge) can take more time visiting the shop and ensure continuation in their quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bora Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant offers burgers with both pork and beef options. All items are available in Junior or Regular sizes, priced per piece. For a set meal, you can add 60 baht, which includes French fries and one drink (choose between lemon tea or water).
Today I ordered the Regular size ONION BURGER with the set meal, totaling 429 baht.
French fries 🍟: Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, with just the right amount of saltiness, not greasy.
The burger 🍔: The bread is soft, the pork patty is a good thickness and juicy, but it starts to get a bit greasy after a while.
Suggestion: If served with a small amount of pickled cucumber or other pickles, it would help cut the greasiness and make the flavors complement each other better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yotsanun Sueyingkan

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered the sausage platter and it came, after an excruciatingly long wait, without a single morsel of bread! When I asked for a slice of bread, they told me that sausage is not hot dog and doesn’t come with a bun!!! I told them that the bread is implied everywhere a sausage platter is on the menu, and they replied that the sausages are Thai and that’s how it is in Thailand!! Meanwhile the place has an English name and menu written in English and serves burgers on buns!! The sausages were actually tasty (though a bit undercooked and seriously overpriced) but with that logic you’d think they’d be serving burgers without buns!! I will not return and cannot recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hojat Salehi

sample_reviews_en.text:
What a disappointment. I used to recommend this place (not this branch) for it's good knock off of In n Out burger. But, I just ordered from this branch and it's so bad.

The bun was flat and soggy. Not enough In n Out sauce. You cannot taste it in the burger. I can make better burger that this.

I ordered the BBQ ribs. It's more like boiled ribs. No flavor. The BBQ sauce was barely covering the ribs. They did give extra sauce, or maybe I ordered extra.

The corn was meh. Again, no seasoning.

I would try the other branch, in the meantime, I wouldn't visit this branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: sagita suwandi

sample_reviews_en.text:
I wish we can do half stars here. I would say 3.5 for food. We ordered 2 fish n chips and 1 tater tots. The fish was ok but it’s paper thin for the price. The chips was a bit tasteless and not cooked well. Tartare sauce is nice. The tater tots was excellent.

The girl at the cashier was probably bored to death and we probably interrupted her browsing social media. Let’s just say, it’s good that it’s a self service type of place 😅

Next time I will try the burgers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Somphon Potisophon

sample_reviews_en.text: Burgers were okay (3/5), lemon ice tea good (4/5), but the truffle fries were horrible (1/5). They didn’t seem completely cooked yet and the taste was really bad and paper-like. We had to throw them away and this happens close to never with any food. Quite disappointing for such a high price point. We ordered at 3.30pm, so also no peak or alike. I was really looking forward to the alleged “in-and-out“-like burger, but this ain’t it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ben

restaurants.name: L'ENTREPOTE
restaurants.address:

312 Pattaya 3rd Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: On a hot sunny day, I went to a restaurant and, oh no, they're closed for the Lunar New Year holiday. I had no choice but to walk around and sweat a lot and stumble upon this place. I ordered a yogurt mixed berry bowl and a latte. First, a familiar soft love pop song filled my ears with a sweet feeling of love. They brought me a latte with a single white flower in bloom. In a word, it's a latte restaurant. The rich, creamy, smooth milk foam and a slight sourness and spiciness are hidden under the foam. When I take a sip of the foam, the softness, acidity, and spiciness stimulate my tongue in that order. It seems easy but difficult, and they seem to be good at blending latte. And when I take a bite of the white cream cookie, sweetness envelops my tongue. The sourness and spiciness of the latte and the sweetness of the cookie, they really are a perfect pair.  And the familiar tropical fruits—banana, dragon fruit, dried coconut, super seed, and yoghurt—make a spoonful of this delicious dessert, bursting with freshness, tartness, and sweetness. Highly recommended. The restaurant I visited was closed, a disappointment, but it was a delightful surprise.
sample_reviews_en.author: B.S. David Kim

sample_reviews_en.text: Hello, I stumbled upon your establishment by chance, which is superb by the way. I was at the end of a two-month holiday in Thailand and I was craving French food, and then I found you! Oh my goodness, what a pleasant surprise! The cuisine was of exceptional quality (filet mignon with homemade mashed potatoes). I must say, the chef has magic hands. I hope she sees this comment; I'm a former cook, so I know what I'm talking about. Congratulations to the chef, the team, and of course the owner, with whom I had the honor of speaking. Bravo! The filet mignon truly blew me away—what incredible skill! For your information, I ordered it twice, so the cooking was truly masterful and consistent, with exquisite finesse. Thank you, I will definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poupi Tchoupi

sample_reviews_en.text: Really polite and welcoming staff, you feel at ease as soon as you arrive. Service is fast and efficient, and the team stays attentive even when it is busy. The food is decent, well executed, with fair portions and flavors that match what you would expect. If you like Saint-Marcellin cheese, this is definitely a place to try in Pattaya: you find it in dishes like a “Saint-Marcellin burger”, which is very tasty and comforting. One thing to know is that the seats are very firm (really), so it is not the ideal place if you want to sit for a long time. On the other hand, if you want to eat quickly and then leave, it is perfect: you eat fast, you are served fast, and it does the job.
sample_reviews_en.author: Root

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem in Pattaya! 🤩 Honestly, go for it! The French-Thai fusion is simply incredible, and you can immediately tell the ingredients are fresh and top quality. It makes all the difference on the plate.

The setting is really lovely and modern, perfect for a relaxing time, and the staff is incredibly attentive and welcoming.

The best part: the crepe with real Nutella to finish! We all know how hard it is to find authentic Nutella in Thailand, so this was pure bliss. A must-try if you're in the area! 🇹🇭🇫🇷
sample_reviews_en.author: Oceane Davril

sample_reviews_en.text:
A huge thank you to this absolutely fantastic French-speaking duo who welcome you with a smile and a genuine passion for what they do. You feel right at home from the moment you arrive.

The atmosphere is friendly, the service impeccable, attentive, and professional from start to finish. Everything is there for a wonderful evening: good humor, quality, and a truly warm welcome.

A place I wholeheartedly recommend to anyone who wants to spend a memorable time in Pattaya in a warm and relaxed atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: S B

sample_reviews_en.text:
Generally, I don't go to French restaurants in Thailand.
You don't travel 10,000 km to eat French food.
I eat Thai food every day; it's much better and lower in calories.

I was very disappointed with the breading on my cordon bleu, which was overcooked and too crispy, like chicken from KFC.
It was definitely cooked in oil and not in a pan. In comparison, at Momento, it's bigger, tastes better, and most importantly, the breading isn't overcooked.
sample_reviews_en.author: Seb T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went for an evening meal at L’Entrepote on Pattaya 3rd rd last night (5th Nov 2025).
Girlfriend had a Thai dish and I had a chicken dish with mashed potatoes.
Both were very good quality and delicious.
The ambience of this new French restaurant was 1st class. Everything spotlessly clean. Service was fast and friendly and reasonably priced. A nice friendly place for a meal. I will definitely go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: David McConkey

sample_reviews_en.text:
New address in Pattaya. The food is excellent across the board.

However, the welcome and service are either outstanding or a complete disaster. In two visits over eight days, we experienced service and hospitality on one occasion, and yesterday, utter contempt! Despite our complaint to the manager, there was no attempt to make amends, just blatant disregard... And then they complain about the reviews 🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: JC GLAS

restaurants.name: Baan Knot
restaurants.address:

83 Soi Samsen 11, Wachira Phayaban, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If there's a restaurant I'd rather take friends back to than just for a quick check-in, it's this one.

The food is genuinely home-cooked. The ingredients are top-notch, you can feel it from the first bite. The squid in Satun is fresh and sweet, and the various cuts of meat are carefully selected. Each dish is perfectly seasoned, not overpowering the natural flavors of the ingredients. You can even customize your menu with the chef.

The flavors are palatable and easy to eat, yet with memorable details. For cocktail lovers, you can ask the chef for a great pairing. They have a wide selection of wines and champagnes.

What I loved just as much as the food was the atmosphere. It felt like having a meal at a friend's house – a beautiful, warm, and private home. You can sit and chat for as long as you like without anyone rushing you to leave. You can even be loud.

It's a restaurant that doesn't try to be flashy, but instead makes you feel good from the moment you enter until you leave. There's parking for 5 cars.

If you're looking for a place to truly spend quality time with someone special, try visiting for a meal. You'll understand why I want to recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tang Okada

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's not exactly a secret dining experience, nor is it a chef's table, but I truly feel that if you want to celebrate with friends or bring your extended family for a special occasion, you shouldn't miss this restaurant.

The chef, Khun Not, is an excellent advisor and can engage you in enneagram discussions. He's a Type 7 who renovated his house into a 'secret lair' filled with a vast array of ingredients, diverse drinks, and constant surprises.

Yes, you might pre-select your food and drinks, but when the chef feels like trying something new, he'll unexpectedly offer it to you.

That day, we tried more than 5-6 drinks, two pasta dishes, Hokkaido snow fish, Satun squid, Surin wagyu, Hokkaido F1 ribeye, and so much more.

All of this (including drinks) cost less than 3,000 baht. We were there from 6 pm until midnight. Yes, they only accept one table per day, making it incredibly private, and it felt like the space was all yours.
sample_reviews_en.author: VICH SANARDHARN

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food and atmosphere are incredibly exclusive, with parking available right in the house. The food is delicious, freshly prepared dish by dish. It starts with a fresh vegetable salad, grilled mushrooms, large, fresh gambas prawns delivered straight from the boat, and beautiful cuts of various meats (I don't eat beef, so I opted for pork, which was just as delicious). Then there's the squid ink spaghetti with large chunks of squid and a generous topping of seafood—so much that you can barely see the pasta! It's topped off with tiramisu and a selection of cocktails, mocktails, wine, and beer in a classic, old-house atmosphere. It's chill and perfect for hanging out with friends, loved ones, or family. There are sofas perfect for a fireside chat.
Chef Nott is incredibly kind and attentive throughout. It's well worth the time and effort.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tui Watsakorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is very friendly, like having a meal at a friend's house. The welcome drink was delicious, and the salad was very refreshing. The ingredients were fresh and seasonal. The four-course meal was just right and very satisfying. If you come, you should try the matcha tiramisu; it's amazing. Khun Not makes excellent cocktails.
Reservations are required, and currently, they're only open on weekends. It's best to call and check beforehand. The owner is very friendly and provides excellent information.

I'll definitely go back again when I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: ขวัญชนก หิรัญตระกูล

sample_reviews_en.text: Incredible experience with my girlfriend's family. Everyone loved the friendly atmosphere. We arrived on a whim, even though you normally need a reservation as this place is only available for private events. We were lucky; Knot, the owner, is just too kind. A real gem, he's passionate about so many things. A must-visit if you want to discover a traditional house brought up to date, full of positive energy and stories. The food was perfect. Enjoy!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jordan Proença

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious. Drink lovers are welcome; the chef is ready with savory dishes, desserts, and both alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks.
The steaks here are amazing, every single one of them. The food is fresh, prepared exactly as requested. The atmosphere is fantastic; it's a restaurant converted from an old Thai house, the ambiance is superb. There's parking for 5 cars on the premises.
sample_reviews_en.author: SY Luxsika

sample_reviews_en.text:
The beef was amazing! It's a secondary cut, but incredibly delicious – a truly mind-blowing experience. I never thought Surin beef could be this good.
Another fantastic dish was the tiramisu. Usually, I give Neil Tavern my number one spot, but this place is 0.5 points better this time. 🥺🥺🥺 The picture was taken after I'd almost finished eating and only just remembered to take it. 🥺🥺🥺
sample_reviews_en.author: Varin Srimahachota

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, the ingredients are fresh, and the chef and staff are attentive.

The traditional wooden house creates a warm and friendly atmosphere.
It's perfect for gatherings with friends or family in a private setting.

There's parking for about three to four cars in front, but you can also park in the side alley.

In summary, I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicole sanjariyapipu

restaurants.name: Ya Chaem's Kanom Bueang Yuan
restaurants.address:

QG56+PJF ซ นครสวรรค์ 4 Wat Sommanat, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
As a tourist you will struggle to find this dish anywhere else in the city. It is a beautiful blend of Vietnamese and Thai cuisine - Ive been here 4 seperate trips, always making time to come here. It is an amazing mix of salty, sour, spicy, sweet. It is like a Vietnamese bahn xeo - but sweeter and with a range of textures and flavours. The side salad provides both freshness from the cucumbers but also more heat from the chili
chili. It might confuse some - but this is a dish worth exploring. The atmosphere lacks - but it is quite romantic to eat in an alleyway. No airs and graces - but wonderful smiling people cooking amazing food just outside one of Bangkok's oldest markets.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christopher Keeling

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I'm going to introduce an old, established Vietnamese crepe (Banh Xeo) shop in the Nang Leong market area. It's been featured on several TV channels.

The shop has two tables for seating and sells Vietnamese crepes and pork buns.

Today I ordered the egg-filled Vietnamese crepe, 60 baht per set. It's served with a dipping sauce similar to a sweet and sour relish. The crepe is cut into bite-sized pieces and tastes great – absolutely delicious!

If you have the chance, give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: เดินสายกิน เดินสายเที่ยว ศราทราเวล

sample_reviews_en.text:
Grandma Chaem's Vietnamese Crepes...
The best! This is how it should be...
Authentic food...the right flavor. Not the kind where the filling is overly sweet and turns into a dessert like most others...the soft, creamy egg filling, or the crispy one. Grandma serves it hot...freshly made.
Most importantly, the dipping sauce with thinly sliced ​​young ginger is the heart of this dish. It cuts through the sweetness and enhances the flavor to another level. This is truly excellent....
sample_reviews_en.author: ChubbyArin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Outstanding khanom bueang yuan. We have visited Bangkok twice and both times we have come to this place to eat it.

The salad/topping they provide to go with the khanom bueang yuan is where a lot of the spice and sweetness comes from. So if you want more spice and less sweetness like us, you can always ask for it to be made that way.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thomas Wood

sample_reviews_en.text:
I passed by this shop twice and saw people eating there both times. I saw they had just finished frying pork-topped bread, so I decided to buy some. It was delicious, but personally, if you eat too much, it can get a bit greasy. I couldn't finish it. 😅

The sellers seemed a bit grumpy and were complaining amongst themselves. 😅
sample_reviews_en.author: miraipa OiL

sample_reviews_en.text:
Vietnamese savory crepes come in both the traditional thin and crispy version and the thicker wrapped version.

The filling is excellent, complete with sweet coconut, bean sprouts, and tofu, served with a sweet and sour dipping sauce and topped with ginger.

The "mouse-shaped bread" is equally delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nong_CNX

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered from the Pok Pok app, and it took almost 4 hours for the rider to deliver it. By the time I opened the box, it was completely cold. I put it on a plate and tried it; it was actually delicious! Seriously. If I had eaten it while it was hot and freshly made, it would have been even better...
sample_reviews_en.author: Sanphat Kijprueang

sample_reviews_en.text: Tried deep fried bread with chopped pork, very tasty at reasonable price. Normally when order some deep fried, its very oily but Ya Chaem did very well, this deep fried was not oily at all and still crunchy even i left it around few hours before eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawinee Santichalanan

restaurants.name: ต้ม ตำ ยำ แซบ by คุณตุ๊ก
restaurants.address:

Rat Burana, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious! The Thai papaya salad had a perfectly balanced flavor. The waterfall salad and spicy soup were incredibly flavorful. The fried chicken wings and sun-dried beef were also tasty, especially the fried chicken wings – it seemed like every table was ordering them. If you go during lunchtime, be prepared to wait. This restaurant is popular with office workers from the area who often call to reserve tables beforehand. On the day I went, there were tables available, but we had to wait about 40 minutes for our food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vimlet Kir

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is absolutely adorable! I had a meal and left a cake as a gift, and the staff helped me surprise my family with it. I was so touched! They didn't have candles, but they provided them. The food was delicious and the prices were reasonable.

It's usually full during lunchtime, so it's best to call and reserve a table. Parking can be a bit difficult. I recommend coming in the evening and ordering your food in advance.

Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Warattaya T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today was my first time eating here.
It was so delicious! The fermented fish was truly amazing.
The price was really cheap, everything was amazing! 😅

I highly recommend Isan Ban Hao. Go for it!

Parking is available on the roadside in front of 7-11.

On weekdays, during lunch, you have to call to make a reservation. Tables fill up quickly.

There are tons of rider orders every day. Oh, I really like Ban Hao.
sample_reviews_en.author: Melon Lemon

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very delicious and affordable som tam restaurant.

Spicy papaya salad with fermented fish, 8/10.
Korat papaya salad, 7/10.
Corn salad, 8/10.
Fried chicken, 100/10 (crispy and hot).
Dried pork, 10/10.
Spicy soup, 10/10.

I recommend eating at the restaurant. It's absolutely delicious!!
I recommend everyone to come and try it.
Parking is available next to the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: TC Review

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a fantastic somtum (papaya salad) restaurant in Rat Burana. There's no parking, so you'll have to park on the side of the road. Reservations are recommended, especially during lunchtime, as it gets very crowded. The food is delicious, the prices are reasonable, and the spicy dressing is amazing. The fried chicken wings are also excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natemiseiko

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork larb is very delicious and has a fragrant roasted rice aroma. The som tam is not too spicy. If you like it sour, you should order it extra. The staff provides good service. I don't know if there is parking, but we parked next to the shop. The food is good and worth the price. I recommend you try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: thanitha sublom

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant was very crowded. I intended to have lunch at 11:00 AM, but all the tables were reserved. Luckily, I was able to sit and eat at the drinks shop next door. Everything on the menu was delicious, except for the tamarind dipping sauce, which was a bit too sweet (in my personal opinion).
sample_reviews_en.author: Wittaya M

sample_reviews_en.text: 🍗 Crispy on the outside, tender on the inside grilled chicken, served with flavorful corn salad. The restaurant is located at the bus stop opposite the Rat Burana Electricity Authority. Good service, you can call to reserve in advance. Parking is available in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชานิวัฒน์ หงษ์ชูเกียรติ

restaurants.name: Piti Bar Cafe
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 10 ซ. ลาดพร้าว 115 Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.author: Chollada Ch.

sample_reviews_en.text: I happened to walk past and saw it from the BTS above; the place was packed, so I decided to chill out since it's close to home. I have to say, I was very impressed with this place. The singers and musicians were very professional and sang beautifully. The food was delicious and reasonably priced. The atmosphere was warm and cozy; the restaurant has its own unique style. I highly recommend this great restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maei Ma

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to see a friend's acoustic live performance. It was my first time in this area. I was excited to see what the area was like! I wonder if this bar has a lot of local Thai customers? They seem to hold events often too. I ordered a pitcher of highball, and it never got any smaller no matter how much I drank. Lol The drinks were reasonably priced!
sample_reviews_en.author: Shinya Mukai

sample_reviews_en.text: An excellent cozy pub that serves good food and drinks at very reasonable price. Love the artsy atmosphere coupled with live music that isn't too loud for any conversation. Service is good too and the staff took our orders in English. Definitely worth checking out Piti Bar if you're in Bangkok
sample_reviews_en.author: Fugly Foo

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is perfect for chilling out. The decor is cool with a collection of art pieces. The owner and staff are super attentive.
The cocktails, food, and snacks are fantastic. The stir-fried pork belly served with pickled vegetables is amazing – a must-try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lalar Tanaswangkul

sample_reviews_en.text: I loved it! The atmosphere was great, and importantly, smoking is allowed if you sit outside. For non-smokers, there's also a cozy indoor area. There were a few mosquitoes, but the shop provided mosquito repellent spray. I will definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bowww Zzzz

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice place!! Very  cozy. Very well decorated.  Friendly staff. The food was fantastic. Fried Mushrooms and Shrimp. Tom Yum Seafood was the best. Fair priced drinks and food. Good atmosphere. I will definitely make another visit here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brett Toney

sample_reviews_en.text: Such a cute and cozy bar restaurant! The live singer was amazing, the decor was adorable, and the food was absolutely delicious. The staff were super friendly, and the atmosphere was just perfect—so chill and relaxing. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Ma

restaurants.name: The Junction - Bang Kachao
restaurants.address:

MHX6+RJF, Bang Kachao, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great little spot with delicious food and a cozy vibe

I stopped by The Junction and was really impressed. The place has a cute, modern design with a relaxed outdoor seating area — perfect for grabbing a drink or a casual meal.

I ordered the Fish & Chips, and it was excellent. The fish was crispy on the outside, soft and flaky inside, and the portion was generous. Fries were hot and well-seasoned, and the homemade tartar sauce was surprisingly good.

The staff were friendly, and the whole atmosphere feels welcoming. They offer craft beer, cocktails, pizza, and Thai-style bar snacks as well — great variety for a small place.

Overall, it’s a nice spot to chill, especially if you’re looking for something cozy and not too crowded. I’d definitely come back again
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattama Ph

sample_reviews_en.text:
🚲 Chill Vibe, Great Food & Craft Beer!
This place has an awesome vibe! It's super close to Bangkok but feels like you're way out in the countryside—all trees and a canal. The air is so fresh.

Lots of tourists, even foreigners, come here to bike and walk. It's super quiet—zero noise! Perfect for just chilling with some food and drinks. They have lots of cool seating areas that are comfy and look great.

The food is tasty! Must-try items are the Pizza, Larb Tod (Fried Spicy Pork), Chicken Pop, Fried chicken wings, and Food for children. etc.

You HAVE to try their craft beer—it's seriously good, aromatic, and doesn't cost a fortune!

The owner and staff are super friendly and give great service. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Art Khamta

sample_reviews_en.text: Well, if you've already found this paradise island in Bangkok, which everyone calls the lungs of the city, then you've definitely taken a bike and ridden many kilometers, exploring the island's sights and probably gotten hungry. Then you've arrived at that very cafe with the most delicious breaded fish. Try it! The portions are huge—feel free to share one. At the neighboring tables, the guys were eating pizza (it looked like it was in Italy) and drinking cold beer. We limited ourselves to Coke and left full and satisfied. The welcoming cafe owner gave us a very pleasant send-off, and I can say for myself—this is a truly great location that everyone should consider a tourist attraction.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julia

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was just walking by and noticed there were a lot of foreigners sitting there, so I decided to check out the menu. The staff said their pizza was amazing. I asked if they used Neapolitan or Romana crust.

It turned out they only sold Neapolitan crust, so I decided to try one. I ordered a Pepperoni pizza for 290 baht.

I didn't have high expectations when I ordered because this is Bang Krachao, not Sukhumvit, but it exceeded my expectations!

The owner was incredibly friendly, and the atmosphere was nice and relaxed. The weather in Bang Krachao was especially nice at that time, which made the pizza taste even better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittima Sudasna

sample_reviews_en.text: I live near Bang Nam Phueng, but I stumbled upon a pizza place I'd never tried before. Today, it's a short drive from the popular park where people cycle. Their main menu includes pizza, and they also have appetizers like french fries and chicken nuggets. I saw they also have beer – I don't drink, but some reviews said it was really good. If you're tired from cycling, don't forget to stop by! The service is good, the food is delicious, and it's a cute, cozy, and friendly place that anyone passing by should try at least once. 💖
sample_reviews_en.author: อรยา สมบูรณ์ยิ่ง

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great chill vibe, nice food/drinks option, super nice owner/staff. 100% recommended.

I've been few times already, nice owner and staff, chill place, nice music, they cook thai and western food, and drinks (coffee, tea) are nice.

I know place is known for beers/drinks but I dont drink alcohol so cant try hahaha

Even worked from here few times, and wifi was provided and was super fast.

It's a perfect place to stop by on the way to the botanical garden or before taking the ferry back.

100% recommended. :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Ruben

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came across this place near the pier after seeing a sign for craft beer and Neapolitan pizza, which was enough for me to stop.
They were out of craft beer when I visited, apparently after a party the night before, but the wood-fired pizzas more than made up for it. I went for the larb moo pizza, my usual go-to in Thailand, spicy and very satisfying.
At under 300 baht, prices are very reasonable, and it’s a great little stop if you’re exploring the area by bike.
sample_reviews_en.author: André Mohr

sample_reviews_en.text: Wow, what a taste sensation! 😋 After 5 weeks of Thai food, we were craving a delicious pizza. We had the Laab Moo pizza and the four-cheese pizza with jalapeños and onion. The Laab Moo pizza was incredibly tasty; the dough was very fluffy yet crispy. The other pizza was also good, but just okay for us. But it's all a matter of taste, of course 🤷‍♀️ We can still wholeheartedly recommend this place!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wendy

restaurants.name: Home Cafe Tha Tien
restaurants.address:

10,12, 14 Tha Tian Aly, Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We picked this place near the Grand Palace after our visit – and the food turned out to be unexpectedly delicious! We finished every single dish! Portions were average-sized. We went during off-peak hours so there weren't many people – everything was made fresh to order, and the service speed was just okay. I imagine it could take quite a while if it's crowded.**

Ambiance: The setting and service were both decent, though it might feel a bit cramped with a full house.

Food: The mango sticky rice is a must-order signature. The shrimp stir-fried noodles – I absolutely love Thai fried noodles – were refreshing and packed with flavor, and the colors looked so appetizing! The fried spring rolls are also a signature but personally, I found them pretty average.

**Drinks:** The watermelon slushie and Thai-style lemon tea – the lemon tea really surprised us! It didn't have that cheap artificial taste – it was fragrant, not overly sweet, and incredibly refreshing in the summer heat. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: ImJade

sample_reviews_en.text:
Highly recommended as a restaurant near Wat Pho and the Grand Palace!!😋😋😋😋

Prices are expensive on the main roads, but here, fried rice and noodle dishes start at 90 baht—the portions are generous and delicious!!

The ingredients inside are incredibly substantial.

The mango smoothie (85B) is so rich, almost as if no water was added, that it feels just like eating a fresh mango🥭

There is also a massage shop across the street, possibly a Wat Pho School branch.

Since it is located in an alley, smokers can comfortably smoke outside.

Vegetarian options are also available.

Kakao Pay, Naver Pay, Alipay, and Toss Pay are accepted.
sample_reviews_en.author: 우미현

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great restaurant, delicious Thai food, huge servings - definitely a must visit if you're around Tha Tien!

Came here at around 11AM, before heading to Reclining Buddha. This time is perfect time as only a couple of table were occupied so I don't have to wait. By around 11:30AM to 12NN, it was already packed.

Staffs were all nice and welcoming. Also have an aircon so perfect to stay a bit to cool down with Thailand's scorching heat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ivy Abe

sample_reviews_en.text:
Home Cafe Thailand, located near the Sanam Chai MRT station, is tucked away in an alley near the Grand Palace. It offers a wide variety of dishes at reasonable prices, making it a great place to order and share with friends.

After your meal, you can stroll through the nearby alleys and get a close-up view of Wat Arun.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hotel King

sample_reviews_en.text:
Home cafe, is a great little restaurant to visit, clean kitchen, toilets are very clean.
Food is awesome as well I had the fried pork belly with rice, it hit the spot just perfectly!
Also the place has air conditioning which is great for those who prefer the cold!

Thanks for the great atmosphere & food!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jon Stone

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went around 1 PM and ordered Pad Thai and pineapple fried rice. They were quite good, and the air conditioning was on, so it was pleasant.

The watermelon and lime juices were nice and cold, too.

It didn't seem like the kind of place where you have to wait in line, so I enjoyed a quiet and cool meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Heavy Slump

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a MUST visit restaurant, it's small but very popular so you will have to wait for atleast 30 mins. One of the best food I had in Thailand. The tastiest prawns gravy and rice I had in my life. I will always remember this place. My last day meal but the most memorable meal in Thailand! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Geetashri Sarma

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, the portions were generous, and the price was reasonable considering the location. The staff provided excellent service. I will definitely go back again.
As a Thai person, I would recommend this place. The food is authentic and the service was wonderful 💗
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirivimon Joslin

restaurants.name: Apollo Duck
restaurants.address:

18, 9-10 ซอย สาทร 11 Yan Nawa, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
For food lovers, you absolutely cannot miss this place! Smoked Cantonese roast duck with lychee wood,
Macau-style crispy pork,
and a variety of shrimp wonton noodles – all incredibly delicious. Open from 10:30 AM to 6:00 PM. Located on Sathorn Soi 11, about a 4-minute walk from BTS Saint Louis Station, Exit 2. If you love duck, you have to try it – it's incredibly delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: พิตตานันท์ จารุนันทภาคย์

sample_reviews_en.text: The flavor isn't too strong, it's well-balanced and fragrant, making it easy to eat continuously without getting tired of it. It's suitable for both casual meals and special occasions. If you're tired of the same old food, you should try it. Change up your usual restaurant experience and try Hong Kong-style Chinese food for both delicious flavor and a new experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: พงศพัฒน์ จิวสุวรรณ

sample_reviews_en.text: The first bite of the roast duck made me understand why people talk about this place. The skin was crispy, the meat inside was juicy and firm, and the sauce was perfectly balanced. The char siu pork, Chinese style, was fragrant with a special sauce, sweet and savory, tender and juicy. It paired well with plum juice or Hong Kong milk tea. Excellent in my opinion.
sample_reviews_en.author: ฐปนันท์ เนื้อนิ่ม

sample_reviews_en.text: The red bean soup is smooth, creamy, and fragrant with red bean flavor. The sweetness is just right, not overly sweet. What I liked most was how well it balanced the saltiness and richness of the crispy pork and roast duck. Eating them together created a well-balanced flavor profile, preventing any cloying feeling. It's also a great way to end the meal! 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Watchara Manadee

sample_reviews_en.text: I like the egg noodle soup with wontons because the noodles are chewy and soft, the broth is fragrant and flavorful, and the wontons are soft and delicious. Eating it hot is very filling and satisfying. The Hong Kong milk tea is also fragrant and rich. The taro and ginkgo sago dessert looks tempting; I'll order it next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Deborah

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordering the mixed platter was incredibly good value. It included roasted duck, char siu pork, and crispy pork belly – all with tender meat and crispy skin, and a flavorful sauce. The portion was generous for the price. The food was served quickly, and the restaurant was clean with a nice atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: nisa siljuntuek

sample_reviews_en.text: This roast duck restaurant also does a great job with the eggs. The yolks are perfectly runny, and the meat is tender and succulent. When you cut into it, the yolk flows out and coats every bite, making it even more delicious. Anyone who loves runny egg yolks must try this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: รติรมย์ คงหนุน

sample_reviews_en.text: The ginger dipping sauce is great; it tastes delicious with chicken and also good with duck. Crispy pork with mustard dip is okay. The boiled noodles with dumplings are enjoyable. The ginger-flavored glutinous rice balls are good, so delicious I ordered extra to take home 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: yen dys

restaurants.name: TANTHAI PIZZA
restaurants.address:

776/5-6 ซอยพัฒนาการ 44 ถนนพัฒนาการ Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The tom yum fish noodles were excellent, with a rich and well balanced flavor. The เกี๊ยว (dumplings), however, seemed slightly stale, and the crispy texture wasn't quite as crisp as expected. The service was attentive, and the restaurant was clean and well maintained, as always.

The pizza was enjoyable overall, but it leaned a bit too salty, which appears to be a common observation mentioned in other reviews. Despite a few minor issues, the meal was generally satisfying.
sample_reviews_th.author: Bangkok Travels

sample_reviews_en.text:
A spacious neighborhood restaurant serving Italian and Thai cuisine. There were no other customers besides us and the employees spoiled the ambience by talking loudly to each other as if we weren’t there. Servers were polite but it was difficult to get their attention.

The food was unremarkable. The texture of the pizza dough was decent but overall the pizza was a tad too salty for our taste. Mixed salad was good. The raw garlic pieces on the tomato bruschetta were too chunky and the taste was too strong.
sample_reviews_en.author: R S

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pizza was average, leaning towards bland, as if there wasn't enough cheese, but it was worth the price. The crust was thin and the ingredients were okay. The only downside was the excessive number of flies in the restaurant; four or five of them were buzzing around the food.

There are only a few parking spaces near the front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: U-Maraj S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
It tastes very good and clean.
However, some employees do not use masks.
That's the person who makes pizza in the kitchen.
Indeed, can you be sure that there is no COVID-19 virus in the pizza made by the person?
sample_reviews_en.author: DAEHEE KIM

sample_reviews_en.text: A restaurant with many delicious dishes, such as Yen Ta Fo Tom Yum noodles,and the most amazing thing is pizza. I really like the truffle pizza. Thin crust, so delicious I'm going to die for it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Virin Jira

sample_reviews_en.text:
Who even own this place should fire the staff that either seat and play on their phone when the restaurant is open.
When walking in 2/3 staff seat and on their phone. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexandre Da Fonseca

sample_reviews_en.text: Pizza diavola is nice adding topping with black olive and taste good especially drunken black ink spaghetti serving with quite big portion with reasonable price!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pat S.

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered Tom Yum Yen Ta Fo (spicy noodle soup), and it was delicious. The atmosphere in the restaurant was nice and the air conditioning was comfortably cool.
sample_reviews_en.author: ศิริรัตน์ ไตรยราช

restaurants.name: Swensen's Central Pattaya Beach
restaurants.address:

เลขห้อง 638-639 ชั้น 6 ต.หนองปรือ Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Swensen’s Ice Cream Restaurant – Central Festival Pattaya

Classic ice cream parlor with a wide selection and delicious coffee

⭐⭐⭐⭐☆

Swensen’s in the Central Festival Shopping Mall is a classic ice cream parlor where you can find all sorts of ice creams in every imaginable shape and flavor. For those who love a sweet treat, this is the perfect spot to take a break from shopping.

Besides the extensive ice cream selection, there's also a nice assortment of specialty coffees. I had a latte, which tasted great and paired well with my ice cream. For me, this is the perfect combination: ice cream and a delicious coffee.

It's not a luxury store, but simply a nice place with a good selection and decent quality. For a quick, sweet stop in Pattaya, Swensen’s in Central Festival is definitely recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bijna niveau 8.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I come here every Tuesday and get buy 1 get 1 free scoops. You have to have the member card which is 299. But then you also get 10% off every time. They always give the young ones crayons and its a good time.

They have cakes also, they sell them by the pound which is random and odd. Speaking of odd they always have a weird flavor of the month, it seems to switch between mango and durian. They serve it with sticky rice which is actually pretty good with ice cream and you're eating pure sugar anyways so what the heck lets go for it fam.

Atmosphere is loud and full of kids. Staff is friendly and always starts you off with free water. Ice cream makes you thirsty for some reason.

So why 5 stars? The ice cream is tasty and cold and what more can you ask of ice cream.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kristopher Schoonnmaker

sample_reviews_en.text: This ice cream is, without a doubt, the most delectable and satisfying ice cream I have ever had the pleasure of indulging in throughout my entire life. This was my second visit to Thailand, and I made certain not to waste a single day during my stay. Each day, I would make it a point to visit this establishment twice in order to savor the exquisite ice cream that they offer. I sincerely hope that one day, a branch of this establishment will open in my home country so that others may also have the opportunity to experience this extraordinary ice cream.
sample_reviews_en.author: Faisal Khan

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff had absolutely no customer service experience. It was like they hired people with no service experience. They took orders over other customers' heads, and customers had to take responsibility for duplicate orders. They couldn't answer any questions, just put the menu down and walked away. When asked, they seemed confused, as if they hadn't read the menu or done any research. They handled the food roughly, almost dropping the ice cream – completely unprofessional. Terrible service. One visit is enough. The taste was mediocre too.
sample_reviews_en.author: TANWARAT JANMANEE

sample_reviews_en.text:
Swensen's ice cream has improved a lot over time, and I can say they're really good now. There's a wide selection of flavors and many different bowls available on the extensive menu, complete with photos and listings of all the flavors and toppings used.
You can sign up for a loyalty card, which costs a small initial fee but guarantees discounts and special offers at all Swensen's stores in Thailand. So, by going for ice cream at least two or three times, the loyalty card fee is absorbed, and you'll start to save a bit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Giuliana Di Palma

sample_reviews_en.text: Swensen's is an international chain of ice cream parlors and restaurants, founded in San Francisco in 1948. This cafe has a long history. The selection of ice cream and desserts is vast. The cafe is popular, as every table was full, and we had to wait. The prices are a bit high. The ice cream is good, but I didn't like the brownie. Complimentary water is offered, and the waiters politely refill your glass as needed. Overall, I liked the cafe. The coffee is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Надежда Каменская

sample_reviews_en.text: The service staff is terrible. Every time I come here and ask for balloons, the staff always say "OK" but never get them. When I asked a second time, the staff made a face of innocence. I was really confused. My child cried just because he wanted balloons. If he didn't want to give them, he should have said something. He shouldn't have just responded with a foul mouth. I come to Central every week and really don't want to come eat at this branch again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tnnoon 25

sample_reviews_en.text:
Grumpy waitress that had way too much work. After a long waiting time we just went away without service. But we did get the free water and that was ok.
There was even no time for the staff to clean the tables.
Very narrow seatsin some places made for asians under 12.
Everything in pink....   awful.
Worst swensen shop I ever saw in Thailand. Usually swensen is a 10. This one was a 0 at the moment of my visit. Avoid this one.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ignace Heymans

restaurants.name: Rendezvous Lounge
restaurants.address:

The Landmark Hotel 138 Sukhumvit Rd, แขวง พระโขนงเหนือ, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Unlike many visitors to Rendezvous Lounge, I happen to live in Bangkok. Most folks likely stay in the Landmark Hotel where Rendezvous is located and experience the lounge for maybe a
week or two while visiting Bangkok. I’ve lived here for 13 years and initially came as a tourist before that. I presently visit Rendezvous many times during the week and at all hours. Unequivocally, I can say this lounge rates high with attractive, knowledgeable female servers and they greet each visitor with a warm welcome upon entering. Their drink selection is great, expansive and affordable. Not a drinker? You can order mocktails, sodas or different coffees or teas… and let’s not forget the food menu. It’s a comfortable place to hang out with friends or simply passing the day working on your laptop computer. Come in and experience the ambience of Rendezvous. The lounge is located just to the side of the hotel lobby.
sample_reviews_en.author: Randall Howlett

sample_reviews_en.text:
While the ambiance and drinks here are great, the service really is not welcoming. No smiles or positive acknowledgment when ordering. In addition, the waiter here took 15+ minutes to bring back my change and acted like she was doing me a favor with a scowl across her face. Maybe she thought I would forget?

Said goodbye when leaving - no acknowledgment again and got a back turned to me. I left a tip, now I regret doing so.

This is the second time I’ve encountered issues with the service at The Landmark Hotel’s restaurants - first at the Rib Room, now here. The front desk, concierge, and the housekeeping are excellent, but their restaurant staff just is not up to scratch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Troy Ronalds

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was visit on cocktail night on Thursday. Chill ambient to sip cocktails, listening music and conversation with companies. Foods and drinks are fine quality. Staffs are welcome and friendly

Cocktails night on Thursday info (2019)
890 baht ++/person with unlimited cocktails, mocktails, some softdrink on menu. Tapas and snacks always fill on table all night. Foods on menu are not included but not expensive. Friday night also have wine tasting by country. Also 890++ baht /person

PS. Duo who sing and play on stage are talent. That lovely lady make me goosebumps on Adele 'Skyfall' and a man can sing some Phil Collins songs very good 👍(another day in paradise)
sample_reviews_en.author: Bennie P.

sample_reviews_en.text: I went for the wine tasting on Friday.  It was just me.  But Tookta took charge, "we weren't expecting you but here is the wine tasting list, do you want to do a wine tasting".  2 mins later (still before the event was to start). All the wine were grouped.  They a personal cold cut tray arrived, then a bread plate, to go with the olives and nuts. The service was so great, as my glass was near to empty there was a new wine suggested.  The red wines were set up on the bar.  Best service ever.  Tookta even chatted to me while making some really good looking cocktails
sample_reviews_en.author: Leigh Taylor

sample_reviews_en.text: Whether you are staying at the Landmark Hotel (Bangkok) or not, the Rendezvous Lounge is somewhere you should stop in for a coffee, bite to eat or a refreshing drink. The coffee is the best in Bangkok, the range of of wines and amazing cocktails cater for every taste. You can also order an extensive range of cuisines from the menu.
