This is all good, but the beauty of the Rendezvous Lounge is the service, which is best in class and the staff such as Sudarat, will always welcome you with a smile and the hospitality make you feel welcomed and always coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Craig Blinco

sample_reviews_en.text: First time stay at Landmark hotel in bkk -from security to doormen to check in staff to house keeping to pool staff very friendly and helpful -popped in to the rendezvous lounge for a cocktail and was met by the  super  friendly Khun Sudarat who has been at this hotel for a few years and is amazing -she mixed a very tasty Bloody Mary -Khun Sudarat keeps up great conversation and is very knowledgeable about the hotel service having studied hotel management in university -I wish Khun Sudarat well and hope she continues with her splendid job
sample_reviews_en.author: Rob Doc

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited the cafe and lounge room on the first floor of the Landmark Hotel.
It's located immediately to the left after entering the hotel entrance, making it easy to find.
The interior had a luxurious feel and was a very comfortable space. This time I had afternoon tea, which had a very cute design inspired by Japan 🌸
The afternoon tea menu changes regularly, so it seems like you can enjoy it even if you visit multiple times.
Also, they have days when you can enjoy free-flowing alcohol, so I would definitely like to try that next time 🍷✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Bua in Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dave's "Free flow" verdict.

Every friday from 18.00 till 21.00 The Landmark Hotel offers a Wine Tasting event in the lobby bar "Rendezvous". Every week a different region is highlighted. You are welcomed with a glass (or more if you want) of sparkling wine and complementary tapas are offered. A live combo band takes care of the music at moderate volume levels. The price of the wine tasting is 890++/person.

My verdict:
Wines 8/10
Food 4/10
Bottle service 9/10
Ambiance 7/10
Music 7/10
Value for money 7/10
sample_reviews_en.author: Dave

restaurants.name: Old Lee's Smokehouse Bangkok
restaurants.address:

PMW9+7FF, Krungthep Kreetha Rd, Thap Chang, Saphan Sung, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't want to say bad about the food because it was nice when it came. The issue was the availability of food in the menu in the day. As it is a smoke house and meats can take 8-12 hrs to cook, once they are out of that food, that's it for the day. So the menu choice can be limited. There was a error on the menu also with the pricing of food items that had not been amended and the change was not then compensated to what the menu stated for that meat piece. Luckily I was having other foods along side so I was full after anyway. The venue is nice. Lots of seating and a games roommand drinking bar next door attached. Screens to view sport and a good bar layout. Staff were available but there was only 2 other tables in at the time. It is worth going as the smoker it's self is impressive to see. Worth calling up and asking what's available on the day before going though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Curtis Gardner

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely loved our experience at Old Lee’s Smoke House! 🇺🇸🔥

We were impressed from the very first bite — the quality of the meat, the flavors, and especially the authentic smoking process using real wood and their professional smoker. You can really taste the craftsmanship behind every dish. It genuinely gave us that true American BBQ experience.

The atmosphere was great, but what really made our visit special was the staff. The hospitality was absolutely 5-star! ⭐️ They were incredibly welcoming, , friendly yet knowledgeable, and gave us excellent recommendations, which made the whole experience even better.

Everything was so well done, and we honestly left very impressed. Definitely a place we’ll be coming back to again! ❤️

Highly recommended for anyone looking for authentic American-style BBQ! 🍖🔥
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyaporn Lim

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great steakhouse with a selection of both beef and pork steaks, great choice for meat lovers.

The pork ribs, and they were delicious—tender, flavorful, and well-seasoned. We also order mac n cheese was absolutely delicious, and the creamy mashed potatoes were incredibly smooth and velvety. The Longan smoked pulled pork and caesar salad were good and met the usual expectations.

One of the highlights is the unlimited refillable side dishes.

The only downside is that parking can be quite difficult to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: happytummy

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was excellent! The waiters were really nice. Especially Marvin and Shyla. Service was phenomenal with amazing music atmosphere. There was darts, mini football, and even a pool table! The food was excellent. The beef cheek was full of flavour and the brisket tasted exquisite. The smell was so good, it smelt like a true authentic Texan barbeque place. Every surface was also nice and clean! 20/5 stars would come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: CraftNes

sample_reviews_en.text:
The smoked beef here is tender, delicious, and melts in your mouth 💛
The restaurant atmosphere is quite nice and not crowded 🧡
The staff are friendly and provide excellent service 🧡💛
If you're looking for a great steak restaurant 🥩🍖 with delicious food and good service, I highly recommend this place 👍💙💛
I ate here and paid for it myself, I'm not a paid reviewer or anything 💜🩷 🇹🇭
sample_reviews_en.author: ดวงใจ แจ่มศรี

sample_reviews_en.text: Fantastic food and great atmosphere! Everything we ordered was super tasty and exceeded our expectations. Marvin took great care of us and was incredibly helpful and friendly. His excellent service made the experience even better. If you're in Bangkok and craving great BBQ, this place is a must-visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: johan schot

sample_reviews_en.text: Smoke - no knife needed, you can eat with your hands, it's amazing! Great service, great food, great beer. You really get what a good restaurant should be like. Thanks, Mawin, for taking such good care of us. There were also activities for the kids to enjoy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Art Tanawat

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best Bbqs ive had so far. I definetly recomend the Burgers but it doesn’t really matter what you pick everything is lovely. The service was wonderful as well Marvin and Shiyla did a great job.
sample_reviews_en.author: Milan Held

restaurants.name: Mind de Pasta
restaurants.address:

1077/2 ชั้นที 1, Phahonyothin Rd, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mind de Pasta: A Truly Hidden Gem

This small restaurant is an absolute treasure. Every dish we tried was exceptional, and the flavors were outstanding. We visited with a group of six and sampled more than ten different dishes, all of which were fantastic. Our favorite was the prawn bisque – it was simply divine. The ingredients are of the highest quality, and the service is top-notch. The chef clearly knows how to craft exceptional dishes with great skill and care. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nalinee Ninsri

sample_reviews_en.text:
This places is truly delicious! It is a hidden gem, if we weren’t recommended to come to this place by a friend we wouldn’t have found it at all. Located on the bottom floor of a condominium.

The food was wonderful and flavors are elegant. Both flavors dancing on your taste buds but the presentation of the food.

The atmosphere is very chilling and you are in your own space.

I would recommend this place for a wonderful date or with friends. Come and enjoy!
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrew Sripimonwan

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious. The spaghetti was perfectly cooked, the cream sauce was flavorful, the grilled prawns were sweet and juicy, the steak was tender, the sauce was tasty, the mashed potatoes were creamy, and the roasted garlic complemented it perfectly. The cheese board had an excellent selection. I loved everything. The service was superb. The chef even gave us a complimentary birthday cake, and it was amazing. I was impressed with everything.
sample_reviews_en.author: aom lertchaiudomchok

sample_reviews_en.text:
The very best Italian cuisine I have been to as far as I can remember!

Well hidden gem away from downtown Bangkok in the Phaya Thai community!

Small shop with only 9 tables

Very young (and shy) Thai chef Serving staff are warm and gentle

I was told that Bangkok is famous for it's Italian cuisine ... It's more than true for Mind de Pasta

Molto delizioso! Bravo!
sample_reviews_en.author: Joseph Koc

sample_reviews_en.text: Omg pls you have to order the vongole white wine. It’s the only dish that we forgot to take a picture. And the ribeye, as a meat lover, one of the best we’ve ever eaten. We got tiramisu as a gift for their anniversary (?) not sure , not so sweet, very good dessert after the heavy meal. Oh and burrata, we were so lucky to get their last one of the day. It was 🤌🤌
sample_reviews_en.author: Pannita Thungtong

sample_reviews_en.text: Restaurant serves upscale food with quality ingredients but in a comfortable atmosphere. We walked in with certain expectations because all the reviews kept mentioning that it was a hidden gem (the sign is quite visible from the street actually), but we were blown out of the water by the pasta. The taste is great and well worth the higher price tag!
sample_reviews_en.author: ariel goh

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food at Mind de Pasta was incredible! My absolute favorite was the smoked duck pasta so flavorful and perfectly cooked. I also tried the prawn bisque; it had a rich taste, but was a bit too creamy for my liking.

Overall, a great dining experience with quality dishes. Will definitely be back to try more!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mo Rith

sample_reviews_en.text: We dined on Valentines evening and it was excellent! The table setting was impeccable! The Caesar salad was fresh and delicious!. We had the spicy beef noodles and mushroom spinach noodles. Chef Mind out did herself as the food was off the charts delicious! We highly recommend this under rated little gem!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dianna Erickson

restaurants.name: ร้านข้าวผัดปูเจ้าสมุทร
restaurants.address:

54 117 Thanon Bang Phrom, Bang Phrom, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, affordable, and chill atmosphere.

The crab fried rice is dry, fragrant, and delicious.
The tom yum soup is rich and flavorful with plenty of shrimp.
The stir-fried mushrooms with oyster sauce are savory.
The fried sea bass with tamarind sauce is very delicious.
The lotus stem salad with fresh shrimp and fermented fish sauce is very flavorful.

The food is served in sets, which is affordable and good value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Molly Lymol

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious. The fish and crab are fresh. The Tom Yum soup and dipping sauce are amazing.
The prices are reasonable, and the portions are generous.
They also have set menus for 2-3 people.
The staff are lovely, polite, and provide excellent service.
There's no parking lot, but you can park on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wan T

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. The crab fried rice was 60 baht and enough for two people. The tom yum soup was flavorful, and the shrimp in fish sauce wasn't fishy. The prices were considered cheap. Parking is available along the roadside. The atmosphere was pleasant.
sample_reviews_en.author: โชติพัฒน์ เกื้อกูลกาญจนา

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good crab fried rice and crab meat rolls, for the inexpensive price. The rolls were quite heavily seasoned, especially with garlic. It was good though not your typical Chinese style crab rolls.

No parking, need to park on the road or nearby Caltex gas station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gunn Vanichbuncha

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered a set meal for three people: two adults and one child. The taste was average, but edible. The seafood dipping sauce was delicious. The tom yum goong (spicy shrimp soup) was a little too sour. Overall, it was acceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yokko Chill

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time trying crab fried rice at this restaurant, and it was incredibly delicious! The price was reasonable, and it was full of crab meat. It's the best crab fried rice I've ever had!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattphong Juibang

sample_reviews_en.text: They offer set meals, which is convenient. The owner provides excellent service, always smiling and cheerful. The shop has a simple, unpretentious atmosphere, and the food is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naphatsawan Thanasarnsporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The crab fried rice was delicious, the crab spring rolls were good, the oysters were fresh, and the spicy crab salad was flavorful.

The seafood was reasonably priced, not expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nopporn M

restaurants.name: Crave restaurant
restaurants.address:

35 ซอย สุขุมวิท 11 Klongtoey nua, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Aloft Bangkok – Crave Restaurant Seafood Dinner Buffet 🦐🦪

So many options, especially if you love seafood! Everything tasted fresh, with a great selection of seafood, meats, fresh salads, and many different international and Thai dishes.

The seafood selection was definitely the highlight, but there was plenty of choice even if you’re not a big seafood fan. The overall quality was really good, and for the price, I think it’s excellent value.

You still get that Marriott quality without paying the prices you’d expect at some of the more expensive hotel buffets in Bangkok.

Fresh food, lots of variety, good quality, and a great price. Highly recommended! 👍

The seafood dinner buffet is currently offered Friday and Saturday evenings at Crave Restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Min Jeong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Spent 3D2N at Aloft Bangkok Sukhumvit 11 for work, and had the pleasure of experiencing their Seafood Live Market Buffet — and I was truly blown away by the incredible variety of fresh seafood and cuisine selections available. It was a modern and refreshing celebration of Thai flavours, spices, and culinary creativity.

What stood out even more was the exceptional Marriott hospitality throughout the evening. A special thanks to K. Sanack and K. Tisha, who took care of us during our entire 3-hour dining experience. They were attentive, warm, and incredibly helpful from start to finish, making the whole experience even more memorable.

Amazing food, wonderful service, and a great dining atmosphere overall. Definitely an experience worth coming back for.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maisarah Ismail

sample_reviews_en.text:
Looking for a standout buffet dinner in central Bangkok? I highly recommend this scenic restaurant with mesmerising city night views through full‑height windows.
Led by Executive Chef KHAOFANH CHERRY KHEM, every dish on the buffet line shows remarkable cooking skill. Fresh seafood, tender steak and premium roast beef are brilliantly executed, rich in flavour and perfectly seasoned. The elaborate dessert station provides a lovely sweet finish after savoury courses.
As a food critic, I truly appreciate the thoughtful menu planning and consistent quality. Gorgeous urban scenery paired with satisfying gourmet dishes makes for an unforgettable night. Without hesitation, I give this restaurant my strongest recommendation.
sample_reviews_en.author: 陳凱特

sample_reviews_en.text: This buffet at Aloft Hotel in Sukhumvit 11 (Soi Nana) is absolutely fantastic! Aloft is a really chic and cool hotel, and the restaurant is beautiful. As soon as you walk in, you're welcomed by friendly staff and an impressive spread of food—including grill stations, Thai dishes, spaghetti, noodles, and delicious desserts.  It was my first visit, and I was thoroughly impressed. I’m definitely coming back! Parking is good as well. The only downside is that the hotel is located a bit deep inside the alley, and it’s only available on Friday and Saturday. Definitely worth checking out
sample_reviews_en.author: TiKoh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Khun Tisha was absolutely amazing! She took exceptional care of us from the moment we arrived until we left, making sure everything was perfect. Her friendly attitude and attentive service made our dining experience even more enjoyable.

The food was delicious, especially the fresh salmon, and there was a generous selection throughout the meal. Everything was well prepared and beautifully presented.

A big thank you to Khun Tisha for her outstanding hospitality. We had a fantastic experience and will definitely be coming back. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Praveen AP

sample_reviews_en.text: A must‑visit premium scenic restaurant in Bangkok with breathtaking city night views and unbeatable ambiance. The full buffet menu is carefully crafted by Head Chef KHEM, featuring fresh seafood, global hot dishes and exquisite desserts. Its signature mixed shaved ice delivers stunning layers of flavour. Dine amid glittering city lights for a feast for both your eyes and palate. Do not miss this wonderful experience on your Bangkok trip.   7 / 18 JASON CHECK.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason Check

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was excellent, and the indoor dining atmosphere was superb. The waitress, TISHA, was incredibly attentive; besides plating our food for photos, she thoughtfully placed an ambient light on the table, creating a truly dreamy ambiance!

I'm so glad I was able to dine here during this precious holiday!

I'll definitely come back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: 周建華

sample_reviews_en.text: The view was absolutely stunning, especially the night view, which was incredibly soothing. The entire restaurant had a wonderful atmosphere. Special thanks to TUES and TISHA for their attentive and thoughtful service; their friendly and gentle attitude, coupled with the delicious food, made for a truly perfect dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Google用戶

restaurants.name: BBC : Big Black Cat -Kushiyaki 串焼き-
restaurants.address:

209 Chakkraphatdi Phong Rd, Wat Sommanat, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Finding the restaurant on the 3th floor was a bit of a challenge, but the experience that awaited me was worth the search.

With a rating of 8.5 out of 10

Modern establishment japanese iskaya and restaurant. The grilled cos salad, complemented by zesty orange and crispy, slightly salty bacon, was a delightfuL. The grilled pork belly, which had been slow-cooked for 22 hours, was tender and flavorful. However, the portion size left a bit to be desired, especially given the price.

I was fortunate to dine when the restaurant was quiet, which meant the service was attentive and personalized. The ambiance was further enhanced by the soft strumming of a live guitar. I heard they even have a DJ on some nights, though I didn't get to experience that vibe.

For those with a penchant for spirits, the restaurant boasts an extensive liquor menu, offering both cocktails and bottled options.

In essence, this hidden gem on the 4th floor promises an japanese dinner, accompanied by soothing live music, making it a must-visit for those in search of a unique dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: ThonG Thitipol

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍷🍸🍹
It's a nice place to grab a bite before going to another bar nearby. It's located on the 4th floor of the building.

When you arrive at the front door you might think the bar is probably closed or if you come to the right place because on the first floor is empty apart from old stuffs. Just get inside and go up to the 4th floor. Then you will see the bar.

🥘🍲🍜🍔
The food is really nice, but the portion is too small if compare with the price. I think it's normal for this kind of place like Japanese Izakaya style. They have some normal beers(like you know 😆), some craft beers and cocktails.

Great service, staffs are nice and friendly.

The atmosphere is fine. They have live music and it might be quite loud to have the conversation, but overall is fine.

🚗🚕🚎
For the parking, you can park along the street after 8 pm.
sample_reviews_en.author: Persephone1531

sample_reviews_en.text: This hidden rooftop bar and restaurant offers delicious food perfect for drinkers, with a great value all-you-can-drink buffet to complement your meal. The prices are on the higher side for a bar with food, but the food is surprisingly delicious – so much so that we ordered more! Recommended dishes include the flame-seared mackerel with soy sauce and wasabi dipping sauce, and the spicy salmon larb (spicy minced salmon salad) as appetizers. For main courses, try the beef tongue fried rice and truffle mushroom spaghetti. The view from the rooftop is amazing, with a beautiful sunset over Wat Saket (Temple of the Emerald Buddha). It's perfect for a family meal, a date, or a night out with friends. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasin Keatparitus

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem in the heart of the old city, this izakaya is a rooftop bar on the 4th floor with an amazing atmosphere.
The restaurant offers both an indoor vintage-style area and open-air seating with stunning Bangkok views.
They have a diverse menu featuring unique homemade Japanese fusion dishes.
Plus, they have over 20 varieties of 'kushiyaki,' Japanese-style grilled skewers.
If you enjoy a relaxed dining experience with a great atmosphere, you should definitely try this place.
Open Thursday-Sunday, 5 PM - 12 AM.
Located opposite the Lan Luang Post Office, at Big Black Cat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prince Kishiro (KIRA)

sample_reviews_en.text:
A place that I list in “can-go-again”❤️
So much in love with cold somen, the food is Japanese-Italian fusion style with a lovely vibe of traditional bkk building on the way. Creativity is hidden in each dish, I would recommend this place for anyone for a date and chill night with pals. Each bite could bring so much more conversation.

On-the-rock Fermented plum liquor is a top notch for me, not too strong with a well balanced of sweetness, salty and sour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimpitcha Sankanit

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the chance to go see ABOY perform. The atmosphere was great, the staff were friendly, and the owner was so welcoming and even remembered the staff's names – so sweet! Just like they said, I got to meet the artists up close and personal, without any filters – you could even see their pores! Haha. I was very impressed. The food was delicious – a perfect 10/10!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sudarut Suwannapum

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is amazing! The food is delicious; I recommend the pickled mackerel with lime. Other izakaya dishes are also tasty. The beer is smooth and easy to drink. The only downside might be limited parking, but overall it's great. Perfect for enjoying a beer in a relaxed atmosphere and watching the sunset.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pare Parepun

sample_reviews_en.text: Tried the grilled dishes and fries, most were okay and so was the drink. The atmosphere however was relaxed and peaceful before sunset. The only complaint was the staff being overattentive to the empty dishes and would rush to take them all the time made me feel pressured and rushed to leave.
sample_reviews_en.author: A Lin

restaurants.name: ร้าน 9 กุ้งอบ ปูอบ-สุกี้ สาขา เซ็นทรัลเวิลด์ | 告共哦，不哦 | 9 Koongaob Seafood
restaurants.address:

4, 4/1-4/2, 4 4 Rajdamri Rd Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fresh seafood, large prawns and crabs, rich and delicious flavors that will make you say "Wow!"
🔸️Large Crab Fried Rice 259.- The rice is wonderfully fragrant and the grains are beautifully separated. They're very generous with the crab meat.
🔸️Stir-fried Cabbage with Fish Sauce 119.- Fragrant and crispy, the vegetables are fresh and the saltiness is just right. It's topped with crispy fried dried shrimp, a perfect combination.
🔸️Tom Yum Goong (River Prawn Soup) 599.- This is the highlight of the day! The prawns are giant, weighing 250-300 grams each. The meat is fresh, bouncy, and incredibly juicy. It's delicious poured over rice. The tom yum soup is flavorful and well-balanced, not too spicy or sour.
🔸️Baked Glass Noodles with Prawns 159.- The noodles are soft and chewy, perfectly seasoned. It's excellent with the seafood dipping sauce.
🔸️Crab Meat Omelette Condo 499.- Packed with chunks of crab meat. Every spoonful is full of crab meat!
🔸️Stir-fried Crab with Curry Powder 499.- Generously loaded with crab meat, a truly satisfying bite. The flavor is mildly spicy, perfect for children!
sample_reviews_en.author: 2madames เที่ยวแบบครอบครัว

sample_reviews_en.text:
The place might look empty, but the food was great and filling for me, also the ingredients were fresh.

I had an omelette with crab meat and rice, while I think most people have the curry crab rice. I learned this after checking the reviews here on Google Maps. However, I was hungry and ordered what I desired, which indeed led me to feel satisfied with this meal, not to mention the extra fresh coconut.

The staff were friendly and polite, and when one of the waiters failed to notice my attention, the chef in the kitchen was helpful and sharp in his surroundings, thus he was able to direct the waitress back to me. I could see that the chef had a passion for cooking and serving customers the dish prepared in the tastiest and best way possible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gabriel lzx

sample_reviews_en.text:
New branch at CentralWorld, 1st floor, Hugthai zone 🇹🇭 My recommended dish is the "Marinated Crab with Roe." The roe is abundant and the marinade is flavorful and well-balanced. Add a little seafood dipping sauce and it's incredibly delicious!

Other equally delicious dishes include:
〰️ Stir-fried Crab Meat with Curry Powder
〰️ Crab Meat Fried Rice
〰️ Tom Yum Goong (Spicy Shrimp Soup)
〰️ Fried Sea Bass with Fish Sauce
〰️ Steamed Crab with Glass Noodles
I love that the prices are reasonable, the taste is great, and the ingredients are incredibly fresh. They offer both single dishes and main courses. Importantly,
#This restaurant doesn't use MSG! Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ich reise gerne

sample_reviews_en.text: It's like having a whole crab farm right here at CTW, on the G floor. The ingredients are fresh and clean, prepared in a small kitchen, but the food comes out quickly and efficiently. The crab menu looks very interesting, from marinated crab and glass noodle casserole to stir-fried crab meat with curry powder, and the shrimp is plump and delicious. The flavors are well-balanced, not overly spicy, allowing customers to fully appreciate the freshness of the seafood. The prices are very reasonable; fresh seafood in a shopping mall at this price is definitely worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Torpong Chiamtawongse

sample_reviews_en.text:
✅ Curry crab meat is the best
✅ The store is at the west entrance, after u get in, walk to the left hand side and you’ll find it.

This restaurant will be my secret one.🥹The customers won’t be too much but there should be! Because it’s sooooo yummy.

499 THB you can have the curry crab meat and the fried rice. The portion is good for 2 people.

Even you only eat the fried rice without other dish, it’s also the top fried rice in my heart🥹

I definitely will come back again and recommend any of with my friends to come here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yi-Sin Hsieh

sample_reviews_en.text: My first day in Bangkok and I come across this place. I never regret my choice! The food is super delicious! I forgotten that I am in Bangkok and ohhh YES... it's authentic Thai food! The setting on the food is beautiful. The portion is big enough for sharing if you are not a big eater. The staff are friendly and helpful. I love the ambience even though it's just a small corner. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Din Neo

sample_reviews_en.text: Chanced upon this near our hotel back in June and it got me hooked onto this magical dish of curry crab throughout the trip. So darn good with a bowl of white rice! I’ve had a few curry crab throughout Bangkok and Phuket but nothing came close to this. Such a gem! Visually it looked amazing, flavour wise - the spice level was perfect and I loved the texture of the eggs. Please try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anita

sample_reviews_en.text: We came here because the restaurant next door was closed, and it turned out to be surprisingly delicious. The service, however, was just so-so. They didn't clear the plates after we finished eating; they only started clearing the table when it was completely full. But the food was definitely good.
sample_reviews_en.author: 萬萬萬

restaurants.name: Green Chilly - Authentic Indian Food
restaurants.address:

363, 5 Moo 10, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A wonderful Indian cafe! We highly recommend it to all Indian lovers! I researched many Indian cafes in Pattaya, and some were either too expensive or the cuisine was weak. This place offers excellent value for money. Everything is prepared perfectly (don't forget the no-spicy option), and the portions are large. The selection is extensive; I think the entire cuisine is represented. For 900 baht, we were so full for two that we barely finished it! The hostess was also very helpful and gave good advice on what to order. The cuisine is also predominantly Indian, so this place is 100% authentic. The real deal.

Enjoy your stay, friends!
sample_reviews_en.author: Павел Немчинов

sample_reviews_en.text:
If any Indan restaurant, is near perfection, its the Green Chilly restaurant. It feels this place is serving the authentic Indian recipes as they were intended. No spice or ingredient left out. The full complete flavor package, where nothing tastes off or out of place.

If you want an extraordinary food experience, try the Dahi Papdi Chaat.  You can see my two masala milktea’s in the background. They are so good that one is imply not enough.

This place does not enforce idiotic breakfast curfew also. Their breakfast pancakes taste good any time of the day!
sample_reviews_en.author: InfiniteWorld

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Indian flavour and atmosphere abroad!!!
Service: The owner and staff are very friendly, warm and inviting. They also give a guidance about tour…
Food: The food gives a home made style taste. The spices were well balanced and the flavour reminded me of Indian.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kunzang Dolma

sample_reviews_en.text: Unfortunately, the food quality isn't great. I had to throw away more than half the chicken because it was raw! They have a QR code on the table encouraging people to leave good ratings on Google Maps, but in reality, the food quality is average.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piotr Czerwiński

sample_reviews_en.text: since from last seven days continuously eating delicious food on this restaurant, and quality of food and services are upto the mark, i suggest every one should once try this place for good tasty indian food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukhdev Singh

sample_reviews_en.text: I recently visited pataya Thiland I found a restaurant namely Green Chilly I am really eager to Share my impression regarding delicious food & brilliant service thanks The team of Restaurant Green Chlliy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rigzin Chosphel

sample_reviews_en.text: Google Maps didn't lie, it's really delicious! I recommend Dosa naan and curry chicken, they're amazing! And not expensive at all, three of us ate for only 950 baht. Everyone should go try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: si xuan xu

sample_reviews_en.text: Pathetic food. Wasted 500baht. Soup was 1st time burnt, second time just hot water. Manchurian gravy was very bad in taste, noodles were average. Not recommended at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akshat Sharma

restaurants.name: Mom's Restaurant & Guesthouse
restaurants.address:

218/3 Soi 18, Phaya Thai, Khet Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I popped in here as it was close to my hotel, one afternoon.
This was the first non-Thai food I'd eaten since I arrived three weeks previously and I was delighted.
The menu was extensive and I was able to peruse it it whilst a bottle of cold water was brought to my table.
I was informed that it would take about 20 minutes for my food to be prepared from fresh which was good to hear.
On arrival, the keema samosas made a delicious starter, crispy pastry encasing lightly spiced minced lamb, accompanied by a chilli chutney. The chicken massala was cooked perfectly and tasted excellent with the plain steamed rice and butter roti, although I wish I'd ordered two! I had also ordered a Bangla dal which was very tasty.
If you're in the area and want to try delicious food then I'd highly recommend 😊.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gary Longdon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really nice Indian restaurant. We had the dhal Makhani, and the Chana Masala, vegetable samosas, rice and paratha bread. It was delicious! Service was quick and friendly. Food was a great size. It was extremely filling. The menu has a lot of choice, and they have a lovely spicy chutney they bring over as well!!!

The only bad thing I could say is that the paratha bread tasted more like a pastry than bread, my partner really enjoyed it but I wasn’t the biggest fan.
sample_reviews_en.author: Briony Collings

sample_reviews_en.text:
recently dined at Mom's Restaurant, and it was an amazing experience from start to finish! The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, with a beautiful interior that made me feel relaxed right away.

The food was absolutely delicious — every dish was fresh, perfectly seasoned, and beautifully presented. I especially loved the [mention favorite dish, Alu paratha and prawn biriani. The service was outstanding too — the staff were friendly, attentive, and always smiling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Md. Faridul Islam James

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner, an elderly gentleman, is very kind and gave great recommendations for dishes for those who have never tried them before. All the food was delicious, the service was excellent, the food was freshly prepared and served quickly, and the prices were very reasonable. It was a wonderful Indian dining experience. I highly recommend it! (Pani puri, butter chicken, lessi, and Indian tea are also recommended) Absolutely delicious! I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: AAUN

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and great value for money! The flavors were very easy to eat. I highly recommend everyone try it. The owner, an elderly gentleman, is very kind. I hope more people will support him/her 🥺 We ordered a full table of food and it only cost a little over 200 baht per person. Great price, large portions, and the restaurant is very clean with no unpleasant smells. I will definitely go again! 👍🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: adorablejemeow

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered through Grab and this restaurant really screws customer with low quantity because it's delivery. Grab doesn't want to take responsibility for food quantity and the restaurant gets away with it.
I ordered 2 dishes and both were just a quarter of the container. If you are going to give such low quantities, I recommend you change the size of the container so that it doesn't look so obvious.
sample_reviews_en.author: KAL JAGADISAN

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a very pathetic experience in this restaurant today. First of all the food was extremely oily, I had used 6-7 tissues to soak omelette oil. Stuffed Paratha was very bad no filing and maida mixed 80%. Images can show white parathas. The staff was very blunt when I addressed its oily. The owner was also very rude. Very bad experience and bad food. Card machine also not working.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lovey Singhal

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem amidst a busy road of Bangkok. Best part is they don't have ready-made food. Every order is freshly made in the kitchen.  A place clearly preferable for homemade style Bangladeshi food. Indian and Burmese foods are also available.

This restaurant is actually in Pratipad road area for almost 20 years.

Don't miss their masala tea if you really like it "karak".
sample_reviews_en.author: Faisal Anwar Patrick

restaurants.name: Yupin's Somtam (2nd Branch)
restaurants.address:

ซอย อรุณอมรินทร์ 22, Thanon Wang Lang 100/4 ถนน อรุณอมรินทร์ Siriraj, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is another popular Northeastern Thai restaurant in Wang Lang. It used to be tucked away in an alley, but now it's moved to the middle of the soi (alley), and the new location is air-conditioned and easy to find.

The menu features typical Northeastern Thai dishes, and the overall taste is good.
The various papaya salads are okay, but the "Tam Pa" (spicy papaya salad with pickled vegetables) has a strong pickled vegetable smell. Those unfamiliar with it might not like it (like me; I ordered it but couldn't handle the smell and couldn't eat a single bite! 555). However, the "Tam Sua" and "Tam Pla Ra" (spicy papaya salad with fermented fish sauce) are good.
The grilled pork neck is a bit fatty but delicious. The grilled chicken and grilled catfish are also decent.
The highlight is the fried corn. They give you a huge, satisfying portion, and the corn pops in your mouth – it's amazing!!! Don't miss it!

The prices are moderate. The owner is lovely and friendly.
The food doesn't take long to arrive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichsaran Ves

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices are a bit high compared to similar restaurants. The taste is okay. The fried papaya salad takes a while to prepare, but it's delicious because it's freshly fried. The worst part is that the restaurant is cramped and they have a child (probably the owner's grandchild) running around and making a lot of noise. They're climbing on things and causing chaos. At first, I thought it was tolerable, but it became unbearable. The noise was constant while we were eating. We had to finish our meal quickly. It was very disruptive. If you want the feeling of having dinner at a friend's house while their child is running around, you might be able to try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: NiYeol Wang

sample_reviews_en.text:
This somtum (papaya salad) restaurant makes truly delicious somtum; every dish is tasty. Other dishes are also great. I've been eating here regularly since my mom was a student.
The food is fresh and made daily.
Recommended dishes:
- Fried Somtum
- Spicy Pork Neck Salad
- Spicy Pork Rib Soup
- Grilled Chicken
- Grilled Intestines
- Northeastern Thai Sausage

The larb and yam (spicy salads) are also delicious.
If I'm craving somtum, this is the only place to go.
The prices are reasonable. The restaurant has plenty of seating, air conditioning, and fans.
The owner and staff are all very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: GraceisGrace

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was so delicious! Yuppin is beautiful, has great skin, and looks even younger than in the photos.
The grilled chicken was tender with crispy skin, delicious.
The papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce was good, medium spicy.
The minced pork salad was flavorful, perfectly balanced, and delicious.
What impressed me the most was the star fruit salad. It's unlike any other, the star fruit is fragrant and the taste is delicious, just the way I like it. The moment you put it in your mouth, the star fruit aroma is very strong. So delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Gib Gib

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious and cooked exactly as requested. The grilled pork neck was tasty and tender, and the dipping sauce with roasted rice powder was perfect. I asked for it without tamarind powder, and they were able to make it delicious. Many other Isaan restaurants I've been to, when I ask for the dipping sauce with roasted rice powder and no tamarind powder, they often don't make it fresh.
I don't like it because after eating it, I need to find a restroom immediately.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anucha Laertwan

sample_reviews_en.text: This somtum (papaya salad) restaurant is located in an alley that you can walk from the Siriraj Hospital side to Wang Lang Market. It has air-conditioned seating and offers a wide variety of delicious somtum. It's one of the best-tasting restaurants in the Wang Lang area, and the prices aren't too high. Their slogan is "The spiciest in the three worlds!" I also recommend their gaeng om (spicy curry), it's really flavorful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chan Non

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located in the alley next to FC shop in Wang Lang Market, near Siriraj Hospital. They serve good-tasting Northeastern Thai food. There are plenty of tables available, so you don't have to wait. The restaurant is air-conditioned, so you can relax and eat after walking around the hot market. The prices are reasonable, not too expensive. The food doesn't take long to prepare.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natsuki Takanori

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste wasn't amazing. The Thai papaya salad tasted like mango salad with crispy fish, and the fermented fish papaya salad wasn't very fragrant.

But the advantages are that it's air-conditioned, many Siriraj Hospital staff eat there, the service is good and fast, and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pathitta D.

restaurants.name: Tonmakok
restaurants.address:

342 Arun Amarin Rd, Siriraj, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tonmakok – A cozy Thai restaurant that makes you feel like home.

Tonmakok is a Thai restaurant with a simple concept, but the food is genuinely delicious without being overly fancy. From the moment you step in, you'll feel a warm and friendly atmosphere, perfect for family meals, gatherings with friends, or just a relaxing meal.

The highlight of the restaurant is the authentic Thai flavors – not too spicy, not too bland. The ingredients are fresh, and the cooking is consistently good, showing a focus on quality over flashy presentation. Most of the dishes are familiar Thai specialties, but prepared in a well-balanced, easy-to-eat way that appeals to all ages.

The atmosphere is comfortable, warm, and airy, ideal for long meals and pleasant conversations. For those who enjoy taking photos, the restaurant isn't a typical cafe, but it's clean, tidy, and offers classic, photogenic charm.

The service is excellent. The staff are attentive, helpful, and understanding, providing good menu recommendations without rushing or making you feel pressured. Overall, the experience is quite memorable.
sample_reviews_en.author: mong pcr

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in the same building as Baan Wanglang Hotel. You can park at Wat Rakhang and call the restaurant for a free shuttle (parking fee is 20 baht per hour).

Upon arrival, ask the staff for directions or walk into the hotel and go up to the second floor.

Actually, this building houses four restaurants with four different styles. On the ground floor is Tani and Cafe N10 (cafe closes at 8 PM). On the second floor is Ton Makok, and on the top floor is 342 Cafe.

Because it was raining when we visited, we didn't go to Tani, but to Ton Makok instead.

But we weren't disappointed at all! The staff were very attentive, the music was great, and importantly, they had a wide variety of Thai dishes, which we really enjoyed.

The Bai Liang (a type of Thai leafy vegetable) was very tender and flavorful. For those who don't like salty food, it might be a little salty.

The drink menu is also diverse and the prices are reasonable.

The restaurant closes at 4 PM, but if you don't want to leave yet, you can go down to Tani for more drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: JoyJoy

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re looking for something refined yet affordable — a place where luxury meets comfort — this is it.

With its beautiful ambience overlooking the majestic Chao Phraya River, every meal feels romantic and unhurried, as if time slows down just for you. Despite the elegant setting, there’s a warmth that makes you feel completely at home.

Bangkok truly never fails to surprise. And the service? Impeccable. The waitress who attended to us was the very definition of professionalism — attentive, gracious, and genuinely hospitable.

An experience we absolutely loved.
sample_reviews_en.author: Augustine Agam Nyawai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I loved the atmosphere; there was a constant breeze.
The food tasted good and the prices were reasonable.
Thanks to the staff member who secretly ordered a cake for us. We were planning to order some dessert, but the staff cut it before we even got it, leaving only the ice cream! Haha, so professional!
The parking at the Wat Rakhang building wasn't scary at all. Just call the restaurant when you arrive, and they'll send a golf cart to pick you up.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaaey Methaporn

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff provided excellent service. Everyone was smiling and ready to serve, especially Nadia. Another female staff member was very attentive. The atmosphere was inviting for a relaxing beer, but the music wasn't very good. The speakers were broken. Listening to it made me feel unrelaxed. It made the singer sound terrible. The music became a distraction.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peangpen Prutayanun

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent. A staff member named Nadia was very polite. Today I brought my grandmother to watch the fireworks, and the staff found a chair for her – I was so impressed! The food was delicious, and the atmosphere was perfect. I will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornpapat rodsaeng

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a beautiful view, the food is delicious and tastes great – authentic Thai cuisine. The staff provides excellent service; they are friendly, cheerful, and especially Nadia who took great care of us. It was a very memorable first night at the restaurant. 😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalisa Mundzic

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, right by the Chao Phraya River, and you can watch the fireworks during the New Year's Eve celebrations. The staff provides excellent service, inquiring about our needs and being very lovely. The food is average in taste. Overall, it's quite good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pitiporn Seeiam

restaurants.name: Login Karaoke & Restaurant ตอมjv213
restaurants.address:

13 37 Prasert-Manukit Rd, Khwaeng Nuanchan, Bueng Kum, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
You can get a nice karaoke room for a fairly cheap price. Food also not that much expensive.
Approximately 400baht per head.
PS. Charge 200baht to open a new bottle from outside.
Rooms will open 6pm and close exactly 12 midnight.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hasitha

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was served very slowly (fried pork knuckle ordered at 6:22 PM, received at 8:16 PM). The portion sizes were smaller than they should have been (Isaan sausage, fried chicken feet).
sample_reviews_en.author: Teelek Saetew

sample_reviews_en.text: The room was great. The food tasted good and the price was reasonable. They also had new music playing, which I personally liked. One room fits about 7-8 people, not too crowded.
sample_reviews_en.author: kiattipong laoraveerochana

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The atmosphere was gloomy.
- The room wasn't soundproof; some noise came through.
- The food was delicious 👍
- The staff provided good service.
- The restroom was clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nueng

sample_reviews_en.text: The karaoke songs were relatively new, but the computer was slow. We booked a large room; the price was reasonable. There were plenty of staff and the service was lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Olivia P.

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food, good service. They play old songs, new songs are a bit hard to find. Free room charge with a minimum food order.
sample_reviews_en.author: ning rattananugool

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is inexpensive, there's karaoke, and the service is good, but the rooms might smell a bit musty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jitsupa T

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted okay, the restaurant atmosphere was a bit quiet, and the staff provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: The End

restaurants.name: Shabu Tique
restaurants.address:

11, ตรงข้าม สาธุประดิษฐ์, ซอย 8 74 Sathu Pradit Rd, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a shabu-shabu restaurant that charges based on the ingredients you pick from the buffet, not by the plate. So, if you plan to eat a lot, you'll need to prepare to spend a bit more money, haha... The quality of the ingredients is good; they are fresh and clean. The dipping sauces are delicious. However, if you're driving to the restaurant, it's best to come after dark because you have to park on the street in front of the restaurant. If you park before dark, the police might tow your car (a 500 baht fine might end up costing more than your meal!), lol....
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyapong Pornvasan

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a shabu-shabu restaurant where you serve your food on a tray and then the waiter serves it.
Stir-fried vegetables, beef, and pork.
There's pork, chicken, liver, jellyfish, crispy squid, squid, and meatballs...about 15-18 items to choose from.

If the shabu-shabu restaurant is full, you can sit at the shop next door.

The sauce is a bit too sweet.

Overall, the taste and quality of the ingredients are worth the price.

There were 4 of us, and we spent about 700 baht.

The price is reasonable.

Parking is convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanapol Rianwatcharalert

sample_reviews_en.text: Shabu Tique is a Thai-style shabu-shabu restaurant where everything is weighed. All ingredients are calculated by weight. The broth is decent, up to standard. However, the ingredients are generally not very good… The vegetables weren't sweet, and the meat was just average. The fried dumplings were also just okay. Although the price is cheap, once is enough! ❌
sample_reviews_en.author: 小威（LP）

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, inexpensive, fresh meat, clean, clean vegetables, good ingredients, weighed by the kilo, just grab whatever you want to eat. The sauce is okay, usable. Parking is on the sidewalk, but you have to go when there are few cars. There are many seating areas, inside the shop and outside. Next to the shop, there is a steak shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr. ChaiYok

sample_reviews_en.text:
Taste is comparable to big players in the market. You pay what you eat by weight. Cozy feeling. Sliced chabu pork is a must try. Beyond my expectation. I will repeat.

Parking is available in the Chinese temple nearby on the other side of the road at 20THB per hr. I recommend you do so during rush hour to avoid ticket. Cheers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sivarat Praditkul

sample_reviews_en.text: The soup was delicious, the ingredients were very fresh, almost no dipping sauce needed. The price was reasonable, perfect for someone like me who doesn't usually get their money's worth at buffets – much cheaper than going to a buffet elsewhere. The owner was very attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sindy Curry

sample_reviews_en.text: Eat as much as you want, get fat... wait, no! You pay for what you eat; they charge by the weight of what you take. The soup is incredibly delicious, and the dipping sauces are amazing too. In short, it's filling, delicious, and not expensive! 😁 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Padcha Chatchirdchaikul

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork was excellent, the ingredients were fresh, the bacon was great, and the broth was delicious. It's a shabu-shabu place with high-quality ingredients, but I wish the dipping sauce was spicier; it was a bit too sweet. #TheOwnerIsHot 😆
sample_reviews_en.author: ธัชชาพรรณ มาเจริญ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The sauce was really tasty and I was looking forward to it, particularly given the rating.

Unfortunately the small pieces of chipped bone or plastic in the beef mince were a showstopper. The shape of the pieces was fairly regular, indicating something had gone into the mincing grinder that shouldn’t have.

I had first thought it was just gristle but after the third crunch against my teeth, I looked closer. Very disappointing.

Fries came out 5 minutes after burger. I waited and ate a few before the show stopped.

I paid for the Sprite.
sample_reviews_en.author: Josh Graham

sample_reviews_en.text:
For everyone in Thailand, especially Pattaya, this is the best burger experience I've had in all of Thailand. The restaurant is clean, the food is prepared right in front of you, and the owner is a very friendly and gentlemanly young Lebanese man. I highly recommend everyone try it.

The best burger restaurant I've tried in Thailand. The restaurant is clean, the food is prepared right in front of you, and the owner is a very friendly and hospitable young Lebanese man. And of course, the burgers are halal.
sample_reviews_en.author: m m

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Absolutely amazing experience at Burgrill Pattaya! 🍔🔥

The burgers were very good – juicy, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. You can really taste the quality of the ingredients. The buns were fresh, the meat was tender, and everything was well-balanced.

The staff were friendly and welcoming, and the service was fast. The place has a great vibe and is clean and comfortable to sit in.

If you’re in Pattaya and craving a proper burger, this is definitely the place to go. Highly recommended! 👌🔥
sample_reviews_en.author: David

sample_reviews_en.text: Burgrill in Pattaya is a hidden gem for anyone looking for quality burgers. The burgers are full of flavor, made fresh and you can really taste the difference in every bite. What makes the place even better is the atmosphere—relaxed, casual and made warm by the genuinely friendly staff who go out of their way to make you feel welcome. If you're in Pattaya, Burgrill is definitely worth checking out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maleeha

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the only veggie burger on the menu. It was AMAZING. Very flavorful, seasoned and cooked well. How was it juicy!! OMG best veggie burger in Pattaya! Customer service was great! I think I just bought stock in Burgrill Pattaya. I will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Truth The Creator

sample_reviews_en.text:
My new favorite burger place in Pattaya. Great service and the ingredients seem to have been carefully selected. The bread and meat are much better than what I tasted in other burger restaurants in Pattaya. I will be back!

PS: I recommend the mushroom burger.
sample_reviews_en.author: Samuel Chopard

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is awesome, the cook takes his time to make every individual order and the owner is so cool. Cant find American food on the block around in pattaya not unless you go to walking street. But if you stay in the area it’s perfect!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tren Genius

sample_reviews_en.text:
Burgrill - One of the best burgers in Pattaya.
Quality of beef if very good, price is reasonable and the owner is really friendly. Don't forget to collect the stamps, Buy 5 burgers get the 6th Free. That is a very generous offer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Damien Moloney

restaurants.address:


sample_reviews_th.text:
อาหารสุดอร่อย พร้อมบรรยากาศอบอุ่น 😊

First time came here and just realized the taste of mom-cooking , after that me and family become T&T big fan. …
sample_reviews_th.author: Yanika Chirachinta

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is like eating at home.
The food tastes really good; it feels like eating at home.
-Grilled Pork Curry with Betel Leaves: Rich, fragrant, and well-balanced flavor. The grilled pork neck is tender and bouncy, a perfect combination.
-Shrimp and Eggplant Salad: The eggplant is grilled and the skin is peeled off, giving it a fragrant aroma. The dressing is rich, well-balanced with a perfect balance of sweet and sour. The shrimp are large.
-Fried Pork with Fish Sauce: The rich flavor is delicious when eaten with the dipping sauce.
-Spaghetti with Water Spinach and Shrimp: The spaghetti is stir-fried perfectly dry, with a well-balanced flavor that has a hint of sweet and sour, as if a little tamarind juice was added.
sample_reviews_en.author: WingZero 00W0

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had the fortune of dining at this cozy little restaurant, thoughtfully chosen by our Thai friends. And when the food started arriving, it was immediately clear why they had chosen this place!

The portions were just right, beautifully plated, with distinct aromas, flavours and textures that kept intriguing our palate with every bite. Honestly, no photo could quite do the food justice.

It may be a little off the beaten path, but this gem is truly worth seeking out. A wonderful dining experience, and one we’re so glad our friends introduced us to!
sample_reviews_en.author: Edward Khoo A.W.

sample_reviews_en.text: Home away from home restaurant, so many choices on the menu!!! We had six different dishes and all were exceptionally delicious, Thai and European!!! Beautiful and peaceful decor which brings an extra touch to better appreciate this restaurant's hospitality! Khun Jieb (owner and well fluent in english)  has  put her personal touch into this restaurant for the past 12 years, a must to visit and dine!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: JP INBKK

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious every time I've eaten here. Today I specifically came to eat Khao Chae (rice in chilled broth), but I waited for over an hour. The first order I placed still hadn't arrived, while all the dishes I ordered after that had already been served. It turned out the waiter served the food to the wrong table. So frustrating!
sample_reviews_en.author: Vicky Sawasdikul

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes good, but the prices are higher than typical restaurants in the same area. Today I ordered 5 dishes, and the taste would be a 4 out of 5. I also ordered beer, but they didn't give me a bottle, so I don't know if the brand matched the glass. Sometimes I expect things to be as good as the Google reviews suggest.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arty Wan

sample_reviews_en.text: Beautiful shop, suitable for hanging out. The food was very delicious. I like rice mixed with shrimp paste, mashed potatoes and gravy, Pad Thai with fresh shrimp, eggplant salad with fresh shrimp, fried pork with fish sauce, Miang Kham, Khao Tang Na Tang, fresh coconut milk ice cream.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hla Si

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is lovely and clean.
The food tastes great, both Thai and international, fresh and delicious.
The service is excellent. I could go back again and again because the menu is so diverse. I was very impressed with the wine cooler and wine glasses.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peeps S

restaurants.address:

447/37 Soi Ratchaprarop 4, Makkasan, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
if you're in Bangkok and don't know what to eat, or you are tired from all the tourist trap and viral but not-so-great food places, you should definitely check this place out. 5 STARS for all the foods, service, and price. price is 80b for the basic menu (fried rice, chicken basil, garlic pork, noodles, etc.) and 180b for the large portion, and big/special menu (crispy pork, etc.)

food was super delicious, especially the crispy pork, super crispy but still juicy on the inside. portion was also super generous. it was super delicious we decided to takeaway 2 portion again to bring all the way back home to Jakarta 😁

not to mention the auntie was also very nice and mentioned the price before we order. definitely would come back here again. a solid 10/10!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kezia Caren

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant doesn't list prices on its menu. The dishes didn't match the order. There were no napkins on the table. The waiters barely spoke English, making communication virtually impossible. In the end, I ordered two identical dishes, but they only brought me two fried eggs; nothing else. They charged me without a receipt, using a calculator, but you couldn't see what they were calculating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paola Romero Rodriguez

sample_reviews_en.text: Fresh home style food! We came here last year and ate here twice during our visit. We’re here again this year. The owners (both wife and husband) are very kind and friendly and they prepare the food themselves. It’s authentic, delicious and freshly prepared. We love grabbing a bite here everytime we visit Bangkok 😊 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Tina Suchde

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here a few times now, I've had really good food every time, and it won't be the last time. Yes there are no prices on the menu but expect a price between 180 to 250 per person for food and drinks. I would advise people to stop by this restaurant and get some of the best original Thai food in Bangkok
sample_reviews_en.author: Maganator marksman

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is fantastic at this little restaurant with its open kitchen.

Although the prices aren't listed on the menu, they readily tell you. All the regular dishes are 80, and the rest are 150, I believe.

We've been there twice. The staff is incredibly welcoming, kind, and always smiling. Thank you to them!
sample_reviews_en.author: justine commerman

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop is a gem, located at the entrance of Soi Ratchaprarop 4. The food is delicious and the service is superb. The staff changes in two shifts; the evening shift is the best, featuring the handsome, good-natured, and friendly owner who still charges the same price every day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rungroj Jitjeiam

sample_reviews_en.text: Came here for lunch and it was an unexpected surprise. Food delicious, chef/owner super friendly, atmosphere local and relaxed. We had 2 rice, chicken with cashews, morning glory and fried pork. With a large bottle of Chang it cost 590 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Golder

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't get some of the criticism here.  You guys do realize you could ask for the price before you order right?  Auntie explained to me clearly how much my dish cost because I asked before I placed my order.  Also, a lot of locals eat here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alfred Kong

restaurants.address:

973 Soi Lat Phrao 48, Samsen Nok, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been here a few times now. The waitress is very attentive. Most of the food is delicious.
The papaya salad with fermented fish is very good, very tasty. The fermented fish sauce is excellent.
The cockles were a bit small, and the seafood sauce was delicious.
But the tom zap wasn't very spicy.
The pork was very good, tender and delicious.
The jim jum is generous and worth the price. The taste is good.
This restaurant's jaew sauce isn't very good, but the seafood sauce is delicious.
The restaurant has nice seating under the dormitory. The tables are clean. Parking may be limited, but motorcycles can be parked in front of the restaurant.
This is another restaurant I'll return to often. I deducted one star because the billing process is still slow.
sample_reviews_en.author: K C

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was not tasty. The papaya salad had noodles that were as chewy as a foot. The restaurant was dirty; the plates were stained. I don't know if the food was clean or not. The staff were very rude. I strongly do not recommend it.
(Note: The provided Thai text also includes a description of a restaurant, poor service, and unrelated information about hygiene, dirty dishes, and bad service.)
sample_reviews_en.author: him him

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has moved to a new location under the building next to its old spot. It's much cleaner now, and the food tastes just as delicious as before. The prices are also very reasonable. My favorite dish is the grilled pork neck – it's tender and juicy. Parking is free under the building next to the old location. If you can't find it, just ask the owner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jantakan Jungpanich

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my go-to place. Everything is delicious. The grilled milk udder is amazing! It's so soft, bouncy, and not chewy at all. It's incredibly good! I've tried it at many places, and they're usually tough and difficult to chew. None of them are as soft and bouncy as this one. And the fried larb is a must-try too! It's really good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thisiskangkang

sample_reviews_en.text: I eat bamboo shoot soup very often because it's inexpensive. However, my recent purchase cost 80 baht (80 baht for spicy tripe salad and 80 baht for minced pork salad). I felt terrible about it. The service was also very bad; the staff ignored customers, had grumpy faces, and their language was very upsetting.
sample_reviews_en.author: ABCCA BBCAA

sample_reviews_en.text: I love the pickled shellfish salad, it's delicious. I ate it at lunchtime in November 2024. It was very hot, but the taste made up for it. There's no parking for cars, you have to find your own. We got our car washed at the shop before the salad shop. A large size (L) was 200 baht. It was clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: NC Chai

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is open-air with no air conditioning. The papaya salad is very spicy; those who can't handle much spice might need to specify the amount of chilies. The grilled chicken is decent, but the dipping sauce isn't very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeab Wiyada

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant isn't crowded, the prices are affordable, the food tastes decent, it's easy to get to, and you can park in the alley next to the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maruj Isarankura Na Ayudhya

restaurants.address:

opp. Outlet Mall, Subway, Thepprasit Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today, September 16, 2023, employees treated Arab customers in a very bad manner. But on the other hand, when customers from Thailand entered, they were treated with a smile and all friendliness. The food was very bad, the vegetables were not fresh, and the bread was cold and not fresh.
