sample_reviews_en.text: This Subway makes their sandwiches at a good standard similarly to other restaurants. The staff are professional and communicated very well according to our needs. Donate downside of this specific store is the slight neglect of the dining area. It doesn't seem to be staff designated to look after it. Moreover, the lighting is a little too dim and the decorations look half done.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yawarakai O.

sample_reviews_en.text: It's been about 2 years since I had Subway back in the US, so when I saw this one I had to stop to fix my craving. Very nice girls working there and also understood English which was a bonus. SO good when you haven't had it for a while. Thank you! It was wonderful! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Kelly K

sample_reviews_en.text: This was a typical Subway. Always reliable quality and service, but thus 1 went above. I was distracted by my daughter while ordering, and they started my sandwich before toasting. They were happy to start over.
sample_reviews_en.author: Otto Williams

sample_reviews_en.text: Thank you for the time that brought us together. I will cherish the good memories. And the reason for my rudeness is to encourage good thoughts and good deeds; nothing evil can overcome good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Esmido Fashion LTD By Esprit

sample_reviews_en.text: Staff had to be asked to add veg to the end of the sandwich. A foot-long sub, no drink, no sides, was 485 Baht! I couldn't believe the price of this sandwich. Dining room was neglected.
sample_reviews_en.author: M Q

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a Subway so not much to say.
Pleasant and friendly staff, very clean branch.

I use this branch when ordering for delivery to home and never had any issues in over two years.
sample_reviews_en.author: Earl Brown

sample_reviews_en.text: The service is excellent, with delivery available through GrabFood. Their chicken kebab menu offers many delicious flavors, perfect for night owls.
sample_reviews_en.author: สิทธิศักดิ์ เตียวเจริญ

restaurants.name: Long Aoei
restaurants.address:

10 Ratchabophit Rd, แขวง วัดราชบพิธ Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I found this restaurant on Google Maps, saw good reviews, and went without high expectations. The interior was like a typical shophouse, with about 5-6 tables – not quite like a restaurant, a bit cluttered with things inside. Some people might not like that, but after ordering about 3 dishes and trying them, it was amazing! The fish and shrimp were incredibly fresh and delicious. While we were eating, delivery drivers kept coming to pick up orders. And the price was incredibly reasonable – better than many famous restaurants I've been to! You do need to be patient though, as the food is quite slow to prepare. I highly recommend trying this restaurant; you won't be disappointed. I didn't get a chance to take pictures of the food because we were too busy eating! I only managed to get a photo of the bill.😅 If I'm ever near Wat Suthat again, I'll definitely go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Goi Wantanee

sample_reviews_en.text:
When I entered I was surprised there were no customers inside and no AC, probably a put off for most people. The old lady looked so kind hence I stayed. She was keen to recommend dishes after I explained to her my food allergy via google  translation. ( Don’t risk it if you have severe allergy though!) I was happy with the choices and the family restaurant vibe.
Also worth mentioning they don’t have a proper bathroom.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wen Jin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious. Everything was tasty.
- Tom Yum Goong (spicy shrimp soup) with lots of mushrooms: Large, fresh, and sweet shrimp.
- Stir-fried water spinach with crispy pork: Crispy vegetables, the broth bursts in your mouth when you bite into it.
- Stir-fried clams: Clean clams.
Saved as a favorite restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daisy

sample_reviews_en.text: My brother brought me here for the first time. At first, I wasn't impressed by the storefront, but after the first bite, I exclaimed, "This is a hidden gem, and it's incredibly delicious!!!" I ordered four dishes, and all four were fantastic. If you're hesitant, trust me, you won't regret it! They're amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: CG CGame

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes good. Our recommended dishes are Pad Krapow (Thai basil stir-fry), Pad Thai (Thai pad thai), and fish cakes. The staff provides good service. The downside is that the restaurant is air-conditioned and has a food smell; the smell lingers on you after leaving.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeab Jeab

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hidden gem of a restaurant. Amazing food and affordable price. Super friendly staff who speak English well.

The store looks like it is closed because of the dark tint, but as long as you go during operating hours it will likely be open. Just swing open the door.!
sample_reviews_en.author: Juno Robertson

sample_reviews_en.text: From the outside, it looks like a place you might not dare go in, so I checked the reviews first 😅 We were visiting the temple and stopped by for a meal. The taste was okay, the portions were generous, the atmosphere was friendly, and the prices were reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: MULAN

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant looks a bit quirky, but the food is delicious and affordable.
We came as a couple and ordered minced pork omelet, tom yum soup (creamy version), chicken with cashew nuts, and stir-fried chayote shoots. Every dish was delicious and very filling!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nisachol Tattpongsasiri

restaurants.name: Chian Bangrak Chicken Rice
restaurants.address:

1462 ถ. เจริญกรุง Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Another favorite restaurant in the Bang Rak area that I've been eating at for over 10 years is Chian Chicken Rice, the old Bang Rak branch (it wasn't located in this building before). The prices are very reasonable, starting at 30 baht.
Even though the price is cheap and the appearance might look a bit pale, the taste is incredibly delicious (I happen to not like the skin). The rice is fluffy, fragrant, and delicious. The chicken is incredibly tender. The highlight is the dipping sauce; it's spicy and flavorful, elevating chicken rice to a whole new level. The soup served with it is also tasty (the dish in the photo cost 40 baht).
Besides chicken rice, they also have clear noodle soup with pork meatballs. The soup here is delicious; you can easily finish the whole bowl. Oh, I almost forgot to mention!!! Today I ordered two spring rolls. They were crispy on the outside and the filling inside was excellent.
The restaurant is located opposite the famous Prince Congee, near the bus stop at the entrance of Soi Charoen Krung 44.
Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: suwit brand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was a little surprised by the portion size when it was served, but I guess that's expected for the price. If you're worried about not being full, order the special size for 50-60 baht.

What I ordered:
👀 Mixed Hainanese Chicken Rice (no skin) 40 baht
The taste was okay. The rice wasn't too oily or soggy.
- Boiled chicken: Not fishy at all, looked clean, not dry.
- Fried chicken: Crispy, with a little bit of burnt bits.
👀 Spring Rolls 10 baht
Delicious, with glass noodle filling. Freshly fried, crispy and hot. Homemade plum sauce.

The owner seemed a bit stern, but the staff provided good service (they forgot some spring rolls I ordered, so I had to remind them, but it didn't take long to wait).

The shop has about 5 tables (4-5 people per table).
There are fans to help with ventilation, but it might be a bit hot because it's right next to the road.

Next time, I'll try the special size to see how much more I can eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dallaso

sample_reviews_en.text:
Considering the price and service, this place is excellent 👍
Regular Hainanese Chicken Rice is 30 baht, special is 40-50 baht. It's still available in Bang Rak, Charoen Krung, and the owner is incredibly friendly and provides excellent service.
I ordered the special for 50 baht; the portion was worth the price.

Starting with the rice, it was soft and slightly moist but still had individual grains. It had a delicious, savory flavor.
The boiled chicken was chopped into flat pieces, tender and juicy, with a well-balanced and delicious taste.
The dipping sauce was seasoned with chili and ginger, perfectly balanced with sweetness, spiciness, and sourness.
The soup wasn't bland; it had a good flavor.
Overall, considering the taste, price, and service, this is a Hainanese chicken rice place I can definitely frequent regularly.
Score: 7.5 out of 10
sample_reviews_en.author: Opas Samsen

sample_reviews_en.text: As a Singaporean this falls short of the minimum standard as compared taste wise. But the chicken was soft and tender. The rest of the dishes didn’t really stood out. The rice had a hint of Fragrance but nothing on the taste side. The spring rolls was okay thou highly recommend by the staff. The chilli was acceptable, not too spicy. The noodle soup with pork ball doesn’t really have any pork taste but the beansprout taste is super strong 😅 service was great and they were really helpful and patient in communicating. The have English words on the menu as well. So it’s pretty easy to order what you want.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ra Voo

sample_reviews_en.text: I really love this Hainanese chicken rice. The chicken is tender but not mushy, the rice is good, and the dipping sauce is delicious. The price is very cheap, with options for 30, 40, or 50 baht. I usually prefer less rice and more chicken, and the owner happily accommodates that. The spring rolls are also tasty. The noodle soup is fragrant, delicious, and clean-tasting. I usually don't add any extra seasoning; their plain soup is delicious as is.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suthida Chaw

sample_reviews_en.text:
My partner was sick so I thought this kind of meal was do him good and it definitely was!!
Such simple yes delicious meal.
The boiled chicken was soo good and the fried one was even more so, it even stayed crunchy after being wrapped for around 15 mins!!
The rice is so aromatic and fluffy and the chicken stock + spicy sauce they give is delicious.
The uncle who owns the place (seems like a family restaurant) is super nice too!! Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: Hana Alaa

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's good. This was my first time eating here. The owner is very kind, talkative, and friendly.

The chicken is delicious, and the noodles are tasty too. The price is reasonable, not expensive.

There's no parking in front of the shop. If you're coming, I recommend parking at Central Plaza or near the schools in the area.

I recommend trying it at least once.
sample_reviews_en.author: santi noikamon

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Hainanese chicken rice is delicious; the chicken is tender and fragrant.
The price is excellent; it's a very generous shop offering great value.

The chrysanthemum tea is superb, fragrant and sweet, tasting like the kind sold in old-fashioned pharmacies. It's also a great price, only 10 baht per bottle.

I highly recommend this shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: me review

restaurants.name: สเต็กลุงใหญ่ สาขาพัฒนาการตัดใหม่
restaurants.address:

Phatthanakan Rd, ตัดใหม่ Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I've bought steak from Uncle Big's branch at the Bangchak gas station on On Nut 46 twice to take home. Both times, the gravy was the same – very thick and seemed like it had been refrigerated and not reheated for customers. The steak itself was tender, but the plastic knives and forks were cheap, flimsy, and bent easily when cut, making them very difficult to slice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Toom Apiwat

sample_reviews_en.text: My child was very hungry and found this restaurant. They have food suitable for both children and adults. I didn't have time to take a picture. The steak was very delicious. The American fried rice had beef and tomatoes without sauce. It was complete with fried eggs, ham, fried chicken, sausage. The owner is very cute.
sample_reviews_en.author: patty h

sample_reviews_en.text: This is our go-to restaurant! We go almost every week. The owner is lovely ❤️🥰 and very friendly. The food comes out quickly, it's delicious, affordable, and the portions are generous. The atmosphere is great, not hot at all. Come visit us! ❤️🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploypaliln Natsengsi

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. Both staff members were making disgusted faces and speaking in a very rude manner. If they didn't want to sell to us, they should have said so, because the food looked delicious, but the service was awful.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิไลพร แปลกตุ้

sample_reviews_en.text:
The New Orleans chicken was rather bland, as if it hadn't been marinated.
But the Boston pork steak was incredibly tough. I couldn't eat it. I spit it out. This will probably be my last time.

Parking is available on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaiyanan P

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is good and more than worth the price. They offer a government subsidy program (half-price). The buttered bread is made with real butter and is very fragrant. The owner provides excellent service. Very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Montawat Sripusitto

sample_reviews_en.text:
The steak was delicious, and the baked spinach with cheese was fragrant and tasty.

The prices were reasonable.
The service was good, and they provided plenty of fans.
The service was fast.
There was parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nin June

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the service was excellent, and the atmosphere was great. It was perfect for chatting with friends. The staff were so lovely and even gave us a huge extra plate of chicken nuggets!
sample_reviews_en.author: ชลลดา หงษ์สท้าน

restaurants.name: Raja Wonton Noodle
restaurants.address:

10320 Sutthisan Winitchai Rd, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: They open the shop right on time at 18.20 so everybody has to sit and wait LOL. There are (always) a lot of take away orders, sometimes it takes an hour to get in. Egg noodle and shrimp wontons are the stars. เกี๊ยวกุ้งคือดีๆๆๆ
sample_reviews_th.author: Petcher Love

sample_reviews_en.text: Personally, I really liked it. It was pretty tasty. I ordered a bowl of special pork wonton noodle soup (60 baht). The price is reasonable. But what makes this restaurant unique is its decor; the walls are covered with posters of famous European football teams from various countries, plus famous footballers from the past and present. My order arrived at my table pretty quickly after ordering. 👌
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitichote Pao

sample_reviews_en.text: To be honest, the wonton noodles were delicious, but I'm only giving it 2 stars because the wait for a table was too long, and the staff were incredibly arrogant. I once came when the shop wasn't fully set up, and they wouldn't let me sit inside to wait. The lights weren't on, and they cut me off abruptly, saying the shop wasn't open yet, even though it was already 6 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: AMNAJ RERKAMNUAYCHOKE

sample_reviews_en.text: Wonton noodles are one of my favourite dishes and I’ve had them in many different countries! This is by far my favourite place I’ve ever had it. The soup flavour is so delicious, noodles always fresh and the meat is amazing. Couldn’t fault it! Had it almost every night. To top it all off, the staff are extremely friendly despite how hard they work! :) highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tiffany Kee

sample_reviews_en.text: This noodle shop is located at the Sutthisan intersection. The must-try dish is the Tom Yum Wonton Noodles. The Tom Yum broth is incredibly flavorful, and the noodles are unlike any other – perfectly chewy and soft. Another recommended dish is the dry noodles. Plus, the prices are very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: BIRD vanilla

sample_reviews_en.text:
We've been here a few times a year for the last seven years, since I first moved to Bangkok. The food and the service has always been exceptional. Hopefully it will be here for another seven years ❤️

Also if you're a football fan, there are lots of retro posters on the walls to look at.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Plume

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was crowded with locals in the evening.
I showed them photos of the food from other posters on Google Maps and placed my order.
I went back to my hotel nearby and ate in my room.

It was cheap and delicious; I was impressed by the high level of quality of Bangkok's local eateries.
sample_reviews_en.author: akio yoshida

sample_reviews_en.text: Had the egg noodles and shrimp dumplings in normal portion, big portions and a bowl of all dumplings. Was delicious!!!!! The noodles was well-cooked, the dumplings filling was big, the red pork pieces was a lean meat, the soup has a sweet hint, was refreshing and flavorful.
sample_reviews_en.author: RinLiTa

restaurants.name: SHIKI OMAKASE BANGKOK
restaurants.address:

1151/3, 7th Floor, Value Plus Building, Kamphaeng Phet, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Divine Culinary Journey at SHIKI Omakase Bangkok

Dining at SHIKI Omakase Bangkok was extraordinary. It’s not just the best omakase I’ve ever had — it’s the best meal of my life. Every course was a masterpiece, combining precision, creativity, and an uncompromising respect for premium ingredients.

From the first bite to the last, the flavors were perfectly balanced and deeply satisfying. The otoro was buttery and rich, the uni was sweet and  fresh, and fish selections showed off the chef’s refined technique and deep understanding of umami. Every dish told a story, and every moment felt thoughtfully curated.

If you’re in Bangkok get a seat at SHIKI. This isn’t just a meal — it’s a celebration of Japanese culinary art at its highest level.
sample_reviews_en.author: parinya raksakaew

sample_reviews_en.text:
-This omakase restaurant on the 7th floor has an amazing atmosphere. Walking in, you get the full Japanese vibe. The decor is beautiful, the mood is great, and there's a rooftop-style balcony with a gorgeous garden and gently flowing water. Sitting outside offers a different ambiance as well.

-The food in the course was excellent in every dish. The signature dishes were outstanding, perfectly balanced, and melted in your mouth. The dessert, probably a sorbet, was tangy, refreshing, and had a delightful crunchy texture.

-The chef explained the dishes very well and was very friendly. The staff were also lovely and attentive.

-There's also parking available 🚗

Loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nina C.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve been to this place last night for the first time as newly opened restaurant. And I found that it was so amazing with a breathtaking view of Bangkok. I think, the restaurant is presented a new style of Japanese Omagase ambience, not like others with a vibrant and fantastic fun mood by the music. Their food is so fresh in each course. The chef offered various kind of fresh-made food. The price is reasonable. The restaurant is on the roof top of Value Plus Bldg, near Samsen Train Station. The building is clean and there’s a parking inside.
In summary, it is highly recommended place for anyone who likes to try an Omagase Japanese Food in this area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panchita Banleuchairit

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere feels really calming and relaxing, the decorations and soft music adds a cozy vibe. There is an outside balcony with a beautiful garden you can take photos in and the view is really nice. The service made me and my family feel very welcomed and we felt like we were at home. Lastly, the food is amazing!! There’s so many deluxe selections and they are all top tier. I really recommend this restaurant especially coming with your friends and family. And if you want a private space it’s perfect because they even have a private room. I guarantee you that you will have a great time here and an amazing tasty meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rongrong Bhuridej

sample_reviews_en.text:
a hidden omakase spot around the Samsen area. The view is beautiful, the atmosphere is lovely, and most importantly, the course price is very good value for what you get.

Their sushi uses red vinegar rice, with flavors that are nicely balanced — not too bold, not too light. The menu is well-rounded: about half is sushi, and the other half includes sashimi, simmered, grilled, and fried dishes. The ingredients are of good quality and thoughtfully selected.

I went for the 3,500-baht course (13 courses) and even got to enjoy premium-grade uni, served generously in a full row — absolutely impressive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hangry Joobert

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant's signature dish is excellent. The appetizer is highly recommended, offering a mix of sweet and savory flavors. Many dishes are rich in flavor. The restaurant uses Yuzu in many dishes, making it refreshing enough to continue eating until the end of the course. The dessert is a perfect balance of light and heavy flavors, ending with Yuzu Sorbet, which is tangy and refreshing. Anyone who loves a refreshing taste should not miss this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: F329

sample_reviews_en.text: This omakase restaurant is not overly complicated, and the atmosphere is relaxed (the outdoor lighting at night is amazing and subtly romantic). Every dish was delicious. You can tell the chef what you don't like or don't want. Some dishes were so good I had to ask for seconds. The dessert and sorbet were fantastic and incredibly refreshing. They even had a cute little birthday surprise cake on the day I went.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gybbie

sample_reviews_en.text: My first time trying omakase was amazing, and I was incredibly impressed. The ingredients were fresh, the flavors were excellent, the atmosphere was wonderful, and the decor was beautiful. The exterior features a Japanese-style garden. The restaurant isn't very spacious, giving it a cozy feel. It's perfect for a date or a family outing. It's located on the 7th floor, and parking is available downstairs.
sample_reviews_en.author: เที่ยวกับคิน กินกับกาย

restaurants.name: Rocket Coffeebar at Lumphini
restaurants.address:

231/16 Sarasin Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Disappointing Experience: False Pricing and Poor Service
​
​I recently visited this coffee shop, and unfortunately, it was a very frustrating experience.
​The main issue was the total lack of transparency regarding their prices. The menu clearly stated a price of 80 Baht for my order, but when it came time to pay, I was charged 112 Baht (as shown on my receipt). When a price is advertised, customers expect it to be honored, and a 40% "surprise" increase is simply unacceptable.
​To make matters worse, the staff was not friendly at all. When I tried to address the pricing discrepancy, they were dismissive and rude rather than trying to be helpful or explain why the receipt didn't match the menu.
​Between the misleading prices and the poor attitude of the personnel, I cannot recommend this place. There are plenty of other cafes nearby that offer better service and honest pricing.
​Avoid if you value transparency and a welcoming atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: STEFANO MARRA

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is a disaster here. Ordered a truffle cream pasta, salad and a coffee here. None tastes even close to decent.

I asked for less salt and the pasta came way too salty like the cook spilled the whole salt jar. Inedible. Salad leaves are quite dry with dressing just ‘’sprinkle’’ on top and not well mixed. The orange Coffee is also so poorly made. It’s supposed to have soda water but you could barely taste it.

Mentioned to the staff but she just repeated she had told the cook to make it “less salty”, and couldn’t care less about the guest’s experience.

Also the little cafe is at the side of a large busy street. Not a breezy and chill atmosphere.

With all those awful experience, the price is still 800 baht(higher than the average cafe in Bangkok). Definitely not going back. Avoid it by all means!
sample_reviews_en.author: Casp Jhon

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been a Rocket Coffeebar fan since their very first branch opened over a decade ago on Sathon Soi 10. As I recall back then, they were one of the first dedicated cafes to take espresso brewing seriously, with 18g pucks and attention to all the details. All of that is fairly commonplace now, but Rocket has kept up with minor advances in brewing technique and in maintaining a high-quality menu of sandwiches, breakfasts and pastries that has slowly shifted from its original Scandinavian inspiration to more Australian/American style. I miss the scando slant for sure, but cannot fault the current menu at all. Still a strong focus on well-trained staff, much appreciated in a city where Thai baristas still lag behind their international counterparts for the most part. Kudos, Rocket.
sample_reviews_en.author: JJ Cummings

sample_reviews_en.text:
Rocket Coffeebar at Lumphini feels like it has both great atmosphere and delicious taste. The shop is decorated in a minimalist style with warm tones, making it very comfortable to sit in.
The drinks and desserts are very delicious and the prices are very good.
Another thing I liked was
the staff provided excellent service, and the food didn't take long to arrive.

Overall, it's a cafe that feels worthwhile in terms of the quality of drinks, food, and atmosphere.
I think it's another shop worth visiting.
If I have the chance, I'd definitely like to come back and try other menu items. 🩵
sample_reviews_en.author: Apirada Hongsa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Rocket Coffee is a brunch spot near Lumphini Park with a great atmosphere. The shop isn't large but has two floors, decorated in warm tones with plenty of photo opportunities. The morning light is beautiful.

The coffee is decent, up to standard. The pastries and food are tasty, easy to eat, and not too heavy. There's a good selection of menu items.

Overall, it's a great cafe for chilling, having a meal, or taking photos. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: pipim ploy

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were nice, the coffee was okay, and the soda water was nice and cold, but the desserts sucked. The carrot cake icing was bland, and the lemon bar was just as bad. I only leave food behind if it tastes terrible because I don't want to waste calories on garbage. These desserts were not good at all. I hate writing this review because this place seems popular and I hate to roast them, but it is what it is.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ali Ameri

sample_reviews_en.text: Anyone who goes for a run in Lumphini Park *must* try this place! It uses high-quality coffee beans and also offers various breads and sandwiches, including #sourdough and #focaccia, which they make themselves. I ordered three items and loved them all. The Cloudy #Latte is fragrant and creamy with coconut water; it's a delicious #espresso that's well worth 150 baht. #tiktokfood (Located near Lumphini Park)
sample_reviews_en.author: Jean ploenpan

sample_reviews_en.text: Thank you so much for the complimentary umbrella! 🌂 It was such a thoughtful and generous gesture, especially with the heavy rain. The staff went above and beyond to make sure we stayed dry, and their kindness truly made our visit even more memorable. Excellent customer service and genuine hospitality—I highly recommend this place and will definitely be coming back. Thank you again for your generosity!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kudos Billiards (Kuya Al)

restaurants.name: ขาหมู นายฮั่ง เลิศรส
restaurants.address:

207 ถ. เจริญกรุง Yan Nawa, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I was so hungry I forgot to take pictures beforehand! This was my first time eating here. I ordered dry noodles with braised pork leg. The skin was chewy and the meat was tender, perfectly complementing the yellow noodles. There was a slightly sweet clear soup that went well with the noodles, and crispy fried garlic sprinkled on top. The price was very reasonable considering the portion size. This dish was 60฿. I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_th.author: Nattawadee Vee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just left here and enjoyed a Pork Noodle Soup with Dumplings. I have been to this shop 3-4 times and it has always been consistently good, the service is friendly and fantastic, portion to price ratio is great. I have only ever eaten the Pork Noodle Soup so that is all I can vouch for, but if you are looking for that in the area it’s good.

The stewed pork smells incredible- I wish they would take some of the stewed pork broth and mix it in with the clear broth to really elevate the soup. All in all definitely recommend ($60 THB) for the portion in the picture. $50 THB if you want the soup with no dumplings. Cash only. Go support this local newer shop with great staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel O

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop owner didn't clearly state the prices. The sign said 60 baht for a plate of roasted pork rice. She asked if I wanted everything, and I said yes. When she calculated the price, she charged 70 baht. I asked why the sign said 60 baht (she said, "Because it includes everything, it's 70 baht." Wow, is that even possible? If you add an egg, it's 70 baht). She didn't mention there was a "special" option for 70 baht... Very confusing. (The crispy pork smelled like it had been left overnight.) If anyone is in this area, I recommend another shop near the Criminal Court, opposite the fish market, for 50 baht. It's tastier and everything is the same.
sample_reviews_en.author: ben jawan

sample_reviews_en.text: I initially planned to just have a casual meal, but it turned out to be incredibly delicious! ✨ This dry noodle dish with char siu pork and crispy pork is exactly what I've been searching for. The noodles are perfectly cooked, neither mushy nor hard. The highlight is the 'crispy pork' – huge pieces! Lots of meat, not too much fat, and the crispiness is off the charts. Noodle lovers have to try this!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutthanon Renupipat

sample_reviews_en.text: Stopped by for a quick meal and it was really satisfying. The braised pork was tender and flavorful, with the fat perfectly soft and the meat not dry at all. The sauce soaked nicely into the rice without being too heavy. Portions were generous for the price and the food came out fast. Simple setup, no frills, but the kind of place you go to when you just want something really good and comforting.
sample_reviews_en.author: OnSite

sample_reviews_en.text:
I originally planned to get the chicken rice bowl next door, but it was sold out, so I came in. They were incredibly friendly and delicious.
The yellow tea is also refreshingly sweet and delicious. You should definitely try it.
The portions weren't as generous as other reviews, but at 50 baht for the pig's feet rice bowl and 70 baht for the mixed rice bowl, it's a bit pricey for the diners.
sample_reviews_en.author: HS Shim

sample_reviews_en.text: Forgot to take pictures!!! By the time I remembered, one dish was already gone. The crispy pork rice was okay, the braised pork rice was okay but the egg was a bit hard. The wonton noodle soup with char siu pork was very generous in portion – noodles, soup, char siu pork, wontons – the taste was average. The shop was clean and the owner, an older gentleman, was overseeing everything.
sample_reviews_en.author: นาย นที รัตนธรรมพร

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. I ordered noodles, but they served rice. When I said I didn't order noodles, they argued that I said "rice," and the argument wouldn't end. I asked again what I ordered, and I said noodles, but they still insisted I ordered rice!!! Luckily, the manager came over to apologize, saying they weren't very fluent in spoken and spoken English.
sample_reviews_en.author: Issariya Kitsirorat

restaurants.name: Pattaya Beer Garden
restaurants.address:

118/4 Beach Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Beer Garden Pattaya Beach Road is one of the best places to enjoy fresh seafood with an incredible beachfront atmosphere.

The seafood selection is outstanding, with a wide variety of dishes that are freshly prepared and full of flavor. You can really taste the freshness in every bite, and the quality of the ingredients is excellent.

One of my favorite things was the coconut smoothie—it was refreshing, perfectly blended, and the ideal drink to enjoy while relaxing by the sea.

The vibes here are simply amazing. Sitting by the beach, enjoying the sea breeze, watching the sunset, and soaking in the lively atmosphere makes for a memorable dining experience. Whether you're visiting with family or friends, it's a fantastic place to unwind.

The staff were friendly, attentive, and provided good service throughout our visit, making the experience even more enjoyable.

Overall, Beer Garden Pattaya Beach Road offers delicious fresh seafood, refreshing drinks, great service, and an unbeatable beachfront ambiance. I would definitely visit again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great dining experience in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiten Tibrewala

sample_reviews_en.text:
Large selection of draft and bottled beers. Tip: Order a jug (a measure for pouring into a small glass) and an ice bucket. This will keep the beer cold until the last sip. The menu includes Western, Thai, and Isaan food. Portion sizes for Western food are generous, Thai food is very small. Hidden charge: Rice costs extra. Note for Thais: The Som Tum is very good. Spice level 1 is for Westerners.

Update 04/2025: Now significantly larger portions for Thai food. Even Westerners will now be satisfied. Pizza is inexpensive by Thai standards. Note: American style. Much more topping than in Europe. My wife complains: The quality of the Som Tum has declined.

Update 02/2026: My wife's feedback: The Som Tum (and especially the Tum Tart) is delicious again. For cider lovers: They now also sell Moose, the first fermented cider in Thailand. It's not on the menu yet – if you're interested, just ask. Update 07/26
Som Tum is still very tasty. Beer prices are stable. Our favorite pub even in 07/26!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sven B

sample_reviews_en.text: I had an excellent review written for this place. We loved it. We always come back when in Pattaya. But yesterday we came back with friends. I had Yum Talay, around 6pm, it was too spicy, but fine, the problem is that it made me sick. It didn’t taste amazing but I thought nothing about it. Around 11 pm I started vomiting, and that didn’t stop all night. I’ve got proper food poisoning with all the symptoms and bad fever. Have been dying for 24 hours now. I don’t like fishballs that came in the salad, so my husband ate them, he also woke up in the middle of the night vomiting. This is the first time I got food poisoning in Thailand in 8 years I’ve lived here. Really bad that I’ve got it from the restaurant, which isn’t cheap and which I’ve always trusted. Unacceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Uliana

sample_reviews_en.text: Very well located opposite Walking Street with a superb view of the bay. I come here often whenever I'm in Pattaya. If you arrive early enough, you can enjoy the sunset with a table overlooking the sea. The staff are friendly and very professional. The food is decent, with generous portions and a mix of Thai and Western dishes on the menu. Personally, I only ordered the Thai dishes, sometimes with a side of fries. The prices are quite reasonable for the location. The prices for pints of draft beer are also very reasonable, especially the local beers. Even the breakfast deal is good, with coffee that can be refilled twice free of charge, and it's served until mid-afternoon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fayçal BENYAHIA

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great place to watch the Sun go down and the lights come on by the Beach. The Pattaya sign was lit up as the Stars & Stripes to welcome visiting sailors from the USS. Abraham  Lincoln. A large outdoor restaurant and bar, beside the beach just before the entrance to Walking Street.

Drinks prices are reasonable, with a huge drinks selection and menu (though I didn't eat). The background is music with video from a wide range of Western Classic with the occasional Thai song included too. It’s a massive well run venue, nothing is added to the menu prices for drinks or service
sample_reviews_en.author: D J

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant with a beautiful beach view in South Pattaya. I come here often. They have a wide variety of Thai and European dishes, all delicious. It's a great place to relax, have a drink, and enjoy the view. They have a good selection of draft beers, perfect for a chill evening. There's a bar area and family-friendly tables. It's near the entrance to Walking Street. Give it a try, friends! Highly recommended! 👍📍Delicious Thai food that suits my taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arunwatee Sangphitak

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was absolutely delicious! We asked for a specific spice level, and they made it exactly as requested. The Tam Pa (mixed papaya salad) was especially amazing—so flavorful and incredibly tasty. The prices are very reasonable, and it paired perfectly with the crispy fried chicken skin. Enjoying such great food with a beautiful sea view and a cool ocean breeze made the experience even better. I highly recommend this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ben Su

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice location for drinks or a meal, especially when the sun is going down. The food I'd describe as ok. It's more about the location than the food. The Thai food felt just a little pricey for what you get while the Western food appeared to be good value for money. 50 baht for a small amount of plain rice is on the "pang" side! 180 baht for chicken and cashew nuts is ok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stickman Bangkok

restaurants.name: Jok Prince Bangrak
restaurants.address:

1391 ถ. เจริญกรุง Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
This is a place I had been planning to visit for a long time because it is so famous in Korea!

Since my accommodation was nearby, I came here often for breakfast and dinner during my month-long stay.

(Takeout is available, so I even packed up breakfast for the next day.)

★ 110 baht for two bowls of Thai-style pork porridge cooked over charcoal, infused with a subtle smoky flavor.

(The smoky flavor can feel like a burnt taste, so it might be hit or miss for some, but I found it fine.)

There are chunks of meat inside, and they are so delicious.

I'm so happy to be able to eat something like that at that price!

It would also be great for a hangover cure if you have heartburn after drinking.

It is a place that is extremely popular among the locals in Thailand.

[ONEHOFILM] _ วอนโฮฟิล์ม
sample_reviews_th.author: ONEHO FILM워노필름

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was hungry, so I ordered a bowl of congee while waiting to watch the England-Argentina football match. I scrolled through Grab for delivery and was glad Prince Congee in Bang Rak was still open (ordered a little after midnight).

The taste was classic as always, with that unique smoky aroma that I've grown accustomed to since my dad took me there as a kid.

Today I ordered the special, with plenty of toppings: soft-boiled egg, liver, stomach, kidney, and the highlight being the large chunks of seasoned minced pork with a perfectly coarse texture—not too smooth like bouncy pork. The congee itself was creamy and inviting.

Finished the bowl... Time to go watch the football!
sample_reviews_en.author: topinito S

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a famous Thai congee (jok) restaurant, and since I was staying nearby, I decided to try it for breakfast.

When I first took a bite, it had a slightly charred or burnt flavor, but after adding the condiments on the table (soy sauce, pepper, vinegar) to my liking, it was absolutely delicious!

Of course, the meatballs and soft-boiled egg were also great 👍

I would definitely like to come back and eat here again when I'm in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: masakky

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hmm, I think it's probably delicious, but it definitely smells burnt.
My wife, who's a chef, said there's a high possibility that the bottom of the pot was burnt and the burnt taste transferred to the porridge.
I managed to mask the taste with seasonings and finished it, but my wife gave up...
I was a little disappointed considering how much I was looking forward to it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ken Yamamoto

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very hot place
Eating while sweating is a common sight
Long time have not eaten but the charcoal taste is there with the thick porridge in nature. And the pork balls with the intestines and organs make my meal more interesting plus the soft boiled egg to give some flavors. Definitely a must try in your visit regardless how many times here
sample_reviews_en.author: Winfred Chai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don't know how to describe the taste and feeling but wow, truly impressed. Better than any of the Congee I've had in HK or SG, so traditionally good and heart warming. The congee was smooth, pork patties were bouncy, egg melted perfectly into the congee.
Felt moved by nostalgia LOL.
Must try, please.
sample_reviews_en.author: Beatrice Lau

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very reasonable prices

Higher quality taste than expected

Pork fermented egg porridge not bad, better than expected

It would have been more accurate if they had written "pork meatballs" on the menu instead of just "pork"

There is no air conditioning, so you have to eat quickly and leave
sample_reviews_en.author: Sejoong Kim

sample_reviews_en.text: Pork congee with a fragrant, slightly burnt aroma from the bottom of the pan, and minced pork infused with herbs. This place has received multiple Michelin awards and other accolades such as True You's recommended restaurants. The atmosphere is that of an old-fashioned, homey eatery.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anusak Wiriyasiriphot

restaurants.name: Trattoria Pizzeria Toscana Pattaya
restaurants.address:

Beach Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
They only served Europeans. Asians called repeatedly but received no service. They called before the tables with Europeans arrived, but they served the Europeans first. That alone speaks volumes about the quality of their service.
We called for a waiter, and more than three people nodded in acknowledgment, but not a single person came to take our order. I understand it might have been because we were a corner table and they couldn't attend to everyone. We had to ask to change tables. Even after changing tables, they still didn't come to take our order. What's unacceptable is that they served other tables that arrived later. You can say there were many customers, but this isn't what customers should have to experience. Before asking me to change my review, "please reconsider your own service first."
sample_reviews_en.author: Ariya Sandy

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant has a comfortable atmosphere and a traditional Western-style decor. It's spacious with several seating areas both inside and outside. We ordered lobster linguine, spaghetti with meat sauce, and calamari, and everything was delicious and the portions were generous – we were very full and almost couldn't finish it. Mostly foreigners were dining there; I didn't see many Thais. Considering the taste, ingredients, and portion sizes, the price is very reasonable. If you're in Pattaya and want Italian food, I recommend trying this place. I didn't order the pizza, so I'll have to try it next time.

The pizza had plenty of toppings and wasn't soggy – I liked it. The pork chop was also excellent; it might look simple, but it was grilled perfectly, tender, and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: primasiaa

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ate here three days in a row — two dinners and a lunch — and it was a fantastic experience. The host is a true gem: welcoming, warm, and with that classic Tuscan vibe of someone who genuinely loves making guests feel good. You can ask him anything, and he’ll always answer with total warmth and honesty, doing his best to accommodate any need — especially when it comes to kosher requests. The food is a true celebration of authentic Italian cuisine, with a special shout-out to his regional specialties.

If I ever find myself back in Pattaya, I’d return here in a heartbeat. Because places like this don't just serve great food — they give you a true taste of home thousands of miles away.
sample_reviews_en.author: Matteo Dei Rossi

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a beautiful Italian restaurant with impeccable service.
The woodfired pizzas are the best we have had in Thailand, we have been travelling all around for nearly 3mths.
Our friend had ordered the seafood spaghetti and it took over 30mins to come out. My partner and I have had our salad and 2 pizzas before the pasta dish arrived.
But my biggest disappointment was the tiramisu. I always order the tiramisu when I got to an Italian restaurant. This one was a frozen dessert that was defrosted. The biscuits were baby mush, the cream definitely did not have any muscarpone.
I do food taste testing back home and been described as being a super taster.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shey Cummings

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very mid experience at this restaurant. The pasta is decent towards the bland side but massive portions and lots of clams which were good.  The steak was pretty good probably the best dish there, tender and good to medium rare.

However, the problem occurred with the mushroom soup which was curdled and separated which resulted in a really bad texture. We notified the staff but had a hard time communicating with them whether its in thai or english about the problem with the soup. They ended up taking it out of the bill which was nice of them. Overall, it was an okay experience for the price but would probably not visit them again.
sample_reviews_en.author: June S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ate at this Italian restaurant today. The place is spacious and clean, but unfortunately, the dining experience was very disappointing.
The spaghetti carbonara was frankly disgusting: the sauce was far too thick and the pasta was barely cooked, much more than "al dente." I left feeling nauseous, no exaggeration. I didn't even finish my plate, thankfully.
The lasagna was also very disappointing and nothing like the Italian lasagna we know.
The pizza, on the other hand, was quite good; it was the only dish we enjoyed.
We were so disappointed that we didn't even order dessert. I unfortunately do not recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: justine

sample_reviews_en.text: Horrible customer service. As you can read by their review responses. Do NOT eat here. Avoid at all coats. Slightly above average tasting Italian food. Overpriced, compared to local food.  I was eating here a few days a week, while staying in the area. I was just aggressively kicked out, of the restaurant, for walking in with a 1/3 cup of water. Which i was walking around with. Genius management, I believe it was the owner. Maybe a reason they always look so empty. I will not return. Brilliant. Everything i said above is 100% facts, no exaggerations.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jackson F

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very nice Italian restaurant along beach road. Good wine list and quality menu choices. I generally go for the homemade ravioli or salmon.

Here I am again. April 2025. Food (Salmon) is still great…service interesting. Water and wine kept full until a few more customers came in. Then, hasbeen, serve myself.  Ok, I’ll come back,  but why stop great service halfway through the meal???

And another thing, you need to have nonsmoking section. Taking the ashtray off the table doesn’t count! I’m surrounded by chimneys killing them selves and me.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dan Rosman

restaurants.name: Laab Ubon Kontrakran
restaurants.address:

251 6 S Sathon Rd, Yan Nawa, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fantastic Local Thai Food at Great Prices!

Had a wonderful dining experience at Laab Ubon Kontrakran. The food was absolutely delicious, full of authentic Thai flavors, and every dish was freshly prepared and packed with taste. The menu offers great variety, and everything we ordered was flavorful and well presented.

What impressed me the most was the value for money. The prices are very reasonable, especially considering the generous portions and quality of the food. It’s a great place to enjoy authentic Thai cuisine without spending a fortune.

The atmosphere is casual, lively, and welcoming, giving a true local dining experience. The staff were friendly and attentive, making the visit even more enjoyable.

If you’re looking for tasty food, authentic flavors, and amazing prices, this is definitely a place worth visiting. I will happily come back again whenever I’m in the area. 🇹🇭🍽️
sample_reviews_en.author: Shev’s Stories

sample_reviews_en.text:
This local restaurant is very popular and always busy. I heard it’s food from the north of Thailand. When I wasn’t sure what to order, the staff recommended the grilled chicken gai yang. It came in a huge portion, so juicy and really delicious. The fish dish I tried was also amazing. The menu has English and photos, so it’s easy to choose. Beer was very cheap, and I drank a lot!!!!

Every dish had a big portion, so it’s the perfect place to come with friends and share many plates. The atmosphere was lively and really gave me the feeling of being in Thailand!
The restaurant is easy to reach from the station, and I definitely want to come back.

Most of the customers were Thai, but there were also some foreigners. The staff seemed used to helping tourists and were very kind.
sample_reviews_en.author: shi du

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner takes good care of customers, but I have feedback for the staff. I ordered bitter soup but got a very sour spicy soup – it was inedible. Also, please train your service staff; they should pay more attention to customers instead of just playing on their phones. Today, I bought food to take home, and the owner even called me over to prepare my order. Please train your service staff to be more attentive to customers and not just sit around playing on their phones. I ordered bitter soup but got a very sour spicy soup instead. It was a disappointing experience, especially since the food wasn't even 70-80 baht – I'm a regular customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: บัวลี เกดตะวง

sample_reviews_en.text: Had a great time here. Just a heads up, it’s super popular with the locals so it gets really busy and loud. It might feel a bit overwhelming at first, but just go with the flow and enjoy the vibe, it’s totally worth it. They do have an English menu which is helpful. Prices are very reasonable. You definitely have to try the grilled beef, it was seriously excellent. The best way to eat here is to just order a bunch of different dishes and some white rice to share, perfect if you're with family or a group of friends. They also have TVs playing football matches sometimes. Great local spot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gregory Vlnt

sample_reviews_en.text:
Used to love this place back when it wasn’t so well-known, but it feels a bit different now. The menu has expanded a lot to cater to tourists—now you’ll find things like shrimp cakes alongside the usual Isaan dishes. While it’s still decent, the taste isn’t as consistent as before, and some of that original bold, punchy flavor seems to be missing.

It’s still a convenient spot with a lively atmosphere, especially in the evenings, but if you’ve been here before when it was more local-focused, you might feel a bit let down. Not bad, but not what it used to be. Gave it 3/5 this time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chen E.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Flavor & Quality: The noodles are chewy and soft, infused with flavor. The broth is sweet and savory, made from bones simmered for hours, combined with shredded chicken or fresh seafood, served with fresh vegetables and crispy roasted peanuts – very appetizing.

Atmosphere & Service: Casual, rustic style, and always bustling with customers. Despite the crowds, the food is served quickly, and the staff are friendly.

Price: Very reasonable, only 50–80 THB/bowl (approximately 35,000–55,000 VND), affordable for both tourists and locals.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nguyễn Thành Đông

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve eaten here four times now, and this is the first time I’ve been disappointed. The grilled chicken was surprisingly mushy and I couldn’t really finish it. I had ordered the same dish on a previous visit and enjoyed it so much that I made a point of ordering it again when I came back, but unfortunately it didn’t live up to my expectations this time.

The other dishes were still quite good and easy to enjoy, and the prices remain reasonable. Hopefully this was just an off day, as I’ve had much better experiences here before.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miin Q

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish we ordered was absolutely delicious and packed with authentic Thai flavour. You can tell it’s the real deal when you see locals dining in too. The menu has plenty of options to choose from, so there’s something for everyone. The restaurant has a great atmosphere inside. Warm and inviting, It’s on a corner, so parking can be a bit limited, but takeaway is also available if you're in a rush. Loved the busy street vibes outside! it adds to the whole Bangkok style experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lester Jones

restaurants.name: MASTER SEAFOOD PATTAYA
restaurants.address:

228 Walking St, Pattaya City, Pattaya, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Let me start by thanking Mr. Hüseyin, who took care of our table. It's a business located on Walking Street. Don't let the entrance fool you; the interior is very large. The atmosphere is wonderful. You feel like you're in Çeşme. The seafood is delicious. We went as a group. The highlight of the evening was when the waitress spilled a plate of salad on me :) Let's call it bad luck. The owners are Turkish. They've been running the business for 18 years. The owners also own another place called Turkish Master Kebab.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gezgin

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is amazing, especially in the evening when the sky is setting. The view is stunning; it's like you're eating the scenery while the food is delicious, especially the seafood. I wouldn't recommend the Western food, but the papaya salad is incredibly good. The person who makes it makes it truly amazing. I've eaten there twice already, today was my second visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: P.Patchareeyarar Prapasai

sample_reviews_en.text: The location is nice, the service is average, and the food is pretty good, BUT, very strangely, they charge extra for water, tea, bread, lemon, and ice. The guy in charge, Kamil, made a ridiculous comment like "We wouldn't charge if we didn't want to, but we do," and he seemed to be constantly high. So I wanted you to know. It's a very absurd situation.
sample_reviews_en.author: rapertuar12

sample_reviews_en.text: Worst seafood ever..not cook or overcooked .i had empty sea food tail in my plate for 2500 bath  . Terrible...they did not want to give money back or give a extra something..they dont care about customer , sitting on their reputation... Sad that i cant put 0 star ....view is the best and the place is very clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: francis picard

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is beautiful with a great atmosphere. The staff are attentive and provide excellent service; you don't need to keep calling them. The draft beer is incredibly cold and refreshing! The seafood wasn't very fresh, the fish had a strong fishy smell, but the spicy salads were delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: J D

sample_reviews_en.text: Avoid this place for delivery if your local as food will be delivered cold. Waited over 45 mins for 2 pizzas to be delivered to the bar next door for the food to arrive cold. Shocking service for a customer who orders here every holiday and I holiday in Pattaya 3/4 times a year. Won’t use again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kieran Beaver Foster

sample_reviews_en.text: Friends, the place is very nice and the food is delicious. The Turkish staff are very helpful, especially Mr. Kamil, we thank him very much. We came as a group of 4 friends and were very pleased, the food and service were excellent, we recommend it to everyone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vedat Ateş

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a wonderful place, fish and raki by the sea, it's amazing, you won't find fish and raki anywhere else, we searched for a long time and found it on our last evening, and there's a king of a brother there, Mr. Kamil from Izmir, he's a king of a man.
sample_reviews_en.author: CEMAL SOĞUKSULU

restaurants.name: Aksorn
restaurants.address:

The Original Store, Aksorn 1266 charoen krung rd 5th Floor, Central:, 1266 ถ. เจริญกรุง Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Michelin-starred! Aksorn: A feast for all five senses

A highlight of my stay in Bangkok was a visit to the Michelin-starred restaurant "Aksorn."
This restaurant offers a chef's choice course, rather than an à la carte option.
The course began with a rose apple appetizer, perfectly paired with shrimp paste, and a flavor that went perfectly with the drinks. The grilled chicken skewers that followed were also exquisite. I was particularly impressed by the crispy fried salad. It was packed with textures and flavors—a taste I personally really enjoyed.
The main course consisted of several curries, grilled beef, and soups, all served together in an authentic style, all eaten with rice. While some dishes were quite spicy, the milder dishes and soups, along with dishes like the fragrant smoked egg, neutralized the spiciness, creating a beautiful balance that made the meal delicious to the last bite.
The coconut crumble dessert, which concluded the meal, was also impressive in both aroma and texture. This is a famous restaurant that we can confidently recommend to anyone who wants to enjoy special, authentic Thai cuisine in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: MAP GPT

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had dinner at Aksorn in Bangkok, and it's safe to say it lives up to its Michelin star. The place runs on a fixed menu for about $150, which might sound steep, but it's worth every penny. What's really interesting is the Australian chef behind the traditional Thai menu, bringing a fresh take on classics. From starters right through to desserts, everything was spot on. The highlight for me was the steamed rice in the main course – the aroma alone was enough to make me overindulge. Ended up with a bit of a food coma and needed a coffee break to recover!

The curry deserves a mention too; it was fantastic without being too spicy. They tailor the spiciness to each diner, so you get to enjoy the flavors and a slight kick. I'm already planning to come back here whenever I want to introduce friends to authentic Thai cuisine.

As for the atmosphere, it's exactly what you'd expect from a Michelin-starred restaurant – impeccable service. Opting for the terrace seating was a great choice, with the cooler evening air and a bit of a breeze making for a perfect setting. Overall, it's a solid 5-star experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Summer Wang

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been meaning to come to a restaurant of David Thompsons in Bangkok .Ever since i went to a restaurant, he helped set up in Battambang ,Cambodia, many years ago .( Jaan Bai). The staff are a stand out for me .Kind ,efficient, and friendly .The Thai waiter who could discuss South Australian wines with me was amazing .I only tried OS menu  wines, which were exceptionally good .My favourite ? The French Pinot Noir,Brut Rose .
The food ? I expected it to be good, and I'm not just biased because David Thompson is Australian !  The food exceeded expectation.I regularly cook from David Thompson's Thai Street Food book .However ,one can not match the skill of  talented and skilled chefs.
The set menu was perfect for me as a single diner .There are a lot of dishes ,but not too many .
All beautifully presented .My favourite dish ... Mmmm sooo hard to choose !
The prawns ,tamarind with tea leaf was delightful ....a dish I could never replicate !
But I loved every mouthful of every dish .A true culinary adventure of the highest order .
It's not cheap ,but it's worth every baht !
sample_reviews_en.author: Veronica Arendtt

sample_reviews_en.text:
Aksorn is a charming restaurant and all dishes are well cooked and high in flavour: I was well taken care of by the staff.

The tasting menu has a variety of dishes; starting with three rather delicious one-bite appetizers (which probably would have more impact served together) - a main course served Thai style consisting of soup, salad, curry, relish, vegetables, eggs  served with rice.  This is a lovely combination of flavours and everything was well executed. The dessert course served in two courses was also delicious and very authentic in both flavours and textures.

Overall I had a nice evening - yet when the bill arrived Did something wring: The price quality - with water and then the n glass of wine the bill came to 4900 BHT (USD 130). That's equivalent to the price level of David Thompson Aaharn in Hong Kong: The menu there contains more variety and uses more upscale products in a more exquisite location.
For what was put on the table, on a global scale, Aksorn is about 20% overpriced in my opinion.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Wijman

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing Experience!
The food, wine, service and setting with open kitchen is great! I really enjoyed the open kitchen watching the service and interactions of the kitchen team. Growing up in a restaurant family and working in them is great to see.
The food is amazing, really strong and bold Thai flavours. Surprisingly the fried tomato salad was my pick of the night (with flavours that just smack you in the face!!), though only slightly ahead of the red curry.
The wine list has a great variety with a mix of prices, I think a lot of the higher end Bangkok restaurants price themselves out of being somewhere you would visit regularly due to wine prices and thankfully this is somewhere we can regularly visit!!
So I went in being a huge fan of Chef Thompson and left just as big a fan if not bigger fan after was able to share a 15 minute chat with him.

They may have fixed now, but google maps might send you a block away. But the entrance is at the Central: The Original Store.
sample_reviews_en.author: D

sample_reviews_en.text:
Most disappointing Michelin star experience I’ve had. They only have a tasting menu at 4150 baht and pairing menu. That’s not a price I’d expect to see for a one star Michelin restaurant unless it was that good.

Most dishes were good and I could see the innovation and preparation that went into it. The rest however really seemed to force flavour combinations that do not work. I was a bit stunned when I had this. The other thing was that the shop mentions reviving traditional taste and I’ve tried to taste Thai flavours but it wasn’t there. It was more of a Vietnamese touch to it if anything. It would help if they explained how but that was amiss.

The last point has to do with price. At that price lọt I’m expecting perfection or a level or two lower. I’ve tried several other joints at one star and they are much better and cheaper. The difference between the two is that the this restaurant uses high quality ingredients. The others make high quality dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alan Huynh

sample_reviews_en.text:
This one-Michelin-star restaurant specializes in authentic, locally inspired Thai cuisine. The dishes are characterized by bold flavors and intensity. The open kitchen layout allowed us to observe and smell the food being prepared, adding to the overall experience.

We were served a tasting menu featuring several courses. The three appetizers were notably interesting; while the shell dish was somewhat chewy, the accompanying sauce was nicely made. The other two appetizers were particularly delicious.

The main course consisted of six shared dishes, presented in a traditional Thai style. The rice was expertly cooked with an enticing aroma, and all the dishes were flavorful. One dish was notably spicy but still tasty.

For dessert, we enjoyed Thai-style treats, especially the Thai pretzels, which we found delightful.

The service was great. All staff were friendly and helpful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutharin Phusitphoykai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dining at Aksorn was truly an unforgettable experience. From the moment I stepped in, I felt a genuine sense of warmth and care that made the evening incredibly special. It wasn’t just a meal, it was a celebration of Thai culture, flavors, and hospitality.

The team made me feel so welcome and valued, creating an atmosphere that was both refined and deeply personal. A special thank you to Chef David, whose passion and creativity shine through every dish. The food was absolutely amazing, each course felt like a journey across Thailand, allowing me to taste flavors from different regions while staying true to the restaurant’s beautiful theme.

Every detail, from the presentation to the storytelling behind the dishes, was thoughtful and memorable. Aksorn is more than a restaurant; it’s an experience I’ll cherish and happily return to. Thank you for such a wonderful evening.
sample_reviews_en.author: Divya Chaitanya

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited an izakaya while wandering through Charoen Nakhon, and I'm thrilled I did! The atmosphere was inviting and laid-back, making it an ideal spot for a casual meal. I decided to try their sashimi and sushi along with some ramen, and every dish was delightful. The freshness of the seafood really stood out, and the noodles had an authentic taste that left me wanting more.

The service was exceptional too. The staff greeted us with enthusiasm and maintained a cheerful attitude throughout, which made the experience even more enjoyable 😊. As for the price, it was quite reasonable considering the quality and variety of Japanese dishes available, perfect for sharing with friends or family.

With such a warm ambiance and satisfying menu, I'd definitely recommend this izakaya to anyone visiting the Charoen Nakhon area! Can't wait to return and explore more of their offerings.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yotsaphat

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a great experience when I stopped by this place after noticing it while passing through the area. The moment I walked in, the lively and welcoming atmosphere caught my attention. The staff were energetic and bright, making the whole dining experience even more enjoyable.

We ordered some grilled dishes, which were incredibly delicious and made me eager to try more from their menu. It's a true izakaya experience with a variety of Japanese favorites, perfect for sharing with friends. The dishes were served promptly, and the overall vibe was fun and vibrant.

Located in SENAFEST, this spot offers an array of Japanese dishes from classic izakaya staples to more elaborate options, all at a reasonable price. I look forward to returning soon, perhaps with family or colleagues, to explore the menu further and enjoy another wonderful evening out! 😊

sample_reviews_en.text:
I walked past and was drawn to the food, so I stopped in to try it without much planning. The atmosphere was clean, inviting, and much more comfortable than I expected. The staff were attentive and polite, making me feel good from the moment I entered 😊

I ordered sashimi, sushi, desserts, and drinks. Everything was delicious! The Japanese food was very well-made, with a wide variety of dishes ranging from appetizers to izakaya-style main courses. It was a very enjoyable and worthwhile experience!

If I'm in the area again, I'd definitely come back. It's perfect for coming with friends or family. For anyone looking for an izakaya in the Charoen Nakhon area with a great atmosphere and delicious food, this place is ideal.

sample_reviews_en.text: First time filling up here. At 3:08 PM, I clearly ordered 1,000 baht, but I overfilled by more than two hundred baht. The male employee said he heard it was full. The guy was the one who asked me what it was a second time. If he couldn't hear clearly, why didn't he ask again? Why did he hesitate? Were we afraid of being scolded? And if we made a mistake and got even more scolded, weren't we more afraid of the latter? They didn't take any responsibility for this mistake, other than a fake apology for their insensitive behavior towards the customer. Even though there weren't many cars in the gas station, I saw no more than two cars filling up. How could there be such a mistake? I turned around and was confused because I heard the nozzle pop. Why was it so much over? Are 1,000 and full tank the same thing? I called the company at 3:13 PM, but no one answered. Maybe it was a holiday. If you see this post, please contact me.

sample_reviews_en.text: It will please those who love crispy pork. It's not hard or tough. They give you big pieces and it's very delicious. The shrimp fried rice has many shrimps. As for me, I'll probably keep the crispy pork as usual. 😅 There are always people coming in. People who eat noodles can eat first because it's made quickly. Made-to-order rice takes a bit longer. sample_reviews_en.text:
This boat noodle shop is delicious and has been open for a very long time. They serve both beef and pork, starting at 19 baht per bowl, but I recommend ordering the special for 55 baht (especially if you like stewed beef or liver – it's really sweet!).

But the real highlight I highly recommend is the papaya salad – I think it's incredibly flavorful and spicy. The stewed pork basil rice is also delicious, and you can finish your savory meal with fried bananas.

There's parking in front and next to the shop. Recommended by locals. Prices start at 19, 50, and 70 baht.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The boat noodles with pork and beef were delicious. The broth was fragrant and served perfectly, almost no need for seasoning. The chili was very spicy. Other dishes I recommend are the crispy pork basil stir-fry and the braised pork basil stir-fry, both incredibly delicious. The papaya salad was decent, with a good balance of sweet, sour, and salty flavors. Overall, it was a good, filling meal. They also have fried bananas, which were okay. If you're passing through Pattaya, I highly recommend this place. Delicious!
Rating: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️✅

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good food, but the service was painfully slow—and no one informed us about the delay.

I went with my family and we ordered around 7–8 dishes. Most arrived fine, but two items—the stir-fried vegetables and a fish dish—took an unusually long time. When I followed up, we were told they had run out of gas in the kitchen, which explained the delay. By then, we were already quite full.

What surprised me was that no one informed us earlier. A simple heads-up would’ve helped manage expectations instead of leaving us waiting and wondering.

When the vegetable dish finally arrived, I asked to cancel the fish since we had almost finished everything else. The staff asked if we could still eat it or take it home. Honestly, if I hadn’t been with my family and trying not to make a scene, I would’ve cancelled it. The delay was extreme and we were never notified in advance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pabavin Thavorrasen

sample_reviews_en.text:
I met up with friends in the Ari area for a delicious meal, and this time we wanted Vietnamese food, so we came to this restaurant. Since there were several of us, we made a reservation beforehand. We arrived on a public holiday around 11:00 AM, and the restaurant wasn't too crowded. The staff provided excellent service.
The food came out quickly, and everything tasted delicious, living up to the Iberry reputation. We were a large group, and I thought the prices would be higher, but they weren't. Divided among us, it came out to just over 500 baht per person, which is very reasonable considering the large number of dishes we ordered.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chom K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Vietnamese restaurant with a spacious, comfortable atmosphere—perfect for gatherings with friends or family. It’s especially great for anyone who enjoys Vietnamese cuisine that highlights fresh vegetables and clean, easy-to-eat flavors.

The standout dishes include the fragrant and well-balanced pho, the generous nem nuong platter packed with fresh greens, and a variety of crispy fried items that are done really well—light, not greasy, and very enjoyable. Altogether, it’s a solid choice for a relaxed meal with refreshing Vietnamese flavors adapted to suit Thai tastes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumol

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is nice, and there's also Fran's restaurant. Some dishes are delicious, like the crispy spring rolls with shrimp, but the recommended dishes weren't to my liking, such as the fried fish with chili sauce, the cockles with Vietnamese coriander, and the grilled pork skewers. I liked the Vietnamese egg coffee. Parking is available with coupons for each table, but only for 2 hours. In summary, it's better than eating at La Villa's because the atmosphere here is much better, even though you have to drive to get there as it's located in a small side street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Priyatat Orm

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ate at Ang Keum today. We ordered a lot because there were 7 of us, so we got to try many dishes.

The food was delicious, clean, and suited Thai tastes. Everything was tasty.
The vegetables were very fresh and clean, and the dipping sauces were good, not too sweet. None of the dishes were overly sweet.

Reservations are possible; the restaurant has plenty of tables.
Parking is a bit difficult as spaces are limited.
However, they do have valet parking.

I recommend coming around 10 am or on a weekday,
and avoiding lunch and dinner times.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattamon s

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm always impressed with the iBerry chain of restaurants. The prices are standard for the iBerry chain.
The Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage) is flavorful, and the dipping sauce is perfectly seasoned to suit Thai tastes.
The fried pork sausage is delicious and very crispy.
The ice cream is refreshing and a great palate cleanser.
I really like the atmosphere of the restaurant. It feels private, spacious, and has a garden feel, yet it's in the heart of Ari. It's like escaping to the countryside. I love it! 🥰
