sample_reviews_en.author: Kulaya Jirapaet Guardian

restaurants.name: Khao Kha Mu Nai Kuang
restaurants.address:

337 Charoen Krung 43 Alley, Si Phraya, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a legendary old-school braised pork knuckle restaurant. I've been eating here since it first opened 40-50 years ago. Mr. Kwang is still going strong. The braised pork knuckle broth is traditional, salty with a hint of sweetness, and a faint taste of pickled cabbage. The meat is tender and melts in your mouth, and the fat and skin are delicious. The pork knuckle and pork trotters are excellent and highly recommended. The intestines are especially amazing, a perfect 110/100! The soup is also refreshing. The yellow chili dipping sauce complements the braised pork knuckle perfectly, as many people praise. The prices are affordable.
This is a legendary restaurant I highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: natty1 ae

sample_reviews_en.text: This simple braised pork leg rice shop is near TCDC and the Bangkok Folk Museum. It's hot inside, so you can sit at the tables or order takeout. The flavor is delicious and well-balanced, both the meat and the skin. The meat is tender and not chewy, and the skin is fragrant and fatty. Eating them together has a chocolatey texture. The highlight is the yellow chili sauce with visible Thai garlic cloves. The pickled vegetables and spicy green chilies make this dish delicious to the last bite.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rapee Suveeranont

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you like authentic Chinese-style braised pork knuckle with a salty, not sweet, flavor, you must try Nai Kwang Braised Pork Knuckle. This kind of flavor is hard to find in Thailand; it's distinctly different from other places.
The pickled vegetables are delicious and pair perfectly with the braised pork knuckle.
The atmosphere is untouched by modern trends, maintaining the original charm of a traditional shophouse.
Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ankana SUEPRASERTSITHI

sample_reviews_en.text: Nai Kwang's Braised Pork Leg Rice is another must-try restaurant in the Bang Rak area. It's located in an alley opposite the Bang Rak Central Post Office. Every time I eat there, I always order the braised pork leg and intestines with extra rice. The braised pork leg is perfectly seasoned, and the chili vinegar sauce is delicious. They also serve seaweed soup and tea. You have to try it to believe how good it is! I give it 5 stars!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasin Saitanmanee

sample_reviews_en.text: The flavor is sweet and salty, but not overly sweet. The pork wasn't very tender today, but still chewy, not tough. Last month, the app seemed to be down, so I had to order from a famous place near Lertsin Hospital. I used to eat there when my dad was a kid; the pork leg broth was extremely sweet. I don't know how those reviewers make it sound so delicious. (Going off-topic again.)
sample_reviews_en.author: ชวภณ ปัญญารัตนชัย

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant's braised pork has a unique flavor.
When you eat it, you can feel certain spices lingering on the back of your throat.
This flavor is still present, but slightly fainter.
It's a salty braised pork, not sweet, with tender meat and soft skin.

Don't expect much from the service.

The atmosphere is just like a typical shophouse restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisby

sample_reviews_en.text: Temptation by delicious smell, accidentally took lunch here. Very tasty, fast served and cosy place. Even though it was hot weather, inside of restaurant was comfortable. Strongly recommend. Khao Kha Mu is the signature menu at this restaurant, this is stewed pork with boiled egg and vegetables. Typical Thai food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khun Yai Choopwat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overview: This is an old, established restaurant located in an alley opposite the Central Post Office.
Taste: Personally, I like pork knuckle, and the restaurant's pork knuckle was said to be delicious, especially with their special dipping sauce which was rich and flavorful. It's a good place to have a meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gerald King

restaurants.name: Fusions RESTAURANT AND BAR
restaurants.address:

52 Sam Sen Rd, Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I keep coming back every day and the food never disappoints. The Shan noodles were full of flavor, and the Nepali dishes I tried were just as delicious. What I love most is the variety .You can choose from Thai, Nepali, Indian, and Burmese  food all in one place. The staff are friendly, and the atmosphere is warm and comfortable. Whether you're looking for a regular lunch spot or want to try something new, this restaurant is a great choice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Niran Khanal

sample_reviews_en.text: Heyy this is the place too Good,,it's small but   amazing place, In Fusions foods and drinks available so good. Me and my friends enjoyed it alot in this place,We had enjoy with Happy hours ☺️ have a mini live music too 👍 👍 👍 Good,,,highly recommend the place ,  yes guys Come and touch this place you will never forget the place.  NEVER TRY NEVER KNOW,,   Let's enjoy
sample_reviews_en.author: Wisanuluitel Tel

sample_reviews_en.text: I was intrigued by this little place with its excellent 5 out of 5 rating and numerous reviews. And I can confirm it: a fantastic place to discover, with delicious Thai and Bieman dishes made fresh to order, all at very reasonable prices. I opted for stir-fried vegetables and a paratha tonight, but I'll definitely be back to try the Mohinga, their specialty!
sample_reviews_en.author: Klervi Dalibot

sample_reviews_en.text: Fusion Cafe & Bar is a perfect blend of comfort and flavor. I tried the potato cheese balls—crispy on the outside, soft and cheesy inside—and they were absolutely delicious. Paired with a smooth, rich cappuccino, it made the experience even better. Cozy vibes, great taste, and a place I’d happily visit again. Highly recommended! ☕✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Sagar Nepal

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're looking for a delightful mix of flavor, atmosphere, and top-notch service, The Tasty Table is a must-visit. From the moment you walk in, the warm lighting and modern rustic décor create a cozy yet elegant vibe, perfect for both casual lunches and special dinners.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aung Myo Oo

sample_reviews_en.text:
YOU SHALL NOT PASS (WITHOUT TRYING THE PARATHA LATE KOTE) 🥙

Kumar welcomed us with open arms in the sweetest most genuine way possible - A gentleman from the beginning and the food; so delicious to match, cooked by his loving mother.

10/10 do not miss out
sample_reviews_en.author: Jamie Prendiville

sample_reviews_en.text: Six of us, trusting the positive reviews, stopped at this small, simple, and unassuming restaurant for dinner. We were surprised by the quality of the home-cooked food and the family-like welcome. The Thai Cashew Chicken is highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrea Pillonca

sample_reviews_en.text: Really cheap, really lovely food. As suggested by the name they have a wide variety of dishes from around southeast asia - me and my girlfriend both had Mohiga - the national dish of Myanmar - which was really good, and we had a long …
sample_reviews_en.author: Aiden Baker-Stanley

restaurants.name: Nong Max Thai Food
restaurants.address:

2 32 Soi Ari 1, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a restaurant located in the middle of an alley.

There are about 20 tables for seating.

We ate there in the evening; it was quite busy, but the wait wasn't too long, only about two or three groups.

The food didn't take too long to arrive.

The taste of the food was decent.

The Thai papaya salad and grilled chicken with dipping sauce were delicious.

The fermented fish papaya salad wasn't quite as flavorful as I'd hoped.

The beef waterfall salad had slightly tough beef, but the taste was good.

The atmosphere is great for chilling out, enjoying Northeastern Thai food with a beer, or just hanging out with colleagues.

For those arriving by car, parking is available in the parking garage in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: ben s.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Isan restaurant is located in the Ari area. The shop is clean, has sturdy covered seating, and a relaxed atmosphere. The food comes out quickly. The Jaew dipping sauce is delicious, salty-spicy. I ordered the Korat papaya salad with mild spice, which was exactly as advertised. The grilled small intestines were delicious. The pork was grilled to perfect tenderness, not too thick. The grilled beef was also tender, neither too raw nor too tough. The Tom Zap soup was a bit too salty today. (If you come to this restaurant, the food is very spicy. If you don't like spicy food, you have to tell them.)

(If you come to this restaurant, the food will be spicy. If you don't like spicy food, be sure to let them know.)
sample_reviews_en.author: UgZilla

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was heading to this area (Ari) to dine at a different restaurant but this restaurant (Nong Max) was an amazing discovery!!

The food was outstanding!!  The server (Max - owner?) was an incredible asset to this restaurant. He explained to us that it might take up to 30 minutes before we were served our food. This is one of the finest restaurants I have eaten in Bangkok in over 8 years of living here. The food is great, the service is great, and the prices are GREAT (three people with drinks for a 1000 baht - exceptional!!)…..I can’t wait to go back!!
sample_reviews_en.author: John ONeil

sample_reviews_en.text:
A somtum (papaya salad) restaurant in Ari that serves incredibly delicious and flavorful grilled pork neck.
- The grilled pork neck and grilled beef are tasty, while the crying tiger beef is sometimes good and sometimes just okay, depending on the grill chef.
- There's plenty of seating, and it's always crowded. Sometimes you might have to wait a little while for your food if it's busy.
- The food prices are reasonable, not overly expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alkaline

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was delicious, everyone! ✨ 100/10
The papaya salad with crab, fermented fish sauce, and pickled shellfish was amazing. The papaya salad had a great flavor. The restaurant was clean, the food was delicious, and the staff provided good service. In the picture is our food; we ordered many dishes, and the total price was only 640 baht.

I loved it so much! I highly recommend it to your friends. The food is delicious! ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: wannalak Wawkratok

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve been to this Esan food restaurant twice now, and the food is good and authentic. It’s simple but good.

I love their grilled chicken, duck larb, and papaya salad with salted eggs. You can ask the staff to adjust the spice level to your preference.

It gets crowded around 6 p.m. onwards, but they have plenty of seating.

They also serve Singha, Chang beer, and other drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chen E.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food took a very long time to arrive. We were seated before the table next to us, who arrived later, and they received the same food we ordered. So we asked about our order, and the staff said, "Next time, you should make a reservation." We then asked the table next to us if they had made a reservation, and they said they had walked in as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: doh41wtk2024 wtk

sample_reviews_en.text:
On a rainy day with heavy traffic, there's a Laab (spicy minced meat salad) restaurant in Ari called Nong Max. I recommend the tomato soup (my favorite).

Other items on the menu include: Pork with chili powder, Corn salad, Bamboo shoot soup, Fried chicken, Minced pork salad, and more.

Feel free to try whatever interests you!
sample_reviews_en.author: Weeraphong Kangwannavakul

restaurants.name: The Moon Cuisine
restaurants.address:

395 397 Rama IX Rd, Bang Kapi, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a follow-up from the Thonglor branch.
It's practically one of my regular restaurants! ^^

The fresh fish maw soup in red broth is amazing! Just as delicious as always. The broth is creamy, fragrant, and incredibly flavorful. The fish maw is wonderfully chewy with a great texture and no fishy aftertaste. I love it!

The char siu (roasted pork) is fragrant, tender, and not greasy, just like the Hong Kong style.

The crispy pork belly is incredibly crunchy, not too fatty, and perfectly seasoned.

The stir-fried spinach with salt is a must-order! Don't miss it! It's incredibly delicious and very different from other restaurants.

The roast goose is like the Hong Kong style, with crispy skin and no gamey taste. The chef is amazing! A little plumpness in the plump goose sauce makes it perfect.

The crispy shrimp noodle soup is a perfect combination. The shrimp is plump, the crispy batter is great, and the sauce is intensely flavorful – don't pour too much at once!

You absolutely have to try it! ^^ So delicious!

The staff are also incredibly attentive and have excellent service minds.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pj Mj

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant looks nice, beautiful, and has a good atmosphere. The staff are also good, although service was a bit slow, but nothing too bothersome, except for the takeout packaging.

- The roast duck was delicious!
- The pork scala was okay.
- The char siu (roasted pork) was average, not bad.
- The Yangzhou fried rice looked a bit strange, but not bad.

- The shrimp dumplings had an off smell.
- The steamed pork ribs with black bean sauce and plum sauce were very small portions, mostly bone, and not tasty.
- The char siu buns had a strong papery smell.
- The char siu rice noodle rolls were terrible. I've never seen rice noodle rolls made like this anywhere else. They need to learn how to make them better!
- The preserved spinach with century egg was a complete failure. It tasted awful and was bitter.

One more complaint: For the leftovers I took home, the staff packed them up without any dipping sauces or condiments. I had to eat them dry.

Considering the quality, the price is quite high.
sample_reviews_en.author: JR V.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. The fluffy scrambled rice with chili and salt was amazing (I didn't take a picture of the food). The chive dumplings were also delicious. The staff provided excellent service; they constantly checked on us and refilled our water without us having to ask. The atmosphere was nice, the seating was comfortable, and the air conditioning was cool.
sample_reviews_en.author: ลลิตภัทร มินามิ

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were all very friendly and smiling, truly lovely. The food was reasonably priced. I especially loved the lotus leaf-wrapped rice; the rice was soft, the flavor was just right—not too sweet, perfectly balanced. The fried chives were also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุประวีณ์ วรกุลธิรัตน์

sample_reviews_en.text:
This branch is bigger and more comfortable than the Thonglor branch.
Good atmosphere, good service, convenient parking.
As for the food, there's not much to say. Everyone who's been here before will definitely come back again. Every dish is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: roungrevee opassathavorn

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my second time eating here. All the food is delicious and suits my taste. I especially love the stir-fried green beans and the salt and pepper fried tofu. The staff are also very friendly and provide excellent service. 🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Mifa Chanyakan

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a roasted goose. This menu is very rare in Chinese restaurants here. I ordered a small size but it is a lot for 2 persons. I recommend for 3-4 persons and try with egg noodles soup with wanton.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ladda Kovitthammakorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice chinese food, and really convenient if your hotel is nearby.
👍👍
They open from 5 pm on (before they close at 1pm, but not sure at what time they open the first time)
sample_reviews_en.author: Luis Araiza

restaurants.name: Sweety Restaurant สวีทตี้ เรสเตอรองก์
restaurants.address:

694/2 Soi Phaya Nak, Khwaeng Thanon Phetchaburi, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Why 5 stars? Basically cos I was comfortable having a simple meal in a quiet environment within what seems to be a family run restaurant.

While the location may be obscured in a lane adjacent to the Hotel Asia (off Ratchathewi BTS station), not many non locals would adventure in the evening (except me).

Regardless throughout my meal, I’ve noticed the constant flow of delivery orders coming in.

Ordered a Phad Thai, Som Tum and a squid &  pork salad. All ingredients were fresh and the taste was surprisingly fabulous to my taste bud.

Food was filling to my heart’s content.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sean Y

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have visited Bangkok many times over the past 10 years.  But this was my first visit that focused on back alleyways.   Getting away from the noise, traffic and congestion.

The atmosphere here is simple, the food is good and comforting  and  the staff/owner very pleasant.

If you are looking for clean, honest and authentic thai food experience, be sure to give Sweety Restaurant a try.

We tried a number of dishes including pork fried rice, cilantro minced beef, Thom Yum soup with shrimp, Papaya Salad with salted egg and a fried chicken nuggets dish (my least favorite).
sample_reviews_en.author: dan stewart

sample_reviews_en.text:
I travelled a whole day and arrived here for my first meal
It was simply satisfying

Ordered 4 dishes and they were all really super for me and my husband

Pad thai is al dente style but really flavourful
Tom yum soup was just right in spiciness for me and prawn is fresh
The salted egg papaya salad was a first time try for me
Its interesting combination very appetising

The minced pork omelette was really good. Fragrant crispy. It’s really very satisfying

Even the white rice was fragrant

Happy
sample_reviews_en.author: Katherine Happiest

sample_reviews_en.text:
It suits Korean tastes perfectly.

The fried shrimp is insane; you absolutely must order it. The morning glory goes without saying.

The staff, including the man with glasses and the elderly lady, are all incredibly kind.

The street leading here feels a bit out of place, but once you enter, it is so clean and peaceful.

I visited around 1 PM; it was even better because there weren't many people, giving it the feel of a hidden local gem. I actually prefer it because there aren't many tourists.
sample_reviews_en.author: 장희주

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located in a lively area, though it's a bit far from the station. The staff's service was polite and not at all rude. However, one of the dishes we ordered never arrived. The stir-fried dishes were watery, suggesting the chef lacked experience. Despite this, the prices were rather high. The beer was well-chilled and delicious, so perhaps this place is more for drinking than for a meal. Overall, it was a disappointing experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: 雨露市徳雄

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food, cool air conditioning, good service. They have cocktails and blended drinks at very good prices, not expensive at all. Comfortable seating.

Everything is great! Delicious food and nice alcoholic drinks. Reasonable price. The cook and the shop lady do not speak English. Please be kind to communicate with them. (You can use Google Translate or just show them a picture of the food you want.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Nam Malisa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent experience dining here. I’m not great at Thai and misunderstood a dish for being chicken pad see ew, when it was actually pork pad see ew.

The auntie corrected me and then allowed the pad see ew chicken order to happen, and at 60 baht it was a great value!

Loved their prik nam plaa (Thai chilis in fish sauce) and their free WiFi. Great family-run spot that I will continue to support.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anish Thakkar (Doc Thakkar)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went in for a soda and the food being served looked superb. Constant stream or delivery orders. That combined with helpful service meant we stayed to order some food.

Tried the crispy pork with Basil. Very very tasty with a rich sauce. Nicely set of with a cold beer, straight from the fridge with a sleeve. Would happily return to try some of the other dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Derek Heap

restaurants.name: ครัวตามตะวันเบียร์วุ้น
restaurants.address:

Bang Chak, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This cute little restaurant serves delicious food with a secret menu that changes every month. The service is great, the prices are excellent, and the atmosphere is chill. Importantly, there's parking available. And the owner (Auntie Tangmo) is lovely, taking care of the customers herself. I highly recommend this place for my meals! (They also have frozen beer and homemade wine from Ranong!)
sample_reviews_en.author: Yeening Chen

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and there's a wide variety of dishes. The owner is lovely and kind. I especially loved the garlic pork and the stir-fried Gnetum leaves with egg was excellent. I just ate there, and thinking about it makes me hungry again! They also have special seasonal dishes, which I really appreciate. It's clean, delicious, and they even have ice-cold beer.
sample_reviews_en.author: B

sample_reviews_en.text:
A restaurant with chilled beer.
Today I ordered the bitter melon salad with fresh shrimp, it was delicious and had a unique flavor.
Another recommended dish is the stir-fried shiitake mushrooms with soy sauce, very tasty.
And another dish I recommend is the stir-fried three-pungent vegetables, fragrant and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Surasak Chaiburum

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything on the menu is delicious. I've been here many times, and so far, nothing I've ordered has been disappointing. The portion sizes are just right, and it's even better with the refreshing jelly beer – pure bliss! The owner is also very lovely. I highly recommend trying it; you'll be hooked!
sample_reviews_en.author: Veerachai Soottitantawat

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, I especially loved the stir-fried pork with shrimp paste. Other dishes were also tasty. The seating is comfortable, the air conditioning is cool, the beer is ice cold, and there's parking in front of the condo.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akarapat Paisarnthitikl

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fried rice with kale and salted fish: Excellent.
Spicy green bean salad with fresh shrimp: Very tasty, the restaurant added large dried shrimp. Excellent.
Pork sausage with beer: Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside. Excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: sunee nitaskusol

sample_reviews_en.text: Salt and pepper shrimp heads, bitter melon salad with fresh shrimp, and french fries were all incredibly delicious! The restaurant has a very homey atmosphere, just like a Japanese restaurant, and the music was great.
sample_reviews_en.author: berry. warin

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food at reasonable prices. The chrysanthemum tea is refreshingly cold and bubbly. Highly recommended! The shop is located in Udomsuk Soi 29.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suphaphorn Sukphoung

restaurants.name: Mu Yo Champa Thong Bistro
restaurants.address:

QGPC+74Q, 300 Amnuay Songkhram Rd, Thanon Nakhon Chai Si, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Vietnamese restaurant offers a variety of easy-to-eat dishes with good flavor. Parking is available along the sidewalk near the Phichai intersection. Service is fast, and dishes are served with vegetables as a side. The restaurant is a single shophouse with about 5-6 tables.
It gets quite busy around lunchtime.
- The clear broth Vietnamese noodle soup is easy to eat, with tender pork and soft, chewy noodles.
- The fried fermented pork salad is flavorful.
- The steamed rice rolls are delicious, and the spicy dipping sauce helps balance the richness.
- The fried spring rolls have a crispy wrapper (seems to be served with the same dipping sauce as the steamed rice rolls).
- The pan-fried eggs are also good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawarin Punyawajee

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old, authentic Vietnamese restaurant in the Dusit area. You can easily get there by taking the MRT to Bang Sue station and then a bus.
It was moderately busy during lunchtime, but the food came out quickly. I tried the Vietnamese noodle soup (Cup Yuan), which was delicious; the broth was flavorful and easy to drink. It starts at 50 baht. The steamed rice rolls in soup were also tasty. The Nem Nuong (grilled pork skewers) was pre-wrapped and ready to eat, which was great. The Vietnamese pork sausage was excellent; I had to buy some to take home, 130 baht per stick. (Jan 26) Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tang Raksat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, clean, and the portions are just right. The prices are reasonable, the service is good and fast, and the owner is polite and friendly.

The steamed rice rolls are soft and chewy, melting in your mouth.

The spicy pork sausage salad has a perfect balance of sour and spicy (with bird's eye chili, fragrant and not sweet).

The fresh and fried spring rolls are generously filled.

The Vietnamese noodle soup is hot and refreshing, with a sweet broth made from pork bones. The pork ribs are tender and melt in your mouth, and the cartilage is so soft it's almost like tendons.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yawidtha watdhanakul

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is highly recommended for its Ubon-style pork sausage, which is delicious whether steamed, fried, or in a salad. Their Vietnamese noodle soup (Khao Piak) and Tom Yum soup are also excellent, with chewy noodles and a rich, savory flavor – a must-try! They also have other delicious dishes like shrimp wrapped in sugarcane, fresh spring rolls, and Vietnamese steamed rice rolls. There are many tasty options on the menu. It's best to come with a group and order a variety of dishes to try everything. Parking can be a bit difficult.
sample_reviews_en.author: rak neo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kind and helpful owner, they have English menu. Quite small portions. We tried three dishes: soup (small portion), fried spring rolls cut in pieces (small amount and almost no filling, mostly crunchy dough), and rice paper rolls with veggies and pork.
180 baht for 2 people to snack at lunch. It was tasty , I would try more dishes from menu. Looks well organized and good hygiene 👍

There is no conditioner, it’s very hot to sit there.
sample_reviews_en.author: A S

sample_reviews_en.text: This is another noodle shop that breaks away from the usual... those who have tried it will understand... noodles with pork sausage... the broth is so hot you can sip it... it's delicious. If you're passing by this way, it's near the Phichai intersection. Besides noodles, they have many other dishes like Vietnamese spring rolls, sugarcane shrimp... oh... many more things. Go and try them!
sample_reviews_en.author: จอมพจน์ ศรีสุพรรณราช

sample_reviews_en.text: This Vietnamese restaurant in the heart of Bangkok serves delicious steamed rice rolls (my mom from Ubon Ratchathani confirms this!). I personally recommend the "Pak Mo Lui Nam" (steamed rice rolls with broth), the soup is flavorful, and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tatchai Titichetrakun

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been coming here for pork sausage noodles since I was little. My dad used to bring me. I've loved pork sausage since I was small, and now they add it to the noodle soup, which makes the broth delicious. Nowadays they also have …
sample_reviews_en.author: NATT SK

restaurants.name: Dino Papa Express X Parabola ice cream
restaurants.address:

โรงอาหาร มจธ Bang Mot, Thung Khru, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I was so hungry today and had a special craving for chicken. I ordered through Line Man, and it was like the delivery guy knew I was hangry! He delivered it to my doorstep in no time. The chicken was still piping hot. When I opened the bag, the chicken pieces were huge! I was so happy. There was even a little note attached – the restaurant really thought it through, so thoughtful and understanding of the current situation… I was smiling. The chicken was delicious as always, and the pickled radish was tasty too. In short, it was amazing! For anyone who hasn't tried it yet, order it! It's totally worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุทธิพร ใจใหญ่

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant that my boyfriend recommended, I have to take him to eat here.
A small, cute Korean fried chicken restaurant in an alley behind Suan Mak Market, "Dino Papa". Korean fried chicken, big pieces, full bites, many flavors to choose from, available to buy individually or in a very worthwhile set.

Today, the set I chose was a 279 baht set, 10 pieces of fried chicken + rice + soup (I really like the soup, I ordered an additional bowl for 15 baht) + pickled radish + French fries, I ordered an additional bowl of kimchi, everything was delicious, very full.

Thank you, my boyfriend ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Saowalak .P

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dino Papa is a small Korean style fried chicken place that mainly serves chicken bowls with rice. I ordered a fried chicken and rice bowl, and overall, I was very impressed. The chicken was crispy on the outside and juicy inside, and the sauce tasted flavorful and went well with the rice , and the food felt freshly made. restaurants.name: etcha
restaurants.address:

7th Floor, Chatrium Grand Bangkok, 728 Phetchaburi Rd, Khwaeng Thanon Phetchaburi, Khet Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If fine dining had a personality — ETCHA would be the charming genius with a wild heart.

Every dish was like going on a blind date with a flavor you didn’t know you’d fall in love with.
Squid with basil and caviar? Yes please. Mustard ice cream? Who knew spicy could be sexy?
Even the bread came with a backstory (hi, bai khee lek breadstick 👋).

And just when I thought the meal was over, boom — kitchen tour!
It looked more like a spaceship than a kitchen. Shiny. Organized. Cooler than my apartment.
The stock room? I swear I saw ingredients that had better skincare routines than I do.

Turns out, Chef Giacomo doesn’t just “order” ingredients. He goes on adventures across Thailand to grow, forage, and sometimes probably wrestle wild herbs into submission.

If you like food that’s serious about taste but doesn’t take itself too seriously — ETCHA is your place.
Book it. Eat it. Tell your therapist about it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tammawit Limlertcharoenvanich

sample_reviews_en.text:
Okay (not great) meal overall. We came in excited by the restaurant’s creative reputation but left somewhat underwhelmed, especially given the price point.

The main course was beautifully presented, but the flavor and preparation weren’t to our taste, and we ultimately didn’t finish the mains. When the server checked in, we mentioned it wasn’t our favorite dish, but there wasn’t a follow-up.

During the kitchen tour, we saw the pigeon aging room with birds hanging upside down in the freezer. I understand this is standard practice in meat preparation, but it was a bit jarring. Pigeon is an adventurous thing to serve at a restaurant - and that might appeal to some diners.. it just wasn’t for us.

On a positive note, one standout dish was the seafood based pappardelle, which was memorable!

Overall, an interesting experience with moments of creativity, but felt pricey for what we received.
sample_reviews_en.author: AZ

sample_reviews_en.text: The chef did show a lot of skills both in making a coherent taste and incorporating local flavors and ingredients.  There were some miss dishes but I think overall it was a great meal where one can see a lot of thought put into.  The amount or ingredients sourcing and R&D must be enormous.  What impresses me the most was how organized the kitchen is.  They took us towards the end to see the kitchen and I was amazed at how clean and tidy it was kept while all the commotion still goes on.   The restaurant was nicely decorated but it’s situated in a not so fine hotel so the view and the outside setting wasn’t up there.  Having said that I must say it’s like being transformed into another world once inside.  A great place to visit , and I am curious to go back for the next menu
sample_reviews_en.author: Monk Monk

sample_reviews_en.text: Had a wonderful dining experience here last night. The ambiance was great, with good music and interesting decor. When you walk in you are greeted by curtains that create a speakeasy like feel. We opted for the larger set menu. Approximately 12-15 plates were served, each equally impressive. The standouts were appetizers, each of them fresh and palate cleansing, and also the desserts which rivaled some of the best I’ve had at fine dining establishments. I have a gluten allergy and the chef was able to make accommodations that tasted so good. The staff provided exceptional, friendly service. Each dish was thoroughly explained during the dinner. The entire experience was truly remarkable. I express my gratitude for such an exceptional dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tamara Lim

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall good. But for me there are some details to improve. The timing between courses was correct although at times I felt the wait was a bit longer than I would have liked. For me the worst part was hearing the head chef yelling in the kitchen. In none of the Michelin-starred restaurants I've been to have I heard shouting from the kitchen while in the dining room. They try to justify it through perfectionism, but for me it's something completely unnecessary that tarnishes the experience.

Worth highlighting are the first bites, the squid with basil and caviar, the lobster with jellyfish, and the caramelized tomato dessert. Overall I liked it but they can (and should) improve things. Btw, the service from the waiters was quite good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaime Ludeña

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in the Chatrium Hotel near Pratunam. It has fewer than 10 tables, making it quite private.

Upon arrival, someone will recommend wines. We chose Riesling, which was delicious and very refreshing.

Overall, the food uses basic ingredients prepared in a modern way, following a "borderless" concept. We especially loved the tomato ice cream with garden vegetables, and another dish that impressed us was the Thai beef, which had absolutely no gamey smell. Even those who don't usually eat beef can enjoy it.

During the meal, there's a mini kitchen tour showing the chefs at work and the origins of the ingredients. It was a real eye-opener.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vasinee Piyatrueng

sample_reviews_en.text: We had a lovely evening at this restaurant. Recently awarded a Michelin star, the ingredients are of excellent quality and locally sourced. We enjoyed discovering the Thai/Italian fusion cuisine offered by the chef. We were particularly impressed by the meat, which was cooked to perfection. We also opted for the five-glass wine pairing and greatly appreciated the sommelier's suggestions. Finally, we had the opportunity to visit the kitchens, which made the experience all the more memorable! As for areas for improvement, we felt the portions were rather small. Furthermore, at the beginning of the meal, we were disturbed by the chef shouting in the kitchen.

The atmosphere is modern and casual, with a colorful and inviting atmosphere. They have a wide selection of menu items.

There's both an air-conditioned indoor area and a chilled-out area at the front.

Today, I ordered a glass of iced pink milk for 55 baht. It had a rich milky aroma and was perfectly sweet. It was delicious. I paired it with steamed bread with pandan custard for 69 baht.

The bread was soft and the pandan custard was delicious.

If you have a chance, stop by and give it a try.
