It was delicious, especially the crispy rice crackers.
I also got a free gift with my review, which I really appreciated.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภราภรณ์ เย็นจิตร

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious pastries, great prices, fresh, clean, made with high-quality ingredients, and a wide variety available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patcharin Kunsila

sample_reviews_en.text: All the desserts are delicious. We always have to buy some before we leave. It's become our regular shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: กุลรัตน์ สายเล็ก

restaurants.name: Santa Fe' Steak
restaurants.address:

ชั้น2 เดอะมอลล์บางแค (ติดกับแผนกของเล่น, เลข ที่ 275 Phet Kasem Rd, Bang Khae Nuea, จ, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
After the rebranding, I found the steak to be even more delicious. I'm not usually a fan of raw cabbage salad, but after switching to a salad, I really liked it. The steak was grilled to perfection. The chicken was fragrant and the skin was perfectly crispy. The pork neck was delicious, grilled to perfection and perfectly seasoned.
Everything (except the salad) came piping hot. The French fries were freshly fried, and the bread was perfectly soft.
I had the chance to eat here today because there was a promotion: a set of pork steak, chicken steak, and two glasses of lemon tea for a total of 249 baht.
If you order individual dishes, it's much more expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Papanatty

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was great and the staff provided excellent service. They were very polite and answered all my questions without getting annoyed. I initially wanted to eat at Hachibang, but their service was poor and they kept getting the queue wrong, so I went to Santa Fe instead. It's right next door, and I usually eat at Santa Fe regularly. It's a shame they didn't have their drunken bacon and Kurobuta pork spaghetti on the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tick Themoon

sample_reviews_en.text: Hot chicken steak, 2-piece combo set is great value. The spicy dipping sauce is delicious. Good price. The restaurant is crowded on weekends, with queues of 15-20 minutes. The staff are friendly but you have to remind them to bring your order. The combo set also includes a complimentary panna cotta.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supoj Tom

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes excellent, the staff are friendly and welcoming, and always smiling. The place is spacious and easy to find, with a large, prominent sign. There's a wide variety of menu options, and the prices are reasonable for the quality …
sample_reviews_en.author: TAi' Juf. (ต่าย_จั๊ฟ.)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Kurobuta Pork Chop with Roasted Rice is a dish I order frequently...
Today, I ate at the The Mall Bang Khae branch. The grilled pork was so dry, it was hard, and there was no tenderness or juiciness left. It was like eating pork …
sample_reviews_en.author: Ivy Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: We sat waiting until the table was full of food and still hadn't received our knives and forks. I'm not sure if we needed to ask for them beforehand. Everything else was great except for the service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yanisa Bolsanthiah

sample_reviews_en.text: The food packaging is very poor. It looks like a roadside restaurant. The food is spilled all over. Did you take it back and throw it away? You paid for it, you didn't ask for leftovers to take home.
sample_reviews_en.author: fabiatube

sample_reviews_en.text: There were too few staff members; they didn't even notice customers. It took a long time to get their attention or for them to come over. Even getting food packed was slow; we waited a long time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Napapohn Srisarad

restaurants.name: Santa Monica Diner Bangkok
restaurants.address:

Sukhumvit Road 1770 The Phyll, Unit G-011B, Phrakanong, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located just a 5-minute walk from On Nut Station, this American diner-style cafe boasts a fantastic atmosphere.

The charming interior, American-style decor, and the natural light streaming in through the large windows create a very pleasant ambiance. The sounds of Western music and cooking fill the air, making it an incredibly comfortable place to be.

However, there was a slight disappointment on this particular day.

The sandwich I wanted to order was unavailable due to a lack of bread. When I tried to order a burger instead, the bacon was also out of stock. Ultimately, I had to choose from the available menu items.

However, the service was speedy, and the food was definitely delicious! The burger came with a free drink and fries, making it great value and very satisfying.

Given the high quality of the food, I'll probably be concerned about whether the menu items are actually available on my next visit.

This is a highly promising restaurant; I hope they improve their inventory management.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuki Mukoyama

sample_reviews_en.text:
My team was craving some authentic American burgers, Mac & Cheese, milkshakes and more so we fastened our seatbelts and visited Santa Monica Diner.

We ordered Double Cheese Burger, Mac and Cheese with Broccoli, Philly Cheese Sandwich and more.

The food - every single dish was amazingly delicious. It tasted natural, fresh and truly American.

The cheeseburger Patty was thick, the burgers were big, the sandwich was also big and delicious. Great portions.

There’s plenty of parking in the adjacent parking building so don’t worry about that.

Also there’s plenty of space in the diner itself. Moreover the entire area is super open, comfortable and has a great vibe.

We loved all the food, the portions and everything else that came with the experience.

Our verdict - pretty much the best burgers and milkshakes in the area.

I really wanted to try their apple pie - but they ran out of it by the time I ordered so maybe next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ankit S J B Rana

sample_reviews_en.text:
Disappointing experience – way better options nearby.
I visited this spot recently and ordered a cheeseburger, fries, and a cola, but the entire meal was a letdown.
• The Food: The burger was mediocre at best—I’d give it a 4/10. What really ruined it, though, were the condiments. Both the ketchup and the barbecue sauce tasted like the cheapest, lowest-quality brands you can find. It really brought down the flavor of the whole meal.
• The Service: Honestly, the service was very bad. They only provided one single napkin for a greasy burger and fries. When I asked for more, it felt like an ordeal just to get basic supplies.
• Overall: Between the poor service and the cheap ingredients, I won’t be coming back. Not worth the price or the time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joha Bukhari

sample_reviews_en.text:
This used to be an amazing place. The food and service were amazing. Recently everything changed.
The food isn’t as good anymore, it takes a really long time to prepare and the service is terrible. Staff don’t understand neither English or Thai. Everything comes out not at all like ordered. Ordered a coffee with milk she said no problem and then the coffee arrived black. I asked for milk she said she cannot bring me any milk unless I pay extra. But she confirmed it when I ordered!!
Spoke to another staff about this and they were rude and unwelcoming.
I think they recently changed management so maybe that’s why everything is not as good here anymore.
Used to come here weekely, now I know I won’t be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hod Malka

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a wonderful experience at this diner great food and very well priced. I had a steak meal with all the trimmings it was delicious and very well presented. I will be going back as well as my partner who ordered the chicken salad and we both ordered two soda fresh fruit drinks which is sooo refreshing all in all a must diner to visit when in Bangkok we like it so much we have plans to come back and try most of their meals before flying back to New Zealand ohh and by the way you can also order  from their restaurant to be delivered to your hotel if you come home late and want a great meal but can't be bothered leaving your hotel then just call them and get your meal sent to your hotel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Darren Smith

sample_reviews_en.text: Decent breakfast, quiet establishment since I was the only one inside, very clean, attentive hosts. I asked for maple syrup when ordering my meal, but when my food came to the table I was informed they mixed the maple syrup with honey because they only had a little left. They should have asked me if that was okay rather than just doing it. You have no idea what allergies a person may have or whether or not they eat honey. The host informed me they only had a little maple syrup so that’s why they mixed it. This was AFTER I had ordered and they brought the food to me. This should’ve been communicated beforehand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christina Williams

sample_reviews_en.text:
No ventilation in the restaurant (or it was off), so my clothes smelled like foodstuff even though i stayed only 15 minutes inside! No bathroom/restroom is available in the restaurant. Very small dish for 10 usd! Chicken was bad, salad was small, and rice was dry and tasteless (I know it's steamed rice, but rice itself is still tasteless!). The service attitude was good.

No wonder why the shop is empty when you offer average food and try to sell for 10 dollars (including 7% charge plus water). That's why businesses fail. We, the customers, don't choose places like this. No next time, sorry.
sample_reviews_en.author: T. K.

sample_reviews_en.text: Staff was friendly but kind of on the slow side. I would love to give it another shot but was definitely disappointed by the burger, though it was a massive burger it was inconsistent and fell apart (and to mention the burger was well done which honestly is just disgraceful). My friend had the philly cheese and it was below expectations for the price range. The prices aren't absurd but aren't bang for buck.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jayson Omland

restaurants.name: จิ้มจุ่มบางโพ
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 822 ถ. กรุงเทพ - นนทบุรี Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A roadside som tam (papaya salad) that you absolutely can't miss.

The som tam with fermented fish is incredibly spicy, even when ordered mildly spicy. It's just the right amount of spicy. The fermented fish doesn't smell fishy or fishy, ​​and it's incredibly fragrant and delicious.

The garlic fried chicken is amazing, with the garlic fried into small pieces, crispy and delicious. The chicken is perfectly crispy.

The grilled pork neck is excellent, served with roasted rice, perfectly tender and juicy. The grilled beef itself is equally delicious. I highly recommend ordering the last three dishes.

There may be limited seating, so if you're arriving late, you might have to wait a bit. Parking is available on the street, but you can park after 8 PM. It's best to park at Gateway Bang Pho and walk there.

The price is reasonable, not too expensive. We ordered a lot for only 1,000 baht. Six of us ate until we were full, so it only cost a little over 100 baht per person.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bhuwadon Watson

sample_reviews_en.text:
This roadside stall is said to be an old establishment that has since moved to this area. The shop doesn't look clean, but the food is clean. Parking is limited to roadside parking. The staff is good, and the food doesn't take long to arrive, though there are a lot of customers. The prices are reasonable.
The Jim Jum soup is okay, but not overly spicy. The meat is fresh, but the intestines are very tough and inedible. The vegetables aren't very fresh, starting to turn yellow, but it's clean.
The grilled beef is delicious, not tough.
The papaya salad is average, nothing special.
The grilled pork neck comes with roasted rice, as if it's dusted with dust. It's delicious.
Overall, it's good. Worth a visit, but it would be better to go again, but it's closer to a BTS station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fon Kawaii

sample_reviews_en.text:
A roadside jim jum restaurant. You're bound to fall for it whenever you walk by, because the aroma of grilled meat is so heavenly.
Today, I ordered:
Som tam (somtam), which was delicious, spicy, salty, and sour.
Koi (grilled beef salad), which was perfectly cooked, tender, and delicious, with a hint of sourness.
Grilled beef tongue, which was sometimes tender and sometimes tough, was a good mix.
Grilled pork, which was lean and lightly marinated, was tender, and delicious.
The jaew sauce was a bit sweet, a nice contrast.
sample_reviews_en.author: May Sirima

sample_reviews_en.text: The fried chicken is definitely a top choice. It's salty, but pairs perfectly with the sweet chicken dipping sauce. The papaya salad is salty, suitable for those who like salty flavors, but personally, I prefer sweeter flavors, so I didn't like it as much. The hot pot has a moderate flavor, good for sipping the broth. Those who like spicy food can try it with the restaurant's spicy dipping sauce. Overall, the taste is good, but it gets crowded, so you might have to wait in line a bit during peak hours.
sample_reviews_en.author: นายสล็อตจิ

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious!!! Highly recommend, especially the grilled/fried dishes, you MUST order them!!! 🔥 The grilled pork neck is amazing, juicy and with a wonderful charcoal aroma. And the Tom Yum soup lives up to its name – hot, spicy, and sour, perfect for sipping. 🤤

The prices are friendly and incredibly good value. The restaurant has a simple atmosphere but is full of delicious food. If you love spicy food or enjoy grilled pork in hot pot, you absolutely have to try it. Don't miss out! 💯✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Panggg S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Northeastern Thai restaurant serves decent-tasting food.
They offer a variety of Northeastern Thai dishes.
The highlight is their Jim Jum (Thai hot pot).
The atmosphere is like a roadside Northeastern Thai restaurant.
The service is okay; the staff are friendly and smiling, except for one overweight female staff member who is very stern.
However, when the restaurant is busy, the service becomes less friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Soottipong Winyoopradist

sample_reviews_en.text:
Somtam is an authentic Isan recipe, salty with fermented fish sauce. Dipped in sticky rice, it's chewy.
The grilled beef tongue is a bit tough, but it's fragrant and delicious once you chew it.
The grilled pork is also good. The fried koi (grilled pork) is thick and delicious with a rich blood.
The price is not expensive, and they accept half-price payment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanapol Jantaraporn

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is very delicious. The Jim Jum has very soft pork. We gave the shrimp in fish sauce, which was the best. Thumbs up, the table, and the plate. It was very delicious, I liked it very much. The price is good, not expensive at all. The garlic fried chicken is full of garlic. It comes with the whole garden. Very impressive. It's really delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Iwannabeyourdog

restaurants.name: Hasul (3rd Floor The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi)
restaurants.address:

3rd Floor The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi, Khwaeng Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "The grilled pork belly at this place is delicious and reasonably priced."

sample_reviews_th.text:
Delicious, generous portions, the 199฿ set is incredibly good value.

And the staff are lovely, constantly refilling the vegetables and kimchi.
sample_reviews_th.author: Jelly bear

sample_reviews_en.text: Looking for a place that serves delicious Korean beef? I found this place while walking at The Mall shopping mall. If your lucky like my about Korean food and very picky about Kimchee then put away your worry because this restaurant is wonderful. I ordered the beef set and took a few more minutes because I was jammed packed for a Sunday afternoon. So I had to wait with the rest of the folks with a piece of paper with a letter and number scribbled on it. I was number A18.  I’d you are impatient then don’t come here but if your willing to hold on the you will be rewarded with really good dishes. I loved the taste of the beef, soup, Kimchee and the staff was so busy. I thought was so good I re-ordered the beef set again (see photo) and I was so happy to eat it. So if you want good Korean food I highly recommend this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Larry Cortez

sample_reviews_en.text: This Korean restaurant on the 3rd floor of The Mall Bangkapi offers a set menu for Korean BBQ without the usual hair-smelling aftertaste. They have a variety of dishes starting at just over 100 baht (excluding 7% VAT). We ordered the grilled pork belly set. It came with pre-sliced, cooked pork on a hot grill with enoki mushrooms, oyster mushrooms, and garlic, along with lettuce and carrots, dipping sauce, and a bowl of rice. The portion was just right for one person. The grill is very hot, so there might be some oil splattering, but it's convenient. The longer you grill the pork, the crispier and tastier it becomes, although some pieces had more fat than meat. Overall, we liked it because the price was good and the food was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thaya Aungtananukul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food 10/10. I ordered the Korean Jajangmyeon with pork for 189 baht. When it was served, it was a huge bowl, I was so surprised! Enough for two people, it was incredibly much food. I also ordered a regular set with pork belly or something like that for 180-190 baht, which was also huge. I was so full I could barely move.
You can refill the side dishes, dipping sauces, and I think you can refill the vegetables too. The staff were very generous with the ingredients. When I asked for refills, they gave me a huge amount.
Drinks are 20+ baht.

There weren't many staff members, but the service was pretty good.
The restaurant was very crowded, and we had to wait in line because there's no time limit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eve sutida

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for Korean-style food, this restaurant is better than most I've been to.
The food tastes good, and the quantity and quality may not appeal to some. Today, I ordered the recommended set menu. There's not much on the menu, and I mostly met Koreans, so I guess the taste is more to my liking.
The staff provided good service. They didn't bother me much, and I could just press the button to call for anything. That's good.
The vegetables are fresh and many of the dishes are interesting. The only downside is that the chopsticks are a bit difficult to use. It would be great if they could increase the portions by 30%.
sample_reviews_en.author: funny time channel

sample_reviews_en.text:
There was a short wait, no more than 15 minutes, which means the restaurant is quite busy.
The food was reasonably priced and the portions were very generous, especially the Jajangmyeon, enough for two people.
The service was quite good; they quickly brought extra vegetables when I asked.
The atmosphere was spacious, with a slight food smell, but not overpowering like a typical BBQ restaurant.
Oh, this restaurant grills the meat for you and serves it on a hot plate with a small burner.
The advantage is that you don't have to grill it yourself from the start; you can eat as soon as you arrive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Atchara Klinnoi

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Korean restaurant offers "ready-to-eat, smokeless BBQ sets," perfect for those who want to enjoy BBQ but don't want the smell of smoke clinging to their clothes and hair.
The restaurant grills everything for you on a hot plate, so you can enjoy your meal comfortably without worrying about smoke.
Kimchi, fresh vegetables, and other Korean-style side dishes are available for refills by pressing the bell on your table.
Small tables for 1-2 people are available, so even solo diners can order a satisfying and value-for-money set meal without feeling awkward.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, generous portions for the price. I eat here every week. Service is sometimes fast around 3 PM, sometimes slow. They should offer delivery. The downsides are the limited number of tables and small space; it feels a bit cramped.

Taste: 5/5
Variety: 3/5
Cleanliness: 4/5
Price: 4/5
Atmosphere: 3/5
Staff: 4/5
Parking: Available

**This review is my personal opinion. Please consult reviews from other users for more accurate information.**
**The ratings given are based on comparisons with similar establishments at comparable prices.**
sample_reviews_en.author: 明丽

restaurants.name: DEL MAX resort Pattaya
restaurants.address:

DEL MAX Resort Pattaya - One-Bedroom Apartment, Thappraya 5 Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
When I'm staying in one place for an extended period, like now for 50 nights in Pattaya, I like to check out interesting accommodations that I might book for my next stay.

So I also paid a visit to the DEL MAX Resort, which is just around the corner from my current accommodation.

The resort is somewhat secluded and therefore absolutely quiet. What I saw was mostly an older crowd, no partygoers. It's about a 30-minute walk to Dongtan Beach.

I first looked at the very nice courtyard with its pool. Everything is very well-maintained.

When a lady from reception spotted me, she offered to show me two rooms without me even asking, one on the ground floor and one on the first floor, which are more or less identical. The rooms, including the bathrooms, were spotlessly clean.

I then chatted briefly with her and another lady from reception. And I sensed that they weren't just talking like employees, but that they were truly passionate about what they did.

Therefore, DEL MAX is definitely on my list for my next trip to Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manfred

sample_reviews_en.text: Have stayed here nearly 2 months.  It's a wonderful small boutique hotel with 2 small 3 story buildings.  Each floor has 7 rooms.  There is a nice mid sized pool between the buildings.  With a restaurant on site serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner.  Plenty of parking for motorbikes and limited car parking in driveway.  Location is halfway between South Pattaya and Pratumnak.  Very quiet place here.  Lots of long term guests so most people get to know each other and it's a friendly environment.  Staff is very happy and friendly here.  Place is well maintained and well run by the owners Max and Lisa.  Very pleasant and wonderful stay.  I would definitely recommend it to anyone who is visiting Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay McLaughlin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Guys… i booked this property only seeing after so many reviews. But this property is not actually wat u seen in google pictures. We have booked 3 rooms and at the date of booking, they said only 2 rooms are available and 1 room is under maintenance on air con. So thy changed our rooms to another near by property called “cozy resort”. Luckily we got good stay in tat property. People around the hotel del max said tat this property is for long tile stay with basic services and not suitable for tourists who wish to have good stay during the trip. We escaped by luck. Rooms in this property are not clean as we see in the google and no lift.

A small/basic property with high price quoted.
sample_reviews_en.author: PhunBox Entertainments

sample_reviews_en.text: AVOID, Visited on Sunday to look into booking a room, ended up paying a deposit after agreeing on a price to move in on Wednesday for a month, asked for picture of the room and was shown a room with a kitchen, and was told we would be on the third floor, I arrived on Wednesday with all my luggage, I wanted to pay card but was told cash only so I went and got cash, got back and then was told that the room was on the second floor with no kitchen, not what was agreed, I asked for a full refund and they tried giving me a thousand baht less then I had paid, I’m now stranded with nowhere to stay and have the stress of finding somewhere else. NOT HAPPY  and would advise to AVOID.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Wilkinson

sample_reviews_en.text: My wife and I stayed here for more than a half year. The family-driven resort including all rooms, pool and restaurant was completely renovated in 2022 and is in perfect condition. Management and staff were very kind, attentive and helpful at any time. The very welcoming atmosphere made us enjoy our stay every single day. The location is pretty quiet, but just a 10 minute ride away from Pattaya beach, Central Festival or walking street as well as Jomtien beach in the other direction. Close to the resort are e. g. convenience stores, laundries and a local market located. Highly recommendable, we would be happy to stay here in future again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joern Justdoit

sample_reviews_en.text:
great hotel, nothing bad to say.  All liked it.  everything in the room is new.  only there are a few remarks: 1) there were no hand and foot towels in my room 2) the safe did not work 3) there is no "do not disturb" sign.  These are all small things, I'm sure if I contacted the staff they would fix everything.  I was too lazy to do it 😀 the room was cleaned every day.  Thank you very much for a wonderful 3 days.  the room smelled very delicious, the view of the pool is beautiful 🙏✌️👍 cool TV 🙂 there is a local street cafe opposite the hotel.  I had room number 31 ✌️ (Mr. Ruslan Murashkin)

One of the best in Pattaya if not the best 😉🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Сур Рум

sample_reviews_en.text:
Such a lovely place, recently renovated completely, so everything is brand new and beautiful! located in a quiet and peaceful area but yet very close to the center. This is a boutique hotel, small and cozy with a stunning swimming pool and overall looks. The feeling at this charming hotel is "Home away from home"! Lisa the manager is amazing and sweet, so knowledgeable, helpful and always taking care of all the guests needs.
The food at the restaurant is DELICIOUS 😋!!
I highly recommend staying at Del Max!!! 👍
.לישראלים, תבקשו מליסה את הנייד של מקס, הוא יסייע בהרבה מידע וטיפים על פטאייה ותאילנד בכלל
sample_reviews_en.author: EyAl SHimOnI

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pros: the restaurant bartender hostess is awesome. The prices are very reasonable. There is a good camaraderie among the people who go there so you can make friends potentially.

Cons: a couple of frustrations I had with the on-site manager although I was in a stress position so that would have played a role in my perception. But the biggest problem was noise transfer from above and outside and it causing me to lose sleep. That's kind of a deal-breaker for a hotel for me no matter how good the other things are.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Tourigny

restaurants.name: ยกครกแซ่บโซน สาขาทาวน์อินทาวน์
restaurants.address:

Lat Phrao 94 Alley, พลับพลา Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The location is great, near Bodin School in the Town in Town area. There's parking behind the restaurant, and the air-conditioned interior is cool. The service is excellent, the food comes out quickly, and there's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, including Thai, Northeastern, Northern Thai food, and chicken noodle soup. Almost everything is delicious. I'll definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mintra Cp

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Tom Yum Seafood soup came with crab, but the crab smelled really bad.
The Wing Bean Salad had grilled pork on it, which didn't go well together. It felt like they were serving leftover or stale ingredients to customers because it was bland (that's just my feeling).
The taste of the other dishes was okay. The service was good and the portions were generous.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wonderberry C

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and the portions are generous. The dishes are large and the taste is great. You can customize the spiciness, sourness, saltiness, and sweetness to your liking.
The service is good, and all the staff are lovely. There's parking available, the air-conditioned room is cool and comfortable, and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natasha CR.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing place, the selection of dishes is huge (they are all tasty, watch out for the spice ;) )
Staff was very patient with my inability to speak Thai, much love to them.
If I could, I would gladly go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: GHøST

sample_reviews_en.text: I come here very often; whenever I'm in this area, it's my go-to restaurant for gatherings. The food is delicious, served quickly, the prices are good, the atmosphere is great, and the music is nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: bbbeer sssmile

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my go-to restaurant. They have over 400 menu items, and I haven't tried them all yet, but many dishes are delicious. They offer food from all four regions of Thailand. Give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: พีรวิศวร์ AK

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food, wide variety, good value. Highly recommended. The service was also good and the chairs were comfortable.

There's ample parking space at the back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pensupa C.

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere inside the restaurant is nice, comfortable seating with air conditioning, and most of the food is spicy Northeastern Thai cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Npaaa 333

restaurants.name: Uncle Mustache Steak – Sutthisan Branch
restaurants.address:

QHWC+Q4X, Ratchadaphisek, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Great place, they have English menu’s, they have home favourites if you need, and lots of local Thai food. It’s simple, and decent. It’s shaded so not hot, there’s a Chemist nearby if you need & the little tuktuk’s that drive up and down will take you to each end of the street if you need - it’s ฿10 flat fare :)
sample_reviews_th.author: Douglas Park

sample_reviews_en.text:
I initially put this place on my back burner because it was near my accommodation, but I shouldn't have. There is a wide variety of food, generous portions, and most importantly, it is delicious. The staff were also very friendly, and it was a great place to experience the local vibe. I think I will be visiting often for the remaining two weeks.

Don't go far. You can have a perfectly satisfying meal right here.

It is an open-air restaurant, so there is no air conditioning, but it isn't too hot. Of course, I did sweat a lot because of the spicy food.
sample_reviews_en.author: 一拳超人 일권초인 one punch man

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is clean and tastes good. I've been cut in line several times, I don't know why. People who came after me got their food first. Takeout orders are even faster. Out of 10 times I've been here, I've been cut in line 5 times. If you're hungry but want to eat here, I recommend eating at the somtum (papaya salad) stall or the other food stalls next door first.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supatchar Sittiros

sample_reviews_en.text:
At the steak restaurant, I ordered pork chops and fish and chips. The dishes came with broccoli, carrots, buttered bread, french fries, and the steak.
The restaurant has seating from four or five different shops combined. You can sit anywhere and order food from all of them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Coffee& Pudding

sample_reviews_en.text: The food delivery is very greedy. They take a lot of online orders and pile them up, then don't prepare them. You have to wait for the tracking number to be sent before they start cooking. You wait 30-40 minutes for just two dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปลายทาง ที่ว่างเปล่า

sample_reviews_en.text: For that price, the steak is simply divine. It even comes with a side dish of vegetables. The staff speaks English, more or less. It's quite good, but don't sit too close to the grill man, or you might get oil drippings.
sample_reviews_en.author: Антон Гера

sample_reviews_en.text: When I asked for the bill, the staff member agreed. They thought I was busy with delivery orders, so I waited for about 2 minutes. Another table came to collect the bill and went to collect the bill before us. 😩
sample_reviews_en.author: Blackdoglovecat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Their pork chop is really good. Recommended.
Portion is quite generous, price around 80THB, with fries, toast and veggies.
I forgot to take photo.
Might need to wait for around 15 mins
sample_reviews_en.author: Julfri Efendi

restaurants.name: Peanocchio : Thai-Fusion Food
restaurants.address:

ชั้น 2 ท่าเรือวังหลัง - 2nd Floor, Wanglang Port Phran Nok Road Siriraj, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time bringing my mom here. The restaurant is open-air, so the noise from motorboats and rafts was constant. The wind from the fans was so strong it messed up my hair! 🤯 It unfortunately detracted from the atmosphere by the Chao Phraya River. Here's my rating of each dish:
Spaghetti with Baked Pork Ribs in Sauce ⭐⭐⭐ The flavor was strong, the pork was tender, but there was a slight off-putting smell.
Thai Stir-fried Vegetables with Fresh Shrimp ⭐⭐⭐ The flavor was a bit too strong. If they toned it down a bit, those who prefer a spicier taste could season it themselves. Adding banana blossom would be a nice touch.
Pomelo Salad with Fresh Shrimp ⭐⭐⭐ The pomelo was in bite-sized pieces. My mom preferred a more traditional style salad 😅 but this one was okay too.
Plum Juice with Sprite ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ The plum flavor was fizzy and refreshing.

The prices were acceptable, but the pomelo salad was slightly overpriced.
The service was good. It would be great if they adjusted the fans. ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: narisara nawakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
As a sololist for lunch today, the criteria for the chosen restaurant was clearly to be indoor, uncrowded, and easy breezy. Peanocchio seemed to fit and thoroughly tick all the right boxes. Located by the river, this place would give you a striking view while you’re enjoying your a la carte. Moreover, the well-ventilated and airy condition resulted in excellent ambience. The staff who came to take my order happened to be the owner, I guess. And, absolutely, he did a great job. My favorite dish was stir-fried minced pork with yellow chili paste + crispy fish in addition. And I’d love to come back again soon.

Update on October, 2022: Foods remain tasty with reasonable price. 😄
sample_reviews_en.author: Chawin OMFS

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is located on the second floor of Wang Lang Market, in the riverside area. Walk up the stairs and you'll find it at the very end. The overall atmosphere is quite good, offering views of the Chao Phraya River and the Tha Phra Chan and Tha Maharaj areas, with boats passing by. However, a drawback is the strong exhaust fumes from the boats; the restaurant would appreciate better ventilation. The food is on the higher-than-average side, but the service is excellent. The staff are all very polite, greeting and thanking customers respectfully. Overall, it's a good experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: SP TP

sample_reviews_en.text:
Two years ago, we had breakfast at this place. Even then, we were impressed by the quality and price. It's wonderful to sit here and watch the activity on the river. Now, two years later, we were back for lunch. Incredibly, we were recognized and warmly greeted. The owner informed us that card payments were now accepted, as they weren't two years ago. What a memory!

In summary, we can still highly recommend this place: great value food, a pleasant atmosphere, and a fantastic view.

It's a little difficult to find and is located upstairs.

We'll be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Melanie Boy

sample_reviews_en.text: Wang Lang Restaurant, located on the second floor by the river, has a great atmosphere and serves Thai fusion food. I've been eating here since my student days, and today's visit was just as delicious as before, with generous portions at a reasonable price. I ordered the chicken breast with spinach and the minced pork stir-fry with rice. The chicken breast was tender and in large pieces, and the minced pork stir-fry wasn't too spicy, which I really enjoyed. The restaurant is currently accepting the Thai Help Thai Plus government subsidy program.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanyaporn Usahakari

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went to Wang Lang to explore the area as tourists, hoping to find a nice place to eat along the way. Since we skipped breakfast, having a well-deserved lunch after walking for a while was a must.

We stumbled upon this place by accident while heading to the toilets, and let me tell you—their Thai food is spectacular! We ordered the Pad Thai and Tom Yum fried rice, and both were absolutely delicious. Highly recommended!

The cherry on top? They have a nice terrace with a view of the river. A top spot with great food at very affordable prices!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rodrigo Bermudez

sample_reviews_en.text:
Aroy mak mak!
After Wat Pho and the Grand Palace, we jumped on the ferry over to Wang Lang market.
No plan other than we were hungry.
Came upstairs to Peanocchio.
Ordered tom yum kung and pepper garlic chicken.
Quick Google translate got us rice with both.
They were both amazing. The soup was all it was meant to be, spicy/sweet/sour with plenty of vegetables and prawns.
The stir fry was also so flavourful.
Usual soft drinks and beer available.
And all with a fantastic view of the bustling river.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adrian Persaud

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent pork cutlet, honestly one of the best I've ever had. You couldn't get it better anywhere else.

The gravy sauce with the sweet potatoes and regular potatoes was absolutely spot on. And as a German, I can confidently say: we know good potatoes when we taste them. The restaurant is right by the water, with a fresh breeze, very clean, friendly atmosphere, and great service.

Highly recommended !
sample_reviews_en.author: David

restaurants.name: SUNTOOB - ซันตุ๊บ (หยุดชั่วคราว) (Temporarily Closed)
restaurants.address:

Suanyai, Phibun Songkhram 3 Tambon Suan Yai, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere at the restaurant is amazing. It's a wooden house by the river with a great view; beautiful and perfect for photos from every angle. It feels like having dinner at a friend's house in the evening.

The restaurant operates on a time slot system, so reservations and advance ordering are required. Upon arrival, this was understandable as the restaurant is located near a temple, requiring a walk through the temple area. The reservation system is well-organized and prevents the need for a table, as the restaurant isn't very large, and allows everyone to fully enjoy the atmosphere of their reserved time slot. ✅ The food looked good, was fresh and clean, and tasted decent. However, I usually prefer stronger flavors, so it was a bit mild for me. The noodles were excellent. ❤️🥩 The meat was tender.
sample_reviews_en.author: Meenny 1989

sample_reviews_en.text:
This small restaurant is located by the river. You have to park at the temple and walk in. It's mostly self-service. We give this place points for the atmosphere. It's very relaxing in the evening, but it gets quite hot before sunset. They should add more fans to the outdoor area. As for the food, the taste is average, nothing spectacular.
- The braised pork is tender and soft, but it's just salty.
- The sauce for the meat is similar to a gravy for Thai noodles.
- The Jjamppong has a rich flavor, but it cools down very quickly.
- The spring rolls are crispy and delicious, but the dipping sauce is bland.
- The Thai-style egg roll, for us, is just an omelet rolled up.
The noodles aren't much different from other restaurants. Compared to the price, we think it's a bit expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mind. Ora

sample_reviews_en.text:
This riverside restaurant has a great atmosphere and stunning sunset views. The restaurant is housed in an old wooden house, decorated to give you a cozy, homey feel. There's even an adorable cat to welcome you!

Their signature dish is their homemade fresh noodles, used in many different recipes. They also offer rice dishes and other snacks. You should definitely try their noodles – they're truly delicious!

To maintain their Zero Waste concept, the restaurant operates in shifts. Reservations and advance orders must be made via Facebook inbox only.
• Thursday-Friday 5:00 PM - 7:00 PM
• Saturday-Sunday 12:00 PM - 2:00 PM and 5:00 PM - 7:00 PM
Check their Instagram and Facebook stories for updates!

📍 Soi Phibul Songkram 3, within Wat Khemaphirataram
🚗 Parking available
sample_reviews_en.author: P Pair

sample_reviews_en.text:
Need to make a reservation and pay the deposit. The ambience is like dining at a house with river view. Although it’s an open air but there’s always a breeze if you pick the tables on the porch.

Bamee with pork rib stew was great. The egg noodles tasted good and stewed pork ribs were tender and juicy.

Bamee Pad Kaprao Balsamic with bacon was tasty. If you can’t handle spicy, you have to tell them to tone it down a little. The mixture of bacon was a good match.

Crispy chick was crispy but we found it was rather ordinary. I would recommend if you go with friends and order it as a side dish to share while chitchat.

Kimchi had a good flavor. The balance between sourness and preserved sauce was in the right level for my taste note.
sample_reviews_en.author: Opas Noppornpitak

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the atmosphere is fantastic. You can sit and enjoy the cool breeze, hearing the waves crashing on the shore telling you to keep going – it feels just like being at the beach! There are also beautiful photo spots. Reservations are required, and food is ordered in advance as they prepare limited quantities; no walk-ins. Please arrive and leave exactly on time. Don't miss the braised pork noodles! Park at Wat Khemabhirata, Gate 2, and walk straight to the iron gate where you'll see a small sign with the restaurant's name. Walk inside and you'll find a wooden door with the restaurant's name. I came looking for a hidden gem, but I might only come once.
sample_reviews_en.author: jija mond

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is neither too small nor too large, located right by the river. Enjoying a meal in the evening offers a view of the sunset, creating a peaceful and warm atmosphere. We really loved the ambiance here.

Food must be ordered 24 hours in advance so the restaurant can prepare the appropriate ingredients for each day.

Food Taste:
- Braised Pork Rib Noodles 3/5
- Curry Fried Rice with Egg Roll 3/5
- Fried Spring Rolls 5/5
- Fried Chicken 4/5
- Mashed Potatoes 3/5

The service is nothing special. The restaurant serves the pre-ordered food to customers, allowing them to enjoy their meal and the atmosphere, which we liked as it felt very private.
sample_reviews_en.author: nicharee kam

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food and service were average, mainly because it's self-service. The best part was the atmosphere!!! Very chill and incredibly romantic.

Personally, I thought the menu wasn't very diverse. And since the food was pre-prepared, it felt a bit cold and bland when it arrived; it wasn't hot from the stove. The taste was average to bland, not very flavorful. However, it looked clean.

The restaurant's atmosphere was amazing, I loved it. Going in the evening allows you to see the sunset, which is incredibly romantic. Parking might not be very convenient; it's a bit confusing where to park because it's in a temple area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ink A.

sample_reviews_en.text:
How to eat #Jjamppong 🍲 like you're at a friend's house 😅😁 I found a hidden gem in Nonthaburi, a #Jjamppong restaurant with an amazing view! Most importantly, the atmosphere is very private because the restaurant requires reservations in advance, limiting the number of people so everyone can fully enjoy the view and the atmosphere. The owner is incredibly lovely. Don't forget to stop by and try it! (Reservations are recommended!) Kate is secretly recommending it! 🤩

🍲Recommended dishes: Minced beef noodles, Jjamppong, Lumpe Yor (spicy spring rolls)
🥘Location: SUNTOOB, a restaurant by the river in Nonthaburi.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kate Adventure

restaurants.name: Sushi Saryu
restaurants.address:

อาคาร โครนอส สาทร ชั้น G 46 N Sathon Rd, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Top notch omakase dinner cost ฿8000++, per person, they only serve 6 people/night.
sample_reviews_th.author: Eric

sample_reviews_en.text:
Looking for an omakase restaurant?
Book this one! You won't be disappointed.
It truly lives up to its reputation; worthy of the awards it has received.
The chef's creations are outstanding.
The ingredients are top-notch, carefully selected, and combined with the chef's experience, they elevate the quality even further.
It's so delicious I can't even find the words to describe it.
The chef's cooking impressed me with every bite.
This is truly the first omakase restaurant I've ever been to that I'd want to return to.

The service was impeccable.
The staff translated everything the chef said, showed pictures, and provided excellent recommendations.

The chef is Japanese and doesn't speak Thai, so the staff had to translate. His experience speaks for itself. If there were 10 stars, I'd give them all!

The restaurant's atmosphere is elegant and sophisticated; perfect for taking photos.
sample_reviews_en.author: Papawadee Kanchanarattakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The portion was a little small for the price. Honestly, I still wasn't full, but the food was delicious. I gave it four stars because I was a little disappointed with the male staff member's attitude. I arrived by car, and the male staff member (who appeared to be a transvestite or gay) repeatedly asked for my car's license plate number to get a free parking stamp. Even though I repeatedly told him my license plate number, he said, "We don't have it," and asked, "Are you sure you don't remember?" The staff member eventually checked with the building and showed me a photo of the car, which was the same license plate number I'd given him from the beginning. When I told him the number (xxxx) (meaning it was the number I'd given him from the beginning), the staff member simply repeated the number in Thai without apologizing.
sample_reviews_en.author: M

sample_reviews_en.text:
Unique experience at a Michelin awarded Omakase restaurant with very select seating (up to 8 guests) . It’s situated in the Kronos building on sathorn road (opposite the banyan tree).

We had dedicated waiters for each group of guests-
Incredible selection of exquisite and rare sea foods, prepared by our award winning Japanese master chef. No wonder this is a favorite of food aficionados in Bangkok 🥰. normal Omakase menu with non-alcoholic drinks such as Tea/Water works out at around 10.000 THB / pax for 15 (mini) courses

Fabulous experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: DJ

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a truly wonderful experience at Sushi Saryu. Everything was amazing from the cute glassware and dishes to the beautifully presented courses. The chef’s food was truly exceptional; I could feel his effort and passion in every dish, each one served with a perfect final touch. I was completely satisfied with my dinner and can’t wait to come back again soon! 🍣✨
sample_reviews_en.author: YJ C

sample_reviews_en.text: My third time here and it was always an awesome dinner. The master chief does high class work - every course is a taste explosion and experience. Service is very professional, there is a very good atmosphere. For me, this restaurant is a must-visit every time I go to Bangkok! Thank so much you made my BKK visit very special again 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Mat Bam

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chef Sudo changed my life the day I had this meal. I’ve had the top omakases in Tokyo and this is still better for me in my opinion. The amount of uni used , the freshness of the fish. Everything is put together perfectly like a symphony.

100% worth it , we come back to Bangkok every year to have a seat with Chef Sudo
sample_reviews_en.author: Mirza Saad Ahmad

sample_reviews_en.text:
Special experience watching chef prepare one bite at a time for  everyone in the room. Food was spectacular and can clearly see the passsion and care that goes into making each piece.

Such a pity some guess were more interested in their phone the entire time or speaking on the phone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Woei Teoh

restaurants.name: My Darling
restaurants.address:

106 Ram Buttri Aly, Talat Yot, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Unfortunately, this restaurant left a very disappointing impression. Let’s start with the food: it was absolutely terrible. The chicken was overcooked to the point of being leathery, and the grilled vegetables were drowning in some kind of greasy, unidentifiable sauce — completely inedible. The rice was dry and tasteless, and the egg looked like it had been fried in a hurry using tired old oil.

The service was just as poor. The staff looked exhausted and disinterested, even though it was still early in the evening and the restaurant wasn’t full. The prices were completely unjustified for the quality — you can find far better places in the area for much less.

I must also mention the cat that lives at the restaurant. Usually, animals like this add a cozy touch, but this poor creature looked thin and miserable, as if even it avoids the food here. That says a lot.

The decor seemed to aim for a certain atmosphere, but the heavy sculptures and bizarre statues felt more oppressive than inviting.

I might have given one extra star if the cat had looked healthier. Sadly, even he seemed disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dmitry

sample_reviews_en.text:
I WROTE THIS REVIEW AFTER LEAVING THE RESTAURANT. 😡😡😡

This is the most impolite restaurant we have ever been to in Khaosan. We were asked by the staff to change seats twice, even though there were still plenty of empty chairs available for other customers. First, they told us to move from a table for four people. Then, after we had already ordered and were in the middle of drinking our beer, they asked us to move again to a table for two.

They didn’t even wait for us to finish our drinks, so my boyfriend and I decided to just pay and leave. What made the situation even more frustrating was that, while we were leaving, we noticed other groups of two people occupying tables meant for four, exactly what they told us not to do. It really felt like they just wanted to get rid of us.

The staff were extremely impolite and unfriendly, especially compared to the other restaurants we’ve visited in the area. This experience was disappointing and left a very bad impression. I would not recommend this place to anyone expecting respectful and fair service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nica Manabo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Spent a few days on Khaosan before flying out and I’m glad that I found Mu Darling. I went there for lunch and dinner once and both meals were great.

I didn’t get a picture of it but I ordered the Spaghetti Bolognese for a lunch meal and it was well done. The pasta was al dente and the sauce full of meat and flavour. The garlic bread wasn’t done in brioche like most places so it was a sweet garlic bred which I appreciated.

Another time for lunch I ordered the Pad Ka Prow. Staple Thai dish. Lots of Thai Red Chilis, chopped up adding a lot of heat to the dish. Egg could have been cooked sunny side which I would have preferred but I didn’t ask until I already ate. Still a good meal.

Dinner was the Grilled Steak. It came with a salads or simple greens and tomato, French Fries, and Garlic Bread. The steak was cooked to my liking. Medium Rare and properly seasoned. Everything tasted very well.

Cheers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Geoff Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: Met friends for a meal and decided on here because it looked so nice and was quite busy. We all ordered together but my husbands came after we’d eaten. Told they’d forgotten but literally slammed it down in front of him. Food was sub standard. Really disappointing as was our last night in Bangkok. Staff came to clear the table and were waving and pointing for us to pass and load all the plates. When paying they asked for a tip, which we’ve never ever been asked but always leave a tip as usually the service has been impeccable everywhere we’ve been. When we said no she shouted something in Thai waved her arms at us as we left. First time I’ve encountered rude staff in Thailand. Would absolutely not come back to eat here on our next trip to bangkok
sample_reviews_en.author: Donna Smith

sample_reviews_en.text: Okay, so to be fair the food was lit. But! The customer service. First, we ordered a beer, the wrong brand of beer came out. Second, we order chicken cashew nut without mushroom and it had shrooms. Third, my girlfriend ordered green curry fried rice and just green curry with a side of rice came. Fourth, the waitress set down a cup of ice wayyyyy on the other end of table and walked off without a glance or smile in our direction. Though, with all this in mind, the chicken cashew, green curry and spring rolls were awesome! We just weren’t impressed with the service. We didn’t even take a picture of the food we were so upset haha maybe you’ll have a better experience than we did 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Will Langston

sample_reviews_en.text: First of all, we waited 15 minutes for someone to ask us what are we going to order. Then waited an our (!) for our dinner. The only reason we did not left was that we were really hungry and the server said every ten minutes: just two more minutues waiting. The food was okay, nothing special, so I planned to give 3 stars. We ordered dessert, the server said she is not sure that they have waffles, she is going to check it. After 20 minutes we asked for receipt, she said the waffels are ready. After 10 more minutes she said no waffels - 2 stars. Okay, just the receipt than. She overcharged us with 140 baht - 1 star, no tips. I would not recommend the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Atila Đurik

sample_reviews_en.text: The space is beautiful! Me and my friend passed by several times and decided to go just because we needed shelter from the pouring rain. No one greeted us, no one sat us down. We had to ask for menus and to be serviced. We also had the worst long islands ever. It was basically a glass of triple sec with coke. They were really cheap drinks though for the area. I am so grateful I didn’t order anything or any food. Service was nonexistent and they can’t even make a simple cocktail. Such a cheap establishment. This place is a tourist trap and still has bad reviews. That says a lot.
sample_reviews_en.author: L

sample_reviews_en.text:
The place is lively, noisy, and atmospheric, located in the evening market.

We were very hungry and stopped in for a bite to eat. The food was expensive and so-so.
The pad Thai was greasy, the fish was overly battered and greasy, the omelet wasn't bad, but the chicken also had a lot of skin and was covered in oil.
It felt like they cater to Indians and their preference for fatty foods 😂

The food is diner-quality, but the service and atmosphere inside were excellent.

I wouldn't visit this place again, although if you're just going for a drink, it's perfectly fine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kateryna Bodnarchuk

restaurants.name: Dragon Seafood
restaurants.address:

29, 33 Ratchadamri Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Upscale seafood restaurant infront of CentralWorld. We used to eat here more than 20 years ago, so this time we bring our daughter along for a good taste of seafood. We oedered medium sized butter fried lobster (me and my daughter cannot even finished it). We also ordered grilled river prawns, soft shelled crab with salted egg, egg omelette, and mango vege. The taste is awesome and delicious. The atmosphere is nice. The staffs are polite. The restaurant is clean. We go there by walking from Chit Lom station (about 10 mins). As expected, the price is expensive but it is way above mu expectation. I'm not dissapointed as the food os really great, but it is not the restaurant that we can frequently visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Azhar Ngah

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were looking for a nice restaurant in the vicinity and found this Chinese Restaurant. Went it and found the food to be good.
However, we noticed that they didn't served us water, but they were serving other customers, mostly locals. When we asked for a glass if water, they gave us 1 bottled water.
When we asked for the bill, they've added 10% tax and 10% service charge. Which I think they don't charge local customers.
The water cost 40 baht (in nearby 7-11its 9 baht).
The food are already expensive as they were, but adding extra charges, I think is overcharging, especially since it was not written in the menu.
It' s alright to pay this extra charges had they been more honest
sample_reviews_en.author: Benedict Sy

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Chinese restaurant has a nice ambience and is suitable for a proper dine-in gathering with family or friends. The environment is comfortable and pleasant, making the overall dining experience quite enjoyable.
The food overall was decent and enjoyable. The prawns were fresh, which was a plus point. However, the portion sizes were slightly on the smaller side, especially considering the pricing. Personally, I feel the prices are a bit on the high side for what is served.
Overall, it’s a decent place with good ambience and acceptable food quality, though value for money could be improved.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tan Adrian

sample_reviews_en.text:
Escorted in and directly to a table with no wait. We saw online they had mantis shrimp and it was a close walk from our hotel. Busy street outside with small shops next door and CentralwOrld mall across the way.

There was no mantis shrimp available so we opted for Tom yum and garlic soft shell crab. Tom yum was good but the soft shell crab was decent. The crab could’ve used a little more flavor.

Pretty expensive for our taste at $27usd or 940 baht for two main dishes, two bowls of rice and one water bottle split. What’s to be  expected from a restaurant against stall outside.
sample_reviews_en.author: mae

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant offers a wide variety of delicious seafood dishes. I had the pleasure of trying the Tom Yum soup, which was incredibly flavorful and left a lasting impression. Additionally, I sampled the shrimp and oysters, both of which were fresh and cooked to perfection. The combination of these dishes made for a memorable dining experience. The restaurant's menu also includes other seafood options that are sure to satisfy any seafood lover. I highly recommend giving this place a visit if you're looking for high-quality and tasty seafood.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yousif Al Hammadi

sample_reviews_en.text: On our 2nd day in Bangkok we tried the Dragon Seafood Restaurant where we had the Crab Curry, Scallops and Seashells with rice and veg. Very tasty and for the price of 90 euros I think it was worth it. Yes maybe it is similar to our prices but some of the items you cannot find back home. The economy is booming out there so do not expect to find cheap food especially in restaurants. For a lower price you are better off going to the foodparks in the shopping malls. Overall a good night out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panayiotis JT

sample_reviews_en.text:
I only walked in bcos of the heat and I was feeling peckish although I am aware of the many negative reviews written on the place. I got the black pepper prawns and I must say I was impressed. Fresh prawns and the black pepper sauce was superb loaded with full black pepper pods!!! The B500 bill was too high for the overall meal.

12 Feb 2020 - this time around the black pepper prawns wasn't as impressive. The taste appeared to be more subdued than before. That's a pity.
sample_reviews_en.author: leon j

sample_reviews_en.text:
We dined in the restaurant 2 times during our trip. The food was so good and price was affordable. The staffs are all friendly especially the young man, he is so caring with guests. Location is also a bonus point that is opposite Central World and next to BigC.
We tried various dishes, the taste is always refreshing. Highly recommend crab stir fried rice, seafood glass nood and minced pork with basil.
sample_reviews_en.author: Doãn Bảo Ngọc

restaurants.name: TOKYO HIGHBALL ROBATA TO KAMAMESHI
restaurants.address:

Thailand, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon, Pathum Wan, Bangkok, Rama I Rd, 邮政编码: 10330

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Highball is the Best in Town!
It lives up to the name of the restaurant. The highballs here are served in ice-cold glasses, refreshingly fizzy, with a perfect ratio of alcohol to soda. There's a wide variety of flavors to choose from; classic lovers will be delighted, and fruity, easy-to-drink options will be loved. They're incredibly refreshing and smooth!
🍢 Must-Try Food Items
The food here isn't just ordinary bar snacks; it's seriously delicious. The flavors are rich and authentic Izakaya-style:
Kushikatsu (deep-fried skewers): Fried without being greasy, the batter is thin and crispy. Dipping it in the restaurant's special sauce is amazing.
Yakitori (charcoal-grilled chicken): Grilled to perfection with a smoky charcoal aroma. The chicken is tender and juicy, not too dry.
Stir-fried/Stewed Dishes: The flavors are well-balanced and just the right amount of spicy. They pair perfectly with the chilled highballs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ticket AfricavarietyTours

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Japanese food was fresh and delicious. The Yellow Tail Miso was excellent; a bit oily but tasty. The tofu was also delicious and refreshing.

For drinks, I tried the Ninja Highball, Tokyo Highball, and Jim Beam Highball. The Tokyo Highball had a slightly bitter lemon peel flavor, the Jim Beam was less bitter, and the Ninja Highball had a sweet Green Apple Cordial. I personally liked this one the most.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sutthi Bualek

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time trying this place. The food was delicious and worth the price, and they have refillable tea. The rice was the highlight – absolutely delicious! The restaurant has a nice atmosphere and the staff provided good service. I will definitely come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suvapat

sample_reviews_en.text:
For those craving to enjoy highball, this is the place you should visit.

Their craft soda made from special natural source of Japan is finely carbonated, truly complimenting your drink sip after sip.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanaporn Siriakkarakornkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're too lazy to fly to Tokyo,
you can come here instead. The taste is the same, maybe even better.

After factoring in the flight costs and time, the price is about the same as in Tokyo.
sample_reviews_en.author: อยุทธ์ บับพิบูลย์

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere, with soft, not too loud music. The food is delicious, and Praw provided excellent service. ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornpawee S

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was great. The staff were lovely, especially Praw, who was very attentive. The food was incredibly delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนพร รัตนะ

sample_reviews_en.text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolutely delicious! Excellent taste, high-quality ingredients, and great service. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Cherdchai Penpian

restaurants.name: ร้านแสงทอง สุทธิสาร
restaurants.address:

573 Inthamara 35 Alley, แขวง, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old restaurant I've only ever driven past, but today I finally got to try it. Although the appearance is ordinary, and the photos only do me so well, once I tasted it, I understood why the restaurant and the food have been like this for a newly moved location. It was incredibly delicious! I bought several more portions to take home. My little one almost finished the whole plate. See you next time!!
The next day, while eating the duck rice, my child was muttering that we would eat the roast pork rice later, but in reality, we had given it to the security guard the day before. (Normally, my child doesn't pay attention to what we bring home; they've picked up their habit of always eating the fresh food from the restaurant and thinking that takeout isn't their food.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Kotchkorn Tuns

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is elevated and lacks a ramp for disabled people. It's old, disorganized, and has a corner where the owner sits to collect money.
They no longer do the chopping themselves in front of the shop.
I ordered the roast duck and crispy pork rice. The portion was quite large, but the amount of chopped duck and crispy pork was neither too much nor too little. The duck tasted good, especially the skin, which was fragrant and flavorful from the old-style roasting. The crispy pork skin was nice and crispy.
The sauce wasn't good; it was too sweet and burned my throat. It was served with blanched vegetables, but no pickled ginger.
The price was 70 baht, which is quite expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุวภัทร ชํานาญวนกิจ

sample_reviews_en.text:
I just realized that this restaurant's menu varies across different apps.

The noodles are good, and the amount of duck is as pictured. If the skin were removed, it would be clearer how many pieces you get, or maybe I should have ordered it without the skin 🤔
I didn't want dumplings, but the menu only offers duck noodles + dumplings.
There's no option to select "special".
The sauce should be added sparingly and tasted first.

P.S. I ordered through the purple app. If you order through the green L app, there are more options and the prices are higher, but there are also more promotions.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akha U.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The roast pork and crispy pork rice dishes were delicious, living up to the restaurant's reputation and its long history. However, I personally found the rice a bit too soft and the sauce a little sparse. The fish maw soup was excellent and a must-try; the flavor was perfectly balanced without needing any extra seasoning. The portion sizes are probably best suited for three people or more; it's a little too much for two people.
As for the atmosphere, it's nice and simple, suitable for bringing your parents to dine. The restaurant is clean, tidy, and airy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natapon knot

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old restaurant near the Sutthisan fire station. My teenage years were longtime customers; it was practically our regular spot. The food is priced between 60 and 70 baht, which is quite high considering the portion size. The Che Po rice dish is 80 baht. I'm not sure if the taste is the same as before, but currently it's just average, nothing outstanding. Regular customers still order the duck, which sells out very quickly. There's no parking in front of the restaurant; you have to park at Lotus and walk over.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffey

sample_reviews_en.text: I used to eat this dish very often. It tasted good. But one day, I went to eat it and the owner made one dumpling, I emphasize one dumpling, and it fell on the floor. The restaurant was full of customers. I happened to see her pick up the dumpling that had fallen on the floor. I thought she was going to throw it away, but no, she didn't. She put the dumpling in a pot and let the customers eat it. After that, I stopped eating there. Even in front of you, it's this dirty. Don't even mention behind your back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanyarak Chinnasot

sample_reviews_en.text: They've moved to a new location next to Lotus, with air conditioning for a comfortable dining experience. Today was my first time eating there. I ordered the crispy pork rice, and I have to admit, the first bite was mind-blowing! This is what old-school crispy pork tastes like. It's unlike any other; I can't quite describe it, but it was truly delicious. I'll definitely be back next time to try their duck, as they're famous for it. Parking at Lotus and walking over is more convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: พชร นัด

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is uniquely delicious and different from other places. Ordering through Line Man is very convenient; no need to go to the store, saving time. The steamed buns are very soft and the price is affordable. It's suitable for both young people and seniors. Next time, I'll have to try the duck buns.

This time I tried the duck buns. The meat is fluffy. Compared to other shops, the price might be a little higher, but it's acceptable. I ordered through Line Man.

This restaurant offers a pleasant atmosphere, perfect for family gatherings and social gatherings of friends for any occasion.

sample_reviews_th.text:
Quite below typical compared to ร้านตามสั่งราดหน้า
I don't know why people recommended this shop. I followed one tiktoker's suggestion but nothing special. Not even mediocre taste at all. I would not recommend this for sure.
Price 80.-/dish
sample_reviews_th.author: Mel Ps

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old, traditional Rad Na (Thai noodle dish) shop in Texas Alley, Yaowarat, with over 60 years of history.
The shop is called Rad Na Yu Yi or Rad Na Pae Mo.

The Rad Na noodles are served in a good portion. It's a simple dish, but the gimmick is that you can order it with just the vegetable stems for an extra 10 baht. The white, tender, and plump kale stems are delicious to chew.
The "Rad Na sauce" here is a clear broth, not thick and creamy, with a sweet flavor that's quite sweet. Adding pickled chili vinegar will balance the sweetness and add some umami.

The crispy edges of the noodles have a fragrant wok-fried or slightly burnt sugar aroma. The marinated pork is tender and in large pieces. Overall, it's delicious with a sweet flavor that those who like sweet dishes will enjoy. For me, adding a little pickled chili vinegar balanced the sweetness perfectly.

Prices are 60/70 baht for Rad Na, and 80 baht for just the stems. The prices are high, as expected for the Yaowarat location. They don't accept bank transfers. There is plenty of seating.
sample_reviews_en.author: สมบูรณ์ โตมากิน

sample_reviews_en.text:
Rad Na Yu Yi (Yaowarat) is a restaurant that has been selling only Rad Na (Thai noodle dish with gravy) for 60 years in the Yaowarat area, a neighborhood known for its diverse food options. It's sure to be special, with award plaques showcasing past appearances in newspapers and magazines displayed in the shop. The restaurant is located on Phadung Dao Street, opposite Texas Suki.

The regular Rad Na with wide rice noodles costs 50 baht, which is reasonable for this area. They use tender, crunchy kale, which I love. The noodles and marinated pork are soft and fragrant, and the gravy is flavorful. The only downside is that it wasn't very hot, just lukewarm. It would be much better if it were served fresh and piping hot. They probably make a large pot and serve it as needed.

The service requires some calling, even though the shop isn't large and the tables are close together. They don't ask for water, but they are polite and friendly. The food is delicious; the only criticism is that it wasn't very hot, which slightly diminished the enjoyment. 😀😀
sample_reviews_en.author: MrStew LuiRoj

sample_reviews_en.text:
Bangkok…Yaowarat…Master Yoda in Rad Nah Galaxy….
Outstanding!!!…Rad Nah (Stir-fried noodles with gravy)!!!
Yoo Yi Rad Nah, an old and famous Rad Nah restaurant in Texas Lane, is well-known in the Rad Nah culinary world.
The noodles are carefully selected and skillfully pan-fried using the "wok hei" (breath of the wok) technique, resulting in a full and fragrant wok aroma.
The Chinese kale is tender and peeled, resulting in sweet and crispy stems.
Most importantly, the highlight is…the Rad Nah gravy!!!!
The ultimate culinary skill and secret technique can be found at Yoo Yi.
Thick noodles, thin noodles, crispy noodles (add 10 baht for crispy noodles) are available in regular, special, or even just noodles and Chinese kale stems – all delicious!
Mixed noodle soup (Kao Lao) is also available!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: NARIN SAWEEPHAT

sample_reviews_en.text:
The stir-fried noodles with soy sauce are delicious and fragrant from the wok. The owner, an older woman, is lovely; she looks stern but speaks very nicely.
For me, the gravy for the noodles was a little too sweet. The stir-fried noodles with soy sauce were noticeably less sweet.
I really love the vegetables at this restaurant; they're crispy, fresh, and delicious. The marinated pork isn't too chewy either; it's tasty.
The restaurant is located opposite Texas Suki. If you're planning to eat here, you can park at Texas Suki and walk over easily. Or you can park at the I'm Chinatown building, which isn't too far to walk.
sample_reviews_en.author: Walisa spn

sample_reviews_en.text:
This old-school Rad Na (Thai noodle dish) shop is a fixture in Yaowarat, located opposite Texas Suki. Today, I tried their crispy noodles with Rad Na, specifically the version with only kale stems.
The noodles were crispy, not greasy or oily. The gravy was a traditional style, with a sweet flavor. The pork was incredibly tender, so soft you could easily tear it apart with a spoon and fork. The kale stems were carefully selected, sweet, crispy, and without any bitter or green taste.
In short, it was just crispy noodles, gravy, kale stems, and tender pork, but the taste was excellent. I finished the plate in no time!
sample_reviews_en.author: ชัยเมศวร์ ซุ่นอื้อ

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been eating here for 40 years.
I've been cycling to buy it since I was a little kid.
I've been cycling to buy it for my family since I learned to ride a bicycle.
And now I'm here...
It tastes the same as always.
But... the service is terrible.
The noodles are much drier than before.
They charge 20 baht for 100ml of sauce.
Am I really going to drink that much?
I'm disappointed.
I guess I'll only eat here when I remember my childhood.
The little kid who cycled here... This is Thanapat Restaurant.
P.S. I ordered the special for 80 baht.
The restaurant only accepts cash.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ongkan Saetang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Rad Na Yu Yi
This is an old Rad Na (Thai noodle dish) restaurant in the Yaowarat area.
It's located opposite Texas Suki.
The noodles are cooked just right, but not as fragrant as I'd like.
They use tender kale, which is a bit of a problem.
I've seen them throw away a lot of kale before.
If you like tender kale, this is the place for you.
The noodles aren't very fragrant.
The gravy is very sweet.
Those who like sweet flavors will probably like this place.
But I don't like sweet flavors.
My only complaint is the very small portion size.
Overall, it's tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piya Jirapapongpan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Discover Sip & Co. BKK at Sindhorn Midtown Hotel Bangkok, Vignette Collection by IHG—your all-day dining destination where every craving finds its match 🍴✨ From wholesome, health-conscious creations to indulgent main courses and irresistible desserts, Sip & Co. blends freshness, flavor, and finesse in every dish 😋 Whether you’re starting your morning with a nourishing bite, enjoying a leisurely lunch, or treating yourself to something sweet, this vibrant dining spot invites you to savor comfort and creativity any time of day 🌿🍰
