sample_reviews_en.author: Rywyn Uttamayodhin (Trustmewithfoods)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sip & Co. offers a delightful cafe experience with a focus on quality food and a comfortable atmosphere. During my recent visit, I had the pleasure of trying their recommended Coftea Latte, which proved to be an excellent suggestion. The latte was well-balanced and flavorful, making for a truly enjoyable beverage.

In addition to the latte, I ordered the Heritage Apple Turnover Tatin. The pastry was a standout, featuring a soft, flaky crust and a generous filling of sweet, tender apples. It was a delicious and satisfying treat that I would highly recommend.

For those who need to stay connected, Sip & Co. provides a reliable internet connection with speeds of approximately 60+ mbps for both download and upload. This, combined with readily available power outlets, makes it a convenient spot for digital work.

Overall, Sip & Co. provides a positive experience with its tasty food, inviting ambiance, and practical amenities. Whether you're looking for a place to enjoy a coffee and pastry or need a spot to work remotely, Sip & Co. is worth considering.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay Sayson

sample_reviews_en.text:
Despite having visited over 50 times, we won't ever come back. We were sitting on the open-air terrace section with my service dog on duty, who was quietly sitting down not bothering anyone, only to be informed that dogs are banned and we have to leave.

I explained that according to The THAI LAW of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Act of Thailand 2007, this supercedes their cafe policy. Individuals with disability can be accompanied by service dogs, we have all the certificates as evidence. Plus, we are outside and the other guests didn't mind. Still the staff told us to leave.

For a hotel targeting expats and tourists, this cafe is so out of touch with modern standards and inclusivity of people with disabilities.

What makes this even more appalling is that smokers are allowed to pollute the air, harming other people's health without any restrictions. Yet a quiet service dog that is trained to help a human being is banned? The hypocrisy is staggering. Please do better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natalie N

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️+ Breakfast heaven in Bangkok! 🤍✨

Sip & Co Cafe Kitchen was an absolute dream from start to finish. The atmosphere is gorgeous, stylish, and super welcoming — but the real stars were Jan and Mew, who were unbelievably sweet, attentive, and genuinely warm. Service like this makes such a difference.

And the FOOD… wow. 🤤 The salmon English muffin was insanely good — fresh, creamy, savory, perfectly balanced, and the kind of breakfast you keep thinking about afterwards. The granola bowl was pure breakfast porn: creamy, crunchy, fruity, beautifully presented, and seriously addictive.

Everything tasted as amazing as it looked. Beautiful vibes, next-level breakfast, and the loveliest service from Jan and Mew. An absolute Bangkok breakfast must! ❤️🥐
sample_reviews_en.author: VJ

sample_reviews_en.text: This place serves coffee and food at the lobby of the hotel. The space is nice with comfortable seats. They also have seats for people with a laptop. On the other hand the food and drink were not so good. We ordered a dirty coffee that looked more like a latte. For the food we tried the burito and some pasta, it was ok when having it but gave me a stomach pain later. The prices are not cheap and there is plenty of better options around. I suggest to avoid that place except if it is for convenience and fast breakfast out from the hotel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Youman

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the ice-cream a few time there. It looks like the normal ice-cream which you can find in many places. But the ice cream itself was tasty with many texture in the cup (customised tiny chocolate bites, green tea choc bites mixed with nut and other texture decor) with reasonable price within 5 stars hotel atmosphere and services in the CBD area. It was a comfortable and cozy space which suit for relaxing & chitchatting or even the business meet up. I recommend you to try and you will like it there :).

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall nice cafe except 3 things: 1) Coffee beans are inconsistent. On some days the coffee is strong and robust, on other days it is weak and blend. 2) When we asked for the cold sandwiches to be heated up, the center is still cold. 3) Staff should ask if we are staying at the hotel and provide the hotel guest discounts. Very nice place to sit down and have your breakfast.

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stumbled upon the "Deutsche Pasta" restaurant in Pattaya quite by chance while driving by. Luckily, we stopped briefly, noted the name, and went there for dinner the very next evening.

What can we say – it was absolutely worth it. A very young chef, clearly passionate about his work, makes everything himself: the pasta fresh by hand and even the desserts completely homemade.

The quality and freshness of the food are exceptional, and you can taste it in every bite. Not your average fare, but honest, handcrafted food of a quality you don't often find.

We were thrilled and will definitely be back.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ate well, thank you, and I really liked the restaurant.
It's clean, tidy, and as a customer, I felt like I was being looked after with care.
I appreciated the pasta, which is artisanal; both the seasoning and the cooking are perfect.
Considering that the bread is also homemade, I would suggest serving it at the tables in appreciable quantities, especially as an accompaniment to the cold cuts.
Good luck, man! Breaking into the Pattaya market isn't easy, but this restaurant has all the right ingredients to succeed. Come on!

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food, friendly staff, and excellent service!

We tried pizza, bruschetta, pasta, and cocktails, and everything was excellent. The pasta carbonara was especially special; it was perfectly presented, and the bacon was cooked perfectly, with some crispy and crispy, while others were softer and more tender, creating a wonderful balance of texture and flavor.

We also loved all the cocktails.
Value for money: 10 out of 10.
Definitely a place you'll want to return to!

sample_reviews_en.text: I only got pizza here. The pizza itself was good. It's obvious they know how to cook it. But! There was very little toppings. I ordered it with dried salmon, and I barely tasted it. I would have paid an extra 50-100 THB for more salmon. I got the same pizza at another restaurant for about 500 THB, and it had whole slices of salmon, which you could really taste. I also liked the dough; the crust turned out really tasty.

Zaru soba is good i think? I not sure
maybe because i put too much wasabi but it still too fast for sauce to not cold.
It need to be eat cold! OK
Tempura(shrimp) a bit oily but fried well the batter is cool tho even it a little bit too hard to eat and not drop a fried batter.
sample_reviews_en.author: shinato sabumi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is okay for the price, but the waitress is pathetic. There's only one person for 12 tables, taking orders, serving, clearing tables, collecting payments, and answering calls. Even with delivery riders coming in, she's never idle. Tables are never cleared on time, and customers wait forever. Customers have to ask for service repeatedly, and everyone has to go and pay for their own bills.

I used to come here often, but now I'm fed up.

The owner should hire at least one more staff member. This is too harsh.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachaya Thitichotrattana

sample_reviews_en.text:
Probably the worst Japanese restaurant experience I had in bangkok. Noodles over cooked, gioza full of oil and water with dark residues from unclean cooking station. Sashimi, some fishes were frozen and some not even cold. Some food were stored on the floor! The freezer wasn't even closed despite telling the staff. After 2 bites we paid paid and left. Even food hair in the soup next to the kitchen! See the picture.🤮
Yes it's cheap but now I understand why.

Health department should come check the kitchen.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexandre Da Fonseca

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Japanese restaurant is tucked away in a rather secluded village. It occupies a small, single-unit shophouse, and parking is available along the roadside.

The interior is simply decorated but adequate, with an air-conditioned section. The menu offers a diverse selection, but surprisingly, the prices are surprisingly affordable for Japanese food.

The taste is also comparable to larger restaurants; in fact, it's quite good. I recommend giving it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jayklee

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small Japanese restaurant in Phruksa Avenue. Parking is available on the street in front of the restaurant. They have a diverse menu, and importantly, the prices are affordable. The food is delicious and of good quality, and the staff are friendly. Highly recommended!

#TravellingAsACouple
sample_reviews_en.author: Bell Belle

sample_reviews_en.text:
The price and taste were about what you'd expect.

However, the soba noodles were terrible; they tasted like instant noodles that had been made an hour earlier. It wasn't just a cooking issue; there was something wrong with the ingredients.
sample_reviews_en.author: JUN TAKIMOTO

sample_reviews_en.text: The ingredients were very fresh and delicious. They used authentic Japanese scallions. The kimchi soup was amazing, and the salmon portions weren't small. The prices were also reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: naruedi chueasuwan

restaurants.name: 🍕The Pocket Pinsa Sathon (Roman-style Pizza) - Delivery Only
restaurants.address:

560, 8 Soi Chan 45, Thung Wat Don, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Average and expensive, I would not order again. The topping are close to minimal and low quality, you can count on one hand the number of slices of salami. The salad came full of oil and with a bitter taste. Place has potential, but should use better ingredients and put a bit of more effort to keep that price level…

LE. Actually I’m 5 mins away from the place, and the issue above has nothing to do with delivery time, is mostly about the quality and price. I would expect for 739 THB pizza to receive decent quality (2 large pinsa + 1 salad).
sample_reviews_en.author: Al Comane

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a takeaway-only pizza shop (delivery only).
It's run by an elderly lady and her daughter, who are both very friendly. The pizza is delicious and flavorful. A small pizza costs 159 baht, and a large one is over 300 baht. The small pizza is enough for two people. I recommend ordering in advance and then picking it up, or ordering through Grab Delivery. If you're picking it up at the shop, please order about 10 minutes in advance because the pizza takes about 10 minutes to bake, including preparation. It doesn't take too long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eakwat Vinijchaikul

sample_reviews_en.text: Hands down one of the best pizza’s I’ve had anywhere! Delivered by Simone himself to our hotel, he came to our rescue on the last night of our holidays in Bangkok in the middle of a monsoon storm! An absolute legend and a gentleman! We had the margarita and the vegetarian pizza’s and they were gorgeous. The Pinsa base is incredible and the toppings were fresh and delicious. If you fancy a change from Thai cuisine or just have a craving for pizza, go for The Pocket Pinsa. Cheers Simone!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rob Campbell

sample_reviews_en.text:
I highly recommend Pinsa pizza for their outstanding pizza and exceptional hospitality!!!
The reviews speak for themselves, highlighting the delicious flavors of their authentic Pinsa, made with high-quality ingredients and cooked to perfection. Additionally, their welcoming and friendly staff (Simone) go above and beyond to provide a warm and enjoyable experience.

Much love from the international crew yesterday that only came to eat Pinsa 💛xoxo
sample_reviews_en.author: Jana Muraspahic

sample_reviews_en.text: By far the best pizza I had in South East Asia. We ordered Pocket pizza to our hotel in Bangkok (in the middle of a monsoon storm!) and Simone braved the rain and thunder to deliver pizza to us! The pinsa was amazing, - we had the margarita and the vegetarian and both were absolutely delicious. Thank you Simone for the most amazing pizza and experience on our last night in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Roisin Lowry

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the best pizza I've ever had. The crust is soft with a crispy edge, and it's not heavy on the stomach. The toppings are also delicious. They seem to use high-quality ingredients at a reasonable price. What impressed me most was the owner, an elderly lady who makes the pizza. She's lovely, friendly, and provides excellent service. I'm so glad I tried it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattamaporn Kuprasert

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious! The crust is thin and crispy, and the ketchup is authentic. What makes it especially great is that it's very close to home, so when it arrives, it's still hot, crispy, and incredibly delicious, just like eating at the restaurant.

(Edited 3/5/2023: Upgraded to 5 stars because the crust hasn't been burnt in recent orders. It's still delicious!)
sample_reviews_en.author: Witwit Witdel

sample_reviews_en.text: A slice of taste from Roma in the heart of bangkok, the real northen italian pinsa made with accurate care , following the recips rules of who knows how to prepare this delicious dish, waiting for the time we will have the possibility to consume in the restaurant , the appointment with the delivery pinsa is at list twice week, you must really try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Gabriele carradori

restaurants.name: Mu Yong Chok Dee
restaurants.address:

26 Rama IV Rd, Maha Phruttharam, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Even if I don't come in person, I always order from this shop. It's delicious, clean, and the staff provides great service. I've kept some of their products for months without them going rancid; they're still delicious. If you haven't tried it yet, you absolutely must! I highly recommend the pork jerky, pork chunks, and the pork floss rice crackers. Another must-try is the pork floss itself – it's their signature item! Okay, I won't talk too much, my mouth is watering. It's perfect with rice porridge.
sample_reviews_en.author: champange lucky

sample_reviews_en.text: An old shredded pork shop from Suan Kwangtung, Wong Wian 22. I've been eating here since I was a child. The taste is just as delicious as ever. Since my parents' generation, the house always had crispy shredded pork in the refrigerator. The pork slices are also delicious. The children's generation has developed more menus. The shredded pork rolls are also very delicious. It's convenient to get to. You can park in front of the shop or take the subway.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kawinruj Jaratteerawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Shredded pork, pork jerky, sweet pork, Chinese sausage - all delicious! Whenever I pass through Hua Lamphong, I always stop by to buy some for my parents. I love it myself too; I've been eating from this shop since middle school. You can even order in advance if you want to come late at night. This is the shop to go to when you crave Chokdee shredded pork!

P.S. Only Chokdee shredded pork at Hua Lamphong! 😋😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Phongviratch Yongsakuljinda

sample_reviews_en.text: I highly recommend this shop for shredded pork, a delicacy in the Hua Lamphong area. It's incredibly fragrant and the shredded pork has a great texture. If you love shredded pork, this is a must-try. They also have shredded pork chili paste, pork sticks, and pork jerky. You can buy it for yourself or as a gift for your elders!🤤
sample_reviews_en.author: napassorn nillawan

sample_reviews_en.text: There are many shops with the same name, but the taste and quality vary, especially for the Chinese sausage. If you want the original, you have to go to the one on Rama IV Road; I've been eating it for many years. Some shops advertise as the original and authentic, but the taste isn't the same. Ordering online is convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: chai m

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been buying from them since I was an undergraduate. Everyone in the shop is so nice. The pork sticks and pounded pork are incredibly delicious! I used to eat them as a snack while studying. The quality is way beyond the price. I highly recommend them 200%! P.S. The last time I went, they were giving away durian too! 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanutda M. (可心)

sample_reviews_en.text: The sweet pork with sticky rice is delicious, and the coconut ice cream with golden rolls is the best! Belle went to celebrate Songkran at the Moo Yong shop and luckily the DJ played really fun music. It's super easy to get there, MRT Hua Lamphong, exit 4. Amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sontaya Lurgritron

sample_reviews_en.text: Thank you to the shop for participating in this wonderful project. The shop told us to choose anything, with prices ranging from 90 to 380 baht. We chose shredded pork for 220 baht. We'll definitely be back to support you next time! 🫶🏻💘 …
sample_reviews_en.author: RW PTM.

restaurants.name: Korn Restaurant
restaurants.address:

357/83 Phra Tam Nak 5, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I lived in Thailand for half a year, and this place has the best Tom Yum I've ever had—just in terms of flavor. The shrimp aren't the biggest, the seafood isn't as plentiful, and the variety isn't as varied as in other places, but it's the best Tom Yum I've ever had. Plus, it's half the price of other places.
As for the other dishes, they're very tasty and very cheap. I've certainly had better ones, but in terms of price and quality, this is one of the best places.
The interior is an acquired taste. The cafe is more like a locals' joint. Everything is simple.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mikhail Komissarov

sample_reviews_en.text: We've dined at many places in Pattaya and Phuket, and this restaurant is the best! The food is delicious, the portions are huge, you can fill up on just one dish, and they really don't use any spices! The seafood dishes include lots of shrimp, squid, and mussels. The price/quality/size ratio is excellent. The food is served quickly! The staff is friendly! The Tom Kha and Pad Thai are the best here! I definitely recommend visiting!
sample_reviews_en.author: Мария Пономарева

sample_reviews_en.text: We tried almost the entire menu – everything was delicious!!! There are several European dishes: spaghetti, chicken wings. The owner or manager is a wonderful woman, speaks good English, and is very welcoming. I highly recommend it – you won't find such delicious Thai soups anywhere else; the vegetables are prepared in a way that would make many restaurants envious. The prices are more than reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Евгения С

sample_reviews_en.text: I wouldn't say it's the most delicious pad thai or tomyam, but the prices are more than reasonable, the portions are large, and the ingredients are fresh. And the hostess is absolutely delightful. I ordered a coconut, and it took a long time to arrive, but then I realized why—the hostess even had to go somewhere to get it, which was really sweet!
sample_reviews_en.author: Irina Siniukova

sample_reviews_en.text:
We're having lunch here for the second time on vacation. The simplicity of the place and the freshly prepared food are captivating. The portions are large and delicious.
You can order almost any dish with seafood.
I recommend it.
The average price for a dish is 80 baht. Tom Yum is 120 baht. Smoothies are 40 baht, beer is 70-80 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Людмила Пенькова

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent value for money, well-cooked, generous with ingredients. We ate the tom yum for an hour. It was delicious and the staff was very friendly. There's a place to wash your hands before eating! The tom yum is 140, the green curry is 120, the portions are generous, you'll be full. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Василий Жабин

sample_reviews_en.text: We had Tom Yum and Pad Thai. They cook quickly, everything is fresh, and it's delicious. The Tom Yum and Pad Thai are simply delicious, with lots of seafood. You can choose just shrimp, just octopus and squid, or both. The price is fantastic for these dishes. Overall, I recommend them 10 out of 10.
sample_reviews_en.author: Руслан Шефер

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is sooo delicious!!
The portions are indecently large!
I asked for very small portions because I wanted to try two dishes. It was absolutely delicious.
The hostess is incredibly sweet. Despite the appearance from the street, everything is clean and tidy.
The tables are all full.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dmitry Tolstov

sample_reviews_th.text:
🍻✨Belgo Belgian Brasserie Thailand is a glamorous craft beer bar with a great atmosphere in the heart of the city, transporting you to the true spirit of Belgian dining and drinking.

GLAM VIBES & BELGIAN BITES 🥂✨ This isn't just a restaurant; it's a space to enjoy delicious food and fun conversations around the table. Perfect for dinner with friends, after-work hangouts, or just chilling with a cold craft beer. sample_reviews_th.author: CALLMEBACON

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently tried BELGO Brasserie, located on the 2nd floor of Central GROOVE.

This is a Belgian restaurant that originated from Vietnam. They already have 6 branches, and this is their 7th and first branch in Thailand.

The atmosphere is chill and comfortable, giving off a European beer bar vibe without being too formal. It's perfect for hanging out with friends.

They have a huge selection of beers. If you don't know where to start, I recommend trying the tasting menu to see which style you prefer.

The food was much better than I expected, especially the mussels. They were perfectly prepared, with a delicious sauce that paired wonderfully with beer.
My favorite dish was the Flammkuchen, which looks like a pizza but has a thinner, crispier crust. It was incredibly delicious and I finished it without realizing it. Another dish I enjoyed was the beer-based pasta.

Overall, it's a great place to chill, eat, drink, and chat with friends for a long time. The prices are mid-range to slightly high, but the quality is excellent.

If you want to try something new and Belgian in Bangkok, this is a great option. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Rojjana Rungrattwatchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Experience authentic Belgian cuisine at 🇧🇪 BELGO BELGIAN BRASSERIE, the first branch in Thailand of this renowned Belgian restaurant. Enjoy delicious dishes straight from Belgium, including their own craft beers, original recipe baked mussels, crispy waffles, and irresistibly golden fries.

Recommended dishes:
𓌉◯𓇋 ‎⡱ RIBEYE STEAK FRITES
RIBEYE steak served with Belgian fries and your choice of four sauces: pepper, mushroom, beanse, and black garlic.
𓌉◯𓇋 ‎⡱ BELGO ORIGINAL
A popular dish in eastern Belgium, France, and Germany. Thin and crispy flatbread topped with a variety of flavors, baked to a golden crisp. Perfectly paired with BELGO beer.
𓌉◯𓇋 ‎⡱ BELGO WIT PASTA
Pasta in a creamy miso sauce mixed with BELGO WIT beer, served with zucchini and pickled flowers.
𓌉◯𓇋 ‎⡱ MUSSELS À LA MARINIERE
Imported mussels cooked in white wine, sautéed with onions, celery, garlic, and fresh cream in a traditional Belgian style.
𓌉◯𓇋 ‎⡱ SPECULOOS WAFFLE
Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside Belgian waffles served with vanilla ice cream and Biskov sauce.
『 BEER FLIGHT 』
4 TYPES ★CHERRY ★AMBER ★BLONDE ★ROYALE
sample_reviews_en.author: cameragirl bkk

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dining at Belga @ CentralWorld brought back that familiar European atmosphere I always love—beautiful food, warm hospitality, and a relaxing ambiance.
Every dish was thoughtfully prepared with authentic Belgian flavors, making this a wonderful place for a family meal, a catch-up with friends, or a special date night.
I truly enjoy discovering different cultures through food, and Belga is definitely one of those places worth coming back to.
Highly recommended if you're looking for an authentic Belgian dining experience in Bangkok. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Pui Chatchaya

sample_reviews_en.text:
First time trying Belgian food. Overall, it was a pleasant experience, although the dishes were not particularly memorable. The French fries were excellent (crispy and better than average)

The Flammekueche (similar to a pizza) had a nicely crispy crust and was enjoyable. The mussels in white wine sauce  and waffle
were also flavorful

The restaurant is a bit pricey, but the service was attentive and professional.

Conveniently located on the 2nd floor of Groove, with easy access via the skywalk connecting to CentralWorld.
sample_reviews_en.author: KinTiewBaoBao

sample_reviews_en.text: The bitterballen were very tasty. There was plenty of meat in them. However, regarding the Dijon mustard, I have my doubts as to whether it really is Dijon mustard. The flavor was far too mild. In addition to the bitterballen, we also tasted the "Sausage combo". However, this was disappointing. I suspect that the sausages are thawed just before frying, making them very watery. Also, the flavors of the sausages themselves did not appeal to me. One of the sausages was even spicy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dieter Wijnen

sample_reviews_en.text: The fondue, made with real chocolate, isn't sweet. People who don't like dark chocolate might find it a bit bitter. The fruit is fresh and okay, but the combination is a bit confusing; it might depend on the person, but for me, it wasn't quite right. The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, but it's a bit hot if you sit by the window. It's a good place to relax. The staff are lovely. The price is a bit high (fondue with one scoop of ice cream is around 6xx baht).
sample_reviews_en.author: calpis l.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Belgo has been one of my favorite spots since it's opening. It's a dream for a Belgian beer lover like me, the best part is that they brew their own beers which are all delicious (the Royale is my absolute favorite)!
The food is also great and obviously goes great with beer. Make sure to try frites with mayonnaise and a flammenkueche! And a last special note goes for the all the staff who is always so welcoming and nice!
Mr Royale ;)
sample_reviews_en.author: Brice Knittel

restaurants.name: Chua Hah Seng Braised Goose
restaurants.address:

Mittraphan Rd, Pom Prap, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chua Ha Seng (Circle 22) - This is the 8th braised goose restaurant on my trip to sample some of the best braised goose places. While the surname Chua is included, this restaurant is not related to or a branch of the Tha Din Daeng branch. After tasting it, I found it very similar to Chua Kim Huat.

The braised goose meat is chewy, not overly tender. The braising sauce is dark in color and salty, just like Chua Kim Huat. The difference, in my opinion, is that Tha Din Daeng's sauce is slightly more fragrant and well-rounded. Both require vinegar to balance the saltiness. However, this restaurant is significantly cheaper than Chua Kim Huat.

This review compares this braised goose restaurant to Chua Kim Huat (Tha Din Daeng) because the flavors are so similar. Opinions are subjective, and everyone's preferences are different. 😁😁
#BestBraisedGooseRestaurants
#BraisedGooseRestaurantNumberEight
sample_reviews_en.author: MrStew LuiRoj

sample_reviews_en.text: Several decades of history hence decided on this goose's eatery. When we reached, we got the seats at their another space in the back alley, as a pair of patrons were about to leave. Ordered a quarter with goose's offal & blood jelly. The braised sauce was savoury, the chili blend was tangy which paired well with the protein. The goose meat was little dry however the braised sauce helped to hydrate. We ordered a soup as we spotted  numerous tables having. We had the chicken feets soup, comforting peppery soup base, reminded me of pig's stomach soup. Owner was friendly & conversed in teochew & shared abit story about the eatery.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Rundown

sample_reviews_en.text:
• Chua Ha Seng
I walked past and the huge goose caught my eye 🦆 It looked so delicious. The restaurant has been open for over 40 years. I ordered a medium plate of pure goose meat. The braised broth was salty and fragrant with spices. The goose meat was tender and chewy, not tough. The goose blood was incredibly delicious, rich and soaked in the braising broth. Adding the chili vinegar sauce completed the dish perfectly; it was a delicious contrast to the other flavors.
sample_reviews_en.author: จมูกพาไป

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chua Ha Seng Braised Goose has been selling for over 40 years.
Located near the 22nd Circle.
Arriving early in the morning, the display case is still full of geese. I ordered a plate of goose meat,
a plate of wings and neck,
a bowl of braised goose broth,
and braised pork stomach.
A refreshing sip of broth, along with a cup of tea.
A bowl of rice.
This meal cost exactly 300 baht.

Closed on Wednesdays. Open 10:00 AM - 2:30 PM.
Chua Ha Seng Braised Goose (蔡合成)
sample_reviews_en.author: Vit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Typical Chinese family owned small restaurant in BKK China town. The owner still chops the goose by himself all time
Excellent soy sauce goose, firm meat no goose smell, some salty follow with very mild sweet taste
Sour dipping sauce with garlic ans chilli is good combination with the goose
Should try double boiled lotus root with pork rib, so good
Very reasonable price with nice smiley service
sample_reviews_en.author: Pureephat “ลุงป๋อง วันนี้กินอะไร” Wangpaiboonkit

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves delicious braised duck that's not too sweet or too salty – you can eat it continuously. The duck is tender and tastes great with rice. They offer several broth options, and the prices are quite reasonable compared to other restaurants in the area. If you're in the Yaowarat area, I highly recommend this place; you won't have to queue for long, and the food is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arpuntee Tee

sample_reviews_en.text: This delicious restaurant is next to a famous noodle shop. The price is reasonable, a large bowl for 800 baht (no wings or tenderloin), it's tasty and not too salty. The seller is friendly. You can place orders in advance. Parking is available in front of the shop. There are also other delicious noodle shops and a kanom krok (Thai dessert) shop nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: PS

sample_reviews_en.text:
Recommendation - Soft and tender braised goose.

Pros - Delicious / Affordable.

Cons - Parking is a bit difficult to find.

PS - The coconut milk pancakes (khanom krok) in the alley behind the store are incredibly delicious.

Update (February 27, 2022) (Pictures 6-11) - Very filling.

Update (April 30, 2023) (Pictures 12-16) - Delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thaweechot Tatiyapermpoon

restaurants.name: Tang Jek Wu
restaurants.address:

308 Banthat Thong Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Just looking at the color, I thought, "Wow, this is going to be delicious!" I kept eating it and it was amazing!!!! I want to eat it again. The meat is so good. I ordered noodles with everything for 80฿ and I'm full!!
sample_reviews_th.author: Pitsinee Kasempipat

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is newly opened, but the first experience wasn't very good. There were no grilled intestines or grilled tongue. We ordered beef stew rice and it was very slow. My mother had already finished the noodle soup and it still hadn't arrived. The grilled beef hadn't arrived yet, so we just asked for the bill. I understand there might be some delays, but it would be good to inform the customers a bit more. I think the service could have been much better. Personally, I'm probably going to hold a grudge and never come again, but my mother thinks the noodle soup is delicious. Anyone interested in trying it is welcome to come.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siravit Chanprasit (Tent)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a delicious beef noodle shop.

The shop's decor is quite beautiful and photogenic.

The prices of the food and drinks are not too expensive.

The food and drinks are delicious to the point of being overly delicious.

You must try the beef shank noodle soup.

There's parking, so you have to take your chances. We guarantee there won't be many customers.

Getting to the shop is easy. You can find it on Google Maps, so you won't get lost.

This is a restaurant and drink that you definitely want to recommend to your friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: thestory man

sample_reviews_en.text: The first thing you'll enjoy is the exotic atmosphere created by making good use of the old architecture. You can order your beef hotpot with a choice of ingredients such as raw meat, aged meat, or luk cuing (meatballs). Enjoy it with the rich soup. The grilled beef skewers are also delicious, with my favorite being the offal. Pair this with a beer and you're in for a treat! If you're coming alone, they also have a noodle dish with beef. The owner, Nung, has lived in Japan before, and is very friendly and helpful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Takeshi Matsunaga

sample_reviews_en.text:
My Thai friend brought me here after I told him that I want to try the spicy beef noodle soup. The area is defined by students and therefore more local and definitely cheaper than other parts of Bangkok.

However, this restaurant has served a rich and very flavorful beef noodle soup with a hint of spiciness. Upon ordering you can select the kind of noodles, meat and of course how spicy it should be.

Once I am back in Bangkok, will visit it again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Roman Skorzus

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is another place worth trying for beef noodles. The aroma and flavors evoke a traditional Chinese atmosphere. The gravy is served to enhance the nostalgic atmosphere.
I also ordered the roast duck from the shop opposite, Banthut Thong. Wow, it was delicious! Dry-roasted and fragrant. Two dishes to try at one place. It was delicious and a great value! The owner even offered me hot Vietnamese tea, which was incredibly refreshing.
sample_reviews_en.author: P’ Ting

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious! It has a lovely herbal aroma that I really like. The taste is great, not fishy at all. The portion is generous, the restaurant is clean, and the service is good. The white and red building is easy to spot.
The building is beautiful and great for taking photos. I chose this restaurant because of its pretty appearance, but after trying it, I was hooked on the taste!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lady Rinna

sample_reviews_en.text: Hidden gem alert!  Discovered Tang Jek Wu and it was fantastic. The beef noodle soup was delicious - flavorful broth and perfectly tender meat.  There was no wait, and the restaurant itself was really nice.  The only thing that could be improved is the menu - a clearer one would make it easier to decide what to order. Prices were very reasonable. Overall, a great experience!"
sample_reviews_en.author: Chou Le

restaurants.name: ทองสมิทธ์ Thongsmith Market Place Krungthep Kreetha
restaurants.address:

หัวหมาก 241 ถนน ศรีนครินทร์ - ร่มเกล้า แขวง หัวหมาก เขตบางกะปิ บางกะปิ Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles were absolutely delicious, bursting with flavor, and the real beef meatballs were a total highlight—juicy and perfectly seasoned. I was bummed the steamed coconut pudding was sold out, but the coconut egg yolk ice cream was an amazing substitute, creamy and delightful! The vibe was lively, and the staff were so friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: PK Smith

sample_reviews_en.text: I gotta say, I liked the service the most, though it's might not the best. The taste of this dish, it's just OKAY for me, not as great as I ate at another Thong Smith 😑 PLUS, I had DIARRHEAR after having this meal 😵‍💫 --not sure if it's because of the beef liver or not. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Phimagine

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles here are perfectly cooked, but you have to specify that you want them soft. For those who prefer soft noodles, our soft vermicelli was incredibly delicious. The braised pork here is super tender. Some branches have tough braised …
sample_reviews_en.author: putharin ph

sample_reviews_en.text: This place serves authentic Thai boat noodles with a bit of a modern touch. The flavor is still super traditional, rich and savory, exactly what you’d want, but the presentation and the vibe feel more polished and a bit more modern. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Donlawat Chitsing

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious noodles in my mind! It was good that Thongsmith opened nearby my home. The noodle and side dishes were good. The taste was consistent all branches. The service was very good, mind of service from all staffs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jetnapa Techawiparat

sample_reviews_en.text: Recommend everyone must try! 😋 One of the best noodle soup in Thailand. I have try Kurobuta noodle soup, it’s very tasty. Also I like the desserts, you should try fried crispy banana ❤️ …
sample_reviews_en.author: Nadear Cholticha

sample_reviews_en.text: Good boat noodle. Kinda pricey for small portion but the taste and quality is good so I understand. The fried bananas here are really good. The kanom tueaw is okay I have had better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tobey H

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken seemed a little less tender than usual today, but it tasted just as delicious. 😅 …
sample_reviews_en.author: tata Lee

restaurants.name: ศูนย์อาหารมุสลิม เอเชียทีค (Halal Food Center Asiatique)
restaurants.address:

24 Charoen Krung 99 Alley, Wat Phraya Krai, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Highly recommended!
Mini Noodle Soup
A favorite of converts to Islam!
The broth is delicious.
You can slurp it up hard; it's mild yet rich.
The dumplings with minced chicken are amazing.

The stir-fried noodles with fish sauce are fantastic.

Absolutely delicious!

The papaya salad with egg is also great.
I loved it so much I had to come back.

I highly recommend it!

They have many other dishes too.

If you're looking for halal fish maw soup,
come on a Saturday!

It's just past the mosque entrance.

Soup confirmed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Usup jintakunaporn

sample_reviews_en.text: Some reviews have indicated that the foodcourt is 100% halal. This is not the case. There are pork items sold at some stalls. I saw only four stalls that had halal labels on their menu. The rest did not and some had pork items. So, choose wisely. Price is very reasonable. Quality is ok. I only tried the halal options. The ceiling fans helped a lot as this is an open air eatery joint. It is right across the street from Asiatique. There are also some halal vendors there too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hisham Isa

sample_reviews_en.text:
A food court just across the street from Asiatique.

I was fed up with the touts of tourist-oriented shops and left Asiatique when this place caught my eye, so I decided to check it out.

It seems to be an area where Muslims gather, so halal food is the main focus.

Halal tom yum noodles are often creamy!

I had creamy tom yum here too.

It was about 70 baht.

It was a perfectly tasty creamy tom yum kuay tiao, nothing particularly special.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pine

sample_reviews_en.text:
What a surprise! I pointed to the dishes I wanted to choose, but unfortunately, they didn't have chicken rice that day.

I had stir-fried mimosa, which was delicious; the texture was similar to water spinach.

Many Muslims were eating here! It was a simple, everyday meal.

You can order first, sit down, and pay when your food arrives (I don't know if foreigners can do this?).
sample_reviews_en.author: no no

sample_reviews_en.text: It's opposite the Ferris Wheel Asian Style Street. There is a mosque nearby. The basil stewed beef here is very delicious. The taste of the beef is very similar to that of Hong Kong. The taste of the beef is also very good, and the price is very reasonable. I have been here for the second time. If I go to Bangkok next time, I will still come back here to eat it.
sample_reviews_en.author: OSCAR TSUI

sample_reviews_en.text: A new discovery for me to find a place like this when i first visit asiatique. The food court serves halal food but there are also non-halal food sold so just look around carefully. Prices are affordable and I really liked the fried fishcake and also chicken rice that was sold there! Will visit again and I hope this place is still up and running after this
sample_reviews_en.author: Ace Shimizu

sample_reviews_en.text:
I eat here almost every time I go to Asiatique. There's a wide selection of food, most of the stalls offer halal food, although some are not. The prices are relatively cheap compared to other places near tourist attractions. The taste is also delicious.
Don't forget to try the chicken rise, which is delicious, and the Thai tea is also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Little RF Family

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd rather eat here for 100 than pay 1,000 at Asiatique. The pork leg rice bowl place in the middle is seriously delicious; it rivals Chiang Mai Cowboy. The price is 50 baht. Also, they give you a ton of bones in the hangover soup for 60 baht. You really have to go here. If you ask the lady for extra, she even gives you a generous amount.
sample_reviews_en.author: 김은정

restaurants.name: Nectar café
restaurants.address:

32 20 Soi Naradhiwas Rajanagarindra 4, Khwaeng Yan Nawa, Khet Sathon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This homie-style cafe has a warm, homey feel. The food is delicious, and they have a great selection of beers and wines.

The owner is lovely and friendly, offering excellent recommendations for both drinks and food.

They also have free board games to play, so if you like them, I highly recommend visiting!
sample_reviews_en.author: Link Jay

sample_reviews_en.text:
There's a huge selection of beers in many styles 😍
The atmosphere is like hanging out at a friend's house.
Lots of card games and board games.
The prices of each beer vary, so feel free to ask the owner.
Oh, and this is important: the owner is beautiful 🥰🥰🤫🤫
So, so beautiful!
Super friendly!
sample_reviews_en.author: Michelan Enola

sample_reviews_en.text: A small cafe emphasized on craft beer. General vibe was good, shoes-off enter. Craft beer was available both on tap and can. Some board games are presented. The food was really delicious. Good service. The staffs were nice and friendly. The price was reasonable. No parking lot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ruby Lib

sample_reviews_en.text:
There were hardly any types of draft beer (there were only two options).

The ingredients looked fresh, but the taste was average.

The owner's acquaintances came to visit, so it was too noisy. Haha.

I bet the owner's friends are probably friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: 박새로이사한집증후군 (Emiyamulzomdao)

sample_reviews_en.text: Craft beer & delicious Thai food....a winner!  A great spot to enjoy fresh beer paired with freshly made local specialties from a small but tasty menu. Easy to find, down a small Soi near  BTS Chong Nonsi. Highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stephen G

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and clean, the owner is lovely and warm, and they have a huge selection of rare beers, especially craft beers, both Thai and imported.
The prices are reasonable and the portions are very large.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasithorn Thawornjak

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good beers and better price than other places in Sathorn/Sukhumvit.
Nice community atmosphere as well with small outdoor sitting as well.
Still got a reasonable mini-selection and taps still running despite Covid.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stuart Blackwood

sample_reviews_en.text:
So this is a great little neighbourhood bar. Good atmosphere, good food, and good imported beer.

The owner is great, perfectly willing to chat with you in Thai or English. Would highly recommend this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Matthew Larson

restaurants.name: อ้ายอ้าย บะหมี่หม่าล่า ก๋วยเตี๋ยวฉงชิ่ง 爱爱麻辣面
restaurants.address:

322 379 Soi Ratchadaphisek 3, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious! Big portions, generous servings.

You can choose your spice level (for those who don't like spicy food, I recommend ordering mild). There's mala chili oil on the table to add more spiciness, and garlic to eat with it.

If you're still hungry, you can get free refills of noodles!! Such incredible value!
🚗 There's no parking for cars in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poy PoY

sample_reviews_en.text:
Apr 25

Delicious Chinese noodles in the neighborhood. It was Mala/Si Chuan style with an option to choose no spicy. We ate around lunch time but there were not many people. Probably due to the price because it was quite high compared to the neighborhood. They had pictures of each dish on the walls. It helped in choosing what we wanted to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Harry Nguyen

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant offers a wide variety of mala dishes that are so delicious you'll want to come back again. I especially love that you can refill your noodles unlimitedly – ​​they have egg noodles, white noodles, and chewy black noodles. The potato salad is also delicious. The owner is friendly and fun. However, parking is limited.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chok Esso

sample_reviews_en.text: Went here for dinner and had a simple noodle soup with pork. Good amount of noodles and meat. Price is okay. The dish is naturally spicy but I would say this one is not overwhelmingly so. The soup is tasty but could be a lil more flavorful (apart from the spicyness). Noodles are nice. Overall it's quite good and I'd go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: L

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered delivery and the food was delicious. The prices are standard for Chinese food, but the portions aren't small. I ordered pork noodle soup and they gave me a huge portion. I ordered it extra spicy and it was genuinely spicy – ​​so spicy you might feel like you're in heaven if you choke once! Overall, it was great!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: miling moon

sample_reviews_en.text: It was incredibly delicious! I ordered the noodles extra spicy, both the dry and the broth versions were flavorful and well-balanced. The duck offal was excellent, and the fried dumplings were crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, with a fantastic dipping sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: KHON PacharA

sample_reviews_en.text: Came here unexpectedly, but it was surprisingly delicious. I love the mala spiciness. The duck intestine dish is a winner. The gyoza is amazing. Everything was delicious. The noodle bowl was huge, I almost couldn't finish it (free refills of noodles!).
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanita

sample_reviews_en.text:
The dry noodles with minced pork and peas are delicious and well-balanced.
Those who don't like a lot of oil might deduct a few points (I'm health-conscious, haha).
I also recommend ordering the pork and chive dumplings; they're very tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: GG GG

restaurants.name: Aishah Shop
restaurants.address:

2813 Charoen Krung 105, Bang Kho Laem, Khet Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This small Thai restaurant is a hidden gem, offering not only delicious food but also a warm, welcoming atmosphere thanks to its incredibly friendly owner. The standout dish is undoubtedly the Tom Yum soup—it’s hands down one of the best you’ll find, packed with bold flavors and the perfect balance of spice and tang. The menu is full of authentic, flavorful dishes, and you can tell that everything is made with care. The owner’s hospitality makes every visit feel special, making it a great spot for both a quick meal or a leisurely dinner. Highly recommended for anyone craving delicious Thai food with a personal touch!
sample_reviews_en.author: Muhammad Ali

sample_reviews_en.text: Aisha Shop is a hidden gem in Bang Kho Laem and, in my opinion, makes the best minced beef Kaprao around. The flavor is rich, perfectly spiced, and the balance of basil, chili, and seasoning makes it truly stand out. It has that authentic home-style taste that’s hard to find elsewhere. If you’re in the area and craving a delicious Halal Kaprao beef, Aisha Shop is definitely worth a visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Syed Haider Hassan

sample_reviews_en.text: We went there with our daughter Ayşe to create a lasting memory. It's fantastic for those who love Thai food, but there aren't many other options. It's a casual place. The cleanliness is above Bangkok standards. You can eat halal food there without any hesitation. It's also very close to a mosque, and the owners are very kind people. May God bless them. Greetings from Turkey.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ahmet Mahmut Taşçı

sample_reviews_en.text: This is Thai Muslim Small Restaurant ( Halal) Run by Bangladeshi and his Thai Muslim wife. Delicious food and all small quantity. That's why we're family of Seven persons had variety of foods and tasted as much. Price's are very reasonable, and it's worth of it. Don't forget when you are in Bangkok do visit. Later you will visit again and again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amfa1551! Mohamed Farouk

sample_reviews_en.text: I cannot stress enough on how authentic the food here is! if you’re looking for Thai cuisine that is rustic & homely while fairly priced, this is the spot. It’s a cozy business run by husband & wife, who are kind & welcoming. Their whole steamed fish, morning glory, tomyum & fried rice are a few must try’s!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dilshani Amith

sample_reviews_en.text:
one of the halal restaurants in
bangkok, the menu has a lot of food,

i really like the fried rice.  almost similar to the taste of Indonesia..
for all of you please stop by this restaurant.  Guaranteed your stomach will be full
sample_reviews_en.author: Bang Tope channel

sample_reviews_en.text: This one of the most delicious food I have had in Thailand, the prices are reasonable and it’s delicious. The owners are so friendly. Me and my husband loved it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ashley Nyonga

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered noodles Tom Yum and Beef Kapao , it was very delicious and the prices are very reasonable , just come and show some love , the owner is amazing
sample_reviews_en.author: Qudratullah Shahab

restaurants.name: Shinkanzen Sushi MBK (FL2)
restaurants.address:

PGWJ+552, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually eat here and order E-delivery but this is the first time I am not comfortable with their service. We feel not respect from the door girl with Kimono. We wait and sit front restaurant. Our queue is B30 and make sure that they call B29 3-4 times more and jump to B31, not call us. After that we go inside and supervisor told us wait for next table without apolozise. Then ok we waited until next they called another next queue not us, we waited again. When we order we were confuse about menu and ask the door girl but she answer us by bad attitude on her face, that is her bad and now she pissed of us 😂😂😂 I am so angry and write these comment at the table. Door girl mission to be welcome guest and take orders but she can not speak even little English at MBK center. There are many foreigners here. I don't wanna too much about her except her attitude, she needs to be trained to be get this job. 😅😅
sample_reviews_en.author: Joyce

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great idea, awful execution by the staff. Terrible, slow service. We ordered multiple items, and after only a few were delivered a waitress dropped the check on our table and walked away. We hadn't received everything we ordered, nor did she say anything to us.

I'm actually still sitting here waiting because we finally got our second round ordered by flagging down someone (took multiple tries) and explained whaylt we wanted. I have been watching another couple try to get the waitstaff's attention for about five minutes.

Come in expecting poor and inattentive service, don't be afraid to stop random waiters to get help, and expect a long wait for your food.

Other than that the actual food was quite good, especially for the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Preston Miller

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good food, fresh sushi. Really affordable price. Will recommend if you have time to wait. We waited 1.5 hours for a table for 2 on Saturday for dinner. There was a QR code to scan and we could just roam free until it was our turn. Service staffs are polite, fast and know what to do. The food comes in 5 mins after we made the first order. Impressive in terms of speed. Overall, will recommend for weekdays during the afternoon. It always seem overly crowded over the weekend.

On a positive note, it is at the corner of MBK with wide window. As we waited outside, we got to explore the whole Bangkok view, watching people walking by. We got to take photos, read books, replied to all emails while we sat outside of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tamruja D.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place steals the show to all the Japanese restaurants around,  as the all-you-can-eat buffet is the same price or cheaper than one dish at the other sushi restaurants within MBK. That’s why we -and many locals- were willing to wait the long line to eat there. On top, the fish taste fresh and yummy, so do all the dishes!
The entry price for the buffet, 329 baths, has many delicious options, but the 549 baths one gives you access to toro salmon, tuna sashimi, wagyu beef etc…
The service was super fast, although once, they brought the ginger at the end of the meal…
The restaurant is too noisy and the four-seater tables are not optimal to reduce the long wait.
But the food is totally worth the wait!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mala S

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Very long waiting time but good that they have a queue application where it will remind you when your queue is coming up close
- The fish is not very fresh
- Kimchi is strongly not recommended.. it is super salty
- Noddles are not well cooked. It's like they are just dipping the noddles in a hot water for a few seconds only.
- Edamame is good, no salt speinkled on top
- It take more than half an hour before receiving the 1st salmon sashimi order
- Shrimp menu is very good.. it comes in big piece and is quite sweet
- The squid sashimi is very rubbery, not recommended
- Miso soup is served warm which is so good to have after finishing several dishes
sample_reviews_en.author: Duangkamol L.

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was delicious, everything was fresh and flavourful. Staff was very friendly and professional. Long queue but they have a nice system with an app that notifies you when you’re about to be called. The drinks came with too much ice making the sodas to have a small quantity but they are included in the menu fixed price. Yes. You choose the menu and then you have 140 minutes to order everything you want. It’s a good option if you’re at MBK shopping and want to eat something. I would not come here on purpose but overall it’s a good experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neimar Alves Guerra

sample_reviews_en.text:
Terrible service. Queue management is awful. It was crowded and had to wait more than an hour to just get queue,   when we finally reached our number they got us table at inconvenient location because we were only 2 people.
We ordered food but I don't know what the food tastes like because they didn't bring any so I left. After calling the staff 2 times for update on our order and waiting 45mins they just brought 1 bottle of plain water and 4 pcs of sushi. I didn't even eat. Just got up and left. Never going there again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Aparimita Tuladhar

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall the sushi tastes bad. I’ve been to quite some sushi restaurants in Japan and Vietnam and I think this one is one of the worst. They shoved wasabi into random pieces without any warning and I had a shock eating them by mistake. The employees here are clearly overworked and underpaid, they didn’t look like having any energy left at all. This place is so small it barely can contain all waiting customers so let’s expect at least a 1-hour of queuing for an unworthy experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Quinn'z Land

restaurants.name: Mobile Steaks ถนนรางน้ำ
restaurants.address:

21, 36 Rang Nam Alley, พญาไท Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
During our Christmas holiday in Bangkok, we had breakfast at Mobile Steaks on Rang Nam Road, conveniently located opposite the King Power Duty Free Complex near Victory Monument.

This charming restaurant is operated by a hardworking local lady who provides a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The menu offers a wide variety of food options to suit different tastes, and everything we ordered was delicious, freshly prepared, and beautifully presented.

The restaurant itself is clean, neat, and well maintained, creating a calm and relaxing environment that allows guests to enjoy their meals in comfort. The attentive service and peaceful ambiance made our dining experience even more enjoyable.

If you are looking for a pleasant breakfast or a relaxing meal near Victory Monument, Mobile Steaks is definitely worth a visit. Good food, friendly service, and a comfortable atmosphere make it a great choice for both locals and tourists.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bhanuka Jayasuriya

sample_reviews_en.text:
Horrible experience. The price is relatively fair for Thai’s standard. However, the food is horrible. The cut of steak they choose is dry, not juicy at all and it is hard to eat. It took me couple of while to chew the meat down my throat feeling all the bad things.

Service is even worse. I wanted additional piece of meat in my dish, but there is nothing there on the menu, so I inquire to the staff there. Actually, a piece of pork can be ordered for 50 bht more, but the staff does not know this, so she inquires to the head staff. What the head staff did was shout from the check counter all over and it took ages for us to understand.

I would not recommend this place no matter what.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattha Inth

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is quite expensive, the taste is average. What was really strange was that I ordered Pad See Ew and the restaurant charged me 15 baht for an egg separately. I had ordered this before but never charged for the egg separately. And the worst part was the owner, an old lady with glasses, was rude when we went to pay at the counter. My friends and I were in separate lines to pay, and the old lady looked stern and said in an annoyed tone, "Why don't we all pay together at once?" So I stopped eating there from that day on. I'll tell you that if you're Thai, you don't need to step foot in this restaurant because they're trying to sell to foreign tourists only.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zarawut Kry

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a terrible experience here. Their payment methods don't support international payments, and I tried to pay multiple times without success. Then they told me they didn't have enough money. The attitude of the lady and the staff member in this picture was awful. Furthermore, they deliberately covered up the zero on the mango sticky rice menu; I thought it was 15 baht, but when I tried to pay, they quoted 150 baht – it was a scam. Everyone should be careful when visiting this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cá Voi

sample_reviews_en.text:
[Food - Thailand Trip 2026]
This small restaurant is located near my AirBnB, a 1-minute walk from the BTS Victory Monument station and a 4-minute walk from the Baan Kuay Tiew Ruathong noodle shop.
It's a very typical local restaurant, from its ambiance to its food, offering a full range of basic Thai dishes. I ordered milk tea, chicken rice, and padthai - the padthai was better, the milk tea was a bit too sweet. The staff were friendly. You might want to try it if you're nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ba Vuong Nguyen

sample_reviews_en.text: Don’t expect a lot from this restaurant and you’ll be surprised how decent it can be. Their tom yum goong is a definite winner - one of the best i had in a while. The rest of their menu is a weird one - as they serve thai food and american food. I guess they are trying to cater not only for the locals, but also for visitors. They’re open till late so if you don’t like the street food, they’re a better option.
sample_reviews_en.author: Erick T

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice and cool inside. We came for breakfast and ordered pad thai, mango sticky rice, American breakfast, apple tea, and coconut shake. I was really impressed with the serving time. All orders came out very quickly. Everything tasted pretty decent except for the Apple tea. It was bland and didn’t taste like Apple at all. Overall, I would eat here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Blessy Chio

sample_reviews_en.text: I wanted an iced latte, so I ordered one, but they brought me coconut water. I told them I hadn't ordered it, but the staff insisted they weren't wrong and just kept saying it was my fault. Their customer service was unacceptable, and I felt like they looked down on tourists. There are plenty of other good places, so I will never go there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: 赤木裕樹

restaurants.name: The Diner Buffet @Vince Hotel
restaurants.address:

26/3 เพชรบุรีซอย 11 แขวงถนนพญาไท เขตราชเทวี, Phayathai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had an absolutely wonderful stay at Vince Hotel, and one of the biggest reasons was Mr. Peter.
Mr. Peter is, without a doubt, the kindest person we met during our entire trip to Thailand. From the moment we arrived, he welcomed us with genuine warmth, professionalism, and exceptional hospitality. He always went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable, assisted us with every request, and made us feel truly valued as guests.
His positive attitude, friendliness, and sincere care made our experience unforgettable. People like Mr. Peter are rare, and he is a true asset to Vince Hotel. He didn't just provide excellent service—he created lasting memories for us.
We will always remember his kindness, and he will definitely have a special place in our hearts for years to come. Thank you, Mr. Peter, for making our stay so memorable. We highly recommend Vince Hotel, and we hope every guest has the opportunity to meet such an amazing person.
Vince Hotel is the best hotel experience, both with breakfast and dinner buffet which is very rare in so far we’ve experience.

Thank you, Vince Hotel!
sample_reviews_en.author: Divine Baptista

sample_reviews_en.text:
All dishes are good and delicious, every dish there is touch of red (spicy) just a mild spicy only. The Vince Hotel is truly a hidden gem — actually, many gems in one place. They offer free unlimited breakfast and dinner, a complimentary shuttle service, and every staff member has a warm and accommodating attitude.
Special mention to Mr. Peter, the dinner buffet receptionist, who always greets guests with a warm smile and makes everyone feel welcome. I’d also like to commend Mr. Keaw. Although he may find it challenging to communicate in other languages, he is clearly doing his best to assist guests, and his effort is truly appreciated. Also my mom approved their services. 😘😘😘

This hotel has a free thai dress and can wear inside the hotel with free photoshoot with Ms. Mild and Ms. Nam they are very "maasikaso" in filipino term.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeremae Flores

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had such a great stay here! The whole place has a modern, cool vibe that makes it feel really stylish and relaxing at the same time. The service was excellent—staff were friendly, attentive, and made everything smooth from check-in to check-out.

A special mention to Ao Kang, Peter, and Nan who took care of me during dinner—they were incredibly accommodating and spoke great English, which made the experience even more comfortable and enjoyable.

The food was also a highlight. Breakfast had a good variety and everything was fresh and delicious, while dinner was just as impressive—flavorful, well-presented, and definitely something to look forward to after a long day.

Overall, a really enjoyable experience. Would definitely come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: maria claren

sample_reviews_en.text:
Come back to visit "The Dinner Bangkok @Vince Hotel" AGAIN!  Still had good Thai buffet (Kao Tom) as before. Though I dreamed for "fish tasty yum", they changed the menu every day (This means we can come every day to try different menus.  This time they had "tufu tasty yum" instead and used fish to do other menu (picture added).  But all dishes are very tasty delicious.

Overall, the Thai buffet at The Dinner offers very varieties of delicious and tasty Thai style dishes, importantly very reasonable price (Honestly worth more than I paid, so I ordered drink from the bar next door hoping to help the hotel to keep this Thai buffet service.

Will be back again soon, as a promise (Wish me luck to have fish tasty yum that day)
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimpana Srisawadi

sample_reviews_en.text:
We would like to commend Mr. Peter from the Diner. He was exceptionally kind, approachable, and attentive throughout our dining experience. He consistently offered assistance, checked on us from time to time, and always greeted us with a warm smile.

The food was excellent, and Mr. Peter truly stood out as one of the best staff members at Vince Hotel.

Thank you, Vince Hotel, for the wonderful dinner buffet experience. We will definitely come back. Vince Hotel is one of the few hotels in Pratunam that offers both a breakfast buffet and a dinner buffet at an affordable price, while also being conveniently located.

We highly recommend Vince Hotel to anyone visiting Bangkok. Thank you for your outstanding hospitality!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jamli Cords

sample_reviews_en.text: Had an amazing dinner buffet at Vince Hotel — such a hidden gem! The buffet was super generous with lots of delicious food to choose from, and the price was unbelievably affordable at just 150 baht. We grabbed cocktails from the bar to enjoy with dinner, which made the whole experience even better. After eating, we chilled at the poolside bar with a great vibe and relaxing atmosphere. The place was so nice that my friends didn’t want to go home at all. Definitely a must-try spot!
sample_reviews_en.author: Charaspan Srisawadi

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here after seeing an advertisement, and I was truly impressed. The food was absolutely delicious! I couldn’t believe that everything costs only 150 THB net, with no additional charges at all, yet the portions were so generous. It’s incredibly good value, especially in times like these.

The hotel is beautiful, and the restaurant has a lovely atmosphere as well. There are many great photo spots throughout the property.

Highly recommended! 📍 Phetchaburi Soi 11
sample_reviews_en.author: Raya sukchaem

sample_reviews_en.text: I highly recommend the complimentary dinner at Vince Hotel for our 5 nights stay. The food are appetizing, warm but some are a little too spicy for my liking. Peter the manager, who assist us every night on our designated table is very warm, gracious, effecient and jolly. We are so thankful of him and also with the very hardworking staff. Our snappy salute to everyone, it makes our stay at Vince Hotel because friendly and accomodating staff.We will be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michelle Ferrer

restaurants.name: Mandarin Suki & Dim Sum The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi
restaurants.address:

3522 Lat Phrao Rd, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi District, Bangkapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall, the food tasted okay, but the dining experience was quite disappointing due to the restaurant's internal management.

I ordered the Gold set but received incomplete food items, and each item was served very slowly, resulting in a long wait for everything to arrive. This significantly impacted the dining experience.

What I'd like the restaurant to improve is its order management and customer order tracking. Throughout the meal, no staff member inquired whether I had received all my food or if I needed anything tracked for the missing items.

I understand that the staff may have been overloaded with many customers and I'm not trying to criticize individual servers, but I believe the restaurant should have a better order verification and customer service system to ensure customers receive their food completely and don't have to wait too long. I hope the restaurant will take this feedback into consideration.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sun Night

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant attracts customers with its cheap prices and beef and lamb dishes, but the lamb was noticeably of poor quality, and they kept ordering the wrong items. The river shrimp I ordered were also terrible; the meat was mushy and not firm after cooking. The quantity of each order was also very confusing. I thought the roast duck would be plentiful, so I ordered two portions, but it turned out to be a small amount, so I ordered three, as shown in the picture. So, there's practically no difference between two and three portions; one portion might only have two slices of meat. Drinks and dipping sauces weren't replenished promptly; they only added a little when the customer noticed. My previous experience was just average, but because of the low prices, I would still go back if the restaurant was full. I won't go there again. I ordered the Gold 399 + 29 (drink).
sample_reviews_en.author: Wei Li

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was fine at first, nothing special. But as I kept eating, it became stressful because the staff were constantly staring at me, as if wondering if I was going to finish my food or throw it away. It completely ruined my appetite. Also, the receptionist at the cashier's desk needs improvement in terms of facial expressions, speech, and service. She seemed unwilling to serve, her facial expressions and demeanor were very obvious. I saw the restaurant was crowded and decided to try it, but I can only say I'm disappointed. 😀🙂 However, some of the staff were lovely, I commend them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Janny 13

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu is incomplete compared to Seacon Square. They don't have beef ribs, lime shrimp, or soy milk. The ice scoop should be stainless steel (I saw a plastic one the day I went). There were small cockroaches on the seats. The food was served quickly and was complete. The taste was average. The dim sum set with drinks was 228 baht, not expensive. It's okay for a filling meal, but nothing spectacular; it wasn't amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuna Zarena

sample_reviews_en.text: I wish there were improvements. If you're going to open a shabu-shabu buffet restaurant, you need to have everything well-prepared. Customers are willing to pay for good quality food, but almost everything was out of stock. I ordered two sets of each item, but only one arrived 😭🥲. This didn't just happen once, it happened several times. Please check and improve your preparation to better serve your customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nurnatasa Mhmd

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted good, but the delivery was completely mixed up and the wait was very long. The first time, it took almost half an hour, and the staff said the bill had been lost and told us to reorder, which we did. We waited until almost our time was up, and then they told us the meat we ordered was sold out. It was very disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: ลีนา สาแลแม

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff initially told us to wait outside the shop for a moment. We sat and waited, seeing empty tables, assuming they were being cleared. After a while, new customers walked in and were invited in to eat without any explanation. The service was confusing and disappointing. It was a terrible experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apiwit meesanga

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were very welcoming and provided excellent service. The food didn't take long to arrive, and there was a wide variety of meats and other dishes. The dipping sauces were delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: อัย

restaurants.name: Jae Lek & Jae Muay
restaurants.address:

2022 Pracha Songkhro 39 Alley, Ratchadaphisek, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: This rice porridge restaurant in Huai Khwang has plenty of seating, including an air-conditioned room. The food is prepared very quickly, and the prices are good. What I liked most was the fried sun-dried beef (80฿), which was thin, crispy, and flavorful 👍🏻
sample_reviews_th.author: Thitipan

sample_reviews_th.text: Terrible experience. The owner overcharged me twice in a row. The Tom Yum Sea Bass was 90฿ on the menu, but she charged me 150฿. The Shrimp Cakes were also 150฿, but she charged me 180฿. She cheated me right in front of my eyes. There was …
sample_reviews_th.author: Rick olo

sample_reviews_en.text:
I fill the glass halfway with water and pour beer into the frozen glass.
The chaotic daily life of Asia.
And then there's tom yum goong (500 yen) and poo pad pong curry. Is there a better choice of Thai food?
Let's talk about the tom yum goong here.
Small, green, weapon-like chili peppers with unusually high attack power are hiding at the bottom of the bowl.
If the soup were clear and you could see through to the bottom, you'd probably be able to avoid their attack, but because the soup is cloudy, they mercilessly and silently climb into your mouth without warning.
They're a stealth feast.
Eating even one will have you in agony.
Be warned, though, as your face will be sweating for about 10 minutes straight. Lol
Like the chili peppers, there are also plenty of large shrimp.
There's absolutely no problem with the taste.
Delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: 浮浪雲放浪記

sample_reviews_en.text:
This rice porridge shop has a huge menu, almost everything is delicious, the portions are generous, and the prices are affordable. It's my comfort zone; when I can't think of anything else to eat, I go to Je Lek Je Muey. It's always crowded, but the service is very fast.
The service is quick. It's a roadside shop, so the atmosphere might be a little chaotic. There's no air conditioning, and parking can be a bit difficult, but you can park along the road. Just be sure to check the parking restrictions.
Recommended dishes: Crispy catfish salad, stir-fried kale with crispy pork, stir-fried clams with chili paste, various tom yum soups, and braised pork intestines.
sample_reviews_en.author: N S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Whenever I can’t think of what to eat in Huay Kwang. I would probably come here.
Their beer is amazing, 80 baht and you’ll get big bottle of beer with a mug, frozen in fridge, with ice in it. The FORMALITY of drinking beer my friend, how can anybody say no to this!?

Atmosphere here is great, open terrance, road side, folded table and plastic chairs, yeah, it is very cheap looking and un-formal in every aspect. But it is this down-to-earth charm that makes it so attractive. The staffs are like families to each other, wearing smiles when they work, and would talk jokes to customers, everyone’s so chill being him or herself here.
sample_reviews_en.author: MAN BOK CHAN

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited around 11:30 PM on a weekday evening, shortly after arriving in Bangkok. It's really helpful that restaurants in Huai Khwang are open until late at night. While looking for a place with a decent number of customers, I found this place.

I ordered som tam with salted egg, stir-fried morning glory, and a squid dish recommended by the waiter. Of course, beer was a must.

All the dishes were delicious and paired perfectly with the beer!

Eating Thai food with a beer on the street... it really makes you feel like you're in Thailand, and I love it.

Also, the staff were friendly, so I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: nobu

sample_reviews_en.text:
This late-night restaurant is open until 3-4 AM. You can stop by for a hot bowl of rice porridge. The food tastes good and the service is lovely and friendly.
- Stir-fried morning glory with chili: Salty but delicious.
- Seafood soup: Very flavorful and spicy.
- Stir-fried clams with chili paste: The taste is okay, but there was some sand in the clams. I'm not sure if they weren't fresh or weren't washed properly.

The prices are reasonable. There's no parking lot. If you eat after midnight, you can park on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Trips Breaker

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went on December 30th, when Bangkok was practically deserted. The beer glass was frozen solid, half ice in the middle. The table was on the side of the road. Because of its location, there were a lot of Chinese tourists. All the food was served quickly and was delicious. Already just to my liking.

This time I had deep-fried chunks of mackerel, deep-fried spinach, stir-fried moo grob with chili sauce, stir-fried kale, gaeng som, khao suai, two Singha beers and one Kalabao beer for 840 baht. I highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Takeshi Saito

restaurants.name: Taco Bell
restaurants.address:

Samyan Mitrtown Parking Lot, 984 Phaya Thai Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Revised January 2026
This remains the best Taco Bell in Thailand.  They are still happy to make the items that have been officially removed from the menu - Double Deckers, Soft Tacos, Loaded Grillers. Some of Taco Bells also do, but NOT Siam Paragon (that is the worst one). The staff here are smart and friendly, and the place is always clean.  If they wanted to upgrade it, they could replace the electrical outlets at the bar area, coz they don't work.  But would be useful for the Chula students and faculty staff that are always on the go.

Original Review:
Compared to the US, Taco Bell in a Thailand is a much higher standard. Always clean and staff are courteous and competent. Prices are also fine. And the free refill soft drinks are a big draw. But unlike the US, the variety is very limited. They almost never add anything new.  And still after all these years, they still refuse to offer refried beans, which means their nachos and burritos are a big disappointment. That said, it's still good to have their signature crispy tacos available here.
sample_reviews_en.author: chriskennedy100 Kennedy

sample_reviews_en.text: Initially, I only intended to rent a power bank at the store, but my phone battery was completely dead and I couldn't do anything. The staff at the Taco Bell branch in Samyan Mitrtown were very kind and helpful, and extremely polite. I was very impressed. (Unlike the reception staff at Samyan Mitrtown mall, who, despite being employees of the mall, just shook their heads and refused when I asked for help.) So, I ended up supporting the restaurant as well. The food was delicious and tasted great as always. It was prepared fresh to order, so the food was ready to eat. I will definitely be a frequent customer again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Baobao Baobei
