sample_reviews_en.text: I really wanted to eat tacos, but they are too expensive in Korea and there are no places selling them near my house, so I ended up eating them here. It's seriously delicious! You just get your own drinks, and I had the main course set. It’s so good that I want to stop by here every day next time I come to Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: 강선미 (Lily)

sample_reviews_en.text: The cafe isn't very crowded, has plenty of spacious seating, and is quiet and peaceful. You can sit and read, study, or have meetings all day. Drinks are free-flow and refillable all day. Food takes a while to prepare, but the staff are well-behaved and stay in the back room, not bothering customers much.
sample_reviews_en.author: Korakot SAELIM

sample_reviews_en.text: The food arrived very quickly, hot and delicious. The restaurant is clean and the atmosphere is great. It's perfect for eating and reading. The staff gave great recommendations and I got a student discount. I'm very impressed and will definitely come back often.🥰🥰🥰🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: blue orange

sample_reviews_en.text: Very disappointed. The food photos on the menu were so similar I couldn't tell them apart. I ordered the wrong thing because I wasn't wearing my glasses. So frustrating! I can't even change my order. The easiest solution is to just stop eating there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Choosak Lek

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff provided excellent service, recommending everything and even explaining the membership program and how to redeem points. There's plenty of seating, and orders were taken quickly, with short wait times. I'm impressed every time I visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Memyself13

sample_reviews_en.text: Great food and great staff, the service was decent. Food was made really fast, only two drinks to drink, which are both coke, disappointment honestly. But other than that it was great!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ido Ross

restaurants.name: II Cups Café and Restaurant Dusit ทูคัพส์ คาเฟ่ แอนด์ เรสเตอรองท์ สาขาดุสิต
restaurants.address:

412, 4 Sam Sen Rd, Dusit, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time eating here. It was very easy to get to. Today I ordered the traditional glass noodle salad, tom yum goong (spicy shrimp soup), and fried chicken. The food tasted really good, fresh, and the portion sizes were appropriate for the price – fair value. I especially loved the fried chicken. Even though it's a common dish, the presentation was extraordinary; it was served with
thin, crispy rice crackers underneath.
The chicken was incredibly crispy 👍 and so enjoyable to eat.
The restaurant is stylish and comfortable. The Chef and the staff are very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chintana Parnchan

sample_reviews_en.text:
II cup - A must-visit cafe! 🌟
If you're looking for a cafe with a great atmosphere, delicious drinks, and amazing desserts, you can't miss II cup!

☕ Recommended Menu:
• Dirty coffee: Rich yet smooth, incredibly aromatic!
• Matcha latte: Rich, not too sweet, authentically Japanese flavor.
• Daily cakes: Adorable and surprisingly delicious!
(Try the warm chocolate lava cake with coffee – it's the best!)

📸 Highlights of the cafe:
• Plenty of photo opportunities, beautiful natural light everywhere.
• Simple yet stylish decor, perfect for photos.
• Friendly and helpful staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamolwan Dee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ice Cappuccino 9/10 (by far the must try one I've tried in Bangkok!), needs no explanation from the topping with nice decoration and a dash of cinnamon in style.
When I visited, BoGof promotion is offered for coffee during late morning till 11.00 am. Freebie is their soda menu.

The place is comfortable and cosy ambience. Panoramic glazing onto a busy street, but quiet inside. I recommend!

Remark. A cutie corner for photo shot with teddy bears is presented for those who love selfie.
sample_reviews_en.author: มานี่มาตรา มานั่น

sample_reviews_en.text: Can't recommend this restaurant. It was cold inside as in a refrigerator. The Latte was pretty good but a lot of what we wanted to order was sold out. We then received something what we didn't ordered, it took pretty long time although no one else besides us was there. The garlic butter bread I ordered was still frozen in the inside. For the high pricing this restaurant is very overrated.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sky

sample_reviews_en.text: The cooking is excellent, the ingredients are high-quality, and the dishes are delicious. My favorite is the fried chicken with white sauce. The chicken is crispy, fragrant, and perfectly coated in a juicy, flavorful sauce that's not too greasy. I ate two plates! 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Leonard Phedra

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere and service here are excellent. Even more impressive is the taste of the food. If you’re visiting Thailand and looking for a restaurant, I highly recommend this place. I hope you will have a wonderful experience in Thailand starting from here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ravitwin mns

sample_reviews_en.text: It's so delicious! The ingredients are organic and a lot of it is homemade. The price is not too expensive. The atmosphere is very family-friendly. If you have the chance to bring your parents or children here, you definitely won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kosai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a classic hot latte which was very tasty. A good selection of coffee beans to choose from.
However, the staff appeared glum and demotivated.
Very cozy interior, however
the air conditioning was very loud and distracting.
Didn't try the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: William H

restaurants.name: aiya bkk
restaurants.address:

The HUB (Phahol - Ari, 466/32, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I haven't been back to Thailand for over 10 years, but I'm truly impressed by the warmth and friendship of the staff, as well as the many services here. The fun and joy are beyond words—something you simply have to experience for yourself.

I haven't been back to Thailand for over 10 years, but I'm very impressed by the friendliness of the staff and the various services here. The fun and joy are beyond words; you simply have to experience it for yourself.
sample_reviews_en.author: Santot Kanteeranon

sample_reviews_en.text: The music is classic 90s and 00s hits, LGBTQ friendly, the air conditioning is cool and smoke-free, the singer has a great voice, it's crowded and the seating is cramped, the women's restroom is clean, the food is average, the average cost is 500-600 per person, the atmosphere is so lively you can dance, reservations are needed in advance, parking is difficult on the second floor of the alley, overall it's worth a visit and revisit.
sample_reviews_en.author: 曼谷上门服务Outcall Services

sample_reviews_en.text: It's an LGBTQ bar. The singers and musicians play music from the 90s-2000s. The voices are good, the music is good, the air conditioning is cool, but parking is hard to find. The shop is in an alley (2nd floor). What I have to praise is that there are no cigarettes or pots in the shop, which is good. The female waitress is friendly. (I went on 22 May 2015) I intended to go see P'Dang.
sample_reviews_en.author: B

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were rude and felt a bit condescending. We booked for 8 people but only got one table. The food was terrible; the rice was soggy. I understand that if you want to eat food, you can go to a restaurant that serves rice dishes, but it should at least be tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanokwan Suriyapornpong

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a shame I went last night, 4/10/68. Late at night, the singer sang only sad songs for a long time instead of being fun, making the atmosphere dull. And there was vaping in the shop, which shouldn't be done. It wasn't great, the whole area in the back stank.
sample_reviews_en.author: วัชรพงศ์ อินต๊ะสุข

sample_reviews_en.text: It was really fun, but the place was way too small. I booked for 10 people, but there was only enough space for about 5, so my friends had to squeeze in. We also waited over an hour for our food because the staff forgot to add our order
sample_reviews_en.author: SOFIA

sample_reviews_en.text: There were so many people in the whole shop. All the singers had good voices. The shop is between Saphan Khwai and Ari stations. If you come by BTS, get off at Saphan Khwai and walk a bit closer than Ari.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattha T.

sample_reviews_en.text: We booked for 15 people and got two tables and six chairs. Later, another chair was added, but we waited for an hour and the table situation still wasn't ready. We haven't even received our menus yet.
sample_reviews_en.author: พีรพัฒน์ ส่งสุข

restaurants.name: เทอเรสซ์ เดอ บางกอก (อาคารสีลม ทาวเวอร์)
restaurants.address:

306 Si Lom Rd, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is right in front of the mall, but the food, in some cases, is terrible and expensive. It doesn't live up to the pictures.
The fried chicken wings with fish sauce were awful, smelled old and stale. The papaya salad was very bland and overpriced at 199 baht. The sour curry with acacia leaves and shrimp was edible but not flavorful enough. The baked pork ribs were okay. The sun-dried pork and sun-dried beef were tasty. The fried sea bass was not fresh at all. The watermelon smoothie was delicious.
It was very busy during lunchtime. The female staff provided good service and we had to follow up on our order several times.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phot Surong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, authentically Thai, and the prices are great. It's fantastic! The flavors truly capture the essence of Thai cuisine; it's the best in the area! The staff provides excellent and friendly service. They now have many new menu items, such as the spicy noodle salad (Tam Sen Lek), which is a must-try.
But the classic dishes like the crab rib stew with wide rice noodles remain my all-time favorites. The flavors are perfectly balanced, and the ribs are so tender they melt in your mouth. If you haven't tried it yet, you absolutely have to! It's truly amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jitsina Siripakmanon

sample_reviews_en.text: Pleasant but casual restaurant that has very tasty food. It is located in a small indoor mall (or they call it a supermarket). I had the Steamed Shrimp with Garlic, and it was absolutely delicious.  An order of brown rice made it a complete meal.  The slight down side is they were out of several items on the menu.  So keep 1 or 2 alternative in mind when ordering.
sample_reviews_en.author: TK

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is flavorful, with a wide variety of Thai dishes to choose from. The prices are reasonable, and the staff are friendly and cheerful. The restaurant is spacious and the decor is pleasing to the eye.
It's perfect for large families or groups of friends. Currently, they have a seafood menu, which I highly recommend – the flavors are intensely satisfying.
sample_reviews_en.author: wasana kamonnant

sample_reviews_en.text: The environment was quite comfortable. I ordered the special set meal for 169 yuan, but the taste was just average. I was only full. The pork cartilage and fried egg rice set meal was better. Also, the curry was too spicy, and there wasn't enough meat.
sample_reviews_en.author: A T

sample_reviews_en.text: Loved the food here. The papaya salad was spot on with the seasoning and easily a highlight. We tried several dishes and most of them were really good, and the desserts were great as well. The green curry was slightly salty but overall very enjoyable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lynn Quach

sample_reviews_en.text: Very delicious Thai dishes with excellent service. Not overpriced. I think it's pretty reasonable for the quality and portion size. I particularly like our herbal drinks, smoothies, and seafood. Highly recommended if you're in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Meay S

sample_reviews_en.text: The crab roe noodles are delicious, and importantly, don't forget the Benjarong Bua Loy (Thai dessert). The staff are friendly and lovely. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for authentic Thai food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aum Ekkapong

restaurants.name: TONG TONG HAAN ปิ่นเกล้า
restaurants.address:

7/1 ชั้น2 รหัสร้าน 202 Borommaratchachonnani Rd, Arun Amarin, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The grilled pork set (set 6) with sesame oil marinated grilled pork is a great value. It's a complete set including rice, soup, grilled pork, dipping sauce, and side dishes.
- The marinated salmon was okay, but I'm not sure if it was frozen salmon. The dipping sauce was spicy and flavorful.
- The Tong Tong fried rice is like a mixed rice dish. It contains butter fried rice, which seems to be the rice fried with butter first, along with shrimp roe, seaweed, pork cracklings, and pork stir-fried in sauce. It's well-mixed and tasty.
- The kimchi soup is spicy, not salty. It has a generous amount of pork belly and tofu. Considering the price, getting that much pork belly is worth it.
- The service from the staff was excellent. We couldn't find the restaurant, so we called for directions and received a very helpful response.
sample_reviews_en.author: jam pitchakorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Korean restaurant is delicious. Some dishes reminded me of the authentic Korean flavors I experienced during my month-long stay in Korea. In particular, some dishes that aren't available at every other restaurant, like the mandu soup (dumplings with lots of glass noodles – it tasted exactly like the real thing! 🤣) and the beef bone soup, were fragrant and rich, very similar to what I used to eat in Korea.

Many things were great, like the free rice refills, pickled vegetables, fresh vegetables, and other aspects were just like the original.

In short, it was delicious. It's a shame the restaurant is in a slightly hard-to-reach location; some people might not know it exists in this area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Atchara Set

sample_reviews_en.text:
Free refills of side dishes include pickled radish and kimchi.
The kimchi is delicious and you can get unlimited refills.
If you order a set meal, you get unlimited free rice refills.
Food is ordered via QR code.
If it's not convenient, you can order with the staff.
Food comes out relatively quickly, no long wait.
It's located inside Central, not in the plaza area.
Walk in from the parking lot on the 2nd floor, straight into the mall.
Before going out to the plaza area.
Not too crowded.
sample_reviews_en.author: Butterfaiy Wang

sample_reviews_en.text: This brand new Korean restaurant is located on the 2nd floor of the mall (not a plaza, just inside the mall!). It has a great Korean atmosphere. The taste is okay, and the prices aren't too high, except for the alcoholic drinks which are a bit pricey. I wanted to drink but it didn't seem worth it. Overall, it's good. The staff are helpful and provide good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattakorn Jirarungroj

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere of the restaurant is amazing! 💖😍 It feels just like being in Korea. The food is also excellent, with very authentic Korean flavors. Side dishes are free, and the price is great value considering the quality of the food. I highly recommend trying it! The staff are also very attentive and lovely. ✌️👍💖 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Warinkarn Srichomphoo

sample_reviews_en.text: The kimchi was delicious! The staff were attentive and very lovely. I recommend the Korean-style grilled pork 👍 The food didn't take long to arrive either. However, I felt the prices were a bit high. Some dishes were okay considering the generous portions. The crispy pork rind Jajangmyeon was delicious ❤️ …
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimmada Leelakajonjit

sample_reviews_en.text: This delicious Korean restaurant has opened a new branch at Central Pinklao! I tried it and everything was amazing. The prices are also very reasonable, and they now offer set meals at this branch. It's fantastic! You definitely have to try it! 💕😋 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimpavee Saladkaew

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the wait time is short, the service is good, and all the staff are lovely. I've eaten here many times and highly recommend it. It's located at Central Pinklao. Eating Korean food here makes me look like a Korean! 😂
sample_reviews_en.author: TON KLA

restaurants.name: Il Giardino di Nam Italian Restaurant
restaurants.address:

417, 86 soi bong kock 8, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have eaten spaghetti bolognese here before that I adored. Tonight I ordered a takeaway napoletana pizza. As I sat and waited I was given some crispy pizza bread (for want of a better description) that was very nice and welcome. The restaurant was almost full and next to me was a table of 4 or 5 men speaking Italian. I think they were here the last time. The lady manager was very effective in driving the staff to do their best. The staff all looked proficient in their work too. The pizza was absolutely fabulous only let down by not having enough anchovies for me but then that's on me. I will definitely come back here again.
Edit:- I recently ate here again this time I ordered the massaman chicken. Unfortunately the meal was quite tasteless lacking flavour and spices. The 'sauce' was like a thin soup and the chicken and potatoes had not been cooked long enough in the soup to absorb the flavour. I had to leave half of it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nelson Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the spaghetti bolognese for 250B.

The dish was well-received, with the texture of the ground meat. The sauce itself was nothing particularly memorable.

The Tabasco sauce was sold in a store-bought container, but it was likely homemade. It was clear and smelled strongly of vinegar, with no noticeable spiciness.

Pasta dishes in Pattaya are generally not properly drained, and this restaurant was no exception, with hot water pooling underneath the pasta.

This restaurant advertises itself as Italian, but they have so many other dishes on the menu that it's hard to decide what to order. I simply ordered spaghetti. I've done my best to take photos of the menu, so I'll post them here.

It's on the first floor of the hotel. There appears to be plenty of parking space.
sample_reviews_en.author: Syo Kei

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lasagne average at best, Tagliatelle bolognese were slightly sauer, when I make a bolognese at home it’s stunning, we eat from it for 3 days in a row, and when I go to a Restaurant I want it to be at least as good as mine, if not better than mine. Surprise me.

I sent it back, I normally never do that, I’m not complicated with food and have a healthy threshold of accepting food, even when it’s average, but when it’s sauer, it means it’s off.

Waiting for the Pizza Diavola now, let’s see what happens…

…also average 0.5 non-spicy Salami slice per piece of pizza.

There were a few elderly Italian guys eating, and even they didn’t seem convinced. Sad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel A

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hi There,

I went yesterday to an Italian restaurant "IL Giardino & Nam.
It's in between two roads so if you don't mind some scooters driving past, this Italian street spot, run by some culinary wizards from Thailand, is hot? I was served up a seafood pasta that was ridiculously good. Seriously, it’s like they kidnapped an Italian mama and made her spill all her secrets. The homemade spaghetti was so on point it could make you question your life choices. And get this @$11 for a meal, water, beer, and a double espresso, awesome or? Oh, and one table surrounded by five old Italian guys, you know your right!!!

Cheers

Richard
sample_reviews_en.author: Richard v. Lauenstein

sample_reviews_en.text:
The chef needs to learn more about cooking..my friend had fish and chips and the fish was well over cooked..burnt on underside..chips were undercooked..my pork chop was well over cooked and dry..cabonara was stodgy but ok.
Girlfriends food was cabonara seafood...4 out 10..battered fried squid was a winner
Bread given...ok ..tomato salad was ok..only tomato on lettuce..
I think and hope with some fine tuning everything could be better..
Bottom line will we be back...ummm..not in a hurry..
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Tatham

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice little garden restaurant. They have the red and white checkered tablecloth a pepper grinder and chili oil as it should be.
I was not too happy with my pizza though.
Ordered a Carrettiera. The dough was nicely thin and crusty, but the topping destroyed it all. Instead of bacon got ham and mushrooms came most probably from the can, all was drenched in cheese and I did not taste any garlic.
Most other customers ate pasta, maybe those are better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Enjoy Pattaya

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I had the set menu with spaghetti alle vongole and fritto misto — both were absolutely exceptional, honestly a 10 out of 10! 🍝🦑

The pasta was perfectly al dente, just the way I asked for it, and the seafood was super fresh and crispy. I also had a Coke with my meal, and in the end, I was shocked by how cheap the total bill was for such high quality.

Truly amazed. One of the best Italian meals I’ve had in Pattaya 🇮🇹👏
sample_reviews_en.author: Doctor A Condo Rentals Angeles City

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is fantastic.

If there are a lot of people, it's a place you'll want to linger at.

I had the Bolognese, but they didn't have any Tabasco sauce.

It came with a baguette, so that was enough to fill me up.

Next time, I'll try the recommended pizza.

Revisited on January 10, 2025

This time, I tried the pizza I'd been wanting to try last time.

Also, the pork fillet was inexpensive, so it was definitely worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: 輝宮城

restaurants.name: SOSHI
restaurants.address:

2 N Sathon Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Premium buffet was amazing. Good quality sashimi with variety of nigiri and maki.

The price was 2199฿net (exclude beverage) In-house guests receive 20% discount and Accor Plus members receive 33% discount.
sample_reviews_th.author: Patrisha Srithawatpong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Disappointed.
We went as a group of three for a birthday.
Two used their Visa Infinite privileges.
The third person paid 2,300 THB.

In the afternoon before entering the restaurant, a staff member called to say they would have a birthday cake ready.

Everything was fine until towards the end. We ordered four oysters, and they were rotten!!! They smelled terrible. Didn't the chef smell them???

When we ordered dessert, we waited for the birthday cake, but no one brought it. Even when we asked for the bill, no one brought it. At first, we thought it was because we were outside customers, since every other table was hotel guests.

If we had paid the full price for three people, it would have been over 7,000, almost 8,000 THB.
For rotten oysters and no birthday cake...it's truly outrageous. Even if it were a complimentary cake, if they had told us beforehand, we would have bought it to surprise my partner.

Extremely disappointed.

After the meal, we wrote on the bill that we didn't receive a cake and that the oysters were rotten. A staff member called to apologize, but it seems no one brought the birthday cake.

In conclusion...it's our own fault.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaywin Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
SOSHI, SOgood, SOamazing.

I normally dont like to write reviews bcoz I prefer to keep hidden gems, hidden. 😂

However, I was surprised at how good SOSHI was but strange how it wasn’t a full house the evening I was there.

Thats a crime. Bcoz the menu was huge, the food was top-notch, the service (by Poppy, Eva and Kik) was impeccable and the value was amazing (booked buffet deal on Hungry Hub). The sushi and sashimi were, as expected, fresh and well-presented. But other offerings, such as the Thai fusion salmon and the unagi, were good too. They did not try to stuff U up with big portions. Rather, servings were according to #of diners  so U can try a lot of whats on their menu. Save some space for their excellent matcha ice cream.

Overall, its (an almost) Michelin level dining experience at an insanely low price. Quick. Book. Go. Enjoy it while it lasts.
⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
sample_reviews_en.author: anthony sim

sample_reviews_en.text: Two years ago, exhausted from our 12 hour flight my husband and I have decided to dine in at our beautiful hotel SO/Bangkok. SO/shi sounded like a great option so the decision was quickly made. I wouldn’t exaggerate saying that it was the best sushi we have ever tried. This appraisal is earned mostly because of the freshness of the ingredients. Think of salmon melting on your tongue and tuna so red as never seen before. Here you can mostly find a limited menu with traditional types of sushi that have a beautiful presentation. We have been craving that sushi ever since. Everytime we ordered sushi back home we compared it to So/shi at SO/Bangkok. So now two years later we are back at SO/Bangkok and of course dining at So/shi. Luckily the standard remained the same and we absolutely enjoyed our time!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nigar Afandiyeva

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tried Soshi's Robatayaki as part of Red Oven's Weekend Dinner and it was probably the highlight and my favorite selection from our dinner. The salmon sashimi was, as expected, very fresh and almost melts in your mouth. As a non-sashimi eater I liked that it didnt have the fishy taste I fear in eating raw fish. The grilled meat were absolutely tasty and tender. I personally liked their grilled pork and australian beef. Despite having the beef well done, it was still very tender and all the skewers we tried were perfectly cooked and well-seasoned.

I liked the open and free-flowing concept SO Bangkok has for their restaurants. Soshi opened up to Red Oven and made the integrated buffet experience flow seamlessly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maxwell Jimenez

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I had an amazing time at Soshi w/ their AYCE menu.
The only reason I gave food 4stars is because I expected a much bigger variety of sushi options in comparison to what was available.
It is located on the 7th floor of a very nice hotel complex.

The service was incredible as Mook and Rat made sure that I was attended to every moment and all my needs were met swiftly. Khob Khun Mak Khap 🙏

The atmosphere was very relaxing as luckily I arrived early upon opening and was able to start ordering right away.
The sashimi and sushi were very nice quality! I am a huge salmon lover and I was definitely satisfied from the available options. Rice to fish ratio was also very nice for an AYCE sushi.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom Liang

sample_reviews_en.text:
I simply love this place for its sushi and sashimi  buffet spread.
Let me be clear, this is not a 'you get the food off the rack yourself' buffet.
This buffet is unlimited ordering from a proper menu with the items prepared for you.
Items include lobster miso soup / foie gras salmon sushi /  hokkaido scallop sushi / wagyu beef skewers / assorted sashimi and many many more.
All the wonderful food is matched with excellent  and attentive service : special mention to Pangpond / Rat!
I loved the entire dining experience so much (last year) that I came back to stay at SO Bangkok again just for this and the quality of food and service remains great!
Keep it up!
sample_reviews_en.author: Adrian

sample_reviews_en.text: This Japanese restaurant is located on the 7th floor of the So Bangkok Hotel on Rama IV Road. The seating area is separate from other restaurants, which I really liked because it felt very private. Mook (as shown on the name tag) provided excellent service; I was very impressed. The food was delicious, especially the sashimi. It was very fresh, clean, and the portions were generous – great value for money. The Three King Roll, with wagyu, eel, foie gras, and truffle sauce, was incredibly good value.
sample_reviews_en.author: cosmo

restaurants.name: เฉิงฟู่ ข้าวมันไก่สิงคโปร์ (สาขา เจริญนคร)
restaurants.address:

1735, 1737 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is a must-visit for its delicious Singaporean-style Hainanese Chicken Rice. They serve tender, juicy chicken thigh meat with perfectly crispy skin, drizzled with the restaurant's special sauce, and served with fragrant, golden-yellow rice. It's irresistibly delicious!

Recommended dishes you can't miss:

Singaporean Hainanese Chicken Rice Set – Tender and juicy chicken thigh meat served with soup and three dipping sauces: Thai style, ginger in oil, and chili orange. A perfectly balanced and delicious flavor.

Crispy Pork Belly – A popular favorite, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, a delightful treat with every bite.

Hong Kong-style Char Siu (BBQ Pork) – Incredibly juicy and delicious.

The restaurant's special soup with fragrant seaweed is refreshing and pairs perfectly with the Hainanese chicken rice.

For Hainanese chicken rice lovers, this restaurant offers authentic Singaporean quality and flavor at affordable prices. Menu items range from 59-99 baht. Try it once and you'll be hooked!

Truly delicious, Chillcheeva confirms!

#Chillcheeva
sample_reviews_en.author: Chill Cheeva

sample_reviews_en.text: Good chicken rice place , the rice is not traditional thai chicken rice . The taste and flavour of the rice is less intensive than normal thai chicken rice . However the chicken is more tender and juicy than normal thai chicken hai nan style rice . The sauce on the table is good . It comes with free soup too . I tried the fried pork bacon . It’s a bit fusion , taste between roast pork skin with bacon flavour . Staff service is good . Price is reasonable for the portion . Parking is street parking and sometimes is hard to get parking nearby shop . Reminder start looking for car park within 50m before arrive shop . Wheel chair is not accessible, as the shop have small door step to walk in . Shop is clean and food is good . Worth a try if around or for someone who likes to try a bit of different Hai Nan chicken rice .
sample_reviews_en.author: TM LEK

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cheng Fu Singaporean Hainanese Chicken Rice
This Singaporean-style Hainanese chicken rice restaurant is known for its succulent and tender chicken cooked using the sous vide method, and its unique Singaporean Hainanese chicken rice sauce. Prices start at approximately 69 - 139 THB (tender chicken with sesame oil sauce).
Minced Chicken (S/M/L): 169 - 339 THB (using only the thigh for maximum juiciness).
Singaporean Chicken Liver: 89 THB (tender liver, no gamey taste).
Crispy Pork Bacon/Hong Kong Style Char Siu Pork: 139 - 229 THB.
Sauces: 3-4 options available, including Thai soybean paste sauce, ginger in oil, and Singaporean-style chili sauce.

Cheng Fu Singaporean Hainanese Chicken Rice (Charoen Nakhon Branch)
sample_reviews_en.author: Vit

sample_reviews_en.text:
The newest Singaporean Hainanese Chicken Rice shop on Charoen Nakhon Road.
The highlight is the rice, the chicken sauce, and the dipping sauces!! I was very impressed with the dipping sauces. The ginger was fragrant, the sesame oil was aromatic, but I was most impressed with the sweet soy sauce. This was the first time I'd tried this brand, or maybe I had, but didn't know it was this delicious. It's sweet with cane sugar, not bitter.
The seaweed soup with pepper was rich and flavorful.
The shop is on the main road, so be aware of police regarding parking.

Oh, one thing that bothered me a little: the drinking straws were extremely thin and difficult to use. I've never seen straws this small and slender before.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pang Kate

sample_reviews_en.text: Our whole family usually loves Hainanese chicken rice, and we recently discovered Cheng Fu Hainanese Chicken Rice at the Charoen Nakhon branch – and we absolutely love it! The rice is perfectly cooked, the chicken is incredibly tender, and the dipping sauce is amazing. We also recommend the crispy pork belly with bacon – it's super crispy and tastes fantastic with their special seafood dipping sauce. And the roasted pork is so tender it practically melts in your mouth! It's incredibly delicious. If you're passing by, we highly recommend trying it. Parking might be a little difficult, but otherwise, it's fantastic.
sample_reviews_en.author: ระ ริน

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a two-shopfront, open-air restaurant by the roadside.

Chicken Rice: The rice is fragrant, neither hard nor soggy. The chicken is very tender. The gravy has a fragrant sesame oil flavor and is slightly salty.

Hong Kong Style Char Siu (BBQ Pork): The spices are rich and savory, making it suitable to eat with rice.

Crispy Pork Belly: The skin is crispy, the meat is tender and firm. The seafood dipping sauce is spicy and flavorful.

Parking: Parking is available along the white and black marked sidewalk.
sample_reviews_en.author: Athiwat Seritanawong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chicken Rice Menu

The chicken is incredibly tender, practically melting in your mouth, almost like sous vide chicken. If you like that, you'll love it; if not, you might find it a bit greasy.

The rice is a little too firm, and there's not enough oil, making it feel dry and slightly tough.

The dipping sauce is average in flavor, neither too salty nor too sweet.

The soup is flavorful, with plenty of seaweed, but no winter melon.

The price is considered cheap given the quantity and quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: P'Na Narak

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm a fan of Hainanese chicken rice. Here, the chicken is tender and fluffy, the sauce is sweet, and the rice is okay. The crispy pork tastes like smoked pork that's been made crispy. The pork liver is decent. My favorite is probably the roasted pork, which I ordered to take home; the meat is very tender. Compared to the portion size, price, and taste, it's a bit pricey for a roadside stall. The restaurant isn't air-conditioned, so it's not suitable for elderly people due to its location.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratchanida Gmail

restaurants.name: Pastaio - Artisan Italian @The QUAD
restaurants.address:

Ground floor, The Quad, 138 Sukhumvit 2, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
As someone who lives here… I personally thought the LandMark Hotel always had great service… Ever since I was a young lad. Pistaio is situated in the lobby of the restaurant. Sort of in a courtyard setting indoors.

Had a light nibble, I ordered the Mushroom Pizza (Sorry forgot the name💀), and the Capracassia?. Either way, I may not be fluent in Italian, È stato fantastico - It was amazing… however, at first glance you might thing it looks little for a pizza. But for the price of ฿280 in a high class hotel is absolutely worth it.

Great staff, great food… would come again for sure! 🤘🏽
sample_reviews_th.author: Jamie Cameron

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Hidden Gem for Pasta and Pizza Lovers in Bangkok!

If you’re craving authentic Italian flavors in the heart of Bangkok, this restaurant is an absolute must-visit. I was genuinely impressed by the quality of both the pasta and the pizza — every bite tasted like it came straight from Italy.

The ingredients are top-notch. You can really taste the difference: fresh herbs, rich sauces, and premium cheeses that melt perfectly. The pasta was cooked al dente, just the way it should be, and the homemade sauces were packed with flavor. The pizza had a thin, crispy crust with generous toppings and a beautiful balance of textures and tastes.

The ambiance is cozy and welcoming, making it a great spot for both casual dinners and special occasions. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable, happy to recommend dishes and wine pairings.

Highly recommend for anyone looking for a truly delicious Italian dining experience in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wannapa Pitilamlertkhun

sample_reviews_en.text:
A brand-new Italian gem at The Landmark Bangkok Hotel, located on the G Floor in The QUAD Sukhumvit Eatery. Pastaio Artisan Italian serves up truly authentic homemade Italian dishes in a cozy, open-kitchen setting. There’s even a stylish bar area with a chill vibe – perfect for date nights or special occasions!

✨ Must-Try Dishes ✨

Homemade Pizza Trio:
Crudo e Burrata Pizza, Funghi e Salsiccia Pizza, and Capricciosa Pizza – all full of flavor and freshly baked.

Fresh Pasta Highlights:
Linguine alle Vongole – light yet savory.
Radiatori Khao Soi Nue Yang – a fun Thai twist that surprisingly works!

Caprese Salad (Insalata Caprese) – fresh, simple, and delicious.

If you're looking for authentic homemade Italian with great flavors and an inviting atmosphere, I highly recommend checking out Pastaio Artisan Italian. It’s a new favorite for me!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanida Raweelertpunya

sample_reviews_en.text: I was really impressed with the service, the taste of the food and the small details. The pastas were delicious, especially the Tuna Tartar; it has a really unique sour but delicate taste, a menu I’ve never tried before. The pizza was amazing; the dough was thick and crispy and very chewy..perfect for a carb lover like me. The burrata tomato salad was also perfect…the pesto was very flavorful. The price of the whole meal ranged around 800 per person, which was reasonable given the quality of the food and the service. The staffs were really nice and friendly as well. Totally recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornjira Pantusen

sample_reviews_en.text: The establishment is located on the first floor of the hotel. Several establishments are in one space. A view of the escalators. We ordered various pastas. Well, I'd give it a three. The dishes didn't have much flavor. We've had much better ones. We ordered pizza and were extremely surprised by the 10 x 10 cm slices (it was a whole pizza). It turns out that all of their pizzas are like that. You won't be full just by yourself. The only tasty cocktail was the Margarita. And the price tag for a five-star pizza was pretty high.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ксения Баранникова

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’m shocked this place doesn’t have many more reviews, it was lovely! We had the burrata salad, cacio e Pepe, Sausage and margerita pizza (the pizzas are smaller than average size which is nice because you can try different bits off the menu if you are hungry!). The service was brilliant and the drinks also tasted nice.

This restaurant is within the quad and it has a bar that serves all the restaurants. It’s a really nice vibe in there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lambo

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is spacious, beautiful, elegant, high-quality, and cozy.

The menu is very diverse with many choices.
The food is hot and very delicious. Service is quite fast and attentive.

Although the prices are listed, they are a little higher than average, but still acceptable.
The atmosphere is good, making it easy to chat.

The restrooms are clean and fragrant.

Overall, my experience here was very good, and I will visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hang Dinh

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is probably one of or maybe the best pasta and pizza in Bangkok I've tried! The pizzas dough is soft and crispy, a lot of ingredients on it. The way they serve Lasagna is also interesting and it tastes delicious.
Also the price is not that expensive as in others average Italian restaurants around that area.
I'd like to visit this play again to try all the menu!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ragnarok Is Near

restaurants.name: Kam's Roast Express
restaurants.address:

1st floor, 1027, 115 Phloen Chit Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kam’s Roast Express at The Market Place Chidlom serves very delicious duck — tender, flavorful, and pleasantly chewy. The roast pork is also tasty, with a nice balance of crisp skin and juicy meat. However, the duck sauce tastes a bit like sesame salad dressing, which doesn't perfectly complement the rich duck flavor. It would be great if they offered a sauce that pairs better with the roast. Overall, I really enjoyed the meal and especially loved the quality and texture of the duck.

Kam’s Roast Express at The Market Place Chidlom has very delicious duck; the meat is tender and has a pleasantly chewy texture. The roast pork is also tasty and tender. However, the sauce tastes a bit like sesame salad dressing, which doesn't quite match the duck flavor. It would be great if they offered a sauce that complements the duck better. Overall, I really liked the meal and especially loved the quality and texture of the duck.
sample_reviews_en.author: Orrahappy

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kam’s Roast Express at Central Embassy offers a convenient option for a quick meal while shopping. The roast meats were flavoursome and nicely prepared, with the duck standing out as particularly enjoyable. The restaurant was clean, and service was efficient, with staff processing orders promptly despite a steady flow of customers.

However, the overall experience did not quite live up to the Michelin reputation displayed throughout the restaurant. While the food was pleasant, it lacked the depth of flavour and wow factor one might expect. The portions were reasonable, but some dishes felt more food-court quality than destination dining.

Overall, a decent and reliable choice for a casual meal in Central Embassy. Good if you’re nearby and looking for a quick bite, but perhaps not somewhere I would make a special journey to visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Y M

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Chill food court atmosphere.
- The soup had a unique flavor, like shrimp and crab shells.
- The duck was from the thigh, tender and juicy with crispy skin.

- The dipping sauce was sesame-flavored, slightly salty, not sweet.
- The chili paste was spicy with a sweet and salty undertone; goes well with anything for those who like spicy food.
- The mustard wasn't too pungent, fragrant and sweet, perfect with the plum sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Disarong Sookmak

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came to eat here at lunch time at Kam's Roast Express. The staff was friendly and took our order after which we received a beeper. When ready, the beeper goes off and have to get the food yourself. The food is delicious!

There are many tables available to sit, and you can order at another restaurant and still together with your friends. Great!
sample_reviews_en.author: Fan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located between Central Chidlom and Central Embassy. The atmosphere is nice, and the wait time is short.
The food is incredibly delicious, especially the char siu pork, crispy pork, and roast duck. What I liked most was the sauce; it was amazing!
The quality is well worth the price. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yanisa Liu

sample_reviews_en.text: The Hong Kong-style noodles were fragrant, the roast duck was flavorful with crispy skin and tender meat, the char siu pork was fragrant and tender with a slightly crispy texture, and the shrimp dumplings were fragrant with pepper, although the soup was a bit bland. Overall, it was good but very expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Witsanu Sae-khow

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located in the Central Chidlom food court, this stall specializes in duck...which I don't like.

However, I thoroughly enjoyed their fried rice! Delicious, well-seasoned, and a generous portion.

And the soup with shrimp wontons was a hit with my partner.
We'll definitely be back! 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Jean-Luc Riou

sample_reviews_en.text:
Too careless towards customers

If you look like a foreigner, I suggest you go there. They serve foreigners very well. Asians should not go there. They treat them differently. Anyway, I will not go there. The attitude is perfunctory. I don't know why it is called Michelin？
sample_reviews_en.author: thiha naing Sai

restaurants.name: เฮียถิตก๋วยเตี๋ยวเป็ด
restaurants.address:

QGGC+VGM, 3/1 Sukhantharam Rd, Suan Chitlada, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300

sample_reviews_en.text: I really like it! The duck noodle soup is delicious, the service is excellent, and the atmosphere is pleasant and comfortable – perfect for relaxing. They open from 4 PM onwards.

sample_reviews_en.text: The soup was fragrant with a hint of sweetness, and the duck was tender and delicious. I don't have a picture because it was so delicious I ate it all and forgot to take photos!

sample_reviews_en.text: You absolutely have to come to this place, it's really delicious, don't miss it!

sample_reviews_en.text:
You can park right in front of the restaurant. There's seating both outside and in private rooms. The staff are very friendly and provide excellent service. However, you might have to wait a bit because there are few staff members and they're often overwhelmed. I felt sorry for them, seeing them running around until they were out of breath.

Some dishes are average in taste, but others are incredibly delicious. I personally loved the papaya salad and the fried sea bass with fish sauce. The papaya salad wasn't refined; it had a simple, down-to-earth flavor, which I really liked – it was amazing! Usually, papaya salad at other restaurants is too fancy.

From what I observed, the fried and spicy dishes are generally better, but the grilled items aren't as good.

The grilled pork neck, which many people rave about, was just okay for me. It was very fatty and quite greasy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jinkawin P

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very delicious!

The snakehead fish was huge and the flavor was very spicy and suited my taste perfectly.
The papaya salad with fermented fish sauce was amazing.
The corn salad, ordered without peanuts and less sweet, was exactly how I wanted it.
The stir-fried pork belly with chili and salt was a little tough on the outside 😊
Overall, the food was delicious.

Came back for a second time.
06/06/2023
Spicy and delicious, the cooking skills haven't dropped at all!
-Grilled pork neck: very large pieces, tender meat.
-Papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce: ordered spicy, and it was perfect.
-Winged bean salad: delicious.
-Corn salad: delicious.
-Spicy pork bone soup: easy to drink, delicious, but the meat wasn't tender enough, a bit tough.

The food was prepared quickly, no long wait.
sample_reviews_en.author: in taphan

sample_reviews_en.text: I often drive past this place but only recently went in. At first, the prices didn't match the reviews here; they've gone up. I thought it was a bit expensive. But once the food arrived, the portions were huge and filling. The fried chicken wasn't chopped into small pieces like other restaurants; it was a whole piece. The pork waterfall dish also had a generous amount of pork. They didn't cut it up for the customer. The taste was delicious; all three dishes were tasty. The atmosphere is more suitable for dinner because it's hot during the day. The restaurant has air-conditioned rooms, several separate rooms with 2-3 tables each, which provides good privacy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tunyatip Tilunggarn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Edit: We went a second time and were not disappointed. They recommended some other dishes that were delicious.

The food was delicious. The owner made amazing recommendations and the staff was so kind to our family and our young children. We will come back soon! The sea bass and pineapple rice was delicious.

The food was delicious. The owner gave great recommendations and the staff were very kind to our family and children. We will definitely come back! The sea bass and pineapple rice was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Luce

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything was delicious, I can confirm! You should definitely come and eat here. I loved it so much! The atmosphere is great and relaxing. The service is good and the staff are friendly and smiling. If you're worried about mosquitoes, there's an air-conditioned room available.
Recommended dishes: The Tom Yum soup was perfect, and the stir-fried cabbage with fish sauce was spot-on ✅
I'll definitely come back again! 💖🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: PraxedeS Lyla

sample_reviews_en.text: Saap Ozone restaurant was a stumble upon, located next to a famous restaurant. Everything we ordered was delicious; we loved it all. They also serve draft beer. The food came out quickly, and we didn't have to wait long. It wasn't too crowded. The owner provided great service. It's a chill place to sit, with old Thai music playing. Overall, we really liked it and will definitely go back to try other dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mkung Power

sample_reviews_en.text: The grilled prawns and the fried prawns with tamarind sauce were delicious. They weren't dry or tough, and the prawns were nice and bouncy. The papaya salad was also tasty. The atmosphere was great, and the service was excellent. I will definitely come again if I have the chance. Importantly, they must accept dogs!
sample_reviews_en.author: วรางคณา ประดิษฐพงษ์

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and flavorful, especially the Tom Kloong soup which is incredibly spicy. It's a restaurant near my house that I've passed by many times. It's a great place to chill, with a cool breeze and old songs playing. The atmosphere is lovely, especially while overlooking the lotus pond.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lady Kissmo

sample_reviews_en.text: A bar with a great atmosphere in the Rama 2 area (Wat Kamphaeng Soi). Good people, good atmosphere. Prices are slightly higher than the night market. Mixers are 35 baht per bottle. Large bottles of water, but soda is in small bottles (one-way soda) and the mixers aren't chilled; they're all served warm. The staff are good-looking and provide good service. There are two full-band bands playing each night.
sample_reviews_en.author: PINKUne1

sample_reviews_en.text: The music is great, the atmosphere is good, and the food is delicious, but the wait for food is a bit long. It's recommended to book a table in advance because seating is limited. Go before 10 PM, as tables fill up quickly. Prices are mid-range, but the beer promotions only offer large bottles, suitable for those who want to get drunk. There are no smaller bottle deals available.
sample_reviews_en.author: ท่อมซิ่งลาดพร้าว Organic drinks Ladphrao

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is nice. The music is relaxing; I enjoy listening to international music. It might be a bit chilly when the shop opens because they use both fans and air conditioning. It gets warmer later in the evening when they turn off the fans.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimpann

sample_reviews_en.text: The live music and  bands at the Five Club are top notch.  It's always a great time.  The snack foods are great.  The staff is attentive and friendly.  I definitely recommend if you're in this area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aaron Smith

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a good place I've been going to for 2-3 years, but the band at 11 PM on Saturdays is really no match. Their voices are too high and out of key.
sample_reviews_en.author: LookAtMe

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, it was good, but the singer's songs were all quite uninteresting, or maybe I just happened to go on a day with an unlively band. 😁

sample_reviews_en.text:

sample_reviews_en.text:
Matcha lovers shouldn't miss this! This is the best matcha shop in the area. They offer a wide selection of matcha and various taste notes, and they serve it hot, perfect for enjoying a bowlful of tea. This is a true masterpiece, not just a photo-taking cafe.

The desserts are also excellently made, with high-quality ingredients and a sense of care. The flavors are fragrant and perfectly sweet. This is another matcha shop you can trust.

Most reviews suggest ordering it cold. If you're here, I recommend trying the hot plain tea or the hot latte. They're guaranteed to be amazing. It's served warm, so it won't burn your mouth. You can sip it right away.

For matcha lovers who enjoy their tea hot, I highly recommend this place. You won't be disappointed.

P.S. The atmosphere is great, the service is excellent, and the prices are great too!
sample_reviews_en.author: Edius14

sample_reviews_en.text:
Highly recommended ka❤️🫶🏻
I came here with my family for personal reasons and accidentally discovered this place while trying to escape the hot weather and wait for a while. We ordered three different matchas, and they were really good and reasonably priced. The homemade fresh daifuku was beyond expectations! The staff are friendly and gave good recommendations.

Even though I don’t live around here, I’ll definitely come back and recommend it to my friends for sure👍🏻

Ps. I sat on the second floor to enjoy my drink and daifuku. The first floor sells salads and veggie dishes. I ordered the potato salad, and they kindly brought it up to serve me as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Net Tny

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stumbled upon this place by accident. I was intrigued by a small sign outside and saw they sold daifuku. I was craving some soft, chewy daifuku, so I decided to check it out.

Before going up to the second floor, I passed a salad shop (I ate salad before seeing the sign for this shop – the salad shop was great!).

Once I got to the second floor, I found the atmosphere of the matcha and daifuku shop to be very comfy. I initially planned to order takeout, but decided to dine in instead. I happily read a book, sipped my matcha, and devoured some soft, freshly made daifuku. Haha. Come and try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: pimfun Jierapipatkul

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop is so cute! I noticed they have many different shades of matcha. I've walked past it for months and finally went in to buy daifuku, and I was so surprised! The shop is incredibly cute (with a million 'k's!). It would be perfect for girls who love matcha. I saw they sell food downstairs too. There are tons of photo opportunities. I highly recommend it. I hope this shop becomes more popular; it would liven up the area a lot.
sample_reviews_en.author: S 2662

sample_reviews_en.text: I happened to be passing by and decided to stop in. They have a variety of matcha and desserts to choose from. I ordered the Akira matcha to try. The taste was okay, with a slight bitterness. I only ordered one cup, but they also gave me water and a small cookie. The shop is small but beautifully decorated, with a nice, quiet atmosphere. The staff provided excellent service. If I'm in the area again, I'll definitely stop by again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mint's

sample_reviews_en.text:
@craft_fe @craft_fe.bkk 🍵🍓🍡😋

I've loved this shop since I was in Khon Kaen. Lately, I've been coming to Taksin Hospital frequently. As I was walking to my destination, I turned around and saw the warm light from this shophouse. When I opened the door and tried the tea and dessert, I realized, "Oh my gosh, it's @craft_fe!" I'm so happy! I want to come here every day for dessert and matcha! 😋🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Mink Monthirarak (moongismink)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This cafe have a calming ambient and serve excellent matcha and daifuku. The restroom is clean. This cafe has not been open for long. The owner loves to go to Japan, and in the future, they plan to release more menu items and open the second floor. Stay tuned!

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is average, but the service is terrible. There's no queuing system; orders are left piling up at the counter even though there are 3-4 staff members standing around chatting. sample_reviews_en.text:
"Pork satay, unique in its pork and the aroma of marinated spices."

The pork is incredibly tender. The first bite, the aroma of spices and grilling fills every sense of the mouth, nose, mouth, tongue, and throat, all simultaneously.

The sauce is rich, fragrant with peanuts, perfectly salty and sweet. The freshly stir-fried pickled vegetables are deliciously sour, a perfect contrast. The bread is toasted crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, with a rich charcoal aroma.

I've been eating here since the original restaurant (O-Kee) until it changed its name to Hong Heng. The taste is exactly the same, no drop in price or change at all.

There's no parking at the front of the restaurant. You can ask the guys at the grill to move your motorbike to a parking spot. The owner is very friendly and hospitable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutthapon Pi

sample_reviews_en.text:
This time, I tried the satay stall near Tha Din Daeng market, called "Ngow Heng." The aroma and sauce of their satay are unlike any other; it's heavily spiced. If you like that kind of spice, you'll probably love it. But if you're used to typical satay, you might not like it as much. The peanut dipping sauce is sweet, so you only need a little to get the flavor.

I tried their liver satay for the first time, and it was delicious. The pickled vegetables weren't very sour and lacked flavor, but I think both the satay and the pickled vegetables tasted a bit better after being left overnight.

It wasn't very crowded when I went, around 6 PM. I parked in the Tha Din Daeng market. Satay pork was 9 baht per stick, and liver satay was 10 baht per stick.
sample_reviews_en.author: Usanisa P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pork satay is delicious, but the other day I ate at the Dusit Central Park branch and found some visibly undercooked pork. I informed the staff, but they replied, "It has to be grilled like this to be delicious."

...I was quite shocked by that answer. However, the staff did remake it until it was thoroughly cooked. I hope they improve their approach to answering questions.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ramida Ngameakauksorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pork and liver skewers were very tender, and the coconut milk dipping sauce was wonderfully fragrant before grilling. The dipping sauce was a standout, rich and flavorful with a hint of mild curry paste.

The grilling process is fast, using a long grill and multiple staff members. There are tables available for dine-in, and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kong Jayanama

sample_reviews_en.text: I bought pork satay and bread to take home. I specifically asked for no pickled cucumbers or relish, and requested extra dipping sauce. I was met with an immediate and dismissive refusal, with the staff saying they already gave me plenty and wouldn't add anything more, even though they were saving me money on cucumbers and relish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Somchai W. (Nume)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The skewers are large and worth the price. The pork is naturally tender and marinated very fragrantly. The dipping sauce is good, not too sweet, and pairs well with the pickled vegetables.

This is an old, established shop in Tha Din Daeng.

The shop is located in front of the Oow Kee fish noodle shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ma Tam Nat มา ตาม นัท

sample_reviews_en.text: For pork satay at Tha Din Daeng, there are many shops to choose from. This shop is another one with really tender pork, but the satay sauce is clearly sweet. If you don't like it, you can skip it. Personally, I like the pork that is marinated until tender and has a fragrant aroma of spices.

Tender pork satay. Just 6 bath per stick. Each stick is big . Bigger than any other places that i used to try. Pork is tender, little sweet, the vegetables side dish is crispy sweet and sour taste. Also have fish ball noodle.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every dish was delicious! The fried chicken was amazing. The service was standard, and the atmosphere was comfortable.

Food:
Fried Chicken Wings: This is definitely the Dish of the Match! Crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, with just the right amount of batter – not too thick and messy. The flavor was delicious and well-balanced.

Traditional Glass Noodle Salad: The glass noodles were chewy and soft. The technique of placing the ingredients at the bottom and topping with the noodles prevents them from absorbing the dressing and keeps them chewy.

Seafood and Minced Pork Hot Pot Egg Custard: Served piping hot, with plenty of ingredients and meat. The only minor drawback was that the squid was a bit chewy, likely due to its relatively large size.

Fried Rice: Ordered without vegetables. It might look simple, but the rice was well-cooked and flavorful.

Service and Atmosphere:
Service: The staff provided good, standard service and were attentive in taking orders.

Atmosphere: The restaurant has a typical, friendly, and comfortable style. It's not flashy, focusing instead on delicious food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peeraset Bu

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was okay, the service was good, but the restaurant's policy was terrible. It seemed like they were avoiding the 60:40 payment method, even having a sign hanging outside. When I tried to pay 60:40 after finishing my meal, they said the QR code hadn't been working all day. Seriously? They probably wouldn't have provided the QR code unless I insisted or complained. (If the owner reads this, I hope they improve this aspect of their attitude.) If it didn't work, they should have said so from the start or taken the sign down.

It's a shame I won't go back, even though the food tasted okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: PB Sae

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce, and the thin rice noodle salad, are delicious; the fermented fish sauce is incredibly flavorful.
- The fried chicken is delicious, served hot and fresh, with a thin, crispy batter.
- The grilled chicken is well-marinated and the skin is crispy – very tasty!
- The duck larb has a good flavor.
Everything is delicious, highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tik P. Pat

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a nice somtum (papaya salad) restaurant. The staff are attentive and ask about the menu (since somtum can be adjusted in various ways). The food doesn't take long to arrive, and it's spicy and flavorful. Those who like a rich, savory taste will love it, especially those who can handle fermented fish sauce. The minced beef salad is delicious, as is the coconut milk drink.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pisawat Payakkamas

sample_reviews_en.text: There's seating both indoors (with air conditioning) and outdoors (without air conditioning). Plenty of parking. The fried rice is delicious. It's a somtum (papaya salad) restaurant, but they have a wide variety of other dishes to choose from: fried rice, salads, somtum, tom yum, etc. We ordered 6 dishes and the bill came to 645 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: มัณทยา ยุวนวรรธนะ

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and of good quality. The prices were a bit high, but my staff used the government's co-payment scheme, although they weren't sure how to use multiple devices. I told them it was only one scheme per bill, and that all locations allow scanning on multiple devices if the total amount exceeds a certain limit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ping Uino

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant serves delicious and spicy Thai salads (Yum and Som Tum) at affordable prices.

The grilled chicken, especially with the spicy dipping sauce, is fantastic.
The Tom Yum soup is also flavorful.

The restaurant is air-conditioned, spacious, bright, clean, and comfortable with good service.

Give it a try!

sample_reviews_en.text: Giving 5 stars for everything. The service was superb; they kept changing the chilled glasses even without being asked.
