sample_reviews_en.text:
This famous beef noodle shop originates from Chiang Mai and is known for serving Wagyu beef.

The Wagyu beef is excellent. The thickness is just right – not too thick, not too thin – and it's not overcooked, resulting in a tender yet chewy texture. It doesn't melt in your mouth, and has a lovely Wagyu aroma. High-quality beef is used.

The noodles are just okay; they don't have much egg flavor.

The broth is extremely sweet, perhaps too sweet, but very fragrant. It would be much better if the sweetness were reduced. It's also very oily.

The beef meatballs are not tasty; they lack flavor, firmness, and are too starchy. It's a shame, a shop of this caliber should use better quality meatballs.

The coconut ice cream is okay, and the shredded egg yolk topping is a delicious complement.

The shop is small with only a few tables and no view; it's more of a place to eat and leave.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chess Pisit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Taste: The soup was bland, not flavorful, disappointing.
Quantity: Not much, even though I ordered the special.
Ingredients: The meat was okay, the meatballs were okay.
Overall, it was a bit ordinary, like any other restaurant, but it costs 100 baht a bowl. It doesn't really live up to the promotion or the Michelin star rating.
Atmosphere: Glass windows but no air conditioning. The location is difficult to access, and there's limited parking.

Probably won't come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: cyber game

sample_reviews_en.text: The highlights are its convenient location and ample street parking. However, the portion sizes are a bit small, and the flavors are very strong; personally, I felt they were too intense and lacked balance, with a sharp, sourness. The prices are quite high. I like how the morning glory is cut into short pieces. The restaurant looks clean and is air-conditioned. The atmosphere would be much better with some interior design improvements.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teethat Ongkosit

sample_reviews_en.text: It was okay. The meat was tasty, the meatballs were average, and the soup wasn't bad, but I prefer Ayutthaya boat noodles more (though they're not directly comparable, they're different styles). I'd go back, but probably not often. It's a bit pricey, as expected. The atmosphere is unremarkable and not very appealing. Parking is limited by the number of tables in the restaurant, which doesn't accommodate many people.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornpiput S.

sample_reviews_en.text: Personally, I thought it was delicious. The boat noodle soup broth was very good, and the meat was excellent. I had the 69 baht version. My mother had the Kurobuta pork boat noodles and also praised them. I don't understand why there weren't many people. The tables were very sticky, probably from the greasy coating, which was a bit annoying. Parking is difficult; you have to find a spot on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Linda A

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is located on the main road, with clear glass windows all around, so it can get quite hot. It's a small shop, but it looks a bit messy, I don't know why. The noodle bowl is small, with thinly sliced ​​beef, the soup is spicy, and the tendon meatballs are good, although sometimes you find large bone fragments. There's parking for two cars, but sometimes motorcycles are parked blocking the way.
sample_reviews_en.author: Splendid Palette

sample_reviews_en.text:
This bowl of premium Wagyu beef is 119 baht.
The portion is about the same as a bowl of boat noodles. The meatballs are so-so, starchy, and don't feel like they're high quality.
The beef, which is claimed to be Wagyu, is just average, nothing special at all.
Good quality Thai beef from other restaurants is much better.

The staff taking the order couldn't explain anything at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sompop Ph

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very tasty noodle soup. I forgot to specify how spicy I wanted it, but they hit the mark. If you don't like spicy food, be sure to mention it when you order. But since I love spicy food, I was very pleased.
When we arrived at the cafe, there was no one there, which made us wary, but photos from other customers gave us hope. So, I'll share photos of these wonderful soups.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nokunoshi Yaps

restaurants.name: Mr. Nova Grilled Buffet Soi Bingkot
restaurants.address:

อรุโณทัย Bong Koch 8, หนองปรือ Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the best BBQ restaurant in Pattaya! They sell meat and seafood by weight, including meatballs, shellfish, crab, etc. The pork belly and braised pork are amazing. They have all kinds of vegetables and seafood, including shrimp and shellfish – everything is fresh and clean. It's one of the few BBQ restaurants in Pattaya where you don't get sick the next day or the day after. The vegetables and noodles are free to take, which I love because even though they're free, they're still clean and the noodles are chewy. I've been there many times and it's always worth it. Every time I go with a group of friends, the bill is never more than 200 baht per person – we're always stuffed! The staff are lovely, friendly, and helpful, even bringing extra salt or MSG from the kitchen. The atmosphere is great, with plenty of seating options – floor seating, tables, even hammocks – I love it! Every time I go with friends, we spend at least two hours there; it's fun and it's become one of my favorite BBQ restaurants in Pattaya. Right now, I rate it as the number one BBQ restaurant in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: nichakan. bamr

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate here a few days ago because the reviews were good. Two of us (one woman) went, and since they charge by the kilogram, it is not good value for money. Even if we just took small portions once, it came out to about 500 baht per person (including fire pit and ice). What was really upsetting was that we drank two bottles of Sam Song—a large and a small one—but when I translated the bill, they had written down "Regency" (which is more expensive). They probably thought we were drunk and tried to rip us off. When I asked them to check and change it, they just wrote it down again. I felt once again that Thai people have absolutely no apology. It would probably be better to just eat at a place where prices are clearly displayed.
sample_reviews_en.author: 김관석

sample_reviews_en.text: I went two days ago and was not impressed. The salmon salad was very fishy and not fresh. The papaya salad was not tasty; I left a whole plate uneaten. You can't talk, laugh, or be loud. If you're talking or laughing loudly, don't go there. Even though it wasn't that loud, a security guard came to warn us. Even the table next to us had children playing and making noise, but they didn't warn the parents at that table. I just paid the bill and went home. It's a waste of money. Nearby restaurants are much better and have better service. I really didn't want to give a star rating, but I can't post if I don't want to. ☹️☹️☹️☹️
sample_reviews_en.author: อรัญญา วงษ์สุภากุล

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is irrelevant. I personally know the foreign waiters and the security guard. When ordering drinks, I never sit down to drink or stand and drink for a long time (no more than 5 minutes), not even once. But today, I sat down and the waiter provided normal service. However, while I was sitting there, I heard the person weighing the drinks and checking the bill. What right did they have to yell and threaten to fire the staff? Customers don't have the right to make noise. (Or do they think they can do whatever they want as the owner?)
This incident occurred on Saturday, October 17, 2026, at approximately 9:30 AM.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชลนธี ศรีอนั

sample_reviews_en.text:
A local Pattaya gem. Foreigners are rare here.

The atmosphere is great. It's a place where you can relax while eating.

They calculate the bill by weight.

I ordered 50g of pork belly with Som Tum and paid 300 baht.

The quality of the pork belly meat was excellent. Just look at the photos.

There is plenty of fresh seafood.

Come and try it.

It tastes amazing with the Som Tum instead of the sauce they serve ❤️

I've been here more than 7 times,

and I often come alone to eat here.
sample_reviews_en.author: HYUN PARK

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten there many times, but I was disappointed by the overcharge on the bill. Sometimes it felt too expensive, but I didn't check it myself. This time, however, I checked and realized I was overcharged. When I asked about it, the cashier got annoyed, argued, and tried to win the argument. The woman who handled the bill even acted disrespectfully towards me, a customer. I was very uncomfortable with that, but I didn't want to argue and I don't want to go back there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: ทิวาพร สังข์เพ็ง

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm very disappointed. The food price didn't match the menu. The menu showed 100 baht, but when it came time to pay, it was 180 baht. When I asked the staff, they went to talk to someone else and said the price tag was wrong, without apologizing. I understand that the staff member didn't speak Thai, but the person who came later offered a perfunctory apology. The customer wasn't at fault, but had to pay extra and didn't receive a genuine apology or explanation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirirat Rattanaruk

sample_reviews_en.text: Hello. I'd like to ask the restaurant owner to please advise the skinny female employee with short hair to be more discouraging. She was making a displeased face and slammed things down on the table. Whether she was tired or not, she shouldn't behave like that in front of customers; it makes them uncomfortable. I've been eating at this restaurant for 3-4 years and have always been impressed, but this time was not okay. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: ผกามาศ ประทุม

restaurants.name: 地鶏屋 伊勢 soi47店 ( ISE 47 )
restaurants.address:

9 Sukhumvit 47 Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
There are a lot of things that happen in the future.
What is the meaning of KTC's name? The price is 10% and the price is 10%. It is not possible to change the name of the person.

In the future, the old man will not let you go. The Japanese people are very friendly, and the Japanese people are very friendly. There are many things that will happen in the future.いました。
焼き鳥も食べたかったのですが、お昼のメニューには見当たらず…夜限定なのかも？次回は確認してみたいと思います。

I stopped by for lunch at the branch near Rain Hill after my child finished their tutoring session.
This time, I was very lucky to have a KTC credit card promotion where I could redeem points for a 10% cashback, so I got a great deal and it was easy on my wallet.

The dish I ordered was the chicken and egg rice bowl, which didn't disappoint at all. The broth was flavorful and fragrant with dashi, typical of ISE restaurant. My child especially loved the fluffy steamed egg custard, finishing the whole bowl with great relish.
I initially wanted to try the grilled chicken as well, but it didn't seem to be on the menu we received. It might be a special evening menu item. I'll ask more next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: BuriRoots

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's located about 100 meters down the street from Sukhumvit 47, on the left. A friend had been recommending this restaurant for a long time. They were offering a promotional two-hour all-you-can-eat and all-you-can-drink course for 1,000 baht. The all-you-can-drink menu offers a wide variety of drinks, including beer, highballs, and sake, so even those who love alcohol won't be disappointed.

As you'd expect from a local chicken restaurant, the yakitori and oyakodon are delicious, but all the other dishes are also excellent. The chicken wasabi and raw liver were also incredibly fresh and delicious. The quality of the meat is undoubtedly second to none in Bangkok. They also have a wide selection of pasta, ramen, and other snacks that go perfectly with alcohol.
sample_reviews_en.author: JUN KOBA

sample_reviews_en.text:
After golfing, I went to "Ise." This Japanese restaurant is located on the left hand side about 100 meters after entering Soi 47. It's on the first floor of a condominium.
I went in as soon as it opened, and I'm grateful to the staff who welcomed me.
They have a wide selection of dishes, from ramen to rice bowls, and they have a particularly good selection of chicken dishes.
This time I brought wine and whiskey with me, and started with chicken sashimi. That's the kind of mood I was in today.
sample_reviews_en.author: james won

sample_reviews_en.text:
📌🍽 Buffet with a wide variety of dishes. The restaurant has a simple decor.
🍽 The overall taste of the food is good, and the ingredients are of good quality.
♦️ The service is good, meeting standard expectations. They should hire someone who understands Thai or English better to take orders.
💥 This restaurant is not suitable for large groups. When there are many orders, the food comes out slowly, orders are mixed up and not in order, making it not worth the money. Improvements are needed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lara Linh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything I've eaten here is delicious.
I've visited this restaurant many times since coming to Thailand, and I've been satisfied with the delicious food every time.
Of course, the yakitori (grilled chicken skewers) are delicious since it's a yakitori restaurant, but the fried chicken, hamburgers, spaghetti, and other dishes that kids would love are also very tasty. Even the ramen and mapo tofu rice bowls are surprisingly delicious.
I want to keep coming here as long as I'm in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: ゴージャスおひめさま

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered yakitori twice.
The first time, there were no other customers, so they brought out one freshly grilled skewer at a time, and it was cooked to perfection.
The second time, there were three other tables with customers, so when it arrived it was cold and overcooked. The liver in particular the second time was quite disappointing compared to the first time.
The ingredients are good, so I hope they'll improve.
The chicken sashimi was excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: mitsuyasu matsuo

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited for the first time in several years.
It's still delicious.
The oyakodon (chicken and egg rice bowl) is the best.
The service was unusually slow today, perhaps because there was a birthday party going on.
However, they were polite, so it's not a problem.
I'll never forget how impressed I was the first time I ate there at 39.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paisley

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is absolutely delicious. The roast beef tastes like beef sashimi and is absolutely delicious! The myoga salad, turnip salad, oyster ajillo, smoked daikon radish and cream cheese, and mentaiko pasta were all delicious!

The all-you-can-eat and all-you-can-drink option is also amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dao 1973dao

restaurants.name: เตี๋ยวเสี้ยน
restaurants.address:

16 Charan Sanit Wong Rd, Bang Yi Khan, Bang Phlat, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Walk a short distance into Soi Charansanitwong 44. This is my third time eating here. I love the spiciness of their basil stir-fry. This time I ordered the braised pork ribs with basil. The ribs were incredibly tender. You can customize the basil stir-fry's spiciness to your liking. Their noodles have a unique red broth, a Phetchaburi recipe. They also have many other dishes. The seating is in an air-conditioned room, making it comfortable to eat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aey Aubsara

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is great, very clean, and has air conditioning. The staff are quick, polite, and lovely. The food tastes good, with rich flavors, the meat is tender and doesn't have any unpleasant smell, and it's served quickly. The braised beef with basil is only 70 baht, which is a very good price for this area. I'll definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: MON

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant serves delicious pork noodle soup, dry stir-fried instant noodles with basil, and braised pork noodles with dipping sauce. There are outdoor seating areas and an air-conditioned indoor section. The restaurant is clean and beautifully decorated.
sample_reviews_en.author: Topp Nakarin

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves beef noodle soup with a unique, spicy and well-balanced flavor. They have many other dishes, but the beef noodle soup is outstanding. The beef is of high quality. The restaurant is air-conditioned, making it comfortable to sit.
sample_reviews_en.author: peeraya pupupu

sample_reviews_en.text: This noodle shop in Soi Charansanitwong 44 is about 20 meters into the soi on the right-hand side. Their pork and beef noodles are delicious, and you can choose your spice level – even the less spicy versions aren't too bad. They also have …
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanarat Prechawanich

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! I stopped by for a meal while getting a haircut, but I've become a regular customer and have to eat here every time I come for a haircut. Or, if I don't come, I order via Grab (but it tastes even better at the restaurant).
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanokchan Aun

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant's management system is excellent. Ordering via QR code is convenient, the prices are good, and the taste is absolutely superb! The staff are also friendly and lovely. I will definitely be eating here often.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanyapat Kornthanapong

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious, especially the stir-fried basil instant noodles with braised beef. The longan juice was also good, not too sweet and refreshing. The restaurant was clean. I'll definitely come back often.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanwisa T.

restaurants.name: On The Table @ The Mall Bangkapi
restaurants.address:

3530/1-130 Lat Phrao Rd, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: After The Mall Bangkapi's renovation, the atmosphere is much better than before. This restaurant isn't very big, but it's clean and tidy. They offer both savory and sweet dishes, and also have a tea bar. I can't remember the name of the dish I ordered, but it was something like salmon fried rice. The portion of rice was huge and very filling. The salmon was delicious, perfectly cooked, and the shallots and chili helped cut the richness. The salmon sushi was also very large and tasty. The staff provided good service, and the wait wasn't too long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thaya Aungtananukul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fried rice had a very strong buttery aroma, though personally, I found it a bit too rich. The salmon was fresh and the flesh was soft, not dry or tough. Overall, the price is on the higher side, possibly because VAT is included.
Plus, there's a 10% service charge. The staff were attentive and caring. The atmosphere was noisy due to the open space, which seems to be a drawback of The Mall Bangna. I rarely like this aspect whenever I eat on this floor.
sample_reviews_en.author: เลิฟบู

sample_reviews_en.text: There were too few staff, and the service was very slow. It was especially difficult to get the attention of those sitting at the tables further back; I had to call them 2-3 times. Eventually, I couldn't wait any longer and had to walk to the counter myself with my food to take away. They saw me but didn't seem to care much. I had to call them again and complain. I definitely won't be coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutthaphatt P.

sample_reviews_en.text: Impressive and expensive delicacies with good ambiance. Friendly staff, quick to served and clean. Plus the fact if your a member you gain points to what you ordered the next time you come back you may ask them to deduct to your next bill the amount you accumulated from the last time or you may keep it depends to you. Having 300baht cash back is not bad at all. Highly recommended!! 555
sample_reviews_en.author: julia lokatour

sample_reviews_en.text:
Quite an ambience and conducive restaurant staffs are nice and fast service, menu meals are reasonably expensive,I have ordered a clam cheeze croquette and pork baguette along with pink guava shake taste good but the baguette pork is too salty for me.

Note: card paper and pencil are on every tables for any suggestion or comment.
sample_reviews_en.author: bublegum princess

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant offers a variety of cuisines and diverse menus, with frequent set meal promotions. The prices are relatively high, but considering the quality of the food, it's worth it. Overall, the food tastes good, with many appetizing dishes, although some might not be outstanding. The staff provides attentive service.
sample_reviews_en.author: winwin

sample_reviews_en.text:
During their promotion, they offer 3 dishes for 599 baht.
I've never been disappointed with the taste of this restaurant.
The food tends toward clean food, so the prices are a bit high, but the quality is also good.

My favorite dessert is the soft cookies whenever I come here.
sample_reviews_en.author: nann

sample_reviews_en.text: Eating here was definitely worth it! The food was delicious and suited my taste, especially the chicken breast salad with avocado 💖. We ate with 5 people, the 899 baht set menu was just the right amount and very filling. Great value! …
sample_reviews_en.author: Phonchita Anekponjrean

restaurants.name: BurnBusaba Central World
restaurants.address:

ศูนย์การค้าเซ็นทรัลเวิลด์ ห้องB611 เลขที่ 999/9, Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Our day off!! Since we're in Bangkok, we have to eat something delicious, spicy, and flavorful. Every dish we ordered was intensely spicy – ​​truly amazing taste! Today's menu included papaya salad, various grilled dishes, and grilled river prawns (you can choose what you want). We ordered so much, but I didn't get a chance to post pictures before it was all gone! Haha. The restaurant has a great atmosphere, lots of customers, but they have cute and comfortable seating areas. It's perfect for chilling, chatting, and eating. Every dish we ordered was delicious; we finished everything! "Kudos to the chef and the staff – the service was excellent and very attentive to customers." The food also arrived incredibly quickly – less than three minutes after we sat down, considering how busy it was. Excellent management – ​​ten stars! I highly recommend this restaurant in Central Plaza. Go try it! I'll definitely be back again – I loved it! 👍👍👍😄😁
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimrawee Srirat

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my favorite restaurant in the iBerry chain. Everything about it is the overall experience – the food selection, the decor, and the service.

I can't remember the name of the papaya salad, but it contained shredded papaya, bean sprouts, pork sausage, chicken feet, and acacia leaves. I ordered it with a flavorful fermented fish sauce – it was delicious!

The sticky rice with salted egg and fried pork belly is amazing; I order it almost every time I come.

The side dishes I ordered separately were also excellent. The blanched squid was perfectly cooked and delicious, and the crispy pork rinds were nice and slightly fatty.

The service standards are consistently high, not just at this restaurant but at all the restaurants in the chain.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jose’ J.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Burn Busaba is a really easy place to enjoy from the first bite. It’s Thai/Isan-style food som tam, spicy salads, grilled dishes all done in a way that just works.

The flavors are bold but balanced.
Sour, spicy, a bit of sweetness, everything comes together nicely without being too complicated. The yum (spicy salads) are especially good fresh, punchy, and very satisfying.

Grilled and fried dishes are also solid, so the meal feels complete, not just about salads. Good for sharing with friends, or even just coming for a casual meal when you’re craving something spicy.

Overall, it’s a place I’d recommend.
If you like bold Thai flavors in a more modern, easygoing setting, Burn Busaba is definitely worth a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornpong W.

sample_reviews_en.text:
🥩 Grilled Pork Neck: 10/10 (out of 10, a million!)
🐷 Pork Larb: 100/10 (100/10)
🐔 Grilled Chicken Wings with Fermented Fish Sauce: 9/10 (10/10)
🥗 Luang Prabang Papaya Salad: 9/10 (10/10)
🦀 Crab Papaya Salad: 9/10 (10/10)

The flavors of the food, especially the grilled dishes, are predominantly sweet with a savory, well-balanced spiciness and tender meat (the grilled pork neck is incredibly tender!).

The larb is delicious and very well-made, but it's best eaten with sticky rice or rice noodles.

Overall, I personally felt the fermented fish sauce in the papaya salad wasn't strong enough and lacked richness; it was light and mild, but the spiciness was intense!
sample_reviews_en.author: saturday _1993

sample_reviews_en.text:
BurnBusaba is truly a great restaurant for people looking to taste an original Esan-style Thai food in the heart of Central World. The restaurant uses high quality ingredients, which are elevated through skillful cooking and presentation. The grilled and spicy menus on offer, from the salted egg yolks pork intestines, baby octopus salads, or the mixed grills to the simple spicy yums, everything is well cooked and really creates an enjoyable meal.

I also liked their overall decoration, using a combination of woods and traditional weavings to decorate creates a more authentic dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisana Varanyuwatana

sample_reviews_en.text:
+ Deep-fried pork belly with fish sauce is No. 1. Available in S/M/L sizes. Ask for sweet chili dipping sauce to balance the saltiness better than Jaew dipping sauce.
+ Vietnamese noodle soup doesn't have much broth, so you have to slurp it up quickly or the noodles will swell up.
+ You can choose the spiciness level for the papaya salad. The price is a bit high, but the taste is premium. It doesn't leave your throat as dry as at other restaurants.
- Sweetened liver was a little dry.

Tips: Some credit cards offer cashback. Don't forget to use your benefits!
sample_reviews_en.author: Full time cat mom

sample_reviews_en.text:
Grilled squid is number 1! The dipping sauce is incredibly delicious.

Sour curry: Very delicious, 10/10 ⭐️
Grilled pork neck: Tender, 10/10
Fried chicken wings with fish sauce: Okay, crunchy, 8/10
Tiger's crying beef: Very tough, surprising, 4/10
Isaan sausage: Could be more sour, 8/10
Spicy instant noodle salad: Very good flavor, 9/10
Grilled squid: 100/10 ⭐️⭐️

There was also fried sticky rice but I forgot to take a picture, it was delicious too.
No queue at all, not many people, and the food was served very quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supisa Kisananone

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes good, but for the price, it's definitely not worth it.
For example,
the salted egg yolk was sliced ​​into very thin, small pieces.
The pork sausage slices were also very thin (compared to other restaurants in a similar price range).

The ingredients provided are completely mismatched with the price.

However, the food is tasty enough, not bad. If they improved the ingredients, it would be much better. Even famous Thai salad restaurants at this price point offer much better value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narintorn Toy

restaurants.name: Oba San
restaurants.address:

2 Inthamara 35 Alley, Ratchadaphisek, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I stop by here very often, especially when I'm working near Vibhavadi Road. I buy both the meat and the belly, but this time I bought the diced tail, which is 400 grams in the picture and cost 299 baht. The diced tail from this shop is exceptional; other shops sell this grade at the price of the meat. The dipping sauce is 20 baht per jar, and buying extra is also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: นริสา คงด้วง

sample_reviews_en.text: We met so close by. You might have seen me before, but you definitely saw me. I'd like to get to know you too. Let's have a meal together sometime when we're free. I hope the rating I gave you will be helpful in some way. Judging from the salmon, it looks very fresh, probably single, because of the transparency of the flesh. Transparent salmon indicates freshness.
sample_reviews_en.author: อุดมเดช ตันติเวชธรรม

sample_reviews_en.text:
I placed an order via LINE last night and asked if I needed to pay in advance. The shop said I could pay at the shop. I thought they had the items in stock. But this morning they said they didn't have any and hadn't even prepared the fish.

The admin is acting like a child playing shopkeeper; they're terrible and irresponsible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phongsapak Jitjarunevanich

sample_reviews_en.text: The salmon was incredibly fresh and of excellent quality. Definitely worth the price. The restaurant sliced ​​it into generous, satisfying pieces. The frozen seaweed salad was also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanaporn K.

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been ordering from them since university. I've been eating Obasan for many years; it's always fresh and delicious. Orders are processed and delivered quickly with excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Forjune Fearless

sample_reviews_en.text: The fish was incredibly fresh and the price was the cheapest I've ever seen. The service at the shop was excellent. They even offered a replacement if the fish wasn't fresh. So lovely!
sample_reviews_en.author: Meaw A.

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered 1 kg of salmon sashimi to eat at home. It was very fresh and had a lot of belly meat, the most I've ever received from many vendors. The service was fast and good. 👍👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: PS BT

sample_reviews_en.text: The price is reasonable. The salmon is always fresh and delicious every time I order. It's become my favorite salmon shop! Everyone I've recommended it to loves it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wendy

restaurants.name: Whiskeys Restaurant at Pattaya
restaurants.address:

364 9 Soi Pattayaklang 14, หนองปรือ Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Whiskeys Restaurant is a little hidden gem. I visited several times during my holiday and tried various dishes, all were first class cuisine. Chicken, Steak and Pork dishes were all delicious. I had ice cream for desert, which was likewise lovely.

The staff were all very welcoming and friendly, with that typical Thia hospitality and welcoming smile.

The ambience was just right, a lovely little restaurant, set in a quiet part of the city. I would highly recommend this lovely little hidden gem to anyone.

I am aware there are 2 Whiskeys restaurants (same owner), I was in the smaller of the 2.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gary Morgan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm leaving Thailand tonight, and I was thinking of having one last authentic Thai meal. I checked some reviews on Google and saw this restaurant had high ratings, so I decided to try it. I ordered Tom Yum soup, green curry, water spinach, raw marinated shrimp, and Pad Thai. The Tom Yum soup was incredibly delicious and rich!

^_^ It's my favorite Tom Yum soup in Thailand. I especially want to mention the service; all the staff were incredibly friendly and genuine – you could definitely feel it! Thank you 🙏 for recommending it to everyone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kita Lau

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small and cozy restaurant, the "moms" who run it are very kind, helpful, and polite (lovely). The food is served quickly, hot, and in large quantities. A highly recommended place. There are many European customers.
P.S. The orange juice for breakfast is natural.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fernando Martínez Alfaro

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is such a wonderful find! It’s a cozy, intimate spot that feels incredibly welcoming. The food was absolutely delicious, and I was genuinely surprised by how reasonable the prices are for the quality you get. A perfect little neighborhood treasure!
sample_reviews_en.author: El Chef

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent value for money, superb breakfast, extremely friendly staff, and a lovely atmosphere. They've really thought of everything, even little things like having a small bin at each table or a smartphone holder. Fantastic! I'll probably become a regular.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nejii .Official

sample_reviews_en.text: All the food was delicious and the price was the best. Also, the owner and the staff are very kind. I will visit again when I hear Pattaya again. This morning, this afternoon, and this afternoon, everything was settled here. Best!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: lee dong

sample_reviews_en.text: A typical spot catering to typical pattaya tourists. You can see they’re trying to make the menu interesting, but the food is still average, and bland in taste, some dishes not really well cooked.
sample_reviews_en.author: Everdens

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was very tasty! The chicken was juicy and perfectly cooked. The seafood salad was a real highlight — plenty of seafood, fresh and well balanced in flavor. We really enjoyed the meal 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Maksim Sheka

restaurants.name: Mikura Curry
restaurants.address:

60 อาคาร, Queen Sirikit National Convention Center, Ratchadaphisek Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I came to the Expo and randomly found this restaurant, so I decided to try it. The restaurant is bright, the atmosphere is pleasant, and the taste is quite good. Today I ordered the medium spicy level, which is probably about halfway between level 1 and 2 of some famous restaurants. Rice and soup are refillable, but honestly, the portions are more than enough to fill you up. The curry broth wasn't very hot, but it was still delicious. The gyoza was also delicious (it's crispy fried), served hot, and still juicy inside. The fried items were well-made. The staff were lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fah Tant

sample_reviews_en.text:
The portions are quite large; I almost couldn't finish it alone. Rice and soup are refillable. Pickled vegetables come in jars, and Japanese chili powder in bottles.

You can choose from three spice levels for the curry: mild, medium, and spicy. Those who don't like spicy food at all can opt for the original version.

The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, is clean, and the staff provides attentive service without being intrusive. Overall, I was impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeann N Fross

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork cutlet curry rice with creamy egg was delicious. The pork cutlet was crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, and the curry was rich and just right. The gyoza were also crispy with a generous filling and tasted great with the dipping sauce. The staff provided good service, the food came out quickly, and the restaurant was clean. I was very impressed! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanota Yamashita

sample_reviews_en.text: I've tried this restaurant 2-3 times already, and it's been delicious every time. I've tried the curry and tonkatsu, both were great. This time I tried the tempura shrimp udon, and it was also excellent. The ingredients are high quality, the restaurant is clean, the staff provides good service, and the food doesn't take long to arrive. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalita C.

sample_reviews_en.text: Highly recommended! I had a wonderful dining experience at Mikuna Curry located in QSNCC. The curry was exceptionally flavorful, rich, and perfectly prepared. The staff were professional, polite, and provided excellent service. The restaurant itself was clean and well-maintained.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aumim Shizuka

sample_reviews_en.text: The food came out super fast, even when it was crowded. All the staff were very nice, constantly refilling ice. You can get refills of soup and rice with the curry rice. It was delicious and filling. There's a 10% service charge, but no added VAT. Great!
sample_reviews_en.author: AMPatGie

sample_reviews_en.text: Whenever I come to the Queen Sirikit Convention Center, I often stop by this restaurant because the food is delicious, whether it's the rice or the udon noodles, it's always to my liking. Plus, the atmosphere is nice and the staff provides good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Duanpen J.

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! Rice, soup, and pickles are refillable. The curry portions are generous and the flavor is great, with adjustable spiciness levels. I recommend trying the stir-fried basil curry; it's surprisingly good and goes well with everything.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thunderduck
