restaurants.name: เอมภิรมย์ Aimbhirom
restaurants.address:

315 4 Phatthanakan Rd, Khwaeng Prawet, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Leaving a client's house, looking for something to eat.
Found this restaurant at a PTT gas station.

Go for it! Ordered two bowls of noodles each (2 special, 2 regular).

Free! 4 fried wontons per bowl (16 pieces total).
I'm going crazy! 555 My gums are aching from chewing! 😆😆😆

Personally, I think it's delicious. I really like it.
But I can't really tell the difference between the special and regular portions!!!

Overall, it's good. Parking is convenient. After eating, I had coffee, took care of personal matters, and continued my journey. 😄

*But after leaving, I smelled of gasoline! Ugh!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr. Chokchai Metapipattanakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Tom Yum noodle soup was delicious, the only minor issue was the thin noodles were a bit hard. Personally, I prefer them chewier and softer, but that's just my personal taste, of course.

The service was excellent; the staff were polite and spoke well.

Overall, the taste was good. It's great to have another good restaurant in the Phatthanakan area.

P.S. The crispy pork rind was a bit too hard; I was worried about breaking my teeth while eating it! I'm getting old. The bones were also a bit brittle. I wish the pork skin was fluffier so it wouldn't be so hard.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pailin Taechaaukarakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The flat noodles are excellent, the tom yum soup is delicious and well-balanced, and the minced pork patties are tasty. The overall atmosphere of the restaurant is warm and inviting, and there's also an air-conditioned room available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vipaporn Prompruk

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the price was reasonable. The seasoning wasn't too strong, it was clean, and the soup was tasty. I didn't get a chance to take pictures; we finished four bowls between two people! 😅 It cost 240 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dack Design

sample_reviews_en.text: The flat noodles with toppings are incredibly delicious! The sauce is flavorful and fragrant with garlic oil. Adding crispy pork cracklings makes it even better! The owner provides great service and the staff are lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: prayfah suksawang

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles are delicious! The Tom Yum noodle soup has a rich flavor; the broth doesn't need any extra seasoning. I highly recommend this restaurant. It's located on Phatthanakan Road, inside the PTT gas station.
sample_reviews_en.author: น้องเล็ก คนดี

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles are delicious, with a clean, refined flavor. Personally, I didn't need to add any seasoning; it was perfect as is. The portion size is just right for a woman, but might be a little small for a man.
sample_reviews_en.author: baleine gato

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum pork noodles were delicious! Adding crispy pork cracklings to the bowl made them perfectly crunchy. They paired wonderfully with the noodles. The fried meatballs were also very tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: gearjuice

restaurants.name: บนบานบาร์ - Bonbanbar
restaurants.address:

110 Phadung Dao Rd, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Oh my God what a fantastic bar!
We sat outside on these red tables and the lady came out and she was such a bubbly personality very very fun !
🤩
We were already a few cocktails in when we arrived here and we decided to try the mango beer 🍻 and the guava beer 🍺 it was the most amazing beer 🍺 I think I’ve ever tasted !! I’m definitely going back to try the other flavors!!

Definitely go here and go and see this lady that’s in the photos !

Highly recommend if you’re here and you want a nice casual evening out definitely definitely stop by here and have a beer the beers are different not your local boring ass beers even the regular beers are different and they’re so good !! 😊

Follow Fauzia for more amazing little finds in Chinatown Bangkok you will love this place in every which way you can it’s got the most cutest little pop-up places unexpectedly !!

You can watch the full videos on our TikTok channel and of course our YouTube channel and you can find our reels and stories on Facebook and Instagram  🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Follow Fauzia

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is great, but the food and service are below average.

The two of us ordered two dishes. The pad thai arrived after 15 minutes, while the fried rice wasn't served until 45 minutes later. Besides us, there were only two other guests who didn't order anything. Despite this, the kitchen and service staff seemed overwhelmed. The portions were very small, the food lacked flavor, and the prices were relatively high.

Because of the nice atmosphere, it's suitable for a few drinks if price isn't a concern.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mat No

sample_reviews_en.text: I loved it! The staff were friendly, fun to talk to, and lovely. The atmosphere was amazing, I really like this kind of place. 😍😍 The prices weren't too high, and the drinks were super creative and delicious. They even have craft beer, but it's in cans. It's a great place to chill with friends. However, there aren't many tables inside, so it might be full on busy days like Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. The outside seating is also nice, but a bit hot. The restrooms were clean, but a little small.
sample_reviews_en.author: KAN WA

sample_reviews_en.text: This place was AMAZING! They were able to accommodate by making vegan pad Thai and it was the best pad Thai I’ve had in Thailand - and I literally order a dish at every restaurant I’ve ever been to in Thailand (multiple trips) the staff is very nice, and the establishment is very clean and everything is cooked fresh! And the prices are very affordable! 11/10 !!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mitchel Armstrong

sample_reviews_en.text: The bar is decorated in a temple fair theme, which is quite unique. They have a wide variety of beers to try, the staff are helpful and entertaining, and they offer homemade infused liquors to sample. They also have food and snacks, and the music is good, with some tracks that occasionally match the bar's theme.😆
sample_reviews_en.author: Padkaprao

sample_reviews_en.text:
Small, expensive, small portions, not as impressive as expected.
Doesn't look as luxurious as in the pictures; looks cheap.
There are similar shops with similar prices.
The pictures and reviews look better than reality; service mind isn't good.
They don't care about customers. Warning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mochiko Aringato

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great little hole in the wall cocktail bar. Also had an excellent selection of interesting Thai craft beers.
They had Halloween themed cocktails when we were there, and the presentation was amazing. Tasty too!
Great place to sit and people watch, or wait out a rain storm.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tash Geelen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Its like back in 90’s i actually love all the drink here , its unique here have a look in my photo
All names of drink s are creative and DAMM dark
Its not easy to find but not too difficult, find them and u will love it
If u like cocktail, u myst b here at least once.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emily insawang

restaurants.name: Sakae
restaurants.address:

ชั้น 3 เดอะ สตอรี่ส์) วัน แบงค็อก เลขที่ 1875 Rama IV Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This shabu-shabu restaurant inside ONE BANGKOK

Beef is the main focus. They also have a selection of Omi beef and other famous Wagyu beef.

There are three courses to choose from, including the Premium Plan.

Some courses include sashimi.

I chose the Superior Course, which includes sashimi.

You can also choose tofu, which was incredibly delicious.

You can also choose the main meat, such as beef or black pork.

I haven't been to many shabu-shabu restaurants in Bangkok, but I guess beef is popular?

A customer kindly offered me 150 grams of beef, so I went.

I looked at the soup options and saw that they had sukiyaki, so I tried it for the first time in Bangkok.

Also, there was all-you-can-eat vegetables.
They even had matsutake mushrooms.

To be honest, this isn't a place I'd normally be able to afford, but the quality of the meat and everything else was top-notch.

I learned a lot.

Also, although it may not be a good thing for the restaurant, the One Bangkok restaurant was very empty, so it seemed pretty good.
sample_reviews_en.author: KAZUYA WAKASUGI

sample_reviews_en.text:
This shabu-shabu restaurant impressed me from the start! My chosen appetizer was the tomato with sesame sauce, which exceeded expectations. It was refreshing and opened up the flavors so well that I wanted to order it every meal! 🍅🥜

Today, I chose Spanish pork. The meat was tender with a good amount of marbling, giving it a fragrant and juicy texture. It was incredibly filling! The vegetables were refillable, perfect for vegetable lovers.

I finished with melon for dessert – sweet, juicy, and refreshing. Unfortunately, I was so engrossed in the meal that I forgot to take a picture! 😆

Equally impressive was the service. The staff were very attentive, constantly refilling food and checking on us. This made the meal enjoyable and relaxing from beginning to end. I'll definitely be back! 🥢✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Supaporn Nokuam

sample_reviews_en.text:
Premium shabu-shabu, served as a set menu, not buffet.

Excellent quality beef with various grades/prices to choose from, ranging from A5 to more affordable options. Pork is also available, from premium cuts to Kurobuta. We ordered a beef set (beautiful marbling!) and added extra pork.

While the sets include unlimited vegetables, rice, and udon noodles, we kept asking for refills of spinach, mizuna, and lotus root, even though we were a little embarrassed to ask the staff.

The sashimi in the set was fresh, the melon was incredibly sweet, and the beef fried rice was amazing! We even bought some to take home. :)

This was our second visit, and we were very impressed with the service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanok C

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an authentic Japanese Shabu Shabu and Sukiyaki restaurant, part of the Oishi Group. It emphasizes premium quality and serves only the highest-grade ingredients. The restaurant offers a course menu with three options:
1. Premium course
2. Superior course
3. Prime course. Courses 2 and 3 include a choice of sashimi, dessert, or cantaloupe. The portions of meat are generous, satisfying, and reasonably priced. The restaurant's ambiance is beautiful, the shabu shabu meat is of high quality, and there are private rooms available. The staff provides excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: wera

sample_reviews_en.text:
Love the vibe at this shabu-shabu place. The space inside is nice and roomy, which makes it super comfortable.

They have quality shabu courses you can choose from, whether you’re into Wagyu beef or pork, and it all comes with tofu appetizers, a fresh veggie set, and ice cream for dessert. I’m obsessed with both the yuzu and matcha flavors.

If you go for the beef course, you also get sashimi, and the fish is so fresh and perfectly sliced. The staff are really attentive too.

Honestly, this is such a premium shabu spot and I would totally recommend it to anyone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sariya SS

sample_reviews_en.text: Shabu & Suki Sakae Premium focuses on quality ingredients rather than oversized portions, making it a good fit for diners who appreciate curated sets instead of all‑you‑can‑eat volume. The assorted beef and pork are fresh, nicely sliced, and pair well with their clean, flavorful broth. Portions aren’t huge, so buffet lovers might feel it’s on the lighter side, but the overall experience leans toward a more premium, relaxed style of shabu rather than a “pile-your-plate” meal. If you prefer quality cuts and a calmer dining pace, this spot delivers exactly that.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumol

sample_reviews_en.text:
This meal was all about the shabu shabu at SAKAE!

The ingredients were premium. The sliced ​​pork had beautiful marbling and was incredibly tender. Dipping it in the fragrant black broth and then in the raw egg yolk was amazing. The vegetables were fresh and clean, and the chilled tofu side dish was delicious. The restaurant's atmosphere was luxurious.

I finished with ice cream topped with honey jelly (or something like that, haha). It was perfect. A truly memorable meal. Anyone who loves shabu shabu needs to try this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Peryp. Jindawattanachok

sample_reviews_en.text: We sat and ate for almost half an hour, and the meat in the set we ordered still hadn't been served. We asked for it nearly ten times, even though there weren't many people, and even if there were, the meat in the set should have arrived at the same time. We waited until the soup had completely evaporated, and the meat still hadn't arrived. The price is very expensive compared to the quality; the meat is rough on the tongue. For this price, you could get much better value at other restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chali N.

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเนื้อคงเส้นคงวา ราชพฤกษ์
restaurants.address:

อาคาร The Circle Ratchapruk 39 Ratchaphruek Rd, Bang Ramat, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went in without any expectations, and it was much, much better than I expected! The noodle soup wasn't sweet, the beef was very fresh and had a delicious, chewy texture. The meatballs were okay, nothing special.
The beef basil stir-fry was spicy as it should be, but slightly sweet. I looked for chili fish sauce but there wasn't any, so I just ate it as is.
My partner ordered the dry rice porridge, and he said it was just okay.
Personally, I give the noodles a perfect score. The other dishes were just alright.
The restaurant doesn't accept credit cards; only cash and QR codes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yappa Yapha

sample_reviews_en.text:
🐮 A small beef noodle shop in The Circle. There are about 4-5 tables inside. The broth is rich and flavorful. Today I ordered the thin rice noodles with mixed beef. The noodles were soft, and the amount of beef and offal was decent – ​​not too little. It cost 125 baht per bowl, which was just the right amount to fill me up. However, this shop also charges a 10% service charge.🥹😅

For those who don't eat beef, they also sell pork noodles and various beef rice dishes.🐷
sample_reviews_en.author: kkkami

sample_reviews_en.text: The beef hot pot soup was delicious, not too salty, and the ingredients were good. I liked the fresh beef, meatballs, and tendons, so I ordered more. I added more broth and the soup, and it tasted great. The restaurant wasn't crowded because it only has a few tables. It was before noon when I arrived. The staff were friendly and the parking was plentiful, which was convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: 9Kasem

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located in The Circle Ratchaphruek. It's spacious and offers a menu of beef, pork, and appetizers. The noodles are delicious; the broth is flavorful, the braised beef is tender, the shank is good, the tendons are soft, and the beef flavor isn't overpowering. The staff are friendly, polite, and provide excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jariya Pinchanchaiyut

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is good, it's clean, and the price is higher than average, which is normal.
The pork is tender and the soup is delicious and well-balanced.
Pork noodle soup is 115 baht per bowl.
This restaurant has a 10% service charge.
No VAT.
The restaurant is air-conditioned and not crowded.
sample_reviews_en.author: tanyalak kritrueangchok

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you are looking for restaurant in The circle that allow your kids 🐕to get into the restaurant  not wait hot outside alone, I would recommend this restaurant!!!
Good taste with reasonable price.
Staff provided a good service.
One of the underrated restaurant here.
sample_reviews_en.author: KP_PK

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is good. The broth is fragrant and delicious. There aren't many offal parts, but the fresh meat is tender and the stewed meat is soft. 😊 Sometimes I like to order the noodles to eat with rice too. 😁👌 P.S. The grilled meatballs are also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Moku Everywhere

sample_reviews_en.text:
When I went, the restaurant wasn't very crowded, so I decided to try it.

The meat wasn't tough, and the tendons were excellent! Delicious!

If you don't know what to eat in this area, I recommend giving it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Minniez Japan

restaurants.name: Biscuit Bar & Restaurant
restaurants.address:

110 Pantachit Alley, Khwaeng Pom Prap, Khet Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice bar with a cool atmosphere. Music amateur will appreciate the vide.
This bar is a bit hidden in the old town and the inside is not big. It is great to come and listen to good music with friends.
The staff is nice and welcoming.
The menu is nice too with a great choice of drink. I removed one star because the cocktail didn’t taste good for that range of price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Youman

sample_reviews_en.text: If this bar were right downstairs from me, I'd practically live there. It has everything I love: the music is great, the staff is trendy without being pretentious. The menu and decor aren't extravagant, but that fosters a relaxed, quality atmosphere—nothing flashy, just the way we like it!
sample_reviews_en.author: marion raveau

sample_reviews_en.text:
The music is beautiful, with a disco feel, not too loud, and it's easy to move around.

The cocktails are quite unique. One tastes like ginger ale, which is a surprise to those who don't like it.

One is sweet and sour, and the jelly aroma is amazing. I really like it.
sample_reviews_en.author: minoru dokidoki

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cozy bar, good place to hangout with friends or couple.
Variety house and chill music from former BED supperclub BKK dj.
Super nice and friendly owner Ronny!
Drink? too sweet for me but can tell bartender to make a drink can match with your drinking style.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sorry It's Accident !!!

sample_reviews_en.text: This is such a gem place we found randomly. Food  taste great. We order the seafood rice, merguez and fig salad. Price is super reasonable. The place is so cozy and the owner is so friendly. Perfect for a diner date. I really recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Janjira

sample_reviews_en.text: Enjoy a drink in a quieter spot than the surrounding streets. The owner is French and friendly. Great background music and excellent cocktails. A good place just steps from Chinatown.
sample_reviews_en.author: J “PJA45” Pascal

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice little place for nice cocktails where you don’t have to remember the names. Tell the bartender how would you like it and it will be served as is
sample_reviews_en.author: Prompiriya Darote (Prime)

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is epic! Food is great, staff are awesome & the music is class. Don’t tell the Australians about this place 😉 couldn’t recommend enough! …
sample_reviews_en.author: Aidan Baker

restaurants.name: Kam-Moon Japaneses Restaurant
restaurants.address:

483 ซอย ประชาอุทิศ Samsen Nok, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything is great. Salmon sashimi is fresh and delicious. Especially mango and avocado sushi rolls are tasty. Ramen is filling.

Chef Kam Moon is a very kind and talented person. We will definitely visit his restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emre Senbabaoglu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Love the foods and the service here. Food is fresh and reasonable price.

Green tea is also high-quality
sample_reviews_en.author: Mickey Chinabunchorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm happy to discover the best Japanese restaurant in the area.
highly recommended.
The price is very low for this level of Japanese cuisine
sample_reviews_en.author: Stepan HK

restaurants.name: Bricks and Barrels Pattaya
restaurants.address:

183 1 Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is terrible for the price. I had the steak, but the meat was too tough, and the pasta was tasteless, so I left it all uneaten.

The service was also very poor. Even though there were no other customers, they didn't give me a bottle opener. The servers left the beer out and went somewhere else, so I couldn't drink for a long time and just had to watch.
sample_reviews_en.author: 하얀풍경

sample_reviews_en.text: Had an amazing time at the restaurant bar today the service was absolutely outstanding. We were looked after by a Vinny look‑a‑like who made the whole experience even better with his energy, attention, and friendly vibe. Drinks were spot on, atmosphere was great, and the staff made us feel genuinely welcome. Will definitely be coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cairo Sembhy

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went here last night, what an awesome atmosphere, I had so much fun! 🤩

Great live band, there is a wide variety of drinks & food. All so delicious!

I highly recommend this place, all of the staff are very friendly & the Manager Mr Don was wonderful & couldn’t be more welcoming!
sample_reviews_en.author: Emily Ashman

sample_reviews_en.text: These were by far the worst chicken wings I have ever encountered. Of the 15 we only managed to eat 8 and that was a struggle. Extremely salty, very diy and no sauce. On top of it they cost 428 baht, the price of a very good pizza or premium burger. Avoid at all costs
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Dunn

sample_reviews_en.text: The mango sticky rice was delicious! However, I found the glass noodle salad a little bland. It would have been much better if it were saltier. Overall, the food was good, the drinks were tasty, and the restaurant has a great view and is close to the beach. 🤗❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponfun Kumpup

sample_reviews_en.text: It was a bit of an experience the person taking our order spoke almost no English at all and it was amazing that when the food arrived they actually got it right the food is okay as a steak lover I was expecting something a little bit better
sample_reviews_en.author: Kurt Penb

sample_reviews_en.text: Freaking awesome atmosphere! Live music band was amazing Friday 04 September! Food variety is great, be careful most these items pack a kick of heat might have to ask for mild. Perfect place to be with friends and family:) would recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adrian Gonzalez

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great food, great atmosphere, and the perfect place to spend a relaxing evening by the beach in Pattaya.

A special thanks to Wai for the excellent service, warm smile, and friendly attitude.

Highly recommended. We’ll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: יאיר בלמס

restaurants.name: 372 Ramen And Sake
restaurants.address:

372 Banphanthom Alley, Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
🍜 The tsukemen was delicious, very similar to the one in Japan. The broth was rich and fragrant with fish flavor, the noodles were perfectly chewy, and the ingredients were of high quality. It was worth the price. If you like Japanese-style tsukemen, I recommend trying it.
🌧️ The overall atmosphere was good. It was raining when we arrived, but that didn't hinder our meal.
💰 The price was reasonable considering the taste and quality of the food.
🧑‍🍳 The service was excellent, friendly, and helpful.
🚗 Parking is available at Chillax Resort (30฿/hour). It's a short walk to the restaurant.
sample_reviews_th.author: Nannapat Sasoda

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here because the supposed best ramen spot in was a 40 minute drive. I walked in and was greeted with a wonderful service from the front.

When you walk in, the atmosphere is wonderful. Smooth jazz, a faint smell of the kitchen, a retro style design for the whole place, with old tvs, vinyls, and wooden furniture. The design of even the menus feels cozy and warm, with every part of this place feeling inviting.

The most important part, being the food is not hindered by any of this. The service is quick, the food is fresh, and it made me come back the day after to try more. The small plates are perfect to pick at and the mains are filling. It’s best to get a main with 2ish sides, as this place has such a broad selection of food. Notably, the Takoyaki was phenomenal, crunchy outside and soft inside. The hot / spicy ramen with chasu pork is incredible, with the meat literally falling apart in your chopsticks. Then the pork gyozas, I don’t even really like gyozas too much, but this place made them perfect and I loved them.

I rarely leave reviews, but this quiet shop is worth it. I will be coming back to Bangkok, partially because of this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manic

sample_reviews_en.text:
This cozy, homey restaurant is great. We went on a Sunday evening and waited for about 15 minutes in a group of 4. You can leave your number and go for a walk while you wait.
🍜White tonkotsu chashu: The flavor was amazing. The sauce was thick, similar to a gravy, but with a tonkatsu taste. The bamboo shoots were very tender. The chashu was neither too thin nor too thick; even someone like me who doesn't like tough pork could eat it comfortably. The small egg noodles were fun to eat.

🍱Tonkatsu rice: Crispy, but the broth was clear and bland, with only bonito flakes and green onions. It seems to be authentic Japanese style; usually in Thailand it's miso soup.

🍆Eggplant ponzu: Delicious! Soft and delicate, the seasoning permeated every bite because it was finely sliced. I loved it!

P.S. I'll come back to try all the menu items! 😍🤤📌
sample_reviews_en.author: Piraorn Bosakoranut

sample_reviews_en.text:
Consider this feedback as a suggestion for customers planning to visit. If you're planning to eat at this restaurant, I recommend not arriving before opening time. The restaurant won't consider you a customer yet, they'll be irritated and rudely refuse you if you ask to wait inside. They'll even honk at you if you stand in the way of their delivery truck, simply because you're confused about what to do next.

To the owner: Just one chair for a customer to sit on shouldn't be a big deal for someone who's been planning to eat at your restaurant, but their arrival time was 20 minutes before opening time. If you're worried about blocking the setup, they can wait outside in the heat. That's better than them standing confused and hindering your business.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chotika P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a small ramen shop that doesn't look like a ramen shop at first glance. The decor is more like a local Thai restaurant, but it's still pretty.

I ordered the tsukemen (rice skewers) and it tasted great. The noodles were chewy and the broth was rich. The first few bites were a little salty, but after that, I found it well-balanced. The braised beef was tender and not too salty. For drinks, I had a craft cola. It wasn't too sweet, just right, but the floral flavor was too strong.

Overall, I really liked it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nawat Ngerncham (Nawat)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the kind of place that truly knows its strengths and stays focused on what it does best. That dedication and consistency are genuinely admirable.

A true hidden gem for delicious ramen. We can’t wait to come back and will definitely recommend it to our family and friends. Wishing the team all the very best ka! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Kae C

sample_reviews_en.text: Tonkotsu Ramen is not too salty. Love all side dishes I ordered, especially the eggplant 😍 Tsukemen was really great, too, with thick style ramen noodle that can nicely covered/absorbed with the thicker broth. Staff were kind and helpful tho. Going to recommend this shop to my moots for sure. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Salita Suh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ramen itself is one of my favorite dishes, I have tasted it a lot in different places around the world and I have to say that here... they really know how to make ramen! The pleasant service and the great, calm atmosphere of the whole place add to it 👑
I really recommend trying the ramen here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Matěj Vrba

restaurants.name: จ้อยหมูกระทะ
restaurants.address:

77 Hua Mak Road, Khwaeng Hua Mak, Khet Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I've never actually eaten at the restaurant; I ordered it through a delivery app. The boiled vegetables were nice and soft, but there was only a small portion of glass noodles. I ordered the M size, and the dipping sauce wasn't enough. If you like a lot of dipping sauce, I recommend ordering extra. The dipping sauce is delicious, but it's spicy, so be aware if you don't like spicy food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Moo Na

sample_reviews_en.text: When I arrived at the restaurant, everyone was in the back. There was no one to call to order drinks. I had to walk into the kitchen to find out there was no grill; they said they didn't have anyone to light it. So I didn't get to eat. It …
sample_reviews_en.author: Lily lilac white

sample_reviews_en.text: The dipping sauce was delicious! The owner and the male staff member provided excellent service. It felt just like eating BBQ at home, and the price was very cheap. The medium set was so filling we had leftovers! 🫶🏼 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Pmffe

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner is incredibly lovely and has a wonderful personality. The food is delicious, perfectly grilled, and the dipping sauce is just right.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐฐิตินาถ ภูมี

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork was delicious and the dipping sauce was good. Overall, the portions were generous and the taste was great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Me'Inontana

sample_reviews_en.text: The portions are very generous. The dipping sauce is delicious and well-balanced. Overall, it's a very tasty meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phoutthavong PHETPHOUTHONE

sample_reviews_en.text: The soup and dipping sauces were delicious, the pork was tender, and the restaurant had a friendly atmosphere 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: วาสนา ทุรัมย์

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, generous portions, flavorful marinated pork, great dipping sauce, and super friendly staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: blanketize

restaurants.name: Pineapple Sport Restaurant
restaurants.address:

172, 3 Soi Buakhao, ตำบล หนองปรือ, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pineapple Sport Restaurant in Soi Buakhao, Pattaya City, is a hidden gem for sports enthusiasts and food lovers alike. The vibrant atmosphere, adorned with sports memorabilia, creates an engaging ambiance. The extensive menu boasts a variety of delectable dishes, catering to diverse tastes.

The culinary experience is exceptional; the chefs at Pineapple Sport Restaurant masterfully prepare dishes that tantalize the taste buds. From hearty burgers to flavorful Thai specialties, the menu offers a delightful fusion of international and local flavors. The portion sizes are generous, ensuring satisfaction for even the heartiest appetites.

What truly sets this establishment apart is its dedication to sports. With numerous large screens, it's the perfect spot to catch live games while enjoying a meal. The attentive staff adds to the overall positive experience, providing prompt and friendly service.

Whether you're a sports fanatic or simply seeking a memorable dining experience in Pattaya, Pineapple Sport Restaurant is a must-visit. The combination of great food, a lively atmosphere, and top-notch service makes it a standout choice in the vibrant culinary scene of Soi Buakhao.
sample_reviews_en.author: Girish Solanki

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is located in a central area so it’s easy to reach. Very local but nice and clean. Here I got one of the best chicken fried rice I’ve ever eaten: it was very delicious and cheap! I highly recommend it. The other plate was minced pork with mashed potatoes with cheese which has some vibes of a Italian lasagna let’s say, not bad! Also, the lady that served us was so nice and kind. The only bad thing is that the temperature is high so it’s hot, but in this place l there is no AC, only fans but not very helpful with 40 degrees outside. But quality of food was really great so I can’t not give less than 5 stars. Very good. We payed around 300/400 baht, which is around 4/5 euros each (we were in 2) including beverages.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ilaria Najim

sample_reviews_en.text: The first time we went there, we were apparently lucky; our food was okay. I wondered why the people at the next table were complaining and sending almost all their food back. On our second visit, it was clear why: the schnitzel was completely tough and stale, like it had been reheated multiple times. The fries were just hard and greasy. Absolutely disgusting, inedible. The service was also very slow and reluctant to come to our table. Maybe they were expecting complaints. Folks, all I can say is: avoid this restaurant! There are so many others around here, and they were all better!
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrea Holland

sample_reviews_en.text: Well, this was not as expected. Menu is great the service is not. When you order - you get the bill at the same time, so I noticed one of the more expensive dishes was billed 20% more than on the menu - no problem it was fixed. After that I noticed they charged me for an egg on a dish that comes with an egg (according to the menu) - they didn't take that charge off... Food is mediocre, soup came with a small stale and hard piece of bread. Disappointing. Not because of the money but because I hate being tricked. The only good thing is the portions are big
sample_reviews_en.author: Mantas Mankevicius

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice selection of some Finnish and local Thai foods, reasonably priced. I tried the fried rice a couple of times before, as takeout which was very delicious. This time I tried eating in. I got a bottle of cold soda water, and a glass filled with ice cubes and a thin slice of lime when ordering lemon soda drink.
The Lemon Chicken was nicely served, tasty and perfectly cooked. All in all it was very nice
sample_reviews_en.author: Husain AlHusaini (Husain_Tula)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very nice restaurant with good food! Love the  atmosphere in there and the parrot in the restaurant is fun extra.
Perfect location, in the heart of soi buakhao, near big markets and have also possibilities to rent room upstairs.
They offer group activities called Siam Great Adventures. It's for people who loves to go fishing. Highly recommend! 5/5
sample_reviews_en.author: Christina

sample_reviews_en.text:
Loved it in here. Had a very busy day of work and still had to get some documents sorted around the corner. We were hungry and the partner fancied steak.

Very affordable and massive portion for the price.

We ordered the beef and pork steak, it came with a huge salad and a choice of potato.

Very nice and the Leo was 70 baht too so it was good
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Redmond

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great restaurant to have good late night dinner or just sipping delicious coffee.
Mashed potatoes with meatballs and cranberry jam was awesome.
Western and Thai food, many Finnish traditional foods.

You can also get daytime or nighttime fishing trips from this restaurant.
Or if you're golf enthusiastic they have it.
Service was top notch 👍🏽
sample_reviews_en.author: Marko Räty

restaurants.name: MK Restaurant Century
restaurants.address:

31ศูนย์การค้าเซ็นจูรี่ Phaya Thai Rd, Thung Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located on the 1st floor of Century Mall. It wasn't very crowded on a weekday when I visited; there were plenty of tables, about 20.

Getting there by BTS Skytrain: Get off at Victory Monument station, use exit 2. There's a connecting walkway to the mall on the 2nd floor. Once inside, take the escalator down one more floor; the restaurant will be on your left.
If driving, you can use the mall's parking lot.

The food is up to MK's standard; the ingredients are good and look fresh, and the taste is good.

The staff provides good service. They helped take photos, refilled water, soup, and dipping sauces promptly. However, they might be a little hard to find at times during busy periods.

The robot waiter here is quite fast, but the staff always assists with serving.

Overall, it's a good, standard MK experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattarapon Erbim

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here many times because of their buffet promotions. The atmosphere and food quality are up to MK's general standard. However, at this branch, the staff can sometimes be slow, requiring repeated follow-ups on orders. Even then, orders aren't always fulfilled on the first try; sometimes they don't respond when called, or they turn but don't come to you. There are also many trainee or student staff members. Overall, the atmosphere is okay, though. Some older staff members are helpful in recommending tables that aren't directly under the air conditioning.
sample_reviews_en.author: S.K. Seataphong

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a la carte, not the buffet, but my order was incomplete. I had to keep asking for things, and even after asking repeatedly, they still didn't arrive. I was so annoyed and lost my appetite. The restaurant wasn't even full, but I don't understand why they managed the orders like that. The manager was informed and came to apologize. I hope they manage things better, because if the service is like this, customers won't want to eat at MK again, especially since there are other sukiyaki brands to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirinun Lueprakorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just one scoop of ice cream.

Waited over 10 minutes, couldn't take it anymore.
Even after following up, it was still slow.
Asked why it was slow, got no answer.
Not a single apology.

And the food came out so slowly, like they were afraid there would be a lot of orders.

I ordered 40 items, and they all arrived in less than 5 minutes. Terrible experience, one time only at this branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: พิเชฐพงษ์ นิมารมย์

sample_reviews_en.text: Every time I order delivery, I never get everything I ordered. Sometimes they forget the noodles when I order a DIY set, sometimes they forget the dipping sauce for kids, and sometimes they forget the soup base. Overall, the food is delicious, and it's great when I eat at the restaurant, but delivery is always lacking something. I really hope they improve this.
sample_reviews_en.author: MooBin

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time trying MK Buffet. The price and quality were definitely worth it, especially the meats, which were great – no need to worry about getting low-quality cuts. The food came out quickly, the staff were attentive, and the music was pleasant and relaxing.
sample_reviews_en.author: เด็กแว่น

sample_reviews_en.text: I love Duck this place does it best. You get half a duck for about $12 USD the special drinks here are really good as well I would suggest trying one of their for frappes. My wife likes the hot pot and loves it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steven J

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good food with fresh products. I would recommend the duck and green spaghetti. We took also noodles, beef, shrimp,rice and of course all the great meals have to end with ice cream.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stathis Kontos

restaurants.name: Sweet Restaurant
restaurants.address:

103 ถนน ตรีเพชร แขวง Khwaeng Wang Burapha Phirom, Khet Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Food was well priced and great for quick mid day meal for a budget."

sample_reviews_en.text:
A colleague recommended this place, saying he once drove all the way to eat here for three consecutive days – it was his favorite restaurant back when he was a student at a vocational school.

There are two restaurants owned by the same person, both selling at the same prices and participating in the government's co-payment scheme (Kon La Khrueng Plus).

The map shows the newer, air-conditioned restaurant; the other is the original one, located a short distance away.

Today, I tried both restaurants to compare. I ordered my colleague's favorite, minced beef basil stir-fry with a fried egg (not even on the menu!), for 60 baht.

The new restaurant's version is more saucy, while the old one is less so. Both were delicious; the old one was slightly saltier, but the flavors were similar enough to be used interchangeably. The rice was also tasty and soft.

Their chili fish sauce was delicious, with a slight sourness, and paired perfectly with the minced beef basil stir-fry.

Then I tried the beef burger for 30 baht – a great deal considering the portion size. It was the same type of beef, but the burger bun looked a little unusual.
sample_reviews_en.author: Waris O

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sweet Restaurant is a fantastic spot for indulging in local Thai cuisine. The service is exceptional, with friendly and attentive staff making sure you have a great dining experience. The prices are reasonable, offering excellent value for the delicious food served.

During our visit, we enjoyed a refreshing watermelon smoothie, which was perfect for cooling off on a hot day. The highlight of our meal was the beef spaghetti with Royal Thai basil. The dish was flavorful, with tender beef and aromatic basil blending seamlessly with the perfectly cooked spaghetti.

Overall, Sweet Restaurant provides a delightful dining experience with great food, friendly service, and good prices. It's a must-visit for anyone looking to enjoy authentic Thai cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Devin Grayman

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food here is delicious. I used to eat here at least once a week.
Years have passed, and it's still as delicious and flavorful as ever.

The prices are quite reasonable compared to similar restaurants.
The portion sizes are fair for the price.
The atmosphere is casual, with tables that might be a bit crowded, especially in the mornings.
There's no parking inside; you can park at The Old Siam or the shopping mall next door. Alternatively, you can take a bus or the MRT.

The food has a rich, savory flavor – not too strong.
I personally recommend the smoked pork knuckle, creamy scrambled eggs, and spicy carbonara spaghetti.
If you're in the Tri Phet/Pak Khlong Talat area,
please give it a try! You won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongtaewin Nakpongpiman

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is called "Sweet," but its specialty isn't desserts, but savory dishes like steaks. It's a Western-style restaurant serving tasty and affordable single-dish meals. It's been open for a very long time, since a time when there weren't many places selling this type of food. It's impossible to say what the signature dish is because the flavors are quite similar across the board. It's a single-shop unit with about ten tables. There's no parking, but you can park at the new Pahurat Market or The Old Siam. The staff provides good service, and the food comes out quickly. The restaurant participates in all government subsidies.
sample_reviews_en.author: Winyu Arayangkoon

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for a first date spot that won't break the bank,
I recommend "Sweet" (the name is so good even diabetes would be jealous!).
Located in front of the rose garden, just a quick crossroads away.
Atmosphere:
The tables aren't fancy, but they have that "sitting next to each other with shoulders touching" vibe.
Perfect for couples who aren't sure if they're officially dating yet, or just hungry and randomly decided to go there.
Price:
Starting at 60 baht! Whether you're proposing or just asking for an extra fried egg, it won't break the bank. Low budget isn't a problem if you have time and an empty stomach.
sample_reviews_en.author: May N.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This roadside food and beverage shop is a spin-off from the original establishment that had been operating since 1982. The menu isn't very extensive, focusing on simple, single-dish meals at affordable prices, making it accessible to students and office workers in the area. The portion sizes are enough to fill you up, and the taste is average. The shop uses a unique blend of soy sauce, fresh chilies, and lime, instead of fish sauce and chili peppers – quite unusual.

The shop has limited seating, around 15-20 seats, and there is no parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuu T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Shining bright yellow like a beacon facing the main road and Poh Chang College of Arts and Crafts, this humble restaurant dishes out fine foods. Local classics known to tourists like Pad Krapow and fusion food, burgers and spaghetti.
It’s noteworthy the chef serves up home cooked meals in generous portion while maintaining a clean spotless kitchen. Food prepped on a long stainless steel freezers where ingredients were kept fresh.
Value for money, on top of courteous efficient service crew.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel W

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old restaurant, open since 1982. Anyone who studied at Poh Chang or Suankularb School will definitely be a customer of this place.

The restaurant is located opposite Poh Chang. You can park behind the restaurant; the entrance is through a Phanthai coffee shop. Parking costs 30 baht per hour. After eating, you can walk around Pahurat, Sampeng, and Pak Khlong Talat.

Speaking of the food, most people come here for steak. For our family, steak is one of our absolute favorites.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mooaorcafe

restaurants.name: Thai Kitchen
restaurants.address:

131/2 Sukhumvit 7/1 Alley, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Place looked decent from outside, so we ventured in. Order food and watched for next 50 minutes how all the others have been fed, except of us. After several complaints food arrived. Actually taste wasn't that bad. But the rest was utter chaos. They were loosing the orders between bar and kitchen, delivering wrong orders etc. judging by few other couples we were not the only disappointed customers.
Bill, well of course first try was completely wrong, different table. Second try the same, third time lucky. So, we paid, food was on expensive side. Overall very disappointing experience, chaotic service, decent but over priced food. I'll never be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Petr Pakl

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were first seated at a small table between the door and the bar. The waiter first tried to take our order by memory but had to revert to paper. It then became apparent they had to move us to a bigger table to accommodate the food.
Hochgarden half pint is a big glass but tastes good. With the restaurant not even half full, we would have expected better service. They forgot a spoon for the soup and napkins.
The food was OK, but nothing we would come back for. The natch portion was big, but the plate warmer than the food when it arrived.
This was also the warmest inn door restaurant we have ever been to in Thailand .
sample_reviews_en.author: Tfarang

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is absolutely phenomenal. The staff are incredible, and I only wish I knew her name so I could personally give her the recognition she deserves. One of the waitresses was the true face of professionalism i.e. welcoming, warm, attentive, and genuinely helpful throughout. I highly recommend this place. I’ve tried a countless number of places across the globe, but I’ve rarely come across one where both the food and the service are this exceptional.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rimon Sarmah

sample_reviews_en.text:
Update: one year later.
Try the coconut ice cream. Delicious!
Food was really good, I had the pad see ew. Staff was really friendly and attentive. I will have to visit again this trip. Only one street down

Right in the middle of tourist central...lol. So, in a good location for a lot of foot traffic.
I was hoping the pad thai here tasted better than in the US. It tastes the same. I am sure it is delightful.  I have never been a fan.
sample_reviews_en.author: J. Smith

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best Thai food I've had in my 49 years. Excellent Moo Manao, Pad Prik Sod, and Pad Krapao. The coconut ice cream and mango sticky rice were also delicious.

Edit: We visited the place a couple of days after, and the Pad Prik Sod was completely different, a bit bland, none of that "soot wok" taste, so I understand why some people gave the place 3 stars. I'll keep my 5-star review since my first experience was just perfect
sample_reviews_en.author: A B

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was good. While I was there, a guy was yelling at someone, I believe something had happened before I arrived.

One of the ladies, who I think was the owner or something, handled the situation exceptionally well. I was genuinely impressed how she deal with difficult situation/ people. Watching her manage the situation was inspiring—I feel like I could learn a lot from the way she handled it.
sample_reviews_en.author: cuas ar

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really good food. Service is also exceptional. You can request them to make your food less spicy if you're really not into spicy food.
The restaurant is easy to find and is in front of the Nana BTS station. They have both air-conditioned and non air-conditioned seatings. You can observe the bustling Bangkok street from this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lalinda Dias

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thai kitchen , bang on main road near Nana BTS, one of the best experience for Thai and international food with drinks. Wide ranges of drinks with happy hour.
Nice selection of Mexican food Nachos and Tacos.
Staff is super nice that assures good hospitality. Great Value for money.
Inside , outside sitting options.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dine Check

restaurants.name: NIYA cuisine ข้าวมันไก่&อาหารไทย สาขาสุขสวัสดิ์14
restaurants.address:

228 230 Alley, Chom Thong, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I found this restaurant on Google Maps with a 4.9-star rating, so I decided to try it.
The restaurant has a promotion: get a 10% discount for writing a review.

I ordered Hainanese chicken rice. The presentation was beautiful and the portion was generous.
The chicken was very juicy and tender, but perhaps not as fragrant as I'd like.
The rice was average, but the dipping sauce was good. Ginger and chili were available to add as you like.

The food prices were okay, not cheap but not expensive either, around 80 baht per person.
Parking is available in front of the shop (in a small shop unit).
sample_reviews_en.author: nas suka

sample_reviews_en.text:
We tried a couple of dishes recommended by the friendly staff, and they were excellent. The steamed chicken was tender and served with a flavorful dressing, with the option to add ginger and chili to your taste – absolutely delicious! Highly recommended 😊

We ordered two dishes recommended by the staff: steamed chicken rice and fried rice with mackerel. They were both incredibly delicious. The steamed chicken was tender and served with a flavorful dressing that you can add ginger and chili to your liking. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pasit Foobunma

sample_reviews_en.text: As someone who's very picky about food, all I can say is that it was fantastic!! I originally came here just to try it out because I didn't have time to look for a restaurant carefully. The few dishes I randomly ordered were all delicious! They really whetted my appetite. The waitresses had sweet smiles and were very friendly. Although the food took a little while to arrive, the wait was worth it; the chef was very attentive in preparing and plating the dishes. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Xuan Sun

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried the Hainanese chicken rice at Le'Rich - Suk Sawat 14. It's a shop in a shophouse, but the seating is comfortable. They offer both single dishes and large sets.

Their Hainanese chicken rice is truly amazing. The rice itself is incredibly fragrant and delicious, and the chicken is tender, large, and satisfying.
The dipping sauce is uniquely rich and flavorful (it's thick, not sweet).

Eating it with the crispy fried shallots on top is the best!
sample_reviews_en.author: สิริกานต์ โลจนะกานต์

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Hainanese chicken rice looked amazing. And when I tried it, it was delicious!
I bought it to take home; even the packaging was impressive.
The restaurant itself is well-decorated, spacious, airy, and comfortable, with air conditioning.
Considering the price and atmosphere, the food is very reasonable.
I'm giving it 5 out of 5 stars!
sample_reviews_en.author: Merry Apinya

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually eat Hainanese chicken rice at many different restaurants, but after trying this one, I don't go to any other place anymore. It's so delicious! The chicken is tender, and the rice is amazing even without any sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sittigorn Yamngern

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves delicious special recipe Hainanese chicken rice. It's clean and excellent. The manager is dedicated and sincere in making sure customers are impressed. I will definitely come again. Giving it 5 stars!
sample_reviews_en.author: Achara

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious, the flavors were just right. The service was impressive, the restaurant was clean, and most importantly, the prices were very reasonable. 10/10, no complaints. I was very impressed! 💕
sample_reviews_en.author: Yamuna Yamngern

restaurants.name: Banna Pla Phao Rama 5
restaurants.address:

10 บางไผ่ 2, Tambon Bang Phai, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, served quickly, and the staff were friendly. However, we went at the wrong time. It was a hot afternoon for lunch with my mother, so we chose the air-conditioned room. But there was a table of about 10 people in the room, and it was very echoey. They were talking incredibly loudly, practically overshadowing each other, which drastically reduced our enjoyment of the meal. We couldn't hear each other, and we could barely hear the waiters when they asked questions – we had to strain to hear them. The staff were considerate of the other customers, most of whom were families, but there wasn't much they could do.
sample_reviews_en.author: passarakob Kob

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every dish we ordered tasted delicious and came out very quickly. The restaurant atmosphere was nice.
The male and female staff were all great; they were polite and provided excellent service.
***However, one staff member, a tomboy with braces, was not very polite. When I asked for my bottled water back, she retorted that we had already charged her. After I paid, she just placed the money tray on the table without saying anything. She should understand what customer service is like. There was no thank you message at all. This staff member needs to improve her service, or she'll lose customers.***
sample_reviews_en.author: ณราวดี

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is nice, and the singer has a beautiful voice.
Parking is convenient. Two dishes were delicious, two weren't to my liking.
The salt-grilled chicken and sun-dried pork were excellent.
The catfish larb was too finely powdered and extremely salty; it was like the salt truck was overflowing!
The papaya salad wasn't great, so I ordered a new one, emphasizing a spicier version. It was slightly spicier, but the fermented fish sauce lacked flavor. I recommend changing the fermented fish sauce; then the world of papaya salad would change!

Keep up the good work!
sample_reviews_en.author: ATeam พี่แกะ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food in general tasted good.
Some dish portions seemed a bit small.
The food didn't take long to arrive.
The restaurant atmosphere was nice, bright and airy.
There are both regular and air-conditioned seating areas.
The staff were attentive and helpful.
They were friendly and polite.
There is parking available both in front of and behind the restaurant.
A highlight is the live music.
It greatly enhances the atmosphere for dinner.
If you're in the Rama 5 Bridge area, you should definitely stop by.
sample_reviews_en.author: BiG

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible service. I asked before ordering for takeout if it was ready, and the staff ran to ask and said it was. In the end, I had to wait for them to reheat it. Terrible service, very unimpressed. Never coming back. No wonder they've been open for a while but still have few customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Werayoot Sojerya

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious.
The restaurant atmosphere was great, with live music.
There's air conditioning.
There's parking available on the side and behind the restaurant.
The staff were very attentive.
I recommend the spicy snail curry; it had a generous amount of snails.
sample_reviews_en.author: May P.

sample_reviews_en.text: I come here often, and I'll keep coming back to the same restaurant, based on reviews. I come even though it's far away. I'm very impressed! The food is delicious, clean, the service is good, and the atmosphere is chill.
sample_reviews_en.author: itsara phitsanusaeng

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food came out quickly, and the staff were lovely and the service was excellent.
I came on a rainy evening, and the weather was beautiful.
The food was delicious. The grilled shrimp and grilled fish were excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicky

restaurants.address:

179 Thung Mangkon 16 Alley, Chim Phli, Taling Chan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop is usually closed on Wednesdays. Luckily, today the shop is open for a special occasion. I saw that they accept half-price payment, so I stopped in to take a break and have coffee, steamed dumplings, and steamed custard. Everything was delicious and not expensive. I saw in the comments that the price was expensive, so I guess it refers to the cake. It's quite expensive, but the shop is beautifully decorated and perfect for taking photos. Let's just say it's average.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปีเตอร์

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located in my neighborhood.
Very cozy. Relaxing atmosphere with easy listening playlist.
Coffee is very good and the homemade pastry is what I love.
The food is not as variety as before but still be a delicious home-cook.
The staff is lovely and very polite.
Photo taken date : 8 March 2025
sample_reviews_en.author: Paveena J. Virojthanachai

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is quite expensive to very expensive, but it's not worth the value.

The atmosphere is peaceful and serene, and you can feel the energy.

You should bring a friend with you so you don't feel like you're at a Vipassana forest temple.

The prices should be more attractive.
sample_reviews_en.author: YoON Spy

sample_reviews_en.text: Good, good coffee, good desserts, not too expensive, not too cheap, parking right in front of the shop. I still eat here today, I eat here almost every day, I'm tired of Starbucks. I like the toffee nut latte, I like the basque cheesecake, this shop gets half of each person too.
sample_reviews_en.author: mayura wilainumchokchai

sample_reviews_en.text: Greenpresso is the best. It is green tea and coffee latte, the special menu at Casta Cafe. You can visit and dine-in i the warm place or take out like me. (Now they have delivery service too) There are many desserts if you like to fulfill some sweet 👍. Please come and enjoy! …
sample_reviews_en.author: Eakchai Tejthiwat

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped by based on reviews. I'm a coffee lover, and I saw people saying the coffee was good. I tried it, and it really is good. They have a decent selection of beans, and the prices are reasonable. If you're in the area, I recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paphonnat Banluechairit

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop may be a bit small, but the baristas are skilled at making quality coffee beans. Perfect for coffee lovers who love authentic coffee.

This shop has the best coffee on Thung Mangkorn Road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kraivitch Tidpaisiam

sample_reviews_en.text: There aren't many people eating in the restaurant, but there are always people coming to buy desserts to take home. The desserts are delicious, but the food is a little slow.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sorawat Sithialanganon

restaurants.name: Chaloem Kiat Roast Duck
restaurants.address:

67 Itsaraphap Rd, Somdet Chao Phraya, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the chance to be in this area, so I used Google Maps to find a restaurant I'd previously bookmarked. I found this place; it's a very old establishment, but the food is surprisingly delicious. Everything was tasty, the portions were generous, and the prices were cheap. The char siu pork was juicy, not dry or tough, and not overly sweet. The sauce was slightly sweet, reminding me of the char siu sauce I used to eat as a child, but the black soy sauce with chili dipping sauce perfectly balanced it out. Next was the roast duck – I loved this one! The meat was juicy, tender, and not tough, with a satisfyingly chewy yet still easy-to-eat skin. The duck sauce was the same as the char siu pork. The wonton noodles were also plentiful, and you can order either char siu pork or roast duck at a very reasonable price. If you're passing through the Ban Khaek, Khlong San, or Isaraphab areas, I highly recommend trying this restaurant. You won't be disappointed! (Note: The restaurant only accepts cash.)
sample_reviews_en.author: tanawata monthonwattana

sample_reviews_en.text:
Roasted Duck in Honor of His Majesty the King
👉 The shop is located on Isaraphap Road, near Soi Isaraphap 5, right by the bus stop.
👉 They sell rice and noodles. They offer roasted pork as an option, with choices of roasted pork rice, roasted duck rice, or roasted pork noodles or roasted duck noodles. Adding pork dumplings costs only 5 baht more. I ordered roasted pork noodles and roasted duck noodles, with extra dumplings. The noodles were plentiful and the dumplings were plentiful. The taste was average, but the duck sauce was perfect for those who like it. The sauce was a little oily; adding chili vinegar would make it much better. The price is very good and the portions are generous.
👉 They also sell sweet zongzi (rice dumplings) with 9 different fillings, which taste great.
👉 This shop only accepts cash.
👉 If you have the chance, I recommend trying it.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชรินทร์ วิภาวีพลกุล

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today (May 30, 2023), I had a regular bowl of dry duck wonton noodles for 50 baht. The shop also provides a small bowl of soup and free iced tea.

Quantity: A very generous portion of noodles, probably one and a half to two portions, plus 5 bite-sized pork wontons and about 10 pieces of roasted duck.

Taste: The noodles are thin, seasoned with a little fish sauce, perfectly cooked, chewy and soft, with a fragrant garlic oil aroma. It's topped with the roasted duck sauce. *Overall, it's a bit salty, so I recommend tasting it before adding any extra seasoning.* The pork wontons were just okay; perhaps they were overcooked and the filling was quite crumbly. The roasted duck and sauce were delicious.

I really liked the noodles. Next time I'll try the char siu noodles and duck rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puak Krub

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old, established restaurant in the Isaraphab area. They give generous portions at reasonable prices. We ordered one special and one regular, and the special was enough to share. The duck was tender and delicious, the dumplings were large, and the sauce was sweet, but we didn't use much, so it wasn't overly sweet. They also provide dark soy sauce and soup. It's great value for the price. The owners, an elderly couple, are very friendly. It gets busy at lunchtime, so you need to be patient if you order. They only accept cash.
sample_reviews_en.author: กิรชาดา

sample_reviews_en.text: This long-established roast duck and red pork noodle shop, known for its Chalermkiat roast duck, is sure to satisfy even the most discerning customer. It's reasonably priced, starting at 35 baht, but it comes with at least 2-3 delicious noodles. A single bowl will fill you up. The red pork is thinly sliced ​​and delicious. The roast duck is also tender and delicious. Most importantly, the portions are generous. The uncle and auntie who own the shop are also lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Art Suwarnatemiya

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, roast duck made with an old recipe, not expensive, lots of noodles and dumplings, the owner is kind and provides good service. The day I went, the duck sold out very quickly. It wasn't even noon yet, so I ate at the restaurant. I ordered to go and it was gone. They don't make a lot of duck and the quantity is limited. If you plan to go, you should call to ask first so you won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: korawit komolrit

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate at this restaurant before playing a game. I ordered duck rice. The food was delicious. The duck sauce was perfectly balanced, with just the right amount of sweetness and saltiness—not too dry, not too wet—allowing the flavors of the rice and duck to blend together harmoniously. It was delicious from the first bite to the last. There was no gamey duck smell either. It's a really good restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Viroon Manacharoenying (BubbleBoard)

sample_reviews_en.text:
My first time here but they open for a long time.  For me many local noodles are better than the expensive branding in the department store.  Here become my favorite and they give us to much to eat them all.  Noodle is very good and duck is my favorite! with very good price!!
Sauce a bit sweet but you can put black vinegar sauce to make it perfect!!
The owners are kind too 😍😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Polly P

restaurants.address:

sample_reviews_th.text: The dipping sauce was delicious, especially the Jaew Hon (spicy dipping sauce). The beef shoulder blade was 219฿, a reasonable price. The spicy salad had a flavorful dressing and was reasonably priced. They also have desserts, but I didn't take a picture of them. The dessert was shaved ice.
sample_reviews_th.author: Proud Wow

sample_reviews_en.text: The spicy hot pot soup was delicious. The beef shank was quite thick and needed to be cooked thoroughly for tenderness. The dipping sauce was tasty; this restaurant also has a bitter version 👍. The papaya salad with crab, fermented fish sauce, and pork sausage was very spicy. The sun-dried beef was freshly fried. The food didn't take long to arrive. The staff were friendly and attentive to customers. The restaurant is near my house, so I'll definitely bring my friends there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ice Nattida

sample_reviews_en.text: The soup was delicious, and the sweet dipping sauce perfectly complemented the broth. The portions were generous and good value. I especially liked the tender, chewy beef shoulder; it wasn't tough at all. The shrimp was fresh, sweet, and juicy. The staff provided good service. The restaurant doesn't have air conditioning, but there are plenty of fans to keep the area cool. There's parking for two cars in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaiwat Choterungruangkorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Jaew Hon (spicy dipping sauce) is incredibly delicious! The dipping sauce is great, the soup is amazing, and the price is reasonable. Besides the delicious Jaew Hon, the desserts are superb. The coconut milk dessert made with real palm sugar is incredibly fragrant and just the right amount of sweetness, not too sweet.
Plus, there's a buy one get one free promotion on 12.12!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakradha Arbsuwon

sample_reviews_en.text: The Jaew Hon (spicy dipping sauce) was ordered in jumbo size and had a generous portion. The dipping sauce was okay, but the soup was even better. The staff were attentive and efficient. It was quite hot inside, and the fans weren't very effective. Overall, I was quite impressed and will definitely come back again. 👍 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Duke Dick

sample_reviews_en.text: The meat was very tender, and the atmosphere was great. I recommend coming when the weather is cool. Personally, I thought the tables were a bit small 😅 Even though we didn't order much, there wasn't enough space for everything. I was very impressed with this meal ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Hathaipat

sample_reviews_en.text: 👨‍🍳Please help promote this restaurant because it's a Jaew Hon (spicy hot pot) place with incredibly affordable prices. The pork, the dipping sauce, and the soup all go together perfectly. //I hope they do well so they can stay open forever …
sample_reviews_en.author: AURA ไดอารี่

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a decent Jaew Hon (spicy dipping sauce) restaurant near my house. It's close to the back of the university, so students probably frequent it. There's parking for two cars in front of the shop, but it might be best to get a smaller …
sample_reviews_en.author: Sherryzaza

restaurants.name: นำสมัยสุขใจสนามชัย
restaurants.address:

2/23 Ekkachai Rd, บางขุนเทียน Chom Thong, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is beautifully decorated, giving off a very contemporary vintage vibe. The atmosphere is great, right by the canal with clean, fresh water. The food tasted great to us. The stir-fried kale with crispy pork, a simple dish, was exceptionally well-made. The kale was perfectly crisp, not tough or chewy, and the pork was incredibly crunchy, like it had just been cooked. Some restaurants find the pork chewy, but this wasn't the case here; it remained crispy and fragrant. My daughter ordered spaghetti, which she liked – I didn't try it, so I can't give a detailed review. My sister ordered some kind of chicken stir-fry; it had a lot of peanuts, but the flavor was well-balanced and delicious. The iced black tea was strong and refreshing. Overall, we really liked it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wida Singha

sample_reviews_en.text:
A cafe that will take you back to happy memories of the past. It's a vintage cafe + Thai food + activities + accommodation. The shop is decorated in a retro 70s-80s style, located by the Sanamchai canal, with a great atmosphere. They have a full range of food and drinks.

Activities include kayaking, pedal boating, and longtail boat charters to explore the canal-side lifestyle of Thonburi. There are overnight rooms for tourists and locals alike. It feels like a relaxing getaway in the countryside – very healing!

📍Namsamai Sukjai Sanamchai (at the end of Soi Ekachai 33)
🕐 Open 11:00-20:00 (Closed every Monday)
🚙 Parking available

Highly recommended! Excellent service 10/10 😄
sample_reviews_en.author: Wilaiporn Khruasri

sample_reviews_en.text: The single-dish menu offers a wide variety of options, and the taste exceeded expectations. The spicy instant noodle salad was incredibly flavorful, and the chef's skill in making it perfect was amazing. The appetizers, like the baked spinach with cheese and the chicken with herbs, clearly used high-quality ingredients. The highlight was the chill atmosphere; it felt like visiting a friend's house by the river. The owner was warm and welcoming, and the boat ride along the Sanam Chai canal was a fun and unique experience. I'll definitely introduce this great restaurant to my friends soon!
sample_reviews_en.author: Walaiporn Yui

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a relatively new restaurant. The food is reasonably priced and the taste is standard; you won't be disappointed.

I ordered the Tom Yum creamy egg soup and Caesar salad (I personally loved it and it was delicious 😋).

I heard the owner plans to have a homestay in the future. It will have a retro, vintage feel, an old Thai house, and a garden next to it. The atmosphere is by the river with a boat, perfect for photos. This is a promising development for the future, potentially becoming a small tourist attraction or hosting community events.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nai 1919

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in Soi Ekachai 33, which is quite narrow.
However, there is parking available right by the restaurant; you can drive in and park.
The restaurant is situated by the river, with no air conditioning but it's not hot. There are quite a few tables. The food took a little while to arrive, but the drinks came out quickly.
Personally, I thought the prices were a bit high for both food and drinks. There's a homestay on the second floor, but we didn't stay there. The vibe is nice for people who like vintage things, a 90s feel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Momo Jung

sample_reviews_en.text: The cafe has a beautiful retro style. There's no air conditioning, but it's not hot. The food is okay, edible but not amazing. I was disappointed with the lemon tea, which seemed to be made from instant powder and was just sweet. In my opinion, if you want lemon tea like that, you could just buy it at a convenience store; no need to travel all the way to a cafe.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gunta Ratanapramote

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is amazing! The evening weather is perfect. The owner seems quiet but is kind. The staff provides good service. Drinks start at only 45 baht, which is very cheap. The atmosphere is truly great. The chocolate is delicious ❤️ and the french fries are huge! It's a real hidden gem. I'll definitely be back often.
sample_reviews_en.author: My mind

sample_reviews_en.text: Good restaurant propose good food with enough choice near the river in a vintage place with many old décorations... The result is wonderful and give a wonderful quiet atmosphere... Possibility to practise water bike , kayak , boat ... Prices are respectable... Beautiful garden and places to discover... I easy advice...
sample_reviews_en.author: laurent barille

restaurants.name: บ้านนาวา
restaurants.address:

19/2 หมู่1 Bang Khun Kong, Bang Kruai District, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
From the main road, follow the winding road (using GPS) – it's not difficult to find. Parking is available right in front of the entrance, which is a walkway.

The restaurant has tables, floor seating, and seating with your legs dangling.
I went at dusk and had the seafood curry with rice. It came with two shrimp and some squid for 50 baht. The rice was a bit hard.
I also had the tofu, minced pork, and seaweed hot pot for 80 baht. It tasted good, and you can watch boats go by while you eat. Bottled water is 10 baht per bottle.

However, there were quite a few mosquitoes bothering my legs. A fan to blow on my legs would be nice.

The staff seemed dedicated. Give it a try if you're in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aegjunk Sailorsunx

sample_reviews_en.text: Well here we have another great find tucked away The piece and quiet sitting by the Khlong  watching the the longtail boats and the sellers selling their wares up and down the river was a joy to watch while having a nice cold Chang and a most beautiful food you could ask for. We got to spend a lot of time talking with the owner and must say she is a lovely lady. We will be back to enjoy the great tasting food. Thank you so much for the lovely afternoon to the owner
sample_reviews_en.author: Oi Yu

sample_reviews_en.text:
A secret local thai food restaurant located by riverside.
Good atmosphere. We went at noon for having brunch and ordered 4 dishes.Food is yummy and price is reasonable (start at 50baht Feb24) you can see menus.
Owner is so kind. Plenty of parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tang Raksat

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a simple, riverside restaurant with a nice atmosphere. The food is very spicy. The owner is friendly and cooks everything herself, so the food comes out slowly. Therefore, if you're coming in a large group, you should call ahead to order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Methinee nn

sample_reviews_en.text: This small restaurant by the canal has a great atmosphere and delicious food at very reasonable prices. I'll definitely go back. All this, plus 4 bottles of beer, water, ice, and soda, cost a total of 1,200 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Richard

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was good and the staff had great customer service. The food was very reasonably priced, delicious, and flavorful, although a little on the sweet side. People who like sweet flavors might enjoy it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Reena Num

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the portions are generous, the prices are reasonable, the service is friendly, the view by the canal is beautiful, and the breeze is cool and refreshing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Welayut Thaikamol

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem by the river. Nice atmosphere, food is average in taste, but the hot pot broth is tasty.
Good and friendly service.
The prices are considered reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arunee Chaitan

restaurants.name: ผมขอทอด - สาขาลาดพร้าว
restaurants.address:

2 Sukhontha Sawat 8 Alley, Khwaeng Lat Phrao, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is Korean-style fried chicken that's worth a try.
They're really good.
We happened to be in the Nakniwat area, so we stopped by for some takeout.
The shop is a shipping container in front of a coffee shop.
It's a little way down an alley, and there's parking. There's outdoor seating, but it can get a bit hot, so it's best for takeout.

While waiting, orders kept coming in through the app. It took about 10-15 minutes to get our food.

The double-fried chicken ensures a long-lasting crispiness. I even tossed it in the sauce and it wasn't too mushy when I got home because the lid was open, and the box had ventilation holes all around it, which prevented steam from building up inside the box, which could make the chicken soft.

I recommend the spicy sauce, which is delicious. The garlic sauce is also good. The chicken pieces are large, and the packaging is nice. The price and quantity are reasonable compared to Korean brands.
This is another place I'll definitely order from again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wilawan Wongwiwattanachaya

sample_reviews_en.text:
📌 I'm Khun Tod - Ladprao Branch
⏰ Open 11:00 AM - 8:30 PM
🍗 This is one of my favorite restaurants. I tried it once and loved it. The prices are lovely. Even when I ordered takeout and ate it the next day, it was still delicious! I miss it so much. Now that I'm back home, I don't get to eat there often. Today I was traveling in the area and remembered it, so I stopped by. I'm still impressed and I've discovered another lovely restaurant. I'm so happy to have found it and hope to see you again!
🚗🛵 There's parking across the street for cars and motorcycle parking in front of the shop for delivery riders and general customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiratchaya Sakultunprateep

sample_reviews_en.text: Korean-style fried chicken is so crispy I ordered it with the original sauce because it wasn't spicy. It was so delicious, crispy, and the sauce was so good. It was sprinkled with fried shallots. It's truly delicious when eaten hot. There are many sauces to choose from, including Mala. There are also side dishes like pickled radish and kimchi, just like in Korean style. The shop is in the same area as the Santiphanit Coffee shop in Bangkok.
