There are tables and chairs in the outdoor area. There is parking for about 20 cars in the alley.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chao Cee

sample_reviews_en.text: It has become our regular Korean fried chicken shop. We had the chance to try it by accident. At first, we thought it would be similar to the famous Korean fried chicken shop, but its taste is very unique. It is Korean fried chicken that does not try to be like any other shop, but it turns out that its taste is delicious and unique. We like the Original flavor the most. It is sweet and salty, very delicious. Everyone should try it. It is a taste that if you want to eat another shop, it cannot be replaced. You really have to try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: ll aps

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is clean, the service is fast, the chicken is boneless, very fragrant, crispy, and easy to eat.
Staff: Smiling, cheerful, friendly, and helpful for first-time customers.
Chicken: Available in both wings and thighs. 6 pieces allow you to choose 1 flavor, and 10 pieces allow you to choose 2 flavors.
Taste: The original flavor is like chicken in fish sauce. The Korean flavor is slightly spicy, while the mala flavor has a fragrant, numbing mala aroma.

(Personally, I think it's better than KFC.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Space

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. This is my second time ordering, but both times, the first and second orders, the staff took different orders. Both times, they were confused and didn't understand what I asked, so I just said, "Okay, that's fine." When the person taking the order asked another friend, the other friend was playing on his phone and not paying attention. Poor thing. 😭 There's a POS, but it looks like the person is still using a calculator to add up. I'll improve this point.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kritsada Natejinda

sample_reviews_en.text: I really like the fried chicken at this shop. Today I had the chance to eat at the shop. You can choose to sit at either the Pad Thai shop in front of the alley or the cafe next door. There is a parking area in the alley, very convenient. The fried chicken is the best when eaten hot out of the oven. I must say it is 3000% delicious. I personally like the original flavor. Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside 👍 Will definitely come back to eat again many times 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Clairdelune

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fried chicken is incredibly delicious! Truly crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. The sauces are amazing; all of them are tasty. The pieces are large, and the price is affordable. Better than any other place I've ever had fried chicken.

It stays crispy for a long time; it's still crispy even when I get home. But if possible, I recommend eating it at the restaurant. It's even better when it's freshly fried than when you order it for takeout.
sample_reviews_en.author: Worawut Tantipisnu

restaurants.name: THE GATE
restaurants.address:

328 Maharat Rd, Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Excellent cafe serving great and very reasonably priced food and drinks quickly."

sample_reviews_en.text: We stayed at this hotel between January 18-22 and the location is fantastic. The amazing view of Wat Arun is almost right below the hotel; you can go out at night or in the early morning, have a drink, watch the view, take photos and videos, and then go back to your room. A 7-Eleven is very close, within walking distance, so you can easily do your shopping. The disadvantages were the lack of a nearby money change office, the very hard bed, and the absence of a window in the room. I'm not counting the money change office because you can use it elsewhere, and it's right in the center anyway. The only negatives about this place were the lack of a window and the hard bed. Other than that, everything was perfect. The fact that the room was tidied up and cleaned and fresh towels were provided when we returned in the evening was an extra plus. If I were to come again, this would be my first choice 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Mehmet

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was just Ok unfortunately. We ordered the grilled pork chop steak, the Mango Seafood salad, the grilled king mushrooms, Pad Tai. The Pad Tai was  very good, The Mango alas was sour and the dried baby shrimp were still rock hard and would break your teeth. It was literally swimming in a fish sauce 2” deep in the bowl. We could only pick through it and eat the squid and large shrimp. The two mussels were bad and I unfortunately eat one. The beer washed it down. The pork chop was also disappointing as it was quite small for a country that lives on pork and chicken and it is so cheap here. Charge a bit more and put a generous Pork chop on the plate.  The service was Ok, no one asked why we didn’t eat the salad. The grilled mushrooms were excellent and a good portion.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Patenaude

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ice cream is generic, the atmosphere is average, and the service standards are far too low.

Point 1: I intended to order gelato from the counter display, but since there was no staff serving, I went inside to order. Upon entering, the staff informed me, "You can order at the counter."

Point 2: After ordering and paying, I wanted to sit and eat inside because I saw there were no other customers. However, the staff informed me, "You can't sit here; you have to order food and drinks first." This was despite the fact that I had many more opportunities to buy food and drinks, but I decided to stop there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattakit C.

sample_reviews_en.text: Three of us came and ordered at the same time, but only two of us arrived. We thought it would be busy because it's a festival, so we waited. But tables that came later got their food first. That was it. When we asked, they said the waiter made a mistake and just told us to wait. So we asked how they were going to handle this problem besides making us wait and offering a dismissive apology, saying the staff made a mistake and that maybe the customers didn't order at the same time. Ugh!!! The man who seemed to be the manager could only say that much. That's it. One time is more than enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: MK

sample_reviews_en.text:
While in Bangkok, I stayed one night at this hotel, which I highly recommend.
Chetuphon Gate is fantastically located, and the little street leading to the Chao Phraya River is very pleasant.

The welcome was extremely warm, the room I stayed in was very clean and nicely decorated, the king-size bed was incredibly comfortable, and... what a surprise when I went to the window: the direct view of Wat Pho Temple was simply breathtaking! 😍🙏 I will definitely return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stéphane Cairn

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent location, unmissable view, but ONLY from rooms 305 and 306!!! Unbeatable value for money. Firm beds, but you sleep well; pillows are too high and hard, unusable. Towels changed daily; linens not (but perhaps you could have just asked). No soap kit. A hairdryer is MISSING! A few mosquitoes (2 or 3 per evening) pass under the door. Spray them with mosquito repellent every day and things will be better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mario Rossi

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible service. We spent 1,000 baht on seven ice creams, yet the staff was incredibly rude from the moment we walked in. They gave us attitude for sitting down before we had even finished looking at the menu. From the servers to the cashier, the energy was unwelcoming. If you don't want to work in hospitality, don't. Save your money and go somewhere that actually appreciates its customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Masia Janamphai

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good food. We got the spring rolls and the pork steak, ice coffee and coconut matsa. In one word: fantastic. Also we got ice cream, although ice cream is only take away( mainly is different shop) but they were kind to serve it in( we paid it in advance before we order the food)
sample_reviews_en.author: Naxos Kitelife kitesurfing center Mikri Vigla

restaurants.name: 298 Nikuya Yakiniku
restaurants.address:

2/34 Sukhumvit 41 Alley, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I tried this restaurant for the first time at lunchtime after finding it on Google Maps and was very impressed. The taste exceeded my expectations, especially the buffet and the premium wagyu. The meat was incredibly tender, melt-in-your-mouth, and perfectly grilled 😋

I chose the PREMIUM BUFFET for 1080฿ and felt it was worth it. There was a wide variety of wagyu and other cuts of beef to choose from, making for a very enjoyable meal. The atmosphere was comfortable, perfect for a long, relaxing meal.

If you're looking for a yakiniku restaurant near Phrom Phong for lunch, this is definitely a place I'll be back to. Next time, I'll bring friends to try more dishes!
sample_reviews_th.author: Pukky Pukpuk Song

sample_reviews_th.text:
This was my first time having dinner here after seeing it on Instagram, and it exceeded my expectations. I chose the PREMIUM BUFFET (1080฿) and the taste was amazing. The Wagyu beef was fragrant, tender, and had just the right amount of marbling, and there was a wide variety of cuts to choose from.

The atmosphere was comfortable and perfect for a relaxed dinner. The service was excellent, allowing for a leisurely and enjoyable meal. It was well worth the price! 😋

If you're looking for a yakiniku restaurant near Phrom Phong for dinner that offers good quality and value, I'd definitely come back again!
sample_reviews_th.author: rattanon jiramahawittayakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited for dinner the second time, this time through a friend’s recommendation, and again I really enjoyed the experience. I ordered a la carte, and the meat quality was excellent, with many Wagyu and beef cut options to choose from.

Everything tasted delicious and the meal felt satisfying overall. The only small point for me was the kimchi, which was a bit more sour than I prefer and had a lingering aftertaste, but that did not take away from the visit 😊

The staff were warm, the atmosphere was comfortable, and I could see myself coming back again. If you are around Phrom Phong and looking for Yakiniku with a wide selection, this is a lovely spot!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarocha S

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don't usually eat meat because I'm sensitive to the taste, but this time I was very impressed. The meat was fresh, high-quality, and not at all gamey. I ordered à la carte during lunchtime, and everything was truly delicious.

This was my first time here, after seeing Pond Phuwin's review. The staff were lovely, the service was excellent, and the atmosphere was comfortable. They have a wide variety of meat cuts to choose from, including Wagyu and other beef cuts. It was great value for money 😊

I will definitely come back if I have the chance. If you're looking for a good yakiniku place near Phrom Phong, I highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: A Chayanoot

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was my first visit, and I chose the PREMIUM BUFFET for dinner after hearing about it from a friend. The meat was genuinely delicious, with rich flavor and a great balance of tenderness and juiciness.

I also liked how many wagyu and beef cuts were available, so there was plenty to choose from and each bite felt special 😊 The staff were friendly, the atmosphere was comfortable, and the overall experience felt worth the price.

If you are looking for Yakiniku around Phrom Phong, this is a very satisfying place for a relaxed dinner! I would happily come back next time with friends to try even more cuts and side dishes 🍽️
sample_reviews_en.author: John Mendiola

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had my first dinner here and was very impressed. Everything I ordered à la carte was delicious, from the beef and pork to the soup and bibimbap. The flavors were truly excellent.

If you're looking for yakiniku near Phrom Phong, I highly recommend it. They have many cuts of meat to choose from, including wagyu and regular beef, and each dish was high quality and great value. 😊

The staff provided excellent service; they were attentive and always there for us. The atmosphere was comfortable, perfect for dinner. I'll definitely be back to try other menu items next time. 🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: nananinnn

sample_reviews_en.text:
A friend recommended this place, and my first dinner visit turned out to be a very satisfying one. I tried the PREMIUM BUFFET and enjoyed the tasty selection overall 😋

In the middle of my meal, I felt this was a great spot for Yakiniku in Phrom Phong. The Wagyu and other beef cuts offered plenty of variety, which made choosing and grilling each bite fun

The atmosphere was easy to relax in, and the buffet felt worth it for a first visit. A few items were a bit too salty for my taste, but I’d still happily come back with friends next time!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kan Riewruja

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited for dinner for the first time after a friend’s recommendation, and the PREMIUM BUFFET was a great choice. The meat quality was genuinely impressive, with tender Wagyu and plenty of beef cuts to choose from, so every round felt satisfying 😋

The grill was easy to use, the atmosphere was relaxed, and the staff kept things comfortable throughout the meal. For anyone looking for Yakiniku in Phrom Phong, this felt like a very good value for the quality!

I’d happily come back with friends next time to try even more cuts and side dishes
sample_reviews_en.author: Damisa K

restaurants.name: ทรงกิจก๋วยเตี๋ยวเนื้อ ตลาดปู่เจ้าสำโรง
restaurants.address:

1736 2 Thepharak Rd, Tambon Thepharak, เมือง Samut Prakan 10270, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Songkit Noodle Shop, Pujo Saming Phrai branch. They make their own beef meatballs, which taste great, as does the broth. The prices are good too. Fresh beef meatball noodle soup (vermicelli) is 40 baht, and beef soup (without noodles) is 50 baht.

Meatballs: 50 pieces for 180 baht, 100 pieces for 350 baht.

I heard they're related to the Songkit shop in the Lam Sali area.

Open daily from 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: Montree T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Beef noodle soup with clear broth.
The noodles were perfectly cooked, soft and delicious.
Personally, I prefer the fresh beef over the stewed beef.
The taste was decent, and the price was reasonable at 50 baht.

The meatballs were just okay, nothing special, and quite small.
sample_reviews_en.author: PO

sample_reviews_en.text: The meatballs are crispy and bouncy with a decent flavor; the fresh meat is tender; the stewed meat isn't quite tender enough; the tendons are soft and flavorful; the broth is clear and well-balanced; and it's sold at a cheap price.
sample_reviews_en.author: pongsathorn poolpoka

sample_reviews_en.text: This old, established shop serves delicious clear broth beef noodle soup with meatballs. A must-try for beef noodle soup lovers! Highly recommended! 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: wattana sutiparinyanont

sample_reviews_en.text: They're small but delicious, I've been eating them for almost 20 years, and now I'm almost 30, and I still go there to eat them.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภาณุพงศ์ สุทธิประสิทธ์

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious. I came with my office friends. We've been eating here for almost thirty years. It's fantastic!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yongyut M.

sample_reviews_en.text: The broth was excellent, the meatballs and the braised beef were all superb. I also loved the fragrant tea.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sacha Gg

sample_reviews_en.text: This noodle shop impressed me the most; the noodles were delicious and the prices were very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: พิษณุ อาภา

restaurants.name: Cheap Shots
restaurants.address:

ตลาดจตุจักร Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every dish on the menu is incredibly delicious and flavorful. The portions are generous, both in quantity and quality. They offer both Thai and Western dishes. The restaurant has a comfortable seating area and refreshing drinks. The spicy spaghetti is amazing! The shrimp paste fried rice is packed with ingredients, the pineapple fried rice is delicious, the Pad Thai with fresh shrimp is rich and perfectly balanced, the Tom Yum Goong (spicy shrimp soup) has a perfectly balanced broth, the crispy pork is a must-try (not greasy!), the fish and chips, pizza, Piadina Ham Cheese, and many other appetizers that are so filling you'll want to order more because they're so tasty. They also have refreshing drinks like lime soda and orange soda that perfectly complement the food. Most importantly, the owner, the beautiful and talented Khun Nat, welcomes you and creates all the delicious dishes.
Thank you for the delicious food and happiness at Cheap Shot! 👍🥰💞
I didn't even get a chance to photograph some of the dishes... we were enjoying the food so much!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yumikogirl Treetraphan

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff are awful, they offer absolutely no options and treat you terribly. I absolutely do not recommend it. I asked if the dish I wanted was spicy and they said very little. Once they brought it to me, it was incredibly spicy, and I had my friends try it to see if it was spicy or if it was just me (one of them liked spicy food, but he said it was extremely spicy). Instead of letting me exchange the dish I hadn't eaten, they rudely snatched it out of my hands and told me I wasn't going to eat anything else, and on top of that, they wanted to charge me for it. I definitely do not recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: nuri sp

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited the Bangkok weekend market and had a terrible experience with the 'western food at this establishment.' Even the garlic bread tasted awful, like it had been frozen. The chicken was foul; I was surprised it made me this sick. I only took a bite, chewed it, and spat it out. I felt like I was going to be sick almost immediately after eating. While I can't say for sure that it was this vendor, I'm 99% certain it was. I've felt awful for the past 24 hours, and it’s been one of the worst experiences of my life. I wouldn't recommend eating here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maher Zeitoun

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was exhausted and worn out from browsing around Chatuchak Market when I spotted this restaurant. I went in solely hoping for some air conditioning, but the food and hygiene were decent, and thanks to it, I was able to refresh myself.

If you are someone who doesn't prefer street food, I would recommend this place as a spot to grab a quick bite while touring Chatuchak Market.

Without the rest under the air conditioning and the cold beer at this restaurant, it would have been a truly difficult day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dongyeon Kang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Many other restaurants in the Chatuchak Market were closed on Friday night, but we saw this one was still open and had good reviews, so our family ate there.

The prices were reasonable, and the food was delicious. I recommend the green curry, basil pork, stir-fried vegetables, and the fried rice, which was okay (but not very fragrant). The restaurant also had air conditioning. The prices were much better than the night market stalls outside, so I recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Helen Yu

sample_reviews_en.text: Today we had something to eat in the Chatuchak market after doing some shopping.  The menu looked good and promised a lot.  The food was really good.  couldn't fault it.  the mango smoothie was equally delicious.  the staff is nice and attentive.  and the ambience is nice.  Conclusion: good quality of food and the price is also right.  would love to come back...
sample_reviews_en.author: bangkokrecomment “Food & Travel TikTok”

sample_reviews_en.text: I have to say, this is another restaurant where I've never been disappointed. Every dish is delicious, and I appreciate the attentiveness of the staff; everyone is cheerful and smiling. The atmosphere inside the restaurant is also great; the air conditioning is nice and cool, making it comfortable to sit. I will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: King Leo

sample_reviews_en.text: Beware of this place!!! Don't go near!!!! I had a live caterpillar!! Huge in the food, my food was full of caterpillar eggs I asked the manager what it was he said it was seasoning I knew it wasn't. And suddenly the whole dish started moving and a huge caterpillar came out of it be careful be careful be careful
sample_reviews_en.author: Nizan Giannetti

restaurants.name: S&P Phyathai 2 Hospital
restaurants.address:

2 Hospital, 943 Phahonyothin Rd, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
There were two of us, and I understand there were a lot of orders, but one of our dishes (Picanha Beef Fried Rice) took almost a full hour to arrive. What's even funnier is that when we checked on it after 30 minutes, the other dish (Shrimp Fried Rice) was still sitting there, waiting. The staff seemed to be planning to serve them together. Even as I'm typing this, it still hasn't arrived. If we waited any longer, the fried rice would be hard and the soup would be cold. We asked for a replacement, and when we asked for a new one, it was just as cold… What kind of common sense does the staff have? Serving everything together seems more important than serving hot food, huh? -_-"

Just as I'm typing this, the other dish arrived. The soup was a bit hotter, so that was okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชล บุนนาค

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I went to the doctor and stopped by to buy a sandwich and a drink to take home.
The staff were friendly and polite, but the person who was supposed to make the drinks refused to do so. They just stood smiling at the empty counter, waiting for orders to pile up before finally making them.
Most importantly, it was very dirty. The area where they made the matcha latte was left unwashed after use.
Then, when it came time to make my clear drink, they just shook it in plain water twice and brewed it immediately.
The area in the sink, where the previous drinks were made, was piled up and not washed, even though that station wasn't touched at all.
Improving the quality would be great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dew Sariya

sample_reviews_en.text:
🏡 A little coffee shop right outside  the main entrance of Building B of Phyathai 2.
🥤 Tried espresso matcha latte, taste great of bitter aroma coffee blended with bitter sweet matcha green tea latte, just perfect 🫶
🍝Spaghetti Salmon, taste ok.
🍪 butter cookies is always ggod, a bit too sweet but fragrance taste of butter
👨‍🍳👩‍🍳 nice and plesant to serve staff
🚘 park at hospital parking lot
🚉 BTS Sanam Pao
sample_reviews_en.author: AmyLoveMaToom

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is located on the 2nd floor of the hospital, near the entrance to the parking lot. Once you walk into the food zone, it’s right on your right. The place is quite spacious with plenty of seating and comfortable AC. They offer a good variety of bakery items, coffee, and savory dishes—all delicious! The staff provides great service, and the prices are reasonable.😄
sample_reviews_en.author: Riley Finn

sample_reviews_en.text:
This little coffee shop is just on the outside of the main entrance to this Phyathai 2 hospital and very convenient. I had an appointment, so I set in there with a coffee and some pastys .Very clean and tidy and staff are very friendly very reasonable priced.
Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason

sample_reviews_en.text: Great food and a clean atmosphere! The Khao Khluk Kapi and the coffee were both outstanding. Unfortunately, the service from some staff members let the experience down and down
sample_reviews_en.author: Pitchaya “PP” Happiest17

sample_reviews_en.text: I always stop by to buy something whenever I come to see the doctor. They have many delicious options, it's convenient, and you can even sit and eat at the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kuakamol Duangprateep

sample_reviews_en.text: The branch at Phya Thai 2 Hospital is located at the front. They have many menu items and promotions. Dine-in service is available, and the service is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชานิวัฒน์ หงษ์ชูเกียรติ

restaurants.name: เตี๋ยวนายไผ่ Nai Phai Noodle
restaurants.address:

628/2 Kanchanaphisek Rd, Bang Phai, Bang Khae, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered Tom Yum soup.
The lime aroma was nice, and the taste was delicious, but it lacked balance. If you like sour flavors, you'll probably like it because the sourness is dominant.
Lots of peanuts, whole peanuts.
The minced pork was shaped into patties, delicious and flavorful.
Plenty of morning glory added.

Basil fried rice, the taste was okay.
They also gave a piping hot soup, which was very refreshing when eating spicy food.
They used jasmine rice, and the basil fried rice with fresh chilies was neither dry nor soggy.
You can choose between minced pork or tender sliced ​​pork. Each dish costs 55 baht.

There were other menu items, but I didn't order them, such as bacon fried rice and mixed dry rice porridge.
sample_reviews_en.author: MonKao GoAround

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, clean, and affordable.
The offal (liver, intestines) is clean, the tom yum soup tastes good (made with real lime juice), they still use rice flour noodles, the rice is good, the pork is tender and okay. They also provide seafood dipping sauce. The grilled meatballs are decent, and the sesame dipping sauce is fragrant. The portion is enough to fill you up in one bowl or one plate. It's worth the price. There's a restroom and street parking. If you're passing by this area, you can satisfy your hunger here; you won't be disappointed. It seems like it just opened recently.
sample_reviews_en.author: S. ASAVA

sample_reviews_en.text: I order from this restaurant regularly whenever I crave pork blood soup or noodle soup, but they have many other dishes to choose from. The food tastes great, the broth is delicious and doesn't need any extra seasoning, and it's perfect with rice. I usually order delivery because the restaurant is not far from my accommodation, which is convenient. I recommend trying it; you won't be disappointed. Parking is available along the roadside.
sample_reviews_en.author: เฉาก๋วย ถ้วยโตโต

sample_reviews_en.text:
This noodle shop serves delicious Tom Yum pork noodles. They have a variety of dishes to choose from. Try it! Today I tried:

Dry Tom Yum noodles (thin noodles): The noodles were perfectly cooked, chewy and just right.

Tom Yum wonton soup: The flavor was intense, no need to add any seasoning.

And minced pork basil stir-fry with rice: It was stir-fried dry, with a nice aroma of basil and chili.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tee lai

sample_reviews_en.text: Located on Kanchanaphisek Road (inbound) before The Mall Bang Khae, this small, clean-looking shop serves pork noodles and side dishes like meatballs and sausages. Their specialty is the Tom Yum pork noodle soup, packed with ingredients for 60 baht. Regular Tom Yum noodles are also available for 40-50 baht. The taste is okay. They also accept the government's co-payment scheme.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pisanu Phatumrat

sample_reviews_en.text: This noodle shop on Kanchanaphisek Road is known for its fresh lime, large dumplings, and flavorful pork blood soup. The staff provides good service. Although the shop isn't air-conditioned, they have large fans to help keep you cool. However, I found hair in my noodle bowl. I wish they were cleaner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alicia

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm a regular customer. The 70 baht special seems like I'm getting less than before. I understand the economic situation and rising costs, but this is still too little. Or maybe it depends on the chef? It varies; the shorter chef before used to give bigger portions.
sample_reviews_en.author: Win Pummanee

sample_reviews_en.text: Parking is available along the roadside. Restrooms are available. The food tastes good; the spicy noodles are very flavorful. If you don't like spicy food, be sure to tell the staff. They also have snacks like fried dumplings and meatballs …
sample_reviews_en.author: MAMRITA Mam

restaurants.name: On the Table The Crystal SB Ratchapruek
restaurants.address:

35/303 Soi Mu Ban Siwali, Bang Khun Kong, Bang Kruai District, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, but there are too few staff members, resulting in less attentive service. The food came out quickly though.
Duo Fries: French fries and sweet potato fries served with two sauces. They were served hot and the fries were tasty, but a little oily.
Crispy Chicken Curry Rice with Creamy Egg: The rice was soft, the creamy egg was smooth, and it didn't have much flavor. It went well with the curry sauce. The fried chicken was thinly breaded, tender, and not oily. The curry sauce was delicious and fragrant.
Shrimp Creamy Egg Spaghetti: This dish was a bit disappointing. The sauce was tasty, and the pasta was cooked perfectly, but it clumped together. The fried shrimp on top seemed like frozen shrimp; the batter was very thick, and there was very little shrimp meat. The shrimp roe on top had a stronger-than-usual smell.
Watermelon Smoothie: Not too sweet, with watermelon pieces on top. It was refreshing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawonwan “Nikki”

sample_reviews_en.text:
Currently, SCB (CardX) is running a promotion with On the Table. If you spend 500 baht or more, you can get a Parma Rocket Truffle Pizza at 50% off, from 380 baht down to 190 baht.
Today I ordered the Popeye & Olive pizza for 280 baht.
(It's a pizza where half is spinach and cheese, the other half is mushroom and truffle sauce).
Both pizzas were delicious; the crust was thin and crispy.

I also ordered the Australian Beef Grilled with Jaew Sauce, medium rare, for 390 baht. The meat was tender and had a nice charcoal-grilled aroma.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thananont Krittayawiwat

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a fusion restaurant offering Thai, Japanese, and Western dishes. The flavors are moderate, suitable for both children and adults. Today, I had a set meal for 888 baht, which included pizza, baked clams with garlic, salmon salad, and pork curry rice with a hamburger. I also ordered two additional dishes: spaghetti and fried calamari. There was also a promotion to order dessert for 100 baht. The prices are typical for this type of restaurant, ranging from mid-range to slightly high.
sample_reviews_en.author: LittleVictor & Daddy (vOonY)

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant offers a diverse menu featuring Western, Japanese, and Thai cuisine, bringing together delicious flavors all in one place. Almost everything is delicious, and the prices aren't too high. The quality of the food is excellent, and they often have great promotions. The restaurant has multiple branches, making it easy to find, and the service is outstanding, from the welcoming atmosphere and food recommendations to every aspect of the service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brownie

sample_reviews_en.text: I've liked coming here for a long time. The kids love it, especially the playground in front of the restaurant. My younger sibling loves the pizza here. I always order the teriyaki tofu rice. The atmosphere is always nice, the staff are always attentive, and it's clean. The membership card is great value. Personally, I like the vegetarian menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: K Uras

sample_reviews_en.text: It was OK, but not much beyond that.  The set up is nice, although the chairs we had made me slide forward.  Service was good, like it is at all these upscale sort of places.  Food was the only disappointment.  The sushi roll was lackluster, and the pasta was a short step up from the 40 baht pasta at 7-Eleven.  I won't be returning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bob D

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were inattentive. We sat and waited for a very long time. No one came to check on us or bring us a menu, even though the restaurant wasn't full; there were only two other tables occupied. This needs improvement. I was very disappointed. In short, we waited and didn't get to eat. We couldn't wait any longer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pijika Tatiyarat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food variety is very good.
But overall, it's not great.

I saw many kids liking it and having their parents bring them (I saw a lot of them).

The portions are small.
Specifically, several ingredients weren't good.
The meat was too tough, and the fried rice was strange.

The staff lacked experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisby

restaurants.name: Jae Fhai Moo Kra Ta
restaurants.address:

174, 2 Soi Chok Chai Ruam Mit, Ratchadaphisek, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The (not so) small pork BBQ set is 350฿, but it lives up to its name. It's more than enough for 3 people (including drinks, only 400฿ total) because the vegetables, instant noodles, glass noodles, and corn are all buffet style. The broth is rich, flavorful, and delicious, and the dipping sauce is amazing. If you're waiting in line at Auntie Tue's for a long time, this is a great place to tide you over. Highly recommended!!!
sample_reviews_th.author: Keetasil Saekhang

sample_reviews_en.text: There are two sets of Thai-style BBQ pork to choose from: a small set for 350 baht and a large set for 550 baht, which includes a mix of pork, liver, squid, and crab sticks. Individual plates of various ingredients are also available for 100 baht each and can be ordered separately. The restaurant has a nice atmosphere with plenty of fans for good ventilation. I requested a set with only pork belly. The staff provided good service. The restaurant also offers a buffet of various vegetables such as carrots, enoki mushrooms, shredded cabbage, water spinach, and pre-boiled corn. Instant noodles and glass noodles are also available for self-service; you can take as much as you want. There are three types of dipping sauces, and mixing them together is delicious. Overall, it's delicious and worth the 380 baht I paid (including a large bottle of water and the small BBQ pork set).
sample_reviews_en.author: NWD

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! My friend really liked the vegetable buffet (she's a big eater!). The fermented tofu dipping sauce was great, and the other sauces were also delicious. It was even better than some famous restaurants with marinated pork belly – the marinade was perfect, like the kind you find in restaurants in the provinces, hard to find in Bangkok! (But I would like to suggest that the restaurant improve the restroom. It was a bit scary at night and I didn't dare go in 🥹)
sample_reviews_en.author: naphat poonyakanok

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went for the buffet yesterday and it was really good. 149 baht, limited time only. The pork was really good. I saw the sign for CP pork and it was better than any other barbecue I've had before, and it wasn't as good as this. There was also Wall's ice cream, my favorite flavor: Rainbow. It was really good. I wasn't disappointed. 149 baht is hard to find anywhere else. This quality is beyond my expectations.

I've been eating here for a long time because it's close to home.
sample_reviews_en.author: G G

sample_reviews_en.text:
📍 I found this restaurant while waiting in line for Auntie Tue's fried noodles. I wasn't expecting much from it at first, but it was delicious! The sauce was amazing, but a bit spicy.
💰 Under 500 baht
🚗 Parking is available at the market before the restaurant. Parking is 50 baht per trip.
✨ Overall, I liked it. If I ever pass by, I'll definitely stop by again. You can get your own vegetables, glass noodles, instant noodles, and corn.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rose

sample_reviews_en.text: No matter how many times I go there, I still like it. The small set of grilled pork costs 350 baht, but they give you a lot. You can scoop up vegetables all you want. The sauce is delicious. It's not better than before, but it's still delicious. Just add chili and it's spicy. The soup is delicious. I like that the restaurant seems to take care of the orderliness and cleanliness, making it a nice place to sit.
sample_reviews_en.author: อัง เปา

sample_reviews_en.text: This used to be my regular restaurant when it lived in this area. I came back today and was surprised by how crowded it was. I thought people were waiting in line for the BBQ pork restaurant, but no, they were waiting in line for Auntie …
sample_reviews_en.author: Air-Wilailux Wanngern

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork barbecue is sold as a set, with a buffet of vegetables and noodles. Personally, I found everything to be too sweet: the pork, the soup, and the three dipping sauces. All three were too sweet, so they weren't to my liking.
sample_reviews_en.author: JCXXIV

restaurants.name: Thai Street Food Place
restaurants.address:

133 Asok Montri Rd, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited for breakfast while staying near Asok.

It is a local restaurant offering the best value for money, where you can enjoy rice, three side dishes, and one soup for just 80 baht—less than 100 baht.

It operates in the style of a typical Thai buffet breakfast; you simply tell the owner what you want, and they will serve it to you along with the rice.

I requested three side dishes: morning glory, stir-fried eggplant, and stir-fried pork. Since they had soft tofu soup with cabbage, I added one more.

Choosing the soft tofu soup with cabbage was a stroke of genius; it was delicious, and the other side dishes were just as tasty as those found in expensive Thai restaurants.

You can observe the cooking area, which is hygienic, and you can also enjoy other dishes, such as pork knuckle rice, in the same space.

If you are staying near Asok, I highly recommend stopping by for a meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: 박병윤

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a local eatery. It's rare to find a place where you can eat a meal at this price in this location.

The system is one-plate, where you put the side dishes on top of the rice. It's similar to Indonesian Nasi Campur.

When you go to the ordering counter, they'll ask if you want to eat in or take away. Then you just point to the side dishes you want from the display and choose 1-3 items. They'll put the side dishes on top of your rice, you pay, and you're done.

There are lots of fried eggs at the payment area, and you can point to one of those for an extra 10 baht. Three side dishes plus a fried egg would be 70 baht.

I used it for breakfast two days in a row. I chose different side dishes each day, and they were all delicious.

If they were open in the evenings, I would definitely go there for dinner too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Semper Fi

sample_reviews_en.text:
This local food court in Bangkok, Thailand, is about a 10-minute walk from Asoke Station. Rice is served on a plate and you can add your favorite side dishes on top. One side dish costs 40 baht, two sides 50 baht, and three sides 60 baht. I wanted to order curry, but they said it was very spicy, so I ordered stir-fried broccoli and carrots and crispy pork. It wasn't spicy, but had a strong flavor and was delicious. 👍
They speak a little Japanese and a little English, so I was able to order what I wanted with peace of mind.
I don't have a sensitive stomach, so I didn't get an upset stomach, so I think it's hygienic, but do it at your own risk. 🖐️
sample_reviews_en.author: K K (きなこ)

sample_reviews_en.text: This place open its shutters at 4am for food prep and start serving only after 5 ish. There are 6 individual stalls, one selling drinks. For tourists its best to come for breakfast or brunch as the office workers start pouring in around 11am- 1.30pm it can get super crowded. By 2pm the stall selling different main & side courses to go with rice have not much left. We had the Kway Chap which is the Pork meat & offals with rice noodles, really tasty. But if business is good that day, there isn’t much left so no point going after 2pm. Food is as local as you can get, tasty and cheap.
sample_reviews_en.author: Evelyn Lau

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had salted fried noodles for 30B (plus an extra 10B fried egg) and stir-fried water spinach for 20B. For a total of 60B, it was the best value for money.

It was kao gaeng (rice topped with rice), so basically you top your rice with your favorite side dishes from over 20 options.

Selecting the side dishes with your eyes makes your mouth water just imagining what they'll taste like. It's so much fun choosing your side dishes.

The side dishes are pre-made, so I wouldn't recommend it for people who are concerned about hygiene. But I think this is the true essence of Thai food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Syo Kei

sample_reviews_en.text: A small food hall with delicious home cooked Thai food. Many different options of food. We tried the Chinese noodles as well as rice plate with curry, fried fish, fried chicken, and vegetables. All were fresh and excellent. There is even a drink stand where you can buy Thai tea, chrysanthemum tea, and Thai coffee. Extremely affordable as well. 50-100 baht per dish. There are fans so there are minimal bugs however there is no AC so can be a little hot and humid inside. Still worth the visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jane Tran

sample_reviews_en.text:
Koreans, you absolutely MUST go~~ Go twice^^

I had the Chicken, Morning Glory, Pad Krapow Moo Sap, and a fried egg, and they were incredibly delicious. The prices are also affordable.

If you drizzle the Nam Prik sauce with spicy chili peppers over the food, it tastes absolutely insane.

If I had stayed for three days, I would have gone three times.

I only went twice because I moved hotels, though...

It is the best local restaurant that has it all: great value, friendliness, and taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: funny life

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came to Bangkok for sightseeing.

This place was close to my hotel, within walking distance.

I visited at 7 AM, and most of the customers were locals. The taste suited Japanese palates, and they kindly explained which dishes were spicy. The prices were also very reasonable.

I recommend it if you want to experience the local atmosphere of Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: kazu shino

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวต้มยำ ป้าแตง
restaurants.address:

6 9 Chakkraphatdi Phong Rd, Wat Sommanat, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Aunt Taeng's Tom Yum Pork Noodle Soup is delicious without needing any extra seasoning. Both the soup and dry versions are available. Freshly sliced ​​lime is squeezed into each bowl. The boiled pork is lean and cut into large pieces, and the minced pork is tasty and not in hard clumps. The broth is flavorful. It's very popular, and sometimes they sell out in the early afternoon. They also have pork offal. Closed on Sundays. 😋😋😋😋👍 The shop is located opposite the Nang Loeng Police Station. If you're coming from Ratchadamnoen, pass the boxing stadium intersection, find parking (on Saturdays), and then walk a short distance to the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Montree T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Aunt Taeng's Tom Yum Pork Noodle shop is located opposite the Nang Loeng Police Station. It's an authentic, old-fashioned Tom Yum pork noodle soup. The toppings include boiled pork, blanched liver, minced pork, and fish cake. They offer both soup and dry versions; you can request bone broth for the dry version. They use real lime, the pork and liver are tender and not chewy, and the Tom Yum flavor is excellent. Expect a wait around lunchtime as it's busy. The liver pieces are large, not bitter or tough – absolutely delicious! If you're in the area, give it a try.

A truly delicious noodle dish...
sample_reviews_en.author: Atsaneewan Pimwanwong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tom Yum Pork Noodle Soup - 5-star taste!
Large, tender chunks of boiled pork.
The pork liver is boiled whole and then sliced, resulting in a smooth texture.
The seasoning is perfectly balanced.
If you go at lunchtime, you'll have to wait about 45-60 minutes because they prioritize serving customers at offices first. The shop serves customers in order of reservation, but there are always plenty of customers waiting.
If you go at 1 PM, you might not get to eat because they'll be sold out.
Pork noodle soup lovers must try this!
sample_reviews_en.author: Soottipong Winyoopradist

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tom Yum Pork Noodle Soup: The tom yum broth is already seasoned to perfection, with a fragrant lime aroma. Delicious whether served as noodle soup or dry. Contains both sliced ​​and minced pork. Served with a flavorful broth and pork bones.

It gets crowded at lunchtime, so you might have to wait for a table.

Parking is difficult in this area; you might need to park further away and walk. Most of the customers are people who work or live in the vicinity.
sample_reviews_en.author: puddee boonnak

sample_reviews_en.text:
Original style pork noodle soup (Yentafo/Tom Yum).

The thin noodles are excellent, soft and delicious.
The Tom Yum soup has a nice aroma from the fresh lime juice and a satisfyingly sour taste (but they add a lot of sugar).

The Yentafo is plain.

The crispy wontons are plentiful and very good.

Overall, it's good and something you could eat repeatedly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Unexpert

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles are delicious, flavorful, and the portions are generous. Importantly, they give everyone a free bowl of pork bone soup. If you come around lunchtime, it will be a bit crowded, but the wait isn't long because they prepare the food quickly. This is a highly recommended noodle shop in this area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Euakan Chumdee

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is delicious and flavorful, a little too sour, thanks to the use of fresh lime. The service is good, but it can be slow and there might be a long wait if there are many takeout orders. Customers dining in also have to wait in line until their takeout orders are completed.
sample_reviews_en.author: นภดล มนตรี สํานักทันตฯ

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been a customer since the auntie's stall was located near the Nang Loeng Police Station. I've been eating there for probably 10 years or more. The tom yum soup is always flavorful. Most recently, I tried the tom yum set with the broth …
sample_reviews_en.author: Joe Tanta

restaurants.name: Fickle Lifestyle
restaurants.address:

545 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Chan Kasem, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for a unique, hands-on experience while exploring the city, look no further, visit ‘Fickle Lifestyle’. Their selection of activities are impressive, and it's the perfect place to unleash your creative side.

One of my favorite activities was tufting, where I got to make a beautiful rug. The process was easy to follow, and the staff was patient and helpful throughout the experience. I was thrilled with the final result and can't wait to display it in my home.

In addition to tufting, the craft art place also offers other exciting activities such as candle making, splash painting, bag making, and lamp making. Each activity is unique and provides an opportunity to tap into your artistic side.

What's more impressive is that all the materials you need are provided, making it a perfect way to spend a few hours exploring your creativity. You can even take your completed masterpiece home with you as a reminder of your experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sheen Skaria

sample_reviews_en.text: I really love this place. I've attended various workshops here, and every time I had a great experience. The first time, I went to a painting workshop where you could throw paint, choose different types, and mix everything you needed. They provide all the necessary tools and clothes, and it was so much fun, very expressive. They let your painting dry, and you can pick it up the next day. I also attended a rug-making workshop where you choose your own design, and they help and teach you how to weave rugs. It was also very interesting, and the result was beautiful. The only thing is that it’s quite hard, so you need strong hands. They have a lovely cat that’s very sweet and affectionate, and the girls who work there are very kind and attentive. I definitely recommend visiting this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna Rodina

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very disappointed.
This was our second time doing splatter art. The paints have either been thinned or the brand has been changed...everything was just drippy. This was definitely not the same paints as before. They also didn't have many of the most basic colors ...royal blue, dark green...
The first time we were here was simply super! Wish they go back to the same quality as before. We love this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Priti Mehta

sample_reviews_en.text: We did the silver workshop, I made a ring and my partner and I really enjoyed the workshop, we had to wait for the silver to dry and to fire so they let us decorate some cookies while waiting but I do wish they included us in the firing process but other than that I would happily do the workshop again! It was so satisfying and the team they have there were all great! Thank you fickle lifestyle!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ilaw Ayuka

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop is located in Soi Ratchada 14, about 250 meters in. It used to be a hotel that has since closed down. The interior is divided into two sections: one is a cafe, and the other is for various activities such as scented candle making and essential oil workshops. The activities change regularly, making it ideal for families to enjoy together.
sample_reviews_en.author: Smith Smith

sample_reviews_en.text: Something different to do in Bangkok during the weekend 😊 The staff were super helpful and they meant it when they told us we don’t need any prior tufting experience at all 👍🏻Super helpful staff, great ambience, and reasonable pricing 👌🏻 Would come back again for another activity soon!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kunn Tansuhaj

sample_reviews_en.text: We had the best time here! Everyone was so lovely, friendly and patient, and we got to interact with all instructors, as they guided us along and helped us throughout the process. Thank you so much ladies! And there was a little kitten who’s so adorable too, loved loved loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Joline Lee Terrell

sample_reviews_en.text: Great! I did a DIY keychain workshop at Fickle today and it was amazing! So much fun! Even without any artistic background, you can do it. The staff were great, giving great guidance and teaching the basics in a very easy way. I want to come back and try all their activities!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sky Blue

restaurants.name: Baan Rongmai Cafe & Homestay
restaurants.address:

59 7 Phetchahung Rd, Tambon Bang Kobua, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I went based on reviews, and we sat in the cafe first. The owner or staff, I'm not sure which, was talking very loudly with an acquaintance in the cafe, showing no consideration for the customers sitting there. Even though there was only one table occupied, their conversation was so loud it sounded like there were no customers – like they were shouting at each other. I initially planned to paint and kayak afterwards, but that plan was abandoned. It felt like they didn't even acknowledge the customers. I wouldn't recommend the freshly squeezed orange juice; it was like they just poured boxed juice over ice – not even a single orange zest! Very unimpressed, especially since I had planned this trip so much.
sample_reviews_en.author: lee than (leerize)

sample_reviews_en.text: The male receptionist provided good service. However, in the cafe, I ordered an espresso and requested it unsweetened, but received one with 20% sugar. When the staff responded, they used a harsh tone with the customer. I recommend that you (staff are the face of the shop) – no matter how nice or good the shop is, if the staff are like this, customers won't come. The food I ordered didn't match the picture; it showed cheese tofu, but I received egg tofu. The menu only listed tofu. The owner was responsible, but the staff who made the mistake should be taught to apologize to customers. I drove 70 kilometers to this shop, and honestly, I was very disappointed. (Please train the staff at the bar as well.)
sample_reviews_en.author: นรารัตน์ เครืออยู่

sample_reviews_en.text:
Baan Rong Mai Canal Front: A Natural Retreat in Bang Krachao

Baan Rong Mai Canal Front offers a serene escape in the lush greenery of Bang Krachao. This beautifully designed wooden homestay blends traditional Thai architecture with modern comfort. The open spaces and large windows connect guests with the surrounding nature, creating a peaceful and relaxing atmosphere. Activities like cycling, kayaking, and exploring the local community enhance the experience, while the on-site dining provides delicious Thai meals with stunning canal views. Perfect for nature lovers seeking a tranquil getaway, Baan Rong Mai promises a rejuvenating stay in Bangkok's "Green Lung."
sample_reviews_en.author: Korn Voravarn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Baan Rong Mai Cafe & Restaurant is a renovated old wooden house that has been converted into a restaurant and homestay. It offers kayaking 🛶 and other interesting activities, making it ideal for group trips or family outings.

The food is delicious, using high-quality ingredients. Everything we ordered was tasty, but we highly recommend the hot pot Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup)!
The drinks, including coffee and other beverages, weren't particularly outstanding (in my opinion).

There are animals on the premises, which are fun for children to watch. The atmosphere is great, and the water is clean and clear for kayaking. The staff are attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lee Archi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted good, but today, we came as a group of three and ordered three individual dishes plus a Yen Ta Fo hotpot. The food arrived quite slowly, with about 10 minutes between each dish, causing us to finish eating one person at a time. The Yen Ta Fo hotpot arrived last, after everyone had finished their main dishes, even though the restaurant wasn't busy. I would like the restaurant to improve the food service order to ensure everything is served more evenly.

Thanks again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tata Kamp

sample_reviews_en.text: If you want to know how thai people enjoy life come to this place. The hospitality, the food, and the atmosphere are 10 stars 🌟The hosts are so gracious (even pick me up in the rain when i got lost) The room designs are wonderful, skylight over the spa tub during the rain so relaxing. Biking to the botanical gardens, kayaking in the canal, the local night market. Was so nice to get away from the hustle and bustle of the city. Thanks again! Will definitely be returning 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Shawn Murphy

sample_reviews_en.text:
The place is located by the water and offers many activities.
Kayaking is 200 THB for 2 people per hour.
The staff are friendly and helpful.
There is seating inside and outside the cafe. The cafe has only a few tables.
There is parking available, but not a lot, and the entrance is quite narrow. Long cars will get their parking sensors beeping all around! 5555
But the atmosphere is great because it's right by the water. Recommended for those who want to relax in nature.
sample_reviews_en.author: Momo Jung

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been there. The food was delicious, but the service was extremely slow due to insufficient staff. The restaurant promoted a "Thai Help Thai" campaign, but upon arrival, they said their phone was broken and they couldn't use the app, and they didn't inform customers beforehand. As a result, I had to pay the full price for the food. I recommend avoiding going on weekdays because the restaurant isn't fully prepared to provide good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phichayada M

restaurants.name: ร้านฝน ซีฟู๊ด
restaurants.address:

752 Bang Khun Thian-Chai Thalae Rd, Tha Kham, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've tried every restaurant in Bang Khun Thian, and this is the one I finally settled on.
At least it showed me that there are still restaurants in Bang Khun Thian that are delicious, clean, affordable, have genuine service, and amazing dipping sauces.

I almost gave up on Bang Khun Thian until I found this place.

Keep up the good work! I'll be a regular customer.

This is the first time I've seen a restaurant that scrubs the cockles with a brush until they're sparkling clean before blanching them, not just rinsing them briefly and throwing them into the pot.

The grilled prawns were perfectly cooked, with juicy heads, and the price was excellent. Even the small size I ordered was delicious.

The scallops were fresh, fragrant, and grilled with butter – highly recommended!

The squid was incredibly fresh, tender, and bouncy. Other expensive restaurants in the area used to serve frozen squid that was tough and thin.

And of course, the seafood dipping sauce is the best! Packed with ingredients, very fragrant, and served in a clean bottle.

Overall, I was very, very impressed. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalit Sawangpol

sample_reviews_en.text: I recommend Fon Seafood Restaurant. The food is delicious and affordable. The owner cooks everything herself, catering to customers' preferences for how well-done they want the food. It's better than some famous restaurants where not everything is delicious, but this one, I can tell you, everything is delicious and the prices are impressive. It's a small restaurant with only a few tables, perfect for those who don't prioritize ambiance but focus on fresh and delicious food.
sample_reviews_en.author: คนแซ่ตรง

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small restaurant that I truly want to recommend.
I'm impressed every time I visit — I've eaten here about 4 times and have never been disappointed. The food is delicious and great value for money. Every dish is worth it. Importantly, the owner takes care of everything personally. You can order whatever you like; they're incredibly friendly.
If you haven't tried it yet, I encourage you to give it a try. I guarantee you won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Napassaporn Puangpong

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and great value for money. It's a small restaurant with good service and fast food. The fried sea bass and crab curry are especially delicious. There are about 8-9 tables. The ingredients are fresh, and there's a restroom. Some tables are located by the water. The prices are very reasonable – cheap and good value. It's a bit of a drive in, but I've been back many times.
sample_reviews_en.author: Im migrant

sample_reviews_en.text: Casual local restaurant with a simple atmosphere. Parking can be a bit tricky, but it’s worth the effort. The seafood is incredibly fresh, and every dish is flavorful. Service is warm and welcoming, especially from the owner’s children, giving it a homey touch. Overall, it’s a definite revisit when craving fresh, budget-friendly seafood—if you don’t mind the modest view.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pomm Koko

sample_reviews_en.text: All the food was delicious and reasonably priced. The service was good; the older staff were polite and spoke well, but the younger staff needed more training in customer service if they wanted to attract repeat customers. Their expressions were stern, their speech was abrupt, and they seemed unwilling to serve. Overall, though, it was OK. I will come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peravit Issaranuwat

sample_reviews_en.text: Let's talk about freshness. Everything is incredibly fresh, even the shrimp marinated in fish sauce is served raw. If you want the freshest ingredients, this is the place to go. The flavors are easy to eat and suitable for all ages. Those who prefer spicy food might need to adjust their expectations, but the ingredients are truly fresh. I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Niran Kulwimol

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the service was good, and the seafood dipping sauce was amazing. The shrimp were large, the blanched cockles were delicious, the fried rice was a very generous portion, and the fried fish was also very tasty. I couldn't finish it all and had leftovers to take home because there was so much food!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ice Ananyaphon

restaurants.name: Somtum Der, Tha Tien ส้มตำเด้อ ท่าเตียน
restaurants.address:

107, Soi Tha Suphan, Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely fantastic experience!
One of the best Thai meals I’ve had in Bangkok. Every dish was full of flavor, beautifully balanced and clearly prepared with great attention to detail. The ingredients were fresh, the seasoning was spot on, and the food felt authentic while still being very refined.
As a chef myself, I especially appreciated the balance of flavors and the quality of the cooking. Excellent food, friendly service and a place I would happily come back to. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: Drobina (Nándor)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The view from the 7th floor is amazing, but the tables are very small, so it's not suitable for large groups, but it's perfect for going with a partner! We recommend arriving before 5:30 to enjoy the sunset here.

The view from the 7th floor is amazing, but the tables are very small, so it's not suitable for large groups, but it's perfect for going with a partner. We recommend arriving before 5:30 to enjoy the sunset here.
sample_reviews_en.author: 陳11

sample_reviews_en.text: We sat on the deck at the rooftop level overlooking the panorama of Bangkok but not exactly of Wat Arun which was disappointing (see picture). We walked 7 floors. Dishes were large in portion therefore value for money. We ate Seafood Krapao, Beef Krapao, Somtam Thai and Pork skewers. All was delicious and worth Michelin mentioning. For us, one time experience is enough. Never try. Never know.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chongcharoen Sornkaew

sample_reviews_en.text: After a sudden downpour nearby, we found this highly-rated restaurant online and decided to give it a try. And the good reviews were definitely well-deserved. The interior was comfortable, and the service was excellent throughout. We ordered several must-try items, and everything was a pleasant surprise – truly delicious, especially the fried chicken! 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Chung Nancy

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered Lobster Pad Thai and a chicken dish. The chicken was a bit cold, which was a shame, but the Lobster Pad Thai was really delicious. I liked that it came with the lobster innards, and all the ingredients in the Pad Thai were tasty. It seems like a decent place worth visiting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Y.J Shin

sample_reviews_en.text:
A random find when we went to Grand Palace and Wat Pho

The food are really great, especially the Tom Kha Gai and Papaya salad with salted egg.

Hope this restaurant chain will come to our country (Philippines) as we do not have a lot of good Thai restaurants here
sample_reviews_en.author: James Carascal

sample_reviews_en.text: Incredible food, incredible view, and incredible service! The food was fresh and delicious and flavorful. We sat on the 7th floor rooftop with a view on wat Arun! Our server, Wan, was soooo nice and attentive and on top of things. Definitely recommend this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: LUCY CALDERON

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious!!

Definitely worth a visit.
I originally just came for a simple meal, but the taste was amazing! Definitely worth a try.
The waiters were very attentive and gentle in explaining everything. The restaurant was also very clean. So delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: 俞曉妘

sample_reviews_th.text: It seems like this branch is getting worse and worse. The wait time is very long, items are incomplete, and it's not clean. The 99฿ salmon promotion, and the glass noodle shrimp, I ordered 5-6 times and waited half an hour, only to get my food twice. I spent over 400฿ but was very upset. They really need to improve.
sample_reviews_th.author: G Ja

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten at the People Park On Nut branch before and the service was excellent. But yesterday, I tried the Samrong branch for the first time and the service was terrible. I asked for chopsticks and waited 10 minutes without getting them. I went back to ask again, and still didn't get them. I had to tell the counter staff that I'd been waiting for chopsticks for 10 minutes and hadn't been able to eat. The staff member who answered the call finally gave me chopsticks. The first two staff members just kept saying "Okay," and asked, "Which table?" The second one said the same thing but didn't provide any. I'm not sure if they were part-time staff or not, but they were so negligent. Other tables asked for chopsticks and got them (from the same staff member). Was it because I was a female customer that they didn't provide good service? I was very upset and I hope they improve. I ate around 7 PM yesterday. If they're not ready to hand chopsticks to customers, they could at least provide them on a surface for customers to pick up themselves. The food arrived much faster than I waited for the chopsticks. Also, my order wasn't complete, and they didn't provide all the necessary utensils.
sample_reviews_en.author: So Ney

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible service. I ate there on January 27th, 2026 at 8:40 PM. There were empty tables, but the staff made us wait. When it was our turn, they called us and seated us at a table that hadn't been cleared yet. We waited for almost 15 minutes. We ordered, but didn't receive our food and had to keep asking. Two other tables waited just as long, finishing their first order and waiting another 15 minutes or so for their second meal. The table next to us, who arrived more than 10 minutes after us, waited for almost half an hour and still hadn't received their food. It was awful. They'll probably only get our money once. Other branches are fine, but this one is a no-go. Think carefully before planning to eat here; go to another branch instead. I'd like to pass this feedback on to management. Customers were sitting and waiting for their food to the point of having to leave.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornchai Chamnanwet

sample_reviews_en.text:
This time, they had crispy pork, with a good balance of meat, skin, and fat. The mala soup was flavorful and rich. There were many appetizers 🍟: shrimp dumplings, crab dumplings, fried chicken, and meatballs.
The Australian beef was excellent, and they also had duck. The glass shrimp and peeled shrimp tasted pretty much the same, but the peeled shrimp were bigger. The Cantonese dipping sauce was delicious.
Overall, it met Lucky Suki's standards.

The last time I ate there, the table next to me stole my crispy pork from the robot cat figurine. I was so angry! //Angry at the table next to me (The robot cat figurine ran past our table to deliver something to the other table first, so I saw that there was crispy pork on our shelf. When the robot cat figurine came back to deliver it, the crispy pork was gone, but everything else was still there 😂😂)
sample_reviews_en.author: KhunT

sample_reviews_en.text: We never expected this to happen. We waited for our food for half an hour. I was the only customer, so I wasn't being served properly? They didn't serve the soup, the plates, the food, nothing at all. It was like they only cared for large tables. Even the table next to us, who arrived 2-3 minutes before us, didn't get anything either. We wasted half an hour trying to eat and had to inform the staff and ask for our food. There was absolutely no one to attend to us. This is very unacceptable. And when we did receive our food, it was wrong. They said we ordered something, but there was a receipt, so why didn't they check the order? Luckily, a staff member came and extended the time, but it was still slow and some dishes were missing. We ordered the same menu items at the same time, but only received one item.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chonticha Chanchuer

sample_reviews_en.text:
Review of LUCKY SUKI, Im Samrong Branch (Promotion +39.-)

Visited on January 21, 2026, around 1:30 PM. Not many customers, plenty of empty tables, no waiting in line.

The slushy machine at this branch was broken; we had to get drinks with ice.

- Crispy pork: The skin wasn't puffy, it was chewy and difficult to eat. The meat itself was tender. The ribs had an Indian spiced flavor. The marinated shrimp was delicious; I ate 3 plates, the dipping sauce was rich and flavorful.
- Beef: Two types available. Ordered one plate of each. Received as pictured. Not ordering again.
- Pork: Pork neck was okay. Only one plate of pork belly. Not ordering again.
- Chicken soup: Sour, came with 2 chicken wings. No fried shallots or dried chilies.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sornpapat Papat

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first and last time eating there. The plates were incredibly dirty. I went at lunchtime, and the bowls had bits of vegetables stuck inside and white residue, plus carrot pieces on the outside. It was disgusting. I asked the staff to change the bowls, but they didn't even apologize. The staff dropped the smaller bowls twice, making a loud noise, but still didn't apologize for disturbing my meal. There were tiny earthworms in the cabbage, and the staff didn't check, inspect, or wash them at all. I was very unimpressed with the restaurant and this branch. Compared to other brands, it's a completely different level. And importantly, the lighting was yellowish, and the air conditioning wasn't cool enough – not great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natnicha Salangam

sample_reviews_en.text: Finally, there's a branch nearby, so I don't have to go far to eat. What I like most about Lucky is probably the Cantonese dipping sauce. It's like the most authentic sukiyaki dipping sauce (it depends on the person's preference). Now, there's a choice of Yen Ta Fo soup, and there's also a set of morning glory and shrimp balls served at the table. The food is the same as other branches, but today was a little special, there were jade noodles with pork ribs. A staff member will push a cart to ask about the table, so we brought some to try. The taste is okay (it depends on the person's preference). Overall, I like that Lucky is clean. The food is good enough for us to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittima Areecharean

restaurants.name: Baan Rim Naam Songwat
restaurants.address:

912 Song Wat Rd, Chakkrawat, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Excellent place to wind down for the day, atmosphere was amazing. Sunset was spectacular! Message was great (30min- 300฿). The session can be booked in advanced to align with when the sun is setting, extremely relaxing!
sample_reviews_th.author: v cc

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely loved the riverside vibe at Baan Rim Naam on Songwat Road! The atmosphere was incredibly relaxed—perfect for an afternoon chill or watching the sunset by the Chao Phraya River. The decor is unique and rustic, with floor seating on mats, vintage upcycled furniture, and open-air spaces that make you feel far away from the city bustle.

As for food and drink, there’s a nice selection, and their Thai dishes and coffee are enjoyable (the house blend coffee is a highlight for coffee lovers). Prices are on the higher side, and the flavors cater to a more international palate—so don’t expect super spicy or traditional local style. Service can be a bit slow during busy hours, but the staff is generally friendly, and the overall experience makes up for any wait.

Easy to access via ferry or a short walk from MRT Hua Lamphong, this spot is perfect for a casual meet-up, date, or just a solo moment to unwind by the water. Highly recommended for the ambiance and riverside view—even if the food is not the star, the atmosphere definitely is!
sample_reviews_en.author: DONMAX

sample_reviews_en.text:
Songwat’s renaissance continues and Baan Rim Naan (BRN) is a very nice addition to a once quiet part of the street.

The longish walk down the nondescript alley doesn’t set you up for this beautiful bar/restaurant that awaits. Like its predecessor bar up the road in Talat Noi, this space beautifully combines art, Chinese culture, Thai Sabai sabai furnishings (triangle pillows) and a stunning riverside view.

Customers can even have a massage while lounging on the cushions and mats. We enjoyed sitting on bar stools, watching the cruise boats go by, and staying cool thanks to the river breeze.

This is a great spot to bring visitors and we will try the food next time. Props to the staff who were very friendly and affable - they also informed us that the sister bar in Talat Noi will reopen when structural repairs to the pier are completed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Meng Yee

sample_reviews_en.text: Hidden gem along Songwat Road! Baan Rim Naam offers authentic Thai cuisine in a charming rustic setting right by the canal. The riverside atmosphere is incredibly relaxing — perfect for unwinding after a long day of sightseeing. Food is genuinely delicious, especially the tom yam and grilled dishes. You may try the Miang Kham, snack from Thailand and Laos. Staff are warm and welcoming. Jazz music on weekends adds a wonderful touch. Sitting on floor cushions while enjoying canal views makes this experience truly unique and memorable. Highly recommend for anyone wanting real local Bangkok dining away from tourist crowds. After you walk for whole day in SongWat Road, legs are tired and sore , you may come here to take a rest, Will definitely return!
sample_reviews_en.author: James Eng

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love here sooooo much! There is a tapping massage at 500baht for 30 mins, head neck shoulder massage at 300baht for 30mins and foot massage at 300baht 30 mins. The masseur also friendly with good-handed massage. No jokeeeee! Must try!

We came at 3pm and chill here till 7pm. My mum and i enjoyed the massage here, had a nap, drink some beer on a hot sunny day and relaxingly reading a bit. The staffs here assist on the seating, and they do not disturb any of the customers after that. It was so good here with nice view. Highly recommended
sample_reviews_en.author: Karmen Wen

sample_reviews_en.text:
If your life goal is to snap a few boujee Instagram pics while pretending you live in a Pinterest board—congrats, you’ve made it.

But prepare to sacrifice comfort and sanity. You’ll be sitting on the floor like it’s story time in kindergarten, except now your feet fall asleep and nobody brings you juice. 🧃😩

Oh, and that simple coffee you ordered? Might arrive in 30 minutes… if the stars align.

Aesthetic: 10/10.
Circulation in my legs: 0/10.
Risk vs reward? I’ll take my caffeine with a chair next time. ☕🪑
sample_reviews_en.author: Joseph Farang

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're looking for a new riverside restaurant with a great atmosphere, not far from Yaowarat, I highly recommend this place! It's best to book a table in advance to get a beautiful view. I also suggest coming in the evening when the ambiance is just perfect. The food and drinks menu isn’t extensive, but you can scan the QR code to check what’s available. This spot is ideal for meeting up with friends or a romantic date. Highly recommended! It’s also close to other great check-in spots in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: meevents phuket

sample_reviews_en.text:
Probably our favorite place that we ate in Bangkok. We were recommended to come here by a bartender we met earlier that night. So grateful he told us about it.

The view is stunning and you have to take your shoes off to go up on the deck to dine. Makes it feel much more relaxed and casual, almost like a picnic with your friends by the water.

Literally everything we ordered was delicious. The cocktail was just fine and a bit pricey, but other than that, would be happy to have anything on their menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kayla Hang

restaurants.name: Mountain Camp Mookata (เมาน์เทนแคมป์ หมูกระทะ)
restaurants.address:

285 Chorakhe Bua, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The 199+39 baht buffet included marinated shrimp, but we had to constantly look to see if they'd refill it. There was seafood like cockles, clams, and scallops, but they couldn't be grilled on the regular BBQ grill, so we had to pay an extra 50 baht for a separate grill. That was acceptable, but I have to talk about the BBQ grill. They brought it out, the charcoal was burning too strongly, and after one grilling session, the grill was completely burnt black. We asked for a replacement because it was so burnt, and they charged another 20 baht. I understand the price per person isn't expensive, but there were a lot of unnecessary details. The staff didn't inform us of the rules before we sat down, and they weren't clarified. And the refillable drinks... my boyfriend came just to drink beer, which was 95 baht a bottle, and we still had to pay an extra 39 baht for refills even though we didn't drink any water. In total, two bottles of beer and the buffet for two people cost almost 800 baht. It wasn't expensive or terrible, but we probably won't go back. This is just my honest review.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mamali Mamali

sample_reviews_en.text: My first visit was amazing! Even though I went late, they kept refilling the food. The staff were lovely, provided excellent service with a great service mind – I really appreciate it! The ingredients were high quality; the shrimp was fresh, and the dipping sauces were delicious. The atmosphere was great. I'll definitely go again. I left a little food and asked if they'd charge extra, and they said, "It's just a little bit left, no extra charge!" So sweet! I commend the staff training. I was so impressed with the service that I had to write a review. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Noon Nirarat

sample_reviews_en.text: Exceeded expectations for the price! Came here because of a TikTok recommendation. At this price, it's incredibly good value. The seafood was amazing, and the staff were all fantastic, constantly refilling the food. The dipping sauces were delicious and varied. A great place to relax. Followed the recommendation and came here! The total bill was 238 baht (Thai government subsidy: 95 baht). Unbelievable! The white shrimp were huge, the marinated shrimp was the best, the pork was tender, and the food variety was excellent. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: บ.ใบบิว รีวิวกระจาย (ใบบิว)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Following the hype, wanting to try it out. 199+39
The food on the platter looked good and clean. The shrimp was fresh, the marinated shrimp and mantis shrimp were good. The seafood dipping sauce was slightly bitter. The papaya salad and spicy salad were sweet. I asked the staff and they said the head chef was out. Okay, I accept that. Maybe we went on the wrong day. The fried food and fried rice were dry and hard. We went around 6 PM, it shouldn't have been that hard. But the staff member who served us was very, very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zed 90K
