sample_reviews_en.text: The pork was a bit chewy, but appropriate for the price. The dipping sauce was delicious, and the chicken pops were tasty. Overall, it was good if you're not too picky. I'd like to see improvement in the service; the staff were very slow. I understand it's busy, but I had to keep walking around asking for things. I'd also like them to separate the marinated shrimp from the mantis shrimp, as some people don't like mantis shrimp and have to choose between the shrimp, which is unfair to those waiting in line.
sample_reviews_en.author: wawine

sample_reviews_en.text: This all-you-can-eat Thai BBQ restaurant offers a variety of pork cuts, grilled over charcoal, with delicious dipping sauces and plenty of seasonings. The pork quality is quite good for the price. The food line is extensive, with covered containers for cleanliness. There's a wide selection of snacks, drinks, desserts, and fruit. The atmosphere is nice, beautifully decorated, and perfect for relaxing and enjoying a beer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Momiji Mint

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was fresh, the meat was cut into large pieces, and the flavors weren't overly salty. The shiitake mushrooms were served in large, whole pieces. The staff provided excellent service, always smiling and cheerful. Most importantly, it's a very affordable buffet. I secretly wondered if the owner could even manage to keep up with the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sareela Sae-Tia

sample_reviews_en.text: The food wasn't fresh, the shellfish smelled rotten and there was no ice to cover it up, and they didn't refill the food. I recommend trying it yourself. Eating around 10 PM, the staff were completely inattentive. People who came based on reviews will be disappointed. Better to go to another restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarinya Rung

restaurants.name: เฝอหม้อไฟ ดานัง
restaurants.address:

177/49 ซอยพระราม2 60 ถนนพระราม2 Samae Dam, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is another favorite restaurant for senior citizens because all the food is fresh, especially the seafood, which they say is very fresh and well-prepared. The prices are reasonable for every dish. The staff provides good service, offers menu recommendations, and is attentive to customers. The cakes are also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: T U

sample_reviews_en.text: This Vietnamese-style shabu shabu offers a wide variety of ingredients including pork, beef, chicken, and various meatballs. The dipping sauce is a sweet, black sauce, and fresh chilies and lime are available to add to your liking, allowing you to adjust the sourness and spiciness to your preference.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sorada Sribunruang

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is practically a hidden gem, tucked away in a quiet alley. The food is delicious, fresh, clean, and made with high-quality ingredients. The dipping sauce is also fantastic and you can mix it yourself.
sample_reviews_en.author: NPS

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the ingredients are of good quality, and the prices are reasonable. It's a small shop, but they maintain a good standard. I've been eating here for many years.
sample_reviews_en.author: PRASONGSOM KOONSOMBAT

sample_reviews_en.text: Fresh ingredients, delicious broth, clean, and reasonably priced. We went with 4 people and ate until we were full for 1200+ baht, averaging 300+ baht per person. Good!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tp Liao

sample_reviews_en.text: Da Nang Pho restaurant in the Rama 2 area offers good prices, a very extensive menu, delicious dipping sauces, a spacious and clean restaurant, and good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: NEST

sample_reviews_en.text: They use very good ingredients, and the prices are reasonable. I loved the Da Nang dumplings. I'll definitely go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattanee Pantanarat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious and good value for money. You should try it.
But the restaurant looked very deserted, not many customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: P. San

restaurants.address:

127-9 Tha Din Daeng 7 Alley, Somdet Chao Phraya, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: They made a mistake by not putting mushrooms in my order. I called to tell the seller, and they just said, "It's just mushrooms." Why would they say that? Will they say "just mushrooms" again next time they sell to me? Is this how you sell things? They put the same ingredients in, but it's not the same as before? Are they trying to take advantage of me and make more profit? They told me to come get a new order, but who wants to waste their time? If their employee made a mistake, they should have returned the item themselves. Terrible service. I don't want to eat at this restaurant anymore; they've made mistakes twice now. Are they deaf, don't they listen, or are they just unwelcoming? They're just selling half-heartedly.
sample_reviews_en.author: bobobobobobobo bobobobobobobo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Updated NOV 2024
I haven't eaten here in a long time.
I miss the hot Vietnamese noodles.
Everything is still the same.

7 years ago
I really like Vietnamese noodles. They're delicious, flavorful, and inexpensive. The grilled meatballs have moved to the next door. They don't only sell Vietnamese noodles. They also sell rice porridge, boat noodles, and crab fried rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sakon Anantachat

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm a regular customer, but today I ordered minced pork stir-fry with less spice to take home. The portion of minced pork stir-fry that came with the rice was surprisingly small. I saw it being cooked in the same pan to be divided into three boxes. I would appreciate it if the restaurant could improve the portion sizes to be more appropriate.
sample_reviews_en.author: sureeporn chakote

sample_reviews_en.text: It's been a long time since I ate at the restaurant, and it was unbearably hot. So hot I couldn't sit still because the fans were blowing incredibly hot air. To make matters worse, the portions were incredibly small; the pork sausage was as thin as tissue paper, and there were only three tiny pieces of bouncy pork. Eating it was stressful.
sample_reviews_en.author: kkt archa

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my go-to Vietnamese noodle soup place; it's the best! They have a variety of dishes, including rice porridge and various salads. They also offer healthy, low-sugar herbal drinks. I tried their bael fruit juice and it was fragrant and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: KuRoMaTee

sample_reviews_en.text: No need to ask anyone famous to come and try it. We have the same mouth. It's awesome, I'm telling you. If you've never tried it, don't judge. There are many menus. It's not just Vietnamese jeep. Dry sukiyaki is also good. No need to wait in line.
sample_reviews_en.author: TAO TANTHADILOK

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop is located in two shophouses on the side of the road, one intersection past Tha Din Daeng Market. This shop has a wide variety of menu items. Recommended dishes include Vietnamese noodles, which are very flavorful and fragrant …
sample_reviews_en.author: toom 93

sample_reviews_en.text:
A roadside stall with average prices and average flavors.

The Vietnamese noodles were delicious and the portions were average, as is popular these days.

The staff were very helpful. They were friendly, attentive, and enthusiastic.
sample_reviews_en.author: chitiwat korawis

restaurants.address:

114 On Nut 65, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: They have fresh coffee, single-dish meals, Thai food, air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned seating, and a playground. It gets quite busy around lunchtime. There are also Chinese customers, who are quite boisterous, but they're not arguing. Speaking loudly is a good characteristic of their culture; they're not shy about speaking softly, which is considered unmanly. However, they don't seem to bother or annoy the locals. Thai people are known for being considerate of others, a quality that Westerners and Chinese people lack.
sample_reviews_en.author: กีรติ บ่อโพธิ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop moved from its original location and reopened as a small shop nearby. Most of the photos are old ones, showing a more spacious shop than it is now.
Old review: Simple à la carte dishes, decent taste. Both air-conditioned and outdoor seating available. Prices have started to get expensive lately.
sample_reviews_en.author: ugrit jong

sample_reviews_en.text: It's fantastic! It offers a great deal of privacy, the staff are lovely and friendly, there's live music on some days, the restrooms are spotlessly clean, there's a fantastic coffee shop nearby, and there are hair salons or massage parlors close by. Overall, it's a top-notch place.
sample_reviews_en.author: ฐานวัฒน์ ศักดาสุรรักษ์

sample_reviews_en.text: Best food I have had in Bangkok. It is a hidden gem and I ate here three days in a row!!! The mushroom soup, cashew chicken and watermelon smoothie was my go-to but my friends ordered other things...all absolutely delicious and the service was great!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason Bender

sample_reviews_en.text: The coffee is good and the service is good, but sometimes the staff are too nosy and try to strike up a conversation, asking personal questions. I'd like to see some improvement in this aspect of the staff's work.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณมน ภัทรกิจธันยกุล (ร้านthegrace)

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the atmosphere was great. However, since we went during lunchtime, the food might take a little longer to prepare. Overall, we were impressed. They even offered free watermelon.
sample_reviews_en.author: MANLIKA KLAISOMBOON

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very nice restaurant. Friendly team and the food tastes very, very good. I enjoy going there.

Very nice restaurant. Friendly team and the food tastes very, very good. I like being there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rüdiger Elsäßer

sample_reviews_en.text: High-quality products, including flower clusters and compressed blocks, at attractive prices. Authorized to sell or process controlled herbs for commercial purposes.
sample_reviews_en.author: แอนนา สมิทธิ์เมธีรักษ์

restaurants.name: บ่อตกกุ้งรุ่งแลนด์พัทยาใต้
restaurants.address:

193/402 m.9 Rungland Village 193/402 ม.9 หนองปรือ บางละมุง, Pattaya City, Banglamung, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited on the evening of December 14, 2023 (Tuesday). This was the first time a Taiwanese person had ventured abroad to fish for shrimp. They brought their beloved fishing rod, a simple rig. There were two hooks on the leader before they even set up the hook. They'd heard that some spots in Bangkok had banned this. Shrimp fishing was 150 baht/hour, just walk straight ahead. Note that this place only opens at 7 PM, they don't open earlier.

They provide chicken hearts as bait, and also provide anti-slip mats and cloths. Basically more considerate than in China 😆 The shrimp were quite large, but the stock was small. There were two Koreans sitting opposite them that day... 1 shrimp caught

7 shrimp caught by myself 😆
Not enough shrimp
3 shrimp sprayed, but the total from the other side is still great 👍
Finally, drinks and food
Beer is quite expensive, 600ml costs 150 baht. Meals are 200 baht all.
I wonder if the price is the same if I catch more than 10 shrimp

That's okay.

The location isn't in the main Pattaya area. Getting here requires a little self-study ability, just a little.
There are so many apps that are so useful in Thailand 👍 I'd consider coming again next time 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: 楊YANG子翰Tyler

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you enjoy shrimp fishing, this is the only place in Pattaya that operates after midnight, allowing you to fish until sunrise the next day.

The shrimp are easy to catch, and you can store any leftovers at the shop for your next visit (I think I still have 7 kg of shrimp left -_-).

The shop has TVs connected to YouTube, a sound system, and karaoke, playing songs from Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, and Thai. You can sing along.

Shrimp fishing is 150 baht/hour, darts are 20 baht/person/round, shrimp processing fee is 200 baht, and food prices are similar to those in the 168 baht/area. Reasonable for a nighttime entertainment venue.

The staff are friendly.

—Written by HUANG, a customer who comes every day in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: 1 Summerplus

sample_reviews_en.text: I had some free time, so a friend came over. Upon entering, they immediately asked how many people were fishing and then provided several shrimp rods without telling me the total cost. They only told me the bill when it was time to pay – that it was for two hours, how many people were fishing, and how much it would cost. From the moment I entered until the end, they never told me the total amount. They only told me at the checkout that there were very few shrimp; they only refilled the line twice in two hours, just a few each time. I don't recommend it. Avoid this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: ax M

sample_reviews_en.text: It was incredibly hot! When I entered the restaurant, the shrimp pond was tiny, completely different from what I'd seen in the photos. The biggest problem was that there weren't many shrimp in it at all. Some buckets hung on the edge, submerged in the water, containing dead shrimp, or at least nearly dead ones. They were put back in periodically, but none of the dead or sick shrimp would bite the bait. I fished for two hours, and my rod hadn't been touched once. The atmosphere was also incredibly stifling; it was a complete waste of two hours.
sample_reviews_en.author: I Wu

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very nice restaurant! It's surprising that there are hardly any customers here; perhaps the place is not very crowded. Nice music, a wonderful atmosphere, and excellent staff. The food was truly delicious. We didn't catch any shrimp, but we ordered a shrimp dish. The cat, Cleo, was very affectionate and sweet.

Live shrimp dishes are sold by weight; each shrimp costs around 110 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miroslav K

sample_reviews_en.text: Went here after reading reviews expecting to eat and have a good time catching shrimp. Service was zero once the poles were set up. No menus, no instructions, no service at all. After an hour of just sitting there without even one bite, we left and were overcharged for the experience. Save your time and money if you're an expat. They are not interested in your business.
sample_reviews_en.author: Carrie Weinberg

sample_reviews_en.text:
A shrimp fishing pond with an air conditioner.
The shrimp are small.

Personally, this is a place where you just drink and chat with your friends, and shrimp fishing is just a bonus.

I released the shrimp on my way back.

I came here by motorbike taxi and twisted my ankle while getting off.

It's a place that holds bitter memories for me.
sample_reviews_en.author: 盆暮Re

sample_reviews_en.text: It was so much fun eating there. Thought we are going to spend only 1 hour there. End up staying for 3 hours because we chat and fish at the same time. Each caught 3, saw them load the pond with a budget of shrimps. I'm not sure about the cost of fishing, because we are traveling and don't have a kitchen, we return everything we catch.
sample_reviews_en.author: J

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and inexpensive. They have rice dishes and rice porridge, with many menu options. Water and ice are self-service. The atmosphere is homey. It gets crowded and chaotic in the evenings. There's no dedicated parking lot, but motorcycles can park in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Moana P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my favorite rice porridge shop.
Delicious, clean, good quality, and inexpensive. They accept the "Kon La Khrueng" (Half-Half) scheme.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aiw Loiilipop

sample_reviews_en.text: There's a wide variety of food to choose from. There's a short wait, but not too long. The prices are affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: jamrad tiramaneekarn

sample_reviews_en.text: Stir-fried jute leaves with minced pork is delicious and affordable. There are many menu options to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: พรพิไล ฐิติสรเสริญ

sample_reviews_en.text: OK, it's usable. The price is reasonable. The food is sometimes delicious, sometimes not. It's just some days.
sample_reviews_en.author: สมชัย ตั้งกุญแจทอง

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant serves delicious food, especially their vegetarian dishes; they are truly outstanding.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nont P.

sample_reviews_th.text:
กุ๊กเด่น อาหารตามสั่ง

Only by following the teacher can you eat at these street food stalls in Thailand.

Cheap and delicious #SeafoodEggFriedNoodles #KaleFriedPork

I have to say, Thai street food is really reliable.

90% of the food is delicious and inexpensive.

I think the cleanliness is already excellent.

#Thailand #Travel #yokodaily #yokotravel #attractions #travel #tour #gurume #b-gradegurume #delicious #Bangkok #ThaiFood #SeafoodFriedNoodles #EggNoodles
sample_reviews_th.author: Yoko日常

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Thai restaurant located in Soi12,
if you are a foreign tourist and don't want to walk anymore in the hot weather,
everything is appropriate.
The price, at least for foreign tourists, is not expensive, and the water is only 10 baht because foreigners don't like free water.

By the way, if you can walk a little longer and want to eat among the locals in a real local restaurant, it's a good idea to challenge soi10, soi5.
The price is more than half the price, and there is even free water that locals drink. Of course, if you want your own water, it's 10 baht in any restaurant.

Good luck ~~~
sample_reviews_en.author: Tony

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered pork fried rice, which was delicious. There were no prices listed on the wall, and the bill came to 80 yuan, which was incredibly cheap, especially since I was so full. The staff provided excellent local service; if you smiled, they would smile back. After our meal, we ordered drinks from outside, which were a first for me – too sweet for me! But that's the point of traveling – to immerse yourself in the local culture and try new things!
sample_reviews_en.author: 貓頭鷹

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had Khao Gapao Kai Dao Duay for the first time at a regular restaurant near my hotel. The rice was about the size of two bowls, and the taste of the gapao moo sap felt a little weak. 
The portion of rice was so large that I ordered another Kai Dao and finished it all. I was full, and I think 70 THB was good value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mikisan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chanced upon this place while walking down the street from the hotel that I’m staying.

We ordered pork basil rice and fried egg, a bowl of noodles with pork blood cake and a morning glory on the side. Pork blood cake is fresh. Portion is big.

Old school vibes with good food, bang for a buck! Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kel P

sample_reviews_en.text:
A street corner resturant with some really good food where you mostly find locals go.
The service is quick and the staff is friendly and fast to take your order. The menue contains most of the traditional Thai disches and the pricing here is very good in comparasing with many other resturants in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mikael Jeppsson

sample_reviews_en.text: Came here for breakfast and ordered 2 pad kra Pao moo, expecting it to turn up with minced pork and a fried egg like usual. Was served sliced pork and no egg instead. The meal was still tasty overall and the pork was well fried, but left me disappointed and wanting more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jacob So

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a small restaurant with surprisingly great flavor. My first visit was unintentional, but I was pleasantly surprised by the chef's skills. They offer a wide variety of dishes, from basic Thai dishes like fried rice and noodles to …
sample_reviews_en.author: Isra Weeraratna

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tom Yam soup made with REAL LIME, not lime juice 🤩

The main difference is that those cooked using lime juice makes your throat dry and may irritate it. However with real limes, you'll realise you can't stop raising up your spoon, mouth after mouth.

My go-to combi everytime I'm here is Fried rice with Crispy Pork (Khao pad moo krob + Tom Yam soup) under S$5.

It's very homely, it's very comforting, it's just very mom-cooking style but properly done.

So if you're visiting Wat Rakang Kositaram or happen to be nearby, drop them a visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Soh Jun Xing

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to order food to offer to monks at Wat Phraya Tham. I didn't make a reservation in advance, meaning I didn't need to make a reservation. It just so happened that there were only one or two people in line, I can't remember. The lady cooks the food quickly, puts it in a box, and is ready to offer to the monks. The crispy pork looks very delicious. The red pork rice looks delicious too. The lady also added an egg for me without charging extra.
sample_reviews_en.author: nantawan h

sample_reviews_en.text: We have a regular menu, which is stir-fried minced pork with basil and fried egg, stir-fried morning glory with crispy pork, and dry wontons with red pork and crispy pork. I'd like to say that it's really delicious and highly recommended. In this area, no one doesn't know about Jae Dong, a la carte food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jungko Harajuku

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the portions are generous. The crispy pork is a must-try; it's incredibly crunchy. I highly recommend the crispy pork! Auntie Dong provides excellent service and prepares the food quickly. It's located along Arun Amarin Road, at the entrance of Soi Arun Amarin 16.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutnachon

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes great, and the portions are appropriate for the price; some days they give so much that I can't finish it all. The owner is lovely. If you're visiting Wat Rakhang for merit-making, you can stop by and eat here. It's located at the entrance of Soi Arun Amarin 16.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nongchanok Sittipatee

sample_reviews_en.text: The crispy pork at this shop is delicious. It's freshly fried and stays crispy for a long time. I especially like the crispy pork stir-fried with chili and salt. It's located at the entrance of Soi Arun Amarin 16. If you're visiting Wat Rakhang, you can try this shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: supimpisa neetithammakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted great, especially the crispy pork – it was incredibly crispy! The prices were reasonable, the portions were just right, and the service was good. Overall, if I'm in the area again, I'd definitely stop by to eat here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: ART QCM

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious! Our go-to dishes are stir-fried kale with crispy pork and rice with a fried egg, and creamy tom yum soup with mixed seafood. Come and try it! The prices are affordable, and the portions are generous. 😘😋
sample_reviews_en.author: รุ่งกานต์ ภูมิสถาน

restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Great food, nice atmosphere and wasn’t overpriced."

sample_reviews_th.text: NICHE @ Siam Kempinski Hotel offers fusion cuisine. The food is tasty, with prices ranging from ฿xxx to ฿0,000 depending on the menu. 4 stars!
sample_reviews_th.author: Chaiwat Puchthongchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the most satisfying restaurants, offering both delicious food and an excellent atmosphere.
Niche Siam Kempinski is located in the luxurious hotel behind Siam Paragon. The restaurant's atmosphere is elegant and inviting, and the staff are welcoming and provide excellent service. We started with Wagyu Beef Tataki, featuring fresh Wagyu beef seared on the surface for a fragrant aroma, sliced ​​into thick, tender pieces. It was served with a tangy Ponzu sauce and spicy wasabi, along with crispy fried lotus root. We also had Grilled Wagyu Hanger Steak (I'm not sure which cut it was), perfectly grilled, tender, similar to tenderloin but with a richer beef flavor. It was sliced ​​into bite-sized pieces and seasoned with salt to enhance the beef's taste.
We finished with ice cream and a hot americano, which had a thick, creamy brown crema and the fragrant aroma of medium-roasted coffee. This restaurant provided a complete and satisfying dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: wichak phijaisanit

sample_reviews_en.text:
‘Edward Kwon in Bangkok’
~Modern Korean Dining~

Experience a 12-course set menu featuring high-end Western cuisine, yet retaining classic Korean flavors. Enjoy both delicious flavors and culinary artistry at the same time.
Created by Chef Edward Kwon and his team of chefs from Busan.

Don't miss out! Available only from July 7th to October 7th.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panatip Boonnil

sample_reviews_en.text:
The whole journey was super good.
1. Starting with the smell, its really good event the food was not in front of us yet.
2. Picture & Presentation are good
3. Taste is really good as well.
4 Staffs are friendly, smiles and always talk with us and always recommend drink paring and the drinks are super nice and match with the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: yongdekfat

sample_reviews_en.text: Waiting is over!! Edward Kwon in Bangkok at Siam Kempinski Hotel Bangkok. All the journey of 12 course so delicious and great balance of taste. Stunning presentation : Simple Luxury but perfect culinary cooking technique. Service staff was excellent. From Busan to BKK now. Don’t miss it before it’s too late.
sample_reviews_en.author: Worapot Phomngam

sample_reviews_en.text: Their pulled pork sliders and their classic margarita were delicious. We didn’t order much as we had eaten a bit at a wedding at the hotel’s ballroom already. However, the Pad Thai at the wedding was so good; therefore, I imagine the Pad Thai at Niche could be yummy too. In case anyone loves to try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tip Jacobsen

sample_reviews_en.text: Beautiful interior, but very limited choice of food, overpriced for what it is and doesn’t taste very good.  Presentation though is on a level. Stuff is friendly. But can’t really recommend for food, for glass of wine in a relaxing and glamorous atmosphere - yes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nathalie’s World

sample_reviews_en.text:
I opened a new experience with Korean Fine dining. Which has chef celebrity from Korea to create the menu as well The appearance of the food looks very appetizing and the taste is good.

The restaurant is at Siam Kempinski Hotel Bangkok. Convenient to travel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanwisa Ongrit

restaurants.address:

Grand floor, Phenix Pratunam (Old Panthip, 1R-08, 604 Phetchaburi Rd, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had an absolutely wonderful dining experience! The hospitality was truly exceptional, making us feel welcome and well taken care of throughout our stay. The Indian food was outstanding—every dish was delicious, authentic, and full of flavor. What impressed us even more was the excellent availability of Jain food, with a wide variety of tasty options prepared with great care.

A special thanks to Sachin Ji, whose warmth, attentiveness, and exceptional hospitality made our experience even more memorable. He went above and beyond to ensure we were comfortable and had everything we needed.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for great hospitality, amazing food, and thoughtful service. We look forward to visiting again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Maniar Associates

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent Indian Vegetarian Restaurant.
Since we eat only vegetarian we looked only for this kind of restaurant and were far from being disappointed.
The taste was awesome, just closing your eyes and you were there.
As always, it is nice to finish with a lassi ;-)
Only point which could be improved, we are not big eaters but still the portions were too small and would have appreciated a little more of  what we ordered.
Still a 5* rating not only for the taste but also for the excellent service provided and welcoming and smiles.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dan M

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at Royal Dosa Phenix, and I must say it’s one of the best Indian restaurants in town! The food quality is absolutely fantastic, and every dish is packed with flavor.

A must-try is their tandoori platter—it's amazingly delicious! The perfect combination of spices and cooking techniques truly brings out the authentic Indian taste.

If you're a fan of Indian cuisine, I highly recommend visiting Royal Dosa Phenix. You won’t be disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Savitree Narula

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best indian i had in bangkok. A small place but the food packs a punch. Full with flovour. We ordered dosa and north indian and we were not disssapointed. Brilliant food. Special mention chef krishna and sachin for the special effort in catering to our needs. I would very highly recommend this place of you craving dosa and North indian food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Abhishek Agarwal

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had been to the Platinum Fashion Mall, Bangkok this month and was searching for a Pure Vegetarian Indian Food and we found a GEM💎….Royal Dosa Phenix…
Do not go by its name…it does serve an authentic Punjabi Food apart from a Dosa!!!
We ate punjabi dishes n they were simply amazing.
Owner and the staff were also very warm, welcoming.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prasanna Sudke

sample_reviews_en.text: "I recently had dinner here and really enjoyed the masala dosa—perfectly crispy and with chatpati chutney. The staff is very polite, and the service was on-time. The atmosphere of the restaurant is very peaceful and clean. If you're a fan of South Indian food, definitely visit here. Highly recommended."
sample_reviews_en.author: kisan Dahal

sample_reviews_en.text:
100% pure vegetarian food.
The north indian food was superb.
Parathas were fantastic. Crispy yet soft.
All sabji was very tasty. They catered specially to our spice level.
Onion pakoda starter was crispy.
The hotel manager Sachin was a great host; catered to all our needs.
Must visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: sam s

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely incredible food, the best we had on our entire trip! We had the paneer butter masala and Mahkni and both were incredible!! The naan, roti and onion bahjis were to die for!! I wish we were able to come back!! Would give 6 stars if I could! 😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Alana Udraufski

restaurants.name: Pho Aroi Home Pro Kanlapapruek
restaurants.address:

604 ถนน กัลปพฤกษ์ Bang Wa, Phasi Charoen, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped by HomePro Kanlapaphruek for some errands and saw this restaurant offering quick, easy lunch options, so I decided to try it. I ordered the braised beef shank pho, and it was delicious! The bowl was large, the broth was flavorful and easy to eat. It was especially good with the vegetables and pho sauce. The portion size was also appropriate for the price. I also tried the Vietnamese steamed rice rolls (Banh Cuon), which were delicious too. The dough was chewy and soft, the filling wasn't overly abundant, but overall it was tasty. The staff provided excellent service, and the restaurant was comfortable. I was much more impressed than I expected and will definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanakarn Limpanapongthep

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant wasn't very crowded, the food came out quickly, and the staff were all lovely and very attentive. The food was delicious; the pho broth was excellent, hot and flavorful. The spring rolls were very crispy and delicious when eaten hot. The shrimp crackers were crispy and fragrant. The banh mi had very crispy yet soft bread, but it's a pity there wasn't more carrot and pickled radish. The iced coffee was strong, and the plum soda was good. I'll definitely be back for a second and third time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suwannee Boonphao

sample_reviews_en.text: For those looking for Vietnamese food, I highly recommend this restaurant: Pho Aroi (HomePro Kanlapaphruek branch). The bowls are huge and satisfying, seasoned with chili sauce, a squeeze of lime, and fresh chilies. Served with dill and basil, it's a perfect combination. The hot broth is filling and delicious. Recommended menu item: Hanoi-style Pork Noodle Soup.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benji Tantrakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The Pho noodles and soup were delicious. The shrimp spring rolls were also tasty, with a chewy wrapper and fresh shrimp. The quality is comparable to good restaurants in Vietnam. The owner is Vietnamese, so the flavors are different from what Thais adapt to their own recipes. If you visit the HomePro Kanlapaphruek branch, I recommend trying it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angkoon Charoenkhum (Char.A)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered beef pho with braised beef shank,
and traditional Vietnamese savory crepes.

The taste was delicious, the beef had no gamey smell, and the crepe wrapper was very soft.

The staff provided excellent service, the atmosphere in the restaurant was okay, and the prices were standard.
I came on a weekday at lunchtime.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuchy Chen

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff provided excellent service. I was strolling around HomePro and decided to stop by for a meal I'd never had before. The soup was delicious, the meatballs were very tasty, and the spring rolls were a bit dry but tasty. My personal favorite was the dessert. It was so delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Eye Bling

sample_reviews_en.text: The pho is delicious, a great Vietnamese dish. The broth is flavorful, the noodles are fresh and good, and the dipping sauce is traditional. Chili sauce and hoisin sauce are also available on the table for you to add as much as you like. The staff provides excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: วสุวัตน์ เมธีวัชรสิริชาติ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The beef pho soup was delicious.
The dish similar to steamed rice rolls was also tasty. The dipping sauce was salty, not sweet, likely in the traditional Vietnamese style.

The prices are quite high, but the taste is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: kimook nt

A late-night rice porridge restaurant perfect for night owls and night owls. The menu offers a wide variety of flavors and is full of flavor. Located on Sukhumvit Soi 71, the food is delicious and highly recommended.

Price: 5/5
Quality: 5/5

sample_reviews_en.author: B. D.

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a beer garden, but draft beer is not available for now. Foods quality is getting worse than before, but the price is still lower than the other beer gardens.  There's a singer singing everyday. If you feel it's too loud then use a table far from the stage.
sample_reviews_en.author: muri

sample_reviews_en.text: Good food and open very late. Rhe location is somewhat odd but not unusual for Bangkok. Right at the road side on Soi 71. Food was great abd not expensive. At least 100 different dishes to chose from. There is also a thai night club connected to the restaurant
sample_reviews_en.author: B Wire

sample_reviews_en.text: This place have local band everyday, enjoyable Thai music, this place open till 3 in normal days. Only 2 beers option available chang and federbu. Overall is Good experience.good music and good service,you must to try this place to enjoy😃and explore ❤️🇹🇭
sample_reviews_en.author: Chona tumulak

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very nice local live music and dining venue. Prices are very affordable and the staff and atmosphere is great.
If you want to have a great time with friends, while eating good food, this is a really good option!
sample_reviews_en.author: Taneli Kallioinen

sample_reviews_en.text: Located in the spacious open space in front of the church building, it's a great place for a group gathering. The menu is in both Thai and English, making ordering a breeze. …
sample_reviews_en.author: YOUNG

sample_reviews_en.text: Good food if you order the right things. Som tam is excellent, seafood is fresh. Extensive menu. Suki seems popular but haven't tried it. Reasonably priced. Live music.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrew Molyneux

restaurants.name: sala rattanakosin eatery and bar
restaurants.address:

39 Tha Tian Aly, Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried to book a table 2 weeks before the trip, they were fully booked, but they said we could go to their rooftop bar instead. So, after visiting Wat Arun, we headed to their rooftop bar right in time for the sunset, only to be told at the door that it was full! Disappointed, I walked to the restaurant and took a chance by asking for a table that was probably reserved for the night but the guests hadn’t arrived yet. I asked while crossing all my fingers and toes. 😅 The hostess, Fern said she could give us an outdoor table, ours for a magical 2 hours and 15 minutes. 😍 That was more than what we needed.

The sunset was downright magical, and the nighttime view over the river? Absolutely fabulous. Drinks hit the spot, food was deliciously yum, and the service? Impeccable. Counting down the days till our next trip, and you bet we'll be reserving ahead of time for another unforgettable experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Loren Pastrana

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff were polite and friendly, especially the young lady who was genuinely warm and welcoming. Her attitude was lovely and much appreciated.

However, the overall service still requires significant improvement... particularly considering the service charge of nearly 600 THB. Unfortunately, the level of attention did not reflect the amount paid.

For example, dishes were served without sharing spoons, used plates were left stacked on the table without being cleared, and dessert was brought out without a spoon, resulting in the ice cream melting before we were even able to enjoy it. These small details may seem minor, but they greatly impact the overall dining experience.

It was quite disappointing this time, as the expectations for a restaurant at this standard are understandably higher.
sample_reviews_en.author: Graiphat Prommusik

sample_reviews_en.text: Really beautiful rooftop bar. We had some good drinks and a few too sweet or too sour. Hit and miss bartender skills. The food brought was good not spectacular. The roof vibe is worth a visit as the music is upbeat fun and views are amazing. Had to wait an extra 35 minutes for our dinner reservation, but can get appetizers at upstairs bar. Dinner was nice traditional Thai food on the outdoor terrace. All in all highly recommended. Must make reservations and be prepared to wait. Nice staff. Not cheap — so those complaints about expensive when you want two beers and order nothing else for a spectacular view with club music and nice seating —well…. You can always get some booze or water at 7/11 and sit on a bench along the river somewhere and play some music on your earbuds :).
sample_reviews_en.author: denisa rafalowski

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had a wonderful dining experience at Sala. We ordered the Som Tam, Pad Thai, spaghetti for our child, and mango smoothies, and every single dish was absolutely delicious. The flavors were fresh, authentic, and beautifully prepared.
The highlight, of course, was the breathtaking view of Wat Arun. Watching the temple from the restaurant created such a memorable atmosphere, especially by the riverside. It was peaceful, relaxing, and truly one of the most beautiful dining experiences we had in Bangkok.
The staff were also friendly and welcoming, making us feel comfortable throughout our visit. If you're looking for delicious Thai food with an incredible view, Sala is definitely a place you shouldn't miss. We would love to come back on our next trip to Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: KYEIN CHUN

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very disappointing dining experience. The food was mediocre at best. The mussels and clams were overly spicy, and many of the shells remained closed, which was concerning. The other dishes were just average and not worth mentioning.

The service was poor throughout the meal. The tables were small, yet the staff simply dropped off the dishes and expected us to make room ourselves. We ordered sparkling water, but no one bothered to open the bottle, and it wasn’t even served with ice.

Between the average food and lackluster service, this place did not live up to expectations. I would not return and would not recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yvette Zhao

sample_reviews_en.text:
The bad things: We order a Italian white wine that was in the dry list. They ask us to taste as usual and guess what, the wine was sweet, I mean very sweet like sangria and was sparkling wine. We don't like that kind of wine so we ask to exchange but it was refuse because she said it was already open. What is the point of tasting then? Since it was a special occasion (it was my honeymoon + my wife birthday) we ask another one. At the end we had to pay for both of them. The food is also okish, it was not worth the price.

The good thing: people are nice, the restaurant is beautiful with a nice view
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuno Costa

sample_reviews_en.text: My family have the amazing dinning experience at sala rattanakosin eatery and bar. The venue is stunning, highly recommend to book the table at 6pm so you can enjoy the sunset during the dinner. The food is high quality, especially the crab apple salad and steaks!! Must go dishes and you won’t feel disappointed. The most important is dining experience and services, Patrick shows his 5 stars hospitality service and recommendations for the food & drinks. We definitely will come back because of the food, view but the most important the services! Lovely night at sala rattanakosin eatery and bar!
sample_reviews_en.author: KITE

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is in a beautiful location right on the water but unfortunately is greatly overpriced. It is one of those restaurants that looks good on the outside but overall was not a good experience because of the food. The food is quite bland and the taste is off. The surf and turf cost $100 but is not worth it at all. The appetizer of salmon over rice is the blandest dish I’ve ever had. I do not recommend this place at all. If you want a meal on the water just buy a river dining tour experience. Do not go here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jayleen James

restaurants.name: กะบับไก่ชีสซอยวัดธรรม
restaurants.address:

WV8X+MMM 296/10ม. 13 Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered sauce but didn't get any. I pressed the "order sauce" button as usual, but I just pressed "no garlic sauce"—meaning no sauce at all. When I called to ask, they said they thought I didn't want any sauce at all. I want to ask why they didn't call if they didn't know. I ended up with dry chicken.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dear Gaming

sample_reviews_en.text: These kebabs are packed with fillings, made with good quality ingredients, and offer a wide variety of choices: chicken, tuna, salmon, and beef. Delivery is available, but it's better to order at the shop for a shorter wait. You can park at Wat Thammasat and walk a short distance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vorawit Thanakarnpanich

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious taste, lots of vegetables, lots of ingredients, good service, always asking even though the shop is busy, riders come to pick up the items, lots of orders, fast work, not a long wait, eat one roll and you're full, can park in the temple next door.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalisa Techawatcharapaikul

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered two pizzas.  Both were good until I took a bite in one slice and found a long black hair.  I will never be ordering from this place again. It’s obvious they don’t use hair nets.  Completely turned me off. Again food was good until that happened
sample_reviews_en.author: Nate Faunteroy

sample_reviews_en.text: The ingredients are clean and quality. Delivery service is available outside the area. Chicken kebab is 60 baht, add cheese for 90 baht, beef kebab is 90 baht. Delicious, clean, and friendly service.
sample_reviews_en.author: wiphaporn Phukjaroen

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and generous portions. Worth every penny. The vendor is lovely. If you're driving and looking for parking, go a little past the shop and turn left to park in the temple.
sample_reviews_en.author: Koong VJ888

sample_reviews_en.text:
This shop is packed with customers and orders from delivery riders.
The food is delicious. I ordered the rolls, and they were packed full of big, satisfying bites.
sample_reviews_en.author: NN 87

sample_reviews_en.text: Best kebab! Not only in Pattaya, but it is one of the best ones I have tasted. The flour is superb. Double cheese beef is a must try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chan B.

restaurants.name: Niwa Cafe By รังนกแลนด์ สาขา8
restaurants.address:

449 Sukhumvit 115, Tambon Thepharak, เมือง Samut Prakan 10270, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This cat cafe/restaurant has a very pleasant atmosphere, complete with a sandpit for children. They serve both Thai and international cuisine. Their must-try items include their thick-crust pizza (an OTOP award-winning product) and their award-winning traditional tea.

Entry to see the cats costs 60 baht per person, which includes a small packet of treats. You can buy extra treats for 20 baht each to show your love to the cats.

Oh, and there's a koi pond! You can feed the fish for 20 baht per container. Koi are slow to sense feeding, so if you feed them sparingly, it won't know. Feed them near the bridge where the water flows to provide oxygen. You'll need to pour more water, like half a container at a time. Definitely worth a visit!

It's a great place to relax and it's close to home. I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Beau Oun

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and affordable. Drinks, whether coffee, tea, or Italian soda, are all under 100 baht, which is great. There are several seating areas, including an air-conditioned room, an outdoor patio, and a shady garden under banyan trees. There's also a cute cat house with several cats. If you come with children, there will be a sandpit, swings, and a slide for them to play on. There's also a small koi pond. Overall, you can come here all day, and it's especially pleasant in the evening in the garden area. The restaurant is easy to find if you're driving; just use Google Maps. There's parking for more than 10 cars at the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanpen Pongkao

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sorry, the famous Pizza is not 5 stars as they wrote on the menus. We ordered large size Pizza when arrived on our table it looks like a small size of Pizza. To much promote with many TV channels. The toppings was made by cheap Bologna. I’m from Europe and ate many Pizza in my life as you can imagine. Plus, I often baked Pizza at home made my own Pizza dough, too. Perhaps, many customers like it, but not for us and for sure not a 5 stars Pizza. As for other food was so so. The service was the best 👍🏻
Thank you for that 🙏🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Inthitra Sirieutiphat

sample_reviews_en.text: A restaurant suitable for children and families. The food tastes good. There is a cat cafe. There is an indoor-outdoor area with lots of seating. There are a lot of holiday people. The staff can be a bit confused. The indoor area makes blended drinks. It is very loud. You can hardly talk to each other. It ruins the atmosphere a bit. But overall, it is good. It is worth coming back. You can also sit in the outdoor area if it is not too hot or raining.
sample_reviews_en.author: Inthira Atama

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant's pizza is delicious, with soft dough and lots of toppings. Everything I ordered was delicious. The atmosphere is nice, with shady trees. There are many seats to choose from, both indoor and outdoor. I came in the evening and the atmosphere was nice, with a cool breeze. It was very enjoyable. There is convenient parking, clean bathrooms, and the staff provided good service. I will definitely come back again. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: K.Kapook

sample_reviews_en.text:
*The atmosphere is nice.
*The food taste has changed a lot.
*The Tom Yum fish soup tasted like bland, very fishy.
*The shrimp in fish sauce had two flavors: very spicy and very salty.
*The papaya salad had a confusing taste.
*The garlic frog was burnt on the outside and mushy on the inside, like it wasn't cooked properly.
*The fried pork intestines with garlic are still delicious.

The food used to taste much better before.
sample_reviews_en.author: uraiwan Sae-lee

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the atmosphere is great. We always come in the evenings when it's quiet and peaceful. There's a wide variety of food and seating options in various zones, including air-conditioned rooms, a garden area, and a children's play area. There's even a cat cafe! But we prefer coming in the evenings because it's quiet and we can enjoy a beer. We've been here more than five times already.
sample_reviews_en.author: ความสุขของฉันคือการท่องเที่ยว

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, there were lots of activities, and the atmosphere was great even at noon – not too hot. There's even a shrine to the Goddess of the Banyan Tree where you can try your luck with the lottery! 🤭 If I win, I'll definitely come back. Overall, it was fantastic!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mari Review

restaurants.name: Kao Na Kai - Talad Noi
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 987 Soi Wanit 2, Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there specifically to eat chicken rice, but they were sold out at 12:30 PM. My question is, was that really the time they should have been sold out? The restaurant's name is "Krom Tha Chicken Rice," and I ate there during normal lunchtime, but they were out.

No problem, since I was already there, I ordered something else. I ordered Yen Ta Fo (a type of noodle soup). I thought to myself, eating Yen Ta Fo at a chicken rice restaurant probably won't be good. You can see from the picture that it wasn't very good. I ordered chrysanthemum tea and asked if it was sweet. The staff said it wasn't. One sip gave me the equivalent of a whole day's sugar intake. That's it for this restaurant. I'm giving it 2 stars because I ate there many years ago. In summary, the chicken rice was good, but everything else... not for now.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nekotama Noom

sample_reviews_en.text: I came to this restaurant after seeing it featured on YouTube. It was a weekday afternoon, just after the peak time, so I was seated right away. Apparently, their rice with thick sauce is famous, and many locals were eating it. However, the YouTube video recommended the Bami Na Gai, so I ordered the noodles instead. I also ordered fried wontons. The Bami Na Gai had a sweet flavor, and the sauce coated the noodles nicely, making it delicious. The fried wontons were crispy and also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: C. Sakaguchi

sample_reviews_en.text: Stunning. Turned up at 130pm on a Saturday and most food had already run out so by chance we ended up eating the Bami na gai which they are apparently known for. And we were so happy that we did. Delicious!! We left with very happy tummies. The food here just leaves you with an amazing natural high thanks to the spices and flavours. Highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julia Ruane

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located in front of the Marine Department, and they serve delicious Khao Soi (Northern Thai curry noodle soup). The taste is great, and the price is reasonable. They also have a wide selection of drinks, including black tea, iced coffee, and chrysanthemum tea.
sample_reviews_en.author: ChubbyArin

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is famous for its Khao Na Gai, but I ordered the Bami Na Gai.
The simple flavor is delicious, with coriander, mild chili peppers, and the mild tasting angkake. And the fact that it's only 50B makes it even better.
I could eat as many bowls as I wanted.
sample_reviews_en.author: 堀田順司

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried Khao Soi for the first time, and since it's a coconut milk-based curry, it was really delicious haha. I like spicy food, so I added tons of chili peppers. Oh, it was 60 baht per bowl, the owner was friendly, and the hygiene was …
sample_reviews_en.author: 김민서

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to Talat Noi Alley and couldn't find a suitable place to eat, so I ended up here (actually, there is a market just a little further up that I could have eaten at, but I went up after eating and found the market there...?). The …
sample_reviews_en.author: Bien

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles are soft and delicious, the shrimp dumplings are amazing, and the char siu pork is tender, fragrant, and uniquely delicious. I ordered the dry tom yum noodles and didn't need to add any extra seasoning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phutthakul Janpakdee

restaurants.name: @friend จุ่มแซ่บ@บางลำภู
restaurants.address:

137 Chakraphong Raod talad ซอย สามยอด Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there because I was craving Jim Jum after a long time.

I ordered the Basil Pork Rice (70 baht) and the Mixed Jim Jum (400 baht).

First up, the Basil Pork Rice! What more can I say? It's delicious.

Make sure to add an egg (25? baht) and try it.

The long-awaited Jim Jum. Seriously, eating hot soup cooked over a charcoal fire in that scorching weather made me sweat profusely.

The broth had cilantro, ginger, and other ingredients, giving it that distinctive Southeast Asian flavor, so it was a bit challenging to cook.

I ended up scooping everything out... but after adding squid, shrimp, chicken, beef, pork, and vegetables and boiling it, the flavors were neutralized, and the broth became slightly palatable later on.

Aside from that, the ingredients were super fresh and tender, the owner was friendly, and the dog was friendly too, so it's a pleasant place.
sample_reviews_en.author: 김YJ

sample_reviews_en.text: I found this restaurant while searching for Jim Jum near Khao San Road. Since it is a dish I had never tried before, it is difficult to judge whether it is better or worse than other places, but it tasted good to me. The ingredients were fresh, and as it simmered, the broth became rich and delicious. I recommend it if you like shabu-shabu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kyunghwa Seo

sample_reviews_en.text:
In our 1 week in Bangkok we have been there already 3 times for lunch (our hotel is near by).  The food is very tasty and well priced.
The beer is a little expensive, but that's ok.

They also offer a laundry service for 50THB per kg.  All washed well, smells nice (not strong).

Will go there again :-)
sample_reviews_en.author: Aivars Anaitis

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing Thai food, prepared fresh, excellent ingredients and really convenient prices as it is off the radar of most tourists. I tried the green curry, pad Thai, red curry, all of them amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Claudio Maldonado

sample_reviews_en.text: Do not get laundry done at this place. It closes without notice and when trying to get it back I was shouted and sworn at. The worst experiences I’ve had in Thailand
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex Duke

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered Pork Sukiyaki but the pork tasted old and smelled quite bad . The owner was  kind enough to made new one but I didn’t have the confidence to eat again .
sample_reviews_en.author: ฟรี ฟาย

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is along a main street, though it is a friendly little place with a wide variety of tasty dish. Prefect for a late dinner and not expensive at all!
sample_reviews_en.author: József Kereszturi

sample_reviews_en.text: LOVE the food! The chicken is perfectly made. I had the fried rice with chicken and an extra egg. Service was very friendly, would definitely recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Marjolein den Boer

restaurants.name: My favorite mango sticky rice(ข้าวเหนียวมะม่วงร้านโปรด)
restaurants.address:

Khaosan Rd, Talat Yot, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: My favorite mango sticky rice is now closed. I started looking for something similar. I wanted the sauce to be sweet and plentiful, and the price to be fair. I usually avoid touristy spots, but my search even took me to Kao San Road. I wasn't expecting much, but it turned out to be delicious and affordable. I'll be back from now on, just outside of the evening rush hours and crowds.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michał Nimiro

sample_reviews_en.text: The lady who makes these delicious sticky rice boxes was very kind, very friendly and took great care in making the dish. The stickyrice was very nice, sweet coconut sauce and the mango was great. We went back a couple of times, one of the best stickyrice mango's ive had! Highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Koen

sample_reviews_en.text: Sweet with a touch of savory taste from the sticky rice. The mango smoothie was a pleasant surprise as well. Bonus points for the ghetto atmosphere. Really brings me back to those childhood snack moments.
sample_reviews_en.author: Changlin Zhao (Charlie)

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good mango stick Rice slightly away from the main street there are some stands next to it that are not very clean and the location is not the best, but the mango is really wonderful
sample_reviews_en.author: DeRoMaT

sample_reviews_en.text: It's cheap and delicious. There was nowhere to sit and eat, so I carried it around for a while and it got a bit soggy, but it was still tasty. I should have bought it again...
sample_reviews_en.author: ym kim

sample_reviews_en.text: Second best mango sticky rice I've had in Bangkok. As for the frequent location, is it sold with a great price. I definitely recommend visiting this food stall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Luboš

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best smoothie I've had in Thailand! A blend of mango and passion fruit, fresh and creamy, fantastic!
The lady was very kind and smiling.
Only 50 baht!
sample_reviews_en.author: Borej955

sample_reviews_en.text: Really good mango sticky rice & reasonably priced; however she could add in almost twice as much sticky rice; it wasn’t enough. The crunchy is the best!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jennifer Aussant

restaurants.name: S.P.A. Foods Ramkhamheang 71
restaurants.address:

1 Ramkhamhaeng 71 Alley, Khwaeng Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the best vegetarian restaurant I've ever eaten at. They don't use MSG, and the food tastes amazing. Every dish I ordered tasted just like regular food. You can even choose whether or not to add onions and garlic. My favorite was the papaya salad with fried chicken – the fried chicken was so crispy and delicious, even better than regular chicken! The spicy sea bass salad was incredibly tasty. Importantly, a membership costs 100 baht and gives you a 10% discount, and 20% on Buddhist holy days – a great deal! The staff are friendly, polite, and the food comes out quickly. There's parking behind the restaurant. Highly recommend coming here, especially on Buddhist holy days for their vegetarian food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Olivia P.

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything is fantastic. Friendly staff, easy to order because Menu are in English. Good and hot taste. I am so glad I found another amazing food place for me because eating vegan food is not as easy. The prices are normal. A lot of food that normally eat can be ordered in vegan dishes. Restaurant is clean and clear. Can be bought frozen food from S.P.A products. Delicious and healthy food. Will definitely come back again. Recommended if you are vegan. Cooking is fast for our dishes so that is also a plus. I also love the fact that there are plants on the table and decorations are also plant based.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nanda Linn Aung

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was fortunate enough to live right across the street from this establishment so I would hope to think I know a thing or two about this place.

Once entering you're always greeted with a warm welcome. Very clean, and extensive menu at an affordable price (mostly in the 100-175 baht range). Talking about authentic thai flavors and plant based food is a hard combination to consider finding but this place knows how to authenticate plant based foods with packs of flavor!
Ensure to try the northern pork sausage and or the tom yum. Overall, you will not be disappointed in whatever dish you order!
sample_reviews_en.author: Marcus Banks

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love the food from this place; I liked the old location better, but what to do. I like that you can do your vegan groceries in the same place as well. The staff is super friendly, they have wifi, and the menu is in English. The only downside is that the washroom is outside. When I went, it was raining and even tho they helped me with the umbrella I got soaked.
Be mindful of the spicy. When a dish said is spicy, it is!!
Update: You can’t pay with your international card, only if u have a local card. I had to walk in the sun and got lost (atm location in google map was wrong) to pay cash.
sample_reviews_en.author: Barbara Bt

sample_reviews_en.text: I stumbled upon this unassuming restaurant with great selection of vegan food. They have plant based mock meat of all kinds (pork, chicken, beef and food) if you prefer that type of vegetarian food. Otherwise they have plenty options of vegetarian dishes without fake meat. The price is insanely inexpensive even for Bangkok standard.  Unfortunately the staff speaks very little English but you can easily overcome it with google translate.
sample_reviews_en.author: oka diputra

sample_reviews_en.text:
Love this restaurant! The food is so good and dilious seriously. And there is no meat. I'm a big fan and have been eating at S.P.A many branches. Even this one moved from Gooden place ramkamheang road. To here at Ramkamheang 71. But we still come for lunch time to time.

Good set meals we always order is Set B and Set E plus BBQ Mala. Spend just 400 bath for 2. Recommended for vegetarians ^^
sample_reviews_en.author: Tika Ridhiwanna

sample_reviews_en.text: I was rushing around today and didn't have time to look at the menu carefully, so I ordered based on the pictures. Everything was delicious, and I was very satisfied. Perhaps because it was past peak hours, it was very quiet, as only the two of us were eating, except for the delivery person picking up a package.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kai Huang

sample_reviews_en.text: They've moved to a new branch here, with convenient parking. The restaurant is spacious and comfortable, and the staff provides excellent service. I'm very impressed. The food tastes as good as before; the papaya salad is delicious, and they offer both vegetarian and vegan options, which I really appreciate.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirapong MetalcorePro

restaurants.name: Amir halal Food
restaurants.address:

60 หมู่ที่ 10 S Pattaya Rd, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
5/5

This is one of Halal restaurant near this area. There's Mosque nearby.

Food: The food is really good!!! Even the egg tastes amazing! I love the Papaya Salad surprisingly from someone who doesn't like papaya.

Price: The price is pretty cheap. For the food I bought, it cost me around 1k Baht for 4 people!

Service: I was confused at first with the service hahaha. When we entered the restaurant, the server served us 3 bottled water and ice cubes. We thought it was complimentary. Turned out they charged us in the bill which was okay for us.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nabila S H

sample_reviews_en.text:
Here’s a polished review you can post:

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Excellent place to stay! The rooms are spacious, and the property has plenty of space to relax. The amenities are well maintained, and there is ample car parking available. I especially appreciated the halal food options and the convenient prayer facilities, which made the stay very comfortable. Everything was neat, clean, and well organized. The staff were friendly and helpful throughout. Highly recommended for families and Muslim travelers looking for a peaceful and comfortable stay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ashik Rahuman

sample_reviews_en.text: An incredible experience. From the friendliness of the staff to the quality of the food, the calm and discreet atmosphere of the restaurant, in short, an experience that has been validated and repeated several times! Perfect for a group or a small gathering, for me the best halal restaurant in Pattaya! Bravo for the quality of the work and the attention to detail!
sample_reviews_en.author: Fraz K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Loved their chili paste shrimps and jasmine rice🤍🇹🇭
Very vibrant food
Would not recommend their steak or papaya salad. Portion size of the chili paste shrimps is average, can be shared by 2 somehow.
The staff are very friendly and hospitable. The environment is a lil chaotic for me but it is a pretty and clean restaurant. 💯recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Noor Azad

sample_reviews_en.text: Some of the best halal Thai food you’ll have in Thailand, the tempura prawns were just amazing! Some of the best I’ve had anywhere and I’ve tried a lot of them. The mango sticky rice is also really good from here. Great customer service. I always look forward to coming back here whenever I visit Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adam Chase

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm interested in giving this review.. but google is telling me to push push.. erm, Amir, is this halal food, right? Sedapp..gentle is delicious...Enviroment nice..the vibe is tip top... The food is also delicious.. you just go here.. it's dizzying.. I'm sure you'll be satisfied.. bye
sample_reviews_en.author: Syndicate Fashion

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best sea food restaurants and it's Halal, we tried seabass with sweet and sour source, 5/5, and sea food fried rice 4/5, as always Tomyum soup 4.5/5, grilled shrimp with tamarind source 4.5/5 and padthai noodle, 5/5, super quick and excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rizwan Nuhuman

sample_reviews_en.text: The service and ambient is ok but the food is terrible. Please learn how to cook because you are giving thai food a bad name especially to the muslim tourists. If I could give zero star for the food, I would.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marshia Chanel

restaurants.name: TigerMala老虎烧烤@RCA
restaurants.address:

21/64 RCA Alley, Bang Kapi, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time at this barbecue restaurant, and the overall experience was great. The skewers were all freshly grilled, and the cooking time was perfect; the meat was tender and flavorful. I especially recommend the lamb skewers and grilled pork belly. The owner and staff were very welcoming, the food came out quickly, and the prices were reasonable, making it great value for money. Plus, they have a buy-one-get-one-free drink promotion every month. I'll definitely come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: 白又文

sample_reviews_en.text: The barbecue was very cold, like scalding something with boiling water and sprinkling on some oil and seasoning—completely cold. It only started heating up after we notified them. The food clearly hadn't been grilled, and it wasn't served even after we paid. We only found out it was served when we wanted to cancel the order. We went to the Shilong branch because we thought the barbecue would be good, but this was a huge disappointment; it was inedible.
sample_reviews_en.author: 江海

sample_reviews_en.text: A spectacular place! I don't usually write reviews, but the waiter who served us was amazing—so kind, so helpful, and with impeccable service. His name (I hope I'm not mistaken) is Yilei! We'll definitely be back! A really cool place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ares Leosa

sample_reviews_en.text: My favorite BBQ place in Bangkok; I've been to both RCA and Huai Khwang locations, and I love them both. They recently added heaters to ensure the food stays hot, which is a big plus.
sample_reviews_en.author: E

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here after the renovations and reopening, and it tasted even better than before, plus it was very affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thiago Swift

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was decent and the service was excellent. It's authentic Chinese style, so if you like that kind of food, I recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ra Dee

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been here many times; this is a testament to the positive feedback and approval from people in Heilongjiang. 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Zeal Zhang

sample_reviews_en.text: Pretty good skewers. There are also various northern and southern cuisines. There are many varieties. Good reviews.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiang yan Shen

restaurants.address:

243 23 Lat Phrao 1, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Even though the fresh vegetables were served late at night, the pork tasted like pork and the chicken tasted like chicken. They gave a generous amount of glass noodles because I took a lot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phatsawut Am

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the lowest quality meat out there. Incredibly chewy with a weird crunchy texture. Also, I didn’t even get the extra pork promo even though my order was almost 300 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thirasit Sanoi

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and affordable. I like that they moved the self-service food counters inside the restaurant; it looks cleaner and the ingredients seem fresher.
sample_reviews_en.author: gartoon

sample_reviews_en.text: I walked into the store, the employee stood with her hands on her hips, chewing on a snack loudly, no greeting, completely ignoring the customer. 🙄
sample_reviews_en.author: Cat Neighbor

sample_reviews_en.text: It's good. The mala is delicious and the price is very reasonable. They also offer free refills of rice and drinks. ❤️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: peem prm

sample_reviews_en.text:
The broth is rich and flavorful, with a variety of ingredients to choose from.
Importantly, free rice is included!
sample_reviews_en.author: Naridsara Hanpradit

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food, very lovely staff, free rice, free dessert, and free pumpkin juice too! Super value!
sample_reviews_en.author: อมิตา สมปัก

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is clean and the service is good. The mala pork bone soup is very fragrant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arreerat Pathong

restaurants.name: Neidan Izakaya
restaurants.address:

483 Sukhumvit 22, Kwang Klongtoei, Khet, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Very overpriced, small portion, lackluster service"

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food and great atmosphere. The food was incredibly delicious 😋, with great, well-balanced flavors, fresh ingredients, beautiful presentation, and just the right portion size. The restaurant's atmosphere was also great, perfect for dining with friends. Overall, I was very impressed and will definitely come back again ❤️✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Matureen

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice food, fantastic, service is great, make fresh. Value for money sapporo promotion for now they have one small glass 99 baht hope they keep this rate forever. It will help them attract customer for drinks and automatically order food also.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Singh

sample_reviews_en.text:
The yakitori and karaage (fried chicken) are overcooked and not juicy at all.
The karaage, in particular, is fried until the batter becomes bitter.
You should accept that this is a Japanese-style izakaya (pub) restaurant in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: ヒロポン100cc

sample_reviews_en.text:
nice place, good service, opens late and most importantly - very good food! pleasure to have met one of the owners Neo, we had a good conversation!
I really love that they sell Berliner Luft here! great drink!
sample_reviews_en.author: Andre Heiss

sample_reviews_en.text: They brought me sushi that wasn't fresh and they don't indicate what's in their rolls. Be careful when ordering delivery because they don't solve the problem and say it's your fault.
sample_reviews_en.author: Seven G (aestheticGamer)

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a very nice yakitori restaurant. The ambiance is great and chill, the food is very fresh and delicious, the drinks are good, and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: 杜宇晨

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was on point, very good, super tasty! Service was friendly, chefs cooking in front of you at bar makes for an amazing atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adam Watters

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the restaurant was beautiful, and the atmosphere was amazing. Such a lovely place! ✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuravadee Naisong

restaurants.name: Faculty of Education Canteen
restaurants.address:

254 Phaya Thai Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, it's lonely. Many shops are closed, probably because it's the school break, so there aren't many people. Many delicious shops have changed hands, with employees changing to people working for money. The taste isn't that great, but it helps you get through life. The fresh fruit is good, the meatballs are good, the crepes are good, and the food is always good. The noodles are good some days. The rice with curry, if hot, is delicious like curry. The soup is quite expensive. Today I ate stewed chicken leg noodles, added dumplings. The soup was a bit salty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pitchanok Champathong

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and clean. The place is clean and tidy. There's a variety of food, like the rice with chili paste and vegetables that I like. The curry rice from the last stall near the serving area tastes great, just like home-cooked food, although he focuses on stir-fried dishes. There are also à la carte dishes, steaks, noodles, and another famous stall selling smoothies. The prices are inexpensive, 25-45 baht. However, fewer shops are open during school breaks because there aren't many students.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teera Somc

sample_reviews_en.text:
In addition to affordable noodle and curry shops, there are also booths selling snacks, desserts, and a wide variety of drinks, including fried food, shabu skewers, roti, bingsu, and fruit smoothies.

There's also a water dispenser where you can refill your water bottles.
After you've finished eating, you must return your plates to the used containers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rajaya Rajatavarn (GungGing)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Many of the restaurants are good, clean, and offer good value for money, with prices suitable for students.

However, my daughter ordered from restaurant number 3 and the food was spoiled. When she told them, the staff just nodded and ignored her. Unacceptable.
We've stopped eating at that restaurant altogether.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mieow J

sample_reviews_en.text:
The cafeteria in the Faculty of Education at Chulalongkorn University.

There's a shop that serves Japanese food, and the katsu curry (35 baht) is delicious.

It tastes exactly the same as in Japan, is generous in portion size, and is cheap.

I eat it almost every day, but I still haven't gotten tired of it.
sample_reviews_en.author: TAKAMITS KITSUDA

sample_reviews_en.text: Uncle and Auntie's Smoothie Shop (Smoothies & Coffee), Faculty of Education (Fruit Cafe'). New menu items: Fresh avocado smoothie, sapodilla milk smoothie, coconut milk smoothie, mixed berry smoothie, fresh kiwi and lime smoothie, and strong, freshly brewed coffee.
sample_reviews_en.author: Norman Hotel

sample_reviews_en.text:
That's right... and we're reducing the price even more!
Chula's generosity...
Strawberry coconut smoothie with milk.
Normally 40 baht! Only 35 baht on graduation rehearsal day!!

#ChulaZeroWaste #ChulaIsCute
sample_reviews_en.author: Kasem Kow

sample_reviews_en.text: It's very clean. The plate racks are constantly being cleared and washed to prevent birds and rats from eating the leftover food. It's one of the cleanest and most delicious cafeterias in the university.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rattasapa Wannacote

restaurants.name: สถานีหม่าล่า (เลี่ยงเมือง-สาย2)
restaurants.address:

255 Soi 4, Sala Thammasop, Thawi Watthana, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍲 Super Chicken Leg Hot Pot 👍 99 THB. This dish is amazing! The chicken legs are stewed to perfection, the broth is rich and flavorful, with just the right amount of spiciness 🌶️ Delicious and worth the price.
🍜 Mixed Seafood Instant Noodle Salad 💯 89 THB. A spicy and flavorful instant noodle salad with a perfect balance of sour, spicy, salty, and sweet flavors. So delicious you'll want to order more! 😋
🍢 Mala Skewers 👯‍♂️ A variety of mala skewers including beef, pork, chicken, and squid. Grilled to perfection, fragrant and juicy, with a rich and flavorful seasoning 🐔🐷🐙
🍗 Fried Chicken Wings 🍻 79 THB. Crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, with a savory flavor and the aroma of white sesame.
Mala Station (Bypass Road - Line 2) is a very interesting restaurant 🍴 If you're looking for a delicious restaurant with a great atmosphere and live music 🎶, I recommend trying this place. You won't be disappointed! 😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Jingjai Review

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a great atmosphere and a wide variety of drinks.
The mala skewers are flavorful and you can choose your spice level.
The food selection is diverse and the prices are reasonable.
The staff are friendly and attentive.
There's live music every day until approximately 9:30 PM.
You can park on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benz Surwide

sample_reviews_en.text: I went without any expectations, just looking for a place to chat with friends, but the place was great! They had live music, delicious food, and the beer was cheap. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a place to hang out with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supisara Kongsirisombat

sample_reviews_en.text: The mala was delicious, and the service was good, although there weren't many staff members around because we came late. The drinks and food were reasonably priced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittipong Roosapakit

sample_reviews_en.text: Great atmosphere, excellent service. The mala hotpot is delicious, spicy, and flavorful. The seafood dipping sauce and pickled radish complement the mala perfectly!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mayurachat Oily

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great and chill. They have a huge selection of food and snacks at very reasonable prices. (Beer glasses are a must-try, no worries there!)
sample_reviews_en.author: Methee Thopsri

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! The sauce was perfect, and the spicy soup was incredibly flavorful. If you're allergic to mosquito bites, you can request insect repellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasikaaa

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is okay, alright. The price is a bit high compared to the quality and quantity of food. Some staff are willing to serve, but some...
sample_reviews_en.author: Napaschanok Nanthasenee

restaurants.name: Grill Yamaya (Central Park Bangkok)
restaurants.address:

