เบต, ชั้น G Central Park เลขที่ 946 Rama IV Rd, Si Lom, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited Yakimono Yamaya, a new restaurant that recently opened in Bangkok's Dusit Central.

I had the grilled mackerel set meal. The freshly cooked rice was fluffy and refillable. I was very satisfied that I could also get refills of the miso soup. 🍚✨

Furthermore, the all-you-can-eat takana (pickled mustard greens) and mentaiko (spicy cod roe) were a nice bonus. The grilled mackerel was perfectly cooked and went wonderfully with the rice. 😋

The dashi broth served at the end was truly delicious and impressive. This restaurant truly allows you to enjoy Japanese set meal culture.

I highly recommend it if you're craving a delicious Japanese set meal in Bangkok! 🇯🇵✨
sample_reviews_en.author: SH A

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently tried Grill Yamaya, a Japanese restaurant serving premium grilled set menus. The main highlight is that all dishes are served charcoal-grilled, including salmon, mackerel, grilled pork, and grilled chicken.

What's special is that the mentaiko (cod roe), pickled vegetables, side dishes, and soup are unlimited refills when you order a set menu. 😀

Menu - Shio Koji Marinated Chicken: 10/10. The chicken was thigh meat, perfectly grilled. The meat was incredibly juicy, and the skin was incredibly crispy – this is the highlight! True to their motto, "crispy on the outside, tender on the inside," the crispy skin and tender meat were simply amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Earn Nigizer

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's delicious! I've eaten here over 10 times. My favorites are the teriyaki chicken set and the mackerel set (they have a new fish now, don't order it – it's full of bones and not juicy, I tried it 😂).

You can enhance the flavor by asking for a fork and spoon. Seriously, it makes it twice as good because it makes it so much easier to squeeze out the mentaiko. At first, it was so difficult to eat the fish roe with chopsticks.

Another star is the soy sauce. Rice + seaweed + mentaiko + sauce is the best! (You can ask for extra seaweed, just tell the staff).

Some days the queue is very long, so be prepared 🤣 But it's worth trying.
sample_reviews_en.author: RainaChannel

sample_reviews_en.text: There are only 4 set menu options to choose from, but you can refill the side dishes unlimitedly. If you're coming with more than one person, you should order a set. You'll need dialysis after eating here because it's extremely salty, especially the fish roe. Sharing or tasting food is strictly prohibited, as you will immediately lose your refill privilege (the staff are secretly watching, hehe). It's not suitable for elderly people who don't eat rice, because if you order individual dishes, you'll be immediately scrutinized for sharing. Anyone who wants unlimited refills of the side dishes, please be warned! 555
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr.Pattaya Chantokul

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time trying the grilled version. I usually only eat at the branches that serve tempura. This time I got to try the grilled option.
This branch isn't very big, so there was a wait, but it wasn't too long.
Today I ordered the salmon set.
You can refill rice, soup, pickles, and mentaiko unlimitedly.
It was delicious and great value.
The staff were lovely, constantly checking on me and refilling my food.
When I was almost finished, they even refilled my rice bowl with soup from the teapot.
It was like eating rice porridge, very comforting.
I recommend trying it!
sample_reviews_en.author: destiny ANN

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a Yamaya restaurant specializing in grilled dishes. The grilled chicken set meal was about 300 baht, and with tax it came to about 360 baht. Rice, mentaiko (spicy cod roe), takana (pickled mustard greens), and miso soup are all refillable, and the set meal itself is very well-made, so I was very satisfied. The mentaiko was delicious and went well with the rice. The rice bowl is small, so I ended up getting refills several times, but the staff were very attentive and brought them quickly. I would like to visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Y H

sample_reviews_en.text: Japanese grilled fish and meat restaurant. They have grilled fish and other meat like pork and chicken. Taste good , fresh ingredient with optimum grilled. Set menu and a la carte are available. I got salmon grilled set which is good in portion and pairing with other condiments. Staffs are helpful with menu selection and others. For set menu, rice , pickle and miso soup are refillable. Picture and English menu are available. Credit card accepted. Seating are quite compact for table and seating space. Enjoy!
sample_reviews_en.author: Supakij Khomvilai

sample_reviews_en.text: I have eaten at this restaurant many times, and it has always been consistently delicious The fish portions are generous and offer great value for the price They also provide free refills of soup and rice with sesame seeds, spring onions, pickled vegetables, and mentaiko  The tea is also very delicious. I always enjoy dining here and will definitely come back again
sample_reviews_en.author: Wipwise

restaurants.name: Ken's Steak House
restaurants.address:

271 17 Sathu Pradit 19 Alley, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Loved the cute Chinese Thai owner. Reminded me from a scene in Blade Runner. Not what I expected though. No classic rock music; just some eclectic old you tube videos changing from Russian to German to American to Bee Gees. Very very small interior. Definitely not a place for steak or beef. Not a wide selection of imported Belgian or German beers that others posted were available? Glad I visited but won't be returning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brian Streb

sample_reviews_en.text:
No matter how many times I come, I can never get the menu item I want.
If they can't stock the ingredients properly, they should close the store.
It's the worst when a steakhouse has no meat.

This store always has no ingredients for the food I ordered.
If they can't stock, it is better to close the store.
The worst thing is that there is no meat in the steakhouse.
sample_reviews_en.author: KOICHI MIYANAGA

sample_reviews_en.text: We stumbled upon this restaurant almost by chance and decided to eat there. It's a very small, pub-style place with surprisingly good food. We had two meat dishes, which were really good, but unfortunately, the portions were quite small. Everything was fresh, well-seasoned, and the prices were reasonable. All in all, I can recommend this restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: merrik hamburg

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant where you can enjoy delicious hamburgers, international beers, and nostalgic music videos. Burgers start at under 200 baht, and even with a Belgian beer, it comes to around 500 baht. The restaurant is closed on irregular days, so we recommend making a reservation by phone before visiting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michiko Matsunaga

sample_reviews_en.text:
Changed hands and now lacks the atmosphere of the past. Ken's interaction with customers was part of the attraction.  Same bar, same music but unfortunately will not go back. My friend who visited from UK was very disappointed.
Search now on for new hostelry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eric Anderson

sample_reviews_en.text: Good food and excellent selection of beer. Parking can be a hassle but you can park at the schools across the street on Sathu Pradit if you don't want to park in the alleyway. A bit cramped in the bar area and the service can be a bit slow (read casual).
sample_reviews_en.author: John Jaworski

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. This small Irish bar-style restaurant is located in Soi Sathu 19.
2. Delicious food, large steak plates, reasonable prices. The minced chicken spaghetti is delicious, with a hint of sourness. The pork chops are large and …
sample_reviews_en.author: Moo Lipis

sample_reviews_en.text: This old restaurant on Sathu Road is a bit stuffy. The food tastes good, but the steak quality is average, making some dishes seem overpriced. It's a great place to chill, sip beer, and listen to 80s and 90s music.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sansanee N.

restaurants.name: Kah Jak Halal Foods
restaurants.address:

QHX2+P7M section 18 Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food prices do not match the costs indicated on the menu. It is too pricey, and I wonder if I was cheated.

A fried chicken dish costs 200 THB, with 4 pieces per serving. I argued that it should only cost 100 THB as written on the menu. I showed the menu to the shop owner as evidence. She said she had just raised the price and claimed there are now 5 pieces of chicken per serving. However, I only received 4 pieces. She returned 50 THB to me, but I still feel she cheated me.

A bottle of water costs 20 THB. For this kind of restaurant, it normally costs only 10 THB.

I am not sure why she acted this way. It may be because I am not a Muslim so I got a special price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalita Taothong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kah Jak is surprisingly not halal anymore. The reason when i said this is because i was surprised that they publicly shared their menu (fried rice with fermented pork).

We have ordered food and eat then just realised that they serve pork in their menu. Really disappointed as Kah Jak always be the go to restaurant when we are in Chatuchak.

For muslim traveller, my tips is always need to be vigilant on the menu serve despite that they claim as it is to be Halal because it’s loosely implemented there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shahid Akhir

sample_reviews_en.text: Visiting this small restaurant to take our brunch before shopping. It is one of the few halal restaurants here. Not many people during our visit. The food is delicious, the portions are fair and the price is affordable. The seller can speak Malay. The service is also good, waiting time does not take too long and the restaurant is clean. The environment is quite narrow and limited seating is available. very recommended to come and have halal meal here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hafizun Mushtafa

sample_reviews_en.text: If you’re at Chatuchak Market, don’t miss Kak Jak – another halal spot besides Saman Islam. The food here is superb, flavorful, and perfect for recharging after hours of shopping. From local Thai dishes to hearty rice and noodle meals, it’s a must-try for Muslim travelers looking for authentic halal options in the heart of Chatuchak.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sharifah Shuhada Syed Ghazali

sample_reviews_en.text: Super friendly staff explained the main dishes, can speak Malay, and we're the 1st customer and they open as early at 9.00am. Served delicious halal food and fried rice located in Section 18, the busiest Chatuchak market on weekend. Worth for money.Recommended for authentic Thai food in Chatuchak Weekend market.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eid deveil

sample_reviews_en.text: An underrated Thai Muslim Halal eatery. Their foods are delicious and prices are quite reasonable compare to the other Halal eatery at Chatucak Market. Make sure to reconfirm and recheck on what you're ordering because the lady gave me wrong orders twice when I went there. Lady can speak Malay language (Melayu).
sample_reviews_en.author: Nqbah Hm

sample_reviews_en.text: What a gem. Fantastic place. Small but the dishes were great. The ladies are lovely and the food is Devine. Highly recommended when you walk past. Also very cheap and clean. The tables are old sewing machines. Great idea!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thomas J. R.

sample_reviews_en.text: Lovely little restaurant tucked away at section 18, soi 26/6. The food is delicious and restaurant is comfortable with fans giving a refreshing feel on a hot day. Recommend stopping by as you won’t be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex Hepden

restaurants.name: Shangarila Restaurant Silom
restaurants.address:

154/4-7 Si Lom Rd, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
[Shangri-La Restaurant Silom]
We visited for the first time on a Sunday night in June 2025 with about 20 people, including representatives from a Thai subsidiary and fellow Japanese business executives.
*There is also a restaurant with the same name near Thaniya Road.

One of the people we visited had previously visited Shangri-La Restaurant when he first moved to Thailand and struggled to get used to Thai food. Apparently, he frequented the restaurant.

Since we were such a large group, we were assigned a room and ate at multiple rotating round tables (which apparently originated in Japan but were re-imported to China), a common sight in Chinese restaurants.

The food and dressing were all delicious, and perfectly suited to Japanese palates.

The Peking duck was especially tasty. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: 太田英樹

sample_reviews_en.text:
I often go here for lunch, but this was my first time for dinner.
After entering the restaurant, I sat down.
We had a little chat, and then the appetizers arrived.

But just when I thought that, all nine dishes were served.
They even brought out fried rice all at once.

Just looking at the food was enough to fill me up.
Is it like they were saying, "Hurry up and eat now?"

They also served Peking duck, but to be honest, it wasn't very tasty.
I wonder if my palate has become strangely refined.
I miss the days when I would devour whatever I ate, saying, "Mmmm, this is so good!"

Speaking of Peking duck, I've never had anything as delicious as the one I had in Sydney a long time ago.
sample_reviews_en.author: ぽるさい

sample_reviews_en.text:
The portions are large, ordered as sets. Overall, the taste is just okay. Normally, at other places, for Peking duck, they let you make one dish with the duck meat without charging extra, but here they charge 250 baht per dish. The same goes for lobster; they charge 250 baht per dish for cooking!!!!

The day I went was Mother's Day, so there was a constant flow of people; the restaurant was full.
The food took a very long time to arrive.

I ate from 11:30 AM to 2:30 PM, a total of 3 hours. Longer than eating a buffet!!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: CharmmyKitty

sample_reviews_en.text: I thought this restaurant would be delicious, but I'd never been there before. I'd heard it was an old, established place. After tasting the food, I was pleasantly surprised. Chinese restaurants in hotels are much better. The taste here was like an expensive banquet, not at all like the sophisticated, high-end Chinese restaurant I expected. I don't think I'll go again, not because of the service, but because the food wasn't worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sithiporn Tojirakarn

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's been a while since I've been here. The dim sum tastes as good as ever. The stir-fried noodles (Pad Ee Mee), Singaporean noodles, and to finish, the Peking duck was delicious. They made sweet and sour duck stir-fry and duck wraps.
Parking is just past the restaurant. At the entrance of the soi (alley), there's an Indian restaurant; turn left a little way in and you'll find the parking lot on the left. You'll need to back up to park.
sample_reviews_en.author: wanee duangchalomnin

sample_reviews_en.text: The portions were huge, so much so that we had to share and take some home. The service was excellent, with great food recommendations. The food tasted delicious and true to expectations. The seafood, including the lobster and fish, was incredibly fresh. Parking might be limited, so it's recommended to contact the restaurant in advance.
sample_reviews_en.author: K Song

sample_reviews_en.text: This large restaurant offers both Thai and English menus, focusing on freshly prepared Chinese food, suitable for banquet-style gatherings, but smaller individual dishes are also available. Parking is available in front, across the street, and behind the building. Credit cards are accepted.
sample_reviews_en.author: Markmaxmook Shop

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was very good. Portions are decent and the price is ok, but not cheap. No rice was provided with meal which I found a bit odd. I asked for it but they forgot. Overall it was a good dinner, even if a bit overpriced. Beef with oyster sauce and sweet and sour chicken are both very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuno Moura

restaurants.name: Greenhouse Landmark Bangkok Hotel
restaurants.address:

Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I recently dined at The Greenhouse at The Landmark Hotel, and it was a wonderful surprise. I ordered Pad Krapow beef (ผัดกระเพรา), and I asked “เอาเผ็ดมาก ๆ จริง ๆ” (which means “make it very spicy”). They got it just right. We also had Moo Krob (หมูกรอบ), crispy Thai pork, which was perfectly seasoned and wonderfully crunchy. The attentive service and local flavors made the whole experience memorable. I’d gladly return!
sample_reviews_th.author: André Chiang

sample_reviews_en.text: I had been craving some authentic dim-sum for a while.  It can be difficult to find in Thailand, as chefs tend to 'localize' it.  I wanted some Hong Kong-style 'proper' dim-sum, and Greenhouse did not disappoint.  The wantan mee soup reminded me of my favorite hawker stall in Singapore.  The Siew Mai could have come off a cart in an HK dim sum hall.  The location is a bit confusing.  I was not sure if this was a stand-alone restaurant or part of the wider group of 'Quad' restaurants in the Landmark atrium area.  Nonetheless, try it out!
sample_reviews_en.author: Keith Moore

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re looking for authentic Hong Kong–style Cantonese congee, look no further than Greenhouse Noodles & Congee.
This place serves one of the best congee bowls in Thailand—definitely among the top two in the country.

Their rice rolls are also excellent, but I especially recommend the one with deep-fried Chinese dough (Pa-Tong-Go) — it’s a perfect match.

While the prices aren’t cheap, the quality and taste fully justify the cost. I truly believe it’s worth every baht you pay. Service is excellent by the way ^^
sample_reviews_en.author: Arigo Siu

sample_reviews_en.text: The congee with Abalone here is a little below average. They use cheap rice for congee and cheap Abalone. Abalone does not taste fresh either. Ginger was not fresh at all 😳🙈 Average or below average Congee here. Won’t be winning a Michelin award for their congee. It’s hard to find a good high end congee place in Bangkok. I have been looking but have not found one yet.The congee with Abalone was 694 Baht, not cheap but  quality was not on par with price charged for Congee. My review vanished for some reason
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Crystal

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fantastic taste at a good price. The congee was thick and came with chives, ginger and fried garlic to add at your own discretion. It also came with some kimchi and fried bread. The steamed buns were delicious, too.

You get the menu for the Chinese/Thai, Italian Restaurant and the burger joint all at once. So if you're with someone and you can't decide what kind of food you want, you can still eat different food together at the same place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karl Keiser

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food was basic, bland and overpriced.

I went here with a friend because he was here years ago and then it was good. It is not good anymore.

Everywhere in southeast Asia soups come filled with meats and vegetables. The soup here was mostly coconut milk.

I also ordered some sort of meat. I was bland and forgettable.

What I do remember is that the meals was much, much more expensive than every other meal we had.
sample_reviews_en.author: R

sample_reviews_en.text: A proper landmark in Bangkok. A throwback to yesteryear and in a prime location with tons of value for money. Really smart is the way they combine three different restaurant menus available in one place so there is something for everyone… Chinese, Italian and Burger Joint (with the ever-trendy MAGA burger and I don’t need to explain that one … but it’s big and cheesy and dominates the table !)
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Anthony

sample_reviews_en.text: Dining on Saturday evening of 26th Apr with newly renovated space, and with a newly combine variety of international cuisine. The food quality is consistently good. The manager on duty, Mr. Bank, is giving a five-stars service with attention down to little detail. Always come here for the best Chinese food in town, especially the congee. Definitely will come back to try the burgers.
sample_reviews_en.author: wynn app

restaurants.name: ร้านเมามาย
restaurants.address:

207 Samae Dam, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It was great! The food was delicious, and the prices for both food and alcohol were reasonable. The live music was nice. The restaurant is located right by the road, but you don't have to worry about getting rear-ended because there are plenty of barriers. 😄
sample_reviews_en.author: Lakkhana Suwanjanta

sample_reviews_en.text: This had to be one of my most favorite places to eat . The staff very kind and look after you always ❤️  . I came back so many times because of their spicy squid salad and fried chicken  karage.  If you around must visit !! Enjoy 😉 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Bence Farkas

sample_reviews_en.text: They have a lot of alcohol and a wide selection of food. However, the stir-fried cabbage with fish sauce I ordered was very salty. Never mind, the other dishes were pretty good. Recommended! P.S. Parking is available on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Easytotalk25

sample_reviews_en.text:
A chill and relaxed place to hang out, perfect for watching football or listening to music. It's not too crowded and there's live music.
The food is delicious in almost every dish.
sample_reviews_en.author: prangrat Langkahln

sample_reviews_en.text: The service is good, the music is nice, the food is delicious, and it's easy to get there. However, parking is limited. It's better to travel by motorcycle or public transport.
sample_reviews_en.author: หนี เที่ยว ตามกัน

sample_reviews_en.text: The house next door is so inconsiderate, I can't sleep. Drunk people keep vomiting and urinating on the trees in front of my house. 😡😡👎 …
sample_reviews_en.author: kanarok -o-

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff are lovely, the food is delicious, the singer is amazing, the atmosphere is great, and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aphinadda Khaewlek

sample_reviews_en.text: I went during Songkran. The owner was friendly and the singer was good, but there were quite a lot of unruly people there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Russarin Gubgib

restaurants.name: Krua Somphoch Thai Chinese food Branch 2
restaurants.address:

ปาก Soi Chan 28/1, Thung Wat Don, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is pretty good, prepared by someone who's also in the same profession; the cooking skills are excellent.
However, the service at the branch next to the bank is terrible. I went around 1:45 AM, there were no customers, and I told them what I wanted to order, but they ignored me even after I repeated myself (the cook). The staff also consistently seemed unwilling to provide good service. If I don't have business that requires me to stay out late, I'd choose the restaurant near the gas station instead; it's less awkward and the service is more polite. I was there to pay, but it felt like I was bothering them. Nevertheless, I really like the taste of the food at this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: nuttawat rujikunpong

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes decent, but the portion size feels expensive compared to the price. The restaurant is next to Makro, so they should be able to source ingredients cheaper easily. Therefore, they shouldn't be charging so much. If they adjusted the pricing and portion sizes to be more balanced, the restaurant would likely be much more successful. Also, I've eaten at many restaurants, and I've never seen one charge 2 baht per glass for ice, even though the food itself is already expensive and that price is already factored in.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakawat Kuboonya-arags

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating at this restaurant for a very long time, almost 15 to 20 years, since my children were little. The taste has never changed (there was a period when the cook changed and the food was inedible, so I stopped going for a while. Once the original cook returned, I started eating there again). I can confirm that everything is delicious. The Hainanese chicken rice is also delicious and the portion is generous.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oneone 2233

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the portions were huge; two people ate until we had to take some home. The restaurant is located by the road, so parking can be difficult, but the food and service are very fast. The staff are efficient. When paying, there was no bill with items and prices, so we had to ask for it. The dishes are a bit pricey, but acceptable considering the portion sizes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Baitoei N.Obradovic

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant opens in the evening and is located opposite Vanilla Moon on Chan Road. The prices are slightly higher than typical local restaurants, but the food is decent and the portion sizes are reasonable for the price. However, I wish they provided a bill detailing everything ordered and its cost.
sample_reviews_en.author: ORNZA Channel

sample_reviews_en.text: I eat at this restaurant often. The food doesn't take long to arrive; the chef is very fast. The taste is delicious. Today I had battered and fried shrimp (150 baht), stir-fried kale with crispy pork over rice (40 baht), bottled water (10 baht), and ice (2 baht per glass).
sample_reviews_en.author: พิมพ์ พรรณ

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! They have a wide variety of dishes, from Hainanese chicken rice and stir-fried noodles to à la carte options. Many things are tasty and the prices are reasonable. They even have beer! Haha. You can sit there as long as you like until they ask you to leave.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hermetz

sample_reviews_en.text: Canned fish soup with glass noodles costs 120 baht. I didn't expect it to be cheap or anything, but the ingredients are just canned fish, mushrooms, and glass noodles. But the price is the same as, or even more expensive than, some seafood dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: few wee

restaurants.name: Moomgapao มุมกะเพรา Caltex เพชรพระเทพ
restaurants.address:

481 Thanon Bang Phrom, Bang Phrom, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch is probably closing down. I walked in and asked why there were two prices, and the staff looked annoyed as if I was disturbing their sleep. They just said that the member price was for members only, and regular customers paid the black price. They didn't ask or explain how to sign up at all. This is a failure, I'm telling you. The staff member with the many tattoos on her arm was particularly unwelcoming.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชาคริต กอสนาน

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted good, like homemade, clean and light with less oil. However, the portion size might not be quite right for the price. As for the atmosphere, the tables weren't cleared on the day I visited, and other customers' finished plates weren't cleared either. This could be improved. 🙏🏻🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: isry w

sample_reviews_en.text: This comfortable basil chicken restaurant has air-conditioned seating. The food tastes good, the chili fish sauce is delicious, and they use duck eggs for a richer flavor than chicken eggs. Overall, it's tasty, but the price is 30-40 baht more expensive than typical street food stalls.
sample_reviews_en.author: RANG เอง

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. My favorite dish is the light chicken sausage with lava egg. The staff provides good service and the food is tasty. However, one thing I'd like to see improved is the TV screen; the funny foreign shows aren't funny at all. Playing music would be better.
sample_reviews_en.author: PetchRatta Chen

sample_reviews_en.text: If you look for a quick lunch or meal, this is the place! Rice is good. Gaprao is good (a bit salty). Krua Kling is okay too. Sun omelette, rice is a but raw. Fried egg is extraordinary! Average taste, nothing fancy but acceptable. Clean, quick, and nice services
sample_reviews_en.author: Tomtam Ch

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in a CALTEX gas station.
The food is average in taste, but the fried eggs are absolutely delicious!
The restaurant is air-conditioned and comfortable. I went when the restaurant had just opened, so there weren't many people.
sample_reviews_en.author: PSP prusapa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pad Krapow (Thai basil stir-fry) is available in 3 levels of spiciness, with various types of meat. The flavor is moderate, and it comes with a fried duck egg.
The "Sun Egg Omelet" is very hard to find; I didn't think anyone would sell it.
sample_reviews_en.author: S M

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, but I have one suggestion: please change the spoons. They are very short and impossible to scoop anything with. Every customer has to dip their hand into the bottle to scoop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Soratat Pongsangiam

restaurants.name: ร้านปรุงสารพัด สำนักพระราชวัง
restaurants.address:

ชั้น 1 อาคาร 605 สำนักพระราชวังสนามเสือป่า Thanon Si Ayutthaya, Dusit District, Bangkok, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This shop serves as a training ground for students in the food service industry, which is a good thing, as you are supporting the school.
For parking, you have to park on the roadside along the canal next to Wat Benchamabophit or on Likit Road. As for the food, the senior students are the chefs, and it tastes good and delicious. For example, the boat noodles with pork are 20 baht per bowl (minimum order of 2 bowls), and a special bowl is 40 baht. The pork is marinated until tender, and the braised pork is also well-prepared. The wide rice noodles with pork in gravy have fragrant wok-fried noodles and tender pork. The taste is good without needing any extra seasoning, although some might find it a little salty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kosit Boonroungkaw

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice small restaurant,  the spaghetti bacon was very good the same with the chicken some tan, service is great, prices low, is not easy to find is opposite of the temple but next to to traffic light for pedestrians to cross the road is a small gate in the fence, there you enter, see pictures, go and enjoy the food there
sample_reviews_en.author: P van Wijk

sample_reviews_en.text: Visit and support the catering services at Chitralada Technology Institute, where students in the catering and food programs gain valuable hands-on experience in serving customers. I highly recommend the fried rice with salted crispy fish—it's delicious and reasonably priced. A great meal with a purpose!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Koong 8142

sample_reviews_en.text:
Currently, the restaurant only serves Waterfall Noodles (Khao Soi) and Spaghetti, along with drinks. Other à la carte dishes are still being prepared as the kitchen is closed for renovations.

Noodles are served from 9:00 AM to approximately 2:00 PM.

Drinks are available from 8:30 AM to 2:30 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chatphet Chomjai

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, but I'm annoyed by the hassle of getting in. Having to exchange a card to enter is inconvenient, making me not want to go again. The security guards at the entrance are quite arrogant, grumpy, and speak without any politeness.
sample_reviews_en.author: bhavinee vijakkhana

sample_reviews_en.text: The shrimp fried rice was delicious. The cocoa had just the right flavor, not too bitter or too sweet. The stuffed pastry was perfectly sweet with a well-balanced filling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pitchayanin Buanil

sample_reviews_en.text: 🤷🏻‍♂️🤷🏻‍♂️ No sign in front of the restaurant, I came, sat down and suddenly at 2:02 PM a lady came to me and said that the restaurant was closed.. 😃🫣 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Dominik Groh

sample_reviews_en.text:
The stir-fried chili and salt dish was delicious, tasty, and affordable.
The boat noodle soup with pork was very tasty and worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirakarn Leungsakul

restaurants.name: เจิน ห่าวชือ บางมด มันส์ไก่ สิงคโปร์
restaurants.address:

264 ซอย Rama II Soi 8, Bang Mot, Chom Thong, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Initially, I planned to just try a few things, but ended up ordering more. The chicken was tender, delicious, and fragrant with just a little sesame oil; the dipping sauce was perfectly balanced; the char siu pork was slightly dark but tender and delicious; the crispy pork belly was beautifully arranged, and when it first arrived, I thought it had no fat, just lean meat. But after tasting it, it was amazing – crispy and tender in one bite! The fried tofu was excellent, and the Osmanthus tea was fragrant and flavorful. The restroom was also clean.

The service was excellent, both the male and female staff. They recommended dishes, took orders themselves, and were attentive to the age of the customers. They didn't need too much ice.
I asked the owner, and they said you can order noodles from the neighboring shop and eat them in this restaurant too. It's great that they support each other's businesses.
**Order the "Ros Chuwong Set" – it's more worthwhile and you get to try everything. You can even take leftovers home! ✌️✌️
sample_reviews_en.author: Meiling Oh

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time trying this restaurant. I ordered the skinless Hainanese chicken rice. What impressed me most was how incredibly tender the meat was. The dipping sauce was rich in spices and incredibly flavorful, a perfect blend of flavors. Another highlight was the unique oval shape of the rice, different from other places I've tried. It was a visually appealing presentation, fragrant and delicate. What impressed me most was the crab claws included in the dish. As a big crab lover, I loved the generous amount of crab meat, and dipping it in the plum sauce was pure heaven.

Another recommended dish is the shrimp dumplings 👍. The special sauce is unique to the restaurant and very difficult to find elsewhere. If you like a slightly spicy and flavorful dish, I highly recommend it.

In short, I finished everything on my plate. It was delicious, satisfying, and great value, leaving me happy and impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: ramin taikan

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was delicious.

Slow-cooked chicken (sous vide)
Well done, tender, juicy, and not too thick.

You can choose which cut you want.
I recommend the thigh; it's tender, juicy, and the skin is lightly chewy.

The restaurant claims that the fried chicken is freshly fried for every dish.
The outside is crispy and the inside is tender, similar to karaage chicken.

The red pork is firm and has a unique aroma.
The crispy pork is dry and crumbly, but the skin isn't crispy or flaky.

It's crispy and flaky, which is quite good.

The three sauces are well-blended.
The green ones are similar to seafood, with a spicy chili paste and a well-balanced soybean sauce.

The sauces are well-blended. After eating, I forgot I usually add ginger and chili, which means the three sauces are quite tasty.

The restaurant offers two types of dark soy sauce: salty and sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kay Cee

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time intentionally eating here, and I wasn't disappointed.
- The restaurant is clean, organized, spacious, and airy, as it's quite large, occupying three shop lots. It's not air-conditioned, but it didn't feel hot.
- There's plenty of parking in front and beside the restaurant, or you can park along the street.
- The food tasted delicious and suited my palate. The preparation was meticulous, and you could feel the owner's dedication. I especially liked the chicken because it wasn't too chewy. Personally, I enjoy the chicken here; the flavor is moderate, not too strong, but good :)
- What impressed me most was the owner's service. They were attentive, spoke politely, and engaged in conversation. That was the first impression that made me want to keep coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: TN •

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were difficult to communicate with, although they had good service attitudes. They lacked knowledge of the procedures and the menu items. I'd like to see this improve. The boiled chicken was tender and delicious, but the fried chicken was cut into uneven pieces, with a thick and hard batter that was crispy, though the uneven size made it unpleasant to eat. The char siu pork was acceptable, but the crispy pork was excessively fatty. I'd like to see better quality control. Initially, a single dish cost 69 baht, but after less than a month of opening, the price increased to 75 baht. As a regular customer, I'm not impressed with the price increase without prior notice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rojjanapol Limsumungkongul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The boiled chicken was good, bouncy and tender. The roasted pork was okay.
The crispy pork was too hard, like it had been leftover and then re-fried.
I had just finished eating, put down my spoon, and drunk some water.
The person collecting the money came to clear the plates. Instead of trying the dessert, I left, even though there were many empty tables and no new customers. It felt like I was being indirectly told to leave, even though the customers who ate before me had left a while before someone came to clear their plates, but our table's plates were cleared immediately.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratcha N

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the Singaporean Hainanese Chicken Rice I've been searching for! The rice is delicious, the chicken is tender, the char siu (roasted pork) is good, and there are many dipping sauces to choose from. The menu offers a variety of dishes, both single servings and sets. The restaurant is spacious, comfortable, and easy to find, located on the main road, Rama 2 Soi 8. There's convenient parking in front of the restaurant. I'll stop by every time I'm in the area. Talking about it makes me want to eat it again! 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: AM MILK homemade

sample_reviews_en.text:
In short - very delicious. I recommend coming before 4 PM, as they make everything fresh daily.

Food: My favorites were: 1. Boiled Chicken 2. Fried Tofu (tender and chewy, like eating meatballs, but with tofu inside) 3. Roast Pork (a bit fatty, if you like it fatty, go for it).

Cleanliness: The restaurant is clean and everything is neatly arranged.

Shop: Open, not hot, on a main road.

Staff: Polite and courteous.

Parking: Parking available in front of the shop and on the side.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wichit Khaijun

restaurants.name: Jok Phochana
restaurants.address:

34 Sam Sen Rd, Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a very disappointing experience here. They claim to accept cards, but in reality, they don’t. I initially planned to eat at Try Me Thai Restaurant, but since they also didn’t accept cards, I walked a bit further and found this small, not-so-clean place.

Before ordering, I specifically asked if they accepted card payments. The lady said yes. But when it was time to pay, she suddenly said their machine wasn’t working and insisted I withdraw cash instead. Since it was my last night and I was heading to the airport at midnight, I really didn’t want to withdraw more cash. In the end, I had to pay an extra 220 baht just to withdraw money and settle the bill.

On top of that, the food wasn’t good—both the Khao Soi and crab dish tasted bad, and I couldn’t finish them.

Another thing I noticed: as a Southeast Asian, I didn’t feel welcome. They seemed friendlier towards white foreigners. I was made to move from a decent table to a wobbly table at the back, even though there were plenty of available seats. It felt disrespectful and unfair.

I wouldn’t recommend this place at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Capricorn Stellium

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went here without any particular expectations because I was disappointed about another store that sells almost the same kind of food.
The price of that store was very expensive, compared to its flavor.
But this store's food was awesome, and the price, I think, was reasonable.
If I had a chance to go to Bangkok again, I would go again.
After writing the above, I visited twice more.
And this time, in early September 2025, my wife and I went in as soon as the doors opened and ordered two Poo Pad Pong curries and one Som Tam. It was delicious.
It was a bit disappointing that there weren't many customers, perhaps because it was the off-season or because of the heavy rain.
The Poo Pad Pong curry was 450 baht, and it was delicious. Even for a big eater like me, the portion was large, so I ended up leaving with some leftovers.
Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: tour nomad

sample_reviews_en.text:
Humble place, but very very very exceptional taste! 👌🏻👌🏻👌🏻

Best experience in tasting the Thai authentic food so far. Placed in humble neighborhood of Banglamphu & Samsen Road, is like an oasis of great food & atmosphere.

The Tom Yum itself is quite sour, but caters to my-heavily-preferenced on spicier food. The shrimp in tamarind is sensational, never thought the tangy side of tamarin can be presented with shrimp harmoniously. Even the simple fried morning glory tasted exceptional.

The staffs here is very helpful and friendly, been here for few times and Mr.Lek already greets me & my friends with "Hello, my friend" ❤️

Recommended menu:

Shrimp with tamarind
Shrimp with garlic
Tom Yum soup with Seafood
Green Curry (quite spicy for my taste, please be careful 🔥🔥🔥)
sample_reviews_en.author: diani apsari

sample_reviews_en.text: I would highly recommend this place! It's a must-visit every time I'm in Bangkok, no matter how far I stay from it. The prices are incredibly reasonable and down-to-earth. The chef always recommends the freshest ingredients of the day, and the food is incredibly delicious. It's definitely one of the most authentic Thai restaurants in Bangkok. The curry crab is unparalleled—the meat is plump and flavorful, the shell is thin and crispy, and most importantly, there's absolutely no markup. Every penny is worth it! It's located next to Khao San Road, and it's fun to stroll around the lively bar district after dinner! It's also not far from the Grand Palace area. I'm writing this review simply because I hope it stays in business forever!
sample_reviews_en.author: Belle HO

sample_reviews_en.text: My group wanted to go there, but when we visited, there was sewage work (ㄸ ㅗ ㅇ ㅊ ㅏ) going on in front of the store, so we were guided to an indoor table instead of an outdoor table. However, since we didn't want to sit there, we waited for a while until ㄸ ㅗ ㅇ ㅊ ㅏ went and went back, but were turned away because there was a reservation. There seemed to be plenty of seats, but the owner's response was a bit neurotic, which was disappointing. Personally, he wasn't friendly, and based on my many experiences, I didn't feel like it was a good restaurant. There are many restaurants in Bangkok with better service and taste, so I recommend keeping that in mind when you visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hyon Kim

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was one of the best little side of the road restaurants I have eaten at in Bangkok and honestly Thailand.

The food itself was great but the environment of even with it just being on the side of the road the owner or cook the one who was making the food was amazing he obviously loves what he does and he had such great energy was dancing along to the music playing and checked on me for every dish.
He is someone who loves what he does and does what he loves.
It's slightly out of the way of things which makes it the perfect local style spot.

If I could get service 6 Stars I would
sample_reviews_en.author: Marlow

sample_reviews_en.text:
The seasoning is exquisite!! It suits the Japanese palate. There's a Japanese menu, but it only covers about 20% of the menu. They recommend the crab curry, which is 450 baht. Other dishes average around 150 baht. The portions are quite large, so two dishes might be too much for one person.

It's not the most hygienic place as it's outdoors with cars and people passing by, but the food is delicious. There are lots of flies and mosquitoes, so it's best to bring insect repellent.

The staff are friendly and great!!
sample_reviews_en.author: izaya -yahn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every time we are in Bangkok, we eat here at the beginning and end of our trip.

The quality of the food is fantastic and it is very cheap here.

The lady and gentleman at Jok Pochana are incredibly friendly.

It is always a treat to be here.
We get to go again the day after tomorrow 🥳.

You can really eat for next to nothing here, but because everything is so delicious, we want to taste everything and fill the whole table.
sample_reviews_en.author: Katelijne Lemmend

restaurants.name: Ministry of Crab Bangkok
restaurants.address:

15, 1 Sukhumvit 31, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pros:
•       Friendly staff
•	Crab meat itself was fresh and flavorful.
•	Garlic bread was very good; we liked it so much that we ordered a second portion.
•	Clams are must have to try for those who enjoy.

Cons:
•	The crab fried rice was very bland and contained paprika, which was not mentioned on the menu. I have an allergy, so I had to remove it manually in order to eat the dish, and we did not finish the rice. Clear ingredient disclosure would be helpful.
•	The prawns were overcooked.
•	The “garlic butter” sauce lacked a noticeable garlic flavor and tasted mostly like oil with chili and spices.
•	Pricing is high compared to similar seafood restaurants in Bangkok.

Conclusion:
The total bill for two people was around 200 EUR, including water and two drinks. All prices already included VAT and service fee. While the overall quality is acceptable, the restaurant feels overpriced. In Bangkok, from experience, it’s easy to find seafood places offering comparable crab and prawn dishes at a much better value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel FL

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had an absolutely unforgettable dining experience at Ministry of Crab Bangkok. We ordered the 1.1kg Garlic Chili Crab, and it was cooked to perfection — bursting with flavor, beautifully tender, and expertly balanced in spice and aroma. Paired with the garlic fried rice, the crab was made with fresh olive oil so fragrant and authentic you could immediately taste the quality, the meal was simply outstanding.

The service was equally impressive. A special shoutout to Head Chef Harsha, who went above and beyond to make our evening memorable. He’s an absolute gem — warm, attentive, and genuinely passionate about his craft. He even surprised us with a thoughtful token to celebrate our visit to three Ministry of Crab restaurants in three different countries.

Overall, it was an exceptional culinary experience — from the food to the hospitality — and we highly recommend it to anyone who appreciates great seafood and heartfelt service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aleef Pasha

sample_reviews_en.text: When you first set foot into the restaurant, you know you have walked into somewhere special. Everything is nicely decorated, napkins are folded perfectly. Everything was just nice and prefect. We had the 1kg crab cooked in Singapore chili. It did not disappoint. To be completely honest, I have had crab less than 5 times in my life. Mostly because i see its too much work for very little gain. But this 1kg was different. The meat separated easily and that are so many flavor hitting you all at the same time. The OMG prawn was very good also. I ordered a basket of bread just to soak up the priceless sauce. The cocktail was brilliant as well. Waiting staff came to check in us through out the meal to make sure everything is prefect. What a great dinning experience. Friendly and comfortable. They just do everything perfectly better than all others.
sample_reviews_en.author: Biohazard

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ministry of Crab Bangkok brings the legendary Sri Lankan crab experience to the city with style and confidence. Specializing in premium mud crabs sourced from Sri Lanka, the restaurant lives up to its reputation for bold flavors and top-tier seafood quality.

The crabs are undoubtedly the star—meaty, fresh, and cooked to perfection. Signature preparations like the iconic chili crab showcase deep, complex spices with just the right balance of heat and richness, while letting the natural sweetness of the crab shine through. Portions are generous, and each dish feels indulgent and well thought out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wisanu Tuntawiroon

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re a fan of massive, meaty crabs, you have to check out this franchise from Sri Lanka! They fly in live crabs and prawns directly from Sri Lanka twice a week, so the freshness is on another level.
​The crabs are huge and packed with meat. We got the Jumbo size, and the claws were literally almost as big as my arm! At only 4,700 THB, it easily fed 4 of us. They offer a huge variety of sauces to choose from, and the prawns are incredibly fresh with rich, creamy roe

The chef and staffs are very friendly, especially the Restaurant manager who helps us crack the crab😁. Definitely recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mmee Eatwithmmee

sample_reviews_en.text: To be honest, Ministry of Crab feels extremely overpriced for what it offers. While it’s a good addition in places with limited seafood options, it doesn’t stand out in Thailand where excellent seafood spots are everywhere. I tried both crab and seafood dishes here and found them comparable to what local restaurants serve at a fraction of the price. The food quality is good, but it doesn’t justify the premium. The overall experience is fine for a one-time visit, but there are many local seafood places nearby that deliver similar taste and freshness for much better value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gandalf

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had an amazing dining experience at Ministry of Crab Bangkok. The crab was incredibly sweet, fresh, and cooked to perfection. The service was outstanding
attentive, friendly, and professional throughout the evening. Both the quality of the food and the level of service truly exceeded my expectations. The pricing is absolutely fair for the exceptional freshness and flavor that they deliver. Overall, it was a perfect balance of taste, quality, and hospitality. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone who loves premium seafood and top-notch service.😍🙏🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Alessia

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good place!  But the review comes with an asterisk that I didn’t have namesake crab.   I did have the crab kaprow and a large prawn.  I would Defenitly want to review it again having more food. However from what I ate I really did enjoy it. The crab dish was plentiful and flavorful and the prawn was big and chunky.  You can only wish lobsters tasted this good in the states.  The chili garlic sauce matched well with the shellfish and was delicious to soak up on its own with the bread.

I will certainly go back on a return trip. No complaints!
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Maros

restaurants.name: Tairyo Sushi - Ladprao (ตึก S-OASIS)
restaurants.address:

Vibhavadi Rangsit Rangsit, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a Japanese restaurant that my business partner in Thailand actually bring me to eat because it is near his office. We went during lunch time and there was a crowd but we still managed to get a table.

Bright and cosy environment. I went for lunch set with grilled salmon, salad, soup and drink. The order came around 15 min time. The grilled salmon was a bit overcooked but still alright for me.
sample_reviews_en.author: Finnz

sample_reviews_en.text: Super slow service. Grilled salmon was overcooked, dry and tasteless. We have to wait for our food for almost an hour and need to follow up with waitress many times. Understand that this is due to lunch time but we arrived early when restaurant still empty until pack and the rest already have their food served.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tuangdej Pinsupakiat

sample_reviews_en.text: I inquired with the staff about an incomplete salad set, expecting only an explanation of which items were received and which were not. Instead, the staff responded rudely, snapping back with a harsh "No!" without any explanation. The service was quite poor considering the price of the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kullanan Khamtha

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I tried Tairyo Sushi at the S-Oasis building. I went in without high expectations because I wasn't familiar with the name, but after trying the food, I was pleasantly surprised by how delicious everything was. For example, I ordered …
sample_reviews_en.author: WPC.

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant displayed a "Half-Half" sign, which encouraged customers to enter the store. However, when it came time to pay, they were told that they could not use the "Half-Half" option because the bill could not be split. There was no …
sample_reviews_en.author: Natty S

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was good.  I enjoyed both dishes.  The service was great - credit of the two waitresses N.Avon and N.Sky who were very proactive.  As it’s located in an office building, don’t expect an atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuch

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and high quality. The Tom Yum udon has a great flavor, the noodles are perfectly cooked—not mushy, not hard. Dashi soup is free. The price is reasonable, and the sesame dressing is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: N Yanachan

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! The food looks exactly like the pictures, no deception. Fresh and clean. I just stopped by to try it because the advertisement pictures made it look so delicious. Highly recommend! …
sample_reviews_en.author: Erk-Erk Erk-Erk

restaurants.name: S&P (Siriraj Hospital)
restaurants.address:

Siriraj Hospital at the welfare shop (84-year-old building), 2 Phan, Phran Nok Road, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We entered the restaurant and found an empty table, but the staff directed us upstairs to the second floor. We went up, but there were no seats available, so we had to walk back down. The table that had been empty initially was already occupied by other customers who arrived later. When we asked the staff why they made us go upstairs, they replied, "Oh! There are no tables?" We then asked, "Why didn't you check properly whether there were tables available or not? You just told us to go upstairs!" The staff couldn't answer, only saying there were several people waiting in line and pointing to a list of names. However, we looked around the restaurant and saw no one waiting for a table. If there was a queue, why didn't they tell us beforehand? Did they want to join the queue? ... The service was terrible, and we don't plan to use their services again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mildtrus

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch is located in Siriraj Hospital and has two floors. The second floor has a nice atmosphere and the staff provides excellent service. However, the food is average. The shrimp chili paste fried rice was mediocre, similar to frozen food that was reheated. The eggplant was pale, almost gray, and the salted egg had a lot of shell fragments stuck to it. But the shrimp was delicious (I forgot to take a picture of this dish). The iced traditional tea was sickeningly sweet, even for someone who usually eats a lot of sweet drinks. The food was served quite slowly; I saw the table next to me get impatient and ask for takeout.
sample_reviews_en.author: PuM Wannisa

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's located in the heart of Siriraj Hospital. It has two floors and a huge variety of items for sale, including snacks, cooked food, and even coffee.

This branch is always packed with people rushing to order and buy. There aren't enough staff, and sometimes they just don't speak politely or frown. I'm really fed up. The menu is getting smaller and smaller, and I don't want to wait long.

I ordered two fried eggs, and after half an hour, I still haven't eaten them, so I had to cancel. I won't be eating at this branch again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kitibordee Yindeear-rom

sample_reviews_en.text: The long wait for food is understandable because there are many people, but when the food was served, it was cold, as if it had barely been heated, even though they said it was freshly made. So, is the food cooked fresh dish by dish, or are they just microwaved frozen food? The kitchen staff should pay more attention to detail, because even if people who come to the hospital only occasionally want to eat quality food that matches the price. The front-of-house staff provided okay service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Modthanoi Saikou

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, January 19, 2026, at approximately 7:00 PM, I ordered an espresso at the branch in Siriraj Hospital (near the 84-Year Building). The staff made it very weak, almost tasteless and without any aroma. It was terrible and below standard. Please improve the quality of your staff to meet the required recipe. Don't let employees like this tarnish the brand's reputation. If this happens again, I will ask to speak to the manager or supervisor and will provide feedback in person.
sample_reviews_en.author: nirutchara

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a great place to escape the heat. I personally already like S&P's coffee. Today I tried the green curry roti with beef shank. The green curry was delicious, not too sweet, and had a rich flavor. The beef was tender and not too chewy. The roti was a little oily, but eating it with the green curry helped to mask some of the oiliness. The place has two floors with comfortable, air-conditioned seating. Come and try the food!
sample_reviews_en.author: ThE JuK MoNsTeR

sample_reviews_en.text: Waiters’ service leave much to be desired. Asked to get orders many times, no reply nor gesture to say ‘please wait, will come right away. Asked water with ice for 3 times, came nothing. Order 3 dishes, being informed later that 2 dishes are not available in 2 separate times. Food delivered without a word, just placed on table indifferently. Water and ice finally came last. So curious how they are trained.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichaya Lapasthamrong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was average, but quite expensive considering the price.

The service was terrible; the queuing system was awful. Even after getting a table, people cut in line and immediately sat down.
The table arrangement, order taking, and serving were chaotic. There was no clear order of tasks; no queueing system in place.

The atmosphere was cramped and stuffy, and the air conditioning wasn't working.
sample_reviews_en.author: iZTECH

restaurants.name: 3Bz Burritoz Pool Garden
restaurants.address:

27/7 Pattaya 3rd Rd, ต.หนองปรือ, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tasty & affordable mexican food. I would usually go for Thai food here, but after staying in Thailand for a month I missed Mexican food.

We went for lunch and it not busy at all. The two people working there were both so nice and welcoming! They made sure we had everything we need and checked up on us, food came fast and hot.

The burritos were indeed huge and very filling. The chips & salsa was tasty and the chips were hot and fresh! The burritos were maybe a bit dry but I think it’s due to the shredded chicken, otherwise they were great, pretty basic but good. They came w an extra side of salsa and we also got sour cream with it which i recommend!

Overall it hit the spot for my cravings and was filling & I had a great time chatting with them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Isabelle Papenfuss

sample_reviews_en.text: Apologies for slow review, Google has been glitching. Overall a nice but small Mex restaurant. I found the portion sizing to be fine. Saw some comment about "small" but have never ordered a "mini". Likewise, Fire Hot Sauce rated a 3-4 for spiciness so I suppose people's complaints are somewhat subjective. The refried beans are well prepped and hope not assumed to be a Rosarita refried bean mush, these have a nice more crisped texture and excellent flavor. Was quite pleased with all ordered! BTW, thought to have ordered the BS7. Perhaps I ended up with BS1. Then again, can eat bhut jolokia... but if the hot sauce is out of context with the dish, it’s an untasty mismatch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Robbz Haney

sample_reviews_en.text:
Maybe the menu has changed as I didn’t see anything Mexican on it

I had the sesame tuna steak and my friend had a bavetta  steak. Food is so delicious. We finished our plates in less than 10mins 😄. Played some pool and had a few cocktails as well.

The woman who run the bar and restaurant are the most welcoming people. Place has good chill vibes. Me and my friend could have easily hanged out there all day. Also, the girls who run the bar are very attentive; you could tell that they really care about your experience at the place.

I’d definitely go back 👍🏽👍🏽👍🏽 wish I’d taken a picture with the restaurant bar staff; lovely people
sample_reviews_en.author: Dionys Gragousian

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered a Carnitas Burrito on a very wet nasty day did not feel like going out and getting anything to eat good day to be lazy. So I gave them a call gave them my order I was told the food would be here within 25 maybe 30 minutes due to the weather the food arrived in 15 minutes. The food arrived hot something most delivery places Can't Get Right. The product was excellent I have recommended them many times and I myself will be using them again in the future. There are many Mexican restaurants now here in Pattaya and I have eaten that about all of them I don't think any of them are as close to being as good as they are here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yesitis Dakid

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have ordered delivery using GRAB multiple times. I've never been to the actual restaurant.

I have tried the chicken burrito and soft taco. The taco is okay but I'm not sure if i will order it again.

The chicken burrito is good but I get the basic version. I haven't gotten the upgraded version with shredded chicken, and I think pinto beans are available.

That's what I'm going to try the next time I order from there
sample_reviews_en.author: Somchai Camilo

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here after seeing it on YouTube as a place for cheap and delicious breakfast. The menu is extensive, and best of all, it's cheap and delicious. You can even get refills on your coffee.

This time I had the standard toast, fried egg, and hash browns, but next time I'd like to order the cowboy breakfast or a burrito.

Looking at the menu, it seems like they're really promoting burritos, so I'm very interested.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daisuke Murayama

sample_reviews_en.text: This review is primarily about the burritos. I highly recommend eating the food at the location itself. I only visit this place for the beef burrito. It’s more Tex-Mex than Mexican! Don’t forget to ask for extra pico de gallo. The ambiance here is always relaxing and inviting. If you’re not in a hurry, I highly suggest going. I’ve visited this place twice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pie S (The Original Pie)

sample_reviews_en.text: Lived in Los Angeles and Mexico, so you could say I'm a Taco connoisseur. These are some of the best ground Beef Tacos I've ever had. I tried a soft shell and hardshell, both great, both significant amount of Beef, corn hardshell def tastes delicious and homemade, homemade taco sauce is also delicious. 9/10 Beef Tacos. Bravo!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ryan A

restaurants.name: thongsmith HOT POT EMSPHERE
restaurants.address:

516 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've visited Thong Smith at different locations many times. This was my second time trying the Thai hot pot beef set.

I only dared to choose Level 1 spiciness for the tom yum soup, and it was still quite spicy 🔥 The dipping sauce is delicious, so make sure to read the instructions and follow the recommended steps for the best experience.

I also ordered the traditional Lod Chong for dessert. To be honest, I often feel that the desserts at Thong Smith are the real stars of the menu, sometimes even more memorable than the noodles themselves 😅

I also enjoy their drink selection, and some of the side dishes are surprisingly good.

Thong Smith is not the cheap option, but the quality of the food and the service are consistently good. Come hungry and enjoy. Bon appétit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Winona Wang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Liked the food. Totally hated the service.
Q is long, biz is good yea.
There are bunch of tables with customers who have finished and just chatting, your staff and even manager did not know how to do crowd control. Is fine we waited even more patiently despite seeing seat-hogging customers who refused to spare a thought for other diners.
Yet after 2 long hrs when its finally our turn; we are dining to near closing time, we are being rushed to finish the food; so you actually do know how to do crowd control but only when it affects your knock-off time? Was disgusted by the quality of service.

Edit 2026: revisted again, much less Q, maybe hype over or more shops setup easing the crowd. Food is good service is alright now. Will recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Whye Kin Woo

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there on a friend's recommendation, and the moment I saw it, I thought, "What is this? Oh, is this another failure?" That's because the color of the soup was completely different from what I had imagined, so first-timers might be a bit taken aback. Judging by the color, I thought Level 3 would be safe enough, so I ordered that, and it really is Level 3 spiciness. As for the taste of the soup... it's hard to describe; I think it would be wise to just try it for yourself. Since I like meat, I ordered only beef, but even though we ordered a moderate amount of various things, we ended up eating a lot. Was spending around 2,000 won for two people a bit excessive?
sample_reviews_en.author: 안드레아

sample_reviews_en.text:
We waited around 25min for this which is not too bad imo.
This is a traditional boat noodle kinda restaurant turn posh in a way i rekon, food are are real nice here.
Its a hotpot resraurant where you can choose ur protein eg pork/beef and it comes with two side dish mainly vegetables and some beef parts (innerds) which are included in the package, but you can add on more dish to your liking.
The broth for the beef pot are delicious and so are the meat so tender and so good
sample_reviews_en.author: lim jenn ching

sample_reviews_en.text:
Premium Waterfall Noodle Soup

The price feels a bit high.
Good service from the staff.

If you like spicy food, choose the first soup option that isn't Waterfall style.
The dipping sauce is spicy, flavorful, and delicious.

Pork and vegetables are served in Japanese shabu-shabu style.

Recommended to order the calamansi juice; it's refreshingly sour and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yumi 1412

sample_reviews_en.text: No matter how many times I eat here, the soup is still incredibly flavorful and rich. Although the price is a bit high, the taste and portion size are definitely worth it. However, I recommend choosing the non-spicy option if you don't like spicy food or prefer less spice (even level 1 is still quite spicy). The staff are friendly, polite, and always smiling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khun Ying

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the braised beef and tendon salad. The dish came with far more tendon than beef; there were only one or two pieces of beef. After finishing and checking out, the staff offered to make me another portion to take home as compensation. I have to give them that! Service and compensation deserve 5 stars. A must-try menu item:
“Sichuan Wonton Salad”
sample_reviews_en.author: Narisada Kaweenantawong

sample_reviews_en.text: I've used their services many times before, and I'm just as impressed as before today. All the staff are incredibly helpful, polite, and provide excellent recommendations. They're very attentive to customers. The prices might seem a bit high, but considering the quality of the food and service, it makes me want to keep coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: butacorn

restaurants.name: ร้านอาหารครัวพันธุ์ไม้ พัทยาใต้ ถนนทัพพระยาซ.13
restaurants.address:

391 79 หนองปรือ Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food pictures looked delicious, so we were interested. We called last month and were told it was closed for renovations for 3 days.😆 Yesterday we called again and were told it was closed, but would reopen tomorrow. We were okay with that. Today we went there and it was closed. We wasted 150 baht on a taxi each way, 300 baht round trip. Ugh, why did they say it was open? It was a huge waste of time.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธีรยุทธ สายคําภา

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went in the morning and the food wasn't so fresh. I'll go again at night when the owner told me there will be more people and music.
Right now 3 stars.
I'll see if I could give more in the future.

In short, nothing special... but that's okay.
The food wasn't the freshest, but I went for lunch and it seems like this place is great for dinner.
We'll see in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gigen Daisuke

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love this place!
I love the terrace; it feels like you're in the jungle.
The service is very attentive.
The food is delicious. The only thing is, I love the pork nukle, and one day it's great, and another day you can tell it's been around for a few days and it's not as good. It's a bit of a gamble, but only with this one dish. Everything else is very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alejandro González García

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a shame the waiter inflated the bill with the drinks. We ordered two soda waters. We never saw the bottles. He poured one soda into two glasses with ice. In the end, the bill came to 140 THB instead of 60 THB… and even 30 THB considering the departure flight. It's a shame because the food was good. Be careful with your bills; double-check them!
sample_reviews_en.author: Serge.L

sample_reviews_en.text: Bad service. We went here, didn’t get anything. We asked a waitress if we could sit outside of the AC room then she said yes. Afterwards she never came back to us even we tried to call her and her colleagues but nobody cares. They might think that we only wanna sit there not want to eat at their place. So we just left.
sample_reviews_en.author: Plearn Chaipichitpan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted delicious and the atmosphere was nice. The only downside was the woman in the red suit who took our order; she wasn't very polite. However, the other waitstaff were very courteous.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boss Tromey

sample_reviews_en.text: I order there and they charge like 5 star hotel my god i ma shock is thai food if you order in 5 star hotel is not expensive and as copare price food is so worst terrible next time i never go this
sample_reviews_en.author: Mangesh Kawle

sample_reviews_en.text: I highly recommend it. Wheelchair users are also very welcome. The food is simply delicious, not overly spicy, but still well-seasoned. Definitely worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Udo Skoluda

restaurants.name: Hishou
restaurants.address:

1st Floor Hotel Nikko Bangkok 27 Soi Sukhumvit 55 (Thonglor),Sukhumvit Road Klongtan Nua, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Came here for a Thai Travel Fair buffet, 1150฿/person.
The atmosphere was quiet and peaceful. The staff were attentive and provided good service. The food was reasonably tasty.
Focused on seafood, which was quite fresh.

Australian Beef had a slight odor and was a bit tough.
Ribeye Beef had a delicious aroma.
sample_reviews_th.author: Jutatip Th. (Leng)

sample_reviews_en.text:
For those who love Japanese food,
you must try this place: HISHOU restaurant.
The highlight of the restaurant is
an authentic Osaka-style Japanese shabu-shabu buffet.
Unlimited Thai Wagyu beef is served along with a variety of fresh vegetables.
There are two soup options: clear broth and dark broth.
Two dipping sauces are available: sesame soy sauce and ponzu.
Finally, a variety of desserts are offered,
including special sauce ice cream and seasonal fresh fruit.

In addition, they have other menu items to choose from.
You can also order à la carte dishes.
And what I highly recommend is the Tempura.
There are various tempura rice bowls with a secret sauce to choose from.
Unlimited rice and soup refills are available.
The chef fries each dish fresh to order,
right in front of you at the counter bar, just like at a famous restaurant in Japan.
What I really love is that every dish is fried fresh using an imported Japanese fryer.
The batter is thin and crispy, not oily, and the secret sauce is fragrant, delicious, and perfectly balanced.
Tempura lovers will definitely be thrilled!
sample_reviews_en.author: Psstory Chanel

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything here was delicious! The ingredients were incredibly fresh, especially the vegetables.

The grilled saba with teriyaki sauce was outstanding—perfectly cooked, juicy, and incredibly fresh. My mom absolutely loved it.

The steamed egg (chawanmushi) was one of the best I've had. It was silky smooth, flavorful, and had no eggy smell at all.

The Obanzai selection was also excellent. We enjoyed almost every dish, and the shrimp karaage was especially delicious.

The staff were incredibly attentive and took great care of us throughout our meal. The atmosphere was quiet, peaceful, and not crowded, making the whole dining experience even more relaxing.

Great food, fresh ingredients, outstanding service, and a wonderful atmosphere. We'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Phenrung Chiewcharnvalijkit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Bringing Japan to the heart of Thonglor! Premium shabu-shabu and juicy sashimi, the vibe is so good you'll feel like you're in Tokyo 🇯🇵✨
Looking for a place to hang out with friends or have a special dinner with family? This modern, warm, and comfortable Japanese restaurant offers a huge selection of dishes!
•
The atmosphere is bright and airy with great design taste. Every corner is perfect for taking photos, and it's the ideal space to sit, eat, and chat for a long time. If you're looking for a Japanese restaurant in the heart of the city that excels in both taste and atmosphere, this is it!
sample_reviews_en.author: GhamYuiiZy #ไปกะเปี๊ยก

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything here exclaims "Japanese", the food, service and atmosphere. The quality and the test of the food is very good and authentically Japanese. The atmosphere is cosy and wuietly elegant. They also have shabu buffet. Now they have set lunch with a small selections of appetizer, side dishes and dessert, but I was informed that they will discontinue the buffet soon. The price is somewhat high, around 1,000 bath plus for lunch. The shabu buffet starts from 780++ to 1250++ per person depending on the menu you choose, which is on the high side, but the quality and services ard premium.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tana Nilchaikovit

sample_reviews_en.text: We were in Bangkok for two weeks recently, decided to have something different than Thai food, therefore we came to the Nikko hotel for some yummy Japanese food and it did not disappoint. The restaurant itself is beautiful and stylish, a very calming space to enjoy your food. The services was excellent, very attentive and friendly staffs. Four of us decided to for their set lunch which comes with a nice little buffet bar with starters, salads and desserts. All of us were happy with the foods, really happy that we came here for Japanese. A nice gem in Bangkok 😘
sample_reviews_en.author: Kevin

sample_reviews_en.text: I was impressed from the moment I called to make a reservation. The restaurant provided excellent food recommendations, and the prices were very reasonable. We had the lunch set menu and were very impressed. On Mother's Day, August 12th, 2026, there was a workshop with activities – a lovely Mother's Day class. The staff were cheerful and smiling. Ploy, Tor, and Gab definitely added some fun elements. There were also stylish photo opportunities. After our meal, they offered complimentary fragrant egg tarts, which made the meal even more satisfying.
sample_reviews_en.author: P. Phattanamongkol

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hishou now offers an izakaya buffet, starting at 1099++ baht. However, if you're a fan of A5 Wagyu beef, I recommend upgrading to 1599++ baht for approximately 10 additional dishes. You have 2 hours to dine, but drinks are not included.
Everything was great. The food tasted delicious, the portions were small, perfect for a buffet. But the highlight was Chef Thanu!
Chef Thanu provided excellent service, from recommending dishes to cooking and serving the food himself. Overall, I was very impressed and will definitely return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawat Ruangkriengsin

restaurants.name: PATIO at EmQuartier
restaurants.address:

2nd floor, The Helix Quartier, Emquartier, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lower than expected.

The restaurant offers a wide variety of dishes, but considering the relatively high prices, I expected the food quality to be much better. Unfortunately, the overall dining experience was disappointing. The truffle pasta, a dish that is usually a safe choice, was particularly underwhelming.

Service was also below expectations. After our order was taken and the food was served, it was difficult to get any assistance from the staff. Even requesting condiments for the fries took some effort, despite there being only four occupied tables in the entire restaurant.

For just two dishes and water, the bill came to nearly 1,100 baht, which made the lackluster food and service even harder to justify.

On a positive note, the restaurant has a quiet and peaceful atmosphere, making it a good choice for those seeking a serene dining experience. The interior design is tasteful and well-executed. However, the ambiance alone was not enough to make up for the disappointing food and service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amy N.

sample_reviews_en.text:
After shopping at EmQuartier, we went to "PATIO AT EMQUARTIER."

Located on the second floor, we went in without much expectation, but it was nice to be able to relax while looking at the greenery of the courtyard.

Looking at the other customers, several people were ordering enough food for two or three meals, so I thought this might be a cafe with delicious food and decided to order one dish.

Since we had dinner plans soon after, we shared a GRILLED NORWEGIAN SALMON between the two of us.

The mashed potatoes on the side were incredibly delicious, something we hadn't anticipated at all. We ended up eating them all, putting them on the salmon and dipping the vegetables in them.

I think I'll go back just for the mashed potatoes. Lol

〈What we ordered〉
◎YUZU PEACH TEA 155B
◎AMERICANO 135B
◎GRILLED NORWEGIAN SALMON 520B
TOTAL 953.37B
sample_reviews_en.author: Rei
