sample_reviews_en.text:
This place just keeps getting worse every time I visit. Most of the dishes I used to order regularly are gone from the menu, and the food takes forever to come out—even when the restaurant is almost empty.

The staff don’t really pay attention to customers at all. Before, there used to be a male manager who was very polite and always looked after my family’s table really well. But in the last 2–3 visits, it feels like there’s no manager around anymore. The staff just stand around chatting with each other instead of checking on customers.

It’s a shame because this used to be my family’s go-to spot for years. I know they’re down to just one branch now, but if things don’t improve, it’ll be really hard for them to compete with other places.
sample_reviews_en.author: louis Santos

sample_reviews_en.text:
I am appalled at the service, maybe it’s because it’s Sunday evening and there’s no manager.

A simple request asking for bread had to be cancelled as it took too long for it to arrive.

When I ordered the bread I was reminded that it would cost me 30 baht!!

Staff standing around laughing maybe they treat “Farangs” different  to Thais when it comes to service.

Or maybe I am dressed to casual!

Who knows
sample_reviews_en.author: Carole Montana

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Truffle Mushroom Pasta, Fried Crab Rice, Calamari, and Ribeye Steak were all delicious, perfect for eating with the kids.

The Mushroom Pizza was tasty, but the Salami was so-so.

The Lobster Linguine was decent, and the Clam White Wine Spaghetti was good.

I don't recommend the Crispy Chicken Steak.

It was way too hard.

The Iced Americano was so good!!

You definitely have to try it♡
sample_reviews_en.author: 박주영

sample_reviews_en.text: I expected a bit more. I saw the words Napoli style pizza, and thought, “Gonna have wonderful dough.” But not really near what you might get in Napoli. And the taste was average. We payed just over 1,000 baht for two pizzas and sodas. I finished half of mine, because I wasn’t so much in love with the taste. So thats my honest opinion on the pizza. Maybe the pasta was much better?
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter DeWit

sample_reviews_en.text: This is our 4th time at Patio. The garlic bread and chicken wings were exceptional. It was amazing then we got to the main dishes.  So me and my mom ordered pasta I ordered carbonara  it was average nothing to crazy then we got to deserts . I ordered cheesecake and it was beyond exceptional, very tasty and the price is reasonable. It is an amazing experience overall at Pation.
sample_reviews_en.author: maymyatwin

sample_reviews_en.text: I just ate there for the first time. The food and desserts were delicious, and the staff provided great service. The prices were a bit high, but that's typical for this area. We sat at a table facing outwards, and the view was just okay. The table wasn't very tidy, hard to describe, but the food was delicious, so I forgive that. I'll definitely go again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nung Juthamas

restaurants.name: Mayura
restaurants.address:

361/8 Moo 10 Nongprue, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were fooled by the high ratings. We ordered biryani, vegetables, malai kofta, and tea. About 40 minutes later, after a reminder, the tea arrived.
We waited an hour for the food! They brought everything at once: cold biryani, warm vegetables, and hot malai kofta. So, they cooked it one at a time and served it all at once. The food was so-so, just spicy and lacking any Indian spices. Even the biryani on Indian trains tastes much better. In my opinion, this place is disgusting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Андрей Никифоров

sample_reviews_en.text: I took the buffet. Staff were polite and the service was good. The buffet selection were alright for the price and the food was tasty too. One suggestion if the management reads the reviews though. Instead of so many items like lemon juice, salt, sugar, chilli powde, pickles kept in big bowls, better to keep them in small cups and add in curds to the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sudhir Sundararaju

sample_reviews_en.text:
I am Japanese. I had dinner at this restaurant on my trip to Thailand.
The food tasted very good. I was able to adjust the spiciness, and I was able to eat my favorite curry.

I am Japanese. I had dinner at this restaurant on my trip to Thailand.
The food tasted very delicious. I was able to adjust the spiciness, so I was able to eat my favorite curry.
sample_reviews_en.author: 吉本勇太

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have been to Bangkok & Pattaya for a trip of 1 week. This is the best Indian restaurant especially it would be loved by Telugu people. It is a Vegetarian restaurant but non-vegetarian would also be served on demand from their other branch which is side by.
Mayura other name is NUHA FOOD CO LTD.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pranav Athreya

sample_reviews_en.text: Very bad. Ordered food through Grab for children to eat. Already specified the directions from the message and through the rider that I don't want spicy at all. But what I received was extremely spicy. Children can't eat it. Wasted a lot of money. Very bad. Greedy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Budsara Ekwarakunakorn

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a very nice food we are here stay 5 days and we every day lunch and dinner eat in this restaurant ...so nice behaviour staff and cooperative and for vegetarians this restaurant very good
sample_reviews_en.author: Bhuresh sankhla

sample_reviews_en.text: food is very awesome we eat here breakfast it's so tasty ..and staff also here very nice behavior thanks mayura restaurant for give us very tasty breakfast
sample_reviews_en.author: Jerald Carlo

sample_reviews_en.text: Great Indian food! Indian food is always a gem! This restaurant too. The food is full of flavours. The bottom line: you get a lot of bang for the bucks.
sample_reviews_en.author: John

restaurants.name: ร้านมยุรา หัวปลา
restaurants.address:

QGJJ+J6F แยกเศรษฐศิริ Thanon Nakhon Chai Si, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: They have a variety of dishes, including wild game. Mostly people come here to drink alcohol. The restaurant isn't 100% hot, and it has a retractable roof that can be closed if it rains. The food comes out very quickly. The prices are inexpensive; we ordered 5 dishes, drinks, and rice for 195 baht per person.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tong Limmontree

sample_reviews_en.text: This late-night restaurant, perfect for those who enjoy drinks, serves both liquor and beer. It's been around for a very long time, long enough to send its children to become chefs in famous hotels. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponchagarj Ngamukos

sample_reviews_en.text: Good food with affordable price, with nice waiters and owners, very welcome to foreign tourists. Recommended places to eat or just drink and chill with ur bro
sample_reviews_en.author: Rifqy Zacky Ariadhy

sample_reviews_en.text: The à la carte dishes are delicious and flavorful, but sometimes a little salty. The Tom Yum soup is excellent. There is no parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phattharawadee S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff are largely blind and completely ignore customers.
The owner manages the place well, but the staff are terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tadsanee Khumfueng

sample_reviews_en.text: Oh no, the shop was closed when I went. What a shame, I really wanted to eat there.
sample_reviews_en.author: ตี๋เล็ก nilchaona

restaurants.name: Hustlers Diner & Sports Lounge Pattaya
restaurants.address:

317 Soi Lengkee, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I come here many times to play pool.
Two 9 foot tables are good and well taken cared off.
There is a smoking and non-smoking area. Good music and sometimes a live performance, then it is loud.
I don't care because it's a good performance with diverse music.
I ate here some pretty good burgers, but sadly the chef is gone and at this moment and you can't order food.
But pizza/ pasta delivery is possible.
Service ladies are nice and not annoy you for drinks.
So overall it's a good sports bar and mostly orientated on playing pool.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neet

sample_reviews_en.text: Great friendly atmosphere with all world sports coverage on numerous screens, nice beautiful and friendly girls, plenty of eight ball competitions, darts competition, great variety of food at great prices and above all, a very accommodating and friendly Aussie owner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ralph Grapentin

sample_reviews_en.text: Great  place, good food  and beer, if you like to watch sport on tv, this the place,  has 3 pool tables, one upstairs in VIP area,  friendly staff  and 2 good owners,  well worth a visit,  try the fish and chips, also  has darts, and live music  certain evenings
sample_reviews_en.author: steven odonoghue

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went monday on pool night
Was a bit drunk but remember it being a friendly place with the locals making me feel welcome
Good pool table and good players
Will be back once ive got rid of the hangover
Owner was a nice man again was made to feel welcome
sample_reviews_en.author: MikeHunt Hunt

sample_reviews_en.text: Great high quality pool tables and cues, pool is FREE. Quick service, good prices on drinks and typically good music being played. Any sport you want is either on the numerous TVs or just ask and they will put it on for you. Nice food and menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: James Quilley

sample_reviews_en.text: They don't make food anymore but you can have food delivered.  There are 2 good sized pool tables and the service is not pushy. The air conditioning is welcome but unfortunately some of the patrons were smoking and that spoiled the experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tony Grima

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hustlers is a great bar to enjoy the drink of your choice and have some great food in. Fully air-conditioned,
very good music played at a sensible volume, 2 x 1st class pool tables and comfortable seating.
All in all a great place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Gray

sample_reviews_en.text: Stopped by with a friend tonight for a couple of drinks really nice relaxed upscale Club very good food menu. Somebody that is well-known here in town was providing music just a very comfortable place I will definitely return
sample_reviews_en.author: Yesitis Dakid

restaurants.name: La marmite
restaurants.address:

24 Soi Ban Sai Ma, Sai Ma, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a nice riverside atmosphere, but the food doesn't quite match the price. The live music was a bit too quiet for an outdoor setting. It was okay if you sat inside near the stage, but sitting by the water was not good; it lacked appeal due to the low volume. The waitstaff were good, but perhaps because there weren't many guests that day, the PR staff helped with serving. They were lovely and attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: สาธินี สุวรรณเสวตร

sample_reviews_en.text: I've seen many reviews criticizing the food, saying it's not delicious. At first, I didn't really believe it...but now I do. Not only is it not delicious, but the quality of the food is very bad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tony

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place! Really chill. Menu is in Thai so, bring your translater. Delicious food. Good cocktails. Relatively cheap. Bring your date for good views and romantic atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christopher Blumhagen

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food, good music, great atmosphere. The tables by the water would be nice, but a little more lighting would be good.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภัคจิรา สกุลศาตะมาน

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere, with a river view. The food tastes good, the music is nice, and the staff are friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dachathorn26@gmail.com Dacha Sookpraw

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was great, the music was good, the food was delicious, and the staff were lovely and very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุวนันท์ สอนโคกสูง

sample_reviews_en.text: I went on Friday, the breeze was nice and cool, and the atmosphere was very private. Perfect for a date!
sample_reviews_en.author: Fame _ss

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was great, there was a lot of PR, and they were lovely, but the price was a bit high.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thirawut Phanmaung

restaurants.name: คุณเล็กอาหารตามสั่ง
restaurants.address:

593 Rama II Frontage Road, Bang Mot, Chom Thong, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
It's just 7 table with maximum serving just for 30 customers by one and only chef but it's worth a visit

Location is front of "Krua Praram 2 - ครัวพระรามสอง" with very ordinary street food look but it's hidden gem is crispy pork.

Morning meal is congee, plan, extra, with egg, with century egg, or with salted egg.

They also available for by order of Paad Kra Prao - Fried with holy basil (ผัดกระเพรา), Paad Prik Kaeng- Fried with chilli paste (ผัดพริกแกง), and the best is Moo Krob - Crispy Pork (หมูกรอบ). Their crispy pork is the best in very very cheap available price.

Peak hour is from 11:30 - 13:30, after 13:30 some fresh ingredients might finished.

Let's savouring the crispy touch and wonderful taste of their crispy pork.
sample_reviews_th.author: 赤楚神愛

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes good, and there's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, both rice dishes and side dishes. Prices are clearly listed on the menu.
I ordered stir-fried water spinach with crispy pork and a fried egg; the portion was worth the price. The stewed pork soup had a slightly sweet broth, but the stewed pork was good and the pieces were just the right size.
The restaurant has plenty of seating, but it's quite hot.
I'm not sure if they have a writing system for ordering, but since I was alone that day, I just walked up and told them what I wanted to order.
Restaurants that serve made-to-order food tend to have long queues. I arrived at 11 am on a Saturday, and finished my stewed pork soup before my rice was served.
There's a small parking area, but I parked at the Susco gas station and walked a short distance.
sample_reviews_en.author: WSN M.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything is delicious and the portions are generous. 60 baht is incredibly cheap considering the ingredients: the rice, the crispy pork, the large shrimp, and the big squid rings.
The Rad Na (Thai noodle dish) and the stewed pork noodles are also delicious.
The crispy pork basil stir-fry is the best in the country. The crispy pork is truly crispy; the skin is crunchy, the meat is tender and juicy, and it explodes in your mouth when you bite into it.
I'm not exaggerating; I've eaten at many places, but none compare to this one.
The water is also free. Some restaurants charge for it.
Come try it, and you'll see!
sample_reviews_en.author: Merry Apinya

sample_reviews_en.text: There's parking at the restaurant, but you have to back out as there's no place to turn around. The à la carte dishes weren't very flavorful or tasty, and the rice was soggy. My companion, who ordered the noodles in gravy, said it was hot and delicious, and that seasoning it herself made it even better. We went around lunchtime, and although it was busy, the food came quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Auwae CH

sample_reviews_en.text:
The menu offers a variety of dishes, including rice porridge, stewed pork noodles, and à la carte options... The atmosphere is comfortable, and the restaurant is located on the main road, at the entrance of Soi Rama II 31.
The prices are reasonable, and the food tastes delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apichart Chanpis

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken basil stir-fry was okay, a little bland. The beef basil stir-fry was delicious. The curry stir-fry was a bit too strong. The omelet was tasty. The rice was quite hard, not jasmine rice. I noticed some of the spoons weren't as clean as they should have been.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุรัตน์ ศรีถมยา

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant completely ignores its customers. I stood there to order food, and the staff looked around, completely uninterested in taking my order. They didn't ask a single question. It's the worst street food restaurant I've ever encountered in my life.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasi J

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and affordable, using good quality ingredients. The rice is fluffy and the fried egg is crispy. It's conveniently located with many bus lines passing by, or you can drive there as it's right on Rama II Road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanawut Srisuk

restaurants.name: บ้านเตี๋ยวเรือ by อยุธยา ลาดพร้าว107แยก25
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 581 Lat Phrao 107 Alley, Lane 25, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I used to eat at this restaurant often, but lately it's not okay anymore. They keep a dog inside the restaurant, and it runs around haphazardly, crossing the street and chasing and biting other people's dogs. Then they yell at the people who were walking by for not controlling their dog and letting it attack their own. When I asked to see the security camera footage, they were too afraid to. If you're going to be a service provider, treating customers like this is unacceptable. I'm done with this place. I have video footage, but I feel sorry for the elderly people involved, so I don't want to post it.
sample_reviews_en.author: mind memorandum

sample_reviews_en.text: This is another restaurant with a relaxing atmosphere and a great dining experience. There's parking available, and both indoor and outdoor seating areas are excellent. The noodles are very affordable and taste great without needing any extra seasoning; the tender beef is fantastic. The rice dishes are also good. I'd recommend this place; I'll be coming back often.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benjamin Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious and affordable. They have boat noodles, crispy pork cracklings, red pork rice, crispy pork, grilled meatballs, and homemade Thai steamed custard (Khanom Thuay). It's fragrant and sweet, I really like it here. It's a complete place with both savory and sweet dishes. Parking is available across the street, but it can be a little difficult.
sample_reviews_en.author: เมนกา ม้วนหน้า พาเพลิน

sample_reviews_en.text: A simple Thai local noodle shop along the street in a community area they have pork/beef with good taste good flavor. However the portions are small, so you need to order a bit more to feel full. The prices are reasonable, and the atmosphere is pleasant with plenty of greenery. The staff provides good service. Parking can be challenging to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: SJ2

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant's boat noodles are delicious. The roast pork and crispy pork rice are also tasty, and the steamed rice cakes are amazing. Everything is delicious and the prices are reasonable. There's plenty of comfortable seating. It's a long-established restaurant with many customers every day. The owner is kind and lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: K.Kittiya 636

sample_reviews_en.text: Since it's near my condo, P'Tom and Nong Fear often stop by to eat. The food is delicious; the noodles are always served perfectly without needing any extra seasoning. The service is good, and they offer a co-payment scheme. I love it! Come and try it! ❤💋❤
sample_reviews_en.author: ต้อมโมเดล สายฮาบ้าจี้Chanel (Tombajee555)

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles are delicious, parking is convenient, and the price is average. There's a promotion where you can use the "Half-Half" or "We Win" program. On Sundays, there's no beef noodles, but there's also red pork and crispy pork rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: phonlawatt pheatsriwongsa

sample_reviews_en.text:
This boat noodle shop near my house is one I've been eating at for ages.
The crispy pork and basil pork are absolutely amazing.
A rare item on the menu is the Thai steamed pudding (Khanom Thuay). Don't forget to save room for dessert!
sample_reviews_en.author: LookwaH Kunjara

restaurants.name: Wooden house - Lounge & Bar
restaurants.address:

79/2 Pracha Chuen Rd, Bang Khen, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent service at all levels. Dogs are allowed. The staff and owner are very lovely. Food takes a little while to come out, but every dish is delicious. There's a buy one get one free promotion on some drinks on Fridays, Saturdays, and holidays (ask the staff). Perfect for drinks and socializing. There's a karaoke room with great sound, ideal for hanging out with friends and family parties. ***I hope the restaurant maintains its high standards. Sending my support!
sample_reviews_en.author: Natcha.M

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, but the pork should have been cooked more.
The pink grilled pork neck was tolerable, but this red braised pork leg was just too much, lol. The staff said, "The chef said it was baked and fried, so it's cooked." We opened it and tried it...the outside was hard, almost burnt (not crispy), and the inside was red, dry, and undercooked.
sample_reviews_en.author: Doungkamol Khamsawad

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was quite quiet the day I went, perhaps because it was raining and the musicians didn't come to play. As for the food, it was very average, not as delicious as many people had said. The price was considered expensive, and the portions were small, not worth the money at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: TONJAKKIT JP

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the environment is very atmospheric, the singers sing well, it is a good place for couples and friends to chat and gather, the friendly and high-quality and meticulous service makes customers feel relaxed and happy
sample_reviews_en.author: Jack Yu

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the restaurant was clean, the atmosphere was great, there was live music, and the staff provided excellent service. The prices weren't as expensive as I thought. It's perfect for a family outing.
sample_reviews_en.author: ORRAVEE S.

sample_reviews_en.text: The waiter was very friendly and service was quick. The did was really tasty, both western and Thai. There is also a pool table. Also live music kicks in after 20:00. Will go back to try a later slot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rob Hurst

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a nice atmosphere, the food is acceptable, the staff provides good service, the live music is enjoyable, there is ample parking, and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: onn chon

sample_reviews_en.text: A luxurious yet relaxed restaurant in the Phong Phet area. The staff are very attentive and provide excellent service. Coin-operated pool tables are available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suebpong Sutthiruck

restaurants.name: เฝอเริญ หม้อไฟเวียดนาม
restaurants.address:

1204 Banthat Thong Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A new pho hot pot restaurant has opened near Banthat Thong. The taste is good and the price is good for this area. It was very quiet when I visited – I don't know if it's usually this quiet, but the food was really good. Fresh and delicious! I especially loved their dumplings, both shrimp and pork – they're homemade, not pre-packaged. The pork and beef shank were excellent, very tender and not chewy at all. I wish the pho noodles were a little chewier, but overall it was great. The dipping sauces were well-balanced and easy to mix. The only downside was that the broth was a bit bland and lacked the fragrant pho herbs.

There were only two staff members when I visited, but the service was good, fast, polite, and very helpful. If you like pho and are in the area, I recommend trying it! I'm worried they might close. Please support them! A delicious restaurant with reasonable prices like this deserves to stay on Banthat Thong! 🥹👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Pina (Pina's Private)

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but my number one recommendation is the sesame oil pork liver. It was incredibly tasty; the liver wasn't tough, it was bouncy and delicious with every bite. Another dish I recommend is the freshly made shrimp meatballs; they have a substantial texture. Overall, I loved it and would love to come back again. The dipping sauce was also excellent. 10/10
sample_reviews_en.author: Ntp.P

sample_reviews_en.text: The dipping sauce was delicious, typical of pho. The prices were normal, but it would be better if the portions were a little bigger (or maybe it felt a bit small because I'm a big person). The pork set was just the right amount to fill me up. The complimentary dumplings listed on Google Maps were also good. Overall, the food was delicious and the atmosphere was nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zeterbiesn Zentinolization

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was excellent, and the dipping sauce was delicious. I was particularly impressed with the fish ball dishes; I liked all the fish ball items on the menu. They use high-quality ingredients; the texture is soft, not fishy, ​​and not chewy. The restaurant atmosphere is nice, and the staff are polite.
sample_reviews_en.author: cha

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pho Reun on Banthat Thong Road is a pho hot pot restaurant that uses carefully selected, fresh, and clean ingredients. The restaurant is beautifully decorated, and the highlight is their Vietnamese dipping sauce, a recipe that suits Thai tastes – spicy and flavorful. A must-try!

#PhoReunBanthatThong
sample_reviews_en.author: สุนันทา พรชัยพิธินันท์

sample_reviews_en.text: The dumplings are delicious, with plenty of shrimp, and the price is affordable. I'm a big guy, and the price per person was around 250-300 baht – very filling! The dipping sauce is tasty. Highly recommended. The sign might be a little hard to find. Parking is available at Stadium One.
sample_reviews_en.author: Xybertron z

sample_reviews_en.text: I've never tasted a dipping sauce like this anywhere else; it's incredibly delicious! The shrimp meatballs are the best, as are the squid meatballs and many others. The service is good. You can park in the Lotus parking lot and walk out in a short time – super convenient!
sample_reviews_en.author: 009_โชษิตา เกียรติเสริมสุข

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu is diverse. The freshly made shrimp and squid meatballs are delicious. The dumplings and sesame-marinated liver are also excellent. Prices are moderate, service is good, and the dipping sauces are tasty. Parking is available at Stadium One and Lotus.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pacharamanee Pan

restaurants.name: RhAp Alternative Cuisine
restaurants.address:

12/56 Soi Ngamwongwan 43 yak 2-14, Ngam Wong Wan 43 Alley, Lane 2-14, Thongsonghong, Lak Si, Bangkok 10210, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pros
1. Affordable price for a 6-course fine dining experience, giving you a chance to try something new (a little over a thousand baht).
2. Great atmosphere, beautiful restaurant, friendly atmosphere, no dress code, no awkwardness.
3. Perfect for long conversations with friends.
4. The chef is attentive and provides good explanations. The servers are always available. Impressive service.
Cons
1. Personally, I think the food is too spicy. The desserts are too sweet, and the main dishes are too salty. I think they could be more balanced.
2. The food takes a long time to be served, each dish takes 20-30 minutes.
3. The location is in an alley, so it's a bit hard to find. You really have to be determined to come here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirin Junpatum

sample_reviews_en.text:
I cant tell if Im reviewing about the right restaurant cuz the names all in Thais, but you can find the right name in my picture.

I came w a group of friends cuz one of us used to live near there and it was nowhere near the central area. But the food was in great quality! The chef was super nice and she's willing to make dish thats not in the menu upon your request, as long as they have the ingredients.

Seafood, pork n chicken dish available in Thais style

Both outdoor and indoor seats available and it was great vibe. Not the right choice if ur looking for sth fancy or have certain expectation based on my review, but I'd definitely recommend it if you live near there and wanna try sth new.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sơn Nguyễn

sample_reviews_en.text: It was a great experience at an affordable price. The food was flavorful and unique, worth trying at least once or multiple times. It was a little disappointing that the air conditioning was broken the day I went, making it a bit hot while waiting for my food. However, the chef and staff were friendly and provided excellent service, creating a pleasant dining atmosphere. While the portions looked small, they were surprisingly filling. The quality of the ingredients was evident. Overall, I enjoyed every dish, though I was slightly disappointed with the desserts. Because there were so many components to the meal and I was already quite full, I wasn't particularly excited about the dessert menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Garn Natta-nan

sample_reviews_en.text: 🍷✨ If you're looking for a dining experience that's different from the norm, you can't miss RhAp Alternative Cuisine, a fine-dining restaurant that offers an "Alternative" concept, using local and seasonal ingredients to create incredibly creative and impressive menus. 🥗 Each course is meticulously presented, like a work of art on a plate. The restaurant's atmosphere is elegant and modern, yet warm, perfect for special dinners, celebrations, or introducing guests to a new dimension of cuisine. 🍽️ The service is attentive to every detail, making every bite a special experience. This is a restaurant that true foodies should experience at least once. ✨
sample_reviews_en.author: JOYANTHIYA

sample_reviews_en.text:
Considering the price, taste, menu planning, and budget, it's excellent. Every dish was great. I highly recommend the Khao Soi, caramelized tomatoes, and Wellington.

The duck Wellington was very good, but I personally would have liked it a bit crispier; the crepe base was a little too soft and oily. Something to balance it out, like some pickled vegetables, would have been nice.

Every dish was delicious.

Placed the speakers downstairs would probably be better.

Chef Jib's other restaurant has even nicer decor.

I want to come again and highly recommend trying it.
sample_reviews_en.author: K T

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was incredibly delicious!
The salmon khao soi was the best; you won't find anything like it anywhere else.
The salmon practically melts in your mouth,
with a texture you rarely find at other restaurants.
And the flavor of the khao soi broth and the chef's homemade pickled vegetables...
This dish was truly the absolute best.

The set menu was also excellent.
Fine dining at an affordable price.

The chef was lovely and friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wann :D

sample_reviews_en.text: A perfect experience if you want the best classic cuisine with the sublime taste and twist of the Thai ingredients. We had a 9 course meal you only get in the better Michelin star restaurants in Europe. But in a rural area of every day life in Bangkok. Away from the tourist area. You taste the love for with which the separate dishes comes together in a harmonious way. Well worth the travel for about 40 minutes from downtown Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gert Arkensteijn

sample_reviews_en.text: Make a reservation before coming to meet the talented chef. The chef is very friendly. The food is delicious. He prepares and arranges the dishes for you to see each course. Every dish is delicious, especially the sauces. The ingredients are premium. If you don't like something, you can tell the chef. The price is reasonable compared to the Chef's table. I will definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chakarin Tonchanachai

restaurants.name: Tennen TOUFU
restaurants.address:

588 ศูนย์การค้าเจเจมอลล์ ชั้น G Kamphaeng Phet 2 Rd, Chatuchak, จตุจักร Bangkok 10900, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Nicely priced for the location and the atmosphere."

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve been eating here since 2023, and this is still one of my absolute favorite places to eat in Chatuchak.

As a tofu lover, this place honestly feels like such a hidden gem. Every time I visit JJ Mall or Chatuchak, this is immediately my go-to spot.

My absolute favorite is their zaru dipping ramen — I genuinely cannot find another place that makes it as delicious as here. The noodles have the perfect texture, the dipping sauce is rich and comforting, and the whole dish is seriously addictive.

The Deep fried custard tofu  is also amazing and something I always look forward to ordering. Crispy on the outside, soft and silky inside, and surprisingly comforting.

What makes this place special is that they truly understand tofu. The tofu dishes never feel like an afterthought; everything tastes carefully made, balanced, and comforting.

I’ve come back here again and again for years, and the quality has kept me loyal ever since.

Reasonable prices, comforting food, and one of those places that deserves way more love and support.

If you’re a tofu lover or just want a comforting meal after walking around Chatuchak, please give this place a try. 🫶
sample_reviews_en.author: Nin

sample_reviews_en.text: This hidden gem in JJ Mall is a paradise for tofu lovers. They have a huge variety of tofu dishes – boiled, fried, grilled, even as steaks! Today I ordered the tofu steak with ponzu sauce, the crispy fried tofu was fragrant, and the tofu nabe (hot pot) was simmered in a sweet and savory broth. The ramen was also decent. They have desserts like mochi and soy milk. It's always nice when it's not crowded; it really needs more popularity. The prices are mid-range, not cheap but not overly expensive. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: June S.

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! It was a truly soul-satisfying meal. Everything was made with meticulous care and attention to detail. The ingredients were top-notch, even the boiled peas were perfectly crisp and fresh. The spicy tofu hot pot soup was superb; the broth was flavorful, fragrant with ginger and dried fish. The packaging was beautiful, clean, and convenient. Everything seems thoughtfully selected. May your business prosper and continue producing such excellent food!
sample_reviews_en.author: nuch nuch

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is located in the basement of JJ Mall, near the exit to Chatuchak Market, in the pet zone. The shop looks a bit old.

They also sell ramen, but the ramen doesn't contain any tofu.

The prices are quite high compared to the portion size. The grilled tofu is delicious. They sell bottled soy milk to take home.

Overall, the food is edible, but the prices are high. There are no filling, budget-friendly tofu dishes on the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Goople review

sample_reviews_en.text:
My GF and I went here recently. She had the minced pork ramen in miso broth (no tofu). I had the mapotofu full set, which came with rice, miso soup, salad, kimchi, and other side dishes (see photo).

The ramen, mapotofu, and salad were delicious. The side dishes were a hit or miss - mostly misses. Overall, we give the food a weak 4 stars for the main dishes. I'd probably go for the mini mapotofu set next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naruth BKK

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried the food without much thought because there were very few people, but the menu was diverse and tastier than I expected. The Refreshing Tofu Salad was delicious; I loved the shredded shiso leaves that paired perfectly with the flavorful tofu salad. However, the food tends to be quite strong in flavor, so it's best paired with green tea. I recommend giving it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Preechaphon T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited a few times and this restaurant still amazes me.
The softest tofu with warm comforting broth, you can choose between 3 types of broth. (clear, mellow and spicy)
The eel sushi is well seasoned no need for soy sauce.

The restaurant is at JJ Mall, G floor in front of exit 4.

Kitchen close for ordering at 19.00 hrs. You can sit and eat till 19.30 hrs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumea Tbc

sample_reviews_en.text: Tofu lovers have to try this place! Even people who don't like tofu will love it. Everything I've tried, both savory and sweet, is delicious. They have a wide variety of dishes, the ingredients are high quality, and each dish looks like it's been made with a lot of care. Every time I come to JJ Market, I eat here and always buy tofu and soy milk to take home.
sample_reviews_en.author: P K

restaurants.name: Saan Somtum Bar
restaurants.address:

Sukhumvit 4 Alley, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was very impressed with my meal at Saan Somtum Bar! The Northeastern Thai food was perfectly seasoned, the menu was diverse and reasonably priced. The restaurant has a great atmosphere, is clean and comfortable, suitable for both friends and family.

I would like to commend the staff for their excellent service. An, Mod, and Earn were very attentive and friendly throughout the meal. Their quick service made the dining experience enjoyable and smooth.

Before the meal, I had the opportunity to tour the hotel. Joey gave us a detailed tour of the rooms, providing complete information and excellent service. It made me definitely want to return and stay here again! 💖💖
sample_reviews_en.author: Krittiyanee Maneesaeng

sample_reviews_en.text: This hotel near BTS Phloen Chit offers an all-you-can-eat papaya salad buffet. It's conveniently located and you can order unlimited papaya salad. K. Bow provided excellent service, offering helpful food recommendations and attentive care at our table. We were very impressed. If you want unlimited papaya salad in a nice atmosphere with convenient transportation, we highly recommend this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ornjira T.

sample_reviews_en.text: This place might be great but when I tried to go, the outside gate guard would not let me in. He asked if I was staying at the hotel, which I'm not. So he would not let me enter. Not sure if this bar is really open to guests of the hotel only, but that seems odd.
sample_reviews_en.author: Matt Diehls

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. Mod and Earn provided excellent service. Joey gave us a tour of the room and hotel facilities, offering helpful and friendly recommendations. The atmosphere was great, located within the Maison Bangkok. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirawut Sriraksa

sample_reviews_en.text: Every time I ask a Thai person what their favorite food is, eight out of ten will say "Som Tum" . I'm always curious about how delicious it is, since it's a Thai specialty. After trying it, I definitely fell in love with it! 😄 It has a …
sample_reviews_en.author: Fangfang Zheng

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, the music is nice, the place is cute, and the food is delicious. I highly recommend the "Pork in a Mortar" dish – it's incredibly tasty! The staff member named Earn is very lovely, attentive, and polite.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutnapin Rorsoongnern

sample_reviews_en.text: The papaya salad was delicious. I went when they had a buffet promotion, and there were so many dishes to choose from. Ms. Bow provided attentive and excellent service. ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Napas Chuenjai

sample_reviews_en.text: The Christmas tree of fried food at Saan Somtum Bar in Maison Hotel Bangkok is incredibly cute! It's available from December 1st to 31st. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Giftoun Blog

restaurants.name: Father & Son´s - The Smash Box
restaurants.address:

362/6 Si Phraya Rd, Khwaeng Maha Phruttharam, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was absolutely delicious! The atmosphere was great, the music was good (80s-90s international music), and the staff provided excellent service. They gave very detailed recommendations for each dish. I took my foreign boyfriend there the other day, and he said everything was delicious. The Australian beef basil stir-fry was amazing! For foreigners who don't like spicy food or can't handle much spice, I recommend ordering it with only one chili pepper – the flavor is just right. I think the classic burger and the pork burger are must-try; they're huge, and the taste and quantity are worth the price. If you get full easily, I recommend ordering the single-sized burger. The cod sticks were also delicious, and the dipping sauce was fantastic. If you're deciding whether to try it, I highly recommend it! It's definitely worth it. We'll definitely be back – this will probably become our regular restaurant. If I could give 10 stars, I would! This restaurant is truly excellent.

P.S. When we went, the restaurant didn't accept credit cards, only cash and bank transfers. If you plan to visit, it's a good idea to call ahead to inquire.
sample_reviews_en.author: Snooker Thitima

sample_reviews_en.text:
Seems like a new burger joint in the Ari area.

I walked past late at night, around 10 PM, and decided to give it a try.

The main attraction is the Smash burger, but there are no side dishes included, so I ordered the Bushpot.

I thought the smash on the burger was well-done, with a nice crispness and a perfect bite-sized portion. I personally prefer it greasy, but if you don't like it too greasy, I think it's delicious as is. I plan to come back next time to try the spiced double smash burger and their lunch set.

The Bushpot... hmm, the fries were a bit sparse and a little bland (?).

The beer selection was a bit limited, but they did have Asahi draft beer.

Overall, it was delicious. I'd give it 7.5/10. The price is mid-range, not too expensive. I secretly hoped for a wider beer selection and more side dishes to include with the burger or set meal.

P.S. The menu text is so confusing, it'll make you want to hit someone over the head with it! (laughs) Reading it while a little tipsy is awful.
sample_reviews_en.author: natpaphon sukitpaneenit

sample_reviews_en.text:
First, to clear up a few inaccuracies (in this listing) for other potential guests... contrary to the pics, there's no bar, draft beer, or even bottled beer available. And despite the credit card branded check holder they present your check bill in, they do not accept credit cards. Also, the menu here is more limited than the Sukhumvit branch I've previously visited.

All of that aside, I'm thrilled there's finally a good burger spot located in Silom. Today I tried their Krapao Burger and it was excellent. I would have loved it even more if it'd been been served with a side of chilies for proper heat. Next time I'll bring my own. I intend to become a regular here.
sample_reviews_en.author: chriskennedy100 Kennedy

sample_reviews_en.text: This is not your usual paper thin smashed patty, it's got some oomph so order the double patty only if you have a horse size appetite. The Classic Deluxe BLT smash oozes flavor and taste. The maillard singe along the edges of the patty nicely complement the sweetness of the tomato, the tanginess of the pickles and rich sharp taste of the creamy melted cheddar. Heavenly ! A great burger that is paired with friendly and attentive service staff makes this establishment a wonderful and deserving inclusion to my growing list of smash burger reviews thats now span the globe. No hesitation in recommending this restaurant for its food, service and ambience.
sample_reviews_en.author: D Yew

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely perfect burgers, buttered crab rolls and Cajun spiced chicken. Today we have tried them to the first time and my Thai wife and I loved every bite of it. Service was very friendly and welcoming as well.

Certainly this is not the cheapest  but also not the most expensive place. Definitely one of the best tasting one we have tried in Thailand so far. It is how it is: great taste and quality ingredients cost more. This is logical and we are always happy to spend the extra baht for satisfying our taste buds.

Thanks to the Father and Son-Team and please keep it this way. See you soon!
sample_reviews_en.author: A. B.

sample_reviews_en.text: I must preface my review by saying the staff were incredible, very attentive, polite and helpful. I expected a bit more from the food. Had the classical double smash and fries. The patties were great and juicy, the buns were soft but the onions stretched like rubber, they were still white, not at all caramelized, which let down the burger taste and texture wise. The fries were okay, a bit too thin and not enough seasoning in my opinion. Also note that it’s cash and Thai QR only, can’t pay by card yet. Would love to give this place another try and give it 5 stars when things improve
sample_reviews_en.author: Adrian

sample_reviews_en.text:
Positives:
-the kitchen is perfectly clean (it really stands out)
-personell is friendly and attentive
-layout and decoration
-dough used for pizzetta
-presentation of meals

Other:
-there is a relatively strong smell in the restaurant. After a few minutes you don’t notice it anymore, but it might deter walk-in customers
-prices don’t match the quality of the food

Pizzetta:
-the mozzarella is not good
-the tomato sauce lacks spices

Burger:
-fries are good. The dip needs some changes.
-patties are small
-the bun was not toasted and very soggy
sample_reviews_en.author: Vic

sample_reviews_en.text: New Smash Hamburgeria in Ari. Soft, light bun, quality meat, and crispy potatoes! Having never tried a Smash burger, I expected it to be dry, but with the onions and sauces, it turned out succulent. For those traveling in groups, the menu has something for everyone, offering not only burgers, but also salads, rice with Phad Kraprao, and much more. The atmosphere is perfect for both lunch and dinner. Upstairs, there's a room that could be used for private parties. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thipsatree V.T.

restaurants.name: หมี ความสุขหมูกระทะ&บุฟเฟ่ต์สาขา2
restaurants.address:

897 On Nut Rd, Khwaeng Suan Luang, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
My boyfriend took me there for the first time. I liked the restaurant's color scheme; it looked inviting. However, after eating, I felt there were some improvements. The food areas should have covers; some items were left out in the open air until they dried out and insects flew through. Also, closing the doors in the food area would be good. The dessert section felt very limited; it was the first time I've seen a restaurant with shaved ice but no red syrup.

The pork was very salty. I'd like them to adjust this.
The dipping sauce could be spicier; it was a bit too sweet.
The pork section was very slow to refill. Sometimes, items were already gone when I went to get more. Many items were sold out. Even the shrimp was gone by 6:30 PM. I'd like them to improve this. Regarding the menu, adding more items would be good, as the prices are quite high. I'll go back again and will ask the restaurant to make these adjustments.
sample_reviews_en.author: อภิวรรณ บุญนาค

sample_reviews_en.text:
Allow me to share my experience at the restaurant.

Today, I dined at the restaurant and generally intended to finish all my food, as I usually don't leave much leftovers. However, this time, one piece of liver was extremely bitter and inedible, and some of the meat had an unusual taste for me. I decided to stop eating and left one plate of food uneaten, approximately 120 grams (according to the staff's measurement).

The staff informed me of a penalty for leftover food. I explained that some of the food was truly inedible, and I willingly paid the penalty to avoid any further issues.

Before leaving, I also mentioned to the restaurant about the food quality, including the rice which was quite soggy. I hope the restaurant will investigate and improve these points, as I truly want all customers to receive quality food and a positive experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panisara Tarin

sample_reviews_en.text: The quality doesn't match the price. The buffet is 269 baht, plus 49 baht for unlimited refills, but what we got was not fresh food, the pork was salty, there were very few appetizers, the fried items were soggy from being left out in the air, the sausages were cheap, red ones, the dipping sauces were awful, and the desserts were disappointing. There was no sweet drink, only diluted coconut milk and syrup. The drink selection was also very limited, despite the 49 baht refill option. In short, one visit is enough; I will never go back to this restaurant again.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปารเมศ นิยมทอง

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is okay. The staff are friendly and there’s a fairly large buffet. However, I wasn’t impressed by the quality of the beef, though the pork was better. Unfortunately, there were quite a lot of flies at the buffet. The price is reasonable. It was very noisy; the music didn’t bother me, but there was a piercing whistling sound coming from somewhere. Conclusion: This restaurant is okay, but only average.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Müller

sample_reviews_en.text: There's a wide variety of food to choose from, and it's quite fresh. The marinated pork is delicious, and the dipping sauces are great, pairing perfectly with the BBQ. 😋🐻🥓 The staff provided good service, constantly clearing plates and refilling food. The restaurant has a comfortable atmosphere, suitable for dining with friends or family. Overall, I was impressed. The price is reasonable. 🫶🏻✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Onicha Hhv

sample_reviews_en.text:
There's a huge selection of food! The dipping sauces are delicious, and the prices are affordable. I especially love the self-serve papaya salad station, haha. I just moved to this area and have saved it as my go-to restaurant. ♥️
> The restaurant is big, with lots of tables, parking for both motorcycles and cars, and they play amazing music! I really want to ask for their playlist! 🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: laddawan pysw

sample_reviews_en.text: The dipping sauce was delicious, but some of the staff seemed inattentive to customers. I'm not sure if they were willing to provide good service. Overall, the restaurant didn't seem very clean; even the tables were dirty, perhaps not properly wiped. I felt that for the price I paid, I should have received better quality food compared to other restaurants at similar prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: em em

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has parking, which is very convenient for those who drive their own cars. The food selection is diverse, the taste is good, the ingredients are fresh, and at 249 baht, it's excellent value.

For drinks, you can choose between a refillable water option for 49 baht or buy a bottle. The staff provides good service, and the restaurant is clean and pleasant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supatida ThanaR

restaurants.name: ควิกโอชา ปตท. เกษตรนวมินทร์ ฝั่งขาออก ตอม่อที่ 69
restaurants.address:

Prasert-Manukit Rd, Chorakhe Bua, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been ordering from this restaurant for several years now. The food tastes okay; two dishes for 90 baht is quite expensive compared to other restaurants in the area. The rice is clearly inferior; it's hard and not soft. If they improved by using fragrant, soft cooked rice, it would be much better.

In 2024, ordering through Line Man many times, I noticed a significant deterioration in service. The food was being packaged by staff who folded the bags in half and placed them down without tying them with a rubber band.
By the time it arrived, the liquid had leaked out of the bags, making them dirty. I commented several times, and they fixed it, but then went back to the old practice of not tying the bags. I'm deducting stars for the poor service.
sample_reviews_en.author: K T

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was good, but the prices were too high for the rice with curry and egg in sweet and sour sauce. The eggs were size 3-4 chicken eggs, the taste was ordinary, and the stir-fried bamboo shoots were bland. The two dishes cost 65 baht, but the rice portion was too small.
P.S. This is just my personal opinion; I may not have tried the recommended dishes, so I thought the taste was average and something you could find anywhere.
sample_reviews_en.author: กรกมล หุ่นอยู่

sample_reviews_en.text: The portions are extremely small, and the price is completely disproportionate to the quality of the food. Comparing the price of rice and curry to the quantity is appalling. Not only are the portions small, but they even took out one piece of side dish just before serving! The food was served like an offering. The price was shocking – over 200 baht! One time is enough. Anyone planning to eat here should read the reviews first.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ra-Wi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I went to Quick Ocha, a curry restaurant. It's one of the best curry restaurants in the area. The food is delicious.
It's another restaurant that I really like. The staff are friendly and the service is excellent. They even have air conditioning. It's rare to find a curry restaurant like this.
Overall, it's excellent. I'm not exaggerating; you have to come and try it.
(Taste is subjective, but I like it this way.)
sample_reviews_en.author: ทําวันนี้ ให้ดีที่สุด

sample_reviews_en.text: Order food via Line. The menu is never updated (for years the menu has never been updated to match the storefront). Write a note to change the menu, but they don't read it. If they have questions, they don't call to ask. Sometimes they order in the note, sometimes they don't, depending on the mood of the person serving. As a store that provides services via Line, they should update the menu to be correct every day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kan T

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste was delicious, just as described 👍 The portion was enough to fill me up. If the price isn't an issue, I'd recommend it.

*The price is more expensive than the portions at Or Tor Kor Market compared to the quantity.

P.S. I ordered the same dishes as another commenter (stir-fried eggplant and pork with shrimp paste), but I got even less eggplant than them! 555+
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongpakorn Pewpong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Message

The food variety was great, I couldn't decide what to order, everything looked delicious. I decided to buy spicy snail curry, tom yum mackerel soup, steamed fish in banana leaves, braised eggs, and stir-fried catfish with chili paste. It was delicious, I wasn't disappointed. It was so enjoyable with hot steamed rice!
sample_reviews_en.author: Adisorn Wongvirat

sample_reviews_en.text: I highly recommend it to anyone passing through this area. Turn into the gas station and stop for a meal at Quick Ocha. It's delicious and reasonably priced. There's a wide selection of dishes to choose from. Parking is convenient. There's also an air-conditioned room to choose from. The restaurant is clean and tidy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimsjung R

restaurants.name: Pratunam Thai Food~Authentic (Cook by thai chef) / ร้านอาหาร ประตูน้ำไทยฟู้ด
restaurants.address:

190 3 ถนน พญาไท Khwaeng Makkasan, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was initially going to rate this place 3 stars, but after seeing how the restaurant responds to negative reviews, I’ve decided it deserves only 1.

This was the most expensive and mediocre meal I’ve had in Bangkok. We were led to a separate air-conditioned room, away from the rest of the locals — and we were the only ones there.

The menu was entirely in English, which felt like a red flag. Despite being a Thai restaurant, it’s clear we were handed a “tourist menu.” I still gave it a shot, assuming the quality and portion sizes would match the higher prices. Unfortunately, I was wrong.

The fried pork belly was decent. The pandan-wrapped chicken, however, was soggy and bland inside. The pineapple fried rice lacked flavour, and while the Pad Thai had good taste, the noodles were undercooked.

Thankfully, we didn’t order the vegetables (259 THB) or a drink (over 100 THB), or we would’ve been even more ripped off.

Definitely not worth the price or the experience. There are far better and more authentic Thai restaurants around.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aloysius Kwok

sample_reviews_en.text:
First experience in here and I'm amazed with the boss child, he is very considerate and skillful (he taken us into the air conditioned-room and brought us the menu book). Good job kid 👍

We ordered tom yum (shrimp seafood) and kaprao with rice (pork). Both portion is big and delicious 👍 For the tom yum, it is VERY DELICIOUSS 😋 but instead of shrimp meat, it contains more shrimp heads ☹ For the kaprao with rice, actually we didn't know what food is that, but we're VERY GLAD as it turns out to be DELICIOUSSS, the same with tom yum 😭😋👌

For both the owner, they are very kind and nice, and I'm sure the owner will gladly fix any lack of the food next time 👍 加油,老板 🤩🔥

P.S. Thank you so much 老板 for your reply 🤩👍 Aaaaa you still remember us, thank you thank you 🙏💖 and OHHHHHH that's why the head is so many 😂👍 REALLYY, THANK U SO MUCHH 🙏 Hope your business get more and more customer and always be successful 🥳🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Michele Septiadi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall did NOT enjoy the dining experience.
1) the food here are overpriced for its portion and quality. While the tomyum soup is flavourful, the others are not up to par to its price. The pineapple fried rice was too moist and soft and the Thai tea has ZERO taste.
2) upon communicating with the staff that the Thai tea has no taste, they just shrugged off and said “it’s like that”
3) they almost OVERCHARGED us. Please check your bill personally as they can be tricky and add a few bahts into your total bill.
4) the restaurant is located just beside the road, so expect to dine with the smell of soot and smoke.

Do not recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tan Hui Yee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stopped by last night with the family.  Neat place.
Food was good. We had the red curry chicken, seafood tom yum, noodle with chicken, steamed rice 🍚 and Thai iced teas.

Food is delicious, guest service is great by owners.  They speak English.

I couldn’t give it 5-stars because I found the portion for rice is ridiculously small. Rice you pay separate and it’s weirdly overpriced.  I think almost everything is overpriced so I think their price caters to foreigners only.

Mango sticky rice is over B200+ and it’s around 100-120 everywhere else.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ashraf M

sample_reviews_en.text:
Never come here plz. You will ruin your fresh feeling traveling beautiful thailand.
Here is a shame of thailand tourism.

The food quality is terrible.
They demands not notified commissions for card payment.
The staffs speak like eveything is okay before foods are served but when you pay bills, they change their words easily and fool you. and demand you commissions.

Never be disguised by the staffs in front of the resto. Here is shameful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Torry Tyson

sample_reviews_en.text:
We discovered this place by accident after walking from Pratunam to the airport rail link Ratchaprarop station. The place is easy to miss from the outside. But the place inside was comfortable and had aircon.
The food was delicious and at a reasonable price.
The service attitude is good and the owner is friendly.
We recommend this place. Just a few minutes walk from the airport rail link station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zhen Wei Kong

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was exceptional, with the pad Thai, and the dry and soup noodles being flavourful. The milk tea was very light and not too sweet. All the food is very authentic and like it is home cooked. The area is very calm, away from busy road. It is clean and very well maintained. Highly recommend for tourist .( this is the only vocab I have to describe this place )
sample_reviews_en.author: ASEAN Countryball Official

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was OK but the price was a rip-off. They don’t have prices written on the menu and you will be surprised when the bill comes. Twice or thrice as high for regular Thai dishes. There is a “Thailicious” outlet a few building away you can enjoy good Thai dishes at half the prices than this restro. An honest review.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aung Than

restaurants.name: KFC PTT Sarnpawut
restaurants.address:

PTT Sarnphawut, Bang Na Nuea, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant announced it would close at 9 PM, but they switched off the order system at 8 PM… and to top it all off, they added the joke about long wait times of 15 minutes or more for anyone arriving after 8 PM…
From the employees' perspective, it's understandable that they're preparing to finish work exactly on time.
But from the customers' perspective, it's a huge disappointment, especially since they arrived before closing time.
The branch manager needs to step in and manage this. The comments are overwhelmingly positive, almost all of them giving it a 1-star rating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Traveller

sample_reviews_en.text:
The order was made incorrectly. None of the requests I submitted were fulfilled. For example, I asked for chicken nuggets in a small bag, but they were mixed with the spicy wings, which is unsuitable for children. I also requested wings instead of drumsticks, but received two drumsticks instead of drumsticks.

(Employee, May 1st, 2024, 12:00-13:00)
sample_reviews_en.author: Supathra Tantiwitayamas

sample_reviews_en.text: I often visit this KFC branch, and overall, I found it to be clean and consider an okay branch. However, during the rush hour, the service could be improved. This resulted in slower service and, unfortunately, my chicken was a bit dried out. Other than that, the experience was fine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supawit Chirayukool

sample_reviews_en.text:
Arrived at this KFC at 7:30 pm, was told chicken would take 25 minutes.  Went to Amazon and 7-11, came back 20 minutes later, the wait for chicken was still 25 minutes.  Five Grab riders waiting for their orders, no other customers.

What use is a KFC with no chicken?
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter B

sample_reviews_en.text: The young woman at the counter provided excellent service. We forgot to bring straws and lids for our drinks. We were with our child sitting at a table, and she came to get them for us. We were very impressed with her.
sample_reviews_en.author: Best Naka

sample_reviews_en.text: I bought it at the branch on 31/07/2026. I feel like the chicken pieces are smaller than before 😂. The Colonel's signature tender chicken tasted normal, but the crispy chicken tasted very strange. I'm not sure why.
sample_reviews_en.author: mo brr

sample_reviews_en.text:
Forgot to take photo of the chicken meal lol.
Good service staff was helpful and placed is clean. Got the 2 piece chicken with fries and a drink for 99 baht
sample_reviews_en.author: frank fw

sample_reviews_en.text: The wait was long and they didn't inform customers at all. People who were in a hurry and hungry, planning to eat, had to wait for over half an hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: CHAIWAT BOONFUENG

restaurants.name: Wichai Noodle
restaurants.address:

PHPQ+796, Soi Sukhumvit 63, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was impressed by how satisfyingly piping hot the broth was. This is an old, long-established restaurant, but lately I've been a little sad to see fewer customers. I'd like to encourage everyone to support them! The noodles are really good, especially the egg noodles which are perfectly cooked. I ordered the Tom Yum noodle soup, and it was delicious and up to standard. If you like it spicier, you can add more seasoning to your liking. Importantly, they give you a generous amount of toppings, including minced pork and meatballs, for only 70 baht a bowl. It's excellent value!

An elderly woman manages the shop and collects money. She might have hearing difficulties, so please speak a little louder if needed. Please be understanding and considerate. The elderly man who makes the noodles is very dedicated and provides excellent service. I hope many of you will come and try it!

The atmosphere is homey and friendly. It might not be as fancy as larger restaurants, but it's comfortable and not cramped at all.

Finally, I believe that taste and experience are subjective. Don't judge a restaurant solely by star reviews. Give this old, established restaurant a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: MT AD

sample_reviews_en.text:
Convenient parking. The owner is friendly. I ordered Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup), it tasted good and had plenty of ingredients. It might not be in the top 5 best, but overall it was very tasty. If you're driving through Ekkamai and are hungry, you can eat here without disappointment. I didn't order the Tom Yum soup, which is on the top 5 list, because I read online that it was bland. Actually, they have lime available to add yourself at the table.
The steamed dumplings were generally tasty. The dipping sauce is a soy sauce mixture, but the smell isn't strong and the flavor is well-balanced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawach Metharattanarak

sample_reviews_en.text: When I was a kid, this place was so delicious. Over time, things have changed with the times, but it still retains its original flavor. The ingredients are good, and the thick dumplings are just as familiar and delicious. The elderly owners, an elderly couple, still take care of everything and provide excellent service. It's a place I miss because of my childhood memories. It's a shame the satay pork was sold out. I used to watch the old man waxing his greasy hair while grilling every week back when the shop was located on Ekkamai Road.
sample_reviews_en.author: DrToy Akkarin Tepprasit

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've passed by this place many times but only recently had the chance to stop by.

The noodle soup tasted good, it seemed like an old-style tom yum.
The dumplings were large, and the pork leg rice portion was very generous.
They no longer have pork satay, the owner said she couldn't manage it anymore.
Prices are 60-70 baht.

The restaurant has plenty of parking.
The tables were sticky and not very clean. Overall, the taste is okay.

The owners, an elderly couple, were friendly and welcoming.
sample_reviews_en.author: B BB

sample_reviews_en.text: Local restaurant in Soi Ekkamai 22, open more than 60 years. Tom Yum Noodle is recommend menu here even this menu called tom yum but not look like tom yum soup it is noodle seasoning with chilli flask, sugar, ground peanuts and fish sauce. I had ordered tom yum dried egg-noodle. The egg-noodle cooked well, good seasoning of tom yum and also reasonable price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supakunlaya Sariphan

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum, Leng Saap, and Yen Ta Fo were all incredibly bland. They didn't taste what they should have. This is my honest review. The meatballs smelled like they were spoiled or undercooked; they were hard. The menu looked interesting the first time I ate here, and I expected it to be better considering the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: hermoilz CE

sample_reviews_en.text:
The noodle soup was delicious. The elderly couple who own the shop were very kind. However, the broth wasn't very hot when I had it. It would have been even better if it were hotter.

I recommend it to anyone passing by this area. A bowl costs 60 baht. There's also plenty of parking, very convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr. Bee

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old-fashioned pork noodle shop, delicious both the tom yum and dry versions. The broth is excellent. The atmosphere is like a rural village, and the prices are very reasonable – you won't find this in the area. There's parking available, and the owner is very friendly. I love it!
sample_reviews_en.author: peerawut keeratikarn

restaurants.name: Indian Cutlery, Authentic Indian Restaurant in Pattaya
restaurants.address:

หมู่ที่ 10 183/9 ซอย 13/2 Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I ordered a salad like the one in the picture on the menu. At first I thought it would be like the picture. But it's actually just cut vegetables and fruits like in the picture and it costs 100฿ for what??? I can ask for cut vegetables like this in Thai food for free. The service is okay but I don't think I should pay 100฿ for a stupid salad like this. The one in the picture shouldn't even be called a salad. The food tastes okay but not great. Even if you eat it when you're hungry, you won't feel that it's delicious. Selling food like this is probably only sold to Indians.😆
sample_reviews_th.author: Natty Prechayanan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Indian Cutlery restaurant in Pattaya serves authentic North Indian cuisine, and their Indian Thali is a great option. The flavors were rich and satisfying, capturing the essence of traditional North Indian dishes. The ambiance is fairly good, offering a comfortable dining experience, and the service was decent as well. Overall, a good choice if you’re craving authentic Indian food in Pattaya. It’s a bit inside the alley (not on the main road), so you won’t find any signs of  this place on main road.
The price is competitive comparing to Indian restaurants on main road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Madhusudan 'Dieselman' Singh

sample_reviews_en.text: We had a fantastic experience at this Indian restaurant! We ordered the tandoori and chicken tandoori, and both dishes were absolutely wonderful. The flavors were rich, the spices were perfectly balanced, and the meat was tender and juicy. We have tried Indian food many times before, and this place is definitely one of the better ones. The aroma, the presentation, and the quality of ingredients all stood out. It truly felt like an authentic Indian dining experience. If you love flavorful, well-cooked Indian food, this place is a must-visit! Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ehsan Z

sample_reviews_en.text:
I found this place on the last day of my stay, else I'd eat there more than just one dinner. They have plenty of options for vegetarians, and the Indian food is great since they have Indian chefs to cook it. I tried veg thali and masala tea, which was very good. The staff is very humble. The seating is comfortable, and the place is right next to the beach.
Highly recommended for the Indian food lovers as well as people seeking Indian vegetarian food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vikramajeet Parmar

sample_reviews_en.text: Extremely mid restaurant offering Indian cuisines.Food is very average ,prices are higher but the service is most terrible.The lady  serving us said  she cannot serve to the plates since they donot charge service charges.Lol !! What a slap on hospitality !! Not at all worth visiting this place who donot understand the basic concept of hospitality industry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Deepak

sample_reviews_en.text: Not good at all. Very poor hygiene. The dosa was pathetic. Don’t remember tasting a dosa this bad in my lifetime. I couldn’t even chew it properly. The dosa was brought cold. Who brings a dosa cold? The washroom area stinks. If you see the kitchen once for yourself you might puke your way out. Avoid this at all costs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Braga

sample_reviews_en.text: Talha,,/Simian Wer absolutely brilliant, food was very courteous, friendly and helpful. Food decently price.  Definitely check this place if your looking for some authentic Indian food.  Definitely will be visiting again while I am here. They offered for us  to Wats app them and they will deliver to our hotel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Balibains Jigbali

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited the restaurant yesterday with my family thinking it is a ginuine halal restaurant. At the door I noticed that they sell alcohol. And I asked the guy who works there and he confirmed, and his excuse is that all "halal restaurants" sell alcohol! We didn't enter the restaurant and turned back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nagash Nour

restaurants.name: ราดหน้าฟาไฉ พรานนก
restaurants.address:

40 Phran Nok Phutthamonthon Sai 4 Rd, Bang Phrom, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The deep-fried noodles were quite oily. The first few bites seemed delicious, but after eating the whole plate, it was very greasy, especially the dry-fried chicken. I couldn't finish it.

The plum sauce that came with the shrimp fritters had a very strange taste; I didn't like it.

The service was also quite poor. While I was ordering, the staff hadn't even repeated my order to me. When I tried to change something, a kitchen staff member came and said it had already been prepared, as if pressuring me not to change my order.

The staff member taking my order also didn't mention the set meal promotion. They just let me order randomly until I saw it myself.

I wasn't impressed and don't think I'll be returning to this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peeraset Bu

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in Thep Charoen Market on Phra Thep Road. The kitchen is on the street, while the seating area is separated by glass walls and air-conditioned.

I ordered rice with stir-fried seafood in garlic. The garlic was fragrant, and the ingredients, including the squid, fried fish, and shrimp, were good.

The winter melon soup was quite disappointing. It arrived late, the flavor was bland, the winter melon wasn't soft, and the chicken leg wasn't tender. It seems like each dish is made fresh to order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ben Tordamrong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in Thep Charoen Market on Phra Thep Road, next to Hotman restaurant. It's easy to find. The restaurant has about 10 tables. The atmosphere isn't big, but it feels cozy. The staff provides good service, is good at recommending dishes, and always smiling, making the meal even more memorable. Parking is convenient on the street and there's also parking behind the restaurant for about 5 cars.
The restaurant is open from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM and closed on the 1st and 16th of each month.
sample_reviews_en.author: Roch

sample_reviews_en.text: The gravy noodles were on the sweeter side; not amazing, but tasty. The noodles were soft, the pork was tender, and the vegetables weren't tough or chewy. The bamboo shoot soup had a small amount of bamboo shoots, but it was delicious and worth the price. My favorite dish was definitely the fried tofu – incredibly crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, absolutely fantastic! The desserts were also delicious. Overall, it was okay and I'd like to try other dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pear Meti

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're in the Phran Nok area, try this Rad Na Si restaurant...

~The Rad Na is good, the sauce is delicious, the marinated pork is tender, the noodles have a subtle wok aroma, just a sprinkle of pepper and you don't need to add any seasoning.

~The Pad See Ew is also good, the noodles have a nice wok aroma and aren't too soggy.

-There's an air-conditioned room for comfortable seating.
-Plenty of parking available.
-Convenient restrooms.
sample_reviews_en.author: MR. Mah Street food

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came here based on reviews… The Rad Na (Thai noodle dish with gravy) was decent. The noodles were chewy and soft, the flavor was okay, the shrimp were large, and the pork pieces were huge (I wish they were cut into bite-sized pieces for easier eating). The vegetables were crispy, and the portion size was appropriate for the price.
There is parking available on the street in front of and behind the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lich W.S.

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. We hadn't even finished eating yet, and there were only two other tables occupied. They were still eating when, at 9 PM, they turned off all the air conditioning in the entire restaurant. It was like they were trying to kick us out. Terrible service and extremely poor manners.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paopao Lertsiri

sample_reviews_en.text: I come here often. Everything is delicious, and the air-conditioned seating is nice and cool. However, sometimes parking is a bit limited. You can park on the street, behind the restaurant, or just circle around where there are no cones from other businesses.
sample_reviews_en.author: Waraporn Munku

restaurants.name: ร้านอาหารยุโรป และอาหารไทย Papassorn Sweet & Bistro
restaurants.address:

39 660 Soi Sakae Ngam 14, Samae Dam, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Went to eat there because I saw that it was close to home and the restaurant had a lot of good reviews. It turned out to be very disappointing, like a waste of money. The price wasn't expensive, but when compared to the quality, it was expensive. I ordered a croissant mix and American fried rice. It turned out that the fried potatoes weren't cooked through, and the egg in the croissant had a raw egg white. But the restaurant said that if you serve it like this, the egg is runny, which is considered raw. The egg white was still slimy and stuck to the croissant, completely mushy. The runny part was the egg yolk. The chicken was burnt on the outside, raw on the inside. I had to go eat at another restaurant to cleanse my palate.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattira Nilnoree

sample_reviews_en.text: Good food, really eat, really pay. The jaew sauce is very delicious. My father is a picky eater and still asked for more. We also ordered to take home. Our family is not good at Western food, but I must say everything is good. Most importantly, the shop is beautiful and very clean. It's even more beautiful if you come at night. I'll come again. I can't take beautiful pictures because the person taking the pictures couldn't eat fast enough. There were 4 of us and we ordered 6-7 dishes until our bellies were full. We also took some home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattawi Rojjanabhokawanich

sample_reviews_en.text: The American fried rice was packed with ingredients and had very little ham. The Tonkatsu Curry Rice had a rich curry flavor and the Japanese-style fried pork was delicious. The Green Curry Seafood Fried Rice was flavorful and full of seafood, including tender squid that was very satisfying. The best thing about this restaurant is the delicious food, great atmosphere, and nice music.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rangsima Mui

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff were excellent, although a bit slow due to the busy New Year's Eve.
The bread was served hot. The food was overall delicious. The smoothies were just right. I tend to like spicy food, so I whispered to the staff to make it a little spicy. There was live music, and you can even request songs. I'll definitely visit again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: หย่งย้ง

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was incredibly delicious!! I emphasize, SO MUCH!! 👍👍👍 The staff were all lovely and provided excellent service. The owner was very kind and lovely too. ❤️✨✨ There's plenty of parking, so no need to worry about finding a spot. The restrooms were clean, there was ample seating, and the atmosphere was great. Overall, I loved it very much! ✨✨
sample_reviews_en.author: SEC1_กัญญารัตน์ ยิ่งเภตรา

sample_reviews_en.text:
