The food was delicious! The pizza crust was amazing, the shrimp pasta was rich and flavorful, and the sausage set was great value with five huge sausages that were grilled to perfection with a crispy skin. 😊😊
There's a decent amount of parking space behind the restaurant.
The restaurant is beautifully decorated and has a great atmosphere. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Duangporn Chokdumrongsook

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is great! They have a huge, diverse menu, offering everything from Western dishes like steaks and spaghetti to Thai single-serving meals. It took me a long time to look through all the menus, but the food was delicious in the end. The restaurant's decor is also lovely. There's parking available behind the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: PotDoi Story

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been there many times, but recently the quality of the ingredients has dropped significantly. They probably need to change the chef. The wait for food is long even though there are only 2 tables. The cocktails are made with rotten lemons. If you plan to continue operating, the owner needs to come down and oversee every step.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Numberfourteen

restaurants.name: San San Kitchen
restaurants.address:

2881 Rama IV Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great and friendly service with a heartwarming vibe as if you are dining in Myanmar. 🇲🇲 Love their hospitality and food. Big portions on any menu items and the taste isn’t compromised. This restaurant is now a must-go in BKK if you are looking for Burmese food with decent price and great quality. They also have Motehingar. Though their seating seems limited, I am sure they are happy to rearrange the seating according to the customer’s needs.
Tea can be improved though; but still better than most of the big name restaurants those who charge more but offer little quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Toon Nawl

sample_reviews_en.text: They seem to be happy to take your money, but not provide the service. Waited for about 45 minutes for my food. My other dinner guests had theirs already and finished, other guests that came in later then us had their food before me as well, finished and left before I even got my food. I eventually had it as take away as my appetite was gone by that time. Not looking for a refund or discount at all, but an apologise would have been nice. Cleanliness of the place is not great either.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andy Jans

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was polite and friendly, the food was delicious, the prices were reasonable, and the restaurant was clean. Everything about it was perfect.

Even though we didn't understand the language, they kindly explained the menu using pictures.

We each ordered different noodle dishes, and both were truly delicious. They perfectly suit the Japanese palate.

If you're staying nearby, you should definitely check it out!

I'll definitely go again! 😙
sample_reviews_en.author: Yohei Okada

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was delicious! I'd never tried Burmese food before and couldn't imagine what it would taste like. But after trying it, it was truly delicious. The young man who spoke some Thai provided excellent and polite service.

Today I ordered Khao Soi (Shan-style curry noodle soup), steamed chicken with vermicelli, and spicy squid salad. The soup that came with it was also very tasty.

The price was reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natchaporn Watakabe

sample_reviews_en.text:
There are many Burmese restaurants, including Kyay Oh Soup and Mohinga. The overall seasoning is not very spicy; Kyay Oh Soup's broth has a pork bone flavor. The stir-fried water spinach doesn't have shrimp paste or chili, but it's only 60 baht a serving, and there's a generous amount of vegetables, so it's still quite decent.

Overall, it's a restaurant I would highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Huang Ming Liu

sample_reviews_en.text: Good food and ambiance! This resto is simple but really satisfied our cravings for authentic Thai foods. Plus, their whole menu is really affordable (with big servings). Kudos to Sansan staffs, they're really attentive and accommodating with our needs. This is not paid or sponsored, but if you happen to be around Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei in Bangkok, you might wanna try it! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Francene Perez

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food was excellent! Generous portions and delicious taste. Great value for money.
Extremely accommodating server (who takes nice photos!). Downside is that food takes a while to be served (and not all at the same time) but if you’re dining awesome company, you won’t really mind the wait. They also stay open if there are still diners eating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Isabel Victoria Martinez

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is simply amazing – rich aromas, perfect balance of spices, and beautifully cooked dishes. The Mohinga, Tea Leaf Salad, Khao Soi, and Tom Yum are full of authentic taste and remind you of true home-style cooking. Every dish is fresh, flavorful, and well presented.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krishna Kaoundal

restaurants.name: Pizza 2000 Pattaya
restaurants.address:

View Talay Condo1 340/3 Thanon Thap Phraya, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent pizza, friendly owner.

To find: if you're at the bus station/Food Mart plaza, walk north on Thappraya. Take the first driveway on your right to "View Talay Jomtien Condominium" - no more than a 15 second walk past the buses.

Head into the complex. The first residential tower on your right is filled with seedy looking bars. You're headed past the first parking lot, past the pool, and two the second building "B". There you'll see the glorious sign for Pizza 2000. Buon appetito!
sample_reviews_en.author: Gregory Heilers

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm a frequent visitor to Thailand from Hawaii (now) and originally from NY, most New Yorkers know good pizza! And this place has excellent pizza; consistent,inexpensive, and for me convenient as I always stay at either View Talay 1or 2, both are close enough to walk to, but I generally opt for delivery. The delivery girl is so sweet and friendly, and works very hard,please don't forget to reward her generously with a gratuity, her appreciative warm smile will melt your heart!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dan Fisher

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's certainly a good pizza place. The price is around 200 baht for a medium size pizza (which isn't super large or anything). It was clearly made using fresh ingredients.

It's not as good as pizzas you can get in the West though.

The area the pizza place is in appears to be a block of hotels. Not sure I was really allowed in as there's a sign saying that you have to present ID (but I just went past on my bike). It's a little hard to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: Harvey Williams

sample_reviews_en.text: September 13, 2019. Good day to everyone reading. Honestly, this place is so-so; there are much better options for the money. We ordered two different pizzas (Las Vegas, from Chef), but they tasted identical. Why? It's because they season all their pizzas with Italian herbs to add some flavor, as all the other ingredients are bland. That's pretty much how the pizzas feel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dmitrii Djachkov

sample_reviews_en.text: Was there in January.  The lovely (lovely!) lady that’s been working there since she was 15 is so nice to talk to.  I stayed for a couple of large Leos while she built her pizza boxes.  She made me a personalized pizza, double this and double that, for around 350B.  Frig!  Was it ever good.  I’ll be back in December.
sample_reviews_en.author: charlie44441

sample_reviews_en.text: By far the best pizza I've ever eaten in Thailand. I don't eat pizza there very often, but with about 40 trips to Thailand, each lasting over a month, I've had quite a few opportunities to compare. Consistently producing good to very good food is true quality. Kudos to this little shop!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ralf s

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don’t have pics from this place , but this is near to this condo.
The pizza was tasty, we took” Las Vegas” pizza
And the worker girl also so amazing and cute !
The place it’s so old but cozy and has some history , not typical pizza cafe , it was open about  20 years ago !
sample_reviews_en.author: Kat Grass

sample_reviews_en.text:
There is a guard post you need to pass through to get to this place.  Not a problem but the business should disclose that in advance.

Excellent, friendly service and the pizza is good.  However, it is oriented to those who like thin crusts.  Decent value.
sample_reviews_en.author: W

restaurants.name: Tae Lao Chin Seng Bakery
restaurants.address:

927, 929 ถ. เจริญกรุง Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This long-established mooncake shop sells delicious, slightly spicy savory mooncakes that aren't cloying. The crumbly pastry pairs perfectly with the flavorful filling. The sweet filling is subtly sweet, not overly so, and the fermented tofu filling is savory, well-balanced, and fragrant with the aroma of fermented tofu. They are small, priced at 10 baht each, easy to eat without the hassle of cutting them.
During peak seasons, many customers are present, and some items may be reserved. Be prepared if you come and find certain items unavailable.
Calling ahead to order is a good option.
There are two convenient branches in Bangkok:
one in Talat Noi opposite the bus stop and another in Tak Lak Kia, and another in Yaowarat, Soi Yaowapanich.
The Yaowarat branch is now easily accessible.
Take the MRT Blue Line extension to Wat Mangkon station; no need to drive and search for parking.
They also offer other delicious and affordable snacks.
sample_reviews_en.author: panas r.rangsi

sample_reviews_en.text: This Chinese confectionery shop sells traditional Chinese pastries, mooncakes, and other Chinese sweets. They offer a variety of mooncakes with different fillings, including a lightly sweet and smooth bean paste filling. They come in various sizes, both small and large. They also have a selection of peanut brittle and sesame brittle, all with a pleasant sweetness, fragrant peanut and sesame aroma, and a crunchy but not hard texture. The sweets are sold by the piece or by weight, and the prices are affordable; for example, a large mooncake is 150 baht. The shop also has a branch in Yaowarat (Chinatown).
sample_reviews_en.author: Nan Peeraya

sample_reviews_en.text: Thank you Mr Sam Chen, 4th Gen owner of Tae Lao Chin Seng bakery (over 100 years old) for all your recommendations of tau sar piah (red and mung bean biscuit). The traditional Teochew piah that we bought and sampled were all SO GOOD! The taste of each piah was so unique and flavourful - sweet, savoury, spicy, 香. We’ve never tasted anything like them in SG or any Asian country. And thank you for the short tour of your “factory”. It is such heritage food (tau sar piah) and a brand like Tae Lao that should be continued for as long as possible. All the best and good health to you.
sample_reviews_en.author: A H

sample_reviews_en.text:
It’s a 100 years ancient tradition cakes bakery, I heard about there also providing the best moon cakes in Bangkok, these cakes are becoming one part of Bangkok. By luckily I met the boss when I specifically went there, he is a very friendly person, introduced different flavors of cakes all the time, let me tasted too many varieties of cakes, very kind.
How can I describe the taste of varieties cakes? I can say all I bought about 8 different cakes were excellent, elegant, delicate and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vincent Neo

sample_reviews_en.text:
A 55 year old shop with an angry snoopy guarding the cake. Whenever I sample the cakes, it starts barking at me .. hilarious 😂

Cakes are delightfully on the sweeter side. When my friend told me he was going to buy Chinese cakes, I told him that's not for me. After sampling, I ended buying more than he does. Worth a visit and after sampling, you can try to resist not buying like I did, which I failed.  6 cakes cost thb96
sample_reviews_en.author: Sean Sean

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop sells authentic Teochew-style mooncakes and has been doing so for almost 100 years. Their signature item is the mooncake, available with many different fillings such as bean paste, winter melon paste, savory fillings, and mixed nuts filling. They come in both small and large sizes, and the fillings are delicious, not overly sweet. They even have mooncakes suitable for wedding ceremonies.
sample_reviews_en.author: DS6909_05 ดาราณี เวชพงศา

sample_reviews_en.text: Back in the day, when Chinese families from the older generation came to Thailand, they didn't have the tools to make them like today. Chinese pastries were very popular among Chinese people back then, especially for engagement and wedding ceremonies. Nowadays, modern sweets like pies, cakes, and cookies have largely replaced them, so the tradition of making Chinese pastries has decreased.
sample_reviews_en.author: พรชัย ทิพย์กําจรวงศ์

sample_reviews_en.text: A traditional Chinese bakery selling delicious Chinese pastry. The shop keepers ( or owners) are all very friendly and kind, they offer sampling of the pastries and introduction of different pastries. Price is also reasonable, you will get a paper box if you purchase 6 pcs or more. Really love the old fashioned style of the shop. Highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Don Leung

restaurants.name: Qi Li Xiang 七里香
restaurants.address:

44 11 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
七里香QiLiXiang(Chinese cuisine in the Northeast)
-Fragrant Seven Li (Li) in Asoke, Sukhumvit 21
Northern style Chinese food with good taste
Although it is stir-fried and deep-fried
But it is considered well-made without being too greasy
Using the fire and pan well, as expected from Chinese food
Easy to eat, tastes good to Thai people
There are many flavors, not just salty
But rich, fragrant and full of flavor
If you want to try Chinese food that is not southern Chinese, good taste, easy to eat, go to this restaurant
Prices vary depending on the menu, it is good to go in a group, it is lively
It is also good to change the atmosphere every now and then

The restaurant is not very big, there are about 15 tables
It is better to make a reservation in advance
Opens from noon
Parking is a bit difficult
Using public transportation is probably more convenient
sample_reviews_en.author: Chom Harn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Jajangmyeon (black bean noodles) 100 baht~ Mixing the noodles with cucumber makes it a real treat. The seasoning alone is salty, deliciously salty.

Grilled chili noodles 180 baht~ Delicious. A bit salty and slightly spicy.
It's a bit salty on its own.
It's perfect with fried dumplings.

Fried dumplings 100 baht~ These are edible, but they feel a bit empty.

Each dish is exactly one serving. We were so full we had some leftovers. Tsingtao beer 100 baht~ We also had a bottle. The total bill doesn't quite add up.

560 baht ~ about 22,400 won.

Delicious. I'd definitely visit again.
There's air conditioning.
sample_reviews_en.author: H jin E

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious 😋 and the wait wasn't long. The taste and portion size were just right.
I also ordered fried rice but didn't take a picture of it. The fried rice took a little while to prepare. The staff were helpful and lovely.
P.S. The restaurant doesn't issue tax invoices; it's a cash receipt, and it's entirely in Chinese.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dadadadaow

sample_reviews_en.text:
I think this is the perfect restaurant for a reasonably priced Chinese meal that won't disappoint. 
I don't remember the name of the dish, but one that looked like sweet and sour pork was particularly delicious. 

However, when they're busy it can take quite a while for your food to come out after you order, so be aware of that.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sweet Yakuza

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a restaurant where you can eat delicious Chinese food at a reasonable price.
The shop isn't big, but I think it's just the right size for enjoying Chinese food with a small number of people.
If you like Chinese food, it's worth trying if you go to Asoke.
It's an affordable and delicious Chinese restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Y Ishikawa

sample_reviews_en.text:
A reasonably priced Chinese restaurant in Asoke. It has a diner-like feel.
It's not very crowded, so it's a good place to have a light meal and drinks by yourself after work.
The cuisine is said to be from the northern part of the mainland, but the taste is not bad and it suits Japanese palates as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: KA

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an affordable Chinese restaurant. Most dishes are priced around 100-120 THB, making it good value for money.
I made a mapo rice bowl with fried rice topped with mapo tofu, and it was delicious.
The boiled dumplings were a little on the light side, so mixing two types of sauce was just right.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yoshinori N

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s nice to have a Chinese food option in Asoke.   This place have a large menu.      I walked in around 5pm the place was quiet I order for takeout took about 20 minutes for my order to be ready.     Not sure how to read the menu, but their sauerkraut based soup with tofu and pork is pretty good.
sample_reviews_en.author: H S

restaurants.name: เจ๊เอ็ง ก๋วยจั๊บน้ำข้น
restaurants.address:

986 ซอย 43 ถนนพระรามที่ 2 Bang Mot, Chom Thong, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
There are no tables to sit and eat at. Even just one would be great. There are no bowls for condiments, and the containers or anything to cover them are left open. The condiment trays aren't clean. We drive past the shop all the time. With COVID-19 on the horizon, it's best to do some preventative cleaning for yourself and your customers.
As for the kuay jap, the soup isn't too sweet, just right.
sample_reviews_en.author: t-gmail 2020

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kuay jap nam khon 8 points
Kao lao 8.5 points
Kuay tiaw lod 8 points
My partner and I ordered four bowls.
We ordered the special, 50 baht per bowl.
Total bill: 200 baht.
The offal was clean and tender. The soup was fragrant and delicious, no need for additional seasoning. The owner was cheerful, friendly, and served the food quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakjira Rangsiwattanasak

sample_reviews_en.text: Very delicious! Crispy pork, soup, noodles, everything is well worth the price. Local restaurants like this are very rare. I used to order through an app and they delivered. This shop seems to sell very well and doesn't accept orders through the app anymore. Such a shame. If I have a chance, I will go and eat at the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: ningning weena

sample_reviews_en.text: The thick broth noodle soup is delicious. The offal, like intestines and liver, has no unpleasant smell. The crispy pork is also crispy and not too fatty. They also have rice noodle rolls. The topping is fragrant and tasty. The price is also affordable. 👍👍👍 …
sample_reviews_en.author: karuna vijitpiromsuk

sample_reviews_en.text:
I last ate there in 2013, back when I worked with Auntie Su and Uncle Po.
It's next to the pharmacy. It's delicious and I always stop by whenever I pass by. I'll definitely support them this year when I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: มดดํา แก้วหานาม

sample_reviews_en.text:
An old favorite, I've been eating here for a long time.
I like to eat kway chap (rice noodle soup) paired with
crispy pork with sweet soy sauce.
= Delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalit Vitayakomol

sample_reviews_en.text: Grandma's cooking is delicious. It has a home-style flavor, not too strong with soy sauce, and it even comes with crispy pork for only 40 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภาณุวัฒน์ ธัญยนพพร

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice noodle soup is delicious, and the rice noodle rolls are okay too. They even add crispy pork. At 40 baht per dish, it's not expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณรงค์ศักดิ์ เลี้ยง

restaurants.name: Shiguma Japanese Restaurant
restaurants.address:

355 แอมพาร์คจุฬา ชั้น1 Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A budget-friendly buffet at 489 baht that offers great value and delicious food.

The shabu-shabu is good; the broth is tasty, the sliced ​​pork is very thin, the bacon is very thin and large, the beef is tender and not chewy, the shrimp is fresh, and the sushi is decent – ​​I like the bite-sized portions, especially the sweet shrimp, seared salmon, and crab stick sushi. They even have ice cream for dessert.

Considering the price per person (with change from a purple banknote), and the quality of the food, it's excellent value. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bad Bad'z

sample_reviews_en.text: The meat quality was good and acceptable, but the sashimi was a bit disappointing. It seemed like the restaurant might be holding back on ingredients, or something. I ordered two plates of salmon salad, but only received one. I asked twice, but they still didn't serve the second one, even though the restaurant wasn't very busy at the time. It shouldn't have been a mistake. I also ordered two large sashimi sets, but only one was served. They were very indifferent. I felt it wasn't worth the 1,799 baht per person.
sample_reviews_en.author: ppraew

sample_reviews_en.text:
For me, it was excellent value at 499 baht.
The sushi was delicious, with just the right amount of rice, good quality pork and beef, and clean vegetables. The staff were friendly and provided good service.
*I encourage you to give it a try. I went on a Sunday and there weren't many people. I really want you to try it. It's a great restaurant with high-quality food. I hope it stays open for a long time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Monkey Mer

sample_reviews_en.text: This Japanese-style shabu-shabu restaurant has a fragrant and delicious broth, high-quality meat, and the fried items are amazing—not greasy at all! The sushi is also delicious with high-quality salmon. The dipping sauces are great. Everything is perfect!!! I will definitely come back again. Importantly, the staff provides excellent service. Very impressed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Earn Apis

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate the 489 net set. The pork was tender, the beef was decent, the soup was fragrant and delicious, and the black dipping sauce was tasty. Once you open the buffet set, you can order sushi or sashimi separately at a lower price. (Currently, there's a promotion where you get one free piece of sushi from the next more expensive set if you leave a review.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Chawannuch Putwatthana

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was of high quality and the service was excellent. The staff were lovely, attentive, and helpful, offering menu recommendations. Food was served quickly, and they refilled our water glasses very promptly (hahaha). We had just finished our water and they had already refilled it a second time!
sample_reviews_en.author: afterweknown official

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was okay, especially the beef broth. Unfortunately, they limit desserts to one per person and refills aren't available. The strawberry soft serve was delicious. Also, the extra charge for bank transfer payments wasn't ideal; cash only, no credit cards accepted.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zeiiz Aezz

sample_reviews_en.text: The meat was excellent, incredibly juicy. Meat lovers must try it! The service was great, the staff were very lovely and attentive to our table throughout the meal. Very impressed. The sashimi was also very fresh and the texture was firm. Come and try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: SUCHANYA JUNSEN

restaurants.name: CoCo ICHIBANYA
restaurants.address:

Floor 3, 3522 Lat Phrao Rd Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Living up to its standard. (taste, price, service wise)

For those who craves Japanese style curry rice and doesn't know where else to go, expects a standard no extravagancy taste, go for Coco Ichibanya. The taste of the curry and its varieties of toppings and ingredients here is just about right (for Thai palette). It's as much as a chain restaurant can give. They've got various branches located at various department stores. The taste is not fancy while the price is within an affordable range ranging from 200THB - 300THB on average per head per meal. If you didn't expect that much of an authentic taste or a fancy place to dine in and Japanese curry is what you craves at the time, it wouldn't hurt to go for Coco.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuntanut C.

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered seafood baked macaroni and cheese for 220 baht. What I got was macaroni and bits of imitation crab. I almost finished the plate and still hadn't found a single shrimp. I don't know if they forgot to add it or if the shrimp were too small to see. I once had this dish at a different pizza chain and it had four shrimp – totally worth the money! If you're going to cut costs that much, just increase the price; I'd gladly pay more. This is a disappointment. Or maybe change the name to "Baked Macaroni and Cheese with Imitation Crab" – that would seem more honest with consumers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fin

sample_reviews_en.text:
🚩 The restaurant has moved to the 3rd floor, the same floor as the cinema. The mall has recently renovated the entire 3rd floor into a restaurant area.

🚩 The food tastes delicious and meets the restaurant's standards. My favorite is the red pickled vegetable called "Fukujinzuke," which pairs perfectly with the curry rice.

🚩 The staff provides good service. The newly decorated restaurant is beautiful and the seating is comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patinya Wisuth

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has plenty of seating, and the food didn't take long to arrive. The prices are quite high for a meal, but the portion size and taste are truly worth the price. Curry usually has a distinctive aroma, but Coco's has a very mild one. It's delicious and flavorful, like it's been adjusted for Thai tastes. The staff were attentive and helpful. Overall, it was a good experience, and I'll definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anchisa Singpitakmatha

sample_reviews_en.text:
This curry is rich and satisfying. You can choose the spiciness level of the curry, the amount of rice, and the amount of curry to suit your preference. If you want to reduce the amount of rice, you'll get a discount.

Recommended: Level 4 spiciness/less rice/

The must-have is the red vegetables in the jar. I can tell you they go perfectly together. When you run out, you can ask the staff for more.
sample_reviews_en.author: TonAor

sample_reviews_en.text: The curry here is amazing! The spiciness level is a bit high for the level 2 I went with, so I'd recommend getting level 2 or lower if you have low spice tolerance. But other than that, this is amazing, the chicken is crispy and nice, the egg is runny in a way, and the snacks are very good. The milk shake is a bit too chunky (with crushed ice?) tho.
sample_reviews_en.author: Isaac

sample_reviews_en.text:
The menu looked cute and there weren't many people, so I decided to come in and eat.

The seating wasn't very comfortable, the service was slow, and the taste didn't match the price. But that day, every restaurant was crowded, and I was very hungry.
sample_reviews_en.author: pink poison

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is clean, airy, and the staff are attentive.
The taste is up to par.
I had it on level 4 spiciness and it was very satisfying. 😁
You can ask for more pickled vegetables.
The kids loved it.

The restaurant offers a 10% service charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natchanan Muangthanasunthon

restaurants.name: ร้านอาหาร New 888
restaurants.address:

Pom Prap, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
An absolute standout in Bangkok’s Chinatown. The food was exceptional — bold flavors, beautifully presented, and every dish felt both authentic and surprisingly refined. But what truly made the experience unforgettable was the service.

The staff were incredibly attentive, warm and genuinely passionate about what they do. From recommendations to small details throughout the evening, everything was handled with care, professionalism and real hospitality that made us feel so welcome.

The cocktails were also a huge surprise in the best possible way — creative, original and perfectly balanced, with unique flavor combinations that felt thoughtful rather than gimmicky. Easily some of the most innovative drinks we’ve had in Bangkok.

Amazing atmosphere, fantastic energy, outstanding service and food to match. A place that feels special from the moment you walk in. Highly recommended. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
sample_reviews_en.author: Patricia Volny

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited this bar twice during our stay in Bangkok and absolutely loved it. We only had drinks (no food), but everything was great and the atmosphere was amazing.
One staff member in particular really stood out, incredibly kind, funny, and full of great tips for the city. He even played some German music just for us, simply to make us feel welcome, which was such a sweet and thoughtful gesture.
Overall, a fantastic place with a warm vibe and wonderful people. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Katy

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I spent two weeks in Bangkok, and discovering New888 Bar was one of the highlights of my trip. The bar has an amazing energy, great music, delicious food, and excellent drinks.
The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, making us feel right at home from the very first moment. We left with wonderful memories and a strong desire to come back.
When we return to Bangkok, New888 will definitely be a must-visit. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ana Rodrigues

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the few regular bars in Chinatown/Bang Rak area. Here you can get a beer for 100 baht and a coke for 50. Just like everywhere else. This area in general only consist of more expensive cocktail bars so it’s really nice to have found this place. Very good English speaking employees and I was treated very good here. They also have karaoke here if you are into that. Definitely a place to drop by and support
sample_reviews_en.author: Kasper Hammer-Hansen

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is magical. I came a year ago and had a blast so naturally on my last night in Thailand I wandered back just to see it and as soon as I walked in the man working remembered me from a year before. Every night in here is special. The karaoke actually goes somewhere and the drinks are legit. Def recommend for a good noght of songs and friends 🧡
sample_reviews_en.author: Morgan Stewart

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice little Bar in Chinatown. They have seating inside and outside. The drink prices are cheap and the staff is very friendly. The music is good and sometimes they have special events. There are TVs with sport broadcasts also. The people coming here are diverse from young to old. Can definitely recommend this Bar.
sample_reviews_en.author: Timo Daedrich

sample_reviews_en.text: As we entered there was a stink in the restaurant which put us off( the wash room  is just there behind the table) Absolutely no one in the restaurant and we were totally disappointed since we expected a good evening karaoke, . Food wasn't that great for the price. There is a 7% vat for beverages.
sample_reviews_en.author: julia kumar

sample_reviews_en.text: I didn't eat any food, so couldn't really give a vote (hence middle of the road 3*). One thing I can review is the excellent service from Pey. He really looked after us and made us welcome..it's a brilliant bar and one we'll 100% come back to. Keep up the good work.
sample_reviews_en.author: T H

restaurants.name: แก้ว บะหมี่เกี๊ยว รสเด็ด
restaurants.address:

PGH8+P8M, Si Phraya, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Hong Kong style noodles, thin, chewy, and delightfully satisfying. Great price, they even have a jumbo size for 70 baht – super filling! Regular is 50 baht, special is 60 baht. You can eat as much as you want and still not feel full. It's really delicious! The noodles are perfectly cooked. Dry noodles aren't usually tasty if the cook isn't skilled, but this place isเทพ (god-level). So delicious, I eat here often. Good service. Highly recommend. Reviewed by me, the owner! (🤣🤣🤣🤣)
sample_reviews_th.author: Nawachai Harnkla

sample_reviews_en.text:
This noodle and wonton shop, which doesn't serve crispy pork, is set up on the sidewalk with tables near a doorway. There are about 10 tables, covered by umbrellas, so it's not too hot. It gets quite busy at lunchtime.

Dry Wonton Noodles (Special): 60 Baht (May 13, 2026) The noodles are thin, chewy, and soft. The wontons are large with plenty of tender pork filling and thin wrappers. The fried garlic is fragrant. The crispy pork cracklings are sparse, dry, bland, and not oily.

Wonton Soup: 60 Baht. A generous portion of wontons in a golden yellow broth with a sweet flavor and fragrant fried garlic. Self-service water is available. Payment by bank transfer is accepted.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponchagarj Ngamukos

sample_reviews_en.text:
Here we go again with another noodle review! This time, it's street food again, and we're talking about the best wonton noodles in this area. The shop is called Kaew Wonton Noodles, located next to Soi Charoen Krung 39.
***Regarding the taste, the noodles are chewy and soft, the broth is rich and flavorful, and the wontons are fragrant and appetizing. They offer both dry and soup versions. It's delicious! I give it 5 stars!
The shop is open from 10:30 AM to 2:00 PM. It's so crowded you'll have to wait in line. Give it a try!
#KaewWontonNoodles
#NoodlesTellMe
#CharoenKrungRoad
#ChallengeToTry
#StreetFoods
sample_reviews_en.author: กินเที่ยวแบบบ้านๆ eattripeasy

sample_reviews_en.text: A hidden gem on Charoen Krung Road: a delicious noodle cart with standard prices. It gets very crowded around lunchtime with long queues. The noodles are perfectly cooked, the dumplings are chewy and soft, and the roasted pork is fragrant and appetizing. Parking is a bit difficult; you'll have to park in Soi Charoen Krung 39.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phanthai Phanpongthai

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious!
Absolutely amazing!

The noodles are bouncy and crispy, incredibly tasty.
The char siu pork is thick and tender, sliced ​​to just the right thickness.
Not just a hint of pork! The soup is average.
The dumplings are bite-sized, and they give you a generous amount of crispy pork rind.

So underrated!
sample_reviews_en.author: Junejune Purr

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious! Dry noodles with wontons and barbecued pork, with barbecued pork broth and crispy pork cracklings mixed together. So flavorful! Enjoy it with the hot soup.

Just seasoned with a little pepper.
It's so good... so comforting.

I could order a second serving, but I'm already full! 😁😁😁😋
sample_reviews_en.author: pornthip sornsuk

sample_reviews_en.text:
These are the best Chinese noodles I've ever eaten!

50 THB for a small bowl, 60 THB for a large one—amazing!

I usually get the noodles dry with the broth on the side; just thinking about it makes my mouth water, hahaha.
sample_reviews_en.author: Salina Nussbaum

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! For a roadside stall, the noodles were perfectly cooked, the char siu pork was flavorful, the dumplings were tasty, and the soup was good. It was well worth driving from another part of the city to eat here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thiraphong Sriratanamongkol

restaurants.name: Swensen’s Market Place Krungthep Kreetha
restaurants.address:

241 Krungthep Kreetha Rd, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I've never had any problems with this brand's products; they're genuinely good. But I'm writing this review because I'm really fed up with the staff. The last time I ate there was on Sunday, January 18th, 2026, around 4:27 PM. There were several staff members standing together, and one of them was clearing glasses and putting things into the refrigerator, making a clinking sound every second. The manager or relevant person can check the security camera footage. I wanted to call the manager, but I don't think it would have any effect since you were standing together and didn't warn anyone. There were 2-3 tables of customers, and everyone heard it. I was very disappointed. I will never go to this branch again, and I wouldn't recommend it. You might encounter a similar situation because the staff seem very relaxed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nitchanan Jamratchaiyawong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I had the opportunity to visit Sam Kha Market Place Krungthep Kreetha and surprised my girlfriend for her birthday. The staff at the shop provided excellent service; I was very impressed. They were extremely cooperative and I highly commend them.
The ice cream was still delicious and clean. Please pass on my compliments to Nong Malengpo (the staff member) and encourage her to maintain this high level of service.
sample_reviews_en.author: ขวัญชนก ปลอดโปร่ง

sample_reviews_en.text: It was a very special and memorable occasion. The staff at Swensen's took excellent care of us, the atmosphere was great—spacious, clean, and the music was lovely. The best part was they gave us free whipped cream and candles for our birthday! Thank you for such a wonderful experience. We'll definitely be back for a second time! 🥰🎁💗
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploypailin Ms

sample_reviews_en.text: I bought a mini quart, but they only gave me three scoops and just spread it on top. It was obvious the inside was hollow. There was no weighing at all; it definitely wasn't even 250 grams. They should improve this. And the ice cream wasn't cheap either.
sample_reviews_en.author: CAt meow :3

sample_reviews_en.text: November 27, 2025 (8:00 PM) Received excellent service. The staff were even nicer than usual, providing great service, good manners, and helpful advice. The ice cream was exactly as pictured. Thank you to all the staff for the wonderful service.
sample_reviews_en.author: CNY YIDNORADIN

sample_reviews_en.text: “I was very impressed. The staff at Swensen's took great care of me, providing warm and attentive service. The atmosphere was great, spacious, clean, and the music was pleasant. The restaurant is large and not cramped at all. The best part …
sample_reviews_en.author: Wrtx Aam _

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I came to have ice cream to celebrate my birthday. All the staff were very attentive and provided excellent service, especially Tangkwa and the two male and female managers. I was very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: SaTHaPoRN NoiPeng

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate at Marketplace, Bangkok Kreetha branch. The staff provided excellent service, especially Tangkwa, who surprised me with a belated birthday celebration❣️ "It was an unforgettable experience."
sample_reviews_en.author: Capt. Shin

restaurants.name: ไซลั้ง ก๋วยเตี๋ยวหลอดเท็กซัส เยาวราช
restaurants.address:

11 Phadung Dao Rd, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
😋 It's hard to find delicious rice noodle rolls these days. I found this place with both thick and thin noodles to choose from, and they give you plenty of pork and squid. There's no tofu, and the bean sprouts are blanched just right – crunchy, not hard, and not bitter. The portion is bigger than I expected; one bowl is perfectly filling.
Motorcycles can park in front of the shop / Cars will probably have to park at Texas Suki / Coming by MRT is probably the most convenient, then you can walk around afterwards.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasina Ngamsinthawee

sample_reviews_en.text:
From being located in a narrow alley next to Texas Suki on Phadung Dao Street, they've moved to a location on Phadung Dao Street, near their original location.
There are tables inside the restaurant, making it more comfortable.
The taste remains the same, but the price has increased, in exchange for cleanliness, convenience, and good service.
Before, there were no assistants, but now there are staff to serve, likely family members helping out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wan Kong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Restaurant: Special Seasoned Rice Noodle Rolls
Texas Alley
Price: 50-60 baht
The shop seasons it perfectly.
I like spicy food, so I added more seasoning.
The fried garlic is fragrant, and the bean sprouts are perfectly blanched.
The pickled radish and green onions are added in just the right amount.
The highlight is the crispy squid.
The shop uses very high-quality ingredients.
I've had crispy squid elsewhere that doesn't compare.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piya Jirapapongpan

sample_reviews_en.text: I am proud to present “Guay tiew lord”, the secret recipe of making traditional steamed rice noodles which has been passed on from generation to generation. The small restaurant is located right in the middle of yaowarat, open from 8 am to 2 pm. If not too busy, I recommend to sit and enjoy eating in; or else taking away and eat them right away before the noodles get too cooked. 50 baht per serving, great value for money
sample_reviews_en.author: Somchart Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: Another unpopular on social media but a true hidden gem. This little restaurant sell a Chinese inspired dry noodles bowl.  At price starting from 60thb, the portions size is very generous and the restaurant use quality ingredients. The braised pork was really aromatic and melted in your mouth. Adding a little bit of their house made chili vinegar gave the dish the extra tang.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sandee Tour

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is clean, the food is delicious, the service is good, and the staff are polite. Today I tried the special thick rice noodle rolls, and they truly delivered on their promise of being extra special. Next time, I'll try the braised pork rice and the Grandma's special rice porridge. I found out that "Sae Lam" is the name of the grandmother who created the recipe.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phetchara Ouitrakul

sample_reviews_en.text: These steamed rice noodle rolls are something I've been eating since I was a child. The soft rice noodle wrappers are served with bean sprouts. The secret ingredient is the fried garlic, sweet pickled radish, and other vegetables, all topped with a flavorful broth of braised pork and dried squid. When eating, drizzle with dark soy sauce and vinegar. Absolutely delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Vitaya Kunavichayanont

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! It's the original recipe, which is hard to find these days. I love the mixed noodles, which include both thick and thin noodles; the texture changes as they absorb the broth. The pork is tender and easy to chew. The flavor isn't too strong these days. There's limited seating, so I recommend taking it home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Treepradab Uts

restaurants.name: ร้าน ปอเจริญ
restaurants.address:

960 Samsen 26 Alley, Thanon Nakhon Chai Si, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Por Charoen is a noodle shop located on Samsen Road, opposite Rajini School, near the entrance to Samsen Soi 26. It's an open-air shop with a reasonable number of tables inside. The atmosphere is that of an old-fashioned noodle shop, with stone tables and wooden chairs. They sell pork noodles, tom yum pork noodles, and yen ta fo noodles. The taste is average, and the prices are inexpensive. The toppings are a bit sparse, though they do give a generous amount of tofu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaiyakit Thanabriboon

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a shop run by a Chinese person, but now the descendants of that person can no longer read the writing on the shop's decor. The noodles are delicious and very cheap!

I also met an elderly lady who spoke Mandarin and asked if I was Singaporean. I said I was from China, and she started telling me about her time in China when she was young. She concluded by saying, "See you again sometime!"
sample_reviews_en.author: castle Ron

sample_reviews_en.text:
This old fish ball noodle shop in the Bang Krabue area is a local favorite. I've been eating here since I was a kid, and now I'm over 40, but the taste is consistently delicious. They used to sell traditional coffee too, but now they only serve noodles.

If you're in the area, you shouldn't miss it. Delicious, generous portions, and great value!
sample_reviews_en.author: Aeronote8tical SJ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very old school.

The noodles are perfectly cooked, not mushy, and the sauce is delicious.

The toppings are good, including the char siu pork, meatballs, and fish dumplings.

There are some fried dumplings, but they're not crispy, just chewy.

Price is 50 baht. Very filling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teerapat Ungsriwong

sample_reviews_en.text: I happened to walk past this place that sells dry Yen Ta Fo noodles with fried tofu. The tofu was soft, and the fish balls were bouncy but not fishy. It's a shame they didn't include fish dumplings, and they even poured the Yen Ta Fo broth over the fried dumplings!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachai Juengsomjit

sample_reviews_en.text: This vintage-style restaurant, reminiscent of our parents' era, offers easy-to-eat, standardly delicious food with generous toppings and plenty of noodles at an affordable price (45 baht). Good service. Give it a try! It's a shame there's no parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: ZUANG JU

sample_reviews_en.text: Clean, reasonable price. They remember my order even before I speak, even though I'm a regular customer. I used to eat there often, but due to COVID, I only go occasionally, and they still remember my favorite dishes.... 👍👍👍👍👍 …
sample_reviews_en.author: lek punk

sample_reviews_en.text: Looking at the vintage style of the shop and noodle cart, it's grammatically perfect. I decided to go in and order. The taste was good, the portions were generous, so I ordered two big bowls.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leo Kanont

restaurants.name: Bee’s
restaurants.address:

Samsen 4 Alley, Khwaeng Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We came here twice during our stay in the neighbourhood after reading the reviews and then had to come again! The most lovely lovely lady runs this place, cooks delicious great value food, is so so friendly and made us feel so welcome. If you’re in the area you have to come here for an authentic meal :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Sophie Shaw

sample_reviews_en.text: I was staying nearby in a hotel and had not eaten dinner yet and I didn’t wanna get into a cab after Bangkok traffic so I decided to search Google and found this place. The nice lady outside makes everything fresh within 10 minutes and like another reviewer said it was the best green curry that I’ve had
sample_reviews_en.author: Raj Balwani

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best restaurants/street food spots I tried during my several-month trip through Asia. Local prices, and the food was made with fresh ingredients.

I especially loved the curry and the basil rice.

The manager is also very friendly and welcoming.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anthony Parmier

sample_reviews_en.text: Thai foods are very delicious here.... All foods are prepares freshly.... I ate fried rice with fried egg topping that's amazing... wow such a great experience.... Also she serves polite and smiles.... You must try once ....😍
sample_reviews_en.author: RJ ROCKY JES (NELLAI ROCKY)

sample_reviews_en.text: A small restaurant run by a very lovely young woman. The Phanaeng curry was the best I've ever had, and all the other dishes were fresh and lovingly prepared. If I ever come back to Bangkok, I'll definitely go to Bee's again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Louana Podgornik

sample_reviews_en.text: Perfect tom yum - spicy, savoury, acidic. A very generous portion, plenty of meat and veg. You can see the owner prepare your food in front of the shop. Everything I wanted, good value with great service as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maddie

sample_reviews_en.text: The cafe is nice and the service good, but the food is disappointing. I ordered pad Thai and saw it being made in front of me - lots of oil was used but no aromatics, no sauce, no spices. It was very very bland.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maria Alice Ferigo

sample_reviews_en.text: Best Thai food near Khao San party mile, cheap and with fresh ingredients from the market every day. I tried at least 5 dishes and everything was great. Run by Bee(zenika) and her daughter, highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stephan Dietl

restaurants.name: บ้านขาหมู - BAAN Kha Moo
restaurants.address:

100/683 Lat Pla Khao Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I came here based on reviews, and it was okay. At 55 baht per plate, you get a good amount of meat; the portion size is worth the price. The pork was tender and easy to eat. The shop is a small house on a side street, with directions on both sides. Following Google Maps might be a bit confusing. You can park on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chuchart Tritrungtassana

sample_reviews_en.text: This pork leg rice dish is delicious and well-rounded, not too sweet or salty. The portions are generous. The garlic and chili peppers that go with it are fresh. The chili sauce is finely ground and rich. The owner provides excellent service. You can park in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukwan At.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The braised pork leg is rich and flavorful, and the menu is diverse. Their stir-fried basil pork is so good, it makes everyone in the restaurant sneeze!

The pork intestines are a bit chewy; I prefer them soft and melt-in-your-mouth.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nut Nithirojpakdee

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a small shop on a corner.
There's seating inside the house.
The garlic is already peeled and ready to serve.
The chili fish sauce is packed with ingredients.
The pork leg stir-fry is incredibly delicious, highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanadej Asawabharuj

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every dish was delicious. My favorite was the stir-fried pork leg with basil; it was so tasty and flavorful.
Parking is available on the roadside according to the rules for each day (even/odd day) as designated by the village.
sample_reviews_en.author: JJ So

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pork leg is delicious and reasonably priced, compared to some restaurants that are not as tasty and expensive.
I highly recommend it. You can also use the "Half-Half" payment method.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanyaporn Singhasemanond

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has very delicious food, especially the pork leg with basil. I recommend coming in the morning when there are fewer people and you can sit and eat in a relaxed manner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zakura_Tipp

sample_reviews_en.text: The braised pork knuckle was delicious, the pork was tender, the chili fish sauce was good, the steamed buns were soft and dense, and the coffee was excellent!
sample_reviews_en.author: Shakri A

restaurants.name: Kitchen Chef's
restaurants.address:

81, 47 Pracha Uthit Rd, Bang Mot, Thung Khru, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I ordered spaghetti with cream sauce; it was very creamy but a little too salty, so I deducted one point. Near the end, I found a hair in my dish. The baked macaroni and cheese (69฿) had 2-3 pieces of bacon; the macaroni was cooked just right, but the portion was a bit small for the price. I ordered salmon and corn salad with fermented fish sauce (149฿) to balance the richness; it wasn't too sweet and tasted good. There's no parking for cars; you have to find parking somewhere in the side street.
sample_reviews_th.author: Kun กุน

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Had a great experience at Kitchen Chef’s! The food has a really good and decent taste overall. The beef is incredibly tender, and I really enjoyed the fermented fish sauce with white small noodles — packed with flavor. Their crispy pork and salmon sashimi are also super tasty and fresh.

Another plus: the takeaway is just as good as dining in. The quality stays consistent, and the packaging is done well.

Just a quick tip — if you’re not good with spicy food, be sure to let the chef know in advance not to add chili, as some dishes can come quite spicy by default.

Definitely worth trying if you’re in the area!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rujiphat L

sample_reviews_en.text: I have come to try Kitchen Chef for the first time, it is a local restaurant that cozy and welcoming. There are variety of food to choose such as spaghetti, steak, yum and so on. I ordered salmon yum, which tastes very good, salmon was flesh also the portion was fair for the price, and the price is affordable. Moreover, the owner is kind too. Only that the restaurant is small, it gets very crowded in  the evening. Overall the place is good, also it near KMUTT too. I would recommend this place especially for Bangmod students to come here and try tasty food.
sample_reviews_en.author: kate pretty

sample_reviews_en.text: Kitchen Chef is a small restaurant near the front of KMUTT. The place has warm lights, simple decorations, and an open kitchen where you can see the chef cooking. These features make the restaurant feel friendly and easy to enjoy. The food is the biggest strength of this place. The spaghetti pesto salmon tastes amazing and always satisfies me, which is why I keep ordering it. Watching the chef cook adds more trust in the food quality. Overall, the experience feels cozy, comfortable, and relaxing. I highly recommend Kitchen Chef to students around KMUTT.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bam 3618

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste of the food: the salmon and crispy pork were a bit too salty. If you reduce the saltiness a bit, it would be perfect. The crispy pork was very good, crispy for a long time, even when the fish sauce was covering it, it was still crispy. The salmon didn't smell fishy at all, it wasn't mushy. Next time I'll try other menus. The combination looks interesting and worth trying. Oh, and one more thing: I'm afraid the chair will break my bottom when I sit on it. There are nails sticking out. I tried to sit on it, otherwise my bottom would break.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wachi W

sample_reviews_en.text:
Bangmod's best! This restaurant is incredibly delicious! I'm so in love with it! 💖
They have a huge selection of dishes, including Thai, Western, and fusion. They have pasta, omelet rice, spicy salads, and more. Everything looks delicious! And most importantly, the prices are amazing, just like eating at an expensive restaurant. They're affordable for students and working professionals. The ingredients are excellent. The salmon is huge and the grilled beef is incredibly fragrant and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyatida Thongtha

sample_reviews_en.text: A small restaurants near KMUTT only 200m away from university reasonably priced and tastes well. If you're unsure what to eat, they suggest the "Up to Chef menu," which the chef will create a mystery menu for you to enjoy .I recommended you the salmon cream cheese spaghetti. Shouldn’t miss this. Unfortunately in rush hour you may need to wait longer than usual.Sadly, there isn't any parking available. Extra points for dogs lover there is 2 little cute Pugs own the restaurant
sample_reviews_en.author: This is H

sample_reviews_en.text: A small and cozy restaurant in an alley on Soi 45, across from KMUTT. The place offers a wide variety of dishes, and the food is delicious. The atmosphere inside is nice and comfortable. However, the menu book has no photos, so it’s sometimes hard to imagine what the dishes look like. You need to check the food pictures on the wall, which can be a bit inconvenient. Overall, it’s a great place if you like trying different menus and don’t mind choosing a bit blindly
sample_reviews_en.author: Nissa Somkidlert

restaurants.name: Five Star J Vegan & Vegetarian Restaurant
restaurants.address:

313, 37 หมู่ที่ 10 S Pattaya Rd, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ning’s 5 Star Vegetarian – Pattaya

I’ve eaten at plenty of vegetarian places over the years, but Ning’s 5 Star Vegetarian really stands out.

The menu is massive — Thai, Indian, even some Western-style dishes — and everything I’ve tried has been full of flavour. The mock meats are genuinely impressive (the “duck” and “prawns” in particular), and you can tell a lot of care goes into the ingredients. No MSG, no shortcuts, just clean, well-balanced food.

The service is warm and helpful, and you feel genuinely welcomed the moment you walk in. It’s a relaxed, clean space that’s perfect whether you’re a full-time vegetarian or just looking for something lighter and healthier.

Standouts for me: the tom yum with veggie seafood, crispy duck with rice, and the mango & papaya salad. Everything was fresh, colourful, and beautifully cooked.

Highly recommended – a real gem in Pattaya if you’re after quality, plant-based food done right.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Flack

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wow, this is Jay vegan on another level...!!

Extensive vegan menu, by far the most impressive I have ever seen!
-Thai food
-Mexican
-Italian
-Amercian

So many choices...!!

I ordered a traditional Thai soup, vegan seafood mock meats in a coconut curry base with a mild amount of spiciness.

The fresh flavors of this soup were outrageous!
-Rather large chunks of fresh ginger
-Lemongrass
-Lime leaves
-Chili peppers

It was a super delicious, medicinal soup.
The owner is very kind and attentive to details.
Definitely 5⭐️ Quality!

I finished the meal with a hot ginger tea and vegan banana cake.
🍵🥮🧡

The banana cake reminded me of bread pudding, lots of raisins and bite-size chunks of banana.
Total 376 baht

Thank you for an amazing jay vegan meal made with love and good karma

Highly recommend
💛🙏💛
sample_reviews_en.author: Jia Moon

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very small cozy place in Pattaya. Closes the kitchen at 8:30pm but they had accommodated us

Run by family of mother and daughter, other than egg there is nothing non veg in it

We had items like Vegetable Toast, Pad Thai, White Rice with Tofu Curry (Red Thai Curry base) and to end with the very amazing and famous thai dish Mango Sticky Rice

The food was light and fresh, the service was quick

People who are vegan and vegetarian like me should go to this place who are bored of having Indian Food Daily this is a must try because getting and Vegetarian local cuisine outside India becomes tough

The place is on the main road and can accommodate about 20 to 30 people at once

This was one of the best local delight we had in Pattaya
sample_reviews_en.author: Prithi Barmecha

sample_reviews_en.text:
Five Star J truly lives up to its name. The food is exceptional — I tried the “chicken” sandwich made from pea protein, and it was delicious. The texture, flavor, and seasoning were spot on, and the crispy golden fries (fried in coconut oil!) on the side made it a perfect meal. Every bite tasted fresh and full of care.

The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, and the staff are warm, attentive, and genuinely kind, and I chatted with the owner and staff for a bit very nice and friendly people 🙏.

Whether you’re vegan, vegetarian, or simply someone who loves great food, this restaurant is a must-visit. It’s one of those rare places where healthy and indulgent meet in the most delicious way!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeramia Valentine

sample_reviews_en.text: BEST PLANT BASED Food/ Restaurant in Pattaya!!  The the place is CLEAN, food is delicious, authentic, GOOD portions reasonably priced & BEST of all CLEAN & HEALTHY(using GOOD oil, NON GMO, NO MSG, no preservatives, no murdered animal)!!!  The menu is quite extensive, & in my opinion could be consolidated (similar items w/ slight changes ie MULTIPLE CURRIES w/ small variations), but to some it may suit them…   The owner is ALWAYS THERE (nice quality control), & her HIGH VIBES, POSITIVE attitude & SUPER FRIENDLY attitude& APPRECIATION for choosing her place just makes the place that much more enjoyable..
sample_reviews_en.author: Eli G.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great vegan & vegetarian restaurant in Pattaya. Their menu is filled with so many choices. It's incredible. The owner of the restaurant Ning, made us feel so comfortable and hospitable. She told us that she has been running this restaurant for 10 years now.

Their food is great, also something interesting to note is , not only do they serve plant based food, but also make sure that your food does not contain, No MSG, No transfat , no chemicals , no palm oil , no refined sugar.

We tried their vegan cheese which was made from cashew it was interesting.

Overall great experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: Suhas Hegde

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited here whilst on a short trip with my non vegan friend. The menu clearly identifies which food is vegan and which is vegetarian. I ordered the 'fried chicken' and my friend ate the khao soi. My friend enjoyed the khao soi but said it was a lil expensive for a basic Thai dish. My chicken was more like chicken nuggets, deep fried with a sauce for taste.  I also ordered the banana pancakes with almonds to take away.  These were quite doughy and unappetising, unfortunately.
The owner was v.friendly, and I was pleased to see it was busy for a Monday evening.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tessa Spiers

sample_reviews_en.text:
Frankly this restaurant isn't the right place to ignore if you're vegan/vegetarian, especially in Thailand. On the other hand, there is finally a restaurant that EVERYBODY can eat, and the food is actually good! Their smoothies are marvelous and the rest of the menu is worth to enjoy.
We were there and the atmosphere was dry but it might be due to the fact we were the first clients over there that evening.
Eventually we had fun, the food was great  and it is recommended to visit even though the location doesn't seem to be the best location.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lior Sapir

restaurants.name: Brunello Thailand
restaurants.address:

15 Rama IX Soi 58, Suanluang, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tonight I had the chance to stop by for a late-night meal, so I only had a salad, soup, and a glass of wine.

The food was delicious and served very quickly. Excellent service.

As for the wine, in my opinion, I would like to see more choices by the glass, at least 2-3 options would be good.

My personal rating: 7.5/10
(Remarks: *Personal opinion* scale
*** Below 7 means I wouldn't go back again.
7️⃣ The taste is okay, not a bad idea if someone invites me.
8️⃣ Delicious, I could go again occasionally.
9️⃣ Very delicious, I would highly recommend it.
🔟🏆 Extremely delicious, I would go again often, it would be my regular spot.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Phattaraphon “Boom” H.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cozy Italian restaurant with both indoor and outdoor table. Private room also available. On site parking available.

Impressed with pizza and pasta especially the pizza dough is amazing ! Fresh mozzarella also good. Some dishes such as clam and salad are nice too. However, the meat dish like lamb may good but not the must. Highly recommend to keep your stomach room for pizza and pasta ;-)

For something sweet, the fried pizza dough with Nutella is great. Hazelnut and rum raisin ice cream are perfect too. For the millefeuille, puff pastry layer is nice but in overall I personally think so-so.

Another good place to try.
sample_reviews_en.author: wallapa d.

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for a true Italian experience in the city, Brunello is a little gem in the heart of Rama IX that's worth a visit. The atmosphere is welcoming yet elegant, with both indoor and outdoor seating and a remarkable wine list.

The cuisine focuses on tradition: fresh homemade pasta, wood-fired pizzas, and clean flavors without unnecessary frills. Many customers return for the pasta and pizza... the quality of the Italian ingredients is evident.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vincenzo Piccolo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Excellent experience. The quality of the ingredients is superb, and the food is simply spectacular, with authentic flavors and impeccable presentation. The atmosphere is welcoming and elegant, ideal for enjoying a relaxing meal.

The owners are wonderful and kind people; you can see the care and passion they put into every detail. A highly recommended place that you'll always want to return to. 👌🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Lorena Norah

sample_reviews_en.text: Had a wonderful experience at Brunello Restaurant. I absolutely love their food, especially the pizza and steak, both were delicious and full of flavor. The atmosphere is warm, cozy, and perfect for a relaxing meal. What really stood out was how well the owner takes care of the customers and makes everyone feel welcome. Great food, great service, and a great environment. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Waristha Chaithongdee

sample_reviews_en.text:
An Italian-style restaurant in the Rama 9 area.

They have a wide variety of dishes, including meat, pizza, fish, and drinks. Everything tastes delicious.

The prices are on the higher side, but the ingredients are high-quality.

It's a small restaurant with limited seating.

Open in two shifts on Saturdays and Sundays: lunch and dinner. Reservations are recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: MuayLek

sample_reviews_en.text: This Italian restaurant near Rama 9 has some delicious dishes. We particularly enjoyed the Tomahawk steak, which was perfectly grilled. The fresh salad was also tasty. However, some dishes were overcooked, such as the steaks and various fish dishes. If you order these, we recommend emphasizing to the staff to avoid overcooking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pagamas Lai

sample_reviews_en.text: We all enjoyed the food very much. The tomahawk steak and lamb chops were perfectly cooked. Spaghetti vongole  and risotto were also delicious and perfectly seasoned. The tiramisu and chocolate lava were not too sweet and just right. Attentive service. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apichaya R.

restaurants.name: ครัวรสใต้ รัตนาธิเบศร์
restaurants.address:

2 หมู่8 Rattanathibech 17 Alley, Tambon Bang Kraso, อำเภอเมือง Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
This is a roadside curry rice stall with the most expensive dishes I've ever seen. If it were expensive but delicious, I wouldn't complain. But the flavors weren't rich, and the ingredients weren't good at all. How can they sell a dish for 120฿? And the stall offers small/medium/large portions, but the staff doesn't even ask customers what price they want. They just decide based on the number of people eating?
It feels like they're deliberately trying to take advantage of customers.
P.S. 3 braised eggs + scraps of pork for 120฿ / Sweet pork belly that had no belly, just the tough, chewy meat for 120฿.
#OneTimeIsEnough No wonder the stall is empty. They're charging exorbitant prices.
(Eating a roadside curry rice meal for almost 400฿ is outrageous.)
#Expensive #TasteDoesn'tLiveUpToPrice #PoorQualityIngredients
sample_reviews_th.author: Tanaporn Hengchoun

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time eating here.

Before ordering, I asked the man, who I assumed was the owner, about the prices. He said that rice with one curry dish cost 50 baht, and each additional side dish was 15 baht. This aligned with the sign on the counter that stated 2 dishes +15 baht, 3 dishes +15 baht. I ordered stir-fried minced pork with chili paste, catfish curry, a salted fried egg, and a bottle of water.

When it came time to pay, I was charged 95 baht. This caused confusion as to whether the price displayed on the sign matched the actual price, or if there were any additional charges that I wasn't informed of beforehand.

Regarding the taste, in my personal opinion, it was quite average. The food was rather salty, the rice was hard and not very hot, and most of the side dishes were cold.

While this might have been my first experience, I think the restaurant should have clearer price signs and consistent pricing details to avoid customer confusion.
sample_reviews_en.author: mellow.bbunny

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste isn't authentic Southern Thai food. The fried fish was very salty, and the other dishes were bland and tasteless, lacking the flavors of Southern Thai curry. It felt overpriced compared to the taste. Rice with two curries, one fish, and one bottle of water cost 320 baht.
The positives: There are fresh vegetables and chili paste available to help yourself to, kept in an ice chest, appearing clean and dust-free. Free drinking water is provided. The restaurant is comfortable to sit in. Adjusting the flavors to reflect authentic Southern Thai tastes would likely improve the experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amy Rung-aroon

sample_reviews_en.text: The food wasn't tasty, and the seller didn't provide any details. This time was better; the turmeric fried fish was more expensive. I thought it would be 180 baht like before, but this time it was 120 baht, which is still expensive. The rice was extremely soggy. The taste wasn't authentic Southern Thai at all! This is a genuine, honest review. P.S. I wanted to order pork bone soup, but luckily I asked the price beforehand, otherwise I would have been charged another 100 baht! 🥴🥴🥴 I've eaten Southern Thai food at many places, and this one is way too expensive!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pathick

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered two plates of rice, one bowl of bitter melon curry, and one plate of stir-fried leafy greens with egg for 340 baht. Hello!!!! Compared to other places, the taste was mediocre to not delicious at all. Speaking from the perspective of someone who cooks and knows the difference between expensive and cheap ingredients, selling at this price is like buying hotel food. It's ridiculous that they dare to sell at this price. They'll only be able to sell to casual customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: EAK EAK

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food didn't taste any better than expected.
But the prices were like a restaurant.
I ordered takeout.
I had high expectations for the taste when paying.
But when I actually ate it, the food tasted quite bad.
I ordered 4 dishes, only one was delicious.
I just ate the rest because I didn't want to waste it.
The price was extremely expensive.
Even the complimentary shrimp paste dip wasn't tasty.
The rice was also of poor quality and soggy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chang Ton

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's delicious, just as advertised, and you get a lot. The seller was kind enough to give me some shrimp paste chili sauce to try. I ordered through Line Man, which was convenient, as I didn't have to go out to eat.
The flavor was delicious, even though I don't usually eat spicy food. I still liked it. Next time, I'll order other dishes to try.
This dessert is hard to find. I love it so much!
sample_reviews_en.author: Freeze Kiwii

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordering takeout was extremely expensive. I ordered two dishes, but the price and quantity of food were completely disproportionate. I've eaten at many Southern Thai curry restaurants, but I've never encountered one like this. I definitely won't be coming back to this restaurant. Please consider this before making your decision.
sample_reviews_en.author: Atommic

restaurants.name: GrillX
restaurants.address:

Soi Sukhumvit 93, Bang Chak, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Rest assured my hungry friend, you’ll get absolutely delicious food at GrillX. I was wandering around yesterday late at night, trying to find some OG seafood and ended up at this hidden bbq, open till 3 am in the morning!

I had a bunch of different skewers, veggie, pork, squid and eel. I loved specially that you can see all the marinated meats and fresh veggies in the fridge, and design your plate. That’s the grill vibe, the squid, Burmese / Myanmar sauces, and pork tongue were outstanding.

The Staff was also very attentive and friendly! Thanks 🦑🦑
sample_reviews_en.author: Sven Mrugala

sample_reviews_en.text:
GrillX Grill & Bar is a hidden gem for anyone who loves hearty grilled dishes paired with a lively, laid-back vibe.

The atmosphere strikes a balance between casual and stylish,warm lighting,  and upbeat music that makes it feel perfect for both a dinner date or a night out with friends.

The food is the real highlight. The grilled meats come out perfectly cooked
sample_reviews_en.author: Wabby

sample_reviews_en.text: All food are so delicious and amazing service.my favorite food is fried Marlar quail, eggplant with pork minced and BBQ Enoki Mushrooms.I recommend you must try it. So so amazing and it is really match with Beer . You can enjoy with full comfortable in nice atmosphere. I love to sit outside and enjoy food 🍲♥️ just love it 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Nitu Pradhan

sample_reviews_en.text: All food are so delicious and amazing service.my favorite food is fried Marlar quail. I recommend you must try it. So so amazing and it is really match with Beer . You can enjoy with full comfortable in nice atmosphere. I love to sit outside and enjoy food 😍.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wut Yee Nyein

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is fresh and delicious! The sauces are truly extraordinary you have to come and try them. BBQ paired with ice-cold drinks makes the perfect combo. The service is friendly, and the cozy atmosphere made our dinner very satisfying. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Teresa Ja Khaing Nu (Ja Khaing Nu)

sample_reviews_en.text: My friends took me to this restaurant, It was a good place to get foods and drinks. The food is delicious and also the service is very nice and the staff are very kind. I would suggest you to those restaurant if you are very into foods and drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chit San

sample_reviews_en.text: We came here multiple times on our trip. It was a nice vibe change from the bustling streets. The service was incredible, and you get lots of extras (free snacks before meal, lots of sauces, etc). Definitely recommend if you’re in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tahlia Franks

sample_reviews_en.text: A gem run by a group of lovely ppl. Homey feel, Christmas spirit, extraordinarily courteous, free corkage, and delicious Bbq and snacks! They may not serve the best food in BKK, but their personality impressed me to return for more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Yeung

restaurants.name: King Indian Restaurant
restaurants.address:

109/22 M 10, Pratamnak Road, Near, Walking St, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: First of all, the reason why I am writing this review is because of the owner Mr. Eswar , the hotel owner , I have stayed at Heeton Concept Hotel  for 4 days and every day I went to this King Indain Restaurant for indian style  food , I felt like no difference in food with our local indian food , and the staff working there also treated me with  very very respect and I really satisfied with their service and food , I suggest every one who search for indian food , will visit once there .
sample_reviews_en.author: The Lion

sample_reviews_en.text: Singh is from Ajmer Rajasthan. Talks in Marwari, so if you from Kolkata or any other part of India, looking for homestyle food. Please do come. We came by for Indian Tea it was on the dot. Poha, chola bhattura and aloo parantha was 10 on 10. Fairly new restaurant but Singh is here for 15 years. Knows his food and very warm hospitality.
sample_reviews_en.author: S S

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the chicken marsala.  It was spicy good.  Not unbearable, just a slow burn that intensifies the more you eat.  I paired it with garlic naan and biryani rice.  I just didn't want to stop eating it.  I had to because nothing was left.  The staff is excellent.  AC.
sample_reviews_en.author: James Schulze

sample_reviews_en.text: Mukesh ji in front of house provides top class service and extremely knowledgeable about the food menu, and very flexible and accommodating. Top class. The chefs so far have served some of the best food I’ve ever had, not just in Thailand but internationally. 6 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Utsav Dua

sample_reviews_en.text: We have stayed almost a week in Pattaya. We have tried most of Indian restros in pattaya but the food quality and taste of this restaurant is osm. Even in india, its difficult to find such a taste. We have eaten this punjabi thali twice a day...
sample_reviews_en.author: DEVESH KUMAR

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was great. It was a bit hard to navigate the menu as we didn't know what the dishes are like. It would be good to list the ingredients of the dishes.

The price was okay just the rice is a bit expensive with 80 thb per  bowl.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Haas

sample_reviews_en.text: If I could give 0 stars I would. Ate here and the food had old food in the main tray. Walk across the restaurant and try the restaurants near the Thai massage shops. Much better quality and service. The worse village food ever.
sample_reviews_en.author: Truffles Travels

sample_reviews_en.text: Indian King Restaurant  The food is very delicious, tastes good.  I live in Pattaya but  I like to eat here regularly.  and received good service, spoke sweetly, would like to recommend King India Restaurant
sample_reviews_en.author: Nngm

restaurants.name: Indian Curry Hut - Bangladeshi Restaurant
restaurants.address:

11, 2 Thanon Second, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Curry

I ordered
Butter Naan, Chicken Tikka, and Butter Chicken.

I ordered a beer, but it took a while to arrive.
Thinking they'd forgotten, I ordered water,
but all I got was a Coke.

I guess it can't be helped, given the pronunciation barrier.

The butter chicken wasn't piping hot, but rather lukewarm, which was very disappointing.

The butter naan was also cold.

The chicken tikka was piping hot,
but unfortunately they didn't offer the green sauce.

It was disappointing, considering the high reviews and high expectations.

It took about 20 minutes for the food to be served.
I was the only customer there, but it might have taken a little longer with other customers.

They brought my beer just as I was finishing my meal, but...
It was disappointing.

All this for 690 baht.

Well, I guess that's about right.
sample_reviews_en.author: 世界のともちゃん

sample_reviews_en.text: Four of us decided to eat here for a family birthday last night. We had been before and really enjoyed the food so we recommended to our family to eat here again. Unfortunately the food wasn't up to the standard of our previous visits and it was barely warm when it was served. The Indian tea looked more like gloopy hot chocolate and didn't taste like tea. There was a discrepancy with slight overcharging on the bill too. Very disappointing and we probably won't be back next time we are in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Morrison

sample_reviews_en.text: We were three of us, had the pleasure of visiting a charming Bengali restaurant in Pattaya recommended by our local friend. It’s a lovely, cozy place that serves authentic homemade Bengali cuisine.
