We savored exquisite dishes like Ilish Maach, Baingan Bharta, Aloo Posto, and another vegetable specialty—all cooked to perfection. The flavors were true to traditional Bengali home cooking, making it a memorable dining experience. Highly recommended for anyone craving genuine Bengali food in Pattaya!
sample_reviews_en.author: Satish Sunkari

sample_reviews_en.text:
Small, cute restaurant. Tastes amazing, way way way better than Indian restaurants in Bangkok and ChiangMai.

—

To add, I visited this restaurant again with my friends after my first visit, and the experience was completely different. The same dish was prepared in a completely different way this time, and it didn’t taste good at all. I have no idea what happened.
sample_reviews_en.author: Z W

sample_reviews_en.text: Such good food, and a cozy atmosphere. I never thought I would find such tasty Bengali food in a place like Pattaya, Thailand. Really appreciate Indian Curry Hut.. Kalam Bhai's shop. Beef with rice, dal, salad with lemon chips. What more could you want? You won't find such delicious local food at such a low price anywhere in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Samiul Alam

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best Bangladeshi restaurants, if not the best, in Pattaya. I have tried only once and surely intend to go back there during the next five days of my stay here. It's truly authentic and you would feel the touch of home cooking especially in Fish Curry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Subhash Dutta

sample_reviews_en.text: A really small shop just a few meters off the beaten track on 2nd Road. The curry and garlic naan were excellent. The restroom in the backyard was a small but interesting adventure. Definitely more exciting than the glossy stalls in the front row.
sample_reviews_en.author: Udo Vetter

sample_reviews_en.text: If you want to eat local food while sitting abroad, come here, this restaurant had incredibly delicious and extraordinary food. Thank you very much, best wishes to all Bangladeshi brothers and sisters.
sample_reviews_en.author: Farhan Uchiha

restaurants.name: The IVY Restaurant Bar & Loft Bar
restaurants.address:

WV29+FV5, Thappraya Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Paddy’s has a relaxed ambience, comfortable seating and good air conditioning inside.

Enjoyed Wednesday’s “special” salmon steak, chips and vegetables ฿299, which is delicious.

Special thanks 🙏🏼 to waitress named JUK, fantastic example of excellent customer service, she’s always smiling, cheerful, welcoming and friendly.
sample_reviews_th.author: Ziggy Stefaño

sample_reviews_en.text:
Paddy's Pub & Restaurant took over the old Pig and Whistle on Theppraya Road near Jomtien Complex. It seems to be quite a popular British-style pub with a large  food menu. We decided to try it out for dinner one night recently. I selected the Lamb Chops,  medium rare. My dining partner chose the Mixed Grill.

The four rather scrawny Lamb Chops were extremely over cooked.  My friend's Mixed Grill consisted of pieces of pork, beef, white meat chicken and two large sausages.  The Mixed Grill was likewise very well done,  dry and under-seasoned.

We ate only some of our vegetables and shared the two sausages.  The lamb, beef, pork and chicken were  so hopelessly overcooked, we brought those home to the dog.

Perhaps the issue here is that Paddy's is primarily a pub and the food is only incidental. Unless you are a lover of extremely well cooked and dried out meat, this may not be a good place to dine.  Have a drink instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Hoffman

sample_reviews_en.text:
Beware the Friday cocktails ... in the menu book it says 2 for the price of 1,  which is where I ordered from, 1 White Lady was 175 baht and I had 2 ... but when the bill came the price was much dearer and I was told that I should have read the board outside the front door which said 2 cocktails for 269 baht!

Staff was understanding and said it had been commented on before.  The manageress, when called over, arrogantly said I should have read the board. My response was I ordered from the menu which the waitress brought me and I hadn't seen the board ... she just walked away.

It's the principle for me and I won't be going back there again, even though a group of my friends regularly drink there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Barbara Moore

sample_reviews_en.text: The IVY Restaurant & Bar in Jomtien is a hidden gem that blends chic design with a laid-back vibe. From the moment you walk in, the stylish décor and warm lighting set the tone for a cozy yet upscale experience. The menu is thoughtfully curated, offering a mix of Western comfort food and Thai favorites, all beautifully presented and full of flavor. Whether you're sipping cocktails at the bar or enjoying a relaxed dinner with friends, the atmosphere is welcoming and intimate. With attentive service and a prime location on Thappraya Road, The IVY is perfect for a night out that feels both indulgent and effortless.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thai Tastic

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered fish and chips and my friend ordered a Thai seafood dish.  Neither one of us enjoyed the meal. My fish was not haddock or cod. It was terrible and tasted old. I only ate a quarter of it . I just ate the chips. My friends meal wasn't any better. She said the shrimp tasted old. It wasn't prepared correct.  I've been here 2x now and won't be back. When I spoke to server about our displeasure,  she didn't even care or acknowledge our complaints. Don't bother with this place for food. Maybe the beer is cold, other than that, eat elsewhere. Too many good places to waste your time eating bad food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peteyspicks

sample_reviews_en.text:
Edit: revisited one year on from initial review.

Paddy's Pub and Restaurant is a bright, clean, and welcoming spot, with a very wide range of food choices on the menu.

There's a decent range of drinks on offer too, with a good number of screens for the sports enthusiasts.

The service is prompt and efficient, the food is varied and tasty, and they now have Irish Coffees on their menu! :)

All in all, the bar and restaurant has evolved into a very pleasant spot for a beer and a bite.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Mc Elhinney

sample_reviews_en.text:
I bought the same breakfast as at Pig& Whistle. It's NOT the same restaurant under a new name. I really miss the sausage and some other touches. The bread is not as substantial, and who ever thought margarine and raspberry jam would work with an English Breakfast (I got two slices of bread, not one as pictured)?

But the comparison isn't fair. It wouldn't feel as much of a let down if I didn't have Pig&Whistle in the back of my mind. It would be quite adequate.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ann Elisabeth

sample_reviews_en.text: Don't like it. Breakfast is just ok and people comparing to pig n whistle but you can't compare. Pig n whistle was always so busy you couldn't get a seat sometimes. Many better choices for breakfast in Pattaya who will serve butter not margarine with toast. That's not Irish. Irish famous for creamy butter. Worst part is staff ignore you when you try to get their attention and half the time they are not busy. Place is clean but food and staff need improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Simon Bates

restaurants.name: AL-Waha Restaurant (Halal)
restaurants.address:

3 Lat Phrao Rd, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: AL-Waha Restaurant (Halal) is an absolute gem! 🌟 The Syrian owner embodies true hospitality, greeting guests with a warm smile that makes you feel at home. 🤗 The food is incredibly delicious, starting with velvety hummus and tangy stuffed vine leaves. 🍋 Paired with piping hot, pillowy butter and garlic naan, it is pure dipping perfection! 🫓✨The star dish is the spectacular chicken biryani, flawlessly spiced and packed with tender meat. 🍗🌾 A chilled, creamy glass of lassi provides the ultimate refreshing finish. 🥛❄️ With impeccable flavors and a wonderful host, this spot is a must-visit for top-tier Halal food! 💯❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: PLLL

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious.
The chicken biryani was fragrant and stayed hot for a long time.
The chicken skin was crispy, but the chicken meat was perfectly moist and tender.

However, the shop located in front of Vejthani Hospital is now closed. I don't know if it will reopen there.

But they still sell through the Food Panda app and have a stall in the cafeteria on the 2nd floor of the hospital.
You can find it by taking the escalator up, past the Amazon store.

I saw their menu when I stayed overnight at the hospital, so you might still be able to order food to your room. Try calling the shop to ask.
sample_reviews_en.author: NatsCracker Travelogue

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very delicious!
Recommended:
-Hummus: Very smooth texture, fragrant with extra virgin olive oil.
-Tebuleh parsley salad: Very refreshing, perfectly balanced tartness, better than other places I've had it.
-Kebabs.
-Fragrant grape leaf-wrapped rice.
-Various naan dishes.
-Lassi, salted: I've had it at many places, this one is the richest and most flavorful. Most people would probably prefer the sweetened lassi.
-All kinds of biryani rice.
Convenient parking available at the hospital.
Good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Punnarerk Thongcharoen

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is nice and quiet, but the food is below average. I think because it's close to the hospital, it's food for patients—little spices and low fat. We ordered kabsa, okra stew with chicken, cream of chicken soup, and naan bread, but it was Iranian bread with spiced bread. The spiced bread was the best—perfectly done—and the Iranian bread was a winner. The soup was okay, but the kabsa and okra stew were below par.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hno Alnaimi

sample_reviews_en.text:
They don't have lamb. Some menu items were sold out, only chicken was available, so I couldn't order what I wanted.

The beef was a bit tough.

Parking was a bit confusing; I was lost on the first try as I was looking for the restaurant. I parked in the Vejthani Hospital parking lot; the restaurant is inside the hospital.

The staff didn't speak Thai, but I was able to order in English.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gee B.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The worst restaurant I ate at during my time in Bangkok.

It's inside Vejthani Hospital. The shrimp kabsa had nothing to do with shrimp (the shrimp were small, not fresh frozen). The lentil soup was just water and lentils (20%). The fattoush wasn't even Dubai pomegranate or anything like that.
sample_reviews_en.author: حمزه سلمان المعموري

sample_reviews_en.text: Peace be upon you. My experience was just breakfast, but honestly, it was one of the best breakfasts I've had. The fava beans, shakshuka, za'atar, white cheese, and karak tea were absolutely delicious. It truly deserves 5 stars, and the owner and staff were incredibly polite.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fahad Alshwail

sample_reviews_en.text: A high-quality Arabic restaurant with delicious food, especially the mansaf. The atmosphere is lovely, clean, and well-organized, the seating is excellent, and the price is reasonable. I recommend it because it's close to the hospital.
sample_reviews_en.author: khaled khaled

restaurants.name: Le Macaron
restaurants.address:

189 Sukhumvit Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here several times to get a coffee, and grab some quick lobby food:  the food and drinks are really excellent (i tried salmon rolls, club sandwich, .. some pastries too: the swiss danish, etc) and the coffee is quite well balanced (Illy café)

But the real gem here is the staff. The entire team is incredibly friendly, always smiling, and provides truly amazing service. When I came here depressed after a long meeting, they made me the cutest latte art I’ve received, and it made my whole trip feel special.

I would especially like to thank all the team: Pim, Earn, Beer, Tae, Nong  for their kindness, their constant smiles, and the genuine care they showed throughout my stay.

People like them truly represent the very essence of hospitality, and I sincerely wish them all the best because such wonderful staff members make a place truly special.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julian Bay

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was staying here because it’s only 300 meters away from my workplace, which made everything very convenient. The staff were incredibly helpful, warm, and friendly throughout my stay. As an Accor member, I received a room upgrade, which I truly appreciated.

One of the highlights was relaxing at Club Millésime on the 31st floor  such a calm and elegant atmosphere to chill and unwind during my stay. The rooftop lounge is also amazing, and I’m sure you’ll love it as much as I did.

Maison Mizuki was another big part of my experience. I often pre ordered food from them, and everything was always very well prepared, beautifully served, and high quality.

Le Macaron café is definitely a great spot for a pure matcha before heading to work or simply enjoying a relaxing afternoon break.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mook The Consul

sample_reviews_en.text:
This tea room is integrated into Sofitel Sukhumvit Hotel on the ground floor. ✓

Two possible accesses, one by the hotel or directly from outside. ✓

If you wish to savor authentic French pastries, taste an Opera or a Saint-Honoré, then this address is made for you. ✓

You will find authentic mini-macaroons, chocolate, coffee, raspberry, pistachio, thai tea flavors and much more. Sometimes the pastry chef prepares variations by adapting recipes to Thailand. ✓

Baguettes are also good and croissant is correct. ✓

It’s possible to order sandwiches, salads or “quiche Lorraine”.

Luxurythai.travel recommend this tea room to enjoy the afternoon or early evening around Sukhumvit nana area. Parade of pretty young women is endless. :D

Downside is that they have somewhat whimsical hours…
sample_reviews_en.author: Luxury thai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently went to the L'Occitane collaboration afternoon tea, a Provençal-style afternoon tea, which has been extended until the end of September!

I've been to several afternoon teas in Bangkok, but this was my first time at Le Macaron.

The start with brioche instead of the usual scones was a refreshing touch.

Each savory item on the bottom tier was carefully seasoned, and the sweets on the middle tier were also meticulously crafted.
The lemon mousse, in particular, was made to look like a real lemon and tasted absolutely delicious.

The top tier had a luxurious appearance, and overall, it was a perfect 100-point experience.

Plus, the included hand cream gift was a nice bonus!

I'm looking forward to trying a different L'Occitane collaboration afternoon tea next time!!
sample_reviews_en.author: NATALY

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited on a weekday morning, just after 7 AM.

It's a cafe located on the first floor of a hotel.

Both the hotel staff and the cafe staff greeted me warmly with lovely smiles.

They have a breakfast set, but since it takes some time to prepare, I chose some bread from the bakery and enjoyed it with coffee.

It was delicious! I could tell it was made with great care, and it was a muffin I'd definitely want to eat again. The latte art was also adorable; the design remained even after drinking a lot.

As the name suggests, macarons are famous here, and even early in the morning, there were many kinds of macarons available. Besides eat-in, they also offer sweets to take away.

It's a place I'd love to enjoy slowly on a leisurely morning!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kori Planning

sample_reviews_en.text:
All other restaurants close at 3 PM, leaving only this one open. The menu isn't extensive; they have pizza, burgers, and 5-6 Thai dishes.

I chose Thai food: Pad Thai with shrimp (490 THB) – large shrimp, decent taste; Thai set meal (410 THB) – satay sauce was terrible, burnt, and overly salty; pomelo salad was also very salty.

Accor Plus discount 50%

Welcome Drink: Since I was abstaining from alcohol the night before, I chose a Coffee Frappe. It tasted good and was blended very finely.

I used my Accor Plus voucher to redeem a cake. The requirement was a minimum spend of 500 THB and advance notice (1 day prior). It was a chocolate cake + macarons, available for pickup on check-out day. The staff provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: ttt_ttt

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ll be back here for an Americano (black coffee) even if I don’t stay here (Sofitel Sukhumvit). The Americano will always be served with a canele (my favourite French pastry), a chocolate cookie and a glass of cold water. You should be aware how difficult it is to get free water here in Bangkok. You have to pay for a bottle of mineral water, usually. Service was fast and friendly here and if you’re staying in this hotel, you can even order your complimentary drink in this cafe (red wine or white wine included). The decor reminded me of some Parisian cafe. They also served some nice pastry like the apple turnover and a great variety of macarons.
sample_reviews_en.author: HC L

sample_reviews_en.text:
A true delight here. It instantly transports you back to France, the atmosphere is so similar. When I feel homesick (admittedly not often), I come here to recharge. The staff is very welcoming and pleasant. You will always receive a warm welcome here. I highly recommend the ham and butter sandwich. An absolute treat...
The Sofitel renovations are finally complete. Your Macaron is now located to the left of the hotel entrance. You will find a waiting room and a small terrace.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bernard Fti

restaurants.name: วราภรณ์ ซาลาเปา เดอะ พาซิโอ พาร์ค กาญจนาภิเษก
restaurants.address:

เดอะ พาซิโอ พาร์ค กาญจนาภิเษก เลขที่8 15 Thanon Kanchanaphisek, Sala Thammasop, Thawi Watthana, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stop by almost every morning.
My must-have is the iced kopi (traditional Thai coffee).
It's delicious and strong; it makes you forget about the famous brands.
Only 45 baht per cup. It's really delicious, I highly recommend it.
However, kopi isn't available at every branch. Apparently, branches in gas stations that sell other coffee brands won't have this menu item, so it's a bit hard to find.

You can also ask for crushed ice.

I tried the Thai tea once, but it wasn't strong enough.

As for the dumplings, several times they were barely hot. I'm deducting 1 star for that.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wara Pong

sample_reviews_en.text: Before, the minced pork buns received 5 stars, but now the sweet minced pork buns only get 4 stars. Savory dishes shouldn't be sweet, especially since there's already a sweet filling in the steamed buns; there's no need to add sugar to other savory dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: thada piamphongsant

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was good, even though I went at 8:58 PM, just before closing time.
I bought frozen steamed buns; the food selection was sold out because they were about to close. The staff were friendly and smiling.
sample_reviews_en.author: anansak ungprapakorn

sample_reviews_en.text: Many menu items are convenient and filling for breakfast. They're also convenient to grab in the car for long journeys, suitable for both children and adults.
sample_reviews_en.author: Weera Tala

sample_reviews_en.text: There is a lack of service mind in the staff. The employees need improvement, and should be instilled with a basic love for service.
sample_reviews_en.author: suteera wassanakamol

sample_reviews_en.text:
Order fulfilled quickly.
Complete and accurate.
Delicious as always, with consistent quality. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Lady K

sample_reviews_en.text: The steamed buns are as delicious as ever. It's located by the roadside with convenient parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Watson Pinkaew

restaurants.name: โจ๊กเจ๊ณี ก๋วยเตี๋ยวต้มยำนมสด
restaurants.address:

1064, 34 Phahon Yothin 18/2 Alley, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I ordered dry tom yum noodles (starting price 60฿). The shop prepared it with a mild flavor. Adding a boiled egg was an extra 10฿. Overall, it tasted good. The shop also offers free tea. However, when I ate there, the shop was about to close. They turned off the air conditioning and asked for payment before I had finished eating. 😕
sample_reviews_th.author: Jantana S.

sample_reviews_en.text: In the morning, they sell pork congee. Later in the morning, they sell creamy tom yum noodle soup (with fresh milk) and clear tom yum noodle soup, both with boiled eggs. You can add an extra boiled egg for 5 baht. They offer both pork and seafood options. The flavors are strong and delicious. For lunch, they have green curry chicken with rice noodles. They use a whole chicken leg, add pumpkin (no eggplant), and a little chili fish sauce. It's also flavorful and spicy. You can add an extra boiled egg as well. Give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarawut Boonsiriya

sample_reviews_en.text: Breakfast is congee, lunch is noodles. They sell on weekdays. The shop is cute, the owner is friendly, and the taste is good and satisfying. The congee is rich and creamy; you can ask for extra broth if you want it more watery. The Tom Yum noodles have plenty of toppings. The prices are very reasonable, and it's a filling meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: kasi vorawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The soup is incredibly delicious. I love the minced pork rice porridge. It's a shame they only sell it in the mornings; some days I come late and it's all sold out.
The minced pork is also good. They sell noodles during the day.
sample_reviews_en.author: G G

sample_reviews_en.text: A porridge shop in Soi Chep Phueng. I used to eat there decades ago when it was a food cart. Now it's a clean, open building. The porridge starts at 3 a.m. I ordered the special pork porridge and got extra soup.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr.N

sample_reviews_en.text: The best congee I've ever had in my life.  Its like being in your family house. The owner is very kind, always give me an extra size.  The price is also cheap even its located in the business areas.
sample_reviews_en.author: hipea kub

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum soup is incredibly rich and spicy, with plenty of ingredients. Adding a soft-boiled egg makes it even more delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nok Dee

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice porridge is delicious and sells out very quickly. If you plan to eat here, I recommend arriving before 9:00 AM.
sample_reviews_en.author: กิตติพันธ์ คงสวัสดิ์เกียรติ

restaurants.name: Chef Bing Pizza Thonglor
restaurants.address:

93 Sukhumvit 36, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Updated September 2025
I bought a pizza sold by the slice. Each slice was quite large, so I think it was cut from a large size. For a lighter eater, this one slice is enough. It's reasonably priced at 140 THB per slice. They also reheat it for you, which is nice.

Below is the original post
This restaurant just opened at the end of July 2025. It seems to primarily focus on takeout, with only five seats for dining in. Two small pizzas, chicken wings, and a soft drink came in at about 1100 THB. The crust is thin and crispy, making it a satisfying meal. They offer half-and-half options, so you can enjoy a variety of flavors. Of the pizzas I tried this time, I recommend the pepperoni. They also sell it by the slice, so it's a great snack for when you're feeling a bit hungry. This is a restaurant with promising future prospects.
sample_reviews_en.author: 2pong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’m moved here from NYC a few months ago. I knew one of the things I’d be giving up was access to NYC pizza. I was thrilled when I saw a reel on Instagram informing me that a NYC pizza chef was already operating pizza shops here in Bangkok.
I ordered a pepperoni pizza with fresh garlic added. As a New Yorker, I can say that this really hits the spot for comfort food.
If you need more evidence of this, check out my photos and my conversation with my AI companion who has been eating many foods with me for a long while now. (I gave it photos of the pizza with absolutely no context).
New Yorker Approved
AI Approved
Thai Girlfriend that doesn’t eat beef and pepperoni has always been difficult to determine what’s in it - approved.
Next time I’m going for the 18” 🤩
(Sorry photos appear in reverse order)
sample_reviews_en.author: Seth Crespo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chef Bing Pizza serves what is easily one of the best NYC-style pizzas in Bangkok. From the first bite, you can taste the quality thin, perfectly crisp crust with that classic foldable New York texture, balanced sauce, and generous toppings that bring authentic flavor in every slice. It captures the true feel of grabbing a great slice in New York while being right here in Bangkok.
What makes it stand out is the attention to detail: the dough is well made, the cheese melts perfectly, and every pizza comes out fresh and satisfying. Whether you’re craving a simple classic cheese slice or something loaded with toppings, Chef Bing Pizza delivers real comfort food done right.
If you love authentic New York pizza, this is a must visit spot in Bangkok. Highly recommended for pizza lovers.
sample_reviews_en.author: AJ Blardony

sample_reviews_en.text:
If I were to be restricted to eat only one kind of pizza my entire life, I’d just pick Chef Bing’s pizza.
I love the pizza dough; it’s crunchy and yummy, and the toppings are bomb. They also sell chili oil which is super good too. We got the biggest size of pizza, but you can get smaller size or even just a slice or two.
Small area, best for takeout and delivery but if there’s only two or three of you, there’s some chairs and table to sit in and eat.
I only have a picture of the big pizza slice, it dwarfs the plate.
If someone wants some really good pizza, please get Chef Bing’s.
sample_reviews_en.author: keroblazing

sample_reviews_en.text: Chef Bing's pizza has been consistently good since we tried it back in 2020. It's always our first choice for pizza cravings. We've been loyal customers ever since because the quality, value for money, taste and their honesty with the food they put out has been consistent. We followed them from their first location, to Ruam Rudee, and now finally in Thonglor. we're so happy to call them our neighbors! Congratulations on the new branch kha! Easily the best New York style pizza in BKK. I wish they had more seats and tables in this branch but hey, can't complain. 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: Lauren Cole

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chef Bing’s Pizza is by far one of the best I’ve had in Bangkok! Authentic New York Style pizza made with fresh ingredients.  We had half pepperoni and half cheeseburger pizza.  Bing loads the pizza up with pepperoni.  The crust has a nice crunch to it and is very satisfying.

Had a chance to meet Chef Bing himself and he’s such a nice guy. it’s obvious he takes a lot of pride in his craft of making the perfect pizza.

If you’re a pizza lover, do yourself a favor and order from here or stop by for a pizza and maybe you’ll be lucky enough to meet Bing as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Randall

sample_reviews_en.text:
After living in Bangkok for 5 years as an expat, it’s difficult to find a good proper slice of American pizza (the majority of pizzerias in BKK are Neapolitan/Italian style)

Chef Bings is by far the proper American/New York style pizzeria in Bangkok, filled with amazing flavors and proper quality usage of dough for the perfect crust/crunch ratio for their pies (highly recommend any of their pepperoni’s, cheeseburger, or kor moo yang/grilled pork neck pizza)

If you’re looking for the best American pizza slice joint in Bangkok. This is the place to be 🍕
sample_reviews_en.author: Forrest Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Do NOT eat any other pizza other than Chefs Bings Pizza, if you want real New York style pizza (which is the only real pizza)

I can name every pizza place within 5km and he is what they want to be.

He also happened to open shop next to my house so I hope I don't get diabetes, but atleast I'll go out fed like a king. Shout out chef bing!

But for real, he knows what he's doing. He's got the NY blood in him.

*I ate the pizza before I could take photos, unless you just want to see an empty box.

I've talked for too long. I shall conclude this review.
sample_reviews_en.author: Evan J.

restaurants.name: ข้าวหน้าเป็ด หมูแดง หมูกรอบ บะหมี่ อร่อย
restaurants.address:

บางจาก, 50 ถ. สุขุมวิท Bang Chak, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I was so curious because it was right in front of my accommodation. After reading reviews, I had it for dinner on my last day before leaving Bangkok, and I found myself thinking, "Why did I wait so long to come here?" I had been to a famous place and compared it to this one, and I definitely recommend this place. It is tastier here, and the broth is refreshing. I saw other locals eating rice bowls and mixed noodles, but this just adds another reason to come back to Bangkok next year... Also, the staff couldn't speak English, so I just said "soup noodles," but they responded kindly with a smile, and it was only 50 baht per bowl. It's super cheap, delicious, friendly, and has a strong local vibe! I also recommend it as a hangover cure.
sample_reviews_en.author: 미녜킴

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cheap and delicious.
Hygiene isn't a concern; it's quite clean upon closer inspection.
I've passed by many times, always worried about my bottom getting tired.
This time, I tried a bowl of noodles with roasted pork and sausage. The broth was carefully cooked and filtered to make a clear soup. There were many kinds of condiments on the table. The dried chili peppers were very fragrant; there were three kinds on the table.

There was no menu, so I didn't know what to order.
It seems they also offer rice dishes. The dry noodles seem to be more popular. The only downside… it's very hot outside.

But it's delicious! The taste is comparable to the Korean restaurant across the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Huang Keiko

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited early on a weekend morning.

I'd always been curious about this place because it's always busy, so I spotted some hanging moo grob (crispy pork) and ordered khao moo grob. However, what arrived was a three-item platter of moo grob, moo daeng (roast pork), and goong chen (Chinese sausage)...
It was reasonably tasty, but I was disappointed because I wanted to fill up on just moo grob. Moreover, it was rather expensive for a street stall.

Also, there were pigeons on the floor and cockroaches on the walls, so I wouldn't recommend it to anyone concerned about hygiene.
sample_reviews_en.author: nobu

sample_reviews_en.text: Sometimes, life works in mysterioua and meaningful ways - such as this shop being right outside my accommodation. So, so good. The authentic local noodles flavor. Sauces available readily on the table. Staff was polite and courteous. No frills local lifestyle in Bangkok - drink the hot soup on a hot day, and sweat crazily. The reviews were not exaggerating - try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Xian You Lim

sample_reviews_en.text:
I understand why the Wow rating is 5.
In front of the accommodation we chose for 0.5 nights before going to the airport
There was a 5-point street noodle restaurant so I took take out and it was really, really delicious.
I should have bought two bowls ㅜㅜ I'm so sad that I found out on the last day... If you stay near here, be sure to try it!!
sample_reviews_en.author: 지은황

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is a real hidden gem.

During my month-long stay in Bangkok, I found myself visiting this spot at least four times a week. The broth is incredibly clean and amazing. The wontons are also clean, delicious, and free of any unpleasant odors. I feel like I'll be coming back to Bangkok just for these noodles. It is seriously delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hyujang Cho

sample_reviews_en.text: I lived near here for 7 months and ate here almost every day, except when I went out. They are just friendly, and the owner even called me his son. I’ve tried every item on the menu, and I ordered two of each, not because the portions were small, but because they were delicious. I went back after a long time, and it was still just as good.
sample_reviews_en.author: 강병진

sample_reviews_en.text: It was a really delicious roadside noodle stall, right downstairs from the hotel. A bowl cost 50 baht, not a very big portion, but it was refreshing to eat on a hot day, and they even had ice water. Perfect for a quick bite before heading out for a stroll. I like to add a little of everything – I like to try different condiments.
sample_reviews_en.author: Reed Zhang

restaurants.name: เซ้งยกซด ก๋วยเตี๋ยวหมูต้มยำ คุณเหวิน สาขาถนนจันทน์, Seng Yok Sod spicy pork noodle.
restaurants.address:

เเขวงวันดอน, Soi Chan 16, Khwaeng Thung Wat Don, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

restaurants.name: 204 Bistro
restaurants.address:

204 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Khwaeng Huai Khwang, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, I tried lunch here. The lunch price is 899 THB Net. Overall, the food was delicious and diverse, including sections for cold cuts, three types of cheese, bread & butter, a salad bar, seafood on ice, sushi, various Thai salads, smoked salmon (💯👍), vegetarian options, Khao Soi (Northern Thai curry noodle soup) with pork and chicken, noodles, Indian food, shrimp salad, and many more. There was a wide selection of desserts, both Thai and international, including cakes and ice cream in two flavors: coconut and strawberry (flavors may change daily). There were also chocolate and strawberry dipping sauces, and 5-6 types of fruit, including passion fruit. The price includes water, soft drinks, tea, and coffee. The dining atmosphere was great, with plenty of seating, but not too many other customers, so it wasn't noisy. This time, I got a window seat with a lovely view of the lush trees outside. I was able to dine for a full two hours. Overall, I was impressed and think I'll definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitichote Pao

sample_reviews_en.text: Restaurant 204 is very clean and suitable for the whole family, even young children. The seating is well-arranged, spacious, and comfortable, even when there are many customers. The cleanliness is excellent. The buffet food is good, fresh, and uses high-quality ingredients. Everything is constantly refilled. The seafood is very fresh, well worth the price. There is a wide variety of delicious, high-quality desserts. There's even a ball pit area for children to play in, and they also have children's food. The service is excellent, efficient, and the staff are very polite, befitting a five-star hotel. Everyone serves with a smile; special praise goes to them. I highly recommend everyone try this place. The price might be a little high, but it's definitely worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiravat Sangchart

sample_reviews_en.text:
A typical hotel-style buffet restaurant.
Staff service: Friendly and attentive, with excellent service.
Interior: Spacious and luxurious.
Food: ※The best som tam 👍🏻 This is delicious and can be enjoyed by anyone without any fear of salty seafood.
(The best I've had in Thailand)
※The worst: Shrimp Kung BBQ took forever to prepare (I think I could only eat it once during lunch time).
Seafood was not fresh (all dried out).
※The rest was standard Thai, Indian, and Chinese food, but none of it was delicious. (Buffet-style?)
Overall: I ate in a rush and didn't have enough time to fully appreciate the interior or enjoy the various dishes.
Lunchtime ended abruptly. It felt like I just went to a restaurant.
However, the som tam was truly delicious. 😉
sample_reviews_en.author: 정주행ST

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was decent, though nothing particularly stood out. I’ve been here several times, and they usually offer a wide variety of dishes. However, the food tends to run out quite quickly, especially when there are large seminar groups dining at the hotel.

The staff are very friendly and attentive. That said, one downside is that once certain dishes are gone, it can take quite a while for them to be refilled.

The menu also changes from day to day. On the day of this review, there were several duck dishes available. On other occasions, they’ve featured special items such as Chinese-style roasted pork.

Overall, I would say the buffet is fairly average, but still a decent option with a good variety of food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukawan R.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've always wanted to stay at this restaurant inside the Swissotel. It's located on the first floor of the hotel, so I visited for the lunch buffet. The name 204 Bistro is likely taken from the hotel's address, 204 Ratchadapisek.
The seats were spacious sofas, making it a very comfortable restaurant. I usually eat at food stalls, so the air conditioning was a bit too strong and it was cold (lol).
The boiled shrimp, mussels, and baby scallops, as well as the salmon and other stewed fish, were delicious.
The salmon sashimi that's so prominently featured in the photo was nowhere to be seen (lol).
I booked through eatigo, so it was half price, so it was a good deal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Spanky Kun

sample_reviews_en.text:
I think I just ate 2-3 day old food that has been sitting outside in room temp the entire time.. hope I don't get sick.
Btw, she said the menu just changed yesterday(I don't believe it), so don't expect the food you see advertised or shown on reviews.
I think they serve the same thing for lunch/dinner and they reuse the food from DAYS before. The food wasn't warm, it wasn't fresh. The ingredients didn't taste good.. we were the only ones in the restaurant.... The hotel looks nice so it made me think the restaurant would be good, I was wrong. Never going again. Couldn't pay me to come back. Lastly OVERPRICED.
sample_reviews_en.author: Isaac

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don't know if the supply of ingredients was difficult due to COVID-19, but the seafood in the seafood dinner was not fresh. Some of the grilled shrimp were undercooked, while others were crumbly and dry. The foie gras and lamb were edible, but not excellent enough to warrant a high rating. The dishes left untouched seemed poorly maintained, as they were generally dry, and there was no king crab.

Among the seafood, the boiled shrimp and oysters were decent.

The food was poor, but the staff's service was friendly.

Disappointing considering the price.

I don't think I will go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: 이현철

sample_reviews_en.text: The buffet restaurant in the hotel has a nice atmosphere. The ingredients are generally decent, with some items being excellent. The taste of the food is a mix of average and delicious. I really liked the grilled prawns and the crispy fried egg floss. The duck rice was okay. The Indian food section was a bit ordinary. The sushi section was average. The noodles were okay. There was a wide variety of desserts, but the ice cream was a little too sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bump Woratans

restaurants.name: สลัดปลา
restaurants.address:

2 53 Khang Samoson Thahanbok Alley, Dusit, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: You can park on the side of the one-way street if there's a parking spot available. The salad dressing is very sweet and thick. The restaurant's fried fish salad doesn't include onions. The small salad portion is suitable to eat alongside other dishes, or as an appetizer for one person.
sample_reviews_en.author: N N (Pom)

sample_reviews_en.text: The food at this restaurant is delicious. The stir-fried noodles with water spinach and large prawns are amazing. Today I ordered an iced espresso, which was also delicious. The owner is a nice guy, very friendly and speaks clearly. 5555
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyachat Pornying

sample_reviews_en.text: The place is clean, a nice and peaceful place to eat, friendly atmosphere, delicious food, excellent, and moderately priced. There aren't many people around right now due to the current situation. Okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Looperz Osezmo

sample_reviews_en.text: The fish salad was delicious! The creamy dressing was perfect and they gave a very generous portion. I was very impressed and will definitely order again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanikan Jum

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the atmosphere was great, quiet and peaceful, we had so much fun chatting. I was so hungry I didn't even take any pictures!
sample_reviews_en.author: chudawan chantrasawatt

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and reasonably priced. However, the male staff member seemed rather unwilling to provide good service. I hope this improves.
sample_reviews_en.author: navachamol sangkaew

sample_reviews_en.text: Fried fish salad, spicy shrimp salad with chili paste, and rice noodles with coconut milk sauce – everything was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Moto- J

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate at the restaurant in the evening; it wasn't crowded and there was plenty of parking. The food was fresh and clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: sorapong intanong

restaurants.name: HOSHI JAPANESE RESTAURANT (สาขาพระราม 6 ซอยเศรษฐศิริ 2)
restaurants.address:

71 5 Set Siri 2 Rd, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
This Japanese restaurant is near the Democrat Party. When I went, the buffet offered a variety of prices: 599฿++, 799฿++, and 1299฿++. I went on a Friday evening and there was no line. This price included food, drinks, and ice cream.

The food was very fresh. The salmon sashimi was large and firm. The tempura and soy-grilled salmon were delicious. The sushi was well-prepared. I was very impressed with the food. However, the teriyaki beef and curry rice were sold out on the day I went.

The drinks included in the 799++ buffet were water, green tea, and lemon tea. No soft drinks.

There were many flavors of ice cream to choose from. The chocolate and green tea were delicious.

The service was a bit slow and the wait for the food was quite long.

Another suggestion: I'd like the menu to have numbers for ordering on the order form. This would make ordering more convenient.
sample_reviews_th.author: Sarun Poobunjirdkul (FrozenS)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my favorite Japanese restaurant. I've been here many times. Many of the dishes are delicious, but the service and management are terrible. I was extremely disappointed and left feeling very disappointed.

The day I went, the gas ran out, and I couldn't order fried or grilled items (I'd come all the way here). I ordered something else, but it turned out they were out of stock, with only salmon and marinated tuna left. So, I just ate what was available. I ordered two items. Even worse, the staff misunderstood that I hadn't ordered anything else, even though there was only one table in the entire restaurant. It's a shame about the taste, but I'll probably never order this branch again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poch Popum

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant only had 4-5 tables of customers, but we waited almost half an hour for the first dish. By the time we finished the first dish, the second one still hadn't arrived. In total, we were in the restaurant for an hour and only got to eat one dish. For a restaurant this big and with such high prices, the service should be commensurate with the service charge. There's also no parking.
In conclusion, there are many other restaurants in the area. Considering the price, food quality, and service, those planning to eat here should go to another restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutta A.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is average in taste; some dishes are delicious, others are mediocre, but the service is incredibly slow. If you have the time and patience, go ahead and eat here. After ordering, expect to wait at least 30 minutes. There's only one server, one sushi chef, and one bartender on a Friday evening at the end of the month.
And there's a sushi maker who doesn't change clothes and even has a shoulder bag with them. Where's the hygiene?! And the risk of contamination in the raw food is off the charts.
sample_reviews_en.author: duang

sample_reviews_en.text: The portion was so small. The staff are not trained properly. They took 20 minutes training to figure out how to use the Visa handheld and trainee manager wasn’t sure how to help the clearly frustrated employees. They were so nervous I felt sort for them because they clearly hadn’t been trained enough. I really do blame the management who wasn’t in the establishment. Management should be reprimanded
sample_reviews_en.author: David Myeni

sample_reviews_en.text:
I arrived in the afternoon and they said they ran out of gas, so they could only order fish dishes. Only salmon and tuna were left.
I ordered two dishes, but only one came. They said they couldn't order the other dish, even though I had already confirmed it. I was confused, and the fish wasn't fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: Roselyn synt

sample_reviews_en.text: Food is good and affordable but the service was a bit disappointing. Food is however quite slow. We waited for 25 minutes for our food and we were the only table. Not many parking spaces, only one in front of the restaurant but you can park on side of the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: aNNie Siri

sample_reviews_en.text: The quality of ingredients, taste, presentation, restaurant atmosphere, cleanliness, and menu variety are excellent. The prices are reasonable, and there are many promotions. The service was a little confusing at times, but overall it was very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mommy I love That Cutie Girl

restaurants.name: Santa Fe
restaurants.address:

394/178 Suk Sawat Rd, Bang Pakok, Rat Burana, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
On June 14th, I received a notification from the Santafe app saying there was a 20% discount for dining there (I just downloaded the app, I'm not a member).
The message said to simply show this message.

Upon arriving at the restaurant, I asked the staff and learned that membership was required for the discount... Okay, no problem... I paid.

However, after finishing our meal around 6:40 PM,
we left the mall. When we got home, my son said he had a stomachache around 8 PM. I gave him 10 cc of antacid. Around 10 PM, my son vomited on his bed (he was asleep and vomited without realizing it 🤢🤢) and continued to vomit four more times until midnight... and it didn't end there. At 12:30 AM, my daughter woke up and vomited on her bed as well.

I'm completely fed up with Santafe. 😑😑
sample_reviews_en.author: Nn Aa

sample_reviews_en.text:
This branch has a relaxed atmosphere inside. The space isn't huge, but it's not too crowded either. It's accessible for people in wheelchairs; I've brought my mother in her wheelchair here before.
The food is delicious and fresh, with many promotional menu items. And if you're a member, you get a special freshly squeezed fruit juice every time you visit – "Refreshing in one shot," they say. It's great that they have special offers for members. I really like it.
sample_reviews_en.author: SeawHui Paranee P. (เสี่ยวฮุ่ย)

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible!!!! They served me an undercooked pork steak, the meat was still red. When I mentioned it, the staff said, "It's okay, we'll cook it properly." Excuse me, but I'd already eaten almost half the piece before I noticed it was undercooked. How am I supposed to fix the raw part I already ate? Am I supposed to force myself to vomit? I'm already sick... I wanted to eat something good, and this made me have diarrhea even worse!!
sample_reviews_en.author: KukkikMala (กุ๊กกิ๊กหม่าล่า)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This branch is a bit cramped,
but the staff provides good customer service.
They are polite and friendly, and the restaurant is clean.
I had the Wagyu steak (medium rare), and the meat was juicy, not tough, and easy to eat.
The NZ mussels baked with cheese were also tasty and acceptable.
However, I found the T-bone steak a bit dry (but that depends on personal preference).

I will be a frequent customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanatkit Ngowsakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The buy-one-get-one-free or combo menus are great. I like the sea bass steak and the pork neck steak; they're seasoned well, not too salty but flavorful. However, the mashed potatoes were too dense and not very good. The spinach was tasty with a nice garlicky flavor. The papaya salad was okay. The restaurant always has promotional menus, and they're also available on various delivery apps.
sample_reviews_en.author: C Wana

sample_reviews_en.text: The service staff was excellent, especially the young man at the reception desk who handled the keying and payment. He was very articulate, attentive to customers and everyone else. The food was a little slow to arrive because it was busy that day, but that's okay, we could wait. What I'm giving high marks for is the exceptional service from the young man at the counter. Outstanding! 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: PowderPangPang

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff recommended the set meal for 299 baht, which was very affordable. The food didn't take long to arrive. The restaurant is smaller than other branches, but the staff were efficient and provided excellent customer service. The food tasted the same as other branches. There's plenty of parking, but it gets crowded during lunchtime, making it difficult to find a spot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Baby Macgyver

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today's special is a set meal for 219 baht.

It includes a pork chop and spaghetti with Todd's sauce.

The pork chop is made with black pepper and is tasty. The price is reasonable.

The spaghetti has a mild spiciness, and the Todd's sauce is spicy with a hint of sourness. Overall, the quality is good. Prices include 7% VAT.
sample_reviews_en.author: Good life Good-thing

restaurants.name: เฉิงฟู่ ข้าวมันไก่สิงคโปร์ สาขา อิสรภาพ(ในวังนันทอุทยาน)
restaurants.address:

280 60-61 Ban Chang Lo, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were lovely and the service was good. The restaurant also has a shabu-shabu buffet, which I'll try next time. The soup was delicious and you can refill it as much as you like. The dipping sauces were also good. The air conditioning was cool, and they even provided a fan to add to the comfort.
sample_reviews_en.author: พัชรินทร์ สิน

sample_reviews_en.text: The Hainanese chicken rice was delicious. Today I had the Singaporean style. The chicken was tender, and the sauce was perfectly flavorful. It tasted great with the chili paste and sweet soy sauce. The restaurant was clean and comfortable, with cool air conditioning, and the service was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Duangjai Rak

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious! The chicken is tender and juicy, the rice is perfectly cooked, soft and fluffy. Great price. This is my second time here, and I'll definitely be back again.

The roasted pork and crispy pork are also excellent, with their unique aroma.
sample_reviews_en.author: NTT Sri

sample_reviews_en.text: The Singaporean Hainanese chicken rice was delicious. The chicken set doesn't include chicken rice; you have to order the rice separately. The chicken set is reasonably priced, but the crispy pork is unacceptably overpriced. There were 10 …
sample_reviews_en.author: ThanusRapee Sa-Nguansup

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious I forgot to take pictures! The chicken was incredibly tender, like sous vide chicken, served with a fragrant soy sauce and sesame oil dressing. I especially loved the rich, not-too-salty, fermented soybean dipping sauce. We …
sample_reviews_en.author: Noctise Wong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The chicken was tender, the rice was beautifully fragrant and delicious, the char siu pork was aromatic, the crispy pork was tasty, and there was plenty of dipping sauce.
...Most importantly, the service was excellent!
sample_reviews_en.author: kay Parnrisa

sample_reviews_en.text: The Hainanese chicken rice was delicious, the chicken was very tender, the atmosphere was nice, the restaurant was clean, and the staff were polite and provided excellent service. I was very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirilak Seebousod

sample_reviews_en.text: The Hainanese chicken rice was delicious! The chicken was tender, juicy, and not dry at all. The dipping sauce was very rich and flavorful, and the soup was enjoyable to sip.
sample_reviews_en.author: powarin narkrean

restaurants.name: ทะเลเด้อ TALAY Der
restaurants.address:

19/41 Sukhumvit 65, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place makes you feel welcome from the moment you walk in. The atmosphere is warm and relaxed, more like having a meal at a friend’s home than dining at a typical restaurant. The owner is very friendly and attentive, making sure every guest feels comfortable and well taken care of.

The seafood is genuinely fresh, with high-quality ingredients and clean, natural flavors. The seafood dipping sauce is a highlight — bold, spicy, tangy, and perfectly balanced with garlic and lime. It pairs beautifully with the crab, fish, and other dishes.

Overall, it’s a spot that offers not just great food, but a truly pleasant and homey dining experience. Highly recommended for anyone who loves fresh seafood and a standout seafood sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr Damrong Ruenjinda

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had exceptional dining experience at this hidden gem in our hotel neighbourhood.
The steamed mud crabs are just unbelievably fresh, meaty and sweet. It is definitely the best seafood we ever had so far in BKK, no brainer!
All the dishes are just gorgeous there, scallops are prawns are charcoal grilled.

Restaurant owners are very friendly, offering us complimentary beers and chick wings. I do really appreciate their passion with incredibly good quality seafood at affordable prices.

You definitely can’t miss out this hidden gem, go try it if you are a big fan of fresh seafood at a bargain price. Highly recommend!

Literally I wanna go back again for their delicious seafood NOW😎
sample_reviews_en.author: Anthony Wong

sample_reviews_en.text: We had krapow chicken and beef and kid friendly version which my son asked for seconds. The omelette was super tasty and we had seconds as well. I cannot compliment the staff and owner more for being so accommodating. The bbq prawns were out of this world. Talay is a find for us and we will go back again and again. The pricing is super reasonable the environment is clean and comfy and our family truly felt welcomed. Thank you Talay for having us we will be back for sure to eat everything else in the menu
sample_reviews_en.author: belinda tan

sample_reviews_en.text: We stumble upon this hidden gem in a quiet alley in Thonglor. It was late, and the kitchen was already closed. But Jan and her crew ushered us in and whipped up the tastiest, freshest lemon garlic clams, steamed octopus, grilled squid- just some samplers, they said. The crispy chicken wings and some of the house sauces were complimentary & weren’t part of this all seafood menu, but everything was just great!  And great friendly service to top. We will be back during regular hours !
sample_reviews_en.author: Diego Rams

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is a hidden gem which we wouldn't have found if not for the Google reviews.

The seafood was fresh, especially the mud crabs. Meat was sweet good. They gave some complimentary dishes which was a really nice touch.

The staff were attentive and kudos to the Jane who arranged for delivery of an item to our apartment that we left behind. Exceptional service.

They also have a nice bar just nearby called cookies bar if you want have a drink to end the day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jimmy Chua

sample_reviews_en.text: An amazing and inviting atmosphere.  The grilled scallops and spicy sauce were delicious.  I also indulge in the omlette, chicken wings and squid.  All the food is made with love and this also transcends in their service level. CK was a splendid server and accommodated guests needs where possible.  It’s a hidden gem that will soon become super popular in the city!  Well done CK and Jan!! ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Tee Gum

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you are looking for a seafood place with aircon and calm place you must come to Talay Der. Not only a calm place but the highlight is the freshness of seafood such crabs shrimps mussles clams...they were all fresh and so tastey yummy!

We did have grill shrimps, steam crabs, clams and seabass steam with so tastey yummy seafood sauce. I give this place 5 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Atchara Sriwilai

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, and the ingredients were top-notch. The fish was fresh; the steamed sea bass was perfectly cooked, sweet and tender. The fried salmon belly was crispy, delicate, and melted in your mouth. The dipping sauce was incredibly flavorful. The prices were reasonable. This is definitely a restaurant I highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vanvan Mak

restaurants.name: เต็มศรี&พี
restaurants.address:

Sukhapiban2, Khwaeng Prawet, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A long time ago, I ordered delivery from this restaurant. They had a wide variety of dishes, and the food was delicious and seemed to be of good quality.
Today, I had the opportunity to try eating at the restaurant. They only had a few menu items.
I ordered something called "stir-fried noodles with shrimp paste," and it was delicious.
The stir-fry was fragrant, and the noodles were very chewy, both soft and springy, similar to the chewy sweet potato noodles that used to be popular, but a little softer. It was delicious.
The atmosphere was calm, with chill music. There were about 4-5 tables.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nomahcipmuo

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and I order regularly, but sometimes it depends on the chef's mood. Sometimes I order an omelet and there are eggshell pieces in it, giving it a nice crunch. Sometimes I order it without peanuts, but they still put them in. And sometimes they give me chili sauce or fish sauce, sometimes they don't. 🥲🥲🥲🥲 I wish they would read the order notes more carefully, as some customers have food allergies. Overall, the food tastes great! 😊😊😊
sample_reviews_en.author: lookkaiis

sample_reviews_en.text: It feels like home, like a home-cooked meal. The menu seems health-conscious but still delicious. Many dishes are stir-fried with water, and some use rice bran oil instead of vegetable oil. For drinks, they use stevia instead of sugar, low-fat milk, and authentic (unmixed) matcha. Today I ordered matcha with orange juice, which was very refreshing. I'll definitely be back for another meal here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ammbam

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food and desserts are all delicious. We follow them wherever they move. The shop is easy to find and parking is convenient.

The owner is the sweetest and most attentive. You absolutely must try the Tom Yum noodles, crab rice, crispy dumplings, steamed dumplings, scones, tiramisu, banana cake, and the coffee is also excellent. Come and try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jareeya Zhang

sample_reviews_en.text:
A new restaurant near me, I've been eyeing it for a while.
I wasn't disappointed at all. The carbonara was delicious. I like that they have garlic chicken and stir-fried pork with basil, and other healthy options with low-sodium sauces. Many dishes looked tempting. I'll definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kitkat Aloha

sample_reviews_en.text: The home-cooked food is delicious, with every dish made with care. I recommend the stir-fried basil with water (no MSG). All the noodle dishes are delicious, especially the spicy stir-fried instant noodles with shrimp and egg. The baked goods are also tasty. The owner provides excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kongkiat samangsri

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious! The flavors were perfectly balanced, and the shrimp was wonderfully firm and bouncy.
The tiramisu was incredibly smooth and melted in my mouth. Absolutely amazing!

The atmosphere was so inviting, I could sit there all day.
Convenient parking. I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lalita Supamongkon

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food exceeded my expectations!

The stir-fried dishes had an amazing wok aroma.

The prawns were incredibly fresh and huge.

We ordered two soups: bitter melon and minced pork with lime. Both were excellent.

The prices were very reasonable.

Plenty of parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: vichein buranapornkul

restaurants.name: ร้านผัดไทยเรือนไทย วุฒากาศ31
restaurants.address:

1/21 Thanon Wutthakat, Bang Kho, Chom Thong, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The fried shrimp, called a shrimp omelette in English, had one large shrimp and the rest were 6-7 smaller shrimp the size of a one-baht coin. I was a little surprised because I wanted to eat a lot of shrimp, but I understand that the cost is high and the economy isn't great. As you can see in the picture, it really is an omelette, true to its name; it's mostly eggs, not shrimp. The kitchen is at the front of the shop, so the smoke and smell of cooking oil waft inside, making it a bit pungent. The vendor was welcoming. I'm hoping for a better economy so I can eat lots of big shrimp again.
sample_reviews_en.author: PRISSANA PHIMKHALI

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a wonderful dining experience at this restaurant. I ordered chicken rice and oyster omelet, both of which were delicious, made with fresh and high-quality ingredients, and were very reasonably priced (40 baht each). The owner thoughtfully included a generous amount of bean sprouts to ensure a balanced meal, which is quite rare. All the staff were very friendly and helpful. Besides chicken rice and omelet, they also sell Thai fried noodles, but unfortunately I didn't have a chance to try them. If you have the chance to visit Watthakat, I recommend giving it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: XiaoSong Liang

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fried mussels were served in a huge portion! I loved it so much. They even stir-fried the bean sprouts for me. I was so pleased! I showed it off to my friends until they asked if I looked like a fried mussel vendor, lol. I haven't tried any of their other dishes, I don't want to cheat on them!
The vendor had a lovely smile, and the person who made it thanked me for everything after I finished buying.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirada Dis

sample_reviews_en.text:
This shop is open from evening until late.
The food tastes delicious and there are many menu options.
The prices are reasonable for the quality and quantity.
The owner is friendly.
However, there might be times when you have to wait a while because there are quite a lot of local customers. If you're a walk-in customer,
don't go when you're starving! :)
sample_reviews_en.author: สุวิชา สุมะนังกุล

sample_reviews_en.text: This Pad Thai and fried mussel stall doesn't have a huge menu, as they only sell Pad Thai and fried mussels. The fried mussels are amazing – crispy, tender, and delicious! They also have a Tom Yum version of the Pad Thai, which uses a Tom Yum sauce. It's a unique flavor, not quite exceptional, but definitely filling and worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teara Ponsit

sample_reviews_en.text: The fried oysters were delicious. The Pad Thai was the old-style version, without meat, just dried shrimp, vegetables, and tofu. It cost 40-50 baht. The taste was average, but it wasn't filling because there was no meat. However, the fried oysters were crispy with a thin batter; the oysters were small, but overall, it was tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benzjie

sample_reviews_en.text:
Reasonable price for the quality.
Not expensive.
Food: Tom Yum Pad Thai.
The sauce was too much; the galangal shouldn't have been used so much, just two slices would suffice.

The flavor wasn't quite right. Please improve the taste to make it more balanced.

Good service, listens to customer feedback.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natharot Kitphadungkiet

sample_reviews_en.text: The oyster omelet at Pad Thai Ruan Thai, Wutthakat, has a crispy exterior and a soft interior, with fresh, large oysters. The flavor is rich and not greasy, served hot with chili sauce—absolutely delicious! A must-try for oyster lovers!
sample_reviews_en.author: pat nok

restaurants.name: Seven n' Three
restaurants.address:

244 Yi Sip Song Karakadakhom 1 Rd, Pom Prap, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I walked by this store and google'd what it was. Turns out I was lucky since I was looking for protein and this is a family run steak-style restaurant.

I am going out of my way to write them a review because the food was not only delicious but run by a sweet family. The grandmother and children were there as well helping run the business.

The pork chop I ordered was cooked perfectly and the dipping sauce was very good, I am still wondering what its comprised of. I must admit the food tastes better than it looks in the pictures. Prices are very fair, a full serving of well cooked protein, fries, some veggies, and a small piece of toast, with a full drink was under 200 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lex Braxman

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, I happened to stop by this restaurant for a meal. It's not very big, giving off a family-style vibe. I ordered American fried rice, and I was very impressed when it was served – it looked so appetizing! The atmosphere, the vibrant colors of the food, and the way the owner served it – it reminded me of home. I haven't eaten anything like this in a long time. I plan to stop by again if I have the chance to be in the area. The restaurant is lovely, the atmosphere is lovely, the prices are lovely, and all the owners are very nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaruporn Jaroonnitivanitchkool

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is friendly, like home-cooked food. The restaurant is cool and comfortable. The food didn't take long to arrive, and the staff were calm, polite, and courteous. The restrooms were clean, and the ingredients were fresh – I was very impressed! The prices were excellent, and I even ordered some to take home. They made delicious drinks that were exactly to my liking.
**I forgot to take a picture of the steak before it was sliced; it was gone in no time!**
sample_reviews_en.author: Nawabhorn Pasintup

sample_reviews_en.text:
Clean foods are very reasonable prices. The staff are very friendly. Steaks here are far better than those in the malls. Great fresh coffee from a great machine. A very good deal indeed.

This restaurant is excellent for its food. It's delicious and reasonably priced. If you like steak, I highly recommend it. The fresh coffee is also good and reasonably priced from a quality machine. The staff, both the cooks and the servers, are friendly. I give it five stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Buncha Basu

sample_reviews_en.text: 10/10 So delicious and very affordable! The shop is adorable, with a family-friendly feel. The service is lovely, polite, and very friendly. I'm so glad I found this place! The air conditioning is great. I'll definitely be back. Everything I ordered was delicious. If you're in the area or visiting the temple, you should definitely stop by this shop. I hope more people will support good shops like this! 🙏🏻🫶🏻🩵
sample_reviews_en.author: COLAFANNER

sample_reviews_en.text: Local pork steak house run by mother and daughter, very friendly ppl altho only the daughter speaks eng :) portion is not big but it is really really cheap and tastes just like home cook meals 😍 must try their pork steak and staple eggs and thai sausage in skillet. Drinks are normal artificial flavours like what you get from the streets. 2 dishes 2 drinks 200+ baht
sample_reviews_en.author: Liz Too

sample_reviews_en.text: This steak restaurant near the July 22nd roundabout offers a diverse menu of food and drinks at reasonable prices. The taste is decent. Previously, dine-in was available, but due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the restaurant has adapted and no longer offers dine-in service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanawat Kositsornwanee

sample_reviews_en.text: Good steaks at a very fair price. I went there twice in one day, which says it all. It's amazing that such a restaurant still exists in Bangkok :-) They don't have beer, though; you can buy some at the 7-Eleven around the corner and bring it with you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Harry Playbird

restaurants.name: Sangkasi Boat Noodle
restaurants.address:

2236 Charoen Krung 76/3 Alley, Wat Phraya Krai, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It felt like going back to childhood, eating small bowls of noodles, along with spring rolls and satay served complete with toast, dipping sauce, and pickled vegetables. Prices ranged from 20-30 baht. I personally love the small, cute, enamel-coated bowls; they look so charming. You can order any type of noodle you want, and everything they have on the menu. I think it's delicious. I especially like the dry noodles with dark soy sauce. The restaurant also has regular-sized dishes like stir-fried basil with rice or sukiyaki, but we didn't order those this time. Today we ordered chrysanthemum tea, which was quite sweet – not to my liking, but forgivable. They also have sticky rice wrapped in banana leaves as a dessert to cleanse the palate. Checking in also gets you a free ice cream cone. The service was excellent for the price. We went on a Sunday and were able to park on the street (we called the restaurant to confirm). On weekdays, they said you can park at the Kway Sae Association at the entrance of the soi (alley).
sample_reviews_en.author: ชญานันทน์ ศรีศักดิ์ตระกูล

sample_reviews_en.text:
Boat Noodle Restaurant (Charoen Krung 76) - I came here based on reviews.
The restaurant is decorated mainly with corrugated iron, giving it a retro atmosphere that blends in with the old wooden houses in this neighborhood. The boat noodle menu offers both pork and beef (separate pots). I chose the pork version. The flavor was well-balanced; the broth had a fragrant spice aroma and was moderately rich, not spicy and not sweet. I really liked it.
As for the crispy pork with chili and salt, the crispy pork was tender and not dry, and it paired perfectly with the fragrant jasmine rice. For appetizers:
The fried spring rolls were crispy, golden brown, and cut into bite-sized pieces. And finally, the grilled pork meatballs. I didn't have high expectations at first, but they exceeded my expectations. The meatballs were a creamy white color and served with a dipping sauce on top. A must-try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Watcharit Pinkasemjit

sample_reviews_en.text:
This shop serves both pork and beef noodles.
Noodle Soup in Corrugated Iron Sheets, Charoen Krung 76. The shop is comfortable, airy, and not hot. The owner is lovely and welcoming, even though we arrived before the shop opened at 9:30 AM. This shop is unique because it uses corrugated iron sheets for the shop and food containers. It's a boat noodle shop without a boat in front, but the taste is just as good as any other. Especially the beef meatballs, they are incredibly bouncy. My family prefers beef, and personally, I like the dry version. It's a shame we arrived too early, the grilled meatballs weren't ready yet. The freshly fried pork cracklings are amazing. They also have fried spring rolls, freshly fried and delicious.
The ice is served in a cute little bowl. Overall, I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suthasinee Trithara

sample_reviews_en.text:
After paying respects and making wishes at Wat Sutthiwararam, I took bus number 1 and got off at the second stop at Asiatique, near Wat Phraya Krai Police Station. I walked a little past the police station, crossed the road to the other side at Soi Charoen Krung 76, and stopped for a noodle meal at "Khao Soi Ruea Sangkasi - Charoen Krung 76 Branch" 😁☝️. It's a chill-style restaurant with pork and beef noodles, as well as stir-fried basil with rice and grilled meatballs. The prices are affordable too. Filling and delicious! 😁
.
.
#KhaoSoiRueaNoodles
#StreetfoodThailand
#Rimtangstory
sample_reviews_en.author: Rimtang Story

sample_reviews_en.text: Located near Asiatique..the food ranges from noodles to rice dishes. I recently discovered this amazing Thai restaurant nestled in a little alley. It's one of those places you'd easily overlook, but I'm so glad I found it. They serve the best Thai noodles and rice dishes I've ever had. The flavors are incredible, and everything tastes so fresh and authentic. The setting is cozy and intimate, which makes it a perfect spot to unwind and enjoy a great meal away from the busy streets. If you ever get a chance, you should definitely check it out. It's truly a hidden gem.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Cork

sample_reviews_en.text: A cute little shop in an alley opposite Wat Phraya Krai Police Station. The young sellers are great. The tin bowls used for the spicy dishes are good, like those at provincial temple fairs. A good price at 15 baht, you can tell them how spicy you want it. The pork cracklings are fresh, they have grilled meatballs, and the snacks to finish off before leaving are delicious too. 😁😉 I'll definitely go again! 👍 It's great!
sample_reviews_en.author: ก็อบปี้ เวิร์ค

sample_reviews_en.text:
One-stop service, delicious food all in one place!

Today I took my girlfriend to a famous restaurant in the Charoen Krung area. Anyone who loves boat noodles with a rich, creamy coconut broth will definitely love it.
Although the restaurant is called "Boat Noodles," they also have almost 10 other equally delicious à la carte dishes.

Anyone passing through the Charoen Krung area should stop by and try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: KRIT JIZZ

sample_reviews_en.text: As you can see in the picture, everything is too sweet. The crispy pork basil stir-fry only had a few pieces of pork and a lot of fat. The noodles come in several sizes, but the meatballs are cut in half. The restaurant has a retro decor. The noodles in the picture are 45 baht, the crispy pork basil stir-fry is 65 baht, and the fried egg is 10 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: NanThiKan แปลว่าน่ารัก

restaurants.name: อันเกิมอันก๋า AnComAnCa ICONSIAM
restaurants.address:

G Floor, Veranda Zone 299 Charoen Nakhon 5 Alley, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Vietnamese food that gives a different experience, my favourite will be their pork noodle soup (380baht) soup is sweet , pork meat is soft and noodles is well cooked . Many dishes come with small salad and their own sauces. For those who likes spicy , try the sauce with the grilled pork with betel leaf. Taste quite authentic with a modern twist . A good place to enjoy Vietnamese cuisine in Bangkok . Staff service is extremely good and friendly . They work fast , and even you wanna enjoy the food with your family , they will arrange table to suits your numbers asap if the shop is not full . For those with wheelchair is welcome too as the shop can easily fit your wheelchair into the seat table . Good team work for the staff 👍. Price range is reasonable but some dishes in beef will be a bit higher. Most of the food looks clean and well presented , hope the kitchen team can maintain this standard . Will comes back again for the pho .
It’s located inside iconsiam . The decoration is modern and comfortable .
sample_reviews_en.author: TM LEK

sample_reviews_en.text:
Before coming in, I hesitated a little because the prices were quite a bit higher than usual, but I wanted to try it to see if it was better than typical restaurants...
First, I have to commend the staff; they were lovely, spoke politely, and provided excellent service.

I ordered two dishes: rice paper rolls and sugarcane-wrapped shrimp. I actually wanted to order Vietnamese noodle soup too, but I was afraid I wouldn't be able to finish it, and more importantly, I was afraid it wouldn't be tasty, so I just ordered these two to try.

Wow! When the food arrived... the portions were huge! Just the rice paper rolls alone would have been enough to fill me up. It's good I only ordered two dishes.
After finishing the food, I thought, "Hmm, the price is reasonable." It was delicious. Especially the sugarcane-wrapped shrimp with vermicelli noodles; it was incredibly delicious!
I'll try other dishes next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pepe Zaa

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Vietnamese restaurant serves flavorful food, similar to Thai food, a bit on the salty side.
I actually ate many dishes today, but didn't take pictures.

My favorite dish was the fried shrimp wrapped in vermicelli noodles.
Overall, the food was decent, but I just thought it was a little too salty.
The portions here are large.

The Nem Nuong and grilled pork wrapped in betel leaves came with similar ingredients, including various vegetables for wrapping.

The fried tofu was delicious; perfectly fried.

The stir-fried sea bass with its unusual yellow color was a bit too salty.

The fresh spring rolls were very large, a real mouthful.
The Banh Cuon (steamed rice rolls) were just okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: SSS BKK

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were visiting ICONSIAM for the first time and decided to look for something to eat. We were passing by Ăn Cơm Ăn Cá and took a look at the menu. We liked what we saw in the menu so we entered and were shown to our table.

I ordered the Vietnamese Fried Rice with nem nuong Com chien nem nuong, and an order of Pork Spring Rolls. My wife ordered the Vietnamese Noodles.

We both really enjoyed our food, everything was delicious. The service was top-notch, the interior was nicely decorated, and everything looked clean.

It was really nice dining in a restaurant that seemed to care about providing good service and excellent food at a reasonable price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike Du Bose

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great Vietnamese food! Vegetable lovers will adore this place; they give you a huge bowl of side vegetables, packed full!

😋 Nem Nuong (grilled pork skewers): Big, bite-sized wraps with a rich, flavorful dipping sauce.
😋 Stir-fried kale with fish sauce: 🥇 I've never had anything this delicious anywhere else! The wok aroma is amazing, the sauce is fantastic, and the vegetables are perfectly crisp.
😋 An Cam An Ca ice cream: Rich coffee flavor, delicious with the restaurant's special fried bananas (banana blended with coconut milk and then fried). 🎉
--
There are tons of other dishes, both savory and sweet. I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: T_HA wandering (ทีฮา:กิน เที่ยว เปรี้ยว เล่น)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The 380 baht beef noodle soup came out with chunks of meat cooked in it... The photo doesn't capture it well, but when I opened it up, the meat wasn't even cooked through.
The broth was delicious, but you can imagine how delicious it was.
The avocado and shrimp spring rolls were delicious.
I couldn't even touch the Vietnamese spring rolls, so I asked them to wrap the leftovers, but they didn't wrap them in paper wrappers...
Perhaps because there were so many customers, the staff was very slow to respond.
The staff was friendly, but seemed a bit preoccupied...
