I won't be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: suniko

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I really wanted Vietnamese food, especially with lots of vegetables. We ended up at An Com An Ca (a Vietnamese restaurant) run by Ms. Pla.

It was so delicious and satisfying, it made me want to go to Vietnam!
- Banana chips: Very fragrant with banana flavor, the texture is similar to regular rice crackers, incredibly tasty.
- Grilled beef and cilantro salad: Also delicious.
- Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork skewers): Also delicious.
- Vietnamese rice crackers: Also delicious.

Everything was delicious! I couldn't find anything I didn't like! 55555555
sample_reviews_en.author: Tonn Suwajachai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Top-tier Vietnamese dining with exceptional service.

As part of the iberry group, the food quality and taste are consistently excellent. This specific branch stands out because the service is notably better and more attentive than many other locations I’ve visited, which is why I keep coming back. The restaurant features two floors of comfortable seating with a great atmosphere and is very easy to find. Highly recommended for anyone seeking premium quality and a wonderful vibe.
sample_reviews_en.author: NNchan

restaurants.name: Mae Sinuan Isaan food and seafood
restaurants.address:

1983-2001 3, Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was renting a room nearby and was casually looking up restaurants on Google Maps when I came across this Isaan restaurant. In conclusion, to be honest, it was a bit of a disappointment.

I ordered sticky rice (15B), Som Tum Thai (49B), Kor Moo Yang (89B), and a soda (20B), for a total of 173B. Overall, the cooking seemed rather sloppy.

The Som Tum had a strange mix of thick and thin papaya, resulting in an unpleasant texture. The Kor Moo Yang was particularly disappointing. It was somewhat stringy, and the strong sauce seemed to mask the flavor. The prices were significantly cheaper than other restaurants, so I wondered what it would be like, but it was as disappointing as I expected. The dipping sauce lacked sourness and was simply spicy.

Overall, it was a rather disappointing restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shibata Keiichiro

sample_reviews_en.text:
On average, the prices are quite high compared to the taste, which isn't particularly outstanding, and the packaging is rather basic.
Papaya salad 80 baht
Beef stir-fry with basil and rice 80 baht (but they don't use jasmine rice)
The fresh bamboo shoot curry had good-tasting bamboo shoots. We ordered it extra spicy; it was delicious, rich, and flavorful.
But the price is very high.
There wasn't much fresh vegetable side dish (the cucumber provided wasn't tender and wasn't peeled, so that deducted points).
Perhaps because it was a delivery order, the price was increased due to the app's fees.
It wasn't very impressive. It would be much better if they could improve it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chom Harn

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is really delicious. I just stopped by before going to the airport near my hotel and it was amazing. The meat dishes and tom yum kung fried rice... they're all delicious. The marinades made with fermented seafood are especially delicious. Be sure to ask for all the marinades. The tall woman who cooks the food looks like the main character in a Thai movie, so single men should definitely go. The only downside is that it's a bit dirty, which is far from luxurious, but I'm sensitive and didn't get an upset stomach, so I don't think you have to worry about hygiene.
sample_reviews_en.author: Byungkyu SHIN

sample_reviews_en.text:
It is located not far from Onnut station. It is located in a good place at the corner of the building and the restaurant condition is very good.
The salad that I had, which was mixed with papaya + shrimp and Lee San's special spicy sauce, is the best salad for me this year.

The fried rice with pork and the freshly grilled chicken wings are also on a level that is better than any other restaurant.

I will visit again next time. It is the best with a cold Chang beer. Cash is the best for payment. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Julien Seo

sample_reviews_en.text:
A restaurant where you can enjoy Thai food at reasonable prices.

The large bottle of Singha beer was the coldest I've had during my entire stay in Thailand – absolutely fantastic. No need for nam khao (spicy soy sauce). I drank it straight from the bottle.

The food is probably seasoned to appeal to tourists; it was a little too sweet for my taste. However, the flavor wasn't bad.

It was nice to eat in the air-conditioned restaurant while watching people go by on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: ht mw

sample_reviews_en.text: When we visited, there were only three groups of customers, but the place quickly filled up. Two women were cooking and serving, but it wasn't hectic and we were able to eat in peace. By the time we left, two more women had arrived, so depending on the time of day, there might be four people working there. The food was delicious, not just tourist-style, but solid Thai cuisine. This is a restaurant we'll definitely return to.
sample_reviews_en.author: おっさん

sample_reviews_en.text: I was staying at the Avani Sukumvit and was looking at a Thai place close by to eat! I had zero expectations of this place as very few people had written about it. When I arrived the place was empty and I was greeted by a man in his 20’s! I placed the order and I feel the husband - wife duo runs this place and the food that came out was beyond my expectations! Fresh, whole some and very authentic! I simply loved it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Gunjan Kumar

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really enjoyed the meal. I had Morning Glory (2 servings), Chicken Wings, Squid Salad, and Ke Moo Yang, and I was impressed by the taste of the food.

It was even better because it wasn't too salty, and the prices are affordable.

The bill came out to about 675 baht. I want to visit again to try other dishes. I recommend this place. Wishing you great success! ♡♡
sample_reviews_en.author: 장미향

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเนื้อเตาถ่านตา-ยาย50ปี
restaurants.address:

1004 1 พระรามที่ 4 Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This hidden gem of a beef noodle shop in Soi Phai Singto has been around for a long time, with the recipe passed down through generations. The broth is fragrant with beef and garlic, and the stewed beef is tender but not mushy – a classic Thai style. The beef meatballs are delicious, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, and the dipping sauce is fantastic. The soup is kept at the perfect temperature over charcoal, preserving its flavor. They offer various cuts of beef. The shop isn't usually crowded, but they have a steady stream of delivery orders.
sample_reviews_en.author: Torpong Chiamtawongse

sample_reviews_en.text: This hidden gem of a braised beef noodle shop is tucked away in a residential area near the Queen Sirikit Convention Center. The prices are friendly, and the food is surprisingly delicious and clean. The broth is incredibly fragrant, and they use a charcoal stove. They also have an amazing dish – the best braised beef with basil I've ever had! It's incredibly flavorful, with just the right amount of spiciness and a wonderful basil aroma. If you're in the area, I highly recommend it. It's a short walk from the MRT Queen Sirikit Convention Center station.
sample_reviews_en.author: NIKI Rose

sample_reviews_en.text: Located in an alley, the shop sells beef noodle soup and minced beef stir-fry. The braised beef is incredibly tender and melts in your mouth. The meatballs are good, made with real beef – you won't be disappointed. I recommend ordering the braised beef; you won't regret it. The minced beef stir-fry is also decent. The rice is perfectly cooked. Each dish is made to order, and you can choose your preferred level of spiciness.
sample_reviews_en.author: GNK23

sample_reviews_en.text: This hidden gem of a beef noodle shop is tucked away in a small alley inaccessible to cars, located near a grandma and grandpa on Rama IV Road. It's incredibly delicious, perfect for beef lovers. The shop is in their house, giving you the feeling of a real grandma and grandpa cooking. The prices are also very reasonable. Highly recommend trying it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kodchaphorn Sanyadech

sample_reviews_en.text:
This noodle shop serves clear, herbal-infused beef noodles, and also offers minced beef stir-fry and braised beef. The beef is delicious and fragrant. 9/10

Water is free, and they don't charge for ice. The owner might argue with his wife a bit sometimes, haha.

You can get your noodles right after ordering; the stir-fry will take a little longer.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชาตรี คุรุภากรณ์

sample_reviews_en.text: I only managed to find this noodle shop by getting lost using a major domestic navigation app. The name is in Thai, and it serves my favorite beef offal noodles. The small storefront is clean and tidy, and they provide a large bucket of fresh, live sweet basil soaking in water. The owner is very friendly, and I've eaten there several times.
sample_reviews_en.author: Reed Zhang

sample_reviews_en.text: I followed a recommendation from Rama 9 area. The noodles are delicious! I ate around 11:00 AM, and everything was perfectly tender. The atmosphere is exactly what I like – a small, homey place that prioritizes quality over quantity, making each bowl to order. They don't take multiple orders; you have to write down your order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirawat Chiwitthayakiat

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is practically a hidden gem. You don't often see beef noodle soup cooked over a charcoal stove. The broth is fragrant and perfectly balanced in flavor. It's cheap, the portions are generous, and the beef basil stir-fry is delicious too. I was really impressed! ✅❤️😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongpipat Jirakittayakorn

restaurants.name: ข้าวต้มชมรถไฟ
restaurants.address:

QCWJ+V8J, Si Rat-Outer Ring Rd Express Way Frontage Rd, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my third time eating here, it's very close to home.
•The prices are quite cheap (compared to the quantity and quality).
•There's a wide variety of food to choose from.
•The rice isn't hard, the rice porridge is hot and very fragrant.
•The fried salted fish is really crispy and delicious (highly recommended).
•The stir-fried clams are very flavorful (highly recommended).
•The owner is very friendly and welcoming, like eating at a relative's house. She gives good food recommendations and is fun to chat with.
•For 1-2 people (typical), the price is around 200 baht or less, but our family eats a lot, so we ordered a lot 😅
The picture only shows the first set, we ordered more.

The highlight was I've never seen such large pieces of stir-fried preserved radish before.
(Usually I see them in strands). It was very satisfying.

If you come on Monday or Tuesday, they also have mixed vegetable stew.
The taste is salty, not sweet (delicious).
sample_reviews_en.author: Indicat Catcafe

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a restaurant specializing in Thai-style dishes and rice porridge. I ate there yesterday evening. Each dish is 20 baht, and rice porridge is 3 baht. They have all kinds of dishes: fried, boiled, stir-fried.

It's clean, very reasonably priced, delicious, and fast.
I give it 5 stars without hesitation.
P.S. Plain rice is also 3 baht per bowl.
Food portions are as pictured.
sample_reviews_en.author: บีเคแอล ฺBKL

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate there back in 2021. It was delicious, the portions were generous, and the price was reasonable. But since 2022, I've tried to go several times, but the shop has always been closed. I suspect it's no longer open for business; it's probably permanently closed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaiyakit Thanabriboon

sample_reviews_en.text:
The prices are affordable, I'd say.
Starting at 20 baht per dish.
Plenty of parking because it's in a trailer lot.
The vendor looks a bit expressionless.
Self-service for both rice and water.
The plates and bowls look old and have black stains.
sample_reviews_en.author: Santr

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and affordable. The crispy fried fish salad is amazing; I highly recommend ordering it. There's plenty of parking and the restaurant has a quiet and peaceful atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Por por

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is cheap, only 20 baht per dish. The portions are just right, and some items are even better value for the price. You'll be comfortably full. Come and try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: MoUiZz Svan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, only 20 baht per dish. The restaurant atmosphere is great, very clean, and the service is good. I go there regularly. There's ample parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chatphant Ujjin (Nueng)

sample_reviews_en.text: This place offers great value, delicious food, and most importantly, it's very affordable. I'll definitely be back next time I'm in the area! 😘😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Suthatip Nitikultanon

restaurants.name: Pad Thai Kesorn Sukhumvit 22
restaurants.address:

สุขุมวิท Khwaeng Khlong Tan, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Pad Thai was incredibly delicious! The flavor was perfect without needing any extra seasoning; just add some chili and you're good to go. The noodles were chewy and soft, and the fresh vegetables were clean and delicious. Excellent!
The fried mussels were equally delicious. Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, and very fragrant. They used large, fresh mussels and gave a generous portion.
The portions were large and the prices were reasonable. Highly recommended!
If you're ever in the area, you should definitely try it.
However, parking is a bit difficult. You might have to park at the nearby 7-Eleven and walk a short distance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Punnathorn Sakkayawong

sample_reviews_en.text: I had Pad Thai here twice so far, one with chicken, one with shrimp, both were delicious. I enjoy the atmosphere, sitting right at the side walk, people watching, and just letting the city wash over you. The prices are hard to beat also, unless you cook the food yourself. I will eat here again, I hope.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kjell Schubert

sample_reviews_en.text:
I happened to pass by this restaurant near the hotel where I was staying and ordered takeout.
It was incredibly delicious.
I'd like to return on my next trip to Thailand and enjoy the atmosphere at the food stall tables and chairs.
Thank you for the meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: 茶馬介

sample_reviews_en.text: Just ate the GREATEST Pad Thai of all time. Many people are saying it. Incredible noodles, PERFECT balance, tremendous flavor. Other Pad Thais? Total disasters. This one? A WINNER. Thailand is doing AMAZING things, folks. Five stars!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Max

sample_reviews_en.text: It was crowded, so I got my Pad Thai in 20 minutes. It didn't taste good. They were very friendly. It was so bland. I don't know what it tasted like. They sprinkled lime and chili powder on it. Pad Thai 80 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bom L

sample_reviews_en.text: So lovely people and for sure the best Pad Thai in BKK or maybe in Thailand. Travelling Thailand more than 6 times and more then 6 month but this is the best one. Highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Markus Brocksieper

sample_reviews_en.text:
I heard from a Thai acquaintance that this is the best Pad Thai in the area, so I decided to try it.
The combination of charcoal-grilled shrimp and chewy Pad Thai noodles is superb. …
sample_reviews_en.author: ray coling (raycoling)

sample_reviews_en.text: Still the best pad thai I’ve had in BKK after living here for almost a year! Delicious, fresh, inexpensive and served by a charming Thai woman who always has a smile. Love it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike P

restaurants.name: Mama’s
restaurants.address:

59 Rama III 79 Alley, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Mama’s Thai Street Food is more than just a culinary spot; it's a voyage into the heart of Thailand’s bustling streets and rich heritage. Nestled inconspicuously among local shops, this gem offers dishes that are both authentic and exquisitely prepared. The flavors are bold and unapologetic, each bite revealing layers of complexity. From the fiery kick of the Tom Yum Goong to the comforting embrace of the Pad Thai, every dish speaks of Mama’s passion and mastery. The ambiance transports diners straight to a Bangkok street corner, complete with the subtle aromas of sizzling woks and aromatic spices wafting through the air. It's not just a meal at Mama’s; it's an unforgettable experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Tajik

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Mama’s over the Papa’s. I must be dreaming. Incredible flavors great affordable prices. Mama cooked me a delicious Pad Krapow Gai and it was so nourishing to my soul I ordered a Curry just to stay in that food induced nirvana a bit longer.

I walked about 15 mins there and was greatly rewarded. I recommend adding this to your list of must try street food in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dylan Smith

sample_reviews_en.text: It's quite a challenge to get to, but it's a highly-rated food stall tucked away in a back alley. We ordered two plates for 50 baht each and were completely full. The taste was fantastic! More than anything, I was drawn to the owner's personality. I really think good customer service is important. I want to try other things, so I'll definitely visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: 野良犬

sample_reviews_en.text:
A great small restaurant held by Mama a lovely lady.

She makes wonderful pad thais, and all of the other dishes are excellent aswell.

The prices are cheap and she cooks all day and all week!

I ate there for 5 months and I never had any issue.

Both eating there or take out is available.

I would recommend 100% :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Cloclo Fbv

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mama’s is the place to be!
Hands down best Pad Thai I’ve ever eaten. Me and my gf just happen to walk past one night and the smells were unreal. Because of that we had to come and eat the next night. You will not be disappointed the food is quality and the service is lovely 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Owen

sample_reviews_en.text: come here to try authentic pad thai and other thai meals :) it was delicious and lady who is cooking is really nice and kind person, she smiles all the time and you feel great energy from her! not obvious place to come but definitely highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Klaudi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Love this place.
I eat there everyday at least one time and I don‘t know what I would do without her.
I will miss it so much when I leave Bangkok and probably I buy her a flight to Germany, so she can open a Streetfood place there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lennart Schnoor

sample_reviews_en.text: Best place where to eat in the neighbourhood,  mama prepares at best the great classics as pad thai, curry soup or mango sticky rice ! Every time I'm back in town I pass here as a customer but even as a friend !
sample_reviews_en.author: tommaso bertolini

restaurants.name: Salad Salad
restaurants.address:

453 Somdet Chao Phraya Rd, Khwaeng Khlong San, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very charming cafe and salad bistro located near Icon Siam. It's a two-story building; the first floor serves fusion salads, which can be enjoyed with any meal. We tried the Mexican-style pasta salad, and it was remarkably impressive. The second floor is a Japanese cafe specializing in matcha and freshly made daifuku. The prices reflect the quality. The staff are also very friendly and professional. Perfect for those looking for a calm and relaxing restaurant and cafe.

It's a small shop with a wonderful atmosphere and lovely staff. It's a two-story building; the ground floor sells various salads, while the upper floor is a cafe selling matcha and freshly made daifuku (they seem to sell other drinks too). You can order both and the staff will bring them to your table. I tried the Mexican-style pasta salad and it was delicious – refreshing and flavorful. The price was very reasonable considering the portion size. The matcha latte was fragrant and easy to drink, and the daifuku had a very soft mochi. I loved how peaceful the shop was; it was so relaxing to sit there. I'll definitely come back and support your business again next time! ✨️🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: Apitchaya Anantachokchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Salad salad is a nice destination restaurant. It’s walking distance from bts and near icon siam. The building is very cozy. It’s a good spot to have lunch and chat with a friend.

Food was prices well and good. I had the soba salad. I wasnt that hungry but it tasted good so i ate the whole thing. Even though I ate a lot i didnt feel gross. The food is healthy.

There is a matcha cafe above salad salad and the drinks are good. It’s a good pairing. The upstairs cafe is also very comfortable.

This is a great spot to meet up with a friend or for a healthy work lunch.

Would recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Matt Fairtex

sample_reviews_en.text:
What a gem! Found it by accident driving pass. It’s extremely cosy inside and the ambience is very pleasant and welcoming.

The girl who served me was so kind and sweet and kept checking on me, especially making sure if the food wasn’t too spicy. Aw!

The best part, of course, was the bowl itself. It was delicious. The ingredients were fresh and the sauce went so well with the salad. I also took 🍵and it was great too!
sample_reviews_en.author: Elīna Blūma

sample_reviews_en.text: Salad-Salad Bar is a charming little place with a selection of about 12 different, very fresh salads (prepared to order), and a choice of 9 different sauces. Everything is wonderfully fresh and beautifully presented. Free fresh water is available for self-service. Upstairs, there's a living room-style area with a coffee bar and very friendly service. Highly recommended. (Closed Saturdays)
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Lipp

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was delicious! The restaurant uses high-quality ingredients; the chicken was especially tasty. They have a wide variety of dishes, and the atmosphere is lovely. There's a matcha shop upstairs, which you can order from. You can park in the alley before the restaurant.

(The salad menu selection was excellent, and the ambiance and decor created a pleasant atmosphere.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Janyaporn Koysombat

sample_reviews_en.text:

Quite possibly the worst restaurant experience that I have ever had. We tried to order drinks, but the waitress told us that they were out of their whole drink menu. I got a water instead, but it never came.

I don't even know what to say, THIS IS THE FIRST TIME! This is my first time writing a review, and unfortunately, it's not the best.

This place is very nice, the view is beautiful, the staff speaks English and is very friendly.

But the food...it's just awful.

I ordered a steak, which wasn't the cheapest, about 200 grams for 650 baht -+.

First, they mixed up the sauces. Second, I ordered medium rare, and they brought it medium rare. The potatoes were completely undercooked, hard, just like the carrots. Everything was tough.

Third, the steak had NO SALT!!! It wasn't a salty steak at all.

I don't recommend coming here. I was so disappointed for the first time that ABSOLUTELY none of the dishes were tasty.

sample_reviews_en.text: A wonderful little spot tucked away in an alley near the highway. This small, family-run restaurant—owned by an Indian couple—offers truly incredible service and absolutely outstanding food. They cater to a Jain diet, which was perfect for me since I can’t eat onion or garlic, and they were also very accommodating with gluten free and dairy free needs. We got the veg biryani, dhal makhani, chicken malabar, and mixed veg. After so much Far Eastern food in Bangkok, this was a refreshing and welcome change, and seriously some of the best Indian food we’ve had outside India. Highly recommend!

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a small Japanese restaurant in the Jinda Market on Vibhavadi 20. There's shared parking available in the market. I went before the ban on dine-in was implemented. It was evening and the restaurant was full, but there were still some empty tables, though they were cramped and close together. Worried about COVID, we sat outside – it was a bit hot, but safer. The staff brought the menu and took our order quickly, despite the crowd. The food was delicious and fresh. The salmon sashimi was cut into large, fresh, and juicy pieces. The grilled salmon had a nice smoky aroma and the sauce was perfectly balanced, not too sweet. Everything was excellent. They offer a free bowl of soup per person. The salmon sushi with mayonnaise was fragrant and delicious, full of umami. The salmon salad was also flavorful and helped cut through the richness. In short, I loved everything we ordered. I'll definitely go back again when dine-in is allowed again!

Everything was tasty. The prices are moderate, not too expensive or too cheap, but the quality of the ingredients is excellent and the taste is great. Plus, they have a loyalty points program. sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried the Organic American Fried Rice at Cafe Jardin. At first, I thought it would be a simple dish, but the details and ingredients exceeded my expectations.

The fried rice was fragrant with just the right amount of seasoning and tomato sauce – not too sweet. The rice grains were fluffy, not soggy, and the flavor was comforting and easy to eat without feeling heavy.

This time, I added organic fried chicken and 100% organic chicken sausage. The fried chicken was crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, not greasy at all. The sausage had a very clean taste, with a real chicken flavor, not salty like typical sausages.

I finished with a homemade caramel custard with coconut sugar. It had a wonderful homemade feel. The custard was smooth, fragrant with egg and milk, and the caramel wasn't overly sweet, balancing the savory dishes perfectly. 🍮

The restaurant's atmosphere remains calm and serene, perfect for brunch or a relaxing meal in the city. 🌿

Overall, it's a restaurant with seemingly simple food, but the attention to detail and quality is evident.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wichai Kulbutdee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food quality was uneven, given the price point. We ordered two lunch meal sets, and the portions were good, and food was well presented. It wasn't fast, but not slow either; but we were the only people with orders on the go at the time.

The problem was taste and quality - the breaded pork was not good - over breaded, poorly fried, and dry. The crispy pork belly was pretty good, but the spicy pasta was simply way too spicy (and yes, I do eat spicy foods in Thailand) due to the amount of fresh finely chopped chilis in the small amount of spaghetti which threw the dish out of balance - just pure heat. The pasta was well cooked, however.

The atmosphere was mediocre. It's called "Jardin", but the garden decor was very limited, even though there was plenty of space. The service was just "ok", especially given there was only one other table occupied.

I know this restaurant focuses on quality Thai produce, but I've been to another restaurant with the same focus, but makes far superior food, at lower prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: D Y

sample_reviews_en.text:
Café Jardin offers a quiet workspace, making it a great option. The atmosphere is calm and peaceful, with Wi-Fi and power outlets available, allowing for extended work sessions without feeling cramped.

I ordered the "Khao Man Gai Than Khun" (Chicken Rice Set), a relatively easy-to-eat dish with fragrant rice, tender chicken, and flavorful dipping sauce. The milk eclair had a soft pastry shell and a perfectly sweet milk filling; it would likely pair well with coffee or other beverages.

Overall, it's a suitable place for those seeking a quiet space to work, read, or relax. The food selection is decent, the atmosphere is comfortable, and it's not overly crowded. It's a good alternative if you're in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุรัตน์ แก้วงาม

sample_reviews_en.text: Upon entering the restaurant, I was greeted with a bright and cheerful smile. The restaurant has a cafe area for enjoying coffee and a dining area. The staff mentioned that the food here is organic, with ingredients sourced directly from farmers. Today, I chose the new Pad Krapow (Thai basil stir-fry) menu item, which allows you to choose from several types of meat. I really liked the concept. Most of the meat options are 50 grams, allowing you to add more in various ways. I was pleasantly surprised by the blueberry cheesecake; it was delicious – not too sweet, not cloying, and they were very generous with the blueberries.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐพล ครองสิงห์

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located in a hotel on Wireless Road, making it quite convenient to get to. The atmosphere is quiet and peaceful, perfect for business meetings or family outings on weekends. I ordered the huge crab claw fried rice, served with seaweed soup. They offer seafood dipping sauce and fish sauce to add flavor as you like. The staff were friendly and cheerful. I appreciate that the restaurant knows the source of its ingredients, ensuring safe food and supporting local farmers and communities. I will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anime game

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to Sivatel Market on the first week of every month. This time, it was very hot outside, but it was cool and comfortable inside the market, making it pleasant to stroll around. I bought several things to take home: bread, steamed rice cakes, mackerel, and lots of other food items.
This time, I tried the Pad Thai with sweet and sour tamarind sauce, which had a perfect balance of flavors, and the crispy pork spaghetti, which was quite spicy and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shiro Shiro

sample_reviews_en.text:
Café Jardin
A delicious restaurant in Sivatel Bangkok.
The prices might seem a bit high, but the quality is worth it. It's really delicious.
Like in the picture...the crispy pork is amazing.
The sun-dried pork neck...is so enjoyable to chew.
Don't miss the Milk Bun, it's seriously delicious.
And the tamarind juice...is incredible.
This is definitely another restaurant worth visiting.
#TasteWithCher guarantees the deliciousness.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirawat Shinawatrawangso

sample_reviews_en.text: Enjoy delicious and worry-free meals here. Every dish is organic and traceable; you'll never be disappointed. The atmosphere is comfortable and clean, a favorite spot in the city center that's always relaxing to visit. Perfect for those who are #Healthy and #Organic. Not only do you enjoy delicious food, but you also support the producers, growers, and livestock farmers – it's truly wonderful!
sample_reviews_en.author: Aphicha Yoosomboon

restaurants.name: Krua Rakang Talingchan
restaurants.address:

16 Borommaratchachonnani Rd, Chim Phli, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food came out super fast! It was the freshest, most delicious, and best I've ever had! 💙

The fried frog with garlic was amazing! The meat was bouncy and enjoyable, with no fishy taste at all. Importantly, I've rarely seen restaurants in Thailand fry the frog with such large pieces of meat; usually, they're tiny. 🐸🌟
The steamed sea bass with lime was also delicious. The pieces were large, firm, and not fishy. 🐟💫
The sour curry with acacia leaves and shrimp had a fluffy, large fried egg and plenty of shrimp. 🦐✨
The crab fried rice was tasty, but I don't have a picture because we ate it all before I could! 🦀
The fried shrimp with tamarind sauce were huge, with firm, bouncy meat.
The stir-fried white chives with minced pork was delicious and a large portion.
The fried fish cakes were huge, like donuts, delicious, and had a nice bouncy texture.

There was a selection of ice cream in the freezer, and it was delicious! 🥰🫶🏻💓
sample_reviews_en.author: Happy Life (KATE)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located on Borommaratchachonnani Road, at the foot of the bridge, opposite Taling Chan Police Station (following directions from Rakhang Phochana, Siriraj Hospital).
Most of the food wasn't very fresh, especially the shrimp and crab. But what surprised me was the crab curry, where the meat was mushy and not in chunks, the flavor wasn't strong, and the side vegetables, like acacia and water spinach, weren't sure if they went well together. The fried dishes were crispy and not oily.
The bill came to over 2,000 baht, which isn't cheap considering what we got.
The serving was a bit inconsistent, with spills here and there, but it wasn't a big deal.
The restaurant has plenty of parking in its own area. There's seating both indoors and outdoors, and they serve alcoholic beverages.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phichak W

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu and taste of the food are similar to Krua Taling Chan (the original restaurant that reopened). The food tastes just as delicious as before. They offer a wide variety of fresh Thai dishes that are very much to my family's taste. Whenever we come here, we always order the spicy snail curry – it's creamy and flavorful, and the snails are clean. The tamarind shrimp was a little too sweet; it could be a bit more sour. The stir-fried water spinach was perfectly cooked. The papaya salad was spicy and delicious. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: sakaw ong

sample_reviews_en.text: I was not impressed with the service. I had to ask about my food many times, to the point that two tables that arrived after me received their orders. In the end, I had to go to the kitchen to find out they hadn't made it. The queue management was poor, and the waitstaff were rude. I wouldn't recommend eating here. Waiting a long time is one thing, but not making the food while claiming it was being prepared was quite disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwang

sample_reviews_en.text: The waitstaff at the restaurant were excellent, providing fast and attentive service. The food was delicious. However, the person answering the phone wasn't very good. I called the 02 number, and they didn't ask for my contact number before hanging up, even though they said they would call back. In the end, I had to call them myself to provide my number, and they never called.
sample_reviews_en.author: baiplu pimwan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes good, the portions are large, and it's good value for money. However, it's not ideal for two people because there's not much variety in the menu. I'd like to see the prices lowered a bit, so that customers can come more often and not just occasionally.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vita Siri

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every dish was delicious, especially the sour fish curry, which was very flavorful. The tamarind-stuffed fried shrimp was also fresh and had a bouncy texture.
The staff were lovely and provided excellent service. The prices were very good. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Athicha San

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted good. It's an old Taling Chan restaurant with plenty of parking and air conditioning. During my visit, there was a group of people who had been drinking heavily and were quite noisy and disruptive. The service from the staff was okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ai Npprn
