sample_reviews_en.text:
Today, I had omakase at this restaurant again, and I have to say that every bite was just as fresh and delicious as always, including the desserts. I also learned something new — the wasabi here isn’t spicy at all. After asking the chef, I found out that they use authentic fresh wasabi, unlike many other places that mix it with horseradish.

The restaurant has a small and private atmosphere, with seating for up to 10 guests. The staff provide excellent service and are all very friendly and cheerful as always. We will definitely come back again.
PS. Thank you very much for a lovely birthday Ice cream waffle ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Goi Susa

sample_reviews_en.text: Had lunch at Tomosasada Omakase yesterday and it was truly an amazing experience. Chef Sasada is very experienced, warm, and friendly — we had a great chat throughout the meal. We come from Singapore where there’s no shortage of good food, but this was easily one of the best omakase experiences we’ve ever had. Every dish was fresh, beautifully crafted, and memorable. Definitely worth visiting, and we will be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom Dinh

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was a chill Sunday night on October 1st. I visited Tomo Sasada Omakase with my partner. Everything was exceptional. The service is attentive. The atmosphere is warm and welcome. Moreover, the food is exceptional. Everybite was a surprise full of umami. Thank you for the experience. Thank you Tomo san and the team. You deserve all the recognition. I will see you again.
Wish you the best
Kellan
sample_reviews_en.author: Kellan Ho

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is amazing! It was my first time eating here, and I'll definitely be back because the food is the best I've ever had. The staff are polite, the chef is lovely, I really enjoyed it. The course meals aren't expensive, and they're delicious. If you want to eat tonight, I highly recommend this restaurant! It's the best!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: นุชรี เปาวะนา

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was amazing! I was impressed from the moment I called to ask for directions and parking. The chef is lovely, and the food and desserts were delicious. It happened to be my birthday when I went, and the chef and staff brought out a cake with candles and sang a birthday song for me. So sweet! Thank you! 🫶🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: NiiNg

sample_reviews_en.text:
Booked 7:30 , had to wait 30mins, ridiculous booking and service system .
Overpriced with some gimmicks that I experienced 15 years ago
Those add on  Abalone or sharkfin
Boring .
The best dish is indeed the eel !
Very crispy and amazing taste .
A bit too sweet that explains why it’s crispy also .
sample_reviews_en.author: Argyle S

restaurants.name: Santa Fe Happy Steak
restaurants.address:

Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The newly renovated restaurant looks bright and cheerful. The staff are welcoming and provide good service.
The food in the menu matches the actual dishes served; the plating is beautiful and appetizing.
First dish: Beef steak (imported), priced at 345 baht. The country of origin wasn't specified. The spinach and corn were well-prepared. The mashed potatoes were firm and topped with gravy. The French fries were thick-cut and perfectly crispy on the outside. The steak was ordered medium rare but came medium well. The flavor was good, but it was a little tough.
Second dish: Fish and chips, priced at 119 baht. It was well-made. Squeezing lemon on the fish and in the dipping sauce made it delicious. Even after it cooled down a bit, it remained crispy without the lemon.
Dessert (we didn't order it), but the restaurant served it for free (I don't know if everyone gets it). The attentive staff served it when we were almost finished with our savory dishes (which was very impressive). It was refreshing, a kind of shaved ice dessert.
Overall, I was very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: พิสินี แย้มศรีบัว

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time at this branch. The decor is very colorful and the atmosphere is great.

I ordered the pork chop steak from the promotion, plus corn soup and American fried rice (but I forgot to take pictures of those two; they were all gone before I remembered).

-Pork chop: Very tasty. The pork wasn't tough and was delicious (the promotion offered two dishes for around 200-300 baht, great value!).

-American fried rice: The sauce wasn't quite as flavorful as I'd hoped, but everything else in the dish was delicious, especially the spicy chicken steak – it was amazing!

-Corn soup: Just okay, nothing spectacular.

The staff provided excellent service. They're very well-trained, always smiling, and explained the promotions well.
They even gave us a complimentary ice stick for dessert.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akaza ชวนชิม

sample_reviews_en.text:
📌🐷🐔🦈 This steak restaurant has a great atmosphere, decorated in a bright, chic orange theme with plenty of photo opportunities. There are two floors of seating, and the air conditioning on the second floor is very strong and cold.
🍽🍚 Happy Steak's American Fried Rice: A large portion with good ingredients, but the fried rice was a bit soggy.
🐷🐔🦈🥖 Mixed Grill Combo: Grilled Dory Steak with Garlic Butter, Space Chicken Steak, Pork Loin Steak, and Kurobuta Sausage. A large portion with good quality meats grilled perfectly. Very filling.
🍋🥤 The lemon tea tasted good.
♦️ Good service. There was a wait for the food, but it was served piping hot. They provided plenty of black pepper.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lara Linh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Santa Fe Happy Steak at Siam Square Soi 3 hits the spot for a quick, no-fuss meal.

I went for the Chicken Steak Yummy with a spicy papaya salad on the side—a combo that just works. Som tam on the side always makes things better. The chicken was juicy and well seasoned, while the som tam added a fresh, spicy kick that balanced the plate perfectly.

Casual, fast, and easy, this is a solid option when you’re shopping around Siam and want something filling without overthinking it. Worth a stop if you’re nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: Farangondiet

sample_reviews_en.text: This newly opened steak restaurant is really good. At first glance, the meat portion seemed small, but it wasn't at all; it was very thick and grilled perfectly, tender and not chewy at all. The sauce was also delicious. The price is reasonable, and one plate is enough to fill you up. Refillable drinks are served first by the staff, then you fill up your own drinks afterwards. The restaurant has plenty of seating and the decor is cute and bright.
sample_reviews_en.author: ศุภิสรา เสตถากร

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere, delicious food, and good service. I would suggest improving the refillable drink system; since the restaurant has two floors, the drink dispenser is only on the first floor. The food didn't take long to arrive, which might depend on how many people were in the restaurant. The air conditioning was effective, and the decor was pleasing to the eye. It's a short walk from the BTS station.
sample_reviews_en.author: MR Folder

sample_reviews_en.text:
I just recently visited the restaurant after the rebranding. The decor has been completely revamped, using brighter colors. This branch is spacious and has plenty of seating. We sat on the second floor, and the atmosphere is bright and airy. The food is just as delicious as ever. I loved the spaghetti with truffle cream and the chicken steak.

After we finished eating, they also gave us free ice cream.
sample_reviews_en.author: nutsfoodjourney

sample_reviews_en.text:
These two dishes totaled 568 baht.
The taste was okay. I had high expectations for the imported beef steak because it cost over 300 baht, but it turned out to be tough and the sauce wasn't that great. But overall, it was acceptable. The truffle sauce spaghetti was fragrant.
I wish the restaurant would find a really good steak sauce recipe.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pun [Pun Pun]

restaurants.name: Ma Norah Social Club Bangkok
restaurants.address:

49 ห้อง B1, โรงแรม เบสคอมฟอร์ท, Soi Sukhumvit 19, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I went alone that day, and I was most impressed by the friendliness and lovely staff. Another highlight was the welcome drink, a Japanese-style fusion. I told them I wasn't good at conversation, but one of the staff members chatted with me endlessly, keeping the conversation going. I enjoyed the jazz music – it was pure bliss! The seating even had curtains for privacy, giving it a business-like, private atmosphere, haha. I could go on and on about how wonderful everything was. In short, I'll definitely be back, and I'll bring my friends too! 💓💓
sample_reviews_en.author: Kulphassorn Sinturak

sample_reviews_en.text: A hidden bar in the heart of the city, where smooth jazz sets the tone for a laid-back evening of food, drinks, and easygoing vibes. The elegant décor and romantic mood make it the perfect spot for friends to hang out, chat, and enjoy drinks all night long. One thing’s for sure—you won’t be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tubtim Silayong

sample_reviews_en.text: For jazz bar lovers, I highly recommend this place because the vibe is amazing! You can sit back, relax, sip wine, and listen to chill music. The live music is great, the decor is beautiful, and the staff provides excellent service. I was very impressed. 🍷🎻 …
sample_reviews_en.author: อรพรรณ จันบํารุง

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is amazing! A perfect blend of modern Thai style. Great drinks, good music, comfortable seating, every corner is photogenic, and there are private spots too. If you're looking for a classy hangout spot, I highly recommend it! 💃🏻🍸
sample_reviews_en.author: Sudthida Fern

sample_reviews_en.text: Chill vibes… I love this place so much! I love the atmosphere, the feel, the music 😍 I followed a friend's recommendation and I wasn't disappointed at all. If you like jazz music, you should check it out 🎺🎷 #secretbar #cocktailbar #jazz
sample_reviews_en.author: Cherry Korakod

sample_reviews_en.text: A newly opened jazz bar in the heart of Sukhumvit, Asoke. Easy to get to, the jazz music is very enjoyable. Perfect for sipping wine with friends or your partner. The prices are great, and the atmosphere is warm and classic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ness Nuttagritar

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a jazz bar with a great mood. All the bands are amazing, and there are tons of photo opportunities. If you're looking for a chill and relaxed place to hang out, I highly recommend this place! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: ชุติกาญจน์ แก้วกล้า

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a hidden gem of a bar with a fantastic atmosphere. They have live music in the early hours, and karaoke is available late into the night. I highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: とっぴーToppi

restaurants.name: Sao Cafe Ladprao
restaurants.address:

110, 12 Soi Lat Phrao 18 Yaek 1, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Last visit:
The drinks were great, and the desserts were as delicious as ever.
It's a shame they've removed the roti from the menu 🤔
The desserts were incredibly delicious.
The coffee was good, the Southern Thai tea was strong, and the Taiwanese tea was amazing (even better than the Thai tea). The shop pays attention to customer feedback and has adjusted the strength of the Thai tea. The prices are okay.
-----------------------
First visit:
Things I'd like to see improved: The Southern Thai tea doesn't seem strong enough compared to other branches. It might need a little adjustment.

The coffee is comparable to other branches, meeting standard expectations. It's delicious.

As for the desserts, this branch makes them better and more delicious than other branches. The desserts exceeded my expectations.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thammatep Wongprasert

sample_reviews_en.text:
A new cafe has opened in Soi Ladprao 18.
They have a huge selection of drinks! I was drawn to their rich cocoa, ordered with 50% sweetness, and it tasted great for the price. Next time I'll try 25% sweetness (I prefer it less sweet). I also ordered toast with custard to take home, and it was delicious – not too sweet, very enjoyable.

The matcha latte was also quite rich.
I'll definitely be back!

The atmosphere is nice, with soft background music.
There's parking available next to the cafe.
Meow's Food Review 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Meaw MiUki

sample_reviews_en.text:
- A small, cozy cafe with nice lighting. The air conditioning wasn't very strong. They have a huge menu of desserts, including bingsu.
- The food and drinks taste great. The Indian tea is unique and you can customize the sweetness level. The kaya sauce is excellent, and the garlic rice is delicious. It would be even better with a spicy dipping sauce.
- The service is good, simple, and relaxed.
- Parking is limited.
- Prices are reasonable: drinks 50++ baht, bread 30++ baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chai Chana

sample_reviews_en.text:
This cafe in Soi Ladprao 18 has parking for two cars in front of the shop, or you can park further down the soi. The interior is cutely decorated, and they have a huge selection of desserts and drinks at reasonable prices, friendly to everyone.
Today I tried the toast and roti. The toast was incredibly buttery and fragrant – the best! The roti was crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, perfectly paired with the Ovaltine lava. I highly recommend everyone try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gaw_ SNSD

sample_reviews_en.text: Arrived in the late afternoon 🚗. The braised chicken with shiitake mushrooms was tender and the bones easily separated from the bone 😊. The Thai tea was from Southern Thailand, strong and fragrant 🌸🌺 – so good, a must-order 👍. Finished off with two-colored custard buns 🥰. The bread was warm and fresh, soft, and paired perfectly with the creamy, flavorful custard ✌️. Finally, ordered two more sets to take home 🤣🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: Thawatchai Kassurinchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Best place for brunch and cafe drinks! I love it!

Food is delish and priced well. They have a really nice cafe menu. And your Thai style dishes along with some western times like banana french toast.

Fast wifi, great for working!

Plenty of seating and cool air con inside.  Some outside seating under the shade too.

Cool local cafe in Lad Phrao MRT area! They open at 12pm.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicholas Stark

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I ordered a latte and Thai tea, along with some bread. The drinks are strong and the pastries are delicious. I've ordered matcha tea through Line Man before and it was delicious, so I decided to try it at the shop. The shop is spacious, clean, and the service is good with friendly and cheerful staff. I'll definitely come back to try other menu items.
sample_reviews_en.author: Janjira Koedlaew

sample_reviews_en.text:
Recommended dishes: Roast pork and crispy pork rice, Braised chicken with shiitake mushrooms rice.
Pros: All the food and drinks are delicious and affordable. There's a huge menu.
Cons: For coffee lovers, the selection of coffee here is quite limited, and most of it is of the same style.
sample_reviews_en.author: Grumpy Face GG Map Reviewer

restaurants.name: Pinki's Deli - Ekkamai
restaurants.address:

ห้องเลขที่ 108 ชั้นที่ 1, เลขที่ 7/1 Soi Sukhumvit 63, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered an iced latte in a takeaway cup (incase i needed to leave before i finished my coffee) sat down to have my coffee and halfway through i needed the toilet (came alone so i didn’t want to leave my belongings/coffee unattended) and when i came back the staff (small skinny thai lady, long hair) wouldnt let me sit down at my table, SO MEAN 😭 i still had half of the coffee left in my cup aswell… the cafe had no queues and at the time was only serving 2-3 customers so i thought getting a seat would be ok..Just checked if they served their coffee differently if it was an eat-in order but it was still in plastic cups anyway?  I would’ve totally understood if it was more expensive to eat-in and would happily pay more just to sit aswell 🥲🥲 coffee was good thoughh and the food looked great too 🥲 i’ve experienced this in seoul but thats their culture but I didnt know it was a thing here in bangkok now lol
sample_reviews_en.author: atsu0202

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited this place for a brunch. To summarize the pro's and con's:

Pro's:
1 Sandwhiches are tasty, big portions and lots of different original choices. The drinks are ok.
2 Prices are very reasonable.

Con's:
1  extremely long waiting time
2 wobly table (one leg tables is not a good idea)
3 no sugar for the coffee. Took almost 10 min before we got some syrup.
4 service is very slow and hard to get attention. I think they have good intentions but can not handle the pressure of a full, not well organized , newly opened restaurant.
5 chaotic atmosphere

My personal opinion is that if the "hype" is over, everything will slow down a lot. They need to get the initial flaws out asap and get this place on track. There is potential, but fast action to improve is vital to acquire a good reputation and be successful on the long run.
sample_reviews_en.author: MABKK

sample_reviews_en.text: I like finding places with sourdough bread, and this place offers a bit of a fusion sandwich menu. We wanted a savory ham and cheese sandwich, but the bread was glazed with sugar. It was interesting, though. You should check the menu first. We tried sourdough bread with all the different spreads and liked the mentaiko the best. We ended up having to take some home. It's best to bring a friend to chat with because the food takes quite a while to prepare. The staff are friendly and speak good English. If the restaurant is empty, I recommend avoiding tables under the stairs; it can feel a bit cramped. I ordered the coconut matcha, which was delicious. Next time I'll try other menu items. They offer online delivery anyway I walked in and didn't have to queue for long.
sample_reviews_en.author: bo kapp

sample_reviews_en.text:
Newly opened - be prepared for long queues. We got there at 11:30am and had to wait for an hour to get a table.

Nice simple menu. Sourdough was delicious; sandwiches nicely toasted without being too oily.
The short rib sandwich was a disappointment - the beef had a very heavy meaty/ farm corn beef type of flavor which was off putting. But overall good.

Being newly opened staff are still very inexperienced. Such a busy restaurant but a lot of staff standing around leading to inefficient service. They also got our order wrong and another table next to us. No hate though as they are very friendly and trying their best.

Nice to have another great sandwich joint in BKK along with Bartels, Larder and Holy! 🥪
sample_reviews_en.author: Bernard Cheng

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious sourdough bread with so many flavor options 🤍
Tried the OG sandwich (tuna melt style) today — super generous filling! Chose the multigrain bread and it did not disappoint at all 🥪
The ricotta kale salad was perfectly chopped, easy to eat, with a touch of pecans that paired so well. Super fresh and refreshing 🥗
Even though the place was quite busy, the service was fast and the food came out quickly.
The takeaway order was packaged really well — breathable paper packaging to release heat, and placed in a thermal bag to keep everything warm. ♨️📦 Very impressed ✨
Can’t wait to come back and try other fillings!
sample_reviews_en.author: Athitarn Earsakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pinkis needs to work out their kinkis.

This place is packed full of Thai locals and they are making so much money selling bread and butter! The problem is they don't have any incentive to fix the queue system until they start losing money.

The kind girl told me it was a 30 minute wait but I waited 70 minutes before leaving to get lunch at Bartels.

Bartels never let's ya down. They have amazing sandwiches and always get you sat in a reasonable time frame.

So maybe one day I will order grab from here and see if the hype was worth it, but today I will enjoy a super late lunch somewhere else.
sample_reviews_en.author: Raymond L

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’m very disappointed with my experience here. We originally intended to dine in, but after a frustrating 20-minute wait, we switched to a takeaway order. We were told it would take 20 minutes, but it took another 40. In total, we spent a full hour waiting for our meal.
The bread itself actually tasted good, but unfortunately, the rest of the meal was a letdown. The Caesar salad had a very overpowering smell of anchovy, and the tuna sandwich was far too heavy on the mayonnaise. Compared to the standard of other local sandwich shops, the flavors just weren't there. I won't be returning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fabrice Loux

sample_reviews_en.text: Me and my friend are sourdough lovers. We ordered shroom zoom sandwich and egg&toast. For the sandwich, seems like bread was fried in oil, not toasted with butter so it lacked aroma. The sourdough itself was extremely bland (and oily). The filling was not well seasoned. For the eggs, it was good- cheesy and buttery. The toast was crusted with parmesan so it helped a lot in terms of flavor. We expected every dish on the menu to be good but I guess it's best to order their signature menu because our sandwich experience made it very difficult to agree with the hype on social media...
sample_reviews_en.author: Yee Sirinna

restaurants.name: MAiSEN - Central Embassy
restaurants.address:

Central Embassy 5 floor 546/4 Phloen Chit Rd, Kwaeng Lumpini Khet Pathumwan Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really enjoyed the food, which was high quality and delicious. However, the service was a major disappointment and made the entire meal unenjoyable. The staff were rude and passive-aggressive in how they served and communicated with us. They questioned our choices when ordering in a way that made us feel uncomfortable and even took away our plates before we had finished eating. When we asked them to leave the plate on the table because we were still eating, they responded poorly and acted unprofessionally.

The experience left me feeling frustrated and wondering if we had somehow offended them, even though we were polite and cordial throughout. Dining out should not feel this stressful. The staff barely smiled, and the whole point of going to a tonkatsu place is to enjoy refillable rice, soup, and vegetables. Yet, every time we asked for a refill, it felt like we had to weigh whether it was worth the dirty looks and bad attitude.

I wouldn’t recommend this place. Instead, I would suggest visiting smaller shops in Silom or Phrom Phong, where the service is much friendlier and the dining experience more enjoyable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ekawat T

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the pork fillet cutlet set meal.
The pork fillet cutlet was a mille-feuille-like dish of layered thin slices of pork. Maybe it's just me, but that doesn't seem like tonkatsu to me.
The sauce that came with the cutlet was super sweet and didn't go well with the tonkatsu. The sauce that was provided on the table was also sweet and didn't go well with the tonkatsu.
The batter on the cutlet was thick and fried too hard. It was so hard that it hurt my gums and made them bleed.
I asked for a receipt as I was using it for a company business dinner, but it was an electronic receipt, which meant I had to enter more information, which was very inconvenient.

Conclusion: I will never go again. I don't recommend it either. I had high hopes for this place, so I'm very disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leo Shingha

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mid-August 2026

While in Bangkok, I had a strong craving for Japanese food, so I went to Tonkatsu Maisen at Central Embassy.

It's very conveniently located, right near Phloen Chit Station.

This time, I had the pork loin cutlet curry.

485 baht, approximately 2,400 yen.

The tonkatsu had a crispy coating, and the meat was tender and delicious. It's wonderful to be able to eat Japanese tonkatsu of this quality overseas.

There was plenty of cabbage, and I enjoyed everything right down to the dessert.

My only minor complaint is that the curry could have been a little hotter.

It was around 8 PM, and there were only about two other groups of customers.

I would definitely like to visit again when I crave Japanese food or tonkatsu in Bangkok. Thank you for the meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: kenji y

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch truly elevates the tonkatsu experience above its counterparts. The pork is exquisitely tender, enveloped in a crust that masterfully balances crunchiness with a delicate softness. Every bite is a testament to the kitchen’s finesse. The atmosphere complements the meal beautifully, with its lofty setting and floor-to-ceiling windows offering a serene escape. The staff are notably attentive, enhancing the overall experience. A touch more warmth in their demeanor—a smile here and there—would make it flawless. Nonetheless, this branch stands out as the epitome of what a tonkatsu dining experience should be.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pantit Wiwarint

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stopped by for a meal today.
I came to take shelter from the rain and had dinner because I was worried about traffic.
I tried Maisen at Central Embassy.

The atmosphere is very relaxing.
There's plenty of space between tables, so it's not cramped and you can easily have conversations.
There's a section by the window with a view.
The service was pretty good.

You can order ala carte or a set meal.
It comes with side dishes, rice, soup, and shredded vegetables.
If I remember correctly, the vegetables are free refills.
The dipping sauces are okay, standard.
The Tonkatsu was okay, passed the test.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naszha Pimpawatin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious and met expectations. The set menu was generous in portion size, just the right amount to feel full. What I liked most was the unlimited refills of shredded cabbage. Adding a little dressing made it so refreshing and helped cut through the richness of the main course.

It wasn't crowded the day I went, so I got a good seat with a beautiful window view. It was very comfortable and relaxing. The only minor issue was that the staff weren't very cheerful, but overall it was okay. It's a simple meal I'd probably come back to if I couldn't think of anything else to eat. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Mi

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered takeout Katsu sandwich, appreciate the fact that it was freshly prepared upon order. Though I didn't consume it till about 3 hours later and the Katsu crust is no longer as crispy since it was drenched in the bulldog sauce. I find that the sauce was overly sweet, though the tenderloin meat is still fragrant and savoury, much is covered by the sauce. The Japanese bread was soft and fluffy. A great snack at value, masterfully presented with quality produce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kim Wee Soh

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a nice atmosphere with views of Nailart Park and Aman Residences.
The sauce for the Kurobuta pork is quite sweet.
Although they open at 11:30 for lunch, they let us in 10 minutes early, and the staff were very friendly.
I felt it was slightly inferior to the Kurobuta pork fillet I had at their main branch in Aoyama.
However, I'm grateful to be able to eat tonkatsu overseas.
Keep up the good work.
sample_reviews_en.author: JUN

restaurants.name: Fusion Restaurant Bkk
restaurants.address:

1087, 145 Phetchaburi 31 Alley, Makkasan, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant's atmosphere is fantastic. Every dish was delicious, from the Fusion Greek to the Indian cuisine – excellent in every aspect: taste, portion size, quality, and price. If you want to try something new, I highly recommend it. The flavors are perfectly balanced and not too spicy.

They have a wide selection of drinks, both alcoholic and non-alcoholic, so whether you're coming with your partner or a group of friends, there's something for everyone.

The restaurant has about four floors, including an indoor area that functions as a
coworking space combined with a rooftop bar and restaurant. The atmosphere is great, the view is beautiful, the breeze is cool, the music is nice, and it's a perfect place to chill.

There's very convenient parking available right at the gas station.

I was very impressed with the vibe and the food. I'll definitely be back! ✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Punchanit Piyakosonsuwan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This fusion restaurant offers Greek, Indian, and Thai cuisine, all with delicious flavors. I personally love Indian food, and this place is incredibly rich and perfectly spiced. For those who have never tried Indian food before and want to give it a try, this is a great place. The flavors are intense but not overly so – you're sure to love it! Plus, the portions are surprisingly large for the price.

I think this place is perfect for any occasion: a romantic dinner with your partner, a family meal, or even a late-night hangout with friends after work – they have a huge selection of delicious drinks!

Highly recommend! I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nithita Ekpathomsak

sample_reviews_en.text: This newly opened fusion restaurant lives up to its name, offering Greek, Thai, and Indian cuisine. The food exceeded expectations; portions were large, the taste was excellent, and the prices were very reasonable. Even the Indian dishes were easy to eat. The atmosphere is great, with a cool breeze and city views – perfect for relaxing after work. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kulin Kakaew

sample_reviews_en.text: A great rooftop restaurant near Pratunam with a beautiful atmosphere and affordable prices. The menu offers a variety of Indian, Greek, and Thai dishes, and the portions are big and definitely worth it. There’s also live music that makes the dining experience even more enjoyable. Perfect spot to relax, eat well, and enjoy the view.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rodcharek C.

sample_reviews_en.text: This place has a great atmosphere. It's both a restaurant and a hangout spot in the middle of the city. The ground floor is a coworking space where many international students come to work in a relaxed setting. The upper floor is a rooftop bar with city views, a cool breeze, and pleasant music—perfect for unwinding after work.
sample_reviews_en.author: T. Piromsuwan

sample_reviews_en.text:
A rooftop in the city center with beautiful views, a nice breeze, and great music.
The Greek • Thai • Indian fusion food exceeded expectations.

The downstairs area is great for working.
The upstairs area is perfect for chilling out.

Most importantly…the prices are very reasonable!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wannaporn Phengbubpha

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! Every dish was fragrant with spices, and the portions were generous for the price. The scallops were huge! The restaurant had a nice atmosphere with background music, and the staff were lovely, attentive, and always ready to assist with anything we needed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prodpran Charis Suranaowarat

sample_reviews_en.text:
A fusion restaurant with a fantastic rooftop atmosphere.
The fusion food tastes great for Thai people; you have to try it.
Every corner upstairs is perfect for taking photos. I recommend going at sunset; it's not too hot and the sky is beautiful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuttakitta B

restaurants.name: SUSHi EXPRESS@Esplanade Ratchadaphisek
restaurants.address:

Esplanade, B1 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We asked for our plates to be counted before the table next to us... but
Staff member 1 went to process another customer's payment.
Staff member 2 came to count the plates for the table next to us before us.
...Finally, staff members 1 and 2 finished their work and completely forgot about us. Even after the table next to us had already counted their plates, paid, and left, no staff member came to count our plates. We had to stand up and ask. Only then did staff member 1 remember that we had asked them to count our plates a long time ago.
In the end, they didn't apologize, didn't feel guilty, or didn't even think they were wrong.
But from a customer's perspective, cutting in line, maintaining order, or if it's inconvenient, calling for someone available instead of ignoring and forgetting about customers, letting the first customer wait while those later are served first, is just terrible. Terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: PANDA PANDA

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'd like to commend all the staff at the restaurant! The service was excellent, I was extremely impressed! I usually eat at the restaurant often, but lately I haven't been able to go as often, so I ordered through Grab instead. The food was still as delicious as if I were eating at the restaurant, and when there was a problem with the food, the staff helped resolve it quickly and were very attentive. Thank you for the outstanding service!

P.S. This time I ordered takeout from the restaurant, so I don't have pictures of the food 🥰🥰🥰 But I can confirm that the sushi is delicious and all the staff are lovely!
sample_reviews_en.author: praphavarin tml

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was my first time eating there. I didn't know you could just walk in and sit down, so I went to wait in line at the counter. I stood there for a long time. The staff saw me, but they didn't talk to me or call me to sit down. I waited for ages until a male staff member in a red shirt came to serve me. He was polite and provided good service. The other staff members just made eye contact with me and were indifferent, not welcoming at all.
The food was okay. The fish looked fresh and wasn't fishy, ​​except for the salmon udon, which had far too few noodles compared to the reviews.
sample_reviews_en.author: li il

sample_reviews_en.text: Located on the B floor of Esplanade Ratchada mall, this open-plan restaurant offers easy access and isn't crowded, making it a good option for those who don't want to wait in long lines at popular spots. Seating is counter bar style, with sushi rotating on a conveyor belt. Prices start at 30, 40, and 60 baht. Hot tea is available. The ingredients are reasonably fresh, but some of the rice is very dry, as if it had been prepared a while ago. Overall, the taste is good, but those looking for a filling meal will likely pay a hefty sum.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffey

sample_reviews_en.text:
This small restaurant has prices of 30, 40, and 60 baht. Two people ate here and the bill came to over 700 baht 😂😂 The salmon roll with spicy dressing was delicious. Hot tea is free, and the pickled ginger is grabbed from the conveyor belt, so you have to be quick!
(Parking at Esplanade is free for 3 hours for purchases over 500 baht - information as of October 2025)
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaa Worajaa

sample_reviews_en.text:
The conveyor belt sushi offers a wide variety of choices, but several items were sold out on the day I visited. The chefs prepare everything fresh, so you can watch them cook while you eat.
The taste, quality, and price are reasonable. The wasabi is fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: Simarak ก้อย

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, worth every bite. Some items are better than famous sushi restaurants.
My second visit wasn't as impressive. There was hardly any food on the conveyor belt, and the signature dishes took a long time to arrive.
sample_reviews_en.author: surasak sawadee

sample_reviews_en.text: This conveyor belt sushi restaurant offers affordable prices, categorized by plate color: 30, 40, and 60 baht. The rice might not be the best quality as it's machine-made, but the staff provides good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nichanat Yamassatien

restaurants.name: Deja Brew Lifestyle Cafe
restaurants.address:

78 Prachathipatai Rd, Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to this restaurant thinking I would be impressed, but the reality was terrible. The discrimination, the service, the staff's facial expressions – the difference was clearly visible. Every action seemed designed to ruin the positive feelings of others. If you don't like it, why work there? It's awful. I've never felt that after paying for a meal, the people receiving the money would treat me like this.
1. Discrimination clearly involves judging people based on their appearance
2. Upon arrival, there were no staff members to assist me; I had to try and ask for things myself
3. The table seemed flimsy; while eating, I had to keep an eye on it to see why it was wobbly
4. It depends on the day. If you meet a good person, you're lucky. But in my experience, I haven't met a single one
5. In conclusion, I will never use this place again. The staff are not kind at all. I hope you all encounter people who treat you that way. Absolutely terrible
sample_reviews_en.author: Wu_JuJu

sample_reviews_en.text: The place was clean and had a calm atmosphere, but the food quality was at the level of very basic, local restaurants. The photos on the menu did not match the actual dishes at all. The quality of the meat was extremely poor — I’m quite certain it wasn’t real meat but a processed product. I asked several times if it was 100% real meat, and they said yes, but the taste clearly showed it was processed. I ordered beef but the meat was white like a pork I’m sure it wasn’t beef. You are cheating. Even the dessert looked completely different from the one shown in the photos. Unfortunately, this feels more like deceiving customers than offering an honest dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Reza Mafiha

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was so good I just had to review it! I'm usually too lazy to review things!!!!
But this restaurant is the best. The service was amazing. I've been to more expensive restaurants, but the service wasn't as excellent. Plus, they had a buffet promotion for two people at 790 baht, which was incredibly worth it because the food was served dish by dish. And it happened to be my boyfriend's birthday, so the restaurant added extra services like dessert and sang a birthday song – I was so impressed! 🥹❤️✨💕 I'll definitely go again. I highly recommend it; it's very healing because the staff are so attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanyapat Sumalee

sample_reviews_en.text: The buffet is 1290 baht per person, using a buy-one-get-one-free promotion. The atmosphere is nice, the restaurant is beautifully decorated, and it wasn't very crowded. Initially, the food came out quickly, but after an hour, you might need to follow up on your order a bit. Overall, the staff were attentive. The food has a moderate flavor profile that foreigners can enjoy. The Thai dishes were on the milder side, not as flavorful as we're used to. I recommend the fried dishes, especially the French fries, which were perfectly fried.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mintnie Moo

sample_reviews_en.text: The food arrived cold. The fried items were a bit chewy. I wasn't very impressed, but the buy 2 get 1 free promotion made it worth the price. The desserts were delicious, I liked the one with banana. The staff at OMO were so nice! I was waiting for my friend before the scheduled time and they let me order mocktails while I waited.🥺💗 I might go back again if I have some free time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khemmanut Suwanasilp

sample_reviews_en.text: I booked the Happy Set 799 for two people on Hungry Hub. It was the perfect amount of food, delicious and flavorful. We came today to celebrate my boyfriend's birthday, and the restaurant surprised him with a delicious dessert! The staff, including Omo, Nun, and another male employee, provided excellent and friendly service. We were very impressed! 💗
sample_reviews_en.author: Gunyanut K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came during a promotion: 2 people for the price of 1, and children were half price. Orders were placed by scanning QR codes on the table, and we had 2 hours to eat.
We were celebrating a birthday with 7 people, and the restaurant gave us free Honey Toast.
Most of the food was delicious, the portions were small but served on large plates.
sample_reviews_en.author: นิยดา เลี้ยงวงษ์

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish was delicious. The bill for two people was 790 baht, which was great value. I highly recommend it and will definitely go back. You have to book through Hungry Hub. We came for our 3rd anniversary and the restaurant had a surprise for us, which was exciting and very grateful.
sample_reviews_en.author: นักชิมอาหาร

restaurants.name: ครัวชฎา
restaurants.address:

The Old Siam Plaza, 6/25 ห้องC308 ชั้น 3 Wang Burapha Phirom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Krua Shada (ครัวชฎา)
A hidden gem on the 3rd floor of Old Siam Plaza . this place serves authentic, old-school Thai food that truly hits the spot. If you’re looking for the real taste of traditional Thai cuisine, I highly recommend giving it a try. I stumbled upon it by chance and will definitely be coming back for more.
sample_reviews_th.author: vutikiat Tua

sample_reviews_th.text:
I ordered padthai for 120฿ with less bean sprouts. I got 4 shims.
It tastes perfect.
sample_reviews_th.author: Red Rose

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a very old restaurant. The food is delicious, the ingredients are good, and it's served quickly. The staff are attentive and provide good service. The fried rice with fermented pork sausage was excellent; the rice grains were perfectly separated, the sausage was well-mixed and flavorful. The spicy curry with snails and the red curry with catfish were both delicious, with a fragrant and flavorful curry paste that wasn't too spicy. The garlic fried shrimp was fresh and tasty. I saw the table next to us order the stir-fried sea bass with chili and salt, and it looked amazing. I will definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: N X

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! The portions were generous and the price was good, with tons of Tom Yum soup base! I loved it!! This mall was almost entirely frequented by locals. Although it's tucked away in a small corner on the third floor of Old Siam Square, it's a great place to come after exchanging money on the first floor! I recommend it if you're here and don't know what to eat or don't want to eat at the street stalls downstairs!
sample_reviews_en.author: Renee Liang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Thai food, no frills, just real Thai flavors. Tucked away in the corner of The Old Siam's third floor, this restaurant is the epitome of the kind of delicious food you will find in a traditional Thai household with a grandma who cooks really well.

The pork nam-tok, pla kang fish with seafood sauce and nam neung are really good. I've never had anything I did not like here anyway. Love this place
sample_reviews_en.author: Somebody Hangry

sample_reviews_en.text: On July 4th, I took six friends to eat here. We'd been here before and loved it, but today was disappointing; it wasn't the same. This is constructive criticism. We ordered the braised pork with liver, and the meat was tough and had a fishy smell – it wasn't like it used to be. The other dishes were acceptable. I hope they've improved it to what it used to be. I'm not sure if they changed chefs or not.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mam IU

sample_reviews_en.text: Many Thai dishes are delicious, and the prices are average. The food comes out quickly, but the smell lingers in the restaurant quite a bit; I sneezed several times. The snakehead fish dishes are delicious, especially the fried fish cakes. I recommend the herbal snakehead fish, sour curry, papaya salad, and fried rice. The fried shrimp cakes were just okay. The Pad Thai was a bit soggy.
sample_reviews_en.author: C Wana

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here. The food was delicious, the music was great, and the atmosphere was warm. It's a hidden gem on the 3rd floor of The Old Siam, next to the barbershop. It's perfect for families. The food was delicious and …
sample_reviews_en.author: Annita socool

restaurants.name: เจ๊หมวยโจ๊กโคลิเซียม
restaurants.address:

806, 34 Rama VI Rd, Thung Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered several items through Grab, but they didn't include all the sauces and soup. When I called the restaurant to report it, they just said it was impossible and hung up.
The incomplete order is one thing, but their manners and customer service were terrible.

Regarding the food:
- Chinese sausage: Delicious
- Crispy pork: Okay, acceptable
- Rice: Loose, separate grains, probably cheap rice.

Crispy pork rice (ordered via Grab): 80 THB
sample_reviews_en.author: ลําเจียก เองจ่ะ

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've driven past many times and seen the crispy pork hanging there, it looked so delicious. So today I made a point to go early in the morning. I ordered pork blood soup with plain rice and roasted pork with rice.
The pork blood soup had just small pieces of pork blood, like the edges had been cut off. The broth was bad, the crispy pork wasn't crispy, and the rice was extremely hard.
The roasted pork with rice wasn't tasty at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: หญิง Ying

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the prices are standard. I've eaten here many times before, but today the staff wasn't very pleasant. They looked unwelcoming, spoke rudely, and didn't smile. If they're tired, they should rest; they shouldn't be working here. I paid money to eat here, and I was a little disappointed. If it weren't for the fact that the food tastes so good, I wouldn't want to eat here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: saibarry

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is quite tasty. The crispy pork as the name suggests has really crispy skin and juicy thick meat👍the red pork meat(char siew) is very lean and it comes with a sweet red sauce. The noodles are really chewy too( taste like pad Thai noodles). The service is really great, she explains well in English too! Overall, good food good service ☺️ most of the food prices are around 60 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sim Sok Jim

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. We ordered roasted pork rice and asked for crispy pork instead because we saw the table next to us eating it, but the staff said they didn't have it. Roasted pork is roasted pork. Another staff member even laughed and went to say something to the dishwasher while staring at us. We stared back and were extremely displeased by their behavior.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุภัสสร อยู่สุขสวัสดิ์

sample_reviews_en.text: If I'm passing by, I always stop for pork blood soup. Sipping it hot late at night is so comforting. No need to add anything, just a little pepper and it's delicious. The staff are also very friendly and nice. 😄😄😄👍👍👍 …
sample_reviews_en.author: สัญชัย จันทร์เต็ม

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're looking for a satisfying meal with standard-tasting dishes like roasted pork, crispy pork, pork blood soup, or congee, you can stop by. They have a wide variety of menu options to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: แมลงตัวหนึ่ง

sample_reviews_en.text: Oh my god, this restaurant is absolutely delicious and cheap! We've been here every day since we came to Bangkok! I wouldn't be surprised if they ever have a Michelin-starred restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Logos CHEN

restaurants.name: Tom Guesthouse & RESTAU CAFE
restaurants.address:

21 8 Ngam Duphli Alley, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I booked this hotel just as a back up due to issues with travel plans. I meet tom. She was very friendly. I ate the food at the restaurant and some of it was amazing. Also compared to where I am staying now it's half the price. I am thinking of ordering food there and bringing it my condo. The rooms are basic but they work for budget traveling. No bugs. Comfortable bed. Wifi worked. Bolt has an issue with the address. 21 ngam duphli alley is what it understands for an exact match.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tony Schiavone

sample_reviews_en.text: Small hostel in the center of BKK. Very friendly and smiling staff. Tasty food and good coffee. A few minutes from 7eleven, pharmacy, massage and shopping center. Also a short walk from the metro. The rooms are up really high stairs, the rooms have no windows and the air conditioning stopped cooling us on the last day. But overall, there is nothing to complain about considering the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jarkka Nytrová

sample_reviews_en.text: Unfortunately, we weren't very happy with our room. There were other people's hairs in the shower, stains on the showerhead, and the room wasn't very clean overall. We slept on the top floor, where the Wi-Fi didn't work. However, for the price and for one night, it was okay. The staff was friendly, and the food in the restaurant was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jule

sample_reviews_en.text: I really want to review this place. I stayed 4 nights with my sister and it was a fantastic stay. The staff helped with our luggages also. The location is also good. The safety and security is also great. Everything was sooooo good. Definitely I will stay again here If I travel to Bangkok again. Thank you !!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ama Wanninayaka

sample_reviews_en.text: I can't believe we found this place the last day in Bangkok. But this is the big town, every corner a surprise. Best thai food we had in 30 days holiday. Best (brand new) room too. So happy for the service, so sad we had to leave. This place is in the middle of chaotic streets, no place for silence.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fabio Branca

sample_reviews_en.text: Stayed in room above. Friendly staff but no one could operate the tv. No toiletries. No soap, No shampoo. Staff did know how to operate tv even asking all of them everyday for the duration of my stay. Room not made up. Fresh drinking water only given on first day. Not sound proof like advertised .
sample_reviews_en.author: Clifford Simpson

sample_reviews_en.text: Thank you to the hotel staff for waiting for me until almost 11 pm before I checked in. However, I had other things to do and didn't have time to sit down and eat on the first floor. I also had to catch my flight and checked out early. I hope I'll have the opportunity to stay here again next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Trip.com Member

sample_reviews_en.text: Reviewing the restaurant only. You can definitely get better options for the price. Portions are generally small and poor looking and serving of the dishes is completely random (one person finishes theirs before the other person gets served). And they disappointingly ran out of coconuts.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kasia Klaczynska

restaurants.name: สำรับยายหลาน
restaurants.address:

2 Tarnsumrid 12/1 Alley, Tambon Bang Kraso, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant has a very homey feel. A young lady greets guests, and the reception area reminds me of a Scandinavian home, complete with a secret attic room.
The food is delicious, beautifully prepared dish by dish, and made with high-quality ingredients—you won't be disappointed. The entire restaurant only has one table occupied, so I recommend calling to reserve a table and choosing your menu in advance.
sample_reviews_en.author: JiRa W.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant has a homey style, like eating at home – warm and comfortable.
The overall taste of the food is like eating at a friend's house, where their mom cooks delicious food, plus the atmosphere makes for a great meal.
The food came out steadily, not as slow as the owner worried. I recommend it for large groups of friends or families who want to eat in a private space and a relaxed atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: ArMz Wongpet

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a very cute and cozy shop, perfect for families or groups of friends to get together. The owners, a family of three (parents cook and daughter help serve), run the place themselves. It has a very homey feel.

The food is truly delicious. The sweet corn with longan is excellent. They also have amazing homemade craft soda that I bought several bottles to take home. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: soso moment

sample_reviews_en.text:
We are group of families and kids. This place is perfect for private party or hanging out. Kids have space to play, a lot of toys also Nong’Namoun kindly taking care of the kids.

Foods wise very tasty and traditional. Some dish is very rare to find in general. Foods served hot and colorful.

Overall we have very nice experience here. We will back again for sure. Must try!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Vilaipan Santarwong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nong Nam-Aun, the receptionist, is very cheerful and adorable.
The homemade food is fresh, delicious, and flavorful in every dish, both savory and sweet.
I especially liked the stir-fried Gnetum leaves with crab meat and egg.

Reservations are required in advance. They only accept one table per sitting, with lunch and dinner seating for 4-14 people.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tar Sujittra Nimvijit

sample_reviews_en.text: The coffee shop has a cozy atmosphere, like eating at home. Auntie Tuk's waterfall pork noodle soup is delicious and doesn't need any extra seasoning. Her youngest son, Thiw, is a top chef who can prepare any dish to order, all equally delicious. Importantly, the portions are generous and the prices are very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponganun P

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, I ordered savory and sweet bento boxes for a merit-making lunch at the Buddhist Hospital, along with flowers, incense, and candles for offerings. The shop handled everything from providing recommendations to preparing the food and arranging delivery. Everything went smoothly and was very reliable and on time. :)
sample_reviews_en.author: note tangtrakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, fresh, and made with carefully selected, high-quality ingredients. Every dish is excellent. The owner is friendly, lovely, and in a great mood, making you feel like you're eating at a friend's house.

I've been here many times and I'm hooked. It's one of my favorite places!
sample_reviews_en.author: anyapatch sattayaphan

restaurants.name: Thai Restaurant
restaurants.address:

1756 Sukhumvit Rd, Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
There are several food stalls lined up here, but the fried rice stall was the best.
It's the best fried rice I've ever had.
I tried three kinds: crispy pork, chicken, and shrimp.
I think they were around 55 to 70 baht each.
Personally, I recommend chicken, crispy pork, and then shrimp.
I was happy that the fried rice contained vegetables like carrots, onions, and spinach.
It paired perfectly with lime.
You can also add pepper from the table to your liking.
The staff were very kind and could communicate in English.
The system is that you order first, wait at your table, and pick up your order when called.
Payment is made after the meal.
There's a roof, so it's safe even if it rains.
sample_reviews_en.author: 磯野鰹

sample_reviews_en.text:
We visited this restaurant, which offers a great selection of dishes, including rice, eggs, instant noodles, and a variety of meats like pork, chicken, and shredded duck. They also sell Thai coffee and milk tea at very reasonable prices with huge portions. We had lunch here, just look at my bowl! The taste is consistently delicious, and I absolutely love it. I’m so glad I accidentally stumbled upon this place!

One bad thing, it’s really hot in here - without any fan.
sample_reviews_en.author: LP

sample_reviews_en.text:
On Nut mornings, when it's hard to find a local place to sit down and eat, this outdoor food court is a real find.

They have a variety of Thai dishes on the menu, and many Thais were stopping by – some eating on their way to work, others taking food to the office.

I chose three dishes from a Khao Gaeng (rice curry) stall and had them with white rice; it was cheap and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: nobu

sample_reviews_en.text: There are a few Thai food stands in this mini food court. This review is for the stand in my photo. Good fresh stir fry, quickly prepared and served. The dish I ordered was shrimp stir fried in curry paste for 60 thb. Portion size was medium. Some other dishes are cheaper. Enough tables to serve the number of customers here. Overall a good place for a quick inexpensive lunch.
sample_reviews_en.author: John K

sample_reviews_en.text: Very friendly staff and multiple food stalls to choose from. Nice authentic vibe as lots of locals eating there and very cheap!! Obviously depends on which place you go to but the ones me and my friends tried were very yummy and they cooperated well with my gluten free friend, accounting to her needs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Claudia Levy

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a collection of small shops selling Thai local food. They have most of the classic Thai dishes. It's open-air, so it can get hot, but all the shops are reasonably priced and delicious. Peak hours are lunchtime, and they close in the evening. Recommended for those tired of the Lotus food court.
sample_reviews_en.author: HARU YAMA

sample_reviews_en.text: There are many food options to choose from, the prices are very cheap, and the food is delicious. The owners of each restaurant are kind and friendly, making you feel like you're eating at home with family. It looks like it might be hot, but it's not; there's a nice cool breeze. Overall, it's great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suruchratha - Ch

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're looking for cheap and OK, Thai food. Place is simple, with outdoor seating. Prices are pocket friendly. Food is decent and simple. Inside the parking area of Burger King, lots of other small restaurants as well as coffee and juice, smoothies shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: S G

restaurants.name: ลาบเป็ดนครพนม
restaurants.address:

8 Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
First time here. The food portions are huge, the prices are affordable, and it's delicious!
- Stir-fried minced beef: I ordered it slightly bitter, and the taste was amazing! It reminded me of home while eating it, haha.
- Grilled beef: Perfectly grilled, but a little chewy, maybe because of my braces. But it was delicious, and the dipping sauce was spicy.
- Papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce: 2 chilies, oh my god, it was so flavorful!
- Corn salad: So refreshing while eating! I was surprised by how refreshing it was. The cold corn combined with the fermented fish sauce was so delicious.
- Mixed seafood salad: So much food! I was shocked by the amount for the price. The ingredients were real, not skimpy.
- The prices are very reasonable. Highly recommend trying it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayanisa. N

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very typical Isaan street food place. It doesn’t get more Isaan than this! The shop itself is tiny but they cater a dozen of tables on both sides of the Soi. I assume they are family.

They serve all Isaan classics: Som Tum, Laab, spicy salads, grilled meats, spicy soups and fish. I had Tom Saeb. The soup was great. Very tasty. The pork ribs were a bit too fat for taste. The grilled beef was good and the nam jim jeaw even better. On top of that they make a good spicy fried egg salat (yaam kaai dao). Three dishes came down to 220 Baht - great! Beers are very cheap as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant's papaya salad with fermented fish is designed to be sour and salty, making it easy to eat without feeling sticky. The grilled meat is also delicious, not tough, but soft enough to chew. As for the fried koi, I'm not sure if it's a special recipe from Nakhon Phanom. I've never eaten it at any other restaurant. It's made so dry and dark in color. The taste is strange but deliciously smooth. It feels like eating truffles, lol. You have to come and try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sawanya Boonrawd

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a casual, home-style restaurant with seating across the street. They serve delicious duck larb, grilled pork neck with spicy dipping sauce, papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce, boiled cockles with seafood dipping sauce, grilled beef in spicy sauce, and grilled intestines. They have a wide variety of Northeastern Thai dishes perfect as appetizers. Takeout is also available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sombat 24

sample_reviews_en.text:
2024: Small street food shop next to a 7-Eleven with chairs and tables on the street.

The food was very delicious, the sauces super balanced and the prices very fair.

Menu was in English and Thai, you have to write down your order by yourself on a Thai only sheet but a well English speaking staff helped us.

Update 2025: quality and taste still very good and politeness top.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mo

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time trying Thai-style hot pot here. It included Chinese cabbage, bok choy, mushrooms, basil, glass noodles, eggs, generous portions of sliced ​​meat and pork liver, and a delicious broth. They also had tasty grilled fish... Other dishes were available, making it a perfect roadside dinner for the cooler seasons...
sample_reviews_en.author: 曹慧如

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely delicious!
The grilled beef is juicy and tender, simply amazing!
The fried egg salad is tasty.
The papaya salad is made to your exact specifications.
The pork neck is tender and fragrant.
The grilled tilapia is huge and the meat is firm and fluffy.

I'll tell you what's good is good! Come on over!
sample_reviews_en.author: Apinya N.

sample_reviews_en.text: The grilled beef was 100 baht per plate and absolutely delicious. The spicy soup was also very good. The papaya salad with rice noodles was incredibly tasty. We ordered all the dishes with less spice, and the spiciness level was perfect for us.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sineenath Nacharoen

restaurants.name: Matsaya
restaurants.address:

Town Hall, Sukhumvit 49, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I reserved a table on a whim; I was looking for a seafood restaurant but this one did not appear on Maps when searching for seafood which is surprising as that is exactly what they do.

They greet you upon entering and the overall service is fantastic.

The squid in squid-ink had a delectable seafood flavour to it. Very unique.
The tiger prawns were large and juicy, and the ซุปส้ม it came in was (surprisingly) very spicy! But, as someone who enjoys spicy foods quite a lot - it was very positive.

Overall, I was very pleasantly surprised with the qualify of the food; I think you're looking for a seafood experience in a more fine-dining kind of setting - I would absolutely recommend it. The menu is nicely segmented in a way that would let each person at the table order something different, but within the same categories and that way you can sample and try all the various (delicious) foods they have on offer.

Definitely recommended.
sample_reviews_th.author: Robin Nygård

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in Town Hall 49. Park in the building and go down to the 1st floor. Walk through the Marriott apartment building to the other side. I was a bit confused looking for it 😂
We liked some of the food here. We thought the mixed shrimp salad was delicious 🦐, very enjoyable. The crab curry was okay but a little too spicy 🦀. The fish larb had a strange taste. We were indifferent to the Choo Chee curry. For dessert, we liked the sour orange drink, it was refreshing 🍊. The staff were lovely, attentive and caring, helping to collect umbrellas and offering to take photos for us. The prices are as shown in the picture, typical Sukhumvit rates.
We came here for a friend's birthday and the restaurant offered a dessert not on the menu. It was delicious, we loved it and finished it all. It was like a coconut custard 🥥.
The cocktails here are quite strong. I recommend trying the tamarind cocktail. We were indifferent to the Thai tea. The restaurant stamped our parking for 3 hours.
The ceiling inside the restaurant is beautiful, the lighting isn't dim, it's great for taking photos. But I didn't like the wooden chairs, they hurt my butt, so I had to ask to sit on the sofa.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyawat Jirapatwong

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Thai seafood is incredibly premium and absolutely amazing. The taste is surprisingly delicious, and the price is great. The ingredients are fresh and of exceptional quality, exceeding expectations. They are all perfectly cooked, and the flavors are unlike anything I've ever tasted in Thailand; even the sour curry is unlike any I've ever had in my life. It's incredibly delicious! 😭
The food was amazing, but the desserts were also exceptional. I ordered desserts from Matsaya, and they were beyond delicious. I loved them so much!
sample_reviews_en.author: Peeraya S

sample_reviews_en.text:
The daily special is the shellfish.
The dressing is too strong; the mixed vegetable salad has conflicting flavors that don't blend well.
The shellfish itself is good.

The tofu is just average. Even though it's from Khlong Ngae, it's not exceptionally delicious. They should use their own unique tofu recipe.

The grilled fish and mushroom salad are delicious. The rice is also very good.

P.S. When the staff asks for your drink, they mean they're bringing the bill.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vanaa

sample_reviews_en.text:
OMG.. what a place that redefines seafood! Went on a Monday night, so we were the only "VIPs" in the restaurant, the maitre'D greeted and usher us to our seats.
Decor of the restaurant is on point, table service was carried out professionally and promptly.
The food...oh my...the food was just amazing! Balanced, interesting flavours and presentation were all 👍👍.
If you're coming to BKK and love seafood, don't miss out Matsaya!
sample_reviews_en.author: Adam Han

sample_reviews_en.text:
Probably my fav meal in Bangkok, if you love seafood defo come here. Was pretty quiet and chill vibes and staff are nice. The curry was proper spicy 🔥 and good meat portions.

My main feedback would be possibly to improve signage. I nearly missed it and went away. The restaurant isnt exactly where marked on Google and I couldn't find any signs pointing to Matsaya. But in the end found it
sample_reviews_en.author: Jake

sample_reviews_en.text: I recently had the opportunity to dine at a new restaurant, Matsaya, a newly opened Thai restaurant that focuses on fresh seafood ingredients. The food was delicious. I recommend the spicy seafood salad and the grilled Japanese banana fish; they were excellent. I'll definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: TonTasteory

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the greatest Thai restaurant in Sukhumvit area. Better than R-haan. The fish is very fresh, alot of japanese and korean guest. THE COCKTAIL!!!!!! the cocktail is also fabulous.

Cheap pricing compared to the location and feel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chinawat Eakarinmaekdarala

restaurants.name: Momo Samsen
restaurants.address:

Ban Phan Thom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been in Bangkok for 3 days now, and this is a delicious and authentic Thai restaurant that I stumbled upon while strolling along Koh San Road! The food, service, and atmosphere were all amazing. If you're tired of typical street food and want to escape the hustle and bustle of Koh San Road to enjoy high-quality, affordable Thai cuisine, I highly recommend Momo Samson. I'll definitely make a special trip back next time!
sample_reviews_en.author: 彥蕙

sample_reviews_en.text: An excellent place to savor local Thai dishes—everything is exquisite! I'm vegetarian and had plenty of options. Everything was delicious: the pad thai, clear tofu soup, tom yum, and mango sticky rice. We went every day for our set lunch! The staff is also very friendly and attentive. Thank you so much! When I return to Thailand, I will definitely come back to this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tati Zambrano

sample_reviews_en.text:
After traveling around for 3 weeks, it's almost time to go home. I ate here and it wasn't bad, but it lacked flavor. I ordered two of the usual Thai dishes with rice. Fortunately, there were spices on the table to at least give it some flavor. I didn't try the Indian dishes; maybe they are more flavorful.

The service was quick and friendly, though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marco L.

sample_reviews_en.text: The best food we've ever had in Bangkok. The place is run by two young women, very well-kept, clean, and reasonably priced. We ordered pad Thai with chicken and pork, papaya salad, and mango sticky rice – very large portions and the tastiest we've had in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamil z

sample_reviews_en.text: I was here two days in a row. The food was amazing. I ordered the red and the green curry and the mango sticky rice. All dishes were so delicious! And the service is although very good. They are very kind and attentive. I can highly recommend this restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chiara Schael

sample_reviews_en.text:
A very nice restaurant near Khaosan Road in Bangkok. Located on a side street, it's very quiet and relaxed.

The service was excellent.

The food was delicious, and we didn't have to wait long.

The prices were reasonable.

We would definitely come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Hendrik Becker

sample_reviews_en.text: Food is tasty and affordable. Vegan options available. 5 stars for friendly service - the server gave our toddler toys to play with and he enjoyed playing with the staff. They had a high chair available but we didn't need it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mich I

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wish we’d known about this place sooner!
Absolutely gorgeous food, in a perfect location with really friendly staff. Food is really reasonably priced and the quality is unreal!
Highly recommend visiting here
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
sample_reviews_en.author: Sophie Harlow

restaurants.name: ZURU Contemporary Japanese Flavors สาขา เย็นอากาศ
restaurants.address:

ซอย นางลิ้นจี่ 3 แขวง ช่องนนทรี เขต ยานนาวา ช่องนนทรี ยานนาวา Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited this restaurant today and unfortunately had a rather disappointing experience.

The fried pork with cheese in my set meal had an unusual sour taste and a slight off smell. I'm not sure if this is intentional as part of the recipe, or if there was an issue with the quality of the pork.

The complimentary salad came with far too much dressing. It was so salty that I had to shake the excess dressing off the vegetables before I could eat them. There was still a large amount of dressing left at the bottom of the bowl afterward.

The yakisoba was also heavily over-seasoned. It was extremely salty and overly sour, which overpowered the other flavors.

The sushi rice was packed much too tightly, making the texture dense and less enjoyable. It felt like the chef may still need more experience in preparing sushi rice.

On a positive note, I really enjoyed the complimentary soup and the teriyaki chicken rice bowl. Those were the highlights of the meal.

I hope the restaurant takes this feedback constructively and improves the consistency and quality of its food, as it has the potential to offer a much better dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Elder Jul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was decent, tasty, and the fish was fresh. The atmosphere was nice, quiet, and peaceful.

However, I'm giving it two stars because we didn't receive the membership discount as the staff had told us. We signed up for the birthday discount (ordering food to qualify for membership). We asked the staff more than once if the discount was applicable immediately and if it was valid today, but in reality, it wasn't.

The staff didn't inform us from the start that the membership discount couldn't be used with the promotional set meals, even though we ordered the promotional set before signing up for membership.

The issue isn't the price; the full price is still considered cheap, as the set meal already offers a discount.

I would have understood and been more satisfied with the restaurant if the staff had informed us from the beginning that the membership discount couldn't be used with the promotional set meals. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chont Taksinawet

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of a good choice for Japanese foods around this area. Foods taste are ok but relatively high price.

Down side is the shop is too small. The staffs direct me to the small table for 2 people which is too small and that limit our order. Their staffs faces on welcoming were not too welcome and does not care much at first. Later on, other 2 persons comes in they offer large table. What da..... unluckily, in the next morning after this dinner around 7-8pm, i have to get up early for the toilet but I do not want to pin point that it is because of this place as it might be from other factors as the other person joining the meal was ok.
===
Recently gave a chance to this place again in Aug/2024:

Services remain the same standard; the matters to talk among service staffs are more important than taking care and be ready to reaponsive to customer's actions/needed
sample_reviews_en.author: Antonio Oattono

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fusion Japanese Restaurant at Soi Yen Ar-Kard that has been opened for a long time (since before COVID) The price is not cheap but tempura, one of their recommended dishes are quite good.

The menu are la-carte mostly (except some promotional set) so you must order rice and drink separately.

Staff are rather passive so keep asking for benefit or promotion before making an order.

Vibes of the restaurant are contemporary: the lighting is well-lit in warm tone all day and you can hear variety of background music from classical to j-pop (re-arranged to be instrumental)
sample_reviews_en.author: Surasak Watthanayontkit

sample_reviews_en.text: Very special Japanese food in my opinion. They really paying attention into doing the dishes. I love the bamboo rice. I feel like a home cooked food. The price is reasonable May be High on some dishes. I love the desert sweet potato with honey. Lastly they could improve on Servicing since I always see new faces of waitress.
sample_reviews_en.author: Taap Poudpongpaiboon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Nice Japanese restaurant. You can get a good quality Japanese meal here. There are sushi available from Japan, Norway & Australia. Most budget Japanese restaurants serve Sushi from Norway. A bit on the sweet side in regards to sauces so order sauce on the side and add by yourself. Give it a go!

Back again. Still yummy 🤤
sample_reviews_en.author: Henry Harrison

sample_reviews_en.text: Pretty decent temporary Japanese restaurant offering lots of authentic Japanese food.  Plenty of sushi and sashimi choices, fish is fresh and in high quality.  Price is reasonable. I wasn't impressed with the wagyu beef though.  Not a very good quality.  So skip beef and enjoy the rest of the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Miso

sample_reviews_en.text: ​"The Salmon Saikyo Sushi here is a must-try! The salmon was incredibly fresh, but the star was the Saikyo miso sauce. It has that perfect balance of sweet and savory, and the way they lightly torched it gave it an amazing smoky aroma that melts in your mouth. Highly recommended for salmon lovers!"
sample_reviews_en.author: Labubu CU

restaurants.name: หมูกระทะวัดดง
restaurants.address:

195/18 Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The dipping sauce was delicious, it was my first time trying it. However, the staff were gossiping and laughing at customers. The soup ran out completely before the pot was empty, but what was unacceptable was that after they brought the soup, they went back to their table and seemed to be talking amongst themselves, then looked at our table and laughed. Overall, the food was delicious, but the service was terrible. I'm not saying everyone was like that, just some. (I know the dipping sauce is delicious and they don't need to care about customers, but the service should be of a higher standard. I also work in customer service.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Natchami Akkasiriskaul

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the 500 baht set without fish, and got a huge plate. It was enough for two people to eat until full and was totally worth it! The shrimp and squid were fresh and large, not small at all like other restaurants where the shrimp are tiny. The pork was also cut into big, generous pieces. I ordered an extra plate of pork belly, and they gave me a lot too, 7-8 pieces.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, that's the only good thing about this restaurant. Everything else was terrible, awful, and extremely unprofessional.

This is an old noodle shop in the Bang Bon area. The noodles are fragrant, thin, and perfectly cooked. They also sell steamed buns, dumplings, and roast pork rice.

The steamed buns and dumplings are in the old-fashioned style, like the ones I ate as a child.

The noodles are inexpensive. A special order is 50 baht and gets you significantly more noodles than the regular size, but there's no special price listed on the sign.
They have chili paste to eat with the roast pork, but it's also delicious with the noodles.

You can park on the street in front of the shop from 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM. Parking outside these hours may result in your car being towed.

restaurants.address:
