restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Affordably priced, delicious noodles that are worth trying again"

sample_reviews_en.text:
Not all noodle stands in Bangkok are the same.

Case in point, the Wat Muang Khae Beef Noodle (WMKBN) stall stands out as it is positioned next to a traditional, bright colored street gate.

Its tables and chairs are also positioned against a wall decorated with a cool mural of a child’s face. More street art can be found down the lane.

WMKBN is a dream spot for Instagrammers and food lovers alike. And the food is excellent. We ordered their beef noodles – one with soup, the other dry – and both delivered on the taste front and more.

While smallish in size, the noodles are rich and flavorsome. The broth flavor was deep (almost medicinal like several Chinese soups), intense, and moreish. The braised beef, meanwhile, was tender and melted in the mouth. The highlight for me, however, was the small pieces of tripe that were cooked perfectly. They added texture and an ever-so-slightly gamey taste to the mix – tripe is hard to get right, but the WMKBN team nailed it.

While they serve pad thai and other street food classics, beef noodles are what they are famed for and it’s worth making the trek to WMKBN, which sits in the middle of the vibrant, historic Bang Rak district.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Meng Yee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located at the entrance of an alley, this small shop has seating on both sides. While eating, I saw many motorbike taxi drivers dining there, suggesting it's a popular local eatery, known for its filling and energy-boosting properties, which explains the large groups of drivers patronizing it.

The shop specializes in a very flavorful beef offal soup, with a strong herbal aroma. It features a variety of offal (lung, liver, stomach, etc., parts I couldn't identify) and a rich, robust flavor. Small dishes are provided on the table for dipping the offal; one particular sour sauce is quite unique, balancing the strong soup flavor and making it more palatable.

They start selling in the morning, and it seemed very popular. You can order beef offal soup with rice, or beef offal rice noodles or flat rice noodles. A serving of beef offal soup with white rice costs 65 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: 倩米璐

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wat Muang Kae Beef Noodles (Soi Charoen Krung 34) - Searching for interesting restaurants in the Charoen Krung area, this restaurant has good ratings, so I pinned it to try their beef noodles. I ordered a stewed beef noodle soup with braised beef, fresh beef, beef chunks, and tendons. It tasted okay, but not outstanding. The fresh beef wasn't marinated tender, and the meatballs were a bit starchy and firm. The stewed beef and tendons were deliciously well-seasoned, tender, and fragrant. The price was 60 baht, and the portions were decent, but not expensive.

✔I try to avoid these types of restaurants, which are hard to write about, even though I love beef. I give it a 3.5 🌟 rating because it's better than the usual, but nothing particularly impressive. When I'm craving something, I have to come here. If it's nearby and convenient, it's a great place to eat. 😀

If you walk past, you'll definitely smell the fragrant spices wafting through the air.

The broth is aromatic and has a well-balanced flavor.

Most people order the beef: tender, fresh, or sliced.

The tender beef likely doesn't offer many cuts to choose from.
The fresh beef and meatballs are average.

If you enjoy beef noodle soup, you should definitely try this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: . DISS

sample_reviews_en.text:
NEEDED THE BROTH

For some reason beef noodles are hard to come by around lower bang rak so I walked a little further up just for it. The sen yai neua(wide rice noodles with beef) was good, beef was tender, and broth strong in flavor just like most thai beef noodles. If I have to nitpick, I’ll prefer alittle less salt in the broth.. but all good. Affordable too!

There are few things better than having beef noodle soup in the mid mornings. It just works for me.. ahhhhh. Why not you try it too? ;)
sample_reviews_en.author: The Daily Meelee

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, I give it full marks. The duck rice was served separately as pictured, the flavor was rich and delicious. The beef noodle soup was also very tasty with all the ingredients, I liked it. Ice is 2 baht per glass, and there's free-flowing tea. The atmosphere is homey, by the building, but the ground might be wet if it rains. Personally, I would definitely stop by for a meal if I'm passing by because of the taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Littlefinger

sample_reviews_en.text: For lunch today, I had a special beef tendon and meatball noodle soup at Wat Muang Kae Beef Noodle Shop, near my workplace in the CAT Tower building near the General Post Office in Bang Rak. This shop has been in business for over a decade. Beef lovers shouldn't miss this place. The shop is located at the entrance to Wat Muang Kae. Anyone passing by should stop by and try it. I give it 4 stars for deliciousness.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasin Saitanmanee

sample_reviews_en.text: Walking past the shop, the aroma hit my nose, so I decided to give it a try. I wasn't disappointed with the stewed beef noodle soup. The soup was rich with spices and a little spicy, just right. It went really well with rice. Next time I'll try the beef noodles. The shop is always packed. It's easy to find, at the entrance of Soi Charoen Krung 34. You can see the sign for the entrance to Wat Muang Kae.
sample_reviews_en.author: FizzyButhcer B

restaurants.name: มิดไนท์ไก่ตอนประตูน้ำ (สาขาถนนพรานนกตัดใหม่) ของแท้เสื้อสีฟ้า
restaurants.address:

23 ซอย บางพรม 9 - ซอย บางพรม 11 Bang Phrom, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been there before and the staff were usually unfriendly. But today, I ordered a soda. My glass was fine, and I was about to drink from my boyfriend's glass when he took a sip, almost halfway through, when he pointed out there was an insect in it. If it were a gnat, we might just flick it away, but this was a baby cockroach!!!! Where is the hygiene? And the worst part is, he'd already taken a sip. The staff said, "Okay, then we won't charge you for the drink." No apology whatsoever. Terrible experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Faiiz jiji

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff was terrible, rude, and slammed things down. I ordered a soup with pumpkin, but they only served it with broth. When I asked for one with pumpkin, they slammed the bowl down and spoke as if they were going to cause a fight with me. Customers are paying for their food, not asking for it for free. The food is delicious, but the problem is the terrible and rude staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kavi Kavi

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I ordered Hainanese chicken rice. When I got home, the chicken smelled bad, like it was spoiled, and the meat was mushy. However, the fried chicken rice itself tasted good and the dipping sauce was delicious. Please check the quality before selling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dong Dank

sample_reviews_en.text: The fried chicken tastes OK, edible. I've never tried the boiled chicken. The prices are affordable. The food doesn't take long to arrive. There's an air-conditioned seating area. Some staff members are okay, while others raise their voices a bit.
sample_reviews_en.author: mmeimeii

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located right on the main road and is easy to spot. Parking is available along the street. It was busy, but the staff were attentive. Many items were sold out when I visited. I ordered two plates of chicken rice with …
sample_reviews_en.author: Good Vibes Only

sample_reviews_en.text: Latest update: The staff are more attentive and provide better service. The highlights are the delicious, fluffy rice, the same tasty dipping sauce, and the tender, not tough, chicken. Note that the fried chicken is sometimes sold out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr. Rangsan.

sample_reviews_en.text: Good news! The chicken is tender and the dipping sauce is delicious. The soup is fragrant and tasty. The taro stew is tender and not bitter. However, the only staff member, a man wearing glasses, has a very rude attitude on several …
sample_reviews_en.author: สุรศักดิ์ นาอุดม

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located on the main road, and you can park on the side of the road. The Hainanese chicken rice tastes decent, and the soup has winter melon in it. It costs 50 baht per bowl (as pictured), which is considered cheap.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ladda W.

restaurants.name: Chanphen
restaurants.address:

647, 7 Itsaraphap Rd, Wat Arun, Bangkok Yai, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food portions are good value for the price (takeout only).
The grilled pork neck is amazing! Not too fatty, large pieces.
I love it and order this dish every time I eat at this restaurant.
The minced pork salad tastes good, not too spicy, not too fatty. The papaya salad and corn salad are delicious.
The food is prepared quickly; they are attentive to customers.
Good prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nate Prasita

sample_reviews_en.text:
Spicy papaya salad was delicious ☆☆☆
Larb (spicy minced meat salad) was good ☆☆☆
Crispy fried intestines were tasty ☆☆☆☆☆
Spicy minced beef salad with lime was good ☆☆☆☆

The portion sizes were generous for the price ☆☆☆☆☆
The staff provided good service and the food didn't take long to arrive ☆☆☆☆
sample_reviews_en.author: kim zumotay

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is reasonably priced and portions are generous. The pork larb is tasty, not too spicy, and not too fatty. The som tam and corn salad are delicious, but overly sweet. The staff are active, provide fast service, and are attentive to customers.
In short, I would definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kongkrub

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating here since I was a kid, 16-17. Now there are over 30 restaurants and it's still delicious and cheap. The 70 boiled cockles in Yaowarat are gone. You can order them raw or cooked. Grilled intestines, spicy salad, pork neck, jim jum are all good. Come support them.
sample_reviews_en.author: BK TH

sample_reviews_en.text: The long-haired vendor making papaya salad in front of the shop spoke very rudely, giving me a nasty look. I ordered pork waterfall soup, and the taste was very sour. Terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natda Chanpan

sample_reviews_en.text: My regular restaurant. Everything is delicious, but I personally like the grilled beef, minced beef salad, and grilled cockles. 👍🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Go with me

sample_reviews_en.text:
Spicy, delicious, and affordable.
P.S. I forgot to take a picture when the food arrived, so only the plates are left 😆😆 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Top Sahachat

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love the fried sun-dried beef.
The fried squid wings are crispy.
The papaya salad is spicy.
Overall, it's good.
8/10
sample_reviews_en.author: นาย ชวาล พรรคเจริญ

restaurants.name: วันใหม่หมูกระทะ
restaurants.address:

164, 68 Lat Phrao 1 Alley, Lane 10, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The restaurant is spacious, airy, not crowded, and looks clean.
They offer a choice of 300฿ or 500฿ for the BBQ pork. We chose the 300฿ option and added extra pork for 50฿. It was just enough for two people. They only have one dipping sauce, the seafood one, but it tasted good. The staff provided good service.

They also sell spicy salads, but it's served by a stall next door.
We ordered a glass noodle salad with pork and pork sausage for 80฿. The portion was just right, not too small. The taste was average, not bad.
sample_reviews_th.author: tp

sample_reviews_th.text: Delicious, great dipping sauce, good quality meat, fresh and clean. Small set 300฿, large set 500฿. There are shrimp, squid, chicken, liver and pork. But the marinated pork is not delicious, too soft. The shop is a bit too hot.
sample_reviews_th.author: NT S

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was delicious! I prefer the set-menu BBQ. I didn't get a chance to take pictures because I was so hungry. The preparation was good, the ingredients were fresh and clean. The set was quite complete, and they even included a free large Coke. I was a little disappointed though that the squid wasn't fresh.

Overall, I liked it and would give it a thumbs up. The soup was delicious, not too sweet, which I liked. The large set was moderately priced, comparable to other restaurants. Ice was free, and they didn't charge much extra for drinks. The add-ons were also reasonably priced.

There are also stalls selling salads, papaya salad, and other dishes in the same area. There's ample parking space. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Wilailux Wanngern

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a hot pot and grill restaurant frequented by locals.

Interestingly, they had a piece of pork fat on top, which I didn't know, so the meat got burnt. We ended up eating burnt meat, but we could still taste the deliciousness, even though it was a little bitter. The staff and owner were very friendly ❤️

Due to the language barrier, we finally understood how to eat there: The broth in the grill pot isn't filled to the top; we need to add it first using the teapot provided by the restaurant (which already contains broth).

Then, there's a piece of pork fat on top of the meat plate; you need to use the pork fat to prevent the meat from sticking and burning…🥹
sample_reviews_en.author: 奶茶

sample_reviews_en.text:
There's plenty of motorcycle parking in front of the restaurant. We went on a Friday evening; it wasn't too crowded at first, but soon all the tables were full.

We ordered the pork BBQ set for 500 baht. This price included a bucket of ice and a bottle of Pepsi. The portion size was good for two people.

The dipping sauce tasted good, but it was a little too watery, so the meat didn't stick well.

Overall, it was delicious and good value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charlie Vongphantuseth

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was great, and the dipping sauce was amazing! We ordered the large set, which came with two small complimentary dishes and a large bottle of Pepsi. The service was excellent. The restaurant is next to a 7-Eleven, and you can park in front of the restaurant or in front of the 7-Eleven. So delicious! I'll definitely be back again! 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Phurin Subcharoenporn

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent. Free delivery, and the owner delivered it himself. The portions were huge; the 300 baht set was amazing – a complete set with pork, squid, shrimp, and a full vegetable platter. The dipping sauce was delicious. I ordered at midnight and they delivered it right to my door. Simply incredible!
sample_reviews_en.author: ธีรชัย อุตตะมะ

sample_reviews_en.text: The music was great, the atmosphere in the restaurant was good, the ingredients were fresh, and the portions were generous and worth the price. I ordered a large set meal for 500 baht, and it came with two small complimentary dishes (you can choose from the menu). The dipping sauces were also good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bell Phakteema

restaurants.name: 윤가 파타야 YoonGa Korean BBQ Restaurant
restaurants.address:

Thailand, Chon Buri, Bang Lamung District, Pattaya City, Boonsampan 10, 20150

sample_reviews_en.text:
This review is for my experience through Grab. Twice, I tried to order from YoonGa on Grab Food between the hours of 2-5PM, clearly during opening hours. First time was just last Friday or Saturday, and second time was just today. Both times, Grab app showed that my order was in the kitchen. And then the restaurant cancelled my order within several minutes.

I'm not sure if they're cancelling all orders received or cancelling orders whenever they feel like it, but my suggestion is to take yourself off of delivery apps to save everyone headaches. This is rather inconvenient and annoying.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kellie Wong

sample_reviews_en.text: The condition of the grilled meat is Pattaya no. 1,2. In Pattaya, the meat is really good, this place seems to be the best. However, there is still a menu being prepared. The other dishes are also good overall. What about the soup??? .. The first taste is not very good.... but it is the kind of taste that makes you want to keep eating (Compared to other places, it seems like they use less seasoning???). It is located a bit outside, but it is not that far when you actually go there, and it is a place worth visiting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dylan kim

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went here after nine days of searching for Korean food, and it was absolutely delicious.
Honestly, I didn't expect much because I was just looking for Korean food, but this is Korea, after all.
I thought it would be expensive because it's Korean food, but the portions were generous, so I ate until I was full.
Hope you keep doing business, sir. I'll have to go back again when I come back to Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: 이내경

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pork belly was overcooked and hard, and there was absolutely no juice left... The kimchi stew was aged at room temperature, so it was more sour than vinegar... and the soybean paste stew was miso soup.
The cook brought a cat back and forth to the kitchen.
He didn't even know the basics of Korean cuisine. After eating the stew and rice, the pork belly was served... sigh.
sample_reviews_en.author: 티스메

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a really great restaurant. There's both air-conditioned indoor seating and garden seating. They mainly serve Korean food, with a wide variety of pork and beef options (you can choose to grill it yourself or have them grill it for you).

Today I tried the grilled pork, fried chicken, seafood soup, and tteokbokki. Everything was delicious! :) Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanat Yodwanlop

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is Yun-ga Pattaya Restaurant🎊, which recently opened near my house.

I’ve seen it a few times while passing by, but today was my first time visiting.

I ordered Kimchi Jjigae and Japchae,

and enjoyed the meal. The Japchae was a little bland though. ^^ Next time, I’ll go for some meat and a glass of Soju. 😁 Stay strong during these difficult times. 🙏🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattaya_ JD

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's close to my house, so I've been going there since the beginning.
The food here has become more diverse than before, and it's always delicious.
Another charm is that the music is so reminiscent of the 80s and 90s that it's magical, making me down three or four bottles of soju.
Is that the owner's sales strategy? Haha.
I'll go for a drink soon~
sample_reviews_en.author: Monaco

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, authentic Korean style with a genuine Korean taste. The owner is friendly and the staff are always smiling. I recommend anyone passing by to try it. Regarding the price, it might be a bit high due to the quality of the ingredients, but the prices are clearly listed on the menu so you can decide before ordering.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภัค ธีระแนว

restaurants.name: หมี่ปลา น้ำยาปู cafe
restaurants.address:

122 Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just stopped by for a bite to eat.
I never expected to feel like a princess in a fairy tale 💖👸🏼

Opened the door... and I went "wowww!"
It felt like I'd stepped into a cartoon world.
First question: Do they sell food here? 5555

Is this a restaurant, a cafe, or a coffee shop?
There are anime cartoons and cute, cheerful dolls everywhere.
Plus, there are books on the shelves that you can pick up and read.
It's truly a happy place 💖🦄🍭🧸🎀

The restaurant's most popular menu item is #crabcurrynoodles.
As the name suggests, it's called "Noodles with Fish and Crab Curry Cafe" 🦀🐟

But today I ordered my favorite, fried chicken wings,
and stir-fried noodles with shrimp and water spinach, which had big, fresh, bouncy shrimp.
I was surprised by the prices too; they weren't expensive at all.

The restaurant is great, like really, really great. The decor is adorable.
There are so many things to look at, it's fun to just browse.
The staff in uniforms are so pretty!
The mode & tone of the restaurant makes my photos look amazing! I'll definitely stop by again to hang out. 🫶🏽☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: parery skincare

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious! The crab curry noodles are amazing!
The fish noodles with seafood dipping sauce are fantastic!
The fried mushroom papaya salad is crispy and flavorful.
The spiciness isn't too much, just right, easy for everyone to enjoy.

I asked for tea in a Mrs. Potts teapot and they gave it to me 🥺 So happy!

The shop is great, with lots of books and figurines to choose from. The shop is well-maintained and very clean. I didn't order coffee yet but I'll definitely be back! (The coffee machine looks amazing, I want to try it!)

The natural light makes every corner perfect for photos. There's parking behind the shop, about a 1-2 minute walk. All the decorations are themed, I loved it!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Raya K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mee Pla Nam Ya Pu Cafe

This old-school Mee Pla Nam Ya Pu (rice noodles with fish and crab curry) restaurant has moved to a location opposite Paolo Chokchai 4 Hospital. It's now a cafe selling coffee as well. The food is still as delicious as before, reasonably priced, and the service is very friendly. The interior is cute, perfect for cafe lovers.

📌 Mee Pla Nam Ya Pu Cafe
⏰ Open: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM
📌 Opposite Paolo Chokchai 4 Hospital, 122 Lat Phrao District, Bangkok 10230
💵 200 - 300 THB/person
🚗 Parking available in front of the shop
sample_reviews_en.author: Panjapon Khamsajja

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a lovely atmosphere and a wide variety of drinks. The staff recommended their signature dish, the fried rice with dried fish, which was delicious and generous in portion size. The food arrived quickly. The spaghetti carbonara was creamy and flavorful. The fried mushroom salad was served with the dressing separate and was also plentiful. The restaurant is located opposite Paolo Chokchai 4 Hospital. Parking is not available in front of the restaurant, but there is parking available in a nearby alley. :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukwan At.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I often drive past this place, but today I ordered delivery.

The dish I ordered was Kobe Pork Rice Noodles (Hainanese Style).

To be honest, I've never had rice noodles like this before. I couldn't really distinguish the components.

It tasted like fermented soybean paste, sesame, lime, garlic, and chili, similar to Hainanese sukiyaki dipping sauce.

The tender pork combined with the rice noodles made it quite delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Varot Sirikaya (แท้บ ครัวซองต์โก๋)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my favorite restaurant. My absolute favorite is the fried rice with dried fish. Every time I visit Paolo Chokchai 4 Hospital, I always stop by to eat here. Their crab curry noodles are also incredibly delicious and they give you a generous amount of crab meat.

The restaurant is decorated in a Japanese anime style, with tons of manga comics to read. The owner and staff are lovely and provide excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: nuengruethai nongyang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Manga (Japanese Cartoon) Cafe with choices of savory dishes or just coffee & baking goods

Lovely atmosphere for anyone who love reading manga (Thai translated) or sitting chilling and sip coffee looking decorations.

If you're hungry, they also serving Thai foods Southern Style. The signature dishes are Mii Pla (Sort of noodles made from fish) and Namya Pu (Rice Noodles with Crabmeat Spicy Thick Sauce).
sample_reviews_en.author: Thana Su

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant and cafe is located next to a photography studio. While waiting for your photoshoot, you can read a book, enjoy the view, and relax.
Or, if you're hungry after taking photos, you can grab a meal at the restaurant. They have a diverse menu, mostly Thai food, with recommended dishes like fish noodles and crab curry noodles. Overall, the food tastes good and is recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr. Kornravit Inthachai

restaurants.name: ร้านต้อยตามสั่งอาหารไทย-จีน
restaurants.address:

1013/8 Sukhumvit 71 Rd, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Toi Tam Sang Thai-Chinese Restaurant is a simple, no-frills place that focuses on what really matters: good food cooked fresh to order. The menu offers a wide range of classic Thai and Chinese-Thai dishes, from stir-fried noodles and rice plates to savory meat and vegetable dishes, all prepared quickly and generously.

The flavors are bold, comforting, and well balanced, clearly aimed at locals rather than tourists. Portions are satisfying, prices are very reasonable, and you can easily customize dishes to your taste, whether you prefer them mild or spicy. Everything is cooked right after you order, which adds to the feeling of freshness and authenticity.

The atmosphere is casual and straightforward — this is not a fancy restaurant, but a reliable everyday spot where people come for honest, tasty meals. Service is efficient and friendly, even during busy hours.

Final verdict:
A great local Thai-Chinese eatery for fresh, flavorful comfort food at fair prices. Perfect if you want an authentic, down-to-earth dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: S*C World Explorer

sample_reviews_en.text: Sorry 😩 I forgot to take a picture when it was served. After eating, I realized how delicious it was. I highly recommend the stir-fried basil with preserved egg. It's very rich. Crispy fried basil leaves, crispy fried preserved egg. Each person finished 2 bowls of rice porridge. They weren't small bowls, they were quite large. If you come, I'd like you to try ordering this menu. Another day, we'll come try another menu. I highly recommend it. There are staff waiting to serve you. It's a rice porridge shop with normal prices. It's quite chill. You have to come eat at 3-4 AM. 🤤😮‍💨 Full.
sample_reviews_en.author: JenzZ_ PINK

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're looking for delicious, affordable Isan food in this area, this is your only choice. I don't really want to tell you about it because it gets so crowded, but if you found it on Google Maps, you're in luck! Not for those who care about information or atmosphere. Chim Chum Nua is the best. They also serve raw liver, of course. It's several levels fresher than a nearby restaurant, but they don't speak Japanese, so you'll need to speak Thai. They do have soy sauce and wasabi, but be sure to ask. The staff are shy, but the service is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tetsuya Harada

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located by the roadside, noisy, opposite Pridi Banomyong Soi 46 and a Bangchak gas station. The food is tasty, but the weather is a bit stuffy. They have a large menu; the spicy frog stir-fry is excellent, the beef stew is good with lots of goji berries (though they put a bit too much fried garlic), and the cashew chicken is superb. The TV inside is very loud. The female staff, mostly from Laos, provide good service. The interior has been recently renovated and painted yellow.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicky Sea

sample_reviews_en.text: Wow! We’ve been staying at the Somerset Hotel nearby and have already eaten at quite a few restaurants – some of them much more expensive. But this place was truly a gem in terms of taste and service. The food was absolutely amazing, and the staff was warm and courteous. We were ten people, each with different preferences, and everyone was fully satisfied. Tasting each other’s dishes, we were blown away by the variety and quality of flavors. A real insider tip!
sample_reviews_en.author: Arian Mingo

sample_reviews_en.text: Stumbled across this local restaurant near our hotel and we loved it so much! We visited on 3 different occasions during our stay. Our favourite dishes were the papaya salad and thai fish cakes, but everything was delicious. The service was great, staff were so friendly and attentive even despite the language barrier. We will come back on our next visit to Bangkok :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Scoobert

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a rice porridge and à la carte restaurant with a diverse menu.
The overall taste is delicious in almost every dish.
The atmosphere inside the restaurant is like an old-fashioned rice porridge shop.

The service is fast; the food comes out relatively quickly.
You can park on the side of the road.

Overall, the price is very reasonable considering the taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: น้อนแมว เมี๊ยวๆ เรียกๆเมี๊ยวๆ เดี๋ยวก็มา

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s a local place we found when staying at Somerset and oh boy, the food was incredible, one of the highlights of Bangkok and we ate in luxury and local places. The quality and taste is incredible for the price and the young staff is super friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: M.C. NOWAK

restaurants.name: "ฉั่ว" ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเนื้อ-หมูตุ๋น (ราชวัตร)
restaurants.address:

699 Thanon Nakhon Chaisi Rd, Khwaeng Thanon Nakhon Chai Si, Khet Dusit, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Chua"... This shop is located in the same area as a super famous beef noodle shop in the Ratchawat area. Just across the street... It must have something special...

Today was the perfect opportunity to try it, giving up on the famous shop because of the long queues.

After trying this, I'll probably be coming back here more often.
This bowl, with thin noodles and everything in it, costs only 100 baht, but you get large pieces of everything... Tender and smooth fresh beef, rich and flavorful stewed beef (maybe not the softest, with a bit of chewiness), bouncy tendon, savory spleen, crunchy tripe, and the highlight is the incredibly soft, melt-in-your-mouth tripe...

Of course, the most important thing in beef noodles is the broth... In short, the broth isn't as dark as many other shops; it's lighter in color, but the beef flavor is rich, savory, and very well-balanced. It's not overly salty, with a hint of sweetness. It's deeply delicious and satisfying.

Simply put, I'm hooked. Anyone passing through Ratchawat has to try it.

P.S. The full name of the shop is "Chua Kiang Liang," a name that sounds as impressive as the flavor it delivers.
sample_reviews_en.author: topinito S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Another beef noodle shop near Ratchawat, opposite Big C, next to Je's. Last time I tried two shops and this one caught my eye... I was curious, so I decided to try "Chua".

It's a small, quiet shop occupying two shophouses. There aren't many tables. It's run by an elderly woman and a young man – I'm not sure if they're mother and son.

The beef is okay.
I ordered a regular hot pot and it came with two bowls of rice... free. The rice was a bit hard.
I don't understand why they don't include beef tongue when I ordered the mixed beef dish, and it's like this at every shop – you always have to order it separately 🤣

The stewed beef was quite tough, chewy like strings. Some pieces had a strange smell when I first put them in my mouth, but it disappeared after a while.
The fresh beef was blanched briefly and cooked after a while.
The tendon pieces were large, not super soft.
The intestines were really big, the biggest part of the pot.
The meatballs were average.
The soup was okay.

Free tea, nice orange color and fragrant.

I liked the service. The elderly woman came to ask if I wanted more ice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sakon Anantachat

sample_reviews_en.text:
This has become one of my go-to beef noodle shops! 🌟
I eat here regularly, at least once a week.

It started with me ordering through an app, and it was so delicious I had to come to the restaurant.
The highlight is the clear broth – not too thick, fragrant with simmered spices, and easy to drink. It's the perfect broth flavor, uniquely delicious 👍🏻

The beef and meatballs are made with high-quality ingredients.
The boiled beef shank with dipping sauce is a must-order.

The braised beef tongue is perfectly tender, but it's probably too much for one person – I recommend coming with a group! The portions are generous and worth the price 😂

The atmosphere is bright and airy. The shop might be a little hard to spot; look for the motorcycle taxi stand – it's on the corner at the entrance of the soi (alley).
The shop opens and closes very early, around 3 PM. They're also available on delivery apps.

🚗 Parking is a gamble 🤣 You can park along the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patchara Ployy

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went for a late breakfast on Sunday, April 5th, 1969.
The atmosphere outside the shop is nice; it's spacious and comfortable. There was no queue outside.
I ordered a mixed noodle soup, one bowl of thin rice noodles and one bowl of vermicelli noodles. The first bite, I wasn't sure which piece of offal I chewed on, but it had a very sour taste. But I'm usually a laid-back person, so I continued eating. This time it was braised beef, and it had that sour taste again. I'm not sure if this is the shop's recipe or not. Regarding the taste,
it was okay, but... 100 baht per bowl.
That's similar to nearby shops.
You'll have to try it yourself.
Some people might like this taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Doyale Channel

sample_reviews_en.text: The Ratchawat area is quite unique, with five beef noodle shops located close together. Chua is one of them, possessing its own distinct flavor. Its soup recipe, different from the shops next door and across the street, makes it a great option for beef noodle lovers. I ordered the tender, lean beef, and it arrived exactly as described, with a subtle beefy aroma. The flavorful broth permeated the beef strands. The tender beef was perfectly crispy, in chunks, and very appetizing. The dipping sauce was delicious. The shop has a vintage, homey atmosphere, giving it a nice feel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Torpong Chiamtawongse

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating beef noodle soup in this area for over twenty years, and today was my first time trying this restaurant, Chua. I read reviews and wanted to try it. I have to say, the taste is very similar to a famous nearby restaurant, just like it used to be. It's delicious, the ingredients are large pieces, and the highlight is the beef tongue – so tender I had to order some to take home. The restaurant is comfortable, airy, and cool, the service is good, and they offer free tea. You have to try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: ปั้นบุญ On Tour

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a bowl of beef tongue, tendon, and intestine soup. The broth was delicious, the tongue was tender, the intestines were good, and the portion was generous – great value for money. The owner, an elderly lady, took good care of the customers. Her cooking skills are comparable to other restaurants. No need to queue. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khem Wattakasopon

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I tried a new restaurant in this area. There are two popular restaurants here now, so it must be good if they dared to open one. The taste is good. The meat is cut into large pieces, and they have tongue and intestines – a complete selection of beef and pork. Overall, it's delicious. Give it a try! 👍👍🤨
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittisak N.

restaurants.name: โกโรตีชาชัก พัทยา
restaurants.address:

140/128 ม.11 ซ Khao Talo, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A cute little shop with delicious roti. I stumbled upon this place by accident, but it turned out to be delicious.

I asked the staff about crispy roti, and they recommended "Kom Faek." The name sounded interesting, so I ordered it. They said it was crispier than tissue paper.

Today's menu items:
• Kom Faek (40 baht) | It's a large, crispy roti. I ordered the regular one with just milk. We scrambled to eat it, and it was gone in no time. I highly recommend it. It's like eating crispy butter.
• Soft and fluffy banana whipped cream (65 baht) | Delicious! The dough is thick and soft, and it comes with whipped cream.
• Thai tea, normal sweetness (55 baht) | If you like sweet things, you might like it. The tea is fragrant and strong as usual.
• Thai tea, 50% sweetness (55 baht) | The tea is fragrant and strong, but not too sweet. I like it.

They also offer free chilled jasmine tea.
The staff are friendly and helpful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amps

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're looking for roti that's both thick and soft, or thin and crispy, I highly recommend this place. The taste and service exceeded expectations. This was my second time here. You can order the sweet tea with 0 or 100% sugar. The roti I ordered was thick and soft. The chicken mataba roti was crispy on the outside and soft on the inside with a delicious filling. The chicken massaman curry was rich and flavorful. The chicken curry fried rice was also good. If you order roti to go, you can separate the sugar and milk. The staff are friendly and cheerful. The shop is clean and comfortable. You can park on the opposite side.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuch S

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything is good except for some of the staff. I usually go there often, but I don't understand why they have to nag at customers who order stir-fried basil with omelet. If there's no omelet, why do they have to go to the back of the shop and nag at them? And if you come to eat at 8:30 PM, the staff will be grumpy. They order rice and don't give you water, and if you order roti and don't fix it, they'll be grumpy. You wait a long time, and in the end you have to go ask for it yourself.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tung Na Ja

sample_reviews_en.text:
I usually don't have any problems eating here. The food here is delicious. I like it. If I remember correctly, they even provide tea, which I really like. However, the staff seemed stressed and irritated. I didn't want to bother them too much. I understand that work is tiring, so I went to the restaurant across the street and missed out on roti. 🥹
But don't blame the staff. I'm afraid they'll be stressed. Maybe they should adjust the workload so they'll be more cheerful.
sample_reviews_en.author: boss S live

sample_reviews_en.text: It's just the right amount of sweet and incredibly delicious. The two dishes in the photo cost only 100 THB, so I think it's a bargain. It's a little hard to get to, but if you're a roti fan, it's worth the effort. The green drink was complimentary, and I think it was pandan tea (or something like that?) that's kneaded into the roti dough. It has a unique flavor, but it's not too sweet and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: 551 SalaPao

sample_reviews_en.text: Cute little restaurant with many seats and it is air conditioned. I ordered a banana roti takeout. It’s delicious with an appropriate portion. The price is reasonable. The staff is very nice and friendly. Services are good and fast. There are several choices in the menu, not only roti but also food and drinks. There are some parking around the restaurant because the restaurant is next to the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Melissa

sample_reviews_en.text: It might take a while to wait, but if you're hungry, I recommend getting something to eat beforehand. Otherwise, you might get a headache. But once you get your order, you'll definitely feel better. Red lemon soda and a large glass of coffee tea are delicious, fragrant, and sweet. The roti is also delicious, crispy, and soft. 🤟
sample_reviews_en.author: ภาณุพินญา ศิริเจริญ

sample_reviews_en.text: The hotel where I stayed during my trip was near the restaurant. I ate there twice in a row. The food and drinks were all made to order, authentic and delicious, and great value for money. Every staff member in the restaurant was friendly and helpful. I hope to have the opportunity to dine there again next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teresa Chen

restaurants.name: แชมป์ก๋วยเตี๋ยวต้มยำรสเด็ด
restaurants.address:

1687 On Nut Rd, Khwaeng Suan Luang, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I've been looking for a place that uses fresh lime in their Tom Yum seafood noodle soup for a long time. The flavor is delicious and rich. The chili paste isn't very spicy, so if you like it spicier, you might need to add more yourself. The price is affordable, starting at 50฿. I really enjoyed it! The shop next door sells crispy pork and roasted pork, which are equally delicious.
sample_reviews_th.author: Thunyamas Onthong (Por)

sample_reviews_en.text: I randomly found this place on Google Maps. They serve Tom Yum noodle soup (with fresh lime) that's packed with ingredients and has a rich, intense flavor. Personally, I didn't find it very spicy; you can add chili if you like it spicier. It's 50 baht per bowl (10 baht for an egg), a great price, and comes with pork, squid, and shrimp. They also have Khanom Sai Sai (a type of Thai dessert) for dessert, at 7 baht per piece, with a very rich coconut flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanchanok Sanyapisitkul

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the best noodle shop in On Nut. If we move somewhere else, we'll miss it so much. We ate there every day, from Monday to Saturday. They're closed on Sundays. They open at 8 PM and close very late, perfect for sleepless teenagers. It's a creamy tom yum noodle soup that's incredibly delicious. It's in my top three favorite noodle shops, and I've eaten a lot of noodles, both expensive and cheap. This shop is genuinely good.
sample_reviews_en.author: sasitip siwadit

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant opens at 8:30 PM, so don't go before then. It closes late, at 3 AM, perfect for those who like to eat late. It's located on the main road. I don't know about car parking because I went by motorbike. The taste is inconsistent; it depends on the day. The Tom Yum soup isn't bad, though. There might be a long queue if you go in the early evening. You might need to add some seasoning; it was a bit bland for my taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: jaru gill

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered Tom Yum Noodle Soup.
Choose between clear or creamy broth.
The soup was spicy and delicious, with fresh lime provided.
It had squid and shrimp. The only downside was the pork was a bit tough.

Even at 2 AM, the tables were full, so we had to wait a bit.
It's a late-night eatery, perfect for a quick meal. The soup was excellent 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Uncle Bob

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, clean, and generous portions. The taste is pretty good, maybe a little more seasoning needed if you prefer a stronger flavor. Overall, I really liked it and will definitely come again. The roast pork and crispy pork rice from the shop next door are a must-order; they're just as delicious! 👆🏻 You have to come!
sample_reviews_en.author: ประภัสสร อังกินันทน์

sample_reviews_en.text: This is another great noodle shop in On Nut. Fresh lime tom yum soup is hard to find these days. The only minor issue is the meatballs; everything else is fantastic. If they improved the quality of the meatballs a bit, this shop would be perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: ยางรัดแกงGuide

sample_reviews_en.text:
💓 Found a great restaurant based on Google Maps 💓
It was so delicious! ✨ Generous portions, good price, amazing flavor. The noodles were incredibly tasty! 10/10 ✨ You should try it! 😍
sample_reviews_en.author: platy- platy

restaurants.name: Camp Tatom 101
restaurants.address:

23 Punna Withi 44 Alley, Bang Chak, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem with a camping-style atmosphere. The food is delicious, flavorful, and super spicy! The vibe is like eating at a friend's house, but you're paying for it 🤣🤣🤣 Just kidding!
The wild game dishes are amazing.
There are cute dogs, Katthi (the dog), Pararuy (the cat), and Somjai (the chicken), who are all adorable. Overall, it's a great place. I'm hooked! ♡

Parking is difficult, or I forgot to ask the staff where there's parking available. I recommend a motorcycle for easier access.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miss M

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is incredibly flavorful and packed with ingredients. I highly recommend trying the stir-fried beef with cumin leaves, spicy stir-fried eel, tom yum soup with catfish, the fragrant wok-fried rice, and the simple yet incredibly delicious minced pork omelet – perfectly crispy and not greasy. The owner is lovely and the service is excellent. The atmosphere is comfortable, like eating at a friend's house. The prices are also very reasonable. 💛
sample_reviews_en.author: Jukubu

sample_reviews_en.text: I loved it! It was delicious, and the price was moderate, not too expensive. The flavors were strong, perfect for those who like spicy food. Even if you don't like spicy food, you can still order something suitable. The atmosphere was nice; I didn't expect to find a place like this here. The restaurant is open almost every day. Great value!
sample_reviews_en.author: sunn sunny

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, perfect for those who like spicy food. Even the chili fish sauce is tasty. The beer is sweet and refreshing. Our must-try dishes are the train station fried rice and the fried chicken wings. Don't even think about asking for spicy food; if you can't handle spice, you'll be sweating profusely!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bbbblackcat 18

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a friendly atmosphere, delicious food, and a diverse menu with both à la carte and wild game dishes. If you like wild game and spicy food, I highly recommend it! The taste is great and flavorful. The service is good, and they even have a Labrador as their resident PR person.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanyanan Pornrasaminondha

sample_reviews_en.text: Just moved to this neighbourhood and walked there for dinner. We had three dishes. Every single dish was extremely well balanced and fair priced. I can only say one thing: I am already looking forward to coming back. Very nice owners and the dog + cat + chicken in their yard = amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Johannes Jung

sample_reviews_en.text: Loved it! I go mostly at night for dinner; the owners are very nice, the enviroment is great and the food is delicious! They have an adorable dog and a cat which as an animal fan i love!!!! I highly recommend to go if you live near phra khanong or punnawithi area.
sample_reviews_en.author: mery

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, like camping. The food is delicious; I recommend the shrimp marinated in fish sauce and the spicy and refreshing stir-fried fish. The staff are attentive and provide genuine service. There's also a cute dog that comes to greet you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thip T

restaurants.name: Suki Teenoi Suan Phloen Market
restaurants.address:

โครงการสวนเพลินมาร์เก็ต ชั้น 2 Rama IV Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to eat alone today. I walked into the area near the stairs and a staff member asked if I was interested in another section, saying there was a 50% discount. I went because I thought I would get a discount. At first, I asked what the promotion was, but they didn't answer. I didn't think anything of it. When I got the bill, they didn't give me the discount. In the end, they made me move to another section because the other section was about to close. They could have just told me nicely. Why lie and make me feel bad? Also, when I said I had a membership, they didn't ask for my membership number or show me the points. They also shortchanged me by 100 baht. If I hadn't checked beforehand, it would have felt like I was cheated out of 100 baht. It's not a lot of money, but they should have checked properly.
But the staff in the restaurant were very nice and provided excellent service. However, the reception staff were a bit rude. I hope they improve on that.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wilasinee Chaisirithanawat

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff was terrible today. I asked for vegetables the first time and didn't get them, so I asked again. After I got them, I ate them all and ordered more. The staff member made a displeased face even though I spoke politely. They loudly and sarcastically called a colleague to take my order, and I overheard them saying, "Bring me two plates because I've been asking so much." When they served it, they slammed the tray down so hard, almost throwing it. It was very rude. The tall male staff member needs to improve his behavior. It was the worst experience I've had, to the point where my boyfriend said we'll never come back here again. I understand the staff might be tired, but that's no reason to act so rudely towards customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dy Dy

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very disappointing experience at the Q counter.The staff member who assisted us was impatient and had a very unfriendly attitude. Her facial expressions made it obvious that she was annoyed.Instead of making customers feel welcome, she made us feel uncomfortable.

Customer service should be polite, respectful,patient and professional. Everyone deserves to be treated equally. The way we were treated made me wonder if it was because we are Myanmar nationals and not Thai. I sincerely hope that was not the reason, but this experience left us feeling disrespected.

I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and provides better customer service training to ensure that no other customers have the same experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Al Khoon Sett

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a small complex of restaurants, grocery stores, and shops. Suki Teenoi is a famous shabu-shabu buffet, very popular with Thais. The food is fairly fresh and the service is quick. It closes late at night. It's best to book for dinner and on weekends because it's often very crowded. Prices are average. Advised.

(Note: The provided Thai text translates to something like "a small complex of restaurants, groceries, and small shops." It also mentions Suki Teenoi being a famous shabu-shabu buffet, very popular with Thais, and that the food is relatively fresh with quick service. It closes late, so booking for dinner and weekends is recommended as it's often very crowded.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Nubaza C.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an extremely popular restaurant. Even at around 9 PM on a weekday, there was an hour-long wait.

Ordering is done by writing your order on paper, but the menu is entirely in Thai. It would be much more helpful for foreigners if they at least numbered the pictures of the dishes. It seems you can also order from your smartphone, but it wasn't working properly that day.

If you don't understand Thai, it might be a bit challenging.

The food is generally tasty, but the beef was quite tough, so I personally wouldn't recommend it.

The availability of ponzu sauce is a nice touch.
sample_reviews_en.author: kazu 0928

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was terrible. I ordered food and didn't get it. Even after following up, they still didn't bring it. I had to reorder to get it.
Another time, I ordered beef, and the staff served beef along with almost 10 skewers of pork. When I told them I didn't order that, the staff just held up a piece of paper without saying anything, even though it only said "beef." Another staff member came and said they served the wrong order, but that staff member didn't apologize at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oum Chanyanud

sample_reviews_en.text: Be prepared to wait 30-40 minutes. The queuing system is slow; they repeated the same number 6-7 times, which was very confusing. We arrived at the table, ordered, and waited 20 minutes, but our food still hadn't arrived. We waited until we were full. When we finally got there, a helpful staff member wrote down our order manually, explaining that it wasn't in the system. The atmosphere was better than other places, but I don't think I'll be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Carebears Ting

sample_reviews_en.text: All-you-can-eat shabu-shabu with pork, beef, and seafood for a super cheap price of 276 baht, including drinks and snacks. They use a scan-to-order system, food is served quickly, and the staff is attentive. You can choose your soup base, and the pot is large enough for one person with no extra charge. They close at 4 AM, so it's less crowded if you go late. I love the dipping sauces and the Australian beef.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutty O.

restaurants.name: Zaab Eli Very Thai (แซ่บอีลี่ เวรี่ไทย) - ไอคอนสยาม
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 299 Charoen Nakhon 5 Alley, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
เล้งหม้อไฟ ฿250 (Volcano Ribs $226)

ต้มแซ่บหมูเด้งเห็ดรวม ฿180 (Spicy and Sour Pork Soup $162)

ข้าวสวย ฿20 (White Rice $18)

I chose ZaabEli, which has Volcano Ribs, for dinner at Iconsiam. The dining environment was comfortable and spacious, but the Volcano Ribs weren't as huge as I expected 😆
And the bones (not the meat) were huge, making it a bit tiring to gnaw on. The Spicy and Sour Pork Soup was incredibly spicy and sour, quite a challenge. Overall, I didn't really like it!
sample_reviews_th.author: Olivier Chiang

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten at this restaurant's One Bangkok branch before, and it was delicious both times. But this time, at the Icon Siam branch, I don't know if it was because it was crowded or if it's usually like this, but the papaya salad was extremely salty. I ordered the "Tam Lao Pla Ra Klak Klak" (a type of papaya salad with fermented fish sauce), and it was so salty that even adding 3-4 tablespoons of water didn't help. The flavor was intense, but it was so salty that it was inedible. The next saltiest dish was another papaya salad (I can't remember the name, but it had rice noodles, acacia leaves, and dried shrimp). Other branches' versions are easier to eat. This one was just too salty and not enjoyable. I wasn't impressed considering the price of 1000 baht. (They also have crispy pork belly, fried larb, and duck larb, which were delicious and perfectly salty.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Sai Wilailak

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. It took almost 20 minutes to get my order, and they repeated the order about twice, then came back to double-check. It was very confusing. They said they forgot to save the order. Furthermore, the food was incredibly slow to come out. They placed the food on the table but didn't provide plates for me to eat from. I was baffled. Finally, I couldn't wait any longer and didn't get to eat anything. I took everything home. They said the grilled chicken would take 3 minutes. From the time I asked them to take the food home, it must have taken over 10 minutes in total. In the end, the restaurant offered a 10% discount for the staff's mistake (but still dared to charge a service charge despite the terrible service). The feeling of disappointment was already ruined. Don't try to erase a bad memory with just 60-70 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sansanee Polsaen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mediocre place, wouldn't recommend it.
I ordered Tom Yum Kung, and it was the worst Tom Yum I’ve ever had in Thailand. I specifically asked for "little spicy," but they made it extremely hot. I actually like spicy food, but this was hotter than when I usually order "spicy."
The huge, unpeeled prawns with heads look nice, but I would have preferred them cleaned. Rice not included with the soup, and you can't even order it separately here. And this single dish costs over 300 baht!
The drinks were also mediocre, and there are only three dessert options, all of which are too exotic - they don't even have a basic Mango Sticky Rice.
Bottom line: unless you just want to sit in a nice location, this place isn't worth visiting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Сергей Лагунов

sample_reviews_en.text: Visited on 21 June 2024. Worth 0 star, if there is an option. The food were extremely salty, and the service staff male/female dark skin with spec made the dining experience so unpleasant, he/she(not sure the pronoun) was rude, appeared very cold, and reluctant to serve. When told him/her the soup was salty, instead of addressing the issue, just asked me back”what to do” “we cannot add soup” and reluctantly took back the soup leaving the word” add water”. I found it was very unprofessional and damaging to the restaurant brand name. As the opposite, the cashier staff Jo served us with true smile, which is my general impression to the friendly Thai people. Thanks Jo, you are the saving grace of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wayne wang

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was terrible.
I ordered corn salad without shrimp, informing them in advance that I'm allergic to shrimp. Instead, I received a dish completely covered in shrimp. I informed the staff, and they brought a new dish without shrimp. I was happy, but as I was mixing the salad and about to eat, I found shrimp under the dressing. It seems the kitchen staff didn't remake it properly, but didn't remove all the shrimp. I informed the staff again that there were still shrimp. None of the staff apologized. It was careless and negligent. How dare they sell this? The quality doesn't match the price. Even a street food cart understands consumers better. Staff should be well-trained before working on the floor!
sample_reviews_en.author: Saichan Aueantaisong

sample_reviews_en.text: Initially, the waitress said the spiciness could be adjusted, and we told her all three soups were mildly spicy. However, all of them arrived at least medium spicy, one of which was unpalatable. We asked her to replace it and requested hot water for all three, but she said she could only replace one at a time. Speechless... We asked if the soup could be a little spicy, and the waitress said OK, but ultimately all three soups were very spicy. We asked them to add hot water. She said she could only do that for one of the three. Besides the spiciness, I don't think the chicken or meat bones were fresh. This is the most terrible experience in Bangkok; apart from that, all the other meals were very good so far.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mayling Chen

sample_reviews_en.text: Northeastern food . Taste quiet authentic . Spicy and sour . Menu selection is very good . Almost covered all the section you need in one restaurant. Food taste wise , local taste , quite strong with spices and spiciness . Thai will prefer to eat this shop too . Interior modern and comfortable. Two floors with stairs . Not suitable for wheelchairs customer . If booking near than 10 people might be a bit cramped but manageable . Staff service is good . Price wise reasonable . Menu must try fried chicken with garlic and beef Tom saap . Normally outside the street you can find pork tom saap but not easy to find beef Tom saap . So worth a try . The drink Logan , with real Longan meat so it’s good to try .
sample_reviews_en.author: TM LEK

restaurants.name: Yayoi - Central Rama 9
restaurants.address:

617 เซ็นทรัล พระราม9 ชั้น 6, Rama IX Rd, Huai Khwang, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
On Wednesday, August 6, 2025, I ordered the mackerel steak set meal. It came with rice, miso soup, salad, kimchi, and a mackerel steak served on a hot plate. I think it was garlic soy sauce and wasabi sauce, but it was a little bland. It would have been better if they had provided Japanese soy sauce (though soy sauce for the gyoza was available on the table). It was served piping hot, which is rare in Thailand, so I was very satisfied.

What I couldn't quite understand was the hot green tea I also ordered. What's this? It's just hot water, green and with no scent. Is there anyone who would consider this to be delicious green tea? They have a full Japanese menu, so I'm sure they're expecting Japanese customers, and even non-Japanese customers would be surprised. I don't remember how much it was, but since they're charging money, shouldn't they make a bit more of an effort? I wonder if Yayoiken's expatriates try every item on the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shinichi

sample_reviews_en.text:
no service charge for this japanese food restaurant, you can find branches in many popular shopping malls, value for money, price reasonable and fast service, apply for
membership entitle you to even further discount (actually i am a repeat customer and visited this restaurant many times), anyway, lots of choice of dishes on menu and set meals, cozy environment as the restaurant quite large in area, and tables (and seats) arranged at adequate distance away from each other

my membership expired for a while as i was out of thailand for some time, i decided to re- apply membership again yesterday when i ate there paying 129baht, i already got the physical membership card, the young female staff kindly promised to help me register in the app when i visit restaurant again next monday

If you like the above review, please give me a
Like ♡, thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: dr ken chao

sample_reviews_en.text:
Back for our second visit and Yayoi did not disappoint. The value for money here is impressive, especially given the generous portion sizes and good quality food.

Highlights of the meal:
• Sukiyaki Pork: Flavorful and comforting.
• Fried Fish: The texture was spot on—crispy batter with juicy meat inside.
• Beef Steak Cubes: Surprisingly thick cuts that remained very tender.
• Tempura: Tasty and above average.
If you go, look for the Combo Sets for the best deal. The atmosphere is standard and service is decent, but the food is definitely the star here.
• Sushi roll: a bit too much sauce. A deep fried shrimp with imitation crab meat on top.  This one can skip.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lady Kim

sample_reviews_en.text: The food service was extremely slow. I waited 35 minutes for just one dish. I asked four different staff members, and none of them gave an answer. I had to ask for my water, and even the food that was served was wrong. I waited 45 minutes for the salmon salad, and only after I said I didn't want it anymore did they tell me it was sold out. I've never had such a terrible experience at any branch. In the end, the staff gave me a 10% discount, but I'm definitely never going back to this branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sn Niix

sample_reviews_en.text: The salmon Thai-style salad at this restaurant isn't served with or topped with Thai-style dressing. It's just a salad of vegetables, salmon, and Japanese soy sauce dressing. I ate it feeling confused, wondering if this was really supposed to be a Thai-style salad. As for the tempura udon, the tempura shrimp was soggy and mushy from being soaked in water, and the soup wasn't hot. I wasn't very impressed with the food. The staff were okay and provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sompeeti Wallibhodome

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is pretty average. It's actually suitable for people who want to eat Japanese food but don't know what to order, or it would be good for families because you can order a variety of Japanese dishes.
This branch has a screen for ordering food, but on the day I went, the staff said the screen was broken and told me to order from the staff, which I think is better because it's probably faster than customers having to search for the menu themselves.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supi H.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Miso soup was delicious (not too salty)
Genuine Japanese rice, kimchi was good and Saba fish and larb karaege were excellent, strongly recommended.

KH Guide & Rating :-

Accessibility   :  highest floor at Central Rama 9
Cleanliness     :  4.5/5
Ambience        :  4.5/5
Food quality    : 4/5
Price                 : 4.5/5 ( promotion set for 2 is excellent value for money )
Attentiveness :  5/5
To visit  again :yes
sample_reviews_en.author: HC_KH%

sample_reviews_en.text: I would like to express my sincere appreciation to the staff at this branch, especially a staff member named Pongsakorn. His service was excellent, he was very polite, gave helpful advice, and waited patiently for my food. This is the first time I've been so impressed with a Yayoi branch, and the first time I've wanted to write a review specifically for Pongsakorn.
sample_reviews_en.author: munkanaporn kaewploy

restaurants.name: The Pizza Company ซอยลาซาล
restaurants.address:

525, 527 Lasalle Rd, Bang Na Tai, Khet Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've bought the 129 baht set twice this month. The staff I encountered were great, mostly women. Today I bought it to take home. I ordered and then went to do laundry, about 30 minutes later. When I came back to pick it up, the staff had already put it in the oven for me. It was perfectly hot when I got home! Very impressed! They also gave me a generous amount of sauce (6 packets).

(I bought it around 8 PM, so there weren't many people.)
sample_reviews_en.author: หทัยภัทร ผ่องแผ้ว

sample_reviews_en.text: A delivery woman, a tomboy with short hair, dark skin, and a slightly large build, arrived to deliver my food. She was furious, saying things like, "What did you say? I couldn't hear you!" She was so annoyed, yelling, "I'm already here!!!" When I went down to receive the food, she gave me a sour look. I'm sorry to say, but I paid for this, I wasn't asking for it for free. If you don't want to deliver, then don't deliver at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: moji dream

sample_reviews_en.text: This Pizza Company branch shouldn’t even get one star. They don’t deserve this. This is the worst branch that I ever went to….. The receptor doesn’t even care if you are waiting to order while in the store there were no one. They just don’t care…. Horrid. Never coming back again. Recommend going to the sukhumvit 103 branch, they deserve 6stars out of 5 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Matt Anantachina

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything was so sweet! Even the stir-fried spaghetti was sweet, the pizza was sweet, and the spinach and cheese had runny cheese inside... In short, Pizza Company is better.

(Note: The repeated phrase "Everything is freaking sweet, even the pizza itself! Recommend Pizza Company for the next time!" is a misreading and not part of the pizza review.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Wassy R.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very bad service experience.
Low quality pizza.
The delivery guy had no manners.

I ordered today and the service was terrible. Both the restaurant staff and the delivery guy were rude and yelled.
I ordered food at 9 PM on September 24th. Please address the staff issue today.
sample_reviews_en.author: F Ps

sample_reviews_en.text: This is terrible. My child was waiting for their food and had a stomach ache, wanting to use the restroom, but we weren't allowed. Where were we supposed to go? We had to find a restroom elsewhere and then come back to get our pizza.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nara

sample_reviews_en.text: They make amazing pizza. The staff are very good and definitely helpful. The only problem is there's no parking because it's on the main street, but the important thing is the taste, 5 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kolofonto

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely delicious stuffed crust pizza, I signed up for their reward card and got a second pizza and 4 wings for free. The card costs 399 baht and is good for one year.
sample_reviews_en.author: Liam B

restaurants.name: ข้าวต้มลุงสม บางศรีเมือง
restaurants.address:

RFQG+QHJ, Bangsrimuang Rd, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I pass by this place every day and finally got to stop by for a meal. Overall, the food was delicious.
Stir-fried morning glory with chili ⭐️⭐️⭐️ Delicious, I'll definitely have to order it again next time.
Steamed sea bass with dipping sauce ⭐️⭐️⭐️ The fish was good, fresh and firm. The dipping sauce was delicious.
Fried frog with garlic ⭐️ The taste was good, like stir-fried frog with garlic. I was expecting it to be crispy fried frog coated in batter, so I deducted points because it wasn't what I expected.
Super sour soup ⭐️⭐️⭐️ Very sour and spicy, just the way I like it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakwan P

sample_reviews_en.text:
This roadside rice porridge shop is comfortable and not too hot. There seems to be a river behind the shop, providing a nice breeze.

The food comes out quickly; the wait isn't long. Almost every dish tastes good, especially the rice porridge, which is fragrant with pandan leaves.

The pickled mustard greens were a bit too salty.

The crispy fried fish wasn't too salty.

The prices are reasonable.

The stir-fried asparagus and stir-fried white chives were very tough; every piece of asparagus was old and needed to be spat out. 😂

The service was good and fast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Being Journal

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Uncle Som's Rice Porridge, Bang Sri Muang" is a rice porridge restaurant with a very extensive menu. The food is delicious, served quickly, and reasonably priced.

- Spicy Fried Fish Salad: Delicious and well-balanced, with pickled ginger.
- Spicy Fried Fish Soup: Flavorful, fragrant, refreshing, and easy to eat.
- Stir-fried Morning Glory with Salted Fish: Very good, don't forget to order it!
- Omelette with Pickled Garlic: A must-try, delicious.

I didn't take many photos, but overall the food was delicious. If you're in the area, stop by and try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: V Vara

sample_reviews_en.text: Khaotom-Uncle Som offers a very warm and welcoming service. It’s a family-run business, and you can truly feel the care they put into everything. My family visits here very often, and we have never been disappointed. Every dish is absolutely delicious, and the prices are very reasonable—you'll be pleasantly surprised because they’re even lower than expected! This place serves my favorite khaotom, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great meal
sample_reviews_en.author: S P

sample_reviews_en.text:
This rice porridge shop in Lang Si Mueang has decent food at friendly prices. It's a Thai-style rice porridge with a strong, salty flavor. I once ordered the preserved olives and found them saltier than those at Chinese rice porridge shops.

My favorite dish is the spicy fried fish salad; they add pickled ginger, which is delicious.

The portions are large and offer great value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wannipa Chimnoy

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! Everything I've tried has been amazing. I go there very often. The prices are reasonable, and the taste suits my palate. The stir-fried dish with chili and salt is delicious, the crispy mixed salad is also tasty, and the Tom Yum and Super soups are all great. The wait time is also short.
sample_reviews_en.author: เกิดไม่ทัน แต่ ดั๊นอยากเล่า

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious! Good price, generous portions for the price. Plenty of comfortable seating. Food comes out quickly. The elderly couple who run the place provide excellent service.

Recommended: Crispy fried fish salad – delicious, crunchy, and perfectly sour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eksuwan Dear

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best rice porridge in the Bang Sri Mueang area. I've been eating here for over 10 years.
The taste has never changed. Affordable price. Delicious flavor.
Rice porridge lovers must try it. Open late in the evening. Come and try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: เรื่องของผม ครีเอเตอร์

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวบ้านบึง สุขุมวิท 64
restaurants.address:

35 ซอย พงษ์เวชอนุสรณ์ 1 Phra Khanong Tai, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ban Bueng Noodle Shop, Sukhumvit 64

The taste is good and the price is reasonable. The Tom Yum Yen Ta Fo (spicy noodle soup) has a perfectly balanced sweet and sour flavor; no need to add any extra seasoning. The noodles are chewy and soft, the fried shrimp are whole, and the boiled blood pudding is soft and not fishy. Those who like spicy food can add more chili.

The shop has a simple atmosphere with fans to keep it from getting too hot. It's comfortable and perfect for a leisurely lunch.

⚠️ A small suggestion: I would like the cooks to wear hairnets to increase confidence in hygiene. 🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: pumpui

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve been here a lot because the food is really good. Every time I come, I always order two bowls 😂
This time I had Yen Ta Fo (no soup), tom yum thin rice noodles, and crispy fried shrimp.
When you order, just tell them not to add fried garlic oil.
It gets really crowded at lunchtime. Also, after people leave and the staff clear the bowls, the tables aren’t always very clean.
There’s no parking, but the good thing is the prices are cheap.
sample_reviews_en.author: TiKoh

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, but there's a long queue at lunchtime. The staff's attitude varies; sometimes they're nice, sometimes they're not, depending on their mood. If there are a lot of orders and they make mistakes, pointing it out will result in a rude response. To avoid frustration, it's best to eat in the morning or afternoon. However, if you encounter the mother, she's usually kinder and speaks more politely than her daughter.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fatcat

sample_reviews_en.text: Highly recommended local food! The owner is friendly, and the food is delicious. I suggest ordering their fried shrimp separately; it's quite good. Also, it's incredibly affordable—the portions of rice and noodles are much larger than other places, and the price is cheap. The main thing is the taste; you'll have to wait in line at restaurants, but oh well, it's so good!
sample_reviews_en.author: Hui Chen

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) is delicious. It's crowded at lunchtime, so expect a wait. The flavor is on the sweeter side. My friend liked the fried shrimp, but I found it a bit too hard. It's easy to eat and has a standard, tasty flavor. Parking is available on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakorn S

sample_reviews_en.text:
The highlight is the noodle soup, it's incredibly delicious and comes with crispy shrimp!
Tom Yum minced pork
Yentafo - spicy salad
It's crowded at lunchtime, parking might be difficult. There's parking for 3-4 cars in front of the shop, along the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: THITIWAT UPANWAN

sample_reviews_en.text: The portions are HUGE! It's delicious, and the ingredients are fresh. I ordered two bowls – Tom Yum Yen Ta Fo and Kao Lao – and almost couldn't finish it all. The portions are so large and the price is fantastic – only 60 baht per bowl!
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyachat Siritoh

sample_reviews_en.text: This Tom Yum noodle soup is delicious, with just the right amount of spiciness, a perfect balance of sweet and sour, and a hint of vinegar. It's best to come before noon or after 1 PM to avoid long queues.
sample_reviews_en.author: thida satitanuchit

restaurants.name: Paed-riew Porridge
restaurants.address:

MG97+8PM, Suk Sawat Rd, Rat Burana, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Location: A roadside rice porridge stall that's always crowded.

Parking: On the street or sidewalk, with people directing traffic. However, it's often crowded, so people frequently park far away and walk, hoping to find a seat. It's recommended to come early in the morning. I came at 6 PM today, and it was much less crowded.

Food: The taste is excellent, especially the sea bass with fish sauce – the pieces were huge!
Unfortunately, I didn't take any pictures. You'll have to try it yourself.

However, the water spinach today was very old and difficult to chew. It's a shame considering the great taste; the ingredients weren't up to par.
sample_reviews_en.author: น้องรักสัตว์เล็ก ชูการ์ นกแก้ว

sample_reviews_en.text: I asked if Tom Yum Pla Krua (spicy fish maw soup) was supposed to be like this, and I got a very angry and aggressive response. The food was delicious and clean, but the owner's service was terrible. I ordered three dishes, three servings of plain rice, and one bottle of beer. We were first-time customers. Tom Yum Pla Krua varies from restaurant to restaurant. I was very disappointed. However, the other staff members were very nice, thank you! 🙏🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: phiangsuri pasyen

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is worse than before.
The heavily seasoned dishes are more suitable for eating with rice porridge.

The stir-fried squid with salted egg yolk wasn't stir-fried with salted egg yolk like other restaurants, but used a dark sauce that wasn't tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kim

sample_reviews_en.text:
I disagree with allowing customers to park on the side of the road like this.
Traffic is constantly congested, and it's dangerous at night.
The locals are inconvenienced.
There should be a more organized parking area inside the premises.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oro Jackson

sample_reviews_en.text: Uh... it's delicious. They have stir-fried Gnetum leaves with eggs and fried frog. You have to park on the side of the road and wait until 5 PM, except on Mondays when you have to wait until 6 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: Critical Doggy

sample_reviews_en.text: All the food was delicious and reasonably priced, especially the super tasty dishes: crab fried rice, stir-fried clams, and garlic fried pork ribs.
sample_reviews_en.author: ดนุช กัณหะกาญจนะ

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant has delicious food at reasonable prices and is busy every day.
I recommend the fried sea bass with fish sauce; it's delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirikwan Deephum

sample_reviews_en.text: Good, come and eat. The soup is delicious. The rice soup is good. It seems to have taro in it.
sample_reviews_en.author: 何淑贤

restaurants.name: ครัวเรวดี63 ตามสั่ง
restaurants.address:

81 หมู่บ้านศรีเกษตร2 แยก6 ซอยเรวดี63 Rewadee Road, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located in Soi Rewadee 63, Intersection 6, Nonthaburi Province, this is a home-based restaurant. It's open from 10:30 AM to 2:00 PM.
Parking is limited, with only about 4-5 tables available.

Menu items start at 55 baht. Seafood and crispy pork dishes start at 75 baht. Main courses start at 100 baht, and seafood dishes start at 120 baht.

The portions are very large, with lots of rice. It's like ordering from a restaurant but with extra portions. The garlic fried rice with seafood is average; adding a little sugar makes it tastier. The crispy pork with curry is delicious, with a generous amount of crispy pork.

If you eat less rice, let the staff know beforehand. They can pack any leftovers to take home. The restaurant doesn't accept 500 or 1000 baht bills, but they do accept bank transfers. The tea is very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffey

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a made-to-order restaurant located in Soi Rewadee 63. There are about 5 tables inside and 2 more outside. I ordered crispy pork and shrimp basil stir-fry with a fried egg, and my boyfriend ordered crispy pork, bamboo shoot, and pickled egg basil stir-fry with a fried egg. When the food arrived, we were surprised by how much rice there was! But their chili fish sauce was also delicious. The food was tasty too. I couldn't finish my rice, but my boyfriend did – we were so full we went back for dinner! For those who don't eat much rice, you can tell the restaurant to reduce the portion size. Parking is quite difficult for those driving. We parked at the entrance of the soi where there was a space along the wall and they allowed parking there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuntawan Nualsri
