sample_reviews_en.text: 20.10.2024 I've seen reviews for a while now, it's a goal I have to try. Today, unexpectedly, I came at 1:00 PM. I only had to wait in line for one person, so I got to eat quickly. I ordered crispy pork with chili and salt over rice + fried egg 80.-, spicy stir-fried bamboo shoots with minced pork 55.-, and dry seafood sukiyaki 80.-, total 215.-. In summary, the taste is average to good, but the quantity and price are quite cheap. It's a restaurant suitable for repeat visits.
sample_reviews_en.author: อนุชิต เสถียรวราภรณ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
The first time I ate there, I couldn't understand why it was so crowded. I was so confused that I went back for a second time. After that, I went every weekend.

The dry green curry was delicious. The curry powder was especially good. And the crispy pork was so big it filled the plate. I wondered what they were selling for so much!!

The regular menu: crispy pork 75 baht, curry powder 85 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tuckpatt

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted great, the portions were large and more than worth the price. The ingredients were fresh and the seasoning was perfectly balanced, just like authentic Thai-style cooking. The food didn't take long to arrive. If you're looking for delicious Thai-style rice dishes, I highly recommend this place. I'll definitely be back! 👍🍛
sample_reviews_en.author: จอจอขอรีวิว

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, I tried the made-to-order food at Krua Rewadee 63. When I saw the food, I was amazed! Why is there so much? Will we be able to finish it all? We had to share it with my friend. They give you so much! The chicken pieces were huge, and you can ask for extra rice. And most importantly, it's cheap, and the food tastes pretty good…
sample_reviews_en.author: Kyomibu Hotarusa

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves huge portions (Huge!), and the food is delicious and very flavorful. Highly recommended for big eaters! However, you might have to wait a while because the restaurant is incredibly popular, with many people calling to reserve tables or ordering takeout. But I can tell you, it's definitely worth the wait!
sample_reviews_en.author: Badinchai Palichaiwat

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious, the portions are generous, and the price is reasonable. However, it's a bit too hot, that's all. Overall, the food is very good. The wait for the food was a bit long, but that's understandable because the restaurant has a long queue. I'll definitely go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Achara Sudsayta

restaurants.name: Rung Rung Sea
restaurants.address:

26 Thanon Thoet Thai, Khwaeng Pak Khlong Phasi Charoen, Khet Phasi Charoen, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious! Close to home, great price. The chef is friendly, serves food quickly, and gives excellent recommendations.

- The spicy seafood hot pot is amazing, with plenty of squid and shrimp.
- The fried soft-shell crab with garlic is incredibly crispy and delicious. This dish is a must-try! I loved how it was crispy while still having tender meat.
- The glass noodle casserole with shrimp is a signature dish, fragrant and flavorful – don't miss it!
sample_reviews_en.author: N. Paphaphae

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the opportunity to take my parents to pay respects at Wat Pak Nam and found this restaurant on the map, so we decided to try it. The food was delicious and the price was very reasonable. The owner was friendly and the staff provided good service. We ordered 3 dishes and took 1 home, for a total of 4 dishes, for only 600 baht! That's an unbelievable price! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: n y

sample_reviews_en.text:
My friend and I just went today and left very full and happy! All the food we order (like 4 dishes) were very good and tasty.

The menus are not in English 😅 but you can always use Google Translate. Owner seemed like a very nice guy, food was brought super fast, all fresh and reasonable prices. If you can, please do go!
sample_reviews_en.author: Katherine Rojas

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located in a building on the main road (there is parking available in the alley next to the restaurant; you can park there and walk through the back). The interior is clean, as are the plates, bowls, and glasses. The service is good, and the food tastes fresh, delicious, and flavorful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Petch Jeerasil

sample_reviews_en.text: The seafood is incredibly fresh, with large, succulent pieces of shrimp and squid. The steamed fish with soy sauce is fragrant and delicious, though slightly too sweet, so I deducted one star. The prices are reasonable and fair. The owner and staff are friendly and provide good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: ann oomsin

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was fresh and delicious, the service was excellent, and the owner was very friendly and welcoming. We ate until we were full and satisfied. The price was reasonable; I thought it would be around 1000 baht but it was less than 1000 baht. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: กันตพัฒน์ อนันตวุฒิศักดิ์

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the prices are very reasonable. The restaurant is beautifully decorated and stylish. There's parking available behind the restaurant. I'm a regular customer; I've been stopping by regularly when I visit Wat Pak Nam for a long time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sathien Chandraruangnabha

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The food is slightly sweet, with a mild flavor suitable for the whole family.
- There is no parking lot; you have to park on the street.
- The ingredients are fresh and the prices are reasonable.
- The salted fried chicken is delicious; I recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: M C.J

restaurants.name: บ้านเดือน
restaurants.address:

94/1 ซอยพุทธบูชา 6 ถนนพุทธบูชา แชวงบางมด Chom Thong, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you enjoy the atmosphere and taste of home-cooked meals like you're having a meal at your mother's house, I highly recommend this place.
The crab curry is delicious. I also loved the fried sea bass with fish sauce; it was a large fish, and the meat was already deboned, so you don't have to worry about bones.
If you're planning to visit, I recommend calling ahead to order your dishes because the cook works alone. This way, you won't have to wait long if you're very hungry.
Another simple, one-dish meal is the stir-fried pork/chicken with basil and a fried egg over rice. If you like dry, crispy basil, made with basil leaves picked from the backyard, you have to try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: akkrapol umavipata

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is tucked away in a corner, with a fruit stall next to Phutthabucha Road. If you don't pay attention, you wouldn't know it's a restaurant. There's parking behind the restaurant. The food is Thai, and we really enjoyed it. The stir-fried morning glory with shrimp paste – I'm not sure what kind of morning glory it was, but it was thin, light green strands neatly arranged – and the sour curry with acacia leaves and shrimp had a rich broth, almost like there was minced fish mixed into the curry paste (just a guess)... The catfish with chili and ginger, served with long beans, was also good... These were the restaurant's recommended dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siri

sample_reviews_en.text:
The air conditioning is good, and there's a spacious parking lot in the back. The staff is friendly, and the spacious atmosphere has a slightly retro yet country feel.
I tried a variety of dishes, and overall, they were all good. Maybe because I'm not used to Thai food, I didn't find it incredibly delicious, but I didn't find any of the dishes bad. Of the dishes I tried,
I think it must be a good restaurant for Thais because the locals enjoyed them so much.
I liked everything, but the 'Gaeng Som Kung Kai Chaom', 'Pad Kaeng Kiaowan Huo Kai', and 'Khao Pad Boo' were particularly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: 이경우 (디스케이스)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Thai restaurant near my house is delicious, reasonably priced, and very clean. I was impressed with both the food and the service from the elderly couple who own it.

We went as a couple and ordered four dishes. In the end, we ate only one meal and were full until tomorrow morning! It was like doing intermittent fasting (IF) at the same time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tal Ratchatawan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food has a light flavor. On the day I went, I ordered fried fish cakes, stir-fried sweet potato leaves with eggs, sun-dried pork, and sour curry with acacia leaves and shrimp. I liked the stir-fried sweet potato leaves the most. The restaurant has a traditional house atmosphere and there is parking behind the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wit

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a clean restaurant with a good atmosphere and top-notch ingredients. They use fresh ingredients every day, with a strong flavor that appeals to the Thai palate. The desserts here are also very delicious. For the quality of the food and the price, out of a full score of 5, I give it 4 points.
sample_reviews_en.author: พระนาย สีหนาทโยธาเทพ

sample_reviews_en.text: The hot food was delicious and satisfying. I recommend the stir-fried morning glory with shrimp paste, the stir-fried catfish with ginger and chili, and the clear soup with seaweed, tofu, and minced pork.
sample_reviews_en.author: Duangkorn Thussaneekulkij

sample_reviews_en.text: This Thai restaurant serves made-to-order dishes in a cozy, homey style. It's clean, has good service, and a good variety of dishes. There's also parking available behind the restaurant. Give it a try! 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Wittaya M

restaurants.name: TAJIMAYA mini
restaurants.address:

PGHM+JJQ, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Today was my first visit, and the air conditioning was broken. We had to open all the doors to ventilate while we ate; it was very hot. We came during a 299฿ promotion for 70 minutes of unlimited food. The dipping sauces were standard. Each person could order one soup base. I ordered the dark sukiyaki soup, which was a bit sweeter than other brands. The tonkatsu soup was good at first, but became cloying after dipping the meat in it. The second soup refill was just hot water. The staff served the first round of food before we could order more meat. The chicken karaage was average. The beef curry rice was standard; the sirloin beef was decent for the price. Today I had lychee ice cream. The tables were very close together, with nowhere to put the meat trays or other items. The staff were attentive. If the price goes back to normal, I'd rather go to the main branch. (Parking at Thaniya Building is 50฿ per hour.)
sample_reviews_th.author: Kun กุน

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is open in two shifts: 11:30 AM - 4:00 PM and 5:00 PM - 10:00 PM. Last walk-ins are at 3:00 PM and 9:00 PM. You have 70 minutes to eat. The price is 299 THB net, no extra charges. They don't accept credit cards.

The restaurant is small with seating very close together. It's a little stuffy but not unbearably hot; they provide small fans. Each person has their own pot. Changing the soup costs 20 THB. Food comes out very quickly. The meat is good, but the cuts vary depending on the plate. The curry rice portion isn't large, but it tastes as usual. You can order raw eggs. The fried items are freshly made. The ice cream is amazing! Food comes out super fast, but the staff seemed tired.

For this price and portion size, it's excellent value. I'd definitely come back. The restaurant doesn't have a restroom, but you can use the one at Thaniya nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: N NS

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a great-value shabu buffet with a cozy counter-bar style. The menu is concise but the quality is good.

If you visit during peak hours, you might need to wait a little bit since seating is limited. Also, once you start getting full, you can just ask for smaller portions; the staff is super accommodating and happy to arrange that for you! (*Prices are now subject to VAT)

This shabu restaurant has become my regular spot. The food selection isn't huge, but what I eat is of good quality, which is more than enough.

The fried chicken is the best! It's fried to order, not pre-fried. If you're starting to feel full but still want some curry or ice cream, you can ask for just a small amount, and the staff will happily accommodate your request.

Seat is limited; you might have to stand and wait a bit during peak hours.

Prices are now subject to VAT.
sample_reviews_en.author: Namfon Viriyapongpan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tajimaya at Central World was my planned destination, and now I've finally visited.

I went in with low expectations, as it looked like there were only counter seats and the menu didn't seem to have much variety.
It turned out the beef, pork, and soup were all excellent.
The curry rice was a decent portion but flavorful.
The chicken karaage was also good.
The French fries were good.
There was nothing bad about it! 555
They offer one ice cream flavor per day, which rotates (I thought that was cute).
Overall, it was good and worth the price.

The atmosphere is nice; the restaurant is small.
At first, I thought there wouldn't be enough tables, but there was space above our table where the staff could easily place their food, which was convenient.

The staff provided excellent service; they were quick to respond and quick to serve.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisby

sample_reviews_en.text:
Satisfying and healthy meal for 369 baht.
The seaweed and dried fish broth has a good, well-balanced flavor that's perfect for sipping.
The fresh vegetables are clean and have beautiful leaves.
The sesame and ponzu sauces are delicious and to my liking.
The egg is fresh and of good quality, suitable for raw consumption.
The beef was a little tough, but still okay considering the price.
The pork neck was very tender and delicious.
Finally, the mango ice cream was great!

I secretly tasted the sukiyaki dipping sauce; personally, I found it too sweet.

The staff taking orders and the counter staff provided excellent service.
The food arrived quickly after ordering. Thumbs up!
sample_reviews_en.author: Untika

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu is small, but the quality is outstanding. The meat is incredibly good, everything is delicious. The appetizers are freshly fried to order, from the gyoza to the karaage – all fantastic. They serve individual pots, so you don't have to share. After your savory meal, don't forget to order the ice cream; it's amazing! There aren't many seats, and it can get a little warm if you sit under the air conditioning, but that's forgivable because the food is truly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panyawat Waitayin

sample_reviews_en.text:
• This was my first time eating here. It's a small, cozy place, a bit cramped.
But the individual hot pot is great.
• The meat is excellent for the price, exceeding expectations. The ramen noodles are delicious, and the overall ingredients are of good quality.
• The staff are cheerful and friendly, chatting well with customers even when busy. They don't frown, and the food arrived quickly. Kudos to them!
• I will definitely be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: kEnEmEyE

sample_reviews_en.text:
It used to be 299 THB until recently, but the price has now gone up to 369 THB. Still, I think it’s good value for money.
The beef wasn’t very impressive, but the pork tasted much better. I also like that you can get plenty of vegetables here.
By around 7 PM the place was full, so I recommend coming around 6:30 PM to avoid the crowd. One downside is that the air-conditioning is quite weak, so it can feel a bit hot inside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gourmet Advisor

restaurants.name: 海味 Umi BKK at Gaysorn Village
restaurants.address:

999 Phloen Chit Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Had Umi Omakase Course (4,800 ฿) for lunch at Gaysorn. Nice environment and really friendly chef 👍 Waitress are also super attentive.

Service: 5 ⭐️
Food: 5 ⭐️
Environmenta: 5 ⭐️
sample_reviews_th.author: Kimberlyn Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came here for lunch, they have several types of Omakase to choose from.

I was a walk in, but still waited 20+ mins to a nearly empty restaurant. Thought I was forgotten outside the door, until one waitress came to get me after she went to the bathroom and realized I’m still there…when you’re in Thailand, expect to wait and wait.

The waitresses don’t understand much English, they could’ve explained some basics such as the difference with the 3 set menus and the type of fish that’s offered but that wasn’t communicated to me, it also took them several tries to understand hot tea and hot water, maybe that’s not their focus, the clean up was super fast and courteous which was a plus.

Food quality is good, but not that mind blowing fantastic compare to other sushi place back in the states. I like that chef was very precise and attentive to every step of the details, next time I’d definitely get the largest Omakase as it seemed to have way more varieties.

Overall decent place for sushi but the overall experience still feels a bit off when you compare to all other Michelin(equivalent-ish) sushi places in US & Japan.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cecilia Chang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had an omakase experience at 海味 Umi BKK in Gaysorn Village—pricey at 8000+ THB per person, but truly worth it. The meal was a stunning journey of flavors with highlights like the braised octopus, Uni Chawanmushi, abalone rice bowl, toro, and sea eel, all capped off with a refreshing yuzu sorbet. Each dish was meticulously crafted, making it a feast for the palate.

A couple of notes: there are only two seatings, so punctuality is a must, and reservations are essential. The evening had a slightly awkward moment with a diner presenting a portrait of the chef and filming excessively—it felt more like a show than dinner. Also, the chef’s heavy accent made some dish explanations a bit challenging to follow. Still, the food was absolutely impeccable. If you’re ready to splurge, Umi delivers an extraordinary omakase experience that’s hard to forget.
sample_reviews_en.author: Willie Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an ultra-high-end sushi restaurant in Gaysorn Village.
Apparently the main store was originally on Soi 49, but it appears to have closed down.

The chef is from Thailand.
Honestly, the level of perfection is extremely high, from the initial appetizers to the nigiri sushi.
It was on a level comparable to that of Japanese chefs.
Without a doubt, the quality of the sushi I have eaten abroad is the best.

There is no menu, only omakase courses.
The prices are by no means cheap,
but the attention to ingredients and the sushi techniques of the overseas chefs
make it a worthwhile experience that is different from eating sushi in Japan.

Reservations can be made easily online.
I thought it might be difficult to make a reservation at this restaurant,
but it was actually surprisingly easy to get a reservation.
sample_reviews_en.author: 谷口和也

sample_reviews_en.text: I wanted to express my disappointment with my recent visit to your sushi restaurant. While I was excited to try your establishment, I was disappointed to find that some of the fish tasted fishy and did not meet the high standards that I expected from a sushi restaurant of your reputation. Additionally, I noticed that the chef didn't seem to take much care in ensuring that we enjoyed our meal. I hope that in the future, you will take steps to ensure the quality of your ingredients and the level of service provided to your customers. Thank you for your attention to this matter.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Christian

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been to Umi Bangkok several times, and they never disappoint. This visit, I tried their new tuna course, and it was absolutely outstanding.

I couldn't resist adding an extra bite of bafun uni at the end, and it was the perfect finish. The fruit and dessert were also exceptional and completed the meal beautifully.

Considering the quality and experience, the price is very reasonable. Umi Bangkok continues to be one of my favorites, and I'll definitely be coming back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutchapol Thanyarattakul

sample_reviews_en.text: Visited recently. The produce was fresh, and the chef's technique was not bad. Overall, the quality of the meal was okay but not mindblowing. The appetizer was subpar, and tamagoyaki (not pictured) needs work. Anago wasn't all that melt-in-your-mouth. Uni was slightly briny but still serviceable. Apart from that, the neta was actually quite good; they had just received fresh produce in the morning. Shari was served slightly warm, which was good. The chef was rather quiet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sg Hungry Ghost

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the most Incredibly amazing experience in BKK.
Wanted to visit Omakasen cuisine in BKK badly, as the CP value is very high. Due to the bad weather, we planned to find somewhere very near the hotel, and we were fortunate enough to find this place.

Foods were amazing, and the chef was surprisingly professional (he is a Thai but spoken fluent Japanese). Highly recommended this place of you are craving for Omakasen like us 😋😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Celia Cheng

restaurants.name: CURRY HUB
restaurants.address:

ally 35, 5 Mana Witthaya Alley, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was great, delicious, clean, and hygienic—definitely not like in the videos. The staff gave pretty good recommendations about the food. The brioche was amazing; it felt like eating in real India. As for the appetizers, I can't remember the names, it was my first time trying them, but they tasted good and would be perfect as an appetizer before the main course to whet the appetite.
Finally, I would recommend the restaurant add Hani Puri to their menu. Indian people know the difference between Hani Puri and other Indian dishes, which would give them a more complete understanding. Honestly, for me, Hani Puri is harder to find at Indian restaurants in Thailand, and importantly, they give a generous portion at a reasonable price.
Overall, I loved it. 10 out of 10 stars, no deductions.
sample_reviews_en.author: phannamas puttang (pinkpanther)

sample_reviews_en.text: This is delicious Indian food, easy to eat. The creamy curries are just right, not too thick. The bread dishes like naan, pani puri, and pabdi chat are incredibly tasty; the bread has a great flavor of its own. The Mutton Masala is rich and flavorful with plenty of gravy. The atmosphere is relaxed, the staff are polite and provide good service, and they speak and understand Thai. The prices are also good, not expensive. I will definitely come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicharee S

sample_reviews_en.text:
A new restaurant has opened in my neighborhood. I believe it’s one of the first authentic Indian restaurants in the area.

For Thai curry lovers, I always love the thick, creamy, and layered aromas of Indian curry. Of course, butter chicken is a must-try. But I recently discovered a new curry that I love even more: Dal Tadka. It’s earthy, warm, and homey. After eating it, you feel like your heart and body are one level more comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suphanat Rodwanna (Moss)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had an amazing experience here! The butter chicken was absolutely delicious—rich, creamy, and perfectly balanced with spices. You can tell the ingredients are fresh and the dish is made with care. The garlic naan paired perfectly with it too.

The staff were very friendly and attentive, and the overall atmosphere was cozy and welcoming. Definitely one of the best spots around for Indian food. Will be coming back again for sure!
sample_reviews_en.author: Panthep Pandey

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of the finest Indian restaurants I've visited in Bangkok. I've tried numerous Indian eateries, but their food was disappointing. However, at this place, everything is fresh and delicious. The ambiance is lovely, the service is speedy, and the food is absolutely tantalizing, not to mention the cheerful smiles of the staff while they serve.
sample_reviews_en.author: Surajsingh Kunwar2468

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentically delicious Indian food. Nice and clean atmosphere with good service. Top-notch 👌

I walked past this newly opened restaurant and went in without high expectations, but the food was incredibly delicious and perfectly balanced, just the way I like it as a Thai dish. I'll definitely be back! Extremely impressed!
sample_reviews_en.author: May Chanpalangsri

sample_reviews_en.text: Sooooo good!!! Unexpectedly sooooo delicious, especially the freshly made butter chicken 🥰 The curry was freshly made, flavorful and very tasty. The storefront might look a bit confusing, but once you go inside, it's great. The restaurant is spacious, the tables are large, and there's a little parking space in front.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicharee Kitiveshphokhawat

sample_reviews_en.text: This place has just opened recently and has the most Amazing authentic Indian cuisine. My first time here and won’t be my last. I forgot to take a picture of the food, however it was served hot and tasted delicious. My favourite was the spicy paneer butter masala and the cheese naan … and the mango lassi👍🏼 10/10 .
sample_reviews_en.author: Kyle Hobson

restaurants.address:

17 Si Lom 3, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I arrived right when they opened at 7am. It's a simple building, like a prefabricated structure. I was aiming for the seafood gapao, but there are many other items on the menu. They didn't understand what I meant by "seafood," so I insisted on "fish" and managed to order. Later, I used Google to add shrimp. A simple gapao with white fish and shrimp!
It seems that if you order the seafood version, it also includes squid. The white fish was fluffy and delicious. The shrimp was, needless to say, excellent. The seasoning was exquisite. My only regret is that I forgot the egg... I will definitely visit again. Next time, I'll have to try the tom yum goong that the person next to me was eating, as it looked very delicious. Thank you for the meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: baddydog

sample_reviews_en.text:
What's particularly noteworthy is that you can't find another restaurant that opens at 7 AM, serves affordable Thai food that Japanese people would likely enjoy, and has a clean and pleasant atmosphere.

While it's great for a regular lunch, the fact that it's open early is a lifesaver for breakfast before checking in on an early morning flight, or for those who want to enjoy one last Thai meal before returning home.

The taste and quality are also exceptional, far exceeding what you'd expect at this price point—in fact, it surpasses many more expensive restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: TONとん

sample_reviews_en.text: They offer both single-dish meals and dishes to share. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, like eating at home. The food tastes good, especially the stir-fried tofu with mixed vegetables and the chicken with black pepper. After the savory dishes, they offer free dessert (grass jelly on the day I went). The prices are also very reasonable; for 5 people, it came out to less than 100 baht per person, which is great value. A word of caution when eating here: you have to walk along a relatively narrow street with no sidewalk, so be careful not to get hit by a car.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prasittichai Kerdlapphon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food, free dessert. Recommended to reserve and order in advance.

- The à la carte dishes are flavorful and spicy – ​​the best in the area.
- My frequently ordered dishes: Tom Yum Fried Rice, Canned Fish Fried Rice, Kale and Pork Fried Rice with Fried Egg.
- Free desserts are randomly selected; you can scoop as many times as you like. Some days they have grass jelly, sticky rice balls in coconut milk, banana in coconut milk... delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dallaso

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious, and there was free dessert too. Truly satisfying and delicious! (Forgot to take pictures again!)
Today I ordered several dishes: chicken with chili paste, stir-fried glass noodles, and another dish with squid that I can't remember the name of. The flavors were strong and delicious. It was stir-fried with onions, similar to a salad or a stir-fried chili dish. Delicious!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Otapa Smitabindu

sample_reviews_en.text: This air-conditioned restaurant in the Silom area serves made-to-order dishes. It's spacious, clean, and can accommodate many people. The prices are standard for this area, starting at 60-65 baht. The portions are appropriate for the price, and the taste is quite good. The owner is friendly and even offers free dessert, which is a lovely touch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pearploy Stp.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Taste is good.
But so much time, wait.
About 30-40.not come drink also.
No good service.
And, glass is not clean.
Keep dust.
I pour water, then cannot drink.
I pour sprite, then cannot drink.
Because not enough clean.
I told to staff two times for clean.

And, calculate water and Sprite.
Not apologize.

Must improve for staff training.....
sample_reviews_en.author: Shigetoshi Higuchi

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a haven for office workers in the area.
The prices are reasonable, and the taste is absolutely delicious!
They offer free desserts every day, with rotating options like banana in coconut milk, sticky rice balls in coconut milk, grass jelly, etc.
I recommend calling ahead to reserve a table if you plan to eat here during lunchtime.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supawit Sintusakk

restaurants.name: Fuse Bistro
restaurants.address:

911 Ramkhamhaeng Rd, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It was a restaurant with an atmosphere that made it impossible not to finish all the remaining soju on the last day of the trip. The outdoor tables were really cool, and as the sun set, it felt like being at a Korean outdoor market. With delicious food and hip background music, I simply couldn't resist drinking soju.
sample_reviews_en.author: D.W.C Love

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the atmosphere is great. The owner speaks English, so it would be good to go there at least once. If you don't like coriander, it would be a good idea to ask them to leave it out in advance. They are very kind. If you come to the area, it would be good to go there.
sample_reviews_en.author: 김지민

sample_reviews_en.text:
A nice Bar near Ramkhamhaeng BTS Station...
Pool Table in Indoor & Outdoor space with Live Band...
It's good to chill with the friends in evening till late night...
Foods are good but a bit pricey...
sample_reviews_en.author: Mashi Khana

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food, great atmosphere, perfect for hanging out with friends and chilling out. The music is lovely, the service is impressive. I love this place and come here often. I give it 10 stars!
sample_reviews_en.author: Naruemon Sangsuree

sample_reviews_en.text: This bar is good have Singer sing a good English music,place is nice open place good atmosphere,good waitress
sample_reviews_en.author: Chona tumulak

sample_reviews_en.text: A cool bar at night, where you can enjoy a beer and a meal at a table. There's also a live stage.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bretla

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice open air venue with pool billiard and sports TV. Didn't try the food but looks good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Reinhard Neureiter

sample_reviews_en.text: Good food.. good live music  with pool table and very cooperative stuff and owner too
sample_reviews_en.author: Pradeep Karwande

restaurants.name: ร้านราเมง โอชิน
restaurants.address:

ร้านราเมง โอชิน Hua Mak 13, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The staff were attentive. The pork shabu rice was delicious (89฿). The karaage chicken was crispy and hot, just right. I recommend coming here. The price is not expensive at all.
sample_reviews_th.author: Tamonvan Somboon

sample_reviews_en.text:
During a visit with my family, we decided to try out this restaurant and ordered their ramen along with some craft soda. I must say that the ramen itself was quite good, with a flavorful broth that left a satisfying taste. However, I found the chashu (sliced pork) to be just average in terms of taste and tenderness.

Despite its small size, the restaurant had a cozy and inviting atmosphere, which added to the overall dining experience. It provided a comfortable setting for our meal, allowing us to enjoy our time together.

One of the standout aspects of this restaurant is its affordability. The prices were reasonable, making it a budget-friendly option for those looking to enjoy a satisfying meal without breaking the bank.

In conclusion, while the ramen and soup were enjoyable, the chashu could have been better. Nonetheless, the cozy ambiance and affordable prices make this restaurant a decent choice for a casual dining experience with family or friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kowit Char

sample_reviews_en.text:
My personal ramen tastes a bit ordinary. The pork is tender, and the soy sauce doesn't have much of a soy sauce flavor, more of a dried bonito flakes smell. The tonkatsu soup is well-balanced and not overly rich. Overall, the flavor is acceptable. The chicken karaage is delicious, fried to a crisp. The mayonnaise sauce mixed with a bit of wasabi enhances the flavor and cuts the richness nicely.

My personal ramen tastes too ordinary: the pork is tender, and the soy sauce doesn't taste much; it's more the smell of dried bonito flakes. The mellow taste of the tonkatsu soup isn't very rich. Overall, the flavor is available. The chicken karaage is delicious, deep-fried, very crispy, with mayon sauce mixed with a bit of wasabi. It enhances the taste and cuts the greasy texture well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirilug T.keerati

sample_reviews_en.text:
This small ramen shop is decorated in a Japanese style, creating a nice atmosphere. It's conveniently located on a main road. The menu features Shio Ramen (a clear, rich, salt-based broth ramen), Shoyu Ramen, and Miso Ramen, all with thick, tender, and large slices of Chashu pork. Besides ramen, they also offer various rice bowls (pork and beef), Tonkatsu (crispy, hot pork cutlet), gyoza, and a variety of cold drinks. The prices are reasonable. A must-try for ramen lovers!

Price: 5/5
Quality: 5/5
Taste: 5/5
Cleanliness: 5/5
Speed: 5/5
Service: 5/5
Location: 5/5
Value for Money: 5/5
sample_reviews_en.author: Akapatr Chiraarreebutr

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small but inviting restaurant with indoor and outdoor seating. The restaurant is located on the roadside. Open during two hours: 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM and 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM.

The tonkatsu ramen is delicious, and the soup is flavorful.

I like the fried gyoza, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.

The shio ramen (clear soup) is delicious, and the clear soup is flavorful.

There's parking behind the restaurant. The service is good, and the menu is comprehensive. The food comes quickly. The quality and quantity are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: charat thangwongchuket

sample_reviews_en.text: The cold soba noodles were delicious and very refreshing. The fried pork salad was amazing; I loved the chewy texture of the pork. Most importantly, the homemade ice cream made by the owner was incredibly delicious! The Hokkaido milk flavor was fragrant, creamy, and so good. But hey, there's something even better: the purple sweet potato ice cream! It's so good, it has chewy pieces of sweet potato in it, and the sweetness is just right. I'll save up to try the other flavors later.😅 P.S. I didn't take a picture of the ice cream.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patsika SPM

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ramen, If someone want to eat some ramen i would recommend you "Tonkatsu" one of the best menu. A soup is so smooth served with Homemade ramen noodles all in one dish and    their menu is not much with 3 ramen, Fries chicken,Gyoza,and 2 menu of Rice. And Soda crafts drinks that you should eat combo with.
They're a small ramen restaurant near a road and have a car park inside but it's limit. Open at 17:00-22:00.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noa Noël

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a small ramen shop I went to last Wednesday. There's parking available at the back. The atmosphere is nice, but it might get a bit crowded if you go with a large group. The pork was so tender it melted in your mouth, and the broth was to my and my boyfriend's liking. The price is reasonable, and they have ice cream for dessert. It tasted great, and I'll definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: APPLE PPN

restaurants.name: ณ ชุมพร at บางกอก
restaurants.address:

185 ซอย 27 คลองจั่น Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you think you've been to many delicious restaurants already…
Please leave a little room in your heart, because this place is on a quiet, mind-blowing level of culinary excellence 🤯

A hidden gem that only those in the know will recommend.
Every dish is crafted with intention, every bite with meticulous attention to detail.
Fresh, high-quality ingredients, professionally balanced flavors.

It's not just about being full…it's an experience.
That will make you stop talking and focus on tasting.

If you’re in Bangkok and craving an unforgettable Thai dining experience —
Na Chumphon is a must.

This hidden gem delivers flavors that go beyond expectations. Every dish is crafted with precision, passion, and premium ingredients, bringing authentic Thai taste to a whole new level.

It’s not just a meal — it’s a journey of flavors.
Every bite tells a story. Every plate is thoughtfully prepared.

If you leave Bangkok without trying Na Chumphon,
you didn’t just miss a restaurant —
you missed one of the city’s best-kept culinary secrets.

Come hungry. Leave amazed.
sample_reviews_en.author: phurichayapat tessana

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in Sinthorn Village, near Happy Land Soi 1/the road opposite The Mall Bangkapi. It's almost at the end of the soi (Soi 27), in a townhouse with the ground floor converted into a restaurant. There's no parking; you'll have to park discreetly at the entrance of the soi (parking near the restaurant will block other residents' houses).

The food has a moderate flavor, not overly spicy like typical Southern Thai cuisine. The ingredients are good, the portions are generous, and it's good value for money. The staff are friendly and smiling.

The restaurant isn't very large, ideal for groups of 3-4 people per table. There are about 4 tables inside and 2 more outside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pathitta D.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted great, everything was delicious, perfectly seasoned and flavorful. The atmosphere was like having a meal at a friend's house. It's a small restaurant in a house, offering a full range of savory dishes, desserts, and drinks. The air conditioning was cool, the music was nice, and the ambiance was great. The owner provided excellent service. Most importantly, the prices were very reasonable. We spent just over 1,500 baht and ate until we were completely full – we couldn't even finish everything! 🥰🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: จิตราภรณ์ โตสุข

sample_reviews_en.text: This home-style restaurant has a limited number of tables, but the atmosphere is cozy. The food is served fairly quickly, so you don't have to wait long. It's not crowded, which is nice and relaxed. The taste suits people from all regions; as someone from Kanchanaburi, I really like this style – easy to eat, flavorful, and not too salty. I recommend calling ahead because there are limited tables. The prices are good and reasonable considering the quality of the ingredients.
sample_reviews_en.author: อําภา พรหมชนะ

sample_reviews_en.text: The squid with eggs is the best! The Southern Thai curry paste is very fragrant, the ingredients are high quality, and the restaurant pays attention to detail, resulting in delicious food. It's a hidden gem, and parking is available in front of the restaurant, though it can be a bit difficult to find a spot. It's best to call the restaurant beforehand to ask for directions.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lux Luxsa

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered from Robin Hood to eat at home. It's a restaurant with incredibly delicious sour curry, tasty mantis shrimp with chili, and excellent stir-fried Gnetum leaves in coconut milk. The squid with eggs was sweet and crunchy. They really pay attention to their ingredients and cook everything perfectly. I'll try visiting the restaurant next time. I'm very satisfied.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ammie Chan

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time here, and I have to say, this restaurant exceeded my expectations. Every dish was delicious, the service was lovely and friendly, and the prices were very reasonable. The fresh ingredients really brought out the best flavors! 😍🥰 It makes me want to come back here often when I crave Southern Thai food. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Mananpat Sriwongsa (NookNui)

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the cooking was excellent, the ingredients were fresh, and the price was worth the portion size. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, like eating at a friend's house. However, parking can be difficult as it's located in a residential area; you'll have to find parking along the village streets.
sample_reviews_en.author: Max Max

restaurants.name: Côte by Mauro Colagreco
restaurants.address:

300/2 ถ. เจริญกรุง Yan Nawa, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐ 1/5

A deeply disappointing experience, especially from a restaurant of this caliber.

I had made a reservation at Côte for a special occasion, only to discover that the table I had reserved had been released and given to someone else. Regardless of the explanation, I find this level of reservation management completely unacceptable for a restaurant that positions itself at the highest end of fine dining.

A reservation is not merely a request — it is a commitment between the restaurant and the guest. When people plan an important evening around that commitment, they expect the restaurant to treat it with the same seriousness.

What disappointed me most was not simply losing the table, but the complete loss of confidence in the restaurant’s ability to handle something as fundamental as a confirmed reservation.

I was extremely frustrated and ultimately decided to dine elsewhere instead.

Excellent food and Michelin recognition may attract guests, but professionalism, reliability, and respect for customers are what make them return. Unfortunately, my experience with Côte fell far below the standard I expected.

For a restaurant at this level, this should simply not happen.
sample_reviews_en.author: Save

sample_reviews_en.text: From the moment we were greeted at the door by the host, to the final bite of our decadent dessert, the entire dining experience was nothing short of exceptional. The service provided by Gift, Pepsi, and the rest of the wait staff was impeccable. They were attentive without being overbearing, quick to refill our glasses, and extremely knowledgeable about the menu. Gift, in particular, offered excellent recommendations and made sure we felt welcomed and comfortable throughout our meal. Of course, the real star of the show was the food itself, masterfully prepared by Chef Davide and his talented team. Each course was a work of art, bursting with fresh, high-quality ingredients and bold, harmonious flavors. The presentation was simply breathtaking, elevating the dining experience to a level of true culinary sophistication. The environment at Cote is equally impressive. The decor creates an atmosphere of refined elegance, while the intimate seating arrangement ensures a cozy and private dining experience. The restaurant's attention to detail complements the exceptional food and service. Cote is a true gastronomic destination. This Michelin starred restaurant is a must-visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eric

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had such a wonderful dining experience. Every course was beautifully prepared and thoughtfully presented. The flavours were refined, well-balanced, and you can really tell that a lot of care goes into every dish. They really put effort to understand customers preference.
What made the experience even more memorable was the service. Every member of the team was genuinely warm, attentive, and welcoming throughout the meal. They made us feel comfortable from the moment we arrived, and the hospitality was truly outstanding.
A special mention for families with young children while the restaurant offers a tasting menu, they don’t force kids follow the same course. Instead, they have an à la carte menu specially for children, which we really appreciated. It made dining with our child so much easier and more enjoyable, without feeling pressured to order a full tasting menu that might not suit younger kids.
Great food, exceptional service, and a genuinely family-friendly fine dining experience. We’ll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr. Rebecca

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything at Côte was simply fantastic from the moment we walked in. The service was flawless, warm, and attentive, setting the perfect tone for an unforgettable dining experience.

Chef Davide Garavaglia presented a truly creative and inspiring menu built around game and mushrooms, showcasing his artistry and passion in every dish. He personally attended to each course, explaining with great detail and care — it felt like a culinary performance.

Highlights of the evening included the monkfish, which was absolutely outstanding, the rabbit, which was executed to perfection, and the venison, which was rich and beautifully balanced. Each plate was crafted with precision, creativity, and elegance.

A sincere thank you to Chef Davide Garavaglia and the entire team for delivering such a memorable and world-class dining experience. Côte is without a doubt one of the finest restaurants in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohammad Farran

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited in Nov 2024

Ended up visiting Cote just 2 days after they got their 2nd Michelin star. So my expectations going in increased versus the time I had made the reservation.

The tasting menu comprised around 13 courses including the amuse bouche and petit fours. Other than the pigeon course, no other dish made me go “wow”, which is not what I expected. Maybe it’s just the current menu (as menus change with season) which I felt was not upto the mark of a 2 star restaurant. Having been to over 70 Michelin star restaurants, I actually felt that the current menu is at max a one star experience, and that might also be a bit generous.

Service was quite good. Absolutely no complaints there.

So overall, the dinner was a disappointment for me personally. However, different people have different flavour/taste preferences, and so it’s for people to try this place out and form their own opinions.
sample_reviews_en.author: Avijeet Sen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Argentinian master Mauro Colagreco was the first non-French chef to receive three Michelin stars at the famous Mirazur on the French Riviera. As a result, he has brought an impressive legacy to his restaurant, Côte by Mauro Colagreco, located at Capella Bangkok on the banks of the Chao Phraya River in Thailand.

While the elegant dining room overlooks the bustling 'River of Kings,' your eyes will be fixed on the clever menu titled 'From Riviera to River,' which combines French textures and flavors with traditional Thai ingredients such as lemongrass, ginger, and pomelo.

Serving lunch and dinner from Wednesday through Sunday, Côte by Mauro Colagreco allows guests to order individual menus or choose from 7-course or 9-course tasting menus. Notably, it features a rich choux pastry with chicken mousse, foie gras, and black trumpet mushrooms, served with black winter truffle sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: 김우성

sample_reviews_en.text:
Of the six restaurants from Asia’s top 100 that I visited on this trip to Bangkok, this one was my overall favourite.

It was also the second most expensive, although worth it! AUD760 for 10 courses plus optional cheese and 7 paired wines.

Service from each team member was exceptional and there was even a visit from the lovely Davide 🥰 I felt so welcome and entertained - very important for a solo traveller/diner.

Of the six restaurants that I visited, I only did three wine pairings (an effort to leave space for food!), and Côte was the best of them.

I was given a shawl and hot water and hot tea to drink whilst I acclimated to the AC. As someone who tends to drink hot water with food rather than cold, I love when there is the foresight to offer it before I even ask ⭐️

I fully intend to revisit on my next trip as I feel this one will be a lifelong favourite 🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: Monika Kryger

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had high expectations after seeing so many reviews on social media praising this place, but unfortunately, the 'Tribute to Tomato' course fell short.

The staff was lovely and attentive, checking food preferences beforehand. However, the flavors didn't wow me—the sardine was so fishy that I had to rush and swallow it and the oyster was also fishy.

When the staff asked which dish was my favorite, it was honestly hard to answer because none of them stood out.

Also, giving one tube of Raspberry Ketchup for two paying guests felt a bit stingy for a restaurant of this level. At other fine dining places, each guest always gets their own takeaway gift. It made me wonder—what if people came with friends who don't live together? How are they supposed to share one tube? Great hospitality, but need to think twice for a rebook.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chawisa NN

sample_reviews_th.text:
A fantastic place for authentic Thai food just a short walk from Khao San Road.
We had several dishes, including the Thai omelette, Tom Yum, Pad Krapow Gai (ผัดกะเพราไก่ – Thai basil chicken), and Laab Gai, and every single dish was excellent. Everything tasted freshly prepared with high-quality ingredients, authentic flavors, and just the right balance of spices. You can really tell that the kitchen takes pride in serving genuine Thai cuisine rather than adjusting the flavors for tourists.
The Tom Yum was rich and aromatic, the Pad Krapow Gai was perfectly seasoned with fragrant holy basil, the Laab Gai was fresh and full of flavor, and the omelette was simple but cooked to perfection.
If you're staying near Khao San Road and want delicious, authentic Thai food at reasonable prices, 168 Thai Restaurant is definitely worth a visit. We'll certainly be back on our next trip to Bangkok.
sample_reviews_th.author: Hans Meijndert

sample_reviews_en.text:
What an amazing random find in Bangkok.

I came across 168 Thai Restaurant completely by chance, and I’m so glad I stopped in. The food was absolutely delicious.

I ordered the Panang curry with chicken and jasmine rice, and it was excellent. Rich, aromatic and full of flavor, with a great balance of spice, creaminess and herbs. The sauce with the jasmine rice was especially good.

The chicken wings were fantastic too. Crispy, well-seasoned and incredibly flavorful, especially with the dipping sauce.

The restaurant has a charming, intimate atmosphere, the food is beautifully presented, and the prices are very reasonable for the quality.

One of those unexpected Bangkok finds that turns into a memorable meal. Highly recommended. I’d absolutely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeff

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wonderful!

This place is truly a GEM in the Wat Phra Kaew area. Starving and all sweaty from our exploration of Wat Phra Kaew, this cozy restaurant offered a much needed respite.

We climbed right away to the air conditioned room upstairs and ordered!

Each Thai dish came in such immaculate presentation (my photos will attempt to do some justice compared to actuality!).

Everything was just amazing. I’ve been to a lot of Thai restaurants, this place is definitely up there in terms of taste and authenticity. And the best part of it all. The price! Fine dining quality for such reasonable price, in this part of town! Truly a great find this restaurant.

And the staff was lovely as well!

Will surely be coming back…
sample_reviews_en.author: Roy Rodriguez

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered two dishes during our visit, the Pad Thai was decent, but it came with only two shrimp, which felt quite disappointing considering the price.
The bigger issue was the second dish. We waited around 35 minutes, and when it finally arrived, it was not what we expected at all. Instead of noodles with gravy, we were served a strange, thick mixture with pieces of meat that seemed to be boiled in water. The texture and taste were very unpleasant and we honestly couldn’t eat it.
It was a bit frustrating to wait so long and then receive something that didn’t resemble the dish we ordered. Overall, the experience was disappointing despite the Pad Thai being okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Blcx

sample_reviews_en.text: I recently visited this Thai restaurant and had a wonderful dining experience. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the staff were friendly and attentive throughout the meal. The highlight was definitely the Thai fried rice. It was perfectly cooked, with fluffy grains, fresh ingredients, and a rich, balanced flavor. The combination of vegetables, egg, and seasoning created an authentic Thai taste that was both satisfying and delicious. The portion size was generous, and the presentation was appealing. Overall, the food quality and service exceeded my expectations. I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone who enjoys authentic Thai cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: 慕葭

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Absolutely outstanding. I had the crab curry with aromatic herbs and jasmine rice, and the flavors were incredible. Rich, fragrant, perfectly balanced, and full of fresh ingredients. Every bite was packed with flavor without being overwhelming.

The presentation was beautiful, the ingredients tasted very fresh, and the whole experience felt authentic and thoughtfully prepared. One of the best meals I’ve had in Bangkok.

Highly recommended, and I will definitely be back.

😊🍛🇹🇭

Came back the next day for more, absolutely delicious.

The location is also  inna calmed street where the local handmade markets are. If you're looming for a place to eat which is small cozy economic price and local food thats the place!! :)

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant doesn't have a parking lot; you have to park on the side of the road. The prices are surprisingly cheap, and there are many other restaurants to choose from. The food came out quickly when I went; I didn't have to wait long. The flavors were very strong, leaning towards both salty and sweet. The glass noodle casserole was extremely sweet, the stir-fried liver was very salty, and the fried sea bass with fish sauce seemed to be made with frozen fish. The mango salad was also too sweet. The service from the staff was okay, not bad.

sample_reviews_en.text: Ratchawat Congee Shop is my partner's favorite place to order delivery. The food is delicious, especially the congee, which pairs great with their recommended sets. The staff are very attentive and helpful in explaining the menu. However, the fried pork belly was a major issue; it was extremely oily, with very little meat and a lot of fat. I definitely do not recommend ordering it. Crispy pork belly would enhance the flavor of the dish much more.

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. Please improve. The food was very slow to arrive, and the taste was just average. The staff seemed confused; the food arrived but no plates, spoons, or forks were provided. I wondered if we were supposed to eat with our hands. They didn't even serve plain rice. It was completely confusing. Plus, they made a mistake on the bill, with 2-3 items we didn't order. This is my first and last time here.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Central's first branch is located on Charoen Krung Road. This was the first store opened by the Chirathivat family and marks the beginning of Central Group's history.

From the outside, it looks like an office building not far from Assumption Convent School and the Mandarin Oriental Hotel, situated on Charoen Krung Soi 38. I've passed by it many times but never been inside. CENTRAL: THE ORIGINAL STORE is now accessible; a security guard will open the door for you. Inside, there's a café, a collection of valuable antique books, a quiet library area, and art on display. It's not crowded. Upstairs is a bar and restaurant that opens in the evenings. The space is warm and modern, and there's a hidden restroom that you wouldn't know is there unless you looked closely – and it's very clean. There are rotating art exhibitions. If you're in Bang Rak, you shouldn't miss checking out this hidden gem that few people in the area know about.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeabka Channel

sample_reviews_en.text:
An interesting shopping mall with a bookstore, exhibition spaces, a library, a restaurant, a bar, and a coffee shop.

In the 1950s, this was the only place in Bangkok where imported books and magazines could be found for sale.
And, as far as I understand, this was the first mall in the Central chain.

In 2020, the building was restored according to an architectural design project.

Today, vintage magazines such as Vogue, Time, Esquire, and others are available for sale on the ground floor.

The library offers interesting books.

The exhibition halls are quite small, but the exhibits are regularly updated.

The location is very close to Charoen 43 Art & Eatery, Mustang Blu, and Wallflowers Upstairs, which I mentioned above (you can find them under the hashtag #Bangkok).

#bookstore #gallery
sample_reviews_en.author: Anton Razumov

sample_reviews_en.text:
if you are interested in the origin or the rise of the Central Group which is the owner of department stores such as the Central Embassy, Central Rama 9, you should probably paid a visit to this address to explore, this is the location where the founders - father and son first started the business around year 1950, yes, more than seven decades ago in a small building doing retail business and operates a small restaurant, for more details i'd recommend visiting the website, for art enthusiast, please note that 3rd and 4th floors are usually used as art exhibitions for various talented and creative artists and i am sure you will be amazed

◆please give me a 'like' if you find my review useful, thanks a lot!
sample_reviews_en.author: dr ken chao

sample_reviews_en.text:
The original building, which housed the "Central" department store in 1950, has been renovated into a creative space with five floors. The first floor features a bookstore and souvenir shop, as well as the Siwilai Cafe, a spacious cafe with an open-air design that lets in natural light without getting too hot. The second floor houses a small library with a wide variety of books available for borrowing and comfortable, quiet seating. The third and fourth floors are dedicated to exhibitions and small events, while the fifth floor is a restaurant serving dinner.

I particularly like the redesigned staircase, which plays with lines and light – very stylish and cool.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuu T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Central Original 1950
Central Trading Department Store was the origin of the current Central Pattana Department Store.
Located on Charoen Krung Road, it has now been transformed into a museum telling the story of Central Department Store's history. The ground floor houses a souvenir shop and a coffee shop.
The second floor is a library with a wide selection of books, perfect for relaxing.
The third floor displays the history of the department store.
The fourth floor is a venue for various exhibitions.
The fifth floor is the Aksorn restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: chill ontheway

sample_reviews_en.text:
Central: The Original Store is located in Charoen Krung Road, walk-able from CAT and TCDC centre.

There are 5 stories. Lv. 1 provides you coffee and restaurant. Lv. 4 is a space for art exhibitions (which rotates every 2-3 months).

Souvenirs and books are also on both lv. 1 and lv. 2. Some are a bit pricey. Staff are willing to assist you. You can find many rare oldies books from here :)

They are the same owner as Central Embassy. Siwilai club is also located on the first floor, adjacent the book store/reception area.

Free entrant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donny Boonyamanop

sample_reviews_en.text: I passed by Shilongjun Road and discovered that this place was originally the original store of Central. It has been converted into a cultural and creative store. The coffee on the first floor is very good. There are also spaces such as a museum and library on other floors. The restaurant on the fifth floor does not open until 6 pm, so I didn't have a chance to visit it. But I heard that it is a Michelin-starred restaurant. If you happen to be passing by, you can stop by for a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: 泰國屁李พี่หลี

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is like a timepiece, taking us back in time to witness important events in the country. Along with the shop itself, there are books and antique items in pristine condition to admire and purchase, especially books. It feels like an escape from the hectic reality of the world, finding a warm and inviting place filled with countless stories. It was a chance to truly reconnect with myself. I will definitely visit again if I have the opportunity.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bodin Yaminda

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop combined many local food stalls (commonly separated) in one including braised duck, pork knuckles, chicken rice, fish noodles, and BBQ pork. I tried their braised duck and fish noodles. Overall quality was high.  What I like about this shop is their consistent operation, whereas some nearby five stars specialty shops can close without notice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Yeung

sample_reviews_en.text: The crispy pork rice is delicious, the noodles are very good, the fish balls are tasty, and the fried rice crackers in front of the shop are delicious. The food is prepared quickly, the wait isn't long. The shop is clean, and there's street parking in front of the shop. It's conveniently located.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nanat Chairoek

sample_reviews_en.text: The Hainanese chicken rice had tender chicken and perfectly cooked, non-greasy rice. The dipping sauce was tasty. The roasted pork rice had tender, not dry or tough pork, and the crispy pork was freshly fried, crunchy and salty. They're ready to sell by 7 am. Overall, it was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: N. sukkaluk

sample_reviews_en.text: For us, we really like the Yen Ta Fo (pink noodle soup) and the noodles from this shop. The Yen Ta Fo hardly needs any seasoning. Another thing we really like is the dry noodles, which comes with minced pork and shrimp meatballs – we love them!

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is colloquially known as "Khun Ben".  It is a favorite among locals in the area. They have many tasty Thai dishes that are priced fairly.
I recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting this area!

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an original shop at Bang Na Nok Pier Market. I used to live in the Bang Na area and have been eating here since I was a teenager. Today I had the opportunity to pass by and support them. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Chotika Putthikullapat

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant looks ordinary, but the food is surprisingly delicious. There are 4-5 food stalls in a two-shop space. I tried the duck rice and Hainanese chicken rice, and both were excellent. …

restaurants.name: ร้านอาหารปักษ์ใต้ช้อนทองชวนทาน

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is flavorful, but not extremely spicy like most Southern Thai food I've had.
I arrived at the restaurant around 12:30 PM, and many items were already sold out. The chili paste was probably all gone. People kept coming in, mostly regulars. I overheard them complaining that they arrived late and many items were already gone.

I tried the sour fish curry. The fish was fresh and in large pieces, with plenty of vegetables including pineapple. It was rich and spicy, but not overly so.
I had the stir-fried minced fish with chili paste for the first time. It wasn't too spicy either, and it was delicious!
The sweet pork and sweet and sour fish were both sweet.
The leftover pork with shrimp paste was given to me as a freebie by the owner.

If you can't handle much spice but like rich flavors, this restaurant is perfect.
The owner's mother and the young man working at the restaurant were very lovely and friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: C Muthita

sample_reviews_en.text: The seating area is airy and not crowded. There are many spacious tables under the trees, providing shade. The restaurant is clean, and the food is displayed in glass cabinets. Ice chests are provided for the vegetable sets, shrimp paste dip, and free ice (for dine-in only). The food tastes good and is delicious. Some dishes, like the spicy stir-fried pork with chili paste, are really tasty with rice. Many popular dishes, such as the stir-fried bamboo shoots, are frequently available and sell out quickly. The stir-fried pork belly with shrimp paste and stink beans is excellent, with a sweet and savory, well-balanced flavor. You have to order it to take home before it's gone! Customers keep coming in. There's ample parking around the restaurant. Fresh, clean vegetables are available for you to help yourself to while you eat. The staff provides good customer service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ndthlim

sample_reviews_en.text:
I drove past this place today after not being on this road for a long time. I ate here about 10 years ago or so. I stopped by today and it's still as delicious as ever. The shrimp paste chili dip is delicious, especially the one with sliced ​​mango. Free vegetables, clean, and affordable.
Good value for money.
P.S. Before commenting, I read some reviews.
Some said it was expensive. Today I had rice with two curries: catfish curry with cumin leaves and stir-fried minced pork with chili paste.
1 bottle of Coke.
65*15=80.-
*I'm a little confused about what's expensive about that.*
sample_reviews_en.author: Otto SayHii

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Southern Thai restaurant is located on Bang Chuek Nang Road, right at the entrance of a soi (alley) near the main road.

They offer a wide variety of Southern Thai dishes, served with rice or as side dishes.
Free vegetables and chili paste are available; you can help yourself as much as you like.
I've never seen a restaurant keep the vegetables in such a large cooler before – it's amazing!

The food tastes good.
The prices are mid-range to slightly high.
The owner is lovely and seems very willing to serve.
You can park right next to the restaurant.

sample_reviews_en.text: This local restaurant showcases the unique characteristics of Southern Thai cuisine with its distinctive flavors. They offer complimentary side vegetables and chili peppers that you can add as much as you like, and the food is excellent value for money considering the quality. Everything here is delicious, such as dry fish kidney curry, sour fish curry, pork rib curry, clam curry with betel leaves, and many more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Naruebedhbordin

sample_reviews_en.text: Google Maps said the restaurant was temporarily closed, but we still came to eat as usual. The food was delicious and spicy, but they also have omelets, stir-fried vegetables, etc., for those who don't like spicy food. They also have a fantastic shrimp paste dip to eat with a wide variety of fresh vegetables. For those who like desserts, they also sell delicious Thai sweets.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponpimon Satit Chula

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves the best Southern Thai curry. The fish kidney curry is top-notch, followed by pork rib curry, and they offer a variety of comforting clear soups. Freshly stir-fried shrimp paste chili dip is served free, a traditional local custom. I'm happy to see the restaurant maintaining this unique chili dip amidst the Bangkok economic climate.
sample_reviews_en.author: sumpun Thammacharoen

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop has been around for decades, selling from a boat moored in the canal in front of Wat Nang Bang Waek. It's currently run by the 3rd or 4th generation. The pork is very tender, available in both sliced ​​and minced versions, but I recommend the minced pork. My family has been eating here since the first generation sold from the boat; my grandmother was a regular customer. The shop is closed on Buddhist holy days. The congee is smooth, not grainy, and the flavor is simple and easy to eat. I highly recommend trying it!
sample_reviews_en.author: keaw nirvana

sample_reviews_en.text:
The congee itself is delicious, smooth, and finely textured.
The minced pork or pork slices are also flavorful, well-balanced, and tender with a chewy texture.
The ginger sprinkled on top is not too old, but not too young either, so even those who don't like ginger should be able to enjoy it. There's no soy sauce to add, only fragrant fish sauce and pickled chili in vinegar, which go well with the dish.
The only downside is that parking is a bit difficult.

sample_reviews_en.text: There were 3-4 customers waiting for their porridge, but instead of serving those eating in the shop first, they prioritized putting it in bags for delivery riders. Each rider got almost 10 bags. They didn't even tell us we were waiting. That's it, we're not waiting anymore. We canceled our order. There are many other shops that sell the same porridge. Never eating there again.

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! The aroma and taste are traditional. The congee is neither too watery nor too thick. A regular portion is 30 baht, and a special portion is 40 baht, which includes both minced and sliced ​​pork – very reasonable considering the generous portion size. The fried dough sticks (patonggo) are also delicious, 7 baht per bag.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chortip Kongpatanasin

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is unique. The pork chunks are finely minced and very tender. What's unusual is that they also have marinated pork slices, unlike anything I've seen before. They offer fish sauce for seasoning, whereas most places use soy sauce. Overall, I think it's good, and the price is reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: San Sheepsankel

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a congee shop I've been eating at since I can remember. The prices are affordable, and it's always delicious. They offer two types of pork: sliced ​​and chunky; I personally like both. You can park in the temple and walk across the street. The shop is closed on Buddhist holy days.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alicia

sample_reviews_en.text: This congee tastes so much better than it did 30 years ago. Before, the congee was like wet, sweet flour-like soup. Now, it's delicious, the congee is finely textured, the pork pieces are tasty, and the soft-boiled egg is perfectly cooked. The price is also very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: พรพิมล ธาราสายทอง

sample_reviews_en.text: It tastes good, I like it. But if you call to order in advance, based on my experience ordering twice, they always mess things up. I ordered minced pork and got sliced ​​pork. I don't know if it was the cook or the person taking the order who messed it up.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of my go-to restaurants that I could eat at every day without getting bored. Their mango salad and many other dishes are all delicious. Oh, and it's Halal-friendly too. It's located near Wongwian Yai train station. There's no parking, so I recommend parking at Talat Phlu market and taking the train one stop for a great atmosphere. But a taxi is the most convenient option.
sample_reviews_en.author: Samunya Mukarsa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Popular item, so expect a short wait.
Wait time, but not too long.
The vendor is friendly and doesn't get grumpy with customers.
Truly delicious and fresh.
Reasonable price and generous portions.
The shop is clean.

I also ordered mango salad with fresh shrimp (please ask for it to be cooked), which was delicious as well. The service was good.

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious, I have to say! The price is reasonable. Parking is inconvenient though. You have to walk into an alley next to the train tracks, not far, and the shop is a small, narrow shophouse with only 3-4 tables. But the taste and price are worth it! 😅😅😅 …

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! The mango salad was as spicy as the shop's name suggests. The owner was lovely, and the price was reasonable for the food. You have to try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Gus Nitithep

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious, the taste is always great, and it's prepared very cleanly. The price isn't too expensive either.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes great, it's delicious, clean, and affordable. The ingredients are fresh. I eat here regularly.

sample_reviews_th.author: Doctor ปึงปัง

sample_reviews_en.text:
🙏Grandpa, at 89 years old, spoke with a cheerful smile and full of energy, "I can't just stay home doing nothing, I'd get bored. I'm happiest when I can cook, meet, and serve customers like you. Good luck!"... He served traditional braised pork trotters with a savory Teochew-style broth, a recipe he inherited from his ancestors and passed down since he was 22 years old.
🙏The meat and skin are chewy and delicious, the broth is fragrant, not overly sweet like modern versions, but incredibly charming. The highlight is the fried tofu, simmered in the broth for a long time until it has absorbed all the flavor. You absolutely can't miss it!
🙏There's no need to elaborate further, because Grandpa is a favorite of everyone from taxi drivers to several former prime ministers who sometimes visit him as a team after parliamentary sessions.
👍😊 If you haven't tried it yet, you absolutely must! It's on Rama IV Road, just before the Banthat Thong intersection.
May he enjoy good health for many more years to come.
sample_reviews_en.author: topinito S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Legendary pork leg rice. I just recently tried it. The old man might walk a bit slowly, but he's still skilled at making pork leg.

The rice is a bit hard, but not every grain is soft. The pork is well-boiled, soft and smooth. The broth is rich and salty. The pickled vegetables are delicious. It's 60-70 baht. Next time I'll try the pork intestines, as I've seen a lot of people ordering it.

📍 The location is incorrect, it's on the other side of the road next to Park Origin.

Grandpa Pork Knuckle Rice with a long history. Juicy, tender pork over rice. The gravy is quite intense towards salty. The rice may not be beautifully cooked to every grain, but it's better than many places with cheap, soft rice. I recommend trying it sometimes.

Note: The pin-up location is incorrect; it should be across the road near Park Origin Condominium.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karn Santidhananon

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here to experience good dining as I saw in social media about the grandpa owner. I thought it would be special, but turned out it made me upset that night.
I don't know but I think I got scammed here.
With language boundary, tried to request skin part of the pork knuckle, kinda hard but finally I got it right.
Later, I got shocked, they charged me THB 200 for the pork and another THB10 for rice.
I never got charged that high for eating pork knuckle rice with the same kind special request, even at Michelin Guide awarded restaurant in Bangkok so far.
Therefore I won't detail review about the taste, how good it is, because of my bad experience, in fact it tasted nothing spectacular, dark place and so damn expensive dining.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rbw dinata

sample_reviews_en.text:
Update April 21, 2021: I went today and the owner is back selling! I wish him good health so we can continue to enjoy his delicious food.

This famous pork knuckle stall in Saphan Lueang has been around for a very long time; it's a very old establishment. My favorite dishes are the pork knuckle and intestines – the flavor is great, not too salty, and the meat is tender. The prices aren't too expensive. I asked him, and he said there probably won't be anyone to carry on the business after his generation. That's a real shame. He's 85 years old now. As for parking, I parked on the side of the road with my hazard lights on, but after 7 PM you can park on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wisanu Saetae

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious without garlic and chili, Teochew style. I brought my own garlic ^0^ The flavor is well-balanced, not too strong, the meat is tender and easy to eat. The tofu is delicious. I haven't tried the intestines or the soup yet. I arrived almost at 8 PM, so I bought some to take home +1 (pork leg with only meat 150-.) Thumbs up! ^ ^
P.S. Updated closing time to 23:00.
sample_reviews_en.author: TaNnY

sample_reviews_en.text: I really felt the language barrier. I told the shopkeeper (not an old man) that I wanted two dishes for 60 baht each, but after eating, he charged me 160 baht. He said it was because they came with a boiled egg, but I didn't understand what he was saying. The old man remained silent. It's a real shame because they were so friendly when I arrived at the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: YUKO SSK

sample_reviews_en.text: I was so disappointed after wanting to try it for months, I found nothing special about this place except the price which was pretty much higher than many other places for same menu. The dish tasted okay. If you lived nearby, it's probably not a bad choice, but if you need to travel across the areas, I dont think it would be worth your time the best.

It appeared to be run by a husband and wife, and their daughter, who looked like a college student, spoke a little English.

I knew this spot since highschool, now it's been almost 10 years and the taste is still spot on, as always. Highly recommended.

It is really delicious. The portions aren't very large, so even though three of us ordered four dishes, it was just slightly unsatisfying.

I recommend it if your accommodation is nearby.

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating this since high school, and I still eat it now that I'm working. It's definitely delicious and perfect for those who love fried food. If you're nearby, come and try it!!

I used to eat there when it was still open in the alley near Sri Srisadu Girls' School.
It was delicious, I ate there when I was a student at Wat Sutthi School.

We believe that a lot of bathroom in Bangkok are liked this one.

Highly recommended

sample_reviews_en.text: Charming little restaurant! The food was delicious, made to order. The sauce that came with the chicken wings was really good, and we devoured our crispy pork and basil pork dishes (best ordered with an extra fried egg)!
sample_reviews_en.author: Marie J T.
