sample_reviews_en.text: stumbled upon this restaurant and we didn’t really have high expectations but the food turned out to be soooooo goooooood omg that crispy pork was so tasty, it might be one of the best crispy pork I’ve ever had ever !!!
sample_reviews_en.author: fonfon

sample_reviews_en.text: Good food and you can choose the level of spicy that you want. We took a beef basil and a duck egg and a crispy pork belly with basil and rice. Very delicious worth a visit for sure and the price is extremely good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aimee Dudley

sample_reviews_en.text: SO DELICIOUS !! Everything was very well made ~ fresh and flavourful. Highly recommend the garlic pork. Very reasonable prices. The atmosphere is very cute too, like a Tiny House (=^x^=)
sample_reviews_en.author: Chloe Watkinson

sample_reviews_en.text: A tiny restaurant food to cook order. Lovely restaurant, friendly staff. I think it is overpriced if comparing the portion. I had Pad Kra Pao Kai (chicken) with omelette: 105 THB.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wipawenee P.

restaurants.name: ร้านขาหมูนำชัย
restaurants.address:

143 Soi Phetchaburi 5, Thung Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I intentionally researched and saved this place as a must-try, besides the pork knuckle. I ordered a set of 'Pork Meatball Soup' to take home. It contained 6 meatballs and a pinch of minced pork for 50฿.

One time is enough. Just sell pork knuckle. The owner and staff were confusing; I waited almost 10 minutes while they were scooping, tying, untying, and retying the soup.

P.S. The plastic bowls are from my home, not the shop's. They shouldn't be charging extra for packaging.
sample_reviews_th.author: Thita D.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The owner is friendly and the food is delicious.

Large rice is 60 baht. Egg is 10 baht.

Please eat it with the garlic and chili peppers on the table. It is a perfect balance of sweet, salty, and spicy.

It is full of the atmosphere of a local market.

There are a lot of takeout customers, and it seems like a lot of locals come here too; it is quite lively.

The location is roughly in the middle of the block.

On the map, it looks like it is on the corner, but it is actually in the middle.

I found it by looking for a yellow street vendor sign.

It is inside the alley behind that street vendor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay-hoya Park

sample_reviews_en.text:
Our real intention was to just eat at Valen Chicken rice but we pass by this one and we really like to try it. So we still ate at Valen but on our way back, we ordered 1 extra pork leg with rice which cost only 60 thb but I also asked her to add 1 egg, so my total bill was 70 thb.

It was very good, the meat was so flavourful and tender and the rice is for 2 people.  It's better to go here by walking on the street, because there's no place to park. Dine in option is also available, though the place is not enclosed. It's just beside Sanook Laundromat and just across Mixue.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yoda Travels

sample_reviews_en.text: This stall offers noodles and rice dishes topped with a fried egg mixed with minced pork. For the rice dishes, you can choose your portion based on the number of eggs: one egg for 25 baht, two eggs for 35 baht, or three eggs for 45 baht. I ordered the one-egg portion to go. The flavor was decent, but I didn’t love that the egg was deep-fried—once placed on the rice, the excess oil dripped and spread all over the dish. As usual, I had to use Google Image Translate to understand the menu and figure out what to order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Claudia Duong

sample_reviews_en.text: The braised pork leg is delicious, especially the trotters. The dipping sauce is tasty, with fresh bird's eye chili and garlic to accompany it. The restaurant also sells braised pork leg noodles. It's located on Phetchaburi Soi 5. Parking is difficult. The prices are reasonable, and there's free self-service drinking water. This is the best braised pork leg I've ever had; I love the flavor. Anyone passing by should make time to try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: อมรรัตน์ กองสุทธิ์ใจ

sample_reviews_en.text: This was the first restaurant I tried after arriving at the hotel. The food was delicious, the rice was soft, and the pork leg meat tasted quite good. I added some vinegar to it and it complemented the dish well. The biggest drawback was that I saw a rat crawling around while I was eating, so I was quite concerned about hygiene. The food quality was good, and I hope the restaurant can improve its hygiene standards.
sample_reviews_en.author: Đinh Trần Khánh Duy

sample_reviews_en.text: This is hands down my must-eat Thai pork leg rice every time I visit Bangkok — truly a hidden gem! Tucked away in a local market where you rarely see any tourists, it feels even more authentic. Huge thanks to the local who recommended it! The pork leg is incredibly flavorful — the fatty meat and skin melt in your mouth, and the rich, sticky fat leaves your lips glistening with deliciousness.
sample_reviews_en.author: VKXK

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's so delicious. This is my go-to pork trotters dish in Bangkok. 120 THB is enough for a big meal, just add rice.

The broth is savory, the meat is super tender, and it doesn't smell bad. Serve with hot rice and fried onions, or even with sticky rice for even better results. Don't forget to add fried chicken from Soi 10.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andy Hasten

restaurants.name: อร่อยพาเพลิน ขนมไทยคุณภาพ รสชาติต้นตำรับ
restaurants.address:

ห้องเสื้อจิตภินันท์ 204 ซ 16 Chok Chai 4 Soi 14, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wow! This is my first time trying Thai desserts from this shop. Some items are standardly delicious, but many are the best I've ever had. The tapioca dumplings with pork filling are incredibly delicious, seriously! The ingredients are top-notch; you can really taste the difference. The pickled radish is also exceptional, and they use extra-light olive oil, perfect for cooking. They use far better ingredients than most other shops. It's unbelievably delicious!

The crispy salty snacks, banana chips, and banana cake are all amazing. And importantly, it's incredibly clean—like a hospital! LOL.

The owner and her sister are lovely, polite, spotlessly clean, and fun to talk to. The quality is so good! If parking is difficult, you might have to find a spot further away and walk back. You HAVE to come!! If you can't come in person, you can order delivery through any app. I'm speechless!

You absolutely can't miss the tapioca dumplings with pork filling, the jade jelly, the pandan custard, the organic black sticky rice, and the most fragrant pandan jelly in the world—made with carrageenan! It's amazing…
sample_reviews_en.author: David Lim (ขิงกี้)

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Aroi Pa Plearn" is a Thai dessert shop that truly caters to health-conscious individuals. Everything comes from carefully selected organic farms, such as the bananas and ginger, which the owner and her mother source from farms in northern Thailand, ensuring they are pesticide-free. This also supports local communities.
The desserts taste great and are delicious. The special thing is that they aren't overly sweet, allowing the authentic flavors of the ingredients to shine through, and making them feel healthy to eat. The attention to detail, from the sourcing of ingredients to the taste, makes this shop truly impressive. I highly recommend everyone try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Phusit Makmangme

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a small Thai dessert shop, but you can really feel the meticulousness and care of the owner. I ordered Bua Loy (Thai rice balls in coconut milk), and the flavor was perfectly balanced – fragrant, sweet, salty, and creamy. It was delicious served warm. The shop mentioned that they don't use artificial food coloring; all the colors come from natural ingredients like pumpkin, purple sweet potato, and pandan leaves, which is great.
The atmosphere of the shop is also very warm and inviting. The owner is lovely, friendly, and speaks politely. I will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gocharach K

sample_reviews_en.text: This Thai dessert shop pays great attention to the quality of its ingredients. The desserts are incredibly delicious, especially the tapioca dumplings with pork filling. The vegetables are washed thoroughly so they're not bitter at all. The owner, an elderly lady, and her daughter are lovely, kind, and polite. The shop is clean and the aroma of Thai desserts fills the air as soon as you enter. There's parking available in front of the shop, and the prices are very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: sanina thianp

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the best Thai dessert shop – authentic, delicious, and hygienic! 🤭 I'm not exaggerating, it's truly amazing. The flavors aren't overly sweet or cloying, which is perfect for me because I love sweets but don't like them excessively sweet. And the texture of the pastry, no matter what you order, is incredibly thin! 😍 Don't just take my word for it, come try it yourself!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lalida Tanchokee

sample_reviews_en.text: Thai desserts are made fresh daily. The bua loy (rice balls in coconut milk) uses natural food coloring. This shop is already popular on delivery apps, and customers are asking for a physical store. The owner provides excellent information about the desserts. The prices are under 100 baht, perfect for a drink to help sober you up after a night out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poonyanuch Paokunta

sample_reviews_en.text: The desserts, like Bua Loy (rice balls in coconut milk), Kluai Buat Chee (banana in coconut milk), Sangkhaya (coconut custard), Niao Piak Lam Yai (sticky rice with longan), and Sago with Pork Filling, are all delicious. The desserts aren't overly sweet; the flavors are well-balanced. The service from the staff is friendly and excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chouxs CC

sample_reviews_en.text:
The owner of the tailor shop, an auntie, loves making Thai desserts, so she sells them in her free time. They're delicious! Her Bua Loy (rice balls in coconut milk) is made fresh, bouncy, chewy, and not too sweet. The price is very reasonable, and it's made with tender coconut – absolutely delicious!

There are only 3 tables available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aomojang Thamrongwirachat

restaurants.name: Little Brother Thai Restaurant- South Pattaya
restaurants.address:

31 12 S Pattaya Rd, หนองปรือ Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Little Brother's Thai Restaurant in Pattaya delivered a truly exceptional dining adventure! The flavor journey began with deliciously spicy seafood noodles that danced across the palate. The roast pork noodles followed suit, bursting with rich, mouthwatering essence. But the coconut shrimp and roast pork soup stole the show - standout stars that elevated the entire experience. Beyond the tantalizing tastes, the affordability added to the allure. This cozy gem offers authentic Thai fare at prices that make the heart sing. For anyone seeking a quick, soul-satisfying Thai meal, Little Brother's is an absolute must. A vibrant flavor destination that will etch itself into your culinary memories of Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Jack

sample_reviews_en.text: Cant give an opinion on the food since I didn't get to eat. I entered the restaurant and sat there for ages, nobody came to offer a menu or see what I needed. On the other hand if you're feeling a heat stroke coming and need a place to cool off with no need to eat you can sit there for while I guess. I just walked a few meters down a side road and found a little restaurant where I was immediately handed a menu and brought my beer right away.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dilema S

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been coming here for several years, but the quality and taste of food has slowly been going down. Mussanan curry was dissapointing.  It doesn't look like the menu and the curry taste was too weak and too sweet for me. Service was not good.  The waitress didn't give me or show me where the silverware was.  I won't be going back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: L. L.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The portion size is a rip-off. In Bangkok, 300 baht gets you a huge bowl, but here it's 290 baht for just a tiny bowl of soup. This is really terrible.
The portion size is a complete scam. In Bangkok, 300 baht gets you a huge bowl, but here it's 290 baht for just a tiny bowl of soup. It's really awful.
•
sample_reviews_en.author: Kevin Chen

sample_reviews_en.text: "I had an incredible meal here last night. The flavors in the [insert dish] were perfectly balanced, and the [insert another dish] was cooked to absolute perfection. The presentation was beautiful, and you can really tell the chef takes pride in their food."
sample_reviews_en.author: Dinesh singh Singh

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice little shop. Tasty food tasting like home cooked. We had steam fish, omelette and tom yum prawns. Good service too. We found parts of the fish was undercooked, they took back and did it right for us without any complaints and with a smile.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tse Ming Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: Food is always amazing, delicious. Staffs are very friendly, smilling and very quick to serve. Everytime I visit Pattaya, I'll get food from this place. My go to place for tasting real thai food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Moshiur Khan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great place to eat delicious Thaï food and a good price. Best quality/ price value in the center of it all ! Kind and smiling waitresses.
I highly recommend their wonderful banane smoothie.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gregoire Comte Jacta

restaurants.name: Rasoi
restaurants.address:

1091/50-52 ถนน เพชรบุรี 31 Makkasan, เขต มักกะสัน Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent service with smile we were group of 28 only had half an hour to eat they made us all very happy and satisfied. We are group of people from three countries Canada USA & India . Taking cruise to Singapore from Thailand. We recommend this restaurant to everyone. Chef is excellent. Two Indian young boys serving in the dinning hall amazing service . We needed Kadak Tandoori Roti chef made it FRESH . We were not getting good Indian food for last three days . Rasoi did amazing job and changed our experience. Thank you . 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunil Bhardwaj

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a pleasant evening at Rasoi. The restaurant has a nice ambience with a modern yet traditional touch. The staff were friendly and professional, though service was a bit slow during the busy hours.
It’s a great place to sit back and enjoy a comfortable dining experience. The prices are fair for the quality and service offered. Overall, Rasoi is worth a visit if you’re looking for a calm and elegant place to dine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bobby bisht

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were 10 of us requested for Jain food thru our travel agent when we went to talk to the owner of the restaurant he was so rude , I have never seen any one in service industry “he said I have 150 people comes I do not change menu, you will eat what ever we put it on buffet. Not one item Jain food every item comes with Onion/Garlic.
I would strongly suggest to stay away.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mukesh Patel

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food here is above average and you would get an Indian feeling as if you were eating somewhere in India.

The owner specially arranged different food for us as well and was quite friendly as well. Would recommend a visit. Although the location could use an improvement but otherwise it was a place you could visit but not necessarily take a detour to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Priyanshu Bansal

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the good Indian restaurant you can find in Bangkok and near Indra Square. Have seen many Indian tourist buses have a stop here because of the same reason that it serves authentic indian food and being run by a Punjabi guy, the prep can be trusted...Tried my breakfast and lunch all the time for 3 days straight without any regret.
sample_reviews_en.author: Flavor Loop

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good option for Indian food.
1. Quality and taste of food is good. Majorly serves veg food with few non veg options in buffet.
2. Service a bit slow but still ok.
3. Location is good. Walking distance from Indra Square market.
Overall would recommend this place to eat tasty, good quality veg Indian food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dinesh Satra

sample_reviews_en.text:
Horrible attitude of the owner. When the restaurant is empty he is forcing to sit at the corner. Talks as if he is serving food for free. Came here just because our agent arranged food here.

Food/Dinner was not ready even after 8PM!!

Don't go here even if food is given free.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wilson Joy

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the many Indian restaurants here, the food was delicious and perfectly made. We were in a hurry so couldn't eat as much as I would have liked! The ambience is good. The staff is friendly. Must visit if you want to check out Indian style food in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Videep Desai

restaurants.name: La petite planete
restaurants.address:

WVFH+885, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time at this restaurant, and it compares favorably with other French restaurants in Pattaya, such as Freelax and Chez Philippe. I ordered the set menu (350 baht) which included homemade pate for an appetizer, salmon steak for the main course, and pudding for dessert. Every dish was absolutely delicious. The homemade pate was even better than the one at Chez Philippe. The grilled salmon steak was incredibly crispy on the skin, plump inside, and perfectly cooked. It was absolutely delicious. Perhaps because it was lunchtime and the restaurant was quiet, the service was generally impeccable. The baguette was warm, and they brought refills promptly if requested. I ordered two small bottles of beer for 140 baht and an espresso for 45 baht after the meal. While I ordered two small bottles of beer, I'd like to enjoy a quarter-carafe of house wine next time to relax and enjoy my meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: mimiruby RIKI

sample_reviews_en.text:
5-Star: Food (overall): Excellent cuisine for a small Deli in Pattaya, best that I have taste so far. Will defintely bring friends to try if there is opportunities

3-Star: Ambience: Unassuming, cozy feel Deli by the road

0-Star: Service: I was invited by the friendly Owner/Mgnr to try but service immediately drops to bottom. No one bother to give me menu until I ask a few times... Menu, food were always drop on my table with a bump & the servers do NOT even bother explain anything to me or give me my condiment rack...
I will defintely not return to try on my own even though I absolutely luv their food... but will bring friends here as they really serve good food
This is the only restaurant that I will NOT tip as its not only non-service, its rude...
sample_reviews_en.author: Akira, Tze Wei Toh

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent place! Friendly staff and delicious food. A Prix Fixe (fixed price) menu is available in addition to A La Carte. 320 Baht for 3 courses of quality food is a bargain. Choice of 3 starters, 4 main courses and 3 desserts. Fantastic! We had Pate and Pumpkin soup as starters. Served with fresh warm bread. Main courses were salmon fillet with a sauce on the side and mashed potato and fresh vegetables. Steak Tournedos was served with pepper sauce and was excellent (it was 50 baht extra IIRC). Desserts of lime sorbet and creme caramel. A carafe of red wine was 260 baht. Add in a coffee and water the total bill was 1040 Baht for a 3 course meal for 2 with wine. Exceptional value for money. Will be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eddie Manning

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐
La Petite Planète, right next to Tucom, is a small but exceptionally cozy restaurant with French/Thai cuisine. I opted for the small suggested menu and was immediately pleasantly surprised. The chicken curry starter was truly delicious—beautifully balanced and full of flavor.
All in all, I had an excellent meal here for a very reasonable, almost modest, price. The price-quality ratio is simply excellent. Definitely worth a try if you're feeling peckish and fancy something refined without breaking the bank.
A lovely place to remember. Top notch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bijna niveau 8.

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely disgusting, ordered dory fish and fries , after trying one of the fries I noticed they tasted of old oil mixed with vomit and plastic, I have no idea where they're getting their oil from , the fish was also under cooked, I picked all the pink bits out ,and the peas were hard n mouldy ,when I complained about the fries she gave me 2 croquettes only to my suprise they were cooked in the same oil 🤮🤢waste of money
sample_reviews_en.author: Omario Man

sample_reviews_en.text: Gone downhill alot over the years. Poor unfriendly staff, food does not resemble the photos on the menu. Frozen chips, and a small portion of them, three meatballs, the photo showed 5+. Sauce tasted like it comes from a can or bottle. The bread was the best thing. Won't be going back in a hurry! Overpriced for what you get.
sample_reviews_en.author: Simon Bubear

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the special for 350 bath.
As appetizer the pate was excellent. Main course pork was a bit low quality. Not bad but also not great. Caramel custard for desserr was also very small without much flavor.
Service was ok.
Nit a bad meal at all but also nothing that would bring me back.
Always good to try new places
sample_reviews_en.author: W DV

sample_reviews_en.text: Went for Lunch.  Had the 3 course special.  Egg mayonnaise starter. Tasty fresh and good portion. 3 slices French baguette was warm and great.  Had the steak for main with pepper sauce.  Cooked perfectly. Lemon sorbet for afters.  All good portions. Great flavours.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tim Mutimer

restaurants.name: Shinkanzen Sushi เดอะ พาซิโอ กาญจนาภิเษก
restaurants.address:

8/1-5 Thanon Kanchanaphisek, Sala Thammasop, Thawi Watthana, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went in and sat down. There weren't many customers at the time. The staff only gave us a menu, not a QR code to order. We had to ask for it to get it. After ordering, we waited quite a long time for the food. The staff didn't seem very attentive to customers. We tried looking around several times to get their attention, but no one paid any attention. We had to wait for the receptionist to be free before we could speak to a staff member.
The salmon sushi came relatively quickly, but the ramen took about 25 minutes. We had to ask the staff about it because we didn't know if they were making it or had forgotten. The ramen was delicious for me, as I don't eat spicy food, but my boyfriend said it was just okay, not bad. In short, taste is a matter of personal preference. The salmon sushi wasn't smelly or fishy.
I actually wanted to order another bowl of ramen, but since the first bowl took so long, I decided to just eat what I had ordered and leave.
sample_reviews_en.author: D Sarocha

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was polite, the restaurant looked clean, and the food in general was delicious, especially the eel, which was amazing, and the various rolls, which I order regularly.

…However, today I tried the rice bowl with fried beef, and it was terrible. It was greasy, salty, and not tasty at all. The batter was extremely thick, really like thin slices of ground hamburger patty coated in batter and fried. At 99 baht, it seems cheap, but I think it's not worth it. You should sell it for 129 or 159 baht but improve the quality; that would be better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brad Lorroongroj

sample_reviews_en.text:
Salmon sushi is 11 baht per piece. I like the plain, grilled (no sauce), mentaiko, and cream cheese versions. The other options have sauces that are a bit too sweet. You can order the plain grilled version without sauce. The salmon is quite good, but the rice isn't too firm. The wasabi is tasty.
Matcha cheesecake is good, 39 baht.
Catalana peach cake is good but the slice is a bit small, 39 baht.
The food is slow to arrive; I waited about 15-20 minutes after ordering. The walkways are wide, and the seating isn't cramped.
sample_reviews_en.author: Almagiro 1

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a budget-friendly sushi restaurant offering both dine-in and takeout. For dine-in, orders are placed via QR code, and the menu can be a bit confusing. The in-store internet connection is also weak, causing the ordering system to malfunction.

The restaurant isn't large, but there's sufficient seating. Overall, the atmosphere is pleasant and not cramped.

The ingredients are of average quality, reflecting the low prices. The sashimi is reasonably fresh, but not outstanding compared to other restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: pakinai kasiwat

sample_reviews_en.text: Giving it a third try is no use. I'm done with it. I used to eat there when I was a teenager, back when it wasn't as popular as the Kaset/Union Products branch. It was much better then. Now, the quality of the ingredients matches the price, and the taste reflects that. The sushi rolls are machine-printed, I didn't like the eel at all. The foie gras was okay for 65 baht. Beware of the fake wasabi that could kill you (it's extremely pungent, don't put too much!). The staff provided good service though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Let's Go! Journey

sample_reviews_en.text:
Per standard for Shinkansen really (minus the grab-and-go option, they don't really have that at this branch I think). You can order to pick up on Grab or Shopee food though.

Still got all the same menu as every other branch. It's usually quiet so that's pretty nice. Fish are pretty fresh. It's not sliced disgustingly thin. Good value for sure.

It can be kinda hard to find a parking lot if you come during busy time like Friday evening or weekends.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Angry Stringinstrument

sample_reviews_en.text: The large, red-shirted staff member wouldn't let us choose a table, and spoke without any politeness. We waited a long time for our food; it said "order completed," but the food never arrived. Even though the tables were full, another staff member offered to add more tables, and we asked if we wanted to. We said no, but the staff member still didn't say anything politely. This shows a complete lack of manners.
sample_reviews_en.author: C P

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't know if it's just this branch, but I've been here several times and haven't been impressed. The fish isn't very fresh; some pieces have chewy skin. Plus, the wait is long. For some dishes, if you eat in the restaurant, you have to wait 40 minutes (based on the order time on the QR code website; it's very popular, and there were delivery riders waiting in front of the store when I arrived).
sample_reviews_en.author: NuTNNuT (NuT)

restaurants.name: พรแจ่วฮ้อนอีสาน
restaurants.address:

140 หมู่16 Nakhon Kuan Kan Rd, Bang Phueng, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I tried "Porn Jaew Hon Isaan" after seeing many positive reviews, and I can say I wasn't disappointed. The Jaew Hon soup is fragrant with herbs, has a rich, authentic Isaan flavor, and is perfectly spicy – ​​very comforting to sip. The longer it simmers, the more mellow and flavorful it becomes; it's not bland or cloying.

The ingredients are excellent value for money. The selection is generous, with plenty of fresh meat, pork, liver, and meatballs. The vegetables are clean and fresh, and the dipping sauce is the restaurant's signature spicy, sour, salty, and flavorful sauce – a perfect combination.

The restaurant atmosphere is friendly and homey, comfortable and spacious, ideal for dining with friends, family, or for a post-work dinner. The price is reasonable considering the quantity and quality. Delicious, satisfying, and great value!

Overall, I was impressed with both the taste and the value. If you like Isaan food, especially authentic, spicy Jaew Hon, I highly recommend trying this restaurant. You won't be disappointed! 👍🔥
sample_reviews_en.author: Rain ^^

sample_reviews_en.text: This Isaan food stall in Bang Pueng has been an institution for 40 years. I've known it since 1998 and think it's a place you simply have to eat every now and then! The menu isn't huge, and it could be a bit tidier and less worn. But perhaps it's precisely these things, along with the typical flavors of northeastern Thai cuisine, that keep drawing people back.
sample_reviews_en.author: J K

sample_reviews_en.text: This Isaan-style restaurant, their fried beef is incredibly delicious, I highly recommend it. Everything else is amazing too. Once you've tried this place, you won't want to go to any other restaurant, seriously.
sample_reviews_en.author: ทยา วงศ์กําแหงหาญ

sample_reviews_en.text: There weren't many people, but the service was slow. The taste was okay. It's easy to understand that the seller acts according to their mood, not in order of the queue. 🤔 …
sample_reviews_en.author: C-ann chanvicha

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything is delicious. I've been to this restaurant many times. The staff provides good service. The food comes out quickly. The taste is good. The price is not too high.
sample_reviews_en.author: พลอย ไพลิน

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been there and the food wasn't to my liking, it wasn't worth the price (it was too expensive and the portions were small), and the staff weren't friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: ศรีสุดา พันคําภา

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a small restaurant at a three-way intersection in Phra Pradaeng, but almost everything is delicious. Grilled beef brisket, hot pot, and more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phaksith Boss

sample_reviews_en.text: Every time I come, it's delicious. I recommend the appetizer, the Phra Pradaeng peanuts; it's amazing with a cold drink.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tantawat Krutman

restaurants.name: Oaker Steak
restaurants.address:

116 18 Phet Kasem 10/1 Alley, Wat Tha Phra, Bangkok Yai, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Update. Still one star, they're still trying to prove it's a ribeye, but it's 100% pork! And no one gave me anything for free! Don't lie!

Of course it's surprising. I came in terribly hungry, hadn't eaten for 24 hours, and was impatiently waiting for the ribeye. Disguised as medium-rare beef, they brought me raw PORK! As if I couldn't tell the difference between the look and the taste, I even checked it online just to be curious.
I don't eat pork at all.
So, for about 20 minutes, they were foaming at the mouth trying to convince me it was a ribeye steak (they even called the owner to tell me this personally 😄).

Finally, they offered to remake it as fish. The fish was terrible, I only ate it to keep from fainting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Дарья Новгородова

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, great value for money. I ordered medium rare and it was truly medium rare, which was perfect. I highly recommend it. I finished the whole plate. The meat was perfectly sized, and the garlic bread was also good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutthida Sutthidechanai

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is great! The food is delicious and affordable, and the service is excellent. I'm extremely impressed! I found it by chance but I really liked it. I'll definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rungriya Inthasean

sample_reviews_en.text: The grilled Dolly fish steak was delicious, tender and fragrant. They also have a combo promotion where you get a discount on the second piece.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarut Lau

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and reasonably priced. It's conveniently located near Tha Phra MRT station, and the restaurant is quiet and peaceful.
sample_reviews_en.author: จิรนันท์ จันขุน

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the portions are generous. The restaurant is clean and located right on the main road, making it easy to get to.
sample_reviews_en.author: int. twx

sample_reviews_en.text:
Came with my girlfriend couple days ago Food was good , steak well cooked . Very fast service and very friendly .
Thank you 🙏
sample_reviews_en.author: clement v

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a medium lair for takeaway but got a medium this time. That's the third time I've received that. I'm done with it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thwan Srivoravieng

restaurants.name: Bonchon Market Place Dusit
restaurants.address:

ห้องเลขที่ DST01LS105 ชั้น1 เลขที่ 157, 19 Ratchawithi Rd, Wachira Phayaban, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. Today, two of us went in. My friend ordered a bowl of Tom Yum Ramen, and I ordered a ramen and chicken set. We waited for a while, but only received the Tom Yum and chicken; the other bowl was missing. We waited for 40-50 minutes, but we were in a hurry to get to work. When we asked the staff, they said, "But you ordered everything, didn't you? You ordered a ramen and chicken set." We were shocked because we ordered clearly. My friend got her Tom Yum Ramen first, then I ordered the set. We were also wet from the rain and very hungry. We were very disappointed. The staff didn't apologize or show any remorse. Instead, they argued with us, saying, "You ordered a set." They didn't even ask if our food was complete when it was served. While we were waiting, we kept looking at the staff, wondering if they would come and ask if we had received everything, but they didn't. They just looked at us and walked past, completely ignoring us.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boon Ya

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant add 7% vat and 10% service charge. It means you have to pay nearly 20% above what you see from the menus. It’s absurdly overpriced with fried chicken which basically fried crusted flour. I have to say no for it after I have been there for hundreds of time and Ive just realized.
sample_reviews_en.author: sup prak

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch has excellent service. The staff are polite and friendly, although one of the cashiers lacked a bit of politeness in her tone. This branch isn't very crowded, so the wait for my order wasn't long. Everything tastes delicious, as I'm a huge Bonchon fan! 🫰🏻🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Nooknik Phasaranan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service at this branch is excellent, better than any other branch I've been to. The place was full, but the staff were smiling and very willing to serve.

Very impressed. The food also arrived quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: saiy s

sample_reviews_en.text:
The chicken wasn't juicy at all; it tasted like it hadn't been coated in sauce.
I've eaten at several branches, but this is the first time I've encountered this problem. 😔😔
sample_reviews_en.author: Supanida Somjit

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere here is great and beautiful, and the food is delicious.
It's perfect for a relaxing holiday.
The food is delicious everywhere, 10/10!
sample_reviews_en.author: fc zbing z.

sample_reviews_en.text: I've never actually eaten at the restaurant, only ordered delivery. I was really impressed by the note the staff member left; it warmed my heart. ♥️
sample_reviews_en.author: Wirasinee Pieanpattanakit

sample_reviews_en.text: Riders have to wait a very long time for their food, sometimes hours, and there's been no improvement in speeding up the process at this branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: นายวันชัย บุณศรี

restaurants.name: Hippiebar@Rambuttri
restaurants.address:

30 Ram Buttri Aly, Chana Songkhram, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small street bar with a truly huge selection of cocktails. They also have a small selection of mocktails, as well as shots, beer, and soft drinks.

The cocktails are an unbeatable 80 THB, so everyone in our group treated themselves to two. And they tasted great.

You can easily overlook the fact that they're served in plastic cups.

There's seating in front of the VW bus where you can watch the world go by.

The staff was very friendly.

LGBTQ+ friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manfred

sample_reviews_en.text: I want to invite everyone to this place! Everything is amazing, the service is the sweetest, the cocktails are delicious and worth the price – not expensive at all! It's a great place to chill, listen to great reggae music. I love it here. I definitely have to be here again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Muthita Comsurun

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely recommendable! This cocktail bar in Bangkok is a real  gem. Super nice people, surprisingly cheap drinks, and a really great atmosphere await you here – it's definitely worth it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrick

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is very good. The customers are really good. I got a boyfriend at this shop. The owner is also cute. Foreigners must come here. I got a husband because of this shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: กมลชนก แวดศรี

sample_reviews_en.text: What kind of flavor do you want? My brother can recommend it because we have never eaten it like this. It's spicy. He said it was spicy, so I thought it was spicy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phanitporn THOMPAT

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very nice chilled bar open until 2am
Music isn’t loud and you can easily talk, the staff is very friendly, been here more than 10 times and never got bored
sample_reviews_en.author: BoTmAn

sample_reviews_en.text: By far the best value for money I had on my 14-day trip to Thailand. The mojito was delicious, and combined with the music, it made for a lovely evening.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sebastian Bethge

sample_reviews_en.text: Cocktails are very cheap, not expensive, and delicious. I enjoy listening to chill music and reggae. I really like this place. I love it here. ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Pigky Kanokphan

restaurants.name: ร้านตี๋ลันสาย1
restaurants.address:

5 Phuttha Monthon Sai 1, Bang Duan, Phasi Charoen, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
For those of you who love steamed rice flour dumplings and steamed rice flour noodles, I highly recommend this place!
They have a variety of menu options. There are 5-6 tables available, both large and small. ❤️
The owner is very kind and friendly, and a great salesperson! 🤣 They gave us some really good recommendations. We ordered 3 appetizers for one 1000 baht (approximately $3 USD) and got change back. So delicious! 💚
The prices are very reasonable. We ate for two people and spent only 3000 baht (approximately $3 USD) and got change back. Great value!!! We were so full!

🚗 There's also parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Snowhiteishappy

sample_reviews_en.text:
The steamed rice flour dumplings (Pak Mo) come in various fillings and broths at affordable prices. The Vietnamese noodle soup (Khao Piak) is also delicious; I especially liked the flavorful broth. The stir-fried chive dumplings (Kui Chae) are chewy and reasonably priced.

The service is excellent, from both the owner and staff, who always greet customers with a smile, even after closing time.

The shop is located by the roadside, but there's currently construction outside, so it might be a bit dusty. Parking is available behind the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicha “TuNg-MaE” Truvichien

sample_reviews_en.text: I saw it on TikTok and decided to try it. I was very disappointed. The soup in the "Pak Mok" noodles is crucial; if it's not hot, it's ruined. I told the restaurant, but they replied that the soup they served was boiling hot and they even heated it further. Hmm, maybe my taste buds were off when I thought the soup was cold? We were a group of four and ordered three bowls, and all three were completely cold. Okay, one time is enough. Bye.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chulanee Wisalkamol

sample_reviews_en.text: Soft rice noodle rolls served with tom yum soup. The rolls are delicious with their soft dough and customizable fillings; my favorite is chives and bamboo shoots. Served with dipping sauce, a set is only 35 baht. The price is very reasonable. The restaurant is airy and cool, with parking available. Be careful not to miss the apartment entrance.
sample_reviews_en.author: panda tong

sample_reviews_en.text: The steamed rice noodle rolls (Pak Mo) had thick dough, unlike the ones I've had in Phanom Sarakham. Putting the rolls in the soup didn't feel right, perhaps because of the thick dough. They provided a dipping sauce similar to chive sauce. The Vietnamese-style steamed rice noodle rolls (Pak Mo Yuan) tasted okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jittima Tippayawat

sample_reviews_en.text: The steamed rice noodle rolls are thin and soft, living up to their reputation. The broth is flavorful. For those who like their food hot, I recommend the fried chives and the sizzling seafood hot pot. The prices are reasonable. I'll definitely stop by again next time I'm in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adisak Naree

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork ribs had an odor. The Vietnamese rice noodle soup was okay, but the broth wasn't hot at all. I ordered the tom yum with thin noodles; the noodles had an odor and were undercooked. The roasted pork was dry. Everything was a failure. I wouldn't go back; it was a waste of money.
sample_reviews_en.author: We Qa

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted good and the portions were generous, but the soup wasn't very hot, possibly due to the cold weather.
It's located next to a road under construction, so there's a bit of dust. The dust will be much less once the road is finished.
sample_reviews_en.author: MiRan

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรืออยุธยา เจ๊เอ๋
restaurants.address:

1247, 1253 Sukhumvit 71 Rd, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I've never found a place I like as much as this one. I've been eating here for almost 10 years. I used to live in the area, and back then it was 15฿ per bowl. Now it's 30฿, but the taste has never changed because the owner hasn't changed either! 😁
sample_reviews_th.author: หนุ่งหนิง

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but the service was awful. They served the wrong table, then brought us more food, and didn't even apologize. We waited outside the restaurant, and no one greeted us; customers had to find their own tables. It was terrible. The woman with glasses who cooked seemed annoyed. We ordered more, and after paying, there was no thank you. They forgot our order and didn't apologize. The food was genuinely delicious, but the service was terrible. They really need to improve.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarunrat Singngam

sample_reviews_en.text: Found this local food spot. Within walking distance from my stay (@BBHouse KhlongTan). Great hospitality by the Bozz. Yummy food (broth?). Can choose vegetarian option. Free veggies. Very cheap too. 15bath/bowl (soup with kwetiauw) - I ate 2 portions, plus free vegies (beansprouts & basils) & 10bath bottled tea; total 40bath only. Ate double portions this late afternoon for my early dinner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dewi Kusnadi

sample_reviews_en.text: I love it and go back very often. The noodles are delicious. Even when it's crowded at lunchtime, the service is still fast. The steamed rice pudding is the kind with a chewy bottom layer and a soft top, not too sweet. It's good, you have to try it!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jajiw

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my regular spot. The broth is rich and delicious, especially in the afternoon when it's extra thick. They also have braised liver. The prices are cheap, and the owner is lovely and kind. I eat here often but this is my first review.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicha “TuNg-MaE” Truvichien

sample_reviews_en.text: The stewed beef was mostly white meat; in the end, only the noodles were edible. I ordered two bowls. The pork was okay, but the beef was inedible. I left the pieces of beef behind after I finished because I really couldn't eat them.
sample_reviews_en.author: P J

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! The noodle broth is very rich and flavorful. The crispy pork rinds are amazing, and they even have pork fat scraps. I recommend ordering two bowls at once and mixing them together for an even better taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nat Lim

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ever since I ate at this restaurant, I haven't been to any other.
It's my all-time favorite boat noodle restaurant.
Boat noodles with minced beef and minced liver, no sugar added.
Try ordering it!! 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Chatlada Petchdee

restaurants.name: Kai Wan Ban Sushi # Caltex Prachanukul Branch
restaurants.address:

54 32 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Lat Yao, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I ordered sushi for 260฿, choosing about 13 pieces, separated into 2 boxes. Each box came with 1 serving of wasabi and 1 serving of soy sauce. I asked for more soy sauce and wasabi, but the staff refused both, saying I could only add one, either wasabi or soy sauce. Everyone has different preferences for dipping, and sometimes being stingy with the ingredients when selling something isn't right.
The sushi was delicious, but there wasn't enough soy sauce and wasabi. Please improve this aspect.
sample_reviews_th.author: pansa thaiprakob

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to buy sushi today. It was crowded, so I asked a female employee to put the sushi in a box for me. What I got was sushi with dry toppings because it had been in the display case for a long time. I know because I compared it to another piece. Several pieces were like this. I was extremely disappointed. They gave customers old, unappetizing sushi.

I'm done with this store. I want to file a complaint with CP, the franchisee.
sample_reviews_en.author: ammahitz

sample_reviews_en.text: I bought 10 items and the employee gave me one packet each of wasabi and soy sauce. I asked for more and they gave me one more. I'm confused, if I buy one item per box, how many packets would I get? They should change employees, this one is terrible. The owner should check these reviews because the employee said the owner is giving them this much before there are no customers. The cashier is awful.
sample_reviews_en.author: นวนว บอสดิว่าะ

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch is near my house, so I stopped by to buy some food. The food tasted good, and the sushi pieces were very large, worth the price. The staff provided excellent service; they were polite, attentive, and spoke nicely. When I was eating outside the store, it started raining, and one of the staff members was worried I would get wet, so she brought an umbrella for me. So sweet!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jannipa Yoosaeng

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a sushi brand that is the most stingy with its wasabi and soy sauce in Thailand. For a set of 11 pieces costing over 200 baht, they only gave me one packet of each. When I asked for more, the staff said it was company policy.
I urge the brand owner to take this matter seriously.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ipon Ratti

sample_reviews_en.text: I bought 11 pieces of sushi for 235 baht. They only gave me one packet each of wasabi and soy sauce. I asked for more and they gave me an extra packet. Why are they so stingy with the wasabi and soy sauce?! The restaurant should improve on this.
sample_reviews_en.author: usaranee hinhumpetch

sample_reviews_en.text:
For us, this is our favorite branch.
The food turns over quickly; nothing gets stale like at other branches.
You can just tell the staff what you want. Even though the branch is small, there's still seating outside. It's awesome!
sample_reviews_en.author: hello world

sample_reviews_en.text: Really bad sushi, ordered on Grab. The tuna was defrosted and tasted bad, the rice was really dense and hard, my husband ate and felt sick after. Stay away
sample_reviews_en.author: Ilana

restaurants.name: Fish Ho Mok ห่อหมกปลาช่อนไร้ก้าง
restaurants.address:

1428, 1244 Srinagarindra Rd, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, good value, and flavorful, made with high-quality ingredients.
The Thai food has a central Thai flavor. The steamed fish curry (Ho Mok) is fragrant and delicious, made with freshly squeezed coconut milk, not boxed. The taste is fragrant, smooth, and refined, even though the restaurant looks simple. It's authentic, beautifully wrapped with wooden skewers, not staples—a thoughtful touch. The fish pieces are a good size for the price.
The fried catfish with ginger and chili is intensely flavorful, with a rich three-flavor profile that's not overpowering. Importantly, the fish is fried crispy, dry, and incredibly fragrant. Highly recommended.
Overall, it's good value for money, the taste is excellent, and the rice is delicious, fluffy yet soft. I want to try more dishes. If you're worried about crowds, I recommend avoiding lunchtime and coming in the afternoon instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: youuu u

sample_reviews_en.text:
The steamed fish curry is great! If you want to try a variety of dishes, come at 11 am.
You can call to reserve in advance.
💖I love the steamed fish belly curry so much!
🫶The salted boiled tilapia is amazing – you can eat the whole fish, bones and scales!
✨The catfish is also delicious!
When you arrive, you'll see the staff sitting and preparing the food. The auntie is very kind.
🚗Parking is available behind the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lilly

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm confused by the review. I bought one yesterday, a cute little piece wrapped in 3-4 layers of banana leaves, for 70 baht each. I've never seen anything so expensive sold on the roadside. I weighed it without the banana leaves and with half a pack of betel leaves, and it wasn't even half a kilo. I guess they didn't make it specifically to sell to us, as usual.🤣🤣🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: Somtum Kapihor

sample_reviews_en.text: Steamed snakehead fish in banana leaves (Hormok Pla Chon) has a balanced flavor, neither too sweet nor too salty. Other dishes are also available, such as fish head tom yum, stir-fried frog, and eel. The restaurant is easy to find, located on Srinakarin Road before the On Nut intersection (coming from Udom Suk). Prices start at 50 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: wiganda Inkam

sample_reviews_en.text: The steamed fish curry is delicious, and the Tom Yum soup lives up to its name. They also have spicy stir-fried frog or basil frog. They give generous portions of rice and have been selling food for a very long time. Parking is available in the alley. The prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anne Vorapreecha

sample_reviews_en.text:
A local restaurant specialized in Ho Mok, steamed-cooked curry wrapped with banana leaves.
It's tasty and if you have never tried Ho Mok, you should try once.
You can dine in or even order through car windows. I saw many customers stopped by and order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Santa Claus

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the service is fast. We ordered several dishes and everything was delicious. They have a wide variety of menu items; we even had to order extra rice! I recommend the clear tom yum soup with snakehead fish; it's amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: TheKiang2002

sample_reviews_en.text:
📍The shop is located on Srinakarin 28, before Suan Luang intersection.

Parking is limited; you can enter the soi (alley) before the shop.
I'll post pictures in the comments.

#Srinakarin #SteamedFishCurry #DeliciousFood #OnNut #HiaKaiNongMaeow
sample_reviews_en.author: Methawat K.

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวต้มยำกากหมูสูตรโบราณสาขาเตาปูน
restaurants.address:

639 Krungthep-Nonthaburi 15 Alley, Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is located on a street corner, an open-air setting. It's breezy and not hot in the evening. They focus on noodles but also offer à la carte dishes.
I highly recommend the crispy pork rinds; they look fresh, not rancid at all, and the flavor is just right – very enjoyable to eat. The tom yum soup is moderately spicy, not too strong. The pork is bouncy and well-marinated, and the liver is soft, just as I read in previous reviews. The peanuts are roasted in-house, according to the sign on the wall, haha, but they really do look fresh, not rancid or soggy. It's great.
I'll definitely come back again or order through the app because parking is quite difficult. This time I was lucky enough to find a parking spot and try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Muse SA

sample_reviews_en.text:
When I arrived, there was only one table available. There were four or five delivery riders waiting in front of the shop. I thought it would take a while.
I ordered spicy noodle salad, and it was served in about five minutes. So I ordered basil chicken as well. It arrived a short while later. It was very fast.
The special noodle dish was 60 baht, and the portion was more than enough. It was delicious, but the flavor was a little mild. I added some seasoning. The crispy pork cracklings were amazing – crunchy, fragrant, and delicious.
The basil chicken rice was very soft and delicious. The flavor was good, and the liver was excellent, in large pieces. I ate it all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sf224

sample_reviews_en.text:
-Located approximately 650 meters from Bang Son MRT station. -Food is served quickly.
-The Tom Yum soup is delicious, rich, and very impressive. I've ordered it at least 7 times. However, I personally think it's a little too sweet because I prefer a sour taste, so I added a little vinegar.
-The pork pieces are large and tender, with a nice chewy texture.
-The pork meatballs are soft and delicious.
-The liver is served in large, very tender pieces (I love it!).
-We ordered an extra Onsen egg for 12 baht each. It goes well with the Tom Yum soup.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benjawan Pukdee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tom Yum Noodle Soup with Minced Pork: Generous amount of minced pork, delicious noodles, but the Tom Yum flavor wasn't strong enough. The roasted peanuts were fragrant and tasty, and there was a huge portion of crispy pork cracklings, which I loved.
Tom Yum Vermicelli Soup: The Tom Yum flavor wasn't too strong, but it was packed with ingredients.
Boiled Dumplings with Dipping Sauce: Delicious, the dipping sauce was amazing – spicy, sour, and flavorful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratisamosorn

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was okay, but the wait was incredibly long. I observed for a while that the staff were very inexperienced in blanching the noodles and seasoning the food. They were slow and hesitant. There seemed to be several staff members, but it took them several minutes to prepare just one bowl. I waited half an hour to an hour, and they kept making mistakes, serving the wrong tables, and switching staff multiple times.
sample_reviews_en.author: สิรวิชญ์ คูปิติการกลุ

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my go-to noodle shop. They offer both dry and soup versions. I personally prefer the dry version because the flavor is richer. They also provide a separate side of delicious broth, which is excellent, and the crispy pork cracklings aren't chewy.

Price: 5/5
Quality: 5/5
Taste: 5/5
Cleanliness: 5/5
Speed: 5/5
Service: 5/5
Location: 5/5
Value for money: 5/5
sample_reviews_en.author: Akapatr Chiraarreebutr

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum noodle soup was delicious. They used fresh lime, which made it very fragrant. The broth was well-seasoned, and the pork, crispy pork cracklings, and peanuts added a rich and delicious flavor. The restaurant has a slightly low ceiling, making it a bit hot. Parking is hit or miss; there's only parking in front of the shop. They accept cash and QR code.
sample_reviews_en.author: merced merced

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum noodle soup with lime was delicious! The pork, bouncy pork, and minced pork were all high-quality ingredients. Eating at the restaurant was very affordable. Prices start at 50 baht, extra 10 baht for a special order, and 12 baht for an egg. A bowl of noodles with an iced Pepsi was only 89 baht! Filling, delicious, and inexpensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirada Pookkasorn

restaurants.name: EAT SPACE 6060
restaurants.address:

QGRW+7J4, 21 Soi Pradipat, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: 606 Eat Space is an absolute gem — from the moment you walk in, you’re greeted by a warm, stylish atmosphere filled with soft lighting, relaxing music, and a vibe that strikes the perfect balance between lively and laid-back. The cocktails are crafted with real attention to detail, each one balancing flavor and presentation beautifully, while the food far exceeds typical bar fare, offering dishes that are both flavorful and elegantly served. What truly sets this place apart, though, is the service — the staff are friendly, attentive, and genuinely make you feel welcome. Whether you’re here for a chill evening with friends or a quiet, intimate night out, 606 Eat Space delivers an experience that’s effortlessly cool and unforgettable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teeradone Mueangsong

sample_reviews_en.text:
This bar is a true hidden gem in Bangkok. Stylish, intimate space that perfectly captures the essence of a classic speakeasy

Team are real pros not only do they nail the classics : they can also craft something completely unique, tailored just for you 🍸

But what really hits is the vibe: warm, welcoming, and authentic . You can come with friends or show up solo - either way, you won’t feel out of place for a second ✨

Live music on Fridays and Saturdays just adds that final touch. It’s the kind of place you keep coming back to, again and again
sample_reviews_en.author: Lily and hedonists

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a great place to visit, especially if you combine it with 6060 Arts Space, an art gallery located on the same soi (alley). The friendly staff who readily strike up conversations, the live music on weekend nights, and the colorful cocktails all contribute to its many attractions. The unique interior design is also a feast for the eyes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Takeshi Matsunaga

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place, amazing atmosphere, and incredibly delicious food. If you want to get drunk, I highly recommend this place. The bartender is super handsome, unforgettable! You won't be disappointed. Service is 10/10/10, I'd even add an 11/10 if I could.
sample_reviews_en.author: ReeL Thesun

sample_reviews_en.text: Sip on drinks in a relaxed atmosphere while enjoying art in a cool setting. The bar is beautifully decorated, but what's even better is the incredibly friendly staff. There's live music where you can sing along and request songs without …
sample_reviews_en.author: วริทธิ์ เต็นพิพัฒน์ (iGoHanG)

sample_reviews_en.text: A really cool place. Incredibly delicious food and cocktails. We'll definitely be back here when we get a chance to visit Bangkok. The guys behind the bar are very friendly and will recommend food and drinks. The atmosphere is fantastic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noel Savel Play

sample_reviews_en.text: The liquor is amazing; those with a high tolerance for alcohol should try it. The staff are funny and the service is good. The snacks are delicious. Be prepared for a wait, so it's recommended to order in advance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yanisa Tachawattana

sample_reviews_en.text: A great, cozy place. We luckily found it when it was empty. The staff treated us like we'd known each other for a long time, giving us great recommendations for both drinks and food. I highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: vish 513

restaurants.name: Phkin Therefore U Bistro - Bar & Coffee
restaurants.address:

31 Inthamara 42 Alley, Ratchadaphisek, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my second time staying at U42 Hotel.
I received coins to redeem for a welcome drink on the 2nd floor at Phkin Therefore U.

The first time, I ordered two Ice Kyoto Matcha Latte. I found that there were clumps of matcha that weren't finely whisked, but the tea itself was fragrant and delicious. It's a shame it wasn't brewed well.

This time, for my second stay, I decided to give it another chance, hoping for improvement. However, it was the same as before, as shown in the picture. If I had to pay 110 baht for two drinks (220 baht total), I would regret it because of this brewing method.

If they could improve the whisking of the matcha to make it smoother, it would be perfect. Please look into this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aurora S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very fine Italian restaurant in a nice & cozy atmosphere hotel indeed. All food comes with great taste, full of flavor particularly Spanish Mussels in white wine sauce. Pizza promotion, a buy-1-get 1 free, is an excellent offer.

The Chef is very lively, friendly and generous with all ingredients in every dishes. Food Taste is uncompromisingly delicious. Never mind gaining a little more weight in exchange for mouthful flavor of happiness. All staffs are Friendly and I am also impressed with owner’s great hospitality.

Will come again and definitely bring my family and friends along for chit-chat here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vasimon Ruanglek

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a restaurant and bar serving both Italian and Thai food. I absolutely love their pizza; it's incredibly delicious. I often order it to take home for my daughter. The crust and cheese are perfectly balanced. It's even better when eaten hot. The atmosphere in the restaurant is great, beautifully decorated with lots of photo opportunities. The cocktails at the bar are excellent, and the service is superb, from both the staff and the hotel owner. It's a complete package! I love it! 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Chotika Manator

sample_reviews_en.text:
Truly impressed with the unexpected experiences thanks to the  varieties of aesthetic vibe in a single floor of hotel.

Pizza is highly recommended for everyone who looking for authentic Italian (even hawaiian is my personal obsession). Apart from the food, restaurant, cafe, bar, and vibe are also key highlights to visit here.

Visiting this place in the late afternoon, and enjoy the night vibe within couple hours, such a wonderful Saturday experience 🫶🏻.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamonwan Srikittichai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I celebrated my recent birthday at PHKIN THEREFORE U at U42 Hotel. The calamari was delicious, the pizza was tasty, and I especially loved the chef's homemade chili oil. I enjoyed how the chef came to recommend dishes and was very fun to chat with.
But my favorite was the Agnolotti – it was the best! The atmosphere was very friendly, and the desserts were amazing. I forgot to take a picture of the Tiramisu, but it was rich and delicious! ^__^
sample_reviews_en.author: nisawan nuamin

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love this restaurant. It's beautiful and has a gorgeous vibe!
I only speak English and they were all so welcoming and ready to help and cater to any request I had and qent above and beyond for me.
Beautiful owner and staff. All with amazing, lovely hospitality!!
Delicious coffee, matcha and cocktails! Incredible food! 10/10 recommend! 🩷 my absolute favourite little place I found in Bangkok.

Must visit!

I will be back! x
sample_reviews_en.author: Megan Rose

sample_reviews_en.text: Great Restaurant by  a friendly Italian chef. The Phkin pizza and truffle pizza are delicious. When we ordered carbonara for our kids, chef’s caring to ask whether we want the traditional Italian style(which some kids might not like it)or the commercial one. We ordered the latter one, and our kids love it. All the ingredients are fresh and high quality. The cocktail is also great. We will definitely comeback here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suttiwat Ton

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited the coffee bar. The shop is divided into restaurant and bar areas on separate sides. The hotel is almost at the end of the soi (alley), and the restaurant is on the second floor.

They offer dark and medium roast coffee beans. I liked the atmosphere, the coffee was delicious, the air conditioning was cool, and the staff were friendly. I tried the mocha and latte, and both were delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyanan V

restaurants.name: Song Peenong Somtum
restaurants.address:

110 Pracha Rat Bamphen Rd, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The food is delicious and affordable, great value for money, and the portions are large.
Salmon salad 200฿ / Fried chicken 60฿ / Crispy catfish salad 165฿ – two people couldn't finish it all, the portions are huge!
The grass jelly dessert is delicious, I highly recommend ordering it.
sample_reviews_th.author: scott mctann

sample_reviews_en.text:
Two Brothers Som Tum Restaurant has a diverse menu.
Today, I chose the mixed pork hot pot set for 200 baht.
The set includes pork, liver, shrimp, squid, and chicken eggs, along with a vegetable platter and three dipping sauces: a sour and salty sauce, a sukiyaki sauce, and a spicy dipping sauce.
The soup base is delicious and well-balanced, slightly on the sweet side.
The Thai papaya salad is excellent and the portion is generous.
I also ordered the steamed bamboo shoots with herbs for 30 baht; it was a very large portion and incredibly delicious.

Overall, the food is delicious, clean, and very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: warangkana yandang

sample_reviews_en.text: The spiciest som tam restaurant in Huai Khwang area. We really like the Thai som tam with salted eggs. It's delicious and has just the right amount of flavor. The Korat som tam is really well done, 10/10. The larb is also great, 9/10. The glass noodle salad is also delicious. The tom zaap is really spicy and makes your mouth water. This is an Isaan restaurant that serves the best food at reasonable prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: sanina thianp

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is incredibly delicious and the service is great. I went alone and the staff were very attentive. As someone from Udon Thani, I can honestly say the papaya salad is authentic. I highly recommend it to everyone! We ordered a lot and it only cost 100 baht! There's also a government subsidy program, so we ate until we were full and paid only 50 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natcha Laepong

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything is good, and the place is clean unlike other shops where the staff is too busy to even wipe your table. Deduct 1 star just because the papaya is too thick and not enough Tum (I want that green beans smashed). Thank you for making it less spicy as I ordered, but actually Som Tum turned out too sweet and Sweet liver turned out salty.
sample_reviews_en.author: jtm

sample_reviews_en.text:
People from Sichuan will love this place! The Tom Yum soup is so rich and flavorful! And the water spinach is strong and delicious! When the owner asks how spicy you want it, just say "very spicy!" Highly recommended!

The coconut leaves are also delicious; I even scooped out all the coconut meat—so good!
sample_reviews_en.author: 罗七岁

sample_reviews_en.text: I went for takeout. I ordered gapao rice, fried chicken, and grilled chicken. It's always packed with customers picking up deliveries, proving it's a favorite among locals. Watching the chefs prepare the food was fast but meticulous. It was also reasonably priced and delicious. I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: kei kato

sample_reviews_en.text: Waited forever! They prioritized Grab drivers and foreigners even though they arrived and ordered first. Anyone wanting to eat in the restaurant will have to wait. So I just asked for the bill already – 40 baht for a bottle of water and a small bottle of Coke. End of review.
sample_reviews_en.author: supamaxx

restaurants.name: LA จิ้มจุ่ม (LA JimJum)
restaurants.address:

1746 Thanon Lat Phrao 101, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Great restaurant, great atmosphere, excellent service. All the food is delicious. They also have karaoke! Currently, they have a promotion: spend 2000 baht on food and get one hour of karaoke free. They now have a second branch located on Ladprao Soi 101, แยก 19 (intersection 19). I've tried that branch and the food is just as delicious and the service is excellent, just like the first branch. They also offer catering services.
sample_reviews_th.author: Bitey Talead

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went on a weekday, and there were hardly any customers.
The atmosphere was super private.
I was hungry late at night, so I checked the map for restaurants near my house that were still open. I found this one that stayed open late.

So we drove there...
The price and food were reasonable.

Generous portions, good value, and delicious.
I don't like spicy food, so I ordered it less spicy, and it tasted great. The food came out quickly (maybe because it wasn't a holiday). The restaurant did a great job.
👍🏻👍🏻

Like most bars, the drinks are on the higher side. 😅

The staff provided good service.

Next time, I might try visiting on a holiday. It seems like the restaurant has live music. 🎙

P.S. The restaurant charges for tissues. Don't forget to take them with you. ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Ratchadaporn pamakham

sample_reviews_en.text: A female staff member was gossiping about customers. My boyfriend overheard because he was in the restroom. We asked for peanut dipping sauce for our grilled fish – real peanut dipping sauce, not just peanuts in the regular seafood dipping sauce – but she went around gossiping about us and speaking negatively. If you have any questions, just ask the customer directly, don't spread bad rumors. I don't know how many people have been tampered with. The food was good in every way, except for the staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maysa Pps

sample_reviews_en.text: When ordering the second set of food, the staff told us to eat quickly because the restaurant was closing, even though it was full, but they only told our table. It was only 11:30 PM. I was so confused. When the second set arrived, I asked for the bill once, which was very confusing. I only realized how poor I looked after visiting this restaurant. //As for the food, the oysters were delicious, but the dipping sauce was strange. The main point is, I really want them to improve the staff's attitude.
sample_reviews_en.author: ploy sai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Simple and tiny place with a fantastic open space dining area at the second floor (rooftop) overlooking traffic movement in the narrow soi down below.
I was lucky to have a parking space at the entrance.
Nicely cocked food with fresh ingredients.
Jimjum was tasty and so were the rest.
Price is average.
suitable for groups and couples to enjoy drinking and eating while listening to music.
sample_reviews_en.author: Husain AlHusaini (Husain_Tula)

sample_reviews_en.text: Craving hot pot? The hot pot was delicious, the broth was good, but the dipping sauce wasn't quite to my liking. Other dishes were okay, but the biggest disappointment was the grilled beef. It was incredibly tough, unlike any other grilled beef I've had. The area near the restroom was a bit scary. 😜 The staff provided good service, thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: satita chaikaew

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! I just discovered this restaurant and when I actually went to eat there, everything was delicious. I'm hooked on the chicken feet soup. My only suggestion is to rearrange the restaurant to make it more spacious and comfortable. I want this great restaurant to have more customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: กก ดด

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an area with almost no foreigners, which is unusual for Bangkok today. Enjoy some chim chim or whatever you like while looking down at the vacant lot, which is either grassland or a parking lot, and reminiscing about the chaotic, busy atmosphere that is the essence of Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: HIVN HIVN

restaurants.name: ข้าวซอยเขลางค์ สาย 1
restaurants.address:

เลยซอย7 ประมาณ20ม ร้านข้าวซอยเขลางค์ 99 ถนน พุทธมณฑลสาย 1 Phasi Charoen, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food has a mediocre taste, not very strong, rather bland.
I ordered three dishes: beef khao soi, mixed khao soi, and chicken biryani. The khao soi soup wasn't rich and lacked the flavor of the curry spices. The crispy noodles sprinkled on top were plentiful and crunchy. The beef was good and tender; the one with Kobe beef was excellent. The chicken biryani had plain rice, but it lacked the aroma of curry spices, so I felt indifferent about it. The chicken pieces were large and juicy, but not very tender. The owner was kind and attentive to customers. The atmosphere was airy (there weren't many people when I went), with plenty of fans. I wish they would make the spices and flavors more intense.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anusit Sae Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered Khao Soi with pork meatballs and added pork neck.

1. Khao Soi broth: The flavor was a little weak. It would be perfect if it were a bit richer. 8/10

2. Pork neck: Very tender, almost no chewing required. Excellent! 10/10

There's parking in front of the shop. If you're coming from Phetkasem Road, look to your left, just past Soi 5.

***The owner, an elderly gentleman, provides excellent service.***
sample_reviews_en.author: Opas Lim

sample_reviews_en.text:
Beef Khao Soi...
This is a must-try restaurant. The flavor is excellent and well-seasoned.
If you're passing by Phutthamonthon Sai 1 Road,
you have to stop by and eat here every time. I've never seen a restaurant in Bangkok that makes it this flavorful.
10/10
Other dishes are also delicious,
but I personally prefer the Khao Soi.
#SheLovesEatingKhaoSoi
sample_reviews_en.author: Permsak “ตี๋โคตรรีวิว” Chantarawongsakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The Khanom Jeen Nam Ngiao (rice noodles with spicy pork broth) was incredibly delicious! It tasted just like the one I had in Chiang Rai. They also gave a generous amount of ingredients. I ordered through a delivery app, and the packaging was clean and tidy. I'm definitely going to be a regular customer from this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanin Hangsavanich

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! The beef Khao Soi is 70 baht and has a generous amount of meat – great value! The chicken Khao Soi is 50 baht and equally filling. The owner, an elderly gentleman, is very friendly and provides excellent service. Besides Khao Soi, they also have chicken and beef biryani.
sample_reviews_en.author: Red Car พาชิม

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious! It's very difficult to find a Khao Soi (Northern Thai curry noodle soup) this good in Bangkok.

The portion size is appropriate for the price. It made me miss Chiang Mai!

Highly recommended. Anyone passing by should stop and try it; you won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sancha Punpoowong

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered delivery to my house. My son and boyfriend ate the Khao Soi and it was okay, but I ate the Khanom Jeen Nam Ngiao and it had only two pieces of bone with no meat on it, and one lump of minced pork. The rest was just vegetables and …
sample_reviews_en.author: วรรณวิมล วัชระบุญโชติ

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste didn't disappoint. The beef and chicken Khao Soi had all the ingredients according to the original Northern Thai recipe, as they brought this delicious flavor to Bangkok so everyone could taste the authentic Northern Thai style.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thawatchai Wit

restaurants.name: จิระภาไก่หมุน บางบอน5
restaurants.address:

ถ. บางบอน 5 Bang Bon Nuea, Bang Bon, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I used to buy rotisserie chicken and papaya salad from this shop often. The shop has changed cooks, and the food isn't as good as it used to be. I ordered a dish, specifically stir-fried basil chicken without chilies, but they put in a whole garden of chilies! They wouldn't even let me exchange the food. Terrible service. I'm never eating there again. 👎👎👎👎👎👎 They should change the person taking the orders too; they seem to be hard of hearing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirilak Hongnipon

sample_reviews_en.text: Papaya salad and grilled chicken are a must-try. The papaya salad has an authentic Northeastern Thai flavor, with a fragrant and delicious fermented fish sauce. We also ordered some à la carte dishes, like the spicy basil chicken, which was very flavorful. The atmosphere is open and breezy, making it nice and cool.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thawatchai Wit

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped by to buy some food to take home. They give you a huge portion! It was delicious and the price was reasonable. The papaya salad was fantastic, and the chicken was tender, juicy, and not dry at all. If you're passing by this area, try stopping by and buying some. You won't be disappointed! ✅✅✅
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattaporn

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves huge portions! I was so full. The papaya salad was delicious, spicy and just the way I like it. The chicken was very tender and tasty, with a slightly sweet flavor. The tamarind dipping sauce was also great. The prices are good too. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Amp Am

sample_reviews_en.text: I loved it! The food was delicious. The spicy papaya salad and waterfall salad were amazing. The chicken was so juicy. The restaurant said they also have papaya salad with thin noodles, I'll try that next time. This is now my go-to restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nawi Pon

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was okay, but the food queuing system was chaotic. People who arrived later got their food first. They couldn't even keep up with the queue outside the restaurant, yet they were accepting online orders. The wait was long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Milddear Queen

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and flavorful, and the prices are reasonable. If you go during peak hours when you're very hungry, you might have to wait.
The atmosphere is like a roadside restaurant, with seating available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suvichan Sthitgitpichead

sample_reviews_en.text: The price is good, not too expensive. The chicken is tender and well-seasoned. The highlight is the delicious dipping sauce. You have to go pretty early because it sells out quickly. Their food is really good.
sample_reviews_en.author: แดร็กคูแมว แมวมาเฟีย

restaurants.name: "Khao Man Kai shop beside the railroad"
restaurants.address:

ข้าวมันไก่ริมทางรถไฟ 19 Soi Thoet Thai 33, Talat Phlu, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd give it 10 stars! The taste is amazing. The boiled chicken is juicy and not flattened. The fried chicken is superb – perfectly crispy, not dry, and not oily. The soup is piping hot and perfectly seasoned, not too salty. The dipping sauce is just right. The rice is plump, sticky, and soft – I don't know how they cook it or what kind of rice they use, but it's delicious even on its own. The portions are surprisingly generous for the price, and the price is excellent. The service is also great; they prepare the food quickly even with a steady stream of orders. The owner cooks everything themselves, is very kind, and speaks politely. The only downside is the lack of parking, but it's definitely worth it if you get to eat here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gencode Ladplakao

sample_reviews_en.text: This legendary Hainanese chicken rice is incredibly cheap and filling. It's only 40 baht to eat in the shop, with free water and unlimited refills of soup and dipping sauce.
