There's always a queue, it's always packed. There are also long queues for delivery drivers. It might be more suitable to walk there as there's no parking lot; you can park on the side of the road for motorcycles. Overall, it's worth the walk.
sample_reviews_en.author: Buntita Dumgleang

sample_reviews_en.text: This chicken rice stall is located by the railway tracks in the Talat Phlu area, on Soi Therdthai 33. They source their chicken thighs and drumsticks with thigh attachments from CP, ensuring freshness, cleanliness, and high quality. Highly recommended! The stall is accessible via both Therdthai Road, Soi 33 and Ratchadaphisek Road, Soi 13.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kiddee Channel

sample_reviews_en.text: I bought it to take home and it tasted pretty good. The chicken was tender, the rice was perfectly cooked—not hard, not mushy, and not too oily. The portion was quite generous, and they offered two types of soup: winter melon and pickled cabbage. The soup was a bit bland, but it was nice and refreshing to sip alongside the chicken rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: MyMine Miine

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice is fragrant, soft, and flavorful. The chicken is chewy, and comes with offal and soft-boiled eggs. They also offer fried chicken. The dipping sauce is spicy and full of flavor. Be prepared to wait in line a bit, though, because their food is genuinely delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jinny Soontorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Kao man gai (Fried Chicken) I Recommend mix chicken cuz you will get Fried chicken and steam chicken, it's very very delicious in my life the texture is perfect for me.
Need you know around here it hard for parking but if you have motorcycle it work.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sakol Detthongkum

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Hainanese chicken rice dish has all three elements perfectly balanced:
1. The rice is well-cooked, soft, and flavorful.
2. The chicken is tender and chewy with just the right texture; the liver is …
sample_reviews_en.author: Opas Samsen

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is tasty for the price, and the portions are generous. The rice has a slight aroma but lacks flavor; it tastes bland. I wish the chicken and rice flavors were stronger. Overall, it's good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter Lai

restaurants.name: เจี๊ยะจุ้ย-Jiajui
restaurants.address:

เลขที่26 Krungthep Kreetha Rd, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Isn't it closing too early? There are many restaurants in the area, perfect for a quick dessert after a meal. The custard and butter buns are okay, and the soy milk is delicious. However, I read bloggers raving about it being similar to Jeaw Wann's – sorry, it's a different style. The aroma isn't quite the same either (and Jeaw Wann closes at 11 PM). But it is the best in the area. This shop has a similar vibe to Nommon but focuses more on soy milk.

I recommend extending their closing time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Very Kelly

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've had the Thai Tea Slushy twice already. It's delicious and very rich, so cold that the grass jelly at the bottom turns into icy flakes. It costs 85 baht. The toast with custard is also good; the custard is tasty, and the toast is fragrant with butter. The chocolate topping is good, but I would prefer a little more melted chocolate.
Slow down when driving, or you might miss the parking area in front of the shop.
The shop closes at 7:30 PM on Mondays.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pook lalintip

sample_reviews_en.text: The custard is delicious; it's rich, not watery or bland, and not too sweet. The Thai tea slush is also very strong, almost too strong, but overall it's delicious. The soy milk is also tasty; it has a real soy flavor, not just a hint of soy, and it's fragrant. They also have more toppings to choose from than most other shops.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natpassorn Phung

sample_reviews_en.text: The Thai tea slushy is very fragrant, but way too sweet. If the sweetness were reduced, it would be perfect. The tofu pudding is soft and has a nice soybean aroma. The cold soy milk is completely bland but has a lovely soybean scent. It would be great if they provided syrup or brown sugar for customers to add themselves.
sample_reviews_en.author: aeykosan aeykosan

sample_reviews_en.text: Anyone who likes Thai tea has to try this! It's incredibly delicious, very strong, and not too sweet. The Taiwanese mixed milk dessert is also amazing, with chewy tapioca pearls. Parking is convenient, and there are 8 tables for seating. The shop is located on the new Bangkok-Krittha road.
sample_reviews_en.author: ลอยชาย เเชลเเนล

sample_reviews_en.text: The Thai tea slushy is rich and fragrant with a good tea flavor. If you like sweet drinks, you'll probably like it. For me, it was a bit too sweet. The desserts are delicious and the shop is decorated cutely, but it closes too early. We finished our meal and didn't have time for dessert.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirilug T.keerati

sample_reviews_en.text: My friend invited me to eat here for the first time. It was so delicious that I ate so much I forgot to take pictures! I only have photos after I finished eating 😌 The owner is lovely. I'm happy for the owner to see the restaurant full of customers. I'll definitely come back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: nathida suthangkool

sample_reviews_en.text: I went based on reviews, but personally, I thought the taste was just average, nothing amazing. I had soy milk with grass jelly, toast, and Thai tea slushy. The shop has a moderate number of tables, but it was almost full when I went. There's parking in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Taksaorn Sirikantaramas

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือคุณหลุยส์
restaurants.address:

156/1 Dinso Rd, Wat Bowon Niwet, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือหมู (Pork noodle soup) is incredibly delicious! You can pick up bean sprouts and leaves yourself. The boat-shaped noodles contain pork, meatballs, pork liver, and pork cracklings. The pork is super tender.

More than half the people eating it are Thai.

The only downside is that it's very hot.
sample_reviews_th.author: Hứa, Hựu Tinh

sample_reviews_th.text: Delicious and affordable. Regular size 50฿, Special size 60฿. The broth is rich but not overly so; no need to add much extra seasoning.
sample_reviews_th.author: Srind dew (ddewdy)

sample_reviews_en.text:
They give a generous portion, but it's not delicious, haha. I especially like the large noodles, which I understand are made from cassava and are clumped together.
I can't stand the small noodles either. The soup is average, and the ingredients are a bit lacking.
In short, the pork rinds are delicious.
The vendors are friendly and the gossip is helpful. If you go to the Wat Suthat festival, trust the vendors and you won't have to go through the trouble yourself.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitinun Jundee

sample_reviews_en.text:
I found the noodles of my life!

The bibim guksu was incredibly flavorful~
The vegetables on the table were complimentary, so you can enjoy them with your noodles.

I've tried many famous noodle restaurants in Khao San,
but I came back to this place again during my schedule.

I tried to keep it a secret, but... I highly recommend trying it.
sample_reviews_en.author: eeuu (eejj)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried the beef soup — it had a different taste from the others I’ve tried, with a big portion and a hint of cinnamon inside. 🍲✨
Totally worth it! 🤣 8,7/10!

By the way, I have a travel agency in Cusco and Machu Picchu, Peru 🇵🇪 — if you ever visit, I can help you!
👉 @dopkertravel
sample_reviews_en.author: Maichel Depcke

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles tasted delicious, but I would appreciate it if the owner could supervise the staff. I ordered glass noodles and was told they were out, but I saw bags of glass noodles in the display case. They were also out of tissues. And they made a mistake calculating the bill.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bucciarati

sample_reviews_en.text: This meat noodle restaurant is very affordable and popular with locals! The vegetables and Thai tea on the table are complimentary. You can add an iced cup for 20 baht, so I added that and poured my drink into it. The noodle soup is incredibly rich.
sample_reviews_en.author: 박찬

sample_reviews_en.text: This may be the best Kuay Teow Lua I have had in Thailand. The soup is thick and has a distinct flavor. It has been de-soured and not too harsh. The meat is just tender enough. You can tell it was cooked slowly and carefully. And the radish …
sample_reviews_en.author: Koji Sabaijai

restaurants.name: The Consul Club
restaurants.address:

B129 JLK Tower 30th Floor, Units 3001 Sukhumvit Road, Klong Toei, Nua, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The food was delicious and the atmosphere was wonderful. What made our experience even more special was the excellent service. A special thanks to ( คุณมี่ or นี่ ) for being so attentive helpful and friendly throughout our visit. They gave great recommendations and even helped us take some beautiful photos! My friend and I were truly impressed and had an amazing time. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_th.author: Belleberry

sample_reviews_en.text: Went there not long after they had opened. Few tables and it’ll likely get more popular with time. Food was excellent as was service. The ambiance was perfect. Live music was a bit loud for my personal preference as it’s hard to converse and draws the attention to the band so if you’re on a date with someone not very talkative, this can be a nice reprieve. 😅
sample_reviews_en.author: William Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The vibes here are solid S-tier.

Went for a dinner date — the music, the food, everything was great.
The Char Siu tasted just like the one I had in Hong Kong, and the Sichuan dishes were as good as what I had in Chengdu.

Definitely the first place I’d recommend if any of my friends ask me for Chinese fine dining in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay Jiang

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely the best venue in Bangkok, it’s a must when visiting or if you live here. I don’t say this lightly, the band it’s just incredible, the atmosphere is of luxury and glamorous. Thomas the manager looks after you like royalty. And big congrats To Alex and his business partner on this massive success
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing experience at Consul Club! The food was absolutely delicious, the atmosphere was incredible, and the live performance was amazing. The staff were also very friendly and helpful, making the whole experience even better. Great vibes all around—I’d definitely recommend it and can’t wait to come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: nasra mohamed

sample_reviews_en.text: I honestly love this place so much. The atmosphere is just beautiful — very classy but still comfortable. The music was perfect and really set the mood for the night. The staff were so kind and attentive, which made the whole experience even better. I’ll definitely be coming back again!🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: เขมนิจ โชติมงคล

sample_reviews_en.text: A wonderful place with a great atmosphere, friendly staff, live music, and talented singers who truly immerse you in a luxurious ambiance. The venue is conveniently located in the city center, making it easy to visit. I had a great time and would definitely recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kate Bass

sample_reviews_en.text: Great restaurant with delicious food and a fantastic atmosphere. The live performances add a special touch and make the dining experience even more enjoyable. As for the service the woman named Lita was really nice and provide excellent service for us.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Reuter

restaurants.name: Goldsmith Bar
restaurants.address:

Second floor, above Chop Chop Cook Shop, 328 Yaowarat Rd, Chakkrawat, Sampunthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We stumbled onto Goldsmith on our last night in Bangkok and had such a blast here. The service was so kind and friendly. Drinks are really unique and interesting. Endlessly sippable. At the time of us visiting, they were doing a collaboration menu with another bartender from India who walked us through the special menu they’d created, giving us tasting notes and things to expect in a given drink. We were some of the only folks in the bar and we felt like VIPs the way the staff were talking to us. It was genuine, and we really appreciated as a send off from this wonderful city. Music was BUMPING too, this DJ needs some serious credit. Come here for a unique craft cocktail before going back to Chinatown for more food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Danyal Bajwa

sample_reviews_en.text: A new speak easy (sort of) bar in Chinatown. You have to walk into another restaurant “Chop Chop Cook Shop” which is also new, and walk up to the second floor. Very cozy, nicely lit and beautifully designed bar. Cocktails are unique, although we only tried two in the list, you could tell that the bar man understands the fundamentals of making a very drinkable cocktail. Great to stop over here for a chill before or after a walk along the Chinatown street food market.
sample_reviews_en.author: mayorosaldoong

sample_reviews_en.text: I and my wife had a great time here. The internal decoration is very vintage with a great mix of east and west. The staffs are super nice, we had a great chat with the Malaysian bartender and Myanmar hostess. They are sooooo friendly and attentive. Most important of all, the drinks are fabulous and delicious, we ordered multiple rounds. This is the place I will recommend to my friends and certainly will come back again during my next visit to Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kevin Fu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great bar in Chinatown which has recently opened. We visited a few days ago, entrance is through a restaurant on the ground floor which leads up to a stylish cocktail bar with a mix of classic and unique drinks.
Staff were really welcoming and gave us a tour of the building which used to be a goldsmith.
Would recommend checking this out if you’re in the area
sample_reviews_en.author: Fraser Wood

sample_reviews_en.text: An upstairs bar with a super cool fit out and really nice lounge vibe. The drink menu was unique and original. We had the pleasure of being served by Nab’s who is extremely knowledgeable in the hospitality space. I highly recommend stopping in if you want one drink or are looking to settle in for the night.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brittney Brockhurst

sample_reviews_en.text:
Another bar spotted in Yaowarat serving good cocktails and  providing good service.
I had 4 glasses of the 'Goldsmith' (as I had to take advantage of American Express points lol)
It really does taste good! My partner had the recommended one 'Kirby's Funhouse', and she loved it!

Will definitely go back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kris Castillo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely loved this bar! The decor is insanely beautiful.The cocktails were amazing, way better than expected, and you can really tell the bartender knows what they’re doing. Super friendly too.

If you’re looking for a cool bar in Yaowarat, this is definitely the spot. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: NISA .

sample_reviews_en.text: We had a great time here, the bartender was friendly and very knowledgeable. Our drinks were unique and delicious. I loved that the DJ performed at a level we could enjoy but still carry a conversation. And we were able to order dessert from downstairs. Would absolutely recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Katie Russell

sample_reviews_th.text:
Thanks to Derek the owner for making me feel welcome , beautiful thai food at a great price Crispy pork and basil 60 bhatt ( $2.70) and seafood curry 70 bhatt ($3.10), been wanting to try this place for a while solid 9.5/10.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Enjoy authentic Thai home cooking!!

I stumbled upon this place by chance during my solo trip, and the owners were incredibly kind; it was a truly wonderful experience!! They speak English, so don't worry about getting there!

Not only is the food delicious, but the prices are reasonable and the portions are just right, so I highly recommend it to anyone who wants to try Thai food!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tatsuhito Nishiwaki

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the pork gapao rice for 50B topped with a fried egg for 10B.

The gapao rice is always delicious, and it was delicious.

I enjoyed it with the fried egg yolk and prik fish sauce to change up the flavor.

Free water is self-service.

The restaurant has four table seats and two counter seats.

There were other delicious-looking dishes, so I'll post the menu here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Syo Kei

sample_reviews_en.text: This place rocks if you like beef Brisket  noodles ,,, Basil and pork? artisan  scratch made food and  Soup.  The husband and wife know and like  what they are doing.  They recommended the beef brisket less than 100 baht what a bargain  and it delivered. What nice experience  Good food good value. good vibe,,, I'll be back...  give it a try if you're in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeremiah Keenan

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is an amazing hidden gem. I ate here every day during my 1 week stay at my hotel. Whether it was the crispy pork and kale, pad thai or the rice dishes the food is fresh and delicious. The owners are inviting and accommodating. I can't wait until to return to eat here in my next visit to this area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Garcia

sample_reviews_en.text: Love eating here. The lady who makes the food went to a special cooking school and it shows. Every meal here is a bit special and different from other places I've eaten. My favorite is the rice with curry, absolutely delicious 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Jesse Ben moyal

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited this place today.

Good service,  good price (50baht) and my meal was excellent.   Tasted very good.

I will try a different dish next time as there’s much to choose from.

Will be returning.

Recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: P.O.

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten at BB Thai Food & Noodles several times now, and the food has always been delicious and reasonably priced. The owner and her husband Derek are very welcoming and dedicated. Definitely recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Luca Baier

restaurants.name: Chiewchan Panich (Thewet Boiled Rice)
restaurants.address:

76 Krung Kasem Rd, Bang Khun Phrom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old, established rice porridge restaurant in the area. We stopped by to try it, and my mother really liked the taste. The portions aren't large, but the flavors are well-balanced, and the food comes out quickly. The ingredients are fresh. However, the staff were very grumpy, and the seating wasn't comfortable. The food comes out fast, so eat quickly and leave. You can park on the street in front of the restaurant, but be careful. In short, eat quickly! The signature dish is the Tom Kha Pla Salid (coconut milk soup with fried fish), which is delicious and comes with pieces of boneless fried fish. The stir-fried clams with chili paste are also excellent and live up to their recommendation, but the portion is a bit small. The restaurant has a constant flow of customers, and there aren't many seats.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suwandee Chaiwarut

sample_reviews_en.text:
Worth the price. Authentic traditional Chinese-Thai rice porridge.
Vegetable dishes like stir-fried morning glory and stir-fried white chives with tofu are delicious. The braised duck with pickled lemon is flavorful, and the rice porridge is fragrant. Eating it with stir-fried salted fish with basil and chili paste is even more delicious.
Healthy food, not greasy, beautifully presented.
The stir-fried greens are flavorful, healthy, and have a wonderful aroma and taste!
Healthy, inexpensive dishes with legendary good traditional Chinese-Thai taste.
16/2/2026 20.00
sample_reviews_en.author: L. W.

sample_reviews_en.text: When we are in Bangkok, we come to Dusit and have dinner here. It's a restaurant that has been passed down from generation to generation and serves truly excellent cuisine. My personal favourite is the Tom Yam soup. It's nicely spicy, fruity, sweet and sour, and full of spices – simply delicious! The single dishes (served with rice) are also very impressive in terms of taste and quantity. The atmosphere and staff are very friendly and authentic!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lukas Pleyer

sample_reviews_en.text:
Legendary rice porridge for over 70 years, Chiewchan Panich (Thewet Rice Porridge)

A delicious dish you must share. Great value and truly delicious.

A legendary menu full of delicious dishes that truly live up to its reputation.

If you've never tried Chiewchiwa, I highly recommend it.

#Chiewchiwa #chillcheeva
sample_reviews_en.author: Chill Cheeva

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! For those who like rice porridge, you'll definitely want to come back. The side dishes have a well-balanced flavor; the mixed vegetable stew is sweet and the various salted fish dishes are highly recommended. The price is considered good value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pimpan Kantacome

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant's rice porridge is so good I always order a second bowl because the broth isn't scalding hot, just perfectly warm. It's delicious with an omelet, and even better with stir-fried pickled radish. Other dishes are also great. I …
sample_reviews_en.author: Kimkana Magazine

sample_reviews_en.text: I recommend ordering the deep-fried pork intestines in soy sauce. Our table ordered three plates – it was amazing! Another must-try is the minced shrimp with preserved olives; it's fantastic. This is definitely a restaurant we'll be back to.
sample_reviews_en.author: SYN พาเที่ยว

sample_reviews_en.text: I eat here very often. The staff are very impressive and the service is excellent. The food is delicious. It's suitable for large groups, but also for couples as there is comfortable seating available, and it even has two floors.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanatcha Tuntiworadet

restaurants.name: จบที่ยำ สาขาห้าแยกลาดพร้าว
restaurants.address:

ร้าน จบที่ยำ สาขาห้าแยกลาดพร้าว เลขที่ 185 Lat Phrao Rd, Chom Phon, จตุจักร Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The restaurant is opposite Union Mall. We're not sure if there's parking because we walked from the BTS station. We saw a lot of cars parked behind the restaurant, but we didn't want to risk looking for a parking spot.

- The restaurant is open-air with no air conditioning, so it was quite hot. There was a noticeable smell of cigarette smoke, but they don't prohibit smoking inside.

- Upon entering, a male staff member greeted us warmly and recommended dishes quickly. The service at this restaurant was very good.

- The portions weren't as large as expected. For example, the salmon and shrimp salad (380 baht) was disappointing due to the small quantity. The food didn't come out very quickly, but there was a good variety of dishes to eat while waiting.

- The deep-fried pork belly with fish sauce was delicious! It's the MVP; you must order it.

- There's a 7% VAT charge. They accept credit cards.

Overall, we deducted points for the atmosphere because it was too hot to eat, and the portion sizes of some dishes were a bit unbearable. However, the taste was truly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Beta -

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant makes delicious salads (Yum) with great flavor in every dish. The staff are very helpful and polite. We ordered Norwegian salmon salad with extra instant noodles; the salmon was fresh and the pieces were large. The Som Tum with rice noodles and crispy pork rind was excellent; they gave us more crispy pork rind than expected. It wasn't too spicy, just perfectly balanced and delicious. The grilled pork neck with Jaew dipping sauce was very fresh, tender, and delicious with just the right amount of fat. The dipping sauce was also great. Another favorite was the fried chicken (I can't remember the name of the dish); it was crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, and served hot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thaya Aungtananukul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Best way to describe-
“absolutely brilliant”

What i loved over the food is the customer service. The store staff is very attentive about customers and take great care in ensuring the right food selection and comfort of the customers.

As for the food - every thing is delicious and ingredients feel absolutely fresh. In restaurants serving “yum” on the menu, freshness is always a concern is always a consideration, but this one checks all the right boxes.

As for price - very very pocket friendly 🥰
I am already planning my next visit 👏👏👏
sample_reviews_en.author: Gautam Ganguly

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The spicy salad and papaya salad were delicious and flavorful. The grilled chicken was just okay, rather bland, but not bad. The menu is quite extensive, and the prices are reasonable. I ordered 3 dishes, plus instant noodles and vermicelli, water, and ice, for a total of 465 baht.
- The staff provided good service, and the restrooms were clean.
- There is no parking at the restaurant. If you go in the evening, you have to find parking in the side streets. If it's later at night, you can park on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kate N.

sample_reviews_en.text: Currently staying at an AirBnB near Union Mall, and we stumbled across this place walking around the area. Have visited here for dinner 3 times, the food is delicious especially the spicy corn salad and larb moo (minced pork). Must eat with sticky rice! Service is always top notch, staff are really friendly and accommodating to our spice level needs :) highly recommend visiting for a meal if you're around the area!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicky Brain

sample_reviews_en.text: I've seen the restaurant move to this location a while ago, passing by many times without stopping. Today I decided to try it. The grilled beef was delicious and tender, and the dipping sauce was good. The fried pork with fish sauce was also tasty. Personally, I think the Tom Yum soup and the spicy salad would be even better if they were spicier, but those who don't like very spicy food would probably enjoy them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sippakorn

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a salad (yam) restaurant with consistently good dressing. No matter how many times I've eaten there, it's always the same, even though the restaurant has moved locations several times. Whenever I'm in Bangkok, I always make sure to stop by. Besides the delicious salads and papaya salad, their hot pot is also fantastic. Parking can be a bit difficult because it's near Lat Phrao Intersection.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apaporn Worklang

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and exactly as pictured. The flavors were bold and spicy, very satisfying. The prices were also very reasonable. The staff served the food quickly, and the restaurant even helped cover the transportation cost for the first hour. It's located right next to the MRT Phahonyothin station. The atmosphere is very chill, and the menu is diverse. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jongjit Yuphrai

restaurants.name: MK
restaurants.address:

333/101 Moo 9, Level 14, 102, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
MK Restaurant, located inside Central Festival, feels subtly better than MK in Terminal 21.

Here's a quick guide to ordering for first-timers.

First, choose your base broth. There's basic broth, mala broth, Japanese miso broth, and half-and-half broth. For Korean palates, I recommend miso or basic broth.

Next, choose your vegetables and meat. You can slowly browse the ordering pad to choose, but if you're unsure, there's a promotional set menu. The portions are roughly enough for two, so just choose your preferred amount and add meat or vegetables if you need more.

The basic drinks are constantly refilled, and you can order things like lemon tea separately, or not.

The fried duck or pork, dim sum, and fish cakes are not bad, but they're not particularly tasty either, so order whatever you like.

For the extras, I recommend the green noodles. The noodles aren't dipped in the broth; they're eaten on their own. The meat, vegetables, and fish cakes are scooped out, wrapped around the noodles, and dipped in sauce, making them incredibly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuru KIM

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was very crowded on a Sunday.
When we arrived at the restaurant, we had to wait in line for no more than 2 minutes, which is understandable given the number of people. Once inside, the staff seemed a little reluctant to serve us, but that's also understandable given the crowd.
The food was served quickly, in less than 15 minutes. However, since we ordered the quick-serve sukiyaki, we didn't know why it came last; at other branches, it's usually the first to arrive.
The jade noodles and crispy pork, which were also quick-serve dishes, felt like too small a portion and not worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pitcha S

sample_reviews_en.text:
MK Restaurant is a safe and reliable choice for Japanese travelers. Their main dish is shabu-shabu.

They offer set meals, but the portions are quite large, so ordering ingredients à la carte is also a good option.

At first, the flavor might seem a little bland, but as you continue eating, the comforting taste of a traditional hot pot dish emerges.

While there are many Japanese restaurants on the floor, this is a highly recommended restaurant for those who want to enjoy authentic local cuisine with peace of mind.
sample_reviews_en.author: キムラです

sample_reviews_en.text: We've been here several times now, and to other MK's as well. The food has always been good, with a great selection of individual dishes. And I personally think the duck is excellent. First-timers might have a little trouble ordering via tablet, but the staff are happy to help if you ask. We're satisfied; otherwise, we wouldn't go there so often, and the place wouldn't always be packed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Willi G.P. Buech

sample_reviews_en.text: Very delicious. The staff is very friendly. Easy to order with the kiosk. They respond immediately when I tell them what I need. The price is reasonable. I had a nice meal with my friend. The duck meat is really delicious. The shabu-shabu meat is generous. The free tea is delicious. I will go back here. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: 김동민

sample_reviews_en.text: We had the Peking duck and hotpot with a selection of Australian beef wagyu. The Peking duck was enjoyable and well prepared, definitely a highlight of the meal. The hotpot was decent, and the wagyu was good quality. While the non-pork broth options were a bit limited, the overall experience was pleasant and satisfying.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shaz Alidina

sample_reviews_en.text: I went with two friends and each ordered one dish. When paying, the staff should not stand with their backs to the customers. Standing and waiting for a large or small amount of money, leaning against the wall like that is not acceptable. It's disrespectful. The Central Pattaya Beach branch should train its employees.
sample_reviews_en.author: Keetapat Saithok

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a classic restaurant that everyone will enjoy. The food is always delicious. 

It's a great place to go when you want to eat with Thai people but not have too much spicy food. 

As it's located inside Sentan, the air conditioning is naturally on, so you can enjoy piping hot pot in a comfortable environment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Syo Kei

restaurants.name: Tales Khaosan Coffee
restaurants.address:

88 Chakrabongse Rd, Taladyod, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Best coffee in Khaosan and hostel too!! ☕🛏️

If you’re looking for the best coffee in Khaosan Road, look no further than Tales Khaosarn Coffee & Hostel. This hidden gem serves high-quality drinks that perfectly match Bangkok’s vibrant vibe. Barista is sooooo great! Reception is nice and helpful.

Not only is the coffee amazing, but the space is cozy, modern, and perfect for digital nomads or travelers who want to chill or work. (So worth iiiittt!!!! // dorm only 12$ per night!!!! OMG!!!)

❤️❤️❤️the hostel upstairs is clean, comfy, and budget-friendly — making it the perfect spot to rest after a day exploring the old town, temples, and night market.

📍Located just a short walk from Khao San Road maybe 30 seconds🤣🤣— peaceful but super central.😉💛🥇
Whether you’re here for a quick caffeine fix or looking for a unique place to stay in Bangkok, Tales Khaosarn hits the mark.

✅ Great coffee
✅ Friendly staff
✅ Stylish space with AC and Wi-Fi
✅ Perfect for solo travelers or couple

I definitely come again❤️

Ps bus from airport only 200baht (6$!!!!)
Private room is available too but they have only1room😂🏳️‍🌈✈️❤️❤️❤️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: หมอนุช เพื่อนลงทุน

sample_reviews_en.text:
ozy Vibes and Great Coffee

I recently visited Tales Khaosan and was pleasantly surprised by its cozy ambiance and warm hospitality. The coffee was excellent, with a rich, smooth flavor that really hit the spot. The baristas were friendly and attentive, making the experience even better. The cafe itself has a laid-back vibe, perfect for relaxing or getting some work done.

The only reason I’m giving it 4 stars instead of 5 is that the seating can be a bit limited during peak hours, making it challenging to find a spot. However, the overall experience was great, and I would definitely recommend Tales Khaosan to anyone looking for a good cup of coffee in a welcoming environment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saranya Cha

sample_reviews_en.text: We got breakfast with some drinks here and were very happy with our choice! The eggs and avocado were tasty, and there is an option to create your own breakfast plate if you like to customise. There are vegetarian options too. There is a good range of choice on the menu. The atmosphere is also really nice as there are tables with bean bags at the back which I find really comfortable and relaxing. We also met some nice people and got chatting at breakfast. The staff are also super lovely. Would recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dominyka Januleviciute

sample_reviews_en.text:
Capping off my wild night at Khao San Road with a life-saving cappuccino here! ☕️✨ This place is a total vibe—the train-themed interior is literally everything.
Huge shoutout to the staff for the Sky Bar recommendations; it was absolute fire! 🔥 They really know where the tea is. Also, can we talk about the insane perks? 150 THB for a shower and 20 THB for the loo? In this prime location? That’s basically a steal. If you’re not stopping by for your airport layover, you’re doing it wrong. Period. 💅✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Butter Bubby

sample_reviews_en.text:
I would recomend Tales Khaosan Coffee if you need to rest your legs and grab a quick bite, in a comfy environment.

It was such a hot day and I decided to grab a toast for a quick bite. The toast was simple but tasty.

There is power charging points to get your phone or devices charged, as well as shower facilities for an additional fee.
sample_reviews_en.author: Johnnie

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lovely brunch spot just around the corner from khaosan road! It did take a little while considering we were the only ones there, however the food was fresh and delicious.
The plates were a little small and cutlery was blunt which is why it’s not a 5star but overall we enjoyed! FYI they only have oat milk
sample_reviews_en.author: Ellie Turner

sample_reviews_en.text: I love this place!!! The food is so nice and cheap for what you get! Staff are very friendly and helpful. They also have lots of board games for us to play. It’s also a hostel and very close to Khao San Road. We didn’t stay there though. Just strolling and found somewhere to chill. Highly recommended!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wander Ping

sample_reviews_en.text: Really lovely cafe. They have a range of seating from tables to beanbags on the floor. It’s a got a really nice vibe with a huge range of food and drinks. They have games at the back that you can use as well. A real hidden gem. It was also really quiet when we went which is nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chloe Carass

restaurants.name: Tee bun song
restaurants.address:

65/9 ซอย ดุสิตาราม, Arun Amarin, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We'd say this restaurant is in the category of "delicious," but not amazingly so. The food is generally spicy, but not burningly so. On the day we went, we ordered minced beef basil stir-fry, stir-fried morning glory, seafood hot pot, and pork sausage salad. The basil stir-fry and pork sausage salad were average in taste; tasty, but nothing spectacular. The seafood hot pot was spicy and the broth was delicious and flavorful, but there wasn't much shrimp or squid. The stir-fried morning glory was well-prepared.

Overall, if there's a good basil stir-fry restaurant near your home/office, you can just eat there instead of coming here. But if you live nearby, it's a decent, conveniently located restaurant.

We deducted 2 stars because the taste wasn't anything spectacular, and there's a garbage dump on the street in front of the restaurant late at night, making it uncomfortable to eat near the trash.
sample_reviews_en.author: Heavytoon

sample_reviews_en.text:
The stir-fried beef with basil was delicious, not too spicy. The rice, however, wasn't very fluffy; it was a little clumpy, but not soggy.

The shop is located right under the overpass, so you might not see it easily. There aren't many tables inside, so you might have to wait for a table during peak hours.

Water is self-service. Parking is available along the street.

The price is typical: Stir-fried beef with basil and a fried egg is 70 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bhuwadon Watson

sample_reviews_en.text:
My absolute favorite minced pork basil stir-fry! I love it so much! Actually, this restaurant is famous for its beef basil stir-fry, but I don't eat beef. Their Tom Yum Goong (spicy shrimp soup) is also amazing – you have to try it! You won't be disappointed. If you're hungry, I recommend calling ahead to order because it's usually quite busy.
--------------------
There's no parking lot; you can find parking along the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nana Relax

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tee Boonsong is a delicious made-to-order restaurant near Phra Pin Klao Bridge on the Thonburi side, open in the evenings.
I tried the stir-fried basil beef with omelet. The stir-fried basil was dry but flavorful, with a clear and fragrant basil aroma. It was very enjoyable.
This is another restaurant that you can trust for its delicious food. 2/2/21
sample_reviews_en.author: นาย กาแฟ

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I came to eat Pad Krapow (Thai basil stir-fry) following in my senior's footsteps. The taste was as spicy as rumored; it's the real deal Pad Krapow, not just random vegetables thrown in. Since it was a weekday, there was no queue. Parking is available along the roadside. 🤭
sample_reviews_en.author: Hanaland

sample_reviews_en.text: Someone recommended this restaurant's basil chicken/pork dish, saying it was delicious, but when I tried it, it was just okay. It was very spicy, but still edible. The dish I really liked was the tom yum goong (spicy shrimp soup). I highly recommend ordering it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phattharaphong Kaoian

sample_reviews_en.text: I went here because it was near my hotel, and it was delicious. It's a great place to eat local food, and the prices are reasonable. It's a bit hot and the lack of air conditioning makes it difficult to eat, but I'd love to visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Life Green Juju

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered basil chicken last night, and it wasn't good at all. Normally, I don't add *fish sauce* to my food—I barely use it at all—but when I ate it, I had to add it, and the taste didn't improve at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนภณ งามประเสริฐ (ต้น)

restaurants.name: Shinkanzen Sushi เดอะ คริสตัล ราชพฤกษ์
restaurants.address:

The Crytal SB, Ratchaphruek, Tambon Maha Sawat, Amphoe Bang Kruai, Chang Wat Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time at this branch. The rice bowl and sushi rice were too sour. The salmon I ordered tasted okay and didn't have any unpleasant smell.
But the worst part was the staff. They just walked in and asked how many people were in my party. After I sat down, a menu was placed on the table by a staff member who didn't say anything. They came back again with a QR code and simply said, "Please scan this QR code to order." After ordering 2-3 items, the staff served the food without saying anything, just placing the plates down and walking away – this happened three times. The family at the next table was very polite, unlike me, who was dining alone. They were very welcoming, saying things like, "May I serve you, customer?" and "Have you received all your food?" in a pleasant tone and with a smile. Even after paying, I didn't hear a thank you; I was the only one who thanked them every time they served me. The service level is extremely low compared to other branches or other brands with similar prices and quality. This kind of discriminatory treatment from the staff is unacceptable. If you're dining alone, I recommend avoiding this place. It felt like I was begging for food.
sample_reviews_en.author: pollyy y

sample_reviews_en.text:
No wonder there are so few customers. I even tried a different branch to give this place a try. My first visit was a complete failure. At first, everything was fine; the staff were welcoming and attentive. But there was one person who made the restaurant feel gloomy. They looked unwelcoming and unwilling to serve, with a tense expression. This person was also a cashier. I saw them bring out the food once, but they seemed displeased. When it came time to pay, instead of smiling and acknowledging my request to wait a little, they just made a displeased face and didn't respond, even though there were no customers in line to pay. It was just not okay. I ate here on August 25th, 2026.
However, the staff who greeted and served me were very good and cheerful.
Except for one person.
"One dead fish spoils the whole barrel."
sample_reviews_en.author: รายการ ทีวี

sample_reviews_en.text: Newly opened on Ratchaphruek Road, located in front of SB The Crystal Ratchaphruek mall. Delicious and affordable Japanese food that suits Thai tastes. I give it 5 stars! I've brought foreigners, including Russians, and other international tourists, and they all praised it. Delicious and inexpensive; you can eat your fill without breaking the bank for about 300 baht per person. Great value! They provide takeout containers if you can't finish your food. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bat sac

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was fresh, tasty, and delicious. It was served quickly; most dishes arrived within 15 minutes, even though there were many tables occupied. Staff members regularly checked to make sure everyone had received their food.

Additionally, it would be great if the staff were more cheerful and smiled.

P.S. I ate at another branch the day before, and the service was terrible, completely different from this branch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Satawat Chaiyasit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I went shopping at Crystal Park and came across Shinkanzen restaurant, so I decided to try it.
When I walked in, the staff were very welcoming and suggested I sign up for membership so I could redeem points for free meals. Personally, I think the food is quite delicious, high quality, and reasonably priced. I could eat here often, and the atmosphere is pleasant. I think I'll definitely be back many more times.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mas Po

sample_reviews_en.text: We arrived around 7:30 PM. We spent some time choosing our food and got the sushi first. Anything we ordered after that didn't arrive until 8:20 PM, even though it wasn't crowded. We ordered the karubi beef rice bowl. Then my sister ordered the tonkatsu pork at 8:20 PM, but the food didn't arrive until 8:53 PM, and that's when a staff member came to ask us about it. This has never happened before.
sample_reviews_en.author: กณวรรธน์ เนตรวัตร

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the rice is fragrant and soft, the food arrived quickly, and it's clean. I recommend trying it. It's right at the front; I randomly went there but unexpectedly found my favorite restaurant. I love it! The staff might be a little confused at times, but it doesn't affect anything because the service is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: C K

sample_reviews_en.text:
Terrible experience.
We sat there for a very long time and the staff didn't bring us a menu.
They served the wrong food to our table and also made a mistake (we asked for well-done salmon rolls for the kids, but got them raw). This happened when there were only 2-3 tables occupied, and it took over an hour to get our food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pong Pong

restaurants.name: อ๊อดข้าวมันไก่ตอนเลิศรส
restaurants.address:

58 ซอย โรงหนังเก่าสุทธิสาร Ratchadaphisek, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited on June 6, 2023.

Regular Boiled Chicken Rice: 50 Baht per plate.
They also have fried chicken, but I didn't try it.

Taste: Very good. So delicious I ordered a second plate. The rice was fluffy, fragrant with chicken fat and a hint of ginger. The chicken was tender and juicy, with crispy skin. The dipping sauce had a prominent soy bean paste flavor followed by chili and ginger. The soup was chicken broth boiled with radish, served in half a bowl (yes, a "bowl," not a "cup"). It had a light flavor, good for cleansing the palate.

I added a little dark soy sauce for a touch of sweetness. Next time I'll try the fried chicken rice.

Motorcycles can be parked discreetly along the road in front of the shop. There is no car parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puak Krub

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of the best Hainanese chicken rice dishes in the area. Unfortunately, there's no parking; you have to call ahead to order and then park and pay in front of the shop. A regular portion is 50 baht, and a special portion is 60 baht. Even the regular size in the picture feels like a generous portion. The dipping sauce is good, and the soup contains winter melon and chicken bones. The chicken is juicy, thick, and tender, and the rice is fragrant. It's worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: cosmo

sample_reviews_en.text: A chicken rice shop in an alley. If you drive, it's a bit difficult to find parking. The interior of the shop is still old, looking like it's been in business for a long time. The uncle and aunt who own the shop take good care of you. I ordered chicken rice with leg meat, and the taste was quite good. The chicken was tender, but the rice was a bit too oily. Fortunately, there was dipping sauce and soup to help balance out the flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aim Kawin

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant I don't eat at often, but I've been coming back for a long time. It's a Hainanese chicken rice place that I can eat repeatedly without getting bored, especially the rice, which is delicious. However, recently I feel like it's less tasty, the chicken is drier than before, and the soup seems blander. The only downside is the lack of parking; parking is difficult in that area. But I still want to come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vespa G.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ideal Hainanese chicken rice. If you're looking for the perfect combination of flavorful rice, tender chicken, and a rich dipping sauce (chili and garlic), this is the one I've been looking for.

The seller is also lovely and friendly (and very kind). I'm so glad I discovered this flavor and got to try it. Thank you for opening our shop. ❤️🙏🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Yanisa Rattanasuwan

sample_reviews_en.text: Aod's Delicious Hainanese Chicken Rice, an old favorite in the Inthamara area. The rice is fragrant and perfectly soft, the chicken is chopped into large pieces and served in generous portions for the price. The dipping sauce has just the right flavor. The shop offers boiled chicken, fried chicken, and offal, which you can order as you like.
sample_reviews_en.author: อัมรินทร์ ดินแดง

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped in to get some protein after going to the gym nearby and it was a hit. The meat was juicy and well-portioned. I discovered a famous restaurant run by an elderly couple in the downtown area. I recommend it to anyone who goes to the gym nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boo Boo

sample_reviews_en.text: I just ate there a little while ago. Aod's Chicken Rice is an old, established restaurant. It used to be very popular, but now it's quieter. It's probably related to the economy. If the economy stays like this for much longer, things will get bad.
sample_reviews_en.author: อุดมเดช ตันติเวชธรรม

restaurants.name: Halal Fish Noodle
restaurants.address:

2655 Phatthanakan Rd, Khwaeng Suan Luang, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
📍 Fish Ball House

- Dry Tom Yum Yentafo with Glass Noodles: Fish and fish balls.
The broth is rich but slightly sweet, not very spicy. Adding lime juice makes it more balanced.

- Clear Soup with Yellow Noodles: Fish and fish balls.
The soup is clean, clear, and very easy to drink.

- Spicy Beef Salad: A flavor I've never tasted before. It's a salad with onions and tomatoes, possibly with chili paste.
Unusual but surprisingly tasty. Sour, sweet, and slightly spicy.

- Boiled Fish Balls with Dipping Sauce: I ordered two plates because the fish balls were excellent and bouncy. The dipping sauce is similar to seafood sauce but with an unfamiliar flavor.

- Dessert: Black sticky rice, corn, and lod chong (Thai dessert with coconut milk). The coconut milk sauce is similar to that of Wat Chet lod chong; not too sweet, a good palate cleanser.

The shop states they close at 2 PM, but I've visited around 1 PM and the shop was already clean and preparing to close.

Also, the shop is very clean, and the owner seems very attentive. If you plan to visit, I recommend arriving before noon.
The shop opens at 7 am. Wake up and come enjoy some delicious soup, it's truly satisfying.

‎ Alhamdulillah
sample_reviews_en.author: Aunya

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for a simple, quick lunch spot, this place delivers on the basics. I ordered a bowl of **Yen Ta Fo**, and while the flavors were standard, it hit the spot for a fast meal. The broth was slightly sweet with the classic pink sauce, and the toppings were fresh but nothing extraordinary.

The cleanliness of the restaurant was acceptable—nothing to complain about. The ambiance had a cozy local vibe with colorful wooden walls that add a bit of charm, but it's certainly a no-frills type of place.

Service was decent as well. Nothing stood out in particular, but my order arrived promptly, and the staff were polite.

Overall, this is a good spot for when you're in a hurry or just want something quick and easy. **Taste: ok | Cleanliness: ok | Service: ok**
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukawat Keratimanoch

sample_reviews_en.text:
Park your car in the n space parking area; there's space for about 10 cars. Walk back a short distance; the restaurant is right on the street, easy to find.
The soup has a clear, refreshing taste, perfect for sipping without needing any seasoning.
Free drinking water and ice are available.
Support Thai businesses!
The portion size is good for the price.

I've never seen a restaurant wrap chopsticks and spoons like this before.
It feels incredibly clean.
But at the same time, I feel like we're creating unnecessary plastic waste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyarat P

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an Islamic noodle shop with excellent taste. The noodles are delicious even without adding any extra seasoning. They offer a variety of options including fish noodles, wonton soup, beef noodles (clear broth and stewed), yentafo (pink noodle soup), and tom yum yentafo. Their beef salad is especially delicious. The prices are affordable, and they also have desserts. The atmosphere is very nice, spacious, and comfortable. The shop is very clean. The owner is very kind, and the staff are polite and provide good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arrida Solaea

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered Tom Yum Noodle Soup (50 baht).
The Tom Yum soup broth was mildly flavorful and well-balanced. If you want it spicier and sourer, you can add chili and chili vinegar.
The fish balls tasted good with a clear fish texture; not too much flour, just the right bounce.
The fish cake was delicious and met standard expectations.
The fried wontons were a little too hard.
There were small pieces of fish in them, which were tasty 😋
Overall, it's a good fish ball noodle shop.
Score: 7 out of 10
sample_reviews_en.author: Opas Samsen

sample_reviews_en.text:
8/2/69 11:30 First impression: The restaurant looked very clean. The taste was well-balanced; even without added seasoning, it was clean and not overly salty or sweet.
The restaurant is located by the canal.
Parking: Parking is available a short distance past the restaurant.
By BTS: Get off at Hua Mak station and walk along the canal to the end of Phatthanakan Road.
By bus: Get off at the end of Vibharam Hospital and walk back a short distance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ladawan Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: They have fish noodle, beef noodle, Kabsa or tomato rice, and some Thai dessert with ice. This local restaurant is obviously located beside the main street, surrounding by skyscrapers, but while you come in, it immediately gives a feeling of warmth and tranquility, which surprisingly makes us appreciate. God bless them clearly as well, running business by peaceful people of course.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dawud

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is 1000000/100 in cleanliness.
I've been eating here for many years, since the restaurant was in its old location.
I always order the same dish: dry tom yum noodles. (I recommend reducing the amount of chili paste if you order the dry version, otherwise it might be a bit too salty. But the soup version is just right.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Phia Thanchanok

restaurants.name: Margarita Storm MaxValu 71
restaurants.address:

MaxValu, 140 Sukhumvit 71 Rd, เเขวง พระโขนงเหนือ, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolutely phenomenal experience! 10/10
If you are looking for incredible Mexican cuisine, look no further. Every single aspect of our visit was top-notch:
• The Food: Absolutely amazing. Everything was incredibly fresh, packed with flavor, and cooked to perfection.
• The Drinks: Just as impressive as the food! They were perfectly mixed, refreshing, and the ideal complement to the meal.
• The Service: The staff truly went above and beyond. They were so kind, friendly, and genuinely welcoming from the moment we walked through the door.
It is rare to find a place that nails the food, the drinks, and the service so effortlessly. Truly a 10/10 experience. I highly recommend this spot and cannot wait to go back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Joseph Martinez

sample_reviews_en.text: We went for dinner and ordered the Chimi de Sunrise and the Red Hot Burrito Mojado, along with the bottomless chips and a big cup of salsa. The salsa was absolutely delicious and paired perfectly with the fresh chips. Both dishes were packed with flavor and the portions were generous. The staff was friendly and attentive, which made the whole experience even better. Overall, it was a really satisfying meal and everything tasted great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shinelle

sample_reviews_en.text: First thing is a service. I feeled very comfortable and taken care of what i need. The music, a/c, chill vibe…everything is very nice here. The second thing is a meal. I order two Super Bowls (Chipotle Chicken and Smoked Brisket) and one High Protein Bowl (Grilled Chicken) - very tasty, delicious and i love it! 🤤🫠💪🏻👌🏻 (on the picture you have Grilled Chicken). Poland need more food place like this 🔥❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamil Szczepański

sample_reviews_en.text: This reminded me of home in America. I’ve been missing Mexican food and this hit the spot. I got a barbacoa burrito and it was delicious; very flavorful and a huge portion. I should’ve taken half home. Rohit was attentive to my needs. He brought me water and asked about a margarita refill. The margaritas were so good. Perfect balance of flavors
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarah Potter

sample_reviews_en.text: This was a great dining experience. My girlfriend and I enjoyed the tacos. It was great. They had all you can eat tacos on Fridays (Tuesdays too!) for 490 baht. The service was amazing and it was a real treat. I like this branch much more than the one by Nana BTS. Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kevin Gillis

sample_reviews_en.text: The ONLY place in Bangkok that I know of for Huevos Rancheros and Breakfast Burritos! Staff is friendly and helpful.  Downstairs and upstairs dining contribute to a cozy atmosphere.  Being a part of the Sunrise Tacos family the Mexican food is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jorge Jetson

sample_reviews_en.text: Great atmosphere, staff were so attentive, and all the food was delicious! Both the red and green enchiladas were so tasty, and the veggies had a delicious charred taste. Loved the bottomless chips and salsa. Definitely will be coming back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Erin Meyers

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff was limited but the service was still good despite us being a larger group (9 people). We were the only ones there at the time, possibly because the branch has recently opened. So, not much to enjoy the atmosphere yet. Coming to …
sample_reviews_en.author: Kunal Kukreja

restaurants.name: ราชาบะหมี่เกี๊ยว หมูแดงอบน้ำผึ้ง
restaurants.address:

57 At Narong Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the best shrimp wanton street food stalls in Bangkok.

Racha Noodles (Sai ​​Loh) is a convenient, street-style noodle and wonton stall with restaurant-quality food. It's a sister shop to Sawang Hualamphong and New Loh Eian in Khlong Toei Market, with Sai Loh being the younger sibling, as its name suggests (Sai ​​Loh means "youngest" in Cantonese). It's open only from 4 PM until late at night and is located in front of Khlong Toei Market. Today, I tried their dried shrimp wontons. The wontons are plump, with a filling of shrimp and pork, similar to Hong Kong-style shrimp wontons. The taste is among the best in Thailand. The wonton wrappers are thin and white, filled with shrimp and topped with fried garlic and chopped scallions. They're delicious on their own or dipped in their signature sour sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: wichak phijaisanit

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pork noodle soup had thick slices of pork, and the pork itself was very tasty, not thin, thick, tender, and flavorful.
The noodles were perfectly cooked, and the soup was delicious, with some cabbage added. Most importantly, it was great value for money. Regular is 30 baht, special is 35 baht. You can't find this quality at this price anywhere else, especially in this era of high living costs in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: prathan “naidear” tongsawas

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is good, homemade, and the price is affordable at 30-35 baht.
Compared to other shops in the 40-45 baht price range, it's better.
It gets quite hot in the evening when the sun shines. Free self-serve ice and free tea. The service is okay. There are a lot of customers and sometimes the cook forgets something, which is understandable.
sample_reviews_en.author: - Nuu -

sample_reviews_en.text:
I discovered this place while taking a walk after the gym.

First of all, it's not in an area frequented by tourists, so there are no English signs. Probably only Thai is spoken.

I ordered using gestures.

Pork? and wontons, vegetable dry noodles, 35 baht.

It's not a large portion, but enough to satisfy a light hunger.

It was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: 小野智紀

sample_reviews_en.text: I never thought I'd still find delicious food for 30-35 baht these days. The food is served very quickly, no more than 5 minutes. I've eaten here 3 times already. Parking is available because people eat quickly and leave... quite convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Susie Buangsang

sample_reviews_en.text: Just order two regular bowls. Ordering the special isn't much different from the regular. It used to be much tastier. Lately, the quality has declined a lot, but it's still good enough to satisfy your hunger.
sample_reviews_en.author: yuht nong_o

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles are good, the barbecued pork and dumplings are delicious, and the price is very cheap. Regular is 30 baht, special is 35 baht. If you're passing by, don't hesitate, stop by and eat!
sample_reviews_en.author: Shinimbig

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a bit hot, but very delicious. I usually like to eat pork noodles with one spoonful of pork sauce. Awesome!!!
Very cheap. I ate 3 bowls for less than 100 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthamon Klaibanmai

restaurants.name: ส.ลาบอุบล
restaurants.address:

403, 108 Charan Sanit Wong Rd, Bang Khun Si, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The Isaan food at this restaurant looks clean and well-maintained, showing investment in tableware. The taste is decent, but as the restaurant gets busier, the food delivery service becomes inconsistent. The servers just serve without much thought, and the kitchen management doesn't write table numbers on the plates for the staff to know which table to deliver to. Customers get frustrated when they don't receive their food, while tables that arrived later receive theirs first. Don't make excuses; this is constructive criticism for improvement. If you want to increase sales, invest in a better system. People come to eat because they're hungry, not to wait anxiously wondering whose dish is on their table... Just something to think about, offered with good intentions. ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Kullawat Khanatong (พี่เอ๋ 90s)

sample_reviews_en.text: The papaya salad here is excellent. The fermented fish sauce is fragrant and delicious. They use freshwater crab, which I really appreciate. The shredded papaya is superb. Everything in the papaya salad with fermented fish sauce is perfect. The "Tam Sua" (spicy papaya salad with noodles) is also very good, with the addition of long-leaf coriander which gives it a refreshing flavor. The prices are reasonable for the papaya salad dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pang R.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, but the service is terrible. Especially the man at the front of the shop – is he an employee or the owner? He acts like it's his own shop. The shop closes at midnight, but they start packing up and turning off the lights at 11 pm. And he speaks like he owns the place. If this continues, I'm closing down. The food tastes great, but the service is awful!
sample_reviews_en.author: กาญจนา เกษมณี

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is one of my favorite somtum (papaya salad) restaurants. It's my go-to place, and I never get tired of it, no matter how many times I visit. Especially the grilled and fried dishes, they are incredibly delicious!
My favorite dish is the grilled intestines. The intestines don't have any unpleasant smell at all, and they're crispy on the outside and tender on the inside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khun Lemon

sample_reviews_en.text:
The rice noodle salad was incredibly delicious! The pork sausage was top-notch.
The fried duck beak and garlic cubes were the best! Super delicious, Auntie! My favorite restaurant near home. The crying tiger beef was also great but I forgot to take a picture. Just one dish, and I give it 10 thumbs up! 🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Eye K

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I went out for food and drinks (bring my own Red Label whiskey).
A bottle of soda was 20 baht.
The bill came to 120 baht for 6 bottles of soda.
I pointed it out and they said okay.
But there was a corkage fee of 50 baht for a somtum (papaya salad) stall on the sidewalk.
sample_reviews_en.author: anucha limtrakultongchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time trying it and I was impressed. The food arrived quickly, even though it was crowded.
I bought it to take home and it came in a box, ready to eat, which was very convenient.
The overall flavor was average, not overly spicy. Three items for 200 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: CYN

sample_reviews_en.text:
Spicy papaya salad with crab, shrimp, and fermented fish sauce - delicious and very tasty! 🦀🦐
Grilled beef tongue with rich and spicy dipping sauce - so good! 🐂
Spicy squid salad - a little too sweet. 🐙
Delicious! Let's go! 🤤🤤🤤
sample_reviews_en.author: Nt Ome - Travis

restaurants.name: Fuji
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 1024 อาคารศูนย์การค้า สุพรีม สามเสน ชั้นที่ แอล 3 ห้องเลขที่ แอล 312-314 Sam Sen Rd, Thanon Nakhon Chai Si, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had Japanese food at "Fuji" restaurant located on the 3rd floor of Supreme Complex (Sam Sen Rd., Thanon Nakhon Chai Si Subdistrict, Dusit District, Bangkok). The restaurant is clean, bright, and the service is good. The food is fresh, high-quality, and delicious. All menu prices include 7% VAT and a 10% service charge.
- Special sets available from 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM are served with tea or coffee, fruit, or dessert.
- Tempura Bento Set: 450 THB
- Pork Sukiyaki and Sashimi Set (Niku Dofu & Sashimi Set): 310 THB. Includes rice, soup, kimchi, and sashimi (3 pieces of tuna and 2 pieces of salmon).
_ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
- "Fuji" opened its first branch in 1999 (26 years in 2025) at CentralPlaza Ladprao. Currently, there are over... 100 branches in Thailand and abroad
- The menu is on thick cardboard, clean, colorful, and the plates and food match the pictures. It's available in 3 languages.

Photo: Before noon, Wednesday, December 25, 2024, 10:59-11:52 AM
Fuji Japanese Restaurant, Supreme Complex Branch, 3rd Floor, Nakhon Chai Si Road, Dusit District, Bangkok.
13°47'22.5"N 100°30'55.3"E (13.789583, 100.515361), altitude 6.2 m.
Post: July 25, 2025, 8:45 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: Satjarthip Thusneyapan

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch isn't crowded. This mall isn't crowded. The food is delicious and up to standard, just like other Fuji branches. You don't have to wait in line like some branches in malls that are crowded. The restaurant is quite large. The atmosphere is relaxed. I go there often, but some days the food is a bit slow. The price is standard Fuji, maybe higher than other Japanese restaurants, but it's clean and good quality. I will definitely go to this branch again. I like the taste. There is parking in this mall, which is very convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teaw Pailintip

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went there for our late dinner. It was around 8 pm so most of the restaurants in Supreme are already closed. We ordered Takoyaki, beef yakiniku on a hot plate (which was not sizzling hot) ramen sushi set.
The beef was ok but doesn’t taste anything amazing. The ramen was really bland, shouldn’t even be selling ramen if they served something like this. Sushi was similar to 10 baht sushi downstairs. The service was great, attentive but the food was subpar at best
sample_reviews_en.author: Phu Koanantakool

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm a regular customer, often with my kids. The staff are very welcoming and take excellent care of the children. I'm surprised this branch has an average rating below 4. The only downside I found was that the food was served slowly when the restaurant was busy, which is normal for any restaurant and acceptable. If you've been here before, please leave a rating to encourage the staff. I give it 5 stars; the service is superb.
sample_reviews_en.author: tadc tadc

sample_reviews_en.text: I have filed several complaints about Fuji restaurant, Supreme Building, Samsen branch (branch code 00029). Ordering food is consistently slow, incomplete, and takes over an hour to arrive. I've had to follow up on my order more than 5 times. There's been no improvement at all. I believe that beyond the food quality, the restaurant should raise its service standards. (Latest complaint: July 15, 2020)
sample_reviews_en.author: Palakorn Sinarpa

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to eat yakiniku (Japanese BBQ) three times. The first time was okay; the meat was hot and juicy. But the second and third times, it was served cold both times. The third time was unbearable; I asked them to reheat it, but they only reheated it. The meat was very dry. Where is the standard? Is it acceptable to prepare yakiniku and serve it like this?
sample_reviews_en.author: Juliett M.

sample_reviews_en.text: Fuji's regular menu items, grilled mackerel and sea bass steak, are as delicious as ever. My only minor complaint is that the fried garlic topping wasn't crispy today; it was chewy and stuck to my teeth. The staff were friendly and polite, even though it was close to closing time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jumroon Chanopatch

sample_reviews_en.text: I really like eating at Fuji. The food tastes great and the ingredients are carefully selected. My daughter likes this restaurant the most. The price and waiting time may be higher than other restaurants, but the service and food have never disappointed me.
sample_reviews_en.author: บุญทิน ทองยศ

restaurants.name: Begin Again
restaurants.address:

58/6 Thanon Yannawa, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and affordable. The rice is soft and tasty, and the portions are generous. However, lately, the taste of the same dishes has changed. Each time I eat there, the taste is inconsistent; it's a bit too sweet. For example, the drunken noodles (Pad Kee Mao) don't taste the same anymore; they're too sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apinya Apinya

sample_reviews_en.text: A good tiny spot with bunch of other cafes around and this one easily take the limelight with ambience and atmosphere it creates. Good spot to catch up with friends with good choices of beverages and crepes. Price slightly on the higher side, but makes up for being an instragamable spot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vichanath Singh

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything we ordered was delicious. There was live music, and the prices were reasonable. I usually don't like shrimp patties, but my sister ordered them and they were amazing. The papaya salad, sea bass with chili sauce, and steamed egg custard were all excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanta B.

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place! The owner is amazing and so friendly. I ordered a spicy salad and told the owner it was too spicy because I forgot to ask for it less spicy. The owner made a new one for me even though I'd already tasted it! Very impressed!
sample_reviews_en.author: 018 เมธาวี เอี่ยมสุวรรณ

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is perfect for people to sit and enjoy a beer after work, have some snacks, and chat. It's a small, uncrowded place playing 90s music. Some of the food is delicious, but it's ideal for a relaxed, conversational session.
sample_reviews_en.author: Su YD

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. The glass noodle larb, seafood salad, and fried beef were all tasty. However, the service is a bit slow. Those who get easily irritated when hungry might have to clench their fists in frustration.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sky Tks

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. We ordered 6 dishes and they were all tasty. The prices weren't high, and the drinks were also reasonably priced. This is definitely going to be one of my regular restaurants in Liz!
sample_reviews_en.author: Om Isri

sample_reviews_en.text: I've passed by this place every day for a year, and only stopped by to eat today. It was delicious, especially the traditional glass noodle salad! 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Usa S.

restaurants.name: BREVE
restaurants.address:

Ramkhamhaeng 24 Huamark, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I'm reviewing a new cafe near our shop 🥰
I've had my eye on it since I started working here, and it was totally worth the wait! The shop is beautiful and has great taste.

I ordered a matcha latte, unsweetened, but I think coffee lovers should try it. They have a wide selection of coffee beans; try chatting with the owner. Personally, I don't drink coffee, I'm a matcha lover!

⭐Cleanliness: Passed!
⭐Service: Probably the owner, great service!
⭐Food: Tastes good!
⭐Decoration/Atmosphere: Love it! Shady and beautiful.
⭐Overall: Great! Come visit! They open early in the morning!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nat Poratip

sample_reviews_en.text:
A cafe that i frequent. Either for quick take away or passing time. Their coffee has been great.
Highlight of this cafe is their variety of imported coffee beans in video. Not your typical coffee chain.
Not a fan of coffee, there’s also tea and matcha available for everyone.
It can get really busy when there’s events eg. concert or international sports comp around here.
Usual weekdays are fine.
sample_reviews_en.author: A

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the coffee shop,which is my girlfriend and me favorite.We always drink here and talk a lot.Sometimes she doesn’t have time to drink here. I will take her to dinner.She is a coffee lover and have high criterion for coffee. I am glad she like this one.We spent a lot time together in here and also good memories.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jing Chris

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a small shop with street parking, which can be difficult to find at certain times and days. The coffee is delicious, made with imported beans, and the price is reasonable for the quality. However, there are limited seats, making it unsuitable for long stays; it's more suitable for takeaway.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siwakorn Job

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop owner is very friendly and provides excellent service. The coffee is superb, with over ten different beans to choose from. The cheesecake is delicious. Importantly, the prices are reasonable and the quality is well worth the money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patsi Love

sample_reviews_en.text: I was in the Ramkhamhaeng area looking for a coffee shop, and I made the right choice! I tried BREVE coffee and ordered an iced Americano with the Berry Blend beans. The price was great, and the berry flavor was intense! Very impressed 💙💙💙
sample_reviews_en.author: ball. bzy

sample_reviews_en.text:
Coffee shop near Rajamangala Stadium with parking available.
Coffee lovers shouldn't miss this place! They might not have a huge selection of beans, but they're all carefully selected ☕️
Great price!! Delicious!!! Highly recommend 🙌🏻💥
sample_reviews_en.author: Kitipa Kongkit

sample_reviews_en.text:
BREVE, a coffee shop behind Ramkhamhaeng University.
Located in the Ramkhamhaeng 24 area, this coffee shop is sure to please coffee lovers. Suitable for all customer groups, from teenagers to working adults, both …
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuradeen Bing

restaurants.name: Phaisan Restaurant
restaurants.address:

Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there for lunch on a weekday during the rainy season.

I couldn't find the restaurant in the morning, but it was fine at lunchtime. Besides me, there were two other customers, a local Thai and a Caucasian. It's a friendly place where you help yourself to free water and drinks from the refrigerated case. The food was served fairly quickly after ordering. However,
the salad was prepared after ordering, with the ingredients cut and mixed, and served last. The seafood egg curry stir-fry was like a seafood version of Pad Pong Curry. It was delicious with just the right amount of spiciness. The soup had a light, refreshing taste with a strong fish broth. It tasted similar to oden broth, and the occasional cilantro added a nice change of pace. And the price was cheap!

The prices are friendly to locals. It seems they also do Uber Eats! It's a shame they close a little early at 7 PM, but they open earlier than other places in the morning.

⇊I ordered the same thing twice (lol)😅
sample_reviews_en.author: Sho Ishikawa

sample_reviews_en.text: I visited alone around 1:00 PM on a Saturday and ordered the Seafood Egg Curry and Seafood Yam Woon Sen. The menu listed rice-topped stir-fried curry powder, and from the photo, I assumed this was the egg curry. The flavor was bland, lacking punch. Perhaps the egg-topped curry made it too mild. It was served lukewarm, and the fan kept cooling it down quickly, so I wondered why they didn't serve it hotter. The Seafood Yam Woon Sen had a seafood to glass noodle ratio of about 7:3. It was way too much. Some people might appreciate the generous amount of seafood, but I was a little disappointed because I thought yum woon sen was meant to be served with glass noodle. Wouldn't it have been better if the ratio had been reversed? The flavor was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shinichi

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stopped in for the first time on my way to the songthaew stop heading towards Jomtien. It was a weekday afternoon, but the restaurant was empty. Looking at the menu, the prices were about the same as Anonymous Shokudo, which shows that it's popular with Japanese people struggling with the weak yen. I ordered the shrimp and egg curry, which was consistently delicious, so I'm not surprised. I was also impressed by the refreshing service. Also, on the menu, I didn't realize at first that there was a 10 baht price difference between the different ingredients, such as pork and shrimp. This is a restaurant I'd like to visit again, thank you for the meal.
I also ordered pork fried rice to take home, and was surprised by how large the portion was.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kawashima Nori

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ski Heng (dry Thai Suki) for 50B. Inexpensive and delicious. Ski Heng is great when you want to eat some vegetables. It uses a variety of vegetables, so it seems healthy. It was delicious, topped with a generous amount of sweet and spicy sauce (perhaps the same as the sauce for Khao Man Gai?).
Free water is self-service.

I had stir-fried chicken and vegetables for 50B (with a fried egg for 10B). The oyster sauce was just right and it was very delicious.

I had spicy drunkard stir-fry for 50B (with a fried egg for 10B). It has a unique name, but it's also delicious.
I asked for it to be mild. It contains whole peppercorns, so be careful when eating it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Syo Kei

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went on Sunday but it was closed, so I tried going on Monday at lunchtime.
I read online that it gets crowded, so I arrived after 11 AM, but there was no one there.
I ordered Sen Yai Pad Kee Mao.
It's hard to find this dish at restaurants, and even when you do, it's often not very good, but it's been years since I've had such delicious Sen Yai Pad Kee Mao.
The beer was also very reasonably priced at 65 baht for a large bottle, and of course, the other dishes were delicious too.
Once you go, you'll understand why it's so popular.
Thank you for the delicious food!
sample_reviews_en.author: Phan I
