sample_reviews_en.text:
It seems like quite a few Japanese people visit here.
I went there at lunchtime, so I think three people, probably Japanese, entered after I did.
The only other customers were three older women who probably work nearby, making this a thriving local diner.
Previously, the menu didn't have prices listed, but when I went this time, I thought it was very easy to read.
As for the taste, it's carefully and cleanly made, and most importantly, delicious!
The complimentary water is served directly from a large mineral water bottle, so you can drink it with peace of mind.
sample_reviews_en.author: AMG

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been in Thailand for half a month, and this is undoubtedly the best restaurant I've been to. From the Pad Thai to the omelets and soup, everything seemed to suit Japanese tastes; for some reason, everything I ordered was delicious. I went twice, once before and once after visiting Koh Larn. The seasoning seems to vary slightly from day to day, but it was exactly what I expected.

On our first day, we ordered Pad Thai and an omelet. This is a very reasonably priced restaurant where you can get a dish for around 40 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hamm

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for local Thai food in Pattaya, this is the place to go. The prices are reasonable and the food is delicious👍🏻
I was looking for one last delicious local Thai restaurant before leaving Pattaya, and this is it.
It's seriously the bestㅠㅠ It might be a little salty for Korean palates, but it's refreshing with beer.
If I ever visit Pattaya again, I'll definitely come here.
I'm leaving a review because there aren't any Korean reviews!!!!!!!!!!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: dan bee hong

restaurants.name: กุยช่าย อาม่า ตลาดสามย่าน
restaurants.address:

PGPF+RRJ, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
In 2014, I bought three fillings: chive, bamboo shoot, and jicama.
The bamboo shoot filling was delicious.
But the jicama filling's dough wasn't cooked through 😭 Or maybe that's actually the shop's standard – cooked al dente?
________
In 2018, I guess I had bad luck.
The stir-fried vegetable filling was undercooked and had a very strong raw vegetable smell. I bought so many to give to relatives.
The bamboo shoot filling, however, was delicious and standard.
sample_reviews_en.author: P Mountain

sample_reviews_en.text:
I arrived around noon today. There was a queue of about four or five people, each buying a lot, so I waited a little, but less than 10 minutes. The shop was very quick in preparing my order.

I bought chive and taro fillings. They were large, generously filled, and delicious as always.

The atmosphere was like a typical market stall.
sample_reviews_en.author: d apk

sample_reviews_en.text: These chive dumplings have a seemingly thick wrapper, but they melt in your mouth! They're incredibly delicious. I initially bought them based on reviews, and I was a little worried they wouldn't be good, but they were amazing! The chive dumplings have a great flavor of their own. I bought 10 of them for 15 baht each.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akari Ning

sample_reviews_en.text: These chive dumplings are delicious! They're full of vegetables, the dough is soft, not too thick and not too thin. I bought some to take home and reheated them, and they were still just as delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wichanikul Seepot

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped by to buy some and I loved it! The taro strips and radish strips are delicious and high-quality. The shop steams them for you, but if you prefer them fried, they have that option too.
sample_reviews_en.author: AS SAWA

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ama's Kuichai is located in Samyan Market, Chula Soi 9, Bangkok, not far from Banthat Thong.
I was informed that there was a queue to buy them, but when we went, there was …
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaroonphan Lim

sample_reviews_en.text: The vegetable filling overflows from the thin dough. It's a little disappointing that there wasn't enough dipping sauce for all 10 pieces. 150 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kornravee r

sample_reviews_en.text: These dumplings are generously filled with delicious chive, jicama, sticky rice, and bamboo shoot fillings. The quality is worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aey T.

restaurants.name: ร้านข้าวฟืนอุ่นสาธุ44/1
restaurants.address:

MGQM+73V, Sathu Pradit 44/1 Alley, Bang Phong Phang, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Arrived around 7:15 AM looking for warm sticky rice noodles.
I've had similar ones in the mountains of Chiang Rai, which were yellowish.
The ones at Yunnan Market in Chiang Mai were whiter.
The texture is like porridge, topped with peanuts, chili oil, vegetables, and pickled vegetables.
It was delicious, but a little too salty, even without any sauce. 50 baht per set.
But I liked it and want more.
The food photos aren't very clear; my camera was probably malfunctioning when I took them.

The shop is open from 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM, according to the staff.
It's an authentic Shan (Tai Yai) restaurant; the menu doesn't have any Thai language.
I'll try other dishes next time.

It's a small alley, turn left a little, the shop is on the right. The alley is narrow and there's no parking.
There's a Shan temple inside; I'll try visiting the temple next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: C Muthita

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hidden gem if you're craving authentic Shan/Burmese food in Bangkok! We tried the warm chickpea tofu (tohu nway) topped with coriander, sesame, crispy garlic and a savory chili-soy sauce, served with golden fried dough on the side for dipping. Comforting, fresh, and packed with flavor — and incredibly cheap for what you get.
The place itself is a whole vibe: paper umbrellas, lanterns, flags, fairy lights everywhere. It feels like stepping into a little corner of Shan State. Super friendly welcome too.
Highly recommend if you want something different from the usual Thai spots. Will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Arnaud ISSOIRE

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried Tofu Nway (60 THB) and Fried Fritters (50 THB).
Both tasted 7/10.
You can dine in an air-con room or outdoor seating.
Staff service: 7/10.
The price is very fair.
I will come again if I crave Shan food.
sample_reviews_en.author: J “𓆝 𓆟”

sample_reviews_en.text: Best Shan food I have ever tried in Bangkok. All menus are delicious and the price is reasonable. I visited twice. If you love authentic Shan food and you are in Bangkok, this is the place for you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saw Zar Li

sample_reviews_en.text: It's like going back to your hometown. The food is delicious, the music is cool, and it feels very chill. The warm water makes you feel more like you're home.
sample_reviews_en.author: aik nokh

sample_reviews_en.text: I have tasted a lot of restaurants and it’s very rare to write a review but this restaurant is the best Shan authentic food ever. Come and try it
sample_reviews_en.author: ZinYu Wai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very authentic Shan food.

Good.
I'm trying Shan food.

The tofu tastes
Sweet, cool, light
Not too thick
Even better than the ones in the market.
sample_reviews_en.author: Willy icat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really got me feeling back home
Love this shop so much
They also have a Small shop selling Shan and Myanmar products  with reasonable prices
sample_reviews_en.author: Thown Thown Zaw

restaurants.name: อับบาส กุ้งใหญ่
restaurants.address:

1 Ramkhamhaeng 118 Alley, Lane 11, Saphan Sung, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
For fresh and expertly prepared seafood, this is the place to go. They offer a wide variety of seafood, from shrimp and squid to clams and fish, all incredibly delicious.

Grilled cockles are perfectly dry and fresh.
The fried sea bass with fish sauce is a favorite among adults; the fish is fresh, the fish sauce is flavorful, and it's perfectly fried and easy to eat.
The sour curry with Ryukyu fish roe is rich and flavorful, with excellent curry paste. You can adjust the spiciness level, and the fish roe bursts in your mouth.
The crab omelet is packed with crab meat – chunks of crab!
The shrimp is the best! Available in several sizes, all delicious and perfectly grilled. The shrimp is fresh and bouncy, making it a joy to eat.
The restaurant is easy to find, located right by the main road. Parking is limited, and the restaurant is small, so it's best to call ahead to reserve a table. The prices are reasonable and offer great value. For delivery, you can order through the app or order directly from the restaurant and arrange for a ride.
sample_reviews_en.author: PlolaBear Pla

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my 4th visit, and probably my last. I went before 6 PM and didn't get to eat until almost 7 PM (we were the only table).
- Mixed stir-fried vegetables...all the vegetables were mushy and soft, like they'd been boiled. It reminded me of mashed boiled vegetables for babies learning to eat without chewing.
- Stir-fried squid with salted egg...still delicious and fresh.
- Stir-fried white shrimp with shrimp paste and stink beans...still okay.
- Omelette...very salty...couldn't even eat it with rice.
- Winged bean salad...too sour and too salty...like they didn't use real lime. I was already full and couldn't eat it anymore because of the taste.

The food came out very slowly, even though we were the only table...and waiting for the bill was a long time...don't expect any speed.
This is truly the last time...before this, it was one of our family's top restaurants on this street.

P.S. The ingredients are still fresh and large portions.
But the cook isn't the same anymore.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sansanee Madmontin

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered 4 dishes: 1. Steamed sea bass with lime. Good flavor, but the fish was a bit mushy. 2. Stir-fried shrimp with shrimp paste. Strong and spicy flavor. 3. Grilled river shrimp. 4. Steamed crab with egg yolk in fresh milk. The rest were 1 pot of rice, 4 bottles of water, 2 buckets of ice. 4 people ate. The bill came to 3,2xx. The price is high because of the last two dishes. Overall, it's okay. Reasonable price. Seafood sauce is spicy. Food is fresh. The shop might not be very big. There's an air-conditioned area and an outdoor area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanida Daria P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Halal seafood restaurant serves delicious Som Tum (papaya salad) and Northeastern Thai food. Every dish is tasty and great value. Delivery service is available. The fresh crab with roe is sweet and the seafood dipping sauce is spicy and flavorful. The prices are reasonable.
#HalalSeafood #AbbasLargeShrimp #CrabWithRoe
#GrilledRiverPrawns #Ramkhamhaeng118
sample_reviews_en.author: Pueng Pitch

sample_reviews_en.text:
Update:
They moved to a new location but the food is still delicious.
Parking is not a problem, but the toilet really needs some improvement.

This was my 1st time here, but certainly not the last. I fall in love with their "crab meat curry" and the "Salt Grilled Tilapia Fish" was just perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Philippe Ch. Endress

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fresh, clean seafood, including som tam, Isaan food, and made-to-order rice dishes. The flavors are rich and flavorful.
However, you might have to wait a bit for your food. Parking is limited, but it's available. The food is good and reasonably priced, making it a good value.
sample_reviews_en.author: AD Leewan

sample_reviews_en.text: I really love the spicy fish roe salad with chili paste. They put in a generous amount of large fish roe. Opening the package makes me so happy! I hope they maintain this quality for a long time. I've ordered from this restaurant many times and have never been disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kenny Treseangrat

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious and the prices were reasonable. The best part is, despite being a seafood restaurant, their papaya salad with fermented crab was incredibly flavorful. I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mhadeawz Mhadeawzz

restaurants.name: Mooham & Nu-Daeng Cafe
restaurants.address:

276 ซ. งามวงศ์วาน 23, Bang Krasaw, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious! (Especially the pork steak, so tender!) Generous portions, and incredibly cheap prices. The owner must be rich to be able to sell at these prices!🤣🩷

Convenient parking right in front of the shop. They have savory dishes, desserts, and drinks! I was so hungry I only managed to take pictures of the desserts.
I guarantee the food is delicious and great value. I wish it were closer to my house, I'd eat here every day! I happened to find this place while running errands that day. I'll definitely be back!

P.S. They have board games on the second floor too!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dark Angle

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is cute. The front entrance caught our eye with a picture of a girl with frizzy hair...
We came for a late lunch and ordered several dishes... as pictured. The taste was great; in fact, very delicious.
The food didn't take too long to arrive (the owner said they cook everything themselves 🍽 and haven't hired a chef yet).
The portions didn't look big, but we were very full.
The ice cream was also so delicious we ordered a second serving.
With such reasonable prices, we'll definitely be back.
There's parking for 3-4 cars in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: moneyแมวลิง

sample_reviews_en.text: The food took a bit too long to arrive. The bill said 2 dishes, but they only served 1. At first, I thought it might just take time, so I didn't complain. Turns out, the restaurant forgot, so we didn't take the rest because it took them a considerable amount of time to prepare (chicken biryani). It wasn't very busy when we went because it was a weekday lunchtime. We told the restaurant and received an apology, but I think they should improve their checking process. The food tasted okay, and the price was reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: mm mook

sample_reviews_en.text:
Saw the reviews on TikTok, the atmosphere is great.
The staff are lovely.
The food tastes like something from a more upscale restaurant.
The Tom Yum soup is a must-try, it's delicious.
But the sun-dried pork has a bit too much batter.
The dipping sauce is a bit too sour and not well-balanced enough.
The Thai papaya salad is on the sour side, but okay.
The omelet with minced pork is plentiful. Overall, it's very good.
I'll definitely stop by again when I have time 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Dow Ny97

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, it's delicious. The staff provides good service and clear menu recommendations. The atmosphere around the shop is okay. The noodles are as delicious as expected. Cars pass by all the time. The shop might be a bit hard to notice because it's on the road and there are a lot of cars passing by. It might be hard to stop and slow down to see. But I'd like you to stop and support them. The price is reasonable, as is the quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: TiGRE MisterX

sample_reviews_en.text:
The decor is beautiful and elaborate, and the prices are reasonable.
The owner is enthusiastic and provides excellent service.

It's a shame the menu is so diverse, which becomes a drawback as there's nothing particularly outstanding. The food itself is rather average.

Perhaps they should choose 1-5 signature dishes and make them stand out. It seems they have everything on the menu, but it's all just mediocre.
sample_reviews_en.author: San Lang

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. The chicken biryani was amazing, the pork satay was very tender, the fish cakes were chewy, soft, fragrant, and delicious, the Thai papaya salad was fresh and crispy with all three flavors perfectly balanced, and the steamed rice cakes were very soft with just the right amount of sweetness. The owner was very attentive and caring towards customers; so lovely!
sample_reviews_en.author: อรุณศรี เดชปรีชาชัย

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to this restaurant for the first time after seeing it on the "Preaw Pak" (Sour Mouth) TV show. Everything was delicious! The spicy pork leg soup and the crispy catfish salad were perfectly sour and flavorful. We ordered 5 dishes in total + 2 drinks and it only cost 557 baht. The price was excellent! I'll definitely go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: thanitnun chotiphanich

restaurants.name: ข้าวขาหมูก๊วยเจ๋ง ลาดพร้าว 101
restaurants.address:

3312 56 Lat Phrao 101 Soi 48, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is clean and delicious. The flavors are well-balanced, slightly salty and a little sweet, making it easy to eat continuously without getting tired of it. If you want it spicier, add chili vinegar and eat it with garlic and fresh chilies – it's delicious! The price is reasonable. Oh, and it's air-conditioned, which is great considering most places don't have air conditioning.
The cleanliness of the tables, chairs, and utensils is exceptional. You can tell the owner takes great care in cleaning. I've never eaten at a restaurant this clean before. The cleanliness is top-notch. The chili vinegar utensils look great and are clean. The garlic is already peeled.
The service is excellent.
You can park in front of the restaurant if it's not time restrictions, just be careful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Busaba Wanchana

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time trying this place. The restaurant was clean, the staff provided good service, and they gave me some dumplings to try. Wow, they were delicious and really big – 8 dumplings for 60 baht. Then I had the braised pork leg rice, which was also very impressive. What I really liked was that I didn't have to peel the garlic myself.
In the end, I bought a box of braised pork leg rice and a box of dumplings to take home.
Come and try it! This has become the first braised pork leg rice place I think of in Soi Ladprao 101.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeeranun Noppakhun

sample_reviews_en.text: The braised pork rice was incredibly delicious. The pork was so tender it melted in my mouth, the dipping sauce was great, and the portion was huge. What I especially liked was that the garlic was already peeled and sliced, clean and ready to eat. The shop also has chrysanthemum tea, which was fragrant and just the right amount of sweet (and it's refillable!). I also happened to meet the owner who was launching a new menu item: grass jelly served with coconut jelly. It was delicious, fragrant, and refreshing! 🫰🏻🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: Rassichapach Thavornvong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pork Leg with Basil and Egg
The pork leg meat and skin were soft and tender, just the way I like it – not too dry. The flavor was very strong, leaning towards salty and spicy. I secretly thought it would be even better if it were a little sweeter. The food quality was appropriate for the price, overall very good. Regarding cleanliness, I have to commend this restaurant. The side dishes were well-covered. The owner is very attentive and always lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaiyo Hosting

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pork leg, fried pork, and intestines were delicious and reasonably priced. The owner was also air-conditioned. The owner was very attentive to detail, which was noticeable.

The only problem was the service. It was incredibly slow. I couldn't understand why it took more than 10-15 minutes per plate of pork to be sliced ​​and placed on rice, even though there were only two tables. After eating two plates, it took almost an hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ordinary Decent Criminal

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my third time eating here, and I feel the fried pork rice isn't as tasty as it used to be. The skin is chewy and has a slightly fishy smell. The service is still slow, as there's only one person working, and when it's busy, they don't always follow the queue. They should add more front-of-house staff to prepare the food so it's not this slow.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aiyarin Watratchatasakun

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stumbled upon this place by chance and decided to try it. The restaurant looks nice, beautifully decorated, and clean. I ordered pork leg rice with soup, but the soup wasn't ready yet, so I only got to try the pork leg.

The portion was generous and the taste was great.
The price wasn't expensive either. They even provided peeled garlic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charlie Vongphantuseth

sample_reviews_en.text: Khao Kha Moo Kuay Jeng is a conveniently located restaurant with a great atmosphere. The Khao Kha Moo (pork leg rice) is delicious and flavorful, and the service is excellent (10/10). The owner is lovely and the staff are attentive. Located in Soi Ladprao 101, it's a place you'll want to visit again. 10/10/10
sample_reviews_en.author: Amorntep

restaurants.name: ซาลาเปาตั่วถั่ง
restaurants.address:

250, 100 Soi Mu Ban Ban Klang Mueang Lat Phrao-chok Chai 4, Khwaeng Lat Phrao, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The steamed buns are delicious, the dough is soft and there's plenty of filling. They're also very affordable at 25฿ per bun.
sample_reviews_th.author: พงษ์ผกา ชินทรเดชา

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered some Tuan Tung steamed buns via Line Man to try. They cost 25 baht each and were... pretty good! 🥟🍥

👉 Compared to Waraporn steamed buns, the dough isn't quite as good. Waraporn's is softer, fluffier, and tastier.
🐖 The savory fillings (minced pork, char siu pork, sausage) are comparable to Waraporn's; I'd rate them even.
🍠 The sweet fillings (black bean, taro) are excellent. They're subtly sweet with a natural aroma (I've encountered some places that use artificial flavoring).

👉 In summary: For 25 baht per bun, I think they're worth the price. The fillings are generous, both savory and sweet. They even use good quality smoked pork sausage.
However, I think the dough could be softer and fluffier, or maybe it's because I ordered delivery 😅
✳️ A little disappointing. We should have ordered some steamed dumplings to try as well.

🙏 Thank you everyone ♥️
for clicking "Follow"!

YouTube 🎬 Paopao Studio
TikTok 🎙️ Paopao Studio
Wongnai 🍭 Paopao Studio

#Wongnai2024 #StreetFood #EatBeforeBed #LowCostReview #PaopaoStudio #LineMan
sample_reviews_en.author: Paopao Studio

sample_reviews_en.text:
I usually don't like Bangkok steamed buns because the dough is usually chewy and sticks to my teeth, but this shop's is different. The dough is soft, not chewy, the wrapper is thin, and the buns are large and delicious! Anyone who doesn't like the wrapper like me will be happy because it's easy to peel off. I ordered three fillings:
- Minced pork: The pork is in firm chunks, with egg, and not too sweet. It also has onions. This was my favorite filling.
- Pandan and young coconut: For someone like me who doesn't like things too sweet, this was just the right amount of sweetness. The filling wasn't lumpy but not runny either. Delicious.
- Cream filling: The texture is similar to the pandan filling. If you like less sweet cream fillings, you'll probably like this one. I'd give it a middle rating.
Personally, I think the dough colors are a bit too bright; the green and yellow look unnatural 😂 If you're driving, there's parking for one car in front of the shop, or you can park across the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yachi Ka

sample_reviews_en.text: I saw a YouTube review saying the food was delicious, so I went to try it, but I had a terrible experience. I ordered, and the employee taking my order, who was busy wrapping dumplings, heard me order but didn't respond and continued wrapping, leaving me standing there confused about whether she'd heard me. After a while, she came to the cash register and keyed in my order. This kind of behavior is terrible; it's like she doesn't care about or value the customer. If you don't have a customer service mindset, you should be in a different role, not taking customer orders. This is the first time I'll ever go there, even if the food is incredibly delicious. The restaurant should take this feedback into consideration and improve its service.
sample_reviews_en.author: supakorn ratchatadechawong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food: Steamed buns (all fillings) are 25 baht each.
Dumplings are 8.33 baht each. Personally, I don't like them because they're too sweet.
The minced pork and boiled egg filling has good dough, chewy and soft. It's still delicious even after refrigerating and reheating in the microwave, but the pork flavor is similar to the dumplings.
The char siu pork filling is sweet.
The cream filling is delicious, not too sweet, and fragrant.
The black sesame filling is delicious and not too sweet.
Service: Good.
Atmosphere: Parking is available on the street. It's best to go in the afternoon; it's unlikely to be convenient in the evening.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kae Boon

sample_reviews_en.text:
This shop is opposite the beef noodle shop. It used to be a different steamed bun shop, not this name. The latest name is Tua Thang. I saw good reviews on Google, so I decided to try it.

They said the minced pork and char siu (roasted pork) fillings were good. And they really were! The minced pork was very generous and the buns were huge. The char siu was also good, juicy and just right. The dumplings were good too, 3 for 25 baht. Good price, not expensive.

#FoodReview
sample_reviews_en.author: Gracelicious (Kaegrace)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Entrance to Soi Chokchai 4, Soi 20
Recently had the chance to try:

Steamed buns (black bean filling)
Large size, fluffy and dense dough, the black bean filling is not too finely ground, not too sweet, delicious.

Dumplings (steamed rice cakes) Large and filling.
Lots of filling, thin dough, no unpleasant smell.
The package with garlic, dipping sauce, and toothpicks is excellent.

Parking is available on the street, but be aware of the parking restrictions.
sample_reviews_en.author: chamachote chokboonmongkol

sample_reviews_en.text: The steamed buns have a delicious dough; thick, soft, and not too fluffy. I've tried several fillings. The minced pork is tasty and has a generous amount of filling. The char siu pork is also flavorful. The vegetable filling is tasty, and the black bean and taro fillings are decent, not too sweet. Personally, I think the sausage and cream fillings aren't very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: 段品家

restaurants.name: Moxy Bar & Restaurant
restaurants.address:

111 Ratchadamri Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🥓✨ A hidden gem of a BBQ buffet in the heart of Bangkok!
Just a short walk from Central World!

🔥 Unlimited BBQ & appetizers, open only Fridays and Saturdays from 6 PM!

🥢 Start with hot, smoky BBQ skewers: beef, pork, chicken, sausages, and grilled corn.
🥩 Follow with premium cuts like Angus, lamb leg, beef tongue, and Brahman belly – incredibly tender and juicy with every bite.
🌊 Enjoy various sauces including seafood, maple BBQ, and Sriracha – so delicious!
🐟 Highlight! Seasonal Thai fish sashimi – fresh, sweet, and succulent; the seafood dipping sauce is the best!

🍔 DIY your own Moxy black burger – juicy and a must-try!
🍲 Plenty of other dishes – bacon fried rice, beef stew, spinach gratin, various fries, and more!
🥗 For health-conscious diners, there's a salad bar. Complete sauce selection.
🍨 Free ice cream to finish off.

🎶 The atmosphere is super chill, with live DJ and awesome music.
🎱 Free games too! Pool table, chess, pinball – everything's available.

📍 9th floor, Moxy Bangkok Hotel, Ratchaprasong.
💸 Only 1,000 THB/person, including drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: akkarapong amrungjitchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Moxi's F&B is comprised of two locations: Moxi Restaurant and Rooftop Sato San. Located right next to the lobby, they serve breakfast through dinner. Dinner offers a fusion of Thai and Western cuisine, creating a unique and delicious combination. There's also a wide selection of tapas, perfect for pairing with drinks. The drinks are also quite good, rivaling those at the rooftop bar's Sato San. If you have a Club Marriott membership, you can get a 30% discount, so show it to the staff. Some staff may not understand the policy, as it's not widely used, but it's definitely worth it. However, it doesn't appear to apply to other discounts, such as happy hour.

Breakfast is also served in the same restaurant, offering a wide selection of food, with about half the check-in desk fully stocked. The milk-based coffee could use some improvement, but the rest of the menu was excellent. Even though it's breakfast, the ice is provided, making it a great option for an iced Americano.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rejuvi_Ms. Heo

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was impressed in every aspect!
- The place is decorated adorably, reminiscent of the Scala Cinema, with a cool and chic industrial loft vibe.
- The food focuses on quality ingredients, with minimal sauces, emphasizing skillful cooking. The seafood dipping sauce is spicy and delicious.
- For guests staying at the hotel, there's a fitness center and meeting rooms available.
- Activities within the restaurant include free pool tables, foosball, and hockey.
- There are seating areas both inside and outside, separate from the restaurant itself. Sitting outside is very relaxing in this weather.
- There's a DJ playing beats to make dining even more enjoyable.
- What impressed me most was the abundance of staff; they're always available to assist you, and their service mind is exceptional.
In short, I highly recommend it every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday evening.
sample_reviews_en.author: August C.S.

sample_reviews_en.text: Moxy Bangkok, one of the lifestyle hotels in the heart of Ratchaprasong, has launched a completely new food and beverage menu at Moxy Bar and Restaurant. The menu features a diverse range of cuisines, including all-day breakfast, various steaks, Thai, Japanese, and Italian dishes, as well as creative desserts such as Lamb it up (900 THB), River Prawn (500 THB), Salmon Miso Bowl (400 THB), Beef Rice Bowl (400 THB), Korat Stir-fried Noodles with Crispy Pork (350 THB), Truffle Pasta (400 THB), and Snow White (300 THB). There are also over 10 signature cocktails, including Candy Crush Colada (380 THB) and Sip & Roll (380 THB). It's a place you can visit for a meal or drink from morning till night.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarat Traipiyavong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Moxy is a Marriott hotel with a lively, stylish atmosphere. The food is mostly comfort-style Western dishes—flavors are quite mild, not very bold, but still enjoyable without salty tastes.

The lobby has a pool table, which makes the space feel fun and social. We tried the 4-course set from Hungry Hub, and the overall experience was good. The staff were all friendly and attentive.

On Friday to Sunday evenings, they have a BBQ buffet, which is great for a relaxed night out—grab a beer, play some pool, and hang out with friends. Worth checking out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narin P. Rattanaroj

sample_reviews_en.text:
Breakfast was good. If rooms are running at capacity, Saturdays & Sundays may run till 11 AM. Otherwise it operates from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM.

Food is well prepared. The fruits are very good. Egg & meat stations are freshly prepared. Bacon is very thick (1.5 mm to 2.5 mm) but still crispy at the ends.

Gourmet coffee station, either DIY or table service.

All good. We liked it. Service was very good. Friendly & happy to serve. Mostly English speaking servers.

2026 January (3rd week)
sample_reviews_en.author: John Tango

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came across the restaurant by chance, just because it was close to our hotel – and it was a really pleasant surprise. The place itself is beautiful, modern and tastefully decorated.
The food was especially delicious – we had fish in a special sauce and it was exceptionally tasty. Definitely a dish to remember!
It was a perfect meal that ended our last day in Bangkok in the best way.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anya Fligel

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a wonderful dinner at Moxy Bar. The food was excellent — everything we ordered was delicious and well prepared. What made the evening even better was the service. The staff were friendly, attentive and made us feel very welcome throughout our meal.

Great food, great service and a really enjoyable atmosphere. Definitely a place I would recommend and would be happy to visit again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Neo Say Hong

restaurants.name: Ami Malaya Indonesian Halal Food
restaurants.address:

480/88 Phetchaburi Rd, Thanon Phetchaburi, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located on 4th floor in Phenix. I went here for lunch and the dish was truly wonderful. I ordered their most popular menu which is ayam kremes, since the business was a bit slow it took a bit of time for them to serve the food because they need to heat up the oil and etc. But that doesn’t bother me at since the food was yummy and the staff who was tending the stall was really friendly. We joked about how bad vegetables taste cus I requested not to put any veggies on my plate. 🤣

The chicken was fragrant and there are varieties of sambal you can choose.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charlie

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ayam geprek is under cook,there still blood inside chicken, the potates is under cook for soto betawi and the rice is under cook🙈
We are dissapointed for the bad service,we already paid for es cendol 95 bath, unfortunately until finished, they are not served our order🤭🙈😓
Please carefully when you are eat in this resto,coz the service is bad
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuningsih Rahayu

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here, and the chicken and sambal were truly delicious, truly Indonesian. The food court's comfortable atmosphere, with its design and furnishings, created a homey atmosphere. I'll definitely be back to try the soto betawi (Betawi soup). The owner was friendly and chatted with me about Bali and Harley-Davidson.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donny Syahbana

sample_reviews_en.text:
The sambal terasi is out of this world. Paired with the ayam geprek is literally so good.

I’ve lived in Thailand for 3 years and have waited patiently for an Indonesian restaurant. And finally life is good again when I discovered Ami Malaya resto.

Cendolnya juga endulita banget gaes.

10/10. Recommend. Approved. Will come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Annisa Tiara

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my first time here, and it will definitely be a regular whenever I miss Indonesian food in Bangkok.

Ps: best sop oxtail ❤️

==============

This is my first time visiting and ordering here, and it will be my favorite restaurant every time I miss Indonesian food in Bangkok.

Ps: best oxtail food ever ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Sonnydar Emon

sample_reviews_en.text:
As an Indonesian living in Bangkok, it's a really good choice to eat!! I'll come back whenever i miss my home.
Location at Phinex mall 4th floor. Really nice ambiance while eating there.

Auntyy!! Be healthy always and serve me delicious food later!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Meliana Savitri

sample_reviews_en.text: Finally, Gokil, there is an Indonesian restaurant in Thailand and it is dedicated at AEC. It really helps me who misses Indonesian food. Everything is delicious from soto betawi, oxtail soup, chicken satay, fried bakwan, and the pecel is …
sample_reviews_en.author: dinayah candrawati

sample_reviews_en.text: The place is cozy. The food is delicious and the portions are generous. The chicken is very tender and the chili sauce is delicious! The seller is also friendly👍You must come here if you miss Indonesian food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Astrid Rahardaya

restaurants.name: สุกี้จานบิน Sukijanbin 飞碟火锅
restaurants.address:

24/5 เสนานิคม Khwaeng Sena Nikhom, จตุจักร Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious! We chose the mala soup base. The restaurant offers three levels of spiciness: 1) moderately spicy (good for sipping), 2) intensely spicy, and 3) very intense. We ordered level two and loved it! It was spicy enough to numb your mouth, but you could still sip the soup, lol. The flavor was great, very Chengdu-esque.

- Dipping sauce is 30 baht per bowl. (A slight criticism: the mala dipping sauce they provide is a bit too sour. Reducing the sourness would make it much more balanced.)

There's a wide selection of vegetables, meats, and noodles. The meat quality is average, and they even have duck intestines!* ✨ If you want a mild mala meal to satisfy your craving in a relaxed atmosphere, this restaurant is a good option.

I ate alone and was quite full. The bill came to 350 baht, comparable to a typical buffet. The staff provided excellent service, constantly checking on us and offering free soup refills. They even gave us mini ice cream after the meal! 🍦

I'll definitely be coming back often since it's close to my condo. It's officially added to my mala soup list! 🩷
sample_reviews_en.author: Thrisha PH

sample_reviews_en.text:
The soup base is delicious, the mala broth is amazing – rich and spicy, with three spice levels to choose from. I'm hooked on this place's mala broth; the clear broth isn't bland like plain water, it's well-balanced. The dark broth is also fragrant, sweet, and salty. I've eaten here many times.

It's not crowded, and the wait isn't long. There's a wide selection of skewers for 5 and 10 baht each. The pork belly slices are large and good. There are many dipping sauces to try. I especially like the tofu skin, they have several varieties. I ate a lot of it!

The owner and staff provide excellent service; they are very friendly and attentive. The restaurant is clean. To top it off, they even give you free mini ice cream to cleanse your palate! It's a short walk down the alley from Bang Bua BTS station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julie Wu

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a small, clean conveyor belt hot pot restaurant. When we went, it was late morning and the restaurant had just opened, so the dipping sauce bar and conveyor belt weren't quite ready yet. But the owner was very nice and welcoming. There was a wide variety of fresh ingredients to choose from on the conveyor belt. The dark broth was tasty, not too salty or sweet. My friend tried the mala broth and loved it. There was also a good selection of ice cream. I usually don't use much dipping sauce, so I just took a little of each, and they tasted great. The owner saw that I only took a little and didn't charge me for the sauces. Very impressed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thaya Aungtananukul

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was great. Today I had the tonkatsu broth, which was flavorful and fragrant with sesame, and the mala broth, which was very tasty even without dipping sauce. The ingredients on the conveyor belt were of pretty good quality. Today, for two people and one child, the price was 800 baht. The price is similar to Suki Teenoi, but you can choose your own broth, and each person gets their own pot. The service was good and very attentive to customers. They even provided toys for the children to play with after the meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: puay chintanakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The soup comes in various flavors: mala, black broth, tonkatsu. The mala soup is delicious and spicy, and you can choose your desired level of spiciness. Food prices start at 5 baht per skewer and go up to 50 baht per plate. Dipping sauces are self-serve. Whipped cream is free with ice cream. The staff provides excellent and attentive service. Parking is available next to the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Katesirin Ruamyod

sample_reviews_en.text: The dipping sauces and soups were delicious! We had the tonkotsu soup, which was flavorful and perfect for those who don't like spicy or mala food – not too numbing. The restaurant is cute, plays nice music, and most importantly, the owner is incredibly lovely and friendly. It's a small, cozy, family-run business. We've been back twice already! 🥰🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuntiya Srisongmueang

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, clean, and a wide variety of food. The owner provides excellent service. Dipping sauces are 30 baht each, with free sukiyaki sauce. Ice is self-service. The mala soup was delicious and exactly to my liking. You can request grilled shrimp, which was very fresh and delicious. The owner even gave us free ice cream!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ruttanaporn Bucha

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a highly recommended restaurant! I wish they had a branch closer to my house. The soup is amazing, the side dishes are plentiful, and the owner is super friendly. Seriously, you have to try it! It's easy to get to, near Bang Bua BTS station. Just walk a short distance into the soi (alley), about 200 meters.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rattiyaporn Thongyourn

restaurants.name: ร้านข้าวแกงสิรินทรา
restaurants.address:

PGP7+JXR 2200 Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The food was delicious and the price was cheap in my opinion because the portions were generous. I ordered chicken massaman curry and stir-fried pork with ginger, served with rice, for only 70฿, and a bowl of cabbage soup for only 40฿. They gave us a huge portion!
I'm a French tourist and I was with my Thai friend. We really liked it. It was really cheap but the quality was good and it was very tasty!
sample_reviews_th.author: Jee Doo

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a truly authentic roadside curry rice stall. It's incredibly delicious! ✅
The flavors are rich and the seasonings are perfect (the dishes aren't bland at all).
Unlimited rice refills. Great price, only 40 baht+.
There's a huge variety of dishes to choose from.
Customers keep coming in.
That day I ordered the rice noodles and they were amazing! Rich flavor and a generous portion.
My first visit was fantastic. I'll definitely go again! 🤤

Look at the first picture, they've already packed the food in bags. See how generous the portions are?
Here's the proof – a huge bag!

The price is incredibly good. Highly recommend! 📌
sample_reviews_en.author: I’m You

sample_reviews_en.text:
This roadside curry rice place is incredibly delicious and serves huge portions. They're honest with their customers, and the queue is fun and lively.
Everyone's happy because they've found something delicious. The Panang Pork gets a 9 out of 10!
There's a huge variety of dishes, 2 for 50 baht,
3 for 60 baht. They give you a lot, and you can get extra rice.
The fried chicken and patties toppings are amazing, a 10 out of 10! It's located on Khao Lam Road.
Parking is a bit difficult, and finding a table is like musical chairs, which is fun.
This is an incredibly good roadside curry rice place! ♥️♥️♥️
sample_reviews_en.author: TRAGOON THONGROD

sample_reviews_en.text: I saw several people walking out of a small alley carrying bags full of delicious-looking food, so I followed them. That's when I discovered Sirinthra's curry rice shop hidden away in a small alleyway between rows of buildings. The curry rice here is made fresh daily, and they serve huge portions at incredibly cheap prices. The elderly couple serving the curry are very generous with high-quality ingredients. Buying ten bags to stock up at home is so heavy – I might get some muscles from all the weight, but it's so satisfying! It's enough for several meals at a very reasonable price. 😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Luna The Orange Cat

sample_reviews_en.text: This street food stall on Khao Lam Road offers over 20 delicious-looking dishes at very affordable prices. Today, before catching my train at Hua Lamphong Station, I stopped by and bought two dishes: chicken with garlic and pepper, and stir-fried pork stew with sausage. The portions were generous, served in plastic bowls with lids and spoons, for only 40 baht. There are tables available for customers to sit and eat, but it was quite crowded.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิน วิน พลัส

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a roadside food stall selling rice and curry, not a permanent location. They operate from a few stalls in front of other shops after closing time. The food is inexpensive; rice with two toppings costs 40 baht, and the portions are generous, both the curry and the rice. The taste is decent. Besides rice and curry, they also offer rice noodles and plain rice porridge at reasonable prices. Open from 5 PM to 8:30 PM, closed on Mondays.
sample_reviews_en.author: ๋Jojo Tang

sample_reviews_en.text: This rice and curry stall is set up as a food cart on the sidewalk, with several folding tables set up along the sidewalk as well. It's crowded from the moment it opens at 5 PM, with people buying takeout and eating in. They offer a variety of dishes, and the food tastes good. Rice with three curries costs 55 baht (November 2nd, 2024). They also provide free pickled fish soup. Payment can be made via bank transfer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponchagarj Ngamukos

sample_reviews_en.text: There's a wide variety of food to choose from, it tastes good, and the prices are affordable. There's no parking in the main alley, but you'll have a better selection of dishes. The service is good and fast. I recommend ordering via Line and picking it up. If you go to the restaurant in the early evening, you might be able to find parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nu Prin

restaurants.name: AL RAYAN (Alif Laila by bawarchi)
restaurants.address:

2, 9 Soi Sukhumvit 3, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Worst Indian/Middle Eastern, Arabic food I’ve ever had. Ordered Malai chicken and the chicken smelled bad like was going off - I tried a little and it was very tough and dry. Clearly this was cooked yesterday or a few days ago and warmed up slightly. I sent it back and explained why. No response no concern and no apology from staff - like they were expecting it. To make matters worse when the bill came the chicken Malai was on the bill ! I told them to remove it. Again no apology or concern from staff. Astonishingly bad experience and customer (lack of) service
sample_reviews_en.author: Ian Soames

sample_reviews_en.text: Worst Indian food I ever had. The chicken stinks like a dirty sock, like it was cooked yesterday, frozen and reheated in a rush. The curry has no taste, not even the taste you know from other restaurants. The food is very expensive and you have to pay extra for rice so a meal for one person can cost like 500 THB while you have plenty of good food around for fraction of the price. I did not finish my meal to avoid poisoning. There will be people including owner in front nagging you to go inside, just avoid this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paweł Derehajło

sample_reviews_en.text: Overpriced but Good india food. Have eaten at this restaurant a number of times and the experience has been good. The selection was good and quite tasty. I typically order a soup & chicken fried rice. Not a large establishment, but clean and with efficient and friendly staff. I have taken a number of people here and they have all endorsed it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hasan Imtiaj

sample_reviews_en.text:
Worse Indian  food ever tested. We ordered variety of food , he recommended pomfret fish, which was absolutely tasteless and he said he will nicely spice it.
Curry was so bland , no taste at all. Tomato rice was. Just red rice.
When he brought the bill , we gave him card , he said his card machine is not working.
I will never go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dipti

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s okish restaurant but super costly. Their prices seem high even if they were in INR. It’s a rip off place, I saw a couple disputing with them too about the bill. My meal cost 610B, it’s the costliest normal meal I have ever had. That waiter even kept the change without asking me (for tip). Would not recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Soham Zemse

sample_reviews_en.text: An authentic taste of Pakistani cuisine! The service is amazing—I have eaten here many times, especially enjoying their breakfast and dinner specials. A big thanks to Mr. Tayyab for consistently providing excellent service. The atmosphere truly feels like a real Pakistani restaurant in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: ameer hamza

sample_reviews_en.text: Here have very good food this is in Bangkok one restaurant who serve very delicious indian Hyderabadi biryani whenever I'll come here I'll eat food in al rayan restaurant here have a Pakistani manager Mr Tayyab he gives us very good hospitality he is very nice person and staff also very nice
sample_reviews_en.author: Muskhan Dkl

sample_reviews_en.text: Your food is good .. but you don’t have too much customers because you need to change ur restaurant decor from inside and outside … open area outdoor  like Nadia karak… people don’t know about ur restaurant… and make social media announcement .. and don’t ask your staffs  to come and eat …
sample_reviews_en.author: khulood M

restaurants.name: Smile Home บาร์ลับ บางเขน
restaurants.address:

164/2 อาคาร, Smile แยก 9, Chaeng Watthana 4 Alley Lane 9, Anusawari, Bang Khen, Bangkok 10220, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the chance to chill at Smile Home, a hidden bar in Bang Khen, with a group of friends in the evening. The atmosphere was much better than I expected. The bar has a relaxed, garden-like feel, more like a casual gathering with friends than a typical bar. It's spacious, airy, and not crowded, with many seating areas and convenient parking. It's perfect for after-work chats, socializing, or just chilling out with live music in the evening.

The food and snacks offer a wide variety of choices, including Thai and Northeastern Thai dishes, salads, som tum (papaya salad), and various appetizers. The flavors are bold and delicious, pairing well with drinks. The ingredients are fresh, and the portions are generous. Many dishes have a unique style specific to the bar, making it clear that the experience wasn't just about the atmosphere; the food was equally impressive.
sample_reviews_en.author: JEDI

sample_reviews_en.text:
Price: Starting from tens of baht. Personally, I think some menu items are expensive.
Staff: Slow, possibly because there were many customers and insufficient staff. Food took a long time to arrive, and dishes didn't come out at the same time. Some menu items were sold out or incomplete without being informed. Paying the bill took a very long time. The staff weren't rude and were welcoming.
Taste: Average. Suitable for children. Those who like strong sour, salty, and sweet flavors might not like it. I personally prefer strong flavors. The portion sizes and prices of some dishes seem disproportionate. The steamed egg custard used frozen seafood.
Location: There is parking available and it's easy to get to with two entrances. The restaurant is large with an outdoor camping style. There are a lot of mosquitoes, so I recommend bringing mosquito repellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Achiraya Leelanoi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The entrance to the restaurant is marked "Suan Klang Krung" (Central City Garden). It's a cluster of restaurants in a mysterious, chill-out style area in the Bang Khen district, specializing in Northeastern Thai food.

The overall space is spacious and clean, with various seating options including camping, tables, and private gazebos.

They offer a wide selection of drinks, including liquor and draft beer, with bottled beer promotions and attentive refills from the staff.

The live music is great, and they play good music, perfect for relaxing for a long time. However, there is occasional airplane noise.

Overall, the food is delicious. Some stalls require separate payment.

The restrooms are decent for this style of restaurant. The parking lot is spacious.

(A cat is very obnoxious and often sits next to us 👎🏻😩😖)
sample_reviews_en.author: Putt Te

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my second visit, and it was terrible. There weren't even that many customers today, but the food was incredibly slow. I waited forever! I was hungry and ordered a simple rice dish, but it took an hour! And to make matters worse, they got it wrong!!! Then I had to wait almost another hour for them to make it again. In the end, I couldn't wait any longer and just took the leftovers home. They also charged me for a large bucket of ice – I ordered a small one! So confusing!!! The service was awful; they didn't ask customers anything, just let us sit and wait without checking on our order. Be prepared for long waits if you plan to go there.
sample_reviews_en.author: พิชชานันท์ ผ่องแผ้ว

sample_reviews_en.text: This hidden gem of a restaurant is tucked away in a deep alley. They serve BBQ pork and a wide variety of other dishes – single-serving meals, main courses, salads, soups, appetizers, and more – all at affordable prices. The staff are polite, friendly, and provide excellent service. It's a great place to relax, chat with friends, and enjoy the atmosphere. It's not hot, has a roof (so you don't have to worry about rain), and offers beer, promotions, and other alcoholic beverages. There's live music, a TV showing football, and plenty of free parking. Driving is recommended as it's located deep in an alley.
sample_reviews_en.author: Momiji Mint

sample_reviews_en.text: This was a terrible place. I went on New Year's Eve hoping for a chill atmosphere, but when I got there, it was like they were relatives of the owner, singing karaoke in a completely off-theme way. They were singing old Thai folk songs and continued singing from 9 PM until midnight. They even held a lottery game, announcing it loudly through the microphone, forcing other customers in the restaurant to listen. If they're going to celebrate with their own family next time, they shouldn't be opening the place to customers like this. A complete waste of money and a very disappointing experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Artit suzuki

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant should prioritize its customers. If I knew they were holding a New Year's party for themselves, I wouldn't have gone. The food took an extremely long time to arrive; I ordered at 9 PM and the food didn't arrive until 11:30 PM. And that's not even including the atmosphere – they seemed more focused on their own team's enjoyment than the customers. Their team sang and had fun themselves, completely disregarding the guests. It felt like I paid to attend a New Year's party for someone I didn't even know. I hope they improve next year, but I don't think I'll go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sutee Teerapunpichai (nine)

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant features live singers who perform until midnight. The singers rotate, covering various genres from folk to 90s music. The restaurant closes at 2 AM, but food orders can be placed until 12:30 AM. The atmosphere is open and airy, with comfortable outdoor seating and a cool breeze. The prices are reasonable, and the food is decent. The BBQ pork is delicious; the small set is good for two people, while the large set is for three or more. There's ample parking, and the restrooms are located next to the parking lot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamphon Rattanakijkamol

restaurants.name: Savory Malatang小食记 (Silom Edge)
restaurants.address:

B1Floor, 2 Si Lom Rd, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Expensive but the taste is terrible. It's bland, and the mala broth is overwhelmingly strong. The fish soup with pickled cabbage, over 200 baht, had only 6-7 pieces of fish and a little pickled cabbage, 3-4 dried chilies. What was plentiful were the shredded tofu, glass noodles, enoki mushrooms, and some bitter melon added to make it look like a lot. And the flavor was definitely mala broth – if you've ever tried it, you'll know it's a savory, sour, and spicy taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hhhg Gga

sample_reviews_en.text: I like this branch the most. The staff are friendly, knowledgeable, and attentive. They don't force you to eat specific dipping sauces and offer instant noodle seasoning packets. The staff aren't confused. Eating at the restaurant is easier than ordering delivery, and it's very filling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daisy B

sample_reviews_en.text: I would like to leave some feedback regarding the service from one of the female staff members taking orders. During the ordering process, her communication felt rather abrupt and she did not seem very willing to assist customers. In …
sample_reviews_en.author: porsch K

sample_reviews_en.text: Very delicious I really love white and golden soups mixed. It was too much spicy like mala soup. And the sesame sauce is very good choice😊 They have many branch and I will choose this brand again may be in other branch
sample_reviews_en.author: Oum Baby Mini traveller

sample_reviews_en.text: The clear soup is flavorful and delicious even without dipping sauce. The restaurant has limited seating and there aren't enough staff to clear tables. Cleanliness needs improvement as table clearing is slow.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thipfany Krung

sample_reviews_en.text: Enjoy a delightful Mala Tang experience where you get to choose your own ingredients and flavors! It's a fun DIY style dish, and the price depends on the weight. Have fun customizing your meal!
sample_reviews_en.author: al bpaisal

sample_reviews_en.text: The original mala tang soup is delicious 👍🏻 There's a bit too little seating in the restaurant, but the food didn't take long to arrive.
sample_reviews_en.author: TantPS 胡.

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered less spicy but the staff did the order wrong and don’t want to admit their mistake. Cannot eat it at all it’s beyond spicy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dodo

restaurants.name: เจ๊สมชายก๋วยเตี๋ยวแคะ by day ดินแดง
restaurants.address:

ถนนประชาสงเคราะห์, เดอะพร้อมดินแดง, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm very disappointed, Auntie Somchai. I came because of the Facebook ad. I know it's hot and it's a community mall, but the food was awful and didn't match the pictures. The Tom Yum soup tasted like they just added their own chili paste; it had no flavor. I live on the main Ratchada road. I saw there was a mall on an inner road and thought I'd come visit. 65 baht... I could have just eaten noodles at the Charoen market instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Note Maneerojchay

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles were overcooked and mushy, short like the person who made them, as if they were chopped up before boiling. The soup had a strange taste. The orders were mixed up, and the rice with the pork leg was very hard. Oh, and the wonton dipping sauce tasted weird. How did this place even get a "Shell Shuan Chim" (a Thai food review program) award, seriously?
sample_reviews_en.author: กอซอ จ้ะ

sample_reviews_en.text: This one restaurant offers a wide variety of dishes, including pork leg rice, noodles, tom yum soup, yen ta fo (pink noodle soup), clear broth noodles, roasted duck wings, and some fried items. The taste is delicious, and there's convenient parking in front of the restaurant. The interior is clean and air-conditioned.
sample_reviews_en.author: Qīng

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices are affordable, comparable to typical restaurants. The taste is good; the Tom Yum soup isn't too spicy, so even those who don't like spicy food can enjoy it. The atmosphere is relaxed, with air conditioning, perfect for a meal on a hot day.
sample_reviews_en.author: SHT NP

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time here. The service was excellent, the food was delicious, and the price was very reasonable at 60-70 baht, especially considering the location and service. It's air-conditioned too. I recommend anyone in the area to try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sorravit Aunaroon

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is clean and the air conditioning is wonderfully refreshing. The pork knuckle is delicious, and the raspberry sauce is amazing. The minced pork meatballs and shrimp meatballs are also good. I want to eat it again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthanit Olankun

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went here for dinner and had some braised pork noodles with a small soup on the side. Simple but good taste. The meat was juicy and well seasoned. Soup was decent.
Fair prices and quick service. Good spot for a quick meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: L

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was nothing special, very average. The pictures of the dishes didn't match at all. The service was terrible; the staff were completely inattentive and didn't ask any questions. I'll only eat here once!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasipriya Jan

restaurants.name: Meat​ ​Labo ​(Central​world 7th fl.)​
restaurants.address:

Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is relaxed, typical of a food court. The decor is simple, perhaps minimalist.

The noodles, including the toppings, are of good quality and very tasty, well worth the price. The crispy pork cracklings with garlic are especially delicious and fresh. However, two stars are deducted because the broth isn't as flavorful as it should be (approximately 40% less intense compared to brands like Thongsmith or other boat noodle brands in this price range). Another reviewer mentioned the Fah Thai brand of instant boat noodle broth. Overall, the broth's flavor might suit tourists unfamiliar with the spiciness and the "waterfall" style of soup, but it might not appeal to Thai palates.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nate Amp

sample_reviews_en.text:
The noodle soup was delicious.
The beef was tasty.
The beef meatballs were just okay.
The quail egg wonton was alright.
The longan drink and lemon tea weren't too sweet.
The prices were reasonable.

The noodle soup was delicious.
The beef was delicious.
The meatballs were so-so.
The quail egg wonton was okay.
The longan juice/lemon tea wasn't too sweet.
The price was reasonable.
There's a 7% VAT and a 10% service charge, which are charged separately.
sample_reviews_en.author: Own Pimz

sample_reviews_en.text:
Both the beef brisket and tom yam noodles were delicious. The side dishes were also good, but I recommend eating the noodles.
It suited my taste perfectly, almost the best restaurant I've eaten at in Thailand, even though this singer isn't on the list of highly-reviewed restaurants.
The prices are higher than some highly-rated street food stalls, but the food is significantly better.
The broth is incredibly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hanahana Lafleur

sample_reviews_en.text:
The worst boat noodles I have ever had.
Beef was totally overcooked and super chewy (I had to spit it out), the soup was very oily.
A normal beef noodles 199baht, price similar or even more expensive than Thong Smith.
They even charge you service fee which is very rare. (The service was very good though)
Very pricey compared to the quality of the food.
Would never come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: T T

sample_reviews_en.text: Original Thai boat noodles, recommended by Chong Ge. The beef is either Wagyu or regular beef. The soup base is quite spicy, so if you can't handle spice, remember to ask for it to be less spicy. The non-spicy soup is quite sweet. The beef is very tender. If you want more, you can order the jumbo size. Overall, it's pretty good and worth a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex Fung

sample_reviews_en.text: Got the lunch menu, it’s cheap and you got one main dish, one appetiser and a drink. It didn’t disappoint. For a food court food, it was really good. The beef noodle soup war delicious, the soup was so rich. The skewer and the wontons were also not bad and another plus point, the staff was friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: bluecamuflase

sample_reviews_en.text:
8:00 p.m. in the evening they don't have beef stew/pork stew plus other things on the menu. I'll never come back to this place I wouldn't recommend it personally but others might not care.
They do make sure they get their extra 10% service charge on the fast food not so much quality food😓
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert Nman

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and flavorful. The dry Tom Yum noodles don't need any extra seasoning, it's already perfect. The cheese-filled dumplings are incredibly delicious. They charge only 25 baht for a child's noodle dish. I highly recommend this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sauwanit Ratanaruamkarn

restaurants.name: Shiguma Japanese Restaurant - Design Village Ratchada
restaurants.address:

Design Village Ratchada ชั้น2 ห้องSH A203, Soi Sutthiphong 1, Ratchadaphisek, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Shiguma, a Japanese shabu-shabu buffet restaurant, offers various price options, starting at 539฿ (cash/bank transfer 489฿ net). The buffet lasts for 90 minutes. I tried the basic option. The food selection was decent, and I personally thought it was worth the price. The ingredients were good, and the soup and dipping sauces were delicious. The staff provided quick service. The price includes drinks (green tea, soft drinks) and desserts such as mochi and soft-serve ice cream (you can choose one dessert). The restaurant is open daily from 11:00 AM to 10:00 PM. It's located on the 2nd floor of Design Village Ratchada and has parking available.
sample_reviews_th.author: Krongrat Si.

sample_reviews_th.text: Delicious! I especially like the 589฿ promotion. I love eel sushi, and it's an all-you-can-eat buffet. If there's no time limit, I could sit there all day.
sample_reviews_th.author: Jasdakorn khumdej

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried this restaurant for the first time the night before closing with my younger brother because it's near our condo. We tried the premium package for 739 baht + net and were amazed and impressed by how delicious everything was. The meat was excellent, the menu was diverse, and they even had Asahi beer to pair with the meat – absolutely perfect! Normally, I only choose shabu-shabu from famous restaurants like Momo or MK Premium (899 baht), but after trying this place, I found the meat was just as good, at a lower price, and it wasn't greasy, easy to eat, and melted in your mouth. Other items like salmon, shrimp, sushi, and appetizers were also very good. The soups we tried – the sukiyaki and the signature soup – weren't greasy or dry, and paired perfectly with the meat. The staff were all lovely, even though we went late and ate until 10 pm. I'm so happy to have discovered this new favorite restaurant by accident and will be visiting regularly. Highly recommended, definitely worth trying! 👍🏻❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️🤤🤤🤤🥩🥩🥩
sample_reviews_en.author: Prachya Api

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. The shabu-shabu tasted average for the price, but the two servings were different. When I asked the staff, they couldn't identify the type of meat.
2. The sushi and sashimi were small, which I personally liked as it didn't fill me up too much. The taste was commensurate with the price.
3. The original soup was good. The sukiyaki soup was good and rich. The shabu-shabu soup was sweet, with a flavor suitable for Thai tastes.

In summary, it satisfied my craving. I ordered the platinum set, which was okay. I'm not sure if the more expensive sets are more premium and taste better, but anything beyond this set might not be worth the service. There needs to be training for the staff to ensure they understand their duties and provide consistent quality service. From what I observed, there are many areas that need improvement.

Also, my table faced the restroom, which wasn't very inviting. I recommend adding a screen or a standee to block the view.
sample_reviews_en.author: pym t

sample_reviews_en.text: Today's special was the 999 baht promotion. The restaurant is clean and comfortable. The food is delicious, the soup is good. The sushi was rather disappointing, not as visually appealing as expected, like something out of Sadness from Inside Out (has that movie?). The tuna larb and various salads were delicious and excellent. The tempura shrimp was served cold, like it had been fried a long time ago, but then re-fried and served – it was delicious! However, it didn't match the menu picture; the batter on the shrimp was purple, not yellow. I was really annoyed by that. Purple is supposed to be fantasy, but why was it served as an overly bright golden yellow? It was too bright, I didn't dare pick it up! (lol) The dipping sauces were delicious, okay overall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prabda Atthasit

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to eat here today. The restaurant's management system is terrible. The service is extremely slow. I ordered sushi and didn't receive it. I asked every time the staff delivered the food, more than 5 times!! Until I didn't wait any longer and just checked and left the restaurant!! Because we had been sitting in the restaurant for almost an hour **an hour without receiving the sushi I ordered since entering the restaurant**. We didn't get what we asked for. We asked for dipping sauce 3 times, had to refill water 3 times, and asked for dessert as if no one had heard us. We asked for the bill 3 times!! The restaurant's management system is extremely terrible. If there aren't enough staff, they should manage things better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Areeya Noiha

sample_reviews_en.text:
90-minute buffet, 489 THB - cash payment only. The price and menu variety are decent, with a reasonable selection.

Includes pork, beef, New Zealand mussels, fresh sea bass, peeled shrimp, various sushi, and salmon sushi.

This was my first time, so I wasn't sure what to order or how much. There were a few minor delays in ordering.

The white and black soups were delicious.

Dipping sauces include ponzu and sukiyaki (with chili, garlic, and lime).
Dessert is limited to one per person, with a choice of either raindrop mochi or ice cream.

Drinks are included: hot and cold green tea and soft drinks (like Es).
sample_reviews_en.author: I like tgm

sample_reviews_en.text:
The soup was okay, both the original and the clear seaweed version. However, I felt slightly thirsty the whole time after eating. I'm not sure if it was the dipping sauce or the soup (this might be a word of caution for those allergic to MSG).

I think the regular set might be more satisfactory; the Premium set isn't that different for the higher price.

I didn't take many pictures because I was too busy enjoying talking with my friends.

The staff were attentive, as usual.

I liked that the restaurant is open-air, so the smell didn't linger on my clothes.

There was ample parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patcha Watthana

restaurants.name: สเต็กลุงหนวด
restaurants.address:

290/3 ถนน สวนผัก Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This branch is delicious (not all branches are delicious).
Salmon steak is 140 baht, perfectly fried like a professional (I've eaten here many times, and it's always perfect).
Buying fresh salmon and frying it myself costs 120 baht per piece.
I can't fry it as nicely as they do, and my house gets oily.
Affordable prices, clean, good service.
Can scan to pay.
Parking available on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wednesday Child

sample_reviews_en.text:
Location: 4/5. Open-air restaurant located on the roadside, so it can get a bit dusty. Parking is available at the side of the inspection area or on the roadside.
Taste: 4/5. Some dishes were pre-prepared, so they weren't hot enough to make them taste good. For example, the mashed potatoes and French fries.
Service: 5/5. Food was prepared quickly and the service was friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nithiwich Jb

sample_reviews_en.text:
My mom came for dinner. The restaurant is easy to find, located on Suan Phak Road. Parking is available on the street or on the side of the restaurant, which can accommodate three cars.
Prices are listed on the menu. The taste is up to standard at Uncle Nuat Steak.
sample_reviews_en.author: รัตนธร

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was okay, but there was very little vegetable in the salad. It was like they gave me a fried fish dish with extra vegetables; it didn't match the salad menu. They wouldn't sell extra dressing separately; it was only sold as part of the set.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุชาติ ภิรมย์รื่น

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was soooooo delicious!
The mashed potatoes were the highlight. The price was also reasonable. The pork chop steak was incredibly tender. It was filling and delicious. The staff provided excellent service. I was extremely impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaimongkol Boonpuapan

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there a long time ago. I ordered the fish salad; there were very few vegetables, just scraps, they were very stingy. They didn't sell the dressing separately, you had to order it with the set. The french fries were soggy.
sample_reviews_en.author: นันทพร ช้างเผือก (อ๊ะออย)

sample_reviews_en.text: Good, cheap, delicious, reasonable price 59 69 79 something like that. I eat here often. Parking is on the side of the road. I like the salad and fish steak the most.
sample_reviews_en.author: annie ta

sample_reviews_en.text:
The steak tasted good, slightly salty and delicious.
I wish they had boiled potatoes on the menu so I could feel more full. Eating only meat isn't very filling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thermo Stream

restaurants.name: Pop A Bowl
restaurants.address:

Unicorn Phaya, Khwaeng Thung Phaya Thai, Khet Ratchathewi, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today (February 21, 2026), around 7 PM, I had the stir-fried beef with chili paste and a fried egg. The stir-fry had a good, well-balanced flavor, though perhaps not very spicy, probably because it's adapted to suit foreign palates. The fried egg was perfectly cooked – crispy white and runny yolk, I loved it!

But what impressed me the most, and deserves my sincere praise, was the female waitress (the one with fair skin). I accidentally dropped my glass of chili fish sauce, spilling it all over the table. I called for a cloth to wipe it up, and she handled it exceptionally well. She quickly came with a large pack of tissues and a cloth, showing no sign of annoyance. She even offered to move me to another seat and helped me move my bag to prevent further spills. After cleaning up, she even asked if I wanted more chili fish sauce. Her attentiveness was truly commendable. I genuinely want to express my sincere appreciation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pavee Laohapoonrungsi

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had their Tom yum seafood bowled to scrambled egg and it was pretty impressive. The rice at the bottom had a lot of flavour and it was the first time I had a tom yum rice instead of soup. It was amazingly delicious.

The egg was down just right, perfectly cooked. There was squid, mussels, large shrimp and the fake crab stick. Everything blended well together. It was a bit spicy but not too much.

The serving was large and I ended up not finishing the seafood bowl.

All the other dishes on the menu u looked quite good as well. Prices are quite reasonable.

If in the Phaya Thai BTS station/Unicorn building area, I highly recommend this place for a quick meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anna M

sample_reviews_en.text: It’s located right below BTS Phaya Thai, in a mall called The Unicorn. Go up to Level 3. It is worth spending the money for a good quality and delicious meal. The restaurant is comfortable and quite aesthetically pleasing. I spent 150THB for a pork teriyaki rice with eggs and a cup of green tea. Affordable price for a mall standard.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fong Kar Mun

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've walked past this place many times, so I finally got a chance to try it.
I ordered the chicken basil with creamy egg. It cost around 100 baht or so. I thought it was a bit expensive considering the portion size, but that's typical for this area.😅 The food took about 20 minutes to arrive. The taste was delicious and flavorful. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Alise

sample_reviews_en.text: We wanted a light meal without spending a fortune and found exactly what we were looking for here. The bowl with rice or noodles cost 120 baht, and the portions were really generous. The service was very attentive and catered to our needs. If you're looking for a quick, good-sized meal at a fair price, this is the place for you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Holger Lange

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is very good value for money. Most of the rice or noodles dishes cost either THB 120 or 140 each, I found the portions are bigger than what you get in food courts.  The drinks are also reasonable around THB 30.

The environment was clean, the service was quick and efficient. The staff were friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuklc Yuklc

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great restaurant on the 2nd floor of the Unicorn building, right next to the Phaya Thai Station.

Also direct access to the Eastin Grand Hotel.

We ate there twice.

Excellent, freshly prepared Japanese, Korean, and Thai cuisine. Nicely spicy 🌶️
Extremely good value for money.

Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Kramp

sample_reviews_en.text: First meal in bangkok and left a impression. First time eating a seafood fried kway teow with fresh ingredients more than the main itself. Prawn is juicy, sotong is springy, fish and mushroom tasty. Ambience, music and neon red wall trendy. Clean and hygienic. Recommend 🙂👍🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: Zheng Whye Hui

restaurants.name: นั่งหน้าบ้าน
restaurants.address:

47/3 Chaiyaphruek Rd, Khlong Chak Phra, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The mashed potatoes were surprisingly delicious as a side dish with the ribeye steak (180฿).
sample_reviews_th.author: Kamolwat Toboonchuay

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried everything that wasn't beef, and I'd give everything 5 stars, especially the tonkatsu and grilled pork neck with dipping sauce. Even the pork sausage salad, spicy soup, and basil stir-fry were better than those at dedicated Thai restaurants. It's a shame the menu is a bit limited, but that's understandable since the owners do everything themselves, and grilling takes time. The restaurant is located near the bridge over the Chakkraphra canal; be careful not to drive past it. The owners, a lovely husband and wife, were very friendly and even came out to direct you to a parking spot. I highly recommend supporting them; you won't be disappointed. The restaurant opens at 5 pm and there's parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: St Junior01

sample_reviews_en.text: As a farang who has tried pizza in Italy, the UK and other places in Europe amd American continent, I must say that I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of their pizzas. Do not forget to order some pasta and their grilled meats. They really know their craft and the pizza won't disappoint. Apart from getting the satisfaction of supporting a small local business you will have the chance to taste a bit of Western flavours with a Thai touch. Very much recommended. Will be coming back soon! Cheers
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel Melendrez

sample_reviews_en.text:
A cozy, locally-owned Thai-Italian pizza shop. Limited menu, but enough for a small family. Today, my large bainza pizza and rib-eye steak are freshly cooked, delicious, and reasonably priced. 😋
They said we can order ahead to avoid waiting. (For next time😚)
sample_reviews_en.author: Wora-pitcha J.
