sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious!!! The pizza is the best! The grilled meat is great. It was so good I had to write a review. The price is very good. The wait for food was a little long though; it's probably better to call and order in advance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benz Somboongedd

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a chill restaurant with delicious food at very reasonable prices. The pizza portions are very small, but the toppings are excellent – ​​you get exactly what you order, regardless of your preferred level of doneness.
sample_reviews_en.author: nirawooth pongsawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
A great find, a hidden gem with a fantastic menu of meats and other dishes.

We came to try the pizza 🍕
and it was a wonderful surprise: authentic thin and crispy crust made with quality ingredients.

Excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eva Lopez

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is diverse, delicious, inexpensive, and the portions are very generous. The service is excellent. I've been here many times and highly recommend trying it; everything is delicious. Parking is limited.
sample_reviews_en.author: Menon Bejho

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a small, old restaurant, just one room with 9 tables. There's only one cook, an elderly woman, and one server, also an elderly woman. There's one man, probably the chef's son, who helps with serving, taking customers, and handling payments.
The food is prepared one dish at a time, so the restaurant is slow. It's suitable for people who aren't in a hurry.

The food tastes like authentic Thai cuisine, spicy but slightly sweet.

Authentic restaurant near the Amulet Market. Basic location but with a river view.
Extensive menu, with the option to choose the type of dish and the fish or meat as the base.
We had the tom yum with chicken, which was very good but nice and spicy, and the dried sukiyaki, which was also good.
Recommended
With two waters, we spent 200 baht (about 5 euros).
sample_reviews_en.author: Jari Trentin

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is located in the heart of the amulet market. We stumbled upon it and loved it.

The dishes are classic Bangkok fare: delicious and inexpensive. It's a perfect place for lunch.

The setting is superb, with tables set up on a terrace overlooking the water.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adrien Amoros

sample_reviews_en.text: A great place with affordable, fresh, delicious food. Overlooking the river, it looks like a family business. The atmosphere is complemented by the elderly owner bustling between tables. Pad Thai is 60 baht. Worth it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Przemek Biały

sample_reviews_en.text: Really nice food and cheap ! Tables available to have a view on the river. just in the middle of amulet market. can be a good place to eat before or after the grand palace visit
sample_reviews_en.author: Elly Bld

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very cheap food right on the riverfront.
The entrance is through the kitchen via a small door. Good service and delicious food.
sample_reviews_en.author: La Travelina

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was okay, but the service was very slow and not in line with the queue. They were out of several ingredients.
sample_reviews_en.author: yuthana armporn

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, well-made food, a view of the river, great prices—what more could you want?
sample_reviews_en.author: Fede C


494 Thanon Asok - Din Daeng, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
I've been here with my friends a couple of times, and you gotta try this dish.

Food Recommendation:
- Rice Vermicelli with Shrimp
(ผัดหมี่กุ้ง)
- Stir-fried Shrimp in Curry Powder

sample_reviews_en.text:
A truly delicious Thai restaurant. They are open until late! We stayed until 1 AM, and it seemed like they stayed open even later.

GLN is available.

I don't know the name, but I highly recommend the fried pork there.

As for the stir-fried morning glory and fried rice, well, no words needed.

It was so delicious that I wanted to order and try every single item on the menu.

It has a slightly pungent fish sauce flavor, but it was fine for me since I can't eat cilantro.

4 dishes plus 2 bottles of Singha beer cost a total of 490 baht.

It is the same price as the local menu, and it is a very honest place that quotes the same price even if you just take a picture of the menu and show it to them.

I was fine with it, but if you are sensitive about hygiene, I recommend getting takeout.
sample_reviews_en.author: 정유진

sample_reviews_en.text:
Environment: The restaurant is not enclosed and is close to the street, so it's noisy and quite polluted.

Service: The food was served extremely slowly. When I went, the restaurant was processing a large takeout order, but they didn't explain or inform customers about the waiting time before they ordered. They just made customers wait, and I waited for almost an hour!

Taste: Fried rice and fried noodles, the most basic national foods in Thailand, how could they taste like this? The taste was okay at first (but compared to what I've had before, this was still very average), but it became tasteless after a while. The meat was also bland. Come on, I didn't come here for a diet. The only thing worth praising was that the portions were relatively large.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jolyne Cujoh

sample_reviews_en.text: We have been to quite some local places around thailand and they where always great, but this was just a big dissapointment to say the least. First the food took forever. The longest we ever waited. We orderd no meat pad thai as it was listed on the menu. As we orderd we enshured again that their is no meat at all in it. Our food came we started eating and noticed halfway through that their where small shrimps, barely noitcebal everywhere in the food. As we tried to bring this up with the restaurant it took really long before somebody came with a check and their was nobody that could speak englisch or thai. The staff did not show a lot of interest in resolving the issue and we had to pay full price. So overall that was just an annoying experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amalia Bechtler

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don't know why this place is rated 4.1.

It's 4.9 or higher.

Affordable prices

Good location

Good service

Portions are almost on par with Seoga & Cook

And the taste is great too... It's good for takeout or dining in.

A real local favorite / I haven't seen any Koreans.

Recommended dishes: 1) Pad Kra Pao (Stir-fried Pork with Basil)
2) Pad Thai
3) Fried Pork Belly (I don't know the name)

The dishes listed as "soup," like Tom Yum Goong or Chicken Soup, are also really delicious.

It doesn't really feel like a date spot with a nice atmosphere lol.

If you like an outdoor vibe, it's GOAT.
sample_reviews_en.author: EDDY (이대)

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was close to the hotel where I was staying and open until late at night, so it was convenient.
There was a wide variety of dishes, and even just the stir-fried gapow had a variety of ingredients. There were two types of chicken alone: ​​minced meat and shredded chicken. I ordered the shredded meat and the portion was so large it was enough for about two people.
The flavor was also strong with garlic, making it one of the most delicious stir-fried gapow dishes I have ever eaten.
For me, the spiciness was just right, but if you don't like spicy food, you might want to order it as non-spicy.
sample_reviews_en.author: s sakmongkol

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate two meals at this restaurant today, and the taste of the fried rice kept nagging at me. The food is cheap and good value, and the restaurant is clean. The waitress who took my order had a slightly grumpy face but was actually very nice and could communicate in both English and Chinese. The food was delicious; the pig's blood soup was actually made with offal, and the broth was rich and flavorful. The dry noodles were very cheap and you could add toppings from the table. The fried rice was absolutely amazing. Everything was great; I highly recommend it and will definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: SOFT Lamp

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there specifically for the green curry.
I asked the waiter if it was spicy, and he said something like, "It's normal, just a little spicy," in English. So I ordered the green curry (chicken) for 100 baht and rice for 10 baht.
When I actually ate it, it was incredibly spicy.
I somehow managed to finish it.
It was absolutely delicious. It was the best green curry I've ever had. The only thing that bothered me was that it took a while for the food to come out after ordering.
sample_reviews_en.author: A K

restaurants.name: Shaxian
restaurants.address:

388 Yaowarat Rd, แขวงจักรวรรดิ, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Shaxian Restaurant offers a variety of authentic Chinese dishes, and while some items truly shine, others could use a bit of refinement.

The Food
•	Peanut Noodles: The highlight of my visit! The noodles were flavorful, with a rich, creamy peanut sauce that had just the right balance of nuttiness and seasoning. A dish I’d definitely recommend to anyone visiting.
•	Xiaolongbao: Unfortunately, this dish fell short. While the flavor was decent, the dumplings were too dry, lacking the juicy broth that makes xiaolongbao so special.

Why Visit?
•	Authentic Options: A good selection of Chinese comfort food that caters to a range of tastes.
•	Hits and Misses: While some dishes are fantastic (like the peanut noodles), others might not meet expectations, such as the xiaolongbao.

Verdict

Shaxian Restaurant is worth a visit for its authentic atmosphere and standout dishes like the peanut noodles. However, the xiaolongbao could use some improvement. If you go, stick to the noodles and other highly recommended dishes for the best experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karin Buddharuksa

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don’t understand why the reviews here are so low. This place is great.
It looks better than most “eateries” there are on the street. No waiting at entry, and had some tables with customers, foreigners and maybe local (they were Asian, I can’t differentiate, sorry)

We got the Chinese pork steamed dumplings and beef small wantons (no soup).
They were great, and coming from someone who eats dumplings on a weekly basis. They felt handmade, not store bought, and had a great filling with a nice bite. Perfectly cooked, not rough and not paste-like.
Both dishes were a size of between first course and main dish. A person eating them both might have been filling full, but we shared these plates between 2 people.

Including a water and a beer, cost us 350 Baht, which is great considering the location this place is in (super touristy, and competing with many other eateries in the area).

For a quick dumplings bite, I’d definitely recommend this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noam Akselbant

sample_reviews_en.text:
My new favorite in Yaowarat. This is a no-nonsense straight to the point - delicious noodle and dumpling joint.
Highly recommend their peanut sauce noodles - it comes with a mound of pickled spicy mustard greens that adds an extra level of flavor to an already tasty favorite. The boiled mixed dumplings are small and wonton-like but size doesn’t matter here - the taste is superb. The boiled dumpling also have peanut sauce and diced scallions - give it a kiss of the soy sauce vinegar blend on the table and you’re in business. There’s also the two types of chili sauce as condiments to perk everything up. Soups are great too - I recommend the bitter gourd pork.
Will eat here every time I’m in Chinatown.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jack Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stopped by because they have braised pork ribs. There's a restaurant I ate at in China that was gone after COVID. I really wanted to try it! (Too bad they don't have pork).

The taste isn't quite the same as in China, but it's still delicious. They give you a lot of meat; I couldn't finish it and had to take some home.

The tofu skin salad was also tasty, and the braised pork ribs with cordyceps were excellent. The prices aren't too high. You should definitely stop by!
sample_reviews_en.author: Napatsanan Chaiwiriyachoke

sample_reviews_en.text:
I only had one portion of dumplings with soy sauce - but I was immediately convinced by the taste.

The service was friendly, but not intrusive. I only noticed this restaurant because someone was standing outside with the menu and didn't directly talk to me while I browsed through it in peace.

Besides locals and Chinese, many Europeans also found their way here. And when I'm back in town, I'll gladly stop here again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Dennis Brauner

sample_reviews_en.text:
"I really enjoyed the fried noodles at this place. The noodles, vegetables, and meat were perfectly balanced, and the overall taste was quite good. The best part of the dish has to be the meat, which was incredibly tender.
However, the soup was a bit disappointing. It was almost tasteless and felt quite bland. If the soup could be made with a richer, more savory flavor, this meal would be absolutely perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khine Than Htwe (Kara)

sample_reviews_en.text: "This Chinese restaurant is really great! The food tastes delicious, the ingredients are fresh, and the portions are generous. The staff are friendly, and the environment is clean and comfortable. What I like most is that there's no extra service charge; the pricing is transparent, making it feel like great value. Overall, it was a very pleasant dining experience, and I highly recommend it!"

I apologize for not having any photos to show, as I was too unimpressed to even take out my camera.

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate there twice. Once the schnitzel was very good, the other time the server misunderstood my order and brought me the wrong thing. I didn't say anything because I'm not going to get upset over 200 baht, but it didn't taste good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bill cipher

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate delicious Khao Tom Moo here two days in a row. Staff was super friendly and the vibe was nice. Looks like a great place to have some beers also, however I was there for the food
sample_reviews_en.author: Eric Ross

sample_reviews_en.text: The place is worth a visit. The flavours and services were excellent. 'Chill out vibe ' kind of place. The food quality is top notch and prices are affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rohan Puthur

restaurants.name: ตำมั่ว โลตัสเลียบด่วนรามอินทรา
restaurants.address:

59 อาคาร เทสโก้โลตัส, Pradit Manutham Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The papaya salad was standard in taste, not disappointing. The Thai style papaya salad, ordered medium spicy, was still quite spicy. The restaurant uses large, high-quality dried shrimp that aren't too salty.

The "mixed papaya salad," as the name suggests, contains bean sprouts, pork cracklings, rice noodles, cilantro, water spinach, salted crab, and many other things mixed together. Ordered medium spicy, it was very spicy, but delicious. The staff explained the spiciness level (mild, medium, spicy) and the number of chilies.

Finally, I couldn't handle the spiciness anymore, so I ordered a new dish to cool down: deep-fried pork belly with makhaen chili paste. It's a Northern Thai style dish; the makhaen wasn't too strong, making it easy to eat for those unfamiliar with it. The pork belly had just the right amount of fat – not too much, not too little – perfect for snacking.

This branch of Tam Mua is tucked away on the outer edge. You have to walk out of Lotus towards the B Quick side; the restaurant is at the very corner of the building. You might miss it if you don't pay attention.
sample_reviews_en.author: Am ja

sample_reviews_en.text: Upon entering the restaurant, we found staff sitting at a table for customers who shouted at us, asking if we wanted to eat in or takeout. We said we wanted to eat in, but they remained seated and continued to ask how many people were in our party, as if we were begging for food. The staff were talking loudly amongst themselves, playing on their phones with the volume up, and walking around without any consideration for customers, acting as if there were no customers in the restaurant. We ordered two dishes: the papaya salad with peanuts was tasty and okay, but the stir-fried sweet potato leaves with fresh shrimp was inedible; it tasted like it had been fried in old oil, with a rancid smell. We only ate the shrimp. We ordered a refillable Coke. The first glass was fine, but when they brought a refill pitcher, the staff had melted ice and the Coke was very bland. This was our first and probably only time eating here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Meow V.

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is delicious, but the papaya salad is sooooo spicy that it burns my stomach, mouth, and tears 😂 I ordered medium spicy fermented fish crab, so I asked the staff how many chilies to put in medium spicy. They said 13. Oh my god, tears are flowing 555. I couldn't eat it because it was so spicy, 13 of them were dried chilies. However, on the bill, you can specify the number of chilies. It was my fault for not asking, because I thought medium spicy would be 5 or something like that. I would like the restaurant to put the spiciness level in the menu so that it would show how many chilies are needed. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Kook Srpp

sample_reviews_en.text:
👩‍👩‍👧‍👦 I have to say, I really love the atmosphere and the taste of the food here. My recommended dishes are the fried pork sausage pancake 👍
🍃 Crispy fried sweet potato leaves salad 😁
and 🐖 Chiang Mai style fried pork with turmeric chili paste 🌿. When you mix the crispy pork belly with the chili paste, it becomes even more fragrant and flavorful. The pork belly isn't greasy at all (if you're worried about calories, I don't recommend it!).
The fried chicken wings are also excellent.

The 5-pepper papaya salad is medium spicy 🌶, just right.
sample_reviews_en.author: pong chaivoot

sample_reviews_en.text: Very disappointed this time. I've eaten here many times, but this time I ordered papaya salad with fermented fish and papaya salad with small noodles. The first time I ordered without garlic, but they put it in. The restaurant changed it, but as soon as they changed it, both the papaya salad with fermented fish and the papaya salad with small noodles were extremely salty. Really disappointed. I want them to fix it and contact me back to inform me of how to handle it.
sample_reviews_en.author: นงลักษณ์ วันคํา

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, it's okay. I got to eat a medium-quality Isaan meal with a medium-quality taste. It was okay in an air-conditioned room, so it wasn't hot. It was quite quiet. I'd like to have the option to add more fish sauce. How many shots do you want? Something like that. The price is okay, just to get by.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apirich Richmontree

sample_reviews_en.text:
I just ordered a bag of papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce to take home.
It's very expensive. The ingredients are terrible; there's no crab, only noodles, and very few noodles at that.
The price was 85 baht.
They're trying to get rich selling this!
sample_reviews_en.author: My Nick Name

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant specializes in papaya salad and other spicy salads. The papaya salad and fried chicken are delicious, but other dishes are average. It's not suitable for children or those who dislike spicy food, as almost everything is spicy.
sample_reviews_en.author: ประศาสตร์ พันธุภัทร์

restaurants.name: ABCF Thaifood
restaurants.address:

99/5 Ratchaprarop Rd, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Reasonable priced Zhi Cha restaurant offering a good variety of dishes!"

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great food for a really affordable and reasonable price. Would recommend the marinated crab papaya salad ( comes with a whole marinated crab), the Tom yum soup - they didn’t skimp on the seefood( good portion enough for 3 people) and the steamed cookles.

Personally the pineapple rice wasn’t what I expected as I was expecting a more southern Chinese version, but their one was more salty and had so much different add ins that we weren’t expecting ( sausage, meat floss, sultanas and prawns). If you like more salty fried rice definitely give it a try.

Also their beer options were really cheap. The bottles listed on the menu were way bigger than we were expecting. We paid 80 bhat for a 620ml of Chang beer.

They have both English and Chinese speaking waiters. They were so friendly and tried their best to help. They even allowed us to bring our unfinished outside drinks into the store even though most restaurants in the area don’t allow that.

Would definitely recommend for anyone looking for food around the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Soupie S

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love dining here. Sometimes, their food can be a hit or miss but I still love it compared to other restaurants in the area.

Yes, you can buy the same food outside cheaper but if you are looking for a restaurant in Pratunam where you can dine and with A/C this is a good option.

I love their pork neck (but sometimes they don’t serve the right part) 😂😭
I always order their fried rice but I feel like the portion is too small for me so I just always add extra rice.

You can bring outside food and drinks here so it’s convenient if you want to buy Milk Tea or even BBQ outside and bring it here. It’s cheaper outside, 10B but here it’s 20B.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Need to speak chinese or thai.
The staff hardly speak english. And messed up our order 3times.

They dont write our order and just write price on the piece of paper.despite there is code on the menu
One of our friend  write the code and the price,
They still mess our order.
2 wrong order and 1 order ( 1 fried rice come twice). We are group of 9.

Despite the eror. They dont say anything
The boss seems wandering around cluelesy
Lucky the food  come fast. Think twice to try if you are big group
sample_reviews_en.author: KeruPug

sample_reviews_en.text: The Teochew 潮州 owner is a friendly guy. Fluent in Thai/Teochew/Cantonese/shanghainese & Mandarin language. Some of his employees are  Vietnamese, Cambodian & Burmese and also speak their respective languages. This restaurant is one of the most international cheap eats places and due to their Asian language skills many foreigners/tourists feel very welcome and well cared for... Despite the lack of English.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mairwen Hodari

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first major disappointment. The owner and his wife were incredibly unfriendly. We ordered several dishes, and they were awful & worst. We couldn't finish half of them. Some were tasteless, and some didn't even resemble Thai food. We complained, but they were met with a perfunctory response and charged us the full price. Believe me, I not recommend this place, and I swear I'll never visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chui Wilson

sample_reviews_en.text: The best and most affordable food in the Pratunam area We had 3–4 dishes and 2-3 drinks, yet most of the time it did not exceed 1K baht. The seller is helpful and friendly. The restaurant's staff is a diverse mix of nationalities. They offer a variety of foods. I like their flower clams and fried squid, not to mention their fried fish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sai

sample_reviews_en.text: The grilled fish, glass noodle and shrimp, Tom Yam soup, and grilled meat were all delicious. The waiters and owner were very friendly. They all spoke Chinese. The grilled meat and glass noodle and shrimp are must-try 🤤, the portions are generous, and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dany Ling

sample_reviews_en.text: Had dinner at ABCF Thaifood in the Pratunam area. They offer a good variety of Thai dishes. Overall, the taste is okay, but the standout was definitely the green curry – very flavorful. Prices are reasonable too. A nice spot for a casual dinner if you’re in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sontos

restaurants.name: Krua Thai Yai
restaurants.address:

101 Soi Pho Kaew 2 Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Krua Thai Yai (ครัวไทยใหญ่) – A Cozy Spot with Authentic Shan Flavors.

If you’re in Bangkapi (subdivision of Bangkok) and love traditional food, Krua Thai Yai is a great find. The dishes are fresh and flavorful

—especially the fried tofu and Shan noodles with tofu gravy, which are absolute standouts.

The staff are friendly Shan locals who make you feel right at home. Their hospitality adds a warm, personal touch that makes the meal even more memorable.

There’s a small coffee bar on-site, with indoor and outdoor seating available. The air-conditioned room is perfect for beating the Bangkok heat, and there’s also a cozy corner for relaxing, working, or catching up with friends. Free Wi-Fi is a nice bonus.

Great food, warm vibes, and an experience you won't regret.
sample_reviews_th.author: The boy who loves freedom

sample_reviews_en.text:
Krua Thai Yai is one of the best places in Bangkok to enjoy authentic Shan cuisine. We tried Tofu Nway (warm chickpea tofu), Shan noodles, fried tofu, Hin Htoke (Shan dumplings), Shan-style sour pork, and crispy pork skin. Every dish was delicious, authentic, and full of flavour.

In addition to these popular Shan breakfast dishes and noodles, the restaurant also serves a variety of rice dishes, curries, and many other traditional Shan specialties.

If you are looking for genuine Shan food in Bangkok, Krua Thai Yai is definitely one of the top restaurants to visit. The quality, taste, and authenticity of the food make it a highly recommended destination for anyone who loves Shan cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: U Ni

sample_reviews_en.text: Krua Thai Yai delivers an authentic Shan dining experience in the heart of Bangkok. Every dish is prepared with care, staying true to its roots while catering to both locals and expats. From the zesty la phat salad to the fiery malar hin, each plate tells a story of Shan culture and tradition. If you’re in Bangkok and craving something unique, Krua Thai Yai is a must-visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Li Shi Ya

sample_reviews_en.text: I just left a comment. Why doesn't the platform accept negative reviews for mistakes? Why did you remove my post? The dough was so lumpy it couldn't be mixed; it was all clumps together, like a pancake. How am I supposed to eat it? The soup was so hot and it still wouldn't mix. Can you please make it a little better? It really affects the taste!
sample_reviews_en.author: Cutie Is_

sample_reviews_en.text: An authentic Shan restaurant in Bangkok, serving authentic flavours at reasonable prices. My visit to this shop fulfilled my longing for the cuisines of my hometown. The shop offers a great outdoor spot to relax in the evening. I’ll certainly be back when I miss the cuisines of Shan State!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nang Lee Hark Onn

sample_reviews_en.text:
With unparalleled cleanliness and delicious food, this shop is a must visit , shop offer perfect combination of cleanliness & excellet food ,Bbq flavor is bold & satisfying flavor taste out there .
I’ll definitely be returning and bringing friends who love shan food to share the experience
sample_reviews_en.author: May Thwe

sample_reviews_en.text: A very cozy place with incredibly delicious food! Every dish is like a work of art — flavorful, fresh, and made with love. Especially sour chicken soup and Padkapao so delicious.The service is excellent, and the atmosphere is warm and welcoming. I’ll definitely be coming back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Star Fish

sample_reviews_en.text: Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, served hot and fresh. The flavor is mild with a fragrant sesame seed aroma (I think). It comes with a slightly sweet dipping sauce. The price is reasonable, service is good, and there's parking in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wendy

restaurants.name: SAI Izakaya tepanyaki
restaurants.address:

9, 54 Si Lom 6, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The all-you-can-eat karaage fried chicken is great value and tastes delicious, homemade style, prepared by a Japanese chef. They've moved to Soi Tan Tawan, just a short walk in on the left. The name has changed to Sai (ไซ), and they're located on the second floor. The atmosphere is still as friendly as before 🥰 But unfortunately, they no longer have garlic sauce 🥺
sample_reviews_th.author: Ting Ting Wu

sample_reviews_th.text: Delicious! Juicy fried chicken, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. Buffet for 119฿.
sample_reviews_th.author: PJ Vlog (โอ๊ะโอ๋)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was satisfied with the surprisingly reasonable meal. Their specialty is the karaage buffet. Unlimited fried chicken at 139 baht for men, and 99 baht for women. Although it’s listed as a lunch menu, it is available in the evening as well. The fried chicken was juicy and tasty with a crispy coating which had a slight curry flavor. The fried chicken came with pasta and salad on the side. The slightly spicy pasta was unexpectedly good. Not only the chicken but also the side dishes are refillable, which makes it an excellent value.
The only downside was the air conditioning inside the restaurant. The place is on the second floor, but the staircase leading up from the first floor has no door, so it’s not sealed off from the outside air. Only one small AC unit was trying to cool the room with assistance of the fans. So the air condition was like an outdoor Thai eatery. It was a bit disappointing, and too warm to stay for long.
Still, it’s a great option for a quick and inexpensive meal, so I think I’ll come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gourmet Advisor

sample_reviews_en.text:
Phenomenal Chicken Buffet.  All you can eat in an hour for BHT139!!! And it's so tasty, delicious, succulent and an incredible Karragge batter.

Set expectations for incredible value chicken and a local worker hit spot for lunch.

This is a secreted venue upstairs and is amazing for lunch.  It was quiet but full, groups and individuals respectfully eating ones fill and promptly leaving.  One serves oneself coke or coke zero and chicken is served, one indicates readiness for more and a few moments later freshly made chicken arrives.

There's a wonderful authentic local atmosphere, locals are having a quick but hearty lunch, there's a fusion of decorations, pop cultural and heritage aspects to the fun decor.

Upstairs. Seating is on stools at wooden tables, it's a very cheap delicious meal, this is about incredible value food.  The chicken is bonlees pieces cut to the size of wings, but it's thing/leg/breast randomly.

We left a considerable tip, as that felt appropriate given we had so much chicken!
sample_reviews_en.author: James Bacon

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Hidden Gem for Comfort Food Lovers!

If you're looking for a place that delivers incredible value and delicious comfort food, this spot is absolutely worth visiting! The all-you-can-eat spaghetti was the highlight for me—fresh, flavorful, and always topped off so you never leave hungry.
I was pleasantly surprised by the egg salad as well. It was creamy, well-seasoned, and made a perfect side to the pasta. The real standout, though, was the chicken karaage. It was crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside, and seasoned perfectly. I found myself going back for seconds... and thirds!
The staff kept everything well stocked, the atmosphere was welcoming, and the entire experience felt relaxed and enjoyable. Whether you're coming for a hearty meal or just want to indulge in some comfort food, this place delivers.
I'll definitely be coming back, and I highly recommend it to anyone who loves great food and amazing value!
sample_reviews_en.author: Steven Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
99 Baht Japanese Chef's Fried Chicken Buffet in Silom

The fried chicken, made by a Japanese chef, is tender and juicy, with crispy, lightly salted skin. It's freshly fried for every order – absolutely delicious! It comes with 4 side dishes: egg salad, spaghetti, papaya salad, and cabbage, which you can order unlimitedly.

The price is incredibly cheap! 99 Baht for women, 139 Baht for men + 7% VAT. You can eat for 50 minutes. If you come during May, water is free! Such a great deal!

This restaurant used to move from Patpong Soi 1. I've eaten here many times before, but they've kept the same price. It's now called Sai Izakaya. There's no parking at the restaurant; you have to park at the Panawong Building in Silom and walk over.

*Recommendation*: Call to reserve a table as seating is limited. Buffet hours are 11:00 AM - 2:00 PM (Closed on Sundays).
sample_reviews_en.author: Orn the table-อรพากิน

sample_reviews_en.text:
All-you-can-eat Karaage chicken buffet, egg salad, shredded cabbage salad, spicy spaghetti, and papaya salad (Thai/fermented fish sauce style) – all you can eat! And right now there's a promotion for free refillable water/soft drinks. Adults 139 THB, Adults 99 THB, and small children half price.

For an additional 39 THB per person, you get unlimited refills of Japanese rice, curry sauce, and egg soup. Everything tastes amazing, and the prices are incredibly affordable. Please support this restaurant that cares so much about its customers! If the restaurant stays open, customers like us will continue to enjoy great food at great prices forever. ❤️⭐️
sample_reviews_en.author: Panthit R.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I heard that the Karaage Chicken Buffet is reopening today, its first day back after being closed for about 3 months. So, I couldn't miss the chance to try my favorite on the first day it reopened. At first, I thought it wouldn't be crowded, but it was packed with Bangkok Bank head office employees!

P.S. There are still four side dishes, but I only ate two.
P.S.2 I overheard that if you don't like papaya salad with fermented fish sauce, you can ask for Thai-style papaya salad instead.
P.S.3 They still have the squeezable chicken pieces!
sample_reviews_en.author: SirChanII

restaurants.name: เกาเหลาเลือดหมูวงเวียนใหญ่
restaurants.address:

82/7 Wutthi Sueksa, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A pork blood soup shop on Wongwian Yai Road near the old Merry King. Eating here brings back memories of the old neighborhood.

The main menu items are as follows (December 2022):
- Noodle soup: 60 baht, special: 70 baht
- Kuay jap: 60 baht, special: 70 baht
- Steamed rice: 7 baht, take-away: 10 baht

The soup is incredibly hot, scalding your mouth and causing your ears to smoke. It helps with circulation. Highly recommended for those craving hot soup.

- Great view from the table, overlooking the King Taksin Monument. You can even watch the car approach.

- Quick checkout, with the owner sitting at the counter.

Payment is available by cash or scanning a QR code.

[Directions and Parking]
The shop is located on Wongwian Yai Road, with parking available along the sidewalk in front of the shop.

[December 4, 2022]
sample_reviews_en.author: Yutthapol Kulthanun

sample_reviews_en.text:
This noodle soup is excellent because of its broth. If you don't like spicy food, it's delicious even without adding any seasoning. The pork, blood, toppings, and vegetables are in large pieces, although sometimes they come in clumps.
The staff might be a bit grumpy, so it's best to pay directly to the owner.
Parking is available on the street near the roundabout, if you can find a spot. The view is of the King Taksin roundabout, and it's beautiful during sunset.
Street food lovers will probably enjoy it.
sample_reviews_en.author: 慎無限土雨

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop's pork blood soup is delicious. It has all the organs, but there's no minced pork or crispy pork. If you want crispy pork, order it from Hia Ming's shop next door. They sell it together at almost every table. Order crispy pork from Hia Ming to eat with it. It's delicious and not expensive. The soup is 70 baht. The pieces of seng ji are large and not fishy. Overall, it's okay for this shop. If you want to eat pork blood soup in Wong Wian Yai, don't miss this shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eakwat Vinijchaikul

sample_reviews_en.text:
A pork blood soup shop on Wongwian Yai Road near the old Merry King. Eating here brings back memories of the old neighborhood.
- Noodle soup: 60 baht, special: 70 baht
- Kuay jap: 60 baht, special: 70 baht
- Steamed rice: 7 baht, takeaway: 10 baht

The hot soup helps to improve circulation. If you crave a hot bowl of soup, the bill is quick. The owner sits at the counter on the side of Wongwian Yai Road. Parking is available along the sidewalk in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธวัชชัย ใหญ่อยู่

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Pork Blood Soup, Wong Wian Yai"
I've been eating here everywhere, and this delicious restaurant is close to my house. The soup is delicious, with just the right amount of flavor. The offal (the stalks are huge!) doesn't smell fishy at all. All this for 107 baht. This bowl of soup is 100 baht for a special (normally 70 baht). Rice is 7 baht per bowl. I have to say it's a great value and incredibly delicious.
#EatWithUncle
#TravelWithUncle
sample_reviews_en.author: Noomdnk Channel

sample_reviews_en.text: Jae Tia's Pork Noodle Soup near Wongwian Yai is a stall that sets up on the roadside in the evenings. Anyone passing by has probably seen it. Their main dish is pork noodle soup; the broth is very fragrant with pepper, and it's very comforting to sip hot. They give you a generous amount of pork and offal (the kidney is HUGE!). It's perfect with hot rice!
sample_reviews_en.author: Koyabapla

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located right by the roundabout on the roadside. You'll see tables set up along the curve where people can eat. It's always crowded. The pork blood soup is delicious and even has morning glory leaves in it. You have to go early for the duck noodle soup because it tends to run out late at night. Today, I only had the pork blood soup.
sample_reviews_en.author: tuppawath atipisankul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pork blood soup
There is also a noodle soup and rice vermicelli. Prices start at 60 baht.
Plain rice is 7 baht per bowl.
A large bowl with lots of ingredients. The offal doesn't smell bad.
The only downside is that there's no Chinese celery.
If you come late at night, you can park on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasan Yosenakul

restaurants.address:

1837 ถ. เจริญกรุง Yan Nawa, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
ACTUAL NAME: THE EXTRA BURGER HOUSE

If you miss Western food and style this very friendly mom and pop place should just about do it for you.
They offer a good and simplified English menu (that you can  see in photos). It's  a perfectly acceptable short order Western food menu with excellent  desserts.
Theres also Mexican food as shown in the photos. The service is prompt and the prices are Thai style low. Now, if you  happen to be a big boy, or you're  really  hungry you might want to remember that the  servings are not large.
My conclusion?
TRY IT: You'll be glad you did.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shawn McGuire

sample_reviews_en.text:
This burger is so tasty and affordable. I choose here because my hotel is very close.

But this was finally a great choice for us.

If you have a chance, you should come and try here.

But, they don’t serve any alcohol for your reference. If they start this service, here becomes better or best for me 555

Anyway thank you for your great foods and service!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: 木村圭介

sample_reviews_en.text:
A down-to-earth hamburger shop.
The correct way to eat it is probably to add the sliced ​​lettuce and tomato that come on top, and barbecue sauce or ketchup.
The freshly cut potato french fries are delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tsutomu K (Moo)

sample_reviews_en.text: Yummy homemade Burger, Quesadilla, Burrito and fresh salad. And also great fried chicken. Must try all. The price is good and friendly.  The warm hommy feeling and service will make you feel good.
sample_reviews_en.author: LEO S R

sample_reviews_en.text: Big burger and patty with reasonable price. It is quite juicy and full of meat. I like to dip it in mustard sauce. Even though the restaurant looked old, but their burger quality is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: yovita anggraeni puspitasari

sample_reviews_en.text:
Might not be the shop that you must try in your life, but definitely worth if you happen to pass around there.

Tasty beef burger with good price ( 115 baht )
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumrit Ariyawuttiphan

sample_reviews_en.text: Best Quesadilla I ever had in BKK, better than taco bell and other chain restaurants. If you are in this area, highly recommend to try this small-cozy place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pleotian Uttarachai

sample_reviews_en.text: The Extra is always great. Nice family owned restaurant. Good burgers and tasty Mexican food. Happy to discover this place. I suspect you will be too.
sample_reviews_en.author: John - จอห์น

restaurants.name: มาม่าซัง ตลาดกัลปพฤกษ์
restaurants.address:

ตลาด Kanlapaphruek Rd, Khwaeng Bang Khae, Bang Khae, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is so delicious! They use Korean instant noodles, which are usually expensive but are sold at a very cheap price, less than 100 baht. I love the crispy chicken; it's still crispy even after I take it home. The sauce is so flavorful. The soy sauce marinated egg is well-prepared and tastes amazing with the spicy instant noodles. They have new menu items, I'll try them all!
Can I give it 10 stars?
sample_reviews_en.author: pao salapao

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious. I've been eating here since they sold at Indie Market, and even after they moved to Talad Mee Dee, I still follow them because the taste hasn't changed at all.

And the vendors are so lovely. They speak politely and have beautiful bows. ❤️

P.S. I love their music, especially Purpeech and Safeplanet! 🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Suneeporn Sritong

sample_reviews_en.text: I eat at this restaurant regularly. My go-to order is No. 4, Mama Sang x Samyang. They have new menu items now; I tried the miso soup and it paired perfectly with the noodles – so good and refreshing! The owners are lovely and polite, always bowing respectfully.

sample_reviews_th.text:
I've heard about this traditional sukiyaki for a long time, but never got to try it until today! 💕

My friend and I each ordered a bowl — they have both the soup and dry versions 🍲
The dipping sauce is also served separately in individual bowls, so you can dip to your heart's content without having to share 😂

Personally, I like to "pour the sauce on one bite at a time" 5555 It's so delicious! The sauce is fragrant, rich, and perfectly balanced, just like authentic traditional sukiyaki. Eating it with the tender pork is pure bliss 😍

The price is also great! The total (including drinks) was only 164฿. It's amazing and I loved it! 💸✨

It was a very filling and budget-friendly meal. Luckily, there weren't many people that day, so we could eat leisurely without waiting in line. The restaurant atmosphere is simple and comfortable, like eating at home 🏡

If you like traditional sukiyaki with amazing dipping sauce, you have to try it! I promise, every bite is worth it!
sample_reviews_th.author: Nutteeya Müller (Btnutteeya)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to this restaurant on Saturday, August 2nd, 2025, based on reviews that said it served traditional sukiyaki with a "clear" broth. I wanted to know what "clear" broth tasted like.

I arrived around 5 pm; there were no people, so there was no queue. I ordered and the food arrived quickly. I ordered beef and crispy squid sukiyaki. After doing some research, I learned that "clear" broth means the soup is light and not oily. Therefore, the sukiyaki here is mild, unlike the rich, flavorful Thai sukiyaki. The fermented tofu dipping sauce initially had a strong smell, but as I ate more, everything blended together perfectly. The mild broth was refreshing. Most importantly, the beef was incredibly tender.

The restaurant's atmosphere was very local; the service wasn't anything spectacular, which I was okay with. I wasn't expecting much.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutsara Deepankeaw

sample_reviews_en.text:
Suki Trok Rong Moo is located on Khao Lam Road, which is lined with many street food stalls. One of the oldest restaurants in the area is Suki Trok Rong Moo.

Suki Trok Rong Moo is tucked away in a small alley, with the shop front situated on a sidewalk corner of Khao Lam Road. They offer both beef and pork suki, available in both soup and dry versions.

Today, I tried the dry pork suki. The advantage of traditional suki is that it's made to order; the broth is stir-fried until dry, unlike modern suki which uses oil. The sauce is a traditional soy bean paste sauce, not the modern suki dipping sauce. The pork is tender, bouncy, and delicious. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasita Padoongmatvorakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I tried the sukiyaki at Trok Rong Moo. I ordered the special pork and squid set for 90 baht. The portion was generous and worth the price. The taste was just right.
The sukiyaki is served in a traditional style, with blanched pork and crispy squid, along with Chinese cabbage and glass noodles, all topped with broth. You can pour the dipping sauce into your bowl yourself or dip the food into the sauce. The sauce is sweet with a hint of fermented tofu, giving it a familiar taste from my childhood. Mmm, delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Eggkarpol Benjarkarn

The food tasted as good as other reviews said, and the price was reasonable. The metal barrier in front of the shop has now been removed, making it easier to see.
Some reviews mentioned calling ahead to reserve a table, especially if you want to order all the dishes. It's a good idea to call ahead, as we did. The owner recommended the shrimp with tamarind sauce and the steamed fish with egg white. People kept coming in while we ate, even though there was only one chef. The restaurant is located by the roadside, so it's quite dusty. We ate around noon, and it was hot, which made us less hungry, haha.

I tried the fried shrimp with tamarind sauce, the baked goose leg with noodles, the creamy squid egg soup, and the stir-fried morning glory.

But my favorite was the fried shrimp with tamarind sauce.
The shrimp were large and bouncy, and the sauce was delicious. I really enjoyed it.

The restaurant has new air-conditioned seating. I only recently found out they charge 10 baht per person for it (because a staff member came in and asked if we wanted to sit in the air-conditioned room, but didn't mention the extra charge).
The air conditioning was quite warm, set to 23°C with two units.

The restaurant should put up a sign in front of the air-conditioned room stating that there's a 10 baht charge for the air conditioning. I informed the staff and asked for a replacement. They brought a new one, but upon closer inspection, it still had soil on it. They said a male staff member had washed them, which is why it was like that. I couldn't sleep that night. I wondered if there were parasite eggs. I ate the first scallion without noticing the soiling; I only noticed it on the second one.

This is a grilled shrimp restaurant with plenty of seating, reasonable prices, and delicious food.

The shrimp come in various price ranges, and they are all fresh.

The food doesn't take long to arrive, whether it's the grilled shrimp or other dishes ordered; everything comes quickly. The seafood dipping sauce is flavorful and not too sweet.

Another recommended dish is the fried sea bass with fish sauce. The fish isn't oily at all, it's large, reasonably priced, and crispy on the outside but the inside isn't dry.

Terrible experience. I ordered 1 kg of shrimp to take home, ungrilled, for 480 baht.

If you're thinking of buying from them, I recommend bringing your own scale.

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a coffee shop during the day and a chill hangout spot at night. The food is delicious, especially the pork with lime sauce and the chicken with lime sauce – the chicken is crispy and the lime sauce is perfectly balanced with a sweet and sour flavor. The pizza is also cheesy and generously portioned. The prices aren't too expensive, the atmosphere is great, and the staff provides good service. While the food takes a while to prepare, it's not excessively long. There's plenty of parking, and it's easy to find a spot. There's a car wash next door, so you can leave your car there while you wait.
sample_reviews_en.author: GengKK

sample_reviews_en.text: A cafe and bistro in Soi Yothin Phatthana, along the Ekkamai-Ramintra Expressway. The shop is decorated in green tones. In the morning, the shop is a cafe selling coffee. At night, it becomes a bar. Food starts at 120 baht per dish, which is not expensive at all. The spaghetti was tasty, but the crispy chicken with lemon sauce was very delicious. The lemon that was added was also good. At night, there is a DJ. There is plenty of parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffey

The shop is located on the expressway, in the alley opposite Central East Ville.

- Clean restrooms.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This roadside noodle shop seems easy to find, but it's not impossible. It's next to a Lotus store, which also has a newly opened Amazon cafe. I'm deducting points for the parking; the road is very unpaved and the entrance is extremely narrow. I'm worried about nails, glass shards, or other debris potentially damaging car tires. Motorcycles are also parked haphazardly.

Food: The taste is good and the price is reasonable. We ordered beef, pork, and seafood options.

We ordered the clear broth version. The beef was good, with tripe. We also had the tom yum seafood, which included bouncy pork. The tom yum was good and didn't need any extra seasoning. The chili powder was very spicy. They also have grilled meatballs, pork cracklings, and desserts like lod chong (not included, but seen on the sign) and various sweet drinks.

Service: Fast and attentive.

Atmosphere: The shop is spacious with plenty of seating. It's busy, but the air circulation is poor, making it hot. I'm deducting points for that. Given the high volume of customers, the shop should consider a system to mist the roof to make it cooler.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sabine Kim

sample_reviews_en.text: The large hot pot is inexpensive and the portion is generous, but it's extremely salty. So salty my mouth felt numb. We've eaten here many times before, but this time was saltier than ever. The price is reasonable, though. The restaurant is next to Lotus, somewhat out of sight. There's plenty of parking, but the road is quite bumpy, so drive carefully.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ai Npprn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Easy-to-eat roadside boat noodles.

The flavor is average, but you might need to add a bit more seasoning. They have a wide selection of appetizers. The staff are friendly and helpful. There's parking, but it's not very large. If you come at lunchtime, it might be a bit hot.
sample_reviews_en.author: mmeimeii

sample_reviews_en.text: Very delicious. Thick soup. The beef soup has a beefy aroma. No need to season. We just added chili. Normal 20, special 40. We ordered 2 bowls of normal. We got a lot. It was just enough for a woman to eat. The amount per bowl is a lot. We …
sample_reviews_en.author: Nonounz

sample_reviews_en.text: Boat noodles are tasty. Small bowls start at 20 baht. They give a lot. If you want to take it home, it starts at 40 baht. They also have tom yum noodles, which are tasty as well (with pork and beef). There is parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: jeab srimart

sample_reviews_en.text: On May 29th, 2024, I went to eat with two friends. I ordered three regular bowls of boat noodles, and my friend ordered one special bowl. We also had pork cracklings, one Coke, and one bottle of water. …
sample_reviews_en.author: orawan nantamanoon

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but the restaurant sign is located at the right turn after exiting Lotus, making it impossible to see the road. Moving it a little would be great. 🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: อัจจิมา วงค์เขน

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food, great taste, affordable prices, lots of snacks available, and shared outdoor parking available for several shops.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warinphorn Sawangphong

restaurants.name: Swensen's Central Rattanathibet
restaurants.address:

68/100 เซ็นทรัล รัตนาธิเบศร์ ชั้น 3, Rattanathibet Rd, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered a birthday cake, and the shop said they had a promotion to write "Happy Birthday" on the recipient's name. I initially thought they would write it on the cake, but when it arrived, I saw a pre-made sign on top. At first, I thought, "Okay, no problem, they'll probably make a separate printed card with the name on it."
But it turned out the employee grabbed a pre-cut A4 sheet of paper and wrote it by hand!
That's Swensen's' card-writing promotion, lol.
I'm giving it 3 stars because the ice cream cake was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: M P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a nice dessert stop at Swensen’s at Central Rattanathibet. 🍨

A great place for a casual break, especially if you’re looking for something sweet after shopping or a meal. The ice cream was creamy and enjoyable, with plenty of toppings and dessert options to choose from. The atmosphere was relaxed and comfortable, making it easy to sit back and enjoy.

Overall, a pleasant Swensen’s experience with good desserts and friendly service. Definitely a nice spot for ice cream with family or friends. 🍦
sample_reviews_en.author: Wisanu Tuntawiroon

sample_reviews_en.text:
My favorite ice cream flavor is still as delicious as ever ☺️

The new shop in Northville is quite small and cramped, suitable for 2-4 people (there's only one large table for 6-7 people). The tables are also very close together, so you're practically in close proximity to people walking past while you're eating. It's near Bonchon, so if you sit close together, you'll smell the chicken. All of this is just to say that the atmosphere makes enjoying the ice cream less enjoyable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Parntor Prarinda

sample_reviews_en.text: This Swensen's branch is packed with customers during the day and evening. It's especially popular with children, who flock there because it's on the third floor, the same floor as the children's playground and movie theater. There's plenty of seating, so it's not crowded, but the restaurant is packed with young customers. The staff provides excellent service and attention to customers. New menu items are always available at Swensen's.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tooh Local Insights

sample_reviews_en.text: Free 3 hour parking.  The parking in the front of the mall has very small spaces so park upstairs where the spaces are wider. Swensen’s is on the top level next to the bathrooms.  Waitresses can speak English.  Look for the promotions to save a few baht. They have Rocky Road flavored ice cream.  We celebrated a birthday in December 2023 and bought an ice cream cake and they put candles in the cake, sliced it, and sang for us!
sample_reviews_en.author: Asa Mizoi

sample_reviews_en.text: I used a Lazada coupon and the service was excellent. There was no queue at all, which was great because there weren't many people. The food was served very quickly. The restaurant was clean and the staff didn't intrude or bother us. I understand they provide good service, but I liked that it was very private.
sample_reviews_en.author: Freeze Kiwii

sample_reviews_en.text: The new shop is on the second floor, opposite Ootoya. It's a small shop but always crowded. The staff provides good service. The ice cream is still delicious, but it feels like the portions have decreased; the scoops are smaller.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakkarddd

sample_reviews_en.text:
💞Welcome to Valentine's Day🥰
With our Valentine's menu: Strawberry Overload Fancy and Strawberry Bunny Sundae Cup.
✅️Delicious in true Swensen's style.
✅️This branch is clean.
✅️Good service from the staff.
✅️Friendly and polite.
sample_reviews_en.author: Choki Choki

restaurants.name: แปดริ้วโภชณา (เฮียรมณ์)
restaurants.address:

660, 2 Soi Pracha Rat Bamphen 26 Yaek 12, Samsen Nok, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Stir-fried morning glory with crispy pork over rice, minced pork omelet, and stir-fried basil with pork, squid, and shrimp over rice were all delicious and the portions were very generous. The jungle curry with chicken was also huge but a bit bland for my taste. Overall, I'd give it an 8/10. I'll definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nalinrut Pobay (ibew)

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, the portions are large, the prices are friendly, and in these economic times, this place is a true haven of friendship.
The owners are incredibly lovely and attentive, and everything is run by the family. Parking is a little difficult as it's in a residential area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasi Noina

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop also has a battery boiling shop called "Hia Lom". The price is not expensive. The food is delicious. The spicy gourami salad is good. I recommend you come and try it. The shop is not very big. There are two or three tables to sit at. The price is not expensive. It's okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: ฐิติพงษ์ หิรัญรำไพ

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is so delicious. The owner and the owner are so kind. The cat is so big, lol. It's become a regular at this restaurant. I recommend you come and try it. You can also order delivery. I really want you to come and try it. It's a very family-friendly restaurant. ❤️🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: tinner 90ś

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a small restaurant made in a home with only 1-2 tables. People like to buy food to take home. The price is cheap, the food tastes good, and the ingredients are really fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: พักร้อน ออนทริป

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my go-to restaurant. The owner and husband are very kind, the food is delicious, and the portions are generous. It's great value for money! Guaranteed delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Cutety sweet Natty

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, lots of food, quick to make, but you have to order from the menu, they don't usually make a la carte. Awesome!!! Recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: หารชัย สังวรกิจธรรม

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and tasty. Many locals order their takeout from here, especially their Tom Yam and mince pork with Thai basil.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeremy Koh

restaurants.name: หล่อเด็ดก๋วยเตี๋ยวต้มยำสุโขทัย
restaurants.address:

100 Soi Samran Rat, Samran Rat, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in Soi Pratu Phi, found through a TikTok video about a filial piety.

There's parking available at the temple and other paid parking areas nearby, but no parking at the restaurant itself. It gets quite busy at lunchtime, but the food comes out quickly, and the table turnover is manageable.

The menu features Sukhothai Tom Yum Noodles with a full selection of noodle types.
- The taste is delicious, the portion is generous, the lime is authentically fresh, and the toppings are plentiful.
- The liver is soft, not tough or gamey.
- The intestines are soft, not smelly, chewy, or bitter (excellent!).
- There's plenty of pork, and they even include crispy pork cracklings.
- The long beans are added in just the right amount, not too many, and perfectly crunchy.

Overall, it's excellent. The quantity, taste, cleanliness, and price are "extremely good value." It's not just a must-try; it could easily become your regular spot.

** Unlimited self-serve crispy wontons.
** Extra pork cracklings are 20 baht, and not greasy.

The owner (a woman) is fun to talk to, friendly, and lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: NJ Story

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant started by making Sukhothai-style noodles with a spicier flavor (without MSG). Those who like spicy and sour flavors can ask for lime or add chili powder. For the Tom Yum noodles, I recommend ordering one bowl of soup and one bowl of dry noodles. The noodles here are quite thin and have a good texture. A recommended appetizer while waiting for your noodles is the fried pork belly, which the restaurant uses cuts with less fat. It tastes really good and costs 50 baht per plate (100 grams).
The restaurant is open until about 2 PM, and most items are sold out. Even at lunchtime, some items start to run out. I recommend reserving a table. I saw some tables that only seat 4 people, but people were willing to squeeze 7 people in to get a table because the tables were full (there aren't many tables in the restaurant).
sample_reviews_en.author: Kosit Boonroungkaw

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't usually write reviews here, but I really have to give this one a try. I found it by chance and smelled the delicious aroma, so I decided to give it a try. It turned out to be incredibly delicious. It's the traditional, authentic taste of tom yum noodles, meaning you don't need to add any seasoning at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supakrit Nunpakdee

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious tom yum! We were tourists in the area and the owner was so helpful as we couldn't speak or read thai, as the menu was in Thai. The broth was clean but also so tasty. Noodles were perfectly cooked! The menu is limited and focuses on tom yum so good try if you're a fan.
sample_reviews_en.author: Melissa

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious, the restaurant was very clean and tidy, the service was excellent, and the experience was fantastic. It was also very cheap, only 60 baht per serving. The sweet, sour, and spicy flavor was the best I had during my 6 days in Thailand.
sample_reviews_en.author: 朱秀雨

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious! The spicy salad was perfect, with a balanced sweet, sour, and spicy flavor.
It's a small, single-room shop with limited seating. It's usually full at lunchtime.
sample_reviews_en.author: Billy Than

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had Tom Yum mixed noodles. You can choose from several types of noodles.

Delicious! The flavor was enjoyable until the very last bite.

The restaurant is clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ri Kk

sample_reviews_en.text: Sukhothai Tom Yum Noodles are delicious, no need to add seasoning, both soup and dry. The portion is large, just right, and the price is reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Raksak Rakdech

restaurants.name: อาหารป่า ศาลากลาง Exotic Restaurant
restaurants.address:

126 100 Soi Wat Mai Phadungkhet, Sala Klang, Bang Kruai District, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This wild game restaurant offers flavorful and spicy dishes at good prices.
I tried four dishes and was impressed with all of them. It's a shame that several of the special meats (crocodile, rabbit, field rat) were sold out the day I went.

Tom Yum Pla Kang (Spicy Fish Soup): 5/5
The fish wasn't fishy at all; it was well-prepared. The tom yum flavor was perfectly sour with a full complement of herbs.

Spicy Stir-fried Wild Boar: 5/5
The curry paste and herbs were very generous.
It's best eaten hot; it gets saltier when it cools down.

Ostrich with Black Pepper: 3/5
The flavor was mild, not overly peppery.
I'd rate this one as average.

Fried Quail with Garlic: 5/5
Simple but delicious. Quail is naturally fragrant.
sample_reviews_en.author: animal eat thing

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've passed by many times but never stopped.
Today I decided to give it a try.
The restaurant is located next to a bridge over the canal.

The menu has a wide variety of flavors.
I ordered four dishes:
Spicy Stir-fried Venison
Spicy Stir-fried Catfish
Tom Yum Soup with Pangasius Fish

You'll have to wait a bit after ordering,
because there's only one cook.

The food I ordered was delicious; every dish was great.

If you're passing by, stop in and give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: อาร์ม อินชัวร์

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a relatively small restaurant with limited seating, but the taste and variety of food are quite interesting (especially for those who enjoy spicy food). The menu features wild game meats such as crocodile, soft-shell turtle, ostrich, frog, deer, etc. The service is casual and informal. They offer alcoholic beverages, soft drinks, and water. Parking might be a bit limited, but it shouldn't be a problem as the restaurant will likely manage it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phalatt Phonwetamnuai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered stir-fried wild boar with chili, stir-fried bird with chili, and deep-fried pork belly with fish sauce.
I also had braised beef. Everything was delicious, not too sweet, which I really liked.
The stir-fried chili dishes were perfectly balanced, not too salty and not too sweet.

It can get a bit hot in the afternoon.

I highly recommend this place; it's one of the best restaurants in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nudd A.

sample_reviews_en.text: All the food was delicious. They have wild game dishes that are incredibly flavorful and spicy. The prices are reasonable, and the portions are generous for the price. The music was nice, and the atmosphere was great with plenty of shade from the trees.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภรภัทร สายพุ่ม

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food at reasonable prices, with bold flavors.
A small restaurant that focuses on taste rather than ambiance.
Spicy stir-fried catfish.
Jungle curry with beef...the beef is tender and not chewy at all!
sample_reviews_en.author: กิตติศักดิ์ นิ่้มอุดมสุข

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop opens at 11:30 AM, but we arrived at 10:00 AM according to what's written on Google Maps. The owner should correct the time. We wasted our time traveling there and got hungry. Very annoying.
sample_reviews_en.author: pitchaporn prukratsameepong

sample_reviews_en.text: The flavors are excellent, rich and delicious. For those who like clear tom yum soup, I highly recommend it – it's a real gem. The fried pork ribs and spicy wild boar stir-fry are also tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: excudo69
