sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is totally not authentic, i wouldn’t call it as korean food as I was living in Korea for quite a while now, i don’t know why on google it has this high ratings, i went it here because of the ratings. Service also terrible, especially the big lady, i think she is the manager or sth. Atmosphere is not that comfortable, furnitures and styles are wired for korean food.
There are bunch of choices in Thonglor for authentic korean food, but not this one.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aggie Zhang

sample_reviews_en.text: The worst Korean restaurant ever since I live in Bangkok last 30 yrs. The bibimbop was cold and doesn’t look like at all the photo of the menu and the service was so lousy and the serving lady wears like pyjama and 2 nd dish they forgot to order… and the sparking water was 230 baht + 17 % , at least the water was good !! And zero side dish!!  Good luck for them !
sample_reviews_en.author: Miwha Shin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hmmmm?

This is the first time I've ever had such strange udon noodles 😅
Flour? What's the base ingredient?

The jeon (Korean pancake) was more like okonomiyaki. It had absolutely no crispiness...
The staff were actually very kind and wonderful, but I wouldn't say the food was good.
I'm puzzled why the reviews are so high 😱
sample_reviews_en.author: きいち

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, rice cooked just right.  Even the cold rice is still delicious.  The sauce has just the right amount of sweet and salty taste. The fried chicken is crispy and not hard. The chicken meat is not dry. When eaten with rice, it fits perfectly together ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: Gu is J

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere was great, and the staff and owner were friendly and helpful.
I had a great time.
It's especially good for those who arrive early in the morning and are hungry.
They're open until 4 a.m., so
I recommend calling ahead.
sample_reviews_en.author: 오승한

sample_reviews_en.text:
the soy garlic fried chicken is delicious. the sauce is so tasty 😋

this is probably my favorite korean fried chicken in BKK. best part is that the chicken is boneless, so no getting your hands dirty! …
sample_reviews_en.author: david

sample_reviews_en.text: Speaking honestly, the fried chicken is the best. I'd give it number one, top marks. The service is very fast and the atmosphere is great, perfect for a date or a party. It's a hidden gem in Thonglor.
sample_reviews_en.author: APINAN KHUANTANG

sample_reviews_en.text: Just come without hesitation because it's absolutely amazing, every dish is delicious, and the music is top-notch. Great food, fantastic atmosphere, so good, last go go new, so yummy, you come!
sample_reviews_en.author: 01ชลธี ครองสิงห์

restaurants.name: Mae Sri Ruen (HomePro Kanlapaphruek)
restaurants.address:

194 ถนน กัลปพฤกษ์ Bang Wa, Phasi Charoen, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Horrible staff treatment!!!
I went to the restaurant แม่ศรีเรือน at HomePro on Sunday 9 January around 5pm. The staff waitress in front of the kitchen acted rude, unprofessional and childish firm. Instead of taking care of the tables, one of the waiters, a thin boy with glasses began to stretch his legs exercising in front of the kitchen door, when he saw that I was looking at him then he and the other waitress girl began to laugh uproariously and look at me above a screen that separates the dining room from the kitchen.  In addition to making continue making comments and pointing at me.  A completely unacceptable stupid attitude. It is not a linguistic problem because I could see perfectly how they acted.  I hope the company takes appropriate action against these workers.
sample_reviews_th.author: JD F

sample_reviews_en.text: I've never actually eaten at the restaurant, only ordered food through the app. They ran out of something and wouldn't take it out of the menu, then called to ask me to change it. That was outrageous. At first, I was going to let it go, but then the restaurant called today – probably a wrong number. They called saying they were going to give me something for free. I was confused; they couldn't understand what I was saying, and then they hung up after I asked several questions. It was frustrating. They were careless, couldn't resolve the problem properly, and the food wasn't even good. Don't call me again.
sample_reviews_en.author: YY_杨洋

sample_reviews_en.text: Chicken noodles are not delicious. Can't compete with bitter melon chicken noodles from a street stall. For other dishes, I ordered fried oysters and waited a very long time. It took about 40 minutes. They claimed they were made in different kitchens. The first time I followed up, they said they were already made. I had to wait another ten minutes. The second and third times, if they had told me from the first time that they weren't made yet, it would have been better. They understood. But they forced me to wait just to sell things.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supachai La-ongjan

sample_reviews_en.text: I once bought Khanom Jeen Sao Nam (rice noodles with coconut milk sauce) to take home. Did you know I got one spoonful of pineapple, one thin slice of ginger (about half an inch by half an inch), and one chopped chili? The noodles were okay, the coconut milk was slightly sweet, and the minced shrimp was added. When mixed together, it was completely unbalanced. You need to fix that. The price was 170 baht. I definitely won't buy it again. The fresh spring rolls were okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pasana Pasana

sample_reviews_en.text:
#VegetarianFood at Mae Sri Ruean
Vegetarian menu available until October 29, 2025

Today we had vegetarian Pad Thai, vegetarian green curry noodles, vegetarian fresh spring rolls, and vegetarian sago with mushrooms.

✨ Everything was delicious. I personally loved the green curry, which was fragrant with spices and medium spicy.

And the sago with mushrooms was chewy and delicious.

#TryIt #longkindooz #VegetarianFood #EatVegetarian
sample_reviews_en.author: Punnaporn Siriviriya

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been to this restaurant quite often. Today, I went with my parents and ordered three dishes. I couldn't eat any of them. It was really bad. If it were a cheap restaurant, it wouldn't matter, but each dish would cost almost 200 baht. But the taste is so bad that a dog wouldn't eat it. I was so disappointed. I spent 1000 baht but felt like I got food for about 150 baht. I can definitely say that I won't come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chey “Hegemon” Che

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually eat chicken noodle soup with soft, slippery noodles. Today I ordered fried rice with dried fish, and it passed the test, it was decent. I finished with original style kanom krok (Thai coconut pudding). The staff were lovely and attentive, but the portion seemed a bit small. The price seemed slightly higher than average, but otherwise, everything was okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ban Vachala

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every time I come, the food and desserts are always satisfying.
Most recently, I ate here and forgot some things I bought from HomePro on the table.
I realized this and returned just as the restaurant was about to close.
The staff had kept the forgotten items for me.
I would like to express my sincere gratitude.
sample_reviews_en.author: arch d.

restaurants.name: Wine Connection @ True Digital Park
restaurants.address:

101/1 Sukhumvit Rd, Khwaeng Bang Chak, Khet Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm giving this place 1 star because of the terrible lunch service. I ate there on a weekday, and there were only 3 tables occupied in the entire restaurant. Around 12:30 PM, almost everyone at my table ordered the same lunch set, which should have been quick to prepare. However, the food didn't arrive until around 1:00 PM – a wait of over 45 minutes! There was no apology or explanation from the staff. When the food was finally ready, the kitchen staff rang a bell for about 5 minutes, and the 4-5 serving staff that were supposed to be there disappeared completely. I waited to see how they would resolve the issue. The kitchen staff seemed completely uninterested in getting the food out, even though customers had been waiting for a very long time. I had to get up and ask if I needed to serve the food myself before they would move. How dare they charge a 10% service fee? The entire service staff seemed completely unenthusiastic and uncaring towards customers, severely damaging the brand's reputation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pond Punyaneramitdee

sample_reviews_en.text:
I really like this restaurant — it’s close to my home, which is very convenient, and the food has always been delicious. From our first visit, I loved that they offered sangria. Back then it was a special item on a separate menu, and later it was added to the main menu, which made me very happy.

However, for the past three weeks, every time we visit, the sangria is unavailable. It’s disappointing, especially since it’s something we always look forward to.

Another thing that has been surprising is that the ceiling near one of the tables has not been fixed for these same three weeks. There is still a warning sign about the issue, and it really affects the overall atmosphere.

Also, there is no clear information that alcohol cannot be served between 2 pm and 5 pm. For a wine-focused restaurant, this is something that should be communicated clearly.

I hope these issues can be resolved soon, because this place has great potential and we used to enjoy it a lot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charlie

sample_reviews_en.text:
Well our experience has a customer was alright , we were four of us eating there. We ordered two bottles of wine, one mix cold cut. We had a total bill of 2600 thb . We asked for the bill when we were still outside on the terrace but 20 minutes before asking the bill the road works inside the True Digital park started and become very annoying as they were drilling the ground. It was reaching a very noisy level that was hard to cope with. Therefore we decided to move inside the restaurant to avoid the noise and get some fresh air. Once we were sitting inside the so called Manager came to our table and said that we had to sit outside if we wanted to continue drinking.  We explained her our issue and she raised her shoulders and hands to the sky and said that we had only 5 minutes to stay inside or else we had to evacuate to the terrace.
Overall experience was very poor compared to all branches where we went till now .
sample_reviews_en.author: Mostque Karim

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm here just to enjoy some wines that are not found in regular bars but apparently they do not carry a wide range. they don't carry Lambrusco which is pretty basic red sparkling slightly sweet wine. when i asked if they do, the staff brought me another red wine, hence i know instantly they don't have any wine knowledge. so I went for my 2nd choice, prosecco. out of the 4 on the menu, 2 of which are  out of stock. i have to settle for something i don't quite like, but since I'm already here with my gf, i shall oblige. Then the relatively new staff was struggling to open the bottle.... another downside is the aircon is not working and it's humid and hot inside which is not ideal given bangkok's weather. so overall i won't be back again as its a hot & sweaty experience.  not forgetting i settled for a 4th choice of drink on a Saturday night.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gray

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited Wine Connection specifically for dessert and ordered only the Choco Lava. It was served cold and completely hard.

I asked the staff to heat it up. The waitress apologized and brought back the same cake, but it was still hard in the center and clearly not properly warmed.

I explained the issue again, and she apologized once more and took the dessert back. The third time, the cake was finally heated correctly, but they had reheated it together with the ice cream. The plate arrived with the ice cream melted and mixed around the dessert.

What disappointed me most was not the initial mistake, but the fact that it took three attempts to serve a simple lava cake properly. I used to enjoy ordering this dessert at Wine Connection in Phuket, so this visit was a real disappointment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maria Yi

sample_reviews_en.text: As a westerner that grew up around excellent Italian food in the mid Ohio valley Region of the US I have to say this place may have the best food I’ve found in Bangkok yet.  I’m a picky foodie that knows what I like and this place DELIVERS.  We ordered all kinds of stuff and everything was super good.  Mushroom Soup, excellent. Bruschetta, 8.5/10.  Margarita Pizza, best I’ve had in Bangkok, Chicken parm, not a traditional smashed cutlet but the breast was seasoned and cooked well and it tasted better than many restaurants back home can do.  Thai gf ordered a few fusion dishes also, and they were very good also.  I look forward to going back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason Couture

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my first time here. I had one of the set lunch options, the steak and cheese sandwich. The steak was done just right with onions and red pepper and there was plenty of cheese as well. It comes with a soup, I had the mushroom it was very good, you can see and taste it was made from fresh mushrooms. For the drink I had the fresh lime soda. It was not that busy so the environment was very relaxed. Overall the service was efficient and I got my order very quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuklc Yuklc

sample_reviews_en.text:
Friendly service, good menu with great value dining choices for fish and meat lovers..  something for the sweet tooth, too... a great wine and beer selection to pick from.  Food service happens soon after the order, and for early Sunday evening, it wasn't  crowded at all.  Upbeat music adds to the atmosphere...   recommended for families or people on a moderate budget looking for a great meal.

Thumbs up and smiles all the way!
sample_reviews_en.author: B. F. G.

restaurants.name: Mixer Riverside
restaurants.address:

ตลาด, 456 ถ Sri Kuankan, Song Khanong, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered chicken tendons, stir-fried squid with salted egg, mixed tom yum soup, and spicy stir-fried wild boar.
I waited a very long time, about 40 minutes.
The appetizers should have come first, but the stir-fried squid with salted egg came first, after I had already finished one plate of rice. The tom yum soup only arrived then. A while later, the chicken tendons came, and then I sat waiting for the spicy stir-fried wild boar, which I really wanted to eat. In the end, it didn't come. Tables that came after me already had 3 dishes served. I asked the staff if their food was ready, as I was already full. Turns out they hadn't made mine yet, so I canceled that order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sorry Eiei

sample_reviews_en.text:
Brief Review
Food - Overall okay.

It's both a noodle shop and offers a wide variety of dishes.
Many menu options including Tom Yum, salads, fried foods, snacks, etc.

Atmosphere - Offers a view of the river and the Bhumibol Bridge.
It's likely to be crowded in the evenings because it's right by the river with a view of the bridge. The restaurant has live music on Fridays and Saturdays. The staff suggested calling to reserve a table because the riverside seats are usually full. I'll try to get a seat there sometime.

Luckily, during low tide in the daytime, you might even see otters. They don't usually show themselves.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krit Santi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food ordered took an hour to arrive. There were only 4 tables of guests.
The menu included: 1. Sea bass 2. Winged bean salad 3. Crispy catfish salad 4. Seafood hot pot 5. Sun-dried pork 6. Grilled pork neck 7. Clear soup 8. Wild boar stir-fry 9. Sweet-tasting dishes 10. Stir-fried vegetables (cancelled). All dishes were very sweet. The staff's facial expressions showed their unwillingness. The food bill was 16xx, and the drinks bill, including beverages, was 2xxx.
For your information, this restaurant is more suitable for drinks than for a meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yardnapa Bureechai

sample_reviews_en.text: The price and quality are completely mismatched. The food is awful, overpriced, and the portions are small. Everything is expensive. I wouldn't mind if it were delicious, but it's terrible despite being expensive. The bill was messed up; they included food I didn't order and charged me for it. There was still half a bucket of ice left, but they threw it away and refilled it. They're so pushy with their sales. Terrible experience. When will this place go bankrupt?
sample_reviews_en.author: เทส โมบาย

sample_reviews_en.text: My favorite place, so many stories. The owner and his mom are kind, the service is great. The clear beef noodle soup is fragrant and delicious. The stewed beef and tendon, the Cowboy stew is the best! Drinks, music, and atmosphere – it's all here. This is the best place for my gang. I'm impressed with the amazing bridge views and all the moments that happened here. This is a special place: good food, good mood, good music.
sample_reviews_en.author: Coco nco

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant under the bridge by the river has a great atmosphere and delicious food.

The German pork knuckle takes a while to prepare, but it's crispy and delicious, while the meat is very tender. The salted fried pork belly, chicken feet soup, and beef stew are all excellent.

The atmosphere is pleasant with a cool breeze, live music, and the staff provides excellent service, always attentive to customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Icecoolice

sample_reviews_en.text: The food needs improvement; it's too sweet. The food was served extremely slowly, taking an hour, even though there were only 3 tables occupied. The service staff were also unfriendly and made disgusted faces. This is the service I received.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิภาดา บุรีชัย

sample_reviews_en.text: Beef lovers rejoice! The Chef really knows his beef dishes, (no steak) but the best, braised, stewed and sautéed Beef ever in BKK I promise! Located right on the Chao Phraya, almost under the bridge which is illuminated in the evening and …
sample_reviews_en.author: Ian Hawkes

restaurants.name: Jay Sri, the owner of water mimosa salad
restaurants.address:

653 Banthat Thong Rd, Khwaeng Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a popular restaurant with a lot of teenagers. The first floor is a bit hot, so I recommend going upstairs to the air-conditioned room on the second floor.
The food is delicious, a little pricey, but the quality and cooking skills are excellent. My regular order is the boiled cockles; they even shuck them for you, and the cockles are huge! All the other à la carte dishes are delicious. Don't forget their amazing water spinach salad, although I usually order the stir-fried water spinach with chili.
Next time I go, I'll write a detailed review with pictures!
/////////////
I've been here many times already, and I was so hungry I forgot to take pictures!
I remembered today, so here's an update.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bamroung Tangsanga

sample_reviews_en.text:
My last meal before boarding the plane. Initially, I saw a long queue at a nearby restaurant and didn't want to wait, but this place looked pretty good, so I went in.

The price wasn't cheap, but it was acceptable. The coconut was huge and the drink was delicious.

I ordered several dishes, including lobster. The only downside was that it took quite a while to arrive, almost fifty minutes. Otherwise, the meal would have been perfect.

The staff were friendly, the food was all pretty good, and the seafood was fresh!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jenny Wu

sample_reviews_en.text: A perfect combination of deliciousness for two people, 5 dishes in total. The blanched cockles were large, fresh, and very sweet. The steamed mussels were amazing – I don't know where the owner gets them from, but they were huge! The glass noodle casserole had plump, large shrimp. The water spinach salad used tender shoots and had the usual perfectly balanced flavor. And the steamed egg custard – a simple dish, but we really wanted to eat it! The total for this meal was 750 baht. Filling, delicious, and worth it!
sample_reviews_en.author: S.Kidsanar แบกพุงไปกิน

sample_reviews_en.text:
Krua Jae Sri, a roadside restaurant opposite the Government Savings Bank in the Stadium One project, focuses on fresh ingredients.
For example, they focus on tender water mimosa shoots, or cockles.
This restaurant focuses on large, reasonably priced seafood dishes served with a spicy seafood dipping sauce. My favorite dishes are the creamy Tom Yum Goong soup and the grilled pork with jaew sauce. We recommend sitting on the air-conditioned upper floor. Parking is available at the Stadium One project.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sombat Honghem

sample_reviews_en.text:
Disappointed! Overpriced.
If they're famous for their water spinach salad, it should be better. A hundred baht for a plate is awful. The boiled clams were cold. The stir-fried dishes were okay, nothing outstanding. I ordered four dishes and none of them were good. The only downside was that the food came quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mairu Monk

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fried fish with fish sauce here is the best, 10/10, no deductions.
The blanched cockles are large and reasonably priced.
The Tom Yum soup has a well-balanced and good flavor.

Just a minor complaint: the crab dishes are a bit pricey.
But overall, I'll definitely be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark K

sample_reviews_en.text:
Water mimosa lover could not miss!
If you don’t know what’s the water mimosa, you can search on Google and you will see how it looks ugly veggie. But! It’s very delicious if you wanna try Spicy Thai style salad.
The cockle is fresh and good with the seafood sauce. Others so so.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alissa Right

sample_reviews_en.text: It's near Rama 1 Lotus. Everything I ate was delicious. The prices are local. It's mostly filled with Thai customers, but the restaurant has a surprisingly large capacity, so I didn't have to wait. The food comes out incredibly fast.
sample_reviews_en.author: 雨露市徳雄

restaurants.name: TONG TONG HAAN (통통한) ตงตงฮัน สาขา กัลปพฤกษ์ KANLAPAPHRUEK
restaurants.address:

MCXR+MR6 ถนน กัลปพฤกษ์ Bang Khun Thian, Chom Thong, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
This restaurant has a Korean drama feel to it. It's clean, there are quite a few staff members providing attentive service, and they accept credit cards. There's parking behind the restaurant.

The food is of standard taste.
The tteokbokki and egg fish cake were a bit overcooked and mushy for my liking, but the tteok was soft and sweet.
The pork bulgogi was served hot, rich, and slightly spicy. I liked this dish more.

They have a large menu, including pre-made BBQ items and various ramen dishes.
Personally, I think the prices are a bit high, but it's worth it for the atmosphere during a special occasion.

These two dishes cost around 400฿.
sample_reviews_th.author: Sudarat Burana

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is another restaurant that always comes to mind when I want Korean food. The prices are reasonable, and the atmosphere is like a traditional Korean tent. There's plenty of seating, perfect for a relaxed and comfortable meal. The staff provides good service, and there's some parking available next to the restaurant. I'll review each item individually.

Budae Jjigae (250 baht) - Lots of ingredients, perfect for two people to share and feel full. They provide the stew paste separately for you to add yourself. You can add as much as you like for a spicier, richer flavor. However, it's quite hard and doesn't break down easily when cooked in the pot, making it a bit difficult.

Cheese Tteokbokki (120 baht) - Delicious again! The rice cakes are thick and soft, and the broth is rich and just the right amount of spicy. It's amazing with kimchi!

Kimchi (50 baht) - The kimchi is good; perfectly sour, spicy, and salty. It's a shame they didn't give me more! 😂
sample_reviews_en.author: beammykakz

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is similar to a Korean dance hall. There's parking next to the restaurant, but it can be a bit difficult to get in and out because there's a lot of traffic on this road.

The Korean food menu has a decent selection. I ordered:
- Korean BBQ grilled beef/pork, ready to eat, with grilled vegetables and garlic (8/10) 320.-
- Kimchi soup with soft tofu, hot pot (8/10) 170.-
- Japchae (9/10) 130.-
- Honey Garlic fried chicken wings (7/10) a bit sweet 120.-
- Budaejjigae, Korean hot pot (8/10) 250.-
- Sweet and spicy fried chicken wings (7/10) not spicy, slightly sweet 155.-

The restaurant has air conditioning and convenient parking. The interior isn't very spacious, but it's not cramped. It has a nice Korean vibe. Give it a try!

#BoomTheerRecommendation #BoomTheer #FoodReview #Korean #DanceHall
sample_reviews_en.author: บูมธีร‘ - BoomThee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Red Tent Korean Restaurant

Prices are reasonable for the portion sizes.

- Sweet and Spicy Fried Chicken Wings (They were out of drumsticks when I went, so disappointing 🥲): Sweet in taste, with a slight burnt smell.

- GG7 Set: Korean-style grilled sliced ​​pork belly: The pork belly wasn't tough, the strips were long, the taste was delicious, and there was more than expected.

- Korean Hot Pot: The taste was okay, but the gochujang sauce was quite bland, making the soup not very flavorful.

- Takoyaki with Wasabi: Delicious as expected, and a generous portion.

- Fried Chicken Wings: Very delicious, crispy, and not chewy. Highly recommend ordering this! The portion is so large I wondered when it would ever be finished 😂
sample_reviews_en.author: SAKONWAN Su

sample_reviews_en.text: The price is quite high compared to the quality and there is also +vat7% on top of the menu. We ordered grilled pork, it was a grilled set, sweet, oily, and greasy. There were no side dishes like kimchi like in Korean barbecue restaurants. Customers who want to eat must order more, each one is 50 baht. The tteokbokki tasted normal, but the worst thing was the kimchi soup. It didn't have a strong kimchi flavor at all. It was bland like diluted soup and didn't have a sour taste. I don't know if this is the restaurant's recipe or a mistake. I want the restaurant to improve the quality of the food because the staff provided good service and the atmosphere was nice to sit in.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chavit K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Korean street food style restaurant.
The staff provided excellent service, offering recommendations and attentive care.
Food prices are moderate.
Alcoholic drinks might be a little pricey.
Ramyun: Delicious, thick, and flavorful soup. Good portion of meat and vegetables for 3-4 people.
Sweet and Spicy Fried Chicken: Good flavor, crispy skin, and well-marinated.
Sesame Oil Jellyfish: Very delicious, with a crunchy texture.
Grilled Marinated Pork Belly: Very delicious, well-marinated, and the side vegetables are grilled perfectly. Suitable for 2 people.
Kimchi: Side dish, a bit sweet, lacking a little sourness.
Overall, delicious and highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aun Kato

sample_reviews_en.text: This Korean street food restaurant is located in a red tent on Kanlapaphruek Road. There's parking right next to the shop. Inside, it's air-conditioned and comfortable. That night, I was craving Korean food at 10 PM, and this place closes at midnight, so I decided to try it. The food was delicious! The grilled pork set was pre-grilled, as they said. The jumeokbap was served unmixed; you have to put on gloves and mix it yourself. I personally don't like spicy food, and this kimchi soup was quite spicy for me, but it was tasty and served piping hot in the pot. I think this is a great place for a late-night meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Beamm wp

sample_reviews_en.text:
The grilled meat tasted good and was already grilled. The air conditioning wasn't very cool the day I went, so the restaurant had fans on to help keep the meat warm for a while, which was good. Another dish was Korean pork rib soup. It wasn't as spicy as the regular spicy pork rib soup, but the large pieces of pork loin were delicious. However, it can get a bit greasy if you eat a lot. The prices weren't expensive.
There's parking at the back, it's a bit dark, but there's someone watching over it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anirut Pattaragarn

restaurants.name: Shell
restaurants.address:

100 Ramkhamhaeng Rd, Khwaeng Saphan Sung, Khet Saphan Sung, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The restrooms look nice and clean, and the area is spacious, but there aren't enough parking spaces. This might be because there are only a few shops nearby: Muang Thong Crab Fried Rice restaurant, Delicafe, and a 24-hour car service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phanomwet Sriarwut

sample_reviews_en.text: Wednesday, January 22, 2025. Stopped to eat and use the restroom at a spacious gas station with plenty of parking in the back. However, it only had a crab fried rice restaurant and a coffee shop, so not many cars stopped there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul

sample_reviews_en.text: Who says Shell gas station restrooms aren't good??? Check out this one! It's great, convenient, and incredibly clean – the best in this area! Three thumbs up and five stars!
sample_reviews_en.author: SaMbOyZ Thanit

sample_reviews_en.text: The service staff were excellent; they wiped the windows until they were sparkling clean. Very professional. Even giving them 20 points felt like too little.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitinun Jundee

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff provided excellent service, the restrooms were clean, and there's also a crab fried rice restaurant in Muang Thong.
sample_reviews_en.author: This is Wee

restaurants.name: SAVY พัฒนาการ53
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 82 Phatthanakan 53, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
**Affordable and Delicious Clam and Garlic Toast, with Great Value for Money!**

I recently had a delightful meal at this cozy, small restaurant. The standout dish for me was the clam served with garlic toast—a perfect balance of flavor and texture. The clams were fresh and paired wonderfully with the crisp garlic toast.

I also enjoyed the pork Cordon Bleu. It was tender, crispy on the outside, and came with a side of perfectly seasoned fries and fresh vegetables. While this place may not compete with high-end Western restaurants, it delivers satisfying meals that are great value for the price.

The atmosphere is relaxed, and while the parking is on the street, it’s worth the visit for a good, hearty meal. Highly recommend this spot if you're looking for delicious food that doesn’t break the bank!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukawat Keratimanoch

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food that soothes the soul, food that evokes childhood memories.

The salmon steak with cheese was delicious. The salmon was layered on top of spinach and cheese, just like spinach lasagna.

The Hawaiian pizza was unique. It had large chunks of ham and pineapple, and other vegetables added. It's unlike any other restaurant's pizza. The thin, crispy crust was delicious.

The beef lasagna was incredibly tasty. The beef was tender and chewy, the sauce was rich, and the cheese was grilled to a perfect crispness and aroma.
sample_reviews_en.author: ** PYMN **

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a steakhouse, but they also have Thai dishes. It's similar to the 13 Coins restaurant I used to love. It's a small but clean place. I like their fish steak and pizza. For Thai food, I like their Shanghai noodle salad with seafood – it's spicy and delicious. Now they've added set meals with various drinks for 99 baht, which are tasty. They use jasmine rice, which is great. The staff are friendly and always smiling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bizzy {Bird}

sample_reviews_en.text: The food and atmosphere are similar to 13 Coins, but the portions aren't as large. The mixed steak was delicious. The garlic-baked mussels were a little bland. The thin-crust pizza was good. We came on the first day after the vegetarian festival and there were hardly any other customers; we were the only table occupied for almost an hour. I understand the current situation.
sample_reviews_en.author: มะรี เหล่า

sample_reviews_en.text:
The original 13 Coins restaurant.
Famous dishes include pizza, baked clams with garlic, and garlic bread. Prices are affordable.
Comfortable seating and good service.
Street parking is available.
(On the day I went, it was an even-numbered day, so I parked across the street from the restaurant.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Bebe Supree

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu offers a wide variety of choices. The food tastes good, the prices are reasonable for the quality, and the atmosphere is comfortable. There is parking available in front of the shop (check the odd/even day parking restrictions).
sample_reviews_en.author: เอกลักษณ์ สูยะศุนานนท์

sample_reviews_en.text: This small shop in a single shophouse unit might surprise you with its amazing food. At first, I thought it would be fast-food style steak, but it turned out to be incredibly well-prepared, delicious, and affordably priced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apijin Apijin

sample_reviews_en.text: I really missed the pizza here. It's been over 10 years since the 13 Coins Bangna branch closed, and I finally had the chance to eat here again. The quality of the ingredients and the taste are still as delicious as before.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanadet Maitrichit

restaurants.name: ข้าวต้มปลาเก๋า กะพง by กลมกล่อมราชพฤกษ์
restaurants.address:

เดอะ การ์เด้น ราชพฤกษ์, Tambon Bang Krang, Amphoe Mueang Nonthaburi, Chang Wat Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The grouper fish was fresh and the rice porridge broth was fragrant, sweet, and delicious. The dry rice porridge was also delicious, rich in flavor with a flavorful sauce and plenty of seafood. The stir-fried morning glory was very tasty; they gave it with long stems which were a little difficult to eat, but the vegetables were fresh and crispy. The stir-fried minced pork larb was unlike any other, very fragrant and delicious. The spicy soup was delicious. I especially liked the chrysanthemum tea and monk fruit tea because they were freshly brewed, naturally fragrant, and importantly, hardly sweet at all. It was fantastic! Before this, I couldn't find a good grouper fish rice porridge near my house, but now I'm so happy to have found my regular spot. Besides rice porridge, they have a huge variety of other dishes. The food is so diverse and looks so tempting. They don't just sell rice porridge! I'll definitely have to try many more things. The prices are very reasonable. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Lookpud Patty

sample_reviews_en.text:
Khao Tom Pla Kao Kapong by Klom Kloam Ratchaphruek is a solid choice for comforting, well-made fish rice soup. The grouper and sea bass are very fresh, with firm yet tender flesh and a natural sweetness, completely free from any fishy smell. The rice is cooked just right—not mushy—and the clear broth is light but deeply flavorful, living up to the restaurant’s name.

The toppings are generous, with ginger, fried garlic, and spring onions adding aroma and balance. It’s an easy, soothing dish that works perfectly for breakfast, dinner, or anytime you want something light but satisfying. The restaurant is clean, service is quick, and prices are reasonable for the quality. A great spot around Ratchaphruek for a comforting bowl of fish rice soup 🍲👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Wisanu Tuntawiroon

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a roadside restaurant with parking available along the road.
The restaurant is air-conditioned and has ample seating.
The seating arrangement is a bit quirky.
The owner is friendly and smiling.

The dry rice porridge is packed with seafood, and the broth is a unique, savory recipe – just the right amount of saltiness and delicious.
Besides rice porridge and fish dishes, the menu also includes items that don't seem to belong together,
such as Khao Soi (Northern Thai curry noodle soup), which is quite tasty but a bit spicy.
They also have radish cake, and the bean sprouts are of the highest quality – crispy and delicious.

The prices are reasonable, and the service is excellent and polite.
sample_reviews_en.author: W. W.

sample_reviews_en.text:
-Sea bass congee: Good flavor, not sweet. Recommended with soybean paste dipping sauce.

-Mixed congee (with minced pork, squid, and shrimp): Sweeter than the sea bass congee. Not recommended for those who don't like sweet congee. This dish is more expensive but has more ingredients, making it more appealing.

-Stir-fried morning glory with crispy pork: Good price, generous portion of crispy pork, delicious. However, on the day I visited, almost every piece of crispy pork was fatty. I wish the restaurant would choose better quality pieces.

-Steamed grouper with soy sauce: Very sweet. I usually can handle sweet flavors, but I recommend reducing the sweetness in this dish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fammy

sample_reviews_en.text:
The rice porridge is delicious, the fish is fresh and not fishy at all. The dry rice porridge with sea bass is very tasty. The restaurant has many menu items, including Northern Thai dishes like Khao Soi Gai (chicken curry noodles), which is delicious with rich coconut milk.
The restaurant is clean, the owner is attentive to customers, and the service is good. I will definitely come back again next time. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: supaporn silaporn

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been here three times already because they have a wide variety of dishes, including grouper fish porridge, Chinese food, and Northern Thai food. I'm trying to sample everything because every time I've visited, everything has been delicious. The freshly brewed chrysanthemum tea is also fragrant and not too sweet, which I really like. It's a small restaurant, but it's air-conditioned and nice and cool.
sample_reviews_en.author: Woody s

sample_reviews_en.text: The air-conditioned room had a musty smell, like it hadn't been cleaned properly (similar to the smell of men's urine). 😭😭 I wish they would pay more attention to cleanliness and the smell in the air-conditioned room. It was like the tables weren't wiped clean. The food tasted average, but the stir-fried noodles were a bit too salty, and the pork blood soup didn't quite live up to the description.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pommy Saranya

sample_reviews_en.text:
Roadside restaurant.
The restaurant is air-conditioned and has ample seating. The food selection is good.
Besides fish porridge, they also have Khao Soi, Northeastern Thai dishes, and Northern Thai food. I'll definitely come back.

Parking is available in front of the restaurant. The prices are reasonable, and the service is very good and polite.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pim lada

restaurants.name: Meeting Bar&Bistro บางพลี
restaurants.address:

155/15ม.12 Bang Phli District, Samut Prakan 10540, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every dish was delicious. The crispy pork was excellent, the grilled river prawns were fresh and firm, and the fried rice was tasty. The Northeastern Thai dishes were also good. I was impressed with the flavors.
The atmosphere was nice, and the live music was lovely.
The staff provided good service, but the food came out rather slowly.
sample_reviews_en.author: jarin w

sample_reviews_en.text: A pub and restaurant that also opens for lunch. I visited in the early evening when it wasn’t very busy. Ordered some food, taste was okay, price was mid-range, and service was good. They have draught beer, and live music starts around 7-8PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pipo Travelgeek

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, but the portion is very small. I ate three bites per plate. The restaurant is in a corner, so you have to find a parking spot and drive carefully. The band is from the 90s.
sample_reviews_en.author: Snam slam

sample_reviews_en.text:
Crispy pork stir-fried with chili and salt is incredibly delicious!
The seafood stir-fry with rice is also good, but the crispy pork is absolutely amazing. Definitely coming back for more.
sample_reviews_en.author: แก้วตา สุขพาณิชยิ่งยง

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice was soft and the food was delicious. The wait wasn't too long. If you're in a hurry, I recommend ordering in advance and letting them know your eating time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wanphen W.

sample_reviews_en.text: It would be great if you could improve the food. The taste, the containers, and the plating would attract more tourists. The music would be good, playing new songs.
sample_reviews_en.author: By Bunnie

sample_reviews_en.text: Stopped for coffee during lunchtime. Drove into May Market and found this cool, black-themed shop with a backdrop of stacked shipping containers – quite stylish. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Farng M Wong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, the portions are generous, and the prices are reasonable. The restaurant is spacious.
Open from 10 AM to midnight.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lalida Wisedjinda

restaurants.name: New York Pizza House

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been going to Thailand for 40 years. I've eaten Italian food many times, but I've never had such a horrendous meal. The pizza base was as hard as a cracker, I had to search for the cheese, and it was dripping with oil. The lasagna was made with fusilli pasta instead of fettuccine. The Bolognese sauce consisted of meatballs without any melted cheese. In the tiny portion (I ordered a regular size!), water had separated at the bottom. The original recipe is readily available online. Anyone who can read can make it. Thanks, but I'll never order from you again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Thormann

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pizza is delicious, and the spicy chicken is tasty with a nice tangy kick that balances the richness. However, those who don't like sour flavors might find it too sour. Order a pizza in a portion that's just right for one person. It'll be less delicious if left for too long and cools down. Ordering a smaller pizza more often and eating it hot is always the best option.

Parking is behind the restaurant; drive past it a little, turn into the alley, and park. It's a short walk.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bank กินเที่ยวไปเรื่อย

sample_reviews_en.text: Craving American-style pizza, I tried this place. I ordered the pepperoni and buffalo chicken toppings. The pepperoni was easy to eat and typical, while the chicken was juicy and delicious with a slight spiciness to balance the richness. The price was very reasonable; a medium-sized pizza is enough for two people. The restaurant has seating and is decorated in a retro pizza shop style.
sample_reviews_en.author: prakarn udomwech

sample_reviews_en.text:
I sometimes order takeout from the bar.
This applies to Pattaya in general, but Westerners' palates are rather unrefined, so the pizza, hamburgers, and steaks in this city aren't particularly delicious to me, and they're fairly expensive, but hey, it's a resort, so I won't complain.
The spicy chicken buffalo wings go really well with beer.
sample_reviews_en.author: J J

sample_reviews_en.text: I took my girlfriend to New York Pizza House on 3rd Road. But she got angry at me for not taking her to Pizza Hut. So we ended up leaving without ordering anything. But I am giving New York Pizza House 5 stars because the pizzas that other customers were eating looked so good. Next time, I will have to come by myself.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jean Gabin

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice indoor, delicious pizza restaurant with a/c. Ingredients are very high quality, hence the slightly high price. I ordered a normal crust Italian and my son ordered a thin crust Hawaiian. We both loved it. After trying many pizza restaurants throughout Pattaya, I think we found our favorite.
sample_reviews_en.author: David Yoo

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop threatened to call the police on me because they could not deliver my order.  They ask to prepay in advance when their drivers cannot make a delivery on time.  Order from a shop that doesn’t try to steal or scam customers
sample_reviews_en.author: EJ Meck

sample_reviews_en.text: The pizza is very good. Nice and fresh ingredients and delicious. Prices are very reasonable and competitive. I love pizza from time to time and I'll definitely be paying another visit. I would certainly recommend them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicholas Pilkington

restaurants.address:

44 11 Soi Akapat Sukhumvit 55 Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the limited-quantity tsukemen (dipping noodles). Including tax and service charge, without a drink, it came to about 550 baht, so the question is whether it was worth it.

The noodles and soup were tasty, but the soup was quite salty. Rather than the flavors of the ingredients clinging to the noodles, it felt like the saltiness was used to balance the thick noodles. It was salty.

The side dish was white rice topped with burnt cheese. I think you're supposed to pour the soup over it. Of course, it's filling in the sense of a rich, hearty rice porridge. However, the strong taste of the cheese masked the flavor of the soup. The soup itself was salty, and the cheese was also salty, so the combined effect was quite salty.

If this were 400 baht, I'd give it 4 stars, but considering it's 550 baht, I'd give it 3.5 stars.

The noodles were delicious. The boiled egg, bamboo shoots, chopped char siu, and chopped green onions were also delicious. Carefully prepared.
sample_reviews_en.author: SA ehime

sample_reviews_en.text:
During my trip to Bangkok, I visited this restaurant because I was craving Japanese-style ramen.

Since I live in a country where it's difficult to find authentic Japanese ramen, I wanted to enjoy some delicious ramen during my Bangkok trip, and I chose this restaurant with high expectations.

The result was a great success!

The soy sauce-based soup was especially delicious; one sip and I knew it was authentic Japanese ramen. The noodles and char siu (roast pork) were also delicious, and I finished it in no time.

The portion size was generous, making it a very satisfying lunch. I was able to enjoy the authentic Japanese ramen I had been hoping for in Bangkok.

I would definitely like to go back and eat here again when I return to Bangkok. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone craving authentic Japanese ramen!
sample_reviews_en.author: Koki Sato

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently heard about a popular noodle place in Thonglor 🍜 and decided to give it a try. The moment I walked in, I was greeted with warm smiles and a cozy, welcoming atmosphere. The restaurant was bright and had a clean, fresh feel to it, which made it even more inviting.

The ramen was absolutely delicious! The broth was rich and flavorful, complemented by perfectly cooked tender noodles. The toppings, including melt-in-your-mouth chashu and fragrant scallions, added to the overall delightful taste.

The staff's friendly and attentive service made the experience even better, creating a pleasant dining environment. 😊 I’m already looking forward to my next visit to enjoy more of their offerings!
sample_reviews_en.author: wisuwat chanachai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Recently, I found myself in need of some comforting food and decided to check out a place recommended by a review site. The moment I walked in, I was warmly greeted with a smile. The ramen I ordered was simply fantastic! The broth was rich and flavorful, and the noodles had the perfect texture, while the toppings complemented the dish perfectly 😊

The atmosphere was so cozy and relaxing, making it an ideal spot to unwind. The staff's friendly and attentive service added to the enjoyable experience.

If you're in Thonglor, craving some good ramen 🍜, this place is a must-visit. I'm already looking forward to my next visit and trying out more from their menu. One of my favourite spots for sure!
sample_reviews_en.author: Suchai Buranavalahok

sample_reviews_en.text:
I discovered this delightful ramen spot through Google Maps and was pleasantly surprised by the experience. The staff greeted us with warm smiles and the service was attentive, making us feel right at home😊 The ramen itself was a treat—savory broth with a rich depth of flavor, complemented by perfectly cooked noodles and tender toppings.

The ambiance of the place was cozy and inviting, providing a serene atmosphere in the bustling area of Thonglor. We truly enjoyed our time there, thanks to the delicious food and excellent service. Looking forward to returning and tasting more of their offerings next time we crave ramen in Thonglor! 🍜 Great flavour and staff. We will come back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tulio Avolio dos Santos

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited a ramen spot recommended by a friend, and it was such a delightful experience. The staff’s explanations about the recommended dishes made ordering a breeze, ensuring confidence in our choices. The ramen we tried was absolutely delicious, with a standout being their limited paitan tsukemen—available only 10 bowls per day! The egg and chashu were truly impressive, and the noodles had a perfect texture 😋

The cozy atmosphere made it easy to relax and enjoy each bite. Located in Thonglor, this ramen place is a gem for those seeking a comforting meal. Next time, I’ll make sure to arrive early to secure one of those coveted ramen bowls! 🍜
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarinpuck kiattiyoscharoen

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited this restaurant on a friend's recommendation, and I was very satisfied from start to finish 😊 The soup was rich yet easy to drink, and the noodles had just the right texture. I enjoyed it to the very last bite.

The atmosphere inside the restaurant was very comfortable, allowing people to relax while dining. The service was also very attentive. The staff were always smiling, spoke kindly and politely, making the overall experience very pleasant.

If you want to eat ramen in Tongluo that makes you feel at ease and satisfied, this place is really worth trying 🍜 Next time I go to Tongluo, I want to come back and try this bowl of ramen again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eas Chen

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stumbled upon this ramen shop in Thonglor after seeing it on social media, and I'm so glad I did! 🌟 The food was absolutely delicious. The broth was rich and hot, providing a warm, satisfying experience, and the noodles had the perfect texture, making each bite delightful.

The ambiance was cozy and relaxing, and I felt right at home with their friendly service. The staff's explanations of the dishes and recommendations were clear, which really helped me choose with confidence.

Overall, I thoroughly enjoyed the welcoming atmosphere and delicious ramen here in Thonglor. I can't wait to return and try out more from their menu! 🍜
sample_reviews_en.author: Tsetah Aki

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there on the Thursday, after Songkran was over. It was my second visit and I still do not understand why the air conditioning is so bad or even non existent that they have to set up large standing fans around the huge indoor area. Even with the fans, the entire indoor still feels humid.

I went there to redeem a free beer that was given to me during my visit on their soft opening and was planning to try out other craft beers on the tap as well. To my utter disappointment, about 80% of thie craft beer was marked as unavailable in their menu. This is quite atrocious, especially when the shop is known for their craft beer business. Thinking back, I believe the free beer that was redeemed wasn't even the same flavour as stated in the voucher.

Besides that, the staff and manager were very attentive and provides great service to attend to the few tables of customers.

But with the humid condition and also lack of choices for food items, I don't think I will be back anymore despite it's great location.
sample_reviews_en.author: Daron Tay

sample_reviews_en.text: Always nice to try a new place and leave thinking “Now that was a good choice.” It was burger, fries and beer for me: food, service and ambience all excellent. I’m partial to craft beer so it was an easy sell. Tried two; they’ll bring me back for more. I’m in the neighbourhood but location is great, on ground floor of Summer Hub Offices, literally at the foot of Phra Khanong BTS station. Still new enough to be considered a hidden gem. Give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ken Mccaffery

sample_reviews_en.text: The bar has a relaxed vibe & it’s right next to Summer Hill Mall. It’s a great little spot to stop for a break, grab some food (LOVEEE THE 🍔) , and enjoy some Burmese/brit craft beers. Definitely worth checking out!

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere wasn't bad, but I was a bit taken aback when they suddenly cleared the table and moved us to the side while we were eating. Craft beers like IPAs seemed to cost around 200 baht.

sample_reviews_en.text: A great neighborhood spot for Burmese food and craft beer! Makes me miss my home in Yangon just a little less 🥰 try the tea leaf salad/laphet thote— it’s amazing! (We ordered two) 🙂‍↕️

sample_reviews_en.text: New restaurant recommendation! The staff provides excellent service. The food is delicious, and there's live music on some days. Recommended for those who want a relaxing atmosphere.

sample_reviews_en.text: Visited BurBriT and really enjoyed the experience. The craft beer has a very nice aroma and you can tell the quality is good. A great place to hang out and enjoy good beer.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Food is excellent with no cutting corners we have enjoyed the food since 2021 and it's still cooking with a consistent taste, do try this when you're eating out or eating in, if you like to eat food once you parked this is a great place, I ordered before I arrive and when I do I get my dish served the moment I sat down, do try this place out before the prices changes because it's quite cheap for a steakhouse prices do check out the menu and the photos of customers...

Toilets are good and clean enough for a roadside steak place.

Language: need to practice your Thai here or do sign language on the menu(Thai)

Parking: now that is a thing...if you're good for a 2 minute walk from the parking there is a small road just after the Steakhouse place 2 shops down and just get any available wall.

Food quality is very good but then again I'm not a good critic so drop by when you can.
sample_reviews_en.author: Enrico Mr CoCo คุณโกโก้

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was absolutely terrible! My boyfriend and I went for dinner late at night and were the last table to order. After finishing our meal and paying, we asked the staff to order some more food to take home. After waiting a while, the staff brought it with a very displeased expression. As we were leaving, the staff started closing the shop and locking the front door. We couldn't get out and had to figure it out ourselves without asking for any help. The staff nearby just stood there watching and didn't assist at all. My boyfriend eventually managed to open the door himself. We were very disappointed and I promise we will never go back there again. The food was mediocre and only cheap, but with this kind of service, we'd rather eat at another restaurant where we can have a much better experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jenjira Hoom-art

sample_reviews_en.text:
I wanted to eat steak around Phran Nok Road and stopped by this place. The staff, or maybe even the owner because it seemed like they were running a business from their home, weren't very welcoming. I wasn't impressed from the moment I arrived. It took a long time to get their attention and to order food. I ordered three things: a burger, pork and chicken steak, and buttered sugar bread. They weren't very tasty, or maybe they just weren't to my taste. The pork seemed undercooked too. I was disappointed. The service was bad, and the food took a long time to arrive. People who came after me got their food first. And it wasn't even that good. I won't be coming back.
[Taste is subjective.]
The total was less than 300 baht, not expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaiwat Mas

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. Pork chop steak: The pork was likely undercooked. The sauce was bland and excessive, completely overpowering the meat.
2. Grilled Dolly fish steak: The fish had a fishy smell and was very bland. There was no hint of the seasoned pepper.
3. Chicken basil stir-fry: The chicken was undercooked! It had a fishy smell, the basil flavor was bland and not strong, and it was excessively oily and unappetizing.
4. Salad greens served with the steak: The vegetables were bitter and the salad dressing was bland.

*If the restaurant wants to improve, please read customer comments and adjust the taste and quality of the food.
I would commend the price, which is reasonable. The issues are with the quality and taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mog Suthan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. The beef basil stir-fry was amazing, the flavor was great, and the chili fish sauce was delicious and fragrant. The pork steak was also tasty and a large portion. We didn't have to wait long; we ate around 8 PM and there were a fair number of people. The food came out quickly and efficiently. Parking is available on the street. There's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisakan Watchakapong

sample_reviews_en.text: The wait was extremely long, and the place was unclean. The plates, bowls, and cutlery looked like they hadn't been washed; they were covered in stains. The staff were grumpy and seemed unwilling to serve, sitting around playing on their phones and not listening when called. They also let children run around, screaming and making noise in the restaurant while customers were present. It was a very unpleasant experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: PAKDIPORN KHAMKONG

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was slow to arrive, over half an hour. I ordered grilled Dolly fish steak, pork neck steak with dipping sauce, fried mushrooms, and mushroom soup. The sauce for the fish steak was very salty. The pork neck steak was 95% fat. The fried mushrooms were very salty. The mushroom soup was watery and bland. The only positive thing is the affordable price; steaks start at 79 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maytika Vasuchoakmetha (Anne)

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was incredibly slow; 30 minutes for one plate of french fries. The chicken steak was undercooked, the black pepper pork steak had an overly sweet sauce, the fried chicken wings were tiny for the price, and the bacon spaghetti was burnt. The overall taste was quite poor. It might be suitable for those looking for a low-cost option, but personally, I wouldn't go back.

Yesterday, I went for an oil change.
There were no staff available, and I had to wait a very long time.
There were two staff members. The first one was visibly intoxicated, with a flushed face. I'm not sure if the other one had been drinking as well.
The intoxicated one tried to replace the oil with the old oil, which didn't have a label on the back of the can.
When I complained, the other one told me to use a new bottle.
I asked if they had a funnel to prevent spills.
They said no, it wouldn't spill. But it still spilled.
Because their hands were unsteady and their intoxication was obvious...

sample_reviews_en.text: I will never go to this gas station again. The restroom cleaner was terrible. While I was using the toilet, they came in to clean the stall next door. They were pouring water and mopping loudly, as if they were unwilling to do so. They even mopped so hard that water flooded into the stall where I was using the toilet and into the stall where I was watching a movie. And many other things happened as well.

restaurants.address:


sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant isn't very big and is located right at Lat Phrao intersection, next to Paté restaurant. I'm not sure exactly where to park, but I saw some street parking in front of the restaurant. You might need to check the parking restrictions.

I liked the seating; the tables and chairs are thick and heavy, so they don't move when you lean on them or rest your arms.

They have a great deal on their Asahi beer buffet, and the staff are very attentive in refilling it. As for the food prices, compared to other restaurants I've been to, they're reasonable, but the menu isn't extensive, and the taste is average. Of course, this depends on personal preference.

Overall, I really liked this restaurant and will definitely go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Easytotalk25

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was mediocre. The salmon sashimi was old and smelly, and I was surprised at how little octopus wasabi there was. The meatballs had too much binder. The chicken wings, Yamachan-style, were the best. Asahi beer is cheap, so perhaps this is a place that only serves beer. I ordered a pitcher of beer around 11:50 and was told they close at 12. I wish they'd said that when I ordered if they close at 12. It's tough to finish a pitcher in 10 minutes. They turned off the lights and asked me to leave even though I wasn't finished. Wouldn't it be better to set a time for last orders? It's not right to just take the money for a pitcher of beer and then leave immediately.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food in general tasted good, the nabe (hot pot) was delicious, but the fried chicken, both the karaage and the fried chicken wings, were extremely salty. The saltiness permeated the meat, not just the skin. I recommend addressing this.

The restaurant isn't large, with seating for probably around 20 people in total. The staff provided good service, although there might be occasional delays or longer wait times for food. The atmosphere is okay, suitable for socializing with friends.

There's no parking available. I recommend parking at Union Mall and walking across the street (free for the first 3 hours).

Overall, it's a good option for a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peeravit R

sample_reviews_en.text: I have to say, the service at this restaurant is excellent. Compared to other restaurants I've been to that are more expensive, this one is much better. We went for the beer buffet, and what impressed me most was how constantly the staff refilled our beer – they weren't stingy at all – and the service was outstanding. This was my first time there, but my friends had been before and didn't expect it to be this good. The service, the food – everything was perfect. They didn't make any customer feel bad. I was very impressed and will definitely be back again. From a true Izakaya lover's perspective, this restaurant gets a thumbs up without hesitation.
sample_reviews_en.author: ad ar

sample_reviews_en.text:
This budget-friendly izakaya is located near Lat Phrao Intersection, next to Paté and near the entrance of Root Bar.

The food is delicious and of standard quality. The nabe (hot pot) broth is sweet and flavorful, and the okonomiyaki is very enjoyable. My favorite is the curry udon; the soft, chewy noodles pair perfectly with the rich curry sauce.

They have a wide selection of beers at very reasonable prices, and the side dishes are tasty. It's a great place to hang out with friends in a relaxed atmosphere.

I recommend getting there by public transport as it's very close to the MRT station (it's a short walk away).
sample_reviews_en.author: R. Nalyn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good taste for Nabe.
Staff take a good care of customer well.
Found some ants run on the dining table may be come from Nabe pot.

Recommened menu:Nabe
Menu:
Okonomiyaki Original:Soft dough. The shop has put the sauce for you.  Causing us to not be able to put the desired amount of sauce.  The sauce that comes out is a bit too much, making the taste quite salty.
Nabe Pork:Umami soup  .The fire that was initially provided couldn't cook the pork,Some of pork was still raw. Causing to ask the staff to fill the fite again.
Namban:The sauce is a bit runny and sour but tastes ok.
sample_reviews_en.author: mangdanoi zzz

sample_reviews_en.text: Initially, the service was excellent; everything was great, and I've been here many times before and was very impressed. However, I'm a little upset that some staff members were gossiping about and insulting customers in the restroom. This might not be ideal. If I've done anything wrong or inappropriate, please feel free to point it out directly. But to overhear staff members insulting customers in the restroom while I was there, I sincerely apologize. I was just sitting and eating, and I had no idea what I did wrong.
sample_reviews_en.author: boss ซ่า

sample_reviews_en.text:
This izakaya-style restaurant offers an authentic Japanese atmosphere.
The prices are reasonable, and the food is quite delicious.
Recommended dishes include okonomiyaki, wagyu beef sushi, Japanese sweet egg omelet, and nabe (hot pot).

They also serve alcoholic beverages, including Asahi draft beer, and offer a beer buffet.

If you're coming on a Friday evening at the end of the month, it's recommended to call and reserve a table beforehand.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khitja Boonsri

restaurants.name: Salt and Pepper
restaurants.address:

20/140 Moo 10 Soi Day Night 2 (behind TUKCOM, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a shame that it's an open-air building and doesn't have air conditioning.

The food is cheap and delicious.

My hotel didn't offer breakfast, so I stumbled upon this place and popped in.

They also had a set menu with the standard toast, sausage, fried egg, and coffee for 120 baht, but I ordered the club sandwich for 120 baht and an iced coffee for 65 baht.

The sandwiches were delicious!
The iced coffee was too sweet, so I'll order it without sugar next time.

The portions were very filling.

It was a little hot with just a fan and no air conditioning, but the food was cheap and satisfying.

Payment is cash only.
sample_reviews_en.author: まこりん。

sample_reviews_en.text:
My name is Jonas and I am from Germany. I visited this place with my brother and had a great experience. The food was excellent, and the atmosphere was warm and welcoming.

What made the visit truly special was the conversation with the owner himself. He showed us his incredible talent for building different engines entirely out of wooden pieces. The models are extremely detailed, true to scale, and crafted with impressive millimeter-level precision. You can see these amazing creations on display when you visit the restaurant.

Highly recommended — amazing food, friendly owner, and something truly unique to see.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jonas Müller

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is a hidden gem and is run by a friendly homely couple. They serve both Thai and Western food at a very economical price.

The food selection is very large and so far, none have disappointed us. Everything was cooked perfectly and served in a timely manner.

The owner is very attentive and does his best to serve and keep the customers happy. It is heartwarming to see.

The only downside is the laxk of parking spots. You might be better lff parking at Tukcom's parking building and walking here (roughly 200m away)
sample_reviews_en.author: Yawarakai O.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my favorite place to eat in Pattaya.  Salt & Pepper Bistro has been serving delicious food and offering friendly, home style service and hospitality for many years. An absolute Pattaya gem! The owner also creates the most incredible wooden models completely by hand. If that interests you, be sure to ask him about it. Nearly twenty years later, the one he made for me remains one of my most prized possessions! Thank you!  - Rich in the U.S.A.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rich

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the opportunity to visit this restaurant twice, once in the morning and once in the evening. It's a nice place to sit by the street. The food is reasonably priced, prepared by a chef. The Thai food is delicious, and the desserts are also tasty. I didn't quite get to try their Western dishes, but overall, the food was great. The evening staff provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: PP GG

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a pleasant experience here. The food was quite good 😋, and the prices were reasonable. The service was attentive and helpful. The atmosphere was okay, not particularly memorable, but it served its purpose. Overall, a solid choice for a meal. ✨🍽️😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Allan Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
A bright and airy restaurant next to the bustling market.
European and Thai dishes at very affordable prices.
A true taste sensation! Special mention for the club sandwiches.
The owners speak English.
sample_reviews_en.author: Carine Danet

sample_reviews_en.text: They prepare good, popular Thai and Western dishes. Delicious pad thai and popular fish and chips. Simple and clean decor. Run by Thai and Indian owners. They are kind and gentle. Fair prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: sym pass

restaurants.name: โชกูจัง (Shokujung)
restaurants.address:

118 2 Thanon Suan Aoi Soi Klang, Khwaeng Dusit, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Japanese Restaurant near Vajira Hospital
- Curry rice: 89 baht. Very cheap, and the curry is rich and flavorful with a mild spiciness. The tonkatsu is crispy and delicious, not a huge piece, but incredibly good value for the price. Pickled vegetables are refillable.
Add an egg for +30 baht.
- Sweet egg omelet: 55 baht. Also great value. The taste is good, with a nice texture, sweet but not cloying. Highly recommended. A little wasabi is provided, which pairs well.
- Plenty of seating. The picture was taken at 11:30 AM, not many people yet. More people started arriving closer to lunchtime.
- No parking available. It's an easy walk from Vajira Hospital.
- The staff might not be very attentive, not always smiling, but they serve normally when called.

In summary, a cheap and delicious Japanese restaurant. Great value for lunch. Definitely worth a visit. Will definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: ฐิติ ตั้งลิตานนท์

sample_reviews_en.text: The wait time at lunchtime is incredibly long; my stomach feels like it's going to digest itself if I wait this long. Every time I come, the wait is always long, and I'm still confused about why my friends and I chose this place. This time was the most disappointing. We ordered and waited for our food for about 45 minutes, and had to follow up twice. They don't manage the food queue very well; I hope they improve that. I gave it two stars because the staff followed up, but I didn't have time for a break anyway, as just waiting for the food took up all my time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tawan P.

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating at this restaurant since it opened about 10 years ago. I go so often that the owner remembers what I like to eat. My favorite dishes are the miso grilled pork, pork cutlet curry, and tonkatsu (fried pork cutlet). Most of the customers are students from Suan Dusit and Suan Nanthi universities, as well as doctors from Vajira Hospital. The prices are all under 100 baht. Honestly, it's even tastier than the food in Korea and Japan because they've adjusted the flavors to suit Thai tastes.
sample_reviews_en.author: K L

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a pleasant atmosphere and is conveniently located not far from the university. The prices are very affordable, and the quality of the food is excellent. Customers do not have to wait very long for their food to arrive. Moreover, there are numerous menus to choose from, including a variety of beverages and snacks, such as a water menu. Overall, this restaurant is an excellent choice for anyone seeking a satisfying meal that won't break the bank.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nannie Piyawan Saisud

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes good, the atmosphere is nice, and the air conditioning is cool. They sell Japanese and Korean food, as well as coffee. The prices are better than restaurants in shopping malls. There's no parking; the street in front of the shop is a small, narrow alley. It's not far from Suan Sunandha University and Vajira Hospital; a short walk away.
sample_reviews_en.author: Punnasiri Wongsricha

sample_reviews_en.text:
Selling food, Japanese style food.
Teenagers like to come and eat here. The taste is
delicious.

The owner's mother also sells rice and curry, inexpensive and very tasty. The shop is called Nam Phet.
The owner's name is P'Mee (Brother Bear).
There are many dishes to choose from each day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Somboon Trongkarndee

sample_reviews_en.text: The spaghetti is really delicious! ✨ The Korean dry ramen is incredibly tasty. Another thing we love is the tteokbokki; you have to order it when you come to this restaurant! ⭐️ The prices are reasonable and the food tastes great. We went for lunch on a weekday and it was quite crowded.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anyarin M.

sample_reviews_en.text: It's an air-conditioned Korean restaurant. The place is clean and tidy. Personally, I think the food is decent, and the prices are cheaper than Korean restaurants in shopping malls. However, there's no parking in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: กรุณา กิจไพบูลย์

restaurants.name: ร้านอาหาร Arunee
restaurants.address:

คอนโดเบ็ลพาร์อาคาร1 ซ. สาธุประดิษฐ์ 19 แยก 4 Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: After arriving in Bangkok, I really wanted to eat knife-cut noodles. The reviews looked pretty good, so I decided to order takeout. I called the number, but the woman who answered didn't seem to be from Shanxi; her voice sounded a bit off. I tried to add her on WeChat using the number she gave me, but couldn't find it. I asked her to add me on WeChat, but she didn't say for a long time whether she could or not. In the end, I couldn't wait any longer and hung up, which was a bit of a disappointment.
sample_reviews_en.author: 苏小懒

sample_reviews_en.text: The world will show you how to make the world a better place. In the future, you will be able to see the beautiful flowers and trees. ，This article will show you how to make a picture. It is not difficult to understand the meaning of this article.的很不一样，应该叫茄汁豆腐，介意的慎点。It's a Chinese à la carte restaurant serving local dishes that I've been eating at since it opened. The food is delicious and the prices are reasonable. I always recommend it to my friends. It's worth trying!
sample_reviews_en.author: mobanche li

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. I recommend the stir-fried noodles with egg or beef, stir-fried liver, and stir-fried green beans. The restaurant is a bit hidden away, and there aren't many tables, so you might have to stand and wait, especially during meal times. I pass by that area often but only recently found out about this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Katie Me

sample_reviews_en.text:
First time eating there. Luckily, I arrived just as they opened, so it was fast and good.

You can communicate with the owner in Chinese.

One thing to note: this shop opens early and closes quickly.

If you want to eat there, it's best to arrive around 4:30 PM if they open at 5 PM. Prices have remained unchanged.
sample_reviews_en.author: 咩鱼

sample_reviews_en.text: bad service experience…ever…we were called waiting outside cuz we ordered take out. We expensed several times here，admittedly，still be treated in an unpleasant way …lol we will never be there again…why treated Chinese in this way？unacceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Claire Q

sample_reviews_en.text: Authentic Chinese food, very delicious. I recommend calling to reserve a table, especially if you're coming in the evening, as there aren't many tables. I personally love the fried mushroom stems. Everything else was delicious too!
sample_reviews_en.author: YUKKALUK

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, in an authentic Chinese style. The entrance to the restaurant might be a little difficult to find. The owner provides good service, and the overall atmosphere is like having a family meal at home.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณภัทรารัตน์ เล็กประดิษฐ์

sample_reviews_en.text: Located on the ground floor of a residential building, the location is a bit hard to find. The taste is authentic; even the meager portion of beef is exactly like what you'd find in a noodle shop back home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vit Su

restaurants.name: 金坊丽轩云傣风情烧烤店
restaurants.address:

107, 446 Ratchadaphisek 13, Ratchadaphisek, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
💖Street stall prices, five-star restaurant quality! The scallion pancakes are fragrant and crispy, only NT$60 each. The grilled pork belly is absolutely amazing. If you're staying near Hui Kuang, you absolutely must come here for a few drinks and some barbecue—you won't regret it!

💖Travel the World with Little Pony

💖Dingwen Travel Agency Taoyuan Branch
sample_reviews_en.author: 李世宏青埔扶輪社,佰達翡利獅子會

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Yunnan BBQ. Run by a Yunnanese/Taiwanese couple - both offerings are quite good.

Don’t come overly hungry, as the food is pretty slow to come out (it’s a homey kitchen - basically just the wife cooking + one person they hired for the grill). Perfect place to top off a night with some shaokao and a beer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christopher Thomas

sample_reviews_en.text: The barbecue was too slow; I recommend ordering stir-fries instead. The taste was okay. There was no parking available; I parked under someone else's apartment building for 50 baht for 2 hours. However, the cold chicken feet salad was delicious; I often order takeout from there.
sample_reviews_en.author: 汤沁

sample_reviews_en.text:
Taste is not bad, but the environment of restaurant disappointed to me. It’s a restaurant for locals. I think if you are nearby, can come, but no need specific visit this restaurant from far away.
Btw, the fish is the most delicious dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: CHRISTINA

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent! It's about a 5-minute walk from MRT Exit 4. You absolutely must come, especially the grilled chives and grilled fish. If you can't handle spicy food, don't bother coming, it'll be so spicy it'll burn your forehead.
sample_reviews_en.author: jay CHANG

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a small shop, but the owner is warm and welcoming.
They serve authentic Taiwanese-style grilled food.
The grilled eggplant is incredibly delicious. You have to try it.
It's perfect for a get-together with friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: PP channel

sample_reviews_en.text: This hole-in-the-wall restaurant is not to be underestimated. The barbecue and stir-fries are delicious 👍, but there is no air conditioning and there are a few mosquitoes.
sample_reviews_en.author: 思孜陳

sample_reviews_en.text: Looks like normal BBQ stall on the road side. Pork BBQ is quite normal. However, must-try their pig tail BBQ. Very juicy and tasty, especially with their spice powder.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yann Song Tang

restaurants.name: Citi Bistro
restaurants.address:

