444 Phaya Thai Rd, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were staying at Pathumwan Princess I decided to try the buffet.
First of the price is very reasonable at 1000 bahts and 600 for our daughter who is 10.

It’s the same place where we have breakfast. All the stations are live meaning you have to show them what you want and they will cook it for you. However, I felt some items could have been prepared from before like in regular buffet place. Some staples like fried rice, noodles should be there without having to wait. They had delicious steak made to order but there were no mash potatoes, or fried or baked potatoes that go very well with steak. Even fried rice you have to order and it wasn’t very good. I felt Intl. menu was limited.

Soft drinks are free and they keep pouring till you ask them to stop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adnan Chowdhury

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a Mother's Day buffet dinner at a hotel. It was an international buffet with a wide variety of delicious food. The sashimi was very fresh, the dim sum was good, and the BBQ ribs were tasty. I especially loved the cooking station with shrimp, shellfish, crab, fish, beef, and lamb – you could choose how you wanted it prepared – grilled, steamed, etc. It's a shame they didn't have tea or coffee. The staff provided excellent service. Parking is available in front of the hotel. I was very impressed and would definitely come again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pui

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fist time here for international dinner buffet. First off, the hospitality was amazing. Loads of food option; thai, japanese, italian, you name it. Mostly the food was nice, but the beef steak was not my liking, the flavor of the meat itself was bland. However, the lamb chops were pretty nice, perfectly cooked.

For the parking, I recommend parking at MBK center. The parking ticket can be stamped at the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tipchutha S.

sample_reviews_en.text: Lunch was great; I liked the salted bread and the variety of dressings, including black olives. The roast pork rice was also very popular. I skipped the noodles though; the noodles were undercooked and the meatballs were chewy. They often have promotions, but it's incredibly noisy. Seriously, it's like people are shouting to talk over each other, like a group chat. Older people would probably like it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kornravee r

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was good, food tasted great, though not much variety.  Duck noodles was excellent and also the shrimp. The steak was a little dry, being cut in small pieces and left under the warming lamp. The creme brulee ran out but didn't get refilled. Fried shrimp ran out too.  Service was good, everyone was friendly and attentive.  I will come back again. Reasonable price too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom Murray

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best dining experience we had so far. Food was WOW!!! Fresh and delicious...just exquisitely superb! And the staff, great all around service. Thank you Sam, Baifern, and to everyone. You all made our dining experience very memorable! Two thumbs up guys! 👍👍 see you all again, next year? 😉
sample_reviews_en.author: Amiel Bautista

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. The selection might not be extensive, but almost everything tastes great. The service is excellent, especially from the female head staff who was always attentive. I commend her. I've eaten at many restaurants, and I think the service here is truly exceptional.
sample_reviews_en.author: potae Amity

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came for Mother's Day and they had a promotion: Moms ate free.
The food was diverse, high-quality, and fresh. The shrimp, grouper, and lamb were all very fresh and delicious. The desserts and cakes were also delicious.

We even got two teddy bears to take home as souvenirs!
sample_reviews_en.author: Karoong kungzZ

restaurants.name: CRIMINAL BURGER
restaurants.address:

3, 3 Kluai Mai Alley, Chorakhe Bua, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Just tried Criminal Burger in Bangkok and honestly this might be one of the best smash burgers I’ve ever had. It’s better than a lot of places in LA.

The patty was perfectly crispy on the edges, juicy in the middle, and packed with flavor. The bacon was thick and smoky, the cheese was gooey, and melted just right, chopped pickles mixed with caramelized onions kick my taste buds perfectly and the bun is so soft, shiny, buttery, brought it all together. Every bite hit hard. You can taste the quality every bite too!

The place itself has a cool vibe too, laid-back but with personality. You can tell they care about what they’re doing, and it shows in the food.

It should be illegal to be this good. 🔥🍔
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul S.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my go-to spot for Smashburgers in Bangkok. The prices are affordable and well worth it for the quality of food you get. I ordered a Smashburger, fries, and chicken nuggets—all freshly made and full of flavor. The hot sauce is especially great! I’m looking forward to trying something new on my next visit. The service was excellent as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emily S

sample_reviews_en.text: The beef hamburger was incredibly flavorful, plump, and juicy. Considering the price and quality, it's just as delicious as hamburgers from restaurants in the city that cost two or three hundred baht each. The meat was perfectly fried, thick, and very filling—just one patty is enough. The bun was okay, but it's the meat that's really delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: trethip bhama

sample_reviews_en.text: The burgers are delicious, and the prices are in the mid-to-high range. The best value burger to try is the one named after the restaurant, which combines pork, chicken, and beef in one patty. The crispy chicken is incredibly tasty. It costs 260 baht. Beer and other drinks are also available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Po-ngern Rattanachote

sample_reviews_en.text: The day we went was the day the shop was closing. They should find a new location to open a new shop. But if you've heard of Criminal Burger, you know it's delicious! Looking forward to the new location. I'll definitely come back to eat there again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nannapas Wachirasomboon

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a really delicious burger. The bread is soft and fragrant, and the sauce is excellent.
It's the restaurant's special recipe. It's a large size; one piece is enough to fill you up.
The Criminal burger, in particular, is superb. Excellent!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanjira Kananurak

sample_reviews_en.text: The burgers here are delicious and perfectly portioned, not too much or too little. The price is reasonable, even cheap. I encourage you to try them yourself. The shop isn't big, the service is good, and you can park right in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thunyapoom T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a surprisingly good little shop tucked away in an alley.
The burger is unlike any other, and the price is reasonable.
The food doesn't take long to arrive, and the meat tastes great.
This is definitely going to be my new regular spot! ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: susisos kxzzc

restaurants.name: ตำแตก บรมราชชนนี ส้มตำ อาหารไทย แกงส้มใต้ รับจัดเลี้ยง อาหารกล่องจำนวนมาก
restaurants.address:

ในปั๊มน้ำมัน ปตท เลขที่ 359/4 Borommaratchachonnani Frontage Rd, ฉิมพลี Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten here many times because I love it.
-5/5 for location: It's conveniently located on my way home, in a large gas station with parking. The restaurant is clean and beautifully decorated. It was Halloween-themed when I went, so the restaurant was decorated to match the occasion.
-5/5 for service: The staff are lovely and friendly.
-4/5 for food: The food tastes amazing, especially the mushroom curry and grilled pork neck. I deducted one point because if you don't specify the spiciness level, it's very spicy.

This is a restaurant I would recommend. Good price.
sample_reviews_en.author: A P

sample_reviews_en.text: This Thai and Northeastern Thai restaurant offers a diverse menu. The restaurant is spacious and air-conditioned. On my first visit, I ordered the turmeric-fried sea bass. The fish was filleted, cut into pieces, and fried to a perfect crispness. The fish itself wasn't seasoned; it was topped with crispy fried garlic and turmeric, which paired well with the seafood dipping sauce. I also ordered the yellow curry with coconut shoots and sea bass, which was pleasantly spicy and sour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charming_Journey

sample_reviews_en.text: Almost everything was delicious. They have a lot of great-tasting Thai dishes. I especially liked the fruit papaya salad and the fresh shrimp papaya salad – they were amazing. The sour curry with acacia leaves and shrimp, the sour curry with sea bass, and the fried sweet potato leaves were all delicious and worth the price. I'll definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Monalisa Home

sample_reviews_en.text: The sour curry with young coconut shoots is delicious, as is the papaya salad and the fried sea bass with spicy dipping sauce. The fish is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. The owner and staff provide excellent service. The food is clean and tastes great. Let the pictures speak for themselves!
sample_reviews_en.author: กานต์ชนก วงศ์แปง

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! The Luang Prabang style papaya salad with crispy pork, turmeric fried chicken, pork sausage salad with egg yolk, and rice noodle salad were all amazing. The staff were lovely and provided excellent service. This has become my regular restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: naulphan leevunkittekul

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the service was good, and most importantly, my girlfriend, who never eats fermented fish sauce at any restaurant, could eat it comfortably here. There was no smell, and she ate non-stop!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanapat Triamwiriyakij

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything is delicious, even the stir-fried morning glory. It's a simple dish, but incredibly tasty.

Every time I come, I have to order the salmon sour curry. If it's not sold out, I have to order it again.
sample_reviews_en.author: kritsadatham Thoopbucha

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the best Northeastern Thai somtum (papaya salad) restaurant! The taste is amazing and the service is excellent. I highly recommend this place to anyone who hasn't tried delicious somtum yet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boaty REVIEW

restaurants.name: sushimai ซูชิมั้ย ศรีบำเพ็ญ
restaurants.address:

27, 1 Soi Si Bamphen, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the best Japanese restaurant I've ever been to, not even in Moscow – incredibly delicious, huge portions of red fish. For 1,000 baht, you can have a truly delicious meal for two and drink Japanese beer on tap.
We went there almost every day while we were staying at the hotel. The food is prepared by a Japanese chef, and the atmosphere is very atmospheric, like something out of an anime. It's a pleasant, family-friendly atmosphere. Foreigners come up to the chef and shake his hand because this is simply an incredible place we stumbled upon by chance. All the reviews on the map are well-deserved, believe me, it's top-notch!

We ate at many places in shopping centers over the past two weeks, and nowhere is there anything like this. Ultimately, we're giving up on dining anywhere better than here. Compared to Turkey, where they sell you instant noodles for 1,000 lira, it's a world apart.
I've attached a photo of the menu; you can check the prices. I recommend getting a mixed fish dish and adding fish salads or fish rolls.

There are two dots on the map - they're the same restaurant, but they have the same entrance - great life hack!
sample_reviews_en.author: Алексей Котиков

sample_reviews_en.text: Two of us decided to splurge before our flight home. Ordered sashimi platter (thick fresh slabs), steamed salmon head (fresh and served with sweet sauce and veg) their speciality pork ramen (not great), a chirashi don (fresh salmon topped on rice). Cold green tea is complementary. We were the only guests at 5pm so service was prompt. Total bill =S$95 which is well worth it - as it was a very filling dinner.
sample_reviews_en.author: PN M

sample_reviews_en.text:
Atmosphere is nice, service is fast and friendly, food especially delicious and japanese-authentic, they even served mashed wasabi for sushi and it had the fresh and spicy tasty like it should be. Portions is also big like was mentioned before.

On top of that, prices were so low I felt like robbing comparing to other (japanese) restaurants
sample_reviews_en.author: James B

sample_reviews_en.text: We stopped in by chance, choosing the one closest to the hotel, and it was our best choice. It's absolutely delicious! We ordered a set of rolls and octopus ramen. The rolls are huge, you'll be surprised, the fish is very fresh. The ramen is perfect, the broth is thick, everything is just right, the octopus is incredibly tender.
sample_reviews_en.author: М М

sample_reviews_en.text: A superb culinary experience combined with an extraordinary level of service. The menu is varied, offering both classic Japanese dishes and fusion cuisine that incorporates Thai traditions. The ingredients are fresh, the restaurant is centrally located in the neighborhood, and close to accommodations. Definitely recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexandre Labelle

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a lovely time... a very pleasant atmosphere... from the moment you walk through the door... music that makes you forget your worries of the day... attentive staff... the option to eat like in Japan with low tables... a great atmosphere with people from all over the world with whom you can chat...
sample_reviews_en.author: Loïc Leborgne

sample_reviews_en.text: The best restaurant in the area! Amazing food and fair price. The staff are very nice and even bring complementary snacks! I definitely recommend the salmon and avocado salad , pork ramen, salmon rolls! The atmosphere is very nice and I’m extremely happy with this place! You should definitely visit!🤩
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaka Maka

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. The pictures on the menu might make the sushi look small, but you definitely can't finish it in one bite! Haha. The fried rice was the same; you definitely couldn't finish it alone. The restaurant's decor really gives you the feeling of being in Japan.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nana

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวหมูเด้ง นายจู๋
restaurants.address:

1008 Happyland Rd, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It's just an ordinary noodle shop, but the bouncy pork is incredibly delicious!!! I've been eating there since I was a kid, always ordering the clear broth noodle soup with extra bouncy pork.
sample_reviews_en.author: Longpaidoosi P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best clear broth pork noodle soup in the Happy Land area.
The broth is flavorful. Be prepared to wait in line if you come at lunchtime.
sample_reviews_en.author: Preeya Story Every Daÿ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Still as delicious as ever. I've been eating here for over 20 years.
There aren't many reviews, but now the restaurant is full at 11 am.
sample_reviews_en.author: Forever Young

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is okay, I'd give it a 7 out of 10.
The shop should sell bottled water, because free water isn't practical these days.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phichayakron Vimuktayon

sample_reviews_en.text: In the evening, duck noodle soup 🦆🦆🦆 is so delicious you'll want to slurp it all up!
sample_reviews_en.author: narai saisroy

sample_reviews_en.text: This noodle soup is truly piping hot! It's a delicious noodle shop close to home.
sample_reviews_en.author: dot max

restaurants.name: CHU CHU Chicken Club
restaurants.address:

10, 2 Ari 4 Alley, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
There is parking available (for a fee). This area has several famous restaurants, including Fish Monger. The restaurant is beautifully decorated and comfortable, with a good atmosphere for both taste, smell, and taste. The upstairs becomes a bar after 6 pm.
The food menu has a moderate selection, but the prices are high. The fried rice with preserved mustard greens tasted decent, as per the reviews, but at this price, I probably wouldn't order it again often.
The fried chicken was standard in taste, and the set meal was also expensive. I didn't feel it was very good value for money.
The service from the staff was polite and friendly, but the restaurant charges a 10% service charge, and we had to pour our own water. Overall, I felt that the price and what we received weren't very worthwhile.
sample_reviews_en.author: N. W.

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices are high, reflecting the quality and location. The restaurant is in the middle of Ari, with a great atmosphere. It's open late and has a DJ. It's located in a slightly secluded alley, but there's parking available (for a fee). The restaurant has two floors; the ground floor sells chicken and rice, while the upper floor is a bar, although you can order cocktails there. The menu has a decent selection, but the dishes are very creative and unique. The mala fried chicken is incredibly juicy, tender, and crispy, with a subtle mala aroma (not too spicy, even the spiciest version). The spaghetti is amazing; the chicken is delicious, but the spaghetti is the perfect finishing touch. You have to try it if you come.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanyanop Ounpanich

sample_reviews_en.text: The preserved mustard greens fried rice is highly recommended. Mixing it with the side dishes and squeezing some lime juice makes it amazing. Next is the Chu Chu Chicken, the restaurant's signature fried chicken. This one is decent, but perhaps because it came with mantou buns and pickled lemon soup, it didn't quite go well together. However, the dipping sauce was good. Following that is a Chinese-style dish: stir-fried eggplant with Chinese-style fried chicken. The eggplant was delicious, but the fried chicken was a different type than the one in the Chu Chu dish – smaller in size. It's topped with Sichuan chili, dried chilies, and oil; very fragrant, but also a bit greasy. The desserts were rather average.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vimlet Kir

sample_reviews_en.text:
📍 A newly opened fried chicken restaurant in the Ari area. Open from 11:00 AM to midnight. The first floor is the dining area, while the bar is on the second floor, open from 6:00 PM onwards.

📍 A must-try dish is the "Gana Chai Fried Rice," with its perfectly cooked, chewy rice and amazing flavor. The fried chicken is also a must-try, served hot with crispy skin and tender, delicious meat. The dipping sauce is a perfect match!

📍 The restaurant is decorated very cutely, with beautiful lighting both inside and outside, offering plenty of photo opportunities for Instagram. The staff are friendly and provide good service. Parking is available in front of the restaurant, with staff to assist with parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patinya Wisuth

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant's interior is beautiful and the service is good.
However, the taste wasn't really worth the price. This might be because I ordered dishes that weren't the restaurant's signature items. The chicken and fried rice were tasteless.
But even if they weren't the standout dishes, I think a restaurant should at least have delicious food on every menu item, right?

The food prices are already high, and there are additional service charges.

The fried chicken seemed undercooked – this was the worst part.
sample_reviews_en.author: chu cha

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has a warm and cozy atmosphere with a comfortable and airy ambiance. The menu focuses on fried chicken and offers a wide variety of delicious fried dishes, including dishes like Khanom Chue fried rice, shrimp with salted egg yolk sauce, crispy fried chicken skin, and a refreshing cucumber salad. A wide selection of drinks is also available. Everything on the menu is delicious. Highly recommended for those looking for a good place to try in the Ari area.
sample_reviews_en.author: sopida

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken was well-marinated, well-cooked, and well-seasoned. It was the most memorable dish we ordered. While the other dishes, like the pasta and orange chicken, were pretty delicious, they didn't stand out as much. I want to give a shout-out to one of their cocktails, the G&C. It surprised me with its combination of gin, rich with an elderflower note, and a smooth blend of chrysanthemum tonic. I've never had anything like it anywhere else.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siraphop Lahankaew

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is beautiful; every corner is perfect for taking photos.
The food tastes great.
The preserved mustard greens fried rice was delicious, with a perfect balance of sour and salty.
I highly recommend ordering the fried chicken; it's delicious, crispy, and flavorful. We ordered it medium spicy, and it came with a choice of side dishes; we chose pickled vegetables, which were tasty. I also liked the lemon sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poohpaelay S.

restaurants.name: ร้านข้าวแฮปปี้แลนด์
restaurants.address:

75 Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is great...very good, everyone. Everything we ordered was delicious. The prices were good, and the portions were just right. I'll definitely be back. I highly recommend it. Parking is available in front of the restaurant.

The stir-fried squid with fresh chili and basil with seafood (80 baht) were both delicious and flavorful. They used soft jasmine rice. The beef noodle soup (90 baht) was a Wat Dong Mung Lek recipe with offal, stewed beef, and meatballs. It was a generous portion, a great value.

After eating until we were full, we were so impressed that we ordered a seafood sukiyaki and stir-fried squid with chili paste to take home. The seafood sukiyaki was excellent, absolutely delicious. The squid with chili paste was also good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Am ja

sample_reviews_en.text: My friend told me about a new restaurant that opened near his place, so we decided to go eat there. They have a huge variety of food, from rice dishes to side dishes and noodles. The prices are very reasonable. I went without expecting much, but it was surprisingly delicious! The restaurant is clean, the service is good, and the food didn't take long to arrive. If you're looking for a place to sit, chat, and eat without it being crowded like the restaurants down the street, this is the place. Anyone in the Happy Land, The Mall Bangkapi, or Ladprao area should try it. Confirmed delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Topper Roc

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, the atmosphere is great, and you can park right in front of the restaurant. The menu is quite diverse, with both main courses and single-dish meals. The Southern Thai food is excellent, and the prices are very reasonable.
Anyone passing through this area should stop by and eat here. The restaurant is located on Happy Land Soi 2, opposite Asia 14 Hotel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ramie P.

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered food and they immediately started serving turmeric-infused dishes! The turmeric-fried sand fish was crispy and delicious, and the crispy turmeric was amazing. The stewed pork meatball soup was tasty. The spicy clam curry was flavorful and the clams were fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: aplusgood168

sample_reviews_en.text: This Southern Thai restaurant serves very flavorful and spicy food that I really enjoyed. It's authentic Southern Thai cuisine at reasonable prices. For those who prefer noodles, they also have stewed pork and beef noodles, and the broth is fantastic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Napassorn Theetawatwong

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! And the restaurant is clean. Everything is made fresh to order. They also have stir-fried mushrooms, stir-fried mixed vegetables, and traditional Gnetum leaves dish, which I didn't get a chance to photograph.
sample_reviews_en.author: MIMIE YANG

sample_reviews_en.text:
✨✨The food is delicious. There's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, including noodles.
😋😋The restaurant is comfortable and clean.✨✨
🛵🚙Parking is available right in front of the shop, very convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploy Kitta

sample_reviews_en.text: The stir-fried pork belly with chili and salt is delicious. The restaurant is located opposite Asia Residence Hotel 14. There are only a few parking spaces in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zacruder Delacroix

restaurants.name: Mae Mali. Ploenchit
restaurants.address:

888/12 Phloen Chit Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very convenient to get to. Just get off the BTS at Ploenchit and head towards the Mahatun Building.
This is a delicious fried pork rice shop with a few customers. The crispy fried pork and salted fish are delicious and go perfectly with hot steamed rice.
I only have a few items, and if I come here every time, I'll smack anyone who eats fried pork. The staff are foreigners who don't understand Thai very well. Oh, and I almost forgot, this shop also has noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nitcha Maneechai

sample_reviews_en.text: I was running errands in the area and looking for breakfast. Luckily, I found this place that opens early. I came in without any expectations, but their fried pork was so delicious that I had to come back another day. Anyone in the Ploenchit area should try it. It's owned by the same person as Radi, the cupcake and coffee shop, which is now located on the second floor of the building.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ka Tib

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an Airbnb accommodation, not a restaurant. When I mentioned there were mosquitoes, they brought an electric mosquito racket and other supplies. They also cleaned the room and refilled the free snacks. It was very convenient having a washing machine and dryer. Getting around was also easy as it is located right in front of Planch Station.
sample_reviews_en.author: mg kim (묘왕동주)

sample_reviews_en.text: This little restaurant was a lucky find. The owners aren't Thai. They serve authentic Hong Kong recipes. All the dishes we ordered were excellent, from the soups to the gyoza. The staff was friendly and fast. The place was spotless. Excellent value for money. A well-deserved five-star rating. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Paolo L.

sample_reviews_en.text: This small restaurant is a hidden gem, offering quick, delicious, and affordable meals perfect for travelers. The cozy atmosphere makes it even more inviting, and knowing they also operate as an Airbnb adds to the convenience. It’s a great spot for a casual meal or a comfortable stay. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: KC

sample_reviews_en.text: Unassuming casual restaurant within walking distance of Nana Plaza. Only Thai people were eating here when I came for lunch, the food was excellent and standard Thai prices, not price inflated for foreigners. There is open air seating but they have a good fan setup which negates the heat well
sample_reviews_en.author: Christopher Wing

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was good, the waitress slash cashier and staff kitchen are energy vampire.
I deleted my first review since i was “forced” to give them good review by their “prayer”.

P.S : Do you want me to post the after pict of my forehead for compliment by the art work of your cashier ?
sample_reviews_en.author: Caroline Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
This spot serves up crispy, juicy pork and punchy chili dips that’ll have you scraping your plate clean. The flavors hit just right, the spice lingers in the best way, and the price makes it all the sweeter. A must-try for a solid, no-fuss Thai meal!
The staff also very kind!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Roxas

restaurants.name: โกยซีหมี่ อาผ่อ สูตรดั้งเดิม
restaurants.address:

3, 1 Phetkasem 68 Yaek 23 Alley, Bang Khae Nuea, Bang Khae, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Koy Si Mee: The noodles have a wonderful wok aroma, and the flavor is rich and authentically traditional, spicy and flavorful. Personally, I didn't need to add any extra seasoning; it was delicious as is.😋😋
Pad Ngo Ngai: The thick noodles are chewy and soft, with a fragrant wok aroma, plenty of ingredients, and a spicy flavor.😋😋
Prad Mee Hong Kong: The noodles are soft, not soggy or oily, and the taste is good.👍👍
Overall, I personally found it delicious. I liked it. The owner is friendly and provides good service. You can park at the restaurant or near the 7-Eleven and walk a short distance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuch S

sample_reviews_en.text:
I like the Hong Kong-style stir-fried noodles; they have a perfect balance of salty, sweet, and sour flavors. I initially thought they'd be bland like typical mee sua noodles. The fried rice, Grandma's recipe, is also delicious – a dry-fried Chinese style. The khao soi noodles (a type of noodle dish) need to be eaten with the soy sauce dip. The food isn't too expensive, but the portions aren't very large.

There were a lot of Grab orders today. When I arrived, I had to wait quite a while because the elderly couple were cooking all by themselves. It's better to call ahead to order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichit thitthaweerut

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered stir-fried noodles with gravy, Hong Kong-style stir-fried noodles, and stir-fried noodles with various toppings. Everything was delicious! However, my family complained that there wasn't enough meat in the dishes. If there are many orders, the service might be a bit slow because there are only two people working there, an elderly couple. The restaurant is in a house with a very nice atmosphere. There's parking for about 2-3 cars. I recommend parking next to the 7-Eleven at the entrance of the alley and walking to the restaurant; it's less than 50 meters away.
sample_reviews_en.author: double u

sample_reviews_en.text: It was my first time here and luckily there wasn't anyone, so I didn't have to wait long. The owner cooked the food in a relaxed manner, without rushing. The stir-fried noodles were fragrant with a slightly burnt flavor, very delicious. The Cantonese-style stir-fried noodles were uniquely tasty, similar to stir-fried chicken with a fragrant soybean paste aroma. It didn't need much extra seasoning, just chili sauce was enough. I'll try other dishes next time and will definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gonggong Gong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything was delicious!
I ordered the stir-fried noodles with seafood – the noodles were fragrant, the wok aroma was great, and the sauce was delicious.
The Hong Kong-style fried noodles had a flavor I've never tasted anywhere else.
The Grandma's fried rice was incredibly delicious; I could eat it endlessly.

Be patient after ordering and let the cook prepare it slowly.
Because it's a home-cooked meal.
Definitely worth the wait!
sample_reviews_en.author: Attasith Kajornrungsilp

sample_reviews_en.text:
The stir-fried noodles are delicious, the stir-fried chicken is delicious, everything is great. Worth the price. No need to add any seasoning.
You might want to call and reserve a table if you want to sit in the air-conditioned room.
There are birds singing while you eat.
Plenty of parking space, you can park at the 7-Eleven.
The owners, an elderly couple, are lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: พิสชา เหลืองมีกูล

sample_reviews_en.text: At first, I didn't have high expectations; I just wanted to eat kway teow (stir-fried noodles with gravy). It turned out to be unexpectedly delicious. The sauce was perfectly seasoned and had a wonderful wok aroma. I even ordered Hong Kong-style noodles to take home for dinner. It tasted very authentically Chinese and was delicious. This is now my regular restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: ศรุต กู้โรจนวงศ์

sample_reviews_en.text: The stir-fried noodles with bamboo shoots were tasty, the bamboo shoots were tender, but the noodles were a bit overcooked. The stir-fried chicken was delicious. The Hong Kong style stir-fried noodles were decent. The fried rice was quite good. The dry-fried noodles were acceptable. If there's no queue, the food doesn't take long to arrive. Prices start at 50 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Almagiro 1

restaurants.name: Sho Ramen @Central Bangna 5th floor
restaurants.address:

เหนือ, 585 Central Bangna, 5th floor Eatery House Zone Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍜 Sho Ramen 🍢 Prices are similar to Hachibang, but we like this one more 😋

🍜 Miso Ramen with Pork Belly Chashu 109 THB
The noodles, chashu pork, soy sauce marinated egg, and miso soup are better than Hachibang's, but still not as good as Ebisu Ramen (the one that often opens in front of gas stations or on the roadside). That one is truly delicious for just over 100 THB.

👉 This place has a good selection of menu items. Next time I have to try other soup bases. They have about 5-6 types of soup.

🙏 Thank you everyone ♥️
for clicking "Follow"!

YouTube 🎬 Paopao Studio
TikTok 🎙️ Paopao Studio
Wongnai 🍭 Paopao Studio

#ShoRamen #PaopaoStudio
sample_reviews_en.author: Paopao Studio

sample_reviews_en.text:
• The staff were very helpful and polite.
• The seating is similar to a food court, allowing you to order from multiple stalls and eat there.
• The prices are reasonable, around 150+ baht, and the taste is good and delicious.

Menu items ordered:
• Tonkatsu Ramen with Chashu Pork Neck: The broth was flavorful and delicious, very fragrant. The ramen noodles were excellent, soft and chewy. The chashu pork was a little tough.
• Spicy Ramen with Chashu Pork Neck: Ordered medium spicy, but it was quite spicy. The broth was rich and delicious.
• Gyoza: Delicious, but the dough was a little thick.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ordinary N.

sample_reviews_en.text: This ramen shop serves delicious ramen with quality ingredients at reasonable prices. The cold ramen noodles are soft and chewy, slightly thin, and the broth is refreshingly cold and flavorful. You can add a little grated ginger for a unique taste that you don't often see at other shops. The spicy ramen with flame-seared sirloin beef has a different type of noodle, which is softer. The spiciness is just right, the beef is tender and not chewy, and the aroma is distinct. You can choose your desired level of spiciness and the type of noodle, which varies in thickness and chewiness.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaii Kung

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at Sho Ramen, and I must say, it was an exceptional experience. From the moment I walked in, the cozy and inviting atmosphere made me feel right at home. The staff were friendly, attentive, and knowledgeable about the menu, making great recommendations for first-timers like myself.

If you're a ramen lover or just looking for a comforting and delicious meal, Sho Ramen is definitely worth a visit. I'll certainly be returning to try more from their menu!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nan Thanwa

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried the mala ramen and the flavor was fragrant, the broth well-balanced, and the mala flavor wasn't too strong, perfect for those who want to eat mala but don't like the strong spices like me, haha. But the highlight was the side dishes. The tempura shrimp was crispy, tender, and delicious, with a texture unlike anywhere else. The seaweed salad was tasty and didn't have any fishy smell. Everything went well with the hot tea. I ordered a lot and ate it all. I'll definitely go again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chor ชอ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is on the 5th floor, near the restrooms. The seating is spacious and not cramped, but it lacks the feel of a Japanese restaurant because it's a counter with shared seating, more like a food court.

The salt-based ramen with fried shrimp had a delicious soup and tasty noodles. However, the yakiniku pork rice bowl needs improvement; the pork was sliced ​​too thick and tough. The sauce covered the rice well, but it was soft and fluffy.
sample_reviews_en.author: kruboo chan

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're a ramen lover, you absolutely shouldn't miss this place. Personally, this was my first time trying Sho Ramen. I tried several dishes, including tempura and tonkatsu. The broth was flavorful, and the saru (spicy pork cutlet) was perfectly balanced and delicious. They also offer curry in various spiciness levels. There's a wide variety of side dishes too. The food is tasty, the prices are good, you have to try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Faiy Piyada

sample_reviews_en.text:
The sitting area and the whole setting is poor
This floor in that mall should be redo as always look unfinished and half empty floor and sitting
Area and the smell of the place isn’t so pleasant as well
The presentation of the bowl looks depressing but the chicken broth is very good, the tempura shrimps are wrap with funny crumbs, the prices for such kind of sitting area isn’t very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amani Hsiao

restaurants.name: CoolMan Street food
restaurants.address:

ตลาด หมู่ที่11 ถนนศรี, Talat, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: So, so, so delicious! We only ordered the picanha steak and pork burger, shared it with my boyfriend and we were more than full. The steak was a large patty, perfectly grilled, juicy and incredibly satisfying. The sauce was flavorful and delicious, even the side dishes were amazing. We ate everything on the plate! The burger was also incredibly delicious, the pork was juicy and not dry. The atmosphere in the restaurant was great, the music was nice, and the owner was kind and friendly. The prices were excellent for this level of quality. Overall, we were very impressed with this restaurant and will definitely be back! ❤️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: ภัคจิรา ศรีใส

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, the atmosphere is friendly, and the owner does everything herself. You order by writing down your menu and sending it to the kitchen, then pick it up when it's ready and sit at your table. There's a wide variety of drinks to choose from in the fridge. I recommend the steak and the juicy, cheesy burgers; they're incredibly delicious and the portions are huge. I'll definitely be back again.
P.S. For those who like building Gundam models, they also sell them. The owner said what you see in the shop is only a part of what they have in stock. Gundam model enthusiasts should definitely stop by.
sample_reviews_en.author: rewat phongphisutthinant

sample_reviews_en.text: Very delicious! The owner is lovely and friendly. The restaurant has a signature dish. In the evening, the atmosphere is very good. I recommend it. You must come and try it at least once because it's really good. The price is affordable. But if you're hungry, think before ordering. The large dishes are worth the price. If you order a lot like we did (only 2 dishes), you'll regret chewing the meat. I'll definitely come back to this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naruphorn Panlamloed

sample_reviews_en.text:
Australian beef steak, priced in the hundreds but tasting like a thousand. Ordered medium, it was perfectly cooked – not dry at all, juicy and tender, yet well-done. The sauce on the meat was delicious; no extra dipping sauce was needed.

The burger, made with coarsely ground beef, was incredibly delicious – juicy and flavorful.

I was very impressed! The owner provided excellent service and was very polite.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noon NNN

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you want to eat a steak or burger that truly defines what delicious is,
then give it a try. Personally, I think it's incredibly delicious; the taste is surprisingly good considering the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bond Jaiaree

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious and such a huge portion!
The price matches the quality and quantity. You won't be disappointed.
I loved all the side dishes: potatoes, garlic,
and the mustard sauce is the best! 💛
sample_reviews_en.author: BR TH.

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! The ingredients were high quality, and the spice aroma was wonderful. The price was very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kasemtan Teavasirichokchai

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the best steak restaurant I've ever eaten at. It's better than many countries; it's Michelin-worthy.
sample_reviews_en.author: maxchange luca

restaurants.name: ข้าวมันไก่ 33 จี๊ดจ๊าด
restaurants.address:

479 Sukhumvit Alley 22, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
This small local restaurant represents Thailand at its expat best.
As far as I know, they serve only one dish—khao mun gai (Hainanese chicken rice)—but it’s the best I’ve had, IMHO.

For just ฿50, you get a generous portion of tender, boneless chicken with beautifully healthy skin, fragrant rice, chili sauce, sweet soy sauce, and a clear chicken broth with a delicious chunk of sweet chayote (which I LUV).

Most people eat everything separately, but combined, it becomes an incredibly comforting soup. I like to heat it until steaming hot in the microwave—and it has me smacking my lips for hours afterward.

The friendly owner, together with his wife and daughter, could easily charge more than double and it would still be a great deal.

By 10:30 a.m. every table was already occupied, so plan on takeaway. I’ve been coming here for years, and this review is long overdue. Try it for yourself.
sample_reviews_th.author: Timothy Rogalski

sample_reviews_en.text: Honestly, it's a clean place for a local place. The broth here is almost like samgyetang. The chicken isn't tough and doesn't have a fishy smell. It's good! It's just the kind of taste that Koreans like! I had a cold but it's healing meㅋㅋㅋㅋ Even including the water, it didn't even cost 100 baht. I think I paid 78? 77? I recommend it. I have to blog about this place too. I'll come back again❤
sample_reviews_en.author: 수수 (Susu)

sample_reviews_en.text: This is another one of my favorite Hainanese chicken rice restaurants. The dipping sauce is a seafood style, and the soup is very fragrant and delicious. If you're in the Sukhumvit 22 area, this is really the place to go for Hainanese chicken rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thc

sample_reviews_en.text: After travelling 200,000 kms by road in Thailand I can easily say this is the best Hainan chicken I have eaten. Fresh, clean, friendly, and an incredible value. I lived 15 years in China and don't remember having anything better. Hainan …
sample_reviews_en.author: Jess

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken was excellent, tender and chewy. The rice wasn't soggy, the soup was hot and contained pumpkin, and the dipping sauce was delicious. Ordering the special gave you a very generous portion, making it incredibly good value.
sample_reviews_en.author: ทัศพร เชียงทอง

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was mediocre, the rice was oily, and they gave me sliced ​​chicken leg. The fan blowing from the restaurant smelled like cat urine. The cleanliness seemed lacking; it wasn't appetizing. I ordered it for home delivery.
sample_reviews_en.author: narongsak nane

sample_reviews_en.text: The best Khao Man Gai in town. Specially the fried chicken one. The namchin is outstanding. The soup served along is delicious. Run by a couple who's hospitality is impeccable. Served with love.
sample_reviews_en.author: Simply South

sample_reviews_en.text: The Hainanese chicken rice tastes great and the portion is generous. The soup is refillable and the dipping sauce is good. Located in Sukhumvit Soi 22.
sample_reviews_en.author: P P

restaurants.name: Fried Chives Jae Noi Yaowarat
restaurants.address:

644 632 ถ. เจริญกรุง Pom Prap, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Another great find near the 22nd Circle: an old-school fried chive dumpling shop. They're crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, with a wonderful aroma because they use pork lard for frying. They offer square and round chive dumplings with various fillings: vegetables, taro, jicama, and bamboo shoots. Unfortunately, I arrived late and only the vegetable filling was left (but I've tried all the fillings and they're all delicious!). Their dipping sauce is also delicious, rich, sweet, spicy, and perfectly sour. You can eat at the shop and they'll fry it for you, or you can order takeout. (They sell from their house in Soi Trok Makham 1 in the mornings, starting at 10 am. You can call to order.)

Next door is a traditional boiled peanut shop. Today I ordered mixed peanuts and sweet egg. The peanuts are plain boiled, but you can ask for extra sugar if you prefer them sweeter. The sweet egg is incredibly sweet, with a bouncy, chewy texture – absolutely delicious! They boil them the old-fashioned way over a charcoal stove, giving it a very authentic feel.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gubgubfy

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is considered one of the oldest shops in this area, having been around for at least 30 years. I've been eating here since I was a kid...

This shop is delicious, especially when it's freshly fried and hot. The dough is chewy and soft, fragrant, and the fillings are delicious and well-balanced in every way. They especially use the square chive pancakes (with less dough and more vegetables). Once you start eating, you can't stop! I feel bad for the scale! 55555

If you're in the area... eat here... Highly recommended 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Niccy nan

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop isn't very famous. One day, I was eating lod chong (a Thai dessert) nearby and noticed that this shop's kuchai (Chinese chives) had a constant stream of customers. So I bought some to try, and it was so delicious it could easily be in the Top Ten in Thailand. The dough was just the right thickness, the filling was rich and flavorful, and they used high-quality pepper, giving it a distinct, fragrant heat.
sample_reviews_en.author: DukeTK

sample_reviews_en.text:
I like the square-shaped pan-fried gu chai here the most. It has more vegetables than dough, and the dipping sauce is good with a slight spiciness. They are very generous with the sauce. The restaurant actually opens at 1 PM and only has one table for dine-in.

(The most delicious pan-fried gu chai (Chaozhou Chinese food). Dipped sauce made from soy sauce mixed with chili. Good for takeaway and try immediately.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirapat Sukjai

sample_reviews_en.text: Walked past and didn’t want to get anything but saw an old lady making the food so decided to give it a try. Bought takeaway here and the food is very good. The dough is chewy and nice, full of fragrant vegetables and fried to crispy outside. The dipping is sweet, sour and spicy at the same time. Recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Michelle Ku

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old, established chive dumpling shop. I've been eating here since it was located in Soi Makham.
They have both square and round dumplings with filling.
They're pan-fried, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, not dry and hard. The dipping sauce is also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kayoo Chuen

sample_reviews_en.text: Don’t miss Aunty’s fabulous streetside stall. We were lucky to grab her last batch in the evening and it was everything we heard it would be. Crisp on the outside and so fresh on the inside. We packed some away to have along with some other food at a nearby restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charles Victor

sample_reviews_en.text:
I arrived at 3:50 PM today, and they were already sold out. Only 10 pieces of bamboo shoots were left. I ordered 3 pieces at 11 baht each. 3 pieces in a bag and 4 pieces in a box. The seasoned bamboo shoots were delicious!

#ThisShopIsMyFavorite
sample_reviews_en.author: S M

restaurants.name: KFC Midtown Asok
restaurants.address:

189 1, Khwaeng Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch is terrible. My boyfriend went to pick up an order, and they used yesterday's chicken to put in the box for the customer. My boyfriend overheard the employees talking about using yesterday's chicken because the delivery rider was pressuring them. It's awful to do that. I'm a former KFC employee who used to work there, so I know what's going on. It's terrible. If they're going to do this, they should close this branch. They're causing trouble for other people, and we don't know if the chicken they gave to customers was contaminated or not.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธัญชนก เงินบริสุทธิ์

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff, manager, or assistant manager spoke rudely and disrespectfully, playing on their phones and ignoring customers. How can someone with such terrible service be a manager? Was this a fluke? They had an unwelcoming expression and were unwilling to serve customers. If they're not willing to provide good service, they shouldn't be there. They're wasting customers' time who genuinely wanted to use the service. How can someone like this be a manager? Could a first-grade student be a manager too??
sample_reviews_en.author: Not Name

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. I ordered several items for takeout. When I received my order, I asked for paper plates. The employee brought one plate and placed it down forcefully, almost throwing it. I was confused as to why they treated me like I was asking for free food when I was paying for it. And to be honest, they only gave me one paper plate – and that was very rude. I've bought from here many times, but today was a very disappointing experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aurora Ch.

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

The food was really delicious and satisfying! The crispy fried chicken was perfectly crunchy on the outside and juicy inside. The spicy chicken with herbs and onions was also full of Thai flavour. Everything was served fresh and hot. Definitely a great spot for fried chicken lovers! Highly recommended. 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Era

sample_reviews_en.text: Customers are all saying the same thing about this branch: terrible service, terrible staff. It's not just the staff; the assistant manager and the manager are no different. Doesn't it seem like there's any management or relevant person overseeing things? I feel terrible every time I use their services.
sample_reviews_en.author: สิ่งสําคัญคือการบริการ ผู้พิพากษาการบริการ

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible service. I asked a staff member (probably the manager) to clear a table, but they replied, "Are there no tables available?" even though the restaurant was empty and I wanted to sit on the sofa. The service should have been better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Katare NTIC

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there without much expectation. I was full and it was raining, so I only ordered two pieces to sit down, but I regret it. It was so delicious. I've been visiting KFC often since then.
sample_reviews_en.author: yours byby

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service staff was terrible, rude, and spoke impolitely.
They were constantly on their phones and speaking in a confrontational manner. Awful.
sample_reviews_en.author: ย่น ย่น

restaurants.name: หยาง​ กั๋ว ฝู​ MALATANG
restaurants.address:

99 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. They didn't inform us that the soup base was out of stock. They only told us when we were about to pay and offered us a choice of other soup bases. The food wasn't cheap, so they should have informed us from the beginning. This is taking advantage of consumers.
2. The staff needs better training. The staff were chatting loudly, ignoring customers, and not maintaining cleanliness at all. While we were eating, the staff kept blowing their noses and spitting loudly for a long time, showing no consideration for those trying to eat. It made it impossible to continue eating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Papichaya Sangarun

sample_reviews_en.text: The soup was tasty. I ordered it extra spicy, but it wasn't very spicy. The food options were limited compared to other restaurants; other places offer much more choices. There were no desserts, and while there was some fruit, they only put out a small amount at a time. When I mentioned it was sold out, they said they didn't have any more and didn't refill it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maiesta May

sample_reviews_en.text: Chicken didnt seem to cook well. I asked for the recook and waited for some times, it came back cold as nth had been done and chicken looked just the same. Cant eat. Vegetables are still raw. Asked for the recook second round. The price is not that competitive as compared to other brand. So, if you have choice. Try sth else.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaweewan Gatepithaya

sample_reviews_en.text: The food options weren't very extensive. They were out of mala chili paste, so I ordered the spiciest mala soup, but it still wasn't spicy enough. The taste was average, edible. The dipping sauces were okay, nothing amazing, just good for a quick fix. The restaurant was clean and the staff were lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: N NS

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten here twice recently.
After I finished getting my food, the staff said they didn't have tomato soup.
The first time I understood.
But the second time they said it was sold out again.
The problem is, why didn't they inform me before I started getting my food?
Or put up a sign saying so?
sample_reviews_en.author: NPB Encourage

sample_reviews_en.text: When I went, the food wasn't fresh; the meat had a strange pink color. The soup, however, was delicious and suited Thai tastes, somewhat similar to Tom Yum noodle soup. There weren't many people there. 100 grams for 55 baht, which was a bit pricey.
sample_reviews_en.author: Porsundos

sample_reviews_en.text: There are student discounts available, and sets are sold. Overall, it's good and conveniently located in a mall. The broth is rich and flavorful, and there's a dipping sauce bar and snacks.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naphat Chumphol

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food, great atmosphere, and flavorful dipping sauces.
The stir-fried dish was especially delicious. I wish the restaurant great success so I can visit again! 😍 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Ling L

restaurants.name: Inle Amhattaya Bangkok အင်းလေးအမှတ်တရ
restaurants.address:

4, 5 Pracha Rat Bamphen 11 Alley, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wow what a great restaurant!

First the people are so nice, they really take care of us and speak very good English to explain the dishes and everything. Plus, the tea is free and really good to quench a thirst!

Then the food is really delicious. Noodles are well cooked and packed with flavours such as peanut or coriander, especially the shan noodles. The vegetable fritters are light and crispy with chunks of various vegetables in it.

Last but not least, the pices are all around 80baht for a generous meal each so it is quite cheap and worth the money.

So just give it a try to support this awesome place!
sample_reviews_en.author: M Boulandu

sample_reviews_en.text: The food here is authentic and full of flavour. This restaurant offers a wonderful glimpse into authentic local flavours with dishes that are both comforting and beautifully presented. The banana leaf sticky rice with garlic topping was fragrant and satisfying, while the noodle soup stood out with its rich, aromatic broth and fresh sides of lime, herbs, and crispy fritters. Generous portions, warm atmosphere, and truly comforting dishes make this place worth revisiting.
sample_reviews_en.author: chawsu leiaung

sample_reviews_en.text: I highly recommend this place if you wanna try authentic Shan food and Shan noodles. The food here is amazingly delicious, and the taste and flavors are truly authentic as it tastes exactly the same as the ones from my hometown. The staff are very polite, friendly, helpful, and professional. I always come to dine here whenever I visit Bangkok. Thank you so much to Inle Amhattya for bringing my hometown’s food to Bangkok. Wishing you more successful years ahead!
sample_reviews_en.author: Poe POE

sample_reviews_en.text: Inle Amhattaya is a delightful restaurant that offers a taste of authentic Shan & Burmese cuisine. My go-to order includes the Burmese Pea Fried Rice, Signature Fried Rice, Shan Noodle, Fried Beans, and Fried Tofu. Each dish is a testament to the restaurant's commitment to quality—never too oily, always delicious, and impeccably clean. Whether dining in or opting for delivery, Inle Amhattaya consistently delivers a satisfying culinary experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naw Hsu Ei Thin Zar (kk)

sample_reviews_en.text: Great, clean little space for dishes from Myanmar. A very different tasting experience to Thai foods. Tried several dishes that looked, and had ingredients totally different. The presentation of dishes is great, even fancy given that it's hard to believe that every item on menu is under 100thb. There is also shelf with cute ingredients to buy to take home. Payment cash or PromptPay. Will recommend to my colleagues.
sample_reviews_en.author: Misma Silfver

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you’re looking for authentic Shan taste, this is the place! I used to eat Shan foods from this restaurant back in Myanmar, and now they have the Bangkok branch opening!
Their signature Shan noodle and Warm Tofu noodle are Must-Try in the menu. Taste is perfect.
Price? Reasonable price when compare to the taste.
Have a parking spot at the front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: phoo pwint Soe

sample_reviews_en.text: If you miss Shan food, you should come to Lako. The taste is the same as when you eat it in the mountains. If you like tofu, you must try tofu. There are fried, sour, fish and rice dishes. I don't know if it's because I like the taste of the dish. I feel that it's a little light. I like the taste of the meat and the curry. I liked the whole menu that I ate today.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kyaw Kyaw

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're craving authentic Shan flavors in Bangkok at an affordable price, Inle Amhattya is a must-visit! 👍👍👍

We had Shan Tofu Nway, Fried Tofu, Sichat Noodle with Steamed Chicken, and Inle Coffee—all exceeded expectations. So glad we made it here for brunch!

✔ Reasonable prices
✔ Superb service
✔ Authentic taste
✔ Relaxed ambience
sample_reviews_en.author: A A

restaurants.name: Wah Ji Wah Indian Restaurant
restaurants.address:

Near royal garden mall beach road Nongprue banglamung District, Beach Rd, Pattaya City, Pattaya, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I am on a holiday here in Pattayya. This is my second consecutive visit to the city . Not to say much there is a very good tasty restaurant across my hotel . All times I have been a regular visitor, guest and a customer this place . They offer the finest Indian cuisine, lots of customs dishes to your taste . So friendly, especially the owner Akshay , who is very amiable , outgoing person, and fulfill his customer needs . Do visit the restaurant and have the food you miss from back home . Do not loose your taste buds . It’s a place of home away from home .
Pavan
Seattle, Washington , USA .
sample_reviews_en.author: Pavan

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had food here 3 times.. we have mixed reviews for the food

Obviously biryani is not fresh and Not spicy. We have ordered extra spicy biryani.. first day it was good but next day it was worst.. Chicken is hard and smelly..

Non veg thali is good here and only preferred food here. All 3 days it was good but chicken was bad. You can try this restaurant once
sample_reviews_en.author: Rajendra Gaddam

sample_reviews_en.text: It's beach side restaurant. It's not proper restaurant basically. Very much affordable and quality food available. They do have vegetarian and non vegetarian options. It's on walking street so you can enjoy beautiful view of beach and alongside road decorations while having your food. They serves fresh and hot meals
sample_reviews_en.author: JAGDISH DUDHATE

sample_reviews_en.text: Worst food I have ever had in my life. I told them not to put spice but still food was too spicy and oil was like floating. There was hardly mutton in mutton curry everything was too bad I shared this with owner I paid 730baht all waste of money. 0 star from my side. Also the service is very poor.
sample_reviews_en.author: VISHALI KATHURIA

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm a tourist from Japan.
The food was delicious, I was allowed to sleep on the sofa, and the staff were friendly, so I was able to relax and unwind :)
There's a cool boss behind the bar.
If you're in Pattaya, I highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: 高橋歩奈

sample_reviews_en.text: We were very happy with the quality and flavour or our beef vindaloo and butter chicken. The naan was perfect and the birijani was also delicious. The staff were happy and friendly, the small shop has front and rear entrance and is air …
sample_reviews_en.author: JustLivingItUp

sample_reviews_en.text: Good Indian food with authentic taste. Curries were flavorful, naan was fresh, and portions were decent. Service was polite and quick. Prices are reasonable. Nice place when you’re craving proper Indian food — would visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: 60 Sri Ranga prakash

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good Indian restaurant in Pattaya. Good atmosphere and Food is the best here. Loved the mutton biryani and Dal Kichidi very much. Starters are also very good especially chilli chicken ,Manchuria and malai chicken kebab❤️.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sai Kumar

restaurants.name: A&W
restaurants.address:

Rat Phatthana, Saphan Sung, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
To wrap things up before closing, we had Waffle To Go and Curry Fries.
We didn't get to try Root Beer because the machine was broken, so we had to try the canned version instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Surasi Prasobdhanakij

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the service was okay, and there was a wide variety of dishes. Personally, I think it was quite good value for money. They gave a generous portion of Coke.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eternal14 CH_

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the staff provides good service, and the atmosphere is nice for a relaxing meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanupong Mee

restaurants.name: เฮียธานี ราดหน้ายอดผัก by บ้านคุณย่า
restaurants.address:

ห้างเซ็นเตอร์วัน อนุสาวรีย์ชัยสมรภูมิ ชั้น 3 ใกล้ทางออกที่จอดรถ เลขที่ 1, Soi Loet Punya, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is absolutely delicious, I have to say! I ordered it two days in a row because I was so hooked. You can order through Line Man and they participate in the government's co-payment scheme. The portions are huge; even a man would be full after eating here. It's easiest to get there by BTS, getting off at Victory Monument station. Parking is difficult, so ordering for home delivery is convenient. The food is fresh and just like eating at the restaurant. The restaurant has 7 recommended delicious dishes. I've already tried 3: Crispy Pork Basil with Fried Egg, Soft Shell Crab Fried Rice, and Grilled Pork with Jaew Dipping Sauce over Rice. They are all amazing, living up to their reputation. The crispy pork with chili fish sauce is incredibly delicious. If you haven't tried it, you absolutely must at least try it at least once in your life.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benz

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food came out very quickly. The taste was excellent, with a good balance of herbs and spices, and the ingredients were of high quality. Cleanliness was superb, and the restaurant atmosphere was pleasant with bright lighting and good ventilation. The prices were reasonable, especially for set meals which were even cheaper. The staff were attentive and very polite.

In an area where Korean and Japanese food is almost completely overshadowed, the presence of such good Thai food is definitely worth supporting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zompoch Boyd

sample_reviews_en.text: Grandma's Noodle Shop is located at the entrance of Soi Rangnam, opposite Century Mall. There's no parking during the day. In the evening, you might be able to sneak in some parking in Soi Rangnam, but be careful before 6 PM to avoid getting your car towed. For a safer and more comfortable meal, park at Century Mall, buy a drink at Tops, and get your parking ticket stamped. Their Pad Thai with Chantaburi noodles is delicious, with great flavor and chewy, soft noodles.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunny พาสุข สนุกสนาน

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, I ordered food from Grandma's Noodle Shop near Soi Rang Nam, but not noodles because I wanted to eat stir-fried basil. I ordered three boxes of stir-fried minced beef with basil and a free fried egg. Each box had a different level of spiciness. I ate the extra spicy box; it was full of chilies and had a strong aroma of roasted chilies. The taste was satisfyingly spicy. I washed it down with a sour and salty minced pork soup, which was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Coke Somchai

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered stir-fried beef with basil and a fried egg for delivery, not expecting much, but it exceeded my expectations. It was delicious and exactly what I wanted. The beef was stir-fried until dry, with a nice smoky aroma, and the flavor was deliciously spicy – ​​just the way I like it! 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Asit Dangthanom

sample_reviews_en.text:
Truly a hidden gem.
Delicious and flavorful, affordable, and accepts the government's co-payment scheme. I tried the chicken basil and crispy pork with chili and garlic for lunch, and I wanted to eat it again in the evening. Pair it with orange juice and taro in coconut milk – pure bliss.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ssy

sample_reviews_en.text:
Your grandmother taught you very well! Wishing the shop owner great success and attention to detail.

P.S. I wish they had snacks available. I'm still hungry but didn't know what else to eat.
P.S.2 I came looking for the Pad Thai in the picture, but they didn't have it on the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zhenzhu Ma

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and reasonably priced. I'm not sure of the exact opening hours, but it closes around 10 PM. The restaurant is located in Soi Rangnam, opposite Century Mall. There's no parking available; you'll need to park in Century Mall's parking lot.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุพิชชา ยืนยง

restaurants.name: วา วา ชาบู WA WA SHABU
restaurants.address:

361 Yukol 2 Rd, Wat Thep Sirin, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Homemade style shabu shabu restaurant.
The highlight is the carefully selected, high-quality ingredients.
I love the dumplings, meatballs, and the fresh, bouncy vegetables.

The noodles are incredibly fresh and of excellent quality.

The cleanliness is superb.

If you're in the area, give it a try; you won't be disappointed. Parking is available on both sides of the street in front of the restaurant.

It started with a friend inviting me, and now it's become my regular spot when I crave shabu shabu. The price is also very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sun Yu

sample_reviews_en.text: This place needs a lot of improvement. There's only one person serving at the front of the shop, doing everything, which is unacceptable. The price is 410 baht, but the service is like this? The menu is very basic. The beef and pork were okay, but the seafood had a fishy smell. Everything else was just passable. I'll try it again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ve Sebastian

sample_reviews_en.text: The chrysanthemum tea was amazing! The 20 baht bottle was huge and tasted great, just like the chrysanthemum tea you find at pharmacies. As for the shabu-shabu, the single-serving bowl was generous and filled the whole bowl. The dipping sauce was delicious, a Cantonese-style sukiyaki sauce. Overall, it was delicious and affordably priced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Klissapas “Beer” Kruthanawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time eating here, and the food was delicious! The sliced ​​pork was huge, and the shrimp dumplings were the best! ❤️ The squid was also excellent.
I was very impressed. It's a very homey shabu-shabu restaurant with amazing quality. The quality far exceeds the price. I highly recommend it! I'll definitely be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitikan Kraisaeng

sample_reviews_en.text: The shabu-shabu was delicious, but the service was extremely slow. We ran out of time and barely got to eat anything. It wasn't worth it at all. We waited for so long, it was a loss for us. Instead of lowering the price because it wasn't our fault (it was your fault for being so slow), they just kept serving the food. Terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Met Sine

sample_reviews_en.text:
Shabu Hommy is so delicious! It's been a while since I last ate here, and it's still as good as ever.

The ingredients are fresh, clean, and high-quality, and they give you generous portions.

I especially like the thinly sliced ​​pork belly; it's perfectly thin.

The owners, an elderly couple, are lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: daydream j

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is delicious and not to be missed. The restaurant provides high-quality products, including very large prawns, but you can only order one serving (6 prawns) at a time. Ordering 6-8 times makes it worth the price per person. The prawns are truly large and very fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pook NineTails

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a convenient store near my workplace. When I'm tired and want something to eat, I can go there close by. The food quality is good, and the prices are moderate—not too cheap, not too expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthida Chabplun

restaurants.name: Sukhumvit Soi 19 Noodle Shop
restaurants.address:

259 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious and reasonably priced.

The shop moved from a side street near Terminal 21 to the Tops food court in Robinson Sukhumvit.
The meatballs are homemade using the shop's own recipe.
Dishes I ate:
- Dry Beef Noodle Soup - A must-order, incredibly delicious! Tender beef, bouncy meatballs, adding roasted chili makes it even better.
- Tom Yum Noodle Soup - Satisfyingly spicy, tasty pork slices, bouncy meatballs.
- Vietnamese Rice Noodle Soup (Goi Cuon) - Soft noodles, with minced pork, Vietnamese sausage, and bouncy meatballs. Delicious!
The prices are good, around 45-55 baht.

If you're in the area, you should definitely try it. A Sukhumvit gem!
But avoid going during lunchtime on weekdays because it gets crowded with office workers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yk Wong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I wonder how many potential customers have been misled by the directions in Google. For the record, this stall is located in the food court at B1 in the same building as Robinson Department Store, together with Top Supermarket. Not inside Grace Baptist Church.

It serves your quintessential Thai Beef Ball / Pork noodles. Nothing special but price is cheap at 50 bahts a bowl. You get to add as much bean sprouts and basil leaves as much as you like, besides all the other usual condiments like chilli flakes, sugar, ground peanut and fish sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wilson Foo

sample_reviews_en.text: A Thai friend of mine told me that this restaurant is delicious but always packed, making it a popular spot among locals. Regardless of the toppings, a regular portion costs 45 baht and a large portion costs 55 baht. I always order the one with beef. Unlike other restaurants, the portions are generous, so even a regular portion is enough to fill me up. The best time to get there is around 11:00 AM.
sample_reviews_en.author: 岩間 智

sample_reviews_en.text: Love it! A quaint hole in the wall kinda of noodle shop along Soi 19. In between the church and spa, easy walk from Asok BTS station. Serves great beef/pork/fish balls noodles in a light peppery soup. The portions are not big but enough to sooth the cravings. Cost only 40 THB per bowl.
sample_reviews_en.author: W.M. LIEW

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is literally a hole in a wall. With no sign of the shops name on the building, only on a sign outside written in Thai.  I asked a Thai what is the name and they told me Taiwan Noodle Shop.  Not the cleanest place for sure, but food tastes great for a great price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jim Totaro

sample_reviews_en.text:
It wasn't a particularly special taste, but it was decent, so I liked it!

You should keep hygiene in mind, and I noticed a lot of locals coming in on their way home from work. Since it's cramped, I had to eat right next to the trash can, which was a bit of a shame.
sample_reviews_en.author: 윤싹콤

sample_reviews_en.text: Had the Clear Soup Egg Noodle with Pork Balls at 45 baht and it was filling enough for me. Simple meal and there is English Menu if need. Environment is not the cleanest of all, but I had a quick meal so didn't affect me much. At least my table was clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kai

sample_reviews_en.text:
The beef noodle soup is delicious, and the meatballs are tasty.
For those who order the soup version, it might be a little bland, but the dry version is delicious, and the broth is just right.
sample_reviews_en.author: RO

restaurants.name: Ung Chew Ha
restaurants.address:

299 Sutthisan Winitchai Rd, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Noodle and Wonton Soup Shop, Roast Pork Rice
The highlight is the crispy pork. The skin is crispy, and the meat is tender.
The noodles are silky smooth, soft yet moderately crispy.
The wonton wrappers are a little thick.
The broth is flavorful.
The portions are generous, and the prices are standard.
The shop opens around noon because they have to wait for the crispy pork to cook. They start making the crispy pork quite late in the day, and it takes about three and a half hours to prepare.
Crispy pork lovers must stop by and try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Soottipong Winyoopradist

sample_reviews_en.text:
This shop seems to be quite old. I used to live in Soi 25 when I was a kid (5 years old) until I was in my twenties.
Back then, I loved their delicious noodle soup. The owner's daughter was around my age at the time.
The shops next door used to be general stores. It's changed now.

Just dropping by to give a rating 😊 Missing it! Almost 25 years already. I'll stop by again sometime.
sample_reviews_en.author: N

sample_reviews_en.text:
The crispy pork was excellent, the noodles were excellent, and the roasted pork was excellent. We ordered dry noodles. If you want soup, you have to pay an extra 5 baht.
The shop is located at the entrance of Soi Inthamara 25.
Actually, they open before noon, so you might want to stop by and check it out.
sample_reviews_en.author: DK

sample_reviews_en.text: The delicious barbecued pork comes with homemade yellow noodles. I once asked the owner, and he said he's been kneading and selling noodles since he was born, using traditional Thai noodle-making techniques. (Just kidding!)
sample_reviews_en.author: aum Yimchaeng

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dry noodles with crispy pork.
I like the noodles; they're thin and firm. The crispy pork is good; I like its thickness and tenderness. But when everything is combined, it's just okay, nothing amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kewalee S.

sample_reviews_en.text: Authentic taste of Thai Chinese-Hong Kong "fastfood" away from crowded Chinatown. Complimentary drinks are great! I personally recommend "O-leang", Thai black coffee.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phumrapee Kornnanan

sample_reviews_en.text: The dry noodle salad with crispy pork is absolutely amazing! It's delicious without needing any extra seasoning, and they give you plenty of crispy pork.
sample_reviews_en.author: NATTHA PLOYONG

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food, lots of unique items on the menu. It's a shame there's no parking. I highly recommend the crispy pork; it's absolutely amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: คุณกล้า ประชานาถ

restaurants.name: Note's Restaurant
restaurants.address:

357 80 ม.10 Buakhaow 15, หนองปรือ Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I love this small restaurant/bar.  Every dish I have had has been great.  The owners Note and Michael are lovely people.  The staff are very attentive and are also wonderful people.  They make you feel right at home.  Very fun place to hang out, have a drink and shoot some pool.  I highly recommend Note’s!
sample_reviews_en.author: Steven

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's strangely 1.5 times more expensive than other places!
And the Pad Thai is capsicum-based... oh my...
I love this place so much that I've been here three times in a year in Pattaya -
but this is the first time I've seen Pad Thai this bad.
Go somewhere else ~~~~~
sample_reviews_en.author: HEEWON KIM

sample_reviews_en.text: When on vacation there are so many places to eat, but Notes just fit so perfect.  The Food was great and my wife and I had to return during our trip. Just wish the curry came with a side of rice.  If we get back to Pattaya, we will eat here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dan R

sample_reviews_en.text: Good location, easy to get to(right behind the Avenue shopping mall) , everything I have eaten there is really really good! Everything is fresh and hot! (And the beer is cold)  :)  I eat here a couple of times a week.
sample_reviews_en.author: daz dragon

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten a few times at Note's with my family. Everything  is done right! Staff is very friendly. Music is great. The owners Mike and Note really welcoming and fun to chat with. Can't wait for my next visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Julia O'Neill

sample_reviews_en.text: Just strolled around the corner to Note's for a light meal. Ordered the pork ribs and seafood yellow curry. The food and service were very good. Very nice to sit on the outer edge and watch the world go by.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anthony Dono

sample_reviews_en.text: Lovely homely bar with great grub. Almost like a private club atmosphere. Regulars eat and drink on a routine basis and take advantage to have a game of pool. Terrific atmosphere. The drain is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom O

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious and the atmosphere was great.
Overall, it was very good value for money, clean, and offered both Thai and Western food 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻 I recommend trying it! …
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattanun Khumjun

restaurants.name: Ronin Pizza พงษ์เพชร
restaurants.address:

17, 8 ซอย ชินเขต 2/6 แยก 2-5 Thung Song Hong, Lak Si, Bangkok 10210, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
The homemade pizza dough is freshly baked, soft and fluffy, and doesn't get hard even if left for a while. I really liked the truffle ham pizza; I understand why it's a best-seller. It's even better when eaten in the restaurant, hot and with gooey cheese. On the day I went, there was a promotion: 2 pizzas (10”) for 599฿, with the option to add extra toppings.

The pizza is worth the price, but I think the salads and side dishes are overpriced. Dipping sauces like chili sauce and ketchup, which should be readily available, cost an extra 19฿.
