The Phong Phet branch is a small shop with limited seating; it focuses more on delivery.
sample_reviews_th.author: Aom P.

sample_reviews_en.text: I pre-ordered at 10:42 AM, the store opens at 11:00 AM, and it was delivered at 12:40 PM. What I received was a pizza that was completely cold. While that might be acceptable, the problem was that it was excessively cold, as if it had been left out for a long time. I could have microwaved it, but I've never encountered that before. The main issue is that the pizza was cold and soggy. I think it was put in the box while still hot, causing condensation. If it had arrived earlier, there wouldn't have been a problem, but the long wait meant the evaporated water was trapped inside the box, making the pizza wet and the dough soggy. Some toppings were waterlogged and swollen. I believe the problem is with the delivery process. I'm not sure if they waited until several orders were completed before calling the delivery person, but what I got was a pizza where the parts that weren't soggy were cold and sticky, and the soggy parts were... well, you know. I think it would be much better if it were served hot at the store or delivered on the spot. At the very least, please don't deliver it ice-cold.
sample_reviews_en.author: thana pongsaskulchoti

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is probably our third time eating at this pizza place, and I have to say, the quality is still as good as ever. It's so delicious, we want to keep coming back! 🍕

What impressed us the most was the pizza crust. Normally, I tend to throw away the crust because many places find it dry and tasteless, but Ronin's crust is amazing. It's fragrant, soft, and perfectly chewy – we ate every last piece without leaving a single crust!

The dough and toppings are also delicious, made with high-quality ingredients and perfectly balanced flavors. But for us, the star of the show is truly the crust. If a restaurant can make someone like me, who usually doesn't eat crust, finish it all, then they're amazing!

For anyone looking for a great pizza place around Phong Phet, this is a place we highly recommend without hesitation. Our third visit is the best proof of how delicious and impressive it is! 🍕❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: N T

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tiny Slice of Heaven
Tucked away on a quiet street, this pizza gem with only three tables feels like dining in a secret trattoria. The focus is clear: quality over quantity. The star of the show is the Margherita pizza—simple, classic, and absolutely perfect.

The crust is thin yet chewy, kissed with just the right char from the wood-fired oven. The tomato sauce bursts with freshness, and the mozzarella melts into creamy pools that balance beautifully with fragrant basil leaves. You can taste the love and precision in every bite.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wisanu Tuntawiroon

sample_reviews_en.text: I really like the rocket salad; the balsamic dressing is the best, the flavors are perfectly balanced. The pizza is also delicious; the ham pizza isn't too salty, although the crust might be slightly burnt. Most orders seem to be delivery, but you can eat in the restaurant, although there are only two tables available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wan

sample_reviews_en.text: Ronin's strength lies in its consistent quality and taste across all branches. It's a very good pizza restaurant. This branch has 3 tables, seating approximately 10 people in total. Reservations are recommended if you're coming during lunchtime. There's parking for 4-5 cars in front of the store.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwan Kajornchaiyakul

sample_reviews_en.text: The pizza is delicious! Everything is great. Eating at the restaurant is the best, but you might want to call and reserve a table beforehand because there are only two tables. Currently, they have a promotion: two 10-inch pizzas for 599 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eksuwan Dear

sample_reviews_en.text: We ate pizza here and it was delicious! The crust was thin, the toppings were generous, and the sauce was tasty. The staff provided good service. Today I had the bacon Hawaiian pizza, and it was amazing! They don't have a huge menu, though.
sample_reviews_en.author: praparat pitakpongputorn

restaurants.name: บะหมี่ ตี๋น้อย
restaurants.address:

54 38 Phran Nok Phutthamonthon Sai 4 Rd, Bang Phrom, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Review of Tee Noi Noodle Shop - A Hidden Gem! 🦞🔥

🌟 Rating: 5/5 🌟

If you're looking for an extraordinary Tom Yum noodle dish, you have to try this place! 🍜✨ The dish in this bowl is Tom Yum noodles with roasted pork, "dragon eggs," and shrimp – a truly spectacular presentation! 🦞

✅ Premium ingredients – Large, plump, juicy, and incredibly fresh shrimp! 🦞🐟
✅ Deliciously spicy Tom Yum – Rich, spicy, sour broth with the aroma of peanuts and fried garlic. Spicy food lovers will adore it! 🔥🌶️
✅ Generous toppings – Includes fragrant roasted pork and plenty of "dragon eggs" (spicy shrimp). 🍖🥢
✅ Beautiful tableware – Thai-patterned bowls that perfectly complement the atmosphere. Just seeing them makes your food look delicious! 💙🤍

📌 Summary: Delicious, great value, and worth the price. A must-try for those who appreciate fine dining at an affordable price! 🍽️🔥 Anyone passing by should stop and try it – you'll definitely be hooked! 😋💯

Recommended to eat after dark when the weather is cooler 👍

#ShrimpNoodles #PremiumTaste #MustTryForFoodies
sample_reviews_en.author: Sam Ti

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is so incredibly delicious, I could use the word "delicious" excessively! The creamy shrimp wonton soup is amazing, so flavorful ❤️❤️❤️ I highly recommend trying it. I'm not a paid endorser, I paid for it myself 🤣🤣🤣 The soup is so delicious and well-balanced. It might sound like I'm exaggerating, but it's genuinely that good! The price is also reasonable and budget-friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Apinyakorn Chavalitnithikul

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner provides good service, the place is clean, and the prices are fair. They serve noodles, rice with roast pork, crispy pork, crab dumplings, shrimp dumplings, pork dumplings, and even lobster. There is seating available and parking is available on the street next to the Caltex gas station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Machai Buanditkjon

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is located by the roadside. The honey-roasted pork noodles are fragrant and delicious. I ordered the dry version with broth, which was very fragrant and flavorful. The shop also provides roasted chili powder, which I really liked when added to the noodles; the chili aroma was perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nadzoh

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here before and liked the thin, soft, and springy noodles. But today I arrived at the restaurant a little after 11 am and only just found out they open at noon, so I couldn't eat because I had other errands to run and wouldn't have been able to wait. What a shame.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vichuta Diloksambandh

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered dry wonton noodles with barbecued pork and crispy pork to take home.
The thin yellow noodles were perfectly cooked. The barbecued pork and crispy pork were delicious. The broth was fragrant and just the right amount of sweetness. I finished the whole bowl.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aranya Tongnumtago

sample_reviews_en.text:
The noodles were delicious, and the crispy pork was incredibly crispy!
It's a must-try item, I highly recommend it. The food is clean, tastes great, and the atmosphere is fantastic and very relaxing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jzy JaNe

sample_reviews_en.text: The sauce for the barbecued pork is on the sweet side, but that depends on personal preference. The barbecued pork and the soup are delicious. Give it a try; it's tastier than you might expect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittivong Suphachaisirikul

restaurants.name: Watchara Phochana
restaurants.address:

166 122 Charan Sanit Wong Rd, Ban Chang Lo, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

restaurants.name: The Oyster bar x Escape Bangkok
restaurants.address:

5th floor in the middle of Escape Bangkok, Emquartier 689 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Having visited Bangkok for the last 30 years since 1995, I always try my best to seek out a new experience and a new pearl somewhere in this fabulous city of wonderful food.

And tonight was a pearl of its own as we discovered Oyster X at the Escape EM Quarter. And order the 12 piece combination oyster platter.

Tasting four different types of oysters we fell in love with the Josephine, which is imported from France. Mixed with their amazing Thai basil, garlic chilli seafood sauce with fresh lemon juice these oysters redefined the experience of a wonderful night on a beautiful rooftop patio in Bangkok.

You must come to this place even if it’s just for 12 oysters before you go somewhere else. You have to try this.
sample_reviews_en.author: C J

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing. I come to EmQuartier often but never knew this place existed. A stunning setting, cool music and lovely atmosphere. I love oysters and I eat them often. This was so good. Really fresh. I ordered six pieces of the finely selected premium oyster. This was basically a combination of three different oyster varieties. Beautifully presented. I could have had another six. Good quality. The condiments were really good too. Added a real kick. The mojito was perfect with it. Very reasonably priced. Great service and friendly staff. Highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Taylor Deni

sample_reviews_en.text: This rooftop spot is great for dates because of the ambiance and attentive service members. Oysters are on the higher price point but definitely served fresh and taste good. Other menu items limited but most people probably come to take photos lol.
sample_reviews_en.author: James H.

sample_reviews_en.text: We appreciated the 1-for-1 drinks offer – that was a great start! We ordered a plate of 12 oysters, and while we enjoyed them, we noticed they weren't quite as chilled as we prefer, which can impact the experience. The US oysters, in …
sample_reviews_en.author: Clarence Chia

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere and ambiance were good, but I personally didn't find the cocktails particularly outstanding, and the snacks were just average. The oysters were high-quality. However, the price was definitely high.
sample_reviews_en.author: calvin kwok

sample_reviews_en.text: The oysters here, especially the Josephine ones, were particularly impressive and deserve a 5.0 rating. If there's room for improvement, perhaps the cocktails could be served a little more generously.
sample_reviews_en.author: jiang lin

sample_reviews_en.text: Nong Tangthai recommended the oysters very well. The bartender here, Pupee, provided excellent service. Top-notch, Number 1! She's second to none at escaping (a bartending session).
sample_reviews_en.author: ORAYA _ M

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my second visit. The oysters are fresh, clean, and delicious, with many varieties to choose from. Personally, I like the Irish Supreme; it's sweet and has a firm texture. …
sample_reviews_en.author: sabsidee payakharn

restaurants.name: Fuji Restaurant
restaurants.address:

607 Phet Kasem Rd, Bang Wa, Phasi Charoen, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a standard restaurant that's usually not amazing, and lately I haven't been very impressed. The only dish I really like is their cold seafood soba.

But today I happened to be at this branch (Seacon Bang Khae) and suddenly wanted soba, and surprisingly, the food quality was excellent in every aspect (even though it was a Monday). Even the garnishes, like the vegetables and lemon slices, were beautiful and fresh. The salad greens were incredibly fresh and crisp.

Most importantly, the portion sizes felt larger than usual. The wasabi was also plentiful, without needing to ask for more (or maybe that's because nowadays they charge for it). If they maintain this consistency, I'll definitely be coming back more often.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ticha Pathumwan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ate a hot pot pork set. It's delicious, salty, and good once in a while.
The advantage of eating a proper meal is that there are plenty of vegetables to eat.

The sukiyaki set with beef and sashimi looked good.
In my personal opinion, the amount of meat in this dish was a little too little. The taste was okay.

I ate at lunchtime and they gave me a drink, one glass, with a choice of
lemon tea, coffee, or iced tea.
I chose lemon tea, which was a little too sweet.

The flame-seared salmon sushi tasted okay.
Overall, the food was good, but the price was a bit high.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naret Kedkanyarat

sample_reviews_en.text: There was a hair in my food. I told the waiter, but instead of replacing it, they just put a new sandwich on top of the old one, leaving the old one still there. They told me to check the food when it was served, but I didn't see the hair at first, only while eating. This is the last time I'll ever eat there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ni TripleBees

sample_reviews_en.text:
The quality matches the price, but the food was a bit slow to come out, even though it wasn't crowded the day I went.

The grilled mackerel was dry, not fishy, ​​and had no small bones left. The sashimi was fresh. The garlic fried rice, however, wasn't as good as at Barbecue Plaza.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaweekai Chok

sample_reviews_en.text: The food service is extremely slow. I ate with my girlfriend and waited until she finished eating before our food was served. This has happened several times already. 🙄
sample_reviews_en.author: Blue Magic

sample_reviews_en.text: I was very confused. We sat down at a table and no one brought us a menu. In the end, we just left the restaurant. The staff didn't seem very interested in customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: The A

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious Japanese food of consistent quality. The new grilled pork rice bowl is amazing! The tempura is also good, but I wasn't a big fan of the steamed egg custard.
sample_reviews_en.author: Viroon Manacharoenying (BubbleBoard)

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a family-friendly restaurant. The prices are high because of the 10% service charge, but thankfully they have a points system for discounts.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปุณยนุช ศรีโสมะสัจจะกุล

restaurants.name: Ootoya Central Bang Na
restaurants.address:

MJ9M+WWM, Bang Na-Trat Frontage Rd, Bang Na Nuea, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything got worse. Food was served slowly, with long waits. There weren't few staff members, but they seemed constantly busy. Customers called for service multiple times, but it's unclear if they heard or ignored us because they were busy or just pretending not to notice. The miso soup tasted worse, bland. The steamed egg custard wasn't hot. I ordered the new beef tongue set, waited a very long time, and the food that came out was nothing like the picture. Some pieces looked like leftovers from a previous customer's order; they were hard and clearly from a previous order. Previously, the service and food were good. This time was a huge disappointment. I will never eat there again. This is the Central Bangna branch. Staff should apologize to customers properly, not just say "I'll check on it" and then give a blank stare.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teerada Fukuda

sample_reviews_en.text:
Yesterday evening, around 4:30 PM, we went for dinner. Even though there were only two other tables occupied, it was a terrible experience. A cleaning staff member started sweeping the floor near our table while we were still eating. They moved the table around loudly, so we told a female staff member. She then told the male cleaning staff member.
We asked, "Could you please stop sweeping? The dust is flying around, and we're eating..."
He stopped, but then switched to sweeping the table furthest inside, seemingly angry. He moved the table around loudly again!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuchala Baba

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is high quality and delicious, the service is good, and there's a wide variety of desserts and drinks. Plus, there are special offers only at Ootoya:
🍵 Unlimited free refills of roasted rice green tea (hot/cold).
*Except for the Phuket branch, green tea refill is 39.-/person.

🍚 Unlimited free refills of Japanese rice or multi-grain rice when ordering a set meal and finishing your first bowl of rice.
*Note:
Hijiki seaweed rice +10.-/serving
Okaka rice bowl +15.-/serving
Jako fish rice bowl +20.-/serving

#Ootoya #AuthenticJapaneseTasteThatNeverChanges
sample_reviews_en.author: Suthida Chaw

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located on the fifth floor, in front of the elevators.
The food is delicious, clean, and the prices are typical for a mall.
I was particularly impressed with their desserts; they're delicious and reasonably priced.
It's great that you can have both savory and sweet dishes in one place.

The service is standard; however, there aren't many staff members, so be prepared for a wait during peak hours.

My favorite is their tofu dishes; they're incredibly delicious, and I always order them whenever I visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: RUJIPAT CHATHERANSASITHORN

sample_reviews_en.text:
While dining at Ootoya in Bang Na, we needed a wheelchair. Ms. Phat and the other staff members immediately noticed and kindly assisted us.

Had I gone to fetch it myself, it would have been like arriving at a hotel and opening the car door on my own instead of letting the doorman do his job—something that might embarrass the host.

My gratitude goes to Ms. Phat, the Ootoya team, and Centara Group for their professionalism and dedication. A truly wonderful restaurant where you can dine with peace of mind.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nam Wa

sample_reviews_en.text:
The nabe (hot pot) was mediocre in taste; the miso soup wasn't good and lacked miso flavor.
The udon noodles were chewy and delicious, but the dipping sauce was quite bland.
The pumpkin croquettes were tasty.
I used an AIS promotion, reducing the price to 444 baht, but I had to pay in cash; card payments weren't accepted, which was strange.
Based on the taste and service, I probably won't return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pan Chantakulchai

sample_reviews_en.text: Always one of our favorite home style Japanese restaurant franchises that still tastes exceptional and special every time. The chicken and fish were charcoal grilled perfectly, served with tasty fresh Japanese side dishes and unlimited rice and green tea refills. Service is also on point and the convenience of it being inside a shopping mall is great. Always leave satisfied.
sample_reviews_en.author: Simon Leong

sample_reviews_en.text:
We've walked past this restaurant so many times, I don't know why, but this time we decided to give it a try. The food here is surprisingly delicious! They have kids' meal options too. The quality of the food is good for the price, and they have a good selection of desserts. We especially liked their matcha ice cream.

#TravellingAsACouple
sample_reviews_en.author: Bell Belle

restaurants.name: FGF Restaurant (Paew and Michel)
restaurants.address:

367/9 S Pattaya Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
FGF Restaurant serves an interesting mix of Thai and Western dishes with pasta and Western meat dishes being popular. There is a god variety of “over-rice” dishes for those looking for some Thai food as well as some Thai curries.

Catering to a mixed crowd of Westerners and Thais the restaurant is a little ramshackle and could do with some sprucing up but the Thai owner/chef, working alone on our visit, made the experience a pleasant one, taking our order and then hurrying back to the kitchen to cook.

We were impressed by the food - we had pad gra pao, kanna moo grob and a pad Thai - all were delicious but just a little disappointed by the crispy pork on the kanna moo grob - this is one of my favourite dishes though, so am now pretty fussy about this.

We would have appreciated a non-smoking policy in place as all the other tables were either smoking or vaping on our visit but appreciate the desire to keep as many people happy as possible.

Pad Thai B60, other dishes from B65. Three dishes came to B180.

Recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Matthew Dallow

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the pork and vegetable stir-fried rice for 50B. The stir-fried vegetables are a simple dish that never disappoints. It was delicious.

Free water is self-service.

The open terrace has 10 table seats, and it looks very cozy. It's a popular restaurant with a steady stream of seemingly regular Farang customers.

There was both a photo menu and a text menu. I've uploaded both.

The text menu can be translated with Google Lens. The menu is divided into Thai food, pasta dishes, meat dishes, and one-plate rice dishes.

Wi-Fi (5G) upload speeds were 29Mbps and download speeds were 15Mbps.
sample_reviews_en.author: Syo Kei

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great local place with excellent Thai food and homemade pastas!
I've tried several dishes here and I have to say, this place is hard to beat.
Thai dishes are really good and well priced for a 'medium' sized portion
But absolutely good is their homemade pasta. Fresh, big sizes and reasonably priced starting from 150b
I highly recommend the spaghetti Bolognese, ravioli pork 4 cheese and lasagna.
sample_reviews_en.author: danny haren

sample_reviews_en.text:
The male owner is a bit sarcastic.
At first, he asked if I was Chinese, and when I told him I was Korean, he smiled and gave me a thumbs-up. Hahaha.

The food came out quickly, and the menu was full of pictures, which was convenient. I just ordered whatever looked delicious!

It's a local restaurant, but there were a lot of Westerners, and the prices were very reasonable!
sample_reviews_en.author: Shanny

sample_reviews_en.text:
A fantastic time at Tao and Michel's restaurant! We received a warm welcome upon arrival, and the atmosphere was truly delightful. The dishes were delicious, prepared with care and passion (my pasta carbonara was excellent)! I loved the experience and am so glad I discovered this place. Thank you to them for this wonderful time; I will definitely be back!

:)
sample_reviews_en.author: Benedicte Irigoyen

sample_reviews_en.text:
There's a bit of a wait because everything is made to order, not prepared in advance (not even the pasta), so the freshness and quality are excellent. Generous portions, unbeatable price for Italian/French food in Pattaya. Not much of an atmosphere, just a trattoria setting open to the street.
Highly recommended!

PS: 300-400 with a Big Chang beer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Herve Blandin

sample_reviews_en.text:
First of all, the owner does not even properly greet guests when they arrive. They only do their own thing regardless of whether an order is placed or not, and lack basic manners toward customers.

Both the quality and quantity of the food are below expectations.
sample_reviews_en.author: 스카치 김

sample_reviews_en.text: Great food, great value. I eat many Thai dishes regularly and this place has some of the best I’ve had in many years of coming here. I live close and I’ve got the feeling this is going to be my new go-to spot. Very friendly service as well! Worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Doss Ramsey

restaurants.name: ชู้ลาว ชู้รส Chulaos Churos - ราชวัตร
restaurants.address:

552 Rama V Rd, Khwaeng Thanon Nakhon Chai Si, Khet Dusit, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The papaya salad was incredibly delicious! The Luang Prabang style was the best. The Thai style papaya salad was also delicious, with a unique aroma and flavor. The grilled udder was soft, good, and very thick. I'm so glad I got to try it because it's hard to find. The picanha was just okay, a bit tough. The biggest disappointment was the Jaew Hon (spicy dipping sauce). The vegetables served were like they were served blindfolded and they didn't care at all. The cabbage was old and bruised with holes, and the celery was yellow, like it had been stored in the refrigerator for ages. The meat was also quite tough. 360 baht 😭 We ordered quite a lot of food, almost filling the whole table. When the staff came to serve, they didn't help clear the finished plates or empty bottles. They just walked over and waited for us to clear them ourselves. We had to keep asking them to take them away. They didn't even come to check if we needed anything else. They just stood with their backs to us, chatting amongst themselves. But the staff themselves were polite and spoke well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fah Chotsirinan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Choo Lao Choo Rot — an Isaan restaurant that has opened a new branch near its original location in Ratchawat. Street parking is available. The ingredients are clean, and the flavors are authentically Isaan.

My favorite dishes were the grilled picanha, which was tender and perfectly cooked to my liking, served with a spicy dipping sauce and pickled radish – a perfect combination.

The Luang Prabang papaya salad used thin, crispy papaya slices, with fermented fish sauce and shrimp paste. The fermented fish sauce was very fragrant and clean, and the flavor was well-balanced.

The thin rice noodle salad had a fermented fish sauce and shrimp paste dressing with a hint of bamboo shoots, topped with crispy pork rinds and pork sausage – a great combination.

The grilled catfish with spicy dipping sauce was boneless, making it easy to eat. The sauce was flavorful and the fish was firm.

There are many more dishes worth trying. The prices are reasonable. I'll definitely try more on my next visit. Expect a wait during peak hours.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasinon Rungwechwat

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went during the middle of the week, so it wasn't too crowded. There was a table available as soon as we arrived. We scanned the QR code to order, and the food was served in less than 10 minutes! It was super fast! And everything came out one after another without any delays.

: Mangosteen Salad: Amazing! Refreshing, with a perfectly balanced, mild flavor.
: Catfish with Jaew Sauce: Personally, I found both the catfish and the chili sauce a bit too salty.
: Lao-style Papaya Salad: Too salty for my taste.
: Spicy Beef Shank Salad with Fresh Chili: Very zesty, and the beef was perfectly cooked!
: Grilled Picanha: 10/10! The medium doneness was perfect. You have to order this!
: Mixed Instant Noodle Salad: This dish might be a little pricey considering the ingredients, but it's forgivable because the taste was great, and the noodles were perfectly cooked – not soggy at all.
: Crispy Pork: The pork wasn't tough at all. My friend praised this dish a lot.

Overall, we'll definitely be back! 🫶🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Supawadee P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chulao Restaurant has opened a branch at Ratchawat Intersection!
1. It's still the same great somtum (papaya salad) restaurant that makes delicious grilled and fried dishes.
2. We like salty food, but the somtum was still too salty for us. My friend who came with me said the somtum tasted better than at the first branch.
3. The grilled milk is delicious, but you have to eat it while it's hot. If you leave it for too long, it gets cold and isn't as good.
4. There are plenty of tables, so the wait isn't long. There are coffee shops and dessert shops around, so you can go find more food after you finish eating.
5. The restaurant isn't as stuffy as the first branch.
6. There's no parking lot. You can park at the minimart next door, but there are only 3-4 parking spaces. To be safe, we recommend parking at Ratchawat Market and walking over. It's good exercise before you eat!🤣
7. Overall, it's good. We would come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pirombhorn S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
🔥 Choo Lao Choo Rot
This is one of those Isaan restaurants where the flavors are "deliciously intense" from the very first bite. The atmosphere isn't fancy, but it's approachable and friendly, perfect for a meal where you want something spicy and flavorful.

The food here is truly intense, living up to its name "Choo Lao Choo Rot" (meaning "intensity flavor"). It's spicy and satisfying, no need to add any extra seasoning. Those who love strong, authentic Thai flavors will be delighted. The freshness of the ingredients and the seasoning make many dishes stand out beyond expectations. The staff provides good service, is friendly and chatty, and clearly recommends dishes.

Overall, Choo Lao Choo Rot is the perfect restaurant for those who want to eat authentic, full-flavored Isaan food, whether you're coming with friends or bringing your family for a big meal. This restaurant is a great choice. 🥢✨
sample_reviews_en.author: noo maree

sample_reviews_en.text: Before coming to this restaurant, I researched that they don't have their own parking, but there are other parking options. The restaurant had a sign indicating that if you come to eat here, you can park at another location and get a parking ticket from the stationery shop or directly from the restaurant. Today, there were 5 of us, and the bill was 1,500-1,600 baht. However, I was disappointed that they charged 40 baht for parking. It's not a lot, and I could afford it, but I felt like I was the customer paying for this. Why didn't the restaurant take responsibility for the parking fee? We were specifically patronizing their restaurant. I also asked for a receipt to use for company reimbursement, but the restaurant couldn't provide one. Well…very impressive, isn't it?
sample_reviews_en.author: wiraporn Jaikham

sample_reviews_en.text:
The presentation was perfect, everything was spot on! Authentic Som Tum (papaya salad). The menu has a wide variety of dishes to choose from.
Prices: There's a wide range from 50-2/300 baht.

Taste: I know I like salty food, but this place was extremely salty!🤣 I'd give it 4/5. It's a well-balanced saltiness, though. If they reduced the saltiness, it would be amazing.
The staff were lovely and said I could write in the notes to reduce the saltiness. I'll try that next time. Anyone ordering might need to add a note for the restaurant.

Parking: A bit difficult to find. You might have to park further down the road at Ratchawat Market (on the side of the road) and walk, or park at Prasertsin Stationery Shop (40 baht/hour) and walk a short distance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanthamon Phatchirathanan

sample_reviews_en.text: This is another incredibly popular modern Isaan fusion restaurant. We went to their new branch, so we didn't have to wait. Everything was excellent, from the menu to the service and ingredients. However, we found the flavors a bit bland. Two of us preferred salty and savory dishes. The Picanha steak was served raw, and everything else had a similar flavor profile, making it cloying after a short time. The Luang Prabang papaya salad was authentically Laotian, focusing on saltiness and savory flavors. The catfish was tasty, but only served with a dip, which wasn't much different from the steak. Next time, we'll look for dishes with more balanced flavors to cut through the richness.
sample_reviews_en.author: Babe Gourmont BECX guide

restaurants.address:

792 ถ. กรุงเทพ - นนทบุรี Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I stumbled upon this place by chance in this area. Locals said this was a must-try. From the outside, it looks like a typical fish porridge shop in a single storefront, but they prepare the fish exceptionally well. The fish is fresh and the texture is firm. The grouper fish soup is good, especially the fish itself, and the broth is served in a typical rice porridge style. The fish salad is also excellent; I ordered the sea bass version, and it was deliciously tangy and satisfying. The portion is generous, enough to fill you up. The price is reasonable considering the quality of the ingredients. If you stop by, you'll need to park on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Torpong Chiamtawongse

sample_reviews_en.text:
This fish porridge is incredibly delicious! They have a diverse menu, including à la carte dishes, Tom Yum Goong (spicy shrimp soup), and other seafood options.

I came here specifically for the food, and I can honestly say I'll be back again.

Located on Bangkok-Nonthaburi Road.

The fish is firm and delicious, in the Tao Poon area.

The restaurant is small, a single townhouse unit, seating about 12-15 people. The prices are reasonable.

You won't be disappointed!

There's no parking lot; you'll have to park on the street. Parking for those with cars might be inconvenient (it's a gamble).
sample_reviews_en.author: PNG

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I ordered Tom Yum Kung (shrimp) instant noodles (creamy broth) and Tom Yum Kung/Fish instant noodles (creamy broth), 1 bottle of water, and 2 servings of ice. The flavors were as intense as usual. The total cost was 210 baht. Normally, when I come to this restaurant, I order the fish porridge and blanched fish with dipping sauce. If you're looking for a good fish porridge restaurant in the Tao Poon area, this is the place to go!
sample_reviews_en.author: เอ Asp auto

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is fresh and delicious. The fish is truly fresh, large pieces, and not fishy. The prawns are big. There are many menu options. It's clean. The owner is kind, remembers customers' regular orders, has a good memory, is polite, and attentive. There's no parking lot; you have to park on the side of the road. It's hot inside the restaurant, but there are fans. The restroom isn't very clean, but usable for a quick fix.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mui Asawin

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the special seafood rice porridge, 65 baht per bowl. It came in a full bowl with fresh shrimp and squid. I forgot to take a picture when it was served because I was so hungry! I only managed to get this one photo 😆. The oyster omelet was 50 baht per plate, delicious, and the oysters weren't fishy at all. I'll definitely go back to try other dishes!
sample_reviews_en.author: Daisy N rose

sample_reviews_en.text:
Seafood noodles 55 baht. The broth looks clear, but the taste is amazing! Super flavorful, no need to add any extra seasoning.
Blanched seafood with dipping sauce 100 baht. The seafood is fresh and bouncy, and they give you a generous portion.

The restaurant has a very extensive menu. I'll have to go back many more times to try everything on the menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jira B.

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! The shop is located right by the road and is easy to find. The owners are friendly and remember their regular customers' orders. From the outside, it might look like just a fish porridge shop, but inside they have a diverse menu with options like noodles, seafood sukiyaki, spicy chicken salad, omelets, etc.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aumari Khanyod

sample_reviews_en.text:
The dishes I ordered included Spicy Grouper, which was very fresh with firm, bouncy flesh, and the seasoning was almost perfect.
Pork Wonton Soup: The wontons were okay, and the soup was sweet.
Pork Stomach Congee: This one was decent.
In summary, the seasoning of all the dishes wasn't quite to my liking.

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is suitable for smokers. The secondhand smoke is very strong; it's almost impossible to sit comfortably. There's no sign indicating this. The food is average, nothing amazing. The glass noodle salad was a bit mushy. Prices are 100+ baht, which I think is expensive for the taste. The music is loud and ear-piercing. In summary, it feels like friends hanging out, cooking together, and singing. The staff provides good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: piim Sasiya

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted delicious and paired well with the beer. The atmosphere was chill, with live music and football matches. The restrooms are shared by several establishments, which is understandable. Parking was convenient, right in front of the shop. The staff were attentive and friendly, making it feel like a family. Anything you needed was easy to discuss. I was also impressed with the owner. I'll definitely be a regular customer!
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐพล ต๊ะสุยะ

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was incredibly delicious! I want to give an award to the chef. I'm usually a picky eater, but the spicy salad was amazing, and the seafood dipping sauce was the best! Everyone at the table praised it. It was my first time, but I'll definitely go again. I loved the food, and the prices were reasonable, not expensive at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: madmee Nunnaphat

sample_reviews_en.text: Returning to my seat, I was very impressed. The staff provided excellent service, to the point where I felt a little embarrassed. The men's restroom had a slightly strong smell. Overall, it was good. I'll be a regular customer. The music was great!
sample_reviews_en.author: Songyot Asura

sample_reviews_en.text: The hygiene in the kitchen is not okay (I accidentally saw it). The ingredients used in the cooking are like they were almost spoiled. The atmosphere and prices are up to the standards of a roadside chill-out restaurant. The service is average.
sample_reviews_en.author: PHUVANATE SAENGDECHA (Nate Aquarius)

sample_reviews_en.text: I decided to give it another try, and I can say there have been positive changes. The food portions are generous, the service is lovely, and the waitstaff are very friendly. There's live music every day. I'll definitely be back! 💗💗

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the beer is reasonably priced, but the restroom is dirty and there are rats running around inside the restaurant. I hope they will make serious improvements because it's about the food and drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: J N

sample_reviews_en.text: I was planning to sit and watch football, sip beer, but I got hit with secondhand smoke. Sometimes people who drink beer don't smoke or like cigarettes. Experiencing this is like being rushed to finish eating and leave.

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best restaurant taste wise, service wise and above all the person Uttambhai. He is very cooperative and saves our money too. And owner Sharma ji also very polite and helpful. Even he arranged taxi at very cheap rate and within short span of time. Thanks a lot.

The smell is nice.

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum Salmon instant noodles were delicious! The cheese was stretchy and the salmon was tasty and not fishy. The spaghetti had a bit too much of a milky flavor. The atmosphere was okay, but it was quite hot sitting there in the afternoon.😅 My only criticism is that I'd like them to increase the portion size of the snacks a little, or lower the price so it would be more accessible to children.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuu Raindell (Thitakorn Rattanakosol)

sample_reviews_en.text: A pleasant place with fast food. As soon as we arrived, they set up umbrellas for us since there were no tables inside. We ordered two portions of tom yum with salmon and cheese; it was delicious and spicy. We also ordered some kind of thing with mashed potatoes and cheese on top; it was much smaller than we expected, but maybe it was some kind of appetizer.

Had a nice meal! The pic shows chips, berry smoothie and my tom yum soup

A reminder for those who have had spicy things, don't touch your eyes afterwards - I was crying all night 😂

sample_reviews_en.text: I happened to pass by and stopped to take a look, but I couldn't get in. They said it's been closed indefinitely for a year. If you're that scared, just abandon it and build a condo.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mama Cheese is delicious. It's a favorite among students.
Fried pork and fried chicken rice are only 45 baht. Delicious and filling for one meal.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the opportunity to dine there around midnight. The atmosphere was quiet and peaceful as usual. For tall people, sitting at the table might cause a little back pain, typical of Thai izakayas. There were some people smoking and some smoke smell, but the restaurant turned on the fans from the start. There were no mosquitoes, and there were trash cans nearby for convenience.

This time I ate at the restaurant, and the salmon had a strangely fishy taste and the texture wasn't the same as what I'd ordered online. The lemon had a strong, bitter smell that overpowered the taste of the fish and squid. It probably depends on personal preference. The salmon marinated in fish sauce seemed marinated for too long, making it hard and the flavor too strong. Personally, I didn't think it tasted like fish sauce at all, as it was more sweet. The miso soup wasn't spicy or flavorful enough. The ikura (salmon roe) was adequate in quantity. Soy sauce and wasabi were in packets.

The draft beer was delicious and cold. It was worth it even without a promotion. The staff provided good service, and the owner was friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: I suck at this

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food is delicioso! The chef understands what we like.

1. The Tako Wasabi is good but I would loved to have it cold with ice krub!

2. Beef rice is really good, the beef is tender, and he gave us beef more than the rice I think. Haha. But it’s a lot and aroiii!

3. Grilled Saba with teriyaki sauce also good, you can choose to have it in package with rice and salad. It’s really tender, juicy, not fishy, and ultimately good!

4. For the Sushi: Spicy Salmon and some egg idk what is that, it’s really nice, me and my wife order twice for both!

5. Asahi beer in pitcher, free ice bucket, and we have it for 2 people omg I feel in the Japanese heaven.

If you are passing the area, please come and support the business that have a good taste food.
If you are some Japanese freak that like everything similar like in japan, please don’t judge. The food is really good but u cannot compare of course.

Here’s some of madness that we have in the pictures
sample_reviews_en.author: Ign. Ocvin Osetino W

sample_reviews_en.text: This sushi place offers affordable sushi made with high-quality ingredients, starting at just 10 baht per piece. They have a diverse menu, including a spicy salad with fermented fish sauce that's truly delicious. It's perfect for a late-night snack. The atmosphere is nice, with a Japanese-style roadside setting, and it's not too crowded. If you're unsure about closing times, it's best to call ahead. They stay open until 1 AM, which is great for late-night cravings. We ate until we were full and it didn't even cost 1000 baht! The prices are excellent. They make everything to order, so it might take a little longer if it's busy, but rest assured, your order will be complete and delicious. If you want to chill and enjoy a beer, this is the place; they even have draft beer!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wimonwiew Sin.

sample_reviews_en.text: My friends opened this shop and I come here all the time. The prices are amazing and the food is even tastier. Everything I’ve eaten here has been delicious and fresh. I recommend the spicy salmon salad and the salmon set. They portions are huge and if you spend around 250 baht you will be absolutely stuffed.
sample_reviews_en.author: George Zikos

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered delivery. I wanted to try the sea urchin caviar. Photo 1 shows what it looks like when you order delivery. Photo 2 shows what they actually delivered. It cost 139 baht per piece. Totally disappointed. The other sushi was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Владимир

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a delicious restaurant, but the lack of parking is a real problem and needs improvement.
I tried to go 2-3 times but couldn't find a parking spot.
(There were also motorcycles parked blocking the road and next to the restaurant.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Parinya Luxkanawong

sample_reviews_en.text: Really good quality and delicious sushi at a reasonable price! I am not in the area for long but if I was I’d be coming here every week! Very friendly and accommodating service aswell, very much enjoyed our visit here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Josie

sample_reviews_en.text: Cheap, good quality and taste, beyond the price. The pickled shrimp is delicious. The miso soup is good. The shop is very chill, but if you order a lot, you might have to wait a bit for the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaruphat Yusuk

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! Only 20 baht per plate. It comes with vegetables and various chili dips: shrimp paste dip, fermented fish dip, and the shrimp paste dip is especially tasty. It's very filling. You can't find this price anywhere else in Bangkok.

restaurants.address:

47 Ramkhamhaeng 24 Yaek 6, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We booked accommodation through Booking.com for 606 baht. The property is located on Soi Ramkhamhaeng 24, Intersection 6. There's a 200 baht deposit for the key card. It's a short walk from the accommodation. There are noodle shops, a steak restaurant, and a 7-Eleven at the entrance of the soi. It's ideal for those taking exams near Ramkhamhaeng University, Hua Mak campus. You can easily take a motorcycle taxi to the exam venue. We were very impressed with the accommodation. The staff provided excellent service. Ironing service is available for 15 baht per item. If you need to check out early, just let the staff know. The room has a hairdryer, two bottles of water, a TV, a water heater, air conditioning, a table, and a lamp. The accommodation is clean. We've stayed at three places in this soi, and this one was the best – cleanest and with the best service. We've stayed at other places in this soi that were more expensive but had terrible service, were dirty, and smelled strongly of cigarette smoke. This place is excellent and highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rose Taechinee24

sample_reviews_en.text: I booked a room with an extra bed, requesting it in April. On the actual check-in date in August, the hotel informed me that they were out of extra beds because they had already given them to walk-in guests. They only provided extra bedding and charged me for an extra bed without actually providing one. They even claimed I had requested it the night before. Only after I asked them to review the chat history did they stop being so rude. There was no parking available, and they said parking at the hotel would cost extra, without informing me in advance. The staff member who answered the phone was very rude and lacked politeness, acting as if I was begging for a place to stay. They even said something like, "I'd even grovel at your feet to apologize," which is completely inappropriate for a receptionist. This kind of language needs significant improvement. Overall, I was very unimpressed. If I hadn't called to rush them, I probably wouldn't have gotten the extra bed. Their customer management is terrible. Please improve this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanatporn Tanyapibal

sample_reviews_en.text: The room was spacious and quiet. The bed was comfortable, although the pillows were a bit flat 😊. The air conditioning was very cold. There was a refrigerator, hairdryer, and TV in the room, but a kettle and microwave were available in the common area. I stayed for 4 nights and slept well every night. It's located in a side street that's not too deep, and there's a 7-Eleven and many restaurants at the entrance of the street. It's behind Ramkhamhaeng University, making it convenient to get around. Parking is limited, so it's not suitable for those who bring their own car.
sample_reviews_en.author: watcharaporn thamklang

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The air conditioning is very cold, almost freezing.

- There are only 3 parking spaces in front of the accommodation.

- A key card is required to open the front door.

- The bathroom is small.

- To get to the accommodation (by bus), get off at the Big C Hua Mak stop and walk approximately 1 km. If you get off at the Ramkhamhaeng stop and walk, it will be about 2 km.

Disadvantages:
- The room is not very soundproof. While sleeping, you can hear people talking outside and the sound of doors opening and closing from the next room.
sample_reviews_en.author: เจ้าชาย โกมินทร์

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a small, very affordable room with a bunk bed. The bed is comfortable and doesn't cause back pain. The room is clean, and the mattresses are odor-free. It's a great place to stay, especially for those on a budget who want a nice place to stay. Laundry service is available. The hotel is located behind and near Ramkhamhaeng University, convenient for those preparing for exams.

The staff are warm and professional. They are friendly, attentive to every detail of the guests, and treat you like family. 🙏🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Dysn

sample_reviews_en.text: The accommodation is good, close to the market, and food is easy to find. Parking is a gamble as you can't reserve a spot in advance. The room is clean and smells nice, although it's a scent we don't particularly like. There's no space for toiletries in the bathroom; you have to fold down the toilet seat to put things on. Overall, it's very good considering the price. Keep up the good work on improving!
sample_reviews_en.author: Natapan Pongprapai

sample_reviews_en.text: Clean, cool air conditioning, door closes at night with key card access, shoes must be removed and slippers provided. Recommended for anyone taking exams near Ramkhamhaeng University. Quiet and peaceful, close to food options. I wish they would fix the drain under the sink in room 8; it's leaking onto the floor. I forgot to take pictures of the accommodation!
sample_reviews_en.author: Warinnisa Rapeepong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I set the air conditioner to 16 degrees and it was still cold.
It was very dark when the lights were off.
The top bunk requires climbing a ladder to get to.
The water pressure in the bathroom is very strong if you turn the valve all the way up.
The small room is cute; a larger room would be even bigger.
Overall, it was perfect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fast sweet

sample_reviews_en.text:
• The noodle soup (Khao Piak) was delicious! The noodles were chewy and soft, and the broth was flavorful and well-balanced—not too sweet or too salty, just perfect. I personally ate it without adding any extra seasoning.
• The pork sausage salad (Yum Moo Yor) was also good. The dressing was to my liking, not too sour, and very tasty.
• It's a shame they don't have Nem Nuong anymore. I've wanted to try it for a long time because my friends raved about how delicious it was, but I never had the chance. The lady who cooks is lovely, and the guy who makes the drinks is kind.
• However, there was another woman who didn't seem very welcoming. She seemed grumpy and kept circling around, staring at our table with an unfriendly expression. Just a short time after we finished eating (I emphasize, just a short time), she seemed rushed to collect the money and leave, even though the restaurant wasn't busy. She seemed annoyed from the moment we walked in and ordered.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maneerat .B

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant isn't just ordinary delicious; it's beyond delicious. The Vietnamese noodle soup (Goi Cuon) and pho are amazing; the broth is fragrant, sweet, and rich. Don't miss the fried spring rolls, available only on Saturdays and Sundays – crispy, fragrant, and overflowing with filling. I'd give this place 10 stars. The Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork skewers) set is huge; two people could easily share it and couldn't try anything else. There's no parking at the restaurant; you have to park in the nearby alley, and finding a parking spot can be difficult.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gookgae Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: I bought a box of Vietnamese spring rolls from the restaurant, but when I got home, the dipping sauce was missing. I called the restaurant, and they said they had taken some out to sell in their shop and forgot to put the sauce back in. 😭😭 Does that mean my box is secondhand? Why would they open a box and resell it? This isn't okay. How can I be sure the vegetables in the box aren't missing too?
sample_reviews_en.author: PJ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in a single-unit shophouse on Phatthanakan Road, near Phatthanakan Soi 21. The main menu consists of Vietnamese dishes, but they also offer many à la carte options. The owner is Vietnamese, born in Thailand, originally from Nong Khai province. Therefore, the Vietnamese food is authentic, tasty, and affordable.

*Rating: 3.5 stars*
sample_reviews_en.author: Coke Somchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Vietnamese rice noodle soup with two types of noodles, delicious.
The pho is also delicious, with plenty of vegetables. It's clean, and the owner is very friendly. They also have other à la carte dishes, all of which are tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pusadee Kongpakdeepong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, the rice is great.
I love the thick-noodle kway chap, it's hard to find, but they have it here.
This has been my regular restaurant since university days 🤤🤤

sample_reviews_en.text: The broth is fragrant and delicious, the noodles are excellent. The owner is polite and the portions are generous. Highly recommended.

sample_reviews_en.text: The environment is a good size, not too big or too small, and not too noisy. There's even a live band on weekends. The food is great, with snacks, drinks, and home-style dishes at reasonable prices. Fishing is 100 baht per hour, with the first hour costing 200 baht, 100 of which is actually a food voucher. You get one hour free for every 6 hours of fishing. Aside from the distance, everything else is excellent; it's one of the most satisfying fishing spots around Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: mobanche li

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a restaurant that also has a shrimp fishing pond.
1. The restaurant has mid-range prices, good food, a nice atmosphere, and good service.
2. The shrimp fishing pond costs 200 baht for the first hour, which includes 100 baht for fishing and a 100 baht discount on food. Subsequent hours of shrimp fishing are 100 baht each. Personally, I like this type of restaurant because it seems to attract people who genuinely want to fish for shrimp as a form of relaxation.

sample_reviews_en.text: The first hour is 200 baht, which can be used as a 100 baht food coupon. Subsequent hours are 100 baht each. Get 1 hour free for every 6 hours spent. Located in Bang Bon 3 Soi 3, next to Sarasas Bang Bon School. Grilled shrimp is 100 baht per kilo. Food prices are reasonable. Open from 2 PM to midnight.

The food is delicious and affordable, perfect for families. It's air-conditioned but smoke-free (with designated smoking areas), which is great. The owner and staff are lovely and provide excellent service.
The shrimp in the shrimp pond are also large.

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first visit and I was very impressed. It wasn't crowded, the restaurant was clean, the food was delicious, and the owner and the staff provided excellent service.

sample_reviews_th.text: One of the best หมูสเต้ะ in my life! Sooo good! Smoky flavor with juicy pork and the sauce with peanut was sooo good highly recommended
sample_reviews_th.author: Nisagon Phakjatturat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Whilst waiting for my fish ball noodles from Lim Lao Ngow—which turned out to be absolutely disappointing, I am very glad I had the pork satays from this stall.

Looks simple but I am sure a lot of work went into marinating the satays.  Absolutely delicious!  Grilled on the charcoal for the right amount of time.  Succulent and moist to the bite.  Cooked perfectly!  👍👍👍👍👍

Unlike other vendors’, the curried peanut sauce here was pleasantly good.

80 Baht for 10 sticks…  Well worth the money spent. 😉

Waited about 20mins, but I was glad I did.  Well worth the wait also.

Assuming it was the lady owner, she was extremely friendly and apologised to me for me having to wait.
👍👍👍

I highly recommend the satays here.  Skip the Lim Lao Ngow fish balls instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chesper-Joghne Pang

sample_reviews_en.text:
**Update:** After not eating here for 2 years, I feel the satay sauce is extremely salty. I'm not sure what happened. We bought it to take home twice, and both times it was incredibly salty. I think it used to be much tastier in the past.
This time, I'm deducting 3 stars because the satay sauce is simply too salty. It's unusable for dipping; you have to eat it without the sauce.

(Old review) The pork is tender and perfectly seasoned; very delicious.
The dipping sauce isn't sweet like other places, and the pickled vegetables are refreshingly sour. I recommend calling ahead to order, otherwise you might go there for nothing because they often sell out. (Old review)
sample_reviews_en.author: Supatta Anusatamonkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
10 skewers of pork satay cost 80 baht (March 1, 2023).

The stall is a street cart with shared seating areas where several other stalls sell food, including fish noodle soup, dumplings, and fish maw soup.

The pork satay has varying amounts of fat on some skewers and lean meat on others. Those who prefer fat will need to specify this when ordering. The pork is tender, has a nice smoky aroma from the charcoal, and the burnt parts are trimmed off. The skewers are quite large. The satay sauce and pickled vegetables are tasty.

There is no parking available. Payment can be made via bank transfer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponchagarj Ngamukos

sample_reviews_en.text: This satay stall is located right next to a famous fish ball noodle shop, sharing tables and chairs. I have to say, this is one of the best satays I've ever had. The satay is tender, fragrant, and has plenty of meat – no separated fat. The flavor is rich, and the juices from grilling are delicious. The pickled dipping sauce is flavorful and packed with ingredients. The only downside is that the peanut dipping sauce isn't very strong. However, the satay itself is so delicious and flavorful you don't even need the dipping sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pesama Saksanit

sample_reviews_en.text:
The satay tasted good.
However, the wait was long.
I was told to come back in an hour, but when I went back an hour later, I was told they were all sold out.
I insisted that I had been told to come back an hour later, and I was finally able to buy some.
I understand that the staff are busy and it can't be helped, but it didn't leave a very good impression.
Unless I can be sure I have a reservation, I probably won't go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: YASUKO “うさ” HIRANO

sample_reviews_en.text: Pork satay from this street food stall in the Songwad area has been a favorite since childhood. The flavor is rich and the portion per skewer is just right. It used to be located at the entrance of the soi (alley) in front of Chia Tai, but now it has moved slightly further into the soi. You can order and eat it at Lim Lao Ngow restaurant. The vendor is very friendly. You can also call to order in advance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sorranut Kraitrakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
I can confidently say this is the best pork ribs in Bangkok.

The original recipe (with pork fat), the grilling technique, the juicy sauce, the unique soy sauce-based marinade (which might be different from other places), and the perfectly balanced, fragrant, and intensely flavorful peanut and chili dipping sauce make this truly stand out.

A true number one in Yaowarat! 🏆🥇
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayanon Chalernsuppayanan

sample_reviews_th.text: The prices are outrageous, starting at 200฿, but the taste is even more outrageous!! This kind of flavor is designed to rip tourists off and make them never want to come back. Consider this a warning to all you newcomers 🫠
sample_reviews_th.author: Chalee Sirisumpund

sample_reviews_en.text: The scam restaurant sells seafood and Thai dishes in Chinatown. Sidewalk restaurant with stainless steel tables and chairs. Due to the large number of guests, it is not clean. The restaurant's food is very bad and the prices are expensive. Steamed fish smells very fishy and tastes bland. Fried squid with garlic has few squid and the squid is not fresh. Fried oysters with eggs only have a few tiny oysters, the rest are all eggs and flour and all these parts separate from each other. The only edible dishes are crab rolls and pork fried rice, but the price is not cheap. The price of this restaurant is more expensive than other restaurants with better quality in shopping malls. The restaurant's staff is impolite and feels like they are defrauding customers. We ordered 2 Leo beers but the staff brought 2 opened bottles of Chang beer. At that time, I said I ordered Leo beer, but the staff said there was no Leo beer, only Chang beer. I said we don't drink Chang beer, but the staff swore at us in English, then brought us Leo beer. I feel scammed and treated very poorly. I advise you not to eat at this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kien Nguyen Manh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ah Tuer Shark Fin Soup offers a traditional Chinese dining experience, particularly known for its rich and flavorful shark fin soup 🍲. The broth is thick and aromatic, with a good balance of flavors and high-quality ingredients. Besides the signature dish, the restaurant also serves a variety of classic Chinese dishes 🥢, including braised abalone, stir-fried vegetables 🥬, and seafood 🦐.

The ambiance is reminiscent of old-school Chinese eateries, giving it an authentic and somewhat nostalgic vibe. Service is friendly and efficient 😊, with staff knowledgeable about the menu and ready to recommend dishes.

However, it’s important to note the ethical concerns surrounding shark fin consumption 🌍. Some diners may prefer alternative options that are equally delicious and more sustainable, such as the double-boiled soup or seafood dishes.

Overall, Ah Tuer Shark Fin Soup offers a taste of traditional Chinese cuisine with an emphasis on rich, comforting soups. For those who enjoy classic flavors and are open to exploring alternatives, this spot delivers a satisfying dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: PK PTD

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was honestly a terrible experience—the food was just bad😡🔥. I wanted to give this place 0 stars, but since Google Maps doesn’t allow that, I’m giving 5 stars instead… for my lovely friends, and to make sure this comment gets pushed up for you to see.

The food looks great in photos, but sadly the taste didn’t match the price at all.👊

We ordered the crab rolls, and there was so little crab that it felt more like a batter roll. I started wondering if the crab was only there in spirit🧐. The stir-fried noodles with water mimosa were bland, yet somehow a bit salty at the same time. The oyster omelet was actually the best dish we had—mainly because the oysters were fresh and at least edible compared to the rest.

Service didn’t help either. The staff weren’t very polite, which made the whole experience even less enjoyable.

Judging from other low-rating reviews, this doesn’t seem to be a one-time issue. Hopefully, the restaurant focuses a bit more on flavor and service in the future—not just presentation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Palita Sedlue

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hia Tua Shark Fin
Yaowarat Street Food Legend

Absolutely delicious! My go-to dishes here are the shark fin, Hong Kong–style stir-fried noodles, crab spring rolls (Hoi Jor), blanched cockles, and crab curry with curry powder every single dish is full of flavor and made with high-quality ingredients.

This is true Yaowarat street food at its best. The taste is consistently great, which is why this is one of my regular spots. The queue is usually long, and seating is often right by the roadside, so it’s not the most comfortable place to eat. The owner can be quite loud and may seem a bit stressed while giving orders to the staff, but she’s actually kind just be a little patient.

It’s totally worth it for the amazing food and fresh ingredients. I don’t recommend driving here because parking is very difficult, and it’s better not to come in a big group since tables are limited.

If you love authentic, bold-flavored street food, this place is a must-try in Yaowarat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornpong W.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Uncle Tue's Shark Fin Soup, Yaowarat 🦈
A legendary restaurant in Yaowarat that foodies must try at least once. Their signature dish is the braised shark fin in red sauce, with a rich, savory flavor and a hint of Chinese herbal aroma. The shark fin is perfectly tender and not at all fishy. The sour and spicy dipping sauce helps cut through the richness.

Other dishes like fish maw soup and crab curry are also well-prepared and meet the standards of a famous restaurant. The atmosphere is a lively street food vibe typical of Yaowarat, perfect for a late-night meal, enjoying the food amidst the lights and people.

Overall, the taste is delicious, the ingredients are high-quality, and while the price is a little high, it's worth the experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: นาย กาแฟ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted good and the ingredients were high quality. I tried the braised fish maw in red sauce; the fish maw was soft, bouncy, and in large pieces, and the crab was very fresh and in chunks. The broth was flavorful. The stir-fried noodles with water spinach and fresh shrimp were okay, but lacked the wok-fried aroma I expected. The sizzling oyster omelet had medium-sized oysters, not too big or too small, and tasted good.

In summary, the food is delicious and worth trying. However, other aspects, such as the restaurant's atmosphere, are a bit noisy and rushed, and hygiene is just average. Personally, I think this is normal for restaurants in this area. If you like this kind of atmosphere, you can give it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukrit S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This review is based on my personal experience and preferences, which others may feel differently about.

This restaurant is one of the first you’ll come across on Yaowarat Road. Upon arrival, you’ll need to wait for a table, and the owner will ask you to place your order in advance. I ordered the shark fin soup and stir-fried fish maw. The shark fin soup is available in three price options: 300, 500, and 1,000 THB. I chose the 300 THB option.

Both dishes were flavorful, with a slightly salty taste. The stir-fried fish maw paired well with the sauce provided.

The seating here is a bit cramped. The total cost for the two dishes and a bottle of water came to 620 THB.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Buttercup

sample_reviews_en.text: Service was a real letdown—staff seemed disinterested, inattentive, and even unfriendly. We ordered one dish per person, but only one meal arrived. After waiting about 10 minutes and asking about it, we were told we’d only ordered one dish. My food finally showed up 20 minutes later, by which point my companion had already finished eating—no apology given. To top it off, they add a standard 10% service charge, which I wasn’t willing to pay after service like that. The food itself was fine—nothing special, but not bad either.

sample_reviews_en.text: The first impression upon entering the restaurant is the youthful yet classic decor, cleverly utilized to create a unique atmosphere thanks to its location in an old building. The staff are incredibly nice. The highlight is the grilled pork jowl, which is incredibly delicious; the meat is tender, juicy, and perfectly complemented by the spicy dipping sauce. The salad and rice with basil-flavored pork are just average; I recommend ordering sticky rice to accompany the grilled meat.
sample_reviews_en.author: giang nguyễn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Price: The glass noodle salad in the picture costs 190 baht and contains only the meat shown in the photo.
Service: Most of the staff have difficulty communicating in Thai, leading to order errors. The female receptionist seemed unwilling to serve. Most of the staff avoided eye contact and needed to be called over. A 10% service charge is added.
Atmosphere: The air conditioning was cool.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The place is quite nice. However, at 9 pm, the kitchen closes. They couldn't even get a few lettuce leaves for the spring rolls... The service was truly minimal. At 9:05 pm, they came to ask for payment.

They close at 9:30 pm and they make that perfectly clear. In short, a forgettable experience because of the service, which we weren't prepared for.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benoit VIVANT

sample_reviews_en.text: While strolling around Songwat, I stopped into this restaurant seeking refuge from hunger and coolness. The interior was incredibly photogenic, giving me the perfect feeling of being in a foreign restaurant. The som tam had a mild flavor and was warm, suggesting it was freshly made. I also enjoyed the gapao, which I had made without spices.
sample_reviews_en.author: KK nyanko

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went for dinner. The restaurant is nicely decorated.
The minced pork salad, papaya salad, fried chicken, and grilled pork were delicious.
The Vietnamese spring rolls were a bit dry, and the grilled chicken was also a bit dry and tough.
The prices are quite high, and there's a service charge.
The staff provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angsupa Phachala

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was good and tasty, but the service and reservation system were terrible. The staff were completely disorganized in managing the table queue. Even those who arrived early and had reservations were given tables to people who arrived later. The staff didn't seem happy at work. The quality of service needs improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: amornrat foongmongkolsatien

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was good, but the portions are absolutely minuscule. My biggest complaint is the staff, we felt, were very unwelcoming and constantly laughed and sneered as we put in our order and paid. We also caught them laughing and pointing at us while we were sat down eating our food. What a joke. Place looks cool tho
sample_reviews_en.author: Harrison Menhenitt

restaurants.name: Khanom Jeen 4 Regions
restaurants.address:

Samrong Nuea, Mueang Samut Prakan District, Samut Prakan 10270, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old, established restaurant in Samrong.
I don't know exactly when it opened, but I've been eating there since I was a teenager... I can't say everything is delicious because I only ever tried the rice noodles with curry sauce.
The taste is to my liking, rich and flavorful.
The vegetables are fresh, new, and clean.
Good quality ingredients.
Served quickly.
Now, if you review on Maps,
the restaurant gives you one slice of toast.
But we didn't take it because we don't like toast.
A small Slurpee would be better though 😁
because it's hot and helps cool you down and counteract the spiciness.
Now, the space next door has opened as a beverage shop.
So the atmosphere of the restaurant feels less cramped.
The restaurant only accepts cash.

Suggestion: The round tray used for serving vegetables takes up too much table space. A long rectangular block with enough compartments for the vegetables would be more suitable.
And the tongs are too big; 3-4 per table is even more cumbersome. Improvements would be great.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิไลวรรณ จันทร์อ่อนแสง

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time trying Khanom Jeen Nam Ya (Thai rice noodles with curry sauce) here, and I really liked the taste of the sauce, especially their Super Coconut Milk Curry and the Crab Curry, which were delicious. Besides Khanom Jeen, they also have coffee and other sweet drinks on the menu. If you're passing through this area, I highly recommend this Khanom Jeen shop!
sample_reviews_en.author: Paerw

sample_reviews_en.text: This place does really good curries for khanom jeen. My favorite is the nam prik, the flavor is super well balanced and really satisfying. If you eat at the shop, there are plenty of fresh veggies and condiments you can grab as much as you want. The staff are friendly and the prices are very reasonable. If you’re into khanom jeen, this place is worth checking out.
sample_reviews_en.author: John de j3k

sample_reviews_en.text: I eat at this restaurant regularly whenever I'm in the area. I've been eating here since the dishes were 12 baht each and the sauce wasn't as plentiful as it is now. Everything is delicious; I've tried all the chili pastes they have. The staff are all lovely. I recommend it to anyone passing by; give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: ภรณ์ชนก สุขเจริญ

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time here and I was impressed with both the service and the taste of the khanom jeen curry. I tried both the crab curry and the super coconut milk curry, which were both very delicious. They also have a wide variety of …
sample_reviews_en.author: Siew Lan Lim

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating here since I was a kid, back when it was in the market. The taste hasn't changed at all. Unlimited fresh, chilled vegetables. The orange coffee is also excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joke Mango

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mae Joi's Four Regions Rice Noodles: The Nam Ngiao (Northern Thai noodle soup) is the best, with a great flavor and fragrant curry paste.
Once you try it, you'll be hooked! 👌🥰 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Oppo A95

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered the spicy jungle curry, which was delicious and flavorful. They have a wide variety of curry dishes, so we'll try other options. It only costs 40 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prapaporn K

restaurants.name: Honaji Ramen Central IX
restaurants.address:

135 Rama IX Rd, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
HonAji Ramen launches new menu ✨

🔥Kimuchi Series🔥
For kimchi lovers, this is a must-try!
Korean pork ramen with kimchi soup – packed with ingredients, the soup has a perfect balance of sweet and sour, absolutely delicious! And the kimchi stir-fried pork rice bowl is overflowing with flavor – incredibly delicious, I loved it! The staff were friendly and the food was served quickly.

Try this deliciousness today at all branches from January 16th to March 31st, 2025 @HonAji Ramen TH 🤤
