#fyp #delicious #foodie #restaurantrecommendation #foodlover #foodtravel #foodie #foodchannel #restaurantpin #ramen #honajiramen #centralrama9 #rama9 #kimchi #kimchiporkricebowl
sample_reviews_th.author: Ploypailin Pathinthanapon

sample_reviews_en.text:
I paid with my SCB card because I got a 15% discount.
However, employee #1 looked confused and seemed unaware of the promotion.
So I showed them the sign explaining the promotion.

Employee #1 took the card and swiped it, but the discount wasn't applied.
I asked why, and they still looked confused.

Employee #2 came to help and asked if they had applied the discount. Employee #1 replied that they hadn't and chuckled.

Employee #2 then called employee #3 from the kitchen to cancel the previous transaction and process it again.

The point is, if they didn't know how to do it, why didn't they call someone who did? Why insist on doing it wrong? It wasted my time and was frustrating. How could they be so clueless?

If they couldn't do it, they could have just said, "I'm sorry, I'm not familiar with this yet. Please wait while another employee comes to help." That would have been enough.

As for the food taste, it was average, on the salty side. But the pork belly was delicious and melted in my mouth.
sample_reviews_en.author: Good Gain

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried the Nagoya ramen, the one named after the city. The broth wasn't overly salty, but it wasn't particularly fragrant either. The noodles were chewy, but not soft; rather, a bit firm. If you prefer chewy and soft noodles, this might not be for you. The noodles were somewhat square-shaped. There weren't many toppings, just corn. The pork slices were of a decent thickness, not thin as paper. After eating a bit, if you want to cut through the richness, I recommend the condiment with mild chili peppers to help change the flavor. Considering the quantity and price, it's quite expensive, and there's an additional VAT charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chapat C

sample_reviews_en.text: it is a betagro group company, no service charge but 7% VAT not included, actually some other restaurants in many malls also charged 10% service charge, Tonkotsu ramen is so good that i even drank all the ramen soup, which is very yummy! good service and reasonable price, but some food menu item not able to order after 8:30pm or so, guess its so popular and therefore sold out by that time. accept credit card if spent over 200 baht, seats a bit busy during lunch and other peak hour, membership available
sample_reviews_en.author: dr ken chao

sample_reviews_en.text: The ramen has a delicious and rich flavor that suits Thai tastes. My favorite is the soy sauce ramen with braised pork; the soup is very tasty and has a nice dried fish aroma. The spicy tonkatsu ramen is also delicious, but a little spicy (for those who don't like spicy food). However, I have to deduct points for the service. I ordered a refillable green tea, but had to keep calling for a staff member to refill it. Overall, though, it's good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanakarn Khrueson

sample_reviews_en.text:
What I liked was the ramen broth; the overall taste was average and easy to eat. However, the noodles weren't cooked thoroughly; some were still hard. The restaurant is convenient and easy to find.
I didn't like the sound from the LED screen; it was very jarring and repetitive. It wasn't relaxing at all and made me want to leave quickly because it was so annoying. They kept saying, "Bring your friends to eat here, it's really worth it!"
sample_reviews_en.author: Panda Zhang

sample_reviews_en.text:
This ramen restaurant offers reasonably priced ramen with branches in major shopping malls.
They have set menus that offer good value for money.

The ramen, in general, has a standard taste; it's delicious without needing any extra seasoning.
Besides ramen, they also offer soba, spaghetti, and various rice bowls.

The restaurant isn't very big, but it has a cool, Japanese-themed decor.
It feels quite spacious and comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichsaran Ves

sample_reviews_en.text:
We came to try their Mother's Day set meal promotion. The price was lovely, and it included two main dishes + gyoza, karaage fried chicken, and a drink. Great value!

The staff were friendly and provided good service. The restaurant was clean, and the food was delicious. 🩵
sample_reviews_en.author: ไปนู่นไปนี่ฉันจะตีก้นเธอ Facebook page

restaurants.name: Leepee Bar&Retaurant Kubon - Ramintra
restaurants.address:

18 42 Soi 2, Tha Raeng, Bang Khen, Bangkok 10220, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Like a hidden gem!!
The food is great, flavorful, living up to the restaurant's name which means "spicy".
There's parking right in front of the restaurant.
We came on a Thursday and the band was amazing!
The speakers and sound system are excellent.
The restaurant is beautiful, the vibe is fantastic. I can't find anything to criticize.
sample_reviews_en.author: nuchie baa

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the atmosphere is great, it feels like eating at a relative's house. They treat you like family. There's a wide variety of drinks, including craft beer and draft beer, at reasonable prices. The music is lovely; they even play The Wonz on Wednesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays. Come and enjoy the live music!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirin Dechdan

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was great, the food was delicious, the music was fantastic and fun, and the prices weren't too expensive. We had so much fun that the owner even went to sleep! 😁😁 #Definitely going again, but I wonder if the owner will let us back in 🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: Noom za za CLIP ZAZA

sample_reviews_en.text:
This bar has a comfy vibe and nice decorations, making it a great place to relax.
Now it was decorated for Halloween, which added a fun touch. The live music created a lively atmosphere without being too loud, making it perfect for hanging out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pad K.

sample_reviews_en.text: A hidden gem in the Khubon area. Delicious food, generous portions, good service, and nice decor. Perfect for hanging out with friends or having dinner. They have imported craft beers. Parking might be a bit limited, but I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattapon Silapawit

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food, great atmosphere, cocktails, craft beer, good music, and every band I've been to has been a great singer. There's also a second floor. The restrooms are very clean. The owner is very kind.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Sloth

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything was great and perfectly coordinated 🥰
Except for the music. The singer was good, but the speakers were so loud! I was trying to work peacefully, but I couldn't stand sitting there any longer 🥲
sample_reviews_en.author: Rattanapron H.

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere and delicious food. I've been eating here for over ten years, even before the renovation. The flavors are bold and well-balanced. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: na sooa

restaurants.name: ครัวมุมสวน
restaurants.address:

26 Chaloem Phrakiat Rama 9 Alley, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a nice, shady atmosphere with lots of trees, but you might need to be careful not to trip. There's ample parking behind the restaurant. The food is flavorful and rich, the chef is very skilled, and there's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, ranging from single-serving rice dishes to wild game cuisine. They also have traditional Thai desserts like grass jelly and old-fashioned ice cream, and importantly, they have Aete ice cream! If you're going with a large group, you might have to wait a little while for your food because there's only one kitchen, but it gives you a warm, homey feeling.
sample_reviews_en.author: HamsterShabu

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a family dinner at this restaurant and brought my laptop to work while I waited. The atmosphere was pleasant, and the food was delicious. The stir-fried water spinach noodles were fragrant, and the snakehead fish with garden vegetables and crispy fish in spicy broth were my first time trying them and I loved them. It's also pet-friendly, so I'll definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cypget

sample_reviews_en.text:
Outdoor Thai-style restaurants have become a top priority when dining out during the COVID-19 pandemic.
This restaurant fits the bill perfectly. They offer a diverse menu of delicious Thai dishes, excellent service, reasonable prices, and ample parking in front of the restaurant.

Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicole sanjariyapipu

sample_reviews_en.text: They have single-serving rice dishes made to order, perfect for a casual meal. It's a bit pricey, but the quality and taste are up to standard. They also serve alcoholic beverages. It's a good place for business meetings, bringing children, or university students. You won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: กีรติ บ่อโพธิ์

sample_reviews_en.text: We brought the family to eat here on Mother's Day. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, the restaurant had a pleasant ambiance, and the food was incredibly delicious – so delicious we had to order seconds!
sample_reviews_en.author: Punch

sample_reviews_en.text: Some dishes taste good, some dishes are just fine. It's a small roadside restaurant but looks cozy. However, I think it's a bit pricy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Little Bunny

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a garden atmosphere with many seating areas. The food is flavorful and very tasty, with a fairly diverse menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: kookykiss kook

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, every dish was tasty. The prices were reasonable, and the atmosphere was great, like a natural garden.
sample_reviews_en.author: กนลรัตน์ จอมประดิษฐ์

restaurants.name: ต้มตุ๋น แจ่วฮ้อน - ชาบู • หมูกระทะ สาขา2 (พระราม4)
restaurants.address:

300/4 ถนน Sukhumvit 42 Rd, Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The menu isn't extensive, but it has everything you could want, including shabu-shabu, Northeastern Thai food, lunch, and fried items.

The appetizers are delicious. I was surprised by the portion size when they were served – it was like homemade! I loved that ❤️😅
The prices are reasonable and easy to pay. The service is lovely and attentive 😍
Plenty of parking. The restaurant is spacious and comfortable. It closes at midnight, by normal time.
If you're looking for a place to hang out in this area, I highly recommend this place.
**They also have a Facebook page and activities! 😊👍👍**
sample_reviews_en.author: Lhin PinG

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Northeastern Thai food, intensely spicy and satisfying 🔥🌶️
Secret deal alert‼️ Pork BBQ for only 99.- 😳

Those who know = incredibly worthwhile. Those who don't know = missing out big time!
Tender meat, incredibly flavorful dipping sauce, you'll eat until the grill is empty! 🐷🥢

📍Tom Tum Branch 2, Rama 4
Spicy food and pork BBQ lovers must try this!

⚠️ Limited time offer. Hurry before it's gone!
Don't say we didn't warn you!

#NortheasternThaiFood #PorkBBQ99 #SecretDeal #TomTum #Rama4 #FoodiesMustTry #HiddenGem
sample_reviews_en.author: Panupong Suparatwattanakul

sample_reviews_en.text: Yesterday, I took the kids from the Community Development Center to eat there. The food was delicious and the service was excellent. The kids were very happy. There was a young woman who seems to be the owner of the shop who helped the kids cook the pork because she was worried it wouldn't be cooked properly. She also treated the kids to ice cream. She was very kind. I highly recommend this restaurant. Go and eat there often.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sriprapa Punphung

sample_reviews_en.text:
The owner is very attentive to customers. Today we came to eat around 6 PM and not all the food was ready yet, but the owner quickly prepared it for us.
On Wednesdays, there's a promotion for pork BBQ for 99 baht, excluding drink refills and VAT.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krit Namsiripongpan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The price is reasonable for the portions, and the taste is delicious.
I recommend the papaya salad with ground fish. It's incredibly spicy.
This is my second time in the area, and I'm very impressed with this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: yanitha klomsaard

sample_reviews_en.text:
The som tam with small noodles and fermented fish sauce was perfectly cooked and incredibly flavorful.
The S-sized dipping sauce was filling and generous. It was a great value. The staff provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Elena

sample_reviews_en.text:
The beer is very sweet, refreshing and soothing to the throat.
The spicy noodle salad is delicious. The hot pot and BBQ pork buffet is 99 baht every Wednesday and Thursday, super worth it, and very filling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanda Duangjan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the atmosphere is great, and the restaurant is cool and comfortable. On Wednesdays and Thursdays, they have an all-you-can-eat hot pot and BBQ buffet for 99 baht, which is excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pig Brink

restaurants.name: LAX RCA
restaurants.address:

29, ROYAL CITY AVENUE (RCA), 70-72 ซอย เพชรบุรี 47 Bangkapi, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I once had a private party at Lax (or Lax RCA), an international restaurant located in the heart of RCA. Looking at the top left corner of the building's facade, you'll see a Boeing airplane sculpture, signifying its international flair. Inside, however, the atmosphere is warm, friendly, and comfortable – perfect for relaxing. The restaurant has a central atrium, with seating on the second floor overlooking the ground floor, giving it a split-level feel. The menu offers healthy options, salads, and fusion dishes with delicious flavors. I highly recommend the cold-pressed juices; they're incredibly refreshing. The food is delicious and worth the price, meeting LA's high standards.

The restaurant regularly has promotions; you can follow their Facebook page for updates. The music is great, and the interior is romantic. It's another highly recommended venue for private events or celebrations.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akaraphat Jingjit

sample_reviews_en.text:
We’ve ordered some OK pork and really well crispy chicken serving with french fries. There also was a wonderful musician playing soulful music. It was so impressing (in a good way) so I left my backpack with all the stuff right there, in the opposite chair.

I’d noticed it only the next day, but the restaurant was closed. We called the staff, somehow found an english-speaking girl who helped us deal this embarrassing situation and eventually I got my bag back.

Thanks to all the participants of this good ending story. Especially the staff, who honestly kept it for me, you are the best.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nikita Kosachev

sample_reviews_en.text: Service was great, it is a little dated in it's furnishings. But a little renovation and updated furniture would do wonders. The food was pretty good. The drinks were okay it wasn't the best mixed drink i have but it was okay. It was a little loud to have a conversation but the outside section would have been better for that. Maybe next time we will sit out there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ken B

sample_reviews_en.text: Very surprised some really healthy dishes both in western style and Thai. The cold press juices were delicious and at a very fair price. I had the grilled chicken mango and avocado salad from the superfood menu which was delicious and a mushroom soup. As I live nearby I'll be visiting regularly for a good ny detox
sample_reviews_en.author: J. T.

sample_reviews_en.text: Underrated restaurant/bar in RCA area. The interior and the sound system are very high end vs other local bars. They only charge 300 baht for byob and 100 baht ice 🪣 which is awesome. I brought my own tequila and enjoyed my time there. The DJ girl was on 🔥 the night I went. She got that moves like Jagger.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thaitiger99

sample_reviews_en.text: It's unclear whether it's a restaurant or a bar. The atmosphere is more like a restaurant, but you can still have drinks, though it's not quite the "drinking vibe." The food is average, nothing outstanding, and the prices are reasonable. It's an air-conditioned restaurant, perfect for a long meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jo Sakura

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a great time visiting this place during Songkran.
The restaurant was converted to an outdoorsy clubbing event and it was so happening. A great place to hangout during Songkran!
Made a few friends without having to squeeze into RCA route 66.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rayston

sample_reviews_en.text: I stumbled upon LAX RCA while walking back to my Condo. It's actually a Bar & Bistro with a live band. The band plays various music genre; jazz, blues, pop and rearranged retro. A good place to chill with a beer. It serves food too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sin Chong TAN

restaurants.name: ปอปัง นมสด ปังปิ้งเตาถ่าน
restaurants.address:

20 105 Lad Prao Wanghin Rd, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The short, flat-nosed employee provided terrible service. The restaurant took a very long time to prepare our order, so we asked to change from dine-in to takeout (we hadn't received our food yet when we informed them). When we received our food, we asked for an extra bag to put the toast in separately. The employee responded curtly, "What kind of bag?" and told us we should have asked beforehand, then simply handed us a bag to put the toast in ourselves without any service whatsoever. It was terrible; we waited so long for our food and then received such bad service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Papawadee JIANJARUNSRI

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an excellent place for sweet dessert bread with various sweet toppings. Each bread is pretty affordable, so I recommend buying four or five or six. It's open pretty late, and there's usually open seating. I usually get the plain bread with a little sugar, but they have peanut butter. Nutella, pork floss, and 35 other different sweet toppings for the bread. The wait can be a little long, because everyone loves this sweet bread and I think they make everything fresh.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joseph Dewey

sample_reviews_en.text: The service is very slow. They should improve this. They should inform customers of the estimated waiting time beforehand so they know whether to wait or not. There were only two tables ahead of us in the queue, but 30 minutes have passed and we still haven't received our food.
sample_reviews_en.author: บัณฑภัทร์ ธีมากร

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop's decor is pleasant and inviting.
The interior is hot, but the service is average.
The tea is bland, neither sweet nor oily.
The bread is good, but the flavor is lacking and lacks aroma.

Overall, a bit disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanyaphat Saneaha

sample_reviews_en.text: The bread is crispy on the outside, the filling is fragrant, and it's not too sweet. The vendor is lovely; she grills the bread and makes the drinks all by herself. Please be patient with her!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sitapak Sriboonsom

sample_reviews_en.text:
✅ I usually order delivery via Line Man, but today I happened to drive by, so I got to eat at the shop.
✅ Compared to other toasted bread I've had, this shop's is the best. They toast …
sample_reviews_en.author: เมนกา ม้วนหน้า พาเพลิน

sample_reviews_en.text: The drinks are delicious, both hot and cold. The toast is fragrant, grilled over charcoal on low heat, so you might need to wait a little while. The slices are quite large.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shakri A

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was awful. The toast was so cold it wasn't even warm, and the drink was ridiculously sweet. There were cockroaches crawling all over the floor, even on my feet.
sample_reviews_en.author: CHONG

restaurants.name: หมูหมู x หมูกระทะ โชคชัย4
restaurants.address:

166 Lad Prao Wanghin Rd, Khwaeng Lat Phrao, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a restaurant I've wanted to try since they only had à la carte, and now they have a buffet. You have to add their Line account to see how to order.
Then there's a QR code to scan for the menu and order again. They should improve this system; it's too complicated. Even when choosing meat from the 289 baht buffet menu, you still have to share a post from their Facebook page. The menu is difficult to read, and some items aren't included in the buffet, so you have to look carefully. I came for a simple BBQ meal, and I had to deal with this. The water glasses, which you have to refill yourself, should be larger; the small size is probably less than 12 oz. The garlic rice should be fried rice, not plain rice with fried garlic on top; that's too simple. The grill pan was blackened, and nobody changed it for me [I came alone]. If anyone wants to try it, go ahead. You probably have to ask for the dipping sauces, chili, and garlic. I won't comment on the taste; that's subjective, and maybe I had high expectations. The restaurant should want customers to come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: teddyme bear

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff were friendly and prompt. They were always happy to assist with requests for dipping sauce, charcoal refills, and pan changes.

We ordered the pork and fried food buffet for 199 baht, plus a refillable drink for 39 baht.

The sauces have their own unique flavors, and each dish's taste may vary. If you live nearby, give them a try.

The grilled pork was tender and the ingredients were fresh. The vegetables were a bit too old today, making the morning glory difficult to chew.

Refillable drinks included water, chrysanthemum tea, lemon tea, and espresso.
The fried food was standard, but not too hot, just lukewarm.

We ordered the crispy squid, which came with 7 pieces, as shown in the picture, for 75 baht (I personally think the serving size is a bit small compared to the 75 baht price).
sample_reviews_en.author: Fay Sompochpisut

sample_reviews_en.text:
I tried it once and was very impressed. They offer both buffet and à la carte options. That day I had the buffet.
-Price 199.- Refillable drinks 39.- Worth it!
-The pork is marinated, not the packaged kind. The meat is high quality.
-The dipping sauces are delicious. Mixing them together goes well with the pork. It's so enjoyable! Haha. Importantly, I felt that the ingredients and what was served were very clean. My boyfriend even commented on it.
-The buffet includes fried items, which are freshly fried, hot, crispy, and delicious.
-Ordering is done via QR code, which is convenient and easy to navigate.
-All the staff at the restaurant provide excellent service. The owner speaks clearly and in a friendly voice. They give great recommendations! I've found another regular BBQ restaurant for me.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunisa’ch Kulprasert

sample_reviews_en.text:
A newly opened pork barbecue restaurant in the Wang Hin area (before Wat Lat Phrao). Their signature dish is their "Marinated Pork with Ice Cream." I was curious to see what it would taste like. When the pork was mixed with ice cream and eggs and pan-fried, it was a perfect combination, with a sweet and creamy flavor (similar to eating bread dipped in egg).

Overall, it was okay. The ingredients were good, the meat was well-marinated, and the soup was tasty. The staff was friendly. The only complaint was that the meat was cut a bit too small, as small pieces tend to burn quickly when fried on a pan.
sample_reviews_en.author: Albert PJ

sample_reviews_en.text: Driving around looking for food, but found this shop. There were a lot of people, so I decided to stop by and try it. In short, I really liked it, but I was a bit confused about the ice cream. In short, the ice cream was really delicious. In short, I went to eat there two days in a row. I like that the fried food is fried hot, so I don't have to walk around to get it. The staff and owner are very good at service. As soon as I parked the car, they went to get it right away. 😂 I've never written a review anywhere before, but this is the first place.
sample_reviews_en.author: narttaya

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a restaurant with excellent service from the staff. Even though they were a bit confused at times, they always smiled and greeted us. Excellent! I commend them.

But for the food, I think there's too little to choose from for the buffet price of 289 baht per person (excluding VAT).

The limited selection is bearable, but they keep charging for small things like soft drinks and ice cream.
Personally, I don't think 289 baht (excluding VAT) is worth it. They shouldn't be charging so much.
sample_reviews_en.author: บุศรินทร์ ดวงแก้ว

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a BBQ pork restaurant, but unlike any other BBQ pork restaurant. The atmosphere is more like a chill hangout spot with a cool breeze, perfect for sipping beer and enjoying BBQ pork as a snack 😂. Even so, the BBQ pork is incredibly delicious. I personally love their dipping sauces; mixing the two together creates a perfectly balanced flavor.

The prices are also very reasonable. A BBQ pork set is only 250 baht and they give you a generous portion. Beer is also at a good price 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattharoth Preecharwongsiri

sample_reviews_en.text: Here's another restaurant recommendation: an all-you-can-eat buffet for 199 baht, with 39 baht for unlimited drinks. The service is excellent, especially from the female staff. They have a marinated pork recipe with ice cream – at first I wondered if it would work, but it actually did! The pork belly is fantastic, the dipping sauces are delicious, and the atmosphere is comfortable and relaxed.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุนีย์ ฟาง

restaurants.name: ก๊วยจั๊บญวน 24ชม.
restaurants.address:

Pattaya 3rd Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It seems like the elderly owner runs the place by herself, but the food is really delicious. The lang sap and noodles are all tasty. It's a bit of a shame that they don't speak English, but the prices are affordable and they are friendly. I think I'll be visiting often whenever I go to Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hand Golden (골든핸드)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don't know if this is a new restaurant, but I've only just discovered it.
Delicious and generous portions.
For only 60 baht, you'll be stuffed...
sample_reviews_en.author: Warawut Songserm

sample_reviews_en.text: Highly recommended! A must-try when in Pattaya. Delicious food, open 24 hours. The owner is lovely. You absolutely have to come...
sample_reviews_en.author: pinit marungruang

sample_reviews_en.text: I happened to pop into this restaurant, but the Kui Jap was delicious. The owner was friendly and I'm glad they're open late.
sample_reviews_en.author: DAI Channel (DAI Channel アジアの歩き方)

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the place was clean, and the service was excellent. I was very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khesorn Soerensen

restaurants.name: ร้านส้มตำเพชรบูรณ์-พระประแดง
restaurants.address:

144 บางพึ่ง ร้านส้มตำเพชรบูรณ์ Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is perfect for a relaxing evening (it's very hot during the day, even with multiple fans).

The food is decent and tasty... especially for those who like spicy fermented fish sauce (the fermented fish sauce itself isn't spicy, it's a bit strange).
I recommend the grilled, roasted, and fried dishes.
The jellyfish salad is crunchy, fresh, and delicious!

Parking is available on the street in front of the restaurant.

The food prices are reasonable, and the service is good. I'll definitely go back for the jellyfish salad again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Melon Lemon

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. The papaya salad has plenty of ingredients, including large dried shrimp. The glass noodle salad and spicy pork salad are also very tasty. The prices are reasonable. The restaurant has moved from its original location to a new one along the Bhumibol Road. It used to be a bar, but now the Som Tum Phetchabun restaurant has opened here. There's seating on the second floor, which is comfortable and has many tables.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wasan Pimram

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually order their papaya salad and grilled pork neck, and now they've added hot pot to the menu. The portions are huge! The pot is massive, enough for three people to eat until they're completely full. The prices are very reasonable, the atmosphere is great, especially in the evening with the cool breeze, and the service is excellent. I'll definitely be back often.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jarupa Nipitvitaya

sample_reviews_en.text: The papaya salad with fermented fish sauce is intensely flavorful, with the vendors giving it their all – every dish is spicy and delicious. The fried pork with garlic is crispy and tasty. The prices are reasonable. You can park on the side of the road, but it's a bit hot inside because the roof is made of corrugated iron.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuch Piyanuch

sample_reviews_en.text: Whenever I'm in this area, I always stop by this restaurant. Their papaya salad is delicious, and their garlic fried chicken wings are amazing. My boyfriend always orders two plates whenever we come.
sample_reviews_en.author: A A

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ingredients and flavors are okay.
The papaya salad is a little too sweet.
Overall, it's okay and the price is reasonable.
Sitting upstairs in the evening is nice with a nice breeze.
sample_reviews_en.author: SU

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. The papaya salad is spicy and flavorful, and the hot pot is packed with ingredients. You can park on the side of the road. The atmosphere is nice in the evening.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ingthanus

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was incredibly delicious and suited my taste perfectly. If you like spicy food, this is the place for you!
There's no restroom, but there's a gas station nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุธาศินี ศิริรักษ์

restaurants.name: อ้วนหลบมุม อาหารตามสั่ง
restaurants.address:

75/5 Soi Pracha Rat Bamphen 18, Samsen Nok, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The stir-fried kale with crispy pork was terrible, very bland. I ordered the special, with extra rice filling the whole box, but there was very little crispy pork. It was also expensive. Compared to the crispy pork with curry I ordered elsewhere, the regular size had more food. There's no consistency at all. I came for the first time expecting it to be good and impressive, but it was a complete failure. The only thing I appreciate is that they use deep containers that hold a lot of food, instead of the typical cheap styrofoam boxes.
sample_reviews_en.author: J T P

sample_reviews_en.text: The food didn't taste good at all. I wish they would try improving the flavor and making it tastier without using MSG, because the restaurant has a wide variety of interesting menu items.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puksapattch Ripunchaiyarpong

sample_reviews_en.text: The green curry with coconut shoots is delicious; the coconut isn't hard and the pork is tender.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warangkana Jitimakorn

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! I often order it to eat at work. The price is very reasonable. 3 thumbs up!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rose Rose

restaurants.name: Summer's Pizza (24 BLVD)
restaurants.address:

Summer's Pizza 1st Floor 24BLVD 88/2, 88/9 Sukhumvit 24 Alley, Khlong Tan, Klongteoy, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I feel like it’s not worth the price, and when we arrived earlier, there was an event going on with no available seating. I thought we could find a place to sit, but it was very difficult to get a table. When we finally sat down, we were asked to leave because of the event. The staff should have informed us beforehand, as when we asked earlier, they said we could sit there. We felt very uncomfortable and wanted to return the food because the whole situation was upsetting.

As for the plastic spoon and fork, I think they should have been properly placed in a plastic wrapper. Instead, the staff just brought them over in their hands. We couldn’t finish the food and felt it was a waste because we really wanted to try it, and we had traveled a long way with heavy traffic just to come here.
sample_reviews_en.author: angkana D.

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm surprised this place has such a high rating. The basic pizza is incredibly slow. I came in for a quick bite and had to wait 40 minutes in an empty restaurant. For Bangkok's fast pace, that's incredibly long. The cashier who takes your order bakes the pizza himself. I can't understand why the pizza tastes so good, even though it's just a piece of dough with cheese.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saint Kebab

sample_reviews_en.text:
Always reliable, now even more convenient!
Thrilled to see my favourite pizza brand open a new location. The pizza is just as delicious and consistent as ever; flavourful, well-made, and satisfying every time. It’s my go-to spot in Bangkok when I’m craving proper pizza. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pham Chittasenee

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice pizza and good service. The pizza was delicious! I ordered the Parma ham + rocket, and it had lots of vegetables. The crust and cheese were perfectly balanced with the ham. It was best eaten hot, dipped in the sauce provided (which had …
sample_reviews_en.author: Chatchanan Sareesirikajorn

sample_reviews_en.text: Worst ever pizza.  Small, overpriced $20USD + and the few tiny fried chicken morsels were dropped on just a few slices.  Incredible.  The lettuce layer disguised the lack of topping and flavour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brad

sample_reviews_en.text: Very tasty pizza with good thick crust. I ordered the spicy Mexican sausage pizza. The dipping sauce with olive oil was also great with the pizza bread. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prakit

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely like this place! The pizza has a great authentic taste and the price is very reasonable. Perfect spot for real pizza lovers. I’ll definitely be coming back!
sample_reviews_en.author: SK Katair

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really rude cashier girl.
they charged us 10% for service…What service?
There is a takeaway counter where you make an order and take the food by …
sample_reviews_en.author: V T

restaurants.name: ร้านน้องภูอาหารตามสั่ง
restaurants.address:

WV6P+76G, Soi Thep Prasit 6, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the Khao Pad Poo for 60B.

Nong Poo → Crab Brothers? (Sorry if I'm wrong.)
The name sounds promising for crab dishes. Since it was my first visit, I played it safe and ordered the aforementioned dish.

Although small, I could see the crab meat on top. The scrambled eggs were orange and looked great.
It looked like a lightly flaky Khao Pad, but it was actually quite moist.

It seems they only use fish sauce as a seasoning. I didn't detect any oyster sauce.
I added the prik fish sauce provided on the table to adjust the richness and spiciness to my liking and enjoyed it.

[Note] As of June 6, 2025, the location shown on Google Maps is a vacant lot. They are now open about 20 meters into Soi Kophai 11.
sample_reviews_en.author: Syo Kei

sample_reviews_en.text: The vendor was incredibly rude. I ordered chicken noodles but she gave me pork noodles instead. She only told me later that the chicken noodles were sold out, but she didn't tell me that from the beginning. Then I ordered another bowl of yellow noodles, and she didn't tell me they were out, only that they had thin noodles. Then she became extremely angry and yelled at me. I understand she might be going through a midlife crisis, but she should have spoken more clearly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwang Aebking

sample_reviews_en.text:
I always order through the app because I have a discount code. The fried rice and basil are delicious. The rice porridge is a bit sweet. The rice packaging is good.
** However, the yam and som tam should have the juices in separate bags. When they arrived, it all leaked out of the box.
The mango salad had a lot of juice. Even though it leaked out of the bag, it was still there in the box. Haha. But the taste was okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: ggg Nnn

sample_reviews_en.text: I stumbled upon this restaurant through a food delivery app and loved it so much I had to come back to the restaurant itself. It's a small, casual eatery with very affordable prices and generous portions. They offer seafood, but my favorite is the crab curry – it's incredibly flavorful and well-seasoned. Their rice dishes are also delicious; the salted fish fried rice is especially good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffey

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered from Grab twice a day. I'm writing this review for my records so I can order from them again next time. The basil meat rice bowl is half meat and half rice. It's absolutely delicious. The pad thai is also good. They put a lot of shrimp and other things in it. The best is Tom Yum!!!!! The chicken was delicious, and everything was delicious. The price was also very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: 유리

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered crab basil stir-fry via a delivery app. The restaurant gave a very generous portion of rice, which was great value compared to many other places. The taste of the food was average. It's a shame the basil stir-fry was so spicy that I couldn't taste the basil, only the chili. I need to try other dishes as well. Overall, it was okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Γαλνανατ Πυχομχιτ

sample_reviews_en.text: As of August 9, 2025, they were open in the vacant lot 30 meters to the right of Kopaisoi 11. I wasn't sure if it was a temporary store, but the crab fried rice (60 bt) was as delicious as ever. Also, the seafood curry (with rice) for 80 bt is on par with Bangkok Somboon, so I highly recommend trying it.
sample_reviews_en.author: 反町孝和

sample_reviews_en.text: It's so delicious I want to become a monk! When I'm in Pattaya, I have to eat it every day, one meal a day. I can't get over the stir-fried kale with salted fish. Pattaya has so many à la carte restaurants, but this one is the best. I don't want to talk too much, I'm going to cry!
sample_reviews_en.author: ชุติมา งาทิพย์

restaurants.name: บ่อตกกุ้งบางกระสอ
restaurants.address:

42 ซอยเลี่ยงเมืองนนทบุรี 10 Tambon Bang Kraso, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered food an hour ago, and they haven't even grilled the shrimp yet. We had to check ourselves what was out of stock. When we ordered more, they found out it was out of stock again. They only informed us an hour later.
We waited another 20 minutes for the shrimp and then another 45 minutes for the rest of the food. We sat at the table for another 45 minutes, and still didn't get it. When we asked about it, we found out they hadn't made it yet. It was a huge waste of time.
They didn't compensate us at all. They just took the money, apologized, and that was it. It's insane.
sample_reviews_en.author: Parichat Sawatwannakit (llMaewmeaWll)

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was great because it was a place where adults and children could enjoy themselves together.

I went for dinner with my daughter and son.
It was their first time fishing, so they couldn't catch a single shrimp.

After the explanation, my son caught nine, and my daughter caught two right next to him. Does fishing require skill? Haha.

Someone had half their basket full of shrimp.

I was so hungry I couldn't take pictures of the food,
but it was plentiful and delicious.

My kids said they want to go again before they go back to Korea.

Please take good care of them then.
sample_reviews_en.author: 장미진

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a shrimp fishing pond restaurant with live music. The weather is nice, not too hot. Most of the staff are very good, except for a few scantily clad women who only seem to serve male customers. You can take all the shrimp you catch home. The food is delicious and reasonably priced, but the service is very slow. There aren't enough restrooms; I wish they would add more. Overall, it's okay, and I'll come again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boonyapak

sample_reviews_en.text: The sign says no artificial attractants, only use the bar's bait. I saw other bars using them. When I tried to use some, the staff told me not to. Then what are those white shrimp and attractants in the plate and next to it? Are they only for people I know? The staff didn't even warn them.
sample_reviews_en.author: นักรีวิว

sample_reviews_en.text: Simple, homey style with live music. There's a shrimp fishing pond, and the owner provides excellent service, saying that everyone who catches shrimp can take them home. Customers never lose out. The food is delicious, and the atmosphere is rustic and friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิริทธิ์พล สุคันธปรีย์

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, and the prawns were large, but the prawn fishermen didn't follow the rules. There was a no-smoking sign, but they shamelessly smoked anyway. None of the staff warned them.
sample_reviews_en.author: SeTBaNNeD

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is friendly. The food here is delicious and the prices are reasonable. The shrimp in the pond are very large. 100 baht/hour is worth it. There is plenty of parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Milan 14

sample_reviews_en.text: We sat down to eat at this Northern Thai restaurant and the food was delicious. The prices were reasonable and the portions were very generous.
sample_reviews_en.author: Angel Nonie

restaurants.name: 老昆明小锅米线 KunMing Rice Noodle บะหมี่คุนหมิง
restaurants.address:

430Soi Phibun Uppatham, Samsen Nok, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very unfriendly

The staff misunderstood between 菊花茶 vs 蹄花汤. We ordered the first one, pointing to it on the menu (we are native Chinese speakers). Result we got served the last one which we thought could have been a free soup (it's a very basic soup) and of course no tea came (but we thought it was forgotten). We took 2 米线 bowls, they were good but not that big. Taste was ok. When we went for paying, the staff insisted we ordered the soup and the Chinese staff just make it like if they didn't want to get involved - argument was in Chinese. We decided to pay as it was ridiculous. It wouldn't happen in mainland china for sure and probably not in other Thai restaurants. Disappointed and we won't come back
sample_reviews_en.author: John Ff

sample_reviews_en.text: Authentic Kunming snacks and rice noodles – a must-try for rice noodle lovers! The owner is friendly, considerate, and a little shy ☺️. Delicious rice noodles are made from rice. They are long strips with a round cross-section. They are white in color and tough. They are boiled in boiling water for a while, then removed and put into the broth. Usually, they are mixed with chopped green onion, soy sauce, salt, spicy oil, and meat sauce. Vermicelli is similar, but has a different taste. For Kunming people, eating a bowl of rice noodles with soup, meat, and vegetables every morning will give them a good start to the day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jessie Liao

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stepping through the door, it felt like I wasn't in Thailand at all.

Everything was in Chinese.
The staff spoke a little Thai.

The restaurant's atmosphere was interesting.

The Thai menu was almost entirely transliterated; I couldn't understand what some words meant, so I used Google Translate.

I ordered the cold noodles. The taste was unique – sour from the pickled vegetables and soy sauce (vinegar). It seemed strange at first, but I found it surprisingly good. It was a novel experience with Chinese cuisine.

I'll try other dishes next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Watcharaporn Amonsak

sample_reviews_en.text: It took us about 35 minutes by motorcycle. The storefront looked familiar at first glance, like it was in a city in China. The shop was very clean inside. We ordered the rice noodles and tofu recommended by a friend. The first bite was fragrant and spicy 👅, absolutely delicious 😋 The tofu 👍👍👍. The rice noodles also lived up to their reputation for being incredibly delicious 😋. The beef in the rice noodles was also very tender and tasty 🤤. Definitely worth the trip to share a late-night snack with! 😛
sample_reviews_en.author: 刘丹

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything on the menu was absolutely delicious! Absolutely delicious! Absolutely delicious! I can't stress this enough! Authentic flavors, fresh ingredients, generous portions, a clean and cozy atmosphere, and two adorable chubby cats! I'll definitely be back next time I'm in Bangkok! A huge thank you to the restaurant for providing such delicious and authentic Yunnan cuisine!
sample_reviews_en.author: woo zakk

sample_reviews_en.text: I found the most authentic taste of home in Bangkok. It's outrageously delicious! Every time I'm in Bangkok, no matter how far away I am, I always make sure to take a taxi here if I'm staying for a while. Friendly advice: if you're not from Yunnan, don't try the stinky tofu rice noodles; you might not like it. Yunnan friends, rest assured, it tastes like home!
sample_reviews_en.author: 张毓凌

sample_reviews_en.text: The most authentic Yunnan rice noodles in Bangkok! Highly recommend the small pot rice noodles, braised rice noodles, and cold rice noodles! The owner is a generous and kind-hearted Yunnan girl who makes delicious beef. I've been eating here for two years now, and it's my favorite! 😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Yunzhu Huang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, authentic Chinese food where no one speaks Thai. You just point to what you want to order. The good thing is you get to try new things and every dish is exciting.
The noodles are delicious, the french fries are delicious, and the skewers of meat are excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: NiiK Leuangboriboon

restaurants.name: Huanom100%
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 32/2 แฟลต พ.4 Pracha Songkhro Rd, ดินแดง Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
These two are our absolute favorites!

Strawberry Bingsu: Delicious, perfectly balanced sweet and sour, refreshing, and the shaved ice is incredibly fine. 69฿

Custard Bread: The custard cream is delicious, not too sweet, and just right. 40฿ for a pair.

Whipped Cream, Shredded Coconut, and Raisin Bread: 50฿ per slice

Custard Toast Sticks: 69฿

Thai Tea Bingsu: 69฿

There's no parking lot. If you park on the street, be careful, the police might tow your car! They're good at towing and fining in this area. Don't break the rules! (Just kidding!)
sample_reviews_th.author: Mii Blue

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted good, but I'm not sure if it was the owner or a service staff member (the one with blonde/brown hair) who was rude to a customer even though the customer was polite from the start. The service was terrible. They kept making faces, seemed unwilling to serve, and used a disrespectful tone (raising their voice). I don't understand why customers have to put up with such a bad attitude. Customers are paying for this meal. I don't know if you can improve your service manners, but please do. If you're not willing to improve your attitude, don't work in the service industry. It's unfair to other customers who want to enjoy a delicious meal but are instead treated with such terrible service. (This review is entirely truthful; I don't intend to be malicious, but the service was truly awful.) Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Janriya Poengkoet

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is pretty standard, you can find similar food anywhere. I've eaten there a couple of times because a friend works there. But one day, I didn't get to eat because I was waiting for a friend we'd planned to go out with. My friend told me to wait at a table outside since she was about to finish work. I hadn't been sitting long when the owner brought me the menu. I said, "Oh, it's okay, my friend said to wait here."
Suddenly, the owner's expression changed from smiling to chasing me away, telling me to go sit somewhere else because those were tables for customers. Does that mean I'm not a customer if I don't eat there? Actually, this happened a year ago, and I wasn't going to make a big deal out of it, but was this how I deserved it?
sample_reviews_en.author: นนท์ ยาวง

sample_reviews_en.text:
The smoothies and desserts are delicious and affordable.

The shop has a nice atmosphere and is always busy.

My recommended menu items are:

Strawberry Cheesecake, Unicorn, and Blue Sky.

They also have toast with various toppings.

Other desserts include Flower Ice Cream.

The service is friendly. The shop is near Din Daeng Market.

It's located right on the road, making it very convenient to get to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tor San

sample_reviews_en.text:
I found this place through Grab, at Jodfair Market, and finally got to eat there! It's a dessert shop with just the right amount of sweetness.
The whipped cream is top-notch – smooth, creamy, and perfectly sweet. Wow! Absolutely amazing!
They also give you complimentary toasted bread and crispy bread.
The Thai tea bingsu was just okay.
The must-try drink is the strawberry cheesecake smoothie!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploy lamore

sample_reviews_en.text:
Recommended.
Good price and good quality.
The best budget-friendly option.
I highly recommend this restaurant.
Every dish I tried was delicious.
The prices are affordable, the portions are generous, and the taste is great.
There's a wide variety of menu items to choose from.
I especially liked the mini toast; it wasn't too big.

You won't find a better deal than this!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thammatep Wongprasert

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were lovely, the service was fast, the menu had a wide variety of options, the prices were very reasonable, the restaurant was clean, simple, the air conditioning was cool, and the music was nice. Great!
sample_reviews_en.author: พิชชาวัลย์ คงเพ็ชรศักดิ์

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is clean, has a wide variety of menu options, the prices are affordable, and they have promotions that change every month.
sample_reviews_en.author: ลาภวัต ตันติพงษ์

restaurants.name: หมิงเจียน BBQ 民间故事特色烧烤 Folk Story Speciality BBQ
restaurants.address:

167 จุฬาฯ 16 Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem among local students and expats – this "folk tale-style BBQ" is a true gem! No influencer filters, just authentic flavors and generous portions to win over customers.

✅ Lamb Skewers + Beef Skewers: The skewers are marinated beforehand and grilled over charcoal until the skin is crispy and juicy! Sprinkled with cumin and chili powder, they're so fragrant you'll want to lick the skewers clean. Absolutely no gamey taste – meat lovers, give it a try!

✅ Beef Brisket + Pork Belly: These two are the real hidden gems! The beef brisket is grilled to a golden brown with a slight char, tender and juicy, fragrant but not greasy; the pork belly is perfectly marbled with fat and lean meat, becoming more flavorful with each chew, the rich, fatty aroma exploding in your mouth – a carb-loving dream!

✅ Grilled Chicken Wings: The skin is crispy, the chicken inside is tender and juicy, falling off the bone with a gentle pull. Savory and flavorful, you'll want to lick your fingers clean afterward!
sample_reviews_en.author: yue1 Pan9

sample_reviews_en.text: Having been abroad for a long time, I really missed Chinese food. This barbecue place was really delicious. I brought my foreign friends to eat here, and they loved it too. It's the kind of food you crave if you can't have it. The taste is very Chinese, which I really liked. Although the ingredients might be slightly different due to the location—for example, the chives didn't taste quite the same as in China—overall, it was really delicious and very reasonably priced. The beef skewers were only 10 baht each. However, when ordering, I forgot what I wanted to eat; there were too many things I wanted to try. I hope I have the chance to come back again next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: nara o

sample_reviews_en.text:
This BBQ place was such a pleasant surprise! 🔥 The ingredients were incredibly fresh, and the meat skewers were grilled to a perfect crisp on the outside and tender on the inside, bursting with aroma. The smell was irresistible from the moment they hit the table. The signature beef skewers and pork belly were especially delicious, with a perfect balance of lean and fat, and paired with their secret sauce, they were absolutely addictive.

The environment was also very clean, with a great atmosphere, making it perfect for gatherings with friends or a casual evening drink. The owner and staff were very welcoming, and the food came out quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: 洛伊

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a highly recommended restaurant. As a northerner, it's rare to find authentic Northeastern Chinese barbecue in Bangkok, but I finally got to try it this time! My child took one bite and immediately said it tasted just like the barbecue from his grandma's house in China. The dumplings, barbecue, and sweet and sour pork were all delicious, and I'll definitely go back.

For the barbecue, we ordered meat skewers, grilled bread, grilled steamed buns, grilled chives, grilled pig's trotters, and grilled bean curd sheets. Both the sweet and savory options were incredibly delicious. We were absolutely stuffed!
sample_reviews_en.author: michelle fan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my fifth time eating here, and I absolutely love this barbecue restaurant! The grilled meat is so tender and juicy; I can't stop eating it every time! The bok choy is absolutely amazing—the tenderest and most fragrant I've ever had! The steamed dumplings are a delightful surprise; the dumpling wrappers are flavorful on their own, and they're incredibly delicious even without any sauce!

And the service is truly exceptional. The staff are warm and attentive, the food comes out quickly, and their attitude is superb. Every time I come here, I feel incredibly comfortable! Highly, highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: TUYẾT NGUYỄN

sample_reviews_en.text: An authentic and absolutely delicious Chinese bbq restaurant with very fair prices. It tastes just like it did in China. The seasoning is perfect and everything is fresh. The dumplings were very juicy and cucumber salad perfect seasoned with lots of garlic and peanuts. I definitely recommend coming here !!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chloe Watkinson

sample_reviews_en.text: How can barbecue be so delicious? One bite and I'm already homesick! 🥹🥹 The owner said he'll stay open as long as Thailand goes out of business, hahaha. In a few days, we'll also be able to eat various stir-fries. I'll definitely be a regular customer. The owner even gave us complimentary water, thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: 宋阳阳

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an amazing Chinese barbecue restaurant! The ingredients are fresh, and the taste is authentic. I've been craving this for so long, and finally getting to eat it was so satisfying! The restaurant is conveniently located near Chulalongkorn University, perfect for both eating and strolling around!
sample_reviews_en.author: Maggie L

restaurants.name: ก๋งเล็กก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือร่วมสมัย
restaurants.address:

150/11 ถ. ประชาราษฎร์ สาย 1 Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the pork dish. The pork was very tender and well-prepared, stewed in chunks, soft and not chewy.

I ordered it to go, requesting the noodles and vegetables be served unblanched. The staff provided excellent service, preparing the meal neatly. Even the garnish, fried garlic, was separated without me having to ask.

The restaurant was clean, the service was good, and the price was reasonable considering the effort put into the dish and the quality of the ingredients.

(It was a little on the sweet side, but that might depend on individual preferences.)
sample_reviews_en.author: chetsupa s

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a new restaurant that opened last month. I tried it for the first time and the beef boat noodle soup was delicious. The noodles were chewy and soft, the beef was tender and fresh, and the broth was flavorful. However, there was a bit too much oil in the broth (those who don't like oil can ask for less). The restaurant was a little hot, but overall the service was good and efficient. Everything is ordered and paid for via QR code scanning. I'd rate it as one of the best restaurants in Bang Pho.
sample_reviews_en.author: SOMKANE CHAINARONG

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered dry noodles with pork neck. It was delicious, not chewy, and they gave me plenty of pieces. The broth was fragrant and the portion was generous, enough to fill me up. The menu via the QR code has more options than the one on the menu in front of the shop. The dry noodles also come with a side of broth. The staff provided good service. The shop is located on the roadside, easy to find, and a short walk from Bang Pho MRT station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cactus156

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here many times before. The taste is delicious, and the portion size and price are reasonable. However, today, the pork cracklings were hard, some pieces were tough and I had to spit them out, and some weren't crispy at all. In short, I endured eating it all because I didn't want to waste the 35 baht. I asked the staff and they said it was from yesterday. 🥲
sample_reviews_en.author: joizzxx

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! I eat here almost every day. The soup is fragrant and flavorful, perfect without needing any extra seasoning, but it's even better if you add some. It's especially delicious with an egg. The atmosphere is nice, the music is pleasant, and it's not hot thanks to the fans that keep the area cool. The taste is consistently good every time I order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boonsitabq

sample_reviews_en.text: The broth is fragrant and delicious; it's a rich and flavorful boat noodle soup in a large bowl with generous portions and big pieces of meat – great value for money. The iced coffee is also strong and good. I forgot to take a picture of the crispy pork cracklings; this one is the fried pork fat cracklings. The shop offers two types to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornchanok Ae

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's delicious! The flavor is great even without any seasoning. The ingredients are excellent, the meat isn't tough, and the meatballs are tasty.

I'm not a paid reviewer; I found it on TikTok and it was so delicious I wanted to help review it. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Isaranon Promdee

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant was very clean. The plates, bowls, chopsticks, and spoons looked like they were of good quality. The braised beef was delicious and not tough at all, and the pork neck was also tender. The food was prepared quickly and the price was very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jitpisut Lee

restaurants.name: Pakmor Mahasan
restaurants.address:

Sand Haus Mengjai, Pracha Uthit Rd, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: A bowl of steamed rice flour dumplings comes with 6 pieces. You can order more if you think that's not enough. What deserves praise is the piping hot broth; it was served piping hot. This is probably because they cooked the beef dumplings by pouring the broth over them. I hope they serve other types of meat this hot as well, and even hotter if possible. I'm really tired of the broth not being piping hot when eating Thai noodles. One thing I'd like to see improved is a wider variety of fillings.
sample_reviews_en.author: veeraphon sahastharachai

sample_reviews_en.text:
This small restaurant is located in the Sand Haus Pracha Uthit-Mengjai project. The taste is considered okay, but the soup isn't as rich as it should be. It's more suitable for health-conscious people looking for something light to eat, with less starch and milder flavors.
For meat eaters, there's a Wagyu beef dumpling dish, but my wife said it wasn't good because the meat was cut with tendons, making it tough. The shrimp and pork, however, were decent.
sample_reviews_en.author: TED-TON P.

sample_reviews_en.text: The steamed rice flour dumplings (Pak Mo) tasted delicious. For something unique, I tried the Tom Yum version. The Tom Yum soup was satisfyingly tangy, and the dumplings were freshly made with a soft yet slightly chewy texture – just right. The restaurant was clean, the staff provided good service, and the mall's parking was convenient – ​​it wasn't too crowded yet, so parking was easy.
sample_reviews_en.author: TW

sample_reviews_en.text:
The steamed dumplings are delicious, with thin and soft dough.
The soup broth tastes great; the tonkatsu is flavorful, and the tom yum is very tasty.
The pork, shrimp, and other ingredients are fresh and clean.
The restaurant is clean, the atmosphere is nice, and the seating is comfortable.
The staff provides excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: J N

sample_reviews_en.text: The only restaurant here that is worth trying. Not a seafood person, so not recommending Laem Charoen. The staff could use a bit of service training as to advising customers. Their mannerisms are great, just not sure of what to do when stuff runs out or how to explain the new menu clearly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brian Reka

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wow wow wow 🤩 the tomyum soup base is awesome 👏 😋 lemon grass freshness with the creamy tomyum flavors made it a perfect bowl to enjoy after a warm summer day. 😊
10 🌟

Loved the noodles and the soup. 🍜 highly recommended.

Not crowded, friendly service, helpful staff.

- PP 🌱
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuii & PP

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted okay, especially the chicken karaage and the soup that came with the fried rice. The fried rice itself was fluffy and decent.
However, I have to criticize the service. The staff taking the orders didn't communicate very well.
sample_reviews_en.author: TT

sample_reviews_en.text: We stumbled upon this little restaurant with a group of children attending a badminton tournament. Everything is handmade; you can see and taste the difference. Well done! I highly recommend it if you're looking for handcrafted food. 👏👏👏
sample_reviews_en.author: LexisConsult

restaurants.name: หมูสะเต๊ะ นายเม้ง
restaurants.address:

170/1 Thanon Charoen Mueang, Rong Mueang, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant has been open for 50 years and sells only pork satay. They offer two types of pork satay:
lean meat and meat mixed with fat. I ordered 20 skewers of the meat mixed with fat satay, plus two slices of toasted bread.
-The meat mixed with fat satay: The pork is marinated to be tender and flavorful, especially with the added fat. It's grilled to perfection, fragrant and delicious. It's served with a rich, sweet, salty, and savory peanut dipping sauce with a fragrant spice blend. The pickled vegetables (cucumber, sliced ​​yellow chili, vinegar and sugar syrup) cut through the richness. Simply delicious.
-The peanut dipping sauce for the pork satay: The restaurant coarsely grinds the peanuts for a nice texture. The flavor is rich, fragrant with spices, sweet, salty, and savory. It's an incredibly perfect match for the pork satay.
If you're near Wat Duang Khae, give it a try! It's definitely delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirichai Thananunthakit

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork satay at this street stall is on the drier side, with a satisfying chew. Those who prefer juicy satay might not like it. The highlight is definitely the dipping sauce – it's incredibly flavorful, with plenty of peanuts, a rich, fragrant, sweet, creamy, and slightly spicy taste, and absolutely no strong curry smell. It's my favorite satay sauce. Eating it with the pickled vegetables is pure bliss.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thiraphong Sriratanamongkol

sample_reviews_en.text: This establishment offers delectable, home-style pork satay that is both flavorful and meticulously prepared. The wait time is minimal, ensuring a seamless dining experience. The pork’s marinade imparts a superb texture and an enticing aroma, elevating the dish to a memorable culinary standard. The accompanying peanut dipping sauce is exceptional, ranking among the finest I have encountered.
sample_reviews_en.author: TP TP

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ve been being a customer since I was little. The owner told me that you could hardly find the special dark sauce like his. So, I hardly miss his special sauce and Pork Satay. Normally Satay would be served with peanut sauce. Here, they serve both. Actually the taste of the food is quite a normal local taste but the hospitality is superb.
sample_reviews_en.author: ไปตามน้ํา

sample_reviews_en.text: For tender, delicious pork satay in the heart of the city, at the Wat Duang Khae intersection, you have to think of Meng Pork Satay. It's a long-standing establishment, delicious, tender, and subtly fragrant with spices (not overpowering). The prices are reasonable, and the service is friendly. Open from 4:00 PM to 9:30 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunn Nitikaan

sample_reviews_en.text:
You have to try it!! Overall, the pork skewers are big and the dipping sauce is delicious, up to standard. The price is inexpensive, 7 baht per skewer (many shops charge 9-12 baht).
I bought it to take home, I didn't sit and eat, but there are 1-2 tables available to sit and eat at. ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: PKe

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating here for 10 years. It started at 3 baht per skewer, then went up to 5, and now it's 7 baht. It's next to the shrine, at the Wat Duang Khae intersection.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peng Aeng

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious! I once ate at the restaurant six days in a row, ordering the same sauce and the pickled vegetable relish. It's a must-try for satay pork fans!
sample_reviews_en.author: นายฐาปนา วรพันธ์พานิช

restaurants.name: ตุ๊กตา อาหารตามสั่ง
restaurants.address:

478/7 Rama IV Rd, Rong Mueang, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stumbled upon this gem beside a massage place near Hua Lamphong Station, and I can't stop thinking about it! The person taking our order was incredibly polite and patient, even as we took our time deciding what to eat.

The food was absolutely delicious and affordable. Every bite was packed with flavor, and it left us wishing we had found this place sooner. What’s even better is that it’s a place where mostly locals eat, which really speaks to how authentic and good the food is.

It was our last day in Bangkok, and I honestly regret not discovering it earlier. If I had, I’d have been here every morning since it’s just a short walk from my hotel.

Highly recommend this spot for anyone looking for tasty, cheap meals in the area. It’s a must-try if you’re near Hua Lamphong! 💕
sample_reviews_en.author: Shika Hanna

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a genuine local gem that puts Street Food Fighter to shame. I was disappointed with the Baek Jong-won restaurant yesterday, but I left this place deeply impressed.

The pork trotters rice bowl and morning glory are absolutely delicious. If you just add extra pork trotters, they give you a bowl full for around 100 baht. If two people order the pork trotters rice bowl, extra meat, morning glory, and a beer, it’s pure bliss.

It’s tasty and affordable, so if you see it while passing by, charge in!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaehoon

sample_reviews_en.text:
The dining area is across the road from the kitchen. The menu is easy to understand with pictures. There was also a Japanese translation on the menu. I had the pork noodles. It had thinly sliced, tender pork (probably loin) and green vegetables. Underneath the generous amount of sauce were chewy wontons. It was incredibly delicious.

I revisited six months later. When eating near Hua Lamphong, this is my only choice.
sample_reviews_en.author: KYO S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited in January 2024.

I visited while waiting for a train to Ayutthaya.

The seats were clean and the prices were reasonable.

There was a photo menu with the names of dishes in various languages ​​posted on the wall, so even tourists could feel at ease.

I ordered gapow rice and a Coke, and was very satisfied with the strong, spicy flavor.


Coincidentally, all the other customers were Thai, which makes sense.
sample_reviews_en.author: goshi kan

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent food restaurant run by nice people. I eat here daily when I am in Bangkok and pick up an extra meal if I am going away. The pork noodle soup is one of my favourites. My other picture is the holy basil seafood and rice. I have tried and also like the fried noodles with pork and the holy basil pork with rice. Tasty, made fresh and affordable.  Try it, you will not be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Doug W

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Tom Yum Goong here was the best Tom Yum Goong I've had in Bangkok.

I had a meal here while waiting for the train to Ayutthaya.
This was my third visit.
The menu includes Tom Yum Goong (120B), fried rice, gapao rice, etc.
The Tom Yum Goong is delicious, but it's spicy enough for Thai people, so I ordered it less spicy and they adjusted it to my liking.
sample_reviews_en.author: 大西拓也

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is a real local gem!!

Every Korean will be satisfied!!

The meat noodle soup is good!

The Tom Yum soup is very, very good!!! (The best Tom Yum soup I've had since coming to Thailand)

I had a great start to my breakfast with the meat rice bowl and more!!!

Everything was delicious!!^^
sample_reviews_en.author: kws lee

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a very local Thai eatery. It's small, with only about six tables. The owner is fluent in English and Vietnamese. The menu is small but has local prices and is written in Thai, English, Japanese, and Vietnamese. It's spicy and delicious! I would like to visit this place again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom Tom

restaurants.name: organic fish shop - ร้านปลาออร์แกนิก
restaurants.address:

8, 27 Vibhavadi Rangsit 22 Alley, Chom Phon, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Seafood from in other places even from restaurants cannot compare. The seafood here were fresh and tasted very good with no off-putting smell.

This shop sells more than just seafood; they also carry other organic produce and other products like shrimp paste (กะปิ).

So if you are looking for safe and tasty seafood, I would recommend ร้านปลาออร์แกนิก!
sample_reviews_th.author: Jitti Parinayakosol

sample_reviews_en.text:
There's a wide variety of organic products, ingredients, seasonings, and traditional fish sauce—something I've never seen before, but it looks clean and likely free of any harmful substances.
This place is famous for its fresh fish and seafood, delivered directly from fishermen without middlemen, ensuring freshness and fair pricing.
At the end of every week, there's a small market in front of the shop with a selection of goods directly from producers. If you're interested, you can check it out. There are farm-raised eggs, fresh, free-range chicken with a chewy texture, delicious grilled chicken, fruits and vegetables, and jams from strawberry farms in Chiang Mai—all excellent. We think in this day and age, it's best to prioritize safe food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leeyakorn J.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Highly recommended!

This shop sells fresh and wholesale seafood (deliveries every Thursday and Friday), frozen seafood, and single-dish meals (every Saturday).
The food is delicious, mid-range in price, and high-quality. They use local ingredients, the place is clean, and there's free parking for more than 4 cars. The shop is located in a quiet alley, perfect for those wanting to escape the big city (but with a central location).
sample_reviews_en.author: Phurit P. (Ernest Map)

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here, and the food was delicious. I ordered the papaya salad with pickled shrimp. The staff were polite, and the restaurant is located in a side street, so it's quiet and peaceful. They also sell organic products. Next time, I'll try some of their single-dish meals.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panadda Tempaiboonkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
The best place to buy organic food.

My mother-in-law usually buys organic chicken and pork from here.

There are also some food sellers in the shop's garden and they sell fruits such as coconuts.

The coconut seller is kind. As we buy lots of coconuts they sometimes give me free coconut juice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Emre Senbabaoglu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Organic sea food to buy and variety of dishes to eat there too.  Very fresh and good tasting food.
Very friendly staff and nice Support for local fishermen community.
(Compressor noise in the restaurant/shop) really too loud…)
sample_reviews_en.author: Lothar Mergili

sample_reviews_en.text: Organic seafood from local fishing communities, caught using environmentally friendly fishing gear, processed according to organic farming standards. Consumers get clean and safe food, and fishermen receive fair prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maphueng Story

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dine-in food is available only on Saturdays from 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM.
Today, I came with a group of friends and we got to try several dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: onn chon

restaurants.name: Insho Japanese Restaurant & Korean BBQ
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 2 Ngamwongwarn 25 Alley, Tambon Bang Khen, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is now my new favorite yakiniku (grilled meat) restaurant 😋🥩
After searching for a really delicious yakiniku restaurant in Nonthaburi, I found Insho and had the chance to try it.

I'd rate it as one of the best yakiniku restaurants in Nonthaburi that I've ever been to. The ingredients are of very high quality; the restaurant seems very meticulous in selecting its produce (even the chilies and garlic are expertly sliced ​​and prepared – very impressive! 555).
Especially the meat, which is incredibly tender and has beautiful marbling. The owner grills it and gives detailed advice on how to grill each type of meat, resulting in different flavors even from the same cut. It's like having a omakase experience in disguise.

Besides the meat, the other dishes like the fried chicken and rice to pair with the meat are also delicious.

If you're a meat lover, I highly recommend trying this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phuncharat Konsanit

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, fresh, and good. The price is reasonable. Today I had shabu-shabu which was amazing. The vegetables were great, and I also had salmon sashimi which was very fresh. You can even request what you want or don't want, and the restaurant will accommodate you. It's my first time here and I'm very impressed. But what impressed me most was the waitress. She was the one who recommended the food, took my requests, and constantly checked on the customers to see if they needed anything. Her service was incredibly attentive. Excellent! Definitely worth a repeat visit. Next time I'll try the yakiniku (grilled meat).
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanchanok Gansomdee

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is super close to my house! It's so close, but if it wasn't good, I wouldn't patronize it. I go there regularly. The food is delicious. I usually eat shabu-shabu. The price is good, and the service is excellent. They have every kind of dipping sauce imaginable, including chili and garlic. I ordered some appetizers, and the chicken karaage was crispy and delicious. They have a wide variety of cold and tasty drinks. I highly recommend it! The price is great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prang Prang

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was very impressed!
- The attentiveness of the staff.
- Especially the chef who explained how to grill the meat deliciously.
- There are two restaurants here, so you can order from either, allowing you to choose between Japanese food, grilled meat, European food, and Thai food.
- The price is very reasonable considering the attentiveness of the staff.
I will definitely come back.
The atmosphere is nice, spacious, and comfortable.
Convenient parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nava H

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my first time giving a perfect 10/10! No deductions.
The meat was amazing, every cut I ordered was excellent. Today I chose Yakiniku and added salmon sashimi.
The eel sushi pieces were large and satisfying, as were the salmon sushi pieces. Everything I ordered this meal was well worth the price. The service from all the staff was also excellent. I will definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Phatthiranarin

sample_reviews_en.text: The dining experience here was immaculate, the service, food, and the atmosphere is just amazing. The beef sets and salmons are so worth it, it is a must try in this restaurant. Dining here as a group provides such great vibes as there is always chattering and laughter, small performances, creating a lively atmosphere. This is a must try if you’re in the area!
sample_reviews_en.author: Neutron

sample_reviews_en.text: The meat was delicious! I highly recommend it. The restaurant offers both Thai and Japanese beef. The chef demonstrated different grilling techniques and let us sample the meat. Every bite was delicious. The staff were also very lovely and attentive, constantly checking on us. I'll definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: rakarvee rattanasumrit

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is seriously so good!!!!!🤍
The food is super delicious, the prices are totally worth it, and the staff are all so nice and friendly. I randomly found this restaurant, but now I’m definitely becoming a regular customer 😂 Highly recommend if you’re looking for good food and good vibes!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pim S.

restaurants.name: Pad Thai La cuisine
restaurants.address:

256 Maha Rat Rd, Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food here is delicious, I ordered Pad Thai with shrimp and I didn't expect it to be delicious, Mango sticky rice and Thai Coffee Ice are also delicious.

The place is crowded and one of the restaurants that opens later than 5 pm while the others are already closed. The food and drink menu is varied, including quite cheap.

However, you have to be patient for the main menu other than (mango sticky rice) they serve it for a long time on average I saw 30-45 minutes for each table, for Pad Thai with shrimp I received 45 minutes (until my friend came to charge his cellphone from 30% - 78%). There are no table numbers, I saw one of the waiters from the kitchen bringing drinks as if he looked confused at which table number the drink orderer he was bringing was.

They provide many dining tables, there are outdoor/indoor ones on the 1st and 2nd floors, and the plus is they also have toilets.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puspa Indah
