sample_reviews_en.text: We had a wonderful meal after visiting the Grand Palace and Wat Pho. The portions were simple but delicious and generously sized. Our biggest plus was the friendly service. Both two younger women and a slightly older man were incredibly helpful. Another plus is that there are fans instead of air conditioning, which keeps the difference between inside and outside realistic. (20-degree air conditioning is far too cold when you're coming from 34 degrees Celsius, and it makes you sick). Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Joris van der Horst

sample_reviews_en.text: This small, made-to-order restaurant is located in Tha Tien Market. It's a short walk from Wat Pho. If you're hungry, you can stop by. In the evenings, while other shops are closed, this one stays open, welcoming many Western and foreign tourists. They offer a variety of dishes, and even have ice cream decorated with Wat Arun tile designs (though it often sells out quickly). Importantly, you can use the restaurant's restroom for a small fee while walking around the area, even without ordering any food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jantima Angkapanichkit

sample_reviews_en.text: After visiting the Grand Palace, I was a bit hungry, so I randomly picked a restaurant and went in. I ordered stir-fried water spinach, Pad Thai, Basil Rice, Mango Sticky Rice, and Thai Milk Tea. Everything was delicious, very authentic Thai cuisine. The Pad Thai noodles were chewy and slightly translucent, quite different from the usual pure white noodles. The restaurant was very busy, with almost no empty seats, but because they were so busy, the staff were a bit indifferent in their service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yilun Huang

sample_reviews_en.text:
I would give negative stars if it was possible. Truly opposite of what I’ve heard about the Thai hospitality.

The owner persisted us to order quickly even though there was no queue outside, and somehow still managed to get all of our orders wrong, and tried to pin the blame on us.

On top of the poor service, the taste of the food was subpar and so many more better options in the vicinity. Please don’t waste your time & money here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rubbini Markandan

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible experience, this was the worst meal I had during my week in Thailand. The shrimp in the fried rice tasted very stale, the rice was almost cold, and it smelled gross. After a few bites, I couldn’t eat any more. The Tom Yum soup was even worse than the ready-made packets you can buy at Trader Joe’s. Service is also bad. A complete waste of time. I would definitely not recommend this restaurant—it's a tourist trap.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped by here in 2024 after visiting Wat Arun. I was served by a friendly young man who even joked around a bit. The place was packed with tourists. Luckily, we still got a seat because there were five of us. However, we had to be independent because only one waiter helped us move chairs and put the tables together. The price was a bit pricey, and the taste was mediocre, perhaps because it's a tourist spot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Desty Caroline

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurants next door have to wait, so I use this place.

The prices are slightly cheaper than the neighboring restaurants,
and the cleanliness is a bit lacking.

Still, the food was delicious, and the beer was refreshing.

* Beer 110 baht, two dishes 180 baht

* Recommended for those who don't want to waste time waiting.
sample_reviews_en.author: 최현성

restaurants.name: Rot Det Tao Pun Restaurant
restaurants.address:

367/5 ถ. กรุงเทพ - นนทบุรี Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I walk past this shop almost every day. I usually order the rice vermicelli noodle soup. The price is standard at 40 baht. The broth is decent; clear, fragrant, and not too sweet, unlike another shop a little further up near Tao Poon MRT station (Tia Kim Ho). In terms of flavor, it's similar to the famous shops in Yaowarat, but it's slightly lacking. The fish balls are firm and chewy, like those from the famous shops, and have a similar taste. They're probably the best in this area. The taro balls aren't good; they're probably not my style. The fried shrimp balls are sometimes delicious, sometimes soggy, like they've been sitting around for a while. In summary, it's edible and you won't be disappointed. If you like clear, flavorful fish ball soup, this is a top choice in this area.
sample_reviews_en.author: WITTAYA LAORIENDEE

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the most delicious fish-cake noodles in Thailand.  You will regret if you miss this.   I ate here when I was about 10 years old and the shop owner still remembers me when I came here again at the age of 30.  The only concerns are a hard to find parking-spot and no more original fried taro like 20 years ago.  (There is still fried taro, but not as tasty as before.  This information is dated back 6-7 years from when I posted in 2017, perhaps they do original fried taro again as I saw in the picture below.)

Updated: There is sky train or subway train (BTS or MRT) already in 2020.  Parking spot should not be a problem.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arm Nakornthab

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ideal fishball noodle shop, feel the originality, the cleanliness of the food, the shop, so try to stop by here
and really not disappointed, delicious taste, good price, clean, will definitely come back again, a bit difficult to find parking

⭐️Food Good Quality
⭐️Clean Restaurant
⭐️Kind Service
⭐️Good taste’

⭐️Good quality of ingredients
⭐️The shop is clean
⭐️Normal service, not too loud
⭐️Delicious, I like it
sample_reviews_en.author: GoWentWhy

sample_reviews_en.text:
Small noodles in Tom Yum soup. The noodles were cooked just right, with a well-balanced sour and spicy flavor. If you like it extra spicy, you might want to add some chili.

The fish dumplings, fried taro, and minced pork were good.
The fried dumpling wrappers weren't crispy.

60 baht

The restaurant was clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teerapat Ungsriwong

sample_reviews_en.text: Anyone who loves authentic, traditional Yaowarat-style fish balls must try this shop. Their fish balls and fish cakes are incredibly fragrant and flavorful. Their shrimp balls are also delicious. Importantly, the price is very reasonable considering the quality – only 50-60 baht per bowl.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paphonnat Banluechairit

sample_reviews_en.text: It is a noodle restaurant, but it uses fish balls and other ingredients. I have known this restaurant for over 30 years. It is reliable and delicious, but it is a small restaurant. Turn right towards Wong Sawang. The restaurant is on the left, about 500 meters from Tao Poon Intersection.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongpan W

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) was delicious, from the noodles and meatballs to the red fermented tofu broth. It was a little sweet, but still very tasty. The shrimp meatballs were so good I ordered some separately.

The vermicelli noodles were incredibly soft – a must-try!

The yen ta fo was delicious, but the tom yum was just so-so.
The fish balls and shrimp balls were truly delicious. The fish balls were chewy, while the shrimp balls had a fragrant sesame oil aroma.
The fried taro was even better when eaten dry.
Parking was difficult to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kosink Kittidechachan

restaurants.name: Grandfather's House Restaurant
restaurants.address:

141 Sukhumvit Rd, Pak Nam, อำเภอเมือง Samut Prakan 10270, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. The spicy lemongrass shrimp salad was flavorful, the fried sea bass with fish sauce was tasty, the oyster omelet was delicious, but the Tom Yum seafood soup was very small for 250 baht and bland, not spicy at all. The fried rice was just average. The atmosphere was very warm, like eating at home, with everyone singing and laughing, and dancing along. Overall, the food tasted good and the atmosphere was great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kessara Chamnonk

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves both Northeastern Thai and general Thai cuisine. They have dishes like Khao Suan Kwang grilled chicken (crispy skin), som tum (papaya salad), snakehead fish, sea bass, and other seafood. There's ample parking, and both air-conditioned karaoke rooms and outdoor seating are available. There's also a coffee shop at the front, right by the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pheeraphat Laowittayawong

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant has karaoke, which is great! It can accommodate approximately 35 tables, perfect for small gatherings. The food is delicious and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aor Benjawan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fast service, complete order, and every dish tasted great.
Especially the grilled chicken; this restaurant grills it exceptionally well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eakawee Ketjuntra

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the price is reasonable. They have karaoke. It's a great place to relax.
sample_reviews_en.author: pat pat

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, it was good. The customers were friendly, the music was nice, and the food was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: มงคล ประกอบแสง

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes good, with a focus on Thai cuisine. The grilled chicken is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: ตามใจพี

restaurants.name: ครัวข้าวหอม แกงปักษ์ใต้
restaurants.address:

Near soi youth exchange school Soi Khlong Lamchiak 2-4, Nuan Chan, Bueng Kum, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dirty. There were baby flies in the food display case. There were dead mosquitoes in the stir-fried vegetables.
The food didn't taste bad, but the dirtiness was unacceptable. The service was mediocre. I asked the staff for rice with curry three times before I could order the side dishes... I went with my mother, and she had already ordered, so we had to eat too. Luckily, we used the "Support Thai Business" scheme and got a discount on the food. Otherwise, I would have been really annoyed.
Parking was available on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: linyenly

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted acceptable, but the prices were exorbitant and not worth the quality. The service was terrible, very poor. The staff were rude and the owner sided with his employees, which is understandable, but there wasn't a single apology. The service needs serious improvement. The atmosphere was mediocre. I recommend going to another restaurant; avoid this one, it's extremely expensive, and they don't even clearly state the prices. Both the owner and the staff were unfriendly and had terrible manners.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oh Oh

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes acceptable.
The portions are small.
If you're thinking of eating here, go to another restaurant.
It's in front of my child's school, not appealing at all.
A waste of time paying 100 baht for a meal.
The staff were also unfriendly, making faces when ordering incorrectly, and offered no apology whatsoever.
Soon, everyone will probably just go to other restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: krittiyarat SCADA

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd like a sign to be posted stating that you need to spend 400 baht to get free vegetables for takeaway. Last time I spent over 300 baht and got them, but this time I didn't, which is strange. Therefore, please write or have a clear sign informing customers of this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Korn B

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, fresh, and clean. The restaurant had a nice atmosphere with plenty of tables and parking available. I especially liked the free shrimp paste dip with fresh vegetables. 😋 Delicious Foods and Good Service
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuttamon Aranyapala

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice lives up to its name with fragrant rice, served with chili paste, vegetables, ice, and free drinking water. Absolutely fantastic!
sample_reviews_en.author: Smartpetch Saensmart

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, flavorful, and spicy, especially the shrimp paste chili dip, and unlimited vegetables.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wawat Padwn

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious Southern Thai food at affordable prices, and you can even split the bill in half...
sample_reviews_en.author: อรุณ จันทวิมล

restaurants.name: ตั้มเอเซียซีฟู้ด
restaurants.address:

18 หมู่1 ซอยวัดบัวขวัญ ถนนประชานิเวศน์3 ตำบลท่าทราย อำเภอเมือง Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The prawns were huge, still the size of my palm even after grilling, perfectly cooked. The restaurant uses really fresh and sweet ingredients. The crab with roe was also very large; usually you only find small ones. The crab was fresh, easy to peel, and the meat was sweet. My only minor complaint is the dipping sauce; it was a little too sweet, maybe because I prefer it sour, haha. But it was still delicious and well-balanced, a standard seafood dipping sauce with a nice lime aroma. Overall, it's delicious, and every time I eat here, it's consistently good and the price is reasonable – enough for two meals!
sample_reviews_en.author: Alisa Manathanya

sample_reviews_en.text: My first visit was a big hit! It's a mid-sized restaurant with parking available on-site. The shrimp and crab were incredibly fresh, with sweet and firm meat. The dipping sauce was delicious. I personally thought the price was reasonable. The staff provided excellent service, constantly refilling water and clearing away food scraps. They even gave us a complimentary plate of watermelon at the end!
sample_reviews_en.author: amppare Moo

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent service. The food is fresh, though a bit pricey. The dipping sauces are delicious, and there's a wide variety of dishes. There's parking available, and it's conveniently located near my house. When I crave seafood, I don't need to go far!
sample_reviews_en.author: ศรีสุดา สายวิเชียรแย้ม

sample_reviews_en.text: The food at the restaurant is fresh, but when I ordered takeout, they secretly included some stale ingredients. This happened twice with the grilled prawns, and several of them were stale. Please improve the quality of your takeout food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattida Sawangsri

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating at this restaurant for a long time. Its strengths are the freshness of the ingredients and the affordable prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Katangoo Prakasvejakit

sample_reviews_en.text: The shrimp are incredibly fresh, straight from the pond. And they really do have roe in their heads, no deception!
sample_reviews_en.author: oaebig phumpoung

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food, fresh ingredients, good service, reasonable prices, and parking available for about 6 cars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamonrat Subprasert

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is fresh and delicious, and the staff are lovely.
The portions are good and meet standards.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nanny Throngrach

restaurants.name: Besides Umi
restaurants.address:

87 Lang Suan Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Umi is a very enjoyable Japanese bistro that focuses on doing simple food properly.

What stood out most to me was the quality of the ingredients and the overall honesty of the cooking. The dishes are not trying to be overly complex or conceptual, but rather hearty, well-executed, and satisfying. It is a great example of simple food done right.

The presentation is clean and thoughtful, and the flavors are balanced and pleasing without being overworked. You can tell there is care in the kitchen, even if the approach remains straightforward.

The staff were very polite and welcoming throughout. The only area for improvement would be communication, as English proficiency could be stronger, but their attitude and effort more than made up for it.

I would happily recommend it to anyone looking for a quick lunch while walking along Langsuan Road, or even for a casual work dinner. The building complex it is located in is also very impressive from an architectural standpoint, which adds nicely to the overall experience.

Overall, a solid and comforting dining experience with good quality ingredients and a clear sense of purpose.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hamza Shouman

sample_reviews_en.text:
This izakaya-bistro has a great atmosphere, perfect for dates, hanging out with friends, or even business meetings. It's small but feels private, so reservations are recommended as seating is limited.

The food here is visually appealing and photogenic. Many dishes are easy to understand but have surprising twists.

The Sakura Shrimp and Potato Salad was my favorite; the combination of flavors and textures was perfect – crispy, salty, creamy, with just the right amount of sweetness and sourness.

The grilled beef was tender, fragrant, and had a crispy, salty, and slightly spicy finish – exactly to my taste.

The Tataki was light and refreshing, another recommended dish.

The only dishes that didn't meet expectations were the Vongole Pasta, which was extremely salty, and the Stuffed Chicken Wings and Yukke, which were surprisingly sweet. These three are worth trying if you're up for a challenge! 😆

For those unfamiliar with this style of cuisine, they have a menu with pictures on a tablet. The staff are attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panshewa P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a lovely time at Umi Besides at Velaa Langsuan.
The vibe is cozy–minimal with that refined Langsuan feel — calm, stylish, and a little tucked away from the city buzz, which I love. ✨

Food:
Fresh ingredients, clean flavors, beautifully plated.
Really enjoyed the [insert your favorite dish here — e.g., toro don / wagyu / uni pasta] — balanced, flavorful, worth coming back for.

Service:
Warm, attentive, and knowledgeable staff.
They recommended dishes based on preferences and made sure everything was smooth and comfortable. Points for genuine hospitality 👌

Overall:
A great spot for a calm lunch or dinner in the city — good food, elegant atmosphere, and service that feels personal.

Would recommend & definitely coming back 💛

4/5 because there is still room to surprise a bit more — but already a lovely place to dine and unwind.
sample_reviews_en.author: tale chutar

sample_reviews_en.text:
Besides UMI — definitely sit at the counter.

That’s where the experience really comes alive. You can watch the chefs at work, talk about the dishes, and have little conversations with them throughout the meal. It feels intimate and personal, but still very relaxed.

Food-wise, the quality is absolutely on par with UMI. Every dish was delicious, and I can easily see this being a great spot for both Thai and international guests who enjoy a more private setting and being able to interact with the chefs.

My favorite of the night? The ankimo maki. No question. 🤤🍣
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaggarphan Prasitvorranan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cozy style. Easy dinning menu. Not many for selection. Flavorful.

Neapolitan Spaghetti, Yakisoba, and grilled boneless chicken very delicious. Beef curry rice taste good but too oily due to the beef fat. Bijin tomatoes dish will be a lot better and more fresh if served colder than this (in my opinion).

Pricey. Great quality of ingredients.

Nice service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kuna Pun

sample_reviews_en.text:
We randomly walked past this place and decided to give it a try and we’re so glad we did.

Everything we ordered was delicious, especially their signature spaghetti. The fish was incredibly fresh, too.

The staff were so friendly, and sitting at the bar chatting with the chef made the whole experience even more enjoyable.✨✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanoknan Traisi

sample_reviews_en.text: Superb place. Ambience, food quality and hospitality. The chef owner has clearly put a lot of thought to the selection of dishes in his restaurant and this is a must visit for people staying in the neighbourhood of Langsuan and craving Japanese food in a casual but stylish place, with no compromise on quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: billy basu

sample_reviews_en.text: Overpriced and the taste is terrible. All the food is too sweet, it's overrated, and the service is extremely slow despite there being only a few tables occupied. I wouldn't recommend it. Go to the other restaurants in the complex instead; most of them are okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mister Tucan

restaurants.name: Hachiban Ramen
restaurants.address:

79 Ratchadaphisek Rd, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A standard Hachiban Ramen franchise that delivers exactly what it promises—fast, affordable, and consistent. Branded as a fast-food–style ramen chain, it doesn’t aim to impress with premium ingredients or intricate presentation, but rather focuses on efficiency and reliability.

The flavors are simple yet satisfying, making it a convenient option for a quick, no-fuss meal.
Don’t expect anything elaborate, but if you’re in the mood for a comforting bowl of ramen at a wallet-friendly price, this place does the job well.
sample_reviews_en.author: TP TP

sample_reviews_en.text:
I usually order Tom Yum Goong Ramen, but this time I tried a new menu item, Kaisenmen. It's a ramen dish with seafood, minced pork, and shiitake mushrooms topped with sauce. The staff warned me beforehand that it would be salty and that they couldn't reduce the saltiness level. It turned out to be very salty. If it were less salty, I would give it 5 stars. Overall, the taste was good, but a little too salty.
(Try new menu called Kaisenmen, it is too salty otherwise will give 5 stars.)
sample_reviews_en.author: My Serenity

sample_reviews_en.text: On March 30, 1969, I went to the restaurant at 8:00 PM. I asked if we could still order, and the staff member seemed annoyed, walked over to clear a table, and muttered something like "Damn it!" while taking my order. Please train your staff. If you're not taking orders anymore, just say so, so I won't leave without eating.
sample_reviews_en.author: อชิ อลิซ

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the Han (rice noodle dish) because I love the wok-fried aroma. This branch was very slow; I'd already finished everything else. And instead, they served boiled vegetables, which was watery and completely lacked the wok-fried flavor. It was like the person who cooked it didn't know how to stir-fry. Terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yoong mosquitoez

sample_reviews_en.text:
Various Japanese noodle dishes and fried rice, along with a variety of appetizers, are sure to please the whole family. The soups are diverse, flavorful, and of high quality.
However, if you go to a Japanese restaurant like this, be prepared for the smell to cling to your clothes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wutt Rj

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hachibang Ramen
The food quality is consistent across all branches.
However, the portion sizes have decreased significantly lately,
both the noodles and the minced pork.
This is in contrast to the constantly increasing prices.
Thankfully, the taste of the food remains the same.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piya Jirapapongpan

sample_reviews_en.text: The cashier was impolite, lacked customer service skills, and used inappropriate language between 5:00 PM and 7:00 PM. Their service and attitude need improvement; they are unsuitable for a counter position. This occurred on June 9th, 2022. Their language was extremely poor.
sample_reviews_en.author: หมูเด้ง หมูเด้ง

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to eat with friends and wanted to split the bill, but the cashier spoke in a very unpleasant tone. She was very rude, like she was angry about something and taking it out on the students. She also gave us a dirty look. I think I won't be going to this branch again.
sample_reviews_en.author: 32 Jiranan Veerawatkamjorn

restaurants.name: ร้านบะหมี่เสนา84
restaurants.address:

RJ9R+X9R, Khlong Lam Chiak Rd, Nawamin, Bueng Kum, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This famous, long-established restaurant from Happy Land has expanded to this location several years ago, and I can honestly say it's just as delicious as the original. Both the noodles and the roast pork rice are excellent. The noodles are soft and springy, and the roast pork is wonderfully fragrant. I highly recommend adding crispy pork for an even more amazing experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธัชชัยแบตเตอรี่ Ajai

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles are soft and springy, and the broth is incredibly flavorful – you absolutely have to order the dry wonton noodles with char siu pork and crispy pork. For a complete set, follow it up with rice with char siu pork and plenty of gravy. They're only open in the evenings, and they sell out quickly. You can park on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: ISARA RUANGSANTI

sample_reviews_en.text:
The roast pork was amazing!
The dumplings were sold out.
I came late.
So I ordered dumpling soup.
The dry noodle soup with dumplings would probably be amazing too.
I'll come back during lunchtime next time.
The crispy pork looked good too.
The roast pork and crispy pork rice looked great; I saw other tables ordering them.
sample_reviews_en.author: W L

sample_reviews_en.text: Checked all the boxes >> Taste, price, ingredient quality, clean restaurant, diverse menu // The roasted pork and crispy pork are good, the soup isn't too salty, the Chinese sausage is delicious, and the prices are friendly. It's a great place for a quick dinner in this area.
sample_reviews_en.author: para dadah

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered the dry noodles with barbecued pork. It was delicious! The noodles were perfectly cooked, not mushy, and the barbecued pork was very juicy and slightly sweet. Overall, it was good. The restaurant looked clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: แร๊บบิท' บิท

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles are good, the char siu pork is juicy and tender, easy to eat, and the broth isn't too salty. You can add seasonings to your liking. The price is reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kitipat Rerkrai

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and reasonably priced. The roast pork is delicious, made from pork neck. The crispy pork is also delicious. Overall, delicious and reasonably priced.
sample_reviews_en.author: Somchai Peumpremsuk

sample_reviews_en.text: Roasted pork with honey is delicious, and the sauce is also tasty. The fried chilies add an extra layer of aroma and flavor. Highly recommend trying it!
sample_reviews_en.author: aplusgood168

restaurants.name: Hawa Pad Thai & Hoi Tod (Fried Mussel Pancake) Halal
restaurants.address:

Thailand, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon, Bang Rak, Bangkok, Charoen Krung 36 Alley

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hawa Pad Thai Halal – Bangkok

If you’re looking for authentic halal Thai street food in Bangkok, Hawa Pad Thai Halal is definitely worth a visit. Conveniently located near Haroon Mosque, it’s an excellent stop whether you’re exploring the Bang Rak area or looking for a halal meal nearby.

The restaurant serves a variety of classic Thai stir-fried dishes, with their Pad Thai being the signature item. Freshly cooked to order, the Pad Thai is packed with flavour and is best enjoyed while it’s still hot. The balance of sweet, savoury, and tangy flavours makes it a satisfying and authentic Thai experience.

The prices are very reasonable, offering great value for generous portions. The friendly local atmosphere and halal-certified menu make it a popular choice for both locals and Muslim travellers visiting Bangkok.

Highly recommended if you’re craving authentic halal Thai food in a simple, local setting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amir Farid Abdul Majid

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered Pad Thai with egg, but unfortunately it turned out to be one of the worst culinary experiences I’ve ever had.
The dish had a very strong fishy taste, which was really unpleasant, and it was also extremely spicy, to the point that it completely covered any other flavor. This was neither mentioned nor warned about.
On top of that, we weren’t even given water, despite the fact that in other customers’ photos you can clearly see a water jug on the table.
I want to point out that I always finish my plate out of respect, even when I don’t really like something. This time, however, it was impossible: I had to leave the dish half-eaten, which almost never happens to me.
A totally negative experience, especially from a culinary point of view. A real disappointment.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gustavo Emanuel Pascuali

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Super crispy fried oysters! A roadside halal stall with restaurant-quality taste."

This street food stall makes incredibly crispy fried oysters. The batter is fluffy, not greasy, and the seafood is quite fresh. A must-try is the "radish cake," stir-fried in a fragrant wok (Wok Hei) with a rich flavor, served on a banana leaf – very appetizing. Prices start at 60-80 baht, which is great value for the portion and taste. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a great halal restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adam dp

sample_reviews_en.text:
A local gem♡
While looking at Google Maps, I was a bit worried that it might be sold off, but thanks to my dependable husband, I found it safely~ My family says this place is even better in terms of taste and texture than Tipsamai, which everyone else raves about!! You should definitely try the oyster pancake and shrimp pad thai! The hygiene was acceptable.♡
sample_reviews_en.author: 쥬우쓰

sample_reviews_en.text: I searched for halal breakfast and was directed to Masjid Haroon, where local Muslim-run stalls operate. Few were open early, but I found one serving Pad Thai. It was my first time trying Thai food in Bangkok. Though unfamiliar, I found the taste to be decent, marking a memorable start to my day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fadzil Hisham

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pad Thai is usually bland in taste, but this one is seriously good! Price is reasonable and portion is big! Highly recommended. The oyster omelette also hits to the core. Just Aroi Mak! 💯💯

But the place can be a little humid as it is just by the street. Doesnt matter for me
sample_reviews_en.author: Mohd Faeiz Yusop

sample_reviews_en.text: Finally found halal pad Thai that tastes amazing! The seasoning is just right, not too spicy, a little bit sour but still manageable. And look at the amount of shrimps and squid, so generous 👍🏻✨🥹 I’d be back if I travel to Thailand again in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Indah Sekar

sample_reviews_en.text: I had some local food 🍚 Shrimp Pad Thai and it was delicious 😋 The shrimp were big too. They ask you how spicy you want it, but I ordered it spicy 🥵 It's really spicy, so if you don't like spicy food, just say "mai pae" and ask for it to be spicier.
sample_reviews_en.author: ノムノム

restaurants.name: ครัวนายโถ มหาดไทย ราม​คำแหง​ 65/​ลาดพร้าว​ 122
restaurants.address:

118 Lat Phrao 122 Alley, Phlabphla, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10312, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small restaurant with surprisingly delicious food. The flavors are excellent and the dishes are very well-seasoned.

- Spicy Stir-fried Minced Pork with Chili Paste ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 Very delicious, but be prepared to shed tears.
- Mixed Seafood Sour Curry (Sea Bass, Squid, Shrimp) ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 Delicious, spicy, and flavorful. This Southern Thai sour curry is unlike any I've ever had. It's amazing! It even has young coconut shoots.
- Stir-fried Gnetum Leaves with Egg ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 Absolutely delicious! A must-order. Even my friend who doesn't eat vegetables ate this dish 😭
- Fried sea bass with fish sauce ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 4/5 Delicious. 🫰🏻
- Stir-fried shrimp with shrimp paste ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 4/5 (It was actually supposed to be stir-fried shrimp with stink beans, but I don't eat stink beans, so I ordered it with shrimp paste instead.) The flavor was well-balanced and just right. It was delicious with rice.
- Fried pork with fish sauce ⭐️⭐️⭐️ 3/5 The taste was okay, typical.

We ordered 6 dishes plus 1 pot of rice and 1 plate, which was perfect for 6 people.

The food took a little while to arrive. The service was okay. The staff were a little strange, but not badly so.😅

Overall 8/10.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ravinvipa Topothai

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here. It's located on the ground floor of Fortune Town Apartment. The GPS is a bit off. It's right next to Maha Thai Night Market. The food is delicious. I recommend coming between 4:00-5:00 PM when the sun is less intense and the wind is lighter. Eating outside is great (don't sit by the road because there are birds perching up there). I recommend stir-fried stink beans with pork belly, turmeric fish, and other dishes. Try ordering them and write a review. The staff provided good service. Overall, it was delicious. Please tell the owner to fix the men's restroom door. There's parking under the Fortune Town building. It's convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichet Keawpong

sample_reviews_en.text: Authentic Southern Thai food with a strong flavor. The price is more than worth it. The ingredients are good. Good shrimp, good stink beans, good braised pork, good braised pork, and the curry paste is the best. There's a refrigerator ready to serve. The owner is friendly and lovely. Parking at the apartment might not be very convenient, but it's not a problem. I'll definitely come back to eat here again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaimongkol Sa-ardium

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish tastes delicious and is to my liking. I would like to praise the frying, which is done well in every dish. The fried chicken tendons are fried just right, dry and okay, not battered and fried inside like boiled chicken tendons. The price is okay. Southern food should be like this, full of flavor. I have posted the menu, there are many dishes, next time I will try other dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploypich R

sample_reviews_en.text: Southern Thai food with strong flavors. Stir-fried morning glory with eggs. The restaurant's curry has a truly southern flavor. The fried pork and spicy salad are also delicious. The restaurant isn't very big. You can park under the dormitory. There's a security guard on duty. The price isn't too expensive, just right.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mai Dateyou

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my second time eating here. My first time was when the restaurant first opened. I'd say their sour curry is their signature dish. It's flavorful, tangy, spicy, and well-balanced. The dry curry was a little lacking in saltiness, but overall delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suea Deaw

sample_reviews_en.text: Authentic Southern Thai food with strong flavors at reasonable prices (80-150 baht). Parking can be difficult (there is parking available under the apartment building where the restaurant is located, but it's quite cramped).
sample_reviews_en.author: Amnat Suwanchathree

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The sour fish curry with sea bass was very bland. This time it lacked the necessary spices and wasn't tasty. I'm not sure if they changed cooks.
- The pork stew with coconut milk was extremely salty. …
sample_reviews_en.author: K5K8K6K6

restaurants.name: Srisamorn Lertros
restaurants.address:

1, 2 Phiphat 2, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
You shoul try Roasted Pork Rice ข้าวหมูอบ
This is very local food close to the school
Many students know this place
sample_reviews_th.author: Fame Tham

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dine-in at the restaurant, Friday, January 30, 2026, 12:37 PM.

Ordered: Thin rice noodles with pork meatballs...

The broth was quite bland and not very salty...

So I looked for fish sauce. I saw a bottle of fish sauce that I wasn't sure what it had been for before, so... I decided I could just eat it bland... without adding any seasoning...

Why don't they buy 300-500ml bottles of fish sauce and put them out for customers to add as they please? Why put it in some unknown bottle like this?
sample_reviews_en.author: Arnon Techathanawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant serves delicious baked rice, baked pork, baked chicken, and Thai papaya salad. The flavors are rich and intense. I usually eat a whole plate of papaya salad by myself and don't share! It's been a fixture near the Convent Road for decades, located in the alley opposite BNH Hospital.

They also have a spicy salad (Yum), which is tasty, flavorful, and perfectly sour, but it only contains minced pork. You can ask for extra fresh vegetables to eat with it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phonraphat Kulnoi

sample_reviews_en.text:
We stopped by early morning for breakfast walking past it coming out of our hotel next door.
The aunties running the store were so sweet, and we had delicious piping hot soup noodles and the most flavourful spicy chicken on rice (served on a cute plastic Barbie plate) for 120 baht, while watching kids walk down the alley to get to school.

If you are staying at Artino Hotel, definitely worth giving this one a shot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jren

sample_reviews_en.text: Stopped for lunch in this area, and I have to say, it's surprisingly affordable and filling. It's hard to find good food around here. The roasted chicken was slightly sweet, the soup was flavorful, and the roasted pork was perfectly cooked with no fat. I arrived at 11 am and there were no other customers. If you're in the area for business and want a quick bite to eat, I highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lynn T

sample_reviews_en.text: I love the baked pork rice and baked chicken rice. I've been eating them for over 40 years. Whenever I'm at the convent, I always stop by this shop. It opens early in the morning. The owner, an elderly lady, is getting old but still works as hard as ever. I've been a customer of this shop since Citibank was located in the Panjabhumi Building on Sathorn South.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hattaya Areekarnlert

sample_reviews_en.text:
Silom Roasted Chicken and Pork Rice is a restaurant located near Convent Road. Their signature dishes are roasted chicken and roasted pork. We had the mixed roasted chicken and roasted pork rice, and it was delicious. The dipping sauce was spicy and satisfying. I loved the soup, which was incredibly flavorful.

#TravellingAsACouple #TravellingAsACouplePlus1
sample_reviews_en.author: Bell Belle

sample_reviews_en.text: The must-try dishes here are the baked pork rice and baked chicken rice. They're best enjoyed while the rice is still hot – pure bliss! They also sell noodles, larb (spicy minced meat salad), and som tum (papaya salad). If you're working in the area, picking up kids, or visiting someone who's sick, give it a try. It's an affordable and delicious option.
sample_reviews_en.author: บักเหน่ง เจ้า

restaurants.name: Mae Yupin Fast Food Kitchen
restaurants.address:

999 ถ. เจริญกรุง Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Normally, I only eat Hainanese chicken rice, which is usually around 60 baht.
Today (my first time ordering à la carte), I tried the chicken basil stir-fry with a fried egg + tofu soup [I didn't want to take a picture because the food looked very ordinary]. The price was 180 baht, ridiculously expensive.
- There was no price list on the menu placed on the table, but there was a large price board behind the restaurant, though it didn't have all the menu items.
- The taste was just chicken stir-fried with black soy sauce, basil leaves, and chili peppers. Adding a fried egg cost 80 baht.
Most importantly, the soup contained tofu, egg tubes cut into five pieces, cabbage, carrot scraps, minced pork scraps, and Knorr broth. How dare they charge 100 baht for that?
Even though I paid to support Thai businesses, I still regret spending the money.
Overall, it was edible. The taste might suit others, but personally, I'll only eat there once.
sample_reviews_en.author: ทาสแมว

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a street stall and quite cramped since there are only two tables!

It seemed like they specialize in delivery, haha.

When you enter, the lady will enthusiastically lead you to the shop on the left, but this place is actually on the right.

The two shops are right next to each other, so make sure to check the location carefully!

There are quite a few items on the menu, and it was easy to choose because they have a picture menu.

*Pad Thai - Too sweet, so it was just so-so.

*Khao Pad Moo Sap - I enjoyed it.

The price was 160 baht for two dishes, so honestly, the value for money isn't great, so I wouldn't highly recommend it.😅
sample_reviews_en.author: kimyuu_traveler

sample_reviews_en.text: This made-to-order restaurant offers a diverse menu and delivery service. There are plenty of tables for seating. The restaurant is located under a covered building. The crispy pork basil rice costs 100 baht (February 21, 2025). The pork is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, and the stir-fry is flavorful with a clear aroma of chili and garlic. It's a dry-fried dish with a prominent oyster sauce flavor. The rice is of good quality. Payment can be made via bank transfer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponchagarj Ngamukos

sample_reviews_en.text:
Terrible service. They skipped orders and people who sat down later got their food first.
I went with a friend, and the first friend finished their meal long ago. The rest of us waited for a very long time. When we asked why we had to wait so long, they answered angrily. 🫠
The food was mediocre. The vendors were arguing amongst themselves. Once is enough to satisfy our hunger. Overall, I wouldn't recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oarasa Boonsan

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a basic Thai dish, pad kaphao kai. It was incredibly simple… tasteless and expensive for street food… 70 baht for the dish alone, and with the egg swimming in way too much oil, it was an extra 10 baht… I left my plate. I don't understand the good reviews for this restaurant. The staff are real pushy types… calling me "my dear" to get me to come in… a very bad experience to avoid.
sample_reviews_en.author: Studio Ohlala

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honestly I’m pretty sure I’m reviewing the place next door that doesn’t have a Google listing. There’s two stores side by side one with an old bird serving the most insanely delicious soups. Get that soup. Grandma knows what’s up.

This place also looks great though and was where I thought I was going to go before I got poached by a waitress and sat at the store next door.
sample_reviews_en.author: Laundry Echo

sample_reviews_en.text:
First visit: Ka Pao Musap
I ordered the regular spicy version, thinking it was the usual spicy level, but it wasn't spicy at all. The balance of salty, spicy, and sweet flavors was perfect. Anyone would enjoy it, but it was a shame the restaurant closed at 3 p.m.
sample_reviews_en.author: river.K

sample_reviews_en.text: Tasty and oh so delicious!!! This food stall has some amazing pad Thai and they’ll go out of their way to bring you some delicious fresh fruit smoothies from a neighbouring booth if you ask. A perfect afternoon lunch in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: Matthew Cunnington

restaurants.name: Padthai Bar (Song Wat)
restaurants.address:

second floor, 172 Song Wat Rd, Khwaeng Chakkrawat, Yaowapanit, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Hidden Gem in Bangkok

Pad Thai Bar is one of those places you could easily walk straight past — it’s upstairs and the name is a little misleading, so you might not realise what you’re missing!

Once inside, though, it’s a lovely find. The staff were very friendly and welcoming, and there’s a relaxed, laid-back ambience with comfortable seating that makes it a great place to unwind.

There’s also a good choice of drinks, all at very reasonable prices.

Definitely worth seeking out if you’re in the area — a hidden gem with friendly service, a relaxed atmosphere and good-value drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: A K

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stumbled upon this place by accident. It's a very small spot that can be easily missed. Despite being small. The atmosphere of the bar is very cozy and old fashioned in a good way. In which I personally enjoy being here.
We aren't the type of people who drink alcohol so we decided to only order pad thai and Kua kai while it's pricey and the portion of the food isn’t a lot. It was very delicious. I fell in love with pad thai here.
To anyone who planning to go to Songwat road, This place is a must visit for the food alone and definitely should try their pad thai
sample_reviews_en.author: Egg S

sample_reviews_en.text:
I walked in randomly, but the taste exceeded my expectations. The Pad Thai was delicious, with a very authentic, original flavor.

As a Thai person who can cook Pad Thai myself, I walked into this place with zero expectations about the taste. But this restaurant truly delivers an authentic OG Pad Thai flavor.
If you genuinely love Pad Thai, you really should give this place a try.
The atmosphere is great, and the bartender is genuinely very nice. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narissara Suratip

sample_reviews_en.text:
Waited 30 mins for a lot of grease :/ sorry for my time and for the place in my belly as there are so many other good places around!

Owner was kind and apologized, he explained he has a small kitchen. Service was kind and welcoming. I feel u should have done a better job picking a place to spend my time and I shouldn’t have eaten this amount of grease. My mistake
sample_reviews_en.author: Omer Burshtein

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely the best Pad Thai I’ve had! The noodles were perfectly cooked with a great balance of sweet, sour, and savory flavors. The shrimp were fresh, the tofu was nicely crisp, and the smoky wok flavor really made the dish stand out. Portions were generous and everything tasted authentic and fresh. Highly recommend if you’re craving real Pad Thai!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasiparat Khoo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Well it does exactly what it says on the board, pad Thai was excellent, still had the wok hei, perfectly stir fried noodles, just the right tartness and meatiness from the shrimp AND still juicy!
Draft beer and cider were good too, only downside was the vibe, needed a bit of oomph to liven up the place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andy Ngan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted good and the atmosphere was nice, but the food queuing system was poorly managed. People who arrived earlier received their food at the same time as those who arrived later. We waited for almost an hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: chitnom29

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hidden Thai craft beer bar (and food). You have to go upstairs to find it. The barkeeper helps you with the beet recommendations.

Beer is really good and the music matches the bar vibes! 💃🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Tom

restaurants.name: เจ๊หนูตามสั่งตรอกโรงหมู
restaurants.address:

PGP8+Q25, Khao Lam Rd, Talat Noi, Samphanthawong, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This made-to-order food cart offers a wide variety of dishes. The cart and about six tables are set up on the sidewalk. It's packed during dinner time, with long queues.

I ordered the Crispy Pork Stir-fried with Curry Paste and a Fried Egg (Special), priced at 90 baht (December 25, 2024). The dish was quite yellow with turmeric powder, and included onions, chopped chilies, and large pieces of crispy pork with tender meat. The rice was served hot and not soggy. Payment can be made via bank transfer.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponchagarj Ngamukos

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been here many times.
I've tried many dishes, and they're all delicious and reasonably priced.
The garlic pork is amazing.
The Tom Yum soup is rich and flavorful.
The dishes are a little on the sweet side, but they're fantastic with chili fish sauce.

The staff are lovely and very polite.
If you go in the evening, you might have to wait in line for a while.
There aren't many tables, about 4-5.
It's more convenient to call and order for takeout and pick it up yourself.
sample_reviews_en.author: MyBlooD MJ

sample_reviews_en.text: Jae Noo's shop in Trok Rong Moo serves delicious and spicy Tom Yum Goong (spicy shrimp soup) with omelet. The stir-fried morning glory with crispy pork is also tasty. The highlight is the chili fish sauce to pour over the rice, which enhances the flavor and makes it even more delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: pitiporn pitiseree

sample_reviews_en.text: Simple street food. Fair price, great attentive service and lots of flavor. We had the pork fried rice, chicken fried rice, morning glory and ate here 4 times in 8 days. I've eaten tons of street food in SE Asia and this was tasty, consistent and hot and fresh. Would recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lawrence Leung

sample_reviews_en.text: There was already a queue when we arrived just as the shop was setting up. We had to wait a while, but the staff were all very polite and provided excellent service, even though there were a lot of orders. They weren't rude or upset at all. It was worth the wait.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aumjill

sample_reviews_en.text: Great service, delicious food, everything was perfect. The instant noodle salad was amazing, even the chili fish sauce was fantastic. Flawless. They even set up a table for us when there was no seating and went to buy us tissues. Excellent!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanchat B.

sample_reviews_en.text: I highly recommend this restaurant! I come back often because all the food is delicious and prepared super fast; you don't have to wait long. The owner is also very lovely. Excellent!🍴✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Warissara Maxpimay

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice service- helpful and fast! My first street food in Asia- didn’t get sick- ordered 2 dishes bc I guess I wanted > food but it was really good, clean and the flavors hit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sophia

restaurants.name: Je Aoun Chicken Rice
restaurants.address:

Soi Phahon Yothin 32/1, Lat Yao, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Please allow me some constructive criticism:

1. My boyfriend ordered the special fried chicken rice, but it was the same size as my regular order.
2. I understand that most of the staff are from neighboring countries, but they should be trained to better understand customer needs.
- I ordered 4 steamed buns: 2 cream filling and 2 char siu pork filling. The first serving came with 2 minced pork and 2 char siu pork. The next serving came with 2 char siu pork, 1 minced pork, and 1 cream filling. I was very confused why there was an extra minced pork bun. I had to repeat the order before they brought the correct ones. I don't know if it was intentional, careless, or what. 😅
- I ordered 1 bottle of water and 2 glasses of ice, but received 2 bottles of Namtip water without ice.
From reading the reviews, everyone agrees on the communication and service issues with your staff. This should be urgently improved.
3. There were a lot of flies in the air-conditioned room. I had to constantly swat flies while eating.

I will definitely not be coming back.
sample_reviews_en.author: JANJIRA LERTSUDAPORN

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Hainanese chicken rice shop has been open for over 40 years, a legendary spot that has been a favorite among Bang Khen residents and Kasetsart University students for a long time. You can eat anytime because it's open 24 hours! Both the boiled and fried Hainanese chicken rice are delicious. The rice is perfectly cooked and not greasy. Chicken offal is available occasionally; if you like it, you should order it. The chicken blood is clean and odorless. The shop has recently been renovated, making it larger with more seating, cleaner, and more comfortable. It gets quite busy at lunchtime, but you usually don't have to wait in line.

🍽️ Hainanese Chicken Rice
🚘 Parking: You can park on the side of Phahonyothin Soi 32/1 or at JPARK Senanikom 1 parking lot (20 baht per hour), about a 100-meter walk.
sample_reviews_en.author: Attawut ミンヂー Wijinthanasarn

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm so disappointed! It's so hard to find good food around here. I thought a big restaurant would have better food, but this is what I got:
- The special pork leg rice: the meat was dry, hard, and bland, like food offered as a religious offering.
- The staff seemed Burmese, confused and disoriented.
- The Hainanese chicken rice: the dipping sauce was sweet with a strong ginger flavor, bland, and watery, not to my liking. The chicken was also dry.
"Anyone planning to come, read this review." I'll say what's good is good, what's not good is not good. This place is unbearable. Minimum transfer is 100 baht for this restaurant.
- The atmosphere was very hot and stuffy. Extremely hot.
For parking, there's parking for motorcycles. If you have a big car, you have to park in the market and walk.
sample_reviews_en.author: xCHEERx

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located right across a market so if you’re hungry before shopping it’s a definite great place to eat. Prices are decent and the menu is simple with rice dishes, noodle dishes, dim sum dishes, bakpaos, some soups and such. The menu is filled with pictures so it’s great if you don’t speak Thai as that’s the only language avaliable.

I got a simple chicken rice with bakpao and it was a very hearty meal especially since with the chicken rice there was a small bowl of warm soup. The restaurant isn’t huge but has a nice amount of tables throughout the restaurant right next to the kitchen area which is to the left when walking in. At the front they sell desserts and ice cream so it could help with the heat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Xoom Too

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was terrible, and the staff's attitude and language were unacceptable.
I've been eating here since my agricultural school days until I'm 30. Today I ordered a plate of fried chicken for 250 baht, but only got one piece (the quantity was like ordering a single plate of Hainanese chicken rice). When I politely asked, the staff got emotional and sarcastically replied, "That's all we have left. What else am I supposed to sell you?" If that's all they had left, they should have told me when I ordered, or lowered the price. Instead, they forced me to pay full price and spoke rudely to a customer like that. I'm very disappointed with my regular restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vorawat Sakunkoo

sample_reviews_en.text:
The chicken rice and soup were okay, but less delicious than when the owner used to cook it herself. I remember when the owner was here, it was fantastic – fast, complete, good, and delicious. I ate there very often.

Now, in 2026, the taste is just okay, nothing special. Orders are often incomplete. The staff are rude, their speech and facial expressions are grumpy, unwelcoming, and not impressive. They speak impolitely, giving me the feeling that I don't want to eat there again, and I don't think I will.

Not recommended. The chicken and rice are very basic, and the staff lack professionalism.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pavisa Pr

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating here since my university days, over ten years ago. Back then, the restaurant wasn't as big as it is now. I loved it because the soup was delicious. I'd often eat here after drinking because it was open 24 hours. Back then, they even charged for the soup! I recently went back again, and the rice was just as delicious as before. The portion size is still small, but that's okay. It's one of my fond memories, though nowadays there are so many more employees, and the old charm might be fading.
sample_reviews_en.author: จอร์จที่ชอบกินจระเข้

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chicken rice, pork leg rice, and many other dishes.
The rice isn't too oily, so it's not greasy.
They have boiled chicken, fried chicken, grilled chicken, and chicken offal on the menu.
They also have pork leg, braised dishes, steamed buns, dumplings, and desserts.
The restaurant has a decent atmosphere, is clean, and has air conditioning, making it a pleasant place to sit.
It's located in a commercial building next to Senanikom 1 Market on Phahonyothin Road, near Paolo Hospital.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaiyawat

restaurants.name: Fishmonger Ari
restaurants.address:

10, 6 Ari 4 Alley, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Took my little one to try Fishmonger this time too.
We took a taxi again. Same process – order and pay first, then head upstairs to eat. Not sure why there were way fewer diners this time – we were the only table at first, and only two more tables came in later.
We ordered two types of fish and chips – one with barracuda and one with black kingfish. We also got a pasta dish and a squid appetiser. Overall the food was pretty good – the fish tasted fresh, and the cream pasta wasn't as heavy as I'd expected. The squid dish was just okay though.
sample_reviews_en.author: HAOLIN LI

sample_reviews_en.text:
There was a bit of a wait, probably because it was during peak hours. I recommend making a reservation 30-45 minutes before arriving. But the food was delicious, almost everything was great.

There's parking in front of the restaurant; if it's full, you can park in a nearby private lot. The prices aren't too expensive.

Seating on the first floor is limited; most of the seating is on the second floor, so it might not be suitable for the elderly or wheelchair users.
sample_reviews_en.author: Namfon Warisa

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere, spacious upper floor, perfect for relaxing and chatting. The food arrived very quickly and tasted excellent – ​​delicious and very fresh. You can call ahead to check on the queue and then come to the restaurant to get your number during peak hours. The staff are very professional in recommending fish; you can ask them about different types of fish you're interested in.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supakij Patthanapitoon

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes very good. The ordering system is pre-payment, and staff bring the food to your table. It's quite crowded even on weekdays, so if you're coming in a large group, it's best to call and make a reservation. There's ample parking, but it's an outdoor parking lot.

The restrooms are a bit small and can get less clean during peak hours. They are shared restrooms, not separated by gender.
sample_reviews_en.author: Preawpan Adulyasak

sample_reviews_en.text: A fish & chips specialist that also serves one of the best pasta dishes in town. Fresh, quality ingredients throughout—you can really taste the freshness of the fish. The seafood was excellent too, with both the shrimp and squid cooked perfectly. Make sure to reserve in advance, especially for dinner, unless you’re happy waiting an hour like I did. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kevin Pupat

sample_reviews_en.text: I recommend booking a table through the Queq app, otherwise the wait is extremely long! / All the dishes were delicious. The fish was tender, the batter crispy and not oily, and the shrimp was very succulent. The lemonade is a must-have, so refreshing ✨ I'll definitely be back! P.S. The cashier was very helpful and answered all my questions, even helping me decide! 🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: Mojimoji

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were lovely. The calamari that was first served didn't quite look like what was pictured, so I commented on it. After we sat and ate for a while, a staff member brought us a new serving of calamari—I wasn't expecting it at all! I was very impressed. The other dishes were also delicious. There was a bit of a wait, but it was worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Autcharaphan R.

sample_reviews_en.text:
- The fried fish was good; the batter was crispy and the fish was juicy.
- I went on a holiday during lunchtime. I took a queue number on Queq and didn't have to wait long, about 15 minutes.
The food came out quickly.
- There is parking in front of the restaurant, but you have to pay. However, I got a discount from 50 baht to 30 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stamp Sarisa

restaurants.name: Hafid Restaurant and Cafe
restaurants.address:

87 Sukhumvit 5 Alley, Khwaeng Khlong Toei Nuea, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I was coming to this restaurant for 7 years from time to time. Flood was always fine. But today is total disappointment. Not me, not my friends, will not come this this restaurant anymore. I ordered medium mixed meat kebab plate. I got overcooked strong meat, some of meat pieces was badly burnt to black color. I was expecting juicy soft meat, but I got meat turned into coals. In these cases usually other restaraunts replacing the dish with a new one, or not including bad dish price in the bill, or give substantional discount - but here the didn't reacted like that, even I told them 3 times. I paid full price for overcooked dish even I nor eat all the  burnt meats. They don't care their reputation. They spoiled my dinner. And finally they didn't respected me an proper appologise.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sergey Zubkoff

sample_reviews_en.text: They are very unprofessional. They don't even know how to behave with their guest. We went there and checked in for one night stay (3 persons). One of their staff took our passport and told us that our room is ready. Then we went to the room. After 5 minutes they informed us that we have to pay extra 500 THB as we are 3 people. but they didn't inform us anything before check in. Then we wanted to leave the hotel but they did not give back to our passport and talked aggressively and also  asked full day rent cost from us though we didn't use their room. One of their staff (female receptionist)  threaded us not to give back our passport without money. After lots of harassment they gave our passport. We never expect this type of unprofessional behavior from any hotel in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rifat Gaffer

sample_reviews_en.text: Place was clean and tidy and staff were very friendly. My choice of food was Mandi Chicken, Okra curry, and Lentil soup.  Ordering was straightforward and easy, but food took sometime to arrive.  Very disappointed with the Mandi rice and the chicken.  Despite the good taste and spicing, it was not even near to what I expected.  The same thing for the Okra which was served in a bowl with runny fluid rich in tomato sauce. Taste was good but I wasn’t prepared for that.  I think the management needs to seriously reconsider serving such dishes at such price, where many other restaurants next door serve top class meals and costs the same.  Thank you
sample_reviews_en.author: Husain AlHusaini (Husain_Tula)

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem right in the Arab area of Nana. Very impressive service, amazing food and a growing place. Seems after a long time a good restaurant is established after the legendary Shaharzad and Nefertiti restaurant.  This place is not that big but really deserves to grow.

Dont miss their large mixed bbq platter if going with few friends. Perfect with their phenomenal Garlic naan. All salonas are amazing there.  They serve beef too what is bit hard to find in most Lebanese restaurants.

Very very much recommended.  Parking is easily available for now but not sure what ll be their parking option after corona the whole area opens up.
sample_reviews_en.author: Faisal Anwar Patrick

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited Hafid near NH Sukhumvit with high expectations but unfortunately the experience was disappointing.

We ordered two plain naan, chicken keema, and an omelette. The naan was not cooked properly and wasn’t even cut before serving. The chicken keema was overly oily and lacked taste. The omelette was served cold and seemed stale.

The service was also quite poor. Plates were not properly clean, which made the overall dining experience unpleasant.

Overall, the food quality and service both need significant improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Irena Roy

sample_reviews_en.text: Has beef shawarma at Hafid by chance on the way to Foodlands supermarket. The beef shawarma was excellent and not saucy. The only thing I didn't like was the tomatoes inside. It was very meaty and good with the Mayo they provided. We also ordered beef grill/seekh kabab...which was provided with one roti, and salads. The grill too was juicy like the shawarma. I will surely recommend this restaurant to tourists especially for arabic food, after having thai food continuously during their stay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shahanaz Rahmathulla

sample_reviews_en.text:
No wonder the rating is 3.6 and its going down and down , the restaurant is in main area but the flavour the hospitality and everything was just rubbish and waste of time , ruined my evening, the food is not delicious at all and the price is sky high , the manager was super rude and when he took the order he was acting like we came here to eat for free and he was angry for some reason , anyways i would never recommend anyone to visit this restaurant

Waste of time and money
sample_reviews_en.author: Qudratullah Shahab

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered a “lamb shawarma” its “halal” with no certificate. If you ask for thailand halal certificate many of these places cant produce it. Not sure if its because they are buying halal meat but cutting certification cost or if they are buying haram meat and selling as halal. Need clarity on this situstion. The meat was so bad . 100baht for the shawarma is cheap and its worse than eating paper. Even a dog might not eat that meat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mc Kc

restaurants.name: Arma Box
restaurants.address:

98, 75 ซอย 83, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I would like to share my experience with this restaurant

I ordered food and snack boxes for my meeting around 56 boxes on 19 April in website and delivery day is 22 April 11 am

What happened on 22 April
1. Delivered late almost 2 hr.
2. Snack and lunch boxes is not arrive at the same time
3. Admin just said sorry and only said rider is on the way never updated where they are
4. When I got lunch boxes menu is different from what i ordered as well
5. The reason for all of this they only mentioned that they got a lot of orders in this day
6. Extend time delivery since 11 am to 12.40 pm

I didn’t write this to disclaimer but I think this is shouldn’t happen to anyone due to my company is lose credibility and your business also.

If your restaurant couldn’t handle lot of order you shouldn’t accept the order since the first because i also did everything follow by your process.

I wish the restaurant improved and manage your back up to be better more than this time. But at least i would give 1 star for admin that is not disappeared and restaurant also took responsible of this situation. But honestly is not worth for my company credibility.
sample_reviews_en.author: toey's life

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten here many times, but the taste has never been good. I've tried so many dishes that I think I've seen them all. Since I've told people to keep ordering from this restaurant, I'd like to ask them to improve the taste to be closer to what you'd expect from food for people. People ordering aren't giving up, but the customers are getting tired of it. Lately, I've been wasting money buying new food, which is frustrating.
The fried chicken wings were a bit tough and chewy.
The American fried rice was soggy and sticky, but the taste wasn't too bad.
The spaghetti was completely bland and lacked umami flavor.
The stir-fried pork with basil was bland, oily, and bland.
The teriyaki chicken was chewy and had a slightly rancid smell.
The shrimp pad Thai had soggy noodles and tasted terrible. The shrimp itself was okay.
Finally, please try adjusting the recipe. It's a shame about the ingredients.
sample_reviews_en.author: Failing Channel (Failing Channel)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Someone recommended this place. I ordered for a company training session for 45 people, including lunch and morning/afternoon breaks. The admin responded quickly and was very helpful. The menu was extensive with many options. The ordering and payment system was easy.
The food arrived on time, well-packaged, clean, and delicious. The attendees praised it. The price was excellent, and the person paying praised the coordinator. It was a hassle-free experience. What could be better? No wonder it's a word-of-mouth recommendation. I'll definitely order again and recommend it to others. Unfortunately, I didn't take any photos, but you can see from other reviews that it's genuinely good.
sample_reviews_en.author: yokeofficemail

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was drawn to their food from the moment I saw the box color and packaging when my company ordered it for a party. The taste was delicious too.
When it came to my grandmother's funeral, which was a very last-minute arrangement, I asked a friend at work for recommendations. They suggested ordering from them if I needed it quickly.

And I wasn't disappointed! The food was delicious, the service was excellent, and they were on time. They're great at finding locations. I'll definitely order again when I have the chance. They also respond to messages quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phitchanya Rodphadung

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried "Grandma's Bento Box" and for me, it was delicious, especially the sour curry. I highly recommend it! If you want to try it, order this dish. It's perfectly spicy, flavorful, and delicious. It's a simple bento box meal, but the portions are generous – more than enough to fill you up, or just right for a big eater. The price is reasonable, not too expensive. They also offer delivery, even for just one box. It's convenient for ordering for meetings or seminars too. Give it a try, I think you'll love it! 👏🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Call me Chowder

sample_reviews_en.text: I've used their service several times and am very impressed. From responding to messages in the back office to the delivery staff who have excellent service minds, everything is great. What really goes the extra mile is that they include food labels – the restaurant always thinks ahead for us. I trust them; deliveries are on time without needing to be followed up. The prices are reasonable, and there's a wide variety of menu items to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanara Ruhapongded

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my second time ordering from this restaurant, and I'm very impressed with the food's taste. I distributed some to the meeting attendees, and everyone complimented how delicious it was. When we ate it, it was truly amazing! I'm extremely impressed. The service from the restaurant was also lovely, from the staff taking the order to the delivery. I will definitely be using their service again!
sample_reviews_en.author: คําพรสนุก 14889

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd like to compliment the delivery staff of our shop. I ordered a delivery to Somdej Phra Pinklao Hospital. I was going to comment two days ago that the service was excellent, but I felt a bit sorry for them because there was no one to help them carry the whole bag up to the 11th floor. So, please compliment them. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dr.Amporn Drchanusin

restaurants.name: Bamee Kon Sae Lee Ladphrao 101
restaurants.address:

6 Thanon Lat Phrao 101, Khlong Chaokhun Sing, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The restaurant is clean, there are plenty of staff who take orders quickly, and the food arrives fast. They even give you free pork rib soup with your meal. In summary, I had crispy pork wonton noodles with pork rib soup for 65฿ and was very full.
sample_reviews_th.author: JamesMa Channel

sample_reviews_en.text:
16/5
We came back for another meal today. I had crispy pork wonton noodles and roast duck, my girlfriend had fried rice with Chinese sausage, and I also ordered wonton soup. You can see what we ordered in the pictures.
======
Saelee Noodle Restaurant is a famous noodle franchise with many branches throughout Bangkok. I'm not sure if there are any branches in other provinces. Today I brought my girlfriend to eat. The prices are quite reasonable these days. The soup was a little bland. Today we ordered crab and shrimp wonton noodles in soup. The inside of the restaurant was a bit stuffy, but the plates, bowls, and food were clean, and the menu was quite diverse. I like the creativity of the menu here. I'll try other menu items next time. Oh... there isn't much parking. If you come by car, you can find parking along the street and in the alleys next to the restaurant.
If you find this review helpful, please press Like to encourage me. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Praween Nildee

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're ordering the roast pork rice, whisper to them not to put too much sauce, because the cooks don't usually taste it, and it becomes extremely salty. The roast duck rice is even worse. Most of the time, foreigners cook it, meticulously preparing it, but then just open the shop and sell it, resulting in poor quality. As for the noodles, absolutely do not order them dry, because they have to be blanched in hot water again, making them quite dry and hard.
Anyone who loves noodles should come to Ladprao 130, in front of the 7-Eleven,
directly in front of the View Place building. You won't be disappointed, but you have to come in the evening until 11 PM. They even have soft-boiled eggs. Their pork meatballs have no flour at all; you get the pure taste of pork. I guarantee that even those who never liked noodles will forget all the others after trying them here.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปริณห์ณัฐชา โชคจรัสชัย

sample_reviews_en.text:
Review of Khun Sae Lee Noodle Restaurant

"Khun Sae Lee Noodles: The noodles are the highlight."

The noodle dishes are particularly delicious, and the fried rice is also a standout. The roasted pork rice is a recommended dish, known for its excellent flavor. They also offer a selection of herbal drinks.

However, a drawback is the lack of parking, making it inconvenient for those with private vehicles.
While the restaurant has fans, they aren't sufficient in hot weather.

Overall, Khun Sae Lee Noodle Restaurant is an interesting and suitable restaurant for those who enjoy noodle dishes and delicious flavors. If the parking situation were improved, it would likely become a great choice for those looking for a place to eat in this area.
sample_reviews_en.author: My Love

sample_reviews_en.text:
The thin, chewy noodles are delicious. Ordered dry, they come tossed with a perfectly balanced sauce. The char siu pork is fragrant, the crispy pork is tender with a fluffy, crunchy skin, and the shrimp dumplings are bouncy. The broth is sweet from the bone, not overly seasoned. They give you a generous portion of broth with bones. The price is reasonable, the service is good, and the restaurant is clean.
The restaurant has been open for a very long time; it wouldn't have lasted this long if it wasn't good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Update 04/07/67: This noodle shop near my house, which I've been eating at for 10 years, still maintains its excellent quality. The food tastes great, the place is clean, the staff are very professional, and the prices are reasonable for the quality – not expensive at all. There's no parking in front of the shop, but there's a parking lot nearby. In short, it's worth a stop if you're passing by.

They have a wide variety of choices, the taste is good, and the staff are friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wongpanit Phokaew

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles are soft and delicious, and the roasted pork is sweet and tasty. However, the soup might not be as flavorful or to my liking (this depends on individual preferences). The crab fried rice is decent. The restaurant doesn't have air conditioning, so it can get quite hot in the summer. Parking is available on the roadside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Travel Yummy

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles are chewy and soft, and the broth is delicious and well-balanced. The shrimp dumplings, char siu pork, crispy pork, and crab meat on top are the restaurant's signature dishes. My younger sibling loved it last time and asked me to bring them back a second time. Today we also ordered crab fried rice to take home.
sample_reviews_en.author: nokchutima _meechalard

restaurants.name: ครัวอุไร_เจริญกรุง107
restaurants.address:

844/72-73 10 ถนน เจริญราษฎร์ Bang Khlo, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is located on the roadside in Soi Pradu or Charoen Rat 10. It occupies two shop spaces and has parking for 1-2 cars in front, or you can park across the street in paid parking. The restaurant stamps your parking ticket for 1 hour of free parking; after that, it's 20 baht per hour.
The restaurant has air conditioning, is clean, and has comfortable seating that isn't crowded. On Sundays between 4-5 pm, it's quite empty.
It's known for its home-style cooking, with every dish made fresh. Some dishes might take a little while to prepare. We focused on Chinese food, with smaller portions. For 5 people, we ordered sizzling oyster omelet, stir-fried morning glory with preserved plums, braised tofu in red sauce, stir-fried radish cake with bean sprouts, seafood crepes, crispy fried sea bass with basil and chili, chicken and shrimp stir-fried with cashew nuts, steamed tofu with mixed ingredients, and braised fish with black bean sauce. All the dishes with red sauce were delicious.
The service was also good and attentive to customers.
This type of restaurant would be very popular with Gen X. The prices aren't expensive either. Go support them!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuttyeat&see

sample_reviews_en.text:
This venerable Thai-Chinese restaurant has stood the test of time, offering an exceptional dining experience. Its delectable cuisine, coupled with its reasonable pricing, has garnered a reputation for affordability. Each menu item is a culinary delight, showcasing the restaurant’s commitment to quality.
The restaurant is situated within a pair of adjacent shophouses, creating a charming ambiance. While parking is available opposite the shop, there is minimal parking fee. Despite its relatively unknown status, this restaurant remains a hidden gem, boasting consistently high-quality food.
sample_reviews_en.author: P. K.

sample_reviews_en.text: Homemade style Chinese food, feels like having a good cozy meal at home!  They use high quality ingredients, no greasy dishes, wonderful smell, and the taste was amazing! The food presentation was simple but really yummy. My favorite dish is the stir fried egg tofu with chili and salt. Dining room with AC is comfortable and not too crowded. Lots of parking space in front of the restaurant. Good place for friends or family gatherings! Can do a little more decorations of the atmosphere. Overall we were really happy with this meal and will definitely come back! Highly recommended!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Inthebigmango

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Chinese restaurant serves delicious food with a unique style.
I recommend the crispy sea bass with basil and a rich sauce.
There are two parking spaces in front of the restaurant; if full, you can park in the parking lot across the street. The restaurant has air conditioning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nisa S.
