sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! Just like dining at home. Open since 7:00 a.m., which is good for parents after dropping kids off at school. I tried many dishes, and they were all good. My favorite was the deep-fried tofu. The best! I will definitely go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattha Tos

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you don't like spicy food, I'd give this place 5 stars. It's a small restaurant but parking is convenient. The food is basic Chinese style, not like a fancy restaurant,
but it's delicious and cheap. I recommend trying it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Virote Laogumnerd

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd give this place 5 stars 10 times! The owner cooks everything themselves, the taste is just right, it's home-style Chinese food, it's clean, and they use good ingredients. I'll definitely be a regular customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: akom

sample_reviews_en.text: I didn't expect much, but it was delicious! There's parking available. If you're passing by, you can stop in for a meal. The crab cakes had plenty of crab, and the chicken tom kha soup was flavorful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Punika Thiraprasit

restaurants.name: เจ๊เล็ก ก๋วยเตี๋ยวต้มยำ ข้าวต้มไก่รวน สูตรโบราณนครปฐม
restaurants.address:

111 54 ถ. โพธิ์แก้ว Nawamin, Bueng Kum, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Driving past, I decided to stop by this roadside eatery in Pho Kaew.
Delicious, clean, and the owner provides great service.
They currently have free, unlimited dumplings. Crispy pork is 15฿, thick and plentiful pieces, with nice crispy pork cracklings.
sample_reviews_th.author: nannaplus Limareewong

sample_reviews_en.text:
This roadside stall exceeded my expectations from the very first bite. The Tom Yum noodle soup, in particular, was exceptionally flavorful, with a perfect balance of sour, spicy, sweet, and salty notes. The multi-dimensional taste made it so enjoyable I finished the whole bowl without realizing it.
The noodles were perfectly cooked, neither mushy nor too firm, and paired wonderfully with the pork and other ingredients.

The crispy pork rice was also fantastic; the pork wasn't dry or tough, and the sweet and fragrant sauce was just right. Pouring it over the hot rice and eating it together was incredibly delicious. Anyone who loves crispy pork rice will definitely love it! 😋

Besides the taste, the atmosphere was very friendly. I think I met the owner today, who was very chatty and easygoing. It's perfect for solo diners, families, or a quick lunch. I'll definitely be back.

Truly delicious, truly impressive, and I want to share this with others! ❤️ If you're in the area, I highly recommend trying it at least once. You'll understand why I gave it 5 stars!
sample_reviews_en.author: suwannee tanapichet

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a restaurant serving made-to-order dishes and delicious noodles.
Its highlights include a traditional recipe over 40 years old, top-quality ingredients, and authentic Tom Yum flavor.
The Tom Yum soup is a truly authentic traditional recipe with a perfect balance of sour, salty, sweet, and spicy flavors. Freshly ground peanuts are used, giving it a wonderful aroma. All ingredients are clean and fresh daily.
In addition to noodles and rice porridge, they also offer roasted pork and crispy pork belly, which is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, with a rich and flavorful sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alan

sample_reviews_en.text: I came based on the reviews, and it lived up to expectations. I wasn't disappointed. The dry Tom Yum Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup) was perfectly seasoned, with a well-balanced flavor that didn't need any extra seasoning. The Tom Yum noodles themselves were also delicious, with a rich broth and huge, tender dumplings. I ordered the roast pork rice to take home, and the sauce was delicious. The roast pork and crispy pork were well-prepared. This is definitely a restaurant worth trying.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mommam Progressive

sample_reviews_en.text: I used to love eating here so much, but the shop stopped selling it in the evenings, so I hardly ever get to eat it anymore. I just found out that they no longer include the fried dumplings when you buy them to take home. I'm disappointed, it was like a signature item of the place. I don't know if they've seen a lot of people trying to steal them, but doing this ruins their unique identity. And it feels like they've increased the price by 10 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: opo ishappy

sample_reviews_en.text: I eat here very often. The taste is extraordinary. The Tom Yum noodle soup is packed with ingredients and perfectly seasoned; it's delicious even without adding anything extra. The chicken rice porridge is the highlight – hot rice porridge with a sweet and savory broth, served with dry-fried chicken that's fragrant with garlic. The flavors complement each other perfectly. The prices are affordable, and the service is friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naiyasit Suakanong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The crispy pork was amazing! Not too much fat, lots of meat, and the skin was crispy like pork rinds.
The braised pork belly was incredibly fragrant with Chinese herbs and very tender. 😍😍
The Yen Ta Fo was rich and flavorful, or maybe it's because I ordered the dry version.
The Tom Yum soup was seasoned just right, but if you like it really spicy, you'll need to add more chili.
sample_reviews_en.author: รวิตา จุฑาจันทร์

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! The Tom Yum noodle soup was perfectly balanced, not too sweet, and didn't need any extra seasoning. The crispy wonton salad was also amazing – I highly recommend it. The braised pork belly with tofu and egg was delicious; the pork was tender and flavorful. The portions were generous and filling, and the prices were affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chananya Pholtawesub

restaurants.name: ร้านยายไทหางหมู​ (street food)​
restaurants.address:

QG45+527, Ban Bat, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here more than once, but this is the first time I've had the chance to write a proper review. Personally, I enjoy their papaya salad with pork neck, Korat-style papaya salad, duck larb, beef waterfall salad, spicy beef soup, grilled pork udder, and grilled crying tiger beef. The food tastes great and the portions are worth the price. However, it can get quite crowded. The atmosphere is casual and homey. There are seating areas both by the canal and in front of the restaurant. If possible, I recommend calling ahead to order your food. As for parking, you'll have to try your luck finding a spot on the sidewalk.
sample_reviews_en.author: ขาสั้นหรรษา Hansa_gang

sample_reviews_en.text: I loved it! The papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce was delicious. The fried pork tail was amazing and very hard to find elsewhere. The waterfall salad, larb, and tom yum soup were unique and unlike anything I've ever tasted. Overall, if you want to eat authentic, flavorful Northeastern Thai food, you have to try it. The atmosphere is chill, like a roadside stall. There are no fans, so if you get hot easily, bring your own.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fernynop

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is good, but beware, it's a scam! The Thai menu lists prices, and once you decipher them, you know how much each item costs. However, the Thai-English menu only lists prices for certain items. For example, a beer that was supposed to cost 90 baht suddenly became 120 baht at checkout (like at an expensive restaurant). The overall scam and unpleasant aftertaste remained, despite the good food. It's a shame!
sample_reviews_en.author: Bartek Maćkowski

sample_reviews_en.text: The grilled dishes are delicious, especially the grilled beef. Those who like the smoky aroma of charcoal-grilled meat and a satisfyingly chewy texture will love it. If you prefer tender, marinated beef, this place isn't for you. The grilled catfish with crispy skin is another unique and delicious item on the menu. Another standout dish is the spicy pork tail soup.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukanya Siriwat

sample_reviews_en.text: Authentic street food in Bangkok. If you want to experience extreme spiciness with watery eyes and sniffling, come straight here. Premium food, but for true connoisseurs. The toilet is an adventure worthy of a free tour, hahaha. In short, magical.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yelo JC

sample_reviews_en.text: A very local Northeastern (Isan) food spot near the Golden Mountain Temple. It might look like regular street food, but the flavors are truly authentic. Plus, if you can’t handle super spicy food, they adjust the spice level accordingly …
sample_reviews_en.author: Chen E.

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves authentic Northeastern Thai food. Their papaya salad is delicious, the grilled beef is excellent with many cuts to choose from, and the grilled pork tail is a must-eat because it loses its flavor when taken home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pratya Chamnongsin

sample_reviews_en.text: The grilled pork tail is amazing! Super crispy, cheap, and every dish is delicious and flavorful. Seven of us ate a full table of food and only spent 1000 baht – incredibly good value! You have to try this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: ลอยชาย เเชลเเนล

restaurants.name: getfresh Lasalle’s Avenue
restaurants.address:

549, 2 Lasalle Rd, Khwaeng Bang Na, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Overpriced and food lacks flavour! #avoidatallcost"

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is nice, the food is okay, but the staff seemed inattentive. The food arrived not hot, and when I asked them to reheat it, it was like they just microwaved it briefly because it wasn't very hot. They also entered my membership number incorrectly, and when I asked them to correct it, they said it was okay because I already got the member discount. How am I supposed to accumulate points like this? It's confusing.
sample_reviews_en.author: C.P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food with moderate calories.
Delicious and healthy too.
The salad dressing is amazing, the vegetables are fresh and of very high quality.

The staff are attentive, caring, polite, and welcoming. They offer good recommendations and excellent service.
I'm a regular customer at this restaurant.
Every dish is delicious. Highly recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: giggs sirindhorn

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my second time eating here. The food is delicious and the prices are reasonable, though slightly high compared to similar restaurants. However, the restaurant is a bit petty. I had a leftover sandwich, a small piece, and asked if I could take it home. They charged 25 baht for the wrapping, so I just wrapped it in tissue paper myself.🤣
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarawut E

sample_reviews_en.text:
No drinks !
My wife and I wanted to go for dinner and as they did not have any wine on the menu I asked if I could bring my own - (for a fee if necessary)..
The staff looked bewildered by this normal request and she then asked the cook....
The answer came back as no so we left... pity..
Never had this situation before...
sample_reviews_en.author: Julian H

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a small box of Smoked Salmon Truffle Caesar Salad to take home. I was worried the fish might be fishy or not fresh, but the fish was excellent. The truffle sauce was just right, not too much. It tasted great with the premium-tasting, healthy dressing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chusuda Srirattanaporn

sample_reviews_en.text: I used my UOB Friday discount. The staff provided good service and the restaurant had a nice atmosphere, but the prices were a bit high compared to the portion sizes. There's also a 10% service charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jxnnie.

sample_reviews_en.text: Food is fresh if they have what you want but many dishes were missing. Both the soup and juice I asked for at 3:40pm had ‘run out’ and the service is on the cold side.
sample_reviews_en.author: Roshanak Lashkari

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and beautifully presented. The breakfast was excellent. I highly recommend this restaurant if you're in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pear Tanaka

restaurants.name: Hia Uan Hakka Noodle
restaurants.address:

PGX8+M8V, Yotse 3 Alley, Wat Thep Sirin, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Come on, ladies and gentlemen! I have a legendary shop to recommend: Uncle Auan's Miniature Noodle Shop. He makes his own miniature meatballs and has been selling for over 40 years, starting as a street vendor and eventually moving to a pushcart. The broth is in a traditional Chinese style – arguably the only one of its kind left in the country. Usually, you find miniature noodle shops in buildings or restaurants, but this street vendor/pushcart style is almost extinct. Uncle Auan's shop isn't hard to find, but you have to look carefully because it's located in the Soi Krua Dok Mai Khao, opposite Hua Chiao Hospital. Drive into the soi, and there's a side street on the right. Look in, and you'll see it – there'll be a crowd around him. Prices start at 40 baht per bowl, 50 baht for a special. If you've been looking for or want to try this, I highly recommend it. I want shops like this to last a long time; it's really hard to find this style anymore. Go try it and let me know if it's cool! 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: VJ พุงพาเพลิน

sample_reviews_en.text:
Here's another excellent noodle shop, "Khao Niao Khrae" (Dwarf Noodles).
It's definitely worth trying, just a little hard to find.
It's located in a side street, and quite a small alley at that.
I had to ask directions from 3-4 vendors on the street outside the alley. But Uncle Aun didn't disappoint. The price is cheap and the portion is just right.

The best part is the Khao Niao meatballs – they're amazing! Not mushy, firm, chewy, and true to the original Khao Niao style.

The fish meatballs are also good, bouncy and soft, but not fishy. The flavor inside the meatballs is well-seasoned and delicious.

The soup is excellent; Uncle Aun has a secret ingredient that makes the broth fragrant, with a perfect balance of salty and sweet.

If you want to eat here, you can park in front of the houses in the alley and then walk into the alley where Krua Dok Mai Khao (White Flower Kitchen) is located. Uncle Aun's stall is directly opposite Krua Dok Mai Khao.
sample_reviews_en.author: pitchaporn prukratsameepong

sample_reviews_en.text: This Hakka noodle dish is a must-try. The taste is excellent, an authentic style that's becoming increasingly rare these days. The broth is flavorful and barely needs any seasoning. The dry version with spicy dressing is highly recommended. Expect a wait if you arrive after 10 am; there are only four tables, so share a table for a relaxed, casual Thai-style experience. It's definitely worth the wait. The noodles are made in the original style, clean, and served in a classic, home-style bowl. There's no water served; you'll need to serve yourself. It's located in a small alleyway not far from the main road. Parking is difficult; motorcycles are the most convenient. Don't miss either the soup or the dry version with spicy dressing if you visit. The atmosphere is a bit off-putting, so the smell of cockroaches might slightly spoil the mood, but it's understandable as it's near a sewer, so it's worth the effort to eat quickly and leave. ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: TaNnY

sample_reviews_en.text: It's located in a small alley, almost impossible to find; you'll need to ask locals. There are only three or four tables, and the place is minimalist. I went almost at noon, but many items were already sold out. It seems to be very popular, with people constantly ordering. They only serve rice vermicelli noodles. I ordered one with soup and one dry spicy noodle dish. The soup was clear and refreshing. What I liked most was the dry spicy noodle dish; it was well-seasoned and had delicious freshly fried pork cracklings – a real bonus! The fish balls were tasty, while the pork and tofu meatballs were just okay, tender though. I recommend ordering the dry spicy noodle dish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wipawee Sakulpanitjaroen

sample_reviews_en.text:
I found this place on Douyin (TikTok). It's quite far, located in a small alley near the Overseas Chinese Hospital. You practically can't find it unless you look very hard 🙄

Luckily, I arrived early. The first bite was amazing—plenty of ingredients, and it was delicious! I was so glad I ordered a second bowl quickly, because by the time I finished, it was already sold out for everyone else.

I finished around 11:40 AM. They started selling at 10 AM and sold out very quickly. There are a lot of takeout customers, so if you want noodles, you have to come early, or they'll sell out! 😓
sample_reviews_en.author: LeiLei Jindana

sample_reviews_en.text:
Uncle Auan's Hakka Noodle Shop

I had the chance to pass by this area, so I had to try it.
At first, I couldn't find the shop. I had to use Google Maps and follow the directions to find it.

When I arrived, the shop was about to open, and there were already a lot of people waiting. I ordered a bowl of dry Hakka-style thin noodles with meatballs, no vegetables, for 50 baht.

The noodles were chewy and soft, perfectly cooked. The highlight was the various meatballs in the bowl. I liked them all; they were delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kim Prachak

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the only shop that still uses a charcoal stove and a makeshift stall. The owner, an elderly gentleman, makes delicious food. The fish balls are wonderfully bouncy and have a substantial texture. Everything else is good, but what really sets it apart is the soup. It looks light, but the flavor is incredibly rich and intense. You won't feel thirsty after eating it. The portions are generous and it's great value for the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pat

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing Hakka Noodle in a tiny alleyway. A little hidden gem of Bangkok. The Hakka fish, pork, and tofu balls are super tasty. Each dish is meticulously prepared by the shop owner who had been selling for over 30 years from the very same cart. The noodle is tossed in aromatic lard and garlic. Just simply amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pete P

restaurants.name: Pa Kai Tam Sang
restaurants.address:

159 Phet Kasem Rd, Pak Khlong Phasi Charoen, Phasi Charoen, Bangkok 10160, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Gary Butler has LITERALLY put this place on the map! That has become both a blessing and a curse to the shop. The proprietors don't do English. Coupled with many people not really knowing what it is that they want, this can really throw a wrench into the works.

I would strongly recommend that if desiring the Gary Butler featured dishes, one should have the photos already downloaded to their phones. This would really help the staff.

One more warning. Reaching the shop from the MRT/BTS interchange is a bit of a challenge. One has to cross both an espressway exit and entrance to reach the shop. Really be careful.

All that said, the offerings are some of the best in greater Bangkok. Even living about an hour's MRT trip away, we've eating there 3 times and always brought more home with us.

Well worth a trip!
sample_reviews_en.author: Curt

sample_reviews_en.text:
Crispy pork basil stir-fry, creamy tom yum goong (shrimp soup), and their chili fish sauce are the best! Auntie Kai's made-to-order food stall on Phetkasem 25/2.
This is the made-to-order food stall I frequent the most because I'm addicted to Auntie Kai's cooking. Everything she makes is delicious. The stall is next to Bang Phai Thong, an old and famous Hainanese chicken rice stall in the Phetkasem area, located at the entrance of Phetkasem 25/2.
I always order the crispy pork basil stir-fry. The garlic and pepper shrimp is also delicious, with large shrimp. This stall uses high-quality ingredients. It's a lovely family-run business. I've been eating here for years and never get bored. Most importantly, their chili fish sauce is incredibly delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Art Suwarnatemiya

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a restaurant that I think is underrated.
I'm reviewing it because it's my regular spot. Auntie Kai has been selling food for almost 30 years. The taste is like mom's cooking; delicious, and she uses pretty good ingredients. She uses duck eggs for her fried eggs and seasons them with fish sauce.
I usually eat her dry sukiyaki (with the restaurant's special sauce), fried rice, and stir-fried spring onions. If I have the chance to order a main dish, I'll really get that "mom's cooking" feeling.
sample_reviews_en.author: panarin suejindaporn

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a made-to-order restaurant that only serves rice dishes; there are no separate side dishes. Considering the price and portion size, it's quite expensive. For example, the crispy pork stir-fry with basil only has 5-7 medium-sized pieces of crispy pork. The amount of rice per container/plate is also quite small. Compared to restaurants in modern trade markets, these might offer better value for money. The taste is just average, like any other restaurant; nothing amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: watcharawipat silaparatana

sample_reviews_en.text: Unexpectedly delicious food with wok hei for a very reasonable price. A quick walk from BTS Bang Wa or MRT Bang Wa. I have tried fried rice and grilled chicken, both were amazing. First time I was there, it was a weekday and almost no one at the restaurant. But for the second time, it was on a weekend morning and there was a but of waiting for the food to be served. Gonna be back for sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lu Mor

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely delicious! The made-to-order dishes, especially the spicy basil pork and crispy pork belly (the skin is incredibly crispy!), are fantastic. The chili fish sauce is excellent, very similar to Chester Grill's – it has a slightly sweet flavor, and the chopped chilies are fantastic. If you're in the area, don't forget to try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: วชิระ ป้องนาลา

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes good, but some dishes are pre-made and served with toppings instead of sauce. The atmosphere in the restaurant is very casual. Sometimes people smoke, making you smell their cigarette smoke. It's better to just buy food to take home.
-The dry sukiyaki was well-prepared but too sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongkun Chueysakun

sample_reviews_en.text:
A local eatery as recommended by Gary Butler (thanks!)

The fried pork belly is only available in the morning. :(

Had Suki (with pork) and fried rice with shrimp. Very delicious, although a little heavy on the seasoning as per my personal taste. The fried rice is done very well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Weikai Fu

restaurants.name: Stacked and Loaded
restaurants.address:

Sukhumvit 6 Alley, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered late-night hoagies from Stacked and Loaded through Grab and had them delivered to our hotel. The service was incredibly fast - we received our food in less than 25 minutes from the time we placed the order.

My husband ordered the cheesesteak, and I ordered the Italian hoagie. He has fairly traditional American tastes and can be picky, while I’ll eat just about anything, so we’re usually a good test of a restaurant. We both thoroughly enjoyed our sandwiches.

As someone from the Philadelphia area, I’m always a little skeptical of cheesesteaks and hoagies anywhere, not just outside the U.S., but these were the real deal. The bread was excellent - which is the foundation of any great hoagie - and the meats were high quality and generously portioned. Everything tasted fresh and authentic.

This was an unexpected and impressive find in Bangkok. If you’re craving a taste of home or just want a genuinely good sandwich, I would absolutely recommend Stacked and Loaded. We would definitely order from them again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tierney Becton

sample_reviews_en.text:
OMG… these subs are HUGE! 😂
I ordered the meatball sub and honestly, I had no idea what I was letting myself in for. It was absolutely massive — I could only manage half, which worked out perfectly because I’ve got the other half waiting for later after a few drinks in Bangkok! 🍻🇹🇭
But size aside, the sub was absolutely incredible. Fresh, packed with flavour, and those meatballs in that rich marinara sauce were genuinely to die for. Every bite was spot on, and you can tell they take pride in what they’re serving.
The service was second to none as well — friendly, welcoming and made the whole experience even better.
If you’re in Bangkok and looking for a proper sub that delivers on both quality AND quantity, this place is an absolute must.
Highly, highly recommended! 🙌🔥
I’ll definitely be back — hopefully next time I can finish the whole thing! 😂
sample_reviews_en.author: Francis Smith

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had been searching for a good “Philly Cheesesteak” in Bangkok for over a year. 2months ago I gave up, because theyre all shit. Now today, Im randomly scrolling on Grab to find something to eat and I come accross this place. I thought, the pictures look good - like always - but most likely what will come will be shit. I decided to give it a shot anyway, and I am happy that I did. Proud to say that, if youre craving a philly cheesesteak that actually looks, feels, and tastes like a philly cheesesteak - this is the only place where you will fulfill that urge.

Big thanks to this place for actually making these sandwiches like they should be, unlike the other places.
sample_reviews_en.author: Raivo Laksa

sample_reviews_en.text: Stacked and Loaded is a gem for anyone craving authentic deli flavors in Bangkok. The friendly staff greet you with smiles, and I had a great conversation with the owner, which really added to the experience. All the meat is cured right in the shop, and I tried the pastrami on a roll. I know it’s a bit of a sacrilege not to have it on rye bread, but it was incredibly tasty nonetheless. The service was quick, and the spacious, laid-back atmosphere makes it a perfect place to chill. Finding authentic deli taste in Bangkok is tough, but this spot nails it—highly recommended if you’re looking for a true taste from home.
sample_reviews_en.author: K K

sample_reviews_en.text:
Finally after two years of hoping, an authentic Sub Sandwich place has opened in central Bangkok.  The subs are absolutely loaded and can be customized from their menu.  Real hoagie bread is used, not baguettes.  I have had three of their offerings and each one has filled the void in my life missing since I’ve moved here to Bangkok.

My next visit will see me ordering their Rueben as they also have an extensive list of deli sandwiches too.

This Sukhumvit Soi 6 location also has some of the cheapest bottled beer prices around.  Definitely on my regular list of places for getting my back home food.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Bruneel

sample_reviews_en.text: I have been coming to stacked and loaded since it opened every single week and as a native New Yorker I could not be more pleased to find a place serving food just like home! The roast beef sandwich sandwiches are perfect and both of the Philly cheesesteak sandwich and Philly cheese tater tots are exceptional and very fun. My mom recently moved here and was an instant fan, joining me on my weekly visits.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adam Kramer

sample_reviews_en.text: Stopped by Stacked and Loaded and honestly everything was so good. The deli sandwiches were fresh, packed with flavor, and the portions were huge. The loaded tots were definitely the highlight for us too. Super chill atmosphere, friendly staff, and overall just a great comfort food spot. Perfect place when you’re craving a really satisfying meal. We’ll definitely be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: J V

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ve tried many sandwich places in Bangkok and there are some good ones, but this place is the closest thing I’ve found to a good hoagie sandwich. I had the twerky club. Nice soft french roll. Quality meats and veg. Pretty decent size. The lady at the counter was very nice and gave me extra pickles. 😄 Sorry, forgot to take photos.
sample_reviews_en.author: Frank Liu

restaurants.name: Udomsuk Cooking Class
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 100 ชอย Sukhumvit 101/2 Alley, Bang Na Nuea, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had an amazing experience here! Although it was our first time joining a cooking class, the instructor explained everything clearly, and the dishes we made were surprisingly easy to cook from scratch. (We just did chopping, cutting, boiling, and stir-frying.)

We were actually late to the class, but they still kindly let us join. Maybe it’s Korean privilege lol. Either way, thank you so much!🙏🏻

Reasons why you should definitely come here (as below):
1. Clean and tidy
2. No bugs
3. Incredibly delicious food 👍🏻👍🏻
— we cooked 똠양꿍, 팟타이, Thai milk tea and green curry 🫶🏻
4. The instructor speaks great English
5. Lovely interior and atmosphere

The only downside for us was the distance. It took about 20 minutes from Asok Station, but honestly, it was still worth it!!! We didn’t gaf💝

They even gave me a safety pin because my skirt ripped 😭

Big thanks to the 사장님들 and the teacher for such a warm experience 🙏🏻🙏🏻😻 코쿤캅 감사합니다 💅🏻🎀❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: 박민선

sample_reviews_en.text: We went shopping in the market together and they shared about the different ingredients we might want to buy and we also bought the ones we used in class. We made Thai tea and it was very good. We also made three separate meals. The meals were very good! We started in the meeting room at a big table where they helped us prepare everything we would need for ingredients. Then we went upstairs to actually cook the food. Each person had their own station with clear instructions on what to do. We all cooked at the same time side by side. After making two of the meals (green curry and Tom Yam King) we brought them back to the original table and ate what we made. Then we prepared our next meal ingredients (pad Thai) and went upstairs and cooked that before coming back down to eat that one as well. They also fed us desert. Yum! The staff is very friendly and have good English! We will highly recommend these classes!
sample_reviews_en.author: Thomas Lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently joined this Thai cooking class and had an amazing experience! The class was fun, interactive, and very well organized. We learned how to make authentic Thai Tea, Pad Kraprao, Tom Kha Gai, and Khanom Tuay. The instructor was friendly, knowledgeable, and explained every step clearly, making it easy to follow even for beginners.

I was very satisfied with the results — all the dishes turned out delicious, and I learned many useful cooking techniques that I can apply at home. The atmosphere was enjoyable, and everyone had a great time throughout the session.

I highly recommend this cooking class to anyone interested in Thai cuisine. It was both educational and entertaining, and I would definitely join another class in the future! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Sendjaja

sample_reviews_en.text: I am so glad my boyfriend and I chose Udomsuk! We had the 9am-12p class with two other women and it was so much fun. The market tour was really educational and handy for knowing what herbs and vegetables go into your food. Our tour guide/chef was funny and sweet and the market itself was clean and organized. The actual studio where we cooked was cool, clean, and adorable! We talked with the manager/owner and she was so passionate and friendly. There are tons of photo-ops and everything was well organized. We enjoyed the diversity of the menu and we felt more confident to try more Thai food afterwards in real restaurants. 10/10 already want to do again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Darling Rodriguez

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good experience including quick shopping at the market, cooking and eating. The chef teacher was friendly, funny and patient. Other staff were also nice. The lesson was fun, interactive and steps for preparing and cooking the dishes were easy to follow. Thai milk tea and the dessert were also provided which was a surprise to us. Reasonable price to spend a few enjoyable and memorable hours with my family (8 people altogether) and to learn some popular Thai dishes! Highly recommended👍🏼👍🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: Jenny Lau

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had the best time at a cooking class today! The place was super cozy, and everyone there was so welcoming. We got to do it all — prep, cook, plate, and of course eat — while learning fun little facts about the ingredients along the way.
The cutest part? They gave us a certificate and a sweet souvenir at the end. Such a thoughtful touch to wrap up an already memorable experience. 💛
sample_reviews_en.author: Arcagail Millanes

sample_reviews_en.text:
So great with the experience, with guests coming from all over the world.

It is worth trying to have it during 3 hours.

I had a great time attending the cooking class with guests from all over the world.

It is a clean and enjoyable cooking class that opened recently. The owners are Korean, so it is a great place to come if you are concerned about the language barrier...
sample_reviews_en.author: Julian

sample_reviews_en.text: The class was absolutely amazing. We knew absolutely nothing about Thai food, but they explained everything to us with great patience. The food was more than spectacular, and the chef is very friendly and walks you through each step. If you come to Thailand, this is a must-do activity, I highly recommend it to do in your first days in Bangkok
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrea Flores Andrade

restaurants.name: KFC Bus Terminal III
restaurants.address:

3 ชั้น G, สถานีขนส่งหมอชิต, 999 Kamphaeng Phet 2 Rd, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If this was my first time having KFC then I'm confident that I'd never order it again. Why would they put the world's slowest KFC in a bus station when people have a bus to catch? It makes for a very distressing experience.

I was waiting 40 minutes for a box meal. I was on the verge of telling them, "just give me what you have and I'll eat it because I'm going to miss my bloody bus!" But it came out and I gobbled it down in 5 minutes.

The worst part is that it's the worst tasting KFC I've ever had! The pieces were so plain and flavourless, it could've been any old fried chicken. There drink was also filled to the brim with ice so I think I only consumed about a thimbles worth of Pepsi.

I burnt my mouth on the egg tart too because it was bollocking hot. I'm guessing that they were waiting on but I didn't even eat it all because it was too hot and I had to run for the bus.

The good news is that I made my bus and I know never to eat here again. I know there's worse things going on in the world than this but as a worshipper of KFC, this place needs to be closed down with immediate effect. It's no good for the colonel's street cred.
sample_reviews_en.author: Stephen Hampton

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to KFC at the bus station expecting something completely ordinary, but I was pleasantly surprised by the quality and taste of their chicken!  I don't know how they do it, but their chicken is so juicy that I think she might even try to write a romantic poem about her palatability.  And if you think I'm kidding, then you've never tried this chicken!  So if you're stuck at the bus station and need a good helping of food, then KFC is definitely the place to visit.  Maybe even a chicken can beat you at cards while you're sitting waiting for your bus."
sample_reviews_en.author: FDM FDM

sample_reviews_en.text: Everytime I order big or small order..they always give ketchup for me ...because I ate ketchup a lot..1 burger I ate 3-4ketchup .but this time oct.05,2023..I ask for 15 ketchup..I have  3 normal burger and 2 chicken roll..but they say not allowed...have a lot of ketchup and only foreigner eat ketchup..thai people not that much...everywhere i go and order ..even grab food..ketchup is not an issue..only this day ..pissed my brunch..hoping it will change for the better..service is no.1
sample_reviews_en.author: zuha suha

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible service, completely indifferent, like they're just going through the motions, no service mindset. Their demeanor and speech were awful, especially the transgender employee who came alone and took three orders, even though they were simple items already available in the display case. In the end, I just abandoned the food and got in my car. I hope this kind of service prospers! But after reading the reviews, everyone agrees, so it's not surprising. 555
sample_reviews_en.author: ที ปังปอนด์

sample_reviews_en.text: I saw the last order number on the screen was 1111, so I placed my order. I received the bill at 1120 and waited until the bus station called to inform me the bus was about to leave. It only arrived at 1110. In the end, I gave the bill to someone else, wasted my money, and didn't even get to eat. This branch consistently provides slow service. The countdown timer and the actual waiting time are meaningless; KPIs are meaningless, aren't they?
sample_reviews_en.author: Jirawat Sorawong

sample_reviews_en.text: I've never waited this long at a KFC anywhere else. They only had one service counter open, but the line was incredibly long. The wait was unbelievable. Opening a branch in a bus station should mean they have more staff and a more efficient management system to avoid wasting time.
sample_reviews_en.author: ploy_ thacha

sample_reviews_en.text: It felt like I was begging the staff for food...they spoke so slowly. Why don't you hire more staff? They took their anger out on the customers. People are working hard, but those who take advantage of their colleagues are just waiting to take advantage of others. It's awful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Palmy Yuth

sample_reviews_en.text: The store closes at 10 PM, but the staff stops frying chicken at 8 PM. When I went to order, they didn't have anything available. I had to wait for everything to be freshly fried. The staff were rude, as if they didn't want me to order. I …
sample_reviews_en.author: tee bee

restaurants.name: เจ๊แอน คอหมูย่าง
restaurants.address:

122 จุฬาซอย50 Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall, the flavors are good, spicy, and delicious. However, none of the papaya salad dishes were good.

My top recommended dishes are:
1. Grilled dishes: Well-made and delicious, especially the grilled intestines, fragrant, marinated in a slightly spicy and rich sauce, grilled until crispy and dry on the outside but juicy on the inside.
2. Grilled chicken: Marinated with spices and turmeric, very fragrant and very tender, excellent!
3. Grilled pork neck: Sweet and delicious only the first time. Subsequent times, the flavor didn't penetrate the meat, it was bland, and sometimes too dry.
4. Crying Pork (spicy minced pork).
5. Sweet liver: Very good, I loved it! Rich flavor, tender and crunchy liver.
6. Spicy minced pork salad and grilled pork neck salad: Very spicy, sour, and salty, excellent!

However, they need to seriously improve their cleanliness. The tables and floor were dirty, wet, and messy, making it very unpleasant to sit in. A large rat was running around in the pile of dishes waiting to be washed, and shockingly, a rat ran out of the bathroom door that was left open. Very creepy!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rujirek R.

sample_reviews_en.text:
We don't want to be against the restaurant, but personally, we think it's pretty bad, both the atmosphere and the food. Overall, only one dish was delicious; the rest were terrible. The papaya salad had so much fermented fish sauce it was like eating seafood. Everything like the larb, nam tok, som tum, and yam was extremely salty, and the dipping sauce was overwhelmingly sour. The grilled pork neck and fried pork neck were okay, but as soon as they were served in the nam tok style, they were incredibly salty.
From someone who has eaten Northeastern Thai food all over Thailand, this is a restaurant I wouldn't return to. And I want to tell anyone who comes because of the high ratings to run away: the staff is incredibly slow. There were only 3 tables, and it took forever to get two dishes—you could open 50+ TikTok videos in that time! The prices are also quite unreasonable. The atmosphere is old and run-down, like it hasn't been renovated. The cleanliness is average; it looks messy and disorganized.
sample_reviews_en.author: KendyKendo89

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious!

Soups: Flavorful and delicious, the pork rib and chicken soups were both incredibly tender and juicy!

Others: Pork neck, simple to prepare, was flavorful and juicy!

Cold spicy and sour chicken salad: The overall seasoning was excellent, tangy and spicy, with plenty of chicken, and the addition of garlic and other flavorful ingredients made it superb!

We also ordered rice noodles separately this time, which were simply delicious mixed into the soup.

The only downside is that it's only an outdoor dining area, with no air conditioning, just a fan (but it wasn't too hot to sit and finish a meal). The surrounding environment is a bit rough, but don't worry, I didn't experience any adverse effects after eating. The staff were also very friendly.

If you want to experience local cuisine, give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: 郭怡伶

sample_reviews_en.text:
This grilled pork neck shop near Chulalongkorn University, next to Samyan Mitrtown, has a very extensive menu, but the prices are quite high compared to the portion sizes.

• The grilled pork neck was tender and not too strong in flavor, but it wasn't hot at all (the cook initially said it was being grilled for a while). There were two sauces available: a spicy dipping sauce and a black soy sauce mixed with tamarind sauce. The portion wasn't very large, and considering the 100 baht price, it's a bit expensive.
• The plain omelet was very oily at 60 baht, which is also expensive.

Overall, it was just average. I probably wouldn't come back because of the high prices. The total bill was 160 baht, and considering the portion size and taste, I wasn't very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puripat Kitkarncharoensin

sample_reviews_en.text: A great Isan food spot near Chula! I love everything here—the food is delicious, the prices are cheap, and the portions are just right. My favorite dishes are the grilled chicken nam tok, crispy catfish salad, and omelet—all perfectly cooked with authentic flavors. The restaurant itself is simple, but everything about it feels right. They also serve beer, but you’ll need to keep it in a bucket since they can’t display it openly. I’ve been here twice already and will definitely be back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chen E.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dishes Ordered:
- Grilled Pork Neck
- Papaya Salad with Rice Noodles
- Spicy Grilled Pork Neck Salad

Food:
- Grilled Pork Neck: Delicious as usual.
- Papaya Salad with Rice Noodles / Spicy Grilled Pork Neck Salad: Very sour, not very impressive.

Service:
- Average, neither good nor bad.

Atmosphere:
- An outdoor restaurant with tables set up along the roadside in a local style, with a covered area and awnings.
sample_reviews_en.author: Irin Lin

sample_reviews_en.text: I waited for my food for a very long time, almost an hour. I saw a woman at the table behind me who came later get her food first. I waited until the afternoon, and I was very hungry. Finally, I asked for a doggy bag to take back to the office to eat. And the taste was... the pork neck was bland, the fried chicken was soggy and not crispy, and the rice was hard. Very disappointing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyathida R

sample_reviews_en.text: I give it 5/10. The taste is average, but the price is cheap. What I didn't like was the fried pork neck; the pork was tough and not tasty at all, and the dipping sauce was too sweet. The papaya salad was also average, a bit sour and sweet. The minced pork salad had too much fat, but the taste was good, not amazing, but the price was great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Winai Thampornvatee

restaurants.name: Santa Monica Diner Pattaya
restaurants.address:

Central Festival Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Best burgers in Pattaya.  Recommend Philly cheese steak sandwich,  pastrami sandwich,  pastrami burger.   Etc.  I don't understand how anyone can give this place less than 4 or 5 star.  Seems like fake reviews to me from competitors.   Good pleasant staff and service.  Beautiful new restaurant.  They are really trying hard to be excellent.   Big menu. The burger was big, juicy, fresh and beefy tasting.  I also got a good apple juice.  All American bacon burger looks great too.  I like to add some salt and pepper though.  Located in Central, ground floor, next to Tops Market and the food court.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lawrence

sample_reviews_en.text:
It takes about 45mins+ to get food here if there is 2-3 people already waiting for food.

I ordered 2 spaghetti with beef for 199 baht each.

Taste, it's not terrible, it's not home made either, it's tomato based.

Price is good, location is good, servers & cashier's are new, last time I ate here service was also slow 30min+ and it took the cashier 15mins to figure out how to charge me when paying with Mastercard.

First time I had food here, the place was empty and my food came out after 10 minutes.
sample_reviews_en.author: SuperDuck

sample_reviews_en.text: Dear Restaurant Owner!! Please, please don't just think about your own profit, hire good and qualified staff!! If you don't think long-term, you will have many problems in the future with such employees. Customer service is zero! You take 7% commission on the bill, at least give that percentage to your employees and hire quality staff. Unfortunately, you failed this time. Also, the meat was not cooked through at all, many people have written about this before but nothing has changed. Regards
sample_reviews_en.author: TK B

sample_reviews_en.text: They really have poor and unprofessional management, this is the third time they have caused such a problem. I am a long-time customer here (I was). First they take the order and you wait a long time, then they say we don't have such and such an item. Today we ordered three breakfast sets and then when they brought a press they said we don't have coffee, change it. This time I said no, or cancel or buy coffee from outside and bring it. This is a disaster for the restaurant management.
sample_reviews_en.author: Makan Samsung

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited in December 2025. I enjoyed it. I had the double cheeseburger set. The burger was good (though not outstanding), and the fries were just right for my taste. The pink lemonade was a bit too sweet for me, but that's a matter of personal preference. There were no long wait times.

What I didn't like was that tax was added to the displayed price at the end. I know this isn't uncommon in Thailand, but it always annoys me, and there are many places that don't do it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian R.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've been here for luch, and let me say, beautiful experience!

With the fact that is close to prime burger no-one come here, but it's the best to have an amazing burger!fast, the burgher perfect, the ingredients fresh juicy and abundant! With the combo menu is just 299 bath and you have a a portion of French fries and a lemonade! And let me say, everything was simply perfect!
Try to believe!
sample_reviews_en.author: Claudio Bertan

sample_reviews_en.text:
I enjoyed a pizza at the famous Pattaya Diner, which seemed very industrial (like in America...), especially since the wait was quite long (15 minutes).

Very beautiful setting, it really feels like the USA, but I don't understand why there's a Turkish food menu 🧐

Accepts card payments and can order via GRAB. 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Kentra

sample_reviews_en.text: I normally don’t write reviews We tried this place yesterday, located in Central Pattaya Mall, the food, the service were exceptional!! The owner or manager greeted us and asked how was the food and the service which was pretty cool. The waitress staff were very friendly professional, and attentive as well
sample_reviews_en.author: MDavis

restaurants.name: Kitjaroen Suksawad 26
restaurants.address:

927 Suk Sawat Rd 26, Bang Pakok, Rat Burana, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to eat there today and just left, very disappointed. The items were:
Spring rolls (2 plates) 160 baht
Fried shrimp salad (1 plate) 200 baht
Stir-fried crab meat with curry powder (1 plate) 200 baht
Steamed sea bass with soy sauce (1 whole fish) 600 baht (I've never eaten sea bass for 600 baht before!). When I asked about it, they said the fish was expensive to buy.😡😡
Stir-fried noodles with water spinach (1 plate) 80 baht
Crispy pork stir-fried with chili and salt (1 plate) 100 baht
Shrimp cakes (1 plate) 120 baht
Plain rice (5 plates) 50 baht
Chrysanthemum tea (2 bottles), Coke (2 bottles), water (1 bottle) 140 baht (no matter how I added it up, it didn't match. Absolutely ridiculous!)😡😡
The total bill was 1680 baht, but when I added it up, it was 1650 baht. I went back to ask for a refund of 30 baht. Then they crumpled up the bill and threw it away right in front of me 😡😡😡😡😡😡😡
I'm not giving any stars, but I want to warn new foodies to think carefully before going in.

It's not that I'm complaining, I'm just a foodie.
And I want to support small shops that aren't in malls, but after experiencing this, I'm disappointed. One time only.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanyasit Meteesuriyatanakij

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've wanted to try this restaurant for a long time. I heard it's been open for a while. It's not too far from my house, I drive past it often, and there's parking available.
Inside, there are only 4-5 tables. The menu consists of single-dish meals and side dishes. The taste is Chinese, and quite refreshing (you can specify what you want or don't want in your food).
The prices for single-dish meals aren't too expensive.
I had stir-fried noodles with seafood and basil, a total of 140 baht. It was just the right amount to fill me up. I'll definitely come back to try other dishes.
It's a family-style, casual restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Punnapatcharee Chotthanakuljira

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop front doesn't look exactly like the one on Google Maps, so you have to look carefully. It's a glass-fronted shop next to a pharmacy... As for the food, the Chinese style dishes are excellent. I really liked the Hong Kong style fried noodles, the stir-fried noodles with seafood, and the seafood fried rice. I even ordered extra of all three to take home! And that's not even including the fish stew with taro, seafood spaghetti, seafood noodles with water spinach, and chicken with cashew nuts that I also ordered to take home... Oh, and I recommend ordering the herbal drink too! 😄
sample_reviews_en.author: หมูทอง ไพ่เมเจอร์

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant doesn't look very big, it feels like a casual eatery. For us, the taste wasn't that great. The crab fried rice had an off smell; we're not sure if they used old rice or not (other restaurants we've been to have rice that isn't clumpy and smells like crab and egg). We asked about the difference between soft-shell crab – was it a whole crab or something? – but they couldn't explain it properly and told us to order it. Turns out it was just battered and fried crab! We ordered 5 dishes and paid over 1,400 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kaew Rattanaporn

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was just right. The lovely thing was that all the service was provided by elderly people 😊 The food came out quickly, and the stir-fried chicken noodles were especially delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaruwan Thieansuwan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, with an authentic Chinese flavor—not too spicy, but everything is tasty, especially the crispy pork stir-fried with chili and salt.
sample_reviews_en.author: PICHAYANAN

sample_reviews_en.text: Homemade Chinese and Thai food, cooked by a family of grandparents. Only 3 tables. Affordable prices. Authentic recipes guaranteed.
sample_reviews_en.author: wasan sawaddikaitikul

sample_reviews_en.text: It's an à la carte restaurant, and the food is delicious. You can request that the food be prepared to your preferred taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: smile supakarn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very cozy and nice place. A decent menu with a nice variation of tasty food, Thai and international.
Nicely decorated, rustic feeling, a big bookshelf with various selection of literature.
Suitable for kids as well. Indoor and outdoor section. Not a very nice view, but a nice chill hangout for a few hours. I am a returning customer, both for breakfast, lunch and dinner,  I really like it and can warmly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andreas Sjokvist (Andy)

sample_reviews_en.text: We stopped in for a bite to eat. We got a meet sandwich. The meat was tough as rubber. It was impossible to eat. The photos were far from reality. The service was mediocre. The place smelled of dogs. We ordered a Thai set. They didn't put dragon fruit in it. Instead of apple juice, they brought pineapple juice, even though they repeated several times about apple. It took a long time to get our order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lyudmila S

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a great little hidden gem - very nice interesting interior with books/ coffee theme; seats outside as well if wanted. Friendly and helpful staff; wide choice on menu - western, Thai, Italian, Indian. I had the Thai Chicken with Cachews / Rice (a-roi maak) followed by rum and raisin ice-cream (total 210 Baht). I give it 5 stars as an excellent little cafe - I’ll be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Graeme Young

sample_reviews_en.text: I would not recommend staying overnight. The walls are thin. There is only a shower. The toilet facilities are old. Supplies are not replenished regularly. The road to the hotel is in bad condition and not yet paved. There are stray dogs in the area. However, the staff seemed friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: 近藤勇

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a very cute ambient, selection is wide and good. Not 5 stars because if I order a hot cappuccino and a cake, I would expect to get a glass of water too, since the prices are slightly higher than average. No big deal, but even in cheaper places they bring you water
sample_reviews_en.author: Massimo Peroncelli

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything perfect, decor, food, ambiance but the coffee? I'll let you know after another couple of visits. Tasted as though it was not fresh brewed but I know they sell bon cafe blend so I'm confused. All the equipment was in evidence. More to add after more visits.
sample_reviews_en.author: richard banjo

sample_reviews_en.text: Given that I travel frequently to Thailand and therefore have a fairly accurate idea of ​​the prices and standards of accommodations, I couldn't justify the 9.4 rating Booking.com lists on its website. The location is excellent (a 5-minute …
sample_reviews_en.author: federica sacchelli

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is cool and comfortable, perfect for escaping the heat 😂
They have shaved ice at the front of the shop, delicious mushroom soup, and delicious potato soup.
They have books to read, mostly in English, with Thai novels available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eve Eve

restaurants.name: Khaosuay Kanglor - ข้าวสวย แกงหล่อ
restaurants.address:

ชั้น G Singha Complex Khwaeng Bang Kapi, Bangkapi Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came here after seeing a review that said, “Good food and service, affordable by US standards but probably less so for locals.” I have to say, I partly agree for the place—but also disagree in some important ways.

The dish I ordered was Khao Soi, but the taste felt more like something you’d get in the US rather than authentic Thai Khao Soi. It lacked the depth and character you’d normally expect from this traditional dish. Definitely not what I would consider an authentic Thai experience.

As for the service, there is a 5% service charge, which I found hard to justify. Aside from the person taking the order—who was friendly and smiling—the rest of the staff didn’t seem attentive or particularly interested in providing service. It didn’t feel like a level of service that warrants an extra charge.

Overall, I think both the food quality and service need improvement, and the service charge doesn’t feel appropriate given the experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Troy

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes quite good, although the portions aren't very large. I recommend the fried pork patties; they're delicious. The sour curry with acacia leaves and shrimp is also excellent; the broth is rich and flavorful. It's conveniently located near Phetchaburi MRT station.
sample_reviews_en.author: paradoy gloomy

sample_reviews_en.text: Southern Thai food is rich but not spicy. If you don't eat spicy food but want to eat Southern Thai food, I recommend this place. You'll definitely like it. The ingredients are high quality and the curry is rich. But if it's a little spicy, it would be great for us.
sample_reviews_en.author: JiRa W.

sample_reviews_en.text: The Thai food there is pretty good and flavorful. I've been there with friends 2-3 times. The restaurant is located in the Singha Complex building. The waitstaff aren't very polite. The food portions and prices are reasonable, and the beer is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amron Tipviset

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Southern style spicy minced pork is not recommended.. overcooked, oily, and salty
- Green curry with beef shanks is almost ok, quite sweet and not spicy at all. The beef shanks are tender though.
- A stir-fry pumpkin with egg is nice but overpriced
sample_reviews_en.author: Duangkamol L.

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves delicious Thai food. I tried the yellow curry with sea bass and coconut shoots, and an omelet. The yellow curry was medium spicy, fragrant with spices, and had a slight saltiness and sourness. The fish was fresh, but …
sample_reviews_en.author: kan tem

sample_reviews_en.text: This newly opened rice and curry shop is only 15 days old. The rice is fragrant, beautiful, and delicious! The food isn't too expensive compared to other restaurants in this area; you could even call it cheap. An omelet is 60 baht, and if …
sample_reviews_en.author: Pang Kate

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant's name is very eye-catching, and the atmosphere is nice and inviting. They serve Thai food, mainly curries and stews, but they actually have a wide variety of dishes including soups, stir-fries, curries, fried dishes, and …

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a restaurant located in a small garden, with a shady and peaceful atmosphere. The food is delicious and inexpensive. That day, I had stir-fried kale with beef and oyster sauce, topped with a fried egg for 45 baht, and a glass of hibiscus juice for 15 baht, totaling 60 baht. I was very satisfied. The restaurant is located on Kanlapaphruek Road, next to the PTT gas station. If you're passing by, give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: supaporn seeyangnok

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today, I followed the map and the shop inside has been converted into a laundry. The restaurant is now located on the roadside.
There are both air-conditioned and outdoor areas.
I was most impressed by the stir-fried stink beans. They gave me a generous amount of shrimp and stink beans. Most importantly, it was delicious.
It was like bringing an entire stink beans garden. The price was very reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aui Petitz

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and very cheap. You pay a hundred baht but get a taste of a thousand! The entrance is a bit hard to find because there are a lot of signs. Slow down when you see the PTT gas station. Before reaching the other gas station, turn left into the alley and follow the road. It's at the very end.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanayu Penphol

sample_reviews_en.text: I love this restaurant so much. It's hard to find a restaurant with this kind of atmosphere. The food is delicious, affordable, and suits my taste perfectly. Everyone at the restaurant is so friendly. I go there very often. When I can't think of anywhere else to go, I always choose Baan Suan. I love it! 😊😀😄 …
sample_reviews_en.author: วรรณา เอื้อพานิชเจริญ

sample_reviews_en.text: Came here because it was right next door to the corgi cafe - turned out to be one of our favorite meals in Bangkok! Everything was delicious (and felt very local), everyone was really nice (despite our lack of Thai ability), and food came out quite fast. Prices here are definitely quite affordable as well :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Raymond Chang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic Thai food in a garden setting.
Delicious food with great taste and reasonable prices.
Pleasant and beautiful atmosphere.
Taste is delicious, just like mom's home-cooked meals.

Recommended dishes:
Pork with chili paste, rice with shrimp paste, grilled pork neck with spicy dipping sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Surachat Sakcharoenphan

sample_reviews_en.text: The nicest food i had whilst in Thailand. Comfortable and cozy restaurant. Service A*, clean and plenty of space. The food was so nice and tasty, service was fabulous, freindly and very courteous!  Highly recommended!!
sample_reviews_en.author: PS - TV
