restaurants.address:

2797 Charoen Krung 105, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It used to be good, but since May 2020, the portions have been small and expensive. The ingredients are mediocre, nothing special. There's a wide variety of dishes on the menu, but you have to take your chances on what's available. I used to eat there often, but I'm not happy anymore. Almost everything I order is out of stock, which is confusing. I guess I'll have to look for other restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natdanai Chant-aree

sample_reviews_en.text: The only downside was the decent welcome, and while the drinks and food looked very similar to the photos, the taste was something else entirely... I absolutely do not recommend this place; we left without finishing our meals! It's a real shame because the ambiance doesn't reflect the food at all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marielle Robin

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the halal food restaurants in Bangkok, Thailand.
The menu is suited to Indonesian palates.

I ate here frequently from 2013 to 2014.
In 2021, is the owner still the same as before?

In 2013, the owner was a young man who was said to be getting married soon. 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: Bang Tope channel

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is a must visit if you stay around Asiatique area. We ordered one big fried fish, beef kailan, garlic squid, white and fried rice for 600 bht which could be eaten by 3 people. The place has good decor and aircon. On the way back …
sample_reviews_en.author: Amelia Bachtiar

sample_reviews_en.text: Small but cosy and clean restaurant about 500m from asiatique runs by a beautiful couple. Reasonably priced and delicious food. Serving took less than 15mins. Keep up the amazing job.
sample_reviews_en.author: Asyraf Muhammad

sample_reviews_en.text:
Best Halal Thai Seafood. Excellent choice of dishes for Seafood lover and for those who are looking for Halal food in town.
Reasonable Price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Irshath Mohamed

sample_reviews_en.text: Great halal restaurant serving Thai halal food near Asiatique. Prices is reasonable and environment is good for family with kids too.
sample_reviews_en.author: SNS

sample_reviews_en.text: Such a good place to visit for thai halal food everything was tasty will visit again
sample_reviews_en.author: anucha ansari

restaurants.name: ร้านส้มตำผ่านฟ้า
restaurants.address:

Bang Pakok, Rat Burana, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Almost everything was delicious! The grilled items were great, and the papaya salad was excellent. It was clean and used good quality ingredients. We ordered 10 dishes and the bill came to 700 baht 😋
1. Papaya salad with salted egg
2. Papaya salad with crab
3. Papaya salad with fermented fish sauce and crab
4. Minced pork salad
5. Grilled pork neck
6. Grilled beef
7. Grilled catfish
8. Spicy pork soup
9. Minced duck salad
10. Sweetened liver

Oh, and they also had 2 servings of rice noodles, 2 servings of sticky rice, 1 serving of ice, and 1 serving of water.

Highly recommend! It's a shame I didn't take pictures.
The restaurant just opened on January 1st, 2025. They moved from the Phan Fa area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jee Jie

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is next to a 7-Eleven. There's plenty of seating. You can park in the 7-Eleven or CJ parking lot, or a little bit along the street. The prices are good and very reasonable.
The papaya salad is amazing!! So delicious. The intestines are a little chewy, but it's okay. Everything else is delicious too. It's my favorite papaya salad place in terms of taste. However, there's a bit of a wait for the food. If you're really hungry, you might get a little frustrated, I think. But the taste gets a perfect 10/10. I'm a regular customer now.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sathita Sangngam

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was incredibly slow to come out, but what was even more infuriating was how slowly each dish was served. It took so long that we'd already finished everything else before the last dish arrived. And before that, people who ordered later got their food first – other tables, even those ordering takeout – while we still hadn't received everything we ordered. It's been about 40 minutes!
sample_reviews_en.author: Fern Fern

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has been open for 30 years. I've been a regular customer since it was located near Phan Fah.
The hot pot is delicious, and the dipping sauce is unique and flavorful.
I highly recommend their grilled pork, 100/10. It's great with the hot pot dipping sauce.
The sweet liver is also delicious, as is the traditional glass noodle salad.
sample_reviews_en.author: boos chic

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! The cook was always smiling. But what really touched me was having a grandmother as part of the team. It feels good to give elderly people the opportunity to earn income and have someone to talk to. The restaurant only has her washing vegetables and things like that; it's not heavy work at all. ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: wanlee pardruang

sample_reviews_en.text: All the food tasted good. The grilled pork was excellent; I don't usually eat fatty meat, but this grilled pork had no fat at all, which I loved. However, the cockles didn't seem very fresh, and there were quite a few flies – I kept swatting them away while eating. Overall, it was good. It's close to home, so I'll go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: aon yoo

sample_reviews_en.text: The food at this restaurant was extremely slow. I only ordered 3 dishes but waited 53 minutes for my food. It might have been because they forgot the bill. Even the sticky rice took 30 minutes to arrive. The taste was average. There were many staff members but they weren't running the place well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vanussaporn Sanitnoi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The grilled food is delicious, especially the grilled pork and pork neck, which practically melt in your mouth.
The papaya salad with fermented crab is also tasty. I happened to walk by and stopped in, it was okay. It's in front of 7-Eleven. You can get whatever you want to drink.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supachai S

restaurants.name: Fai Daeng Signature
restaurants.address:

ตลาดอยู่สอาด Wang Ngam Alley, Nong Bon, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop moved from Paradise Place, but it was closed for renovations, so they're now located at Yu Sa-ard Market. The food is prepared quickly, and you can eat inside (it's a bit hot, but there are fans). The owner is friendly and easy to talk to, and the service is good. They have a variety of dishes, so you should definitely try it, or you can order delivery.
sample_reviews_en.author: s. lee

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered stir-fried pork with chili paste and green beans, topped with a fried egg.
The flavor was spicy and delicious.
70 baht.
They have other tempting dishes on the menu too.
The shop is located in the market; it's a bit hot inside. Walk in and it's on the left.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rungrawee Tipmontree

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a traditional, spacious restaurant, a bit warm in the summer, but the à la carte dishes are really tasty. Today I tried the crispy pork belly with kale, and it was perfectly crispy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaruwan Weraamornkul

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered minced pork basil rice, and it was a bit too sweet. I don't like sweet food, but if you like sweet flavors, it would probably be okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thipthanat Khiewumporn

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, the taste is okay, generous portion, but a little too sweet. It's like they give you fish sauce to add yourself.
sample_reviews_en.author: CPN Thai

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was prepared incredibly quickly; unbelievably, it took less than 5 minutes! Delicious, I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chokchai Phanibut

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is clean, prices are clearly displayed, service is fast, no long wait, and the food tastes good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pin thiwa NongLek

sample_reviews_en.text: Opening on August 15th, the market is clean. Are there tables to sit and eat at? (FC, traffic light)
sample_reviews_en.author: Chutipon Suksri

restaurants.name: ร้านจูลี่ ข้าวมันไก่
restaurants.address:

VH6J+2RF เลขที่ 304 1021 Soi Phahon Yothin 49/1, Talat Bang Khen, Lak Si, Bangkok 10210, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Hainanese chicken rice and roast pork shop in the Bang Bua area.
The shop and utensils are clean, and the staff are friendly.
The portions are very generous, making it great value for money. The price is inexpensive, and the atmosphere is very welcoming. However, the taste is average, not amazing, and doesn't quite reach its full potential. The roast pork sauce and soup are quite bland.
The roast pork was a bit dry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tongz NP

sample_reviews_en.text: Julie's is a chicken rice shop located in the alley opposite the Bang Bua Housing Stadium. They also serve boiled chicken, fried chicken skin, and their signature dipping sauces. I personally like the fact that you can make your own dipping sauces, including sweet and sour sauces, which go perfectly with the chicken rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: bank bank tawatchai

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually order from this restaurant to eat at home, but today I found a whole box of old chicken. The chicken meat was hard as a kidney. The hardness of the chicken meat was so great that even if I pressed it hard with a spoon, it still wouldn't sink in.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nopporn Leng

sample_reviews_en.text: Clean and very delicious, whether it's chicken rice, pork leg rice, crispy pork rice, or red pork rice. The red pork rice with gravy of this shop is very delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: กนกพัชร คล้ายใส

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, clean, and good service when eating at the restaurant. It's also very convenient to take home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bpy Yyy.

sample_reviews_en.text: Besides being delicious, it's also clean, and the vendor is kind and very friendly to customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: นันท์นภัส ปานกึ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very delicious, clean, and good service.
You have to go early because they sell out quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: ฉัฐวัสส์ พิพัฒน์วิสุทธิ์กุล

restaurants.name: แป๊ะ หูฉลาม(สาขาลาดพร้าว80)
restaurants.address:

68/7 Soi Lat Phrao 80 Yaek 22, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pae Shark Fin Restaurant in Soi Lat Phrao 80
This shophouse-style restaurant has no air conditioning. Parking is available by finding a parking spot along the sidewalk (not in front of a house).
Menu ordered:
- Fish Maw in Red Soup (THB 100): Served hot in a clay pot, the soup was a bit salty, but the fish maw was good. It was topped with crab and shiitake mushrooms, making it a good value.
- Chicken Fried Noodles (THB 70): The soup was a bit salty, similar to the fish maw. The other ingredients were tender chicken and crunchy bamboo shoots, which were delicious.
- Crab Fried Rice (THB 70): The stir-fry was delicious, the rice wasn't mushy, and the flavors were well-balanced.
- Oyster Omelette (THB 100): The oysters were soft, not large, but fresh, and the portions were quite generous. The flavors were good, not too salty. You can eat them plain or with chili sauce.
Overall, I liked the crab fried rice and oyster omelette. The price was good, and the portions were good value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boat ANRPS

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! The flavors were great. The fried rice was fragrant, perfectly cooked, and the grains were beautifully separated but not hard. There was plenty of crab meat in every bite. The stir-fried noodles were also excellent. The oyster omelet had large oysters. The fish maw soup was amazing, with lots of big pieces of crab claws. The prices were very reasonable considering the quality and quantity. The female staff member provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: xChikapu

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant's dad makes every dish delicious, but when his children cook, the taste is reduced by half. I once bought fish maw soup that his children made, and before I could even eat it, the broth was gone. My regular orders are fish maw soup, Yangzhou-style fried noodles, seafood basil stir-fry with rice, and oyster omelet.
sample_reviews_en.author: KhunGig Karnrawee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Authentic street-side Chinese food.

Everything is delicious ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

Good ingredients, good prices.

The owner also makes single-dish meals. We ordered crab stir-fry with basil, it was okay.

The braised fish maw in red sauce was superb.

Oh, and the portions are just as good as famous restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: vichein buranapornkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my regular spot. Whenever I come to this area, I have to eat here. Personally, I like it better than many restaurants in the Yaowarat area, and the price is much better.

But parking is a bit difficult. The shop is right on the roadside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Moofar far

sample_reviews_en.text: I like ordering the crab fried rice and fish maw soup. It's good value for money, the portions are generous, and the taste is delicious. However, parking is a bit difficult; you have to park a little further away and walk to the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panyawat Waitayin

sample_reviews_en.text: The price and taste are excellent. It's a Chinese-style restaurant (I'm not sure which region), not too greasy, and not too spicy. They have single-dish menus ranging from braised shark fin soup to stir-fried basil with rice, etc. It's …
sample_reviews_en.author: khanchai somkliang

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything this uncle stir-fries is delicious, especially the Yangzhou noodles. They're incredibly flavorful and delicious! There's parking in front of the shop and seating, but no air conditioning.
sample_reviews_en.author: montraa montareeya

restaurants.name: Pa Krim Pla - Khun Sai Jai
restaurants.address:

23/1 Soi Samsen 13 Alley, Wachira Phayaban, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The snakehead fish soup at this restaurant is located at the end of Soi Samsen 13. It costs 60฿. The broth is flavorful and well-balanced. The snakehead fish is firm, not fishy, ​​and very delicious.
sample_reviews_th.author: 60 Seconds

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pakrim Pla, Khun Saijai
Authentic Vietnamese Noodle Soup
Pakrim Pla is a Vietnamese noodle soup with snakehead fish, but I didn't try it because I don't like snakehead fish. I ate the regular pork bone version.
The noodles are chewy and soft, and the soup is thick and viscous with a mild flavor.
The overall atmosphere is that of a shop set up in someone's house, with tables along the roadside and some seating in the back.
You have to order early in the morning, otherwise it will be sold out.

The service is fast and efficient, in the style of a traditional shop...
sample_reviews_en.author: ChubbyArin

sample_reviews_en.text: For those living or nearby in the Samsen area who love Vietnamese noodle soup (Khao Piak), I highly recommend Pak Rim Pla Khun Saijai. The broth is smooth and refreshing, the noodles are soft and chewy, the fish has no unpleasant smell, and the pork ribs are tender. In short, it's delicious! The shop is located at the very end of the soi (alley). There's seating inside. They usually sell out by 7 am, so even though it's busy, the wait isn't too long. You can park on the street in the soi or in the university parking lot for 20 baht per hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuch S

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop sells reasonably priced fish cakes. We ordered a mixed bowl with three ingredients: snakehead fish, pork ribs, and pork sausage, for 60 baht. The broth was delicious, the noodles were perfectly cooked, the fish was tender and had no fishy smell, the pork ribs were soft, and the pork sausage was tasty. You can sit inside the shop, which is shady and pleasant. We ate at 7:30 am, and the owner said there wasn't much left, as she opens at 5 am. Anyone wanting to eat here should come early.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ayumi Mumu

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm not sure if it's called "Pla Krim Pla" or "Pak Krim Pla,"

but we're more familiar with the name "Vietnamese Rice Noodle Soup (Khao Piak Yuan)."

It's a Vietnamese dish that's unique because it includes fish.

The broth is fragrant, sweet, and delicious.

The noodles are slippery but slightly chewy, giving a nice texture.

We added extra pork ribs, Vietnamese sausage, fried shallots, roasted chili peppers, and a squeeze of lime. The flavor was perfectly balanced.
sample_reviews_en.author: บทเพลงปีศาจ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Vietnamese noodle soup here is a "must-order." A bowl is packed with pork ribs, Vietnamese sausage, and egg. The broth is fragrant and very comforting.

My favorite part is the Vietnamese sausage – it's delicious, bouncy, soft, and perfectly balanced in flavor. It's busy in the mornings, but the food comes out quickly, so you don't have to wait long. It's perfect for breakfast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Savor and savage

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the regular mixed bowl, and let me tell you, it was amazing! Usually, no restaurant I've tried includes fish. I didn't think it would go well together, but it ended up being even tastier than before. Another highlight is the "lime," which is rarely found at other restaurants. The soup wasn't too salty, which I really liked.
P.S. The regular mixed bowl is 60 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: fayefaye. pp (Fayeya)

sample_reviews_en.text: The flavor is well-balanced, the fish is not fishy at all, the texture is firm, not mushy, and the pork sausage is also not fishy. The broth is clear, and the noodles have the perfect chewy texture. It's incredibly delicious! I've been eating this since I was studying at Joan of Arc, over 20 years now. I'm completely hooked! 😊 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Lili

restaurants.name: Pannarat Fish Ball Noodle
restaurants.address:

MFJJ+V67, Rama II Rd, Bang Mot, Chom Thong, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: It's delicious! I especially love the fish dumplings; they're chewy and soft. "This bowl of dry thin noodles with only fish dumplings is 50฿." Once I tried it, I had to come back often whenever I had the chance.
sample_reviews_th.author: maree lao. (mam)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pannarat Fish Balls 🍢🍥 Delicious roadside stall on Rama 2 Road, KM 1.

📍The stall is located on Rama 2 Road, KM 1, in an area known as O-Eh Market. You can park on the roadside at night. Police might tow cars in the evening.
🍜 The fish balls, shrimp balls, and shrimp dumplings are delicious and reasonably priced.

YouTube 🎬 Paopao Studio
TikTok 🎙️ Paopao Studio
Wongnai 🍭 Paopao Studio
sample_reviews_en.author: Paopao Studio

sample_reviews_en.text:
The various meatballs and dumplings are of good quality and fresh.
The wide noodles are made from pure rice flour.
They aren't very chewy or soft.

The thin noodles are chewier and softer.

I ordered Yen Ta Fo and Tom Yum.
The restaurant made them with a moderate flavor; I had to add my own seasoning.
I liked that they had crushed peanuts available to add yourself.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kay Cee

sample_reviews_en.text:
January 15, 2024. Arrived after 9 PM. Parked on the side of the road. The soup was delicious, and all the fish ingredients were tasty. The noodle soup (Kao Lao) had plenty of fish ingredients. The Yen Ta Fo was also decent, although the portions weren't very large.

I saw the shop was closed today. It was closed for several days during the New Year period.
sample_reviews_en.author: BD Life

sample_reviews_en.text: It's so good! I love the fish dumplings the most. I like to order the small dry noodles with just fish dumplings, 5 large ones included. The shop recently opened around 11 p.m. If you pass by, you have to stop and eat. The yen ta fo is also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: มะรี เหล่า

sample_reviews_en.text: Every noodle dish is delicious, especially the fish balls. They're so crispy and bouncy, not fishy at all. I really like them. I highly recommend them. They're so delicious I forgot to take a picture.
sample_reviews_en.author: เที่ยวไป กินไป กับ นายซัน

sample_reviews_en.text: The fish dumplings are incredibly delicious! Every time I come, I always order an extra bag of just the dumplings to take home. It's a small shop but they stay open late. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukit Benjangjaru

sample_reviews_en.text:
The various meatballs are tastier than those at shops in Yaowarat (Chinatown).
The fish dumplings are a highlight, packed with fish.
The dry noodles with soy sauce are also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: I_Bow Slavik

restaurants.name: Skip Cafe Sam Yan
restaurants.address:

Soi Chulalongkorn 42, Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a fantastic Japanese restaurant near U-Center dorms. It offers great value for money in terms of price, quality, and quantity. They have a huge menu with many hidden gems, and the prices are very student-friendly. The atmosphere might seem a bit unusual because it's full of greenery. The restaurant has two seating areas, so you can choose where to sit. I recommend the single-serving Dolly fish dish for 109 baht; you get a whole Dolly fish – the best value in the area. The taste might not be authentically Japanese, but it's easy to eat and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pesama Saksanit

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of my regular stops around Samyan!
Skip is a cozy Japanese restaurant in the U-Center area with variety of menu at very friendly prices. The food comes out quickly, which is perfect when you’re hungry but don’t want to wait too long.

Overall, the flavors range from decent to genuinely good. My personal favorites are the fried salmon belly and the teriyaki salmon — both are consistently tasty and satisfying. If you’re nearby and craving simple, affordable Japanese food, this place is definitely worth a visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tenz Photoz

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is one of my favorite restaurants. If I'm in Samyan Mitrtown for business, I can park in the mall.
The menu has a wide variety of options, which is great for kids and students because the prices are affordable. It's a Japanese style restaurant, so the food isn't too spicy, which my mom loves.
If you're passing by or have the chance, I highly recommend trying it. The food comes out quickly, no long wait.
My kids love this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: รัตนธร

sample_reviews_en.text: Located in the U-Center area, this restaurant has been open for many years and is so popular that it has expanded. They offer a wide variety of Japanese and other dishes at affordable prices, with many items under 100 baht. This ensures the restaurant is always full. However, it must be acknowledged that the taste and quality of the ingredients aren't exactly premium, but they're certainly not bad.
sample_reviews_en.author: Coke Somchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Japanese food is inexpensive and tastes decent (but the katsudon rice bowl came in a strange way, with a separate vegetable broth from the rice and pork).
The only criticism is that the foreign staff (probably hired cheaply) seem aloof towards customers. Many reviews have mentioned this as well. If the owner reads these reviews, please take this into consideration and improve this aspect.
sample_reviews_en.author: Itachi Uchiha

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd like to file a complaint. The food is okay, and the prices are cheap, suitable for students. However, please train your staff better. The service is terrible. The staff were grumpy, snatched the menu from the customer's hand after they finished writing, didn't apologize, and were indifferent. It's a shame for the restaurant, which has been around for a long time. Please improve this.
sample_reviews_en.author: P J

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices are inexpensive, and the food is edible but not delicious. The fish wasn't fresh, and the rice in the set was hard, not typical Japanese rice. The okonomiyaki was crispy and had a lot of sauce, unlike the usual. The restaurant had a strong fishy smell and didn't look very clean. The pictures in the menu were blurry. It's just okay for the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sara K

sample_reviews_en.text: I eat at this restaurant often, but this time I ordered delivery to my room. I requested some extra salad dressing, but it wasn't all there. I also found a hair in my food, and the fish was on top of it, just as I was about to pour it out with the salad. Anything that goes into the consumer's mouth should be made better than this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chadtrakool Bunchongkleang

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยววัดดงมูลเหล็ก พัทยาสาขา2
restaurants.address:

ถนนเ Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Last night, I drove past the restaurant several times.
The taste wasn't bad, but the service was terrible.
If you can't wait to take your order, you could have just left it on your table instead of just sitting there in a dissatisfied manner. Also, for the hot pot, you have to order your noodles separately, but they didn't inform you. The noodles were cooked until they were hard and raw. The liver looked spoiled and had a bad smell. This was my first time eating there with my girlfriend. Honestly, I wasn't happy about it. I work in service, too. When I went, there were no tables available. Please fix this so others don't have the same experience as me. I probably won't go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: BoomSk *

sample_reviews_en.text:
I arrived around 8:30 PM and there were no other customers; I was the only table.
1. The service was very slow, even though there was only one table.
2. The staff taking orders seemed inexperienced and made mistakes with the orders.
3. The staff didn't seem to work together. If this continues, it's very bad.
They need to improve this urgently. The food wasn't very good. I ordered spicy pork rib soup and got a spicy soup with tough pork. The sun-dried pork seemed like old pork that had been fried before, and it was extremely sour.
I am very dissatisfied with my dining experience and wasted my money on things I didn't receive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Simon

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is located on the roadside and open 24 hours. I arrived at 8 a.m. and they said they were out of everything: stewed pork and beef.

I ordered stewed pork, but they said they only had a little left, so they asked me to add pork pieces. I ordered stir-fried pork with basil, but they were also out of stock.

Another person ordered stewed beef noodles, but they were out of stock, leaving only fresh beef. However, they served fresh pork instead.
Pork noodle soup, 80 baht, 5 pieces of pork.
The taste was okay, but considering the portion size, it didn't feel like a good value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalisa Techawatcharapaikul

sample_reviews_en.text: Very slow, the queue is all messed up, first come first served, slow. The excuse is that the paper doesn't come out, the food doesn't come out to all tables at the same time, one table even got up and left the restaurant (really bad). Customers aren't gods, it's true, but we chose to eat at your restaurant, you should take care of the service more than this. Please improve. The food tastes normal, we exchange money for your food. Ordered pork, got beef. Fix this urgently. No apology, really bad. Comments like this are for improvement, criticism is constructive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aomsup FM

sample_reviews_en.text: On February 22nd, 2026, at 1:20 AM, I ate at this restaurant and the service was terrible. The staff took my order as if they were annoyed, had a grumpy face, and spoke very rudely. The food was also very slow. I was paying for my meal, not begging for it; they need to improve their service. Anyone thinking of eating here should think twice. It was one of the worst noodle shops I've ever encountered in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fighter Shop Online

sample_reviews_en.text: The braised beef with basil was extremely sweet, the rice was watery and soggy, like eating sticky rice balls with braised beef. The food came out very slowly, even though there were no customers in the restaurant. The food wasn't hot, like it had been cooked and then left sitting. The staff looked like they hadn't slept, their faces all scrunched up like broken-necked steamed tuna.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supatswan Boonlap

sample_reviews_en.text:
My friend and I stopped by this cafe. We ordered strawberry lemonade and a passion fruit smoothie. For dinner, we had fried rice with seafood and shrimp. The total cost was 270 baht.
Everything was delicious; we really enjoyed it. The portions were huge.
We didn't get any food poisoning, so feel free to eat.
There's seating on the veranda and a private room with air conditioning.
sample_reviews_en.author: Татьяна Круглова

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to try the crispy pork rice, but unfortunately they didn't have it, so I ordered the gapow moo and gai instead. It was mildly spicy, like Nit Noi. We've eaten gapow rice many times in Thailand, and I think this one is in the top three. I hope I get the chance to eat it again.

2025.2
When I went back after they moved, the taste had dramatically deteriorated. What a shame.
sample_reviews_en.author: 白石浩一

restaurants.name: Sushi Kubota
restaurants.address:

Thong Lo, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the sushi restaurant in Bangkok that I frequent the most.

The rice is perfectly cooked, and the vinegar is balanced to complement everything from fatty to lighter cuts.

Starting with the classic striped jack mackerel, every seasonal ingredient is delicious, and I remember being impressed by the seasonal sea urchin, sea bream, firefly squid, deep-sea smelt, sardines... I'm always amazed and delighted by the food.

It continues to surprise and delight my taste buds every time.
sample_reviews_en.author: 影山文彦

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hidden gem in Thong Lor
A delightful omakase experience!
The Japanese chef was very professional, and there were even several books introducing the various fish ingredients. Every dish was delicious and fresh, and the accompanying ingredients were perfect, elevating the flavors to another level.

🇭🇰
sample_reviews_en.author: Michelle Wong

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my third visit. They serve sushi made with fresh ingredients flown in from Japan. I always look forward to it because they also offer seasonal ingredients.

The restaurant's atmosphere and the staff's service are excellent, making it a place I definitely want to visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ai Okada

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the lunch course. It wasn't cheap, but there are many Japanese izakayas in Bangkok where you can eat sashimi and sushi, and the selection was different for a counter sushi restaurant. I especially tried the "Mehikari" (sea bream), which was my first time and was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: name

sample_reviews_en.text:
My husband and I visited.
We had the Goku lunch course.
Every ingredient was of high quality and delicious!
Next time, I'd like to visit with my family.
Everything was delicious, but I especially recommend the sweet shrimp.
sample_reviews_en.author: 打越遥

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a wonderful restaurant where they always serve delicious sushi made with seasonal ingredients.

Even my 5-year-old daughter, who is a picky eater, will eat anything served here; I trust them completely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Y O

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first visit. Every dish was a pleasant surprise, and I thoroughly enjoyed it. The atmosphere was calm and relaxing. I will definitely visit again. Thank you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Matsuo Kyo

sample_reviews_en.text: Each dish was amazing and made with the best ingredients. I’d suggest giving this restaurant a try if you’re in Bangkok or planning a visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuki C.

restaurants.name: ข้าวโค้ง มหาดไทย
restaurants.address:

26 พลับพลา 10 Lat Phrao 122 Alley, Lane 8, Khwaeng Phlabphla, Khet Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The service is very bad. I asked for plain water 3 times and still didn't get it. In the end, I had to get up and get it myself. The staff didn't care at all. If I didn't go get it myself, I probably wouldn't have gotten the food. The price is expensive compared to other restaurants with better service. This is my first time here and I won't recommend anyone to come here again. It's not delicious either. The end.
sample_reviews_en.author: Meen Thanwarat

sample_reviews_en.text:
From a customer, I became a waiter myself. I called the staff several times, but no one paid attention. I had to get my own eating utensils: plates, chopsticks, spoons, forks, drinking water, glasses, and ice. The food wasn't cheap, and the service was unimpressive.
**Only serving those who drank alcohol, those who ate were excluded.**
sample_reviews_en.author: kochapak kongpan

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, it was okay. The dipping sauce for the hot pot was just average. We ordered a 350 baht set for two people and couldn't finish it. They gave a lot of vegetables and a decent amount of meat, appropriate for the price. The staff seemed normal, not bad service. It wasn't too crowded, so it was a nice, relaxed atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: fanny Chan

sample_reviews_en.text: We waited so long for our food that the ice we ordered was almost completely melted. The dipping sauce for the hot pot was incredibly bland. The staff were slow, serving was slow, and bringing the bill was slow. I strongly advise against eating here.
sample_reviews_en.author: ARAYA TANPHANIT

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, cafe style. The food is delicious, and there's live music. The owner is lovely and friendly, and the staff are all wonderful and provide excellent service. I highly recommend this place! Please support this restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: เสาวภา คําครองแก้ว

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious. The price is standard, not cheap, not expensive. It's located on Lat Phrao 122 Road. You'll definitely be full at this restaurant. If you walk, the route isn't deserted, but it's dark in some places.
sample_reviews_en.author: AԵhίmeԵ S.

sample_reviews_en.text: Khao Khong restaurant in Soi Mahathai, Ladprao 122, offers a variety of dishes. The dishes I tried were minced pork basil with pork sausage and a fried egg, and minced pork basil with squid.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paitvza

sample_reviews_en.text: There's a football match to watch, and the food is delicious with a wide variety to choose from. I recommend coming in the evening for a more authentic experience than during the day.
sample_reviews_en.author: pattrawut balangura

restaurants.name: Aunt Paad Pad Kaphrao
restaurants.address:

380 Arun Amarin Rd, Siriraj, Bangkok Noi, Bangkok 10700, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Ordered takeout and they charged extra for the box, 10฿ for the container. This place is ridiculously expensive. I've been to other places that charge for containers, but it's usually 2-5฿. This is way too much! The food at the restaurant, where they don't charge for containers, tastes better.
sample_reviews_th.author: JUPAJIB

sample_reviews_en.text:
The management was terrible. A customer came waiting for their bill and they lost it, but they didn't pay any attention. They just kept saying they didn't have any. The service was top-notch. Then another person got a single shrimp on their plate and asked the staff if they had just one. The same staff member replied, "That's all they had." 555+

If it's not free, or the world isn't the only place left, I recommend walking past.
sample_reviews_en.author: kemanan pinphiphop

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you come at 11 am, there will be a long queue and the restaurant will be full.
If you come earlier, there might be people who ordered by phone.

The minced pork basil stir-fry is delicious. This restaurant makes really good basil stir-fry. Usually, it's very crowded from noon to early afternoon. It's so busy that you might not find a seat, or you might not be able to wait because it takes so long.
sample_reviews_en.author: pairash pleanmalai

sample_reviews_en.text: Made-to-order restaurant, the size of a shophouse with about eight tables. No beef. Stir-fried minced pork with liver and basil with a lot of rice. Stir-fried dry with thick sliced chilies. Just the right amount of spiciness. No dark soy sauce. Good quality rice, warm, not cold or hard. Thinly sliced liver, stir-fried until cooked but still bouncy. Accepts bank transfers and payments.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponchagarj Ngamukos

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a made-to-order restaurant that everyone at Siriraj Hospital knows. The taste is delicious, flavorful, and spicy—every chili is hot! How do I even describe it? Every dish is perfectly balanced. If you can't decide what to eat, this is the place to go; you won't be disappointed. Give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: ThE JuK MoNsTeR

sample_reviews_en.text: I used to eat here often, even though it was expensive. But the last time I went, I ordered food and they forgot to make it. I had to wait for a long time. I asked for it back, but they said they didn't order it. 55555. Goodbye.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ing Zp Charatprakai

sample_reviews_en.text: Take long time for ordering, about half and hour just 4 onlu one menu. But fried minced pork with basil ontop the rice taste sooooo good. True flavor of thai Pad Kaprao
sample_reviews_en.author: Luminis_ K

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent.. I like to eat pork basil with rice + fried egg, it's rich + lots of chili.. I personally like it like this. During the day, there are a lot of people.🥰🥰🥰 …
sample_reviews_en.author: ฮูกคับ

restaurants.name: The Diner
restaurants.address:

PJ8C+PJQ, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is decorated in a retro American style, reminiscent of the 80s and 90s. The main menu consists of American fast food and drinks. It opens at 5 PM, and there's live music in the evenings. If you enjoy this kind of atmosphere or style, I highly recommend it.

Price: 4/5
Quality: 4/5
Taste: 5/5
Cleanliness: 5/5
Speed: 5/5
Service: 5/5
Location: 5/5
Value for money: 4/5
sample_reviews_en.author: Akapatr Chiraarreebutr

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had a proper meal for the first time in two days.

It would have been better if I had known about this place sooner.

It's such a shame.

I really enjoyed the meal :)

I especially ordered the morning glory three times lol.
sample_reviews_en.author: 누누

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm in Panya Village. It's easier to access via Phatthanakan Soi 30, but from October 1st to early January 2022, the Phatthanakan Road side will be closed for renovations. Please access via On Nut instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุมิตร สุมิตร

sample_reviews_en.text: I came to deliver something. I like that the main road isn't cluttered with parked cars. The only downside is that the security guard has a bad attitude; it's not as good as other places.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeerasak Auntaso

sample_reviews_en.text: I bought an iced green tea today and it came with a cockroach. The contact number I tried to get was unreachable.
sample_reviews_en.author: ZzA Dear

sample_reviews_en.text: We played badminton and then had a meal. The food was decent (some dishes), and the prices were moderate.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phattraporn Akraponpanit

restaurants.name: Bake A Wish House (ครัวกลาง)
restaurants.address:

เบค อะ วิช ครัวกลาง 166 Suk Sawat Rd 26, Bang Mot, Chom Thong, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a central kitchen selling products that failed quality control. Goods are stocked from 4:00 PM onwards, with sales starting around 6:30 PM. There's a wide variety of products to choose from, such as macarons, Dubai chocolates, various types of donuts, chocolate balls, cakes, marshmallows, and orange cake. Prices start at 20, 30, and 50 baht depending on the item. You can often buy a lot to take home. If you go at a good time, they might even give you some freebies. A little further down is a market with several parking areas.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffey

sample_reviews_en.text: This not-so-secret hidden gem on TikTok caught my eye. I came all the way here, but everything was sold out! Only the crispy bread and baked cheesy vegetables were left. I've bookmarked it and will come back another day. The staff said they're open every day and start giving out queue numbers at 3 PM. I'm determined to try it next time!
sample_reviews_en.author: IDA&VESPA ไอด้า เวสป้า พาเที่ยว

sample_reviews_en.text: The pastries from Bake a Wish that had minor quality control issues were generally good, just like the ones sold in department stores. We went at 4 PM, and there were already some people, but it wasn't crowded, so we didn't have to worry about being squeezed in. We parked at the Lotus Mini on the same side as the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: TANG KWA

sample_reviews_en.text:
A factory producing a famous bakery brand:
"BAKE A WISH"
- Products are available for sale at the factory in the late afternoon (4 PM). There are long queues in the sweltering heat.
- The prices are affordable, making them very accessible.
- The macarons are delicious and inexpensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: TOMashi R

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been here many times. The snacks are very cheap. I came around 4 PM when it was busy, but the queue didn't last long and it wasn't too chaotic. I enjoyed picking things so much that I ended up spending over 500 baht before I knew it! Overall, I really like it and it's great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Passakorn Schuaphudee

sample_reviews_en.text: "I bought shio bread and found black mold after taking one bite, making it inedible. However, after informing the store and receiving a full refund, I am grateful for their responsibility. I hope they will conduct stricter quality control checks for customer safety."
sample_reviews_en.author: Do Ap

sample_reviews_en.text: The cake was good, but the macarons had assorted colored shells, yet all had the same filling. I'm not sure what kind of quality control issue it slipped through, or if it was just leftover filling scraps that were piped into the box and sold. Not okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: eliza van

sample_reviews_en.text: Don't come here. The staff are rude, speak as if they don't want to talk, and have unwelcoming expressions. If you've come a long way, don't come. You'll be extremely disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: จ๋าชอบ โกหก

restaurants.name: ส้มตำภูไท
restaurants.address:

1466 Phibul Songkhram Rd, Wong Sawang, Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Isaan food tends to be on the sweet side.
I ordered many dishes, but only the pork larb and sweet liver were edible. They were quite sweet when they first arrived, so I had to tell them that the next dishes shouldn't be sweet.
The grilled beef was okay.
You can see the grilled pork neck and grilled intestines in the pictures.
The grilled intestines were surprisingly sweet; I've never had grilled intestines like that before.
The papaya salad was also okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: LL

sample_reviews_en.text: The first time I ate there, I was very impressed. I sat down to eat around 7 PM and it wasn't hot. The food was delicious and not expensive at all. I ordered the papaya salad with fermented fish and it was very spicy and delicious. The grilled pork neck was tender and tasty. The spicy and sour pork waterfall and the grilled chicken were delicious. I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Milli

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here, I don't usually write reviews, but this place was delicious! Especially the papaya salad with fermented crab and fish sauce, it was incredibly flavorful. The price was good too. The owner was friendly and had a great attitude. I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: chutipon boonsen

sample_reviews_en.text: It was as delicious as the reviews said! The dipping sauce for the pork neck was amazing, spicy and flavorful. The pork neck itself was excellent. The larb with skin was perfect. The papaya salad was delicious and spicy. I'll definitely go back again!
sample_reviews_en.author: MMAY20

sample_reviews_en.text: Isaan restaurant near King Mongkut's University of Technology North Bangkok. Recommended: delicious som tum (papaya salad), salted fried chicken, and pork gaeng om (spicy pork curry).
sample_reviews_en.author: Fon Watcharee

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious. I recommend it. My recommended dish is the spicy crab salad with fermented fish sauce – it's incredibly tasty!
sample_reviews_en.author: คันธรัตน์ พระหันธงชัย

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious. I recommend the stir-fried minced meat salad and the incredibly flavorful papaya salad with fermented crab.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thammajak Prahantongchai

sample_reviews_en.text: I recommend Som Tum Phutai restaurant if you happen to be passing by King Mongkut's University of Technology North Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukanya Kotabin

restaurants.name: Secret Restaurant
restaurants.address:

916 จอมพล Khwaeng Chom Phon, Khet Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious I almost cried! The best meal I had in Thailand! A truly perfect restaurant! Pad Thai is amazing! The staff's recommendations were spot on! 😭👍 I decided to stop halfway through my meal to give it a five-star review. I'll definitely come back if I'm in the area again. Everyone should come and eat to their heart's content! I absolutely love Thailand! 🇹🇭🍴🥇
sample_reviews_en.author: 邱意涵

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's located a short walk from Saphan Khwai station towards Chatuchak Weekend Market.

I was glad I went into the restaurant.

The wine prices are reasonable.

Price tags are attached to the wine bottles, making it easy to choose.

They seem to offer wine tastings occasionally.

The food was delicious; the steak was perfectly cooked.

The pasta was also excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: 鈴木勇一

sample_reviews_en.text:
This wine shop has an incredible selection of French and Italian wines.

So you can buy wine and also have dinner there.
Our dishes were very good and beautifully presented.
The owner gave us a very warm welcome and was delighted that we were French.
A great place to eat near Chatuchak, the BTS Skytrain, or Don Mueang Airport.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris ALEX

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Thai food was beautifully presented, perfectly prepared, and had just the right amount of spiciness – I was very satisfied.

The second floor was quiet, and the air conditioning worked well, making for a cool and comfortable dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cow Sheep

sample_reviews_en.text: It was impossible to order a glass of wine! The staff didn't speak English and didn't bring the beer we ordered either. To top it all off, the owner gave us a hard time because we were waiting for a taxi outside the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Harry

sample_reviews_en.text: Authentic Thai cuisine boasts rich and intense flavors, offering a wide variety of dishes including beef, pork, and venison, all expertly prepared with bold and spicy notes. Choose your wine pairing to complement your meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wimwp D

sample_reviews_en.text: It looks like a liquor store from the outside, but inside it offers a variety of delicious food. The food is great, the service is friendly, and the atmosphere is relaxed – definitely a place worth visiting again! 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Eleanor yun

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant seems for wine sales but there is delicious food.  Seats are limited but environment is fine.  Spring roll and deep fried chicken are delicious. Deep fried pork is crispy.  Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ho Eric

restaurants.name: อาบอบบาร์
restaurants.address:

Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We had some wonderful evenings here! The atmosphere was always lively and friendly, with great live music and lots of locals enjoying themselves. The bands were excellent and really made the evening special. The staff were welcoming, the drinks were reasonably priced, and everyone was having a great time. It was a nice place to relax, listen to live music and enjoy a real Thai night out or celebrate a birthday. We will definitely come back. Highly recommended if you are looking for live music and friendly people. Absolutely fantastic Thai Bar!
sample_reviews_en.author: Susani

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a nice atmosphere and was crowded on a Saturday. The live music in the early evening was good. The food is on the expensive side; these two dishes cost 240 baht. Families would probably enjoy it. The food was a bit slow to come out, but overall the service was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tuaytoon.orangebear

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to a local hot spot on Friday and the live performance was the best. It's a place I want to keep to myself and the food is delicious. I want to go there again next time I visit Thailand. The person performing the live performance is also good at singing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jung

sample_reviews_en.text: This place has a great vibe! You can sit here for a long time. The atmosphere is chill, the music is just right, and the food is okay. It's perfect for chatting with friends. If you're looking for a comfortable place to hang out, I recommend giving it a try! 🍻
sample_reviews_en.author: nitikorn ebay shop

sample_reviews_en.text:
Almost every dish is delicious and the prices are affordable. There's live music on some days (probably Fridays).
Recommended dishes: French fries, fried rice, fried chicken wings with fish sauce, spicy pork rib soup.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eunseo P.

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is good, but the service flow needs improvement. We waited an hour for our first order, even though the place wasn't busy. Staff should improve their ability to answer questions and their service attitude.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ex Siren

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was as delicious as ever! 🐷🍅🥬🥕
The beer and drinks were refreshing 🍻, and every ice cube was perfectly chilled 😅. The musicians sang beautifully too. Love it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pig Brink

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious! I come back very often. The prices aren't overpriced. The music is great, and the atmosphere is nice, perfect for hanging out after work.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiratchaya Julniem

restaurants.name: LT Fish Restaurant Themallbangkapi
restaurants.address:

ชั้น3 Bangkapi - The Mall Bangkapi, Khwaeng Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Sichuan-style Chinese restaurant is amazing! The flavors are authentically spicy and the spices are distinctly fragrant in every dish 🌶️🔥

🥘 Food
The chili fish stew is the best! The broth is rich and intensely spicy with a true mala kick – you won't be able to stop eating it!
The braised pork belly is melt-in-your-mouth tender and perfectly balanced in flavor.
The stir-fried clams with spicy sauce and the grilled chicken are also delicious, with a full range of flavors.

🍽️ Quality
Fresh ingredients, every dish is cooked to order, and the portions are generous, perfect for sharing.

🏡 Atmosphere
The restaurant is beautiful, clean, and comfortable, suitable for both families and friends.

💬 Summary
If you love spicy Chinese food, you must try this restaurant! You won't be disappointed.
Delicious, intensely flavorful, and satisfying! 5 stars without hesitation! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

#LTfish #ChineseFood #Mala #TheMallBangkapi #FoodRecommendation
sample_reviews_en.author: สาธิต ฟองจัน

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd been here before and had a good impression, so I came again. However, the fish scales weren't properly scraped off for the fish fillets; my mouth was full of scales. In all my years of eating sauerkraut fish, I've never encountered a mouthful of fish scales. I was instantly disappointed 😞. Also, the sauerkraut fish included potato slices, which were spoiled. They were clearly sliced ​​and soaked in water for a long time beforehand, and then went bad. I hope the owner sees this and will make sure to prepare the fish properly in the future, so they can have more repeat customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Q Q

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pickled mustard greens fish soup, a signature dish of the restaurant, was delicious and didn't disappoint. The soup was refreshing, not too sour or salty, just right. The fish was very tender and bouncy. I highly recommend ordering it! Even the smallest size is almost too much for two people to finish.

The Typhoon Pork Ribs were amazing. Breaded and fried pork, served with breadcrumbs and chili, was fantastic with rice.

The stir-fried green beans had a standard Chinese restaurant flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanan J

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've eaten here many times, and I love LG Fish's pickled cabbage fish soup the most. It's my number one pickled cabbage fish soup restaurant. The flavors are so delicious to Thais. It's salty, sour, and spicy, and very refreshing. The other Chinese dishes are also good. There might be a few dishes that I'm not used to, but overall, they're delicious.

Even if you order the small size, you always get a lot. It might seem a bit pricey, but the portions and flavors are worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Montawach Lew

sample_reviews_en.text: Went on a Wednesday evening, there weren't many people, and the food was prepared very quickly. The fish stewed in pickled mustard greens was sour, salty, and rich, with a slight sesame oil aroma. It was refreshing to drink. The stir-fried eggplant and long beans were cooked perfectly and were very delicious. The stir-fried Sichuan pork belly was oily but not greasy, very delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: ่Gist Zera

sample_reviews_en.text:
- Fish soup with pickled mustard greens
- I felt the fish at this branch was slightly more fishy than at Eastville.
- The soup and vegetables were good as usual, the only issue was the fishy smell.
- The tissue box was packed too tightly, making it difficult to reach.
- The table was in a secluded corner, so staff didn't often pass by, and I had to walk to the counter to pay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pr Ch

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but I'd like to deduct points on the day I went. There weren't many customers, but we waited for our food for a long time. People who came later got their food first. After a while, a staff member came to inform us that our order hadn't entered the system. 😥 The staff were very enthusiastic in negotiating. Every dish we ordered was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: MAY KYN

sample_reviews_en.text: This famous restaurant serves fish soup with pickled mustard greens. The fish is fresh, and the broth is pleasantly sour. If it's too strong, you can ask for more broth. It's not too spicy. Another popular dish is the spicy fried chicken. It's a bit numbing but has just the right amount of spiciness. It pairs well with the soup and rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattarawan Wannabumphen (PlaKadJa)

restaurants.name: Wraptor
restaurants.address:

ปาก Soi Ari Samphan 2, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Came here for the first time tonight with my wife. Absolutely lovely little place. Great ambience, nice decor, great lighting giving a cool chill out kind of vibe. Service was awesome with super friendly staff and the food was just spectacular. We ordered a burrito with chicken and the beef taco combined with a margarita and a soft drink. Flavor full and piping hot the taco delivered hugely. Great taco and lovely seasoning, good amount of pulled beef and really good sauce to accompany it. The burrito wasn’t overly heavy and filled with rice but was a lighter option with ample veggies and chicken and again offered great taste and texture profiles. The margarita wasn’t huge but was the perfect accompaniment and was really well made. I’d definitely highly recommend this place and we will most certainly be coming back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrew “Andy” Davis

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently had a chance to sample their wraps and tacos. The presentation was great, and the ingredients seemed fresh, but I found the flavors a bit on the bland side. The wraps were satisfying, but they could have used a little more spice or seasoning to really bring out that bold Mexican flavor I was hoping for. Similarly, the tacos were nice, with a good balance of ingredients, but again, they didn’t have that punch of flavor I was expecting from a good Mexican dish.

The service was friendly, and the atmosphere was welcoming, making it a pleasant place to dine.

Overall, if you're looking for a simple, casual spot for wraps and tacos, this place is worth checking out. But if you’re after something with more kick, you might want to explore other options.
sample_reviews_en.author: Veeraya S.

sample_reviews_en.text: Bright and nicely decorated shop with good selection of craft beer, although no "local" as the sign claims... Wrapator is not really authentic, not does it pretend to be... I liked the queso dip served with light and crispy corn chips... Much less impressed with the chicken tacos, the shells were not fresh and they were topped with some kind of tasteless cheese lava sauce rather than real cheese... Several salsas available for reasonable prices but nothing spicy unfortunately... No margaritas available... Basically it's geared for Thais who like the idea of Mexican food but don't really know much about it... That being said, it's not a bad snack for the price
sample_reviews_en.author: chriskennedy100 Kennedy

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything we ordered was delicious. The taste was great, and the price and portion sizes were worth it. Food was served quickly, and the staff were welcoming and helpful. It's a small restaurant with only a few tables, so it's best to park in advance if you're coming with a large group. They have draft and imported beers. You can park in the alley across the street for free, but you need to get your parking ticket stamped by the restaurant.

Update (July 2025): This was my fourth visit. The food isn't as good as the first 2-3 times. The Nachos were oily and bland. The Fish and Chips, however, were still delicious and the portion size remained consistent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Annibale Mars

sample_reviews_en.text:
Would love to give this restaurant a better review as the food was amazing but let down by terrible service.

When I arrived it was quiet and the staff spent the entire time on their phone. Seems phones were more interesting as they forgot half my order.

By the time i left it had gotten reasonably busy and the front of house staff seemed have lost all organisation with people waiting to order and confusion with the staff. Ended up having get up and approach them to ask for my bill.

Food 10/10
Beer 6/10 (wasn't cold enough)
Service 1/10
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Morony

sample_reviews_en.text:
Margs were good (230thb/glass, reasonable price)
Staffs were not friendly AT ALL, like im dining for free or something?
Beef steak was rubber level chewy and wayyyyy overpriced for this beef quality.
The toilet… just don’t drink too much water while dining there. 🥹🤢👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻
(It was fine when we arrived, but later when there were more people coming in the toilet papers were all around the floor, the toilet itself was wet and yellow, we could smell the toilet at our table, very gross, worse than public ones.)
sample_reviews_en.author: WooRoo

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Wraptor cafe is smaller, brighter and less formal than its newer sibling Wraptor 2 (located just around the corner on Ari Soi 2). That makes it the perfect spot for lunch!

I had the Chicken Burritos, and asked for them “a little spicy”. And they delivered perfectly. Not only that, there was some very nice, super-spicy mayo with them so that I could increase the heat to exactly the level I wanted.

On top of this, the service was friendly, and the music was… um… groovy (!?!)
sample_reviews_en.author: Jonathan Tinnacher

sample_reviews_en.text: Stumble upon this Mexican restaurant while strolling for a place for lunch. Great Mexican musics, my experience with Mexican food  were all about spice and hot. What we had here at this cafe were somehow different from what i had before. Wrapped was great, veggies were all fresh and packed. Bavaria apple non algohol was very interesting. Nice and cozy corner. Big portions of dishes. If you are a Mexican food lover here is a descent place for one with a very reasonable price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Amazeme

restaurants.name: ข้าวต้มเหม่งจ๋ายโภชนา
restaurants.address:

782 Pracha Uthit Rd, Samsen Nok, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Meng Jai Rice Porridge (Green Chair) - A famous restaurant in this area.
The atmosphere is in a commercial building, with air-conditioned indoor seating and outdoor seating by the street. The tables and chairs are clean and simple stainless steel.
Free rice porridge, unlimited refills. Delicious with a variety of side dishes.
Signature dishes include: Crab Omelette (100฿), Crispy Pork with Chinese Kale (large, satisfying pieces of crispy pork),
Crispy Fried Snakehead Fish (crunchy and enjoyable), and Stir-fried Morning Glory (fragrant with the wok aroma).
The food has a balanced flavor, neither too salty nor too sweet.
Every dish is served in generous portions, offering great value for money.
The service is fast and friendly. A delicious and satisfying meal at a friendly price. 💚
Parking is available along the street.
sample_reviews_th.author: Sugar Berry

sample_reviews_th.text: So delicious! Generous portions at an affordable price. We ordered 4 dishes for 590฿. Rice porridge and plain rice are free. The service was great and lovely. This is my second time eating here and I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_th.author: Kawinthip Thojersin

sample_reviews_en.text:
As a congee (rice porridge) eater, if you sit in the air-conditioned room, you'll notice a musty smell, typical of older restaurants. The owner and staff are enthusiastic in serving customers.

The prices are reasonable and acceptable. Free, hot congee is a plus, which is great because other restaurants usually don't keep it warm.

Now, for the taste of the food, and this is important, the appearance differs significantly from typical restaurants. If it's a special recipe, it should be delicious, but it wasn't, and everything seemed to have an off-putting smell, possibly from the frying oil.

For example, the stir-fried preserved radish with egg was watery, which wasn't tasty. I expected it to be dry with a wok aroma. The stir-fried clams with chili paste had an off smell. And the stir-fried chives with tofu was unusual; they didn't fry the tofu, just served it as is – quite strange.

Overall, the prices are affordable. However, if you're a frequent congee eater, I'd say the taste needs improvement.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eak Brompton

sample_reviews_en.text: Overall, the food was delicious, especially the stir-fried kale with crispy pork, the minced pork soup with pickled cabbage, and the crab curry. The prices were good, and they gave generous portions of crab meat. For orders over 500 baht, they even gave free rice porridge and plain rice. The staff were also very helpful. However, be sure to double-check your bill when paying. Initially, they quoted 970 baht, but when I asked to see the bill, they immediately changed it to 890 baht. I'm not sure if they were distracted or not. Personally, I think the prices are quite reasonable. I hope the restaurant checks the bill carefully before quoting the total. And for those of you who go there, remember to double-check your bill!
sample_reviews_en.author: Mint Thanjira

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mengjai Rice Porridge Restaurant, opposite Makro.
We ordered 4-5 dishes: preserved olives, crispy pork belly with chili and salt, stir-fried cabbage with fish sauce, crab omelet, and minced pork with plum soup. We got free rice if our bill was over 500 baht. The taste was okay; nothing was particularly amazing, but it was enjoyable. It's a comfort food style restaurant. Most of the customers were families; it seems to be a regular spot for people in the area.
Importantly, the price is great. All this cost 620 baht, and we were completely full. The portions were generous, the service was good, and the food was served quickly. Recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Salin Amponnavarat

sample_reviews_en.text:
The portion sizes for the price are okay.
However, I wasn't very impressed with the stir-fried white chives with egg tofu. The egg tofu wasn't fried; it would have been tastier if it had been fried to a firmer surface. The taste was mediocre, and the first bite had a slightly strange smell, like garlic.

The stir-fried clams with chili paste had a slightly unpleasant smell. I could only eat two shells before stopping. The taste was okay, but the clams had a strong smell.

The spicy fried fish salad was the best of the three dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: นิษฐา ศิริอารยะพันธ์

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent. From the moment we sat down, the elderly couple running the restaurant were very friendly and smiling. They even recommended the daily specials. The food tasted great; I especially loved the stir-fried preserved olives. The prices weren't too high, averaging around 80 baht per dish. Rice porridge was free. I highly recommend this place! They even offer to pack up leftovers for you to take home. On my way out, I met three staff members who all said goodbye with big smiles – a truly impressive experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: MeMeen MyMind

sample_reviews_en.text: After reading the initial reviews, I almost hesitated to go in. But after tasting the food, it was better than I expected. The crab curry was amazing; the crab meat was in large, generous chunks, and the creamy curry was delicious. There was a strange smell, I'm not sure what it was, but it was tasty nonetheless. The Tom Yum soup was also excellent, and the stir-fried water spinach was fragrant. The staff were good at recommending dishes, provided great service, and were polite. I wasn't disappointed at all.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fuji Japanese Restaurant - Simple and Authentic

This place serves up honest, no-frills Japanese food with a focus on clean flavors. We tried a few dishes:

The tofu steak (100 THB) was simple but satisfying with its soft texture. Salmon teriyaki set (295 THB) had perfectly cooked fish, though the teriyaki sauce could have been bolder. Pork sukiyaki set (300 THB) hit the right balance of sweetness. The yakisoba (140 THB) stood out with its light, clean flavor.

Little details make this place interesting - hot ocha comes in a traditional metal jug while cold versions are bottled. There's even a robot waiter that brings your food, which is a fun touch. Our set meals end with a complimentary fruit salad pudding that's light and refreshing.

The food is straightforward Japanese comfort food done right. Prices are reasonable for the quality and portion sizes. I'd come back when craving simple, clean Japanese meals.
sample_reviews_en.author: leotrails

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ambiance and decor are beautiful both inside and out.
The service is attentive and the menu recommendations are good.
There's a wide variety of choices, and the quality and taste are worth the price.
Yesterday, I tried the pork sukiyaki set.
It's served in an earthenware pot.
It's not kept hot with a constant flame.
The advantage is that it doesn't burn your eyes or have a strong alcoholic smell.
However, it cools down a bit quickly, and the pork becomes tough faster.
But the highlight is the pot full of vegetables, including onions, Japanese scallions,
shiitake mushrooms, and bok choy, all in a sweet, savory, and well-balanced dark broth.
If you find it too rich, I recommend sprinkling chili peppers on your rice and dipping it in the sweet and spicy soy sauce – it's just right. Or you could use it as a dipping sauce.
Come and try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: sine merry

sample_reviews_en.text:
@ grand plaza rama 9, 10% service charge and 7% VAT added to the bill, however, this japanese restaurant can be considered value for money, as the seats are comfortable, spacious and in nice decor, menu offer varieties of choice of dishes/drinks (see photos), what is more, service is nice, efficient, and dishes are of high quality and delicious, i like ♥ especially the aburi salmon sushi here, almost order every time whenever i visit this restaurant! please note that actually this restaurant offer dishes at different price range, so it is suitable for more budget conscious customer as well (again you can spend sometime browsing its menu shown in my photos)

After an hour, the food arrived, but the rice in the sushi rolls was completely broken and messy. We asked them to remake it, but it was broken again. Honestly, even 5-baht sushi is well-made and beautiful, not this messy. I'm extremely disappointed. 😡😡

- PP 🌱

sample_reviews_en.text:

It’s a small detail, but it would make the experience even better. Overall, still a nice place with good food and service.

Taste - The duck basil stir-fry was delicious. The noodle soup had a flavorful and aromatic broth, but it was a little too sweet. I added some chili and chili vinegar to balance the sweetness.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall Review

A good value Thai restaurant in Terminal 21

Food

It is a place where you can enjoy Thai food casually. They offer dishes that suit Korean palates well. The taste is decent.

Price
The pork fried rice is 119 baht. The price is affordable for a restaurant located in Terminal 21. Since the restaurant does not sell drinks separately, I bought a beverage from the shop next door to enjoy with my meal.

Service
You can think of it like a food court in a department store; however, since it is located in the back rather than inside the restaurant, you have to go pick up your food yourself after ordering. Most of the staff are male. They provide standard service.

Unlike a food court, the restaurant does not have its own seating area; you have to eat at a shared table. Even though I went just before dinner time started, there were plenty of seats available. This might be because it was a weekday.
sample_reviews_en.author: Botacu

sample_reviews_en.text:
PAD Thai Food, located in the LG level of Terminal 21 in Bangkok, offers a convenient dining option within the bustling food court.
As part of this shared space, you'll find communal tables, making it a lively spot to enjoy your meal. The Pad Thai served here is truly delightful, showcasing authentic flavors that are sure to please. Additionally, the prices are budget-friendly, making it an attractive choice for those looking for a tasty meal without breaking the bank.
Overall, PAD Thai Food is a great place for a quick bite, allowing you to refuel and continue exploring the vibrant offerings of Terminal 21.
