..........................
sample_reviews_en.author: Osiris Pluto

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice soup at this restaurant is delicious. It's not fishy. You can choose between grouper and sea bass. I really like the oysters. The sauce is tasty and spicy. The soup is clear and not salty. The mixed salad is delicious. I ate it all. You can park on the side of the road. If you come on a Saturday or Sunday, you can park in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nit Cha

sample_reviews_en.text:
This fish porridge place is one of our favorites. This time, the price felt a bit high, but it's delicious nonetheless. You should definitely try it; you won't be disappointed.

The downsides are that the shop is old and there's no parking; you have to hope to find a spot in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vadhanabong Pek Suvarnadhamma

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! I wanted to go to Yaowarat today, but the prices were too high, so I changed my mind and looked elsewhere. I was very impressed! The prices are very reasonable, easily comparable to Yaowarat. I wish you great success and good fortune! I'll definitely visit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: centimeter KARN

sample_reviews_en.text:
This long-established fish porridge shop serves a clear, not-too-salty broth, firm and fresh-tasting fish with no fishy smell, and a delicious seafood dipping sauce. You can easily finish the whole bowl.

The price is reasonable for the quality, sometimes even considered cheap.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karn Santidhananon

sample_reviews_en.text: The fish porridge was delicious, not fishy at all. The restaurant has been open for a very long time. I wish it were more well-known. It's much tastier and more reasonably priced than the trendy restaurants these days.
sample_reviews_en.author: BaanPorpeang

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice porridge was very delicious. The fish was fresh, the shellfish was fresh, and the shrimp were big and bouncy. It was worth the price. I slurped up the whole bowl of soup.
sample_reviews_en.author: ลิษา ศลิษา

restaurants.name: canteen19.bkk
restaurants.address:

19/31 Sathu Pradit 57 Yaek 3 Bang Phong Phang, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very impressive restaurant! Great value for money and I highly recommend 👍🏼.

Local Thai ingredients served in Italian style. All the food we had today was very awesome, fresh ingredients and very tasteful. We had a few dishes today and everything was perfect. Chef was very friendly and welcome as well as all the staffs. Understandably that staffs are still quite new so still need some refined training but all in all they were good and I have no complaints at all.

We think they could charge customer slightly more (and trust me, I don’t normally say this). Food portion was great and you can enjoy number of dishes without breaking the bank certainly.

Drinks were ok, they don’t have wine by glass so we didn’t try the wine. But we did try glasses of standard cocktail which were good as well. Choice of deserts is limited but we went there for the seafood so that’s alright.

The only downside (which I hope the Chef really consider this) is the chair! 😅. Chair was a bit uncomfortable and I think we would enjoy talking and drinking a lot more (since overall environment was great already) if the chair is better. Hope they think about replacing the chair.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nat Wongsuryrat

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went there as a group of 12, so it felt like we had the whole place to ourselves! The atmosphere was cozy and intimate — kind of like a chef’s table but with a home-cooked touch. There’s parking available, which is always a plus.

The food was amazing — Italian style with a focus on seafood. Every dish was delicious and perfectly suited to Thai taste buds. My favorite was definitely the Gambas — their signature shrimp dish. I’ve never seen any restaurant use shrimp head butter like this before. It was so flavorful! Even the complimentary bread was great.

For dessert, I had the homemade vanilla gelato with vanilla olive oil — it sounded strange at first but turned out surprisingly good. The flavors blended together so well!

Before coming, I saw some reviews saying the food was just okay and the service wasn’t great, but personally, I had a really good experience. Everyone in our group enjoyed both the food and the service.

Would definitely love to come back again (if we can manage to get a reservation 😂)!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattida Yolpol

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall, the taste is good, the prices are reasonable, and the service is attentive and caring.
The sashimi menu is outstanding, and almost all the appetizers are good. The menu is diverse, especially the seafood.
However, the main dishes, particularly the meat dishes, could use some improvement.

The restaurant is nicely decorated and clean.

I appreciate that the restaurant provides information about parking in advance.
I believe that if the location had more convenient parking, it would be even harder to get a reservation.

Personal rating: 8.25/10
(Remarks: *Personal opinion* scale
*** Below 7 means I wouldn't go back again.
7️⃣ The taste is okay, acceptable if someone invites me.
8️⃣ Delicious, would go again occasionally.
9️⃣ Very delicious, would highly recommend.
🔟🏆 Extremely delicious, would go again often, would be a regular restaurant.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Phattaraphon “Boom” H.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall food is yummy as other reviews suggest especially prawn arrabbiata which is Thai level spicy and I love it.

However, for me personally some dishes are missing some detail that can enhance the flavor. For example, crab avocado salad is good… avocado ice cream at the top is creamy and sweet and the crab salad is fresh and a bit salty. So for me I was expecting some tangy flavor to complement this maybe some lemon zest or simply just a slice of lemon.

I expect carpaccio to be cold but it is served at normal room temperature. It is good but can be better if it’s cold.

Pizza TC is burnt at the bottom making the taste bitter but overall it’s delicious for cheese lovers for sure.

Service is great nothing to complain. Parking is available in walking distance from the resto.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vasinee Piyatrueng

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here, after booking about 3 months in advance. Personally, I don't know if I had high expectations, but today's meal wasn't amazing. The dishes I really liked were the crab avocado gelato salad and the grouper carpaccio – they were fresh, flavorful, and well-balanced. However, the squid backing pasta could have had more flavor, and the squid with eggs Puttanesca was just okay. Nothing really stood out. Maybe it's just the Italian style of food – mostly bland and salty. But the seafood was all incredibly fresh. The 5% service charge was a bit annoying, though. The service was just average. Sitting at a long table shared with other people made me feel a little awkward.
sample_reviews_en.author: Parinda Klangjun

sample_reviews_en.text:
Canteen 19 is a reservation-only restaurant offering a wide variety of fusion dishes. The flavors are quite impressive — each plate is thoughtfully prepared and beautifully presented. However, given the rather high price point, my expectations were set quite high, which left a tiny room for improvement. Overall, I’d rate the food 4.5 out of 5.

The service, on the other hand, was excellent — attentive, friendly, and professional. The atmosphere feels warm and welcoming, making it a pleasant place to enjoy a relaxed meal. There’s also sufficient parking space for customers, which is a plus.

A great spot for those who appreciate creative cuisine and cozy vibes!
sample_reviews_en.author: Banpot Jantarathada

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, reasonably priced, and the key ingredients are unique. The overall flavor of the food is considered strong Western food, but I like it.

The owner and staff are lovely, and the restaurant has a homey, lovely atmosphere. I'll definitely be back.

The star dish is the grouper jaw. It's so good, the meat is firm, and the tory potatoes served with it are also excellent. The beautiful rock mussels are similar to clams, but larger. They're fresh and delicious. Dipping the bread in the sauce is the best.

Everything is delicious, really. The avocado salad, crab meat, tiger prawns, and mango salad are all my favorites.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sukhumarn Lertpanyaroj (Benz)

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's not delicious. If you want Italian food at this price, Sukhumvit or other cities have plenty of delicious options. For cool fusion food, Chef May's is better at Rama 6. Grandma's pasta is also much better. Ngam Ngam is the best. It can't be compared to anything else.

The quality of the ingredients is poor. They're not fresh. The noodles don't meet your expectations.

The service is good. There's only one long table, and everyone in the restaurant is sitting together.

I wouldn't recommend it and I won't go again. If you want to believe the ratings, go try it for yourself. If you like it, that's up to you!
sample_reviews_en.author: K T

restaurants.name: ร้านครัวบ้านช้าง
restaurants.address:

35/3 Chaloem Phrakiat Rama 9 Alley, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
✨️Lunchtime on a hot day like this calls for a cool, air-conditioned place to eat. Today, I have one restaurant that fits the bill: "Krua Baan Chang" (Elephant Kitchen) 🐘, serving single-dish meals, steaks, spaghetti, and cold drinks.

🛷Parking: You can park inside the restaurant's fence. There aren't many parking spaces, but the tables aren't too crowded. My favorite dish here is the spaghetti with bacon and dried chilies. The flavor is great, the noodles are perfect, and it's not too spicy – ​​I can eat it comfortably! 🍴🍝

#tbackpackp
*******************************************
♥️This review is based solely on my personal opinion. You have to try it yourself to see if you agree with me! 😁
******************************************
Please follow me! 🤭

📌Facebook & IG: tbackpackp
sample_reviews_en.author: TbackpackP (Ton)

sample_reviews_en.text:
I used to frequent this restaurant when my daughter was studying at Palina.
Today, I felt like having it again, so I stopped by with my daughter.
The food here is well-prepared and flavorful, not too strong, but you can specify your preferred level of spiciness. Today, my daughter ordered the pork katsudon, which was delicious. I ordered the fried sea bass with fresh chili, which was also incredibly delicious. The price is reasonable for the quality. If you're passing by, stop and try it! They also serve coffee and desserts. The owner is a chef who graduated from a renowned institution.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarun ch คุณพ่อ2i

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted delicious, but the staff seemed inattentive. When they added ice, they spilled some in the glass and didn't refill it, leaving only a little ice left in the glass. Another staff member brought the food and placed the spoon on the table, wrapped in tissue paper but not properly, instead placing it on the plate.
sample_reviews_en.author: วลัยพรรณ ขุนเสน

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is delicious, the food is excellent, the taste is great, the chef is very skilled. They also have desserts, which are also delicious, and coffee. I really like this restaurant. There's limited parking. It was so delicious I forgot to take pictures! 5555
sample_reviews_en.author: phawat2001 ss (menn)

sample_reviews_en.text: I've ordered delivery several times, and also ate at the restaurant. The single-dish meals are delicious and use quality ingredients. The cakes are light, easy to eat, and not too sweet. The prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dreamer

sample_reviews_en.text:
I haven't been here in a long time...

Today was a complete experience! Delicious food, quality ingredients, fragrant coffee, lovely staff, and a chill atmosphere.
I was so happy.

This place is a must-visit...
sample_reviews_en.author: Rathapong Pradithapong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and affordable, and it's close to my workplace.
The desserts and coffee are also delicious, especially the coffee cake :)
The owner and the person taking orders are very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Duck Buaykem

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and of good quality.
But the parking is "terrible." Sometimes, I decide not to come. I'm too lazy to back up. If the parking could be improved, it would be great.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panavat Baron

restaurants.name: หมูสะเต๊ะ เม่งเส็ง (เจ้าเก่า)
restaurants.address:

280 2-3 หมู่18 Suk Sawat Rd, Tambon Bang Phueng, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🐖🥓 Meng Seng Pork Satay is an old, established shop in the Phra Pradaeng area. I've been eating here for decades, and the taste is still as delicious as ever.

🥓 We found them at the Ploen Dee Market in Bang Khun Thian.
🐖 The taste is just as delicious as the original branch (the original branch is still open!).
🐖 A small set of pork satay (10 skewers) and one slice of toasted bread costs 105 baht.
🥓 The pork satay is tender, grilled to perfection with a fragrant aroma, and brushed with coconut milk for added richness and flavor.
😋 This shop's pork pieces are larger than most other shops, and they separate the fat from the meat, so those who don't like fat can enjoy just the lean meat.
💦 The dipping sauce is rich and flavorful, served with crispy bread. And the pickled vegetables are great for cutting through the richness.

🙏 Thank you all ♥️
for clicking "Follow"!

YouTube 🎬 Paopao Studio
TikTok 🎙️ Paopao Studio
Wongnai 🍭 Paopao Studio

#StreetFood #PaopaoStudio
sample_reviews_en.author: Paopao Studio

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious!!!
You absolutely can't miss the pork knuckle satay!
Even though I was already full, I still ordered a small plate.

The pork is tender and lean.
The marinade is perfectly seasoned.

Normally, we think flat pork knuckles would be dry,
but this was incredibly juicy and succulent. Every bite was pure bliss!

The dipping sauce is amazing – not spicy, but flavorful.
It complements the pork perfectly. Ten out of ten!
The pickled vegetables were a little lacking in dressing,
but the cucumber and onion portions were generous.

The small set is 98 baht for 14 skewers. The price isn't overly expensive.
I was just surprised to see a 15-skewer set for 108 baht.
Why add one more skewer?

But it's worth it for the deliciousness! 💙💙
Definitely coming back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lostwith Teresa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tuesday, January 28, 2025, 7:09 PM
Dine-in (at the restaurant)

Ordered: 10 skewers of pork satay, 90 baht
Special request: Requested extra fat (pork fat)

Preparation: Served on a stainless steel tray. The satay skewers had a little coconut milk drizzled on them. The pickled vegetables were okay, plentiful and not too sweet or sour. The dipping sauce was also plentiful, enough for 10 skewers.

Taste: Overall, very delicious (but the curry powder smell was a little too strong, though acceptable).

Texture: Soft and delicious.

Value: Overall, the satay skewers had large pieces of meat, commensurate with the price. Good value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arnon Techathanawat

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the best satay pork I've ever had. It's an old shop that my dad used to buy for me often when I was a kid. Back then it was a shophouse, now it's a roadside stall. The taste is just as delicious as ever. The pork is thick, tender, and large pieces, grilled to perfection with a fragrant aroma. The fat is separated, so those who don't like fat can enjoy it comfortably, and those who like fat can have it on their hands. The peanut dipping sauce is rich and fragrant, leaving a lasting impression. Whenever I'm in the Rama 2 area, I always stop by to buy Meng Seng satay pork to take home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ayumi Mumu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, delicious, delicious! The best in Phra Pradaeng!
I especially loved the liver satay; it was juicy, with the perfect balance of salty and sweet.
The pork satay was also delicious, grilled to perfection with a wonderful aroma.

I'm not sure where to park for cars; we parked our motorbike on the side of the alley.

There's a noodle shop and a fried pork rice shop nearby, so you can order from them to eat together.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alice Chan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The liver satay exceeded my expectations! The pork satay was also delicious. I bought two cups of tofu with milk, but they were terrible, poor quality, and I threw them away. Nobody would eat them. Selling them with the satay might damage their reputation.
But I will definitely go back to buy the liver satay again, it was amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Juntra Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! The pork is tender, the dipping sauce is fantastic – not too sweet. The pickled vegetables are also tasty, but there's not much of them. Whether you buy 10 or 15 skewers, you get exactly the same amount. However, I don't like that they put the pork fat on top, as I don't eat it. Otherwise, I would give it 5 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Porntip Ming

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate this on March 18, 2019. 7 baht per skewer. Delicious. Each skewer has a small square piece of pork fat at the end. It's good because if you want to eat the fat, you can; if you don't want to eat the fat, you don't have to. They're clearly separated.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rungtip por

restaurants.name: Super Beef Noodle Soup
restaurants.address:

287 Soi Suan Mali 1, Wat Thep Sirin, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a street food cart with seating on the sidewalk. Free tea is available. They only serve rice noodles, and preparation is quite slow. The highlight is the tender, fresh beef in the noodles. There is no parking; you'll have to find parking in nearby parking garages around Worachak.
sample_reviews_en.author: Poramet Boonnumsirikij

sample_reviews_en.text: This old shop opposite the central hospital sells food at night. The prices are moderate, 60-80 baht. Overall, the food is tasty. The braised beef here is lean, which some people might like, but personally, I found it a bit dry. It would be better if it had a little more fat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanin Makarukpinyo

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is good, the stewed beef and meatballs are delicious. They're open in the evenings on weekdays and Saturdays. On Sundays, they open from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM, but they're usually almost sold out by noon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Surachate Chutima

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant uses an old family recipe. I've been eating here for almost 20 years, and the taste hasn't changed. It's delicious, fresh, and the unique soup recipe is incredibly tasty! 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Prapas N

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of the best beef noodle soups I've ever had, but parking is a bit difficult. The tender beef, fresh beef, and meatballs are heaven for beef lovers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Khanittha Thongkorn

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodle soup has a fragrant broth that needs a little seasoning to your liking. The broth has a mild flavor, and the meatballs are nice and tender.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prasarn Wongwirojruk

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodle soup and beef stew are delicious and inexpensive. The restaurant is located by the roadside, so finding parking can be a bit difficult.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manutpong Tepunwong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The beef meatballs with crispy edges are as delicious as ever.
The soup is fragrant. It's an old, established shop. I forgot to take a picture.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paphawin Papatsiri

restaurants.name: เฝอเวิน
restaurants.address:

552 รามคำแหง 24 แยก 24 Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I highly recommend this place! Experience luxury and glamour at an affordable price. We ordered a set meal and the chef himself brought the dish out to us! We were so surprised and amazed by the presentation that we forgot to talk to him. When I saw the menu, I wondered if it was just pretty pictures, but it wasn't! It was beautiful and delicious. The staff were also very friendly and got along well with the kids, chatting, playing, and constantly refilling water and clearing plates. The restaurant is clean, beautifully decorated, spacious, and right by the road. The prices are reasonable. You absolutely must try the pho; the soup is amazing! However, they don't provide chili oil or Thai-style fish sauce with the Vietnamese noodle soup (Goi Cuon). The fried rice was a bit dry for my taste.🤣 And I just discovered that fried dough sticks (Patongko) are incredibly delicious with pho! 😍😍😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Paowara Kang

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, three of us ordered shrimp wrapped in sugarcane, a large set of Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage), fresh spring rolls, fried spring rolls, grilled pork, fried chicken wings, and shrimp crackers. Everything was delicious except the fried chicken wings, which were a bit bland. I was indifferent to that dish. My favorite was the Nem Nuong; it was exceptionally well-made and unlike any other. I highly recommend trying it... For parking, park at Gate 4 and walk over. If you look on Google Maps, you'll see two restaurants, Pho Van and Pho Wen, located close together. They are actually the same restaurant; just go to Pho Van, which is right by the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kunchit Dilokwanich

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’m a true Vietnamese food lover, but this restaurant was surprisingly disappointing. I ordered only three dishes and they still forgot one. The fried dough sticks came undercooked and cold inside, and they were served so late that my pho was already finished—without even a single apology.

The staff were unfriendly and unwelcoming. When I asked for coffee menu recommendations, they showed an unpleasant attitude. No shared plates or cutlery were provided until I asked, I truly felt there was nothing welcoming about this place, both in taste and in service.

Wanida Vongsena
sample_reviews_en.author: wanida vongsena

sample_reviews_en.text: The actual food differed slightly from the pictures in the menu. I was surprised by how small the portion was; it was gone in just a few bites. The taste was delicious, but the price was too high. There were no free fresh vegetables like other Vietnamese restaurants. The new restaurant has a nice atmosphere, located in Pure Place on Ramkhamhaeng Road. It wasn't crowded, but the air conditioning wasn't very effective.
sample_reviews_en.author: SIRIPEN T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant has a very distinct style; simple, elegant, and sophisticated.
I have to commend the service staff; they were very neat, making me feel a little embarrassed for coming in wearing shorts and flip-flops, haha.
As for the food, the Vietnamese spring rolls were amazing, and there are many other dishes worth trying. The prices are reasonable. This is one of my top favorite restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: Folk Song' Scales

sample_reviews_en.text:
First time after Covid and I have to say "WoW".
👍Attractive and better ambiance after  renovation and expansion the restaurant from 1 building to 2.
🍜 Pho is great as always. No doubt.
👍 Love the idea of using restaurant 's balcony for food delivery guys.
😭 Sad to know that no reward member points anymore.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joop

sample_reviews_en.text: Vietnamese restaurant behind Ramkamheng University. I enjoyed the Vietnamese food here! All of the dishes are well prepared and really tasty, ingredient are fresh. The soup is superb. Good service and clean place overall. I will definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thiendanai Bus Sermboonpaisarn

sample_reviews_en.text: This Vietnamese restaurant serves delicious and clean food at moderate prices. Every time I come, I have to order Nem Nuong (grilled pork skewers), Shrimp Wrapped in Sugarcane, and Salted Chicken. The staff are friendly and polite.
sample_reviews_en.author: ศักดิ์เดช สุริยะพรชัยกุล

restaurants.name: Rice & Noodles Express (The PARQ)
restaurants.address:

Ratchadaphisek Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
— Quick, Reliable, and Unpretentious —
Rice & Noodles Express at The PARQ is a chain diner that delivers what its name promises: straightforward comfort food at a fair price.
I had fried pork with rice and a spicy soup (115 THB) along with a longan drink (45 THB). The food was tasty and satisfying, served promptly—helped, no doubt, by the fact that the venue was almost empty. That quietness robbed the place of any real charm, but it did mean attentive service and no waiting.
If you’re looking for ambience, look elsewhere. But if what you need is a quick, reliable meal without fuss, this spot gets the job done—and does it well for the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leo Grey

sample_reviews_en.text: Fantastic atmosphere, the Cafe decor is beautiful and so clean. Food and drink prices are comparable to street food but the quality is so much better with lots of choices. Staff are friendly and welcoming. Portion sizes are great and the food is as good as any expensive restaurant. Highly recommend this Cafe, it is probably the best I've been to in Bangkok, this is my third visit! Give it a try, I'm sure you won't be disappointed 🫠
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Howe

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant was open during Songkran when all the other shops in The Park were closed. The menu is diverse, living up to its name, offering both rice and noodle dishes. I ordered the crispy pork basil instant noodles; the basil aroma was fragrant, the flavor was spicy, and they also provided a refreshing broth. The restaurant is clean, the service is polite, and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: N. W.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The chicken rice was delicious. The chicken was tender and not dry. The rice was cooked well, fragrant and soft. The chicken soup was well-rounded and easy to swallow.
The yen ta fo was good.
The beef noodles had a rich, slightly salty soup.
The appetizers, like the fried dumplings and grilled meatballs, were also good.
Comparing the price to the quality, it was excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: BHUMIBHAT ISARANKURA

sample_reviews_en.text:
The noodles are delicious, the thin noodles are chewy and soft, and the braised pork is tender and tasty. However, I felt the portion was a bit small (or maybe I'm just fat!). A bowl costs 90 baht and wasn't enough to fill me up.

While the taste and quality are commendable, it's important to mention that the portion sizes offered could be more generous T_T
sample_reviews_en.author: Bangkok Stray dog

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner, an elderly lady, was so lovely. Seeing that I was with my young child, she had her staff set up a table on the sofa for the little one and even cut the chicken into portions suitable for children. I'll definitely stop by again next time I bring my child for vaccinations.
sample_reviews_en.author: P K

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is moderately flavorful, not too spicy. The fresh chili noodles take a bit of time because they are made fresh for every bowl. However, the price is a bit expensive at 135 baht. The owner and his team are very good at providing service and taking care of orders.
sample_reviews_en.author: Surachai In

sample_reviews_en.text: A new and inexpensive lunch place in The PARQ building. They have a very simple menu, but tasty and fresh, and reasonably priced. Best is Fried and Boiled Khao Man Gai, which comes with clear soup. There is one server who can speak English …
sample_reviews_en.author: Thulana Fernando

restaurants.name: Cafe De Bua
restaurants.address:

327, 1 Thanon Ram Buttri, Khwaeng Talat Yot, Khet Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had drinks and dinner at this establishment, and the bill was a very disappointing experience. In addition to the cost of our food and drinks, we were charged a supplement for each course, another for the drinks, a venue fee, and an additional charge for paying by card.
It's true that they informed us about the card payment surcharge at the time of payment, although we were already aware of it. However, what we found unacceptable was the number of surcharges they apply to practically everything. In the end, it felt like they were trying to inflate the bill with unreasonable extra charges. Our experience was very negative, and we won't be returning.
sample_reviews_en.author: JUDITH SAN MILLÁN JÁÑEZ

sample_reviews_en.text: Wouldn’t recommend, came at lunch time, asked for two bruschettas one with pesto. They said they didn’t have pesto which was fine. Then she came back and said she can’t do bruschetta. We would have gone somewhere else but she’d already made us drinks. Asked for just french fries instead, she says okay then two minutes later says they can’t do them either? I said what can you do and she didn’t know! Very disappointed, had drinks, paid and went somewhere else
sample_reviews_en.author: Tasha Moore

sample_reviews_en.text:
This man opposite kicked a poor cat on the street today. Just drop kicked it because it was near his stand, then laughed.
However this bar is really lovely! I think they sometimes serve fake Chang (they fill the empty bottles with non-Chang) so be sure to watch them open the bottle. However they are really nice, and it’s cheap & good location.
sample_reviews_en.author: Genevieve F

sample_reviews_en.text:
Reasonable prices, very good service. They have a very wide selection of food and drinks. The food was good but the drinks were delicious.
Hope they'll keep it this way when they'll have 1k+ reviews, that's why I gave a generous tip, to show you can make good money without trying to scam people.
I'll be back for sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Flo Rentin

sample_reviews_en.text: Really nice spot for some drinks, stayed here for a few hours. Had some great chilled live music in the afternoon. Also had lots of games to play - we played dobble for about 2 hours! Great service and drinks selection here. Started raining a bit but plenty of seating inside
sample_reviews_en.author: Leo van Galen

sample_reviews_en.text: A very good restaurant with friendly staff and a lovely interior. On some evenings, there's a band playing relaxing music. Price-wise, it's one of the most affordable restaurants in the area. I recommend all the shakes and cocktails.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mattia Grossi

sample_reviews_en.text: I was tired from walking around in the heat during the day, so I enjoyed a beer. I was grateful that they served it during daylight hours, and the price was very reasonable. I was able to relax in an elegant atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: 雨露市徳雄

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is good; you should go for the live band and the ambiance, but definitely NOT for the food!

The photos don't quite match the dishes... And the English translation isn't accurate... Good luck!
sample_reviews_en.author: Brez BYM

restaurants.name: เจ๊มะลิเป็ดย่าง
restaurants.address:

74 Sri Kuankan, Talat, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I went based on reviews, and it was truly delicious. No gamey or fishy smell. Highly recommended ✅ The price is reasonable 😀 The duck is huge, with a wonderful aroma. Great as a snack, a side dish, or as part of a variety of other exquisite dishes for parties and gatherings. It's not far; just use the map and you'll be there in no time.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐพล สมบูรณ์ (Yakultz)

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! We loved the roast duck the most. The meat was tender and the price was reasonable at 320 baht per duck. The seller was lovely. Highly recommended! If you're passing through Phra Pradaeng, buy some as a souvenir; the recipient will definitely be impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumo Eiei

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a shop selling roasted duck and braised duck. It's located in front of the Phra Pradaeng ferry pier. There's no seating; it's takeout only. The ducks are large and the price is good. The taste is excellent, fragrant and tender. The owner is very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Witoon Vorapoonsuki

sample_reviews_en.text: We don't offer dine-in service. You have to call ahead to order and then come pick it up. The shop is located right in front of the pier, directly opposite the district office. You can park before or in front of the shop to pick up your order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suchart Veerawuhttipong

sample_reviews_en.text: The duck meat was excellent and the price was very reasonable. The dipping sauce was delicious, and best of all, the vendor's service was fantastic. She was cheerful and friendly. The good smile and excellent service made the drive worthwhile.
sample_reviews_en.author: TITAN 09

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to support them today. The duck was large and worth the price. The meat was tender, and the dipping sauce was delicious and flavorful, with no gamey smell—exactly as advertised. It lives up to its reputation! 👍👍👍💜
sample_reviews_en.author: ประนอม ลี้รักสิทธิ์

sample_reviews_en.text: The braised duck was delicious, the dipping sauce (vinegar-based) was tasty, the duck wasn't small, and the price was very good. It remained delicious even after being refrigerated. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: DS KTO

sample_reviews_en.text: I haven't been able to eat it lately. I finish work late and miss out because the duck is always sold out. This has happened several times already. I have to get to eat it next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: suphat fuangphayap

restaurants.name: Barbali Bistro
restaurants.address:

58 Phra Athit Rd, Chana Songkhram, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: At barbali, there will never be a dull moment. Enjoy the extremely favor Thai food and a wide rage of beverage in a reasonable price on the first floor and buy something speak to you on the upstairs where the locally crafted products are featured. This place also serves as a venue for artist to display their works. Either come alone or hangout with your folks, the new vibes and the delighted moments can be infused here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nawapol Kunkeaw

sample_reviews_en.text: Art Gallery & Restaurant  in one place.  If you want to try Thai food from Mom's cooking, please stop to this place.  Please look around on the art object in this restaurant and you will find a piece for your collection.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krit Pnoi

sample_reviews_en.text: Truly excellent, refined Thai food at reasonable prices. Small and cozy, with a shop upstairs selling wonderful items of all kinds, from clothing to ornaments, all strictly handcrafted.
sample_reviews_en.author: luisa cocco

sample_reviews_en.text: Really good food and the atmosphere was calm, which can be appreciated in this very living city. However the price are à little bit high in my opinion. Will Côme back there anyway
sample_reviews_en.author: Pierre DUNAND

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was a little slow but the food was great. Big selection, seems like the local crowd enjoys it too. I'd come back
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Van Derven

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent Thai + AC: the latter drew me in out of the heat, but didn’t make me wish I had a coat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Barrett

sample_reviews_en.text: Feeling like eating at home with sister. Good food warmly service with reasonable price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanannat Meemark

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the atmosphere is inviting, and the owner is very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: jirapong wongwiwat

restaurants.name: แสนดี โภชนา
restaurants.address:

29/31 Soi Bang Hua Sue, Bang Hua Suea, Phra Pradaeng District, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're in the area and haven't stopped by, you're missing out (though it's not comparable to the restaurants by the dam, it's a different style). The taste is decent, the seafood is fresh, and the quick, single-serving dishes are good value for money in terms of quantity and quality.
The black tea is strong. The restaurant opens at 5 PM, is closed on Sundays, and there's no parking lot; you have to find parking on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vichit Chin

sample_reviews_en.text: A charming vintage-style wooden house restaurant in a garden, owned by Nong Non and Nong Noi, who welcome customers with smiles. The menu offers reasonably priced food that tastes surprisingly good for the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kittikaseam Adchasai

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a lovely, cozy, vintage atmosphere. The owner is friendly, the food is reasonably priced and tastes good. The salmon steak was delicious. Overall, I liked it.
sample_reviews_en.author: KITTAYAPORN NARKKERD

sample_reviews_en.text: A wide variety of dishes in different styles, every menu item is delicious. You must come and try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: nuetip Junpui

restaurants.name: หล่อลวก ก๋วยเตี๋ยวลูกชิ้นปลา สาขาพุทธบูชา
restaurants.address:

ชั้น 2 โครงการซัสโก้ สแควร์ 367 ถนน พุทธบูชา Bang Mot, Thung Khru, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The thin noodles were a bit clumpy after being overcooked. The cold noodle soup with tofu was okay. I liked the mixed fried items; they were fresh and crispy. The fried tofu was delicious, and the fried taro was also good, especially with the dipping sauce.

The noodle bowl was a good size for a filling meal. The tom yum noodle soup with thin noodles was incredibly filling. If you order the dry version of the crab and crispy pork noodles, you can ask for some soup to go with it. There's also a soup option. The tom yum cold noodle soup was tasty. The chrysanthemum and roselle teas were average; the chrysanthemum tea wasn't very fragrant.
sample_reviews_en.author: BD Life

sample_reviews_en.text:
From the start:
I was looking for a restaurant that accepted the government's co-payment scheme for food delivery.
I found this place, and the prices were reasonable.

This was my first time ordering.
I didn't intend to write a review at all.
The photo is of the bowl I had at home.
Because I ordered via Lineman, I didn't have high expectations.
I figured it wouldn't be as good as eating at the restaurant.

But I was very impressed with:
The fish ball noodle soup.
The broth was clear and flavorful, the noodles were excellent, and the fish balls were great.

The fried taro and fried tofu were also delicious.

I'll definitely order again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pla Ryukin

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually come to Laor Luak to eat yum, and it is always very delicious. The restaurant  is located near King Mongkut’s University of Technology Thonburi, so it is easy to visit, especially for students. The yum has a strong and tasty flavor, with fresh ingredients and many options to choose from. I really like the spicy and sour taste, which is very satisfying. The price is affordable, and the portion is worth it. The atmosphere is simple and relaxed, making it a good place to eat with friends after class. I would definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: พาทิศ อัครบวร

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my go-to restaurant when I was in university 😋🤗 I've eaten here countless times. My favorite dish is the "Break-Stopping" Dumplings; it's such comfort food, filling and easy on the stomach. Other dishes are delicious too. The noodle soup broth is great in all varieties, and you can tell the staff how you like the spicy salad. The staff are friendly and I ate here so often they've even memorized my order! 5555

If you're passing by while refueling, I highly recommend stopping by for a meal.
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: วีริศ สถิตย์มั่น

sample_reviews_en.text: If you are around Phuttha Bucha, you have got to check this place out! The main features are the super affordable prices, delicious food, and a huge variety of menus they even have ice cream for dessert. The best benefit is that it is the perfect spot where you can easily invite your friends to go eat there together without spending too much. From my experience, the restaurant is not very big and perhaps the wait for food was a little too long. Also, keep in mind there is parking, but not much.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chisnucha

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu includes salads, fried dishes, noodles, sticky rice, and even fried chicken. The food tastes good, the place is clean, and there's plenty of parking. The restaurant is on the second floor and doesn't have air conditioning, so elderly people don't need to worry as there's an elevator. You can walk straight into the restaurant from the elevator, which is very convenient. This time, we ate with 3 people, and the total bill was 469 baht. The food is as shown in the pictures.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anuwat Klungphol

sample_reviews_en.text: I've walked past Susco Square many times. I just finished a run in Thonburi Park this morning, so I decided to eat at this restaurant because the noodles looked delicious. It turned out to be better than expected! I ordered a bowl of plain pork noodles with a bottle of water. The total price was 72 baht. The broth, noodles, and pork meatballs were perfectly cooked, resulting in a well-balanced flavor that wasn't too sweet. I'll definitely be back next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patrick Commizza

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is on the 2nd floor of Succo Square, near the elevator. I had the noodles and they were delicious. The fish balls were tasty, the ingredients were good. The crispy wonton soup was amazing, the taro fritters with dipping sauce were delicious, and the fried pork was also tasty and generous in portion size. The condiments were clean and the staff provided good service. The only downside was the wait time due to the large number of customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bowy Hu

restaurants.name: Same Same Socialeatery
restaurants.address:

Q98W+CM6, Sala Thammasop, Thawi Watthana, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! Beautifully presented, the flavors were exquisite and delightful, and the aroma was wonderful. The soft background music made everything perfect. The atmosphere was wonderful. If you're looking for a romantic suburban restaurant for a special occasion with your loved one, you should definitely check this place out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zuzii B

sample_reviews_en.text:
Absolute excellent and high quality food. We got so many different things and enjoyed every single bite.
The way how the food was presented on the plate and then explained through the staff was just great.
We enjoyed a lot, and we come again. Thanks
sample_reviews_en.author: Markus Largo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great service
I love all appetizers especially the seaweed one.
Coconut milk ice cream that comes with fish and panma cotta is really good.
I dont like the taste of Cabonara. Panna cotta's texture is weird but I like the taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Namm Kanokkorn

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a great place!  We went here for our Thanksgiving "fancy meal and were very pleased.   This is the  best western food I've had in Bangkok that is not inside an international hotel.  Highly recommend them!
sample_reviews_en.author: John Kane

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lovely appetizer and desserts! Oh and the complimentary bread and butter was also delicious. We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves.

We probably ordered half of the savory dishes on the menu and all three desserts.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lilly Ravisara

sample_reviews_en.text: Decent food, great service, family like environment, price is reasonable but a bit pricey in the area
sample_reviews_en.author: Audi Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the prices are reasonable for the quality, and the atmosphere is nice.
sample_reviews_en.author: xFree Stylex

sample_reviews_en.text: Great restaurant out of busy Bangkok centre. Lovely service , amazing chef, worth to try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zibi Biz

restaurants.name: Tani.BKK Restaurant & Bar | Khaosan
restaurants.address:

19 Thanon Tani, Talat Yot, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Very good selection of tasty meals, you get 1 course + access to buffet...
everything is tasty, good for heavy eaters, can't pick a favourite as all dish were so good, they keep you going for hours as energy boost😋😋😋
Thank you to Ping, Oh & Wi who served us during our stay ❤️ ขอบคุณ
sample_reviews_th.author: Nicole Magtibay

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had an amazing time. From the moment we reserved a table, the staff was incredibly kind, attentive, and eager to make our experience perfect. They were very flexible with our requests, which we truly appreciated. It’s rare to find a restaurant that goes above and beyond to accommodate guests, but Tani.BKK did just that with ease.

The food was absolutely delicious and beautifully presented. Each dish looked like a work of art, and the flavors were spot-on. The atmosphere added to the whole experience, making it not just a meal but a genuinely fun outing. We had such a great time together and left with smiles all around.

We highly recommend Tani.BKK to anyone looking for a great dining experience. We’re already looking forward to our next visit!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wipavee Knecht

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I wholeheartedly recommend this restaurant! We had a wonderful evening. The dishes were delicious, carefully prepared, and bursting with flavor. The setting is magnificent, with a warm atmosphere and a stunning view.

A huge thank you to Ann, who took care of us with such kindness, professionalism, and a smile. Her warm welcome and attentiveness made our meal even more enjoyable.

Thank you to the entire team for this wonderful experience. We will definitely be back on our next trip to Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: remy laurent

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the pleasure of eating breakfast twice at Tani. The food was nothing but pure pleasure to my taste buds. Their offerings for breakfast are beyond the options of most of the hotel breakfasts I’ve had throughout Bangkok, completely worth the experience. The servers were attentive and the wine and artsy theme was cool. Certainly recommend grabbing a bite from here when you’re near Khaosan Road!
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Anglin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food is good and freshly prepared. Good serving size, heavy breakfast. Quality taste and worth every penny.

Buffet breakfast is available with limited selection to complement the main breakfast.

Staff are courteous and attentive. Thank you Ping, Oh, and Wi for serving us during our stay.

Great ambiance, relaxing playlist.

We'll defenitely recommend Tani to our family and  friends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicole Arriz Acorda

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered several dishes and asked for no spicy food. The dishes arrived after half an hour with spicy food We called the waitress and said we asked for no spicy. The waitress took the dishes, wiped the spicy and put them back again Just shocking, even in a conversation with the manager, we did not receive any attention to our request
sample_reviews_en.author: Rely Amzaleg

sample_reviews_en.text: I was a hotel guest and had breakfast here, and I was absolutely delighted. The selection was great, the food was incredibly delicious and fresh, and above all, the service was a perfect 10/10! The staff were incredibly attentive and accommodating, fulfilling every special request. Thank you for this wonderful experience! 🙏🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Carina

sample_reviews_en.text: The breakfast was absolutely delicious! I had the avocado toast with egg and bacon on white toast, and it was so tasty and fresh. The staff were also super friendly and welcoming. A special thank you to Ping and his crew for taking such good care of us and making us feel so welcome! Definitely a lovely place for breakfast.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarah Maria

restaurants.name: Torlente
restaurants.address:

1017 Si Lom Rd, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Torlente is a delightful Italian restaurant that has been our go-to place for the past decade. What makes it truly special is that the food has remained consistently excellent throughout the years.

Our all-time favorite, the refreshing Tuna salad perfectly complements the delicious pizza bread. The mussel with tomato sauce is the ideal appetizer, and the Italian pan-fried sausage is always a treat. Each pasta dish we have tried has been outstanding, leaving us craving for more.

The desserts deserve a special mention as well. Indulging in Chocolate butter rum, Zuppa, and delightful ice cream is an absolute delight. The staff's friendly demeanor and the reasonable prices make Torlente our top choice for Italian cuisine.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suthiporn Saipetch

sample_reviews_en.text: Unfortunately, I've been a long-time customer of this restaurant, even ordering delivery to my home even when I don't dine in. Today I ordered tuna salad and spinach soup. The soup didn't taste the same as usual; it lacked broth, like it was just plain water. I called to ask them to check if they'd made a mistake in the kitchen, but the person who answered didn't even bother to ask the kitchen. They immediately replied that they made it the same way as always and that I shouldn't worry about getting a refund; I just called to suggest an improvement. I probably won't order from them again, but I hope they'll make improvements, especially since they've been open for so long.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wee

sample_reviews_en.text: We tried this place because it was close to the hotel we were staying at! Wish I would’ve listened to some of these reviews. I figured how bad could it really be?. It was really bad. I almost vomited. I could not even try a second bite. It’s not fresh at all definitely a frozen microwaved dinner! Was very expensive too! The waitress knew we didn’t like it but never said a word to us or even asked if everything was ok! Please do yourself a favor stay away or waste 1500bht like we did! We ended up going around the corner a a little taco joint called La Lupita! Such good food and drink specials. Amazing service too!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nancy Marie

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered two pasta dishes and a Margherita pizza. The spaghetti with gorgonzola was excellent. The lasagna was over-seasoned with local spices; it was tasty, but not typical Italian. The Margherita pizza was missing the basil topping; it was just a plain cheese pizza. The place was lovely, with a relaxed atmosphere and jazz. We tried to order dessert, but half the items on the menu were unavailable. We ordered one, and a while later, they told us they didn't have it. They only had one type of dessert from the entire menu; it was clear they were eager to go home.
sample_reviews_en.author: joaquin suarez

sample_reviews_en.text: This is our family's favorite Italian restaurant. We've been eating here for 10 years. The food is delicious and the flavors are great. We always order the spaghetti: chili garlic, bolognese, carbonara, and amatisiana (highly recommended!). Also try the baked spinach with cheese, the tuna salad with anchovies, pizza, chicken mafia, pork chops, almond fish, and the Charlo ice cream (a must-try!). The tortilla cake is also delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: JarnNan 3D

sample_reviews_en.text: Had 2 really good meals here! Great beer. Great home made pizza. Good coffee, Not strong. A fantastic salad! Enough for 2! And it was all fresh and cold. 😋 Had to share it with my wife. ❤️ Real good Risotto, tomato soup. She liked her Penne pasta dish as well.  Bottled water ❤️ Very Good service. Only complaint was no dessert. Oh well. The cheese on the pizza was delicious. Highly recommend this nice restaurant on the corner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ed Smith

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutly terible ! I visited this place at 2018 many times amd was good . But now is it disaster. We had tuna salat and this was ok . But everything else so nad amd disgusting . In spagetti carbonara thay put cream ? And pork scalopini  with musroom they serve with champignons from can and sauce was with  Knor besamel . House wine in price 600 bath for 0.5 l carafe was worse than wine for cooking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Filip Nyklicek

sample_reviews_en.text:
2nd visit in past two years , nothings changed much. Both the ladies , L and XL are unwelcoming and plain uncourteous.

The food has also started becoming unwelcoming.

Waited a year to write something positive but they won.

Owner should realize the value of a smile on their staff’s face ; it enhances the dining experience.

Not sure what will bring a smile on their faces.
sample_reviews_en.author: 1973metube

restaurants.name: โจ๊กหมูทอง (ดินแดง)
restaurants.address:

4569, 32-33 Pracha Songkhro Rd, Ratchadaphisek, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the pork congee with egg and offal. The congee was delicious, smooth in texture, and flavorful without needing any extra seasoning. The pork and egg were well-prepared, but the offal wasn't very fresh, probably because I ate late. The pork blood soup was delicious, rich, and well-balanced. This is a good place for a warm, comforting late-night meal. The portion size is just right, and the price is reasonable. The quality might be better if you go during the daytime. Parking is available at The Prom for 20 baht, then you can walk over.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ruby P

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located by the roadside. I went on a weekday evening and the restaurant was quite empty with plenty of seating to choose from.

They have a variety of dishes to choose from, including other single-serving meals besides congee. The food didn't take long to be served.

I ordered the three-egg congee. The salted egg they included was very salty. When eaten with the already salty congee, it made it even saltier. I recommend using a less salty salted egg instead.
sample_reviews_en.author: Charlie Vongphantuseth

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered a mixed chicken but got boiled chicken instead. This is at the Din Daeng, Pracha Songkhro branch, near the Din Daeng police station. The staff didn't listen at all, and the service was extremely slow. I had to wait for a while. This isn't a typical Hainanese chicken rice shop, it's much faster here. There wasn't even a queue. This branch is hopeless.
sample_reviews_en.author: เด็กหญิง ธิดารัตน์

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually eat here regularly, but today I got a dark, sour, and smelly pork blood soup. The staff said that's just how their soup is, but I argued with them, saying I eat here often and that the soup at other branches is clear and delicious. I was very disappointed and asked for a refund. Has the owner ever checked the quality of their food?
sample_reviews_en.author: Nichtakant P

sample_reviews_en.text: Jok Moo Thong Din Daeng is a restaurant that sells rice porridge with various egg options and separate vegetables like spring onions and sliced ​​ginger to add. They also offer Hainanese chicken rice, pork leg rice, roast pork rice, crispy pork, and pork blood soup, providing a wide variety of choices. There is ample seating available.
sample_reviews_en.author: พิชัย แตงอ่อน

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is near Promphan School. There's no parking at the restaurant itself. They sell dishes like congee, pork blood soup, pork leg rice, Hainanese chicken rice, and roast pork rice. The prices are mid-range. There's a decent …
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffey

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop has Khaw Man Gai ( Chicken boiled or crispy with oil rice) And Khaw Kha Moo ( Pork leg rice) delicious and street shops around here serve Pad thai, fried chicken, fried rice and stir fried basil chicken rice ( Pad Khrapaw)
sample_reviews_en.author: Jenin Rathnayake

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff member who took our order was very helpful, but the surrounding staff kept staring and had unfriendly expressions. When my child went to pay, they ignored her, and we had to go and ask them ourselves.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suttipat Tabtam

restaurants.name: ป.ประทีปก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือ@ลาดพร้าว48
restaurants.address:

875/1 Samsen Nok, ลาดพร้าว Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Regarding the food, we ordered noodles. The noodles were quite hard, not soft. The soup was okay, but the portion was small; even though we ordered the "special," it still seemed smaller than other places.

Regarding the service, my boyfriend wrote down the following on the menu:
"Noodles, Pork, Spicy Waterfall Sauce, Mild, 1 serving"
"Noodles, Beef, Spicy Waterfall Sauce, Special, Spicy, 1 serving"
The waiter came to take the bill and asked if both orders were "special." We replied that only the beef was "special."
When paying, they said "special 2," but we said "special 1." The waiter said, "But the bowls are the same."
But we had already told them only the beef was "special," so we paid anyway. Looking back, it wasn't okay.

The restaurant atmosphere was typical.
sample_reviews_en.author: mission complete

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a boat noodle shop that I really love. For a while, they sold mango sticky rice, which was incredibly delicious – I had to order a second serving! Two bowls for only 40 baht each; it's hard to find such a good deal. The boat noodles are quite flavorful and delicious, especially with the crispy pork cracklings. I also tried the pork satay, which was good, although they didn't give me much dipping sauce. Eating it with toasted bread made the flavor even better.
The shop also has orange juice; they said it's a blend of several oranges, and it's incredibly tasty. If you come here, you'll definitely want to order the orange juice again.
I've actually tried many dishes here, and they were all delicious and reasonably priced. I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaiwat Mas

sample_reviews_en.text:
The boat noodles were delicious, rich, and slightly sweet and sour. I ordered a small bowl, which was just right.
Sen Lek, Sen Mee, Sen Yai (rice vermicelli), and Sen Yai (rice thick) were 20 baht each.
But other noodles were 40 baht per bowl.

I recommend the Nam Tok (water chestnut soup), which is the restaurant's signature dish.

Parking is available for 8-10 cars.
Freshly fried pork rinds, not too soft or rancid.

Fried meatballs and fried dumplings: this bowl was 30 baht. The price was good, and the portions were generous.

The broth was S. If you want other brands, you'll have to bring your own.
sample_reviews_en.author: Taweekiat Trongwongsa

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've heard of this restaurant often, and now that it's opened near my house, I finally got to try it.
I ordered pork noodle soup and plain rice.
The rice quality was average to good.
The noodle soup had a sweet flavor and a burnt chili smell from the restaurant's roasted chilies. Only blanched water spinach was provided; you can choose your own fresh vegetables, including bean sprouts, large basil leaves, and sawtooth coriander.
Overall, considering the taste, quality, and quantity, the price is quite high, even though the noodle soup is 40 baht. However, the fried dumplings were delicious at 30 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Narukom Sakoonvilaikidcharoen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Best boat noodles! In fact nicer than the famous one at victory monument area, after coming here I won't go to the victory monuments ones which are much dirtier too.
This boat noodle here amazes me on the broth which is rich and flavourful. I ordered the spicy dry noodle to try this time and it is very good! Especially the beef which is very soft and tender and flavourful. It's chewy especially those pieces with fats on it. So nice till I ordered another separate bowl of beef for add ons.
Highly recommend this place for boat noodles!
sample_reviews_en.author: jayden

sample_reviews_en.text: The boat noodles at this restaurant are delicious. The soup is rich, fragrant, and just the right amount of spicy. The noodles are chewy and soft, not mushy. The stewed beef is tough. 😭 The portions are quite small, typical of boat noodles. But overall, it's worth it. The service is fast and the staff are friendly. The restaurant is simple but clean. It's perfect for a quick meal if you want a strong flavor that's not too heavy. You'll feel full after eating, but not too greasy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ruby P

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious in P. Prateep's style. Spicy and savory, good noodles, large chunks of meat, and the crispy pork cracklings are incredibly delicious—fragrant, oily, and crunchy; they stay crispy even when added to the noodles. They also have fried dumplings, pork satay (tender and tasty), and a decent dipping sauce.

The restaurant is clean, has parking, and restrooms.
sample_reviews_en.author: yothin hansaphan

sample_reviews_en.text:
✔️The food tastes delicious and the portions are generous. The restaurant is spacious and the staff provides good service. There's a wide variety of food on the menu.

💔However, I have to deduct points for the lack of hygiene. The cook was coughing while preparing the food, not wearing a mask, and even coughing on the food being served. This is unacceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: PimMu

restaurants.name: ชายทะเลบางพระ กทม
restaurants.address:

โครงการ ชิ ว ชิ ว อิน ทาวน์ 335/1 ซอย ลาดพร้าว 94 ปัญจมิตร ถนน ซอย พระยาประเสิฐ พลับพลา Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It's near my house. I'm currently waiting for my device to be repaired under warranty. I'll decide later whether the staff provides good service, maintains customer confidentiality, and uses my device.
sample_reviews_en.author: Viroj Phanyaruchirakul

sample_reviews_en.text: Brilliant service. Tasty seafood on our first night in Bangkok. They have taken care of us so well. The location is even more beautiful, quiet and secluded. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sam R

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and fresh. At first, I thought it would be bad because there weren't many people, but it was good. Parking was convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kwanthip Thienkul

sample_reviews_en.text: Seafood was not fresh at all. We had to return a dish (tamarind soup with fish eggs) because the eggs were smelly as they were already off.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pete P

sample_reviews_en.text: The seafood is fresh and delicious, just like the original restaurant at Bang Phra Reservoir.
sample_reviews_en.author: CHALERMRUT MAYSACHAIYA

restaurants.name: ร้าน อ.เจริญชัยไก่ตอน ดินแดง
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 6666 3939 Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🏡 Located on Pracha Songkhro Road in Din Daeng district, the restaurant is open 24 hours. Street parking is available in front of the shop (check odd/even day restrictions). There are about 4-5 tables for dine-in.

💸 They sell Hainanese chicken rice and fried chicken, starting at 55 baht. Special or mixed portions are 65 baht. Mixed special is an extra 10 baht. They also have Super and Tom Yum soups for 80 baht.

🍚 I ordered a special mixed Hainanese chicken rice for takeaway, priced at 75 baht. The rice portion was huge, enough for two people. The rice itself tasted good, although it was a little soggy. The fried chicken had a slight spiciness, and the boiled chicken pieces were thick and tender. The dipping sauce was delicious. The price, quantity, and taste make it great value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffey

sample_reviews_en.text: I want everyone to see this review before ordering. Yesterday, I ordered a special Hainanese chicken rice through the application. It was supposed to be a "special" Hainanese chicken rice, but what I received didn't seem like a special at all. I'm not sure if the restaurant made a mistake or did it intentionally. I contacted the restaurant, but received no response or explanation about what was sent. It seems quite irresponsible towards the consumer, especially with the chicken scraps on top of the rice. The picture shows the food before I've even eaten it, because I want to know if this was intentional on the part of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: isawan srinang

sample_reviews_en.text: I really need the restaurant to improve its cleanliness. The taste of the food is okay, though. I've eaten there several times. The first time I went, everything was clean and good. But recently, I've seen rats running around in the restaurant very frequently. People in the restaurant saw it, but the staff just ignored it. I tried to be open-minded and go back several times, but every time I encountered rats. Most recently, I found both a rat and hair in my food. Please improve this urgently. Sincerely, a satisfied customer.
sample_reviews_en.author: manut gaemglom

sample_reviews_en.text: Recently, I ate chicken skin that was extremely chewy and had hairs in it. The restaurant was hot while I was eating. Initially, I was impressed with the food, but lately, the quality has deteriorated. Posting photos might not be appropriate. Please improve this, restaurant. I'm very disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: LIL “rteeh” T

sample_reviews_en.text: The price is cheap, I'll admit. Initially, it was delicious and the quality was decent. Lately, the rice has been soggy and not very tasty, and the chicken has an off smell. It might be because the staff are careless, causing the once delicious recipe to disappear.
sample_reviews_en.author: Seal Slattery

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating at this restaurant for 5 years. It's delicious, the portions are generous, and the prices are cheap. The soup is unlimited refills, and there are three types of dipping sauces: black soy sauce, bean paste, and sweet chili …
sample_reviews_en.author: PTD Leo

sample_reviews_en.text: It was great, delicious, I recommend it. They give generous portions whether you order takeout or eat in. Both the special and regular portions are very filling. The prices are also cheap. I've been to this shop 4 times already.
sample_reviews_en.author: ศุภชัย ศิริมานนท์

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered Hainanese chicken rice and chicken leg soup. The taste was good. The chicken rice portion was generous, and the chicken was chopped into pieces, not flattened. The chicken leg soup had a nice, spicy flavor.
sample_reviews_en.author: พรพิพัฒน์ พ่วงแม่กลอง

restaurants.name: ซีอานเยี่ยม (สาขาบรรทัดทอง) - Xi An Yiam
restaurants.address:

1790 Banthat Thong Rd, Rong Mueang, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food: Average, nothing special, even slightly disappointing. Both the noodles and grilled meat were lacking in flavor. Also, the lamb skewers were really strong-smelling; I'd recommend the beef skewers, which are slightly better, but only marginally so.

Service: The young women were all very nice, and it's not easy for them, so I don't have much to say.

The reason for giving it two stars is that WeChat Pay charges a 5% (4.45%) transaction fee, plus 7% tax, adding an extra 12% to every dish! Next door is another Chinese-owned hot pot restaurant, CQK, and I recommend eating there; they don't even have transaction fees for credit card payments!! I simply dislike these petty tricks!
sample_reviews_en.author: Aoo .z

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! Authentic Chinese food. The braised pork is amazing when eaten hot, though it's a little oily, typical of Chinese cuisine. The noodles are all delicious, including the oil noodles, savory noodles, and hot pot noodles. The portions are huge! Think carefully before ordering, or you might not be able to finish it all! The grilled chicken wings are also tasty. Overall, it's great and you should try it. My Chinese friend loves this restaurant and goes back often. It's located right on Banthat Thong Road, easy to find. There's a Ping Ma Yong doll in front of the restaurant. The staff speaks both Thai and Chinese.
sample_reviews_en.author: KH-CAITH

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is another restaurant I really like. It serves Xi'an-style Chinese food.
The flavors are bold and not bland at all, I can assure you.
Most of the dishes are spicy, and there's a wide variety to choose from.
The portions aren't small, great value for money!

Parking: You can park in the parking lot across the street for 20 baht per hour, but you get 1 hour free while eating at the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chavinee Jermsuwan

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles are delicious, soft and springy. The shiso noodles are amazing; they're fresh and refreshing, not greasy at all. The beef burger is also delicious, the dumplings are large, and the portions are huge. Those with smaller appetites should be mindful of their order. It's good value for money. The restaurant is clean and the staff provides good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akkashanya Taveekul

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the number one Chinese restaurant over all others! They offer traditional Shaanxi local cuisine at a great price, and the taste brings back my childhood memories. As someone from Northwest China, I have to say the food here is truly authentic! Of course, don't always compare it to the most popular restaurants back home.
sample_reviews_en.author: F X

sample_reviews_en.text: The food had absolutely no flavor; even the chili paste for seasoning had no taste or heat. Spices are a foreign concept in that restaurant. And then, on the street, they confiscated my chopsticks. No matter which restaurant in the world I've been to, I've always been allowed to keep my chopsticks as souvenirs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bernd Wunderlich

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best Chinese food places I’ve eaten in Bangkok, all the dishes were very good, had 2 types of noodles, Chinese pork burger, fried dumplings and mala skewers. The place is very spacious and the staff is very kind and attentive, very friendly with kids too! Super recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Guille Marroquín

sample_reviews_en.text: We walked around looking for a place, we were a bit skeptical but wow it was so good, we had the pork sandwich thing and it was very tasty and the iron pot pork noodles that were excellent, the place is very very clean and the staff was nice!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tal Reuven

restaurants.name: ห้องอาหารแก้วเจ้าจอม
restaurants.address:

1 U Thong Nok Rd, แขวง วชิระ Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
After visiting the Saisutthanaphol Building Museum, and near lunchtime, try Thai food at Kaew Chao Chom Restaurant in the Suan Sunandha Hotel, which is located within the same compound as Suan Sunandha Rajabhat University.

The appetizers included "Thung Thong" (golden pouches) with plum sauce, followed by stir-fried fresh shrimp paste, Phra Ram Long Song (a traditional Thai dish), and Gaeng Ngao Ngod (a sour curry similar to Thai sour curry but with a strong sourness and no sweetness, containing young watermelon and freshwater fish). The food was moderately flavored. We then had three-colored coconut milk dessert, which was quite sweet. My favorite was probably the Kaew Chao Chom drink, which was sweet and sour with a fragrant aftertaste.

The restaurant has a warm atmosphere and inviting decor. The view of the garden outside the window was lovely, and the lace tablecloths on the tables were beautiful. The staff provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: narisara nawakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered three dishes: Nam Prik Long Ruea Fried Rice, Mee Kati, and some kind of fish fried rice (I can't remember the exact name). 55😅

Food: Delicious. I really liked the Nam Prik Long Ruea Fried Rice and the Mee Kati (a bit too sweet for kids, but I'm not a big fan of sweets).
Desserts: Delicious (I ordered several, but I can't remember the exact name). Not too sweet, but I liked them.)

Service: Good (I had other things to do on the day I went, so I had to rush the kitchen (the staff were always there to help me with the food).

Parking: We parked right in front of the restaurant on the day we went (but I don't know where else you can park).

Overall, the food was delicious, tasty, and the service was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Duenpen Jaikong

sample_reviews_en.text:
-I only ordered one dish: Gaeng Ranjuan (a type of curry). It was flavorful and spicy, with a fragrant aroma of basil, shrimp paste, and chopped lemongrass that enhanced the aroma while eating.
-The portion size was quite large; enough for 2-3 people to share with other dishes comfortably. But if you order it alone, you'll definitely be full.
-Next time I'll try other dishes like Gaeng Liang (a type of vegetable curry) and Gaeng Massaman (a type of curry).
-The staff weren't very attentive; they were busy on their phones behind the counter. I had to go and ask for the menu myself.

-The overall atmosphere was okay. It wasn't crowded, maybe because it's not very well-known.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanit M

sample_reviews_en.text: Kaew Chao Chom Restaurant is located within the hotel training center of Suan Sunandha Rajabhat University. The atmosphere is comparable to a luxurious restaurant, complete with cutlery, napkins, and cutlery, all ready for enjoying authentic Thai cuisine. The kitchen here serves genuine Thai food, especially royal Thai dishes, known for their smooth, well-balanced, and fragrant flavors with every bite. Today, I had the opportunity to try "Phra Ram Long Song" and "Gaeng Ranjuan with Pork" for the first time. Everything was perfectly balanced in taste, portion size, and value for money. I highly recommend everyone to experience it at least once in their lifetime.
sample_reviews_en.author: Konjanart Koonpoon (Boom)

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was mediocre, but the service was terrible. The staff inside the restaurant were completely uninterested in serving us (even though there were only two tables of customers). They let us sit at our table for almost 10 minutes. When we tried to order food, we were ignored until we had to ask at the hotel counter. Even worse, their attitude and facial expressions showed a complete lack of willingness to serve.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wararat Kaikhoontod

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is lovely and peaceful, and the dining room is beautiful. Their Nam Prik Long Ruea fried rice is considered the best in Thailand. Other dishes are also exceptionally delicious, with a refined, royal court flavor. It's truly an extraordinary restaurant. Many traditional dishes are unique to this place, such as Gaeng Joo, Pad Krapow, and Gaeng Ngao Ngod.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dawud

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted good, almost everything looked delicious, and there was a wide variety of dishes on the menu. However, on the day I went (5/6/69), the air conditioning wasn't working, so it was hot. The restrooms were under renovation and located on the 3rd floor because the elevator was also being repaired.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kornpon Chanjirapat

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had quite high expectations for this place from reading the reviews. However, the food doesn’t deliver the same level of taste. The fried foods are oily and battered in thick layer of flour.

The service is good and the atmosphere is calming though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thammarith Likittheerameth

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวหมูโบราณ กิ่งแก้ว50
restaurants.address:

65 King Kaeo Rd, Racha Thewa, Bang Phli District, Samut Prakan 10540, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Traditional pork noodles, 20 baht per bowl, located on King Kaew Road.
What we liked:
1. The shop is clean and reasonably priced.
2. They have the same toppings as traditional pork noodles.
If they could improve this, we'd be more satisfied.
1. The soup is a bit too sweet for us. If you like sweet soup, you'll probably like this place. For us, it would be even better if it were a bit less sweet.
2. It's located on a main road, so the noise from passing traffic can be quite disturbing.

The small bowls of noodles allow you to try both dry and soupy noodles. Sugar is also included. If you don't like sugar, don't forget to ask the shop for it, as there's sugar in the bowl. You can add your own seasonings.
sample_reviews_en.author: M Ktkct

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tom Yum Noodle Soup, fragrant with lime.
Delicious taste.
It's hard to find this kind of flavor these days.

Dry Tom Yum Noodles
come with lime to squeeze and season.
Tom Yum Noodle Soup (soup version)
is already seasoned.
Small bowl, you can order a second serving.

Crispy wontons are available as a side dish,
adding to the enjoyment.

Two elderly ladies are busily blanching noodles and seasoning,
their hands moving rapidly,
with an elderly gentleman assisting in serving.

The shop is located on the ground floor of a shophouse.
It's a little difficult to find,
because the front of the shop, on the sidewalk,
is blocked by a large tree from the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nok Ninat

sample_reviews_en.text: Traditional pork noodles, available in both small and large bowls. Small bowl 20 baht, large bowl 35 baht. We chose the small bowl so we could eat many bowls in many different styles. Today we ate glass noodles with tom yum and small dry tom yum. The tom yum is not seasoned, it's ready to eat as tom yum, so we don't have to add seasonings. It's traditional pork noodles with tender pork, liver and intestines, not smelly or fishy. Personally, I like it, it's quite delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nok Thanida

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! Hard to find this kind of dish. The filling is excellent. The price is cheap. If you're looking for traditional noodles, I highly recommend this place. You won't be disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: wanchna mm

sample_reviews_en.text: It was so delicious! I loved it so much. I've never had Tom Yum soup that tasted like this before. It's not like typical Tom Yum, but I liked it even more than regular Tom Yum.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panupong D Bat

sample_reviews_en.text:
20 baht per bowl
30 baht for the special
It's truly traditional. The taste is okay.
The shop is located right on the street, at the corner of Soi 50.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nivat Phasuk

sample_reviews_en.text:
Small dry spicy salad, a real hit.
The pork blood soup is also delicious. It's so cheap and delicious. It's hard to find something this good.
sample_reviews_en.author: โสภณ เผือกอุดม

sample_reviews_en.text: The GPS is correct. The journey is convenient and comfortable. We arrived at the destination in front of the shop right at the point.
sample_reviews_en.author: รวยทรัพย์ พรมพาน

restaurants.name: Sanaethai Thaicuisine
restaurants.address:

77 Maharat Rd, Khwaeng Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Khet Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Thai restaurant serves spicy food and has both air-conditioned indoor seating and a covered riverside terrace, although heavy rain can still get into the seating area.

🍛 The focus is on Thai and seafood dishes, but they also offer Western options like salads and spaghetti.
