The food is spicy; if it's spicy, it's really spicy, so be sure to specify your spice level to the staff. We ordered several dishes, and our favorite was the stir-fried eggplant with minced pork and salted fish in soybean paste. The eggplant was soft and easy to eat, with a subtle salted fish flavor to balance it. The green curry with beef ribs is a recommended dish, but it was quite oily and the beef was firm and chewy, similar to sun-dried beef. Overall, the seasoning was delicious.

The riverside atmosphere is beautiful and relaxing.

The prices are reasonable, leaning slightly towards the higher side.

There is ample parking as it's part of the Royal Thai Navy Club parking lot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Karn Santidhananon

sample_reviews_en.text: Returning to Bangkok from out of town, I was looking for a restaurant along the Chao Phraya River when I found this one. Looking at the menu, the prices seemed reasonable, although these didn't include tax and service charge. You have to drive into the club and tell them you're dining there; they'll let you park. The service was good, the food was delicious, and the atmosphere was quiet. This is probably because you can't see Wat Arun directly from this area. Also, there were some holes in the ground outside, and if the chair legs went into them, you could fall over. I asked the restaurant to fix this because I almost fell while holding my phone – it nearly fell into the water! Luckily, I held on tight. For two people, we ordered three dishes and the bill was under 1000 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanop Traipoom

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible. They didn't find a table for customers; customers had to find their own. They were completely incompetent. When customers finally found a table, they weren't quick to resolve the situation, and another person brought in a foreign customer to sit in their place. Then, that person started speaking rudely to the customers, even though their own service was terrible. They glared and yelled at them, even though their own service was awful and customers had to do everything themselves. When it was Khun Kung's restaurant, we ate there regularly and never had a problem with seating. There were plenty of empty tables, yet they didn't put any there. This place is awful.
sample_reviews_en.author: sarada aengsirapas

sample_reviews_en.text: Thai food here is delicious, with just the right amount of spice. I recommend the Tom Yum soup and the steamed sea bass with lime. The desserts are also tasty. It's perfect for a family meal. The staff provides excellent service, and the prices are very reasonable. The view is beautiful; the tables near the river are breezy and not too hot. There are air-conditioned rooms and what seems to be a banquet hall as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cholacha A.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a great place to bring the family for a meal. Enter via the Royal Thai Navy Club entrance. Drive in and inform the staff that you're going to Saneh Thai restaurant, and they will park on the left.

The food tastes good and the portions are quite large for the price.

We ordered the fried fish with tamarind sauce. You can request the sauce to be served separately and specify your preferred level of spiciness.
sample_reviews_en.author: N. Tee

sample_reviews_en.text: This newly opened restaurant is located in the Royal Thai Navy Club. The interior is nicely decorated, with both indoor and outdoor seating areas. It's mostly frequented by foreign tourists. The menu primarily features Thai food, but they also offer steaks and spaghetti. The food is of a moderate taste, not overly spicy. It gets quite busy during lunchtime. Parking is available in the Royal Thai Navy parking lot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Omiiigod CJ.

sample_reviews_en.text:
A cafe and restaurant by the Chao Phraya River.

The atmosphere is great, both day and night. At night, the lights reflecting on the water are beautiful. The food is delicious, and the staff are lovely and friendly. There's convenient parking, and you can also arrive by boat via the pier.

On the day we visited, the cashier at the cafe during the day was rude.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuii Paweena

sample_reviews_en.text:
Some staff seemed a little confused.
Food was served quickly.
There are air-conditioned rooms,
air-conditioned rooms by the river, and
riverside rooms.
Three options to choose from.
Plenty of parking available.
Don't forget to get your parking ticket stamped at the restaurant.
Fish food is available for purchase for children to feed the fish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Butterfaiy Wang

restaurants.name: Born to Dine - Hualamphong
restaurants.address:

477, 9 Phraya Singhaseni Alley, Rong Mueang, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A new restaurant opened near the Blue Hostel. I walked past and saw a cute poster, so I decided to give it a try.

The menu features Asian-inspired fusion food. You order and then pick it up yourself, like a KFC. I chose the tonkatsu side dish. The rice was delicious, Japanese-style. The tonkatsu was firm and crispy. What I really liked was the salad that came with it, which was wakame salad. I don't usually find salads like this.

Overall, the food was delicious. The restaurant is comfortable and has many tables. It's near MRT, but there's no parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattha Thanabat (MJ)

sample_reviews_en.text: Waited for like 10 mins for my order to be taken - had to come up myself (they said to wait for a waitress in the beginning). Food is okay, but in the menu there are 4 pieces- i took 2 portions- both had 3 pieces instead of four. Inside, too cold and bathroom was dirty - no soap to wash hands (didnt even want to take a photo- disgusting). Too much plastic used unnecessarily carelessly. Poor service
sample_reviews_en.author: Gulmira Batyrkhanova

sample_reviews_en.text:
I highly recommend the crispy chicken green curry rice. I usually order it for takeout, but today I decided to eat at the restaurant for a change. It's self-service, by the way.

The taste and packaging are the same as when I order takeout, but it's more comfortable to sit in, the atmosphere is nice, and it saves electricity compared to eating at home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thitich a

sample_reviews_en.text:
On a day when I wanted to feel comfy and chill, I came across this place. The poster was very eye-catching. I looked at the menu and decided to try the Ochazuke salmon, which seemed perfect for my mood.
- The taste was okay, the salmon was delicious.
- It perfectly matched my chill mood today.
- It wasn't too heavy, ideal for a light and easy meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chavyeub

sample_reviews_en.text: Beef Noodles. Just the appearance of the dish looks delicious. Pour the sauce and add chili. It's very delicious. For those of us who like it spicy, add the whole chili packet. The stewed beef is very delicious. The side dish of pickled cucumber goes well with it. I recommend this menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนัญชกร จิรชุติภาสกุล

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered via Grab to eat at home.
The flavor is light, which I've been looking for for a long time, because usually most restaurants tend to make things too spicy. This restaurant's flavor is something I can eat every day (delicious, especially the chicken soup). I recommend trying it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aftershockz -

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and worth the price. The salmon pieces were large, firm, and juicy. They have Ochazuke, which is hard to find elsewhere, and it was delicious. The rice and soup were fragrant. Importantly, I loved the poster outside the shop; the design was beautiful 🥺 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Som O

sample_reviews_en.text: Normally, ordering food delivery is already delicious. Today, I stopped by Hua Lamphong area, so I tried ordering Pick up to eat fresh and hot like the food just came out of the kitchen. It's even more delicious. I really like this menu: Braised Pork Rice 24.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natteera Station

restaurants.name: อามีนะห์ ก๊ะเตี๋ยวเนื้อน้ำข้น
restaurants.address:

Soi Sathu Pradit 30, Bang Phong Phang, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The soup was very salty. The car was parked blocking the sidewalk. The sidewalk is not private property; you should be considerate of others. Don't just sell your goods and then have your customers park all the way on the sidewalk. It causes problems for pedestrians. Last weekend, a sedan was parked on the sidewalk, leaving no room to walk. People had to walk on the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Famu

sample_reviews_en.text:
The beef noodle soup is delicious, the beef is good quality.
The basil stir-fry is well-made, fragrant, spicy, and very tasty, I really like it.
The chili fish sauce is also good.
There is no parking lot, you have to park on the side of the road.

The restaurant is on the side of the bridge over the Sathu intersection, heading towards Central.
sample_reviews_en.author: Venika Thitipongpinyo

sample_reviews_en.text:
The beef noodle soup is delicious, 60 baht. The portion is generous and worth the price, plus rice, one bowl is enough to fill you up. The shop is easy to find.
They also have tasty sun-dried beef.

Grab/motorcycle parking is more convenient. If you're driving, it's probably easier and safer to walk a little further past the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: 林.秀英

sample_reviews_en.text:
The fresh beef noodle soup, with sliced ​​beef, is delicious. The broth is rich and flavorful.
Parking might be difficult if you go by car.
The noodles cost 60 baht per bowl.
The broth is hot and very fragrant.
It's near the mosque, easy to find. It's a roadside stall with red tables.
sample_reviews_en.author: V Vangtong

sample_reviews_en.text: The stewed beef noodles are tender, and the broth is not too salty, just perfectly balanced. The fried beef with rice is also tasty, but not amazing. You should definitely try this place; it's one of my regular spots.
sample_reviews_en.author: kar fa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything was good, even the chili fish sauce.
The price was affordable, and one bowl was enough to fill you up.
The fried beef with rice was amazing.
The noodle portion was huge, very filling.
sample_reviews_en.author: คุณส้ม

sample_reviews_en.text: Very delicious! Friendly price. Good quality meat, fragrant soup, hot rice, excellent chili fish sauce. It's a roadside stall, so it's a little hot inside. Finding parking is a bit difficult.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naphat Thiwakornkitkul

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is a real gem! The prices are reasonable, and the food is delicious, especially the fried beef with rice and the Riski noodles with extra broth.
sample_reviews_en.author: วันเฉลิม ปั้นแหยม

restaurants.name: Took A-roi
restaurants.address:

Suk Sawat Rd, Rat Burana, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is great, the food tastes good, there's a wide variety of dishes, the prices are reasonable, and the ingredients are fresh and tasty. The restaurant has two seating areas. The first area is next to Suk Sawat Road, which is best for evenings and late nights (currently under construction for the Purple Line MRT).
The indoor area is air-conditioned, cool and comfortable. It occupies about four to five shop houses, has comfortable seating, and three large TVs (probably at least 65 inches) to watch. The restrooms are clean.
Parking might be difficult in the early evening, but there is free parking available. The restaurant closes at 2 AM, so late nights shouldn't be a problem.
sample_reviews_en.author: สมชาย แซ่แต้

sample_reviews_en.text: It wasn't crowded, but we had to ask for our food twice. We ordered simple dishes: stir-fried morning glory, crispy pork with kale, pork omelet, bitter melon with egg, and seafood tom yum. The stir-fried morning glory and bitter melon with egg came first, and after half an hour, the rest still hadn't arrived. When we asked the staff, they were unfriendly and unwelcoming. We waited another 10 minutes and asked a male staff member, who led us into another large kitchen area before we finally got our food (only one area was open that day). It wasn't busy at all. #The staff's facial expressions were really bad. Terrible service.
sample_reviews_en.author: เกตุฤดี สุขเงิน

sample_reviews_en.text: The food service was extremely slow. I understand it was busy, but they should have informed us if there were any delays or issues with our orders. We waited almost an hour for the crispy pork stir-fried with chili and salt, and had to ask about it four times before it still didn't arrive. They didn't even tell us the rice was undercooked, letting us wait until two other dishes had already arrived. They also made a mistake with the bill; we ordered four items but only received two. It was a terrible dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phuricha Roypromma

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my second visit. The food tastes great and the prices aren't too expensive. My friend said the pickled plum soup was amazing.

Deep-fried pork belly with fish sauce ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
It's fatty, but not greasy at all. Delicious!
The squid in black ink sauce was good, but nothing special.

Overall, I would definitely come back again.

Parking is available in the side alley; there's a staff member to direct you. The staff were very helpful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Milk Milk

sample_reviews_en.text: I've driven past this place many times, but only recently stopped to eat. I really missed out; I should have eaten here sooner. The prices are cheap, and the food is delicious, just as the name suggests. The prawns are large and firm, the squid is cut into thick, firm pieces, and the fish is fresh and sweet. The flavors are spot-on. I've marked this as my go-to restaurant for meals.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarph D.

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant on Suk Sawat Road serves delicious congee (rice porridge). They have a wide variety of tasty dishes at reasonable prices, such as fried pork intestines in soy sauce, spicy Chinese sausage salad, chicken feet soup, and many more. There are both air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned seating areas, and parking is available with attendants. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manus Euasuknukun

sample_reviews_en.text:
Air-conditioned restaurant serving Thai rice dishes and congee.
Affordable and delicious.

There are 3 branches in total.
This branch is located in an alley with limited parking (approximately 10 cars).

The food is delicious and cheap, living up to the restaurant's name.
This branch has two floors and clean restrooms.

The restaurant accepts cash and QR code payments.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supawut Saengrassamee

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, affordable, and good. I eat here often. Parking is a bit difficult though. You should try it if you're passing by. They have a good variety of dishes (see attached). The recommended dishes are good. The restaurant is a bit chaotic inside, but it's okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wirayos Wachiraphoka

restaurants.name: sea zone seafood & steak restaurant .
restaurants.address:

92-92/1 หมู่ 10 Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious and the staff were incredibly attentive. At first, I thought that because it's in a tourist area, the food would be geared towards foreigners, but it turned out to be unexpectedly delicious and flavorful. I highly commend the staff; they were so friendly, attentive, and polite.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pongpnayap Lamomsri

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is absolutely delicious and the price is unbeatable. They also have meat options for those who don't like seafood. I've already been twice and I'll definitely be back for a third or even a fourth time to really try the menu.

👍🏽
sample_reviews_en.author: sergio d

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the atmosphere was great, and the staff were very attentive. I was extremely impressed! 🤍
sample_reviews_en.author: Aritsada Sompanwang

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the seafood was fresh, and the atmosphere was great. It's perfect for a family meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kodcha Korn

sample_reviews_en.text: I liked the atmosphere, the food was delicious, and the staff were polite and provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Realme C55

sample_reviews_en.text: A welcoming cafe with delicious food and friendly staff. I recommend trying the scallops.
sample_reviews_en.author: irina komzyk

restaurants.name: Sirichai pork leg & seafood
restaurants.address:

40 Pracha Songkhro Rd, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We were expecting a good lunch of delicious pork knuckles, but we were disappointed.
The pork was too sweet, but pork is a bit of an exaggeration. They served only bones with some kind of strange pork rind. Everything was drizzled with a very sweet sauce.
The second course, red barbecue pork, was better and more delicious, but the pork knuckle marred our visit to this establishment.
The service leaves much to be desired; everyone seems to be walking around and working with a certain reluctance. They could have served one egg per dish, as they usually do in other establishments, but even here, we got half an egg.
They didn't serve any greens. It feels like you have to pay for everything in this restaurant. Ice is 2 baht, water is 10 baht, while it's free elsewhere.
To sum it up, we still paid more for this than we usually would for similar dishes. I don't recommend going here; it's better to grab some shashlik to go.
sample_reviews_en.author: Артём Ципотан

sample_reviews_en.text:
When I went in, there was no staff to greet me, but they went to serve customers who came in later. Okay, no problem.
So I called out, and then they argued about who would take my order. I ordered food, and it turned out that people who came later got their food first. So I sat and waited for a while. The staff I hired were talking to each other; there was no one in the kitchen. I felt like I wasn't going to get my food. I was very disappointed from the moment I entered the restaurant until I left. If I had to wait that long, shouldn't they have come to ask if I had received all my food? Terrible service. First and last time here. I'm definitely going back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nacha Soomjiter

sample_reviews_en.text:
The mama instant noodle salad is a must. Warn u its very spicy.
The grilled chicken and pork collar  is very tender and goes well with the special sauce.
Tomyum clear soup has a nice kick and comes with half a flower crab inside.

By the way PLease bring sufficient CASH as they do not have cashless payment mode.
Quite sad to see the staff who do not know English explaining to the diners/tourists. Some of diners/tourists I witnessed gave condescending remarks, Quite sad to see this. Be respectful if you are there
sample_reviews_en.author: m

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff didn't really care about the service. Because I didn't know, I went to order and got a stern look. When collecting the bill, there were already staff sitting at the table, but they chased me to go pay with the staff taking the order. The price of the food is normal. The cleanliness of the zone is not air conditioned. There are too many flies. The taste is delicious. What needs to be improved is to train new staff in the service.
sample_reviews_en.author: ARTISAYA. C

sample_reviews_en.text: Pork knuckle is 200 baht per plate. For two people, we ordered two plates: one knuckle, one meat and skin, two plates of rice, two glasses of ice, and one bottle of water. The total was 454 baht. I was shocked and stunned. I reluctantly paid because I'd already gone in. Importantly, there was no price list. Once is more than enough. The taste was just okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arisara Raksa

sample_reviews_en.text:
This has to be my favourite pork leg rice joint, and I have to have it when I'm in Bangkok. Other than the pork leg rice, also try the roast chicken leg and the pork jowl. The chilli goes extremely well with all the dishes, and is not too spicy.

Tip: if the weather is too warm, there is a small air conditioned area all the way at the back of the eatery.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hong Rui Toh

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the place to go to for pple wanting to see the "night life" in Bangkok.. all sorts of shops you would expect to see opened in the days are opened here to facilitate pple who only have time to run such errands on the wee hours of the morning.. the food is simple but surprising delicious.. looked around the locals to see how to enjoy the dishes...
sample_reviews_en.author: Ling Tsong Hung

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a late-night or evening-returning-from-a-party friendly restaurant. The food is delicious and doesn't disappoint, especially the papaya salad – it's incredibly good! However, the atmosphere, hallway, restrooms, and the smell are quite off-putting and can really kill your appetite. If the restaurant improves these aspects, it would be fantastic!
sample_reviews_en.author: T schn

restaurants.name: Wallace สาขา ลาดพร้าว122
restaurants.address:

268/4-5, Lat Phrao 122 Alley, Lane 26, Phlabphla, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried a new brand and was very unimpressed. The service was extremely slow. The staff said it would be a 15-minute wait, but it actually took almost an hour. When I asked about my order, the staff looked confused, even though they were able to put the food in the container immediately. As for the food, it needs urgent improvement. I bought it to eat at home. The batter was thick, undercooked, still soggy and mushy. The outer layer was burnt and tasted bitter. The flavor was completely bland. The chicken itself was acceptable, but the fries were soggy. It seemed like they had been in the container for a while. I really hope the restaurant improves. I'm quite disappointed. 😢
sample_reviews_en.author: Pacharadanai Maruekhathat

sample_reviews_en.text:
1. The chicken was very bland. It was just plain fried. Adding more seasoning powder, like the one from the big chain Red Chicken, would make it much tastier.
2. The large set I ordered only had 8 small chicken drumsticks. It would be much better if they offered a mix of different sizes.
3. The French fries were a bit chewy.
4. A refillable drink option would be a great selling point.

**I commend the friendly staff, the spacious and comfortable area, and the fact that everyone was provided with gloves to prevent hands from getting dirty.**
sample_reviews_en.author: มิ้น มิ้น

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a sign saying it's open 24 hours. I've eaten there twice before and was quite impressed. However, last week, I went around midnight or 1 AM and saw the staff sitting and chatting. I had my boyfriend ask if the restaurant was closed. The staff looked at each other and laughed before saying, "We close at 11 PM," and then continued laughing. I'd like to know the actual opening and closing times. I wish they would put up a clear sign.
sample_reviews_en.author: onpriya

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my second time eating here. The chicken pieces are huge, the taste is delicious, and the price is affordable. What impressed me most was the excellent service from the staff. The first time, one piece of chicken was undercooked, and the staff took great action, bringing me extra chicken as an apology. I don't want it to become too popular though, I'm afraid it will get crowded. 🥹
sample_reviews_en.author: PPRIM

sample_reviews_en.text: I just ordered takeout and the manager was incredibly helpful. He explained the promotions and gave great recommendations. My boyfriend even chatted with him, answering all my questions in a friendly and kind manner. I really liked him; it's rare to meet someone like that. He even gave me a box when I asked for one. 🙏🏻🙏🏻🙇🏻‍♀️😊 …
sample_reviews_en.author: กาญจนา พึ่งเงิน

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered food at 1 AM and the restaurant is about to close, and I still haven't received it. Terrible! Other branches deliver in less than 5 minutes. I'm so angry and hungry. The staff didn't inform me of anything and didn't care about the customers. In the end, I went to eat noodles instead. I feel terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pang Triyawat

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is beautiful and the prices are very cute. The staff are friendly and attentive to customers. The menu has a wide variety and is delicious. If you order to take home, they will provide gloves and toothpicks. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hasan Nurdian

sample_reviews_en.text:
The roasted chicken took a long time to prepare, and the staff didn't inform us of the waiting time.
The taste was good, but the portion was too small for the price. Buying the 6-piece pack would feel more worthwhile.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pranee Chd

restaurants.name: Indian Food (Suan Phlu)
restaurants.address:

562, 17 Thanon Suan Phlu, Thung Maha Mek, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Update: Dec 2019

After approximately 15 orders from Indian Food they have always provided a delicious meal with fresh and handmade ingredients.  I truly love the food here and want to thank the cook for all the amazing meals.

Due to my upbringing I never experienced Indian food until I was older and I am truly grateful that Indian Food 17 has provided me with the best Indian food in Bangkok to help me catch up.  Please see my photo of the naan bread tonight,  it’s brilliant and so perfect made with a lot of care!!

Thank you 🙏🏻 I even posted this before eating to say thank you for all of your hard work.

—

I want to give my thanks to Indian Food for their continued excellence for take out orders.  I highly recommend their paneer makhani (the sweetness to it always hits the spot) and vegetable pakoras (wide variety of vegetables like onion, zucchini and cauliflower mmmmmm!!).

Indian food 17 is some of the best Indian food Bangkok and the best Indian food near me.  Many thanks for always serving delicious food.  I will keep ordering and recommending.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arroyo Spero

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a new Indian restaurant just opened on Suanplu recently. The sister restaurant (also named "Indian Food") is located on Charoen Nakhon 17, it is currently rated 4.2 out of 5 on Google Maps by 84 reviewers so it must be good right? I was skeptical at first since the people working in the restaurant were all Thai (I expected Indian chefs when I want authentic Indian food) but that skepticism totally goes away once the food came. They were some of the best Indian dishes I ever had! The shrimp saag spinach curry was thick with lots of spinach, and has 2 huge size shrimps; those large shrimps are not cheap... The fish vindaloo curry was also excellent with very fine ingredients. The garlic naan was freshly made and very tasty too. The prices are some of the lowest I had seen for an Indian restaurant and the food quality is a few notches above the price level; good food with good prices, what else you can ask for!! The lady owner was extremely nice and took the time to answer my questions about the food and the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: David T

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is not actually good they don't have actual recipe of Indian food and this restaurant is not actually Indian restaurant they're just try to attract tourist and give you something different from what you order.  We ordered biryani but they served is orange colored simple meethy Chawl kind of rice and separately cooked frozen chicken chunks it it.. and the naan was to hard to chew as it was 2 to 3 days old.

Please avoid getting into the scam.
sample_reviews_en.author: Silvia Patras

sample_reviews_en.text:
Extremely disappointed with the terrible food. Ordered chicken tikka, paneer makhni, dum aloo, chapati and plain rice via Grab Food.
Chicken tikka and dum aloo gravy had way too much artificial coloring which looked repelling. Both paneer makhni and dum aloo were very oily and did not taste good at all. Worst thing was there was a piece of plastic in the chapati.
Only decent thing was the plain rice, simply because it was plain.
sample_reviews_en.author: Depapepe P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered butter chicken & garlic naan per reviews.

Chicken: 1/5
Dry, and extremely over cooked. Seemed like they made it earlier and just reheated it.

Sauce & gravy: 1/5
Shouts tomato sauce. Buttery though.

Reason I gave it a 2 was the garlic naan was okay and the tomato sauce was a bit buttery, which was also okay. They really need to restructure their business strategy/food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ahsan Javed

sample_reviews_en.text:
Grab delivery. 10 minutes distance only.

Saag paneer. Very watery, too finally ground saag. Was it prepared I'm a blender? Barly any paneer. Just few pieces.

Butter chicken wasn't even warm. Had to heat it. Chicken was tasteless. It's like previous cookef chicken breast had been thrown into a cold previously prepared sauce. Didn't seem to have been cooked together.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jonas S Karlsson (大鱼)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Worst Indian food I have had in Bangkok in 5 years. Ordered chicken tikka, dum aloo, paneer makhni, chapati and rice through Grab.
Chicken tikka and dum aloo looked hideous with all the dark red artificial coloring. Both gravies were extremely oily.
The chapati had a piece of plastic, so had to throw rest of them away.
NEVER EVER ORDER FROM THIS PLACE.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shantanu Tambe

sample_reviews_en.text:
Mango lassi B60 was actually mango smoothie with hint of yogurt, pleasant surprise and delicious.
Non-vegan small set B260 consists of chicken curry, spinach curry with cheese, plain rice, plain naan, yogurt with cucumber, tasty and value for money.
Will definitely come back with my loved one
4 star coz of room for improvement in terms of ambiance
sample_reviews_en.author: Inzaikun Chiba

restaurants.name: Atithi Restaurant Pattaya
restaurants.address:

Opp, 59/41, Moo-10-Soi-sip Chet, Soi Diamond, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently visited Atithi Restaurant Pattaya, and it truly lives up to its reputation as an egg specialist. If you’re someone who enjoys egg-based dishes, this place is a must-visit.

The menu offers a wide variety of options, especially catering well to Indian tastes while also covering multiple cuisines. From classic Indian flavors to fusion dishes, everything feels thoughtfully prepared and satisfying.

What stood out the most was the affordability—great quality food at very reasonable prices, which is not always easy to find in Pattaya. The service was prompt and friendly, making the overall dining experience smooth and enjoyable.

The interior is clean, well-maintained, and gives a comfortable vibe.

Overall, I highly recommend this restaurant, especially for Indian visitors or anyone craving flavorful, budget-friendly multi-cuisine food in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naveen M

sample_reviews_en.text:
Atithi Restaurant is a must-visit if you’re craving authentic Gujarati flavors in Pattaya.
The Surti Ghoatala was absolutely delicious—rich, spicy, and packed with true Surti taste, just like back home. Perfectly balanced and full of flavor.
The Fafda was fresh and crispy, served with tasty curdy that complemented it really well—great as a breakfast or light meal.
The Thepla was soft, well-cooked, and flavorful, pairing beautifully with pickle and chutney.

Overall, the food felt homely, authentic, and freshly prepared. A great spot for Indian and Gujarati food lovers in Pattaya. Highly recommended! 🇮🇳✨
sample_reviews_en.author: shrikant kanase

sample_reviews_en.text:
Man the food test really amazing. I have had my all the taste buds tickled with the recipes they made. They are so into the service providing business that even by telling them that I can wait and they just left their tea and snacks aside and served me first. The Ambience is amazing and you can get the vibe of peace. Quite cooler than hot outside atmosphere.
Highly appreciate the efforts of abhi and Sagar
sample_reviews_en.author: AKASH CHAUHAN

sample_reviews_en.text: “I recently visited Atithi Restaurant in Pattaya, and it was such a delightful experience! The food was delicious — full of authentic flavors and beautifully presented. The ambiance had a classic, cozy vibe that made the meal even more enjoyable. The staff were incredibly polite and gentle, making us feel truly welcomed. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for great food and genuine hospitality
sample_reviews_en.author: md asif

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited Atithi Restaurant yesterday and it truly lives up to its name.
The ambience is warm, the service is quick, and the food tastes absolutely authentic and fresh.
A big thanks to Ar. Abhishek for the amazing hospitality and attention to detail — you made the experience even better.

Highly recommended place for anyone looking for great food and a welcoming atmosphere!”

Thank u!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rawat Ankit

sample_reviews_en.text: We stay 5 days in Pattaya we eat every day in atithi restaurant samir is the owner and he provide great service staff is also so friendly great experience I must say to all my friends and family to visit this restaurant only from kapil …
sample_reviews_en.author: Ganesh Masala

sample_reviews_en.text:
Atithi Restaurant is a must-visit!
If you’re looking for authentic Gujarati food with amazing taste, this is the place to be. Every dish reflects true Gujarati flavors—fresh, perfectly balanced, and absolutely satisfying.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ravi Gohel

sample_reviews_en.text: One of the best restaraunts near walking street. Their chicken biryani is to die for. Ordered Egg ghotala also, one of the best that I have ever eaten. Excellent customer service and helpful staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akhil Rawat

restaurants.name: เทพเจ้าเพอร์ซีอุส ตำนานก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือแห่งลุ่มแม่น้ำแยงซีเกียงและกษัตริย์แห่งอาณาจักรทั้งเจ็ด
restaurants.address:

242 Srivara Rd, Phlabphla, วังทองหลาง Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have to admit, I chose this restaurant because of its name:

"Perseus, the God of Boat Noodles of the Yangtze River and King of the Seven Kingdoms."

Perseus is a god in Greek mythology who killed Medusa, the snake-haired woman. The Yangtze River is in China and is the third longest river in the world after the Nile and Amazon. As for the Seven Kingdoms, I'm not sure what it refers to; maybe something like the seven dwarves?

The boat noodles are a bit pricey. A bowl of braised beef is 99 baht, and they also have bowls that cost hundreds of baht like those at Thongsmith, but they also have a cute small bowl for 19 baht.

It's delicious without needing any extra seasoning. You can choose from three levels of spiciness.

You have to wait a while after ordering. The restaurant is large, and it takes several minutes for them to walk back and forth with the order slip.
sample_reviews_en.author: Praphon Wongsakpakdee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff's attitude was terrible. Couldn't they just tell me politely that I couldn't park there? They kept saying "No parking! No parking!" Is it a private road or something, that they're telling me not to park there?
When I tried to move to another parking spot, they kept yelling, "No parking! No parking! No parking!" I understand, but I had to walk to the other parking spot and move the barrier first.
Please clarify whether the area next to the shop is private property or not. If it is, I apologize. But if it's public property, please train your staff to speak more politely. I was planning to come and support this shop after my errands, but after such rude and disrespectful behavior, I'm done with it.
sample_reviews_en.author: pichy test

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant does a good job with offal, especially the beef tongue and liver. The stewed beef, however, could be better. It wasn't very flavorful, but the price and portion size were reasonable. The food came out quickly, and despite the large number of customers, the restaurant managed to keep things organized.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sooksira G

sample_reviews_en.text:
The legendary boat noodles of the Yangtze River Basin 🌊 Meet Perseus 🙏, the god who ruled over the Seven Kingdoms, at the famous Town in Town restaurant 🏪. Discover the unique flavors and quirks that will leave you hooked with every bite! 😋

#BoatNoodles #FamousBoatNoodleRestaurant
sample_reviews_en.author: TM Abasi

sample_reviews_en.text: No wonder the shop went bankrupt. Expensive, small portions, afraid of not making a profit. Customers eat there once and never come back. There's plenty of competition in the noodle shop area. If you keep doing this, you can keep it to yourself and just pack up and go home.
sample_reviews_en.author: brooks

sample_reviews_en.text: Waited a very long time for food, 30 minutes, even though there were no customers. The staff didn't serve drinks and were standing around chatting in front of the kitchen. I was too lazy to wait for the food to be served all at once, several bowls at a time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanut Govitsittinun

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is clean, the food is good, and the decor is nice. I'd definitely come back again if I have the chance.
The prices are a bit high (555, not that I mean expensive compared to the restaurant).
sample_reviews_en.author: Yoh

sample_reviews_en.text: There is a history of the owner (which is similar to the history of the shop but has nothing to do with the shop, so it's fun to read). The air conditioning is cool and the noodles are delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: JOKERKILL MM

restaurants.name: 8817 Cafe
restaurants.address:

88 Inthamara 45 Alley, Ratchadaphisek, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A good cozy place to eat some nice Malaysian style food. Ordered
1) Nasi lemak is quite good with their special Msian sambal and "rendang" chicken add on. Total Price 216 baht
2) Hokkien Mee Prawn (fried version with black soya sauce) has a slight bitter aftertaste because of their soya sauce. It is fried with chinese cabbage with about 6 medium size prawn. Top up with crispy fried pork fat and fried shallot. Came with a chili paste at a side.  Price: 188 baht
3) Spicy stingray.  Supposed to be Spicy but probably too bland for Thai. Price: 388 baht
4) Takeaway.  Char koay teow with extra blood cockles and prawn.  Taste quite good. Price: 298 baht
5) "Teh tarik" (Msian tea). Price 88 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: BP Chuah

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered here through Grab.

It was nice but not truly authentic char kwuay teow.

Laksa was nice but way too much noodles.

Also PLEASE use less oil. Nowhere in Malaysia do they use this amount of oil.

Also why did you ruin the roti canai but squeezing it as hard as possible? I ordered 5 and had to throw 4 away the next day.

Additionally, something spilled in the bag on the way.

Hope your packaging improves. Also less cheap “filler” ie. Noodles. Save yourself money and provide an appropriate portion.
sample_reviews_en.author: Onono Pugnob

sample_reviews_en.text: Calling all Malaysians and Singaporean that misses KL food in Bangkok. This place is the best place to get your Malaysians food fix in Bangkok. I searched through Google many Malaysians restaurant  and tried them all. Laksa, KL Hokkien noodle, Yong Tau Foo very close to Ampang standard.  First time here and wanted to congratulate the boss but he is holidaying in Phuket but will come back and try Nasi Lemak and the rest next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kenneth Chow

sample_reviews_en.text: Malaysian food done by Malaysian Chef! Nothing more authentic. Had the curry noodle and prawn noodle. Both done to the likeness of good old kl style! Boss and helpers all super nice. Great place to have Malaysian food and make Malaysian friends! Almost forgot that their lo mai Kai is heavenly and can be bought and take away for next day's breakfast!
sample_reviews_en.author: Adrian Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: A restaurant and bar with a strong hometown vibe, the food is very Malaysian, and the coffee, cocktails, and drinks are also good—after all, it's a cafe! 😎 Those who miss Chinese songs should definitely come and listen to familiar tunes, or even belt out a song. Parking is no problem at the 68 Hotel, which is about 70 meters away. Recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: mobanche li

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a home-style Malaysian restaurant run by a Chinese-Malaysian chef. Most of the dishes are Malaysian-style Chinese cuisine, such as Char Koay Toew, Prawn Mee, Hokkian Mee, and Curry Mee. They also offer Nasi Lemak, Rendang, and more. The food is delicious and affordable. There's a small parking area in front of the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattapat Boonprakong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Purposely came for Malaysian food but unfortunately they’ve changed the Menu , now only Thai food available .

Ordered 1 dishes but it takes more than 30min for them to serve , and until I asked only the waitress said it’s not available but she didn’t tell when I ordered it 🫩🫩🫩

Not coming back again .
sample_reviews_en.author: Laine Ee

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and there's a good variety of dishes. It reminded me of the food I ate in Malaysia. The Nasi Goreng was decent, and their signature grass jelly coffee was flavorful. There's also a dog in the shop. It's a small shop with limited seating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prakit

restaurants.name: TA-KE SUSHI
restaurants.address:

50, วัดโบถส์ 33 ถนน บางศรีเมือง Bang Krang, เมือง Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a Japanese restaurant on Saphan Jet Road. The food menu is okay. The taste is normal and some dishes are not well made. As for the price, if the location and quality of the food is like this, it's a bit expensive for this area. The atmosphere of the restaurant is normal. The restaurant is a shophouse of about 3 units. The inside is not decorated much.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุทธิเจตน์ หวังสิริเลิศกุล

sample_reviews_en.text: First time here, tried the mixed sushi and pickled wasabi salmon. Very satisfied with the soft, chewy Japanese rice, well seasoned, and very fresh ingredients. The price and quality were better than expected in a suburban area like this. Will definitely come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattaya B.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Japanese rice is very hard
The service staff do not care about customers, they hide in the shop
They play country music, the shop looks clean but there are flies in the shop
They should improve it urgently before it goes bankrupt
sample_reviews_en.author: Boat Natthee

sample_reviews_en.text: Traveling is convenient if you need to do business. Within this area, there is also a water production plant called the Bang Khen Water Plant. This plant produces and supplies water to people in Bangkok and surrounding areas.
sample_reviews_en.author: เฉลิมพล ชาวนาใต้

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, great value, and fresh, clean ingredients.
Premium quality. I love the wasabi salmon salad, the fresh wasabi squid, the kimchi, and the best part is the soya and plum wine. Truly Japanese flavors!
sample_reviews_en.author: Napattaorn Nut

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious! The owner, P' Lek, is very kind and friendly. If you like Japanese food, I highly recommend it, especially for night owls as the restaurant closes at 11 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: แม่คะนิ้ง ม่อนแจ่ม

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate here last year and loved it, it was delicious. I came again this year and it's still just as delicious. I'll definitely go again next year.
sample_reviews_en.author: PaNg Todd

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and clean. The owner is very friendly. If you're in the area, you must try it. It's a great place to eat!
sample_reviews_en.author: Veemusic Shop

restaurants.name: Coco Pizza&Pasta ptt ราบ 1
restaurants.address:

181/2 Vibhavadi Rangsit Rd, Samsen Nai, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is another Italian restaurant that offers a warm atmosphere and great value for money. The dish I tried today was the dry-fried spaghetti with clams. The flavor was perfectly balanced, with a fragrant blend of garlic and dried chilies. It wasn't too oily, the clams were fresh and odorless, and the spaghetti was cooked just right.

I also had the mushroom soup, which had a smooth, rich texture and a distinct buttery aroma. It was served piping hot and paired perfectly with the crispy yet soft garlic bread, completing the meal beautifully.

Overall, every dish exceeded expectations in terms of quality and price. The flavors were delicious without needing any extra seasoning, and the restaurant's atmosphere was clean, spacious, and comfortable, suitable for solo diners or groups of friends.

If you enjoy homemade-style Italian food, I highly recommend trying this restaurant. You won't be disappointed!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nickz Pisut

sample_reviews_en.text: Hidden gem! A great pizza place with delicious food at reasonable prices. The ingredients are high quality. The spinach soup is creamy, the carbonara spaghetti is cheesy, and the pizza is delicious with a thin crust and generous toppings. The prices are very reasonable. The restaurant is comfortable, although there are only 5 tables and one private room. It's like musical chairs with customers constantly coming in. The food is prepared quickly, so you don't have to wait long. In short, it's excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: เจ้ส้ม ขายทุกสิ่ง

sample_reviews_en.text:
They have many delicious pasta and pizza dishes. The taste is excellent, especially considering the reasonable price.
The staff provided great service, offering good menu recommendations and showing incredible enthusiasm. I didn't expect this from a small restaurant located in a gas station. I was very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peerajate Soonthrajan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was surprisingly delicious for a place located at a gas station. There is plenty of parking, though it can be a bit hard to find at first. The entire place is run by just one staff member, yet the service was still good. What impressed me the most was the great taste and the very affordable prices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Weeriya Samakgan (ws27th)

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small shop packed with quality.
Good ingredients, delicious and fragrant pizza.
Soft pasta noodles with large prawns.
Good service from the staff, food served quickly.

Recommended for travelers passing by.
A delicious and reasonably priced meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: คุณเชอรี่ พิธีกรมืออาชีพ

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the ingredients are high quality, and the taste is consistently good every time I visit. The staff provides excellent service; they are always smiling, cheerful, and friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: juntima kreengoen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great taste, appealing presentation, and affordable price.
It's a small shop, but they also have a private room with one table.
Parking and restrooms are available at the gas station.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yaowalak S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fast serve even we ordered homemade pizza
Pasta and appetizers also good
We ordered Capellini with calms and Clams cream cheese, there are a tons of clams

Highly recommend 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Pranotparn Nakvichet

restaurants.name: Auntie's Boat Noodle Victory Monument
restaurants.address:

QG8Q+FF5, Soi Rim Khlong Sam Sen, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The shop is located by the canal, near the pedestrian bridge. The noodles are served quickly, taste good without needing any extra seasoning, and have a slight spiciness. The price is cheap. (Personally, I didn't find the waterfall-style broth quite to my liking, but the overall taste was better than other shops near the อนุ (Anu) area that I've tried.)
sample_reviews_th.author: Joyy Sasithon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tucked away in a lesser-known boat noodle alley, the first shop on the left is a true hidden gem. With years of experience, they serve boat noodles that deliver a rich, thick taste you won’t forget. The service is quick, and the staff are attentive, making sure you’re well taken care of.

The atmosphere is raw and unpolished—the opposite of fancy. The space is a little tight, so you definitely come here for the food, not the comfort. Sitting right next to the canal, you’ll often spot water monitors gliding through the water, adding a unique and memorable touch to the experience. If you’re looking for authentic, no-frills boat noodles, this place is absolutely worth it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicola

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located along the canal , best experience of eating like a local ! They speak simple English so do be gracious about them taking some time to understand you.

With choices of beef and pork and 3 kinds of noodles (rice noodles, egg noodles and vermicelli) . Staff was extremely welcome and nice .

We tried only the pork as we don't take beef . But all 3 was a bomb and we had to have more .

Really affordable and nomilicious meal 😋

To note - highly recommend taking the BTS or if you're taking a ride (car/tuktuk) to be prepared to do a short walk due to the heavy traffic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mel N

sample_reviews_en.text: Auntie’s Boat Noodle is a small but popular spot for affordable boat noodles near Victory Monument. Each bowl costs only 12 baht, making it easy to try several bowls and mix different flavors. You can choose from three noodle options: egg noodles, rice noodles, or thin rice noodles. Despite the small size of the shop, the noodles are tasty, flavorful, and satisfying. A great place for a quick, budget-friendly meal and a fun way to experience Bangkok’s famous boat noodle culture. 🍜✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Chubby Hands

sample_reviews_en.text:
The stoves were heated by wood, making it quite warm. There were three noodle stalls in this alley, all serving Teochew-style braised noodles in a spicy and sour broth.

The stall at the alley entrance was 15 baht with plenty of meat and toppings but few seats. The second stall inside the alley was 12 baht with plenty of toppings but few seats. The stall furthest inside had a large space with plenty of seats, fewer toppings, and just the right amount of meat.
sample_reviews_en.author: 邱烽祐

sample_reviews_en.text:
There are two noodle shop on this point. I have been the inside shop. And, I love this local Thai style noodle for the awesome taste.

One woman helped me to order two types (soup type, dried type) of noodle because I can’t speak Thai. She said she has been visiting this restaurant for 30 years. It is amazing!

FYI, this noodle shop open until 4 pm!
sample_reviews_en.author: JD Kim

sample_reviews_en.text:
Old-style boat noodle shop by the canal.
The broth is rich and flavorful, not too spicy, just right. The meat pieces are large and tender, and the offal is good. Eating it brings back memories of the taste from over 30 years ago. Now it's 15 baht per bowl, whereas before it was 3 baht. Anyone remember that? 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: rakpong aroon

sample_reviews_en.text: Really liked the taste of this auntie's boat noodles! She's a friendly, funny lady and we had a good time there, despite our busy day and the hot weather. Only small letdown was, that the place has no fan and is pretty hot, but the (I wanna say more authentic) boat noodles we had made up for it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arne Leonhardt

restaurants.name: Pork leg with mushrooms, Wat Suthat
restaurants.address:

PGX2+J26, Ti Thong Rd, Wat Ratchabophit, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. Today, my father bought pork knuckle to take home. Normally, the starting price is 60 baht for takeout. My father ordered 100 baht worth, but the portion was appalling, like something you'd get for 60 baht a bag. The price and quantity were unacceptable. The restaurant participates in the government's co-payment scheme, and my father informed them beforehand that he wanted to pay co-pay. My father agreed and we understood. However, when he scanned the QR code on the restaurant's screen, his phone showed a payment confirmation, but the restaurant quickly closed the transaction, so the confirmation didn't appear. Then, the restaurant tried to get my father to make a new transfer. What did my father do wrong to need a new transfer? The taste of the food is fine, but the service is definitely awful.
sample_reviews_en.author: T C

sample_reviews_en.text:
Braised pork leg with shiitake mushrooms was delicious. The pork leg was tender, the sauce wasn't greasy, and the mushrooms were tasty. The dipping sauce, which was a vinegar-based sauce, was good. Fresh chili and garlic were provided. The pork intestines were clean, without any fat or odor, but they weren't as tender as I'd like. The tofu was of good quality, but it might not have been cooked properly, so it was a little bland (perhaps because I went too early in the morning).
Prices: Braised pork leg with rice starts at 50 baht, special 60 baht, braised pork leg with shiitake mushrooms 65 baht, braised pork leg as a side dish starts at 100 baht, rice/egg 10 baht, tofu 30 baht per piece.
Seating is in a small alley.
There is no parking lot; you can park along the roadside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ruchira N.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is another one of my regular breakfast spots.
The braised pork knuckle is delicious, not too sweet, not too salty, but with a well-balanced flavor and a fragrant shiitake mushroom aroma. It includes the knuckle, meat, and skin, served with shiitake mushrooms and pickled vegetables.

The price is cheap!! 50-60-70 baht.

There are about 6-7 tables, along with a drinks shop next door. It has a nostalgic, 1956 vibe – a vintage coffee shop where people from that era used to hang out and chat. They offer hot tea and all the drinks you'd find at a traditional coffee shop. They use a charcoal stove, but there's no smoky smell when you're sitting next to them.

Both shops are delicious! ✅
sample_reviews_en.author: Thapakorn Pinpongphan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Braised Pork Leg with Shiitake Mushrooms, Wat Suthat
👉 The shop is located on Tithong Road, opposite Wat Suthat.
👉 It's a food cart set up on the roadside with tables for eating in the alley.
👉 I've passed by many times and really wanted to try it. Today I had to stop by. I parked on the side of the road and ordered it to go. I ordered the lean meat, which I love, but the shop has everything, including the pork knuckle which looked delicious.
👉 The taste is perfectly balanced, not too sweet, not too salty. The shiitake mushrooms and the slightly sour dipping sauce are excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชรินทร์ วิภาวีพลกุล

sample_reviews_en.text:
I strolled to Wat Suthep.

I originally wanted to go to the congee shop on the corner, but it was always sold out.

I walked past a group of aunties and saw them buying a bunch of braised pork.

I stopped too. I looked at the menu; again, no English.

I thought I'd order the mid-range option for 65 yuan.

But to my surprise, it had braised pork with shiitake mushrooms! 🍄‍🟫 I love shiitake mushrooms! The pork wasn't too sweet, which was a huge plus. Delicious! 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: YUN

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious.
I walked past and thought there might be something exciting because it looked like an old-fashioned alley.
There's a small coffee shop run by an elderly grandpa.
Judging by its appearance, it's a Chinese-owned shop, so I assumed the drinks wouldn't be too sweet.

And it turned out to be really delicious, not too sweet at all.

The orange juice was quite tasty; it wasn't pre-made juice, but a homemade blend.
sample_reviews_en.author: kantaporn tanti

sample_reviews_en.text: The braised pork leg was tender, delicious, and very fragrant with shiitake mushrooms. I loved it! Anyone who likes braised pork leg in clear broth should try it. The shop is located in a small alley, but it's cool and comfortable, not hot.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dutch Milk

sample_reviews_en.text: Pig's legs stew with less fat gravy. It's one of my flavorite street food because of it's mellow and nice smelling gravy pour on soft and tasty chopped pork stew (pig's leg) that served with well cooking rice. Moreover, chef give you some …
sample_reviews_en.author: Route 359

restaurants.name: Poru Ramen by เบคแอนจอยน์ สนามเป้า
restaurants.address:

111, 13 Phahonyothin Rd, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm hungry, so I'm going to a ramen shop!

🎌 🍜 PORU RAMEN BY @poru_ramen.sanampao is a Japanese street-style cafe serving Japanese-style ramen, prepared by a ramen-loving chef. The shop uses high-quality ingredients and makes almost everything in-house, including the chashu pork, broth, soup sauce, chili peppers, bamboo shoots, and pickled eggs, all at friendly prices 🤑

🎏 The shop's decor is designed in a Japanese street style, giving off a cozy, homey feel, and there are tons of photo opportunities – perfect for anyone who loves taking pictures.

Recommended dishes:
🍜 Tonkotsu Spicy Ramen
Spicy pork bone broth with chopped green onions, chashu pork, seaweed, and a boiled egg.
🍜 Maseri Ramen
Mildly spicy pork bone broth. Comes with a complete set of toppings including kakuni, tantan pork, naruto fish cakes, and more.
🥟 Gyoza
Japanese-style gyoza with homemade sauce.
🍜 Shoyu Ramen
The broth is made with soy sauce, or Japanese soy sauce, resulting in a clear, rich brown broth. Enhanced with char siu pork, pickled bamboo shoots, and chopped green onions.
🧇 Cruffle Topped Ice Cream
🥤 Yuzu Soda
sample_reviews_en.author: cameragirl bkk

sample_reviews_en.text:
A coffee shop with a Japanese atmosphere, full of cute photo spots. The croissants here are excellent, even delicious plain. The coffee is delicious, medium roast with a slightly darker finish.

The interior has many different styles of tables and chairs, giving it a distinctly Japanese feel. Choose whatever style suits you. Or, there are also tables outside in front of the shop.

If you're looking for something a little heavier, they have several ramen menus. I haven't tried them yet, but I'll definitely come back next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuttakorn I.

sample_reviews_en.text:
It exceeded my expectations!
I was impressed with the croffle; it was soft, chewy, and fragrant with butter when eaten warm.
As for the drink, I tried the mint cocoa (65 baht), which was rich and smooth. The sweetness level was just right, not too sweet. There was also a promotion for a drink under 60 baht paired with a croffle for 105 baht, so I ordered a basic iced tea. The tea was fragrant and strong; even after the ice melted, it didn't feel diluted or bland. Overall, it was excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: May N.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ramen was delicious, the soup was flavorful.
The gyoza were also good, and they looked carefully made, with the wrappers not dry or tough. The filling was delicious.
The bakery had a wonderful buttery aroma, so you know they're using high-quality ingredients.
The Americano had a rich coffee aroma and the perfect amount of bitterness.
The matcha had a rich, seaweed-like aroma.
It was so delicious I forgot to take a photo.
No parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yanagin

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a cute little Japanese-style bakery that also serves ramen. The ramen tastes good and is reasonably priced, perfect for those who aren't expecting authentic, traditional ramen. There's only one staff member, so it might take a little time to prepare the ramen.

The shop is located near the bus stop on Soi Luecha or Phahonyothin Soi 1. It's in a small alley with a ramen sign and the shop's sign clearly visible. It's easy to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: nathchriszada muangnil

sample_reviews_en.text:
Landing in Japan at Sanam Pao station! This is the second branch of Bake & Join, featuring a Japanese Street concept that starts right at the storefront. If you miss the small, cozy shops in Japanese alleys but can't fly to Japan yet, this is the place to be!

The menu offers a wide variety of choices including teas, coffees, cocoa, and various sodas, as well as baked goods, croissants, and croissants with different fillings.
sample_reviews_en.author: sitthut sittisamarn

sample_reviews_en.text: The ramen is delicious and very reasonably priced. The portion is just right to fill you up, but if you're still hungry, you can add extra noodles for 19 baht per serving, which is very affordable. I especially like the Tantantanmen here because it comes with both minced pork and chashu pork, and the Tonkatsu Ramen has crispy fried shallots added to the texture, which is unique and I really enjoy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chalunton Tantivipanuwong

sample_reviews_en.text: It's like you fly to Japan for real from the street to this cafe it's all Japanese. The atmosphere was really great, it had so many spots you could take photos, the food was tasty, the service was okay, the drinks were good and nice and the best was croffle. It's really yummy once you go there you really need to order they have many flavors.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanawan Detchusananart

restaurants.name: Chicken Fried Noodle Chae Hua Khua Kai
restaurants.address:

594 Maha Chai Rd, Wang Burapha Phirom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: A family atmosphere where you feel very welcome; they are super hardworking and attentive people, and it gave me the same good vibes as when I ate at my grandparents' house. The food is so delicious that I went back the next day. ขอบคุณมากค่ะ 🩷☺️
sample_reviews_th.author: A Blazquez

sample_reviews_en.text: This is truly a hidden gem of a restaurant! I've had their stir-fried noodles for breakfast two days in a row now, and it's incredibly fragrant. The rice noodle sheets are thin and springy, and stir-fried with eggs, they're especially delicious without being greasy. There's also a fresh prawn, lots of chicken pieces, and I think some pork too? The meat slices are large, smooth, and not dry at all. A meal with meat, prawns, squid, and noodles only costs 65 baht, about 13 RMB. The elderly couple are incredibly kind and attentive; even though they're not very healthy and walk slowly, they still bring you condiments, napkins, and water—it really feels like being at your grandma's house. I eat here every day in Bangkok!
sample_reviews_en.author: 陈奕君

sample_reviews_en.text:
Jae Hua's Stir-fried Chicken Noodles, the original shop at Saphan Han (the alley next to Krung Thai Bank)
It's a small, hidden gem, but the taste is extraordinary. Although the storefront is a bit narrow because it's a private house,
the food is made fresh to order and served hot. It's really delicious. Personally, it's the taste of my childhood, the kind I used to eat when I was a kid, which modern shops can't replicate. It's a taste I'll never forget... and importantly, it's inexpensive. They make it themselves in their house; the uncles and aunties are very lovely and friendly. Come and support them!
sample_reviews_en.author: ChubbyArin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The owners, an elderly couple, are so lovely and kind. Eating here made me feel so warm and welcome.
The taste lives up to its reputation. This was my first time ever eating stir-fried noodles with coconut milk, and I'm so glad I chose the right restaurant.
Delicious, fragrant, good quality ingredients, and the price is moderate—not too cheap, not too expensive. I liked it so much I want to find an opportunity to eat there again!
sample_reviews_en.author: thipha bum

sample_reviews_en.text: This stir-fried chicken noodle shop is quite hidden. You have to go down a small alley next to Krung Thai Bank, but the taste is amazing! The noodles are chewy and soft, and have a wonderful wok aroma. It costs 55 baht and includes everything, even liver. The lettuce is fresh, clean, and only the tender parts are selected, so it's not bitter at all. They only accept cash. P.S. The owner, an elderly lady, is very lovely!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chusanang Trisateinpong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is very small, not suitable for large groups. You have to enter from beside Krung Thai Bank, walk 20 meters in, and look to your right; you'll find the shop.

The stir-fried chicken is excellent. The portion is generous, the chicken is tender, and the squid is crispy. It might not have a strong wok-fried aroma, but it's delicious. One plate is definitely enough to fill you up.
sample_reviews_en.author: Knight D

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a small, home-style, made-to-order restaurant with limited seating. Their stir-fried chicken is delicious, with a wonderful wok-fried aroma. A regular plate is 55 baht. The owner is lovely and friendly, and the atmosphere is like eating at home. The restaurant is a little hard to find, located in a narrow, somewhat secluded alley. It's a hidden gem worth trying.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanapat Pretanont

sample_reviews_en.text: This was the first restaurant I visited in Bangkok. It was a bit tricky to find because it was tucked away in a corner, but the taste of the food made me realize it was a hidden gem. I ordered noodles, and they were chewy like rice cakes, and the unique spices blended well with the flavor. I was satisfied. The noodles with the seasoning were even more delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: D X

restaurants.name: Nana Kitchen
restaurants.address:

WVHV+MPQ, Arunotai 11, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's a truly casual, everyday eatery. It's near the famous Nirang Condone.

I ordered the stir-fried pork with curry paste (60B) topped with a fried egg (10B).

When ordering, I was asked about the spiciness level; I asked for "just a little," but it was quite spicy. I was right to ask for just a little.

The dish was strongly seasoned, so I didn't need to use the usual prik nam pla (chili fish sauce).

It contained green beans and eggplant, which I don't often see in Thai food, and I enjoyed the texture.

The fried egg topping was perfectly runny, just as I wanted, and helped to temper the spiciness.

There were other delicious-looking dishes, so I'll upload the menu.

Free water is self-service.

The WIFI (5G) had upload speeds of 73Mbps and download speeds of 50Mbps.
sample_reviews_en.author: Syo Kei

sample_reviews_en.text:
A True Hidden Gem ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Updated: 12/12/25
Super nice and accommodating owner/ Chef. They cook food from the heart. Local prices 👍👍👍

Food is delicious at local prices & fast service

I ordered chicken with basil over rice with eggs. I requested no msg, no salt , no sugar and chicken boiled in water(see pic) . Owner obliged without hesitation

Chicken was perfectly cooked and the eggs fluffy and runny(see photo). Rice was good quality and cucumbers fresh and crunchy.

Bratwurst and homemade sauerkraut: snappy sausage and mild sour tasting kraut served with two rye bread. Delicious

I will try their homemade ice cream and smoothies next time.

❤️❤️❤️Nana Kitchen

If this review was helpful, please give it a 👍

Happy Eats
sample_reviews_en.author: SoloJoe

sample_reviews_en.text:
I loved it.

I love spicy food. I LOVE curry.

Thus, today I ordered the green curry with chicken, and I requested "Thai Hot" for the spice level.

I was not disappointed. For the first time in awhile, I had food that was ACTUALLY SPICY! And it very very tasty. The chicken was excellent.

It is also worth mentioning that my fruit smoothie and chocolate shake were very nice as well.

I feel very full, and happy. I love Thai food.

Thank you!
sample_reviews_en.author: Maury Jackson

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing pad kra pao . I have eaten over 50 pad kra paos in my times in Thailand and this is the best . It's made with total love amd bursting with flavour . Not a fancy restaurant. Very simple but that's what I love about here. When your food is so good . That's all that matters . Would definitely recommend
sample_reviews_en.author: Simon Madden

sample_reviews_en.text: The owner is very friendly, but the food didn’t live up to the hype. The Pad Thai was average at best, the chef is definitely not as high rated as others have claimed. I won’t be returning. Everything had an overwhelming amount of sugar in it, even the dishes that were suppose to be spicy
sample_reviews_en.author: Allen M

sample_reviews_en.text: I specifically ordered the chicken with cashew nuts based on the owner's recommendation. It was an overly sweet, inedible mush. I complained after the first bite and sent it back. The owner didn't care at all. I can't remember ever eating so badly in Thailand. Never again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cloud Is the Future

sample_reviews_en.text: Reasonably priced food. The quality of the dishes is commensurate with the price. If you're on a budget, this is the place for you. The owner could use some of the Thai friendliness. If necessary, he'll buy what he needs at 7/11 or Lotus.
sample_reviews_en.author: The Single Man on Earth

sample_reviews_en.text:
A variety of very reasonably priced Thai street food

Although it's street food-style, there's a wide variety of dishes.

I'm looking forward to trying more of their dishes.

This restaurant is always packed with customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: 輝宮城

restaurants.name: ร้านพี่ทอง ส้มตำทอด
restaurants.address:

94 Thanon Charoen Wiang, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I had the chance to try the original fried papaya salad at P' Thong's restaurant again, and I can say the taste is still as spicy and flavorful as ever, with generous amounts of ingredients. This restaurant also has many other delicious Northeastern Thai dishes. During weekdays, most customers are office workers from the area, and lunchtime is extremely busy – you definitely won't find a seat, so please avoid that time as there aren't many tables. There's no parking at the restaurant; if you're coming, I recommend parking at Robinson Bang Rak and walking across the street into Soi Charoen Wiang, about 200 meters.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thatha Bkk

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten here many times, but never reviewed it. My favorite dishes are the catfish larb, fried catfish, and fried chicken skin. The catfish larb is dry, flavorful, and just the right amount of spicy. The fried catfish is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, you can eat almost the whole thing. The fried chicken skin is freshly fried every day and has no rancid smell. And don't forget the must-order fried papaya salad – it's a Thai-style papaya salad with seafood, and it's delicious. The only downside is the slight smell inside the restaurant, but otherwise, it's fantastic. Give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: ThE JuK MoNsTeR

sample_reviews_en.text:
Classic down to earth Isaan restaurant. They have a street selling shop but you can also sit inside. The inside area is really like the living room of the family. The tv is running, there are pictures of the children on the wall and one guy was actually sleeping on the floor next to my table while I was eating.

The food is also very classic. Spicy, meaty and sour. I had Tom Saeb. But K will come back to try more. They have all the Isaan classics.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text: I drove all this way because I wanted to eat the fried papaya salad and I saw good reviews too. Everything tasted too salty and not good at all. It was bland, salty, and not tasty. The fried papaya salad was okay, but too salty and flavorful. The price was very high for the quality of the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Petcharat Kiatkanarat

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small, delicious somtum (papaya salad) restaurant.

The fried somtum is a must-try!

Recommended to arrive before 11:30 AM as there's only one chef and the food might be a bit slow, but it's worth the wait.

It's a small restaurant with limited seating.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthawut Khao-orn

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here, and I was very impressed with the owners, an elderly couple who were so fun to talk to. As for the food, everything I ordered was delicious. My favorites were the grilled chicken and the squid larb – they …
sample_reviews_en.author: Satjapot Manprasong

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was absolutely delicious and very reasonably priced. Everything was worth the money and really satisfying. The only small downside was that the food took a little while to arrive, but overall it was still a great dining experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chana' Ch.

sample_reviews_en.text: The fried papaya salad is amazing, so delicious! The aunt and uncle who run the place provide excellent service, they're so lovely. It feels like eating a meal with my parents. The prices are also very reasonable. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Paidarin D

restaurants.name: ลาซาลนิยม
restaurants.address:

31/62 Sukhumvit Rd, Bang Na Tai, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Lasalle Niyom is located right at the entrance of Lasalle Soi. Behind it is a spacious parking lot, perfect for parking and then taking the BTS Skytrain. In front is a food court with many different types of restaurants. One of my favorites is Pad Thai Station. They offer a wide variety of international dishes, including Thai, Japanese, pasta, and appetizers. The quality is on par with a hotel, as the owner previously worked in a five-star hotel. I ordered the crab fried rice – the rice was fluffy, fragrant, and delicious – and the tempura – the batter was crispy, the shrimp was substantial, sweet, and crunchy, and the dipping sauce was delicious, served hot. It's a restaurant worth trying, whether it's their pasta, sushi, or stir-fried noodles. Give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: ครัวเห็นหมี see me kitchen

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had dinner with friends here.

Overall, we thought many dishes were delicious, but some were a bit too salty, like the papaya salad and the sweet liver, which we thought wasn't quite cooked through (lol). Even our foreign friends asked if it was fully cooked!

If you go, you absolutely must order the grilled pork intestines; they're delicious.

In terms of price, it's mid-range, not expensive but not cheap either.

Going with a group makes it more fun to order many different dishes.

If you have the chance, give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: JKS

sample_reviews_en.text: The space is open and airy, with a very relaxed atmosphere, perfect for meeting up with friends and having a casual chat. Soft music plays in the background, and the food is pretty good at several restaurants. There's a large parking lot at the back, and at certain times there are activities like skateboarding and skateboarding.
sample_reviews_en.author: N. sukkaluk

sample_reviews_en.text: The word "delicious" is overused here; it's great value for money. There's a wide variety of restaurants, including a hot pot and Northeastern Thai restaurant with delicious food, and a Japanese restaurant with reasonably priced spaghetti. The food is varied and tasty, and there's parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Art Tanawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
My first time at Lasalle Niyom.
- It's a place to eat with many different types of restaurants to choose from. From what I saw, there are à la carte restaurants, hot pot restaurants, steak restaurants, and beer places.
- The food taste is average; edible.
Overall, it's okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wisaroot S.

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great, and the food is delicious at every restaurant. There's plenty of parking. The basil chicken is amazing – spicy and flavorful! The hot pot and papaya salad are also fantastic. The Japanese food is equally delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: nannan .1998

sample_reviews_en.text:
Cheap and delicious food. Nice open-air area in the evening.
There's now a skateboard park behind the parking lot, so it gets crowded with teenagers. If you go late, you might not get a table.
sample_reviews_en.author: prasit px

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice range of options of traditional Eastern Thai (Isan) dishes. Open courtyard/seating area really makes it worthwhile. Nearby parking is plentiful, but costs 60 Baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Maxwell Krem

restaurants.name: ครัวบ้านช่าง พหลโยธิน43
restaurants.address:

15 Phahon Yothin 43 Alley, Lat Yao, จตุจักร Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
- There are two atmosphere options: outside, which might be hot; inside, which is air-conditioned, but noisy and chaotic; inside, it's best to have a light drink beforehand; otherwise, it's best to have something to eat beforehand; otherwise, it's best to be prepared for a long wait; otherwise, it's best to have something to eat beforehand; however, the food service is extremely slow. If you come during a time when there's a large group celebrating, find another restaurant. You could wait for an hour and only get papaya salad (which seems to be a dish that doesn't require a stove). Drinking water wasn't refilled at all.
- From what I observed, each dish takes a very long time to come out.
- The staff don't pay much attention to individual tables.
- If you ask about your order, the staff will get annoyed and say there's a lot of food to prepare, and that table has already received theirs, but you'll have to wait longer.
- The cook said the food is slow because the stoves are busy and the kitchen might be understaffed. This needs improvement.
- The food is probably delicious, but the system and service are quite poor.
- This review is based on a 43-minute wait.
sample_reviews_en.author: ThePoppy Smile

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is super chill and feels really homey. It’s a small, cozy spot with a relaxed vibe. The staff are super friendly and easygoing, and some days they even have live music. There’s also a small outdoor area if you prefer sitting outside. The food is mainly Thai and Isaan style – tasty and flavorful. They also serve Australian wine, which goes really well with the food. Overall, it’s just a nice place to sit, eat, and have a few drinks without any pressure, almost like hanging out at a friend’s house.
sample_reviews_en.author: PK

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a chill, relaxed, and unpretentious place. It's a small, homey spot with very friendly staff. There's live music on some days, and sometimes the owner even joins for drinks and plays music himself – super chill, like eating at a friend's house. The food is decent and the portions are generous. If you want a casual place to eat and drink, this is perfect. There's parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: LM

sample_reviews_en.text: A home-style restaurant using a house as a restaurant with air conditioning inside. You can sing karaoke in a circle. The outdoor area has good air and is not stuffy. There are staff to serve drinks all night. The food is delicious. Suitable for socializing with friends. Parking is available on the street in Soi Phahonyothin 43.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nott Peerawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good food and local drinks .
Reasonable price .
