Restaurants have AC also live music every Friday and Saturday night .
sample_reviews_en.author: Ann Krainit

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and clean, the staff provides good service, and there is parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: pompam onpimol

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything is delicious. Food is served quickly. Comfortable seating. Parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Beer จะไม่ทน

restaurants.name: Arno's EmQuartier
restaurants.address:

EmQuartier., 7th floor @Helix, 693 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's in a great location and serves delicious steak.

If you're looking for the best taste, I recommend going to the main branch.

There's a noticeable difference in taste between the meat cut on the spot (at the main branch) and the vacuum-sealed meat (at this branch).
sample_reviews_en.author: S O

sample_reviews_en.text: Rustic vibes, really like a steakhouse. Service is prompt and friendly. Order burger, steak and soup. Gave 4 stars because of the steak - ordered their speciality which was covered with pepper. If you want the real taste of steak, I suggest going for the plain one.
sample_reviews_en.author: G Lee

sample_reviews_en.text: One of my favorite places to eat in Thailand for steak. It's always good, and I usually order the tenderloin. I'm not a Wagyu fan, though...I honestly don't like the stuff. Give me a good tenderloin over Wagyu any day.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sam Fisher

sample_reviews_en.text:
A restaurant in a mall, and not even secluded.
Noise from other "shoppers" walking by.
The menu looks huge, but they actually repeat the dishes making them combos.
It is expensive, and not really worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kai “Khun Kai” Odegard

sample_reviews_en.text: juicy, tender, and a fresh colour of pink in the meat, modern style restaurant, plate burning, was the best experience. I want to look forward to come again. Thanks for the amazing food!
sample_reviews_en.author: I love Food

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first trip to Thailand since returning from my overseas assignment in 2022.

I savored the familiar flavors!

They were just as delicious as ever♪
sample_reviews_en.author: 菊池憲司

sample_reviews_en.text:
The most valuable steak in town.
Great value steak, perfectly cooked.
Delicious basil rice.
The best price in the Sukhumvit area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chiraphat B.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was excellent. The steak was large, tender, and flavorful. The price was good, and the staff were very welcoming.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vichai Mongkoljinda

restaurants.name: Chill Grill
restaurants.address:

Chill Grill, Thappraya Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited this establishment today and was very disappointed with my order. I ordered a classic shawarma, which, according to the menu, includes meat, lettuce, tomatoes, pickles, and sauce.
Unfortunately, the shawarma I received was completely different from the description. There was no lettuce, no pickles, and no tomatoes. Instead, they added French fries, which I didn't order and which aren't on the menu. Besides the missing ingredients, the shawarma itself was very dry and tasteless.
The atmosphere was chaotic and disorganized. The woman taking the orders also cooked them herself and may have messed something up (although it's unclear what could possibly mess up a shawarma with practically nothing).
Overall, I am extremely disappointed with my visit to this establishment. I felt deceived and scammed. I do not recommend this establishment to anyone. After two years in Pattaya, I've become unaccustomed to such a low level of service. Thais often forget things, but to forget three ingredients at once is obviously a way of "saving" on customers, essentially a scam.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike Somerset

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a great business with a faultless experience.
- The menu is well presented and easy to follow.
- You can choose your portion size.
- You can customize ingredients as much as you like.
- The staff are courteous and friendly.
- The food waiting time is not long.
- The food is fresh and very tasty.
- The flavors and Sauces are superb.
- They offer a nice selection of drinks including fresh cranberry juice.
- The food presentation is great.
- They provide gloves in lieu of the excess sauce.
- They provide easy to access napkins.
- They provide cutlery if you choose.
- They provide power outlets at every table.
- The music is nice ambient background music thats not too loud.
- The shop is cooled by both aircon and fans.
- There is an easy to find and use toilet.
- The shop lighting and general ambience is nice.
- The shop is open right through to 2am.
- The pricing is very fair and reasonable.
- I have been here many times during my Pattaya visit and its consistently good.
sample_reviews_en.author: EJ Pryor

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️ (3/5)

I ordered a classic shawarma and clearly asked for no tomatoes or ketchup – I even repeated that it was very important. The staff said okay and confirmed no tomatoes. I was also told I could choose one sauce, but if I wanted just a little bit of garlic sauce, it would cost an extra 30 baht, which felt a bit unfair since many other places include that for free.

Unfortunately, when I received my shawarma, there were tomatoes inside. I had to open it up and remove them myself, which really took away from the experience. There was also too little sauce, so it ended up tasting a bit dry.

On the positive side, the quality of the beef was actually good – tender and flavorful. It’s just a shame that the attention to detail wasn’t better, especially after making my preferences so clear.
sample_reviews_en.author: Martin Jørgensen

sample_reviews_en.text: Hi everyone. My wife and I stopped by this place today for shawarma. We were greeted very pleasantly, explained the menu, and made recommendations. The atmosphere was pleasant, everything was clean, and there was a sink where we could wash our hands before eating (a rarity in Pattaya). There were 12 shawarma options on the menu. We ordered items 1 and 10, both in size M (minimum). Regarding the size, one size M shawarma was a bit much for one person. The taste was different from what we're used to, but it was delicious. Even in Russia, the dishes are made differently in different cities, so it's a matter of habit; some people might find it just like in Russia. The prices were quite reasonable (90 and 120 baht). I highly recommend this place! :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Anton Postnikov

sample_reviews_en.text:
I've bought shawarma from this place 5-6 times (size M, L), and every time it's a disaster. Sometimes it's dry, sometimes there's so much sauce that before you can even bite into it, it's already completely oozing.
Sometimes they add chips with your order, sometimes they don't. Apparently, it depends on the shift. And there's no consistent format.
Today, for example, I got a shawarma to go, and after two minutes I opened it, it had holes in it on both sides. The filling had spilled out, the sauce was thin (watered down) like water, and it was all over the paper. Plus, it was ice-cold inside!
I'd advise the owner to not just sit there morosely with his feet on the customer chair, but to improve the cafe's operations.
sample_reviews_en.author: New

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shawarma is absolute crap. I ordered delivery and it cost 255 baht (even though I chose a medium size). It was delivered like it would be for a child. For 255 baht, that's almost 700 rubles, like the airport price list. The taste is absolute crap, nothing but mayonnaise, the chicken is old. Avoid this place. Blacklisted!

The shawarma is absolutely terrible. I ordered delivery and paid 255 baht (even though I chose a medium size), but what I got was more like a kid's portion. For 255 baht—that's nearly 700 rubles—the price feels like something you'd expect at an airport.

The taste is awful: it's basically just mayonnaise, and the chicken is clearly old. Stay away from this place.

Blacklisted.
sample_reviews_en.author: papife

sample_reviews_en.text:
We love this place very much, we always order classic shawarma, it is the best with garlic sauce, we are very pleased with the freshness, taste and service! Also very tasty desserts and cervelat, I recommend, for 2 years there has not been a single miss! Thank you very much for your efforts 👍

Today I tried the cheese curds for the first time, I am delighted, I really missed real cheese curds from Russia

We love this place very much, we always order classic shawarma, it is the best with garlic sauce, we are very pleased with the freshness, taste and service! Also very tasty desserts and cervelat, I recommend, for 2 years there has not been a single miss! Thank you very much for your efforts 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Соня Андреева

sample_reviews_en.text:
Chill Grill as we’re told is a form of Russian street food. Think Kebab but different flavour. Similar in ways but unique or as they say inn Thailand same same but different. The chicken and beef rolls you cannot go wrong. If you’re in search of something hearty and hits the spot this is it and ask for fresh pickles. Just be prepared they do not short change you on portions. These rolls are large and will impress. Get the fries with your order fresh oil is used and they are delicious.

Staff is kind full of smiles and the owner is regularly overseeing operations and friendly. Honestly you can go wrong with Chill Grill. Extremely awesome in EC’s opinion.
sample_reviews_en.author: ECEPattaya

restaurants.name: Pakistan Restaurant
restaurants.address:

Nana Nua, 1/10 Soi Sukhumvit 3, Klongtoey, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We went for late night eat around 22:00.
First of all the food was actually very good. Tender chicken and good flavour. Excellent fresh naan.

The reason for the low rating is a few things -

1. The atmosphere was very obnoxious. The chef/owner came out and was extremely LOUD on the phone with no regard for the customers.

2. We found not 1, not 2, but 4 hairs in our food. 4 hairs?! The host was apologetic but still completely unacceptable.

3. We only order 2 dishes and they still managed to get one wrong. Also extremely greasy food. So much oil.

Go here if you have no other option since they are open late, but watch what you order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Julian Thomas

sample_reviews_en.text:
Amazing Pakistani food in Bangkok! 🇵🇰❤️ The food was fresh, flavorful, and tasted very authentic—just like homemade Pakistani cuisine. The biryani, and specially BBQ were especially delicious. The portions were generous, prices were reasonable, and the owner
was very friendly and welcoming.

If you’re missing authentic Pakistani food in Bangkok, I highly recommend visiting this place. Definitely one of the places I’d love to visit again! 🇵🇰🇹🇭

Highly recommended! 👌🔥
sample_reviews_en.author: Malik Muqeet Dilawar

sample_reviews_en.text: Visited this place recently. Some items on the menu were not available.  Tried the Shinwari Mutton, which tasted average.  Ordered Daal Maash but just ordinary Masur Daal came, also average tasting with a little too much chilli added. The Chappatis were lovely. This place is not on the main road, rather it's on a side street which with maps you can find. However there is a lot of competition around, so more likely to try a different place next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Walnut

sample_reviews_en.text:
Not sure if it’s the global troubled times or just a poor kitchen! 450b for a mutton nihari which has 3 small pieces and 2 of them are just bones. For real?! Why don’t these restaurants think about quality of food and repeat customers?
This restaurant is probably better in the by lanes of Pakistan instead of charging this kind of prices for basic tasting foods. The ratings so far makes sense!
sample_reviews_en.author: Adnan Khalid

sample_reviews_en.text: Please avoide this restsurant, Last week we went to this restaurant, and that was extreamly bad idea, whole restaurant smels like Butchery, like fresh Meat, never have eten such a bad food in my life, which restaurant can make fresh nihari in 10min? Only this restaurant, only and only African Peoples coming to eat in this restaurant, my advise please dont even try this restaurant
sample_reviews_en.author: S.i Haider

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Authentic Pakistani food with amazing flavors! Everything we ordered was delicious, especially the biryani and freshly baked naan. The spices were rich and aromatic, and the portions were generous. The food was served fresh and tasted authentic. Definitely a great place to try if you love Pakistani and South Asian cuisine. Highly recommended! 🍛✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Honey Hawk

sample_reviews_en.text: Third class restaurant and completely fraud . My friends and I came here and when we entered, there was a strong smell of meat everywhere. We decided to order only tea but it was made with powdered milk. The staff was also third class. I would strongly recommend never visiting this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zain Baloch

sample_reviews_en.text: Staff is good and sweet but totally not a Pakistani restaurant. They don't know how to cook Pakistani food. I ate the worst biryani ever in my life. The restaurant is more oriented towards African people. 02 stars only for the staff otherwise doesn't even deserve a single star
sample_reviews_en.author: Falah ud din Sheryar

restaurants.name: บางจาก
restaurants.address:

246/59 ต.สำโรงใต้ (สำโรง) อ.พระประแดง Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: 10/5/24 I filled up with E85. The first time I scanned and paid, the odometer didn't show up. Normally, it shows up immediately after filling. When I asked, they didn't know what to do. The first time was at 9:30 AM, but the second time it showed up. This is bad. I usually fill up at this gas station. How can I report this to the staff?
sample_reviews_en.author: NATDANAI PATTHONG

sample_reviews_en.text: I use the Bangchak gas station on Puchaosamingphrai Road quite often. The attendants are quick to serve, and the restrooms are clean, especially the restrooms themselves. Regarding smoking, the owner doesn't allow it at all, so it's very clean – perfect for non-smokers. They also sell coffee and have a tire service center.
sample_reviews_en.author: นาวึ ศรึนาค

sample_reviews_en.text: The gas station attendants at this branch provide excellent service and are polite. After using their services several times, I've never encountered a case of oil dripping onto my car. As for the Inthanin coffee shop at this branch, the drinks are consistently good and the taste is regular every time I order.
sample_reviews_en.author: Acharaporn C.

sample_reviews_en.text: I went there for a gas station. The attendant overfilled the tank and didn't fill it to the full amount. It was a terrible experience. Gasoline is expensive, and the staff were taking advantage of customers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Watari Loles

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were uninterested in refueling. I waited for almost 10 minutes, and they just stood there counting, ignoring each other and arguing. It was Sunday shift work. A message to the gas station owner.
sample_reviews_en.author: นัฐสิทธิ์ ปลื้มประเสริฐกุล

sample_reviews_en.text: It's good, the restrooms are clean. Personally, I prefer going to Bangchak gas stations over others because there aren't many people, reducing the risk of contracting COVID-19.😆😆😆 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Kriang Kullachat

sample_reviews_en.text: The gas station attendant seemed unwilling to work. I waited a long time for my car to be refueled, but there weren't any cars there, so he didn't bother to fill my tank.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธาริณี ศรีสุวรรณ

sample_reviews_en.text: The latest staff member provided terrible service; it was very slow and they were busy playing on their phones. There's also no convenience store at the gas station.
sample_reviews_en.author: APK24 channel

restaurants.name: จูโจว
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 75 Soi 15, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I heard they've been selling food for a hundred years, so I decided to try it. I wasn't very impressed.
The restaurant is old-fashioned, but there's parking in the alley, a short walk away, which is convenient.

As for the food, the braised duck had firm meat but the intestines were chewy and hard to break apart. The stir-fried lettuce with shrimp meatballs was tasty, freshly cooked and hot. I didn't really like the pickled lime soup; the flavor was bland and not very strong.

I'm not sure if the restaurant closes early or if the area is quiet and deserted. I saw many restaurants in the area closing down. I wish them well in their business.
sample_reviews_en.author: Billy Than

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd heard about this place for a while and finally stopped by while driving past, but they weren't open for dine-in. I ordered dry noodles and duck rice. The portions were generous. The duck was tender, and what I'd never seen before was the black sauce – it was flavorful, fragrant with Chinese herbs, and not too salty. It mixed perfectly with the dry noodles. The chili vinegar sauce was also good for cutting through the richness.
sample_reviews_en.author: Messara

sample_reviews_en.text: I had breakfast at 9:00 AM. I ordered rice with toppings. The crispy pork tasted good, but it seemed like it had been reheated and fried the day before. The duck was good and odorless, but again, it was leftovers from the previous day; the meat was very dry. The quality for the price is considered expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanawat “TEDDY” K

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the braised goose; the taste was average, nothing outstanding. The braised pork knuckle with steamed buns wasn't very flavorful either. The duck intestines and water spinach were okay. In summary, the goose and braised pork knuckle were just passable. Parking was good and the restaurant was clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: rakpong aroon

sample_reviews_en.text:
The goose, which was small, and the crispy pork were okay. # The goose seemed like it was sliced ​​up from scraps; there was very little of it, truly small as the name suggests. Importantly, it was old and had a very unpleasant smell.
The crispy pork was okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: กิตติเชษฐ์ พงศ์จิระอังกูร

sample_reviews_en.text: Eating braised duck here is like eating goose, because the braising sauce recipe is the same as the famous braised goose of the Chua family in Tha Din Daeng. The price is standard. If you eat at the restaurant, there are many other dishes to try.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนินพงศ์ รัตนประสิทธิ์

sample_reviews_en.text: If you like Chinese food this is one of the places that can give you all i mean old style Chinese food the price is reasonable might be expensive for something but overall good Duck and Goose also available here Nice one
sample_reviews_en.author: Smile Baby

sample_reviews_en.text: Old school Chinese foods in local area. The service is good, auntie is very nice and smile with warm welcoming us. The must is slow cook vegetables soup call "chap - chai".
sample_reviews_en.author: Suchart Tangnimitchok

restaurants.name: MK Restaurants # Nawamin City Avenue
restaurants.address:

30/19-21 Moo 4, Nawamin City Avenue, Kaset-Nawamin Road, Chorakhe Bua, Khet Lat Phrao, Prasert-Manukit Rd, จรเข้บัว, ลาดพร้าว, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: The KTC promotion is great! Now, squid tentacles, crispy squid, and jellyfish have been added to the 299.-฿ buffet menu. With the KTC points redemption, the price is reduced to 149.-฿.
sample_reviews_th.author: S.Kidsanar แบกพุงไปกิน

sample_reviews_en.text: Why doesn’t this place have more reviews since it was packed from the moment we stepped in to the moment we left?! Seriously they were so busy staff were overwhelmed by the number of things they had to do. However that doesn’t mean they weren’t nice or friendly or graciously served us with a smile even though neither my partner nor I spoke a lick of Thai. The food was excellent, absolutely excellent and fresh. The water served was clean and delicious. The meals that came out looked humble but the flavor profile and portions were huge. I would rather eat here then at some of the fancier places in bkk. I will be back for more. Also really great value per bhat.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jennifer Estrada

sample_reviews_en.text: I eat at this MK branch very often. But now you have to get your parking ticket stamped for the first hour of free parking; you have to pay for each hour after that if you don't get your receipt stamped. The food quality is typical MK. As for the service, the staff are good, but there aren't enough staff to serve everyone. Sometimes, when you call a staff member, they're busy with other tasks, and it takes a very long time to get what you need. The orders seem confusing; you sit there for a long time, the main dishes arrive, but the vegetables you ordered still haven't come. I tried the regular dry sukiyaki and thought it was overpriced.
sample_reviews_en.author: ไอจะของจีน

sample_reviews_en.text: The elderly female employee, I'm not sure if she even wants to work, provides the worst service. She has unwelcoming facial expressions and treats customers like they don't want to serve them. We're not asking for free food, we're paying! That elderly employee stares at customers from head to toe, I'm not sure why she does that. If she's not willing to serve customers, she should quit. It was a terrible experience, the first time I've eaten here, and I will never come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pun Jolie

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted up to MK's standards, but the service urgently needs improvement. There weren't enough staff; even with 8 tables of customers, we had to follow up on our orders 2-3 times. Each staff member took our orders but didn't follow up. Customers had to wait anxiously for the bill, and no one made eye contact. They just walked past. It's near my house, but I won't be coming back. Bye!
sample_reviews_en.author: Manusavee Piyalohawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
MK's standards are complete and perfect.

I went there right when the restaurant opened. There was nobody there. The air conditioning was comfortably cool. The food came out quickly. The staff were attentive, refilling water and dipping sauces constantly.

This restaurant uses automatic serving machines, reducing contact and increasing cleanliness.

The food was as delicious as always.
sample_reviews_en.author: Achara Boonyawongvirot

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were so lovely and concerned, worried that my order might be incomplete. The staff member who took the order seemed to be new, still wearing a student uniform, but they were all very dedicated. I frequent this branch often because all the staff are wonderful, and most importantly, the food is fresh, delicious, and suits my taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayapaphar Tanespipat

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the worst service I've ever experienced at this branch. There are very few staff members, they don't refill tea, and we waited at least 10 minutes for our food. We called for service repeatedly, but no one paid any attention or came to check on us.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuttakit Mahavisessin

restaurants.name: นิยม.ปิ้งย่าง
restaurants.address:

นิยมปิ้งย่าง 1122 Phatthanakan Rd, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The beef quality was excellent. The pork belly was also fantastic, freshly sliced ​​for every order. The ingredients were very fresh. All the dipping sauces were delicious. It's not a buffet, but when you split the bill, it wasn't expensive at all.
For appetizers, we ordered marinated salmon and fried meatballs. We were so happy!
sample_reviews_en.author: DARA J

sample_reviews_en.text: This BBQ restaurant on the new Phatthanakan Road has great quality meat, delicious dipping sauces, and amazing service. The atmosphere is also great, with a cool breeze and a beautiful fish tank. Today they had free chilled beer, free meat, and free shaved ice! It was fantastic! I'll definitely be back and I'll bring my family.
sample_reviews_en.author: thananpat l.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, especially the grilled meat. It was fresh, tender, and flavorful. I recommend trying the grilled dishes. The dipping sauces were tasty, the service was good, and the prices were reasonable. They were having a Halloween event and offering discounts up to 50%!
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐพล ลอยเมฆ

sample_reviews_en.text: I'd give this place 10 stars! The food is amazing, and the prices are very reasonable considering the quality. The meat is delicious (highly recommended!). The service is top-notch. They offer two types of dipping sauces, both delicious. The ice-cold beer is fantastic!
sample_reviews_en.author: Natcha Yospoonno

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere at the restaurant is amazing! Coming after the rain was so relaxing 🤤 The dipping sauces are delicious; you have to mix the two together for the best taste! It's a unique dipping sauce unlike any other BBQ restaurant. I want to come every day 🥹 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Alice alice

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! The dipping sauce is unique and tasty. The sliced ​​pork belly is perfect. The service is excellent. The marinated shrimp is delicious and the seafood dipping sauce is a perfect match. This is my second time eating here and I'm very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pipattra Lipiphan

sample_reviews_en.text: The dipping sauces are excellent, both types are delicious. They use high-quality butter and the pork is top-notch. I highly recommend trying it. The atmosphere is nice and parking is convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nantiya Auareesuksakul

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious. The weather wasn't hot, there were fans. The meat was tasty, especially the Australian beef, which was amazing. It had a lovely buttery and meaty aroma. I loved it! …
sample_reviews_en.author: mind noname

restaurants.name: เตี่ยเฮง โจ๊ก ข้าวต้มปลา
restaurants.address:

ร้านเตี่ยเฮง โจ๊ก ข้าวต้มปลา, 15/326 ซอยเสือใหญ่อุทิศ(รัชดา36, จันทรเกษม, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I happened to drive past this restaurant. It's located on Sena Road, near Ratchada 36 and Suea Yai.
There's parking for about two cars in front, and more parking is available behind the restaurant. The restaurant is spacious and inviting.

The menu is beautifully presented, and the food looks exactly like the pictures.
I ordered the dry rice porridge with pork. The dipping sauce was a bit salty, probably a Chinese recipe. I recommend eating it with the soup; it's delicious.

The prices are reasonable. Highly recommended :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Suvicha Chusakulpattana

sample_reviews_en.text:
This breakfast spot is the right kind, located in a narrow alley. Parking is difficult due to a steep, sloping incline, and it's often crowded with delivery riders.

The shop itself looks clean and airy. The owner is present and friendly, always smiling.

The pork congee with egg was very cold, completely lacking in heat.
A huge disappointment, although the taste was acceptable.
The dry rice porridge was okay, but the sea bass had a lot of bones, so be careful.
**The restroom was extremely dirty; avoid it.**
sample_reviews_en.author: W. W.

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is good. I like the mixed dry rice porridge. I usually buy it to take home because it's close to my house. Even after taking it home and reheating it in the refrigerator, it's still delicious. It would probably be delicious if eaten at the restaurant. The price isn't cheap compared to the quantity and location, but it's not expensive compared to the quality and taste. There's only parking for about 2 cars in front of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phee S.

sample_reviews_en.text: I came at 9 am and there weren't many people. The congee was incredibly smooth and creamy. They also have crispy noodles, so if you like congee with crispy noodles, you'll definitely love it. Just add a little Maggi seasoning and it's delicious. The rice is fragrant; the aroma wafts from the shop when I drive past. It's delicious, you have to try it. The picture shows pork congee with egg for 50 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: รัชโยธิน ทิมทอง

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice porridge broth is wonderfully fragrant and delicious; it's not overly sweet from artificial seasoning. The fish isn't fishy, ​​and the soy sauce dipping sauce is amazing. The sukiyaki dipping sauce is also delicious, made with fermented tofu – a recipe I haven't had in a long time. The prices are also reasonable, and the restaurant is clean. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Soy s.

sample_reviews_en.text: The mixed seafood rice porridge has a fragrant broth, fresh seafood with no fishy smell, and the soy sauce dipping sauce is delicious. The dry sukiyaki also has a tasty sukiyaki dipping sauce. The wonton soup with roasted pork has a fragrant broth and good roasted pork. The prices are reasonable and the portions are generous.
sample_reviews_en.author: แพรวรุ้ง ฐานันดรสุข

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the ingredients are high quality, the atmosphere is great, and the price is reasonable. It would be perfect if the restaurant could improve the heating (it's quite hot inside), but overall, it's excellent value for money. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kobkit Piromyaporn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Generous portions of food.
Dry sukiyaki: served with a light broth, not spicy, with a strong fermented tofu flavor.

Pork bone congee: tasty.

The restaurant has many ceiling fans, but they are broken and cannot be turned on.
There is limited parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: MessageFromFah (Fah)

restaurants.address:

sample_reviews_th.text:
Fish Ball Noodle Soup

Located in Soi Rangnam, on the Ratchaprarop side. I ordered dry noodles; the noodles were soft, the fish balls and fish cake were delicious, and the fried wontons were crispy and tasty. There was also minced pork.

The Tom Yum soup was also good. This shop's fish balls are truly delicious. Overall, it was very good. A regular bowl is 60฿.

I'll definitely come back again when I have the chance.
sample_reviews_th.author: Wanvi K

sample_reviews_th.text:
The taste is on the sweet side. Lots of ingredients. 100฿ for this bowl. Overall, it's okay.

Please specify clearly whether you want it with broth or dry.
So the vendor won't get confused.
Because I thought spicy noodle salad was supposed to be with broth, haha. Never mind, I can eat it all...
I didn't write clearly enough.
sample_reviews_th.author: Nengz A&P

sample_reviews_th.text: The portion size is very small compared to the 60-70฿ price for a bowl of Yen Ta Fo (Thai noodle soup).
sample_reviews_th.author: Jinny Apsrr

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lee Heng Kee Noodle Shop
A legendary fish ball and yen ta fo noodle shop, recommended by Shell Shuan Chim (a Thai food review website).
Located in Soi Rangnam since 1980,
its original recipe comes from the Talat Noi area. It's known for its authentic Chinese flavor, clear and savory broth, and fresh, homemade toppings that are not fishy.
It also features roasted pork and fried wontons, just like in Talat Noi. Location: Located on the roadside in Soi Rangnam, Phaya Thai Subdistrict, Ratchathewi District, Bangkok (on the side closer to Ratchaprarop Road). Opening Hours: Open Monday - Friday and Sunday, 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM (Closed every Saturday).
Lee Heng Kee Noodle Shop
sample_reviews_en.author: Vit

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Hey! The customer said let's eat noodles first!"
I couldn't refuse, haha.

Cut to the shop: Wow! It looks traditional, old-fashioned, which I love...a lot!

I ordered dry noodles first...the noodles were soft, the wontons were crunchy with a loud sound, haha. There was a decent amount of meatballs too. Before I knew it, the bowl was empty! 😆😆😆

So I ordered another bowl of dry thin noodles...Hey! The noodles were so soft, delicious!

Total: 4 bowls, 240 baht.
The customer also ordered 'Kiem Yee' (a type of noodle dish), a hard-to-find menu item. 😆
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr. Chokchai Metapipattanakul

sample_reviews_en.text:
A small noodle shop in a single-room building.
Not many tables, it gets busy around lunchtime.
If you want to go when it's less crowded, I recommend coming in the late morning or after 1 PM.
The fish ball noodles are delicious, not fishy at all, and have a nice chewy texture.
The dumplings are tasty, both boiled and crispy fried.
The flat noodles are also delicious.
They offer clear broth, tom yum, and yen ta fo (pink noodle soup) options.
The prices are not too expensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shutisara Wongwenai

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste (the soup is delicious), portion size, and price are all OK.
(Personally, I like the atmosphere in the restaurant. It's like a family running the business together. The restaurant is packed with customers, chatting and enjoying the food. I love this kind of atmosphere; the restaurant has charm.)
If you like the taste of Chinatown, I recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gim Siri

sample_reviews_en.text:
67.02.12_Today I'm taking you to try this restaurant. It's authentic traditional Chinese cuisine. The soup is on the milder side, but it has a nice aroma. Overall, it doesn't stand out in any particular aspect. I think I'll have to try the dry noodle salad, it might be good.
The price is on the expensive side. The highlight is probably the fish balls.
sample_reviews_en.author: ห๊ะะะ

sample_reviews_th.text:
🇹🇭It’s what you’re looking for
🇹🇭Family vibe
🇹🇭ChillAF with good music & food

Wandering around the Green Lung on the bicycle, I once again found myself by the water. Drawn in by the sounds and smells of broth and grill pork…had to chill. Leo, noodles #Thiccc, expats speaking Thai, chirping Parrot, วิวทิวทัศน์ที่สวยงาม, and ‘grab the beer from the cooler’ self service that reminds me of Korea (South Korea not North Korea)

Chill here and contribute to the vibe
sample_reviews_th.author: Ibrahim

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a grocery store located by the pier.
They have Cremo ice cream (delicious!),
a full range of drinks from water and soft drinks to herbal drinks, sparkling and non-sparkling beverages in every color 😁,
and also noodles and other made-to-order dishes.
The noodles are tasty,
but the basil chicken rice was a bit bland.
The prices are cheap, the atmosphere is nice, and there's a view of the Chao Phraya River.
The owner is lovely and friendly.
Parking is easy to find; just park along the roadside,
or ask a motorcycle taxi driver there.
Then walk to the pier.
The store is right at the pier entrance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thepakbung

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant, now known by a new sign, is called "Hanging Leg Noodles." The atmosphere is unique, with bar-style tables where you sit with your legs dangling over the water, but regular tables are also available. Regarding the noodles, the Tom Yum is highly recommended; it's flavorful and rich. A highlight is the high-quality shrimp meatballs and the generous amount of fragrant, slightly saucy minced pork, which pairs perfectly with the traditional Tom Yum pork noodles. Locals shouldn't miss this place; it's considered the best in this area.
sample_reviews_en.author: DukeTK

sample_reviews_en.text: The riverside atmosphere is lovely, with a cool breeze. Today I ordered a special Tom Yum noodle soup with thin noodles and a bottle of water with ice. The noodles tasted great, no need to add any extra seasoning. My only complaint is that the crispy pork cracklings were a bit rancid. Everything else was perfect. The price was inexpensive, 50 baht for the special and 10 baht for the water, totaling 60 baht for the meal. If you're passing by, you should try it. However, parking for cars can be difficult due to the narrow road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tony Namkhing

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is practically a hidden gem. They serve an old-fashioned noodle dish that's tasty but has a slightly sweet aftertaste. They also have a la carte dishes which are decent, but the crispy pork isn't quite up to par. The atmosphere is nice, right by the Chao Phraya River.

🚙 Parking is available on the right before the restaurant.

♿️ Access is possible, but you'll need someone to help carry your luggage as there are some uneven surfaces.
sample_reviews_en.author: NoBi Kung

sample_reviews_en.text: Come relax and chill out at this casual, inexpensive riverside restaurant. The food isn't outstanding, not something you absolutely have to try, but the real draw is the view and the down-to-earth, local atmosphere – it's like living right by the river. There's a constant breeze, but be prepared for intense heat from the sun. Parking is available along the roadside, so be careful when turning around as there's no designated U-turn area.
sample_reviews_en.author: bankbunnie S.

sample_reviews_en.text:
3Dec25,
My third day in 2025, we took the big ferry from Wat Bang Na Nok which cost 5 Bth per person. Rent a bicycle, 50bth per bike. We ride here after we stop by the Cafe and Homestay.
This Thai noodles Shop is a tiny eating place where you can big view over Chao Praya River overseeing big container port.
Enjoy the sea breeze and a bowl of pork Kuateaw (minced pork soup noodle.
sample_reviews_en.author: alan yong

sample_reviews_en.text: Personally, I think the food tastes okay, average. The owner provides good service and is very friendly 👍👍. The restaurant is located at the end of Bang Kob Bua Road. It's an open-air restaurant by the Chao Phraya River with a great view. You can see from Phra Khanong, Khlong Toei, and Sathorn. The restaurant isn't very big. You can park in the parking lot or on the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuch S

restaurants.name: Lazy Sol
restaurants.address:

180 Lat Phrao 26 Alley, Chom Phon, จตุจักร Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere and the music is perfectly to my taste. The menu offers a wide variety of delicious dishes. Today I had the mackerel rice bowl, which was amazing. I finished with dessert and some wine – a complete and satisfying experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: E

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, especially the fried rice with grilled shrimp – it was clearly well-prepared and thoughtfully made. The restaurant has a nice, chill atmosphere with a great vibe. There's parking available and the service is good. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Cher T.

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my go-to restaurant. I go almost every day. The staff are lovely and friendly. The food is delicious, 100/100. The atmosphere is relaxed. On Fridays and Saturdays, there's live music late at night. The drinks are also very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Palm

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere at the restaurant is very cozy, like eating at home. It's clean, and the staff are friendly. It's a great place to chill out. The food is delicious; the bacon carbonara spaghetti is especially good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suparicha

sample_reviews_en.text: The best spot near LadPrao MRT…Foods are delicious and can get a premium coffee taste. Can also study or work for a long time. Prices are reasonable and Pet is also allowed. Love this cozy space.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jing Gui Ming

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious! The flavors were rich and intense. The fried rice had a wonderful wok aroma, and the spaghetti was especially delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuttanicha Poolwas

sample_reviews_en.text:
The quiet atmosphere is great, the water is delicious, and the food is delicious too.
The air conditioning is nice and cool.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ponpimon Pankeaw

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is beautiful, the atmosphere is great, and the rice with mackerel is incredibly delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeeraporn Wichaiphoosit
