restaurants.address:

263 ถ. เทอดไท Bang Yi Ruea, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Highly recommended for boat noodle lover. Good portion and price (normal 40 extra 50) i order noodle with braised beef and raw beef เนื้อหมก. It is so gooood!
sample_reviews_th.author: Natty Soponviriyanon (Nattybearound)

sample_reviews_en.text: ...This Ayutthaya-style boat noodle shop is located opposite Wat Intharam, right by the bus stop. They offer both pork and beef options. I ordered the small rice noodle soup (Nam Tok style). The broth was quite salty and sour when served, not quite to my liking. Adding chili powder and sugar made it perfect, as the broth was already rich and flavorful. The noodles were chewy and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: MrStew LuiRoj

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodle soup has a well-balanced flavor. Adding the stir-fried chili peppers makes it even better with a little extra spiciness. The bowl is large, and some of the meat is a bit chewy, so it takes a while to eat. The oil seems to stay hot for a long time, indicating it's been boiling vigorously, which is perfect for someone like me who enjoys a leisurely meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: a sone

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork noodle soup is usually tasty, but the beef waterfall noodle soup is exceptionally delicious. It's so good, it's out of this world! The restaurant is located opposite Wat In.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phasit Maliphan190

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, generous portions, and affordable, but a little too salty for my liking (I don't like salty food). I've eaten there 4 times.
sample_reviews_en.author: GLITZY WOMAN

sample_reviews_en.text:
The herbal broth was a bit too strong,
but the crispy pork cracklings were delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: ปริญาภรณ์ รวงผึ้ง

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste wasn't to my liking, and the bowl was too big. I expected a smaller bowl.
sample_reviews_en.author: sompra suakasem

sample_reviews_en.text: It's delicious, just like the boat noodle recipe, but the portion is a bit small.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sumete Claew-sri

restaurants.address:

712 Muban Di Somchok Soi 1, Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍜 The mala pork bone soup is rich and flavorful. There's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, and the food is prepared very quickly. ✅ The staff are lovely, welcoming, and provide excellent service. I highly recommend this place! 💖

📍 There's parking available, it's easy to find, and there's plenty of seating, so it's not crowded.
sample_reviews_en.author: Namwan Chadaphon

sample_reviews_en.text: The broth is delicious, and there's a huge variety of ingredients to choose from. There are also many dipping sauces. I've finally found a truly honest shabu-shabu restaurant where you pay by weight! 💗 This is now one of my favorite restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: ข้าว จ้าว

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant is near my house, and I eat there very often, at least twice a month. They have a wide variety of dishes to choose from, and all the soups are delicious. I can confirm they are incredibly tasty!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wichaya Sirisom

sample_reviews_en.text:
So good!!! Delicious, the dipping sauce is great.
I eat here very often, but there's no parking. That's forgivable because it's so delicious. The restaurant is very clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suwaneeeye Seeda

sample_reviews_en.text: The soup base tastes delicious, and there's a good selection of ingredients. There's also a wide variety of dipping sauces. You can also use your Thai Plus benefits here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chinta Sroyhin

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a great restaurant with a wide selection of dishes and soups. The staff are welcoming, there's a large selection of drinks, and the food is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: พรหมพิริยะ ศรีสุวรรณ

sample_reviews_en.text: This is another one of my favorite restaurants. Every time I eat here, the food is always delicious. There's a huge variety of food to choose from!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kew' TTcr

sample_reviews_en.text: The service is good, and the soup tastes consistently good every time I visit. I've become a regular customer without even realizing it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nathapat Pongsaicharoen

restaurants.name: FOWLMOUTH theCOMMONS Saladaeng
restaurants.address:

The COMMONS, 126 Saladaeng, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A perfect 10 experience at FOWLMOUTH (theCOMMONS Saladaeng). If you like fried chicken with a spicy and authentic touch, this is the place for you.
What we liked most:
• The Chicken (Nashville Style): Spectacular. The breading is super crispy and the meat is very juicy. The best part is that you can choose the spice level (from none to "Death"). We tried the Hot Chicken Burger and the Tenders, and the portions are very generous. Be careful with the spice level, though; I ordered medium and it was very hot, and I like spicy food.

• Sides: Don't miss the Curly Fries and the Mac & Cheese; they are the perfect complement to the spice.

• The Atmosphere: Located inside theCOMMONS, the place is modern, semi-open, and has beautiful architecture. It's a very social and relaxed space, ideal for dinner with friends or a quiet drink.
Bonus points:
• Service: Very fast and efficient.

• Quality: The chicken is clearly fresh and of good quality (no hormones or antibiotics).

Verdict: It's a bit more expensive than typical Bangkok street food, but the quality of the product and the atmosphere at theCOMMONS justify every Baht. Highly recommended if you're in the Silom/Saladaeng area!
sample_reviews_en.author: Salvador Sevillano

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered the chicken bites. Hot. With ranch.

The chicken pieces were nice and juicy.

To be fair I’m not really familiar with Nashville style fried chicken. Maybe it’s not my favorite style of fried chicken. I love fried chicken, the preparation was on point. However, I did not really like the flavor of the seasoning and it was rather dry and tasted like it was added after frying instead of integrated into the batter. Maybe that’s the style.

The “hot” is #3 out of 5 levels of spicy. It was very spicy 🥵. I’m used to eating spicy Thai and Mexican food. This is a different type of spicy. Not really adding flavor just heat. I would go for the level #2 next time.

I will certainly return and try some other menu items. The chicken sandwich looks really good and I will try next time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neen

sample_reviews_en.text:
I recently stumbled upon this incredible food venue that has completely blown my mind! It’s like a world tour for your taste buds, featuring everything from mouthwatering American burgers and crispy fries to refreshing Japanese sake and poke bowls.

And if you’re a beer lover, you’ll definitely want to check out their amazing selection of crafted international beers. Oh, and don’t forget about the pho – it’s absolutely heavenly!This place is perfect for the younger crowd looking to take a break from Thai food and explore delicious flavors from around the globe.

If you’re in need of a foodie adventure, I highly recommend visiting this gem! You won't regret it!
sample_reviews_en.author: MR MR

sample_reviews_en.text:
I asked for mild but the chicken wings are super spicy and super small, so westerners should ask for buttermilk / normal level
And get a spicy sauce. I went to tell the employees and they said it’s spicy level so stuck with $10 / 300B food. The chicken wings are super small and the Texas toast is just plain toasted white bread, should have garlic or butter. Tator tots and pickles taste old, not fresh . they charge 30B for extra sauce. Profit driven street food in a good location but it’s not worth the price or effort to come here again. Very loud bass music in this food court, only good thing is free water by the door.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ethan L

sample_reviews_en.text:
During COVID, I ordered from this place quite often. Today, I finally arrived at the store and decided to order something.

It's located on the 2nd floor of The Commons Saladaeng. There were 4-5 staff members inside. I waited for 5 minutes before I had to ask, "Is the store open yet?" Only then did a staff member come to take my order.

I asked the staff member and they said the store opens at 8:00 AM, according to mall time. Some items might not be ready for sale yet.

After ordering, I picked up my food and sat together in the central seating area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prassy Srikittichai

sample_reviews_en.text: Spicy, intensely hot, tears streaming down your face! Large, hot pieces of chicken with many side dishes to choose from. They also offer a discount on drinks. There's a bit of a wait, likely because it's freshly fried. I ordered extra spicy, and it was genuinely spicy! No wonder there's a no-refund sign – maybe some people can't handle it. I paired it with coleslaw, biscuits, and lemon tea. Overall, it was delicious. The atmosphere is lively, with people meeting up in a common area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Padchy K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fried chicken with waffles were very nice. Chicken was crisp and juicy, and you can choose how hot you want it to be. I appreciate the buttermilk option as well.

A bit pricey, but it was rather filling for 2 people. The syrup has a slight caramel taste to it.

The Commons eating area is pretty chill during the afternoon as well. Glad we decided to dine here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rana

sample_reviews_en.text: Chickens and Waffles here are so so good! I chose Hot level for chicken, it’s perfect spiciness for me, the skin is crunchy and tender inside, recommended to eat with Mississippi Comeback sauce, so yummy! and the waffles are superb! better than some waffles shop, never expected to be this good and the maple syrup here is good too. Highly recommend ;)
sample_reviews_en.author: Hathaikorn W.

restaurants.name: Reply very soon
restaurants.address:

บ้านเลขที่ 25 Suphakit Alley, Khwaeng Suan Luang, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Reply Very Soon Homie Cafe feels like a warm, cozy home.
It truly gives the vibe of hanging out at your best friend’s house when you were a kid.

The café is decorated with lots of Disney toys—Toy Story, Ratatouille, Lady and the Tramp, and more—which adds a fun, nostalgic touch.

They offer only medium-roast coffee beans, which work perfectly for iced lattes (my usual choice). The banoffee is a must-try—not too sweet, but rich with coffee and chocolate flavors.

There are different seating options: desks for working, a big table for group hangouts, and a small couch for relaxing with a good book.

Bonus point: there are furry staff members here 🐾
I met one today—his name is Cruikshank (hope I spelled it right 😅).

Parking is limited, so driving isn’t recommended. There are only two parking spots in front of the house else you need to find street parking yourself.
sample_reviews_en.author: Intera Phongsawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
A super cute, homey cafe in the Rama 9 area. The shop is decorated very adorably, with a retro and charming vibe. The lighting is beautiful, and every corner is stylishly decorated. Plus, there's a cat to welcome customers. The cakes and drinks are delicious and tasty, and the prices are reasonable.
Location: Rama 9 Soi 62, House No. 25
Getting there: MRT Hua Mak (Yellow Line), then take GRAB or a motorcycle taxi.
Opening hours: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM. Closed Monday and Tuesday.
sample_reviews_en.author: OK CHAK BAN

sample_reviews_en.text:
This cafe felt like visiting a lovely friend's house, and it was so healing!
I only came to take pictures, but the cats entertained me and were so comforting!
I don't usually play with cats, but this white cat was so cute! 🥹💖

The drinks were pretty good, and the food looked exactly like the pictures, although it got a little bit cloying after a few bites.

I'll definitely visit again when I have the chance! 🤍ྀི
sample_reviews_en.author: puffypocket

sample_reviews_en.text: The interior of the cafe is incredibly cute, decorated like a childhood friend's house, filled with adorable toys and collectibles, especially Disney items, scattered throughout the cafe. Each corner is perfect for taking photos. Reply Very Soon is ideal for anyone looking for a cute cafe with beautiful photo opportunities, or a place with delicious food in a relaxed atmosphere to unwind on their day off.
sample_reviews_en.author: toon Chanatip

sample_reviews_en.text: This cute cafe is tucked away in a house at the end of a small alley. There's some parking available inside the alley. Reviews mentioned a cute cat that greets guests, but today it was sleepy and napping in a corner on the front fence. I tried the matcha clear, and although it's culinary grade, the taste was good – not too bitter or astringent, and worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: cosmo

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a great restaurant. The food is delicious, and the cakes are absolutely amazing. My only complaint is I'm not sure if the air conditioning is working or if it's broken, as it was quite hot. Having air conditioning would be fantastic. Also, the food took a little while to arrive. But the cat is very smart and adorable!
sample_reviews_en.author: Phatara Pattanasin

sample_reviews_en.text: This cafe is so cute! It has a cozy, homey feel, great atmosphere, and plenty of seating. I almost couldn't find it at first; I found it after seeing a review on a Facebook page. The cat is adorable! The food tastes good and is reasonably priced. The Clear Matcha drink was okay, not bitter.
sample_reviews_en.author: Antventure

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a cafe with both indoor and outdoor seating areas. They sell drinks and food, and there are tons of great photo opportunities. I happened to be doing a workshop there in the afternoon, and it got quite crowded. There are two adorable cats there.
sample_reviews_en.author: AEA Charoenkool

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเนื้อ เกาเหลาเนื้อ
restaurants.address:

1731 20 ถ. เจริญกรุง Yan Nawa, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Beef noodle and beef soup shop next to Wat Sutthi, Charoen Krung 65.
Go about 300 meters into the soi (alley), it's on the left. There's a sign for pork blood soup at the entrance of the soi.
This shop has offal, tender beef, and beef slices.
They have both spicy and thick broth options.
The taste is good, the soup is fragrant, and the price is reasonable.
Beef lovers should try it.
I ordered dry vermicelli noodles with everything except spleen:
50 baht.
Beef soup with mixed ingredients, except spleen: 60 baht.
Beef soup with tender beef only: 60 baht.
Ice (per glass).
Total: 172 baht.
Filling and satisfying meal.
The shop is closed every Sunday.
Open 7:00 AM - 3:00 PM.
Beef noodles, beef soup.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vit

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good taste, worth the price.
The beef is perfectly tender.
The broth is not sweet, but has a fragrant beef aroma.
The vegetables include Chinese water spinach.
It's a shop located down an alley next to the temple.
You can find it on Google Maps; the pin is accurately placed.
There are 6 tables for seating.
For beef lovers, I recommend giving it a try.
You might even find it so delicious that it becomes your regular spot.

Food, service, and atmosphere are subjective; there's no right or wrong answer.
Some people may or may not like it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kitipong Jitmaitree

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a beef noodle soup and beef stew shop.
It's really delicious! Usually, beef offal has a strong smell,
but this shop prepares it very cleanly. There's hardly any smell at all.
The stewed beef is perfectly tender; not too soft and mushy, and not too tough.
They also have a wider variety of offal than other places.
The broth has a good flavor, not too salty. Overall, it's great.
The price is also affordable. The quality and quantity are worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panthit R.

sample_reviews_en.text:
A lawyer's daily routine: After fighting cases at the Bangkok South Civil/Criminal Court, the first thing to do is enjoy a hot bowl of beef noodle soup near the courthouse. The essential energy boost! Delicious and refreshing, ready to tackle work again.

The broth at this shop is clear but rich and flavorful, with tender, easy-to-eat pieces of beef.
sample_reviews_en.author: dusit rasniyom law office

sample_reviews_en.text: I saw a recommendation for this place. It's a bit of a hidden gem; you have to walk into an alley next to Wat Sutthi School and turn left at the first alley. Today I ordered the mixed noodle soup, and the taste was decent. The price is also reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: akom

sample_reviews_en.text: This hidden gem of a restaurant is tucked away in an alley. Give it a try! I ordered the beef tendon and meatball soup. Overall, it was okay; the broth tasted good. The only downside was the rice was a bit hard.
sample_reviews_en.author: เอกลักษณ์ วรกิจจานุวัฒน์

sample_reviews_en.text: This noodle shop's beef noodle soup is fragrant and delicious. Overall, it's good, but there are a lot of mosquitoes, so I recommend wearing long pants.
sample_reviews_en.author: New Nuch

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great taste, Great value for money, Easy going owner.
Really recommend this hole in the wall Beef Noodle Shop.
Unsweetened soup is sublime.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kowit Kay

restaurants.name: ครัวตาสุข ลาดพร้าว64
restaurants.address:

71 Lat Phrao 64 Yaek 4 Rd, Khwaeng Wang Thonglang, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hidden gem in Soi Ladprao 64, "Krua Nakorn" serves authentic, flavorful Southern Thai cuisine from Nakhon Si Thammarat. The atmosphere is fantastic; a cozy, homey setting with cool air conditioning perfect for relaxing for hours.

• Spicy Mussel Curry: Thick and creamy, with an intensely rich and flavorful taste.
• Stir-fried Pork Belly with Stink Beans: Large, crunchy stink beans, not at all bitter, and incredibly flavorful.
• Crispy Fried Sandfish with Turmeric: Fragrant and crispy, a truly enjoyable dish.

Finish your meal with refreshing desserts and smoothies – everything you need in one place. The service is very friendly. If you're in the Ladprao area, you absolutely must check this place out!
sample_reviews_en.author: มกรธวัช รัตนารักษ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today was my first time trying this place, based on the great reviews I'd seen.
I ordered: Stir-fried shrimp with shrimp paste and bitter beans: Very salty, but edible with rice; Deep-fried pork belly with fish sauce: Well-fried, but too salty, edible with rice; BUT! The worst was the yellow curry with sea bass and coconut shoots: Just the smell was incredibly fishy! And when I tasted it, I couldn't stand it. So, so fishy!!! I'm usually a huge fan of Southern Thai food, but this was just too much. It lacked the authentic Southern Thai curry flavors. Extremely disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lanyata Kosachan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time eating here. I was riding my motorbike past and the aroma of the stir-fried shrimp paste was so fragrant that I turned back to try it.
I ordered the stir-fried three pungent vegetables and the deep-fried pork belly with fish sauce.
I have to say, it was great 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻 The flavors were excellent, no compromises. I also ordered the spicy snail curry, which was not bad at all.
I'll definitely come back next time to try other dishes.

Thank you to Grandpa Suk for making such delicious food 🙏🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Akekun LightCatcher

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Southern Thai restaurant has parking for about 6-7 cars.
The food tastes very good.
The lemongrass salad is delicious.
I wouldn't recommend ordering the papaya salad.
Overall, almost everything is delicious considering the price.
The staff provides good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: OUM Waranya

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time visiting this restaurant.
The place looks simple, and the atmosphere is pleasant.
The food tastes great; they serve authentic Southern Thai cuisine.
The prices are very reasonable considering the portion sizes and taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Melomind

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, great flavor, well-seasoned, freshly ground curry paste. The food was a bit slow to arrive, but worth the wait. Not recommended for people with cat allergies; it's almost unbearable!
sample_reviews_en.author: RATCHANON THEPPABUTRA

sample_reviews_en.text: Nam Prik Jom (Thief's Chili Paste) is delicious! If you like Southern Thai food at affordable prices, you should definitely try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิศัลยา พงศ์เพชรบัณฑิต

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered yellow curry with sea bass for delivery, good taste, big fish, good curry paste_full of southern curry flavor
sample_reviews_en.author: PS Suphaphorn

restaurants.name: Turnip Cake Wat Intharam
restaurants.address:

PFFJ+9VV Wat Intharam Worawiharn, Bang Yi Ruea, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a radish cake shop I've been eating at since I was a kid. When I'm in Talat Phlu, I always stop by. From the father's generation to the son's, the queue used to be long, with a bit of a wait. But after reviews went viral on social media, the queue is even longer now, to the point where they have to hand out queue numbers. I went on Sunday, July 13th.
It's slightly less delicious than the father's version 😁 but still tasty. I love the double egg yolk version. The radish cake isn't too heavy on the flour, it's moist, and it goes perfectly with the chili in the chili vinegar sauce.
They only sell on Saturdays and Sundays.
#WipaSaysIt'sGoodTryIt
#WipaWadeeLongsi
sample_reviews_en.author: Wipa Sappakijtipakorn

sample_reviews_en.text:
Inexpensive and delicious radish cakes. Open only on weekends. I went before 9 AM, but it was very popular and mostly frequented by locals. The staff's attentiveness and customer service were excellent.

They hand out numbered cards at the beginning, so be sure to take one. A staff member will come to ask you when your turn is approaching.

I waited 40 minutes, but the sight of them making the cakes and the market atmosphere were so enjoyable that I didn't mind the wait.

The stainless steel plates really enhance the local feel. The light and delicious seasoning is great.

Payment is by cash or QR code.
sample_reviews_en.author: Cha Tora

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stopped by unintentionally. I saw the stir-fried radish cake in the pan and it smelled so delicious. I ordered the special with double eggs for 50 baht.

The stir-fried radish cake was dry, not greasy, and the flavor wasn't too strong – delicious as is without needing any seasoning. The bean sprouts were still crispy, and the eggs were soft, not overcooked.

The man who was stir-frying the cake was very welcoming. After ordering, they provided a table for me to sit at and I could order other dishes to eat as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bunnarach Punnarach

sample_reviews_en.text:
Round 1: We usually love eating stir-fried radish cake.
We ordered it to go, with two eggs for 45 baht.
Even after it cooled down at home, it was still fragrant and delicious. It was stir-fried with minimal oil, which was great.
The radish cake batter was good, the eggs were perfectly cooked, and the bean sprouts were still crispy. Full marks!
This is definitely a place we'll go back to again.

Went back for a second time, and it was just as delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pukan Suphansa

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're in the Talat Phlu, Wutthakat area or nearby and love radish cake, I recommend the radish cake shop at Wat In. The aroma from the wok is amazing, and the taste is delicious – no need to add any extra seasoning. You might have to wait in line for a while, but the taste is worth the wait! You can park on the street near Wat Chantharam or Wat In and walk into the alley next to the temple. The shop is only open on Saturdays and Sundays.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuch S

sample_reviews_en.text: I was really looking forward to eating beef noodle soup. I parked my motorbike and saw people waiting for something. At first, I thought it was congee because I saw chicken eggs. Turns out it was my favorite: radish cake with egg. It was stir-fried a bit wet, not dry, and the flavor was mild; you can add seasonings yourself. Personally, I only added pickled chili in vinegar, and that was enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฏดนัย แย้มเฉลียว

sample_reviews_en.text:
Even from afar, you can hear the sound of the wok clanging. The vendors, from the father's generation to the son's, stir-fry while clanging the wok. Nowadays, they've had to use two stoves, resulting in long queues. The taste is delicious and suits my palate, and the price is reasonable.
They sell out by late morning. Those who want to eat here can park at Wat Intharam (South).
sample_reviews_en.author: Silp Ayukarn

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste is good, not greasy, and worth the price. The atmosphere is like eating by the temple fence... though it's quite hot.

The best part is the cook, an elderly man who is incredibly calm and friendly. He's not moody at all, even though it's extremely hot.

I recommend coming early to get a queue number because they usually sell out by 9:30 today.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rossana S.

restaurants.name: Santa Fé Steak
restaurants.address:

MH2V+CWH, Samrong Nuea, Mueang Samut Prakan District, Samut Prakan 10270, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: It’s easy and good variety of choices for Steak. It cooks in comfort taste and mixed of way to cook steaks in Thai and Western. I notice that price increased a bit but still acceptable. Staffs are prompt service but if you come on weekend that may ตtake a while to get your main steak dish. We had a spinach soup, Salmon Steak and Spicy Chicken. All dishes are ok.
sample_reviews_th.author: Miki T.

sample_reviews_en.text: On January 8th, 2025, I ate at the restaurant around 7:30 PM. I ordered, and it took until 8:00 PM to receive my food. Because it was a steak, I had to wait. While I was eating, around 8:00 PM, a staff member came to check on my plate and see if I was finished. This felt very impolite. I could wait for my food, but why couldn't they wait for me to finish? They hadn't even cleared the table yet. Furthermore, I found a piece of plastic in my steak. The kitchen was closed, but the restaurant wasn't. If you're still taking orders, you should provide better service. I had to rush my meal because it seemed like the restaurant was closing and there were no front-of-house staff. Please improve this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arthitiya Tan

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located on the 2nd floor of Lotus Plus Mall Srinakarin, near the escalator, at the front of the area with many restaurants lined up.

The food is delicious, like usual, like every other restaurant.

But what impressed me the most,
and something I'd never tasted before, was...
...the pineapple juice with chili and salt...
Unbelievably delicious!
Especially for someone like me who never drinks pineapple juice.
The pineapple juice with chili and salt was amazing.
I'm impressed, it's really, really good.
sample_reviews_en.author: PATY ParSiNee

sample_reviews_en.text: Head up to the cinema area of ​​Central Bangna, before the stairs leading to the badminton courts, you'll find Santa Fe near where kids practice dance. Currently, they have steak topped with Hershey's chocolate sauce, which is unusual, so I ordered it. It was surprisingly good; the rich chocolate sauce paired well with the wood-smoked grilled chicken. The baked corn with cheese wasn't great though; it was bland, the corn wasn't of good quality, and the cheese was lumpy and not stretchy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suppasa Aimsaard

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere and food taste as expected from a major brand, but the attention to service needs improvement, especially the behavior and manners of the staff, particularly the cashier.
The person in the picture shouldn't use such poor manners towards customers. They shouldn't use sarcastic language with customers. Such rude behavior needs to be improved if they have any sense of customer service.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธัญญวัฒน์ แผ่นพงษ์ศิลป์

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff are lovely and the service is good.
The food didn't take long to arrive. The atmosphere is nice and not crowded.

However, I would like to point out that some of the staff members kept coming over to ask customers to scan a QR code to rate the service, which was disruptive to customers' mealtimes. It would be better to ask customers to do this during the payment process. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: SATURN__

sample_reviews_en.text:
The staff seemed confused; I took a takeout order, but they served it on a plate.
Then I ordered to eat in the restaurant. I ordered the Japanese rice with chicken steak and Jaew sauce, but the rice wasn't cooked properly. I asked for a replacement, but it was the same problem.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tutiya Yoosawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Spaghetti with sausage, tasted good.
Ribeye steak, ordered medium, came rare. Side dish: sautéed spinach with butter, very bland.
Kurobuta pork steak, some parts were undercooked.
Beer-marinated pork steak, very tender.
The staff provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: SE-G

restaurants.name: Spicy cat La Meow ล่าเมียว ซีคอนสแควร์ ศรีนครินทร์ หม่าล่า diy (seacon square ชั้น 4) 辣喵湘菜
restaurants.address:

Seacon Square, Srinakarin Shopping Mall, 55 Room No. 4009, 4th Floor, Srinagarindra Rd, Nong Bon, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time trying this place, specifically the pickled cabbage fish soup. We shared it between two people, adding mapo doufu, stir-fried green beans, and mala dumplings.

Everything was delicious, and the portions were quite large.

Most dishes had coarsely chopped garlic and scallions, which I loved! So satisfying!

I'll definitely have to bring my family here.

The green beans were especially flavorful and fragrant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kullawat Inthawat

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I'm the first customer at the restaurant! I've eaten here many times before and I'm hooked, so I came back again, haha. Today I ordered the L size, which gives me a whole fish to eat to my heart's content. It's as good as always, truly never disappoints!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nongluck Kangsadarn

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! The fish stew with pickled mustard greens is the best. This is my 4th visit! The fried chicken wings with chili and salt are also delicious. I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chutimon Thapana

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the restaurant was clean, and the staff provided excellent service. They were all lovely. I will definitely go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: ฟาติม๊ะ หมันวาหาบ

sample_reviews_en.text: Very delicious 👍 The soup was flavorful, the staff provided good service, the restaurant was clean, and the price was reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: อุไรวรรณ วงษาเคน

sample_reviews_en.text: The dry-fried mala dish was delicious, very flavorful. The fish stew with pickled mustard greens was also very tasty and spicy.
sample_reviews_en.author: อังคณา หลักหมั้น

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, there was a good selection of dipping sauces to choose from, and the soup was comforting.
sample_reviews_en.author: PT Pdz

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered three dishes and they were all delicious. The staff were also lovely and provided excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pang C.

restaurants.name: Sunbrew Cafe (ซันบรูว์ คาเฟ่)
restaurants.address:

374/9 Phetchaburi 12, Khwaeng Thanon Phetchaburi, Khet Ratchathewi, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A perfect 10/10! The drinks were delicious, but the service was even better. Our group was quite noisy when we went in, luckily there weren't any other customers.

Even though we were worried about the taste of a menu item that wasn't on the menu, the staff member still made it. It was surprisingly delicious! The staff member was also very friendly and attentive, answering all our questions. Even though she wasn't Thai, she spoke Thai very clearly. Please support them! It's located in Soi Phetchaburi 12, just a short walk in!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nitcha Maneechai

sample_reviews_en.text: I had a delicious latte here. Nice and air conditioned. An oasis from the heat. Nice calm music and friendly staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason Harris

sample_reviews_en.text: The drinks tasted great, the atmosphere was nice and relaxing. The staff were very attentive. I was very impressed!
sample_reviews_en.author: admin dotsheep02

sample_reviews_en.text: Excellent! You can tell the owner put a lot of effort into it. The drinks are delicious and the prices are good 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Tummawat Klaiwong

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious, it's mind-blowing! The matcha is so rich and flavorful. The atmosphere is great too. 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: nurse EXO'L

sample_reviews_en.text: The drinks tasted great, I really liked them. The atmosphere was nice, and the staff were very lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: DejponXoy Nawatham

sample_reviews_en.text: I highly recommend it. It's easy to get to, the food tastes great, and the price is reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: กิตติ เดชธิสา

restaurants.name: Central Bangna Food Court
restaurants.address:

MJ9M+QRV, Bang Na Nuea, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted okay, and the price was reasonable for a restaurant in a mall considering the portion size.

However, I would like to comment on the service.

On the day we visited, there was only one person working in the kitchen and three servers (I'm not sure if one of them was the manager). For a restaurant with only 12 seats, the staff-to-customer ratio wasn't low at all.

But I noticed the food was slow to arrive. I think this might be due to the insufficient staff in the kitchen.

Additionally, the three servers stood in a line at the payment counter, facing outwards and chatting without paying attention to the customers in the restaurant. They didn't seem to hear customers calling them. We only ate for a short time, but this happened twice.

Actually, the food at the restaurant, especially the Hainanese chicken rice, is quite delicious. If the staff were more attentive, the food would taste even better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Warisa Sihirunwong

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop front looks very delicious, so we stopped by for breakfast together.
We ordered the roast pork menu. Some menus do not allow you to choose the type of roast pork, whether it is the outer loin or the neck.

I chose the dry wonton noodles with roast pork. I got the outer loin, soft meat, good taste, delicious, served with a strong soup, Hong Kong style.
The wontons here are filled with pork and shrimp, the meat is firm, so it comes out hard, you have to chew a lot.

My sister ordered the wonton soup and the roast pork rice, which allows you to choose the outer loin or the neck.

The shop sells congee, rice, dry noodles, and soup noodles, all of which are soft noodles. There are crispy pork, roast pork, pork balls, and century eggs in the congee.

This shop has about 5-6 tables.
It is located on the ground floor between the Tops Supermarket and the Food Court.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ruttiya V.

sample_reviews_en.text:
I like that you don't need to exchange cards anymore; you can just scan at the entrance. The restaurant has a wide variety of dishes, making it fun to choose what to eat.

Som Tum Poo Pla Ra (papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce), Nam Tok Moo (spicy pork salad) from Phutai Gai Yang (grilled chicken restaurant) – asked for it spicy, and it was spicy and refreshing.

Khao Soi Mae Mi (Northern Thai curry noodle soup) – Khao Soi with 2 chicken legs, 85 baht. Filling until evening.

Pad Krapow Moo Tum (stir-fried basil with pork) from Cook Kee Mao (drunken chef) – very tender pork, not greasy, medium spicy, easy to eat.

Pad Krapow (stir-fried basil with pork) from a local restaurant – not very spicy, and lacked much basil aroma.

It gets quite crowded around lunchtime or 6 pm. The staff provides good service and constantly clears tables.
sample_reviews_en.author: K Phis

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located in the food court in front of Tops, easy to find. There are a decent number of tables available. After work, I walked around for a while trying to decide what to eat and this restaurant caught my eye with its Hainanese chicken rice set that included stir-fried vegetables. So I decided to try it. The taste was as it should be, and of course, the stir-fried vegetables made the meal even more flavorful. The dipping sauce was also good. To finish, a hot Chinese tea was a nice touch. I'll try other menu items next time I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: jesda yenjabok

sample_reviews_en.text: This Hainanese chicken rice stall is located in the food court of Central Mall. The chicken is just average; the meat isn't particularly tender or juicy. The soup tastes similar to a fish maw soup. There are only two dipping sauces: a soy bean paste sauce and a chili sauce. In my opinion, Singaporean Hainanese chicken rice with a sesame oil aroma is better. The price is reasonable at 140 baht for a set, which includes a generous portion of toppings and vegetables. Give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Art C

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Hong Kong-style roast pork rice and Hainanese chicken rice shop is a bit pricey, but the portions are worth it – enough to fill you up completely.

The taste is delicious and suits my palate. The chicken portion is a little small, but the deliciousness makes up for it. The rice is fragrant with garlic.

The roast pork is incredibly flavorful – a must-order. The shop is located opposite the cashier in the basement food court. There aren't many seats, only about 5 tables.
sample_reviews_en.author: ME ME

sample_reviews_en.text: My favourite Teppanyaki shop is gone.  The chef was excellent and the portions were huge.   He uses lots of garlic.  I think the reason it is gone is because most people going to the food court don't want to spend 170-300 baht.  Now there is a teppanyaki shop next to MK on the 2nd floor.  It is slightly more expensive and the portions are small.  He uses very little garlic :-(
sample_reviews_en.author: Lawrence

sample_reviews_en.text: Chicken rice stall in the food court area at Central Bangna. Kind of Hong Kong style. They have set menu which is worth the price. Taste and chicken were good, but maybe I’m not used to this style. They also serve crispy pork and BBQ pork, both rice and noodle. … but I think I prefer the Singaporean style stall, which is just a few steps away.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pipo Travelgeek

restaurants.name: Teppan France Kanda
restaurants.address:

1Fl., No.88, Thong Lo, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
A true 5-star experience. The moment you step into this warm, petite venue, you feel instantly transported. From the very first bite, Chef Toshiaki’s creations gently fill you with joy. Truly, you will sense his dedication: from the meticulous care in ingredients selection, the love in preparing each component, and the magic in crafting everything in-house.

Every dish was just perfectly harmonious, balanced, and thoughtfully created. The fish was cooked beautifully, with crisp skin and paired wonderfully with the special sauce. The hero of the night, the Wagyu steak, simply melted in the mouth.

To end the evening on a high note, all desserts were included and left as a playful surprise for you to explore. They were delicate, refined, and not at all overly sweet—just the perfect gentle kiss to close the meal.

Will definitely be back for more.
sample_reviews_en.author: Olan Ro

sample_reviews_en.text:
💯 Easy 5 stars!! Visited for lunch the first time and was so impressed that I had to come back for dinner. Every dish was delicious and fresh, and the chef is truly amazing. Chef Toshiaki is also an Iron Chef, which makes the experience even more special.

For the dinner set, the desserts are all made by the chef, you can choose your favorite or try them all.

The team is incredibly friendly, attentive, and provides outstanding service.

This will definitely become one of my regular spots!
sample_reviews_en.author: Saranya WRA

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited for my birthday (^^)
I could tell from the appetizers that everything was made with great care, and it was all delicious!
I was with my child, and there were many staff members who were all friendly and kind to us.
The meat and garlic rice were all delicious♪
I think it's perfect for a special occasion!
I would like to visit again 🫶
sample_reviews_en.author: ふぁみ

sample_reviews_en.text:
We always use this restaurant for anniversary dinners. Every time, we enjoy everything, including dessert, and are completely satisfied. 😊 Even my child, who usually dislikes raw food, always enjoys the food here and finishes it all, which surprises me.

I'd love to use it again for someone's birthday.
sample_reviews_en.author: M F

sample_reviews_en.text: The interior design is reminiscent of the Showa era. It has an old-fashioned feel and lacks a sense of luxury. It's a bit disappointing considering the price. I had Saga beef. The staff were clumsy. 😅 …
sample_reviews_en.author: masa

sample_reviews_en.text: Experience a French-style omakase dining experience with a wonderful Japanese twist. High-quality ingredients, a great atmosphere, and friendly chefs and sous chefs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nile Rusticboy

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious Teppan鐵板yaki with French cuisine touch．this is almost a private dining reservation.  Do not confuse it with sit down night market style teppan yaki
sample_reviews_en.author: RAY HSU

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's amazing to find teppanyaki of this quality at this price in Bangkok.

The meat is truly delicious, especially the tenderloin! The garlic rice is superb.
sample_reviews_en.author: mi7mi

restaurants.name: Potato Corner Central Rama 9
restaurants.address:

ชั้นB หน้า Tops market 9/9 Rama IX Rd, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10320, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Potato Corner is a well-known chain in Bangkok, famous for its fries. I grabbed some without waiting in line!

Located on the basement level of Rama 9 shopping mall.

A very noticeable storefront.
The decor is predominantly green.
I chose the BBQ flavor, a large size for 49 baht.

They're fried on the spot, taking about 3 minutes.

Then the staff shakes it in a plastic container to mix it.

It's really delicious, but remember to drink plenty of water afterward!

📍Address: ชั้นB หน้า Tops market 9/9 Rama IX Rd, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10320, Thailand

⏰Hours:

Monday-Sunday 10:00 AM - 9:30 PM

🅿️Indoor parking

Or directly accessible by MRT
sample_reviews_th.author: Le Le

sample_reviews_en.text: You can buy delicious fries at Potato Corner Central Rama in Bangkok. Better than the fries from McDonald's and Burger King. As Dutch people, we sometimes crave tasty fries. So, at Patat Corner, you can get delicious fries here. There are several branches in Bangkok. As far as we know, there are locations at MBK, Siam Paragon, Central World, Terminal 21, and Central Rama 9 in Bangkok. It is just a pity that you cannot sit down. You can only sit if you go to Siam Paragon and Central Rama, where the seating is small.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ludwig Beckker

sample_reviews_en.text:
I used my AIS points for a 30 baht discount.
I ordered the cheese-coated chicken popcorn and it cost only 59 baht (after claiming the discount in the myAIS app).
It was delicious, served hot and the food arrived very quickly, in less than 5 minutes.
The staff provided good service and recommendations. This branch is very fast-paced. I will definitely come back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jidapa Samphunjaroen

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered through the app around 9:20 PM. It arrived very oily, wilted and mushy. It was extremely greasy. My house isn't far from the store, and I received it very quickly. Even when I buy takeout from other branches, it's not like this. I'm disappointed. And I ordered the large size too.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐชา สุราฤทธิ์
akinko

sample_reviews_en.text: first time trying potato corner here and boyyyy it was so good!! i bought the super mega if im not wrong and the flavour was BBQ. not gonna lie, it is so good they gave a lot and the flavour is really solid just nice, not too salty but it …
sample_reviews_en.author: ri fieschi

sample_reviews_en.text: I bought here some times. But this time, it disappoint me. When i came to the counter, the boy here keep looking at the phone and typing withouth saying me to wait. What’s a disgrace. I will never buy anything from this again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Minh Dương Đức

sample_reviews_en.text:
You can enjoy freshly fried potatoes after ordering.

The actual boxes are displayed, which makes it easy to understand.

There are several flavors, and I think they could expand the selection even further!
sample_reviews_en.author: route 18

restaurants.address:

15/5 Hua Mak 13, Khwaeng Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious! The broth is fragrant with Chinese herbs, the braised meat is tender and melts in your mouth, and the soup is flavorful.
They cook pork and beef in separate pots.

The crab fried rice is delicious with a slight wok-burnt aroma.
The braised pork with basil is good, rich, and just the right amount of spicy.

There's parking, air conditioning, and restrooms.

The owner's daughter takes orders and speaks politely and courteously; the service is good.

In the evening, they sell fish porridge after 4 PM. It's also delicious, clean, the fish is fresh, and the broth is fragrant.

In short, I'm a regular customer at this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: kitirojass sritaniyakosit

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has both air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned seating areas. The service is good; order slowly and clearly. I've ordered both for takeout and ate in, and the taste is consistent. The broth is fragrant, and they offer both beef and pork. I recommend the Kobe beef vermicelli; the meat is tender and juicy. There's convenient parking available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ae Hellojaae Natechanok

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles were delicious, and the braised beef was very tender and soft. The portion size was quite small compared to the price, but the quality was excellent. The broth was rich and flavorful (though leaning towards salty). The staff provided good service, and there was parking available near the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: namwarn oumwang

sample_reviews_en.text:
Dong Mool Lek Noodles: The broth is flavorful, made with a traditional Chinese herbal stew. Besides noodles, they also offer other dishes like rice porridge.

Prices are reasonable for the portion size.

Service is good.

The venue has both air-conditioned and outdoor seating areas.

Parking is available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wannaporn Punudom

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located on the main road and has parking. They have a wide variety of dishes, including rice and noodle dishes (pork and beef). The taste is good and delicious. They also offer coconut ice cream with toppings. Cash and scan-to-pay are accepted.
sample_reviews_en.author: แมวเหมียวสีส้ม

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered beef noodle soup through Grab and received a very small portion for 100 baht. It was incredibly salty; even eating it with rice was difficult.

If this is normally the case, I wouldn't recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nucha Sibunruang

sample_reviews_en.text:
For meat lovers, I highly recommend this restaurant.
They also have pork, especially their braised pork which is delicious... Highly recommended. It's located by the roadside, easy to find, and has parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: supachai chaichalotorn

sample_reviews_en.text: The meat was tender and the broth was delicious. I ordered the hot pot noodle soup. The pot only stayed hot for a short time, but it was delicious. Each ingredient was tender and not chewy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Onweena Patta.

restaurants.address:

132 42 Ramkhamhaeng 24 Alley, Lane 34, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The noodles here are so good! The best chinese noodles I had in bangkok at this price (THB 90 per bowl)
The noodles are very chewy, and the sauce very homy too👍
There are also a variety of other chinese dishes, I tried the steamed chicken, stir fry vegetables.
The taste is like eating at home.

There is air-con available indoors and parking in front of the shop along the street👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Sabrina Wu

sample_reviews_en.text: This is like having real cuisine in China. So delicious and so rare. I've been looking for restaurants that have this cuisine and this place have it all. Great food, good price. Very delicious. The taste is just like the ones in China. I really like it. It's not expensive. It gives a lot. It's very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Imm

sample_reviews_en.text: The flavors are very authentically Chinese. The pig ear salad and tofu salad are very flavorful, but the pickled mustard greens soup is mildly sour, perhaps not very sour at all. The prices are reasonable per dish compared to other Chinese restaurants in the city. The spicy chicken isn't greasy either.
sample_reviews_en.author: Reiko Pitpatsorn

sample_reviews_en.text: Every dish was delicious and flavorful, and most importantly, the prices were excellent! If you're looking for Chinese food that feels like eating at a friend's house, I highly recommend trying this place. They have a diverse menu, and parking is available across the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manipa T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
We are locals and the price is reasonable for us.

Would to recommend for those passing through Huamark area.

We’ve tried the mutton and it turned out pretty good. Just the normal smell and no stink at all. Everything cooks to perfection.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miiw

sample_reviews_en.text: Some of the best noodles I've ever had.  You definitely get your money's worth here, too, as the bowls are HUGE!  I recommend the beef noodle soup or the spicy beef noodle soup.  Amazing.  The dumplings are excellent, too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Trey Adams

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste was just so-so. The xiaolongbao (soup dumplings) were made with advanced technology and ruthless skill; they were all frozen buns wrapped in tin foil, and I have no idea how old the meat was.
sample_reviews_en.author: peter 0971

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good food but a bit pricey.
Conveniently close to where we lived
A second time with my wife.
The first time with my nephew's couple and a family friend from Abec University.
I like their porkleg stew.
sample_reviews_en.author: Torontoian_007

194/26 Samae Dam, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: You don't need to go all the way to Central Department Store; you can enjoy delicious Japanese food at reasonable prices close to home. The sashimi, in particular, is thickly sliced ​​and delicious. It seems to be a family-run business, so there are few staff members and the food takes some time to prepare, but they prepare it carefully. I highly recommend you try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Moriyasu Sudo

sample_reviews_en.text: There's a Japanese restaurant near my house that's been open for a long time. The food is fresh, clean, and delicious, and most importantly, the prices are very reasonable. They have a wide variety of drinks to choose from, and all the staff are lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jittima

sample_reviews_en.text:
Reasonable prices. The salmon is incredibly fresh, premium buffet grade. The ramen is pretty good. I usually order via Grab.

P.S. I've corrected the restaurant name and phone number.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jzyunaza

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious and reasonably priced.
The staff provided good service, the atmosphere was nice, and the kids loved the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yaoyao Cho

sample_reviews_en.text: The salmon sashimi was very fresh. The service was good and delivery was fast. I was impressed from my first purchase. 👍 …
sample_reviews_en.author: Billionhome

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and reasonably priced. The salmon salad is excellent; the salmon is fresh and of good quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benjamaporn Matulaprungsan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is not too expensive. The restaurant is clean, the air conditioning is cool and inviting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sakol Kiattinai

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and reasonable price. Have many menu for sashimi Unagi and salmon . Very various menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ome PL

restaurants.address:

Siamese Gioia ซ.ทวีสุข สุขุมวิท 31 Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I really love coming to this little hidden  place, delicious food is prepared in front of you, the owner is lovely and accommodating. The drink menu has something new every few weeks as well. You can totally relax on the sofa and enjoy the bright fresh atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Clasina Erasmus

sample_reviews_en.text: The is my go-to place when I am in thonglor. The owner is super nice! Lots of food variety. I love the scrambled eggs and sausages a lot. Also recommend the iced latte and smoothie. Price is reasonable compared to similar places in this area. 5 star experience!
sample_reviews_en.author: kun li

sample_reviews_en.text: This wasn't a place I planned to visit; I stumbled upon it by chance. But I'll definitely come back. The atmosphere is relaxed, the food is delicious, the coffee is excellent, and the service is great.
sample_reviews_en.author: review review

sample_reviews_en.text:
I came for the healthy salads I saw pictures of on here, but when I got there, there were no salads on the menu. Also, a cafe shouldn’t charge you to plug in your device
I liked the drinks
sample_reviews_en.author: K

sample_reviews_en.text: A minimalist-style cafe with a lovely owner. All the drinks are delicious, and the simple food, including the tasty brunch, is great. I frequent this place whenever I'm at Nadao.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boonyanuch Patyuyean

sample_reviews_en.text: Bacon sandwiches, green smoothies, banana smoothies, orange juice, cappuccinos, and carbonara were our family's go-to choices. Everything was delicious. And Is is so charming!
sample_reviews_en.author: aki takano

sample_reviews_en.text:
Coffee is good, food options are basic but still good, very good value for money. Very wholesome place, lady who works there is lovely.

Very quiet and comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aiden Pearce

sample_reviews_en.text: Cozy place, feel comfortable to sit, owner is polite, friendly and provide proper service.Good selection of breakfast menu.Will definitely return.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rawiwan Boonmaprasit

restaurants.name: ร้านคุณย่าอลิน
restaurants.address:

1/1 ซอย11 มั่งมี Tha Raeng, Bang Khen, Bangkok 10220, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The reviews were an exaggeration. I came specifically for the crispy pork, and it was incredibly delicious! I usually love made-to-order dishes, especially crispy pork, and Grandma's shop lives up to its name. The skin is crispy, the meat is tender and not dry or tough. The stir-fried kale with crispy pork was perfect – not greasy, the oyster sauce was flavorful, and the spiciness was just right. This is the crispy pork and kale I've been waiting for! It's conveniently located near my house; I'll be a regular customer from Grandma now. I came around 11 am, and there wasn't much to wait for. Parking is available on the street. If there's a queue, wait a little; it's worth the wait. Grandma is lovely and does everything herself. Don't write down your order; just order directly from Grandma. She said she can't read handwriting very well, but she's amazing at remembering things! The rice was also excellent – ​​not too hard, not too soggy, perfect for someone like me who loves authentic jasmine rice. I really liked Grandma's rice. Oh, and I almost forgot to mention, Grandma cuts the crispy pork into large, satisfying pieces. I love it! 😁🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Kae Kae

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I had stir-fried pork with Chinese broccoli.
The food tasted good, delicious, so I'm giving it 5 stars.
The portion size was generous, also 5 stars.
The cleanliness gets 3 stars,
because there were flies buzzing around the vegetable display case.
Therefore, I'm deducting a star, leaving a total of 4 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Me มี

sample_reviews_en.text:
Not expensive, rich flavor, good ingredients, fragrant jasmine rice.
The crispy pork skin is crunchy, and the garlic pork is freshly fried, fragrant, not stir-fried.
The chili fish sauce on the table is always fresh.
50-60 baht per dish. I'll be a regular customer here.
(Cash only)
sample_reviews_en.author: C.

sample_reviews_en.text: I've driven past this place for years and only recently realized it was a made-to-order restaurant after reading comments on Google Maps. So I decided to buy some to take home for dinner. It tasted great! I think I'll become a regular customer now.
sample_reviews_en.author: wasan150

sample_reviews_en.text: Two grandparents make crispy pork that is crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. Very delicious. The shop is clean and inviting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamthorn Kaeo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Crispy pork and delicious food, satisfying and reasonably priced.
The cook, an elderly lady, is lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: ChampME

sample_reviews_en.text: Fast service, clean environment, great value, and restaurant-quality taste. Come and try it yourself!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sathid Chimplee

sample_reviews_en.text: Crispy pork basil stir-fry is delicious! I recommend trying it. The price is very reasonable 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Gear Up

restaurants.name: แม่ออยซอยจุ๊
restaurants.address:

ร้าน แม่ออยซอยจุ๊(ตรงข้ามโครงการเดอะซีน, 274 Srivara Rd, Phlabphla, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I definitely won't be using their service again. I visited around 7 PM; there were no other customers. I ordered three dishes and received the first one within 3-5 minutes. After that, no more food came out. I asked a staff member to follow up on my order. I waited almost 40 minutes in total, and the food still hadn't arrived. I asked if there was a problem and was told that they had an urgent order from the owner that they had to prioritize. From a customer perspective, I understand that they opened the restaurant to eat themselves. Goodbye. Anyone considering using their service, good luck.
sample_reviews_en.author: Assadawut Jaroenrussameesopa

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the atmosphere was great, and the prices were reasonable. The sous vide beef tongue and crispy pork belly were excellent. The restaurant's decor was luxurious and the staff were incredibly attentive and lovely. They bowed respectfully from the kitchen to the cashier and constantly refilled our water – it felt like a fine dining restaurant! 😅 The kitchen was clean, and there's parking behind the restaurant; just let the staff know. I'll definitely go back, especially when the snails are in season (I came because of the snails, but there weren't any!).
sample_reviews_en.author: MO JI

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is incredibly delicious! The restaurant's decor might be a bit confusing, and you wouldn't expect the flavors to be this amazing. From the outside, you wouldn't know what kind of food they sell, but once you try it, you'll become a regular customer. Their signature fermented fish sauce is fragrant, not smelly, and tastes fantastic. I love every dish, but the best are the grilled fish curry with sweet potato leaves, the spicy noodle salad, and the grilled pork neck.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชนากานต์ ภูษิตวิทย์

sample_reviews_en.text: The grilled picanha is a must-try, and the grilled pork neck with spicy dipping sauce is excellent. The portion sizes are appropriate for the price. The crispy fried pork belly was better than expected – crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. The shrimp and salmon were very fresh. Parking is a bit difficult; you can park on the street in front of the restaurant, or try calling the restaurant first. There's parking for four cars behind the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gnapat N.T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
A new restaurant has opened opposite The Scene. The food is incredibly delicious and the portions are huge, like they're doing charity work! The owner is very nice. The food is truly excellent. Try the papaya salad with crab and the sweet vegetable curry with dried fish – they're the best!!! The grilled items are also amazing.
Every dish is so flavorful! 😚
sample_reviews_en.author: Junlawut K.

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything we ordered was delicious. The restaurant is beautiful, the air conditioning is cool, and the seating is comfortable. The fermented fish sauce was flavorful… Parking is available in front of the restaurant, but remember to move your car in the evenings as tickets come out very quickly during rush hour 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: MrKeng

sample_reviews_en.text: The freshwater snails, which are hard to find elsewhere, are here fresh and clean, and taste amazing with the seafood dipping sauce. The spicy catfish larb is flavorful, and the star fruit salad is well-made. Overall, the food tastes great!!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: gates K

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is clean and delicious. I liked that there were a lot of dishes that Koreans can enjoy without feeling burdened. The lobster dish 🦞 in particular was superb. I forgot to take a picture before eating the food hahaha
sample_reviews_en.author: Su Lee (LEESU)

restaurants.name: Empire Luxury Private Club
restaurants.address:

2nd Floor 306, 64-68 Thappraya Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Current inventory.
Price per stick in USD. OUCH!!!
Cohiba Robustos $269 each.
Upmann Magnum 54's $169 ea
Montecristo 2 $219 each.
Montecristo Line 1935 Legend $301 ea.

Partagás Maduro No. 2. $157 ea.
Partagás Series D No. 4 $168 ea
Romeo And Juliet Wide Churchill. $169 each.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vendor MANAGER

sample_reviews_en.text: I enjoyed this place. Honestly probably one of the best humidors in all of Thailand. Only a couple of cigar lounges in bangkok can rival it. Coacoa is an amazing host. Good drink selection and music. Nice partagus cigars and cohibas. Even saw flatheads in the humidor. Hoping to come back very soon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Robert B

sample_reviews_en.text: This exclusive, well-air-conditioned club offers its guests everything a discerning connoisseur could desire: a unique and truly luxurious ambiance, a fantastic selection of single malt whiskies and cigars, a wide variety of other excellent drinks, and charming service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Torsten Hansen

sample_reviews_en.text: A cigar bar as nice as you will find anywhere in the world. Good cigar selection. Huge whiskey and gin selection... Food can be ordered from downstairs. Definitely a lot of thought went into designing this bar. Currently there is a 400 baht …
sample_reviews_en.author: mark wirsig

sample_reviews_en.text: A very chic lounge; I've never seen anything better. Huge selection of drinks and cigars. Pleasant music, friendly service, and friendly guests. You shouldn't come in your beach clothes. I'll definitely be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suso Rickenbach

sample_reviews_en.text: Indian food served but ambience is normal...didn't find any luxury...as the place name suggest... Ok for meal 🍴🍱 but not any such exclusive ...its normal like many other restaurants serving Indian cuisines... …
sample_reviews_en.author: Vivek

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very nice bar with nice girls! Incredibily good looking and tasting drinks.
You need to visit this place at least once!

Though it mentions 'Private' in the title everybody is welcomed. Thats a little confusing
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike Mueller

sample_reviews_en.text: Perfect! Fantastic classic style gentlemen's club... Leather chairs, superb drinks, finest cigars, perfect service. That's what was missing in the Pattaya night scene...thumbs up! Give it a try...
sample_reviews_en.author: P M

restaurants.name: Hachiban Ramen
restaurants.address:

31 Soi Ratchawithi 9, Thung Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Honestly, it was even more delicious than I expected! The miso ramen in particular was superb, with the rich soup perfectly blended with the noodles. The atmosphere inside the restaurant was also relaxed, making it perfect for a relaxed meal with friends. The staff were friendly and the service was excellent. In addition to ramen, I also ordered gyoza and fried rice, which were also of very high quality. Overall, the value for money was good, and I'd definitely like to go back if I'm feeling a bit craving for ramen. If you're a ramen lover, it's definitely worth trying at least once!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yusuke

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodles were very hard today; I had to ask them to boil them until they were softer. Also, it was extremely hot in the area to the right of the entrance. I understand it's a central air conditioning system, but the air from the vents outside the shop was blowing very strong air, while inside the shop it was completely still. The restaurant should inform the building management to investigate this. They shouldn't just ignore it. Please be considerate of the customers dining here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eung PB FutureTech

sample_reviews_en.text: It was as delicious as always! I ordered the Paitan Ramen, and the white broth was perfect for me. It's been a long time since I last ate here. This time I didn't eat at the restaurant but ordered it to go. I added wakame seaweed and an onsen egg myself – excellent! I ordered it without pork but asked for vegetables instead. The restaurant gave me a generous amount of noodles and vegetables, making it really worth the price. The price is very reasonable. I'll definitely order again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Air T.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is of standard Hachibang quality, but there are issues with the staff. I've dined here several times and observed several service shortcomings, such as taking over-orders multiple times. Furthermore, the cleaning has been particularly problematic. Once, I visited in the early evening, and the staff were mopping the floor when I sat down at a table, but the area under the table was soaking wet, as if the cleaning had been done carelessly.
sample_reviews_en.author: S.K. Seataphong

sample_reviews_en.text: On February 6th, 2026, I visited the restaurant between 4:00 PM and 4:30 PM. I'm not sure if I encountered an audit officer or something similar, wearing a blue polo shirt. They were talking to a staff member about work schedules and on the phone, saying very loudly that they hadn't been to this branch for over two months. This was extremely disruptive to other customers. I'm not sure if they had a hearing problem; if so, I apologize.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chidchanok Niyomchuen

sample_reviews_en.text: Ramen Number Eight... This shop is located in Century Mall near Victory Monument. There is parking available, but it might be crowded and parking limited during lunchtime or evening. During normal times, it's easy. It's conveniently located near the BTS Victory Monument station, making it a good place to meet friends for a meal. The taste and price are typical ramen.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunny พาสุข สนุกสนาน

sample_reviews_en.text: Paitan Ramen tastes like it's up to Hachibang's standard. If you like vegetables, I recommend this dish. You can order via QR code or from a staff member. The food comes out quickly (I ate on a Saturday around 11:30 AM). The restaurant plays pleasant Japanese music. You can also get a 10% discount with your membership card (cash/scan).
sample_reviews_en.author: เด็กแว่น

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was okay, but after I paid and walked out of the restaurant, the staff member ran after me and loudly said that I hadn't paid, which caused people outside the restaurant to look back. I understand that this was a misunderstanding, but I'd like to see staff trained to handle this situation better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Harper Moore

restaurants.name: Yayoi The Seasons Mall
restaurants.address:

899 Phahonyothin Rd, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located at the front, it's easy to find, with plenty of tables and a comfortable atmosphere.

Menu ordered:

🍱 Fried Pork Cutlet Set (224 baht). The fried pork was crispy and served with vegetables, kimchi, miso soup, rice, and sauce. It was delicious.
🍜 Champion Ramen (189 baht). The flavor was smooth and rich. The noodles, pork, and egg were delicious.

We scanned the questionnaire and received a free scoop of ice cream. We chose vanilla. It was cool, fragrant, and delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: saowaluk saekow

sample_reviews_en.text:
Now, restaurants that use robots to serve food are great and very compatible with the new normal.

The taste of the food is still the same.
The restaurant atmosphere isn't too busy, and the food doesn't take too long to arrive.
sample_reviews_en.author: nathchriszada muangnil

sample_reviews_en.text: This Japanese restaurant is delicious. Personally, I think it's tastier than Fuji, and the price is about the same.
sample_reviews_en.author: pornthep theecharoen

sample_reviews_en.text: This branch is okay. The food came quickly, looked exactly like the picture, and the service was good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pornusa Suksakol

sample_reviews_en.text:
Not crowded, the air conditioning was very cold.
The food tasted good, up to Yayoi's standard.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sean Rlik

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is good enough; further development of the flavor will reach its full potential.
sample_reviews_en.author: Liebe waitrich

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the restaurant wasn't crowded, and the service was lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paedaw Tulyanon

restaurants.name: เบิร์นบุษบา - BurnBusaba Central Ladprao
restaurants.address:

ศูนย์การค้าเซ็นทรัลลาดพร้าว ห้องเลขที่ 331 ชั้น 3, เลขที่ 1697 Phahonyothin Rd, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I was very disappointed with the food service. We ordered Som Tum Thai with salted egg, Pad Mee Korat (Korat-style stir-fried noodles), Tom Yum with pork ribs, and sticky rice with garlic, salted egg yolk, and crispy fried pork. The food took a long time to arrive. While we could wait, they should have known what to serve first. We ate our fill while waiting for just one plate of Som Tum. What were we supposed to eat it with? They served all the other dishes but forgot the Som Tum, and it was served last. We had previously informed them that we wanted to cancel the order because it was taking so long, but it was brought soon after. I'm not sure what the communication was about. I'm very upset. The food was delicious, but I was very disappointed with the service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oum Chingrum

sample_reviews_en.text:
And for those who love spicy food, I highly recommend this restaurant!

The corn salad is delicious, the corn is super sweet! The portions are just right, not too small. For me, "mildly spicy" here means normal spiciness. The fried sticky rice was amazing, I've never had anything like it before, it was creamy and flavorful, and went great with the spicy salad. The Korat stir-fried noodles had a nice chewy texture, but the flavor wasn't quite authentically Korat. Overall, it was great and not too expensive.

The service was good, as expected from an Iberry chain restaurant. The staff were very efficient.

They accept credit cards.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arinta

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thai Papaya Salad - Delicious, rich flavor, fragrant with spices and lime.

Spicy Salad - Sweet and tasty. The shallots were sliced ​​a bit too large, but the dressing was refreshing.

Grilled Squid - Coated in dark soy sauce, likely grilled on a hot wire. The aroma wasn't very strong. The dipping sauce was okay.

Grilled Pork Neck - Sweet and savory flavor. Made with real pork neck, good amount of marbling, and perfectly grilled.
Hatyai Fried Chicken - The fried shallots were excellent. The chicken itself was freshly fried. The taste was average.

Spicy Squid Salad - Delicious but expensive. Very little squid, about 5 pieces.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patriko Malayan

sample_reviews_en.text:
This somtum (papaya salad) restaurant is located in a shopping mall. The flavors are well-balanced and perfect for Thai tastes. They have a wide variety of dishes to choose from. Even those who don't usually eat fermented fish sauce should try this place; the sauce isn't too strong.
They also offer rice as a side dish, adding variety to your somtum experience.

Overall, the food is delicious. You can try everything on the menu. It's a great place to bring friends.

P.S. The prices are on the high side, as expected for a somtum restaurant in a shopping mall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanachai Tundulyasaree

sample_reviews_en.text: Spicy and delicious! You can specify how many chilies you want, but either way, it's deliciously spicy. The grilled pork neck waterfall salad is delicious, the freshly roasted chilies have a wonderful aroma. The chicken leg soup is also tasty. In short, everything we ordered tasted great, so much so that I forgot to take pictures! By the time I remembered, all that was left were empty plates. The prices are on the high side, but it's worth it. We ate there as a couple and I give it 5/5.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boy Rak

sample_reviews_en.text:
Burn Busaba (by Iberry group) franchise is finally opened at Central ladprao on lv. 3.

The shop decoration is keeping to its theme pantone (purpish, red, orange vibrant colour). Known for its e-san food, where flavourful and spices are their specialties.

The deep fried chicken wings is pretty decent. Good service. Only 7-8 tables inside though, which is very small compared to other branches at other department malls.

Theres 3-4 outdoor seatings as of 2025.
sample_reviews_en.author: Donny Boonyamanop

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for something spicy and flavorful for a quick and easy lunch with your girlfriends, and you don't want to wait in long lines at other famous Som Tum (papaya salad) restaurants, I highly recommend Burn Busaba. The food comes out fast, the Som Tum is spicy and amazing (zaap!), and the grilled pork neck is delicious. It's the dependable, standard pricing you expect from the iberry group—totally worth it, you won't be disappointed!
"
sample_reviews_en.author: Chom K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
First of all overpriced, second the food tastes terrible. I don’t mind to pay higher prices, if the foods is delicious. The staff didn’t take care of us. We kept calling them 🤦🏼‍♀️ we were with 10 people’s there.
Won’t go back again for sure. Don’t waste your money as you can get outside so much cheaper. We had a meeting that’s why we chose this restaurant. It was convenient and wasn’t loud.
sample_reviews_en.author: Inthitra Sirieutiphat

restaurants.name: ร้านน้องปุ๋ย ผัดไทย หอยทอด
restaurants.address:

384/5 Chit Ari Alley, Khlong Chaokhun Sing, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Yesterday evening, I ordered Pad Thai with fresh shrimp through Robinhood. The restaurant called to inform me that they only had one shrimp left (usually two are included in a plate), so they would add squid for me. However, I don’t eat squid, so I declined. The restaurant then informed me that they would add noodles and an egg instead. I was fine with that, as I had no other choice. I had already placed my order, but when I received it, I opened it and there were no shrimps. There were even fewer dried shrimps than usual, and there weren’t many eggs either. The only thing that was included was noodles, just noodles, for 70 baht. I think the restaurant took advantage too much and didn’t know why they didn’t include the one shrimp they said was left. Why did they keep it? I was quite disappointed, as this restaurant has been open for a long time. I’ve been eating there since I was a child. I didn’t think that the standards would drop like this.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rampanmont Sonthitiwitoon

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I visited my younger brother in Soi Ladprao 87 and for lunch we ate at Nong Pui's Pad Thai and Fried Oyster shop. It's located in the middle of the soi, at the 7th intersection, and they only sell two dishes: Pad Thai and fried oysters. They've been open for about ten years. The taste is just as delicious as the Pad Thai at Pratu Phi, and the prices are moderate. If you're passing by, give it a try! I'm not promoting it, I'm just encouraging you to try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: patarasak SJP

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food has a moderate flavor and can be seasoned to your liking.
The ingredients are of good, fresh quality.
Parking might be a bit difficult as it's located on a street in a side street. You might have to park your car near the 7-Eleven across the street. Motorcycles can park on the opposite side.
Importantly, this restaurant has a variety of fusion dishes including Pad Thai, fried mussels, radish cake, and taro noodles. You should definitely try them.
sample_reviews_en.author: Preecha Wilatkietsakun

sample_reviews_en.text: Pad Thai is very delicious. There are many menus to choose from. Turnip cake can be ordered as crispy or soft. It is truly a good thing in Wang Thonglang. If you go after 7 pm, you will not be able to eat it. Their food is good and sells out quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fanpeea White

sample_reviews_en.text: It was past lunchtime, so we walked around looking for food and found this restaurant. My father cooked it for me. Next time, I'll try my son's cooking. I think his cooking tastes different from my father's. I'll definitely go back and try it again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pipat P

sample_reviews_en.text:
It's delicious. It's hard to find Chinese cabbage these days. This restaurant has it.
The pad thai noodles are chewy and soft, and delicious. I especially ordered the seafood pad thai. It's packed with ingredients and worth the price.
sample_reviews_en.author: อานนท์ นาคเกิด

sample_reviews_en.text: The location is convenient, the shop is easy to find, the products are good quality, the taste is delicious, the seller is attentive to the deliciousness of every dish, and the service is friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Watcharin Rungwannarat

sample_reviews_en.text:
This traditional Pad Thai is incredibly delicious! It's unlike any other Pad Thai I've ever had.
I've tried stir-frying the noodles with chili sauce before, which confused me.
