sample_reviews_en.author: วาสนาดี บุญเสริม

restaurants.name: ごはん処 庵寺 Washoku Aji Sukhumvit 39 (Gohan Dokoro)
restaurants.address:

CityResort, Sukhumvit 39, Klongtan-nua, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I came to Japan. My first meal was at 3 pm.
The curry was spicy and there were 5 levels of spiciness to choose from.
I chose level 4, my friend chose level 5.
You can adjust the amount of rice to be less and get a 20 baht discount.
I didn't want eggs, but the restaurant gave me a 20 baht discount. (The staff later informed me that you can't not want eggs, but I've never eaten curry with eggs. Or maybe it's the restaurant's signature dish. I apologize.)
I added fried shrimp as a topping (70 baht).
The curry sauce was just the right amount for the rice. I thought it was really delicious.
I'll definitely go again next time!!!
You can apply for a membership card for 50 baht (get a 5% discount).
But this time I didn't buy a card.
sample_reviews_en.author: kullahchat Suphawatee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food: Everything was super delicious, no complaints!

We ordered a lot of dishes to split between us, definitely liked some more than others. I wouldn't recommend getting squid here as it was super chewy, but you simply cannot go wrong with any sushi, sashimi, or Tempura dish.

Service: The food is really fast, and the waitresses and waiters are pretty attentive. No complaints.

Atmosphere: The only thing is the store (inside) is not that big, so in the case of grilling meats or crying children, the store will hold these kinds of noises in. However, there is outdoor seating (when weather permits, haha).
sample_reviews_en.author: Tar T

sample_reviews_en.text: I recently moved to a condo not far from the restaurant, and this was my first time dining here with my son. It's on the second floor of Fuji. We arrived just minutes before closing time, but the staff were very welcoming. The price is very good considering the quality and taste of the food. We ordered a lot, and it cost over a thousand baht. My son and I ate here together, which was a great value. I usually only order sushi at Fuji, but I didn't expect a restaurant to be this good. It's a small place, but the food is delicious and worth the price. I'll definitely be back. ♥️✨
sample_reviews_en.author: Rabaifan Hongsung

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant has a great atmosphere, giving you the feeling of being in Japan. The food is fresh and delicious; every dish was great. I especially loved the grilled eel – it was perfectly cooked with crispy skin and tender meat 😋
They also have special beer prices during happy hour.
If you like authentic Japanese food, I highly recommend this restaurant. The chef is also very friendly, smiling and greeting customers both when they enter and when they leave. He seems very attentive to customers and even gives out snacks to children.
sample_reviews_en.author: peerapong toi

sample_reviews_en.text:
The quality is very good for the price. Excellent value. (November 6, 2024, lunch)
Price is reasonable, taste is average.

Sweet egg rice ball (20 baht) with a thick egg, which I like.
Salmon rice ball (40 baht) - the fish is not too thin, not too thick. The quality is in line with the price.
Cold soba noodles are chewy and tasty. I like it.
The plate presentation is beautiful. The sushi is well-made and meticulously prepared.

The food arrived very quickly.

Overall, it's good value. I can eat it often without breaking the bank.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayuttaphol Toon

sample_reviews_en.text: The small branch at Fuji Supermarket on Sukhumvit 39 of the big Washoki Aji Japanese restaurant (on Sukhumvit 63). It has limited menu and more suitable for a quick or single meal but still retains similar quality for its Japanese food offerings.  For the full experience and much more extensive menu, go to the main branch on Sukhumvit 63.  But for a nice, quick bite, this is a good place for quick Japanese meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: inn news

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the beef tendon curry, and it was absolutely delicious—better than the curry at specialty curry restaurants. The curry was rich, the meat was plentiful, and the rice was perfectly firm. 😊
The fukujinzuke pickles were also super tasty. I'm impressed by this restaurant's dedication to providing delicious, homemade (presumably) fukujinzuke.
sample_reviews_en.author: K T

sample_reviews_en.text: Superb quality and prices ratio...khun yeen..privided warmness and japanese style quality service..great little place at soi 39..to have great japanese food with relaxed atmosphere  ...and of course ..couple of sakes..lol..food and service as well the quality of food and presentation is remarkable..highly recommended..
sample_reviews_en.author: MAGIC S

restaurants.name: Grillcraft&Draftbeer
restaurants.address:

777, 7 Ekkachai Rd, Bang Bon Nuea, Bang Bon, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! The dipping sauces were great, my favorite was the seafood sauce – I finished it all! The pork was of good quality. The owner provided excellent service and offered a 5% discount on all items ordered. The staff were also helpful, offering cooking instructions. The pork set costs 195 baht and includes five types of vegetables. If you need more, you can order additional vegetables from the separate menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuntharat S.

sample_reviews_en.text: I was quite disappointed with my visit to Grillcraft & Draftbeer. At first, I thought it was a cool place. However, I was disappointed to find that there were no craft beers. The food was also not worth trying, given the poor quality and quantity of meat and vegetables....... I found it hilarious that they served raw meat on top of vegetables, which should eat fresh as you can see the green oak in my photo"~"
sample_reviews_en.author: Bentneb

sample_reviews_en.text: Surprisingly good. The beef are delicious and the service are the best. Did not expect anything from this restaurant but the quality is above most of place in this area. Will absolutely come back again for many many times!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pathompong Phongsaporamut

sample_reviews_en.text: Self cook in a skillet.... Not the newest of ideas. Skillet is tiny and smoke billowing everywhere. Meats were fresh and tasty but the French fries with cheese dip takes the cake. Overall a pleasant experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Leonard Wee

sample_reviews_en.text: Since I couldn't dine in, I ordered takeout. It was just as delicious as always, rich and flavorful, with tender, large pieces of meat, and a wonderful aroma of pepper. The chili fish sauce was also excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: monkeyfoto

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a nice, comfortable atmosphere with parking, but the taste needs improvement. I ordered minced beef basil stir-fry; it looked great, but the taste wasn't amazing! (Personal opinion)
sample_reviews_en.author: buraset pannark

sample_reviews_en.text: The sliced ​​meat is delicious. The owner is friendly and provides advice on grilling each type of meat to make it delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prawit Charikphruet

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible service. I drove a long way, and then they said, "I'm all alone." If you're not prepared, you shouldn't open a shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prayoon Yawichai

restaurants.name: Zakaria Restaurant
restaurants.address:

26/104, 17 Soi Diamond, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Unfortunately, the experience was bad. They served us cucumber yogurt salad, and I found a hair in it. I tried to remove it without my relative noticing because I knew he wouldn't eat it, but unfortunately, he noticed me, canceled his order, and left the restaurant. I sat and ate alone, even though they changed the plate, but that didn't change his mind.
sample_reviews_en.author: mohamed obaid

sample_reviews_en.text: All the dishes are cooked right in front of you, but the food is very clean and prepared with great care, taste, and professionalism. Mr. Zakaria and Mrs. Maryam are the owners of the restaurant and personally manage it. The food is halal and suitable for families, young people, and children. I highly recommend it in Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: سليمان الرشيدي

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is excellent, especially the dried shrimp with okra, which is amazing. The Muslim people are humble and kind, and Zakaria's wife is cheerful, loves to chat, and gives you good advice. The restaurant lacks air conditioning, which is weak and only has fans, so the atmosphere is a bit hot.
sample_reviews_en.author: abdullah s

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice, excellent location, reasonable and competitive prices, very good quality, and very kind and friendly service. Zakaria's daughters, his wife Salha, and their father are running this lovely project.
sample_reviews_en.author: M M

sample_reviews_en.text: A restaurant offering some of the most delicious Arabic and Thai cuisine in Pattaya, with excellent service from all the staff and the owner, Zakaria, and his wife.
sample_reviews_en.author: Waleed Khalid

sample_reviews_en.text: The young man's meal was amazing! Two people ordered fish with bread, and the other ordered rice with 1 riyal of water, all for 750 baht. What's with that?
sample_reviews_en.author: عبدالله العبيداني

sample_reviews_en.text: This Thai restaurant serves halal Arabic food. It's located on VC Street in Pattaya. The prices are fairly good compared to other Arabic restaurants.
sample_reviews_en.author: AHMED ALGHARIBI

sample_reviews_en.text:
The owner seem to have worked in GCC before

The food was perfect for breakfast

Reminds me of Home

Definitely coming back again
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr Nice Albusaidi

restaurants.name: DOZO IZAKAYA&GRILL โดโซะ บางกรวย
restaurants.address:

14 99 Bang Kruai - Sai Noi Rd, Bang Bua Thong, Bang Bua Thong District, Nonthaburi 11130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The service was mediocre, leaning towards confused and unprofessional.
I ordered a beer and it took half an hour to get it, even though there were only three tables occupied in the whole restaurant. I had to jokingly comment on how slow it was.
Considering the location, the price is a bit on the expensive side.
As a big fan of Japanese food, I'm indifferent to the taste. I'd rather eat at other restaurants. But it depends on where you live.
However, since I live nearby, I won't be eating here again.
The restroom was clean and usable. The male staff who run the restaurant were very nice, dressed in female school uniforms.
sample_reviews_en.author: Miss_Som

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is beautifully decorated with many photo opportunities both inside and outside. I didn't expect to find a place like this in this area. The food tastes good, although there's a slight wait, but it's freshly prepared, which is …
sample_reviews_en.author: ลุงพวง

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices are quite high compared to other restaurants in the same category, considering the taste, atmosphere, and location. If the restaurant offered promotions or lowered the prices a bit, it would be more worthwhile to visit again. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Anupap Jettanapanichkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
So amazing! The atmosphere is just like being in Japan.
You can sit, drink, grill, and take beautiful photos everywhere.
Plus, there are beer and grilling promotions too! Such great value!
sample_reviews_en.author: ฉัตรชัย แจ่มกล้า

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is great, the decor is cute, they use high-quality imported meat, and the prices are reasonable.
There are many kid-friendly menu items, which is perfect for the location. …
sample_reviews_en.author: ปิยดา จําเนียรจํารัส

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is beautiful and has a great atmosphere. They offer both grilled dishes and à la carte options. The food tastes good, but the sushi might take a little longer to prepare.
sample_reviews_en.author: jirutchaya Vatcharasukum

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, the service was good, and the atmosphere was nice. Today, there was a male staff member dressed in a Japanese schoolgirl cosplay outfit, which was cute.
sample_reviews_en.author: 3 สุภัค เฑียรบุญเลิศรัตน์

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tasted great, everything I tried was delicious. The staff were polite. There are many photo opportunities. Parking was very convenient. ❤️👍
sample_reviews_en.author: นัฐวุฒิ

restaurants.name: ครัว เถาวัลย์
restaurants.address:

MC33+VHW, Kanchanaphisek Rd, Bangkok, Bang Bon, Nonthaburi 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I was very hungry, searched online and found this place. I came around noon. The weather by the lotus pond was pleasant and not too hot.
The food tasted good and the prices were reasonable.
There was a much wider variety of dishes than I expected.
Tom yum fish soup, oyster salad, sun-dried beef, fried pork belly with fish sauce, glass noodle salad, grilled pork neck, etc.
P.S. The restaurant is located in an alley. There are trees at the entrance of the alley, so it's a little hard to spot. Overall, I was impressed with the service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ayarat Ploy

sample_reviews_en.text: Krua Thaewan (Vineyard Kitchen) enjoys a cool breeze year-round from the sea and nearby fishing ponds. The food is incredibly fresh and delicious, and the prices are excellent. If you have any special requests, call ahead; the owner is very kind and will accommodate them. Meat lovers shouldn't miss the "7-second beef," the fresh and delicious fried sea bass with fish sauce, and the amazing fried rice with shrimp paste. The food is fantastic and so fresh – I've been there over 10 times!
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyachanoke

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is vibing for me as a 40-year old loner. Food is great and priced very reasonably towards cheap. Slow Thai pop and Look krung music of the 90’s.
Great place for meeting friends. If you are in late 30s to 50s you will likely enjoy this place.

Calamari with garlic and chilli is highly recommended.
Food can be very slow when it’s crowding.

The place to my surprise is not hot and also breezy. Love it
sample_reviews_en.author: Minc S.

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious food, great atmosphere, cool breeze. I've been here many times. I recommend calling ahead to order if you want something special. The fried sea bass with fish sauce is incredibly delicious! I didn't get a chance to take a picture before it was all gone. Everything else in the pictures was delicious too.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploy-PP

sample_reviews_en.text: All the food was delicious and reasonably priced. The food came out quickly, with minimal waiting time. The only downside was the number of mosquitoes, but the restaurant did provide mosquito repellent. The portions were larger than shown in the pictures because we had already eaten some of the dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ploysai

sample_reviews_en.text: One of my fav places to come in Thailand, good for family and friends, very friendly welcoming people, great view, nice food and lovely beer of course!
sample_reviews_en.author: You know where Hugh go

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the atmosphere is nice, spacious and comfortable. The entire restaurant can be rented for events such as parties. The service is
sample_reviews_en.author: กชพร อินทนะ

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the atmosphere is very natural. It's hard to believe it's right next to Kanchanaphisek Road. Perfect for chilling out.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธนพงศ์ การเกษตร

restaurants.name: ล้านต้นคูน
restaurants.address:

553 Bang Waek, Phasi Charoen, Bangkok, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: You can't find this quality and taste at such an affordable price in the city. This restaurant is amazing. The cooks have clearly defined roles. The papaya salad is spicy and flavorful. I recommend the seafood soup with raw crab, blanched cockles, and raw shrimp – it's a papaya salad with fermented fish sauce but without the shredded papaya. The catfish larb is incredibly detailed and delicious. The fried chicken wings are amazing – be careful, they're hot! The crying tiger beef is so good it'll make you cry. The hot pot is also cheap and fantastic. The original "pork in a mortar" dish is here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jajabing Babibubey

sample_reviews_en.text: This small somtum (papaya salad) shop may be small, but the flavors are amazing. Every dish is incredibly delicious and spicy. The fermented fish sauce (plara) is excellent. I don't usually eat plara, but my wife does and can vouch for it here. Parking is available at the gas station. It can be a bit difficult to find a spot in the evenings, and sometimes you can't find one. In that case, you can get your car washed at the gas station – leave your car there, eat, and have it washed by the time you finish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teerapat Asawataweechoke

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time trying this place near my dorm. I was craving papaya salad, and it was delicious! The crab and fermented fish papaya salad with rice noodles was amazing. The base flavor was sweet and savory; you can ask for more sourness if you prefer. The fried intestines were also delicious and make a great appetizer. They have a huge menu to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: นิรมล มูลจันทา

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is clean and delicious in every dish. Recommended dishes include the spicy pork neck in a mortar (with a fantastic dipping sauce), the incredibly tasty papaya salad, and the very fresh, sweet-fleshed grilled fish. If you're in the Bang Waek or Charan 13 area, come and try it! It's truly delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sawalax Poo

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is the best somtum (papaya salad) restaurant on Bang Waek Road, Soi Bang Waek. I've been eating here for 10 years. It's very popular and always crowded. You have to call to reserve a table. Everything is delicious and the prices are great.
When I'm stressed, I just need something spicy!
sample_reviews_en.author: Fangkamonchanok Int

sample_reviews_en.text: I don't come to this restaurant very often, but at least once a month. The food tastes good and the prices are reasonable. The only downside is the lack of parking, as it's a shophouse. You have to park at the PTT gas station next door, but even that is rarely available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alex August

sample_reviews_en.text: Authentic Northeastern Thai food, delicious! I recommend the fried intestines and grilled meat (depending on the day). The good thing is the price is unbelievably cheap – too cheap! The downside is the restaurant is very hot. You might be …
sample_reviews_en.author: Nu contractor

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is super delicious, the service is also great as well. This is my family's favorite restaurant. The food is cheap and very delicious. Everything about this restaurant is awesome. This place never lets us down!
sample_reviews_en.author: R C

restaurants.name: Tenjo Sushi & Yakiniku Premium Buffet (Central Plaza Rama 3)
restaurants.address:

ชั้น​ 6, เซ็นทรัลพลาซา, Rama III Rd, Chong Nonsi, Yan Nawa, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The meat quality wasn't as good as I expected; it had an unpleasant smell. I'm not a big meat eater, but I felt this one had a bad odor.
However, other menu items were okay. Grilling the shrimp was quite difficult; I kept burning it and couldn't eat it. It felt like the heat wasn't strong enough. Even after changing the charcoal and adding a fan, it was still hard to cook. The cleanliness was acceptable, and the dipping sauces were varied and good. But for the price, it felt like it wasn't worth it considering the taste, although there's a wide selection of dishes. Some items were missing from my order; for example, I ordered a shrimp roll or something similar, and after ordering 3-4 times, I didn't get it until I had to go to the counter to ask about it. Worse still, I ordered 5 sesame leaves but only received 1, and had to press the button again to get it. The staff provided good service. The Wagyu neck steak was delicious; the rest was mediocre or not tasty at all. I don't know what exactly, but they were thin, large slices with no white fat—it was just meat, mind you.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yanisa Lertsaravuth

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was incredibly slow! Even though we were the first table of customers today, our first order only included two or three items. We waited over ten minutes for the rest, and they still didn't come. We followed up with the staff, and waited again and again. Finally, the staff said everything was ready. So we placed a new order. A little while later, the items we had previously ordered, which the staff said were complete, were served after our new order had already been placed. This happened several times! We didn't get anything we ordered, and just sat there for ages. The food was also incredibly hot. We just gave up. The service was ridiculously slow, and it was a waste of money and time. I wouldn't recommend coming here!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wachi W

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is always crowded during meal times so we went earlier for brunch. The menu is extensive and has lots of options for sushi, sashimi and grill. And thankfully, the food tastes as good as it looks! Portion size is just right for a buffet and the service staff were attentive - might be different if you go during crowded meal times. The unagi/eel dishes are amazing and were served promptly. It was overall a good dining  experience but felt like we didn't have enough time to sample most of the creative menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suthida Chang

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went here last week and was very disappointed by the quality of the food.
I used to come here a lot few years ago and I loved it, fresh food, nice service but it’s so different now. 👎🏻
I chose the platinum set (1,300 baht) and what I got are sashimi that weren’t fresh, shrimp got a strange smell and I love lamb but your lamb smelled terrible.
The only reason I gave stars are for your friendly service and your dipping sauces were delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wear Me

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant's windows should be wiped down first thing in the day; they make it uninviting. Inside, the glass panels between each table are messy and look unclean. There weren't many customers, so they should have had the staff take care of this. The food wasn't fresh; there's nothing much to say. The dipping sauce had an off smell. I ate here once many years ago and thought it would be better this time, but it's the same as before.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sutas Vichienkalayarat

sample_reviews_en.text: I ate there yesterday. The Prestige set was approximately 1500 baht net. It took a very long time to get the first set after ordering. The sashimi wasn't fresh; the fish and octopus were sliced ​​about two inches thick. The hamachi was also fishy. Some of the staff seemed confused. I ordered bubble tea, and the tapioca pearls were hard as lumps. I didn't expect this kind of buffet for 1500 baht. I'd give it a negative rating.
sample_reviews_en.author: zaza garo

sample_reviews_en.text: The food, especially the BBQ pork, was terrible. There was no sign saying it was BBQ pork when we arrived. The taste was awful, the dipping sauce was mediocre, and the ingredients weren't fresh. The marinated pork tasted...well, maybe it was just our family that had it bad, but if anyone wants to try it, go ahead. Everyone has different tastes, but we'll definitely remember this for a long time. They really need to improve.
sample_reviews_en.author: pronthip khotphui

sample_reviews_en.text: Terrible. I ordered 20 split shrimp (total on the bill) but only received 7. I ordered tempura at 5:24 PM and it arrived at 6:30 PM, and I only received one set. I even had to order another set and a salad. Isn't that way too long? I'm not sure how they handle this. I definitely won't be coming back. I've eaten at this branch almost 10 times, and it's been slow almost every time, but this time was excessively long.
sample_reviews_en.author: B3ing Good

restaurants.name: CORNER 144
restaurants.address:

144 Bamrung Mueang Rd, Wat Ratchabophit, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had the opportunity to visit the Sao Chingcha area and stopped by a cool cafe, which led me to Corner 144, located on the corner of Bamrung Mueang Road. It's a very cute cafe with window views overlooking the Giant Swing, Wat Suthat, and Bangkok City Hall.

Today, I tried their cake, cookies, and two coffees. The coconut cake was delicious – the young coconut was sweet, fragrant, and perfectly creamy. It's a must-try! The coconut coffee, however, wasn't very sweet, but that's understandable as the sweetness of the coconut varies from day to day. The cafe gives you a generous amount of young coconut flesh, so much so that they provide a spoon to scoop it out.

If you're planning a visit to this area, stop by! Parking is very convenient now; you can park in the underground parking lot at Bangkok City Hall for 20 baht per hour – much cheaper than other places in the area.

Parking closes at 6 PM Monday to Friday.
Saturday and Sunday, it's open 24 hours.

After parking, walk diagonally across to Bamrung Mueang Road.

Even though it was April, the cafe's air conditioning was incredibly cool and refreshing despite the hot outside air.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phakwipha Kaewwisit

sample_reviews_en.text:
I visited at the beginning of February. I was drenched in sweat after walking from Wat Bowonniwet when I entered the restaurant. I was soothed by the cool air inside, the stylish atmosphere, and the smiling faces of the staff. It was a true oasis.
I ordered the green curry lunch set. I was amazed to find that lunch sets exist in Thailand.
The green curry was spicy but delicious, and the accompanying salted egg warmed my sweaty body. I'll never forget that taste.
When I wanted to use the restroom and didn't know how to turn the light on, a staff member came running over and did it for me. They were very kind. I was so happy.
I'd like to return to the window seats with a view of the Big Swing.
sample_reviews_en.author: あげたてのからあげ

sample_reviews_en.text: The vegetarian food at this restaurant is delicious. The ingredients are high quality, the service is excellent, and the prices are reasonable. Personally, I love the Emperor's Noodles (Rad Na Hong Kong style) and the crab curry with rice noodles; the noodles are similar to white vermicelli but very soft. They also have vegetarian sticky rice with fried pork and garlic. If you don't want to travel, you can order through Line Man. They also have a variety of cakes. Overall, it's a winner!
sample_reviews_en.author: Monpat Sriwongniam

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located on Bamrung Mueang Road, is a nice little spot close to the Giant Swing and nearby historic temples—perfect for a relaxed break while exploring the area.

I went for the chicken massaman curry with roti—rich, aromatic, and nicely balanced, with tender chicken and a comforting sauce that pairs perfectly with the roti.

Cozy atmosphere, fine service, and a great place to slow down for a bit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Farangondiet

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant near Wat Suthat and the Giant Swing has delicious food, is air-conditioned, and has two floors. It's a beautiful place for taking photos. The food tastes great, the decor is lovely, and the air conditioning is wonderfully cool. You can park next to the temple and walk over; it's not far from the temple walls.
sample_reviews_en.author: Techopat Sritrhammasit

sample_reviews_en.text: This cafe is very close to the Giant Swing. The decor is inviting and perfect for taking photos. It has two floors of seating and sells drinks, cakes, and ice cream, as well as meals. You can park at the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration parking lot and walk to the cafe; it's not far.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayopat Fungladda

sample_reviews_en.text: Good place, very accessible. With good view of the Giant Swing. Food is good, too. Staff are nice and they have staff who can speak English. They also allowed us to go on the top floor to have a good view of the adjacent temple and the bug swing, nice photo spot! Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Rome Valencia

sample_reviews_en.text:
"Check in at this classic cafe near Sao Chingcha ✨"
The shop is adorable, and the atmosphere is perfect for taking photos. For those with a big appetite, they offer delicious Pad Thai and spaghetti. It's a great place to chill and feel satisfied, both mentally and physically. ☕🍰🍝
sample_reviews_en.author: Can BRC

restaurants.name: ร้าน@ซอยเก้า
restaurants.address:

Soi Chaloem Phrakiat Ratchakan Thi 9 Soi 9, Nong Bon, Prawet, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and moderately priced. The taste is great, perfect as a snack or for a light dinner before the live music starts.

The waitresses and beer girls are pretty and cute. They sell liquor and beer, and have promotions like buy 3 get 1 free or free mixers – you have to ask the restaurant as the promotions change sometimes. Previously, food was 50% off before 9 PM, making the bill very cheap. Now they offer set menus with 4 dishes for around 799 baht.
The live music starts around 8 or 9 PM, and they're fun and lively, chatting with customers.
There's parking at the back, but if it's full, you can park in the side street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chin Ngamvilairat

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the atmosphere is nice, and the music is good... but if you want to hire a waitress, be warned, it's 500 baht per hour. Don't believe them if they say 500 baht for the first hour and 100 baht for each subsequent hour... because you'll be shocked when you get the bill.
sample_reviews_en.author: ศิวเชษฐ์ ชุนชํานิ

sample_reviews_en.text: The kids are cute, as are the staff. The atmosphere is fun and perfect for relaxing. The live music is a little too soft, but you can still talk without shouting. Overall, it's okay.
sample_reviews_en.author: PhuPha Family

sample_reviews_en.text:
Feeling lonely and need a kid? Come here.
But if you're an independent person who wants to sit alone, go somewhere else.
The prices are a bit steep though.
sample_reviews_en.author: Oata SevenFive

sample_reviews_en.text: Bar with a restaurant. Nice girls serving. The music becomes live later on. Unfortunately, it's so loud that conversation is difficult.
sample_reviews_en.author: Michael Wagner

sample_reviews_en.text: Every time I come here, I get drunk. The PR girls are cute, the music is great, and the prices aren't too high.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tangmo Sawitree

sample_reviews_en.text:
There are lots of cute girls.
If you want to drink with them, there is an additional charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: hiroshi nukui

sample_reviews_en.text: A casual, chill hangout spot with live music and female staff to provide attentive service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanawat Ngamdumrongyuenyong

restaurants.name: วิลลี่แหนมเนือง ประชาสงเคราะห์ Willynamnuang
restaurants.address:

3004 ซ. ประชาสงเคราะห์ 26 Khwaeng Din Daeng, Din Daeng, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This small restaurant is located on Prachasongkroh Road, Soi 26 (the sign is barely visible, obscured by telephone wires). It's opposite Soi 33/1. Inside, seating is limited to only four tables, ideally one person per side. Each table probably seats four at most, but two people is perfectly comfortable. I sat at a table by the window with curtains, but large red ants were crawling on the curtains and then on the table. I was worried and not very happy while I ate. 😣😣

The food arrived relatively quickly, which was pretty good. The taste was decent, and the portions were generous. The vegetables were nicely presented, but they weren't washed and peeled individually; they were just skewered in heads. 🥲 (My mom saw on a TV program that they said the vegetables were home-grown. It's better to leave the stems exposed when picking them; the vegetables would look nicer that way.) The restaurant accepts bank transfers and cash. They offer a 5% discount for cash payments. I ordered four dishes, and after the discount, the total was around 1000 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lite B

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is quite small, with about 4-5 tables. There's a clean restroom available. The staff member who took our order was very helpful and polite.

The food was delicious. We ordered 3 dishes, totaling a little over 800 baht, but the portions were generous. We were very full!
- The grilled pork udder was a little salty, but very tasty. It helped balance out the other two dishes.
- The Cha Yor (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage) comes in a small set of 2 pieces and a large set of 3 pieces. The side dishes are the same as the Nem Nuong, the only difference is the pork itself. The texture is like a mix of Nem Nuong, Moo Yor, and minced pork. It has a peppery taste. If you don't like pepper, I recommend sticking with the regular Nem Nuong.
- The Pak Mo (Vietnamese steamed rice rolls) came in a very large tray. It could probably be cut into 8 pieces. The bottom is a crispy rice cracker, and the top is a rice flour and steamed rice roll filling. It's delicious eaten hot; crispy and soft. The dipping sauce was tasty.
sample_reviews_en.author: c cineandeni

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love it so much! ^_^ I've never been to the restaurant, I order through Shopee Food very often.
*Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage)*
- The fresh vegetables are well-washed, clean, fresh, and very well-packaged.
- The pork is decent. If you choose Ready to Eat, it comes warm and already sliced.
- The garlic, chili, unripe banana, and cucumber are also already sliced ​​if you choose Ready to Eat.
- The dipping sauce is delicious and there's enough of it.

***Fried Spring Rolls
Crispy and delicious. The dipping sauce is also good.

***Pork Sausage with Skin
Super delicious! I love it so much. It's fun to chew.

- The containers used to be different. The restaurant serves it this way, probably for Ready to Eat (but there's a lot of plastic everywhere).
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanlaya Srinantawong (Mummie)

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I went to eat at a restaurant that said on the website and outside that it opened at 9:00 AM. When I actually arrived at 9:45 AM, the staff said the restaurant was open but not yet ready to serve customers. Why announce that opening time if you're not ready to serve at 9:00 AM? Customers who intended to eat there were disappointed. (I didn't get to eat because they weren't ready to serve.) I'll go again when I'm in a better mood. Please check the actual opening and closing times.
sample_reviews_en.author: Taotao Krugkuntod

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a small restaurant, just one shop unit, with only four tables. The food is delicious and high-quality, with good ingredients, fresh vegetables, and tasty dipping sauces. The prices are a bit high. There are relatively few staff members, only two I saw, but the food didn't take long to arrive. You can park at the apartment building behind the restaurant, called Kong-Am, for 20 baht (the parking fee is included in the food bill).
sample_reviews_en.author: Dearz Sinsukpakdi

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a small Vietnamese restaurant that does a really good job. I went there two days in a row while staying in the area. There's nothing to complain about. The prices are moderate, but considering the location and the portion sizes, it's great value. They serve Vietnamese food with flavors adjusted to suit Thai palates.
sample_reviews_en.author: Usada Klinbhiboon

sample_reviews_en.text: The food quality and cooking methods are up to standard. The vegetables are fresh, washed, and ready to eat. The price is a bit high; promotions would be good for customers. For takeout orders, I'd like to see more vegetables. The dipping sauce for the Vietnamese spring rolls (Nem Nuong) should be less salty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Home

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. The portion of the Nem Nuong set was larger than expected. We ordered the small set and it was more than enough for two people. The vegetables were very crisp, fresh, and clean. The staff were very attentive, constantly refilling our water and dipping sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piyawan Chuaymankong

restaurants.name: ร้านนายเหนือ
restaurants.address:

106 Ratchawithi 18 Alley, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Mr. Nuea visited this restaurant for the first time. It's a Thai restaurant by the canal in Soi Wat Makok. He's eaten at Sam-Ang Boat Noodles many times but never noticed this place. Is it a hidden gem? It's on the opposite side of the canal from Sam-Ang Boat Noodles. Recommended dishes include: Crispy Catfish Salad (served hot and crispy, with a delicious, well-balanced dressing), Tom Yum Seabass (medium spiciness, not too sour or spicy, delicious, and easy to finish the broth), Garlic Prawns (served hot and delicious with rice), and Salted Mackerel in Spicy, Sour, and Sweet Sauce (a perfect balance of flavors). He also bought some Steamed Snakehead Fish Curry to take home. The food is reasonably priced, and the owner is friendly and provides good service. The restaurant is open Monday-Friday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, closed Saturday, Sunday, and public holidays. Parking is quite difficult to find.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krongrat Si.

sample_reviews_en.text: Hey!! This OTOP (One Tambon One Product) shop in Soi Wat Makok is amazing! The food is delicious, the prices are reasonable, and the atmosphere is homey. A must-try is the stir-fried kale with salted fish. It's so good; they sprinkle shallots and chilies on top and squeeze lime on it, like eating a salad and stir-fried vegetables at the same time. Also, anything with catfish – crispy catfish, catfish with chili and ginger, catfish with basil – order it, it's all delicious. Another dish I tried today was "crying pork" (normally it's "Tiger's Tears" beef, right?), but this is pork! It was so good, perfect as a snack or appetizer. You have to order it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Usana Chuanak

sample_reviews_en.text:
Thai restaurant by the canal.
Many dishes are delicious, but some are not.
🤩 Recommended dishes:
- Crispy fried fish salad
- Tom Yum soup (creamy version) (The clear soup isn't good; it has a strange sourness, like vinegar)
- Stir-fried squid/shrimp with curry powder
- Stir-fried mixed vegetables
- Kale with crispy pork
- Fish dishes such as "Lui Suan" (a type of Thai salad)

😭 I once ordered stir-fried pork with oyster sauce, but the restaurant added ginger, and the pork was undercooked, especially the last few pieces. I think the restaurant used frozen pork and didn't stir-fry it evenly, so the meat was pinkish-white.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fangrio Studio (fangrio)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Recommended to call and reserve a table and order food in advance.
Lunchtime can be quite long for food.
- Crispy fried catfish with chili paste and "pork with chili powder" are must-orders. Absolutely delicious!
- Fried soft-shelled fish with garlic is very crispy and the portion is generous.
- Salted egg yolk squid has a mild flavor and the squid is fresh.
- Fried fish cakes are firm and bouncy with a generous portion.
- Squid salad is standard, not sweet.
- Chicken with cashew nuts is average, the chicken is crispy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanakan Chuengmankhong

sample_reviews_en.text: This Thai restaurant is located on the canal bank at the bridge across from Wat Makok. You have to look carefully because you won't see the shop from the outside. The taste is good, everything we ordered was delicious. The price is reasonable, and the portions are generous. The atmosphere is homey and relaxed. It opens during the day, perfect for lunch. Some days it gets quite crowded. They also seem to do boxed lunches and cater for parties. If you're passing through this area, I recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pantawee Pantaweesak

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is a wooden house with about 10 tables, but the owner, Mr. Nuea, has been running it for a very long time. Mr. Nuea's food is delicious, especially the salted mackerel stew and steamed snakehead fish in banana leaves, which have an authentic, traditional flavor—very hard to find elsewhere. The food tastes like it's from a high-end restaurant, but the prices are in the hundreds of baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sorn Ubolchai

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious! The prices are great, and the restaurant has a nice atmosphere. It's been open for a while, and I'll definitely go again. The steamed snakehead fish curry was also incredibly delicious.
Recommended dishes:
Snakehead fish tom yum soup (with belly and roe)
Stir-fried squid with salted egg
Excellent selection of fish and seafood
The steamed fish curry is a must-try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ling Ling

sample_reviews_en.text: Garlic fried shrimp, crispy catfish salad, crispy catfish with basil, and fried sea bass with fish sauce are all incredibly delicious. The restaurant does a fantastic job with their fried dishes; the flavors are rich and intense, and the prices are excellent. I recommend calling ahead to reserve a table, as it's fully booked during lunchtime.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anyapat Thana

restaurants.name: ครัวคุณสุ
restaurants.address:

1618 4 ถ. กรุงเทพ - นนทบุรี Wong Sawang, Bang Sue, Bangkok 10800, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: I had the chance to try it out. The Vietnamese spring rolls (แหนมเนือง) were great, perfect for snacking. I went in the evening during the time the TV drama was airing. The food service was fast, and the restaurant has a vintage style decor. It's near my house, but parking is a bit difficult.
sample_reviews_th.author: Nutthamont Paekhunthod

sample_reviews_th.text: It's delicious! I ate everything. It's my regular restaurant. My favorite is the Vietnamese grilled pork sausage (แหนมเนือง); it's affordable and incredibly tasty.
sample_reviews_th.author: เกรียน SSw

sample_reviews_en.text:
This Vietnamese restaurant has a super vintage atmosphere. It's a cute place with parking available in the side alley. Stepping inside, the decor feels like browsing through old family photos! 5555

The menu is unique, with food photos displayed in an album with prices – very classic!

Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage):
The pork is delicious, fragrant, and served hot – 5 stars!
The vegetables are perfectly clean and beautifully presented.
The dipping sauce is a perfect balance of sweet, sour, salty, and slightly spicy.
The rice paper wrappers are made from fresh rice paper (not sure what it's called), but unlike others I've tried, they don't need soaking.

Pork wrapped in betel leaves:
The aroma is amazing, and the taste is impressive – rich in flavor and aroma from the spices and seasonings.

Vietnamese rice noodle soup (Jap Yuan):
The noodles are soft and chewy, the broth is flavorful and fragrant with pepper – a refreshing taste that doesn't need any extra seasoning.

In short, if you like vegetables and Vietnamese food, I highly recommend this restaurant. Delicious food, great atmosphere, and friendly prices! 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Ornwipha Sessila

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is near my house, and I've driven past it many times but wasn't sure if it was open because the exterior looked a bit gloomy, haha.
Inside, the atmosphere is vintage. The menu is in old-fashioned photos. There aren't many tables, and there's only one staff member at the front.
Some dishes were really delicious, like the grilled pork with betel leaves, which was very fragrant. Some dishes were almost perfect (like some kind of crispy rice crackers that were tasty, but could have had some dipping sauce). The Vietnamese spring rolls were average, okay. I wish the dipping sauce bowl was bigger; I didn't dare ask for more. The shrimp wrapped in sugarcane was also fragrant. Plus, the prices are cheap. But we ordered 4 dishes for 2 people and weren't full, haha.

Anyway, it's a restaurant worth trying. As for the wait time, I personally didn't think it was long. The food came out steadily, one dish at a time, because it seems like the owner is doing everything inside. But if you come when you're really hungry, you might get a little frustrated. 😃
sample_reviews_en.author: Pandha Trakarnthai (Pandha_somehow)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Khun Su's Kitchen is a Vietnamese restaurant that has been in my mother's heart for over 20 years. My mother has been dining here since before she was married, and now my daughter is a young woman.
The owner has been making the food himself, consistently delivering high-quality dishes for over 20 years.
The food is guaranteed to be delicious and fresh. Prices are listed on the menu, with each dish costing less than 100 baht, except for the nem nuong (steamed rice noodles), which is 100 baht for a set of colored pencils.
For those who enjoy Vietnamese food and want a small atmosphere with 3-4 tables,
my mother recommends giving this restaurant a try.
And if you're hungry, call ahead and order your food half an hour beforehand. When you arrive, you'll get your food hot and ready, no waiting.
I paid 555 baht for this meal, as I also bought nem nuong and fried bananas to take home.
sample_reviews_en.author: รัตนธร

sample_reviews_en.text:
I found this place on TikTok. It's a Vietnamese restaurant with really good prices. Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage) is only 100 baht per set! It's crazy good, and the taste is amazing too. This set was enough for two people.
It was perfectly filling.
If you're near Bang Son, Tao Poon, or Pracha Chuen, come try it! It's delicious and inexpensive.

The Nem Nuong is 100 baht and it's really, really good.
The Shrimp Fritters are 95 baht and very tasty.
The Glass Noodle Soup with Chicken was around 115 or 95 baht, I can't remember exactly. The broth was excellent, flavorful, and didn't need any seasoning.

The food took a little while to arrive, 10-15 minutes, but we were chatting and having fun, so it wasn't a big deal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Surassada Phongpornpat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Khrua Khun Su
📍Bangkok-Nonthaburi

💬: The overall taste of the food is okay. It's tasty, but not amazing.
: Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage): The dipping sauce is a bit watery and sweet. The grilled pork is well-cooked, not burnt, and smells good. There wasn't enough vegetables.
: Grilled Pork with Vermicelli: The noodles are good, but the grilled pork is burnt. The marinade is okay.
: Shrimp Fritters: Delicious, served hot.
: Vietnamese Noodle Soup (Khao Piak): Served hot, the soup is fragrant with pepper. I didn't really like the bouncy pork, but the Vietnamese pork sausage was okay.

💰: Total: 395 Baht (for 2 people)
🕰️: 11 am - 2:30 pm, 5:30 pm - 9:30 pm
🚗: In Soi 38 or 40 (a bit of a secluded soi).
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanlaya Jatujinda

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant serves both Vietnamese and Thai food.
This is the first Vietnamese restaurant that I've found to my liking.

-Taste: Very delicious, though a little on the sweet side. The chef is very meticulous in preparing the food; everything is made fresh, so you don't have to worry about it being leftovers from the previous day.
-Service: Because there's only one chef, service is a bit slow.
-Atmosphere: It's a very old restaurant, dating back to my father's time, so it has a bit of a 90s vibe.
-Price: I have to say, the price is much cheaper than expected considering the quality of the food.

I highly recommend trying it!
sample_reviews_en.author: VFX MTeerathorn

restaurants.name: หม่าล่าปากซอย
restaurants.address:

5/5 บางไผ่ Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: They have a wide selection of dishes, and the taste is amazing. It's not overly sweet like some other places; just the right amount of sweetness, with the perfect sprinkle of mala chili powder. The dipping sauce is incredibly spicy. The restaurant is clean, the service is very fast, and the prices are reasonable. The staff are all attentive and enthusiastic. The restaurant is next to Sainom (a milk shop), so you can order drinks and snacks from the shop next door to enjoy here. The outdoor atmosphere is cool and comfortable, with fans on constantly. They have a great exhaust system, so there's no smell of breakfast smoke. They play good music, making it a great place to chill. However, they don't serve alcohol like some other mala restaurants, so it's perfect for those who don't drink alcohol but enjoy the milk from Sainom instead. They also have a wide variety of delicious cafe-style desserts.
sample_reviews_en.author: SP Wong

sample_reviews_en.text: This is another Mala restaurant that grills the meat dry. The sauce and sprinkled chili are incredibly spicy and satisfying. I would also like to recommend the traditional grilled pork. It's very delicious. The pork is tender and fragrant. If you buy it to take home and save it to eat, the grilled pork juice will come out. Dip sticky rice in it and it's delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Facebook สถานีเมืองนนท์

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered it less spicy, could eat it continuously. The pork belly was very crispy and delicious. The kimchi was pleasantly tangy. The seafood dipping sauce was okay, good flavor, but you could eat it without it too; the oil drizzled over the grilling made it even better. 😊👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Saraphee Kongchoo

sample_reviews_en.text: Grilled Mala is delicious. You can choose your spice level. The Mala powder is rich and comes with a dipping sauce for those who like it spicy. Improvements have been made. The first time I came, there were a lot of flies. This time, the …
sample_reviews_en.author: Tai Tai

sample_reviews_en.text: I've ordered delivery and received the wrong items twice already. I still haven't received a refund for the latest order. I've called three times to follow up, but they still haven't transferred the money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Teerathanon Estate

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is great. The restaurant is spacious and airy, especially on a rainy day when the weather is cool and comfortable. The mala sauce tastes good and the food is served quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: ภาคภูมิ โทธานี

sample_reviews_en.text: Mala shop on Nakhon In Road at the entrance to Sangkhathan Temple. There are both outdoor and air-conditioned seats. It's the same shop as the fresh milk shop. The taste is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jomchai P.

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is okay, but it's expensive and doesn't have a price tag. This is too much. 3 pieces of fish cheese tofu for 20 baht. I thought it was the price in the city.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pond fyp

restaurants.name: ร้านแล้วแต่เชฟ
restaurants.address:

แขวง ทุ่งครุ, Thung Khru, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I've driven past this place for years, and today was my first time trying it. The wait for food was a bit long as there's only one chef, but the prices are cheap and the food is delicious. The stir-fried squid with salted egg yolk, where the squid is deep-fried instead – it's unique but incredibly tasty! I'll definitely be back often.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tuiinuii Kamonchanok

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant offers a diverse menu of made-to-order dishes, all with great taste and affordable prices. Preparation is a bit slow, but you'll receive freshly made food every time. Parking is available behind the restaurant. It's located on the roadside next to a Taekwondo school.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pat Siri

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a local Thai street food (small)restaurant.
Cheap price for foods selling here compared to the current cost of living in Thailand.
There is also a Thai dessert which is Thai Cupcakes, known as Khanom Tuay, sold here. The taste is great.
Good to try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jak Hanpobamorn

sample_reviews_en.text: I've passed by this place many times but only recently had the chance to stop and eat. The food is delicious, the prices are reasonable, and they have a wide variety of dishes. The owner is also very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tee Vigo

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, clean, and the taste is just right. The crispy pork dish is also very tasty. The fried rice with crispy dried fish is super crunchy and the rice is very fragrant. 😋
sample_reviews_en.author: Jay Chol

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes great, with a nice wok-fried aroma... There were a lot of customers today, so there was a bit of a wait, but the food didn't take too long to prepare.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thongchai poonyaarpa

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste and ingredients are excellent. The price is also affordable.
Big prawns and other dishes for only 55 baht 😋 I've bookmarked this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Peerapong Maythanarapong

sample_reviews_en.text: The à la carte food is delicious and the prices are reasonable. Importantly, there's a wide variety of dishes to choose from.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krissada Ong-art-kositavong

restaurants.name: ตี๋ ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเนื้อตุ๋น หมูตุ๋น เครื่องในตุ๋น
restaurants.address:

33 Sukhumvit 95/1 Alley, Bang Chak, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand
restaurants.price_level: Photo of reviewer who wrote "Reasonably priced at 70 baht for a large bowl of soup."

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is my first time leaving a Google Maps review.

I went there twice during a short trip. Similar to galbitang, but with a richer rice noodle soup, generous chunks of tender meat, a variety of sauces, insane prices, a local vibe, fast service (3 minutes), and a friendly, young owner.

This place is my definition of beef noodle.
sample_reviews_en.author: 김승현 (John Kim)

sample_reviews_en.text: They give generous portions, but we bought it to eat at home. The restaurant looked clean and had air conditioning, but the broth was too salty. I've had the dry version before and it was also extremely salty. I don't know if they added too much of the broth that made it salty. They should probably adjust the saltiness down a bit.
sample_reviews_en.author: ณัฐนรี JARASRATWORARAT

sample_reviews_en.text: I regularly buy this to take home. The braised beef is of high quality, using premium ingredients. The quality is comparable to famous restaurants, even though the cook is young but dedicated. It's delicious and conveniently located near my home. I highly recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anirut Rattanavipas

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered beef soup with rice for only 80 baht. Good food at a reasonable price, with a nice portion and good hygiene.

It suits the Korean palate well. If you add some white pepper, fish sauce, and red chili powder, it's also great for a hangover cure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Seong Myeong

sample_reviews_en.text: I stopped by because my accommodation was nearby. Just as you mentioned earlier, the broth is rich! You can choose the type of noodles to go with the base broth. However, if you don't like offal, I recommend asking them to leave it out. It's delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: MUTAL무탈

sample_reviews_en.text: I tried the seafood noodles and the restaurant gave me a huge portion of seafood! Everything was very fresh and the taste was really good. My colleague also ordered the stir-fried minced pork with chili paste and it was delicious! Excellent!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chompoo_1581

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious, cheaper than many other restaurants, and air-conditioned.
You can enjoy spicy food comfortably.
A must-order item: the separate tripe dish. You have to try the noodle soup with lots of ingredients; it's very filling.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vasutron Luanglum (Tor Original)

sample_reviews_en.text: The beef noodle soup is delicious, the portion is generous with all the toppings, the price is reasonable, the service is good, the restaurant is clean, and the condiments and eating utensils are neatly and cleanly arranged.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanda Sringa-ngam

restaurants.name: Kitti Duck Noodles (On Nut Branch)
restaurants.address:

1147 Sukhumvit 77 Rd, Bang Chak, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went there for lunch on a weekday.

The restaurant is small, with only about six tables, but it's clean, bright, and has an welcoming atmosphere, even for first-timers.

The restaurant specializes in duck noodle dishes, and the menu has recently been revamped to make it easier to understand.

My favorite is the egg noodle soup (bami hen). The several types of aromatic vegetables add an exquisite accent and bring out the umami of the duck.

Even the "large" size isn't that much, so if you want a hearty meal, I recommend going for the large size.

There is no air conditioning inside the restaurant, but this is one restaurant I always visit when in Bangkok.
sample_reviews_en.author: コツコツマップ

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered a regular duck noodle soup with offal, no blood, for 70 baht. Compared to what I got, it's very expensive.
(If I didn't want blood, they should have added more duck meat, but instead they added intestines.)🥴
The soup is a clear broth, light and savory with a balanced flavor. They give you a lot of soup.
The duck meat is sliced ​​very thinly and in small pieces. There's so little of it that I barely felt like I was eating duck noodles. (I wanted to yell, "Where's my duck?!"😅)
There were also only a few pieces of liver and gizzard; the intestines were the most plentiful.
At least the owner and staff were welcoming.
Overall, 5 out of 10.
sample_reviews_en.author: Opas Samsen

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very delicious, generous portions, and incredibly cheap for the amount you get. It's so cheap it's surprising. Even ordering the regular version is more generous than other specials. The duck pieces are large and generous, and the intestines are clean and crispy.
I order this regularly and will continue to order.
If you like duck noodles or duck intestines, you should definitely give it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nanthida phothirat

sample_reviews_en.text: This duck noodle shop is supposedly famous, but after trying it, the price is quite high. The broth is unexpectedly watery and the flavor is so bland that it can't even be called braised duck. The chrysanthemum tea (25 baht) is extremely diluted and tasteless. I recommend the shop next door, near the entrance to Wat Yang opposite Soi 30; it's much better and an old, established shop in On Nut.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachawis Kanjanarojpokin

sample_reviews_en.text: For delicious duck noodle soup near On Nut, I highly recommend this restaurant. The place looks bright and clean, the food is tasty and reasonably priced. They also sell duck offal, which is especially delicious, particularly the glass noodles. One bowl is enough to make you want another! Parking is available along the street.
sample_reviews_en.author: Art C

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a truly authentic braised duck noodle shop.

The duck meat is tender, and the broth is flavorful (though it might be a little salty for those who don't like salty food).

The duck offal is soft, crunchy, delicious, and not gamey.

And for those who prefer flat noodles or "pepper" noodles, this shop has them!
sample_reviews_en.author: Prim

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered delivery of duck rice. There was a huge portion of rice, with only 5 thin slices of duck and 2 very thin pieces of duck blood pudding the size of my pinky finger. The duck wasn't fragrant at all. This is a huge rip-off. I wouldn't recommend this place. Very disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ayutt Yuktanandana

sample_reviews_en.text: This has always been one of my favorite duck noodle restaurants. It's great that they've opened a branch in On Nut, which is closer to my house. I want to say that the taste is consistently good. Try it, you won't be disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: jate SATHON BK

restaurants.name: Gu ja Drift
restaurants.address:

987 Soi 3, Bang Phrom, Taling Chan, Bangkok 10170, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
My friend lives around the area and brought us here for some Gu Ja drifting and dinner as we did not manage to play go kart in the afternoon. Gu ja drift is created in Thailand and takes some time to get the hang of drifting.
Price is reasonable and fun for adult and kids. The outdoor table we sat at faced the the track and music was played which made the mookaata dinner enjoyable. Mookata is awesome as it uses charcoal. The kids loved the crab meat fried rolls and fried chicken wings. It was fun, drinking beer and drifting hahaha… will go back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paul Ryan Soh

sample_reviews_en.text:
Besides enjoying drift racing, which was great fun for the kids,
the food at the restaurant was also surprisingly delicious.
We didn't order the BBQ pork to get the discount on the drift racing tickets,
but we ordered individual dishes like spaghetti and fried rice, and everything was delicious. Come and enjoy the drift racing and then have a meal here; no need to go anywhere else. Eat, then continue drifting before heading home.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anuwat Siripongvakin

sample_reviews_en.text: The breeze is cool and refreshing. The owner is lovely and very laid-back (lol). There's a wide variety of food to choose from, including BBQ pork, appetizers, papaya salad, various salads, and single-dish meals. It's kid-friendly. There's ample parking. They even have a drift car you can drive – it's not dangerous, even a 5-year-old can drive it comfortably.
sample_reviews_en.author: May Praowpitcha

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant serves Western, Thai, and Northeastern Thai (Isaan) food, perfect for a leisurely drive. There's plenty of seating in two zones: air-conditioned and fan-cooled.
Food prices are a bit high, so check the prices before ordering.

Overall, it's a great place to bring kids; the whole family will enjoy it.
sample_reviews_en.author: บีเคแอล ฺBKL

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice chill cozy drift place.Kids loved the place.Been here couple of times.While kids go for drift,parents sit and enjoy the food and wait next by.Food tastes really good and with a reasonable price.Service is quite slow recommend to order in bunch.Overall nice place,kids really enjoyed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sareena S

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was generally good and varied. The staff were friendly, smiling, and attentive. At the golf course, the staff also gave good advice on how to play and were very cheerful. It was a lot of fun! I recommend it to anyone who wants to try spinning or drifting!
sample_reviews_en.author: zpmlapzaa PW.

sample_reviews_en.text: Very cozy location and environment. Good for both family and friends. I enjoyed their e-Tricycle Drift Machine and also they have a skating rink right beside the Drift Track. I would definitely come back for more food and drift ^^
sample_reviews_en.author: AJ

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was bad. They didn't queue up. When I asked why they let other groups play first, the supervisor replied, "Then why don't you drive the kids' cars?" It was a strange response. I don't plan on playing again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanyarat Pornsiriparpa

restaurants.name: ร้านอาหารป่าพี่หนิง
restaurants.address:

223 Bang Yi Ruea, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is open every day, closed only on days when they don't have stock. The food quality is good. The value for money is excellent. The taste is decent; the food isn't too salty. The shop has only three tables for walk-in customers and is more suitable for take-away.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aphinya Boorakorn

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere is nice and rustic, and the food tastes delicious. My favorites were the tom yum soup with snakehead fish maw and the crispy pork stir-fried with chili and salt.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kannikar Jaroonrak

sample_reviews_en.text: The flavor is predominantly spicy; salty and sweet notes are lacking, and it's not sweet at all. There are plenty of ingredients and a lot of oil. The price is good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaleewaln Vijitrussamee

sample_reviews_en.text: The food offers a wide variety of choices, it's delicious and clean, and includes wild game, pork, shrimp, chicken, and beef.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chollada Wattanasataien

sample_reviews_en.text:
High-quality ingredients.
Excellent taste.
You'll be hooked after your first visit. This restaurant is highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: เซ้ง POPATAS

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes good, the prices are reasonable, and the atmosphere is comfortable. Overall, it's good. 8/10.
sample_reviews_en.author: สมบัติ ว่องการ

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, affordable, and good. The fragrant rice is incredibly tasty! There's a wide variety of dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: ชลลดา วัฒนะเสถียร

sample_reviews_en.text: If anyone is in the Talat Phlu area, please stop by. The food is delicious, clean, and inexpensive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuyntee Yimpunkang

restaurants.name: เชฟอมรเบ็นโตะ
restaurants.address:

เชฟอมรเบ็นโตะ 125 104 Lat Phrao Rd, Khlong Chaokhun Sing, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a restaurant I order from online, and the food is exactly as described. I've never eaten there before. The price is reasonable, the portions are generous, and the food is delicious. The packaging is excellent. I rank this restaurant as my number one choice.
sample_reviews_en.author: buntita bbb

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordering from Gojek for home delivery was great. The food was delicious, the pork wasn't tough, the sauce was tasty, and the pickled vegetables were delicious with a nice sesame oil aroma.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anne “Momster” P.

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely delicious! Every dish is meticulously prepared. The menu may seem simple, but the flavors are uniquely amazing. The prices are affordable. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: ท่อมซิ่งลาดพร้าว Organic drinks Ladphrao

sample_reviews_en.text: I order from this restaurant most of the time. The food here is delicious and clean. Beef and pork meals are a must-try. It is worth recommending and giving five stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Soe Thit Htun

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered through Line Man. The portion was generous and delicious. My favorite was the pickled vegetables. I'll definitely order it again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: TeaTime Kuk

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, clean, and generous portions. Every time I eat here, I always order two sets! The three-layered grilled pork ribs with sauce are amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nutawut Boonlom

sample_reviews_en.text: No. 1! I order again and again. The quantity, quality, taste, price, packaging, and the chef's attention to detail are top-notch in every aspect. 💯
sample_reviews_en.author: บุษกร ฤกษ์ปรีดี

sample_reviews_en.text:
Take away only.
The chef apparently used to work in Japan and speaks Japanese very well.
I always enjoy the delicious meals.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tamago Aoki

restaurants.name: Fahana Italian (Halal)
restaurants.address:

939 Rama IX Rd, Khwaeng Suan Luang, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, and the price and portion sizes were reasonable. The braised beef pho was flavorful. The food came out quickly, with minimal waiting time. There's a wide variety of dishes, but I forgot to take pictures of everything today. The Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage) wasn't served with unripe bananas today; normally it is, which was a little strange, but overall it was very good. Parking was convenient. The staff were a little difficult to make eye contact with; if you arrive, order in advance as they don't always look at customers. You have to crane your neck to find an opportunity to make eye contact or walk to the counter. However, the overall service was good. The restrooms were clean, and there's a prayer room.
sample_reviews_en.author: ์Nidanuch Binsa-aeteh

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but the customer service was terrible. The staff were completely unwelcoming. When I arrived, the restaurant was very crowded, so I wondered if it was full. I hesitated at the door for a long time, unsure how to act, and no staff member came out to greet me or ask anything. I had to go in myself, and even then, they just stood there, not asking how many people were in my party or if I had a reservation. I had to ask the staff myself. It was a very disappointing experience, especially considering it's a high-end restaurant; the service was awful.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hannan Somboon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Had a great meal here. The seafood fried rice was really tasty - full of flavour and generous with seafood. The Vietnamese spring rolls with shrimp were fresh, crispy, and very well done, one of the highlights of the meal.

The pizza is also good, definitely worth trying if you’re here. As a halal Italian restaurant, this place is a solid option in Bangkok Thailand with good portions and a comfortable atmosphere. Food quality exceeded my expectations. Will come again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ying-Noii

sample_reviews_en.text: This Italian, Vietnamese, and Halal restaurant offers a wide variety of dishes at reasonable prices. The beef pho is delicious and comes in a large portion. The pizza has a thin crust and tastes average. Other dishes are also average, but the portions are generous.
sample_reviews_en.author: มาเที่ยว

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes great and there's a wide variety of dishes. I'll have to come back many more times to try everything! 😅 The restaurant is clean, air-conditioned, and has two floors. There's parking in front of the restaurant. I recommend giving it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Montree Hamarn

sample_reviews_en.text: The new branch has a great atmosphere and the food is just as delicious as before, especially the soft-crust pizza and mushroom soup, which the kids loved. Importantly, it's halal Italian food. I highly recommend Fahana Italian Food! 🍕🍄👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Jiraroj Mamadkul

sample_reviews_en.text:
There were two of us. We ordered Nem Nuong (Vietnamese grilled pork sausage) and beef steak.
It was just enough for two people. The food was delicious and suited our taste. The staff were friendly and the restaurant was clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: นที ศรีรองเมือง

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really good restaurant with parking. All thai food in the menu is good, pasta is ok, pizza is ok. Try the Vietnamese  soup is really good. Price a bit more expensive compared to similar places.

Recommended. Nice people.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hamid Man

restaurants.name: KFC Siam Paragon
restaurants.address:

991 Rama I Rd, Pathumwan, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff was not trained well; after my order, about 35 minutes, we waited for the food in fast food! My point was, why didn't they inform us before late service? Because we can use other restaurants. You can find many restaurants on the first floor of Siam Paragon. We were six people; four of us got their food in 2 minutes, but for 2 people, it was 30 minutes. The food is always delicious, and the environment is good, but sometimes something unexpected happens.
sample_reviews_en.author: Majid Boojarzadeh

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken at KFC was fresh and tasty, which is always appreciated. However, one major inconvenience was the lack of a handwashing station inside the outlet. Having to go all the way to the mall's public toilet just to wash hands is not ideal—especially when eating fried food. For a dine-in experience, basic hygiene facilities should be available on-site.
sample_reviews_en.author: 蔡迎秋

sample_reviews_en.text: Because my group was so hungry they couldn't wait for food, we ordered a Zinger Burger set, which wasn't even on the plan. The seasoning was too salty. The fries were a bit greasy. The burger was just okay. I'd rather have a burger or something.
sample_reviews_en.author: 하얀감자

sample_reviews_en.text: I went to Siam Paragon and needed a quick bite to eat. I didn't know what to eat. I happened to see KFC, so I ordered a fried chicken set. The staff asked if I wanted shrimp sauce on top. I'd never tried it before, so I gave it a try. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachatar Viriyapreecha

sample_reviews_en.text: KFC Review: Crispy on the outside, tender on the inside fried chicken. Standard taste, delicious every time. Fast service. Comfortable atmosphere. Great taste, crispy chicken, good value. 食物好吃，鸡肉香脆，服务方便。日本語: チキンはサクサクで美味しい、また来たい店です。
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanakrit Sukkul

sample_reviews_en.text: We tried kfc here, and it was different from Sri Lanka. I liked the taste and it was different. Place is crowded and difficult to find seats. They had quick service and very friendly. Hope they improve the seating places.
sample_reviews_en.author: Disharatnam Varatharatnam

sample_reviews_en.text: The male cashier was very rude. I ordered one thing and was charged another. I ordered takeout and he served it to me. I told him I didn't order this set and he didn't even care about me. He was so rude.
sample_reviews_en.author: แชม เปญ

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. No matter how many orders there are, if the owner of an order can't be found, it should be left alone, not skipped and given to the next person. It's very rude. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthaphong Saema

restaurants.name: 十割そば のじ庵 SOBA NOJIAN
restaurants.address:

786, 13-16 Thong Lo, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Visited on December 16, 2019.
I ordered a mixed plate of soba noodles and a beer during happy hour.
Well...
I'll get straight to the point to save time.
The wooden box the noodles were served in had a bamboo mat underneath, but underneath that...
It was absolutely teeming with baby cockroaches.
Basically, the wooden box had the mat in place, the cockroaches laid eggs, hatched, and then it was served like that.
Long-term storage, unwashed, and with a cockroach as a bonus.
The female server who served me was very apologetic and said I didn't have to pay, but I left 100 baht anyway.
I only ate about three bites.
I thought the manager might come out, but they didn't.
You can imagine what kind of hygiene management they have.

If the restaurant staff sees this review, please leave a comment.
In some countries, this could lead to a lawsuit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lulu Pink

sample_reviews_en.text:
It was delicious! The soba noodles were perfect, chewy and soft. The tsuki sauce was also good and refreshing. / The Tokyo tsuke soba had a fragrant sesame oil aroma, a salty taste, and the thick soba noodles went very well with the soup. You can order 1-2 portions of noodles with the soba dish; the picture shows 2 portions, which is a very generous amount.

The stir-fried pork with ginger was amazing and a must-try! / The Mabo nasu was also good; I wish it had rice.

Overall, I will definitely come back. The soba restaurant closes at 9 PM, but the ramen shop downstairs closes at 2 AM and is equally delicious. You can stop by and eat here too!
sample_reviews_en.author: Arpprn K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious! The matcha green tea soba (thin noodles) with its unique green tea aroma is amazing. The soba noodles are thick, firm, and chewy, giving you a satisfyingly full mouthfeel.
The fried chikuwa is fragrant and crispy, and the meal is finished off with a warm bowl of soba soup (soba yu) for a truly delightful ending.
The restaurant is located on the 2nd floor of the Nojiya building. There is condo parking available, so you can bring your car.
sample_reviews_en.author: Supicha Stienkijumpai

sample_reviews_en.text:
I had three servings of 100% buckwheat soba noodles.

Two servings arrived first, and the third one came later.

If they brought all three servings at once, the last one would get soggy and wouldn't be as tasty, so they boiled the third serving when I was almost finished with the first two, so I could enjoy it fresh and delicious.

This was my first time experiencing something like this, and I was very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Manzoni

sample_reviews_en.text:
Noji-an has reopened on the second floor of its sister restaurant, Nojiya Yuushi. I used to frequent the original location in Thaniya.

I had my favorite Tokyo-style tsukemen (dipping noodles), and the 100% buckwheat noodles, made without any binders, had a wonderful aroma and firm texture. It was delicious, as always.

The location is a little inconvenient, but I'd like to stop by again when I'm in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: KA

sample_reviews_en.text: A casual soba izakaya (Japanese pub specializing in soba noodles). The 100% buckwheat soba noodles served at the end of the meal (up to 3 extra servings free of charge) are absolutely delicious. A friend of mine (who has lived in Thailand for 10 years) also recommended the beer, saying it's cheap and good. I recommend it too.
sample_reviews_en.author: SANAICHI

sample_reviews_en.text:
If you're looking for 100% buckwheat soba in Thailand, this is the place.

I always order the Tokyo-style dipping soba, which has chili oil in the dipping sauce for a slightly spicy kick.

The fact that you can get up to 3 servings of noodles for free is also a nice bonus.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rui

sample_reviews_en.text:
They are currently undergoing reconstruction and are temporarily closed. They are scheduled to reopen on April 1st.

Soba shochu mixed with soba broth. And squid tentacles with soba noodles. Perfect! Being able to drink in the middle of the day is the best!
sample_reviews_en.author: tkmrsha1

restaurants.name: TONG TONG HAAN (통통한) - Bangna Udomsuk
restaurants.address:

Soi Bang Na-Trat 23, Bang Na Nuea, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ate at 6:30 pm on Saturday, January 4th. There were 2-3 tables of customers, and they kept coming in until we paid the bill. The food was served within 10 minutes.

The Korean bibimbap was delicious! It had a rich, savory flavor. We removed half of the sauce before mixing it in, and it turned out perfectly.

The bulgogi pork had a subtle ginger aroma, the pork was pleasantly chewy, and the sauce was rich with sweet, juicy onions.

The kimchi and pickled radish were free, which was great for cutting through the richness.

The honey garlic fried chicken wings were crispy and fragrant; they were the last ones we got.

Overall, everything was excellent. The portions were huge! We even took two wings home – we couldn't finish them all! The total bill was around 500 baht. It was a great experience, and definitely worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Piraorn Bosakoranut

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time at Tongtonghan. The fried chicken was amazing! So delicious, especially when eaten hot. The garlic rice was very fragrant. The Budaejjigae looked like a mix of Tom Yum and sour curry, but it was flavorful and rich. The stir-fried sausage in sauce was also tasty. Importantly, the food came quickly; no long wait.
