The prices are mid-range, not cheap. If you're passing by, stop in and try it!
sample_reviews_en.author: กินเที่ยวเฟี้ยวเงาะ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The waitresses were lovely, hardworking, and polite. There's ample parking.

The kimchi soup had a strangely strong flavor, the fried seaweed was hard, and it really only contained glass noodles.

P.S. Kimchi is 50 baht/serving, and cabbage is 30 baht/serving (small portions). I secretly checked the price at the next table. 😂😂

So-so Korean food. But good service and sufficient parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pavisa Pr

sample_reviews_en.text: "I honestly don't think the chefs here have ever tasted authentic Korean food. The Kimchi Soup was completely tasteless, so I asked them to fix it—only for it to come back tasting even worse. Every single dish we ordered was a disappointment. This is easily the worst dining experience I’ve ever had. We left the food almost untouched; that’s how bad it was. Definitely a place to avoid."
sample_reviews_en.author: Thiha naing

sample_reviews_en.text:
Korean-style tent restaurant with a red tent atmosphere.
The grilled pork wasn't quite to my liking; the side dishes were basic.
The steamed egg custard was ordinary.
The soy sauce marinated shrimp and seafood dipping sauce weren't spicy enough.
They say their fried food is good; I'll try it next time.
Plenty of parking, cool air conditioning, loud music, excellent staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: CottoN

sample_reviews_en.text: At first, I drove past and hesitated to go in. Actually, it's air-conditioned inside, the staff are friendly, and parking is easy – no need to circle around to get to a parking garage. The food tastes good, but the portions are huge! Prices are 200-300 baht per dish; for example, ordering these two dishes would cost over 500 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thana Wan

sample_reviews_en.text: This Korean street food tent restaurant is highly recommended. The flavors are delicious, rich, and spicy, and the prices are affordable. They have a diverse menu, making it perfect for family meals or a chill out with friends – giving you a truly authentic Korean experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jongjit Yuphrai

sample_reviews_en.text:
Korean food that isn't really Korean.
The pork rib hot pot was sweet.
The Jumeokbap had mayonnaise in it.
The fried chicken was crispy but sweet, not spicy at all.
It was a Korean meal that we couldn't finish. We kept getting tired of it. We were really disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Netnapa Jong

restaurants.name: ห้องอาหารไร่ส้ม
restaurants.address:

สมาคมหนังสือพิมพ์ 299 Ratchawithi Rd, Dusit, Dusit District, Bangkok 10300, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, and some of the staff are attentive. However, I recommend going alone or without a family because some of the staff are overly sensitive to any situation. Honestly, I knew this place had been open for a while, but this was my first time, and I didn't realize it wasn't suitable for families. Otherwise, it could easily cause family problems. No drama, please. This is just my personal opinion.
sample_reviews_en.author: นิรนาม

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious and reasonably priced.
The service is good, although it can get a little slow due to the large number of customers.
Overall, it's very good and suitable for celebratory gatherings for older people.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aten Style

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent, the food was delicious and served quickly. The atmosphere might not be very modern, as it's been open for decades and is located at the intersection near the Royal Thai Government Center.
sample_reviews_en.author: jantana jampat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Central Thai flavors are hard to find elsewhere.
This place has a unique, slightly unusual taste.
The service is lovely.
The atmosphere is a bit dim.
Let's just say, finding a quiet corner to sit in is alright.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ton Sunsern

sample_reviews_en.text: I entered the shop and the staff completely ignored me. They were all busy putting on makeup. The service was terrible. I wouldn't recommend coming here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mai DAY

sample_reviews_en.text: Good service and delicious food... except for some of the DJs who are unfriendly... You should focus on the food, not on singing or tipping the DJs.
sample_reviews_en.author: polsak bhukanchana

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, there are plenty of waitstaff, but the music is loud, so it might not be ideal for a conversation. Parking is limited.
sample_reviews_en.author: NP PUAY

sample_reviews_en.text:
Karaoke not updated / No internet access (planned to sing via YouTube)
Good service, food taste wasn't that amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: BANK HOYYA

restaurants.name: Duck Noodle Phayathai Hospital 2 (the old one)
restaurants.address:

961 Phahonyothin Rd, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: considered good duck noodle, bit bland, hard to find parking. Uses msg and gives very small portion. i love their ใส้แก้ว
sample_reviews_th.author: nan doji

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is one of the oldest (legendary) duck noodle shops, practically a fixture right next to the hospital.

The menu is diverse, offering duck noodles, chicken noodles, wonton noodles with roast pork and crispy pork, roast pork rice, and crispy pork rice. I'm not sure if they also have pork leg rice.

The shop is clean and tidy, with food items separated into different sections.

Recently, I had a medical check-up at the hospital, and while waiting for the results, I had the opportunity to stop by this noodle shop. I ordered two bowls, one dry and one soup. I felt the soup was a bit too sweet... For those who want to add seasonings, some might not need to add any sugar at all. I recommend tasting before adding any seasonings, because some people don't like sweet food. If you don't taste it and accidentally add sugar, the noodles will become even sweeter.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panot Laocharoen

sample_reviews_en.text:
The soup has a perfectly balanced soy sauce flavor, neither too strong nor too weak. This is a delicious restaurant serving classic guay teow (Thai noodle soup) with plenty of duck meat and blood clots.

They also have kanom jeep (steamed dumplings) and ha gow (shrimp wontons).

It's not incredibly delicious, but it's good.

The soup has a strangely addictive flavor that makes you want to drink every last drop.

It's a restaurant I'd like to visit again when I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shinichi Hoshi

sample_reviews_en.text:
My sister invited me to eat here after my health checkup. It's a duck noodle soup shop next to Phaya Thai 2 Hospital. The soup is fragrant and not too salty.
The liver and duck wings are stewed until tender. Personally, I didn't feel it was much different from other places; it depends on your preference. The staff provided good service.
The shop does not accept bank transfers; cash only.
sample_reviews_en.author: Munalin Ya

sample_reviews_en.text:
Braised Duck Noodle Soup near Phaya Thai 2 Hospital, close to BTS Sanam Pao station.
I've been eating here since it was in the alley next to the hospital.
It's still as delicious as ever. The soup is fragrant and not too salty.
Too bad I arrived late, the liver was sold out. The braised duck wings are a must-order every time.
The shop does not accept bank transfers; cash only!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Wiphawee Danpongprasert

sample_reviews_en.text: Fast and attentive service. No parking lot; only one car can park temporarily in front of the shop, but the owner said they would help watch for others. A quick meal to leave, but the food was delicious! Both the broth and the tender duck meat were tasty, not thick, and flavorful. They've been selling for a very long time, almost 40 years I think.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mui Asawin

sample_reviews_en.text: Old shop since I live in that area almost 30 years ago when it's in a small alley beside the hospital. I like the taste of the soup but portion is a bit small. Duck is average. Crispy pork itself and soup are nice, with rice is average. Siew Mai is nice but Ha Gao is so so. The bad point is accepting cash only.
sample_reviews_en.author: Little Bunny

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a really delicious duck noodle soup. The duck is tender and falls off the bone. I've been eating at this restaurant for over 30 years, and the quality and standards remain excellent. The staff are lovely and friendly, the owner comes down to oversee the place, and the food comes out very quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Capt.Saksarun Nakkaraj

restaurants.name: ข้าวมันไก่ บิ๊กไนท์ไก่ตอน พระราม4
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 2162 Rama IV Rd, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Big Night Chicken 🐔 Serving up deliciousness 24 hours a day.
If you're not afraid of gaining weight, come this way! 😋

🤔 The last time I ate rice from a hole-in-the-wall plate
was probably when I was at scout camp. 😄

🍗 Fried Chicken and Grilled Chicken with Rice, 80 baht.
The shop also offers biryani (rice with chicken and rice) for an additional 10 baht.
🍚 Their rice is a dark yellowish color, soft and fragrant, quite good.
🥣 They offer four types of dipping sauces: soybean paste, jaew sauce, fried chicken sauce, and sweet soy sauce.
🥣 The soup is a Japanese-style seaweed soup.
🐔 The fried chicken and grilled chicken are good for the price.
😴 Perfect for late-night eaters, as parking during the day is difficult to find.

Location:📍 Big Night Chicken, Rama 4 Road
⏰️ Open 24 hours. Stop by whenever you're hungry.
🚙 Street parking available at night. (Parking is quite hard to find.)

🙏 Thank you everyone ♥️
for clicking "Follow"!

YouTube 🎬 Paopao Studio
TikTok 🎙️ Paopao Studio
Wongnai 🍭 Paopao Studio

#BigNightChicken #StopbyandTryRitTang #EatBeforeBed #PaopaoStudio
sample_reviews_en.author: Paopao Studio

sample_reviews_en.text:
We decided to have Khao Man Gai for our first meal in Bangkok, so we headed to this restaurant.

You can enjoy three types of Khao Man Gai all in one place: steamed, grilled, and fried.

I was amazed that a place of this size, which appears to be a privately owned establishment, is open 24 hours a day.

I wasn't that hungry, so I only ordered one plate, but it was a success. The portions are quite large. We ordered one plate for two people and a beer each, and were full to the brim.

But then I realized something.
The steamed version would be enough.
sample_reviews_en.author: OmmyEatWorld

sample_reviews_en.text: A very decent Chicken Rice shop which operates 24 hours. The portion is very fulfilling for a person. It come into traditional tray which fit all of the meal in a plate. The soup is quite amazing. They have blended seaweed into it. I would recommend this if you are nearby in the area or during the odd hours when nothing is available. They have wide variety of dish available and it will leave your stomach happy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thusnai M

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice was delicious, the chicken was juicy, and the dipping sauce was flavorful with plenty of chili, garlic, and ginger. The staff might seem a bit grumpy, but that's understandable since they probably aren't Thai. It's better to help yourself to water than to wait for staff to ask. The inside of the restaurant is a bit hot. It's a shame they stopped selling biryani rice.
sample_reviews_en.author: Feeno Ning

sample_reviews_en.text: Ordered food delivery, ordered a special mixed chicken for 110 baht and a special boiled chicken for 85 baht, but the quantity and price were like heaven and earth. The packaging was terrible. I called the restaurant, but no one answered. Overall, I think I'll only order this once, it's really terrible.
sample_reviews_en.author: จตุพล หิ้งสุวรรณ

sample_reviews_en.text: The soup is very salty. Normally when I come here, the other person's soup isn't salty at all. There's seaweed too. I came today at 3:46 AM on 21/08/68. The soup is so salty that I can't drink it. Oh, no way. I'm not sure if the restaurant has changed the recipe. If they have, I'll have to stop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kanokrat Saengchan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Honest Chicken Rice
The rice has no garlic added.
If you don't like garlic but love chicken rice, I highly recommend this restaurant!

The sauce is delicious, and the soup is seaweed-based.

I found this while scrolling through my feed, so I ordered it.
This is my fourth order, and I love it!
sample_reviews_en.author: K.W. Yu

sample_reviews_en.text: The prices are reasonable, with the cheapest meal costing only 50 baht. The chicken is quite tender, the accompanying sauces are good and clean, and it also comes with a bowl of soup. It's great value for money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Huang Ming Liu

restaurants.name: Suvarna Yangon Biryani & Delicacies สุวรรณะ - ย่างกุนบริยานีและอาหารเลิศรส
restaurants.address:

18 5 Soi Sathon 11, Yan Nawa, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The foods are very delicious and the stuff they are very nice and kind. While I was eating I felt like I was in Myanmar . You should definitely try this out. I promise you won’t regret it!!I can’t say which food was my favourite cause everything is yummy!!One thing I would like to say is they should add more drinks choices, that’s all I have to say cause everything is perfect!! You don’t wanna miss it out!!
sample_reviews_en.author: yubarap thannaing

sample_reviews_en.text:
I have tried the restaurant 3 times and each time different menu. While Biryani and Nangyithoke are excellent, there are dishes I don’t really like, in particular mixed fried tempura. As you can see in the picture, they are definitely not freshly made. Anyway, i will still go there for the menu they are great at.

Biryani : 5/5 excellent
Shan noodle: 3/5
Nangyithoke: 5/5
Monthingar: 3/5
Mixed tempura: 0/5
sample_reviews_en.author: Jewel Kyi Soe

sample_reviews_en.text: Very cute and delicious Burmese option in Soi 11. I used to go to this little Burmese place in Soi 8 but it closed. So I was afraid I had to miss out on my tea leaf salad or that I had to go all the way to the Sukhumvit area. But luckily this place opened. And it‘s very busy! Looks like they are doing well. Which is great because their food is very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is small but it is compact and very comfortable. The environment is also easy to get to as it is located in the middle of the street near the entrance to the main road. The food is good. It is not too greasy and not too spicy. Tea is the best!
sample_reviews_en.author: Peter's Creations

sample_reviews_en.text: This place have best Myanmar food in Sathorn area. The chicken briyani have an authentic Yangon flavor. The other menu items are also really delicious and have authentic flavors. This place have a great service. I highly recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nyi Nyi

sample_reviews_en.text: Suvarna is kind of Burmese hidden spot very near by Myanmar Embassy. Burmese Biryani is the signature and give a taste of home. Must go at least once if you arrive near Myanmar Embassy, BTS Saint Louis or Satong area.
sample_reviews_en.author: Saw Thura Oo

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went to eat a snack of rice cakes
I asked for a quick meal of rice cakes, but it didn't come for 15 minutes. I had to wait another 15 minutes.
Even for a quick meal like rice cakes, I had to wait for half an hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ingyin Mhwe

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice with rice noodles is very good. The chicken is tender. The shop is quiet and you can chill. The traditional Burmese tealeaf salad is also very good. If you haven't been there yet, I recommend you to try it.
sample_reviews_en.author: war r

restaurants.name: Plearn Pooong Noodles & More (ICONSIAM)
restaurants.address:

ชั้น G, 403 ติดสยามทาคาชิมายะ Charoen Nakhon 10 Alley, Khlong Ton Sai, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Retrospective review from a visit several weeks ago.
A friend invited me, saying the food wasn't too expensive.
I noticed a lot of foreigners frequenting the restaurant.
The food seems to use a lot of MSG,
because my mouth felt quite dry afterwards.
The hot pot took a while to heat up.
My friend and I each chose a main dish,
and ordered instant noodles to share.
(You can choose the spiciness level).

The tables are quite cramped, probably due to limited space.
The staff worked quite quickly,
but table management was still a bit slow.

The restaurant is near a 7-Eleven. After leaving the restaurant,
I had to stop and buy some water because my mouth was really dry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joy sarinubia

sample_reviews_en.text:
I eat here regularly, and it's pretty good. The flavors are moderate, not too strong, and they focus on using good quality ingredients, suitable for foreigners.
The price is a bit high, but that's probably partly because it's in a mall.
The noodles are a little bland for my taste, but the rice tastes good.
The desserts are pretty good, and the snacks are delicious, but the portions feel small. The drinks are standard.

The service is good; the staff are quick. Sometimes it's busy and they can't keep up. The atmosphere depends on the time of day. If it's not crowded, it's peaceful. When it's busy, it gets chaotic and the food comes out a bit slower.
sample_reviews_en.author: Juliet Kathy K.

sample_reviews_en.text:
✨ Plearn Pung, a one-dish restaurant offering simple and affordable Tom Yum noodles at Icon Siam. We recommend this place.

🥢 Tom Yum noodles with fried chicken and salted egg, and Tom Yum glass noodles with bouncy pork and salted egg. Their Tom Yum is perfectly seasoned and not too spicy, making it suitable for foreigners.
For a snack, try freshly fried spring rolls, crispy and delicious.

📍 Plearn Pung, G Floor, Icon Siam

#TryIt #longkindooz #PlearnPung #ThisMealIsWorthIt #noodles
sample_reviews_en.author: Punnaporn Siriviriya

sample_reviews_en.text: The environment and service was extremely good, however the food was flavorless to say the least. I ordered some noodles and rice omelette, and on the menu they both appeared to have large servings of meat. However when I received my food, the servings were tiny and the noodles weren’t even mixed in (it was literally a square at the bottom of my soup). I recommend you to spend your money at any other restaurant than this tiny serving restruant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Calvin C

sample_reviews_en.text: The food tastes good except for the crispy chicken with orange sauce. The chicken is very hard. The price of the food is not expensive compared to other restaurants in the mall and nearby areas. The staff provides good service. The atmosphere of the restaurant is good. If you are looking for a restaurant with affordable prices, I recommend considering this as one of your options.
sample_reviews_en.author: Peeravit R

sample_reviews_en.text:
This affordable noodle shop in Icon is rather bland, with a focus on making your own seasonings. They offer a wide selection of condiments and a small amount of filling for the dumplings, but I understand they're trying to keep costs in check. Overall, it's a good place to eat and I'll definitely be back.

Besides noodles, they also offer a scrambled egg rice dish worth a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patarin Napanukroh

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is mid-range, not expensive, which I think is a good price for ICONSIAM mall. The menu is easy to understand, and the staff are attentive and caring.
If you want to eat inexpensive and easy-to-understand food, I recommend this restaurant. The taste is appealing to foreigners and worth trying. It's not hot inside the mall.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siri J

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered Padthai, but it was really tiny, like a bird's feed, and we weren't full. Then we ordered chicken salad, but that wasn't enough either. The sauce they put in ruined the taste; we couldn't eat it. We left hungry. It's not worth the price. We deeply regret what we got. I don't recommend this place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yeliz Durmaz

restaurants.name: Khun Chang
restaurants.address:

Bang Khlo, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok 10120, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a hidden gem in the area. The staff are incredibly attentive, constantly refilling drinks – nothing ever runs low! 😂 The snacks are basic, like any other bar. There's a separate VIP room next door.

The bar allows customers to sing two songs per table, rotating through the rooms. You can sit and sing for as long as you like.

Parking is available around the perimeter of the bar.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alicia

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was delicious but served a bit slowly. The prices were quite high. The service was excellent, and the owner and musicians were very friendly.

The atmosphere was more of a niche setting; customers could take turns singing, and the music was quite loud.

It's more suitable for a fun, relaxed meal than for those looking for a place to chill, work, or families with children.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rinrawee Phosri

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're looking for a fun, lively atmosphere and karaoke, this is the place to be. The food is excellent and you'll receive a warm welcome. Nice venue and a good selection of beers.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris Roadtrip

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm back again. I ordered Gai Yang and Ka Pho Kai Kem. The same staff member from my last visit was there and greeted me. It was a very pleasant experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: shindou kazuyuki

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a place where you won't want to leave. The atmosphere is great, and customers at each table can go up and sing, because the owner sings beautifully.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siraphat Sarakham

sample_reviews_en.text: Affordable prices, delicious food, family atmosphere, great sound system, and comfortably cool air conditioning.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุรินทร์ หมื่นเจริญ

sample_reviews_en.text: Really friendly staff and good Thai food.  Live music and karaoke were fun. The place had a nice “biker” vibe.
sample_reviews_en.author: Skip Hodges

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is relaxed, comfortable, and friendly.
Songs for life (Thai folk/protest music).
sample_reviews_en.author: Pairoj Songrenu

restaurants.name: Joke Wat Thung
restaurants.address:

1109, 24 ถนน สุขุมวิท 101/1 Bang Chak, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
🍽️Food Taste: If you're looking for good congee in Soi Wachirathamsathit, this is the place to go.
🥩Ingredient Quality: Good
🥦Vegetarian Menu: Not recommended for vegetarians.
🧒Kids' Menu: Unsure if they charge for children's congee.
🫧Cleanliness: Acceptable
🪙Food Price: Moderate
⌛Waiting Time for a Table: Busy on Saturday and Sunday mornings, but the wait isn't too long.
⏳Waiting Time for Food: Short wait.
🧑‍🍳Service: Moderate
🌳Restaurant Atmosphere: The restaurant is a typical shophouse.
🚘Parking: You'll need to find parking in the side streets next to the congee shop.
♿Wheelchair Accessible: The entrance and exit are on the sidewalk in the alley, which may not be convenient for wheelchairs.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mktg Buddy

sample_reviews_en.text:
The congee itself was quite runny, and the pork was more like bouncy pork than typical minced pork. It was lightly seasoned, with a hint of sauce aroma, but overall it was rather bland. There were also a few small clumps of rice scattered throughout.

Compared to other places I've eaten at, the congee was usually stickier and the pork tastier. Perhaps it's just my personal preference for this style.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bee BeYourCyber

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! The porridge was packed with bouncy pork and very filling. The herbal drink was refreshing and just the right amount of sweetness. I ordered it to take home and the porridge stayed hot for a long time, just like eating at the restaurant. My family was very impressed!
sample_reviews_en.author: O’ S

sample_reviews_en.text: This place is one of the best! The rice is smooth, fragrant, and delicious, and it goes perfectly with the fried dough sticks. The minced pork is a bit bouncy, which I personally don't like as much... but overall it's okay. I often have breakfast here. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sutipat R.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very expensive.
The taste wasn't anything special.
Long wait time and small portions.
There's no price list posted outside the shop.
I bought 3 sets of vegetables and ginger, but only got one set. Terrible! How stingy can they be? Shouldn't it be one set per bag?
sample_reviews_en.author: Wutthikhorn Junhasobhaga

sample_reviews_en.text: Considering all the places I've eaten porridge, this is one I can keep coming back to. I don't usually eat porridge much, but the service is friendly and cheerful. As for the atmosphere, it's typical seating with tables, and the restaurant is clean and spacious.
sample_reviews_en.author: nuchjarin phetburee

sample_reviews_en.text: The highlight of this shop is the bouncy pork!!!🐷🐷 This shop's bouncy pork is truly amazing. I always keep some in the fridge. When I don't know what to eat or what to cook, just add the bouncy pork and it's delicious! It can be used in …
sample_reviews_en.author: Monthira Jirawatthanadumrong

sample_reviews_en.text: I've been eating here since I was a kid, and now that I'm old, I still go there. The taste is still as delicious as ever, it hasn't changed at all. In front of the porridge shop, they also have delicious soy pudding and soy milk.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kamila ZN

restaurants.name: Bamee Thewet
restaurants.address:

QG93+9V6, Bang Khun Phrom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Someone once told me this noodle shop was their regular haunt. I tried their dry noodles and it was delicious, though a little too sweet.
The owner gave me a generous portion of noodles. I liked the large pieces of crispy pork rind; they were tasty. The meatballs were bouncy, soft, and smooth, which was good. However, the dumplings were a bit mushy. The bowl came with a flavorful broth, and the accompanying soup was easy to drink, with a sweet and well-balanced taste.
The atmosphere was typical street food, with metal tables lined up like other noodle shops along the sidewalk.
There was a constant stream of customers. I understand that foreigners might also frequent the shop, as the owner initially thought I was Chinese.

Overall, I liked it. This time I couldn't finish it all because the portion was so large, but if you're really hungry, I think you'll be able to finish it all.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattra Pip

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodle soup is delicious and hot, reminiscent of the noodles I used to eat as a child, over 40 years ago. The soup was so good you didn't even need to add anything, but I like it spicier, so I only added chili powder. The fish balls, fish dumplings, pork dumplings, and egg noodles are all delicious and soft. The shop is located in front of Soi Thewet 1, opposite the bus depot for bus number 53. They're open on Sundays. It's a bit of a drive by the road, but it's hot. The noodles are delicious; they also have shrimp balls (you can ask to add everything!). The soup is sweet and tasty; I don't usually like sweet food, but it has that old-fashioned sweetness that some people might find a bit too sweet. The shop focuses on Tom Yum noodles and provides lime wedges to add as much as you like. You can park along the canal on weekends.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krisakan Watchakapong

sample_reviews_en.text: This old, established Cantonese noodle shop in Thewet has been selling noodles for over 40 years. The owner, Mr. San, makes the noodles himself. I tried their noodle soup; the noodles were soft and firm, the broth was flavorful, and the char siu pork was delicious. Plus, it's cheap! My bowl cost 30 baht. Even though I asked for less noodles, they still filled the bowl. It's another great place to try.
sample_reviews_en.author: นาย กาแฟ

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is an old noodle and wonton shop that has been in business since around 1977.
They make their own noodles.
The noodles are chewy and soft.
The dry noodles are generously coated in fried pork lard, giving them a fragrant aroma.
The broth is flavorful.
A bowl costs 30 baht and the portion is generous.
It's considered a cheap noodle dish, similar to those found in laborer's stalls.
sample_reviews_en.author: Soottipong Winyoopradist

sample_reviews_en.text:
This old noodle shop in the Thewet area is located at the entrance of Soi Thewet 1. The taste is good and the price is reasonable, but it's a bit too oily; you need to eat it with the broth to balance it out.

The owner is very fast; even when it's crowded, the wait isn't long.

We like to order the wonton soup with barbecued pork; it's delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chatchanok Chanyeam

sample_reviews_en.text:
Wonton noodles with barbecued pork, a late-night favorite.
Generous portions for the price. Thick noodles topped with a sweet barbecued pork sauce; if you don't like it too sweet, just add a little. Large pieces of crispy pork crackling, unlike anything else. It brings back childhood memories. The shop has been open for over 30 years.
sample_reviews_en.author: Metoo Nonthum

sample_reviews_en.text: Homemade noodles, tender and delicious roast pork, the roast pork sauce is a bit sweet, the meatballs are okay, and the price is only 40 baht. I ate until I was stuffed. Overall, it was delicious and much more than the price. I wondered if the seller was a detective investigating a case.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chanin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was absolutely delicious and the owner was incredibly friendly. I especially loved the crispy bacon in the soup. The noodles with pork were also very tasty.

It's a stall right on the street, but everyone inside is so friendly, making you feel very comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ann-Christin H

restaurants.name: Tonchin Ramen (One Bangkok)
restaurants.address:

1 Rama IV Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I had lunch at Tonchin Ramen, One Bangkok branch, located on B1 floor, storey side, near Oh Juice.

This restaurant has received Michelin awards in 2019, 2020, and 2021.

The restaurant's signature dish is Tonkatsu Ramen.
The broth is delicious and well-balanced, not too salty, just the right flavor, making it easy to finish the whole bowl without feeling腻 (cloying).

The restaurant offers two options, differing only in the type of meat. The popular option includes both Chashu pork and pork belly, while the more expensive option is just pork belly.

I decided to try the recommended option and tasted both types of meat. The Chashu slices were large but not thick, but the pork belly was very thick, with a slightly tough texture to chew.

For those who like to add their own seasonings, the restaurant provides a set of condiments.

I also ordered gyoza today. They weren't very big and were soft rather than crispy. This dish was just okay.

They have refillable green tea.

There are plenty of tables, including counter seating near the chef.

The staff were polite and provided good service. The food came out quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shasha Pol

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything was delicious and the service was excellent.
The wavy noodles were perfectly cooked, with a nice slight chewiness. The pork bone broth can be ordered in standard or with reduced saltiness and richness. I had the standard version, and it was rich and flavorful; I finished the whole bowl without feeling腻 (cloying) like at some other restaurants. In short, it was delicious. Next time, I'll try ordering it with less salt and richness to compare.
The pork neck steak rice bowl had thick, tender meat and a rich flavor. It was delicious, and the Japanese rice was a perfect combination. The grated daikon radish served alongside added more nuance to the taste. It was fantastic.
The chicken breast topping I ordered extra looked pale, and I thought it would be bland, but it had a lovely, subtle aroma. The meat was tender and juicy, and the flavor was subtly delicious.
The restaurant is located in an area without a beautiful view. It's really a place to come for the delicious food. If it had a better location and view, it would be fantastic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gunn Polparsi

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good food but horrible service. When we came to the shop, there was only one table, us. We ordered 3 menus together, but only 2 menus came. We were almost finished eating and still didn't have any. So we asked the staff to help us find them. The staff went into the kitchen and pretended that it was on the bill, but the kitchen forgot to make it... Then we saw the kitchen looking out at our table and giggling that they forgot to make it. It was horrible. We will not recommend or use this branch again. The staff training is very bad.

The food was good, but the service was horrible. When we came the shop only had a single table, us!! We ordered 3 menus, they took the order, but only 2 menus came. When we asked about it, they checked the kitchen and apparently forgot the menu even though it was on the bill. The chef inside the kitchen was also looking at us an giggling in response to forgetting to make a menu. It was plain rude!! Never coming back to this branch ever again, horrendous behavior.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nithi Pakmanee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stopped by for a quick bite to cheer myself up.
I heard they've received a Michelin star for 7 consecutive years, so I wanted to give it a try.
I ordered the ramen, slightly spicy.
For those who like spicy food, this might not be very spicy.
But for those who can't handle spicy food, the broth will feel spicy and hot in your digestive tract when you swallow.
The noodles have a good texture, not too hard or too soft.
The broth is rich in flavor, spicy first, then salty and savory.
The egg is cooked perfectly; the egg white isn't 100% cooked, so it's still somewhat soft.
The chashu pork is well-prepared, tender, and flavorful, already seasoned.
The price, including VAT, for one bowl (without drinks) was 341 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: HIPSKULL Pomade

sample_reviews_en.text:
Aug/2025
I ordered the Tokyo Truffle Shoyu Ramen... Oh my god! The aroma of truffle oil hit my nose... It was so delicious! The noodles, soup, and toppings were all just right... This is one of those ramen shops with chains that maintains excellent quality control... The egg was just the right amount...

That wasn't enough for me, so I ordered the Char Siu Pork Steak with Ponzu Sauce for extra protein. It was great... And a common weakness of many ramen shops is the lack of vegetables and the lack of extras. This place had a salad menu, like the Chicken Breast Salad with Plum Sauce. It was refreshing and opened my taste buds beautifully.
sample_reviews_en.author: Antonio Oattono

sample_reviews_en.text:
I wish the restaurant would let me change the noodle type and soup base. I like the thin noodles, but I'm getting bored with the same old soup.

The staff recommended the truffle soy sauce ramen as a new menu item.
I was a bit confused because I've seen it on the menu since they opened their first branch in Thailand many years ago.

And also, it's a ramen shop, a type of noodle restaurant, so there's not much service involved. They just take an order in 2-3 sentences and bring the bowl to the table, so I felt a little uneasy about why I had to pay a +10% service charge.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sakulrut Saipunya

sample_reviews_en.text: My favorite ramen brand with several branches in Bangkok. Unfortunately, my go-to tsukemen isn’t available at this branch. The taste and quality also feel a bit lower compared to other locations I’ve visited. Still, the garlic on the table is one of the signature highlight for this brand. This branch offers a calm and quiet atmosphere, making it a pleasant spot to enjoy ramen despite the drop in quality.
sample_reviews_en.author: NNchan

sample_reviews_en.text: Tonchin, a ramen shop in Ikebukuro, Tokyo, has opened a branch at ONE BANGKOK. It offers counter and table seating in an open space. The flavor is authentic. The thick, curly noodles pair perfectly with the soy sauce and pork bone broth, making it very tasty. It's quick and easy to eat, so you can head back to work straight away, making it very convenient for businessmen working at ONE BANGKOK.
sample_reviews_en.author: Yoshinori N

restaurants.name: Sin Zab Esan ซิ้น แซ่บอีสาน
restaurants.address:

280 Krungthep Kreetha Rd, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I have to say, I was disappointed. I ordered because I saw so many high-star reviews. If you like Northeastern Thai food in Bangkok, you might like it, but I'll describe the dishes one by one: The Tom Yum soup was overly sweet, with lots of tomatoes – you can judge for yourself. The Kua Khom (spicy minced meat salad) was bland and tasteless. The Catfish Larb lacked spiciness and had tons of large bones. The Fried Duck Beaks weren't crispy at all. The Jim Jum (Thai hot pot) had incredibly tough meat. The Grilled Tongue was average. Otherwise, I was just disappointed. I don't know what those people who gave so many high stars thought. And the wait for food was ridiculously long. I ordered takeout and had someone wait for it – it took 40 minutes! Just a few dishes, and I'm done with this place. I'm writing this in detail so that those who like Northeastern Thai food can consider this.
sample_reviews_en.author: ATHIPAT KHUANTHAM

sample_reviews_en.text: I was looking for a hot pot restaurant near my house and found this one. I'd never tried it before, but I often drive past it, so I decided to stop by. Wow... the hot pot was incredibly delicious! 💖✨ The owner and staff were also very friendly and provided great service. The other dishes were also tasty and flavorful. There's plenty of parking. Highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Parkii Rinlapat

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the taste is great. The first time we came with friends, we ordered grilled fish with herbs and spices, papaya salad with crab and fermented fish sauce, sweet liver, shrimp patties, and grilled pork neck. It was all so good, we came back again, this time with our family. Everyone loved it too.
sample_reviews_en.author: ทิวาพร หลวงบํารุง

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and cheap. If you want to come here to avoid traffic jams from the city center, you can take the ARL and get off at Hua Mak, then continue with Grab/Bolt/Taxi/Ojek until here, or take the MRT Yellow Line and get off at Si Krittha station and continue with Grab/Bolt/Taxi/Ojek
sample_reviews_en.author: cvy.s

sample_reviews_en.text:
My first time eating here and I was so impressed!
Especially Mr. Tan, the owner 😊😊
Recommended dishes: Papaya salad with thin noodles and crab in fermented fish sauce 👍👍
Seafood papaya salad
Spicy catfish soup
And the "U-Pia" (a type of spicy soup)...it's absolutely amazing! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: ความทรงจํา จากสิ่งดี ดี

sample_reviews_en.text: I came to try this place because I've seen it's been around for a while. I read reviews on Google Maps, and everyone said it was good. After trying it myself, I have to say it was amazing! The food was delicious in every dish. It's a shame …
sample_reviews_en.author: Churirat Sumethanaphit

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food was amazing, I'll definitely come back again! 👋
My friend (a fan of Lin Yang) thinks the price is too cheap! 🥳
I even saw him on the 13th, so lucky! Unfortunately, my friend forgot to give him Labubu! 🥲
sample_reviews_en.author: ice parsons

sample_reviews_en.text: Convenient parking. The restaurant has a very chill atmosphere in the evening. The food is delicious, especially the fried dishes which are fragrant and very crispy.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichayapat Thongsrikate

restaurants.name: นายเลี้ยงขนมหวานสาขา2
restaurants.address:

84 Udom Suk Rd, Bang Na Nuea, Bang Na, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I went for a late-night drive around Udom Suk area. The shop is located in Soi 8, a small shop on the right-hand side.

The owner, an elderly lady, is very friendly. Her desserts include sweet bean curd, longan juice with fresh milk and various toppings. They are delicious, made with high-quality ingredients, and the portions are very generous. Importantly, they aren't overly sweet; the sweetness is just right. The tea she serves is Chinese tea, which is more fragrant than other shops (and it's free).

Besides desserts, she also makes savory dishes to order, depending on what she has available that day. It's a simple, homey shop where you'll feel happy while eating. I'll definitely stop by often if I'm in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: wanchalerm jeankittimasak

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is located in Udom Suk Soi 8, right next to the noodle shop, perfect for a sweet treat to finish off your meal. The shop closes after 1 AM.
The grass jelly with fresh milk is not too sweet.
There's a wide variety of menu options. The owner is lovely, offering recommendations and even giving freebies. If I crave dessert late at night, I'll definitely stop by again.
sample_reviews_en.author: tktm ntch

sample_reviews_en.text: This shop's bua loy (Thai rice balls in coconut milk) is superb. The coconut milk is perfectly sweet, creamy, and slightly salty. The rice balls are chewy, soft, and incredibly enjoyable to eat. Plus, they add tender coconut pieces that are so juicy and moist to chew on. I used to not like bua loy at all, but after trying this shop's, I'm hooked! 😍😍🥰🥰
sample_reviews_en.author: Niwat ratipong

sample_reviews_en.text: Yesterday, I happened to pass by and bought ginkgo nut milk and shaved ice. The taste was amazing, so much so that I came back again today. The shop also sells made-to-order food, both savory and sweet, and it's all delicious. If you're passing by, I highly recommend trying it. Besides the reasonable prices, the owner and her daughter are very kind.
sample_reviews_en.author: John Doe

sample_reviews_en.text: Sweet, soft, and creamy with fresh coconut milk. Dessert lovers will know what we're craving! 😄🍧👍🏻 We found out it's an original shop from Yaowarat (Chinatown), and their candied ginkgo nuts and lotus root are uniquely soft and juicy. If you're in Udom Suk or Bang Na, you definitely can't miss this place!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ik

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is located behind the congee shop, a short walk into a small alley.
It's delicious, Yaowarat quality. The ginkgo nut and pomegranate dessert is amazing. You can specify how sweet you like it.
The owner is very kind.
The shop was closed for 2 years and just reopened 3 weeks ago.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chadaratch Udomswangchoke

sample_reviews_en.text:
The ginkgo nut milk dessert uses Bear Brand milk, it's delicious. The owner is also very talkative and gave me free longan juice to sample, which was really tasty. Usually, I find longan juice that's too sweet, but hers was just right. I liked it a lot.
📍The shop is located in Soi 8.
sample_reviews_en.author: P 8

sample_reviews_en.text:
This dessert shop closes at 2 AM and the desserts are amazing. We live far away near Mega Bangna, but we drove all the way here, and it was totally worth it.
- The lotus root dessert is fragrant and not too sweet.
- The crispy water chestnut dessert is the best!
sample_reviews_en.author: beercappom

restaurants.name: EAt Am Are Good Steak เดอะมอลล์งามวงศ์วาน
restaurants.address:

ห้องเลขที่ 332-334 หมู่ที่ 2 Ngamwongwan Rd, ตำบลบางเขน Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I checked out this Western-style casual dining restaurant in The Mall Ngamwongwan, and the portions were incredibly generous.

I ordered a hearty mixed platter with pan-fried fish fillet, steak, thick-cut fries, and toasted bread, served with a refreshing cabbage salad. The fish fillet was pan-fried to a golden brown and crispy perfection, and a squeeze of lime added a refreshing touch. The steak was drizzled with a rich sauce, bursting with meaty flavor; the thick-cut fries were topped with salad dressing, and the toasted bread was soft and sweet – a single plate offered a variety of delicious options.

I also ordered a bacon and beef burger. The bun was perfectly toasted and juicy, the thick beef patty was satisfying, and the combination of crispy bacon and lettuce created a satisfyingly layered flavor. Each bite was bursting with flavor, and the accompanying mashed potatoes were smooth and creamy. I also ordered a salad, but without dressing, it was a perfect balance to cut through the richness of the other ingredients.
sample_reviews_en.author: YU CHEN

sample_reviews_en.text:
I usually order delivery, but this is my first time dining in at the restaurant. They have a new branch at The Mall Ngamwongwan. It's been open for a while now, and initially the queues were very long, so I hesitated to try. Today, I decided to try it. There were about 10 tables to choose from, and it took about 20 minutes to get a table. Most of the tables were for 4 people, and since our family of 7 had no larger tables available, we had to sit separately. Overall, it wasn't a very long wait.

You can order food via QR code or through a staff member. The food arrived quickly, it was delicious, reasonably priced, and the service was good. However, they only accept cash or bank transfers.
sample_reviews_en.author: kate space

sample_reviews_en.text: I usually only eat at the Westgate branch because the service is good, but this is my first time eating at this branch. Here are some issues: 1. The staff didn't give me a QR code to scan for my purchases and just walked away, even though the restaurant wasn't full. 2. There were many staff members, but none of them responded when I called them. 3. Other tables that arrived later received QR codes and were served immediately. I don't know why. Is this a selective customer service practice? 4. There were no plates, forks, or knives provided! Yet other tables that arrived later received them!
sample_reviews_en.author: Pitcha Pongpanit

sample_reviews_en.text:
🐟 The tuna salad here is delicious! The portion is generous, the vegetables are fresh and crisp, the creamy dressing is well-balanced, and the tuna isn't too salty.
🐽 Pork steak and grilled fish: I usually order the same things, but this time I tried it and it wasn't that great. I'll stick to my usual order next time, haha. The papaya salad is delicious, and the bread with tartar sauce is the best!

🧑🏻‍🍳 Service: The food was served quickly. The foreign staff might not understand the order clearly when repeating it, but there were no mistakes. They were efficient and did a good job.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vanillin Chaophuwiang

sample_reviews_en.text: My favorite steak place. There might be a short wait, but not too long because this branch has quite a few tables. You get two large steaks for only 189 baht, which is cheap compared to prices in malls. The papaya salad is delicious; I come here specifically for the papaya salad. The staff might not always speak clearly or understand what you say, which might be a signature issue as it's like this at every branch, lol. Sometimes, when there are a lot of kids, it's really headache-inducing and ear-splitting 🥲. Even so, I still come here every month, lol.
sample_reviews_en.author: Gloyjai ᯓᰔ

sample_reviews_en.text:
The pork served was undercooked. Menu item: Black Pepper Pork Steak.
Branch: The Mall Ngamwongwan.
First serving: The pork was redder than this, but I didn't take a picture. The staff said the pork was cooked to the restaurant's standard and confirmed we could continue eating. We asked them to reheat it.

Second serving: After reheating, this is what we got (as pictured).

Could you please check if the pork was actually cooked, or am I mistaken in thinking that marinating the meat to be that red was normal?
sample_reviews_en.author: wanlapha panpram

sample_reviews_en.text:
This steakhouse, over a decade old, has expanded from a branch in the city to the Ngamwongwan area.
The spacious space is designed according to the brand's concept, with a large staff and excellent service. The menu is presented in a booklet, allowing you to scan a QR code to order.
The food tastes as delicious as ever, with excellent quality and quantity. It's filling and worth every penny. I'm very satisfied and will continue to patronize the place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nukio Postal

sample_reviews_en.text: The black pepper pork steak is tender and juicy, the sausage is perfectly grilled, and you can choose one side dish from options like French fries, onion rings, and more. It comes with bread, a fresh and crispy salad with a delicious, non-greasy dressing, and flavorful papaya salad. The prices are affordable, the service is good and attentive, and the food arrives quickly. It's great value for money, delicious and budget-friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prapawadee Nui

restaurants.address:

473 Thanon Si Ayutthaya, Thung Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
FRUIT IS NATURE'S CANDY 🍋 🍏 🍌 🥕 🍭
💚 @drinkpaak's newest branch at THE BAPTIST PHAYATHAI is huge! It's the biggest branch yet, offering full service.
🍽️ ✨ And a very special new menu item available only at the Phayathai branch! For each menu item, you can choose your own protein: chicken, beef, seafood, or some menus even offer quinoa rice.
✨ 🥤 They also have smoothies and cold-pressed drinks, all sugar-free, and you can DIY your own! Choose whatever you like. Personally, I think it's perfectly balanced, easy to drink, and packed with nutrients. Even someone like me who doesn't like vegetables found this delicious 🙊 ✨ 💚

My choices for this meal included:
𓌉◯𓇋 𓈒 𓏸 SALMON PESTO BOWL
𓂃𓂑 𓌈 TROPICAL AHI POKE BOWL
𓌉◯𓇋 𓈒 𓏸 BANGKOK PANANG BOWL
𖠚ᐝ GOLDEN HOUR
BLUE SPIRULINA / MANGO / COCONUT YOGURT / COCONUT MILK / PINEAPPLE
𖠚ᐝ BERRY BERRY
MIXED BERRY / PASSION FRUIT / MANGO / PINEAPPLE / BANANA
sample_reviews_en.author: cameragirl bkk

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'm really impressed with PAAK. I've been doing a juice fast for several days. I ordered 4 juices per day and they've all been delicious. They have a few vegetable based options that aren't sweet, which was important for me. I'm quite impressed how creative and tasty some of their combinations are.

I went into the store the other day and tried their salmon quinoa dish, it was delicioous too.

The staff members mentioned their membership and offerere dme a free watermelon drink. I didn't want another drink that day, but they sent my free drink with my next grab order. That was super great service.

I think the balance of quality and cost is really good. You can definitely find cheaper juice, but not with this quality and range of flavours.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alexander Roan

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had the opportunity to attend the launch of a collaboration between the fruit and vegetable juice shop "Paak" (@drinkpaak) and the matcha specialty shop @grow.teastudio. Grow Tea used ceremonial-grade Yame Saemidori green tea to blend with PAAK's signature juices, resulting in six new, perfectly balanced drinks 🍵🥦🍎🍊🍌 (150-220 baht): Clear Matcha, Maplew Matcha, Matcha Island, Basil-Lemon Matcha Fizz, Tropic Jungle Matcha, and Midori Paradise Smoothie.
All six drinks are delicious and healthy.
⭐️ Find this collaboration menu at PAAK branches in Phaya Thai, Ekkamai, and The Commons Sala Daeng.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sarat Traipiyavong

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is fantastic, with a great atmosphere both inside and out – spacious and airy.

It's close to Phaya Thai BTS station. If you're driving, just turn into the BSC building around the corner and you're there. There's ample parking.

The menu is a bit extensive, but the staff can help with recommendations. This branch also serves food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kitikun Techavichian

sample_reviews_en.text:
Food is ok but take 40 mins after order without cutlery(next7 mins more),no service at all. Cashier can’t speak English or Thai she’s not understanding.All staff look like part time staff, just the one boy who is not Thai can deal with customer(speak English)
After all, out of the restaurant with smoked on the shirt. I will not come again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Leo Leo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Lovely spot in Phayathai
You can create your own DIY cold press juice - everything’s fresh
Staff are super nice and friendly, and the Barrot Cold Press juice is absolutely superb They also have a membership program, which makes it even better for regular visits. Highly recommend checking out their promotions too!
sample_reviews_en.author: Prim T

sample_reviews_en.text: A great spot for healthy food with plenty of menu options to choose from. The restaurant has a nice, welcoming layout, and the staff are friendly and attentive. The prices are a little on the higher side, but it’s understandable given the quality of the ingredients and the focus on healthy food.
sample_reviews_en.author: M. Seraphina

sample_reviews_en.text:
I like the smoothie and the breakfast with sourdough bread; it's delicious.

They have many smoothie options, including Açaí bowls and Greek yogurt. I recommend the Kale Yah, a protein-infused smoothie from the Proove brand.

The seating area has a nice atmosphere and is great for taking photos.
sample_reviews_en.author: Paksikorn Tubtimthong

restaurants.name: ส้มตำโคราช Korat Spicy Papaya Salad
restaurants.address:

50 Phahonyothin Rd, Lat Yao, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Korat Spicy Papaya Salad 🥢🌶️
This delicious Isan restaurant at Kasetsart University, Bangkhen Campus is a must-try for anyone working near the Royal Forest Department, the Department of National Parks, or Kasetsart University students!
This restaurant is known for its "delicious, authentic Isan flavors" at affordable prices. The atmosphere is simple, airy, and shady, with indoor and outdoor seating available, perfect for a relaxing lunch break. 🌿

A must-order dish is the crispy fried chicken, the fragrant fried pork belly, and the rich, flavorful Korat stir-fried noodles. The papaya salad is freshly prepared for every dish, offering a rich, sour, salty, and spicy flavor. 🥗✨
Dine alone, with a partner, or in a group. Parking is available.

📍 Location: Inside Kasetsart University, Bangkhen Campus (near the Department of Agriculture building).
🕐 Open daily, including Saturdays and Sundays.
💸 Prices start at just 10 baht, with flavors in the hundreds.

Looking for a delicious Isan lunchtime meal? We recommend calling ahead to reserve a table, as it gets very busy at lunchtime! 🔥
sample_reviews_en.author: parichat bu

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious and affordable Northeastern Thai food. Table reservations are available for lunch. If you're looking for a great alternative to spicy food at lunchtime near Kasetsart University, the Department of Forestry, or the Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation, I highly recommend this place.
Recommended dishes you shouldn't miss include: Fried Chicken, Fried Pork Belly, and Stir-fried Noodles.

P.S. It can get a bit crowded at lunchtime, but the food comes out quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: DAF WD

sample_reviews_en.text: This small Som Tum (papaya salad) restaurant in Korat, serving Northeastern Thai food, is located inside Kasetsart University, Bang Khen campus. It's clean, comfortable, has a nice atmosphere, and is dust-free. It's near the Department of Agricultural Extension building and is open on Saturdays and Sundays.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaiyaporn Nupak

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious, inexpensive, authentic Korat, delicious Pad Mee, recommended to try, delicious Som Tam, delicious glass noodle salad, delicious but spicy Tom Saab, very delicious and spicy, easy to travel, lots of parking, can park, can park a motorbike.
sample_reviews_en.author: gammpowpow

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious Somtum, good quality protein e.g. crispy fried chicken, crispy fried pork belly, grill pork, etc. but no beef
Available QR code payment and cash
Also available on GRAB
Take around 20 - 30 minutes waiting
About 10 cars parking lot
sample_reviews_en.author: Onprang Sutthakiet

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was terrible. The vendor was rude and had poor manners. When I politely asked about the food, she responded emotionally with a bad attitude and facial expression. I won't be eating here again. That's enough for this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puu Tho.

sample_reviews_en.text: I found this place by chance. It's great, clean, the fried chicken is crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside, the spicy soup is delicious, and the Korat-style papaya salad is flavorful. The prices are affordable. Satisfying!
sample_reviews_en.author: pikajean ariyaburoot

sample_reviews_en.text: The papaya salad is incredibly flavorful, the fried chicken is crispy and delicious. It's an open-air dining experience with self-service drinks. Office workers are advised to arrive before noon because the tables fill up quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pracha Pong

restaurants.address:


sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I tried playing pickleball at this court.
It shares a court with the badminton court.
However, pickleball is only available at certain times, so you should check beforehand.

There are many courts, probably around 14 in total.

The online admin and the counter staff are very helpful.
The price for a court and equipment is good value at 300 baht.
But pickleballs are not available for rent; you have to buy them for 220 baht (a bit pricey). I recommend bringing your own.

There is parking available under the building.
sample_reviews_en.author: Than Thanakul

sample_reviews_en.text: 🚩The rubber court is excellent. It's large, spacious, airy, and comfortable – not hot at all. It's on the 2nd floor and costs 180 baht per hour. Members get a discount. It opens at 9:00 AM. There's plenty of parking. Balls are for sale at 100 baht each, but there are lots of old balls inside the court. If you don't mind, rackets are available for rent if you don't bring your own. The staff are friendly and the place is clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thriller Massimo

sample_reviews_en.text:
There are multiple courts.
The courts are not crowded and there is good spacing between them.
There are floor fans in each court's seating area.

Parking is insufficient on some days.
The courts are showing signs of age.
The floor has several repairs.
The lighting is not very bright.
The restroom doors are difficult to lock.

Update: October 2025 The court surface has been renovated.
sample_reviews_en.author: Fon PS

sample_reviews_en.text:
I'd like to see improvements to the field lighting. Some fields have broken bulbs that are just left as they are without any repairs or replacements. The urinals in the men's restrooms are also all broken and haven't been repaired.
**The field has been improved as per the review. I'm changing my rating to 5 stars.**
sample_reviews_en.author: Bb Jupiter

sample_reviews_en.text:
There's a group that plays badminton every Tuesday and Thursday. It's crowded and fun. The organizer is lovely and the players are lovable.
The group's name is #KungKingInvitesYouToPlayBadminton
sample_reviews_en.author: Tigger On Tour

sample_reviews_en.text:
There are gatherings every Tuesday and Thursday,
from 8 PM to midnight. The organizers are lovely, they open up plenty of fields, so there's not much waiting time, and you can request games.
sample_reviews_en.author: RMCA สนามรามอินทรา40

sample_reviews_en.text: Very convenient to get there. The staff and overall the service were good and satisfactory.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jead Noichangkid

sample_reviews_en.text: There is parking available and the restrooms are clean. Reservations are required by phone.
sample_reviews_en.author: Praorawee Pojanapakorn

sample_reviews_en.text: This seemingly simple Pad Krapow (Thai basil stir-fry) restaurant serves surprisingly flavorful dishes. You can order online or dine in; there's seating available. It might be a bit stuffy during lunchtime, but the fans keep it from getting too hot. The crispy pork is excellent – ​​not too greasy and not too hard; it's a perfectly balanced and delicious Pad Krapow.
sample_reviews_en.author: PaTaBo Kuna

sample_reviews_en.text:
4⭐️
I wasn’t very hungry. My husband ordered this while I was asleep. It was very good though. It was a delivery order, and I was half asleep, so I forgot to take pictures. Would definitely get again, and I would definitely recommend to anyone in the area.
sample_reviews_en.author: AL Franklin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The basil stir-fry is delicious.
You can tell from the taste that the restaurant uses high-quality basil leaves.
It has a nice spiciness, you can tell it's a good quality dish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Veravit Suksittisopon

sample_reviews_en.text: I often use their delivery service, and their food is delicious, not greasy, and easy to eat. I recommend choosing the option to stir-fry with water instead of oil.
sample_reviews_en.author: M Insight

sample_reviews_en.text: A newly opened basil restaurant near Ekkamai, Donki intersection. The taste is better than I thought. They use good quality ingredients. Delivery/takeaway only.
sample_reviews_en.author: N K

sample_reviews_en.text: The basil is very flavorful. It's the right kind of basil. Those who can't handle spicy food may have to order it less spicy because it's really delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kiengfa Tavarit

sample_reviews_en.text: The beef basil stir-fry is incredibly delicious! Whenever I'm in this area, I always order it to take home. It's great value for money. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: Marisa Pakdee

sample_reviews_en.text: It's a small but charming shop with lovely, cheerful staff. The food is delicious; the fried eggs are tasty, and the basil chicken is especially good.
sample_reviews_en.author: poopae paepae

sample_reviews_en.text: This grilled chicken place is a local favorite. It gets very crowded at lunchtime, with long queues for both in-store and online orders. The grilled chicken itself doesn't take long to prepare, but you might have to wait a bit for papaya salad. Their signature item is the grilled chicken. If I'm traveling out of town early in the morning, I'll stop and buy some chicken and sticky rice. When I get on the bus, mmm... the aroma of the grilled chicken and the hot steam are amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: ammie j

sample_reviews_en.text:
The chicken is way better than other places in Wichian Buri.
The papaya salad is good, the fermented fish sauce is amazing!
Too hot, but it added to the atmosphere.
Not expensive, worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nut Wut

sample_reviews_en.text:
The grilled chicken is delicious, juicy, and fragrant with herbs.
The papaya salad is spicy, the spicy soup is tender, the place is clean, and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: kaneugnooch choodornwai

sample_reviews_en.text:
You definitely won't be disappointed.
Perfectly cooked, not mushy, dry yet tender, delicious flavor, and fragrant with spices.
sample_reviews_en.author: P l Char l Farmer

sample_reviews_en.text: The papaya salad is delicious, the other dishes are tasty, the grilled chicken is tender, and it's clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Panutda Srithad

sample_reviews_en.text: So delicious! The flavor is just right. The price is affordable. Go early though, they sell out quickly!
sample_reviews_en.author: Arm Arm

sample_reviews_en.text: I eat here often. The food is good, delicious, and affordable. Overall, it's very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: chaturaphat toouaiphon

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken was delicious, the dipping sauce was great, and the price was excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: ลัทธพล เก่งถนอมม้า

sample_reviews_en.text: To be honest, I've been to this branch so many times, and it's always hot inside. It's probably the air conditioning being broken again, as usual. They never fix it. I've been many times and it's always been hot. Sometimes I want to go eat delicious food and relax, hoping for cool air, but it's never the case. Even though the food is delicious and the prices aren't too high, and the staff is friendly, the atmosphere in the restaurant just doesn't need improvement. I hope they've replaced the air conditioning units so I can visit again, because I like the taste of the food.
sample_reviews_en.author: kaweewat kueklang

sample_reviews_en.text: Sunday morning was another brunch hunt, but I was disappointed 🤣 I originally planned to eat fast food in this neighborhood. After parking, I saw several shops with menus outside, and I spotted the prosciutto 😋, so I chose this one! The pizza, sandwiches, and salads were all delicious, but the fries and pasta weren't to my taste. I also discovered there were many other dishes to try 😝 The portions were quite large (because I'm not a normal person 😝 I ate too much...). For two people, I suggest ordering two dishes first and then adding more if needed. Highly recommended 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: שַׁחַר שַׁחַר

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tasted standard, but the service at this branch was extremely poor. When I walked in, three staff members were engrossed in their phones, completely ignoring me. Even when my girlfriend said, "Excuse me," they still ignored her, until someone from the kitchen had to come out to help.

Throughout the meal, I was the only customer. Three or four staff members sat idle, and not a single person even got up to refill our water. The service was far from what you'd expect from Wine Connection. They really need to improve.

P.S. There was a fly in the melon dish.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bundith Chokumnuykij

sample_reviews_en.text:
Unfortunately probably my worst experience in wine connection. Ordered the new menu salmon zaap. Straddling the line for freshness to consume.

Wanted to clean my palette with my white wine so ordered some cheese. 60g came in 4 pieces, 2 were fine. 2 were clearly off.

I understand turnover may not be as high as downtown but QC must be adhered to even tho it may not be ordered as much as pizza or pasta. As I live right next door, it's sad to see.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bryan Ra

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love WINE CONNECTION. it's an awesome concept of wine and food. very nice selection of wine and an excellent  Menu

I must have been to various wine connections atleast 20 times now

my only concern is that with such a great selection of wine the staff needs to be trained on how to handle wine bottles, pour wine. That training is pending and that will make wine connection a class apart
sample_reviews_en.author: Rajesh Sokhal

sample_reviews_en.text: Today, I went to Wine Connection at Market Place Krungthep Kreetha with my mum and my dad! I had Margherita Pizza which taste excellent and Chocolate Italian Ice Cream for dessert which is nice! Staff are nice! Good Service! Highly Recommended for people living in Krungthep Kreetha area!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nicky Wedemeyer

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating at this branch. The food tasted standard for their restaurant style. You can choose your own wine or ask the staff for recommendations based on your preferences. The staff service was adequate, changing glasses frequently.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nipatchon Navapongsireetorn

sample_reviews_en.text: I go here regularly. The staff at this branch are polite, attentive, and the food comes out quickly. They're always smiling and friendly. It's become one of our favorite restaurants. We buy wine here, and we only drink wine with our loved ones here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Shameem Wakamatsu

restaurants.name: The Chamber Bangkok
restaurants.address:

136/6-7 Pradiphat Rd, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Overall:

The Chamber Bangkok is a fantastic restaurant that offers a delicious and unique dining experience. The food is prepared with fresh, high-quality ingredients, and the service is impeccable. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a special meal.

Food:

The food at The Chamber Bangkok is simply outstanding. The menu features a variety of dishes, all of which are made with care and attention to detail. I particularly enjoyed Pad kraprao Moo, which was perfectly cooked and seasoned. The Fried Potato with Salt Egg was also excellent

Service:

The service is top-notch. The staff is friendly, knowledgeable, and attentive. They are always happy to answer any questions you have about the menu or wine list, and they make sure that you have a wonderful dining experience.

Atmosphere:

The atmosphere at  is elegant and inviting. The restaurant is beautifully decorated, and the tables are spaced far enough apart so that you can enjoy your meal in privacy. The noise level is also perfect for conversation.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ray Rewat

sample_reviews_en.text:
First Class, I don’t find places like this when if you want a certain coffee or a Cuban  its all possible, I went there in the morning for coffee I only found at the four seasons and that was a event
The upstairs Lounge was just in the plans when I left, there’s something about that neighborhood and The Chamber is a nice place to relax and get some food and drink
I will stay there at Riva Surya Or New Siam River so I’m close to that place

khob khun khrap🙏 Aloha
sample_reviews_en.author: Todd Cash

sample_reviews_en.text: The Chamber Bangkok is a great bar with delicious local Thai food, good music, good service, and a very nice owner. I highly recommend the Spicy Garlic Belly Pork, which is one of their signature dishes. The Pad Kraprao is also excellent. The service at The Chamber is top-notch. The staff is attentive and friendly, and they're always happy to help you choose the perfect drink or dish. Overall, I highly recommend The Chamber Bangkok for a great night out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike Macrobond

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, the music is great, and it's a hit with 90's teenagers. The restaurant isn't crowded, and the atmosphere is relaxed, perfect for chatting with friends. The food is as per other comments. The chef's taste is average, not too spicy, not too bland, just right. The price is moderate, as is standard for this type of restaurant. 😊
sample_reviews_en.author: Somsakul Boonkaseam

sample_reviews_en.text: The best mac and cheese in Bangkok!!! So delicious! Highly recommended! Great band, great restaurant, great restrooms. A comfortable and chill place to chat with friends. Perfect for meeting up and catching up. Parking available in front of the restaurant from 7 PM onwards.
sample_reviews_en.author: A T

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has a great atmosphere, comfortable seating, and delicious Thai and international food. We ordered papaya salad, tom yum fish soup, stir-fried noodles with shrimp and water spinach, macaroni and cheese, and fried chicken wings—everything was excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mes Mesajee

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food, live music, and the band is really good.
Crispy pork belly with chili and onsen egg 10/10
You'll regret not ordering this.
Spicy mala pork intestines + beer is a perfect combination.
(These spicy mala pork intestines are seriously amazing.)
sample_reviews_en.author: RUX RATTANASAMAHARN

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. You absolutely must order the mac and cheese; it's amazing. The fried pork larb is also excellent. The staff provides great service and is very attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nussaraporn Sumretphol

restaurants.name: Chokdi
restaurants.address:

190 Thanon Chaokhamrop, Pom Prap, Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Bangkok 10100, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This noodle shop, specializing in Rad Na and Pad See Ew, is located in the alley next to Central Hospital.

The menu offers a wide variety of Rad Na noodles, including wide rice noodles, thin rice noodles, and crispy noodles. They also have Pad See Ew and other à la carte dishes.
The shop prepares each type of noodle in a large wok, so even if you arrive together but order different types of noodles, your order may not be ready at the same time. You'll have to wait. The shop will inform you beforehand.

Today, I tried the Pad See Ew with wide rice noodles. The flavor wasn't too strong, light but well-balanced and delicious.
It wasn't too oily and had a good wok-fried texture.
The kale leaves were large and not bitter.
Adding a little chili made it even better.

The prices are mid-range to high, but considered reasonable for this area.
The shop isn't large and doesn't have many tables, but it's always crowded.
You might have to share a table.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pichsaran Ves

sample_reviews_en.text:
The taste might not be strong, but it's well-balanced. The pork is tender and in large pieces. If you're shopping at Khlong Thom and looking for something to eat, I recommend this place. They have à la carte dishes, noodles in gravy, and stir-fried noodles with soy sauce. I ordered the wide rice noodles with egg for 60 baht. Next time I come, I'll try the stir-fried noodles with soy sauce (I saw many tables ordering it, some tables ordered stir-fried noodles with soy sauce instead of noodles in gravy).
There's no parking lot, but you can find a place to park motorcycles along the side.
sample_reviews_en.author: Juy Jaoo

sample_reviews_en.text:
Another old-style Chinese restaurant serving delicious made-to-order dishes, located in the alley next to Central Hospital. The highlight here is the large, tender, and flavorful pork slices.

The pork with garlic rice and omelet costs a little over 60 baht. The pork slices are large and tender, stir-fried perfectly with a hint of dark soy sauce. It pairs beautifully with the omelet, which isn't fluffy or oily. Even for takeout, they provide cilantro and cucumber.

The only downside is that the rice is a bit hard.
sample_reviews_en.author: Puripat Kitkarncharoensin

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes okay, and considering the price, it's great. The portions are generous.
The owner seems very attentive to customers. When I ordered takeout, they asked if I wanted it in a plastic bag or styrofoam container, and also asked when I would be eating it. In the evening, they separated the ingredients for me (I ordered stir-fried basil with pork and a fried egg).
sample_reviews_en.author: Duangduean L.

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a restaurant where many locals eat and order takeout. The food is delicious, but the stir-fried noodles with soy sauce were a little oily. The marinated pork was tender, and the shrimp and squid pieces were large. The price is good.
- Stir-fried noodles with pork
- Stir-fried noodles with seafood
- Pork basil stir-fry
- Spicy seafood instant noodles
sample_reviews_en.author: K. Vijit.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The flavor and portion size were excellent. The noodles and marinated pork were tender, not mushy. The price was affordable, and it included an egg.
It wasn't salty, making it very easy on the stomach. However, the place felt a bit cramped and uncomfortable, but it didn't affect the taste of the food. The owner was very welcoming.
sample_reviews_en.author: eakki eakki

sample_reviews_en.text: The taste is moderate; those who don't like spicy food can add chili peppers to make it just right. As for the portion size, I might have been unlucky; I ordered a regular stir-fried noodles with soy sauce for 60 baht, and it was gone in 8 bites.
sample_reviews_en.author: buddhabxss

sample_reviews_en.text:
The crispy yellow noodles are thin and delicious. The pork is tender, and the kale is crispy yet soft, easy to chew. They also have à la carte dishes. It's next to the Central Hospital.
You can park at the hospital and walk over to eat easily.
sample_reviews_en.author: opp_ak69

restaurants.name: Kaow Tom Khakai
restaurants.address:

VH9V+J3V, Anusawari, Bang Khen, Bangkok 10220, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This chicken leg porridge shop used to be near the Ministry of Finance and has now moved to Phahonyothin Road.
The food is considered affordable but delicious and high-quality. Must-try dishes include chicken leg, drumstick, and wing porridge.
They also offer various soups, plain porridge, and porridge with toppings, as well as seafood.
The seafood, such as mussels and cockles, is carefully selected.
Their salads are exceptional, and other dishes are also good, using quality ingredients.
You should try it and order according to your preferred spice level. Parking is convenient, especially at the BTS Bang Khen station. A landmark to look for is Wat Phra Sri Mahathat. The prices are reasonable; you should definitely try it.
Don't just take my word for it, try it yourself...
sample_reviews_en.author: พรสิทธิ์ เยาวรักษ์

sample_reviews_en.text: Passing by Wat Phra Si, I stopped to buy some spicy chicken feet soup, along with a couple of other dishes to take home. While waiting, I saw they had delivery bags, so I took a picture to share in case anyone wants to try it. I'm not sure about the delivery locations though, so you might want to call and ask. Currently, you can dine in at the restaurant. Parking is free at the bus depot in front, but drive in a little way past the left lane to get to the entrance and park in front of the restaurant. The first left lane is the bus exit, so don't drive against the flow. If you're too lazy to drive, you can take the BTS Skytrain to Wat Phra Si station – it's very convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Achararax kanja

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant serves incredibly delicious chicken galangal rice porridge. I eat here often, usually ordering takeout, but today I ate at the restaurant because I was going to make merit afterward. The restaurant is located on the main road with plenty of parking. They have both air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned seating areas, and the staff are very welcoming. This is my fifth time eating here, and I'm very impressed. I will definitely be back.

Their chicken and fish rice porridges are both excellent. This time I tried their pork rice porridge and was very impressed. I highly recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Yuttanapong Trisurat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Been eating at this popular restaurant spot for over 6 years with my wife. It’s family run and the owners even though have plenty of waiters and waitresses are very active on taking customer orders.

The food is consistently good serving Thai Chinese dishes. My favorite is the chicken cash nuts. They also have some delicious pork Sarah’s as well.

This restaurant however is best known for their chicken feet with rice soup and yes I do eat chicken feet.

Love this restaurant and friendly atmosphere and will keep coming for dinners.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wally’s Travels and Eats

sample_reviews_en.text:
-The food is delicious and the prices aren't too high. I eat there often. I love the crab curry, stir-fried clams with chili paste, chicken tom yum soup, pork satay, and everything else is delicious.
-The fresh coconut water is very refreshing.
