-Park your car next to the bus station and get your parking ticket stamped by the restaurant for free parking.
-It's very crowded, especially late at night, but there are always seats available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pp Jit

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a Thai-style rice porridge restaurant. I don't understand why there are so few reviews. All the food is delicious, the prices are moderate (not expensive), the staff is fast, and the food comes out quickly. Parking is available at the bus station next door.

I highly recommend this restaurant. The chicken feet soup is amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: ธุรกิจทันตกรรม

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, especially the chicken leg rice porridge; the chicken is very tender. It's near the MRT station (Ratchaprasong 11). If you come by car, you can park at the BMTA depot next door, and there are people to watch over your vehicle, so it's safe. I found this place after seeing Dr. Thosaporn's post.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nat Vee

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is inexpensive, and most importantly, it comes out very quickly – no long wait at all. The taste is average to good, not too strong.

We especially loved the Thai melon jelly with shaved ice. It was so delicious! The Thai melon was fragrant and sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: hapuy fluffy

restaurants.name: Baantuktuk
restaurants.address:

106 ข้าง 7-11 หลังกระทรวงสาธารณสุขประตู 4 33 Daongmane, บางเขน เมือง Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes great, flavorful, and diverse. There's a wide variety of spicy Northeastern Thai dishes, made with good and clean ingredients. The food is colorful and beautifully presented. The flavors are strong and spicy, so if you can't handle much spice, order it less spicy.
The single dishes, main courses, and other à la carte options are also delicious, with large portions that are filling and tasty.
The restaurant is inviting, although not spacious, the space is well-utilized. The decor is modern, clean, and comfortable. The music is pleasant, perfect for young working adults. The air conditioning is cool and refreshing. There are restrooms outside at the back of the restaurant, but parking is limited. They also offer shabu-shabu and BBQ, along with cold drinks. The food prices are very friendly, and they accept QR code payments.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rachel Ko

sample_reviews_en.text:
The shop is located next to 7-Eleven in Soi Duangmani, behind the Ministry of Commerce. It's a small shop, not very big, with an air-conditioned area of ​​about 4-5 tables and another 3-4 tables outside.

The food is varied and reasonably priced. The atmosphere is nice, perfect for chilling out with drinks and listening to background music, or for a casual get-together with friends.
The shop is quiet, not noisy. The owner is friendly and polite, and there's a cat too.

There's parking for 1-2 cars next to the shop. Motorcycles are more convenient. It's a bit of a walk from the Ministry.

The taste is average, acceptable, but might be a bit spicy for those who don't like spicy food.

The prices are standard and considered inexpensive. Overall, it's a good place.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattarapon Erbim

sample_reviews_en.text:
A made-to-order restaurant near the Ministry of Public Health.
It's hard to find a place to eat when running errands, but this place has parking for one car inside, and it's air-conditioned and comfortable. It's not crowded, so it's private.
The owner, the young man, and the cat are all very nice and provide good service.

You have to scan a QR code to order, which is a bit unusual.
The food takes a little while to prepare.
I tried three dishes, and they were all delicious and easy to eat.
I specifically requested the basil chicken not spicy, and it was perfectly mild.
The prices are also reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Worawit Laosatirawong

sample_reviews_en.text:
Certificates are hanging on the wall proving that the head chef attended culinary school, and you can taste the difference.

The food is delicious and beautifully presented.

The dishes containing chili are very spicy, so let them know beforehand if you'd prefer it milder.

The restaurant is small but nicely decorated.

The restrooms were clean.

The value for money is simply excellent! 👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Daniel “Danilo”

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my go-to restaurant; I eat here every time I'm at my condo. The food is delicious, the flavors are amazing, and the portions are huge! The owner and the young man who recommends dishes are super friendly and helpful. (The restaurant is air-conditioned, and the music is great too!) 100/10, highly recommend! ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Jar Nitcharatkul

sample_reviews_en.text: Let me tell you, the food was delicious 😋, the service was excellent and very polite, and the atmosphere was amazing – perfect for socializing, enjoying food, listening to music, and having cold drinks after a tiring day at work. 10/10 👍👍👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Palat Thananattawat

sample_reviews_en.text: The food prices are high and the wait time is long. I ordered American fried rice to take home in a box. It came with fried rice, 2 small drumsticks, 2 sausages, and 1 fried egg. The price was 120 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: Som Viyanan

sample_reviews_en.text: The music is good, the atmosphere is great, the restaurant is beautifully decorated and inviting, the space is neither too big nor too small. The food looks delicious and the prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tanapon Bunchu

restaurants.name: Lasani (Halal)
restaurants.address:

1179 Soi Charoen Krung 47, Si Phraya, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ordered chicken Masala and a plain Nan. It's a really good eating experience, fresh and delicious, especially the nan. The Masala's portion was a bit small for the price, while the nan was bigger than I thought. I'd say a plain nan was enough for two portions of chicken masala.

Most staffs there can understand English and a bit of Thai.
sample_reviews_en.author: Krittamate

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious Pakistani food and super nice service!

I had Dal Maash with paratha and loved it. Slightly oily but fine with the bread. Texture is great. Very filling and tasty. Prices are pretty low. The owner is super friendly. Always smiling.

They don’t serve alcohol since this is a Muslim restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Christian Breitkreutz

sample_reviews_en.text: Best authentic Pakistani homemade style food. I ordered mutton korma and surprisingly it tastes like homemade with tandoori roti and chapati. 100% recommended if you are missing homemade Pakistani food. Food was fresh and mild spicy but I think you can ask for spicy if you like.
sample_reviews_en.author: Muhammad Tahir

sample_reviews_en.text:
Really delicious food, cheap prices, big portions, great quality. Family run place with home-style cooking.
Paya, Brian masala, mutton masala are a must try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Adil Rashid

sample_reviews_en.text: The food here is excellent and has an authentic, homemade style—unlike other restaurants where the food is delicious but made with commercial spices.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jalees W

sample_reviews_en.text: Owner is an incredibly generous guy. Feels like family every time I go there. always tempted to order more. Outstanding homemade style food
sample_reviews_en.author: Kal Hill

sample_reviews_en.text: Very cheap yet wholesome high quality North Indian cuisine and some traditional rural Pakistani cuisine cooked to perfection.
sample_reviews_en.author: Akbar Khan

sample_reviews_en.text: The vibe of the restaurant is very relaxing and food is fresh and delicious one of the best halal food spot in Bangkok
sample_reviews_en.author: Ahmad Malik

restaurants.name: Patara Fine Thai Cuisine
restaurants.address:

375, 19 Thong Lo, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I revisited for dinner in August 2026. It was as clean as ever, and everything we ordered—food and drinks—was delicious. My children also raved about the fried rice.

The staff were friendly, but compared to before, there were often no staff available when we wanted to order, requiring us to call them multiple times, interrupting our meal each time. While I initially thought the staff were busy, they were chatting amongst themselves, which was rather unpleasant.


[Revisited in 2025] I still think it's a very good restaurant. It's a place you can confidently visit for business dinners and other occasions. The female manager, who speaks fluent Japanese, is always smiling and lovely. We ordered various à la carte dishes including Thai curry, papaya salad, satay, and fried rice, and everything was delicious. I visited with a vegetarian, and they were very pleased. The restaurant is clean and comfortable; I will definitely go again!


[2024]
The atmosphere and interior were lovely, and all the staff were very nice. The lunch set menus had a wide variety, were well-balanced, and tasted delicious. Above all, it was very reasonably priced. I recommend it!
sample_reviews_en.author: M Insight

sample_reviews_en.text:
We recently visited Patara Fine Thai Cuisine and had a mixed experience. The food was absolutely excellent: beautifully presented, authentic, and full of flavor. The interior design and the surrounding area are also very nice.

However, the service definitely needs improvement. We arrived about 30 minutes later than our reservation due to heavy city traffic. The staff member at the entrance seemed quite angry about our late arrival and expressed his frustration openly. This was surprising, especially since the restaurant was almost completely empty, only two tables were occupied.

He continued to complain until I mentioned that the reservation was not that important to us and that we could simply leave and have lunch elsewhere. Only then did he escort us to our table, though he did so while clearly looking offended.

Overall, the cuisine and ambiance were wonderful, but the welcoming experience left an unpleasant impression. I hope the restaurant will work on improving their customer service, as the kitchen truly deserves better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ivan Sydorenko

sample_reviews_en.text: Food was not good, compared to authentic Thai restaurants, it’s an “elevated cuisine” restaurant but nothing was elevated… this place lacked flavor for some dishes and one dishes I ate gave me indigestion and I felt a little nauseous and extremely heavy after eating one dish which was just 80% coconut milk and it grossed me out I almost vomitted. I’ve had variations of this dish before many times so I knew how it should taste (which wasn’t 80% just coconut milk which is too much) and never felt this way. I also made this dish myself and obviously didn’t pour an entire bottle of coconut milk inside. It was a red curry dish that didn’t have much taste except the coconut. There was also no one at the restaurant except my table, we were the only people at the restaurant and only two other tables were filled after and we stayed until closing and no one else came this was on a Friday night.
sample_reviews_en.author: Celena Liu

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant has convenient parking, is spacious, clean, and simply decorated. We started with some fried rice crackers and taro chips as appetizers. We ordered a set meal with four dishes served on one plate: Ma Hor (a type of Thai snack), Miang Kham (a Thai wrap with lotus petals), followed by Khao Chae (rice in chilled broth), which was tasty. The grilled river prawns were okay, but not impressive. The Massaman goat curry was absolutely delicious. We also had grilled beef, three-colored rice, sweet and sour fish, and stir-fried cabbage with fish sauce – all decent. We finished with caramelized bananas. We visited again after 4 years, booking a private room upstairs and ordering a variety of dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: พร้อมพูล ชอบเพื่อน

sample_reviews_en.text:
For tonight's dinner, I was looking for a restaurant suitable for entertaining clients, and I found one called Patara.

After climbing up to Thonglor Soi 19 and walking down an unassuming street, you'll see a restaurant that looks like a mansion – that's Patara.

It's a standalone restaurant with a very nice atmosphere. The garden is beautifully maintained, the interior is luxurious, and the staff are very pleasant.

The first floor has table seating, and the second floor has private rooms, so it seems perfectly suitable for entertaining clients.

Looking at the menu, the prices are a bit on the high side.
sample_reviews_en.author: james won

sample_reviews_en.text: Patara Fine Thai Cuisine offers an exceptional dining experience with its elegant atmosphere, attentive service, and beautifully presented dishes. The restaurant combines authentic Thai flavors with a modern twist, using high-quality ingredients to create a refined yet comforting meal. Their signature dishes, such as the grilled river prawns and Massaman Lamb curry, showcase the depth of Thai cuisine. The ambiance is warm and sophisticated, making it a great choice for both intimate dinners and special occasions. If you’re looking for a premium Thai dining experience, Patara is worth a visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naowarat Prathet

sample_reviews_en.text:
One of the most memorable Thai cuisine I had in Thailand, it's going to be a place that I will visit everytime I am back in Bangkok from now on. Very authentic yet refined!

The tumeric rock shrimp tempura, southern fried chicken wings with crisp shallots, mango salad with soft shell crab, crab meat aubergine salad, crab meat and betel leaves yellow curry, steam organic seabass, grilled pork neck and grilled river shrimp were all on point.

Will definitely share this hidden gem with my friends and family!
sample_reviews_en.author: Kin Yang Chua

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a very good Thai restaurant. It’s moderately priced and the quality of the dishes were superb. I ordered two fish dishes and both were prepared very well. Wine selection was fair. The ambience was pleasant - the majority of customers seemed to be couples (both young and older) and the noise level was perfect for socializing. Desserts were nice as well.

The only complaint I have is that I wish the restaurant stayed open a bit later. But that’s a minor issue for an otherwise very good restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ed Gradascevic

restaurants.name: KFC Susco Prachauthit
restaurants.address:

301 Pracha Uthit Rd, Khwaeng Thung Khru, Khet Thung Khru, Bangkok 10140, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
It took too long. Next time, please include extra time for preparation.
When ordering, it said 20 minutes. That means 20 minutes for it to be ready and delivered to the customer, not that the chicken was fried in 20 minutes and then they told the customer to wait an extra 5 or 10 minutes. Next time, please specify the waiting time, like 30 minutes or half an hour.
sample_reviews_en.author: krichaporn lamlert

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff didn't check that the food was sold out, especially the egg tarts. They didn't make any until we asked. We waited 30+10 minutes, and were told we had to wait another 10 minutes. Normally, egg tarts are ready in a maximum of 15 minutes.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธัญญพัทธ์ ลี

sample_reviews_en.text: If you're ordering takeout, you don't need to get out of your car. Drive along the designated lane, stop to order food, continue driving until you reach the payment lane, and then continue driving until you reach the food pickup lane.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ti Po

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff at this branch provide excellent service. They are polite, cheerful, and highly recommend the food at the counter. This branch is truly excellent at sales; they recommend everything!
sample_reviews_en.author: Patipan Thinsanga

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff were talking loudly, and they even brought fruit to eat at a table for customers. I was a little surprised they didn't eat it in the back of the shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: แล้วแต่

sample_reviews_en.text: I paid already and was told to wait for the chicken to be fried. They didn't tell me before I paid. There's another branch a little further down the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: หมอมาแล้ว

sample_reviews_en.text: KFC that you can buy from a food truck. Medium-sized restaurant with plenty of seating. Promotion: 199 baht for 9 large pieces of fried chicken.
sample_reviews_en.author: Thongchai poonyaarpa

sample_reviews_en.text: The male customer service representative at the front desk was very honest; I dropped a five-baht coin and he brought it to my car.
sample_reviews_en.author: boss za

restaurants.name: Somdet Cuisine by Chatcharee Bunnag
restaurants.address:

53 Somdet Chao Phraya Rd, Somdet Chao Phraya, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Thai food is delicious. I had the braised eggs in soy sauce (ไข่พะโล้) and the spicy curry (แกงรัญจวน), both excellent. The restaurant has air conditioning, making it cool and comfortable. It's near Wat Anong, so after visiting the temple, it's less than a 5-minute walk.
sample_reviews_th.author: chunyagun thanyaaut

sample_reviews_en.text:
The setting is in a old Bunnag house compound on Somdet Chao Phya Road. Some parking is available once you navigate the narrow entrance alleyway. The dining room setting is one of past grandeur but it feels somewhat musty. The dishes we ordered were generally good. The service was performed by several individuals who were dressed like the were performing other household tasks, like washing the clothes, gardening, etc. Not for serving meals in such setting.
One server was quite talkative and could be one of the owners of the place because she was quite condescending on her guests. I guess it's a one time experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sivaporn Dardarananda

sample_reviews_en.text:
Hygienic = 0
Found rat's poo in the glass twice 🤢🤮

First time we informed them and the aunty just says sorry na. (We did not take photo but can clearly see in the glass) so we are aware of it and found it the second time that all glass are not clean.

The price is very high from the bills, compare to service and sanity.

Food are mostly sweet. We came with elderly, and they says its not traditional food or anything at all, just plainly sweet.  The price is so contrast with service and hygienic. We probably never revisit again.
sample_reviews_en.author: THANYAKORN P.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Foods are too high prices compare to the quality. Some dish is very very sweet, some is very very salty, some is tasteless. There are no standard of old Thai cuisines which is far from delicious. We ordered one dish called Num Prik Jone which has only few tiny chopped shrimp in little liquid that is very very salty.
Very disappointed to come and not worth the  money.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pasakorn Chumsilpsiri

sample_reviews_en.text: The place is spacious, but parking is limited. If you're coming with several cars, you should inform the owner so they can park on the main street. The food is traditional Thai, with a sweet undertone. If you prefer a spicier taste, you need to specify in advance, or adjust the seasoning to your liking. The prices are on the high side.
sample_reviews_en.author: Choke Dee

sample_reviews_en.text: The focus is on à la carte dishes. The pork steak is tasty, and the shrimp fried rice and tamarind chili paste fried rice are also good. The winged bean salad is a bit too sweet. The atmosphere is nice, and they are suitable for wedding receptions or seminars because they have spacious grounds, parking, and a garden.
sample_reviews_en.author: Surat Lertpanomwan

sample_reviews_en.text: This is an old restaurant with an atmosphere reminiscent of the reign of King Rama V, currently undergoing renovations. This was my first time here. The food is flavorful, leaning towards salty rather than sweet. The atmosphere is pleasant, but parking is limited. The stir-fried kale with salted fish was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: pisit apiphatvoradate

sample_reviews_en.text: This is another legendary restaurant where the food is incredibly delicious. My favorite dishes include the young tamarind chili paste, herbal braised eggs, and green curry, among others. If you've never tried it, I highly recommend giving it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: But SAWAROT

restaurants.name: D. Elbasha (Phra Khanong Takeaway ONLY)
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 2463, โทร พระโขนง, Here is the address, ปาก Soi Sukhumvit 48, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I don’t understand how this restaurant got high reviews (Probably fake reviews).
1- Hummus is terrible (no taste, no viscosity). If you sell this hummus in Lebanon or Turkiye you would bankrupt on the second day. Also, selling bread as optional means you are doing this business just for money because hummus and bread are complementary food. Hummus is eaten with bread not with spoon.
2- Shawarma is below average and overcooked.
3- The owner is quite arrogant and rude. He doesn’t behave properly to his staff and customers.
Thailand is the home of hospitality and kindness not arrogance. If you support this restaurant you will see more arrogant restaurant owners like him.

Edit:
ALERT!! The owner is neither Turkish nor Lebanese.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hektor

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the hummus, tabbouleh, and Lebanese fattoush salad and wow, what a refreshing combo! The hummus was so creamy and comforting, it honestly felt like a warm hug for my taste buds. The tabbouleh? Bright, zingy, and bursting with parsley a little sharp on its own, but I found it perfect when paired with bread. And the fattoush was the real surprise crisp, zesty, and full of texture.

You can really tell they care about freshness and balance. It’s not just food it’s flavor with personality. I didn’t expect to enjoy a salad trio this much, but I’d definitely come back for it. Highly recommend if you’re in the mood for something clean, bold, and not your average lunch.
sample_reviews_en.author: Al Pha

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered shawarma from El Basha, and honestly, I was very pleasantly surprised. I’m usually not a big shawarma fan, but this one completely changed my mind.

The wrap was perfectly crispy on the outside, with a nice golden texture, and super juicy on the inside. The meat was very tender, well-seasoned, and cooked just right — not dry at all. You can really taste the quality.

Everything felt balanced: great texture, great flavor, and very satisfying overall. It didn’t feel heavy or greasy, just really well done.

If you think you don’t like shawarma, trust me — this one is worth trying. For me, it was honestly excellent, and I’d definitely order again. 🔥🌯
sample_reviews_en.author: Mister Benz

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered the hummus with bread and the falafel sandwich. The taste was decent. They were pretty well prepared, and it was a pick-up order. It was ready on time. The service was decent. The quality is decent, and the pricing is fair.

overall...

I think it's nice to have another option for this type of food, and I would recommend trying this out and seeing if you like it.

Just FYI- I don't think this is a dine in kind of place. It seems like a place that is only for takeaway. You can check with them to make sure.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wandering Free bird

sample_reviews_en.text: The chicken shawarma is excellent and worth coming back for, but not the “authentic Lebanese hummus,” which comes not with olive oil but some other kind of oil, nor the shami bread, which was rather tasteless. Order took about 25 minutes to prepare around lunchtime on a Saturday. Note: This shop is takeout only with a couple chairs around the corner for waiting (and maybe eating?), with no convenient parking on nearby side roads..
sample_reviews_en.author: Jonathan Borland

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything is freshly made to order with quality ingredients. The owner is often at the restaurant to ensure fast service and great hospitality. They have amazing vegetarian options. their dough is so delicious, fluffy yet crispy on the outside. The garlic sauce is to die for, i could literally bathe in it. This location is pick up only but im excited to try their other locations for a dine in experience.
Shukran Habibi!
sample_reviews_en.author: Ellie Ross

sample_reviews_en.text: Unfortunately I didn't realise it's a take away stall only but there is one small outside table around the corner to use.  Friendly service and the lamb kebab was Ok (not the best I've had in the area).  The lamb were like pre-made and not lamb strips.  The kebab used fresh vegetables cooked in a sandwich press but it was drowned in garlic sauce which made it messy to eat (no tissues provided). It's just Ok.
sample_reviews_en.author: Neil McArthur

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food hit home run! I have been craving for Arabic food, and Elbasha nailed it!
I don’t have a picture to post because I ravaged the food.
I ordered tabouleh, beef shawarma, and hummus.
Tabouleh was lit. Like for real. Same with the beef shawarma, omg I can’t get enough of it, the hummus was creamy and homey, so soft and awww no more words😍
Thank you so much, Elbasah! ❤️👌🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Lovely Comillas

restaurants.name: U-Taley seafood 吃海鲜，來如意海鲜店
restaurants.address:

54, 1 Soi Lat Phrao 80 Yaek 22, Wang Thonglang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: This place is so delicious!! The seafood is so fresh. Especially “ชุปผักกาดดอง” my favorite i love it so much that would come back for another time😋😋
sample_reviews_th.author: Lilliesy ‘s

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sichuan-style food, delicious taste, price per dish 200-390 baht, portions vary depending on the dish.
Seafood is also sold by weight.
Be prepared for a while as food is cooked fresh to order, one dish at a time.
It's recommended to call and reserve in advance, as many items on the menu are sold out. Many items are unavailable when dining in. Ordering in advance allows the restaurant to order fresh seafood.

Seafood restaurant - Sichuan style
Price/dishes 200-390
Also, there are seafood price per weight (g./kg.)
Waiting time for food is quite long as there is only 1 chef and food is prepared 1 plate at a time.
I suggest calling ahead to reserve food/seafood. Most of the food was out of stock when I visited.
So, it's better to call in advance so they can order fresh seafood to prepare for you, as they don't stock many items.
sample_reviews_en.author: JNP XX

sample_reviews_en.text: This signature Mala Seafood Hot Pot features a highlight jumbo-sized lobster with incredibly fresh, succulent, and sweet meat. The set also includes blue crab, three types of seasonal shellfish, two plates of pork belly, a variety of mixed vegetables, glass noodles, and eggs. There are seven soup bases to choose from, but the star is the rich and flavorful Mala soup, intensely spicy and numbing – a perfect complement to the fresh seafood. The pot is divided into two sections, each offering a choice of two soups; the other side is a light and refreshing herbal soup with Angelica sinensis (Dong Quai). It's served with two dipping sauces: a rich and savory hot pot sauce with a perfect balance of sweet and sour, and a spicy seafood sauce.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kinklaikrung Page

sample_reviews_en.text:
A Chinese-style seafood restaurant with delicious food and friendly prices (the seafood dipping sauce is amazing).
1. Crab meat spring rolls 9/10
2. Stir-fried green beans 9/10
3. Fried mantis shrimp with garlic 10/10
4. Mantis shrimp marinated in mala soy sauce 10/10
5. Mantis shrimp marinated in seafood dipping sauce 10/10
6. Jellyfish salad with sesame oil 8/10
7. Mala seafood with sweet potato noodles 10/10
sample_reviews_en.author: Sittikorn 8341

sample_reviews_en.text: The crab claws are homemade, very large, and contain lots of crab meat; the price is reasonable. The lobster is fresh. If you want to order tiger prawns or crab claws, you need to call ahead. The red bean pancakes are delicious, like fried jujubes.
sample_reviews_en.author: โป่งเจอนั่น journey

sample_reviews_en.text: If you want incredibly fresh and reasonably priced seafood with an authentic 100% Chinese flavor, come here without hesitation. Considering the quality, the price is incredibly cheap. Come on over! If I say it's delicious, it really is delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: 298tustyle

sample_reviews_en.text: The food in here is very delicious, the seafood is fresh (like lobster sashimi), only the shrimp is not fresh. The somboon crab is very tasty, the fried pork is also recommended to order, gohyong 👍🏻. Satisfied to eat here
sample_reviews_en.author: Winny Manuella Lee Grande

sample_reviews_en.text: The portions are large, and the seafood is incredibly fresh, making it perfect for a family meal. The crab curry is delicious, and the mala sukiyaki is well-presented.
sample_reviews_en.author: Preaw Panda

restaurants.name: Porjai Restaurant
restaurants.address:

151 1 Walking St, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150

sample_reviews_en.text: The Tom Yum soup was the least authentic I had in Thailand (and not the cheapest either). The portion size was just as small as other Thai restaurants – not enough to fill you up. The food came out at a reasonable speed, and the atmosphere was okay. However, after our meal, we wanted to use a power outlet to charge our phones, but were told we couldn't do it without ordering another dish. This was absurd; does charging a phone for a few minutes really cost 1 baht? (Our per-person spending was three times the average spending per person at this restaurant.)
sample_reviews_en.author: Charles Gui

sample_reviews_en.text: My first time here and won't be the last time. I ordered omlete with rice and it was yummy. I just had to wait for only 10 mins. The good thing is despite located inside walking street the price was reasonable otherwise all other restaurants Inside walking street are expensive and they charge tax also. This one did not charge any tax and the food was quite yummy at a very reasonable price. I paid 80 thb for the omlette rice. Right opposite to Istanbul kebab shop.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kundan Rawat

sample_reviews_en.text: Being starving, finding a good rice dish at the walking street was incredibly difficult! Finally found this place, and it was delicious! Papaya salad, basil chicken with fried egg, sukiyaki, and ice-cold Singha beer – I highly recommend this Thai restaurant for anyone who hasn't had a meal. The flavors are authentically Thai! I ate here two days in a row.
sample_reviews_en.author: ธัญลักษณ์

sample_reviews_en.text: We stopped in for a bite before bed. The tom yum soup was sour and tasted bad, and the next morning my husband felt terrible: vomiting, stomach pain, and a high fever. I was lucky I didn't order it either. We didn't eat anywhere else outside of that place, and we don't drink alcohol, so it was definitely this soup. I don't recommend it 👎🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Анастасия Михайлова

sample_reviews_en.text:
Didn't feel much inspired by the grill house restaurants of Pattaya, randomly bumped into that one that looked like authentic Thai food.
I wasn't disappointed! I took the yellow curry chicken (sorry was hungry and think of picture only after I eat).
It was delicious and at a very decent price! I recommend it for real Thai food lovers :)
sample_reviews_en.author: atomic qwark

sample_reviews_en.text:
Best meal so far in Pattaya, authentic thai taste with refinement.

Update
Revisited Nov 2024. Thry moved to a new store on the main street. Ordered the stir fried kale and milk tea, same level as before. Great ingredients, great taste, very satisfied.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mischa Ngan

sample_reviews_en.text: The rice porridge was delicious, packed with ingredients, and the flavor was well-balanced. It's perfect for a late-night meal. The service was friendly, the restaurant was clean, and the atmosphere was homey, but very kind.
sample_reviews_en.author: Meiji Meiji

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious, with authentic Thai flavors. The staff are very friendly and provide excellent service. The prices are reasonable, and they have fresh fruit smoothies that are very refreshing.
sample_reviews_en.author: สาวไทยแลนด์ สะใภ้ฟินแลนด์

restaurants.name: ครัวจัดจ้าน
restaurants.address:

76 Prachathipatai Rd, Ban Phan Thom, Khet Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I found this restaurant by chance. It's located directly across from the main entrance of Wat Tri Thotsathep. Just cross the street and you're there! It's in front of an apartment building. The elderly couple who run the restaurant make incredibly delicious and flavorful food, living up to its reputation for being spicy and delicious. When you arrive, you can ask the owner for recommendations – you'll definitely love it! Today, they only had one dessert: homemade mango jelly. It was absolutely amazing! The desserts rotate depending on the season. I highly recommend stopping by; you can park under the apartment building – there's plenty of parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: จิตติ พิกุลทอง

sample_reviews_en.text:
So delicious!!! The restaurant isn't very big, but the food is absolutely amazing. The flavors are bold and delicious. The stir-fried rice with mackerel and basil is fantastic; the rice grains are perfectly cooked, chewy and sticky. I highly recommend trying it if you come here. Actually, the menu has a wide variety of dishes. I was so hungry I didn't take many pictures! 5555+

I'm not sure about parking, but you might be able to park at Wat Tri Thep and walk across the street in a short time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phasukarn Tuntrajin

sample_reviews_en.text:
!!Hidden Gem Alert!!

Popular among those who know. A hidden gem for those who arent. Kra Pao Mackerel was a wow surprise. 9/10 for the fried chicken. A must try.

Edit came here again today (11/12/2025)
Still amazing, not to be missed if you’re in the area !!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Anant Jha

sample_reviews_en.text: Great little restaurant. Tasty food. Good service. Polite staff. Pleasant atmosphere. Had a chicken noodle dish and a beer. Has been on Thai television a few times I noticed by some photos on the wall. Hope I can visit again when I return to Thailand 🇹🇭 😀👌👍
sample_reviews_en.author: Joe Harris

sample_reviews_en.text: It was delicious! This time I ordered from Robin Hood. They separated the broth from the contents, which kept the flavor great. I especially loved the papaya salad in a tube. The adults at home ate it all before I even had a chance to take a picture!
sample_reviews_en.author: Chayanis Songsermsawad

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, but the wait was incredibly long, even though there were only 3 tables of customers. We ordered 5 dishes, but only 3 arrived. We waited so long we finished that we had to save some rice to eat with the other 2 dishes.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattakarn Saeheng

sample_reviews_en.text: I recommend the stir-fried mackerel with basil and rice; it's delicious and flavorful with herbs. They also offer authentic Thai dishes, prepared with care using fresh herbs and spices. Located opposite Wat Tritotsathep.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wutt Rj

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, with a perfect balance of sweetness, saltiness, and richness. It's clean and the ingredients are of very good quality.
Parking is available at Wat Tri.
Wheelchair accessible.
The owner is lovely.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pakkad Kaew

restaurants.name: Dee Lite Bistro
restaurants.address:

Lobby Floor, 18/1 Sukhumvit 26, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Went for a weekday work lunch. Nice atmosphere. We had the a la crate menu I ordered the duck curry, rice and fish cakes. Food took a long time for what was supposed to be a quick lunch menu and the duck curry completely soaked in so much oil, I had to use a separate bowl to remove it before I could eat. However my partner ordered pad Thai which was decent. Service ok, staff were professional. Overpriced considering very basic food. Chang water (usually 7thb outside) was over 100 Thb per bottle. I understand up marking the price in a nice establishment but over 1000% of standard price was a bit much.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jasmeet Srikureja

sample_reviews_en.text:
Report; English/German
Hotel guests at the DoubleTree by Hilton have breakfast in this restaurant. The food was good. Attention is also paid to presentation; the dishes are beautifully presented on the table. Because, as we all know, you eat with your eyes. The staff are friendly and courteous.

Hotel guests at the DoubleTree by Hilton have breakfast in this restaurant. The food was good. Attention is also paid to presentation; the dishes are beautifully arranged on the table. Because, as we all know, you eat with your eyes. The staff are friendly and courteous.
sample_reviews_en.author: yellowPoint

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delight Restaurant, Sukhumvit 26, offers a wide variety of breakfast options.
There's a fruit station, salads, Thai food, wok-fried dishes, a noodle of the day station, Japanese food like sushi and miso soup, and oatmeal.
A wide selection of drinks are available, including fresh coffee, cappuccino, latte,
Thai tea, and herbal tea.
Importantly, the staff provides excellent service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Suriyan Jomkratok

sample_reviews_en.text: Deelite Restaurant is great, offering a full spread for breakfast and lunch. It's like a United Nations, from Eflorentine to Khao Soi (Northern Thai noodle soup) and even sushi and sashimi! Plus, they have Thai desserts, hot and cold tea and coffee, and fresh, cold-fresh fruit. So refreshing! The staff are incredibly friendly. Come and try it, you'll be absolutely thrilled! 💃🕺
sample_reviews_en.author: มนต์ Mont

sample_reviews_en.text: Inter buffet 950 THB net, including drinks (tea, coffee). The food is fresh, clean, delicious, and there's a wide variety to choose from. You can sit and enjoy your meal for as long as you like. The atmosphere is great, and it's conveniently located near Phrom Phong BTS station, so you don't have to worry about traffic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Naruepol Nangtala

sample_reviews_en.text:
Today I went to eat there and ordered a DT Burger and Tom Yum Gong. The food was delicious and the Deelite Colada was great. The staff member, Coco, was very cute, made delicious drinks, and had a great smile. Arm provided excellent service.
I will definitely go back again if I have the opportunity.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lay wara wara

sample_reviews_en.text: This is the worst buffet ever. You can have crab on Friday and Saturday nights, but it's as crowded as a market, and there's no ordering. It takes over 30 minutes just to get the bill. They don't even clear the plates after you're done eating. I blame my choice, but I'll never go back.
sample_reviews_en.author: sangho Park

sample_reviews_en.text: The service was excellent and the food was delicious. The staff were all very nice. It was a great value experience, especially the seafood, desserts, cakes, and egg tarts, which were my favorites. The stir-fries were also good! I'll definitely come again!
sample_reviews_en.author: Zhiyue Tan

restaurants.name: ครัวสำเภา
restaurants.address:

45/20 Thanon Thakham, Samae Dam, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The portions are large and offer good value. The stir-fried preserved olives were delicious and very tasty; it was a standout dish. However, the atmosphere inside the restaurant was quite noisy. We could hear chanting from the neighboring restaurant constantly, making it difficult to have a conversation. I'm not sure if they chant every day (we ate there around 9 PM).
sample_reviews_en.author: Alisa C

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes good.
- The catfish soup is delicious and sour, just right.
- The pickled garlic omelet was my first time trying it. The pickled garlic cut through the richness of the omelet.
- The stir-fried salted egg with holy basil was a bit too sweet, but still delicious.
- The stir-fried shrimp with chili paste was delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natamon Benja

sample_reviews_en.text: The dishes I ordered were delicious and met the standard of a late-night rice porridge restaurant. Last time I ordered the sour curry with acacia leaves and was very impressed; it was truly delicious. The restaurant was full when I came, but I didn't have to wait long. Overall, it's good and the price is acceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aikeiichiro Toey

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious. Rice porridge was 10 baht per bowl, the price was reasonable, not too expensive. I ordered stir-fried clams with chili paste (100 baht), stir-fried chayote shoots (70 baht), fried squid with garlic (150 baht), and stir-fried squid with salted egg (150 baht).
sample_reviews_en.author: พิลัยลักษณ์ พรรธนประเทศ

sample_reviews_en.text: No english menus so if you’re a falang know what you wanna order in Thai. Staff is very nice and accommodating to my bad Thai. I eat here for dinner often.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tess Marie

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious and inexpensive... Fried snakehead fish, crispy fish salad, stir-fried clams with chili paste, and more, depending on your luck.
sample_reviews_en.author: นิพันธ์พงศ์ พานิช

sample_reviews_en.text: The food used to be delicious, but now the taste has changed. The stir-fried clams are too sweet, and the tom yum soup is too sweet.
sample_reviews_en.author: P.B Kc

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious. Prices on the menu are around 120 baht. The restaurant is located right by the roadside.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jaturong jarungjirakiat

restaurants.name: ซานตาเฟ่
restaurants.address:

51 3 Pradit Manuthum 19, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
They sell steaks (pork, beef, chicken), salmon, spaghetti, salads, soups, and many other items. I used to eat at other places with their old menu, but now they have new sets to try. They still keep the original menu for those who want to try a variety of things. I tried it and the taste was good, the spices were well-infused into the meat.
There were many customers, both foreigners and Thais. The food took a reasonable amount of time to prepare. The staff provided good service. The price was reasonable considering the taste and quantity.
Overall, 4 stars.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tossapon Pongcharoen

sample_reviews_en.text:
This steak restaurant offers great value for money. The food is beautifully presented, tasty, and the portions are generous at a very reasonable price, especially considering it's located in a mall. It's air-conditioned, clean, convenient, and easily accessible.
Santa Fe also frequently offers promotional menus, including new items or special set meals.
Overall, it's a highly recommended steak restaurant that offers great value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chompunake K

sample_reviews_en.text:
🔺This is my daughter's favorite restaurant. Her go-to dish is the spaghetti with ham and mushroom cream sauce. She finishes it all! It's delicious, easy for kids to eat, and affordable.

🔺This branch is located on the 3rd floor, in the outdoor open-air area near the Central shopping mall entrance. The restaurant is large and spacious with plenty of seating. The staff provides good service and the food is served quickly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patinya Wisuth

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is on the 2nd floor, in the hot zone near the mall entrance. It's a large restaurant. It's not very crowded at lunchtime on weekdays, so the food doesn't take long to arrive. The service is okay. The food is delicious and not too expensive; the price is reasonable.

The Mala Chicken Steak is 129 baht, a good portion. There are promotions available.
sample_reviews_en.author: MEE KKE

sample_reviews_en.text:
Santa Fe

Stopped by for lunch. Ordered a few dishes. Prices are typical, portions are generous. Many branches to choose from. Friendly service. I really liked the mushroom soup and spaghetti.

📌 Santa Fe
⏰ Open: 10:00 AM - 9:00 PM
📌 51/3 Pradit Manutham 19 Rd., Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230
💵 1-100 THB/person
🚗 Parking available in front of the restaurant
sample_reviews_en.author: Panjapon Khamsajja

sample_reviews_en.text: Every time I come here, the service is excellent. The staff are lovely and attentive. For example, my boyfriend and I ordered just one glass of lemon tea to share, and they provided two straws. The food is prepared quickly, and it's delicious, fresh, and clean.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phornphan Suphacharoen

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious; I personally liked every dish. The portions were generous, the place was clean, and the prices were moderate. However, the wait for food was quite long because it was crowded. The staff provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Prangsiri Prang

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff provided excellent service with a very positive attitude. They were polite, provided good information, and were willing to help, even though it was busy with promotions. They even offered complimentary dessert at the end.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sweet CJ

restaurants.name: No Man's Land
restaurants.address:

5 Floor, 1375 ถ. เจริญกรุง Bang Rak, Silom, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We select this restaurant for its cozy rooftop atmosphere for bbq dining, and it’s the only good thing you can expect here. The rest were catastrophic.

- Average food quality.
- Inefficient management (actually you can’t even call it a restaurant).
- The order were messed up between table, and we have to take our ordered dish from someone else’s table in the middle of COVID-19 situation! (the restaurant later give these two dishes for free)
- Extremely slow service (you have to wait for half an hour for an order, even there were only 3 tables).
- Super unfriendly, zero service mind staff.
- When we got the bill, we were surprised by the amount of food we haven’t order for. We wait for 3-4 revisions for almost 20 min and they couldn’t make it right.
- The only thing we got as an apology was insincere sorry from the staff, and the excuse was just that the staffs were not able to understand and communicate Thai clearly. Really?
sample_reviews_en.author: Wirach Leelakiatiwong (Joe)

sample_reviews_en.text:
Fantastic spot, set over 2 floors with a great roof terrace where you can watch the fireworks at the River.

They have a really good selection of food and drinks and an ever changing menu for bud so there's always something different to try.

Loads to do here also if you don't smoke, there's a PlayStation, tons of board games and retro arcade machine. You can have hours of fun here.

Easy to locate, they have a banner outside so you cant miss it - but just incase, the door is to the left of "wrap god", follow the corridor to the lift at the back and head up to floor 5 :)
sample_reviews_en.author: Caitlin Burnett

sample_reviews_en.text:
Beautiful place run by a beautiful young team of very friendly people. decent buds from really good strains, you better ask for their recommendation, this lovely guys know what their dealing with ;) the shop has more than buds and good vibes to offer if you around do not hesitate to visit this cozy space for sure. even if you not smoking you can drink and buy some smoking gear for your smoker friends, like amazingly handcrafted bongs and all.. very very Cool place
and i loved it when i see playstation is always on)
thank you P' Ma
sample_reviews_en.author: Cagatay “CAM” Kaciktas

sample_reviews_en.text: Very nice place to chill, good vibes. We walked from the Sky Bar at Lebua State Tower. To find it from the street, you go inside a narrow hallway next to a little food window, walk down straight to an elevator & go up to the 5th floor. Immediate good vibes! Loved the neon signs :) there’s a bar area, then you can go up to rooftop area that is very open & relaxing. Staff was super friendly & helpful. Would definitely come here again & recommend it to anyone!
sample_reviews_en.author: Cristina Ocampo

sample_reviews_en.text: Product is extremely average for Thai standards and overpriced. I used to come here to drink and watch the sunset while smoking my own flower. They eventually told me that I could not smoke my own product here, due to them being a shop, disregarding the money I'd spend on beer and food each visit. I felt like I wasn't valued as a customer, and the owner is very strict about the staff. There are other cannabis cafe's around which are better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Goldie

sample_reviews_en.text: Great place to try Cannabis. My hotel was just in the same neighborhood & we tried few times. We selected the rolled version. The quantity in the roll is unpredictable as it can be, but the quality is spot on. The shop is on the fifth floor & it has a balcony where you can smoke therefore a great view is also guaranteed. Overall a great place to try something cannabis.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jithin Varghese

sample_reviews_en.text:
This place is so welcoming and monmon is the girl that makes the place run
We came here one year ago and the same girl is there which makes the place so special
We don’t spend a lot of money, but she is always nice to us and that is to us so special
She has looked after me and my kids so many times
Thank you👌😎🤩
sample_reviews_en.author: Simon Mackenzie

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my another favourite of dispensary in BKK. The reasons I love this place are because they have very friendly staffs, a roof top open space that you can chitchat with friends or meeting new friends, and also their game room. How I can ask for more :) worth to spend sometimes here!
sample_reviews_en.author: Tif Chan

restaurants.name: Jay Yen Chicken Rice
restaurants.address:

61 ตรอก, Chang Thong, San Chao Pho Sua, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
📆: July 2021
📝: The Hainanese chicken rice portion is generous. The chicken thigh meat is tender, juicy, and not dry, both the skin and the meat. The rice has a garlicky aroma. The dipping sauce is average, edible as is, and the soup is refreshing.
⭐: Inexpensive, large portion, good value.
💰: Starting at 40฿
🚙: Find parking along the roadside or in the nearby side streets.
sample_reviews_th.author: PANUPAN JANTAPIMOL

sample_reviews_en.text:
Ambiences are so and so, located at tip of a quiet alley, outdoor dining area in front of shops.
Service of lady owner was not so polite and friendly, no smile, no greeting, but fast and responsive.
Chicken rice was as delicious as best chicken rice at Bangkok. Lovely presentation, juicy and tender chicken meat, topped on fragrant rice, so appetizing.
The dip sauce is great, spice and sour, boosting the flavor of chicken rice and it is on the table, free for you to add more.
Amazingly, the broth soup was superb. In fact, I rarely emptied my soup when eating chicken rice, but this one is too hard to pass up.
Average portion, affordable price.
Recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rbw dinata

sample_reviews_en.text:
We ordered two dishes: a large mixed chicken (boiled and fried) with chicken broth and Thai tea (50% sweet), and they were incredibly delicious! And reasonably priced too.

The boiled chicken was tender and not dry at all, and the fried chicken was freshly fried and juicy.

There were three kinds of sauces, and they were all delicious. At least for me, a Japanese person, the flavors suited my taste 🥰
The soup was served hot and simply seasoned, which I also appreciated.

The staff spoke English and the conversation was smooth; they carefully explained how to eat the Khao Man Gai.

I want to come again!
sample_reviews_en.author: 混凝土太郎

sample_reviews_en.text:
Je Yen's Hainanese Chicken Rice, Tanao Road, near Praeng Phuthon. The rice is perfectly cooked, just the way I like it, with a hint of garlic. The boiled chicken is tender and decent. My favorite part is the soup! 8/10 😋😋😋😋

I've been eating at this place since I was in high school. It used to be one of my favorites when it was near Sanguan School. Anyone who went to Sanguan would stop by. Unfortunately, the taste has declined compared to before. This time I saw Je Yen, and she hasn't aged at all.

The shop is open daily from 9:30 AM to 9:00 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: Montree T.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The first bite at this restaurant was incredibly exciting. The rice was perfectly cooked, fragrant, and delicious—a texture I haven't experienced since childhood. Back then, chicken rice had this kind of rice texture everywhere, but it seems to have disappeared.

I'm giving this restaurant 4 stars, deducting one star because the dipping sauce was a bit too sweet.

The chicken itself was very juicy, tender, and delicious.

The soup was decent, meeting the standard of a good chicken rice restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Arnon Techathanawat

sample_reviews_en.text:
Let’s not get carried away, it’s chicken rice. But - it’s very good chicken rice! I tried the mixed - comes with fried and broiled chicken, nice mix of textures, good flavour, some fresh cucumber slices, and a very good condiment in the table, laced with ginger and chillies. The rice isn’t award winning, but it does the job and doesn’t disappoint.

Recommended if you’re in the area
sample_reviews_en.author: Jens Seidl

sample_reviews_en.text: This Hainanese chicken rice shop is located in an alley. I saw the sign and decided to try it. The taste was just average, nothing special. What stood out from other shops was the rice, which was cooked perfectly. The downside is that the dipping sauce was a bit too sour and quite watery. The shop is inexpensive and the owner is very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: DukeTK

sample_reviews_en.text: The first bite left me speechless. The rice was incredibly soft and melt-in-your-mouth delicious, even better than many big, famous restaurants. The chicken was in thick pieces, not flattened. The price was more than worth it. Whenever I pass by, I always buy some to take home. If you haven't tried it yet, I highly recommend giving it a try.
sample_reviews_en.author: Goy Pathitta

restaurants.name: ธาตุแท้ 76 bar
restaurants.address:

13, 34 moo13 Industrial Ring Rd, Tambon Bang Phueng, Amphoe Phra Pradaeng, Samut Prakan 10130, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is great for chilling out, having drinks, socializing with friends, or bringing the family for a meal.
The food is reasonably priced and tastes very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jitjima Seenongkote

sample_reviews_en.text: Good Food, Price, Vibes in Phrapadeang. The food price is cheap and nice environment. Also have the live music as well.
sample_reviews_en.author: al bpaisal

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and clean. The flat noodles are very tasty, and the meatballs are large and satisfying.
sample_reviews_en.author: Brandon Chan

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was delicious, and the all-you-can-drink beer buffet was incredibly good value!
sample_reviews_en.author: le papillon

restaurants.name: Crafted Space by CCC - Fine Wine and Isan Cuisine
restaurants.address:

298/8 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Samrae, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: We are staying at the Anantara Resort but didn’t enjoy it. We found this gem near the resort, at a large road intersection with a car park. Live music, excellent service, very good food, and good wine. The only thing we missed was an espresso martini to round off the meal. Keep it up and we will be back.
sample_reviews_en.author: Josefin Ydhag

sample_reviews_en.text:
A hidden gem in a car showroom. The food is delicious! The papaya salad is incredibly spicy. The pork crackling is incredibly good.
The wine is excellent. The Isaan food is excellent. The view of the 100 million baht car is amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: naratnun luangluecha

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was amazing, truly delicious, and the prices were excellent, not expensive at all. Good wine, good cocktails, great atmosphere, great singer, and incredibly good service. Highly recommend! Come visit! *****
sample_reviews_en.author: Sirin Ying

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was great, with live music to listen to relaxing tunes. The food was delicious, especially the Luang Prabang papaya salad and the spicy jungle papaya salad – they were incredibly tasty!
sample_reviews_en.author: kakojung h.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is very cheap, 70-80 baht, and for a restaurant of this caliber, the quality is excellent. Wine starts at only 800 baht. The singer has a fantastic voice. It's a very chill atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: กฤษติกา คุ้มครอง

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything was delicious and the atmosphere was amazing. The olive chili paste was the absolute best. Prices are very reasonable. Highly recommend visiting, you’ll love it from the first time.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patteeya Piyakamonnirun

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was absolutely fantastic, the food was delicious, and the wine started at only 850 baht, which was a great price. The food arrived quickly, and the ambiance was amazing!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nick Potter

sample_reviews_en.text: Best place to hangout around Thonburi area. Food is amazing. My fav was Nam Tok Moo. They also offer great selection of wine & beers. Staff very friendly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Britney Pooh

restaurants.name: ร้านเจ้ส้มตามสั่ง
restaurants.address:

664 Soi Krungthonburi 4, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: The made-to-order food was delicious, exactly as ordered. This has become my regular restaurant!
sample_reviews_en.author: Garanyaporn Ngamying

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is incredibly delicious. It takes a while, but it's definitely worth it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pawarit Kitphian

restaurants.name: Fufu Phochana - ฟูฟู​โภชนา (อาหารและข้าวแกงใต้)​
restaurants.address:

เลขที่ 2293 4 Sukhumvit Rd, Bang Chak, Phra Khanong, Bangkok 10260, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Southern food is my favorite, so whenever I pass by a shop selling southern curry rice, I must stop, whether I'm hungry or not. Tried this place for the first time tonight. Excellent flavor and spicing. Restaurant is clean and brightly lit, and tables are spaced far apart. Rice with 2/3 curries is 40/50 thb. Free ice water. Can't go wrong here!
sample_reviews_en.author: John K

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was extremely salty. I ordered chicken curry for 89 baht and got only bones. I had to sit and pick them out. I was so angry and sad. Plus, the taste was so salty that I couldn't eat it. I had to order from another restaurant. I'm sorry, but is selling like this too profitable? Is it too frugal?
sample_reviews_en.author: Thanyaporn SIRITHAMKHANTI

sample_reviews_en.text: I hadn't even finished eating yet, and I went to get some ice water and came back when the lady had already collected the plates. She was about to take them back from the basin. Why are you rushing to collect them? There's so much rice left.
sample_reviews_en.author: Likit Wannapram

sample_reviews_en.text: I'm a regular customer of this restaurant. I eat here almost every day. There are many dishes that I really like. I recommend the braised eggs and stir-fried pork with chili paste. They also serve free shrimp paste and fresh vegetables.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lastminute N

sample_reviews_en.text: I understand that everything has a cost, but I think the quantity doesn't match the price. It used to be delicious and they gave generous portions, but now they give very little. The curry in the bags is really small in portion.
sample_reviews_en.author: Patty W

sample_reviews_en.text: Good food. Cheap price, kind staff. What more could you want from a canteen style restaurant. Paid 52 Baht for rice with two sides, papaya salad and a water. Tasty quick and cheap
sample_reviews_en.author: Cameron Browne

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is ridiculously expensive, and the taste is just average. I'm confused, what makes it so expensive? The staff serving the food were also incredibly rude.
sample_reviews_en.author: Annabelle

sample_reviews_en.text: Affordable tasty food with paid parking just down the soi. Try to go before peak hours for hot food. The selection past peak hour isn't always fantastic.
sample_reviews_en.author: Crypto Calories

restaurants.name: สวนอาหารปิ่นแก้ว
restaurants.address:

33/13 หมู่4 ซ, ท่าอิฐ-ไทรม้า Sai Ma, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stumbled upon this restaurant by chance. It's located near Wat Trai Ma Nuea, about 200 meters before the temple. I learned that it's owned by a former high-ranking government official and a politician from the democratic side. Apparently, he opened the restaurant because his wife had free time and he wanted something to do.
Recommended dishes include sour curry and pad Thai without noodles, but my favorite is the crispy catfish with ginger and chili. The flavor is rich and delicious, not too spicy, and tastes great with hot steamed rice. It's also delicious on its own as an appetizer or snack. I highly recommend it. The prices are very reasonable. For those who want to eat seafood, the restaurant says you need to call and order in advance because they want customers to receive truly fresh seafood.
There is convenient parking at the restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Surapak Dharachan

sample_reviews_en.text: The place is beautiful and peaceful, with an atmosphere like an old-fashioned wealthy home, but situated in a garden surrounded by shady trees. There's a large garden and lawn to stroll around, and a playground with equipment for children. Covered parking is convenient, but might be a little difficult during the rainy season. The food ranges from reasonably good to very good, but I didn't find anything disappointing. It seems the chef tries to create unique and innovative recipes. The prices are moderate, not cheap but not outrageously expensive. The restroom is limited to one person at a time. The restaurant is located tucked away in an alley next to Wat Trai Ma Nuea, but there are two convenient access points.
sample_reviews_en.author: กฤษณ์ วีณะคุปต์

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food is delicious, but expensive. There's a 10% service charge.
Most importantly, the prices on the menu don't match the bill. Steamed sea bass with lime was 400 baht on the menu, but the bill was 450 baht.
The garlic chili shrimp was also charged an extra 50 baht from the menu price. This is unacceptable.
I usually eat here often, but after this experience, I won't be eating here again because of this dishonesty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kasipat 456

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered the cashew chicken with taro nest for takeout, but there was no taro nest included. I called to inquire and was told they were out of taro. There was a complete lack of coordination between the order taker and the chef, and they didn't inform the customer so I could change my order. This dish was therefore less enjoyable and I was very disappointed.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pa Ch

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and flavorful, and the atmosphere is great. The weather is fantastic these days, just like being in Khao Yai. I recommend bringing a scarf! The restaurant has recently renovated its outdoor area, making it much more comfortable and charming. I highly recommend this place for families and friends to socialize. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Chaninun Thongvanit

sample_reviews_en.text: This is another place you shouldn't miss. The food is delicious, there's ample parking, and there are many beautiful spots for taking photos. The light is especially stunning in the evening as the sun is setting. Anyone who loves taking pictures shouldn't miss it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Phawat Topaisan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Pin Kaew Garden Restaurant: Delicious Thai food.
Excellent atmosphere, perfect for the whole family.
Features a children's play area and is located by the Chao Phraya River.
sample_reviews_en.author: 4WD Focus [พี่น้องร้องเพลง]

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is okay. The atmosphere is peaceful, the service is good, and the food is delicious. If you've never been here before, you should give it a try!
sample_reviews_en.author: Natthagritta _27

restaurants.name: Tehran Restaurant Pattaya
restaurants.address:

260/1 moo. 10 South Pattaya, Pattaya Sai 2 Rd, Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
An Iranian restaurant in Pattaya with a menu of various Iranian dishes.
The restaurant reception was in Persian and they sent us the menu and prices via WhatsApp.
Of course, the prices of the food are a bit high, the prices are on the menu that I posted a photo of.
We placed the order by phone, but since they didn’t have a courier, we went in person to get the food delivered.
The restaurant environment was small but clean and quiet. The staff was Iranian and Thai; their attitude was very polite, warm and funny.
We were there at around 3 pm when the restaurant was empty. We ordered the kebab kebab kobideh and the eggplant curd; both were very tasty and of high quality.
Overall, it was a good experience and if you are craving Iranian food in Pattaya, this is a good option.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mahboobe Mohammadi

sample_reviews_en.text: I have eaten at many Persian food restaurants in Pattaya and this one, Tehran, is the best.  The food is delicious and the place is clean, has good atmosphere and is a pleasure to visit, as opposed to many others that I have tried.  The people working there are also very professional and nice.  Try the Mirza Ghasemi.  They made it fresh and it was delicious.  Kebabs were juicy.  Salad Shirazi was fresh and the dough was delicious.  I also like the unique plates that they use.  I will only go to the Tehran restaurant for Persian food when in Pattaya from now on.  Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Frank S

sample_reviews_en.text:
Good food, terrible service.

I ordered the kubideh which was very good (I’m Iranian so I know how it should be). The doogh (yoghurt drink) was disappointing.

Sadly, the service was awful. The waitress didn’t smile or say a single word to me. She just stood next to me to let me know she was ready to take my order. Both the chef and the waitress sat inside watching separate videos on their phones and they were both clearly annoyed with each other. Really unpleasant atmosphere
sample_reviews_en.author: Mark Mostafavi

sample_reviews_en.text:
A once-in-a-lifetime experience 🤷‍♂️
I ordered this dish for 600 baht thinking it might be the most luxurious option 😦
The meat had a rancid, stale taste.
I didn't even finish half the rice with green beans and dill.
The soup was okay; I swallowed a little bit with the rice to make it easier to eat.
The order came without bread.
The salad was mixed with colored cabbage, onions, half a lemon, peppers, and basil.
It took a long time to be served.
sample_reviews_en.author: ALI ALKHAYYAT

sample_reviews_en.text:
We had mixed kebabs with rice and lots of side dishes with drinks first time and yummy Ghormeh Sabzi second time. Apart from being healthy we experienced real taste of Persia. Recommended to anyone who wants to enjoy a top quality meal in Pattaya.
Thanks to Tehran Restaurant for providing fresh and delicious food with friendly and professional staff.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jason sajadi

sample_reviews_en.text:
A truly wonderful experience at Tehran Restaurant 👌 The Iranian food is authentic and delicious, especially the kebabs and grilled meats 🔥 The rice was perfectly cooked, and the service was respectful and fast.

The place is simple, but the food makes up for anything 👍 I will definitely go back and recommend it to everyone ❤️
sample_reviews_en.author: Oliver Explorer

sample_reviews_en.text: The worst experience in Pattaya with Tehran Restaurant. Today we went there to have lunch. However, the food was very bad and not cooked. The man who is the owner was so rude and disrespectful. The food was very bad-tasting and expensive; they charged 500B.The food looked good, but the taste and cooking were awful and so bad.
sample_reviews_en.author: zanyar sharif

sample_reviews_en.text: Very good food and the price is reasonable. The service is not as good unfortunately. We ate there twice and the waitress didn’t come back after serving the food. Also the food items served were not the same as the pictures in the menu. Overall recommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Payman Shamsollahi

restaurants.name: ตำเด็ดคุณ
restaurants.address:

VG39+HJ7, Soi Tiwanon 14, Tambon Talat Kwan, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
There are two somtum (papaya salad) restaurants next to each other in an alley.
Food: On the day I went, I ordered 👉 crab somtum and lotus stem somtum. I have to say I ordered the somtum extra spicy, and it was VERY spicy! They don't skimp on the chilies at all. The restaurant uses dried chilies for their somtum. If you order it normally, I think it would still be spicy, but this was my first time, so I didn't know, and I ordered it extra spicy. The color in the picture looks like normal, but it was so spicy it made my eyes water. There was no other flavor besides spiciness. It woke me up! 5555
👉 Gaeng Om (Thai herbal curry): Delicious.
👉 Grilled pork neck: Tender and delicious.
👉 Grilled beef with chili powder: Chewy but okay.
👉 Khanom Jeen (Thai rice noodles) that came with Chinese morning glory: Very confusing! 555
👉 Blanched noodles: Good garlic aroma, but they were stuck together.
The prices weren't too high, and the government's co-payment scheme worked out perfectly.

Atmosphere: Simple seating with fans.

Service: The staff were polite, but very slow.

Parking: Very, very difficult to find parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sabine Kim

sample_reviews_en.text: The papaya salad with fermented fish sauce was delicious, and they weren't stingy with the chilies. The sweet liver was tasty but a little too tough (if you prefer softer liver, order it soft). The fresh vegetables were good. I finished off and cooled down the spiciness with a refreshing grass jelly dessert, which I loved – chewy and delightful. The service was good and friendly, and they played relaxing music. Parking is on the main road, just a short walk into the alley on the right. I'll definitely come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Abby

sample_reviews_en.text: My Thai friend brought me here to eat. We ordered three dishes. It was quite crowded, so the wait was a bit long. Although I'm not sure what she ordered, everything was delicious. One dish, which looked like fried fish, was very crispy and had great sauce. The soup was sour and spicy, and very tasty. The green papaya salad was delicious, with a strong fish sauce flavor—quite different from what I've had in Taiwan.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tiffany Hung

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves really good Northeastern Thai food. It's delicious, clean, and authentic. My favorite dishes were the grilled fatty beef, blanched beef slices, and chicken soup with young tamarind leaves (they put a lot of tom yum ingredients in it!). This was my first time eating here, but I'll definitely be back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sung N.

sample_reviews_en.text: Great taste, friendly prices. I really like the fermented fish sauce at this restaurant. I often order the "Som Tum Pla Ra Ded Khun," "Som Tum Sen Lek Moo Tum," "Som Tum Luang Prabang," "Yam Pla Duk Fu," and "Grilled Beef." However, parking can be difficult on weekdays.
sample_reviews_en.author: ponglada srivicha

sample_reviews_en.text: The only thing that's okay is the cheap price. The ingredients weren't very fresh. The fresh vegetables I ordered weren't fresh at all. The first dish, deep-fried pork belly with fish sauce, was of a poor quality cut and wasn't served hot, …
sample_reviews_en.author: phukan

sample_reviews_en.text: This restaurant serves good somtum (papaya salad), grilled and fried chicken, and fried larb (spicy minced meat salad). The somtum is a bit spicy and sour. Other dishes are of good quality. There is no dedicated parking.
sample_reviews_en.author: Bunjong D.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and clean. The restaurant has plenty of seating on two floors. It's recommended to call and order food in advance because sometimes ordering directly at the restaurant means a long wait.
sample_reviews_en.author: Pattarasuda Toitoi

restaurants.name: สุดแซ่บ ยำมะม่วงปูม้า เจ้าเก่าสะพานพุทธ
restaurants.address:

258 Prajadhipok 4 Alley, Wat Kanlaya, Thon Buri, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Spicy minced pork salad with egg yolk 150฿. Very small portion, overpriced. (Ordered via app)
sample_reviews_th.author: Waraphon Rueangrak

sample_reviews_en.text: That day I ordered century egg salad and mixed seafood salad, but the mixed seafood salad was incomplete; I didn't get the century eggs or the oysters. Usually, when I eat there, everything is included. If they had told me that something was out of stock, I wouldn't have ordered it. Doing this is really disappointing. Also, the person who spoke to me wasn't very polite. I remember it was a woman, and I was dressed quite simply that day. She looked at me condescendingly. When I ordered, she even asked, "It's expensive, do you really want it?" That made me feel really uncomfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Aor Aoraor

sample_reviews_en.text: My beautiful sister's shop, a legend forever! The portions are huge! This dish cost a little over 3 red bills (approximately 120 baht). The shop has a huge menu to choose from. Delivery orders are flying out! It's always so busy, no matter what day you go. 😋 Delicious and popular food in the Saphan Phut area. 100/10!
sample_reviews_en.author: อีฟซี่’ เกรียน

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is right by the road, the atmosphere is comfortable and relaxing. The food tastes good but is quite spicy, so I recommend medium spicy. The salted egg papaya salad is delicious, and the fresh shrimp salad is also tasty. There are delivery riders constantly taking orders, so it's very popular.
sample_reviews_en.author: tuppawath atipisankul

sample_reviews_en.text: I bought takeout today. It was my first time buying from them, and the first thing that impressed me was the excellent service. The staff were very attentive and polite. I was very impressed and will definitely order again. It's so heartwarming to meet staff like this!
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattakan Jean

sample_reviews_en.text: This is unacceptable. Those who arrived first got served last. I waited a very long time, and even when I asked about my food, they didn't let me know if it was ready. They just left me sitting there waiting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Anamanee I1199

sample_reviews_en.text: Good service, nice atmosphere, delicious food, good value for money. However, there are only 4 tables, so you have to come early. It's really worth it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Apirat Kumcharoen

sample_reviews_en.text: For those ordering delivery, I recommend ordering about 1 hour in advance. And please help cheer on the delivery riders while you wait! 5555
sample_reviews_en.author: ออกไปใช้ชีวิต

restaurants.name: ครกใหญ่อินดี้ @สุคนธสวัสดิ์
restaurants.address:

หน้าสนามไดร์ฟกอล์ฟ เกียรติธาดา, 35/369 Sukhonthasawat Rd, Khwaeng Lat Phrao, Khet Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered steamed sea bass with lime sauce, served separately, to offer to monks tomorrow morning. However, the food arrived in terrible condition. It was awful. The owner must have taught their staff to do this; the food arrived in such a bad state. I paid for this, I didn't get it for free. I ordered through Grab and tried to contact the restaurant using the number listed, but it was out of service. When I got a new number, no one answered. I've never experienced anything like this before. This place is the worst I've ever been to. They'll probably go out of business soon.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunday za

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten at this restaurant many times before. On my last visit, the food was okay, and the taste had improved. The ordering system was more organized with QR code scanning, but lately it's become quite disorganized. I had to frequently ask for my order, and the service wasn't very good. The karaoke machine was also out of order; it took several hours to get it fixed before I could sing. I wasn't very impressed.
sample_reviews_en.author: HEART FELT (ผู้ใช้บัญชีนี้ชื่อฮาร์ตเฟลต์)

sample_reviews_en.text: If you like spicy food, I recommend this place. It's really spicy with lots of dried chilies. The papaya salad has crispy noodles but isn't as flavorful as I'd hoped. Today's hero dish was the duck larb, with plenty of meat and lots of delicious dried chilies. The grilled beef and beef waterfall salad weren't that impressive. There's plenty of parking and restrooms. The seating area is spacious and comfortable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jeffey

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere of the restaurant is nice, spacious and comfortable. We didn't eat in the restaurant, we ordered takeout. The food prices are not expensive at all, and the taste is very good, really delicious. It was my first time eating there, we went by chance but didn't expect to be so impressed. I will definitely go again next time. The staff provided good service.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nudchanard

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating here. The hot pot was delicious, especially the spicy dipping sauce. I also ordered the Korat-style papaya salad, which was delicious with a flavorful fish sauce dressing 👍🏻 The prices are reasonable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Klp Nk

sample_reviews_en.text: The menu price was one thing, but they charged a different price. The price has increased. The menu should reflect the increased prices. It's disappointing. The staff provided good service, and the food was acceptable.
sample_reviews_en.author: Raksanalee Noey

sample_reviews_en.text: I highly recommend it! The hot pot and papaya salad are delicious. If I've tried other places and they haven't been to my liking, I always come back here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Phucha Sri

sample_reviews_en.text: Everything is delicious and the prices are good too. I recommend the fried duck beaks, fried chicken, papaya salad, and pork hot pot – they are the best!
sample_reviews_en.author: jane-uksorn chariyakul

restaurants.name: Puesto callejero comida
restaurants.address:

108 Atsadang Rd, Wang Burapha Phirom, Phra Nakhon, Bangkok 10200, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: Don't be fooled by appearances, because if you are, you won't stop. Everything we tried was delicious, but I forgot to take pictures. I only remembered when I ordered more and snapped some photos of the pad Thai. The woman cooks on the street in the traditional style. And the prices are very affordable, 50 baht a plate, a steal. However, they don't understand English or anything like that, so communication is best through the photos in the reviews unless you speak Thai. People keep coming in to take food away. It's worth it.
