Just be aware, there are only two tables, so good luck.
sample_reviews_en.author: Juan Jose Cruz Martinez

sample_reviews_en.text: It is really delicious. I couldn't understand the menu even with a translator, so I ordered the owner's recommended dishes, and everything was tasty. The seasoning is just right. Even though it is a street stall, it is clean and the staff are very friendly. The rice topped with fried pork is really good.
sample_reviews_en.author: sso kim

sample_reviews_en.text: This place was so welcoming and friendly. A short walk away from the hustle and bustle of the Grand Palace and high prices, we had great banter with the staff and the food was top drawer for a kerbside eatery at a very affordable price. We highly reccommend.
sample_reviews_en.author: Dan OConnell

sample_reviews_en.text: Delicious! We ordered two pad thais (shrimp and pork) and they were so delicious we ordered another one, and the cook made one especially for us. The food was SPECTACULAR, and the cook was very friendly. If you're a tourist, try to stop by here.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jorge

sample_reviews_en.text: A very local spot to eat delicious pad Thai. The lady was very friendly and willing to serve us the best of her dishes. Although the place doesn't look very appealing at first glance, everything changes when you give it a chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: Marc Lozano

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a wonderful little Thai restaurant that we stumbled upon after visiting The Reclining Buddha. Delicious taste and very affordable price for food and drinks.

Very pleasant shop owner who provided table service!
sample_reviews_en.author: Lane Liddle

sample_reviews_en.text:
Don't expect luxury, but if you want real food at an incredible price, this is the place for you. We waited about 30 minutes, but it was totally worth it. The photos speak for themselves.
Feel like a true local.
sample_reviews_en.author: Juan Hurtado

sample_reviews_en.text:
Yes, this is an authentic Thai restaurant.
Friendly staff, and delicious food that will leave you wanting more.
Believe me, in Bangkok, the restaurants without fancy decor often have the best food!
sample_reviews_en.author: 朱嘉詮

restaurants.name: Nakhon Nua - Nakhon Phanom Taste
restaurants.address:

1521/1 Sukhumvit Rd, Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text: Super tasty, all dishes are packed with high quality ingredients! ตำเส้นเล็ก (tum sen leak) is a MUST try, highly recommend for anyone who wanna taste authentic north-eastern Thai restaurant with homey atmosphere and convenient location, just minutes walk from bts prakhanong.
sample_reviews_th.author: nithawan srivichai

sample_reviews_en.text: Finally, a Thai, Northeastern Thai, and other cuisine restaurant has opened near my house! I'm so happy and the food is delicious too, because usually there are only Japanese restaurants around here. The restaurant is beautifully decorated, clean, spacious, and the staff provides excellent service. The prices aren't too expensive, and the food is delicious. I've eaten there twice and ordered several dishes, and they were all great. The pork sausage was amazing, and the beef noodle soup was okay. Some people might not be used to it because it comes with a dipping sauce, which adds to the flavor. I heard it's busy during lunchtime, mostly with office workers. I saw that you can call to order in advance. I went after peak hours, so there were seats available. This will probably become my regular restaurant near home. I love it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Praew S.

sample_reviews_en.text: The service staff is very good. I am very impressed. There was a slight problem with our order, but the staff was polite and solved the problem to our satisfaction. They apologized every time they served. The owner also came out to apologize again. Before leaving, he came to talk and apologize again. We were very impressed. We will definitely go back again because it is close to home. The food is very delicious. I feel that this is the first restaurant that I think the price and the taste of the food go together. It may be a little expensive, but it is because of the price that I understand. It is very delicious. We are very impressed. 💗💗
sample_reviews_en.author: Thunyaporn Kengkwasing

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located a 30-second walk from Phra Khanong Station, this restaurant serves regional cuisine from Nakhon Pathom, a region of Thailand about 50 kilometers west of Bangkok.

The restaurant offers a fusion of Vietnamese and Thai cuisine, reflecting the active exchange between the two regions.

The food was delicious, the service was friendly, and I'd definitely like to return.

Most dishes are under 100B, and 200B will fill you up with two dishes, excluding drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: 生駒泰斗

sample_reviews_en.text:
This restaurant is in Nakhon Phanom, Laos, located on the opposite bank of the Mekong River in the Isan region.
It seems to be a popular restaurant among locals. They serve hearty som tam with crab and para.
They also serve regular gapow and noodle dishes, which are all quite tasty.
Rather than serving anything particularly delicious, they serve just regular, tasty Thai food.

By the way, this is apparently the hometown of the current king's wife.
sample_reviews_en.author: MASAHIRO TAKAKI

sample_reviews_en.text: A little piece of Nakhon Phanom right here in Bangkok, Isan (thai Northeast) food which the friendly staff made me feel right at home. The food was simply amazing – the flavors were bold and authentic, just like the Isan food in Nakhon Phanom. The thai salad with crispy pork was especially delicious, with the perfect balance of sweet, sour, and spicy. If you're craving a truly authentic Isan meal, this is the place to go!!!
sample_reviews_en.author: KinTiewLen

sample_reviews_en.text:
The food tastes great, and there's a wide variety of dishes to choose from, including noodles, som tum (papaya salad), single-serving meals, drinks, and desserts.

Today, I really enjoyed the beef noodle soup. The broth was fragrant and rich, the beef was tender, and it tasted great with the crispy pork rind dipping sauce. I also liked the corn salad with salted egg. I'll definitely be back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ka Tib

sample_reviews_en.text: This Isan restaurant is located near Phra Khanong Station. It seems to have opened on the first floor, directly in front of the building where Akiyoshi is located. You can easily order at your seat using a QR code. There is an English menu with pictures, so it's easy to order. I ordered Gai Yang rice, which was quite tasty and had a wide selection of dishes, so I'd like to come again.
sample_reviews_en.author: Kiyo

sample_reviews_en.text: A noodle shop selling yen ta fo, tom yum, and pork blood soup in Phra Pradaeng. Personally, the dry noodles with spicy salad might be a bit too sweet. The noodles are a bit soft. The taste of the spicy kao lao is average. If you like a particular flavor, you have to add more seasoning yourself. The portions are very large. The shop is on the side of the road, a bit outside Phra Pradaeng Market. Parking is on the side of the road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nuch S

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodle soup tastes just like when I was a kid, it's delicious even without any extra seasoning...the meatballs are good too, not too starchy and not fishy...the price is also inexpensive. The shop is easy to find, just turn in a little bit, you'll see it right by the motorcycle taxi stand.
sample_reviews_en.author: ChubbyArin

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious and well-balanced, with a great, home-style flavor.
This taste reminds me of my teenage years.

Importantly‼️ The regular size is 40 baht, and it's a substantial portion.

Highly recommended ❤️

As for me, I finished it all 😁
sample_reviews_en.author: Suttiporn Aof

sample_reviews_en.text: In my personal opinion, the noodles were delicious and the pork blood soup tasted good, although the offal had a slight smell. The prices were cheap, and the owner was kind. I'll definitely visit again if I have the chance.
sample_reviews_en.author: bam rider10

sample_reviews_en.text:
This old-fashioned pork noodle and yen ta fo (pink noodle soup) shop in Prachaprang has been in business since around 1967.
The dry noodles are fragrant with pork fat and generously topped with …
sample_reviews_en.author: Soottipong Winyoopradist

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and the portions are generous. There's motorcycle parking in front of the shop. If you're visiting the Phra Pradaeng City Pillar Shrine, try stopping by this restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Nattacha Chansri

sample_reviews_en.text: The noodle bowl is large, with plenty of toppings, and the dumplings are delicious. The price is very affordable, only 40 baht per bowl, and iced coffee is just 10 baht.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิน วิน พลัส

sample_reviews_en.text: This is my favorite restaurant in Phra Pradaeng Market. Small dry dumplings with spicy sauce. The soup is clear and easy to swallow. Very delicious.
sample_reviews_en.author: warintip Ubonpuech

restaurants.name: ร้านอาหารใคร
restaurants.address:

69 2 Bang Krang, Mueang Nonthaburi District, Nonthaburi 11000, Thailand

sample_reviews_th.text:
Nestled in a charming walking alley, ร้านอาหารใคร is a hidden gem surrounded by lush greenery and tranquil waters. The peaceful ambiance immediately sets the tone for a relaxing dining experience, offering a perfect escape from the hustle and bustle of the city.

The menu is a delightful exploration of Thai flavors, with the Pad Thai and corn somtum standing out as must-tries. The Pad Thai is perfectly balanced, with just the right amount of sweetness and tang, while the corn somtum brings a refreshing twist to the classic dish, bursting with vibrant flavors.

To complement the meal, I highly recommend the coconut smoothie. Creamy, refreshing, and packed with natural sweetness, it’s the perfect drink to enjoy while soaking in the serene surroundings.
sample_reviews_th.author: Wisanu Tuntawiroon

sample_reviews_th.text: The Pad Thai with extra crispy pork rind has a rich flavor (90฿). The price is quite high, and the portion is average, not too much or too little. There are quite a few mosquitoes after 6 PM because it's a garden area, but the restaurant has fans.
sample_reviews_th.author: theSMOKKOK

sample_reviews_en.text:
First time here… The owner recommended the "Pad Thai with Crispy Pork Rinds" and "Luang Prabang Papaya Salad." So I ordered those, plus some grilled pork neck salad with sticky rice.
1. Pad Thai with Crispy Pork Rinds: Excellent! For those who love crispy pork rinds, they give you a generous amount. The Pad Thai noodles are perfectly soft. Each bite has a balanced sweet, salty, peanut, and chives flavor.
2. Luang Prabang Papaya Salad (contains fermented fish sauce according to the Luang Prabang recipe): Those who don't like fermented fish sauce might miss out on this dish. It was delicious and not too salty.
3. Grilled Pork Neck Salad: The flavor was just right, with a good lime tang. However, the description said "less fat," but the kid couldn't read it. A slight mistake; it was a bit fatty.
4. Sticky Rice: Served hot (some places I've been to serve it cold).
Summary: Personally, I love the Pad Thai with crispy pork rinds. This place is worth a repeat visit for those who love Pad Thai and crispy pork rinds.
sample_reviews_en.author: อนุชิต เสถียรวราภรณ์

sample_reviews_en.text:
The entrance is like a hidden gem. You have to park outside and walk a short distance. The atmosphere inside is nice with lots of plants, but those allergic to insects should be careful.

We ordered several dishes. The Pad Thai had chewy noodles and fragrant peanuts, but it was extremely sweet and a bit soggy. The crispy pork cracklings were good, but the portion was surprisingly small.
We also had mixed steamed dumplings; the taste was very average, nothing outstanding. The dipping sauce was like a sweet soy sauce.
We ordered minced pork basil stir-fry to take home, asking for it not to be spicy or have garlic, but when we opened it, it was full of garlic.

The service was good. The woman with short hair was polite and helpful. The other foreign staff seemed a bit confused; we ordered takeout but ended up eating in the restaurant (which is understandable since we didn't tick the boxes on the order form).
sample_reviews_en.author: Slimickkly Thiti

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant's atmosphere is shady, natural, and not too hot.
Regarding the food taste, this review is only for what I ordered:
The food was extremely sweet.
-The lemon tea was undrinkable, extremely sour.
-The green tea tasted like milk, not tea at all.
-The papaya salad was very sweet and had a strong fermented fish sauce smell.
-The traditional Pad Thai was extremely sweet and also very salty.
Service: The short-haired female staff member provided excellent service. She was polite, smiling, and cheerful.
The staff member taking food orders had a rather harsh and unpleasant tone of voice.
We waited about 30-40 minutes for a table, but definitely waited more than 45 minutes for the food.

Overall, the restaurant urgently needs to improve the taste of its food and drinks.

Personally, I was quite disappointed with the food taste.
sample_reviews_en.author: Siwanon Srivacha

sample_reviews_en.text:
The restaurant is located in an alley and doesn't have its own parking lot; you have to park at the temple if the street parking in front of the restaurant is full. The alley is difficult to navigate, and there are road repairs currently making driving even harder. So we parked at the temple and walked back to the restaurant.
The restaurant itself is nice and shady. The food took a little while to arrive. When we came, the place wasn't full, but if it were full, we probably would have had to wait even longer. The noodle soup was very flavorful and delicious. The Pad Thai was okay, but the crispy pork cracklings didn't feel as fresh as they should have been. Overall, it was acceptable.
The restaurant still seems a bit disorganized, especially when it comes to paying the bill; it took a very long time. They should manage that better.
sample_reviews_en.author: Methiya F.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food at affordable prices. The owner makes its own fermented fish sauce, which is incredibly fragrant – a must-try!
The Crab Rangoon is a must-order; it's delicious, with a cheesy twist, and the cheese dumplings are amazing.
The restaurant is surrounded by a small canal, creating a great atmosphere. It's a real canal, not a man-made one, making it hard to find this kind of ambiance in Nonthaburi.

The tables are under the shade of large banyan trees, providing plenty of coolness. I was worried it would be hot and stuffy, but surprisingly, it wasn't at all.
There is parking available. Enter through the temple entrance and park along the road or before the temple gate; it might be a bit of a walk.

The restaurant is open every day. It's very shady and pleasant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Noravee Pacherat

sample_reviews_en.text:
📍 First time here, based on reviews. The atmosphere is great, very relaxing. The service from the staff was good, friendly and smiling. The food tasted good. I went right when the restaurant opened, and it was already crowded.
🍝 The Pad Thai was amazing, but delicious!
🍗 The fried chicken would be perfect if it were marinated with a little salt, as it was too bland.
🥟 The giant dumplings were also delicious.
🥓 The Basil Chicken Rice was the best, very flavorful.
♻️ Highly recommend, you have to try it!
🔖 A minor issue: I wish there were table numbers or clearer communication within the team, as we experienced our order being served to the wrong table. Also, it would be great if they double-checked the order during service. 💗💗
sample_reviews_en.author: PureMagic P.

I especially love the crispy sea bass salad with herbs and the fish and chips. Overall, I highly recommend trying it.

sample_reviews_en.text: 🍃💗 Ohkajoo, the famous vegetarian restaurant that never disappoints. My go-to dish is the salmon steak with spinach and truffle 😋✨ It's absolutely amazing! One serving is enough to fill you up, but I couldn't resist ordering other dishes. Everything is delicious and high-quality, especially the vegetables which are incredibly fresh 🥗🌈 …

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is as delicious as ever. The salmon steak with spinach promotion is incredibly good value; the portion is huge and the salmon is perfectly cooked. Plus, as a member, there's a buy-one-get-one-free smoothie offer. The staff at the EmQuartier branch are lovely, polite, and provide great recommendations on promotions.

sample_reviews_en.text: The staff are lovely and the service is great. The birthday set is excellent value; the portions are huge, more than two people could finish. During your birthday month, you get a free fruit salad and a free smoothie. If you book in advance, you also get pumpkin soup and a welcome drink.

sample_reviews_en.text: Impeccable food as always, great value for money made much more memorable by distinguished service by Venus, who not only was kind enough to walk us through updates to the loyalty membership application but also helping us to make the most of all the specials that came with it!
sample_reviews_en.author: Sam Wipatavit

sample_reviews_en.text: We ordered several dishes. The vegetables were very fresh. I especially liked the fried sea bass with herb salad.

sample_reviews_en.text:

sample_reviews_en.text: Meat lovers and garlic enthusiasts, you have to try this! 🥩🧄 At 'Campfire Meat', I ordered the crispy garlic and chili rice. They gave me a generous portion of ingredients, and the aroma was incredibly satisfying. Mixing it with hot rice was pure bliss. The best part is, if you eat at the restaurant, you get free clear soup and pickled vegetables – perfect for cutting through the richness of the meat. They offer both pork and beef options, and you can choose your size (M, L, XL) depending on your hunger. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
sample_reviews_en.author: krapalm krapalm

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is located in the basement of MRT Lat Phrao station. It's a counter bar style setup, so seating is limited, but the food is outstanding. The meat is high-quality, perfectly cooked, and well-seasoned. If you like spicy food, I recommend the "Hell's Hot Beef Rice Bowl," the one in the picture is the XL size, priced at 299 baht, and comes with soup and pickled vegetables. It's a very filling and worthwhile meal. Meat lovers should definitely try it! 🤤
sample_reviews_en.author: usanee asayut

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tasty but not amazing. Good price. The skewers of meat were quite chewy.
The fried rice had a nice, soft texture, but the smell was a bit strong (for me). The dipping sauce was okay.
|| The ingredients weren't quite ready. The pickled eggs were freshly pickled on the day I ate there. Many customers missed out, so I ended up eating eggs marinated in fish sauce instead :(

sample_reviews_en.text: "Spicy Rice with Beef (Hell's Sauce)" - The spiciness is just right (you can choose the level of spiciness). The beef is perfectly cooked and not chewy. If you eat at the restaurant, you'll also get pickled vegetables and soup. It's so delicious, you have to try it! ☺️
sample_reviews_en.author: patawee sangsri

sample_reviews_en.text: Some people say it's from the United Nations, I don't know which region they're from, but anyway, you should be careful, even though 300 isn't a huge number. I don't want to bash the business, but it might make you feel better when you have a bad experience.
sample_reviews_en.author: truth seeking

sample_reviews_en.text: Today I tried the crispy garlic and chili beef with rice, and it was so delicious! The portion size was just right, the beef was tender and not chewy, and perfectly cooked. Meat lovers must try it!

sample_reviews_en.text:
Stopped by this halal spot near Masjid Darul Aman for a quick dinner. It’s simple, affordable, and has aircond seating, which was really nice after walking around in the Bangkok heat.

Daging bakar was actually quite good. Pad Thai was okay, not amazing but still enjoyable. Just the steam seabass was not fresh but gravy is acceptable

Service was good, the staff were polite and helpful. And the best part the whole meal cost us just 570 baht, including one rice and one black tea.

sample_reviews_en.text: This place became my go-to spot for food in Bangkok. It's like a hidden gem, kinda tucked away, especially when it's raining. The Tom Yum soup is insanely delicious, and the mango salad is a real treat. Their drinks are also super refreshing. The service is quick and on point, and the toilets are nice and clean. Good job to the folks running this place!

However... the price is expensive and not really worth it.

sample_reviews_en.text:
First and last time here.

- The atmosphere is okay, with air conditioning, a bit cool.
- But the prices are very expensive. A dry chicken rice salad is 80 baht, and a creamy seafood tom yum soup is 150 baht with only tiny shrimp and squid scraps. Ice is 3 baht per glass, and a no-name brand drink is 10 baht. (Chicken and seafood rice dishes are 80-100 baht).

Other dishes were also delicious, but the fried papaya salad was very bland; it was soggy, I'm not sure why. And to finish, the mango sticky rice was truly excellent, with big, juicy mangoes! 😻

This is a truly local, down-to-earth restaurant.
There's a dog roaming around, and the owner often watches TV in the back. Don't expect fancy ambiance or service.

I frequent this place and have never been disappointed.
However, if you're looking for a comprehensive review and expect to compare it to other experiences, I recommend trying a different restaurant.

sample_reviews_en.text: I saw a new restaurant and decided to try it. I ordered beef noodle soup with tripe and tendon, plus plain rice. At first glance, the 80 baht bowl was quite small, and they seemed stingy with the broth, giving very little. I thought the broth would be amazing, given the restaurant's name, but the first sip was a little disappointing. The broth was on the sweet side, mild in flavor, and not impressive. The portion was so small that a typical man wouldn't be full with just a bowl of rice and a normal bowl of noodle soup; he'd need to go somewhere else. Compared to other restaurants, it's just okay, but it falls short of the famous ones around Ratchawat or further down on Ruamchit Road, like the second branch of the beef noodle shop on Phra Athit Road. However, the highlight of this restaurant is their chili vinegar sauce – it's wonderfully sour and refreshing. But again, in terms of broth and beef noodle soup preparation, it's still far inferior to many of those famous places.

sample_reviews_en.text:
Street Food Gem: Charcoal-Grilled Pork Satay by the Roadside 🔥

If you’re exploring Thailand and love discovering hidden street food spots, don’t miss this humble roadside stall selling pork satay (Moo Satay) — grilled the traditional way over a charcoal fire!

You’ll smell the smoky, irresistible aroma before you even see the stall. The pork is marinated with fragrant spices and grilled to perfection, giving it that slightly charred, juicy bite that locals can’t resist.

What makes it even better? It comes with crispy toasted bread, perfect for soaking up the rich, creamy peanut sauce, made from a secret recipe that’s sweet, savory, nutty, and just the right hint of spice. On the side, you’ll also get a small pack of cucumber, red onion, and chili pickles, offering the perfect refreshing contrast to the richness of the satay.

✨ Simple. Affordable. Full of flavor. It’s the kind of Thai street food experience you’ll remember long after your trip.

Pro Tip: Look for stalls with a small charcoal grill and a queue of locals — that’s usually a good sign you’ve found the right spot!
sample_reviews_en.author: Talk To Tui

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is near Saphan Kwai intersection. It's more convenient to park at Big C and walk over. The pork is tender, fragrant, and flavorful. I like the tangy pickled vegetable dipping sauce; it's refreshing and cuts through the richness. The peanut dipping sauce is also delicious, fragrant, creamy, and not too sweet. At times, it can get busy, so you might have to wait a while after ordering. It's a good idea to go for a walk and find other food options afterwards.

sample_reviews_en.text: The pork satay has an authentic flavor, and although the price has gradually increased, it still maintains its quality and taste. The only downside is the atmosphere isn't very inviting; it might be more comfortable to eat and then leave, or buy it to take home and eat.

sample_reviews_en.text:
The chicken noodle soup with bitter melon is delicious, the broth is rich and flavorful.
The chicken leg and feet are incredibly tender, and the chili paste is very spicy. I highly recommend this restaurant, it's truly amazing.
sample_reviews_en.author: Somsak Sujindanupong

sample_reviews_en.text:
I ordered dry noodles.
What I got was noodles that were overcooked and mushy.
I couldn't pick them up with chopsticks because they were so mushy they broke apart.
They charged a high price, and the vendor had a grumpy face.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sunphop Phurirungsiphol

restaurants.name: Afghan Cuisine
restaurants.address:

Shop, 11 Charoen Krung 38 Alley, Bangkok 10500, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
I stumbled upon what I think might be the only Afghan restaurant in Bangkok and decided to check it out! Afghanistan is a country I'd love to visit, but it's quite difficult to get to. So, being able to eat authentic Afghan food made by Afghans right here in Bangkok is incredibly wonderful!

AI recommended Kabul pilaf and mantou, saying I should try them for my first time, so I ordered those two dishes. Besides tables, the restaurant also has a space where you can sit on the floor and eat like you would in Afghanistan, giving you a real sense of the culture. The Kabul pilaf wasn't greasy like the pilafs from Central Asia like Uzbekistan; it was light and easy to eat. The mantou also had that typical Central Asian taste.

It was a very interesting first experience with Afghan cuisine.

According to the staff, there's a certain number of Afghans living in Bangkok. I felt the diversity and the connection to the culinary Silk Road.
sample_reviews_en.author: Staff Terry's Cafe

sample_reviews_en.text:
I love Middle Eastern and Central Asian cuisine, so my friend chose this place for dinner.
I ordered the Kabul pilaf, and when I tasted it, the seasoning was mild, bringing out the natural flavors of the ingredients. The mutton had absolutely no unpleasant odor and was incredibly tender, practically falling apart with just a touch of the spoon. It was delicious. The spiciness was mild, which I think is a good thing for Japanese tastes.
I highly recommend it if you're ever in the area!
sample_reviews_en.author: 郡山リオ

sample_reviews_en.text: Guys, the pilaf is amazing, with carrots and raisins, just right. It's essentially no different from the Uzbek version. I also liked the other dishes: the rush is excellent, the lamb is very soft and odorless, the bread is freshly baked. The dessert is delicious. I hope the guys stay with us for a long time. Finally, delicious pilaf has arrived in Bangkok, no need to go all the way to Pattaya.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vsevolod Chakilev

sample_reviews_en.text: Had my first Afghani meal last night and it was amazing. The pulao had a natural sweetness from carrots and raisins, which was something new for me. The mutton was incredibly tender. The owner was super friendly and even shared stories about different types of pulao and karahi. Great experience. Highly recommended.
sample_reviews_en.author: Natee Visesrut

sample_reviews_en.text: Really incredible, delicious food. We were able to try many different dishes and honestly, I really can't decide what I preferred because everything was so good. And thank you to the very kind staff for explaining and helping us order. We really loved our experience here and recommend it very highly.
sample_reviews_en.author: Chris LaVigne

sample_reviews_en.text: I have seen many clips on YouTube about afghan cuisine and I was always aspiring to try authentic afghan cuisine in real! Guess what!I have ordered signature dish Kabuli Pulao 😋It tastes sophisticated flavour with a big chunk of tender lamb meats! زما خوښ دي
sample_reviews_en.author: 灰色狼

sample_reviews_en.text: We recently visited this Afghan cuisine restaurant and had an amazing experience we tried almost all the dishes, and honestly, every single one was absolutely delicious each bite had rich, authentic Afghan flavors that truly impressed us. …
sample_reviews_en.author: Ali Hamza

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely outstanding Afghan cuisine! The food was authentic, fresh, and full of rich traditional flavors. Every dish was perfectly prepared and beautifully presented. The hospitality was warm and welcoming, making the entire dining …
sample_reviews_en.author: Landof tourmaline

restaurants.name: Mr. Joe ก๋วยจั๊บ 脆皮豬雜湯
restaurants.address:

ชั้น 5 Food Zone, One Bangkok, Witthayu Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
(Taiwanese Flavor)
It's a combination of pork bone soup, pork offal, and crispy roast pork. The taste is good, but it's all familiar Taiwanese flavor, lacking a bit of surprise. However, the crispy roast pork skin was fried very crispy and evenly; I would give it five stars just for the roast pork alone.

This food court uses self-service ordering machines. The machines have Thai and English options. For Taiwanese people, the machines only accept Line Pay or cash vouchers. We tried Line Pay but it failed; I don't know if we didn't link it or something.

Cash Voucher Usage:
1. Order from the machine and see how much it costs.
2. Buy a cash voucher at the entrance counter; only cash is accepted.
3. Go back to the machine to order again and select cash voucher.

Welcome to add me, Pikmin, as a friend to explore different places: 216791256415
sample_reviews_en.author: J K

sample_reviews_en.text:
The main branch is in a slightly inconvenient location, but this is a branch that opened in the food court of One Bangkok.

It's wonderful that you can eat the famous Kuay Jab at One Bangkok.

Kuay Jab is packed with offal, making it irresistible for offal lovers. The soup is quite peppery from the start, so try it without adding anything first.

The Moo Grob has a beautifully cut cross-section. The outside is crispy, the inside is tender and juicy, and it's the kind of taste that makes you crave a beer.

As expected of a Michelin-listed restaurant, the taste of this famous establishment is still present even in the food court.
sample_reviews_en.author: KA

sample_reviews_en.text:
I’ve been eating at this restaurant since they opened their first branch and I usually come to the One Bangkok branch almost every week Every time I visit, I ask for extra spring onions, and the staff have always been happy to give me some.

Today, I asked for extra spring onions again, but the staff member replied, “That’s already a lot.” It honestly made me feel uncomfortable because I’ve never been treated like that before, especially as a regular customer.

I know it may seem like a small thing, but good service and the way customers are spoken to matter. I think I’ll stop coming here from now on.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wipwise

sample_reviews_en.text: Was introduced to Mr Joe's since going to its location over at charoen krung. It's one of the go to because an ability to maintain the quality of meat with the technique of getting it juicy inside, crispy outside and right amount of meat to fat as critical. Unfortunately disappointed the last few times with the size and amount of what's given.  The innards still processed well and the noodle is ok. But crispy pork needs to work on consistent quality to make it a go to
sample_reviews_en.author: L C

sample_reviews_en.text:
Since it is a business district, there are many office workers.

You can pay via QR code at the kiosk or with a card loaded with cash.

The offal smell was too strong for my taste, so I couldn't eat it in the end... and threw it away. If you like things like sundaeguk (blood sausage soup), it might suit your palate... but I don't really enjoy sundaeguk... The pork belly is crispy, but since it is served cold, it gets progressively greasy...
sample_reviews_en.author: 잔잔한zanzanhan

sample_reviews_en.text:
Everything on the menu was amazing.  roast pork with the sticky sauce is definitely worth the michellin star. The pork soup was delicious and you can ask for no offals.
Crab meat siu mai is very unique and a must try item

Came here at around 12pm on public holiday. No queue, big restaurant with lots of seatings. Many locals as well as tourists here. got in straight away, foods served quickly. Very cheap for a michellin restaurant
sample_reviews_en.author: kam

sample_reviews_en.text: Undeniably impressive, delivering a perfect balance of a crunchy exterior with tender, juicy meat. While the pork itself isn't the most flavorful on its own, the thick sweet soy sauce and tangy vinegar dipping options definitely make up for it. Unfortunately, the soup broth noodles were fairly meh and didn't live up to the high standard set by the pork. We've been told that that the main branch has more flavorful pork.
sample_reviews_en.author: Richard Isleta

sample_reviews_en.text:
Tucked at the food court at level 5/6.
Came for the famous crispy roast pork.
It was indeed crispy but flavour was lacking. Had the bowl of rolled rice noodle but the taste is nothing exceptional. Just glad I didn't have to queue for this. Can top up the cash card or pay via their qr code as you ordered at the ksiok which is in 2 language, Thai and English.
sample_reviews_en.author: Joyce

restaurants.name: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเนื้อตุ๋น สุขนิยม ซุ้มเนื้อ Sukhniym Beef Pavilion
restaurants.address:

ซอยตรงข้ามเซเว่นเรือยอท 23 Phatthaya Tai 8 Alley, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
This is a beef restaurant. I visited during lunchtime and had the beef yakisoba (stir-fried noodles) for 120B as a light meal.

This Japanese-style yakisoba was topped with seaweed and bonito flakes, and the aroma was very appetizing.

The beef used was tenderloin. It was lean and had a light flavor. It was carefully stir-fried with a Japanese-style sauce and was delicious.

Although I didn't order a drink, they kindly provided a bottle of water free of charge. I appreciate their thoughtfulness. Thank you very much.

There were other delicious-looking beef dishes on the menu, so I'll post them here.

The open-air restaurant has 10 table seats. There are also 3 tables in the adjoining drink area. (A cool motorcycle was sitting there.)

I will definitely visit again. Thank you for the meal.
sample_reviews_en.author: Syo Kei

sample_reviews_en.text:
Sookniyom Beef, Pattaya Soi 8
This hidden gem is run by a chef known as the number one culinary talent in Pattaya. Though he never reveals which luxury hotel he works for, his dishes speak for themselves.

🥩 Premium Selection – Only the finest Thai beef is chosen, prepared with the same precision you’d expect in a five-star kitchen.
🌍 Unique Fusion – The flavors blur the line between Western fine dining and bold Isaan-style cooking. You’ll find it hard to tell where the steakhouse ends and the street-side spice begins.
✨ The Experience – It feels like fine dining, yet warm and down-to-earth, letting everyone taste the skill of a top chef without the hotel price tag.

A true Pattaya secret waiting to be discovered.
sample_reviews_en.author: Montree 911

sample_reviews_en.text:
Anyone familiar with Pattaya knows its cuisine can be quite uneven. Today, however, we're at a hidden gem. Far from the hustle and bustle, we're enjoying a cozy, open-plan restaurant and savoring excellent food prepared by a host with an eye for detail and a genuine passion for good food. Both dishes were perfectly balanced in flavor and a true delight.

The service is attentive and friendly, and while the ambiance initially appears somewhat simple, a closer look reveals a love for detail.
sample_reviews_en.author: Heiko Jacob

sample_reviews_en.text:
Very tasty. The guy was so attentive. We had lunch at 2:30 p.m. I was the only guest. He offered me a fan and showed me how to eat properly.
We take a cabbage leaf, add a couple of green florets (like ginkgo biloba), a mint leaf, and some beef. I put a cucumber on top. We dip it in the sauce and eat it 🫠
The dish costs 250, the water costs 50.
sample_reviews_en.author: Ольга Бенгс

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is delicious and flavorful, with excellent quality meat. They have hard-to-find dishes like spicy beef stew, spicy dry noodles, spicy wild boar liver, and grilled beef steak with a unique coconut fish sauce dip – you won't find anything like it anywhere else! They provide three types of dipping sauces.
sample_reviews_en.author: วิทยสาธิต เรืองบุญ

sample_reviews_en.text:
Every time I come to Pattaya, I have to try their beef. It melts in your mouth! The beef is fresh, tender, and firm yet juicy. The environment is very comfortable. My favorite is their grilled beef, poach mix beef, and spicy stomach salad.

This restaurant doesn't just sell beef; they have many other options.
sample_reviews_en.author: TYL p

sample_reviews_en.text: Meat lovers must try this place! They have great dishes at reasonable prices. The owner and staff are very friendly. The restaurant is clean, newly opened, and the food is delicious. I personally love the spicy beef soup and the grilled picanha. Highly recommended!
sample_reviews_en.author: sunzol braids

sample_reviews_en.text: I can recommend this restaurant 300%; the chef seems to have trained in very prestigious establishments. Every single dish was truly exquisite. I highly recommend trying this restaurant. It's tucked away in a back alley, but it's well worth the visit.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike Molto

restaurants.name: Htet Akari Burmese Foods
restaurants.address:

2342/3 Ramkhamhaeng Rd, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I’ve been craving Rakhine food so bad recently and this place just satisfied all my cravings!! The Rakhine mont t was pretty authentic and for the 55 baht price point, I could definitely demolish at least 3 plates. Actually, I might not be able to as the portion sizes were very filling. I also had their octopus salad. It was incredibly refreshing and delicious!! So delicious that I had to order a serving of their seafood salad for takeout. Hope this shop gains the attention and love and opens branches near my place >_<
sample_reviews_en.author: Elita

sample_reviews_en.text:
A great place for a delicious taste of Myanmar. I tried the Hnin Pearl Steamed Rice with Fried Chicken. The rice was nice, though served a bit cool, and the fried chicken is distinctly Myanmar-style—well-seasoned but chewy, so it's best eaten with your hands. They've switched from traditional leaf to plates.

No English menu, but they have daily specials. Service was friendly, and prices are very affordable. Important to note: this is not a Halal restaurant.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lat Aung

sample_reviews_en.text: 100% recommend Burmese Food. You can enjoy the authentic Burmese cuisine and Myanmar’s homemade Mohingha which is really great for those who want to taste the authentic cuisine. Its owner and staff are friendly and hospitable to everyone. Prices are very reasonable and worth it. I will give 10 out of 10. I will come back again.
sample_reviews_en.author: soe lin htet

sample_reviews_en.text: Amazing Burmese and Rakhine food in Bang Kapi! The owner speaks perfect English and can help with translating the menu if your Burmese is rusty. We had mohinga, round noodles, and pork curry, and all three dishes were excellent. The restaurant is clean and bright, with very good aircon. We will be going back!
sample_reviews_en.author: Martha Brantley

sample_reviews_en.text: The Burmese food here is absolutely delicious and full of authentic flavors. Every dish tasted fresh and homemade, reminding me of traditional meals from Myanmar. If you love bold flavors and unique textures, this place is definitely worth visiting.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sheila T

sample_reviews_en.text: Absolutely loved the food at Htet Akari! Such authentic and flavorful Burmese and Rakhine dishes. Everything tasted fresh and homemade. Will definitely be back to try more of their menu. Highly recommend!
sample_reviews_en.author: Myo Htet Aung

sample_reviews_en.text:
The Best Burmese Restaurant in Town ♾️
My favorite restaurant in Bangkapi. Everything on their menu is good 😭❤️
I eat them almost every day, both in-store and in-store... …
sample_reviews_en.author: Aye Sandar Min

sample_reviews_en.text: This Burmese restaurant in BKK, foods are so delicious. It’s same taste like when I had been ate in Myanmar.Rakhine Mone-T( ອານສົນນີນີດ) is the most I like menu.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hom

restaurants.name: สเต็กลุงหนวดเลียบทางด่วนคุณกะลา
restaurants.address:

เลียบทางด่วน Kanchanaphisek Rd, Samae Dam, Bang Khun Thian, Bangkok 10150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered one beef steak, one pork chop steak, and one serving of mashed potatoes. Why was I charged 190 baht? I only realized this when I got home, and it doesn't seem like it should be that much. I didn't even order any drinks.
sample_reviews_en.author: สุพจน์ ลาภมีมา

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating at this branch. I ordered pork steak, but the pork was undercooked, so I had to cook it myself. Next time, I hope the restaurant will check the food more carefully.
sample_reviews_en.author: chatinee sungthong

sample_reviews_en.text: The steak tasted good, but some dishes were not prepared and served correctly; improvements are needed.
sample_reviews_en.author: komkrit chumjam

sample_reviews_en.text: The atmosphere was relaxed, the service was good and fast, and the steak was delicious!
sample_reviews_en.author: จารุวรรณ จันทร์พันธ์

sample_reviews_en.text: The steak was delicious, the price was reasonable, and the portion was generous.
sample_reviews_en.author: แววดาว หล้าแสนสืบ

restaurants.name: Salad Factory @ The Mall Bangkapi
restaurants.address:

QJ8R+8RW, Bangkapi - The Mall Bangkapi, Khwaeng Khlong Chan, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
**Excuse me, but I'd like to suggest an improvement regarding the service of one of the female staff members. She was wearing a blue glove on only her left hand. She should improve her serving technique. In service work, we need to place dishes and food carefully. Coworkers should remind her. Speaking from experience in service, I understand that cutlery, if it's stained, shouldn't be placed on the table. Please look into this. Thank you.**
The atmosphere inside the restaurant is clean. There are a few areas for improvement, and I hope to see further development. The quality and taste of the food maintain a good standard. I always like the promotions from this brand. 😚
sample_reviews_en.author: Phimagine

sample_reviews_en.text:
I am a regular visitor to the Salad factory restaurants around Thailand, and this would be my first visit to this particular location (since the major revamp of the mall).
As expected, quiet and relaxing place and great food.
The menu is full of great selection of dishes that is well illustrated in clear pictures together with details in both English and Thai.
Prices are reasonable as they have always been.
Really nice place to enjoy without any hassle or complaints.
It would be great if the management would consider providing additional condiments such as salt, pepper at each dining table as most of the dishes come as plain as can be.
sample_reviews_en.author: Husain AlHusaini (Husain_Tula)

sample_reviews_en.text:
This was my first time trying it, and I was so impressed!!! This branch is on the upper floor, the lighting is beautiful, perfect for taking photos. The staff were polite, attentive, and very lovely. The salad was huge, so satisfying! This was my first time trying the Tom Yum Goong salad, and it was even better than I imagined. You really have to try it!
And of course, I couldn't miss the mango yogurt for dessert. So delicious and filling! 😊😍
sample_reviews_en.author: Panggg S.

sample_reviews_en.text: The food is "clean" style. Compared to similar restaurants like Ohkajoo and Sizzler, the taste is milder, perhaps because it's "cleaner" and has fewer vegetables, but the price is lower. The staff provides good service; there's a button to call the staff at each table, making it convenient for customers, even when sitting in a secluded corner. Some tables even have charging ports available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Rich Richy

sample_reviews_en.text: This was my first time eating at this branch. There were some issues with the service and presentation, including undercooked food, but the staff handled the situation well. They apologized, remade the dishes, and compensated with my membership stars. I hope they've improved their skills to meet the restaurant's standards next time. 💓 The food taste, however, was still as good as always.
sample_reviews_en.author: YORYING EAT AROI

sample_reviews_en.text: I used to eat at their Fashion Island branch regularly, until they opened at The Mall Bangkapi. It's much more convenient and closer. It's a restaurant where you can get great value for your money on salads; they're delicious, not expensive, and the portions are large. They prepare the food quickly, and the service is good. Today I ate lightly because it was already past 8 PM.
sample_reviews_en.author: **air-air-air**

sample_reviews_en.text: I've eaten at this restaurant dozens of times and always gotten a delicious dish, but today was the last time I tried the mentaiko spaghetti. The noodles were too hard, it smelled like vomit, the taste was strange and bland, lacking the savory mentaiko flavor. Even Shinkan* makes it better. I'm a little disappointed, and the price wasn't cheap either. 🥲🥲
sample_reviews_en.author: Jamais Vu

sample_reviews_en.text: If you are looking for a simple or health-conscious dinner, this restaurant seems like a good choice. I usually visit in the early evening and order spaghetti and salads; I recommend it because it is an excellent meal that doesn't upset my stomach. However, there are so many items on the menu that it always takes a long time to decide.
sample_reviews_en.author: 김용현

restaurants.name: Xiangi Thai Food & Sea Food
restaurants.address:

88, 20 Soi Saengkan, Thanon Phaya Thai, Ratchathewi, Bangkok 10400, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
We managed to secure a table at the restaurant before the place filled up. To our surprise, there was a second floor that could accommodate additional guests once the ground floor was full. However, the stairs leading up to it were not handicap-friendly; they were steep and narrow, making it challenge.

We settled into our table and took some time to peruse the extensive menu. The menu had a wide variety of authentic dishes (I liked the pictures). Our server was attentive, helpful, and polite. There were plenty of servers available, with only one person at the register. The restaurant was clean and organized.

Our order took a bit of time to arrive, but we were pleased that all our dishes arrived simultaneously. No complaints about the food; it was delicious. So far, the morning glory vegetables with garlic has been the best I’ve had in Thailand (in Phuket and Bangkok).

We were all satisfied.

I recommend 👍🏼
sample_reviews_en.author: M Abalos

sample_reviews_en.text:
⭐ 5/5 – Delicious Thai Food Near Pratunam Night Market!
If you're around Pratunam Night Market, don’t miss the amazing local Thai food spots nearby! So many delicious options with authentic flavors at affordable prices. 🍲🌶️
We tried several dishes – from Tom yum Gong , Green Curry to sea bass steam – all incredibly tasty and cooked fresh. You can really taste the spices and traditional Thai touch.
Perfect place to enjoy local food after a shopping spree. The vendors are friendly, and the atmosphere is lively and full of local charm.
Highly recommended for anyone wanting a real taste of Thailand just steps away from the market! 🇹🇭🍛
sample_reviews_en.author: IR1

sample_reviews_en.text: The staffs are friendly, attentive and polite. Quite a number of customers in the restaurant. Our order take some time to arrive. The lime steamfish is a perfect balanced of sweet, sour and spicy (request less spicy). The fish is fresh and taste delicious. The coriander lime chilli sauce adds 'kick' to the fish💦💦. The stir fried vege with garlic may look simple but is deliciously crunchy and has 'wok hei'. The complimentary sour mustard soup may look simple but taste great. The blueberry soda and coconut taste great. 😎😎👍👍 It's an enjoyable dinner.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lim Swee Choon

sample_reviews_en.text: I only took the picture of this small size Leng Sapp served in Xiangi, our first meal in Bangkok, Pratunam Night Market. I’ve been a fan of this dish since I’ve tried it in Jatujak (SM Aura), and nothing compares in trying the authentic one from Thailand. This is a small size serving of Xiangi, but as you can see, this is enough for 4 people! I wonder how big is the big size. 😅 When you’re in Pratunam Night Market, you should try this dish!! The resto is serving 24hrs btw~
sample_reviews_en.author: Machan

sample_reviews_en.text: We went to a new branch on Soi Wutthi Phan which was terrific.  We had the salt BBQ fish, green mango salad and grilled aubergine.  The fish was a big portion and tasted fresh.  The Thai seafood sauce was fish sauce forward.  My own preference is more lime juice to fish sauce.  The mango salad was really excellent, redolent with lemongrass and shallots.  Nice pieces of whole dried shrimp.  Aubergine was soft and tasty but took a while to arrive, being baked.  Good value.
sample_reviews_en.author: Alice Gee

sample_reviews_en.text:
A rather pushy promoter was at the entrance, who was nonetheless friendly, though a bit too intrusive!

Unfortunately, we were then chased away by a 37-member Thai family who claimed our table. The restaurant owners couldn't be held responsible for this, of course, and immediately reassigned us to another table.

However, there was a suspicious smell of urine at the entrance.

The food was excellent and the staff very friendly! The prices were also great!
sample_reviews_en.author: Johannes

sample_reviews_en.text: Xiangi Thai Food at Pratunam is a great casual spot for authentic Thai cuisine in the heart of Pratunam. We enjoyed the flavorful dishes and generous portions at reasonable prices, and the food felt fresh and satisfying. The atmosphere is relaxed and friendly, making it a nice place to stop for a meal after shopping and exploring the area. Overall, Xiangi offers tasty Thai food and good value in a convenient location.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mr Lee Keng Lock

sample_reviews_en.text: We had our dinner in this restaurant earlier and ordered lots of food. We ended packing up the rotis, eggplant and some enoki for breakfast. The grilled onion leaves had some Indian spices. The tom yum soup was flavorful and comforting. It had a lot of mushrooms, too. The mango sticky rice was great!
sample_reviews_en.author: Allyn Japitana

restaurants.name: On the Table Tokyo Cafe Central Pattaya
restaurants.address:

WVMM+V9H, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand

sample_reviews_en.text:
My husband and I really love this place, or at least we did before he got food poisoning after eating the sushi here. We feel very conflicted now because it was literally our favorite restaurant in town, but if we have to risk getting food poisoning again, that's not very good incentive to come back.

Maybe next time we will steer clear of the sushi, and there are many other good options on the menu. Pricing is moderate: not cheap, but not horribly expensive. And we really enjoy the homie environment, with nice cushions at the table, for example.

The service here is always good as well,  and the people are very friendly.

If you go, you might consider the Shukshuka, which is kind of like a combination of lasagna and pizza, without noodles. Just be careful, as it will arrive very hot!

The strawberry ice cream (sherbet?) was nice too.

It's also worth noting that they attack on a 10% service charge, which is I rather large tip compared to Thai standards. This left me feeling a little conflicted about not leaving a cash tip, but maybe that's just me.
sample_reviews_en.author: Tim G

sample_reviews_en.text: Went there yesterday with my friends. We all ordered together a drink, appetizer and main dish. It took them like 20min to bring my friends their cokes. We asked about my drink and they said it will be there shorty. Then the appetizer and main dish from one of my friends arrived. Still i didnt even receive my drink until that point 😂. Then the other two main dishes arrived (after like 10 more min). Really bad timing. What is my friend supposed to do? Eat while i dont even have my drink? Wait for us so her food gets cold???? Well then i received my drink. Wow. Btw the APPETIZER was still missing. While eating we asked twice about our appetizer and when we finished our main dish it arrived. Btw the restaurant was literally completely empty. There were 3 or 4 waitresses just standing around doing nothing. I dont know what they did but they definitely did not prepare our food 😊. The food was ok but really watery. Dont take the salmon, it tastes like nothing. Yeah just dont go there. I think there is a reason why its always so empty.
sample_reviews_en.author: Hanna

sample_reviews_en.text:
Great place in Central Pattaya for quality food and a relaxed cafe-restaurant vibe.
The menu has strong Japanese-inspired dishes, good pizzas, fresh ingredients, and nicely presented plates. Everything tasted fresh and well prepared. Coffee and drinks are also solid.
The location inside Central Festival Pattaya is very convenient. Easy stop for lunch, dinner, or a break from shopping. Clean space, comfortable seating, and fast service. Staff were polite and efficient.
Prices are reasonable for a mall restaurant and the overall quality matches what you pay. Portions could be slightly bigger, but the taste makes up for it.
Good choice if you are looking for a reliable restaurant in Pattaya, Tokyo-style cafe, or a casual dining spot in Central Festival Pattaya.
I would come back and recommend it.
sample_reviews_en.author: Jack “Mee” Hoff

sample_reviews_en.text:
Went there with my partner. My dish was wrong and took a long time to arrive, while my partner's was correct. No apology from the staff. The food was good, but the service needs improvement.

I went there with my partner. The staff served the wrong dish. My partner's dish was correct, but mine was wrong. We had to wait a long time for our food, and there was no apology at all. The food was delicious, but the service needs improvement. ☹️☹️
sample_reviews_en.author: Zoe Kavanagh

sample_reviews_en.text: They came to take away my plate while I was eating. They insisted on checking my drink even though I still had quite a bit left. It took about 20 minutes of my meal. It was over an hour until closing time. Even though the restaurant was empty to begin with, I was seated next to a group of small children. The staff training is poor. Now I understand why it was empty even on a Saturday evening. It was a mistake. I'll never go again.
sample_reviews_en.author: rio nito

sample_reviews_en.text: Went to the restaurant at 4pm, it was completely empty with 2-4 customers. Yet it took the staff more than 20 minutes just to make a smoothie. The service is extremely slow. And then it turned out that the smoothie was done and just staying on the bar desk, and nobody just brought it to my table. Very slow and poor service honestly, there are easily 5-6 staff working here yet even with no people the service is extremely slow.
sample_reviews_en.author: Vladislav B

sample_reviews_en.text: The service is terrible I had to wait one hour for a breakfast omelette with waffle and after one hour and 3 times I asked about my breakfast the waitress came to me and said that they can’t make it and to order something else after that I just asked for the check to get out of this place and they wouldn’t let me leave they got me spending 1.5 hours here without getting nothing other then the shake I ordered just terrible!!
sample_reviews_en.author: Itay - Team11

sample_reviews_en.text: I believe they forgot to put my order in as I was waiting for a while, and then she translated to me when I asked that the bill had not been placed. It was not busy. There were hardly any customers I should have known. The food was terrible, with no flavor and very watery like.
sample_reviews_en.author: Lisa

sample_reviews_en.text:
Im American so our food malls cant ever compare and I may be biased.

Salmon was fresh and cooked accordingly to my palate.  The rice was warm and delicious fragrant aroma. The drink was even made to order (no sugar, no syrup). The staff are well prepared for us english speaking guess which is also a plus!
sample_reviews_en.author: Gabriel Williams

sample_reviews_en.text: Nice all you can eat style restaurant, 3 price levels to choose from. Minus points: people sharing a table have to all order the same price level, no WiFi making it hard to order if you don't have a SIM card as orders are all done online via QR code. And the time limit is maximum 2 hours or even less.
sample_reviews_en.author: Boom Shankar BMSS Records

sample_reviews_en.text:
As a professional working in the F&B I was astonished by such a poor customer service level.

Being asked for a vaccination proof as a foreigner, to be noticed that to local Thai customers no such a think has been asked.

Staff extremely rude and looks like bothered by having to talk to customers....
sample_reviews_en.author: Andrea Picello

sample_reviews_en.text:
After finishing my dinner with Hamagi sushi
Ifelt it was not so fresh because the taste was not sweet and soft like ever from the other restaurants. Then in the morning I got food poisoning, so bad. I will not go to eat there in the future.
sample_reviews_en.author: Montree Udompataikul

sample_reviews_en.text: The food was alright and atmosphere is nice but customer service is EXTREMELY SLOW, the restaurant had only 7 seats, yet it took them 25 MINUTES to get one fish out.
sample_reviews_en.author: Korn Chaiwongkiat

sample_reviews_en.text: Food is just OK, staff lazy and not polite. Look at the huge service charge before ever giving a tip as they are guarenteed a tip from the arbitary tip.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mathew Nicholls

sample_reviews_en.text: The quality and services minded are still good with the standard of Chain Japanese restaurant for Thailand. It's kind of fresh raw material here.
sample_reviews_en.author: December19

sample_reviews_en.text: Service and food was alright, consider as a pricier meal compare to many other jap restaurant available around the corner. …

sample_reviews_en.text:
Well it’s one of those things where you pass a restaurant so many times and you never ever stop to really look at the menu I mean you do but then we just move onto another one and I’m so glad that my friend and I decide to meet here for lunch on a Sunday afternoon where it was really quiet and we could really take time to order what we wanted and the food was really good!!

Very clean and extensive menu with lots of different fun options to try!
Definitely going back again as prices are also very reasonable!!

Highly recommended 🍜🍜🍜🍜

How to find us: Make sure you follow us, Follow Fauzia around Bangkok and beyond and of course we have now been going to Phuket quite a bit so we got some amazing reviews in Phuket, honest, authentic and real! 💋💋
You can find Follow Fauzia on IG, FB and of course our YT channel has over 700 videos all vlogs on food reviews plus YT shorts are plenty. 💚💚🩷💚💚💚🩷🩷🩷🩷🩷💚💚💚
sample_reviews_en.author: Follow Fauzia

sample_reviews_en.text:
Located at Level G of Empire Tower, this casual restaurant offers South East Asian cuisine, it is part of the restaurant operations of Thai Beverage.

While food is ASEAN themed, the offerings are closer to Thai, Cambodian and Vietnamese rather than all ASEAN countries.

The seafood fried rice was good but would have been better if we get Nasi Goreng, Satay etc from Indonesia and Malaysia too. 2nd time tried the Thai Green Beef Curry.
sample_reviews_en.author: Soo Hin Yeoh

sample_reviews_en.text: Comfortable ambience and wonderfully polite servers. The restaurant is spacious and bright. The nasi lemak would have been great if it was cooked fresh - the chicken and rice was microwaved. The Vietnamese coffee is fabulous and strong (forget Starbucks!). I would return, just to taste the other dishes and enjoy the relaxing atmosphere.
sample_reviews_en.author: Zainal

sample_reviews_en.text:
There were only two customers when I came in (including me), however, the service was still pretty slow.

The staff was nice, the food and the price was average, perhaps because I went there for breakfast. Wouldn’t recommend it as a breakfast spot, there are other much nicer and more delicious spots nearby.
sample_reviews_en.author: Antonina Babych

sample_reviews_en.text: Placed on a G floor of Empire Tower and near BTS. There are many interesting choices from south east Asian countries on the menu BUT like third of them I had marked as sold out or unavailable. That takes a lot of wind from the sails of that concept of exploring ASEAN countries through food.
sample_reviews_en.author: Josef Čermák

sample_reviews_en.text: Went there at 2 pm on a Thursday and found a very surprising relaxed and quiet environment. Its modern, some staff speaks english, close to BTS, and reasonably priced. Definitly a good place for a date, lunch break or trying some new dishes. Some Malay, Thai, Vietnamese dishes available.
sample_reviews_en.author: Raul Peixoto

sample_reviews_en.text:
International food !!!
There are many menu from Asia which I never try before. The menu is super fancy, you cannot choose what you want to eat at that moment!!

I ordered Singapore Chicken Rice. The tase back then was so so, however I used to ordered other menu and it was worth to try.
sample_reviews_en.author: RattoWanderlust

sample_reviews_en.text:
They have - as a name suggests - all dishes from ASEAN.

It then deserves a recommendation from me at the first place.

A good flavor of the dish is enough to be assigned as a place to visit when you run out of idea at lunch time or welcoming customers or colleagues.
sample_reviews_en.author: โอฬาร

sample_reviews_th.text: Ordered on Grab. It’s good food but price is too high. ฿500 for Orange chicken and fried rice. Portion is good for rice, but I think it’s cheaper at home. I would order more but it’s too expensive in my opinion.
sample_reviews_th.author: William Scanlon

sample_reviews_en.text:
Quite disappointed with the portion size after paying for an upsize. Understand that if you pay to upgrade the size from 16oz to 32oz, you’re just going to get a bigger container filled slightly above halfway. Unacceptable considering the upgrade fee brings the price to B280 for maybe 17oz of General Tso
chicken.

Compared to may other restaurants, the prices are about outrageous. They’re almost 50% more than similar restaurants with food that taste almost the same. Their prices cannot be justified in portions, flavor or quality. The most flavorful item was the crab ragoon.

Glad they replied. Price on grab for General Tso is B280. Where do you get B140 from?

I will gladly stay as far away from your restaurant as possible. No chance at a recommendation from me either.
sample_reviews_en.author: Eric Davis

sample_reviews_en.text:
Delicious food here!

In addition to American style Chinese food, the restaurant has a 2nd menu of American BBQ. 😋

We went for the Chinese food this time.
Great egg drop soup and hot/sour/spicy soup.
The Mongolian beef was also amazing

Service is good. The servers understand the English menu 👍 😌 😊

The atmosphere has both inside and outside seating. Inside is very clean and well air conditioned.
Outside has a few tables in the shade.

Prices are a bit expensive, but the food quality is very good.
sample_reviews_en.author: Doctor Kutchapeckeroff

sample_reviews_en.text:
These people think that we are here for them not the other way around. They will not take orders the day before, which would help them, and they insist on being paid upfront. The restaurant itself lacks atmosphere and is dark and dingy. The staff are surly. No wonder the place has changed hands several times because clearly the staff run the restaurant not the owner.

This restaurant has been the Hungry Panda, the American Grill and Let’s Wok
. Why? All of them have had the same staff problems.
sample_reviews_en.author: Mike Wall

sample_reviews_en.text: As a person who suffers from gout my Only issues were when I ordered some spring roll and it was vegetable spring roll no one told me that inside had mushrooms inside of them once I had one and found out I called my doctor immediately thank goodness nothing serious I just pluck the rest of the mushroom put the reminding two spring rolls but the food was amazingly delicious in every way I am going back this Friday for another round of their delicious amazing food keep up the good work
sample_reviews_en.author: Chucky Harris

sample_reviews_en.text: Been meaning to go here for sometime now and finally made it happen. I was looking for some good ole American style Chinese food and I definitely found it here. They are located on Soi Lengkee. The big sign out front says American Bar & Grill with a smaller sign for Let’s Wok! Now for the food. Like I said, I wanted American/Chinese and they delivered. I had the honey glazed chicken and fried rice and my friend had the sweet & sour port with fried rice. Both dishes were excellent.
sample_reviews_en.author: Steve Miller

sample_reviews_en.text: I ordered noodles with vegetables together with orange chicken. The noodles didn't have any vegetables except for a lot of onions and a bit of sprouts so I complained. I had to wait for the addition of the vegetables too long, my chicken got cold. The broccoli had some sand and the noodles themselves were quite tasteless. The excuse was that they had a lot of customers but there were only six customers in the restaurant. Not a  second time for me.
sample_reviews_en.author: Johan Kwaaitaal

sample_reviews_en.text: Legit American style orange chicken, crab ran goons, lo mein, and even American sodas like Mtn Dew, Root Beer, etc. Suggest ordering "house" fried rice or lo mein as it will be packed with everything (shrimp, meats, veggies) and sometimes order extra sauce to add to your meal in case too dry.  Also, the house made chili paste is not too spicy, crunchy, and tastes good on everything! Chinese delivery in the little paper boxes your used to.
sample_reviews_en.author: Benji Harrison

sample_reviews_th.text:
I had a terrible experience when I went to eat there with two friends.
1. They didn't have the 10฿ chicken skewers (they used to).
2. The dipping sauce wasn't free (during lunchtime), even though it was free 2-3 days before when I ate there.
3. I didn't get the 50฿ discount coupon (for bills over 250฿) because the staff said they were out of coupons.
4. After eating and paying, I asked for my loyalty points coupon.
There was no response until I had to repeatedly ask about the loyalty point stamp.

I've eaten here about 3-4 times before (and was very impressed), but this time I'm done with it. I won't be going back.
sample_reviews_th.author: Sukanya Srivilai

sample_reviews_th.text:
What sets this place apart from others is that, in addition to the two soup options, you can also grill.

Price: Very affordable.
Food Quality: Great value for money, appropriate portion sizes.

Taste: You can request your preferred level of spiciness for the mala soup.
The restaurant's signature sauce is also delicious and pairs well with the shabu-shabu.

Location: Located opposite Seacon Square, easy to find. Park in the mall and cross the pedestrian bridge.

*Spend 300฿ or more to get a 50฿ discount coupon.*
*For future coupons, spend 200฿ or more to get a discount.*
sample_reviews_th.author: Sarita Tan

sample_reviews_en.text: The restaurant is clean, the seating isn't crowded, and it's not hot. The food is fresh and clean, with a wide variety to choose from. The staff are attentive and constantly refill the food, so it never runs out – which is great! They have several dipping sauces you can customize to your liking, although their own recipe isn't very strong. ^^ As for the soup, those who like it very spicy might not like it; it's a bit bland, but not bad. For parking, I recommend parking in Seacon Square and walking across the pedestrian bridge, or finding parking in the nearby alley. Motorcycles are probably more convenient in front of the restaurant. P.S. I love their chopsticks; they're high-quality wooden chopsticks and, importantly, long enough for easy picking up food. 👍🏻
sample_reviews_en.author: Manuschanok Pengthina

sample_reviews_en.text: This is one of my favorite mala restaurants; I eat there often and recommend it to everyone. However, on my last visit at lunchtime, I saw a sign advertising a buffet starting at 12:00 PM and was excited to try it. But when I got there, the staff said the buffet only opens at 5:00 PM; currently, only à la carte is available. I was confused. I even asked repeatedly, "But the sign says we're open from 12:00 PM to 11:00 PM," but the staff couldn't answer, only saying "We open at 5:00 PM." That was it. My positive experience was ruined. I felt like I was tricked. I would have understood and accepted the buffet opening time if it was advertised, but it was disappointing to see the buffet sign only to find out I couldn't eat there.
sample_reviews_en.author: Sasitorn. Snp

sample_reviews_en.text:
💜There are 2 parking spaces in front of the shop + 3-4 spaces in front of the clinic next door, but there's also parking behind the shop (you'll need to ask).
🩷Soup is 49 baht, dipping sauce is 30 baht. The only pork available is pork neck (50 baht per plate), beef (50 baht per plate), and fatty pork skewers (20 baht each) (the pork is thick and chewy). There are no ramen noodles.
🩵The atmosphere inside the shop is comfortable and not cramped. The chairs are comfortable, and there's no need to queue. The dipping sauce recipe is posted, and the taste is okay, not quite like Haidilao, but more affordable.
sample_reviews_en.author: mil Sd

sample_reviews_en.text: This is a conveyor belt mala hotpot restaurant in a single shop unit, with 18 seats, located opposite Seacon Square Srinakarin. I went in the evening and it was busy. The taste and price are good. A special feature is the small grill option for 69 baht, while the soup pot alone is 49 baht, and the dipping sauce is 29 baht. It's slightly more economical than the market leaders. There's parking for about 3 cars in front of the shop, and you can also park in the large parking lot further down Srinakarin Soi 40.
sample_reviews_en.author: yimp yimpdow

sample_reviews_en.text: The shop is small and clean, offering a dual experience of spicy food and barbecue on a conveyor belt. The ingredients are fresh and the portions are generous, and the DIY dipping sauce is fun. The broth can be adjusted to different levels of spiciness, but it's not spicy enough. At around 300 baht per person, it's good value. There are only 3 parking spaces; it's recommended to park at Seacon and use the skybridge. Even when it gets crowded in the evening, the service remains attentive.
sample_reviews_en.author: 曼谷上门服务Outcall Services

sample_reviews_en.text:
The atmosphere is great, it's clean, and I was very impressed with the staff.
They were very attentive and provided excellent service.
Parking at Seacon Square and walking across is convenient.
It's not crowded during the day.
At night, in the evening, it starts to get busier. There's parking for about 3 cars, but you should call the restaurant beforehand to check if there's space. Motorcycles can be parked all day, very convenient.
sample_reviews_en.author: Wimonrat Laksameeopas
